english_verse: Then seven ugly, skinny cows came up out of the river and
translation_verse: Nɛ-kɔnnʋŋ balɩpɛ ma lɩɩ fuo-la lɛ a kʋ lɩɩ chɩŋ a kpagɛ nɛ-duoru-la sɩ chɩŋ fuo-la niiŋ.

english_verse: ate the fat, healthy cows. When this happened, the king woke up.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɛ-kɔnnʋ-la paa nɛ-duoru-la balɩpɛ a liŋ, Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro hirige sii doŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The king went back to sleep and had another dream. This time seven full heads of grain were growing on a single stalk.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra pɩŋ doŋ a bɩra duosi a na kuorimii-daa-bala pagɩlɛ pagɩlɩ-duoruŋ balɩpɛ.

english_verse: Later, seven other heads of grain appeared, but they were thin and scorched by a wind from the desert.
translation_verse: Ʋ harɩŋ ʋ bɩra na kuorimii-pʋgʋŋ dɩ ʋ ma pagɩlɛ pagɩlaa balɩpɛ, wulumuŋ kɛŋ ba fʋgʋmɛ.

english_verse: The thin heads of grain swallowed the seven full heads. Again the king woke up, and it had only been a dream.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuorimii-fʋgʋmɩa-la balɩpɛ paa kuorimii-duoru-la balɩpɛ liŋ. Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro hirige sii, dɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The next morning the king was upset. So he called in his magicians and wise men and told them what he had dreamed. None of them could tell him what the dreams meant.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ sii chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla, ʋ tʋɔŋ kala vʋgʋmɛ. Ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ jaŋ wʋjɩnnaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa chichiribe kala hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a bʋl ʋ duoso-la pɩba, ama nʋʋkala bɩ wuo dagɛ duoso-la bʋbʋɔŋ pʋ.

english_verse: The king's personal servant said: Now I remember what I was supposed to do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro nyʋnyʋalɩ koruru-hɩaŋ-la bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Jɩnɩŋ mɩ liisi wɩɩ nɛ mɩ sɩ ŋaa chei.

english_verse: When you were angry with me and your chief cook, you threw us both in jail in the house of the captain of the guard.
translation_verse: Kuoro, bʋa-la lɛ ŋ fa sɩ na baanɩŋ a kɛŋ mɩ dɩ ŋ boroboro wasɩrʋ-hɩaŋ kaa mʋ tɔ dɩa ŋɩɩ laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔŋ nɩhɩaŋ dɩa lɛ,

english_verse: One night we both had dreams, and each dream had a different meaning.
translation_verse: la balɩa kala duosi duosoo tɩta-bala, duoso-na kala arɩ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: A young Hebrew, who was a servant of the captain of the guard, was there with us at the time. When we told him our dreams, he explained what each of them meant,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Hiburu bapʋɔsɩ-bie kʋbala ma fa hɛ la tʋɔŋ a ŋaa laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔŋ nɩhɩaŋ tɩntɩnnʋ. La bʋl la duoso-la pʋ, ʋ wuo dagɛ la kʋŋkala duoso bʋbʋɔŋ pɩla.

english_verse: and everything happened just as he said it would. I got my job back, and the cook was put to death.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala pɩla nɛ sɛnɛ ŋaa. Mɩ mɩɩra kɔ mɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa, ka ba lieŋi ŋ boroboro wasɩrʋ-la ma.”

english_verse: The king sent for Joseph, who was quickly brought out of jail. He shaved, changed his clothes, and went to the king.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro tɩŋ ba mʋ lɩɩsɛ Josɛf nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa lɛ lɩma lɩma, a kaa kɔ. Ʋʋ kɔ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro sɩpaaŋ dɩ ʋ fʋŋ ʋ tɔŋŋɔɔ, a wuri ʋ nɩtɔɔrɩ gɛnnɩŋ aŋ laalɛ gɛrɩ falaa.

english_verse: The king said to him, “I had a dream, yet no one can explain what it means. I am told that you can interpret dreams.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro bʋla pɩ Josɛf, “Mɩ duoso nɛ, ka nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ dagɛ ba bʋbʋɔŋ pɩmɛ. Ama mɩ nɩa dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bʋl ʋ duosoo pɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: “Your Majesty,” Joseph answered, “I can't do it myself, but God can give a good meaning to your dreams.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf bʋla pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro a bʋl, “Mɩ-na bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ, ama Wɩa nɛ jaŋ wuo dagɛ ŋ duoso-la bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: The king told Joseph: I dreamed I was standing on the bank of the Nile River.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro bʋla pɩ Josɛf, “Mɩ duosoo lɛ, mɩ na arɩ mɩ chɩŋ fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Naayɩl niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I saw seven fat, healthy cows come up out of the river, and they began feeding on the grass.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɛ-duoruŋ balɩpɛ kʋ lɩɩ fuo-la lɛ a didii yaŋ.

english_verse: Next, seven skinny, bony cows came up out of the river. I have never seen such terrible looking cows anywhere in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, nɛ-kɔnnʋŋ balɩpɛ ma lɩɩ fuo-la lɛ, mɩ ha bɩ nɛ-lɔrʋnʋŋ deemba doho na Ijipiti tinteeŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: The skinny cows ate the fat ones.
translation_verse: Nɛ-kɔnnʋ-la paa nɛ-duoru-la balɩpɛ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kʋ lɩɩ a liŋ.

english_verse: But you couldn't tell it, because these skinny cows were just as skinny as they were before. At once, I woke up.
translation_verse: Ba paa liŋ aŋ ha nagɛ ba nagɩsɩŋ arɩ ba bɩ kʋŋkala die. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sii doŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then seven other heads of grain came up. They were thin and scorched by a wind from the desert.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, kuorimii-daa-la tɩtɩa bɩra pagɩlɛ pagɩlaa balɩpɛ, wulumuŋ kɛŋ ba fʋgʋmɛ a hɩl.

english_verse: These heads of grain swallowed the full ones. I told my dreams to the magicians, but none of them could tell me the meaning of the dreams.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuorimii-fʋgʋmɩa-la paa kuorimii-duoru-la liŋ. Mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩ mɩ tinteeŋ chichiribe kala, ama ba kʋŋkala bɩ wuo dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: Joseph replied: Your Majesty, both of your dreams mean the same thing, and in them God has shown what he is going to do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf bʋla pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro, “Kuoro, ŋ duoso-la balɩa kala bʋbʋɔŋ ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Wɩa joŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ ŋaa nɛ a dagɩŋ.

english_verse: The seven good cows stand for seven years, and so do the seven good heads of grain.
translation_verse: Nɛ-duoru-la balɩpɛ ŋaa jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ nɛ, kuorimii-duoru-la balɩpɛ ma ŋaa jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ nɛ. Duoso-la balɩa kala bʋbʋɔŋ ŋaa wʋbala nɛ.

english_verse: The seven skinny, ugly cows that came up later also stand for seven years, as do the seven bad heads of grain that were scorched by the desert wind. The dreams mean there will be seven years when there won't be enough grain.
translation_verse: Nɛ-kɔnnʋ-la balɩpɛ sɩ lɔrɔ arɩ kuorimii-pagɩlɛ-la balɩpɛ wulumuŋ sɩ kɛnɛ ba fʋgʋmɛ a hɩl kala ŋaa jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ nɛ losuŋ sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ.

english_verse: It is just as I said—God has shown what he intends to do.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩ ŋ-na Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro ŋɩɩ arɩ wɩɩ nɛ Wɩa joŋo dagɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa.

english_verse: For seven years Egypt will have more than enough grain,
translation_verse: Jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ bʋa lɛ kʋdiilee jaŋ pʋrɩgɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: The famine will be so bad that no one will remember that once there had been plenty.
translation_verse: Kʋdii-daŋ-la fa sɩ jʋʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, ba jaŋ yʋ ba wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa, losu-la sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ jaŋ chaasa-lɔrɛ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: God has given you two dreams to let you know that he has definitely decided to do this and that he will do it soon.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ŋ-na Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro duoso-la ŋaa balɩa bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ Wɩa chaasɛ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni.

english_verse: Your Majesty, you should find someone who is wise and will know what to do, so that you can put him in charge of all Egypt.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ ʋ maga dɩ ŋ-na Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro lɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ jegile nɩɩ wɩaa a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a leŋ dɩ tɩɩna bibeŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Then appoint some other officials to collect one fifth of every crop harvested in Egypt during the seven years when there is plenty.
translation_verse: Kuoro, leŋ dɩ ba liisi nɩhɩasɩŋ dɩ ba bibeŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ. Jɩsɩ-la balɩpɛ kʋdiilee sɩ jaŋ pʋrɩgɛ tintee-la lɛ, dɩ ba kɛŋ kʋdiile-la kaa kpaa leree banɔŋ a joŋ kʋbala tʋɔlɛ.

english_verse: Give them the power to collect the grain during those good years and to store it in your cities.
translation_verse: Nɩhɩasɩŋ deemba maga dɩ ba laa kʋdiilee jɩsɩŋ deemba balɩpɛ kɩaa sɩ jaŋ pʋrɩgɛ lɛ a tʋɔlɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro yɩrɩŋ lɛ tabalaa kala lɛ.

english_verse: It can be stored until it is needed during the seven years when there won't be enough grain in Egypt. This will keep the country from being destroyed because of the lack of food. Joseph Is Made Governor over Egypt
translation_verse: Kʋdiilee deemba nɛ ma jaŋ joŋo tʋɔlɛ a pɔ jɩsɩ-la balɩpɛ losuŋ sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ tintee-la chei.”

english_verse: The king and his officials liked this plan.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩŋ woruŋ a pɩ kuoro arɩ ʋ nɩhɩasɩŋ kala.

english_verse: So the king said to them, “Who could possibly handle this better than Joseph? After all, the Spirit of God is with him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro pɩɛsɛ ʋ nɩhɩasɩŋ, “La jaŋ bɩra wuo na nʋʋ sɩ nagɛ baala deeŋ Wɩa dɩma-la hɛ ʋ lɛ?”

english_verse: The king told Joseph, “God is the one who has shown you these things. No one else is as wise as you are or knows as much as you do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro bʋla pɩ Josɛf, “Wɩa sɩ leŋe ŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala, nʋʋkala bɩra tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a magɩŋ.

english_verse: I'm putting you in charge of my palace, and everybody will have to obey you. No one will be over you except me.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ jaŋ bibeŋ mɩ kuoru-dɩa, mɩ nɩaa kala jaŋ tuto ŋ niiŋ. Mɩ kuoru kpasa dʋndʋŋa nɛ mɩ jaŋ kaa kɩɩŋ.” Ba joŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ hɛ Josɛf nɩsɩŋ lɛ

english_verse: Then the king took off his royal ring and put it on Joseph's finger. He gave him fine clothes to wear and placed a gold chain around his neck.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro lɩɩsɛ ʋ kuori-nenii-pɩrɩŋ a hɛ Josɛf neniiŋ lɛ a leŋ ba laalʋ gɛrɩ-balaa a joŋ sɛlɩmɛ banzɔlɔ a hɛ ʋ baŋŋaa.

english_verse: He also let him ride in the chariot next to his own, and people shouted, “Make way for Joseph!” So Joseph was governor of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋ ba joŋu hɛ jaaba toruko lɛ, a kaa gɔllɔ dagɛ arɩ ʋ nɛ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ, ka nɩaa ŋɩŋaa goŋ, aa bʋl, “Má ka wombiiŋ, má ka wombiiŋ. Baala deeŋ nɛ ba joŋo hɛ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kala.”

english_verse: The king told Joseph, “Although I'm king, no one in Egypt is to do anything without your permission.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro bʋla pɩ Josɛf, “Mɩ nɛ ŋaa kuoro, ama dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ wombiiŋ pa, nʋʋkala tuo Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ.”

english_verse: He gave Joseph the Egyptian name Zaphenath Paneah. And he let him marry Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, a priest in the city of Heliopolis. Joseph traveled all over Egypt.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro hɛ Josɛf yɩrɩŋ Zefena-Panɩa. Ʋ joŋ Pɔtɩfɛra tolo Asɛnaf pʋ ʋ jaa. Pɔtɩfɛra nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɔŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf sii gɔllɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kala.

english_verse: For seven years there were big harvests of grain.
translation_verse: Jɩsɩ-la balɩpɛ sɩ zɔmɔ tʋɔŋ kʋdiilee faasa pʋrɩgɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Joseph collected and stored up the extra grain in the cities of Egypt near the fields where it was harvested.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf laa kʋdiilee jɩsɩ-la balɩpɛ-la tʋɔŋ kʋdiilee sɩ pʋrɩga Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a tʋɔlɛba tabalaa lɛ. Taŋ-kala nɩaa kɛŋ kʋdiilee mʋ hɛ tabal-la sɩ kpagʋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: In fact, there was so much grain that they stopped keeping record, because it was like counting the grains of sand along the beach.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf laa kʋdiile-la a tʋɔlɛ ba chʋɔrɛ woruŋ a nagɛ hagɩlɩ-bumbugulo sɩ chʋɔrɛ mʋga niiŋ. A tɩŋ kʋdiilee sɩ faasa yʋgɛ a kɩɩ magɩsɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩra bɩ magɩsɛ.

english_verse: Their first son was named Manasseh, which means, “God has let me forget all my troubles and my family back home.”
translation_verse: Josɛf hɛ ʋ bii-hɩaŋ yɩrɩŋ Manasɛ, aŋ bʋl, “Wɩa leŋe mɩ yʋ mɩ hɛɛ-la kala mɩ sɩ na, arɩ mɩ nyɩmma dɩa ma wɩaa kala nɛ.”

english_verse: His second son was named Ephraim, which means “God has made me a success in the land where I suffered.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ hɛ ʋ bii-lɩa-la ma yɩrɩŋ Efirem aŋ bʋl, “Wɩa leŋe mɩ dʋa nɛ tintee-la lɛ mɩ sɩ na hɛɛŋ.”

english_verse: Egypt's seven years of plenty came to an end,
translation_verse: Jɩsɩ-la balɩpɛ lɛ, kʋdiilee sɩ pʋrɩgɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ kʋ kieli,

english_verse: and the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. There was not enough food in other countries, but all over Egypt there was plenty.
translation_verse: aŋ ka jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ-la losuŋ sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ suomi arɩ Josɛf fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ losuŋ jʋʋ tintee-la kala sɩ kpagɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, ama kʋdiilee hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: When the famine finally struck Egypt, the people asked the king for food, but he said, “Go to Joseph and do what he tells you to do.”
translation_verse: Losuŋ sɩ suomo jʋjʋʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, nɩalɩŋ suomo yele pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro a chɩchɛ kʋdiilee. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro bʋla pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ nɩaa kala, “Má mʋ Josɛf teeŋ, ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la kala pɩma, ma ŋaa.”

english_verse: The famine became bad everywhere in Egypt, so Joseph opened the storehouses and sold the grain to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: Losuŋ sɩ jʋʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kala, ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf suri lere-la ba sɩ tʋɔlɛ kʋdiile-la a suomo yallɛ kʋdiile-la pɩpɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa losuŋ chaasɛ jʋʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: People from all over the world came to Egypt to buy grain, because the famine was so severe in their countries.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala kɔ Ijipiti tinteeŋ dɩ ba yɔɔ kʋdiilee Josɛf leriŋ.

english_verse: When Jacob found out there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, “Why are you just sitting here, staring at one another?
translation_verse: Jekɔb sɩ nɩa dɩ kʋdiilee hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma hɔnɔ bibeŋ dɔŋɔ ŋ-la?”

english_verse: I have heard there is grain in Egypt. Go down and buy some, so we won't starve to death.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jekɔb bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ nɩa arɩ kuori-mɩaa hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Má mʋ nɩmɛ a yɔɔ dɔnsʋŋ kɔ dɩ la ma dii a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: Ten of Joseph's brothers went to Egypt to buy grain.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf naambiiri-la fii sii mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ dɩ ba yɔɔ kuori-mɩa-la.

english_verse: But Jacob did not send Joseph's younger brother Benjamin with them; he was afraid that something might happen to him.
translation_verse: Ama Jekɔb bɩ leŋe Josɛf ŋaana Bɛnjamɩŋ to ba harɩŋ mʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛnʋ nɛ arɩ ba jaŋ ŋaa ʋ ma wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: Since Joseph was governor of Egypt and in charge of selling grain, his brothers came to him and bowed with their faces to the ground.
translation_verse: Josɛf nɛ fa ŋaa kʋhɩaŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ nɛ fa yallɛ kuori-mɩaa pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ kala tintee-la lɛ. Josɛf naambiiriŋ sɩ kɔ, ba tuu kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlʋ.

english_verse: Joseph remembered what he had dreamed about them and said, “You're spies! You've come here to find out where our country is weak.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf liise yi ʋ duoso-la lɛ ʋ sɩ duoso a tɩgɛ ʋ naambiiriŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma kɔ dɩ ma na wɩɩ-la la sɩ kaa hɔŋ nɛ, maa chɛ dɩ ma na la bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: “No sir,” they replied. “We're your servants, and we have only come to buy grain.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “La nɩhɩaŋ, ŋɩɩ dee, la-na ŋ tɩntɩnnaa kɔ dɩ la yɔɔ kʋdiilee nɛ.

english_verse: We're honest men, and we come from the same family—we're not spies.”
translation_verse: La kala ŋaa ba-bala biiriŋ nɛ. La kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, la bɩ kɔ dɩ la na wɩɩ-la ma sɩ kaa hɔŋ.”

english_verse: “That isn't so!” Joseph insisted. “You've come here to find out where our country is weak.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf bɩra bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ dee, ma kɔ dɩ ma na wɩɩ-la la sɩ kaa hɔŋ la tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: But they explained, “Sir, we come from a family of twelve brothers. The youngest is still with our father in Canaan, and one of our brothers is dead.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ma bʋl, “La fa ŋaa fii arɩ balɩa nɛ a kala ŋaa ba-bala biiriŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ. La tʋɔŋ kʋbie hɛ la nyɩmma teeŋ aŋ ka dɔŋɔ ma tuo ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: and I'm going to find out the truth. I swear by the life of the king that you won't leave this place until your youngest brother comes here.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ma sɩ jaŋ to a laa ma tɩtɩa nɛ ŋ-la: Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, ma bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ma lɩɩ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ see dɩ ma kɛŋ ma ŋaana kaa kɔ daha.

english_verse: Choose one of you to go after your brother, while the rest of you stay here in jail. That will show whether you are telling the truth. But if you are lying, I swear by the life of the king that you are spies!
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ma dɔŋɔ mʋ kɛŋ ma ŋaana kɔ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ ma kʋkaanaa tɔ dɩa, dɩ la na wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ma ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɔ dɩ ma na wɩɩ-la la sɩ kaa hɔŋ la tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Joseph kept them all under guard for three days,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛmba kala tɔ dɩa tapʋlaa batori.

english_verse: before saying to them: Since I respect God, I'll give you a chance to save your lives.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf bʋla pɩba tapʋl tori-la chɛɛŋ, “Mɩ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩɩ fá Wɩa nɛ, má ŋaa ŋ-la aŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ:

english_verse: If you are honest men, one of you must stay here in jail, and the rest of you can take the grain back to your starving families.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ma dɔŋɔ jaŋ hɛ bɩnɩŋ dɩa lɛ, ka dɩ ma kʋkaanaa kɛŋ kʋdiilee mʋ pɩ ma dɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ sʋʋ losuŋ.

english_verse: But you must bring your youngest brother to me. Then I'll know that you are telling the truth, and you won't be put to death. Joseph's brothers agreed
translation_verse: Ama ʋ maga dɩ ma kɛŋ ma naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ kʋbie-la a kaa kɔ mɩ teeŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋaa wɩɩ-la Josɛf sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: and said to one another, “We're being punished because of Joseph. We saw the trouble he was in, but we refused to help him when he begged us. That's why these terrible things are happening.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, hɛɛŋ deeŋ la sɩɩ na tɩgɛ wɩɩ-la la sɩ joŋo ŋaa la naambie lɛ nɛ. La na ʋ sɩ chaasa sʋlla ŋɩɩ woruŋ a tɩgɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ka la bɩ jegile nɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ hɛɛŋ deeŋ puula ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Reuben spoke up, “Didn't I tell you not to harm the boy? But you wouldn't listen, and now we have to pay the price for killing him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rubiŋ pɩɛsɛ, “Mɩ fa bɩ bʋla pɩma arɩ má sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ joŋo ŋaa bile deeŋ lɛ? Ama ma bɩ jegile. Ʋ chɩmɩŋ nɩɩ tiŋ la lɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: They did not know that Joseph could understand them, since he was speaking through an interpreter.
translation_verse: Ba fa bɩ jɩŋ dɩ Josɛf nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ bʋl, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa bʋl wɩaa nʋʋ nɛ laa bʋla pɩba.

english_verse: Joseph turned away from them and cried, but soon he turned back and spoke to them again. Then he had Simeon tied up and taken away while they watched. Joseph's Brothers Return to Canaan
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf jɩɩgɛ mʋa aŋ yel, aŋ mɩɩra kɔ a bʋl wɩaa ʋ naambiiriŋ teeŋ. Ʋ leŋ ba kɛŋ Simioŋ vɔɔ ʋ naambiiri-la sɩpaaŋ a kɛnʋ viiri.

english_verse: Joseph gave orders for his brothers' grain sacks to be filled with grain and for their money to be put in their sacks. He also gave orders for them to be given food for their journey home. After this was done,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf leŋ ba ŋaa kuori-mɩaa su ba bɔtɔba aŋ bɩra joŋ kʋŋkala moribiee ma hɛ ba bɔtɔba tʋɔŋ, aŋ pɛ pɩba kʋdiilee dɩ ba kaa dii vɩvɛŋ wombiiŋ lɛ. Ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ a pɩba,

english_verse: they each loaded the grain on their donkeys and left.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ nɛ ba paa kuori-mɩa-la daŋ ba kakusuŋ lɛ a viiri.

english_verse: When they stopped for the night, one of them opened his sack to get some grain for his donkey, and at once he saw his moneybag.
translation_verse: Lee-la ba sɩ mʋa dɩ ba chʋa, ba dɔŋɔ puri ʋ bɔtɔ dɩ ʋ ŋaa kuori-mɩaa pɩ ʋ kakumo, a na ʋ moribiiŋ bɔtɔ-la lɛ.

english_verse: “Here's my money!” he told his brothers. “Right here in my sack.” They were trembling with fear as they stared at one another and asked themselves, “What has God done to us?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, “Ba mɩɩra joŋ mɩ moribiiŋ pɩmɛ nɛ, na ʋ nɛ hɛ bɔtɔ tʋɔŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hirigi, ba bɔɩsɩŋ joŋ, ba pɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Bɛɛ nɛ Wɩa ŋaala lɛ ŋ-la?”

english_verse: When they returned to the land of Canaan, they told their father Jacob everything that had happened to them:
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɔ ba nyɩmma Jekɔb teeŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ, ba bʋl wɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaaba lɛ a pʋ. Ba sɩ,

english_verse: We come from a family of twelve brothers. The youngest is still with our father in Canaan, and the other is dead.”
translation_verse: La fa ŋaa naambiiriŋ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ la nyɩmma lʋl, dɔŋɔ tuo ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, aŋ ka la kala kʋbie hɛ la nyɩmma teeŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ ŋ-la.’

english_verse: Then the governor of Egypt told us, “I'll find out if you really are honest. Leave one of your brothers here with me, while you take the grain to your starving families.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ taŋ-la kʋhɩaŋ-la bʋla pɩla, ‘Ŋ-la lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo to jɩŋ arɩ ma ŋaa nɩtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Má leŋ ma naambie dɔŋɔ hɔŋ mɩ teeŋ, ka dɩ ma kʋkaanaa kɛŋ kʋdiilee mʋ pɩ ma dɩa nɩaa dɩ ba sɩ́ losuŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: But bring your youngest brother to me, so I can be certain that you are honest men and not spies. After that, I'll let your other brother go free, and you can stay here and trade.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ ma tʋɔŋ kʋbie kaa kʋ dagɛmɛ, mɩ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ma bɩ kɔ dɩ ma na wɩɩ-la la sɩ kaa hɔŋ la tinteeŋ lɛ, ama ma ŋaa nɩtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ joŋ ma naambie pɩma ka dɩ ma didii yɔbɔ la tinteeŋ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: When the brothers started emptying their sacks of grain, they found their moneybags in them. They were frightened, and so was their father Jacob,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba chusi ba bɔtɔba. Ba sɩ chusi ba bɔtɔba, ba kʋŋkala na moribie-la ba bɔtɔba tʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ ba dɩ ba nyɩmma Jekɔb kala.

english_verse: who said, “You have already taken my sons Joseph and Simeon from me. And now you want to take away Benjamin! Everything is against me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba nyɩmma Jekɔb bʋl, “Maa chɛ dɩ mɩ biiriŋ kala lɛl mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛɛ? Josɛf tuo, Simioŋ ma tuo, aŋ ka ma bɩraa chɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ Bɛnjamɩŋ ma ŋ-la. Wɩaa deemba kala ma kaa jʋʋ mɩ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Reuben spoke up, “Father, if I don't bring Benjamin back, you can kill both of my sons. Trust me with him, and I'll bring him back.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rubiŋ bʋla pɩ ʋ nyɩmma, “Kpʋ mɩ hambolibiisiŋ balɩa-la, dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ mɩɩra kɛŋ Bɛnjamɩŋ kaa kɔ. Joŋ Bɛnjamɩŋ hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ kɔ.”

english_verse: But Jacob said, “I won't let my son Benjamin go down to Egypt with the rest of you. His brother is already dead, and he is the only son I have left. I am an old man, and if anything happens to him on the way, I'll die from sorrow, and all of you will be to blame.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jekɔb bʋl, “Mɩ bie bɩ jaŋ to ma harɩŋ mʋ nɩmɛ, ʋ malɩma sʋba nɛ aŋ ka ʋ dʋndʋŋa. Dɩ ma nɩɩ mʋ, dɩ wɩɩ ŋaaʋ wombiiŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩ nyu-pʋmpʋllʋŋ deemba kaa tuu bʋa arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ.”

english_verse: The famine in Canaan got worse,
translation_verse: Losuŋ wasa jʋʋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: until finally, Jacob's family had eaten all the grain they had bought in Egypt. So Jacob said to his sons, “Go back and buy some more grain.”
translation_verse: Jekɔb arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa sɩ dii kuori-mɩa-la ba sɩ yɔbɔ a lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kʋ dɛrɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Jekɔb bɩra bʋla pɩ ʋ biiriŋ, “Má mɩɩra mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a bɩra yɔɔ kʋdiilee mʋa kaa kɔ dɩ la pɛ la tɩtɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: Judah replied, “The governor strictly warned us that we would not be allowed to see him unless we brought our youngest brother with us. If you let us take Benjamin along, we will go and buy grain. But we won't go without him!”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ ʋ to la harɩŋ mʋ, la ma bɩ jaŋ mʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa baal-la chaasa bʋla pɩla arɩ ʋ bɩ jaŋ beŋ la sɩaa lɛ, see dɩ la ŋaana guoli la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Jacob asked, “Why did you cause me so much trouble by telling the governor you had another brother?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ wɩɩ nɛ ma lɔgɛ hɛ mɩ lɛ ŋ-la? Ma ŋaa ɛɛ nɛ a bʋla pɩ baal-la arɩ ma ha kɛŋ naambii nɛ?”

english_verse: They answered, “He asked a lot of questions about us and our family. He wanted to know if you were still alive and if we had any more brothers. All we could do was answer his questions. How could we know he would tell us to bring along our brother?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Baal-la chaasa pɩɛsɛla wɩaa nɛ woruŋ a tɩgɛ la dɩa nɩaa lɛ. Ʋ pɩɛsɛla, ‘Ma nyɩmma ha hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛɛ? Ma ha kɛŋ naambii dɔŋ nɛɛ?’ Ʋ sɩ pɩɛsɛla wɩalɩŋ kala nɛ la daga pʋ. Ɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaa jɩŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ bʋl dɩ la to kɛŋ la ŋaana kɔ?”

english_verse: Then Judah said to his father, “Let Benjamin go with me, and we will leave at once, so that none of us will starve to death.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juda bʋla pɩ ʋ nyɩmma Iziral, “Leŋ dɩ bile to la harɩŋ dɩ la mʋ, dɩ losuŋ sɩ́ la dɩ la biiriŋ kala kpʋ.

english_verse: If we had not wasted all this time, we could already have been there and back twice.”
translation_verse: Faafaa-la kala la sɩ bʋla, dɩ ŋ nɛ fa sɛyɛ, ŋ-la la fa vɛŋ lee-la bʋlɩa.”

english_verse: Their father said: If Benjamin must go with you, take the governor a gift of some of the best things from our own country, such as perfume, honey, spices, pistachio nuts, and almonds.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba nyɩmma Iziral bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ ŋ-la nɛ jaŋ chɩŋ, má leŋ dɩ la chɛ la tinteeŋ tɩɩ-nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ, tʋʋŋ mʋa, tɩɩ-kel-sʋɔrʋsʋŋ arɩ kʋdiilee tegisiŋ a kaa mʋ pɩ baal-la.

english_verse: Also take along twice the amount of money for the grain, because there must have been some mistake when the money was put back in your sacks.
translation_verse: Má joŋ moribii-la ma fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kaa mʋ yɔɔ kʋdiile-la magɛ ŋɩɩ bʋlɩa, bɛɛ wɩaa moribie-la sɩ hɛ ma bɔtɔba tʋɔŋ ma kaa mɩɩra kɔ, ŋ bɩ pɔ ba perige nɛ.

english_verse: Take Benjamin with you and leave at once.
translation_verse: Má to kɛŋ ma ŋaana mʋ baal-la teeŋ lɩma.

english_verse: When you go in to see the governor, I pray that God All-Powerful will be good to you and that the governor will let your other brother and Benjamin come back home with you. But if I must lose my children, I suppose I must.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a leŋ dɩ baal-la leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ ma naambiiriŋ Bɛnjamɩŋ arɩ Simioŋ mɩɩra kɔ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Mɩ-na ŋ-la, dɩ mɩ biiriŋ deemba nɛ tuo, ba tuo nɛ.”

english_verse: The brothers took the gifts, twice the amount of money, and Benjamin. Then they hurried off to Egypt. When they stood in front of Joseph,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba to joŋ chɔgɩtaba-la a kɛŋ Bɛnjamɩŋ a joŋ moribii-la ma ba fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kaa mʋ yɔɔ kʋdiile-la magɛ ŋɩɩ bʋlɩa a mʋ Josɛf teeŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: he saw Benjamin and told the servant in charge of his house, “Take these men to my house. Slaughter an animal and cook it, so they can eat with me at noon.”
translation_verse: Josɛf sɩ na Bɛnjamɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ dɩa tɩntɩnna, “Kɛŋ nɩaa deemba kaa mʋ mɩ dɩa. Ba jaŋ dii kʋdiilee mɩ dɩa lɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ deeŋ. Kpʋ pʋna a ŋaa kʋdiile-la.”

english_verse: The servant did as he was told and took the brothers to Joseph's house.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩa tɩntɩnnʋ-la kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ kaa mʋ Josɛf dɩa arɩ ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But on the way they got worried and started thinking, “We are being taken there because of the money that was put back in our sacks last time. He will arrest us, make us his slaves, and take our donkeys.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ kɛmba kaa mʋ Josɛf dɩa ŋɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba. Ba bɩɩna arɩ moribie-la ba fa sɩ joŋo hɛ ba bɔtɔba tʋɔŋ wɩaa nɛ. Ba bɩra bɩɩna baa chɛ dɩ ba na wombiiŋ a dii doluŋ ba lɛ a laa ba kakusuŋ aŋ kɛmba ŋaa yosi.

english_verse: So when they arrived at Joseph's house, they said to the servant in charge,
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kʋ yi Josɛf dɩa boiŋ niiŋ, ba bʋla pɩ ʋ dɩa tɩntɩnnʋ-la,

english_verse: “Sir, we came to Egypt once before to buy grain.
translation_verse: “La laa sɩpaaŋ kɔ daha nɛ a yɔɔ kʋdiilee.

english_verse: But when we stopped for the night, we each found in our grain sacks the exact amount we had paid. We have brought that money back,
translation_verse: La sɩ yɔɔ kʋdiile-la a mʋmʋ dɩa a chʋa wombiiŋ lɛ, la suri la bɔtɔba, la kʋŋkala na moribii-la la sɩ kaa kʋ yɔɔ kʋdiile-la hɛ la bɔtɔba tʋɔŋ. La mɩɩra kɛŋ moribie-la kaa kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: together with enough money to buy more grain. We don't know who put the money in our sacks.”
translation_verse: La kɛŋ moribiiŋ ma kɔ nɛ dɩ la yɔɔ kʋdiilee. La bɩ jɩŋ nɩɩ-la fa sɩ joŋ moribie-la hɛ la bɔtɔba tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: “It's all right,” the servant replied. “Don't worry. The God you and your father worship must have put the money there, because I received your payment in full.” Then he brought Simeon out to them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ʋʋ magɛ nɛ. Ma Wɩa arɩ ma nyɩmma Wɩa nɛ joŋ dʋa a hɛ ma bɔtɔba tʋɔŋ. Ma fa joŋ ma moribiiŋ pɩmɛ nɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ Simioŋ kaa kʋ lɩɩ pɩba.

english_verse: The servant took them into Joseph's house and gave them water to wash their feet. He also tended their donkeys.
translation_verse: Josɛf dɩa tɩntɩnnʋ-la kɛmba jʋʋ Josɛf dɩa a ŋaa lɩɩŋ pɩba ba sɔŋ ba naasɩŋ a pɩba kʋdiilee ma ba pɩ ba kakusuŋ.

english_verse: The brothers got their gifts ready to give to Joseph at noon, since they had heard they were going to eat there.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ kɩalɩŋ kala ba fa sɩ kaa kɔ dɩ ba pɩ Josɛf chɔgɩta hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ gbɛrʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɩa arɩ ba jaŋ dii wɩɩhɛyɛ kʋdiilee Josɛf dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: When Joseph came home, they gave him the gifts they had brought, and they bowed down to him.
translation_verse: Josɛf sɩ kɔ dɩa, kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa kɔ dɩ ba pʋ chɔgɩta, ba kaa jʋʋ kpirime pʋ.

english_verse: After Joseph had asked how they were, he said, “What about your elderly father? Is he still alive?”
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩɛsɛ ba yarɩfɩɛlaa wɩaa, aŋ bʋl, “Ma nyɩmma banɩhɩaŋ-la wɩaa ma sɩ bʋla doliee? Ʋ ha hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: They answered, “Your servant our father is still alive and well.” And again they bowed down to Joseph.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Ŋ tɩntɩnna, la nyɩmma ha hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ a dol,” aŋ tuu kpirime chʋɔlʋ.

english_verse: When Joseph looked around and saw his brother Benjamin, he said, “This must be your youngest brother, the one you told me about. God bless you, my son.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ na Bɛnjamɩŋ ʋ naambie, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Ma naambile wɩaa ma sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la? Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ mɩ bii.”

english_verse: Then, because of his love for Benjamin, he rushed off to his room and cried.
translation_verse: Josɛf sɩ na ʋ naambie, ʋ tʋɔŋ wɩɩ ʋ lɛ, sɩlɩɩrɩŋ chal ʋ sɩaa lɛ, ʋ fá jʋʋ ʋ dɩa a yel.

english_verse: After washing his face and returning, he was able to control himself and said, “Serve the meal!”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ yele dɛrɛ, ʋ sɔŋ ʋ sɩaa aŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, ʋ kʋ lɩɩ ŋaa ba kpaa kʋdiilee.

english_verse: Joseph was served at a table by himself, and his brothers were served at another. The Egyptians sat at yet another table, because Egyptians felt it was disgusting to eat with Hebrews.
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa Josɛf kʋdiilee pʋ, aŋ ŋaa ʋ naambiiri-la ma kʋŋkala kɩaa pɩba, aŋ ŋaa pɩ Ijipiti tɩmma-la ma. Ba bɩ joŋo hɛ dɔŋɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩɩŋ jʋʋ Hiburu tɩŋŋaa nɛ ba bee lileeniba.

english_verse: To the surprise of Joseph's brothers, they were seated in front of him according to their ages, from the oldest to the youngest.
translation_verse: Ba hɔŋ a kɩɛla kpagɛ Josɛf a chɩŋ kʋhɩaŋ lɛ a mʋ dɛrɛ kʋbie lɛ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere, ba hɔŋ aŋ bibeŋ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: They were served food from Joseph's table, and Benjamin was given five times as much as each of the others. So Joseph's brothers ate and drank with him and had a good time.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa kʋdiilee hɛ Josɛf gbaŋa lɛ, dɩ ba kpaa, Bɛnjamɩŋ kɩaa nɛ yie yʋgɛ a kɩɩ kʋkaanaa kala naansɩɩŋ bʋnɔŋ. Ba dii aŋ nyʋa kʋnyʋalaa halɩɩ. Ba tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ Josɛf nyuŋ.

english_verse: Later, Joseph told the servant in charge of his house, “Fill the men's grain sacks with as much as they can hold and put their money in the sacks. Also put my silver cup in the sack of the youngest brother.” The servant did as he was told.
translation_verse: Joŋ mɩ nyʋnyʋala-la ba sɩ kɛŋ hɔpʋla ŋaa a hɛ ba tʋɔŋ kʋbie bɔtɔ tʋɔŋ aŋ pɛ joŋ ʋ moribie-la ma ʋ sɩ kaa kɔ dɩ ʋ yɔɔ kʋdiilee ma hɛ.” Josɛf dɩa tɩntɩnnʋ-la ŋaa ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: Early the next morning, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋlaa kɔ, nɩalɩŋ lɩɩ kɛsɛ ba kakusuŋ a joŋ ba wombiiŋ.

english_verse: But they had not gone far from the city when Joseph told the servant, “Go after those men! When you catch them, say, ‘My master has been good to you. So why have you stolen his silver cup?
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩa, ba ha bɩ dɩ-bolii mʋa, ka Josɛf tiŋ ʋ dɩa tɩntɩnna a bʋl, “Kiri nɩalɩŋ harɩŋ lɩma. Dɩ ŋ nɛ puuba, pɩɛsɛ ba, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma joŋ wʋbɔmʋŋ tiŋ wʋzɔmʋŋ lɛ?

english_verse: Not only does he drink from his cup, but he also uses it to learn about the future. You have done a terrible thing.’ ”
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma gaa joŋ mɩ kʋhɩaŋ nyʋnyʋala? Ʋ nɛ ʋ kaa nyʋa lɩɩŋ aŋ pɛ kaa bee na wɩaa. Wʋbɔŋ nɛ ma ŋaa ŋɩɩ.’ ”

english_verse: When the servant caught up with them, he said exactly what Joseph had told him to say.
translation_verse: Josɛf dɩa tɩntɩnnʋ-la sɩ puuba, wɩaa deemba nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛba.

english_verse: But they replied, “Sir, why do you say such things? We would never do anything like that!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ la kʋhɩaŋ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ? Wɩa bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ la ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ doho.

english_verse: We even returned the money we found in our grain sacks when we got back to Canaan. So why would we want to steal any silver or gold from your master's house?
translation_verse: La sɩ kʋ yɔɔ kʋdiilee ma teeŋ a kaa mʋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ, a na moribie-la la sɩ joŋo yɔɔ kʋdiile-la la bɔtɔba tʋɔŋ, la mɩɩra kaa kɔ nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ dɩ la gaa hɔpʋla koo sɛlɩmɛ ŋ kʋhɩaŋ dɩa lɛ?

english_verse: If you find that one of us has the cup, then kill him, and the rest of us will become your slaves.”
translation_verse: La ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, dɩ ŋ nɛ naʋ la kʋŋkala teeŋ, leŋ dɩ tɩɩna sʋʋ, ka dɩ la kʋkaanaa ŋaa ŋ yosi, la kʋhɩaŋ.”

english_verse: “Good!” the man replied, “I'll do what you have said. But only the one who has the cup will become my slave. The rest of you can go free.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Ʋ zɔmɔ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ma sɩ bʋla. Nɩɩ-la kala teeŋ mɩ sɩ na nyʋnyʋala-la nɛ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ yomo, ka ma kʋkaanaa wiesi.”

english_verse: Each of the brothers quickly put his sack on the ground and opened it.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kʋŋkala chʋgɛ ʋ bɔtɔ bil tinteeŋ lɩma lɩma a kaa puri.

english_verse: Joseph's servant started searching the sacks, beginning with the one that belonged to the oldest brother. When he came to Benjamin's sack, he found the cup.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf dɩa tɩntɩnnʋ-la suomo gbigbilli bɔtɔba-la. Ʋ suomi ba tʋɔŋ kʋhɩaŋ lɛ nɛ a gbilli ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi ba tʋɔŋ kʋbie Bɛnjamɩŋ lɛ, a na nyʋnyʋala-la ʋ bɔtɔ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: This upset the brothers so much that they began tearing their clothes in sorrow. Then they loaded their donkeys and returned to the city.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ leŋ ba tʋɔŋ chei. Ba kɩɛsɛ ba gɛnnɩŋ aŋ paa ba chʋgʋsʋŋ vɔɔ ba kakusuŋ lɛ a mɩɩra mʋ tabal-la ba sɩ lɩa.

english_verse: When Judah and his brothers got there, Joseph was still at home. So they bowed down to Joseph,
translation_verse: Josɛf ha hɛ dɩa lɛ nɛ, dɩ Juda arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ nɛ mɩɩra kʋ jʋʋ ŋɩɩ a tuu titel tinteeŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: who asked them, “What have you done? Didn't you know I could find out?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf pɩɛsɛba, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma ŋaa ŋ-la? Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ-na dɔŋɔ tɩɩna sɩ magɛ ŋ-la jaŋ wuo chɛ nɩna wɩaa?”

english_verse: “Sir, what can we say?” Judah replied. “How can we say we are innocent, when God has shown we are guilty? And now all of us are your slaves, especially the one who had the cup.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juda bʋl, “Kʋhɩaŋ, wʋbɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ? Wʋbɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ bʋl? Wʋbɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ bʋla laa la tɩtɩa? Wɩa na la ŋaa wɩɩ-la chei nɛ. Lɛɛlɛ, la kala ŋaa ŋ yosi nɛ, la dɩ nɩɩ-la kala teeŋ ba sɩ na nyʋnyʋala-la.”

english_verse: Joseph told them, “I would never punish all of you. Only the one who was caught with the cup will become my slave. The rest of you are free to go home to your father.” Judah Pleads for Benjamin
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf bʋl, “Ma sɩ bɩɩna mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ, nɩɩ-la teeŋ mɩ sɩ na nyʋnyʋala-la dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ yomo. Ma kʋkaanaa jaŋ wuo mɩɩra mʋ ma nyɩmma teeŋ.”

english_verse: Judah went over to Joseph and said: Sir, you have as much power as the king himself, and I am only your slave. Please don't get angry if I speak.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juda sʋʋsa yi Josɛf a bʋl, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ nɛ a pɩŋ. Mɩ jɩma, ŋ dɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro dɩchɩnɩŋ kala magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, ama sɩ́ baanɩŋ na mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna nyuŋ a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You asked us if our father was still alive and if we had any more brothers.
translation_verse: La nɩhɩaŋ, ŋ pɩɛsɛla arɩ la nyɩmma ha hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛɛ? A bɩra pɩɛsɛla arɩ la ha kɛŋ naambii dɔŋ ma nɛɛ?

english_verse: So we told you, “Our father is a very old man. In fact, he was already old when Benjamin was born. Benjamin's brother is dead. Now Benjamin is the only one of the two brothers who is still alive, and our father loves him very much.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la bʋl, ‘Oo, la nyɩmma ŋaa banɩhɩaŋ nɛ, ʋ kɛŋ hambolibii-bie nɛ ʋ sɩ hɩɛsa aŋ lʋl. Bile malɩma sʋba nɛ aŋ ka ʋ dʋndʋŋa ʋ naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ nyɩmma saa chou nɛ woruŋ.’

english_verse: You ordered us to bring him here, so you could see him for yourself.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ bʋla pɩla, ‘Ma kɛnʋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ dɩ mɩ naʋ arɩ mɩ sɩɩŋ.’

english_verse: We told you that our father would die if Benjamin left him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la bʋla pɩŋ, ‘Bile bɩ ʋ nyɩmma bʋbʋɔŋ wuo sʋʋsɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ sʋʋsɛ ʋ nyɩmma bʋbʋɔŋ, ʋ nyɩmma jaŋ sʋʋ.’

english_verse: But you warned us that we could never see you again, unless our youngest brother came with us.
translation_verse: Ka ŋ ha bʋl, ‘Dɩ ma bɩ ma ŋaambie kaa kɔ, ma bɩ mɩ sɩpaaŋ wuo chɩŋ.’

english_verse: So we returned to our father and reported what you had said.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ la sɩ mɩɩra mʋ la nyɩmma teeŋ, la bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ bʋla pɩla pʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Later our father sent us back here to buy more grain.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la nyɩmma bʋl, see dɩ la ha bɩra mʋ a yɔɔ kʋdiilee mʋa kaa kɔ.

english_verse: But we told him, “We can't go back to Egypt without our youngest brother. We will never be let in to see the governor, unless he is with us.”
translation_verse: Ama la bʋla pʋ, ‘La bɩ jaŋ wuo mʋ see dɩ la naambie to la harɩŋ mʋ. Dɩ la naambie bɩ la harɩŋ to mʋ, ka dɩ la mʋ ma, la bɩ jaŋ wuo mʋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.’

english_verse: Sir, our father then reminded us that his favorite wife had given birth to two sons.
translation_verse: La nyɩmma ma bʋla pɩla, ‘Ma jɩma, mɩ haala lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ pɩmɛ,

english_verse: One of them was already missing and had not been seen for a long time. My father thinks the boy was torn to pieces by some wild animal,
translation_verse: dɔŋɔ lɛl mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, magɛ ŋ-la kʋŋ nɛ kɛnʋ pʋɔsa ta. Mɩ ha bɩ ʋ na a kʋʋ yi jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: and he said, “I am an old man. If you take Benjamin from me, and something happens to him, I will die of a broken heart.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ma saa bɩra laa deeŋ ma mɩ teeŋ, dɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ, ma jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ sʋʋ nenigi sʋʋŋ a tuu bʋa arɩ nyu-pʋmpʋllʋŋ.’

english_verse: That's why Benjamin must be with us when I go back to my father. He loves him so much
translation_verse: Mɩ nyɩmma mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ bile, dɩ mɩ nɛ mɩɩra mʋ mɩ nyɩmma teeŋ aŋ bɩ bile kaa mʋ,

english_verse: that he will die if Benjamin doesn't come back with me.
translation_verse: ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ nenige sʋʋŋ, a tuu bʋa arɩ nyu-pʋmpʋllʋŋ.

english_verse: I promised my father that I would bring him safely home. If I don't, I told my father he could blame me the rest of my life.
translation_verse: Mɩ nyɩmma joŋ bile hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ bʋla pʋ dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ mɩɩra kɛŋ bile kaa kɔ, mɩ jaŋ laa cheeriŋ a ka mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Sir, I am your slave. Please let me stay here in place of Benjamin and let him return home with his brothers.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, leŋ dɩ mɩ mɩɩra laa bile nyuŋ a hɛ ŋ teeŋ a ŋaa ŋ yomo, ka dɩ bile to ʋ naambiiriŋ harɩŋ mʋ.

english_verse: How can I face my father if Benjamin isn't with me? I couldn't bear to see my father in such sorrow.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ mɩɩ ŋaa dɩ mɩ mʋ mɩ nyɩmma teeŋ dɩ bile nɛ bɩ mɩ harɩŋ to? Mɩ bɩ jaŋ cho dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ chei mɩ nyɩmma tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: Since Joseph could no longer control his feelings in front of his servants, he sent them out of the room. When he was alone with his brothers, he told them, “I am Joseph.”
translation_verse: Juda sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ, Josɛf kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa lɔl, aŋ yel ʋ tɩntɩnna-la sɩpaaŋ a leŋ nɩwogusu-la kala lɩɩ, ka ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa dagɛ ʋ naambiiriŋ.

english_verse: Then he cried so loudly that the Egyptians heard him and told about it in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ faasa yel ŋɩɩ, Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ ba kuoro dɩa nɩaa kala nɩɩ.

english_verse: Joseph asked his brothers if his father was still alive, but they were too frightened to answer.
translation_verse: Josɛf bʋla pɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, “Mɩ-na nɛ Josɛf. Mɩ nyɩmma ha hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛɛ?” Fawʋllʋŋ faasa kɛŋ ʋ naambiiri-la, ba bɩ wuo bʋl wɩɩkala pʋ.

english_verse: Joseph told them to come closer to him, and when they did, he said: Yes, I am your brother Joseph, the one you sold into Egypt.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf bʋla pɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, “Ma yaa sʋʋsa kʋ yimi.” Ba sɩ sʋʋsa kʋ yiu, ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ-na nɛ Josɛf, ma naambile ma sɩ yalla pɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Don't worry or blame yourselves for what you did. God is the one who sent me ahead of you to save lives.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tʋɔŋ chei, a sɩ́ baanɩŋ ma na dɔŋɔba nyuŋ a tɩŋ ma sɩ yallɛmɛ pɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa nɛ dagɛ ŋɩɩ dɩ mɩ laa nɩaa ta.

english_verse: There has already been a famine for two years, and for five more years no one will plow fields or harvest grain.
translation_verse: Jɩsɩŋ balɩa nɛ ŋ-la losuŋ sɩ jʋʋ tinteeŋ, aŋ ha ka jɩsɩŋ banɔŋ ma, ma sɩ bɩ jaŋ pɛrɛ, a bɩ jaŋ kʋŋ ma.

english_verse: But God sent me on ahead of you to keep your families alive and to save you in this wonderful way.
translation_verse: Wɩa leŋe mɩ laa ma sɩpaaŋ kɔ daha dɩ ʋ to mɩ lɛ nɛ a laa ma dɩ ma doho nɩaa ta dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋmagɩl.

english_verse: After all, you weren't really the ones who sent me here—it was God. He made me the highest official in the king's court and placed me over all Egypt.
translation_verse: Ma dee bɩ mɩ kaa kɔ daha, Wɩa nɛ kɛmmɛ kɔ, a leŋ mɩ nɛ tɩtɩgɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro lɛ a ŋaa ʋ dɩa nɩhɩaŋ a bibeŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kala.

english_verse: Now hurry back and tell my father that his son Joseph says, “God has made me ruler of Egypt. Come here as quickly as you can.
translation_verse: Má ŋaa lɩma a mʋ bʋla pɩ mɩ nyɩmma, arɩ ʋ bie Josɛf, Wɩa leŋe ʋ ŋaa Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa kala sɩpaalaarʋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ́ dienu aŋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: You will live near me in the region of Goshen with your children and grandchildren, as well as with your sheep, goats, cattle, and everything else you own.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kɔ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ Goseŋ tinteeŋ lɛ a kpagɛmɛ, ma dɩ ma biiriŋ, ma nihee, ma pʋsʋŋ, ma jiŋŋee arɩ kʋŋ na-kala ma sɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I will take care of you there during the next five years of famine. But if you don't come, you and your family and your animals will starve to death.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bibemma, dɩ losuŋ sɩ́ ma dɩa jʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa losu-la ha jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ jɩsɩŋ banɔŋ.

english_verse: All of you, including my brother Benjamin, can tell by what I have said that I really am Joseph.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ ma tɩtɩa na nɛ, mɩ ŋaana Bɛnjamɩŋ ma na arɩ mɩ-na Josɛf nɩɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba ma teeŋ.

english_verse: Tell my father about my great power here in Egypt and about everything you have seen. Hurry and bring him here.
translation_verse: Má bʋla pɩ mɩ nyɩmma, arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ zilmi Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ na, aŋ kɛŋ mɩ nyɩmma kaa kɔ daha lɩma.”

english_verse: Joseph and Benjamin hugged each other and started crying.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ guori dɔŋɔ a kala yiyel.

english_verse: Joseph was still crying as he kissed each of his other brothers. After this, they started talking with Joseph.
translation_verse: Ʋ guori ʋ naambiiri-la kala cheŋ aŋ yiyel. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ ʋ naambiiriŋ ma bʋl wɩaa ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: When it was told in the palace that Joseph's brothers had come, the king and his officials were happy.
translation_verse: Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro sɩ nɩa dɩ Josɛf naambiiriŋ kɔ ʋ teeŋ, ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ kala tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: So the king said to Joseph: Tell your brothers to load their donkeys and return to Canaan.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro bʋla pɩ Josɛf, “Bʋla pɩ ŋ naambiiriŋ dɩ ba vɔɔ kʋdiilee a daŋ ba kakusuŋ lɛ a mɩɩra mʋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Tell them to bring their father and their families here. I will give them the best land in Egypt, and they can eat and enjoy everything that grows there.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ ma nyɩmma arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala kɔ Ijipiti tinteeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ pɩba Ijipiti tinteeŋ lee-la sɩ sɩma a kɛŋ dʋa dɩ ba hɔŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Also tell your brothers to take some wagons from Egypt for their wives and children to ride in. And be sure they bring their father.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba dɩ ba to paa pʋsʋŋ torukoba dɔnsʋŋ, a kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ mʋ paa ba biiriŋ, ba haalaa arɩ ba nyɩmma kaa kɔ.

english_verse: They can leave their possessions behind, because they will be given the best of everything in Egypt.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo paa wɩaa walɩmɛma, bɛɛ wɩaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ kala jaŋ ŋaa ma kɩaa.”

english_verse: Jacob's sons agreed to do what the king had said. And Joseph gave them wagons and food for their trip home, just as the king had ordered.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ Iziral biiriŋ ŋaa. Josɛf pɩba pʋsʋŋ torukoba-la arɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ a pɩba kʋdiile-la ba sɩ jaŋ dii vɛŋ wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Joseph gave some new clothes to each of his brothers, but to Benjamin he gave five new outfits and
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩ nʋʋkala gɛrɩ-falɩŋ, aŋ joŋ warɩpʋla zɔɔ-batori arɩ gɛrɩ-falaa banɔŋ a pɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ.

english_verse: To his father he sent ten donkeys loaded with the best things in Egypt, and ten other donkeys loaded with grain and bread and other food for the return trip.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ ma ʋ sɩ joŋo pa dɩ ba kaa mʋ pɩ ba nyɩmma nɛ ŋ-la: Kaku-belliŋ fii chʋŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, aŋ ka kaku-haalaa ma fii chʋŋ kuori-mɩaa arɩ kʋdiilee dɔnsʋŋ a kaa mʋ pɩ ba nyɩmma dɩ ʋ kaa dii aa vɛŋ wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then he sent his brothers off and told them, “Don't argue on the way home!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ naambiiriŋ lɩɩ hɛ wombiiŋ lɛ, aŋ bʋla pɩba, “Má pɔ dɩ ma sɩ́ dɔŋɔ yuo.”

english_verse: Joseph's brothers left Egypt, and when they arrived in Canaan,
translation_verse: Ba lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a mʋ ba nyɩmma Jekɔb teeŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: they told their father that Joseph was still alive and was the ruler of Egypt. But their father was so surprised that he could not believe them.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ yie, ba bʋla pɩ ba nyɩmma Jekɔb arɩ Josɛf ha hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ nɩɩ tɩgɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro lɛ aa beŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kala. Jekɔb sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ niiŋ maa, ʋ bɩ laa dii arɩ Josɛf ha hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then they told him everything Joseph had said. When he saw the wagons Joseph had sent, he felt much better
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala Josɛf sɩ bʋla pɩba a pʋ, aŋ ka ʋ na pʋsʋŋ torukoba-la Josɛf sɩ joŋo tɩa dɩ ba kaa kʋ joŋu kɔ, ʋ yaraa pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and said, “Now I can believe you! My son Joseph must really be alive, and I will get to see him before I die.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral bʋl, “Lɛɛlɛ mɩ laa dii arɩ mɩ bie Josɛf ha hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ mʋ naʋ aŋ-na sʋʋ.”

english_verse: Jacob packed up everything he owned and left for Egypt. On the way he stopped near the town of Beersheba and offered sacrifices to the God his father Isaac had worshiped.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral paa ʋ kɩaa kala a mʋmʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ. Ʋ sɩ yi Bɛɛsɩba, ʋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a siili ʋ nyɩmma Aɩzɩk Wɩa.

english_verse: That night, God spoke to him in a dream and said, “Jacob! Jacob!” “Here I am,” Jacob answered.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ kʋbala Wɩa bʋl wɩaa pɩ Iziral arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ a yɩrʋ, “Jekɔb, Jekɔb.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sɛɩ, “Na mɩ nɛ ŋ-la.”

english_verse: God said, “I am God, the same God your father worshiped. Don't be afraid to go to Egypt. I will give you so many descendants that one day they will become a nation.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ nɛ Wɩa, Wɩa-la sɩ ŋaa ŋ nyɩmma Wɩa. Sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá arɩ ŋ sɩɩ mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ leŋ ŋ dɩ ŋ doho nɩaa pʋŋ a ŋaa tintee-bal lee-la.

english_verse: I will go with you to Egypt, and later I will bring your descendants back here. Your son Joseph will be at your side when you die.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ to ŋ harɩŋ a mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ aŋ bɩra kɛnɩŋ kɔ daha. Ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ Josɛf nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: When Jacob went to Egypt, his children who were born in northern Syria also went along with their families. Jacob and his wife Leah had a total of
translation_verse: Biiriŋ deemba nɛ Liya lʋla pɩ Jekɔb Mesopotemia lɛ, a pɛ ʋ tolo Daana lɛ. Ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ hantolibiisiŋ kala ŋaa mara arɩ fii arɩ batori nɛ.

english_verse: The king will call you in and ask what you do for a living.
translation_verse: Dɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro nɛ yɩrɛma a pɩɛsɛma arɩ tɩntɩŋ bɛɛ nɛ ma tɩtɩŋ,

english_verse: Jacob and Zilpah, the servant woman Laban had given his daughter Leah, had a total of
translation_verse: Hambolibiisiŋ deemba nɛ Zilipa lʋla pɩ Jekɔb, nɩɩ-la Labaŋ sɩ joŋo daŋ ʋ tolo Liya. Ba kala ŋaa fii arɩ balɩdʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Jacob and Bilhah, the servant woman Laban had given his daughter Rachel, had seven children and grandchildren. Their son Dan took his son Hushim. Their son Naphtali took his sons Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
translation_verse: Hambolibiisiŋ deemba nɛ Biliha lʋla pɩ Jekɔb, nɩɩ-la Labaŋ sɩ joŋo daŋ ʋ tolo Rakɛl. Ba kala ŋaa balɩpɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Sixty-six members of Jacob's family went to Egypt with him, not counting his daughters-in-law.
translation_verse: Jekɔb doho nɩaa kala fa sɩ to ʋ harɩŋ mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ ŋaa mahɩŋ batori arɩ balɩdʋ nɛ a lɩɩsɛ ʋ bii-haalaa ta.

english_verse: Jacob had sent his son Judah ahead of him to ask Joseph to meet them in Goshen.
translation_verse: Jekɔb tɩŋ Juda dɩ ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ mʋ Josɛf teeŋ a bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ kʋ chemba Goseŋ tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ ba nɛ kɔ.

english_verse: So Joseph got in his chariot and went to meet his father. When they met, Joseph hugged his father around the neck and cried for a long time.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf sii joŋ ʋ jaaba arɩ ʋ toruko a mʋ Goseŋ dɩ ʋ cheŋ ʋ nyɩmma. Ʋ sɩ mʋ chemu, ʋ guori ʋ nyɩmma Iziral aŋ yel a dieni.

english_verse: Jacob said to Joseph, “Now that I have seen you and know you are still alive, I am ready to die.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jekɔb bʋla pɩ Josɛf, “Lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo sʋʋ, mɩ folo naŋ nɛ a jɩŋ ŋ hɛ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Then Joseph said to his brothers and to everyone who had come with them: I must go and tell the king that you have arrived from Canaan.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf bʋla pɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ arɩ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa kala, “Mɩ jaŋ mʋ bʋla pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ arɩ mɩ nyɩmma doho nɩaa kala fa sɩ hɛ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ kɔ mɩ teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I will tell him that you are shepherds and that you have brought your sheep, goats, cattle, and everything else you own.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pʋ arɩ ma ŋaa kʋdaaraa nɛ, ma kɛŋ ma pʋsʋŋ arɩ ma kʋŋkala kaa kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: When he does, be sure to say, “We are shepherds. Our families have always raised sheep.” If you tell him this, he will let you settle in the region of Goshen. Joseph wanted them to say this to the king, because the Egyptians did not like to be around anyone who raised sheep.
translation_verse: má chaasa bʋla pʋ arɩ ma sɩ sie kala, pʋsʋŋ nɛ ma dɩdaa arɩ ma nyɩmmaba fa sɩ sii a ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ ba mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ bʋl ŋ-la, ʋ jaŋ leŋ ma mʋ hɔŋ Goseŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.” Josɛf bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩɩŋ jʋʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ daa pʋsʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: who asked them, “What do you do for a living?” “Sir, we are shepherds,” was their answer. “Our families have always raised sheep.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro pɩɛsɛ ʋ naambiiri-la, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ nɛ maa tɩŋ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro, “Laa ŋaa kʋdaaraa nɛ arɩ la nyɩmmaba fa sɩɩ daa kɩaa ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: But in our country all the pastures are dried up, and our sheep have no grass to eat. So we, your servants, have come here. Please let us live in the region of Goshen.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra bʋl, “La kɔ dɩ la hɔŋ daha mʋa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa losu-la faasa hɛɩ nɛ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ, la pʋsʋŋ ma bɩ yaŋ ka na dɩ ba dii. La saa sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ leŋ dɩ la hɔŋ Goseŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The king said to Joseph, “It's good that your father and brothers have arrived.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro bʋla pɩ Josɛf, “Ŋ nyɩmma arɩ ŋ naambiiriŋ kɔ ŋ teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I will let them live anywhere they choose in the land of Egypt, but I suggest that they settle in Goshen, the best part of our land. I would also like for your finest shepherds to watch after my own sheep and goats.”
translation_verse: Ka Ijipiti tinteeŋ hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, leŋ dɩ ŋ nyɩmma arɩ ŋ naambiiriŋ hɔŋ lee-la sɩ zɔmɔ. Leŋ dɩ ba hɔŋ Goseŋ lɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ jɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ pʋsʋŋ nyuŋ beniŋ woruŋ, leŋ dɩ ba bibeŋ mɩ pʋsʋŋ.”

english_verse: Then Joseph brought his father Jacob and introduced him to the king. Jacob gave the king his blessing,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf kɛŋ ʋ nyɩmma Jekɔb kaa kɔ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro teeŋ. Jekɔb sʋl Wɩa pʋ.

english_verse: and the king asked him, “How old are you?”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ sʋl Wɩa pʋ, ŋɩɩ harɩŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ ŋaa jɩsɩŋ baŋmɛɛ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Then Jacob gave the king his blessing once again and left.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jekɔb sʋl Wɩa pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro aŋ viiri.

english_verse: Joseph obeyed the king's orders and gave his father and brothers some of the best land in Egypt near the city of Rameses.
translation_verse: Josɛf leŋ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ hɔŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ dɩ-zɔmʋŋ, lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ramesis lɛ, arɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The famine was bad everywhere in Egypt and Canaan, and the people were suffering terribly.
translation_verse: Kʋdiilii kala fa tuo Ijipiti arɩ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ losu-la wasa nyɛsɛ woruŋ nʋʋkala sʋsʋʋ losuŋ.

english_verse: So Joseph sold them the grain that had been stored up, and he put the money in the king's treasury.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf laa moribie-la kala Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ kaa kʋ yɔɔ kʋdiilee pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro.

english_verse: But when everyone had run out of money, the Egyptians came to Joseph and demanded, “Give us more grain! If you don't, we'll soon be dead, because our money's all gone.”
translation_verse: Moribie-la fa sɩ hɛ Ijipiti arɩ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ kala lɛ fa sɩ dɛrɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa kala sii mʋ Josɛf teeŋ a bʋl, “Pɩla kʋdiilee, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ jaŋ bibenla ka la sʋsʋʋ losuŋ? La moribiee kala nɛ dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: “If you don't have any money,” Joseph answered, “give me your animals, and I'll let you have some grain.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf bʋl, “Dɩ ma moribiee nɛ dɛrɛ, má kɛŋ ma pʋsʋŋ kʋ lenni kʋdiilee.”

english_verse: Then the people came to him and said: Sir, there's no way we can hide the truth from you. We are broke, and we don't have any more animals. We have nothing left except ourselves and our land.
translation_verse: Jɩna bɩra sɩ yie, ba bɩra kɔ Josɛf teeŋ a bʋl, “La kʋhɩaŋ, la bɩ jaŋ kaa faaŋ, la bɩra bɩ moribii kala kɛnɛ, la pʋsʋŋ ma kala nɛ dɛrɛ. La bɩra bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ dɩ la pɩŋ, see la tɩtɩa arɩ la tinteeŋ nɛ ka.

english_verse: Don't let us starve and our land be ruined. If you'll give us grain to eat and seed to plant, we'll sell ourselves and our land to the king. We'll become his slaves.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ jaŋ bibenla, ka laa sʋʋ losuŋ ka dɩ la tinteeŋ pɩna ta? Joŋ kʋdiilee yɔɔla arɩ la tinteeŋ kala dɩ la ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro yosi, ka la tinteeŋ ma ŋaa ʋ kʋŋ. Pɩla kʋdoho dɩ la duu a na kʋdiilee a sɩ́ sʋʋ, ka dɩ la tinteeŋ pɩŋ pɛɩ.”

english_verse: The famine became so severe that Joseph finally bought every piece of land in Egypt for the king
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf yɔɔ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kala a pɩ ba kuoro. Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa kala joŋ ba tinteeŋ yallɛ, a tɩŋ losuŋ sɩ faasa jʋʋba wɩaa, tintee-la kʋ ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro kʋŋ.

english_verse: and made everyone the king's slaves,
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ Josɛf to a kɛŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa kala ba ŋaa yosi.

english_verse: except the priests. The king gave the priests a regular food allowance, so they did not have to sell their land.
translation_verse: Tintee-la dʋndʋŋa ʋ sɩ bɩ yɔbɔ nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tinteeŋ. Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro yie pɩpɩba kʋdiilee nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba-na bɩ ba tinteeŋ yalla.

english_verse: Then Joseph said to the people, “You and your land now belong to the king. I'm giving you seed to plant,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Lɛɛlɛ mɩ sɩ yɔɔma arɩ ma tinteeŋ kala a pɩ ma kuoro, má laa kʋdoho mʋ duu tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: but one fifth of your crops must go to the king. You can keep the rest as seed or as food for your families.”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ kʋ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa, ma kaa kpaa leree banɔŋ a joŋ dɔŋɔ a pɩ ma tinteeŋ kuoro. Ka dɩ kʋkaanaa ŋaa ma kʋdoho arɩ ma biiriŋ arɩ ma dɩa nɩaa kala kʋdiilee.”

english_verse: “Sir, you have saved our lives!” they answered. “We are glad to be slaves of the king.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Ŋ laa la mɩɩsɩŋ pɩla nɛ, la jaŋ jʋʋ ŋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ a ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro yosi.”

english_verse: The people of Israel made their home in the land of Goshen, where they became prosperous and had large families.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa hɔŋ Goseŋ lɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a dʋa kɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ, ba nɩaa ma pʋŋ woruŋ a pɛ.

english_verse: When Jacob knew he did not have long to live, he called in Joseph and said, “If you really love me, you must make a solemn promise not to bury me in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ sɩ kpagɛ dɛrɩŋ, ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ nanʋala Josɛf a bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ chomi, joŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ hɛ mɩ naapuiŋ bʋbʋɔŋ a hɛ niiŋ pɩmɛ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, dɩ mɩ nɛ sʋba ŋ bɩ jaŋ jommi hugi Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ,

english_verse: Instead, bury me in the place where my ancestors are buried.” “I will do what you have asked,” Joseph answered.
translation_verse: ama dɩ mɩ nɛ kʋ sʋʋ, ŋ jaŋ jommi kaa mʋ hugi lee-la ba sɩ hugi mɩ nyɩmmaba.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ŋ sɩ bʋla.”

english_verse: “Will you give me your word?” Jacob asked. “Yes, I will,” Joseph promised. After this, Jacob bowed down and prayed at the head of his bed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jekɔb bʋl, “Ŋmɩɛsa pɩmɛ.” Josɛf ŋmɩɛsa pʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩɛbɛ ʋ dantɩga aŋ dɛnnɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Joseph was told that his father Jacob had become very sick. So Joseph went to see him and took along his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ ba bʋla pɩ Josɛf arɩ ʋ nyɩmma wɩɩlʋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩa, Manasɛ arɩ Efirem a to ʋ harɩŋ mʋ dɩ ʋ na ʋ nyɩmma Jekɔb.

english_verse: When Joseph arrived, someone told Jacob, “Your son Joseph has come to see you.” Jacob sat up in bed, but it took almost all his strength.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bʋla pɩ Jekɔb arɩ ʋ bie Josɛf kɔ dɩ ʋ naʋ nɛ, ʋ nyaga sii a hɔŋ bɔsɔ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Jacob told Joseph: God All-Powerful appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, where he gave me his blessing
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jekɔb bʋla pɩ Josɛf a bʋl, “Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛmɛ nɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ Bɛtɛl lɛ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ a bʋl dɩ ʋ jaŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: and promised, “I will give you a large family with many descendants that will grow into a nation. And I am giving you this land that will belong to you and your family forever.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ mɩ dʋa dɩ mɩ doho pʋŋ a ŋaa tintee daŋ. Ʋ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ pɩ mɩ doho nɩaa kala a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Then Jacob went on to say: Joseph, your two sons Ephraim and Manasseh were born in Egypt, but I accept them as my own, just as Reuben and Simeon are mine.
translation_verse: Efirem arɩ Manasɛ, ŋ hambolibiisi-la balɩa ŋ sɩ lʋla Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ ka mɩ-na kɔ daha jaŋ ŋaa mɩ kɩaa arɩ mɩ sɩ tɩɩ Rubiŋ arɩ Simioŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Any children you have later will be considered yours, but their inheritance will come from Ephraim and Manasseh.
translation_verse: Biiri-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ lʋl ba harɩŋ, ŋ ma kɩaa nɛ ŋɩɩ, ba malɩmaba sɩ tɩɩ lere-la kala, ba nɛ ba ma jaŋ tɩɩ.

english_verse: Unfortunately, your mother Rachel died in Canaan after we had left northern Syria and before we reached Bethlehem. And I had to bury her along the way.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ lɩɩ Mesopotemia lɛ aa kɔ, ŋ naaŋ Rakɛl sʋʋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ ka mʋa, ka dɩ mɩ yi Ɛfɩrata. Mɩ joŋu hugi Ɛfɩrata wombiiŋ lɛ . Ŋɩɩ leŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ chei woruŋ lee-la.”

english_verse: Jacob turned to Joseph and told him, “For many years I thought you were dead and that I would never see you again. But now God has even let me live to see your children.”
translation_verse: Iziral bʋla pɩ Josɛf, “Mɩ fa bɩ bɩɩna arɩ mɩ jaŋ bɩra naŋ, aŋ ka Wɩa leŋ mɩ naŋ, ŋ dɩ ŋ biiriŋ kala.”

english_verse: Then Joseph made his sons move away from Jacob's knees, and Joseph bowed down in front of him with his face to the ground.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf kɛŋ ʋ biiri-la paa Jekɔb naasɩŋ lɛ aŋ tuu kpirimi a kɛŋ ʋ nyuŋ chugili.

english_verse: After Joseph got up, he brought his two sons over to Jacob again. He led his younger son Ephraim to the left side of Jacob and his older son Manasseh to the right.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf kɛŋ hambolibiisi-la kɔ ba chɩŋ ʋ nyɩmma sɛmɛ. Efirem chɩŋ Josɛf nadiiŋ aŋ hɛ Iziral nagʋa, ka Manasɛ ma hɛ Josɛf nagʋa aŋ chɩŋ Iziral ma nadiiŋ. Josɛf kɛmba mʋ kpagɛ Iziral.

english_verse: But before Jacob gave them his blessing, he crossed his arms, putting his right hand on the head of Ephraim and his left hand on the head of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa gɩrɛ a joŋ ʋ nadiiŋ daŋ Efirem nyuŋ lɛ, ba tʋɔŋ kʋbie, aŋ joŋ ʋ nagʋa daŋ Manasɛ kʋhɩaŋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then he gave Joseph his blessing and said: My grandfather Abraham and my father Isaac worshiped the Lord God. He has been with me all my life,
translation_verse: Ʋ sʋl Wɩa pɩ Josɛf a bʋl, “Mɩ nyɩmma Abɩraham arɩ Aɩzɩk sɩɩ to Wɩa-la, ʋ nɛ pɔmɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ aa kɔ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: and his angel has kept me safe. Now I pray that he will bless these boys and that my name and the names of Abraham and Isaac will live on because of them. I ask God to give them many children and many descendants as well.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ lɩɩsɛmɛ mɩ wʋjʋʋlaa kala lɛ pɛ hambiisiŋ deemba lɛ, a leŋ dɩ mɩ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ, dɩ mɩ nyɩmma Abɩraham arɩ Aɩzɩk yɩrɩŋ ma yɩrɛ, a ŋaa dɩ ba pʋŋ a su tinteeŋ kala.”

english_verse: Joseph did not like it when he saw his father place his right hand on the head of the younger son. So he tried to move his father's right hand from Ephraim's head and place it on Manasseh.
translation_verse: Josɛf sɩ na dɩ ʋ nyɩmma joŋ ʋ nadiiŋ daŋ Efirem nyuŋ lɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ chei. Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nyɩmma nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kaa joŋo daŋ Manasɛ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Joseph said, “Father, you have made a mistake. This is the older boy. Put your right hand on him.”
translation_verse: Josɛf bʋla pɩ ʋ nyɩmma a bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ dee, Manasɛ nɛ kʋhɩaŋ. Joŋ ŋ nadiiŋ daŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: But his father said, “Son, I know what I am doing. It's true that Manasseh's family will someday become a great nation. But Ephraim will be even greater than Manasseh, because his descendants will become many great nations.”
translation_verse: Ama ʋ nyɩmma vɩa aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ bii, mɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ, ʋ ma doho jaŋ pʋŋ dɩ ʋ ma ŋaa babiibal, ama ʋ ŋaana nɛ jaŋ kɩɩʋ. Ʋ doho nɩaa jaŋ pʋŋ a ŋaa tintee daŋ.”

english_verse: Jacob told him that in the future the people of Israel would ask God's blessings on one another by saying, “I pray for God to bless you as much as he blessed Ephraim and Manasseh.” Jacob put Ephraim's name first to show that he would be greater than Manasseh.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sʋl Wɩa pɩba tapʋlɩɩ-la aŋ bʋl, “Dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ suri ba niiŋ a sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ pɛ nʋʋ lɛ, ba jaŋ bʋl, ‘Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ nagɛ Efirem arɩ Manasɛ.’ ” Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Efirem laa Manasɛ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: After that, Jacob said, “Joseph, you can see that I won't live much longer. But God will be with you and will lead you back to the land he promised our family long ago.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral bʋla pɩ Josɛf a bʋl, “Mɩ sʋʋŋ yie nɛ, ama Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ a mɩɩra kɛnɩŋ mʋ ŋ nyɩmmaba tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Jacob called his sons together and said: My sons, I am Jacob, your father Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jekɔb yɩrɛ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ a bʋl, “Má hilimi dɩ mɩ dagɛma ŋɩɩ ma chie sɩ jaŋ nagɛ.

english_verse: Come, gather around, as I tell your future.
translation_verse: Ma hilimi, mɩ hambolibiisiŋ aŋ jegile nɩɩ mɩ-na ma nyɩmma Iziral sɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la.

english_verse: Reuben, you are my oldest, born at the peak of my powers; you were an honored leader.
translation_verse: Rubiŋ, ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ bii-hɩaŋ a ŋaa mɩ doluŋ, mɩ zile arɩ mɩ jɩma.

english_verse: Uncontrollable as a flood, you slept with my wife and disgraced my bed. And so you no longer deserve the place of honor.
translation_verse: Ŋ nagɛ fuoŋ sɩ suo nɛ a pɛllɛ paa kɩaa vɩvɛŋ, ama ŋ bɩ jaŋ dii dɩa, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ kɛŋ mɩ haala ketiiŋ pɩŋ nɛ a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ mɩ kʋpɩnaa lɛ.

english_verse: Simeon and Levi, you are brothers, each a gruesome sword.
translation_verse: Simioŋ arɩ Levi ŋaa naambiiri nɛ a kɛŋ bayuori kɩaa a didii doluŋ.

english_verse: I never want to take part in your plans or deeds. You slaughtered people in your anger, and you crippled cattle for no reason.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ hɛ ba wʋlʋara vʋʋraa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba yie na baanɩŋ a kpʋkpʋ nɩaa aŋ pɛ bubolimi nɩaa pʋsʋŋ ba tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Now I place a curse on you because of your fierce anger. Your descendants will be scattered among the tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ma lɛ a tɩŋ ma baanɩŋ arɩ ma tʋɔhɛɛŋ sɩ faasa yʋgɛ wɩaa nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmma pɔrɛ mɩ-na Jekɔb biiriŋ tʋɔŋ, aŋ kɛmba pɩsɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Judah, you will be praised by your brothers; they will bow down to you, as you defeat your enemies.
translation_verse: Juda, ŋ ma naambiiriŋ jaŋ bɩbɛsɛ ŋ lɛ, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ. Ŋ naambiiriŋ jaŋ kpirimi ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: My son, you are a lion ready to eat your victim! You are terribly fierce; no one will bother you.
translation_verse: Juda, ŋ nagɛ naachigi-bie nɛ. Ŋ wuo jʋʋ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tʋɔŋ aŋ mɩɩra kʋ lɩɩ ka ba bɩŋ die. Ŋ nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩ pɩna a hʋhʋʋnɛ nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo mʋ ʋ teeŋ?

english_verse: You will tie your donkey to a choice grapevine and wash your clothes in wine from those grapes.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ kakumo mʋ vɔɔ girep tɩa lɛ aŋ kɛŋ ʋ kaku-bie ma vɔɔ tɩa-la naakel-duoŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ sɩ fɩɛsa a nagɛ chalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Your eyes are darker than wine, your teeth whiter than milk.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ nyʋa girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ dɩ ʋ sɩaa fɩɛsɛ dɩ ʋ nyɩlaa ma pʋllɛ arɩ nayɩlɩŋ.

english_verse: Zebulun, you will settle along the seashore and provide safe harbors as far north as Sidon.
translation_verse: Zebuluŋ ma jaŋ jʋʋ kpagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ, lee-la nɛ jaŋ ŋaa lɩɩŋ-daborusuŋ dɩchɩnɩŋ. Ʋ dɩ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩdɔŋ tɩŋŋaa nɛ jaŋ pɛ bʋa.

english_verse: Issachar, you are a strong donkey resting in the meadows.
translation_verse: Ɩsaka nagɛ kaku-duo nɛ, a pɩŋ ʋ gbagaa pɛgɛ.

english_verse: Dan, you are the tribe that will bring justice to Israel.
translation_verse: Daŋ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a laa ʋ nɩaa sɩpaaŋ a nagɛ Iziral doho doho-la dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: You are a snake that bites the heel of a horse, making its rider fall.
translation_verse: Daŋ jaŋ nagɛ basɩŋkpɩaŋ a pɩŋ wombiiŋ niiŋ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ jɩl ʋ jaaba kʋʋ bal, ʋ ta jaaba naaŋ lɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩɩna yagɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, I am waiting for you to save us.
translation_verse: Mɩ TƖƖNA, mɩ gbɛrɩŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ laa mɩ ta.

english_verse: Gad, you will be attacked, then attack your attackers.
translation_verse: Gaaraa jaŋ golli Gad, ama ʋ jaŋ kiri ba kala dɩ ba fá.

english_verse: Asher, you will eat food fancy enough for a king.
translation_verse: Asa tinteeŋ jaŋ kɛŋ kʋdiilee, ba jaŋ zɔŋ a magɛ kuoro diiniŋ.

english_verse: Naphtali, you are a wild deer with lovely fawns.
translation_verse: Nafɩtalɩ nagɛ aamɩŋ sɩ tɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ, a lʋl bii-zɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Joseph, you are a fruitful vine growing near a stream and climbing a wall.
translation_verse: Josɛf nagɛ tɩa sɩɩ nɛŋ nɛ woruŋ a chɩŋ lɩɩ-bulo niiŋ, ʋ naakelee jɛrɛ a tɔ leriŋ kala.

english_verse: Enemies attacked with arrows, refusing to show mercy.
translation_verse: Ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ bɛrʋ, a gollu a yuou arɩ toŋ.

english_verse: But you stood your ground, swiftly shooting back with the help of Jacob's God, the All-Powerful One— his name is the Shepherd, Israel's mighty rock.
translation_verse: Ama Jekɔb Wɩa sɩ ŋaa doluŋ kala TƖƖNA leŋe ʋ toŋ arɩ ʋ nɩsaa kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ, a tɩŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa pʋpɔɔrɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: Your help came from the God your father worshiped, from God All-Powerful. God will bless you with rain and streams from the earth; he will bless you with many descendants.
translation_verse: Wɩa-la ŋ nyɩmma sɩɩ to jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ, Wɩa doluŋ kala TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ a pɩŋ duonuŋ dɩ lɩɩŋ ma bulo lɩɩ tinteeŋ a leŋ dɩ ŋ kɩaa wasɛ, aŋ pɩŋ biiriŋ ma yʋgɛ.

english_verse: My son, the blessings I give are better than the promise of ancient mountains or eternal hills. Joseph, I pray these blessings will come to you, because you are the leader of your brothers.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ dɩ ŋ na kʋzɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ faafaa peelee arɩ dundollu-la nyuŋ. Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa a pɩ Josɛf, nɩɩ-la Wɩa fa sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Benjamin, you are a fierce wolf, destroying your enemies morning and evening.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamɩŋ jaŋ nagɛ guŋguro losuŋ sɩ faasa kɛŋ, ʋ kpʋ didii chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ dɩdaanɩŋ kala.”

english_verse: These are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is how Jacob gave each of them their proper blessings. Jacob's Death
translation_verse: Iziral doho doho fii arɩ balɩa-la kala, wɩaa deemba nɛ ba nyɩmma Jekɔb fa sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ pɛ ba kʋŋkala lɛ a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ wɩaa sɩ maga. Jekɔb sʋʋŋ

english_verse: Both the cave and the land that goes with it were bought from the Hittites.
translation_verse: Ŋmaŋkaa-la arɩ bʋ-bʋa-la kala nɛ ba yɔɔ Hiti tɩŋŋaa teeŋ.”

english_verse: When Jacob had finished giving these instructions to his sons, he lay down on his bed and died.
translation_verse: Jekɔb sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩ ʋ biiriŋ dɛrɛ, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ naasɩŋ pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ aŋ wiesi ʋ wiesi-katɩɩ aŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Joseph started crying, then leaned over to hug and kiss his father.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf tele nyagɛ ʋ nyɩmma a guoru aŋ yel,

english_verse: When the time of mourning was over, Joseph said to the Egyptian leaders, “If you consider me your friend, please speak to the king for me.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ yele dɛrɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf bʋla pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro nɩhɩasɩŋ, “Dɩ ma nɛ chomi, má leŋ dɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ jʋʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro dɩgɩlɩŋ.

english_verse: Just before my father died, he made me promise to bury him in his burial cave in Canaan. If the king will give me permission to go, I will come back here.”
translation_verse: Mɩ nyɩmma leŋe mɩ ŋmɩɛsa pʋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ ʋ kpagɛ sʋʋŋ nɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ sʋba dɩ mɩ kɛnʋ mʋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ, lee-la nɛ ʋ lu ʋ bʋa a bil. Leŋ dɩ mɩ mʋ hugi mɩ nyɩmma. Mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.”

english_verse: The king answered, “Go to Canaan and keep your promise to your father.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro bʋl, “Mʋ a hugi ŋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ sɩ leŋe ŋ ŋmɩɛsa pʋ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: After crossing the Jordan River, Joseph stopped at Atad's threshing place, where they all mourned and wept seven days for Jacob.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋ yi taha-la lɛ Atad sɩ ŋmoo ʋ mɩaa a kpagɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, ba ŋmoo niiŋ bambaŋ a yel woruŋ. Josɛf ŋaa ʋ nyɩmma yoho wɩaa lee-la tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: The Canaanites saw this and said, “The Egyptians are in great sorrow.” Then they named the place “Egypt in Sorrow.”
translation_verse: Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ hɛ lee-la a na Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa dɩ baa yel Atad taha-la lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Yo-bal nɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa deemba yiyel ŋ-la.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ lee-la sɩ kpagɛ Jɔdaŋ fuoŋ aa yɩrɛ Abɛl-Mizirem.

english_verse: So Jacob's sons did just as their father had instructed.
translation_verse: Jekɔb biiriŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ fa sɩ bʋla pɩba aŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: They took him to Mamre in Canaan and buried him in Machpelah Cave, the burial place Abraham had bought from Ephron the Hittite.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋu kaa mʋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ a hugu Makɩpɛla bʋ-bʋa-la lɛ a kpagɛ Mamɩrɛ. Ŋmaŋkaa-la arɩ bʋ-bʋa-la nɛ Abɩraham yɔɔ Hiti tɩɩna-la Ɛfʋrɔŋ teeŋ ʋ ŋaa ʋ sʋʋ-hugiri lee.

english_verse: After the funeral, Joseph, his brothers, and everyone else returned to Egypt. Joseph's Promise to His Brothers
translation_verse: Josɛf sɩ hugi ʋ nyɩmma dɛrɛ, ʋ mɩɩra mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, ʋ dɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ to ʋ harɩŋ mʋ ʋ nyɩmma dɩ-huguŋ. Josɛf wasa chaga laa ʋ naambiiriŋ

english_verse: After Jacob died, Joseph's brothers said to each other, “What if Joseph still hates us and wants to get even with us for all the cruel things we did to him?”
translation_verse: Josɛf naambiiriŋ sɩ na dɩ ba nyɩmma sʋba, ŋɩɩ nɛ fawʋllʋŋ jʋʋba, ba bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ, “Bɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Josɛf nɩɩ bɩɩnɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaala wʋbɔŋ a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la la sɩ joŋo ŋaa ʋ lɛ?”

english_verse: So they sent this message to Joseph: Before our father died,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tɩŋ tɩndaarɩŋ a pɩ Josɛf a bʋl, “Wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ ŋ nyɩmma bʋl aŋ sʋʋ,

english_verse: he told us, “You did some cruel and terrible things to Joseph, but you must ask him to forgive you.” Now we ask you to please forgive the terrible things we did. After all, we serve the same God that your father worshiped. When Joseph heard this, he started crying.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ naambiiriŋ sɩ ŋaa cheyiŋ a chɛba. Joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba, bɛɛ wɩaa ba maa to Wɩa-la ŋ nyɩmma sɩɩ to nɛ.” Josɛf sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ bʋla a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ naambiiriŋ lɛ, ʋ yel.

english_verse: Right then, Joseph's brothers came and bowed down to the ground in front of him and said, “We are your slaves.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf naambiiriŋ tɩtɩa kɔ Josɛf teeŋ a kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ bʋl, “La ŋaa ŋ yosi nɛ.”

english_verse: But Joseph told them, “Don't be afraid! I have no right to change what God has decided.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf bʋla pɩba, “Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma, mɩ ŋaa Wɩa nɛɛ?

english_verse: You tried to harm me, but God made it turn out for the best, so that he could save all these people, as he is now doing.
translation_verse: Ma-na fa bɩɩna dɩ ma ŋaamɛ wʋbɔŋ nɛ, ama Wɩa mɩɩra kɛŋ wɩɩ-la bɩrɩmɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ dɩ mɩ laa nɩaa yʋgɛ mɩɩsɩŋ ta.

english_verse: Don't be afraid! I will take care of you and your children.” After Joseph said this, his brothers felt much better. Joseph's Death
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, mɩ jaŋ beŋ ma dɩ ma biiriŋ kala.” Ʋ fɩɛla bʋl ŋɩɩ pɩba, ba tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala. Josɛf Sʋba

english_verse: Joseph lived in Egypt with his brothers until he died at the age of
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf arɩ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa hɔŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Josɛf fa yi jɩsɩŋ zɔlɔ arɩ fii nɛ.

english_verse: Joseph lived long enough to see Ephraim's children and grandchildren. He also lived to see the children of Manasseh's son Machir, and he welcomed them into his family.
translation_verse: Efirem biiriŋ arɩ ʋ nihee kala puu Josɛf nɛ. Manasɛ nanʋala Makɩɩ ma biiriŋ waa Josɛf nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Before Joseph died, he told his brothers, “I won't live much longer. But God will take care of you and lead you out of Egypt to the land he promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf bʋla pɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, “Mɩ sʋʋŋ yie nɛ. Ama Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a kɛmma kaa lɩɩ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ tintee-la ʋ sɩ bil niiŋ pɩ Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba.”

english_verse: Now promise me that you will take my body with you when God leads you to that land.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf leŋ Iziral hambolibiisiŋ hɛ niiŋ pʋ, a bʋl, “Dɩ Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛma a kaa mʋ tintee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, má pɛ paa mɩ haŋgbelee a kaa mʋ.”

english_verse: When Jacob went to Egypt, his son Joseph was already there. So Jacob took his eleven other sons and their families. They were: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Benjamin, Dan, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher. Altogether, Jacob had
translation_verse: Jekɔb doho nɩalɩŋ kala fa ŋaa mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Josɛf-na fa paala hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: After Joseph, his brothers, and everyone else in that generation had died,
translation_verse: Ʋ kʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ Josɛf arɩ ʋ naambiiri-la kala sɩ hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ sʋʋ.

english_verse: the people of Israel became so numerous that the whole region of Goshen was full of them.
translation_verse: Ama ba doho nɩaa fa lʋl biiriŋ yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ a pʋŋa su tintee-la kala.

english_verse: Many years later a new king came to power. He did not know what Joseph had done for Egypt,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoru-falɩɩ kʋ dii kuoruŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ bɩ Josɛf wɩaa jɩŋ.

english_verse: and he told the Egyptians: There are too many of those Israelites in our country, and they are becoming more powerful than we are.
translation_verse: Kuoru-la bʋla pɩ ʋ nɩaa, “Má bee na, Iziral tɩmma-la pʋŋa kɩɩla nɛ.

english_verse: If we don't outsmart them, their families will keep growing larger. And if our country goes to war, they could easily fight on the side of our enemies and escape from Egypt.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la chɛ wɩɩ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ba jaŋ pʋŋa kieli, dɩ laalɩŋ nɛ maachie kʋ sii, ba jaŋ pɛ la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ dɩ ba yuo diila aŋ fá.”

english_verse: The Egyptians put slave bosses in charge of the people of Israel and tried to wear them down with hard work. Those bosses forced them to build the cities of Pithom and Rameses, where the king could store his supplies.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba chaarɛ nɩaa ba bibeŋ Iziral tɩmma-la dɩ ba fʋgɛba dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ yoŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ba saa tabalaa balɩa a pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro, dɩ baa bil kɩaa nɩmɛ, tasɩ-la yɩraa nɛ Pɩtɔm arɩ Ramesis.

english_verse: But even though the Israelites were mistreated, their families grew larger, and they took over more land. Because of this, the Egyptians feared them worse than before
translation_verse: Ba sɩ faasa dʋdɔgɩsɛba ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba pʋŋa pɩpɛ, a jɛrɛ su tintee-la. A tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa fɩfába woruŋ,
