english_verse: Work the first six days of the week, but rest and relax on the seventh day. This law is not only for you, but for your oxen, donkeys, and slaves, as well as for any foreigners among you.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa balɩdʋ nɛ ma jaŋ kaa tɩŋ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa aŋ wiesi tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ. Ma nɛ-pɛrɛɛ, ma kakusuŋ, ma yoŋ-biiriŋ arɩ ma nʋhʋɔraa kala maga dɩ ba wiesi nɛ tapʋlʋŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: Make certain that you obey everything I have said. Don't pray to other gods or even mention their names. Three Annual Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: Má jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩma. Má pɔ dɩ ma sɩ́ vʋɩyaa kpaarʋ, a sɩ́ ba yɩrɩŋ yɩrʋ.

english_verse: Do not offer bread made with yeast when you sacrifice an animal to me. And make sure that the fat of the animal is burned that same day.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ pʋna chalɩŋ kaa kɔ dɩ ma ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, má pɔ dɩ ma sɩ́ boroboro-la sɩ kɛŋ sɩbʋrʋŋ to kaa kɔ, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ pʋna-la ma sɩ kaa kʋ kpʋ pɩmɛ nʋʋŋ chɩna chʋa.

english_verse: Your women will give birth to healthy children, and everyone will live a long life.
translation_verse: Ma tinteeŋ haal kala bɩ jaŋ chei ta koo a ŋaa hapɩrɛ. Nʋʋkala jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩ-duduoŋ.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bumoo ŋaa ma baga kʋdii falaa, má gbieli gbiele-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ kʋdii falaa gbiele. Dɩ ma nɛ bɩra kʋ tɔrɛ ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ, má bɩra gbieli gbiele-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ bagasieu gbiele.

english_verse: Your men must come to these three festivals each year to worship me.
translation_verse: Jɩna na-kala dɩ ma nɩɩ gbieli gbielee deemba batori, baalaa kala maga dɩ ba kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩpaaŋ nɛ a chʋɔlɛmɛ.

english_verse: Celebrate three festivals each year in my honor.
translation_verse: Má gbieli gbiele naansɩɩŋ butori jɩna na-kala tʋɔŋ a liliisi mɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: Celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread by eating bread made without yeast, just as I have commanded. Do this at the proper time during the month of Abib, because it is the month when you left Egypt. And make certain that everyone brings the proper offerings.
translation_verse: Chɛnɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Abib tʋɔŋ, chɛnɛ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛmma lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, má gbieli gbiele-la ba sɩ yie gbieli a dii boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ. Tapʋlaa balɩpɛ ma jaŋ dii boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ arɩ mɩ sɩ dagɛma ŋɩɩ. Nʋʋkala pɔ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ mɩ sɩpaaŋ kɔ arɩ na-hɩllɩŋ.

english_verse: Each year bring the best part of your first harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. A Promise and a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma kʋdii falaa ma sɩ ŋaa kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ kaa kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩa a zilmi. Ma pɔ má sɩ́ bʋ-bie koo pie-bie joŋo hɛ ʋ naaŋ yɩlɩŋ lɛ a chɔ. La TƖƖNA sɩ ʋ jaŋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaaŋ

english_verse: I am sending an angel to protect you and to lead you into the land I have ready for you.
translation_verse: Má bee na, mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ mɩ tɩndaara dɩ ʋ laa ma sɩpaaŋ a pɔma a kɛmma kaa mʋ lee-la mɩ sɩ wasa bil ma lɛ.

english_verse: My angel will lead you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩndaara jaŋ laa ma sɩpaaŋ a kɛmma mʋ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa, Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa, Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa, Hivi tɩŋŋaa arɩ Jebus tɩŋŋaa tintee-la. Mɩ jaŋ chei ba kala.

english_verse: Don't worship their gods or follow their customs. Instead, destroy their idols and shatter their stone images.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ba vesiŋ sɩpaaŋ kpirimi a kpaarɛba a to ba wʋŋaalaa lɛ. Má ŋmoo kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ kpaarʋ chei.

english_verse: Worship only me, the Lord your God! I will bless you with plenty of food and water and keep you strong.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ to mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma na kʋdiilee arɩ lɩɩŋ, a pɔ dɩ nyanyalɩɩ kala sɩ́ ma kɛŋ.

english_verse: I will terrify those nations and make your enemies so confused that they will run from you.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ tinteye-la nɩaa ma sɩ jaŋ mʋ cheŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba wɩaa vʋgʋmɛ, dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala fá lɛl.

english_verse: I will make the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites panic as you approach.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ kɛntɛrɩsɩŋ laa ma sɩpaaŋ a kiri Hivi tɩŋŋaa, Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa arɩ Hiti tɩŋŋaa dɩ ma nɛ kʋʋ yiba.

english_verse: But I won't do all this in the first year, because the land would become poor, and wild animals would be everywhere.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ kiriba jɩ-bala pɛgɛ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, tintee-la jaŋ wuoli, dɩ baga-kɩaa pʋŋa yʋgɛ a wʋwalɩmɛma.

english_verse: Instead, I will force out your enemies little by little and give your nation time to grow strong enough to take over the land.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kikiriba mʋa mʋa, a kʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ jaŋ pʋŋ a wuo su tintee-la kala.

english_verse: I will see that your borders reach from the Red Sea to the Euphrates River and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert. I will let you defeat the people who live there, and you will force them out of the land.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dagɛ ma tinteeŋ bʋa pɩma, a chɩŋ mʋga-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ a kaa mʋ mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediterenia, a bɩra chɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ a kaa mʋ Yufireti fuo-la. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ a hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ma kiriba aŋ laa lee-la.

english_verse: But you must not make any agreements with them or with their gods.
translation_verse: Ma pɔ má sɩ́ nii kala hɛ arɩ ba, koo a ta niiŋ ba vesiŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Don't let them stay in your land. They will trap you into sinning against me and worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba hɔŋ ma tinteeŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma tuto ba vesiŋ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ jaŋ ŋaa bɛrɛ a pɩma.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up to me on this mountain. Bring along Aaron, as well as his two sons Nadab and Abihu, and
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Má kʋ jɩl mɩ teeŋ, ŋ dɩ Arɔŋ, Nadab arɩ Abihu, arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii. Ʋ maga dɩ ma chɩŋ dɩ-bolii nɛ aŋ zilmi.

english_verse: Moses gave the Lord's instructions to the people, and they all promised, “We will do everything the Lord has commanded!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis mʋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla arɩ wombie-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ baa to. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala bʋl, “La jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla.”

english_verse: Then Moses wrote down what the Lord had said. The next morning Moses got up early. He built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up a large stone for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla a bil. Ʋ sii chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla a saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ peel-la bʋbʋɔŋ, a paa tabɩaa fii arɩ balɩa pɛ ba nagɛ jebiiŋ. Tabɩɩ kala chɩŋ Iziral doho doho fii arɩ balɩa-la kʋŋkala nyuŋ.

english_verse: He also sent some young men to burn offerings and to sacrifice bulls as special offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛ bapʋɔsaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ, a leŋ ba ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ aŋ kpʋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ ma a ŋaa nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Moses put half of the blood from the animals into bowls and sprinkled the rest on the altar.
translation_verse: Mosis kɛŋ pʋsʋ-la chalɩŋ kpaa balɩa a joŋ dɔŋɔ a bɩsa hɛ gbansɩŋ lɛ, aŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ ma mɩsɛ koru-la.

english_verse: Then he read aloud the Lord's commands and promises, and the people shouted, “We will obey the Lord and do everything he has commanded!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ Wɩa niiriŋ sɩ hɛ a karɩma pɩ nɩalɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla, la jaŋ sɛɩba a tutoba.”

english_verse: Moses took the blood from the bowls and sprinkled it on the people. Next, he told them, “With this blood the Lord makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis joŋ chal-la mɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ aŋ bʋl, “Chal-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo hɛ niiŋ ʋ dɩ ma pɛgɛ nɛ ŋ-la a tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla lɛ.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with Nadab and Abihu and the
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis, Arɔŋ, Nadab, Abihu arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩ-la mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii sii jɩl peel-la.

english_verse: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something that looked like a pavement made out of sapphire, and it was as bright as the sky.
translation_verse: Ba na Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, dɩ ʋ chɩŋ tabɩɩ-zɔmɔ kʋbalaba ba sɩ kaa ŋaa wombiiŋ. Tabɩa-la yɩrɩŋ nɛ safɩya a nagɛ diibelimbine a tʋtʋl a nagɛ wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: Even though these leaders of Israel saw God, he did not punish them. So they ate and drank. Moses on Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩ-la wɩɩkala ŋaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩ-la na Wɩa aŋ hɔnɔ bibenu a dii kɩaa aŋ nyʋa, ka Wɩa bɩ ba wɩɩkala ŋaa.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up on the mountain and stay here for a while. I will give you the two flat stones on which I have written the laws that my people must obey.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Kʋ jɩl mɩ teeŋ peel-la nyuŋ a gbɛrɛmɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ mɩ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ hɛ dɩ ma tuto arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga dɩ ma ŋɩŋaa a pɩŋ.”

english_verse: Moses and Joshua his assistant got ready, then Moses started up the mountain to meet with God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis arɩ Josua ŋaa siri dɩ ba jɩl Wɩa peel-la nyuŋ. Josua fa ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ ba tɩtɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Moses had told the leaders, “Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur will be with you, and they can settle any arguments while we are away.”
translation_verse: Mosis bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ, “Má gbɛrɛla daha, la jaŋ mʋ aŋ kɔ. Arɔŋ arɩ Huu jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩ sɩɩ walɩmʋ, ʋ mʋ naba.”

english_verse: When Moses went up on Mount Sinai, a cloud covered it,
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ jɩl peel-la nyuŋ, duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ kʋ tɔ ʋ kala.

english_verse: and the bright glory of the Lord came down and stayed there. The cloud covered the mountain for six days, and on the seventh day the Lord told Moses to come into the cloud.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tʋla tɔ Sɩnaɩ peel-la kala, duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la tɔ ŋɩɩ tapʋlaa balɩdʋ. Chɛ-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ La TƖƖNA to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la tʋɔŋ a yɩrɛ Mosis.

english_verse: blue, purple, and red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ, gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ, bʋ-pʋnaa,

english_verse: Tell everyone in Israel who wants to give gifts that they must bring them to you.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba kɛŋ kɩaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩmɛ, laa kʋ-la kala nʋʋkala sɩ cho dɩ ʋ joŋo pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Here is a list of what you are to collect: Gold, silver, and bronze;
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ jaŋ laa ba teeŋ nɛ ŋ-la: sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla arɩ kɔlɩɩŋ,

english_verse: tanned ram skins; fine leather; acacia wood;
translation_verse: pie-bel tenniŋ ba sɩ hɛ biriŋ ʋ fɩɛsɛ, lɩɩ-nɛŋ tenniŋ arɩ sɔjaamɩŋ daaŋ,

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices to mix with the incense and with the oil for dedicating the tent and ordaining the priests;
translation_verse: chaanaa nʋʋŋ, arɩ tegisi-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ arɩ tegisi-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma,

english_verse: and onyx stones and other gems for the sacred vest and the breastpiece.
translation_verse: tabɩɩ-tʋlaa ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ɔnɩs arɩ tabɩɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋo hɛ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la arɩ bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: I also want them to build a special place where I can live among my people.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ŋaa lee sɩ zɔmɔ pɩmɛ, dɩ mɩ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Cover it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the lid.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ a taarɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ harɩŋ kala aŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa mɛ golli.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ libi nenii-pɩraa banɛsɛ, a joŋo hɛ naasɩŋ banɛsɛ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ. Balɩa jaŋ hɛ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, dɩ balɩa ma hɛ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Make two poles of acacia wood. Cover them with gold
translation_verse: Keri sɔjaamɩŋ daaterigeba, a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taarɛba.

english_verse: and put them through the rings, so the chest can be carried by the poles.
translation_verse: Joŋ daaterigeba-la tʋʋ nenii-pɩra-la sɩ hɛ daga-la sɛsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ ba lɛ aa joŋ daga-la.

english_verse: Don't ever remove the poles from the rings.
translation_verse: Daaterigeba-la jaŋ tʋʋ daga-la nenii-pɩra-la lɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba kɛmba lɩɩsɛ.

english_verse: Then hammer out two winged creatures of pure gold and fasten them to the lid at the ends of the chest.
translation_verse: Kʋ-la ŋ sɩ kaa libi daga-la nii-tɔlɔ tɩtɩa nɛ maga dɩ ŋ kaa libi kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ. Dɔŋɔ jaŋ chɩŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, dɩ dɔŋɔ ma chɩŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Inside it place the two flat stones with the Ten Commandments on them and put the gold lid on top of the chest.
translation_verse: Joŋ mɩ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la balɩa lɛ a pɩŋ a hɛ daga-la tʋɔŋ a joŋ daga-la nii-tɔlɔ tɔ.

english_verse: I will meet you there between the two creatures and tell you what my people must do and what they must not do. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ kɔ ŋ teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ hɛ kɩalɩŋ balɩa-la sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ pɛgɛ daga-la nyuŋ. Nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ dagɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba tuto. Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la teebʋl

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Ŋaa giriŋ dɩ ʋ jalɩŋ magɛ nachala a golli teebʋl-la, a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ biere golli.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ libi nenii-pɩraa banɛsɛ a joŋo hɛ teebʋl-la gʋnaa lɛ naasɩŋ leree.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table are to be placed through these rings and are to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Keri sɔjaamɩŋ daasɩŋ a kaa ŋaa daaterigeba-la a joŋ sɛlɩmɛ taara tɔ ba kala. Daasɩ-la lɛ nɛ ba jaŋ kɛŋ a jujoŋ teebʋl-la.

english_verse: The table is to be kept in the holy place, and the sacred loaves of bread must always be on it. All bowls, plates, jars, and cups for wine offerings are to be made of pure gold and set on this table. The Lampstand (Exodus
translation_verse: Má joŋ boroboro-la ma sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩpɩmɛ a daŋ teebʋl-la nyuŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ bʋa na-kala. Chaaŋ daaŋ

english_verse: Make a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered gold
translation_verse: Kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ libi chaanaa sɩɩ daŋ kʋ-la nyuŋ, ʋ bʋbʋɔ-chala arɩ ʋ kerikee kala. Ʋ nyʋnyʋalʋ-la sɩ nagɛ tɩɩ-lugoo arɩ tɩɩfɩɩlaa sɩ pɔsɔ dɩ ba kala mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ a ŋaa kʋbala.

english_verse: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.
translation_verse: Kerike-la arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ tɩɩ-fɩɩlɩŋ sɩ lugo, sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ maga dɩ ŋ kaa libi, dɩ ba kala nagɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The tongs and trays for taking care of the lamps are to be made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ libi kʋ-la lɛ ŋ sɩ jaŋ joŋ chaaŋ-ŋmɛnɩŋ hɛ a mɩlɩma ta ʋ tutuu aŋ jɩjɩl.

english_verse: and they must be made according to the pattern I showed you on the mountain.
translation_verse: Libi kɩalɩŋ dɩ ba nagɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ dagɩŋ peel-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, use a piece of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: Leŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ gɛnnɩŋ sʋɔnʋŋ kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ a yɛrɛ patɩɩsaŋ a sʋa kɩaa hɛ ʋ lɛ, a joŋo kɛrɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: As the material for protecting the tent, use goat hair to weave eleven sections of cloth
translation_verse: Patɩɩsamba-la fii arɩ kʋbala kala maga dɩ ba magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, dɩ ba duomuŋ ŋaa yaadɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ, ka ba jalɩŋ ma ŋaa yaadɩ balɩa.

english_verse: The top of the sacred tent must be made from ten pieces of the finest linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ patɩɩsamba fii ba sɩ kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ, ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ arɩ ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ yuo. Leŋ dɩ gɔgɔ sʋa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a hɛ patɩɩsamba-la lɛ a ŋaa Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la.

english_verse: and sew them together into two panels with five sections each.
translation_verse: Yɛrɛ patɩɩsamba-la banɔŋ mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ nii-duduosuŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a yɛrɛ banɔŋ ma mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The panel of goat hair will be a meter longer than the tent itself, so fold
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ bʋ-pʋnaa patɩɩsamba-la kiele tuu Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɛsɩŋ naakieliŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ. Ba nɛ jaŋ kɛrɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɛmɛ na-kala.

english_verse: Sew five of the sections together to make one panel. Then sew the other six together to make a second panel, and fold the sixth section double over the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Yɛrɛ patɩɩsamba-la banɔŋ mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba ŋaa kʋbala. Kɛŋ kʋkaanaa balɩdʋ-la ma yɛrɛ mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ aŋ kɛŋ patɩɩsaŋ-du-la kaa kpeŋ bʋlɩa a kaa kɛrɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Make two more coverings—one with tanned ram skins and the other with fine leather. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Hɛ biriŋ pie-tenniŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ fɩɛsɛ, aŋ joŋ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ a tɔ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la nyuŋ a joŋ pie-tenni-la tɔ daŋ.

english_verse: Build a framework of acacia wood for the walls of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ sɔjaamɩŋ daasɩŋ sɩ tʋʋla a ŋaa Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la.

english_verse: with two wooden pegs near the bottom.
translation_verse: Higi Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la daapɛsɩŋ kala bʋbʋɔŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ kerikee balɩa a challɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Place two silver stands under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so the frames can be joined together. Put
translation_verse: Kɛŋ hɔpʋla libi hɔ-taalɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa dɩ ba kɛŋ bʋɔsʋŋ a hɛ daapɛsɩ-la ma bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ. Daa na-kala bʋbʋɔŋ jaŋ kɛŋ hɔ-taalɩsɩŋ balɩa.

english_verse: For the back wall along the west side use six frames
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ ma jaŋ kɛŋ daapɛsɩŋ balɩdʋ.

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. Make certain that these corner frames are joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Gʋna-la daapɛsɩŋ maga dɩ ba ŋaa daa-kparaa nɛ a lɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ a kaa jɩlaa yi nyuŋ dɩ nenii-pɩrɩ-bala tʋʋ ba kala lɛ.

english_verse: Altogether, this back wall will have eight frames with two silver stands under each one.
translation_verse: Daa-pɛsɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ gʋna-la lɛ maga dɩ ba ŋaa chori nɛ, dɩ hɔpʋla hɔ-taalɩsɩ-la ma sɩ kɛŋ bʋɔsʋŋ ŋaa fii arɩ balɩdʋ. Daa na-kala bʋbʋɔŋ jaŋ kɛŋ hɔ-taalɩsɩ-la balɩa.

english_verse: Make five crossbars for each of the wooden frames,
translation_verse: dɩ banɔŋ ma hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, ka banɔŋ ma hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.
translation_verse: Tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ daa-gɛsɩŋ maga dɩ ʋ chɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a mʋ yi sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Cover the frames and the crossbars with gold and attach gold rings to the frames to run the crossbars through.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taarɛ daapɛsɩ-la kala, aŋ ŋaa sɛlɩmɛ nenii-pɩraa a hɛ daapɛsɩ-la lɛ. Ba lɛ nɛ daa-gɛsɩa-la jaŋ tʋʋ. Kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taara tɔ daa-gɛsɩa-la ma.

english_verse: Then set up the tent in the way I showed you on the mountain. The Curtain inside the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ŋaa Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la dɩ ʋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ dagɩŋ peel-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: Outside the most holy place, as you face the curtain, put the table for the sacred bread on the right side and the gold lampstand on the left.
translation_verse: Joŋ teebʋl-la bil Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tʋɔŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔmʋŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ, aŋ joŋ chaaŋ daaŋ a bil wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ dɩ ba chɩna challɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Make a curtain to separate the holy place from the most holy place. Use fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. Cover four acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a silver stand. Then fasten gold hooks to the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Patɩɩsaŋ-la maga dɩ ʋ sagɛ kʋkaachɛbɛ-kɛnɩa-la lɛ nɛ, a kɛŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔmʋŋ arɩ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ kaa kpaa. Dɩ ŋ joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la jʋʋ bil Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ.

english_verse: Cover five acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a bronze stand. Then put gold hooks on the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ sɔjaamɩŋ daaŋ ŋaa daapɛsɩŋ banɔŋ, a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taara tɔ a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa kʋkaachɛbɛ-kɛnɛɛ, dɩ patɩɩsaŋ sagɛ ba lɛ. Kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa hɔ-taalɩsɩŋ banɔŋ dɩ daapɛsɩ-la chɩŋ ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: Cover two acacia wood poles with bronze and put them through the rings for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Joŋ daaterigeba-la a hɛ nenii-pɩra-la sɩ hɛ koru-la sɛsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba kaa jujoŋ.

english_verse: All the equipment for the altar must also be made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the sprinkling bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa koru-la nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa deemba: tʋɔrʋŋ pupoiŋ, safʋlba, kʋmɩsɩrɩ gbansɩŋ, lɛsɩ-la ba sɩ kaa lɩɩsɛ nammɩa arɩ nʋʋ-hallɩŋ.

english_verse: Halfway up the altar build a ledge around it, and cover the bottom half of the altar with a decorative bronze grating. Then attach a bronze ring beneath the ledge at the four corners of the altar.
translation_verse: Joŋ kɔlɩɩŋ kʋ-la sɩ kɛŋ bʋɔsʋŋ a nagɛ nanchɛbɩrɩ kʋa a tagɩlɛ koru-la tʋɔŋ, dɩ ʋ jɩla yi ʋ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ.

english_verse: Construct the altar in the shape of an open box, just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Kɛŋ daborusuŋ nɛ ŋaa koru-la a leŋ dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kɛŋ bʋa arɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ dagɩŋ peel-la nyuŋ. Lɩga-la sɩ golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la

english_verse: Command the people of Israel to supply you with the purest olive oil. Do this so the lamp will keep burning
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba kɛŋ nʋʋŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ kɔ, dɩ ŋ hɛ chaanaa lɛ dɩ ba didii.

english_verse: for the west. Then hang a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. Place three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hang a curtain
translation_verse: Daa-pɛsɩ-la lɛ patɩɩsamba-la sɩ jaŋ sagɛ maga dɩ ba ŋaa mara, dɩ hɔ-taalɩsɩ-la nyuŋ daapɛsɩ-la sɩ jaŋ chɩŋ ma ŋaa kɔlɩɩŋ hɔ-taalɩŋ mara a kɛŋ hɔpʋla ŋaa kʋkaachɛbɛ-kɛnɛɛ arɩ lere-la patɩɩsamba-la sɩ jaŋ vɔɔ.

english_verse: Use four more of these posts for the entrance way, then hang on them an embroidered curtain of fine linen nine meters long and woven with blue, purple, and red wool.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ gɔgɔ kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ, arɩ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ, a yɛrɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lɩga boiŋ niiŋ patɩɩsaŋ a sʋa, dɩ ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa yaadɩ fii. Daa-pɛsɩ-la nyuŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ sagɛ ma ŋaa banɛsɛ, dɩ hɔ-taalɩsɩ-la nyuŋ daapɛsɩ-la sɩ jaŋ chɩŋ ma ŋaa banɛsɛ.

english_verse: Make the rest of the equipment for the sacred tent of bronze, including the pegs for the tent and for the curtain surrounding the courtyard. The Oil for the Lamp in the Holy Place (Leviticus
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ jaŋ kaa tɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tɩntɩŋŋaa arɩ daa-pɛ-biisi-la kala sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ lɩga-la arɩ lɛbɩ-la a kɩɩ maga dɩ ŋ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ ŋaa. Chaanaa nʋʋŋ

english_verse: in front of the curtain that separates the holy place from the most holy place, where the sacred chest is kept. Aaron and his sons are responsible for keeping the lamp burning every night in the sacred tent. The Israelites must always obey this command.
translation_verse: Lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tʋɔŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔmʋŋ, Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambiisiŋ maga dɩ ba nyɩgɛ chaanaa bil La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ dɩdaanɩŋ, dɩ ba didii a kaa mʋ chʋchʋɔŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho kala dɩ ba tuto bʋa na-kala.”

english_verse: Send for your brother Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. They are the ones I have chosen from Israel to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Kɛŋ ŋ naambie Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ Nadab, Abihu, Elieza arɩ Ɩtama lɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ, ba nɛ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa.

english_verse: Aaron is to be dedicated as my high priest, and his clothes must be made only by persons who possess skills that I have given them.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ joŋ jɩma pa ba jɩŋ gɛnnɩŋ yɛrɩŋ, dɩ ba yɛrɛ gɛnnɩ-la dɩ ŋ joŋ Arɔŋ hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: Here are the items that need to be made: a breastpiece, a priestly vest, a robe, an embroidered shirt, a turban, and a sash. These sacred clothes are to be made for your brother Aaron and his sons who will be my priests.
translation_verse: Gɛnnɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ yɛrɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩŋ, gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩŋ, gɛrɩ-duduoŋ sɩ nagɛ diibelimbine a tuu magɛ naasolluŋ, gɛrɩ-pʋl-duduoŋ sɩ tuu magɛ naachɩgɩsɩŋ, nyu-bɛlɛ arɩ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie, dɩ ŋ naambie Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ laalɛ a ŋaa mɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa.

english_verse: Use only gold and fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool, for making these clothes. The Vest for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: Ŋmɛŋ-sumunuŋ, ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ nɛ maga dɩ ba kaa yɛrɛba. Gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩŋ

english_verse: Attach two gold settings to the shoulder straps and fasten them with two braided chains of pure gold. The Breastpiece for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: Kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ libi chɔrʋmɔɔ, dɩ ba nagɛ ŋmɛsɩŋ, dɩ ŋ joŋo vɔɔ a mɛrɛ sɛlɩmɛ kʋtaalɩsɩ-la lɛ. Bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩŋ

english_verse: and engrave on each of them the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Tabɩa-la jaŋ ŋaa fii arɩ balɩa, dɩ ŋ ŋmʋnsɛ Jekɔb hambolibiisi-la fii arɩ balɩa yɩraa hɛ, dɩ tabɩɩ na-kala chɩŋ doho kala nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: From the same costly material make a breastpiece for the high priest to use in finding out what I want my people to do.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛyɛ-la tɩtɩa ŋ sɩ kaa yɛrɛ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la a yɛrɛ bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩŋ ma, dɩ ba kaa jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ. Leŋ dɩ gɔgɔ nɛ yɛrɛ.

english_verse: with four rows of three precious stones: In the first row put a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;
translation_verse: Paa tabɩɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ kɩɛlɛ naaderee banɛsɛ bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩ-la lɛ. Naaderi-bumbuŋ lɛ mɛrɛ tabɩaa deemba: ‘rubi’ a ŋaa tabɩɩ-fɩaŋ, ‘topas’ a ŋaa tabɩɩ-sumunuŋ arɩ ‘bɛrɛl’ a ŋaa tabɩɩ-jɔgɩlɩɩŋ.

english_verse: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
translation_verse: Naaderi-torimuŋ lɛ, mɛrɛ tabɩaa deemba: ‘jasɩŋ’ ʋ ma ŋaa tabɩɩ-diibelimbine nɛ, ‘agɛtɩ’ a ŋaa tabɩɩ-tʋlʋŋ arɩ ‘amɛtɩs’ ʋ ma nagɛ diibelimbine nɛ.

english_verse: Attach two gold rings to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fasten them with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ chɔrʋmɔ-la niipiŋ-kaanaa jɩla vɔɔ mɛrɛ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la vaasɩŋ jolluŋ lɛ sɩpaaŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Then take a blue cord and tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. This will keep the breastpiece in place.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine a vɔɔ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la nenii-pɩraa arɩ bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩ-la nenii-pɩraa a mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ŋmɛsɩ-la kiele tuu vɔɔ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie lɛ, dɩ bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩ-la sɩ́ sʋʋsʋ, aŋ ka gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la.

english_verse: Under his vest Aaron must wear a robe of blue wool
translation_verse: Kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ diibelimbine a yɛrɛ gɛrɩ-duduoŋ-la sɩ tuu yi naasolluŋ.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for his head. Be sure to bind the material around the collar to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: Hɛ gɛrɩ-la baŋŋaa tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ a sʋa ʋ kala golli, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ kɩɛsʋ.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe weave pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a gold bell between each of them.
translation_verse: Kʋgugulie-la sɩ nagɛ kampoi nɛnɛɛ arɩ sɛlɩmɛ bimbelime-la jaŋ chagɩsɛ chagɩsɛ a golli gɛrɩ-la niipinee.

english_verse: If Aaron wears these clothes when he enters the holy place as my high priest, the sound of the bells will be heard, and his life will not be in danger.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ maga dɩ ʋ laalɛ gɛrɩŋ deeŋ nɛ bʋa na-kala dɩ ʋ nɩɩ chɛ ʋ tɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa, dɩ ʋ nɩɩ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tʋɔŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ koo dɩ ʋ nɩɩ lɩɩ. Bimbelime-la sɩ hɛ gɛrɩ-la niipinee lɛ jaŋ dʋdɔŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ sɩ́ sʋʋ.

english_verse: On a narrow strip of pure gold engrave the words: “Dedicated to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ libi pɩrata a ŋmʋnsa hɛ ʋ lɛ a bʋl, ‘Ʋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA kʋzɔŋ nɛ.’

english_verse: Fasten it to the front of Aaron's turban with a blue cord,
translation_verse: Joŋ pɩrata-la a kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine a vɔɔ mɛrɛ nyu-bɛlɛ-la sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: so he can wear it on his forehead. This will show that he will take on himself the guilt for any sins the people of Israel commit in offering their gifts to me, and I will forgive them.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ jaŋ joŋo vɔɔ ʋ tile lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dagɛ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ chei a mʋʋ tɩgɛ ba Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩaa lɛ, aŋ kaa mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ bʋa na-kala, ʋ ha jaŋ laa ba sʋla.

english_verse: Since Aaron's sons are priests, they should also look dignified. So make robes, sashes, and special caps for them.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ a yɛrɛ gɛrɩ-pʋl-duduoŋ-la sɩ tuu yi naachɛyɛɛ arɩ nyu-bɛlɛ, arɩ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie. Leŋ dɩ gɛrɩ-yɛrɩrɩ gɔgɔ nɛ sʋa gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie-la pɩ Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ.

english_verse: Then dress Aaron and his sons in these clothes, pour olive oil on their heads, and ordain them as my priests.
translation_verse: Joŋ gɛnnɩŋ deemba a laalɛ ŋ naambie Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ, aŋ joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ a sʋl Wɩa hɛ ba lɛ a jomba hɛ mɩ-na Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa.

english_verse: Make linen shorts for them that reach from the waist down to the thigh, so they won't expose themselves.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ a yɛrɛ kpuŋkpel-biisiŋ a pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ.

english_verse: Whenever they enter the sacred tent or serve at the altar or enter the holy place, they must wear these shorts, or else they will be guilty and die. This same rule applies to any of their descendants who serve as priests.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ maga dɩ ba vɔɔ kpuŋkpelliŋ deemba nɛ, dɩ ba nɩɩ jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, koo dɩ ba nɩɩ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tʋɔŋ koru-la teeŋ dɩ ba tɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa, dɩ wʋbɔŋ sɩ́ ba lɛ ŋaa koo dɩ ba sɩ́ sʋʋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ maga dɩ ʋ chɩŋ nɛ a pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa kala dɩ ba tuto a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for sin and as a way of purifying the altar. In addition, you must smear the altar with olive oil to make it completely holy.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala kɛŋ nɛ-bele a sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta. Pɩɩsɛ koru-la disiniŋ ta aŋ joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ taaʋ a wasʋ.

english_verse: Then from your finest flour make three batches of dough without yeast. Shape some of it into larger loaves, some into smaller loaves mixed with olive oil, and the rest into thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ mɛmpɛ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ a sɩ́ sɩbʋrʋŋ hɛ a wasɛ boroboro, a kɛŋ nʋʋŋ buu dɔnsʋŋ ma a wasɛ muŋ-gulumoo, aŋ wasɛ boroboro pɛrɛ pɛrɛ biisiŋ ma a ŋaa nʋʋŋ taa.

english_verse: Put all of this bread in a basket and bring it when you come to sacrifice the three animals to me.
translation_verse: Jomba kala hɛ sime tʋɔŋ, a pɛ kɛŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋ-la arɩ pie-belli-la balɩa a kaa kɔ.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the sacred tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kaa kɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ a ŋaa lɩɩŋ foba.

english_verse: and then ordain him by pouring olive oil on his head.
translation_verse: Joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ a bɩsa hɛ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ nɛ-bele-la kaa kɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ a leŋ dɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ joŋ ba nɩsaa daŋ nɛŋ-la nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Kill the bull near my altar in front of the tent.
translation_verse: Kpʋ nɛŋ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Use a finger to smear some of its blood on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest of the blood on the ground next to the altar.
translation_verse: Ŋaa nɛŋ-la chalɩŋ a kɛŋ ŋ neniiŋ tagɛ a hɛ koru-la nyilliŋ lɛ aŋ joŋ kʋkaanɩŋ bɩsa ta koru-la bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But the meat, the skin, and the food still in the bull's stomach must be burned outside the camp as an offering to ask forgiveness for the sins of the priests.
translation_verse: Ama nɛŋ-la nammɩa, ʋ teniŋ arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa maga dɩ ŋ kɛmba lɩɩ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ harɩŋ a nyɩgɛ, ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Bring one of the rams to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ pie-belli-la dɔŋɔ a leŋ dɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ joŋ ba nɩsaa daŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Kill the ram and splatter its blood against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Kpʋ pie-bele-la a chaga laa ʋ chalɩŋ a joŋo mɩsɛ koru-la sɛsɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Cut up the ram, wash its insides and legs, and lay all of its parts on the altar, including the head.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ piesu-la keri muno muno a chɛsɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa arɩ naasɩŋ a joŋ ba dɩ ʋ nyuŋ a pɛ nammɩa-la kala ŋ sɩ kere lɛ a hɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Then make sure that the whole animal goes up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Joŋ piesu-la kala nyɩgɛ koru-la nyuŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Bring the other ram to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ pie-bel-kaaŋ-la a leŋ dɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ joŋ ba nɩsaa daŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Kill the ram and place some of its blood on Aaron's right ear lobe, his right thumb, and the big toe of his right foot. Do the same for each of his sons and splatter the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Kpʋ piesu-la a chaga laa ʋ chalɩŋ a taga lagɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nadiiŋ dɩgɩlɩŋ pɩpaarɩŋ lɛ, ba nadiiŋ nenii-baalaa arɩ ba nadiiŋ naanii-baalaa aŋ joŋ chal-la mɩsɛ koru-la sɛsɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Then take some of the blood from the altar, mix it with the oil used for ordination, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his clothes, and also on his sons and their clothes. This will show that they and their clothes have been dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Paa chal-la dɔnsʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ a mɩsa hɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba gɛnnɩŋ lɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jomba hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: This ram is part of the ordination service. So remove its right hind leg, its fat tail, the fat on its insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: Kʋɔrɛ piesu-la nʋʋŋ, nʋʋ-la sɩ tɔ dokeliŋ arɩ nʋʋ-la sɩ tɔ tʋɔŋ kɩaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ tɔ chʋɩŋ arɩ nʋʋ-la sɩ tɔ chʋchɔ-biee arɩ nʋʋ-la sɩ tɔba, a lɩɩsɛ nadiiŋ huiŋ pɛ. Piesu-la ba sɩ kaa wasɛ wɩaa a joŋ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ a hɛ mɩ-na Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: and put this bread, together with the meat, into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then they will lift it all up to show that it is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Joŋ kʋdiile-la hɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɩsaa lɛ dɩ ba kaa je a zaarɛ. Ŋɩɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA teeŋ.

english_verse: After this, put the meat and bread on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Laa kɩalɩŋ ba nɩsaa lɛ a joŋo pɛ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa lɛ ŋ sɩ jaŋ nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA a nyɩgɛba kala koru-la nyuŋ. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: You may eat the choice ribs from this second ram, but you must first lift them up to show that this meat is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Piesu-la ŋ sɩ kaa wasɛ wɩaa a joŋ Arɔŋ hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, keri ʋ bɔyɛ a kaa je a zaarɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA teeŋ. Ŋ toruŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: After Aaron's death, his priestly clothes are to be handed down to each descendant who succeeds him as high priest, and these clothes must be worn during the seven-day ceremony of ordination.
translation_verse: Bile sɩ laa Arɔŋ nyuŋ dɩ ʋ jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ a tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ jaŋ laalɛ gɛnnɩ-la tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: then Aaron and his sons are to eat it together with the three kinds of bread at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ jaŋ chaŋ nammɩa-la aŋ dii boroboroba-la sɩ hɛ sime-la tʋɔŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: At their ordination, a ceremony of forgiveness was performed for them with this sacred food, and only they have the right to eat it.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ dii kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta a wasɛ wɩaa a jomba hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ dii kɩalɩŋ, nɩwogo bɩ maga dɩ ʋ diiba, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa mɩ kʋzɔmɔ nɛ.

english_verse: If any of the sacred food is left until morning, it must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Dɩ kʋdiile-la kʋŋkala nɛ chɩna dɩ taŋ pʋl, má bɩra sɩ́ dii, má joŋo nyɩgɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa mɩ kʋzɔmɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Repeat this ordination ceremony for Aaron and his sons seven days in a row, just as I have instructed you.
translation_verse: Ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɩŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ. Joŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ a wasɛ wɩalɩŋ a jomba hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa.

english_verse: Do this for seven days, and the altar will become so holy that anyone who touches it will become holy. Daily Sacrifices (Leviticus
translation_verse: Kɛŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ a pɩɩsɛ koru-la disiniŋ ta a joŋo hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Koru-la jaŋ zɔŋ mɩ sɩaa lɛ. Dɩ kʋŋkala nɛ digi koru-la, ʋ ma jaŋ ŋaa kʋzɔŋ mɩ sɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: Each day you must sacrifice two lambs a year old,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ pie-biisiŋ balɩa sɩ yi jɩna a kaa kʋ kpʋ pɩmɛ koru-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: one in the morning and one in the evening.
translation_verse: Kpʋ dɔŋɔ chʋchʋɔŋ aŋ kpʋ dɔŋɔ ma wɩɩ-mul-jʋʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: With each lamb offer one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of pure olive oil, and also pour out a liter of wine as an offering. The smell of this sacrifice on the fires of the altar will be pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Pie-bii-lɩa-la ma ŋ sɩ jaŋ kpʋ wɩɩ-mul-jʋʋlʋŋ ŋ jaŋ magɩsɛ munuŋ, nʋʋŋ arɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa ŋ sɩ magɩsa chʋchʋɔŋ pie-bii-la lɛ a nyɩgɛ. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Because of who I am, the tent will become sacred, and Aaron and his sons will become worthy to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ wasɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ arɩ koru-la aŋ wasɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ a lɩɩsɛba dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa.

english_verse: I will live among you as your God,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ a ŋaa ba Wɩa.

english_verse: and you will know that I am the Lord your God, the one who rescued you from Egypt, so that I could live among you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa ba TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ kɛmba kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ba TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Mix four liters of olive oil with the following costly spices: six kilograms of myrrh, three kilograms of cinnamon, three kilograms of cane, and six kilograms of cassia. Measure these according to the official standards. Then use this sacred mixture
translation_verse: Joŋ kɩaa deemba guoli dɔŋɔ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ dɩ ʋ sʋɔra sɩŋ. Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ nʋʋŋ ŋaanɩŋ ŋaa. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋ-zɔŋ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: the altar for sacrifices, and the large bowl with its stand.
translation_verse: arɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koruŋ arɩ ʋ nyuŋ kpɩɛraa kala, a pɛ taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la arɩ kʋ-la nyuŋ ʋ sɩ chɩna.

english_verse: Build an altar of acacia wood where you can burn incense.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ sɔjaamɩŋ daaŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ dɩ ba nyɩnyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ taara tɔ ʋ nyuŋ arɩ ʋ sɛsɩŋ kala arɩ nyilli-la, aŋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ-la mɛ giriŋ golli koru-la kala.

english_verse: Then below the edging on opposite sides attach two gold rings through which you can put the poles for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Libi sɛlɩmɛ nenii-pɩraa banɛsɛ hɛ giri-la bʋbʋɔŋ dɩ sɛmɛ na-kala kɛŋ balɩa, dɩ ba nɛ chagɛ daaterigeba-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa jujoŋ koru-la a kɩɩ.

english_verse: These poles are also to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ sɔjaamɩŋ daaŋ a ŋaa daaterigeba-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa jujoŋ koru-la a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taara tɔ ba kala.

english_verse: Put the altar in front of the inside curtain of the sacred tent. The chest with the place of mercy is kept behind that curtain, and I will talk with you there.
translation_verse: Joŋ koru-la bil Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tʋɔŋ, patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ kɛŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔmʋŋ arɩ lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ kaa kpaa, joŋo bil ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ nɛ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la arɩ ʋ nii-tɔlɔ hɛ, nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ kʋ chemiŋ.

english_verse: Burn only the proper incense on the altar and never use it for grain sacrifices or animal sacrifices or drink offerings.
translation_verse: Pɔ dɩ ŋ sɩ́ kʋsʋɔrʋ wogo nyɩgɛ koru-la nyuŋ, a sɩ́ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa koo mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa ma nyɩgʋ koru-la nyuŋ. Pɔ ŋ sɩ́ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa bɩsa wurisi koru-la.

english_verse: Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing on its four corners the blood of an animal sacrificed for sin, and this practice must always be followed. The altar is sacred because it is dedicated to me. The Money for the Sacred Tent
translation_verse: Jɩna na-kala tʋɔŋ Arɔŋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna chalɩŋ nɛ a taa koruŋ nyilliŋ a pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta a pɩ ʋ doho nɩaa kala sɩ jaŋ to harɩŋ kɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa koru-la ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋŋ sɩ chaasa bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ.” Moribie-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ tiŋ a laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: Find out how many grown men there are in Israel and require each of them to pay me to keep him safe from danger while you are counting them.
translation_verse: “Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ dɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ʋ maga dɩ ŋ leŋ dɩ ba kʋŋkala kɛŋ kʋŋ nɛ kaa kʋ time pɩ La TƖƖNA a laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ dɩɩsʋ, dɩ wʋbɔŋ kala sɩ́ kʋ jʋʋba, bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ dɩɩsɛba.

english_verse: , whether rich or poor, must pay me the same amount of money, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ jaŋ sʋsɔŋ ba nɩsaa arɩ ba naasɩŋ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: This money is to be used for the upkeep of the sacred tent, and because of it, I will never forget my people. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
translation_verse: Laa moribie-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kaa kɔ dɩ ba time laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ a kaa wʋwasɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa vɛnɛ ŋaa pɩpɩmɛ.” Taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ sʋsɔŋ ba tɩtɩa

english_verse: If you ever make any of it to use as perfume, you will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ chɛbɛ ŋaa tʋlaalɩɩ deeŋ doho a pɩ ʋ tɩtɩa, ʋ maga dɩ ma lɩɩsʋ ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: Make a large bronze bowl and a bronze stand for it. Then put them between the altar for sacrifice and the sacred tent, so the priests can wash their hands and feet before entering the tent or offering a sacrifice on the altar. Each priest in every generation must wash himself in this way, or else he will die right there. The Oil for Dedication and Ordination (Exodus
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ba sɔŋ ba nɩsaa arɩ ba naasɩŋ nɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ba sɩ́ sʋʋ, wɩɩŋ deeŋ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ nɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa sɩ jaŋ vɛnɛ ŋɩŋaa a kaa mʋ wuu.” Wɩa nʋʋ tɩsɩŋ

english_verse: By dedicating them in this way, you will make them so holy that anyone who even touches them will become holy.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ chaasa ŋaa kɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ. Dɩ kʋŋkala nɛ digi kɩaa deemba, ʋ ma jaŋ ŋaa kʋŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: the table with its equipment, the lampstand with its equipment, the incense altar with all its utensils,
translation_verse: a pɛ teebʋl-la arɩ ʋ nyuŋ kpɩɛraa lɛ, a pɛ kʋ-la nyuŋ ba sɩ joŋ chaanaa dɩdaŋ arɩ ʋ nyuŋ kpɩɛraa arɩ koru-la lɛ ba sɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a pɩpɩmɛ,

english_verse: When you ordain Aaron and his sons as my priests, sprinkle them with some of this oil,
translation_verse: Kɛŋ nʋʋ-la tɩsɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ a wasɛba dɩ ba ŋaa mɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa.

english_verse: and say to the people of Israel: “This oil must always be used in the ordination service of a priest. It is holy because it is dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ‘Nʋʋŋ deeŋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ, ma doho kala lɛ.

english_verse: Mix equal amounts of the costly spices stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense, then add salt to make the mixture pure and holy.
translation_verse: Joŋ kɩaa deemba kala guoli dɔŋɔ lɛ a ŋaa tɩɩkel sʋɔrɩ-sɩŋŋaa. Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ tʋlaalɩɩ ŋaanɩŋ ŋaa. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ, hɛ yɩsɩŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋzɔŋ mɩ sɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: Pound some of it into powder and sprinkle it in front of the sacred chest, where I meet with you. Be sure to treat this incense as something very holy.
translation_verse: Nɔŋ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ, dɩ ŋ joŋo bil mɩ niiriŋ daga-la sɩ hɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ sɩpaaŋ. Nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ kʋ chemiŋ. Ʋ maga dɩ kɩalɩŋ chaasa ŋaa kɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: I have chosen Bezalel from the Judah tribe to make the sacred tent and its furnishings.
translation_verse: “Bee na, mɩ lɩɩsɛ Uri nanʋala Bɛzalɛl nɛ, Huu sɩ ŋaa Juda doho nʋʋ nihiŋ.

english_verse: Not only have I filled him with my Spirit, but I have given him wisdom and made him a skilled craftsman who can create objects of art with gold, silver, bronze, precious stones, and wood.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ jɩŋ tabɩaa yɛrɩŋ arɩ ba kaa tɩmɩŋ, a jɩŋ daasɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a wuo tɩŋ gɔgɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala.

english_verse: I have appointed Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to work with him, and I have also given skills to those who will help them make everything exactly as I have commanded you:
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra lɩɩsɛ Ahɩsama nanʋala Oholiab sɩ lɩɩ Daŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ ma nɛ, dɩ ʋ pɛ Bɛzalɛl lɛ. Mɩ joŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a pɩ gɔgɩa-la nɛ, dɩ ba wuo ŋaa kɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɩŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Moses told the Israelites that the Lord had said: The Sabbath belongs to me. Now I command you and your descendants to always obey the laws of the Sabbath. By doing this, you will know that I have chosen you as my own.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba to chɛ-wiesii-la woruŋ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ sɩ chɩŋ mɩ dɩ ma arɩ ma doho nɩaa kala pɛgɛ, dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA, Nɩɩ-la sɩ leŋe ma ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma.

english_verse: Keep the Sabbath holy. You have six days to do your work, but the Sabbath is mine, and it must remain a day of rest. If you work on the Sabbath, you will no longer be part of my people, and you will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma joŋ tapʋlaa balɩdʋ a tɩŋ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa, ama tapʋl-pɛɩ nɛ ŋaa chɛ-wiesii-la. Ʋ ŋaa chɛ-zɔŋ nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa chɛɛ-la, ʋ maga dɩ má kpʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: This day will always serve as a reminder, both to me and to the Israelites, that I made the heavens and the earth in six days, then on the seventh day I rested and relaxed.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ a pɩŋ mɩ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, bɛɛ wɩaa tapʋlaa balɩdʋ nɛ mɩ-na Wɩa joŋo ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ. Tapʋl-pɛɩ mɩ bɩ tɩma, mɩ wiese nɛ.”

english_verse: When God had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two flat stones on which he had written all his laws with his own hand.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩ Mosis Sɩnaɩ peel-la nyuŋ a dɛrɛ, ʋ joŋ tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la balɩa lɛ ʋ sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa hɛ a pɩ Mosis.

english_verse: Moses, I have seen how stubborn these people are,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Mɩ jɩŋ nɩaa deemba nɛ, ba ŋaa nyu-duo tɩmma nɛ.

english_verse: The people got up early the next morning and killed some animals to be used for sacrifices and others to be eaten. Then everyone ate and drank so much that they began to carry on like wild people.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, ba sii chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ aŋ joŋ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma ŋaa nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɔnɔ dii kɩaa aŋ nyʋa aŋ sii gbigbieli aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ.

english_verse: Moses said to them, “You obeyed the Lord and did what was right, and so you will serve as his priests for the people of Israel. It was hard for you to kill your own sons and brothers, but the Lord has blessed you and made you his priests today.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋl, “Jɩnɩŋ ma joŋ ma tɩtɩa pɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ, ʋ pɛ ma lɛ nɛ a tɩŋ ma sɩ na baanɩŋ ma biiriŋ arɩ ma naambiiriŋ nyuŋ ba sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA, ma kpʋba.”

english_verse: After the people saw that Moses had been on the mountain for a long time, they went to Aaron and said, “Make us an image of a god who will lead and protect us. Moses brought us out of Egypt, but nobody knows what has happened to him.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ na dɩ Mosis ka dienu peel-la nyuŋ ʋ bɩ kʋʋ tuu, ba sii mʋ golli Arɔŋ chu a bʋla pʋ, “Mɛ vesiŋ pɩla dɩ ba laa la sɩpaaŋ a kɛnla vɩvɛŋ. Mosis, nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛnla kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, la bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa ʋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Aaron told them, “Bring me the gold earrings that your wives and sons and daughters are wearing.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Arɔŋ bʋla pɩba, “Má chaarɛ ma haalaa, ma hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ma toloo sɛlɩmɛ dɩgɩlɩŋ-kpɛnsɩŋ kaa kʋ pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: then he melted them and made an idol in the shape of a young bull. All the people said to one another, “This is the god who brought us out of Egypt!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ laa kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa kɔ, a kaa libi vene ʋ nagɛ nɛ-bie. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ bʋl, “Iziral tɩmma, vene-la sɩ kɛnla lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kɔ nɛ ŋ-la.”

english_verse: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the idol and said, “Tomorrow we will celebrate in honor of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Arɔŋ sɩ na ŋɩɩ, ʋ saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ vene-la sɩpaaŋ aŋ heele bʋl, “Chie la jaŋ gbieli a zil La TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: Hurry back down! Those people you led out of Egypt are acting like fools.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Tuu lɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ba chei ba tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: They have already stopped obeying me and have made themselves an idol in the shape of a young bull. They have bowed down to it, offered sacrifices, and said that it is the god who brought them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ba daŋa vɩa wombii-la mɩ sɩ dagɛba nɛ, aŋ libi vene ʋ nagɛ nɛ-bie, ba kpʋ kɩaa pʋ aŋ zilu a bʋl, ‘Iziral tɩmma, vene-la sɩ kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la.’ ”

english_verse: and I'm angry enough to destroy them, so don't try to stop me. But I will make your descendants into a great nation.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mʋ aŋ lemmi, mɩ baanɩŋ sie nɛ woruŋ ba nyuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ cheiba, aŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ doho nɩaa pʋŋ a ŋaa tinteeŋ sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ.”

english_verse: Moses tried to get the Lord God to change his mind: Our Lord, you used your mighty power to bring these people out of Egypt. Now don't become angry and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis sʋl ʋ Tɩɩna Wɩa a bʋl, “Ou, mɩ Tɩɩna, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ na baanɩŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ chei nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ arɩ ŋ doluŋ?

english_verse: If you do, the Egyptians will say that you brought your people out here into the mountains just to get rid of them. Please don't be angry with your people. Don't destroy them!
translation_verse: Ŋŋ chɛ dɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa bʋl arɩ tʋɔbɔmʋŋ nɛ ŋ kaa kɛŋ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɩɩ dɩ ŋ kpʋba peelee tʋɔŋ, aŋ cheiba ta tinteeŋ kala lɛɛ? Leŋ dɩ ŋ baanɩŋ tuu tinteeŋ dɩ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ nɩaa chei ta.

english_verse: Remember the solemn promise you made to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You promised that someday they would have as many descendants as there are stars in the sky and that you would give them land.
translation_verse: Liisi ŋ tɩntɩnnaa Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb wɩaa. Ba nɛ ŋ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa yɩrɩŋ kaa ŋmɩɛsa pa arɩ ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba doho nɩaa pʋŋ a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, aŋ joŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ ma kala a pɩba dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba dɩ ba doho nɩaa kʋŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: So even though the Lord had threatened to destroy the people, he changed his mind and let them live.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ wʋbɔŋ-la ʋ fa sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ joŋo ŋaa ʋ nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: When Joshua heard the noisy shouts of the people, he said to Moses, “A battle must be going on down in the camp.”
translation_verse: Josua sɩ nɩa dɩ nɩalɩŋ ka ŋaa goŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Ʋ naga laalɩŋ nɛ sie la dɩhɔnʋŋ.”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “It doesn't sound like they are shouting because they have won or lost a battle. It sounds more like a wild party!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋl, “Goŋ-la bɩ laalɩyuori-diiri goŋ naga, ʋ bɩ yele ma ŋaa, ama ʋ nagɛ yɩɩlaa nɛ baa yɩɩ.”

english_verse: As Moses got closer to the camp, he saw the idol, and he also saw the people dancing around. This made him so angry that he threw down the stones and broke them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ kʋ kpagɛ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ, a na vene-la ba sɩ libe ʋ nagɛ nɛ-bie arɩ gʋala, ʋ baanɩŋ faasa sii. Ʋ joŋ tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la ʋ sɩ koro lo peel-la bʋbʋɔŋ ba kala yɛrɛ.

english_verse: He melted the idol the people had made, and he ground it into powder. He scattered it in their water and made them drink it.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis mʋ joŋ vene-la ba sɩ libe ʋ nagɛ nɛ-bie a hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ ʋ dii, ʋ lɩɩsɛ a nɔŋ ʋ bii a nagɛ munuŋ. Ʋ paa a hɛ lɩɩŋ lɛ a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nyʋa.

english_verse: Moses asked Aaron, “What did these people do to harm you? Why did you make them sin in this terrible way?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis pɩɛsɛ Arɔŋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ nɩaa deemba ŋaa ŋ lɛ, ŋ lɛrɛ wʋbɔŋ-balɩŋ deeŋ kʋ hɛ ba lɛ?”

english_verse: Aaron answered: Don't be angry with me. You know as well as I do that they are determined to do evil.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ sɩ, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, sɩ́ baanɩŋ na, ŋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ nɩaa deemba sɩ cho wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They even told me, “That man Moses led us out of Egypt, but now we don't know what has happened to him. Make us a god to lead us.”
translation_verse: Ba bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Mɛ vesiŋ pɩla dɩ ba laa la sɩpaaŋ a kɛnla vɩvɛŋ, Mosis-la sɩ kɛnla lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, la bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa ʋ lɛ.’

english_verse: Then I asked them to bring me their gold earrings. They took them off and gave them to me. I threw the gold into a fire, and out came this bull.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩba, ‘Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ kʋŋ, ʋ lɩɩsa kaa kʋ pɩmɛ.’ Ba kaa kɔ mɩ joŋo hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ a libi vene deeŋ sɩ nagɛ nɛ-bie.”

english_verse: Moses knew that the people were out of control and that it was Aaron's fault. And now they had made fools of themselves in front of their enemies.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis na arɩ nɩalɩŋ hoso, Arɔŋ ma leŋ ba yeŋŋi a ŋaa mɔmɩa ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ teeŋ.

english_verse: So Moses stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, “Everyone who is on the Lord's side come over here!” Then the men of the Levi tribe gathered around Moses,
translation_verse: Mosis chɩŋ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ boiŋ niiŋ aŋ bʋl, “Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ to La TƖƖNA harɩŋ, ʋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Levi doho nɩaa kala mʋ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: and he said to them, “The Lord God of Israel commands you to strap on your swords and go through the camp, killing your relatives, your friends, and your neighbors.”
translation_verse: Mosis bʋla pɩba, “Ŋ-la nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa bʋl, ‘Má paa ma tokobiee a chɩŋ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ boiŋ deeŋ lɛ a kpʋ ma naambiiriŋ, ma nandɔsʋŋ arɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa a mʋ yi boiŋ nii-la dɔŋɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The men of the Levi tribe followed his orders, and that day they killed about
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Mosis sɩ bʋla, a kpʋ nɩaa bʋɩ batori tapʋlɩɩ-la.

english_verse: The next day Moses told the people, “This is a terrible thing you have done. But I will go back to the Lord to see if I can do something to keep this sin from being held against you.”
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, Mosis bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka, “Ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋ bal nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ mʋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ a sʋlʋ, kapo, ʋ jaŋ joŋ ma wʋbɔŋ-la chɛma.”

english_verse: Moses returned to the Lord and said, “The people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a gold idol to be their god.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis mɩɩra mʋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ a bʋl, “Ou, nɩaa deemba ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-bal nɛ, ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ libi vene pɩ ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: But I beg you to forgive them. If you don't, please wipe my name out of your book.”
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, joŋ ba wʋbɔŋ-la chɛba, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, lɩɩsɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ ta ŋ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ ŋ sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ŋ nɩaa yɩraa hɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “I will wipe out of my book the name of everyone who has sinned against me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ mɩ teeŋ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsa ta mɩ teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Now take my people to the place I told you about, and my angel will lead you. But when the time comes, I will punish them for this sin.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mʋ a kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ mʋ lee-la wɩaa mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ, mɩ tɩndaara jaŋ laa ma sɩpaaŋ. Ama dɩ bʋa-la nɛ kʋ yi a magɛ dɩ mɩ dɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋ-la wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba.”

english_verse: So the Lord punished the people of Israel with a terrible disease for talking Aaron into making the gold idol.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA joŋ nyanyal-bɔŋ a hɛ nɩalɩŋ lɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩ leŋe Arɔŋ mɛ vene-la sɩ nagɛ nɛ-bie pɩba arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ zil vene-la.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: You led the people of Israel out of Egypt. Now get ready to lead them to the land I promised their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Sii daha, ŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, a mʋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ chaasa hɛ niiŋ pɩ Abɩraham arɩ Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb arɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩ ba doho nɩaa.

english_verse: It is a land rich with milk and honey, and I will send an angel to force out those people who live there—the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. But I will not go with my people. They are so rebellious that I would destroy them before they get there.
translation_verse: Má mʋ tintee-la sɩ sɩma a kɛŋ kɩaa, ama mɩ dɩ ma bɩ jaŋ to dɔŋɔ mʋ nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ dagɩŋ ka nɩɩ nɛ. Ma jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩ cheimi wombiiŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ kpʋma.”

english_verse: Even before the Lord said these harsh things, he had told Moses, “These people really are rebellious, and I would kill them at once, if I went with them. But tell them to take off their fancy jewelry, then I'll decide what to do with them.” So the people started mourning,
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ ba ŋaa nɩaa sɩ bɩ dagɩŋ ka nɩɩ nɛ, dɩ mɩ dɩ ba nɛ fa to dɔŋɔ mʋ, magɛ ŋ-la mɩ fa kpʋba. Lɛɛlɛ leŋ ba wuri kpɩɛra-la kala sɩ hɛ ba yaraa lɛ, ka dɩ mɩ na wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ba lɛ.”

english_verse: and after leaving Mount Sinai, they stopped wearing fancy jewelry. The Lord Is with His People
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wuri ba kpɩɛraa kala ta peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ bʋbʋɔŋ. Lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ

english_verse: Moses used to set up a tent far from camp. He called it the “meeting tent,” and whoever needed some message from the Lord would go there.
translation_verse: Mosis fa yie mʋ hɛ lɛbɩŋ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ harɩŋ dɩ-bolii a hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ, “Lɛbɩ-la lɛ La Tɩɩna sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ.” Dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ chɛ na wɩɩ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, ʋ yie mʋ nɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Each time Moses went out to this tent, everyone would stand at the entrance to their own tents and watch him enter.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala dɩ Mosis nɩɩ jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La Tɩɩna sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, nʋʋkala yie sii chɩŋ ʋ lɛbɩŋ boiŋ niiŋ nɛ a bibeŋ Mosis ŋɩɩ ʋ mʋ jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la.

english_verse: Then they would bow down because a thick cloud would come down in front of the tent, and the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, just like a friend. Afterwards, Moses would return to camp, but his young assistant Joshua would stay at the tent. The Lord Promises To Be with His People
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA arɩ Mosis yie chaasɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ aŋ bʋbʋl wɩaa a nagɛ nʋʋ arɩ ʋ nandɔŋɔ sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ba nɛ dɛrɛ, Mosis yie mɩɩra mʋ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ nɛ, ka Nuŋ nanʋala Josua-na yie ka lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ. Josua fa ŋaa bapʋɔsɩ-bie nɛ a pɛ Mosis lɛ ba tɩtɩŋ. Mosis arɩ La TƖƖNA tʋla

english_verse: Moses said to the Lord, “I know that you have told me to lead these people to the land you promised them. But you have not said who will go along to help me. You have said that you are my friend and that you are pleased with me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩ La TƖƖNA, “Ŋ bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ mɩ laa nɩaa deemba sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba mʋ tintee-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ ŋ joŋo pɩba, ama ŋ bɩ leŋe mɩ jɩŋ mɩ dɩ nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ tɩŋ, aŋ bʋl ŋ jɩŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ, dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ.

english_verse: If this is true, let me know what your plans are, then I can obey and continue to please you. And don't forget that you have chosen this nation to be your own.”
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ, dagɛmɛ ŋ wombie-la dɩ mɩ wuo jɩmba, dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ wasa tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ. Jɩŋ arɩ nɩaa deemba ŋaa ŋ nɩaa nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “I will go with you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Mɩ jaŋ hɛ ŋ teeŋ lee na-kala ŋ sɩɩ mʋ, a leŋ dɩ ŋ na wiese.”

english_verse: Then Moses replied, “If you aren't going with us, please don't make us leave this place.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋl, “Dɩ mɩ dɩŋ nɛ bɩ jaŋ to dɔŋɔ mʋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la sii daha.

english_verse: But if you do go with us, everyone will know that you are pleased with your people and with me. That way, we will be different from the rest of the people on earth.”
translation_verse: Wʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ ŋ cho mɩ dɩ ŋ nɩaa nɛ dɩ la dɩŋ nɛ bɩ dɔŋɔ to mʋ? Wʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ mɩ dɩ ŋ nɩaa ŋaa dabaŋ nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala tʋɔŋ?”

english_verse: So the Lord told him, “I will do what you have asked, because I am your friend and I am pleased with you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋ sɩ pɩɛsaa chɛ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaaʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jɩmɩŋ nɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ nyuŋ.”

english_verse: Then Moses said, “I pray that you will let me see you in all of your glory.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋl, “Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, leŋ dɩ mɩ na ŋ tʋla.”

english_verse: The Lord answered: All right. I am the Lord, and I show mercy and kindness to anyone I choose. I will let you see my glory and hear my holy name,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ tʋla laa ŋ sɩpaaŋ a heele yɩrɛ mɩ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ ‘La TƖƖNA’ ŋ sɩpaaŋ. Nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ mɩ fá ba nenige, mɩ jaŋ fá ba nenige, nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ mɩ fá ba nisusuŋ, mɩ jaŋ fá ba nisusuŋ.”

english_verse: but I won't let you see my face, because anyone who sees my face will die.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl, “Ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo na mɩ sɩaa, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ na mɩ sɩaa, ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ.”

english_verse: There is a rock not far from me. Stand beside it,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl, “Na bʋŋ nɛ kpagɛmɛ ŋ-la, jɩla chɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: and before I pass by in all of my shining glory, I will put you in a large crack in the rock. I will cover your eyes with my hand until I have passed by.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ to lee-la bɩbal arɩ mɩ tʋla, mɩ jaŋ joŋuŋ hɛ bʋŋ-la bʋa lɛ a kɛŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ tɔŋ aŋ-na bal.

english_verse: Then I will take my hand away, and you will see my back. You will not see my face.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ bala dɛrɛ, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ dʋɔrɛ ŋ lɛ, ka dɩ ŋ na mɩ harɩŋ, ama ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo na mɩ sɩaa-na.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I promise to perform miracles for you that have never been seen anywhere on earth. Neighboring nations will stand in fear and know that I was the one who did these marvelous things.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Mɩɩ bil niiŋ nɛ mɩ dɩŋ pɛgɛ. Ŋ nɩaa kala sɩpaaŋ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa ha sɩ bɩ ŋaa aŋ ka tintee kala lɛ koo dʋnɩa kala lɛ. Ma dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ jʋʋ jaŋ na ŋɩɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ to ŋ lɛ a tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ.

english_verse: Be ready tomorrow morning to come up Mount Sinai and meet me at the top.
translation_verse: Ŋaa siri chʋchʋɔŋ a kʋ jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ nyuŋ, a kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa kɔ mɩ teeŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: No one is to come with you or to be on the mountain at all. Don't even let the sheep and cattle graze at the foot of the mountain.”
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ to ŋ harɩŋ kɔ koo nʋʋkala paala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kʋ jɩl peel-la nyuŋ. Pʋsʋŋ ma paala bɩ maga dɩ ba kɔ peel-la bʋbʋɔŋ a dii yaŋ.”

english_verse: So Moses cut two flat stones like the first ones, and early the next morning he carried them to the top of Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis yɛrɛ lɩɩsɛ tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la balɩa ba nagɛ bumbuŋ kɩalɩŋ. Ʋ koriba a kaa jɩl peel-la nyuŋ chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Then he passed in front of Moses and called out, “I am the Lord God. I am merciful and very patient with my people. I show great love, and I can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ to Mosis sɩpaaŋ bal aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, mɩ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa-la sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa-la nɩaa sɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ mɩ lahɔrɩmɔ, mɩ baanɩŋ bɩ lɩma lɩma ka sii, a cho nɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ,

english_verse: Moses quickly bowed down to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis guu tuu kpirimi aŋ chʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: He prayed, “Lord, if you really are pleased with me, I pray that you will go with us. It is true that these people are sinful and rebellious, but forgive our sin and let us be your people.” A Promise and Its Demands (Exodus
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Ou mɩ Tɩɩna, dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ laa la sɩpaaŋ a kɛnla mʋ. Nɩalɩŋ ŋaa tʋɔ-dol tɩmma nɛ. Ama joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ la wʋcheelee chɛla, aŋ jonla dɩ la ŋaa ŋ nɩaa.”

english_verse: Your men must come to worship me three times a year, because I am the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Jɩna tʋɔŋ ʋ maga dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa baalaa kala kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩpaaŋ naansɩɩŋ butori, mɩ nɛ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa.

english_verse: I demand your complete loyalty—you must not worship any other god!
translation_verse: Má pʋpɔ dɩ ma sɩ́ vene kala zil. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ nɛ yarɩ-bieri Tɩɩna, mɩ bɩ hadɔrʋŋ ka chɛ.

english_verse: The first-born males of your families and of your flocks and herds belong to me.
translation_verse: Ma hambolibii bumbumba kala jaŋ ŋaa mɩ kɩaa, a pɛ ma pʋŋ doho na-kala bii-bumbuŋ sɩ ŋaa bele lɛ.

english_verse: Don't make metal images of gods.
translation_verse: Má pʋpɔ ma sɩ́ hɔɔŋ kaa libi tɔŋ-kala a pɩ ma tɩtɩa.

english_verse: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.
translation_verse: Ma to wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɩŋ jɩnɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ kiri Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa, Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa, Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa, Hivi tɩŋŋaa arɩ Jebus tɩŋŋaa ta ma teeŋ.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.
translation_verse: Má pʋpɔ ma dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ ma sɩɩ mʋ sɩ́ nii pɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ to ŋɩɩ lɛ a bɛrɛ kɛmma.

english_verse: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Ama má giri ba vʋɩyaa korunuŋ a yɛrɛ ba tɔŋŋɔɔ tabɩa-la aŋ pɛ keri ba vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩ-la lo.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with the people there, or you will soon find yourselves worshiping their gods and taking part in their sacrificial meals.
translation_verse: Má pʋpɔ ma dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ sɩ́ nii kala pɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa ba wʋchɔrʋmɔɔ a kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ ba tɔŋŋɔɔ a dɩdɛnnɛba, ba jaŋ yɩrɛma dɩ ma kʋ pɛ dii ba kʋdiile-la.

english_verse: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.
translation_verse: Má gbigbieli gbiele-la ma sɩ yie dii boroboro sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ. Tapʋlaa balɩpɛ ma jaŋ dii boroboro sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ arɩ mɩ sɩ dagɩŋ ŋɩɩ. Ma ŋɩŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ chɛnɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Abib tʋɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ ma lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You can save the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must save every first-born son. Bring an offering every time you come to worship.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ pie-bie a time laa ma kakumo kala bii-bumbumba. Ama dɩ ma nɛ bɩ time laa, ŋɩɩ-na see ma kɛŋ ʋ baŋŋaa mɩlɩma bori. Má time laa ma hambolibii bumbumba kala. Nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ arɩ na-hɩllɩŋ.

english_verse: Work for six days and rest on the seventh day, even during the seasons for plowing and harvesting.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ tɩŋ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa tapʋlaa balɩdʋ, ama tapʋl-pɛɛmɩŋ chɛɛŋ ʋ maga dɩ ma wiesi, dɩ ʋ nɛ paala ŋaa pɛrɩŋ bʋa lɛ koo kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ bʋa lɛ ma.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: Má gbigbieli gbiele-la ma sɩ yie kʋŋ ma baga mɛmpɛ-falaa aa gbieli, arɩ gbiele-la ma sɩ yie gbieli jɩna dɩdɛrɩŋ dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa dɛrɛ.

english_verse: As you advance, I will force the nations out of your land and enlarge your borders. Then no one will try to take your property when you come to worship me these three times each year.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kiri tinteyee ta ma sɩpaaŋ aŋ kɛŋ ma tinteeŋ jallɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo gɩrɩma laaʋ, dɩ ma nɩɩ kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ jɩna na-kala naansɩɩŋ butori.

english_verse: When you sacrifice an animal on the altar, don't offer bread made with yeast. And don't save any part of the Passover meal for the next day.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kpʋ pʋna-kala a chɩchɛ dɩ ma joŋ chalɩŋ pɩmɛ, má pɔ dɩ ma sɩ́ kʋdiil na-kala sɩ kɛŋ sɩbʋrʋŋ pɛ kaa kɔ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele kʋdiilee chɩna chʋa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must bring the first part of your harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma baga kʋfalaa sɩ zɔmɔ woruŋ a kaa kʋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. Ma pɔ má sɩ́ bʋʋ-bie koo pie-bie chɔ ʋ naaŋ yɩlɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to put these laws in writing, as part of his agreement with Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba bil, bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɛ mɩ kaa bil niiŋ mɩ dɩŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ.”

english_verse: Moses came down from Mount Sinai, carrying the Ten Commandments. His face was shining brightly because the Lord had been speaking to him. But Moses did not know at first that his face was shining.
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ lɩɩ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ nyuŋ kʋ tuu a kori tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la balɩa, ʋ fa bɩ jɩŋ dɩ ʋ sɩaa ka tʋl nɛ a tɩŋ ʋ dɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: When Aaron and the others looked at Moses, they saw this, and they were afraid to go near him.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩ na Mosis sɩaa ka tʋl ŋɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba, ba bɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpagʋ.

english_verse: Moses called out for Aaron and the leaders to come to him, and he spoke with them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis yɩrɛba, Arɔŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩpaalaaraa mɩɩra kɔ Mosis teeŋ, ʋ bʋl wɩaa pɩba.

english_verse: Then the rest of the people of Israel gathered around Moses, and he gave them the laws that the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kɔ ʋ teeŋ ʋ dagɛba niiri-la kala La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pʋ Sɩnaɩ peel-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: The face of Moses kept shining, and after he had spoken with the people, he covered his face with a veil.
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ pɩba dɛrɛ, ʋ joŋ nyu-bɛlɛ a tɔ ʋ sɩaa.

english_verse: Moses would always remove the veil when he went into the sacred tent to speak with the Lord. And when he came out, he would tell the people everything the Lord had told him to say.
translation_verse: Ama bʋa na-kala dɩ ʋ nɩɩ mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ dɩ ba bʋl wɩaa, ʋ yie kɛŋ nyu-bɛlɛ-la suri nɛ, see dɩ ʋ bɩra kʋ lɩɩ. Ʋ sɩ yie kʋ lɩɩ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pʋ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa,

english_verse: They could see that his face was still shining. So after he had spoken with them, he would put the veil back on and leave it on until the next time he went to speak with the Lord.
translation_verse: ba yie na arɩ ʋ sɩaa ka tʋl. Mosis yie bɩra joŋ nyu-bɛlɛ-la a tɔ ʋ sɩaa, see dɩ ʋʋ chɛ ʋ mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ ʋ kaa suri.

english_verse: You have six days in which to do your work. But the seventh day must be dedicated to me, your Lord, as a day of rest. Whoever works on the Sabbath will be put to death.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa balɩdʋ nɛ ma jaŋ tɩtɩŋ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ama chɛ-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ ŋaa tapʋl-zɔŋ nɛ a pɩma, a ŋaa chɛ-wiesii a pɩ La TƖƖNA ma. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa chɛɛ-la, ʋ maga dɩ ma kpʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't even build a cooking fire at home on the Sabbath. Offerings for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ma pɔ má sɩ́ nyiniŋ hɛ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ kala chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ.” Kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la

english_verse: The women who were good at weaving cloth brought the blue, purple, and red wool and the fine linen they had made.
translation_verse: Haala-la ma kala sɩ jɩŋ gɛrɩ-ŋmɛnɩŋ koo gɛnnɩŋ yuonuŋ ma kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine koo ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ koo ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ koo gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ kaa kʋ pɩ La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: onyx stones or other gems for the sacred vest and breastpiece.
translation_verse: tabɩɩ-tʋlaa ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ɔnɩs arɩ tabɩɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋo hɛ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la arɩ bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: And he has given them all kinds of artistic skills, including the ability to design and embroider with blue, purple, and red wool and to weave fine linen.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ pɩba nɛ ba jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala, a jɩŋ ŋmɛŋ-mʋɔlaa, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-fɩɛsɩŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ-fʋfʋlaa yuonuŋ wɩɩkala, dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa gɔgɔ wɩɩkala nɩhɩasɩŋ.

english_verse: If you have any skills, you should use them to help make what I have commanded:
translation_verse: Jɩma tɩŋŋaa kala sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ maga dɩ ba kɔ a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ daga:

english_verse: and the finely woven priestly clothes for Aaron and his sons. Gifts for the Lord
translation_verse: gɛnnɩ-la ba sɩ laala tɩtɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa, kɩalɩŋ Arɔŋ sɩ jaŋ laalɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara arɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ sɩ jaŋ laalɛ a tɩtɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tɩntɩŋŋaa.”

english_verse: Moses told the people of Israel that the Lord had said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala, “Wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA dagɛ, ʋ sɩ:

english_verse: I will welcome an offering from anyone who wants to give something. You may bring gold, silver, or bronze;
translation_verse: Ma dʋa tʋɔŋ, má lɩɩsɛ dɔnsʋŋ a kaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho dɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la, ʋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, kɔlɩɩŋ,

english_verse: blue, purple, or red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ, gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ, bʋ-pʋnaa,

english_verse: tanned ram skin or fine leather; acacia wood;
translation_verse: pie-bel tenniŋ ba sɩ hɛ biriŋ ʋ fɩɛsɛ arɩ lɩɩ-nɛŋ tenniŋ arɩ sɔjaamɩŋ daaŋ,

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices for the oil of dedication and for the incense; or
translation_verse: chaanaa nʋʋŋ, arɩ tegisi-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ arɩ tegisi-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma,

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles, its place of mercy, and the curtain in front of it;
translation_verse: Wɩa niiriŋ daga arɩ daaterigeba arɩ ʋ nii-tɔlɔ, arɩ patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ kɛrʋ,

english_verse: the table with its carrying poles and all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: teebʋl-la arɩ ʋ daaterigeba arɩ ʋ nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa arɩ kʋdiile-la sɩɩ chɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ,

english_verse: the lamp with its equipment and oil;
translation_verse: chaaŋ daaŋ, arɩ ʋ nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa arɩ chaana-la arɩ ba nʋʋŋ,

english_verse: the incense altar with its carrying poles and sweet-smelling incense; the ordination oil; the curtain for the entrance to the sacred tent;
translation_verse: koru-la nyuŋ ba sɩɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ arɩ ʋ daaterigeba arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma arɩ patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ jaŋ tɔ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la boiŋ niiŋ,

english_verse: the altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koruŋ arɩ kʋ-la ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa ʋ kɛŋ bʋɔsʋŋ a nagɛ nanchɛbɩrɩ kʋa a tagɩlɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ, ʋ daaterigeba arɩ ʋ nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa, kɔlɩɩŋ taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la arɩ kʋ-la nyuŋ ʋ sɩ chɩna,

english_verse: the curtains with the posts and stands that go around the courtyard and the curtain at the entrance;
translation_verse: patɩɩsamba-la ba sɩ kaa kɛrɛ golli lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ arɩ ʋ daapɛsɩŋ arɩ ʋ hɔ-taalɩsɩŋ, a pɛ lɩga-la boiŋ niiŋ patɩɩsaŋ lɛ,

english_verse: the pegs and ropes for the tent and the courtyard;
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la daapɛ-biisiŋ, arɩ daapɛsɩ-la lɛ lɩga-la patɩɩsaŋ ŋmɛsɩŋ sɩ jaŋ vɔɔ,

english_verse: Moses finished speaking, and everyone left.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sii Mosis sɩpaaŋ a viiri.

english_verse: Men and women came willingly and gave all kinds of gold jewelry such as pins, earrings, rings, and necklaces.
translation_verse: Baalaa arɩ haala-la kala tʋɔbɩɩnaa sɩ suo kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ kpɩɛraa deemba kɔ: dɩgɩlɩŋ-kpɛnsɩŋ, banzɔlɔba, nanjɔlɔba, nenii-pɩraa arɩ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ kaa kpɩɛrɛ ba tɩtɩa. Nʋʋkala kɛŋ ʋ kɩaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Everyone brought their blue, purple, and red wool, their fine linen, and their cloth made of goat hair, as well as their ram skins dyed red and their fine leather.
