translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, koo ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ koo ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ koo gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ, koo bʋ-pʋnaa, pie-bel tenniŋ ba sɩ hɛ biriŋ ba fɩɛsɛ koo lɩɩ-nɛŋ tenniŋ kaa kɔ.

english_verse: Anyone who had silver or bronze or acacia wood brought it as a gift to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ hɔpʋla koo kɔlɩɩŋ kaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ sɔjaamɩŋ daasɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ wuo kaa tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ma kaa kɔ.

english_verse: And the women who knew how to make cloth from goat hair were glad to do so.
translation_verse: Haala-la dɔnsʋŋ ma kala tʋɔbɩɩnaa sɩ suo aŋ kɛŋ jɩma kɛŋ bʋ-pʋnaa ŋaa gɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: The leaders brought different kinds of jewels to be sewn on the special clothes and the breastpiece for the high priest.
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaara-la ma kɛŋ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ɔnɩs, arɩ tabɩɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋo hɛ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la arɩ bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩ-la lɛ kɔ.

english_verse: They also brought sweet-smelling spices to be mixed with the incense and olive oil that were for the lamps and for ordaining the priests.
translation_verse: Ba pɛ kɛŋ tegisiŋ dɔnsʋŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa nyɩgɛ chaanaa arɩ tegisiŋ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma kaa kɔ.

english_verse: Moses had told the people what the Lord wanted them to do, and many of them decided to bring their gifts. Bezalel and Oholiab (Exodus
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa baalaa arɩ haala-la kala tʋɔbɩɩnaa sɩ suo kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kʋ pɩ La TƖƖNA, dɩ Mosis laa a kaa tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ. Bɛzalɛl arɩ Oholiab

english_verse: Moses said to the people of Israel: The Lord has chosen Bezalel of the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, “Má bee na, La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ Uri nanʋala Bɛzalɛl nɛ, Huu sɩ ŋaa Juda doho nʋʋ nihiŋ.

english_verse: Not only has the Lord filled him with his Spirit, but he has given him wisdom and made him a skilled craftsman who can create objects of art with gold, silver, bronze, precious stones, and wood.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ jɩŋ tabɩaa yɛrɩŋ arɩ ba kaa tɩmɩŋ, a jɩŋ daasɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a wuo tɩŋ gɔgɔ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala.

english_verse: The Lord is urging him and Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to teach others.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA joŋ nɩaa dagɩŋ jɩma a pɩ Bɛzalɛl arɩ Oholiab nɛ. Oholiab nyɩmma nɛ Ahɩsama a ŋaa Daŋ doho nʋʋ.

english_verse: and he gave them the gifts that the people of Israel had donated for building the place of worship. In fact, so much was being given each morning,
translation_verse: Ba kɔ a laa kɩalɩŋ kala Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kaa kʋ pɩ Mosis dɩ ba kaa tɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ka ba ha kɛŋ ba tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kʋkɔ chʋchʋɔ na-kala.

english_verse: and said, “Moses, there is already more than we need for what the Lord has assigned us to do.”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Kɩalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kaa kɔ dɩ la kaa tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛla, ba yʋga kieli nɛ.”

english_verse: But there was already more than enough to do what needed to be done. The Curtains and Coverings for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa kɔ paala yʋga kɩɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la nɛ. Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la

english_verse: and they were sewn together to make two curtains with five panels each.
translation_verse: Ba yɛrɛ patɩɩsamba-la banɔŋ a mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a yɛrɛ banɔŋ ma mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: These eleven sections were joined to make two panels, one with five and the other with six sections.
translation_verse: Ba yɛrɛ patɩɩsamba-la banɔŋ mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a bɩra joŋ balɩdʋ ma a yɛrɛ mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Two other coverings were made—one with fine leather and the other with ram skins dyed red. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ pie-bel tenniŋ ba sɩ hɛ biriŋ ba fɩɛsɛ arɩ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ a ŋaa Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la nyuŋ tɔlɔ.

english_verse: Altogether, along the back wall there were eight frames with two silver stands under each of them.
translation_verse: Daa-pɛsɩ-la kala ŋaa chori nɛ, hɔpʋla ba sɩ kaa ŋaa hɔ-taalɩsɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ bʋɔsʋŋ daasɩ-la sɩ jaŋ tʋʋ ma ŋaa fii arɩ balɩdʋ, balɩa hɛ daa-kala bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Six frames were used for the back wall along the west side
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ba ŋaa daapɛsɩŋ balɩdʋ nɛ a hɛ.

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. These corner frames were joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Sɩpaaŋ gʋnaa deemba lɛ, ba ŋaa daapɛsɩ-la mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a chɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ a kaa jɩlaa yi nyuŋ a kala tʋʋ nenii-pɩrɩ-bala lɛ.

english_verse: Five crossbars were made for each of the wooden frames, with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋaa tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ daa-gɛsɩŋ, ʋ gɛsɛ daapɛsɩ-la nyuŋ a lɩɩ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a mʋ yi sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The frames and crossbars were covered with gold, and gold rings were attached to the frames to run the crossbars through. The Inside Curtain for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ taarɛ daapɛsɩ-la arɩ daa-dolo-la, aŋ libi nenii-pɩraa arɩ sɛlɩmɛ a chɛbɛ kɛŋ daa-dolo-la.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, they used a curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la boiŋ niiŋ ba kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ nɛ yɛrɛ patɩɩsaŋ a kɛrɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ gɛnnɩŋ sʋɔnʋŋ nɛ sʋa.

english_verse: They made the inside curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ nɛ a yɛrɛ patɩɩsaŋ, gɔgɔ sʋa kɩaa hɛ ba nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ.

english_verse: They also made four acacia wood posts and covered them with gold. Then gold rings were fastened to the posts, which were set on silver stands.
translation_verse: Sɔjaamɩŋ daasɩŋ nɛ ba kaa ŋaa Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la daaterigeba banɛsɛ a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taarɛ, a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa ba kʋkaachɛbɛ kɛnɛɛ, a kɛŋ hɔpʋla ŋaa hɔ-taalɩsɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ bʋɔsʋŋ daapɛsɩ-la sɩ jaŋ tʋʋ.

english_verse: They made five posts, covered them completely with gold, and set each of them on a gold-covered bronze stand. Finally, they attached hooks for the curtain.
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa daaterigeba ma banɔŋ arɩ ba kʋkaachɛbɛ kɛnɛɛ a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taarɛ daasɩ-la nyuŋ arɩ bʋbʋɔŋ, aŋ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa hɔ-taalɩsɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ bʋɔsʋŋ, dɩ daasɩ-la tʋʋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: He covered it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the top.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ a taarɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ harɩŋ kala, a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ-la mɛ giriŋ a golli Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la kala.

english_verse: He made four gold rings and attached one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Ʋ libi sɛlɩmɛ nenii-pɩraa banɛsɛ nɛ a joŋo hɛ daga-la naasɩŋ lɛ. Balɩa hɛ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, balɩa ma hɛ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Then he made two poles of acacia wood, covered them with gold,
translation_verse: Ʋ keri sɔjaamɩŋ daaterigeba nɛ a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taarɛba.

english_verse: The entire lid of the chest, which was made of pure gold, was the place of mercy.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ a ŋaa Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la nii-tɔlɔ. Ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakiel bala arɩ mʋa, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ arɩ mʋa.

english_verse: On each of the two ends of the chest he made a winged creature of hammered gold. They faced each other, and their wings covered the place of mercy. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa kɩalɩŋ ba kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ jɛrɛ a tɔ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la. Ka ba sɩaa chaasɛ dɔŋɔ a bibeŋ daga-la nii-tɔlɔ. Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la teebʋl

english_verse: He covered it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa giriŋ, ʋ jalɩŋ magɛ nachala a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ biere golli.

english_verse: He made four gold rings and attached one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ libi nenii-pɩraa banɛsɛ hɛ teebʋl-la gʋnaa banɛsɛ-la lɛ naasɩŋ leriŋ.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table were placed through these rings
translation_verse: Ba joŋ nenii-pɩra-la hɛ a kpagɛ giri-la nɛ, ba chaga kɛŋ daaterigeba-la ba sɩ kaa joŋ teebʋl-la.

english_verse: and were made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Daaterigeba-la ba sɩ kaa jujoŋ teebʋl-la ŋaa sɔjaamɩŋ daasɩŋ nɛ, ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taarɛ ba kala.

english_verse: Everything that was to be set on the table was made of pure gold—the bowls, plates, jars, and cups for wine offerings. The Lampstand (Exodus
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ libi teebʋl-la nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa: pɩrataba, hɛntɛrɛɛ, gbansɩŋ arɩ tagɩsɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ta lɩɩŋ. Chaaŋ-daaŋ

english_verse: Bezalel made a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, was made from a single piece of hammered gold,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ libi chaaŋ-daaŋ, ʋ bʋbʋɔ-chɛlɛ arɩ ʋ nyuŋ kerikee, ba libi nyʋnyʋalʋsʋŋ sɩ nagɛ tɩɩ-lugoo arɩ tɩɩfɩɩlaa sɩ pɔsɔ a hɛ kerike-la lɛ ba kala mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ a ŋaa kʋbala.

english_verse: with three branches on each of its two sides.
translation_verse: Chaaŋ-daa-la kɛŋ kerikee balɩdʋ nɛ, batori hɛ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, batori ma hɛ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: There was also a blossom where each pair of branches came out from the stem.
translation_verse: Ba libi nyʋnyʋalʋsʋ-la sɩ nagɛ fʋfʋl nɛnɛɛ sɩ pɔsɔ a hɛ chaaŋ-daa-la kerikee balɩdʋ lɛ nɛ. Kerikee balɩa na-kala pɛgɛ kʋbala hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: The lamp and its equipment, including the tongs and trays, were made of about
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba magɩsɛ sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo mara arɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ a kaa libi chaaŋ-daaŋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa kala. Kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ koruŋ

english_verse: He covered it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ a taarɛ koru-la sɛsɩŋ, ʋ nyuŋ arɩ ʋ nyilliŋ aŋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ-la tɩtɩa mɛ giriŋ golli koru-la kala.

english_verse: Then below the edging on opposite sides he attached two gold rings through which he put the poles for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Ba libi sɛlɩmɛ nenii-pɩraa balɩa a hɛ giri-la bʋbʋɔŋ, koru-la sɛsɩŋ balɩa-la kala lɛ dɩ ba chagɛ daaterigeba-la ba sɩ kaa jujoŋ koru-la kɩɩ.

english_verse: These poles were also made of acacia wood and covered with gold. The Oil for Dedication and the Incense (Exodus
translation_verse: Daaterigeba-la ŋaa sɔjaamɩŋ daasɩŋ nɛ, ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taara tɔ ba kala.

english_verse: Bezalel mixed the sacred oil for dedication and the pure spices for the sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma. Tʋlaalɩɩ ŋaara nɛ ŋaa.

english_verse: Bezalel made a large bowl and a stand out of bronze from the mirrors of the women who helped at the entrance to the sacred tent. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ beenantɩrɛba-la haala-la sɩɩ tɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ sɩ kaa kɔ nɛ, a ŋaa taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la arɩ kʋ-la nyuŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɩŋ. Lɩga-la sɩ golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la

english_verse: Then he attached a bronze ring beneath the ledge at the four corners to put the poles through.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ a libi nenii-pɩraa banɛsɛ a hɛ kʋ-la sɩ kɛŋ bʋɔsʋŋ a nagɛ nanchɛbɩrɩ kʋa gʋna-la banɛsɛ lɛ, dɩ daaterigeba-la tʋʋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: put them through the rings for carrying the altar, which was shaped like an open box. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ daaterigeba-la a tʋʋ nenii-pɩra-la banɛsɛ sɩ hɛ kʋ-la lɛ koru-la sɛsɩŋ, ba kɛŋ ba lɛ aa joŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la. Daborusuŋ nɛ ba kaa ŋaa koru-la, ʋ tʋɔŋ kɛŋ bʋa. Kɔlɩɩŋ taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la

english_verse: And it was used to make the stands for the entrance to the tent, the altar and its grating, the equipment for the altar,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ kɔlɩɩ-la a libi lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ hɔ-taalɩsɩŋ, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa libi Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ hɔ-taala-la sɩ kɛŋ bʋɔsʋŋ a nagɛ nanchɛbɩrɩ kʋa arɩ koru-la nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa.

english_verse: For the entrance to the courtyard, Bezalel made a curtain nine meters long, which he hung on four bronze posts that were set on bronze stands. This curtain was
translation_verse: Daa-pɛsɩŋ ŋaa banɛsɛ, kɔlɩɩŋ hɔ-taalɩsɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ bʋɔsʋŋ ma ŋaa banɛsɛ. Hɔpʋla nɛ ba kaa ŋaa kʋkaachɛbɛ kɛnɛɛ arɩ lere-la ŋmɛsɩŋ sɩɩ vɔɔ, a kɛŋ hɔpʋla taarɛ ba nyusuŋ.

english_verse: for the west. Then he hung a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. He placed three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hung a curtain
translation_verse: aŋ ŋaa daapɛsɩŋ mara a kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ libi hɔ-taalɩsɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ bʋɔsʋŋ mara, a bɩra kɛŋ hɔpʋla libi kʋkaachɛbɛ-kɛnɛɛ arɩ lere-la patɩɩsamba-la ŋmɛsɩŋ sɩ jaŋ vɔɔ.

english_verse: Bezalel had worked closely with Oholiab, who was an expert at designing and engraving, and at embroidering blue, purple, and red wool. The two of them completed the work that the Lord had commanded to be done. Moses put Aaron's son Ithamar in charge of the Levites who kept record of the metals used for the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ʋ dɩ Ahɩsama nanʋala Oholiab sɩ ŋaa Daŋ doho nʋʋ. Oholiab fa ŋaa nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩnnɩ gɔgɔ nɛ a kɛŋ jɩma, a jɩŋ kɩaa kpɩɛrɩŋ, a jɩŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ kaa tɩmɩŋ wɩɩkala.

english_verse: the stands for the posts that surrounded the courtyard, including those at the entrance to the courtyard, and the pegs for the tent and the courtyard.
translation_verse: Kɔlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ ba kaa libi hɔ-taalɩsɩ-la kala sɩ golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lɩga arɩ ʋ boiŋ niiŋ hɔ-taalɩsɩŋ, a pɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la daapɛ-biisiŋ arɩ lɩga-la daapɛ-biisiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Beautiful priestly clothes were made of blue, purple, and red wool for Aaron to wear when he performed his duties in the holy place. This was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ arɩ ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ a yuo gɛnnɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ laalɛ a tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ aŋ yuo dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ zɔmɔ a kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ a pɩ Arɔŋ, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ. Gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩŋ

english_verse: and on each of them was engraved the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Tabɩa-la fa ŋaa fii arɩ balɩa nɛ, ba tuuri Jekɔb hambolibiisi-la fii arɩ balɩa yɩraa hɛ. Tabɩɩ na-kala chɩŋ doho kala nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The entire priestly vest was made of fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool. Thin sheets of gold were hammered out and cut into threads that were skillfully woven into the vest.
translation_verse: Gɔgɔ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ libi kʋtaalɩ-biisiŋ a kɩɛra lɩɩsɛ nyɩlaa a kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, ŋmɛŋ vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ a sʋa mɛrɛ.

english_verse: It had two shoulder straps to support it and a sash that fastened around the waist.
translation_verse: Ŋmɛsɩ-la tɩtɩa ba sɩ kaa yuo gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la nɛ ba kaa yuo ʋ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie a mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Onyx stones were placed in gold settings, and each one was engraved with the name of one of Israel's sons.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ libi kʋtaalɩsɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ bʋɔsʋŋ a paa tabɩɩ-tʋlɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ɔnɩs ba sɩ tuuri Iziral hambolibiisiŋ fii arɩ balɩa-la yɩraa hɛ a joŋo hɛ.

english_verse: Then these were attached to the shoulder straps of the vest, so the Lord would never forget his people. Everything was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Breastpiece (Exodus
translation_verse: Ba joŋo mɛrɛ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la vaasɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA liliisi Iziral tɩŋŋaa wɩaa, arɩ ʋ sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ. Bɔyɛ gɛrɩŋ

english_verse: The words “Dedicated to the Lord” were engraved on a narrow strip of pure gold,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ libi pɩrata a tuuro hɛ ʋ lɛ: “Ʋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA kʋzɔŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: The breastpiece was made with the same materials and designs as the priestly vest.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ gɔgɔɔ kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-sumunuŋ, ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ a yɛrɛ bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩ-la arɩ ba sɩ yɛrɛ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The priestly robe was made of blue wool
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ gɔgɔ kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ diibelimbine a yɛrɛ gɛrɩ-duduoŋ sɩ tuu magɛ naachɩgɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst were in the third row;
translation_verse: Naaderi-tori tabɩaa yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la: ‘jasɩŋ’ a ŋaa tabɩɩ-diibelimbine, agɛtɩ a ma ŋaa tabɩɩ-tʋlʋŋ arɩ ‘amɛtɩs’ a ma nagɛ diibelimbine.

english_verse: and two more near the bottom of the shoulder straps right above the sash.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra libi sɛlɩmɛ nenii-pɩraa balɩa a mɛrɛ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la tɩŋa dɩɩrɩŋ a kpagɛ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie.

english_verse: To keep the breastpiece in place, a blue cord was used to tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Clothes for the Priests (Exodus
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ nenii-pɩra-la sɩ hɛ bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩ-la lɛ a vɔɔ mɛrɛ nenii-pɩra-la sɩ hɛ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la lɛ arɩ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine a kaa tuu vɔɔ mɛrɛ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie-la lɛ, dɩ bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩ-la sɩ́ sʋrʋsʋ aŋ ka gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa gɛnnɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ

english_verse: which was fastened to Aaron's turban. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Work Is Completed (Exodus
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine a vɔbʋ mɛrɛ nyu-bɛlɛ-la lɛ, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ. Mosis beŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la ba sɩ ŋaa

english_verse: When Moses saw that the people had done everything exactly as the Lord had commanded, he gave them his blessing.
translation_verse: Mosis beŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala a na dɩ ba tɩŋ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sʋl Wɩa pɩba.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for the head. The material around the collar was bound so as to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: Ba hɛ gɛrɩ-la baŋŋaa tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ a sʋa golli dɩ ʋ sɩ́ kɩɛsʋ.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe were woven pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a bell of pure gold between each of them. This robe was to be worn by Aaron when he performed his duties.
translation_verse: Bimbelime-la arɩ kʋgulogulo-biisi-la chagɩsɛ a golli gɛrɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ laalɛ a tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa niipiniŋ lɛ, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Everything that Aaron and his sons wore was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, including their robes and turbans, their fancy caps and underwear, and even their sashes that were embroidered with needlework.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine arɩ ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ a sʋa gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles and the place of mercy;
translation_verse: a pɛ Wɩa niiriŋ daga arɩ ʋ daaterigeba arɩ ʋ nii-tɔlɔ,

english_verse: So the people of Israel finished making everything the Lord had told Moses to make.
translation_verse: Ba tɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa kala dɛrɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis.

english_verse: Then they brought it all to Moses: the sacred tent and its equipment, including the hooks, the framework and crossbars, and its posts and stands;
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, ʋ nyuŋ tɔlɔ, ʋ kpɩɛraa, ʋ kʋkaachɛbɛ kɛnɛɛ, ʋ daapɛsɩŋ, ʋ daa-gɛsɛɛ, ʋ daaterigeba arɩ ʋ hɔ-taalɩsɩŋ kala kaa kɔ Mosis teeŋ,

english_verse: the covering of tanned ram skins and fine leather; the inside curtain;
translation_verse: a pɛ pie-tenni-la ba sɩ hɛ biriŋ ba fɩɛsɛ, lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ, arɩ patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩɩ kɛrɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tʋɔŋ,

english_verse: the table with all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: teebʋl-la arɩ ʋ nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa arɩ kʋdiile-la sɩɩ chɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ,

english_verse: the lampstand of pure gold, together with its equipment and oil;
translation_verse: a pɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ libi chaaŋ-daaŋ, arɩ ʋ chaanaa arɩ ʋ nyuŋ kɩaa arɩ chaana-la nʋʋŋ,

english_verse: the gold-covered incense altar; the ordination oil and the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
translation_verse: a pɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa, Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ, kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma arɩ patɩɩsamba-la sɩ kɛrɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ,

english_verse: the bronze altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: a pɛ koru-la ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kʋ-la sɩ nagɛ nanchɛbɩrɩ kʋa, ʋ daaterigeba, ʋ nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa, taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la arɩ kʋ-la nyuŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɩŋ,

english_verse: the curtain with its posts and cords, and its pegs and stands that go around the courtyard; everything needed for the sacred tent;
translation_verse: lɩga-la patɩɩsamba arɩ ʋ daapɛsɩŋ, ʋ hɔ-taalɩsɩŋ, ʋ boiŋ niiŋ patɩɩsaŋ, ʋ ŋmɛsɩŋ arɩ ʋ daapɛ-biisiŋ. Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ kpɩɛraa kala,

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: Set up my tent on the first day of the year
translation_verse: “Chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋl-bumbuŋ lɛ, pɛ mɩ-na Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ.

english_verse: and put the chest with the Ten Commandments behind the inside curtain.
translation_verse: Joŋ mɩ niiriŋ daga-la a bil mɩ dɩ-zɔŋ-la tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ patɩɩsaŋ kɛrɛ.

english_verse: Bring in the table and set on it those things that are made for it. Also bring in the lampstand and attach the lamps to it.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ teebʋl-la ma kʋ jʋʋ, a joŋ ʋ nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa daŋ, a joŋ chaaŋ-daaŋ ma kʋ jʋʋ. Joŋ chaana-la sagɛ ʋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Then place the gold altar of incense in front of the sacred chest and hang a curtain at the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa aa nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ a bil patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ kɛrɛ mɩ niiriŋ daga-la sɩpaaŋ, aŋ joŋ mɩ-na Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la boiŋ niiŋ patɩɩsaŋ a kɛrɛ.

english_verse: Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent.
translation_verse: Joŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ a bile kpagɛ mɩ dɩ-zɔŋ-la boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water.
translation_verse: Joŋ taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la a bil Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la arɩ mɩ dɩ-zɔŋ-la pɛgɛ a ŋaa lɩɩŋ hɛ.

english_verse: Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.
translation_verse: Lɩgɛ lɩga a golli mɩ dɩ-zɔŋ-la a kɛŋ patɩɩsaŋ kɛrɛ lɩga-la boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Use the sacred olive oil to dedicate to me the tent and everything in it.
translation_verse: Joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ taa mɩ dɩ-zɔŋ-la arɩ ʋ kpɩɛraa kala dɩ ba chaasa ŋaa kʋzɔmɔ.

english_verse: Do the same thing with the altar for offering sacrifices and its equipment
translation_verse: Joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ taa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la arɩ ʋ nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa dɩ ba chaasa ŋaa kʋzɔmɔ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kaa kɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ a foba lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest.
translation_verse: Joŋ mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ gɛnnɩ-la a laalɛ Arɔŋ, a joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ tɩsʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ.

english_verse: Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons
translation_verse: Kɛŋ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ ma kɔ a paa gɛrɩ-pʋl-duduosu-la laalɛba.

english_verse: Moses followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ.

english_verse: And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up.
translation_verse: Ba pɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la jɩ-lɩa tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋl-bumbuŋ chɛɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis joŋ tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la lɛ Wɩa niiriŋ sɩ hɛ a hɛ daga-la tʋɔŋ, a joŋ daaterigeba-la a tʋʋ daga-la sɛsɩŋ a joŋ ʋ nii-tɔlɔ tɔ.

english_verse: The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ daga-la lɛ Wɩa niiriŋ sɩ hɛ a kaa kʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ, a joŋ patɩɩsamba-la sɩ jaŋ kɛrɛ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la a saga kɛrɛ daga-la, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis joŋ teebʋl-la ma jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la dɩ-zɔmʋŋ, a joŋo bil wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa,

english_verse: after which the bread was set on the table.
translation_verse: a joŋ boroboro-la daŋ teebʋl nyuŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ.

english_verse: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord.
translation_verse: a nyɩgɛ chaana-la La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: aa nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma ʋ nyuŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ.

english_verse: The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩɩ kɛrɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la boiŋ niiŋ a saga kɛrɛ.

english_verse: Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra joŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koruŋ a bile kpagɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ, a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la a bil lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la pɛgɛ a ŋaa lɩɩŋ hɛ ba kaa sʋsɔŋ ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.
translation_verse: Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kɛŋ taasɩ-gbaŋa-la tʋɔŋ lɩɩŋ sʋsɔŋ ba nɩsaa arɩ ba naasɩŋ.

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ ba nɛ jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ koo dɩ ba nɛ mʋ koru-la leriŋ, ba yie sɔŋ ba nɩsaa arɩ ba naasɩŋ nɛ, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Finally, Moses had the curtains hung around the courtyard and at the entrance. The Glory of the Lord
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis lɩgɛ lɩga a golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la arɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la, a joŋ lɩga-la boiŋ niiŋ patɩɩsaŋ a saga kɛrɛ. Ŋ-la nɛ Mosis tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la dɛrɛ. La TƖƖNA tʋla

english_verse: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ kʋ tɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ. La TƖƖNA tʋla su Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la kala.

english_verse: Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow;
translation_verse: Wombii-la kala Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ vɛnɛ, bʋa na-kala dɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la nɛ kʋ sii Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la nyuŋ, ba yie sii lee-la ba sɩ hɔnɔ nɛ a bɩra vɩvɛŋ.

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la nɛ bɩ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la nyuŋ sie, ba bɩ vɛŋ, see tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ sie.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la fa yie hɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la nyuŋ nɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ, tɩtaŋɩŋ ma ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ a chol nyiniŋ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, bʋa-la kala lɛ ba fa sɩɩ vɛŋ wombiiŋ.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses from the sacred tent and gave him instructions for the community of Israel to follow when they offered sacrifices. Sacrifices To Please the Lord The Lord said: Sacrifices to please me must be completely burned on the bronze altar. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices. If the animal is a bull, it must not have anything wrong with it. Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, and I will let you know if it is acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɛŋ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋ a nyɩga ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩmɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ nɛ-bele sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a kaa mʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ laa tɩɩna sʋla.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: Tɩɩna maga dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ a daŋ nɛŋ-la nyuŋ lɛ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ kpʋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ dɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA to pʋna-la lɛ a laa ʋ sʋla, a pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kpʋ nɛ-bele-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ dɩ Arɔŋ hambolibiisi-la sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa laa ʋ chalɩŋ mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɩ chɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ sɛsɩŋ kala,

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ hambolibiisi-la sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ til daasɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la lɛ a hɛ nyiniŋ ʋ nyuŋ,

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ chɛsɛ tʋɔŋ kɩaa arɩ naasɩŋ, dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara laa ba kala a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ. Ʋ ŋaa kʋnyɩga Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: Dɩ pʋna-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ kpʋ a nyɩga ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ ŋaa piesu koo bʋʋŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa pie-bele koo gbuŋgbogo sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kpʋ pʋna-la Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, dɩ Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa laa ʋ chalɩŋ a mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛsɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ chɛsɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa arɩ naasɩŋ a joŋo pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara dɩ ʋ nyɩgɛ ba kala Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ. Ʋ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: Dɩ kʋ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ kpʋ nyɩga ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩmɛ nɛ ŋaa kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ balɩa tɩɩna, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa kokomo nɛ.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ kaa mʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la teeŋ a mɩlɩmɛ nyuŋ keri a joŋ nyuŋ-la nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ, aŋ leŋ dɩ kokomo-la chalɩŋ chuuro hɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛmɛ.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ kʋɔlʋŋ a pɛ ʋ pʋnaa lɛ a kaa mʋ ta Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛmɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ lee-la tʋɔrʋŋ sɩ pɩna.

english_verse: Finally, he will take the bird by its wings, tear it partially open, and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Aŋ kɛ kokomo-la a kaa gʋrɛ dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara joŋo nyɩgɛ daasɩ-la sɩ til nyiŋ-la lɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ. Ʋ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ a wɛnsɛ nʋʋŋ hɛ a joŋ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ daŋ,

english_verse: and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: a kaa mʋ pɩ Arɔŋ hambolibiisi-la sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɩ dɔŋɔ ŋaa muŋ-zɔŋ-la arɩ nʋʋ-la arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋ-la kala nɩsɩŋ sɩɩ, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩ-diiliŋ a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩmɛ.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ tɩɩ kʋkaana-la. Ba ŋaa kʋzɔmɔ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ ba joŋo ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ mɩaa wasɛ boroboro a kaa sʋl mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma ŋaa munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ a kɛŋ nʋʋŋ buu aŋ sɩ́ sɩbʋrʋŋ hɛ, koo dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa boroboro pɛrɛ pɛrɛ biisiŋ ma, má sɩ́ sɩbʋrʋŋ hɛ aŋ wasɛ a ŋaa nʋʋŋ taa.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma hal munuŋ nʋʋ-hala lɛ a kaa sʋl mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, má ŋaa munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ a buu arɩ nʋʋŋ a sɩ́ sɩbʋrʋŋ hɛ,

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: a kaa yɔrɩsɛ a wɛnsɛ nʋʋŋ daŋ, ʋ ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma chɔ munuŋ ma a kaa sʋl mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma ŋaa munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ nɛ a hɛ nʋʋŋ.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Dɩ kɩaa deemba kʋŋkala nɛ ma kaa kɔ dɩ ma sʋl mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ maga dɩ ma joŋo pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara dɩ ʋ laa a kaa mʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la teeŋ.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ joŋ La TƖƖNA dɩ-diiliŋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ. Ʋ sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ sɩ ka ŋaa Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kɩaa nɛ. Ba ŋaa kʋzɔmɔ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɛ ba joŋo ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ na-kala ma sɩ jaŋ kaa kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA teeŋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ sɩbʋrʋŋ. Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ na-kala ma sɩ jaŋ nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ tʋʋŋ koo sɩbʋrʋŋ.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ sɩbʋrʋŋ koo tʋʋŋ, ma jaŋ wuo kɛmba a sʋl kʋdii falaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma nyɩgɛba Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ba sʋɔra bɩ sɩŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Salt is offered when you make an agreement with me, so sprinkle salt on these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ na-kala maga dɩ má hɛ yɩsɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa yɩsɩŋ nɛ ŋaa nii-la sɩ hɛ ma dɩ Wɩa pɛgɛ magɩlɩŋ. Má hɛ yɩsɩŋ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋŋ na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ ma mɩɩ-falaa sʋl mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, má keri mɩɩ-nyusu-la kʋlaarɩŋ a wasɛ a gɛrɩgɛ,

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: a hɛ nʋʋŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ mɩɩ-gɛrɩgɩa-la lɛ, ʋ ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ ŋaa mɩɩ gɛrɩgɩa-la arɩ nʋʋ-la a pɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋ-la lɛ, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩ-diiliŋ, a nyɩgɛ ba kala a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩmɛ.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ chɛ ʋ kɛŋ nɛŋ ŋaa nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ bele koo nɩɩŋ sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a ŋaa.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Tɩɩna maga dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ pʋna-la nyuŋ lɛ aŋ kpʋ pʋna-la lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ. Arɔŋ hambolibiisi-la sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ laa ʋ chalɩŋ a mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛsɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Offer all of the fat on the animal's insides,
translation_verse: Nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ nyɩgɛ nʋʋ-la kala sɩ tɔ pʋna-la tʋɔŋ kɩaa,

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: a pɛ chʋchɔ-biee arɩ nʋʋ-la sɩ tɔba arɩ chʋɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ jaŋ joŋ kɩaa deemba a daŋa pɛ kʋnyɩgɩa-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ daŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ nyiŋ-la lɛ, a nyɩgɛ ba kala. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ chɛ ʋ kɛŋ piese koo bʋʋna a ŋaa nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ bele koo nɩɩŋ sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a ŋaa.

english_verse: If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɩɩ chɛ ʋ kɛŋ piese ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kaa kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ nɛ,

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: a joŋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ piesu-la nyuŋ lɛ aŋ kpʋʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ. Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ jaŋ laa ʋ chalɩŋ a mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛsɩŋ kala.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: a pɛ chʋchɔ-biee arɩ nʋʋ-la sɩ tɔba arɩ chʋɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ laaba a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ, ba ŋaa kʋdiilee wɩɩ-sʋla nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: Dɩ bʋʋna nɛ ʋʋ chɛ dɩ ʋ kaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛnʋ kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ nɛ,

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: a joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ bʋʋŋ-la nyuŋ lɛ aŋ kpʋʋ lee-la mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ. Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ jaŋ laa ʋ chalɩŋ a mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛsɩŋ kala.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: a pɛ chʋchɔ-biee arɩ nʋʋ-la kala sɩ tɔba arɩ chʋɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ laaba a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩmɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ tɩɩ pʋna-la ba sɩ kpʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nʋʋŋ kala.

english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho kala maga dɩ ba kɩkɩsɛ pʋna chalɩŋ koo nʋʋŋ nɛ ba mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ lee na-kala ba sɩ hɛ.’ ”

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: a kɛŋ ʋ neniiŋ a tagɛ chal-la mɩsɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩpaaŋ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ, kʋ-la sɩ kɛrɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩ-zɔŋ-la.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ gbuŋgbogo-la nyuŋ lɛ aŋ kpʋʋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ lee-la ba sɩɩ nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ neniiŋ tagɛ pʋna-la chalɩŋ a taa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la lɛ ba sɩ nyɩgɛ kɩaa pɩpɩmɛ nyilliŋ aŋ joŋ chal-kaaŋ-la a bɩsa ta Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: ‘Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ sɛnɛ aŋ chei mɩ niiri-la dɔŋɔ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ to wɩaa deemba nɛ:

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ a joŋ cheeriŋ hɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ kaa kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA teeŋ a pɩɩsɛ ʋ wʋbɔŋ-la ta.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ nɛ-bel-bie-la kaa kɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ, a joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ nɛŋ-la nyuŋ lɛ aŋ kpʋʋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ-la jaŋ ŋaa chal-la dɔnsʋŋ a kaa jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ tʋɔŋ,

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ jaŋ ŋaa nɛ-bele-la chal-la taa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la lɛ ba sɩɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pɩpɩmɛ nyilliŋ. Ʋ nɛ chɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ, aŋ kɛŋ chal-kaaŋ-la a lɩɩ bɩsa ta Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la lɛ ba sɩ nyɩgɛ kɩaa pɩpɩmɛ bʋbʋɔŋ. Ʋ nɛ chɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: a kaa lɩɩ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ lee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋnyɩgaa tʋɔrʋŋ lɩɩ tɩta a hɛ nyiniŋ a nyɩgɛ.

english_verse: When the nation of Israel disobeys me without meaning to, the whole nation is still guilty.
translation_verse: Dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nɛ bɩ jɩŋ aŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ a chei wɩalɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bile dɔŋɔ, arɩ ba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ ma kala, ba ha kɛŋ cheeriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ kʋ jɩŋ arɩ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ nɛ-bele nɛ kaa kɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ a sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ jaŋ joŋ ba nɩsaa a daŋ nɛ-bele-la nyuŋ lɛ aŋ kpʋʋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ jaŋ ŋaa nɛŋ-la chalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ a kaa jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ tʋɔŋ,

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: a kɛŋ ʋ neniiŋ tagɛ chal-la a mɩsɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩpaaŋ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ-la jaŋ ŋaa chal-la dɔnsʋŋ a taa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la lɛ ba sɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pɩpɩmɛ nyilliŋ. Ʋ nɛ chɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ, aŋ joŋ chal kaaŋ-la a lɩɩ bɩsa ta Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la lɛ ba sɩ nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa pɩpɩmɛ bʋbʋɔŋ. Ʋ nɛ chɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove the fat from the bull and send it up in smoke on the altar. Finally, he will burn its remains outside the camp, just as he did with the other bull. By this sacrifice the sin of the whole nation will be forgiven. When a Tribal Leader Sins The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ nɛŋ-la a kaa lɩɩ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ a nyɩgɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ nyɩgɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ŋɩɩ. Deeŋ-na ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋa nɛ.

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ kʋ jɩŋ arɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa, ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ gbuŋgbogo sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ neniiŋ tagɛ pʋna-la chalɩŋ a taa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la lɛ ba sɩɩ nyɩgɛ kɩaa pɩpɩmɛ nyilliŋ, aŋ joŋ chal kaaŋ-la a bɩsa ta Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ joŋ pʋna-la nʋʋŋ kala nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ arɩ ba sɩɩ nyɩgɛ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna nʋʋŋ ŋɩɩ. Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ ŋaa ŋ-la, ʋ pɩɩsɛ sɩpaalaarʋ-la wʋbɔmʋŋ ta nɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛʋ.

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ kʋ jɩŋ arɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa, ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ bʋ-nɩɩŋ sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a kaa kʋ sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a tɩŋ wʋbɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ bʋ-nɩɩ-la nyuŋ lɛ aŋ kpʋʋ lee-la ba sɩ nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa pɩpɩmɛ.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kʋɔrɛ pʋna-la nʋʋŋ arɩ ba sɩ kʋɔrɛ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna nʋʋŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara joŋo nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ ŋaa ŋ-la, ʋ pɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la wʋbɔmʋŋ ta nɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛʋ.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Dɩ piesu nɛ ʋ kaa kɔ dɩ ʋ sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ pie-nɩɩŋ sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ piesu-la mʋ lee-la ba sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a nyɩga pɩpɩ Wɩa nɛ, a joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ piesu-la nyuŋ lɛ aŋ kpʋʋ.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ neniiŋ tagɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ piesu-la chalɩŋ a taa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la lɛ ba sɩ nyɩgɛ kɩaa pɩpɩ Wɩa nyilliŋ, aŋ joŋ chal-kaaŋ-la bɩsa ta koru-la bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kʋɔrɛ piesu-la nʋʋŋ kala arɩ ba sɩɩ kʋɔrɛ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ piese nʋʋŋ ŋɩɩ, a pɛ kʋnyɩgɩa-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ daŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ a nyɩgɛ ba kala pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ ŋaa ŋ-la, ʋ pɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la wʋbɔmʋŋ ta nɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛʋ.

english_verse: You are guilty and unfit to worship me, if you accidentally touch the dead body of any kind of unclean animal.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ sɛnɛ aŋ digi kʋŋ na-kala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ, pʋŋ-sʋʋŋ koo baga kʋŋ koo kɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tuuri tinteeŋ, arɩ ʋ sɩ bɩ jɩŋ ma kala, ʋ tɩɩna ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ, ʋ laa cheeriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: Koo dɩ ʋ nɛ digi nuhuobiine kʋŋkala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ aŋ bɩ jɩŋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ kʋ jɩŋ, ʋ laa cheeriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kʋŋkala chei, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ sɛɩ nɛ aŋ suri ʋ niiŋ a bʋl wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa chei dɩ nɩaa nɩɩ.

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la chei, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ pie-nɩɩŋ koo bʋ-nɩɩŋ a kaa kʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara pɩɩsɛ ʋ wʋbɔmʋŋ ta.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛmba kaa mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara teeŋ, dɩ ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ aŋ mɩlɩmɛ baŋŋaa bori aŋ sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nyuŋ cholli,

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: aŋ kɛŋ ʋ chalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛsɩŋ kala, aŋ kɛŋ chal-la kʋkaanɩŋ chuoro ta Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la bʋbʋɔŋ, ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩɩ-la nɛ bɩ kokosuŋ balɩa lɛ wuo yi dɩ ʋ kaa sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ gbaŋa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a kaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ joŋ nʋʋŋ koo kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ hɛ muŋ-la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ, ʋ bɩ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kaa mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara teeŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɩsɩŋ sɩɩŋ mɩ dɩ-diiliŋ a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ pɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la wʋbɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa ta nɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛʋ. Muŋ-kaaŋ-la jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara toruŋ, a nagɛ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ muŋ-kaanɩŋ sɩ ŋaa ʋ toruŋ ŋɩɩ.’ ” Cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: “Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ jɩŋ aŋ bɩ kʋŋ ʋ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ time pɩ Wɩa time, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ cheeriŋ pie-bele sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ, a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Piesu-la yalɩŋ maga dɩ ʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ daga Wɩa dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ joŋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ kpuŋkpel-kuuŋ a vɔɔ a joŋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ gɛrɩ-duduoŋ a laala daŋ, aŋ paa kʋnyɩgɩa-la tʋɔrʋŋ a bil Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛmɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do when they commit other sins against the Lord: You have sinned if you rob or cheat someone, if you keep back money or valuables left in your care, or if you find something and claim not to have it.
translation_verse: koo dɩ nʋʋ kʋŋ ma nɛ lɛlɛ dɩ ʋ naʋ a joŋ a nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ʋ bɩ ʋ na koo a ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ ʋ bɩ ʋ wɩaa jɩŋ,

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: “Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩaa deemba nɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ jaŋ kaa kʋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ tɩsɛba dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa. Muŋ-zɔmʋŋ gbaŋa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ ba jaŋ vɛnɛ kaa sʋl mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA bʋa na-kala. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ kpaa bʋlɩa, a joŋ dɔŋɔ sʋl chʋchʋɔŋ a joŋ dɔŋɔ ma sʋl dɩdaanɩŋ.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.
translation_verse: Baal na-kala sɩ hɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ jaŋ wuo chaŋ nammɩa-la, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ŋaa kʋŋ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
translation_verse: Dɩ chʋrʋŋ nɛ ba kaa mɛ pupoi-la lɛ ba sɩ chɔ nammɩa-la, ʋ maga dɩ ba ŋmoo yɛrɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa kɔlɩɩŋ pupoiŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba wʋrʋgʋ arɩ tintiisiŋ aŋ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ yegili.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord: You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning.
translation_verse: “Bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ: ‘Wombiee deemba nɛ ba jaŋ to a ŋɩŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ nyɩga sʋl Wɩa jaŋ daŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ a kaa mʋ chʋchʋɔŋ. Nyiŋ-la sɩ hɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ maga dɩ ʋ didii tɩtaŋɩŋ kala dɩ taŋ pʋl.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ wuri gɛrɩ-zɔmɔ-la bil aŋ paa gɛnnɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ laalɛ a paa tʋɔrʋ-la a kaa lɩɩ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ lee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Nyiŋ-la sɩ hɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ maga dɩ ʋ didii a sɩ́ dɩsʋ. Chʋchʋɔ na-kala Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ hɛ daasɩŋ nɛ nyiŋ-la lɛ, a paa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋnyɩgaa arɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna nʋʋŋ daŋ a nyɩga pɩmɛ.

english_verse: The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out. Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nyiŋ-la sɩ hɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ maga dɩ ʋ didii bʋa na-kala, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ dɩsɛ. Mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: Wombiee deemba nɛ ma jaŋ to a ŋɩŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Arɔŋ hambolibiisi-la sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋkɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la teeŋ.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ ŋaa muŋ-zɔŋ-la arɩ nʋʋ-la arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋ-la kala nɩsɩŋ sɩɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩ-diiliŋ a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: The rest of it is to be baked without yeast and eaten by the priests in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent. This bread is very holy, just like the sacrifices for sin or the sacrifices for making things right, and I have given this part to the priests from what is offered to me on the altar.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ joŋo wasɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba hɛ sɩbʋrʋŋ, ba toruŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩba a lɩɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nyɩga pɩmɛ tʋɔŋ. Ba ŋaa kɩa sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ, arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa sɩ ŋaa kʋzɔmɔ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Arɔŋ doho nʋʋ na-kala sɩ ŋaa baal jaŋ wuo dii kɩaa deemba, ba kpaalɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ vɛnɛɛ dii. Dɩ ba nɛ kɛŋ mɩaa kɔ dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, kʋŋ na-kala sɩ digi kɩaa deemba bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ buu muŋ-la arɩ nʋʋŋ a hal nʋʋ-hala lɛ a kaa yɔrɩsɛ a kaa kʋ ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩmɛ. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Each of Aaron's descendants who is ordained as a priest must perform this ceremony and make sure that the bread is completely burned on the altar. None of it may be eaten! Sacrifices for Sin (Leviticus
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara tɩtɩa nɛ ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ na-kala, ʋ maga dɩ ba nyɩgɛ ba kala nɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ diiba.” Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ: ‘Wombiee deemba nɛ ba jaŋ to a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna maga dɩ ba kpʋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa lee-la ba sɩ kpʋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna, ʋ ŋaa kʋzɔŋ nɛ woruŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ deeŋ maga dɩ ʋ dii ʋ toruŋ nɛ dɩ-zɔŋ, lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ kaala tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.
translation_verse: Dɩ kʋŋ na-kala nɛ digi nammɩa-la ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ. Dɩ ʋ chalɩŋ nɛ taa gɛrɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba chɛsʋ lee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Ama wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna na-kala chalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa kʋ jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ dɩ ba pɩɩsɛ nʋʋ wʋbɔmʋŋ ta, nammɩa bɩ maga dɩ ba chaŋ. Ʋ maga dɩ ba nyɩgɛ ʋ kala.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ jomba a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ ŋaa cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ boroboroba-la kala kʋŋkʋŋ a hɛ dɔŋɔ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ-la sɩ joŋ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna-la chalɩŋ mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nɛ tɩɩ kɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Dɩ nammɩa-la nɛ digi kʋŋ na-kala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma chaŋʋ, má joŋo nyɩga ta. Ama nammɩɩsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ-na, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ jaŋ wuo chaŋ.

english_verse: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, lee-la ba sɩ yie kpʋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna, a joŋ ʋ chalɩŋ a mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛsɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides,
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ba kʋɔrɛ nʋʋ-la sɩ tɔ pʋna-la tʋɔŋ kɩaa nɛ, a lɩɩsɛ dokeliŋ,

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: a chaarɛ chʋchɔ-biee arɩ nʋʋ-la sɩ tɔba arɩ chʋɩŋ.

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara doho nʋʋ na-kala sɩ ŋaa baal jaŋ wuo diiba. Ʋ maga dɩ ba diiba lee sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ba ŋaa kɩa zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
translation_verse: Cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ wombiiŋ ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ tɩɩ pʋna-la ʋ sɩ kaa pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ ta nammɩɩ-kaanɩŋ.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ kɛŋ nʋʋkala kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ maga dɩ ʋ tɩɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna-la teniŋ.

english_verse: just as he may eat the bread from a sacrifice to give thanks to me.
translation_verse: Mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ na-kala lɛ, dɩ ba joŋo wasɛ nɛ koo dɩ ba joŋo chɔ pupoiŋ lɛ koo dɩ ba joŋo hal nʋʋ-hala lɛ nɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ jaŋ tɩɩba.

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ na-kala lɛ, dɩ ba joŋ nʋʋŋ nɛ hɛ koo dɩ kʋnyʋʋnʋ nɛ, Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ jaŋ tɩɩba dɩ ba kaa kpaa a magɛ dɔŋɔ. Nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: Wombiee deemba nɛ ba jaŋ to aa sʋl nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ aa pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ chɛ ʋ sʋl nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a lɔllɛ La TƖƖNA, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ pʋna-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ kaa sʋl nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ boroboro sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ a hɛ nʋʋŋ a wasɛ arɩ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ ba sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ hɛ, a wasɛ boroboro pɛrɛ pɛrɛ biisiŋ a ŋaa nʋʋŋ taa, arɩ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ ba sɩ hɛ nʋʋŋ a hal.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna-la nammɩa maga dɩ ʋ chaŋʋ tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa ʋ sɩ sʋl Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la nɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ chɩna chʋa.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ŋaa niiŋ nɛ ʋ kʋ lɩɩsɛ, koo dɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ, Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋ-la nammɩa maga dɩ ʋ chaŋʋ tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ sʋl Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la nɛ. Ama dɩ kʋŋ nɛ ka dɩ taŋ pʋl, ʋ ha jaŋ wuo chaŋ.

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ chaŋ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna-la nammɩa tapʋl-tori chɛɛŋ, Wɩa bɩ sɛɩ, ʋ bɩ nɩɩ-la Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ka laa, ʋ bɩ Wɩɩ-sʋl-zɔŋ ŋaa, ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ chaŋ nammɩa-la jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ digi kʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ nuhuobiine lɛ a kɛŋ disiniŋ, koo dɩ ʋ digi pʋna koo baga kʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ koo kʋŋ na-kala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ, aŋ chaŋ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna nammɩa sɩ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋa, ʋ maga dɩ ba lɩɩsʋ ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.’ ” Pʋsʋŋ nʋʋŋ arɩ chalɩŋ diiniŋ ka kɩsɛ nɛ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral-tɩŋŋaa: ‘Má sɩ́ nɛŋ koo piese koo bʋʋna nʋʋŋ dii.

english_verse: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.
translation_verse: Dɩ pʋna nɛ sʋba koo dɩ baga kʋŋ nɛ kɛŋ pʋna pʋɔsa ta dɩ ma naʋ, ma jaŋ wuo lɩɩsɛ ʋ nʋʋŋ a kaa ŋaa wɩaa dɔnsʋŋ, ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma diiu.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ dii pʋna-la ba sɩ nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nʋʋŋ, ʋ maga dɩ má lɩɩsʋ ta nɛ ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: Lee na-kala ma sɩ hɛ, má pʋpɔ ma sɩ́ pʋna koo kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ tɩŋŋaa chalɩŋ dii.

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ dii chalɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ má lɩɩsʋ ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.’ ” Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kpaalɩŋ

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If you want to offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, you must bring the part to be burned and lay it on the bronze altar. But you must first lift up the choice ribs with their fat to show that the offering is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ maga dɩ ʋ kori kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ pʋna-la nʋʋŋ arɩ pʋna-la vaaŋ, a kɛŋ vaa-la je aa zaarɛ mɩ sɩpaaŋ. Ŋɩɩ ŋaa ʋ tɩtɩa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ ʋ kaa je mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ nʋʋ-la a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ, ka dɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ joŋ vaa-la.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ tʋɔŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna-la chalɩŋ arɩ ʋ nʋʋŋ sʋl Wɩa nɛ jaŋ joŋ pʋna-la nadiiŋ huiŋ, ʋ toruŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ, mɩ joŋ vaa-la ba sɩ kaa je a zaarɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ arɩ hui-la ba sɩ kaa kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ a pɩ Arɔŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa ba toruŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.’ ”

english_verse: These are the ceremonies for sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessing or his forgiveness, as well as the ceremonies for those sacrifices that demand a payment and for the sacrifices that are offered when priests are ordained.
translation_verse: Wombiee deemba nɛ ba jaŋ to a ŋɩŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ yie ŋaa a lɩɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ La TƖƖNA dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ nyuŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kʋ pʋ.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis joŋ pʋna-la vaaŋ, ʋ toruŋ, a kaa je aa zaarɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Kɛŋ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ, a pɛ paa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa gɛnnɩ-la ba sɩɩ laalʋ, a joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ, a kɛŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ, a kɛsɛ pie-belliŋ balɩa arɩ boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ sime sɩɩŋ,

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: a yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ kala dɩ ba kɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ.”

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩba, “Wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ daga nɛ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kʋ lɩɩ a ŋaa lɩɩŋ sɔmba.

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ gɛrɩ-pʋl-duduoŋ-la a laalɛ Arɔŋ a joŋ tɩŋgɛnnɛ a vɔɔ ʋ tɩŋa a joŋ gɛrɩ-duduoŋ-la sɩ nagɛ diibelimbine a tuu magɛ naasolluŋ a laala daŋ, a joŋ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩŋ laala pɛ, a kɛŋ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie ba sɩ sʋa woruŋ a vɔɔ mɛrɛ.

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: Mosis bɩra joŋ bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩŋ a laalɛ Arɔŋ a joŋ Urim arɩ Tumim a hɛ bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩ-la tʋɔŋ. .

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ nyu-bɛlɛ a bɛ Arɔŋ nyuŋ, a joŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ libi Wɩa kʋmagɩla-la a mɛrɛ ʋ tile lɛ nyu-bɛlɛ-la lɛ, ŋɩɩ dagɛ arɩ Arɔŋ hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Mosis ŋaa wɩaa deemba arɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ a taa lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa kala a joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ nʋʋ-la dɔnsʋŋ a mɩsa hɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la arɩ ʋ nyuŋ kɩaa lɛ arɩ taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la arɩ kʋ-la nyuŋ ʋ sɩ chɩna naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ, a wasɛ ba kala a joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: aŋ wansɛ nʋʋ-la dɔnsʋŋ ma a hɛ Arɔŋ nyuŋ lɛ a sʋl Wɩa hɛ ʋ lɛ a joŋu hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis kɛŋ Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ ma kʋ jʋʋ a paa gɛrɩ-pʋl duduosuŋ a laalɛba a joŋ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ biisiŋ a vɔɔ ba tɩnsɩŋ, a paa nyunchuuluŋ ma a chu ba nyusuŋ, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ-bele kʋ lɩɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ joŋ ba nɩsaa daŋ nɛŋ-la nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis kpʋ nɛ-bele-la a ŋaa ʋ chalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ a kɛŋ na-niiŋ tagɛ a hɛ nyilli-la sɩ hɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la gʋnaa lɛ a pɩɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la disiniŋ ta, aŋ bɩsɛ chal-la kʋkaanɩŋ a ta Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la bʋbʋɔŋ, a joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋzɔŋ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Ʋ kʋɔrɛ nʋʋ-la kala sɩ tɔ tʋɔŋ kɩaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ tɔ chʋɩŋ a pɛ chʋchɔ-biee arɩ nʋʋ-la sɩ tɔba a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ,

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: aŋ kɛŋ nɛ-bele-la teniŋ, ʋ nammɩa arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa a lɩɩ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ a nyɩgɛ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Mosis bɩra kɛŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pie-bele kʋ lɩɩ. Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ joŋ ba nɩsaa daŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis kpʋ piesu-la a joŋ ʋ chalɩŋ a mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛsɩŋ kala,

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ʋ chɛsɛ tʋɔŋ kɩaa arɩ naasɩŋ a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a joŋ nammɩa-la kala a nyɩga pɩ La TƖƖNA. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ La TƖƖNA, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bɩra kɛŋ pie-bele dɔŋɔ kʋ lɩɩ, ba sɩ jaŋ kaa wasɛ wɩaa, a joŋ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ a hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa. Ba joŋ ba nɩsaa daŋ piesu-la nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis kpʋ pie-bele-la a tagɛ ʋ chalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ a lagɛ Arɔŋ nadiiŋ dɩgɩlɩŋ-pɩpaaŋ lɛ, a ŋaa dɔnsʋŋ lagɛ ʋ nadiiŋ nenii-baalɩŋ arɩ ʋ nadiiŋ naanii-baalɩŋ.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bɩra kɛŋ Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ ma kɔ a ŋaa chal-la a lagɛ ba nadiiŋ dɩgɩlɩŋ pɩpaarɩŋ lɛ, a ŋaa lagɛ ba nadiiŋ nenii-baalaa arɩ ba nadiiŋ naanii-baalaa, aŋ ŋaa chal-la mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛsɩŋ kala.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Mosis kʋɔrɛ piesu-la nʋʋŋ arɩ nʋʋ-la sɩ tɔ tʋɔŋ kɩaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ tɔ chʋɩŋ a lɩɩsɛ chʋchɔ-biee arɩ nʋʋ-la sɩ tɔba a pɛ dokeliŋ arɩ nadiiŋ huiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Sime-la arɩ kʋdiilee sɩ chɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ tʋɔŋ, ʋ lɩɩsɛ boroboro arɩ boroboro pɛrɛ pɛrɛ-bie arɩ boroboro ba sɩ kɛŋ nʋʋŋ a wasɛ, a joŋ kɩaa deemba pɛ nʋʋrʋ-la arɩ nadiiŋ hui-la lɛ.

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ kɩaa deemba a hɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɩsaa lɛ ba kaa je aa zaarɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis laa kɩalɩŋ ba nɩsaa lɛ a kaa mʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ a joŋo daŋ a pɛ kʋnyɩgɩa-la sɩ daŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ a nyɩgɛ ba kala pɩ La TƖƖNA. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pʋ.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
