translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ arɩ chal-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la lɛ a mɩsa hɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba gɛnnɩŋ kala lɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ a joŋ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba gɛnnɩŋ kala a hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ, “Má chɔ nammɩa-la lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ a chaŋ arɩ boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ a hɛ sime-la tʋɔŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ. Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ maga dɩ ba diiba.

english_verse: Burn what is left over
translation_verse: Nammɩa-la arɩ boroboro sɩ ka, má joŋo nyɩgɛ.

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ sii, má hɔŋ nɩmɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ, see tapʋlɩa-la ba sɩ kaa wasɛ ma wɩaa dɩ ma ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɛrɛ.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ wɩɩ-la dɩ la ŋaa a pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ ta nɛ, la ŋaa ŋɩɩ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma hɔŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala tapʋlaa balɩpɛ, a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ daga. Má pɔ má sɩ́ nɩmɛ sii, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ma jaŋ sʋʋ. Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛmɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ to Mosis lɛ a bʋla pɩba.

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: a bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ, kɛŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ ŋ sɩ jaŋ kaa sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a kɛŋ pie-bele ma ŋ sɩ jaŋ kaa sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a kɔ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, kɩaa deemba kʋŋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nyɔɔ.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba kɛŋ gbuŋgbogo ba sɩ jaŋ kaa sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a kɛŋ nɛ-bie arɩ pie-bel-pɔrʋŋ sɩ yi jɩna a bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a kʋ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ,

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: a kɛŋ nɛ-bele arɩ pie-bele ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a kpʋba La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, a pɛ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ba sɩ joŋ nʋʋŋ hɛ. Má ŋaa wɩaa deemba, bɛɛ wɩaa jɩnɩŋ La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛma.

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kala Mosis sɩ daga kɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala kʋ chɩna kpagɛ lee-la, La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋl, “Wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA dagɛ dɩ ma ŋaa, aŋ wuo na ʋ tʋla.”

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Mosis bɩra bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ, “Mʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la teeŋ a kpʋ ŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ ŋ disiniŋ ta aŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Arɔŋ mʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la teeŋ a kpʋ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ-bie.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ chaga laa nɛŋ-la chalɩŋ pʋ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ neniiŋ tagɛ a hɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyilliŋ lɛ aŋ joŋ kʋkaanɩŋ bɩsa ta Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛŋ-la nʋʋŋ arɩ ʋ chʋchɔ-biee arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ tɔ chʋɩŋ a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: aŋ kɛŋ nɛŋ-la nammɩa arɩ teniŋ kaa lɩɩ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ a nyɩgɛ.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Arɔŋ kpʋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pie-bele-la ma ʋ hambolibiisiŋ chaga laa chalɩŋ pʋ, ʋ joŋo mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛsɩŋ kala.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kɛŋ nammɩa-la keri keri a paa pʋ a pɛ nyuŋ lɛ ʋ joŋo nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ,

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: aŋ chɛsɛ tʋɔŋ kɩaa arɩ naasɩŋ a joŋo daŋa pɛ kʋnyɩgɩa-la sɩ hɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ a nyɩgɛ ba ma.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Arɔŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kʋ lɩɩ, a kpʋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ bʋʋna a sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ bumbuŋ kʋ-la lɛ.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa ma kɔ a nyɩgɛba arɩ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kɔ a ŋaa nɩsɩŋ sɩɩŋ, a pɛ chʋchʋɔŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋnyɩgaa lɛ a nyɩgɛ ba kala Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Arɔŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛŋ arɩ nɛ-bele, ʋ hambolibiisiŋ chaga laa chalɩŋ pʋ ʋ joŋo mɩsɛ koru-la sɛsɩŋ kala.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ nɛ-bele-la arɩ pie-bele-la nʋʋraa leree: dokeliŋ, chʋchɔ-biee arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ tɔ chʋɩŋ,

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: aŋ joŋ vaa-la arɩ nadiiŋ huiŋ a kaa je aa zaarɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ arɩ Mosis sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Arɔŋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa je a chaasɛ nɩalɩŋ aŋ sʋl Wɩa pɩba. Ʋ sɩ sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ dɛrɛ, ʋ sʋʋsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, aŋ kʋ lɩɩ a sʋl Wɩa pɩ nɩalɩŋ, La TƖƖNA tʋla guu chaanɛ ba kala na.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA leŋ nyiniŋ kɔ a dii kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ daŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ na wɩalɩŋ, ba chiesi arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ aŋ tuu tel a kɛŋ ba sɩaa chu tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Nadab arɩ Abihu sɩ ŋaa Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ paa kɩalɩŋ lɛ ba sɩ yie hɛ nyiniŋ, a chaanɛ nyiniŋ hɛ a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA, ʋ sɩ bɩ ba daga.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ nyiniŋ kʋ jomba dii ba sʋʋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ, “Wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa nɛ La TƖƖNA fa bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ sɩ: ‘Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋ kpagɛmɛ, mɩ jaŋ dagɛba arɩ mɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Nʋʋkala jaŋ zilmi.’ ” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Arɔŋ ŋaa chɩm.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis yɩrɛ Arɔŋ nyɩŋ-bie Ʋzɩɛl hambolibiisiŋ Mɩsɩɛl arɩ Ɛlɩzafaŋ, a bʋla pɩba, “Má mʋ paa ma naambiiri-la kʋsʋʋnʋŋ lɩɩ Wɩa dɩa-la lɛ a kaa lɩɩ ma dɩ-hɔnɩɩ-la kala lɛ.”

english_verse: So they dragged the dead men away by their clothes.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kʋ paaba lɩɩ ba dɩ-hɔnɩɩ-la arɩ Mosis sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ba ha laalɛ ba gɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ Elieza arɩ Itama “Má pɔ má sɩ́ ma nyusuŋ vɩa ta, a sɩ́ ma gɛnnɩŋ ma kaa kɩɛsɛ arɩ ma tʋɔŋ cheye nɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ma jaŋ sʋʋ, ka dɩ La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nyuŋ. Ama ma dɩa nɩaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala jaŋ wuo yel nɩalɩŋ yoho La TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe nyiniŋ dii kpʋ.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Má pɔ má sɩ́ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ sii, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ma jaŋ sʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ joŋ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ tɩsɛma nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ arɩ Mosis sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ,

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: “Ŋ dɩ ŋ hambolibiisiŋ kʋŋkala pʋpɔ má sɩ́ sɩ-yele koo sɩ-duo kala nyʋa dɩ ma nɩɩ jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ vɩa, ma jaŋ sʋʋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ a pɩ ma doho kala dɩ ma tuto.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma jɩŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa kɩaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa nuhuobiinee kɩaa, a jɩŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ,

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: aŋ dagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wombie-la kala La TƖƖNA sɩ to Mosis lɛ a dagɛma.”

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisi-la balɩa sɩ hɛ ba mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, Elieza arɩ Itama, “Má joŋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ nyɩga pɩ La TƖƖNA kʋkaanaa a kaa wasɛ boroboro a sɩ́ sɩbʋrʋŋ hɛ, a diiba Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa kɩa zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Má diiba Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ dɩ ŋ hambolibiisiŋ toruŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ nyɩga pɩ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ, ŋ-la nɛ La TƖƖNA dagɛmɛ.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nʋʋ-la kala, má kɛŋ hui-la arɩ vaa-la a kaa kɔ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Ama kʋkaanaa jaŋ ŋaa ŋ dɩ ŋ hambolibiisiŋ kpaalɩŋ bʋa na-kala lɛ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Mosis pɩɛsɛ a mʋ na dɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ bʋʋŋ-la kala nɛ ba joŋo nyɩgɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ na baanɩŋ Arɔŋ hambolibiisi-la balɩa sɩ weye nyuŋ, Elieza arɩ Itama aŋ pɩɛsɛ,

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nammɩa-la chaŋa Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ? Ʋ ŋaa kʋzɔŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ tɩɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩ ŋaa chei ta aŋ pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Ma sɩ bɩ pʋna-la chalɩŋ kaa kʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la ŋɩɩ, ʋ fa maga dɩ ma chaŋ nammɩa-la-na nɩmɛ nɛ arɩ mɩ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Arɔŋ bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Jɩnɩŋ nɛ ba ŋaa ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ba kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, saa na wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ fa chaŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nammɩa-la, La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ fa jaŋ tɔrɛɛ?”

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala.

english_verse: any animal that has divided hoofs and chews the cud.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ wuo chaŋ pʋna koo bagɩl na-kala sɩ kɛŋ naachɛŋŋɛɛ aŋ gbu kɩaa chɩchaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: “Má bʋla pɩ Iziral-tɩŋŋaa: ‘Pʋsʋŋ arɩ bagɩla-la kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ, kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ wuo chɩchaŋ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: Ama má sɩ́ fille-la dɔnsʋŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ naasɩŋ banɛsɛ chaŋ, ba kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't even touch the dead bodies of animals that have divided hoofs but don't chew the cud. And don't touch the dead bodies of animals that have paws. If you do, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma kʋŋkala nɛ joŋ ba kʋsʋʋŋ, ʋ maga ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ nɛ, ama ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la kala dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ. Ba ŋaa disiŋ kɩaa nɛ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: dɩdaaŋ-sʋʋŋ, baaŋ, kʋlʋŋgbɛnɛ arɩ kuŋkoluŋ-bawɩɩ. Ba kala kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Kʋnyiere-la kala sɩɩ vɛŋ tinteeŋ, ba tʋɔŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ ma teeŋ nɛ la dagɛ ŋɩɩ. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ digi ba kʋsʋʋŋ, tapʋlɩɩ-la kala ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Dɩ kɩaa deemba kʋŋkala nɛ tel pupoiŋ tʋɔŋ, pupoi-la arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa kala kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ má ŋmoo yɛrɛ.

english_verse: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ka dɩ pupoi-la tʋɔŋ lɩɩŋ digi kʋdiilii na-kala ma sɩ jaŋ wuo dii koo kʋnyʋalɩɩ na-kala ma sɩ jaŋ nyʋa, ba jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Dɩ kɩaa deemba nɛ sʋʋ hɛ pupoiŋ lɛ koo tabʋʋŋ lɛ, má ŋmoo yɛrɛ, ba kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-bulo arɩ vilee lɩɩŋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ bʋa na-kala, dɩ kɩalɩŋ la sɩ daga kʋŋ nɛ sʋʋ hɛ ba lɛ ma. Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ digi kʋsʋʋ-la sɩ tele hɛ, ŋ-na jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Dɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ kʋŋ nɛ sʋʋ hɛ ma kʋdoho lɛ ma, ba bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba nɛ joŋ kʋdoho hɛ lɩɩŋ lɛ, ka dɩ kɩalɩŋ kʋŋ sʋʋ hɛ, ba kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Pʋna koo bagɩl na-kala ma sɩ jaŋ wuo chaŋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ sʋba dɩ ma kʋŋkala digu, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la kala dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ chaŋ nammɩa-la maga ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ nɛ, ama ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ. Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ joŋ kʋsʋʋ-la maga ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ, ama ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ kɩaa deemba kʋŋkala ŋaa dɩ ma kɛŋ disiniŋ. Má sɩ́ ba chaŋ a sɩ́ ba digu.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, má joŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ kɩalɩŋ la sɩ daga ŋaa dɩ ma kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA sɩ kɛmma lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa ma Wɩa, ŋɩɩ wɩaa má sɩ disiniŋ kɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma jɩŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, a jɩŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ma chaŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ maga dɩ ma chaŋ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ‘Dɩ haal nɛ kɛŋ luoruŋ a lʋl hambolibie, tapʋlaa balɩpɛ pɛgɛ ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ yie hɛ tɩŋa a kɛŋ disiniŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Tapʋl-chori chɛɛŋ maga dɩ ba keri bile peniŋ.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ lʋl hantolibie, yɔɔsʋŋ balɩa pɛgɛ ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ hɛ tɩŋa a kɛŋ disiniŋ ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa tapʋlaa mahɩŋ batori arɩ balɩdʋ, ka dɩ chal-la sɩ lɩɩ ʋ lɛ disiŋ-la-na dɛrɛ.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ lʋl hambolibie koo hantolibie, dɩ ba pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta dɛrɛ, haal-la maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ piese sɩ yi jɩna arɩ kokomo a kaa kʋ pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ. Ʋ jaŋ joŋ piesu-la ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ aŋ joŋ kokomo-la ma sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ laa kɩalɩŋ a kaa mʋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta a tɩŋ chalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ ʋ yaraa lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ haal kala sɩ lʋl hambolibie koo hantolibie ŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If she cannot afford a lamb, she can offer two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice to please me and the other as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Dɩ haala nɛ bɩ piese lɛ wuo yi, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ kokosuŋ balɩa kɔ, dɩ ba kpʋ dɔŋɔ a nyɩga pɩ Wɩa, ka dɔŋɔ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ wɩɩ-sʋlʋŋ kʋa. Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ ŋaa wɩaa deemba, ʋ pɩɩsɛ haal-la disiniŋ ta nɛ, ʋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ,

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: “Dɩ nʋʋ lee nɛ ŋmɛrɛ koo a pisimi koo a pʋllɛ sɩ jaŋ wuo kʋ bɩrɩmɛ yaraa nyanyalɩɩ sɩɩ chol, ʋ maga dɩ ba kɛnʋ kaa kɔ Arɔŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara teeŋ koo ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɔŋɔ ma sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ beŋ nɩɩ-la yaraa lee-la nɛ. Dɩ pʋna-la sɩ hɛ lee-la nɛ bɩrɩmɛ kʋpʋllʋŋ ka dɩ lee-la mʋʋra tuu, ŋɩɩ na nyanyalɩɩ-la ŋaa nyanyalɩɩ sɩ jaŋ wuo chol nɛ. Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ na wɩaa deemba, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ heeli arɩ nɩɩ-la kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Dɩ lee-la sɩ ŋmɛrɛ koo a pisimi nɛ pʋlla, ka dɩ lee-la bɩ mʋʋra tuu, dɩ pʋna-la ma sɩ hɛ lee-la bɩ pʋlla, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ pɔ dɩ tɩɩna sɩ́ nɩaa tʋɔŋ guolu tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: If the disease hasn't spread by that time, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ bɩra benu tapʋl-pɛɩ-la chɛɛŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ na dɩ lee-la ha bɩ bɩrɩma koo a kiere pɛ, ʋ ha maga dɩ pɔ ʋ sɩ́ nɩaa tʋɔŋ guolu tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: Then if the disease hasn't become any worse or spread, the priest will say, “You are clean. It is only a sore. After you wash your clothes, you may go home.”
translation_verse: Dɩ tapʋl-pɛɩ-la nɛ bɩra kʋ yi, ʋ maga dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara bɩra benu. Dɩ lee-la sɩ ŋmɛrɛ koo a pisimi nɛ fʋɔra, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ heeli arɩ tɩɩna bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ʋ lee-la ta pisimi nɛ. Tɩɩna maga dɩ ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ nɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ bɩra benu nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ na dɩ lee-la sɩ pisime nɛ sɛnɛ kiere pɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ heeli arɩ tɩɩna kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, nyanyalɩɩ-la ŋaa nyanyal-cholii nɛ.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: Dɩ nyanyal-cholii nɛ hɛ nʋʋ lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kɛnʋ mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ benu, dɩ ʋ nɛ na tɩɩna yaraa lee ŋmɛrɛ aŋ pʋllɛ a mirisi, ka dɩ pʋna-la sɩ hɛ lee-la ma pʋllɛ,

english_verse: But if the disease has run its course and only the scars remain, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara na dɩ ʋ yaraa kala pʋlla, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ heeli arɩ ʋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ na ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ heeli arɩ tɩɩna kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ nyanyalɩɩ sɩɩ chol nɛ.

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ benu, dɩ ʋ nɛ na dɩ naawɩɩla-la sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ bɩrɩma a pʋllɛ, ʋ jaŋ heeli arɩ ʋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: ka dɩ lee-la jɩgɛ a fɩɛsɛ koo a pʋllɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa mʋ dagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ benu. Dɩ ʋ nɛ na dɩ lee-la nɛ mʋʋra tuu ka dɩ pʋna-la sɩ hɛ lee-la pʋllɛ, ʋ maga dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara heeli arɩ tɩɩna kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, mɔpʋla-la ka chol nɛ.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ beŋ lee-la dɩ ʋ pʋnaa bɩ pʋlla, ka lee-la ma bɩ mʋʋra tuu aŋ nagɛ dɩ ʋ fʋɔra, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ pɔ tɩɩna sɩ́ nɩaa tʋɔŋ guolu tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: Dɩ jɩgɩ-la nɛ kiere pɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ heeli arɩ tɩɩna kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Nyanyalɩɩ-la ŋaa nyanyal-cholii nɛ.

english_verse: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Dɩ jɩgɩ-la nɛ bɩ jalla pɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ heeli arɩ tɩɩna bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ʋ ta ŋaa fʋfʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ yaraa nɛ folo dɩ lee-la sɩ folo pʋllɛ koo a fɩɛsɛ,

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ beŋ lee-la sɩ folo. Dɩ ʋ nɛ na dɩ lee-la mʋʋra tuu, ka pʋna-la sɩ hɛ lee-la pʋllɛ, nyanyal-cholii nɛ suomi dɩ-folii-la lɛ a kʋkɔ ŋɩɩ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ heeli arɩ tɩɩna kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ na dɩ pʋna-la sɩ hɛ lee-la nɛ bɩ pʋlla, dɩ lee-la ma bɩ mʋʋra tuu aŋ fʋɔrɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩsʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ bɩra beŋ tɩɩna nɛ tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ dɩ ʋ nɛ na lee-la dɩ ʋ kiere pɛ. Ʋ maga ʋ heeli arɩ tɩɩna kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, nyanyal-cholii nɛ kɛnʋ.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ lee-la nɛ bɩ kiere pɛ aŋ fɩɛlɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ heeli arɩ tɩɩna bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Lee-la ta ŋaa fʋfʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: Dɩ baal koo haal nɛ kɛŋ naawɩɩlɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ koo ʋ talaŋa lɛ,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ beŋ naawɩɩl-la, dɩ ʋ nɛ na lee-la dɩ ʋ mʋʋra tuu, ka dɩ pʋna-la ma sɩ hɛ lee-la gɩl, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ heeli arɩ tɩɩna kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Naawɩɩ-la ŋaa dʋdɔɔ nɛ, ʋʋ chol nɛ.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ na naawɩɩl-la bɩ mʋʋra tuu, dɩ lee-la pʋnaa ma bɩ bɩrɩma, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩsʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: Tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ bɩra beŋ naawɩɩl-la nɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ na dɩ ʋ bɩ kiere pɛ a bɩ mʋʋra tuu, ka dɩ pʋna-la ma sɩ hɛ lee-la bɩ gɩla,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: ʋ maga dɩ tɩɩna fʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ koo ʋ tɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ leŋ naawɩɩl-la leriŋ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ lɩɩsʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread and seems no more than skin deep, he will say, “You are clean; now you must wash your clothes.”
translation_verse: Tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ bɩra benu nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ na dɩ naawɩɩl-la bɩ kiere pɛ, lee-la ma bɩ mʋʋra tuu, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ heeli arɩ tɩɩna bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Tɩɩna maga ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, “You are unclean.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ bɩra benu nɛ, dɩ naawɩɩl-la nɛ kiere, ʋ bɩ maga ʋ bee chɩchɛ pʋŋ-gɩlaa, ʋ maga ʋ jɩŋ arɩ tɩɩna kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But if he thinks you are completely well, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: Ama Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ na dɩ lee-la bɩ bɩrɩma ka pʋŋ-bisiŋ nyʋ lee-la, naawɩɩl-la fɩɛla nɛ, ʋ maga ʋ heeli arɩ tɩɩna bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: Dɩ baal koo haal yaraa nɛ lagɩsɛ kʋpʋllʋŋ,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ beŋ tɩɩna lere-la sɩ lagɩsa nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ na dɩ-lagɩsɩa-la bɩ chaasa pʋllɛ, ʋ maga ʋ heeli arɩ tɩɩna bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, kɩalɩŋ ta lagɩsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nyuŋ kala nɛ bɩ puoro, ka ʋ tile dʋndʋŋa nɛ puori, ʋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ benu nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ na naawɩɩl-la sɩ hɛ ʋ nyuŋ koo ʋ tile lɛ nɛ fɩɛsa a pʋllɛ a nagɛ nyanyal-cholii,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ nyanyal-cholii-la maga ʋ laalɛ gɛrɩ-kɔsʋmɔɔ nɛ a sɩ́ ʋ nyuŋ chaasʋ aŋ kɛŋ kʋa tɔ ʋ niiŋ, aŋ bʋbʋl: ‘Mɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ! Mɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ!’

english_verse: and if the mildew has spread in that time, he will say, “This is unclean
translation_verse: Tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ ʋ bɩra maga ʋ beŋ kʋ-la nɛ. Dɩ kʋl-na-la nɛ pʋŋaa pɛ gɛrɩ-la lɛ koo teŋ-la lɛ koo gɛrɩ-sʋalɩɩ-la lɛ, kʋl-na-la ŋaa kʋl-bɔŋ nɛ. Kʋ-la kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: because the mildew has spread.” Then he will burn the clothing or the piece of leather.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ nyɩgɛ gɛrɩ-la koo kʋla na-kala lɛ kʋl-na-la sɩ hɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa kʋl-na-la ŋaa kʋl-bɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: ʋ maga ʋ leŋ dɩ ba chɛsɛ kʋ-la nɛ, dɩ ʋ joŋo bil tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: after which he will examine it again. If the spot hasn't spread, but is still greenish or reddish, the clothing or leather is unclean and must be burned.
translation_verse: Tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ bɩra beŋ kʋ-la nɛ. Dɩ kʋl-na-la nɛ bɩ bɩrɩma a bɩ pʋŋaa pɛ ma, ʋ ha kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Dɩ kʋl-na-la hɛ ʋ sɩɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ, koo sɩɩ-bɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, ʋ maga ʋ joŋo nyɩgɛ.

english_verse: But if the spot has faded after being washed, he will tear away the spot.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ bɩra bene dɩ dɩ-kʋlɩɩ-la nɩɩ lɛl gɛrɩ-la lɛ koo teŋ-la lɛ koo gɛrɩ-sʋalɩɩ-la lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɩɛsɛ lee-la fa sɩ kʋla ta nɛ.

english_verse: Later, if the spot reappears elsewhere on the clothing or the leather, you must burn it.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ kɩɛsɛ lee-la ta, ka dɩ kʋ-la bɩra kʋl, ʋ maga ba joŋo nyɩgɛ.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ chɛsɛ gɛrɩ-la koo teŋ-la koo gɛrɩ-sʋalɩɩ-la, dɩ kʋl-na-la lɛl, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ bɩra chɛsɛ nɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ kʋla bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: These are the rules for deciding if clothing is clean or unclean after a spot appears on it.
translation_verse: Wombie-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a mʋʋ tɩgɛ gɛnnɩŋ koo tenniŋ sɩ kʋla lɛ aa dagɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ duoro kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ tɩŋŋaa balɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ a pɛ kuolu daaŋ lɛ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ-fɩaŋ a chɔl kaku-dɩgɩlɩŋ pɛ.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ leŋ dɩ ba ŋaa lɩɩŋ sɩɩ bul a hɛ pupoiŋ lɛ a kɛŋ zaara-la dɔŋɔ chugili lɩɩ-la lɛ a kpʋ.

english_verse: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.
translation_verse: Ka dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara joŋ zaarʋ-la sɩ ka a pɛ kuolu daa-la arɩ gɛrɩpɛ-fɩaŋ arɩ kaku-dɩgɩl-la lɛ a kɛŋ ba kala yʋ chal-la arɩ lɩɩ-la.

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsa mɩsa hɛ nɩɩ-la disiniŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ pɩɩsa ta lɛ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ aŋ heeli arɩ ʋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, aŋ joŋ zaarʋ-la dɔŋɔ ʋ sɩ bɩ kpʋa a kaa lɩɩ ta pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la disiniŋ ʋ sɩ pɩɩsa ta maga dɩ ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ a fʋŋ ʋ pʋnaa kala aŋ fo lɩɩŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ʋ jaŋ kʋ jʋʋ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ, ama ʋ bɩ maga ʋ jʋʋ ʋ dɩa a kaa mʋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Tapʋl-pɛɩ-la ʋ bɩra maga ʋ fʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ, ʋ tɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ sɩɩ-pʋnaa arɩ ʋ yaraa pʋnaa kala. Ʋ maga ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ a fo lɩɩŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring
translation_verse: Tapʋl-chori chɛɛŋ ʋ maga ʋ kɛŋ pie-bel-pɔrɔɔ balɩa arɩ pie-keeŋ sɩ yi jɩna, dɩ ba kʋŋkala sɩ nyɔɔ kɛŋ, a pɛ munuŋ gbaŋa arɩ mʋa ba sɩ kɛŋ nʋʋŋ buu arɩ nʋʋŋ loŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, dɩ ba kaa ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ kɛŋ nɩɩ-la arɩ kɩalɩŋ a kaa mʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ pie-bel-pɔrʋ-la dɔŋɔ arɩ nʋʋŋ loŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a sʋl cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a kaa je aa zaarɛ. Ŋɩɩ ŋaa ʋ tɩtɩa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ ʋ kaa je mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kpʋ pie-bel-pɔrʋ-la lee-la ba sɩ vɛnɛɛ kpʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ arɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ. Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara kʋŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋa ma ŋaa ʋ kʋŋ. Ʋ ŋaa kʋŋ zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ tagɛ cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna-la chalɩŋ a lagɛ nɩɩ-la disiniŋ ʋ sɩ pɩɩsa ta nadiiŋ dɩgɩlɩŋ-pɩpaaŋ arɩ ʋ nadiiŋ nenii-baalɩŋ arɩ ʋ nadiiŋ naanii-baalɩŋ.

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ nʋʋ-la a wansa hɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nagʋa nachala lɛ,

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: a kɛŋ ʋ nadiiŋ wɩa neniiŋ tagɛ nʋʋ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ nachala lɛ a kaa mɩsɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ.

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nadiiŋ wɩa-neniiŋ a tagɛ nʋʋ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ nachala lɛ a lagɛ nɩɩ-la disiniŋ ʋ sɩ pɩɩsaa ta nadiiŋ dɩgɩlɩŋ-pɩpaaŋ, a lagɛ ʋ nadiiŋ nenii-baalɩŋ arɩ ʋ nadiiŋ naanii-baalɩŋ a daŋ cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna chal-la lɛ.

english_verse: and he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then he will offer the other two animals—one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ, a pɛ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ a pɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la disiniŋ ta. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, tɩɩna bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ kokosuŋ balɩa ma kɔ a joŋ dɔŋɔ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ aŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ ma ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ wansɛ nʋʋ-la dɔnsʋŋ hɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nagʋa nachala lɛ,

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: a kɛŋ ʋ nadiiŋ wɩa-neniiŋ tagɛ nʋʋ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ nachala lɛ a mɩsɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ.

english_verse: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ tagɛ nʋʋ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ nachala lɛ a lagɛ nɩɩ-la disiniŋ ʋ sɩ pɩɩsa tɩta lere-la tɩtɩa ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ tagɛ cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna chalɩŋ lagɛ.

english_verse: And he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then, depending on what you can afford, he will offer either the doves or the pigeons together with the grain sacrifice. One of the birds is the sacrifice for sin, and the other is the sacrifice to please me. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: dɩ dɔŋɔ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋa, ka dɔŋɔ ma ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋa, a pɛ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ. Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, ʋ pɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la disiniŋ ta nɛ.”

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you have leprosy and cannot afford the usual sacrifices to make you clean. When There Is Mildew in a House
translation_verse: Wombie-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a mʋʋ tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ nyanyal-choloo aŋ duori aŋ bɩ kɩalɩŋ kɛnɛ ba sɩ maga dɩ ba kaa mʋ dɩ ba pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ pɩɩsɛ kʋa sɩ kʋla disiniŋ ta

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ,

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: “Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ, lee-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩma, dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ, dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ nʋʋ dɩa nyʋ-bumbugo tintee-la lɛ,

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ dɩa-la maga dɩ ʋ mʋ bʋla pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara arɩ dɩa-la naga ʋʋ nyʋ nɛ.

english_verse: The priest will reply, “Empty the house before I inspect it, or else everything in it will be unclean.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ba mʋ paa dɩa-la tʋɔŋ kɩaa kala kʋ lɩɩ, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ magɩla bʋl dɩa-la tʋɔŋ kɩaa ma kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, ka dɩ ʋ-na jʋʋ a beŋ dɩa-la.

english_verse: If the priest discovers greenish or reddish spots that go deeper than the surface of the walls,
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ jʋʋ dɩa-la, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ beŋ dɩa-la jeeŋ nɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ na dɩ jee-la nyʋa a nagɛ jɔgɩlɩɩŋ koo a fɩɛsɛ aŋ dii jʋjʋʋ,

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: ʋ jaŋ lɩɩ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ aŋ kɛŋ boiŋ tɔ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread.
translation_verse: Tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ bɩra mʋ suri dɩa-la, a na dɩ jee-la nyʋ pɛ nɛɛ.

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: a leŋ dɩ ba paasɛ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ kala a golli, a kɛŋ hagɩla-la lɩɩ ba taŋ lɛ, lee sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.
translation_verse: Lere-la tabɩaa sɩ nyʋa ba chaara ta, ba jaŋ tʋɔsɛ tabɩɩ-falaa a kaa mʋ hɛ lere-la a wasa taarɛ dɩa-la kala.

english_verse: the priest will come and say, “This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ jʋʋ a beŋ dɩa-la nyʋna-la, dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa nyʋ bɔŋ, dɩa-la kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba ŋmoo dɩa-la lo, a chaarɛ ʋ tiebiee, ʋ daasɩŋ a paa ʋ tɩarɩŋ a kaa lɩɩ ta taŋ-la harɩŋ, lee-la sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa balɩpɛ-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara sɩ kɛŋ dɩa-la tɔ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ jʋʋ dɩa-la, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la kala dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ pɩŋ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ koo dɩ ʋ nɛ dii kɩaa dɩa-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ taarɛ dɩa-la ŋɩɩ, dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ na dɩ dɩa-la bɩra bɩ nyʋa, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ heeli arɩ dɩa-la bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, nyʋna-la lɛlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Then, to show that the house is now clean, he will get two birds, a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant and bring them to the house.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ pɩɩsɛ dɩa-la disiniŋ ta, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ tɩŋŋaa balɩa arɩ kuolu-daaŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ-fɩaŋ arɩ kaku-dɩgɩlɩŋ a kaa pɩɩsɛ dɩa-la disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa lɩɩŋ sɩɩ bul a hɛ pupoiŋ tʋɔŋ aŋ kɛŋ zaara-la dɔŋɔ chugili lɩɩ-la lɛ a kpʋ.

english_verse: Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ zaarʋ-la dɔŋɔ ʋ sɩ bɩ kpʋa lɩɩ ta pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ pɩɩsɛ dɩa-la disiniŋ ta nɛ, ʋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.
translation_verse: dɩ ba wuo jɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ kʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Wombie-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a mʋʋ tɩgɛ nyanyal-choloo arɩ dɩa sɩ nyʋ-bumbugo lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Any man with an infected penis is unclean,
translation_verse: “Má bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: ‘Dɩ lɩɩŋ nɩɩ lɩɩ baal na-kala faagaa lɛ, lɩɩ-la kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: and if you touch either these or him, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ digi nɩɩ-la lɩɩŋ sɩɩ lɩɩ ʋ faagaa lɛ, ʋ maga ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ a fo lɩɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: If you are spit on by the man, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩɩ-la faagaa lɛ lɩɩŋ sɩɩ lɩɩ nɛ tʋ nantʋɔrʋŋ hɛ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ, tɩɩna jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ fo lɩɩŋ a chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: Any saddle or seat on which the man sits is unclean. And if you touch or carry either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ digi kɩalɩŋ nyuŋ ʋ sɩ hɔnɔ, tɩɩna jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ. Dɩ nʋʋ ma nɛ paa kɩalɩŋ, ʋ maga ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ a fo lɩɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: If the man touches you without first washing his hands, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩɩ-la faagaa lɛ lɩɩŋ sɩɩ lɩɩ nɛ bɩ ʋ nɩsɩŋ sɔmɔ aŋ digi nʋʋ, tɩɩna maga ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ a fo lɩɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: Any clay pot that he touches must be destroyed, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.
translation_verse: Pupoi na-kala nɩɩ-la faagaa lɛ lɩɩŋ sɩɩ lɩɩ sɩ dige, ʋ maga dɩ ba ŋmoo yɛrɛ nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa daaŋ nɛ ba kaa ŋaa kʋ-la, ʋ maga dɩ ba tiisu.

english_verse: Seven days after the man gets well, he will be considered clean, if he washes his clothes and takes a bath in spring water.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩɩ-la faagaa lɛ lɩɩŋ sɩɩ lɩɩ nɛ duoro, ʋ maga ʋ gbɛrɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ a chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ aŋ ŋaa lɩɩ-bulo lɩɩŋ fo. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: On the eighth day he must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Tapʋl-chori chɛɛŋ ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ kokosuŋ balɩa mʋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ a joŋo pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ laa a joŋ dɔŋɔ a sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ aŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ ma sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ŋ-la nɛ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa a pɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la faagaa lɛ lɩɩŋ sɩɩ lɩɩ disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: Any man who has a flow of semen must take a bath, but he still remains unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal nɛ fɩɩ bafɩɩrɩŋ, ʋ maga ʋ chaasa fo lɩɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɩ bafɩɩrɩ-la nɛ digi gɛrɩŋ koo teniŋ, ʋ maga ba joŋo chɛsɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: After having sex, both the man and the woman must take a bath, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal arɩ haal nɛ pɛ bɔsɔ aŋ sii, ʋ maga dɩ ba fo lɩɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ba ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɩ haala nɛ hɛ tɩŋa, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ digu, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ digi kʋŋ na-kala nyuŋ ʋ sɩ hɔnɔ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ nɛ a fo lɩɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal nɛ kɛŋ haal-la sɩ hɛ tɩŋa pɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Bɔsɔ na-kala lɛ baal-la sɩ pɩna jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: Any woman who has a flow of blood outside her regular monthly period is unclean until it stops, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: Dɩ haal nɛ hɛ tɩŋa dɩ ʋ kieli bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ dɛrɛ, koo dɩ ʋ hɛ tɩŋa bʋa-la lɛ sɩ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ hɛ, ʋ ha kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ pɩŋ bɔsɔ kala lɛ, bɔsɔ-la kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ hɔŋ kʋŋ ma kala lɛ, kʋ-la ma jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala saa sɩ digi kɩaa deemba, ʋ tɩɩna ma kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ nɛ a fo lɩɩŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ tɩŋa-la nɛ dɛrɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ dɩɩsɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ nɛ, ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ʋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Tapʋl-chori chɛɛŋ haal-la maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ kokosuŋ balɩa kaa mʋ pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ a sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a joŋ dɔŋɔ ma sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ŋ-la nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a pɩɩsɛ haal-la disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ chagɩlɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa kɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ disiniŋ lɛ, dɩ ba sɩ́ disiniŋ ŋaa hɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ ma teeŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ba sɩ́ sʋʋ.’ ”

english_verse: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ ŋ naambie Arɔŋ, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a hɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ jʋʋ, lee-la Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la sɩ chɩna, bʋa na-kala lɛ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ vɩa aŋ jʋʋ, ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ yie to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ lɛ a kʋ tuu daga-la nii-tɔlɔ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Dɩ Arɔŋ nɩɩ chɛ ʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a hɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ, bʋa-la sɩ maga, see dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ arɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pie-bele a kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ joŋ ʋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ gɛrɩ-duduoŋ-la a laalɛ, a joŋ ʋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ kpʋŋ-kpeli kuuŋ a vɔɔ, a joŋ gɛrɩ-la gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie a vɔɔ, a joŋ nyu-bɛlɛ bɛ. Gɛnnɩŋ deemba ŋaa Wɩa kɩaa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ maga dɩ ʋ fo lɩɩŋ aŋ-na laalɛba.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ jaŋ kɛŋ nɛ-bele a sʋl ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛsɛ gbuŋgbogusu-la balɩa a kaa kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tɔnsɔ lɩɩsɛ gbuŋgbogusu-la tʋɔŋ kʋ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA arɩ kʋ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo ta.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Dɩ Arɔŋ nɛ kʋ jɩŋ gbuŋgbogo-la sɩ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋa, ʋ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Bʋʋŋ-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ joŋo ta, ʋ jaŋ kɛnʋ mʋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ aŋ joŋo ta dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ mʋ.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ jaŋ kɛŋ nɛ-bele a sʋl ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, aŋ kpʋ.

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ mʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a joŋ kʋ-la lɛ ba sɩɩ hɛ nyiniŋ a chaanɛ nyiŋ-halaa su a ŋaa kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma ba sɩ nɔmɔ ba bii, nɩsɩŋ sɩɩŋ bʋlɩa, a kaa jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a hɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ.

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ joŋ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋ-la sʋɔra sɩ sɩma hɛ nyiŋ-la lɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ dɩ ba nyʋɔsʋŋ sii tɔ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la arɩ ʋ nii-tɔlɔ, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la nii-tɔlɔ na a sʋʋ.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa nɛ-bele-la chalɩŋ a kɛŋ ʋ neniiŋ tagɛ a mɩsɛ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la nii-tɔlɔ aŋ bɩra tagɛ a mɩsɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ʋ jaŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ bʋʋna a ŋaa ʋ chalɩŋ kaa jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a hɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ a ŋaa mɩsɛ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la nii-tɔlɔ nyuŋ aŋ ŋaa mɩsɛ daga-la sɩpaaŋ ma arɩ ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kɛŋ nɛ-bele-la chalɩŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ pɩɩsɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ disiniŋ ta nɛ, disiŋ-la arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa hɛ lee-la. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ ma lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ma kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la teeŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a pɩɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la ma disiniŋ ta. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa nɛ-bele-la arɩ bʋʋŋ-la chalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ a taa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyilliŋ.

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Dɩ Arɔŋ nɛ pɩɩsɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ disiniŋ ta dɛrɛ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a hɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ arɩ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ arɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ bʋ-wei-la kaa kɔ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ,

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: a joŋ ʋ nɩsaa daŋ bʋ-wei-la nyuŋ lɛ, aŋ bʋl wʋbɔmɔ-la, arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ vɩa Wɩa niiŋ aŋ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la kala a hɛ bʋʋŋ-la lɛ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ kiri bʋʋŋ-la kaa mʋ ta tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala jaŋ hɛ bʋʋŋ-la lɛ dɩ nɩɩ-la kire mʋ ta lee nʋʋkala sɩ tuo.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ fo lɩɩŋ lee sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, aŋ paa ʋ gɛnnɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ laalɛ, aŋ kʋ lɩɩ a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ nɩalɩŋ disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna-la nʋʋŋ a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kiri bʋʋŋ-la kaa lɩɩ ta maga ʋ ma fo lɩɩŋ nɛ a chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ aŋ-na kʋ jʋʋ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ nyɩgɛ kɩaa deemba maga dɩ ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ a fo lɩɩŋ aŋ-na mɩɩra jʋʋ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ ma sɩ jaŋ tuto a kaa mʋ wuu: Jɩna na-kala chɛŋ pɛɩ lɛ tapʋlaa fii chɛɛŋ, Iziral tɩɩna koo nʋhʋɔrʋ kala sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ maga dɩ ʋ vɔɔ niiŋ a sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ,

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa tapʋlʋŋ deeŋ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta dɩ ma sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa chɛ-wiesii nɛ dɩ ma vɔɔ niiŋ a sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ ma sɩ jaŋ tuto a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala lɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ nɛ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ laalɛ gɛnnɩ-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩɩ laalʋ nɛ,

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: a ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala a pɩɩsɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ disiniŋ ta, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a hɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ arɩ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la, a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ ma sɩ jaŋ tuto a kaa mʋ wuu: Jɩna tʋɔŋ ʋ maga dɩ ba pɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta bala.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala: ‘Wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dagɛ:

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: aŋ bɩ kaa mʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ, má joŋ tɩɩna arɩ ʋ jaasɛ chalɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ jaasɛ chal-la ŋɩɩ, má keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ pʋna-la chalɩŋ a mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɩ chɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ aŋ joŋ pʋna-la nʋʋŋ nyɩgɛ, ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Remember! No one in Israel, including foreigners, is to offer a sacrifice anywhere
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba, ‘Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna koo dɩ nʋhʋɔrʋ nɛ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koo Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ dɔŋ,

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: aŋ bɩ kaa mʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ maga dɩ ba keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna koo nʋhʋɔrʋ sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ dii chalɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ vɩa nɩɩ-la a keru ta mɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own.
translation_verse: Kʋŋ na-kala sɩ weye mɩɩsɩŋ hɛ ʋ chalɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ nɛ mɩ joŋo pɩma dɩ ma kaa pɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tɩta Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ, chalɩŋ nɛ yie pɩɩsɛ nʋʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta ka ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: That's also why I have forbidden you to eat blood.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ bʋlaa pɩ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ nʋhʋɔra-la kala sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, má sɩ́ chalɩŋ dii.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna koo nʋhʋɔrʋ kala sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ mʋ nambagɩlɩŋ a kpʋ bagɩl koo diibie kala ma sɩɩ chaŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma keri ʋ chalɩŋ hugi,

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa kʋŋkala sɩ weye mɩɩsɩŋ hɛ ʋ chalɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ sɩ má sɩ́ kʋŋkala chalɩŋ dii ŋɩɩ. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ die, ʋ maga ma keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma kʋŋkala koo nʋhʋɔrʋ nɛ dii kʋŋ sɩ sʋʋ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ koo dɩ baga kʋŋ nɛ kpʋa, tɩɩna maga dɩ ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ a fo lɩɩŋ. Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ. Dɩ wɩa nɛ jʋa, ʋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ chɛsɛ a fo lɩɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala: ‘Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.
translation_verse: Má pɔ má sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ ŋaa to, lee-la ma fa sɩ hɛ, arɩ wɩalɩŋ Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ ŋaa lee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ kɛmma mʋ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Má to mɩ wombiee a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma, mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Don't have sex with any of your close relatives,
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ naambie pɩŋ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: especially your own mother. This would disgrace your father.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ nyɩmma hɩɩsʋ a kɛŋ ŋ naaŋ pɩŋ. Ŋ naaŋ nɛ, sɩ́ ʋ kaa pɩŋ.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ŋ nyɩmma hɩɩsʋ a kɛŋ ŋ naaŋ hadɔŋɔ pɩŋ.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your sister or stepsister, whether you grew up together or not.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ dɩhaala kaa pɩŋ, ŋ nyɩmma tolo koo ŋ naaŋ tolo, dɩ ba lʋl ma kala dɩ-bala nɛ koo dɩ ba lʋlʋ lee dɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't disgrace yourself by having sex with your granddaughter
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ nihiŋ kaa pɩŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ naaŋ ŋaana kaa pɩŋ, ŋ naaŋ kʋbie nɛ.

english_verse: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ nyɩmma kʋbie hɩɩsɩŋ hɛ a kɛŋ ʋ haala pɩŋ, ŋ naaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your daughter-in-law
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ nanʋala haala kaa pɩŋ, ŋ bii-haala nɛ.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ haala arɩ ʋ tolo kala kaa pɩŋ koo haal-la nihee. Ma pɛ chalɩŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ haala nɛ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ jaa ʋ ŋaana dɩ ba ŋaa hadɔsɛ.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: Dɩ haala nɛ hɛ tɩŋa, pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ʋ kaa pɩŋ, ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ nʋʋ haal kaa pɩŋ a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Má pʋpɔ ma sɩ́ ma bii kaa pa dɩ ba kaa kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk, a hɛ ma Wɩa hɩɩsɩŋ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ ba-dɔŋɔ kaa pɩŋ, arɩ nɩa sɩ yie kɛŋ haala pɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋʋ kɩsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: Má pʋpɔ ma sɩ́ wɩaa deemba kʋŋ ŋaa a kɛŋ disiniŋ. Lee-la ma sɩɩ mʋ wɩaa deemba nɛ baa ŋaa, mɩɩ chɛ mɩ kiriba ta tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ nɛ ba ŋaa tintee-la kala kɛŋ disiniŋ, mɩ dɔgɩsɛba a kiriba ta tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ ŋaa disiŋ wɩaa deemba nɛ a chei tintee-la kala.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa disiŋ wɩaa deemba tintee-la lɛ, mɩ jaŋ kirima ta arɩ mɩ sɩ kiri nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ ta ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Má ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma, aŋ sɩ́ disiŋ wɩalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ a ŋɩŋaa to a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ma tɩtɩa lɛ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala: ‘Má sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna Wɩa bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ mɩ vɩa aŋ kpʋkpaarɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ koo a kɛŋ hɔɔŋ libi vesiŋ a pɩ ma tɩtɩa. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma ŋaa nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, má to wombie-la mɩ sɩ daga dɩ mɩ laa ma sʋla.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Má chaŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nammɩa-la tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa ma sɩ ŋaa koo chɛ-lɩa chɛɛŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ka tapʋl-tori chɛɛŋ, má joŋo nyɩga ta.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ chaŋ nammɩa-la tapʋl-tori chɛɛŋ, ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA bɩ sɛɩ.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ chaŋa, ʋ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ kʋ-la sɩ zɔmɔ Wɩa teeŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ maga ma keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ma bagɩsɩŋ kɩaa, má sɩ́ sɛŋ-keree kɩaa ŋaa, ma bɩra sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ a kuuni ma.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Má bɩra sɩ́ ma girep nɛnɛɛ mɩɩra mʋ tɔrɛ a sɩ́ nɛnɛ-la ma sɩ tele paa, má lemba pɩ summo arɩ nʋhʋɔraa dɩ ba mʋ kuuni. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ gaa. Má sɩ́ wɩaa nyɩa. Má sɩ́ dɔŋɔba ma nyɩsʋ.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ wɩaa nyɩa aŋ ŋmɩɛsɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ a chei mɩ yɩrɩŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ dɔŋɔba gɩrɩmʋ koo a kɛŋ dɔŋɔba kɩaa lɩlaa. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ tɩma pɩŋ ka ŋ timu, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ moribiiŋ chʋa ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Má fá mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a sɩ́ taŋɩŋ tʋʋsʋ koo a joŋ kʋa bil nyʋlɩma sɩpaaŋ dɩ ʋ gɛrɛ tel.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ gɔllɔ chichei ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa yɩrɩŋ. Má sɩ́ ma naambiiriŋ joŋo hɛ wɩaa lɛ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ŋ naambie bɛrʋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ pʋ, dɩ ŋ sɩ́ pɛ laa cheeriŋ.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ tʋɔŋ kɛŋ arɩ ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna aa chɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wɩaa tiŋ chɩŋŋaa, ama cho ŋ dɔŋɔ arɩ ŋ sɩ cho ŋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga tɩtɩŋ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ pʋŋ-wogusuŋ jɩjɩl dɔŋɔ. Má sɩ́ kʋdo wogusuŋ balɩa joŋo duu bagɩ-bala lɛ. Má sɩ́ gɛrɩpɛ wogusuŋ balɩa ba sɩ kaa yɛrɛ gɛrɩŋ laalʋ.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: Dɩ yoŋ-haal nɛ ha bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa time laa koo nɩɩ-la sɩ yɔbʋʋ ha bɩ ʋ joŋo ta, ka dɩ baal bilu a bɩ ʋ naasɩŋ to ka dɩ ba-wogo kɛŋ haal-la pɩŋ, ba maga dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛ haal-la arɩ baal-la sɩ kɛnʋ pɩŋ nɛ. Ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba kpʋba.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pie-bele-la a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la wʋbɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa ta mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛʋ.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ Kɛnaŋ tintee-la a chɔnsɛ tɩɩsɩ-la nɛnɛɛ ma sɩɩ dii, dɩ ba nɛ kʋ nɛŋ, má kɩkɩsɛba jɩsɩŋ batori.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Jɩ-nɛsɛ lɛ, má joŋ tɩɩnɛnɛ-la kala hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ a zilmi.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Ama jɩ-nɔŋ lɛ, ma jaŋ wuo didii tɩɩnɛnɛ-la. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ jaŋ wasɛ woruŋ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ nammɩa ha sɩ kɛŋ chalɩŋ chaŋ. Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ vʋgʋ, a sɩ́ chichiribi wɩaa ma ŋaa.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sʋba, ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ ŋɩɩ wɩaa tɩŋ a kpɛrɛ ma tɩtɩa. Má sɩ́ kɩaa tuuro hɛ ma yaraa lɛ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: Má pʋpɔ ma toloo sɩ́ berimu a ŋɩŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, tintee-la kala jaŋ su arɩ hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Má to mɩ chɛ-wiesii-la woruŋ aŋ zizil lee-la ma sɩ kʋʋ zilmi. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ vʋgʋ, a sɩ́ kantɔŋ dɩɩsɩŋ ma jʋʋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ disiniŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Má fá ma Wɩa a leŋ dɩ ma sɩɩŋ susu nɩhɩasɩŋ a zizilba. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋhʋɔrʋ nɛ hɔŋ ma tinteeŋ lɛ, má pʋpɔ má sɩ́ ʋ walɩmʋ.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nʋhʋɔra-la sɩ hɛ ma tinteeŋ lɛ, má kɛmba woruŋ arɩ ma naambiiriŋ. Má choba arɩ ma sɩ cho ma tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ. Ma ma fa ŋaa nʋhʋɔra nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kaa magɩsɛ kɩaa a magɩsɛ kɩaa woruŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ ma lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and I command you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Má to mɩ niiŋ arɩ wombie-la kala mɩ sɩ daga. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, dɩ ba kʋŋ koo nʋhʋɔra-la sɩ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ kʋŋ nɛ joŋ ʋ bie pa dɩ ba kaa kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala maga dɩ ba yagɛ tɩɩna kpʋ arɩ tabɩaa.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: ‘Mɩ jaŋ vɩa tɩɩna a keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ joŋ ʋ bie pa ba kaa kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk wɩaa. Ʋ ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ mɩ-na Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ nɛ a chei mɩ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la.
