english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: mɩ-na tɩtɩa jaŋ joŋ mɩ sɩaa a chaasɛ nɩɩ-la arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa, a keriba ta ba nɩaa tʋɔŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ vɩa mɩ niiŋ aŋ to ba harɩŋ kpʋkpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ sɩaa chaasɛ nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ jʋʋ vʋgʋrʋ-dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ kantɔŋ-dɩɩsɩŋ a keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Má joŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Má to mɩ niiŋ arɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ dagɛma. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ leŋe ma ŋaa nɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bʋl wʋbɔŋ hɛ ʋ nyɩmma koo ʋ naaŋ lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɛ, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ʋ sʋʋŋ.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kɛŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ haala pɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋ baal-la arɩ haal-la kala nɛ.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ ʋ nyɩmma haala pɩŋ, ʋ hɩɩsɛ ʋ nyɩmma nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ má kpʋ baal-la arɩ haal-la kala. Ba tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ba sʋʋŋ.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal nɛ kɛŋ ʋ bii-haala pɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ má kpʋ baal-la arɩ haal-la kala, wʋberige nɛ ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ba sʋʋŋ.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal nɛ kɛŋ ʋ ba-dɔŋɔ pɩŋ arɩ ba sɩɩ pɩŋ haala ŋɩɩ, ba ŋaa wɩɩ sɩɩ kɩsʋ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ma kpʋba nɛ. Ba tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ba sʋʋŋ.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ jaa haal arɩ ʋ tolo kala, ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ maga má nyɩgɛ ba kala batori a giri wʋbɔŋ-la ta ba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Dɩ haal ma nɛ leŋe dɩ pʋna kɛnʋ pɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ má kpʋ haal-la arɩ pʋna-la kala, ba tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ba sʋʋŋ.

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal nɛ jaa ʋ dɩhaala, ʋ nyɩmma tolo koo ʋ naaŋ tolo a kɛnʋ pɩŋ, ʋ ŋaa hɩɩsɛ wɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ má keriba ta ba nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ʋ hɩɩsɛ ʋ dɩhaala nɛ, ʋ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal nɛ kɛŋ haala sɩ hɛ tɩŋa pɩŋ, ba ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ma keriba ta ba nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ ʋ nyɩmma dɩhaala koo ʋ naaŋ naambii pɩŋ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa hɩɩsɛ nɛ. Ba jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ ʋ nyɩmma kʋbie haala pɩŋ, ʋ hɩɩsɛ ʋ nyɩm-bie nɛ. Ba jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ sʋʋ dɩ ba bɩ bii lʋla.

english_verse: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ laa ʋ naambie haala jaa, ʋ ŋaa disiŋ nɛ. Ʋ hɩɩsɛ ʋ naaŋ-bile nɛ, ba jaŋ sʋʋ dɩ ba bɩ bii lʋla.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: Má to mɩ niiŋ arɩ wombie-la kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma wuo hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛŋ maa mʋ. Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, tintee-la bɩ jaŋ laama.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kiri tintee-la lɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ to. Wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma, ba kala nɛ ba ŋaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɛrɛba.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, mɩ jaŋ joŋ ba tintee-la sɩ sɩma a kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ a pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ nɛ lɩɩsɛma tinteyee kala tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Má joŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, mɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Mɩ nɛ lɩɩsɛma tinteyee kala tʋɔŋ dɩ ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal koo haal nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a ŋaa vʋgʋrʋ koo kantɔŋ yɩrɩrʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma yagɛba kpʋ, arɩ tabɩaa, ba tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ba sʋʋŋ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, dɩ ba kʋŋ naambii nɛ sʋba, ʋ sɩ́ ʋ digu a kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ dɩhaal ma nɛ hɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ a bɩ bala jaa aŋ sʋʋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo digi.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ haala naambii nɛ sʋba, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ digi ʋ kʋsʋʋŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩ maga dɩ ba fʋŋ ba nyusuŋ koo a kɛ ba tɔŋŋɔɔ koo a kpɛrɛ ba yaraa dɩ ba nɩɩ yel yoho.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ disiniŋ a chei mɩ-na ba Wɩa yɩrɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ lɩɩsɛba nɛ dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ mɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa pɩpɩmɛ a ŋaa kʋ diilee Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩmɛ. Ba bɩ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: Ba bɩ maga dɩ ba jaa haala-la sɩ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa aa hɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa, koo haala-la sɩ vɩa ba balaba, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩ maga ba kɛŋ disiniŋ mɩ-na ba Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa maga dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɛ joŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋdiilee a pɩpɩ mɩ-na ma Wɩa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, a leŋ ma ma bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara tolo nɛ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ, ʋ hɛ ʋ nyɩmma hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ tolo-la a nyɩgɛ.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tʋɔŋ kʋhɩaŋ, nɩɩ-la ba sɩ chaasa lɩɩsɛ a wansɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nʋʋŋ hɛ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ, dɩ́ ʋ nɛ laalɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ gɛnnɩŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ vɩa ʋ nyuŋ ta koo a kɛŋ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ aa dagɛ arɩ ʋʋ yel yoho nɛ.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ mʋ kpagɛ sʋʋŋ, dɩ ʋ naaŋ koo ʋ nyɩmma nɛ sʋba ma, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tʋɔŋ a yel yoho a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba lɩɩsʋ nɛ a joŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nʋʋ-la tɩsʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: Haal-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ jaa maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa hapuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ jaa yo-haal koo haal arɩ ʋ bala sɩ vɩa dɔŋɔ koo haal-la sɩ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa a hɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ jaa hapuŋ nɛ ʋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ,

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ ʋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ lɩɩsʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarɩ-hɩaŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ yaraa nɛ kɛŋ nyɔɔ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kʋ kpagɛmɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ nyʋlɩma, koo dɩ ʋ nɛ gbɛrɩgɛ koo dɩ ʋ yaraa nɛ bɩ chese koo a ŋaa jɩgɩla jɩgɩla.

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ naaŋ koo ʋ nɩsɩŋ nɛ sʋba, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋdiilee kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ gʋma koo a faasa kui, koo dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ sɩɩ-togo, koo dɩ ʋ lee nɛ ŋmɛrɛ a lɩlɩɩ nʋɔlʋŋ, koo dɩ ʋ luribiee nɛ yɛrɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋdiilee kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋl wɩaa deemba kala pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɩ ba sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a chei Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ yie kaa kʋ pɩmɛ ŋaa. Ba sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ ŋaa a chei mɩ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: Dɩ Arɔŋ doho nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ nyanyal cholii koo lɩɩŋ lɩlɩɩ ʋ faagaa lɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ dii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo pɩ Wɩa, see ba pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta. Dɩ Arɔŋ doho Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋŋ nɛ digi sʋʋŋ koo dɩ bafɩɩrɩŋ nɛ lɩɩ ʋ lɛ,

english_verse: or if you have touched an unclean creature of any sort, including an unclean person.
translation_verse: koo dɩ ʋ nɛ digi kɩalɩŋ sɩɩ vaamɛ tinteeŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ koo dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa disiŋ-la hɛ ʋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩa nɛ jʋa ʋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ʋ jaŋ wuo dii Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo pɩ Wɩa, ba ŋaa ʋ kʋdiilee nɛ.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga ʋ chaŋ kʋŋ sɩ sʋʋ pimee koo kʋŋ baga kʋa sɩ kpʋa, dɩ ʋ nɛ chaŋa, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa maga dɩ ba tuto wombie-la mɩ sɩ dagɛba nɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ba jaŋ laa cheeriŋ a to ŋɩɩ lɛ sʋʋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA a leŋ ma bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɩa nɩaa dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ wuo dii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ. Nʋhʋɔrʋ sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ koo pachɩŋ-diiru sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ bɩ jaŋ wuo dii.

english_verse: However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ yɔɔ yomo koo dɩ ba lʋl yomo-la ʋ dɩa lɛ nɛ, ʋ-na jaŋ wuo dii.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara tolo nɛ jaa nʋʋ sɩ tuo Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ, tolo-la ma bɩ jaŋ wuo dii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Ama dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara tolo nɛ ŋaa yo-haal koo ʋ dɩ ʋ bala nɛ vɩa dɔŋɔ, dɩ ʋ bɩ bii kɛnɛ, aŋ kʋ hɔŋ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa lɛ a ŋaa dɩɩ-tolo, ʋ jaŋ wuo dii ʋ nyɩmma kʋdiilee, ama nʋhʋɔrʋ na-kala bɩ jaŋ wuo dii.

english_verse: and anyone else who accidentally does so, must pay for the food plus a fine of
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ jɩŋ aŋ dii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ, ʋ jaŋ tiŋ kɩalɩŋ aŋ ha tiŋ tʋŋ bʋnɔŋ a daŋ.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ pʋna sɩ kɛŋ nyɔɔ kaa sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ laa ŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩ maga dɩ ba ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ yie kaa kʋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ leŋe dɩ nɩwogusuŋ pɛ didii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛ dii laa cheeriŋ, a tiŋ chɩmɩŋ. Mɩ-na nɛ ma TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.” Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la doho La TƖƖNA sɩ bɩ chɛ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala: Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna koo nʋhʋɔrʋ nɛ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋkɔ dɩ ʋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, dɩ niiŋ nɛ ʋʋ chɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ koo dɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ,

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kɛŋ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ-bele koo piese kɔ dɩ ʋ sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, dɩ niiŋ nɛ ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ koo dɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ, pʋna-la bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nyɔɔ kala. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee mɩ bɩ jaŋ laa ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ pʋna sɩ pugumo koo pʋna sɩ kɛŋ nyɔɔ, nɛ-bele koo piese a sʋl tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ama ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kaa lɩɩsɛ niiŋ-na. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ laa ŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: As long as you live in this land, don't offer an animal with injured testicles.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ kɛŋ pʋna luribiee sɩ yɛrɛ koo ba sɩ fere kaa sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ ma TƖƖNA. Ma bɩ maga dɩ ma ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ ma tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: Dɩ pʋna nɛ nagɛ ŋɩɩ, ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ laa nʋhʋɔrʋ ma teeŋ a kaa sʋl kʋdiilee Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma Wɩa. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ laa ma sʋla, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ kɛŋ nyɔɔŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: “Dɩ nɛŋ koo piese koo bʋʋŋ nɛ lʋl bie, bile maga dɩ ʋ hɛ ʋ naaŋ teeŋ nɛ a wasɛ yɩlɩŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. A chɩŋ tapʋl chori a kaa mʋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo kaa sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ nɛŋ koo piese arɩ ʋ bie kala kpʋ chɛ-bala.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ ŋ kpʋ pʋna a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a lɔllɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, to wombie-la mɩ sɩ daga dɩ mɩ laa ŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Ʋ maga ŋ chaŋ ʋ nammɩa tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ chɩna chʋa, mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Má to mɩ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: ‘Gbielee deemba nɛ maga dɩ ma kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ aa gbieli mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa balɩdʋ nɛ ma jaŋ tɩŋ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa, ama chɛ-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ nɛ ŋaa chɛ-wiesii-la. Ʋ maga má kʋ hilimi mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ. Lee na-kala ma sɩ hɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la ŋaa chɛ-wiesii nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele arɩ boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tiŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la, bɛɛ wɩaa tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ maga ma pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ ta mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele jaŋ suomi jɩna tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋlaa fii arɩ banɛsɛ chɛɛŋ dɩdaanɩŋ.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩa-la tʋɔŋ nɛ maga dɩ má joŋ kʋdiilee ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Tapʋl-pɛɩ má hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ aŋ sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ.’ ” Kʋdii-falaa

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: ‘Dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ Kɛnaŋ tintee-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ joŋo pɩma, jɩna na-kala dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ma kʋdii falaa, má sʋa mɩɩ-jagɩsɩŋ a kaa mʋ pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: a pɛ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ gbaŋa lɛ a kɛŋ nʋʋŋ buu a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩmɛ, a pɛ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ loŋ arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ŋaa, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma dii ma kʋdii falɩɩ kala, dɩ ba kaa wasɛ boroboro nɛ koo dɩ ba joŋo wasɛ nɛ koo dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋhuoŋ nɛ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ a magɛ dɩ ma doho kala tuto, lee na-kala ma sɩ hɛ. Baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ gbiele

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Má paala sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ a magɛ dɩ ma doho kala tuto lee na-kala ma sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: Má chɩŋ chɛ-wiesii-la taŋ sɩ pʋla lɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩ-jagɩsɩŋ je, a zaara ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a dɩɩsɛ yɔɔsʋŋ balɩpɛ.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Kaala kala nɩaa maga dɩ má kɛŋ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ gbaŋa a hɛ sɩbʋrʋŋ a wasɛ boroboro balɩa a kaa kʋ je a zaara sʋl kʋdii falaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Má pɛ kɛŋ pie-pɔrɔɔ balɩpɛ sɩ yi jɩna a bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a pɛ boroboroba-la lɛ, arɩ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ a pɛ pie-belliŋ balɩa lɛ. Kɩaa deemba nɛ ma jaŋ joŋo sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA a pɛ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ. Ba ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa wɩɩ-sʋlʋŋ nɛ. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Má kpʋ gbuŋgbogo ma sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, aŋ kpʋ pie-bel-pɔrɔɔ balɩa sɩ yi jɩna a sʋl nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ pie-belli-la balɩa arɩ ba sɩ kɛŋ kʋdii falaa wasɛ boroboroba-la a je aa zaarɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Ŋɩɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ. Ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ mɩ teeŋ, a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋdiilee.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa ʋ maga dɩ má hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ aŋ sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ a magɛ dɩ ma doho kala tuto lee na-kala ma sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa Kɛnaŋ tintee-la lɛ, má sɩ́ sɛŋ-keree kɩaa ŋaa, má bɩra sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ kuuni ma. Má lemba pɩ summoo arɩ nʋhʋɔraa. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: “Chɛŋ-pɛɩ-la tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa fii chɛɛŋ nɛ ma jaŋ pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ ta. Má hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ a vɔɔ niiŋ a joŋ kɩaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Má vɔɔ niiŋ chɛnɛ-la tʋɔŋ tapʋl-nibi dɩdaanɩŋ a kaa mʋ ʋ chɛ-lɩa dɩdaanɩŋ. Ʋ maga dɩ ma to chɛ wiesii-la woruŋ.” Lɛŋŋɛɛ gbielee

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Tapʋl-bumbuŋ-la má tɔrɛ ma tɩɩ-nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ, a chɔl abɛ pɩpaarɩŋ, a chɔl tɩɩ-naakelee sɩ kɛŋ pɩpaarɩŋ a jʋɔsɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: ‘Chɛŋ-pɛɩ tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa fii arɩ banɔŋ chɛɛŋ nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele jaŋ suomi. Ʋ jaŋ dieni a magɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Tapʋl-bumbuŋ ma jaŋ hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ aŋ sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩa-la balɩpɛ, má joŋ kɩaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩgaa pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Tapʋl-chori chɛɛŋ má hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ a joŋ kɩaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Gbiele-la dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Má sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ.

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: Gbielee deemba nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dagɛ dɩ ma hihilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩpɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ maga dɩ ma kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a pɛ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllʋŋ deemba kala pɛ chɛ-wiesii-la Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ nɛ, arɩ zile kɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ yie joŋo pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA arɩ ma tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, a pɛ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ yie kaa lɩɩsɛ niiri-la ma sɩ hɛ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa, má gbieli gbiele deeŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Má suomi chɛŋ-pɛɩ-la tapʋlaa fii arɩ banɔŋ chɛɛŋ. Tapʋl-bumbuŋ ŋaa chɛ-wiesii nɛ, tapʋl chori ma ŋaa chɛ-wiesii.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Jɩna na-kala chɛŋ pɛɩ lɛ, má gbieli gbiele deeŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Gbiele deeŋ maga dɩ ma doho nɩaa kala gbigbielu nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩa-la balɩpɛ kala lɛ ma sɩɩ gbieli gbiele-la, nʋʋ na-kala sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩɩna maga dɩ ʋ jʋjʋʋ lɛbɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma doho nɩaa kala jaŋ liliisi arɩ mɩ leŋe Iziral tɩŋŋaa jʋʋ lɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛmba lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.’ ”

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala jɩŋ tapʋlɩa-la sɩ maga dɩ baa gbieli gbielee deemba, a zizil La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kpʋ nʋʋ pʋna, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ pʋna tiŋ ʋ chɩmɩŋ, ama dɩ nuhuobiiŋ nɛ ŋ kpʋ, ba jaŋ kpʋ ŋ ma.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: “Leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kɛŋ olif nʋʋŋ sɩ faasa zɔŋ kɔ dɩ ba joŋo hɩhɛ chaanaa lɛ dɩ ba didii a sɩ́ dɩsʋ.

english_verse: Aaron will set up the gold lampstand in the holy place of the sacred tent. Then he will light the seven lamps that must be kept burning there in my presence, every night from now on. This law will never change. The Sacred Bread The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ ŋaa chaaŋ-daaŋ ʋ chɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, chaana-la sɩ sagɛ ʋ nyuŋ maga dɩ ba didii nɛ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: Ŋaa munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ a wasɛ boroboroba fii arɩ balɩa, dɩ ba kʋŋkala yuŋuŋ ŋaa kilo balɩa,

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: a joŋo daŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ naaderee balɩa teebʋl-la ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ ŋaa nyuŋ, dɩ ʋ chɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Naadere-la kʋŋkala lɛ, hɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sɩ faasa zɔŋ sɩ jaŋ laa boroboroba-la nyuŋ a ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA toruŋ dɩ ba joŋo ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ na-kala Iziral tɩŋŋaa maga ba kɛŋ boroboroba-la kɔ, dɩ Arɔŋ joŋo bil mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ ŋaa nii nɛ pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala dɩ ba tuto wuu.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Boroboroba-la ŋaa Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kɩaa nɛ. Ba jaŋ diiba Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa kʋdiilee zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ nɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ.” Ba yagɛ nʋʋ sɩ chei Wɩa yɩrɩŋ kpʋ

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Baal-la naaŋ sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩɩna bʋl wɩaa chei La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛnʋ mʋ Mosis teeŋ. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Sɛlɔmɩf, Dibiri sɩ ŋaa Daŋ doho nʋʋ tolo.

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: Ba kɛnʋ tɔ dɩa aŋ gbɩgbɛrɛ dɩ La TƖƖNA dagɛ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba ŋaa ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: “Kɛŋ mɩ yɩrɩ-cheeru-la sʋʋsa lɩɩ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla joŋ nɩsaa daŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ, ka dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala paa tabɩaa a yagʋ kpʋ.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ ŋaa nʋhʋɔrʋ koo dɩ ʋ ŋaa Iziral tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala maga dɩ ba paa tabɩaa yagʋ kpʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kpʋ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kpʋ ʋ dɔŋɔ pʋna, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ pʋna nɛ tiŋ ʋ chɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bolimi ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa nɩɩ-la lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba joŋ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋaa ʋ ma lɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ nʋhʋɔraa kala nɛ maga dɩ ba tuto wombiee deemba. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.”

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba kala pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɛrɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ baal-la fa sɩ bʋl wɩaa chei La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ, a sʋʋsa lɩɩ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ a paa tabɩaa yagʋ kpʋ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ hɛ yalɩŋ a magɛ jɩsɩ-la ŋ naambile sɩ jaŋ wuo pɛrɛ tintee-la lɛ, ka dɩ jɩna-la ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tinteye-la ba sɩ yɔbɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa-na yi.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ nyuŋ,

english_verse: This is a year of complete celebration, so don't plant any seed or harvest what your fields or vineyards produce.
translation_verse: Jɩ-mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii-la lɛ, má sɩ́ pɛrʋ koo a ŋaa kʋtɩarɩ-la sɩ bɩa koo a tɔrɛ ma girep nɛnɛɛ.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, dɩ ma nɛ kʋ jʋʋ Kɛnaŋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, tintee-la jaŋ kɛŋ jɩna ʋ sɩ jaŋ pɩna wiesi a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: but the seventh year you must let your fields and vineyards rest in honor of me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Ama jɩ-pɛɩ lɛ ma bɩ maga dɩ ma pɛrɛ tintee-la koo a buori ma girep tɩɩsɩŋ ta. Ʋ maga dɩ tintee-la pɩna wiesi nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: This is to be a time of complete rest for your fields and vineyards, so don't harvest anything they produce.
translation_verse: Kʋtɩarɩ-la ma sɩ waa ba tɩtɩa lɛ, má sɩ́ ba kala ŋaa a sɩ́ girep tɩɩsɩ-la sɩ nɛnɛ ma kala tɔrʋ. Tintee-la maga dɩ ʋ pɩna wiesi nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: Ma pʋsʋŋ arɩ gɩrɩŋ kɩaa kala nɛ jaŋ didiiba. Kʋtɩarɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ bii tintee-la lɛ ma jaŋ wuo diiba. Jɩ-mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: Ʋ nyɩmma kʋbie koo ʋ nyɩmma kʋbie ma bie koo ʋ naambii na-kala jaŋ wuo time laaʋ, koo dɩ ʋ ma tɩtɩa nɩsɩŋ nɛ kʋ kɛŋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo time laa ʋ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Jɩna-la chɛŋ-pɛɩ tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa fii chɛɛŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ jaŋ pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ ta, ʋ maga dɩ ma ŋmʋʋ banyile tintee-la kala lɛ.

english_verse: This fiftieth year is sacred—it is a time of freedom and of celebration when everyone will receive back their original property, and slaves will return home to their families.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, má lɩɩsɛ jɩ-mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, dɩ ʋ ŋaa jɩna-la nʋʋkala sɩ maga dɩ ʋ tɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa. Jɩna deeŋ tʋɔŋ, dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ tinteye-la kala nɩaa sɩ yɔbɔ maga dɩ ba joŋo pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ, ka dɩ yosuŋ ma mɩɩra mʋ ba dɩa nɩaa teeŋ.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa jɩ-zɔŋ nɛ a pɩma. Ma jaŋ dii kʋtɩarɩ-la sɩ bɩɩ ma bagɩsɩŋ lɛ, ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa a kaa kɔ dɩa a tʋɔlɛ.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: Jɩna deeŋ tʋɔŋ maga dɩ ma joŋ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa tinteye-la ma sɩ yɔbɔ pɩba nɛ.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Dɩ jɩsɩ-la nɛ yʋga, ʋ maga dɩ yalɩŋ ma yʋgɛ nɛ, ka dɩ ba nɛ bɩ yʋgɛ, yalɩŋ ma bɩ maga dɩ ʋ yʋgɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa kʋdiilee magɛ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo na tintee-la lɛ nɩɩ dagɛ ʋ yalɩŋ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩɩna kala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ gʋrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ama má to mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ.

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ na kʋdiilee woruŋ tintee-la lɛ a didii aŋ hɔŋ sɔm.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ wuo pɩɛsɛ arɩ ma sɩ bɩ kɩaa duo a bɩ kɩaa ŋaa, bɛɛ kɩaa nɛ ma jaŋ dii jɩ-pɛɩ-la tʋɔŋ?

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma kʋdiilee chaasa wasɛ jɩ-dʋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ma wuo dii yi jɩsɩŋ batori.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ duu kɩaa jɩ-chori tʋɔŋ aŋ ha didii jɩ-dʋ-la kʋbɩnaa a mʋ jʋʋ jɩ-nibi tʋɔŋ bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa.

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ maga ma joŋ tintee-la yalla pɩ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ʋ kʋŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ tɩɩ tintee-la, ka ma ŋaa nʋhʋɔra a hɔŋ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ yallɛ tinteeŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma bʋla bil arɩ tɩɩna jaŋ wuo bɩra tiŋ a laa ʋ kʋa.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna kala nɛ summo a keri ʋ tinteeŋ yallɛ, ʋ naambile sɩɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ maga dɩ ʋ time laa tintee-la.

english_verse: if that relative has the money. Later, if you can afford to buy it,
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ naambii kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ time laa, ka dɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dʋa, a jaŋ wuo time laa,

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: ʋ jaŋ dɩɩsɛ jɩsɩ-la tɩɩna sɩ yɔɔ tintee-la a kʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ time laa, a tiŋ jɩ-kaana-la sɩ ka, ka dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa-na yi.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ time laa, nɩɩ-la sɩ yɔbɔ jaŋ tɩɩ tintee-la a mʋ yi jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa dɩ ʋ saa-na laa ʋ kʋa.

english_verse: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
translation_verse: Dɩ taŋ nɛ ba saa kɛrɛ golli, ka dɩ nʋʋ joŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ dɩa yalla pɩ nʋʋ, jɩna-la lɛ ʋ sɩ yalla dʋndʋŋa tʋɔŋ nɛ ʋ jaŋ wuo time laa ʋ kʋa.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ time laa ka dɩ jɩna-la bal, dɩa-la jaŋ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ yɔbɔ arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa kʋŋ a kaa mʋ. Dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ yie, dɩa-la-na bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ yalla kʋŋ.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ama tasɩ-la na-kala ba sɩ bɩ kɛrɛ saa golli ka dɩ nʋʋ joŋ dɩa a yalla lee-la, nɩɩ-la sɩ yalla jaŋ wuo time laa ʋ kʋa. Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ time laa, jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩpɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ yie, nɩɩ-la sɩ yalla jaŋ laa ʋ kʋa.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa-na ŋaa dabaŋ nɛ. Ba-na jaŋ wuo time laa ba dɩɩsɩŋ ba tasɩ-la ba sɩ joŋo pɩba bʋa na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Dɩ Levi doho nʋʋ nɛ yallɛ ʋ dɩa, dɩ ba saa kɛrɛ golli taŋ-la koo ba bɩ saa golli, aŋ bɩ wuo time laa, dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩpɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ yie, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ laa ʋ kʋa nɛ. Levi doho nɩaa dʋndʋŋa nɛ tɩɩ ba dɩɩsɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ama pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diile-la kala sɩ golli Levi doho nɩaa tasɩŋ-na bɩ maga dɩ ba joŋo yallɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa ba kɩaa nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna kala nɛ kʋ summi a bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa wuo bibeŋ, má kɛnʋ mɛrɛ ma tɩtɩa lɛ a bibenu, arɩ ma sɩɩ beŋ nʋhʋɔraa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ wuo hɛ ma tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ nɛ kɛŋ ma kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ joŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ pɩma aŋ ŋaa ma Wɩa.

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna kala nɛ kʋ summi a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa yalla pɩ ʋ naambii, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ʋ tɩma pʋpʋ a nagɛ yoŋ.

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ joŋu dɩ ʋ nagɛ pachɩŋ diire koo nʋhʋɔra sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tɩma pʋ a mʋ yi jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ biiriŋ, tɩɩna maga dɩ ʋ leŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ kala mɩɩra mʋ ʋ doho nɩaa teeŋ ba tinteeŋ,

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ mɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba joŋ ba kʋŋ yallɛ a nagɛ yomo.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma kɛŋ tʋɔhɛɛŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Má fɩfá mɩ-na ma Wɩa.

english_verse: If you want slaves, buy them from other nations
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ yosuŋ, ma jaŋ wuo yɔɔba tinteye-la sɩ kpagɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: or from the foreigners who live in your own country, and make them your property.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ wuo yɔɔ nʋhʋɔra-la ma sɩ hɔŋ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ba doho nʋʋkala ba sɩ lʋla ma tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa ma kɩaa.

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: Ma biiriŋ ma jaŋ wuo sii tɩɩba, dɩ ba ŋaa ba yosi a kaa mʋ wuu. Ama ma pɔ má sɩ́ ma Iziral tɩɩna dɔŋɔ dɔgɩsʋ.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋhʋɔra-la sɩ hɔŋ ma tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ ŋaa kɩaa tɩɩna dɩ ma dɔŋɔ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa yalla pʋ koo nʋhʋɔrʋ-la doho nʋʋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ summo wɩaa,

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: wombiiŋ hɛ nɩmɛ ba sɩ jaŋ wuo time laaʋ. Ʋ naambiiriŋ dɔŋɔ jaŋ wuo time laaʋ.

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ yallɛ ʋ tɩtɩa pa maga dɩ ʋ joŋu arɩ pachɩŋ diiru nɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ dʋdɔgɩsʋ.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ paala bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa wuo time laa ma, jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ yie, nɩɩ-la sɩ yɔbʋ maga dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ ta nɛ,

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ mɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kɔ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.”

english_verse: I am the Lord your God! So don't make or worship idols or images.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Má sɩ́ kʋŋkala ŋaa a pɩ ma tɩtɩa aa kpaarɛ: tɔŋŋɔɔ, vesiŋ, koo a saa tabɩaa aa kpaarɛ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Má to mɩ chɛ-wiesii-la woruŋ, a zizil lee-la ma sɩ kʋʋ chʋɔlɛmɛ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ ʋ bʋa lɛ a pɩma dɩ ma kʋdiilee arɩ ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ wasɛ.

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ Kɛnaŋ tintee-la lɛ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ dɩ wɩɩkala sɩ leŋe dɩ ma bɔyɛ joŋ. Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ gɩrɩŋ kʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ laalɩŋ ma tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ kire to ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ a kpʋba.

english_verse: Your barns will overflow with grain each year.
translation_verse: Ma pire jaŋ chol dɩ ma chaarɛ kʋbɩnaa aŋ hɛ kʋfalaa.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma pʋŋ, aŋ leŋ dɩ nii-la ma mɩ sɩ bile mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ chɩŋ.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ lemma ta.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a ŋaa ma Wɩa dɩ ma ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ma Wɩa, mɩ nɛ kɛmma kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ ma sɩ́ ba yosi ŋaa. Mɩ nɛ laama ta dɩ ma tɩɩ ma tɩtɩa a sɩ́ wɩɩkala fá.” Dɔgɩsɩna-la ma sɩ jaŋ na dɩ ma nɛ vɩa Wɩa niiŋ

english_verse: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement,
translation_verse: aŋ vɩa mɩ niiŋ wɩaa mɩ sɩ daga arɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ma tuto a chei nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ,

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: ŋ-la nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaama: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ jʋʋma. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyanyalaa sɩ bɩ daalusuŋ kɛnɛ hɛ ma lɛ, arɩ yarɩ-lɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma nyʋlɩmɛ dɩ ma yaraa kala yʋɔlɛ ŋɩɩ dɩ ma mʋ sʋʋ. Ma jaŋ duu kɩaa aŋ bɩ jaŋ dii kɩalɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ jaŋ diiba.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ vɩama ta a leŋ dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diima. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛrɛma nɛ jaŋ bemma. Ma jaŋ fá, ka nʋʋ bɩ maa kiri.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩaa deemba kala nɛ ŋaa ma lɛ, ka ma ha bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma a magɛ ŋɩɩ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ, a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ giri ma babii-ballɩŋ ta. Duonuŋ bɩ jaŋ nɩɩ pɩma, ma tinteeŋ jaŋ hɩl korikori.

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ tɩŋ pɛɩ, ma baga kɩaa bɩ jaŋ wasɛ, ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ ma bɩ jaŋ nɛŋ.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ baga kɩaa kʋ kpʋ ma biiriŋ arɩ ma pʋsʋŋ, dɩ ma nɩaa faasa muuri, dɩ ma wombiee kala pɩŋ hoi.

english_verse: I'll remain your enemy and punish you even worse.
translation_verse: mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma na hɛɛŋ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ laalɩŋ kʋ gɩrɛma a tɩŋ ma sɩ chei nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ fá jʋʋ ma tabalaa dɩ ma laa ma mɩɩsɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diima.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ kʋdiilee nyaa, dɩ ha-bala joŋ haalaa fii kʋdiilee ŋaa tabʋʋ bala lɛ. Ba jaŋ pɩɛrɛ mʋa mʋa a pɩ nʋʋkala dɩ ma dii aŋ bɩ vɔgɛ.

english_verse: I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins!
translation_verse: mɩ baanɩŋ jaŋ sii ma nyuŋ dɩ mɩ dɔgɩsɛ ma a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ, a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ losuŋ faasa jʋʋma, dɩ ma gʋra kɛsɛ ma biiriŋ chɩchaŋ.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chei ma vʋɩ-kpaarɛ leree arɩ korunu-la nyuŋ ma sɩɩ nyɩgɛ ma kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ, aŋ kpʋma a paa ma kʋsʋʋnʋŋ daŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ ma tɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩ cheye nyuŋ, aŋ vɩama ta.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma tasɩŋ pɩŋ jikpeeniŋ aŋ chei ma vʋɩyaa dɩ-kpaaraa, ma kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ sʋɔra bɩra bɩ jaŋ sɩma pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma tinteeŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere a pɩ ma dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ hɛ lee-la.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ laalɩŋ kirima dɩ ma fá a pɩsa jʋʋ tintee-wogusuŋ, ka ma tinteeŋ arɩ ma tasɩŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la kala lɛ tintee-la sɩ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, ʋ jaŋ wiesi jɩsɩ-la kala ʋ fa sɩ maga dɩ ʋ wiesi, ka ʋ bɩ wiese, ka dɩ ma hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tinteyee lɛ.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ fá a yigi dɔŋɔ lulo arɩ laalɩŋ nɩɩ kirima, ka nʋʋkala bɩ maa kiri. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma sɩ́ wuo yuo ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ mʋ sʋʋ tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ, ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tinteeŋ jaŋ diima.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ma nɩkaana-la sɩ bɩ sʋba ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tinteeŋ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɩl ŋɩɩ a mʋ sʋʋ, a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ma nyɩmmaba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ leŋ mɩ yaraa hosi ba lɛ, mɩ kiriba hɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tinteyee lɛ, dɩ ba nɛ leŋ ba babii-ballɩŋ aŋ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri a na hɛɛ-la sɩ maga dɩ ba na, a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: mɩ jaŋ liisi nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ Jekɔb arɩ Aɩzɩk arɩ Abɩraham pɛgɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ tintee-la mɩ sɩ sɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩba lɛ.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Tintee-la jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a wiesi, nʋʋkala jaŋ tuo ʋ lɛ. Ʋ maga ba na hɛɛ-la sɩ maga dɩ ba na nɛ, a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba vɩa mɩ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga nɛ.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, dɩ ba nɛ hɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tinteeŋ lɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ vɩaba ta koo a bɛrɛba a cheiba, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ba pɛgɛ chei. Mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ ba wɩaa, a liise yi nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ba naabalɩmaba pɛgɛ, nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ka tinteyee nɩaa kala bibeŋ. Mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa.”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Wombie-la arɩ niiri-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩ Mosis peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ nyuŋ dɩ ʋ joŋo dagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba tuto nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: ‘Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ta niiŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ nuhuobiiŋ a hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ, aŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ nii-la,

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: Ma kʋpɛrɛɛ, mɩaa arɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ kala, ma jaŋ kaa kpaa leree fii a joŋ dɔŋɔ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ba ŋaa kʋzɔmɔ nɛ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: If you try to substitute any other animal, no matter how good, for the one you promised, they will both become holy and must be sacrificed.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ pʋna-la lenni pʋna dɔŋ, kʋzɔŋ koo kʋlɔrʋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba kala balɩa jaŋ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋzɔmɔ.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ ta nii-la nɛ ŋaa summu a bɩ jaŋ wuo na warɩpʋla-la magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kaa lɩɩsɛ nii-la, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kaa ta nii-la a mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara teeŋ dɩ ʋ dagɛ maga ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ wuo tiŋ.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: Dɩ pʋna sɩ bɩ kɩsɛ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ kaa ta nii-la, pʋna-la jaŋ ŋaa mɩ-na Wɩa kʋzɔŋ.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Dɩ pʋna-la ʋ sɩ kaa ta niiŋ nɛ kɛŋ disiniŋ ba sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo kaa sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ pʋna-la mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara teeŋ.

english_verse: But if you want to buy it back, you must pay an additional
translation_verse: Dɩ pʋna-la tɩɩna nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ time laa, ʋ jaŋ tiŋ ʋ yalɩŋ, aŋ ha kɛŋ pʋna-la yalɩŋ kpaa leree banɔŋ a joŋ dɔŋɔ pɛ.

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ chɔgɛ ʋ doho nɩaa tinteeŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ yalɩŋ maga dɩ ʋ magɛ kʋdoho-la ba sɩ jaŋ joŋo duu lee-la yalɩŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Mɩɩ-doho bɔtɔ yalɩŋ ŋaa warɩpʋla mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ.

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ joŋ kʋyɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ dɩ ʋ joŋ tintee-la hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ yalɩŋ ha maga dɩ ʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: But any time after that, the price will be figured according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ joŋ kʋyɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ bala ka dɩ ʋ joŋ tintee-la hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ jɩsɩ-la sɩ bala ta nɛ aŋ hɛ ʋ yalɩŋ.

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: Dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ joŋ kʋyɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ kʋ yi, tintee-la jaŋ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ jaŋ tɩɩʋ.

english_verse: If you promise me a field that you have bought,
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ yɔɔ tinteeŋ a ma bɩra joŋo hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ yɔɔ tintee-la aŋ dɩɩsɛ jɩsɩŋ magɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ ka, ka dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ kʋyɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa yi aŋ hɛ ʋ yalɩŋ, dɩ nɩɩ-la timu tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa. Moribiiŋ deeŋ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋzɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: Dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ kʋyɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ kʋ yi, nɩɩ-la teeŋ ʋ sɩ yɔɔ tintee-la nɛ jaŋ laa ʋ kʋa.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma hɛ kʋŋkala yalɩŋ, má hɛ dɩ ʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ daga Wɩa dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo joŋ piese koo bʋʋŋ koo nɛŋ sɩ lʋl ʋ bii-bumbuŋ hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma paala jɩŋ arɩ ba-na ŋaa mɩ kɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ joŋ nuhuobiine koo pʋna koo ʋ doho nɩaa tinteeŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo time laa koo a joŋo yallɛ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋzɔŋ.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ mɩ chaasa lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba kpʋ, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo time laaʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ mɩɩra time laa kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ, ʋ jaŋ tiŋ ʋ yalɩŋ aŋ ha kɛŋ ʋ yalɩŋ kpaa leree banɔŋ a joŋ dɔŋɔ time daŋ.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Ma pʋsʋŋ tʋɔŋ, pʋŋ fii tɩɩna na-kala ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋa nɛ.

english_verse: no matter how good or bad it is. If you substitute one animal for another, both of them become holy, and neither can be bought back.
translation_verse: Dɩ pʋŋ fii-la nɛ ŋaa kʋzɔŋ koo kʋlɔrʋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma kaa lenni pʋna dɔŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ kaa lenni pʋna dɔŋ, ba kala balɩa jaŋ ŋaa mɩ kɩaa, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo time laa.’ ”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ Mosis Sɩnaɩ peel-la nyuŋ dɩ ʋ bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ jɩ-lɩamɩŋ tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-lɩamɩŋ tapʋl-bumbuŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ Mosis, lɛbɩ-la lɛ ʋ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ Sɩnaɩ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩ Arɔŋ maga dɩ ma dɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩɩna na-kala sɩ ŋaa baal a yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ, a pɛ baala-la fii arɩ balɩa ba sɩ lɩɩsɛ lɛ

english_verse: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala arɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis.

english_verse: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa-na maga dɩ ba hɛ ba lɛŋŋɛɛ a golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la nɛ, lee-la Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la sɩ hɛ, a pɔ dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la teeŋ kɔ, a ŋaa dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ sii Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ. Levi doho nɩaa nɛ maga ba bibeŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la.”

english_verse: But those from the Levi tribe were not included
translation_verse: Ba bɩ Levi doho nɩaa-na dɩɩsa bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ dɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: because the Lord had said to Moses:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Sɩ́ Levi doho nɩaa dɩɩsa pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: Instead, give them the job of caring for the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the objects used for worship. They will camp around the tent, and whenever you move, they will take it down, carry it to the new camp, and set it up again. Anyone else who tries to go near it must be put to death.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala, dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ ma churi Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la a kaa mʋ lee, Levi doho nɩalɩŋ nɛ maga ba churu a kaa mʋ pɛ dɩ-falɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ mʋ. Dɩ nɩwogo kala nɛ mʋ kpagɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, ʋ maga ma kpʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Iziral doho doho-la kala maga dɩ ba ŋmoo bugoo a hɔŋ, bugu kala arɩ ba magɩlɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ,

english_verse: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
translation_verse: “Iziral doho doho-la kala maga dɩ ba ŋmoo bugoo a hɔnɔ golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la nɛ, aŋ sɩ́ ʋ kpagʋ, doho kala arɩ ʋ jɔnjɔŋ arɩ ʋ magɩlɩŋ.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the east side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ nɛ.

english_verse: On one side of Judah will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel son of Zuar as the leader of its
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab son of Helon as the leader of its
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ balɩpɛ arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: On one side of Reuben will be the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai as the leader of its
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ nibi arɩ zɔɔ-batori nɛ.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ banɔŋ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ.

english_verse: Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ sie ba vɛŋ, lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ arɩ Levi doho nɩaa buguŋ sɩ hɛ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ jaŋ sii. Ba sɩ hɔŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ba nɛ sie dɩ ba vɛŋ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba jaŋ vɩvɛŋ, nʋʋkala arɩ ʋ leriŋ arɩ ʋ magɩlɩŋ.

english_verse: On one side of Ephraim will be the tribe of Manasseh, with Gamaliel son of Pedahzur as the leader of its
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa nɛ.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la kala ba sɩ dɩɩsa doho doho nɛ ŋ-la: ba ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan son of Gideoni as the leader of its
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: On one side of Dan will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel son of Ochran as the leader of its
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ kʋbala arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Naphtali with Ahira son of Enan as the leader of its
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ Levi doho nɩaa-na dɩɩsa pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis.

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis, a ŋmoo ba bugoo a hɔŋ arɩ ba magɩlaa. Dɩ ba nɛ sie ba vɛŋ ma, ba yie vɛŋ doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa nɛ.

english_verse: Aaron's four sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar,
translation_verse: Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ yɩraa nɛ fa: Nadab, ʋ bii-hɩaŋ, Abihu, Elieza arɩ Ɩtama.

english_verse: But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord. And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Ama Nadab arɩ Abihu-na tel La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ nɛ a sʋʋ Sɩnaɩ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, bʋa-la ba sɩ nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa pɩ La TƖƖNA, ka ʋ bɩ ba ŋɩɩ daga. Nadab arɩ Abihu fa bɩ biiriŋ lʋla, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba nyɩmma Arɔŋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ Elieza arɩ Ɩtama dʋndʋŋa nɛ faa tɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: who have been appointed to be priests. Anyone else who tries to perform the duties of a priest must be put to death.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɩ ba nɛ tɩtɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tɩntɩŋŋaa. Dɩ nɩwogo nɛ chɛbɛ a chɩchɛ ʋ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩa-la ba sɩɩ tɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma kpʋʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Moses, I have chosen these Levites from all Israel, and they will belong to me in a special way. When I killed the first-born sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in every Israelite family and the first-born males of their flocks and herds would be mine. But now I accept these Levites in place of the first-born sons of the Israelites. The Levites Are Counted
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa hambolibii bumbumba kala ŋaa mɩ kɩaa nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kpʋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba, mɩ lɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba nɛ dɩ ba ŋaa mɩ kɩaa, nuhuobiinee arɩ pʋsʋŋ kala. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis Sɩnaɩ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ,

english_verse: “Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.”
translation_verse: “Dɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. Dɩɩsɛ baal na-kala sɩ yi chɛnɛ koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: So Moses obeyed and counted them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis dɩɩsɛba arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans.
translation_verse: Levi hambolibiisiŋ yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la: Gɛsɔŋ, Kohaf arɩ Mɛrarɩ.

english_verse: Gershon's sons were Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Libini arɩ Sɩmɛɩ.

english_verse: Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohaf doho nɩaa nɛ: Amɩram, Ɩzɩha, Hɛbʋrɔŋ arɩ Ʋzɩɛl.

english_verse: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.
translation_verse: Mɛrarɩ tɩŋŋaa doho nɩaa nɛ: Mali arɩ Musi. Levi doho nɩaa dɩa dɩa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites,
translation_verse: Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa nɛ ŋaa Libini tɩŋŋaa arɩ Sɩmɛɩ tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance,
translation_verse: Lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, Gɛsɔŋ tɩmma-la nɩɩ beŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la arɩ ʋ lɛbɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ tɔ lɛbɩ-la nyuŋ, a pɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ kɛrɛ ʋ boiŋ niiŋ lɛ,

english_verse: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: arɩ lɩga-la sɩ golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la patɩɩsamba arɩ patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ kɛrɛ lɩga-la boiŋ niiŋ, arɩ koru-la, ŋmɛsɩŋ, arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ pɛ kɩaa deemba lɛ ba kaa tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,
translation_verse: Kohaf doho nɩaa nɛ ŋaa Amɩram tɩŋŋaa, Iziha tɩŋŋaa, Hɛbʋrɔŋ tɩŋŋaa arɩ Ʋzɩɛl tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. The Kohathites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: Ba nɩɩ beŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la, teebʋl, chaaŋ daaŋ, korunu-la, Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa, patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ kɛrɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ pɛ kɩaa deemba lɛ ba kaa tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa sɩpaalaarɩ-hɩaŋ nɛ ŋaa Elieza, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Arɔŋ nanʋala. Ʋ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la dɩ-zɔmʋŋ kʋhɩaŋ.

english_verse: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites,
translation_verse: Mɛrarɩ doho nɩaa nɛ ŋaa Mali tɩŋŋaa, arɩ Musi tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ba sɩpaalaara nɛ fa ŋaa Abɩhɛɛl nanʋala Zʋrɩɛl. Ba nɛ maga dɩ ba ŋmoo ba buguŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
translation_verse: Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ jaŋ ŋmoo ba buguŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ sɩpaaŋ. Ba nɛ jaŋ tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la dɩ-zɔmʋŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a pɩpɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Dɩ nɩwogo nɛ mʋ kpagɛ lee-la, ʋ maga dɩ ma kpʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron obeyed the Lord and counted the Levites by their clans. The total number of Levites at least one month old was
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ dɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa doho doho, baala-la kala sɩ yi chɛnɛ koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ba ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩa nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Make a list and count the first-born sons at least one month old in each of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Dɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba kala sɩ yi chɛnɛ koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa.

english_verse: They belong to me, but I will accept the Levites as substitutes for them, and I will accept the Levites' livestock as substitutes for the Israelites' first-born livestock.”
translation_verse: Joŋ Levi doho nɩaa pɩmɛ dɩ ba nɛ chɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba nyuŋ, aŋ joŋ Levi doho nɩaa pʋsʋŋ ma pɩmɛ dɩ ba ma chɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pʋsʋŋ bii-bumbumba nyuŋ. Mɩ-na nɛ ma TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord and counted the first-born sons;
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis dɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba kala arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: “The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock.
translation_verse: “Joŋ Levi doho nɩaa hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba nyuŋ, aŋ joŋ ba pʋsʋŋ ma hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pʋsʋŋ bii-bumbumba nyuŋ. Levi doho nɩaa maga ba ŋaa mɩ nɩaa nɛ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: ʋ maga dɩ ŋ laa nʋʋkala nyuŋ warɩpʋla banɔŋ nɛ, a magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ laa Wɩa dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: This money must then be given to Aaron and his sons.”
translation_verse: Joŋ moribie-la ba sɩ joŋo time laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba-la sɩ daŋa, a pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ.”

english_verse: Moses collected the silver from the extra
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis laa moribie-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba-la sɩ daŋa nyuŋ.

english_verse: Then he gave it to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis joŋ moribie-la kala a pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ,

english_verse: The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ Kohaf tɩŋŋaa tɩtɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ nɛ, dɩ ba bibeŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ kʋzɔmɔ woruŋ.

english_verse: When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain,
translation_verse: Dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩɩ sii ba dɩhɔnʋŋ, Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ jaŋ jʋʋ puri patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ kɛrɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a kaa tɔ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la.

english_verse: and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ joŋ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ a tɔ, a joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-diibelimbine a tɔ daŋ, a joŋ daaterigeba-la ba sɩ kaa jujoŋ daga-la a tʋʋ ba dɩ-tʋʋlaa.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will use another blue cloth to cover the table for the sacred bread. On the cloth they will place the dishes, the bowls for incense, the cups, the jugs for wine, as well as the bread itself.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-diibelimbine a tɔ teebʋl-la nyuŋ boroboro sɩ yie daŋ a chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ, a paa pɩrataba, dasɔsʋŋ, gbansɩŋ arɩ tagɩsɩŋ ba sɩ kaa ŋɩŋaa kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a daŋ. Boroboro-la sɩ daŋ teebʋl-la nyuŋ maga dɩ ʋ daŋ nɩmɛ nɛ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-diibelimbine a tɔ chaaŋ daaŋ arɩ ʋ chaanaa, a pɛ kʋ-la ba sɩ kaa mɩlɩmɛ chaana-la ta ba jɩjɩl aŋ tutuu, tʋɔrʋŋ gbaŋa, arɩ chaana-la nʋʋŋ tagɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ bɩra kɛŋ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ a bɛ tɔ chaaŋ daaŋ arɩ ʋ nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa kala, a joŋo daŋ daasɩ-la nyuŋ ba sɩ kaa chʋchʋŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-diibelimbine arɩ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ a tɔ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la, a joŋ daaterigeba-la ba sɩ kaa jujoŋ koru-la a tʋʋ ba dɩ-tʋʋlaa.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ paa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩa lɛ, a joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-diibelimbine a bɛ tɔ, a joŋ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ a tɔ daŋ, a joŋo daŋ daasɩ-la ba sɩ kaa chʋchʋmba lɛ.

english_verse: They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and cover it with a purple cloth.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ chaarɛ tʋɔrʋ-la kala sɩ hɛ kɔlɩɩŋ koru-la tʋɔŋ, aŋ joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-vachalɩŋ tɔ.

english_verse: On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ paa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ koru-la nyuŋ: nʋʋ-hallɩŋ, nammɩa lɛsɩŋ, safʋlba arɩ kʋmɩsɩrɩ gbansɩŋ a daŋ. Ba jaŋ joŋ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ a tɔ daŋ, aŋ joŋ daaterigeba-la ba sɩ kaa chʋchʋŋ koru-la a tʋʋ ba dɩ-tʋʋlaa.
