english_verse: When the camp is ready to be moved, the Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects and the furnishings of the sacred tent. But Aaron and his sons must have already covered those things so the Kohathites won't touch them and die.
translation_verse: Dɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ tɔ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la kpɩɛrɩ-zɔmɔ-la arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ kala dɛrɛ, dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba vɛŋ, Kohaf doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ kʋ chʋmba. Ama ba bɩ maga dɩ ba digi Wɩa kʋzɔmɔ-la. Dɩ ba nɛ dige, ba jaŋ sʋʋ. Ba nɛ jaŋ chʋŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa kala.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Arɔŋ nanʋala Elieza nɛ maga dɩ ʋ bibeŋ kɩaa deemba kala nyuŋ: chaana-la nʋʋŋ, kʋsʋɔrɩ-sɩŋŋa-la, tapʋlɩɩ kala mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ. Ʋ nɛ maga dɩ ʋ bibeŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa a pɛ ʋ kpɩɛrɩ-zɔmɔ-la kala lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: for carrying the curtains of the sacred tent, its two outer coverings, the curtain for the entrance to the tent,
translation_verse: Ba nɛ jaŋ chʋŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la patɩɩsamba, lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, gɛrɩpɛ-la sɩ tɔʋ arɩ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenni-la sɩ tɔ daŋ, a pɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ patɩɩsamba lɛ,

english_verse: the curtains hanging around the courtyard of the tent, and the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard. The Gershonites are to do whatever needs to be done to take care of these things,
translation_verse: lɩga-la sɩ golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la arɩ koru-la patɩɩsamba arɩ ʋ boiŋ niiŋ patɩɩsamba, ŋmɛsɩ-la arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa. Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Duties of the Merarite Clans
translation_verse: Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa sɩ maga dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Arɔŋ nanʋala Ɩtama nɛ maga dɩ ʋ bemba dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ. Mɛrarɩ tɩŋŋaa

english_verse: The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands,
translation_verse: Ba tɩntɩŋŋaa ba sɩ jaŋ tɩtɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ba nɛ jaŋ chʋchʋŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la daapɛsɩŋ, daa-gɛsɛɛ, daaterigeba, arɩ hɔ-taalɩsɩŋ,

english_verse: as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry,
translation_verse: Lɩga-la sɩ golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la daapɛsɩŋ, hɔ-taalɩŋ, lɛbɩ-la daapɛ-biisiŋ, ŋmɛsɩŋ, arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa. Dagɛ baal na-kala kʋ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ chʋŋ.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelite leaders obeyed the Lord and counted the Levi tribe by families and clans, to find out how many men there were between the ages of
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ, ba dagɛ nʋʋkala ʋ tɩntɩmɩŋ arɩ kʋ-la nʋʋkala sɩ maga dɩ ʋ chʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ kala arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Put out of the camp everyone who has leprosy or a bodily discharge or who has touched a dead body. Now that I live among my people, their camp must be kept clean.”
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩalɩŋ ŋaa baalaa nɛ koo haalaa nɛ, ma sɩ leŋe dɩ ba hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ, lee-la mɩ sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you commit a crime against someone, you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, dɩ baal koo haal nɛ vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ, aŋ ŋaa wɩɩ a chei ʋ dɔŋɔ, nɩɩ-la laa cheeriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: If the victim has no relative who can accept this money, it belongs to me and will be paid to the priest. In addition to that payment, you must take a ram for the priest to sacrifice so your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ nɩɩ-la lɛ ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la chei nɛ sʋba, aŋ bɩ naambii kɛnɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ tiŋ kɩalɩŋ pa, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ time pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ. Ba jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara kɩaa. Tɩɩna jaŋ pɛ kɛŋ pie-bele kɔ dɩ ba kaa pɩɩsɛ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta.

english_verse: When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him. A Suspicious Husband
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tʋɔŋ kʋŋ na-kala nɛ laa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, ba ŋaa ʋ kɩaa nɛ.” Dɩ baal nɛ bɩɩna arɩ ʋ haala ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof.
translation_verse: dɩ baal-la nɛ bɩɩnɛ ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ yaraa bibieri ʋ haala nyuŋ, ka haal-la bɩ wɩɩ jɩŋ,

english_verse: He must take his wife to the priest, together with one kilogram of ground barley as an offering to find out if she is guilty. No olive oil or incense is to be put on that offering.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ haal-la kaa mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara teeŋ. Ʋ jaŋ pɛ kɛŋ munuŋ gbaŋa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a kaa mʋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ haal-la wɩaa. Baal-la bɩ maga dɩ ʋ joŋ nʋʋŋ koo kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a guoli muŋ-la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ŋaa yarɩ-bieriŋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa a pɩa na wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ kɛŋ haal-la kɔ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ joŋ taka a ŋaa mɩ lɩɩzɔmʋŋ hɛ a ŋaa Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tinteeŋ hagɩla a hɛ lɩɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: Next, he will remove her veil, then hand her the barley offering, and say, “If you have been faithful to your husband, this water won't harm you. But if you have been unfaithful, it will bring down the Lord's curse—you will never be able to give birth to a child, and everyone will curse your name.” Then the woman will answer, “If I am guilty, let it happen just as you say.”
translation_verse: Dɩ lɩɩŋ deeŋ la sɩ kaa kalɩbɛ nɛ tuu ŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ŋ nɛ jɩŋ wɩɩ, wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Dɩ haal-la laa hɛ a bʋl, ‘A leŋ dɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, a leŋ dɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa.’

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ kaa kalɩbɛ a hɛ daboro lɛ a chɛsɛ hɛ lɩɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ haal-la joŋ lɩɩ-la a nyʋa. Dɩ ʋ nɛ jɩŋ wɩɩ, kalɩbɩ-na-la jaŋ diiu dɩ ʋ chaasa na hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ laa yarɩ-bieriŋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ muŋ-la haal-la teeŋ, a kaa zaarɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, aŋ kaa mʋ koru-la teeŋ.

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ muŋ-la nɩsɩŋ sɩɩŋ, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩ-diiliŋ a nyɩgɛ koru-la nyuŋ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ haal-la nyʋa lɩɩ-la.

english_verse: If the woman has been unfaithful, the water will immediately make her unable to have children, and she will be a curse among her people.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ ʋ bala teeŋ, aŋ ŋaa disiniŋ, ʋ sɩ nyʋa lɩɩ-la ba sɩ kaa kalɩbɛ ŋɩɩ, kalɩbɩ-na-la jaŋ diiu ʋ nɩaa sɩɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ chaasa na hɛɛŋ, ʋ luoruŋ jaŋ su, dɩ ʋ lʋla kʋʋrɛ.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ haal-la nɛ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ, ʋ ha jaŋ wuo lʋlʋl biiriŋ.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: koo dɩ ʋ yaraa nɩɩ bieri ʋ haala nyuŋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ bɩɩna arɩ ʋ haala bɩ tɛŋɛ lɛ chɩna, ʋ jaŋ kɛnʋ mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara teeŋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ haal-la chɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ dɩ ʋ joŋ wombiiŋ deeŋ to ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: Baal-la bɩ wɩɩkala cheye dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ama haal-la nɛ jaŋ laa cheeriŋ dɩ ʋ nɛ jɩŋ wɩɩ. Ʋ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋ-la bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, dɩ baal koo haal nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ chaasa chɩŋ a ta niiŋ, a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɩmɛ, a tɔ nyukiiŋ,

english_verse: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—
translation_verse: wɩaa deemba nɛ maga dɩ ʋ ŋɩŋaa: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa sɩ-duoruŋ nyʋanʋŋ lɛ: tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ koo sɩ-yele-na kala, girep nɛnɛɛ lɩɩŋ, a sɩ́ ʋ nɛnɩŋ ma dii, kʋlaaŋ koo kʋhɩlɩŋ.

english_verse: During the time that you are a Nazirite, you must never go close to a dead body,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la-kala lɛ ʋ sɩ ta nii-la a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kpagɛ sʋʋŋ.

english_verse: not even that of your father, mother, brother, or sister. That would make you unclean. Your hair is the sign that you are dedicated to me, so remain holy.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la kala lɛ ʋ sɩ ta nii-la, ʋ hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If someone suddenly dies near you, your hair is no longer sacred, and you must shave it seven days later during the ceremony to make you clean.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ guu sʋʋ a kpagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ ta niiŋ a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pɩmɛ, ŋɩɩ leŋe nyu-kɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ tɔ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ fʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ-la tapʋl-pɛɩ ba sɩ jaŋ pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Tapʋl-chori chɛɛŋ, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ kokosuŋ balɩa a mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara teeŋ, lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ a sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, aŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ ma a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta, bɛɛ wɩaa sʋʋ-la leŋe ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ jaŋ bɩra joŋ ʋ nyuŋ-la a hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ bɩra wasa chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ a ta niiŋ a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ pie-bel-pɔrʋŋ sɩ yi jɩna a sʋl cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Tapʋlɩa-la-na sɩ bala bɩra bɩ pɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ sɩ ta nii-la a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pɩmɛ bʋa-la lɛ, ʋ cheye nɛ.

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ ʋ jaŋ kʋ ŋaa ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ pie-bel-pɔrʋŋ sɩ yi jɩna a bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a kɛŋ pie-keeŋ sɩ yi jɩna a bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a kɛŋ pie-bele ma sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a sʋl nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ,

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: a pɛ ba mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ba kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ, a pɛ kʋdiilee sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ sime sɩɩŋ, munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ ba sɩ kɛŋ nʋʋŋ buu a wasɛ boroboro arɩ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ ba sɩ kaa wasɛ boroboro pɛrɛ pɛrɛ biisiŋ a ŋaa nʋʋŋ taa.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ kɛŋ kɩaa deemba kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a sʋl nɩɩ-la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ʋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ nɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pɩmɛ jaŋ fʋŋ ʋ nyu-kɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ tɔ. Ʋ jaŋ paa nyu-pʋna-la a hɛ nyiŋ-la lɛ ba sɩ nyɩgɛ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa.

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: Dɩ nyu-kɩɩ-la tɩɩna nɛ fʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ-la ʋ sɩ tɔ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ chɔ pie-bele-la vaaŋ, a lɩɩsɛ boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ kʋbala arɩ boroboro pɛrɛ pɛrɛ biisi-la ma sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ kʋbala sɩ hɛ sime-la tʋɔŋ a joŋo hɛ nyu-kɩɩ-la tɩɩna nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You will hand them back to the priest, who will lift them up in dedication to me. Then he can eat the meat from the ram's shoulder, its choice ribs, and its hind leg, because this is his share of the sacrifice. After this, you will no longer be a Nazirite, and you will be free to drink wine.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ laa kɩalɩŋ a kaa zaarɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ, ba ŋaa mɩ kʋzɔmɔ nɛ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ tɩɩba, ʋ nɛ tɩɩ vaa-la arɩ hui-la ma ʋ sɩ yie kaa zaarɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩ ta niiŋ a tɔ nyukii-la tɩɩna jaŋ wuo nyʋa tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: “When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ, wombii-la ba sɩ jaŋ to a sʋlmɛ dɩ mɩ pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Ba jaŋ bʋl:

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: ‘La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a kɛmma woruŋ.

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ suri ʋ sɩaa pɩma, ʋ jaŋ fá ma nenige.

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ beŋ ma nyuŋ arɩ ʋ chonuŋ, a leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ.’

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israelites, I will give them my blessing.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ yɩrɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ a bʋl wɩaa deemba, mɩ jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ.”

english_verse: When Moses had finished setting up the sacred tent, he dedicated it to the Lord, together with its furnishings, the altar, and its equipment.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la Mosis sɩ pɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la dɛrɛ, ʋ joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ tɩsɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kpɩɛraa kala, a joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩra joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ a sʋl Wɩa hɛ koru-la arɩ ʋ nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa kala ma lɛ, a joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa, ba dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩ ŋaa ba doho doho sɩpaalaaraa sɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ ba dɩɩsɛ, kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩaa kɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: “Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.”
translation_verse: “Laa kɩalɩŋ ba teeŋ a kaa tɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Laa a joŋo pɩ Levi doho nɩaa a magɛ ŋɩɩ nʋʋkala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ kaa tɩŋ.”

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis laa nɛ-ferisi-la arɩ torukoba-la, a joŋo pɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.
translation_verse: a bɩra joŋ nɛ-ferisi-la chori arɩ torukoba banɛsɛ a pɩ Mɛrarɩ doho nɩaa a magɛ ba ma tɩntɩŋŋaa. Arɔŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nanʋala Ɩtama nɛ faa beŋ ba kala.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.
translation_verse: Ama Mosis bɩ kɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala joŋo pɩ Kohaf doho nɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba tɩntɩmɩŋ nɛ ba chʋchʋŋ Wɩa dɩa kʋzɔmɔ-la.

english_verse: On the day the altar was dedicated, the twelve leaders brought offerings for its dedication.
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ taa koru-la lɛ, sɩpaalaara-la kɛŋ ba Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩaa kɔ koru-la sɩpaaŋ dɩ ba sʋl Wɩa a joŋ koru-la pɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to give his offering for the dedication.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Tapʋlɩɩ-kala, sɩpaalaara-la fii arɩ balɩa tʋɔŋ kʋbala nɛ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kɔ dɩ ma joŋ koru-la pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: rams a year old as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing.
translation_verse: Tapʋl-nibi chɛɛŋ, Gidioni nanʋala Abɩdaŋ sɩ ŋaa Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ kɛŋ ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kɔ.

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩaa La TƖƖNA teeŋ, ʋ nɩɩ La TƖƖNA yikoro Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la nii-tɔlɔ nyuŋ, kɩalɩŋ balɩa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ pɛgɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ dɩ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.”
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ dɩ ʋ nɩɩ chɛ ʋ joŋ chaana-la balɩpɛ a sagɛ chaaŋ-daa nyuŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ sagɛba dɩ ba pʋlʋmʋŋ chaana hɛ chaaŋ-daa-la sɩpaaŋ.”

english_verse: The lampstand was made of hammered gold from its base to the decorative flowers on top, exactly like the pattern the Lord had described to Moses. Instructions for Ordaining the Levites
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ba ŋaa chaaŋ-daala: Sɛlɩmɛ nɛ ba kaa libi, a chɩŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔ-chɛlɛ a kaa jɩl ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ tɩɩfɩɩlaa. Ba ŋaaʋ ʋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis nɛ. Ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ to a lɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: The Levites must be acceptable to me before they begin working at the sacred tent. So separate them from the rest of the Israelites
translation_verse: “Lɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ arɩ ʋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ ba sɩ hɛ nʋʋŋ a kɔ, a pɛ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ dɔŋɔ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent,
translation_verse: Kɛŋ Levi doho nɩaa kɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ sɩpaaŋ, aŋ yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kʋ hilimi.

english_verse: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ jaŋ joŋ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ a pɩmɛ, a nagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩaa ba sɩ kaa je, dɩ ba nɛ tɩtɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ Levi doho nɩaa joŋ ba nɩsaa a daŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrɔ-la balɩa nyusuŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋ kpʋ dɔŋɔ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, aŋ kpʋ dɔŋɔ ma a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ chɩŋ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ sɩpaaŋ, ka dɩ ŋ jomba a pɩmɛ, a nagɛ ba sɩ yie kɛŋ kɩaa je a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩmɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ŋ jaŋ to a lɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ, dɩ ba ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba arɩ ba pʋsʋŋ bii-bumbumba sɩ ŋaa belliŋ kala ŋaa mɩ kɩaa nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kpʋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba, mɩ leŋ ba-na nɛ dɩ ba ŋaa mɩ kɩaa.

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: Mɩ saa joŋ Levi doho nɩaa a hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala hambolibii bumbumba nyuŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala tʋɔŋ, mɩ lɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa nɛ a ŋaa zile pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ, dɩ ba laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ a tɩtɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa, aŋ pɛ pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ tɩta. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ mʋ kpagɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, dɩ wʋlɔrʋ sɩ́ ba jʋʋ.”

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelites made sure that the Levites did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis, Arɔŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kɛŋ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis.

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Levi doho nɩaa pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta aŋ chɛsɛ ba gɛnnɩŋ. Arɔŋ jomba hɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ yie kɛŋ kɩaa kaa je a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA ŋɩɩ, aŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa a pɩɩsɛ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta.

english_verse: After this, the Levites worked at the sacred tent as assistants to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ Levi doho nɩaa mʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ aa tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa. Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ faa bemba. Wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis nɛ ba ŋaa Levi doho nɩalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: They may help the other Levites in their duties, but they must no longer be responsible for any work themselves. Remember this when you assign their duties.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii jaŋ wuo pɛ ba naambiiriŋ lɛ dɩ ba tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa, ama ba-na tɩtɩa bɩ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ tɩntɩŋ nyuŋ. Ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ to a dagɛ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ Mosis Sɩnaɩ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ jɩ-lɩa tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-bumbuŋ. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: in the evening of the fourteenth day of this month and do it by following all the regulations.”
translation_verse: Má gbieli gbiele-la chɛŋ-bumbuŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa fii arɩ banɛsɛ chɛɛŋ wɩɩ-mul-jʋʋlʋŋ, a to wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ maga.”

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba gbieli gbiele-la Sɩnaɩ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tʋɔŋ tapʋl fii arɩ banɛsɛ chɛɛŋ wɩɩ-mul-jʋʋlʋŋ, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala arɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis.

english_verse: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord, and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Ama Iziral tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ bɩ wuo gbieli gbiele-la, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fa kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, a tɩŋ ba sɩ digi sʋʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sii kɔ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ teeŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa,

english_verse: “Even though we have touched a dead body, why can't we celebrate Passover and offer sacrifices to the Lord at the same time as everyone else?”
translation_verse: a pɩɛsɛ Mosis, “La kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ a tɩŋ la sɩ digi sʋʋŋ, ama ɛɛ nɛ la ma jaŋ ŋaa a wuo kɛŋ la Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kʋ pɩ La TƖƖNA bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kɔ ŋɩɩ?”

english_verse: Moses said, “Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩba, “Má gbɛrɛ, ka mɩ pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA a na wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma ŋaa.”

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, dɩ ba dɔŋɔ koo ba doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ to ba harɩŋ kɔ dɔŋɔ nɛ kɛŋ disiniŋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ digi sʋʋŋ, koo dɩ ʋ paala vɛŋ wombiiŋ ma aŋ ha chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ gbieli mɩ dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la, ʋ jaŋ wuo gbieli.

english_verse: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs,
translation_verse: Ba maga ba gbieli gbiele-la chɛŋ-lɩa tʋɔŋ tapʋl-fii arɩ banɛsɛ chɛɛŋ wɩɩ-mul-jʋʋlʋŋ. Ba jaŋ chaŋ gbiele-la pie-bie nammɩa aŋ dii boroboro sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ arɩ pɩpaa-haarɩŋ.

english_verse: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ maga dɩ ba chaŋ nammɩa-la aŋ ka dɩ ʋ chɩna chʋa, nammɩa-la haŋgbel ma bɩ maga dɩ ʋ yɛrɛ. Dɩ ba nɩɩ gbieli gbiele deeŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba to wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ maga nɛ.

english_verse: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, a bɩ wombiiŋ ma vɛnɛ aŋ vɩa dɩ ʋ gbieli gbiele-la, ʋ maga dɩ ma keri tɩɩna ta nɛ ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ vɩa dɩ ʋ kɛŋ gbiele-la Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kʋ pɩmɛ nɛ bʋa-la sɩ maga lɛ. Tɩɩna maga dɩ ʋ na hɛɛŋ nɛ a tɩŋ wʋbɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.
translation_verse: Dɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la nɛ chɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la nyuŋ tapʋlaa balɩa koo chɛnɛ koo jɩna, Iziral tɩmma-la ma yie hɔŋ ba buguŋ lɛ nɛ, ba bɩ sii. Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ sie, ba ma yie sii nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: Have someone make two trumpets out of hammered silver. These will be used to call the people together and to give the signal for moving your camp.
translation_verse: “Kɛŋ hɔpʋla libi banyilliŋ balɩa, a kɛmba ŋmʋʋ a yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ hɩhɛ dɔŋɔ, aŋ bɩra kɛmba ŋmʋʋ a bʋla pɩpɩba bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga dɩ ba sii ba dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: If both trumpets are blown, everyone is to meet with you at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ ŋmʋʋ banyilli-la kala balɩa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala maga ba kʋ hilimi ŋ sɩpaaŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But if just one is blown, only the twelve tribal leaders need to come together.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ kʋbala nɛ ba ŋmʋʋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho doho sɩpaalaara-la dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga ba kʋ hilimi ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Give a signal on a trumpet when it is time to break camp. The first blast will be the signal for the tribes camped on the east side, and the second blast will be the signal for those on the south.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ bɩra faasa ŋmʋʋ banyile-la dɔŋɔ lɩa, Iziral doho doho-la sɩ hɔŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ma nɛ jaŋ sii ba dɩhɔnʋŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ fɩɛla ŋmʋʋ banyile-la, ba jaŋ sii ba bugoo lɛ.

english_verse: But when you want everyone to come together, sound a different signal on the trumpet.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ ŋ yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ, ŋ jaŋ faasaa ŋmʋʋ banyilli-la.

english_verse: The priests of Aaron's family will be the ones to blow the trumpets, and this law will never change.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ maga ba ŋmʋŋmʋʋ banyilli-la. Ba dɩ ba doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord, will hear it and rescue you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ hɛ ma tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ laalɩŋ sii ma dɩ ma dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩɩ fʋgɛma pɛgɛ, má faasa ŋmʋʋ banyilli-la, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ nɩɩ a laama ta ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: During the celebration of the New Moon Festival and other religious festivals, sound the trumpets while you offer sacrifices. This will be a reminder that I am the Lord your God. The Israelites Begin Their Journey
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ gbieli ma tʋɔtɔrɛ-gbielee: chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbielee arɩ ma gbielee dɔnsʋŋ, a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ma nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, má maga dɩ ma ŋmʋʋ banyilliŋ deemba, a liliisi mɩ wɩaa. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.” Iziral tɩŋŋaa sii Sɩnaɩ lɛ

english_verse: On the twentieth day of the second month of that same year, the cloud over the sacred tent moved on.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti lɛ jɩ-lɩa tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-lɩa tapʋlaa mara chɛɛŋ, duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la sɩ tɔ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la nyuŋ, lee-la Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la sɩ hɛ, sii.

english_verse: So the Israelites broke camp and left the Sinai Desert. And some time later, the cloud stopped in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩmma-la lɩɩ Sɩnaɩ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ a gɔllɔ baarɛ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la mʋ chɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Paraŋ lɛ.

english_verse: This was the first time the Lord had told Moses to command the people of Israel to move on.
translation_verse: Ba bumbuŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ sie arɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ Mosis.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe,
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoro-la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ sii arɩ ba magɩlɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Juda buguŋ laalɩyuoroo, Ɩsaka laalɩyuoroo arɩ Zebuluŋ laalɩyuoroo. Amɩnadab nanʋala Nasɔŋ nɛ ŋaa Juda laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe,
translation_verse: Zʋaa nanʋala Nɛtanɛl ma nɛ ŋaa Ɩsaka doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.
translation_verse: Heloŋ nanʋala Ɛlɩab ma nɛ ŋaa Zebuluŋ doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba polli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la. Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Mɛrarɩ doho nɩaa kʋ lɩɩ paa chʋŋ, a sii to.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out second, carrying their banner. Elizur son of Shedeur was the leader of the Reuben tribe,
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoro-la sɩ sii tɩgɛ Gɛsɔŋ tɩŋŋaa arɩ Mɛrarɩ tɩŋŋaa lɛ arɩ ba magɩlɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Rubiŋ buguŋ laalɩyuoroo, Simioŋ laalɩyuoroo arɩ Gad laalɩyuoroo. Sediu nanʋala Elizu nɛ ŋaa Rubiŋ doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe,
translation_verse: Zurisadai nanʋala Sɛlʋmɩɛl ma nɛ ŋaa Simioŋ doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: Dʋɛl nanʋala Ɛlɩasaf ma nɛ ŋaa Gad doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: Next were the Kohathites, carrying the objects for the sacred tent, which was to be set up before they arrived at the new camp.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Kohaf doho nɩaa ma sii a paa Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tʋɔŋ kʋzɔmɔ-la a chʋŋ. Ʋ maga dɩ ba mʋ yiyi lee-la ba sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ, dɩ ba pɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la dɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe,
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoro-la ma sɩ sii tɩgɛ arɩ ba magɩlɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Efirem buguŋ laalɩyuoroo, Manasɛ laalɩyuoroo arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ laalɩyuoroo. Amihud nanʋala Ɛlɩsama nɛ ŋaa Efirem doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe,
translation_verse: Pedazu nanʋala Gamalɩɛl ma nɛ ŋaa Manasɛ doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: Gidioni nanʋala Abɩdaŋ ma nɛ ŋaa Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that camped alongside it were to protect the Israelites against an attack from behind, and so they marched last, carrying their banner. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of the tribe of Dan,
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoro-la ma sɩ sii to ba kala harɩŋ arɩ ba magɩlɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Daŋ buguŋ laalɩyuoroo, Asa laalɩyuoroo arɩ Nafɩtalɩ laalɩyuoroo. Amɩsadaɩ nanʋala Ahieza nɛ ŋaa Daŋ doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe,
translation_verse: Ɔkɩraŋ nanʋala Pagɩɛl ma nɛ ŋaa Asa doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.
translation_verse: Ɛnaŋ nanʋala Ahɩra ma nɛ ŋaa Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo sɩ sii vɛŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, “We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.”
translation_verse: Mosis ba-jene nɛ fa Rʋɛl. Rʋɛl ŋaa Midiaŋ tɩɩna nɛ. Ʋ nanʋala nɛ Hobab. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩ Hobab, “La kɛŋ la tɩtɩa nɛ dɩ la mʋ tintee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla. Kɔ dɩ la mʋ, la jaŋ kɛnɩŋ woruŋ. La TƖƖNA hɛ niiŋ nɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ pɩ la Iziral tɩŋŋaa.”

english_verse: “No, I won't go,” Hobab answered. “I'm returning home to be with my own people.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hobab bʋl, “Aɩ, mɩ bɩ mʋ, mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ mɩ tinteeŋ, mɩ nɩaa teeŋ.”

english_verse: “Please go with us!” Moses said. “You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.
translation_verse: Ama Mosis bʋl, “Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, sɩ́ la harɩŋ mɩɩrʋ, ŋ nɛ jɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ lee-la la sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ, ŋ nɛ jaŋ dagɛla.

english_verse: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ to la harɩŋ mʋ, wʋzɔŋ na-kala La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa la lɛ, ŋ ma jaŋ kɛŋ kpaalɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sii La TƖƖNA peel-la nyuŋ, a joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la, daga-la laa ba sɩpaaŋ ba vɛŋ tapʋlaa batori dɩ ʋ dagɛba lee-la ba sɩ jaŋ hɔnɔ wiesi.

english_verse: Each day as the Israelites began their journey, Moses would pray, “Our Lord, defeat your enemies and make them run!”
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la dɩ ba mʋ, Mosis yie bʋl, “La TƖƖNA, sii, a ŋmoo ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala pɩsɛ. Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩŋ cho nyɩɩgɛ ŋ sɩpaaŋ.”

english_verse: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, “Our Lord, stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩra mʋa dɩ ʋ chɩŋ ma, Mosis yie bʋl, “La TƖƖNA, mɩɩra kɔ, a hɛ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩ-dandaŋ-la teeŋ.”

english_verse: One day the Israelites started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard them and became so angry that he destroyed the outer edges of their camp with fire.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ suomo gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA teeŋ a tɩŋ hɛɛ-la ba sɩɩ na. La TƖƖNA nɩɩ, ʋ baanɩŋ sii ba nyuŋ, ʋ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ ba buguŋ sɛŋ-keree sɛsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ʋ dii.

english_verse: When the people begged Moses to help, he prayed, and the fire went out.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ ŋmoo niiŋ pɩ Mosis, ʋ sʋl La TƖƖNA, ʋ leŋ nyiŋ-la dɩsɛ.

english_verse: They named the place “Burning,” because in his anger the Lord had set their camp on fire. The People Grumble about Being Hungry
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɛ lee-la yɩrɩŋ Tabɩra, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩmɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ nyiniŋ dii ba dɩhɔnʋŋ sɛŋ-keree. La TƖƖNA pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa jɩmpɩrɩwɩɩba

english_verse: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, “We don't have any meat!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nammɩa hɩɛnɩŋ faasa kɛŋ nʋhʋɔra-la sɩ hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ. Iziral tɩmma-la bɩra ŋmoo niiŋ a bʋl, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ pɩla nammɩa dɩ la chaŋ?

english_verse: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.
translation_verse: La fa yie chaŋ chenfilee nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ pɛɩ, a dii bʋalaa, kakɩasɩŋ, arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ liik arɩ alabasaba arɩ tintee-hɛɛlɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Galɩk.

english_verse: But we're starving out here, and the only food we have is this manna.”
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ, la niiŋ kala nɛ kpʋa, ka la bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ a pɛ kʋdiile-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ‘Mana’ lɛ.”

english_verse: The manna was like small whitish seeds
translation_verse: Mana-la fa ŋaa kʋpʋla nɛ a nagɛ sɛrɛɛ biee.

english_verse: He prayed: I am your servant, Lord, so why are you doing this to me? What have I done to deserve this? You've made me responsible for all these people,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ ŋaa mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna ŋ-la? Wʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa cheyiŋ ŋ joŋ nɩaa deemba kala a nyagɛmɛ?

english_verse: but they're not my children. You told me to nurse them along and to carry them to the land you promised their ancestors.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ta nɩaa deemba, koo mɩ nɛ lʋlba? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ sɩ dɩ mɩ paaba nɔgɛ a nagɛ haala sɩ nɔgɛ bii-mulo a kɛmba kaa mʋ tintee-la ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ba naabalɩmaba arɩ ŋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba?

english_verse: This job is too much for me. How can I take care of all these people by myself?
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndʋŋa bɩ nɩaa deemba wuo beŋ, wɩɩ-la yuŋŋie kɩɩ mɩ nɛ.

english_verse: If this is the way you're going to treat me, just kill me now and end my miserable life! Seventy Leaders Are Chosen To Help Moses
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaamɛ ŋ-la, kpʋmɛ lɛɛlɛ, dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ na hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: While I am talking with you there, I will give them some of your authority, so they can share responsibility for my people. You will no longer have to care for them by yourself.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kʋ tuu ŋ teeŋ nɩmɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩŋ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ Dɩma-la mɩ sɩ joŋo hɛ ŋ lɛ mʋa a hɛ ba lɛ, dɩ ba laa nɩalɩŋ wʋwalɩmɩa-la dɔnsʋŋ, dɩ ʋ bɩra sɩ́ ŋ dʋndʋŋa chʋga ŋaa.

english_verse: As for the Israelites, I have heard them complaining about not having meat and about being better off in Egypt. So tell them to make themselves acceptable to me, because tomorrow they will have meat.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, dɩ ba pʋllɛ ba tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa, chie ba jaŋ chaŋ nammɩa, La TƖƖNA nɩa ma sɩ bunso nɛ a bʋl, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ pɩla nammɩa dɩ la chaŋ? La faa nɩɩ sɩma nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.’ Ŋɩɩ wɩaa La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɩma nammɩa dɩ ma chaŋ.

english_verse: . They turned against me and wanted to go back to Egypt. Now they will eat meat until they get sick of it.
translation_verse: ama ma jaŋ chaŋʋ chɛŋ piliŋ, dɩ ʋ fɩɩ ma mɩɩsɩŋ, a tɩŋ ma TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, ka ma vɩa ʋ wɩaa aŋ yiyel ʋ sɩpaaŋ a bʋl, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ paala tɩɩ la lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ?’ ”

english_verse: Even if we butchered all our sheep and cattle, or caught every fish in the sea, we wouldn't have enough to feed them.”
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ paala kpʋ piese-la arɩ nɛsɩ-la kala la sɩ kɛnɛ ma, ba bɩ baa vɔgɛ, koo dɩ la nɛ kɛsɛ chenfile-la kala sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ a pɩba ma, ba bɩ baa yi.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “I can do anything! Watch and you'll see my words come true.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Ŋ bɩɩna mɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ nɛ koo? Ŋ jaŋ na wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ jaŋ ŋaa koo ʋ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: Eldad and Medad were two leaders who had not gone to the tent. But when the Spirit took control of them, they began shouting like prophets right there in camp.
translation_verse: Nɩhɩasɩ-la mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii-la tʋɔŋ, baalaa balɩa ma nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Elidad, dɔŋɔ ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ Mɛdad. Ba-na fa bɩ lɛbɩ-la bʋbʋɔŋ mʋa, aŋ hɛ ba dɩ-hɔnɩɩ-la lɛ. Ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ nɛ aŋ ka Dɩma-la pɛ jʋʋba, ba ma bʋl wɩaa a nagɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa.

english_verse: A boy ran to Moses and told him about Eldad and Medad.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ bapʋɔsɩ-bie kʋbala lɩɩ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ a fá mʋ bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Elidad arɩ Mɛdad nɩɩ bʋl wɩaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ la dɩhɔnʋŋ.”

english_verse: Joshua was there helping Moses, as he had done since he was young. And he said to Moses, “Sir, you must stop them!”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, dɩ baal kʋbala hɛ nɩmɛ baa yɩrɛ Josua. Ʋ nyɩmma yɩrɩŋ nɛ Nuŋ. Ʋ bapʋɔsʋŋ kala lɛ nɛ ʋ pɛ Mosis lɛ ba tɩtɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ Mosis, kiri nɩalɩŋ balɩa dɩ ba sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “Are you concerned what this might do to me? I wish the Lord would give his Spirit to all his people so everyone could be a prophet.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis pɩɛsʋ, “Mɩ wɩaa ka wɩɩŋ nɛɛ? Mɩ-na tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ dɩ La TƖƖNA fa joŋ ʋ Dɩma-la a hɛ ʋ nɩaa kala lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa.”

english_verse: Some time later the Lord sent a strong wind that blew quails in from the sea until Israel's camp was completely surrounded with birds, piled up about a meter high for many kilometers in every direction.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA guu leŋ peliŋ lu a paa jɩmpɩrɩwɩɩba, a kaa lɩɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ kʋ kpagɛ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ a golli sɛmɛ na-kala, ba zɩzaarɛ tinteeŋ a magɛ naakieli bala. Tapʋl-piliŋ nɛ ŋ jaŋ vɛŋ aŋ-na yi ba dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: The people picked up quails for two days—each person filled at least ten large baskets. Then they spread them out to dry.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, nɩalɩŋ lɩɩ kɛsɛ jɩmpɩrɩwɩɩba-la wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala arɩ chɛ-lɩamɩŋ kala. Diibiisi-la nʋʋkala sɩ kɛsɛ yi bɔtɔ fii nɛ. Ba yie joŋo yieni a golli ba dɩhɔnʋŋ kala.

english_verse: But before the meat could be eaten, the Lord became angry and sent a deadly disease through the camp.
translation_verse: Ba chɩna dɩ ba chaŋ nammɩa-la nɛ, ka La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ, a joŋ nyanyal bɔŋ kʋbala hɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: After they had buried the people who had been so greedy for meat, they called the place “Graves for the Greedy.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɛ lee-la yɩrɩŋ Kɩbʋrɔf-Hataava, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ niiŋ fa sɩ sɩma sʋba nɛ woruŋ, ba hugiba nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Israel then broke camp and traveled to Hazeroth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sii Kɩbʋrɔf-Hataava lɛ a mʋ Hazɛrɔf, a hɔŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: and told Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to come to the entrance of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA guu bʋla pɩ Mosis, Arɔŋ arɩ Mɩrɩam, “Má kala batori kɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ.

english_verse: There the Lord appeared in a cloud and told Aaron and Miriam to come closer.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ sɩ nagɛ jebiiŋ lɛ, a kʋ tuu chɩŋ lɛbɩ-la boiŋ niiŋ, aŋ yɩrɛ Arɔŋ arɩ Mɩrɩam. Ba sɩ mʋa,

english_verse: Then after commanding them to listen carefully, he said: “I, the Lord, speak to prophets in visions and dreams.
translation_verse: ʋ bʋl, “Má jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋl. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ, mɩ yie kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa dagʋ a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ nɛ, aŋ bʋl wɩaa pʋ duoso lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord became angry with Aaron and Miriam. And after the Lord left
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ woruŋ ba nyuŋ aŋ viiri.

english_verse: and the cloud disappeared from over the sacred tent, Miriam's skin turned white with leprosy. When Aaron saw what had happened to her,
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mʋa ŋɩɩ, duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la sɩ chɩŋ lɛbɩ-la nyuŋ ma sii. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mɩrɩam yaraa kala guu pʋllɛ a nagɛ dayalɩma. Arɔŋ mɩɩra beŋ Mɩrɩam dɩ ʋ yalɩba.

english_verse: he said to Moses, “Sir, please don't punish us for doing such a foolish thing.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, sɩ́ la dɔgʋsʋ a tɩŋ la sɩ ŋaa nɩyaarɛ wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: Don't let Miriam's flesh rot away like a child born dead!”
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Mɩrɩam yaraa nagɛ haala sɩɩ lʋl bie dɩ ʋ sʋba, ʋ yaraa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ dii dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: But the Lord replied, “Miriam would be disgraced for seven days if her father had punished her by spitting in her face. So make her stay outside the camp for seven days, before coming back.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Dɩ Mɩrɩam nyɩmma nɛ tʋ nantʋɔrʋŋ hɛ ʋ sɩaa lɛ, hɩɩsɩŋ maga dɩ ʋ diiu nɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Lɩɩsʋ ta ma dɩhɔnʋŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ, ka dɩ ʋ-na mɩɩra kʋ jʋʋ.”

english_verse: The people of Israel did not move their camp until Miriam returned seven days later.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ Mɩrɩam ta ba dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩ lee-kala sii mʋ ka tapʋlɩa-la yi, ʋ bɩra mɩɩra kʋ jʋʋ.

english_verse: Then they left Hazeroth and set up camp in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ ba sii Hazɛrɔf lɛ a mʋ ŋmoo buguŋ Paraŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: In fact, we saw the Nephilim who are the ancestors of the Anakim. They were so big that we felt as small as grasshoppers.”
translation_verse: La paala na Anakɩ doho nɩaa nɩwaayiilee nɛ nɩmɛ. Anakɩ doho nɩalɩŋ nɛ ba ha yɩyɩrɛ Nefilim. La beŋ la tɩtɩa a nagɛ nyaŋgɩrɩgɛba nɛ ba sɩaa lɛ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ la sɛnɛ nagɛ ba teeŋ.”

english_verse: “Choose a leader from each tribe and send them into Canaan to explore the land I am giving you.”
translation_verse: “Iziral doho doho fii arɩ balɩa-la tʋɔŋ, lɩɩsɛ doho na-kala sɩpaalaarɩ-bala, a leŋ dɩ ba mʋ lʋara beŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ, lee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma.”

english_verse: So Moses sent twelve tribal leaders from Israel's camp in the Paran Desert
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɔŋ Paraŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, ka Mosis tɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaara-la arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Before Moses sent them into Canaan, he said: After you go through the Southern Desert of Canaan, continue north into the hill country
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ tɩmba dɩ ba mʋ lʋara beŋ Kɛnaŋ tintee-la ŋɩɩ, ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Má mʋ to Nɛgɛf a mʋ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga,

english_verse: and find out what those regions are like. Be sure to remember how many people live there, how strong they are,
translation_verse: a na ŋɩɩ tintee-la sɩ naga, a na dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ ŋaa nɩduoru nɛ koo nɩpʋgʋnʋ nɛ, ba ŋaa nɩ-daŋ nɛ koo ba muuro nɛ,

english_verse: and if they live in open towns or walled cities. See if the land is good for growing crops and find out what kinds of trees grow there. It's time for grapes to ripen, so try to bring back some of the fruit that grows there.
translation_verse: Má beŋ ba tinteeŋ ma a na dɩ ʋ sɩma nɛ koo ʋ bɩ sɩŋ, dɩ ʋ ŋaa lee sɩ kɛŋ tɩɩsɩŋ nɛ koo ʋ bɩ kɛnɛ. Má hɛ doluŋ aŋ pɛ kɛŋ tintee-la tɩɩnɛnɛɛ dɔnsʋŋ kɔ.”

english_verse: The twelve men left to explore Canaan from the Zin Desert in the south all the way to the town of Rehob near Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ, a chɩŋ Zɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ a beŋ tintee-la ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rehob sɩ kpagɛ Lebo-Hamaf.

english_verse: As they went through the Southern Desert, they came to the town of Hebron, which was seven years older than the Egyptian town of Zoan. In Hebron, they saw the three Anakim clans of Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai.
translation_verse: Ba to ŋɩɩ a jɩl Nɛgɛf dɩɩrɩŋ, a joŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ. Ahɩmaŋ, Sɛsaɩ arɩ Talɩmaɩ ŋaa Anakɩ doho nɩaa nɛ, ba nɛ fa hɛ Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: the twelve men returned to Kadesh in the Paran Desert and told Moses, Aaron, and the people what they had seen. They showed them the fruit
translation_verse: Ba kɔ Mosis, Arɔŋ arɩ Iziral tɩmma-la kala teeŋ Kɛdɛs sɩ hɛ Paraŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ na lee-la a pɩba aŋ pɛ kɛŋ tintee-la tɩɩnɛnɛ-la ma dagɛba.

english_verse: But the people who live there are strong, and their cities are large and walled. We even saw the three Anakim clans.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ dolie, ba tabalaa jalɩa ka ba saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli ba kala. La paala na Anakɩ doho nɩaa nɩwaayiilee nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Besides that, the Amalekites live in the Southern Desert; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites are in the hill country; and the Canaanites live along the Mediterranean Sea and the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa nɛ hɔŋ Nɛgɛf tinteeŋ lɛ, ka Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Jebus tɩŋŋaa arɩ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa hɔŋ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ, ka Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa ma hɔŋ a kpagɛ mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediterenia arɩ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la niiŋ.”

english_verse: Caleb calmed down the crowd and said, “Let's go and take the land. I know we can do it!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Kalɩb ŋaa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ pɩpɩ Mosis tɔrɛ ba niiŋ, ka ʋ bʋl, “Má leŋ dɩ la mʋ a yuo laa tintee-la, la jaŋ wuo yuo laaʋ.”

english_verse: But the other men replied, “Those people are much too strong for us.”
translation_verse: Ama ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ to dɔŋɔ mʋ tintee-la ma sɩ, “La bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ wuo chɩŋ, ba dolie kɩɩla nɛ.”

english_verse: Then they started spreading rumors and saying, “We won't be able to grow anything in that soil. And the people are like giants.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ dʋʋra nyɩɛ wɩaa a mʋʋ tɩgɛ tintee-la ba sɩ mʋ lʋara beŋ lɛ, a bʋl, “Tintee-la la sɩ mʋ lʋara beŋ, ʋ bɩ kʋdiilee kɛnɛ woruŋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa dii. Nɩalɩŋ ma la sɩ na nɩmɛ waa nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: and complained to Moses and Aaron, “We wish we had died in Egypt or somewhere out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Ba kala gʋrɩmɛ wɩaa Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ teeŋ, a bʋl, “La fa yaara sʋʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ koo tintee-hɩlɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, ʋ nɛ kpɩa.

english_verse: Is the Lord leading us into Canaan, just to have us killed and our women and children captured? We'd be better off in Egypt.”
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA kɛnla kɔ tinteeŋ deeŋ dɩ ba kpʋla laalɩŋ lɛ aŋ kɛsɛ la haalaa arɩ la biiriŋ? Ʋ bɩ jaŋ kpɩa dɩ la nɛ mɩɩra mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ?”

english_verse: Then they said to one another, “Let's choose our own leader and go back.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ, “Má leŋ dɩ la lɩɩsɛ sɩpaalaara dɩ ʋ mɩɩra kɛnla mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron bowed down to pray in front of the crowd.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ tuu tele chu Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: and said: We saw the land ourselves, and it's very good.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala, “Tintee-la la sɩ mʋ beŋ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If we obey the Lord, he will surely give us that land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Dɩ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɛ la nyuŋ, ʋ jaŋ kɛnla mʋ tinteeŋ deeŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ a joŋu pɩla.

english_verse: So don't rebel. We have no reason to be afraid of the people who live there. The Lord is on our side, and they won't stand a chance against us!
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ La TƖƖNA wɩɩkala vɩa, a sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ ma fá, la jaŋ yuo diiba. La TƖƖNA hɛ la teeŋ nɛ, ba bɩra bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ dɩ ba kaa pɔ ba tɩtɩa, má sɩ́ ba fá.”

english_verse: The crowd threatened to stone Moses and Aaron to death. But just then, the Lord appeared in a cloud at the sacred tent. Moses Prays for the People
translation_verse: Ama Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala bʋl arɩ ba jaŋ yagɛ Josua arɩ Kalɩb kpʋ arɩ tabɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA tʋla guu kʋ chaanɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ ʋ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “I have done great things for these people, and they still reject me by refusing to believe in my power.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA pɩɛsɛ Mosis, “Ɛɛ nɛ nɩaa deemba chɛ dɩ ba vɩamɛ a diene magɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩaa deemba bɩ mɩ laa dii arɩ mɩ sɩ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ arɩ wʋmagɩlaa magɛ ŋɩɩ ba tʋɔŋ?

english_verse: So they will no longer be my people. I will destroy them, but I will make you the ancestor of a nation even stronger than theirs.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ ba lɛ dɩ ba cheiba, aŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ-na kʋ ŋaa tintee sɩ jaŋ yʋgɛ a kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩba.”

english_verse: Show us your great power, Lord. You promised
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ La TƖƖNA, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, dagɛla ŋ doluŋ arɩ ŋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: that you love to show mercy and kindness. And you said that you are very patient, but that you will punish everyone guilty of doing wrong—not only them but their children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ bɩ lɩma lɩma ka sii, ŋ kɛŋ chonuŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a joŋ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ba wʋcheelee aa chɛba, a bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa chei ka leŋ pɛɩ. Ŋ yie dɔgɩsɛ nyɩmmaba biiriŋ arɩ ba nihee arɩ ba nihi-lɩɛrɛba a tɩŋ ba nyɩmmaba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: You are merciful, and you treat people better than they deserve. So please forgive these people, just as you have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ cho nɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ, joŋ nɩaa deemba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba arɩ ŋ fa sɩ joŋ ba wʋcheelee chɛba bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ.”

english_verse: But as surely as I live and my power has no limit,
translation_verse: Ama a tɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ sɛnɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, mɩ tʋla bɩ dʋnɩa lee-kala buo,

english_verse: I swear that not one of these Israelites will enter the land I promised to give their ancestors. These people have seen my power in Egypt and in the desert, but they will never see Canaan. They have disobeyed and tested me too many times.
translation_verse: ba kʋbala ma bɩ jaŋ na tintee-la mɩ sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩ ba naabalɩmaba. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩamɛ bɩ jaŋ na tintee-la.

english_verse: But my servant Caleb isn't like the others. So because he has faith in me, I will allow him to cross into Canaan, and his descendants will settle there.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ tɩntɩnna Kalɩb mɛlɛ bɩ ba naga, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ aa tomi. Mɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ mʋ tintee-la ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ mʋ beŋ. Ʋ doho nɩaa jaŋ tɩɩ tintee-la.

english_verse: Now listen, Moses! The Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valleys of Canaan. And tomorrow, you'll need to turn around and head back into the desert toward the Red Sea. The Israelites Are Punished for Complaining
translation_verse: Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa arɩ Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɔŋ fuonaa-la lɛ ŋɩɩ, chie má mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ a chaasɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ wombii-la ba sɩ to a mʋmʋ mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ,

english_verse: to give this message to the people of Israel: You sinful people have complained against me too many times! Now I swear by my own life that I will give you exactly what you wanted.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ bʋla, mɩ jaŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ pɩɛsaa chɛ.

english_verse: You will die right here in the desert, and your dead bodies will cover the ground. You have insulted me, and none of you men who are over
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ba dɩɩsʋ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ dɩɩsɛ nɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ gʋrɩmɛ wɩaa mɩ teeŋ, ba jaŋ sʋʋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: will enter the land that I solemnly promised to give you as your own—only Caleb and Joshua will go in.
translation_verse: Ma kʋbala ma bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ma hɔŋ nɩmɛ, see Jefuni nanʋala Kalɩb arɩ Nuŋ nanʋala Josua.

english_verse: You were worried that your own children would be captured. But I, the Lord, will let them enter the land you have rejected.
translation_verse: Ma biiri-la ma fa sɩ bʋla arɩ ba jaŋ kpʋma aŋ kɛsɛ, mɩ jaŋ kɛmba jʋʋ tintee-la ma sɩ vɩa, dɩ ba-na hɔŋ nɩmɛ, a nɩnɩɩ sɩma.

english_verse: You will die here in the desert!
translation_verse: Ama ma-na jaŋ sʋʋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: So they got up early the next morning and got ready to head toward the hill country of Canaan. They said, “We were wrong to complain about the Lord. Let's go into the land that he promised us.”
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla, ba sii a tʋʋlɛ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga a mʋmʋ. Ba sɩ, “Má leŋ dɩ la mʋ tintee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla, la jɩma la ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Ten of the men sent to explore the land had brought back bad news and had made the people complain against the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ tɩma ba mʋ a lʋara beŋ tintee-la, aŋ mɩɩra kɔ a dʋʋra nyɩɛ wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ tintee-la lɛ a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa gʋrɩmɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA teeŋ,

english_verse: So he sent a deadly disease that killed those men,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA joŋ nyanyal bɔŋ hɛ ba lɛ ba sʋʋ.

english_verse: but he let Joshua and Caleb live. The Israelites Fail To Enter Canaan (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ mʋ lʋara beŋ tintee-la kala tʋɔŋ, Nuŋ nanʋala Josua arɩ Jefuni nanʋala Kalɩb dʋndʋŋa nɛ bɩ sʋba.

english_verse: The Amalekites and the Canaanites came down from the hill country, defeated the Israelites, and chased them as far as the town of Hormah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa arɩ Kɛnaŋ tɩmma-la sɩ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ peelee sɩ yʋga sii kʋ tuu a yuo diiba, a kiriba ŋɩɩ a kʋ yi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɔma.

english_verse: The people of Israel were very sad after Moses gave them the Lord's message.
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ba faasa yel.

english_verse: so don't even try it. The Lord refuses to help you, because you turned your backs on him. The Amalekites and the Canaanites are your enemies, and they will attack and defeat you.”
translation_verse: Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa arɩ Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa jaŋ yuoma, bɛɛ wɩaa ma mɩɩrɛ La TƖƖNA harɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ to ma harɩŋ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diima.”

english_verse: But the Israelites ignored Moses and marched toward the hill country, even though the sacred chest and Moses did not go with them.
translation_verse: Arɩ Mosis sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ kala, ba bɩ ʋ niiŋ nɩa, aŋ sii jɩl tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga, ka Mosis arɩ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la-na hɛ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to give the Israelites the following laws about offering sacrifices:
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: Dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ,

english_verse: Bulls or rams or goats are the animals that you may burn on the altar as sacrifices to please me. You may also offer sacrifices voluntarily or because you made a promise, or because they are part of your regular religious ceremonies. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ nɛŋ koo piese kɔ dɩ ma ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩgɛ dɩ ʋ sʋɔra sɩŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koo dɩ pʋna nɛ ma kpʋ aa sʋl, dɩ niiŋ nɛ maa chɛ ma lɩɩsɛ koo dɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ, koo dɩ gbiele Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ,

english_verse: If you sacrifice a young ram or goat, you must also offer a kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of olive oil as a grain sacrifice. A liter of wine must also be poured on the altar.
translation_verse: Kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ na-kala ŋ sɩ kɛŋ pie-bie sʋl koo pʋna kala ŋ sɩ kpʋa a pɩ Wɩa, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ loŋ arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ kʋ sʋl kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: you must offer three kilograms of flour mixed with two liters of olive oil.
translation_verse: pɛ kɛŋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ gbaŋa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a joŋ nʋʋŋ lonnuŋ batori a hɛ.

english_verse: Two liters of wine must also be poured on the altar. The smell of this smoke is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Pɛ kɛŋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ lonnuŋ batori ma kʋ sʋl kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ŋ jaŋ nyɩgɛ kɩaa deemba a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩmɛ.

english_verse: If you are a native Israelite, you must obey these rules each time you offer a bull, a ram, or a goat as a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩɩna maga dɩ ʋ to wombii-la nɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kɔ dɩ ʋ nyɩgɛ dɩ ba sʋɔra sɩŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: This law will never change. I am the Lord, and I consider all people the same, whether they are Israelites or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Niiri-la arɩ wombie-la kala ma sɩ jaŋ tuto tɩtɩa nɛ nʋhʋɔra-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ ma jaŋ tuto.”

english_verse: When you eat food in the land that I am giving you, remember to set aside some of it as an offering to me.
translation_verse: dɩ ma kʋdiilee nɛ wasa tintee-la lɛ dɩ ma didii, má lɩɩsɛ dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kɩaa, dɩ ma kaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩmɛ.

english_verse: From the first batch of bread dough that you make after each new grain harvest, make a loaf of bread and offer it to me, just as you offer grain.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ tintee-la kʋdii falaa wasɛ boroboro a kaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩmɛ, a nagɛ ma sɩ yie ŋmoo ma mɩaa a ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses to tell the people what must be done if they ever disobey his laws:
translation_verse: a chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ to ʋ lɛ a dagɛ wɩalɩŋ pɩma, ʋ maga ma dɩ ma doho nɩaa kala kɛmba tɩtɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If all of you disobey one of my laws without knowing it, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice, a wine offering, and a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ perige wɩaa deemba kʋŋkala lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ma kɛŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ a kʋ sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA, arɩ ʋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ʋ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a kɛŋ gbuŋgbogo a sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, arɩ mɩ sɩ dagɛ ma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Then the priest will pray and ask me to forgive you. And since you did not mean to do wrong, and you offered sacrifices,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ pɩɩsɛ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala disiniŋ ta, dɩ mɩ joŋo chɛma, bɛɛ wɩaa ma bɩ jɩŋ aŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la aŋ kɛŋ ma kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kɔ dɩ ma pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la ma sɩ ŋaa chei.

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong without knowing it, you must sacrifice a year-old female goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ nɩbala nɛ bɩ jɩŋ aŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kʋŋ chei, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ bʋ-keeŋ sɩ yi jɩna a kʋ sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: The priest will then ask me to forgive you, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ pɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ jɩŋ aŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la chei disiniŋ ta mɩ sɩpaaŋ dɩ mɩ joŋo chɛʋ.

english_verse: The law will be the same for anyone who does wrong without meaning to, whether an Israelite or a foreigner living among you.
translation_verse: Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna koo dɩ nʋhʋɔra-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ kʋŋ nɛ bɩ jɩŋ aŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kʋŋ chei, wombii-bala-la nɛ maga ma kala to.

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong on purpose, whether Israelite or foreigner, you have sinned against me by disobeying my laws. You will no longer belong to my people. A Man Put to Death for Gathering Firewood on the Sabbath
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ gʋʋnɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA wʋbʋlaa nɛ aŋ chei wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga. Má chaasa keri tɩɩna ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ, ʋ wʋbɔŋ-la jaŋ nyʋa ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.” Ba kpʋ baal-la sɩ chei chɛ-wiesii-la wombiiŋ

english_verse: Once, while the Israelites were traveling through the desert, a man was caught gathering firewood on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, ba kɛŋ baal kʋbala dɩ ʋʋ jaa daasɩŋ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ.

english_verse: He was taken to Moses, Aaron, and the rest of the community.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ naʋ kɛnʋ kaa mʋ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala teeŋ.

english_verse: But no one knew what to do with him, so he was not allowed to leave.
translation_verse: Ba kɛnʋ tɔ hɛ dɩa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la lɛ ba ha bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Tell the people to take that man outside the camp and stone him to death!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Baal-la maga dɩ ma kpʋʋ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala maga dɩ ba kɛnʋ lɩɩ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ a yagʋ kpʋ arɩ tabɩaa.”

english_verse: So he was killed, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Tassels on the People's Clothes
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kɛnʋ lɩɩ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ a yagʋ kpʋ arɩ tabɩaa, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa yɛrɛ jʋɔsaa hɛ ba gɛnnɩŋ niipinee lɛ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Sew tassels onto the bottom edge of your clothes and tie a blue string to each tassel.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ‘Ma doho kala lɛ a kaa mʋ, má kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine a yɛrɛ jʋɔsaa a hɛ ma gɛnnɩŋ niipinee lɛ.

english_verse: These will remind you that you must obey my laws and teachings. And when you do, you will be dedicated to me and won't follow your own sinful desires.
translation_verse: Dɩ jʋɔsaa deemba nɛ hɛ ma gɛnnɩŋ niipinee lɛ a liliisima wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma dɩ ma tutoba, ma jaŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma a ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God who led you out of Egypt.”
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ kɛmma lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa ma Wɩa. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.’ ”

english_verse: Korah son of Izhar was a Levite from the Kohathite clan. One day he called together Dathan, Abiram, and On from the Reuben tribe, and the four of them decided to rebel against Moses. So they asked
translation_verse: a nyɛsɛ Mosis nyuŋ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii-la ba sɩ lɩɩsa, nʋʋkala jɩmba woruŋ, ma sii chɩŋ ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: and Aaron and said, “Why do you think you're so much better than everyone else? We're part of the Lord's holy people, and he's with all of us. What makes you think you're the only ones in charge?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala sii kʋ nyɛsɛ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ nyuŋ, a bʋla pɩba, “Ma ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kieli nɛ, la Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. La TƖƖNA hɛ la kʋŋkala teeŋ nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma joŋ ma tɩtɩa arɩ ma nɛ kɩɩ la Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala?”

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he knelt down to pray.
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ tuu tele chu.

english_verse: Then he said to Korah and his followers: Tomorrow morning the Lord will show us the person he has chosen to be his priest, and that man will faithfully serve him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bʋla pɩ Kora arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “Chie chʋchʋɔŋ La TƖƖNA jaŋ dagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa ʋ nʋʋ arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ʋ teeŋ. Nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa, ʋ jaŋ kɛnʋ mʋ kpagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: Korah, here is what you and your followers must do: Get some fire pans, fill them with coals and incense, and place them near the sacred tent. And the man the Lord chooses will be his priest. Korah, this time you Levites have gone too far!
translation_verse: Chie ma chaanɛ nyiniŋ hɛ a hɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ, a kaa mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Nɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsa nɛ jaŋ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ʋ teeŋ. Ma-na Levi doho nɩaa, ma nɛ ŋaa kieli.”

english_verse: You know that the God of Israel has chosen you Levites from all Israel to serve him by being in charge of the sacred tent and by helping the community to worship in the proper way. What more do you want?
translation_verse: ma bɩɩna wʋbie nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsɛma ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a leŋ ma nɛ kpagʋ a tɩtɩŋ ʋ dɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ, aŋ laa ba sɩpaaŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ baa?

english_verse: The Lord has given you a special responsibility, and now, Korah, you think you should also be his priest.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ joŋ wɩɩŋ magɛ ŋ-la a pɩ ma Levi doho nɩaa, aŋ ka ma ha bɩra chɩchɛ dɩ ma laa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tɩntɩŋŋaa ma,

english_verse: You and your followers have rebelled against the Lord, not against Aaron.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nyuŋ nɛ ŋ dɩ ŋ harɩ-tooroo kala nyɛsɛ ŋɩɩ, Arɔŋ nyuŋ dee. Arɔŋ ma nɛ kʋbɛɛ?”

english_verse: Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, but they sent back this message: “We won't come!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis tɩma yɩrɛ Ɛlɩab hambolibiisiŋ Dataŋ arɩ Abɩram. Ba sɩ, “La bɩ kɔ.

english_verse: It's bad enough that you took us from our rich farmland in Egypt to let us die here in the desert. Now you also want to boss us around!
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩɩna wʋbie nɛ ŋ ŋaa la lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋ sɩ kɛnla lɩɩ tintee-la sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ, a kɛnla kɔ tintee-hɩlɩŋ deeŋ lɛ dɩ la sʋʋ, aŋ ha chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ fʋfʋgɛla?

english_verse: Moses was very angry and said to the Lord, “Don't listen to these men! I haven't done anything wrong to them. I haven't taken as much as a donkey.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis chaasa na baanɩŋ, a bʋla pɩ La TƖƖNA, “Sɩ́ ba Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ laa, mɩ ha bɩ ba kʋŋkala kakumo kaa laa, mɩ ha bɩ ba kʋŋkala wɩɩ ma cheye.”

english_verse: Then he said to Korah, “Tomorrow you and your followers must go with Aaron to the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bʋla pɩ Kora, “Ŋ dɩ ŋ harɩ-tooro-la arɩ Arɔŋ chie kɔ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Each of you take along your fire pan with incense in it and offer the incense to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩ ŋ harɩ-tooroo zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii-la kʋŋkala joŋ kʋ-la lɛ ba sɩ yie hɛ nyiniŋ aa nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ, a chaanɛ nyiniŋ hɛ, a hɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a kaa kɔ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.”

english_verse: The next day the men placed incense and coals in their fire pans and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kʋŋkala joŋ ʋ kʋa a hɛ nyiniŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋ-la. Ba dɩ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ kala mʋ chɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, Korah had convinced the rest of the Israelites to rebel against their two leaders. When that happened, the Lord appeared in all his glory
translation_verse: Kora sɩ kɛŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la ba chɩna chaasɛ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA tʋla guu chaanɛ a hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala lɛ.

english_verse: and said to Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ,

english_verse: “Get away from the rest of the Israelites so I can kill them at once!”
translation_verse: “Má lɩɩ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ ka dɩ mɩ dɛrɛba lɛɛlɛ.”

english_verse: But the two men bowed down and prayed, “Our God, you gave these people life. Why would you punish everyone here when only one man has sinned?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ tuu tele chu aŋ ŋmoo niiŋ, “Ou Wɩa, ŋ nɛ ŋaa nuhuobiine mɩɩsɩŋ, nɩbala wʋbɔmʋŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ na baanɩŋ ŋ nɩaa kala nyuŋ?”

english_verse: The Lord answered Moses,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: “Tell the people to stay away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.”
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala dɩ ba sʋrɩsa lɩɩ, aŋ ka Dataŋ, Abɩram arɩ Kora arɩ ba lɛŋŋɛɛ.”

english_verse: Moses walked over to Dathan and Abiram, and the other leaders of Israel followed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis sii, Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ to ʋ harɩŋ ba mʋ Dataŋ arɩ Abɩram teeŋ.

english_verse: Then Moses warned the people, “Get away from the tents of these sinful men! Don't touch anything that belongs to them or you'll be wiped out.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis chaasa bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala, “Má sʋrɩsa lɩɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba lɛŋŋɛɛ bʋbʋɔŋ. Má sɩ́ ba kʋŋkala digu. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba wʋbɔŋ-la jaŋ pɛ diima.”

english_verse: Moses said to the crowd, “The Lord has chosen me and told me to do these things—it wasn't my idea. And here's how you will know:
translation_verse: Mosis bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Ŋ-la lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ to a jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba, mɩ tɩtɩa wʋchɛɛlɛɛ dee mɩɩ ŋaa:

english_verse: If these men die a natural death, it means the Lord hasn't chosen me.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa deemba sʋʋŋ nɛ yie dɩ ba sʋʋ, ka Wɩa bɩ ba dɔgɩsɔ, ŋɩɩ-na La TƖƖNA dee bɩ mɩ tɩma.

english_verse: But suppose the Lord does something that has never been done before. For example, what if a huge crack appears in the ground, and these men and their families fall into it and are buried alive, together with everything they own? Then you will know they have turned their backs on the Lord!”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ nɩaa ha sɩ bɩ na aŋ ka, a leŋ dɩ tinteeŋ suri a paa ba dɩ ba kɩaa kala liŋ kʋweyee, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ nɩaa deemba fa vɩa La TƖƖNA wɩaa nɛ.”

english_verse: As soon as Moses said this, the ground under the men opened up
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba aa dɛrɛ, dɩ lee-la Dataŋ arɩ Abɩram sɩ chɩna suro,

english_verse: and swallowed them alive, together with their families and everything they owned. Then the ground closed back up, and they were gone.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ suro a paaba liŋ kʋweyee nɛ, ba dɩ ba kɩaa kala nyɩɩgɛ ba nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites heard their screams, so they ran off, shouting, “We don't want that to happen to us!”
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma-la kala fa sɩ hɛ lee-la a nɩɩ ba yele, ba fá aŋ bʋl, “Tinteeŋ ka chɛ ʋ paa la ma liŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent a fire that burned up the
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ nyiniŋ kʋ dii sɩpaalaara-la zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii sɩɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron's son Eleazar to take the fire pans from the smoldering fire and scatter the coals. The pans are now sacred,
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Elieza, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Arɔŋ nanʋala, dɩ ʋ mʋ chaarɛ kɩalɩŋ lɛ ba sɩ yie hɛ nyiniŋ aa nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ nyiniŋ sɩ dii nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ, a kɛŋ nyɩŋ-hala-la mʋ bɩsa ta dɩ-bolii mʋa, bɛɛ wɩaa kɩalɩŋ ŋaa kɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: because they were used for offering incense to me. Have them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar. Those men died because of their sin, and now their fire pans will become a warning for the rest of the community.”
translation_verse: Paa nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la a sʋʋ kɩalɩŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a kaa libi pɩrataba a joŋo tɔ koru-la, ʋ ŋɩɩ jaŋ ŋaa chagɩlɩna a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Ba sɩ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ lɛ ba sɩ yie hɛ nyiniŋ aa nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ŋɩɩ, ba bɩrɩmɛ kʋzɔmɔ nɛ mɩ teeŋ.”

english_verse: Eleazar collected the pans and had them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Elieza mʋ a paa ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ libi kɩalɩŋ lɛ ba sɩ yie hɛ nyiniŋ aa nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a kaa libi pɩrataba dɩ ʋ kaa tɔ koru-la,

english_verse: just as the Lord had told Moses. The pans were a warning to the Israelites that only Aaron's descendants would be allowed to offer incense to the Lord. Anyone else who tried to would be punished like Korah and his followers. The Israelites Rebel and Are Punished
translation_verse: arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ to Mosis lɛ a dagʋ ŋɩɩ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ liliisi Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala, dɩ Arɔŋ doho nʋʋ dee bɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ nyɩga mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, ka dɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa ʋ sɩ joŋo ŋaa Kora arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo lɛ a ŋaa tɩɩna lɛ.

english_verse: The next day the people of Israel again complained against Moses and Aaron, “The two of you killed some of the Lord's people!”
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ teeŋ a bʋl, “Ma kpʋ La TƖƖNA nɩaa nɛ.”

english_verse: As the people crowded around them, Moses and Aaron turned toward the sacred tent, and the Lord appeared in his glory in the cloud covering the tent.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ sɛyɛ sɩ mɩɩra chaasa lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, ba na dɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ guu kʋ tɔ lɛbɩ-la kala, ka La TƖƖNA tʋla chaanɛ.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron walked to the front of the tent,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ mʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: where the Lord said to them,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: “Stand back! I am going to wipe out these Israelites once and for all.” They immediately bowed down and prayed.
translation_verse: “Má sʋrɩsa lɩɩ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ, ka dɩ mɩ kpʋ ba kala lɛɛlɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tuu tele chu tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron, “Grab your fire pan and fill it with hot coals from the altar. Put incense in it, then quickly take it to where the people are and offer it to the Lord, so they can be forgiven. The Lord is very angry, and people have already started dying!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ, “Mʋ joŋ ŋ kʋ-la lɛ ŋ sɩ yie hɛ nyiniŋ aa nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ, a chaanɛ nyiŋ-halaa koru-la lɛ a hɛ, a hɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a ŋaa lɩma mʋ nɩalɩŋ kala teeŋ a pɩɩsɛ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta. La Tɩɩna chaasa na baanɩŋ nɛ nɩalɩŋ nyuŋ, a joŋ nyanyal bɔmʋŋ hɛ ba lɛ, ʋ suomo kpʋkpʋba.”

english_verse: Aaron walked back and stood with Moses at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Nyanyal bɔŋ-la sɩ kʋ dɛrɛ, Arɔŋ mɩɩra mʋ Mosis teeŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: Place these sticks in the tent right in front of the sacred chest where I appear to you.
translation_verse: Joŋ dantɩgɩsɩ-la bil lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ tʋɔŋ, mɩ niiriŋ daga-la sɩpaaŋ lee-la mɩ sɩ yie kɔ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: I will then choose a man to be my priest, and his stick will sprout. After that happens, I won't have to listen to any more complaints about you.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa dantɩga jaŋ tɔsɛ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa, ʋ jaŋ giri wɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ yie vɛnɛɛ gʋrɩmɛ ma teeŋ a ta.”

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had commanded, and they gave him the walking sticks from the twelve tribal leaders, including Aaron's from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ba doho doho fii arɩ balɩa-la sɩpaalaarʋ kala kɛŋ ʋ dantɩga kɔ, Arɔŋ ma kʋa pɛ.

english_verse: Moses took them and placed them in the Lord's sacred tent.
