english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. On that day you must rest from all work and come together for worship. Show sorrow for your sins by going without food,
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-pɛɩ-la tʋɔŋ tapʋl fii chɛɛŋ, má vɔɔ niiŋ a sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ, aŋ hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and bring to the altar one young bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ, pie-bele arɩ pie-bel-pɔrɔɔ balɩpɛ sɩ yi jɩna jɩna, a kaa kʋ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩmɛ. Pʋsʋ-la kʋŋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nyɔɔ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Nɛ-bele-la lɛ, má hɛ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ kuokuo gbaŋa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a hɛ nʋʋŋ, a hɛ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ gbaŋa pie-bele-la ma lɛ.

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: Pie-bel-pɔrɔɔ-la ma kʋŋkala lɛ, má ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ kuokuo gbaŋa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a hɛ nʋʋŋ.

english_verse: A goat must also be sacrificed for the sins of the people. You will offer these sacrifices in addition to the sacrifice to ask forgiveness and the regular daily sacrifices. The Sacrifices during the Festival of Shelters (Leviticus
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ gbuŋgbogo ma a pɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ-la ma sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa a pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ ta lɛ, a pɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ʋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa lɛ. Gbiele-la ba sɩ yie gbieli a hɛ lɛŋŋɛɛ

english_verse: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-pɛɩ-la tʋɔŋ tapʋl-fii arɩ banɔŋ chɛɛŋ, má hilimi mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ, aŋ sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ. Má gbieli tapʋlaa balɩpɛ a zil mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the rams,
translation_verse: Nɛ-bel-pɔrɔ-la fii arɩ batori kʋŋkala lɛ, má ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ gbaŋa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, a hɛ nʋʋŋ. Pie-belli-la balɩa ma kʋŋkala lɛ, má ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ gbaŋa pɛ.

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: Pie-bel-pɔrɔ-la ma fii arɩ banɔŋ kʋŋkala lɛ, má ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ gbaŋa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a pɛ.

english_verse: You must also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These are to be offered in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ gbuŋgbogo ma a pɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ʋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ʋ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: For the next six days of the festival, you will sacrifice one less bull than the day before, so that on the seventh day, seven bulls will be sacrificed. The other sacrifices and offerings must remain the same for each of these days.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ gbuŋgbogo ma a pɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a saa pɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa lɛ arɩ ʋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɛ ʋ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: On the eighth day, you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship.
translation_verse: Tapʋl-chori chɛɛŋ, má hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ a sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ.

english_verse: Bring to the altar one bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ nɛ-bele, pie-bele arɩ pie-bel-pɔrɔɔ balɩpɛ sɩ yi jɩna jɩna kʋ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩmɛ. Pʋsʋŋ deemba kʋŋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nyɔɔ.

english_verse: You must also offer the proper grain sacrifices and drink offerings of wine with each animal.
translation_verse: Nɛ-bele-la, pie-bele-la arɩ pie-bel-pɔrɔ-la kʋŋkala lɛ, má ŋaa ba mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ba kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a magɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ dagɛma.

english_verse: And offer a goat as the sacrifice to ask forgiveness for the people. These sacrifices are made in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ gbuŋgbogo ma a pɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a saa pɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa lɛ arɩ ʋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɛ ʋ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: You must offer all these sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, together with any offerings that are voluntarily given or given because of a promise.
translation_verse: Gbielee deemba kala ma sɩ jaŋ gbigbieli lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ má joŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, a saa pɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩmɛ a lɩɩsɛ niiri-la ma sɩ hɛ, arɩ ma tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa.”

english_verse: Moses told the people of Israel everything the Lord had told him about the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to Israel's tribal leaders:
translation_verse: Mosis bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho doho nɩhɩasɩŋ, “Ŋ-la nɛ La TƖƖNA dagɛ:

english_verse: Suppose a young woman who is still living with her parents makes a promise to the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɩ hantolibie nɛ ha hɛ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa lɛ aŋ hɛ niiŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ pɩ La TƖƖNA, koo dɩ ʋ ŋmɩɛsa nɛ arɩ ʋ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ,

english_verse: If her father hears about it and says nothing, she must keep her promise.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ nyɩmma nɛ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ aŋ bɩ wɩɩ bʋla, nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ arɩ ŋmɩaŋ-la jaŋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: But if he hears about it and objects, then she no longer has to keep her promise. The Lord will forgive her, because her father did not agree with the promise.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ nyɩmma nɛ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ a bɩ sɛyɛ, nii-la arɩ ŋmɩaŋ-la kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋo chɛʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nyɩmma bɩ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: But if her husband hears about the promise and objects, she no longer has to keep it, and the Lord will forgive her.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ bala nɛ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ a bɩ sɛyɛ, nii-la arɩ ŋmɩaŋ-la bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋo chɛʋ.

english_verse: If her husband hears about the promise and says nothing, she must do what she said.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ bala nɛ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ aŋ bɩ wɩɩ bʋla, nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ arɩ ŋmɩaŋ-la jaŋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: But if he hears about the promise and does object, she no longer has to keep it. The Lord will forgive her, because her husband would not allow her to keep the promise.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ bala nɛ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ a bɩ sɛyɛ, nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ arɩ ŋmɩaŋ-la bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋo chɛʋ.

english_verse: Her husband has the final say about any promises she makes to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ʋ bala kɛŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ nii-la arɩ ŋmɩaŋ-la chɩŋ koo ʋ leŋ ba sɩ́ chɩŋ.

english_verse: If her husband hears about a promise and says nothing about it for a whole day, she must do what she said—since he did not object, the promise must be kept.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ bala nɛ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ aŋ bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla a yi tapʋlɩɩ, nii-la ʋ sɩ ta arɩ ŋmɩaŋ-la jaŋ chɩŋ. Haal-la maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But if he waits until the next day to stop her from keeping her promise, he is the one who must be punished.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ bala-la nɛ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ a leŋ dɩ tapʋlɩɩ kieli ka dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩɩ, ʋ nɛ jaŋ mɩɩra laa cheeriŋ.”

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave Moses about husbands and wives, and about young daughters who still live at home.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ Mosis a mʋʋ tɩgɛ baala arɩ ʋ haala pɛgɛ, arɩ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ tolo ha sɩ bɩ bala jaa aŋ hɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ pɛgɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: “Before you die, make sure that the Midianites are punished for what they did to Israel.”
translation_verse: “Midiaŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ, joŋ ba chɩmɩŋ a tiŋ ba lɛ, ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ.”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “The Lord wants to punish the Midianites. So tell our men to prepare for battle.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, “Má chaarɛ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ yuo Midiaŋ tɩŋŋaa a tiŋ chɩŋ-la arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Twelve thousand men were picked from the tribes of Israel, and after they were prepared for battle,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ doho kala lɩɩsɛ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ. Ba kala ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩa a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa dɩ ba mʋ laal-la.

english_verse: Moses sent them off to war. Phinehas the son of Eleazar went with them and took along some things from the sacred tent and the trumpets for sounding the battle signal.
translation_verse: Mosis leŋe Elieza nanʋala Finihas Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ kɛmba mʋ laal-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Finihas paa kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩa lɛ, a pɛ paa banyilliŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋmʋʋ bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩba.

english_verse: The Israelites fought against the Midianites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. They killed all the men,
translation_verse: Ba mʋ a yuo Midiaŋ tɩmma-la arɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis a kpʋ ba baalaa kala.

english_verse: including Balaam son of Beor and the five Midianite kings, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ ŋaa Midiaŋ kuoroo deemba banɔŋ: Evi, Rekim, Zuu, Huu, arɩ Reba. Ba fa pɛ kpʋ Bioo nanʋala Balam ma nɛ laal-la lɛ.

english_verse: The Israelites captured every woman and child, then led away the Midianites' cattle and sheep, and took everything else that belonged to them.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa yuo dii Midiaŋ tɩŋŋaa kala nɛ a kɛsɛ ba haalaa, ba biiriŋ, ba nɛsɩŋ arɩ piesee, a paa ba dʋa kala.

english_verse: They also burned down the Midianite towns and villages.
translation_verse: Ba nyɩgɛ Midiaŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɔŋ tabala-la lɛ arɩ ba bugoo kala.

english_verse: Israel's soldiers gathered together everything they had taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba paa kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ yuo dii a pɛ pʋsʋŋ arɩ nuhuobiine lɛ,

english_verse: Then they returned to their own camp in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, where Moses, Eleazar, and the other Israelite leaders met the troops outside camp.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Elieza arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaara-la kala lɩɩ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ a chemba.

english_verse: and said, “I can't believe you let the women live!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma bɩ haala-la ma kala kpʋa?

english_verse: You must put to death every boy and all the women who have ever had sex.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, má kpʋ hambolibiisi-la kala aŋ kpʋ haala-la kala sɩ jɩŋ baalaa.

english_verse: But do not kill the young women who have never had sex. You may keep them for yourselves.”
translation_verse: Ama má leŋ hantolibiisi-la ha sɩ bɩ baalaa jɩŋ. Ma nɛ tɩɩba.

english_verse: Then Moses said to the soldiers, “If you killed anyone or touched a dead body, you are unclean and have to stay outside the camp for seven days. On the third and seventh days, you must go through a ceremony to make yourselves and your captives clean.
translation_verse: Ma Iziral tɩmma-la kala sɩ kpʋ nɩaa koo a digi sʋʋnʋŋ, ma sɩ kʋ jʋʋ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ a yi tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Má hɛ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ harɩŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Tapʋl-tori arɩ tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ maga dɩ ma pɩɩsɛ ma dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ yuo kɛsɛ disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: Then wash your clothes and anything made from animal skin, goat's hair, or wood.”
translation_verse: Má to pɩɩsɛ ma gɛnnɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kɛŋ tenniŋ koo bʋʋna pʋnaa koo daaŋ a ŋaa disiniŋ ta.”

english_verse: Eleazar then explained, “If you need to purify something that won't burn, such as gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, or lead, you must first place it in a hot fire. After you take it out, sprinkle it with the water that purifies. Everything else should only be sprinkled with the water. Do all of this, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
translation_verse: koo kʋŋ na-kala sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ nyiniŋ aŋ bɩ dii, má joŋo hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ama ʋ maga dɩ ma ha kɛŋ lɩɩ-la ba sɩ kaa pɩpɩɩsɛ disiniŋ a pɩɩsɛba nɛ. Kʋŋ na-kala sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ nyiniŋ a dii, má kɛŋ lɩɩ-la ba sɩ kaa pɩɩsɛ disiniŋ dʋndʋŋa a chɛsɛ.

english_verse: Wash your clothes on the seventh day, and after that, you will be clean and may return to the camp.” Everything Taken from the Midianites Is Divided
translation_verse: Tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ ma chɛsɛ ma gɛnnɩŋ, dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ma bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ma jaŋ wuo kʋ jʋʋ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ.” Ba kɛŋ dʋa-la ba sɩ yuo laa kpaa

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: Make a list of everything taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals. Then divide them between the soldiers and the rest of the people. Eleazar the priest and the family leaders will help you.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo laa a kpaa leree balɩa, a joŋ dɔŋɔ pɩ laalɩyuoro-la, aŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ ma pɩ Iziral tɩmma-la nɩkaanaa.

english_verse: From the half that belongs to the soldiers, set aside for the Lord one out of every
translation_verse: Joŋo pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Elieza, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA toruŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: So we want to give the Lord all the gold jewelry we took from the Midianites. It's our gift to him for watching over us and our troops.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ kpɩɛraa deemba la sɩ na kɔ dɩ la ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ pɔla wɩaa: Kagunsuŋ, banzɔlɔba, kuori-nenii-pɩraa, dɩgɩlɩŋ-kpɛnsɩŋ arɩ naŋ-jɔlɔba.”

english_verse: women and gave them to Eleazar to be dedicated to the Lord. Then from the half that belonged to the people, Moses set aside one out of every
translation_verse: Laal-la sɩ dɛrɛ ka laalɩyuoro-la kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kɔ nɛ ŋ-la: piesee bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ.

english_verse: and listed everything that had been taken from the Midianites. The list included
translation_verse: Haalaa ma sɩ bɩ baalaa jɩŋ bʋɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩa.

english_verse: and said, “Sir, we have counted our troops, and not one soldier is missing.
translation_verse: a bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ tɩntɩnnaa dɩɩsɛ laalɩyuoro-la kala la sɩ kaa mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ, la kʋŋkala bɩ lɛlɛ.

english_verse: This did not include the things that the soldiers had kept for themselves.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoro-la kʋŋkala paa kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ yuo laa a kɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: then after the Lord helps Israel capture the land, you can return to your own land. You will no longer have to stay with the others.
translation_verse: a laa ba tinteeŋ, ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ma laa ma tɩtɩa La TƖƖNA arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ma jaŋ wuo mɩɩra mʋ lee-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ma nɛ tɩɩ tintee-la.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben and Gad owned a lot of cattle and sheep, and they saw that the regions of Jazer and Gilead had good pastureland.
translation_verse: Rubiŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Gad doho nɩaa fa kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ nɛ woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba na arɩ Jaza tinteeŋ arɩ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ zɔmɔ arɩ pʋsʋŋ dɩɛsɩŋ.

english_verse: So they went to Moses, Eleazar, and the other leaders of Israel and said,
translation_verse: Ba sii mʋ Mosis arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Elieza arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa teeŋ a bʋl,

english_verse: “The Lord has helped us capture the land around the towns of Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon. That's good pastureland, and since we own cattle and sheep,
translation_verse: “Tasɩŋ deemba nɛ La TƖƖNA pɛ la lɛ la yuo laa: Atarɔf, Dɩbɔŋ, Jaza, Nɩmɩra, Hɛsɩbɔŋ, Ɛlɩalɩ, Sɛbam, Nebo arɩ Bioŋ, tasɩ-la saa zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ arɩ pʋsʋŋ dɩɛsɩŋ, ka la ma kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: would you let us stay here east of the Jordan River and have this land as our own?”
translation_verse: Dɩ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɛ la nyuŋ, má joŋ tasɩ-la tinteeŋ pɩla dɩ ʋ ŋaa la kʋŋ, dɩ la bɩra sɩ́ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la chol.”

english_verse: Moses answered: You mean you'd stay here while the rest of the Israelites go into battle?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis pɩɛsɛ Gad doho nɩalɩŋ arɩ Rubiŋ doho nɩalɩŋ, “Maa chɛ dɩ ma hɔŋ daha nɛ ka dɩ ma naambiiriŋ mʋ laalɩŋ?

english_verse: If you did that, it would discourage the others from crossing over into the land the Lord promised them.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ maa chɛ dɩ ma leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ wuo chol a jʋʋ tintee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩba?

english_verse: They went as far as Eshcol Valley, then returned and told the people that we should not enter it.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋ yi Ɛsɩkɔl fuonaa-la a na tintee-la aŋ mɩɩra kɔ, ba bʋl wɩaa a yʋɔrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nandaasɩŋ nɛ, dɩ ba sɩ́ wuo mʋ tintee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba.

english_verse: Moses said: You promised that you would be ready to fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ ma nɛ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ma sɩ bʋla, má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a mʋ laal-la.

english_verse: but he was so angry with the others that he forced them to wander around in the desert for
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nyuŋ a leŋ ba baarɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa, a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la sɩ sʋʋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: So Moses gave the Machirites the region of Gilead, and they settled there.
translation_verse: Mosis joŋ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ a pɩ Makɩɩ tɩŋŋaa, Manasɛ doho nɩaa, ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Now you people of Reuben and Gad are doing the same thing and making the Lord even angrier.
translation_verse: Ma nɩaa deemba, wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa, ma ma bɩra sii chɩŋ ma nyɩmmaba wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa ba fa sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ nɛ, aa chɛ dɩ La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ faasa sii Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ.

english_verse: If you reject the Lord, he will once again abandon his people and leave them here in the desert. And you will be to blame!
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ mɩɩrɛ La TƖƖNA harɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ bɩra vɩa Iziral tɩŋŋaa deemba ta tintee-hɩlɩŋ deeŋ lɛ dɩ ba sʋʋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma nɛ jaŋ laa cheeriŋ.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad replied: Let us build places to keep our sheep and goats, and towns for our wives and children,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rubiŋ doho nɩalɩŋ arɩ Gad doho nɩalɩŋ mʋ Mosis teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Laa chɛ dɩ la saa la pʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩŋ daha nɛ, aŋ saa tabalaa ma a pɩ la haalaa arɩ la biiriŋ.

english_verse: We will stay with them until they have settled in their own tribal lands.
translation_verse: La bɩ jaŋ mɩɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa harɩŋ, see ba kʋŋkala sɩ na ʋ dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: The land on this side of the Jordan River will be ours, so we won't expect to receive any on the other side.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ kɛmba chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, la-na bɩra bɩ jaŋ laa tintee kala nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la-na folo laa la toruŋ nɛ daha, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.”

english_verse: You also agreed to cross the Jordan and stay with the rest of the Israelites, until the Lord forces our enemies out of the land. If you do these things,
translation_verse: Dɩ ma kala nɛ jaŋ nyɩgɩlɛ a to La TƖƖNA niiŋ a chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, a yuo la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ La TƖƖNA pɛ la lɛ a yuo diiba,

english_verse: But if you don't keep your promise, you will sin against the Lord and be punished.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, La Tɩɩna teeŋ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, ʋ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma.

english_verse: Go ahead and build towns for your wives and children, and places for your sheep and goats. Just be sure to do what you have promised.
translation_verse: Má saa jasɩŋ pɩ ma haalaa arɩ ma biiriŋ, a saa ma pʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩŋ ma a hɛ ma pʋsʋŋ, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ sɩ ma jaŋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad answered: Sir, we will do just what you have said.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Gad doho nɩaa arɩ Rubiŋ doho nɩaa bʋla pɩ Mosis, “La jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: Our wives and children and sheep and cattle will stay here in the towns in Gilead.
translation_verse: La biiriŋ arɩ la haalaa arɩ la pʋsʋŋ kala jaŋ ka Gɩlɩad tasɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: But those of us who are prepared for battle will cross the Jordan and fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ama la baalaa kala nyɩgɩla nɛ dɩ la mʋ laal-la arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. La jaŋ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a yuo laal-la arɩ ŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: “Make sure that the tribes of Gad and Reuben prepare for battle and cross the Jordan River with you. If they do, then after the land is in your control, give them the region of Gilead as their tribal land.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Dɩ Gad doho nɩaa arɩ Rubiŋ doho nɩaa nɛ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, a mʋ laalɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, a pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma yuo laa tintee-la, má joŋ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ pɩba dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.

english_verse: But if they break their promise, they will receive land on the other side of the Jordan, like the rest of the tribes.”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba nɛ bɩ ma lɛ pɛ a chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a yuo laal-la, ba ma jaŋ laa ba kpaalɩŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The tribes of Gad and Reuben replied, “We are your servants and will do whatever the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Gad doho nɩaa arɩ Rubiŋ doho nɩalɩŋ bʋl, “La jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: We will cross the Jordan River, ready to fight for the Lord in Canaan. But the land we will inherit as our own will be on this side of the river.”
translation_verse: La jaŋ to La TƖƖNA niiŋ a chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a mʋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ a yuo laalɩŋ, ka dɩ Jɔdaŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ ŋaa la kʋa.”

english_verse: So Moses gave the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh the territory and towns that King Sihon the Amorite had ruled, as well as the territory and towns that King Og of Bashan had ruled.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis joŋ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Sɩhɔŋ tinteeŋ arɩ Basaŋ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Ɔgɩ tinteeŋ arɩ tasɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ golliba a pɩ Gad doho nɩaa, Rubiŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Josɛf nanʋala Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la.

english_verse: The tribe of Gad rebuilt the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Gad doho nɩaa wasa saa Dɩbɔŋ, Atarɔf, Arʋa,

english_verse: Atroth-Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
translation_verse: Atɩrɔf Sɔfaŋ, Jaza, Jogbeha,

english_verse: Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-Haran. They built walls around them and also built places to keep their sheep and goats.
translation_verse: Bɛf-Nɩmɩra arɩ Bɛf-Haraŋ, a saa kɛrɛ golli ba kala, aŋ saa ba pʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩŋ ma.

english_verse: The tribe of Reuben rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
translation_verse: Rubiŋ doho nɩaa ma wasa saa Hɛsɩbɔŋ, Ɛlɩalɩ, Kɩrɩatam

english_verse: Sibmah, as well as the towns that used to be known as Nebo and Baal-Meon. They renamed all those places.
translation_verse: a pɛ Nebo, Baal Mɩɔŋ arɩ Sɩbɩma , aŋ pɩba yɩrɩ-falaa.

english_verse: The clan of Machir from the tribe of East Manasseh went to the region of Gilead, captured its towns, and forced out the Amorites.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Manasɛ nanʋala Makɩɩ doho nɩaa ma mʋ yuo dii Gɩlɩad a kiri Amɔrɩ tɩmma-la fa sɩ hɔŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Jair from the Manasseh tribe captured villages and renamed them “Villages of Jair.”
translation_verse: Jaa ma sɩ ŋaa Manasɛ doho nʋʋ, ʋ ma yuo dii tabiisi-la dɔnsʋŋ a hɛ lere-la yɩraa Havɔf Jaa.

english_verse: Nobah captured the town of Kenath with its villages and renamed it Nobah.
translation_verse: Noba ma yuo dii Kenaf arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ gollu, aŋ joŋ Noba, ʋ tɩtɩa yɩrɩŋ a hɛ pɩ lee-la.

english_verse: As Israel traveled from Egypt under the command of Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho kala sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ ŋaa ba sɩpaalaaraa, ba vɛŋ doho doho a hɔŋ lere-la nɛ ŋ-la.

english_verse: Moses kept a list of the places they camped, just as the Lord had instructed. Here is the record of their journey:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA dagɛ Mosis nɛ ʋ ŋmʋnsɛ lere-la ba sɩ vɛnɛ hɔŋ hɔŋ yɩraa a bil.

english_verse: Israel left the Egyptian city of Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month. This was the day after the Lord had punished Egypt's gods by killing the first-born sons in every Egyptian family. So while the Egyptians were burying the bodies, they watched the Israelites proudly leave their country.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Ijipiti tɩmma-la ka hugi ba hambolibii bumbumba-la La TƖƖNA sɩ kpʋa. La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ leŋe Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa vesiŋ kala jɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩba.

english_verse: After the Israelites left Rameses, they camped at Succoth,
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ sii Ramesis lɛ, ba kʋ hɔŋ Sʋkɔf lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: and from there, they moved their camp to Etham on the edge of the desert.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra lɩɩ Sʋkɔf lɛ a kʋ hɔŋ Ɛtam lɛ, tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la niiŋ.

english_verse: Then they turned back toward Pi-Hahiroth, east of Baal-Zephon, and camped near Migdol.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra sii Ɛtam lɛ a mɩɩra mʋ Pi-Hahɩrɔf, Baal-Zefoŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a hɔŋ a kpagɛ Mɩgɩdɔl.

english_verse: They left Pi-Hahiroth, crossed the Red Sea, then walked three days into the Etham Desert and camped at Marah.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra sii Pi-Hahɩrɔf lɛ a to Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ tʋɔŋ a mʋ jʋʋ Ɛtam tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la. Ba vɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa batori nɛ a mʋ hɔŋ Mara lɛ.

english_verse: They left Elim and camped near the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Ba bɩra sii Elim lɛ, a mʋ hɔŋ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: then turned east and camped along the western edge of the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra sii Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ niiŋ a mʋ hɔŋ Sɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: From there they went to Dophkah, Alush, and Rephidim, where they had no water.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra sii Alusi lɛ a mʋ hɔŋ Refidim lɛ. Nɩmɛ nɛ nɩalɩŋ fa bɩ lɩɩŋ na dɩ ba nyʋa.

english_verse: They left Rephidim and finally reached the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra sii Refidim lɛ a mʋ hɔŋ Sɩnaɩ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: When they left Kadesh, they came to Mount Hor, on the border of Edom.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra sii Kadɛs lɛ a mʋ hɔŋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɔɔ bʋbʋɔŋ a hɛ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: That's where the Lord commanded Aaron the priest to go to the top of the mountain. Aaron died there on the first day of the fifth month,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA leŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Arɔŋ jɩl peel-la nyuŋ, nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ sʋʋ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-nɔŋ tapʋl bumbuŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: It was then that the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Southern Desert of Canaan, heard that Israel was headed that way.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Arad kuoro sɩ ŋaa Kɛnaŋ tɩɩna a hɔŋ Nɛgɛf tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, nɩɩ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ka kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: and finally in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra lɩɩ Abarɩm peelee leriŋ a mʋ hɔŋ Mʋab tintee-taalɩsɩ-la lɛ a kpagɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, Jeriko cholo.

english_verse: Their camp stretched from Beth-Jeshimoth to Acacia. The Lord's Command To Conquer Canaan
translation_verse: Mʋab tintee-taalɩsɩ-la lɛ, ba hɔnɔ a kpagɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la nɛ a chɩŋ Bɛf Jɛsɩmɔf lɛ a kaa mʋ yi Abɛl Sɩtɩm.

english_verse: While Israel was camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, the Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ba sɩ hɔŋ lee-la, ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to give the people of Israel this message: When you cross the Jordan River and enter Canaan,
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, dɩ ba nɛ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a mʋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ,

english_verse: you must force out the people living there. Destroy their idols and tear down their altars.
translation_verse: ba kiri nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ lee-la a chei ba vesiŋ kala, kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ saa arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ libe aŋ chei lere-la kala ba sɩɩ kpaarɛ ba vʋɩyaa,

english_verse: Then settle in the land—I have given it to you as your own.
translation_verse: aŋ laa tintee-la tɩɩ a hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Mɩ nɛ joŋo pɩma.

english_verse: I will show you how to divide the land among the tribes, according to the number of clans in each one, so that the larger tribes will have more land than the smaller ones.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ tɔnsɛ a kɛŋ tintee-la kpaa doho doho. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yʋga, ba leriŋ jaŋ yʋgɛ, doho-la nɩaa sɩ muuro, ba leriŋ ma jaŋ muuri. Lee na-kala ba sɩ tɔnsɔ a joŋo pɩ doho na-kala, ba kʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If you don't force out all the people there, they will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your back. They will always be trouble for you,
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ kala kire, ba jaŋ walɩmɛma tintee-la lɛ a nagɛ kʋa sɩ jʋʋ ŋ sɩɩŋ koo sɔɔŋ sɩ hɛ ŋ nampɩlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and I will treat you as severely as I planned on treating them.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ nɩalɩŋ kala kire tintee-la lɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ fa sɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa ba lɛ a ŋaa ma lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel that their land in Canaan would have the following borders:
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ‘Dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ Kɛnaŋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ bʋa.

english_verse: The southern border will be the Zin Desert and the northwest part of Edom. This border will begin at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Tintee-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ bʋa jaŋ chɩŋ Mʋgʋ-sʋʋ-la niiŋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ a mʋ to Ziŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a mʋ yi Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ bʋa,

english_verse: It will go west from there, but will turn southward to include Scorpion Pass, the village of Zin, and the town of Kadesh-Barnea. From there, the border will continue to Hazar-Addar and on to Azmon.
translation_verse: a bɩra chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ na-dii-la a chaasɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Akɩrabɩm a to ŋɩɩ mʋ Ziŋ a mʋ yi Kadɛs Banɩa wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, a lɩɩ nɩmɛ a to ŋɩɩ mʋ Haza Ada, a kaa mʋ yi Azɩmɔŋ.

english_verse: It will run along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la jaŋ bɩra chɩŋ Azɩmɔŋ lɛ a to ŋɩɩ mʋ fuonaa-la sɩ hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ niiŋ a mʋ dɛrɛ mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediterenia lɛ.

english_verse: The western border will be the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediterenia nɛ jaŋ ŋaa tintee-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ bʋa.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean, then continue eastward to Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Ma tintee-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa bʋa jaŋ chɩŋ mʋgʋ-bal-la niiŋ a mʋ yi peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɔɔ,

english_verse: After that, it will run to Lebo-Hamath and across to Zedad, which is the northern edge of your land.
translation_verse: a chɩŋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɔɔ lɛ a to Lebo-Hamaf a mʋ yi Zɛdad,

english_verse: From Zedad, the border will continue east to Ziphron and end at Hazar-Enan.
translation_verse: a bɩra chɩŋ Zɛdad lɛ a mʋ to Zɩfʋrɔŋ a mʋ dɛrɛ Haza-Enaŋ lɛ. Ma wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa bʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham,
translation_verse: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ bʋa ma jaŋ chɩŋ Hɛzaa-Ɛna lɛ a mʋ to Sɛfam.

english_verse: and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la bɩra jaŋ chɩŋ Sɛfam lɛ a mʋ to Rɩbɩla sɩ hɛ Aɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ a to peele-la sɛmɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ jʋʋ mʋga-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Galilii sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ,

english_verse: then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea. The land within those four borders will belong to you.
translation_verse: a lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ to Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a mʋ dɛrɛ mʋga-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mʋgʋ-sʋʋŋ lɛ. Ma tintee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma bʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ.’ ”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, “Tintee-la ma sɩ jaŋ tɔnsɛ a kaa kpaa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ nɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ dɩ ma kaa kpaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho doho nibi arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa Rubiŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Gad doho nɩaa arɩ Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-na laa ba kpaalɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: across from Jericho, east of the Jordan River.” The Leaders Who Will Divide the Land
translation_verse: Dosunuŋ deemba balɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la nɛ laa ba kpaalɩŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a chaasɛ Jeriko.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: “Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: “Nɩaa deemba nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ tintee-la kpaama dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Elieza arɩ Nuŋ nanʋala Josua.

english_verse: One leader from each tribe will help them,
translation_verse: Má lɩɩsɛ sɩpaalaarʋ doho kala tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ dɩ ma kpaa tintee-la.”

english_verse: These are the men the Lord commanded to help Eleazar and Joshua divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba nɛ La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ kpaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: to say to them: When you receive your tribal lands, you must give towns and pastures to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, tintee-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩba lɛ, ba lɩɩsɛ tasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ a pɩ Levi doho nɩaa, aŋ keri ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diiliŋ ma a golli ba tasɩ-la a pɩba,

english_verse: That way, the Levites will have towns to live in and pastures for their animals.
translation_verse: dɩ ba wuo kɛŋ tasɩŋ a jʋjʋʋ, a kɛŋ nɛsɩŋ, piesee, bʋʋnaa arɩ pʋsʋŋ dɔnsʋŋ arɩ ba dɩ-diiliŋ.

english_verse: The pasture around each of these towns must be in the shape of a square, with the town itself in the center. The pasture is to measure
translation_verse: A bɩra chɩŋ taŋ-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ a kaa mʋʋ yi pʋsʋ-la dɩ-diiliŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ʋ duomuŋ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa naakieliŋ zɔlɔ nibi a golli taŋ-la kala. Tasɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ fá mʋ yuori

english_verse: Six of the towns you give them will be Safe Towns where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection. But you will also give the Levites
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ pɩ Levi doho nɩaa tasɩŋ balɩdʋ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ sɛnɛ aŋ kpʋ nʋʋ, dɩ ʋ wuo fá mʋ yuori. Ma ha jaŋ pɩba tabalaa mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ balɩa ma a pɛ.

english_verse: Since the towns for the Levites must come from Israel's own tribal lands, the larger tribes will give more towns than the smaller ones. The Safe Towns (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ joŋ tabala-la pɩ Levi doho nɩaa, doho-la nɩaa sɩ yʋga, ŋ jaŋ pɩba tasɩŋ yʋgɛ, doho-la ma nɩaa sɩ muuro, ŋ jaŋ pɩba tasɩŋ baŋmɛnɛ.”

english_verse: by one of the victim's relatives. He will take revengefor his relative's death as soon as he finds you.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kpʋa naambii nɛ cheŋ nɩkpʋʋrʋ-la, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ ma kpʋʋ.

english_verse: There are to be six of these Safe Towns,
translation_verse: Tasɩŋ deemba balɩdʋ nɛ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ dɩ ma fá mʋ aa yuori.

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: After you have crossed the Jordan River and are settled in Canaan,
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ‘Dɩ ma nɛ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a mʋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ,

english_verse: choose Safe Towns, where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection.
translation_verse: má lɩɩsɛ tasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ sɛnɛ aŋ kpʋ nʋʋ, dɩ ʋ fá mʋ yuori.

english_verse: If the victim's relatives think it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of these Safe Towns for protection and not be killed before a trial is held.
translation_verse: Leree deemba jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ sɛnɛ aŋ kpʋ nʋʋ ʋ jaŋ fá mʋ jʋʋ dɩ ba sɩ́ ʋ kpʋ a tiŋ ŋɩɩ chɩmɩŋ, ka dɩ ba wuo diiu sarɩya.

english_verse: three on each side of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Batori jaŋ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la cholo wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, dɩ batori ma hɛ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They will be places of protection for anyone who lives in Israel and accidentally kills someone. Laws about Murder and Accidental Killing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Tasɩŋ deemba balɩdʋ jaŋ ŋaa tasɩ-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩwogusu-la sɩ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ kala sɩ jaŋ fá mʋ aa yuori dɩ ba kʋŋ nɛ bɩ sɛnɛ aŋ kpʋ nʋʋ.

english_verse: Suppose you hit someone with a piece of iron or a large stone or a dangerous wooden tool. If that person dies, then you are a murderer and must be put to death
translation_verse: Koo dɩ nʋʋ nɛ joŋ daaŋ a jɩŋ arɩ daa-la jaŋ wuo kpʋ nɩa, ka dɩ ʋ joŋo ŋmoo nʋʋ dɩ ʋ sʋʋ, ʋ ŋaa nɩkpʋʋrʋ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ma kpʋ ʋ ma.

english_verse: Or suppose you get angry and kill someone by pushing or hitting or by throwing something. You are a murderer and must be put to death by one of the victim's relatives.
translation_verse: koo dɩ nɩsɩŋ nɛ ʋ joŋo ŋmobu dɩ ʋ sʋʋ, tɩɩna ŋaa nɩkpʋʋrʋ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ sʋba naambii nɛ na nɩkpʋʋrʋ-la, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kpʋʋ.

english_verse: But if you are not angry and accidentally kill someone in any of these ways, the townspeople must hold a trial and decide if you are guilty.
translation_verse: wɩaa deemba kʋŋkala lɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa maga dɩ ba jʋʋ wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ a na nɩɩ-la kɩaa sɩ sɩma.

english_verse: If they decide that you are innocent, you will be protected from the victim's relative and sent to stay in one of the Safe Towns until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa maga dɩ ba pɔ nɩkpʋʋrʋ-la a kɛnʋ mɩɩra mʋ taŋ-la ʋ fa sɩ fá mʋ yuori. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ nɛ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ sɩ hɛ lee-la sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: But if you ever leave the Safe Town
translation_verse: Ama dɩ nɩkpʋʋrʋ-la nɛ lɩɩ taŋ-la ʋ sɩ fá mʋ yuori tʋɔŋ,

english_verse: and are killed by the victim's relative, he cannot be punished for killing you.
translation_verse: dɩ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kpʋa naambiiriŋ kʋŋ naʋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo kpʋʋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ wɩɩkala cheye.

english_verse: The community of Israel must always obey these laws.
translation_verse: Ma doho nɩaa kala maga dɩ ma tuto wombiee deemba nɛ lee na-kala ma sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: Death is the penalty for murder. But no one accused of murder can be put to death unless there are at least two witnesses to the crime.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kpʋ ʋ dɔŋ, ʋ maga dɩ nɩaa yi balɩa nɛ a pɛ na arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ka dɩ ba-na kpʋʋ. Nɩbala dʋndʋŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo na wɩɩ dɩ ba tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa a kpʋ nʋʋ.

english_verse: You cannot give someone money to escape the death penalty; you must pay with your own life!
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kpʋ ʋ dɔŋɔ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo time laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋ ʋ ma.

english_verse: And if you have been proven innocent of murder and are living in a Safe Town, you cannot pay to go back home; you must stay there until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo time laa ʋ tɩtɩa a lɩɩ taŋ-la ʋ sɩ fá mʋ yuori lɛ a mɩɩra mʋ ʋ jaŋ, dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ-la sɩ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ nɛ bɩ sʋba.

english_verse: One day the family leaders from the Gilead clan of the Manasseh tribe went to Moses and the other family leaders of Israel
translation_verse: Gɩlɩad ŋaa Makɩɩ nanʋala nɛ, a ŋaa Manasɛ ma nihiŋ, ba kala lɩɩ Josɛf doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Gɩlɩad doho nɩaa dɩa kʋhɩasɩŋ sii mʋ Mosis arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa teeŋ,

english_verse: and said, “Sir, the Lord has said that he will show what land each tribe will receive as their own. And the Lord has commanded you to give the daughters of our relative Zelophehad the land that he would have received.
translation_verse: a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ Mosis a leŋ la tɔnsɛ a kɛŋ tintee-la kpaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ʋ leŋe la joŋ la naambie Zelofihad kpaalɩŋ pɩ ʋ toloo nɛ.

english_verse: But if they marry men from other tribes of Israel, the land they receive will become part of that tribe's inheritance and will no longer belong to us.
translation_verse: Dɩ tolie-la nɛ mʋ jaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho dɔŋ, kpaal-la ba sɩ laa jaŋ ŋaa doho-la ba sɩ jaa kʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tintee-la ba sɩ kpaa pɩla muuri.

english_verse: Even when land is returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration, we will not get back Zelophehad's land—it will belong to the tribe into which his daughters married.”
translation_verse: Dɩ jɩna-la la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ joŋ kʋyɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ yie, kpaal-la tolie-la sɩ laa jaŋ ŋaa doho-la ba sɩ jaa kʋŋ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la nyɩmma doho nɩaa kpaalɩŋ muuri.”

english_verse: So Moses told the people that the Lord had said: These men from the Manasseh tribe are right.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋl wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla pʋ pɩ Iziral tɩmma-la. Ʋ sɩ, “Wɩɩ-la Manasɛ doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: I will allow Zelophehad's daughters to marry anyone, as long as those men belong to one of the clans of the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Zelofihad tolie-la kɛŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ba jaa baala-la ba sɩ cho nɛ, ama ba maga dɩ ba jaa ba doho-la tɩtɩa nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Tribal land must not be given to another tribe—it will remain the property of the tribe that received it.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ kpaal-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho kala sɩ laa, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kʋ ŋaa doho dɔŋ kʋŋ. Doho na-kala jaŋ tɩɩ ba naabalɩma tinteeŋ a kaa mʋmʋ.

english_verse: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah the daughters of Zelophehad obeyed the Lord and married their uncles' sons
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zelofihad tolie-la, ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mala, Tɩɩza, Hogila, Mɩlɩka arɩ Nua ŋaa ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis, a jaa ba nyɩmma doho nɩaa.

english_verse: and remained part of the Manasseh tribe. So their land stayed in their father's clan.
translation_verse: Ba fa jaa Josɛf nanʋala Manasɛ doho nɩaa nɛ, ba kpaalɩŋ ha hɛ ba nyɩmma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave to Moses and the Israelites while they were camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Wombie-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ to Mosis lɛ a dagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ hɛ Mʋab tintee-taalɩsɩ-la sɩ kpagɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, Jeriko cholo nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Now, turn around and go back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: Ama ma-na, má mɩɩra to tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la a mʋ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: People of Israel, when we were in our camp at Mount Sinai, the Lord our God told us: You have stayed here long enough.
translation_verse: La fa sɩ hɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ lɛ, La TƖƖNA Wɩa bʋla pɩla, “Má hɔŋ daha dieni nɛ.

english_verse: Leave this place and go into the land that belongs to the Amorites and their neighbors the Canaanites. This land includes the Jordan River valley, the hill country, the western foothills, the Southern Desert, the Mediterranean seacoast, the Lebanon Mountains, and all the territory as far as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Má sii mʋ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga arɩ lere-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, a mʋ Jɔdaŋ fuonaa-la, a mʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ, a mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, a mʋ mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediterenia niiŋ, a mʋ Kɛnaŋ tintee-la a kiele mʋ Lɛbanɔŋ tinteeŋ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋʋ yi fuo-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Yufireti.

english_verse: I give you this land, just as I promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Now you must go and take the land. Leaders Were Appointed (Exodus
translation_verse: Leree deemba kala nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA hɛ niiŋ a pɩ ma naabalɩmaba Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb arɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩ ba dɩ ba doho nɩaa kala. Má mʋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ, ma nɛ tɩɩʋ.” Mosis lɩɩsɛ sɩpaalaaraa

english_verse: After I gave these instructions to the judges, I taught you the Lord's commands. Men Were Sent To Explore the Hill Country (Numbers
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ dagɛma wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ tɩma ba mʋ lʋara beŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ

english_verse: You stayed in your tents and grumbled, “The Lord must hate us—he brought us out of Egypt, just so he could hand us over to the Amorites and get rid of us.
translation_verse: Ma hɔŋ ma lɛŋŋɛɛ lɛ nɛ a gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa arɩ ma TƖƖNA bɛrɛma nɛ a kɛmma kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ kɔ dɩ ʋ jomma hɛ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba kpʋma.

english_verse: Right after the Lord commanded us to leave Mount Sinai, I told you: Israel, being your leader is too big a job for one person.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bɩra bʋla pɩba: Bʋa-la lɛ la sɩ hɛ Sɩnaɩ peel-la lɛ, mɩ bʋla pɩma arɩ mɩ dʋndʋŋa bɩ jaŋ wuo bemma,

english_verse: God has even promised to bless us a thousand times more, and I pray that he will.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ ma Tɩɩna, ma naabalɩmaba Wɩa, leŋ dɩ ma pʋŋa yʋgɛ woruŋ aŋ pɛ ma lɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But I cannot take care of all your problems and settle all your arguments alone.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ dʋndʋŋa saa jaŋ wuo ŋaa a beŋ ma nɩ-daŋ deeŋ arɩ ma wʋwalɩmaa arɩ kaalɛrɛba kala?

english_verse: Then I took these men, who were already wise and respected leaders, and I appointed them as your official leaders. Some of them became military officers in charge of groups of
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ laa nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ lɩɩsa a leŋ dɔnsʋŋ bibeŋ nɩaa bʋɩba, dɔnsʋŋ ma bibeŋ zɔlɔba, dɔnsʋŋ ma bibeŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fiiba dɔnsʋŋ ma bibeŋ nɩaa fiiba, aŋ leŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ doho na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: and others became judges. I gave these judges the following instructions: When you settle legal cases, your decisions must be fair. It doesn't matter if the case is between two Israelites, or between an Israelite and a foreigner living in your community.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩ ma sɩpaalaara-la sɩ jaŋ laa ma wɩaa jɩma pɩpɩma: Dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa balɩa nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩ, koo dɩ ba dɩ nɩwogo nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ma bʋl wɩɩ-la ʋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: And it doesn't matter if one is helpless and the other is powerful. Don't be afraid of anyone! No matter who shows up in your court, God will help you make a fair decision. If any case is too hard for you, bring the people to me, and I will make the decision.
translation_verse: Má dii nʋʋkala sarɩya ʋ bʋa lɛ, má sɩ́ nʋʋkala sɩɩŋ fá, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa nɛ dagɛma. Wɩɩ-la kala sɩ dolie kɩɩma, má kaa kɔ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: even though he had always been with us in the desert. During the daytime, the Lord was in the cloud, leading us in the right direction and showing us where to camp. And at night, he was there in the fire.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa yie laa ma sɩpaaŋ nɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ a nagɛ nyiniŋ, a laa ma sɩpaaŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ aa dagɛma lere-la ma sɩ jaŋ to arɩ lere-la ma sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord had commanded us to leave Mount Sinai and go to the hill country that belonged to the Amorites, so we started out into the huge desert. You remember how frightening it was, but soon we were at Kadesh-Barnea,
translation_verse: La sɩ hɔŋ Sɩnaɩ peel-la leriŋ ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA Wɩa bʋla pɩla arɩ la sii. Ŋɩɩ nɛ la sii nɩmɛ a chaasɛ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga a vɛŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la sɩ jalɩa a kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi Kadɛs Banɩa.

english_verse: and I told you, “We have reached the hill country. It belongs to the Amorites now, but the Lord our God is giving it to us. He is the same God our ancestors worshiped, and he has told us to go in and take this land, so don't hesitate and be afraid.”
translation_verse: Má bee na tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma nɛ pɩŋ ma sɩpaaŋ ŋɩɩ, má mʋ a hɔŋ ʋ lɛ a tɩɩʋ arɩ ma nyɩmmaba Wɩa sɩ dagɛma ŋɩɩ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma koo dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ.”

english_verse: Then all of you came to me and said, “Before we go into the land, let's send some men to explore it. When they come back, they can tell us about the towns we will find and what roads we should take to get there.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma kala kɔ mɩ teeŋ a bʋl, “Má leŋ dɩ la lɩɩsɛ nɩaa dɩ ba laa sɩpaaŋ mʋ a lʋara beŋ tintee-la maŋŋaa, aŋ kʋ bʋla pɩla wombii-la sɩ maga dɩ la to arɩ tasɩ-la la sɩ jaŋ to jʋʋ.”

english_verse: It seemed like a good idea, so I chose twelve men, one from each tribe.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na dɩ wɩɩ-la zɔmɔ. Mɩ lɩɩsɛ baalaa fii arɩ balɩa, doho na-kala lɛ nɩbala.

english_verse: They explored the hill country as far as Bunch Valley
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩ a mʋ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga a mʋ yi Ɛsɩkɔl fuonaa-la a beŋ ʋ kala.

english_verse: and even brought back some of the fruit. They said, “The Lord our God is giving us good land.” Israel Refused To Obey the Lord (Numbers
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ ba tɔrɛ tintee-la tɩɩnɛnɛɛ dɔnsʋŋ a kaa kʋ dagɛla, aŋ bʋla pɩla, “Tintee-la ŋaa tintee-zɔŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa joŋo pɩpɩ la.” Iziral tɩŋŋaa vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ

english_verse: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ama ma vɩa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ nɛ a bɩ chɛ dɩ ma mʋ tintee-la.

english_verse: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.”
translation_verse: Ma sɩ, “Nɩɩ nɛ la jaŋ mʋ? La naambiiriŋ sɩ mʋ beŋ tintee-la joŋ fawʋllʋŋ hɛ la lɛ nɛ.” Ba sɩ, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ waa kɩɩla nɛ a dolie kɩɩla ma. Ba tasɩŋ jalɩa, ba saa kɛrɩsɩŋ sɩ jɩla yi wɩa-nyuŋ a golli. La na Anakɩ doho nɩaa nɩwaayiilee ma nɛ tintee-la lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ laa ma sɩpaaŋ jaŋ yuo nɩalɩŋ a pɩma arɩ ʋ fa sɩ yuo Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩma ma sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.”
translation_verse: Ma fa sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, ma na ŋɩɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ pɔma nɛ, a kɛmma kaa kɔ daha a nagɛ bie nyɩmma sɩ yie pɔ ʋ bie ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: But you still would not trust the Lord,
translation_verse: Ma na wɩaa deemba kala nɛ aŋ ha bɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa laa dii.

english_verse: You had made the Lord angry, and he said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ gʋrʋma, ʋ na baanɩŋ nɛ ma nyuŋ, aŋ chaasa ŋmɩɛsɛ.

english_verse: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Ma nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba kʋŋkala sɩɩŋ bɩ jaŋ na tintee-zɔŋ-la mɩ sɩ sɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩ ma naabalɩmaba,

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.
translation_verse: see Jefuni nanʋala Kalɩb. Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ jʋʋ tintee-la. Ʋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ mɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee-la a pa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ to mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA arɩ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: Ma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ mɩ ma tɩtɩa Mosis nyuŋ, a bʋl arɩ mɩ ma bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ tintee-la.

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: Ma biiri-la wɩaa ma sɩɩ yel arɩ ba jaŋ sʋʋ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ma biiri-la ha sɩ bɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ arɩ wʋzɔmʋŋ bʋa jɩŋ, ba jaŋ jʋʋ tintee-la. Mɩ jaŋ joŋu pɩba dɩ ba tɩɩʋ.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma bʋl, “La ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ, la jaŋ mʋ tintee-la a yuo laalɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma kʋŋkala paa ʋ bayuori kɩaa a bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa mɔlɩɩ nɛ dɩ ma mʋ yuo peelee sɩ golli tintee-la nɩaa.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma, “Má sɩ́ laal-la mʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ ma harɩŋ chɩna, dɩ ma nɛ vɩa aŋ sɛnsɛ, ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ yuo diima.”

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la pɩma, ka ma bɩ jegile nɩɩ, aŋ gɩrɛ vaasɩŋ a mʋ dɩ ma yuo laal-la.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Amɔrɩ tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ peel-la nyuŋ kʋ lɩɩ a nagɛ tʋʋ-bii-laalɩŋ a kirima a lɩɩ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛdɔm lɛ a kaa mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɔma.

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ,

english_verse: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.
translation_verse: “Ma baara golli tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga a dieni nɛ, má mɩɩrɛ a to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: And give the people these orders: “Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you,
translation_verse: Bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩ nɩalɩŋ: Ma ka mʋa ka dɩ ma jʋʋ ma naambie Ɛsɔ doho nɩaa sɩ hɛ Ɛdɔm lɛ tinteeŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ na ma, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmba, ŋɩɩ wɩaa má fɩɛlɛ ma yaraa.

english_verse: but don't start a war with them. I have given them the hill country of Seir, so I won't give any of it to you, not even enough to set a foot on.
translation_verse: Ma pɔ dɩ má sɩ́ ba kaa yuo laalɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋ ba tinteeŋ mʋapɩlɩɩ ma pɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ joŋ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ kala a pɩ Ɛsɔ arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Má tiŋ kʋdiile-la ma sɩ jaŋ dii arɩ lɩɩ-la ma sɩ jaŋ nyʋa tintee-la lɛ.”

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la joŋ wombii-la sɩ lɩɩ Ɛlaf arɩ Ɛzɩɔŋ-Geba a mʋ Mʋgʋ-sʋʋŋ a mʋ kieli la naambie Ɛsɔ doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ lɛ, a leŋ wombii-la, aŋ to tintee-hɩlɩŋ wombii-la sɩɩ mʋ Mʋab tinteeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Má sɩ́ Mʋab tɩmma-la fugusu koo a kɛmba yuo laalɩŋ. Ba ŋaa Lɔt doho nɩaa nɛ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋ ba tintee-la mʋapɩlɩɩ ma a pɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ joŋ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Aa a pɩ Lɔt arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ, dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.”

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.
translation_verse: Emi tɩŋŋaa nɛ fa hɔŋ Aa taŋ-la lɛ. Ba fa yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ a ŋaa nɩduoru aŋ waa yi a nagɛ Anakɩ tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: Anakɩ tɩmma-la yɩrɩŋ dɔŋɔ ma nɛ fa Refem tɩŋŋaa. Ama Mʋab tɩŋŋaa-na fa kɛmba yɩyɩrɛ Emi tɩŋŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Hɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa nɛ fa hɔŋ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛsɔ doho nɩaa mʋ yuo a kiriba, aŋ laa lee-la a hɔŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ yuo kiri ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ŋɩɩ aŋ laa tintee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩba.

english_verse: When we came to the Zered Gorge along the southern border of Moab, the Lord told us to cross the gorge into Moab, and we did.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩla, “Má sii a chol fuonaa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zɛrɛd.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ la sii a chol.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ,

english_verse: “Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border
translation_verse: “Jɩnɩŋ, má jʋʋ Mʋab tinteeŋ a to tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Aa.

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ yi Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ, má sɩ́ ba fugusu koo a kɛmba yuo laalɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋ ba tinteeŋ mʋapɩlɩɩ ma a pɩma. Lɔt doho nɩaa Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa nɛ mɩ joŋ tintee-la pa.”

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: (Refem tɩmma-la fa sɩ hɔŋ lee-la, ba nɛ tɩɩ tintee-la, ama Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa-na ka yɩrɛba Zamzumi tɩŋŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa chei Hɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ aŋ leŋ Ɛsɔ doho nɩaa sɩ hɛ Ɛdɔm lɛ laa ba tinteeŋ a hɔŋ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Ava tɩmma-la sɩ hɔŋ tabiisi-la kala sɩ hɛ lee-la a kɩɛlɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi Gaza, Kafɩtɔ tɩŋŋaa lɩɩ ba tinteeŋ a kʋ yuo diiba nɛ aŋ hɔŋ lee-la.) Iziral tɩŋŋaa yuo dii Hɛsɩbɔŋ kuoro Sɩhɔŋ

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: La sɩ kieli Mʋab tinteeŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩla, “Má sii a chol Anɔŋ fuo-la cholo, mɩ joŋ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Sɩhɔŋ sɩ hɛ Hɛsɩbɔŋ lɛ arɩ ʋ tinteeŋ kala a hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa a yuo laa tintee-la.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: A chɩŋ jɩnɩŋ a kaa mʋ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ a hɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala lɛ, dɩ ba nɛ nɩɩ ma wɩaa, dɩ ba chichel.”

english_verse: After we had crossed the Arnon and had set up camp in the Kedemoth Desert, I sent messengers to King Sihon of Heshbon, telling him that his nation and ours could be at peace. I said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tɩŋ nɩaa ba lɩɩ Kɛdɛmɔf tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ a mʋ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Sɩhɔŋ sɩ hɛ Hɛsɩbɔŋ lɛ teeŋ, a chɩchɛ nii-maga,

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: a bʋl, “Leŋ dɩ la to ŋ tinteeŋ a bal, la jaŋ joŋ womporuŋ a mʋ, la bɩ jaŋ gɛbɛ nadiiŋ koo nagʋa.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: a nagɛ Ɛsɔ doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ lɛ arɩ Mʋab tɩmma-la sɩ hɔŋ Aa taŋ-la lɛ sɩ leŋe la to ba tinteeŋ bal ŋɩɩ, dɩ la chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a mʋ tintee-la La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩpɩla.”

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mɩ joŋ kuoro Sɩhɔŋ arɩ ʋ tinteeŋ kala a hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a yuo laa tintee-la dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ.”

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Kuoro Sɩhɔŋ arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoro kala sɩ kʋ lɩɩ chenla Jaha lɛ dɩ ba yuola,

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa jomba hɛ la nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, la kpʋʋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoro kala.

english_verse: Then we captured and destroyed every town in Sihon's kingdom, killing everyone,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, la yuo dii ʋ tasɩŋ kala nɛ, a kpʋ baalaa, haalaa arɩ hambiisi-la kala sɩ hɛ tasɩ-la lɛ, la bɩ nʋʋkala leŋe.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Ba pʋsʋŋ arɩ ba dʋa dʋndʋŋa nɛ la fa paa ba ŋaa la kɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Arʋa sɩ hɛ Anɔŋ fuo-la fuonaaŋ niiŋ a kaa mʋ yi Gɩlɩad, taŋ kala fa tuo a wuola. La TƖƖNA Wɩa leŋe la yuo dii ba kala nɛ.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ sɩ dɩ la sɩ́ tasɩ-la yuo, la bɩ ba jʋa. Ba nɛ: Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ, arɩ tasɩ-la kala sɩ golli fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jabɔk arɩ tasɩ-la sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ bɔyɛ joŋ a tɩŋ kuoro Ɔgɩ wɩaa. Mɩ joŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa arɩ ba tinteeŋ kala hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Wɩɩ-la ŋ fa sɩ joŋo ŋaa Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Sɩhɔŋ fa sɩ hɛ Hɛsɩbɔŋ lɛ, joŋ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa ŋaa Basaŋ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Ɔgɩ ma lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: La chei ba tasɩŋ kala nɛ a kpʋ baalaa, haalaa arɩ hambiisiŋ, arɩ la sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Sɩhɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Ba pʋsʋŋ arɩ ba dʋa dʋndʋŋa nɛ la fa paa ba ŋaa la kɩaa.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, la laa Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoroo deemba balɩa tinteeŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, a chɩŋ Anɔŋ fuonaa-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋʋ yi peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛmɔŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa.

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: La yuo dii tasɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ peelee nyuŋ nɛ, a yuo dii Gɩlɩad arɩ Basaŋ tinteyee kala a kaa mʋʋ yi Salɩka arɩ Ɛdɩrɛ. Kuoro Ɔgɩ nɛ faa beŋ Basaŋ tinteeŋ tasɩ-la kala.

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, a pɛ ma naambiiriŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ dɩ ma yuo laa tintee-la La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩba dɩ ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ, ma jaŋ wuo mɩɩra mʋ a hɔŋ lere-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩma.” La TƖƖNA sɩ Mosis bɩ jaŋ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sʋl La TƖƖNA nɛ woruŋ, a bʋl,

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: “Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ŋ dagɛmɛ ŋ doluŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ, veŋ bɛɛ ma nɛ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ koo tinteeŋ a jaŋ wuo pagɩsɩŋ a ŋaa wʋduoru-la ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa?

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, leŋ dɩ mɩ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a na tintee-la sɩ sɩma woruŋ aŋ na tintee-sɩŋ-la peelee sɩ yʋga arɩ Lɛbanɔŋ peelee.”

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: Ama a tɩŋ ma wɩaa, La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ nɛ mɩ nyuŋ, a bɩ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, aŋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Ʋ maga nɛ, bɩra sɩ́ wɩɩ-la bʋl mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Jɩl Pisiga peel-la nyuŋ, a beŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a na tintee-la kala, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Ama dagɛ Josua wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa, a pʋ doluŋ a leŋ dɩ ʋ nyuŋ nyaasɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ jaŋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaaŋ a kɛŋ ba chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la dɩ ba yuo laa tintee-la ŋ sɩ jɩl peeliŋ a na.”

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la hɔŋ Bɛf Pio fuonaa-la lɛ.

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: Má jegile nɩɩ wombie-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ dagɛma, a tutoba. Dɩ ma nɛ toba, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a laa tintee-la a tɩɩ, tintee-la La TƖƖNA, ma naabalɩmaba Wɩa, sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Má pɔ ma sɩ́ wɩɩ kaa pɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma lɛ, koo a keri wɩalɩŋ kʋŋ ta. Má tuto ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiri-la kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma.

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: Ama ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ to ma TƖƖNA Wɩa arɩ tʋɔ-bala nɛ ha hɛ ma mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋ-la jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ, a sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ na yʋ ma mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ. Má joŋ wɩalɩŋ dagɛ ma biiriŋ, dɩ ba ma bɩra joŋo dagɛ ba biiriŋ.

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: Má liisi tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ chɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ Sɩnaɩ peel-la lɛ, bʋa-la ʋ sɩ leŋe mɩ yɩrɛma kʋ hilimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ, dɩ ma nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ bʋl, a jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ zizilu ma mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, aŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ dagɛ ma biiriŋ ma.

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma kʋ chɩŋ peel-la bʋbʋɔŋ, ka peel-la kala tɔ arɩ nyiniŋ. Nyʋɔsʋŋ leŋ lee-la kala biri a nagɛ duoŋ-timbine a jɩla tɩgɛ wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA hɛ nyiŋ-la tʋɔŋ nɛ aŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩma. Ma nɩɩ ʋ yikoro dʋndʋŋa nɛ aŋ bɩ ʋ nagɩŋ na.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl nii-la sɩ hɛ ma dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ wɩaa nɛ, niiri-la fii ʋ sɩ dagɛma dɩ ma tuto, aŋ ŋmʋnsɛba hɛ tabɩɩ-taalaa balɩa lɛ.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, La TƖƖNA leŋe mɩ dagɛma wombie-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ tuto nɛ dɩ ma nɛ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a jʋʋ tintee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ma tɩɩʋ. Má sɩ́ vʋɩyaa kpaarʋ

english_verse: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ nyiŋ-la tʋɔŋ aŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩma Sɩnaɩ peel-la lɛ, ma bɩ ʋ nagɩsɩŋ na. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: a sɩ́ disiniŋ ŋaa hɛ ma tɩtɩa lɛ a mɛ vʋɩŋ pɩ ma tɩtɩa dɩ ʋ nagɛ baal koo haal,

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: Má sɩ kɩaa deemba ma sɩɩ na wɩa-nyuŋ zil: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, chɛnɛ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa. Ba ŋaa kɩa nɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa na baanɩŋ nɛ mɩ nyuŋ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ chaasa ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ mɩ bɩ jaŋ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a jʋʋ tintee-zɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩpɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mɩ jaŋ sʋʋ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la. Ama ma-na jaŋ chol fuo-la a laa tintee-zɔŋ-la a tɩɩʋ.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ a pʋpɔ dɩ má sɩ́ nii-la sɩ hɛ ma dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa pɛgɛ yʋ. Má sɩ́ tɔŋ kala mɛ dɩ ʋ nagɛ kʋŋkala a pɩ ma tɩtɩa. Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa ka kɩsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ sɩɩ belimi kɩaa nɛ, ʋ bɩ hadɔrʋŋ ka chɛ.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋmooma pɩsa hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ. Tintee-wogusu-la lɛ, ma jesiŋ kala jaŋ sʋʋ aŋ ka nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: Tinteye-la lɛ, ma jaŋ kpʋkpaarɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ ba sɩ mɛ, koo a kɛŋ daaŋ saa koo tabɩaa. Tɔmɔ-la bɩ jaŋ nɩna, ba bɩ nɩɩ, ba bɩ kɩaa wuo dii, ba bɩ sʋɔra maa nɩɩ.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩaa deemba kala nɛ ŋaa ma lɛ, dɩ hɛɛŋ jʋʋma, ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ma jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ a sɛyʋ.

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ma TƖƖNA ŋaa Wɩa sɩɩ fa nɩaa nenige nɛ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ vɩama ta koo a cheima. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ yʋ nii-la sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩ ma naabalɩmaba pɛgɛ wɩaa. La TƖƖNA nɛ Wɩa

english_verse: When the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt, you saw how he fought for you and showed his great power by performing terrifying miracles. You became his people, and at Mount Sinai you heard him talking to you out of fiery flames. And yet you are still alive! Has anything like this ever happened since the time God created humans? No matter where you go or who you ask, you will get the same answer. No one has ever heard of another god even trying to do such things as the Lord your God has done for you.
translation_verse: Veŋ bɛɛ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a jaŋ wuo mʋ tinteeŋ tʋɔŋ a ŋaa wɩaa magɩsɛba, a ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ arɩ wʋmagɩlaa, a yuo laalɩŋ, a dagɛ ʋ doluŋ a ŋaa wɩaa sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ a laa ʋ nɩaa tintee-la nɩaa teeŋ? Ŋ-la nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa ŋaa ma sɩɩŋ lɛ aŋ laama kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe ma nɩɩ ʋ yikoro sɩ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ, a bʋl wɩaa dagɛma. Tinteeŋ ma lɛ, ʋ leŋ ma na nyiniŋ, ka ʋ hɛ nyiŋ-la tʋɔŋ aŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩma.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ cho ma naabalɩmaba nɛ tɩɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛma, a tɩtɩa kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ arɩ ʋ doluŋ.

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: Ma bɩra na ʋ sɩ yuo dii tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩma nɛ, a kiriba ta aŋ joŋ ba tinteeŋ a pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ. Ma nɛ ha tɩɩ tintee-la arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Ma jɩŋ woruŋ jɩnɩŋ a sɩ́ yʋ, La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala Wɩa, wɩa dɔŋ bɩra tuo.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Má to ʋ wombie-la arɩ ʋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, dɩ wɩaa wuo vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩ ma dɩ ma doho nɩaa, dɩ ma nɛ mʋ hɔŋ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ a kaa mʋ wuu lɛ. Tasɩ-la nɩaa sɩ jaŋ fá mʋ yuyuori

english_verse: Moses said, “People of Israel, you must set aside the following three towns east of the Jordan River as Safe Towns: Bezer in the desert highlands belonging to the Reuben tribe; Ramoth in Gilead, belonging to the Gad tribe; and Golan in Bashan, belonging to the Manasseh tribe. If you kill a neighbor without meaning to, and if you had not been angry with that person, you can run to one of these towns and find safety.” The Second Speech: Moses Tells What the Lord Demands Israel at Beth-Peor
translation_verse: Tasɩ-la yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la: Bɛza, ʋ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ peelee sɩ yʋga nɛ. Rubiŋ doho nɩaa kʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ramɔf, ʋ ma hɛ Gɩlɩad lɛ nɛ. Gad doho nɩaa ma kʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ, arɩ Golaŋ, ʋ ma hɛ Basaŋ lɛ nɛ. Manasɛ doho nɩaa ma kʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Mosis suomo joŋ Wɩa wombie-la ʋ sɩ bile a dagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: a kɔ fuo-la sɩ kpagɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf Pio sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ lɛ nɛ. Lee-la ŋaa Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Sɩhɔŋ sɩ hɛ Hɛsɩbɔŋ lɛ tinteeŋ nɛ. Mosis arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ kɔ nɛ ba yuo diiu, aŋ laa tintee-la.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: Ba sɩ laa ʋ tinteeŋ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ ŋɩɩ, ba laa Basaŋ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Ɔgɩ ma tinteeŋ. Kuoroo deemba balɩa kala ŋaa Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoroo nɛ a hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ deeŋ chɩŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Arʋa lɛ nɛ, Anɔŋ fuo-la niiŋ aŋ pɩŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sirioŋ, ʋ nɛ ha baa yɩrɛ Hɛmɔŋ.

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ ha mʋ kɛŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a mʋ yi Mʋgʋ-sʋʋŋ a kaa mʋ Pisiga peel-la lee-la sɩ chullo tuu.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a bʋla pɩba: Iziral tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ niiri-la arɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ. Má gʋnnɛba woruŋ a kɛmba kaa tɩŋ.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ nʋʋ kpʋ.

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Sɩnaɩ peel-la lɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa hɛ niiŋ nɛ la dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ.

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩ la nyɩmmaba dʋndʋŋa pɛgɛ dee ʋ hɛ nii-la, ama ʋ hɛ nii-la ʋ dɩ la nɩalɩŋ kala ha sɩ hɛ la mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ jɩnɩŋ pɛgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: Sɩnaɩ peel-la lɛ La TƖƖNA hɛ nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ a chaasɛma, aŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩma.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, mɩ chɩŋ ma dɩ La TƖƖNA pɛgɛ nɛ aŋ laa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩɩ bʋl a bʋla pɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa nyiŋ-la fa leŋe fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma nɛ, ma bɩ peel-la jɩla. La TƖƖNA sɩ:

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ nɛ kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, lee-la ma fa sɩ hɛ a ŋaa yosi.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ maga dɩ má kɛŋ wɩa kala a pɛ mɩ-na Wɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: Ma pɔ má sɩ́ tɔŋ kala mɛ a pɩ ma tɩtɩa dɩ ʋ nagɛ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋŋ koo tinteeŋ nyuŋ kʋŋ koo lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ kʋŋ.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Ma pɔ má sɩ́ ba sɩpaaŋ kpirimu koo a zilba. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ bɩ hadɔrʋŋ ka chɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛrɩmɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nyɩmmaba arɩ biiriŋ arɩ ba nihee arɩ ba nihi-lɩɛrɛba a tɩŋ nyɩmmaba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ chomi a tuto mɩ niiriŋ, mɩ jaŋ dagɛ mɩ chonuŋ a pɩba arɩ ba doho doho bʋɩba sɩ jaŋ to ba harɩŋ kɔ.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: Má pɔ ma sɩ́ mɩ yɩrɩŋ yɩrʋ pɛɩ. Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ yɩrɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ pɛɩ.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Má tɩŋ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa tapʋlaa balɩdʋ pɛgɛ,

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
