translation_verse: ama tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ ŋaa chɛ-wiesii nɛ, a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. Má sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ, ma biiriŋ, arɩ nɩwogusu-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, ma pʋsʋŋ arɩ ma dɩa tɩntɩnnaa kala baalaa arɩ haalaa, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma tɩntɩnnaa baalaa arɩ haalaa ma kala wiesi.

english_verse: This special day of rest will remind you that I reached out my mighty arm and rescued you from slavery in Egypt.
translation_verse: Má jɩŋ arɩ ma fa ŋaa yosi nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa kɛŋ mɩ doluŋ a kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA bʋla pɩma arɩ ma tuto mɩ chɛ-wiesii-la woruŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: Má zizil ma nyɩmmaba arɩ ma naamba, arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛma ŋɩɩ. Dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ ma mɩɩsɩŋ duomi, dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩma tintee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma lɛ.

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ gaa.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA niiri-la ʋ sɩ heele bʋl a dagɛma Sɩnaɩ peel-la nyuŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ hɛ nyiniŋ arɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-bine tʋɔŋ aŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ aŋ bɩra bɩ wɩɩ bʋla pɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋmʋnsɛ niiri-la a hɛ tabɩɩ-taalaa balɩa lɛ a joŋo pɩmɛ.

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: Peel-la kala fa sɩ tɔ arɩ nyiniŋ ŋɩɩ, ka ma nɩɩ yikoro biriŋ-la tʋɔŋ, ma doho doho-la kala sɩpaalaaraa arɩ ma nɩhɩasɩŋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ nɛ,

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA Wɩa kɛŋ ʋ doluŋ arɩ ʋ tʋla dagɛla nɛ, la nɩɩ ʋ yikoro ma nyiŋ-la tʋɔŋ. Jɩnɩŋ la jɩma arɩ Wɩa arɩ nuhuobiine jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩaa, ka dɩ tɩɩna ha kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Ama bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ la jaŋ chɛ sʋʋŋ a pɩ la tɩtɩa? Dɩ la nɛ bɩra nɩɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa yikoro, nyiŋ-balɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ diila dɩ la sʋʋ.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ bɛɛ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ Wɩa sɩ weye hɛ nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ aŋ bʋl wɩaa pʋ, ka ʋ bɩ sʋba arɩ la sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Mosis, mʋ́ kpagɛ a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩɩ bʋl, a kaa kʋ bʋla pɩla, la jaŋ jegile nɩɩ a kaa tɩŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ nɛ, ba bʋl woruŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋɩɩ naaŋ lɛ a zizilmi, aŋ tuto wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga, ŋɩɩ fa jaŋ leŋ dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩ ba dɩ ba biiriŋ kala a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: Mʋ́ a bʋla pɩba dɩ ba mɩɩra mʋ ba lɛŋŋɛɛ.

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na Mosis, hɛ mɩ teeŋ daha, dɩ mɩ dagɩŋ mɩ wombiee arɩ mɩ niiriŋ ŋ sɩ jaŋ kaa mʋ a dagɛba dɩ ba tutoba tintee-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩba dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.”

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Má to wɩalɩŋ kala ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ́ dagɛma, dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩma dɩ ma hɔŋ tintee-la ma sɩɩ mʋ dɩ ma tɩɩ lɛ, a dieni.

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: Wombiee arɩ niiriŋ deemba nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa dagɛmɛ dɩ mɩ joŋo dagɛma, dɩ ma tutoba dɩ ma nɛ mʋ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a jʋʋ tintee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ.

english_verse: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Ma dɩ ma biiriŋ arɩ ma nihee kala maga dɩ má zizil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ, a tuto wombie-la arɩ niiri-la kala mɩ sɩ jaŋ dagɛma, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ mɩɩ-duduoŋ tintee-la lɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, má tuto wombie-la woruŋ dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩma, dɩ ma pʋŋa yʋgɛ tintee-la sɩ sɩma woruŋ a kɛŋ kɩaa lɛ, arɩ La TƖƖNA ma nyɩmmaba Wɩa sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩma.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, má jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa ŋaa kʋbala nɛ.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩ-wɩɩkala a cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Má ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ a joŋo vɔɔ ma nɩsaa arɩ ma tilliŋ lɛ dɩ ba liliisima bʋa na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ kɛmma kaa mʋ tintee-la ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, tabalaa sɩ kɛŋ dʋa ma sɩ dee bɩ chɛ,

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: dɩɩsɩŋ kala su arɩ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ma dee sɩ bɩ chɛ. Vilee ma hɛ nɩmɛ ma sɩ dee bɩ luo, girep arɩ olif tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ ma hɛ nɩmɛ ma sɩ dee bɩ pɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ ma nɛ kʋ dii kɩaa deemba a vɔgɛ,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: má sɩ́ ma TƖƖNA wɩaa yʋ. Ʋ nɛ kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, lee-la ma fa sɩ hɛ a ŋaa yosi.

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: Má zizil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a chʋchʋɔlɛ ʋ dʋndʋŋa a tutou, a ŋɩŋaa wɩɩkala ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ vene kala to, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔnɔ kpagɛma vesiŋ.

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa bɩ hadɔrʋŋ ka chɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ to vene dɔŋ, ʋ baanɩŋ jaŋ faasa sii ma nyuŋ dɩ ʋ cheima ta tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa magɩsʋ arɩ ma fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Masa lɛ.

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: Má hɛ doluŋ aŋ to wombie-la, niiri-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛma.

english_verse: and live in a way that pleases him. Then you will be able to go in and take this good land from your enemies, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma wuo yuo kiri ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala tintee-la lɛ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: Maachie dɩ ma biiriŋ nɛ pɩɛsɛma, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa bʋl dɩ la to wombiee deemba arɩ niiriŋ deemba arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ dagɛla?”

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: Má bʋla pɩba, “La fa ŋaa yosi nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA joŋ doluŋ a yuo laala.

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: La sɩɩŋ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ, wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋduoruŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Ʋ laala ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a kɛnla kaa kɔ tinteeŋ deeŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩ la naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ chaasa to wombie-la kala, arɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ daga, ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ la nyuŋ.”

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má hɛ doluŋ aŋ to wombie-la arɩ niiri-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Tintee kala ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ, má cheiba, má sɩ́ ba nenige fá. Má sɩ́ ba vesiŋ kpaarʋ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ to ŋɩɩ lɛ a nyɩsa kɛmma.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: Dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ jomba hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ma yuo dii, má sɩ́ ba nenige fá, má chei ba kala. Má sɩ́ leŋe ma dɩ ba pɛ nii.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ leŋe ma biiriŋ jaa ba toloo, tolie-la jaŋ lɛrɛba mʋ dɩ ba ma tuto ba vesiŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ saa ŋaa ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ chaasa na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ a guu cheima.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa nɩalɩŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Má giri ba vʋɩyaa korunuŋ, a ŋmoo ba vesiŋ tabɩaa yɛrɛ, a keri ba vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ lo aŋ nyɩgɛ ba tɔŋŋɔɔ kala.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: Ma chaasa ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɩaa nɛ. Ʋ lɩɩsɛma nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala tʋɔŋ dɩ ma nɛ chaasa ŋaa ʋ nɩchooloo.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA paala choma nɛ a bɩ chɛ dɩ nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba kʋ ŋaa pɛɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ yuo laama arɩ ʋ doluŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, lee-la ma fa sɩ hɛ a ŋaa yosi.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ʋ maga dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nii-la sɩ hɛ ma dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ chɩŋ. Ʋ jaŋ dagɛ ʋ chonuŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ chou a tuto wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga doho doho bʋɩba.

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛrʋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ lemba, ʋ jaŋ cheiba.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a kɩɩ tintee dɔŋ kala. Ma tʋɔŋ, bapɩrɩ koo hapɩrɩ bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Ma pʋsʋŋ ma kala jaŋ lʋlʋl.

english_verse: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!
translation_verse: Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ vesiŋ deemba kʋŋkala kaa kʋ jʋʋ ma dɩa. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋmɩaŋ-la sɩɩ to vesi-la jaŋ mɩɩra toma. Má kɩkɩsɛ kɩaa deemba a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba kpagɛma, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA ŋmɩɛsa hɛ vesi-la lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ choma a pɛ ma lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ma pʋŋ. Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma lʋl biiriŋ yʋgɛ, a leŋ ma mɩaa, girep arɩ olif tɩɩsɩŋ wasɛ, a leŋ dɩ ma pʋsʋŋ ma pʋŋ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala a pɩma tintee-la lɛ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ to wombie-la woruŋ a kɛmba tɩtɩŋ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ choma a leŋ dɩ nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩ ma pɛgɛ chɩŋ, arɩ ʋ sɩ ŋmɩɛsɛ ŋɩɩ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba.

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nyanyalɩɩ kala jʋʋma. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ joŋ nyanyal bɔmɔ-la ma sɩ na Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ kʋŋkala hɛ ma lɛ. Ama La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ pɔ ma jaŋ bʋl arɩ tinteyee deemba nɩaa dolie kɩɩma nɛ, ɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ ŋaa a kiriba dɩ ba lɩɩ tintee-la lɛ?

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: Ama má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma a tɩŋ ba wɩaa. Má liisi wɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa kala lɛ.

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: Ma na wʋkpuŋkperisi-la arɩ wʋmagɩla-la arɩ wʋduoru-la La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ ʋ doluŋ ŋaa nɛ, aŋ kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ joŋo ŋaa nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ fá lɛ.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ faasa jʋʋba. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ foro ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ a faa, ʋ jaŋ kpʋba.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ wɩaa, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ, ʋ ŋaa Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ a magɛ dɩ nʋʋkala fɩfáʋ.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ kiri tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ dɩ ba lɩɩ kʋŋ kʋŋ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma guu kiri ba kala bala. Dɩ ʋ nɛ leŋe ma guu kiri ba kala bala, baga kɩaa jaŋ pʋrɩgɛ tintee-la lɛ a wʋwalɩmɛma.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ joŋ ba kuoroo ma a hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ma leŋ dɩ ba yɩraa lɛl dʋnɩa kala lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo yuo diima. Ma nɛ jaŋ yuo diiba a cheiba.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Má nyɩgɛ ba vesi-la kala. Má sɩ́ vesi-la sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla paa a kɛŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ lɔrɛ a pɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa ka kɩsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: Má hɛ doluŋ aŋ to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, dɩ La TƖƖNA leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a pʋŋ, a jʋʋ tintee-la ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa ma sɩaa tuu tinteeŋ nɛ, ʋ joŋ losuŋ kpʋma, aŋ bɩra leŋ ma dii kʋdiile-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ “Mana.” Ma dɩ ma nyɩmmaba kʋŋkala bɩ kʋdiile-la jɩŋ. Ʋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ a chɩchɛ ma jɩŋ arɩ kʋdiilee dʋndʋŋa dee bɩ nuhuobiine mɩɩsɩŋ ka pa, ama Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl nɩɩ pɩ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Má saa maga dɩ ma jɩŋ nɛ, a nagɛ nuhuobiine sɩ yie kɛŋ ʋ bie a dagʋ wɩaa a kɛnʋ tʋra kɩkɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa ma kɛmma tʋra kɩkɩɩ.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Wombie-la kala ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛma, má tutoba a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga a zizilu.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa kɛmma kaa mʋmʋ tintee-sɩŋ nɛ. Tintee-la kɛŋ fuonuŋ arɩ lɩɩ-bul-sɩaa sɩ bulo lɩɩ a pɩpɛllɛ fuonaasɩŋ arɩ dundolluŋ kala lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. Wheat and barley fields are everywhere, and so are vineyards and orchards full of fig, pomegranate, and olive trees, and there is plenty of honey. Don't Forget the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kʋdiilee bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba nyaa tintee-la lɛ. Ma bɩ jaŋ chɛ kʋŋkala ka nɩmɛ. Tintee-la bʋsʋŋ kɛŋ hɛgɛŋŋɛɛ, ʋ dundolluŋ ma kɛŋ hɔɔ-fɩaŋ, ma sɩ jaŋ wuo huri.

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ dii kɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩɩ chɛ tintee-la lɛ a vɔgɛ, má zil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa arɩ ʋ sɩ joŋ tintee-zɔŋ-la pɩma.

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: Má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a sɩ́ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩaa yʋ. Má to ʋ niiŋ, ʋ wombiee arɩ ʋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ na kɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩɩ chɛ a dii vɔgɛ, a saa dɩɩ zɔŋŋɔɔ a jʋjʋʋ,

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: dɩ ma pʋsʋŋ ma pʋŋ, dɩ ma sɛlɩmɛ arɩ ma hɔpʋla ma pʋŋa pɛ arɩ kʋŋ na-kala ma sɩ kɛnɛ,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa dagʋ a yʋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩaa. Ʋ nɛ kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, lee-la ma fa sɩ hɛ, a ŋaa yosi.

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ kɛmma vɛŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la sɩ jalɩa a kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ lɛ, lee-la dɩ-bɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nʋɔmaa sɩ hɛ. Tintee-la fa bɩ lɩɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ leŋ lɩɩŋ lɩɩ bʋŋ lɛ a pɩma.

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩma kʋdiile-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ‘Mana’ nɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, kɩalɩŋ ma dɩ ma nyɩmmaba kʋŋkala ha sɩ bɩ die aŋ ka. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a magɩsɛma nɛ dɩ ma sɩaa tʋʋ tinteeŋ, dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩma.

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ má jɩŋ nɛ arɩ dʋa-la kala ma sɩ na, ma tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ dee ma naba.

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Má jɩŋ arɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ pɩma doluŋ ma dʋa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ daga arɩ nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba chɩna nɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ chɩŋ ŋɩɩ a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ to, ʋ jaŋ cheima arɩ ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ chei tinteye-la dɔnsʋŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ, jɩnɩŋ ma jaŋ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a mʋ yuo laa tinteyee nɩaa sɩ yʋga kɩɩma aŋ dolie kɩɩma ma tinteeŋ. Nɩalɩŋ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ sɩ jɩla tɩgɛ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ a golli ba tasɩŋ.

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ waayi nɛ woruŋ aŋ dol ma, ba nɛ baa yɩrɛ Anakɩ tɩŋŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ma nɩɩ ba wɩaa nɛ arɩ nʋʋ tuo a jaŋ wuo yuo diiba.

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Jɩnɩŋ, má jɩŋ arɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ laa ma sɩpaaŋ dɩ ʋ yuo dii nɩalɩŋ a nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩɩ dii kɩaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ma kiri ba kala ta dɩ ba lɩɩ tintee-la lɛ arɩ ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ yʋ, ŋɩɩ ma sɩ leŋe ma TƖƖNA Wɩa baanɩŋ faasa sii ma nyuŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a kʋ yi daha, ma vɩa ma TƖƖNA niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ leriŋ, ma leŋe La TƖƖNA chaasa na baanɩŋ nɛ ma nyuŋ a magɛ dɩ ʋ cheima.

english_verse: he said: Moses, hurry down the mountain to those people you led out of Egypt. They have already disobeyed me and committed the terrible sin of making an idol.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Lɩɩ peel-la nyuŋ a tuu lɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ yeŋŋe nɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋ. Ba vɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛba nɛ, aŋ libi vene a pɩ ba tɩtɩa.”

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mɩ jɩŋ nɩaa deemba nɛ, ba ŋaa nyu-duo tɩmma nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: Mʋ́ aŋ lemmi, mɩ na baanɩŋ nɛ woruŋ ba nyuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ cheiba, dɩ ba yɩrɩŋ lɛl dʋnɩa lɛ aŋ to ŋ lɛ a leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa tinteeŋ sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ a yʋga kɩɩba a dolie kɩɩba ma.”

english_verse: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ lɩɩ peel-la nyuŋ a kʋʋ tuu a kori tabɩɩ-taalɩ-la balɩa lɛ Wɩa niiri-la sɩ hɛ, niiri-la sɩ hɛ ma dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ, ka peel-la kala tɔ arɩ nyiŋgeliŋ.

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ kʋ tuu, mɩ na dɩ ma vɩa wɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛma nɛ, aŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ a libi nɛ-bie. Ma guu vɩa wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛma nɛ.

english_verse: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la balɩa mɩ sɩ koro a yaga yɛrɛ ma sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa na baanɩŋ nɛ woruŋ Arɔŋ ma nyuŋ bʋa-la lɛ, a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sʋla laa ʋ ma.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ ma wʋbɔŋ kʋ-la ma sɩ libe ʋ nagɛ nɛ-bie a hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ ʋ dii. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ a ŋmoo yɛrɛ a nɔŋ ʋ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ, mɩ paa hɛ lɩɩ-la sɩ pɛllɛ lɩɩ peeliŋ nyuŋ a tutuu lɛ.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: Ma bɩra leŋe La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ nɛ ma nyuŋ leree deemba lɛ: Tabɩra, Masa arɩ Kɩbʋrɔf Hataava lɛ.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ sɩ ma lɩɩ Kadɛs Banɩa lɛ a mʋ tintee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ, ma vɩa nɛ. Ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ daga to, ma bɩ ʋ laa dii.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ jɩmma faafaa kala, ma paala bɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa ka nɩɩ.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: Mɩ gbieni La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala tapʋlaa mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA fa sɩ ʋʋ chɛ dɩ ʋ cheima nɛ.

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: Mɩ sʋllʋ a bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, sɩ́ ŋ nɩaa ŋ tɩtɩa sɩ lɩɩsa chei. Ŋ nɛ laaba arɩ ŋ doluŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ a kɛmba kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Liisi ŋ tɩntɩnnaa Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb wɩaa, aŋ sɩ́ nɩaa deemba nyuduoŋ, ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ba wʋcheelee wɩaa beŋ.

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa jaŋ bʋl arɩ ŋ bɩ wuo kɛŋ ŋ nɩaa kaa yi tintee-la ŋ sɩ sɩ ŋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ bɛrɛba wɩaa. Ba jaŋ bʋl ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ kɛmba kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ŋ kpʋba ta tintee-hɩlɩŋ deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa ŋ nɩaa nɛ, ŋ nɛ tɩɩba, ŋ nɛ kɛmba arɩ ŋ dol-balɩŋ a kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Yɛrɛ a lɩɩsɛ tabɩɩ-taalaa balɩa dɩ ba nagɛ bumbuŋ kɩalɩŋ a kaa kʋ jɩl mɩ teeŋ peel-la nyuŋ. Kɛŋ daaŋ ŋaa daga ma, ʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ jaŋ joŋ tabɩa-la hɛ.

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa fa sɩ hɛ bumbuŋ kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ joŋo yaga yɛrɛ lɛ, a hɛ ba lɛ, dɩ ŋ joŋo hɛ daga-la tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kɛŋ sɔjaamɩŋ daaŋ a ŋaa daga-la, aŋ yɛrɛ lɩɩsɛ tabɩɩ-taalaa balɩa ba nagɛ bumbuŋ kɩalɩŋ, mɩ kaa jɩl peel-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa ʋ fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ bumbuŋ kɩalɩŋ lɛ a hɛ ba ma lɛ, ʋ niiriŋ fii-la ʋ fa sɩ hɛ nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ peel-la nyuŋ aŋ dagɛma, bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ hilimi peel-la bʋbʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA joŋ tabɩa-la a pɩmɛ.

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la a lɩɩ peel-la nyuŋ kʋ tuu a joŋo hɛ daga-la tʋɔŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛmɛ ŋɩɩ. Tabɩa-la ha hɛ daga-la tʋɔŋ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: Má zizil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a tɩma pʋpʋ. Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ a kɛŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ a tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: (Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɩɩ Jakaŋ tɩŋŋaa vile-la leriŋ a mʋ lee kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔsɛra. Nɩmɛ nɛ Arɔŋ sʋʋ ba hugu, ka ʋ nanʋala Elieza laa ʋ nyuŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ba lɩɩ Mɔsɛra lɛ a mʋ Gugoda a kiele mʋ Jobata, lee-la fuo-biisiŋ sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Peel-la nyuŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa baalaa, dɩ ba nɛ chʋchʋŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la aŋ tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa a sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Ba tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ ha ŋɩɩ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mʋ a laa nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba mʋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ hɛ niiŋ a pɩ ba naabalɩmaba arɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩba dɩ ba tɩɩʋ.” Má zizil ma TƖƖNA

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa, má jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma ŋaa. Má zizil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ. Má cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a tɩma pʋpʋ arɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩ-wɩɩkala.

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Má to ma TƖƖNA niiŋ arɩ ʋ wombie-la mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ a pɩma.

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ tɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ, Wɩa-jaŋ arɩ tinteeŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, La TƖƖNA chaasa cho ma naabalɩmaba nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bɩ tintee dɔŋ-kala lɩɩsa, aŋ lɩɩsɛma dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ʋ nɩaa. Ma nɛ ha ŋaa ʋ nɩaa arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ kɩɩ vene kala. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ kʋŋkala lɛ a magɛ dɩ ma zizilu. Ʋ bɩ nɩaa kaa pʋpɔrɛ, nʋʋkala ma bɩ ʋ wuo kpal dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haala wɩaa ka sɛɩ. Ʋ cho nɩwogusuŋ a pɩpɩba kʋdiilee arɩ gɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má cho nʋhʋɔraa, bɛɛ wɩaa ma ma fa ŋaa nʋhʋɔra nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ ŋaa ma Wɩa, má zilu. Ma tɩtɩa na wʋduoru-la arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa pɩma nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Má cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a tuto ʋ niiŋ arɩ ʋ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Remember, he corrected you and not your children. You are the ones who saw the Lord use his great power
translation_verse: Jɩnɩŋ ma jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ na, ma biiriŋ dee bɩ ba na. Ma nɛ na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ a kɛmma tʋraa kɩɩ, ma na ʋ ballɩŋ arɩ ʋ doluŋ sɩ yʋga nɛ.

english_verse: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.
translation_verse: Ma na wʋmagɩla-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ nɩaa kala lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!
translation_verse: Ma na ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ yuo dii Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo arɩ ba janɩŋ arɩ ba janɩŋ torukoba kala nɛ, a jomba yuo hɛ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ lɛ ba kala sʋʋ, bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kire to ma harɩŋ.

english_verse: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.
translation_verse: Ma biiriŋ dee bɩ wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa pɩma tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ na, aŋ ka ma-na kɔ daha.

english_verse: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe tinteeŋ suri Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩɩŋ lɛ a paa Ɛlɩab sɩ ŋaa Rubiŋ doho nʋʋ biiriŋ liŋ, Dataŋ arɩ Abɩram arɩ ba dɩa nɩaa, ba lɛŋŋɛɛ, tɩntɩnnaa arɩ ba pʋsʋŋ kala.

english_verse: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord's mighty power do all these things.
translation_verse: Ama ma tɩtɩa nɛ na wʋduoru-la kala La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ toba, ma jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a wuo chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a jʋʋ tintee-la a laaʋ tɩɩ.

english_verse: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma wuo dieni tintee-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩ ba dɩ ba doho nɩaa. Tintee-la zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ a kɛŋ kɩaa.

english_verse: It's better land than you had in Egypt, where you had to struggle just to water your crops.
translation_verse: Tintee-la ma sɩɩ mʋ, dɩ ma laaʋ a tɩɩ, ʋ bɩ Ijipiti tintee-la lɛ ma sɩ lɩa naga. Ijipiti lɛ ma yie duu kɩaa nɛ a ŋaa lɩɩŋ mɩmɩsɛ.

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: Ama tintee-la ma sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma jʋʋ, ʋ kɛŋ peelee arɩ fuonaasɩŋ nɛ, duonuŋ nɩnɩɩ woruŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩɩŋ fɩɛsɛ tintee-la lɛ nɛ woruŋ, ʋ yie beŋ ʋ nyuŋ a lɩɩ jɩna dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa dɩ ma nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a to wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ a cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a tɩmaa pʋ arɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩ-wɩɩkala,

english_verse: he will send rain at the right seasons, so you will have more than enough food, wine, and olive oil, and there will be plenty of grass for your cattle.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma pʋsʋŋ ma na yaŋ a didii, dɩ ma tɩtɩa na kʋdiilee a dii vʋvɔgɛ.

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa, dɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa sɩ́ bɩrɩmʋ dɩ ma to vesiŋ harɩŋ a kpʋkpaarɛba.

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ. Ʋ jaŋ pɔ dɩ duonuŋ sɩ́ nɩɩ pɩma dɩ ma wuo pɛrɛ a na kɩaa. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma sʋʋ lɩma tintee-zɔŋ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩpɩma.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Má joŋ wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma a hɛ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma nyuŋ lɛ, a ŋmʋnsɛba a vɔɔ mɛrɛ ma nɩsaa arɩ ma tilliŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Má joŋ wɩalɩŋ a dɩdagɛ ma biiriŋ bʋa na-kala, ma dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ koo dɩ ma nɩɩ vɛŋ wombiiŋ, dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma pɩŋ koo dɩ ma nɛ pɩna aŋ sii.

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: Má ŋmʋnsɛba a hɛ ma borusuŋ arɩ ma boi-baalaa lɛ,

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma dɩ ma biiriŋ kala mɩɩsɩŋ duomi tintee-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba, dɩ ma hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a tuto wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma, a cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, a tuto ʋ wombiee a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ,

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: ʋ jaŋ yuo a kiri tinteye-la kala nɩaa sɩ hɛ ma sɩpaaŋ a yʋga kɩɩma a kɛŋ doluŋ ma kɩɩma. Ka dɩ ma laa ba dɩhɔnʋŋ a hɔŋ.

english_verse: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Lee na-kala ma sɩ joŋ naaŋ nʋɔsɛ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ. Ma tinteeŋ bʋa jaŋ chɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ a mʋ yi Lɛbanɔŋ tinteeŋ, a bɩra chɩŋ Yufireti fuo-la lɛ a kaa mʋ mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediterenia sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ ma sɩpaaŋ. Lee na-kala ma sɩ jaŋ mʋ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ hɛ nɩalɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba fɩfáma arɩ ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You have a choice—do you want the Lord to bless you, or do you want him to put a curse on you?
translation_verse: Jɩnɩŋ wɩaa balɩa nɛ mɩ joŋo bil ma sɩpaaŋ: Wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa pɛ ma lɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa cheima.

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa pɛ ma lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ ma nɛ to ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ma, ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa cheima nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ ma nɛ vɩa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ aŋ tuto vesiŋ ma sɩ bɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ kɛmma mʋ tintee-la ma sɩɩ mʋ dɩ ma tɩɩʋ, ʋ maga dɩ má jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɛrɩzɩm nɛ a dagɛ wɩalɩŋ nʋʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa pɛ ʋ lɛ, aŋ bɩra jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛbal ma a dagɛ wɩalɩŋ nʋʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa cheyu.

english_verse: You know that these two mountains are west of the Jordan River in land now controlled by the Canaanites living in the Jordan River valley. The mountains are west of the road near the sacred trees of Moreh on the other side of Gilgal.
translation_verse: Peelee deemba balɩa hɛ Kɛnaŋ tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la cholo tinteeŋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ, ba dɩ More tɩɩ-bala-la bɩ bol aŋ kpagɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɩlɩgal.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Ma ka mʋa nɛ, ka dɩ ma chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a jʋʋ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩpɩma dɩ ma tɩɩ. Dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ tintee-la a hɔŋ nɩmɛ,

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: má hɛ doluŋ aŋ to wombie-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ joŋo bil ma sɩpaaŋ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: Wombiee deemba arɩ niiriŋ deemba nɛ maga dɩ ma fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a tuto, bʋa-la kala lɛ ma sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa ma naabalɩmaba Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma.

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Tinteye-la kala ma sɩ yuo dii, má chei ba vʋɩyaa dɩ-kpaaraa kala, kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ peelee nyuŋ arɩ dundolluŋ arɩ tɩɩsɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Má yɛrɛ ba vʋɩyaa korunuŋ arɩ ba vesiŋ tabɩaa, aŋ nyɩgɛ ba vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ. Má chei ba tɔŋŋɔɔ kala, dɩ ba yɩraa lɛl lere-la.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: Ma pɔ má sɩ́ ŋɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ to aa kpaarɛ ba vesiŋ to a zil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Dɩ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ma zizilu nɛ faasa bol arɩ ma dɩɩsɩŋ, ma jaŋ wuo kpʋ pʋsʋ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩma ma tasɩŋ lɛ a chaŋ a magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ma sɩɩ chɛ arɩ mɩ sɩ dagɛma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ wuo chamba arɩ ma sɩɩ chaŋ tɛhɩɩ koo aamɩŋ ŋɩɩ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ Wɩa teeŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ Wɩa teeŋ kala jaŋ wuo chaŋ.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ chalɩŋ ka dii, La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ, dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩ ma dɩ ma doho nɩaa kala.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna nammɩa arɩ ʋ chalɩŋ kaa mʋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa koru-la teeŋ. Ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ kala chalɩŋ maga dɩ má joŋo bɩsa wurisi La TƖƖNA koru-la nɛ. Ama, ma jaŋ wuo chaŋ ba nammɩa-na.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a tuto wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma, dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩ ma dɩ ma doho bʋa na-kala lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa maa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ a tʋtɔrɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ chei tinteye-la kala nɩaa sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ ma sɩɩ mʋ dɩ ma tɩɩ. Ama dɩ ma nɛ kiriba ta ba tintee-la lɛ aŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ,

english_verse: But that's when you must be especially careful not to ask, “How did those nations worship their gods? Shouldn't we worship the Lord in the same way?”
translation_verse: ma pʋpɔ dɩ má sɩ́ chɩchɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ to a kpʋkpaarɛ ba vesiŋ, a bʋl ma ma jaŋ to ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa a zil ma Wɩa.

english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Má bɩ maga dɩ má zil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa ŋɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ zil ba vesiŋ. Dɩ ba nɩɩ kpaarɛ ba vesiŋ, ba yie ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ bana kɛnɛ a kɩkɩsɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Ba yie wuo joŋ ba biiriŋ a nyɩga pɩ ba vesiŋ.

english_verse: Obey all the laws and teachings I am giving you. Don't add any, and don't take any away.
translation_verse: Má hɛ doluŋ aŋ to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma, ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ wɩɩ lɩɩsa ta a sɩ́ wɩɩ ma kaa pɛ.

english_verse: Someday a prophet may come along who is able to perform miracles or tell what will happen in the future. Then the prophet may say, “Let's start worshiping some new gods—some gods that we know nothing about.”
translation_verse: dɩ wʋkpuŋkpere-la koo wʋmagɩl-la wɩaa ʋ sɩ bʋla nɛ sɛnɛ ŋaa, ka dɩ ʋ bʋl, “Má leŋ dɩ la to vesiŋ a pɛ La Tɩɩna lɛ a kpʋkpaarɛba ,”

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: má sɩ́ jegile nɩɩ ʋ teeŋ. Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa to ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ dɩ ʋ magɩsɛma a na arɩ ma chou arɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩ-wɩɩkala nɛ.

english_verse: You must be completely faithful to the Lord. Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga dɩ ma tuto a zizilu. Má tuto ʋ niiŋ a tɩma pʋpʋ a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: because he rescued you from slavery in Egypt. If a prophet tells you to disobey the Lord your God and to stop worshiping him, then that prophet is evil and must be put to death.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la koo nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagɛ duosoo bʋbʋɔŋ maga dɩ ma kpʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla lɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ daga harɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ kɛmma kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, a laama ta lee-la ma fa sɩ hɛ a ŋaa yosi. Nɩdoho deeŋ ka walɩmɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛma wombii-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛma lɛ nɛ. Má kpʋ nɩɩ-la a giri wʋbɔŋ-la ta ma tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kpʋ nɩɩ-la dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmba. Ba kʋŋkala maachie bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la doho.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ hɔŋ tasɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩma, a nɩɩ

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɩɩ ma tʋɔŋ a nyɩsɛ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ to vesiŋ, vesi-la ma ha sɩ bɩ to aŋ ka,

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: má hɛ doluŋ aŋ beŋ wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ woruŋ a na, dɩ ma nɛ kʋ na dɩ wʋlɔrʋ-la sɛnɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: má chei taŋ-la kala, a kpʋ ʋ nɩaa arɩ ba pʋsʋŋ kala.

english_verse: Gather all the possessions of the people who lived there, and pile them up in the marketplace, without keeping anything for yourself. Set the pile and the whole town on fire, and don't ever rebuild the town. The whole town will be a sacrifice to the Lord your God. Then he won't be angry anymore, and he will have mercy on you and make your nation stronger, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ taŋ-la kɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala La TƖƖNA sɩ sɩ ma nyɩgɛ joŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA baaŋ-la ʋ sɩ faasa na ma nyuŋ jaŋ tuu tinteeŋ ka dɩ ʋ fá ma nenige. Ʋ jaŋ fá ma nenige a leŋ dɩ ma pʋŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ a pɩ ma naabalɩmaba ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: dɩ ma nɛ to ʋ niiŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ma ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ. Dʋnɩa kala tʋɔŋ, ma TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛma nɛ dɩ ma ŋaa nɩa ʋ sɩ chaasa cho.

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ wuo chaŋ diibiisi-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ wuo chaŋ pʋna koo bagɩl na-kala sɩ kɛŋ naachɛŋŋɛɛ aŋ gbu kɩaa chɩchaŋ.

english_verse: But don't eat camels, rabbits, and rock badgers. These animals chew the cud but do not have divided hoofs. You must treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Ama pʋsʋ-la arɩ bagɩla-la sɩ bɩ naachɛŋŋɛɛ kɛnɛ aŋ gbu kɩaa chɩchaŋ tʋɔŋ, má sɩ́ bʋntaŋŋa, chuomo arɩ bʋŋ-nyuŋ gbuŋgbogo chaŋ, ba kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: Tooŋ ma kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ ma teeŋ, ʋ ma kɛŋ naachɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ aŋ bɩ kɩaa gbu chɩchaŋ, má sɩ́ ʋ nammɩa chaŋ a sɩ́ ʋ kʋsʋʋŋ ma digu.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ kerikee arɩ horuŋ ma jaŋ wuo chamba.

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Ama kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ horuŋ arɩ kerikee kɛnɛ, ba kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ ma teeŋ má sɩ́ ba chaŋ.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ wuo chaŋ filli na-kala sɩ kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ aŋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ kʋŋ na-kala sɩ sʋʋ pimee dii. Ma jaŋ wuo joŋo pɩ nɩwogusu-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ dɩ ba dii koo ma yalla pɩ nɩwogusu-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ hɔnɔ kpagɛma. Ma ŋaa ma TƖƖNA nɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ. Má sɩ́ bʋʋ-bie koo pie-bie chɔ ʋ naaŋ yɩlɩŋ lɛ. Kpaalɩŋ fii-la sɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA kʋa

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa jɩna na-kala, ma kaa kpaa leree fii a joŋ dɔŋɔ bil.

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ma mɩaa, ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ a kpaa leree fii-la a joŋ kɩalɩŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA, a pɛ ma pʋsʋŋ bii-bumbumba lɛ, má kaa mʋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dagɛma dɩ ma mʋ a zizilu nɩmɛ a dii kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Má ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ a zizil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa bʋa na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Dɩ lee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ daga nɛ bolie arɩ ma dɩɩsɩŋ, ma sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo chʋŋ kpaalɩŋ fii time-la kaa mʋ, kɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA sɩ pɛ ma lɛ ma na,

english_verse: then sell this part and take the money there instead.
translation_verse: má joŋo yallɛ a kɛŋ moribie-la mʋ lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ dɩ ma zizilu nɩmɛ.

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: Ma joŋ moribie-la a yɔɔ kʋŋ na-kala ma sɩɩ chɛ: Nɛsɩŋ, piesee, tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ koo sɩ-yele. Ma dɩ ma dɩa nɩaa jaŋ dii kɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ aŋ gbieli.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: Ma pɔ má sɩ́ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ wɩaa yʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba-na bɩ tinteeŋ kpaalɩŋ kɛnɛ ma tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: Jɩ-tori na-kala dɩdɛrɩŋ, ma sɩ yie kɛŋ ma baga kɩaa kpaa lere fii a joŋ kʋbala-la a pɩ La TƖƖNA, má joŋ ba kala bil ma tasɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Kʋdiile-la nɛ jaŋ ŋaa Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ kpaal kɛnɛ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ kʋdiilee, ba dɩ nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haala-la sɩ hɛ ma tasɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba dii a vɔgɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ wɩɩkala ma sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, dɩ summoo hɛ ma naambiiri-la tʋɔŋ tasɩ-la kʋŋkala lɛ, má sɩ́ tʋɔhɛɛŋ kɛŋ a vɩaba ta.

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ maga ma ŋɩŋaa: Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna nɛ joŋ kɩaa a chɩŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ, ʋ bɩra sɩ́ pɩɛsa laa, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ sɩ ba giri chɩŋŋaa ta yie nɛ.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ wuo pɩɛsa laa ma chɩŋŋaa nɩwogusuŋ teeŋ, ama ma naambiiriŋ-na teeŋ, má gire ta.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ chaasa pɛ ma lɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩma ŋɩɩ. Tinteyee jaŋ yʋgɛ a chɩŋ kɩaa ma teeŋ, ama ma-na bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ kʋŋ nʋʋkala teeŋ. Tintee kala nɩaa bɩ jaŋ bibemma, ama ma-na jaŋ bibeŋ tintee daŋ.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and lend them what they need.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ zile a joŋ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ chɛ a chɩmba.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Dɩ jɩ-pɛɩ-la lɛ ma sɩ jaŋ giri chɩŋŋaa ta nɛ kpaga ma, ka dɩ ma naambiiri-la kʋŋ nɩsɩŋ buo, dɩ ʋ chɩchɛ ʋ chɩŋ kʋŋ ma teeŋ, má sɩ́ tʋɔhɛɛŋ kɛŋ a vɔmʋ. Dɩ ma nɛ vɔmʋ dɩ ʋ yele pɩ La TƖƖNA, ma jaŋ laa cheeriŋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ wɩaa gʋrʋmʋ aŋ-na pɛ ʋ lɛ, má pɛ ʋ lɛ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala ma sɩɩ tɩŋ lɛ, ma nɩsɩŋ jaŋ su.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ pʋsʋ-la kʋŋ nɛ kɛŋ nyɔɔ, dɩ ʋ nyʋlɩma nɛ koo dɩ ʋ gbɛrɩgɛ nɛ koo dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nyanyal-bɔŋ dɔŋ nɛ, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛnʋ kʋ kpʋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ taʋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ mʋ arɩ na-hɩllɩŋ.

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ pɛ ŋ lɛ ŋ dʋa a pʋ, piesee, mɩaa arɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ yomo-la nɛ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ ʋ bɩ jaŋ viiri, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ cho ŋ dɩ ŋ dɩa nɩaa wɩaa, ka ʋ nɩsɩŋ ma jʋjʋʋ,

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na kɛŋ ʋ dɩgɩlɩŋ mʋ mɛrɛ boro lɛ a tɔɔ luri arɩ luro. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ yoŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Dɩ yomo-la nɛ ŋaa haal, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: Má joŋ ma pʋsʋŋ bii-bumbumba sɩ ŋaa belliŋ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. Ma pɔ má sɩ́ ma nɛsɩŋ bii-bumbumba-la kaa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa, a pʋpɔ má sɩ́ ma piesee ma bii-bumbumba pʋnaa kɛ.

english_verse: Instead, each year you must take the first-born of these animals to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped. You and your family will sacrifice them to the Lord and then eat them as part of a sacred meal.
translation_verse: Jɩna na-kala ma dɩ ma dɩa nɩaa jaŋ kɛŋ pʋsʋ-la mʋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ, a kpʋ chaŋ.

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ʋ teeŋ, ma kala jaŋ wuo chamba ma tasɩŋ lɛ a nagɛ ma sɩ yie chaŋ tɛhɩɩ koo aamɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ba chalɩŋ dii, má joŋo bɩsa ta.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: Chɛnɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Abib tʋɔŋ, má gbieli ma TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele, bɛɛ wɩaa chɛnɛ-la tʋɔŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ nɛ ʋ kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ laa ma wɩɩkala sɩpaaŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma a tɩɩʋ. Má sɩ́ vesiŋ to

english_verse: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord. The Harvest Festival (Exodus
translation_verse: Má dii boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ tapʋlaa balɩdʋ, ama tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ má sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ, má hilimi a zil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. Baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ gbiele

english_verse: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Má lɩɩsɛ piese koo nɛŋ a kaa mʋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ma zizilu a kpʋ a ŋaa ma TƖƖNA dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la kʋdiilee.

english_verse: Don't offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town where you happen to live.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ La TƖƖNA dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la pʋna kpʋ taŋ kala ma sɩ cho lɛ, tasɩ-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma lɛ,

english_verse: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.
translation_verse: see lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛma dɩ ma mʋ a zizilu. Nɩmɛ nɛ ma jaŋ kpʋ pʋsʋ-la wɩɩ-mul-jʋʋlʋŋ, bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ ma sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.
translation_verse: Má wasɛ nammɩa-la a chaŋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dagɛma. Dɩ taŋ nɛ pʋla chʋchʋɔŋ, má mɩɩra mʋ ma dɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ tabɩɩ kala joŋo bil aa kpaarɛ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa bɛrɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: After you have finished the grain harvest and the grape harvest, take your sons and daughters and all your servants to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Celebrate the Festival of Shelters for seven days. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. The Lord will give you big harvests and make you successful in everything you do. You will be completely happy, so celebrate this festival in honor of the Lord your God. Three Festivals at the Place of Worship (Exodus
translation_verse: Má mʋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dagɛma dɩ ma zizilu a gbieli gbiele-la tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma TƖƖNA pɛ ma lɛ nɛ ma baga kɩaa wasɛ, a pɛ ma lɛ ma nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa ma kala lɛ.

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ dɩ ma pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, má pɔ dɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daa kala sɩ́ nɩmɛ pɛ.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you start your grain harvest,
translation_verse: Má chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ suomo a kʋkʋŋ ma mɩaa a dɩɩsɛ yɔɔsʋŋ balɩpɛ,

english_verse: go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped and celebrate the Harvest Festival in honor of the Lord your God. Bring him an offering as large as you can afford, depending on how big a harvest he has given you. Be sure to take along your sons and daughters and all your servants. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Ma dɩ ma biiriŋ, ma tɩntɩnnaa, baalaa arɩ haalaa, Levi doho nɩalɩŋ arɩ nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haala-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, ma kala maga dɩ má mʋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ma zilu nɩmɛ a gbieli ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be. Treat Everyone with Justice Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ kʋŋ nɛ a mʋ dii zile pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ. Sarɩya diiree

english_verse: Each year there are three festivals when all Israelite men must go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. These are the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters. And don't forget to take along a gift for the Lord.
translation_verse: Jɩna na-kala tʋɔŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa baalaa kala maga má mʋ ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ naansɩɩŋ butori nɛ, lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛma dɩ ma zizilu, a gbieli gbielee deemba: La TƖƖNA dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele, baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ gbiele arɩ lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele. Nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ arɩ na-hɩllɩŋ.

english_verse: After you are settled in the towns that you will receive from the Lord your God, the people in each town must appoint judges and other officers. Those of you that become judges must be completely fair when you make legal decisions, even if someone important is involved. Don't take bribes to give unfair decisions. Bribes keep people who are wise from seeing the truth and turn honest people into liars.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba bɩ maga dɩ ba joŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ faa, a sɩ laa pɛ nʋʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kɩaa nɛ bɩ sɩŋ, a sɩ́ kpalaa laa. Kpalaa nɛ yie leŋ nɩaa joŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ faa aŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ bɩrɩmɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted! Put To Death People Who Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ma pɔ má sɩ́ nɛŋ koo piese sɩ kɛŋ nyɔɔ kpʋ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, ʋʋ kɩsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.
translation_verse: dɩ ma nɛ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, má nyilimi wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ woruŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ na dɩ wɩɩ-la ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ, arɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ nɛ ba sɛnɛ ŋaa Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ,

english_verse: But you will need two or three witnesses—one witness isn't enough to prove a person guilty. Get rid of those who are guilty of such evil. Take them outside your town gates and everyone must stone them to death. But the witnesses must be the first to throw stones. Difficult Cases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ dii pɛ na nɛ maga dɩ ba laa sɩpaaŋ paa tabɩaa a yagɛ nɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋ, ka dɩ nɩkaanaa na pɛ. Ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a giri wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba doho ta Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba, dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ wʋdosunu-la ŋaa. Ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ to a lɩɩsɛ kuoro

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ yi tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ma hɔŋ ʋ lɛ a tɩɩʋ, ma jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ kuoro, arɩ tinteye-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ golli ma sɩ kɛŋ kuoroo ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: Má beŋ woruŋ arɩ nɩɩ-la ma sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kuoro, ŋaa nʋʋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa. Ʋ maga ʋ ŋaa ma naambii nɛ, nɩwogo bɩ maga ʋ ŋaa ma kuoro.

english_verse: The king should not have many horses, especially those from Egypt. The Lord has said never to go back there again.
translation_verse: Kuoru-la bɩ maga ʋ kɛŋ janɩŋ yʋgɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ nɩaa mɩɩra mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a yɔɔ janɩŋ kaa kʋ pʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ, ʋ bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ nɩaa bɩra joŋ ba sɩaa chaasɛ lee-la.

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Kuoru-la bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ haalaa yʋgɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa La TƖƖNA. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ chɩchɛ ʋ kɛŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ yʋgɛ.

english_verse: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ dii kuoruŋ, ʋ maga ʋ laa ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa hɛ teŋ-la lɛ Levi doho nɩaa sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa teeŋ, a leŋ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ teniŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ pʋ dɩ ʋ bil, a kɩkarɩmɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: Teŋ-la maga ʋ hɛ ʋ teeŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ kɩkarɩmɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ zizil ʋ Tɩɩna Wɩa a tuto ʋ wombiiŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ Wɩa wombiiŋ lɛ bibegili, a bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ nɛ kpɩa ʋ naambiiriŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala. Dɩ ʋ nɛ to woruŋ, ʋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa jaŋ dii kuoruŋ a dieni Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ ba naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ dɩ ʋ nagɛ ŋ-na Mosis, a joŋ mɩ wɩaa hɛ ʋ niiŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagʋ a pɩba.

english_verse: Some Levites may have money from selling family possessions, and others may not. But all Levites serving at the place of worship will receive the same amount of food from the sacrifices and gifts brought by the people. Don't Do Disgusting Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩ ʋ dɔnsʋ-la kala kpaalɩŋ jaŋ magɛ dɔŋɔ. Kpaalɩŋ deeŋ-na bɩ ʋ nyɩmma dʋa kpaalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa lɛ pɛ. Wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kɩsʋ

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord,
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa kala bɩ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ tinteeŋ kpaal Iziral tinteeŋ kala lɛ. Ba kpaalɩŋ nɛ kɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kaa kɔ dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kpʋ nɛ-bele koo piesu dɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ vaaŋ, talaŋa arɩ tʋɔŋ kɩaa.

english_verse: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Ma doho doho kala tʋɔŋ, Levi doho nɩaa arɩ ba doho nɩaa kala nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: Dɩ Levi tɩɩna nɛ lɩɩ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa tasɩ-la kʋŋ ʋ sɩ hɛ lɛ, a mʋ lee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ma zizilu,

english_verse: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.
translation_verse: ʋ jaŋ wuo tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa ʋ Tɩɩna Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɩmɛ arɩ ʋ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ ŋɩɩ lee-la.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord, and you must not follow their example.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ jʋʋ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, má sɩ́ tinteye-la sɩ hɛ lee-la nɩaa lɛ to a ŋaa wɩaa deemba sɩɩ kɩsʋ.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋkɩsaa deemba nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa kikiri tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Never be guilty of doing any of these disgusting things! A Prophet like Moses Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma kɛŋ wʋcheeli kala ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla

english_verse: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.
translation_verse: Tinteye-la ma sɩɩ mʋ dɩ ma yuo kiri aŋ laa ba tinteeŋ, ba nɩaa ka to vʋgʋraa arɩ chichiribee niiŋ nɛ. Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa bɩ chɛ dɩ ma-na tuto wɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ ma naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ a pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ʋ wʋlaabʋlla a nagɛ mɩ-na Mosis. Ʋ maga dɩ má jegile nɩnɩɩ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord, “Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die!”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ hilimi peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ bʋbʋɔŋ, ma sɩ, “La bɩra bɩ chɛ dɩ la nɩɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa yikoro, koo dɩ la na ʋ nyiŋ-bal-la, dɩ la nɛ na ŋɩɩ la jaŋ sʋʋ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ vɩa dɩ ʋ jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ-la sɩ jaŋ bʋl mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, mɩ-na tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ tɩɩna.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ama dɩ mɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ kala nɛ bʋl wɩɩ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, ka mɩ dee bɩ ʋ hɛ, koo dɩ vene dɔŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ ma kpʋʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ wuo pɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ a bʋl, “Ɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaa jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa dee bɩ ʋ hɛ ʋ bʋbʋl wɩɩ-la?”

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ bʋl wɩɩ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ, ka wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla bɩ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ, ŋɩɩ-na La TƖƖNA dee bɩ ʋ hɛ, ʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la ʋ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ, má sɩ́ ʋ fa.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord your God has promised that if you obey his laws and teachings I'm giving you, and if you always love him, then he will give you the land he promised your ancestors. When that happens, you must name three more Safe Towns in the new territory.
translation_verse: a tɩŋ ma sɩ fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a to wombie-la kala mɩ sɩ joŋo dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, a cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a tuto ʋ wombiee bʋa na-kala, ʋ maga dɩ má bɩra lɩɩsɛ tasɩŋ batori nɛ a pɛ.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled,
translation_verse: Dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ chei tinteye-la nɩaa tinteeŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, dɩ ma kiriba ta aŋ laa ba tasɩŋ arɩ ba dɩɩsɩŋ a hɔŋ,

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: La joŋ arɩ nʋʋ arɩ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna nɛ sii mʋ gɩrɩŋ dɩ ba keri daasɩŋ. Ʋ sɩɩ keri ŋɩɩ, dɩ saaŋ fogi a yagɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna-la kpʋ. Baal-la jaŋ wuo fá mʋ tasɩ-la dɔŋɔ a laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: You don't deserve to die, since you did not mean to harm your friend. But he did get killed, and his relatives might be very angry. They might even choose one of the men from their family to track you down and kill you. If it is too far to one of the Safe Towns, the victim's relative might be able to catch you and kill you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kpʋa naambile sɩ jaŋ dii ʋ dʋa nɛ na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa, ʋ jaŋ na baanɩŋ a kire to nɩɩ-la sɩ kpʋ ʋ naambie harɩŋ. Dɩ taŋ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ mʋ yuori nɛ bolie, ʋ jaŋ kire kɛnʋ a kpʋʋ, ka ʋ fa bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kpʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ sɛnɛ.

english_verse: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ mɩ bʋl ma lɩɩsɛ tabalaa batori a pɩ ma tɩtɩa a fá mʋ yuyuori nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You will need them, so innocent people won't be killed on your land while they are trying to reach a Safe Town that is too far away. You will be guilty of murder, if innocent people lose their lives because you didn't name enough Safe Towns in the land the Lord your God will give you.
translation_verse: Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ, dɩ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye chalɩŋ sɩ́ tintee-la lɛ jaasʋ, dɩ ma laa cheeriŋ.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɛrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, a maachie sii lʋara ŋmobu kpʋ, aŋ fá mʋ tasɩŋ deemba dɔŋɔ,

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: ʋ taŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ maga dɩ ba leŋ dɩ ba mʋ kɛnʋ mɩɩra kɔ ba jaŋ nɛ, dɩ ba joŋu hɛ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kpʋa naambile sɩ jaŋ dii ʋ dʋa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋʋ.
