english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ nɩɩ-la nenige fá. Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ a leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye chalɩŋ sɩ́ jaasʋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, ka dɩ wɩaa wuo vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩma.

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma lɛ, má sɩ́ tinteeŋ bʋɔsʋ-la ma naabalɩmaba sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bil kaa vʋgʋmɛ a gʋrɛ dɔŋɔ. Pɛ-naaraa wɩaa

english_verse: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ba bʋl arɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ nɛ a chei, nɩbala dʋndʋŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ na arɩ wɩɩ-la ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Nɩaa balɩa koo nɩaa batori nɛ jaŋ wuo pɛ na ka dɩ wɩɩ-la na chɩŋ.

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sɩ ʋ pɛ na wɩɩ a nyɩɛ wɩaa pɩ nʋʋ arɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ nɛ a chei,

english_verse: then both you and the accused must be taken to the court at the place where the Lord is worshiped. There the priests and judges will find out if you are lying or telling the truth. If you are lying and the accused is innocent,
translation_verse: Sarɩya diire-la maga dɩ ba beŋ wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ nɛ woruŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ kʋ na arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ sɩ ʋ pɛ na wɩɩ-la nɛ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ, a nyɩɛ wɩaa pɩpɩ ʋ naambile,

english_verse: then you will be punished without mercy. You will receive the same punishment the accused would have received if found guilty, whether it means losing an eye, a tooth, a hand, a foot, or even your life. Israel, the crime of telling lies in court must be punished. And when people hear what happens to witnesses that lie, everyone else who testifies in court will tell the truth.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ nʋʋkala nenige fá. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kpʋ ʋ dɔŋɔ, má kpʋʋ ma, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ pʋrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ sɩɩŋ, má pʋrɛ ʋ ma sɩɩŋ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋmoo ʋ dɔŋɔ nyɩlɩŋ churi, má ŋmoo ʋ ma nyɩlɩŋ churi, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bori ʋ dɔŋɔ nɩsɩŋ, má bori ʋ ma nɩsɩŋ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bori ʋ dɔŋɔ naaŋ, má bori ʋ ma naaŋ.

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: Dɩ laalɩŋ nɛ sii ma dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ pɛgɛ, dɩ ma nɛ na ba janɩŋ arɩ ba janɩŋ torukoba arɩ ba laalɩyuoroo dɩ ba yʋga kɩɩma, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma, bɛɛ wɩaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ kɛmma kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ma mʋ laalɩŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ kʋ lɩɩ chɩŋ ma laalɩyuoroo sɩpaaŋ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩba.

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ bʋl, “Iziral tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ, jɩnɩŋ maa mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ dɩ ma yuo ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ. Má sɩ́ ba fá, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma bɔyɛ joŋ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ, má sɩ́ chel ba sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ kɛmma vɩvɛŋ, ʋ jaŋ yuo dii ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩma.”

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ ma jaŋ pɩɛsɛ laalɩyuoro-la, “Ma kʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a saa dɩɩ-falɩɩ aŋ ha bɩ suroo? Ʋ tɩɩna mɩɩra mʋ dɩa, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ jaŋ wuo sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ ka dɩ nɩwogo mɩɩra mʋ suri dɩa-la.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Ma kʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a chɔnsɛ tɩɩsɩŋ baga, aŋ ha bɩ ba nɛnɛɛ die? Ʋ tɩɩna mɩɩra mʋ dɩa, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ jaŋ wuo sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, ka dɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ mɩɩra dii tɩɩnɛnɛ-la.

english_verse: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.
translation_verse: Ma kʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a sʋgɛ haala aŋ ha bɩ jaa? Ʋ tɩɩna mɩɩra mʋ dɩa, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ jaŋ wuo sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, ka dɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ jaa haal-la.”

english_verse: Finally, if any of you are afraid, you may go home. We don't want you to discourage the other soldiers.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la jaŋ bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “Ma kʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ ʋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ koo fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ? Ʋ tɩɩna mɩɩra mʋ dɩa, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ naambiiri-la ma nandaasɩŋ jaŋ yʋɔrɛ.”

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Dɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la nɛ bʋl wɩalɩŋ pɩ laalɩyuoro-la a dɛrɛ, ba jaŋ lɩɩsɛ sɩpaalaaraa dɩ ba bibeŋ laalɩyuoro-la.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: Ama tabala-la sɩ hɛ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ, má kpʋ kʋŋ na-kala sɩɩ wiesu a hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ má kpʋ tinteyee deemba nɩaa kala: Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa, Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa, Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa, Hivi tɩŋŋaa arɩ Jebus tɩŋŋaa arɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ba kpʋa, ba jaŋ dagɛma dɩ ma to ba lɛ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kɩsʋ aa kpaarɛ ba vesiŋ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa lɛ.

english_verse: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ yuo taŋ kala, dɩ yuosu-la nɛ diene magɛ ɛɛ ma, má sɩ́ tɩɩsɩ-la sɩɩ nɛŋ taŋ-la lɛ keru, bɛɛ wɩaa ma jaŋ wuo dii ba nɛnɛɛ. Tɩɩsɩ-la-na bɩ nuhuobiine ŋaa dɩ ma yuyuoba.

english_verse: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ wuo keri tɩɩsɩ-la nɛnɛɛ ma sɩ bɩ dii, a kaa ŋaa lusuŋ-cholluŋ a jʋʋ taŋ-la a yuo diiba.

english_verse: Suppose the body of a murder victim is found in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you, and no one knows who the murderer is.
translation_verse: Tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ, dɩ ma nɛ na nʋʋ dɩ ʋ sʋʋ pɩŋ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ, ka ma bɩ jɩŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ kpʋʋ,

english_verse: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.
translation_verse: ma nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ sarɩya diiree maga dɩ ba mʋ lee-la sʋʋ-la sɩ pɩna, a magɩsɛ a na tasɩ-la sɩ golli lee-la, kʋ-la ʋ sɩ kpaga.

english_verse: The leaders from that town will go to their cattle herds and choose a young cow that has never been put to work.
translation_verse: Taŋ-la sɩ kpagɛ sʋʋ-la, ʋ nɩhɩasɩŋ jaŋ kɛŋ napaha ba ha sɩ bɩ kaa tɩŋ aŋ ka,

english_verse: They and some of the priests will take this cow to a nearby valley where there is a stream, but no crops. Once they reach the valley, the leaders will break the cow's neck. The priests must be there, because the Lord your God has chosen them to be his special servants at the place of worship. The Lord has chosen them to bless the people in his name and to be judges in all legal cases, whether property or injury is involved.
translation_verse: Levi doho sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa maga dɩ ba hɛ nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa, aŋ sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩma, a laa ma wɩaa jɩma pɩpɩma dɩ nɩaa nɛ kɛŋ kaalɛrɛ koo dɩ ba yuo dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The town leaders will wash their hands over the body of the dead cow
translation_verse: Sʋʋ-la sɩ pɩna a kpagɛ taŋ-la, ʋ nɩhɩasɩ-la jaŋ sɔŋ ba nɩsaa a hɛ napaha-la ba sɩ kaa mʋ fuonaaŋ a mɩlɩmɛ ʋ baŋŋaa bori lɛ,

english_verse: and say, “We had no part in this murder, and we don't know who did it.
translation_verse: aŋ chaasa bʋl, “La dee bɩ baala deeŋ kpʋa, la bɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kpʋʋ ma jɩŋ.

english_verse: But since an innocent person was murdered, we beg you, our Lord, to accept this sacrifice and forgive Israel. We are your people, and you rescued us. Please don't hold this crime against us.” If you obey the Lord and do these things, he will forgive Israel. Marrying a Woman Taken Prisoner in War Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Má sɩ folo ŋaa ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩɩ chɛ, ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ laa cheeriŋ baal-la ba sɩ kpʋa bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ. Haalaa ba sɩ yuo laalɩŋ kɛsɛ jaanɩŋ wɩaa

english_verse: From time to time, you men will serve as soldiers and go off to war. The Lord your God will help you defeat your enemies, and you will take many prisoners.
translation_verse: Dɩ laalɩŋ nɛ sii ma dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ pɛgɛ, dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma yuo diiba aŋ kɛsɛ ba haalaa,

english_verse: One of these prisoners may be a beautiful woman, and you may want to marry her. But first you must bring her into your home, and have her shave her head, cut her nails, get rid of her foreign clothes, and start wearing Israelite clothes. She will mourn a month for her father and mother, then you can marry her.
translation_verse: aŋ wuri gɛnnɩ-la ʋ fa sɩ laala, ka ma yuo kɛnʋ aŋ laalɛ gɛrɩ-wogusuŋ. Leŋ dɩ ʋ hɛ ŋ dɩa lɛ a yel ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ yoho chɛŋ-piliŋ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, ma jaŋ wuo jaa dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Later on, if you are not happy with the woman, you can divorce her, and she can go free. But you have slept with her as your wife, so you cannot sell her as a slave or make her into your own slave. Rights of a First-Born Son Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ kʋ magɛ bʋa dɔŋ dɩ ŋ bɩra bɩ ʋ cho, ŋ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ʋ mʋ lee-kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ. Ŋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ joŋu yallɛ arɩ yomo, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ kɛnʋ ŋaa haal nɛ aŋ ka. Kpaal-la sɩ maga dɩ hambolibii-hɩaŋ laa

english_verse: A father and a mother may have a stubborn and rebellious son who refuses to obey them even after he has been punished.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal arɩ ʋ haala nɛ kɛŋ ba bii, dɩ bile kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a bɩ ba niiŋ ka nɩɩ, dɩ ba dagʋ a lɔl,

english_verse: If a son is like that, his parents must drag him to the town gate, where the leaders of the town hold their meetings.
translation_verse: ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ bile mʋ ba jaŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ lee-la ba sɩɩ hilimu.

english_verse: The parents will tell the leaders, “This son of ours is stubborn and never obeys. He spends all his time drinking and partying.”
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ bʋla pɩ nɩhɩasɩ-la, “La bie deeŋ ŋaa nyu-duo tɩɩna nɛ, ʋ bɩ la niiŋ wɩaa ka nɩɩ, a chichei moribiee aŋ pɛ ŋaa sɩ-nyʋarʋ ma.”

english_verse: The men of the town will stone that son to death, because they must get rid of the evil he brought into the community. Everyone in Israel will be afraid when they hear how he was punished. The Body of a Criminal Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Baala-la kala sɩ hɛ ʋ taŋ-la lɛ maga dɩ ba yagʋ kpʋ nɛ arɩ tabɩaa, a lɩɩsɛ wʋbɔŋ-la ta ma tʋɔŋ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala jaŋ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba. Wombie-la ba sɩ bile dɔnsʋŋ

english_verse: If a criminal is put to death, and you hang the dead body on a tree,
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ chaasa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ dɩ ma kpʋʋ a joŋo sagɛ tɩa nyuŋ,

english_verse: you must not leave it there overnight. Bury it the same day, because the dead body of a criminal hanging on a tree will bring God's curse on the land. The Lord your God is giving this land to you, so don't make it unclean by leaving the bodies of executed criminals on display.
translation_verse: ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma leŋ dɩ ʋ sagɛ nɩmɛ dɩ taŋ pʋl. Ʋ maga dɩ ma hugu tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ nɩɩ-la kala kʋsʋʋŋ sɩ sagɛ tɩa nyuŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa disiniŋ a hɛ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩpɩ ma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If you see a cow or sheep wandering around lost, take the animal back to its owner.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ na ŋ naambie nɛŋ koo ʋ piese dɩ ʋ lɛlɛ, sɩ́ beŋ a nagɛ ŋ bɩ ʋ na, kɛŋ a kaa mʋ pʋ.

english_verse: If the owner lives too far away, or if you don't know who the owner is, take the animal home with you and take care of it. The owner will come looking for the animal, and then you can give it back.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ naambile nɛ bɩŋ kpaga, koo ŋ bɩ pʋna-la tɩɩna jɩŋ, kɛŋ pʋna-la kaa mʋ ŋ dɩa. Dɩ ŋ naambile nɛ chɛ pʋna-la kɔ, dɩ ŋ kaa pʋ.

english_verse: That's what you should do if you find anything that belongs to someone else. Do whatever you can to help, whether you find a cow or sheep or donkey or some clothing.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa, dɩ ŋ naambie kakumo koo ʋ gɛrɩŋ koo ʋ kʋŋkala nɛ lɛlɛ. Sɩ́ vɩa ta.

english_verse: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that. Don't Take a Mother Bird Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Haala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ laalɛ baalaa gɛnnɩŋ koo baala laalɛ haalaa gɛnnɩŋ. Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa bɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: If you build a house, make sure to put a low wall around the edge of the flat roof. Then if someone falls off the roof and is killed, it won't be your fault. Laws against Mixing Different Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ saa dɩɩ-falɩŋ a yuo, saa kɛrɛ golli lusu-la chu, dɩ nʋʋ sɩ́ lusu-la nyuŋ lɩɩ tel a sʋʋ dɩ ba joŋ cheeriŋ pɩŋ.

english_verse: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga, sɩ́ kʋŋ dɔŋ joŋo duu hɛ tɩɩsɩ-la pɛgɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ kɩkɩsɛ baga-la kɩalɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Don't hitch an ox and a donkey to your plow at the same time.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ kakumo arɩ nɛŋ kaa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba pɛrɛ.

english_verse: When you weave cloth for clothing, you can use thread made of flax or wool, but not both together.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ gɛrɩŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ arɩ pʋnaa yuo laalʋ.

english_verse: And when you make a coat, sew a tassel on each of the four corners. When a Husband Accuses His Wife Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Má yɛrɛ jʋɔsaa hɛ ma gɛnnɩ-la ma sɩɩ laalʋ niipinee banɛsɛ kala lɛ. Dɩ baala nɛ nyɩɛ wɩaa a pɩ ʋ haala arɩ ʋ bɩ hapuŋ ŋaa, ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ to

english_verse: Suppose a man starts hating his wife soon after they are married.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal nɛ jaa haala a kɛnʋ pɩŋ aŋ bɩra bɩ haal-la cho,

english_verse: If this happens, the bride's father and mother must go to the town gate to show the town leaders the proof that the woman was a virgin.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa, haal-la nɩaa maga dɩ ba joŋ gɛrɩ-la ba sɩ jaa dɔŋɔ a kaa jɛrɛ pɩŋ. Dɩ chalɩŋ nɛ hɛ gɛrɩ-la lɛ nɛ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa hapuŋ nɛ, dɩ ba kaa mʋ lee-la ba taŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩɩ hilimu a dagɛba.

english_verse: Her father will say, “I let my daughter marry this man, but he started hating her
translation_verse: Haal-la nyɩmma jaŋ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ joŋ mɩ tolo pɩ baala deeŋ ʋ jaa nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ bɩra bɩ ʋ cho.

english_verse: and accusing her of not being a virgin. But he is wrong, because here is proof that she was a virgin!” Then the bride's parents will show them the bed sheet from the woman's wedding night.
translation_verse: Ʋ chei ʋ yɩrɩŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ jaaʋ ʋ bɩ hapuŋ ŋaa, na kʋ-la sɩ daga arɩ mɩ tolo fa ŋaa hapuŋ nɛ.” Ba jaŋ kɛŋ gɛrɩ-la a jɛrɛ ba taŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ dɩ ba na.

english_verse: The town leaders will beat the man with a whip
translation_verse: Nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩ na gɛrɩ-la ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ bala-la a dɔgʋsʋ.

english_verse: But if the man was right and there is no proof that his bride was a virgin,
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ bala-la sɩ bʋla ma nɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ, dɩ kʋŋkala nɛ tuo sɩ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ haal-la ŋaa hapuŋ nɛ,

english_verse: the men of the town will take the woman to the door of her father's house and stone her to death. This woman brought evil into your community by sleeping with someone before she got married, and you must get rid of that evil by killing her. Laws about Illegal Sex Moses said:
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na ba jaŋ kɛŋ tolo-la a mʋ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa boiŋ niiŋ, dɩ ʋ jaŋ baalaa yagʋ kpʋ arɩ tabɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa hɩɩsɩ wɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Iziral kala lɛ, ʋ sɩ hɛ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa lɛ a bɩ bala jaa aŋ pɩpɩŋ baalaa. Ʋ maga dɩ ma giri wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ ta nɛ ma tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: People of Israel, if a man is caught having sex with someone else's wife, you must put them both to death. That way, you will get rid of the evil they have done in Israel.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal nɛ kɛŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ haala pɩŋ dɩ ma kɛnʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋ baal-la arɩ haal-la kala nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ má giri wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ ta nɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If a man is caught in town having sex with an engaged woman who isn't screaming for help, they both must be put to death. The man is guilty of having sex with a married woman. And the woman is guilty because she didn't call for help, even though she was inside a town and people were nearby. Take them both to the town gate and stone them to death. You must get rid of the evil they brought into your community.
translation_verse: ʋ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ baal-la sɩ kɛnʋ pɩŋ arɩ tolo-la kala a lɩɩ ba jaŋ lɛ, a yagɛba kpʋ arɩ tabɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa jaŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, ka tolo-la vɩa dɩ ʋ ŋmoo niiŋ dɩ ba laaʋ ta. Baal-la ma maga dɩ ʋ sʋʋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋ haal nɛ ʋ kaa pɩŋ. Ʋ maga dɩ má giri wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ ta nɛ ma tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: If an engaged woman is raped out in the country, only the man will be put to death.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal nɛ gurigi tolo gɩrɩŋ lɛ nʋʋ sɩ sʋga dɩ ʋ jaa, baal-la dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga dɩ ba kpʋ.

english_verse: Do not punish the woman at all; she has done nothing wrong, and certainly nothing deserving death. This crime is like murder,
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba ŋaa haal-la wɩɩkala, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa chei sɩ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ naga nʋʋ sɩ mʋ gurigi ʋ naambie a kpʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: because the woman was alone out in the country when the man attacked her. She screamed, but there was no one to help her.
translation_verse: Baal-la sɩ gurigi tolo-la nʋʋ sɩ sʋga dɩ ʋ jaa, ʋ jaŋ wuo ŋmoo niiŋ lee-la, ka nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ laaʋ ta.

english_verse: Suppose a woman isn't engaged to be married, and a man forces her to have sex with him. If he is caught,
translation_verse: Dɩ baal nɛ na hapuŋ nʋʋ ha sɩ bɩ sʋga a gurigu, dɩ ba nɛ kɛmba,

english_verse: A man must not marry a woman who was married to his father. This would be a disgrace to his father.
translation_verse: Baal kala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nyɩmma haala pɩŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ hɩɩsɛ ʋ nyɩmma nɛ.

english_verse: If a man's private parts have been crushed or cut off, he cannot fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ba feri koo dɩ ʋ peniŋ nɛ ba kere ta, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ guoli La TƖƖNA nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: No one born outside of a legal marriage, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa mɛŋgaa-bii, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ guoli La TƖƖNA nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a chɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ a kaa mʋ ʋ doho doho fii sɩ jaŋ to ʋ harɩŋ kɔ.

english_verse: No Ammonites or Moabites, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can become part of Israel, the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Amɔŋ tɩɩna kala koo Mʋab tɩɩna koo ba doho nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ guoli La TƖƖNA nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a chɩŋ ba lɛ a kaa mʋ ba doho doho fii sɩ jaŋ to ba harɩŋ kɔ,

english_verse: This is because when you came out of Egypt, they refused to provide you with food and water. And besides, they hired Balaam to put a curse on you.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa, bʋa-la lɛ ma fa sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti lɛ a kʋkɔ, ba vɔmma lɩɩŋ arɩ kʋdiilee nɛ aŋ mʋ kpal Balam sɩ ŋaa Bioo nanʋala a lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Pɛtɔ a hɛ Mesopotemia lɛ, dɩ ʋ kalɩbɛ hɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord your God loves you, so he refused to listen to Balaam and turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: Ama ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ choma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bɩ jegile nɩɩ Balam teeŋ, aŋ leŋ ŋmɩaŋ-la mɩɩra wasɛma.

english_verse: Don't even think of signing a peace treaty with Moab or Ammon.
translation_verse: Má mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, má pɔ ma dɩ ba sɩ́ wɩɩ pɛ.

english_verse: But Edomites are your relatives, and you lived as foreigners in the country of Egypt. Now you must be kind to Edomites and Egyptians
translation_verse: Ma pɔ má sɩ́ Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa bɛrʋ, ba ŋaa ma naambiiriŋ nɛ. Má sɩ́ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa ma bɛrʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma fa ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa nɛ ba tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and let their great-grandchildren become part of Israel, the Lord's people. Keep the Army Camp Acceptable Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ba doho doho tʋmbʋ-tori ha sɩ jaŋ to ba harɩŋ kɔ jaŋ wuo guoli La TƖƖNA nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ

english_verse: When you men go off to fight your enemies, make sure your camp is acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ ŋmoo buguŋ dɩ ma yuo ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ lɛ.

english_verse: For example, if something happens at night that makes a man unclean and unfit for worship, he must go outside the camp and stay there
translation_verse: Dɩ ma baala-la kʋŋ nɛ pɩŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ a duoso fɩɩ bafɩɩrɩŋ, ŋɩɩ leŋe ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: until late afternoon. Then he must take a bath, and at sunset he can go back into camp.
translation_verse: Dɩ dɩdaanɩŋ nɛ kʋ yi, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ fo lɩɩŋ, dɩ wɩɩ-muluŋ nɛ jʋa, ʋ mɩɩra kʋ jʋʋ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: Set up a place outside the camp to be used as a toilet area.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ má lɩɩ dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ nɛ a chɛ lee ma sɩ jaŋ mʋ a fɩfɩɩ fɩɩrɩŋ aŋ nyɩnyɛ bɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: And make sure that you have a small shovel in your equipment. When you go out to the toilet area, use the shovel to dig a hole. Then, after you relieve yourself, bury the waste in the hole.
translation_verse: Ma kʋŋkala maga dɩ ʋ pɛ kɛŋ kʋŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kaa lu bʋa a nyɛ bɩnɩŋ a fɩɩ fɩɩrɩŋ hɛ aŋ gbaa tɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You must keep your camp clean of filthy and disgusting things. The Lord is always present in your camp, ready to rescue you and give you victory over your enemies. But if he sees something disgusting in your camp, he may turn around and leave. Runaway Slaves from Other Countries Moses said:
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ zɔŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩaa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ ma dɩ-hɔnɩɩ-la lɛ, a pʋpɔma, a leŋ ma yuo didii ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ. Ma pɔ dɩ má sɩ́ wɩɩkala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ ŋaa dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ mɩɩrɛ ma harɩŋ. Wombie-la dɔnsʋŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ tuto

english_verse: When runaway slaves from other countries come to Israel and ask for protection, you must not hand them back to their owners.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ yomo nɛ fá kɔ ŋ teeŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ laaʋ ta, sɩ́ ʋ kaa mɩɩra mʋ pa ʋ tɩɩna.

english_verse: Instead, you must let them choose which one of your towns they want to live in. Don't be cruel to runaway slaves. Temple Prostitutes Moses said:
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ʋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lee na-kala ʋ sɩ cho arɩ taŋ na-kala ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa lɛ, sɩ́ ʋ dɔgʋsʋ.

english_verse: People of Israel, don't any of you ever be temple prostitutes.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩɩna kala, baal koo haal bɩ maga dɩ ʋ jʋʋ vene kala, dɩ bachɔrʋŋ koo hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa nɛ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord your God is disgusted with men and women who are prostitutes of any kind, and he will not accept a gift from them, even if it had been promised to him. Interest on Loans Moses said:
translation_verse: Ma pɔ má sɩ́ haal koo baal sɩ ŋaa wʋchɔrʋŋ a dʋa kʋŋ kaa kʋ jʋʋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩa a lɩɩsɛ niiŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa ka kɩsɛ wʋdosunu-la nɛ.

english_verse: When you lend money, food, or anything else to another Israelite, you are not allowed to charge interest.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma kʋŋ nɛ joŋ moribiee koo kʋdiilee koo kʋŋ na-kala a chɩŋ ŋ naambii Iziral tɩɩna, sɩ́ lɩɩŋ kaa daŋ.

english_verse: You can charge a foreigner interest. But if you charge other Israelites interest, the Lord your God will not let you be successful in the land you are about to take. Sacred Promises to the Lord Moses said:
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ lɩɩŋ daŋ a pɩ nʋhʋɔraa, ama ŋ naambie-na, ŋ bɩ ŋɩɩ wuo ŋaa. Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ lɩɩŋ kaa daŋa pɩ ma naambiiriŋ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-kala ma sɩ jaŋ tɩtɩŋ tintee-la ma sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord, then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma kʋŋ nɛ ta niiŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ dieni ka ŋ lɩɩsɛ nii-la. Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ lɩɩsɛ nii-la, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: On the other hand, if you never make a sacred promise, you can't be guilty of breaking it.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ paala bɩ niiŋ ta, ŋ bɩ wɩɩkala cheye.

english_verse: You must keep whatever promises you make to the Lord. After all, you are the one who chose to make the promises. Eating Someone Else's Produce
translation_verse: Wɩɩkala ŋ sɩ suri ŋ niiŋ a bʋl La TƖƖNA teeŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ ta nii-la ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ jʋʋ ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna tɩɩnɛnɛɛ baga, ŋ jaŋ wuo dii a magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ, ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ tɔrɛ a hɛ ŋ lʋaga lɛ.

english_verse: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ jʋʋ ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna kuori-mɩaa baga, ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ a kɩɩlɛ mʋa a chaŋ, ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ kɛŋ sɩa jʋʋ a ta.

english_verse: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal nɛ jaa haal, ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɩɩ haal-la, dɩ baal-la chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ vɩa haal-la, a ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ haal-la aŋ kiru ta ʋ lɩɩ ʋ dɩa lɛ,

english_verse: Since she has slept with her second husband, she cannot marry her first husband again. Their marriage would pollute the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and he would be disgusted. Newlyweds Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ʋ bala-la fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ a jaaʋ aŋ kiru ta bɩra bɩ maga dɩ ʋ jaaʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa haal-la kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ kɩsɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Má sɩ́ disiniŋ ŋaa hɛ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɩ baal nɛ jaa ha-falɩŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma leŋ dɩ ʋ mʋ laalɩŋ koo a pʋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-dɔŋ kala. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ hɔŋ dɩa lɛ nɛ jɩna, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ haal-la tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that they will pay back the loan. But don't take one or both of their millstones, or else they may starve. They need these stones for grinding grain into flour to make bread. Kidnapping Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala pʋpɔ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna nɔmʋŋ koo nɔŋ-biiŋ joŋ a tɩŋ chɩmɩŋ wɩaa, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ naga tɩɩna mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ ŋŋ chɛ ŋ lɩɩsɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna kala nɛ gaa kɛŋ ʋ naambie a leŋ ʋ ŋaa ʋ yomo aa dɔgʋsʋ koo a yallʋ, ʋ maga dɩ má kpʋ gaarʋ-la. Ʋ maga dɩ ma giri wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ ta nɛ ma tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: I have told the priests what to do if any of you have leprosy, so do exactly what they say.
translation_verse: Dɩ dayalɩbɩŋ nɛ jʋʋ ma jaŋ, má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a to Levi doho sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa niiŋ. Wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛba, má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a toba.

english_verse: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Má liise yi wɩɩ-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ ŋaa Mɩrɩam lɛ wombiiŋ lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that the money will be paid back. But you must not go into their house to get it.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ kʋŋkala a chɩchɩŋ ŋ naambie, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ jʋʋ ʋ dɩa a joŋ kʋ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋo bil chɩŋ-la bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Suppose someone is so poor that a coat is the only thing that can be offered as a guarantee on a loan. Don't keep the coat overnight.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa summu aŋ joŋ ʋ gɛrɩŋ a bil chɩŋ-la bʋbʋɔŋ a pɩŋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ gɛrɩ-la chʋa ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing. Poor People's Wages Moses said:
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛrɩ-la mʋ pʋ nɛ, ka dɩ wɩa-na jʋʋ, dɩ ʋ kaa tɔ ʋ tɩtɩa. Ʋ jaŋ lɔllʋŋ, dɩ ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa ma na arɩ tʋɔpʋl wɩɩ nɛ ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.
translation_verse: Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna koo nɩwogusu-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ kʋŋ nɛ ŋaa summu, a tɩma pɩpɩŋ ka dɩ ŋ titimu, pʋpɔ dɩ ŋ sɩ́ ʋ gʋrʋ.

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala, joŋ ʋ time pʋ ka wɩa-na jʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ sɩ ŋaa summu ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ, time-la lɛ nɛ ʋ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ, dɩ ŋ nɛ vɩa, ʋ jaŋ yele pɩ La TƖƖNA, ŋɩɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ a pɩŋ.

english_verse: Parents must not be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children must not be put to death for crimes committed by their parents. Don't put anyone to death for someone else's crime. Don't Mistreat the Powerless Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ bii nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba kpʋ ʋ nyɩmma a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la wɩaa, dɩ nyɩmma ma nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba kpʋ ʋ bie a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Nʋʋkala maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ a tɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔmʋŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Make sure that orphans and foreigners are treated fairly. And if you lend money to a widow and want to keep something of hers to guarantee that she will pay you back, don't take any of her clothes.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ nɩwogusuŋ arɩ biisinsiŋ gʋrʋ, koo dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ kʋŋ a chɩŋ yo-haala, sɩ́ ʋ gɛrɩŋ laa bil chɩŋ-la bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Má liise yi arɩ ma fa ŋaa yosi nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa laama ta, a kɛmma lɩɩ nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ sɩ ma to wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa, kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ gɛllɛ ta, má bɩra sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ kuuni. Má lemba a pɩ nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa pɛ ma lɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ tɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ tɔrɛ ma olif nɛnɛɛ, kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ gɛllɛ ta, má bɩra sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ tɔrɛ, má lemba a pɩ nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa.

english_verse: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ tɔrɛ girep nɛnɛɛ ma bagɩsɩŋ lɛ, kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ gɛllɛ ta, má bɩra sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ tɔrɛ, má lemba a pɩ nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: Má liise yi arɩ ma fa ŋaa yosi nɛ Ijipiti lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ sɩ ma to wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Suppose you and someone else each accuse the other of doing something wrong, and you go to court, where the judges decide you are guilty. If your punishment is to be beaten with a whip, one of the judges will order you to lie down, and you will receive the number of lashes you deserve.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ laa cheeriŋ nɛ maga dɩ ba vɩɩrʋ, sarɩya diiru-la maga dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ nɩɩ-la tuu pɩŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ, dɩ ba vɩɩrʋ a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ wɩɩŋ sɩ maga.

english_verse: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless. Don't Muzzle an Ox Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kpaasa naansɩɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ maga dɩ ʋ laa. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kieli ŋɩɩ lɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ vɩɩrʋ kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ yaraa jaŋ faasa fol dɩ ʋ nagɛ ʋ ŋaa nɩtɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain. A Son for a Dead Brother Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɩ nɛŋ nɩɩ ŋmoo mɩaa, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ vɔɔ ʋ niiŋ tɔ.

english_verse: Suppose two brothers are living on the same property, when one of them dies without having a son to carry on his name. If this happens, his widow must not marry anyone outside the family. Instead, she must marry her late husband's brother, and their first son will be the legal son of the dead man.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ lʋl ba bii-bumbuŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa hambolibie, ʋ nɛ jaŋ chɩŋ ʋ naambile sɩ sʋba nyuŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ sɩ́ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ lɛl.

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ naambile nɛ bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋ yo-haal-la jaa, haal-la maga dɩ ʋ mʋ ba taŋ boiŋ niiŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ bala naambie ka chɛ ʋ naambile sɩ sʋba yɩrɩŋ lɛl nɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩ chɛ ʋ jommi jaa dɩ la lʋl biiriŋ dɩ ba chɩŋ ʋ naambile nyuŋ.”

english_verse: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her,
translation_verse: Ʋ taŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ jaŋ yɩrʋ a bʋl wɩaa pʋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ha vɩa aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ jaa haal-la,”

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: yo-haal-la jaŋ mʋ ʋ bala naambile teeŋ nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩpaaŋ a kɛŋ baal-la nɛntɛbɩŋ dɔŋɔ lɩɩsɛ aŋ tʋ nantʋɔrʋŋ hɛ ʋ sɩaa lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Ŋ-la nɛ maga dɩ ba ŋaa baal-la sɩ vɩa dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ naambie yo-haala jaa dɩ ba lʋl biiriŋ dɩ ba chɩŋ ʋ naambie nyuŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts,
translation_verse: Dɩ baalaa balɩa nɩɩ loo, dɩ dɔŋɔ haala kɔ dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ bala lɛ a kɛŋ baal-la dɔŋɔ luroo lɛ,

english_verse: you must cut off her hand. Don't have any mercy. Be Honest in Business Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: má kɛŋ haal-la a ta ʋ nɩsɩŋ keri, má sɩ́ ʋ nenige fá.

english_verse: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma kɛŋ sanɩaba la sɩ maga a mɩmagɩsɛ kɩaa, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma wuo hɔŋ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma lɛ a dieni.

english_verse: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest. Wipe Out Amalek Moses said:
translation_verse: Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa bɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ gʋrɛ nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?
translation_verse: Má liise yi wɩɩ-la Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa ma lɛ, ma sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kʋkɔ.

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ma kala fa sɩ lɔlɔ a pʋgʋmɛ, ba bɩ Wɩa fá aŋ kʋ lɩɩ chemma wombiiŋ lɛ a kɛrɛ yuo nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ nɛrɩgɛ tuto ma harɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ leŋe dɩ ma na wiese ma dʋndɔmɔ-la kala sɩ gollima chu nɩsɩŋ lɛ, tintee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ, má kpʋ Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa doho kala dɩ ba yɩrɩŋ lɛl dʋnɩa lɛ. Má sɩ́ wɩɩŋ deeŋ yʋ.

english_verse: The Lord is giving you the land, and soon you will conquer it, settle down,
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ a hɔŋ nɩmɛ,

english_verse: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: ma kʋŋkala maga ʋ ŋaa ʋ kʋdii falaa ʋ sɩ pɛrɛ tintee-la lɛ a hɛ sime tʋɔŋ, a kaa mʋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dagɛ dɩ ma zizilu nɩmɛ.

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: Má bʋla pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ aa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa bʋa-la lɛ, “Jɩnɩŋ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ dagɛ a pɩ mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa arɩ mɩ jʋʋ tintee-la ʋ fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ la naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla nɛ.”

english_verse: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ laa sime-la arɩ kʋdiile-la ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a joŋo bil ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa koru-la sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, ŋ jaŋ bɩra bʋl wɩaa deemba: “Mɩ nyɩmma fa ŋaa Siiria tɩɩna nɛ, a gɔllɔɔ baarɛ, ʋ doho nɩaa fa bɩ yʋgɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ hɔŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, nɩmɛ nɛ ba pʋŋa yʋgɛ a ŋaa tintee sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ arɩ doluŋ.

english_verse: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.
translation_verse: Ama Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa dɔgɩsɛla nɛ nɩmɛ a leŋ la tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ a na hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la ŋmoo niiŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa la naabalɩmaba Wɩa, ʋ nɩɩ la bunso a na ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛla, hɛɛ-la la sɩɩ na arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ nyagɛla bil.

english_verse: Then you terrified the Egyptians with your mighty miracles and rescued us from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA kɛŋ ʋ doluŋ a ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ a kɛnla kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛnla kaa kɔ daha nɛ, a joŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ sɩ sɩma a kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ a pɩla.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ lɛɛlɛ mɩ kɛŋ tintee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ kʋdii falaa mɩ sɩ pɛrɛ a kaa kɔ dɩ mɩ pʋ.” Ŋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, joŋ sime-la a bil ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩpaaŋ aŋ kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlʋ.

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ nɩwogusu-la kala sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ maga dɩ má gbieli ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ nɛ, a tɩŋ kʋzɔmɔ-la kala ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩ ŋ dɩ ŋ dɩa nɩaa.

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ yie kɛŋ ma kɩaa a kpaa leree fii a joŋ kʋbala-la a pɩ La TƖƖNA jɩ-tori lɛ, má joŋo pɩ Levi doho nɩaa, nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haala-la kala sɩ hɛ ma tasɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba dii a vɔgɛ.

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ bʋla pɩ ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa, “Mɩ dɩa lɛ, mɩ lɩɩsɛ kpaal-la kala sɩ ŋaa ŋ kʋa nɛ a joŋo pɩ Levi doho nɩaa, nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa, arɩ ŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ bɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa vɩa, mɩ bɩ ba kʋbala ma yʋa.

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ ŋ kpaal-la mʋa ma die mɩ sɩɩ yel yoho, mɩ bɩ mʋa ma lɩɩsa bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ, mɩ bɩra bɩ ba mʋa ma joŋo a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ lɛlɛɛ. Mɩ to ŋ-na mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ nɛ, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ dagɛmɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ, ŋ dɩ-jʋʋlɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, gʋra bee na ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa a pɛ la lɛ aŋ wasɛ tintee-la sɩ sɩma a kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ, dɩ ʋ wasa zɔŋ woruŋ arɩ ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩ la naabalɩmaba.” Má to La TƖƖNA niiriŋ

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bɩra bʋl, “Jɩnɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa bʋlaa pɩma dɩ ma tuto ʋ niiriŋ, ʋ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a kɛŋ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩwɩɩ kala a toba.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Jɩnɩŋ ma daga arɩ ma TƖƖNA nɛ ma Wɩa, ma jaŋ sɛyʋ a to ʋ wombiee, ʋ niiriŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Jɩnɩŋ La TƖƖNA daga arɩ ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa nɛ. Ma nɛ ŋaa ʋ nɩcholoo arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ pɩma, ʋ saa sɩ ʋ maga dɩ ma to wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Ʋ daga arɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma nɛ kɩɩ tinteyee kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa, a kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ dɩ nɩaa bɩbɛsɛ ma lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma ʋ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩma ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Mosis arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ bʋla pɩ ba nɩaa, “Má to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ joŋo dagɛma jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ tabɩaa a saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ nɩmɛ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. Má sɩ́ tɩntɩnnɩ kʋŋkala sɩ ŋaa hɔɔŋ kaa digi tabɩa-la.

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ má kɛŋ tabɩa-la ba sɩ bɩ saa nɛ a saa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa koruŋ, a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Má kpʋ ma pʋsʋŋ a sʋl nɩɩ-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɩmɛ a diiba aŋ gbigbieli ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Don't forget to write out a copy of these laws on the stone slabs that you are going to set up. Make sure that the writing is easy to read. Curses on Those Who Disobey
translation_verse: Má ŋmʋnsɛ niiri-la hɛ tabɩa-la ma sɩ taara lɛ dɩ ba chaasa lɩɩ woruŋ.” Ba jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛbal a kalɩbɛ

english_verse: Moses stood together with the priests and said, “Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis arɩ Levi doho Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bʋl wɩaa pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa a bʋl, “Má kɛŋ goŋ aŋ jegile nɩɩ. Lɛɛlɛ ma ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɩaa nɛ,

english_verse: So you must obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you.”
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má jegile nɩɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ, a to ʋ niiŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ.”

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa Mosis bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ:

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ wasɛ ma tasɩŋ arɩ ma bagɩsɩŋ kala.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma lʋl biiriŋ a yʋgɛ, a leŋ dɩ kʋdiilee pʋrɩgɛ ma tinteeŋ lɛ, dɩ ma nɛsɩŋ, piesee arɩ bʋʋnaa ma pʋŋ.

english_verse: You will have plenty of bread to eat.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ wasɛ ma baga kʋpɛrɛɛ arɩ kʋdiile-la ma sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: The Lord will make you successful in your daily work.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a leŋ dɩ ma virisiŋ su a leŋ dɩ ma tɩntɩmɩɩ-kala wasɛ. Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ tintee-la lɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma lɛ.

english_verse: If you follow and obey the Lord, he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ to ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wombiee, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩma.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ na La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsɛma ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ba fɩfáma.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɩma dʋa a yʋgɛ tintee-la ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ a pɩ ma naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma lɛ. Ma jaŋ lʋl biiriŋ woruŋ, a kɛŋ nɛsɩŋ arɩ kʋdiilee yʋgɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ suri duonuŋ a leŋ dɩ ʋ nɩɩ ʋ bʋa lɛ a pɩma tintee-la lɛ, aŋ pɛ ma lɛ ma tɩntɩmɩɩ-kala lɛ. Tinteyee jaŋ yʋgɛ a chɩŋ kɩaa ma teeŋ, ama ma-na bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ kʋŋ nʋʋkala teeŋ.

english_verse: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa sɩpaalaara, ma bɩ jaŋ ŋaa harɩ-tooro. Dɩ ma nɛ jegile a nɩɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ joŋo dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, a fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a toba, ma jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ wɩɩkala lɛ, ma bɩ jaŋ to harɩŋ.

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ sʋʋ dɩ zaaraa arɩ baga kɩaa didii ma kʋsʋʋnʋŋ, ka nʋʋkala jaŋ tuo dɩ ʋ kiriba.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba jaŋ ŋaa magɩl ma dɩ ma doho nɩaa kala teeŋ aa chagɩlɛma a kaa mʋ wuu,

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ma sɩaa fɩɛla a jegile nɩɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ a to ʋ wombiee arɩ ʋ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ joŋo dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, ŋmɩaŋ deemba nɛ jaŋ diima:

english_verse: Your businesses and farms will fail.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ kalɩba hɛ ma tasɩŋ arɩ ma bagɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ diima, ʋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ ma lʋl biiriŋ yʋgɛ, a leŋ dɩ kʋdiilee nyaa ma tinteeŋ lɛ, ma nɛsɩŋ, piesee arɩ bʋʋnaa ma bɩ jaŋ pʋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will make you fail in everything you do.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ kalɩba hɛ wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ vɩa La TƖƖNA, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma wɩɩkala vʋgʋmɛ, dɩ wʋwalɩmaa jʋʋma dɩ ma to ŋɩɩ lɛ a kala guu chei, a tɩŋ wʋbɔŋ-la ma sɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra leŋ dɩ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ arɩ hagɩla lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a kʋ tɔma dɩ ma sʋʋ.

english_verse: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diima. Ma jaŋ to dɩ-bala a mʋ dɩ ma yuoba, ama ba jaŋ kirima dɩ ma fá pɩsɛ a chɩchɛ dɩ ma laa ma tɩtɩa. Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa ma lɛ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ faasa kɛmba.

english_verse: The Lord will make you suffer with diseases that will cause oozing sores or crusty itchy patches on your skin or boils like the ones that are common in Egypt. And there will be no cure for you!
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ mɔpʋllʋ-la doho ʋ fa sɩ joŋo hɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa lɛ a hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma yaraa kala ŋaa naawɩɩlaa a tɩtɩsɛ. Daaluno kala tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo vaarɛma.

english_verse: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ nyɩnyɛrɩŋ arɩ nyʋlʋmʋŋ a hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ kala vʋgʋmɛ.

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ gɔllɔ laarɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ a nagɛ nyʋlɩma, aŋ bɩ jaŋ na wɛnɩŋ. Ma wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ wasa. Tapʋlɩɩ-kala nɩaa jaŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛma a kɛŋ ma kɩaa lɩlaa, aŋ ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ laama ta.

english_verse: A man will be engaged to a woman, but before they can get married, she will be raped by enemy soldiers. Some of you will build houses, but never get to live in them. If you plant a vineyard, you won't be around long enough to enjoy the first harvest.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ sʋgɛ haala dɩ ma jaa, ka dɩ nʋʋ kɛŋ haal-la pɩŋ. Ma jaŋ saa dɩa aŋ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ. Ma jaŋ pɛrɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga aŋ bɩ jaŋ dii ʋ nɛnɛɛ.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ jaŋ kɛŋ ma nɛŋ kpʋ ma sɩɩŋ lɛ, ama ma bɩ jaŋ chaŋ ʋ nammɩa. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ ma kakumo laa ma teeŋ, a kaa viiri. Ba jaŋ laa ma piesee a pɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, ka nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ laaba pɩma.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛŋ ma biiriŋ laa pɩ tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa, ma jaŋ bibeŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ wʋwɩɩ, ka ma bɩ wɩɩkala wuo ŋaa.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Nɩwogusu-la ma sɩ paala bɩ jɩŋ nɛ jaŋ dii ma baga kɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ suolo na, ka dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛma ŋɩɩ ma mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ na jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma nyaasɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ kiri ma dɩ ma kuoro kala a mʋ hɛ tintee-wogo lɛ ma dɩ ma nyɩmmaba ha sɩ bɩ jɩŋ. Nɩmɛ ma jaŋ kpaarɛ vesiŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ daasɩŋ arɩ tabɩaa a ŋaa.

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Tintee-wogusu-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ kirima mʋ hɛ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ wʋkpuŋkpere dɩ ba mʋmɔmma aŋ sisieri ma lɛ.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ duu kɩaa a yʋgɛ ma bagɩsɩŋ lɛ, ama kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa bɩ jaŋ yʋgɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa hɔbɔ jaŋ diiba.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ pɛrɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ a yʋgɛ, a wasa hɛba, ama ma bɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ tɩɩnɛnɛ-la koo a nyʋa ba sɩnɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nanchʋɔlaa jaŋ dii tɩɩsɩ-la kala.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Olif tɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ yʋgɛ ma tinteeŋ lɛ, ama ma bɩ jaŋ na nʋʋŋ a dii, bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɛnɛɛ kala jaŋ yuoro ta.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Hɔbɩ-laalɩŋ jaŋ dii ma tinteeŋ tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ma bagɩsɩŋ kɩaa kala.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: Nʋhʋɔra-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ nyuŋ kɩɩma, ka dɩ ma-na mɩɩra hɛ naasɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: Ba nɛ jaŋ mɩɩra joŋ kɩaa a chɩchɩmma, ma-na bɩ jaŋ wuo joŋ kʋŋkala a chɩmba. Ba nɛ jaŋ mɩɩra ŋaa ma sɩpaalaaraa, ka dɩ ma tuto ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: Ŋmɩaŋ deemba kala jaŋ diima. Ba jaŋ kire to ma harɩŋ a yuo diima dɩ ma kala mʋ dɛrɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma vɩa dɩ ma sɛɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ a to ʋ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ dagɛma nɛ.

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,
translation_verse: a tɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋ dʋa-la kala a pɩma, ka ma vɩa dɩ ma tutou arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ma jaŋ kɛŋ losuŋ, lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ, yarɩ-biree, a nyaabɛ, aŋ pɛ tɩma pɩpɩ ma dʋndɔmɔ-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo hɛ ma lɛ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma chaasa na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛŋ tinteeŋ nɩaa yikoro ma sɩ bɩ nɩɩ a lɩɩ dʋnɩa lee sɩ bolie a kʋ hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ba yuoma a nagɛ kachuuŋ sɩ yie kʋ tuu jiŋŋee lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa tintee nɩaa sɩ bɔmɔ nɛ a kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ, ba bɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ ka zil a bɩ hambiisiŋ ma nenige ka fá.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kʋ gollo chu ma tinteeŋ tasɩŋ kala a yuo dii tasɩ-la ma sɩ saa kɛrɩ-duoruŋ sɩ leŋie a golli a joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ dɩ ba kala tel. Ba jaŋ kʋ gollo chu tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma tasɩŋ kala, a pɔ ma sɩ́ kʋŋkala kaa kʋ jʋʋ koo a kaa lɩɩ,

english_verse: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.
translation_verse: a tɩŋ hɛɛ-la ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ jaŋ joŋ hɛ ma lɛ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ gollo chu ma tasɩŋ a pɔ ma sɩ́ kʋŋ kaa jʋʋ koo a kaa lɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ gʋra kɛsɛ ma biiri-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma a chɩchaŋ.

english_verse: Because of hunger, a man who had been gentle and kind will eat his own children and refuse to share the meal with his brother or wife or with his other children.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ kpʋ biiri-la kʋŋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ yʋ aŋ chɔgɔ pɩ ʋ hachoolii-la koo ʋ naambii, bɛɛ wɩaa ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ kʋ gollo chuba dɩ ba yuo diiba ŋɩɩ, kʋ-la kala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. But times will be so bad that she will secretly eat both her newborn baby and the afterbirth, without sharing any with her husband or her other children. Disobedience Brings Destruction Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: a tɩŋ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ gollo chu ba tasɩŋ hɛɛ-la jʋʋba wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ lʋara chaŋ ʋ bii-mulo arɩ biriŋ kala aŋ vɔŋ ʋ bala arɩ ʋ biiriŋ.

english_verse: You must obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Because if you don't respect the Lord,
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ma sɩaa fɩɛla a to Wɩa niiŋ arɩ ʋ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa a hɛ teniŋ deeŋ lɛ, a bɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa yɩrɩ-bal-la sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ kaa tɩtɩŋ,

english_verse: like those you were so afraid of in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ joŋ nyanyalɩa-la kala ʋ fa sɩ joŋo hɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa lɛ a hɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra jaŋ joŋ nyanyalaa arɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la doho ba sɩ bɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wɩa wombiee teniŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ, a hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma kala sʋʋ a dɛrɛ.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Ma fa yʋga nɛ woruŋ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, ama ma kala jaŋ dɛrɛ aŋ ka nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ, a tɩŋ ma sɩ vɩa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɔ ʋ ŋaa ma pʋŋ a kɛŋ dʋa ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ʋ cheima. Ba jaŋ kirima tintee-la ma sɩɩ jʋʋ dɩ ma tɩɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛmma pɩsa hɛ dʋnɩa tinteyee kala lɛ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ma jaŋ kpaarɛ vesiŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ arɩ tabɩaa a ŋaa, vesi-la ma dɩ ma naabalɩmaba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Chʋchʋɔŋ ma jaŋ bʋl, ‘Dɩ dɩdaanɩŋ nɛ fa.’ Dɩdaanɩŋ ma, ma jaŋ bɩra bʋl, ‘Dɩ chʋchʋɔŋ nɛ fa,’ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ na arɩ fawʋllɩɩ-la sɩ jʋʋma wɩaa.

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ paama mɩɩra mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, lee-la mɩ sɩ sɩ ma bɩra sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ. Nɩmɛ ma jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ma joŋ ma tɩtɩa a yalla pɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ a ŋaa yosi, ka nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ yɔɔma.”

english_verse: So Moses finished telling the Israelites what they had to do in order to keep the agreement the Lord was making with them in Moab, which was in addition to the one the Lord had made with them at Mount Sinai. The Third Speech: Israel Must Keep Its Agreement with the Lord The Lord Is Your God
translation_verse: Nii-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bile ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ Mosis daga pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la, a pɛ nii-la ʋ sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ Sɩnaɩ peel-la lɛ.

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ la sɩ kʋ yi daha, Hɛsɩbɔŋ kuoro Sɩhɔŋ arɩ Basaŋ kuoro Ɔgɩ kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ba yuola nɛ, ama la yuo diiba nɛ,

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: a laa ba tinteeŋ a joŋo pɩ Rubiŋ doho nɩaa, Gad doho nɩaa arɩ Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a to niiŋ deeŋ woruŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa vɛŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: In this agreement, the Lord promised that you would be his people and that he would be your God. He first made this promise to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and today the Lord is making this same promise to you. But it isn't just for you; it is also for your descendants.
translation_verse: ʋ bile a pɩpɩ la nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ chɩŋ ʋ-na La Tɩɩna sɩpaaŋ jɩnɩŋ arɩ la doho nɩaa kala ha sɩ jaŋ to la harɩŋ kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Ma fa na ba sɩ kɛŋ daasɩŋ, tabɩaa, hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ a ŋaa tɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, kɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩɩ kɩsʋ.

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: Má hɛ doluŋ aŋ pɔ dɩ baal koo haal koo nyɩŋ-nʋʋ koo doho nʋʋ sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ jɩnɩŋ sɩ́ ʋ harɩŋ joŋo yɩa la TƖƖNA Wɩa, aŋ mʋ kpʋkpaarɛ tinteye-la kʋŋ vesiŋ. Má pɔ dɩ ma doho nʋʋkala sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ-la ŋaa sɩ jaŋ cheima.

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ nɩɩ kalɩbɩŋ deeŋ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ha hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa, ka dɩ wɩaa ha vɛŋ woruŋ a pʋ, ʋʋ nyɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ lɛrɛ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ kʋ hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ba chei ma nɩzɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kala.

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ dʋndʋŋa Iziral doho doho kala tʋɔŋ a dɔgɩsʋ, a leŋ dɩ ŋmɩaŋ-bɔmɔ-la kala sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ nii-la lɛ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wɩa wombiiŋ teniŋ tʋɔŋ diiu.

english_verse: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land
translation_verse: Ma biiriŋ sɩ jaŋ to ma harɩŋ kɔ arɩ nɩwogusu-la sɩ lɩɩ tintee-boloo maachie jaŋ sii a na wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la arɩ nyanyal-bɔmɔ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo ŋaa tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: has become a scorching desert of salt and sulfur, where nothing is planted, nothing sprouts, and nothing grows. It will be as lifeless as the land around the cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, after the Lord became angry and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Tintee-la kala jaŋ nagɛ yɩsɩŋ arɩ jiribiiŋ, ba bɩ kʋŋ wuo duu nɩmɛ. Kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo nyʋ nɩmɛ. Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ Sodom, Gomora, Adɩma arɩ Zeboyim tasɩ-la La TƖƖNA fa sɩ faasa na baanɩŋ a chei.

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ pɩɛsɛ, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA ŋaa tinteeŋ deeŋ ŋ-la? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ baanɩŋ faasa sii ŋ-la?’

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ bʋl, ‘Ba vɩa dɩ ba to nii-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bile nɛ, nii-la ʋ sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ba naabalɩmaba pɛgɛ bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ kɛmba kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: Ba vɩa nɛ aŋ kpʋkpaarɛ vesiŋ a kpikpirimi ba sɩpaaŋ, vesi-la ba fa sɩ bɩ jɩŋ, vesi-la ʋ sɩ bɩ joŋo pɩba.

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ sɩ faasa sii ba nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛba tintee-la lɛ a kɛmba pɩsa hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ lɛɛlɛ.’

english_verse: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.
translation_verse: Wɩaa dɔnsʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa joŋo faala, ba-na ŋaa ʋ kɩaa nɛ, ama wombie-la ʋ sɩ joŋo dagɛla, la dɩ la biiriŋ kala maga dɩ la tutoba nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ to La TƖƖNA Wɩa wombiee, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ vɩa ʋ niiŋ, ʋ jaŋ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ma lɛ a kɛmma pɩsa hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ,

english_verse: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.
translation_verse: ama dɩ ma dɩ ma biiriŋ nɛ mɩɩra kɔ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ a tou arɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩwɩɩ kala, a to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ joŋo dagɛma jɩnɩŋ,

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ paala pɩsɛ a mʋ hɛ dʋnɩa loŋgoru-la sɩ faasa bol lɛ ma, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa ha jaŋ kɛmma mɩɩra kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛmma kɔ tintee-la sɩ ŋaa ma naabalɩmaba kʋŋ, dɩ ma bɩra tɩɩʋ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma dʋa kɩaa woruŋ a pʋŋa yʋgɛ a paala kɩɩ ma naabalɩmaba.

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ suri ma dɩ ma doho nɩaa kala tʋɔŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma chou arɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩ-wɩɩkala a wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ mɩɩra joŋ ŋmɩaŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ deemba kala a hɛ ma dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ bɛrɛma aa dɔgɩsɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: You will again obey the laws and teachings of the Lord,
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ bɩra sɛɩ ma TƖƖNA niiŋ a tuto ʋ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ joŋo dagɛma jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma dʋa woruŋ wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma pʋŋ, dɩ ma pʋsʋŋ ma pʋŋ a yʋgɛ, dɩ kʋdiilee ma pʋrɩgɛ ma tinteeŋ lɛ. Ma TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ bɩra jaŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ woruŋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma kuori arɩ ʋ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ma naabalɩmaba lɛ.

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ama ʋ maga dɩ má to ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiri-la ʋ sɩ bile arɩ ʋ wombiee ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ ʋ teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ maga dɩ má sɛyʋ arɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩ-wɩɩkala. Mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ maa chɛ koo sʋʋŋ

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ joŋo dɩdagɛma jɩnɩŋ, ba bɩ hɛɩ koo ba bɩ dolie kɩɩ ma tonuŋ.

english_verse: His commands aren't in heaven, so you can't excuse yourselves by saying, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are in heaven, and no one can go up to get them, then bring them down and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Ba bɩra bɩ wɩa-nyuŋ ma nɛ hɛ, ma sɩ jaŋ bʋl, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ jɩla kaa kʋ tuu a bʋl dɩ la nɩɩ a kaa tɩŋ?’

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Ba bɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ cholo ma nɛ hɛ ma sɩ jaŋ bʋl, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ chol lee-la a kɛmba kaa kʋ bʋl dɩ la nɩɩ a kaa tɩŋ?’

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ dee wɩalɩŋ nagɛ, ba kpagɛma nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ. Ma jɩmba nɛ woruŋ a jaŋ wuo toba ma.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: Má bee na, jɩnɩŋ mɩ joŋ mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ dʋa, a joŋ sʋʋŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ cheima nɛ, a bil ma sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Jɩnɩŋ mɩ yɩrɛ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ ba pɛ na nɛ arɩ mɩ joŋ mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ sʋʋŋ nɛ a bil ma sɩpaaŋ, a bɩra joŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ La TƖƖNA pɛ ma lɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ʋ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ma lɛ a bil ma sɩpaaŋ dɩ ma bagɩsa lɩɩsɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má lɩɩsɛ mɩɩsɩŋ, dɩ ma dɩ ma biiriŋ kala kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Má cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a tuto ʋ niiŋ a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ. La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa ma mɩɩsɩŋ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ a dieni, arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk, arɩ Jekɔb ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis ha bʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa,

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma koo ma chichel a tɩŋ ba wɩaa, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ a kɛmma mʋ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ vɩama ta koo ʋ lɩɩ ma harɩŋ da.”

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis yɩrɛ Josua Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩpaaŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Nyɩrɛ ŋ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ, ŋ nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ nɩaa deemba a mʋ tintee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ba naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba a kɛŋ tintee-la kpaa pɩba dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa jaŋ hɛ ŋ teeŋ a laa ŋ sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ vɩaŋ ta koo ʋ lɩɩ ŋ harɩŋ da. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ koo dɩ ŋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ.” Wɩa wombiiŋ teniŋ karɩmɩŋ wɩaa

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa wombie-la a joŋo pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Levi biiri-la sɩɩ chʋŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la a pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa kala lɛ.

english_verse: Moses told these priests and leaders: Each year the Israelites must come together to celebrate the Festival of Shelters at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. You must read these laws and teachings to the people at the festival every seventh year, the year when loans do not need to be repaid.
translation_verse: dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nɛ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ lɛ, ma jaŋ karɩmɛ La TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa deemba ba sɩpaaŋ dɩ ba nɩɩ.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: Ba biiri-la sɩ bɩ wombiee deemba jɩŋ, maga dɩ ba nɩɩba nɛ a gʋnnɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ fɩfá ma TƖƖNA Wɩa ba mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ tintee-la ma sɩ jaŋ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a laa tɩɩ lɛ.” Iziral tɩŋŋaa jaŋ vɩa Wɩa niiŋ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ yie nɛ, yɩrɛ Josua dɩ ma kɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, dɩ mɩ lɩɩsʋ dɩ ʋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaaŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis arɩ Josua kɔ lɛbɩ-la leriŋ.

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ sɩ nagɛ jebiiŋ tʋɔŋ a kʋ tʋʋ chɩŋ lɛbɩ-la boiŋ niiŋ,

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: aŋ bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ a mʋ ŋ nyɩmmaba teeŋ. Ŋ sʋʋŋ harɩŋ lɛ, nɩaa deemba jaŋ vɩamɛ aŋ suomo ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, aa kpaarɛ vesiŋ tintee-la ba sɩɩ mʋ lɛ, a chei nii-la mɩ sɩ bile mɩ dɩ ba pɛgɛ.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ kʋ ŋaa, mɩ baanɩŋ jaŋ sii ba nyuŋ dɩ mɩ vɩaba, a joŋ harɩŋ yɩaba dɩ ba chei. Wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ arɩ wʋwalɩmaa jaŋ jʋʋba. Bʋa-la lɛ ba jaŋ bʋl, ‘La Wɩa sɩ tuo la teeŋ nɛ tɩɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ deemba kala ŋɩŋaa la lɛ ŋɩɩ.’

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ harɩŋ yɩaba, a tɩŋ ba sɩ vɩamɛ aŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a kpʋkpaarɛ vesiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛmba mʋ tintee-la sɩ sɩma a kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ, tintee-la mɩ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ba naabalɩmaba dɩ mɩ joŋo pɩba, ba jaŋ na kʋdiilee a magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ba sɩɩ chɛ a didii ba tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, ama ba jaŋ vɩa mɩ niiŋ aŋ kpʋkpaarɛ vesiŋ a chei nii-la mɩ sɩ bile mɩ dɩ ba pɛgɛ.

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Dɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ arɩ wʋwalɩmaa nɛ jʋʋba, yɩɩlɩŋ deeŋ nɛ jaŋ liliisiba, bɛɛ wɩaa ba dɩ ba doho nɩaa kala bɩ jaŋ yʋ yɩɩl-la. Mɩ paala jɩŋ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala nɛ aŋ-na kɛmba kaa kɔ tintee-la mɩ sɩ hɛ niiŋ dɩ mɩ joŋo pɩba.”

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa, Mosis ŋmʋnsɛ yɩɩl-la bil a dagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ ka La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Nuŋ nanʋala Josua, “Nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kaa mʋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ hɛ niiŋ dɩ mɩ joŋo pɩba. Mɩ jaŋ chɩŋ ŋ harɩŋ.”

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa wombie-la kala a hɛ teniŋ lɛ.

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ ŋmʋnsa dɛrɛ, ʋ bʋla pɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chʋŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la,

english_verse: This is The Book of God's Law. Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.
