translation_verse: “Má laa Wɩa wombiee teniŋ deeŋ a joŋo bil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la sɛmɛ dɩ ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ a ŋaa magɩl a pɩma.

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma ma ŋaa nyu-duo tɩmma nɛ a bɩ dagɩŋ ka nɩɩ. Mɩ ha sɩ hɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ ka ma vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ ŋ-la, ɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ nagɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ sʋba?

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Má yɩrɛ ma doho doho nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kala dɩ ba kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩba, aŋ yɩrɛ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ dɩ ba ŋaa la pɛ-naaraa.

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma mɩ sʋʋŋ harɩŋ lɛ, ma jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ vɩa wombii-la mɩ sɩ dagɛma. Bʋa dɔŋ jaŋ kɔ, wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ jaŋ ŋaa ma lɛ a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA sɩɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ.” Yɩɩl-la Mosis sɩ yɩa

english_verse: Israel, I will teach you. My words will be like gentle rain on tender young plants, or like dew on the grass.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagʋ nagɛ duonuŋ sɩɩ nɩɩ, dɩ mɩ wʋbʋlaa nagɛ nyalɩŋ, a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ mirise hɛ yaŋ sɩ bumo nyʋ lɛ, a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ faasa nɩɩ a hɛ kʋduuloo ha sɩ bɩ waa lɛ.

english_verse: Join with me in praising the wonderful name of the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ dɩ ʋ nɩaa dagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ doluŋ sɩ maga.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty rock, and he never does wrong. God can always be trusted to bring justice.
translation_verse: Ʋ doluŋ nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ, a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ tɛŋɛ nɛ woruŋ ʋ wombiee kala lɛ. Ʋ ŋaa Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a bɩ wɩaa ka chei nɛ.

english_verse: But you lie and cheat and are unfaithful to him. You have disgraced yourselves and are no longer worthy to be his children.
translation_verse: Ama ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ Wɩa teeŋ, ma bɩra bɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ, ma ŋaa nɩa sɩɩ pillu nɛ, ma bɩ dɩ-bala chɩna.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord is your Father, the one who created you, but you repaid him by being foolish.
translation_verse: Ma nɩyaaraa deemba sɩ bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ, ŋ-la nɛ maga dɩ ma joŋo ŋaa La TƖƖNA lɛɛ? Ʋ dee ma nyɩmmaa? Ʋ dee bɩ ma ta, a leŋ ma ŋaa nɩaa?

english_verse: Think about past generations. Ask your parents or any of your elders. They will tell you
translation_verse: Má liisi wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa faafaa, a pɩɛsɛ ma nyɩmmaba dɩ ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa a pɩma, má pɩɛsɛ ma nɩhɩasɩŋ ma, dɩ ba dagɛ wɩalɩŋ pɩma.

english_verse: that God Most High gave land to every nation. He assigned a guardian angel to each of them,
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala kɛŋ tinteeŋ a kpaa tinteyee kala nɛ, a kɛŋ nuhuobiine kaa pɔrɛ a dagɛ ba tinteeŋ bʋa, a leŋ ʋ tɩndaaraa bibemba.

english_verse: but the Lord himself takes care of Israel.
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ Jekɔb doho nɩaa nɛ dɩ ba ŋaa ʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord discovered you in a barren desert filled with howling winds. God became your fortress, protecting you as though you were his own eyes.
translation_verse: Ʋ na Iziral tɩŋŋaa tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ nɛ, tintee-la sɩ bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ, ka peliŋ huhuuri. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ chu tɔba a bemba woruŋ, a pɔba a nagɛ jimiŋ sɩ chu tɔ ʋ halaa,

english_verse: The Lord was like an eagle teaching its young to fly, always ready to swoop down and catch them on its back.
translation_verse: a nagɛ kachuuŋ sɩɩ gʋnnɛ ʋ biiriŋ filiŋ a pʋpɔba ŋɩɩ dɩ kʋŋ nɩɩ chɛ ʋ tel, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ kɛrɛ kɛŋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ tel.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord led you, and without the aid of a foreign god,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA dʋndʋŋa nɛ laa ba sɩpaaŋ, vene kala bɩ ʋ lɛ pɛ.

english_verse: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe ba hɔŋ tintee-la sɩ chaasa zɔŋ lɛ nɛ, a dii tintee-la kɩaa a leŋ ba na tʋʋŋ bʋ-bʋa lɛ. Ʋ leŋe ba olif tɩɩsɩŋ wasɛ nɛ woruŋ kpagɩnyɩlɩŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.
translation_verse: Ba nɛsɩŋ arɩ ba piesee kɛŋ yɩlɩŋ woruŋ, ba nɛsɩŋ, ba piesee arɩ ba bʋʋnaa kala chaasa nɛrɛ, a nagɛ Basaŋ tinteeŋ pʋsʋŋ. Ba mɛmpɛba ma chaasa zɔŋ woruŋ. Ba nyʋa girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ ma sɩ chaasa zɔŋ.

english_verse: Israel, you grew fat and rebelled against God, your Creator you rejected the Mighty Rock, your only place of safety.
translation_verse: Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa dii kɩaa deemba nɛ a nɛrɛ woruŋ aŋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa Wɩa sɩ dolie a nagɛ bʋŋ a ŋaama, aŋ vɩa ma Laataara.

english_verse: You made God jealous and angry by worshiping disgusting idols and foreign gods.
translation_verse: Ma to vesiŋ, wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ kɩsʋ a leŋ ʋ yaraa bieri ʋ na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ.

english_verse: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.
translation_verse: Ma vɩa Wɩa nɛ aŋ tuto jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ, a kpʋkpaarɛ veŋ-falɩa-la ma sɩ bɩ jɩŋ, Vesi-la ma naabalɩmaba sɩ bɩ fá.

english_verse: You turned away from God, your Creator; you forgot the Mighty Rock, the source of your life.
translation_verse: Ma vɩa ma nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ dolie a nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ, ma yʋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaama wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: You were the Lord's children, but you made him angry. Then he rejected you
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ na wɩalɩŋ ʋ biiriŋ sɩ ŋaa, ʋ baanɩŋ sii ba nyuŋ nɛ ʋ vɩaba.

english_verse: and said, “You are unfaithful and can't be trusted. So I won't answer your prayers; I'll just watch and see what happens to you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ harɩŋ a yɩaba aŋ na ba dɩdɛrɩŋ sɩ jaŋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa nyu-duo tɩmma nɛ, ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.
translation_verse: Ba leŋe mɩ yaraa bieri ba veŋ-kpaarɩɩ-la lɛ nɛ, mɩ na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bene dɩ ba bɩ nɩa ŋaa, ma ŋaa dɩ ba yaraa bieri. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tintee-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ ŋaa dɩ ba baanɩŋ sii.

english_verse: “My people, I will breathe out fire that sends you down to the world of the dead. It will scorch your farmlands and burn deep down under the mountains.
translation_verse: Mɩ baanɩŋ jaŋ sii a nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ a dii kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ dii a tuu yi lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ, a dii peelee kala. Kʋdiilii kala jaŋ tuo.

english_verse: I'll send disaster after disaster to strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ a nyagɛba, aŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ kala dɛrɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Young and old alike will be killed in the streets and terrified at home.
translation_verse: Laalɩŋ jaŋ diiba womporuŋ lɛ. Ba dɩɩsɩŋ ma lɛ fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmba. Ba bapʋɔsaa arɩ ba hatoloo, bii-mulluŋ arɩ banɩhɩasɩŋ kala jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: “I wanted to scatter you, so no one would remember that you had ever lived.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩ mɩ jaŋ kɛmba pɩsɛ aŋ leŋ dɩ ba yɩrɩŋ lɛl dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: But I dreaded the sound of your enemies saying, ‘We defeated Israel with no help from the Lord.’ ”
translation_verse: Ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ na wombiiŋ a bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ a bʋl, ‘La-na nɛ yuo dii nɩalɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ba TƖƖNA dee bɩ wɩaa deemba ŋaa.’

english_verse: People of Israel, that's what the Lord has said to you. But you don't have good sense, and you never listen to advice.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa tintee nɩaa nyuŋ sɩ bɩ tɩŋ nɛ, ba bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: How could one enemy soldier chase a thousand of Israel's troops? Or how could two of theirs pursue ten thousand of ours? It can only happen if the Lord stops protecting Israel and lets the enemy win.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩbala wuo kiri Iziral tɩŋŋaa bʋɩ? Koo nɩaa balɩa yuo a dii Iziral tɩŋŋaa bʋɩ fii? Dɩ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ dee bɩ ba joŋo pa koo dɩ mɩ-na ba Wɩa dee bɩ ba harɩŋ mɩɩra, nʋʋ bɩ wɩɩ wuo ŋaa.

english_verse: Even our enemies know that only our God is a Mighty Rock.
translation_verse: Ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jɩma arɩ ba vene bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ, ʋ bɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa maga.

english_verse: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;
translation_verse: Ba wʋŋaalaa nagɛ Sodom arɩ Gomora nɩaa nɛ. Ba nagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ kɛŋ huoŋ nɛ, ba nɛnɛɛ jagɩsɩŋ kala hɛɩ.

english_verse: their wine is more deadly than cobra venom.
translation_verse: Ba wʋŋaalaa nagɛ dɩmɩŋ huoŋ ba sɩ kaa bɩrɩmɛ sɩnɩŋ nɛ, a nagɛ kataha huoŋ.

english_verse: But the Lord has written a list of their sins and locked it in his vault.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ ŋaa a hɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ aa gbɛrɛba.

english_verse: Soon our enemies will get what they deserve— suddenly they will slip, and total disaster will quickly follow.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ laa yuo pɩma a tiŋ ma chɩmɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga. Bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi dɩ ba sɩɛrɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ba lɛ kpagɛ nɛ, ba sʋʋŋ yie nɛ.”

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ laa ʋ nɩaa ta, aŋ fá ʋ tɩntɩnnaa nenige, dɩ ʋ nɛ na dɩ ba doluŋ kala dɛrɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa yosuŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩɩ ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: But first the Lord will say, “You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ pɩɛsɛ, “Vesi-la lɛ ma sɩ joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ, nɩɩ nɛ ba hɛ?

english_verse: You offered them wine and your best sacrifices. Can't those gods help you now or give you protection?
translation_verse: Vesi-la sɩ dii ma vʋɩ-kpaarɛ kɩaa nʋʋŋ leree aŋ nyʋnyʋa ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ, má leŋ dɩ ba sii a pɛ ma lɛ, a tɔ hɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!
translation_verse: Má bee na, mɩ-na nɛ Wɩa, Wɩa dɔŋ bɩra tuo. Mɩ yie kpʋ nɛ aŋ bɩra chɩsɛ, a pɩrɛ aŋ vaarɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo laa nʋʋ ta mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: “I make this solemn promise: Just as I live forever,
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ nɩsɩŋ a je wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ aŋ ŋmɩɛsɛ, mɩ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ,

english_verse: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.
translation_verse: dɩ mɩ nɛ taa mɩ tokobiiŋ dɩ ʋ tʋtʋl palpal, dɩ mɩ kori sarɩya chɛ-diiliŋ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ a fɩɩsɛ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ aŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛrɩmɛ.

english_verse: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.”
translation_verse: Mɩ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ jaŋ jʋʋba dɩ ba chalɩŋ jaasɛ, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tokobiiŋ a kpʋ nɩalɩŋ kala, nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɩra arɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ arɩ ba sɩpaalaaraa kala.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord, because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa, ma pɛ La TƖƖNA nɩaa lɛ a jʋɔsɛ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ chɩŋ ʋ nɩaa nyuŋ a laa ba yuosuŋ yuo, aŋ joŋ ʋ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba aŋ pɩɩsɛ ba tinteeŋ disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: he said, “Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Má joŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ chaasa bʋla pɩma jɩnɩŋ a hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ, a dagɛ ma biiriŋ dɩ ba fɩɛlɛ ba sɩaa a to wombie-la kala mɩ sɩ daga.

english_verse: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.” Moses Will See the Land
translation_verse: Wombie-la bɩ wʋpɛɩba ŋaa, ba nɛ ma mɩɩsɩŋ, má toba. Ba nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma wuo hɔŋ tintee-la ma sɩ jaŋ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a tɩɩ lɛ a dieni.” Mosis jaŋ sʋʋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nebo nyuŋ

english_verse: Later that day the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.
translation_verse: “Mʋ́ Abarɩm peele-la sɩ hɛ Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ a jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nebo, ʋ hɛ Jɔdaŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ a chaasɛ Jeriko, a beŋ a na Kɛnaŋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.

english_verse: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Peel-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ jɩl, ʋ nyuŋ nɛ ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ a mʋ ŋ naabalɩmaba teeŋ, arɩ ŋ naambie Arɔŋ sɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɔɔ lɛ a mʋ ʋ naabalɩmaba teeŋ.

english_verse: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.
translation_verse: Ma kala balɩa fa vɩa dɩ ma ŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ dagɛma nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaaŋ Mɛrɩba lɩɩ-la leriŋ, Zɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma vɩa dɩ ma zilmi nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, tintee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ŋ jaŋ beŋ a naʋ dɩ-bolii, ama ŋ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ ʋ tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: Moses was a prophet, and before he died, he blessed the tribes of Israel by saying:
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa tɩntɩnna Mosis sɩ sʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa aŋ-na sʋʋ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “La TƖƖNA lɩɩ Sɩnaɩ peel-la lɛ nɛ a mʋ chugili ʋ nɩaa nyuŋ, a chaana hɛ ba lɛ a chɩŋ Ɛdɔm lɛ a kaa mʋ yi Paraŋ peel-la. Ʋ kɔ arɩ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-daŋ nɛ a lɩɩ ʋ peel-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ lere-la sɩ chullo a tutuu.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, La TƖƖNA cho ʋ nɩaa nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ ba kala kpirimi a laa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga,

english_verse: I called a meeting of the tribes of Israel and gave you God's Law.
translation_verse: arɩ wombie-la Mosis sɩ daga dɩ ba tuto. Ʋ ŋaa Jekɔb doho nɩaa kʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Tribe of Reuben, you will live, even though your tribe will always be small.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl a tɩgɛ Rubiŋ doho lɛ: Ʋ sɩ, “Rubiŋ nɩaa bɩ yʋgɛ, ama ba jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋmʋ.”

english_verse: The Lord will listen to you, tribe of Judah, as you beg to come safely home. You fought your enemies alone; now the Lord will help you.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl a tɩgɛ Juda doho ma lɛ: “Ou La TƖƖNA, jegile nɩɩ Juda nii-ŋmobo, aŋ kɛnʋ kɔ ʋ nɩaa teeŋ, ʋ doluŋ nɛ ʋ kaa pɔ ʋ tɩtɩa. La TƖƖNA, pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ wuo ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: Protecting Israel's agreement with the Lord was more important to you than the life of your father or mother, or brothers or sisters, or your own children.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ leŋe, ba nyɩmmaba arɩ ba naamba, ba naambiiriŋ arɩ ba biiriŋ wɩaa chɩlba a magɛ ŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga. Ba sɛɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa nɛ a to nii-la ma ŋ sɩ bile ŋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ.

english_verse: You teach God's laws to Israel, and at the place of worship you offer sacrifices and burn incense.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa nɛ yie dagɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ arɩ ŋ wombiee a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Ba nɛ yie nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋara sɩ sɩma ŋ sɩpaaŋ, aŋ nyɩgɛ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ma ŋ koru-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless everything you do, and make you strong enough to crush your enemies.
translation_verse: Ou La TƖƖNA, pɛ ba lɛ dɩ ba wʋjɩmɩŋ yʋgɛ, dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa nyuŋ. Yuo dii ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba bɩra kɛŋ doluŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord Most High loves you, tribe of Benjamin. He will live among your hills and protect you.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamɩŋ doho ma lɛ ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl: “Nɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ cho nɛ ŋ-la a leŋ ba hɔŋ sɔm. Ʋ hɛ ba teeŋ nɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ a pʋpɔba.”

english_verse: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.
translation_verse: Josɛf doho nɩaa ma lɛ, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl: “La TƖƖNA, leŋ dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ woruŋ a pɩba, dɩ lɩɩŋ ma bulo lɩɩ tinteeŋ dɩ ba tinteeŋ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ.

english_verse: Month by month, your fruit will ripen in the sunshine.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ wɩa pɔsɔ hɛ ba kɩaa lɛ dɩ ba wasɛ woruŋ bʋa-la sɩ maga lɛ.

english_verse: You will have a rich harvest from the slopes of the ancient hills.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba peel-bɩnaa kɛŋ tɩɩ-nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ dɩ kʋdiilee hɛ ba dundolluŋ ma lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord who appeared in the burning bush wants to give you the best the land can produce, and it will be a princely crown on Joseph's head.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ nɩaa nyuŋ a leŋ dɩ kʋŋ na-kala sɩ zɔmɔ hɛ ba tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋ nɛ Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nyiniŋ sɩɩ dii tɩɩ-pugu-la lɛ aŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ. Leŋ dɩ wɩaa deemba kala ŋaa Josɛf doho nɩaa lɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa ʋ naambiiriŋ sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: The armies of Ephraim and Manasseh are majestic and fierce like a bull or a wild ox. They will run their spears through faraway nations.
translation_verse: Josɛf kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ nɛŋ bii-bumbuŋ sɩ ŋaa bele nɛ. Ʋ nyilliŋ nagɛ baga nɛŋ nɛ. Ʋ nyilli-la nɛ ŋaa Manasɛ doho nɩaa bʋɩ-la arɩ Efirem doho nɩaa bʋɩ fii-la. Nyilli-la nɛ ʋ jaŋ kaa gbaa tinteyee a hɛ dɔŋɔ a yigiba mʋ ta dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ.”

english_verse: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ yɩrɛ nɩaa dɩ ba kɔ peeliŋ nyuŋ dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ sɩ maga a pɩ Wɩa, aŋ gbieli tʋɔtɔrɛ gbiele, a tɩŋ dʋa-la ba sɩ jaŋ na mʋga arɩ fuo-niiŋ.”

english_verse: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.
translation_verse: Gad doho nɩaa ma lɛ, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl: “Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Gad tinteeŋ jalla pɛ. Gad nagɛ naachigiŋ nɛ, aa chɔl nɩaa vaasɩŋ koo aa bori nyusuŋ.

english_verse: Your leaders met together and chose the best land for your tribe, but you obeyed the Lord and helped the other tribes.
translation_verse: Ʋ lɩɩsɛ tinteeŋ lee-la sɩ faasa zɔŋ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ʋ kʋa. Sɩpaalaaraa kpaalɩŋ nɛ ʋ tɩɩ. Dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa nɛ kʋ hilimi, ʋ yie ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ nɛ aŋ dii Iziral tɩŋŋaa sarɩya ʋ bʋa lɛ.”

english_verse: Tribe of Dan, you are like a lion cub, startled by a snake.
translation_verse: Daŋ doho ma lɛ, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl: “Daŋ nagɛ naachigi-bie nɛ a fɩla lɩɩ Basaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with you, people of Naphtali. He will bless you and give you the land to the west and the south.
translation_verse: Nafɩtalɩ doho ma lɛ, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl, “La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ Nafɩtalɩ nyuŋ nɛ woruŋ, ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ kɩŋkɛŋ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ Galilii mʋgʋ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil
translation_verse: Asa doho ma lɛ, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl: “Wɩa jaŋ pɛ Asa lɛ kɩɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ kala, a leŋ dɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ sɛɩ ʋ niiŋ a pɛ ʋ lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ʋ tinteeŋ ma kɛŋ olif tɩɩsɩŋ a yʋgɛ,

english_verse: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ taŋ boi-baalɩŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ hɔɔŋ arɩ kɔlɩɩŋ, dɩ ʋ hɔŋ, dɩ wɩɩkala sɩ́ ʋ walɩmʋ.”

english_verse: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.
translation_verse: Kʋŋkala tuo a magɛ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa. Ʋ yie lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ tʋla a kʋ tuu pɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la la sɩ yie fá mʋ yuori, ʋ dol-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ ʋ kaa pʋpɔma. Ʋ jaŋ kiri ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, aŋ leŋ dɩ ma cheiba.

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa jaŋ hɔŋ tintee-la sɩ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ lɛ, tintee-la duoŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ jaŋ nɩɩ, dɩ kʋdiilee arɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued you and given you more blessings than any other nation. He protects you like a shield and is your majestic sword. Your enemies will bow in fear, and you will trample on their backs.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, La TƖƖNA pɛ ma lɛ nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nagɛma, ma ŋaa nɩa La TƖƖNA sɩ laa ta nɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ chu tɔma a pɩpɛ ma lɛ. Ʋ nɛ ma laalɩyuoro, ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kɔ ma teeŋ a nagɛ ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri nɛ a sʋsʋlma, ka dɩ ma vɩa aŋ yuo diiba.

english_verse: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis lɩɩ Mʋab tintee-taalɩ-la leriŋ a jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Pisiga, a to ŋɩɩ mʋ jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nebo nyu-gbaŋa Jeriko cholo. Nɩmɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA dagʋ tintee-la kala, a chɩŋ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ a mʋ yi Daŋ tinteeŋ, a pɛ

english_verse: He let Moses see the territories that would soon belong to the tribes of Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Judah, as far west as the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Nafɩtalɩ tinteeŋ, Efirem arɩ Manasɛ tinteeŋ, a kɛŋ Juda tinteeŋ kala ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediterenia,

english_verse: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.
translation_verse: Nɛgɛf arɩ lee-la sɩ pɩna a chɩŋ Jeriko fuonaa-la lɛ, tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ taŋ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zʋaa.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pʋ, “Tintee-la mɩ sɩ hɛ niiŋ a pɩ Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb dɩ mɩ joŋo pɩ ba doho nɩaa nɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ leŋe ŋ naʋ nɛ arɩ ŋ sɩɩŋ, ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ jʋʋ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis, La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnna sʋʋ Mʋab tintee-la lɛ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA hugu Mʋab fuonaa-la lɛ nɛ a chaasɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf-Pio. Ama nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ vaamɩŋ leriŋ jɩŋ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: The people of Israel stayed in the lowlands of Moab, where they mourned and grieved
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa yel Mosis yoho tapʋlaa mara arɩ fii nɛ Mʋab tintee-taalɩsɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet
translation_verse: Nuŋ nanʋala Josua fa kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Mosis fa joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ a daŋ ʋ lɛ nɛ a sʋl Wɩa pʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɛɩ Josua niiŋ, a to wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ to Mosis lɛ a dagɛba.

english_verse: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him
translation_verse: Mosis sʋʋŋ harɩŋ lɛ, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ kala bɩra bɩ kɔ a nagɛ Mosis, arɩ ʋ dɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ yie chaasa dɔŋɔ a bʋbʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: and sent him to perform powerful miracles in the presence of the king of Egypt and his entire nation.
translation_verse: Mosis nɛ La TƖƖNA tɩŋ ʋ mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a ŋaa wʋduoruŋ, wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro, arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ʋ tinteeŋ nɩaa kala lɛ.

english_verse: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala ha bɩ dol kala wuo dagɛ koo a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ jʋʋ nɩaa arɩ Mosis sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, was dead. So the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been the assistant of Moses. The Lord said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnna Mosis sʋʋŋ harɩŋ lɛ, La TƖƖNA fa bʋl wɩaa a pɩ Nuŋ nanʋala Josua, nɩɩ-la fa sɩ pɛ Mosis lɛ ba tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: My servant Moses is dead. Now you must lead Israel across the Jordan River into the land I'm giving to all of you.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ tɩntɩnna Mosis sʋba nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a mʋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma.

english_verse: Wherever you go, I'll give you that land, as I promised Moses.
translation_verse: Lee na-kala ma sɩ jaŋ joŋ ma naaŋ nʋɔsɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma arɩ mɩ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ a pɩ Mosis.

english_verse: It will reach from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and to the northeast as far as the great Euphrates River. It will include the land of the Hittites, and the land from here at the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
translation_verse: Ma tinteeŋ bʋa jaŋ chɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ a mʋ yi lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lɛbanɔŋ peele-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa, a chɩŋ fuo-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Yufireti sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ Hiti tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ kala ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediterenia sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.
translation_verse: Josua, ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo yuo diiŋ. Mɩ jaŋ hɛ ŋ teeŋ arɩ mɩ fa sɩ hɛ Mosis teeŋ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ vɩaŋ ta koo a lɩɩ ŋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. Never stop reading The Book of the Law he gave you. Day and night you must think about what it says. If you obey it completely, you and Israel will be able to take this land.
translation_verse: Kɩkarɩmɛ teŋ-la Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ mɩ wombiee hɛ bʋa na-kala, aŋ kɛmba chʋchɔgɩsɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ, aŋ fɩɛlɛ ŋ sɩaa a to wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ ʋ lɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ wɩɩkala jaŋ chaasa vɛŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go. The Eastern Tribes Promise To Help
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ ŋ nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ dɩ ŋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ, mɩ-na ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ hɛ ŋ teeŋ lee na-kala ŋ sɩɩ mʋ.”

english_verse: Joshua ordered the tribal leaders
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ a bʋl,

english_verse: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.
translation_verse: “Má jʋʋ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ a gɔllɔ bʋla pɩ nɩaa kala dɩ ba ŋaa ba kʋdiilee a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ. A chɩŋ jɩnɩŋ a kaa mʋ tapʋlaa batori pɛgɛ, ma jaŋ chol Jɔdaŋ fuoŋ a mʋ laa tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩpɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ.”

english_verse: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua bʋla pɩ Rubiŋ doho nɩaa, Gad doho nɩaa arɩ Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la ma,

english_verse: The Lord's servant Moses said that the Lord our God has given you land here on the east side of the Jordan River, where you could live in peace. Your wives and children and your animals can stay here in the land Moses gave you. But all of you that can serve in our army must pick up your weapons and lead the men of the other tribes across the Jordan River. They are your relatives, so you must help them
translation_verse: Ma haalaa, ma biiriŋ arɩ ma pʋsʋŋ jaŋ hɛ daha, tintee-la Mosis sɩ joŋo pɩma lɛ, ama ma laalɩyuoroo kala maga dɩ ba nyɩgɩlɛ nɛ a laa ma naambiiriŋ sɩpaaŋ a chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la. Ʋ maga dɩ ma pɛ ma naambiiriŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ

english_verse: conquer the land that the Lord is giving them. The Lord will give peace to them as he has given peace to you, and then you can come back and settle here in the land that Moses promised you.
translation_verse: a kaa mʋ bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ pɩba dɩhɔnʋŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ pɩma dɩhɔnʋŋ ŋɩɩ, see ba ma sɩ na tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩba dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, ma jaŋ wuo mɩɩra kʋ hɔŋ ma tinteeŋ deeŋ sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, kʋ-la La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnna Mosis sɩ joŋo pɩma.”

english_verse: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ Josua, “La jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ŋ sɩ sɩ la ŋaa, lee na-kala ŋ sɩ sɩ la mʋ, la jaŋ mʋ.

english_verse: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩŋ sɛyɛ aŋ ŋaa wɩɩ a chei wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga, la jaŋ kpʋ tɩɩna. Ŋ-na nyɩrɛ ŋ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ.”

english_verse: Joshua chose two men as spies and sent them from their camp at Acacia with these instructions: “Go across the river and find out as much as you can about the whole region, especially about the town of Jericho.” The two spies left the Israelite camp at Acacia and went to Jericho, where they decided to spend the night at the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua tɩŋ baalaa balɩa ba lɩɩ lee kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Sɩtɩm, dɩ ba mʋ lʋara beŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ a na ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ naga, a wasa nyaŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jeriko. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ mʋ, a jʋʋ chʋa hachɔrʋŋ kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rahab dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.”
translation_verse: Jeriko kuoro nɩɩ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ kɔ ba tinteeŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ dɩ ba lʋara bee na wɩɩ-la ba sɩ kaa hɔŋ ba tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:
translation_verse: Ka dɩ baala-la-na pɩŋ doŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ, Rahab sii jɩl ba teeŋ lusu-la nyuŋ,

english_verse: I know that the Lord has given Israel this land. Everyone shakes with fear because of you.
translation_verse: a bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ jɩma arɩ La TƖƖNA joŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ a pɩma nɛ, ma wɩaa paala leŋ fawʋllʋŋ chaasa jʋʋla nɛ. Nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ kpaŋa nɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa.

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: La nɩɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ lɩɩŋ hʋ nɛ bʋa-la lɛ ma fa sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ kpʋ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ kuoroo balɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩhɔŋ arɩ Ɔgɩ.

english_verse: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.
translation_verse: La sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ fawʋllʋŋ jʋʋla nɛ, nʋʋkala nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa. Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ tɩɩ tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kala.

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ má hɛ niiŋ a pɩmɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ, arɩ ma jaŋ ŋaa mɩ dɩ mɩ dɩa nɩaa woruŋ a nagɛ mɩ sɩ ŋaa woruŋ ma lɛ ŋɩɩ. Má pɩmɛ nii-la magɩlɩŋ

english_verse: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.
translation_verse: sɩ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ ma jaŋ laa mɩ nyɩmma, mɩ naaŋ, mɩ naambiiriŋ arɩ ba dɩa nɩaa kala ta, ma bɩ jaŋ kpʋla.”

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baala-la bʋl, “A leŋ dɩ Wɩa kpʋla dɩ la nɛ chei nii-la sɩ hɛ la pɛgɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ wɩɩ-la la sɩ kɔ dɩ la ŋaa daha bʋla pɩ nɩaa, la jaŋ kɛnɩŋ woruŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ joŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ a hɛ la nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Haal-la dɩa mɛrɛ jebii-la ba sɩ saa golli ba taŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ a ta ʋ to tokoro lɩɩ ba to ŋmɛŋ-la lɛ a lɩɩ.

english_verse: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.”
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bʋla pɩba, “Má to peelee tʋɔŋ mʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kiri ma libe sɩ́ ma na. Má mʋ faa nɩmɛ tapʋlaa batori, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛma mɩɩra kɔ dɩa, ka dɩ ma-na lɩɩ joŋ ma wombiiŋ a viiri.”

english_verse: “I'll do exactly what you said,” Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.
translation_verse: Haal-la bʋl, “Mɩ sɛyɛ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ma sɩ bʋla.” Ʋ taba ba viiri, ka ʋ joŋ ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ a vɔɔ tokoro-la lɛ.

english_verse: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho,
translation_verse: Ba sɩ lɩa, ba jʋʋ peelee tʋɔŋ a faa nɩmɛ tapʋlaa batori, ka nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ kiri ba libe joŋ wombiiŋ kala a beŋ a bɩ ba na aŋ mɩɩrɛ.

english_verse: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baala-la balɩa sɩ mʋa dɩ ba lʋara beŋ tintee-la lɩɩ peele-la tʋɔŋ kʋ tuu a chol fuo-la a mʋ Nuŋ nanʋala Josua teeŋ, a bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa ba lɛ a pʋ.

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”
translation_verse: Ba bʋla pɩ Josua, “La TƖƖNA chaasa joŋ tintee-la kala a hɛ la nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Fawʋllʋŋ chaasa jʋʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ nɛ a tɩŋ la wɩaa.”

english_verse: Early the next morning, Joshua and the Israelites packed up and left Acacia. They went to the Jordan River and camped there that night.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla, Josua arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho doho-la kala sii lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩtɩm a mʋ Jɔdaŋ fuoŋ, a hɔŋ a gbɩgbɛrɛ dɩ ba chol fuo-la.

english_verse: Two days later their leaders went through the camp,
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ, ba nɩhɩasɩŋ sii a gɔllɛ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ kala,

english_verse: shouting, “When you see some of the priests carrying the sacred chest, you'll know it is time to cross to the other side. You've never been there before, and you won't know the way, unless you follow the chest. But don't get too close! Stay about a kilometer back.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ wombii-la ma sɩ jaŋ to a mʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma ha bɩ wombiiŋ deeŋ vɛnɛ aŋ ka. Má hɛ dɩ-bolii aŋ leŋ dɩ ma dɩ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la pɛgɛ wuoluŋ yi naakieliŋ bʋɩ. Má pʋpɔ ma sɩ mʋ kpagʋ.”

english_verse: Joshua told the people, “Make yourselves acceptable to worship the Lord, because he is going to do some amazing things for us.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Má pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ ta, bɛɛ wɩaa chie La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ ma tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: Then Joshua turned to the priests and said, “Take the chest and cross the Jordan River ahead of us.” So the priests picked up the chest by its carrying poles and went on ahead.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma, “Ma joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la a laa nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ a laa ba sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Josua, “Jɩnɩŋ mɩ jaŋ suomo to ŋ lɛ a ŋaa wɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩɩŋ lɛ a leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa nɩyuŋi ba teeŋ, dɩ ba jɩŋ arɩ mɩ hɛ ŋ teeŋ nɛ arɩ mɩ fa sɩ hɛ Mosis teeŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.”
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ chʋŋ mɩ niiriŋ daga-la, dɩ ba nɛ mʋ yi Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, ba jʋʋ chɩŋ lɩɩ-la niiŋ.”

english_verse: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua fa bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma, “Má kɔ daha a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: The Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites control the land on the other side of the river. But the living God will be with you and will force them out of the land when you attack. And now, God is going to prove that he's powerful enough to force them out.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ mʋ, ma TƖƖNA jaŋ sɛnɛ kiri Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa, Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Hivi tɩŋŋaa, Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa, Gɩgasɩ tɩŋŋaa, Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa arɩ Jebus tɩmma-la kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ dɩ ba lɩɩ. Ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ weye hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ,

english_verse: Just watch the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord, the ruler of the whole earth. As soon as the priests carrying the chest step into the Jordan, the water will stop flowing and pile up as if someone had built a dam across the river. The Lord has also said that each of the twelve tribes should choose one man to represent it.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ chʋŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ tɩɩ tinteeŋ kala niiriŋ daga nɛ joŋ ba naasɩŋ a nʋɔsɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la tʋɔŋ, lɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɛllʋ jaŋ kɛrɛ, a chɩŋ dɩ-bala aŋ sii chʋɔrɛ.”

english_verse: The Israelites packed up and left camp. The priests carrying the chest walked in front,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ sii ba dɩhɔnʋŋ dɩ ba chol Jɔdaŋ fuoŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ chʋŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la nɛ laa ba sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water,
translation_verse: Baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ, dɩ fuo-la kala suo a pɛllɛ lɩlɩɩ. Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ chʋŋ daga-la sɩ mʋ yi Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, ba naasɩŋ digi lɩɩ-la niiŋ,

english_verse: the river stopped flowing, and the water started piling up at the town of Adam near Zarethan. No water flowed toward the Dead Sea, and the priests stood in the middle of the dry riverbed near Jericho while everyone else crossed over.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa fa sɩ chʋŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la chɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, ka Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala vɛŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la nyuŋ ŋɩɩ a kala cholo dɛrɛ.

english_verse: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala fa sɩ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a dɛrɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Josua,

english_verse: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba, dɩ ba kʋŋkala joŋ tabɩɩŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, lee-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ chɩna, a kaa mʋ bil lee-la ma sɩ jaŋ chʋa jɩnɩŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ.”

english_verse: Joshua chose twelve men; then he called them together
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ fɩɩ arɩ balɩa-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa Iziral doho doho-la kala tʋɔŋ,

english_verse: and said: Go to the middle of the riverbed where the sacred chest is, and pick up a large rock. Carry it on your shoulder to our camp. There are twelve of you, so there will be one rock for each tribe.
translation_verse: a bʋla pɩba, “Má mʋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la sɩpaaŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, má kʋŋkala joŋ tabɩɩŋ ŋ doho nɩaa nyuŋ lɛ a baasɛ

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why are these rocks here?” Then you can tell them how the water stopped flowing when the chest was being carried across the river. These rocks will always remind our people of what happened here today.
translation_verse: Má bʋla pɩba arɩ bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la fa sɩɩ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, lɩɩ-la fa sɩɩ pɛllʋ kɛrɛ nɛ a chɩŋ dɩ-bala. Tabɩaa deemba nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa liliisi wɩɩ-la a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: The men followed the instructions that the Lord had given Joshua. They picked up twelve rocks, one for each tribe, and carried them to the camp, where they put them down.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baala-la fii arɩ balɩa ŋaa ŋɩɩ Josua sɩ dagɛba. Ba paa tabɩaa fɩɩ arɩ balɩa nɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, tabɩɩ-kala chɩŋ doho doho-la nyuŋ, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Josua ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba chʋŋ tabɩa-la ŋɩɩ a kaa mʋ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ a joŋo bil.

english_verse: Joshua set up a monument next to the place where the priests were standing. This monument was also made of twelve large rocks, and it is still there in the middle of the river. The People of Israel Set Up Camp at Gilgal
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua paa tabɩaa fɩɩ arɩ balɩa-la ba sɩ paa Jɔdaŋ fuo-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, lee-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ chʋŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la fa sɩ chɩna a pɛ, arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala tabɩa-la ha hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: It was the tenth day of the first month of the year when Israel crossed the Jordan River. They set up camp at Gilgal, which was east of the land controlled by Jericho.
translation_verse: Chɛŋ bumbuŋ tapʋl-fii chɛɛŋ nɛ, Iziral tɩmma-la fa chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a mʋ hɔŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɩlɩgal lɛ. Ʋ hɛ Jeriko tinteeŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The men who had carried the twelve rocks from the Jordan brought them to Joshua, and they made them into a monument.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua joŋ tabɩa-la fɩɩ arɩ balɩa ba fa sɩ paa Jɔdaŋ fuo-la tʋɔŋ, a hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a bil Gɩlɩgal lɛ,

english_verse: Then Joshua told the people: Years from now your children will ask you why these rocks are here.
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, “Dɩ ma doho nɩaa nɛ maachie pɩɛsɛma arɩ tabɩaa deemba bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ bɛɛ,

english_verse: Tell them, “The Lord our God dried up the Jordan River so we could walk across. He did the same thing here for us that he did for our people at the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ leŋe Jɔdaŋ fuo-la hʋ ma sɩpaaŋ ka ma chol, arɩ ʋ fa sɩ leŋe Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ-la lɩɩŋ hʋ ka la bal ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: because he wants everyone on earth to know how powerful he is. And he wants us to worship only him.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma fɩfá ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: The Amorite kings west of the Jordan River and the Canaanite kings along the Mediterranean Sea lost their courage and their will to fight, when they heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan River to let Israel go across. Israel Gets Ready To Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuorie-la sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ arɩ Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa kuorie-la sɩ hɛ Mediterenia mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ fa sɩ nɩa dɩ La TƖƖNA ŋaa Jɔdaŋ fuoŋ hʋ nɛ ka Iziral tɩŋŋaa chol, fawʋllʋŋ chaasa jʋʋba woruŋ. A tɩŋ Iziral tɩmma-la wɩaa ba nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ arɩ ba sɩ jaŋ cheme yuoba.

english_verse: While Israel was camped at Gilgal, the Lord said, “Joshua, make some flint knives and circumcise the rest of the Israelite men and boys.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Josua, “Yɛrɛ naŋkpachɩllɩŋ dɩ ba nagɛ sɩɩsɩŋ a kɛŋ niiŋ a keri Iziral tɩŋŋaa penee.”

english_verse: Joshua made the knives, then circumcised those men and boys at Haaraloth Hill.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua fa yɛrɛ naŋkpachɩllɩ-la a kaa keri Iziral tɩŋŋaa penee Gɩbɩaf Haralɔf lɛ [ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ ‘peel-la lɛ ba sɩ keri penee’].

english_verse: This had to be done, because none of Israel's baby boys had been circumcised during the
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ sʋʋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ biiriŋ penee nɛ Josua keri ŋɩɩ. Ba fa bɩ ba penee kere wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who had been circumcised needed time to heal, and they stayed in camp.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ keri ba tintee-la nɩaa kala penee, ba fa hɔŋ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ deeŋ deeŋ pene-la fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “It was a disgrace for my people to be slaves in Egypt, but now I have taken away that disgrace.” So the Israelites named the place Gilgal, and it still has that name.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pɩ Josua, “Jɩnɩŋ mɩ leŋe hɩɩsɩ-la kala ma sɩ die Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ dɛrɛ nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɛ lee-la yɩrɩŋ Gɩlɩgal. Arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala lee-la yɩrɩŋ nɛ ha ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Israel continued to camp at Gilgal in the desert near Jericho, and on the fourteenth day of the same month, they celebrated Passover.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ hɔŋ Gɩlɩgal lɛ, Jeriko tintee-taalɩsɩ-la lɛ, chɛnɛ tapʋlaa fɩɩ arɩ banɛsɛ chɛɛŋ dɩdaanɩŋ, ba gbieli dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la.

english_verse: The next day, God stopped sending the Israelites manna to eat each morning, and they started eating food grown in the land of Canaan. They ate roasted grain and thin bread made of the barley they had gathered from nearby fields. Israel Captures Jericho
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ dii tintee-la kʋdiilee taŋ sii pʋl, ‘mana-la’ fa sɩ yie tel ba didii bɩra bɩ tele. Jɩna-la Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ kʋdiilee nɛ ba dii. Josua arɩ baala sɩ kori tokobiiŋ

english_verse: One day, Joshua was near Jericho when he saw a man standing some distance in front of him. The man was holding a sword, so Joshua walked up to him and asked, “Are you on our side or on our enemies' side?”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Josua sɩ mʋ a kpagɛ Jeriko, ʋ na baal kʋbala dɩ ʋ chɩŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ a kori tokobiiŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mʋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ pɛ la lɛ nɛ koo ŋ ŋaa la dʋndɔŋ nɛ?”

english_verse: “Neither,” he answered. “I am here because I am the commander of the Lord's army.” Joshua fell to his knees and bowed down to the ground. “I am your servant,” he said. “Tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋl, “Aɩ, mɩ nɛ ŋaa La TƖƖNA laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua tuu tele chu tinteeŋ a zilu aŋ pɩɛsʋ, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, wʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ tɩntɩnna ŋaa?”

english_verse: “Take off your sandals,” the commander answered. “This is a holy place.” So Joshua took off his sandals.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la bʋla pɩ Josua, “Chaarɛ ŋ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa lee-la ŋ sɩ chɩna ŋaa Wɩa lee nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua ŋaa ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Jericho had been locking the gates in their town wall because they were afraid of the Israelites. No one could go out or come in.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ba fa tɔ boi-baala-la kala ba sɩ to jʋjʋʋ Jeriko nɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ, a tɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wɩaa. Nʋʋ bɩ taŋ-la lɛ wuo lɩɩ, nʋʋ ma bɩ wuo jʋʋ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Joshua: With my help, you and your army will defeat the king of Jericho and his army, and you will capture the town. Here is how to do it: March slowly around Jericho once a day for six days.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala, ŋ dɩ ŋ laalɩyuoro-la sɩ vɔɔ tʋɔnʋŋ, má sii a kɩɛlɛ a vɛnɛ golli taŋ-la bala. Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ tapʋlaa balɩdʋ.

english_verse: Take along the sacred chest and tell seven priests to walk in front of it, carrying trumpets. But on the seventh day, march slowly around the town seven times while the priests blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩaa balɩpɛ paa pie-bel nyilliŋ a laa Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la sɩpaaŋ. Tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ, má kɩɛlɛ a vɛnɛ golli taŋ-la naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ, ka dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ŋmʋŋmʋʋ nyilli-la.

english_verse: Then the priests will blast on their trumpets, and everyone else will shout. The wall will fall down, and your soldiers can go straight in from every side.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ nɩa dɩ ba faasa ŋmʋʋ nyilli-la, ma nɩalɩŋ kala maga dɩ ma faasa ŋaa goŋ nɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, jebii-la sɩ golli Jeriko jaŋ tel, ka dɩ ma laalɩyuoroo kala wuo jʋʋ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: Joshua called the priests together and said, “Take the chest and tell seven priests to carry trumpets and march ahead of it.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nuŋ nanʋala Josua yɩrɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa a bʋla pɩba, “Má joŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la aŋ leŋ dɩ ma nɩaa balɩpɛ ma paa nyilliŋ a laa daga-la sɩpaaŋ.”

english_verse: They obeyed Joshua's orders and carried the chest once around the town before returning to camp for the night.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la a lɩɩ golli taŋ-la bala, aŋ mɩɩra mʋ chʋa ba dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: On the seventh day, the army got up at daybreak. They marched slowly around Jericho the same as they had done for the past six days, except on this day they went around seven times.
translation_verse: Tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ, ba sii chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla a golli taŋ-la ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ. Chɛ-pɛɩ-la dʋndʋŋa nɛ ba golli taŋ-la naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ.

english_verse: Then the priests blew the trumpets, and Joshua yelled: Get ready to shout! The Lord will let you capture this town.
translation_verse: Ba fa sɩɩ golli ŋɩɩ pɛɛmɩŋ lɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa faasa ŋmʋʋ nyilli-la, ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Má faasa ŋaa goŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA joŋ taŋ-la a hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But you must destroy it and everything in it, to show that it now belongs to the Lord. The woman Rahab helped the spies we sent, so protect her and the others who are inside her house. But kill everyone else in the town.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma chei taŋ-la arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ, ba ŋaa La TƖƖNA kɩaa nɛ. Rahab, hachɔrʋŋ-la arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ ka, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ kɛŋ baala-la la sɩ tɩma ba mʋ lʋara beŋ tintee-la a faa.

english_verse: The silver and gold and everything made of bronze and iron belong to the Lord and must be put in his treasury. Be careful to follow these instructions, because if you see something you want and take it, the Lord will destroy Israel. And it will be all your fault.
translation_verse: Sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ koo hɔɔŋ ŋaa, ba ŋaa La TƖƖNA kɩaa nɛ. Ba maga dɩ ba jʋʋ ʋ dʋa dɩ-biliŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: The priests blew their trumpets again, and the soldiers shouted as loud as they could. The walls of Jericho fell flat. Then the soldiers rushed up the hill, went straight into the town, and captured it.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ faasa ŋmʋʋ nyilli-la, nɩalɩŋ ma faasa ŋaa goŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jeriko jebii-la tel. Laalɩyuoro-la guu jʋʋ taŋ-la a yuo diiu.

english_verse: After Jericho was destroyed, Joshua warned the people, “Someday a man will rebuild Jericho, but the Lord will put a curse on him, and the man's oldest son will die when he starts to build the town wall. And by the time he finishes the wall and puts gates in it, all his children will be dead.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ Josua chaasa ŋmɩɛsɛ a bʋl, “Dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ bɩra paa Jeriko a saa, La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ diiu. Ʋ bii-hɩaŋ nɛ ʋ jaŋ kaa bil taŋ-la gentine. Dɩ ʋ nɛ saa dɛrɛ, ʋ bii-katɩɩ nɛ ʋ jaŋ kaa hɛ taŋ-la boi-baalaa.”

english_verse: The Lord helped Joshua in everything he did, and Joshua was famous everywhere in Canaan.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa chɩŋ Josua harɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ teeli tintee-la kala.

english_verse: The Lord had said that everything in Jericho belonged to him. But Achan from the Judah tribe took some of the things from Jericho for himself. And so the Lord was angry with the Israelites, because one of them had disobeyed him.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa sɩ bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba sɩ́ kʋŋkala sɩ maga dɩ ba chei Jeriko lɛ joŋ ŋɩɩ, ba bɩ nii-la kaa tɩŋ. Ka baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ekaŋ vɩa aŋ paa kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ. Ekaŋ nyɩmma nɛ Kaamɩ, Kaamɩ ma nyɩmma nɛ Zimiri, Zimiri ma nyɩmma nɛ Zɛra. Ba kala ŋaa Juda doho nɩaa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nyuŋ.

english_verse: Joshua and the leaders of Israel tore their clothes and put dirt on their heads to show their sorrow. They lay facedown on the ground in front of the sacred chest until sunset.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ kɛŋ ba gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ a ŋaa hagɩla bʋgɛ ba nyusuŋ ba tʋɔŋ sɩ cheye, aŋ tuu tele chu La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la sɩpaaŋ a pɩŋ nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ halɩɩ Wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: Then Joshua said: Our Lord, did you bring us across the Jordan River just so the Amorites could destroy us? This wouldn't have happened if we had agreed to stay on the other side of the Jordan.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua pɩɛsɛ, “Ou, La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ kɛnla a chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a kɔ daha dɩ ŋ jonla hɛ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba kpʋla? Ŋ fa maga ŋ leŋ dɩ la hɔŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la cholo sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I don't even know what to say to you, since Israel's army has turned and run from the enemy.
translation_verse: Ou La TƖƖNA, wʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋl, na Iziral tɩŋŋaa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ mɩɩra wuoba ŋ-la?

english_verse: Everyone will think you weren't strong enough to protect your people. Now the Canaanites and everyone else who lives in the land will surround us and wipe us out.
translation_verse: Dɩ Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ba jaŋ sii a kʋ gollila a kpʋ la kala dɩ la yɩrɩŋ lɛl tinteeŋ lɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ŋ yɩrɩ-bal-la sɩ́ lɛl?”

english_verse: The Lord answered: Stop lying there on the ground! Get up!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Josua, “Sii, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ pɩna chu?

english_verse: I said everything in Jericho belonged to me and had to be destroyed. But the Israelites have kept some of the things for themselves. They stole from me and hid what they took. Then they lied about it.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, a chei nii-la mɩ sɩ bile a pɩba dɩ ba to. Ba paa kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba chei nɛ, ba gaa kɩalɩŋ nɛ, aŋ nyɩɛ wɩaa, aŋ paa guoli ba kɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: What they stole was supposed to be destroyed, and now Israel itself must be destroyed. I cannot help you anymore until you do exactly what I have said. That's why Israel turns and runs from its enemies instead of standing up to them.
translation_verse: Ba chei ba tɩtɩa nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩra bɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ wuo ŋɩɩ. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ see dɩ ma chei kɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ sɩ ma chei.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel, “Tomorrow you will meet with the Lord your God, so make yourselves acceptable to worship him. The Lord says that you have taken things that should have been destroyed. You won't be able to stand up to your enemies until you get rid of those things.
translation_verse: Mʋ a pɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ disiniŋ ta, ka dɩ ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ chie. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Iziral Wɩa kɛŋ wɩɩ nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma. Kɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ sɩ ma chei dɔnsʋŋ hɛ ma dʋa tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma bɩ jaŋ wuo yuo dii ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, see dɩ ma chaarɛ kɩalɩŋ ta.

english_verse: “Tomorrow morning everyone must gather near the place of worship. You will come forward tribe by tribe, and the Lord will show which tribe is guilty. Next, the clans in that tribe must come forward, and the Lord will show which clan is guilty. The families in that clan must come, and the Lord will point out the guilty family. Finally, the men in that family must come,
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba, chʋchʋɔŋ ba jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ doho doho. Doho-la kala mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ, jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa. Nyɩŋ-nɩalɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ dɩa dɩa. Dɩa-la ma kala mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ, jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ kʋŋ kʋŋ.

english_verse: and the Lord will show who stole what should have been destroyed. That man must be put to death, his body burned, and his possessions thrown into the fire. He has done a terrible thing by breaking the sacred agreement that the Lord made with Israel.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa sɩ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ sɩ dɩ ma chei, ma jaŋ nyɩgɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa arɩ ba kɩaa kala. Nɩɩ-la chei nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ nɛ, a joŋ hɩɩsɩŋ hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala lɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua got up early the next morning and brought each tribe to the place of worship, where the Lord showed that the Judah tribe was guilty.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua sii chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla a kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kʋ lɩɩ doho doho. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ Juda doho.

english_verse: Then Joshua brought the clans of Judah to the Lord, and the Lord showed that the Zerah clan was guilty. One by one he brought the leader of each family in the Zerah clan to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Zabdi's family was guilty.
translation_verse: Josua bɩra kɛŋ Juda doho nɩaa kʋ lɩɩ nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa. La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ Zɛra nyɩŋ nɩaa, ʋ bɩra kɛŋ Zɛra nyɩŋ-nɩalɩŋ ma kʋ lɩɩ dɩa dɩa, La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ Zimiri nɩaa.

english_verse: Finally, Joshua brought each man in Zabdi's family to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Achan was the guilty one.
translation_verse: Josua leŋ Zimiri dɩa nɩaa kʋ lɩɩ kʋŋ kʋŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ Ekaŋ. Ekaŋ nyɩmma nɛ Kaamɩ, Kaamɩ ma nyɩmma nɛ Zimiri, Zimiri ma nyɩmma nɛ Zɛra. Ba kala ŋaa Juda doho nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: “Achan,” Joshua said, “the Lord God of Israel has decided that you are guilty. So tell me what you did, and don't try to hide anything.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua bʋla pɩ Ekaŋ, “Mɩ bii, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Dagɛ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ cheye pɩmɛ, sɩ́ joŋo faamɛ.”

english_verse: “It's true,” Achan answered. “I sinned and disobeyed the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ekaŋ bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa teeŋ. Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: While we were in Jericho, I saw a beautiful Babylonian robe,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua tɩŋ nɩaa ba fá jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ a na kɩalɩŋ dɩ ba hugi nɩmɛ, ka warɩpʋla-la hɛ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: They brought them back and put them in front of the sacred chest, so Joshua and the rest of the Israelites could see them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba paa kɩalɩŋ kala lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ a kaa kʋ lɩɩ Josua arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala teeŋ, a kaa bɩsa bil La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Then everyone took Achan and the things he had stolen to Trouble Valley. They also took along his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys, and sheep, his tent, and everything else that belonged to him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua arɩ Iziral tɩmma-la kɛŋ Zɛra nanʋala Ekaŋ a paa warɩpʋla-la, gɛrɩ-la arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la a kɛsɛ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ, ʋ toloo, ʋ nɛsɩŋ, ʋ kakusuŋ arɩ ʋ piesee, a churi ʋ lɛbɩŋ arɩ kʋŋ na-kala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ a kaa tʋʋ fuonaa kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Akɔ.

english_verse: Joshua said, “Achan, you caused us a lot of trouble. Now the Lord is paying you back with the same kind of trouble.” The people of Israel then stoned to death Achan and his family. They made a fire and burned the bodies, together with what Achan had stolen, and all his possessions.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ Josua pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ lɛrɛ hɛɛŋ deeŋ kʋ hɛ la lɛ ŋ-la? La TƖƖNA ma jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ na hɛɛŋ jɩnɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala paa tabɩaa a yagʋ kpʋ, a yagɛ ʋ dɩa nɩaa ma kpʋ aŋ nyɩgɛ ba dɩ ba kɩaa.

english_verse: They covered the remains with a big pile of rocks, which is still there. Then the Lord stopped being angry with Israel. That's how the place came to be called Trouble Valley.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba paa tabɩaa a chʋɔrɛ Ekaŋ nyuŋ, arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala tabɩa-la ha hɛ nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba hɛ lee-la yɩrɩŋ Akɔ fuonaaŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua: Don't be afraid, and don't be discouraged by what happened at the town of Ai. Take the army and attack again. But first, order part of the army to set up an ambush on the other side of the town. I will help you defeat the king of Ai and his army, and you will capture the town and the land around it. Destroy Ai and kill its king as you did at Jericho. But you may keep the livestock and everything else you want.
translation_verse: Má joŋ wɩɩ-la tɩtɩa ma sɩ ŋaa Jeriko arɩ ʋ kuoro lɛ a ŋaa Aɩ arɩ ʋ kuoro ma lɛ. Ama Aɩ-na lɛ, kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ yuo laa, má paaba, a kɛsɛ ba pʋsʋŋ ma pɛ dɩ ba ŋaa ma kɩaa. Má faa taŋ-la harɩŋ a yuoba.”

english_verse: The rest of the army will come with me and attack near the gate. When the people of Ai come out to fight, we'll run away and let them chase us. They will think we are running from them just like the first time. But when we've let them chase us far enough away,
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kire to la harɩŋ dɩ la nyɩsa kɛmba fá a kagɛ ba jaŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ bɩɩnɛ arɩ laa fá arɩ la fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ fá ŋɩɩ nɛ. Dɩ la nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: you come out of hiding. The Lord our God will help you capture the town.
translation_verse: ma jaŋ sii lee-la ma sɩ faa a jʋʋ yuo laa taŋ-la. Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ joŋ taŋ-la hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then set it on fire, as the Lord has told us to do. Those are your orders,
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ yuo dii taŋ-la, má nyɩgʋ. Má ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala La TƖƖNA sɩ daga, a to mɩ niiŋ woruŋ.”

english_verse: Early the next morning he got his troops ready to move out, and he and the other leaders of Israel led them to Ai.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla, Josua yɩrɛ ʋ laalɩyuoroo a hɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa laa ba sɩpaaŋ baa mʋ Aɩ.

english_verse: They set up camp in full view of the town, across the valley to the north.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩ laalɩyuoro-la kala sɩ hɛ ʋ teeŋ sɩɩ mʋ Aɩ ŋɩɩ, ba mʋ kpagɛ taŋ-la boi-baalɩŋ, a ŋmoo buguŋ Aɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ, ka fuonaaŋ hɛ ba dɩ taŋ-la pɛgɛ.

english_verse: Now all his troops were in place. Part of the army was in the camp to the north of Ai, and the others were hiding to the west, ready to make a surprise attack. That night, Joshua went into the valley.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ kala kɩɩ kɩɩ, ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ. Dɔnsʋŋ hɛ taŋ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa, ka nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ faa taŋ-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Tɩtaŋ-la Josua sii a tuu fuonaa-la.

english_verse: So he called out every man in Ai to go after Joshua's troops. They all rushed out to chase the Israelite army, and they left the town gates wide open. Not one man was left in Ai or in Bethel. Joshua let the men of Ai chase him and his army farther and farther away from Ai.
translation_verse: Baal kala bɩ Aɩ lɛ koo Bɛtɛl lɛ ka, ba kala nɛ lɩɩ kire to Iziral tɩŋŋaa harɩŋ. Ba leŋ ba taŋ kala ta nɛ nʋʋ bɩ pɔ, ka ba lɩɩ kire to Iziral tɩmma-la harɩŋ.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord told Joshua, “Point your sword at the town of Ai, because now I am going to help you defeat it!” As soon as Joshua pointed his sword at the town,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Josua, “Kɛŋ tiŋ-la sɩ hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a yɩa Aɩ dɩɩrɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ taŋ-la a hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua kɛŋ tiŋ-la a yɩa Aɩ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: the soldiers who had been hiding jumped up and ran into the town. They captured it and set it on fire.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ faa sii ba leree lɩma lɩma, a fá jʋʋ taŋ-la a laa ʋ kala a guu chol nyiniŋ hɛ ʋ didii.

english_verse: When Joshua and his troops saw smoke rising from the town, they knew that the other part of their army had captured it. So they turned and attacked. The men of Ai looked back and saw smoke rising from their town. But they could not escape, because the soldiers they had been chasing had suddenly turned and started fighting.
translation_verse: Josua arɩ Iziral tɩmma-la kala sɩ na dɩ ba baala-la fa sɩ faa, dɩ ba laa taŋ-la a joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ nyʋɔsʋŋ sisii, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mɩɩrɛ a yuyuo Aɩ tɩmma-la.

english_verse: Joshua made sure every building in Ai was burned to the ground. He told his men to kill the king of Ai and hang his body on a tree. Then at sunset he told the Israelites to take down the body, throw it in the gateway of the town, and cover it with a big pile of rocks. Those rocks are still there, and the town itself has never been rebuilt. Joshua Reads the Blessings and Curses (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Ka ʋ lieŋi Aɩ kuoro tɩa lɛ, a leŋ ʋ sagɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ yi dɩdaanɩŋ. Wɩɩ-muluŋ sɩ jʋa, Josua ŋaa ba sori ʋ kʋsʋʋŋ tɩa-la lɛ a joŋo lo ta taŋ-la boi-baalɩŋ lɛ. Ba paa tabɩaa a chʋɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ, tabɩa-la ha hɛ nɩmɛ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. Ba wasa wulli nii-la ba sɩ bile Ɛbal peel-la lɛ

english_verse: The people of Gibeon had also heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai.
translation_verse: Gibioŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la Josua sɩ ŋaa Jeriko arɩ Aɩ lɛ,

english_verse: So they decided that some of their men should pretend to be messengers to Israel from a faraway country. The men put worn-out bags on their donkeys and found some old wineskins that had cracked and had been sewn back together.
translation_verse: ba chɛ wombii dɔŋ ba sɩ jaŋ to a mʋ nyɩsʋ. Ba sii kɛsɛ kakusuŋ a chʋŋ kʋdiilee arɩ bɔtɔ kɔsʋmɔɔ arɩ sɩnɩŋ puroo sɩ kɔsɔ ba sɩ yɛrɛ yɛrɛ, a mʋ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Their sandals were old and patched, and their clothes were worn out. They even took along some dry and crumbly bread.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa laalɛ gɛrɩ-kɔsʋmɔɔ nɛ a hɛ nɛntɛŋ-kpaarɩŋ ba sɩ yɛrɛ yɛrɛ. Boroboroba-la ma ba sɩ paa kala nɛ hɩla aŋ nyʋ.

english_verse: Then they went to the Israelite camp at Gilgal, where they said to Joshua and the men of Israel, “We have come from a country that is far from here. Please make a peace treaty with us.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ Josua teeŋ Gɩlɩgal lɛ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ, a bʋla pɩ ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, “La lɩɩ dɩ-bolii nɛ a kɔ, aa chɛla dɩ ma hɛ niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: The Israelites replied, “But maybe you really live near us. We can't make a peace treaty with you if you live nearby.” The Gibeonites said, “If you make a peace treaty with us, we will be your servants.” “Who are you?” Joshua asked. “Where do you come from?” They answered:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ bʋla pɩ Josua, “La ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua bɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Kʋbɛɛ ba nɛ ma ŋaa, nɩɩ nɛ ma lɩɩ?”

english_verse: We are your servants, and we live far from here. We came because the Lord your God is so famous. We heard what the Lord did in Egypt
translation_verse: Ba bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ tɩntɩnnaa lɩɩ dɩ-bolii nɛ, la nɩɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩaa nɛ a kɔ. La nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ fa sɩ ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ,

english_verse: and what he did to those two Amorite kings on the other side of the Jordan: King Og of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth, and King Sihon of Heshbon.
translation_verse: arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuorie-la balɩa sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, Hɛsɩbɔŋ kuoro Sɩhɔŋ arɩ Basaŋ tinteeŋ kuoro Ɔgɩ, sɩ hɔŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩtarɔf lɛ.

english_verse: Our leaders and everyone who lives in our country told us to meet with you and tell you that all of us are your servants. They said to ask you to make a peace treaty with our people. They told us to be sure and take along enough food for our journey.
translation_verse: La nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ la tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ bʋla pɩla dɩ la joŋ kʋdiilee a kaa vɛŋ wombiiŋ a kɔ ma teeŋ a bʋla pɩma, la ŋaa ma tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, má leŋ dɩ la dɩ ma hɛ niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: See this dry, crumbly bread of ours? It was hot out of the oven when we packed the food on the day we left our homes.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la la sɩ sii paa la kɩaa dɩ la kɔ ma teeŋ, la boroboro deeŋ fa zɔmɔ nɛ, ama ma bee na lɛɛlɛ ʋ kala nɛ hɩla a nyʋ.

english_verse: These cracked wineskins were new when we filled them, and our clothes and sandals are worn out because we have traveled so far.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ la sɩ hɛ sɩnɩŋ puroo deemba lɛ, ba kala fa falɩa nɛ, ama ma bee na lɛɛlɛ ba kala nɛ kɩɛsa. La gɛnnɩŋ arɩ la nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ ma kala nɛ kɔsɔ, a tɩŋ wombii-duduoŋ-la la sɩ vɛnɛ wɩaa.”

english_verse: The Israelites tried some of the food, but they did not ask the Lord if he wanted them to make a treaty.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩ La TƖƖNA pɩɛsa, aŋ laa nɩalɩŋ kʋdiilee mʋa mʋa a dii.

english_verse: So Joshua made a peace treaty with the messengers and promised that Israel would not kill their people. Israel's leaders swore that Israel would keep this promise.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ Josua kɛŋ Gibioŋ tɩmma-la a dii nandɔnsʋŋ a lemba, ʋ bɩ ba wɩɩkala ŋaa. Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ ma hɛ niiŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ arɩ ba bɩ jaŋ ŋaaba wʋbɔŋ kala.

english_verse: A couple of days later, the Israelites found out that these people actually lived in the nearby towns of Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-Jearim. So the Israelites left the place where they had camped and arrived at the four towns two days later.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma sii vɛŋ tapʋlaa batori a mʋ na tasɩ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩa. Tasɩ-la nɛ ŋ-la: Gibioŋ, Kɛfɩra, Bɛɛrɔf arɩ Kɩrɩaf Jɩarɩm.

english_verse: But they did not attack the towns, because the Israelite leaders had sworn in the name of the Lord that they would let these people live. The Israelites complained about their leaders' decision not to attack,
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa yɩrɩŋ nɛ a kaa hɛ niiŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ arɩ ba bɩ jaŋ ŋaa ba wʋbɔŋ kala, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba bɩ ba wɩɩkala ŋaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩmma-la kala gʋrɩmɛ wɩaa ba sɩpaalaaraa teeŋ.

english_verse: but the leaders reminded them, “We promised these people in the name of the Lord God of Israel that we would let them live, so we must not harm them. If we break our promise, God will punish us. We'll let them live, but we'll make them cut wood and carry water for our people.”
translation_verse: La bɩ jaŋ kpʋba, ama ba nɛ jaŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ kikeri la daasɩŋ, aŋ ŋaa lɩɩŋ ma a pɩpɩla.” Wɩɩ-la sɩpaalaara-la fa sɩ vʋʋra nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Joshua told some of his soldiers, “I want to meet with the Gibeonite leaders. Bring them here.” When the Gibeonites came, Joshua said, “You live close to us. Why did you lie by claiming you lived far away?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua yɩrɛ Gibioŋ tɩmma-la a pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma nyɩsɛla arɩ ma lɩɩ dɩ-bolii nɛ, a see ma jʋʋ a kpɩkpagɛla nɛ?

english_verse: So now you are under a curse, and from now on your people will have to send workers to cut wood and carry water for the place of worship.”
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ diima nɛ. Ma nɛ jaŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ keri daasɩŋ a chʋŋ lɩɩŋ a kaa mʋmʋ mɩ Wɩa dɩa a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: The Gibeonites answered, “The Lord your God told his servant Moses that you were to kill everyone who lives here and take their land for yourselves. We were afraid you would kill us, and so we tricked you into making a peace treaty. But we agreed to be your servants,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ Josua, “La ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa la nɩɩ ŋɩɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna Mosis arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ tintee-la kala a pɩma, aŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ nɛ. Fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛnla nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la tɩŋ la mɩɩsɩŋ wɩaa a ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: and you are strong enough to do anything to us that you want. We just ask you to do what seems right.”
translation_verse: La hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ lɛɛlɛ. Ŋaala wɩɩ-la-kala ŋ sɩ cho.”

english_verse: Joshua did not let the Israelites kill the Gibeonites,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua laaba ta Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba bɩ ba kpʋa.

english_verse: but he did tell the Gibeonites that they would have to be servants of the nation of Israel. They would have to cut firewood and bring it for the priests to use for burning sacrifices on the Lord's altar, wherever the Lord decided the altar would be. The Gibeonites would also have to carry water for the priests. And that is still the work of the Gibeonites.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ Josua leŋ Gibioŋ tɩmma-la ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ kikeri daasɩŋ aŋ ŋaa lɩɩŋ pɩpɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa aŋ pɛ ŋaa jʋjʋʋ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɩ hɛ, lee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ lɛ. Ba tɩntɩmɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: King Adonizedek of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured and destroyed the town of Ai, and then killed its king as he had done at Jericho. He also learned that the Gibeonites had signed a peace treaty with Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jerusalɛm kuoro Adoni-Zɛdɛk nɩɩ arɩ Josua yuo dii Aɩ a chei ʋ kala, a kpʋ ʋ kuoro arɩ ʋ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Jeriko arɩ ʋ kuoro lɛ. Ʋ bɩra nɩa arɩ Gibioŋ tɩŋŋaa ma sii mʋ ba dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛ niiŋ nɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa leŋ ba hɔnɔ kpagɛba.

english_verse: This frightened Adonizedek and his people. They knew that Gibeon was a large town, as big as the towns that had kings, and even bigger than the town of Ai had been. And all of the men of Gibeon were warriors.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ fawʋllʋŋ faasa jʋʋ ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Gibioŋ fa ŋaa tabal nɛ, a magɛ ta-jalɩa-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ kuoroo. Ʋ fa yʋga kɩɩ Aɩ, ʋ nɩaa ma kala chaasa ŋaa bayuoro.

english_verse: So Adonizedek sent messages to the kings of four other towns: King Hoham of Hebron, King Piram of Jarmuth, King Japhia of Lachish, and King Debir of Eglon. The messages said,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jerusalɛm kuoro Adoni-Zɛdɛk tɩŋ dɩ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Hɛbʋrɔŋ kuoro Hoham, Jaamʋf kuoro Pɩram, Lakɩs kuoro Jafɩa arɩ Ɛgɩlɔŋ kuoro Debi,

english_verse: “The Gibeonites have signed a peace treaty with Joshua and the Israelites. Come and help me attack Gibeon!”
translation_verse: a bʋl, “Má kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ la yuo Gibioŋ tɩŋŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba sii mʋ ba dɩ Josua arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛ niiŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: the Gibeonites sent a message to the Israelite camp at Gilgal: “Joshua, please come and rescue us! The Amorite kings from the hill country have joined together and are attacking us. We are your servants, so don't let us down. Please hurry!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Gibioŋ tɩmma-la tɩma pɩ Josua ba dɩhɔnʋŋ Gɩlɩgal lɛ a bʋl, “Sɩ́ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa vɩa ta, kɔ la teeŋ lɩma a laala ta. Pɛ la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuorie-la kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ sii kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a yuyuola.”

english_verse: Joshua and his army, including his best warriors, left Gilgal.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala, a pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ faasa jɩŋ laalɩ-yuonuŋ woruŋ, lɩɩ Gɩlɩgal lɛ a mʋmʋ.

english_verse: “Joshua,” the Lord said, “don't be afraid of the Amorites. They will run away when you attack, and I will help you defeat them.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Josua, “Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ wɩaa, mɩ jomba hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ ŋ sɩpaaŋ wuo chɩŋ.”

english_verse: Joshua marched all night from Gilgal to Gibeon and made a surprise attack on the Amorite camp.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ-la kala Josua arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo lɩɩ Gɩlɩgal lɛ a vɛŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ Gibioŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ a yuo dɩ Amɔrɩ tɩmma-la lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord made the enemy panic, and the Israelites started killing them right and left. They chased the Amorite troops up the road to Beth-Horon and kept on killing them, until they reached the towns of Azekah and Makkedah.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa leŋe Amɔrɩ tɩmma-la wɩɩkala vʋgʋmɛ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la sɩpaaŋ. Ba chaasa yuo diiba Gibioŋ lɛ, a kire to ba harɩŋ a joŋ wombii-la sɩɩ mʋ Bɛf Horoŋ a kpʋba ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Azɛka arɩ Makɛda.

english_verse: And while these troops were going down through Beth-Horon Pass, the Lord made huge hailstones fall on them all the way to Azekah. More of the enemy soldiers died from the hail than from the Israelite weapons.
translation_verse: Amɔrɩ tɩmma-la fa sɩɩ fá dɩ ba laa ba tɩtɩa Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo nɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, a chɩŋ Bɛf Horoŋ lɛ a mʋmʋ Azɛka, La TƖƖNA leŋ duoŋ-tabɩɩ-balaa lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a kʋ tuu telee yagɛba. Duoŋ-tabɩa-la fa kpʋ ba nɩ-daŋ nɛ a paala kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ Iziral laalɩyuoro-la sɩ kpʋa.

english_verse: Never before and never since has the Lord done anything like that for someone who prayed. The Lord was really fighting for Israel.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ kala ha bɩ ŋɩɩ naga, tapʋlɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ jegile nɩɩ nuhuobiine teeŋ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, La TƖƖNA nɛ yuo laalɩŋ pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: After the battle, Joshua and the Israelites went back to their camp at Gilgal. Joshua Kills the Five Enemy Kings
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua arɩ Iziral laalɩyuoro-la kala mɩɩra mʋ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ Gɩlɩgal lɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa kpʋ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoroo banɔŋ

english_verse: While the enemy soldiers were running from the Israelites, the five enemy kings ran away and hid in a cave near Makkedah.
translation_verse: Kuorusu-la banɔŋ fa fá nɛ a mʋ faa bʋ-bʋa tʋɔŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Makɛda lɛ.

english_verse: Joshua's soldiers told him, “The five kings have been found in a cave near Makkedah.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bʋla pɩ Josua arɩ ba mʋ faa nɩmɛ,

english_verse: Joshua answered, “Roll some big stones over the mouth of the cave and leave a few soldiers to guard it.
translation_verse: ʋ sɩ, “Má bilimi tabɩɩ-balaa a mʋ tɔ bʋ-bʋa-la niiŋ aŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa chɩna pɔ.

english_verse: But you and everyone else must keep going after the enemy troops, because they will be safe if they reach their walled towns. Don't let them get away! The Lord our God is helping us get rid of them.”
translation_verse: Ama, ma ha sɩ́ ma dʋndɔmɔ-la leŋ, má kire to ba harɩŋ a yuoba a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba wuo yi ba jaŋ. Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa jomba a hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: So Joshua and the Israelites almost wiped out the enemy soldiers. Only a few safely reached their walled towns.
translation_verse: Josua arɩ Iziral laalɩyuoroo kpʋ nɩalɩŋ jesiŋ kala nɛ, ba nɩaa mʋa nɛ wuo fá a mʋ jʋʋ ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ a golli ba tasɩ-la a laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: The Israelite army returned to their camp at Makkedah, where Joshua was waiting for them. No one around there dared say anything bad about the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua laalɩyuoro-la kala mɩɩra kɔ ʋ teeŋ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ Makɛda lɛ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Nʋʋkala bɩ nii suro ba teeŋ.

english_verse: Joshua told his soldiers, “Now, move the rocks from the entrance to the cave and bring those five kings to me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua bʋla pɩba, “Má suri bʋ-bʋa-la a chaarɛ kuorusu-la banɔŋ a kaa kɔ mɩ teeŋ.”

english_verse: The soldiers opened the entrance to the cave and brought out the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.
translation_verse: Ba suri bʋa-la a kɛŋ Jerusalɛm kuoro, Hɛbʋrɔŋ kuoro, Jaamʋf kuoro, Lakɩs kuoro arɩ Ɛgɩlɔŋ kuoro a kaa kʋ lɩɩ.

english_verse: After Joshua had called the army together, he forced the five kings to lie down on the ground. Then he called his officers forward and told them, “You fought these kings along with me, so put your feet on their necks.” The officers did this,
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɛŋ kuoroo deemba kɔ Josua teeŋ, ʋ yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa baalaa kala aŋ bʋla pɩ ʋ dɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩ mʋa, “Má kɔ a joŋ ma naasɩŋ a nʋɔsɛ kuoroo deemba baŋŋaa lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala kʋ lɩɩ a paa ba naasɩŋ a nʋɔsɛ ba baŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: and Joshua continued, “Don't ever be afraid or discouraged. Be brave and strong. This is what the Lord will do to all your enemies.”
translation_verse: Josua bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ. Má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ. Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa ma dʋndɔmɔ-la kala sɩ jaŋ yuyuo ma lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.”
