english_verse: Joshua killed the five kings and told his men to hang each body on a tree. Then at sunset
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua kpʋ kuorie-la a paaba sagɛ tɩɩsɩŋ banɔŋ lɛ, a lemba nɩmɛ a mʋ yi dɩdaanɩŋ.

english_verse: he told some of his troops, “Take the bodies down and throw them into the cave where the kings were found. Cover the entrance to the cave with big rocks.” Joshua's troops obeyed his orders, and those rocks are still there. Joshua Continues the Fighting
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ jʋa, Josua ŋaa ba sori ba tɩɩsɩ-la nyuŋ, a paaba yuo hɛ bʋ-bʋa-la lɛ ba fa sɩ jʋʋ faa, aŋ bilimi tabɩɩ-balaa a tɔ bʋa-la niiŋ. Tabɩa-la ha hɛ nɩmɛ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Joshua and his army left Makkedah and attacked the town of Libnah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kala sii Makɛda lɛ a mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Libina a yuou.

english_verse: The Lord let them capture the town and its king, and they killed the king and everyone else, just as they had done at Jericho.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra joŋ taŋ-la ma arɩ ʋ kuoro a hɛ Iziral laalɩyuoroo nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kpʋ nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ, nɩbala ma bɩ ka. Wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ joŋo ŋaa Jeriko kuoro lɛ nɛ, ʋ fa joŋo ŋaa Libina kuoro ma lɛ.

english_verse: Joshua then led his army to Lachish, and they set up camp around the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kala bɩra sii Libina lɛ a mʋ Lakɩs, a gollu chu a yuou.

english_verse: and the next day the Lord let them capture the town. They killed everyone, as they had done at Libnah.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra joŋ Lakɩs ma a hɛ Iziral laalɩyuoroo nɩsɩŋ lɛ, Josua fa yuo diiu chɛ-lɩa chɛɛŋ nɛ. Nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ nɛ Josua kpʋ, a nagɛ ʋ sɩ ŋaa Libina tɩŋŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: King Horam of Gezer arrived to help Lachish, but Joshua and his troops attacked and destroyed him and his army.
translation_verse: Gɛza kuoro Horam fa sii mʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ Lakɩs tɩŋŋaa lɛ, Josua kpʋ ʋ dɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala, nɩbala ma bɩ ka.

english_verse: From Lachish, Joshua took his troops to Eglon, where they set up camp surrounding the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua arɩ Iziral laalɩyuoroo kala sii Lakɩs lɛ a mʋ Ɛgɩlɔŋ. Ba mʋ a gollu chu a yuou.

english_verse: captured it that same day, then killed everyone, as they had done at Lachish.
translation_verse: Ba fa yuo diiu tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ, a kpʋ nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ Ɛgɩlɔŋ lɛ, a chei ʋ kala arɩ ba sɩ ŋaa Lakɩs ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Joshua and his army left Eglon and attacked Hebron.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kala bɩra sii Ɛgɩlɔŋ lɛ, a mʋ yuo Hɛbʋrɔŋ.

english_verse: They captured the town and the nearby villages, then killed everyone, including the king. They destroyed Hebron in the same way they had destroyed Eglon.
translation_verse: Ba fa yuo dii taŋ-la arɩ ʋ kuoro arɩ ʋ tabiisiŋ kala nɛ, a kpʋ nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ ba lɛ, nɩbala ma bɩ ka arɩ ba sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Ɛgɩlɔŋ lɛ. Ba chaasa chei taŋ-la kala nɛ, a kpʋ nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Joshua and the Israelite army turned and attacked Debir.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kala mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ a mʋ Debi a yuou.

english_verse: They captured the town, and its nearby villages. Then they destroyed Debir and killed its king, together with everyone else, just as they had done with Hebron and Libnah.
translation_verse: Ba fa yuo a dii taŋ-la arɩ ʋ kuoro arɩ ʋ tabiisiŋ kala nɛ, a kpʋ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, a chaasa chei ba kala, nɩbala ma bɩ ka. Wɩɩ-la ba fa sɩ joŋo ŋaa Libina arɩ ʋ kuoro arɩ Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ tɩtɩa nɛ ba joŋo ŋaa Debi arɩ ʋ kuoro lɛ.

english_verse: Joshua captured towns everywhere in the land: In the central hill country and the foothills to the west, in the Southern Desert and the region that slopes down toward the Dead Sea. Whenever he captured a town, he would kill the king and everyone else, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded.
translation_verse: Josua fa yuo dii tintee-la kala nɛ: Tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga, Nɛgɛf tinteeŋ kala, dundollu-la kala sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ peelee lere-la sɩ chullo tutuu arɩ ba kuoroo kala. Ʋ fa bɩ ba kʋŋkala leŋe. Kʋŋ na-kala sɩɩ wiesu, ʋ chei ba kala nɛ arɩ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa fa sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Joshua wiped out towns from Kadesh-Barnea to Gaza, everywhere in the region of Goshen, and as far north as Gibeon.
translation_verse: Josua fa yuo dii Kadɛs Banɩa nɛ, a to ŋɩɩ mʋ Gaza arɩ tasɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ Goseŋ lɛ a mʋ yi Gibioŋ.

english_verse: King Jabin of Hazor heard about Joshua's victories, so he sent messages to many nearby kings and asked them to join him in fighting Israel. He sent these messages to King Jobab of Madon, the kings of Shimron and Achshaph,
translation_verse: Hazɔ kuoro Jabɩŋ fa sɩ nɩa dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa yuo didii tasɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ tɩma pɩ Madɔŋ kuoro Jobab, a tɩma pɩ Sɩmɩrɔŋ kuoro arɩ Akɩsaf kuoro,

english_verse: the kings in the northern hill country and in the Jordan River valley south of Lake Galilee, and the kings in the foothills and in Naphath-Dor to the west.
translation_verse: arɩ kuorie-la kala sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ tasɩ-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ, a hɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Araba, Galilii mʋgʋ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, arɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ a kpagɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nafɔf Dɔɔ a hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: He sent messages to the Canaanite kings in the east and the west, to the Amorite, Hittite, Perizzite, and Jebusite kings in the hill country, and to the Hivite kings in the region of Mizpah, near the foot of Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bɩra bʋla pɩ Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ arɩ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa, Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa arɩ Jebus tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ, arɩ Hivi tɩmma-la sɩ hɔŋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛmɔŋ bʋbʋɔŋ, a hɛ Mɩzɩpa tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua: Don't let them frighten you! I'll help you defeat them, and by this time tomorrow they will be dead. When you attack, the first thing you have to do is to cripple their horses. Then after the battle is over, burn their chariots.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pɩ Josua, “Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa chie bʋa deeŋ lɛ mɩ jaŋ jomba hɛ Iziral laalɩyuoroo nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ma kpʋba. Ŋ jaŋ gbɛrɩgɛ ba janɩŋ kala aŋ nyɩgɛ ba janɩŋ torukoba.”

english_verse: Joshua and his army made a surprise attack against the enemy camp at Merom Pond
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala guu mʋ a yuoba Mɛrɔm fuo-bie-la leriŋ,

english_verse: Up to this time, the king of Hazor had controlled the kingdoms that had joined together to attack Israel, so Joshua led his army back and captured Hazor. They killed its king
translation_verse: Josua fa mɩɩrɛ bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ a mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hazɔ a yuo dii ʋ dɩ ʋ kuoro kala.

english_verse: and everyone else, then they set the town on fire.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ, ba kala nɛ ba fa kpʋ. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ ka, aŋ nyɩgɛ Hazɔ kala.

english_verse: Joshua and his army took control of the northern and southern hill country, the foothills to the west, the Southern Desert, the whole region of Goshen, and the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Josua fa yuo a laa tinteeŋ deeŋ kala nɛ, tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga, Nɛgɛf, Goseŋ tinteeŋ kala, dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, Araba arɩ Iziral peelee arɩ ba dundolluŋ kala,

english_verse: The Lord had told Moses that he wanted the towns in this region destroyed and their people killed without mercy. That's why the Lord made the people in the towns stubborn and determined to fight Israel. The only town that signed a peace treaty with Israel was the Hivite town of Gibeon. The Israelite army captured the rest of the towns in battle.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nɛ fa ŋaa tasɩ-la kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a yuyuo Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ to ŋɩɩ lɛ a chaasa cheiba, a kpʋ ba kala aŋ sɩ́ ba nenige fá, arɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pɩ Mosis.

english_verse: During this same time, Joshua and his army killed the Anakim from the northern and southern hill country. They also destroyed the towns where the Anakim had lived, including Hebron, Debir, and Anab.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ Josua fa bɩra mʋ a chei Anakɩ tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ, a chɩŋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ, Dɛbɩ arɩ Anab, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ Juda tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga, arɩ Iziral tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga. Josua fa chei lere-la arɩ tasɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: There were not any Anakim left in the regions where the Israelites lived, although there were still some in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.
translation_verse: Anakɩ doho nʋʋkala fa bɩra tuo tinteeŋ lɛ, see tasɩŋ deemba: Gaza, Gaf arɩ Asɩdɔd dʋndʋŋa lɛ nɛ Anakɩ nɩaa mʋa ka.

english_verse: That's how Joshua captured the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses, and Joshua divided it up among the tribes. Finally, there was peace in the land.
translation_verse: Josua laa tintee-la kala nɛ, arɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ, a kaa kpaa a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho doho-la ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tintee-la nɩaa saa wiesi laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he and the people of Israel had defeated two kings east of the Jordan River. These kings had ruled the region from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, including the eastern side of the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Kuorie-la Mosis arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo fa sɩ yuo a dii aŋ laa ba tinteeŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, a chɩŋ Anɔŋ fuonaa-la lɛ a kaa mʋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛmɔŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, a pɛ Araba wɩɩpɔsʋŋ kala nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: The first king that Moses and the Israelites defeated was an Amorite, King Sihon of Heshbon. The southern border of his kingdom ran down the middle of the Arnon River gorge, taking in the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the gorge. The Jabbok River separated Sihon's kingdom from the Ammonites on the east. Then the Jabbok turned west and became his northern border, so his kingdom included the southern half of the region of Gilead.
translation_verse: Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Sɩhɔŋ sɩ hɛ Hɛsɩbɔŋ lɛ nɛ faa beŋ tintee-la kala sɩ chɩŋ Arʋa sɩ hɛ Anɔŋ fuonaa-la niiŋ, a kaa mʋ fuonaa-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Jabɔk fuo-la. Ba dɩ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa bʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ a kɛŋ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ pɛ.

english_verse: Sihon also controlled the eastern side of the Jordan River valley from Lake Galilee south to Beth-Jeshimoth and the Dead Sea. In addition to these regions, he ruled the town called Slopes of Mount Pisgah and the land south of there at the foot of the hill.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ haa beŋ Araba wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ma, a chɩŋ Galilii mʋga-la lɛ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Araba mʋga-la a pɛ Bɛŋ Jɛsɩmɔf lɛ, arɩ ŋ sɩɩ mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, Pɩsɩga dundolluŋ lere-la sɩ chulloo tuu.

english_verse: Next, Moses and the Israelites defeated King Og of Bashan, who lived in the town of Ashtaroth part of each year and in Edrei the rest of the year. Og was one of the last of the Rephaim.
translation_verse: Ba yuo dii Basaŋ kuoro Ɔgɩ ma nɛ, ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa Refem tɩmma-la dɔŋɔ sɩ ka, ʋ fa hɔŋ Asɩtarɔf arɩ Ɛdɩrɛ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: His kingdom stretched north to Mount Hermon, east to the town of Salecah, and included the land of Bashan as far west as the borders of the kingdoms of Geshur and Maacah. He also ruled the northern half of Gilead.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ faa beŋ Hɛmɔŋ peel-la, Salɛka arɩ Basaŋ tinteeŋ kala a kaa mʋ yi Gesu tɩŋŋaa arɩ Maaka tinteeŋ bʋa, a saa pɛ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a kaa mʋ yi Hɛsɩbɔŋ kuoro Sɩhɔŋ tinteeŋ bʋa.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, had led the people of Israel in defeating Sihon and Og. Then Moses gave their land to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh.
translation_verse: Mosis, La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnnʋ-la, arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo nɛ fa yuo dii kuoroo deemba balɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis, La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnna joŋ ba tinteeŋ a pɩ Rubiŋ doho nɩaa, Gad doho nɩaa arɩ Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.

english_verse: Many years later, the Lord told Joshua: Now you are very old, but there is still a lot of land that Israel has not yet taken.
translation_verse: Josua fa hɩɛsa nɛ woruŋ, ka La TƖƖNA bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ hɩɛsa ma nɛ, ama tinteeŋ ha yʋga ŋ sɩ maga ŋ yuo a laa.

english_verse: Moses had already given land east of the Jordan River to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Rubiŋ doho nɩaa, Gad doho nɩaa arɩ Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la kʋkaanaa, La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnna Mosis fa laa sɩpaaŋ a joŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tintee-la nɛ pɩba, ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.

english_verse: This region stretched north from the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, and included the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley. It covered the flatlands of Medeba north of Dibon,
translation_verse: Ba tinteeŋ bʋa nɛ, a chɩŋ Arʋa sɩ hɛ Anɔf fuonaa-la niiŋ, a kɛŋ taŋ-la sɩ hɛ fuonaa-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, a pɛ Mediba tintee-taalɩsɩ-la kala lɛ a mʋ yi Dɩbɔŋ,

english_verse: and took in the towns that had belonged to Sihon, the Amorite king of Heshbon. Some of these towns were as far east as the Ammonite border.
translation_verse: arɩ tasɩ-la kala Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Sɩhɔŋ fa sɩ hɛ Hɛsɩbɔŋ lɛ sɩɩ beŋ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ kaa mʋ yi ʋ dɩ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ bʋa,

english_verse: Geshur and Maacah were part of this region, and so was the whole territory that King Og had ruled, that is, Gilead, Mount Hermon, and all of Bashan as far east as Salecah. Og had lived in Ashtaroth part of each year, and he had lived in Edrei the rest of the year. Og had been one of the last of the Rephaim, but Moses had defeated Sihon and Og and their people and had forced them to leave their land.
translation_verse: a kɛŋ Basaŋ kuoro Ɔgɩ fa sɩɩ beŋ tintee-la pɛ. Ɔgɩ nɛ fa ŋaa Refem tɩmma-la dɔŋɔ sɩ ka. Ʋ fa hɔŋ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩtarɔf arɩ Ɛdɩrɛ lɛ nɛ. Mosis nɛ fa yuo dii nɩalɩŋ, aŋ laa ba tintee-la.

english_verse: However, the Israelites did not force the people of Geshur and Maacah to leave, and they still live there among the Israelites. Why Moses Did Not Give Land to the Levi Tribe
translation_verse: Ama Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa bɩ Gesu arɩ Maaka tɩŋŋaa-na kire, arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala ba-na ha hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord God of Israel had told them, “Instead of land, you will receive the sacrifices offered at my altar.” The Land Moses Gave to the Reuben Tribe
translation_verse: Mosis fa bɩ tintee kala kpaa pɩ Levi doho nɩaa-na, bɛɛ wɩaa ba kpaalɩŋ nɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ yie nyɩgɛ a pɩpɩ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩba.

english_verse: Moses gave land to each of the clans in the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: Tintee-la Mosis fa sɩ joŋo pɩ Rubiŋ doho nɩaa nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa, ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: Their land started in the south at the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, took in the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley, and went as far north as the flatlands around Medeba.
translation_verse: Ba tinteeŋ bʋa nɛ, a chɩŋ Arʋa sɩ hɛ Anɔŋ fuonaa-la niiŋ, a bɩra chɩŋ taŋ-la sɩ hɛ fuonaa-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, arɩ tintee-taalɩsɩ-la kala ŋɩɩ a kaa mʋ yi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediba,

english_verse: The Amorite King Sihon had lived in Heshbon and had ruled the towns in the flatlands. Now Heshbon belonged to Reuben, and so did the following towns in the flatlands: Dibon, Bamoth-Baal, Beth-Baal-Meon, Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath, Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-Shahar on the hill in the valley, Beth-Peor, Slopes of Mount Pisgah, and Beth-Jeshimoth. Moses defeated Sihon and killed him and the Midianite chiefs who ruled parts of his kingdom for him. Their names were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba.
translation_verse: a pɛ tasɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ tintee-taalɩsɩ-la lɛ, arɩ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Sɩhɔŋ sɩ hɔŋ Hɛsɩbɔŋ lɛ tinteeŋ kala. Mosis nɛ fa yuo dii ʋ dɩ Midiaŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa deemba kala: Ɛvɩ, Rɛkɛm, Zuu, Huu arɩ Reba. Ba kala fa ŋaa sɩpaalaaraa nɛ a pɛ kuoro Sɩhɔŋ lɛ a bibeŋ tintee-la.

english_verse: The Israelites also killed Balaam the son of Beor, who had been a fortuneteller.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kpʋa laalɩŋ lɛ, ba kpʋ Bioo nanʋala Balam ma nɛ, ʋ fa ŋaa vʋgʋrʋ nɛ.

english_verse: This region with its towns and villages was the land for the Reuben tribe, and the Jordan River was its western border. The Land Moses Gave to the Gad Tribe
translation_verse: Rubiŋ doho nɩaa tinteeŋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa nɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la niiŋ. Tabalaa arɩ tabiisiŋ deemba kala nɛ ba joŋo pɩ Rubiŋ doho nɩaa nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa, ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.

english_verse: Moses also gave land to each of the clans in the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: Tintee-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ma Mosis fa sɩ joŋo pɩ Gad doho nɩaa nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa, ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: It included the town of Jazer, and in the Gilead region their territory took in the land and towns as far east as the town of Aroer just west of Rabbah. This was about half of the land that had once belonged to the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Ba tintee-la bʋa nɛ a chɩŋ Jaza tinteeŋ arɩ tasɩ-la sɩ hɛ Gɩlɩad lɛ arɩ Amɔŋ tinteeŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Arʋa sɩ hɛ Raba wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ,

english_verse: The land given to Gad stretched from Heshbon in the south to Ramath-Mizpeh and Betonim in the north, and even further north to Mahanaim and Lidebor.
translation_verse: a bɩra chɩŋ Hɛsɩbɔŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ Ramaf-Mɩzɩpa arɩ Bɛtɔnɩŋ, a bɩra lɩɩ Mahanem lɛ a kaa mʋ yi Dɛbɩ tinteeŋ,

english_verse: Gad also received the eastern half of the Jordan River valley, which had been ruled by King Sihon of Heshbon. This territory stretched as far north as Lake Galilee, and included the towns of Beth-Haram, Beth-Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon.
translation_verse: a bɩra chɩŋ Jɔdaŋ fuonaa-la lɛ, a kɛŋ Bɛf Haram, Bɛf Nɩmɩra, Sʋkɔf arɩ Zafɔŋ, a pɛ Hɛsɩbɔŋ kuoro Sɩhɔŋ tintee-kaanɩŋ lɛ. Ba tintee-la bʋa pɩŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nɛ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Galilii mʋgʋ-bal-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: These regions with their towns and villages were given to the Gad tribe. The Land Moses Gave to Half the Manasseh Tribe
translation_verse: Tabala-la arɩ tabiisiŋ deemba kala nɛ ba joŋo pɩ Gad doho nɩaa nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa, ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.

english_verse: Moses gave land east of the Jordan River to half of the clans from the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Tintee-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ma Mosis ha sɩ joŋo pɩ Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa, ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: That was how Moses divided up the Moab Plains to the east of Jericho on the other side of the Jordan River, so these two and a half tribes would have land of their own.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ Mosis sɩ kɛŋ Jeriko arɩ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ tinteeŋ kpaa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ ʋ hɛ Mʋab tintee-taala-la lɛ.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord had promised that he would always provide for them.
translation_verse: Mosis bɩ tintee kala kpaa a pɩ Levi doho nɩaa ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ. Levi doho nɩaa kpaalɩŋ nɛ ŋaa kɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩba.

english_verse: One day while the Israelites were still camped at Gilgal, Caleb the son of Jephunneh went to talk with Joshua. Caleb belonged to the Kenaz clan, and many other people from the Judah tribe went with Caleb. He told Joshua: You know that back in Kadesh-Barnea the Lord talked to his prophet Moses about you and me.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Juda doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sii mʋ Josua teeŋ Gɩlɩgal lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jefuni nanʋala Kalɩb, Keni tɩɩna-la pɩɛsɛ Josua, “Ŋ liise yi wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna Mosis a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ dɩ ŋ lɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kadɛs Banɩa lɛɛ?

english_verse: The other spies said things that made our people afraid, but I completely trusted the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ dɩ mɩ naambiiri-la sɩ mʋa, ba mɩɩra kɔ a joŋ fawʋllʋŋ a hɛ nɩalɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na to mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ.

english_verse: The same day I came back, Moses told me, “Since you were faithful to the Lord God, I promise that the places where you went as a spy will belong to you and your descendants forever.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis hɛ niiŋ a bʋl tapʋlɩɩ-la, arɩ tintee-la mɩ sɩ joŋ mɩ naaŋ a nʋɔsɛ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ dɩ mɩ biiriŋ kʋŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ to mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ.

english_verse: I'm just as strong today as I was then, and I can still fight as well in battle.
translation_verse: Mɩ ha dolie nɛ a nagɛ bʋa-la lɛ Mosis fa sɩ tɩmmɛ. Mɩ ha kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ mɩ bumbuŋ-la nɛ, mɩ ha jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ.

english_verse: So I'm asking you for the hill country that the Lord promised me that day. You were there. You heard the other spies talk about that part of the hill country and the large, walled towns where the Anakim live. But maybe the Lord will help me take their land, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, joŋ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga a pɩmɛ arɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pɩmɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la. Ŋ ma tɩtɩa nɩɩ ŋɩɩ Anakɩ tɩŋŋaa nɩwaayiile-la sɩ hɛ lee-la sɩ dolie nɛ. Ba tasɩ-la fa ŋaa tabalaa nɛ, ba saa kɛrɛ a golli ba kala. Ama dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ pɛ mɩ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ yuo kiriba arɩ ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Joshua prayed that God would help Caleb, then he gave Hebron to Caleb and his descendants.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua sʋl Wɩa a pɩ Jefuni nanʋala Kalɩb, aŋ joŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛbʋrɔŋ a pʋ, ʋ ŋaa ʋ kʋŋ.

english_verse: And Hebron still belongs to Caleb's descendants, because he was faithful to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Hɛbʋrɔŋ ha ŋaa Jefuni nanʋala Kalɩb sɩ ŋaa Keni tɩɩna-la kʋŋ nɛ, arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ to La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa arɩ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ.

english_verse: Judah's southern border started at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Ba tintee-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa-la chɩŋ mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mʋgʋ-sʋʋŋ niiŋ nɛ,

english_verse: As it went west from there, it ran south of Scorpion Pass to Zin, and then came up from the south to Kadesh-Barnea. It continued past Hezron up to Addar, turned toward Karka,
translation_verse: a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ jɩl Akɩrabɩm dundolo a chullo tuu a mʋ yi Zɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Kadɛs Baanɩa wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a bɩra to ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi Hɛzɩrɔŋ a joŋo jɩl tabala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ada a gʋrɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi Kaka.

english_verse: and ran along to Azmon. After that, it followed the Egyptian Gorge and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This was also Israel's southern border.
translation_verse: Tintee-la bɩra chɩŋ nɩmɛ nɛ a mʋ yi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Azɩmɔŋ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ to fuonaa-la sɩ hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ bʋa a kaa mʋ yi mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediterenia. Nɩmɛ nɛ ba tinteeŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Judah's eastern border ran the full length of the Dead Sea. The northern border started at the northern end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Ba wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ma bʋa nɛ, a chɩŋ Mʋgʋ-sʋʋ-la lɛ a kaa mʋ yi Jɔdaŋ fuo-la niiŋ. Ba wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa ma nɛ: a chɩŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la niiŋ,

english_verse: From there it went west up to Beth-Hoglah, continued north of Beth-Arabah, and went up to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: a to ŋɩɩ a mʋ Bɛf Hogila a kaa mʋ yi Bɛf Araba wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Rubiŋ nanʋala Bɔhaŋ tabɩɩŋ.

english_verse: From there, it went to Trouble Valley and Debir, then turned north and went to Gilgal, which is on the north side of the valley across from Adummim Pass. It continued on to Enshemesh, Enrogel,
translation_verse: Tintee-la bʋa nɛ ha jɩla to Akɔ fuonaaŋ a lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ yi Dɛbɩ aŋ bɩra gɛbɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi Gɩlɩgal, a chaasɛ Adumim wombii-la sɩ hɛ peelee pɛgɛ a joŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ fuonaa-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Ʋ ha pɩŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ to Ɛŋ-Sɛmɛs lɩɩ-bulo-la leriŋ, a to ŋɩɩ a kʋ lɩɩ Ɛŋ-Rɔgɛl.

english_verse: and up through Hinnom Valley on the land sloping south from Jerusalem. The city of Jerusalem itself belonged to the Jebusites. Next, the border went up to the top of the mountain on the west side of Hinnom Valley and at the north end of Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: Tintee-la bʋa nɛ ha jɩla to Bɛŋ Hɩnɔm fuonaaŋ a joŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ to Jebus tɩŋŋaa tabal-la a joŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ jɩl dundolo nyuŋ sɩ hɛ Hɩnɔm fuonaa-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a bɩra hɛ Refem fuonaaŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: At the top of the mountain it turned and went to Nephtoah Spring and then to the ruins on Mount Ephron. From there, it went to Baalah, which is now called Kiriath-Jearim.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋa bɩra chɩŋ dundolo-la nyuŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ, aŋ tʋʋlɛ Nɛfɩtʋa lɩɩ-bulo-la ŋɩɩ a kʋ lɩɩ to tasɩ-la sɩ hɛ peel-la ba sɩ yɩrɛ Ɛfʋrɔŋ a to ŋɩɩ a tuu, a tʋʋlɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baala .

english_verse: From Baalah the northern border curved west to Mount Seir and then ran along the northern ridge of Mount Jearim, where Chesalon is located. Then it went down to Beth-Shemesh and over to Timnah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra gʋrɛ, a tʋʋlɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a lɩɩ Baala a mʋ Sɛɛ peel-la, a joŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ to peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jɩarɩm wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ lee-la sɩ chullo aa tuu , a joŋ ŋɩɩ tʋʋ to Bɛf Sɛmɛs a kiele mʋ Tɩmɩna.

english_verse: It continued along to the hillside north of Ekron, curved around to Shikkeron, and then went to Mount Baalah. After going to Jabneel, the border finally ended at the Mediterranean Sea,
translation_verse: Tintee-la bʋa bɩra to Ɛkʋrɔŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa lee-la sɩ chulloo tuu nɛ, aŋ bɩra gɛbɛ to Sɩkɛrɔŋ, a joŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ to peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baala a mʋ yi Jabɩnɛɛl. Tintee-la bʋa mʋ dɛrɛ Mediterenia mʋgʋ-bal-la lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Next, Caleb started a war with the town of Debir, which at that time was called Kiriath-Sepher.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ lɩɩ a mʋ yuo a kiri nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Dɛbɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Joshua gave Caleb some land among the people of Judah, as God had told him to do. Caleb's share was Hebron, which at that time was known as Arba's Town, because Arba was the famous ancestor of the Anakim.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Josua ŋɩɩ, ʋ fa joŋ Juda tinteeŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a pɩ Jefuni nanʋala Kalɩb. Hɛbʋrɔŋ nɛ ʋ fa joŋo pʋ . Aaba nɛ fa ŋaa nɩwaayiile-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Anakɩ naabalɩma.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah, Zanoah, En-Gannim, Tappuah, Enam, Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah, Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Kalɩb kiri Anakɩ nyɩŋ-nɩaa deemba batori arɩ ba dɩa nɩaa Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ: Sɛsaɩ, Ahɩmaŋ arɩ Talɩmaɩ.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdalgad, Dilan, Mizpeh, Joktheel, Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon, Cabbon, Lahmas, Chitlish, Gederoth, Beth-Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Kalɩb bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ tolo Akɩsa a pɩ baal-la sɩ jaŋ yuo dii Kɩrɩaf Sɛfa a kɛsɛ ʋ nɩaa dɩ ʋ jaa.”

english_verse: Caleb's nephew Othniel captured Kiriath-Sepher, and Caleb let him marry Achsah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Kalɩb naambie Ofiniel sɩ ŋaa Kɛnas nanʋala yuo dii taŋ-la. Kalɩb fa joŋ ʋ tolo-la a pʋ ʋ jaa.

english_verse: Right after the wedding, Achsah started telling Othniel that he ought to ask her father for a field. She went to see her father, and while she was getting down from her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What's bothering you?”
translation_verse: Ba fa sɩ jaa dɔŋɔ dɛrɛ, ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ Ofiniel hɛ ʋ haala dɩ ʋ pɩɛsɛ ʋ nyɩmma Kalɩb a laa tinteeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tolo-la sii jɩl kakumo mʋ dɩ ʋ na ʋ nyɩmma. Ʋ sɩ mʋa a tuu ʋ kakumo nyuŋ, Kalɩb pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ chɩchɛ?”

english_verse: She answered, “I need your help. The land you gave me is in the Southern Desert, so I really need some spring-fed ponds for a water supply.” Caleb gave her a couple of small ponds, named Higher Pond and Lower Pond. Towns in Judah's Land
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tolo-la bʋl, “Chaasa pɛ mɩ lɛ. Ŋ laa sɩpaaŋ pɩmɛ tinteeŋ nɛ Nɛgɛf lɛ, ka lɩɩŋ tuo nɩmɛ. Pɩmɛ lee-la sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩ-bulo ma.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Kalɩb joŋ lɩɩ-bulo-la sɩ hɛ taŋ-la nyuŋ arɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kala a pʋ.

english_verse: The following is a list of the towns in each region given to the Judah clans:
translation_verse: Juda doho nɩaa nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa sɩ laa tintee-la ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The first region was located in the Southern Desert along the border with Edom, and it had the following
translation_verse: Lɛbaɔf, Sɩlɩhɩm, Aɩŋ arɩ Rɩmɔŋ. Ba tabalaa ŋaa mara arɩ nibi nɛ, a pɛ ba tabiisiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The second region was located in the northern part of the lower foothills, and it had the following
translation_verse: Saarem, Aditem, arɩ Gɛdɛra . Ba ma tabalaa ŋaa fii arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ, a pɛ ba tabiisiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The third region was located in the southern part of the lower foothills, and it had the following
translation_verse: Gɛdɛrɔf, Bɛf Dagɔŋ, Naama arɩ Makɛda. Ba ma tabalaa ŋaa fii arɩ balɩdʋ nɛ arɩ ba tabiisiŋ.

english_verse: The fifth region was located along the Mediterranean seacoast, and it had the following towns with their surrounding settlements and villages: Ekron and the towns between there and the coast, Ashdod and the larger towns nearby, Gaza, the towns from Gaza to the Egyptian Gorge, and the towns along the coast of the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Asɩdɔd arɩ ʋ tabalaa arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ gollu, Gaza arɩ ʋ tabalaa arɩ ʋ tabiisi-la sɩ gollu, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ fuo-bie-la sɩ hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ bʋa arɩ mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediterenia niiŋ.

english_verse: The eleventh region was located in the northern part of Judah's hill country, and it had the following two towns with their surrounding villages: Rabbah, and Kiriath-Baal, which is also called Kiriath-Jearim.
translation_verse: Ba tasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ: Kɩrɩaf Baal arɩ Raba. Ba tabalaa ŋaa balɩa nɛ a pɛ ba tabiisiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The twelfth region was located in the desert along the Dead Sea, and it had the following six towns with their surrounding villages: Beth-Arabah, Middin, Secacah, Nibshan, Salt Town, and En-Gedi. The Jebusites
translation_verse: Nɩbɩsaŋ arɩ tabal-la sɩ kɛŋ yɩsɩŋ arɩ Ɛŋ-Gedi. Ba tabalaa ŋaa balɩdʋ nɛ, a pɛ ba tabiisiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Jebusites lived in Jerusalem, and the people of the Judah tribe could not capture the city and get rid of them. That's why Jebusites still live in Jerusalem along with the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Juda doho nɩaa bɩ wuo kiri Jebus tɩmma-la sɩ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. A kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala Jebus tɩmma-la ha hɛ Juda nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The following is a description of the land that was divided among the clans of the Ephraim tribe. Their southern border started at Ataroth-Addar and went west to Upper Beth-Horon
translation_verse: Efirem doho nɩaa nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa fa sɩ laa tinteeŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ba tinteeŋ bʋa nɛ a chɩŋ Atarɔf Ada wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kaa jɩl Bɛf Hɔrɔŋ sɛmɛ-la sɩ hɛ nyuŋ,

english_verse: Ephraim also had some towns and villages that were inside Manasseh's tribal land.
translation_verse: Tabala-la arɩ tabiisi-la ba fa sɩ lɩɩsa Manasɛ tinteeŋ lɛ a pɩ Efirem doho nɩaa ma pɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Ephraim could not force the Canaanites out of Gezer, so there are still some Canaanites who live there among the Israelites. But now these Canaanites have to work as slaves for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ama ba bɩ Kɛnaŋ tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Gɛza lɛ kire, a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa ha hɛ Efirem nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ama ba fʋgɛba hɛ nɛ ba tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa pɩba.

english_verse: The land of the Manasseh tribe went from its northern border with the Asher tribe south to Michmethath, which is to the east of Shechem. The southern border started there, but curved even farther south to include the people who lived around Tappuah Spring.
translation_verse: Manasɛ tinteeŋ bʋa chɩŋ Asa lɛ nɛ, a kaa mʋ yi Mɩkɩmɛtaf sɩ hɛ Sɛkɛm wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a gɛbɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, a mʋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɔŋ Ɛŋ-Tapʋa tinteeŋ a pɛ.

english_verse: The town of Tappuah was on Manasseh's border with Ephraim. Although the land around Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, the town itself belonged to Ephraim.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ Manasɛ nɛ tɩɩ Tapʋa tinteeŋ, ama Tapʋa taŋ-la tɩtɩa sɩ hɛ Manasɛ tinteeŋ bʋa lɛ, Efirem tɩŋŋaa nɛ tɩɩʋ.

english_verse: Manasseh was supposed to have the following towns with their surrounding villages inside the borders of Issachar's and Asher's tribal lands: Beth-Shan, Ibleam, Endor, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, which is also called Naphath.
translation_verse: Ɩsaka arɩ Asa tinteyee lɛ, Manasɛ nɛ ha tɩɩ Bɛf Saŋ, Ibɩlɩam arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Doo lɛ, a kɛŋ Ɛndɔ, Taanak arɩ Megido arɩ tasɩ-la kala sɩ golliba chu.

english_verse: But the people of Manasseh could not capture these towns, so the Canaanites kept on living in them.
translation_verse: Manasɛ doho nɩalɩŋ fa bɩ wuo yuo kiri nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ tasɩ-la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Kɛnaŋ tɩmma-la chaasa kɛŋ ba tʋɔŋ nɛ dɩ ba hɔŋ lee-la.

english_verse: When the Israelites grew stronger, they made the Canaanites in these towns work as their slaves, though they never did force them to leave. Joseph's Descendants Ask for More Land
translation_verse: Ama Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ kʋ kɛŋ doluŋ a yʋgɛ, ba fʋgɛ Kɛnaŋ tɩmma-la hɛ nɛ ba tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a pɩpɩba, ama ba bɩ ba kala kiri ba tasɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: One day the Joseph tribes came to Joshua and asked, “Why didn't you give us more land? The Lord has always been kind to us, and we have too many people for this small region.”
translation_verse: Josɛf doho nɩalɩŋ pɩɛsɛ Josua, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ joŋ tinteeŋ sɛmɛ kʋbala dʋndʋŋ a pɩla, la kpaalɩŋ ŋaa kʋbala? La TƖƖNA pɛ la lɛ nɛ woruŋ la pʋŋ a yʋgɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua replied, “If there's not enough room for you in the hill country of Ephraim, then go into the forest that belonged to the Perizzites and the Rephaim. Clear out the trees and make more room for yourselves there.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua bʋl, “Dɩ ma nɩaa nɛ yʋga a kɩɩ Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga, ŋɩɩ-na ma jaŋ wuo sii a mʋ duuŋ tʋɔŋ, a kpʋ leriŋ a pɩ ma tɩtɩa Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa arɩ Refem tɩmma-la tinteeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: “Even if we do that,” they answered, “there still won't be enough land for us in the hill country. And we can't move down into Jezreel Valley, because the Canaanites who live in Beth-Shan and in other parts of the valley have iron chariots.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf doho nɩalɩŋ ma bʋl, “Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga bɩ yʋgɛ a pɩla, Kɛnaŋ tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ tintee-taalɩsɩ-la lɛ, ba kɛŋ hɔɔŋ janɩŋ torukoba nɛ, ba dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Bɛf Saŋ lɛ arɩ tasɩ-la kala sɩ golliba a chu arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jɛzɩrɛl fuonaa-la lɛ kala.”

english_verse: “Your tribes do have a lot of people,” Joshua admitted. “I'll give you more land. Your tribes are powerful,
translation_verse: Josua ma bɩra bʋla pɩ Josɛf doho nɩalɩŋ Efirem arɩ Manasɛ, “Tɛŋɛ, ma yʋga nɛ woruŋ, a kɛŋ doluŋ ma. Ma bɩ kpaalɩŋ kʋbala wuo kɛŋ,

english_verse: so you can have the rest of the hill country, but it's a forest, and you'll have to cut down the trees and clear the land. You can also have Jezreel Valley. Even though the Canaanites there are strong and have iron chariots, you can force them to leave the valley.”
translation_verse: ama ma jaŋ tɩɩ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga duu-la kala ma a pɛ. Má kpʋ duu-la kala a mʋ yi ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ. Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa magɩla kɛŋ hɔɔŋ janɩŋ torukoba nɛ a kɛŋ doluŋ ma, ama ma jaŋ wuo kiriba ta dɩ ba lɩɩ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: After Israel had captured the land, they met at Shiloh and set up the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ yuo laa tintee-la, ba kala kʋ hilimi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩlɔ lɛ, a pɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: There were still seven tribes without any land,
translation_verse: Ama Iziral tɩmma-la doho doho balɩpɛ nɛ fa ha ka a bɩ ba tinteeŋ kpaalɩŋ laa.

english_verse: Just before the men left camp, Joshua repeated their orders: “Explore the land and write a description of it. Then come back to Shiloh, and I will find out from the Lord how to divide the land.”
translation_verse: Baala-la sɩ lɩa dɩ ba mʋ a beŋ tintee-la a na ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ kpaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua bʋl ŋ-la a pɩba, “Má mʋ a beŋ tintee-la a ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ naga a kaa mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ tɔnsɛ daha Sɩlɔ lɛ a pɩma La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.”

english_verse: The men left and went across the land, dividing it into seven regions. They wrote down a description of each region, town by town, and returned to Joshua at the camp at Shiloh.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baala-la mʋ a beŋ tintee-la a ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ kpaa leree balɩpɛ a hɛ teniŋ lɛ a ŋmʋnsɛ tasɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mɩɩra kɔ Josua teeŋ Sɩlɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Joshua found out from the Lord how to divide the land, and he told the tribes what the Lord had decided. Benjamin's Land
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua tɔnsɛ Sɩlɔ lɛ a pɩba La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, a kɛŋ tintee-la a kpaa pɩ Iziral tɩmma-la doho doho. Kpaal-la Bɛnjamɩŋ sɩ laa

english_verse: Benjamin was the first tribe chosen to receive land. The region for its clans lay between the Judah tribe on the south and the Joseph tribes on the north.
translation_verse: Ba fa sɩ tɔnsɔ ŋɩɩ, Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ a joŋ ba kpaalɩŋ. Ba tinteeŋ nɛ hɛ Juda doho nɩaa arɩ Josɛf doho nɩaa tinteyee pɛgɛ:

english_verse: Benjamin's northern border started at the Jordan River and went up the ridge north of Jericho, then on west into the hill country as far as the Beth-Aven Desert.
translation_verse: Ba tinteeŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa nɛ a chɩŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la lɛ a joŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ Jeriko wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ tintee-la sɩ chulloo tuu, a tʋʋlɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a mʋ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga, a kʋ lɩɩ Bɛf Avɛŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth, Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah, Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah, Zelah, Haeleph, Gibeah, Kiriath-Jearim, and Jerusalem, which is also called Jebusite Town. These regions are the tribal lands of Benjamin.
translation_verse: A lɩɩ Bɛf Horoŋ peel-la lɛ a tʋʋlɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Bʋa-la nɛ bɩra mɩɩra gʋrɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ a to wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a to ŋɩɩ kʋ lɩɩ Kɩrɩaf Baal , sɩ ŋaa Juda nɩaa taŋ. Ʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Benjamin's southern border started at the edge of Kiriath-Jearim and went east to the ruins and on to Nephtoah Spring.
translation_verse: Ʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa ma nɛ, a chɩŋ Kɩrɩaf Jɩarɩm sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ, a to ŋɩɩ a kʋ lɩɩ Nɛfɩtʋa lɩɩ-bulo-la.

english_verse: From there it went to the bottom of the hill at the northern end of Rephaim Valley. The other side of this hill faces Hinnom Valley, which is on the land that slopes south from Jerusalem. The border went down through Hinnom Valley until it reached Enrogel.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la bɩra joŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ a tuu peel taala-la, a tʋʋlɛ Bɛŋ Hɩnɔm fuonaa-la a to Rafaɩ tɩŋŋaa fuonaaŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ. Ʋ nɛ ha to ŋɩɩ a tuu Hɩnɔm fuonaa-la, a joŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ to Jebus tɩŋŋaa taŋ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tintee-la sɩ chulloo tuu a joŋo tuu taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛŋ-Rogɛl.

english_verse: At Enrogel the border curved north and went to Enshemesh and on east to Geliloth, which is across the valley from Adummim Pass. Then it went down to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ mɩɩra gʋrɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a joŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ Ɛŋ-Sɛmɛs, a ha to ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Gɛlɩlɔf a tʋʋlɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Adumim wombii-la sɩ hɛ peelee pɛgɛ, a to ŋɩɩ mʋ tuu Rubiŋ nanʋala Bohaŋ tabɩɩŋ.

english_verse: The border ran along the hillside north of Beth-Arabah, then down into the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋa nɛ ha to ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi Bɛf Araba lee-la sɩ chulloo tuu a hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ, a joŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ tuu Araba fuonaaŋ.

english_verse: Inside the valley it went south as far as the northern hillside of Beth-Hoglah. The last section of the border went from there to the northern end of the Dead Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra to ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi Bɛf Hogila wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ tintee-la sɩ chulloo tuu, a to ŋɩɩ kʋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa tintee-la sɩ golibo jʋʋ Mʋgʋ-sʋʋŋ a hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la niiŋ. Tintee-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The Jordan River itself was Benjamin's eastern border. These were the borders of Benjamin's tribal land, where the clans of Benjamin lived.
translation_verse: Jɔdaŋ fuo-la nɛ ŋaa tintee-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa. Lere-la sɩ dagɛ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nyɩŋ-nɩaa tinteeŋ bʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ, sɛmɛ na-kala a gollo bal.

english_verse: One region of Benjamin's tribal land had twelve towns with their surrounding villages. Those towns were Jericho, Beth-Hoglah, Emek-Keziz, Beth-Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel, Avvim, Parah, Ophrah, Chephar-Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba.
translation_verse: Kɛfa Amoni, Ofini arɩ Geba. Tabalaa ŋaa fii arɩ balɩa nɛ a pɛ ba tabiisiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Simeon was the second tribe chosen to receive land, and the region for its clans was inside Judah's borders.
translation_verse: Ba fa sɩ tɔnsɔ ŋɩɩ, Simioŋ doho nyɩŋ-nɩaa ma nɛ ŋaa lɩamɩŋ a joŋ ba kpaalɩŋ. Ba tinteeŋ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: In one region of Simeon's tribal land there were the following
translation_verse: Bɛf Labʋɔf arɩ Saruheŋ. Ba ŋaa tabalaa fii arɩ batori nɛ arɩ ba tabiisiŋ sɩ golliba.

english_verse: and continued north to Gath-Hepher, Ethkazin, and Rimmonah, where it curved toward Neah
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ ha chɩŋ nɩmɛ a to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a mʋ Gaf Hefa arɩ Ɛf Kazɩŋ, a kʋ lɩɩ Rimoŋ aŋ bɩra gʋrɛ, a tʋʋlɛ Nɩa.

english_verse: In another region, Simeon had the following four towns with their surrounding villages: Enrimmon, Tachan, Ether, and Ashan.
translation_verse: Tasɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ Aɩŋ, Rɩmɔŋ, Ɛta arɩ Asaŋ. Ba ŋaa tabalaa banɛsɛ nɛ arɩ ba tabiisiŋ.

english_verse: Simeon's land also included all the other towns and villages as far south as Baalath-Beer, which is also called Ramah of the South.
translation_verse: Tabiisi-la sɩ golliba kɛŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ deeŋ deeŋ a mʋ yi Baalaf Bɛɛ. Simioŋ doho nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa fa sɩ laa tintee-la ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Simeon's tribal land was actually inside Judah's territory. Judah had received too much land for the number of people in its tribe, so part of Judah's land was given to Simeon. Zebulun's Land
translation_verse: Juda tinteeŋ nɛ ba fa keri pɩ Simioŋ doho nɩaa ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Juda doho nɩaa tinteeŋ fa yʋga a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ chɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Simioŋ doho nɩaa laa ba tinteeŋ kpaalɩŋ ʋ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ. Tinteeŋ kpaal-la Zebuluŋ sɩ laa

english_verse: and became the northern border. Then it curved south around Hannathon and went as far west as Iphtahel Valley.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ bʋa-la chɩŋ aŋ gollo mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a mʋ yi Hanatɔŋ, a mʋ dɛrɛ Ifita Ɛl fuonaa-la lɛ.

english_verse: Zebulun had twelve towns with their surrounding villages. Some of these were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Jiralah, and Bethlehem.
translation_verse: Tasɩ-la sɩ pɛ nɛ ŋaa: Kataf, Nahalal, Sɩmɩrɔŋ, Idala arɩ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm. Ba ŋaa tabalaa fii arɩ balɩa nɛ arɩ ba tabiisiŋ.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem, Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath, Debirath, Kishion, Ebez, Remeth, En-Gannim, Enhaddah, Beth-Pazzez, Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth-Shemesh. Asher's Land
translation_verse: Tabalaa deemba arɩ ba tabiisiŋ kala, Zebuluŋ doho nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa nɛ tɩɩba. Tinteeŋ kpaal-la Ɩsaka sɩ laa

english_verse: Issachar was the fourth tribe chosen to receive land. The northern border for its clans went from Mount Tabor east to the Jordan River. Their land included the following
translation_verse: Tabalaa deemba arɩ ba tabiisiŋ kala, Ɩsaka doho nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa nɛ tɩɩba. Kpaal-la Asa sɩ laa

english_verse: then east to Beth-Dagon. On the southeast, Asher shared a border with Zebulun along the Iphtahel Valley. On the eastern side their border ran north to Beth-Emek, went east of Cabul, and then on to Neiel,
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ ha mɩɩra to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a tʋʋlɛ Bɛf Dagɔŋ a mʋ yagɛ Zebuluŋ arɩ Ifita Ɛl fuonaa-la lɛ, aŋ to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a mʋ yi Bɛf Ɛmɛk arɩ Nɛyɩl a kiele mʋ Kabʋl sɩ hɛ nagʋa.

english_verse: Abdon, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, and as far north as the city of Sidon.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la bɩra to Abɩdɔŋ, Rehob, Hamɔŋ arɩ Kana, a joŋ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ a mʋ yi Sɩdɔŋ balɩŋ.

english_verse: The Naphtali clans received this region as their tribal land, and it included
translation_verse: Tabalaa deemba arɩ ba tabiisiŋ kala, Nafɩtalɩ doho nyɩŋ-nɩaa nɛ tɩɩba. Tinteeŋ kpaal-la Daŋ sɩ laa

english_verse: The Israelites were still gathered in Shiloh in front of the sacred tent, when Eleazar the priest, Joshua, and the family leaders of Israel finished giving out the land to the tribes. The Lord had told the people to give Joshua whatever town he wanted. So Joshua chose Timnath-Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, and the people gave it to him. Joshua went to Timnath-Serah, rebuilt it, and lived there.
translation_verse: Tintee-la Elieza sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara arɩ Josua, Nuŋ nanʋala arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyɩŋ-nɩaa nɩhɩasɩŋ fa sɩ tɔnsɔ Sɩlɔ lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ ʋ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ a kaa kpaaba nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ ba fa sɩ to a kɛŋ tintee-la kpaa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: These Safe Towns were set up, so that if Israelites or even foreigners who lived in Israel accidentally killed someone, they could run to one of these towns. There they would be safe until a trial could be held, even if one of the victim's relatives came looking for revenge.
translation_verse: Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna koo dɩ nɩwogusu-la sɩ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ kʋŋ nɛ bɩ sɛnɛ aŋ kpʋ ʋ dɔŋɔ, ʋ jaŋ wuo fá mʋ yuori tasɩŋ deemba ba sɩ lɩɩsa dɔŋɔ, dɩ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kpʋa naambile sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋ ŋɩɩ chɩmɩŋ tiŋ ʋ lɛ sɩ́ ʋ kpʋ. Ka dɩ ʋ wuo hɛ nɩmɛ a mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilimi sɩpaaŋ dɩ ba diiu sarɩya.

english_verse: One day the Lord told Joshua:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pɩ Josua:

english_verse: When Moses was still alive, I commanded him to tell the Israelites about the Safe Towns. Now you tell them that it is time to set up these towns.
translation_verse: “Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ tasɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ fá mʋ a yuyuori arɩ mɩ sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: If a person accidentally kills someone and the victim's relatives say it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of the Safe Towns and be safe from the victim's relatives. The one needing protection will stand at the entrance to the town gate and explain to the town leaders what happened. Then the leaders will bring that person in and provide a place to live in their town.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ fá a mʋ tasɩŋ deemba kʋŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ chɩŋ taŋ-la boi-baalɩŋ lɛ nɛ, taŋ-la nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ bʋl wɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa a pɩba. Ba nɛ jaŋ laaʋ, a pʋ leriŋ dɩ ʋ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: One of the victim's relatives might come to the town, looking for revenge. But the town leaders must not simply hand over the person accused of murder. After all, the accused and the victim had been neighbors, not enemies.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ sʋba naaŋ-bile sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋ ŋɩɩ chɩmɩŋ timu lɛ nɛ kiri ʋ harɩŋ a kɔ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba joŋu pa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ sɛnɛ aŋ kpʋ nɩɩ-la naambie, ʋ bɩ ʋ dʋndɔŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: The citizens of that Safe Town must come together and hold a trial. They may decide that the victim was killed accidentally and that the accused is not guilty of murder. Everyone found not guilty must still live in the Safe Town until the high priest dies. Then they can go back to their own towns and their homes that they had to leave behind.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ nɛ deeŋ deeŋ a mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ kaa lɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilimi sɩpaaŋ dɩ ba diiu sarɩya. Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ wɩɩ cheye, ʋ jaŋ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ʋ jaŋ wuo mɩɩra mʋ ʋ jaŋ, a jʋjʋʋ ʋ tɩtɩa dɩa, lee-la ʋ fa sɩ lɩɩ fá.”

english_verse: The Israelites decided that the following three towns west of the Jordan River would be Safe Towns: Kedesh in Galilee in Naphtali's hill country, Shechem in Ephraim's hill country, and Kiriath-Arba in Judah's hill country. Kiriath-Arba is now called Hebron.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ Kɛdɛs sɩ hɛ Galilii tinteeŋ lɛ, a hɛ Nafɩtalɩ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ, a bɩra lɩɩsɛ Sɛkɛm ma sɩ hɛ Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ arɩ Kɩrɩaf Aba a hɛ Juda tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ.

english_verse: The Israelites had already decided on the following three towns east of the Jordan River: Bezer in the desert flatlands of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead, which was a town that belonged to Gad, and Golan in Bashan, which belonged to Manasseh.
translation_verse: Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ Jeriko wɩɩpɔsʋŋ ma, ba lɩɩsɛ Bɛza sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la sɩ pɩŋ Rubiŋ doho nɩaa tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ. Gad doho nɩaa tinteeŋ ma lɛ, ba lɩɩsɛ Ramɔf sɩ hɛ Gɩlɩad lɛ nɛ. Manasɛ doho nɩaa tinteeŋ ma lɛ, ba lɩɩsɛ Golaŋ sɩ hɛ Basaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: While the Israelites were still camped at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, the family leaders of the Levi tribe went to speak to the priest Eleazar, Joshua, and the family leaders of the other Israelite tribes. The leaders of Levi said, “The Lord told Moses that you have to give us towns and provide pastures for our animals.”
translation_verse: Ba fá mʋ ba teeŋ Sɩlɔ sɩ hɛ Kɛnaŋ lɛ nɛ, a bʋla pɩba, “La TƖƖNA fa to Mosis lɛ a bʋl arɩ ma pɩla tasɩŋ nɛ dɩ la jʋjʋʋ, arɩ la pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee.”

english_verse: Since the Lord had said this, the leaders of the other Israelite tribes agreed to give some of the towns and pastures from their tribal lands to Levi.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa to La TƖƖNA fa sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, a joŋ tasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba tinteeŋ kpaalɩŋ tʋɔŋ a pɩ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ lere-la ba pʋsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ didii.

english_verse: The leaders asked the Lord to show them in what order the clans of Levi would be given towns, and which towns each clan would receive. The Kohath clans were first. The descendants of Aaron, Israel's first priest, were given
translation_verse: Kohaf doho nyɩŋ-nɩa nɛ, ba laa sɩpaaŋ kpaa tasɩŋ pa. Ba fa joŋ tasɩŋ fii arɩ batori nɛ a pɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Arɔŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara doho nɩaa. Juda, Simioŋ arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ba joŋ tasɩ-la a pɩba.

english_verse: towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Ba fa joŋ ŋmaŋkaanɩ-la arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ gollo a pɩ Jefuni nanʋala Kalɩb nɛ ba ŋaa ʋ kɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord had told Moses that he would show the Israelites which towns and pastures to give to the clans of Levi, and he did. Towns from Judah, Simeon, Benjamin
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ joŋ tasɩ-la a pɩ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ lere-la ba pʋsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ didii, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ to Mosis lɛ a dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The descendants of Aaron from the Kohath clans of Levi were priests, and they were chosen to receive towns first. They were given
translation_verse: Tasɩ-la kala ba sɩ joŋo pɩ Arɔŋ doho Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa fa ŋaa fii arɩ batori nɛ arɩ lere-la ba pʋsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ didii.

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe had a total of
translation_verse: Tasɩ-la kʋŋkala lɛ, pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diiliŋ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ a gollu.

english_verse: The Lord gave the Israelites the land he had promised their ancestors, and they captured it and settled in it.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA joŋ tintee-la kala ʋ fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba, arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ pɩba nɛ. Ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: There still were enemies around Israel, but the Lord kept his promise to let his people live in peace. And whenever the Israelites did have to go to war, no enemy could defeat them. The Lord always helped Israel win.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wiese nɛ sɛmɛ na-kala, arɩ ʋ fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩ ba naabalɩmaba. Ba dʋndɔŋ-kala fa bɩ wuo yuo diiba. La TƖƖNA joŋ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala a hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ ba wuoba.

english_verse: The Lord promised to do many good things for Israel, and he kept his promise every time.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wʋzɔmɔ-la kala a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ba kala nɛ ʋ ŋaa, ba kʋbala ma bɩ birige.

english_verse: Joshua held a meeting with the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh, and he told them:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua yɩrɛ Rubiŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Gad doho nɩaa arɩ Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la a kʋ hilimi,

english_verse: You have obeyed every command of the Lord your God and of his servant Moses. And you have done everything I've told you to do. It's taken a long time, but you have stayed and helped your relatives.
translation_verse: Faafaa kala a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ ma bɩ ma naambiiriŋ vɩa ta, ma chaasa tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord promised to give peace to your relatives, and that's what he has done. Now it's time for you to go back to your own homes in the land that Moses gave you east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa pɩ ma naambiiriŋ dɩ-hɔnɔ wiesiŋ nɛ arɩ ʋ fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ. Má mɩɩra mʋ ma dɩɩsɩŋ tintee-la lɛ La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnna Mosis sɩ joŋo pɩma Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Moses taught you to love the Lord your God, to be faithful to him, and to worship and obey him with your whole heart and with all your strength. So be very careful to do everything Moses commanded.
translation_verse: Má ta fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a to niiri-la arɩ wombie-la La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnna Mosis sɩ joŋo pɩma. Má cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, a tuto ʋ wombiee kala, arɩ niiri-la ʋ sɩ daga, a mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ a tɩma pʋpʋ arɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩ-wɩɩkala.”

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh reached the western side of the Jordan River valley and built a huge altar there beside the river. When the rest of the Israelites heard what these tribes had done,
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ nɩa arɩ ba saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ nɛ Gɛlɩlɔf sɩ hɛ Kɛnaŋ lɛ a kpagɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la sɛmɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ,

english_verse: the Israelite men met at Shiloh to get ready to attack the two and a half tribes.
translation_verse: ba kala sii hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ Sɩlɔ lɛ dɩ ba mʋ yuoba.

english_verse: But first they sent a priest, Phinehas the son of Eleazar, to talk with the two and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tɩŋ Elieza sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nanʋala Finihas dɩ ʋ mʋ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ, Rubiŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Gad doho nɩaa arɩ Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la teeŋ.

english_verse: Each of the ten tribes at Shiloh sent the leader of one of its families along with Phinehas.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩɩ mʋ, ba lɩɩsɛ sɩpaalaaraa fii nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ, doho kala dɩa nɩhɩaŋ, ba to ʋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: Phinehas and these leaders went to Gilead and met with the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. They said:
translation_verse: Ba kɔ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ, Rubiŋ doho nɩaa, Gad doho nɩaa arɩ Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la teeŋ, a bʋla pɩba:

english_verse: All of the Lord's people have gathered together and have sent us to find out why you are unfaithful to our God. You have turned your backs on the Lord by building that altar. Why are you rebelling against him?
translation_verse: “La TƖƖNA nɩaa kala sɩ: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma bɩra bɩ Iziral Wɩa laa dii? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma mɩɩrɛ La TƖƖNA harɩŋ a saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ pɩ ma tɩtɩa aŋ vɩaʋ?

english_verse: Wasn't our people's sin at Peor terrible enough for you? The Lord punished us by sending a horrible sickness that killed many of us, and we still suffer because of that sin.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋ-la la sɩ ŋaa Pio lɛ bɩ magaa? Wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ magɩla ŋaa La TƖƖNA nɩaa ma lɛ nɛ, ama, a chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ laa na hɛɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Now you are turning your backs on the Lord again. If you don't stop rebelling against the Lord at once, he will be angry with the whole nation.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ ma joŋ ma harɩŋ a yɩyɩa La TƖƖNA nɛ koo? Dɩ ma nɛ vɩa La TƖƖNA jɩnɩŋ, chie ʋ jaŋ na baanɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nyuŋ.

english_verse: If you don't think your land is a fit place to serve God, then move across the Jordan and live with us in the Lord's own land, where his sacred tent is located. But don't rebel against the Lord our God or against us by building another altar besides the Lord's own altar.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma tinteeŋ nɛ kɛŋ disiniŋ, má kɔ La TƖƖNA tinteeŋ, lee-la ʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ ʋ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ sɩ hɛ, a kʋ pɛ hɔŋ la tinteeŋ lɛ. Ama má sɩ́ La TƖƖNA koo la-na vɩa aŋ saa koruŋ pɩ ma tɩtɩa a pɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't you remember what happened when Achan was unfaithful and took some of the things that belonged to God? This made God angry with the entire nation. Achan died because he sinned, but he also caused the death of many others.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Ekaŋ, Zɛra nanʋala sɩ bɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ to aŋ paa kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ ba chei, La TƖƖNA fa tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa a dɔgɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nɛ. Ekaŋ dʋndʋŋa dee fa bɩ sʋba a tɩŋ wʋbɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.”

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God! We ask him to be our witness, because he knows whether or not we were rebellious or unfaithful when we built that altar. If we were unfaithful, then we pray that God won't rescue us today. Let us tell you why we built that altar,
translation_verse: “Wɩa nɛ ŋaa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ, ʋ-na jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ la ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ, la saa chɛ dɩ ma ma jɩŋ nɛ. Dɩ la nɛ vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ, ŋɩɩ-na ʋ sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: and we ask the Lord to punish us if we are lying. We didn't build it so we could turn our backs on the Lord. We didn't even build it so we could offer animal or grain sacrifices to please the Lord or ask his blessing.
translation_verse: Dɩ la vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ nɛ aŋ saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ pɩ la tɩtɩa, a ŋɩŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koo a kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋɩŋaa nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa dɔgɩsɛla a tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: We built that altar because we were worried. Someday your descendants might tell our descendants, “The Lord made the Jordan River the boundary between us Israelites and you people of Reuben and Gad. The Lord is Israel's God, but you're not part of Israel, so you can't take part in worshiping the Lord.” Your descendants might say that and try to make our descendants stop worshiping and obeying the Lord.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA leŋe Jɔdaŋ fuo-la sɩ hɛ la dɩ ma pɛgɛ nɛ ŋaa la dɩ ma-na Rubiŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Gad doho nɩaa bʋa. Ma bɩ kpaal kala kɛnɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ.’ Ma doho nɩaa jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, a leŋ dɩ la doho nɩaa sɩ́ La TƖƖNA fá.

english_verse: That's why we decided to build the altar. It isn't for offering sacrifices, not even sacrifices to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ la saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ naga kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koo la sɩ jaŋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ wɩaa nɛ,

english_verse: Phinehas and the clan leaders were pleased when they heard the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh explain why they had built the altar. Then Phinehas told them, “Today we know that the Lord is helping us. You have not been unfaithful to him, and this means that the Lord will not be angry with us.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elieza nanʋala Finihas sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara bʋla pɩ Rubiŋ, Gad arɩ Manasɛ doho nɩalɩŋ, “Jɩnɩŋ la jɩma arɩ La TƖƖNA hɛ la teeŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa a chei La TƖƖNA. Lɛɛlɛ ma laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta nɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Phinehas and the clan leaders left Gilead and went back to Canaan to tell the Israelites about their meeting with the Reuben and Gad tribes.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elieza nanʋala Finihas, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ-la arɩ sɩpaalaara-la sɩ mʋ Rubiŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Gad doho nɩaa sɩ hɛ Gɩlɩad lɛ ba kɛŋ vʋʋra-la, ba mɩɩra mʋ Kɛnaŋ a hɛ duoso pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: The Israelites were happy and praised God. There was no more talk about going to war and wiping out the tribes of Reuben and Gad.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ, ba tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ, ba dɛnnɛ Wɩa. Ba bɩra bɩ wɩɩ bʋla a mʋ tɩgɛ ba fa sɩ sɩ ba jaŋ mʋ a yuo Rubiŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Gad doho nɩaa aŋ chei tintee-la lɛ ba sɩ hɔnɔ.

english_verse: The people of Reuben and Gad named the altar “A Reminder to Us All That the Lord Is Our God.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rubiŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Gad doho nɩaa hɛ koru-la yɩrɩŋ: Magɩl-la sɩ hɛ la dɩ ma pɛgɛ a dagɛ arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa Wɩa.

english_verse: The Lord let Israel live in peace with its neighbors for a long time, and Joshua lived to a ripe old age.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala sɩ ŋaa bal harɩŋ, La TƖƖNA laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta ba dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ golliba nɩsɩŋ lɛ ba wiesi. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Josua fa hɩɛsa nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: One day he called a meeting of the leaders of the tribes of Israel, including the old men, the judges, and the officials. Then he told them: I am now very old.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ, ba sɩpaalaaraa, ba sarɩya diiree arɩ ba tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ a hilimi a bʋla pɩba: “Mɩ hɩɛsa nɛ woruŋ lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: You have seen how the Lord your God fought for you and helped you defeat the nations who lived in this land.
translation_verse: Ma tɩtɩa saa na wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA ma Wɩa sɩ ŋaa tinteye-la lɛ nɛ, a tɩŋ ma wɩaa. Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ yuoba a pɩma.

english_verse: There are still some nations left, but the Lord has promised you their land. So when you attack them, he will make them run away. I have already divided their land among your tribes, as I did with the land of the nations I defeated between the Jordan River and the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ jaŋ kiriba ta ma wombiiŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ yigiba ta ma sɩpaaŋ, ka dɩ ma laa ba tintee-la dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ arɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩma.

english_verse: Be sure that you carefully obey everything written in The Book of the Law of Moses and do exactly what it says.
translation_verse: Má chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ, a fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a to wombie-la kala Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil teniŋ tʋɔŋ, a sɩ́ begile mʋ nadiiŋ koo nagʋa.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with the nations that live around you. Don't worship their gods or pray to their idols or make promises in the names of their gods.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa kaa mɛrɛ tinteye-la nɩaa ha sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ. Má sɩ́ ba vesiŋ ma yɩrɩŋ yɩrʋ koo a ŋmɩɛsɛba. Má pɔ ma sɩ́ ba kpaarʋ koo a kpirimi ba sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Be as faithful to the Lord as you have always been.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma mɛrɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa lɛ nɛ, arɩ ma sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: When you attacked powerful nations, the Lord made them run away, and no one has ever been able to stand up to you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA kiri tintee-balaa sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ ma sɩpaaŋ. A kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ nʋʋkala ha bɩ ma sɩpaaŋ wuo chɩŋ.

english_verse: Any one of you can defeat a thousand enemy soldiers, because the Lord God fights for you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Ma nɩbala jaŋ wuo kiri nɩaa bʋɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ jaŋ yuo pɩma arɩ ʋ fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Be sure to always love the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Don't ever turn your backs on him by marrying people from the nations that are left in the land. Don't even make friends with them. I tell you that if you are friendly with those nations, the Lord won't chase them away when you attack. Instead, they'll be like a trap for your feet, a whip on your back, and thorns in your eyes. And finally, none of you will be left in this good land that the Lord has given you.
translation_verse: ma jɩŋ woruŋ arɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa bɩra bɩ jaŋ kiri tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ hɛ ma sɩpaaŋ ta. Ba jaŋ nagɛ bɛrɛ ma lɛ, koo a nagɛ chɩba a vɩvɩɩrɛ ma harɩŋ lɛ, a nagɛ sɔɔŋ ma sɩaa lɛ deeŋ deeŋ dɩ ma kʋŋkala sʋʋ tintee-zɔŋ-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma lɛ.

english_verse: I will soon die, as everyone must. But deep in your hearts you know that the Lord has kept every promise he ever made to you. Not one of them has been broken.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, bʋa-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ yie nɛ. Ma kʋŋkala jɩma ma tʋɔŋ lɛ arɩ wʋzɔmɔ-la kala, Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pɩma, ba kala nɛ ʋ ŋaa. Ʋ bɩ ba kʋŋkala kere ta.

english_verse: Yes, when the Lord makes a promise, he does what he has promised. But when he makes a threat, he will also do what he has threatened. The Lord is our God. He gave us this wonderful land and made an agreement with us that we would worship only him. But if you worship other gods, it will make the Lord furious. He will start getting rid of you, and soon not one of you will be left in this good land that he has given you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ vɩa dɩ ma to nii-la sɩ hɛ ma dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa pɛgɛ, kʋ-la ʋ sɩ dagɛma, aŋ kpʋkpaarɛ vesiŋ a kpikpirimi ba sɩpaaŋ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ a leŋ dɩ ma kala guu nyɩɩgɛ tintee-zɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩma lɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua called the tribes of Israel together for a meeting at Shechem. He asked the leaders, including the old men, the judges, and the officials, to come up and stand near the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Josua yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho doho-la kala kʋ hilimi Sɛkɛm lɛ, a leŋ ba nɩhɩasɩŋ, ba sɩpaalaaraa arɩ ba sarɩya diiree arɩ ba tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kɔ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Then Joshua told everyone to listen to this message from the Lord, the God of Israel: Long ago your ancestors lived on the other side of the Euphrates River, and they worshiped other gods. This continued until the time of your ancestor Terah and his two sons, Abraham and Nahor.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Bumbuŋ-la ma naabalɩmaba fa hɛ Yufireti fuo-la cholo nɛ a tuto vesiŋ. Tɛra ma fa pɛ nɛ, Abɩraham arɩ Nahɔ nyɩmma nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But I brought Abraham across the Euphrates River and led him through the land of Canaan. I blessed him by giving him Isaac, the first in a line of many descendants.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kɛŋ Abɩraham sɩ ŋaa ma naabalɩma, a lɩɩ Yufireti fuo-la cholo tintee-la lɛ, a kɛnʋ to Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ a leŋ ʋ doho nɩaa pʋŋ woruŋ. Mɩ fa leŋe ʋ lʋl Aɩzɩk nɛ,

english_verse: Then I gave Isaac two sons, Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau the hill country of Mount Seir, but your ancestor Jacob and his children went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: a bɩra leŋ Aɩzɩk ma lʋl Jekɔb arɩ Ɛsɔ. Mɩ nɛ joŋ Sɛɛ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga a pɩ Ɛsɔ, ama Jekɔb arɩ ʋ biiriŋ-na mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Later I sent Moses and his brother Aaron to help your people, and I made all those horrible things happen to the Egyptians. I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, but the Egyptians got in their chariots and on their horses and chased your ancestors, catching up with them at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛŋ ma naabalɩmaba kʋʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa fa lɩɩ kire to ba harɩŋ nɛ arɩ ba janɩŋ torukoba arɩ ba ja-jɩllaa a kʋ yi Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Your people cried to me for help, so I put a dark cloud between them and the Egyptians. Then I opened up the sea and let your people walk across on dry ground. But when the Egyptians tried to follow, I commanded the sea to swallow them, and they drowned while you watched. You lived in the desert for a long time,
translation_verse: Ba sɩ yele pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ pɛ ba lɛ, mɩ fa joŋ birimiŋ hɛ ba dɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ nɛ a leŋ lɩɩŋ kʋ tɔ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa. Ma tɩtɩa na wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋaa Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, ma hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ tʋɔŋ a dieni nɛ.

english_verse: then I brought you into the land east of the Jordan River. The Amorites were living there, and they fought you. But with my help, you defeated them, wiped them out, and took their land.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛmma kaa kɔ Amɔrɩ tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuoŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ. Ba fa sɩ sii yuyuoma, mɩ jomba hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Mɩ kpʋba nɛ ma sɩpaaŋ, ka ma laa ba tinteeŋ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ.

english_verse: King Balak decided that his nation Moab would go to war against you, so he asked Balaam to come and put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Zipo nanʋala Balak sɩ ŋaa Mʋab tɩŋŋaa kuoro fa sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ yuo ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ʋ tɩma yɩrɛ Bioo nanʋala Balam nɛ dɩ ʋ kɔ a kalɩba hɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: But I wouldn't listen to Balaam, and I rescued you by making him bless you instead of curse you.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ bɩ jegile nɩɩ Balam teeŋ, mɩ fa leŋe ʋ mɩɩra sʋl Wɩa pɩma nɛ. Mɩ bɩra laama ta Balak ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You crossed the Jordan River and came to Jericho. The rulers of Jericho fought you, and so did the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. I helped you defeat them all.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a kɔ Jeriko. Jeriko tɩmma-la ma bɩra sii a yuyuoma, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa, Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa, Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa, Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Gɩgasɩ tɩŋŋaa, Hivi tɩŋŋaa, arɩ Jebus tɩŋŋaa ma fa ŋaa, ama mɩ jomba a hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Your enemies ran from you, but not because you had swords and bows and arrows. I made your enemies panic and run away, as I had done with the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Ma fa sɩɩ mʋ, mɩ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ kɩŋkɛŋ hɛ ba lɛ nɛ a kiriba ta ma sɩpaaŋ a pɛ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuorie-la balɩa lɛ. Ma tokobiee arɩ ma tosuŋ dee ma kaa ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You didn't have to work for this land—I gave it to you. Now you live in towns you didn't build, and you eat grapes and olives from vineyards and trees you didn't plant.
translation_verse: Mɩ pɩma tintee-la ma sɩ bɩ hɛɛŋ na ʋ lɛ nɛ, arɩ tasɩ-la ma sɩ dee bɩ saa, ma hɔŋ ba lɛ a didii girep nɛnɛɛ arɩ olif nʋʋŋ ma dee sɩ bɩ chɔnsɔ.’

english_verse: Then Joshua told the people: Worship the Lord, obey him, and always be faithful. Get rid of the idols your ancestors worshiped when they lived on the other side of the Euphrates River and in Egypt.
translation_verse: Maa fá La TƖƖNA a tutou arɩ ma wʋtɩtɩɩ. Má paa vesi-la ma naabalɩmaba fa sɩɩ kpaarʋ Yufireti fuo-la cholo arɩ Ijipiti lɛ a yuo ta, aŋ tɩma pɩpɩ La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: But if you don't want to worship the Lord, then choose here and now! Will you worship the same idols your ancestors did? Or since you're living on land that once belonged to the Amorites, maybe you'll worship their gods. I won't. My family and I are going to worship and obey the Lord!
translation_verse: Dɩ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ bɩ tɔrɔ ma sɩ́ jaŋ to La TƖƖNA, ŋɩɩ-na jɩnɩŋ má bagɩsa lɩɩsɛ kʋ-la ma sɩ jaŋ to: Dɩ ma naabalɩmaba fa sɩɩ kpaarɛ vesi-la Yufireti fuo-la cholo nɛɛ, koo dɩ vesi-la Amɔrɩ tɩmma-la tinteeŋ lɛ ma sɩ hɔnɔ sɩɩ kpaarʋ nɛ. Ama mɩ-na arɩ mɩ dɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ to La TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: The people answered: We could never worship other gods or stop worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ bʋl, “La bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ la leŋ La TƖƖNA aŋ to vesiŋ da.

english_verse: The Lord is our God. We were slaves in Egypt as our ancestors had been, but we saw the Lord work miracles to set our people free and to bring us out of Egypt. Even though other nations were all around us, the Lord protected us wherever we went.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa tɩtɩa nɛ kɛŋ la arɩ la naabalɩmaba lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, tintee-la lɛ la fa sɩ hɛ a ŋaa yosi. Ʋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa la sɩɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a pɔla wombii-la kala lɛ la sɩ vɛnɛ arɩ tinteye-la tʋɔŋ la sɩ to lɩɩ.

english_verse: And when we fought the Amorites and the other nations that lived in this land, the Lord made them run away. Yes, we will worship and obey the Lord, because the Lord is our God.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nɛ kiri tinteye-la kala fa sɩ hɛ la sɩpaaŋ a ta, a pɛ Amɔrɩ tɩmma-la lɛ, nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa la ma jaŋ to La TƖƖNA, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ la Wɩa.”

english_verse: Joshua said: The Lord is fearsome; he is the one true God, and I don't think you are able to worship and obey him in the ways he demands. You would have to be completely faithful, and if you sin or rebel, he won't let you get away with it.
translation_verse: Josua bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Má bɩ jaŋ wuo to La TƖƖNA, ʋ bɩ mɔlɩɩ ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ʋ bɩ hadɔrʋŋ ka chɛ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛma dɩ ma nɛ vɩa ʋ niiŋ.

english_verse: If you turn your backs on the Lord and worship the gods of other nations, the Lord will turn against you. He will make terrible things happen to you and wipe you out, even though he had been good to you before.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ vɩa La TƖƖNA aŋ to vesiŋ, ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra joŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ a ŋaa ma lɛ dɩ ma kala sʋʋ a dɛrɛ, arɩ ʋ sɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩma ma kala.”

english_verse: But the people shouted, “We won't worship any other gods. We will worship and obey only the Lord!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ bʋla pɩ Josua, “Aɩ, la jaŋ to La TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: Joshua said, “You have heard yourselves say that you will worship and obey the Lord. Isn't that true?” “Yes, it's true,” they answered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua bʋl, “Ma sɛyɛ arɩ ma lɩɩsɛ La TƖƖNA nɛ dɩ ma tutou?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Oo, la sɛyɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua said, “But you still have some idols, like those the other nations worship. Get rid of your idols! You must decide once and for all that you really want to obey the Lord God of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josua bɩra bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ-na lɛɛlɛ, má paa vʋɩya-la kala sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ a yuo ta, aŋ joŋ ma tʋɔŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa.”

english_verse: The people said, “The Lord is our God, and we will worship and obey only him.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ bʋla pɩ Josua, “La jaŋ to La TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ a to ʋ dʋndʋŋa.”

english_verse: Joshua helped Israel make an agreement with the Lord that day at Shechem. Joshua made laws for Israel
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la Josua fa sɩ leŋe Iziral tɩŋŋaa hɛ nii-la ba dɩ Wɩa pɛgɛ Sɛkɛm lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ joŋ wombie-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ tuto a dagɛba.

english_verse: and wrote them down in The Book of the Law of God. Then he set up a large stone under the oak tree at the place of worship in Shechem
translation_verse: Josua fa ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ a hɛ Wɩa wombiiŋ teniŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ ka ʋ joŋ tabɩɩ-jalɩɩ kʋbala a pɛ piine kʋbala bʋbʋɔŋ ʋ chɩŋ. Tɩa-la kpagɛ lee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: and told the people, “Look at this stone. It has heard everything that the Lord has said to us. Our God can call this stone as a witness if we ever reject him.”
translation_verse: Josua bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala, “Má bee na, tabɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ ŋaa la magɩlɩŋ. Ʋ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩla nɛ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ma magɩlɩŋ dɩ ma nɛ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ ma Wɩa teeŋ.”

english_verse: Not long afterwards, the Lord's servant Joshua died at the age of
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala harɩŋ lɛ nɛ Nuŋ nanʋala Josua, La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnnʋ-la sʋʋ, dɩ ʋ fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ zɔlɔ arɩ fii.

english_verse: The Israelites buried him in his own land at Timnath-Serah, north of Mount Gaash in the hill country of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Ba joŋu hugi ʋ tɩtɩa sɩ tɩɩ tintee-la Tɩmɩnaf Sɛra lɛ, a hɛ Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga a hɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gaas wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: As long as Joshua lived, Israel worshiped and obeyed the Lord. There were other leaders old enough to remember everything that the Lord had done for Israel. And for as long as these men lived, Israel continued to worship and obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Josua mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa to La TƖƖNA nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ sʋʋŋ harɩŋ ma, nɩhɩasɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ ba mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ a na wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ba mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa ha to Wɩa nɛ.

english_verse: When the people of Israel left Egypt, they brought the bones of Joseph along with them. They took the bones to the town of Shechem and buried them in the field that Jacob had bought for
translation_verse: Josɛf haŋgbele-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ paa a lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kɔ, ba fa joŋo hugi Sɛkɛm lɛ nɛ, tintee-la Jekɔb sɩ yɔbɔ Hamɔ biiriŋ teeŋ, warɩpʋla zɔlɔ. Hamɔ nɛ suomo bil Sɛkɛm gentine. Tintee-la ŋaa Josɛf doho nɩaa kʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: When Eleazar the priest died, he was buried in the hill country of Ephraim on a hill that belonged to his son Phinehas.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ nanʋala Elieza ma sʋʋ ba joŋu hugi Gɩbɩa lɛ, tintee-la ba sɩ joŋo pɩ ʋ nanʋala Finihas, ʋ hɛ Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites asked the Lord, “Which of our tribes should attack the Canaanites first?”
translation_verse: Josua sɩ sʋba harɩŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA, “Do bɛɛ nɩaa nɛ maga dɩ ba laa sɩpaaŋ a mʋ yuo Kɛnaŋ tɩmma-la?”

english_verse: “Judah!” the Lord answered. “I'll help them take the land.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Juda doho nɩaa nɛ maga ba mʋ, mɩ joŋ tintee-la hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: The people of Judah went to their relatives, the Simeon tribe, and said, “Canaanites live in the land God gave us. Help us fight them, and we will help you.” Troops from Simeon came to help Judah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juda doho nɩaa bʋla pɩ ba naambiiriŋ Simioŋ doho nɩaa, “Má kʋ pɛ la lɛ dɩ la mʋ tintee-la ba sɩ kere pɩla a yuo Kɛnaŋ tɩmma-la. La ma jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma yuo laa ma tinteeŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Simioŋ doho nɩaa pɛ ba lɛ ba mʋ.

english_verse: After that, they attacked the Canaanites who lived at Hebron, defeating the three clans called Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. At that time, Hebron was called Kiriath-Arba.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ Kɛnaŋ tɩmma-la fa sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ , a yuo dii doho doho deemba: Sɛsaɩ, Ahɩmaŋ arɩ Talɩmaɩ.

english_verse: The king tried to escape, but soldiers from Judah caught him. They cut off his thumbs and big toes,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Bɛzɛk kuoro fá, ama ba kire kɛnʋ a keri ʋ nenii-baalaa arɩ ʋ naanii-baalaa.

english_verse: They attacked Jerusalem, captured it, killed everyone who lived there, and then burned it to the ground.
translation_verse: Juda doho nɩaa bɩra mʋ yuo Jerusalɛm ma, a yuo diiu. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kpʋ taŋ-la nɩaa aŋ nyɩgɛ taŋ-la.

english_verse: Judah's army fought the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, the Southern Desert, and the foothills to the west.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, Juda doho nɩaa bɩra mʋ dɩ ba yuo Kɛnaŋ tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: From Hebron, Judah's army went to attack Debir, which at that time was called Kiriath-Sepher.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Debi lɛ .

english_verse: Caleb told his troops, “The man who captures Kiriath-Sepher can marry my daughter Achsah.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Kalɩb bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ tolo Akɩsa a pɩ baal-la sɩ jaŋ yuo dii Kɩrɩaf Sɛfa a kɛsɛ ʋ nɩaa dɩ ʋ jaa.”

english_verse: Caleb's nephew Othniel captured Kiriath-Sepher, so Caleb let him marry Achsah. Othniel was the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Kalɩb ŋaana Kɛnas, ʋ nanʋala Ofiniel yuo dii taŋ-la. Kalɩb joŋ tolo-la a pʋ ʋ jaa.

english_verse: Right after the wedding, Achsah started telling Othniel that he ought to ask her father for a field. She went to see her father, and while she was getting down from her donkey, Caleb asked, “What's bothering you?”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ jaa dɔŋɔ dɛrɛ, ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ Ofiniel hɛ ʋ haala dɩ ʋ pɩɛsɛ ʋ nyɩmma Kalɩb a laa tinteeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tolo-la sii jɩl kakumo mʋ dɩ ʋ na ʋ nyɩmma. Ʋ sɩ mʋa a tuu ʋ kakumo nyuŋ, Kalɩb pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ chɩchɛ?”

english_verse: She answered, “I need your help. The land you gave me is in the Southern Desert, so please give me some spring-fed ponds for a water supply.” Caleb gave her a couple of small ponds named Higher Pond and Lower Pond.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tolo-la bʋl, “Chaasa pɛ mɩ lɛ. Ŋ laa sɩpaaŋ pɩmɛ tinteeŋ nɛ Nɛgɛf lɛ, ka lɩɩŋ tuo nɩmɛ. Pɩmɛ lee-la sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩ-bulo ma.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Kalɩb joŋ lɩɩ-bulo-la sɩ hɛ taŋ-la nyuŋ arɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kala a pʋ.
