translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl joŋ nʋʋŋ arɩ loŋ, a wansa hɛ Sɔɔl nyuŋ lɛ, aŋ guoru a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɩŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa ʋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: When you leave me today, you'll meet two men near Rachel's tomb at Zelzah in the territory of Benjamin. They'll tell you, “The donkeys you've been looking for have been found. Your father has forgotten about them, and now he's worrying about you! He's wondering how he can find you.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ tamɛ jɩnɩŋ aŋ mʋmʋ, ŋ jaŋ cheŋ baalaa balɩa dɩ ba kpagɛ Rakɛl vaamɩŋ sɩ pɩŋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zɛlɩza, a hɛ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ bʋa. Ba jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ kakusu-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩ chɩchɛ, ba naba nɛ. Ŋ nyɩmma bɩra bɩ ba-na wɩaa ka bɩɩnɛ, ŋ wɩaa nɛ mɩɩraa walɩmʋ lɛɛlɛ. Ʋ pɩpɩɛsɛ, ‘Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nanʋala deeŋ wɩaa?’

english_verse: Go on from there until you reach the big oak tree at Tabor, where you'll meet three men on their way to worship God at Bethel. One of them will be leading three young goats, another will be carrying three round loaves of bread, and the last one will be carrying a clay jar of wine.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ bɩra joŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi tɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tabɔ leriŋ. Nɩmɛ ŋ jaŋ cheŋ baalaa batori dɩ baa mʋ Wɩa teeŋ Bɛtɛl lɛ. Dɔŋɔ jaŋ baasɛ bʋʋ-pɔrɔɔ batori, dɩ dɔŋɔ ma kori boroboroba batori, ka dɩ dɔŋɔ ma laalɛ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ arɩ puruŋ.

english_verse: After they greet you, they'll give you two loaves of bread.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ lɔllʋŋ aŋ joŋ boroboroba balɩa a pɩŋ. Ʋ maga ŋ sɛɩ nɛ a laa boroboroba-la.

english_verse: Next, go to Gibeah, where the Philistines have an army camp. As you're going into the town, you'll meet a group of prophets coming down from the place of worship. They'll be going along prophesying while others are walking in front of them, playing small harps, small drums, and flutes.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ, ŋ jaŋ jɩl Wɩa dundolo-la sɩ hɛ Gɩbɩa lɛ, nɩmɛ nɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo buguŋ hɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ kʋʋ kpagɛ taŋ-la, ŋ jaŋ cheŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa dɩ ba pʋɔla a lɩɩ dundolo-la nyuŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a kʋʋ tuu, ka nɩaa dudu kɔnɛba, aa chɩgɩsɛ chɩnchɩgɩsɩŋ, a ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlaa, a du chenniŋ hɛ a laa ba sɩpaaŋ. Ba jaŋ bʋbʋl wɩaa Wɩa Dɩma doluŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord will suddenly take control of you. You'll become a different person and start prophesying right along with them.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Dɩma-la jaŋ jʋʋ ŋ ma arɩ doluŋ, dɩ ŋ pɛ ba lɛ a bʋbʋl wɩaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ bɩrɩmɛ nɩwogo.

english_verse: After these things happen, do whatever you think is right! God will help you.
translation_verse: Dɩ wʋmagɩlaa deemba kala nɛ kʋ ŋaa ŋ lɛ, wɩɩ-la na-kala ŋ sɩ bene dɩ ʋ zɔmɔ, ŋaa. Wɩa chɩŋ ŋ harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Then go to Gilgal. I'll come a little later, so wait for me. It may even take a week for me to get there, but when I come, I'll offer sacrifices to please the Lord and to ask for his blessings. I'll also tell you what to do next. Saul Goes Back Home
translation_verse: Laa sɩpaaŋ tutuu Gɩlɩgal, mɩ jaŋ kʋ tuu puuŋ nɩmɛ, a kpʋ pʋsʋŋ sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ama gbɛrɛ nɩmɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ, mɩ jaŋ kɔ ŋ teeŋ a bʋl wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a pɩŋ.” Sɔɔl dii kuoruŋ

english_verse: As Saul turned around to leave Samuel, God made Saul feel like a different person. That same day, everything happened just as Samuel had said.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sɩ lɩɩ Samʋɛl leriŋ dɩ ʋ mʋ, Wɩa kɛŋ Sɔɔl tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩrɩmɛ ʋ ŋaa nɩwogo. Wɩalɩŋ kala sɛnɛ ŋaa tapʋlɩɩ-la arɩ ŋɩɩ Samʋɛl sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: When Saul arrived at Gibeah, a group of prophets met him. The Spirit of God suddenly took control of him, and right there in the middle of the group he began prophesying.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ-la sɩ mʋ yi Gɩbɩa, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa pʋɔlɛ a kʋ chemu. Wɩa Dɩma-la kʋ jʋʋ Sɔɔl arɩ doluŋ woruŋ, ʋ ma pɛ ba lɛ ba bʋbʋl wɩaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Some people who had known Saul for a long time saw that he was speaking and behaving like a prophet. They said to each other, “What's happened? How can Saul be a prophet?”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jɩmʋ sɩ naʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ a bʋbʋl wɩaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ, ba pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ wɩɩ ma nɛ ŋaa Kɩs nanʋala Sɔɔl lɛ ŋ-la? Sɔɔl ma ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la dɔŋɔ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: “Why not?” one of them answered. “Saul has as much right to be a prophet as anyone else!” That's why everyone started saying, “How can Saul be a prophet?”
translation_verse: Baala-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ dɔŋɔ pɩɛsɛ, “Ka Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la dɔnsʋŋ-na, ma bɩɩna ba nyɩmmaba nɛ kʋbɛɛba?” Ʋ ŋaa wʋbʋllɩ nandaa nɩaa bʋbʋl, “Sɔɔl ma ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la dɔŋɔ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: After Saul stopped prophesying, he went to the place of worship.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩalɩŋ a dɛrɛ, ʋ mʋ dundolo-la nyuŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Later, Saul's uncle asked him, “Where have you been?” Saul answered, “Looking for the donkeys. We couldn't find them, so we went to talk with Samuel.”
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala harɩŋ Sɔɔl nyɩmma kʋbie naʋ, a pɩɛsɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ-la, “Nɩɩ nɛ ma mʋ?” Sɔɔl sɩ, “La lɩɩ chɩchɛ kakusu-la nɛ. Ama la sɩ kʋ jɩŋ arɩ la bɩ jaŋ naba, la mɩɩra mʋ Samʋɛl teeŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: “And what did he tell you?” Saul's uncle asked.
translation_verse: Ʋ nyɩŋ-bie-la bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ Samʋɛl bʋla pɩŋ? Bʋla pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: Saul answered, “He told us the donkeys had been found.” But Saul didn't mention that Samuel had chosen him to be king. The Lord Shows Israel that Saul Will Be King
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl bʋl, “Ʋ chaasa bʋla pɩla arɩ ba na kakusu-la nɛ.” Ama Samʋɛl sɩ bʋla pɩ Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ, ʋ bɩ ʋ-na wɩaa bʋla pɩ ʋ nyɩŋ-bie-la.

english_verse: Samuel sent messengers to tell the Israelites to come to Mizpah and meet with the Lord.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala a kɔ La TƖƖNA teeŋ Mɩzɩpa lɛ,

english_verse: When everyone had arrived, Samuel said: The Lord God of Israel told me to remind you that he had rescued you from the Egyptians and from the other nations that abused you.
translation_verse: a bʋla pɩba, “Wɩɩ-la ma TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ nɛ kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, a laama ta Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ kala sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛma nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God has rescued you from your troubles and hard times. But you have rejected your God and have asked for a king. Now each tribe and clan must come near the place of worship so the Lord can choose a king.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ma Wɩa, mɩ nɛ laama ta ma wʋjʋʋlaa arɩ hɛɛ-la kala ma fa sɩɩ na lɛ. Ama lɛɛlɛ ma vɩamɛ nɛ aŋ bʋl: Bil kuoro pɩla. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má kala kɔ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ doho doho arɩ nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa.”

english_verse: Samuel brought each tribe, one after the other, to the altar, and the Lord chose the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl sɩ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho doho-la kʋ lɩɩ kʋŋ kʋŋ, La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa.

english_verse: Next, Samuel brought each clan of Benjamin there, and the Lord chose the Matri clan. Finally, Saul the son of Kish was chosen. But when they looked for him, he was nowhere to be found.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl bɩra kɛŋ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩalɩŋ ma lɩɩ nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa. La TƖƖNA bɩra lɩɩsɛ Matɩrɩ nyɩŋ-nɩaa. Dɩ-dɛrɩŋ kala, Kɩs nanʋala Sɔɔl nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ. Ama ba sɩ bee chɩchɛʋ, ba bɩ ʋ na.

english_verse: The people prayed, “Our Lord, is Saul here?” “Yes,” the Lord answered, “he is hiding behind the baggage.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA, “Baal-la kɔ daha nɛɛ?” La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Oo, ʋ nɛ faa chʋgʋsʋŋ tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: The people ran and got Saul and brought him into the middle of the crowd. He was more than a head taller than anyone else.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba fá mʋ kɛnʋ kʋ lɩɩ, ʋ chɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ a duomo kɩɩ nʋʋkala.

english_verse: “Look closely at the man the Lord has chosen!” Samuel told the crowd. “There is no one like him!” The crowd shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Samʋɛl bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Ma na baal-la La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsa nɛ. Nʋʋkala tuo ma tʋɔŋ a magʋ.” Nɩalɩŋ kala faasa ŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “A leŋ dɩ kuoro deeŋ kɛŋ mɩɩ-duduoŋ.”

english_verse: Samuel explained the rights and duties of a king and wrote them all in a book. He put the book in one of the shrines where the Lord was worshiped. Then Samuel sent everyone home.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl dagɛ nɩalɩŋ kuoruŋ wombiee, aŋ ŋmʋnsa hɛ teniŋ lɛ a joŋo bil La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ ka Samʋɛl ta nɩalɩŋ kala ba mɩɩra mʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: God had encouraged some young men to become followers of Saul, and when he returned to his hometown of Gibeah, they went with him.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl ma mɩɩra mʋ ʋ jaŋ Gɩbɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa digi bayuori duoru-la dɔnsʋŋ tʋɔŋ ba to ʋ harɩŋ mʋ.

english_verse: But some worthless fools said, “How can someone like Saul rescue us from our enemies?” They did not want Saul to be their king, and so they didn't bring him any gifts. But Saul kept calm.
translation_verse: Ka wʋhɛɛrɛɛ dɔnsʋŋ bʋl, “Ɛɛ nɛ nɩa deeŋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa a laala ta?” Ba bee gʋʋnʋ nɛ, a bɩ zile kʋŋkala kaa kʋ pʋ. Ka Sɔɔl tɔrɛ ʋ niiŋ.

english_verse: About this time, King Nahash of Ammon came with his army and surrounded the town of Jabesh in Gilead. The people who lived there told Nahash, “If you will sign a peace treaty with us, you can be our ruler, and we will pay taxes to you.”
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ, Amɔŋ kuoru-balɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nahas kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo mʋ golli taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jabɛs sɩ hɛ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ lɛ a chu, dɩ ba yuou. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jabɛs tɩŋŋaa baalaa kala bʋla pʋ, “Leŋ dɩ la hɛ niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ, ka dɩ la sɛɩ dɩ ŋ bibenla.”

english_verse: Nahash answered, “Sure, I'll sign a treaty! But not before I insult Israel by poking out the right eye of every man who lives in Jabesh.”
translation_verse: Nahas bʋl, “Dɩ ma nɛ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ mɩ chaarɛ ma nadiiŋ sɩaa, a hɛ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala hɩɩsɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la hɛ niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: The town leaders said, “Give us seven days so we can send messengers everywhere in Israel to ask for help. If no one comes here to save us, we will surrender to you.”
translation_verse: Jabɛs nɩhɩasɩŋ ma bʋla pʋ, “Pɩla tapʋlaa balɩpɛ, dɩ la wuo tɩŋ tɩndaarɩŋ a pɩ Iziral tinteeŋ nɩaa kala. Dɩ la nɛ bɩ nʋʋ na sɩ jaŋ kʋ laala ta, la jaŋ sɛyɛ pɩŋ.”

english_verse: Some of the messengers went to Gibeah, Saul's hometown. They told what was happening at Jabesh, and everyone in Gibeah started crying.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ tɩŋ tɩndaaraa ba mʋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala a pɩ Sɔɔl jaŋ Gɩbɩa nɩaa, ba faasa ŋmoo niiŋ.

english_verse: Just then, Saul came in from the fields, walking behind his oxen. “Why is everyone crying?” Saul asked. They told him what the men from Jabesh had said.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Sɔɔl kiri ʋ nɛ-belliŋ a lɩɩ baga kʋkɔ. Ʋ pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ nɛ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ba yiyel?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ wɩɩ-la Jabɛs nɩaa sɩ bʋla a to pʋ.

english_verse: Then the Spirit of God suddenly took control of Saul and made him furious.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ, Wɩa Dɩma kʋ jʋʋ-ʋ arɩ doluŋ, ʋ baanɩŋ faasa sii.

english_verse: Saul killed two of his oxen, cut them up in pieces, and gave the pieces to the messengers. He told them to show the pieces to everyone in Israel and say, “Saul and Samuel are getting an army together. Come and join them. If you don't, this is what will happen to your oxen!” The Lord made the people of Israel terribly afraid. So all the men came together
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛsɛ nɛ-belliŋ balɩa, a kaa keri muno muno, a paa tɩŋ nɩaa ba kaa gɔllɛ Iziral tinteeŋ kala, a heele bʋl, “Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ vɩa dɩ ʋ to Sɔɔl arɩ Samʋɛl harɩŋ a mʋ laalɩŋ, ŋɩɩ Sɔɔl sɩ ŋaa ʋ nɛ-belliŋ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba jaŋ joŋo ŋaa nɩɩ-la ma nɛ-belliŋ lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ fawʋllʋŋ faasa kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ba kala sii kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a ŋaa nii-bala.

english_verse: Saul and his officers sent the messengers back to Jabesh with this promise: “We will rescue you tomorrow afternoon.” The messengers went back to the people at Jabesh and told them that they were going to be rescued. Everyone was encouraged!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ tɩndaara-la sɩ kɛŋ duoso lɩɩ Jabɛs sɩ hɛ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ lɛ a kɔ, “Má mʋ a bʋla pɩ ma nɩaa, chiemiŋ wɩɩ-hɛɛ-siesee ma jaŋ na laatanɩŋ.” Tɩndaara-la sɩ mɩɩra mʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la pɩ Jabɛs nɩaa, ba tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala.

english_verse: So they told the Ammonites, “We will surrender to you tomorrow, and then you can do whatever you want to.”
translation_verse: Ba bʋla pɩ Amɔŋ tɩmma-la, “Chie la jaŋ sɛyɛ pɩma, wɩɩ-la kala ma sɩ cho, ma jaŋ wuo ŋaa la lɛ.”

english_verse: The next day, Saul divided his army into three groups and attacked before daylight. They started killing Ammonites and kept it up until afternoon. A few Ammonites managed to escape, but they were scattered far from each other.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ-la Sɔɔl kɛŋ ʋ nɩaa a kpaa leree batori. Sɩɩ-pʋʋraa ba guu jʋʋ Amɔŋ tɩmma-la dɩhɔnʋŋ, a kpʋba ŋɩɩ halɩɩ a mʋ yi wɩɩ-hɛɛ-siesee. Ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka fá pɩsɛ tintee-la lɛ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ na nɩaa balɩa ma dɩ baa to dɔŋɔ. Ba wasa leŋ Sɔɔl kuoruŋ chɩŋ

english_verse: The Israelite soldiers went to Samuel and demanded, “Where are the men who said they didn't want Saul to be king? Bring them to us, and we will put them to death!”
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛɛlɛ pɩɛsɛ Samʋɛl, “Nɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ pɩɛsa arɩ Sɔɔl jaŋ wuo dii kuoruŋ a beŋ la nyuŋ hɛ? Má kɛsɛba kaa kɔ dɩ la kpʋ.”

english_verse: “No you won't!” Saul told them. “The Lord rescued Israel today, and no one will be put to death.” Saul Is Accepted as King
translation_verse: Ama Sɔɔl bʋl, “Aɩ, má sɩ́ nʋʋkala kpʋ jɩnɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa jɩnɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta.”

english_verse: “Come on!” Samuel said. “Let's go to Gilgal and make an agreement that Saul will continue to be our king.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Má kɔ dɩ la kala mʋ Gɩlɩgal, a chaasa wasa leŋ dɩ Sɔɔl kuoruŋ chɩŋ.”

english_verse: Everyone went to the place of worship at Gilgal, where they agreed that Saul would be their king. Saul and the people sacrificed animals to ask for the Lord's blessing, and they had a big celebration.
translation_verse: Ba kala sii mʋ Gɩlɩgal, a mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a chaasa bil Sɔɔl kuoruŋ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ba kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala gbieli gbieli-bal kuorii-la bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Samuel told the Israelites: I have given you a king, just as you asked.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala, “Mɩ jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ, a bil kuoro pɩma dɩ ʋ bibemma.

english_verse: You have seen how I have led you ever since I was a young man. I'm already old. My hair is gray, and my own sons are grown. Now you must see how well your king will lead you.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ ma kɛŋ kuoro nɛ dɩ ʋ laa ma sɩpaaŋ. Mɩ-na hɩɛsa nɛ, mɩ nyuŋ kala pʋllɛ. Mɩ kɛŋ biiriŋ nɛ ma tʋɔŋ. Mɩ hambiiriŋ kala lɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa ma sɩpaalaarʋ, a kaa kʋ yi jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: Let me ask this. Have I ever taken anyone's ox or donkey or forced you to give me anything? Have I ever hurt anyone or taken a bribe to give an unfair decision? Answer me so the Lord and his chosen king can hear you. And if I have done any of these things, I will give it all back.
translation_verse: Mɩ chɩŋ daha nɛ dɩ mɩ pɩɛsɛma: dɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nʋʋ lɛ, tɩɩna kʋ lɩɩ bʋl La TƖƖNA arɩ kuoru-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa sɩpaaŋ. Ma kʋbɛɛ nɛŋ nɛ mɩ ha kaa laa? Ma kʋbɛɛ kakumo nɛ mɩ ha kaa laa? Mɩ ha gʋrɛ ma kʋŋ koo a dɔgɩsɛ ma kʋŋ? Ma kʋbɛɛ teeŋ nɛ mɩ ha laa kpalaa ŋɩɩ leŋ mɩ bɩ mɩ sɩaa wuo kaa suri? Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kʋŋ ma dɔŋɔ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra tiŋ tɩɩna.”

english_verse: Samuel said, “The Lord and his chosen king are witnesses to what you have said.” “That's true,” they replied.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl bɩra bʋl, “La TƖƖNA arɩ kuoru-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa nɛ pɛ na jɩnɩŋ, arɩ ma kʋŋkala kɩaa tuo mɩ teeŋ.” Ba bʋl, “La TƖƖNA pɛ na nɛ.”

english_verse: Then Samuel told them: The Lord brought your ancestors out of Egypt and chose Moses and Aaron to be your leaders.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl bʋla pɩba, “La TƖƖNA nɛ lɩɩsɛ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ, a kɛŋ ma naabalɩmaba kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Now the Lord will be your judge. So stand here and listen, while I remind you how often the Lord has saved you and your ancestors from your enemies.
translation_verse: Má chɩŋ daha, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl ma wɩaa nɛ a liisima La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, a mʋ tɩgɛ wʋduoru-la kala La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa a laa ma dɩ ma nyɩmmaba ta.

english_verse: After Jacob went to Egypt, your ancestors cried out to the Lord for help, and he sent Moses and Aaron. They brought your ancestors out of Egypt and led them here to settle this land.
translation_verse: Jekɔb arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa sɩ mʋ hɔŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa dɔgɩsɛba, ma naabalɩmaba-la yele pɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA tɩŋ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ, ba mʋ a kɛŋ ma naabalɩmaba lɩɩ nɩmɛ kɔ, a leŋ ba hɔŋ leriŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: But your ancestors forgot the Lord, so he let them be defeated by the Philistines, the king of Moab, and Sisera, the commander of Hazor's army.
translation_verse: Ama ma naabalɩmaba yʋ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩaa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa arɩ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa kuoro arɩ Hazɔ tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩsɛra yuo diiba.

english_verse: Again your ancestors cried out to the Lord for help. They said, “We have sinned! We stopped worshiping you, our Lord, and started worshiping Baal and Astarte. But now, if you rescue us from our enemies, we will worship you.”
translation_verse: Ba bɩra yele pɩ La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ a bʋl, ‘La ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, la sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA, aŋ mɩɩra tuto vesi-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal arɩ Asɩtarɔf. Ama lɛɛlɛ, laala ta la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, la jaŋ tutoŋ.’

english_verse: The Lord sent Gideon, Bedan, Jephthah, and Samuel to rescue you from your enemies, and you didn't have to worry about being attacked.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA hɛ Jerub-Baal, Barak, Jɛfɩta arɩ mɩ-na Samʋɛl, la kʋŋkala nɛ wuo laama ta ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ma wuo hɔŋ, wɩɩkala bɩ maa walɩmɛ.

english_verse: Then you saw that King Nahash of Ammon was going to attack you. And even though the Lord your God is your king, you told me, “This time it's different. We want a king to rule us!”
translation_verse: Ama ma sɩ na dɩ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Nahas ka chɛ ʋ yuoma, ma vɩa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ paala ŋaa ma kuoro nɛ, aŋ bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Laa chɛ kuoro nɛ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ la.’

english_verse: You asked for a king, and you chose one. Now he stands here where all of you can see him. But it was really the Lord who made him your king.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, na kuoru-la ma sɩ lɩɩsa nɛ ŋ-la, ma nɛ pɩɛsa chɩchɛ kuoro. La TƖƖNA joŋu pɩma nɛ dɩ ʋ bibemma.

english_verse: If you and your king want to be followers of the Lord, you must worship him and do what he says. Don't be stubborn!
translation_verse: Wɩɩkala jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ pɩ ma dɩ kuoru-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ bibemma, dɩ ma dɩ ʋ kala nɩɩ fá La TƖƖNA Wɩa, a tɩma pʋpʋ, a sɛyɛ tuto wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: If you're stubborn and refuse to obey the Lord, he will turn against you and your king.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ bɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ to, aŋ chichei wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga, ʋ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ ma dɩ ma kuoru-la kala arɩ ʋ fa sɩ dɔgɩsɛ ma nyɩmmaba ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Just stand here and watch the Lord show his mighty power.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má chɩŋ daha a na wʋbal-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ma sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Isn't this the dry season? I'm going to ask the Lord to send a thunderstorm. When you see it, you will realize how wrong you were to ask for a king.
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ lɛ ŋaa tafaaŋ nɛ. Ama mɩ jaŋ sʋl La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ taŋ dɔŋ, dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ lɛɛlɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ma chaasa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, ma sɩ bʋla pʋ arɩ maa chɛ kuoro nɛ.”

english_verse: Samuel prayed, and that same day the Lord sent a thunderstorm. Everyone was afraid of the Lord and of Samuel.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl sɩ sʋl La TƖƖNA, tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ taŋ dɔŋ, duonuŋ nɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala chaasa fɩfá La TƖƖNA arɩ Samʋɛl.

english_verse: They told Samuel, “Please, pray to the Lord your God for us! We don't want to die. We have sinned many times in the past, and we were very wrong to ask for a king.”
translation_verse: Ba kala bʋla pɩ Samʋɛl, “Laa sʋlʋŋ, sʋl ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa a pɩ la-na ŋ tɩntɩnnaa dɩ la sɩ́ sʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa la na dɩ la ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ a pɛ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, la sɩ bʋla arɩ laa chɛ kuoro nɛ.”

english_verse: Samuel answered: Even though what you did was wrong, you don't need to be afraid. But you must always follow the Lord and worship him with all your heart.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl bʋl, “Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma, ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba kala nɛ, ama má sɩ́ harɩŋ joŋo yɩa La TƖƖNA, má tou arɩ ma tʋɔŋ kala.

english_verse: Don't worship idols! They don't have any power, and they can't help you or save you when you're in trouble.
translation_verse: Má pɔ ma sɩ́ mʋ tuto tɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ bɩ bʋbʋa kala kɛnɛ. Ba bɩ wʋzɔŋ kala wuo ŋaa pɩpɩma, ba bɩra bɩ ma wuo laa tɩta ma, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa kʋpɛɩba nɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord has chosen you to be his own people. He will always take care of you so that everyone will know how great he is.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩ-balɩŋ wɩaa, ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ vɩa ʋ nɩaa ta, ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛma ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: I would be disobeying the Lord if I stopped praying for you! I will always teach you how to live right.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ vɩa dɩ mɩ sʋl Wɩa pɩma. Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ La TƖƖNA lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dagɛma wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ a magɛ dɩ ma ŋɩŋaa.

english_verse: You also must obey the Lord—you must worship him with all your heart and remember the great things he has done for you.
translation_verse: Má hɛ doluŋ aŋ fá La TƖƖNA, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a tutou arɩ ma tʋɔŋ kala. Má liisi wʋbala-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa pɩma wɩaa.

english_verse: But if you and your king do evil, the Lord will wipe you out.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ vɩa aŋ ha pɛsɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ chei ma dɩ ma kuoru-la kala ta.”

english_verse: The messengers then said to the people of Israel, “Saul has destroyed the Philistine army camp at Geba. Now the Philistines really hate Israel, so every town and village must send men to join Saul's army at Gilgal.”
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nɩɩ duoso-la, arɩ Sɔɔl mʋ chei Fɩlɩsɩtɩa laalɩyuoroo buguŋ nɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛɛlɛ ŋaa nɩa Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩ chaasa bɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩndaara-la yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala ba mʋ Gɩlɩgal a pɛ kuoro Sɔɔl lɛ.

english_verse: The Israelite army realized that they were outnumbered and were going to lose the battle. Some of the Israelite men hid in caves or in clumps of bushes, and some ran to places where they could hide among large rocks. Others hid in tombs or in deep dry pits.
translation_verse: Ba sɩɩ yuo laalɩŋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa na dɩ ba tɔ ba laalɩyuoroo hɛ nɛ, leriŋ lɩma pɩba, ba dɔnsʋŋ jʋʋ faa bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ lɛ, tɩɩ-lugunuŋ tʋɔŋ, bʋ-pɛgɩsɩŋ lɛ, buotuonuŋ tʋɔŋ, arɩ vilee tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Still others went to Gad and Gilead on the other side of the Jordan River. Saul stayed at Gilgal. His soldiers were shaking with fear,
translation_verse: Ba dɔnsʋŋ paala fá a chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, a mʋ Gad arɩ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ. Ka Sɔɔl-na ha hɛ Gɩlɩgal lɛ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ laalɩyuoro-la kala sɩ hɛ ʋ teeŋ ba chichel.

english_verse: and they were starting to run off and leave him. Saul waited there seven days, just as Samuel had ordered him to do, but Samuel did not come.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl gbɛrɛ Samʋɛl Gɩlɩgal lɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ, arɩ Samʋɛl sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pʋ, ama Samʋɛl bɩ Gɩlɩgal kɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoro-la kala sɩ hɛ Sɔɔl teeŋ tapʋlɩa-la balɩpɛ suomo pɩpɩsɛ kʋŋ kʋŋ.

english_verse: Finally, Saul commanded, “Bring me some animals, so we can offer sacrifices to please the Lord and ask for his help.” Saul killed one of the animals,
translation_verse: Sɔɔl fa bʋla pɩba, “Má kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ arɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kʋ pɩmɛ, dɩ mɩ kaa sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA a sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ la lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la.

english_verse: and just as he placed it on the altar, Samuel arrived. Saul went out to welcome him.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la a dɩdɛrɛ, dɩ Samʋɛl ma kɔ. Sɔɔl lɩɩ chemu a lɔllʋ.

english_verse: “What have you done?” Samuel asked. Saul answered, “My soldiers were leaving in all directions, and you didn't come when you were supposed to. The Philistines were gathering at Michmash,
translation_verse: Samʋɛl pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ?” Sɔɔl bʋl, “Mɩ na dɩ mɩ laalɩyuoro-la ka pɩsɛ nɛ, ka bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ sɩ ŋ jaŋ kɔ, ŋ bɩ kɔ. Ka Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa ma kʋ hilimi Mɩkɩmas lɛ.

english_verse: and I was worried that they would attack me here at Gilgal. I hadn't offered a sacrifice to ask for the Lord's help, so I forced myself to offer a sacrifice on the altar fire.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩɩnɛ arɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa jaŋ kʋ yuomi Gɩlɩgal lɛ, ka mɩ ha bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa dɩ La TƖƖNA pɛ mɩ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ dɩ ʋ maga dɩ mɩ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.”

english_verse: “That was stupid!” Samuel said. “You didn't obey the Lord your God. If you had obeyed him, someone from your family would always have been king of Israel.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl bʋl, “Nɩyaarɛ wɩɩ nɛ ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Wɩɩ-la ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩŋ dɩ ŋ to nɛ ŋ vɩa ŋɩɩ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ fa tou, ʋ fa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ doho nɩaa nɛ didii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: But no, you disobeyed, and so the Lord won't choose anyone else from your family to be king. In fact, he has already chosen the one he wants to be the next leader of his people.”
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ ŋ doho nɩaa dee bɩra bɩ jaŋ didii kuoruŋ. La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ ʋ tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ʋ nɩaa sɩpaalaara, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ bɩ ʋ niiŋ lɛ to.”

english_verse: Then Samuel left Gilgal. Part of Saul's army had not deserted him, and he led them to Gibeah in Benjamin to join his other troops. Then he counted them and found that he still had
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl lɩɩ Gɩlɩgal lɛ a mʋ Gɩbɩa sɩ hɛ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ, laalɩyuori kaana-la sii to Sɔɔl harɩŋ. Sɔɔl sɩ dɩɩsɛ laalɩyuoro-la fa sɩ hɛ ʋ teeŋ, ba ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩdʋ nɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩ laalɩyuori kɩaa kɛnɛ

english_verse: Saul, Jonathan, and their army set up camp at Geba in Benjamin. Jonathan Attacks the Philistines The Philistine army was camped at Michmash.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ nanʋala Jonataŋ arɩ laalɩyuoro-la kala sɩ hɛ ba teeŋ faa chʋa Gɩbɩa sɩ hɛ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ, ka Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa ma ŋmoo ba buguŋ Mɩkɩmas lɛ.

english_verse: Each day they sent out patrols to attack and rob villages and then destroy them. One patrol would go north along the road to Ophrah in the region of Shual.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa kpaa leree batori ba dɩhɔnʋŋ, dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ. Dɔŋɔ to Ɔfɩra sɩ hɛ Sʋal tinteeŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a mʋmʋ,

english_verse: Another patrol would go west along the road to Beth-Horon. A third patrol would go east toward the desert on the road to the ridge that overlooks Zeboim Valley.
translation_verse: dɔŋɔ ma to Bɛf Horoŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, ka tori tɩɩna ma to tintee-la bʋa, lee-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ chɩŋ aŋ bibeŋ Zeboyim fuonaa-la, a chaasɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: The Philistines would not allow any Israelites to learn how to make iron tools. “If we allowed that,” they said, “those worthless Israelites would make swords and spears.”
translation_verse: Libiru kala fa tuo Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa bɩ leŋe ba gʋnnɛ libiŋ. Ba sɩ, “Dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ jɩŋ libiŋ, ba jaŋ libi ba tɩtɩa tokobiee koo tiŋŋee!”

english_verse: Whenever the Israelites wanted to get an iron point put on a cattle prod, they had to go to the Philistines. Even if they wanted to sharpen plow-blades, picks, axes, sickles, and pitchforks they still had to go to them. And the Philistines charged high prices.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ kpallɛ nɛsɩŋ pire koo piri-saa, ba yie laa warɩpʋla balɩa nɛ. Ka dɩ ba nɛ taa saa-balɩŋ koo sɩɩ-kɔrɔ, ba yie laa warɩpʋla kʋbala nɛ.

english_verse: So, whenever the Israelite soldiers had to go into battle, none of them had a sword or a spear except Saul and his son Jonathan.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yuo laalɩŋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kʋbala ma bɩ tokobiiŋ koo tiŋ kɛnɛ. Sɔɔl arɩ Jonataŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: The Philistines moved their camp to the pass at Michmash,
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa fa leŋe ba laalɩyuoroo dɔnsʋŋ mʋ pɔ wombii-bie-la sɩ hɛ peelee tʋɔŋ Mɩkɩmas lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Jonathan decided to get to the Philistine camp by going through the pass that led between Shiny Cliff and Michmash to the north and Thornbush Cliff and Geba to the south.
translation_verse: Bʋsʋ-la dɔŋɔ chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ, a chaasa Mɩkɩmas. Ka dɔŋɔ ma chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a ma chaasa Geba.

english_verse: Jonathan and the soldier who carried his weapons talked as they went toward the Philistine camp. “It's just the two of us against all those godless men,” Jonathan said. “But the Lord can help a few soldiers win a battle just as easily as he can help a whole army. Maybe the Lord will help us win this battle.”
translation_verse: Jonataŋ bɩra bʋla pɩ ʋ bapʋɔsɩ-bie-la sɩɩ kori ʋ laalɩyuori kɩaa, “Kɔ dɩ la chol a mʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la sɩ bɩ la Wɩa ka to leriŋ. Kapo La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ la lɛ. Wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ wuo pɔ dɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ́ la laa ta, dɩ la yʋga koo dɩ la bɩ yʋgɛ.”

english_verse: “Do whatever you want,” the soldier answered. “I'll be right there with you.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kori ʋ laalɩyuori kɩaa bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la kala ŋ sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ŋ ŋaa, ŋaa. Mɩ chɩŋ ŋ harɩŋ nɛ arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala.”

english_verse: “This is what we will do,” Jonathan said. “We will go across and let them see us.
translation_verse: Jonataŋ bɩra bʋl, “Kɔ dɩ la chol a tʋʋlɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la a leŋ dɩ ba nala.

english_verse: If they agree to come down the hill and fight where we are, then we won't climb up to their camp.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ sɩ, ‘Má chɩŋ nɩmɛ dɩ la kɔ,’ la jaŋ chɩŋ, la bɩ jaŋ mʋ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: But we will go if they tell us to come up the hill and fight. That will mean the Lord is going to help us win.”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba nɛ bɩra sɩ, ‘Ma kʋ jɩl la teeŋ,’ la jaŋ jɩl, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋɩɩ daga arɩ La TƖƖNA jomba hɛ la nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Jonathan and the soldier stood at the bottom of the hill where the Philistines could see them. The Philistines said, “Look! Those worthless Israelites have crawled out of the holes where they've been hiding.” Then they yelled down to Jonathan and the soldier, “Come up here, and we will teach you a thing or two!” Jonathan turned to the soldier and said, “Follow me! The Lord is going to let us win.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ lee-la kpɩa Jonataŋ arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kori ʋ laalɩyuori kɩaa lɛ a bʋl, “Má kʋ jɩl la teeŋ dɩ la dagɛma wʋjɩmɩŋ.” Jonataŋ bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kori ʋ laalɩyuori kɩaa, “Kɔ dɩ la jɩl, La TƖƖNA jomba hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Jonathan crawled up the hillside with the soldier right behind him. When they got to the top, Jonathan killed the Philistines who attacked from the front, and the soldier killed those who attacked from behind.
translation_verse: Jonataŋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa arɩ ʋ naasɩŋ nɛ pɛrɩsɛ jɩl, ka nɩɩ-la ma sɩ kori ʋ laalɩyuori kɩaa tuto. Ʋ sɩ jɩla, ʋ ŋmoo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la lulo, ka bapʋɔsɩ-bie-la ma kpʋba a tuto.

english_verse: I wish you had eaten some of the food the Philistines left behind. We would have been able to kill a lot more of them.”
translation_verse: Bee na, dɩ nɩalɩŋ nɛ fa dii kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo laa ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ teeŋ mʋa jɩnɩŋ, ba fa jaŋ kpʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la a kɩɩ ŋ-la.”

english_verse: Saul quickly called his army together, then led them to the Philistine camp. By this time the Philistines were so confused that they were killing each other.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a mʋ laal-la. Ba sɩ mʋa, ba na dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa nɩaa wɩɩkala chaasa vʋgʋmɛ, ba tɩtɩa gʋraa ta dɔŋɔ arɩ tokobiee.

english_verse: The whole Philistine army panicked—those in camp, those on guard duty, those in the fields, and those on raiding patrols. All of them were afraid and confused. Then God sent an earthquake, and the ground began to tremble. Israel Defeats the Philistines
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ fawʋllʋŋ chaasa kɛŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kala, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ba buguŋ lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yuo laalɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tinteeŋ zigili. Wɩa nɛ joŋ fawʋllɩɩ-la a hɛ ba kala lɛ.

english_verse: Saul's lookouts at Geba saw that the Philistine army was running in every direction, like melted wax.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔba Gɩbɩa sɩ hɛ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ, beŋ a na dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa nɩaa laalɩyuoroo wɩɩkala vʋgʋma, ba fá pɩsɛ leriŋ kala.

english_verse: Saul told his officers, “Call the roll and find out who left our camp.” When they had finished, they found out that Jonathan and the soldier who carried his weapons were missing.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ laalɩyuoro-la sɩ hɛ ʋ teeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ, “Má dɩɩsɛ laalɩyuoro-la kala a na kʋbɛɛ nɛ tuo.” Ba sɩ dɩɩsa, ba na dɩ Jonataŋ arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kori ʋ laalɩyuori kɩaa nɛ tuo.

english_verse: Just as Saul finished saying this, he could see that the Philistine army camp was getting more and more confused, and he said, “Ahijah, never mind!”
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara teeŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ wɩaa wasa vʋgʋmɛ kɩŋkɛŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la buguŋ lɛ ba ŋɩŋaa goŋ. Sɔɔl bɩra bʋla pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, “Leŋee wiesi.”

english_verse: There were also some hired soldiers in the Philistine camp, who now switched to Israel's side and fought for Saul and Jonathan.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ fa sɩ hɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, a to mʋ lee-la Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋmoo ba buguŋ dɩ ba yuo Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ba leŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa aŋ mɩɩra mʋ pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ a yuo pɩpɩ Sɔɔl arɩ Jonataŋ.

english_verse: Many Israelites had been hiding in the hill country of Ephraim. And when they heard that the Philistines were running away, they came out of hiding and joined in chasing the Philistines.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ fa sɩ faa Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ sɩ nɩa dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa ka fá nɛ, ba kala kʋ lɩɩ pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ. Ba chaasa kire to Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa harɩŋ.

english_verse: So the Lord helped Israel win the battle that day. Saul's Curse on Anyone Who Eats Saul had earlier told his soldiers, “I want to get even with those Philistines by sunset. If any of you eat before then, you will be under a curse!” So he made them swear not to eat. By the time the fighting moved past Beth-Aven, the Israelite troops were weak from hunger.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la losuŋ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo ba na hɛɛŋ woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Sɔɔl fa ŋmɩɛsa nɛ a bʋl, “Dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ mɩ baanɩŋ joŋo fɩɩsɛ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ jɩnɩŋ, ka dɩ ma kʋŋ dii kɩaa, ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii tɩɩna.” Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nʋʋkala bɩ kʋŋ die.

english_verse: The army and the people who lived nearby had gone into a forest, and they came to a place where honey was dripping on the ground. But no one ate any of it, because they were afraid of being put under the curse.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ jʋʋ duuŋ tʋɔŋ, ba na dɩ tʋʋŋ gbu lɩlɩɩ tinteeŋ, ka ba kʋŋkala bɩ taga hɛ ʋ niiŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛmba nɛ a tɩŋ Sɔɔl ŋmɩaŋ-la wɩaa.

english_verse: Jonathan did not know about Saul's warning to the soldiers. So he dipped the end of his walking stick in the honey and ate some with his fingers. He felt stronger and more alert.
translation_verse: Ama Jonataŋ-na fa bɩ nɩa dɩ ʋ nyɩmma ŋmɩɛsa pɩ nɩalɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ dantɩga ʋ sɩ koro niiŋ a tɔɔ tʋʋ-jaga dɔŋɔ, a kaa jɩla lenni. Ʋ yaraa guu polli.

english_verse: Then a soldier told him, “Your father swore that anyone who ate food today would be put under a curse, and we agreed not to eat. That's why we're so weak.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoro-la dɔŋɔ bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ nyɩmma ŋmɩɛsa pɩ laalɩyuoroo kala nɛ a bʋl, ‘Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ dii kʋŋ jɩnɩŋ, ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii tɩɩna.’ Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ nɩalɩŋ kala yaraa yʋɔrɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Jonathan said, “My father has caused you a lot of trouble. Look at me! I ate only a little of this honey, but already I feel strong and alert.
translation_verse: Jonataŋ bʋl, “Mɩ nyɩmma hɛ wɩɩŋ ʋ tinteeŋ nɩaa lɛ. Mɩ sɩ lenni tʋʋ-la mʋa, mɩ yaraa kala nɛ pollo.

english_verse: By evening the Israelite army was exhausted from killing Philistines all the way from Michmash to Aijalon.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ chɩŋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɩkɩmas, aŋ kpʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ a mʋ yi Aɩjalɔŋ, ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, ba chaasa lɔl nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: They grabbed the food they had captured from the Philistines and started eating. They even killed sheep and cows and calves right on the spot and ate the meat without draining the blood.
translation_verse: Ba tuoŋi kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo laa ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ teeŋ, a kɛsɛ piesee, nɛsɩŋ arɩ nɛ-biisiŋ a kpʋ jaasɛ leriŋ kala, a chɩchaŋ arɩ chalɩŋ.

english_verse: Someone told Saul, “Look! The army is disobeying the Lord by eating meat before the blood drains out.” “You're right,” Saul answered. “They are being unfaithful to the Lord! Hurry! Roll a big rock over here.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋ dɔŋ hɛ duoso pɩ Sɔɔl, “Nɩalɩŋ ka ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ La Tɩɩna teeŋ, ba sɩɩ chaŋ nammɩa arɩ chalɩŋ.” Sɔɔl bʋl, “Ma joŋ ma Wɩa laa diiniŋ ta nɛ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Má bilimi tabɩɩ-balɩŋ kaa kɔ daha lɩma.”

english_verse: Then tell everyone in camp to bring their cattle and lambs to me. They can kill the animals on this rock, then eat the meat. That way no one will disobey the Lord by eating meat with blood still in it.” That night the soldiers brought their cattle over to the big rock and killed them there.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Má lɩɩ nɩalɩŋ teeŋ a bʋla pɩba, ‘Má kʋŋkala kɛŋ nɛsɩŋ arɩ piesee kaa kɔ mɩ teeŋ daha a kpʋ a chaŋ. Má sɩ́ ba dɩ chalɩŋ chaŋ, a ŋaa wʋbɔŋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ.’ ” Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋkala kɛŋ ʋ pʋna kʋ kpʋ nɩmɛ tɩtaŋ-la.

english_verse: It was the first altar Saul had built for offering sacrifices to the Lord. The Army Rescues Jonathan
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA. Ʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-bumbuŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ saa.

english_verse: Saul said, “Let's attack the Philistines again while it's still dark. We can fight them all night. Let's kill them and take everything they own!” The people answered, “We will do whatever you want.” “Wait!” Ahijah the priest said. “Let's ask God what we should do.”
translation_verse: Sɔɔl bɩra bʋl, “Má leŋ la tuu yuo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa tɩtaŋɩŋ a paa ba kɩaa ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi sɩɩpʋʋraa. Má leŋ la kpʋ ba kala.” Nɩalɩŋ bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la kala sɩ zɔmɔ a pɩŋ, ŋaa.” Ama Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara sɩ, “Má leŋ dɩ la laa sɩpaaŋ pɩɛsɛ Wɩa daha a na.”

english_verse: Saul asked God, “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help us win?” This time God did not answer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl pɩɛsɛ Wɩa, “Mɩ mʋ yuo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa? Ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa yuo diibaa?” Tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla pʋ.

english_verse: Saul called his army officers together and said, “We have to find out what sin has kept God from answering.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa Sɔɔl bʋl, “Má nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaaraa, má kɔ la chɛ na wʋbɔŋ-la la sɩ ŋaa jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: I swear by the living Lord that whoever sinned must die, even if it turns out to be my own son Jonathan.” No one said a word.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ weye a laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa tɩta wɩaa, mɩ ŋmɩɛsa, dɩ mɩ bie Jonataŋ ma nɛ paala ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la, ʋ maga ba kpʋʋ nɛ.” Ka nɩalɩŋ kala tɔrɛ ba niiŋ.

english_verse: Saul told his army, “You stand on that side of the priest, and Jonathan and I will stand on the other side.” Everyone agreed.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl bɩra bʋl Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ, “Má kala mʋ chɩŋ daha, ka mɩ dɩ mɩ nanʋala Jonataŋ ma chɩŋ daha.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la kala sɩ zɔmɔ a pɩŋ, ŋaa.”

english_verse: Then Saul prayed, “Our Lord, God of Israel, why haven't you answered me today? Please show us who sinned. Was it my son Jonathan and I, or was it your people Israel?” The answer came back that Jonathan or Saul had sinned, not the army.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl sʋl La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa a bʋl, “Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, dagɛmɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ cheye. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna teeŋ jegile jɩnɩŋ? Dɩ cheeriŋ lɩɩ mɩ nɛ koo mɩ bie Jonataŋ nɛ, to Urim lɛ a leŋ la jɩŋ. Ama dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ nɛ cheeriŋ lɩɩ, to Tumim lɛ a leŋ la jɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ Jonataŋ arɩ Sɔɔl Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Saul told Ahijah, “Now ask the Lord to decide between Jonathan and me.” The answer came back that Jonathan had sinned.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl bʋl, “Má tɔnsɔ pɩ mɩ dɩ Jonataŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tɔnsɛ, ʋ kɛŋ Jonataŋ.

english_verse: “Jonathan,” Saul exclaimed, “tell me what you did!” “I dipped the end of my walking stick in some honey and ate a little. Now you say I have to die!”
translation_verse: Sɔɔl bʋla pɩ Jonataŋ, “Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa, bʋla pɩmɛ.” Jonataŋ bʋl, “Mɩ dantɩga niiŋ nɛ mɩ kaa tagɛ tʋʋŋ mʋa a kaa jɩla lenni. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa wɩɩ nɛ a magɛ dɩ mɩ sʋʋ?”

english_verse: “Yes, Jonathan. I swear to God that you must die.”
translation_verse: Sɔɔl bʋl, “A leŋ dɩ Wɩa dɔgɩsɛmɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ leŋe ba kpʋ ŋ-na Jonataŋ.”

english_verse: “No!” the soldiers shouted. “God helped Jonathan win the battle for us. We won't let you kill him. We swear to the Lord that we won't let you kill him or even lay a hand on him!” So the army kept Saul from killing Jonathan.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoro-la kala bɩ sɛyɛ, aŋ ŋaa goŋ a bʋla pɩ Sɔɔl, “Jonataŋ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ chaasa laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta nɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ sʋʋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa. La TƖƖNA sɩ weye wɩaa, ʋ nyu-pʋŋ ma bɩ maga dɩ ʋ churo tel. Wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa jɩnɩŋ, Wɩa nɛ pɛ ʋ lɛ.” Ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ a laa Jonataŋ ta, ba bɩ ʋ kpʋa.

english_verse: Saul stopped hunting down the Philistines, and they went home. Saul Fights His Enemies
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ Sɔɔl bɩra bɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa harɩŋ kire, ka ʋ dɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo mɩɩra mʋ ba tinteeŋ.

english_verse: When Saul became king, the Moabites, the Ammonites, the Edomites, the kings of Zobah, the Philistines, and the Amalekites had all been robbing the Israelites. Saul fought back against these enemies and stopped them from robbing Israel. He was a brave commander and always won his battles. Saul's Family
translation_verse: Ʋ chaasa yuo laalɩŋ nɛ woruŋ arɩ baalɩŋ, a yuo dii Amalɛk tɩmma-la, aŋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ yie yuo diiba aŋ paa ba kɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Sɔɔl dɩa nɩaa

english_verse: Saul was at war with the Philistines for as long as he lived. Whenever he found a good warrior or a brave man, Saul made him join his army.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, ʋ dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa chaasa yuo laalɩŋ nɛ woruŋ. Dɩ Sɔɔl nɛ na nɩduo koo bɔɩ-duo tɩɩna na-kala, ʋ yie kɛnʋ pɛ ʋ laalɩyuoroo lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: One day, Samuel told Saul: The Lord told me to choose you to be king of his people, Israel. Now listen to this message from the Lord:
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Samʋɛl bʋla pɩ Sɔɔl, “La TƖƖNA tɩmmɛ nɛ, mɩ joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ a tɩsɩŋ, ŋ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: “When the Israelites were on their way out of Egypt, the nation of Amalek attacked them. I am the Lord All-Powerful, and now I am going to make Amalek pay!
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa a tɩŋ ba fa sɩ kɛrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wombiiŋ lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kʋkɔ.

english_verse: “Go and attack the Amalekites! Destroy them and all their possessions. Don't have any pity. Kill their men, women, children, and even their babies. Slaughter their cattle, sheep, camels, and donkeys.”
translation_verse: Mʋ a yuo Amalɛk tɩmma-la a chei kʋŋ na-kala ba sɩ kɛnɛ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ kʋŋ ka. Kpʋ baalaa, haalaa, hambiisiŋ arɩ bii-mulluŋ, nɛsɩŋ arɩ piesee, bʋntaŋŋaba arɩ kakusuŋ kala.’ ”

english_verse: Saul sent messengers who told every town and village to send men to join the army at Telaim. There were
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl yɩrɛ laalɩyuoro-la kala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛlɛm lɛ. Laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ vɛŋ naasɩŋ lɛ a lɩɩ Iziral tinteeŋ ŋaa bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩa nɛ, ka bʋɩ fii ma lɩɩ Juda tinteeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told Samuel,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Samʋɛl,

english_verse: then led them to a valley near one of the towns in Amalek, where they got ready to make a surprise attack.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoro-la sii mʋ Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa taŋ, a tuu faa fuonaaŋ sɩ luŋie lɛ, a pɔ.

english_verse: Some Kenites lived nearby, and Saul told them, “Your people were kind to our nation when we left Egypt, and I don't want you to get killed when I wipe out the Amalekites. So stay away from them.” The Kenites left,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl bʋla pɩ Keni tɩŋŋaa, “Má pɔrɛ ma tɩtɩa a lɩɩ Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ, dɩ mɩ sɩ́ ma pɛ kpʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma fa kɛŋ zile nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a kʋkɔ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Keni tɩmma-la pɔrɛ ba tɩtɩa a lɩɩ Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Every Amalekite was killed except King Agag.
translation_verse: Ʋ kpʋ Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa kala nɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ba kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Agag.

english_verse: Saul and his army let Agag live, and they also spared the best sheep and cattle. They didn't want to destroy anything of value, so they only killed the animals that were worthless or weak. The Lord Rejects Saul
translation_verse: Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo bɩ kuoro Agag-na kpʋa, a pɛ ba pʋŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, piesee, nɛsɩŋ, nɛ-bii-nɛrɛɛ arɩ pie-pɔrɔɔ arɩ kʋŋ na-kala sɩ zɔmɔ pɩba. Ama kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ zɔmɔ pɩba, ba kala nɛ ba chei a pɛ pʋsʋ-la sɩ pugumo lɛ.

english_verse: “Saul has stopped obeying me, and I'm sorry that I made him king.” Samuel was angry, and he cried out in prayer to the Lord all night.
translation_verse: “Mɩ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ cheye mɩ sɩ leŋe Sɔɔl dii kuoruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ joŋ harɩŋ a yɩamɛ nɛ, a bɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga ka to.” Wɩɩ-la walɩmɛ Samʋɛl woruŋ, ʋ bɛrɛ doŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala a sʋl La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Early the next morning he went to talk with Saul. Someone told him, “Saul went to Carmel, where he had a monument built so everyone would remember his victory. Then he left for Gilgal.”
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla chʋchʋɔŋ, ʋ sii mʋ Sɔɔl leriŋ dɩ ʋ naʋ, ama nʋʋ bʋla pʋ, “Sɔɔl mʋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kamɛl. Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ tabɩaa saa kʋŋ ʋ ŋaa magɩl a pɩ ʋ tɩtɩa, dɩ nɩaa liliisi ʋ wɩaa, aŋ lɩɩ nɩmɛ mʋ Gɩlɩgal.”

english_verse: Samuel finally caught up with Saul, and Saul told him, “I hope the Lord will bless you! I have done what the Lord told me.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Samʋɛl sɩ kʋ na Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl chʋɔlʋ aŋ bʋl, “La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ! Mɩ to wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ daga nɛ.”

english_verse: “Then why,” Samuel asked, “do I hear sheep and cattle?”
translation_verse: Samʋɛl pɩɛsɛ, “Ka bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ nɩɩ piesee arɩ nɛsɩŋ yele?”

english_verse: “The army took them from the Amalekites,” Saul explained. “They kept the best sheep and cattle, so they could sacrifice them to the Lord your God. But we destroyed everything else.”
translation_verse: Sɔɔl bʋl, “Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa teeŋ nɛ laalɩyuoro-la kɛsɛba lɩɩ. Ba leŋ piese-la arɩ nɛsɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ dɩ ba kaa kpʋ sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ a pɩ ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa, kʋkaana na-kala nɛ la kpʋ.”

english_verse: “Stop!” Samuel said. “Let me tell you what the Lord told me last night.” “All right,” Saul answered.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl bʋla pɩ Sɔɔl, “Chɩna magɛ ŋɩɩ! Leŋ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA dɩa sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ a pɩŋ.” Sɔɔl bʋl, “Bʋla pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: Samuel continued, “You may not think you're very important, but the Lord chose you to be king, and you are in charge of the tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl bʋl, “Bumbuŋ kala, ŋ tɩtɩa fa bene arɩ ŋ bɩ nʋʋ ŋaa nɛ. Ŋ dee saa bɩ kʋ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho doho-la kala sɩpaalaara ŋɩɩ? La TƖƖNA nɛ lɩɩsɩŋ ŋ ŋaa ba kuoro.

english_verse: Why didn't you listen to the Lord? Why did you keep the animals and make him angry?”
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ lɛ to? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ sɩɩŋ fɩɛsɛ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ yuo laa lɛ, a ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ?”

english_verse: “But I did listen to the Lord!” Saul answered. “He sent me on a mission, and I went. I captured King Agag and destroyed his nation.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl bʋl, “Mɩ to La TƖƖNA niiŋ nɛ, mɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ sɩ mɩ tɩŋ nɛ. Mɩ chaasa kpʋ Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa kala nɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ba kuoro Agag kʋweeŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: All the animals were going to be destroyed anyway. That's why the army brought the best sheep and cattle to Gilgal as sacrifices to the Lord your God.”
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ la sɩ yuo laa tʋɔŋ nɛ laalɩyuoro-la kɛsɛ piesee arɩ nɛsɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ ba ŋaa Wɩa kɩaa, dɩ ba kpʋ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ Gɩlɩgal lɛ a pɩ ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa.”

english_verse: “Tell me,” Samuel said. “Does the Lord really want sacrifices and offerings? No! He doesn't want your sacrifices. He wants you to obey him.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl pɩɛsɛ, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA chɩchɛ, kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koo ba sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koo nʋʋ sɩ to ʋ niiŋ lɛ nɛ? Dɩ ŋ nɛ to ʋ niiŋ ʋ nɛ kpɩa ŋ sɩ kpʋ pie-belliŋ sɩ zɔmɔ a nyɩga ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋ.

english_verse: Rebelling against God or disobeying him because you are proud is just as bad as worshiping idols or asking them for advice. You refused to do what God told you, so God has decided that you can no longer be king.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ vɩa ʋ niiŋ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ a nagɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ vʋgʋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ sɩɩ-duoŋ, ŋɩɩ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ ʋ teeŋ a nagɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa. Ŋ sɩ bɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ lɛ to ŋɩɩ, ʋ ma kiriŋ kuoruŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: “I have sinned,” Saul admitted. “I disobeyed both you and the Lord. I was afraid of the army, and I listened to them instead.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl bʋla pɩ Samʋɛl, “Mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ. Mɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ nɛ, a bɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga ma to. Mɩ nɩaa sɩɩŋ nɛ mɩ fá, a ŋaa wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: Please forgive me and come back with me so I can worship the Lord.”
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, joŋ mɩ wʋbɔŋ-la chɛmɛ, aŋ to mɩ harɩŋ dɩ la mɩɩra mʋ, dɩ mɩ wuo zil La TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: “No!” Samuel replied, “You disobeyed the Lord, and I won't go back with you. Now the Lord has said that you can't be king of Israel any longer.”
translation_verse: Ama Samʋɛl bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ to ŋ harɩŋ mʋ. Ŋ vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ nɛ, ʋ ma kiriŋ nɛ, ŋ bɩra bɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoru ŋaa.”

english_verse: As Samuel turned to go, Saul grabbed the edge of Samuel's robe. It tore!
translation_verse: Samʋɛl sɩ mɩɩra dɩ ʋ viiri, Sɔɔl guu kɛŋ ʋ gɛrɩŋ niipiniŋ lɛ ʋ kɩɛsɛ.

english_verse: Samuel said, “The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel away from you today, and he will give it to someone who is better than you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ Sɔɔl, “Jɩnɩŋ, La TƖƖNA kɛŋ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoruŋ laa ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ arɩ doluŋ, a joŋo pɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ sɩ kpɩaŋ.

english_verse: Besides, the eternal God of Israel isn't a human being. He doesn't tell lies or change his mind.”
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋla, ʋ bɩ wɩaa ka nyɩɛ koo aa bɩrɩmɛ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa. Ʋ bɩ nuhuobiiŋ ŋaa, a kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩbɩrɩmɛ.”

english_verse: Saul said, “I did sin, but please honor me in front of the leaders of the army and the people of Israel. Come back with me, so I can worship the Lord your God.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl bʋl, “Mɩ jɩma mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, ama mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ zilmi mɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaaŋ, aŋ to mɩ harɩŋ dɩ la mʋ, dɩ mɩ wuo zil ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa.”

english_verse: Samuel followed Saul back, and Saul worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl mɩɩra to ʋ harɩŋ ba mʋ, Sɔɔl zil La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Then Samuel shouted, “Bring me King Agag of Amalek!” Agag came in chains, and he was saying to himself, “Surely they won't kill me now.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl bʋl, “Má kɛŋ Agag, Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa kuoru-la kɔ mɩ teeŋ.” Agag nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ aŋ mʋ, a bɩɩnɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ maga dɩ ba kpʋmɛ kiele nɛ.”

english_verse: But Samuel said, “Agag, you have snatched children from their mothers' arms and killed them. Now your mother will be without children.” Then Samuel chopped Agag to pieces at the place of worship in Gilgal.
translation_verse: Ama Samʋɛl bʋl, “Ŋ sɩ kpʋ nɩaa biiriŋ, ka ba naamba hɔŋ arɩ na-hɩllɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋ naaŋ ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ na-hɩllɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ kpʋ Agag La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ Gɩlɩgal lɛ.

english_verse: Samuel went home to Ramah, and Saul returned to his home in Gibeah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl sii lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ ʋ jaŋ Rama, ka Sɔɔl ma mʋ ʋ jaŋ Gɩbɩa.

english_verse: Even though Samuel felt sad about Saul, Samuel never saw him again. The Lord Chooses David To Be King The Lord was sorry he had made Saul the king of Israel.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl yele pɩ Sɔɔl nɛ, ama ʋ kaa mʋʋ sʋʋ dɩ ʋ sɩɩŋ bɩra bɩ Sɔɔl na. La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ fa cheye nɛ woruŋ ʋ sɩ leŋe Sɔɔl dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: One day he said, “Samuel, I've rejected Saul, and I refuse to let him be king any longer. Stop feeling sad about him. Put some olive oil in a small container and go visit a man named Jesse, who lives in Bethlehem. I've chosen one of his sons to be my king.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala La TƖƖNA pɩɛsɛ Samʋɛl, “Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ chei Sɔɔl wɩaa a diene magɛ? Mɩ folo kiru nɛ, ʋ bɩra bɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoru ŋaa. Ŋaa nʋʋŋ a su loŋ, a mʋ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm. Baal kʋbala nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ baa yɩrɛ Jesi. Mʋ ʋ dɩa. Mɩ lɩɩsɛ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ.”

english_verse: Samuel answered, “If I do that, Saul will find out and have me killed.” “Take a calf with you,” the Lord replied. “Tell everyone that you've come to offer it as a sacrifice to me,
translation_verse: Samʋɛl bʋl, “Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa a mʋ? Dɩ Sɔɔl nɛ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ʋ jaŋ kpʋmɛ.” La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Kɛŋ na-paha aŋ bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ pɩɛsɩŋ, ‘Mɩ kaa kɔ dɩ mɩ kpʋ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ.’

english_verse: then invite Jesse to the sacrifice. When I show you which one of his sons I have chosen, pour the olive oil on his head.”
translation_verse: Yɩrɛ Jesi dɩ ʋ ma kɔ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la leriŋ, mɩ jaŋ dagɩŋ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa. Ŋ jaŋ joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ a tɩsɛ nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa a pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: Samuel did what the Lord told him and went to Bethlehem. The town leaders went to meet him, but they were terribly afraid and asked, “Is this a friendly visit?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl ŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla. Ʋ sɩ mʋ yi Bɛtɩlɛhɛm, nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ kʋ lɩɩ a chemu, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba. Ba pɩɛsɛ, “Ba fɩɛlaa?”

english_verse: “Yes, it is!” Samuel answered. “I've come to offer a sacrifice to the Lord. Get yourselves ready to take part in the sacrifice and come with me.” Samuel also invited Jesse and his sons to come to the sacrifice, and he got them ready to take part.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl bʋl, “Ba fɩɛla nɛ. Mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ nɛ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA. Má pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ ta, aŋ kɔ dɩ la mʋ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la leriŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɩsɛ Jesi arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ ma disiniŋ ta, aŋ yɩrɛ ba ma, dɩ ba kʋ pɛ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: When Jesse and his sons arrived, Samuel noticed Jesse's oldest son, Eliab. “He has to be the one the Lord has chosen,” Samuel said to himself.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋa, Samʋɛl na Jesi hambolibii-hɩaŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛlɩab, a bɩɩnɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Nɩa deeŋ sɩ chɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ daha, ʋ nɛ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa.”

english_verse: But the Lord told him, “Samuel, don't think Eliab is the one just because he's tall and handsome. He isn't the one I've chosen. People judge others by what they look like, but I judge people by what is in their hearts.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Samʋɛl, “Sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ zɔmɔ koo ʋ sɩ waayi lɛ beŋ, ʋ dee mɩ lɩɩsɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA bɩ kɩalɩŋ nuhuobiine sɩɩ beŋ nɩɩ beŋ. Nuhuobiine yie beŋ yaraa zɔmʋŋ lɛ nɛ, ka mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA ma bibeŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesse told his son Abinadab to go over to Samuel, but Samuel said, “No, the Lord hasn't chosen him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jesi yɩrɛ ʋ nanʋala Abɩnadab ʋ kʋ to Samʋɛl sɩpaaŋ a mʋ. Samʋɛl bʋl, “Ʋ ma dee La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ.”

english_verse: Next, Jesse sent his son Shammah to him, and Samuel said, “The Lord hasn't chosen him either.”
translation_verse: Jesi bɩra yɩrɛ dɔŋɔ ma ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sama, ʋ kʋ bal. Samʋɛl bɩra bʋl, “Nɩa deeŋ ma dee La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ.”

english_verse: One by one, Jesse told all seven of his sons to go over to Samuel. Finally, Samuel said, “Jesse, the Lord hasn't chosen any of these young men.
translation_verse: Jesi ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ a leŋ ʋ hambolibiisi-la balɩpɛ kala to Samʋɛl sɩpaaŋ a bal, ama ʋ bʋla pʋ, “La TƖƖNA bɩ ba kʋŋkala lɩɩsa.”

english_verse: Do you have any other sons?” “Yes,” Jesse answered. “My youngest son David is out taking care of the sheep.” “Send for him!” Samuel said. “We won't start the ceremony until he gets here.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl pɩɛsɛ Jesi, “Ŋ hambolibiisiŋ kala nɛ ŋɩɩ?” Jesi bʋl, “Ba tʋɔŋ kʋbie ha hɛ nɩmɛ, ama ʋ mʋ pie-daalɩŋ.” Samʋɛl bʋl, “Tɩŋ dɩ ba mʋ kɛnʋ kɔ, la bɩ jaŋ hɔŋ see dɩ ʋ kɔ.”

english_verse: Jesse sent for David. He was a healthy, good-looking boy with a sparkle in his eyes. As soon as David came, the Lord told Samuel, “He's the one! Get up and pour the olive oil on his head.”
translation_verse: Jesi tɩŋ ba mʋ kɛnʋ kɔ. Ʋ fa ŋaa bapʋɔsɩ-fɩaŋ zɔŋ-bie nɛ, ʋ sɩɩ-biee ma kala tʋtʋl. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Samʋɛl, “Nɩɩ-la nɛ ŋɩɩ, joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ a tɩsɛ ʋ nyuŋ.”

english_verse: Samuel poured the oil on David's head while his brothers watched. At that moment, the Spirit of the Lord took control of David and stayed with him from then on. Samuel returned home to Ramah. David Plays the Harp for Saul
translation_verse: Samʋɛl joŋ loŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ a wansa tɩsʋ ʋ naambiiri-la kala sɩpaaŋ. A chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la a kaa mʋ, La TƖƖNA Dɩma kʋ hɛ Devit lɛ a pʋ doluŋ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ Samʋɛl mɩɩra mʋ Rama. Sɔɔl joŋ Devit ʋ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord had left Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord was terrifying him.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Dɩma-la lɩɩ Sɔɔl lɛ, ka La TƖƖNA leŋ dɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ mɩɩra kʋ jʋʋ-ʋ, a wʋwalɩmʋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: “It's an evil spirit from God that's frightening you,” Saul's officials told him.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl tɩntɩnnaa bʋla pʋ, “Wɩa leŋe jɩŋ-bɔŋ nɛ hɛ ŋ lɛ a wʋwalɩmɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: “Your Majesty, let us go and look for someone who is good at playing the harp. He can play for you whenever the evil spirit from God bothers you, and you'll feel better.”
translation_verse: La nɩhɩaŋ, pɩla wombiiŋ dɩ la chɛ nʋʋ sɩ jɩŋ cheŋ dunuŋ, dɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la nɛ sii ŋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ du cheŋ-la a pɩŋ dɩ ŋ yaraa bɩra kpɩa mʋa.”

english_verse: “All right,” Saul answered. “Find me someone who is good at playing the harp and bring him here.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl bʋl ʋ tɩntɩnna-la lɛ, “Má chɛ nʋʋ sɩ chaasa jɩŋ cheŋ dunuŋ woruŋ a kaa kʋ pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: “A man named Jesse who lives in Bethlehem has a son who can play the harp,” one official said. “He's a brave warrior, he's good-looking, he can speak well, and the Lord is with him.”
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnna-la dɔŋɔ bʋl, “Mɩ jɩŋ Jesi sɩ lɩɩ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm nanʋal kʋbala lɛ nɛ, ʋ chaasa jɩŋ cheŋ dunuŋ nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ ŋaa bɔɩ-duo tɩɩna nɛ, a ŋaa bayuoru. Ʋ ŋaa bapʋɔsɛ-zɔŋ nɛ, a jɩŋ wɩaa bʋlʋŋ woruŋ. La TƖƖNA chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Saul sent a message to Jesse: “Tell your son David to leave your sheep and come here to me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Jesi, “Leŋ dɩ ŋ nanʋala Devit, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ daa ŋ piesee kɔ mɩ teeŋ.”

english_verse: Jesse loaded a donkey with bread and a goatskin full of wine, then he told David to take the donkey and a young goat to Saul.
translation_verse: Jesi sii a kɛŋ ʋ nanʋala Devit, a leŋ kakumo chʋŋ boroboro, ʋ hɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ a su puruŋ a kɛŋ bʋ-keeŋ pɛ a leŋ Devit kaa mʋ pɩ Sɔɔl.

english_verse: David went to Saul and started working for him. Saul liked him so much that he put David in charge of carrying his weapons.
translation_verse: Devit mʋ Sɔɔl teeŋ a tɩma pʋpʋ. Ʋ cho ʋ wɩaa woruŋ a leŋ ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ dɔŋɔ sɩɩ kori ʋ laalɩyuori-kɩaa.

english_verse: Not long after this, Saul sent another message to Jesse: “I really like David. Please let him stay with me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl tɩŋ ba bʋla pɩ Jesi, “Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, leŋ dɩ Devit hɛ mɩ teeŋ a tɩmaa pɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Whenever the evil spirit from God bothered Saul, David would play his harp. Saul would relax and feel better, and the evil spirit would go away.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala lɛ, dɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ sii Sɔɔl lɛ, Devit yie joŋ cheŋ nɛ a du, jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la leŋu, ka ʋ yaraa pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The Philistines got ready for war and brought their troops together to attack the town of Socoh in Judah. They set up camp at Ephes-Dammim, between Socoh and Azekah.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo sii kʋ hilimi Juda tinteeŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Soko lɛ, dɩ ba mʋ yuo laalɩŋ a ŋmoo ba buguŋ Ɛfɩs Damɩm sɩ hɛ Soko arɩ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Azɩka pɛgɛ.

english_verse: The Philistine army had a hero named Goliath who was from the town of Gath and was about three meters tall.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ a ŋaa laalɩyuori babiibal, baa yɩrɛ Golɩaf, ʋ lɩɩ Gaf nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kʋ lɩɩ a mɩmagɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Ʋ duomuŋ ka mʋa ʋ yi naakieliŋ butori.

english_verse: He wore a bronze helmet and had bronze armor to protect his chest and legs. The chest armor alone weighed about
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ kɔlɩɩŋ patuosiba a bɛ tɔ ʋ naasɩŋ, aŋ joŋ tokobiiŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ libi a laalɛ.

english_verse: When David came back from fighting Goliath, he was still carrying Goliath's head. Abner took David to Saul,
translation_verse: Devit sɩ kpʋ Golɩaf Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna-la bʋa-la lɛ aŋ mɩɩra kɔ, Abɩna pʋʋra kɛnʋ mʋ Sɔɔl sɩpaaŋ, dɩ Golɩaf nyuŋ ha paala hɛ Devit nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and his spear was so big that the iron spearhead alone weighed about seven kilograms. A soldier always walked in front of Goliath to carry his shield.
translation_verse: Ʋ timiŋ chaasa barɩmɛ nɛ woruŋ ʋ kori. Tiŋ-la niipiniŋ hɔɔŋ dʋndʋŋa yuŋuŋ ŋaa kilo balɩpɛ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ kori hɔɔtaala-la Golɩaf sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori-hɛŋŋɛɛ laa ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Goliath went out and shouted to the army of Israel: Why are you lining up for battle? I'm the best soldier in our army, and all of you are in Saul's army. Choose your best soldier to come out and fight me!
translation_verse: Golɩaf lɩɩ chɩŋ aŋ kpɩa goŋ Iziral laalɩyuoroo teeŋ a bʋl, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma kʋ lɩɩ chɩŋ dɩ ma yuo laalɩŋ? Mɩ ŋaa Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna nɛ, ka ma ma ŋaa Sɔɔl tɩntɩnnaa. Má lɩɩsɛ baal ma tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ kʋ tuu chemmi dɩ la yuo dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: If he can kill me, our people will be your slaves. But if I kill him, your people will be our slaves.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ wuo yuo a kpʋmɛ, la jaŋ ŋaa ma yosi a tɩma pɩpɩma, ama dɩ mɩ ma nɛ wuo yuo a kpʋʋ, ma ma jaŋ ŋaa la yosi a tɩma pɩpɩla.”

english_verse: Here and now I challenge Israel's whole army! Choose someone to fight me!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna-la bɩra bʋl, “Jɩnɩŋ mɩɩ tʋʋsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kala joŋŋoo nɛ. Má lɩɩsɛ baal dɩ ʋ kɔ dɩ la yuo dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: Saul and his men heard what Goliath said, but they were so frightened of Goliath that they couldn't do a thing. David Decides To Challenge Goliath
translation_verse: Sɔɔl arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna-la sɩ bʋla, fawʋllʋŋ faasa kɛmba, ba kala kpaŋ.

english_verse: David's father Jesse was an old man, who belonged to the Ephrath clan and lived in Bethlehem in Judah. Jesse had eight sons:
translation_verse: Devit nyɩmma nɛ fa Jesi. Jesi ŋaa Yufireti tɩɩna nɛ, a lɩɩ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ chori nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ Sɔɔl sɩ dii kuoruŋ, dɩ Jesi hɩɛsa woruŋ.

english_verse: He took care of his father's sheep, and he went back and forth between Bethlehem and Saul's camp.
translation_verse: ka Devit yie lɩɩ Sɔɔl teeŋ bʋa dɔŋɔ a mʋ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm dɩ ʋ beŋ ʋ nyɩmma piesee.

english_verse: Goliath came out and gave his challenge every morning and every evening for
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna-la yie kʋ lɩɩ a magɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ dɩdaanɩŋ kala ŋɩɩ tapʋlaa mahɩŋ balɩa.

english_verse: and picked up his shepherd's stick. He went out to a stream and picked up five smooth rocks and put them in his leather bag. Then with his sling in his hand, he went straight toward Goliath. David Kills Goliath
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ joŋ ʋ dantɩga, a tʋɔsɛ tabɩaa sɩ ŋaa mʋla mʋla kɩaa banɔŋ fuoŋ sɩɩ pɛllʋ lɛ, a joŋo hɛ ʋ pie-daarɩ-lʋaga lɛ, aŋ kori kpalɩŋ ma ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a mʋ kpagɛ Golɩaf Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna-la.

english_verse: One day, Jesse told David, “Hurry and take this sack of roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread to your brothers at the army camp.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala, Jesi bʋla pɩ ʋ nanʋala Devit, “Laa mɩɩ-halaa gbansɩŋ banɔŋ arɩ boroboroba fii, a ŋaa lɩma a kaa mʋ ŋ naambiiriŋ buguŋ a pɩba.

english_verse: And here are ten large chunks of cheese to take to their commanding officer. Find out how your brothers are doing and bring back something that shows that they're all right.
translation_verse: Laa na-yɩl-nʋʋ-gulimoo fii a pɛ a kaa mʋ pɩ laalɩyuoru-hɩaŋ-la sɩɩ bemba, aŋ pɛ na wɩalɩŋ ŋ naambiiriŋ sɩɩ ŋaa, a laa kʋŋ ba teeŋ kaa kɔ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ ba kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa nɛ.

english_verse: They're with Saul's army, fighting the Philistines in Elah Valley.”
translation_verse: Ŋ naambiiri-la arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nɛ hɛ Sɔɔl teeŋ Ɛla fuonaa-la lɛ a yuyuo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa.”

english_verse: David obeyed his father. He got up early the next morning and left someone else in charge of the sheep; then he loaded the supplies and started off. He reached the army camp just as the soldiers were taking their places and shouting the battle cry.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla, Devit sii a leŋ piesee pɩ pie-daarʋ dɔŋ, aŋ paa kʋdiile-la lɩɩ mʋ, arɩ Jesi sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ mʋʋ yi ba buguŋ, dɩ laalɩyuoro-la lɩɩ chɩchɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa, aŋ ŋɩŋaa laalɩyuori-goŋ.

english_verse: The army of Israel and the Philistine army stood there facing each other.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa kala kʋ lɩɩ chɩŋ a chaasɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ.

english_verse: David left his things with the man in charge of supplies and ran up to the battle line to ask his brothers if they were well.
translation_verse: Devit leŋ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ kaa mʋ, a pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ ba laalɩyuoro-la kɩaa, aŋ fá mʋ laal-la leriŋ a chʋɔlɛ ʋ malɩmaba.

english_verse: While David was talking with them, Goliath came out from the line of Philistines and started boasting as usual. David heard him.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ba teeŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori babiibal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Golɩaf, a lɩɩ Gaf, dɩ ʋ bɩra tʋɔra lɩɩ chɩŋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ kpɩa goŋ a mɩmagɩsɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ vɛnɛɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Devit nɩɩ.

english_verse: When the Israelite soldiers saw Goliath, they were scared and ran off.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ na baal-la, fawʋllʋŋ chaasa kɛmba, ba fá.

english_verse: They said to each other, “Look how he keeps coming out to insult us. The king is offering a big reward to the man who kills Goliath. That man will even get to marry the king's daughter, and no one in his family will ever have to pay taxes again.”
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la lɛɛlɛ bʋbʋl, “Ŋ-na baala deeŋ sɩ kʋ lɩɩ chɩŋ nɛɛ? Ʋʋ tʋʋsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa joŋŋoo nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ wuo kpʋʋ, kuoro jaŋ pɩ tɩɩna dʋa a yʋgɛ. Ʋ jaŋ joŋ ʋ tolo ma pʋ dɩ ʋ jaa, aŋ leŋ dɩ tɩɩna arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala bɩra sɩ́ lampoo tiŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: David asked some soldiers standing nearby, “What will a man get for killing this Philistine and stopping him from insulting our people? Who does that worthless Philistine think he is? He's making fun of the army of the living God!”
translation_verse: Devit pɩɛsɛ laalɩyuoro-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ chɩna kpagʋ, “Ma sɩ bɛɛ nɛ ba jaŋ ŋaa pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kpʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa baala deeŋ a lɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hɩɩsɩŋ lɛ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ka Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna deeŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to, aa tʋʋsɛ Wɩa-la sɩ weye laalɩyuoroo joŋŋoo?”

english_verse: The soldiers told David what the king would give the man who killed Goliath.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra bʋl wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ wuo kpʋ Golɩaf a pɩ Devit.

english_verse: David's oldest brother Eliab heard him talking with the soldiers. Eliab was angry with him and said, “What are you doing here, anyway? Who's taking care of your little flock of sheep out in the desert? You spoiled brat! You came here just to watch the fighting, didn't you?”
translation_verse: Devit malɩma Ɛlɩab sɩ nɩa dɩ Devit ka bʋl wɩaa laalɩyuoro-la teeŋ, ʋ baanɩŋ faasa sii ʋ nyuŋ kɩŋkɛŋ ʋ pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ kɔ daha? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ joŋ piese-la baŋmɛnɛ pa pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ? Mɩ jɩŋ ŋ nyuduoŋ arɩ ŋ tʋɔhɛɛŋ wɩaa nɛ, ŋ kɔ dɩ ŋ na ŋɩɩ la sɩɩ yuo laalɩŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: “Now what have I done?” David answered. “Can't I even ask a question?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa? Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa?”

english_verse: Then he turned and asked another soldier the same thing he had asked the others, and he got the same answer.
translation_verse: Devit bɩra mʋ laalɩyuoro-la dɔŋɔ ma teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ pɩɛsɛ laalɩyuoroo dɔnsʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ma bɩra bʋl wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa ba sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pʋ.

english_verse: Some soldiers overheard David talking, so they told Saul what David had said. Saul sent for David, and David came.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala Devit sɩ bʋla, ba mʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala a pɩ Sɔɔl. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl tɩma yɩrʋ.

english_verse: “Your Majesty,” he said, “this Philistine shouldn't turn us into cowards. I'll go out and fight him myself!”
translation_verse: Devit bʋla pɩ Sɔɔl, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, nʋʋkala sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ bɔyɛ joŋ a tɩŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna-la wɩaa, mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna jaŋ mʋ yuou.”

english_verse: “You don't have a chance against him,” Saul replied. “You're only a boy, and he's been a soldier all his life.”
translation_verse: Sɔɔl ma bʋla pɩ Devit, “Ŋ ŋaa bii-bie nɛ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo mʋ yuo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna-la, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ŋaa laalɩyuoru nɛ ʋ hambiiriŋ kala lɛ.”

english_verse: But David told him: Your Majesty, I take care of my father's sheep. And when one of them is dragged off by a lion or a bear,
translation_verse: Devit bɩra bʋla pɩ Sɔɔl, “Mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna nɩɩ beŋ mɩ nyɩmma piesee. Bʋa na-kala dɩ naachigiŋ koo lʋgʋmʋŋ nɛ kʋ kɛŋ piese-la kʋŋ,

english_verse: I go after it and beat the wild animal until it lets the sheep go. If the wild animal turns and attacks me, I grab it by the throat and kill it.
translation_verse: mɩ yie kire ŋmobu nɛ a laa piesu-la ʋ niiŋ lɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ sii hosi mɩ nyuŋ, mɩ yie kɛŋ ʋ yikori-ŋmʋlʋŋ lɛ nɛ, aŋ ŋmobu kpʋ.

english_verse: Sir, I have killed lions and bears that way, and I can kill this worthless Philistine. He shouldn't have made fun of the army of the living God!
translation_verse: Mɩ kpʋ naachigee arɩ lʋgʋmaa nɛ woruŋ, Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa baala deeŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to ma jaŋ nagɛ ba dɔŋɔ mɩ teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ tʋʋsɛ Wɩa-la sɩ weye laalɩyuoroo joŋoo nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued me from the claws of lions and bears, and he will keep me safe from the hands of this Philistine. “All right,” Saul answered, “go ahead and fight him. And I hope the Lord will help you.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsɛmɛ naachigee arɩ lʋgʋmaa niiŋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsɛmɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna deeŋ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl bʋla pɩ Devit, “Mʋ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ chɩŋ ŋ harɩŋ.”

english_verse: Saul had his own military clothes and armor put on David, and he gave David a bronze helmet to wear.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl paa ʋ laalɩyuori gɛnnɩŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa, a nyɩgɩlɛ Devit. Ʋ joŋ nyunchu-gbaŋkogo ma ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa, a pʋ ʋ chu.

english_verse: David strapped on a sword and tried to walk around, but he was not used to wearing those things. “I can't move with all this stuff on,” David said. “I'm just not used to it.” David took off the armor
translation_verse: Devit joŋ ʋ tokobiiŋ a vɔɔ mɛrɛ laalɩyuori-gɛrɩ-la lɛ a kaa gʋgɔllɛ dɩ ʋ na, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ ba laala mal. Devit bʋla pɩ Sɔɔl, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ kɩaa deemba mʋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ wuri gɛnnɩ-la bil.

english_verse: Goliath came toward David, walking behind the soldier who was carrying his shield.
translation_verse: Dɩ Golɩaf arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoru-la sɩɩ kori hɔɔtaala-la ʋ sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori-hɛŋŋɛɛ ma kʋ kpagɛ Devit.

english_verse: When Goliath saw that David was just a healthy, good-looking boy, he made fun of him.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna-la sɩ na Devit dɩ ʋ ŋaa bapʋɔsɩ-fɩaŋ zɔŋ-bie, ʋ bee gʋʋnʋ.

english_verse: “Do you think I'm a dog?” Goliath asked. “Is that why you've come after me with a stick?” He cursed David in the name of the Philistine gods
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛ Devit, “Vaha nɛ mɩ ŋaa, ŋ kori daaŋ kʋkɔ mɩ lɛɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kalɩbɛ ʋ vesiŋ a hɛ Devit lɛ,

english_verse: and shouted, “Come on! When I'm finished with you, I'll feed you to the birds and wild animals!”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl, “Kɔ daha dɩ mɩ kɛnɩŋ pʋɔsa pɩ zaaraa arɩ baga kɩaa dɩ ba dii.”

english_verse: David answered: You've come out to fight me with a sword and a spear and a dagger. But I've come out to fight you in the name of the Lord All-Powerful. He is the God of Israel's army, and you have insulted him too!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit ma bʋla pʋ, “Ŋŋ kɔ mɩ lɛ arɩ tokobiiŋ arɩ timiŋ nɛ, ama mɩ-naa kɔ ŋ lɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa Iziral laalɩyuoroo Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ joŋŋoo nɛ ŋ tʋʋsɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Today the Lord will help me defeat you. I'll knock you down and cut off your head, and I'll feed the bodies of the other Philistine soldiers to the birds and wild animals. Then the whole world will know that Israel has a real God.
translation_verse: Jɩnɩŋ La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋuŋ hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ kpʋŋ a keri ŋ nyuŋ. Jɩnɩŋ mɩ jaŋ joŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo deemba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ a pɩ zaaraa arɩ baga kɩaa dɩ ba dii. Ŋɩɩ nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ jɩŋ dɩ Iziral Wɩa nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: Everybody here will see that the Lord doesn't need swords or spears to save his people. The Lord always wins his battles, and he will help us defeat you.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ daha jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ tokobiiŋ koo timiŋ dee La TƖƖNA kaa laa nɩaa tɩta. La TƖƖNA nɛ yie yuo didii ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ jaŋ joŋ ma kala a hɛ la nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: When Goliath started forward, David ran toward him.
translation_verse: Golɩaf sɩ kʋ kpagɛ dɩ ʋ yuo Devit, Devit guu fá mʋ dɩ ʋ chemu.

english_verse: He put a rock in his sling and swung the sling around by its straps. When he let go of one strap, the rock flew out and hit Goliath on the forehead. It cracked his skull, and he fell facedown on the ground.
translation_verse: Devit tʋʋ ʋ lʋaga tʋɔŋ a lɩɩsɛ tabɩɩŋ hɛ kpalɩŋ lɛ a kaa viisi viisi, aŋ yagɛ Golɩaf tile lɛ. Tabɩɩ-la mʋʋra jʋʋ ʋ tile, ʋ tuu tele chu.

english_verse: David defeated Goliath with a sling and a rock. He killed him without even using a sword.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit yuo dii Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna-la arɩ kpalɩŋ. Ʋ bɩ tokobiiŋ ma koro, aŋ yuo dii Golɩaf a kpʋʋ.

english_verse: David ran over and pulled out Goliath's sword. Then he used it to cut off Goliath's head. When the Philistines saw what had happened to their hero, they started running away.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit fá mʋ chugili Golɩaf lɛ, a kɛŋ Golɩaf tokobiiŋ lɛrɛ tʋʋrɛ ʋ pɛɛŋ lɛ, a keri Golɩaf nyuŋ arɩ tokobii-la. Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩ na dɩ ba ba-nyantʋɔrɛ sʋba, ba mɩɩra fá.

english_verse: But the soldiers of Israel and Judah let out a battle cry and went after them as far as Gath and Ekron. The bodies of the Philistines were scattered all along the road from Shaaraim to Gath and Ekron.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Juda tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo ŋaa goŋ aŋ kire to ba harɩŋ a mʋ yi tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gaf arɩ Ɛkʋrɔŋ boi-baalaa. Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa kʋsʋʋnʋŋ fa pɩŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Saarem wombiiŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi Gaf arɩ Ɛkʋrɔŋ.

english_verse: When the Israelite army returned from chasing the Philistines, they took what they wanted from the enemy camp.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kiri Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la a mʋ, ba mɩɩra jʋʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa buguŋ a paa ba kɩaa kala.

english_verse: David took Goliath's head to Jerusalem, but he kept Goliath's weapons in his own tent. David Becomes One of Saul's Officers
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit joŋ Golɩaf nyuŋ a kaa mʋ Jerusalɛm, aŋ paa Golɩaf laalɩyuori kɩaa a bil ʋ-na tɩtɩa Devit lɛbɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: After King Saul had watched David go out to fight Goliath, Saul turned to the commander of his army and said, “Abner, who is that young man?” “Your Majesty,” Abner answered, “I swear by your life that I don't know.”
translation_verse: Sɔɔl fa sɩ na dɩ Devit mʋa dɩ ʋ yuo Golɩaf, ʋ pɩɛsɛ ʋ laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Abɩna, “Abɩna, kʋbɛɛ bie nɛ bapʋɔsɛ bie deeŋ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Tɛŋɛ, kuoro, mɩ bɩ jɩŋ.”

english_verse: “Then find out!” Saul told him.
translation_verse: Kuoro bɩra bʋl, “Pɩɛsɛ a na nɩɩ-la sɩ lʋl bapʋɔsɛ bie deeŋ.”

english_verse: and Saul asked, “Who are you?” “I am David the son of Jesse, a loyal Israelite from Bethlehem.”
translation_verse: Sɔɔl pɩɛsɛ Devit, “Bapʋɔsɩ-bie, kʋbɛɛ bii nɛ ŋ ŋaa?” Devit sɩ, “Ŋ tɩntɩnna Jesi, Bɛtɩlɛhɛm tɩɩna-la nɛ lʋlmɛ.”

english_verse: From that time on, Saul kept David in his service and would not let David go back to his own family.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la a kaa mʋ, Sɔɔl leŋ Devit hɛ ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ bɩra bɩ leŋe ʋ mɩɩra mʋ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa.

english_verse: Jonathan liked David so much that they promised to always be loyal friends.
translation_verse: Jonataŋ sɩ cho Devit arɩ ʋ sɩ cho ʋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ, ʋ hɛ niiŋ a pʋ arɩ ba jaŋ ŋaa nandɔsɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Jonathan took off the robe that he was wearing and gave it to David. He also gave him his military clothes, his sword, his bow and arrows, and his belt.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jonataŋ wuri ʋ gɛrɩ-balɩŋ arɩ ʋ laalɩyuori-gɛrɩŋ a pɩ Devit, a pɛ ʋ tokobiiŋ arɩ toŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie lɛ.

english_verse: David was a success in everything that Saul sent him to do, and Saul made him a high officer in his army. That pleased everyone, including Saul's other officers. Saul Becomes David's Enemy
translation_verse: Dɩ Sɔɔl nɛ tɩŋ Devit dɩ ʋ mʋ ŋaa wɩɩ, ʋ yie ŋaa wɩɩ-la woruŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl leŋ ʋ ŋaa ʋ laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ dɔŋɔ. Sɔɔl tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ wɩɩ-la Sɔɔl sɩ ŋaa pɩ Devit lɛ.

english_verse: David had killed Goliath, the battle was over, and the Israelite army set out for home. As the army went along, women came out of each Israelite town to welcome King Saul. They were celebrating by singing songs and dancing to the music of tambourines and harps.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Devit sɩ kpʋ Golɩaf ka ba mɩɩra kʋkɔ dɩa, haalaa lɩɩ Iziral tasɩŋ kala lɛ, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a gʋa cheŋ kuoro Sɔɔl. Ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ a chɩgɩsɛ chɩnchɩgɩsɩŋ a du kɔnɛba a hɛ.

english_verse: They sang: Saul has killed a thousand enemies; David has killed ten thousand!
translation_verse: Haala-la yɩɩ yɩɩla-la gʋgʋa ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bʋbʋl, “Sɔɔl kpʋ nɩaa bʋɩba nɛ, ka Devit kpʋ bʋɩ fiiba.”

english_verse: This song made Saul very angry, and he thought, “They are saying that David has killed ten times more enemies than I ever did. Next they will want to make him king.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩɩ yɩɩ yɩɩla-la ŋɩɩ, Sɔɔl tʋɔŋ kala chei, ʋ baanɩŋ ma sii kɩŋkɛŋ. Ʋ bʋl ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Ba sɩ Devit kpʋ nɩaa bʋɩ fiiba nɛ, ka mɩ-na kpʋ bʋɩba dʋndʋŋ. Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ saa ka dɩ ʋ laa, dɩ mɩ kuorii-la dee?”

english_verse: Saul never again trusted David.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la, Sɔɔl yaraa bibieri Devit nyuŋ ʋ gɩgɩɛnʋ.

english_verse: The next day the Lord let an evil spirit take control of Saul, and he began acting like a crazy man inside his house. David came to play the harp for Saul as usual, but this time Saul had a spear in his hand.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla Wɩa leŋ jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ guu kʋ jʋʋ Sɔɔl arɩ doluŋ. Ʋ faasaa bʋl wɩaa ʋ dɩa tʋɔŋ a nagɛ nyɩnyɛ-tɩɩna, ka Devit dudu cheŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ vɛnɛɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ dɩ Sɔɔl kori timiŋ.
