english_verse: Saul thought, “I'll pin David to the wall.” He threw the spear at David twice, but David dodged and got away both times.
translation_verse: Ʋ yuo tiŋ-la aŋ bʋl ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Mɩ jaŋ yagɛ Devit a mɛrɛ jeeŋ lɛ.” Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa nɛ, Devit ma wuo nuuro lɩɩ bʋlɩa-la kala.

english_verse: Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was helping David and was no longer helping him.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ Sɔɔl a tɩŋ Devit wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA lɩɩ Sɔɔl harɩŋ nɛ, a mɩɩra chɩŋ Devit harɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord helped David, and he and his soldiers always won their battles.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ na-kala Devit sɩ ŋaa vɛŋ woruŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: This made Saul even more afraid of David.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sɩ na dɩ Devit wɩɩkala ka vɛŋ woruŋ, ʋ chaasa fɩfáʋ woruŋ.

english_verse: But everyone else in Judah and Israel was loyal to David, because he led the army in battle.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ arɩ Juda tinteeŋ kala lɛ cho Devit nɛ woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ laa ba sɩpaaŋ ba wɩaa vɩvɛŋ woruŋ nɛ.

english_verse: One day, Saul told David, “If you'll be brave and fight the Lord's battles for me, I'll let you marry my oldest daughter Merab.” But Saul was really thinking, “I don't want to kill David myself, so I'll let the Philistines do it for me.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Sɔɔl bʋla pɩ Devit, “Na mɩ tol-hɩaŋ Mɛrab nɛ ŋ-la, mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩŋ dɩ ŋ jaa. Ŋ-na kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ a to mɩ niiŋ a yuo La TƖƖNA laalɩŋ.” Sɔɔl bʋla ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Mɩ-na bɩ jaŋ ŋaaʋ wɩɩkala, Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa nɛ jaŋ kpʋʋ pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: David answered, “How could I possibly marry your daughter? I'm not very important, and neither is my family.”
translation_verse: Ama Devit bʋla pɩ Sɔɔl, “Mɩ ma nɛ kʋbɛɛ, mɩ dɩa nɩaa koo mɩ nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa magɛ ɛɛ nɛ Iziral doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a magɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa kuoro hɩɩlɛ-baala?”

english_verse: But when the time came for David to marry Saul's daughter Merab, Saul told her to marry Adriel from the town of Meholah.
translation_verse: Ama bʋa-la sɩ yie dɩ ba joŋ Sɔɔl tolo Mɛrab a pɩ Devit, ba mɩɩra joŋo pɩ Mehola doho nɩaa baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Adɩrɩɛl ʋ jaa.

english_verse: Saul had another daughter. Her name was Michal, and Saul found out that she was in love with David. This made Saul happy,
translation_verse: Sɔɔl fa kɛŋ tolo dɔŋ ma nɛ baa yɩrɛ Mɩkal. Tolo-la dɩma kɛŋ Devit woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl wɩɩ-la pɩ Sɔɔl, ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: and he thought, “I'll tell David he can marry Michal, but I'll set it up so that the Philistines will kill him.” He told David, “I'm going to give you a second chance to marry one of my daughters.”
translation_verse: Sɔɔl bʋl ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ tolo-la pʋ dɩ ʋ jaa, dɩ mɩ to ʋ lɛ a bɛrɛ kɛŋ Devit dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa kpʋʋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl bɩra bʋla pɩ Devit, “Lɛɛlɛ wombiiŋ bɩra pɩna nɛ a pɩŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa mɩ hɩɩlɛ-baala.”

english_verse: Saul ordered his officials to speak to David in private, so they went to David and said, “Look, the king likes you, and all of his officials are loyal to you. Why not ask the king if you can marry his daughter Michal?” “I'm not rich or famous enough to marry princess Michal!” David answered.
translation_verse: Ba bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋlɩa bʋlɩa a pɩ Devit. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛ, “Ma bɩɩna ʋ ŋaa wʋbie nɛ dɩ nʋʋ ŋaa kuoro hɩɩlɛ-baalaa? Mɩ ŋaa summu nɛ, nɩaa ma bɩ mɩ jɩŋ woruŋ.”

english_verse: The officials went back to Saul and told him exactly what David had said.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl tɩntɩnna-la sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ Devit sɩ bʋla pɩba a pɩ Sɔɔl,

english_verse: Saul was hoping that the Philistines would kill David, and he told his officials to tell David, “The king doesn't want any silver or gold. He only wants to get even with his enemies. All you have to do is to bring back proof that you have killed
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl sɩ, “Má bʋla pɩ Devit, ‘Hajaarɛ kɩalɩŋ kala kuoro sɩɩ chɛ nɛ, dɩ ŋ joŋ ʋ baanɩŋ fɩɩsɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, a kpʋ ba nɩaa zɔlɔ a keri ba penee puroo kaa kʋ bil ʋ sɩpaaŋ.’ ” Sɔɔl tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala nɛ, dɩ ʋ joŋ Devit a hɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ.

english_verse: The officials told David, and David wanted to marry the princess. King Saul had set a time limit, and before it ran out,
translation_verse: Sɔɔl tɩntɩnna-la sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ a pɩ Devit, ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa kuoro hɩɩlɛ-baala. Ka dɩ bʋa-la ba sɩ jaŋ jaa dɔŋɔ na yi,

english_verse: King Saul knew that she loved David, and he also realized that the Lord was helping David.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sɩ kʋ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA chɩŋ Devit harɩŋ nɛ, ʋ tolo Mɩkal ma chou,

english_verse: But knowing those things made Saul even more afraid of David, and he was David's enemy for the rest of his life.
translation_verse: fawʋllʋŋ wasa kɛŋ Sɔɔl woruŋ a tɩŋ Devit wɩaa. Ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, ʋ kɛŋ Devit ŋaa ʋ dʋndɔŋ.

english_verse: The Philistine rulers kept coming to fight Israel, but whenever David fought them, he won. He was famous because he won more battles against the Philistines than any of Saul's other officers.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo yie vɛnɛ kɔ a yuyuo Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Dɩ ba nɛ kɔ na-kala, Devit yie yuo diiba nɛ. Ʋ nɛ yuo dii nɩaa kɩɩ Sɔɔl laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ kala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit yɩrɩŋ teeli leriŋ kala.

english_verse: One day, Saul told his son Jonathan and his officers to kill David. But Jonathan and David were best friends,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala nɛ Sɔɔl bʋla pɩ ʋ nanʋala Jonataŋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa kala dɩ ba kpʋ Devit. Ama Jonataŋ arɩ Devit fa mal dɔŋɔ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: and he warned David, “My father is trying to have you killed, so be very careful. Hide in a field tomorrow morning, and I'll bring him there. Then I'll talk to him about you, and if I find out anything, I'll let you know.”
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩ mɩ nyɩmma jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ chɩŋ ŋmaŋkaaŋ lee-la ŋ sɩ faa, dɩ mɩ bʋl ŋ wɩaa pʋ. Wɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩ nɩa ʋ niiŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ.”

english_verse: The next morning, Jonathan reminded Saul about the many good things David had done for him. Then he said, “Why do you want to kill David? He hasn't done anything to you. He has served in your army and has always done what's best for you. He even risked his life to kill Goliath. The Lord helped Israel win a great victory that day, and it made you happy.”
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lenni sʋʋŋ nɛ, a kpʋ Golɩaf. La TƖƖNA nɛ pɛ ʋ lɛ ʋ yuo dii a laa yɩrɩŋ pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala. Bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ na wɩɩ-la, ŋ tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɔ nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ŋ chɩchɛ ŋ kpʋ Devit sɩ bɩ wɩɩkala cheye?”

english_verse: Saul agreed and promised, “I swear by the living Lord that I won't have David killed!”
translation_verse: Sɔɔl jegile nɩɩ Jonataŋ teeŋ aŋ ŋmɩɛsɛ, “La TƖƖNA sɩ weye wɩaa, mɩ bɩ jaŋ kpʋ Devit.”

english_verse: Jonathan went to David and told him what Saul had said. Then he brought David to Saul, and David served in Saul's army just as he had done before.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jonataŋ yɩrɛ Devit a bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ bʋla a pʋ, aŋ kɛŋ Devit kɔ Sɔɔl teeŋ, ʋ tɩma pʋpʋ arɩ ʋ fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ tɩtɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The next time there was a war with the Philistines, David fought hard and forced them to retreat. Michal Helps David Escape
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ laalɩŋ bɩra sii. Devit lɩɩ a chaasa yuo dii Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa, ba fá.

english_verse: One night, David was in Saul's home, playing the harp for him. Saul was sitting there, holding a spear, when an evil spirit from the Lord took control of him. Saul tried to pin David to the wall with the spear, but David dodged, and it stuck in the wall. David ran out of the house and escaped.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl nɛrɩgɛ dɩ ʋ yagɛ Devit mɛrɛ jeeŋ lɛ arɩ tiŋ-la. Devit wuo nuuro lɩɩ, tiŋ-la bɩ ʋ kɛnɛ, aŋ mʋ jʋʋ jeeŋ. Tɩtaŋ-la Devit lɩɩ fá mʋ ʋ dɩa.

english_verse: Saul sent guards to watch David's house all night and then to kill him in the morning. Michal, David's wife, told him, “If you don't escape tonight, they'll kill you tomorrow!”
translation_verse: Sɔɔl tɩŋ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ a pɔ Devit dɩa, a kpʋʋ chʋchʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit haala Mɩkal lʋara bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ lɩɩ fá tɩtaŋɩŋ deeŋ, chie chʋchʋɔŋ ba jaŋ kpʋŋ.”

english_verse: She helped David leave through a window and climb down to the ground. As David ran off,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mɩkal joŋ Devit ta ʋ to tokoro lɩɩ, a fá viiri,

english_verse: Michal put a statue in his bed. She put goat hair on its head and dressed it in some of David's clothes.
translation_verse: ka ʋ mɩɩra joŋ tɔmʋŋ a jʋʋ bil Devit kʋpɩnaa nyuŋ a kɛŋ gɛrɩŋ tɔ, a paa bʋ-pʋnaa a mɛrɛ tɔŋ-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: The next morning, Saul sent guards to arrest David. But Michal told them, “David is sick.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ Sɔɔl sɩ tɩma sɩ mʋa dɩ ba kɛŋ Devit, Mɩkal bʋla pɩba, “Ʋʋ wɩɩlɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Saul sent the guards back and told them, “Bring David to me—bed and all—so I can kill him.”
translation_verse: Ba mɩɩra kʋ bʋla pɩ Sɔɔl. Ʋ bɩra tɩmba a bʋl, “Má mɩɩra mʋ Devit dɩa, a dʋɔrʋ bɔsɔ-la lɛ a kaa kʋ pɩmɛ, dɩ mɩ kpʋʋ.”

english_verse: When the guards went in, all they found in the bed was the statue with the goat hair on its head.
translation_verse: Ba mʋ jʋʋ beŋ bɔsɔ-la lɛ dɩ tɔmʋŋ nɛ pɩna, ba paa bʋ-pʋnaa mɛrɛ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: “Why have you tricked me this way?” Saul asked Michal. “You helped my enemy get away!” She answered, “He said he would kill me if I didn't help him escape!” Samuel Helps David Escape
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl tɩŋ ba yɩrɛ Mɩkal. Ʋ kɔ, ʋ pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ nyɩsɛmɛ ŋ-la, aŋ leŋ mɩ dʋndɔmɔ fa lɛl?” Mɩkal bʋla pʋ, “Ʋ sɩ, ʋ jaŋ kpʋmɛ, dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ ʋ lɛ pɛ dɩ ʋ fá lɛl.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, David went to Samuel at Ramah and told him what Saul had done. Then Samuel and David went to Prophets Village and stayed there.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Devit sɩ lɩɩ fá, ʋ mʋ Samʋɛl teeŋ nɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rama lɛ, a bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala Sɔɔl sɩ ŋaa ʋ lɛ a pʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ dɩ Samʋɛl sii mʋ hɔŋ lee kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nayɔf.

english_verse: Someone told Saul, “David is at Prophets Village in Ramah.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ hɔŋ nɩmɛ, ba bʋla pɩ Sɔɔl, “Devit nɛ hɛ Nayɔf sɩ hɛ Rama lɛ.”

english_verse: Saul sent a few soldiers to bring David back. They went to Ramah and found Samuel in charge of a group of prophets who were all prophesying. Then the Spirit of God took control of the soldiers and they started prophesying too.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ hɛ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ kɛnʋ. Ba sɩ mʋa, ba na Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa dɩ ba hilime a bʋbʋl wɩaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ. Samʋɛl hɛ nɩmɛ a ŋaa ba sɩpaalaara. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩma kʋ jʋʋ nɩalɩŋ Sɔɔl sɩ tɩma, ba ma bʋbʋl wɩaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When Saul heard what had happened, he sent some more soldiers, but they prophesied just like the first group. He sent a third group of soldiers, but the same thing happened to them.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ʋ bɩra tɩŋ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma ba mʋ. Ba sɩ mʋa, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋaa ba ma lɛ. Sɔɔl bɩra tɩŋ nɩaa torimuŋ lɛ ba mʋ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa bɩra ŋaa.

english_verse: Finally, Saul left for Ramah himself. He went as far as the deep pit at the town of Secu, and he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” “At Prophets Village in Ramah,” the people answered.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, Sɔɔl tɩtɩa sii a mʋmʋ Rama. Ʋ sɩ mʋ yi vil-bal kʋbala sɩ hɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Seku, ʋ pɩɛsɛ, “Nɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl arɩ Devit hɛ?” Ba bʋla pʋ, “Ba hɛ Nayɔf sɩ hɛ Rama lɛ.”

english_verse: Saul left for Ramah. But as he walked along, the Spirit of God took control of him, and he started prophesying. Then, when he reached Prophets Village,
translation_verse: Sɔɔl joŋo mʋmʋ nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩma-la jʋʋ-ʋ ma, ʋ bʋbʋl wɩaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi Nayɔf.

english_verse: he stripped off his clothes and prophesied in front of Samuel. He dropped to the ground and lay there naked all that day and night. That's how the saying started, “Is Saul now a prophet?”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mʋa, ʋ wuri ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kala ta nɛ, aŋ ma bʋbʋl Wɩa wɩaa Samʋɛl sɩpaaŋ, aŋ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree pɩŋ tinteeŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ nɩaa pɩpɩɛsɛ, “Sɔɔl ma ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: David escaped from Prophets Village. Then he ran to see Jonathan and asked, “Why does your father Saul want to kill me? What have I done wrong?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit lɩɩ fá Nayɔf sɩ hɛ Rama lɛ, a mʋ Jonataŋ teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa? Wʋbɔŋ bɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa ŋ nyɩmma lɛ, ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋmɛ?”

english_verse: “My father can't be trying to kill you! He never does anything without telling me about it. Why would he hide this from me? It can't be true!”
translation_verse: Jonataŋ bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa, ŋ bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ. Bee na, mɩ nyɩmma bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩkala dɩ ʋ bɩ bʋla pɩmɛ, dɩ wɩɩ-la ŋaa wʋbal koo wʋbie. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ joŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ faamɛ. Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ bʋla bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: “Jonathan, I swear it's true! But your father knows how much you like me, and he didn't want to break your heart. That's why he didn't tell you. I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I'm only one step ahead of death.”
translation_verse: Devit ŋmɩɛsa pɩ Jonataŋ a bʋl, “Ŋ nyɩmma jɩma arɩ ŋ chomi nɛ woruŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, ‘Jonataŋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ jɩma, ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ faasa chei.’ Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ weye yɩrɩŋ lɛ, mɩ dɩ sʋʋŋ pɛgɛ bɩ bol mʋa ma.”

english_verse: Then Jonathan said, “Tell me what to do, and I'll do it.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jonataŋ bʋla pɩ Devit, “Wɩɩ-la kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa a pɛ ŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: David answered: Tomorrow is the New Moon Festival, and I'm supposed to eat dinner with your father. But instead, I'll hide in a field until the evening of the next day.
translation_verse: Devit bʋl, “Chie nɛ ŋaa chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele, ʋ maga mɩ dɩ kuoro nɛ chie pɛ dɔŋɔ a dii kɩaa. Ama leŋ dɩ mɩ mʋ faa ŋmaŋkaaŋ lɛ, a kaa mʋ yi chietuo dɩdaanɩŋ.

english_verse: If Saul wonders where I am, tell him, “David asked me to let him go to his hometown of Bethlehem, so he could take part in a sacrifice his family makes there every year.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nyɩmma nɛ chɛ mɩ ka kɩalɩŋ dɩ-diiliŋ, bʋla pʋ arɩ mɩ sʋl wombiiŋ nɛ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ dɩ mɩ fá mʋ mɩ jaŋ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la lɛ mɩ nyɩŋ-nɩaa kala sɩ yie vɛnɛɛ sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ jɩna na-kala yie nɛ.

english_verse: If your father says it's all right, then I'm safe. But if he gets angry, you'll know he wants to harm me.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ sɩ, ‘Ʋ zɔmɔ.’ Ŋɩɩ-na, ŋ tɩntɩnna bɩ wɩɩ jʋa. Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ na baanɩŋ, ŋɩɩ-na jɩŋ arɩ ʋ chaasa chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaamɛ wʋbɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Be kind to me. After all, it was your idea to promise the Lord that we would always be loyal friends. If I've done anything wrong, kill me yourself, but don't hand me over to your father.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na Jonataŋ, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, dagɛ ŋ chonuŋ pɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna, aŋ leŋ dɩ nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ pɩmɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ arɩ mɩ dɩŋ jaŋ ŋaa nandɔŋ-zɔmɔ a kaa mʋ wuu chɩŋ. Ama dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ a chei, ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ maga dɩ ŋ kpʋmɛ. Sɩ́ mɩ joŋo hɛ ŋ nyɩmma nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋmɛ.”

english_verse: “Don't worry,” Jonathan said. “If I find out that my father wants to kill you, I'll certainly let you know.”
translation_verse: Jonataŋ bʋl, “Sɩ́ ŋɩɩ bɩɩnʋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ fa paala nɩɩ mʋa ma, arɩ mɩ nyɩmma ka chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaaŋ wʋbɔŋ, ŋ bɩɩna mɩ bɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ?”

english_verse: “Let's go out to this field, and I'll tell you,” Jonathan answered. When they got there,
translation_verse: Jonataŋ bʋl, “Kɔ dɩ la lɩɩ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba to dɔŋɔ lɩɩ.

english_verse: Jonathan said: I swear by the Lord God of Israel, that two days from now I'll know what my father is planning. Of course I'll let you know if he's friendly toward you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jonataŋ bɩra bʋla pɩ Devit, “La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa nɛ jaŋ ŋaa la pɛ-naara, chietuo bʋa deeŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ chaasa pɩɛsɛ mɩ nyɩmma a na tʋɔbɩɩna-la ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ, dɩ ba ŋaa tʋɔbɩɩŋ zɔmɔ nɛ koo ɛɛ nɛ. Dɩ tʋɔ-la ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ arɩŋ nɛ zɔmɔ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: But if he wants to harm you, I promise to tell you and help you escape. And I ask the Lord to punish me severely if I don't keep my promise. I pray that the Lord will bless you, just as he used to bless my father.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ wuo jɩŋ dɩ mɩ nyɩmma ka chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaaŋ wʋbɔŋ nɛ, aŋ vɩa dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩŋ, dɩ ŋ fá viiri arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa, a leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA dɔgɩsɛmɛ woruŋ. A leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA chɩŋ ŋ harɩŋ arɩ ʋ fa sɩ chɩŋ mɩ nyɩmma harɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Someday the Lord will wipe out all of your enemies. Then if I'm still alive, please be as kind to me as the Lord has been. But if I'm dead, be kind to my family.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ sʋba ma, kɛŋ chono-la tɩtɩa mɩ dɩa nɩaa ma lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ paala kpʋ ŋ-na Devit dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala dɛrɛ tinteeŋ lɛ ma.”

english_verse: Jonathan and David made an agreement that even David's descendants would have to keep. Then Jonathan said, “I pray that the Lord will take revenge on your descendants if they break our promise.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jonataŋ hɛ niiŋ ʋ dɩ Devit doho nɩaa pɛgɛ a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ ʋ baanɩŋ a fɩɩsɛ Devit doho nɩaa lɛ dɩ ba nɛ chei nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ Devit pɛgɛ.”

english_verse: Jonathan thought as much of David as he did of himself, so he asked David to promise once more that he would be a loyal friend.
translation_verse: Jonataŋ leŋ Devit bɩra wasa hɛ niiŋ pʋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ chou a kaa mʋ wuu, bɛɛ wɩaa Jonataŋ cho Devit nɛ woruŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ cho ʋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: After this Jonathan said: Tomorrow is the New Moon Festival, and people will wonder where you are, because your place at the table will be empty.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jonataŋ bʋla pɩ Devit, “Chie nɛ ŋaa chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele, nɩaa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ŋ tuo kʋdiile-la leriŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ jaŋ pɩŋ pɛɩ.

english_verse: By the day after tomorrow, everyone will think you've been gone a long time. Then go to the place where you hid before and stay beside Going-Away Rock.
translation_verse: Chietuo a kaa mʋ dɩdaanɩŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, mʋ faa lee-la tɩtɩa ŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ mʋ faa wɩaa deemba sɩ suomo, a gbɛrɛmɛ tabɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛzɛl leriŋ.

english_verse: I'll shoot three arrows at a target off to the side of the rock,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ yuo to-hɛŋŋɛɛ batori ta dɩ ba kʋ to tabɩɩ-la sɛmɛ bal, a nagɛ kʋŋ nɛ mɩɩ magɩsɛ.

english_verse: and send my servant to find the arrows. You'll know if it's safe to come out by what I tell him. If it is safe, I swear by the living Lord that I'll say, “The arrows are on this side of you! Pick them up!”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ bii-bie a bʋl, ‘Mʋ chɛ paa to-hɛmɛ-la kaa kɔ.’ Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋla pʋ, ‘To-hɛmɛ-la hɛ ŋ sɛmɛ deeŋ nɛ, mʋ paa kɔ,’ ŋ ma sii kɔ. Ŋɩɩ daga arɩ wɩɩ tuo nɛ ŋɩɩ. La TƖƖNA sɩ weye wɩaa, wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ jʋʋŋ.

english_verse: But if it isn't safe, I'll say to the boy, “The arrows are farther away!” This will mean that the Lord wants you to leave, and you must go.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋla pɩ bile, ‘To-hɛmɛ-la kieliŋ a mʋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ,’ ŋɩɩ daga arɩ La TƖƖNA ka chɛ dɩ ŋ viiri nɛ. Ŋ ma sii mʋ.

english_verse: But he will always watch us to make sure that we keep the promise we made to each other.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ dɩŋ sɩ bʋla bil ŋɩɩ, jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ pɛ na a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: So David hid there in the field. During the New Moon Festival, Saul sat down to eat
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit mʋ faa pɔkʋŋ nyuŋ. Chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele-la sɩ yie, kuoro Sɔɔl hɔŋ dɩ ʋ dii kʋdiile-la.

english_verse: by the wall, just as he always did. Jonathan sat across from him, and Abner sat next to him. But David's place was empty.
translation_verse: Ʋ hɔŋ lee-la ʋ sɩ vɛnɛɛ hɔŋ nɛ a kpagɛ jeeŋ. Abɩna hɔnɔ tɩgɛ Sɔɔl lɛ, Jonataŋ ma hɔŋ a chaasɛ Sɔɔl, aŋ ka Devit dɩhɔnʋŋ pɩŋ pɛɩ.

english_verse: Saul didn't say anything that day, because he was thinking, “Something must have happened to make David unfit to be at the Festival. Yes, something must have happened.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la Sɔɔl bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩɩna ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ a bʋl, “Ʋ naga wɩɩ nɛ ŋaa Devit lɛ, ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ.”

english_verse: The day after the New Moon Festival, when David's place was still empty, Saul asked Jonathan, “Why hasn't that son of Jesse come to eat with us? He wasn't here yesterday, and he still isn't here today!”
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele-la tapʋl-lɩamɩŋ chɛɛŋ ma, Devit dɩhɔnʋŋ ha bɩra pɩŋ pɛɩ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl pɩɛsɛ ʋ nanʋala Jonataŋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ Jesi bile bɩ kʋdiilee leriŋ kɔ, dɩa arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala?”

english_verse: Jonathan answered, “The reason David hasn't come to eat with you is that he begged me to let him go to Bethlehem. He said, ‘Please let me go. My family is offering a sacrifice, and my brother told me I have to be there. Do me this favor and let me slip away to see my brothers.’ ”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, ‘Leŋ dɩ mɩ mʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nyɩŋ-nɩaa kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ gbiele nɛ la jaŋ lɛ. Mɩ naambie bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ mɩ kɔ nɩmɛ. Dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ, pɩmɛ wombiiŋ dɩ mɩ mʋ na mɩ naambiiriŋ.’ Kuoro, wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ʋ bɩ ŋ kʋdiilee leriŋ kɔ nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Saul was furious with Jonathan and yelled, “You're no son of mine, you traitor! I know you've chosen to be loyal to that son of Jesse. You should be ashamed of yourself! And your own mother should be ashamed that you were ever born.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ Sɔɔl baanɩŋ guu sii Jonataŋ nyuŋ woruŋ, ʋ bʋl, “Ŋ ŋaa ha-bii-balɩŋ dɩgɩlaa sɩ bɩ wɩaa ka nɩɩ bii nɛ. Mɩ jɩma ŋ pɛ Jesi nanʋala lɛ nɛ. Ŋ saa joŋ hɩɩsɩŋ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa arɩ ŋ naaŋ-la sɩ lʋlʋŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You'll never be safe, and your kingdom will be in danger as long as that son of Jesse is alive. Turn him over to me now! He deserves to die!”
translation_verse: Dɩ Devit nɛ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ŋ dii kuoruŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ. Leŋ ba kɛnʋ kɔ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: “Why do you want to kill David?” Jonathan asked. “What has he done?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jonataŋ pɩɛsɛ ʋ nyɩmma, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ chɩchɛ ŋ kpʋʋ? Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ʋ chei?”

english_verse: Saul threw his spear at Jonathan and tried to kill him. Then Jonathan was sure that his father really did want to kill David.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ Sɔɔl joŋ ʋ timiŋ a yuo dɩ ʋ kpʋ Jonataŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jonataŋ chaasa jɩŋ arɩ ʋ nyɩmma kɛŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ kpʋ Devit nɛ.

english_verse: Jonathan was angry and hurt that his father had insulted David so terribly. He got up, left the table, and didn't eat anything all that day.
translation_verse: Jonataŋ chaasa na baanɩŋ, a sii kʋdiile-la nyuŋ. Ʋ bɩ kʋŋkala die chɛ-lɩa-la, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ tʋɔŋ fa chaasa chei ʋ nyɩmma nyuŋ nɛ woruŋ, a tɩŋ hɩɩsɛ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa Devit lɛ.

english_verse: In the morning, Jonathan went out to the field to meet David. He took a servant boy along
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla chʋchʋɔŋ, Jonataŋ mʋ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ dɩ ʋ dɩ Devit cheŋ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ pɛ kɛŋ bii-bie nɛ ba mʋ.

english_verse: and told him, “When I shoot the arrows, you run and find them for me.” The boy started running, and Jonathan shot an arrow so that it would go beyond him.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩ bile, “Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ yuo to-hɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ, fá a mʋ paa kaa kɔ.” Bile sɩ fá mʋmʋ, Jonataŋ yuo to-hɛmɩŋ ʋ kieli bile mʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: When the boy got near the place where the arrow had landed, Jonathan shouted, “Isn't the arrow on past you?”
translation_verse: Bile sɩ mʋ yi lee-la to-hɛŋ-la sɩ tele, Jonataŋ yɩrʋ a bʋl, “To-hɛŋ-la hɛ sɩpaaŋ.”

english_verse: Jonathan shouted to him again, “Hurry up! Don't stop!” The boy picked up the arrows and brought them back to Jonathan,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ kpɩa ʋ lɛ, “Ŋaa lɩma lɩma! Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ chɩŋ.” Bile mʋ a joŋ to-hɛŋ-la a kaa mɩɩra kʋ pɩ ʋ nɩhɩaŋ.

english_verse: Jonathan gave his weapons to the boy and told him, “Take these back into town.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jonataŋ joŋ ʋ laalɩyuori-kɩaa pɩ bile aŋ bʋla pʋ, “Kaa mɩɩra mʋ dɩa.”

english_verse: After the boy had gone, David got up from beside the mound and bowed very low three times. Then he and Jonathan kissed each other and cried, but David cried louder.
translation_verse: Bile sɩ mʋa harɩŋ, Devit sii tabɩɩ-la sɛmɛ, a kʋ kpirimi Jonataŋ sɩpaaŋ naansɩɩŋ butori. Ba guori dɔŋɔ aŋ yiyel. Ama Devit nɛ faasa yel kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: Jonathan said, “Take care of yourself. And remember, we each have asked the Lord to watch and make sure that we and our descendants keep our promise forever.” David left and Jonathan went back to town.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jonataŋ bʋla pɩ Devit, “Ŋ jaŋ mʋ woruŋ. Mɩ dɩŋ ŋmɩɛsa pɩ dɔŋɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ a ŋaa nandɔsɛ. La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa la pɛ-naara, a ŋaa mɩ doho nɩaa arɩ ŋ doho nɩaa ma pɛgɛ pɛ-naara a kaa mʋ wuu.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit viiri, ka Jonataŋ ma mɩɩra mʋ dɩa.

english_verse: David went to see Ahimelech, a priest who lived in the town of Nob. Ahimelech was trembling with fear as he came out to meet David. “Why are you alone?” Ahimelech asked. “Why isn't anyone else with you?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit mʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Nɔb dɩ ʋ na Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Ahɩmɛlɛk nɩmɛ. Ahɩmɛlɛk sɩ kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ʋ chemu, fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ, ʋ chichel aŋ pɩɛsɛ Devit, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ dʋndʋŋa kɔ daha? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nʋʋkala bɩ ŋ harɩŋ to?”

english_verse: “I'm on a mission for King Saul,” David answered. “He ordered me not to tell anyone what the mission is all about, so I ordered my soldiers to stay somewhere else.
translation_verse: Devit bʋla pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Ahɩmɛlɛk, “Kuoro tɩmmɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ, aŋ bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala jɩŋ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ sɩ ŋ ŋaa.’ Mɩ harɩ-tooro-na, mɩ bʋla pɩba dɩ ba chemmi lee kʋbala nɛ.

english_verse: Do you have any food you can give me? Could you spare five loaves of bread?”
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛŋ kʋdiilii nɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ŋ pɩmɛɛ? Pɩmɛ boroboroba banɔŋ koo kʋŋ na-kala ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: “The only bread I have is the sacred bread,” the priest told David. “You can have it if your soldiers didn't sleep with women last night.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara bʋla pɩ Devit, “Mɩ bɩ boroboro wogo kala kɛnɛ daha, see boroboro-la ba sɩ joŋo pɩ La TƖƖNA dʋndʋŋa nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ. Dɩ ŋ dɩ ŋ harɩ-tooro-la nɛ bɩ haalaa pɩna, ŋ jaŋ wuo laa.”

english_verse: “Of course we didn't sleep with women,” David answered. “I never let my men do that when we're on a mission. They have to be acceptable to worship God even when we're on a regular mission, and today we're on a special mission.”
translation_verse: Devit bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ dɩ mɩ harɩ-tooroo nɩɩ lɩɩ dɩ la tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ, la dɩ haalaa bɩ bɔsɔ ka pɛ, la kʋŋkala bɩ disiniŋ kɛŋ. Dɩ la nɛ paala mʋ dɩ la tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ dɔŋ sɩ bɩ sɩɩfɩaŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ ŋaa ma, la yie bɩ disiŋ wɩaa ka ŋaa, a saa wasa nyaŋ jɩnɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ sɩ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ.”

english_verse: The only bread the priest had was the sacred bread that he had taken from the place of worship after putting out the fresh loaves. So he gave it to David.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Ahɩmɛlɛk fa paa boroboroba-la sɩ pɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ aŋ bil kʋfalaa. Ʋ joŋ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ paa a pɩ Devit, bɛɛ wɩaa boroboro dɔŋ kala fa tuo a pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: It so happened that one of Saul's officers was there, worshiping the Lord that day. His name was Doeg the Edomite, and he was the strongest of Saul's shepherds.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la dɩ Sɔɔl tɩntɩnnaa dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Dʋɛg a ŋaa Ɛdɔm tɩɩna hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba kɛnʋ bil nɛ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ dɔŋ sɩ maga ʋ tɩma pɩ Wɩa. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Sɔɔl pie-daarɩ-hɩaŋ.

english_verse: David asked Ahimelech, “Do you have a spear or a sword? I had to leave so quickly on this mission for the king that I didn't bring along my sword or any other weapons.”
translation_verse: Devit pɩɛsɛ Ahɩmɛlɛk, “Ŋ bɩ timiŋ koo tokobiiŋ kɛnɛ dahaa? Mɩ bɩ tokobiiŋ koo laalɩyuori kʋŋkala koro daha, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩɩ-la kuoro sɩ sɩ dɩ mɩ ŋaa, ʋ guu dɩ mɩ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: The priest answered, “The only sword here is the one that belonged to Goliath the Philistine. You were the one who killed him in Elah Valley, and so you can take his sword if you want to. It's wrapped in a cloth behind the statue.” “It's the best sword there is,” David said. “I'll take it!” David Tries To Find Safety in Gath
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara bʋl, “Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna-la ŋ sɩ kpʋa baa yɩrɛ Golɩaf, Ɛla fuonaa-la lɛ, ʋ tokobiiŋ nɛ hɛ daha. Ʋ nɛ ba kɛŋ gɛrɩŋ bɛ tɔ a joŋo bil gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la harɩŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ, ŋ jaŋ wuo joŋ ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ hɛ daha.” Devit bʋl, “Tokobii dɔŋ tuo a zɔmɔ magʋ, joŋu pɩmɛ.” Devit mʋ Gaf

english_verse: David kept on running from Saul that day until he came to Gath, where he met with King Achish.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ Devit lɩɩ fá dɩ Sɔɔl sɩ́ ʋ kpʋ a mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gaf kuoro Akɩs teeŋ.

english_verse: The officers of King Achish were also there, and they asked Achish, “Isn't David a king back in his own country? Don't the Israelites dance and sing, ‘Saul has killed a thousand enemies; David has killed ten thousand’?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Akɩs tɩntɩnnaa pɩɛsʋ, “Devit deeŋ dee bɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro ŋaa? Ʋ dee ba fa yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a gʋgʋa aŋ bɛsɛ ʋ lɛ bʋl, ‘Sɔɔl kpʋ nɩaa bʋɩba nɛ, ka Devit kpʋ nɩaa bʋɩ fiiba?’ ”

english_verse: David thought about what they were saying, and it made him afraid of Achish.
translation_verse: Devit kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ bɩɩnɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ woruŋ a tɩŋ Gaf kuoro Akɩs wɩaa.

english_verse: So right there in front of everyone, he pretended to be insane. He acted confused and started making scratches on the doors of the town gate, while drooling in his beard.
translation_verse: Devit sɩ hɛ kuoro Akɩs arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ fugo ŋɩŋaa wɩaa arɩ ʋ nyuŋ tuo. Ʋ yie paa kɩaa a pɩpaasɛ taŋ-la boi-baalɩŋ borusuŋ, aŋ gieri nantʋɔrʋŋ su ʋ tɔŋŋɔɔ kala, a nagɛ nɩa sɩɩ nyaasʋ.

english_verse: “Look at him!” Achish said to his officers. “You can see he's crazy. Why did you bring him to me?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Akɩs pɩɛsɛ ʋ tɩntɩnna-la, “Ma sɩ na dɩ baala deeŋ ka nyaasʋ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma kɛnʋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ?

english_verse: I have enough crazy people without your bringing another one here. Keep him away from my palace!”
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ mɩ bɩ nyɩnyɛ tɩŋŋaa kɛnɛ nɛ, ma kɛŋ baala deeŋ kɔ ʋ ŋɩŋaa nyɩnyɛ wɩaa mɩ sɩpaaŋ? Nɩdoho deeŋ maga dɩ ʋ jʋʋ mɩ dɩa nɛɛ?”

english_verse: When David escaped from the town of Gath, he went to Adullam Cave. His brothers and the rest of his family found out where he was, and they followed him there.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit lɩɩ fá Gaf lɛ, a mʋ faa bʋ-bʋa kʋbala sɩ kpagɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Adulam lɛ. Ʋ naambiiriŋ arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ba sii mʋ ʋ teeŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: A lot of other people joined him too. Some were in trouble, others were angry or in debt, and David was soon the leader of
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma mʋ ʋ teeŋ, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ koo nɩalɩŋ sɩ dii chɩŋŋaa koo nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ sɩ bɩ dɩ-bala pɩna. Ba mʋ ʋ teeŋ ʋ ŋaa ba sɩpaalaara. Nɩalɩŋ fa yi nɩaa zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: David left Adullam Cave and went to the town of Mizpeh in Moab, where he talked with the king of Moab. “Please,” David said, “let my father and mother stay with you until I find out what God will do with me.”
translation_verse: Devit bɩra lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ Mɩzɩpa sɩ hɛ Mʋab tinteeŋ, a bʋla pɩ Mʋab kuoro, “Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, leŋ dɩ mɩ nyɩmma arɩ mɩ naaŋ kʋ hɛ ŋ teeŋ, ka dɩ mɩ na wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ ŋaa pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: So he brought his parents to the king of Moab, and they stayed with him while David was in hiding.
translation_verse: Devit leŋ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ naaŋ a pɩ Mʋab kuoro, ba hɔŋ ʋ teeŋ bʋa-la kala lɛ ʋ sɩ faa dɩ-duo-la lɛ.

english_verse: One day the prophet Gad told David, “Don't stay here! Go back to Judah.” David then left and went to Hereth Forest. Saul Kills the Priests of the Lord
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala, Wɩa Wʋlaabʋlla Gad bʋla pɩ Devit, “Sɩ́ dɩ-duo-la lɛ hɛ, mʋ Juda tinteeŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit lɩɩ a mʋ duu kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛrɛf duuŋ. Sɔɔl kpʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa Nɔb lɛ

english_verse: Saul was sitting under a small tree on top of the hill at Gibeah when he heard that David and his men had been located. Saul was holding his spear, and his officers were standing in front of him.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Sɔɔl kori timiŋ a hɔŋ dundolo nyuŋ tɩa kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ tamarɛs bʋbʋɔŋ Gɩbɩa lɛ. Ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kala chɩna gollu, ka ʋ nɩɩ arɩ ba na Devit nɛ.

english_verse: He told them: Listen to me! You belong to the Benjamin tribe, so if that son of Jesse ever becomes king, he won't give you fields or vineyards. He won't make you officers in charge of thousands or hundreds as I have done.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa, má jegile nɩɩ, Jesi bile jaŋ wuo pɩma ŋmaŋkaanɩŋ arɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ bagɩsɩŋ? Ʋ jaŋ sɛɩ a leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa laalɩyuoroo bʋɩba arɩ zɔlɔba sɩpaalaaraa?

english_verse: But you're all plotting against me! Not one of you told me that my own son Jonathan had made an agreement with him. Not one of you cared enough to tell me that Jonathan had helped one of my officers rebel. Now that son of Jesse is trying to ambush me.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma kala lɩɩ mɩ harɩŋ a vʋvʋʋrɛ mɩ wɩaa? Ma kʋŋkala ha bɩ bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ mɩ nanʋala arɩ Jesi bie pɛ niiŋ nɛ. Ma kʋŋkala sɩpaaŋ tuo mɩ lɛ, koo a bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ mɩ bie yigi mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ ʋ bɩbagɩlɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋmɛ, arɩ ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ jɩnɩŋ.”

english_verse: Doeg the Edomite was standing with the other officers and spoke up, “When I was in the town of Nob, I saw that son of Jesse. He was visiting the priest Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
translation_verse: Dɩ Dʋɛg, Ɛdɔm tɩɩna-la ma fa chɩŋ Sɔɔl tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la tʋɔŋ nɩmɛ. Ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ fa na Jesi nanʋala Devit nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ kɔ Ahitub nanʋala Ahɩmɛlɛk teeŋ Nɔb lɛ.

english_verse: Ahimelech talked to the Lord for him, then gave him food and the sword that had belonged to Goliath the Philistine.”
translation_verse: Ahɩmɛlɛk chɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ na wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a pʋ, aŋ pʋ kʋdiilee a joŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa Golɩaf tokobiiŋ ma a pɛ pʋ.”

english_verse: Saul sent a message to Ahimelech and his whole family of priests at Nob, ordering them to come to him. When they came,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Sɔɔl tɩma yɩrɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Ahɩmɛlɛk, arɩ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa Nɔb lɛ. Ba kala kɔ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Saul told them, “Listen to me, you son of Ahitub.” “Certainly, Your Majesty,” Ahimelech answered.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl bʋla pɩ Ahɩmɛlɛk, “Jegili mɩ teeŋ.” Ʋ bʋl, “Kuoro, mɩɩ jegili nɛ.”

english_verse: Saul demanded, “Why did you plot against me with that son of Jesse? You helped him rebel against me by giving him food and a sword, and by talking with God for him. Now he's trying to ambush me!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ dɩ Jesi nanʋala vʋʋrɛ mɩ wɩaa, ŋ paala pʋ kʋdiilee a joŋ tokobiiŋ pʋ, aŋ ha chɛ Wɩa teeŋ dɩ ŋ na wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ ʋ ŋaa a pʋ? Ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ vɩamɛ aŋ bɩbagɩlɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋmɛ.”

english_verse: “Your Majesty, none of your officers is more loyal than David!” Ahimelech replied. “He's your son-in-law and the captain of your bodyguard. Everyone in your family respects him.
translation_verse: Ahɩmɛlɛk bɩra pɩɛsɛ kuoro Sɔɔl, “Ŋ tɩntɩnnaa kala tʋɔŋ, kʋbɛɛ nɩɩ to ŋ niiŋ a magɛ Devit? Ʋ paala ŋaa ŋ hɩɩlɛ-baala nɛ, a ŋaa laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔŋ nɩhɩaŋ, ŋ dɩa nɩaa ma kala zizilu woruŋ.

english_verse: This isn't the first time I've talked with God for David, and it's never made you angry before! Please don't accuse me or my family like this. I have no idea what's going on!”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la dee bɩ mɩ chɛ-bumbuŋ ŋaa mɩ sɩ chɛ Wɩa teeŋ dɩ mɩ na wɩaa a pɩ Devit. Kuoro, sɩ́ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna koo mɩ nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa kʋŋkala ŋmaamʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ jɩŋ.”

english_verse: “Ahimelech,” Saul said, “you and your whole family are going to die.”
translation_verse: Kuoro bʋl, “Ahɩmɛlɛk, ŋ dɩ ŋ nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa kala maga dɩ ma sʋʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Saul shouted to his bodyguards, “These priests of the Lord helped David! They knew he was running away, but they didn't tell me. Kill them!” But the king's officers would not attack the priests of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bʋla pɩ laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ ʋ-na kuoro, “Má kpʋ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ma kala chɩŋ Devit harɩŋ nɛ. Ba jɩma arɩ ʋ fa a viviiri nɛ, ka ba vɩa dɩ ba bʋla pɩmɛ.” Ama laalɩyuoro-la vɩa dɩ ba kpʋ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara-la.

english_verse: Saul turned to Doeg, who was from Edom, and said, “Kill the priests!” On that same day, Doeg killed
translation_verse: Kuoro mɩɩra bʋla pɩ Dʋɛg, “Kpʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Dʋɛg, Ɛdɔm tɩɩna-la kpʋba. Tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ kpʋ ba nɩaa mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ banɔŋ nɛ sɩɩ laalɛ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩŋ.

english_verse: Then he attacked the town of Nob, where the priests had lived, and he killed everyone there—men, women, children, and babies. He even killed their cattle, donkeys, and sheep. Only Abiathar Escapes from Nob
translation_verse: Dʋɛg bɩra mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nɔd a kpʋ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ arɩ pʋsʋ-la kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, baalaa arɩ haalaa, hambiisiŋ arɩ bii-mulluŋ, nɛsɩŋ, kakusuŋ arɩ piesee kala.

english_verse: Ahimelech's son Abiathar was the only one who escaped. He ran to David
translation_verse: Ama Ahɩmɛlɛk nanʋala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Abɩata, Ahitub nihiŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ wuo lɩɩ fá, a mʋ Devit teeŋ,

english_verse: and told him, “Saul has murdered the Lord's priests at Nob!”
translation_verse: a bʋla pʋ arɩ Sɔɔl kpʋ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kala nɛ Nɔb lɛ.

english_verse: Stay here. Isn't the same person trying to kill both of us? Don't worry! You'll be safe here with me.”
translation_verse: Hɔŋ mɩ teeŋ, sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá. Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ walɩmɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋŋ, ʋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋ mɩ ma. Wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ ŋaaŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: One day some people told David, “The Philistines keep attacking the town of Keilah and stealing grain from the threshing place.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ Devit, “Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa ka yuo taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɛɛla nɩaa nɛ, a gɔllɔ to ba mɩɩ-ŋmoori tahɩŋ a pɩpaa ba mɩaa.”

english_verse: David asked the Lord, “Should I attack these Philistines?” “Yes,” the Lord answered. “Attack them and rescue Keilah.”
translation_verse: Devit pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA a bʋl, “Mɩ mʋ yuo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa deemba?” La TƖƖNA bʋla pʋ, “Mʋ yuoba, a laa Kɛɛla nɩaa ta.”

english_verse: But David's men said, “Look, even here in Judah we're afraid of the Philistines. We will be terrified if we try to fight them at Keilah!”
translation_verse: Ama Devit nɩaa bʋla pʋ, “La hɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ daha aŋ fɩfá Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa, ɛɛ nɛ saa ʋ jaŋ naga pɩla dɩ la nɛ lɩɩ daha mʋ Kɛɛla dɩ la yuo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa deemba?”

english_verse: David asked the Lord about it again. “Leave at once,” the Lord answered. “I will give you victory over the Philistines at Keilah.”
translation_verse: Devit bɩra pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Sii a tuu Kɛɛla, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ joŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la a hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: David and his men went there and fiercely attacked the Philistines. They killed many of them, then led away their cattle, and rescued the people of Keilah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa mʋ Kɛɛla a yuo dii Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa a kpʋba, aŋ kɛsɛ ba pʋsʋŋ. Devit chaasa kpʋba nɛ woruŋ, aŋ laa Kɛɛla nɩalɩŋ ta.

english_verse: David heard about Saul's plan to capture him, and he told Abiathar, “Let's ask God what we should do.”
translation_verse: Devit sɩ nɩa dɩ Sɔɔl ka kɔ dɩ ʋ yuou nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Abɩata, “Kɛŋ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la kɔ.”

english_verse: David prayed, “Lord God of Israel, I was told that Saul is planning to come here. What should I do? Suppose he threatens to destroy the town because of me.
translation_verse: Devit bɩra bʋl, “La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna chaasa nɩɩ dɩ Sɔɔl ka bɩɩnɛ dɩ ʋ kɔ Kɛɛla a chei tabal-la nɛ, a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: Would the leaders of Keilah turn me over to Saul? Or is he really coming? Please tell me, Lord.” “Yes, he will come,” the Lord answered.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Kɛɛla lɛ jaŋ kɛmmɛ pʋʋ? Sɔɔl sɛnɛ jaŋ kɔ arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ tɩntɩnna sɩ nɩa? La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, jaaŋ jaaŋ bʋla pɩmɛ, mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Ʋ jaŋ kɔ.”

english_verse: David asked, “Would the leaders of Keilah hand me and my soldiers over to Saul?” “Yes, they would,” the Lord answered.
translation_verse: Devit bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Kɛɛla lɛ jaŋ joŋ mɩ dɩ mɩ nɩaa a pɩ Sɔɔl?” La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl, “Ba jaŋ jomma pɩba.”

english_verse: David stayed in hideouts in the hill country of Ziph Desert. Saul kept searching, but God never let Saul catch him.
translation_verse: Devit fa gɔllɔ fɩfaa tintee-hɩlɩŋ dɩ-duoruŋ arɩ Zɩf tintee-hɩlɩŋ dundollu-la lɛ nɛ. Ka Sɔɔl gɔllɔ chɩchɛʋ tapʋlɩɩ kala. Ama Wɩa bɩ leŋe Devit jʋʋ Sɔɔl nɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: One time, David was at Horesh in Ziph Desert. He was afraid because Saul had come to the area to kill him.
translation_verse: Devit fa sɩ hɛ Hɔrɛs sɩ hɛ Zɩf tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, ʋ bɩra nɩa arɩ Sɔɔl kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ʋ kpʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: But Jonathan went to see David, and God helped him encourage David.
translation_verse: Devit sɩ hɛ lee-la ŋɩɩ, Sɔɔl nanʋala Jonataŋ mʋ bʋl wɩaa a nyaasɛ Devit nyuŋ arɩ Wɩa pɔʋ nɛ.

english_verse: “Don't be afraid,” Jonathan said. “My father Saul will never get his hands on you. In fact, you're going to be the next king of Israel, and I'll be your highest official. Even my father knows it's true.”
translation_verse: Jonataŋ bʋla pʋ, “Sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá. Mɩ nyɩmma Sɔɔl bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛnɩŋ. Ŋ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, dɩ mɩ tɩtɩgɛ ŋ lɛ. Mɩ nyɩmma Sɔɔl ma tɩtɩa paala jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: They both promised the Lord that they would always be loyal to each other. Then Jonathan went home, but David stayed at Horesh. David Escapes from Saul
translation_verse: Ba balɩamɩŋ bɩra leŋ nii-la ba sɩ hɛ pɩ dɔŋɔ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ wasa chɩŋ. Jonataŋ mɩɩra mʋ dɩa, ka Devit ha hɛ Hɔrɛs lɛ.

english_verse: Some people from the town of Ziph went to Saul at Gibeah and said, “Your Majesty, David has a hideout not far from us! It's near Horesh, somewhere on Mount Hachilah south of Jeshimon.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zɩf tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ sii mʋ Sɔɔl teeŋ Gɩbɩa lɛ, a bʋla pʋ, “Devit nɛ faa la tinteeŋ dɩ-duoruŋ lɛ, dundolo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hakɩla lɛ a kpagɛ Hɔrɛs sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jɛsɩmɔŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: If you come, we will help you catch him.”
translation_verse: Kuoro, bʋa-la kala ŋ sɩ cho kɔ, la jaŋ kɛnʋ pɩŋ.”

english_verse: Saul told them: You've done me a big favor, and I pray that the Lord will bless you.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl bʋl, “La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a tɩŋ tʋɔbɩɩna-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Now please do just a little more for me. Find out exactly where David is, as well as where he goes, and who has seen him there. I've been told that he's very tricky.
translation_verse: Má mɩɩra wasa mʋ beŋ woruŋ, a jɩŋ lee-la Devit sɩ hɛ, a leŋ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ naʋ nɩmɛ. Mɩ nɩa dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Find out where all his hiding places are and come back when you're sure. Then I'll go with you. If he is still in the area, or anywhere among the clans of Judah, I'll find him.
translation_verse: Má beŋ woruŋ a jɩŋ lere-la kala ʋ sɩ yie fɩfaa, a kʋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ a pɩmɛ. Mɩ jaŋ to ma harɩŋ mʋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ hɛ lee-la, mɩ jaŋ chɛ kɛnʋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ paala magɛ dɩ mɩ gbilli Juda tinteeŋ kala ma.”

english_verse: The people from Ziph went back ahead of Saul, and they found out that David and his men were still south of Jeshimon in the Maon Desert.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ laa Sɔɔl sɩpaaŋ ba mʋ Zɩf. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa hɛ Mayɔŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, fuonaa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Araba a hɛ Jɛsɩmɔŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Saul and his army set out to find David. But David heard that Saul was coming, and he went to a place called The Rock, one of his hideouts in Maon Desert. Saul found out where David was and started closing in on him.
translation_verse: Ka Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ nɩaa suomo chɩchɛ Devit. Devit nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, a sii mʋ faa bʋŋ kʋbala sɩ hɛ Mayɔŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. Sɔɔl nɩɩ a sii kiri Devit libe mʋ bʋŋ-la leriŋ.

english_verse: Saul was going around a hill on one side, and David and his men were on the other side, trying to get away. Saul and his soldiers were just about to capture David and his men,
translation_verse: Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ nɩaa hɛ bʋ-taala sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa ma hɛ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a nɩnɛrɩgɛ dɩ ba fá a lɛl Sɔɔl nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo sɩ kʋ kpagɛ Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa dɩ ba kɛsɛba,

english_verse: when a messenger came to Saul and said, “Come quickly! The Philistines are attacking Israel and taking everything.”
translation_verse: dɩ tɩndaara kɔ Sɔɔl teeŋ a bʋl, “Má ŋaa lɩma kɔ! Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa nɛ kɔ a didii la tinteeŋ.”

english_verse: Saul stopped going after David and went back to fight the Philistines. That's why the place is called “Escape Rock.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl bɩra bɩ Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa libi kire, aŋ mɩɩra mʋ dɩ ʋ yuo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛŋ bʋ-taala-la leriŋ a yɩyɩrɛ Sɛla Hamalɛkɔf.

english_verse: David left and went to live in the hideouts at En-Gedi.
translation_verse: Devit bɩra sii nɩmɛ a mʋ faa Ɛŋ-Gedi tinteeŋ dɩ-duoruŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: When Saul got back from fighting off the Philistines, he heard that David was in the desert around En-Gedi.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sɩ kiri Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa mʋ aŋ mɩɩra kɔ, ba bʋla pʋ, “Devit hɛ Ɛŋ-Gedi tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: There were some sheep pens along the side of the road, and one of them was built around the entrance to a cave. Saul went into the cave to relieve himself. David and his men were hiding at the back of the cave.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sɩ kʋ yi piesee dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ kpagɛ wombiiŋ, bʋ-bʋa kʋbala nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, ʋ jʋʋ nɩmɛ dɩ ʋ togili, dɩ Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa ma jʋʋ faa bʋ-bʋa-la tɩtɩa tʋɔŋ sɩpaaŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: They whispered to David, “The Lord told you he was going to let you defeat your enemies and do whatever you want with them. This must be the day the Lord was talking about.” David sneaked over and cut off a small piece of Saul's robe, but Saul didn't notice a thing.
translation_verse: Devit nɩaa bʋla pʋ, “Tapʋlʋŋ deeŋ wɩaa nɛ La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pɩŋ ŋɩɩ, bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ sɩ, ‘Mɩ jaŋ joŋ ŋ dʋndɔmɔ hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋ ŋaaʋ wɩɩ-la kala ŋ sɩ cho.’ ” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit sii densi a mʋ lʋara keri Sɔɔl gɛrɩŋ niipiniŋ.

english_verse: Afterwards, David was sorry that he had even done that,
translation_verse: Devit sɩ keri Sɔɔl gɛrɩ-la niipiniŋ dɛrɛ harɩŋ, ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa walɩmʋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Soon, David also got up and left the cave. “Your Majesty!” he shouted from a distance. Saul turned around to look. David bowed down very low
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit ma lɩɩ bʋ-bʋa-la lɛ, a kʋ lɩɩ a yɩrɛ Sɔɔl, “Kuoro, mɩ nɩhɩaŋ.” Sɔɔl daasɛ harɩŋ a naʋ, Devit tuu kpirime yi tinteeŋ.

english_verse: and said: Your Majesty, why do you listen to people who say that I'm trying to harm you?
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩɛsɛ Sɔɔl, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ jegile nɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩŋ niiŋ, arɩ mɩ-na Devit ka chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaaŋ wʋbɔŋ nɛ?

english_verse: You can see for yourself that the Lord gave me the chance to catch you in the cave today. Some of my men wanted to kill you, but I wouldn't let them do it. I told them, “I will not harm the Lord's chosen king!”
translation_verse: Jɩnɩŋ, ŋ tɩtɩa na ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋuŋ hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ bʋ-bʋa-la tʋɔŋ. Mɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ fa sɩ dɩ mɩ kpʋŋ nɛ, ama mɩ-na nɛ ta leŋiŋ. Mɩ sɩ, ‘Mɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nɩhɩaŋ wʋbɔŋ kala, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ nɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ ŋaa kuoro.’

english_verse: Your Majesty, look at what I'm holding. You can see that it's a piece of your robe. If I could cut off a piece of your robe, I could have killed you. But I let you live, and that should prove I'm not trying to harm you or to rebel. I haven't done anything to you, and yet you keep trying to ambush and kill me.
translation_verse: Mɩ nyɩmma, beŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a na gɛrɩ-kɔsʋ-bie-la mɩ sɩ koro. Ŋ gɛrɩŋ niipiniŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ keri, aŋ bɩŋ kpʋa. Lɛɛlɛ jɩŋ woruŋ arɩ mɩ bɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa cheyiŋ koo a vɩa ŋ niiŋ. Mɩ bɩ wʋbɔŋ ma joŋo ŋaa ŋ lɛ, ka ŋ bagɩla chɩchɛmɛ dɩ ŋ kpʋ.

english_verse: I'll let the Lord decide which one of us has done right. I pray that the Lord will punish you for what you're doing to me, but I won't do anything to you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nɛ jaŋ dii mɩ dɩŋ pɛgɛ sarɩya. Wʋbɔmɔ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ, La TƖƖNA nɛ jaŋ joŋ ba chɩmɩŋ timiŋ. Ama mɩ-na bɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ digiŋ.

english_verse: An old proverb says, “Only evil people do evil things,” and so I won't harm you.
translation_verse: Faafaa nɩaa sɩ, ‘Nɩbɔmʋŋ nɛ yie ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ,’ ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ-na bɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ a digiŋ.

english_verse: Why should the king of Israel be out chasing me, anyway? I'm as worthless as a dead dog or a flea.
translation_verse: Bee na Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro sɩ lɩɩ a kikiri mɩ-na Devit dɩ ʋ kpʋ. Mɩ-na Devit teeŋ mɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩ nɛ, a nagɛ va-sʋʋŋ koo buguluŋ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will help me escape and show that I am in the right.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nɛ jaŋ dii mɩ dɩŋ pɛgɛ sarɩya. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ beŋ mɩ wɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ, aŋ chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ a laamɛ ta ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: “David, my son—is that you?” Saul asked. Then he started crying
translation_verse: Devit sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɛrɛ, Sɔɔl pɩɛsɛ, “Mɩ nanʋala Devit, ŋ nɛɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ faasa ŋmoo niiŋ.

english_verse: and said: David, you're a better person than I am. You treated me with kindness, even though I've been cruel to you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bʋl, “Ŋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a kɩɩmɛ, ŋ-na kɛmmɛ woruŋ nɛ, ka mɩ joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You've told me how you were kind enough not to kill me when the Lord gave you the chance.
translation_verse: Wʋzɔmɔ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ bʋla pɩmɛ ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA chaasa jommi a hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ka ŋ bɩ mɩ kpʋa.

english_verse: If you really were my enemy, you wouldn't have let me leave here alive. I pray that the Lord will give you a big reward for what you did today.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ na ʋ dʋndɔmɔ, ʋ jaŋ leŋu ta dɩ ʋ mʋ pɛɩ? La Tɩɩna jaŋ timiŋ woruŋ a tɩŋ wʋzɔŋ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: I realize now that you will be the next king, and a powerful king at that.
translation_verse: Mɩ chaasa jɩŋ arɩ ŋ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, dɩ tintee-la wɩɩkala chɩŋ woruŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Promise me with the Lord as your witness, that you won't wipe out my descendants. Let them live to keep my family name alive.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ, ŋmɩɛsa pɩmɛ arɩ ŋ bɩ jaŋ kpʋ mɩ doho nɩaa koo a leŋ dɩ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛl mɩ nyɩmma dɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: So David promised, and Saul went home. David and his men returned to their hideout.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit hɛ niiŋ pɩ Sɔɔl, ʋ mɩɩra mʋ dɩa, ka Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa mɩɩra mʋ lee-la ba sɩ faa.

english_verse: One day, Nabal was in Carmel where his servants were cutting the wool from his sheep. David was in the desert when he heard about it.
translation_verse: Devit sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ nɩɩ dɩ Nabal ka kɛ ʋ piesee pʋnaa.

english_verse: So he sent ten men to Carmel with this message for Nabal: I hope that you and your family are healthy and that all is going well for you.
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pʋ, ‘A leŋ dɩ ŋ dɩ ŋ dɩa nɩaa hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa dɩ wɩɩkala vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩŋ, dɩ ma kɛŋ mɩɩ-duduoŋ.

english_verse: I've heard that you are cutting the wool from your sheep. When your shepherds were with us in Carmel, we didn't harm them, and nothing was ever stolen from them.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩa arɩ bʋa deeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ kɩkɛ ŋ piesee pʋnaa. Bʋa-la lɛ ŋ pie-daaraa sɩ hɛ la teeŋ, la bɩ ba wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa. Bʋa-la ma lɛ ba sɩ hɛ Kamɛl lɛ, ba kɩaa kʋŋ bɩ lɛlɛ.

english_verse: Ask your shepherds, and they'll tell you the same thing. My servants are your servants, and you are like a father to me. This is a day for celebrating, so please be kind and share some of your food with us.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ pɩɛsɛ tɩntɩnna-la, ba tɩtɩa jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, kɛŋ mɩ bapʋɔsɛ biisiŋ deemba woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa gbiele tapʋlɩɩ nɛ la kɔ daha. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, kʋ-la kala ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ, ŋ jaŋ wuo joŋo pɩ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa arɩ ŋ nanʋala Devit.’ ”

english_verse: David's men went to Nabal and gave him David's message, then they waited for Nabal's answer.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ Devit sɩ tɩma, sɩ mʋ Nabal teeŋ, ba joŋ Devit niiŋ a to pʋ aŋ gbɛrɛ.

english_verse: This is what he said: Who does this David think he is? That son of Jesse is just one more slave on the run from his master, and there are too many of them these days.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nabal pɩɛsɛ Devit tɩntɩnna-la, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ Devit? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ Jesi nanʋala deeŋ? Tapʋlaa deemba tɩntɩnnaa yʋga nɛ a lɩɩ fa kɩkagɛ ba nɩhɩasɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: What makes you think I would take my bread, my water, and the meat that I've had cooked for my own servants and give it to you? Besides, I'm not sure that David sent you!
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ dɩ mɩ joŋ kʋdiilee arɩ lɩɩŋ arɩ pʋsʋ-la mɩ sɩ kpʋa dɩ mɩ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kɛ mɩ piesee pʋnaa, a pɩ nɩa sɩ lɩɩ lee mɩ sɩ bɩ jɩŋ?”

english_verse: The men returned to their camp and told David everything Nabal had said.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ mɩɩra mʋ Devit teeŋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala Nabal sɩ bʋla a pʋ.

english_verse: “Everybody get your swords!” David ordered. They all strapped on their swords. Two hundred men stayed behind to guard the camp, but the other
translation_verse: Devit fa bʋla pɩba, “Má paa ma tokobiee.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba paa, Devit ma tɩtɩa joŋ ʋ kʋa. Nɩaa yi zɔɔ-banɛsɛ a to ʋ harɩŋ ba mʋ, ka nɩaa zɔɔ-balɩa ma ka harɩŋ a pɔ ba kɩaa ba buguŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He's a bully who won't listen to anyone. Isn't there something you can do? Please think of something! Or else our master and his family and everyone who works for him are all doomed.
translation_verse: Beŋ wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ woruŋ a na ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa la nɩhɩaŋ lɔgɛ wɩaa wurisi ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ ŋaa nɩbɔŋ nɛ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩaa pʋ.”

english_verse: and told her servants, “Take this on ahead, and I'll catch up with you.” She didn't tell her husband Nabal what she was doing.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa, “Má kaa laa sɩpaaŋ, mɩ jaŋ to harɩŋ a kɔ.” Ama ʋ bɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋla pɩ ʋ bala Nabal.

english_verse: Abigail was riding her donkey on the path that led around the hillside, when suddenly she met David and his men heading straight at her.
translation_verse: Abɩgɛl joŋ ʋ kakumo jɩl a joŋ fuonaaŋ sɩ to peelee pɛgɛ mʋmʋ, dɩ Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa nɛ kʋʋ tuu ŋɩɩ, ʋ mʋ chemba.

english_verse: David had just been saying, “I surely wasted my time guarding Nabal's things in the desert and keeping them from being stolen! I was good to him, and now he pays me back with insults.
translation_verse: Devit faa bʋl ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Wʋpɛɩ nɛ mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ sɩ beŋ Nabal dʋa nyuŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ ba kʋŋkala bɩ lɛlɛ. Wʋbɔmʋŋ nɛ ʋ mɩɩra joŋo tiŋ wʋzɔmʋŋ chɩmɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ lɛ,

english_verse: I swear that by morning, there won't be a man or boy left from his family or his servants' families. I pray that God will punish me if I don't do it!”
translation_verse: a leŋ dɩ Wɩa dɔgɩsɛ mɩ-na Devit kɩŋkɛŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ Nabal arɩ baal kala sɩ ŋaa ʋ dɩa nʋʋ kpʋa chie chʋchʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: Abigail quickly got off her donkey and bowed down in front of David.
translation_verse: Abɩgɛl sɩ na Devit ŋɩɩ, ʋ guu tuu ʋ kakumo nyuŋ, a kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ a kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa chu tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to that good-for-nothing Nabal. His name means “fool,” and it really fits him! I didn't see the men you sent,
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, sɩ́ Nabal nɩbɔŋ-la wɩaa joŋo hɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ nɩyaarɩ, ʋ sɛnɛ ŋɩŋaa nɩyaarɩ wɩaa. Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna bɩ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ tɩma na.

english_verse: Please forgive me if I say a little more. The Lord will always protect you and your family, because you fight for him. I pray that you won't ever do anything evil as long as you live.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, joŋo chɛmɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋl wɩaa yʋyʋgɛ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa nɛ didii kuoruŋ wuu, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA laalɩŋ nɛ ʋ yuyuo. A leŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, ŋ sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: The Lord your God will keep you safe when your enemies try to kill you. But he will snatch away their lives quicker than you can throw a rock from a sling.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ nɛ paala kikiri dɩ ʋ kpʋŋ ma, La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ weye jaŋ pɔŋ woruŋ, dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ sɩ́ lɩɩ. Ama ʋ jaŋ guu lɩɩsɛ ŋ dʋndɔmɔ-la mɩɩsɩŋ lɩma, a kɩɩ ba sɩ joŋ tabɩɩŋ hɛ kpalɩŋ lɛ a yuo ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord has promised to do many good things for you, even to make you the ruler of Israel. The Lord will keep his promises to you,
translation_verse: Dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ pɛ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ lɛ, a ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba kala pʋ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ pʋ, a ŋaa dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ,

english_verse: and now your conscience will be clear, because you won't be guilty of taking revenge and killing innocent people. When the Lord does all those good things for you, please remember me.
translation_verse: mɩ nɩhɩaŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa jaŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala. Ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋ ʋ baanɩŋ fɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye lɛ, a kpʋba, a laa cheeriŋ. Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ pɛ ŋ lɛ, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala a pɩŋ, liisi mɩ wɩaa.”

english_verse: David told her: I praise the Lord God of Israel! He must have sent you to meet me today.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ Abɩgɛl, “Mɩɩ dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, ʋ nɛ kɛnɩŋ kʋ chemmi ŋɩɩ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: And you should also be praised. Your good sense kept me from taking revenge and killing innocent people.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ a tɩŋ wʋzɔmɔ-la ŋ sɩ joŋo dagɛmɛ jɩnɩŋ, a lɩɩsɛmɛ mɩ bɩ mɩ baanɩŋ joŋo fɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ lɛ a kpʋba.

english_verse: If you hadn't come to meet me so quickly, every man and boy in Nabal's family and in his servants' families would have been killed by morning. I swear by the living Lord God of Israel who protected you that this is the truth.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ fa dee, La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ weye, ʋ-nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ pɔ dɩ mɩ sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa ma lɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ fa bɩ guu kʋ chemmi ŋɩɩ, taŋ fa jaŋ pʋpʋl dɩ mɩ kpʋ Nabal arɩ ʋ dɩa nʋʋ na-kala sɩ ŋaa baal.”

english_verse: David accepted the food Abigail had brought. “Don't worry,” he said. “You can go home now. I'll do what you asked.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit laa kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ kaa kɔ dɩ ʋ pʋ aŋ bʋl, “Ŋ jaŋ mʋ dɩa arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa, mɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ bʋla nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩɩ chɛ.”

english_verse: Abigail went back home and found Nabal throwing a party fit for a king. He was very drunk and feeling good, so she didn't tell him anything that night.
translation_verse: Abɩgɛl mɩɩra mʋ dɩa, dɩ Nabal yɩrɛ nɩaa kʋ hilimi dɩa lɛ, ba didii kɩaa a nyʋnyʋa aŋ gbigbieli a nagɛ kuoro, ka ʋ bugi, ʋ tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩgɛl bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla pʋ, aŋ ka taŋ pʋl.

english_verse: But when he sobered up the next morning, Abigail told him everything that had happened. Nabal had a heart attack, and he lay in bed as still as a stone.
translation_verse: Chʋchʋɔŋ Nabal sɩaa sɩ fɩɛla, ʋ haala bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa a pʋ. Ʋ bɔyɛ guu joŋ ʋ terigi a ŋaa kpaŋŋɩlaŋ a nagɛ tabɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Ten days later, the Lord took his life.
translation_verse: Ʋ tapʋlaa fii pɛgɛ, La TƖƖNA ŋmoo Nabal kpʋ.

english_verse: Abigail quickly got ready and went back with David's messengers. She rode on her donkey, while five of her servant women walked alongside. She and David were married as soon as she arrived.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ guu sii a kɛŋ kakumo jɩl. Ʋ fa kɛŋ ketiee banɔŋ nɛ ba tɩma pʋpʋ, ba ma to. Ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ Devit sɩ tɩma kala to dɔŋɔ mʋ ʋ teeŋ ʋ ŋaa Devit haal.

english_verse: David had earlier married Ahinoam from the town of Jezreel, so both she and Abigail were now David's wives.
translation_verse: Devit fa jaa tolo kʋbala ma nɛ baa yɩrɛ Ahɩnʋam, a lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jɛzɩrɛl. Ʋ dɩ Abɩgɛl kala ŋaa ʋ haalaa.

english_verse: Meanwhile, Saul had arranged for Michal to marry Palti the son of Laish, who came from the town of Gallim.
translation_verse: Dɩ Sɔɔl fa kɛŋ ʋ tolo Mɩkal Devit fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ jaa, a laa a joŋo pɩ baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Palɩtɩɛl, ʋ jaa. Ʋ ŋaa Las nanʋala nɛ, a lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Galɩm.

english_verse: Once again, some people from Ziph went to Gibeah to talk with Saul. “David has a hideout on Mount Hachilah near Jeshimon out in the desert,” they told him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zɩf tɩŋŋaa bɩra sii mʋ Sɔɔl teeŋ Gɩbɩa lɛ a bʋl, “Devit nɛ faa dundolo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hakɩla nyuŋ, a kpagɛ Jɛsɩmɔŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.”

english_verse: Saul set up camp on Mount Hachilah, which is across the road from Jeshimon. But David was hiding out in the desert. When David heard that Saul was following him,
translation_verse: Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo mʋ hɔŋ wombiiŋ niiŋ Hakɩla dundolo-la sɛmɛ, a chaasɛ Jɛsɩmɔŋ. Ka Devit ha faa tintee-hɩlɩŋ tʋɔŋ. Devit sɩ kʋ jɩŋ arɩ Sɔɔl kɔ a chɩchɛʋ nɛ,

english_verse: he sent some spies to find out if it was true.
translation_verse: ʋ tɩŋ nɩaa ba lʋara mʋ, dɩ Sɔɔl sɛnɛ kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Then he sneaked up to Saul's camp. He noticed that Saul and his army commander Abner the son of Ner were sleeping in the middle of the camp, with soldiers sleeping all around them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit sii tɩtaŋɩŋ a mʋ lee-la Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo sɩ ŋmoo buguŋ, a na lee-la Sɔɔl arɩ Nɛɛ nanʋala Abɩna sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ sɩ pɩna. Sɔɔl fa pɩŋ doŋ ba bugu-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ nɛ, ka laalɩyuoroo pɩna gollu.

english_verse: David asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Joab's brother Abishai, “Which one of you will go with me into Saul's camp?” “I will!” Abishai answered.
translation_verse: Devit mɩɩra mʋ ʋ nɩaa teeŋ a pɩɛsɛ Hiti tɩŋŋaa baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ahɩmɛlɛk arɩ Zeruya nanʋala Abɩsaɩ, Jʋab naambie, “Má kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo to mɩ harɩŋ a mʋ Sɔɔl buguŋ?” Abɩsaɩ bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ mʋ.”

english_verse: That same night, David and Abishai crept into the camp. Saul was sleeping, and his spear was stuck in the ground not far from his head. Abner and the soldiers were sound asleep all around him.
translation_verse: Devit arɩ Abɩsaɩ sii mʋ laalɩyuoro-la leriŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ, dɩ Sɔɔl pɩŋ doŋ ba dɩ-hɔnɩɩ-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, aŋ joŋ timiŋ pɛ tinteeŋ ʋ nyuŋ, ka Abɩna arɩ laalɩyuoroo pɩna gollu.

english_verse: Abishai whispered, “This time God has let you get your hands on your enemy! I'll pin him to the ground with one thrust of his own spear.”
translation_verse: Abɩsaɩ fɩɛlɛ bʋla pɩ Devit, “Jɩnɩŋ La TƖƖNA joŋ ŋ dʋndɔmɔ Sɔɔl hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Leŋ dɩ mɩ joŋ mɩ timiŋ tɔbʋ a mɛrɛ tinteeŋ bala, bʋlɩa ma dee.”

english_verse: As surely as the Lord lives, the Lord will kill Saul, or Saul will die a natural death or be killed in battle.
translation_verse: Devit bɩra bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ weye tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ kpʋ Sɔɔl, ʋ sʋʋŋ jaŋ yi dɩ ʋ sʋʋ, koo dɩ ʋ mʋ laalɩŋ a lɛl nɩmɛ.

english_verse: But I pray that the Lord will keep me from harming his chosen king. Let's grab his spear and his water jar and get out of here!”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ mɩ ŋaa nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ ŋaa kuoro wʋbɔŋ kala. La jaŋ joŋ timiŋ arɩ lɩɩŋ loŋ-la sɩ chɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ a kaa viiri.”

english_verse: David took the spear and the water jar, then left the camp. None of Saul's soldiers knew what had happened or even woke up—the Lord had made all of them fall sound asleep.
translation_verse: Devit joŋ tiŋ-la arɩ lɩɩŋ loŋ-la ba kaa viiri, ka nʋʋkala bɩ ba na koo a jɩŋ ba wɩaa, nʋʋkala ma bɩ hirige sii, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA leŋe ba kala chaasa pɩŋ doŋ nɛ a yuo naaŋ.

english_verse: David and Abishai crossed the valley and went to the top of the next hill, where they were at a safe distance.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit arɩ Abɩsaɩ chol fuonaaŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a mʋ dɩ-bolii mʋa, a jɩla chɩŋ dundolo nyuŋ.

english_verse: “Abner!” David shouted toward Saul's army. “Can you hear me?” Abner shouted back. “Who dares disturb the king?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit yɩrɛ Sɔɔl laalɩyuoroo arɩ Nɛɛ nanʋala Abɩna, “Mɩ sɩɩ yɩrɛma, ma bɩ nɩɩ, Abɩna?” Abɩna bʋl, “Ŋ nɛ kʋbɛɛ a yɩyɩrɛ kuoro dɩ ʋ sii doŋ lɛ?”

english_verse: “Abner, what kind of a man are you?” David replied. “Aren't you supposed to be the best soldier in Israel? Then why didn't you protect your king? Anyone who went into your camp could have killed him tonight.
translation_verse: Devit bɩra bʋl, “Ŋ waa baal nɛ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a magɩŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bɩ kuoro pɔ? Nʋʋ nɛ kʋ jʋʋ ma buguŋ dɩ ʋ kpʋ ma kuoro.

english_verse: You're a complete failure! I swear by the living Lord that you and your men deserve to die for not protecting the Lord's chosen king. Look and see if you can find the king's spear and the water jar that were near his head.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ma sɩ ŋaa, ʋ bɩ zɔŋ. La TƖƖNA sɩ weye wɩaa, ŋ dɩ ŋ nɩaa kala fa maga dɩ ma sʋʋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma bɩ ma nɩhɩaŋ-la ma TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ ŋaa kuoro pɔ. Má beŋ ma teeŋ a na, nɩɩ nɛ kuoro timiŋ arɩ ʋ lɩɩŋ loŋ-la sɩ chɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ hɛ?”

english_verse: Saul could tell it was David's voice, and he called out, “David, my son! Is that you?” “Yes it is, Your Majesty.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl wuo jɩŋ arɩ Devit yikoro nɛ a pɩɛsɛ, “Mɩ nanʋala Devit, ŋ nɩɩ bʋl wɩaa?” Devit bʋl, “Oo mɩ nɛ, kuoro.”

english_verse: Why are you hunting me down? Have I done something wrong, or have I committed a crime?
translation_verse: Devit bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ-na mɩ nɩhɩaŋ kirimi a bɩbaarɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa a cheyiŋ?

english_verse: Please listen to what I have to say. If the Lord has turned you against me, maybe a sacrifice will make him change his mind. But if some people have turned you against me, I hope the Lord will punish them! They have forced me to leave the land that belongs to the Lord and have told me to worship foreign gods.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋl. Dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ sɩ dɩ ŋ chɩŋ mɩ lɛ, ŋɩɩ-na ʋ laa mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa. Ama dɩ nuhuobiinee nɛ leŋe ŋ chɩŋ mɩ lɛ, dɩ La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ diiba. Ba kirimi ta tinteeŋ sɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA kʋŋ lɛ nɛ a bʋl, ‘Mʋ a tuto vesiŋ.’

english_verse: Don't let me die in a land far away from the Lord. I'm no more important than a flea! Why should the king of Israel hunt me down as if I were a bird in the mountains?”
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba kpʋmɛ ta tintee-la sɩ bɩ la TƖƖNA kʋŋ ŋaa lɛ. Mɩ-na teeŋ mɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩ nɛ, a nagɛ buguluŋ ka Iziral kuoro bɩbagɩlɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋmɛ, a nagɛ nɩa sɩɩ bagɩlɛ yoho peelee tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: “David, you had the chance to kill me today. But you didn't. I was very wrong about you. It was a terrible mistake for me to try to kill you. I've acted like a fool, but I'll never try to harm you again. You're like a son to me, so please come back.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl bʋl, “Devit, mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, mɩɩra kɔ mɩ bii, bɛɛ wɩaa jɩnɩŋ ŋ leŋ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ pɩmɛ nɛ, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaaŋ wʋbɔŋ kala. Mɩ wʋŋaalaa ŋaa nɩyaarɛ wɩaa nɛ, mɩ cheeriŋ yʋga.”

english_verse: “Your Majesty, here's your spear! Let one of your soldiers come and get it.
translation_verse: Devit bʋl, “Kuoro, ŋ timiŋ nɛ hɛ mɩ teeŋ daha. Leŋ dɩ ŋ bapʋɔsɩa-la dɔŋɔ kʋ laa.

english_verse: The Lord put you in my power today, but you are his chosen king and I wouldn't harm you. The Lord rewards people who are faithful and live right.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala tʋɔpʋla arɩ ʋ Wɩa laa diiniŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ timu. Jɩnɩŋ ʋ joŋuŋ hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ama mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ joŋ wʋbɔŋ kala a ŋaa nɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ ŋaa kuoro lɛ.

english_verse: I spared your life today, and I pray that the Lord will spare my life and keep me safe.”
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ bene dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ kʋŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ teeŋ jɩnɩŋ, mɩ bɩŋ kpʋa, La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa mɩ ma lɛ, a lɩɩsɛmɛ wʋbɔŋ kala lɛ.”

english_verse: “David, my son, I pray that the Lord will bless you and make you successful!” David in Philistia Saul went back home. David also left,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl bʋla pɩ Devit, “Mɩ bii, La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ. Wɩɩ na-kala ŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa, jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩŋ.” Devit viiri, ka Sɔɔl ma mɩɩra mʋ dɩa.

english_verse: but he thought to himself, “One of these days, Saul is going to kill me. The only way to escape from him is to go to Philistia. Then I'll be outside of Israel, and Saul will give up trying to catch me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bɩɩnɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a bʋl, “Tapʋlaa deemba dɔŋɔ, Sɔɔl jaŋ wuo kɛmmɛ a kpʋmɛ. Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a laa mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ lɩɩ mʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl jaŋ leŋ mɩ gɔllɔ chɛnɩŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, ka dɩ mɩ wiesi.”

english_verse: When Saul found out that David had run off to Gath, he stopped trying to catch him.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sɩ nɩa dɩ Devit fá mʋ Gaf, ʋ bɩra bɩ gɔllɔ chɛʋ.

english_verse: One day, David was talking with Achish and said, “If you are happy with me, then let me live in one of the towns in the countryside. I'm not important enough to live here with you in the royal city.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Devit sii a bʋla pɩ Akɩs, “Dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ, joŋ ŋ tinteeŋ tasɩŋ dɔŋɔ pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Mɩ bɩ maga dɩ mɩ hɔŋ ŋ teeŋ ma tabalɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Achish gave David the town of Ziklag that same day, and Ziklag has belonged to the kings of Judah ever since.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Akɩs joŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zɩkɩlag a pɩ Devit tapʋlɩɩ-la. A chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ a kaa kɔ nɛ Zɩkɩlag ŋaa Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo kʋŋ.

english_verse: David was in Philistia for a year and four months.
translation_verse: Devit hɔŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ lɛ jɩna arɩ chɛnsɩŋ banɛsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites lived in the area from Telam to Shur and on as far as Egypt, and David often attacked their towns.
translation_verse: Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa sii mʋ yuo Gesu tɩŋŋaa, Gɛzɩ tɩŋŋaa arɩ Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Whenever David and his men attacked a town, they took the sheep, cattle, donkeys, camels, and the clothing, and killed everyone who lived there. After he returned from a raid, David always went to see Achish,
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ Devit nɛ mʋ yuo lee-kala, ʋ yie kpʋ baalaa arɩ haalaa kala nɛ, aŋ kɛsɛ piesee, nɛsɩŋ, kakusuŋ, bʋntaŋŋaba, a paa ba gɛnnɩŋ ma pɛ, a kaa mɩɩra kɔ Akɩs teeŋ.

english_verse: who would ask, “Where did you attack today?” David would answer, “Oh, we attacked some desert town that belonged to the Judah tribe.” Sometimes David would say, “Oh, we attacked a town in the desert where the Jerahmeel clan lives” or “We attacked a town in the desert where the Kenites live.”
translation_verse: Dɩ Akɩs nɛ pɩɛsʋ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ mʋ yuo jɩnɩŋ?” Devit yie bʋl, “Mɩ mʋ yuo tasɩ-la sɩ hɛ Juda wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ, Jɛramɛɛl doho nɩaa tinteeŋ koo Keni tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ.”

english_verse: That's why David killed everyone in the towns he attacked. He thought, “If I let any of them live, they might come to Gath and tell what I've really been doing.” David made these raids all the time he was in Philistia.
translation_verse: Devit bɩ baal koo haal kala kʋweeŋ kaa kʋkɔ Gaf, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩɩna ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ a bʋl, “Dɩ mɩ nɛ lemba, ba jaŋ sɛnɛ mʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa.” Wɩalɩŋ Devit sɩ hɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ faafaa kala a ŋɩŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But Achish trusted David and thought, “David's people must be furious with him. From now on he will have to take orders from me.”
translation_verse: Akɩs laa Devit dii nɛ woruŋ, a bʋl ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ, “Ʋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa chaasa bɩ ʋ wɩaa cho, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnʋ a kaa mʋ wuu,”

english_verse: The Philistines went to Shunem and set up camp. Saul called the army of Israel together, and they set up their camp in Gilboa.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa kala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a ŋmoo buguŋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sunem lɛ, ka Sɔɔl ma kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ ba ma ŋmoo ba buguŋ Gɩlɩbʋa lɛ.

english_verse: Saul took one look at the Philistine army and started shaking with fear.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sɩ na Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo, fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ, ʋ bɔyɛ jujoŋ.

english_verse: So he asked the Lord what to do. But the Lord would not answer, either in a dream or by a priest or a prophet.
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ na wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa. Ama La TƖƖNA bɩ duosoo lɛ koo kʋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Urim lɛ koo Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ kala lɛ to a bʋl wɩɩ pʋ.

english_verse: Then Saul told his officers, “Find me a woman who can talk to the spirits of the dead. I'll go to her and find out what's going to happen.” His servants told him, “There's a woman at Endor who can talk to spirits of the dead.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, “Dɩ ma nɛ jɩŋ haal sɩɩ vʋgʋ woruŋ a hɛ lee, má dagɛmɛ, dɩ mɩ mʋ vʋga na wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ mɩ ŋaa.” Ba bʋl, “Dɔŋɔ nɛ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛndɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: That night, Saul put on different clothing so nobody would recognize him. Then he and two of his men went to the woman, and asked, “Will you bring up the ghost of someone for us?”
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋɩŋ Sɔɔl sii a paa gɛrɩ-wogusuŋ laalɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wuo jɩmʋ, a kɛŋ baalaa balɩa a pɛ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ ba mʋ haal-la leriŋ. Ʋ bʋla pɩ haal-la, “Pɩɛsɛ lɛlɛɛ pɩmɛ dɩ ba dagɛmɛ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ maga dɩ mɩ ŋaa. Nɩɩ-la yɩrɩŋ mɩ sɩ yɩra, yɩrɛ ʋ dɩma dɩ ʋ kɔ.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Why are you trying to trick me and get me killed? You know King Saul has killed everyone who talks to the spirits of the dead!”
translation_verse: Ama haal-la bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ chaasa jɩŋ wɩɩ-la Sɔɔl sɩ ŋaa nɛ. Ʋ kiri vʋgʋraa arɩ chichiribee kala nɛ, ba lɩɩ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ bɛrɛ kɛmmɛ a kpʋmɛ?”

english_verse: Saul replied, “I swear by the living Lord that nothing will happen to you because of this.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl ŋmɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ a pʋ a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ weye wɩaa, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa a dɔgʋsʋŋ.”

english_verse: “Who do you want me to bring up?” she asked. “Bring up the ghost of Samuel,” he answered.
translation_verse: Haal-la bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “Mɩ yɩrɛ kʋbɛɛ a pɩŋ?” Sɔɔl sɩ, “Yɩrɛ Samʋɛl.”

english_verse: When the woman saw Samuel, she screamed. Then she turned to Saul and said, “You've tricked me! You're the king!”
translation_verse: Haal-la sɩ na Samʋɛl, ʋ faasa ŋmoo niiŋ, aŋ pɩɛsɛ Sɔɔl, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ nyɩsɛmɛ? Ŋ nɛ kuoro Sɔɔl.”

english_verse: “Don't be afraid,” Saul replied. “Just tell me what you see.” She answered, “I see a spirit rising up out of the ground.”
translation_verse: Kuoro Sɔɔl bʋla pʋ, “Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ. Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ na?” Haal-la bʋl, “Nɩdɩma nɛ mɩ na dɩ ʋ tɔɔ tinteeŋ kʋʋ lɩɩ.”

english_verse: “What does it look like?” “It looks like an old man wearing a robe.” Saul knew it was Samuel, so he bowed down low.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl pɩɛsɛ, “Ʋ nagɛ ɛɛ nɛ?” Haal-la bʋl, “Banɩhɩaŋ nɛ, a laalɛ gɛrɩ-duduoŋ a kʋʋ lɩɩ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl jɩŋ arɩ Samʋɛl nɛ. Ʋ tuu kpirime yi tinteeŋ.

english_verse: “Why are you bothering me by bringing me up like this?” Samuel asked. “I'm terribly worried,” Saul answered. “The Philistines are about to attack me. God has turned his back on me and won't answer any more by prophets or by dreams. What should I do?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl pɩɛsɛ Sɔɔl, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ walɩmɛmɛ, a kɛmmɛ kʋ lɩɩ?” Sɔɔl bʋl, “Wɩaa chaasa jʋʋmɛ nɛ, Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa nɩɩ yuomi, ka Wɩa lɩɩ mɩ harɩŋ. Ʋ bɩra bɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla lɛ koo duoso lɛ to a bʋl wɩɩkala a pɩpɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ yɩrɩŋ dɩ ŋ kʋ dagɛmɛ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: Samuel said: If the Lord has turned away from you and is now your enemy, don't ask me what to do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samʋɛl pɩɛsɛ, “Dɩ Wɩa nɛ lɩɩ ŋ harɩŋ a ŋaa ŋ dʋndɔŋ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ jaŋ pɩpɩɛsɛmɛ wɩɩ-la sɩ maga ŋ ŋaa?

english_verse: I've already told you: The Lord has sworn to take the kingdom from you and give it to David. And that's just what he's doing!
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ to mɩ lɛ bʋla pɩŋ faafaa kala, ʋ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. La TƖƖNA kɛŋ Iziral tinteeŋ a laa ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a mɩɩra joŋo pɩ Devit,

english_verse: When the Lord was angry with the Amalekites, he told you to destroy them, but you didn't do it. That's why the Lord is doing this to you.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA fa chaasa na baanɩŋ Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ nɛ, a bʋl dɩ ŋ chei ba dɩ ba kɩaa kala, ŋ vɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ joŋ wɩaa deemba kala a ŋɩŋaa ŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: Tomorrow the Lord will let the Philistines defeat Israel's army, then you and your sons will join me down here in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Chie, La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ ŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala a hɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ kpʋ ŋ dɩ ŋ hambolibiisiŋ dɩ ma kɔ mɩ teeŋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa yuo dii Iziral laalɩyuoroo.”

english_verse: At once, Saul collapsed and lay stretched out on the floor, terrified at what Samuel had said. He was weak because he had not eaten anything since the day before.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ, fawʋllʋŋ jʋʋ Sɔɔl ʋ tel tinteeŋ a tɩɛnɛ. Ʋ nandaasɩŋ kala fa yʋɔrɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ kʋŋkala die tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala.

english_verse: The woman came over to Saul, and when she saw that he was completely terrified, she said, “Your Majesty, I listened to you and risked my life to do what you asked.
translation_verse: Havʋgʋrʋ-la sii mʋ Sɔɔl teeŋ a na dɩ ʋ faasaa chel, ʋ bʋl, “Bee na, mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna to ŋ niiŋ nɛ, a joŋ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ a yɔɔ sʋʋŋ a ŋaa wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ sɩ mɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Now please listen to me. Let me get you a little something to eat. It will give you strength for your walk back to camp.”
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Leŋ dɩ mɩ pɩŋ kʋdiilee dɩ ŋ dii a kɛŋ doluŋ a wuo sii vɛŋ ŋ wombiiŋ.”

english_verse: “No, I won't eat!” But his officers and the woman kept on urging Saul, until he finally agreed. He got up off the floor and sat on the bed.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl vɩa aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ dii kʋŋkala.” Ʋ dɩ baala-la sɩ mʋa arɩ haal-la ha vɩa aŋ pɛsɛ dɩ ʋ dii kɩaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sɛɩ ba niiŋ, a sii tinteeŋ a hɔŋ ʋ kʋpɩnɩŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: At once the woman killed a calf that she had been fattening up. She cooked part of the meat and baked some thin bread.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la kɛŋ nɛ-pɔrʋŋ ʋ sɩ dɩɛsa ʋ nɛrɛ a kpʋ, a ŋaa munuŋ a buu a wasɛ boroboro a bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ hɛ.

english_verse: Then she served the food to Saul and his officers, who ate and left before daylight.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ kʋdiile-la a kaa mʋ bil Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna-la sɩpaaŋ ba dii, aŋ sii viiri tɩtaŋ-la tɩtɩa.

english_verse: The Philistine army commanders were angry and shouted: Send David back to the town you gave him. We won't have him going into the battle with us. He could turn and fight against us! Saul would take David back as an officer if David brought him the heads of our soldiers.
translation_verse: Ama Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la na baanɩŋ Akɩs nyuŋ a bʋl, “Leŋ dɩ baal-la mɩɩra mʋ taŋ-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pʋ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ to la harɩŋ a mʋ laalɩŋ dɩ-yuoluŋ. Laal-la lɛ ʋ jaŋ wuo mɩɩra yuyuola. Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ ʋ nɩhɩaŋ Sɔɔl bɩra cho ʋ wɩaa, dɩ la nɩaa tɩtɩa dee dɩ ʋ kpʋ a keri nyusuŋ?”

english_verse: The Israelites even dance and sing, “Saul has killed a thousand enemies; David has killed ten thousand!”
translation_verse: Devit deeŋ wɩaa dee ba fa yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ a gʋgʋa ŋɩɩ aŋ bʋl, “Sɔɔl kpʋ nɩaa bʋɩba nɛ, ka Devit kpʋ nɩaa bʋɩ fiiba?”

english_verse: Achish called David over and said: I swear by the living Lord that you've been honest with me, and I want you to fight by my side. I don't think you've done anything wrong from the day you joined me until this very moment. But the other Philistine rulers don't want you to come along.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Akɩs yɩrɛ Devit a bʋla pʋ, “La TƖƖNA sɩ weye wɩaa, ŋ wʋŋaalaa leŋe mɩ jɩŋ arɩ ŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ woruŋ. Mɩ fa jaŋ cho dɩ ŋ pɛ mɩ laalɩyuoroo lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa a chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ kɔ mɩ teeŋ a kaa kɔ bʋa deeŋ lɛ, mɩ ha bɩ ŋ wʋcheeli kala na. Ama Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa bɩ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: Go on back home and try not to upset them.
translation_verse: Mɩɩra mʋ dɩa arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa, aŋ sɩ́ wɩɩkala ŋaa dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaara-la tʋɔŋ chei.”
