english_verse: “But what have I done?” David asked. “Do you know of anything I've ever done that would keep me from fighting the enemies of my king?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa? Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ na ŋ tɩntɩnna lɛ a chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ a kaa kɔ lɛɛlɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo mʋ yuo mɩ nɩhɩaŋ sɩ ŋaa kuoro dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ?”

english_verse: Achish said: I believe that you're as good as an angel of God, but our army commanders have decided that you can't fight in this battle.
translation_verse: Akɩs bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ jɩma ŋ wʋŋaalaa tɔrɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ a nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaara nɛ, ka Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩasɩŋ bʋl, ‘Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ to la harɩŋ a mʋ laalɩŋ.’

english_verse: You and your troops will have to go back to the town I gave you. Get up and leave tomorrow morning as soon as it's light. I'm pleased with you, so don't let any of this bother you.
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩ ŋ tɩntɩnna-la kala sɩ vɩa Sɔɔl aŋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ maga dɩ ma sii lɩma chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla, a viiri, dɩ leriŋ nɛ suomo pʋpʋllɛ.”

english_verse: David and his men got up early in the morning and headed back toward Philistia, while the Philistines left for Jezreel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa sii chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla-la, dɩ ba mɩɩra mʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ. Ka Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la ma mʋ Jɛzɩrɛl.

english_verse: It took David and his men three days to reach Ziklag. But while they had been away, the Amalekites had been raiding in the desert around there. They had attacked Ziklag, burned it to the ground,
translation_verse: Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa mʋ yi Zɩkɩlag tapʋl-tori chɛɛŋ nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa fa sɩ tuo ŋɩɩ, Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa kʋ yuo Juda wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ Zɩkɩlag kala. Ba sɩ yuo dii Zɩkɩlag, ba nyɩgʋ,

english_verse: When David and his men came to Ziklag, they saw the burned-out ruins and learned that their families had been taken captive.
translation_verse: Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa sɩ kɔ Zɩkɩlag, ba na dɩ nyiniŋ dii ʋ kala. Ka ba kɛsɛ ba biiriŋ arɩ ba haalaa, toloo arɩ hambolibiisiŋ kala viiri.

english_verse: They started crying and kept it up until they were too weak to cry any more.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa yel woruŋ a kala pʋgʋmɛ.

english_verse: David's two wives, Ahinoam and Abigail, had been taken captive with everyone else.
translation_verse: Ba fa pɛ kɛsɛ Devit haalaa balɩa-la ma kala nɛ, Ahɩnʋam sɩ lɩɩ Jɛzɩrɛl arɩ Kamɛl tɩŋŋaa Nabal yo-haal-la ʋ sɩ jaa baa yɩrɛ Abɩgɛl.

english_verse: David was desperate. His soldiers were so upset over what had happened to their sons and daughters that they were thinking about stoning David to death. But he felt the Lord God giving him strength,
translation_verse: Devit tʋɔŋ fa faasa chei, bɛɛ wɩaa, baala-la bʋla arɩ ba jaŋ yagʋ kpʋ arɩ tabɩaa a tɩŋ ba sɩ kɛsɛ ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ hantolibiisiŋ viiri wɩaa. Ka La TƖƖNA Wɩa leŋ Devit ha kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ.

english_verse: and he said to the priest, “Abiathar, let's ask God what to do.” Abiathar brought everything he needed to get answers from God, and he went over to David.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Abɩata, Ahɩmɛlɛk nanʋala, “Joŋ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la la sɩ kaa chɛ nɩna wɩaa La TƖƖNA teeŋ kʋ pɩmɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩata joŋo mʋ pʋ.

english_verse: Then David asked the Lord, “Should I go after the people who raided our town? Can I catch up with them?” “Go after them,” the Lord answered. “You will catch up with them, and you will rescue your families.”
translation_verse: Devit pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA, “Mɩ jaŋ wuo kiri la dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ kʋ dii la jaŋ harɩŋ? Mɩ jaŋ puuba?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Kiri ba harɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ puuba a laa ma nɩaa ba teeŋ.”

english_verse: Some of David's men found an Egyptian out in a field and took him to David. They gave the Egyptian some bread, and he ate it. Then they gave him a drink of water,
translation_verse: Ba mʋ puu Ijipiti tɩɩna kʋbala pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ a kɛnʋ mʋ Devit teeŋ, a pʋ lɩɩŋ arɩ kʋdiilee.

english_verse: some dried figs, and two handfuls of raisins. This was the first time in three days he had tasted food or water. Now he felt much better.
translation_verse: Ba pʋ kɩŋkɛsɩmɛɛ arɩ tɩɩ-nɛŋ hɩlaa nɛ ʋ dii ʋ yaraa polli, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ tapʋlaa nɛ batori ʋ sɩ bɩ kʋŋ die, a bɩ lɩɩŋ ma nyʋa wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala.

english_verse: “Who is your master?” David asked. “And where do you come from?” “I'm from Egypt,” the young man answered. “I'm the servant of an Amalekite, but he left me here three days ago because I was sick.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ ŋaa kʋbɛɛ nʋʋ nɛ, a lɩɩ nɩɩ?” Ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ ŋaa Ijipiti tɩɩna nɛ, a ŋaa Amalɛk tɩɩna kʋbala yomo. Mɩɩ wɩɩlɛ nɛ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ vɩamɛ ta aŋ mʋ, ʋ tapʋlaa batori nɛ ŋ-la.

english_verse: We had attacked some towns in the desert where the Cherethites live, in the area that belongs to Judah, and in the desert where the Caleb clan lives. And we burned down Ziklag.”
translation_verse: La nɛ yuo dii Kɛrɛtɩ tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ Juda wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ Kalɩb doho nɩaa ma sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. La nɛ yuo dii Zɩkɩlag ma a nyɩgʋ.”

english_verse: “Will you take me to those Amalekites?” David asked. “Yes, I will, if you promise with God as a witness that you won't kill me or hand me over to my master.”
translation_verse: Devit bɩra pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛmmɛ tuu dagɛ Amalɛk tɩmma-la sɩ yuo la jaŋ leriŋ?” Yoŋ-la bʋl, “Ŋmɩɛsa pɩmɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, arɩ ŋ bɩ jaŋ kpʋmɛ koo a kɛmmɛ mʋ pɩ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ. Ka dɩ mɩ kɛnɩŋ tuu dagɛ ba leriŋ.”

english_verse: He led David to the Amalekites. They were eating and drinking everywhere, celebrating because of what they had taken from Philistia and Judah.
translation_verse: Devit sɛɩ, yoŋ-la kɛnʋ ba mʋ, dɩ Amalɛk tɩmma-la sii pɩsa su lee-la ba sɩ hɔnɔ kala a didii kɩaa aŋ nyʋnyʋa, aŋ gbigbieli a tɩŋ kʋ-daŋ-la ba sɩ yuo laa Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tinteeŋ arɩ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: David attacked just before sunrise the next day and fought until sunset. Four hundred Amalekites rode away on camels, but they were the only ones who escaped.
translation_verse: Sɩɩpʋʋraa Devit sii a yuoba ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ taŋ pʋl a kaa mʋ yi dɩdaanɩŋ. Bapʋɔsaa zɔɔ-banɛsɛ dʋndʋŋa nɛ wuo paa bʋntaŋŋaba a jɩla fá. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ba kʋŋkala fa bɩ ka.

english_verse: David rescued his two wives and everyone else the Amalekites had taken from Ziklag.
translation_verse: Devit yuo laa ba kɩalɩŋ kala Amalɛk tɩmma-la fa sɩ paa Zɩkɩlag lɛ, a pɛ ʋ haala-la balɩa lɛ.

english_verse: No one was missing—young or old, sons or daughters. David brought back everything that had been stolen,
translation_verse: Ba kʋŋkala bɩ lɛlɛ. Hambie koo nɩhɩaŋ, hambolibie koo hantolibie, kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ yuo paa koo kʋŋ na-kala ba sɩ joŋo. Ba kala nɛ Devit bɩra laa.

english_verse: including their livestock. David also took the sheep and cattle that the Amalekites had with them, but he kept these separate from the others. Everyone agreed that these would be David's reward.
translation_verse: Ʋ laa Amalɛk tɩmma-la piesee arɩ nɛsɩŋ kala nɛ, ʋ nɩaa kiri ba kala a pɛ ba kɩaa lɛ a hɛ ba sɩpaaŋ aŋ bʋl, “Kɩalɩŋ Devit sɩ yuo laa nɛ ŋ-la.”

english_verse: Some of David's men were good-for-nothings, and they said, “Those men didn't go with us to the battle, so they don't get any of the things we took back from the Amalekites. Let them take their wives and children and go!”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ fa sɩ to Devit harɩŋ a mʋ laal-la a ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ arɩ wʋhɛɛrɛɛ bʋl, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ la harɩŋ wuo to mʋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ la kpaa kɩalɩŋ la sɩ yuo laa Amalɛk tɩmma-la teeŋ a pɩba. Ba kʋŋkala maga dɩ la joŋ ʋ haalaa arɩ ʋ biiriŋ nɛ a pʋ dɩ ʋ kaa viiri.”

english_verse: But David said: My friends, don't be so greedy with what the Lord has given us! The Lord protected us and gave us victory over the people who attacked.
translation_verse: Devit bʋl, “Aɩ, mɩ naambiiriŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa ŋɩɩ kɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩla lɛ. Ʋ pɔla nɛ woruŋ, a joŋ la dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ kʋ dii la jaŋ a hɛ la nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Who would pay attention to you, anyway? Soldiers who stay behind to guard the camp get as much as those who go into battle.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ bʋla, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ kɛmba tɩŋ? Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔnɔ pɔ la kɩaa sɩ jaŋ laa kpaal-la, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ mʋ laalɩŋ jaŋ laa. Ma kala kpaalɩŋ jaŋ magɛ dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: David made this a law for Israel, and it has been the same ever since.
translation_verse: Devit joŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ a bil ʋ ŋaa nii a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ba tuto a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: David went back to Ziklag with everything they had taken from the Amalekites. He sent some of these things as gifts to his friends who were leaders of Judah, and he told them, “We took these things from the Lord's enemies. Please accept them as a gift.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Devit sɩ kʋ yi Zɩkɩlag, ʋ joŋ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yuo laa dɔnsʋŋ a dii zile pɩ Juda nɩhɩasɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ aŋ bʋl, “Kɩalɩŋ la sɩ yuo laa La TƖƖNA dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ teeŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, má laa.”

english_verse: This is a list of the towns where David sent gifts: Bethel, Ramoth in the Southern Desert, Jattir, Aroer, Siphmoth, Eshtemoa, Racal, the towns belonging to the Jerahmeelites and the Kenites, Hormah, Bor-Ashan, Athach, and Hebron. He also sent gifts to the other towns where he and his men had traveled.
translation_verse: arɩ Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ. Devit bɩra joŋ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ a dii zile pɩ nɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩ hɛ lere-la kala ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa sɩ gɔllɔ mʋ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the Philistines were fighting Israel at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa kʋ yuo Iziral tɩŋŋaa a kpʋba woruŋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɩlɩbʋa nyuŋ, ka ba dɔnsʋŋ fá a lɛl.

english_verse: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
translation_verse: Ka Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kire to Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ harɩŋ, a kpʋ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ deemba batori: Jonataŋ, Abɩnadab arɩ Malɩkɩ-Sʋa.

english_verse: The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Laal-la sɩ kʋ lɩma kɛŋ Sɔɔl, ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yagʋ arɩ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ, a bolimu woruŋ.

english_verse: Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want these worthless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.” But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Saul then took out his own sword; he stuck the blade into his stomach, and fell on it.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kori ʋ laalɩyuori kɩaa, “Lɩɩsɛ ŋ tokobiiŋ a tɔɔmɛ kpʋ, ŋɩɩ dee disiŋ tɩŋŋaa deemba jaŋ kʋ kpʋmɛ a tʋʋsɛ mɩ joŋŋoo.” Ama fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ kori ʋ laalɩyuori kɩaa nɛ, ʋ bɩ wuo ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa tokobiiŋ a pɛ, a tel ʋ nyuŋ a kpʋ ʋ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: When the soldier knew that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kori Sɔɔl laalɩyuori kɩalɩŋ sɩ na dɩ ʋ sʋba, ʋ ma lɩɩsɛ tokobiiŋ kpʋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɛ Sɔɔl lɛ.

english_verse: Saul was dead, his three sons were dead, and the soldier who carried his weapons was dead. They and all his soldiers died on that same day.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ batori arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kori ʋ laalɩyuori kɩaa arɩ ʋ nɩaa kala sʋʋ tapʋl-bala nɛ.

english_verse: The Israelites on the other side of Jezreel Valley and the other side of the Jordan learned that Saul and his sons were dead. They saw that the Israelite army had run away. So they ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites had left behind.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Jɛzɩrɛl fuonaaŋ lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ ma fa sɩ cholo hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuoŋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ, sɩ na dɩ Iziral laalɩyuoroo kala fá a lɛl, ka Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ ma sʋʋ, ba lɩɩ fá kagɛ ba tasɩŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa kʋ jʋʋ hɔŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: The day after the battle, when the Philistines returned to the battlefield to take the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers, they found Saul and his three sons lying dead on Mount Gilboa.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la sii mʋ dɩ ba wuri nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa kɩaa, ba na dɩ Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ batori sʋʋ pɩŋ Gɩlɩbʋa peeliŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: The Philistines cut off Saul's head and pulled off his armor. Then they put his armor in the temple of the goddess Astarte, and they nailed his body to the city wall of Beth-Shan. They also sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the good news in the temples of their idols and among their people.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ ʋ laalɩyuori kɩalɩŋ a bil ba vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩtarɔf dɩa lɛ, aŋ joŋ Sɔɔl kʋsʋʋŋ a kpaasa mɛrɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf Saŋ jeeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul's body.
translation_verse: Jabɛs Gɩlɩad nɩaa sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa Sɔɔl lɛ,

english_verse: So one night, some brave men from Jabesh went to Beth-Shan. They took down the bodies of Saul and his sons, then brought them back to Jabesh and burned them.
translation_verse: ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ sii a vɛŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ a mʋ Bɛf Saŋ, a sori Sɔɔl kʋsʋʋŋ Bɛf Saŋ jee-la lɛ, a paa ʋ hambolibiisiŋ pɛ a kaa mɩɩra mʋ Jabɛs a nyɩgɛ.

english_verse: They buried the bones under a small tree in Jabesh, and for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ paa ba haŋgbelee hugi tɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ tamarɛs bʋbʋɔŋ Jabɛs lɛ, aŋ vɔɔ niiŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: Saul was dead. Meanwhile, David had defeated the Amalekites and returned to Ziklag.
translation_verse: Iziral tinteeŋ, kuoro Sɔɔl sɩ sʋba harɩŋ, Devit mʋ yuo dii Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa aŋ mɩɩra kɔ Zɩkɩlag, a hɔŋ nɩmɛ tapʋlaa balɩa.

english_verse: Three days later, a soldier came from Saul's army. His clothes were torn, and dirt was on his head. He went to David and knelt down in front of him.
translation_verse: Tapʋl-torimuŋ chɛɛŋ, baal kʋbala lɩɩ Sɔɔl laalɩyuoroo buguŋ a fá kɔ Devit teeŋ. Ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kala fa kɩɛsa nɛ, ʋ nyuŋ ma kala bʋgɛ arɩ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ aa dagɛ tʋɔ-cheeŋ. Ʋ sɩ kɔ Devit teeŋ, ʋ tuu kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlʋ.

english_verse: David asked, “Where did you come from?” The man answered, “From Israel's army. I barely escaped with my life.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit pɩɛsʋ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ lɩɩ?” Ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ foro fá nɛ a lɩɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa buguŋ.”

english_verse: “Who won the battle?” David asked. The man said, “Our army turned and ran, but many were wounded and died. Even King Saul and his son Jonathan are dead.”
translation_verse: Devit bɩra pɩɛsʋ, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa nɩmɛ, bʋla pɩmɛ.” Baal-la bʋl, “Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo fá nɛ laalɩŋ lɛ. Ba jesiŋ kala nɛ sʋba. Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ nanʋala Jonataŋ ma sʋʋ.”

english_verse: The young man replied: I was on Mount Gilboa and saw King Saul leaning on his spear. The enemy's war chariots and cavalry were closing in on him.
translation_verse: Bapʋɔsɩ-bie-la bʋl, “Mɩ fa hɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɩlɩbʋa nyuŋ nɛ aŋ na Sɔɔl dɩ ʋ yelli ʋ timiŋ, ka ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ laalɩyuori-janɩŋ torukoba arɩ ja-jɩllaa fá kʋʋ kpagʋ.

english_verse: When he turned around and saw me, he called me over. I went and asked what he wanted.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ daasa namɛ, ʋ yɩrɛmɛ. Mɩ pɩɛsɛ, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa pɩŋ?’

english_verse: Saul asked me, “Who are you?” “An Amalekite,” I answered.
translation_verse: Ʋ ma pɩɛsɛmɛ, ‘Ŋ nɛ kʋbɛɛ?’ Mɩ bʋl, ‘Mɩ ŋaa Amalɛk tɩɩna nɛ.’

english_verse: Then he said, “Kill me! I'm dying, and I'm in terrible pain.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Kɔ mɩ teeŋ a kpʋmɛ, mɩ pɩra nɛ woruŋ, a chɩchɛ mɩ sʋʋŋ.’

english_verse: So I killed him. I knew he was too badly wounded to live much longer. Then I took his crown and his arm-band, and I brought them to you, Your Majesty. Here they are.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mʋ a kpʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa pɩnna-la doho ʋ sɩ pɩna, mɩ jɩma ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ sii. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ ʋ kuoru nyunchuulo arɩ ʋ vaagɩraa tabɩɩŋ kaa kɔ dɩ mɩ pɩŋ, mɩ nɩhɩaŋ.”

english_verse: They cried all day long and would not eat anything. Everyone was sad because Saul, his son Jonathan, and many of the Lord's people had been killed in the battle.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba yel a vɔɔ niiŋ wɩa tuu jʋʋ, a tɩŋ Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ nanʋala Jonataŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA laalɩyuoroo wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa Iziral nɩ-daŋ nɛ ba kpʋ laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: David asked the young man, “Where is your home?” The man replied, “My father is an Amalekite, but we live in Israel.”
translation_verse: Devit bɩra pɩɛsɛ bapʋɔsɩ-bie-la sɩ kʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ pʋ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ lɩɩ?” Baal-la bʋl, “Mɩ nyɩmma ŋaa Amalɛk tɩɩna nɛ, a hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: David said to him, “Why weren't you afraid to kill the Lord's chosen king? And you even told what you did. It's your own fault that you're going to die!” Then David told one of his soldiers, “Come here and kill this man!” David Sings in Memory of Saul
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋl Amalɛk tɩɩna-la lɛ, “Ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ŋ sʋʋŋ. Ŋ tɩtɩa bʋla: Mɩ nɛ kpʋ nɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ ŋaa kuoro.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit yɩrɛ ʋ nɩaa dɔŋɔ a bʋla pʋ, “Mʋ kpʋ baal-la.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mʋ kpʋʋ. Devit tʋɔŋ chei Sɔɔl arɩ Jonataŋ wɩaa

english_verse: David sang a song in memory of Saul and Jonathan,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ deeŋ a tɩgɛ Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ nanʋala Jonataŋ lɛ,

english_verse: Israel, your famous hero lies dead on the hills, and your mighty warriors have fallen!
translation_verse: “Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ba kpʋ ma laalɩyuori sɩpaalaaraa Sɔɔl arɩ Jonataŋ nɛ a bil dundolluŋ nyuŋ. Ma laalɩyuori duoruŋ tele nɛ wuru a sʋʋ!

english_verse: Don't tell it in Gath or spread the news on the streets of Ashkelon. The godless Philistine women will be happy and jump for joy.
translation_verse: Ma pɔ má sɩ́ wɩɩ-la bʋl Gaf lɛ. Má sɩ́ Asɩkɛlɔŋ wombiee lɛ chɩna heele bʋlʋ pɩ nɩaa. Má sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa toloo tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to toloo jʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: Don't let dew or rain fall on the hills of Gilboa. Don't let its fields grow offerings for God. There the warriors' shields were smeared with mud, and Saul's own shield was left unpolished.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ duonuŋ sɩ́ Gɩlɩbʋa peelee nyuŋ nɩɩ, dɩ nyalɩŋ ma sɩ́ nɩmɛ nyal, dɩ ba bagɩsɩŋ ma kʋŋ sɩ́ kʋduulii kala kɛŋ dɩ ba kaa ŋaa Wɩɩ-sʋla, bɛɛ wɩaa hɔɔtaala-la laalɩyuori duoruŋ sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ jʋʋ disiniŋ nɛ. Hɔɔtaala-la Sɔɔl sɩ kaa kɛrɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ, ba bɩra bɩ nʋʋŋ ŋaa tɩsʋ.

english_verse: The arrows of Jonathan struck, and warriors died. The sword of Saul cut the enemy apart.
translation_verse: Jonataŋ to-hɛmɩŋ bɩ laalɩŋ mʋa aŋ mɩmɩɩrɛ pɛɩ. Sɔɔl ma tokobiiŋ bɩ pɛɩ ka viisi. Ba yie ŋmoo laalɩyuori duoruŋ lo nɛ a kpʋba.

english_verse: It was easy to love Saul and Jonathan. Together in life, together in death, they were faster than eagles and stronger than lions.
translation_verse: Nɩaa fa cho Sɔɔl arɩ Jonataŋ nɛ woruŋ, ba kala fa hɛ ba mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, aŋ kala bɩra to dɔŋɔ a sʋʋ. Ba fa lɩma a kɩɩ kachuunuŋ, ba kɛŋ doluŋ ma a kɩɩ naachigee.

english_verse: Women of Israel, cry for Saul. He brought you fine red cloth and jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa haalaa, má yel Sɔɔl lɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ laalɛma. Ʋ nɛ joŋ sɛlɩmɛ kɩaa a kpɩɛrɛ ma gɛrɩ-balaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Our warriors have fallen in the heat of battle, and Jonathan lies dead on the hills of Gilboa.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori duoruŋ tele nɛ laalɩŋ lɛ! Jonataŋ nɛ sʋba pɩŋ ma dundolluŋ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jonathan, I miss you most! I loved you like a brother. You were truly loyal to me, more faithful than a wife to her husband.
translation_verse: Jonataŋ, mɩ naambii, mɩɩ yel ŋ lɛ nɛ. Mɩ fa choŋ nɛ woruŋ. Ŋ ma fa chomi nɛ woruŋ, a kɩɩ haala sɩ cho ʋ bala.

english_verse: Our warriors have fallen, and their weapons are destroyed.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori duoruŋ tele sʋʋ nɛ, ka ba laalɩyuori kɩaa pɩŋ pɛɩ.”

english_verse: Later, David asked the Lord, “Should I go back to one of the towns of Judah?” The Lord answered, “Yes.” David asked, “Which town should I go to?” “Go to Hebron,” the Lord replied.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala harɩŋ lɛ nɛ, Devit pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA, “Mɩ jaŋ wuo mɩɩra mʋ Juda tasɩ-la dɔŋɔɔ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pʋ, “Mʋ.” Devit bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “Tabɛɛ nɛ maga mɩ mʋ?” La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Mʋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ.”

english_verse: David went to Hebron with his two wives, Ahinoam and Abigail. Ahinoam was from Jezreel, and Abigail was the widow of Nabal from Carmel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit kɛŋ ʋ haala-la balɩa ba mʋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ: Jɛzɩrɛl tɩŋŋaa tolo Ahɩnʋam arɩ Kamɛl tɩŋŋaa Nabal yo-haal-la ʋ sɩ jaa baa yɩrɛ Abɩgɛl.

english_verse: David also told his men and their families to come and live in the villages near Hebron.
translation_verse: Devit fa pɛ kɛŋ baala-la sɩ hɛ ʋ teeŋ ma mʋ nɛ, ba dɩ ba dɩa nɩaa. Ba hɔŋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ arɩ tasɩ-la kala sɩ gollu lɛ.

english_verse: The people of Judah met with David at Hebron and poured olive oil on his head to show that he was their new king. Then they told David, “The people from Jabesh in Gilead buried Saul.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juda doho nɩaa kɔ Hɛbʋrɔŋ, a joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ tɩsɛ Devit a dagɛ arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ba kuoro. Ba sɩ bʋla pɩ Devit arɩ Jabɛs Gɩlɩad nɩaa nɛ hugi Sɔɔl,

english_verse: David sent messengers to tell them: The Lord bless you! You were kind enough to bury Saul your ruler,
translation_verse: ʋ tɩŋ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ bʋla pɩba, “La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ, a tɩŋ ma sɩ zil ma nɩhɩaŋ Sɔɔl a hugu.

english_verse: and I pray that the Lord will be kind and faithful to you. I will be your friend because of what you have done.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋl La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ dagɛ ʋ zile arɩ ʋ wutɩtɩɩ ma teeŋ. Mɩ ma jaŋ kɛmma woruŋ, a tɩŋ wʋzɔŋ-la ma sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: Saul is dead, but the tribe of Judah has made me their king. So be strong and have courage. Ishbosheth Becomes King of Israel
translation_verse: Má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma nɩhɩaŋ Sɔɔl sʋba nɛ, ka Juda nɩaa lɩɩsɛmɛ mɩ ŋaa ba kuoro.” Laalɩŋ sii Devit dɩa nɩaa arɩ Sɔɔl dɩa nɩaa pɛgɛ

english_verse: Abner the son of Ner had been the general of Saul's army. He took Saul's son Ishbosheth across the Jordan River to Mahanaim
translation_verse: Ama bʋa deeŋ lɛ, dɩ Sɔɔl laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ Abɩna sɩ ŋaa Nɛɛ nanʋala, sii kɛŋ Sɔɔl nanʋala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf ba chol Jɔdaŋ fuoŋ a mʋ Mahanem.

english_verse: and made him king of Israel, including the areas of Gilead, Asher, Jezreel, Ephraim, and Benjamin.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ leŋ Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf dii tinteyee deemba kuoruŋ: Gɩlɩad, Asuri, Jɛzɩrɛl, Efirem, Bɛnjamɩŋ arɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kala.

english_verse: and he ruled from Hebron for seven and a half years. The War between David and Ishbosheth
translation_verse: Devit dii kuoruŋ a hɔŋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ a beŋ Juda doho nɩaa jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ arɩ chɛnsɩŋ balɩdʋ nɛ.

english_verse: One day, Abner and the soldiers of Ishbosheth left Mahanaim and went to Gibeon.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nɛɛ nanʋala Abɩna arɩ Sɔɔl nanʋala Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf laalɩyuoroo sii Mahanem lɛ a mʋ Gibioŋ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, Joab the son of Zeruiah was leading David's soldiers, and the two groups met at the pool in Gibeon. Abner and his men sat down on one side of the pool, while Joab and his men sat on the other side.
translation_verse: Zeruya nanʋala Jʋab, ʋ dɩ Devit tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ lɩɩ chemba lɩɩŋ sɩ pɩŋ lee-la Gibioŋ lɛ. Jʋab sɩ ŋaa Devit nɩaa sɩpaalaara, ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa hɔŋ vil-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, Abɩna arɩ ʋ nɩaa ma hɔŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, ba chaasɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Abner yelled to Joab, “Let's get some of our best soldiers to stand up and fight each other!” Joab agreed,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩna bʋla pɩ Jʋab, “Leŋ dɩ la ŋaa dɩ la ba-pʋɔsa-la dɔnsʋŋ sii tʋʋ vaasɩŋ loo dɩ la na.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋab bʋl, “Ʋ zɔmɔ, leŋ dɩ ba sii loo.”

english_verse: and twelve of Ishbosheth's men from the tribe of Benjamin got up to fight twelve of David's men.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ nɩaa fii arɩ balɩa Bɛnjamɩŋ arɩ Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a lɩɩsɛ nɩaa fii arɩ balɩa Devit ma nɩaa tʋɔŋ dɩ ba loo.

english_verse: They grabbed each other by the hair and stabbed each other in the side with their daggers. They all died right there! That's why the place in Gibeon is called “Field of Daggers.”
translation_verse: Dɔŋɔ yie kɛŋ dɔŋɔ nyuŋ lɛ, aŋ tɔɔ ʋ sɛmɛ lɛ arɩ sɩɩ-chɔrɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋaa a kala sʋʋ lee-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ lee-la yɩyɩrɛ Hɛlɩkaf Hazurim.

english_verse: Then everyone started fighting. Both sides fought very hard, but David's soldiers defeated Abner and the soldiers of Israel.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala suomo yuyuo ʋ dɔŋɔ tapʋlɩɩ-la, laalɩŋ chaasa hosi woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit nɩaa yuo dii Abɩna arɩ Iziral nɩaa.

english_verse: Zeruiah's three sons were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel could run as fast as a deer in an open field,
translation_verse: Dɩ Zeruya hambolibiisi-la batori ma hɛ nɩmɛ: Jʋab, Abɩsaɩ arɩ Asahɛl. Asahɛl faa fá nɛ woruŋ a nagɛ tɛhɩɩ.

english_verse: When Abner turned and saw him, he said, “Is that you, Asahel?” Asahel answered, “Yes it is.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩna daasɛ harɩŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ nɛɛ Asahɛl?” Ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ nɛ.”

english_verse: Abner said, “There are soldiers all around. Stop chasing me and fight one of them! Kill him and take his clothes and weapons for yourself.” But Asahel refused to stop.
translation_verse: Abɩna bʋla pʋ, “Sɩ́ mɩ harɩŋ kire to, laalɩyuoroo nɛ gollila, gɛbɛ mʋ ŋ nadiiŋ koo nagʋa, a kpʋ bapʋɔsɛ biisi-la dɔŋɔ aŋ laa ʋ laalɩyuori kɩaa.” Ama Asahɛl vɩa aŋ ha kire to ʋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: Abner said, “If you don't turn back, I'll have to kill you! Then I could never face your brother Joab again.”
translation_verse: Abɩna bɩra bʋla pɩ Asahɛl, “Sɩ́ mɩ harɩŋ kire to! Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ kpʋŋ? Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa beŋ ŋ naambie Jʋab sɩaa lɛ?”

english_verse: But Asahel would not turn back, so Abner struck him in the stomach with the back end of his spear. The spear went all the way through and came out of his back. Asahel fell down and died. Everyone who saw Asahel lying dead just stopped and stood still.
translation_verse: Ama Asahɛl ha vɩa aŋ kire to. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩna joŋ ʋ timiŋ gentine a yɩ hɛ Asahɛl luoruŋ lɛ, ʋ lɩɩ gɩrɩgɛ. Ʋ tele sʋʋ lee-la tɩtɩa. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kʋ yi lee-la Asahɛl sɩ sʋʋ pɩŋ, ʋ yie chɩŋ nɛ a beŋ.

english_verse: But Joab and Abishai went after Abner. Finally, about sunset, they came to the hill of Ammah, not far from Giah on the road to Gibeon Desert.
translation_verse: Jʋab arɩ Abɩsaɩ ma bɩra kire to Abɩna harɩŋ. Wɩa tuu jʋjʋʋ dɩ ba yi dundolo kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ama, a kpagɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɩa sɩ hɛ wombii-la ba sɩɩ mʋ, Gibioŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la.

english_verse: Abner brought the men of Benjamin together in one group on top of a hill, and they got ready to fight.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sii pɛ Abɩna lɛ. Ba hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a jɩla chɩŋ dundolo nyuŋ a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ.

english_verse: Abner shouted to Joab, “Aren't we ever going to stop killing each other? Don't you know that the longer we keep on doing this, the worse it's going to be when it's all over? When are you going to order your men to stop chasing their own relatives?”
translation_verse: Abɩna yɩrɛ Jʋab a pɩɛsʋ, “Ʋ maga dɩ la kpʋkpʋ dɔŋɔ deeŋ deeŋ nɛɛ? Ŋ bɩ jɩŋ ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔ-cheeŋ a pɩla? Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɛ ʋ diene magɛ ka dɩ ŋ kiri ŋ nɩaa dɩ ba sɩ́ ba naambiiriŋ harɩŋ kire to?”

english_verse: Joab shouted back, “I swear by the living God, if you hadn't spoken, my men would have chased their relatives all night!”
translation_verse: Jʋab bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ ŋmɩɛsɛ Wɩa sɩ weye, dɩ ŋ nɛ fa bɩ ŋ-la bʋla, mɩ nɩaa fa jaŋ kiri ba naambiiri-la baarɛ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ dɩ taŋ pʋl.”

english_verse: Joab took his trumpet and blew the signal for his soldiers to stop chasing the soldiers of Israel. At once, the fighting stopped.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋab ŋmʋʋ banyile sɩ ŋaa magɩl a pɩ ʋ nɩaa kala ba guu chɩŋ. Ba bɩra bɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa harɩŋ kire to a yuoba.

english_verse: Abner and his troops marched through the Jordan River valley all that night. Then they crossed the river and marched all morning until they arrived back at Mahanaim.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ-la kala Abɩna arɩ ʋ nɩaa vɛŋ Jɔdaŋ fuonaa-la tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ-na chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la. Taŋ pʋl chʋchʋɔŋ ba vɛŋ ŋɩɩ a bɩra mʋ yi Mahanem.

english_verse: As soon as Joab stopped chasing Abner, he got David's troops together and counted them. There were
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋab leŋ Abɩna harɩŋ kire tonuŋ, aŋ yɩrɛ ʋ nɩaa kala a hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ʋ sɩ dɩɩsɛba, ʋ na dɩ Devit nɩaa fii arɩ nibi nɛ tuo a pɛ Asahɛl lɛ.

english_verse: Joab and his troops carried Asahel's body to Bethlehem and buried him in the family burial place. Then they marched all night and reached Hebron before sunrise.
translation_verse: Jʋab arɩ ʋ nɩaa joŋ Asahɛl a hugi ʋ nyɩmma bʋa-la sɩ hɛ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm lɛ. Ka ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa vɛŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ a mʋ yi Hɛbʋrɔŋ sɩɩ-pʋʋraa.

english_verse: As the war went on between the families of David and Saul, Abner was gaining more power than ever in Saul's family.
translation_verse: Laal-la sɩ sii Sɔɔl dɩa nɩaa arɩ Devit nɩaa pɛgɛ, Abɩna doluŋ nɛ fa pʋŋa pɩpɛ Sɔɔl dɩa nɩaa kala tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: He had even slept with a wife of Saul by the name of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah. But Saul's son Ishbosheth told Abner, “You shouldn't have slept with one of my father's wives!”
translation_verse: Sɔɔl fa bil haal kʋbala nɛ aŋ bɩ jaa ba yɩyɩrɛ Rɩzɩpa. Haal-la fa ŋaa Ayɩa tolo nɛ. Sɔɔl nanʋala Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf pɩɛsɛ Abɩna, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ kɛŋ mɩ nyɩmma haal-la ʋ sɩ bile aŋ bɩ jaa pɩŋ?”

english_verse: Abner was very angry because of what Ishbosheth had said, and he told Ishbosheth: Am I some kind of worthless dog from Judah? I've always been loyal to your father's family and to his relatives and friends. I haven't turned you over to David. And yet you talk to me as if I've committed a crime with this woman.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf sɩ bʋla leŋ Abɩna baanɩŋ chaasa sii. Ʋ pɩɛsɛ, “Ŋ bɩɩna mɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩ nɛ a pɩpɛ Juda nɩaa lɛɛ? Bumbuŋ kala a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ, mɩ chaasa chɩŋ ŋ nyɩmma Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa arɩ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ kala harɩŋ nɛ woruŋ. Mɩ ha bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa a joŋuŋ hɛ Devit nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ka ŋ chichei mɩ yɩrɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ haala deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I ask God to punish me if I don't help David get what the Lord promised him!
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ Wɩa dɔgɩsɛ mɩ-na Abɩna kɩŋkɛŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ Devit lɛ pɛ dɩ ʋ na wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pʋ. La TƖƖNA hɛ niiŋ pʋ

english_verse: God said that he wouldn't let anyone in Saul's family ever be king again and that David would be king instead. He also said that David would rule both Israel and Judah, all the way from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south.
translation_verse: arɩ ʋ jaŋ laa kuoruŋ Sɔɔl doho nɩaa teeŋ a pɩ Devit dɩ ʋ ŋaa kuoro Iziral arɩ Juda tinteeŋ kala lɛ, a chɩŋ Daŋ tinteeŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ yi Bɛɛsɩba tinteeŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.”

english_verse: Ishbosheth was so afraid of Abner that he could not even answer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf woruŋ, ʋ bɩra bɩ wuo bʋl wɩɩkala Abɩna teeŋ.

english_verse: Abner sent some of his men to David with this message: “You should be the ruler of the whole nation. If you make an agreement with me, I will persuade everyone in Israel to make you their king.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩna tɩŋ tɩndaaraa ba mʋ Devit teeŋ, a bʋl, “Ŋ nɛ nɩɩ-la fa sɩ maga dɩ ŋ bibeŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa leŋ dɩ la niiŋ ŋaa kʋbala, ka dɩ mɩ pɛ ŋ lɛ a leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kʋ tutoŋ.”

english_verse: David sent this message back: “Good! I'll make an agreement with you. But before I will even talk with you about it, you must get Saul's daughter Michal back for me.”
translation_verse: Devit bʋl, “Ʋ zɔmɔ. La niiŋ jaŋ ŋaa kʋbala. Ama wʋbala nɛ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa pɩmɛ: Dɩ ŋ nɛ mɩɩra kʋkɔ mɩ teeŋ, pɛ kɛŋ Sɔɔl tolo Mɩkal kaa kʋ pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: David sent a few of his officials to Ishbosheth to give him this message: “Give me back my wife Michal! I killed
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit tɩŋ tɩndaaraa ba mʋ Sɔɔl nanʋala Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf teeŋ a bʋl, “Joŋ mɩ haala Mɩkal pɩmɛ, nɩɩ-la jaarɩŋ mɩ sɩ kpʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa zɔlɔ a keri ba penee puroo tiŋ.”

english_verse: Ishbosheth sent some of his men to take Michal away from her new husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.
translation_verse: Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf leŋ ba mʋ laa Mɩkal ʋ bal-falɩŋ Palɩtɩɛl teeŋ. Palɩtɩɛl nyɩmma nɛ Las.

english_verse: Paltiel followed Michal and the men all the way to Bahurim, crying as he walked. But he went back home after Abner ordered him to leave.
translation_verse: Ʋ bala-la lɩɩ yele tuto ʋ harɩŋ ŋɩɩ halɩɩ a mʋ yi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bahurim. Abɩna bʋla pʋ, “Mɩɩra mʋ dɩa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mɩɩrɛ.

english_verse: Abner talked with the leaders of the tribes of Israel and told them, “You've wanted to make David your king for a long time now.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩna arɩ Iziral nɩhɩasɩŋ bʋl wɩaa. Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Faafaa kala ma cho dɩ Devit nɛ ŋaa ma kuoro.

english_verse: So do it! After all, God said he would use his servant David to rescue his people Israel from their enemies, especially from the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ wombiiŋ hɛ nɩmɛ dɩ ma ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA hɛ niiŋ a pɩ Devit nɛ a bʋl, ‘Mɩ jaŋ to mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit lɛ a laa mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa arɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɩsɩŋ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Finally, Abner talked with the tribe of Benjamin. Then he left for Hebron to tell David everything that the tribe of Benjamin and the rest of the people of Israel wanted to do.
translation_verse: Abɩna bʋl wɩaa a pɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa ma. Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ sii mʋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ, dɩ ʋ bʋla pɩ Devit wɩalɩŋ kala Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa kala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba ŋaa.

english_verse: soldiers with him, and when they got to Hebron, David gave a big feast for them.
translation_verse: Abɩna sɩ mʋ Devit teeŋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ, ʋ dɩ baalaa mara nɛ mʋa. Devit ŋaa kʋdiilee pɩba. Ba dii aŋ gbieli.

english_verse: After the feast, Abner said, “Your Majesty, let me leave now and bring Israel here to make an agreement with you. You'll be king of the whole nation, just as you've been wanting.” David told Abner he could leave, and he left without causing any trouble. Joab Kills Abner
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩna bʋla pɩ Devit, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, leŋ dɩ mɩ lɛɛlɛ mʋ a kɛŋ Iziral nɩalɩŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a kɛmba kɔ ŋ teeŋ dɩ ma niiŋ ŋaa kʋbala, dɩ ŋ dii ba kuoruŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩɩ chɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit ta Abɩna ʋ viiri arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Jʋab kpʋ Abɩna

english_verse: Soon after Abner had left Hebron, Joab and some of David's soldiers came back, bringing a lot of things they had taken from an enemy village.
translation_verse: Abɩna sɩ mʋa harɩŋ, Devit nɩaa arɩ Jʋab mɩɩra lɩɩ laalɩŋ kɔ ʋ teeŋ, a kɛŋ kʋ-daŋ ba sɩ yuo laa a kaa kɔ. Ama bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Abɩna bɩra tuo Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Devit taʋ ʋ viiri nɛ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: Right after they arrived, someone told Joab, “Abner visited the king, and the king let him go. Abner even left without causing any trouble.”
translation_verse: Jʋab arɩ laalɩyuoro-la sɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ, ba bʋla pʋ arɩ Nɛɛ nanʋala Abɩna kɔ kuoro teeŋ nɛ, ka kuoro leŋ ʋ mɩɩra viiri arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: Joab went to David and said, “What have you done? Abner came to you, and you let him go. Now he's long gone!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋab sii a mʋ kuoro Devit teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ? Abɩna sɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ leŋ ʋ mʋ? Lɛɛlɛ ʋ viire nɛ!

english_verse: You know Abner—he came to trick you. He wants to find out how strong your army is and to know everything you're doing.”
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ Nɛɛ nanʋala Abɩna sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ kɔ dɩ ʋ nyɩsɩŋ nɛ, a jɩŋ ŋ vɛnɩŋ maŋŋaa, aŋ pɛ na wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: Joab left David, then he sent some messengers to catch up with Abner. They brought him back from the well at Sirah, but David did not know anything about it.
translation_verse: Jʋab sɩ sii Devit teeŋ, ʋ tɩŋ tɩndaaraa ba kiri Abɩna harɩŋ a mʋ kɛnʋ Sɩra viliŋ leriŋ, a kaa mɩɩra kɔ. Ama Devit fa bɩ ŋɩɩ lɛ jɩŋ.

english_verse: When Abner returned to Hebron, Joab pretended he wanted to talk privately with him. So he took Abner into one of the small rooms that were part of the town gate and stabbed him in the stomach. Joab killed him because Abner had killed Joab's brother Asahel. Abner's Funeral
translation_verse: Abɩna sɩ mɩɩra kɔ Hɛbʋrɔŋ, Jʋab kɛnʋ a bal boi-baalɩŋ niiŋ a nagɛ ʋʋ chɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ dʋndʋŋa bʋl wɩaa nɛ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ joŋ ʋ naambie Asahɛl, Abɩna sɩ kpʋa chɩmɩŋ a tiŋ ʋ lɛ, a tɔɔ ʋ luoruŋ lɛ ʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: David heard how Joab had killed Abner, and he said, “I swear to the Lord that I am completely innocent of Abner's death!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, Devit nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA jɩma mɩ dɩ mɩ nɩaa bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ Nɛɛ nanʋala Abɩna sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Joab and his family are the guilty ones. I pray that Joab's family will always be sick with sores and other skin diseases. May they all be cowards, and may they die in war or starve to death.”
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ Jʋab arɩ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ Abɩna sʋʋŋ wɩaa, a leŋ dɩ Jʋab dɩa lɛ bʋa na-kala dɩ nʋʋ kɛŋ naawalɩŋ sɩɩ lɩɩ nʋɔlʋŋ koo dayalɩmɩŋ koo dɩ nʋʋ ŋaa puwuol koo dɩ ba kpʋkpʋba laalɩŋ lɛ koo dɩ kʋdiilee nyaa ba dɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: David told Joab and everyone with him, “Show your sorrow by tearing your clothes and wearing sackcloth! Walk in front of Abner's body and cry!” David walked behind the stretcher on which Abner's body was being carried.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ Jʋab arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ teeŋ, “Má kɛŋ ma gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ, aŋ laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ a laa Abɩna kʋsʋʋŋ sɩpaaŋ a yiyel.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka kuoro Devit tɩtɩa tuto sʋʋ-la harɩŋ.

english_verse: Abner was buried in Hebron, while David and everyone else stood at the tomb and cried loudly.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ Abɩna mʋ a hugi Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ, Abɩna bʋa leriŋ. Kuoro faasa ŋmoo niiŋ, nɩalɩŋ ma kala yel woruŋ.

english_verse: Then the king sang a funeral song about Abner: Abner, why should you have died like an outlaw?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro yel aŋ ta jembiiŋ deeŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ Abɩna lɛ: “Abɩna maga dɩ ʋ sʋʋ nɩyaarɩ sʋʋŋ deeŋ nɛɛ?

english_verse: No one tied your hands or chained your feet, yet you died as a victim of murderers. Everyone started crying again.
translation_verse: Ba bɩŋ nɩsaa vɔbɔ, ba bɩra bɩ ŋ naasɩŋ ma vɔbɔ. Ka ŋ sʋʋ arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ kpʋ nɩa.” Nɩalɩŋ kala bɩra yel ʋ lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Then they brought some food to David and told him he would feel better if he had something to eat. It was still daytime, and David said, “I swear to God that I won't take a bite of bread or anything else until sunset!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala kɔ a sʋsʋl Devit dɩ ʋ dii kɩaa dɩ taŋ ha bɩ bire, ama Devit ŋmɩɛsɛ a bʋl, “A leŋ dɩ Wɩa dɔgɩsɛmɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ dii kʋŋkala ka dɩ wɩɩ-muluŋ-na jʋʋ.”

english_verse: Everyone noticed what David did, and they liked it, just as they always liked what he did.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ, ba tʋɔŋ chaasa tɔrɛ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, wɩɩ na-kala kuoro sɩ ŋaa tɔrɛ ba tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Now the people of Judah and Israel were certain that David had nothing to do with killing Abner.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ Juda nɩaa arɩ Iziral nɩaa kala jɩŋ arɩ kuoro bɩ Nɛɛ nanʋala Abɩna sʋʋŋ lɛ jɩŋ.

english_verse: David said to his officials, “Don't you realize that today one of Israel's great leaders has died?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro pɩɛsɛ ʋ nɩaa, “Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ sɩpaalaarɩ-duo arɩ nɩbal nɛ sʋʋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ jɩnɩŋ?

english_verse: I am the chosen king, but Joab and Abishai have more power than I do. So God will have to pay them back for the evil thing they did.”
translation_verse: Jɩnɩmba, mɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ mɩ dii kuoruŋ, ama Zeruya biiriŋ Jʋab arɩ Abɩsaɩ dolie kɩɩ mɩ nɛ. A leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA joŋ wʋbɔŋ-la ba sɩ ŋaa chɩmɩŋ a tiŋ ba lɛ!”

english_verse: Ishbosheth felt like giving up after he heard that Abner had died in Hebron. Everyone in Israel was terrified.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl nanʋala Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf sɩ nɩa dɩ Abɩna sʋʋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ, ʋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala ŋaa holumoŋ.

english_verse: Ishbosheth had put the two brothers Baanah and Rechab in charge of the soldiers who raided enemy villages. Rimmon was their father, and they were from the town of Beeroth, which belonged to the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl nanʋala fa kɛŋ baalaa balɩa sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoru bugo-la sɩ gɔllɔ kpʋ nɩaa tasɩŋ lɛ aŋ lɩlaa kɩaa sɩpaalaaraa nɛ. Dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Baana, dɔŋɔ ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ Rekab. Ba nyɩmma nɛ Rimoŋ, a ŋaa Bɛrɔf tɩɩna, a lɩɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ba fa joŋ Bɛrɔf ʋ ma pɛ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The people who used to live in Beeroth had run away to Gittaim, and they still live there.
translation_verse: Bɛrɔf nɩaa fa lɩɩ mʋ hɔŋ Gitem lɛ nɛ, a ŋaa nʋhʋɔra a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: One day about noon, Rechab and Baanah went to Ishbosheth's house. It was a hot day, and he was resting
translation_verse: Rimoŋ, Bɛrɔf tɩɩna-la hambolibiisiŋ Rekab arɩ Baana, sii a mʋmʋ Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf dɩa, a mʋ yi nɩmɛ wɩɩ-hɛɛ-siese, dɩ Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf pɩna aa wiesi.

english_verse: in his bedroom. The two brothers went into the house, pretending to get some flour. But once they were inside, they stabbed Ishbosheth in the stomach and killed him. Then they cut off his head and took it with them. Rechab and Baanah walked through the Jordan River valley all night long.
translation_verse: Ba mʋ jʋʋ ʋ dɩa sɩpaaŋ a nagɛ dɩ ba jʋa dɩ ba ŋaa mɛmpɛ nɛ, aŋ tɔɔ ʋ luoruŋ lɛ ʋ kʋpɩnɩŋ nyuŋ ʋ sʋʋ. Rekab arɩ ʋ naambie Baana keri ʋ nyuŋ a joŋo kaa lʋara lɩɩ tɩtaŋ-la kala a to Jɔdaŋ fuonaa-la a viiri.

english_verse: Finally they turned west and went to Hebron. They went in to see David and told him, “Your Majesty, here is the head of Ishbosheth, the son of your enemy Saul who tried to kill you! The Lord has let you get even with Saul and his family.”
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf nyuŋ-la kɔ kuoro Devit teeŋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ, a bʋl, “Na ŋ dʋndɔmɔ Sɔɔl, nɩɩ-la sɩ walɩma dɩ ʋ kpʋŋ nanʋala Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf nyuŋ. Jɩnɩŋ La TƖƖNA joŋ ŋ-na mɩ nɩhɩaŋ sɩ ŋaa kuoro baanɩŋ a fɩɩsɛ Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: David answered: I swear that only the Lord rescues me when I'm in trouble!
translation_verse: Devit mɩɩra bʋla pɩ Rekab arɩ ʋ naambie Baana, “La TƖƖNA sɩ weye wɩaa, ʋ nɛ laamɛ ta mɩ wʋjʋʋlaa kala lɛ,

english_verse: When a man came to Ziklag and told me that Saul was dead, he thought he deserved a reward for bringing good news. But I grabbed him and killed him.
translation_verse: baal-la fa sɩ kɔ Zɩkɩlag a bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ Sɔɔl sʋba, aŋ bɩɩnɛ arɩ wʋzɔŋ nɛ ʋ kʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ, mɩ kɛnʋ nɛ a kpʋʋ. Ʋ time mɩ sɩ joŋo timu nɛ ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kʋ bʋla pɩmɛ.

english_verse: You evil men have done something much worse than he did. You've killed an innocent man in his own house and on his own bed. I'll make you pay for that. I'll wipe you from the face of the earth!
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ saa maga dɩ mɩ ŋaa ma nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ lɛ? Ma kpʋ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩkala cheye nɛ ʋ dɩɩ-pɩnɩŋ tʋɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ ŋɩɩ chɩmɩŋ a tiŋ ma lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ma nyɩɩgɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: Then David said to his troops, “Kill these two brothers! Cut off their hands and feet and hang their bodies by the pool in Hebron. But bury Ishbosheth's head in Abner's tomb near Hebron.” And they did.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit leŋ ʋ nɩaa kpʋba, a keri ba nɩsaa arɩ ba naasɩŋ, aŋ joŋ ba yaraa sagɛ a kpagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ pɩŋ lee-la Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ. Ama ba joŋ Ɩsɩ-Bɔsɛf-na nyuŋ a hugi Abɩna bʋa lɛ Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre sent some officials to David. Carpenters and stone workers came with them, and they brought cedar logs so they could build David a palace.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ Taaya tinteeŋ kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hiram tɩŋ tɩndaaraa ba kɔ Devit teeŋ, a kɛŋ kuolu daasɩŋ arɩ kapɩntaba arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ tabɩaa tɩntɩŋŋaa, ba kʋ saa kuoru dɩa a pɩ Devit.

english_verse: He lived in Hebron for the first seven and a half years and ruled only Judah. Then he moved to Jerusalem, where he ruled both Israel and Judah for
translation_verse: Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ, Devit beŋ Juda nɩaa jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ arɩ chɛnsɩŋ balɩdʋ nɛ. Jerusalɛm ma lɛ, ʋ beŋ Iziral arɩ Juda kala nɩaa jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ batori nɛ. Devit yuo laa Jerusalɛm

english_verse: The Jebusites lived in Jerusalem, and David led his army there to attack them. The Jebusites did not think he could get in, so they told him, “You can't get in here! We could keep you out, even if we couldn't see or walk!”
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ kuoro Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa sii a mʋ Jerusalɛm dɩ ba yuo Jebus tɩmma-la sɩ hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Jebus tɩmma-la bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ daha. Dɩ la nɛ paala gbɛrɩgɛ koo a nyʋlɩmɛ ma, la bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ yuo dii la tabalɩŋ.” Ba bɩɩna Devit bɩ jaŋ wuo yuo diiba.

english_verse: David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna chɩŋ Devit harɩŋ woruŋ, ʋ doluŋ wasa pʋŋa pɛ.

english_verse: David knew that the Lord had made him king of Israel and that he had made him a powerful ruler for the good of his people. David's Sons Born in Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ Devit jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ leŋe ʋ kuoruŋ chɩŋ woruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, a leŋ ʋ tinteeŋ wɩaa vɩvɛŋ woruŋ a tɩŋ ʋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: After David left Hebron and moved to Jerusalem, he married many women from Jerusalem, and he had a lot of children.
translation_verse: Devit sɩ sii Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ a mʋ Jerusalɛm, ʋ kɛŋ haala-la ʋ sɩ bile aŋ bɩ jaa ma yʋgɛ nɛ a pɛ ha-daŋ-la ʋ sɩ jaa a to ba naasɩŋ lɛ. Haala-la lʋl hambolibiisiŋ arɩ toloo a yʋgɛ a pʋ.

english_verse: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
translation_verse: Ɩbɩha, Ɛlɩsʋa, Nɛfɛg, Jafɩa,

english_verse: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet. David Fights the Philistines (
translation_verse: Ɛlɩsama, Ɛlɩada arɩ Ɛlɩfɛlɛt. Devit yuo dii Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa

english_verse: The Philistines heard that David was now king of Israel, and they came into the hill country to try and capture him. But David found out and went into his fortress.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩ nɩa dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ Devit nɛ a joŋ nʋʋŋ tɩsʋ ʋ ŋaa Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro, ba laalɩyuoroo kala sii mʋ a chɩchɛʋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ dɩ ba kɛnʋ. Devit nɩɩ a sii tuu faa dɩ-duo kʋbala lɛ.

english_verse: So the Philistines camped in Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la kʋ lɩɩ jɛrɛ su Refem fuonaaŋ.

english_verse: David asked the Lord, “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you let me win?” The Lord told David, “Attack! I will let you win.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA, “Mɩ mʋ yuo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-laa? Ŋ jaŋ jomba hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛɛ?” La TƖƖNA bʋla pʋ, “Mʋ, mɩ jaŋ jomba hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: David attacked the Philistines and defeated them. Then he said, “I watched the Lord break through my enemies like a mighty flood.” So he named the place “The Lord Broke Through.”
translation_verse: Devit sii a mʋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal Pɛrazɩm. Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ yuo diiba, aŋ bʋl, “La TƖƖNA leŋe mɩ yuo dii mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, a nagɛ fuoŋ sɩ suo a gbu lɩɩ pɛllɛ paa kɩaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ lee-la a yɩyɩrɛ Baal Pɛrazɩm.

english_verse: David and his troops also carried away the idols that the Philistines had left behind.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la fá a vɩa ba tɔŋŋɔɔ ta nɩmɛ, Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa paa kaa viiri.

english_verse: Some time later, the Philistines came back into the hill country and camped in Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la bɩra kʋ lɩɩ a jɛrɛ su Refem fuonaa-la kala.

english_verse: David asked the Lord what he should do, and the Lord answered: Don't attack them from the front. Circle around behind and attack from among the balsam trees.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bɩra pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ na ʋ jaŋ bɩra wuo mʋ yuobaa. La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Sɩ́ ba leriŋ tegi tegi mʋ, gollo to ba harɩŋ a chɩŋ tʋrʋ tɩɩsɩ-la sɩpaaŋ aŋ yuoba.

english_verse: Wait until you hear a sound in the treetops like marching troops. Then attack quickly! That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kʋ nɩɩ laalɩyuoroo naasɩŋ dɔmɔ tʋrʋsʋ-la nyuŋ, guu mʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋɩɩ daga arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA laa ŋ sɩpaaŋ mʋ nɛ dɩ mɩ yuo dii Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la.”

english_verse: David obeyed the Lord and defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Geba to the entrance to Gezer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit ŋaa ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ, a kire kpʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa a chɩŋ Gibioŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ a kaa mʋ Gɛza.

english_verse: The people carrying the chest walked six steps, then David sacrificed an ox and a choice cow.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ chʋŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la sɩ joŋ naakieliŋ bʋlɩdʋ, Devit leŋ ba chɩŋ, ka ʋ kpʋ nɛ-bele arɩ nɛ-pɔrʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ nammɩa a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: He was dancing for the Lord with all his might, but he wore only a linen cloth.
translation_verse: Devit fa laalɛ gɛrɩpɛ-fʋfʋl gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ, aŋ gʋgʋa arɩ ʋ doluŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: He and everyone else were celebrating by shouting and blowing horns while the chest was being carried along.
translation_verse: Ka ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kɛŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la kʋʋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm a ŋɩŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ aŋ ŋmʋŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ.

english_verse: Saul's daughter Michal looked out her window and watched the chest being brought into David's City. But when she saw David jumping and dancing for the Lord, she was disgusted.
translation_verse: Ba fa sɩ kɛŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la kʋʋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm ŋɩɩ, Sɔɔl tolo Mɩkal to tokoro a nyilime na Devit. Ʋ sɩ naʋ dɩ ʋ fɩla aŋ pɛ gʋgʋa La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, ʋ tʋɔŋ lɩɩʋ.

english_verse: They put the sacred chest on a new ox cart and started bringing it down the hill from Abinadab's house. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio were guiding the ox cart,
translation_verse: Ba fa joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la daŋ nɛsɩŋ toruko falɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a kaa lɩɩ Abɩnadab dɩa-la sɩ chɩŋ dundolo nyuŋ a kʋ lɩɩ. Uza arɩ Ahio sɩ ŋaa Abɩnadab biiriŋ nɛ fa kɛŋ toruko-la vɩvɛŋ,

english_verse: led them to Baalah in Judah, which was also called Kiriath-Jearim. They were going there to get the sacred chest and bring it back to Jerusalem. The throne of the Lord All-Powerful is above the winged creatures on top of this chest, and he is worshiped there.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa kala sii mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baala sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ, dɩ ba joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la a kaa mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm. Ʋ nyuŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa lɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ pɛgɛ.

english_verse: with Ahio walking in front of it.
translation_verse: ka Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la daŋ ʋ lɛ. Ahio nɛ fa laa toruko-la sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Some of the people of Israel were playing music on small harps and other stringed instruments, and on tambourines, castanets, and cymbals. David and the others were happy, and they danced for the Lord with all their might.
translation_verse: Ka Devit arɩ Iziral tɩmma-la kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, faasa jʋjʋɔsɛ arɩ ba doluŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a du chenniŋ, kɔnɛba, gugonnuŋ, a chɩchɩgɩsɛ chɩnchɩgɩsɩŋ arɩ buguloo.

english_verse: But when they came to Nacon's threshing-floor, the oxen stumbled, so Uzzah reached out and took hold of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kʋ yi baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nakɔŋ taha, nɛsɩ-la gɛrɛ. Uza guu mʋ kɛŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la.

english_verse: The Lord God was very angry with Uzzah for doing this, and he killed Uzzah right there beside the chest.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa fa chaasa na baanɩŋ Uza nyuŋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ digi Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la. Ŋɩɩ faa kɩsɛ nɛ. Ʋ ŋmobu kpʋ a bil daga-la sɛmɛ.

english_verse: David got angry with God for killing Uzzah. He named that place “Bursting Out Against Uzzah,” and that's what it's still called.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit ma na baanɩŋ a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ kpʋ Uza. A kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala ba kɛŋ lee-la a yɩyɩrɛ Pɛrɛs Uza nɛ.

english_verse: David was afraid of the Lord and thought, “Should I really take the sacred chest to my city?”
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ Devit tapʋlɩɩ-la a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA wɩaa. Ʋ bʋl, “Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa a joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la kaa kɔ mɩ teeŋ?”

english_verse: He decided not to take it there. Instead, he turned off the road and took it to the home of Obed Edom, who was from Gath.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la mʋ ʋ teeŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mɩɩra joŋ a kaa mʋ bil baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm dɩa lɛ, ʋ ŋaa Giti tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: The chest stayed there for three months, and the Lord greatly blessed Obed Edom, his family, and everything he owned. Then someone told King David, “The Lord has done this because the sacred chest is in Obed Edom's house.” At once, David went to Obed Edom's house to get the chest and bring it to David's City. Everyone was celebrating.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ kuoro Devit, “La TƖƖNA pɛ Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa arɩ kʋŋ na-kala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ lɛ nɛ woruŋ, a tɩŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ wɩaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit mʋ joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm dɩa lɛ, a kaa kʋkɔ Jerusalɛm, aŋ ka ba chaasa gbigbieli.

english_verse: They put the chest inside a tent that David had set up for it. David worshiped the Lord by sacrificing animals and burning them on an altar,
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la jʋʋ bil ʋ dɩ-biliŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ kuoro Devit sɩ hɛ a pʋ. Devit ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: then he blessed the people in the name of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ sʋl Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la a dɛrɛ, ʋ sʋl Wɩa pɩ nɩalɩŋ, La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He gave all the men and women in the crowd a small loaf of bread, some meat, and a handful of raisins, then everyone went home. Michal Talks to David
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ boroboro, kpʋla nɛnɛɛ arɩ girep nɛŋ-hɩlaa a kpaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩ-daŋ-la kala, baalaa arɩ haalaa. Ba kala mɩɩra mʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: David went home so he could ask the Lord to bless his family. But Saul's daughter Michal went out and started yelling at him. “You were really great today!” she said. “You acted like a dirty old man, dancing around half-naked in front of your servants' slave-girls.”
translation_verse: Devit fa sɩ mɩɩra kɔ ʋ dɩa dɩ ʋ sʋl Wɩa pɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa lɛ, Sɔɔl tolo Mɩkal lɩɩ chemu a bʋl, “Bɛɛ kɩaa hɩɩsɛ wɩaa nɛ ŋ-na Iziral kuoro ŋaa ŋɩɩ jɩnɩŋ, a wuri ŋ kɩaa ta ŋ tɩntɩnnaa haalaa sɩpaaŋ a nagɛ nɩyaarɩ?”

english_verse: David told her, “The Lord didn't choose your father or anyone else in your family to be the leader of his people. The Lord chose me, and I was celebrating in honor of him.
translation_verse: Devit bʋla pʋ, “La TƖƖNA leŋ ŋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala ta nɛ, aŋ lɩɩsɛmɛ mɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaara, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ gʋgʋa ʋ sɩpaaŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I'll show you just how great I can be! I'll even be disgusting to myself. But those slave-girls you talked about will still honor me!”
translation_verse: Mɩ ha jaŋ gʋa a hɩɩsɛ mɩ tɩtɩa a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ mɩɩ hɩɩsɛ mɩ tɩtɩa nɛ, ama tɩntɩnnɩ-haala-la wɩaa ŋ sɩ bʋla jaŋ zilmi.”

english_verse: But I will never put an end to my agreement with him, as I put an end to my agreement with Saul, who was king before you.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ chonuŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ dɛrɛ ʋ teeŋ, arɩ ʋ sɩ dɛrɛ Sɔɔl teeŋ ŋɩɩ, mɩ lɩɩsʋ, ka ŋ mɩɩra dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: Then one day, as David was talking with Nathan the prophet, David said, “Look around! I live in a palace made of cedar, but the sacred chest has to stay in a tent.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Netaŋ, “Mɩɩ jʋʋ kuoru dɩa ba sɩ kɛŋ kuolu daasɩŋ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ a saa nɛ, ka Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la hɛ lɛbɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Nathan replied, “The Lord is with you, so do what you want!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Netaŋ bʋla pɩ kuoro Devit, “Ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ŋ sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ zɔmɔ pɩŋ, La TƖƖNA chɩŋ ŋ harɩŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: That night, the Lord told Nathan
translation_verse: Ama tɩtaŋ-la tɩtɩa nɛ La TƖƖNA fa bʋl wɩaa pɩ Netaŋ:

english_verse: to go to David and give him this message: David, you are my servant, so listen to what I say. Why should you build a temple for me?
translation_verse: “Mʋ bʋla pɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit, Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ŋ dee bɩ maga dɩ ŋ saa dɩa pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ jʋjʋʋ.

english_verse: I didn't live in a temple when I brought my people out of Egypt, and I don't live in one now. A tent has always been my home wherever I have gone with them.
translation_verse: Mɩ ha bɩ dɩa kala jʋa a chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa a lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ. Mɩ gɔllɔɔ baarɛ nɛ a jʋjʋʋ lɛbɩŋ.

english_verse: I chose leaders and told them to be like shepherds for my people Israel. But did I ever say anything to even one of them about building a cedar temple for me?
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ kɛŋ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa vɩvɛŋ, mɩ ha bɩ ba sɩpaalaara-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ba bibemba kʋŋ pɩɛsa, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bɩ kuolu daasɩŋ kaa saa dɩa pɩmɛ?’

english_verse: David, this is what I, the Lord All-Powerful, say to you. I brought you in from the fields where you took care of sheep, and I made you the leader of my people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, bʋla pɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ lɩɩsɩŋ pie-daalɩŋ lɛ nɛ a leŋ ŋ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro.

english_verse: Wherever you went, I helped you and destroyed your enemies right in front of your eyes. I have made you one of the most famous people in the world.
translation_verse: Lee na-kala ŋ sɩ mʋa, mɩ chɩŋ ŋ harɩŋ nɛ, a yuo dii ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala. Lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ sii, arɩ dʋnɩa nɩbalaa yɩrɩŋ sɩ sii ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I have given my people Israel a land of their own where they can live in peace, and they won't have to tremble with fear any more. Evil nations won't bother them, as they did
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ leriŋ a pɩ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa, a leŋ ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba tɩtɩa lee, dɩ nʋʋ bɩra sɩ́ ba walɩmʋ. Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩra bɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba arɩ ba fa sɩ ŋaaba ŋɩɩ bumbuŋ-la,

english_verse: when I let judges rule my people. And I have kept your enemies from attacking you. Now I promise that you and your descendants will be kings.
translation_verse: bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa sɩ lɩɩsɛ sɩpaalaaraa ba bibemba. Mɩ sɩ mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma wiesi ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na ŋ TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ dɩa chaasa chɩŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: I'll choose one of your sons to be king when you reach the end of your life and are buried in the tomb of your ancestors. I'll make him a strong ruler,
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ tapʋlaa nɛ yie dɩ ŋ sʋʋ a mʋ ŋ nyɩmmaba teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ ŋ bii-lʋlʋŋ dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ ŋ nyuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ kuoruŋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: and no one will be able to take his kingdom away from him. He will be the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ saa dɩa pɩmɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ kuoruŋ chɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I will be his father, and he will be my son. When he does wrong, I'll see that he is corrected, just as children are corrected by their parents.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ nyɩmma, dɩ ʋ ma ŋaa mɩ bie. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ a chei, mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛ ʋ dɩgɩlɩŋ a nagɛ nuhuobiine sɩ yie lɛrɛ ʋ bie dɩgɩlɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: After all, you really are Israel's God, the Lord All-Powerful. You've told me that you will let my descendants be kings. That's why I have the courage to pray to you like this, even though I am only your servant.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral Wɩa, ŋ leŋe mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna jɩŋ arɩ mɩ doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna wuo nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ aŋ sʋsʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: David went into the tent he had set up for the sacred chest. Then he sat there and prayed: Lord All-Powerful, my family and I don't deserve what you have already done for us,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Devit sii mʋ jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ Wɩa niiriŋ daga sɩ hɛ, a hɔŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, aŋ chʋɔlʋ a bʋl: “La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, mɩ dɩ mɩ dɩa nɩaa nɛ kʋbɛɛba, ŋ ŋaa wʋbalɩŋ deeŋ la lɛ?

english_verse: I am your servant, and you know my thoughts, so there is nothing more that I need to say.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, ŋ jɩŋ mɩ wɩɩkala nɛ. Mɩ bɩra bɩ wɩɩkala kɛnɛ mɩ bʋl.

english_verse: You have done this wonderful thing, and you have let me know about it, because you wanted to keep your promise.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa wʋbalɩŋ deeŋ, a leŋ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna jɩmʋ a tɩŋ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa arɩ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you are greater than all others. No one is like you, and you alone are God. Everything we have heard about you is true.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ŋ nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala. Kʋŋkala tuo a magɩŋ. Wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ nɩa daga arɩ ŋ nɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: And there is no other nation on earth like Israel, the nation you rescued from slavery in Egypt to be your own. You became famous by using great and wonderful miracles to force other nations and their gods out of your land, so your people could live here.
translation_verse: Tintee dɔŋ tuo dʋnɩa lɛ a magɛ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Ba nɛ ŋ laa ta Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ faafaa, bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ ŋaa yosuŋ. Ŋ laaba ta dɩ ba ŋaa ŋ nɩaa. Wʋbala-la arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa pɩba leŋe ŋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ nɛ dʋnɩa kala lɛ. Ŋ kiri tinteyee arɩ ba vesiŋ ta nɛ ŋ nɩaa sɩpaaŋ. Ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa ta Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You have chosen Israel to be your people forever, and you have become their God.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe Iziral tɩŋŋaa chaasa chɩŋ nɛ a ŋaa ŋ nɩaa a kaa mʋ wuu. Ŋ-na La TƖƖNA nɛ lɛɛlɛ ŋaa ba Wɩa.

english_verse: Then you will be famous forever, and everyone will say, “The Lord God All-Powerful rules Israel, and David's descendants are his chosen kings.”
translation_verse: dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa jaŋ bʋl, ‘La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa Iziral Wɩa.’ Ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna Devit dɩa chaasa chɩŋ.

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you are God. You have promised me some very good things, and you can be trusted to do what you promise.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ŋ nɛ Wɩa. Ŋ niiŋ wɩaa ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba a pɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna.

english_verse: Please bless my descendants and let them always be your chosen kings. You have already promised, and I'm sure that you will bless my family forever.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, pɛ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna doho nɩaa lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ba ŋaa nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba didii kuoruŋ. Ŋ-na La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ŋ laa sɩpaaŋ a bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ. Mɩ laa dii arɩ ŋ jaŋ pɛ mɩ doho nɩaa lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was the commander of David's bodyguard. David's sons were priests.
translation_verse: Jehoyada nanʋala Bɛnaaya ma nɛ fa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Devit nɩhɩaŋ, ka Devit hambolibiisiŋ ma ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa a chɩchagɩlʋ.

english_verse: David also defeated the Moabites. Then he made their soldiers lie down on the ground, and he measured them off with a rope. He would measure off two lengths of the rope and have those men killed, then he would measure off one length and let those men live. The people of Moab had to accept David as their ruler and pay taxes to him.
translation_verse: Devit fa bɩra yuo dii Mʋab tɩŋŋaa ma, a leŋ ba laalɩyuoroo pɩŋ tinteeŋ a kɩɛlɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ a magɩsɛba. Dɩ ʋ nɛ magɩsɛ ŋmɛŋ-la naansɩɩŋ butori, ʋ yie kpʋ leree balɩa nɛ aŋ ka kʋbala. Mʋab tɩmma-la sɛɩ Devit bibemba ba tiŋ lampoo a pʋpʋ.

english_verse: David set out for the Euphrates River to build a monument there. On his way, he defeated the king of Zobah, whose name was Hadadezer the son of Rehob.
translation_verse: Devit bɩra yuo dii Zɔba tinteeŋ kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hadadɛza, Rehob nanʋala. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Hadadɛza mʋa dɩ ʋ yuo nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Yufireti fuo-la leriŋ, aŋ laa lee-la bibeŋ.

english_verse: When troops from the Aramean kingdom of Damascus came to help Hadadezer, David killed
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Siiria tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ sɩ sii kɔ dɩ ba pɛ Zɔba tinteeŋ kuoro Hadadɛza lɛ, Devit kpʋ ba nɩaa bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩa.

english_verse: He left some of his soldiers in Damascus, and the Arameans had to accept David as their ruler and pay taxes to him. Everywhere David went, the Lord helped him win battles.
translation_verse: Devit fa leŋe ʋ laalɩyuoroo dɔnsʋŋ gɔllɔ ŋmoo bugoo Damasɩkʋs tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ, a hɔŋ Siiria tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ lee-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Siiria tɩmma-la sɛɩ Devit bibemba, ba tiŋ lampoo pʋpʋ. Lee na-kala Devit sɩ mʋa, La TƖƖNA yie pɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ʋ yuo dii.

english_verse: Hadadezer's officers had carried their arrows in gold cases hung over their shoulders, but David took these cases and brought them to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Devit fa paa laalɩyuori kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa nɛ, hɔɔtaalɩ-la Hadadɛza laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ, a kaa mʋ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: He also took a lot of bronze from the cities of Betah and Berothai, which had belonged to Hadadezer.
translation_verse: Tasɩŋ deemba: Tɛba arɩ Berotai sɩ ŋaa Hadadɛza lere, kuoro Devit fa paa kɔlɩɩŋ yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: King Toi of Hamath and King Hadadezer had been enemies. So when Toi heard that David had attacked and defeated Hadadezer's whole army, he sent his son Joram to praise and congratulate David. Joram also brought him gifts made of silver, gold, and bronze.
translation_verse: ʋ tɩŋ ʋ nanʋala Joram dɩ ʋ mʋ lɔllɛ kuoro Devit, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ yuo dii Hadadɛza wɩaa. Tou arɩ Hadadɛza ma fa laa sɩpaaŋ yuo laalɩŋ nɛ. Joram kɛŋ hɔpʋla, sɛlɩmɛ arɩ kɔlɩɩŋ kɩaa a kaa mʋ pʋ.

english_verse: David gave these to the Lord, just as he had done with the silver and gold that he had captured from
translation_verse: Devit fa sɩ laa kɩalɩŋ, ʋ joŋo hɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a nagɛ ʋ sɩ joŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la ʋ sɩ yuo laa tinteyee deemba kala teeŋ a hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ:

english_verse: Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, Amalek, and from King Hadadezer of Zobah.
translation_verse: Ɛdɔm, Mʋab, Amɔŋ, Fɩlɩsɩtɩa arɩ Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, a pɛ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yuo laa Zɔba kuoro Hadadɛza, Rehob nanʋal-la teeŋ.

english_verse: Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abiathar the son of Ahimelech, were the priests. Seraiah was the secretary.
translation_verse: Ahitub nanʋala Zadɔk arɩ Abɩata nanʋala Ahɩmɛlɛk nɛ fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa. Sɛraaya ma nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba tenniŋ.

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah was the commander in chief of the army. Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud kept the government records.
translation_verse: Zeruya nanʋala Jʋab nɛ fa ŋaa laalɩyuoro-la nɩhɩaŋ, ka Ahilud nanʋala Jehosafat ma ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba wɩaa bibil,

english_verse: One day, David thought, “I wonder if any of Saul's family are still alive. If they are, I will be kind to them, because I made a promise to Jonathan.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Devit pɩɛsɛ, “Nʋʋ ha hɛ Sɔɔl dɩa lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ wuo dii zile ʋ lɛ, a tɩŋ Jonataŋ wɩaa?”

english_verse: David called in Ziba, one of the servants of Saul's family. David said, “So you are Ziba.” “Yes, Your Majesty, I am.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Sɔɔl dɩa tɩntɩnnaa dɔŋɔ hɛ nɩmɛ baa yɩrɛ Ziba. Ba yɩrʋ ʋ kɔ kuoro Devit sɩpaaŋ, ʋ pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ nɛ baa yɩrɛ Ziba?” Tɩntɩnnʋ-la bʋl, “Kuoro, mɩ nɛ.”

english_verse: David asked, “Are any of Saul's family still alive? If there are, I want to be kind to them.” Ziba answered, “One of Jonathan's sons is still alive, but he can't walk.”
translation_verse: Kuoro bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “Nʋʋ dɔŋ bɩra tuo Sɔɔl dɩa lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ wuo dagɛ Wɩa chonuŋ ʋ lɛɛ?” Zɩba bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Jonataŋ bii nɛ ha hɛ nɩmɛ, ama ʋ ŋaa gbɛrɩgʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: “Where is he?” David asked. Ziba replied, “He lives in Lo-Debar with Machir the son of Ammiel.”
translation_verse: Kuoro pɩɛsɛ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ʋ hɛ?” Ziba bʋl, “Ʋ nɛ hɛ Amɩɛl nanʋala Makɩɩ dɩa sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lo Dɛba lɛ.”

english_verse: David sent some servants to bring Jonathan's son from Lo-Debar. His name was Mephibosheth, and he was the grandson of Saul. He came to David and knelt down. David asked, “Are you Mephibosheth?” “Yes, I am, Your Majesty.”
translation_verse: Jonataŋ nanʋala Mɛfɩbɔsɛf, Sɔɔl nihiŋ sɩ kɔ Devit teeŋ, ʋ tuu kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ a zilu. Devit yɩrʋ, “Mɛfɩbɔsɛf!” Ʋ bʋl, “Namɛ, kuoro.”

english_verse: David said, “Don't be afraid. I'll be kind to you because Jonathan was your father. I'm going to give you back the land that belonged to your grandfather Saul. Besides that, you will always eat with me at my table.”
translation_verse: Devit bʋla pʋ, “Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ bɔyɛ joŋ, mɩ jaŋ chaasa dagɛ mɩ chonuŋ a pɩŋ a tɩŋ ŋ nyɩmma Jonataŋ wɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee-la kala sɩ ŋaa ŋ naabalɩma Sɔɔl kʋŋ a pɩŋ, aŋ ka dɩ ŋ didii kɩaa ma mɩ dɩa lɛ bʋa na-kala.”

english_verse: Mephibosheth knelt down again and said, “Why should you care about me? I'm worth no more than a dead dog.”
translation_verse: Mɛfɩbɔsɛf bɩra tuu kpirimi aŋ bʋl, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ chɩl mɩ wɩaa ŋ-la? Mɩ paala bɩ va-sʋʋŋ lɛ kpɩa.”

english_verse: David called in Ziba, Saul's chief servant, and told him, “Since Mephibosheth is Saul's grandson, I've given him back everything that belonged to your master Saul and his family.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro yɩrɛ Ziba, Sɔɔl tɩntɩnnʋ-la a bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ joŋ kʋŋ na-kala sɩ ŋaa ŋ nɩhɩaŋ Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kʋŋ a pɩ ʋ nihiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: When the kings who had been under Hadadezer's rule saw that Israel had beaten them, they made peace with Israel and accepted David as their ruler. The Arameans were afraid to help Ammon any more.
translation_verse: Kuoro-la kala fa sɩɩ to Hadadɛza sɩ na dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa yuo diiba nɛ, ba leŋ ba dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa bʋla hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ba sɛɩ Devit bibemba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ Siiria tɩmma-la, ba bɩra bɩ chɛ dɩ ba pɛ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: David said, “Nahash was kind to me, and I will be kind to his son.” So he sent some officials to the country of Ammon to tell Hanun how sorry he was that his father had died.
translation_verse: Devit bɩɩnɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a bʋl, “Nahas fa dagɛ ʋ chonuŋ kɩŋkɛŋ mɩ lɛ, mɩ ma jaŋ dagɛ mɩ chonuŋ ʋ nanʋala lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit sii a tɩŋ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ lɔllɛ Hanuŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ nyɩmma sʋʋŋ lɛ. Devit nɩalɩŋ sɩ mʋ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ,

english_verse: But Hanun's officials told him, “Do you really believe David is honoring your father by sending these people to comfort you? He probably sent them to spy on our city, so he can destroy it.”
translation_verse: Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ pɩɛsɛ ba kuoro Hanuŋ, “Ŋ laa dii arɩ ŋ nyɩmma zile wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ Devit sɛnɛ tɩŋ nɩaa deemba dɩ ba kʋ lɔllʋŋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ sʋba wɩaa? Ka Devit bɩ ba tɩma dɩ ba kʋ lʋara beŋ la jaŋ a na ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ to a yuo diiu nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Hanun arrested David's officials and had their beards shaved off on one side of their faces. He had their robes cut off just below the waist, and then he sent them away.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hanuŋ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ Devit sɩ tɩma, a fʋŋ ba kʋŋkala tɔŋŋɔɔ sɛŋ-kɩa sɛŋ-kɩa, aŋ keri ba gɛnnɩŋ ta, a chɩna magɛ ba bʋbʋɔ-kelee lɛ a kaa tuu, aŋ kiriba ta ba viiri.

english_verse: They were terribly ashamed. When David found out what had happened to his officials, he sent a message and told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards grow back. Then you can come home.”
translation_verse: Hɩɩsɩŋ chaasa kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ arɩ ba sɩ jaŋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ mʋ dɩa. Devit sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ʋ tɩŋ nɩaa ba mʋ chemba a bʋla pɩba, “Kuoro sɩ, má hɔŋ Jeriko lɛ dɩ ma tɔŋŋɔɔ waa, ka dɩ ma-na kɔ dɩa.”

english_verse: Be brave and fight hard to protect our people and the cities of our God. I pray that the Lord will do whatever pleases him.”
translation_verse: Nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ dɩ la yuo laa la nɩaa arɩ la Wɩa tasɩŋ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ wɩɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ pʋ chɩŋ.”

english_verse: David heard what they had done, and he sent out Joab with all of his well-trained soldiers.
translation_verse: Devit sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ leŋ Jʋab kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala mʋ dɩ ba yuoba.

english_verse: The Ammonite troops came out and got ready to fight in front of the gate to their city. The Arameans from Zobah and Rehob and the soldiers from Tob and Maacah formed a separate group in the nearby fields.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kʋ lɩɩ a chɩŋ ba tabalɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ lɛ, ka Siiria tɩmma-la sɩ lɩɩ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zoba arɩ Rehob arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Tob arɩ Maaka, ba-na kiele lɩɩ a hɛ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Joab saw that he had to fight in front and behind at the same time, and he picked some of the best Israelite soldiers to fight the Arameans.
translation_verse: Jʋab sɩ na dɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ laalɩyuoroo chɩŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ arɩ ʋ harɩŋ kala dɩ ba yuoba, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ tʋɔsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ woruŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la tʋɔŋ dɩ ba yuo Siiria tɩmma-la,

english_verse: He put his brother Abishai in command of the rest of the army and gave them orders to fight the Ammonites.
translation_verse: aŋ joŋ laalɩyuori-kaanaa a hɛ ʋ naambie Abɩsaɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba ma yuo Amɔŋ tɩmma-la.

english_verse: Joab told his brother, “If the Arameans are too much for me to handle, you can come and help me. If the Ammonites are too strong for you, I'll come and help you.
translation_verse: Jʋab fa bʋla pɩ Abɩsaɩ, “Dɩ Siiria tɩmma-la nɛ kʋ dolie kɩɩmɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ŋ kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ, dɩ Amɔŋ tɩmma-la ma nɛ dolie a kɩɩŋ, mɩ ma jaŋ kʋ pɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Joab and his soldiers attacked the Arameans, and the Arameans ran from them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋab arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo mʋ yuo Siiria tɩmma-la, ba fá.

english_verse: When the Ammonite soldiers saw that the Arameans had run away, they ran from Abishai's soldiers and went back into their own city. Joab stopped fighting the Ammonites and returned to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo sɩ na dɩ Siiria tɩmma-la fá, ba ma fá jʋʋ ba taŋ, aŋ leŋ Abɩsaɩ arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋab leŋ Amɔŋ tɩmma-la yuonuŋ aŋ mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: The Arameans realized they had lost the battle, so they brought all their troops together again.
translation_verse: Siiria tɩmma-la sɩ na dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa yuo diiba, ba bɩra yɩrɛ ba laalɩyuoroo kala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Hadadezer sent messengers to call in the Arameans who were on the other side of the Euphrates River. Then Shobach, the commander of Hadadezer's army, led them to the town of Helam.
translation_verse: Kuoro Hadadɛza tɩma yɩrɛ Siiria tɩmma-la kala sɩ hɛ Yufireti fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ba kɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sobak sɩ ŋaa Hadadɛza laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ kɛmba mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Helam.

english_verse: David found out what the Arameans were doing, and he brought Israel's whole army together. They crossed the Jordan River and went to Helam, where the Arameans were ready to meet them.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩ Devit, ʋ sii yɩrɛ Iziral laalɩyuoroo kala hɛ dɔŋɔ ba chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a mʋ Helam. Nɩmɛ nɛ Siiria tɩmma-la hɛ a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba yuo Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: It was now spring, the time when kings go to war. David sent out the whole Israelite army under the command of Joab and his officers. They destroyed the Ammonite army and surrounded the capital city of Rabbah, but David stayed in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Tafaaŋ, bʋa-la lɛ kuoroo sɩ yie mʋmʋ laalɩŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit ta Jʋab arɩ ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ Iziral laalɩyuoroo kala ba mʋ laalɩŋ. Ba mʋ yuo dii Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa aŋ tɔ ba tabalɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Raba ma hɛ. Ka Devit-na fa hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: he may get angry and ask, “Why did you go so near the city to fight? Didn't you know they would shoot arrows from the wall?
translation_verse: ʋ baanɩŋ jaŋ wuo sii dɩ ʋ pɩɛsɩŋ, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma faasa mʋ kpagɛ taŋ-la dɩ ma yuoba? Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ ba jaŋ to jebiiŋ nyuŋ a yuoma arɩ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ?

english_verse: But later, when she found out that she was going to have a baby, she sent someone to David with this message: “I'm pregnant!”
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, Bafɩsɛba na dɩ ʋ kɛŋ luoruŋ. Ʋ tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Devit, “Mɩ kɛŋ luoruŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: David sent a message to Joab: “Send Uriah the Hittite to me.” Joab sent Uriah
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Jʋab laalɩŋ lɛ: “Leŋ dɩ Yuria, Hiti tɩɩna-la kɔ.” Jʋab ta Yuria ʋ kɔ Devit teeŋ.

english_verse: to David's palace, and David asked him, “Is Joab well? How is the army doing? And how about the war?”
translation_verse: Yuria sɩ kɔ, Devit pɩɛsʋ Jʋab arɩ laalɩyuoro-la wɩaa arɩ ŋɩɩ laalɩŋ sɩɩ vɛŋ.

english_verse: Then David told Uriah, “Go home and clean up.” Uriah left the king's palace, and David had dinner sent to Uriah's house.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ Yuria, “Mʋ dɩa a fo lɩɩŋ.” Yuria sɩ lɩɩ kuoro dɩa lɛ, Devit joŋ kɩaa pa dɩ ba kaa mʋ pʋ.

english_verse: But Uriah didn't go home. Instead, he slept outside the entrance to the royal palace, where the king's guards slept.
translation_verse: Ama Yuria fa bɩ ʋ dɩa mʋa. Ʋ mɩɩra lɩɩ pɩŋ kuoro tɩntɩnnaa teeŋ nɛ boiŋ nii-la ba sɩ to a jʋjʋʋ kuoro dɩa.

english_verse: Someone told David that Uriah had not gone home. So the next morning David asked him, “Why didn't you go home? Haven't you been away for a long time?”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bʋla pɩ Devit arɩ Yuria bɩ dɩa mʋa, ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit yɩrʋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Dɩ-bolii dee ŋ lɩɩ kɔɔ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bɩ dɩa mʋa?”

english_verse: Uriah answered, “The sacred chest and the armies of Israel and Judah are camping out somewhere in the fields with our commander Joab and his officers and troops. Do you really think I would go home to eat and drink and sleep with my wife? I swear by your life that I would not!”
translation_verse: Yuria bʋla pɩ Devit, “Wɩa niiriŋ daga arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Juda tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kala hɛ laal-baga lɛ nɛ, mɩ nɩhɩaŋ Jʋab arɩ ʋ nɩaa ma hɛ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ. Ɛɛ nɛ saa mɩ-na jaŋ wuo mʋ dɩa a dii kɩaa ka mɩ dɩ mɩ haala pɩŋ? Ŋ sɩ hɛ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋdoho deeŋ.”

english_verse: Then David said, “Stay here in Jerusalem today, and I will send you back tomorrow.” Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day. Then the next day,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pʋ, “Pɩŋ daha jɩnɩŋ bɩra, chie mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩra mʋ.” Tapʋlɩɩ-la Yuria chʋa Jerusalɛm lɛ taŋ pʋl ʋ ha bɩra chʋa.

english_verse: David invited him for dinner. Uriah ate with David, who gave him so much to drink that he got drunk. But Uriah still did not go home. He went out and slept on his mat near the palace guards.
translation_verse: Devit yɩrʋ, ʋ mʋ ba dii kɩaa aŋ nyʋa. Devit leŋ ʋ nyʋa kɩaa a kala bugi. Dɩdaaŋ-la Yuria bɩra bɩ dɩa mʋa, aŋ lɩɩ pɩŋ ʋ bɔsɔ lɛ ʋ nɩhɩaŋ tɩntɩnnaa teeŋ.

english_verse: Early the next morning, David wrote a letter and told Uriah to deliver it to Joab.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ sii chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla Devit ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ Yuria dɩ ʋ kaa mʋ pɩ Jʋab.

english_verse: The letter said: “Put Uriah on the front line where the fighting is the worst. Then pull the troops back from him, so that he will be wounded and die.”
translation_verse: Teŋ-la lɛ ʋ sɩ, “Jʋab, joŋ Yuria a hɛ laalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ, lee-la sɩ lɩma, aŋ bʋla pɩ laalɩyuoro-la kala dɩ ma nʋga lɩɩ harɩŋ, ka dɩ ba kpʋʋ.”

english_verse: Joab had been carefully watching the city of Rabbah, and he put Uriah in a place where he knew there were some of the enemy's best soldiers.
translation_verse: Jʋab arɩ ʋ nɩaa sɩ gollo dɩ ba yuo taŋ-la, ʋ beŋ a na ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ laalɩyuori-duoruŋ sɩ hɛ lee-la, a joŋ Yuria hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: When the men of the city came out, they fought and killed some of David's soldiers—Uriah the Hittite was one of them.
translation_verse: Taŋ-la nɩaa sɩ kʋ lɩɩ a yuo Jʋab arɩ ʋ nɩaa, ba kpʋ kuoro Devit laalɩyuoroo dɔnsʋŋ, Yuria Hiti tɩɩna-la nɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Joab sent a messenger to tell David everything that was happening in the war.
translation_verse: Jʋab tɩŋ dɩ ba mʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa laalɩŋ lɛ a pɩ Devit.

english_verse: He gave the messenger these orders: When you finish telling the king everything that has happened,
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba nɛ ʋ pɛ bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ tɩma: “Dɩ ŋ nɛ mʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa a pɩ kuoro,
