translation_verse: Wʋhɛɛrʋ kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ baa yɩrɛ Sɛba. Ʋ ŋaa Bikiri nanʋala nɛ, aŋ ŋaa Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nʋʋ. Ʋ ŋmʋʋ banyile, aŋ kpɩa goŋ a bʋl, “La nɩsɩŋ tuo Jesi nanʋala Devit lɛ. Iziral tɩmma, má leŋ la mɩɩra mʋ la dɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: So they stopped following David and went off with Sheba. But the people of Judah stayed close to David all the way from the Jordan to Jerusalem. David's Ten Wives
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩmma-la kala vɩa Devit, aŋ tuto Bikiri nanʋala Sɛba. Ama Juda doho nɩaa na-kala chɩna gbɛrɛ ba kuoro Devit nɛ, a to ʋ harɩŋ a lɩɩ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a mʋ yi Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: David had left ten of his wives in Jerusalem to take care of his palace. But when he came back, he had them taken to another house, and he placed soldiers there to guard them. He gave them whatever they needed, but he never slept with any of them again. They had to live there for the rest of their lives as if they were widows. The Army Goes after Sheba
translation_verse: Devit sɩ mɩɩra kɔ ʋ kuoru dɩa sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, ʋ kɛŋ haala-la ʋ sɩ bile aŋ bɩ jaa a leŋ ba pɔ ʋ kuoru dɩa, a tɔ hɛ dɩa lɛ a leŋ laalɩyuoroo bibemba. Ʋ pɩpɩba kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ chɛ, ama ʋ dɩ ba kʋŋkala bɩ bɔsɔ ka pɛ. Ba tɔba ŋɩɩ nɛ, ba hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ a mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ sʋba. Ba hɛ nɩmɛ a nagɛ yo-haalaa.

english_verse: David said to Amasa, “Three days from now I want you and all of Judah's army to be here!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro bʋla pɩ Amasa sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoru-hɩaŋ, “Yɩrɛ Juda tɩmma-la kala dɩ ŋ dɩ ba kɔ mɩ teeŋ a chɩŋ jɩnɩŋ a kaa mʋ tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ.”

english_verse: Amasa started bringing the army together, but it was taking him more than three days.
translation_verse: Ama Amasa sɩ mʋa dɩ ʋ yɩrɛ Juda tɩmma-la, ʋ diene kɩɩ tapʋlɩa-la batori kuoro sɩ dagʋ nɛ.

english_verse: So David said to Abishai, “Sheba will hurt us more than Absalom ever did. Take my best soldiers and go after him. We don't want him to take over any walled cities and get away from us.” Joab Kills Amasa
translation_verse: Devit fa bʋla pɩ Abɩsaɩ, “Lɛɛlɛ Bikiri nanʋala Sɛba jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ la lɛ a kɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Abɩsalɔm sɩ ŋaa. Kɛsɛ mɩ laalɩyuoroo a kiri Sɛba libe, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ jaŋ wuo mʋ jʋʋ tabala-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli dɔŋɔ, a fori la nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Abishai left Jerusalem to try and capture Sheba. He took along Joab and his soldiers, as well as David's bodyguard and best troops.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩsaɩ sii kɛŋ Jʋab arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Devit arɩ laalɩyuori-babiibala-la kala. Ba lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kikiri dɩ ba kɛŋ Bikiri nanʋala Sɛba.

english_verse: They had gone as far as the big rock at Gibeon when Amasa caught up with them. Joab had a dagger strapped around his waist over his military uniform, but it fell out as he started toward Amasa.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋ yi bʋ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Gibioŋ lɛ, Amasa kʋ chemba, dɩ Jʋab laalɛ ʋ laalɩyuori-gɛnnɩŋ, a joŋ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie vɔɔ ʋ tɩŋa, aŋ joŋ sɩɩ-chɔrɔ sɩ hɛ ʋ pɛɛŋ lɛ a vɔɔ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie-la lɛ. Ʋ fa sɩɩ mʋ dɩ ʋ chemu ŋɩɩ, sɩa-la fuoso tel. Ʋ joŋ arɩ nagʋa.

english_verse: Joab said, “Amasa, my cousin, how are you?” Then Joab took hold of Amasa's beard with his right hand, so that he could greet him with a kiss.
translation_verse: Jʋab chʋɔlɛ Amasa a bʋl, “Mɩ naambii, ŋ yaraa fɩɛlaa?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ kɛŋ Amasa tɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ arɩ ʋ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ a nagɛ ʋʋ chɛ dɩ ʋ guoru nɛ.

english_verse: Amasa did not see the dagger in Joab's other hand. Joab stuck it in Amasa's stomach, and his insides spilled out on the ground. Joab only struck him once, but Amasa was dying. Joab and his brother Abishai went off to chase Sheba.
translation_verse: Amasa fa bɩ sɩa-la sɩ hɛ Jʋab nɩsɩŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ na, ka Jʋab joŋ sɩa-la a tɔɔ ʋ luoruŋ lɛ, ʋ luobiee lɩɩ tel tinteeŋ. Jʋab tɔbʋ bala dʋndʋŋ nɛ, ka Amasa sʋʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka Jʋab arɩ ʋ naambie Abɩsaɩ kiri Sɛba libe a mʋ.

english_verse: One of Joab's soldiers stood by Amasa and shouted, “If any of you are for Joab and David, then follow Joab!”
translation_verse: Jʋab laalɩyuoroo dɔŋɔ kʋ chɩŋ Amasa sɛmɛ aŋ bʋl, “Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho Jʋab, a ŋaa Devit nʋʋ, ʋ kʋ to Jʋab harɩŋ.”

english_verse: Amasa was still rolling in his own blood in the middle of the road. The soldier who had shouted noticed that everyone who passed by would stop, so he dragged Amasa off the road and covered him with a blanket.
translation_verse: Dɩ Amasa fa pɩŋ ʋ chalɩŋ tʋɔŋ wombiiŋ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, laalɩyuoro-la kʋŋkala yie kʋ naʋ, a chɩŋ. Baal-la sɩ na dɩ nʋʋkala yie kʋ na Amasa a chɩŋ, ʋ lɛrʋ kaa mʋ ta gɩrɩŋ tʋɔŋ, a joŋ gɛrɩŋ tɔʋ.

english_verse: After this, no one else stopped. They all walked straight past him on their way to help Joab capture Sheba. Sheba Hides Out in the Town of Abel
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɛŋ Amasa joŋ wombiiŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, laalɩyuoro-la kala to Jʋab harɩŋ ba kiri Bikiri nanʋala Sɛba libe dɩ ba kɛnʋ.

english_verse: Sheba had gone through all of the tribes of Israel when he came to the town of Abel Beth-Maacah. All of his best soldiers met him there and followed him into the town.
translation_verse: Sɛba to Iziral doho doho-la kala tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Abɛl Bɛf Maaka. Bɛrɩ tɩŋŋaa kala sii kʋ chemu ba jʋʋ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Joab and his troops came and surrounded Abel, so that no one could go in or come out. They made a dirt ramp up to the town wall and then started to use a battering ram to knock the wall down. A Wise Woman Saves the Town
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋab arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoro-la kala kʋ golli Abɛl Bɛf Maaka chu a tɔ Sɛba hɛ. Ba kɛŋ tɩɛrɩŋ saa vaŋkumba a yelli kɛrɛ-la dɩ ba to ba lɛ jʋʋ taŋ-la, aŋ suomo ŋmuŋmoo kɛrɛ-la dɩ ba lo.

english_verse: A wise woman shouted from the top of the wall, “Listen to me! Listen to me! I have to talk to Joab! Tell him to come here!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩ ha-wʋjɩnnʋ kʋbala hɛ taŋ-la lɛ. Ʋ jɩl kɛrɛ-la a ŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Má bʋla pɩ Jʋab dɩ ʋ kɔ daha dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ pʋ.”

english_verse: When he came, the woman said, “Are you Joab?” “Yes, I am,” he answered. She said, “Please, listen to what I have to say.” “All right,” he said. “I'll listen.”
translation_verse: Jʋab mʋ, haal-la pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ nɛ ŋaa Jʋab?” Ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ nɛ.” Haal-la bɩra bʋl, “Jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna sɩ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl.” Jʋab bʋl, “Mɩɩ jegili nɛ.”

english_verse: She said, “Long ago people used to say, ‘If you want good advice, go to the town of Abel to get it.’ The answers they got here were all that was needed to settle any problem.
translation_verse: Haal-la bʋl, “Faafaa-la ba yie bʋl, ‘Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ pɩɛsa jɩŋ wɩɩ sɩaa, mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Abɛl, ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ.’ Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ dagɛba lee-la nɛ yie leŋ ba jɩŋ ba wɩɩkala sɩaa.

english_verse: We are Israelites, and we want peace! You can trust us. Why are you trying to destroy a town that's like a mother in Israel? Why do you want to wipe out the Lord's people?”
translation_verse: La ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ yuosuŋ ka chɛ nɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Maa chɛ dɩ ma chei taŋ-la sɩ nagɛ Iziral tinteeŋ tasɩŋ kala naaŋ nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ kpʋ La TƖƖNA nɩaa kala?”

english_verse: Joab answered, “No, no! I'm not trying to wipe you out or destroy your town!
translation_verse: Jʋab bʋl, “Aɩ, ŋɩɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa, mɩ bɩ jaŋ kpʋma koo a chei ma jaŋ!

english_verse: That's not it at all. There's a man in your town from the hill country of Ephraim. His name is Sheba, and he is the leader of a rebellion against King David. Turn him over to me, and we will leave your town alone.” The woman told Joab, “We will throw his head over the wall.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ dee la bɩɩnɛ. Bikiri nanʋal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛba, a lɩɩ Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga nɛ sie a yuyuo kuoro Devit. Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ baal-la pɩmɛ, la bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩkala ma jaŋ lɛ.” Haal-la bʋla pɩ Jʋab, “La jaŋ keri ʋ nyuŋ a yuo ta ʋ to kɛrɛ kʋ lɩɩ a pɩŋ.”

english_verse: She went to the people of the town and talked them into doing it. They cut off Sheba's head and threw it to Joab. Joab blew a signal on his trumpet, and the soldiers returned to their homes. Joab went back to David in Jerusalem. Another List of David's Officials
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la kɛŋ ʋ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la mʋ dagɛ ʋ jaŋ nɩaa. Ba sɛɩ a keri Bikiri nanʋala Sɛba nyuŋ a yuo ta ʋ to kɛrɛ kʋ lɩɩ a pɩ Jʋab. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋab ŋmʋʋ banyile a giri laalɩyuoro-la kala taŋ-la lɛ, ba kʋŋkala mɩɩra mʋ ʋ dɩa. Jʋab ma mɩɩra mʋ kuoro Devit teeŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: Joab was the commander of Israel's entire army. Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was in command of David's bodyguard.
translation_verse: Jʋab nɛ fa ŋaa Iziral laalɩyuoroo kala nɩhɩaŋ. Jehoyada nanʋala Benaaya ma nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Devit nɩhɩaŋ.

english_verse: Adoram was in charge of the slave-labor force. Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud kept government records.
translation_verse: Adoniram ma nɛ faa beŋ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ fʋga hɛ ba tɩtɩŋ. Ahilud nanʋala Jehosafat ma nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba wɩaa bibil.

english_verse: Sheva was the secretary. Zadok and Abiathar were the priests.
translation_verse: Sɛva nɛ fa ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba tenniŋ. Zadɔk arɩ Abɩata ma nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa.

english_verse: He said, “What can I do to make up for what Saul did, so that you'll ask the Lord to be kind to his people again?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Devit yɩrɛ Gibioŋ tɩmma-la a pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ ma chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa pɩma? Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa a wasɛ wɩɩ-la ka dɩ ma sʋl La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ bɩra pɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ?”

english_verse: They replied, “Saul tried to kill all our people so that none of us would be left in the land of Israel.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra bʋla pɩ Devit, “Sɔɔl nɛ faa chɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋ la nɩaa kala, dɩ la sɩ́ lee-kala kɛŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Give us seven of his descendants. We will hang these men near the place where the Lord is worshiped in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, the Lord's chosen king.” “I'll give them to you,” David said.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba kɛsɛ Sɔɔl doho nɩaa baalaa balɩpɛ pɩla dɩ la kpʋ, a kɛmba lɩɩ bil dɩ-jalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, Sɔɔl, nɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ ŋaa kuoro, ʋ jaŋ Gɩbɩa lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ kɛsɛba pɩma.”

english_verse: David had made a promise to Jonathan with the Lord as his witness, so he spared Jonathan's son Mephibosheth, the grandson of Saul.
translation_verse: Kuoro Devit fa leŋ Sɔɔl nanʋala Jonataŋ bie Mɛfɩbɔsɛf-na nɛ, a tɩŋ nii-la ʋ dɩ Sɔɔl nanʋala Jonataŋ fa sɩ hɛ pɩ dɔŋɔ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: turned them over to the Gibeonites, who hanged all seven of them on the mountain near the place where the Lord was worshiped. This happened right at the beginning of the barley harvest. Rizpah Takes Care of the Bodies
translation_verse: Devit jomba a pɩ Gibioŋ tɩmma-la, ba kpʋba a joŋo sagɛ dundolo nyuŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ Gɩbɩa lɛ. Ba kala balɩpɛ nɛ ba kpʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ. Ba kpʋba tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ suomo kʋkʋŋ ba mɩɩ-bumbumba nɛ.

english_verse: Rizpah spread out some sackcloth on a nearby rock. She wouldn't let the birds land on the bodies during the day, and she kept the wild animals away at night. She stayed there from the beginning of the harvest until it started to rain. The Burial of Saul and His Descendants
translation_verse: Aya tolo Rɩzɩpa, Sɔɔl hɩɩla dɔŋɔ sii joŋ bɔtɔ-kɔsʋmɔɔ a lɩɩ mʋ jɛrɛ bʋŋ nyuŋ a pɩna pɔ sʋʋnʋ-la, a chɩŋ baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ bʋa lɛ a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ duonuŋ sɩ nɩɩ hɛ ba lɛ. Ʋ bɩ leŋe diibie kala digiba wɩɩhɛyɛ, koo gɩrɩŋ kʋŋ digiba tɩtaŋɩŋ.

english_verse: David had their bones taken to the land of Benjamin and buried in a side room in Saul's family burial place. Then he gave orders for the bones of the men who had been hanged to be buried there. It was done, and God answered prayers to bless the land. The Descendants of the Rephaim (
translation_verse: Ba joŋ Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ nanʋala Jonataŋ haŋgbelee hugi Sɔɔl nyɩmma Kɩs bʋa lɛ, taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zɛla lɛ, Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ, aŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala kuoro sɩ sɩ ba ŋaa. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ, Wɩa laa ba sʋla a pɛ ba tinteeŋ lɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa yuo laalɩŋ

english_verse: There was another war, this time in Gath. One of the enemy soldiers was a descendant of the Rephaim. He was as big as a giant and had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot.
translation_verse: Laalɩŋ dɔŋɔ fa bɩra sii Gaf lɛ. Baal kʋbala fa hɛ nɩmɛ a waayi woruŋ a kɛŋ neniee fii arɩ balɩa, naaniee ma fii arɩ balɩa. Ba kala ŋaa mara arɩ banɛsɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa Rafa doho nʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: One time David got very tired when he and his soldiers were fighting the Philistines.
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ, laalɩŋ bɩra sii Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ. Devit sii kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo mʋ dɩ ba yuo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ lɔlʋŋ jʋʋ-ʋ woruŋ.

english_verse: One of the Philistine warriors was Ishbibenob, who was a descendant of the Rephaim, and he tried to kill David. Ishbibenob was armed with a new sword, and his bronze spearhead alone weighed about three and a half kilograms.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la fa kɛŋ laa-yuori-babiibal nɛ, baa yɩrɛ Ɩsɩbɩ-Bɛnɔb. Ʋ fa ŋaa Rafa doho nɩwaayiile-la dɔŋɔ nɛ. Ba kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ libi ʋ timiŋ, ʋ nyuŋ yuŋuŋ ŋaa kilo batori arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ fa kori tokobii-falɩŋ ma nɛ. Ʋ bʋl arɩ ʋ jaŋ kpʋ Devit.

english_verse: But Abishai came to the rescue and killed the Philistine. David's soldiers told him, “We can't let you risk your life in battle anymore! You give light to our nation, and we want that flame to keep burning.”
translation_verse: Ama Zeruya nanʋala Abɩsaɩ kʋ kpʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩɩna-la, a laa Devit ta. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit laalɩyuoroo ŋmɩɛsa pʋ a bʋl, “La bɩra bɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ to la harɩŋ a mʋ laalɩŋ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ, la bɩ jaŋ cho dɩ ba kpʋŋ.”

english_verse: There was another battle with the Philistines at Gob, where Sibbecai from Hushah killed a descendant of the Rephaim named Saph.
translation_verse: Bʋa dɔŋɔ ma lɛ nɛ laalɩŋ fa bɩra sii ba dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ Gob lɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ Sɩbɛkaɩ sɩ ŋaa Husa tɩɩna kpʋ Rafa doho nɩaa dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Saf.

english_verse: There was still another battle with the Philistines at Gob. A soldier named Elhanan killed Goliath from Gath, whose spear shaft was like a weaver's beam. Elhanan's father was Jari from Bethlehem.
translation_verse: Laalɩŋ dɔŋɔ bɩra sii Gob-la lɛ ba dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ, Ɛlɩhanaŋ, Jaarɛ Ɔrɛgɩm, sɩ ŋaa Bɛtɩlɛhɛm tɩɩna bie, kpʋ Gɩtɩ tɩɩna kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Golɩaf. Ʋ timiŋ daaŋ fa chaasa barɩmɛ nɛ a nagɛ gɛrɩpɛ-yuori daaŋ.

english_verse: But when he made fun of Israel, David's nephew Jonathan killed him. Jonathan was the son of David's brother Shimei.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ joŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ʋ hɛ sɩɩŋ lɛ, Devit naambie Sɩmɩa nanʋala Jonataŋ nɛ kpʋʋ.

english_verse: David and his soldiers killed these four men who were descendants of the Rephaim from Gath.
translation_verse: Baalaa deemba banɛsɛ fa ŋaa Rafa doho nɩaa nɛ a hɔŋ Gaf lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jʋʋ Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ ba kpʋba.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ laamɛ ta mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ chaasa kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩmɛ.

english_verse: David sang a song to the Lord after the Lord had rescued him from his enemies, especially Saul. These are the words to David's song:
translation_verse: Yɩɩlɩŋ deeŋ nɛ Devit yɩɩ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ laaʋ ta ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ Sɔɔl nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ TƖƖNA, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ tinteyee nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “La TƖƖNA, ŋ nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ, ŋ nɛ mɩ dɩ-duoŋ, ŋ nɛ laamɛ tɩta.

english_verse: You are the rock where I am safe. You are my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter. You rescue me and keep me safe from violence.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, ŋ nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ, ŋ nɛ mɩ yuori. Ŋ nɛ chu tɔmɛ, ŋ nɛ laamɛ tɩta. Ŋ nɛ mɩ dɩ-duoŋ, Ŋ nɛ mɩ yie yuori ŋ laamɛ ta. Ŋ nɛ laamɛ ta nɩduoruŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I praise you, our Lord! I prayed to you, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ dɛnnɩŋ La Tɩɩna, mɩ sʋla yɩrɩŋ nɛ, ŋ laamɛ ta mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Death, like ocean waves, surrounded me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Sʋʋŋ fa nagɛ lɩɩ-pel-duoŋ nɛ a tɔ mɩ hɛ a chɩchɛ ʋ jommi liŋ.

english_verse: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
translation_verse: Sʋʋŋ ŋmɛsɩŋ vɔɔmɛ nɛ a golli, aŋ ka ʋ bɛrɩsɩŋ ma gbɛrɛmɛ.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Wɩaa fa chaasa jʋʋmɛ nɛ, mɩ yɩrɛ ŋ-na mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa. Ŋ hɛ ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ nɛ aŋ nɩɩ mɩ yikoro. Mɩ nii-ŋmobo-la kala jʋʋ ŋ dɩgɩlaa nɛ.

english_verse: Earth shook and shivered! The columns supporting the sky rocked back and forth. You were angry
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ na baanɩŋ, tinteeŋ zigile nɛ, wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa ma kala jigisi a kɛŋ ba gentisiŋ pɛ.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Ka nyʋɔsʋŋ lɩlɩɩ ŋ-na La TƖƖNA mɩɩ-boyee lɛ, nyiŋgeliŋ arɩ nyiŋ-hal-muloo ma lɩlɩɩ ŋ niiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛŋ wɩa-nyuŋ bɛgɛ ta nɛ aŋ kʋ tuu, ka duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-bisiŋ hɛ ŋ naasɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures. You appeared with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Ŋ sagɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa nyuŋ nɛ a file to peliŋ lɛ a kʋ tuu.

english_verse: Darkness was your tent! Thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe birimiŋ nagɛ lɛbɩŋ nɛ a golluŋ, ka duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-bine ma tɔŋ.

english_verse: Fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Pʋlʋmʋŋ chaanɛ ŋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ, a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ lɩgɩsa leriŋ pʋllɛ.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala, ŋ sɩ kpɩa goŋ wɩa-nyuŋ, leriŋ kala chɩɩma nɛ.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ sɩ kpɩa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ, ʋ lɩɩŋ kala hʋa nɛ a nyɩɩsɛ tinteeŋ lɛ, ŋ sɩ wiese ma, tinteeŋ zigile nɛ.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Ŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ kʋ tuu, a liirimi lɩɩŋ sɩ luŋie tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ sɩ jʋʋmɛ, ba sii kɔ dɩ ba yuomi, ŋ-na La TƖƖNA sii chɩŋ nɛ a pɔmɛ.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ tɔmɛ hɛ, ŋ nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ ta pʋlʋŋ-jaala lɛ, ŋ chomi nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ laamɛ ta.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA ŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ lɛ a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wɩaa nɛ. Mɩ sɩ bɩ disiŋ kala kɛnɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ siilimi.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ to La TƖƖNA wombiee nɛ, mɩ ha bɩ Wɩa harɩŋ lɩa a ŋaa wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never turn away from your teachings.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ to wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile nɛ, mɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga dɩ la tuto kʋŋkala vɩa.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA siilimi, mɩ sɩ bɩ disiŋ kɛnɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: With all who are sincere you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, ŋ yie pʋllɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ pɩba nɛ, ama nɩalɩŋ wɩaa sɩ golibo, ŋ yie hosi ba nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you look for ways to put down the proud.
translation_verse: Ŋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri a ta nɛ, aŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ muuri.

english_verse: Our Lord and God, you are my lamp. You turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Mɩ TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa mɩ chaanɩŋ, ŋ leŋe biriŋ-la tʋɔŋ mɩ sɩ hɛ bɩrɩmɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, ŋ wombiiŋ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ, ʋ wɩaa ma tʋʋlɛ. Ŋ nagɛ hɔɔtaala-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ a chu tɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋ yuoruŋ.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Wɩa dɔŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a pɛ LA TƖƖNA Wɩa lɛɛ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ la Wɩa dee?

english_verse: You are my strong fortress, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ pɩmɛ doluŋ, a leŋ mɩ wombiiŋ chaasa zɔŋ.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ leŋe mɩ naachɛɛŋ lɩŋ a nagɛ aamɩŋ. Ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ mɩ wuo jɩla chɩŋ peelee nyuŋ.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ gʋnnɛmɛ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ wuo yuo toŋ-la ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: You alone are my shield, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: Ŋ chu tɔmɛ nɛ a laamɛ ta. Ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ a leŋ mɩ ŋaa nɩbal.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ pori mɩ wombiiŋ ʋ jal, dɩ mɩ sɩ́ mɩ naaŋ joŋo ŋmoo.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Mɩ kire to mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ nɛ a kpʋba, mɩ bɩ harɩŋ mɩɩra aŋ cheiba.

english_verse: I destroyed them! I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmooba lo mɩ naasɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, ba bɩ wuo sii. Mɩ yuo diiba.

english_verse: You helped me win victories and forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Ŋ pɩmɛ doluŋ nɛ mɩ kaa yuo laalɩŋ, a yuo dii mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe mɩ dʋndɔmɔ-la mɩɩra fɩfá nɛ, ka mɩ kire kpʋba.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ba ŋmoo niiŋ a chɩchɛ nʋʋ nɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ, ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ laaba ta. Ba yɩrɛ ŋ-na La TƖƖNA ma, ŋ fʋʋla yagɛba.

english_verse: I ground them to dust, and I squashed them like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmooba nɛ ba bɩɩ a nagɛ hagɩlɩ-nʋkʋŋ. Mɩ tigisiba, a fɩrɩgɛba a nagɛ vʋchɔɔŋ sɩ hɛ womporuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You rescued me from my stubborn people and made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ laamɛ ta nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yuomi nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a leŋ mɩ ŋaa tintee-wogusuŋ sɩpaalaara. Lɛɛlɛ ba ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ.

english_verse: They have lost all courage and from their fortresses they come trembling.
translation_verse: Ba nandaasɩŋ kala nɛ yʋɔra, ba lɩɩ ba dɩ-duoruŋ lɛ a chele kʋkɔ.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you! You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na La TƖƖNA weye nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ, ŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ heele bʋl Wɩa sɩ laamɛ ta yɩrɩ-balɩŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ Wɩa a laa mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo pɩmɛ, a joŋ tinteyee nɩaa pɩmɛ mɩ bibeŋ.

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies, and you made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ laamɛ ta mɩ dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ cho yuosuŋ woruŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a leŋ mɩ ŋaa nɩbal a kɩɩ ba kala.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ leŋe mɩ-na ŋ kuoro Devit yuo dii. Ŋ dagɛ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na, nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa arɩ mɩ doho nɩaa a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: Our Mighty Rock, the God of Jacob, told me, “A ruler who obeys God and does right
translation_verse: Iziral Wɩa, nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ bʋŋ bʋla pɩmɛ: ‘Dɩ kuoro nɛ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a bibeŋ ʋ nɩaa nyuŋ, a to Wɩa niiŋ lɛ a bibemba,

english_verse: is like the sunrise on a cloudless day, or like rain that sparkles on the grass.”
translation_verse: kuoru-la nagɛ taŋ sɩ pʋla leriŋ pʋllɛ nɛ, duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ kala tuo, a bɩra nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ nɩa yaŋ nyʋ.’

english_verse: I have ruled this way, and God will never break his promise to me. God's promise is complete and unchanging; he will always help me and give me what I hope for.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ pɛ mɩ doho nɩaa lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa, ʋ nɛ hɛ nii-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ a pɩmɛ, nii-la sɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ birige. Nii-la suo nɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ kɛnʋ bɩrɩmɛ. Wɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ jɩma bʋa na-kala ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a pɩmɛ.

english_verse: But evil people are pulled up like thornbushes. They are not dug up by hand,
translation_verse: Ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nagɛ sɔsʋŋ nɛ, ba jaŋ churiba ta. Nɩsɩŋ dee ba jaŋ kaa churiba.

english_verse: but with a sharp spear and are burned on the spot. The Three Warriors (
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ chɛ ʋ digi sɔsʋ-la, see ʋ kɛŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kʋŋ sɩ ŋaa hɔɔŋ koo timiŋ, ba jaŋ nyɩgɛ ba kala nɩmɛ tɩtɩa ba sɩ pɩna.” Devit laalɩyuori babiibalaa

english_verse: except Eleazar. He killed Philistines until his hand was cramped, and he couldn't let go of his sword. When Eleazar finished, all the Israelite troops had to do was come back and take the enemies' weapons and armor. The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
translation_verse: ka Elieza-na chɩŋ, a kpʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa ŋɩɩ halɩɩ, tokobii-la ʋ sɩ koro paala nyʋa mɛrɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral laalɩyuoroo mɩɩra kɔ Elieza leriŋ, a wuri Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la sɩ sʋba kɩaa. Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA leŋe ba yuo diiba nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: and certainly just as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was the commander of the Thirty Warriors, but he still did not become one of the Three Warriors.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ laa yɩrɩŋ kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ batori-la. Ʋ fa bɩ ba tʋɔŋ pɛ, aŋ mɩɩra kʋ ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.

english_verse: These are the names of David's warriors: Ishbosheth the son of Hachmon was the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle, he killed
translation_verse: Devit laalɩyuori babiibalaa yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la: Jɔsɛb-Basɛbɛf, ʋ ŋaa Takɛmɔŋ tɩɩna nɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ batori sɩɩ yɩrɛ ba tɩtɩa laalɩyuori-babiibal kpaŋkpamba sɩpaalaara nɛ. Ʋ fa kɛŋ timiŋ a kpʋ nɩaa zɔlɔ chori nɛ laal-bala lɛ.

english_verse: The next one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite. One time when the Philistines were at war with Israel, he and David dared the Philistines to fight them. Every one of the Israelite soldiers turned and ran,
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ, Dodai nanʋala Elieza, a ŋaa Aho tɩɩna. Bʋa kʋbala lɛ ʋ dɩ Devit nɛ mʋ magɩsɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa ba sɩ kʋ hilimi lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Pas Damɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral laalɩyuoroo mɩɩra fá,

english_verse: but Shammah stood in the middle of the field and killed the Philistines. The crops were saved, and the Lord gave Israel a great victory.
translation_verse: ka Sama chɩŋ baga-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ a pɔ kpʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la. Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA leŋe ʋ yuo diiba nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: One year at harvest time, the Three Warriors went to meet David at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley
translation_verse: Baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ bʋa lɛ, laalɩyuori-babiibala-la mara arɩ fii tʋɔŋ nɩaa batori sii mʋ Devit teeŋ, dɩ ʋ faa bʋbʋa-la sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Adulam lɛ. Dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa laalɩyuoroo ma ŋmoo ba buguŋ Refem fuonaaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and had taken over Bethlehem. David was in his fortress,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Devit faa bʋbʋa-la lɛ, ka Fɩlɩsɩtɩa laalɩyuoroo ma fa hɛ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm lɛ.

english_verse: and he was very thirsty. He said, “I wish I had a drink from the well by the gate at Bethlehem.”
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-nyʋasʋŋ kɛŋ Devit, ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ fa jaŋ cho dɩ nʋʋ mʋ ŋaa lɩɩŋ vil-la sɩ kpagɛ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm boi-baalɩŋ a kaa kʋ pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ nyʋa.”

english_verse: The Three Warriors sneaked into the Philistine camp and got some water from the well near Bethlehem's gate. But after they brought the water back to David, he refused to drink it. Instead, he poured it out as a sacrifice
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuori babiibala-la batori wuo nyɩgɩsa to Fɩlɩsɩtɩa laalɩyuoro-la tʋɔŋ, a mʋ ŋaa lɩɩŋ vil-la sɩ kpagɛ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm boi-baalɩŋ lɛ a kaa kʋ pɩ Devit. Ama ʋ vɩa lɩɩ-la aŋ joŋo bɩsa ta La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ,

english_verse: and said to the Lord, “I can't drink this water! It's like the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.” The Three Warriors did these brave deeds. The Thirty Warriors (
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pɩ La TƖƖNA, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo nyʋa lɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ nagɛ nɩalɩŋ batori sɩ joŋ ba mɩɩsɩŋ yɔɔ sʋʋŋ a ŋaaʋ kʋ pɩmɛ chalɩŋ nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩ lɩɩ-la nyʋa. Bɔɩ-duo wɩalɩŋ laalɩyuori babiibal-kpaŋkpamba-la batori fa sɩ ŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. He killed two of Moab's best fighters, and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion.
translation_verse: Jehoyada nanʋala Bɛnaaya ma fa ŋaa laalɩyuori-duo nɛ, a lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kabɩzɛɛl. Ʋ fa tɩŋ bɔɩ-duo tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ fa kpʋ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori-duoruŋ balɩa nɛ. Bʋa kʋbala lɛ bʋrʋŋ tɔ, ka ʋ tuu buo-tuoŋ tʋɔŋ a kpʋ naachigiŋ.

english_verse: Another time, he killed an Egyptian, as big as a giant. The Egyptian was armed with a spear, but Benaiah only had a club. Benaiah grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ bɩra kpʋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori-duo kʋbala sɩ waayi. Ijipiti tɩɩna-la fa kori timiŋ nɛ, ka Bɛnaaya mʋ ʋ lɛ arɩ toŋguluŋ, a kɛŋ baal-la timiŋ laa a gʋra kpʋʋ.

english_verse: Benaiah did these things. He never became one of the Three Warriors, but he was just as famous as they were and certainly just as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. David made him the leader of his bodyguard.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa laa yɩrɩŋ a kɩɩ laalɩyuori babiibala-la mara arɩ fii, ama ʋ fa bɩ nɩalɩŋ batori lɛ pɛ. Ka Devit joŋu ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔʋ tʋɔŋ nɩhɩaŋ.

english_verse: and said, “Your Majesty! Why have you come to see me?” David answered, “I've come to buy your threshing place. I have to build the Lord an altar here, so this disease will stop killing the people.”
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ kuoro mɩ nɩhɩaŋ kɔ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna teeŋ?” Devit bʋl, “Mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ yɔɔ ŋ taha-la nɛ, a saa koruŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA, dɩ nyanyal-bɔmɔ-la sɩ jʋʋ nɩalɩŋ ba sʋsʋʋ dɩ ʋ dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: They went to Gilead and to Kadesh in Syria. Then they went to Dan, Ijon, and on toward Sidon.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra joŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ Gɩlɩad arɩ Tatɩm Hosi tinteeŋ, a mʋ Daŋ Jaaŋ a joŋ ŋɩɩ gollo to Sɩdɔŋ.

english_verse: So David told Joab and the army officers, “Go to every tribe in Israel, from the town of Dan in the north all the way south to Beersheba, and count everyone who can serve in the army. I want to know how many there are.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro bʋla pɩ Jʋab arɩ ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ ʋ teeŋ, “Má mʋ Iziral doho doho-la kala tʋɔŋ a chɩŋ Daŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ Bɛɛsɩba sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a dɩɩsɛ laalɩyuoroo kala dɩ mɩ wuo jɩŋ ba niiŋ.”

english_verse: But when David refused to change his mind, Joab and the army officers went out and started counting the people.
translation_verse: Ama kuoro fa sɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la nɛ chɩna a kɩɩ wɩɩ-la Jʋab arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩ bʋla. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sii kuoro sɩpaaŋ a mʋ dɩ ba dɩɩsɛ laalɩyuoro-la kala sɩ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They crossed the Jordan River and began with Aroer and the town in the middle of the river valley. From there they went toward Gad and on as far as Jazer.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, ba ŋmoo buguŋ a kpagɛ Arʋa, taŋ-la sɩ hɛ fuonaa luŋii-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a mʋ to Gad a joŋo mʋ Jaza.

english_verse: After they had gone through the whole land, they went back to Jerusalem. It had taken them
translation_verse: Ba joŋ chɛnsɩŋ nibi arɩ tapʋlaa mara nɛ a gɔllɛ tintee-la kala dɛrɛ, aŋ mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Araunah looked and saw David and his soldiers coming up toward him. He went over to David, bowed down low,
translation_verse: Araʋna sɩ na kuoro arɩ ʋ nɩaa dɩ ba chaasʋ a kʋkɔ, ʋ lɩɩ mʋ chemba, a tuu kpirimi kuoro sɩpaaŋ a kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa chu tinteeŋ.

english_verse: David saw the angel killing everyone and told the Lord, “These people are like sheep with me as their shepherd. I have sinned terribly, but they have done nothing wrong. Please, punish me and my family instead of them!” David Buys Araunah's Threshing Place (
translation_verse: Devit sɩ na Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ, ʋ bʋla pɩ La TƖƖNA, “Mɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la a chei wɩaa. Nɩaa deemba nagɛ piesee nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ ba ŋaa? Mɩɩra dɔgɩsɛ mɩ dɩ mɩ dɩa nɩaa nɛ.” Devit saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ

english_verse: After everyone had been counted, David realized he had done wrong. He told the Lord, “What I did was stupid and terribly wrong. Lord, please forgive me.”
translation_verse: Devit sɩ dɩɩsɛ laalɩyuoro-la kala dɛrɛ, ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa walɩmʋ. Ʋ bʋla pɩ La TƖƖNA, “Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa, ʋ chaasa wʋbɔŋ nɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ La TƖƖNA, joŋo chɛmɛ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ cheerii-la mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna lɛ. Nɩyaarɩ wɩɩ nɛ mɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: Before David even got up the next morning, the Lord had told David's prophet Gad
translation_verse: Ka dɩ taŋ-na pʋl, Devit sii chʋchʋɔŋ, dɩ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ Gad sɩ ŋaa ʋ wʋlaabʋllʋ. Gad nɛ fa ŋaa Devit sɩɩ-naara.

english_verse: to take a message to David. Gad went to David and told him: You must choose one of three ways for the Lord to punish you: Will there be seven years when the land won't grow enough food for your people? Or will your enemies chase you and make you run from them for three months? Or will there be three days of horrible disease in your land? Think about it and decide, because I have to give your answer to God, who sent me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Gad mʋ Devit teeŋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla, aŋ pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋŋ chɛ dɩ losuŋ jʋʋ ŋ tinteeŋ jɩsɩŋ batori nɛ koo ŋŋ chɛ dɩ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kiriŋ baarɛ chɛnsɩŋ batori nɛ koo ŋŋ chɛ dɩ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ jʋʋ ŋ tinteeŋ tapʋlaa batori nɛ? Bɩɩnɛ a joŋ ba tʋɔŋ kʋ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ, dɩ mɩ mʋ bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ.”

english_verse: David was really frightened and said, “It's a terrible choice to make! But the Lord is kind, and I'd rather be punished by him than by anyone else.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ Gad, “Mɩ tʋɔŋ chaasa chei nɛ. Leŋ dɩ la jʋʋ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋʋ fá nɩaa nenige nɛ woruŋ, ama sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la jʋʋ nuhuobiine nɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: Araunah said, “Take whatever you want and offer your sacrifice. Here are some oxen for the sacrifice. You can use the threshing-boards and the wooden yokes for the fire.
translation_verse: Araʋna bʋla pɩ Devit, “Kuoro mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo joŋ kʋŋ na-kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ a kaa sʋl Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la. Na nɛ-ferisiŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo kaa sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Na mɩɩ-ŋmoori daasɩŋ arɩ daasɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo hɩhɛ nɛsɩŋ baŋŋaa nɛ ŋ-la, ŋ jaŋ wuo kaa hɛ nyiniŋ.

english_verse: That same day the prophet Gad came and told David, “Go to the threshing place that belongs to Araunah and build an altar there for the Lord.” So David went.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit mʋ, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ to Gad lɛ a bʋl ŋɩɩ pʋ.

english_verse: Take them—they're yours! I hope the Lord your God will be pleased with you.”
translation_verse: Kɩaa deemba kala nɛ mɩ-na Araʋna joŋo pɩ ŋ-na kuoro.” Ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩ kuoro, “A leŋ dɩ ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa laa ŋ sʋla.”

english_verse: But David answered, “No! I have to pay you what they're worth. I can't offer the Lord my God a sacrifice that cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing place and the oxen for
translation_verse: Kuoro ma bɩra bʋl, “Aɩ, mɩ cho dɩ mɩ timiŋ nɛ. Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ kʋŋkala kpʋ a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩ mɩ bɩ chɩmɩŋ ŋmobo kʋ-la lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit yɔɔ taha-la arɩ nɛ-ferisi-la a tiŋ warɩpʋla mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii.

english_verse: Then he built an altar for the Lord. He offered sacrifices to please the Lord and to ask for his blessings. The Lord answered the prayers of the people, and no one else died from the terrible disease.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ nɩmɛ a pɩ La TƖƖNA, a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. La TƖƖNA laa ʋ sʋla, nyanyalɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: King David was now an old man, and he always felt cold, even under a lot of blankets.
translation_verse: Kuoro Devit fa sɩ faasa kʋ hɩɛsɛ, dɩ ba nɛ paala joŋ gɛrɩ-bɔsʋnʋŋ tɔʋ ma, waarɩŋ ha yie kɛnʋ nɛ.

english_verse: His officials said, “Your Majesty, we will look for a young woman to take care of you. She can lie down beside you and keep you warm.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa fa bʋla pʋ, “Kuoro, leŋ dɩ la chɛ hatolo ha sɩ bɩ baal jɩŋ a kaa kɔ dɩ ʋ hɛ ŋ teeŋ a bibeniŋ. Ʋ jaŋ pɩŋ ŋ sɛmɛ a tɔ lɩmɩŋ hɩhɛ ŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Adonijah was the son of David and Haggith. He was Absalom's younger brother and was very handsome. One day, Adonijah started bragging, “I'm going to make myself king!” So he got some chariots and horses, and he hired
translation_verse: Ama Adonija nyɩmma Devit ha maachie bɩ ʋ wɩɩ pɩɛsa a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ wʋŋaalaa lɛ. Adonija fa zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ, ʋ malɩma nɛ Abɩsalɔm.

english_verse: Adonijah himself was afraid of what Solomon might do to him, so he ran to the sacred tent and grabbed hold of the corners of the altar for protection.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ fa sɩ kɛŋ Adonija ma tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ Solomoŋ wɩaa, ʋ sii jʋʋ La TƖƖNA lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ gʋnaa lɛ.

english_verse: Adonijah met with Joab the son of Zeruiah and Abiathar the priest and asked them if they would help him become king. Both of them agreed to help.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Adonija sii mʋ na Zeruya nanʋala Jʋab arɩ Abɩata sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, ba chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and David's bodyguards all refused.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Zadɔk arɩ Jehoyada nanʋala Benaaya, Netaŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla, a saa pɛ Sɩmɛɩ arɩ Rɛɩ arɩ laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro Devit, ba-na bɩ Adonija harɩŋ chɩna.

english_verse: Adonijah invited his brothers and David's officials from Judah to go with him to Crawling Rock near Rogel Spring, where he sacrificed some sheep, cattle, and fat calves.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Adonija kpʋ piesee, nɛ-belliŋ, nɛ-pɔrɔɔ sɩ nɛrɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ Dɩmɩŋ tabɩɩ-la lɛ, a kpagɛ Ɛŋ-Rɔgɛl. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ naambiiriŋ kala sɩ ŋaa kuoro biiriŋ, a pɛ Juda baala-la kala sɩ ŋaa kuoro tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ.

english_verse: But he did not invite Nathan, Benaiah, David's bodyguards, or his own brother Solomon.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ bɩ Netaŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ yɩra, a pɛ Benaaya arɩ laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro arɩ ʋ naambie Solomoŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When Nathan heard what had happened, he asked Bathsheba, Solomon's mother: Have you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith has made himself king? But David doesn't know a thing about it.
translation_verse: Netaŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ʋ pɩɛsɛ Solomoŋ naaŋ Bafɩsɛba, “Ŋ bɩ nɩa arɩ Hagɩf nanʋala Adonija bil ʋ tɩtɩa kuoruŋ nɛ ka la nɩhɩaŋ Devit jɩma tuo?

english_verse: You and your son Solomon will be killed, unless you do what I tell you.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, leŋ dɩ mɩ dagɩŋ wɩɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ to a laa ŋ dɩ ŋ nanʋala Solomoŋ kala mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Go say to David, “You promised me that Solomon would be the next king. So why is Adonijah now king?”
translation_verse: Mʋ kuoro Devit teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, ‘Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, ŋ dee bɩ ŋmɩɛsa pɩmɛ arɩ mɩ nanʋala Solomoŋ nɛ jaŋ laa ŋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ? Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ Adonija mɩɩra dii kuoruŋ?’

english_verse: While you are still talking to David, I'll come in and tell him that everything you said is true.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ jaŋ hɛ kuoro teeŋ a bʋbʋl wɩɩ-la, mɩ ma jaŋ kʋ jʋʋ a bʋl wɩɩ-la tɩtɩa a pʋ.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, David was in his bedroom where Abishag was taking care of him because he was so old. Bathsheba went in
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Bafɩsɛba mʋ dɩ ʋ na kuoro ʋ dɩɩ-pɩnɩŋ lɛ. Kuoro Devit fa hɩɛsa nɛ woruŋ, Abɩsak sɩ lɩɩ Sunami nɛ faa benu.

english_verse: and bowed down. “What can I do for you?” David asked.
translation_verse: Bafɩsɛba sɩ mʋa, ʋ tuu kpirimi kuoro Devit sɩpaaŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ chɩchɛ?”

english_verse: Bathsheba answered: Your Majesty, you promised me in the name of the Lord your God that my son Solomon would be the next king.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, ŋ ŋmɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA ŋ Wɩa a pɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna nɛ arɩ ŋ nanʋala Solomoŋ nɛ jaŋ laa ŋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: But Adonijah has already been made king, and you didn't know anything about it.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ, Adonija paala dii kuoruŋ nɛ ka ŋ bɩ ŋɩɩ lɛ jɩŋ.

english_verse: He sacrificed a lot of cattle, calves, and sheep. And he invited Abiathar the priest, Joab your army commander, and all your sons to be there, except Solomon, your loyal servant.
translation_verse: Ʋ kpʋ nɛ-belliŋ yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ, piesee, nɛ-pɔrɔɔ sɩ nɛrɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, aŋ yɩrɛ ŋ-na kuoro hambolibiisiŋ kala, a pɛ Abɩata sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara lɛ, arɩ Jʋab ŋ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ. Ama ʋ bɩ ŋ nanʋala Solomoŋ-na yɩra.

english_verse: Your Majesty, everyone in Israel is waiting for you to announce who will be the next king.
translation_verse: Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩaa pɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ, dɩ ŋ dagɛba nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ laa ŋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: If you don't, they will say that Solomon and I have rebelled. They will treat us like criminals and kill us as soon as you die.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, dɩ ŋ nɛ sʋba, ba jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa mɩ-na arɩ mɩ nanʋala Solomoŋ lɛ a nagɛ la ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Someone told David that he was there, and Nathan came in. He bowed with his face to the ground
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Netaŋ kɔ daha nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Netaŋ mʋ kuoro sɩpaaŋ a tuu kpirimi,

english_verse: and said: Your Majesty, did you say that Adonijah would be king?
translation_verse: aŋ pɩɛsɛ, “Kuoro mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, ŋ nɛ bʋla arɩ Adonija jaŋ laa ŋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ?

english_verse: Earlier today, he sacrificed a lot of cattle, calves, and sheep. He invited the army commanders, Abiathar, and all your sons to be there. They are already eating and drinking and shouting, “Long live King Adonijah!”
translation_verse: Jɩnɩŋ ʋ kpʋ nɛ-belliŋ yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ, piesee arɩ nɛ-pɔrɔɔ sɩ nɛrɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ʋ yɩrɛ ŋ-na kuoro hambolibiisiŋ kala nɛ, a pɛ ŋ laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Abɩata lɛ. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ nɩaa deemba kala hɛ ʋ teeŋ a didii kɩaa aŋ pɛ nyʋnyʋa kɩaa aŋ ŋaa goŋ a bʋbʋl, ‘Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ kuoro Adonija mɩɩsɩŋ duomi.’

english_verse: But he didn't invite me or Zadok the priest or Benaiah or Solomon.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna, arɩ Zadɔk sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, arɩ Jehoyada nanʋala Benaaya arɩ ŋ nanʋala Solomoŋ nɛ ʋ bɩ yɩra.

english_verse: Did you say they could do this without telling the rest of us who would be the next king? Solomon Becomes King
translation_verse: Kuoro, ŋ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ aŋ bɩ bʋla pɩ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa dɩ ba jɩŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ laa ŋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ?” Devit leŋe Solomoŋ dii kuoruŋ

english_verse: David said, “Tell Bathsheba to come here.” She came and stood in front of him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Devit bʋl, “Má yɩrɛ Bafɩsɛba dɩ ʋ kʋ jʋʋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kʋ jʋʋ a chɩŋ kuoro sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Then he said, “The living Lord God of Israel has kept me safe. And so today, I will keep the promise I made to you in his name: Solomon will be the next king!”
translation_verse: wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ hɛ niiŋ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ a pɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaaʋ jɩnɩŋ. Ŋ nanʋala Solomoŋ nɛ jaŋ laa mɩ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ.”

english_verse: Bathsheba bowed with her face to the ground and said, “Your Majesty, I pray that you will live a long time!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Bafɩsɛba tuu kpirimi kuoro sɩpaaŋ aŋ bʋl, “A leŋ mɩ kʋhɩaŋ kuoro Devit mɩɩsɩŋ duomi.”

english_verse: Then David said, “Tell Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah to come here.” When they arrived,
translation_verse: Kuoro Devit bʋl, “Má yɩrɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Zadɔk, arɩ Netaŋ, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la arɩ Jehoyada nanʋala Benaaya dɩ ba kɔ.” Ba sɩ kɔ kuoro sɩpaaŋ,

english_verse: he told them: Take along some of my officials and let Solomon ride my own mule to Gihon Spring.
translation_verse: ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Má kɛsɛ mɩ tɩntɩnnaa dɩ ma kɛŋ mɩ nanʋala Solomoŋ a leŋ dɩ ʋ jɩl mɩ kakumo dɩ ma kɛnʋ mʋ Gɩhɔŋ lɩɩ-bulo-la leriŋ.

english_verse: When you get there, Zadok and Nathan will pour olive oil over Solomon's head to show that he is the new king of Israel. Then order someone to blow a trumpet and tell everyone to shout, “Long live King Solomon!”
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Zadɔk arɩ Netaŋ, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la jaŋ lɩɩsʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa Iziral kuoro. Má ŋmʋʋ banyile, a kpɩa goŋ bʋl, ‘A leŋ dɩ kuoro Solomoŋ mɩɩsɩŋ duomi.’

english_verse: Bring him back here, and he will take my place as king. He is the one I have chosen to rule Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ kɛnʋ mʋ, aŋ kɛnʋ mɩɩra kɔ daha dɩ ʋ hɔŋ mɩ kuoru kpasa lɛ a laa mɩ nyuŋ. Mɩ nɛ lɩɩsʋ dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ Iziral arɩ Juda tinteeŋ kala lɛ.”

english_verse: Benaiah answered, “We will do it, Your Majesty. I pray that the Lord your God will let it happen.
translation_verse: Jehoyada nanʋala Benaaya bʋla pɩ kuoro, “La jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ daga! A leŋ dɩ ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa leŋ dɩ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ bʋla chɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord has always watched over you, and I pray that he will now watch over Solomon. May the Lord help Solomon to be an even greater king than you.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa chɩŋ ŋ harɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, a leŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ Solomoŋ harɩŋ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ kuoruŋ yʋga kɩɩ ŋ kʋa.”

english_verse: Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah left and took along the two groups of David's special bodyguards. Solomon rode on David's mule as they led him to Gihon Spring.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Zadɔk arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Netaŋ arɩ Jehoyada nanʋala Benaaya arɩ laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro Devit, ba sii tuu a leŋ Solomoŋ jɩl Devit kakumo, ba kɛnʋ kaa mʋ Gɩhɔŋ lɩɩ-bulo-la leriŋ.

english_verse: Zadok the priest brought some olive oil from the sacred tent and poured it on Solomon's head to show that he was now king. A trumpet was blown and everyone shouted, “Long live King Solomon!”
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ Zadɔk sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara joŋ nʋʋŋ arɩ nyile ʋ sɩ joŋo Wɩa lɛbɩŋ tʋɔŋ a bɩsa hɛ Solomoŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋmʋʋ banyile, nɩalɩŋ kala kpɩa goŋ a bʋl, “A leŋ dɩ kuoro Solomoŋ mɩɩsɩŋ duomi.”

english_verse: Then they played flutes and celebrated as they followed Solomon back to Jerusalem. They made so much noise that the ground shook.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala to Solomoŋ harɩŋ a ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlaa aŋ faasa jʋɔsa ŋɩŋaa goŋ, tinteeŋ paala jijigisi.

english_verse: Adonijah and his guests had almost finished eating when they heard the noise. Joab also heard the trumpet and asked, “What's all that noise about in the city?”
translation_verse: Adonija arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala ʋ fa sɩ yɩra dii kɩaa aŋ gbiele dɩdɛrɛ nɛ aŋ nɩɩ goŋ-la. Jʋab sɩ nɩɩ banyile-la ba sɩɩ ŋmʋʋ, ʋ pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ goŋ nɛ baa ŋaa jaŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ?”

english_verse: Just then, Jonathan son of Abiathar came running up. “Come in,” Adonijah said. “An important man like you must have some good news.”
translation_verse: Ʋ fa sɩɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, dɩ Abɩata sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nanʋala Jonataŋ kɔ. Adonija yɩrʋ, “Kʋ jʋʋ. Ŋ-na sɩɩfɩaŋ tɩɩna deeŋ sɩɩ kɔ ŋ-la, ʋ naga wʋzɔŋ nɛ ŋ kaa kɔ.”

english_verse: Jonathan answered: No, I don't! David has just announced that Solomon will be king.
translation_verse: Jonataŋ bʋla pɩ Adonija, “Wʋzɔŋ dee mɩ kaa kɔ. Kuoro Devit leŋe Solomoŋ nɛ dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: Solomon rode David's own mule to Gihon Spring, and Zadok, Nathan, Benaiah, and David's special bodyguards went with him. When they got there, Zadok and Nathan made Solomon king. Then everyone celebrated all the way back to Jerusalem. That's the noise you hear in the city.
translation_verse: ka Zadɔk, arɩ Netaŋ joŋ nʋʋŋ tɩsʋ ʋ dii kuoruŋ Gɩhɔŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka ba jʋʋ jaŋ tʋɔŋ, a jʋɔsa ŋɩŋaa goŋ. Goŋ-la ŋ sɩ nɩa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Solomon is now king.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ nɛ lɛɛlɛ ŋaa kuoro.

english_verse: And listen to this! David's officials told him, “We pray that your God will help Solomon to be an even greater king!” David was in his bed at the time, but he bowed
translation_verse: Kuoro tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la kala nɛ kʋ lɔllɛ la nɩhɩaŋ kuoro Devit aŋ bʋl, ‘A leŋ dɩ ŋ Wɩa ŋaa dɩ Solomoŋ yɩrɩŋ sii a kɩɩ ŋ kʋa, dɩ ʋ kuoruŋ ma yʋgɛ a kɩɩ ŋ kʋa.’ Kuoro Devit ma kpirimi ʋ bɔsɔ lɛ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA

english_verse: and prayed, “I praise you, Lord God of Israel. You have made my son Solomon king and have let me live to see it.”
translation_verse: a bʋl, ‘Mɩɩ dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, jɩnɩŋ ʋ sɩ leŋe mɩ doho nʋʋ laa mɩ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ a leŋ mɩ sɩɩŋ naʋ.’ ”

english_verse: Adonijah's guests shook with fear when they heard this news, and they left as fast as they could.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala Adonija sɩ yɩra sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba. Ba guu sii pɩsɛ.

english_verse: Someone told Solomon, “Adonijah is afraid of you and is holding onto the corners of the altar. He wants you to promise that you won't kill him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋ bʋla pɩ kuoro Solomoŋ arɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ Adonija nɛ a tɩŋ ʋ wɩaa, ʋ jʋʋ kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la gʋnaa lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Má leŋ dɩ Solomoŋ ŋmɩɛsa pɩmɛ jɩnɩŋ arɩ ʋ bɩ jaŋ kpʋmɛ.”

english_verse: Solomon answered, “If Adonijah doesn't cause any trouble, I won't hurt him. But if he does, I'll have him killed.”
translation_verse: Solomoŋ bʋl, “Dɩ ʋ wɩaa nɛ zɔmɔ, ʋ nyu-pʋŋ ma bɩ jaŋ churo tel tinteeŋ, ama dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔmɔ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ sʋʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Then he sent someone to the altar to get Adonijah. After Adonijah came and bowed down, Solomon said, “Adonijah, go home.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Solomoŋ tɩŋ ba mʋ kɛnʋ lɩɩ koru-la nyuŋ a kɔ. Ʋ kɔ a kpirimi kuoro Solomoŋ sɩpaaŋ. Solomoŋ bʋla pʋ, “Sii mʋ dɩa.”

english_verse: Not long before David died, he told Solomon:
translation_verse: Devit sʋʋŋ sɩ yie, ʋ bʋl wɩaa a pɩ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ.

english_verse: My son, I will soon die, as everyone must. But I want you to be strong and brave.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ sʋʋŋ yie nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ.

english_verse: Do what the Lord your God commands and follow his teachings. Obey everything written in the Law of Moses. Then you will be a success, no matter what you do or where you go.
translation_verse: To wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ: To ʋ wombiee, arɩ ʋ wʋdagaa kala. Tuto wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ joŋo dagɛ Mosis ʋ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ wɩɩkala ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa arɩ lee-kala ŋ sɩɩ mʋ, dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ pɩŋ.

english_verse: You and your descendants must always faithfully obey the Lord. If you do, he will keep the solemn promise he made to me that someone from our family will always be king of Israel.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ to La TƖƖNA niiŋ, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ pɩmɛ chɩŋ. Ʋ fa bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ doho nɩaa nɛ didii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, dɩ ba nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a tou arɩ ba tʋɔŋ arɩ ba wɩɩ wɩɩkala.

english_verse: Solomon, don't forget what Joab did to me by killing Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether, the two commanders of Israel's army. He killed them as if they were his enemies in a war, but he did it when there was no war. He is guilty, and now it's up to you to punish him
translation_verse: Ŋ tɩtɩa jɩŋ wɩɩ-la Zeruya nanʋala Jʋab sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ nɛ, ʋ sɩ kpʋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la balɩa, Nɛɛ nanʋala Abɩna arɩ Jɛta nanʋala Amasa. Wɩɩkala fa bɩ jʋa ka ʋ kpʋba a nagɛ laalɩŋ sɩ sie. Lɛɛlɛ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩɩra daŋ mɩ nyuŋ nɛ, mɩ nɩna hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: in the way you think best. Whatever you do, don't let him die peacefully in his old age.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ŋɩɩ maga, joŋo ŋaa ʋ lɛ, ama sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ hɩɛsɛ a sʋʋ ʋ Wɩa sʋʋŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: Be sure to do something about Shimei son of Gera from Bahurim in the territory of Benjamin. He cursed and insulted me the day I went to Mahanaim. But later, when he came to meet me at the Jordan River, I promised that I wouldn't kill him.
translation_verse: Pɔ ŋ sɩ́ Gɛra nanʋala Sɩmɛɩ, Bɛnjamɩŋ tɩɩna-la sɩ lɩɩ Bahurim wɩaa yʋ. Ʋ chaasa bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a hɛ mɩ lɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ mʋ Mahanem. Ʋ sɩ kʋ puumi Jɔdaŋ lɛ, mɩ ŋmɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA nɛ, arɩ mɩ bɩ jaŋ kpʋʋ.

english_verse: Now you must punish him. He's an old man, but you're wise enough to know that you must have him killed. David Dies
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ, sɩ́ ʋ pɛɩ leŋ. Ŋ ŋaa wʋjɩnnʋ nɛ, ŋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ leŋ dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: he saddled his donkey and went after them. He found them and brought them back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɩmɛɩ sii kpɩɛrɛ ʋ kakumo a mʋ Akɩs teeŋ Gaf lɛ a chɩchɛ ʋ yosu-la. Ʋ sɩ mʋ Gaf, ʋ na yosi-la a kɛsɛba kaa mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Joab's family will always suffer because of what he did, but the Lord will always bless David's family and his kingdom with peace.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ Jʋab sɩ kpʋa cheeriŋ nyʋa ʋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa nyuŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, aŋ ka dɩ La TƖƖNA leŋ dɩ Devit arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa, arɩ ba kuoruŋ wɩaa vɩvɛŋ woruŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: His son Solomon became king and took control of David's kingdom. Adonijah Is Killed
translation_verse: Solomoŋ sɩ laa ʋ nyɩmma Devit nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ, ʋ kuoruŋ fa chaasa chɩŋ nɛ woruŋ. Solomoŋ kuoruŋ chɩna

english_verse: One day, Adonijah went to see Bathsheba, Solomon's mother, and she asked, “Is this a friendly visit?” “Yes.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala, Hagɩf nanʋala Adonija sii mʋ Solomoŋ naaŋ Bɛfɩsɛba teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Bɛfɩsɛba pɩɛsʋ, “Ba fɩɛla nɛ ŋ kʋkɔ mɩ teeŋ?” Ʋ bʋl, “Oo, ba fɩɛla nɛ.”

english_verse: I just want to talk with you.” “All right,” she told him, “go ahead.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ kɛŋ wɩɩ nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩŋ.” Bɛfɩsɛba sɩ, “Ŋ jaŋ wuo bʋl.”

english_verse: “You know that I was king for a little while,” Adonijah replied. “And everyone in Israel accepted me as their ruler. But the Lord wanted my brother to be king, so now things have changed.
translation_verse: Adonija bʋl, “Ŋ jɩma, kuorii-la fa ŋaa mɩ kʋa nɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala faa chɛ mɩ nɛ ŋaa ba kuoro. Ama wɩaa bɩrɩma nɛ, kuorii-la mɩɩra ŋaa mɩ naambie kʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA chɩchɛ.

english_verse: Would you do me a favor?” “What do you want?” Bathsheba asked.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ sʋl wʋbala nɛ ŋ teeŋ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, sɩ́ mɩ sʋla-la vɩa.” Bɛfɩsɛba sɩ, “Ŋ jaŋ wuo bʋl.”

english_verse: “All right,” she said. “I'll ask him.”
translation_verse: Bɛfɩsɛba sɩ, “Ʋ zɔmɔ, mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩ kuoro.”

english_verse: When Bathsheba went to see Solomon, he stood up to meet her, then bowed low. He sat back down and had another throne brought in, so his mother could sit at his right side.
translation_verse: Bɛfɩsɛba sɩ mʋ kuoro Solomoŋ leriŋ dɩ ʋ bʋl Adonija wɩɩ-la, kuoro sii chɩŋ a chemu, a tuu kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ, aŋ sii hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ, a leŋ ba kɛŋ kuoru kpasa dɔŋɔ kʋ pɩ ʋ naaŋ, ʋ ma hɔŋ ʋ nadiiŋ.

english_verse: Bathsheba sat down and then asked, “Would you do me a small favor?” Solomon replied, “Mother, just tell me what you want, and I will do it.”
translation_verse: Bɛfɩsɛba bʋl, “Mɩ kɛŋ wʋbie nɛ a chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa pɩmɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ wɩɩ-la vɩa.” Kuoro sɩ, “Mɩ naaŋ, bʋl wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ vɩa.”

english_verse: “Allow your brother Adonijah to marry Abishag,” she answered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Bɛfɩsɛba bʋl, “Leŋ dɩ ŋ naambie Adonija jaa Abɩsak, tolo-la sɩ lɩɩ Sunem.”

english_verse: Solomon said: What? Let my older brother marry Abishag? You may as well ask me to let him rule the kingdom! And why don't you ask such favors for Abiathar and Joab?
translation_verse: Kuoro Solomoŋ pɩɛsɛ ʋ naaŋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ chɩchɛ dɩ Adonija jaa Abɩsak? Ŋɩɩ-na bʋl mɩ joŋ kuorii-la ma a pɛ pʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ŋaa mɩ malɩma nɛ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Abɩata arɩ Zeruya nanʋala Jʋab ma paala chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: I swear in the name of the Lord that Adonijah will die because he asked for this! If he doesn't, I pray that God will severely punish me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Solomoŋ ŋmɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA: “A leŋ dɩ Wɩa dɔgɩsɛmɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ leŋe dɩ ba kpʋ Adonija a tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ ʋ sɩ pɩɛsa chɩchɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord made me king in my father's place and promised that the kings of Israel would come from my family. Yes, I swear by the living Lord that Adonijah will die today.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA leŋe mɩ dii kuoruŋ mɩ nyɩmma Devit nyuŋ nɛ, a leŋ mɩ kuoruŋ chaasa chɩŋ. Ʋ hɛ niiŋ nɛ arɩ mɩ doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ didii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ ŋmɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ weye, Adonija maga dɩ ʋ sʋʋ nɛ jɩnɩŋ.”

english_verse: “Benaiah,” Solomon shouted, “go kill Adonijah.” So Adonijah died. Abiathar Is Sent Back Home
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Solomoŋ leŋ Jehoyada nanʋala Benaaya mʋ kpʋ Adonija,

english_verse: Solomon sent for Abiathar the priest and said: Abiathar, go back home to Anathoth! You ought to be killed too, but I won't do it now. When my father David was king, you were in charge of the sacred chest, and you went through a lot of hard times with my father.
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pɩ Abɩata ma sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, “Mɩɩra mʋ ŋ jaŋ Anatɔf. Ʋ fa maga dɩ mɩ kpʋŋ nɛ, ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ kpʋŋ a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ chʋŋ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ niiriŋ daga-la mɩ nyɩmma Devit sɩpaaŋ, a pɛ na hɛɛ-la ma mɩ nyɩmma sɩ na wɩaa.”

english_verse: But I won't let you be a priest of the Lord anymore. And so the promise that the Lord had made at Shiloh about the family of Eli came true. Joab Is Killed
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ kiri Abɩata sɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ. Ŋɩɩ leŋ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ Sɩlɔ lɛ a tɩgɛ Eli doho nɩaa lɛ sɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: Joab had not helped Absalom try to become king, but he had helped Adonijah. So when Joab learned that Adonijah had been killed, he ran to the sacred tent and grabbed hold of the corners of the altar for protection.
translation_verse: Jʋab fa pɛ Adonija lɛ nɛ dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ aŋ lɩɩ Abɩsalɔm harɩŋ. Ʋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ʋ sii fá jʋʋ La TƖƖNA lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ gʋnaa lɛ.

english_verse: When Solomon heard about this, he sent someone to ask Joab, “Why did you run to the altar?” Joab sent back his answer, “I was afraid of you, and I ran to the Lord for protection.” Then Solomon shouted, “Benaiah, go kill Joab!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ kuoro Solomoŋ arɩ Jʋab fá jʋʋ La TƖƖNA lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ nɛ, a chɩŋ koru-la sɛmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ bʋla pɩ Jehoyada nanʋala Benaaya, “Mʋ kpʋʋ.”

english_verse: Benaiah went to the sacred tent and yelled, “Joab, the king orders you to come out!” “No!” Joab answered. “Kill me right here.” Benaiah went back and told Solomon what Joab had said.
translation_verse: Benaaya mʋ jʋʋ La TƖƖNA lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ a bʋla pɩ Jʋab, “Kuoro sɩ, ŋ kʋ lɩɩ.” Jʋab sɩ, “Aɩ, mɩ jaŋ sʋʋ daha.” Benaaya mɩɩra mʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la Jʋab sɩ bʋla a pɩ kuoro.

english_verse: Solomon replied: Do what Joab said. Kill him and bury him! Then my family and I won't be responsible for what he did to Abner the commander of Israel's army and to Amasa the commander of Judah's army. He killed those innocent men without my father knowing about it. Both of them were better men than Joab. Now the Lord will make him pay for those murders.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ nɩalɩŋ balɩa Jʋab sɩ kpʋa, ka mɩ nyɩmma Devit jɩma tuo chɩmɩŋ a tiŋ ʋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kala balɩa fa kpɩaʋ: Nɛɛ nanʋala Abɩna fa sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ arɩ Jɛta nanʋala Amasa ma fa sɩ ŋaa Juda nɩaa laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ.

english_verse: Benaiah went back and killed Joab. His body was taken away and buried near his home in the desert.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Benaaya sii mʋ a kpʋ Jʋab. Ba joŋu hugi ʋ jaŋ lɛ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Solomon put Benaiah in Joab's place as army commander, and he put Zadok in Abiathar's place as priest. Shimei Is Killed
translation_verse: Kuoro leŋ Benaaya laa Jʋab nyuŋ a ŋaa laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ, aŋ leŋ Zadɔk ma laa Abɩata nyuŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: Solomon sent for Shimei and said, “Build a house here in Jerusalem and live in it. But whatever you do, don't leave the city!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro tɩŋ ba yɩrɛ Sɩmɛɩ, ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Saa dɩa Jerusalɛm lɛ a hɛ nɩmɛ, sɩ́ lee-kala mʋ.

english_verse: If you ever cross Kidron Valley and leave Jerusalem, you will be killed. And it will be your own fault.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ maachie sie a chol Kɩdɩrɔŋ fuonaa-la, tapʋlɩɩ-la ba jaŋ kpʋŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ sʋba, ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ŋ sʋʋŋ.”

english_verse: “That's fair, Your Majesty,” Shimei answered. “I'll do that.” So Shimei lived in Jerusalem from then on.
translation_verse: Sɩmɛɩ bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ bʋla zɔmɔ nɛ. Mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ŋ sɩ bʋla.” Sɩmɛɩ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a dieni woruŋ.

english_verse: About three years later, two of Shimei's servants ran off to King Achish in Gath. When Shimei found out where they were,
translation_verse: Jɩsɩŋ batori harɩŋ, Sɩmɛɩ yosuŋ balɩa lɩɩ fá a mʋ Gaf kuoro Akɩs teeŋ, Maaka nanʋala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ Sɩmɛɩ arɩ ʋ yosu-la hɛ Gaf lɛ.

english_verse: Someone told Solomon that Shimei had gone to Gath and was back.
translation_verse: Ba bʋla pɩ Solomoŋ arɩ Sɩmɛɩ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ a mʋ Gaf nɛ aŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: Solomon sent for him and said: Shimei, you promised in the name of the Lord that you would never leave Jerusalem. I warned you that you would die if you did. You agreed that this was fair, didn't you?
translation_verse: Kuoro Solomoŋ yɩrɛ Sɩmɛɩ a pɩɛsʋ, “Mɩ bɩ leŋe ŋ hɛ niiŋ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ arɩ ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ a mʋ lee kalaa? Mɩ chaasa bʋla pɩŋ nɛ arɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ lɩɩ mʋ lee dɔŋ, jɩŋ arɩ ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ. Bʋa-la lɛ ŋ bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ ŋ sɛɩ wɩɩ-la nɛ, ŋ jaŋ tou.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me and have broken the promise you made to the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ŋ bɩ nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ pɩ La TƖƖNA arɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ lɛ to?”

english_verse: I know you remember all the cruel things you did to my father David. Now the Lord is going to punish you for what you did.
translation_verse: Kuoro bɩra bʋla pɩ Sɩmɛɩ, “Ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, ŋ jɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ nyɩmma Devit lɛ nɛ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ ba chɩmɩŋ a timiŋ.

english_verse: But the Lord will bless me and make my father's kingdom strong forever.
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ mɩ-na kuoro Solomoŋ lɛ, dɩ Devit kuorii-la chaasa chɩŋ woruŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: “Benaiah,” Solomon shouted, “kill Shimei.” So Shimei died. Solomon was now in complete control of his kingdom.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro leŋ Jehoyada nanʋala Benaaya mʋ kpʋ Sɩmɛɩ. Kuorii-la lɛɛlɛ chaasa chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ Solomoŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: At that time, there was no temple for worshiping the Lord, and everyone offered sacrifices at the local shrines.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ ba ha bɩ Wɩa dɩa saa dɩ ba mʋ dɩdɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA nɩmɛ. Nɩaa faa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lere-la ba fa sɩɩ kpaarɛ vesiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I'll also give you what you didn't ask for. You'll be rich and respected as long as you live, and you'll be greater than any other king.
translation_verse: Mɩ ha jaŋ bɩra pɩŋ kɩalɩŋ ma ŋ sɩ bɩ sʋla. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ kɩaa, a leŋ dɩ nɩaa ziziliŋ. Ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, kuoru kala jaŋ tuo a magɩŋ.

english_verse: Solomon loved the Lord and followed his father David's instructions, but Solomon also offered sacrifices and burned incense at the shrines.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ fa cho La TƖƖNA nɛ, a tuto wɩalɩŋ ʋ nyɩmma Devit sɩ daga, ama ʋ ma kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋɩŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lere-la ba sɩɩ kpaarɛ vesiŋ nɛ, a nyɩnyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: One night while Solomon was in Gibeon, the Lord God appeared to him in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ kʋbala Solomoŋ sɩ hɛ Gibioŋ lɛ, La TƖƖNA kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagʋ duoso lɛ a bʋla pʋ, “Sʋl kʋŋ na-kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ pɩŋ.”

english_verse: Solomon answered: My father David, your servant, was honest and did what you commanded. You were always loyal to him, and you gave him a son who is now king.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ bʋl, “Ŋ chaasa dii zile kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ mɩ nyɩmma Devit sɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnna lɛ, a tɩŋ ʋ fa sɩ laaŋ dii a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a chɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ naaŋ lɛ. Zile-la tɩtɩa nɛ ŋ haa ŋaa ʋ lɛ a pʋ hambolibie, ʋ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ jɩnɩŋ ŋ-la.

english_verse: Lord God, I'm your servant, and you've made me king in my father's place. But I'm very young and know so little about being a leader.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, ŋ leŋe mɩ laa mɩ nyɩmma Devit nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ nɛ. Ama mɩ ŋaa hambie nɛ a bɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ maga dɩ mɩ ŋaa jɩŋ.

english_verse: And now I must rule your chosen people, even though there are too many of them to count.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ba ŋaa nɩ-daŋ nɛ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛ.

english_verse: Please make me wise and teach me the difference between right and wrong. Then I will know how to rule your people. If you don't, there is no way I could rule this great nation of yours.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, pɩmɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ wʋzɔmʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ bʋa a kaa beŋ ŋ nɩaa. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa a beŋ ŋ nɩ-daŋ deeŋ?”

english_verse: God said: Solomon, I'm pleased that you asked for this. You could have asked to live a long time or to be rich. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom to make right decisions.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ sɩ folo chɩchɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ, aŋ bɩ mɩɩ-duduoŋ koo dʋa nɛ pɩɛsa chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ, a bɩra bɩ sʋla chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ma nɛ sʋʋ, ama aŋ sʋla chɩchɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ ŋ kaa beŋ ŋ nɩaa,

english_verse: So I'll make you wiser than anyone who has ever lived or ever will live.
translation_verse: mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ a pɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ pɩŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nʋʋ ha sɩ bɩ kɛnɛ aŋ ka arɩ maachie kala.

english_verse: If you obey me and follow my commands, as your father David did, I'll let you live a long time.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ jaŋ to mɩ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ daga, arɩ ŋ nyɩmma Devit sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ duomi.”

english_verse: Solomon woke up and realized that God had spoken to him in the dream. He went back to Jerusalem and stood in front of the sacred chest, where he offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. Then Solomon gave a feast for his officials. Solomon Makes a Difficult Decision
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ hirige sii a na dɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm, a chɩŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la sɩpaaŋ a kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ yɩrɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa kala ba kʋ gbieli aŋ dii kɩaa. Solomoŋ dii sarɩya arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ

english_verse: One day two women came to King Solomon,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala hachɔrʋmɔɔ balɩa sii a kɔ Solomoŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: and one of them said: Your Majesty, this woman and I live in the same house. Not long ago my baby was born at home,
translation_verse: Haala-la dɔŋɔ bʋl, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, mɩ dɩ haala deeŋ kala hɛ dɩɩ-bala lɛ nɛ, mɩ lʋl hambolibie dɩ ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: and three days later her baby was born. Nobody else was there with us.
translation_verse: Mɩ lʋlʋŋ harɩŋ, tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ ʋ ma lʋl. La dʋndʋŋa nɛ, nʋʋ dɔŋ fa bɩ la lɛ pɛ dɩa-la lɛ.

english_verse: One night while we were all asleep, she rolled over on her baby, and he died.
translation_verse: Haala deeŋ pɩŋ tɩtaŋ kʋbala a bilime nyagɛ ʋ bie kpʋ.

english_verse: Then while I was still asleep, she got up and took my son out of my bed. She put him in her bed, then she put her dead baby next to me.
translation_verse: Mɩ pɩŋ doŋ ka ʋ sii tɩta-siesee a joŋ mɩ bie sɩ pɩŋ mɩ sɛmɛ, a kaa mʋ bil ʋ sɛmɛ, aŋ mɩɩra joŋ ʋ bii-sʋʋ-la a kaa kʋ bil mɩ sɛmɛ.

english_verse: In the morning when I got up to feed my son, I saw that he was dead. But when I looked at him in the light, I knew he wasn't my son.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ sie chʋchʋɔŋ, a chɩchɛ mɩ kɛŋ yɩlɩŋ a pɩ mɩ bie, mɩ bene dɩ ʋ sʋba. Ama leriŋ sɩ pʋlla mɩ beŋ fii, mɩ na dɩ mɩ bie dee.”

english_verse: “No!” the other woman shouted. “He was your son. My baby is alive!” “The dead baby is yours,” the first woman yelled. “Mine is alive!” They argued back and forth in front of Solomon,
translation_verse: Haal-la dɔŋɔ ma bʋl, “Aɩ, bile sɩ weye nɛ mɩ kʋa, bii-sʋʋ-la nɛ ŋaa ŋ kʋa.” Ha-bumbuŋ-la ha pɛsɛ, “Aɩ, bii-sʋʋ-la nɛ ŋaa ŋ kʋa, kʋla sɩ weye nɛ ŋaa mɩ kʋa.” Ba kaa chɩna lɩlɛrɛ kuoro sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: until finally he said, “Both of you say this live baby is yours.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Solomoŋ bʋl, “Ma kʋŋkala sɩ, ‘Mɩ nɛ tɩɩ bile sɩ weye, ŋ nɛ tɩɩ bii-sʋʋŋ.’ ”

english_verse: Someone bring me a sword.” A sword was brought, and Solomon ordered,
translation_verse: Solomoŋ bɩra bʋl, “Má joŋ tokobiiŋ kʋ pɩmɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋo kaa kʋ pʋ.

english_verse: “Cut the baby in half! That way each of you can have part of him.”
translation_verse: Kuoro pa wombiiŋ a bʋl, “Má kɛŋ bii-wei-la keri balɩa a joŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ pɩ dɔŋɔ, aŋ joŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a pɩ dɔŋɔ ma.”

english_verse: “Please don't kill my son,” the baby's mother screamed. “Your Majesty, I love him very much, but give him to her. Just don't kill him.” The other woman shouted, “Go ahead and cut him in half. Then neither of us will have the baby.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nisusuŋ kɛŋ haal-la bie sɩ bɩ sʋba, ʋ bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ kuoro, joŋ bile a pɩ haal-la, sɩ́ ʋ kpʋ.” Ama haal-la dɔŋɔ ma bʋl, “La kala jaŋ ta, la kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ tɩɩ bile. Má kɛnʋ keri balɩa.”

english_verse: Solomon said, “Don't kill the baby.” Then he pointed to the first woman, “She is his real mother. Give the baby to her.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ bʋl, “Má sɩ́ bile kpʋ, má joŋ bile pɩ ha-bumbuŋ-la, ʋ nɛ tɩɩ bile.”

english_verse: Everyone in Israel was amazed when they heard how Solomon had made his decision. They realized that God had given him wisdom to judge fairly.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ kuoro sɩ dii sarɩya-la, ba kala zizilu woruŋ. Ba jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa pʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ kaa dii sarɩya ʋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: Solomon chose twelve regional officers, who took turns bringing food for him and his household. Each officer provided food from his region for one month of the year.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ fa kɛŋ nɩaa fii arɩ balɩa nɛ ba bibeŋ Iziral tinteeŋ kala ba sɩ kaa kpaa. Ba nɛ yie kɛŋ kʋdiilee kʋʋ pɩ kuoro arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa. Ba kʋŋkala yie tɩa kʋdiile-la chɛnɛ nɛ jɩna-kala tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: These were the twelve officers: The son of Hur was in charge of the hill country of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la: Bɛŋ-Huu, ʋ nɛ faa beŋ Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga.

english_verse: The son of Deker was in charge of the towns of Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-Shemesh, and Elon-Beth-Hanan.
translation_verse: Bɛŋ-Dɛkɛɛ, ʋ ma nɛ faa beŋ tasɩŋ deemba: Makas, Saalɩbɩm, Bɛf Sɛmɛs arɩ Ɛlɔŋ Bɛfɩhanaŋ.

english_verse: The son of Abinadab was in charge of Naphath-Dor and was married to Solomon's daughter Taphath.
translation_verse: Bɛŋ-Abɩnadab, ʋ ma nɛ faa beŋ Nafɔf Doo. Ʋ nɛ fa jaa Solomoŋ tolo Tafaf.

english_verse: The son of Geber was in charge of the town of Ramoth in Gilead and the villages in Gilead belonging to the family of Jair, a descendant of Manasseh. He was also in charge of the region of Argob in Bashan, which had
translation_verse: Bɛŋ-Geba ma nɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ nɛ faa beŋ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ramɔf a hɛ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ lɛ, arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ ŋaa Jaa nyɩŋ-nɩaa kɩaa, Manasɛ doho nɩɩ-la. Ʋ nɛ fa haa beŋ Agɔb ma sɩ hɛ Basaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ arɩ ʋ tabala-la mahɩŋ batori ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli a kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa ba borusuŋ daa-doloo.

english_verse: Ahinadab son of Iddo was in charge of the territory of Mahanaim.
translation_verse: Ido nanʋala Ahɩnadab ma nɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ nɛ faa beŋ Mahanem tinteeŋ kala.

english_verse: Ahimaaz was in charge of the territory of Naphtali and was married to Solomon's daughter Basemath.
translation_verse: Ahɩmaas ma nɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ nɛ fa jaa Solomoŋ tolo ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Basɛmaf. Ʋ nɛ faa beŋ Nafɩtalɩ tinteeŋ kala.

english_verse: Baana son of Hushai was in charge of the territory of Asher and the town of Bealoth.
translation_verse: Husai nanʋala Baana ma nɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ nɛ faa beŋ Asa tinteeŋ arɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Alɔf.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah was in charge of the territory of Issachar.
translation_verse: Parʋa nanʋala Jehosafat ma nɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ nɛ faa beŋ Ɩsaka tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Shimei son of Ela was in charge of the territory of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Ɛla nanʋala Sɩmɛɩ ma nɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ nɛ faa beŋ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Geber son of Uri was in charge of Gilead, where King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan had lived. And one officer was in charge of the territory of Judah. The Size of Solomon's Kingdom
translation_verse: Uri nanʋala Geba ma nɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ ma nɛ faa beŋ Gɩlɩad, lee-la Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Sɩhɔŋ arɩ Basaŋ kuoro Ɔgɩ fa sɩ hɔnɔ. Nɩhɩaŋ dɔŋ ma nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ a bibeŋ Juda tinteeŋ kala. Kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yie kaa kʋ pɩ Solomoŋ tapʋlɩɩ kala

english_verse: Solomon ruled every kingdom between the Euphrates River and the land of the Philistines down to Egypt. These kingdoms paid him taxes as long as he lived.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ nɛ faa beŋ tintee-la kala a chɩŋ Yufireti fuo-la lɛ a kaa mʋ yi Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Ijipiti tinteeŋ bʋa. Solomoŋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteye-la kala lɛ fa tiŋ ba lampoo a pʋpʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Solomon ruled the whole region west of the Euphrates River, from Tiphsah to Gaza, and he was at peace with all of the countries around him.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ nɛ faa beŋ kuorusu-la kala sɩ hɛ Yufireti fuo-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a chɩŋ Tɩpɩsa lɛ a kaa mʋ Gaza. Nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ fa hɛ ʋ dɩ tinteye-la kala sɩ hɔnɔ kpagɛ ba pɛgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone living in Israel, from the town of Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south, was safe as long as Solomon lived. Each family sat undisturbed beneath its own grape vines and fig trees.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Solomoŋ sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, Juda arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala, a chɩŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Daŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa a kaa mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛɛsɩba sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, nʋʋkala fa hɔnɔ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ nɛ, wɩɩkala bɩ ba jʋa. Nɩalɩŋ kala fa kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa tɩɩnɛnɛɛ bagɩsɩŋ arɩ ba tutogusuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Each of the twelve regional officers brought food to Solomon and his household for one month of the year. They provided everything he needed,
translation_verse: Solomoŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la fii arɩ balɩa sɩɩ beŋ Iziral tinteeŋ ba sɩ kaa kpaa, dɩ ba kʋŋkala chɛnɛ nɛ yie, ʋ yie kɛŋ kʋdiilee kʋ pɩ Solomoŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ dii kɩaa ʋ dɩa lɛ nɛ, dɩ ba sɩ́ kʋŋkala chɛ ka.

english_verse: as well as barley and straw for the horses. Solomon's Wisdom
translation_verse: Ba ha yie pɛ kɛŋ mɩaa arɩ ja-yaŋ ma a kaa kɔ nɛ ba laa pɩ janɩ-la. Solomoŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ

english_verse: Solomon was brilliant. God had blessed him with insight and understanding.
translation_verse: Wɩa fa pɩ Solomoŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, ʋ wuo bee nɩna wʋtɩtɩɩ, a jɩjɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ. Ʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ fa bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ.

english_verse: He was wiser than anyone else in the world, including the wisest people of the east and of Egypt. He was even wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Mahol's three sons, Heman, Calcol, and Darda. Solomon became famous in every country around Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ fa jɩŋ wɩaa a kɩɩ nʋʋkala. Ʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ fa kɩɩ Ɛzɩra tɩŋŋaa Ɛtaŋ, arɩ Hemaŋ, Kalɩkɔl arɩ Daada sɩ ŋaa Mahol biiriŋ kala. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ fa teeli tinteye-la kala sɩ golli Iziral tinteeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: He could talk about all kinds of plants, from large trees to small bushes, and he taught about animals, birds, reptiles, and fish.
translation_verse: Ʋ wuo jɩŋ tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ nyʋ ma wɩaa nɛ: Tɩɩ-balaa, kʋbiisiŋ, a wuo jɩŋ pʋsʋŋ arɩ bagɩlaa wɩaa, diibiisiŋ, kɩalɩŋ sɩɩ vaamɛ tinteeŋ arɩ chenfilee kala.

english_verse: Kings all over the world heard about Solomon's wisdom and sent people to listen to him teach.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa kuoroo kala nɛ nɩɩ Solomoŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ wɩaa, a tɩŋ nɩaa ba kʋ jegilee nɩɩ ʋ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre had always been friends with Solomon's father David. When Hiram learned that Solomon was king, he sent some of his officials to meet with Solomon.
translation_verse: Taaya tɩŋŋaa kuoro Hiram sɩ nɩa dɩ Solomoŋ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ ʋ laa ʋ nyɩmma Devit nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ, ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ dɩ ba mʋ lɔllɛ Solomoŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ dɩ Devit fa ŋaa nandɔsʋ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God promised my father that when his son became king, he would build a temple for worshiping the Lord. So I've decided to do that.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa hɛ niiŋ pɩ mɩ nyɩmma Devit nɛ arɩ ʋ nanʋal-la sɩ jaŋ laa ʋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ nɛ jaŋ saa ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ a pʋ. Ŋɩɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ mɩ kɛŋ dɩ mɩ saa dɩɩ-balɩŋ a pɩ mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa.

english_verse: I'd like you to send your workers to cut down cedar trees in Lebanon for me. I will pay them whatever you say and will even have my workers help them. We both know that your workers are more experienced than anyone else at cutting lumber.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa leŋ dɩ ŋ nɩaa keri kuolu daasɩŋ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ a pɩmɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa kʋ pɛ ŋ nɩaa lɛ dɩ ba keri daasɩ-la. Magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ tiŋ ŋ nɩaa, mɩ jaŋ time pɩŋ. Ŋ jɩma, la bɩ nɩaa kɛnɛ ba jɩŋ daasɩŋ keriŋ a magɛ ŋ nɩaa.”

english_verse: Hiram was so happy when he heard Solomon's request that he said, “I am grateful that the Lord gave David such a wise son to be king of that great nation!”
translation_verse: Hiram sɩ nɩɩ Solomoŋ tɩndaarɩɩ-la, ʋ tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ, ʋ bʋl, “Mɩɩ dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA jɩnɩŋ ʋ sɩ joŋ hambolibie sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a pɩ Devit dɩ ʋ beŋ tintee-balɩŋ deeŋ.”

english_verse: Then he sent back his answer: I received your message and will give you all the cedar and pine logs you need.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hiram tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Solomoŋ, “Mɩ laa tɩndaarɩ-la ŋ sɩ tɩma nɛ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa keri kuolo arɩ bʋtʋma doloo a kaa kʋ pɩŋ.

english_verse: My workers will carry them down from Lebanon to the Mediterranean Sea. They will tie the logs together and float them along the coast to wherever you want them. Then they will untie the logs, and your workers can take them from there. To pay for the logs, you can provide the grain I need for my household.

english_verse: Along the sides and back of the temple, there were three levels of storage rooms. translation_verse: Bʋbʋɔŋ dɩa-la dɩɩsɩŋ jalɩŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ kɩaa jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ butori, ka nyuŋ kɩaa ma ŋaa naakeliŋ butori arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ. Solomoŋ fa leŋe ba saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la ʋ kɛŋ gʋnaa nɛ harɩŋ, dɩ daasɩ-la daŋ ba nyuŋ aŋ sɩ́ jebii-la jʋʋ.

translation_verse: Kuoro leŋe ba chɔ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ a bɩsa hɛ chʋrʋŋ ba sɩ kaa mɛ kɩaa lɛ a ŋaa kɩalɩŋ Sʋkɔf arɩ Zarɛtaŋ pɛgɛ, Jɔdaŋ tintee-taala-la lɛ.

english_verse: There were so many bronze things that Solomon never bothered to weigh them, and no one ever knew how much bronze was used.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ fa bɩ leŋe ba magɩsɛ kɔlɩɩŋ kɩaa deemba kala ʋ jɩŋ ba yuŋuŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fa yʋga nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ. Ʋ bɩ wuo jɩŋ kɔlɩɩ-la sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ ba kaa ŋaaba.

english_verse: Solomon gave orders to make the following temple furnishings out of gold: the altar; the table that held the sacred loaves of bread;
