translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bunso pɩ La TƖƖNA a bʋl, “Mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa, bɛɛ kʋŋ wʋlɔrʋ nɛ ŋ ŋaa yo-haala deeŋ lɛ ŋ-la? Ʋ kɛmmɛ nɛ woruŋ ʋ dɩa lɛ, ka ŋ leŋ ʋ nanʋala sʋʋ.”

english_verse: Elijah stretched himself out over the boy three times, while praying, “Lord God, bring this boy back to life!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ chu tɔ bile lɛ naansɩɩŋ butori aŋ bɩra sʋl La TƖƖNA, “Mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa, leŋ dɩ bie deeŋ bɩra sii a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord answered Elijah's prayer, and the boy started breathing again.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nɩɩ Ɩlaaja sʋla, a leŋ bile bɩra sii a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Elijah picked him up and carried him downstairs. He gave the boy to his mother and said, “Look, your son is alive.”
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja joŋ bile dɩa-la lɛ a kaa tuu pɩ ʋ naaŋ aŋ bʋl, “Na ŋ nanʋala, ʋ weye nɛ.”

english_verse: “You are God's prophet!” the woman replied. “Now I know that you really do speak for the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la bʋla pɩ Ɩlaaja, “Mɩ jɩma lɛɛlɛ ŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ bʋla sɛnɛ lɩɩ La TƖƖNA teeŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: At that time Obadiah was in charge of Ahab's palace, but he faithfully worshiped the Lord. In fact, when Jezebel was trying to kill the Lord's prophets, Obadiah hid
translation_verse: Jɛzɛbɛl fa sɩɩ kpʋ La TƖƖNA wʋlaabʋllaa, Obadaaya kɛsɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa zɔlɔ a faa bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ balɩa lɛ. Mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii ma hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a pɩpɩba kʋdiilee arɩ lɩɩŋ.)

english_verse: and said, “We have to find something for our horses and mules to eat. If we don't, we will have to kill them. Let's look around every creek and spring in the country for some grass.
translation_verse: Ahab bʋla pɩ Obadaaya, “Leŋ dɩ la gɔllɛ la tinteeŋ lɩɩ-bulo leree arɩ fuonaasɩŋ kala, ŋ bɩ pɔ la jaŋ na yaŋ a pɩ la janɩŋ arɩ kakusuŋ dɩ ba sɩ́ sʋʋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ la sɩ́ la pʋna kala kpʋ.”

english_verse: You go one way, and I'll go the other.” Then they left in separate directions.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ ba tinteeŋ lere-la ba sɩ jaŋ mʋ a kaa kpaa. Ahab to sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, Obadaaya ma to sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: As Obadiah was walking along, he met Elijah. Obadiah recognized him, bowed down, and asked, “Elijah, is it really you?”
translation_verse: Obadaaya sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, Ɩlaaja chemu. Obadaaya wuo jɩmʋ a tuu kpirimi tinteeŋ aŋ pɩɛsɛ, “Ŋ nɛ sɛnɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ nɩhɩaŋ Ɩlaaja?”

english_verse: Obadiah replied: King Ahab would kill me if I told him that. And I haven't even done anything wrong.
translation_verse: Obadaaya pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa chei, ŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ joŋ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna a hɛ Ahab nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋmɛ?

english_verse: I swear to you in the name of the living Lord your God that the king has looked everywhere for you. He sent people to look in every country, and when they couldn't find you, he made the leader of each country swear that you were not in that country.
translation_verse: Ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ weye wɩaa, tintee koo kuoru kala lee tuo mɩ nɩhɩaŋ sɩ bɩ nɩaa tɩma ba mʋ chɩchɛŋ. Dɩ tintee koo kuoru kala lee nɩaa nɛ sɩ ba bɩŋ na, ʋ yie leŋ ba ŋmɩɛsɛ nɛ arɩ ba sɛnɛ bɩŋ na,

english_verse: Do you really want me to tell him you're here?
translation_verse: ka ŋ bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ mɩ mʋ bʋla pɩ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ arɩ ŋ hɛ daha.

english_verse: What if the Lord's Spirit takes you away as soon as I leave? When Ahab comes to get you, he won't find you. Then he will surely kill me. I have worshiped the Lord since I was a boy.
translation_verse: Ka dɩ mɩ nɛ leŋiŋ daha aŋ mʋ, dɩ La TƖƖNA Dɩma-la kʋ joŋuŋ kaa mʋ lee mɩ sɩ bɩ jɩŋ? Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋla pɩ Ahab arɩ ŋ hɛ daha ka ʋ bɩŋ na, ʋ jaŋ kpʋmɛ. Ama mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna to La TƖƖNA nɛ mɩ hambiriŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: Elijah said, “I'm a servant of the living Lord All-Powerful, and I swear in his name that I will meet with Ahab today.”
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja bʋl, “La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ weye wɩaa, nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ tɩma pɩpa, mɩ jaŋ sɛnɛ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa mʋ Ahab teeŋ jɩnɩŋ.” Ɩlaaja hɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kamɛl nyuŋ

english_verse: Obadiah left and told Ahab where to find Elijah. Ahab went to meet Elijah,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Obadaaya mʋ cheŋ Ahab a bʋla pʋ arɩ Ɩlaaja hɛ daha. Ahab mʋ dɩ ʋ naʋ.

english_verse: and when he saw him, Ahab shouted, “There you are, the biggest troublemaker in Israel!”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ na Ɩlaaja, ʋ pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ koo, Iziral tɩŋŋaa wʋhɛɛrʋ?”

english_verse: Elijah answered: You're the troublemaker—not me! You and your family have disobeyed the Lord's commands by worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ wɩɩkala hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋ dɩ ŋ nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa nɛ hɛ wɩaa. Ma nɛ vɩa wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ daga aŋ mʋ tuto vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal.

english_verse: Ahab got everyone together, then they went to meet Elijah on Mount Carmel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahab tɩma yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala arɩ veŋ-kpaara-la, ba kʋ hilimi peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kamɛl nyuŋ.

english_verse: Elijah stood in front of them and said, “How much longer will you try to have things both ways? If the Lord is God, worship him! But if Baal is God, worship him!” The people did not say a word.
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja mʋ chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ bʋl, “Ɛɛ nɛ maa chɛ dɩ ma diene magɛ aŋ joŋ wɩaa deemba balɩa kʋ-la sɩ maga dɩ ma to? Dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa Wɩa, má tou, ama dɩ Baal ma nɛ ŋaa Wɩa, má tou.” Ama nɩalɩŋ bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla.

english_verse: Bring us two bulls. Baal's prophets can take one of them, kill it, and cut it into pieces. Then they can put the meat on the wood without lighting the fire. I will do the same thing with the other bull, and I won't light a fire under it either.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ nɛ-belliŋ balɩa kʋ pɩla, dɩ Baal vʋgʋraa joŋ dɔŋɔ a kpʋ a kaa keri muno muno a daŋ daasɩŋ nyuŋ a sɩ́ nyiniŋ cholo hɛ. Mɩ ma jaŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ a kpʋ a ŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: The prophets of Baal will pray to their god, and I will pray to the Lord. The one who answers by starting the fire is God. “That's a good idea,” everyone agreed.
translation_verse: Baal veŋ-kpaaraa jaŋ sʋla yɩrɛ ba vene, dɩ mɩ ma yɩrɛ La TƖƖNA. Ba tʋɔŋ kʋ-la sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nyiniŋ kɔ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Elijah said to Baal's prophets, “There are more of you, so you go first. Pick out a bull and get it ready, but don't light the fire. Then pray to your god.”
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja bɩra bʋla pɩ Baal veŋ-kpaara-la, “Má laa sɩpaaŋ a bagɩsa lɩɩsɛ nɛ-belli-la dɔŋɔ a kpʋ, ma nɛ sɩ yʋga. Má sɩ́ nyiniŋ cholo hɛ, aŋ sʋla yɩrɛ ma vene.”

english_verse: They chose their bull, then they got it ready and prayed to Baal all morning, asking him to start the fire. They danced around the altar and shouted, “Answer us, Baal!” But there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kpʋ nɛ-bele-la ba sɩ lɩɩsa a bɩrɩmɛ, aŋ sʋla yɩrɛ ba vene Baal, a chɩŋ chʋchʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩhɛyɛ. Ba faasa ŋaa goŋ a bʋl “Baal, nɩɩ la yɩra.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba gʋa gugolli koru-la ba sɩ saa. Ama ba bɩ wɩɩkala nɩa.

english_verse: At noon, Elijah began making fun of them. “Pray louder!” he said. “Baal must be a god. Maybe he's daydreaming or using the toilet or traveling somewhere. Or maybe he's asleep, and you have to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩhɛyɛ Ɩlaaja suomo sisieri ba lɛ a bʋl, “Má faasa kpɩa, ʋ sɛnɛ ŋaa vene nɛ! Ŋ bɩ pɔ ʋ chaasaa bɩɩnɛ wɩaa nɛ, koo ʋʋ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ, koo ʋʋ vɛŋ wombiiŋ nɛ. Ŋ bɩ pɔ ʋ pɩŋ doŋ nɛ a magɛ dɩ ma chɩsʋ.”

english_verse: The prophets kept shouting louder and louder, and they cut themselves with swords and knives until they were bleeding. This was the way they worshiped,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra faasa kpɩa aŋ kɛŋ sɩɩsɩŋ arɩ tiŋŋee kikeri aŋ tʋtɔɔ ba tɩtɩa arɩ ba naabarɩŋ wombiiŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, chalɩŋ pɩpɛllɛ.

english_verse: and they kept it up until time for the evening sacrifice. But there was no answer of any kind.
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ deeŋ deeŋ a mʋ yi dɩdaanɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ŋaanɩŋ bʋa, aŋ bɩ wɩɩkala nɩa.

english_verse: Elijah told everyone to gather around him while he repaired the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɩlaaja bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala, “Má kɔ mɩ teeŋ daha.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɔ, ʋ wasa bɩrɩmɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la fa sɩ yɔrʋmɔ.

english_verse: Then he used twelve stones to build an altar in honor of the Lord. Each stone stood for one of the tribes of Israel, which was the name the Lord had given to their ancestor Jacob. Elijah dug a ditch around the altar, large enough to hold about
translation_verse: Tabɩa-la nɛ ʋ kaa saa koruŋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ, aŋ lu bʋa a gollu a magɛ lɩɩŋ galaŋ batori sɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ.

english_verse: He placed the wood on the altar, then they cut the bull into pieces and laid the meat on the wood. He told the people, “Fill four large jars with water and pour it over the meat and the wood.” After they did this,
translation_verse: Ʋ paa daasɩŋ a daŋ koru-la nyuŋ aŋ kɛŋ nɛ-bele-la keri muno muno a daŋ daasɩ-la nyuŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bʋla pɩba, “Má ŋaa lɩɩŋ su lonnuŋ banɛsɛ a bɩsa hɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ arɩ daasɩ-la lɛ.” Ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: he told them to do it two more times. They did exactly as he said
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Má bɩra ŋaa hɛ lɩa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋaa hɛ. Ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Má bɩra ŋaa hɛ tori.” Ba bɩra ŋaa hɛ tori.

english_verse: until finally, the water ran down the altar and filled the ditch.
translation_verse: Lɩɩŋ su koru-la kala a pɛllɛ tuu su bʋa-la sɩ golli koru-la.

english_verse: When it was time for the evening sacrifice, Elijah prayed: Our Lord, you are the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel. Now, prove that you are the God of this nation, and that I, your servant, have done this at your command.
translation_verse: Dɩdaanɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ bʋa sɩ yie, Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Ɩlaaja kʋ lɩɩ chɩŋ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb Wɩa, jɩnɩŋ leŋ dɩ ba jɩŋ arɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa a hɛ Iziral lɛ, a bɩra leŋ dɩ ba jɩŋ arɩ mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa, ŋ nɛ hɛmɛ.

english_verse: Please answer me, so these people will know that you are the Lord God, and that you will turn their hearts back to you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, leŋ dɩ nɩaa deemba jɩŋ arɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ba TƖƖNA, a ŋaa Wɩa, aŋ kɛŋ ba tʋɔŋ bɩrɩmɛ dɩ ba toŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord immediately sent fire, and it burned up the sacrifice, the wood, and the stones. It scorched the ground everywhere around the altar and dried up every drop of water in the ditch.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ nyiniŋ kʋ tuu joŋ Wɩɩ-sʋla kɩalɩŋ arɩ daasɩ-la arɩ tabɩa-la arɩ hagɩla kala dii, lɩɩ-la ma sɩ hɛ bʋa-la lɛ kala hʋ.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what had happened, they all bowed down and shouted, “The Lord is God! The Lord is God!”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ na wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ba tele chu tinteeŋ aŋ ŋmoo niiŋ a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA nɛ Wɩa! La TƖƖNA nɛ Wɩa!”

english_verse: Just then, Elijah said, “Grab the prophets of Baal! Don't let any of them get away.” So the people captured the prophets and took them to Kishon River, where Elijah killed every one of them. It Starts To Rain
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɩlaaja bʋl, “Má kɛsɛ Baal vʋgʋra-la kala. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba kʋŋkala fá viiri.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛsɛba. Ɩlaaja laaba a kaa tuu Kɩsɔŋ fuonaaŋ a kpʋba nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Elijah told Ahab, “Get something to eat and drink. I hear a heavy rain coming.”
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja bʋla pɩ Ahab, “Mʋ dii kɩaa, mɩ nɩɩ duoŋ-bal nɛ huuro a kʋkɔ.”

english_verse: Ahab left, but Elijah climbed back to the top of Mount Carmel. Then he stooped down with his face almost to the ground
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahab mʋ dɩ ʋ dii kɩaa, ka Ɩlaaja jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kamɛl nyuŋ, a tuu chugili a kɛŋ ʋ nyuŋ hɛ ʋ naadʋsʋŋ pɛgɛ.

english_verse: and said to his servant, “Look toward the sea.” The servant left. And when he came back, he said, “I looked, but I didn't see anything.” Elijah told him to look seven more times.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna, “Mʋ beŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.” Ʋ mʋ beŋ aŋ kʋ bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ kʋŋkala na.” Ɩlaaja leŋ ʋ vɛnɛ beŋ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ.

english_verse: After the seventh time the servant replied, “I see a small cloud coming this way. But it's no bigger than a fist.” Elijah told him, “Tell Ahab to get his chariot ready and start home now. Otherwise, the rain will stop him.”
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnnʋ-la mʋ beŋ pɛɩ lɛ aŋ mɩɩra kʋ bʋl, “Duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-bie nɛ lɩɩ chɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nyuŋ a magɛ nuhuobiine nɩsɩŋ.” Ɩlaaja bʋl, “Mʋ bʋla pɩ Ahab dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ jaaba toruko a viiri dɩ duonuŋ sɩ́ ʋ tɔ hɛ.”

english_verse: A few minutes later, it got very cloudy and windy, and rain started pouring down. So Elijah wrapped his coat around himself, and the Lord gave him strength to run all the way to Jezreel. Ahab followed in his chariot.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kʋ jʋʋ Ɩlaaja. Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛrɩŋ a vɔɔ ʋ tɩŋa, aŋ fá a laa Ahab sɩpaaŋ a mʋ Jɛzɩrɛl.

english_verse: Ahab told his wife Jezebel what Elijah had done and that he had killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Ahab bʋla pɩ ʋ haala Jɛzɛbɛl wɩalɩŋ kala Ɩlaaja sɩ ŋaa arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ kpʋ Baal vʋgʋra-la kala.

english_verse: She sent a message to Elijah: “You killed my prophets. Now I'm going to kill you! I pray that the gods will punish me even more severely if I don't do it by this time tomorrow.”
translation_verse: Jɛzɛbɛl tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Ɩlaaja, “Dɩ mɩ nɛ chie bɩŋ kpʋa bʋa deeŋ lɛ arɩ ŋ sɩ kpʋ Baal vʋgʋra-la ŋɩɩ, a leŋ dɩ mɩ vesiŋ dɔgɩsɛmɛ kɩŋkɛŋ.”

english_verse: Elijah was afraid when he got her message, and he ran to the town of Beersheba in Judah. He left his servant there,
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ Ɩlaaja, ʋ lɩɩ fá dɩ ʋ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Ʋ sɩ mʋ yi Bɛɛsɩba sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ leŋ ʋ tɩntɩnna ta nɩmɛ,

english_verse: then walked another whole day into the desert. Finally, he came to a large bush and sat down in its shade. He begged the Lord, “I've had enough. Just let me die! I'm no better off than my ancestors.”
translation_verse: aŋ tɩtɩa joŋ tapʋl bala a vɛnɛ mʋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ. Ʋ mʋ hɔŋ tɩa kʋbala bʋbʋɔŋ, aŋ sʋl Wɩa a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ʋ sʋʋ. Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ TƖƖNA, mɩ na hɛɛŋ magɛ nɛ, leŋ dɩ mɩ sʋʋ. Mɩ bɩ mɩ naabalɩmaba kɩɩ.”

english_verse: Then he lay down in the shade and fell asleep. Suddenly an angel woke him up and said, “Get up and eat.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ tuu pɩŋ tɩa-la bʋbʋɔŋ a joŋo pɩŋ doŋ. Wɩa tɩndaara guu kɔ ʋ teeŋ a digu aŋ bʋl, “Sii a dii kɩaa.”

english_verse: Elijah looked around, and by his head was a jar of water and some baked bread. He sat up, ate and drank, then lay down and went back to sleep.
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja sii bene golli lee-la, a na boroboro ba sɩ wasa nyiŋ-halaa lɛ arɩ loŋ arɩ lɩɩŋ dɩ ba chɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ. Ʋ joŋ kɩalɩŋ dii a nyʋa lɩɩ-la aŋ bɩra tuu pɩŋ.

english_verse: and he spent the night there in a cave. The Lord Appears to Elijah While Elijah was on Mount Sinai, the Lord asked, “Elijah, why are you here?”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mʋ yi nɩmɛ, ʋ jʋʋ chʋa bʋ-bʋa lɛ. La TƖƖNA pɩɛsʋ, “Ɩlaaja, bɛɛ nɛ ŋ ŋɩŋaa daha?”

english_verse: He answered, “Lord God All-Powerful, I've always done my best to obey you. But your people have broken their solemn promise to you. They have torn down your altars and killed all your prophets, except me. And now they are even trying to kill me!”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ TƖƖNA, doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, mɩ hɛ mɩ doluŋ kala nɛ a toŋ. Ama Iziral tɩŋŋaa vɩa nii-la sɩ hɛ ŋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ nɛ, aŋ ŋmoo ŋ korunuŋ lo, a kpʋ ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa. Mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ka, lɛɛlɛ baa nɛrɩgɛ dɩ ba kpʋ mɩ ma nɛ.”

english_verse: “Go out and stand on the mountain,” the Lord replied. “I want you to be there when I pass by.” All at once, a strong wind shook the mountain and shattered the rocks. But the Lord was not in the wind. Next, there was an earthquake, but the Lord was not in the earthquake.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Sii a lɩɩ chɩŋ peel-la nyuŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ kʋ to lee-la a bal.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ pel-duo bal kʋbala kʋ lu a yɛrɛ peele-la a kɛŋ tabɩaa pɩsa bal, ama La TƖƖNA fa tuo pel-la lɛ. Pel-la sɩ bala, tinteeŋ ma bɩra zigili, ama La TƖƖNA fa tuo tinteeŋ zigiline-la ma lɛ.

english_verse: Then there was a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. Finally, there was a gentle breeze,
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ sɩ zigile a bal, nyiniŋ chol, ama La TƖƖNA fa tuo nyiŋ-la lɛ. Nyiŋ-la ma sɩ cholo a bal, ʋ nɩɩ yikori fɩɛlɩ-bie.

english_verse: and when Elijah heard it, he covered his face with his coat. He went out and stood at the entrance to the cave. A voice asked, “Elijah, why are you here?”
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja sɩ nɩɩ yikori fɩɛlɩ-bie-la, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛrɩŋ tɔ ʋ sɩaa a lɩɩ chɩŋ bʋ-bʋa-la boiŋ niiŋ. Yikoro-la pɩɛsʋ, “Ɩlaaja, bɛɛ nɛ ŋ ŋɩŋaa daha?”

english_verse: Elijah answered, “Lord God All-Powerful, I've always done my best to obey you. But your people have broken their solemn promise to you. They have torn down your altars and killed all your prophets, except me. And now they are even trying to kill me!”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl, “La TƖƖNA, doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, mɩ hɛ mɩ doluŋ kala nɛ a toŋ. Ama Iziral tɩŋŋaa vɩa nii-la sɩ hɛ ŋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ nɛ, aŋ ŋmoo ŋ korunuŋ lo, a kpʋ ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa. Lɛɛlɛ, mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ka, ba nɩnɛrɩgɛ dɩ ba kpʋ mɩ ma.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Elijah, you can go back to the desert near Damascus. And when you get there, appoint Hazael to be king of Syria.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Ɩlaaja, “Mɩɩra joŋ wombii-la ŋ sɩ to kɔ, a mʋ to Damasɩkʋs tintee-hɩlɩŋ a jʋʋ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ yi nɩmɛ, joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ a tɩsɛ Hazɩɛl, a lɩɩsʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa Siiria tinteeŋ kuoro.

english_verse: Then appoint Jehu son of Nimshi to be king of Israel, and Elisha son of Shaphat to take your place as my prophet.
translation_verse: Bɩra joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ a tɩsɛ Nimisi nanʋala Jehu ma, dɩ ʋ ma ŋaa Iziral kuoro, aŋ lɩɩsɛ Safat nanʋala Elaasa sɩ lɩɩ Abɛl Mɛhɔla dɩ ʋ laa ŋ nyuŋ a ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ.

english_verse: Hazael will start killing the people who worship Baal. Jehu will kill those who escape from Hazael, and Elisha will kill those who escape from Jehu.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ wuo fori Hazɩɛl nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ bɩ ʋ kpʋa, Jehu-na jaŋ kpʋ tɩɩna. Dɩ nʋʋ ma nɛ wuo fori Jehu nɩsɩŋ lɛ, Elaasa jaŋ kpʋ tɩɩna.

english_verse: Elijah left and found Elisha plowing a field with a pair of oxen. There were eleven other men in front of him, and each one was also plowing with a pair of oxen. Elijah went over and put his own coat on Elisha.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɩlaaja lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ na Safat nanʋala Elaasa, dɩ ba kɛŋ nɛ-pɛrɛ bʋbʋɔ-bugoo fii arɩ balɩa a pɩpɛrɛ. Elaasa nɛ fa ŋaa fii arɩ balɩa tɩɩna a tuto ba harɩŋ. Ɩlaaja mʋ ʋ teeŋ a wuri ʋ gɛrɩ-balɩŋ a joŋo daŋ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Elisha stopped plowing and ran after him. “Let me kiss my parents goodbye, then I'll go with you,” he said. “You can go,” Elijah said. “But remember what I've done for you.”
translation_verse: Elaasa leŋ nɛ-pɛrɩɛ-la aŋ fá to Ɩlaaja harɩŋ. Ʋ sɩ, “Leŋ dɩ mɩ mʋ ta mɩ nyɩmma arɩ mɩ naaŋ, aŋ kɔ dɩ la mʋ.” Ɩlaaja bʋla pʋ, “Mɩɩra mʋ, ama liisi wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa ŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha left and took his oxen with him. He killed them and boiled them over a fire he had made with the wood from his plow. He gave the meat to the people who were with him, and they ate it. Then he left with Elijah and became his assistant.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elaasa mɩɩra mʋ, a kɛsɛ ʋ nɛ-pɛrɩɛ-la balɩa a kpʋ, aŋ kɛŋ daasɩ-la ʋ fa sɩ joŋo hɛ ba baŋŋaa a kaa hɛ nyiniŋ a chɔ nammɩa-la pɩ nɩalɩŋ ba chaŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka ʋ mɩɩra mʋ to Ɩlaaja harɩŋ a tɩma pʋpʋ.

english_verse: They dressed in sackcloth and put ropes on their heads, then they went to Ahab and said, “Your servant Benhadad asks you to let him live.” “Is he still alive?” Ahab asked. “Benhadad is like a brother to me.”
translation_verse: Ba paa tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ a vɔɔ ba tɩnsɩŋ aŋ paa ŋmɛsɩŋ ma vɔɔ ba nyusuŋ a mʋ Iziral kuoro Ahab teeŋ a bʋl, “Ŋ tɩntɩnna Bɛŋ-Hadad sɩ ʋʋ sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.” Iziral kuoro pɩɛsɛ, “Ʋ ha weye nɛɛ? Ʋ nagɛ mɩ naambii nɛ.”

english_verse: Benhadad sent a messenger to tell King Ahab of Israel,
translation_verse: Ʋ tɩŋ tɩndaaraa ba mʋ Iziral kuoro Ahab teeŋ a bʋl,

english_verse: “Your Majesty,” Ahab replied, “everything I have is yours, including me.”
translation_verse: Iziral kuoro bʋl, “Má bʋla pɩ kuoro Bɛŋ-Hadad mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, arɩ mɩ dɩ mɩ kɩaa kala ŋaa ʋ kɩaa nɛ.”

english_verse: Later, Benhadad sent another messenger to say to Ahab, “I already told you to give me your silver and gold, your wives, and your children.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra tɩŋ tɩndaara-la ba kɔ Ahab teeŋ a bʋl, “Mɩ tɩma ba bʋla pɩŋ dɩ ŋ joŋ ŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ ŋ haalaa arɩ ŋ biiriŋ pɩmɛ,

english_verse: But tomorrow at this time, I will send my officials into your city to search your palace and the houses of your officials. They will take everything else that you own.”
translation_verse: ama chie bʋa deeŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kʋ gbilli ŋ kuoru dɩa arɩ ŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ dɩɩsɩŋ kala. Ba jaŋ paa ma kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ kala a kaa viiri.”

english_verse: “Don't listen to him!” they answered. “You don't have to do what he says.”
translation_verse: Nɩhɩasɩ-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala bʋl, “Sɩ́ ʋ teeŋ jegilu, sɩ́ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ŋaa.”

english_verse: So Ahab sent someone to tell Benhadad, “Your Majesty, I'll give you my silver and gold, and even my wives and children. But I won't let you have anything else.” When Benhadad got his answer,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ Bɛŋ-Hadad tɩndaara-la, “Má mʋ bʋla pɩ kuoro mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, arɩ mɩ-na ʋ tɩntɩnna sɛɩ bumbuŋ wɩɩ-la nɛ, ama wʋlɩa-la-na, mɩ bɩ sɛyɛ.” Ba kɛŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla mɩɩra mʋ bʋla pɩ Bɛŋ-Hadad.

english_verse: he replied, “I'll completely destroy Samaria! There won't even be enough of it left for my soldiers to carry back in their hands. If I don't do it, I pray that the gods will punish me terribly.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Bɛŋ-Hadad bɩra tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Ahab, “Mɩ jaŋ chei Samarɩa kala. Ʋ mʋa-la sɩ jaŋ ka bɩ jaŋ su mɩ laalɩyuoroo nɩsɩŋ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, a leŋ dɩ mɩ vesiŋ faasa dɔgɩsɛmɛ.”

english_verse: Ahab then answered, “Benhadad, don't brag before the fighting even begins. Wait and see if you live through it.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral kuoro bʋl, “Má bʋla pɩ kuoro Bɛŋ-hadad, arɩ laalɩyuoro yie bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ yuo dii nɛ, ama bʋa-la lɛ ʋ ha sɩ bɩ yuo dii lɛ dee.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, Benhadad and the other kings had been drinking in their tents. But when Ahab's reply came, he ordered his soldiers to prepare to attack Samaria, and they all got ready.
translation_verse: Bɛŋ-Hadad ka nɩɩ tɩndaarɩŋ deeŋ, dɩ ʋ dɩ kuorusu-la sɩ kʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ hɛ ba lɛŋŋɛɛ tʋɔŋ nɛ a nyʋnyʋa kɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo arɩ ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a mʋ yuo taŋ-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba mʋ yuo taŋ-la. Kuoro Ahab yuo dii kuoro Bɛŋ-Hadad

english_verse: At that very moment, a prophet ran up to Ahab and said, “You can see that Benhadad's army is very strong. But the Lord has promised to help you defeat them today. Then you will know that the Lord is in control.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ dɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ kɔ Iziral kuoro Ahab teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Ŋ na laalɩyuori daŋ deeŋ nɛɛ? Mɩ jaŋ jomba a hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ jɩnɩŋ, dɩ ŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa ŋ Tɩɩna.’ ”

english_verse: “Who will fight the battle?” Ahab asked. The prophet answered, “The young bodyguards who serve the district officials.” “But who will lead them into battle?” Ahab asked. “You will!” the prophet replied.
translation_verse: Ahab pɩɛsɛ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ mʋ yuo laalɩŋ deeŋ?” Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la bʋl, “Laalɩyuori bapʋɔsɛ biisi-la sɩɩ tɩgɛ Iziral tinteeŋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ lɛ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la.” Ʋ bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ laa ba sɩpaaŋ?” Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la bɩra bʋl, “Ŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: At noon, King Ahab and his Israelite army marched out of Samaria, with the young soldiers in front. King Benhadad of Syria and the
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori bapʋɔsɛ biisi-la sɩɩ tɩgɛ Iziral tinteeŋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ lɛ nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ mʋ. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ dɩ Bɛŋ-Hadad ma hɛ nɩaa dɩ ba lɩɩ bee na ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Ba beŋ aŋ kʋ bʋla pʋ, “Laalɩyuoroo nɛ lɩɩ Samarɩa a kʋkɔ.”

english_verse: “Take them alive!” Benhadad ordered. “I don't care if they have come out to fight or to surrender.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Dɩ ba fɩɛla nɛ ba kʋkɔ koo dɩ baa kɔ dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ nɛ, má kɛsɛba.”

english_verse: and each of them attacked and killed an enemy soldier. The rest of the Syrian army turned and ran, and the Israelites went after them. Benhadad and some others escaped on horses,
translation_verse: Ba kʋŋkala mʋ yuo a kpʋ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ yuo. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Siiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo fá, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kire to ba harɩŋ. Ama Siiria kuoro Bɛŋ-Hadad arɩ ʋ ja-jɩllaa dɔnsʋŋ-na paa ba janɩŋ a fá viiri.

english_verse: but Ahab and his soldiers followed them and captured their horses and chariots. Ahab and Israel's army crushed the Syrians.
translation_verse: Iziral kuoro arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kire kɛsɛ Siiria tɩmma-la arɩ ba janɩŋ arɩ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba kala a chaasa kpʋba.

english_verse: Later, the prophet went back and warned Ahab, “Benhadad will attack you again next spring. Build up your troops and make sure you have some good plans.” Syria Attacks Israel Again
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la kɔ Iziral kuoro Ahab teeŋ a bʋl, “Mʋ a kɛŋ ŋ laalɩyuoroo hɛ dɔŋɔ woruŋ, aŋ chɛ wombiiŋ ma sɩ jaŋ to, bɛɛ wɩaa harɩŋ jɩna tafaaŋ lɛ Siiria kuoro jaŋ bɩra mɩɩra kʋ yuoma.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, Benhadad's officials went to him and explained: Israel's gods are mountain gods. We fought Israel's army in the hills, and that's why they defeated us. But if we fight them on flat land, there's no way we can lose.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Siiria kuoro tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ bʋla pʋ, “Iziral tɩŋŋaa vesiŋ ŋaa peelee nyuŋ vesi nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba wuola ŋɩɩ. Ama dɩ la nɛ yuoba tintee-taala lɛ, la jaŋ wuoba.

english_verse: Then get more soldiers, horses, and chariots, so your army will be as strong as it was before. We'll fight Israel's army on flat land and wipe them out. Benhadad agreed and did what they suggested.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra maga dɩ ŋ chɛ laalɩyuoroo arɩ janɩŋ arɩ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba dɩ ba yʋga magɛ faafaa kɩalɩŋ. La jaŋ yuo Iziral tɩmma-la tintee-taala lɛ, bʋa deeŋ-na lɛ la jaŋ wuoba.” Bɛŋ-Hadad sɛɩ ba niiŋ a ŋaa ŋɩɩ ba sɩ daga.

english_verse: In the spring, Benhadad got his army together, and they marched to the town of Aphek to attack Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ jɩna bɩra kʋ yi tafaaŋ, Bɛŋ-Hadad yɩrɛ Siiria tɩŋŋaa kala ba jɩl taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Afɛk, dɩ ba yuo Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: The prophet went to Ahab and said, “The Syrians think the Lord is a god of the hills and not of the valleys. So he has promised to help you defeat their powerful army. Then you will know that the Lord is in control.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la kɔ Iziral kuoro teeŋ a bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘A tɩŋ Siiria tɩŋŋaa sɩ bɩɩna arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA ŋaa peelee nyuŋ vene nɛ, aŋ bɩ tintee-taala-na vene ŋaa wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ joŋ ba laalɩyuori daŋ deeŋ kala a hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA.’ ”

english_verse: For seven days the two armies stayed in their camps, facing each other. Then on the seventh day the fighting broke out, and before sunset the Israelites had killed
translation_verse: Ba ŋmoo ba bugoo a hɔnɔ chaasa dɔŋɔ ŋɩɩ nɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ nɛ laalɩŋ suomi. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kpʋ Siiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ zɔlɔ tapʋlɩɩ-la.

english_verse: The rest of the Syrian army ran back to Aphek, but the town wall fell and crushed
translation_verse: Ba kʋkaanaa fá mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Afɛk. Nɩmɛ nɛ jeeŋ tele kpʋ ba ma nɩaa bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩpɛ. Bɛŋ-Hadad ma fá jʋʋ taŋ-la, a jʋʋ faa dɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: His officials said, “Your Majesty, we've heard that Israel's kings keep their agreements. We will wrap sackcloth around our waists, put ropes around our heads, and ask Ahab to let you live.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ bʋla pʋ, “La nɩa arɩ Iziral kuoroo ka fá nɩaa nenige nɛ. Leŋ dɩ la paa tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ vɔɔ la tɩnsɩŋ aŋ paa ŋmɛsɩŋ ma a vɔɔ la nyusuŋ a mʋ ʋ teeŋ. Ŋ bɩ pɔ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: Benhadad's officials were trying to figure out what Ahab was thinking, and when he said “brother,” they quickly replied, “You're right! You and Benhadad are like brothers.” “Go get him,” Ahab said. When Benhadad came out, Ahab had him climb up into his chariot.
translation_verse: Bɛŋ-Hadad tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la joŋ wɩɩ-la arɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ. Ba guu cheme laa Ahab niiŋ lɛ a bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, Bɛŋ-Hadad ŋaa ŋ naambii nɛ.” Kuoro bɩra bʋl, “Má mʋ kɛnʋ kaa kɔ.” Bɛŋ-Hadad sɩ kʋ lɩɩ, Ahab ŋaa ʋ jʋʋ ʋ laalɩŋ jaaba toruko.

english_verse: Benhadad said, “I'll give back the towns my father took from your father. And you can have shops in Damascus, just as my father had in Samaria.” Ahab replied, “If you do these things, I'll let you go free.” Then they signed a peace treaty, and Ahab let Benhadad go. A Prophet Condemns Ahab
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Bɛŋ-Hadad bʋla pʋ, “Tasɩ-la kala mɩ nyɩmma sɩ yuo laa ŋ nyɩmma teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra joŋo pɩŋ. Ŋ jaŋ wuo bil ŋ tɩtɩa yɔbɔ Damasɩkʋs lɛ, arɩ mɩ nyɩmma sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Samarɩa lɛ.” Ahab ma bʋl, “See dɩ la hɛ niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ, ka dɩ mɩ-na joŋuŋ ta.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ hɛ niiŋ pʋ, aŋ leŋ ʋ viiri. Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla bʋl kuoro Ahab teeŋ

english_verse: About this time the Lord commanded a prophet to say to a friend, “Hit me!” But the friend refused,
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ lɛ dɩ La TƖƖNA leŋe ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa dɔŋɔ bʋla pɩ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, “Ŋmoomi.” Ʋ dɔŋɔ-la vɩa.

english_verse: and the prophet told him, “You disobeyed the Lord, and as soon as you walk away, a lion will kill you.” The friend left, and suddenly a lion killed him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la bɩra bʋl, “A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa, dɩ ŋ nɛ lemmi aŋ viviiri, naachigiŋ jaŋ kpʋŋ.” Baal-la sɩ leŋu aŋ viviiri, naachigiŋ naʋ a kpʋʋ.

english_verse: The prophet found someone else and said, “Hit me!” So this man beat him up.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la bɩra na baala dɔŋɔ ma a bʋl, “Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, ŋmoomi.” Baal-la ŋmobu bolimi.

english_verse: The prophet left and put a bandage over his face to disguise himself. Then he went and stood beside the road, waiting for Ahab to pass by.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la joŋ nyu-bɛlɛ vɔɔ tɔ ʋ sɩaa dɩ nɩaa sɩ́ ʋ jɩŋ, a lɩɩ chɩŋ wombiiŋ lɛ aa gbɛrɛ kuoro.

english_verse: When Ahab went by, the prophet shouted, “Your Majesty, right in the heat of battle, someone brought a prisoner to me and told me to guard him. He said if the prisoner got away, I would either be killed or forced to pay
translation_verse: Kuoro sɩ kʋʋ bal, ʋ yɩrʋ a bʋl, “Mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna hɛ laalɩŋ sɩ hoso tʋɔŋ nɛ, nʋʋ kɛŋ baal ʋ sɩ yuo kɛŋ laalɩŋ lɛ kaa kʋ pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ pɔ, aŋ bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ mɩ nɛ leŋe dɩ ʋ lɛl, mɩ jaŋ sʋʋ koo mɩ jaŋ tiŋ chɩmɩŋ warɩpʋla bʋɩ batori.

english_verse: But I got busy doing other things, and the prisoner escaped.” Ahab answered, “You will be punished just as you have said.”
translation_verse: Mɩ fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa, ka baal-la fá lɛl.” Iziral kuoro Ahab sɩ, “Ŋ dii ŋ tɩtɩa sarɩya nɛ, ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ bʋla nɛ ba jaŋ ŋaaŋ.”

english_verse: The man quickly tore the bandage off his face, and Ahab saw that he was one of the prophets.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la guu kɛŋ nyu-bɛlɛ-la sɩ tɔ ʋ sɩaa kaa suri, Iziral kuoro naʋ a jɩŋ arɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The prophet said, “The Lord told you to kill Benhadad, but you let him go. Now you will die in his place, and your people will die in place of his people.”
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la bʋla pɩ kuoro, “La TƖƖNA sɩ, ‘Ŋ joŋ nʋʋ ʋ sɩ sɩ dɩ ŋ kpʋ ta nɛ ʋ viiri. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ŋ jaŋ mɩɩra laa ʋ nyuŋ a sʋʋ, dɩ ŋ nɩaa ma laa ʋ nɩaa nyuŋ a sʋʋ.’ ”

english_verse: Ahab went back to Samaria, angry and depressed.
translation_verse: Iziral kuoro Ahab tʋɔŋ chei. Ʋ na baanɩŋ a mɩɩra mʋ ʋ jaŋ Samarɩa.

english_verse: Naboth owned a vineyard in Jezreel near King Ahab's palace.
translation_verse: Nabɔf fa kɛŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga nɛ Jɛzɩrɛl lɛ a kpagɛ Ahab kuoru dɩa sɩ hɛ Samarɩa lɛ.

english_verse: One day, Ahab said, “Naboth, your vineyard is near my palace. Give it to me so I can turn it into a vegetable garden. I'll give you a better vineyard or pay whatever you want for yours.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala, Ahab bʋla pɩ Nabɔf, “Joŋ ŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga-la sɩ kpagɛ mɩ dɩa pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ chɔnsɛ dɩ-pɩpaarɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ lee sɩ zɔmɔ kɩɩʋ a pɩŋ. Koo dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ, mɩ jaŋ tiŋ magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ yalɩŋ sɩ maga pɩŋ.”

english_verse: Naboth answered, “This vineyard has always been in my family. I won't let you have it.”
translation_verse: Ama Nabɔf bʋla pɩ Ahab, “Wɩa bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a joŋ mɩ naabalɩma dʋa a pɩŋ.”

english_verse: So Ahab went home, angry and depressed because of what Naboth had told him. He lay on his bed, just staring at the wall and refusing to eat a thing.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahab kɛŋ sɩaa chei, a na baanɩŋ a mɩɩra jʋʋ dɩa a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la Nabɔf Jɛzɩrɛl tɩɩna-la sɩ bʋla pʋ. Ʋ vɩa kʋdiilee aŋ jʋʋ pɩŋ ʋ bɔsɔ lɛ a dɩdɩɩsɛ chosuŋ.

english_verse: Jezebel his wife came in and asked, “What's wrong? Why won't you eat?”
translation_verse: Ʋ haala Jɛzɛbɛl kɔ a pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ kɛŋ sɩaa chei? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ vɩa kʋdiilee?”

english_verse: “I asked Naboth to sell me his vineyard or to let me give him a better one,” Ahab replied. “And he told me I couldn't have it.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ bʋla pɩ Nabɔf Jɛzɩrɛl tɩɩna-la nɛ arɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga yalla pɩmɛ koo dɩ ʋ nɩɩ chɛ ʋ leŋ mɩ pʋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga dɔŋɔ, ʋ vɩa.”

english_verse: “Aren't you the king of Israel?” Jezebel asked. “Get out of bed and eat something! Don't worry, I'll get Naboth's vineyard for you.”
translation_verse: Ʋ haala Jɛzɛbɛl pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ-la nɛ maga dɩ Iziral kuoro ŋaa? Sii dii kɩaa a leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Mɩ jaŋ laa Nabɔf Jɛzɩrɛl tɩɩna-la baga-la a pɩŋ.”

english_verse: After receiving her letters, they did exactly what she had asked.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩhɩasɩ-la arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la sɩ hɛ Nabɔf jaŋ lɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa Jɛzɛbɛl sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ tenni-la lɛ.

english_verse: They told the people that it was a day to go without eating, and when they all came together, they seated Naboth at the front.
translation_verse: Ba hɛ tapʋlʋŋ a heele pɩ nʋʋkala dɩ ba vɔɔ niiŋ, aŋ kɛŋ Nabɔf mʋ ʋ hɔŋ nɩbalaa dɩhɔnʋŋ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The two liars came in and sat across from Naboth. Then they accused him of cursing God and the king, so the people dragged Naboth outside and stoned him to death.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ lɩɩsɛ wʋnyɩɛraa balɩa sɩ jaŋ wuo chei nɩaa yɩrɩŋ, ba hɔŋ a chaasɛ Nabɔf, a nyɩɛ wɩaa pʋ a bʋl, “Nabɔf tʋʋsɛ Wɩa arɩ kuoro joŋŋoo nɛ.” Ba kɛnʋ lɛrɛ lɩɩ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ a yagʋ kpʋ arɩ tabɩaa.

english_verse: The leaders of Jezreel sent a message back to Jezebel that said, “Naboth is dead.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tɩma pɩ Jɛzɛbɛl, “La yagɛ Nabɔf kpʋ nɛ arɩ tabɩaa.”

english_verse: As soon as Jezebel got their message, she told Ahab, “Now you can have the vineyard Naboth refused to sell. He's dead.”
translation_verse: Jɛzɛbɛl sɩ nɩɩ tɩndaarɩɩ-la, ʋ bʋla pɩ Ahab, “Joŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga-la, Nabɔf, Jɛzɩrɛl tɩɩna-la fa sɩ vɩa dɩ ʋ joŋo yalla pɩŋ. Ʋ tuo ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Ahab got up and went to take over the vineyard. Elijah Condemns Ahab
translation_verse: Ahab sɩ nɩa dɩ Nabɔf sʋba, ʋ sii mʋ dɩ ʋ laa baga-la tɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Elijah the prophet,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Ɩlaaja, Tisibi tɩɩna-la:

english_verse: “King Ahab of Israel is in Naboth's vineyard right now, taking it over.
translation_verse: “Sii mʋ Iziral kuoro Ahab sɩ hɛ Samarɩa lɛ teeŋ. Ʋ mʋ Nabɔf girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga-la leriŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ laaʋ tɩɩ.

english_verse: Go tell him that I say, ‘Ahab, you murdered Naboth and took his property. And so, in the very spot where dogs licked up Naboth's blood, they will lick up your blood.’ ” When Elijah found him,
translation_verse: Bʋla pʋ arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ, ‘Ŋ kpʋ nʋʋ nɛ aŋ laa ʋ dʋa. Lee-la vasɩŋ sɩ lenni Nabɔf chalɩŋ, nɩmɛ nɛ vasɩŋ jaŋ lenni ŋ ma chalɩŋ.’ ”

english_verse: Ahab said, “So, my enemy, you found me at last.” Elijah answered: Yes, I did! Ahab, you have managed to do everything the Lord hates.
translation_verse: Ahab na Ɩlaaja a bʋl, “Mɩ nɛ ŋ kɛŋ ŋ-la mɩ dʋndɔŋ.” Ɩlaaja bʋl, “Oo mɩ kɛnɩŋ nɛ, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la La TƖƖNA sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Now you will be punished. You and every man and boy in your family will die, whether slave or free.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ wʋlɔrʋŋ kʋ hɛ ŋ lɛ, a kpʋ ŋ dɩ ŋ doho nɩaa baalaa kala Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, yosuŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ yosi ŋaa.

english_verse: Your whole family will be wiped out, just like the families of King Jeroboam and King Baasha. You've made the Lord very angry by sinning and causing the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ dɩa nagɛ Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam dɩa arɩ Ahija nanʋala Baasa dɩa, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la a leŋ mɩ baanɩŋ sii.

english_verse: And as for Jezebel, dogs will eat her body there in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Ŋ la nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl a tɩgɛ Jɛzɛbɛl lɛ: ‘Vasɩŋ jaŋ diiu Jɛzɩrɛl jeeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Dogs will also eat the bodies of your relatives who die in town, and vultures will eat the bodies of those who die in the country.
translation_verse: Ŋ naambiiri-la sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ jaŋ tʋɔŋ, vasɩŋ jaŋ diiba, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ gɩrɩŋ lɛ, zaaraa nɛ jaŋ diiba.’ ”

english_verse: Tell them to put him in prison and to give him nothing but bread and water until I come back safely.”
translation_verse: Má bʋla pɩba arɩ ba laaʋ tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa a pʋpʋ boroboro mʋa mʋa arɩ lɩɩŋ dʋndʋŋ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.”

english_verse: Ahab asked his officials, “Why haven't we tried to get Ramoth in Gilead back from the Syrians? It belongs to us.”
translation_verse: Iziral kuoro fa pɩɛsɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, “Ma jɩma la nɛ tɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ramɔf Gɩlɩad, ama bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ la bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa dɩ la laaʋ Siiria kuoro teeŋ?”

english_verse: Then he asked Jehoshaphat, “Would you go to Ramoth with me and attack the Syrians?” “Just tell me what to do,” Jehoshaphat answered. “My army and horses are at your command.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛ Jehosafat, “Ŋ jaŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ la mʋ yuo Ramɔf Gɩlɩad?” Jehosafat bʋla pɩ Iziral kuoro, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ, mɩ dɩ mɩ nɩaa arɩ mɩ janɩŋ ma kɛŋ la tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But first, let's ask the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ama leŋ dɩ la laa sɩpaaŋ pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA na.”

english_verse: But Jehoshaphat said, “Just to make sure, is there another of the Lord's prophets we can ask?”
translation_verse: Jehosafat bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “La TƖƖNA wʋlaabʋllʋ tuo daha dɩ la to ʋ lɛ a pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA naa?”

english_verse: Then Ahab sent someone to bring Micaiah as soon as possible.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahab yɩrɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ dɔŋɔ a bʋl, “Mʋ kɛŋ Imila nanʋala Mɩkaaya kɔ daha lɛɛlɛ.”

english_verse: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria. They were listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Ka Iziral kuoro arɩ Juda kuoro Jehosafat kala laalɛ ba kuori gɛnnɩŋ a hɔŋ ba kuoru kpasɩnɩŋ lɛ taha-la sɩ kpagɛ Samarɩa taŋ-la boi-baalɩŋ niiŋ. Wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la chɩŋ ba sɩpaaŋ a bʋbʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, “Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out!”
translation_verse: Wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Zedikaaya, a ŋaa Kɛnaana nanʋala. Ʋ fa kɛŋ hɔɔŋ libi banyilliŋ nɛ, ʋ kaa heele bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Kɩaa deemba nɛ ŋ jaŋ kaa tɩɩgɛ Siiria tɩŋŋaa kala kpʋ.’ ”

english_verse: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth, and they promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.
translation_verse: Wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la kʋkaanaa ma kala bʋl ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa. Ba sɩ, “Mʋ yuo Ramɔf Gɩlɩad, ŋ jaŋ yuo diiu, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋu hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la ba sɩ tɩma dɩ ʋ yɩrɛ Mɩkaaya bʋla pʋ, “Na, Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la bʋl wʋbala nɛ. Ba sɩ, ‘Kuoro jaŋ yuo dii.’ Dɩ ŋ nɛ mʋa, ŋ ma chɩŋ ba kʋa lɛ a bʋl ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa.”

english_verse: “I'll say whatever the living Lord tells me to say,” Micaiah replied.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mɩkaaya bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ weye wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla, ʋ nɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋl.”

english_verse: Then Micaiah went to Ahab, and Ahab asked, “Micaiah, should I attack the Syrians at Ramoth?” “Yes!” Micaiah answered. “The Lord will help you defeat them.”
translation_verse: Mɩkaaya sɩ kɔ, kuoro Ahab pɩɛsʋ, “La mʋ yuo taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ramɔf Gɩlɩad koo la sɩ́ mʋ?” Ʋ bʋl, “Má mʋ yuou. La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋu hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: “Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth!” Ahab shouted. “What does the Lord really say?”
translation_verse: Kuoro Ahab bɩra pɩɛsʋ, “Naansɩɩŋ bʋŋmɛɛ nɛ maga dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋmɩɛsɛ aŋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ pɩmɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ?”

english_verse: He answered, “In a vision I saw Israelite soldiers walking around in the hills like sheep without a shepherd to guide them. The Lord said, ‘This army has no leader. They should go home and not fight.’ ”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mɩkaaya bʋl, “Mɩ na Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala dɩ ba pɩsa su dundolluŋ nyuŋ, a nagɛ piesee sɩ bɩ pie-daara kɛnɛ, ka La TƖƖNA bʋl, ‘Nɩaa deemba bɩ sɩpaalaarʋ kɛnɛ. Leŋ dɩ ba mɩɩra mʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.’ ”

english_verse: Micaiah replied: Listen to this! I also saw the Lord seated on his throne with every creature in heaven gathered around him.
translation_verse: Mɩkaaya bɩra bʋl, “Má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla: Mɩ na La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ, ka ʋ tɩndaaraa kala chɩna gollu, ʋ nadiiŋ arɩ ʋ nagʋa.

english_verse: This is exactly what has happened, Ahab. The Lord made all your prophets lie to you, and he knows you will soon be destroyed.
translation_verse: Mɩkaaya bʋl, “La TƖƖNA joŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ dɩma hɛ nɩaa deemba kala sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩŋ niiŋ lɛ nɛ. La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa bʋla arɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ jaŋ jʋʋŋ.”

english_verse: Zedekiah walked up to Micaiah and slapped him on the face. Then he asked, “Do you really think the Lord would speak to you and not to me?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zedikaaya sɩ ŋaa Kɛnaana nanʋala mʋ fallɛ Mɩkaaya, aŋ pɩɛsʋ, “Bʋa bɛɛ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA dɩma-la lɩɩ mɩ lɛ, a kɔ ŋ teeŋ a bʋl wɩaa pɩŋ?”

english_verse: Ahab shouted, “Arrest Micaiah! Take him to Prince Joash and Governor Amon of Samaria.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Ahab bʋl, “Má kɛŋ Mɩkaaya mɩɩra mʋ taŋ nɩhɩaŋ Amɔŋ arɩ mɩ nanʋala Jʋas teeŋ.

english_verse: However, during the fighting a soldier shot an arrow without even aiming, and it hit Ahab where two pieces of his armor joined. He shouted to his chariot driver, “I've been hit! Get me out of here!”
translation_verse: Laal-la tʋɔŋ, laalɩyuoro-la dɔŋɔ yuo to-hɛmɩŋ bine, ʋ to Ahab laalɩyuori gɛrɩŋ pɛgɛ a jʋʋ kɛnʋ. Ʋ bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ toruko vɩvɛŋ, “Mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ a kɛmmɛ lɩɩ laal-la tʋɔŋ, ba bolimimi nɛ.”

english_verse: Ahab and Jehoshaphat led their armies to Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral kuoro arɩ Juda kuoro Jehosafat sii kɛŋ ba laalɩyuoroo mʋ dɩ ba yuo Ramɔf Gɩlɩad.

english_verse: Before they went into battle, Ahab said, “Jehoshaphat, I'll disguise myself, but you wear your royal robe.” Then Ahab disguised himself and went into battle.
translation_verse: Iziral kuoro bʋla pɩ Jehosafat, “Dɩ laalɩŋ nɛ suomo, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa bɩrɩmɛ a jʋʋ laalɩŋ tʋɔŋ, ama ŋ-na laalɛ ŋ kuoru gɛnnɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral kuoro kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa bɩrɩmɛ a jʋʋ laal-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: So when they saw Jehoshaphat in his robe, they thought he was Ahab and started to attack him. But when Jehoshaphat shouted out to them,
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩ na Jehosafat, ba bɩɩnɛ a bʋl, “Iziral kuoro Ahab nɛ ŋ-la.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩrɩmɛ dɩ ba yuou. Ama Jehosafat ŋmoo niiŋ.

english_verse: they realized he wasn't Ahab, and they left him alone.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩ na dɩ Iziral kuoro dee, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba leŋu.

english_verse: As the sun was going down, someone in Israel's army shouted to the others, “Retreat! Go back home!”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-muluŋ sɩɩŋ sɩ tuu jʋjʋʋ, Iziral laalɩyuoro dɔŋɔ heele bʋl, “Nʋʋkala mɩɩra mʋ ʋ jaŋ.”

english_verse: Ahab's body was taken to Samaria and buried there.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ kuoro Ahab kʋsʋʋŋ a kaa mʋ Samarɩa, a hugu nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Some workers washed his chariot near a spring in Samaria, and prostitutes washed themselves in his blood. Dogs licked Ahab's blood off the ground, just as the Lord had warned.
translation_verse: Ka ba kɛŋ toruko-la tuu chɛsɛ Samarɩa fuoŋ lɛ . Vasɩŋ lenni ʋ chalɩŋ, arɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Everything else Ahab did while he was king, including the towns he strengthened and the palace he built and furnished with ivory, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Ahab sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, a pɛ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ batu-nyɩlaa kpɩɛrɛ ʋ kuoru dɩa arɩ tasɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli nɛ, ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Iziral kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Ahab died, and his son Ahaziah became king. King Jehoshaphat of Judah (
translation_verse: Ahab sɩ sʋba, ʋ nanʋala Ahazɩa nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ. Jehosafat dii Juda kuoruŋ

english_verse: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king of Judah in Ahab's fourth year as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Ahab sɩ dii kuoruŋ Iziral lɛ, ʋ jɩ-nɛsɛ lɛ nɛ Asa nanʋala Jehosafat ma dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The country of Edom had no king at the time, so a lower official ruled the land.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ fa bɩ kuoro kɛnɛ, ka ba leŋ kuoro tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ dɔŋɔ bibeŋ lee-la.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat had seagoing ships built to sail to Ophir for gold. But they were wrecked at Ezion-Geber and never sailed.
translation_verse: Dɩ Jehosafat fa leŋe lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ mʋmʋ Ofi dɩ ba chʋŋ sɛlɩmɛ, a mʋ chei lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛzɩɔŋ-Geba lɛ a bɩra bɩ vɛnɛ.

english_verse: Ahaziah son of Ahab offered to let his sailors go with Jehoshaphat's sailors, but Jehoshaphat refused.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ kuoro Ahab nanʋala Ahazɩa bʋla pɩ Jehosafat, “Leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa ma pɛ ŋ lɩɩŋ daborusu-la tɩntɩnnaa lɛ dɩ ba mʋ.” Ama Jehosafat bɩ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoram became king. King Ahaziah of Israel
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehosafat sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi Devit tabal-la lɛ ʋ naabalɩmaba tʋɔŋ. Ka ʋ nanʋala Jehoram dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. Ahazɩa dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ

english_verse: Ahaziah son of Ahab became king of Israel in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat's rule in Judah, and he ruled two years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Jehosafat sɩ dii kuoruŋ Juda lɛ, ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ balɩpɛ lɛ nɛ Ahab nanʋala Ahazɩa dii Iziral kuoruŋ a hɔŋ Samarɩa lɛ, a beŋ Iziral jɩsɩŋ balɩa.

english_verse: Ahaziah disobeyed the Lord, just as his father, his mother, and Jeroboam had done. They all led Israel to sin.
translation_verse: Ahazɩa fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ arɩ Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam sɩ ŋaa nɛ a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Ahaziah worshiped Baal and made the Lord God of Israel very angry, just as his father had done.
translation_verse: Ʋ faa to vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal nɛ, a leŋ La TƖƖNA Iziral Wɩa baanɩŋ chaasa sii arɩ ʋ nyɩmma fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Soon after King Ahab of Israel died, the country of Moab rebelled against his son King Ahaziah. One day, Ahaziah fell through the wooden slats around the porch on the flat roof of his palace in Samaria, and he was badly injured. So he sent some messengers to the town of Ekron with orders to ask the god Baalzebub if he would get well.
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ Iziral kuoro Ahazɩa lɩɩ ʋ lusuŋ nyuŋ a tuu tele bolimi woruŋ Samarɩa lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ tɩŋ nɩaa a bʋla pɩba, “Má mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛkʋrɔŋ a pɩɛsɛ ba vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal Zebub a na mɩ jaŋ duori?”

english_verse: About the same time, an angel from the Lord sent Elijah the prophet from Tishbe to say to the king's messengers, “Ahaziah has rejected Israel's own God by sending you to ask Baalzebub about his injury.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa tɩndaara kʋbala kʋ bʋla pɩ Ɩlaaja, Tisibi tɩɩna-la, “Sii mʋ cheŋ Samarɩa kuoro tɩndaara-la a pɩɛsɛba, ‘Wɩa tuo Iziral lɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma mʋmʋ dɩ ma chɛ na wɩaa Ɛkʋrɔŋ tɩŋŋaa vene Baal Zebub teeŋ koo?’

english_verse: Tell him that because he has done this, he's on his deathbed!” And Elijah did what he was told.
translation_verse: Má mʋ bʋla pɩ kuoro Ahazɩa arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ ʋ bɩ jaŋ duori, ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɩlaaja mʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pʋ.

english_verse: When the messengers returned to Ahaziah, he asked, “Why are you back so soon?”
translation_verse: Tɩndaara-la sɩ mɩɩra kɔ kuoro teeŋ, ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma mɩɩrɛ ŋɩɩ lɩma?”

english_verse: “A man met us along the road with a message for you from the Lord,” they answered. “The Lord wants to know why you sent us to ask Baalzebub about your injury and why you don't believe there's a God in Israel. The man also told us that the Lord says you're going to die.”
translation_verse: Ba bʋla pʋ, “Baal kʋbala nɛ kʋ cheŋ la, a bʋla pɩla arɩ la mɩɩra kʋ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ tɩnla dɩ la mʋ Ɛkʋrɔŋ tɩŋŋaa vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal Zebub teeŋ a chɛ na wɩaa? Ŋ bɩɩna Wɩa tuo Iziral lɛ nɛ koo? A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ duori, ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ.’ ”

english_verse: “What did the man look like?” Ahaziah asked.
translation_verse: Kuoro pɩɛsɛba, “Ɛɛ nɛ baal-la nagɛ?”

english_verse: “He was hairy and had a leather belt around his waist,” they answered. “It must be Elijah!” replied Ahaziah.
translation_verse: Ba bʋla pʋ, “Baal-la laalɛ teniŋ gɛrɩŋ nɛ a joŋ tembiiŋ a vɔɔ ʋ tɩŋa.” Kuoro bʋl, “Ɩlaaja nɛ, Tisibi tɩɩna-la.”

english_verse: Fire has already wiped out the other officers and their soldiers. Please don't let it happen to me.”
translation_verse: Nyiniŋ laa sɩpaaŋ dii laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ balɩa arɩ ba nɩaa nɛ, ama laa sʋlʋŋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa la-na lɛ.”

english_verse: The angel from the Lord said to Elijah, “Go with him and don't be afraid.” So Elijah got up and went with the officer.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaara bɩra bʋla pɩ Ɩlaaja, “Sii to ʋ harɩŋ dɩ ma mʋ, sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɩlaaja sii to ʋ harɩŋ ba mʋ kuoro teeŋ.

english_verse: When Elijah arrived, he told Ahaziah, “The Lord wants to know why you sent messengers to Ekron to ask Baalzebub about your injury. Don't you believe there's a God in Israel? Ahaziah, because you did that, the Lord says you will die.”
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja sɩ kɔ, ʋ bʋla pɩ kuoro, “La TƖƖNA sɩ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ tɩŋ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ Ɛkʋrɔŋ tɩŋŋaa vene Baal Zebub teeŋ a chɛ na wɩaa? Ŋ bɩɩna Wɩa tuo Iziral lɛ nɛ koo? A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ŋ bɩ jaŋ duori. Ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ.”

english_verse: Ahaziah died, just as the Lord had said. But since Ahaziah had no sons, Joram his brother then became king. This happened in the second year that Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Ahazɩa sɛnɛ sʋʋ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ to Ɩlaaja lɛ a bʋl ŋɩɩ. Ahazɩa fa bɩ hambolibie kɛnɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ naambie Joram laa ʋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ. Jehosafat nanʋala Jehoram sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, ʋ jɩ-lɩa lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaziah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Ahazɩa sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Not long before the Lord took Elijah up into heaven in a strong wind, Elijah and Elisha were leaving Gilgal.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la sɩ yie dɩ La TƖƖNA to pel-vinvilimiŋ lɛ a joŋ Ɩlaaja a kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ, Ɩlaaja arɩ Elaasa fa lɩɩ Gɩlɩgal lɛ nɛ a mʋmʋ.

english_verse: Elijah said to Elisha, “The Lord wants me to go to Bethel, but you must stay here.” Elisha replied, “I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I will stay with you no matter what!” And he went with Elijah to Bethel.
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja bʋla pɩ Elaasa, “Hɔŋ daha, La TƖƖNA tɩmmɛ nɛ Bɛtɛl lɛ.” Elaasa bʋla pʋ, “La TƖƖNA sɩ weye, arɩ ŋ ma sɩ weye wɩaa, mɩ bɩ jaŋ mɩɩrɛ ŋ harɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala to dɔŋɔ a mʋ Bɛtɛl.

english_verse: A group of prophets who lived there asked Elisha, “Do you know that today the Lord is going to take away your master?” “Yes, I do,” Elisha answered. “But don't remind me of it.”
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ hɛ Bɛtɛl lɛ kʋ lɩɩ pɩɛsɛ Elaasa, “Ŋ jɩma arɩ La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ ŋ nɩhɩaŋ jɩnɩŋ a kaa viiri koo?” Ʋ bʋl, “Oo, mɩ jɩma nɛ, ama, má tɔrɛ ma niiŋ.”

english_verse: Elijah then said, “Elisha, now the Lord wants me to go to Jericho, but you must stay here.” Elisha replied, “I swear by the living Lord and by your own life, that I will stay with you no matter what!” And he went with Elijah to Jericho.
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja bɩra bʋla pɩ Elaasa, “Hɔŋ daha, La TƖƖNA tɩmmɛ nɛ Jeriko lɛ.” Elaasa bɩra bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ weye, arɩ ŋ ma sɩ weye wɩaa, mɩ bɩ jaŋ mɩɩrɛ ŋ harɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala to dɔŋɔ a mʋ Jeriko.

english_verse: A group of prophets who lived there asked Elisha, “Do you know that today the Lord is going to take away your master?” “Yes, I do,” Elisha answered. “But don't remind me of it.”
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩ hɛ Jeriko lɛ ma kʋ lɩɩ pɩɛsɛ Elaasa, “Ŋ jɩma arɩ La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ ŋ nɩhɩaŋ jɩnɩŋ a kaa viiri koo?” Ʋ bʋl, “Oo, mɩ jɩma nɛ, ama, má tɔrɛ ma niiŋ.”

english_verse: Elijah then said to Elisha, “Now the Lord wants me to go to the Jordan River, but you must stay here.” Elisha replied, “I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I will never leave you!” So the two of them walked on together.
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja bɩra bʋla pɩ Elaasa, “Hɔŋ daha, La TƖƖNA tɩmmɛ nɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la lɛ.” Elaasa bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ weye, arɩ ŋ ma sɩ weye wɩaa, mɩ bɩ jaŋ mɩɩrɛ ŋ harɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala bɩra to dɔŋɔ a mʋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la.

english_verse: Fifty prophets followed Elijah and Elisha from Jericho, then stood at a distance and watched as the two men walked toward the river.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii to Ɩlaaja arɩ Elaasa harɩŋ a mʋ chɩŋ dɩ-bolii mʋa, a bibeŋ ka ba balɩa mʋ chɩŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la niiŋ.

english_verse: When they got there, Elijah took off his coat, then he rolled it up and struck the water with it. At once a path opened up through the river, and the two of them walked across on dry ground.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɩlaaja wuri ʋ gɛrɩŋ a kaa kpeŋ a kaa ŋmoo lɩɩ-la, ʋ pɔɩ balɩa. Ka tintee-hɩlɩŋ pɩŋ, ba to tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ a chol.

english_verse: After they had reached the other side, Elijah said, “Elisha, the Lord will soon take me away. What can I do for you before that happens?” Elisha answered, “Please give me twice as much of your power as you give the other prophets, so I can be the one who takes your place as their leader.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ cholo a dɛrɛ, Ɩlaaja pɩɛsɛ Elaasa, “Dagɛmɛ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa pɩŋ, ka dɩ La Tɩɩna-na jommi kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ.” Elaasa bʋl, “Leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ dol-la ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa.”

english_verse: Elijah and Elisha were walking along and talking, when suddenly there appeared between them a flaming chariot pulled by fiery horses. At once, a strong wind took Elijah up into heaven.
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja arɩ Elaasa ha sɩ vɛnɛ aŋ bʋbʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ laalɩŋ janɩŋ lɛrɛ toruko arɩ nyiniŋ a guu kʋ to ba pɛgɛ, a kɛmba pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ɩlaaja to pel-vinvilimiŋ lɛ a jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ.

english_verse: Elisha saw this and shouted, “Israel's cavalry and chariots have taken my master away!” After Elijah had gone, Elisha tore his clothes in sorrow.
translation_verse: Elaasa sɩ na ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋmoo niiŋ, “Mɩ nyɩmma, mɩ nyɩmma. Iziral tɩŋŋaa laataarɩ-duoŋ lɛlɛ. Ɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaa?” Elaasa sɩɩŋ bɩra bɩ ʋ na. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ.

english_verse: Elijah's coat had fallen off, so Elisha picked it up and walked back to the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Dɩ Ɩlaaja gɛrɩŋ foro tel. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elaasa joŋ a kaa mɩɩra mʋ chɩŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la niiŋ.

english_verse: He struck the water with the coat and wondered, “Will the Lord perform miracles for me as he did for Elijah?” As soon as Elisha did this, a dry path opened up through the water, and he walked across.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ Ɩlaaja gɛrɩ-la sɩ tele a kaa ŋmoo lɩɩ-la aŋ pɩɛsɛ, “Nɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA Ɩlaaja Wɩa hɛ?” Ʋ sɩ ŋmoo lɩɩ-la ŋɩɩ, ʋ kpaa balɩa, ʋ wuo chol.

english_verse: When the prophets from Jericho saw what happened, they said to each other, “Elisha now has Elijah's power.” They walked over to him, bowed down,
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii sɩ lɩɩ Jeriko sɩ chɩŋ nɩmɛ a bibenu bʋl, “Wɩa Dɩma-la sɩ hɛ Ɩlaaja lɛ lɩɩ jʋʋ Elaasa nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ chemu a kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: They kept begging until he was embarrassed to say no. He finally agreed, and the prophets sent the men out. They looked three days for Elijah but never found him.
translation_verse: Ba ha vɩa aŋ pɛsɛ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ, Elaasa walɩma ka aŋ bʋl, “Má mʋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii kala mʋ gɔllɔ chɛʋ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ tapʋlaa batori aŋ bɩ ʋ na.

english_verse: They returned to Jericho, and Elisha said, “I told you that you wouldn't find him.” Elisha Makes the Water Pure at Jericho
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mɩɩra kɔ Elaasa teeŋ Jeriko lɛ, ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Mɩ bɩ bʋla pɩma arɩ má sɩ́ mʋʋ?” Elaasa leŋe lɩɩŋ zɔŋ

english_verse: One day the people of Jericho said, “Elisha, you can see that our city is in a good spot. But the water from our spring is so bad that it even keeps our crops from growing.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Jeriko nɩaa sii bʋla pɩ Elaasa, “La jaŋ deeŋ chɩŋ dɩ-zɔŋ nɛ, aŋ ka la lɩɩŋ bɩ zɔŋ, ŋɩɩ leŋ la tinteeŋ kɩaa bɩ wasɛ.”

english_verse: He replied, “Put some salt in a new bowl and bring it to me.” They brought him the bowl of salt,
translation_verse: Elaasa bʋl, “Má ŋaa yɩsɩŋ a hɛ gbaŋ-falɩŋ lɛ a kaa kʋ pɩmɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋaa hɛ a kaa mʋ pʋ.

english_verse: and he carried it to the spring. He threw the salt into the water and said, “The Lord has made this water pure again. From now on you'll be able to grow crops, and no one will starve.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sii kaa mʋ lɩɩ-bul-sɩɩŋ leriŋ, a bɩsɛ yɩsɩ-la hɛ ʋ lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ leŋe lɩɩŋ deeŋ zɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ma kʋŋ sʋʋ koo dɩ ma tinteeŋ kɩaa sɩ́ wasʋ.”

english_verse: The water has been fine ever since, just as Elisha said. Some Boys Make Fun of Elisha
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-la ha zɔmɔ nɛ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala arɩ Elaasa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Elisha left and headed toward Bethel. Along the way some boys started making fun of him by shouting, “Go away, baldy! Get out of here!”
translation_verse: Elaasa lɩɩ Jeriko lɛ a mʋmʋ Bɛtɛl. Ʋ sɩɩ mʋ, bapʋɔsɛ biisiŋ lɩɩ taŋ-la lɛ a sieri ʋ lɛ a bʋl, “Nyu-puoro tɩɩna, mʋ lɩɩ daha.”

english_verse: Elisha turned around and stared at the boys. Then he cursed them in the name of the Lord. At once two bears ran out of the woods and ripped to pieces
translation_verse: Ʋ mɩɩra bɩrɩma bemba, aŋ kalɩba hɛ ba lɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ lʋgʋmaa balɩa lɩɩ gɩrɩŋ tʋɔŋ a kʋ kɛsɛ bapʋɔsɛ biisi-la mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ balɩa kala a chaŋ.

english_verse: Elisha went up to Mount Carmel, then returned to Samaria.
translation_verse: Ka Elaasa mʋ jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kamɛl a lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mɩɩra mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Samarɩa.

english_verse: Joram son of Ahab became king of Israel in Jehoshaphat's eighteenth year as king of Judah. Joram ruled twelve years from Samaria
translation_verse: Jehosafat sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ chori lɛ nɛ Ahab nanʋala Joram ma dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ hɔŋ Samarɩa lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ balɩa.

english_verse: and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He tore down the stone image his father had made to honor Baal, and so he wasn't as sinful as his parents.
translation_verse: Ʋ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, ama ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ Jɛzɛbɛl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ maga. Joram fa ŋmoo vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal tabɩɩ-la ʋ nyɩmma fa sɩ bile a yɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But he kept doing the sinful things that Jeroboam son of Nebat had led Israel to do. The Country of Moab Rebels against Israel
translation_verse: Ama wʋbɔmɔ-la Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam fa sɩ ŋaa, a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ba tɩtɩa, Joram ma fa ŋaa ba tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: For many years the country of Moab had been controlled by Israel and was forced to pay taxes to the kings of Israel. King Mesha of Moab raised sheep, so he paid the king of Israel
translation_verse: Mʋab kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɛsa faa dɩɛsɛ piesee nɛ. Jɩna na-kala ʋ yie joŋ pie-pɔrɔɔ bʋɩ zɔlɔ nɛ a pɛ pie-belliŋ bʋɩ zɔlɔ pʋnaa lɛ a tiŋ lampoo a pɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro.

english_verse: But soon after the death of Ahab, Mesha rebelled against Israel.
translation_verse: Ama Kuoro Ahab sʋʋŋ harɩŋ lɛ, Mʋab kuoro Mɛsa vɩa Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro niiŋ.

english_verse: One day, Joram left Samaria and called together Israel's army.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala kuoro Joram lɩɩ Samarɩa lɛ a yɩrɛ Iziral laalɩyuoroo kala ba kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ,

english_verse: He sent this message to King Jehoshaphat of Judah, “The king of Moab has rebelled. Will you go with me to attack him?” “Yes, I will,” Jehoshaphat answered. “I'm on your side, and my soldiers and horses are at your command.
translation_verse: aŋ tɩma pɩ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Jehosafat a bʋl: “Mʋab kuoro vɩa mɩ niiŋ nɛ. Ŋ jaŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ la mʋ yuou?” Jehosafat bʋl, “Oo, mɩ jaŋ mʋ. Mɩ dɩ mɩ nɩaa arɩ mɩ janɩŋ kɛŋ la tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ dɩ ŋ nɩaa arɩ ma janɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: But which way should we go?” “We will march through Edom Desert,” Joram replied.
translation_verse: Jehosafat pɩɛsɛ, “Wombii bɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ to a mʋ yuoba?” Joram bʋl, “La to Ɛdɔm tintee-hɩlɩŋ.”

english_verse: So Joram, Jehoshaphat, and the king of Edom led their troops out. But seven days later, there was no drinking water left for them or their animals.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Joram arɩ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Jehosafat a pɛ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ kuoro lɛ sii a mʋmʋ dɩ ba yuo Mʋab tɩŋŋaa. Ba sɩ gɔllɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ, ba lɩɩŋ dɛrɛ. Laalɩyuoro-la bɩra bɩ lɩɩŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ba dɩ ba pʋsʋŋ nyʋa.

english_verse: Joram cried out, “This is terrible! The Lord must have led us out here to be captured by Moab's army.”
translation_verse: Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Joram ŋmoo niiŋ a bʋl, “Bɛɛ ba! La TƖƖNA yɩrɛ la kuoroo deemba batori kala kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ʋ jonla hɛ Mʋab tinteeŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ koo?”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat said, “Which of the Lord's prophets is with us? We can find out from him what the Lord wants us to do.” One of Joram's officers answered, “Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He was one of Elijah's closest followers.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehosafat pɩɛsɛ, “La TƖƖNA wʋlaabʋllʋ kala tuo daha dɩ la to ʋ lɛ a pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA a naa?” Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Joram tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ dɔŋɔ bʋl, “Safat nanʋala Elaasa hɛ daha. Ʋ nɛ fa pɛ Ɩlaaja lɛ ba tɩtɩŋ.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat replied, “He can give us the Lord's message.” The three kings went over to Elisha,
translation_verse: Kuoro Jehosafat bʋl, “Ʋ sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuorusu-la batori kala to dɔŋɔ a mʋ Elaasa teeŋ.

english_verse: and he asked Joram, “Why did you come to me? Go talk to the prophets of the foreign gods your parents worshiped.” “No,” Joram answered. “It was the Lord who led us out here, so that Moab's army could capture us.”
translation_verse: Elaasa pɩɛsɛ kuoro Joram, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ wɩɩ nɛ ŋ chɛ mɩ teeŋ? Mʋ pɩɛsɛ ŋ nyɩmma arɩ ŋ naaŋ veŋ-vʋgʋra-la.” Joram bʋl, “Aɩ, La TƖƖNA nɛ yɩrɛ la kuoroo deemba batori kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ʋ joŋ la hɛ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha said to him, “I serve the Lord All-Powerful, and as surely as he lives, I swear I wouldn't even look at you if I didn't respect King Jehoshaphat.”
translation_verse: Elaasa bʋl, “La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ weye, Nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ tɩma pɩpa wɩaa, dɩ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Jehosafat wɩaa dee, mɩ fa paala bɩ jaŋ bee naŋ.”

english_verse: Then Elisha said, “Send for someone who can play the harp.” The harpist began playing, and the Lord gave Elisha this message for Joram:
translation_verse: Elaasa bɩra bʋl, “Má yɩrɛ cheŋ-duuro pɩmɛ.” Cheŋ-duuru-la sɩ kɔ a du, La TƖƖNA doluŋ kʋ jʋʋ Elaasa.

english_verse: The Lord says that this dry riverbed will be filled with water.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má lu buotuonuŋ fuonaaŋ deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You won't feel any wind or see any rain, but there will be plenty of water for you and your animals.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jaŋ na peliŋ koo duonuŋ daha, ama fuonaa-la kala jaŋ su arɩ lɩɩŋ dɩ ma dɩ ma pʋsʋŋ kala nyʋa.

english_verse: That simple thing isn't all the Lord is going to do. He will also help you defeat Moab's army.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa wʋbie nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Ʋ jaŋ joŋ Mʋab tɩmma-la ma a hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You will capture all their walled cities and important towns. You will chop down every good tree and stop up every spring of water, then ruin their fertile fields by covering them with rocks.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ yuo dii tabala-la kala ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli arɩ tasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ. Ma jaŋ keri tɩɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ kala a lo, aŋ tɔ lɩɩ-bul-sɩaa kala, aŋ paa tabɩaa tɔ ba tinteeŋ lee na-kala sɩ sɩma.”

english_verse: The next morning, while the sacrifice was being offered, water suddenly started flowing from the direction of Edom, and it flooded the land.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla chʋchʋɔŋ, bʋa-la sɩ maga dɩ ba kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ a lɩɩ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a kʋ su tintee-la kala.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Moab had heard that the three kings were coming to attack them. They had called together all of their fighting men, from the youngest to the oldest, and these troops were now standing at their border, ready for battle.
translation_verse: Mʋab tɩŋŋaa sɩ nɩa arɩ kuorusu-la batori kɔ dɩ ba yuoba nɛ, ba yɩrɛ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ magɛ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ, nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ bapʋɔsɛ biisiŋ kala nyɩgɩlɛ, a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a mʋ chɩŋ ba tinteeŋ bʋa.

english_verse: When they got up that morning, the sun was shining across the water, making it look red. The Moabite troops took one look
translation_verse: Mʋab tɩmma-la sɩ sie chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla, ba na dɩ wɩa pɔsɔ hɛ lɩɩ-la lɛ, ʋ fɩɛsɛ a nagɛ chalɩŋ.

english_verse: and shouted, “Look at that blood! The armies of those kings must have fought and killed each other. Come on, let's go take what's left in their camp.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ na ŋɩɩ, ba bʋl, “Chalɩŋ nɛ, kuorusu-la naga ba gʋra yuo dɔŋɔ nɛ a kpʋ dɔŋɔ. Má leŋ dɩ la mʋ ba buguŋ a paa ba kɩaa.”

english_verse: But when they arrived at Israel's camp, the Israelite soldiers came out and attacked them, until they turned and ran away. Israel's army chased them all the way back to Moab, and even there they kept up the attack.
translation_verse: Ama Mʋab tɩmma-la fa sɩ kʋ yi Iziral tɩŋŋaa buguŋ, ba sii yuoba ba fá. Ba kire to ba harɩŋ jʋʋ ba tinteeŋ a kpʋba.

english_verse: The Israelites destroyed the Moabite towns. They chopped down the good trees and stopped up the springs of water, then covered the fertile fields with rocks. Finally, the only city left standing was Kir-Hareseth, but soldiers armed with slings surrounded and attacked it.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa chei Mʋab tasɩŋ kala, aŋ paa tabɩaa tɔ ba tinteeŋ lee na-kala sɩ sɩma, a tɔ ba lɩɩ-bul-sɩaa ma kala, aŋ keri ba tɩɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ kala a lo. Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɛɛ-Harɛsɛf dʋndʋŋa nɛ fa ka. Ama kpal-yuoroo ma nɛ mʋ golli taŋ-la a yuou.

english_verse: King Mesha of Moab saw that he was about to be defeated. So he took along
translation_verse: Mʋab tinteeŋ kuoro Mɛsa sɩ na dɩ ba yuo diiu, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo zɔɔ-balɩpɛ, baa nɛrɩgɛ dɩ ba luuro to Ɛdɔm kuoro laalɩyuoroo tʋɔŋ lɩɩ, a walɩma lɔl.

english_verse: He then grabbed his oldest son who was to be the next king and sacrificed him as an offering on the city wall. The Israelite troops were so horrified that they left the city and went back home.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ hambolibii-hɩaŋ-la sɩ jaŋ laa ʋ nyuŋ dii kuoruŋ a kpʋʋ ba taŋ jebiiŋ nyuŋ a kpaarɛ ba vene. Fawʋllʋŋ faasa kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ba mɩɩra mʋ ba tinteeŋ.

english_verse: One day the widow of one of the Lord's prophets said to Elisha, “You know that before my husband died, he was a follower of yours and a worshiper of the Lord. But he owed a man some money, and now that man is on his way to take my two sons as his slaves.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa dɔŋɔ yo-haala mʋ Elaasa teeŋ, a yele pʋ, “Ŋ jɩma mɩ bala fa ŋaa ŋ harɩ-tooru nɛ a to La TƖƖNA woruŋ aŋ sʋʋ. Ama ʋ dii nʋʋ chɩŋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kɔ dɩ ʋ kɛsɛ mɩ hambolibiisiŋ balɩa a kaa mʋ dɩ ba ŋaa ʋ yosi.”

english_verse: “Maybe there's something I can do to help,” Elisha said. “What do you have in your house?” “Sir, I have nothing but a small bottle of olive oil.”
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Elaasa pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa pɩŋ? Ŋ dɩa lɛ, bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ kɛŋ? Bʋla pɩmɛ.” Yo-haal-la bʋl, “Mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ, see nʋʋŋ mʋapɩlɩɩ a hɛ loŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha told her, “Ask your neighbors for their empty jars. And after you've borrowed as many as you can,
translation_verse: Elaasa bɩra bʋl, “Mʋ gɔllɔ sʋl nʋʋŋ-loŋ wuoloo ŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jʋʋ kpagɛ dɔŋɔ teeŋ. Laa yʋgɛ,

english_verse: go home and shut the door behind you and your sons. Then begin filling the jars with oil and set each one aside as you fill it.”
translation_verse: dɩ ŋ dɩ ŋ hambolibiisiŋ kaa jʋʋ dɩa aŋ kɛŋ boiŋ tɔ. Má wansɛ nʋʋ-la a hɩhɛ loŋ-wuolo-la kala lɛ. Dɩ ba kʋŋkala nɛ suo, má kaa gɩɩga bil.”

english_verse: The woman left. Later, when she and her sons were back inside their house, the two sons brought her the jars, and she began filling them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la ta Elaasa aŋ mʋ gɔllɔ sʋl loŋ wuolo-la. Ʋ dɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ jʋʋ dɩa aŋ kɛŋ boiŋ tɔ. Ʋ biiri-la paa loŋ-wuolo-la pʋ, ʋ wansɛ nʋʋ-la a hɩhɛ.

english_verse: At last, she said to one of her sons, “Bring me another jar.” “We don't have any more,” he answered, and the oil stopped flowing from the small bottle.
translation_verse: Lonnu-la kala ʋ biiriŋ sɩ joŋo pʋ sɩ suo, ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ hambolibiisi-la dɔŋɔ a bʋl, “Bɩra joŋ loŋ-la dɔŋɔ a kaa kɔ.” Bile bʋl, “Loŋ kala bɩra tuo.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋ-la ma fa sɩɩ lɩɩ loŋ-la lɛ ʋ sɩɩ wansʋ kɛrɛ a bɩra bɩ lɩɩ.

english_verse: After she told Elisha what had happened, he said, “Sell the oil and use part of the money to pay what you owe the man. You and your sons can live on what is left.” Elisha Brings a Rich Woman's Son Back to Life
translation_verse: Haal-la mʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa a pɩ Elaasa. Elaasa bʋla pʋ, “Mʋ joŋ nʋʋ-la yallɛ tiŋ ŋ chɩŋ-la, aŋ ka ŋ dɩ ŋ hambolibiisiŋ ma kɛŋ kʋkaanaa a kaa beŋ ma tɩtɩa.” Elaasa chɩsɛ Sunem tɩŋŋaa bie sʋʋŋ lɛ

english_verse: Once, while Elisha was in the town of Shunem, he met a rich woman who invited him to her home for dinner. After that, whenever he was in Shunem, he would have a meal there with her and her husband.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Elaasa sii mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sunem. Haal kʋbala fa hɛ nɩmɛ a kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la yɩrʋ dɩ ʋ kʋ dii kɩaa ʋ dɩa lɛ. A lɩɩ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, dɩ Elaasa nɛ kɔ taŋ-la na-kala, ʋ yie kɔ haal-la arɩ ʋ bala dɩa nɛ a dii kɩaa.

english_verse: Some time later the woman said to her husband, “I'm sure the man who comes here so often is a prophet of God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ bʋa kʋbala lɛ haal-la bʋla pɩ ʋ bala, “Mɩ laa dii arɩ baal-la sɩ yie vɛnɛ kʋkɔ daha ŋaa Wɩa nʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Why don't we build him a small room on the flat roof of our house? We can put a bed, a table and chair, and an oil lamp in it. Then whenever he comes, he can stay with us.”
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ la saa dɩɩ-bie a sugili la dɩa nyuŋ, a chɛ kʋpɩnɩŋ, kpasa, teebʋl arɩ chaanɩŋ a bil nɩmɛ. Bʋa na-kala dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ la teeŋ, dɩ ʋ chʋa nɩmɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The next time Elisha was in Shunem, he stopped at their house and went up to his room to rest.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Elaasa bɩra kɔ, a jʋʋ pɩŋ dɩa-la ba sɩ saa bil ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ wiesi.

english_verse: He said to his servant Gehazi, “This woman has been very helpful. Have her come up here to the roof for a moment.” She came, and Elisha told Gehazi to say to her, “You've gone to a lot of trouble for us, and we want to help you. Is there something we can request the king or army commander to do?” The woman answered, “With my relatives nearby, I have everything I need.”
translation_verse: Elaasa bɩra bʋla pɩ Gehazi, “Bʋla pɩ haal-la arɩ ʋʋ lɔl la wɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ. Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ cho dɩ la ŋaa pʋ? Ʋ kɛŋ wɩɩ, ʋ sɩ jaŋ cho dɩ mɩ mʋ bʋla pɩ kuoro koo laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ dɩ ba ŋaa pʋʋ?” Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, haal-la ma bʋl, “Mɩ hɛ mɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ, aa na kʋŋkala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ.”

english_verse: “Then what can we do for her?” Elisha asked Gehazi. Gehazi replied, “I do know that her husband is old, and that she doesn't have a son.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elaasa pɩɛsɛ Gehazi, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ maga dɩ la ŋaa pʋ?” Ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ jɩma arɩ ʋ bɩ bii kɛnɛ, ka ʋ bala ma hɩɛsɛ.”

english_verse: “Ask her to come here again,” Elisha told his servant. He called for her, and she came and stood in the doorway of Elisha's room.
translation_verse: Elaasa bɩra bʋl, “Bɩra yɩrʋ.” Gehazi sɩ yɩrɛ haal-la, ʋ kʋ jʋʋ a chɩŋ boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Elisha said to her, “Next year at this time, you'll be holding your own baby son in your arms.” “You're a man of God,” the woman replied. “Please don't lie to me.”
translation_verse: Elaasa bʋla pɩ haal-la, “Harɩŋ jɩna bʋa deeŋ tɩtɩa lɛ, ŋ jaŋ kori hambolibie.” Haal-la bʋl, “Aɩ, mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, sɩ́ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna nyɩsʋ, ŋ ŋaa Wɩa nʋʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: But a few months later, the woman got pregnant. She gave birth to a son, just as Elisha had promised.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ haal-la kɛŋ luoruŋ, a lʋl hambolibie harɩŋ jɩna bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ Elaasa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pʋ.

english_verse: One day while the boy was still young, he was out in the fields with his father, where the workers were harvesting the crops.
translation_verse: Bile sɩ kʋ waa mʋa, tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala ʋ sii a mʋ ʋ nyɩmma teeŋ, dɩ baa ŋaa baga kɩaa.

english_verse: Suddenly he shouted, “My head hurts. It hurts a lot!” “Carry him back to his mother,” the father said to his servant.
translation_verse: Bile ŋmoo niiŋ a bʋla pɩ ʋ nyɩmma, “Mɩ nyuŋ nɩɩ wɩɩ, mɩ nyuŋ nɩɩ wɩɩ.” Ʋ nyɩmma bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa dɔŋɔ, “Kɛnʋ kaa mʋ pɩ ʋ naaŋ.”

english_verse: loaves of bread made from the first barley that was harvested. Elisha said, “Give it to the people so they can eat.”
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnnʋ-la sɩ kɛnʋ kaa mʋ pɩ ʋ naaŋ, ʋ laaʋ bil ʋ naasɩŋ nyuŋ chʋchʋɔŋ kala a kaa mʋ wɩɩhɛyɛ bile sʋʋ.

english_verse: She carried him upstairs to Elisha's room and laid him across the bed. Then she walked out and shut the door behind her.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛnʋ a kaa jɩla bil Elaasa dɩa-la lɛ, ʋ kʋpɩnɩŋ nyuŋ, aŋ kʋ lɩɩ a kɛŋ boiŋ tɔ hɛ bile lɛ.

english_verse: The woman called to her husband, “I need to see the prophet. Let me use one of the donkeys. Send a servant along with me, and let me leave now, so I can get back quickly.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la yɩrɛ ʋ bala a bʋla pʋ, “Leŋ dɩ tɩntɩnna-la dɔŋɔ kɛŋ kakusu-la dɔŋɔ kʋ pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ fá mʋ Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ-la teeŋ aŋ mɩɩra kɔ.”

english_verse: “Why do you need to see him today?” her husband asked. “It's not the Sabbath or time for the New Moon Festival.” “That's all right,” she answered.
translation_verse: Ʋ bala pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ mʋ ʋ teeŋ jɩnɩŋ? Jɩnɩŋ bɩ chɛŋ-falɩɩ ŋaa a bɩra bɩ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ ma ŋaa.” Haal-la bʋl, “Wɩɩkala tuo.”

english_verse: She saddled the donkey and said to her servant, “Let's go. And don't slow down unless I tell you to.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ kpɩɛrɛ ʋ kakumo a jɩl aŋ bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna, “Laa sɩpaaŋ dɩ la fá mʋ, sɩ́ chɩŋ, see dɩ mɩ sɩ ŋ chɩŋ.”

english_verse: She left at once for Mount Carmel to talk with Elisha. When Elisha saw her coming, he said, “Gehazi, look! It's the woman from Shunem.
translation_verse: Ʋ sii a mʋmʋ. Ʋ mʋa dɩ Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ-la hɔŋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kamɛl nyuŋ. Elaasa sɩ na haal-la dɩ-bolii dɩ ʋʋ kɔ, ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna Gehazi, “Bee na, Sunem tɩŋŋaa haal-la nɩɩ kɔ.

english_verse: Run and meet her. And ask her if everything is all right with her and her family.” “Everything is fine,” she answered Gehazi.
translation_verse: Sii fá mʋ chemu lɩma a pɩɛsʋ na ba fɩɛla nɛɛ? Ʋ dɩ ʋ bie arɩ ʋ bala kala doliee?” Ʋ mʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ, haal-la ma bʋl, “Wɩɩkala tuo.”

english_verse: But as soon as she got to the top of the mountain, she went over and grabbed Elisha by the feet. Gehazi started toward her to push her away, when Elisha said, “Leave her alone! Don't you see how sad she is? But the Lord hasn't told me why.”
translation_verse: Ama haal-la sɩ kʋ jɩl Elaasa teeŋ peel-la nyuŋ, ʋ mʋ kpirime kɛŋ ʋ naaŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Gehazi kɔ dɩ ʋ yigi haal-la ta. Elaasa bʋla pʋ, “Leŋu, ʋ tʋɔŋ chaasa chei nɛ, ama La TƖƖNA kaa faamɛ nɛ, ʋ bɩ leŋe mɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I begged you not to get my hopes up, and I didn't even ask you for a son.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la pɩɛsɛ Elaasa, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, mɩ pɩɛsɩŋ bii wɩaa? Mɩ bɩ sɩ ŋ sɩ́ mɩ nyɩsʋʋ?”

english_verse: “Gehazi, get ready and go to her house,” Elisha said. “Take along my walking stick, and when you get there, lay it on the boy's face. Don't stop to talk to anyone, even if they try to talk to you.”
translation_verse: Elaasa bʋla pɩ Gehazi, “Kɛŋ ŋ tembiiŋ vɔɔ ŋ gɛrɩŋ kpɛrɛ a kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ, a laa mɩ dantɩga a kaa fá mʋ haal-la dɩa. Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ mʋ, sɩ́ chɩna chʋɔlɛ nʋʋkala. Dɩ nʋʋ chʋɔlʋŋ ma, sɩ́ laa. Dɩ ŋ nɛ mʋa, joŋ mɩ dantɩga-la a daŋ bile sɩaa lɛ.”

english_verse: But the boy's mother said to Elisha, “I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I won't leave without you.” So Elisha got up and went with them.
translation_verse: Bile naaŋ bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ weye, arɩ ŋ ma sɩ weye wɩaa, mɩ bɩ jaŋ mʋ dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ mɩ harɩŋ to.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elaasa sii to haal-la harɩŋ ba mʋ.

english_verse: Gehazi ran on ahead and laid Elisha's walking stick on the boy's face, but the boy didn't move or make a sound. Gehazi ran back to Elisha and said, “The boy didn't wake up.”
translation_verse: Gehazi laa sɩpaaŋ fá a kɛŋ dantɩga-la a mʋ daŋ bile sɩaa lɛ, ka bile bɩ jigise koo a ŋaa wɩɩ a nagɛ arɩ ʋ weye. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Gehazi mɩɩra fá mʋ cheŋ Elaasa a bʋla pʋ, “Bile bɩ sie.”

english_verse: Elisha arrived at the woman's house and went straight to his room, where he saw the boy's body on his bed.
translation_verse: Elaasa mʋ jʋʋ dɩa-la, a na bile dɩ ʋ sʋba a pɩŋ ʋ-na Elaasa kʋpɩnɩŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: He walked in, shut the door, and prayed to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ boro tɔ hɛ ʋ dɩ bile lɛ aŋ sʋl La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Then he got on the bed and stretched out over the dead body, with his mouth on the boy's mouth, his eyes on his eyes, and his hand on his hands. As he lay there, the boy's body became warm.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jɩla pɩŋ bile nyuŋ, a kɛŋ ʋ niiŋ chu bile niiŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa ma chu mɛrɛ bile sɩaa lɛ, a kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa ma daŋ bile nɩsaa lɛ, aŋ saa tɩɛna chu bile kala lɛ. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bile yaraa kala lɩŋ.

english_verse: Elisha got up and walked back and forth in the room, then he went back and leaned over the boy's body. The boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ sii gʋgɔllɛ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ, a mʋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ mɩɩra kɔ harɩŋ, a mʋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ mɩɩra kɔ harɩŋ, aŋ bɩra mʋ tɩɛna chu tɔ bile lɛ. Bile chɩmɩsɛ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa suri.
