english_verse: Elisha called out to Gehazi, “Ask the boy's mother to come here.” Gehazi did, and when she was at the door, Elisha said, “You can take your son.”
translation_verse: Elaasa yɩrɛ Gehazi a bʋla pʋ, “Yɩrɛ Sunem tɩŋŋaa haal-la.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrʋ. Haal-la sɩ kɔ Elaasa teeŋ, ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Joŋ ŋ nanʋala.”

english_verse: She came in and bowed down at Elisha's feet. Then she picked up her son and left. Elisha Makes Some Stew Taste Better
translation_verse: Haal-la kʋ jʋʋ kpirimi Elaasa sɩpaaŋ, aŋ sii joŋ ʋ bie a kaa lɩɩ. Elaasa bɩra ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ balɩa

english_verse: Later, Elisha went back to Gilgal, where there was almost nothing to eat, because the crops had failed. One day while the prophets who lived there were meeting with Elisha, he said to his servant, “Prepare a big pot of stew for these prophets.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ Elaasa mɩɩra kɔ Gɩlɩgal tinteeŋ, dɩ losuŋ jʋʋ nɩmɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala ʋ dɩdagɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩ kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna, “Hɛ nyiniŋ a joŋ pupoi-balɩŋ a chɔ dɩsɩŋ pɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa deemba.”

english_verse: One of them went out into the woods to gather some herbs. He found a wild vine and picked as much of its fruit as he could carry, but he didn't know that the fruit was very sour. When he got back, he cut up the fruit and put it in the stew.
translation_verse: Ba dɔŋɔ lɩɩ jɩl pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ dɩ ʋ jaa pɩpaarɩ-la ba sɩɩ dii, a na pɩpaa-kpuŋkpere ba sɩɩ bɩ ʋ jɩŋ. Ʋ tɔrɛ ʋ nɛnɛɛ su ʋ gɛrɩŋ a kaa jʋʋ kere hɛ dɩsɩ-la ba sɩ chɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The stew was served, and when the prophets started eating it, they shouted, “Elisha, this stew tastes terrible! We can't eat it.”
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa dɩsɩ-la a pɩ nɩalɩŋ dɩ ba dii. Ba die dɩ ba hɛyɛ, ba ŋmoo niiŋ a bʋla pɩ Elaasa, “Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ, dɩsɩ-la hɛyɛ nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩ wuo dii.

english_verse: “Bring me some flour,” Elisha said. He sprinkled the flour in the stew and said, “Now serve it to them.” And the stew tasted fine. Elisha Feeds One Hundred People
translation_verse: Elaasa bʋl, “Má kɛŋ munuŋ mʋa kɔ.” Ba kaa kɔ ʋ joŋo hɛ dɩsɩ-la arɩ pupoi-la tʋɔŋ, aŋ bʋl, “Má ŋaa dɩsɩ-la pɩba dɩ ba dii.” Ba die dɩ ba sɩma.

english_verse: So the servant served the bread and grain to the people. They ate and still had some left over, just as the Lord had promised.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnʋ-la joŋ kɩalɩŋ a bil nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ. Ba dii aŋ ka, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Naaman was the commander of the Syrian army. The Lord had helped him and his troops defeat their enemies, so the king of Syria respected Naaman very much. Naaman was a brave soldier, but he had leprosy.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ baa yɩrɛ Naamaŋ. Ʋ fa ŋaa Siiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ nɛ. La TƖƖNA fa pɛ ʋ lɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo yuo dii ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ. Siiria kuoro ma faa zilu nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ fa ŋaa laalɩyuori babiibal nɛ, ka dayalɩbɩŋ kɛnʋ.

english_verse: One day while the Syrian troops were raiding Israel, they captured a girl, and she became a servant of Naaman's wife.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Siiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo sii mʋ yuo Iziral tɩŋŋaa, a kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hantolibie kʋbala kɔ ʋ tɩma pɩpɩ Naamaŋ haala.

english_verse: When Naaman told the king what the girl had said,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Naamaŋ haala bʋl wɩɩ-la hantolibie-la sɩ bʋla a pʋ.

english_verse: the king replied, “Go ahead! I will give you a letter to take to the king of Israel.” Naaman left and took along
translation_verse: Naamaŋ sii mʋ a bʋl wɩɩ-la pɩ Siiria kuoro. Kuoro bʋl, “Mʋ, mɩ jaŋ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩŋ dɩ ŋ kaa mʋ pɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Naamaŋ sii joŋ warɩpʋla bʋɩ mara arɩ fii, sɛlɩmɛ chɛnfɛŋ daasɩŋ bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ gɛrɩ-laalaa dabamba fii.

english_verse: He also carried the letter to the king of Israel. It said, “I am sending my servant Naaman to you. Would you cure him of his leprosy?”
translation_verse: Teŋ-la ʋ sɩ kaa mʋ pɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ ŋmʋnsa hɛ: “Mɩ-na Siiria kuoro nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a joŋo pɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna Naamaŋ dɩ ʋ kaa kʋ pɩŋ. Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ a vaarɛ ʋ dayalɩbɩŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha sent someone outside to say to him, “Go wash seven times in the Jordan River. Then you'll be completely cured.”
translation_verse: Elaasa tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩnna ʋ kʋ lɩɩ bʋla pʋ, “Mʋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa tuu yu lɩɩŋ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ. Ŋ jaŋ duori, ŋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ jaŋ kɛŋ.”

english_verse: When the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his clothes in fear and shouted, “That Syrian king believes I can cure this man of leprosy! Does he think I'm God with power over life and death? He must be trying to pick a fight with me.”
translation_verse: Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro sɩ laa teŋ-la karɩmɛ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ ʋ tʋɔŋ chei. Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ aŋ bʋl, “Siiria tɩŋŋaa kuoro sɩ sɩ dɩ mɩ vaarɛ baala deeŋ, ʋ bɩɩna mɩ ŋaa Wɩa nɛ sɩ jaŋ wuo kpʋ aŋ chɩsɛɛ? Ʋ nagɛ yuosuŋ nɛ ʋ chɩchɛ mɩ teeŋ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: As soon as Elisha the prophet heard what had happened, he sent the Israelite king this message: “Why are you so afraid? Send the man to me, so that he will know there is a prophet in Israel.”
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Elaasa sɩ nɩa dɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro ŋaa wɩɩ-la, ʋ tɩŋ nɩaa ba mʋ pɩɛsʋ: “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ chei ŋ kɛŋ ŋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ? Leŋ dɩ baal-la kɔ mɩ teeŋ, ʋ jaŋ jɩŋ dɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Naaman left with his horses and chariots and stopped at the door of Elisha's house.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Naamaŋ arɩ ʋ janɩŋ arɩ ʋ janɩŋ torukoba kʋ chɩŋ Elaasa dɩa boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: But Naaman stormed off, grumbling, “Why couldn't he come out and talk to me? I thought for sure he would stand in front of me and pray to the Lord his God, then wave his hand over my skin and cure me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baanɩŋ kɛŋ Naamaŋ ʋ viviiri aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ fa bɩɩna ʋ jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ mɩ teeŋ a yɩrɛ ʋ Tɩɩna Wɩa, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ zaarɛ mɩ yaraa lere-la sɩ pʋlla a vaarɛmɛ.

english_verse: What about the Abana River or the Pharpar River? Those rivers in Damascus are just as good as any river in Israel. I could have washed in them and been cured.”
translation_verse: Fuonu-la sɩ hɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ baa yɩrɛ Abana arɩ Faapa bɩ zɔmɔ kɩɩ fuonu-la kala sɩ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛɛ? Mɩ fa jaŋ wuo tuu ba dɔŋɔ a kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa yu lɩɩ-la a duori a bɩra bɩ disiniŋ jaŋ kɛŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Naamaŋ faasa na baanɩŋ a viviiri.

english_verse: His servants went over to him and said, “Sir, if the prophet had told you to do something difficult, you would have done it. So why don't you do what he said? Go wash and be cured.”
translation_verse: Naamaŋ tɩntɩnnaa kɔ ʋ teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “La nyɩmma, dɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la nɛ fa sɩ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wʋduo, ŋ fa bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa? Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa mʋ yu Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a duori arɩ ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ?”

english_verse: Naaman walked down to the Jordan; he waded out into the water and stooped down in it seven times, just as Elisha had told him. At once, he was cured, and his skin became as smooth as a child's.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Naamaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa tuu yu Jɔdaŋ fuo-la lɩɩŋ naasɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ, arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Elaasa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pʋ. Ʋ duori, ʋ yaraa kala ŋaa mʋla mʋla a nagɛ bii-mulo.

english_verse: Naaman and his officials went back to Elisha. Naaman stood in front of him and announced, “Now I know that the God of Israel is the only God in the whole world. Sir, would you please accept a gift from me?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Naamaŋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa kala mɩɩra mʋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la teeŋ. Naamaŋ mʋ chɩŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ bʋl, “Lɛɛlɛ mɩ jɩma arɩ Wɩa tuo dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala see Iziral lɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, laa zile kɩaa deemba ŋ tɩntɩnna teeŋ.”

english_verse: “I am a servant of the living Lord,” Elisha answered, “and I swear that I will not take anything from you.” Naaman kept begging, but Elisha kept refusing.
translation_verse: Elaasa bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ weye wɩaa, Nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ tɩma pɩpa, mɩ bɩ kʋŋkala jaŋ laa ŋ teeŋ.” Naamaŋ ha vɩa aŋ pɛsɛ, ka ʋ vɩa.

english_verse: Finally Naaman said, “If you won't accept a gift, then please let me take home as much soil as two mules can pull in a wagon. Sir, from now on I will offer sacrifices only to the Lord.
translation_verse: Naamaŋ bɩra bʋl, “Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ kʋŋkala jaŋ laa, leŋ dɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna ŋaa ma tinteeŋ hagɩla kakumo toruko sɩɩŋ bʋlɩa a kaa viiri. A chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ nyɩgɛ kɩaa pɩ vene koo a kpaarɛ vene kala, see La TƖƖNA dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: But I pray that the Lord will forgive me when I go into the temple of the god Rimmon and bow down there with the king of Syria.”
translation_verse: Ama mɩɩ sʋl La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ joŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ chɛmɛ: Dɩ mɩ nɛ pɛ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ Siiria kuoro lɛ a kɛnʋ jʋʋ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rimoŋ dɩ-kpaarɩŋ, dɩ ʋ kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ a yelli mɩ vaaŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ ma ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ La TƖƖNA joŋo chɛmɛ.”

english_verse: “Go on home, and don't worry about that,” Elisha replied. Then Naaman left. Elisha Places a Curse on Gehazi After Naaman had gone only a short distance,
translation_verse: Elaasa bʋl, “Ʋ zɔmɔ, ŋ jaŋ mʋ woruŋ.” Naamaŋ sɩ vɛnɛ mʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: Gehazi said to himself, “Elisha let that Syrian off too easy. He should have taken Naaman's gift. I swear by the living Lord that I will talk to Naaman myself and get something from him.”
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Elaasa tɩntɩnna Gehazi bʋl ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ leŋe Naamaŋ nɩɩ sɩma nɛ, ʋ sɩ bɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ kaa kɔ dɩ ʋ pʋ kʋŋkala laa, La TƖƖNA sɩ weye wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ kiri ʋ libe a laa kʋŋ ʋ teeŋ.”

english_verse: So he hurried after Naaman. When Naaman saw Gehazi running after him, he got out of his chariot to meet him. Naaman asked, “Is everything all right?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Gehazi kire to Naamaŋ harɩŋ. Ʋ sɩ na dɩ ʋ fá kʋkɔ ʋ teeŋ, ʋ tuu ʋ jaaba toruko lɛ a chemu a pɩɛsʋ, “Ba fɩɛlaa?”

english_verse: “Yes,” Gehazi answered. “But my master has sent me to tell you about two young prophets from the hills of Ephraim. They came asking for help, and now Elisha wants to know if you would give them
translation_verse: Gehazi bʋl, “Ba fɩɛla nɛ. Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ nɛ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩŋ, ‘Bapʋɔsɛ biisiŋ balɩa nɛ lɩɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa tʋɔŋ Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ a kɔ. Ʋ sɩ dɩ ŋ pɩmɛ warɩpʋla bʋɩ batori arɩ gɛrɩ-laalaa tʋŋ bʋlɩa dɩ ʋ pɩba.’ ”

english_verse: “Sure,” Naaman replied. “But why don't you take twice that amount of silver?” He convinced Gehazi to take it all, then put the silver in two bags. He handed the bags and the clothes to his two servants, and they carried them for Gehazi.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Naamaŋ bʋl, “Ŋ jaŋ wuo laa warɩpʋla magɛ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ daga naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa a pɛ gɛrɩ-laalɩa-la lɛ.” Naamaŋ pɛsɛ Gehazi lɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ a vɔɔ warɩpʋla-la bɔtɔ balɩa a pɛ gɛrɩ-laalaa tʋŋ bʋlɩa lɛ a joŋo chʋŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa balɩa ba kaa laa Gehazi sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: When they reached the hill where Gehazi lived, he took the bags from the servants and placed them in his house, then sent the men away. After they had gone,
translation_verse: Gehazi sɩ kʋ yi dundolo-la nyuŋ Elaasa sɩ hɛ, ʋ laa kɩalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ teeŋ a joŋo bil dɩa lɛ, aŋ taba ba viiri.

english_verse: Gehazi went in and stood in front of Elisha, who asked, “Gehazi, where have you been?” “Nowhere, sir,” Gehazi answered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka Gehazi jʋʋ a chɩŋ ʋ nɩhɩaŋ Elaasa sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ pɩɛsʋ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ lɩɩ Gehazi?” Ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ lee-kala mʋa.”

english_verse: Elisha asked, “Don't you know that my spirit was there when Naaman got out of his chariot to talk with you? Gehazi, you have no right to accept money or clothes, olive orchards or vineyards, sheep or cattle, or servants.
translation_verse: Elaasa bɩra pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ bɩ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ dɩma naŋ nɛɛ, bʋa-la lɛ Naamaŋ sɩ tuu ʋ jaaba toruko nyuŋ a kʋ chemiŋ? Bʋa deeŋ lɛ nɛ maga dɩ ŋ laa moribiee arɩ gɛnnɩŋ, Olif tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ arɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ, piesee, arɩ nɛsɩŋ, koo tɩntɩnnaa?

english_verse: Because of what you've done, Naaman's leprosy will now be on you and your descendants forever!” Suddenly, Gehazi's skin became white with leprosy, and he left.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa Naamaŋ dayalɩbɩɩ-la jaŋ mɩɩra jʋʋ ŋ dɩ ŋ doho nɩaa a kaa mʋ wuu.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Gehazi leŋ Elaasa aŋ lɩɩ. Dayalɩbɩɩ-la kɛnʋ, ʋ yaraa kala pʋllɛ a nagɛ kuŋkunuŋ.

english_verse: One day the prophets said to Elisha, “The place where we meet with you is too small.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩ hɛ Elaasa teeŋ bʋla pʋ, “Lee-la la sɩɩ hilimu muuro nɛ a pɩla.

english_verse: Why don't we build a new meeting place near the Jordan River? Each of us could get some wood, then we could build it.” “That's a good idea,” Elisha replied, “get started.”
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ la mʋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la leriŋ dɩ la kʋŋkala keri doluŋ a kaa kʋ saa la dɩ-hilimii-la dɩ ʋ jal.” Elaasa bʋl, “Ʋ zɔmɔ, má mʋ.”

english_verse: “Aren't you going with us?” one of the prophets asked. “Yes, I'll go,” Elisha answered,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba dɔŋɔ pɩɛsɛ, “Ŋ bɩ jaŋ to dɩ la mʋʋ?” Elaasa bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ mʋ.”

english_verse: and he left with them. They went to the Jordan River and began chopping down trees.
translation_verse: Ʋ to mʋ. Ba sɩ mʋ yi Jɔdaŋ a suomo kikeri daasɩŋ,

english_verse: “Where did it fall in?” Elisha asked. The prophet pointed to the place, and Elisha cut a stick and threw it into the water at that spot. The ax head floated to the top of the water.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elaasa pɩɛsʋ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ʋ tel?” Ʋ dagʋ lee-la, Elaasa keri daaŋ a yuo hɛ nɩmɛ. Saa-bii-la kʋ lɩɩ daŋ lɩɩŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: “Now get it,” Elisha told him. And the prophet reached in and grabbed it. Elisha Stops an Invasion of the Syrian Army
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Lɩɩsɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la mʋ a lɩɩsɛ saa-la. Elaasa leŋe Siiria tɩŋŋaa nyʋlɩmɛ

english_verse: Time after time, when the king of Syria was at war against the Israelites, he met with his officers and announced, “I've decided where we will set up camp.”
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ Siiria kuoro chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ yuo Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Ʋ dɩ ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ hɔnɔ vʋʋrɛ. Ʋ dagɛba lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋmoo buguŋ.

english_verse: Each time, Elisha would send this warning to the king of Israel: “Don't go near there. That's where the Syrian troops have set up camp.”
translation_verse: Elaasa tɩŋ ba bʋla pɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro: “Pʋpɔ dɩ ŋ sɩ́ lee-la mʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩmɛ nɛ Siiria tɩŋŋaa pɔ.”

english_verse: The king of Syria was furious when he found out what was happening. He called in his officers and asked, “Which one of you has been telling the king of Israel our plans?”
translation_verse: Siiria kuoro sɩ kʋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa lɛ, ʋ baanɩŋ chaasa sii. Ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ a pɩɛsɛba, “Ma jaŋ wuo dagɛmɛ la tʋɔŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ la bʋbʋɔŋ ta a pɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro?”

english_verse: “None of us, Your Majesty,” one of them answered. “It's an Israelite named Elisha. He's a prophet, so he can tell his king everything—even what you say in your own room.”
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la dɔŋɔ bʋl, “Kuoro, la kʋŋkala dee, Elaasa nɛ, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la sɩ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ yie wuo bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ paala bʋl ŋ dɩpɩnɩŋ ma lɛ a pɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro.”

english_verse: “Find out where he is!” the king ordered. “I'll send soldiers to bring him here.” They learned that Elisha was in the town of Dothan and reported it to the king.
translation_verse: Siiria kuoro bʋl, “Má mʋ chɛ na lee-la ʋ sɩ hɛ, dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ ba mʋ kɛnʋ.” Ba mʋ aŋ mɩɩra kʋ bʋla pʋ, “Ʋ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Dotaŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: He ordered his best troops to go there with horses and chariots. They marched out during the night and surrounded the town.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ hɛ laalɩyuori-duoruŋ, ba paa janɩŋ arɩ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba mʋ. Ba mʋ tɩtaŋɩŋ a golli taŋ-la kala chu.

english_verse: When Elisha's servant got up the next morning, he saw that Syrian troops had the town surrounded. “Sir, what are we going to do?” he asked.
translation_verse: Elaasa tɩntɩnna sɩ sii chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla, ʋ na dɩ laalɩyuoroo golli taŋ-la kala chu arɩ janɩŋ arɩ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba. Ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ-la ŋmoo niiŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, bɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaa?”

english_verse: “Don't be afraid,” Elisha answered. “There are more troops on our side than on theirs.”
translation_verse: Elaasa bʋl, “Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ, la laalɩyuoroo nɛ yʋga a kɩɩ ba laalɩyuoroo.”

english_verse: Then he prayed, “Lord, please help him to see.” And the Lord let the servant see that the hill was covered with fiery horses and flaming chariots all around Elisha.
translation_verse: Elaasa sʋl La TƖƖNA a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA, suri mɩ tɩntɩnnʋ-la sɩaa dɩ ʋ wuo na.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA suri ʋ sɩaa. Ʋ beŋ dundolo nyuŋ a na dɩ janɩŋ arɩ janɩŋ torukoba sɩ kɛŋ nyiniŋ golli Elaasa chu.

english_verse: As the Syrian army came closer, Elisha prayed, “Lord, make those soldiers blind!” And the Lord blinded them with a bright light.
translation_verse: Siiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo sɩ kʋ kpagʋ, Elaasa bɩra sʋl La TƖƖNA a bʋl, “Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, leŋ dɩ nɩaa deemba nyʋlɩmɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ ba nyʋlɩmɛ, arɩ Elaasa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Elisha told the enemy troops, “You've taken the wrong road and are in the wrong town. Follow me. I'll lead you to the man you're looking for.” Elisha led them straight to the capital city of Samaria.
translation_verse: Elaasa bʋla pɩba, “Wombii-la dee ŋ-la, taŋ-la ma ma sɩɩ chɛ dee ŋ-la. Má to mɩ harɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ kɛmma mʋ dagɛ nɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ chɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ mɩɩra kɛmba mʋ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Samarɩa.

english_verse: When all the soldiers were inside the city, Elisha prayed, “Lord, now let them see again.” The Lord let them see that they were standing in the middle of Samaria.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoro-la kala sɩ kʋ jʋʋ Samarɩa, Elaasa bɩra bʋl, “La TƖƖNA, suri nɩaa deemba sɩaa dɩ ba wuo nɩna.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA suri ba sɩaa, ba na dɩ ba hɛ Samarɩa tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ.

english_verse: The king of Israel saw them and asked Elisha, “Should I kill them, sir?”
translation_verse: Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro sɩ naba, ʋ pɩɛsɛ Elaasa, “Mɩ nyɩmma, mɩ kpʋbaa?”

english_verse: “No!” Elisha answered. “You didn't capture these troops in battle, so you have no right to kill them. Instead, give them something to eat and drink and let them return to their leader.”
translation_verse: Elaasa bʋl, “Sɩ́ ba kpʋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bɩ tokobiiŋ koo toŋ kaa yuo kɛsɛ laal-baga lɛ. Pɩba kʋdiilee dɩ ba dii a pɩba kɩaa ma dɩ ba nyʋa aŋ mɩɩra mʋ ba nɩhɩaŋ teeŋ.”

english_verse: The king ordered a huge meal to be prepared for Syria's army, and when they finished eating, he let them go. For a while, the Syrian troops stopped invading Israel's territory. King Benhadad of Syria Attacks Samaria
translation_verse: Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro leŋ ba ŋaa kʋdiilee yʋgɛ ʋ pɩ Siiria laalɩyuoro-la ba dii aŋ nyʋa, ka ʋ taba ba mɩɩra mʋ ba nɩhɩaŋ teeŋ. Ba sɩ mʋa, Siiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo naaŋ bɩra bɩ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ nʋɔsa. Laalɩŋ golli Samarɩa tinteeŋ, losuŋ jʋʋ

english_verse: Some time later, King Benhadad of Syria called his entire army together, then they marched to Samaria and attacked.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ bʋa kʋbala lɛ, Siiria kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Beŋ-Hadad yɩrɛ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba mʋ yuo Iziral tɩŋŋaa a gollo chu Samarɩa.

english_verse: They kept up the attack until there was nothing to eat in the city. In fact, a donkey's head cost
translation_verse: Ba gollo chu taŋ-la a dieni nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ losuŋ jʋʋ. Ba yallɛ kakumo nyuŋ warɩpʋla mahɩŋ banɛsɛ, a yallɛ suonoo nɩsɩŋ sɩɩŋ ma warɩpʋla banɔŋ.

english_verse: One day as the king of Israel was walking along the top of the city wall, a woman shouted to him, “Please, Your Majesty, help me!”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro to ba taŋ jebiiŋ nyuŋ bɩbal, ŋɩɩ nɛ haal kʋbala ŋmoo niiŋ ʋ teeŋ a bʋl, “Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, kuoro mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, pɛ mɩ lɛ.”

english_verse: “Let the Lord help you!” the king said. “Do you think I have grain or wine to give you?”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩ haal-la, “Dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ bɩ ŋ lɛ pɛ, ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa a pɛ ŋ lɛ? Mɩ bɩ kʋdiilii koo sɩnɩŋ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ pɩŋ.”

english_verse: Then he asked, “What's the matter anyway?” The woman answered, “Another woman and I were so hungry that we agreed to eat our sons. She said if we ate my son one day, we could eat hers the next day.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro pɩɛsɛ haal-la, “Bɛɛ nɩɩ walɩmɩŋ?” Haal-la bʋl, “Mɩ dɩ mɩ ha-dɔŋ nɛ losuŋ kɛŋ, la sɛɩ dɩ la chaŋ la biiriŋ. Ʋ sɩ dɩ mɩ joŋ mɩ bie dɩ la chaŋ jɩnɩŋ, ka dɩ taŋ pʋl dɩ la chaŋ ʋ ma bie.

english_verse: So yesterday we cooked my son and ate him. But today when I went to her house to eat her son, she had hidden him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ mɩ bie chɔ la chaŋ. Ka taŋ pʋl mɩ mʋ ʋ dɩa dɩ la chaŋ ʋ ma bie, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ bie faa.”

english_verse: The king tore off his clothes in sorrow, and since he was on top of the city wall, the people saw that he was wearing sackcloth underneath.
translation_verse: Kuoro sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ tʋɔŋ chei ʋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛrɩŋ kɩɛsɛ. Ʋ fa sɩɩ vɛŋ jebiiŋ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, nɩaa na dɩ tʋɔ-chei gɛrɩŋ nɛ ʋ fa laalɛ aŋ laalɛ gɛrɩŋ daŋ.

english_verse: He said, “I pray that God will punish me terribly, if Elisha's head is still on his shoulders by this time tomorrow.”
translation_verse: Kuoro bʋl, “A leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA dɔgɩsɛmɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ Safat nanʋala Elaasa nyuŋ kere jɩnɩŋ.”

english_verse: Then he sent a messenger to Elisha. Elisha was home at the time, and the important leaders of Israel were meeting with him. Even before the king's messenger arrived, Elisha told the leaders, “That murderer is sending someone to cut off my head. When you see him coming, shut the door and don't let him in. I'm sure the king himself will be right behind him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro tɩŋ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ mʋ Elaasa teeŋ. Ʋ mʋa dɩ ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ hɔŋ ʋ dɩa lɛ. Elaasa bʋla pɩ nɩhɩasɩ-la, “Má bee na, nɩkpʋʋra tɩŋ nʋʋ nɛ ʋ kʋkɔ dɩ ʋ keri mɩ nyuŋ. Dɩ tɩndaarʋ-la nɛ kɔ, má kɛŋ boiŋ yagɛ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ jʋʋ. Kuoro ma tɩtɩa jaŋ kiri tɩɩna harɩŋ kɔ.”

english_verse: Before Elisha finished talking, the messenger came up and said, “The Lord has made all these terrible things happen to us. Why should I think he will help us now?”
translation_verse: Elaasa fa ha sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩba ŋɩɩ, dɩ tɩndaarʋ-la kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Kuoru-la ma kɔ a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ deemba kala ŋaa la lɛ, bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ la jaŋ bɩra gbɛrʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ la lɛ?”

english_verse: Elisha answered, “I have a message for you. The Lord promises that tomorrow here in Samaria, you will be able to buy a large sack of flour or two large sacks of barley for almost nothing.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elaasa bʋl, “Má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla: La TƖƖNA sɩ chie bʋa deeŋ tɩtɩa lɛ, ŋ jaŋ wuo joŋ warɩpʋla kʋbala a yɔɔ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ gbaŋa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, koo a joŋ warɩpʋla balɩa a yɔɔ mɩaa gbansɩŋ batori Samarɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: The chief officer there with the king replied, “I don't believe it! Even if the Lord sent a rainstorm, it couldn't produce that much grain by tomorrow.” “You will see it happen, but you won't eat any of the food,” Elisha warned him. The Syrian Army Stops Its Attack
translation_verse: Kuoro nanzɔɔ bʋla pɩ Elaasa, “Mɩ-na bɩ laa dii, dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ paala suri wɩa-nyuŋ a leŋ dɩ mɩaa chuchuri ma, wɩɩŋ deeŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa.” Elaasa bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ŋ na kʋdiile-la arɩ ŋ sɩɩŋ, ama ŋ bɩ jaŋ dii ba kʋŋkala.” Ba giri laalɩŋ

english_verse: About the same time, four men with leprosy were just outside the gate of Samaria. They said to each other, “Why should we sit here, waiting to die?
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ dayalɩmaa banɛsɛ fa hɔŋ Samarɩa boi-baalɩŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ dayalɩma-la pɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ la jaŋ hɔŋ daha deeŋ deeŋ a mʋ sʋʋ?

english_verse: There's nothing to eat in the city, so we would starve if we went inside. But if we stay out here, we will die for sure. Let's sneak over to the Syrian army camp and surrender. They might kill us, but they might not.”
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ jʋʋ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ, la bɩ jaŋ na kʋŋkala a dii, losuŋ jaŋ kpʋla. Dɩ la nɛ bɩra hɔŋ daha ma, la jaŋ sʋʋ. Má leŋ dɩ la kɛŋ la tɩtɩa a mʋ hɛ Siiria tɩmma-la laalɩyuoroo nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ kpʋla, ʋ kala nɛ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ba nɛ bɩra lenla ma, ʋ kala nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: They said to each other, “This isn't right. Today is a day to celebrate, and we haven't told anyone else what has happened. If we wait until morning, we will be punished. Let's go to the king's palace at once and tell the good news.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ, “La bɩ woruŋ ka ŋaa. Jɩnɩŋ ŋaa tapʋl zɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ magɛ la dʋndʋŋ. Dɩ la nɛ bɩ bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala ka dɩ taŋ pʋl, ba jaŋ dɔgɩsɛla. Má leŋ dɩ la mʋ kuoro dɩa a bʋl wɩɩ-la pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ.”

english_verse: They went back to Samaria and shouted up to the guards at the gate, “We've just come from the Syrian army camp, and all the soldiers are gone! The tents are empty, and the horses and donkeys are still tied up. We didn't see or hear anybody.”
translation_verse: Ba mɩɩra kɔ Samarɩa a yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ jaŋ-la boi-baalɩŋ a bʋla pɩba, “La mʋ Siiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo buguŋ, la bɩ nʋʋkala na, la bɩ nʋʋ dɔmɔ ma nɩa nɩmɛ. Ba janɩŋ arɩ ba kakusuŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ vɔɔ nɩmɛ, ka ba lɛŋŋɛɛ kala ha chɩŋ ba chɩnɩŋ.”

english_verse: The guards reported the news to the king's palace.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ boi-baal-la ma kɛŋ wɩɩ-la mʋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ kuoro dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: The king got out of bed and said to his officers, “I know what those Syrians are doing. They know we're starving, so they're hiding in the fields, hoping we will go out to look for food. When we do, they can capture us and take over our city.”
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ-la tɩtɩa, kuoro sii a bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, “Mɩ jaŋ dagɛma wɩɩ-la Siiria tɩmma-la sɩ ŋaa bʋbʋɔŋ. Ba jɩma losuŋ jʋʋla nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba leŋ ba buguŋ aŋ lɩɩ faa pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ, a bɩɩnɛ arɩ la jaŋ lɩɩ la taŋ lɛ a gɔllɔ chɩchɛ kʋdiilee, dɩ ba mɩɩra kʋ tɔ la hɛ a yuo kɛsɛla a laa la tabalɩŋ.”

english_verse: One of his officers replied, “We have a few horses left—why don't we let some men take five of them and go to the Syrian camp and see what's happening? We're going to die anyway like those who have already died.”
translation_verse: Ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ hɩasɩ-la dɔŋɔ bʋl, “Leŋ dɩ la tɩŋ nɩaa dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ janɩ-la sɩ ka, kɩaa banɔŋ, a kaa mʋ Siiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la buguŋ a na wɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka jaŋ lɛ sʋʋŋ puula nɛ a nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ sʋʋ.”

english_verse: They found two chariots, and the king commanded the men to find out what had happened to the Syrian troops.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ nɩaa a pɩba janɩŋ torukoba balɩa arɩ janɩŋ, kuoro tɩmba a bʋl, “Má mʋ na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa Siiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la lɛ.”

english_verse: The men rode as far as the Jordan River. All along the way they saw clothes and equipment that the Syrians had thrown away as they escaped. Then they went back to the king and told him what they had seen.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ vɛŋ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ a mʋ yi Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, a na Siiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la fá a gaarɛ ba gɛnnɩŋ arɩ ba kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ta wombiiŋ lɛ. Tɩndaara-la mɩɩra kʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ na a pɩ kuoro.

english_verse: At once the people went to the Syrian camp and carried off what was left. They took so much that a large sack of flour and two large sacks of barley sold for almost nothing, just as the Lord had promised.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa mʋ paa Siiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo buguŋ kɩaa kala. Ba yallɛ munuŋ gbaŋa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ warɩpʋla kʋbala, a yallɛ mɩaa gbansɩŋ batori ma warɩpʋla kʋbala, arɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The king of Israel had put his chief officer in charge of the gate, but he died when the people trampled him as they rushed out of the city.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro joŋ ʋ nanzɔɔ-la hɛ dɩ ʋ pʋpɔ boi-baal-la. Nɩaa girige lɩɩ a nʋɔsʋ kpʋ boi-la niiŋ, arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Elaasa fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ kuoro sɩ kɔ ʋ dɩa.

english_verse: But the officer refused to believe that even the Lord could do that. So Elisha warned him that he would see it happen, but would not eat any of the food.
translation_verse: Kuoro nanzɔɔ fa bʋla pɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Elaasa, “Mɩ-na bɩ laa dii, dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ paala suri wɩa-nyuŋ a leŋ dɩ mɩaa chuchuuri ma, wɩɩŋ deeŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elaasa ma fa bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ jaŋ na kʋdiile-la arɩ ŋ sɩɩŋ, ama ŋ bɩ jaŋ diiba.”

english_verse: And that's exactly what happened—the officer was trampled to death.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ sɛnɛ ŋaa baal-la lɛ. Nɩaa nʋɔsʋ kpʋ Samarɩa boi-baalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then she returned to Israel and immediately begged the king to give back her house and property.
translation_verse: Jɩ-pɛɩ-la dɩdɛrɩŋ, haal-la mɩɩra kɔ Iziral tinteeŋ a mʋ sʋl kuoro dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ dɩa arɩ ʋ tinteeŋ pʋ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the king was asking Gehazi the servant of Elisha about the amazing things Elisha had been doing.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ kuoro ka pɩɛsɛ Elaasa tɩntɩnna Gehazi wɩaa a mʋʋ tɩgɛ wʋduoru-la kala Elaasa sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: While Gehazi was telling him that Elisha had brought a dead boy back to life, the woman and her son arrived. “Here's the boy, Your Majesty,” Gehazi said. “And this is his mother.”
translation_verse: Gehazi sɩ bʋla pɩpɩ kuoro ŋɩɩ Elaasa sɩ chɩsɛ bie sʋʋŋ lɛ, dɩ haal-la tɩtɩa, nɩɩ-la bie Elaasa sɩ chɩsa nɛ kʋ jʋʋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ sʋl kuoro a laa ʋ dɩa arɩ ʋ tinteeŋ. Gehazi bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Kuoro mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, na haal-la nɛ ŋ-la nɩɩ-la bie Elaasa sɩ chɩsa sʋʋŋ lɛ, na ʋ bile ma nɛ ŋ-la.”

english_verse: Some time later Elisha went to the capital city of Damascus to visit King Benhadad of Syria, who was sick. And when Benhadad was told he was there,
translation_verse: Harɩŋ, bʋa kʋbala lɛ Elaasa mʋ Damasɩkʋs dɩ Siiria kuoro Bɛŋ-Hadad ka wɩɩlʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la kɔ daha nɛ.”

english_verse: Hazael left with forty camel loads of the best things made in Damascus as a gift for Elisha. He found the prophet and said, “Your servant, King Benhadad, wants to know if he will get well.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hazɛɛl sii paa Damasɩkʋs kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a chʋŋ bʋntaŋŋaba mahɩŋ balɩa a kaa mʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa chɔgɩta pɩ Elaasa. Ʋ sɩ mʋ naʋ, ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ tɩntɩnna kuoro Bɛŋ-Hadad nɛ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ pɩɛsɩŋ na arɩ ʋ sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ duorii?”

english_verse: “Tell him he will,” Elisha said to Hazael. “But the Lord has already told me that Benhadad will definitely die.”
translation_verse: Elaasa bʋla pɩ Hazɛɛl, “La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ, ama ŋ-na mʋ bʋla pʋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ duori.”

english_verse: Elisha stared at him until Hazael was embarrassed, then Elisha began crying.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elaasa beŋ Hazɛɛl ŋɩɩ jim, hɩɩsɩŋ kɛŋ Hazɛɛl. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elaasa suomo yiyel.

english_verse: “Sir, why are you crying?” Hazael asked. Elisha answered, “Because I know the terrible things you will do to the people of Israel. You will burn down their walled cities and slaughter their young men. You will even crush the heads of their babies and rip open their pregnant women.”
translation_verse: Hazɛɛl pɩɛsɛ Elaasa, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ yiyel?” Elaasa bʋl, “Mɩ jɩŋ wʋbɔŋ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ. Ŋ jaŋ nyɩgɛ ba tasɩ-la kala ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli, aŋ kpʋ ba bapʋɔsaa, a paa ba hambiisiŋ vɩɩra yɛrɛ, aŋ kpɛrɛ ba hapuugoo.”

english_verse: “How could I ever do anything like that?” Hazael replied. “I'm only a servant and don't have that kind of power.” “Hazael, the Lord has told me that you will be the next king of Syria.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hazɛɛl bʋl, “Mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna, mɩ bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ.” Elaasa bɩra bʋl, “La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ ŋ nɛ jaŋ dii Siiria tinteeŋ kuoruŋ.”

english_verse: Hazael went back to Benhadad and told him, “Elisha said that you will get well.”
translation_verse: Hazɛɛl ta Elaasa aŋ mɩɩra kɔ Bɛŋ-Hadad teeŋ. Bɛŋ-Hadad pɩɛsʋ, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ Elaasa bʋla pɩŋ?” Hazɛɛl bʋl, “Ʋ sɩ ŋ jaŋ duori.”

english_verse: But the very next day, Hazael got a thick blanket; he soaked it in water and held it over Benhadad's face until he died. Hazael then became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Ama taŋ sɩ pʋla, Hazɛɛl joŋ kuntuŋ a yu lɩɩŋ lɛ, a joŋo chu tɔ Bɛŋ-Hadad sɩaa lɛ, a nyaga kpɛrɛ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ ʋ sʋʋ. Ka ʋ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. Jehoram dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ

english_verse: So Jehoram and his cavalry marched to Zair, where the Edomite army surrounded him and his commanders. During the night he attacked the Edomites, but he was defeated, and his troops escaped to their homes.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehoram sii kɛŋ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba ba mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zayi. Nɩmɛ nɛ Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa tɔ ʋ dɩ nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba-la hɛ. Ama tɩtaŋɩŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba nɩhɩasɩ-la foro fá. Ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala fá pɩsɛ a mʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: While Jehoram was king, the people of Edom rebelled and chose their own king.
translation_verse: Jehoram kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ, Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa fa vɩa dɩ ba to Juda tinteeŋ kuoro nɛ, aŋ ma bil ba kuoro.

english_verse: Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat became king of Judah in Joram's fifth year as king of Israel, while Jehoshaphat was still king of Judah.
translation_verse: Ahab nanʋala Joram sɩ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ jɩ-pɛɩ lɛ nɛ Jehosafat nanʋala Jehoram ma dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ, dɩ Jehosafat nɛ fa ha ŋaa Juda tinteeŋ kuoro.

english_verse: Jehoram disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He married Ahab's daughter and was as sinful as Ahab's family and the kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Jehoram fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa Iziral kuoroo sɩ ŋaa nɛ ʋ jaa Ahab tolo nɛ. Ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa Ahab dɩa nɩaa fa sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: But the Lord refused to destroy Judah, because he had promised his servant David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah.
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA fa tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩnna Devit wɩaa nɛ a bɩ Juda tinteeŋ cheye, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa hɛ niiŋ pʋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ didii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: years old when he became king, and he ruled from Jerusalem for only one year. His mother was Athaliah, a granddaughter of King Omri of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa ha vɩa dɩ ba to Juda nɩaa nɛ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lɩbɩna nɩaa ma vɩa dɩ ba to Juda kuoro.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoram did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Jehoram sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Jehoram died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Ahaziah then became king. King Ahaziah of Judah (
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehoram sʋʋ ba joŋu hugi ʋ nyɩmmaba dɩ-huguŋ Devit tabal-la lɛ. Ka ʋ nanʋala Ahazɩa dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. Ahazɩa dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ

english_verse: Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah in the twelfth year of Joram's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Ahab nanʋala Joram sɩ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ balɩa lɛ nɛ Jehoram nanʋala Ahazɩa ma dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Since Ahaziah was related to Ahab's family, he acted just like them and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ahazɩa naaŋ fa ŋaa Ahab tolo nɛ, ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ ma ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa Ahab dɩa nɩaa fa sɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA teeŋ.

english_verse: Ahaziah went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: Ahazɩa fa to Ahab nanʋala Joram harɩŋ nɛ ba mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ramɔf Gɩlɩad dɩ ba yuo Siiria tɩŋŋaa kuoro Hazɛɛl. Nɩmɛ nɛ Siiria tɩŋŋaa bolimi Joram.

english_verse: so he went to the town of Jezreel to recover. Ahaziah went there to visit him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mɩɩra mʋ ʋ jaŋ Jɛzɩrɛl dɩ ʋ vaarɛ ʋ tɩtɩa. Jehoram nanʋala Ahazɩa sɩ ŋaa Juda kuoro mʋ nɩmɛ dɩ ʋ na ʋ nyanyalaa.

english_verse: One day, Elisha called for one of the other prophets and said: Take this bottle of olive oil and get ready to go to the town of Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Elaasa yɩrɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩ hɛ ʋ teeŋ dɔŋɔ a bʋla pʋ, “Kɛŋ ŋ tembiiŋ vɔɔ ŋ gɛrɩŋ kpɛrɛ a kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a joŋ nʋʋŋ arɩ loŋ deeŋ a mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ramɔf Gɩlɩad.

english_verse: When you get there, find Jehu son of Jehoshaphat and grandson of Nimshi. Take him to a place where the two of you can be alone,
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ mʋa, chɛ na Jehu sɩ ŋaa Jehosafat bie, Nimisi nihiŋ. Kɛnʋ dɩ ma balɩa jʋʋ dɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: then pour olive oil on his head to show that he is the new king. Say to him, “The Lord has chosen you to be king of Israel.” Then leave quickly—don't wait around for anything!
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ jʋa, joŋ nʋʋ-la a wansɛ hɛ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ aŋ bʋl, ‘Ŋ-la nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl: Mɩ lɩɩsɩŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro.’ Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, kɛŋ boiŋ suri a lɩɩ a chaasa fá woruŋ a viiri.”

english_verse: The young prophet left for Ramoth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la sii a mʋ Ramɔf Gɩlɩad.

english_verse: When he arrived, the army officers were meeting together. “Sir, I have a message for you,” he said. “For which one of us?” Jehu asked. “You, sir,” the prophet answered.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mʋa, ʋ na laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ dɩ ba hilime hɔŋ. Ʋ bʋl, “Laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ, mɩ kɛŋ wɩɩ nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩŋ.” Jehu pɩɛsʋ, “La tʋɔŋ kʋbɛɛ?” Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la sɩ, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, ŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: So Jehu got up and went inside. The prophet poured olive oil on Jehu's head and told him: The Lord God of Israel has this message for you: “I am the Lord, and I have chosen you to be king of my people Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehu sii ba jʋʋ dɩa. Ba sɩ jʋa, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la joŋ nʋʋŋ a wansɛ hɛ Jehu nyuŋ lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Mɩ lɩɩsɩŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro.

english_verse: I want you to wipe out the family of Ahab, so Jezebel will be punished for killing the prophets and my other servants.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ kpʋ ŋ nɩhɩaŋ Ahab doho nɩaa kala nɛ, dɩ mɩ to ŋɩɩ lɛ a joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ a fɩɩsɛ Jɛzɛbɛl lɛ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ kpʋ mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ mɩ tɩntɩnnaa wɩaa.

english_verse: Every man and boy in Ahab's family must die, whether slave or free.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ Ahab doho nɩaa baalaa kala sʋʋ nɛ, nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ hambiisiŋ kala, yosuŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩɩ ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: His whole family must be destroyed, just like the families of Jeroboam son of Nebat and Baasha son of Ahijah.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kpʋ Ahab dɩa nɩaa kala, ka dɩ ʋ dɩa nagɛ Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam dɩa arɩ Ahija nanʋala Baasa dɩa.

english_verse: As for Jezebel, her body will be eaten by dogs in the town of Jezreel. There won't be enough left of her to bury.” Then the young prophet opened the door and ran out.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ jaŋ hugi Jɛzɛbɛl, vasɩŋ nɛ jaŋ diiu Jɛzɩrɛl tinteeŋ lɛ.’ ” Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ kɛŋ boiŋ suri a lɩɩ fá.

english_verse: Jehu went back to his officers, and one of them asked, “What did that crazy prophet want? Is everything all right?” “You know him and how he talks,” Jehu answered.
translation_verse: Jehu sɩ mɩɩra mʋ ʋ nɩhɩa-dɔnsʋ-la teeŋ, ba dɔŋɔ pɩɛsʋ, “Ba fɩɛla nɛɛ? Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ nyɩnyɛ tɩɩna deeŋ chɩchɛ ŋ teeŋ?” Jehu bʋl, “Ma jɩŋ baala deeŋ arɩ ʋ wʋbʋl dosunuŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: “No, we don't. What did he say?” they asked. “He had a message from the Lord,” Jehu replied. “He said that the Lord has chosen me to be the next king of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ba bʋl, “Aɩ, la bɩ ʋ wʋbʋlaa jɩŋ, bʋl wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ a pɩla.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Ʋ sɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro.”

english_verse: They quickly grabbed their coats and spread them out on the steps where Jehu was standing. Someone blew a trumpet, and everyone shouted, “Jehu is king!” Jehu Kills Joram and Ahaziah
translation_verse: Ba guu wuri ba gɛnnɩŋ a jɛrɛ lusuŋ chol-sɩɩ-la nyuŋ Jehu sɩ chɩna, aŋ ŋmʋʋ banyile, a bʋl, “Jehu nɛ ŋaa kuoro.” Jehu kpʋ Joram arɩ Ahazɩa

english_verse: When the guard in the watchtower at Jezreel saw Jehu and his men riding up, he shouted to the king, “I see a large group of men coming this way.” Joram ordered, “Send someone out to ask them if this is a friendly visit.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ chɩŋ dɩɩ-leŋii-la nyuŋ aa pɔ Jɛzɩrɛl na Jehu arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo dɩ baa kɔ. Ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ na nɩaa nɛ dɩ baa kɔ.” Joram bʋl, “Má lɩɩsɛ ja-jɩllʋ dɩ ʋ mʋ cheme a pɩɛsɛba naa, ba fɩɛla nɛɛ?”

english_verse: One of the soldiers rode out and said to Jehu, “King Joram wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just stay behind me with the rest of my troops!” About the same time the guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back.”
translation_verse: Ja-jɩllʋ-la jɩl jaaba a mʋ cheŋ Jehu a bʋl, “Kuoro sɩ dɩ mɩ kʋ pɩɛsɩŋ naa: ‘Ba fɩɛla nɛ ma kʋkɔ?’ ” Jehu ma pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɛ fɩɛlɩŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa? Kʋ bala to mɩ dɩ mɩ nɩaa harɩŋ.” Nɩɩ-la sɩ pɔ jaŋ-la bʋl, “Tɩndaarʋ-la yi ba nɛ, ama ʋ bɩra bɩ mɩɩraa kɔ.”

english_verse: So Joram sent out another rider, who rode up to Jehu and said, “The king wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just get behind me with the rest of my troops!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro bɩra tɩŋ nɩ-lɩa ʋ jɩl jaaba mʋ. Ʋ sɩ mʋ chemba, ʋ bʋl, “Kuoro sɩ dɩ mɩ kʋ pɩɛsɩŋ naa: ‘Ba fɩɛla nɛ ma kʋkɔ?’ ” Jehu ma pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɛ fɩɛlɩŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa? Kʋ bala to mɩ dɩ mɩ nɩaa harɩŋ.”

english_verse: The guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back either. Wait a minute! That one man is a reckless chariot driver—it must be Jehu!”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ pɔ ba jaŋ-la bɩra bʋl, “Tɩndaarʋ-la ma yiba nɛ, ama ʋ ma bɩ mɩɩraa kɔ. Gbɛrɛ yei! Nʋʋ nɛ jʋʋ jaaba toruko a faasa fá kʋkɔ a nagɛ nyɩnyɛ tɩɩna. Ʋ nagɛ Jehu nɛ.”

english_verse: Joram commanded, “Get my chariot ready.” Then he and Ahaziah got in their chariots and rode out to meet Jehu. They all met on the land that had belonged to Naboth.
translation_verse: Joram bʋl, “Má ŋaa mɩ jaaba toruko siri.” Ba sɩ ŋaa jaaba toruko-la siri, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro Joram arɩ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Ahazɩa kala jʋʋ ba janɩŋ torukoba a lɩɩ mʋ cheŋ Jehu. Ba mʋ chemu Jɛzɩrɛl tɩŋŋaa baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nabɔf ŋmaŋkaaŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Joram asked, “Jehu, is this a peaceful visit?” “How can there be peace?” Jehu asked. “Your mother Jezebel has caused everyone to worship idols and practice witchcraft.”
translation_verse: Joram sɩ na Jehu ʋ pɩɛsʋ, “Jehu, ba fɩɛlaa nɛ ŋ kʋkɔ?” Jehu ma pɩɛsɛ, “Ɛɛ nɛ yarɩfɩɛlaa jaŋ wuo ŋaa hɛ nɩmɛ, ma sɩ́ bɩ ma naaŋ Jɛzɛbɛl vʋɩyaa arɩ ʋ hɩl-wɩalɩŋ leŋe?”

english_verse: “Ahaziah, let's get out of here!” Joram yelled. “It's a trap!” As Joram tried to escape,
translation_verse: Joram mɩɩra fá, aŋ yɩrɛ Ahazɩa a bʋl, “Nɩbɔŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Jehu shot an arrow. It hit Joram between his shoulders, then it went through his heart and came out his chest. He fell over dead in his chariot.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehu yuo ʋ toŋ a yagɛ Joram sɛmɛ lɛ a jʋʋ kɛŋ ʋ chʋbagɩlɩŋ-buguluŋ ʋ tel ʋ jaaba toruko tʋɔŋ a sʋʋ.

english_verse: Jehu commanded his assistant Bidkar, “Get Joram's body and throw it in the field that Naboth once owned. Do you remember when you and I used to ride side by side behind Joram's father Ahab? It was then that the Lord swore to Ahab that he would be punished in the same field where he had killed Naboth and his sons. So throw Joram's body there, just as the Lord said.”
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ La TƖƖNA fa bʋl, ‘Mɩ dɩa na dɩ ba kpʋ Nabɔf arɩ ʋ biiriŋ ŋmaŋkaaŋ deeŋ lɛ. Mɩ saa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kpʋ ŋ ma ŋmaŋkaaŋ deeŋ tɩtɩa lɛ.’ Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, joŋ Joram kʋsʋʋŋ yuo hɛ ŋmaŋkaa-la lɛ, arɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Ahaziah saw all of this happen and tried to escape to the town of Beth-Haggan, but Jehu caught up with him and shouted, “Kill him too!” So his troops shot Ahaziah with an arrow while he was on the road to Gur near Ibleam. He went as far as Megiddo, where he died.
translation_verse: Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Ahazɩa sɩ na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa, ʋ fá to taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf Hagaŋ dɩɩrɩŋ mʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehu kire to ʋ harɩŋ aŋ kpɩa, “Má kire kpʋʋ ma.” Ba bolimu hɛ ʋ jaaba toruko tʋɔŋ wombii-la sɩɩ mʋ Guu sɩ kpagɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɩbɩlɩam lɛ. Ama ʋ wuo kaa fá jʋʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɛgɩdɔ a sʋʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Ahaziah's officers put his body in a chariot and took it back to Jerusalem, where they buried him beside his ancestors.
translation_verse: Ʋ tɩntɩnnaa joŋ ʋ kʋsʋʋŋ hɛ ʋ jaaba toruko tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ Jerusalɛm a joŋu hugi ʋ nyɩmmaba dɩ-huguŋ, Devit taŋ-la lɛ.

english_verse: Jehu headed toward Jezreel, and when Jezebel heard he was coming, she put on eye shadow and brushed her hair. Then she stood at the window, waiting for him to arrive.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehu mʋ Jɛzɩrɛl. Jɛzɛbɛl sɩ nɩɩ ʋ wɩaa, ʋ ŋaa kɩaa taa ʋ sɩɩ-pʋnaa aŋ vɔɔ ʋ nyuŋ, aŋ to tokoro a nyinyilimi.

english_verse: As he walked through the city gate, she shouted down to him, “Why did you come here, you murderer? To kill the king? You're no better than Zimri!”
translation_verse: Jehu sɩ mʋ jʋjʋʋ taŋ-la boi-baalɩŋ, Jɛzɛbɛl pɩɛsɛ, “Ba fɩɛla nɛ ŋ nɩkpʋʋra deeŋ kɔ dahaa? Zimiri nɛ ŋ ŋaa, a kpʋkpʋ ŋ nɩhɩaŋ?”

english_verse: He looked up toward the window and asked, “Is anyone up there on my side?” A few palace workers stuck their heads out of a window,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehu beŋ tokoro-la leriŋ aŋ pɩɛsɛ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ?” Ba-ferisiŋ balɩa koo batori kʋ nyilimi.

english_verse: and Jehu shouted, “Throw her out the window!” They threw her down, and her blood splattered on the walls and on the horses that trampled her body.
translation_verse: Jehu bʋl, “Má joŋu yuo ta dɩ ʋ kʋ tuu.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋu yuo ta ʋ kʋ tuu tele sʋʋ. Jehu kɛŋ ʋ janɩŋ arɩ toruko a nʋɔsɛ Jɛzɛbɛl bal. Ʋ chalɩŋ jaasɛ a hɛ jeeŋ arɩ janɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Jehu left to get something to eat and drink. Then he told some workers, “Even though she was evil, she was a king's daughter, so make sure she has a proper burial.”
translation_verse: Jehu kʋ jʋʋ ʋ kuoru dɩa a dii kʋdiilee aŋ nyʋa kɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa, “Má mʋ joŋ ha-bɔŋ-la hugi woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ŋaa kuoro tolo nɛ.”

english_verse: But when they went out to bury her body, they found only her skull, her hands, and her feet.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋa dɩ ba joŋu hugi, ba bɩ ʋ jesiŋ kala na, see ʋ nyu-kuŋkogulo, ʋ naasɩŋ arɩ ʋ na-chɩgɩsɩŋ haŋgbelee.

english_verse: They reported this to Jehu, and he said, “The Lord told Elijah the prophet that Jezebel's body would be eaten by dogs right here in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mɩɩra kʋ bʋla pɩ Jehu, “La TƖƖNA to ʋ tɩntɩnna Ɩlaaja Tisibi tɩɩna-la lɛ nɛ a bʋl arɩ vasɩŋ nɛ jaŋ dii Jɛzɛbɛl kʋsʋʋŋ Jɛzɩrɛl tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And he warned that her bones would be spread all over the ground like manure, so that no one could tell who it was.”
translation_verse: Jɛzɛbɛl kʋsʋʋŋ jaŋ pɩsɛ Jɛzɩrɛl tinteeŋ kala a nagɛ nɩsʋrʋŋ, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wuo jɩŋ arɩ Jɛzɛbɛl nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Your town is strong, and you're protected by chariots and an armed cavalry. And I know that King Ahab's descendants live there with you. So as soon as you read this letter,
translation_verse: “Ma nɩɩ beŋ kuoro doho nɩaa, ma kɛŋ janɩŋ arɩ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba nɛ, a kɛŋ laalɩyuori kɩaa, aŋ saa kɛrɛ golli ma taŋ ma. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ ma nɛ laa teniŋ deeŋ,

english_verse: choose the best person for the job and make him the next king. Then be prepared to defend Ahab's family.
translation_verse: má lɩɩsɛ ma nɩhɩaŋ biiriŋ tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ ma sɩ bene dɩ ʋ maga, a leŋ dɩ ʋ dii ʋ nyɩmma kuoruŋ, ka ma chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ a yuo laa Ahab doho nɩaa.”

english_verse: The officials and leaders read the letters and were very frightened. They said to each other, “Jehu has already killed King Joram and King Ahaziah! We have to do what he says.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ fawʋllʋŋ chaasa kɛmba ba bʋl, “Dɩ kuoroo balɩa nɛ paala bɩ wuo yuo dii Jehu, ɛɛ nɛ saa la-na jaŋ ŋaa a wuou?”

english_verse: The prime minister, the mayor of the city, as well as the other leaders and Ahab's supporters, sent this answer to Jehu, “We are your servants, Your Majesty, and we will do whatever you tell us. But it's not our place to choose someone to be king. You do what you think is best.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ, arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ-la sɩɩ beŋ taŋ-la, taŋ-la nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ Ahab doho nɩaa tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Jehu, “La ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa la jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ na-kala ŋ sɩ bʋla. La-na bɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nʋʋkala dɩ ʋ ŋaa la kuoro, ŋ-na ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ŋ sɩ cho.”

english_verse: Jehu then wrote another letter which said, “If you are on my side and will obey me, then prove it. Bring me the heads of the descendants of Ahab! And be here in Jezreel by this time tomorrow.” The
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehu bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ teŋ lɩa a pɩba a bʋl, “Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa aa nɩɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa, má keri ma nɩhɩaŋ biiriŋ nyusuŋ chie bʋa deeŋ lɛ a kaa kɔ Jɛzɩrɛl a pɩmɛ.” Bʋa deeŋ lɛ dɩ kuoro Ahab biiriŋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii-la fa hɛ taŋ-la nɩhɩasɩŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ ba bibemba.

english_verse: When Jehu was told what had happened, he said, “Put the heads in two piles at the city gate, and leave them there until morning.”
translation_verse: Tɩndaara kʋ bʋla pɩ Jehu, “Ba kɛŋ kuori-biiri-la nyusuŋ kɔ nɛ.” Jehu bʋl, “Má jomba bil puguloo balɩa taŋ-la boi-baalɩŋ lɛ dɩ taŋ pʋl.”

english_verse: The next morning, Jehu went out and stood where everyone could hear him, and he said, “You people are not guilty of anything. I'm the one who plotted against Joram and had him killed. But who killed all these men?
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla chʋchʋɔŋ, Jehu sii lɩɩ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ lee-la, “Ma nɩaa deemba bɩ wɩɩkala cheye. Mɩ-na nɛ sii chɩŋ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ kuoro Joram lɛ a kpʋʋ. Ka nɩaa deemba ma saa, kʋbɛɛ nɛ kpʋba?

english_verse: Then Jehu killed the rest of Ahab's relatives living in Jezreel, as well as his highest officials, his priests, and his closest friends. No one in Ahab's family was left alive in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehu kpʋ Ahab doho nɩkaanaa kala sɩ hɛ Jɛzɩrɛl lɛ. Ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ arɩ ʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpaarɛ vesiŋ. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ ka.

english_verse: Jehu left for Samaria, and along the way, he met some relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah at a place where shepherds meet. He asked, “Who are you?” “We are relatives of Ahaziah,” they answered. “We're going to visit his family.”
translation_verse: nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ cheŋ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Ahazɩa naambiiriŋ dɔnsʋŋ a pɩɛsɛba, “Kʋbɛɛba nɛ ma ŋaa?” Ba bʋl, “La ŋaa Ahazɩa naambiiriŋ nɛ. Laa mʋ dɩ la lɔllɛ Kuoro Ahab arɩ ʋ haala Jɛzɛbɛl dɩa nɩaa nɛ.”

english_verse: “Take them alive!” Jehu said to his officers. So they grabbed them and led them to the well near the shepherds' meeting place, where they killed all
translation_verse: Jehu bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, “Má kɛsɛba.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛsɛba, ba nɩaa mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ balɩa a kpʋba vil kʋbala sɩ kpagɛ nɩmɛ bʋbʋɔŋ. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ ka.

english_verse: As Jehu went on, he saw Jehonadab son of Rechab coming to meet him. Jehu greeted him, then said, “Jehonadab, I'm on your side. Are you on mine?” “Yes, I am.” “Then give me your hand,” Jehu answered. He helped Jehonadab into his chariot
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ lɩɩ nɩmɛ, ʋ bɩra mʋ cheŋ baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Jehonadab. Ʋ fa ŋaa Rekab nanʋala nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehu chʋɔlʋ aŋ pɩɛsɛ, “Ŋ chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ arɩ mɩ sɩ chɩŋ ŋ harɩŋ ŋɩɩ nɛɛ?” Jehonadab bʋl, “Oo mɩ chɩŋ ŋ harɩŋ nɛ.” Jehu bɩra bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ-na kɛŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ kɔ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehonadab kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ mʋ. Jehu kɛŋ a pɛ ʋ lɛ a lɛrʋ hɛ ʋ laalɩŋ jaaba toruko lɛ.

english_verse: and said, “Come with me and see how faithful I am to the Lord.” They rode together in Jehu's chariot
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bʋl, “Kɔ dɩ la mʋ dɩ ŋ na ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ sɩ maga La TƖƖNA lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba balɩa jɩl Jehu laalɩŋ jaaba toruko-la a mʋ Samarɩa.

english_verse: to Samaria. Jehu killed everyone there who belonged to Ahab's family, as well as all his officials. Everyone in his family was now dead, just as the Lord had promised Elijah. Jehu Kills All the Worshipers of Baal
translation_verse: Ba sɩ yi nɩmɛ, Jehu kpʋ Ahab doho nɩkaana-la ma kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ ka, arɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ to ʋ tɩntɩnna Ɩlaaja lɛ a bʋl ŋɩɩ. Ba kpʋ Baal veŋ-kpaaraa

english_verse: Jehu called together the people in Samaria and said: King Ahab sometimes worshiped Baal, but I will be completely faithful to Baal.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehu yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Samarɩa lɛ hɛ dɔŋɔ a bʋla pɩba, “Kuoro Ahab kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal mʋa nɛ, ama mɩ-na nɛ jaŋ chaasa kpaarʋ.

english_verse: I'm going to offer a huge sacrifice to him. So invite his prophets and priests, and be sure everyone who worships him is there. Anyone who doesn't come will be killed. But this was a trick—Jehu was really planning to kill the worshipers of Baal.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má yɩrɛ Baal kpʋkpaaraa kala arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ tou arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pʋpʋ. Má sɩ́ ba kʋŋkala kere ta, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ chaasa kpaarɛ Baal nɛ woruŋ. Nɩɩ-la kala nɛ bɩ kɔ, mɩ jaŋ kpʋ tɩɩna.” Jehu ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ nyɩsa kpʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal nɛ.

english_verse: He said, “Announce a day of worship for Baal!” After the day had been announced,
translation_verse: Jehu bʋl, “Má hɛ tapʋlʋŋ a heele pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ to Baal, dɩ ba kʋ hilimi a kpaarʋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba heele bʋl wɩɩ-la.

english_verse: Jehu sent an invitation to everyone in Israel. All the worshipers of Baal came, and the temple was filled from one end to the other.
translation_verse: Jehu leŋ ba tɩma yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ to Baal Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ ba kɔ, ba kʋŋkala bɩ ka. Ba kʋ jʋʋ su Baal dɩa kala pɩlɩm pɩlɩm.

english_verse: Jehu told the official in charge of the sacred robes to make sure that everyone had a robe to wear.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehu bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ gɛnnɩ-la ba sɩ laala a kpʋkpaarɛ Baal, “Paa gɛnnɩ-la kaa kʋ lɩɩ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Baal.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ paa kʋ lɩɩ pɩba.

english_verse: Jehu and Jehonadab went into the temple, and Jehu said to the crowd, “Look around and make sure that only the worshipers of Baal are here. No one who worships the Lord is allowed in.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ, Jehu arɩ Rekab nanʋala Jehonadab ma jʋʋ Baal dɩa-la tʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehu bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpaarɛ Baal, “Má beŋ ma tʋɔŋ woruŋ a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnnaa guoli ma tʋɔŋ, see ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Baal dʋndʋŋ.”

english_verse: As soon as Jehu finished offering the sacrifice, he told the guards and soldiers, “Come in and kill them! Don't let anyone escape.” They slaughtered everyone in the crowd and threw the bodies outside. Then they went back into the temple
translation_verse: Jehu sɩ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩ-sʋla-la dɛrɛ, ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɔ leriŋ arɩ ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ: “Má jʋʋ kpʋ ba kala, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba kʋbala ma fá lɛl.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jʋʋ a kpʋ ba kala. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɔ leriŋ arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ lɛrɛ ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ kaa lɩɩ dɩ-jalɩŋ, aŋ mɩɩra jʋʋ vene-la dɩa sɩpaaŋ,

english_verse: and carried out the image of Baal. They burned it
translation_verse: a paa Baal tabɩa-la kala ba sɩ bile dɩa-la tʋɔŋ a kaa kʋ lɩɩ nyɩgɛ.

english_verse: and broke it into pieces, then they completely destroyed Baal's temple. And since that time, it's been nothing but a public toilet.
translation_verse: Ba ŋmoo vene-la kɩaa yɛrɛ aŋ ŋmoo Baal dɩa-la ma lo, a kaa bɩrɩmɛ bɩnɩŋ dɩa, arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala lee-la ha ŋaa bɩnɩŋ dɩa nɛ.

english_verse: But he did not stop the worship of the gold statues of calves at Dan and Bethel that Jeroboam had made for the people to worship.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ fa bɩ Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam wʋbɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa ba tɩtɩa leŋe. Ʋ fa haa kpaarɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ libi nɛ-bel-biisi-la bil tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛtɛl arɩ Daŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Later the Lord said, “Jehu, you have done right by destroying Ahab's entire family, just as I had planned. So I will make sure that the next four kings of Israel will come from your own family.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Jehu, “A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa woruŋ mɩ teeŋ a to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ fa sɩ bɩɩna dɩ mɩ ŋaa Ahab dɩa nɩaa lɛ, ŋ doho nɩaa jaŋ dii Iziral tinteeŋ kuoruŋ naansɩɩŋ bʋnɛsɛ a tɩgɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: But Jehu did not completely obey the commands of the Lord God of Israel. Instead, he kept doing the sinful things that Jeroboam had caused the Israelites to do. Jehu Dies
translation_verse: Jehu bɩ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile to arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala. Ʋ bɩ Jerobuam wʋbɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa ba tɩtɩa leŋe.

english_verse: In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel's territory. King Hazael of Syria defeated the Israelites and took control
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA suomo leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ mumuuri. Siiria kuoro Hazɛɛl yuo dii Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ba tinteeŋ sɛmɛ na-kala lɛ,

english_verse: Everything else Jehu did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Jehu sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ arɩ wʋduoru-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Iziral kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Jehu died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz became king.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehu sʋʋ. Ba joŋu hugi ʋ nyɩmmaba dɩ-huguŋ Samarɩa lɛ. Ka ʋ nanʋala Jehuahas dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David and gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Ʋ paa kuoro Devit tiŋŋee arɩ ʋ hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, a pɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought Joash outside, where he placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, while the crowd clapped and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehoyada kɛŋ Ahazɩa nanʋala Jʋas kʋ lɩɩ a joŋ kuoru nyunchuulo chuu, aŋ joŋ teniŋ pʋ. Teŋ-la lɛ nɛ ba ŋmʋnsɛ wombie-la kuoroo sɩ maga dɩ ba to a bibeŋ tintee-la hɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ nʋʋŋ tɩsʋ a dagɛ arɩ ʋ nɛ lɛɛlɛ ŋaa kuoro. Nɩalɩŋ kala porisi nɩsaa aŋ ŋaa goŋ, “A leŋ dɩ kuoro mɩɩsɩŋ duomi.”

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with Jehosheba for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah. Jehoiada Makes Joash King of Judah (
translation_verse: Jʋas arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ benu faa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ jɩsɩŋ balɩdʋ, ka Ahazɩa naaŋ Atalɩa dii kuoruŋ a bibeŋ Juda tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Joash was only seven years old when this happened.
translation_verse: Jʋas fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ nɛ aŋ dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: Joash son of Ahaziah had hidden in the Lord's temple six years. Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada the priest sent for the commanders of the king's special bodyguards and the commanders of the palace guards. They met him at the temple, and he asked them to make a promise in the name of the Lord. Then he brought out Joash
translation_verse: Ʋ jɩ-pɛɩ lɛ nɛ Jehoyada sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara tɩma yɩrɛ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba arɩ laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ kuoro dɩa ba nɩhɩasɩŋ, a kɛmba jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. Jehoyada arɩ ba bil niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ, aŋ ka ʋ leŋ ba ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ ba jaŋ chɩŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ ŋaa lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka ʋ kɛŋ kuoro bile dagɛba.

english_verse: and said to them: Here's what I want you to do. Three of your guard units will be on duty on the Sabbath. I want one unit to guard the palace.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bʋla pɩba, “Wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, ma laalɩyuori bugoo batori nɛ jaŋ tɩŋ, buguŋ dɔŋɔ jaŋ pɔ kuoro dɩa,

english_verse: Another unit will guard Sur Gate, and the third unit will guard the palace gate and relieve the palace guards.
translation_verse: dɩ dɔŋɔ ma pɔ boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Suu. Ka dɩ dɔŋɔ ma pɔ boiŋ nii-la sɩ hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiŋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: The other two guard units are supposed to be off duty on the Sabbath. But I want both of them to stay here at the temple and protect King Joash.
translation_verse: Ma bugo-la balɩa sɩ bɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa ka kɔ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, má maga dɩ ma ma kʋ pɔ kuoro Jʋas nɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la.

english_verse: Make sure they follow him wherever he goes, and tell them to keep their swords ready to kill anyone who tries to get near him.
translation_verse: Má kala kori ma laalɩyuori kɩaa a chɩna golli kuoro a pɔʋ, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kʋ kpagɛma, má kpʋʋ. Má kpagɛ kuoro lee na-kala ʋ sɩɩ mʋ.”

english_verse: Then they gave the weapons to their guards, who took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect Joash on every side.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ kori ba laalɩyuori kɩaa a chɩna golli kuoro a kpagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a pɔ kuoro Jʋas, a chɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Queen Athaliah heard the crowd and went to the temple.
translation_verse: Atalɩa sɩ nɩɩ goŋ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ ŋaa, ʋ mʋ nɩalɩŋ teeŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns, which was the usual place for the king. The singers and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the people were celebrating and blowing trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bene, ʋ na kuoro Jʋas dɩ ʋ chɩna a kpagɛ jebiiŋ arɩ ba naabarɩŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. Ka laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ chɩŋ ʋ sɛmɛ. Tintee-la nɩaa kala jʋjʋɔsɛ aŋ ŋmʋŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Atalɩa tʋɔŋ chei, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ aŋ ŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “Ma ŋaamɛ zɛmbɛ, ma ŋaamɛ zɛmbɛ.”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Kill her! But don't do it anywhere near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops and kill anyone who is with her!”
translation_verse: Jehoyada bɩra bʋla pɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba, “Má kɛŋ Atalɩa pɩɛga to nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ tʋɔŋ kʋ lɩɩ, má kpʋ nʋʋkala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ laaʋ ta, ama má sɩ́ Atalɩa kpʋ a kpagɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lee-kala.”

english_verse: So the commanders dragged her to the gate where horses are led into the palace, and they killed her there.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛnʋ, dɩ ʋ yi lee-la janɩŋ sɩ yie to a jʋjʋʋ kuoro dɩa a kpʋʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest asked King Joash and the people to promise that they would be faithful to each other and to the Lord.
translation_verse: Jehoyada sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, leŋ kuoro Jʋas arɩ nɩalɩŋ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ba jaŋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA nɩaa. Ʋ bɩra leŋ nɩalɩŋ arɩ kuoro ma hɛ niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ arɩ ba jaŋ bʋla nɩnɩɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Then the crowd went to the temple built to honor Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal right in front of the altars. After Jehoiada had placed guards around the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ mʋ ŋmoo Baal vene-la dɩa-la lo a yɛrɛ ʋ korunuŋ kala, a ŋmoo tɔmɔ-la kala yɛrɛ muno muno, aŋ kpʋ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ kpaarɛ Baal baa yɩrɛ Mataŋ korunu-la sɩpaaŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehoyada lɩɩsɛ nɩaa ba pʋpɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la.

english_verse: he called together all the commanders, the king's special bodyguards, the palace guards, and the people. They led Joash from the temple, through the Guards' Gate, and into the palace. He took his place on the throne and became king of Judah.
translation_verse: Ka ʋ kɛŋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ kuoro arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ kuoro dɩa arɩ taŋ-la nɩaa kala ba kɛŋ kuoro Jʋas a lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. Ba to nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ boi-baalɩŋ a jʋʋ kuoru dɩa, a hollu ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ.

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest taught Joash what was right, and so for the rest of his life Joash obeyed the Lord.
translation_verse: Jʋas mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, ʋ fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Jehoyada nɛ faa dagʋ.

english_verse: The fines that had to be paid along with the sacrifices to make things right and the sacrifices for sin did not go to the temple. This money belonged only to the priests.
translation_verse: Moribie-la ba sɩ time a pɛ cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ, ba bɩ ba kaa jʋʋ hɛ dagɩ-bie-la sɩ chɩŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ tɩɩba.

english_verse: But even Joash did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ama, Jʋas fa bɩ vesiŋ dɩ-kpaarɩa-la ŋmoo ta, nɩaa fa haa kpaarɛ vesiŋ nɛ a nyɩnyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: One day, Joash said to the priests, “Collect all the money that has been given to the Lord's temple, whether from taxes or gifts,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Jʋas bʋla pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, “Má laa moribie-la kala ba sɩ kaa kʋʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ a bil, moribie-la ba sɩ dɩɩsɛ nɩaa ba tiŋ, moribie-la ba sɩ kaa kʋ lɩɩsɛ niiriŋ arɩ moribie-la nɩaa tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɛ ba kaa kɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la.

english_verse: But the priests never started repairing the temple. So in the twenty-third year of his rule,
translation_verse: Ama Jʋas sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ batori lɛ, dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ha bɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wasa.

english_verse: Joash called for Jehoiada and the other priests and said, “Why aren't you using the money to repair the temple? Don't take any more money for yourselves. It is only to be used to pay for the repairs.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋas yɩrɛ Jehoyada arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɔnsʋŋ a pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma ha bɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lere-la sɩ cheye kʋŋkala wasa? A chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ, ma kʋŋkala bɩra sɩ́ moribie-la laa bil. Dɩ ma nɛ laa, má joŋo pa dɩ ba kaa wasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la.”

english_verse: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money or be in charge of the temple repairs.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɛɩ arɩ ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ laa moribie-la nɩaa teeŋ a bil, ba tɩtɩa ma dee bɩra bɩ jaŋ beŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wasɩŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Jehoiada found a wooden box; he cut a hole in the top of it and set it on the right side of the altar where people went into the temple. Whenever someone gave money to the temple, the priests guarding the entrance would put it into this box.
translation_verse: Jehoyada chɛ dagɩ-bie a luri bʋa daga-la nii-tɔlɔ lɛ, a joŋo bil ŋ sɩɩ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la nadiiŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la sɛmɛ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiŋ joŋ moribie-la kala nɩaa sɩ kaa kɔ a hɩhɛ dagɩ-bie-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: When the box was full of money, the king's secretary and the chief priest would count the money and put it in bags.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ ba nɛ na dɩ moribie-la yʋga daga-la tʋɔŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ kuoro teniŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ nɛ yie kʋ chaarɛ moribie-la a dɩɩsɛ, aŋ paa hɛ lʋagaba lɛ.

english_verse: Then they would give it to the men supervising the repairs to the temple. Some of the money was used to pay the builders, the woodworkers,
translation_verse: Ba yie joŋ moribie-la pɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ lɩɩsa ba bibeŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ wasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. Ba laa tiŋ kapɩntaba arɩ dɩɩ-saara-la a pɛ

english_verse: the stonecutters, and the men who built the walls. And some was used to buy wood and stone and to pay any other costs for repairing the temple.
translation_verse: meesimba lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɛrɛ tabɩaa. Moribie-la tʋɔŋ nɛ ba yie lɩɩsa yɔɔ daasɩŋ arɩ tabɩa-la ba sɩ kaa wʋwasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la, arɩ chɩŋ na-kala ba sɩ ŋmobo dɩa-la wasɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: While the repairs were being made, the money that was given to the temple was not used to make silver bowls, lamp snuffers, small sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or anything gold or silver for the temple.
translation_verse: Moribie-la nɩaa sɩ kaa kʋ pa Wɩa dɩa lɛ, ba bɩ ba tʋɔŋ lɩɩsa yɔɔ hɔpʋla taasɩ-gbansɩŋ, kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa wasɛ chaaŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ tɩta, kʋmɩsɩrɩ gbansɩŋ, banyilliŋ koo kʋŋ na-kala ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ koo hɔpʋla ŋaa sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ.

english_verse: The men in charge were honest, so no one had to keep track of the money.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ beŋ tɩntɩnna-la ba wʋwasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa nʋʋkala bɩ ba pɩɛsa chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ na ŋɩɩ ba sɩ kɛŋ moribie-la tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: About the same time, King Hazael of Syria attacked the town of Gath and captured it. Next, he decided to attack Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ Siiria kuoro Hazɛɛl mʋ yuo dii taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gaf, aŋ bɩra mʋ dɩ ʋ yuo Jerusalɛm ma.

english_verse: So Joash collected everything he and his ancestors Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah had dedicated to the Lord, as well as the gold in the storage rooms in the temple and palace. He sent it all to Hazael as a gift, and when Hazael received it, he ordered his troops to leave Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Jʋas sii paa kʋzɔmɔ-la kala ʋ dɩ ʋ naabalɩmaba: Jehosafat, Jehoram arɩ Ahazɩa fa sɩ joŋo pɩ La TƖƖNA, a pɛ sɛlɩmɛ-la kala fa sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ arɩ ʋ kuoru dɩa lɛ, a kaa mʋ pɩ Siiria tinteeŋ kuoro Hazɛɛl. Ʋ laa aŋ bɩra bɩ Jerusalɛm yuo.

english_verse: Everything else Joash did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Jʋas sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: At the end of his rule, some of his officers rebelled against him. Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer murdered him in a building where the land was filled in on the east side of Jerusalem, near the road to Silla. Joash was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Amaziah became king.
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la fa sɩ kpʋʋ nɛ ŋaa Sɩmɩaf nanʋala Jozabad arɩ Sɔma nanʋala Jehozabad. Ʋ sɩ sʋba, ba joŋu hugi ʋ nyɩmmaba dɩ-huguŋ Devit taŋ-la lɛ. Ka ʋ nanʋala Amazɩa dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in the twenty-third year of Joash's rule in Judah. Jehoahaz ruled
translation_verse: Kuoro Ahazɩa nanʋala Jʋas sɩ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ ʋ jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ batori lɛ nɛ, Jehu nanʋala Jehuahas ma dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ hɔŋ Samarɩa lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ balɩpɛ.

english_verse: and said, “Open the window facing east.” When it was open, Elisha shouted, “Now shoot!” Jehoash shot an arrow and Elisha said, “That arrow is a sign that the Lord will help you completely defeat the Syrian army at Aphek.”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl, “Kɛŋ tokoro-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ suri.” Jehuas kaa suri. Elaasa bʋl, “Yuo.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yuo toŋ-la. Elaasa bɩra bʋl, “To-hɛmɩŋ deeŋ daga arɩ La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma chaasa yuo dii Siiria tɩŋŋaa lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Afɛk.”

english_verse: and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He never stopped following the example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa to Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa ba tɩtɩa. Ʋ fa bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ leŋe.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with the Israelites, so he let King Hazael of Syria and his son Benhadad rule over them for a long time.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ leŋ La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ, a leŋ Siiria kuoro Hazɛɛl arɩ ʋ nanʋala Bɛŋ-Hadad yuo diiba, a bemba dieni.

english_verse: Jehoahaz prayed to the Lord for help, and the Lord saw how terribly Hazael was treating the Israelites. He answered Jehoahaz
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehuahas sʋl La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ. La TƖƖNA na ŋɩɩ Siiria kuoro Hazɛɛl sɩ chaasaa dɔgɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, a laa ʋ sʋla.

english_verse: by sending Israel a leader who rescued them from the Syrians, and the Israelites lived in peace as they had before.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Laataara. Ʋ laaba ta Siiria kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛɛlɛ hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ arɩ ba fa sɩ hɔŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoahaz did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Jehuahas sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Jehoahaz died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoash became king. King Jehoash of Israel
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehuahas sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi Samarɩa lɛ, aŋ ka ʋ nanʋala Jehuas dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. Jehuas dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ

english_verse: “Grab a bow and some arrows,” Elisha told him, “and hold them in your hand.” Jehoash grabbed the bow and arrows and held them. Elisha placed his hand on the king's hand
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩ Jehuas, “Joŋ toŋ-la a kori.” Ʋ joŋo kori. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elaasa joŋ ʋ nɩsaa a daŋ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Jehuas nɩsaa lɛ,

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord by doing just like Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Jehuas fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, arɩ Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam fa sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋɩɩ, a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his war against King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Jehuas sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa laa yɩrɩŋ, a pɛ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Amazɩa yuo laalɩŋ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria beside the other Israelite kings. His son Jeroboam then became king. Elisha the Prophet Dies
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehuas sʋʋ. Ba joŋu hugi Samarɩa lɛ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoroo dɩ-huguŋ. Ka ʋ nanʋala Jerobuam dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Some time before the death of King Jehoash, Elisha the prophet was very sick and about to die. Jehoash went in and stood beside him, crying. He said, “Master, what will Israel's chariots and cavalry be able to do without you?”
translation_verse: Ka dɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Jehuas-na sʋʋ, bʋa kʋbala lɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Elaasa chaasa wʋwɩɩlɛ a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ sʋʋ. Kuoro Jehuas mʋ dɩ ʋ naʋ a chɩŋ ʋ sɛmɛ a yel, aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ nyɩmma, mɩ nyɩmma. Ŋ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa laataarɩ-duo nɛ, dɩ ŋ nɛ sʋba, ɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaa?”

english_verse: Elisha said, “Pick up the arrows and hit the ground with them.” Jehoash grabbed the arrows and hit the ground three times, then stopped.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elaasa bɩra bʋl, “Paa to-hɛmɛ-la a vɩɩrɛ tinteeŋ.” Jehuas paa a vɩɩrɛ tinteeŋ naansɩɩŋ butori aŋ leŋ.

english_verse: Elisha became angry with the king and exclaimed, “If you had struck it five or six times, you would completely wipe out the Syrians. Now you will defeat them only three times.”
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Elaasa na baanɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ a bʋl, “Ʋ fa maga dɩ ŋ joŋo vɩɩrɛ tinteeŋ naansɩɩŋ bʋnɔŋ koo bʋlɩdʋ nɛ, ka dɩ ma fa wuo yuo dii Siiria tɩŋŋaa a kaa mʋ wuu. Ama ŋ sɩ ŋaa ŋ-la, naansɩɩŋ butori dʋndʋŋ nɛ ma jaŋ yuo diiba aŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuoba.”

english_verse: Elisha died and was buried. Every year in the spring, Moab's leaders sent raiding parties into Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elaasa sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi. Jɩna na-kala duoŋ-puso lɛ, Mʋab tɩŋŋaa yie hɛ laalɩyuoroo ba mʋ yuo Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: Once, while some Israelites were burying a man's body, they saw a group of Moabites. The Israelites quickly threw the body into Elisha's tomb and ran away. As soon as the man's body touched the bones of Elisha, the man came back to life and stood up. Israel Defeats Syria
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa huhugi baal kʋbala sɩ sʋba, a na Mʋab laalɩyuoro-la dɩ baa kɔ, ba guu joŋ sʋʋ-la a lo hɛ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ hugi Elaasa aŋ fá. Sʋʋ-la sɩ tuu digi Elaasa haŋgbelee, baal-la sii sʋʋŋ lɛ a sii chɩŋ.

english_verse: Israel was under the power of King Hazael of Syria during the entire rule of Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Jehuahas kuoruŋ bʋa kala lɛ, Siiria kuoro Hazɛɛl walɩmɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: But the Lord was kind to the Israelites and showed them mercy because of his solemn agreement with their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. In fact, he has never turned his back on them or let them be completely destroyed.
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA fa fá Iziral tɩŋŋaa nenige, a tɩŋ nii-la sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba, Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb pɛgɛ wɩaa. Ʋ ha maachie bɩ leŋe ba cheiba, ʋ ha bɩ chaasa vɩaba ta ma.

english_verse: Hazael died, and his son Benhadad then became king of Syria.
translation_verse: Siiria kuoro Hazɛɛl sʋʋ, ka ʋ nanʋala Bɛŋ-Hadad dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: King Jehoash of Israel attacked and defeated the Syrian army three times. He took back from Benhadad all the towns Hazael had captured in battle from his father Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehuahas nanʋala Jehuas yuo dii Hazɛɛl nanʋala Bɛŋ-Hadad a laa tasɩ-la kala ʋ nyɩmma Hazɛɛl fa sɩ yuo laa Jehuas nyɩmma Jehuahas teeŋ. Naansɩɩŋ butori nɛ Jehuas yuo dii Bɛŋ-Hadad aŋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa tasɩŋ.

english_verse: Jeroboam extended the boundaries of Israel from Lebo-Hamath in the north to the Dead Sea in the south, just as the Lord had promised his servant Jonah son of Amittai, who was a prophet from Gath-Hepher.
translation_verse: Jerobuam deeŋ nɛ fa kɛŋ Iziral tinteeŋ bʋa jalla pɛ, a chɩŋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lebo Hamaf a kaa mʋ yi mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mʋgʋ-sʋʋŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ. La TƖƖNA Iziral Wɩa fa to ʋ tɩntɩnna Jona sɩ ŋaa Amɩtaɩ nanʋala lɛ a bʋl ŋɩɩ nɛ. Jona fa ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ a lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gaf Hefa.

english_verse: Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah in the second year of Jehoash's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Jehuahas nanʋala Jehuas sɩ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ jɩ-lɩa lɛ nɛ Jʋas nanʋala Amazɩa ma dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Jerobuam deeŋ ma fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, ʋ fa to Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam bumbuŋ-la naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa, a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: Jeroboam died and was buried, and his son Zechariah became king.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jerobuam sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi Iziral kuoroo dɩ-huguŋ. Ka ʋ nanʋala Zɛkarɩya dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Amaziah followed the example of his father Joash by obeying the Lord and doing right. But he was not as faithful as his ancestor David.
translation_verse: Amazɩa fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ nɛ, ama ʋ fa bɩ ʋ naabalɩma Devit maga. Ʋ fa to ʋ nyɩmma Jʋas naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ wɩɩkala lɛ.

english_verse: Amaziah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bɩ veŋ-kpaarɛ lere-la ŋmoo ta. Nɩaa fa haa kpaarɛ vesiŋ nɛ a nyɩnyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: As soon as Amaziah had control of Judah, he arrested and killed the officers who had murdered his father.
translation_verse: Amazɩa kuoruŋ sɩ chɩna dɛrɛ, ʋ kɛsɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la fa sɩ kpʋ ʋ nyɩmma fa sɩ ŋaa kuoro a kpʋba.

english_verse: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. Go ahead and celebrate—but stay at home. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Amazɩa, ŋ bɩɩna ŋ dolie nɛ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ yuo dii Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa a bibigisi ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ. Hɔŋ ŋ dɩa lɛ sɔm, sɩ́ wɩaa lɔgɔ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa arɩ Juda tinteeŋ nɩaa kala lɛ.”

english_verse: One day, Amaziah sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala, Amazɩa tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Jehuas sɩ ŋaa Jehuahas nanʋala aŋ ŋaa Jehu ma nihiŋ, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa baal, kʋ lɩɩ chemmi dɩ la yuo laalɩŋ.”

english_verse: Jehoash sent back this reply: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon announced that his son was going to marry the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
