translation_verse: Sɛɛ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Lotaŋ, Sobal, Zibioŋ, Ana, Dɩsɔŋ, Ɛza arɩ Disaŋ.

english_verse: Lotan was the father of Hori and Homam; Lotan's sister was Timna.
translation_verse: Lotaŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ Hori arɩ Homam. Lotaŋ dɩhaala nɛ Tɩmɩna.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeon was the father of Aiah and Anah.
translation_verse: Sobal ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Alɩvaŋ, Manahaf, Ɛbal, Sefo arɩ Onam. Zibioŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Aya arɩ Ana.

english_verse: Anah was the father of Dishon and the grandfather of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
translation_verse: Ana nanʋala nɛ Dɩsɔŋ. Dɩsɔŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Hemidaŋ, Ɛsɩbaŋ, Ɩtɩraŋ arɩ Keraŋ.

english_verse: Ezer was the father of Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishan was the father of Uz and Aran.
translation_verse: Ɛza hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Bilihaŋ, Zaavaŋ arɩ Akaŋ. Dɩsaŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Yus arɩ Araŋ. Ɛdɔm kuoroo

english_verse: After Bela's death, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king.
translation_verse: Bɛla sʋʋ, ka Zɛra nanʋala Jobab sɩ lɩɩ Bozira dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: After Jobab's death, Husham from the land of Teman became king.
translation_verse: Jobab ma sɩ sʋba, Husam sɩ lɩɩ Tɛma tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: After Husham's death, Hadad son of Bedad became king and ruled from Avith. Earlier, Bedad had defeated the Midianites in the territory of Moab.
translation_verse: Husam ma sɩ sʋba, Bɛdad nanʋala Hadad ma nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ fa yuo dii Midiaŋ nɩaa Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ tabalɩŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Avif.

english_verse: After Hadad's death, Samlah from Masrekah became king;
translation_verse: Hadad ma sɩ sʋba, Samɩla sɩ lɩɩ Masɩrɛka nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: after Samlah's death, Shaul from the town of Rehoboth on the Euphrates River became king;
translation_verse: Samɩla ma sɩ sʋba, Sawʋl sɩ lɩɩ Rehobɔf a kpagɛ fuoŋ niiŋ nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and after Shaul's death, Baal Hanan son of Achbor became king.
translation_verse: Sawʋl ma sɩ sʋba, Akɩbɔ nanʋala Baal-Hanaŋ ma nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: After Baal Hanan's death, Hadad ruled from Pai. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
translation_verse: Baal-Hanaŋ ma sɩ sʋba, Hadad ma nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. Ʋ tabalɩŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Pɔɔ. Ʋ haala yɩrɩŋ nɛ Mɛhɛtabɛl. Mezahab tolo Matɩrɛd nɛ fa ŋaa ʋ naaŋ.

english_verse: The Edomite clans were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hadad ma sʋʋ. Ɛdɔm kuoroo nɛ fa ŋ-la: Tɩmɩna, Alɩva, Jɛfɛf,

english_verse: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
translation_verse: Oholibama, Ɛla, Pɩnɔŋ,

english_verse: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
translation_verse: Kenas, Tɛmaŋ, Mibizaa,

english_verse: Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Juda hambolibiisiŋ nɛ fa: Ɛɛ, Onaŋ arɩ Sɛla. Ʋ dɩ ʋ haala Bafɩsʋa, Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa tolo-la nɛ lʋl biiriŋ deemba batori. Juda bii-hɩaŋ Ɛɛ fa ŋaa nɩbɔŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA kpʋʋ.

english_verse: Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.
translation_verse: Juda arɩ ʋ bii-haala Tama ma lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ: Pɛrɛs arɩ Zɛra. Juda hambolibiisiŋ kala fa ŋaa banɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul.
translation_verse: Pɛrɛs hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Hɛzɩrɔŋ arɩ Hamʋl.

english_verse: Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.
translation_verse: Zɛra hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Zimiri, Ɛtaŋ, Hemaŋ, Kalɩkɔl arɩ Daada. Ba ŋaa banɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Achan, who was a descendant of Zerah and the son of Carmi, caused trouble for Israel, because he kept for himself things that belonged only to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kaamɩ nanʋala nɛ Ekaŋ. Ʋ nɛ lɛrɛ wɩaa kʋ hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ sɩ vɩa nii-la ba sɩ bile aŋ paa kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ sɩ ba chei, a faa.

english_verse: Ethan's son was Azariah. The Ancestors of King David
translation_verse: Ɛtaŋ nanʋala nɛ Azarɩa. Kuoro Devit doho nɩaa

english_verse: Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
translation_verse: Hɛzɩrɔŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jɛramɛɛl, Ram arɩ Kalɩb.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah.
translation_verse: Ram nanʋala nɛ Amɩnadab. Amɩnadab ma nanʋala nɛ Nasɔŋ, ʋ fa ŋaa Juda nɩaa sɩpaalaarʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Nahshon's descendants included Salma, Boaz,
translation_verse: Nasɔŋ nanʋala nɛ Salɩmɔŋ. Salɩmɔŋ ma nanʋala nɛ Bʋas.

english_verse: Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
translation_verse: Jesi fa kɛŋ toloo balɩa ma nɛ: Zeruya arɩ Abɩgɛl. Zeruya hambolibiisiŋ nɛ fa: Abɩsaɩ, Jʋab arɩ Asahɛl.

english_verse: Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa. The Descendants of Hezron
translation_verse: Abɩgɛl bala nɛ fa Jɛta. Jɛta ŋaa Ɩsɩmɛl doho nʋʋ nɛ. Ba nanʋala yɩrɩŋ nɛ Amasa. Hɛzɩrɔŋ doho nɩaa

english_verse: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translation_verse: Hɛzɩrɔŋ nanʋala Kalɩb fa jaa Azuba nɛ, ba lʋl hantolibie a hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Jɛrɩɔf. Jɛrɩɔf ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jɛsa, Sobab arɩ Aadɔŋ.

english_verse: After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur
translation_verse: Azuba sɩ sʋba, Kalɩb mɩɩra jaa Ɛfɩraf, ba lʋl Huu.

english_verse: was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
translation_verse: Huu nanʋala nɛ Uri, Uri ma nanʋala nɛ Bɛzalɛl.

english_verse: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa. The Descendants of Jerahmeel
translation_verse: Hɛzɩrɔŋ sɩ sʋba, Kalɩb joŋ ʋ nyɩmma haala Ɛfɩraf a jaa. Ba lʋl hambolibie a hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Asihu. Ʋ nɛ suomi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛkʋa. Jɛramɛɛl doho nɩaa

english_verse: Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translation_verse: Hɛzɩrɔŋ bii-hɩaŋ Jɛramɛɛl fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ banɔŋ nɛ: Ram, Buna, Ɔrɩŋ, Ozem arɩ Ahija.

english_verse: Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam.
translation_verse: Jɛramɛɛl fa kɛŋ haal dɔŋ ma nɛ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Atara. Ʋ nɛ lʋl Onam.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
translation_verse: Jɛramɛɛl bii-hɩaŋ Ram hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Maas, Jamɩŋ arɩ Ɛka.

english_verse: Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada. Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur.
translation_verse: Onam ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Samaɩ arɩ Jada. Samaɩ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Nadab arɩ Abisu.

english_verse: Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid.
translation_verse: Abisu haala yɩrɩŋ nɛ Abɩhɛɛl, ʋ nɛ lʋl Abaŋ arɩ Molid.

english_verse: Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children;
translation_verse: Nadab ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Sɛlɛd arɩ Apem. Sɛlɛd bɩ bii lʋla aŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
translation_verse: Apem nanʋala nɛ Ɩsɩ, Ɩsɩ ma nanʋala nɛ Sɛsaŋ, Sɛsaŋ ma nanʋala nɛ Alaɩ.

english_verse: Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children,
translation_verse: Samaɩ naambie Jada hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jɛta arɩ Jonataŋ. Jɛta bɩ bii lʋla aŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.
translation_verse: Jonataŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Pɛlɛf arɩ Zaza. Nɩaa deemba kala fa ŋaa Jɛramɛɛl doho nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɛsaŋ joŋ ʋ tolo pɩ ʋ yoŋ-la ʋ kaa lʋl Ataɩ.

english_verse: the father of Nathan and the grandfather of Zabad.
translation_verse: Ataɩ nanʋala nɛ Netaŋ, Netaŋ ma nanʋala nɛ Zabad.

english_verse: Zabad's descendants included Ephlal, Obed, Jehu, Azariah, Helez, Eleasah, Sismai, Shallum, Jekamiah, and Elishama. The Descendants of Caleb
translation_verse: Salum ma nanʋala nɛ Jɛkamaaya, Jɛkamaaya ma nanʋala nɛ Ɛlɩsama. Kalɩb doho nɩaa

english_verse: Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, had the following descendants: Mesha, Ziph, Mareshah, Hebron,
translation_verse: Jɛramɛɛl naambie Kalɩb hambolibii-hɩaŋ nɛ Mɛsa. Mɛsa nanʋala nɛ Zɩf, Zɩf ma nanʋala nɛ Marɛsa, Marɛsa ma nanʋala nɛ Hɛbʋrɔŋ.

english_verse: and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
translation_verse: Hɛbʋrɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Kora, Tapʋa, Rɛkɛm arɩ Sɛma.

english_verse: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai,
translation_verse: Sɛma ma nanʋala nɛ Raham, Raham ma nanʋala nɛ Jɔkɩam. Rɛkɛm ma nanʋala nɛ Samaɩ.

english_verse: the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
translation_verse: Samaɩ nanʋala nɛ Mayɔŋ. Mayɔŋ ma nanʋala nɛ Bɛf Zuu.

english_verse: Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez.
translation_verse: Kalɩb sɩ bil haal-la aŋ bɩ jaa baa yɩrɛ Ɛfa, ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ Haraŋ, Moza arɩ Gazɛs. Haraŋ ma nanʋala yɩrɩŋ nɛ Gazɛs.

english_verse: Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
translation_verse: Jadaɩ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Regem, Jotam, Gesaŋ, Pɛlɛt, Ɛfa arɩ Saaf.

english_verse: Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah.
translation_verse: Kalɩb haal-la dɔŋɔ ma ʋ sɩ bile aŋ bɩ jaa baa yɩrɛ Maaka, ʋ nɛ lʋl Sɛba arɩ Tɩɩhana.

english_verse: Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ ha lʋl Saaf, Saaf ma lʋl Madɩmana. Ʋ nanʋala dɔŋɔ ma nɛ Sɛva. Sɛva ma lʋl Makɩbɛna arɩ Gɩbɩa. Kalɩb tolo nɛ fa Akɩsa.

english_verse: All of these were Caleb's descendants. Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader.
translation_verse: Dɔŋɔ ma nɛ Salɩma, ʋ ma nɛ suomi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm. Dɔŋɔ ma nɛ Harɛf, ʋ ma nɛ suomi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf Gada.

english_verse: Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan,
translation_verse: Sobal, nɩɩ-la sɩ suomi Kɩrɩaf Jɩarɩm doho nɩaa nɛ: Harɔɩ arɩ Manaha tɩŋŋaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ,

english_verse: and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
translation_verse: arɩ Kɩrɩaf Jɩarɩm nyɩŋ-nɩaa deemba: Ɩtɩrɩ tɩŋŋaa, Puti tɩŋŋaa, Suma tɩŋŋaa arɩ Mɩsɩra tɩŋŋaa. Nɩaa deemba lɛ nɛ Zɔra tɩŋŋaa arɩ Ɛsɩtɔl tɩŋŋaa kala lɩɩ.

english_verse: Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites.
translation_verse: Salɩma ma doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Bɛtɩlɛhɛm tɩŋŋaa, Netofa tɩŋŋaa, Atɩrɔf Bɛf Jʋab tɩŋŋaa, arɩ Manaha tɩŋŋaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, Zori tɩŋŋaa,

english_verse: Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_verse: arɩ kerichiba sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ doho nɩaa sɩ hɛ Jabɛs tinteeŋ lɛ: Tɩra tɩŋŋaa, Sɩmɩa tɩŋŋaa arɩ Suka tɩŋŋaa. Nɩaa deemba ŋaa Keni tɩŋŋaa nɛ, Hamaf doho nɩaa. Hamaf nɛ fa ŋaa Rekab tɩŋŋaa naabalɩma.

english_verse: more sons. His wife Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel gave birth to Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.
translation_verse: Ahas, Ahas ma nanʋala nɛ Hezikaaya. Hezikaaya ma nanʋala nɛ Manasɛ. Manasɛ ma nanʋala nɛ

english_verse: David's other sons included Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Ɛlɩsama, Ɛlɩada arɩ Ɛlɩfɛlɛt, ba kala ŋaa nibi nɛ.

english_verse: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter. The Descendants of King Solomon
translation_verse: Devit hambolibiisiŋ nɛ nɩaa deemba kala, haala-la ʋ sɩ bile aŋ bɩ jaa hambolibiisiŋ-na bɩ pɛ. Devit fa kɛŋ tolo ma nɛ baa yɩrɛ Tama. Kuoro Solomoŋ doho nɩaa

english_verse: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Jehoyakim hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jehoyachiŋ arɩ Zedikaaya. Kuoro Jehoyachiŋ doho nɩaa

english_verse: Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel,
translation_verse: Jehoyachiŋ, kuoru-la ba fa sɩ yuo kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩpɛ nɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ: Sɩalɩtɩɛl,

english_verse: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation_verse: Malɩkɩram, Pedaaya, Sɛnaza, Jɛkamaaya, Hosama, arɩ Nɛdabaaya.

english_verse: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
translation_verse: Pedaaya hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Zerubabɛl arɩ Sɩmɛɩ. Zerubabɛl ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Mɛsʋlam arɩ Hananaaya. Ba dɩhaala nɛ Sɛlɔmɩf.

english_verse: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
translation_verse: Zerubabɛl fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ banɔŋ ma nɛ: Hasuba, Ohel, Bɛrɛkɩa, Hasadɩa arɩ Jusab-Hɛsɛd.

english_verse: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Sɛkanɩa nanʋala nɛ Sɛmaaya, Sɛmaaya ma hambolibiisiŋ ŋaa banɔŋ nɛ: Hatus, Ɩgal, Barɩa, Nɩarɩa arɩ Safat.

english_verse: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
translation_verse: Nɩarɩa ma hambolibiisiŋ ŋaa batori nɛ: Elionai, Hizikia arɩ Azirikam.

english_verse: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_verse: Elionai ma kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩpɛ nɛ: Hodavia, Ɛlɩasɩb, Pɛlaaya, Akub, Johanaŋ, Delaaya arɩ Ananɩ.

english_verse: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation_verse: Juda hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Pɛrɛs, Hɛzɩrɔŋ, Kaamɩ, Huu arɩ Sobal.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
translation_verse: Sobal nanʋala nɛ Reeya, Reeya ma nanʋala nɛ Jahaf. Jahaf ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ Ahumai arɩ Lahad. Zora nyɩŋ-nɩaa nɛ fa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath. Some of his descendants settled the town of Bethlehem. Hur's other descendants included Etam, Penuel, and Ezer. Etam's sons were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash, and his daughter was Hazzelelponi. Penuel settled the town of Gedor, and Ezer settled the town of Hushah.
translation_verse: Huu nɛ fa ŋaa Kalɩb haala Ɛfɩraf bii-hɩaŋ. Ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ saa tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm. Huu fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Ɛtam, Pɛnʋɛl arɩ Ɛza. Ɛtam ma kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Jɛzɩrɛl, Ɩsɩma arɩ Ɩdɩbas. Ba dɩhaala yɩrɩŋ nɛ Hazɛlɛlɩpɔnɩ.

english_verse: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
translation_verse: Asihu, nɩɩ-la sɩ saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛkʋa fa kɛŋ haalaa balɩa nɛ: Hɛla arɩ Naara.

english_verse: daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩ Naara lʋl biiriŋ banɛsɛ nɛ: Ahuzam, Hefa, Temeni arɩ Haahasɩtarɩ.

english_verse: Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
translation_verse: Asihu arɩ Hɛla ma lʋl hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Zɛrɛf, Zoha arɩ Ɛtɩnaŋ.

english_verse: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
translation_verse: Anub arɩ Hazɔbɛba nyɩmma nɛ Kos, ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa Harum nanʋala Ahahɛl nyɩŋ-nɩaa naabalɩma.

english_verse: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ baa yɩrɛ Jabɛs, ʋ fa kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ a kɩɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ kala. Ʋ naaŋ fa hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Jabɛs bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ aŋ lʋlʋ.”

english_verse: One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Jabɛs sʋl Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, a bʋl, “Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, pɛ mɩ lɛ a leŋ dɩ mɩ tinteeŋ jalla pɛ. Pɔmɛ dɩ wʋbɔŋ kala sɩ́ mɩ jʋʋ dɩ mɩ na hɛɛŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa laa ʋ sʋla.

english_verse: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton,
translation_verse: Suha naambie Kelub nanʋala nɛ Mehi. Mehi ma nanʋala nɛ Ɛsɩtɔŋ.

english_verse: whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
translation_verse: Ɛsɩtɔŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Bɛf Rafa, Pasɩa arɩ Tɛhɩna. Tɛhɩna nɛ saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nahas. Nɩaa deemba fa hɛ Rɛka lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai,
translation_verse: Kenas fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ, Ofiniel arɩ Sɛraaya. Ofiniel ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ Hataf arɩ Mionotai.

english_verse: who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
translation_verse: Mionotai nɛ saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɔfɩra. Sɛraaya ma nanʋala nɛ Jʋab, Jʋab ma nɛ saa taŋ-la nɩaa sɩ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa, baa yɩrɛ Ge-Harasim.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
translation_verse: Jefuni nanʋala Kalɩb hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Iru, Ɛla arɩ Naam. Ɛla ma nanʋala nɛ Kenas.

english_verse: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hodia nɛ fa jaa Naham dɩhaala. Ba doho nɩaa nɛ ŋaa Gaam nyɩŋ-nɩaa a hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɛɛla lɛ, arɩ Maaka nyɩŋ-nɩaa ma sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛsɩtɛmʋa lɛ.

english_verse: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
translation_verse: Sɩmɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Amɩnɔŋ, Rɩna, Bɛŋ-Hanaŋ arɩ Tiloŋ. Ɩsɩ doho nɩaa nɛ: Zɔhɛf arɩ Bɛŋ-Zɔhɛf.

english_verse: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king. The Descendants of Simeon
translation_verse: Doho deeŋ nɩaa nɛ ŋaa pupoi mɛɛrɛ-la sɩ hɛ tasɩŋ deemba lɛ: Netem arɩ Gɛdɛra. Ba hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ a tɩma pɩpɩ kuoro. Simioŋ doho nɩaa

english_verse: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Simioŋ fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ banɔŋ nɛ: Nɛmʋɛl, Jamɩŋ, Jarɩb, Zɛra arɩ Sawʋl.

english_verse: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.
translation_verse: Sawʋl nanʋala nɛ Salum, Salum ma nanʋala nɛ Mibisam, Mibisam ma nanʋala nɛ Mɩsɩma.

english_verse: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.
translation_verse: Mɩsɩma nanʋala nɛ Hamʋɛl, Hamʋɛl ma nanʋala nɛ Zakɔ, Zakɔ ma nanʋala nɛ Sɩmɛɩ.

english_verse: Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim.
translation_verse: Bɛf-Maakabɔf, Haza-Susim, Bɛf-Biri arɩ Saarem. Ba tasɩŋ nɛ fa ŋɩɩ a kʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Devit sɩ dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan,
translation_verse: Ba fa hɔŋ tabiisiŋ deemba banɔŋ ma lɛ nɛ: Ɛtam, Ayɩŋ, Rimoŋ, Tɔkɛŋ arɩ Asaŋ,

english_verse: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
translation_verse: arɩ tabiisi-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ golliba a kaa mʋ yi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baalaf. Lere-la Simioŋ doho nɩaa sɩ hɔnɔ hɔnɔ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Nʋʋkala arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa dɩhɔnʋŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located,
translation_verse: Ba fa sɩɩ chɛ yaŋ dɩ ba pɩ ba pʋsʋŋ, ba vɛŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ mʋ yi fuonaa-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɛdɔ.

english_verse: and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites,
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ ba na pʋsʋŋ ya-zɔmʋŋ, tintee-la ma jal woruŋ, a fɩɛla pɩŋ sɔm, wʋwalɩmɩɩ ma kala tuo. Ham tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ fa hɔŋ lee-la aŋ ka.

english_verse: but when Hezekiah was king of Judah, the descendants of Simeon attacked and forced the Hamites and Meunites off the land, then settled there.
translation_verse: Ama Hezikaaya sɩ kʋ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, Simioŋ doho nɩalɩŋ yɩraa la sɩ daga mʋ yuo kiri Ham tɩŋŋaa arɩ Mɩʋŋ tɩŋŋaa ta tintee-la lɛ aŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ, a tɩŋ lee-la sɩ kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ ya-diiliŋ.

english_verse: They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ kpʋ Amalɛk nɩkaana-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, aŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph,
translation_verse: Rubiŋ nɛ fa ŋaa Jekɔb bii-hɩaŋ, ama ʋ bɩ wuo dii hɩasɩŋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ ʋ nyɩmma haala pɩŋ, ŋɩɩ leŋ ba joŋ hɩasɩŋ mɩɩra pɩ Josɛf.

english_verse: Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
translation_verse: Jekɔb bii-hɩaŋ Rubiŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Hanɔk, Pallu, Hɛzɩrɔŋ arɩ Kaamɩ.

english_verse: The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
translation_verse: arɩ Bɛɛra, nɩɩ-la Asiiria kuoro Tɩgɩlaf-Pɩlɩsa sɩ yuo dii a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga. Bɛɛra fa ŋaa Rubiŋ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaarʋ nɛ.

english_verse: The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon,
translation_verse: arɩ Azas nanʋala Bɛla sɩ ŋaa Sɛma nihiŋ a ŋaa Jowɛl nyɩŋ-nʋʋ. Ba fa hɔnɔ kpagɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Arowa nɛ, a kaa mʋ yi tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nebo arɩ Baal Mioŋ.

english_verse: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
translation_verse: Ba pʋsʋŋ fa yʋga Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba hɔŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Yufireti fuo-la.

english_verse: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
translation_verse: Sɔɔl kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ, Rubiŋ doho nɩaa mʋ yuo dii Hagi tɩŋŋaa, aŋ laa ba tintee-la kala sɩ hɛ Gɩlɩad wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a hɔŋ. Gad doho nɩaa

english_verse: The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah.
translation_verse: Gad doho nɩaa ma nɛ fa hɔnɔ kpagɛba lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Basaŋ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Salɛka.

english_verse: Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Jowɛl nɛ fa ŋaa ba sɩpaalaaraa Basaŋ lɛ, Safam tɩtɩgɛ, a saa pɛ Janaɩ arɩ Safat lɛ.

english_verse: Their relatives included Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.
translation_verse: Ba naambiiriŋ nɛ: Maakɩl, Mɛsʋlam, Sɛba, Jorai, Jakaŋ, Zɩa arɩ Ɛba, ba kala fa ŋaa balɩpɛ nɛ.

english_verse: They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz.
translation_verse: Ba kala fa ŋaa Huri nanʋala Abɩhɛɛl doho nɩaa nɛ. Huri nyɩmma nɛ Jarʋa. Jarʋa ma nyɩmma nɛ Gɩlɩad, Gɩlɩad ma nyɩmma nɛ Maakɩl, Maakɩl ma nyɩmma nɛ Jɛsɩsaɩ, Jɛsɩsaɩ ma nyɩmma nɛ Jado, Jado ma nyɩmma nɛ Bus.

english_verse: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
translation_verse: Guni nanʋala Abɩdɩɛl ma nanʋala Ahi nɛ fa ŋaa ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa kʋhɩaŋ.

english_verse: The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon.
translation_verse: Gad doho nɩaa fa hɔŋ Basaŋ arɩ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ tabiisiŋ lɛ nɛ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Sarɔŋ tinteeŋ pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diiliŋ.

english_verse: Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ba doho wɩaa deemba kala a bil nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ Jotam sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, arɩ bʋa-la lɛ Jerobuam sɩ dii Iziral tinteeŋ kuoruŋ.

english_verse: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ yuo Hagi, Jɛtɔ, Nafɩs arɩ Nodab tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoroo deemba sɩ mʋa dɩ ba yuo Hagi tɩŋŋaa, ba joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ Wɩa lɛ nɛ a sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba wuo yuo dii Hagi tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋ pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria. The Tribe of East Manasseh
translation_verse: Hagi tɩŋŋaa jesiŋ kala sʋʋ laal-la lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa faa yuoba nɛ. Rubiŋ doho, Gad doho arɩ Manasɛ doho kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la nɩaa fa hɔŋ lee-la nɛ a kaa kɔ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kɛsɛba kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga Asiiria tinteeŋ lɛ. Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ

english_verse: East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la fa sɩ hɔŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ fa yʋga nɛ woruŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɔŋ Basaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Baal Hɛmɔŋ tinteeŋ, Sɛnɩ arɩ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛmɔŋ.

english_verse: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers. The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
translation_verse: Ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa nɛ: Ɛfɛ, Ɩsɩ, Ɛlɩɛl, Azɩrɩɛl, Jɛrɩmaaya, Hodavia arɩ Jadɩɛl. Ba fa ŋaa laalɩyuori-duori nɛ, nɩaa jɩmba woruŋ.

english_verse: So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa yigi Asiiria kuoro Pul hɛ ʋ kʋ yuo dii Iziral doho doho deemba: Rubiŋ doho, Gad doho arɩ Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la, a kɛsɛba kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga Asiiria tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ fʋgɛba ba hɔŋ tasɩŋ deemba lɛ: Hala, Habɔ arɩ Hara, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma hɔnɔ kpagɛ Gozaŋ fuo-la a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohaf ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Amɩram, Ɩzɩha, Hɛbʋrɔŋ arɩ Ʋzɩɛl.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Amɩram ma biiriŋ nɛ: Arɔŋ, Mosis arɩ Mɩrɩam. Arɔŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Nadab, Abihu, Elieza arɩ Ɩtama.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza fa pɛ kɛŋ Jehozadak mʋ yoŋ-baga nɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe Nebukadineza kɛsɛ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ.

english_verse: Levi's three sons had sons of their own.
translation_verse: Levi hambolibiisi-la batori, Gɛsɔŋ, Kohaf arɩ Mɛrarɩ, ba ma kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gɛsɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Libini arɩ Sɩmɛɩ.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohaf ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Amɩram, Ɩzɩha, Hɛbʋrɔŋ arɩ Ʋzɩɛl.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
translation_verse: Mɛrarɩ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Mali arɩ Musi. Nɩaa deemba kala nɛ fa ŋaa Levi doho nɩaa nyɩŋ-nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa.

english_verse: Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Tahaf, Tahaf ma nanʋala nɛ Ʋrɩɛl, Ʋrɩɛl ma nanʋala nɛ Uzia, Uzia ma nanʋala nɛ Sawʋl.

english_verse: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation_verse: Ɛlɩkaana hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Amasaɩ arɩ Ahimof,

english_verse: Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
translation_verse: Ɛlɩab, Jeroham, Ɛlɩkaana arɩ Samʋɛl.

english_verse: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
translation_verse: Samʋɛl hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jowɛl ʋ bii-hɩaŋ arɩ Abija ʋ bii-lɩamɩŋ.

english_verse: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah. The Temple Musicians
translation_verse: Sɩmɩa, Sɩmɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Hagɩa, Hagɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Azaaya. Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa

english_verse: After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɛŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la kɔ Jerusalɛm, ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, nɩaa deemba nɛ Devit lɩɩsɛ ba ŋaa kʋduuroo arɩ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa La TƖƖNA dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Asaph was Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Asaph's ancestors included Berechiah, Shimea, Michael, Baaseiah, Malchijah, Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah, Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei, Jahath, Gershon, and Levi.
translation_verse: Sɩmɛɩ ma nyɩmma nɛ Jahaf, Jahaf ma nyɩmma nɛ Gɛsɔŋ, Gɛsɔŋ ma nyɩmma nɛ Levi.

english_verse: Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.
translation_verse: Sɛma ma nyɩmma nɛ Mali, Mali ma nyɩmma nɛ Musi, Musi ma nyɩmma nɛ Mɛrarɩ, Mɛrarɩ ma nyɩmma nɛ Levi.

english_verse: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent. The Descendants of Aaron
translation_verse: Ba Levi doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ faa tɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tɩntɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ kala.

english_verse: Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
translation_verse: Ama Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ fa yie kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kaa mʋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ koruŋ teeŋ. Ba nɛ faa tɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ tɩntɩŋŋaa, a ŋɩŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Wɩa joŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba, arɩ Wɩa tɩntɩnna Mosis sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in.
translation_verse: Arɔŋ doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ ŋaa Kohaf nyɩŋ-nɩaa, ba nɛ fa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ joŋ tasɩŋ pa.

english_verse: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.
translation_verse: Ba fa joŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛbʋrɔŋ sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ pɩba, a pɛ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diiliŋ sɩ golli taŋ-la.

english_verse: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translation_verse: Ama bagɩsɩ-la arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ golli Hɛbʋrɔŋ nɛ ba fa joŋo pɩ Jefuni nanʋala Kalɩb.

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa ma tinteeŋ lɛ ba joŋ tasɩŋ deemba nɛ pɩba: Geba, Alɛmɛf arɩ Anatɔf a pɛ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee lɛ. Tasɩŋ fii arɩ batori nɛ ba joŋo pɩ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa.

english_verse: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
translation_verse: Kohaf doho nɩaa nɩkaanaa fa laa tasɩŋ fii nɛ Manasɛ nyɩŋ-nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
translation_verse: Gɛsɔŋ nyɩŋ-nɩaa laa tasɩŋ fii arɩ batori nɛ a lɩɩ doho doho deemba leriŋ: Ɩsaka, Asa, Nafɩtalɩ arɩ Manasɛ doho-la dɔŋɔ sɩ hɛ Basaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Levi nyɩŋ-nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Mɛrarɩ lɛ, laa tasɩŋ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ a lɩɩ doho doho deemba leriŋ: Rubiŋ, Gad arɩ Zebuluŋ.

english_verse: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa joŋ tasɩŋ arɩ pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diile-la sɩ golli tasɩ-la a pɩ Levi doho nɩaa ba hɔŋ.

english_verse: All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
translation_verse: Ba tɔnsɔ nɛ a chaarɛ tasɩ-la la sɩ daga a lɩɩ doho doho deemba lɛ: Juda, Simioŋ arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ.

english_verse: Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Kohaf nyɩŋ-nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ laa ba tasɩŋ Efirem doho nɩaa tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: These families received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Shechem in the hill country, Gezer, Jokmeam, Beth-Horon, Aijalon, and Gath-Rimmon.
translation_verse: Aɩjalɔŋ arɩ Gaf Rimoŋ, a pɛ lere-la ba pʋsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ didii.

english_verse: The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa ma laa tasɩŋ deemba nɛ Manasɛ doho kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ: Golaŋ sɩ hɛ Basaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ arɩ Asɩtarɔf, a pɛ lere-la ba pʋsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ didii.

english_verse: Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa ma tinteeŋ lɛ, tasɩŋ deemba nɛ ba laa: Kɛdɛs sɩ hɛ Galilii tinteeŋ lɛ, Hamɔŋ arɩ Kɩrɩatam, a pɛ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee lɛ.

english_verse: The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun.
translation_verse: Mɛrarɩ doho nɩkaana-la ma laa tasɩŋ deemba nɛ: Zebuluŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, ba laa Rimono arɩ Tabɔ, a pɛ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee lɛ.

english_verse: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
translation_verse: Ɩsaka hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Tola, Pʋa, Jasub arɩ Sɩmɩrɔŋ. Ba kala fa ŋaa banɛsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were
translation_verse: Tola ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Uzi, Refaaya, Jɛrɩɛl, Jamaɩ, Ɩbɩsam arɩ Samʋɛl. Ba fa ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ ba doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ a ŋaa laalɩyuori-duoru ma. Devit kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ Tola doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo fa ŋaa bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba nyɩmma Efirem yel ba yoho a dieni, ʋ naambiiriŋ kɔ dɩ ba pʋ kenyiri.

english_verse: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.
translation_verse: Uzi nanʋala nɛ Izirahia. Izirahia ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Maakɩl, Obadaaya, Jowɛl arɩ Ɩsɩa. Ba kala banɔŋ fa ŋaa kuoroo nɛ.

english_verse: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation_verse: Zofa hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Sʋa, Haanɛfa, Sʋal, Beri, Ɩmɩra,

english_verse: In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of
translation_verse: Ɩsaka doho wɩaa ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil daga arɩ ba doho fa kɛŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ balɩpɛ nɛ. Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa

english_verse: Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamɩŋ fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Bɛla, Bɛka arɩ Jɛdayɛl.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was
translation_verse: Bɛla fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ banɔŋ nɛ: Ɛzɩbɔŋ, Uzi, Ʋzɩɛl, Jɛrɩmɔf arɩ Iri. Ba fa ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a ŋaa laalɩyuori-duoru ma. Ba doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo fa ŋaa bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩa arɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil.

english_verse: Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
translation_verse: Bɛka hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Zɛmɩra, Jʋas, Elieza, Elionai, Omiri, Jɛrɛmɔf, Abija, Anatɔf arɩ Alɛmɛf.

english_verse: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,
translation_verse: Efirem doho nɩaa nɛ: Sʋtɛla, Bɛrɛd, Tahaf, Ɛlɩada, Tahaf,

english_verse: Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
translation_verse: Jɛdayɛl nanʋala nɛ Bilihaŋ. Bilihaŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Jeyus, Bɛnjamɩŋ, Ehud, Kɛnaana, Zɛtaŋ, Taasɩs arɩ Ahɩsaha.

english_verse: Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Ulam ma nanʋala nɛ Bɛdaŋ. Nɩaa deemba kala ŋaa Makɩɩ nanʋala Gɩlɩad sɩ ŋaa Manasɛ nihiŋ doho nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan. Dan was the father of Hushim. The Descendants of Naphtali
translation_verse: Iri hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Supim arɩ Hupim. Aha ma nanʋala nɛ Husim. Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa

english_verse: Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. The Descendants of Manasseh
translation_verse: Nafɩtalɩ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Jazɩɛl, Guni, Jeza arɩ Sɩlɛm. Ba fa ŋaa Nafɩtalɩ naaŋ Biliha doho nɩaa nɛ. Manasɛ doho nɩaa

english_verse: Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead.
translation_verse: Manasɛ arɩ haal-la ʋ sɩ bile aŋ bɩ jaa a kaa lɩɩ Siiria tinteeŋ, ba lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ: Asɩrɩɛl arɩ Makɩɩ. Makɩɩ nanʋala nɛ Gɩlɩad.

english_verse: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah. Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Makɩɩ jaa haalaa pɩ Hupim arɩ Supim. Makɩɩ bii-lɩa yɩrɩŋ nɛ Zelofihad. Zelofihad fa lʋl toloo dʋndʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem.
translation_verse: Makɩɩ arɩ ʋ haala Maaka fa lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ: Pɛrɛs arɩ Sɛrɛs. Pɛrɛs ma lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ: Ulam arɩ Rakɛm.

english_verse: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
translation_verse: Gɩlɩad dɩhaala Hamɔlɛkɛf fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Ɩsɔd, Abieza arɩ Mala.

english_verse: Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam. The Descendants of Ephraim
translation_verse: Sɛmɩda hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Ahɩaŋ, Sɛkɛm, Likihi arɩ Anɩam. Efirem doho nɩaa

english_verse: Zabad, and Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath.
translation_verse: Zabad arɩ Sʋtɛla. Gaf taŋ nɩaa fa kpʋ Ɛza arɩ Ɛlɩad nɛ ba sɩ mʋa dɩ ba gaa ba pʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ haala bɩra pɛ bɔsɔ, ʋ kɛŋ luoruŋ a lʋl hambolibie, a hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Bɛrɩa, a tɩŋ nyu-bɔŋ-la sɩ jʋʋ ʋ dɩa.

english_verse: Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
translation_verse: Ʋ tolo nɛ fa Sɛɛra, nɩɩ-la sɩ saa tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf-Horoŋ, nyuŋ arɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kala, a pɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Uzeŋ Sɛɛra lɛ.

english_verse: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
translation_verse: Efirem nanʋala dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Refa. Refa doho nɩaa nɛ: Resef, Tɛla, Tahaŋ,

english_verse: Nun, and Joshua.
translation_verse: Nuŋ arɩ Josua.

english_verse: The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Efirem doho nɩaa fa laa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛtɛl arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ gollu nɛ a hɔŋ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Naaraŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a bɩra kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Gɛza sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ ʋ tabiisiŋ. Ba tinteeŋ nɛ ha tabala-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛkɛm arɩ Aya kala arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ golliba.

english_verse: The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages. The Descendants of Asher
translation_verse: Manasɛ doho nɩaa nɛ fa tɩɩ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf-Saŋ, Tanak, Mɛgɩdɔ arɩ Doo, a pɛ tabiisi-la sɩ golliba lɛ. Jekɔb nanʋala Josɛf doho nɩaa nɛ fa hɔŋ tasɩŋ deemba lɛ. Asa doho nɩaa

english_verse: Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
translation_verse: Asa hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Imina, Isiva, Isivi arɩ Bɛrɩa. Ba dɩhaala nɛ fa ŋaa Sɛra.

english_verse: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.
translation_verse: Bɛrɩa ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Hɛba arɩ Malɩkɩɛl. Malɩkɩɛl nanʋala nɛ fa Bɛzaɩf.

english_verse: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.
translation_verse: Hɛba hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jafɩlɛt, Soma arɩ Hotam a pɛ ba dɩhaala Sʋa lɛ.

english_verse: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
translation_verse: Jafɩlɛt hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Pasak, Bɩmɩhal arɩ Asɩvaf.

english_verse: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
translation_verse: Soma ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Ahi, Roga, Huba arɩ Aram.

english_verse: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation_verse: Jafɩlɛt naambie Hotam ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Zofa, Imina, Sɛlɛs arɩ Amal.

english_verse: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
translation_verse: Bɛza, Hod, Sama, Sɩlɩsa, Ɩtɩraŋ arɩ Bɛɛra.

english_verse: Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
translation_verse: Jɛta hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jefuni, Pɩsɩpa arɩ Ara.

english_verse: Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
translation_verse: Ula hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Ara, Hanɩɛl arɩ Rɩzɩa.

english_verse: These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba kala fa ŋaa Asa doho nɩaa nɛ. Ba fa ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɩaa sɩɩ zil nɛ, a ŋaa laalɩyuori-duoruŋ ma. Laalɩyuoro-la sɩ hɛ Asa doho tʋɔŋ, ba kala fa ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩdʋ nɛ ba sɩ dɩɩsa a ŋmʋnsa bil.

english_verse: Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah,
translation_verse: Bɛnjamɩŋ bii-hɩaŋ nɛ Bɛla, Asɩbɛl ŋaa ʋ bii-lɩa, Ahara ŋaa ʋ bii-tori,

english_verse: Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud,
translation_verse: Bɛla hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Ada, Gɛra, Abihud,

english_verse: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
translation_verse: Abɩsʋa, Naamaŋ, Ahʋa,

english_verse: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
translation_verse: Gɛra, Sɛfʋfaŋ arɩ Huram.

english_verse: Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.
translation_verse: Naamaŋ, Ahija arɩ Gɛra. Gɛra fa ŋaa Uza arɩ Ahihud nyɩmma nɛ, ʋ nɛ fa laa ba sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba mʋ.

english_verse: Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath.
translation_verse: Bɛrɩa arɩ Sɛma. Ba fa ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ a hɔŋ tabal-la ba sɩ yɩrɛ Aɩjalɔŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kiri nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɔŋ Gaf tabal-la lɛ ba lɩɩ.

english_verse: These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba kala ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ ba doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, aŋ pɛ ŋaa nɩbalaa, ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil. Ba fa hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there
translation_verse: Jɛyɛl nɛ fa saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gibioŋ, a hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Ʋ haala yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Maaka.

english_verse: along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: Ʋ bii-hɩaŋ ma nɛ Abɩdɔŋ. Ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ: Zuu, Kɩs, Baal, Nɛɛ, Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
translation_verse: Gɛdɔ, Ahio, Zɛka,

english_verse: and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives. The Descendants of King Saul
translation_verse: arɩ Mɩkɩlɔf sɩ ŋaa Sɩmɩa nyɩmma. Ba ma hɔnɔ kpagɛ ba naambiiriŋ nɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Nɛɛ nanʋala nɛ Kɩs, Kɩs ma nanʋala nɛ Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jonataŋ, Malɩkɩ-Sʋa, Abɩnadab arɩ Ɛsɩ-Baal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah,
translation_verse: Jonataŋ ma nanʋala nɛ Mɛrɩb-Baal, Mɩka nyɩmma.

english_verse: and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Mɩka hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Pɩtɔŋ, Mɛlɛk, Tarɩa arɩ Ahas.

english_verse: Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza,
translation_verse: Ahas ma nanʋala nɛ Jehuada, Jehuada ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Alɛmɛf, Azɩmavɛf arɩ Zimiri. Zimiri ma nanʋala nɛ Moza.

english_verse: as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Azɛl fa lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩdʋ nɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ: Azɩrɩkam, Bokeru, Ɩsɩmɛl, Sɩarɩa, Obadaaya arɩ Hanaŋ.

english_verse: Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Azɛl naambie Ɛsɛk ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Ulam, ʋ bii-hɩaŋ, Jeyus ʋ bii-lɩa arɩ Ɛlɩfɛlɛt ʋ bii-tori.

english_verse: Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of
translation_verse: Ulam hambolibiisiŋ fa ŋaa bayuori-wajɩaba nɛ, a yuyuo toŋ woruŋ. Ba fa kɛŋ biiriŋ arɩ nihee zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ. Nɩaa deemba kala ŋaa Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: And the first people to return to their towns included priests, Levites, temple workers, and other Israelites.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ mɩɩra kɔ ba tasɩŋ, a hɔŋ ba dɩ-tɩɩlaa nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Levi doho nɩaa, Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Juda doho, Bɛnjamɩŋ doho, Efirem arɩ Manasɛ doho doho a fa hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ:

english_verse: Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ mɩɩra kɔ nɛ ha: Adaaya. Ʋ nyɩmma nɛ Jeroham, Jeroham ma nyɩmma nɛ Pasɩhɔ, Pasɩhɔ ma nyɩmma nɛ Malɩkɩja, arɩ Maasaɩ. Ʋ nyɩmma nɛ Adɩɛl, Adɩɛl ma nyɩmma nɛ Jazɛra, Jazɛra ma nyɩmma nɛ Mɛsʋlam, Mɛsʋlam ma nyɩmma nɛ Mɛsɩlɛmɩf, Mɛsɩlɛmɩf ma nyɩmma nɛ Ɩma.

english_verse: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan,
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩa boi-baalaa a hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ: Salum, Akub, Talɩmɔŋ, Ahɩmaŋ arɩ ba naambiiriŋ. Salum nɛ fa ŋaa ba sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
translation_verse: Ba faa pɔ boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kuoro Boi-baalɩŋ nɛ a hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Ba naabalɩmaba nɛ faa pɔ Levi doho nɩaa bugoo.

english_verse: Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kori nanʋala Salum. Kori nyɩmma nɛ fa Ɛbɩasaf, Ɛbɩasaf ma nyɩmma nɛ Kora arɩ ʋ naambiiri-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ ŋaa Kora nɩaa, ba nɛ faa pɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ, arɩ ba naabalɩmaba fa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Elieza nanʋala Finihas nɛ faa beŋ ba nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ boi-baalaa. La TƖƖNA fa chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
translation_verse: Mɛsɛlɛmɩa nanʋala Zɛkarɩya ma nɛ faa pɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boi-baalɩŋ.

english_verse: and now they guarded the temple gates.
translation_verse: Ba dɩ ba doho nɩaa nɛ haa beŋ Wɩa dɩa boi-baalaa.

english_verse: There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple.
translation_verse: Boi-pɔɔrɔ-la faa beŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ boyee kala nɛ.

english_verse: Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty.
translation_verse: Ba naambiiri-la sɩ hɛ ba tabiisiŋ lɛ fa yie kʋ laa ba lɛ a pɔ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ balɩpɛ aŋ ka pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there.
translation_verse: Boi-pɔɔrɔ-la nɩhɩasɩŋ fa ŋaa banɛsɛ nɛ. Ba ŋaa Levi doho nɩaa nɛ. Ba nɛ faa beŋ dɩɩsɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩa tʋɔŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Ba fa yie chɩna golli Wɩa dɩa-la tɩtaŋɩŋ nɛ a pɔ, a sii chʋchʋɔŋ a kɛŋ ʋ boi-baala suri.

english_verse: Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ nɛ faa beŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩa lɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ paa kʋ lɩɩ ba yie dɩɩsɛ nɛ, dɩ ba nɛ bɩra paa jʋʋ ma, ba dɩɩsɛ.

english_verse: But only the priests could mix the spices.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dʋndʋŋ nɛ fa kɛŋ tegisi-la tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings.
translation_verse: Levi tɩɩna kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Matɩtɩa, Kora tɩŋŋaa Salum bii-hɩaŋ, ʋ nɛ ba fa leŋ ʋ wʋwasɛ boroboro-la ba sɩ kaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
translation_verse: Kohaf tɩŋŋaa naambiiriŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ fa yie wasɛ boroboro a daŋ teebʋl nyuŋ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ na-kala.

english_verse: The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
translation_verse: Levi dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ nɛ fa ŋaa yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa, ba fa hɛ Wɩa dɩa-la tʋɔŋ nɛ, ba fa bɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-dɔŋ ka tɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba faa tɩŋ Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala.

english_verse: All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem. King Saul's Family (
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba kala ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ Levi doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, aŋ ŋaa nɩbalaa ma ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil. Ba fa hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ. Sɔɔl doho nɩaa

english_verse: the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
translation_verse: Mɩkɩlɔf nanʋala nɛ Sɩmɩa. Ba ma hɔnɔ kpagɛ ba naambiiriŋ nɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived.
translation_verse: Jɛyɛl nɛ fa saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gibioŋ, a hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Ʋ haala yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Maaka.

english_verse: They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: Ʋ bii-hɩaŋ ma nɛ Abɩdɔŋ. Ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ: Zuu, Kɩs, Baal, Nɛɛ, Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth
translation_verse: Gɛdɔ, Ahio, Zɛkarɩya arɩ Mɩkɩlɔf.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Nɛɛ nanʋala nɛ Kɩs, Kɩs ma nanʋala nɛ Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jonataŋ, Malɩkɩ-Sʋa, Abɩnadab arɩ Ɛsɩ-Baal.

english_verse: The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Azɛl fa lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩdʋ nɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ: Azɩrɩkam, Bokeru, Ɩsɩmɛl, Sɩarɩa, Obadaaya arɩ Hanaŋ.

english_verse: The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa kʋ yuo Iziral tɩŋŋaa a kpʋba woruŋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɩlɩbʋa lɛ, ka ba dɔnsʋŋ fá a lɛl.

english_verse: Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead,
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sʋba a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ. Ʋ vɩa ʋ niiŋ nɛ aŋ mʋ vʋgʋra teeŋ dɩ ʋ chɛ na wɩaa lɛlɛɛ teeŋ,

english_verse: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
translation_verse: Ka Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kire to Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ harɩŋ, a kpʋ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ deemba batori: Jonataŋ, Abɩnadab arɩ Malɩkɩ-Sʋa.

english_verse: The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Laal-la sɩ kʋ lɩma kɛŋ Sɔɔl, ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yagʋ arɩ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ, a bolimu.

english_verse: Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want those godless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.” But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Then Saul stuck himself in the stomach with his own sword and fell on the blade.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kori ʋ laalɩyuori kɩaa, “Lɩɩsɛ ŋ tokobiiŋ a tɔɔmɛ kpʋ, ŋɩɩ dee disiŋ tɩŋŋaa deemba jaŋ kʋ kpʋmɛ a tʋʋsɛ mɩ joŋŋoo.” Ama fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ kori ʋ laalɩyuori kɩaa nɛ, ʋ bɩ wuo ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa tokobiiŋ a pɛ, a tel ʋ nyuŋ a kpʋ ʋ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kori Sɔɔl laalɩyuori kɩalɩŋ sɩ na dɩ ʋ sʋba, ʋ ma lɩɩsɛ tokobiiŋ kpʋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɛ Sɔɔl lɛ.

english_verse: Saul, three of his sons, and all his male relatives were dead.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ batori arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala sʋʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Jɛzɩrɛl fuonaaŋ lɛ sɩ na dɩ Iziral laalɩyuoroo kala fá a lɛl, ka Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ ma sʋʋ, ba lɩɩ fá kagɛ ba tasɩŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa kʋ jʋʋ hɔŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: The next day the Philistines came back to the battlefield to carry away the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers. When they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa,
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la sii mʋ dɩ ba wuri nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa kɩaa, ba na dɩ Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ batori sʋʋ pɩŋ Gɩlɩbʋa peeliŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: they took Saul's weapons, pulled off his armor, and cut off his head. Then they sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the news among their people and to thank the idols of their gods.
translation_verse: Ba keri Sɔɔl nyuŋ aŋ wuri ʋ laalɩyuori kɩaa, aŋ tɩŋ nɩaa ba gɔllɔ heele bʋl wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ kala lɛ arɩ ba vesiŋ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ ʋ laalɩyuori kɩalɩŋ a bil ba vesiŋ dɩa lɛ, aŋ joŋ Sɔɔl nyuŋ sagɛ ba vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Dagɔŋ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: When the people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
translation_verse: Jabɛs Gɩlɩad nɩaa sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa Sɔɔl lɛ,

english_verse: some brave men went to get his body and the bodies of his three sons. The men brought the bodies back to Jabesh, where they buried them under an oak tree. Then for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ sii a mʋ paa Sɔɔl arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kʋsʋʋnʋŋ a kaa mɩɩra mʋ Jabɛs a hugiba tɩɩ-bal kʋbala bʋbʋɔŋ, aŋ vɔɔ niiŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ.

english_verse: instead of asking the Lord. So the Lord had Saul killed and gave his kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: aŋ vɩa dɩ ʋ pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA kpʋʋ aŋ joŋ ʋ kuoruŋ pɩ Jesi nanʋala Devit.

english_verse: The Jebusites said, “You won't be able to get in here!” But David captured the fortress of Mount Zion, which is now called the City of David.
translation_verse: bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ daha.” Ama Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa wuo yuo dii Zaayɔŋ dɩɩ-duo-la, ʋ nɛ lɛɛlɛ baa yɩrɛ Devit taŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Israel's leaders met with David at Hebron and said, “We are your relatives,
translation_verse: Iziral doho doho-la kala kɔ Devit teeŋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ a bʋl, “La ŋaa ŋ doho nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: So we have come to crown you king of Israel.” David made an agreement with the leaders and asked the Lord to be their witness. Then the leaders poured olive oil on David's head to show that he was now king of Israel. This happened just as the Lord's prophet Samuel had said. David Captures Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Iziral nɩhɩasɩŋ kala sɩ sii kɔ kuoro Devit teeŋ ŋɩɩ Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ, Devit leŋ ʋ dɩ nɩhɩasɩ-la hɛ niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Ba joŋ nʋʋŋ a tɩsɛ Devit nyuŋ a dagɛ arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro, arɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ to Samʋɛl lɛ a dagɛ ŋɩɩ. Devit yuo dii Jerusalɛm

english_verse: David had told his troops, “The first soldier to kill a Jebusite will become my army commander.” And since Joab son of Zeruiah attacked first, he became commander.
translation_verse: Devit fa bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ kpʋ Jebus tɩmma-la dɔŋɔ, tɩɩna nɛ jaŋ ŋaa laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋab, ʋ naaŋ nɛ fa Zeruya, ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ lɩɩ kpʋ ba dɔŋɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ hɩasɩŋ pʋ.

english_verse: The Lord had promised that David would become king, and so everyone in Israel gave David their support. Certain warriors also helped keep his kingdom strong.
translation_verse: Devit laalɩyuori babiibalaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nɛ leŋe ʋ kuoruŋ dol dɩ ʋ wuo bibeŋ tintee-la kala, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jerusalem was called Jebus at the time, and David led Israel's army to attack the town.
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ kuoro Devit arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sii mʋ dɩ ba yuo Jerusalɛm nɩaa, bʋa-la lɛ ba faa yɩrʋ Jebus nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jebus tɩmma-la sɩ hɔŋ nɩmɛ

english_verse: Later, David moved to the fortress—that's why it's called the City of David.
translation_verse: Devit sɩ yuo laa dɩɩ-duo-la, ʋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ, a kɛŋ lee-la yɩyɩrɛ Devit taŋ.

english_verse: David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side. The Three Warriors (
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna chɩŋ Devit harɩŋ woruŋ, ʋ doluŋ wasa pʋŋa pɛ. Devit laalɩyuori babiibalaa

english_verse: Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ bɩra kpʋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori-duo kʋbala sɩ waayi. Ijipiti tɩɩna-la fa kori tiŋ-bal nɛ a nagɛ gɛrɩpɛ yuori daaŋ, ka Bɛnaaya mʋ ʋ lɛ arɩ toŋguluŋ, a kɛŋ baal-la timiŋ laa a gʋra kpʋʋ.

english_verse: and he said, “I'm very thirsty. I wish I had a drink of water from the well by the gate to Bethlehem.”
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-nyʋasʋŋ kɛŋ Devit, ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ fa jaŋ cho dɩ nʋʋ mʋ ŋaa lɩɩŋ vil-la sɩ kpagɛ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm boi-baalɩŋ a kaa kʋ pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ nyʋa.”

english_verse: The first of these warriors was Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle he killed
translation_verse: Devit laalɩyuori babiibalaa yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la: Jasɔbɩam, a ŋaa Hakɩmɔŋ tɩɩna. Ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ batori ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ laalɩyuori babiibal kpaŋkpamba sɩpaalaara. Ʋ fa kɛŋ timiŋ a kpʋ nɩaa zɔɔ-batori nɛ laal-bala lɛ.

english_verse: Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ, Dodai nanʋala Elieza, a ŋaa Aho tɩɩna.

english_verse: except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
translation_verse: ka Elieza arɩ ʋ nɩaa chɩŋ baga-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ a pɔ kpʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la. Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA leŋe ba yuo diiba nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ mara arɩ fii nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba tʋɔŋ nɩaa batori sii mʋ Devit teeŋ, dɩ ʋ faa bʋbʋa-la sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Adulam lɛ. Dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa laalɩyuoroo ma ŋmoo ba buguŋ Refem fuonaaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and had taken over Bethlehem. David was in a fortress,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Devit faa bʋbʋa-la lɛ, ka Fɩlɩsɩtɩa laalɩyuoroo ma fa hɛ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm lɛ.

english_verse: and said, “Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.” The Three Warriors did these brave deeds. The Thirty Warriors (
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl, “Wɩa bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ mɩ nyʋa lɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ nagɛ nɩalɩŋ batori sɩ joŋ ba mɩɩsɩŋ yɔɔ sʋʋŋ a ŋaaʋ kʋ pɩmɛ chalɩŋ nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩ lɩɩ-la nyʋa. Bɔɩ-duo wɩalɩŋ laalɩyuori babiibal-kpaŋkpamba-la batori fa sɩ ŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ laa yɩrɩŋ kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ batori-la. Ʋ fa bɩ ba tʋɔŋ pɛ, aŋ mɩɩra kʋ ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion.
translation_verse: Jehoyada nanʋala Bɛnaaya ma fa ŋaa laalɩyuori-duo nɛ, a lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kabɩzɛɛl. Ʋ fa tɩŋ bɔɩ-duo tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ fa kpʋ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori-duoruŋ balɩa nɛ. Bʋrʋŋ tɔ bʋa kʋbala lɛ, ka ʋ tuu buo-tuoŋ tʋɔŋ a kpʋ naachigiŋ.

english_verse: Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors,
translation_verse: Bɔɩ-duo wɩalɩŋ Jehoyada nanʋala Bɛnaaya sɩ ŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ ma fa laa yɩrɩŋ nɛ a nagɛ laalɩyuori babiibala-la batori.

english_verse: even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa laa yɩrɩŋ a kɩɩ laalɩyuori babiibala-la mara arɩ fii, ama ʋ fa bɩ nɩalɩŋ batori lɛ pɛ. Ka Devit joŋu ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔʋ tʋɔŋ nɩhɩaŋ.

english_verse: Several of these warriors were from King Saul's own tribe of Benjamin. They were experts at using a bow and arrows, and they could shoot an arrow or sling a stone with either hand.
translation_verse: Ba fa ŋaa Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa nɛ, kuoro Sɔɔl naambiiriŋ. Ba fa kɛŋ nadiiŋ arɩ nagʋa kala yuyuo toŋ arɩ kpalɩŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Men from the tribe of Gad also joined David at his fortress in the desert and served as his warriors. They were also brave soldiers—fierce as lions and quick as gazelles. They were always prepared to fight with shields and spears.
translation_verse: Gad doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo dɔnsʋŋ ma kɔ Devit teeŋ nɛ ʋ sɩ faa dɩ-duo-la lɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ. Ba fa ŋaa laalɩyuori-duoru nɛ a kɛŋ hɔɔtaalɩ-la ba sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ arɩ tiŋŋee yuyuo laalɩŋ. Ba sɩaa fa kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ a nagɛ naachigiŋ nɛ, ka ba naaŋ ma lɩŋ woruŋ arɩ wieme.

english_verse: All these men were army officers; some were high-ranking officers over a thousand troops, and others were officers over a hundred troops.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba kala fa ŋaa laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaaraa nɛ. Dɔnsʋŋ bibeŋ nɩaa bʋɩba, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma bibeŋ zɔlɔba.

english_verse: Earlier, they had crossed the Jordan River when it flooded, and they chased out the people who lived in the valleys on each side of the river. Warriors from the Benjamin and Judah tribes
translation_verse: Ba nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la jɩna tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-bumbuŋ lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ fuo-la sɩ chaasa su a gbu lɩlɩɩ, a kiri nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ fuonaa-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ kala ba fá pɩsɛ.

english_verse: One time a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went to the fortress where David was staying.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Juda doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma fa kɔ Devit teeŋ nɛ dɩ-duo-la lɛ ʋ sɩ faa.

english_verse: David met them outside and said, “If you are coming as friends to fight on my side, then stay and join us. But if you try to turn me over to my enemies, the God our ancestors worshiped will punish you, because I have done nothing wrong.”
translation_verse: Devit lɩɩ chemba a bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ fɩɛlɩŋ nɛ maa kɔ dɩ ma pɛ mɩ lɛ, ma naawʋ. Ama dɩ ma nɛ kɔ dɩ ma jommi yalla pɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, a leŋ dɩ la naabalɩmaba Wɩa dɔgɩsɛma, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa chei.”

english_verse: and brave soldiers, and so David made them officers in his army. They fought on his side when enemy troops attacked.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala fa ŋaa laalɩyuori babiibala nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit leŋ ba ŋaa ʋ laalɩyuoroo sɩpaalaaraa, a pɛ ʋ lɛ ba yuyuo nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kʋʋ yuou.

english_verse: Other Israelites from as far away as the territories of Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought cattle and sheep to slaughter for food. They also brought donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen that were loaded down with flour, dried figs and raisins, wine, and olive oil. Everyone in Israel was very happy.
translation_verse: Ba naambiiriŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma kɛŋ kakusuŋ, bʋntaŋŋaba, kakusuŋ sɩ nagɛ janɩŋ arɩ nɛ-ferisiŋ a chʋŋ kʋdiilee lɩɩ Ɩsaka, Zebuluŋ arɩ Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa tinteeŋ a kaa kʋ pɩba. Kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa kɔ nɛ ŋaa: Munuŋ, tutogi nambil-hɩlaa, tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ, olif nʋʋŋ, nɛsɩŋ arɩ piesee. Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ fa su Iziral tinteeŋ kala nɛ.

english_verse: All of these soldiers voluntarily came to Hebron because they wanted David to become king of Israel. In fact, everyone in Israel wanted the same thing.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoroo deemba kala chaasa kʋ lɩɩ nɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ a mʋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba leŋ dɩ Devit dii Iziral kuoruŋ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩkaanaa ma kala fa cho ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: The soldiers stayed in Hebron three days, eating and drinking what their relatives had prepared for them.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ chʋa Devit teeŋ tapʋlaa batori nɛ, a dii kɩaa aŋ nyʋnyʋa. Ba dɩa nɩaa fa kɛŋ kʋdiilee kʋ pɩba nɛ.

english_verse: Then he led them to Baalah in Judah, which was also called Kiriath-Jearim. They went there to get the sacred chest and bring it to Jerusalem, because it belonged to the Lord God, whose throne is above the winged creatures on the lid of the chest.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit arɩ Iziral tɩmma-la kala mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baala a hɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ ba joŋ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa niiriŋ daga kaa kɔ. Daga-la nyuŋ nɛ ba ŋaa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a sagɛ ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: David was afraid what the Lord might do to him, and he asked himself, “Should I really be the one to take care of the sacred chest?”
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ Devit tapʋlɩɩ-la a tɩŋ Wɩa wɩaa, ʋ bʋl, “Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa a joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la kaa kɔ mɩ teeŋ?”

english_verse: The people agreed this was the right thing to do.
translation_verse: Ba kala tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ wɩɩ-la lɛ, ba sɛɩ.

english_verse: The sacred chest was still at Abinadab's house, and when David and the crowd arrived there, they brought the chest outside and placed it on a new ox cart. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio guided the cart,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la Abɩnadab dɩa lɛ, a joŋo daŋ nɛsɩŋ toruko falɩŋ lɛ. Uza arɩ Ahio nɛ fa kɛŋ toruko-la vɩvɛŋ.

english_verse: while David and the crowd danced and sang praises to the Lord with all their might. They played music on small harps and other stringed instruments, and on tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit arɩ Iziral tɩmma-la kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, faasa jʋjʋɔsɛ arɩ ba doluŋ kala Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a du chenniŋ, kɔnɛba, aa chɩchɩgɩsɛ chɩnchɩgɩsɩŋ, buguloo, a ŋmʋŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ ma.

english_verse: But when they came to Chidon's threshing place, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out and took hold of the chest to stop it from falling.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kʋ yi baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɩdɔŋ taha, nɛsɩ-la gɛrɛ. Uza guu mʋ kɛŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la dɩ ʋ sɩ́ tel.

english_verse: The Lord God was very angry with Uzzah for doing this, and he killed Uzzah right there beside the chest.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa chaasa na baanɩŋ Uza nyuŋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ digi Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la. Ʋ ŋmobu kpʋ a bil daga-la sɛmɛ.

english_verse: David then got angry with God for killing Uzzah. So he named that place “Attack on Uzzah,” and it's been called that ever since.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit ma na baanɩŋ a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ kpʋ Uza. A kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala ba kɛŋ lee-la a yɩyɩrɛ Pɛrɛs Uza nɛ.

english_verse: So instead of taking it to Jerusalem, David decided to take it to the home of Obed-Edom, who lived in the town of Gath.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bɩ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la joŋo mʋ ʋ teeŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mɩɩra joŋ a kaa mʋ bil baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm dɩa lɛ, ʋ ŋaa Giti tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: The chest stayed there for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-Edom, his family, and everything he owned.
translation_verse: Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la fa hɛ Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm dɩa lɛ chɛnsɩŋ batori nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA pɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: David and his army marched to Baal-Perazim, where they attacked and defeated the Philistines. He said, “I defeated my enemies because God broke through them like a mighty flood.” So he named the place “The Lord Broke Through.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa sii mʋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal Pɛrazɩm. Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ yuo diiba, aŋ bʋl, “Wɩa leŋe mɩ yuo dii mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, a nagɛ fuoŋ sɩ suo a gbu lɩɩ pɛllɛ paa kɩaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ lee-la a yɩyɩrɛ Baal Pɛrazɩm.

english_verse: David obeyed God and he defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Gibeon to the entrance to Gezer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit ŋaa ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ dagʋ, a kire kpʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa laalɩyuoroo a chɩŋ Gibioŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ a kaa mʋ Gɛza.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre sent some officials to David. They brought along carpenters and stone workers, and enough cedar logs to build David a palace.
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ, Taaya tinteeŋ kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hiram tɩŋ tɩndaaraa ba kɔ Devit teeŋ, a kɛŋ kuolu daasɩŋ arɩ kapɩntaba arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ tabɩaa tɩntɩŋŋaa, dɩ ba kʋ saa kuoru dɩa pʋ.

english_verse: After David moved to Jerusalem, he married more women and had more sons and daughters.
translation_verse: Devit sɩ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ, ʋ jaa haalaa yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ, ba lʋl hambolibiisiŋ arɩ toloo a yʋgɛ a pʋ.

english_verse: From then on, David became even more famous, and the Lord made all the nations afraid of him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit yɩrɩŋ teeli tintee-la kala, La TƖƖNA leŋ tintee kala nɩaa fɩfáʋ.

english_verse: When the Philistines heard that David had become king of Israel, they came to capture him. But David heard about their plan and marched out to meet them in battle.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩ nɩa dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ Devit nɛ a joŋ nʋʋŋ tɩsʋ ʋ ŋaa Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro, ba laalɩyuoroo kala sii mʋ a chɩchɛʋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ dɩ ba kɛnʋ. Devit nɩɩ a sii lɩɩ dɩ ʋ chemba.

english_verse: The Philistines had already camped in Rephaim Valley and were raiding the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la kʋ lɩɩ su Refem fuonaaŋ a yuo dii tabiisi-la sɩ kpagɛ lee-la.

english_verse: David asked God, “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help me win?” The Lord told David, “Yes, attack them! I will give you victory.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit pɩɛsɛ Wɩa, “Mɩ mʋ yuo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-laa? Ŋ jaŋ jomba hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛɛ?” La TƖƖNA bʋla pʋ, “Mʋ, mɩ jaŋ jomba hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Then David ordered his troops to burn the idols that the Philistines had left behind.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la fá a vɩa ba tɔŋŋɔɔ ta nɩmɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ dɩ ba paa nyɩgɛ.

english_verse: Some time later, the Philistines came back into the hill country and camped in Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la bɩra kʋ lɩɩ a yuo dii tabiisi-la sɩ hɛ Refem fuonaa-la lɛ.

english_verse: David asked God what he should do, and God answered, “Don't attack them from the front. Circle around behind them where the balsam trees are.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bɩra pɩɛsɛ Wɩa dɩ ʋ na ʋ jaŋ bɩra wuo mʋ yuobaa. Wɩa sɩ, “Sɩ́ ba leriŋ tegi tegi mʋ, gollo to ba harɩŋ a chɩŋ tɩɩsɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ‘balɩsam’ sɩpaaŋ aŋ yuoba.

english_verse: Wait there until you hear the treetops making the sound of marching troops. That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army. So you must then attack quickly!”
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kʋ nɩɩ laalɩyuoroo naasɩŋ dɔmɔ ‘balɩsam’ tɩɩsɩ-la nyuŋ, mʋ yuyuo, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋɩɩ daga arɩ mɩ laa ŋ sɩpaaŋ mʋ nɛ dɩ mɩ yuo dii Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la.”

english_verse: David had several buildings built in Jerusalem, and he had a tent set up where the sacred chest would be kept.
translation_verse: Devit sɩ saa ʋ tɩtɩa dɩɩsɩŋ ʋ tabal-la lɛ a dɛrɛ, ʋ wasɛ leriŋ, a hɛ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la lɛbɩŋ.

english_verse: Next, David invited everyone to come to Jerusalem and watch the sacred chest being carried to the place he had set up for it.
translation_verse: Devit yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ Jerusalɛm lɛ dɩ ba joŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la a kaa mʋ bil lee-la ʋ sɩ wasa.

english_verse: He also sent for Aaron's descendants and for the Levites. The Levites that came were:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa.

english_verse: Shemaiah, the leader of the Elizaphan clan, and
translation_verse: Ɛlɩzafaŋ doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ, Sɛmaaya nɛ ŋaa ba sɩpaalaara a pɛ ʋ naambiiriŋ zɔɔ-balɩa lɛ.

english_verse: David called together these six Levites and the two priests, Zadok and Abiathar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit yɩrɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa Zadɔk arɩ Abɩata, a pɛ Levi doho nɩaa balɩdʋ lɛ: Ʋrɩɛl, Asaaya, Jowɛl, Sɛmaaya, Ɛlɩɛl arɩ Amɩnadab.

english_verse: The first time we tried to bring the chest to Jerusalem, we didn't ask the Lord what he wanted us to do. He was angry with us, because you Levites weren't there to carry the chest.”
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ma Levi doho nɩaa fa sɩ dee bɩ daga-la joŋo kaa kɔ nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa na baanɩŋ la nyuŋ ŋɩɩ. La fa bɩ ʋ pɩɛsa na ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ la to.”

english_verse: The priests and the Levites made themselves clean. They were now ready to carry the sacred chest
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa pɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa ta a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba joŋ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la.

english_verse: on poles that rested on their shoulders, just as the Lord had told Moses to do.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩalɩŋ joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la daŋ daaterigeba lɛ a joŋo baasɛ, arɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ to Mosis lɛ a dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: David then told the leaders to choose some Levites to sing and play music on small harps, other stringed instruments, and cymbals.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ Levi doho nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ ba naambiiriŋ dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba du kɔnɛba, chenniŋ, a chɩgɩsɛ buguloo a yɩɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ yɩɩlaa a hɛ.

english_verse: Four Levites were then appointed to guard the sacred chest. They were Berechiah, Elkanah, Obed-Edom, and Jehiah. Finally, David chose priests to walk in front of the sacred chest and blow trumpets. They were Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer. The Sacred Chest Is Brought to Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Sɛbanɩa, Josafat, Nɛtanɛl, Amasaɩ, Zɛkarɩya, Bɛnaaya arɩ Elieza, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma nɛ fa laa daga-la sɩpaaŋ aa ŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ. Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm arɩ Jɛhɩa nɛ faa pɔ daga-la.

english_verse: David, the leaders of Israel, and the army commanders were very happy as they went to Obed-Edom's house to get the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa arɩ ba laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩasɩŋ mʋ Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm dɩa dɩ ba joŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la, ba kala jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: God gave the Levites the strength they needed to carry the chest, and so they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ Wɩa sɩ pɛ Levi doho nɩaa lɛ ba wuo chʋŋ daga-la, ba kpʋ nɛ-belliŋ balɩpɛ arɩ pie-belliŋ ma balɩpɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: David, the Levites, Chenaniah the music director, and all the musicians were wearing linen robes, and David was also wearing a linen cloth.
translation_verse: Devit fa laalɛ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ gɛrɩ-duduoŋ nɛ. Levi doho nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ chʋŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la arɩ Kɛnanɩa sɩ ŋaa yɩɩlɩ yɩɩra-la sɩpaalaara a pɛ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩra-la kala arɩ kʋduuro-la kala fa laalɛ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ gɛrɩ-duduosuŋ nɛ. Devit fa ha laalɛ gɛrɩpɛ-fʋfʋlɩɩ-la gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: While the sacred chest was being carried into Jerusalem, everyone was celebrating by shouting and playing music on horns, trumpets, cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kɛŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la kʋʋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm a ŋɩŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ aŋ ŋmʋŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ, a chɩchɩgɩsɛ buguloo, a dudu kɔnɛba arɩ chenniŋ.
