english_verse: Saul's daughter Michal looked out her window and watched the chest being brought into David's City. But when she saw David jumping and dancing in honor of the Lord, she was disgusted.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɛŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la kʋʋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm ŋɩɩ, Sɔɔl tolo Mɩkal to tokoro a nyilime na Devit. Ʋ sɩ naʋ dɩ ʋ fɩla aŋ pɛ gʋgʋa, ʋ tʋɔŋ lɩɩʋ.

english_verse: After David had finished, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord
translation_verse: Devit sɩ sʋl Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la a dɛrɛ, ʋ sʋl Wɩa pɩ nɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: and gave every person in the crowd a small loaf of bread, some meat, and a handful of raisins.
translation_verse: aŋ joŋ boroboro, kpʋla nɛnɛɛ arɩ girep nɛŋ-hɩlaa a kpaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩ-daŋ-la kala, baalaa arɩ haalaa.

english_verse: David appointed some of the Levites to serve at the sacred chest; they were to play music and sing praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Devit lɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la sɩpaaŋ, dɩ ba du kɩaa a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa.

english_verse: Asaph was their leader, and Zechariah was his assistant. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and another man named Jeiel were appointed to play small harps and stringed instruments. Asaph himself played the cymbals,
translation_verse: Asaf nɛ fa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa kʋhɩaŋ, Zɛkarɩya tɩtɩgɛ. Ba harɩŋ nɩaa ma nɛ ŋ-la: Jɛyɛl, Sɛmɩramɔf, Jɛhɩɛl, Matɩtɩa, Ɛlɩab, Bɛnaaya, Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm arɩ Jɛyɛl. Ba nɛ faa du kɔnɛba arɩ chenniŋ, ka Asaf ma chɩchɩgɩsɛ buguloo.

english_verse: and the two priests Benaiah and Jahaziel were to blow trumpets every day in front of the sacred chest. David's Song of Praise (Psalms
translation_verse: Bɛnaaya arɩ Jahazɩɛl sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma nɛ faa ŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la sɩpaaŋ bʋa na-kala. Yɩɩla-la Devit sɩ yɩɩ dɛnnɛ Wɩa

english_verse: We must never forget his agreement and his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ nii-la ʋ sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ma pɛgɛ ka yʋ, nii-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu,

english_verse: You belong to the family of Israel, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: ma-na Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnna doho nɩaa, Jekɔb biiriŋ, nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa.

english_verse: That same day, David instructed Asaph and his relatives for the first time to sing these praises to the Lord:
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la Devit leŋ Asaf arɩ ʋ harɩŋ nɩaa yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ deeŋ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA:

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Má lɔllɛ La TƖƖNA, má yɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ. Má leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, má bʋl wʋkpuŋkperisi-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa a pɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power. Worship him always.
translation_verse: Má joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ lɛ, aŋ chɩchɛʋ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Má liisi wʋkpuŋkperisi-la arɩ wʋduoru-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ dii sarɩya ʋ bʋa lɛ,

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa, ʋ niiŋ wɩaa hɛ dʋnɩa lee-kala nɛ.

english_verse: God made an eternal promise
translation_verse: nii-la ʋ sɩ bile ʋ dɩ Abɩraham arɩ Aɩzɩk pɛgɛ.

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ pɩŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋ kʋŋ.”

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ba fa bɩ wɩɩ maga, ba chaasa muuri nɛ a ŋaa nʋhʋɔra ma tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: Ba fa gɔllɔɔ baarɛ nɛ, a lɩɩ tintee a mʋ tintee.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ leŋe nʋʋkala dɔgɩsɛba, a tɩŋ ba wɩaa, ʋ dɔgɩsɛ kuoroo nɛ.

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ mɩ nɩaa mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa digu, a sɩ́ mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa ma wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa.”

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa pɩ La TƖƖNA, dʋnɩa nɩaa arɩ kʋŋkala. Tapʋlɩɩ kala, má heele bʋl ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ laala ta.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Má heele bʋl ʋ ballɩŋ wɩaa arɩ tɩntɩŋ-duoru-la ʋ sɩ tɩma a pɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nɛ yʋga kɩɩ kʋŋkala a magɛ dɩ la faasa dɛnnʋ, ʋ nɛ maga dɩ la fá a kɩɩ vene kala.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Tintee wogusuŋ nɩaa kala kpaarɛ vesiŋ nɛ, ama La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Zɔmʋŋ arɩ ballɩŋ kala hɛ ʋ teeŋ, doluŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ su ʋ dɩa kala.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, tintee-na kala nɩaa, má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA a tɩŋ ʋ tʋla arɩ ʋ doluŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple. Worship the Lord, majestic and holy.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩ-balɩŋ, má kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kaa kʋ jʋʋ ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ. Má kpirime chʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble!” The world stands firm, never to be shaken.
translation_verse: Kʋŋ na-kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, má chichel ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Tinteeŋ chɩna nɛ kpaŋkpaŋ, kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛnʋ jigisi.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! And announce to the nations, “The Lord is King!”
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, má jʋjʋɔsɛ, dɩ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Má bʋla pɩ tinteyee nɩaa arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ kuoro.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all of its creatures and the fields to rejoice with all of their crops.
translation_verse: Mʋgʋ-balɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ, má ŋaa goŋ, bagɩsɩŋ arɩ kʋduuloo kala, má jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth.
translation_verse: Tɩɩsɩŋ ma kala sɩ hɛ duuŋ lɛ, jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA. Ʋ jaŋ kʋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa kala sarɩya.

english_verse: Praise the Lord because he is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Má lɔllɛ La TƖƖNA, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ wɩaa zɔmɔ, ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Say to him, “Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Má bʋla pʋ, “Laala ta, La TƖƖNA Wɩa, laala ta tinteyee nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ aŋ kɛnla kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ, dɩ la wuo lɔllʋŋ a dɛnnɛ ŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever.” After David finished, the people shouted, “Amen! Praise the Lord!” David Appoints Worship Leaders at Jerusalem and Gibeon
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa a kaa mʋ wuu. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala bʋl, ‘Amɩɩ’ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: David chose Asaph and the Levites in his clan to be in charge of the daily worship at the place where the sacred chest was kept.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit leŋ Asaf arɩ ʋ harɩŋ nɩalɩŋ hɛ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la teeŋ aa dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA bʋa na-kala a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga baa ŋaa tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: David also chose Zadok the priest and his relatives who were priests to serve at the Lord's sacred tent at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Devit fa leŋe Zadɔk sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɔnsʋŋ ma faa tɩŋ La TƖƖNA dɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ nɛ, dundolo-la nyuŋ ba sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa Gibioŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They were to offer sacrifices on the altar every morning and evening, just as the Lord had commanded in the Law he gave Israel.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ yie nyɩgɛ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ dɩdaanɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ kala Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ nyuŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ La TƖƖNA wombiiŋ teniŋ tʋɔŋ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba tuto.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were their assistants, as well as the other men who had been chosen to praise the Lord for his never-ending love.
translation_verse: Devit fa bɩra lɩɩsɛ Hemaŋ arɩ Jedutuŋ nɛ arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba dɩdɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, a tɩŋ ʋ chonuŋ sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were also responsible for blowing the trumpets, and for playing the cymbals and other instruments during worship at the tent. The Levites in Jeduthun's clan were the guards at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Hemaŋ arɩ Jedutuŋ nɛ faa ŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ, a chɩchɩgɩsɛ buguloo a dudu gugonnu-la dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba nɩɩ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa. Jedutuŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ faa pɔ boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: After that, everyone went home, and David went home to his family.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala mʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ, ka Devit ma mɩɩra kɔ dɩa dɩ ʋ sʋl Wɩa pɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa.

english_verse: Soon after David moved into his new palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Look around! I live in a palace made of cedar, but the sacred chest is kept in a tent.”
translation_verse: Kuoro Devit sɩ mʋ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru dɩɩ-falɩŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Netaŋ, “Mɩɩ jʋʋ kuoru dɩa ba sɩ kɛŋ kuolu daasɩŋ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ a saa nɛ, ka La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la hɛ lɛbɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: and yet you have promised to do even more for my descendants. You are treating me as if I am a very important person.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, a nagɛ bumbuŋ wɩɩ-la paala bɩ yʋgɛ, ŋ bɩra wasa dagɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna dɩa maachie sɩ jaŋ nagɛ. La TƖƖNA Wɩa, ŋ bemmi arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa ŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɩbalɩŋ.

english_verse: That night, the Lord told Nathan
translation_verse: Ama tɩtaŋ-la tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa bʋl wɩaa pɩ Netaŋ:

english_verse: to go to David and tell him: David, you are my servant, so listen carefully: You are not the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: “Mʋ bʋla pɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit, Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la, ‘Ŋ dee bɩ maga dɩ ŋ saa dɩa pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ jʋjʋʋ.

english_verse: I didn't live in a temple when I brought my people out of Egypt, and I don't live in one now. A tent has always been my home wherever I have gone with them.
translation_verse: Mɩ ha bɩ dɩa kala jʋa a chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa a lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ. Mɩ gɔllɔɔ baarɛ nɛ a jʋjʋʋ lɛbɩŋ.

english_verse: I chose special leaders and told them to be like shepherds for my people Israel. But did I ever say anything to even one of them about building a cedar temple for me?
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ kɛŋ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa vɩvɛŋ, mɩ ha bɩ ba sɩpaalaara-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ba bibemba kʋŋ pɩɛsa: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bɩ kuolu daasɩŋ kaa saa dɩa pɩmɛ?

english_verse: Wherever you went, I helped you and destroyed your enemies right in front of your eyes. I have made you one of the most famous people in the world.
translation_verse: Lee na-kala ŋ sɩ mʋa, mɩ chɩŋ ŋ harɩŋ nɛ, a yuo dii ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala. Lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ sii, arɩ dʋnɩa nɩbalaa yɩrɩŋ sɩ sii ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I have given my people Israel a land of their own where they can live in peace. They will no longer have to tremble with fear—evil nations won't bother them, as they did
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ leriŋ a pɩ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa, a leŋ ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba tɩtɩa lee, dɩ nʋʋ bɩra sɩ́ ba walɩmʋ. Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩra bɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba arɩ ba fa sɩ ŋaaba ŋɩɩ bumbuŋ-la,

english_verse: when I let judges rule my people, and I will keep your enemies from attacking you. Now I promise that like you, your descendants will be kings.
translation_verse: bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsɛ sɩpaalaaraa ba bibemba. Mɩ jaŋ yuo dii ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala. Lɛɛlɛ mɩ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ mɩ-na ŋ Tɩɩna tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ saa dɩa pɩŋ.

english_verse: I'll choose one of your sons to be king when you reach the end of your life and are buried beside your ancestors. I'll make him a strong ruler,
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ tapʋlaa nɛ yie dɩ ŋ sʋʋ a mʋ ŋ nyɩmmaba teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ ŋ bii-lʋlʋŋ dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ ŋ nyuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ kuoruŋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: and no one will be able to take his kingdom away from him. He will be the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ saa dɩa pɩmɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ kuoruŋ chɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I will be like a father to him, and he will be like a son to me. I will never put an end to my agreement with him, as I put an end to my agreement with Saul, who was king before you.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ nyɩmma, dɩ ʋ ma ŋaa mɩ bie. Mɩ chonuŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ dɛrɛ ʋ teeŋ, arɩ ʋ sɩ dɛrɛ Sɔɔl teeŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I will make sure that your son and his descendants will rule my people and my kingdom forever.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ didii kuoruŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.’ ”

english_verse: Nathan told David exactly what the Lord had said. David Gives Thanks to the Lord (
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Netaŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ joŋo dagʋ a pɩ Devit. Devit lɔllɛ Wɩa

english_verse: I am your servant, and you know my thoughts. What else can I say, except that you have honored me?
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, ŋ jɩŋ mɩ wɩɩkala nɛ. Mɩ bɩra bɩ wɩɩkala kɛnɛ mɩ bʋl, ŋ sɩ leŋe mɩ yɩrɩŋ sii ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: David went into the tent he had set up for the sacred chest. He sat there and prayed: Lord God, my family and I don't deserve what you have already done for us,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Devit sii mʋ jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ Wɩa niiriŋ daga sɩ hɛ, a hɔŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, aŋ chʋɔlʋ a bʋl: “La TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ dɩ mɩ dɩa nɩaa nɛ kʋbɛɛba, ŋ ŋaa wʋbalɩŋ deeŋ la lɛ?

english_verse: It was your choice to do these wonderful things for me and to make these promises.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa wʋbalɩŋ deeŋ, a leŋ mɩ jɩŋ a tɩŋ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna arɩ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: No other god is like you, Lord—you alone are God. Everything we have heard about you is true.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, kʋŋkala tuo a magɩŋ. Wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ nɩa daga arɩ ŋ nɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: And there is no other nation on earth like Israel, the nation you rescued from slavery in Egypt to be your own. You became famous by using great and wonderful miracles to force other nations and their gods out of your land, so that your people could live here.
translation_verse: Tintee dɔŋ tuo dʋnɩa lɛ a magɛ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Ba nɛ ŋ laa ta Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ faafaa, bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ ŋaa yosuŋ. Ŋ laaba ta dɩ ba ŋaa ŋ nɩaa nɛ. Wʋbala-la arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa pɩba leŋe ŋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ nɛ dʋnɩa kala lɛ. Ŋ kiri tinteyee nɩaa ta nɛ ŋ nɩaa sɩpaaŋ, ŋ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa ta Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You have chosen Israel to be your people forever, and you have become their God.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋaa ŋ nɩaa a kaa mʋ wuu. Ŋ-na La TƖƖNA nɛ lɛɛlɛ ŋaa ba Wɩa.

english_verse: Then you will be famous forever, and everyone will say, “The Lord All-Powerful rules Israel and is their God.” My kingdom will be strong,
translation_verse: dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa jaŋ bʋl, ‘La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ Iziral Wɩa.’ Ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna Devit dɩa chaasa chɩŋ.

english_verse: because you are my God, and you have promised that my descendants will be kings. That's why I have the courage to pray to you like this, even though I am only your servant.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, ŋ leŋe mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna jɩŋ arɩ mɩ doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ didii kuoruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna wuo nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ aŋ sʋsʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: You are the Lord God, and you have made this good promise to me.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ Wɩa. Ŋ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna.

english_verse: Now please bless my descendants forever, and let them always be your chosen kings. You have already blessed my family, and I know you will bless us forever.
translation_verse: Ŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ pɛ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna doho nɩaa lɛ, a leŋ ba ŋaa nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa ba didii kuoruŋ. La TƖƖNA, ŋ pɛ mɩ dɩa nɩaa lɛ nɛ, mɩ laa dii arɩ ŋ ha jaŋ pɛ mɩ doho nɩaa lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: While King Hadadezer of Zobah was trying to gain control of the territory near the Euphrates River, David met him in battle at Hamath and defeated him.
translation_verse: Devit bɩra yuo dii Zɔba tinteeŋ kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hadadɛza, lee-la sɩ kpagɛ Hamaf. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Hadadɛza mʋa dɩ ʋ yuo nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Yufireti fuo-la leriŋ, aŋ laa lee-la bibeŋ.

english_verse: Hadadezer's officers had carried gold shields, but David took these shields and brought them back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Devit fa paa laalɩyuori kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa nɛ, hɔɔtaalɩ-la Hadadɛza laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ, a kaa mʋ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: When troops from the Syrian kingdom of Damascus came to help Hadadezer, David killed
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Siiria tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ sɩ sii kɔ dɩ ba pɛ Zɔba tinteeŋ kuoro Hadadɛza lɛ, Devit kpʋ ba nɩaa bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩa.

english_verse: Then David stationed some of his troops in Damascus, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler and pay taxes to him. Everywhere David went, the Lord helped him win battles.
translation_verse: Devit fa leŋe ʋ laalɩyuoroo dɔnsʋŋ gɔllɔ ŋmoo bugoo Damasɩkʋs tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ, a hɔŋ Siiria tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ lee-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Siiria tɩmma-la sɛɩ Devit bibemba, ba tiŋ lampoo pʋpʋ. Lee na-kala Devit sɩ mʋa, La TƖƖNA yie pɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ʋ yuo dii.

english_verse: King Tou of Hamath and King Hadadezer had been enemies. So when Tou heard that David had defeated Hadadezer's whole army, he sent his son Hadoram to congratulate David on his victory. Hadoram also brought him gifts made of gold, silver, and bronze.
translation_verse: ʋ tɩŋ ʋ nanʋala Joram dɩ ʋ mʋ lɔllɛ kuoro Devit, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ yuo dii Hadadɛza wɩaa. Tou arɩ Hadadɛza ma fa laa sɩpaaŋ yuo laalɩŋ nɛ. Joram kɛŋ hɔpʋla, sɛlɩmɛ arɩ kɔlɩɩŋ kɩaa a kaa mʋ pʋ.

english_verse: David gave these gifts to the Lord, just as he had done with the silver and gold he had captured from Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek.
translation_verse: Devit sɩ laa kɩalɩŋ, ʋ joŋo hɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a nagɛ ʋ sɩ joŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la ʋ sɩ yuo laa tinteyee deemba kala teeŋ hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ: Ɛdɔm, Mʋab, Amɔŋ, Fɩlɩsɩtɩa arɩ Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Then he stationed troops in Edom, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler. Everywhere David went, the Lord gave him victory in war. A List of David's Officials (
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra leŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo gɔllɔ ŋmoo bugoo Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ lɛ a hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa sɛɩ Devit bibemba. Lee na-kala Devit sɩ mʋa, La TƖƖNA yie pɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ʋ yuo dii. Devit tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah was the commander in chief of the army. Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud kept the government records.
translation_verse: Zeruya nanʋala Jʋab nɛ fa ŋaa laalɩyuoro-la nɩhɩaŋ, ka Ahilud nanʋala Jehosafat ma ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba wɩaa bibil,

english_verse: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests. Shavsha was the secretary.
translation_verse: Ahitub nanʋala Zadɔk arɩ Abɩata nanʋala Ahɩmɛlɛk nɛ fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa. Sɛraaya ma nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba tenniŋ.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was the commander of David's bodyguard. David's sons were his highest-ranking officials.
translation_verse: Jehoyada nanʋala Bɛnaaya ma nɛ fa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Devit nɩhɩaŋ, ka Devit hambolibiisiŋ ma ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ.

english_verse: David said, “Nahash was kind to me, so I will be kind to his son.” He sent some officials to Ammon to tell Hanun how sorry he was that his father had died. But when David's officials arrived at Ammon,
translation_verse: Devit bɩɩnɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a bʋl, “Nahas fa dagɛ ʋ chonuŋ kɩŋkɛŋ mɩ lɛ, mɩ ma jaŋ dagɛ mɩ chonuŋ ʋ nanʋala lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit sii a tɩŋ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ lɔllɛ Hanuŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ nyɩmma sʋʋŋ lɛ. Devit nɩalɩŋ sɩ mʋ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ,

english_verse: Joab saw that the enemy troops were lined up on both sides of him. So he picked some of the best Israelite soldiers to fight the Syrians.
translation_verse: Jʋab sɩ na dɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ laalɩyuoroo chɩŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ arɩ ʋ harɩŋ kala dɩ ba yuoba, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ tʋɔsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ woruŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la tʋɔŋ dɩ ba yuo Siiria tɩmma-la,

english_verse: Some time later, King Nahash of Ammon died, and his son Hanun became king.
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ, Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Nahas sʋʋ, aŋ ka ʋ nanʋala Hanuŋ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When the kings who had been under Hadadezer's rule saw that Israel had defeated them, they made peace with David and accepted him as their new ruler. The Syrians never helped the Ammonites again.
translation_verse: Kuoro-la kala fa sɩɩ to Hadadɛza sɩ na dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa yuo diiba nɛ, ba leŋ ba dɩ Devit bʋla hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ba sɛɩ Devit bibemba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Siiria tɩmma-la bɩra bɩ chɛ dɩ ba pɛ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: the Ammonite leaders said to Hanun, “Do you really believe King David is honoring your father by sending these men to comfort you? He probably sent them to spy on our country, so he can come and destroy it.”
translation_verse: Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ pɩɛsɛ ba kuoro Hanuŋ, “Ŋ laa dii arɩ ŋ nyɩmma zile wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ Devit sɛnɛ tɩŋ nɩaa deemba dɩ ba kʋ lɔllʋŋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ sʋba wɩaa? Ka Devit bɩ ba tɩma dɩ ba kʋ lʋara beŋ la tinteeŋ a na ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ to a yuo diiu nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Hanun arrested David's officials and had their beards shaved off and their robes cut off just below the waist, and then he sent them away.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hanuŋ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ Devit sɩ tɩma, a fʋŋ ba kʋŋkala tɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ keri ba gɛnnɩŋ ta, a chɩna magɛ ba bʋbʋɔ-kelee lɛ a kaa tuu, aŋ kiriba ta ba viiri.

english_verse: They were terribly ashamed. When David found out what had happened to his officials, he sent a message that told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards grow back. Then you can come home.”
translation_verse: Hɩɩsɩŋ chaasa kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ arɩ ba sɩ jaŋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ mʋ dɩa. Devit sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ʋ tɩŋ nɩaa ba mʋ chemba a bʋla pɩba, “Kuoro sɩ, má hɔŋ Jeriko lɛ dɩ ma tɔŋŋɔɔ waa, ka dɩ ma-na kɔ dɩa.”

english_verse: David heard what was happening, and he sent out Joab with his army.
translation_verse: Devit sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ leŋ Jʋab kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala mʋ dɩ ba yuoba.

english_verse: The Ammonite troops marched to the entrance of the city and prepared for battle, while the Syrian troops took their positions in the open fields.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kʋ lɩɩ a chɩŋ ba tabalɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ lɛ, ka Siiria kuorusu-la ma kiele lɩɩ a hɛ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Then he put his brother Abishai in command of the rest of the army and told them to fight against the Ammonites.
translation_verse: aŋ joŋ laalɩyuori-kaanaa a hɛ ʋ naambie Abɩsaɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba ma yuo Amɔŋ tɩmma-la.

english_verse: Joab told his brother, “If the Syrians are too much for me to handle, come and help me. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, I'll come and help you.
translation_verse: Jʋab bʋla pɩ Abɩsaɩ, “Dɩ Siiria tɩmma-la nɛ kʋ dolie kɩɩmɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ŋ kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ, dɩ Amɔŋ tɩmma-la ma nɛ dolie a kɩɩŋ, mɩ ma jaŋ kʋ pɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Be brave and fight hard to protect our people and the towns of our Lord God. I pray he will do whatever pleases him.”
translation_verse: Nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ nyuduoŋ dɩ la yuo laa la nɩaa arɩ la Wɩa tasɩŋ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ wɩɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ pʋ chɩŋ.”

english_verse: Joab and his soldiers attacked the Syrians, and the Syrians ran from them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋab arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo mʋ yuo Siiria tɩmma-la, ba fá.

english_verse: When the Ammonite troops saw that the Syrians had run away, they ran from Abishai's soldiers and went back into their own city. Joab then returned to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo sɩ na dɩ Siiria tɩmma-la fá, ba ma fá jʋʋ ba taŋ, aŋ leŋ Abɩsaɩ arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋab leŋ Amɔŋ tɩmma-la yuonuŋ aŋ mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: As soon as the Syrians realized they had been defeated, they sent for their troops that were stationed on the other side of the Euphrates River. Shophach, the commander of Hadadezer's army, led these troops to Ammon.
translation_verse: Siiria tɩmma-la sɩ na dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa yuo diiba, ba bɩra yɩrɛ ba laalɩyuoroo kala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ. Kuoro Hadadɛza tɩma yɩrɛ Siiria tɩmma-la kala sɩ hɛ Yufireti fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ba kɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sobak sɩ ŋaa Hadadɛza laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ laa ba sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba mʋ.

english_verse: David found out what the Syrians were doing, and he brought Israel's entire army together. They crossed the Jordan River, and he commanded them to take their positions facing the Syrian troops. Soon after the fighting began,
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩ Devit, ʋ sii yɩrɛ Iziral laalɩyuoroo kala hɛ dɔŋɔ ba chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, a leŋ ba kala chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa a chaasɛ Siiria laalɩyuoro-la. Ba sɩ suomi laal-la,

english_verse: The next spring, the time when kings go to war, Joab marched out in command of the Israelite army and destroyed towns all over the country of Ammon. He attacked the capital city of Rabbah and left it in ruins. But David stayed in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Tafaaŋ, bʋa-la lɛ kuoroo sɩ yie mʋmʋ laalɩŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit ta Jʋab arɩ ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ Iziral laalɩyuoroo kala ba mʋ laalɩŋ. Ba mʋ yuo dii Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa aŋ tɔ ba tabalɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Raba ma hɛ. Ka Devit-na fa hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Jʋab yuo Raba a chei ʋ kala ʋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: He forced the people of Rabbah to work with saws, iron picks, and axes. He also did the same thing with the people in all the other Ammonite towns. David then led Israel's army back to Jerusalem. The Descendants of the Rephaim (
translation_verse: aŋ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ kʋ lɩɩ a fʋgɛba hɛ ba tɩtɩŋ. Ba kɛŋ sɔɔba, pɩŋgaasɩba arɩ piri-saasɩŋ a kaa tɩtɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Devit ŋaa Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa tasɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ ma kala lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm. Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa yuo laalɩŋ

english_verse: Some time later, Israel fought a battle against the Philistines at Gezer. During this battle, Sibbecai from Hushah killed Sippai, a descendant of the Rephaim, and the Philistines were defeated.
translation_verse: Bʋa dɔŋɔ ma lɛ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa mʋ yuo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɛza. Laalɩŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ Sɩbɛkaɩ sɩ ŋaa Husa tɩɩna kpʋ Rafa doho nɩaa dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩpaɩ, aŋ ka ba yuo dii Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la.

english_verse: In another battle against the Philistines, Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath from Gath, whose spear shaft was like a weaver's beam.
translation_verse: Laalɩŋ dɔŋɔ bɩra sii Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Jaa nanʋala Elihanaŋ kpʋ Golɩaf sɩ lɩɩ Gaf naambie Lamɩ. Lamɩ timiŋ daaŋ fa chaasa barɩmɛ nɛ a nagɛ gɛrɩpɛ-yuori daaŋ.

english_verse: Another one of the Philistine soldiers who was a descendant of the Rephaim was as big as a giant and had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. During a battle at Gath,
translation_verse: Laalɩŋ dɔŋɔ bɩra sii Gaf lɛ. Baal kʋbala fa hɛ nɩmɛ a waayi woruŋ a kɛŋ neniee fii arɩ balɩa, naaniee ma fii arɩ balɩa. Ba kala ŋaa mara arɩ banɛsɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa Rafa doho nʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: he made fun of Israel, so David's nephew Jonathan killed him.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ joŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ʋ hɛ sɩɩŋ lɛ, Devit naambie Sɩmɩa nanʋala Jonataŋ nɛ kpʋʋ.

english_verse: David and his soldiers killed these three men from Gath who were descendants of the Rephaim.
translation_verse: Baalaa deemba fa ŋaa Rafa doho nɩaa nɛ a hɔŋ Gaf lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jʋʋ Devit arɩ ʋ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ ba kpʋba.

english_verse: But David replied, “No! I want to pay you what they're worth. I can't just take something from you and then offer the Lord a sacrifice that cost me nothing.”
translation_verse: Kuoro Devit ma bɩra bʋl, “Aɩ, mɩ cho dɩ mɩ timiŋ ʋ yalɩŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ kʋŋkala kpʋ a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩ mɩ bɩ chɩmɩŋ ŋmobo kʋ-la lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Gad, one of David's prophets,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Gad sɩ ŋaa Devit sɩɩ-naara,

english_verse: Joab answered, “Your Majesty, even if the Lord made your kingdom a hundred times larger, you would still rule everyone in it. Why do you need to know how many soldiers there are? Don't you think that would make the whole nation angry?”
translation_verse: Jʋab bʋla pɩ kuoro, “A leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA ŋaa dɩ ŋ laalɩyuoro-la pʋŋa pɛ naansɩɩŋ zɔlɔ, kuoro mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, ba kala ŋaa ŋ nɩaa nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wʋdoho deeŋ a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa?”

english_verse: But David would not change his mind. And so Joab went everywhere in Israel and Judah and counted the people. He returned to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ama kuoro sɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la nɛ chɩna a kɩɩ wɩɩ-la Jʋab sɩ bʋla. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋab sii a gɔllɛ Iziral tinteeŋ kala aŋ mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Joab refused to include anyone from the tribes of Levi and Benjamin, because he still disagreed with David's orders. God Punishes Israel (
translation_verse: Ama Jʋab fa bɩ Levi doho arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa laalɩyuoro dɩɩsa pɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa bɩ kuoro nii-la sɛyɛ.

english_verse: “Tell David that I will punish him in one of three ways. But he will have to choose which one it will be.”
translation_verse: “Mʋ a bʋla pɩ Devit, ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩaa batori nɛ mɩ joŋo bibil ŋ sɩpaaŋ. Lɩɩsɛ ba tʋɔŋ kʋ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ cho dɩ mɩ joŋo ŋaa ŋ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: and David prayed, “It's my fault! I sinned by ordering the people to be counted. They have done nothing wrong—they are innocent sheep. Lord God, please punish me and my family. Don't let the disease wipe out your people.” David Buys Araunah's Threshing Place (
translation_verse: Devit bʋla pɩ Wɩa, “Mɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la a chei wɩaa. Mɩ nɛ leŋe ba dɩɩsɛ laalɩyuoro-la. Nɩaa deemba nagɛ piesee nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ ba ŋaa? Mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩɩra dɔgɩsɛ mɩ dɩ mɩ dɩa nɩaa nɛ, aŋ leŋ nɩaa deemba.”

english_verse: David's order to count the people made God angry, and he punished Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la kuoro sɩ bʋla ma fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ Wɩa teeŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ dɔgɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: David prayed, “I am your servant. But what I did was stupid and terribly wrong. Please forgive me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ Wɩa, “Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa, ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ bal nɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, joŋo chɛmɛ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ cheerii-la mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna lɛ. Nɩyaarɩ wɩɩ nɛ mɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: Gad went to David and told him: You must choose how the Lord will punish you:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Gad mʋ Devit teeŋ a bʋl, “Wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ daga nɛ ŋ-la, lɩɩsɛ ba tʋɔŋ kʋ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ:

english_verse: Will there be three years when the land won't grow enough food for its people? Or will your enemies constantly defeat you for three months? Or will the Lord send a horrible disease to strike your land for three days? Think about it and decide, because I have to give your answer to God who sent me.
translation_verse: Ŋŋ chɛ dɩ losuŋ jʋʋ ŋ tinteeŋ jɩsɩŋ batori nɛ koo ŋŋ chɛ dɩ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kiriŋ baarɛ chɛnsɩŋ batori nɛ koo ŋŋ chɛ dɩ La TƖƖNA leŋ dɩ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ kʋ kpʋ ŋ tinteeŋ nɩaa tapʋlaa batori nɛ, ka dɩ ʋ tɩndaara chei Iziral tinteeŋ? Bɩɩnɛ a joŋ ba tʋɔŋ kʋ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ, dɩ mɩ mʋ bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ.”

english_verse: David was miserable and said, “It's a terrible choice to make! But the Lord is kind, and I'd rather be punished by him than by anyone else.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ Gad, “Mɩ tʋɔŋ chaasa chei nɛ. Leŋ dɩ mɩ jʋʋ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋʋ fá nɩaa nenige nɛ woruŋ, ama sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la jʋʋ nuhuobiine nɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: So the Lord sent a horrible disease on Israel, and
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, nɩaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii sʋʋ.

english_verse: Then he sent an angel to destroy the city of Jerusalem. But just as the angel was about to do that, the Lord felt sorry for all the suffering he had caused the people, and he told the angel, “Stop! They have suffered enough.” This happened at the threshing place that belonged to Araunah the Jebusite.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩŋ ʋ tɩndaara dɩ ʋ mʋ chei Jerusalɛm. Ama ʋ tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ chei leriŋ, La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ chei, ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ, “Ʋ maga nɛ, lemba magɛ ŋɩɩ.” Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ La TƖƖNA tɩndaarʋ-la fa hɛ Jebus tɩɩna kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Araʋna taha lɛ.

english_verse: David saw the Lord's angel in the air, holding a sword over Jerusalem. He and the leaders of Israel, who were all wearing sackcloth, bowed with their faces to the ground,
translation_verse: Devit beŋ a na La TƖƖNA tɩndaara dɩ ʋ chɩŋ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ pɛgɛ a kori tokobiiŋ a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ chei Jerusalɛm. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩ laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ tuu tele chu.

english_verse: The Lord's angel told the prophet Gad to tell David that he must go to Araunah's threshing place and build an altar in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la hɛ Gad dɩ ʋ mʋ bʋla pɩ Devit arɩ ʋ sii mʋ Araʋna, Jebus tɩɩna-la taha a saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Araunah and his four sons were threshing wheat at the time, and when they saw the angel, the four sons ran to hide.
translation_verse: Araʋna arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ banɛsɛ faa ŋmoo mɛmpɛ nɛ taha-la lɛ aŋ na Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la, ʋ hambolibiisi-la sii fá mʋ faa.

english_verse: Just then, David arrived, and when Araunah saw him, he stopped his work and bowed down.
translation_verse: Araʋna sɩ na kuoro Devit dɩ ʋʋ kɔ, ʋ lɩɩ taha-la lɛ a mʋ chemu, a tuu kpirimi kuoro Devit sɩpaaŋ a kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa chu tinteeŋ.

english_verse: David said, “Would you sell me your threshing place, so I can build an altar on it to the Lord? Then this disease will stop killing the people. I'm willing to pay whatever you say it's worth.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋl, “Yallɛ ŋ taha-la pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ saa koruŋ nɩmɛ a pɩ La TƖƖNA, dɩ nyanyal-bɔŋ-la sɩ jʋʋ nɩalɩŋ ba sʋsʋʋ dɛrɛ. Mɩ jaŋ tiŋ ʋ yallɩŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Araunah answered, “Take it, Your Majesty, and do whatever you want with it. I'll even give you the oxen for the sacrifice and the wheat for the grain sacrifice. And you can use the threshing-boards for the fire. It's all yours!”
translation_verse: Araʋna bʋla pɩ Devit, “Kuoro, mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ taha-la a ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ. Na nɛ-ferisiŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo kaa sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Na mɛmpɛ ma ŋ sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, na mɩɩ-ŋmoori daasɩŋ ŋ jaŋ wuo kaa hɛ nyiniŋ. Kɩaa deemba kala nɛ mɩ-na Araʋna joŋo pɩ ŋ-na kuoro.”

english_verse: David built an altar and offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. David prayed, and the Lord answered him by sending fire down on the altar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ nɩmɛ a pɩ La TƖƖNA, a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. La TƖƖNA laa ʋ sʋla, a leŋ nyiniŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a kʋ tuu dii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: Then the Lord commanded the angel to put the sword away.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ ʋ tɩndaarʋ-la. Ʋ joŋ ʋ tokobiiŋ hɛ ʋ pɛɛŋ lɛ aŋ leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: When David saw that the Lord had answered his prayer, he offered more sacrifices there at the threshing place,
translation_verse: Devit sɩ na dɩ La TƖƖNA laa ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ Araʋna Jebus tɩɩna-la taha lɛ, ʋ bɩra kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: because he was afraid of the angel's sword and did not want to go all the way to Gibeon. That's where the sacred tent that Moses had made in the desert was kept, as well as the altar where sacrifices were offered to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ama Devit fa bɩ wuo mʋ koru-la sɩ hɛ Gibioŋ lɛ a pɩɛsa na wɩaa Wɩa teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ faa fá La TƖƖNA tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ kori tokobii-la nɛ.

english_verse: David said, “The temple of the Lord God must be built right here at this threshing place. And the altar for offering sacrifices will also be here.” David Prepares To Build the Temple
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋl, “Daha nɛ maga dɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ hɛ.” Ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba saa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ

english_verse: David ordered the foreigners living in Israel to come to Jerusalem. Then he assigned some to cut blocks of stone for building the temple.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit leŋ ba yɩrɛ nʋhʋɔra-la kala sɩ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ a hɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ lɩɩsɛ nɩaa ba tʋɔŋ dɩ ba yɛrɛ tabɩaa dɩ ba nagɛ tiebiee dɩ ba kaa saa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: He also brought an endless supply of cedar logs from the cities of Sidon and Tyre.
translation_verse: Devit fa chɛ kuolu daasɩŋ ma yʋgɛ nɛ ba sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛ a bil. Sɩdɔŋ nɩaa arɩ Taaya nɩaa nɛ fa kɛŋ daasɩ-la kʋ pʋ.

english_verse: He said, “The temple for the Lord must be great, so that everyone in the world will know about it. But since my son Solomon is young and has no experience, I will make sure that everything is ready for the temple to be built.” That's why David did all these things before he died. David Instructs Solomon To Build the Temple
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋl, “Mɩ nanʋala Solomoŋ ha ŋaa hambie nɛ ʋ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ woruŋ, ama La TƖƖNA dɩa-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ saa maga dɩ ʋ yʋgɛ nɛ a zɔŋ woruŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala jɩŋ ʋ zɔmʋŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ chɛ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kaa saa dɩa-la a bil.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ chɛ kɩalɩŋ yʋgɛ woruŋ a bil aŋ-na sʋʋ.

english_verse: David sent for his son Solomon and told him to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit yɩrɛ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ a bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ saa dɩa pɩ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa.

english_verse: He said: My son, I wanted to build a temple where the Lord my God would be worshiped.
translation_verse: Devit bɩra bʋla pɩ Solomoŋ, “Mɩ nanʋala, mɩ fa kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ saa dɩa dɩ ba dɩdɛnnɛ mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa nɩmɛ.

english_verse: But some time ago, he told me, “David, you have killed too many people and have fought too many battles. That's why you are not the one to build my temple.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-la nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ: ‘Ŋ kpʋ nɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ, a yuo laalɩŋ ma woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ŋ dee bɩ jaŋ saa dɩa dɩ ba dɩdɛnnɛmɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: But when your son becomes king, I will give him peace throughout his kingdom. His name will be Solomon, because during his rule I will keep Israel safe and peaceful.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ jaŋ lʋl hambolibie dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ ʋ kuoruŋ bʋa kala lɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa Solomoŋ , bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hɔŋ sɔm arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ.

english_verse: Solomon will build my temple. He will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him. In fact, one of his descendants will always rule in Israel.”
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ jaŋ saa dɩa dɩ ba dɩdɛnnɛmɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nanʋala, dɩ mɩ ma ŋaa ʋ nyɩmma. Ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.’

english_verse: Solomon, my son, I now pray that the Lord your God will be with you and keep his promise to help you build a temple for him.
translation_verse: Mɩ nanʋala, La TƖƖNA jaŋ hɛ ŋ teeŋ, dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩŋ, dɩ ŋ saa ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩa arɩ ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: May he give you wisdom and knowledge, so that you can rule Israel according to his Law.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa pɩŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ dɩgɩlɩŋ-jegilee dɩ ŋ nɛ kʋ dii kuoruŋ, dɩ ŋ wuo to ʋ wombiiŋ a beŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: If you obey the laws and teachings that the Lord gave Moses, you will be successful. Be strong and brave and don't get discouraged or be afraid of anything.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ fɩɛlɛ ŋ sɩaa a to ʋ niiriŋ arɩ ʋ wombie-la ʋ sɩ to Mosis lɛ a dagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, wɩaa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩŋ. Nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ koo dɩ ŋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: I have also assigned men who will cut and lay the stone. And there are carpenters and people who are experts in working with
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛŋ tɩntɩnnaa ma yʋgɛ nɛ: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɛrɛ tabɩaa, dɩɩ-saaraa, kapɩntaba, a pɛ gɔgɔɔ yʋgɛ ma sɩ jɩŋ

english_verse: gold, silver, bronze, and iron. You have plenty of workers to do the job. Now get started, and I pray that the Lord will be with you in your work.
translation_verse: sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, kɔlɩɩŋ arɩ hɔɔŋ kaa tɩmɩŋ. Lɛɛlɛ suomi tɩntɩmɩɩ-la, La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: David then gave orders for the leaders of Israel to help Solomon.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa kala dɩ ba pɛ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ lɛ.

english_verse: David said: The Lord our God has helped me defeat all the people who lived here before us, and he has given you peace from all your enemies. Now this land belongs to the Lord and his people.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ, ʋ pɩma wiese nɛ ma sɛmɛ kala. Ʋ joŋ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ tɩɩ tintee-la a hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, tintee-la lɛɛlɛ ŋaa La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ nɩaa kʋa nɛ.

english_verse: Obey the Lord your God with your heart and soul. Begin work on the temple to honor him, so that the sacred chest and the things used for worship can be kept there.
translation_verse: Má saa to ma TƖƖNA Wɩa arɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩwɩɩ-kala. Má suomi La TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ saanɩŋ, dɩ ma wuo joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la arɩ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ La TƖƖNA tɩntɩŋŋaa kaa kʋ jʋʋ bil ʋ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ ba sɩ jaŋ dɩdɛnnʋ.”

english_verse: David was old when he chose his son Solomon to be king of Israel.
translation_verse: Devit sɩ faasa kʋ hɩɛsɛ, ʋ leŋ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ nɛ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Some time later, David called together all of Israel's leaders, priests, and Levites.
translation_verse: Ʋ yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ, a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: Every morning and evening, the Levites are to give thanks to the Lord and sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kala chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ dɩdaanɩŋ, ba nɛ maga dɩ ba lɔllɛ La TƖƖNA a dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: David then divided the Levites into three groups according to the clans of Levi's sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit kɛŋ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ kpaa leree batori ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa nyusuŋ: Gɛsɔŋ, Kohaf arɩ Mɛrarɩ. Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa

english_verse: Gershon had two sons: Ladan and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gɛsɔŋ fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ: Ladaŋ arɩ Sɩmɛɩ.

english_verse: Ladan was the father of Jehiel, Zetham, and Joel.
translation_verse: Ladaŋ ma fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Jɛhɩɛl, Zɛtam arɩ Jowɛl.

english_verse: They were all family leaders among their father's descendants. Shimei was the father of Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran.
translation_verse: Sɩmɛɩ ma fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Sɛlɔmɔf, Hazɩɛl arɩ Haraŋ. Ba nɛ fa ŋaa Ladaŋ doho nɩaa nɩhɩasɩŋ.

english_verse: Later, Shimei had four more sons, in the following order: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah. But Jeush and Beriah didn't have many children, so their descendants were counted as one family.
translation_verse: Jahaf nɛ fa ŋaa ʋ bii-hɩaŋ, Ziza ma nɛ faa tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ, a pɛ Jeyus arɩ Bɛrɩa lɛ. Jeyus arɩ Bɛrɩa hambolibiisiŋ fa bɩ lʋla yʋgɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba dɩɩsɛ ba kala ba ŋaa dɩɩ-bala nɩaa nɛ. Ba joŋ tɩntɩŋ-bala pɩba. Kohaf doho nɩaa

english_verse: Kohath had four sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohaf ma hambolibiisiŋ fa ŋaa banɛsɛ nɛ: Amɩram, Ɩzɩha, Hɛbʋrɔŋ arɩ Ʋzɩɛl.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were chosen to be in charge of all the sacred things. They served the Lord by offering sacrifices to him and by blessing the people in his name.
translation_verse: Amɩram ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Arɔŋ arɩ Mosis. Ba fa lɩɩsɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa nɛ a jomba hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu dɩ ba bibeŋ Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ, a kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ La TƖƖNA aŋ sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩ nɩaa a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Gershom's oldest son was Shebuel.
translation_verse: Gesom bii-hɩaŋ nɛ fa Sʋbɛɛl.

english_verse: Rehabiah, who was Eliezer's only son, had many children.
translation_verse: Elieza fa kɛŋ hambolibii-bala nɛ baa yɩrɛ Rehabia, ama Rehabia-na fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Hebron, the third son of Kohath, was the father of Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Hɛbʋrɔŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jɛrɩa ʋ bii-hɩaŋ, Amarɩa ʋ bii-lɩa, Jahazɩɛl ʋ bii-tori arɩ Jekamɩam ʋ bii-nɛsɛ.

english_verse: Merari had two sons: Mahli and Mushi. Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish.
translation_verse: Mɛrarɩ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Mali arɩ Musi. Mali hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Elieza arɩ Kɩs.

english_verse: Eleazar had no sons, only daughters, and they married their uncle's sons.
translation_verse: Elieza ka sʋʋ dɩ ʋ bɩ hambolibie kɛnɛ, toloo dʋndʋŋa nɛ ʋ lʋl. Tolie-la jaa ba nyɩŋ-bie Kɩs hambolibiisiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Mushi the second son of Merari, was the father of Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.
translation_verse: Musi hambolibiisiŋ ŋaa batori nɛ: Mali, Ɛda arɩ Jɛrɩmɔf.

english_verse: David said: The Lord God of Israel has given his people peace, and he will live in Jerusalem forever.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋl, “La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa pɩ ʋ nɩaa wiese nɛ, ʋ tɩtɩa jaŋ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: And so, the Levites won't need to move the sacred tent and the things used for worship from place to place.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Levi doho nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ chʋchʋŋ Wɩa lɛbɩ-la, koo kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa.”

english_verse: will serve the Lord by helping Aaron's descendants do their work at the temple, by keeping the courtyards and rooms of the temple clean, and by making sure that everything used in worship stays pure.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa tɩntɩmɩŋ nɛ dɩ ba pɛ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa lɛ a tɩtɩŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba beŋ Wɩa dɩa-la kaalɩsɩŋ arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ dɩɩsɩŋ, aŋ leŋ dɩ Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa ma sɩ disiniŋ kɛŋ.

english_verse: They will also be in charge of the sacred loaves of bread, the flour for the grain sacrifices, the thin wafers, any offerings to be baked, and the flour mixed with olive oil. These Levites will weigh and measure these offerings.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ jaŋ bibeŋ boroboro-la sɩ yie daŋ teebʋl nyuŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ munuŋ, boroboro pɛrɛ pɛrɛ biisiŋ sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ, boroboro wasɩŋ arɩ ba sɩ kɛŋ nʋʋŋ a buu munuŋ arɩ kɩaa magɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: They must also give thanks and sing praises when sacrifices are offered on each Sabbath, as well as during New Moon Festivals and other religious feasts. There must always be enough Levites on duty at the temple to do everything that needs to be done.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala dɩ ba nɛ kɛŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kaa mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ arɩ chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele arɩ gbielee dɔnsʋŋ, Levi doho nɩaa maga dɩ ba yi magɩna nɛ a hɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ bʋa na-kala a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩa-la sɩ maga dɩ ba tɩŋ.

english_verse: They were once in charge of taking care of the sacred tent; now they are responsible for the temple and for helping Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ pɛ ba naambiiriŋ lɛ, Arɔŋ doho nɩaa lɛ a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩa-la kala sɩ maga dɩ ba tɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ maga dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ ma tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants were then divided into work groups. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Ba fa kɛŋ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa kpaa bugoo nɛ. Arɔŋ fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ banɛsɛ nɛ: Nadab, Abihu, Elieza arɩ Ɩtama.

english_verse: But Nadab and Abihu died long before their father, without having any sons. That's why Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
translation_verse: Ama Nadab arɩ Abihu nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ sʋʋ ba nyɩmma lɛ, ba fa bɩ bii lʋla. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elieza arɩ Ɩtama kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa.

english_verse: David divided Aaron's descendants into groups, according to their assigned work. Zadok, one of Eleazar's descendants, and Ahimelech, one of Ithamar's descendants, helped David.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Devit kɛŋ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa kaa hɛ bugoo dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa. Zadɔk sɩ ŋaa Elieza doho nʋʋ arɩ Ahɩmɛlɛk sɩ ŋaa Ɩtama doho nʋʋ nɛ pɛ Devit lɛ.

english_verse: groups, and Ithamar's were divided into eight groups, because Eleazar's family included more family leaders.
translation_verse: Pɛtahɩa ŋaa fii arɩ nibi, Jɛhɛzɩkɛl ŋaa mara,

english_verse: However, both families included temple officials and priests, and so to make sure the work was divided fairly, David asked God what to do.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ Elieza arɩ Ɩtama doho nɩaa kala tʋɔŋ fa sɩ kɛŋ Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ Wɩa wɩaa sɩpaalaaraa, ba yie tɔnsɔ nɛ a kɛŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa kpaaba.

english_verse: As each group was assigned their duties, Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the Levite wrote down the name of the family leader in charge of that group. The witnesses were David and his officials, as well as Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the family leaders from the clans of the priests and the Levites.
translation_verse: Ba yie tɔnsɛ nɛ a tɩŋ aŋ ka pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ, Nɛtanɛl nanʋala Sɛmaaya sɩ ŋaa Levi doho nʋʋ nɛ yie ŋmʋnsɛ dɩa kʋhɩaŋ-la sɩɩ beŋ bugu-la yɩrɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie ŋaa pɛ-naaraa nɛ: Kuoro Devit arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, a pɛ Zadɔk sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara lɛ arɩ Abɩata nanʋala Ahɩmɛlɛk arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa dɩa dɩa kʋhɩasɩŋ.

english_verse: These men were assigned their duties at the temple, just as the Lord God of Israel had commanded their ancestor Aaron. The Rest of the Levites Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Ba fa dagɛ baalaa deemba ba sɩ kaa kpaa bugoo kʋŋkala ba tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, arɩ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ dagɛ ba naabalɩma Arɔŋ ŋɩɩ. Levi doho nɩaa nɩkaanaa

english_verse: Here is a list of the other descendants of Levi: Amram was the ancestor of Shubael and Jehdeiah.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Jedeya, ʋ ŋaa Amɩram arɩ Sʋbaɩl doho nʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Rehabiah was the ancestor of Isshiah, the oldest son in his family.
translation_verse: Ɩsɩa, ʋ ma ŋaa Rehabia doho nʋʋ nɛ,

english_verse: Izhar was the father of Shelomoth and the grandfather of Jahath.
translation_verse: Jahaf, ʋ ma ŋaa Ɩza arɩ Sɛlɔmɔf doho nʋʋ nɛ,

english_verse: Hebron had four sons, in the following order: Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Jɛrɩa, Amarɩa, Jahazɩɛl arɩ Jɛkamɩam. Ba ŋaa Hɛbʋrɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ, a chɩŋ kʋhɩaŋ a kaa tuu kʋbie.

english_verse: Uzziel was the father of Micah and the grandfather of Shamir.
translation_verse: Mɩka nanʋala nɛ Samɩɩ, ʋ ŋaa Ʋzɩɛl doho nʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Isshiah, Micah's brother, was the father of Zechariah.
translation_verse: Mɩka naambie Ɩsɩa nanʋala Zɛkarɩya, ʋ ŋaa Ʋzɩɛl doho nʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli, Mushi, and Jaaziah.
translation_verse: Mɛrarɩ doho nɩaa nɛ: Mali, Musi arɩ Jaazɩa.

english_verse: Jaaziah had three sons: Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
translation_verse: Jaazɩa hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Beno, Soham, Zaku, arɩ Ibiri.

english_verse: Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish. Eleazar had no sons, but Kish was the father of Jerahmeel.
translation_verse: Mali hambolibiisiŋ nɛ Elieza arɩ Kɩs. Elieza bɩ hambolibie lʋla, ama Kɩs-na lʋl hambolibie nɛ baa yɩrɛ Jɛramɛɛl.

english_verse: Mushi had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the descendants of Levi, according to their clans.
translation_verse: Musi ma kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Mali, Ɛda arɩ Jɛrɩmɔf. Levi doho nɩaa nɛ ba kala.

english_verse: Each one was assigned his duties in the same way that their relatives the priests had been assigned their duties. David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites were the witnesses.
translation_verse: Dɩa na-kala kʋhɩaŋ arɩ ʋ ŋaana yie tɔnsɛ nɛ a kɛŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa kpaa, a nagɛ ba naambiiriŋ Arɔŋ doho Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa fa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Kuoro Devit, Zadɔk, Ahɩmɛlɛk arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa dɩa dɩa kʋhɩasɩŋ nɛ fa yie chɩŋ a ŋaa pɛ-naara.

english_verse: David and the temple officials chose the descendants of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to be in charge of music. They were to praise the Lord by playing cymbals, harps and other stringed instruments. Here is a list of the musicians and their duties:
translation_verse: Devit arɩ Levi doho nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa lɩɩsɛ Asaf, Hemaŋ arɩ Jedutuŋ doho nɩaa nɛ dɩ ba nɛ kɛŋ nɩaa yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa Wɩa dɩa lɛ ka ba dɛnnɛ hɩhɛ. Ba nɛ jaŋ dagɛ dɩ ba du chenniŋ, kɔnɛba a chɩgɩsɛ buguloo aa dɛnnɛ Wɩa. Nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ lɩɩsa nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: Asaph's four sons, Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, were under the direction of their father and played music whenever the king told them to.
translation_verse: Asaf hambolibiisi-la banɛsɛ, Zaku, Josɛf, Nɛtanɩa arɩ Asarɛla. Ba nyɩmma Asaf nɛ fa ŋaa ba sɩpaalaara. Dɩ kuoro nɛ sɩ ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa, ʋ nɛ yie dɛnnɛ hɩhɛ.

english_verse: Heman was one of the king's prophets, and God honored Heman by giving him
translation_verse: Hemaŋ nɛ fa ŋaa kuoro sɩɩ-naara. Wɩa pʋ hambolibiisiŋ fii arɩ banɛsɛ, toloo ma batori arɩ Wɩa fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ a leŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: His sons were under his direction and played cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments during times of worship at the temple. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman took their orders directly from the king.
translation_verse: Hambolibiisi-la nyɩmmaba nɛ fa ŋaa ba sɩpaalaaraa, a yie leŋ ba chɩgɩsɛ buguloo, a du chenniŋ arɩ kɔnɛba dɩ ba nɩɩ chɛ ba dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ. Asaf, Jedutuŋ arɩ Hemaŋ yie ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala kuoro sɩ daga nɛ.

english_verse: David assigned them their duties by asking the Lord what he wanted. Everyone was responsible for something, whether young or old, teacher or student.
translation_verse: Ka dɩ ba-na kɛŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa kpaaba, ba kala yie tɔnsɛ nɛ, dɩ ŋ ŋaa bii-bie koo nɩhɩaŋ, wʋjɩnnʋ koo gʋŋgʋnnʋ.

english_verse: Elam, Jehohanan, and Eliehoenai.
translation_verse: Ɛlam, Jehohanaŋ arɩ Ɛlɩɛhɔnaɩ.

english_verse: Shemaiah was the father of Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, and Semachiah. They were all respected leaders in their clan.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm bii-hɩaŋ Sɛmaaya fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩdʋ nɛ: Ofini, Rɛfɛɛl, Ɔbɛd, Ɛlɩzabad, Ɛlɩhu arɩ Sɛmaaya. Ba kala fa ŋaa nɩduoru nɛ.

english_verse: Eighteen descendants of Meshelemiah were chosen for this work.
translation_verse: Mɛsɛlɛmɩa doho nɩaa fii arɩ chori ma nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ sɩ jaŋ wuo tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la woruŋ.

english_verse: Hosah, from the Merari clan, was the father of Shimri, Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. Hosah had made Shimri the family leader, even though he was not the oldest son. Thirteen men from Hosah's family were chosen to be temple guards.
translation_verse: Ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ Hɩlɩkaaya, Tabalɩa arɩ Zɛkarɩya. Hosa hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ kala fa ŋaa fii arɩ batori nɛ.

english_verse: The guards were divided into groups, according to their family leaders, and they were assigned duties at the temple, just like the other Levites.
translation_verse: Ba fa kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boi-baalaa kaa kpaa bugoo nɛ, dɩa dɩa, a pɩba tɩntɩŋŋaa Wɩa dɩa lɛ, arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Each group, no matter how large or small, was assigned a gate to guard, and they let the Lord show them what he wanted done.
translation_verse: Dɩa na-kala nɩaa, dɩ ba yʋga koo ba muuro, ba yie tɔnsɛ nɛ a na boi-baal-la ba sɩ jaŋ pɔ.

english_verse: Shelemiah was chosen to guard the East Gate. Zechariah his son was a wise man and was chosen to guard the North Gate.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ tɔnsɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ wɩaa, ʋ tel Sɛlɛmaaya nyuŋ nɛ. Ba bɩra tɔnsɛ ʋ nanʋala Zɛkarɩya nyuŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ nɩaa chagɩlɩŋ woruŋ, a lɩɩsɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ a pɩ ʋ ma.

english_verse: Obed-Edom was then chosen to guard the South Gate, and his sons were chosen to guard the storerooms.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra tɔnsɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ ma wɩaa, ʋ tel Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm nyuŋ. Ba sɩ tɔnsɛ Wɩa dɩa chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩa ma wɩaa, ʋ tel ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Shuppim and Hosah were chosen to guard the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road. The guards were assigned the following work schedule:
translation_verse: Supim arɩ Hosa ma nɛ ba tɔnsɔ lɩɩsɛ, a leŋ ba bibeŋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ arɩ Salɛkɛf boi-baalɩŋ sɩ hɛ nyuŋ dɩɩrɩŋ wombiiŋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leree fa tɩma aŋ ka pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Each day six guards were on duty on the east side of the temple, four were on duty on the north side, and four were on duty on the south side. Two guards were stationed at each of the two storerooms,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kala Levi doho nɩaa balɩdʋ nɛ yie hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, banɛsɛ ma hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ, banɛsɛ ma hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, ka balɩa ma hɛ ba chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩa-la leriŋ.

english_verse: four were stationed along the road leading to the west courtyard, and two guards stayed in the court itself.
translation_verse: Nɩaa banɛsɛ nɛ yie chɩŋ kaala-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ wombiiŋ lɛ, ka nɩaa balɩa ma hɛ kaala-la tɩtɩa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: These were the guard duties assigned to the men from the clans of Korah and Merari. Guards Are Assigned to the Treasury
translation_verse: Kora arɩ Mɛrarɩ doho nɩaa bugo-la fa sɩɩ pɔ boi-baala-la nɛ ŋɩɩ. Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ tɩntɩnnaa dɔnsʋŋ

english_verse: The Levites who were relatives of the Korahites and the Merarites were in charge of guarding the temple treasury and the gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Ba doho nɩaa Levi doho nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ nɛ faa beŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ dʋa arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Ladan was from the Gershon clan and was the father of Jehieli. Many of his other descendants were family leaders in the clan.
translation_verse: Ladaŋ fa ŋaa Gɛsɔŋ nyɩŋ-nʋʋ nɛ, ʋ nanʋala nɛ Jɛhɩɛlɩ. Ladaŋ doho nɩaa fa yʋga nɛ a ŋaa sɩpaalaaraa ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Jehieli was the father of Zetham and Joel, and they were responsible for guarding the treasury.
translation_verse: Jɛhɩɛlɩ hambolibiisiŋ Zetam arɩ Jowɛl nɛ faa beŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ dʋa.

english_verse: Other guards at the treasury were from the Kohathite clans of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Ba fa pɩ Amɩram, Ɩza, Hɛbʋrɔŋ arɩ Ʋzɩɛl doho nɩaa ma tɩntɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom the son of Moses. He was the chief official in charge of the temple treasury.
translation_verse: Sʋbaɩl fa ŋaa Mosis nanʋala Gesom doho nʋʋ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ-la sɩɩ beŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la dʋa.

english_verse: The descendants of Gershom's brother Eliezer included Rehabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zichri, and Shelomoth.
translation_verse: Gesom naambie Elieza doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Rehabia, Jesaaya, Joram, Zikiri arɩ Sɛlɔmɩf.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the gifts that were dedicated to the Lord. These included the gifts that King David had dedicated, as well as those dedicated by the family leaders, army officers, and army commanders.
translation_verse: Sɛlɔmɩf arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ nɛ faa beŋ kɩalɩŋ kuoro Devit dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ sɩ kaa kʋ ŋaa chɔgɩta pɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ yuo laa laalɩŋ lɛ, ba joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ ba kaa tɩtɩŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were responsible for any gifts that had been given to the temple, including those from Samuel the prophet, King Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah. Other Officers Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Sɛlɔmɩf arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ nɛ faa beŋ kʋŋ na-kala ba sɩ joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a pɛ chɔgɩta kɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Samʋɛl, arɩ Kɩs nanʋala kuoro Sɔɔl, Nɛɛ nanʋala Abɩna arɩ Zeruya nanʋala Jʋab fa sɩ kaa kɔ.

english_verse: Chenaniah from the Izhar clan and his sons were government officials and judges. They did not work at the temple.
translation_verse: Ɩzɩha doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Kenania arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɩɩ tɩŋ ba tenniŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ba nɛ fa ŋmʋnsɛ ba wɩaa bibil aŋ pɛ didii Iziral tɩŋŋaa sarɩya.

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah had begun to count the people, but he stopped when the Lord began punishing Israel. So the total number was never included in David's official records. Officials in Charge of the King's Property
translation_verse: Zeruya nanʋala Jʋab sɩ suomi a dɩdɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ, ʋ bɩ dɛrɛ ka Wɩa na baanɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ aa dɔgɩsɛba, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ nɩalɩŋ dɩɩsɩŋ. A tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba fa bɩ nɩalɩŋ niiŋ ŋmʋnsa hɛ kuoro Devit wʋŋaalaa tenniŋ tʋɔŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ kuoro dʋa

english_verse: In the first month, Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel,
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-bumbuŋ nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Zabɩdɩɛl nanʋala Jasɔbɩam,

english_verse: a descendant of Perez;
translation_verse: ʋ ŋaa Pɛrɛs doho nʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: in the second month, Dodai the Ahohite, whose assistant was Mikloth;
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-lɩa sɩpaalaara nɛ Dodai, ʋ ŋaa Aho tɩɩna nɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ŋaa Mɩkɩlɔf.

english_verse: in the third month, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada the priest,
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-tori sɩpaalaara nɛ Bɛnaaya, ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Jehoyada nanʋala nɛ.

english_verse: who was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and whose son Ammizabad was also an army commander;
translation_verse: Bɛnaaya deeŋ nɛ fa ŋaa laalɩyuori babiibala-la mara arɩ fii sɩpaalaara. Ʋ nanʋala Amizabad ma fa ŋaa laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: in the fourth month, Asahel the brother of Joab, whose son Zebadiah took over command after him;
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-nɛsɛ sɩpaalaara nɛ Jʋab naambie Asahɛl. Ʋ nanʋala Zɛbadɩa nɛ laa ʋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: in the fifth month, Shamhuth from the Izrah clan;
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-nɔŋ sɩpaalaara nɛ Ɩzɩra tɩŋŋaa Samɩhʋf.

english_verse: in the sixth month, Ira the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa;
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-dʋ sɩpaalaara nɛ Tɛkʋa tɩŋŋaa Ɩkɛs nanʋala Ɩra.

english_verse: in the seventh month, Helez from Pelon in the territory of Ephraim;
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-pɛɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ Hɛlɛs a lɩɩ Pɛlɔŋ sɩ hɛ Efirem tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: in the eighth month, Sibbecai from Hushah of the Zerah clan;
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-chori sɩpaalaara nɛ Sɩbɛkaɩ a lɩɩ Husa, ʋ fa ŋaa Zɛra nyɩŋ-nʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: in the ninth month, Abiezer from Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin;
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-nibi sɩpaalaara nɛ Abieza a lɩɩ Anatɔf sɩ hɛ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: in the tenth month, Maharai from Netophah of the Zerah clan;
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-fii sɩpaalaara nɛ Maharaɩ a lɩɩ Netofa, ʋ fa ŋaa Zɛra nyɩŋ-nʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: in the eleventh month, Benaiah from Pirathon in the territory of Ephraim;
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-fii arɩ kʋbala sɩpaalaara nɛ Bɛnaaya, a lɩɩ Pɩratɔŋ sɩ hɛ Efirem tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: in the twelfth month, Heldai from Netophah, who was a descendant of Othniel. David Assigns Tribal Leaders
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-fii arɩ balɩa sɩpaalaara nɛ Hɛlɩdaɩ a lɩɩ Netofa, ʋ ŋaa Ofiniel doho nʋʋ nɛ. Doho doho sɩpaalaaraa

english_verse: years of age, because the Lord had promised long ago that Israel would have as many people as there are stars in the sky.
translation_verse: Efirem doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Azazɩa nanʋala Hosia. Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ sɩpaalaara nɛ Pedaaya nanʋala Jowɛl.

english_verse: Azmaveth the son of Adiel was in charge of the king's personal storage rooms. Jonathan the son of Uzziah was in charge of the king's other storerooms that were in the towns, the villages, and the defense towers in Israel.
translation_verse: Adɩɛl nanʋala Azɩmavɛf nɛ faa beŋ kuoro chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩŋ. Uzia nanʋala Jonataŋ ma nɛ faa beŋ kuoro chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ tabalaa, tabiisiŋ arɩ dɩɩ-duduosi-la lɛ.

english_verse: Ezri the son of Chelub was in charge of the workers who farmed the king's land.
translation_verse: Kelub nanʋala Ɛzɩrɩ nɛ faa beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ kuoro bagɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Shimei from Ramah was in charge of the vineyards, and Zabdi from Shepham was in charge of storing the wine.
translation_verse: Sɩmɛɩ sɩ lɩɩ Rama nɛ faa beŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ, ka Zabidi sɩ lɩɩ Sɩfam ma nɛ bibeŋ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ biliŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Baal Hanan from Geder was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the western foothills, and Joash was in charge of storing the olive oil.
translation_verse: Baal-Hanaŋ sɩ lɩɩ Gɛda nɛ faa beŋ olif tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ diibina tɩɩsɩŋ a chɩŋ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Jʋas ma nɛ faa beŋ olif nʋʋŋ.

english_verse: Shitrai from Sharon was responsible for the cattle that were kept in Sharon Plain, and Shaphat son of Adlai was responsible for those kept in the valleys.
translation_verse: Sɩtɩraɩ sɩ lɩɩ Sarɔŋ nɛ faa beŋ nɛsɩ-la sɩ hɛ Sarɔŋ lɛ. Atalɩa nanʋala Safat ma nɛ faa beŋ nɛsɩ-la sɩ hɛ fuonaasɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels, Jehdeiah from Meronoth was in charge of the donkeys, and Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the sheep and goats.
translation_verse: Obil, sɩ ŋaa Ɩsɩmɛl doho nʋʋ nɛ faa beŋ ba bʋntaŋŋaba. Jɛdɩya sɩ lɩɩ Mɛrɔnɔf nɛ faa beŋ kakusuŋ.

english_verse: These were the men in charge of David's royal property. David's Personal Advisors
translation_verse: Jazɩs, sɩ ŋaa Hagɩ tɩɩna nɛ faa beŋ ba piesee arɩ bʋʋnaa. Nɩaa deemba kala fa ŋaa kuoro Devit tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ ʋ dʋa nɛ.

english_verse: David's uncle Jonathan was a wise and intelligent advisor. He and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni taught David's sons.
translation_verse: Devit nyɩŋ-bie Jonataŋ fa ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlɛ nɩaa. Ʋ fa jɩŋ teniŋ nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ dɩ Hakɩmɔnɩ nanʋala Jɛhɩɛl nɛ faa dagɛ kuoro Devit hambolibiisiŋ.

english_verse: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah was the king's advisor after Ahithophel, and later, Abiathar was his advisor. Joab was commander of Israel's army.
translation_verse: Bɛnaaya nanʋala Jehoyada nɛ fa laa Ahitofɛl nyuŋ, harɩŋ Abɩata ma bɩra laa ʋ nyuŋ. Jʋab nɛ fa ŋaa kuoro laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ.

english_verse: David called a meeting in Jerusalem for all of Israel's leaders, including the tribal leaders, the government officials, the army commanders, the officials in charge of the royal property and livestock, the palace officials, and the brave warriors.
translation_verse: Kuoro Devit yɩrɛ Iziral tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kala dɩ ba kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa doho doho-la sɩpaalaaraa, kuoro laalɩyuoro-la ba sɩ kaa kpaa bugoo, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩba arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ biiriŋ pʋsʋŋ arɩ ba kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ, kuoro dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, nɩbalaa arɩ laalɩyuori-babiibalaa kʋ hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: After everyone was there, David stood up and said: Listen to me, my people. I wanted to build a place where the sacred chest would be kept, so we could go there and worship the Lord our God. I have prepared all the supplies for building a temple,
translation_verse: Kuoro Devit sii chɩŋ a bʋl, “Mɩ naambiiri, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ dɩ mɩ saa dɩa nɛ a hɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la, ʋ naasɩŋ dɩ-daŋɩŋ. Mɩ chɛ kɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ jaŋ kaa saa dɩa-la nɛ.

english_verse: but the Lord has refused to let me build it, because he said I have killed too many people in battle.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ saa dɩa-la dɩ ba dɩdɛnnʋ nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ sɩ mɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoru nɛ a kpʋ nɩaa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God chose Judah to be the leading tribe in Israel. Then from Judah, he chose my father's family, and from that family, he chose me to be the king of Israel, and he promised that my descendants will also rule as kings.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa fa lɩɩsɛ Juda doho nɛ dɩ ba ŋaa sɩpaalaaraa. Juda ma lɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛ mɩ nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa, mɩ nyɩmma biiriŋ tʋɔŋ, ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro, aŋ hɛ niiŋ arɩ mɩ dɩ mɩ doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ didii kuoruŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed me with many sons, but he chose my son Solomon to be the next king of Israel.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA pɩmɛ hambolibiisiŋ yʋgɛ nɛ, ama ba tʋɔŋ, ʋ lɩɩsɛ mɩ nanʋala Solomoŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ dii ʋ-na La Tɩɩna nɩaa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoruŋ.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Your son Solomon will build my temple, and it will honor me. Solomon will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Ŋ nanʋala Solomoŋ nɛ jaŋ saa mɩ dɩa arɩ mɩ kaalɩsɩŋ a pɩmɛ. Mɩ lɩɩsʋ nɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ nanʋala, ka dɩ mɩ ma ŋaa ʋ nyɩmma.

english_verse: If he continues to obey my laws and commands, his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ kuoruŋ chɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu dɩ ʋ nɛ haa to mɩ niiŋ wɩaa arɩ mɩ wombiee.’

english_verse: My friends, you are the Lord's people. And now, with God as your witness, I want you to promise that you will do your best to obey everything the Lord God has commanded us. Then this land will always belong to you and your descendants.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, La TƖƖNA Wɩa arɩ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ hilime sɩpaaŋ, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma hɛ niiŋ arɩ ma jaŋ hɛ doluŋ aŋ to wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛla, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma dɩ ma doho nɩaa tɩɩ tintee-zɔmʋŋ deeŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: Solomon, my son, worship God and obey him with all your heart and mind, just as I have done. He knows all your thoughts and your reasons for doing things, and so if you turn to him, he will hear your prayers. But if you ignore him, he will reject you forever.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ ma, “Mɩ bii, to ŋ nyɩmma Wɩa a tɩma pʋ arɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ ŋ wɩɩwɩɩ kala. La TƖƖNA jɩŋ la tʋɔbɩɩnaa arɩ la wʋchɛɛlɛɛ kala nɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ chɛʋ, ŋ jaŋ naʋ, ama dɩ ŋ nɛ vɩaʋ, ʋ ma jaŋ vɩaŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen you to build a temple for worshiping him. Be confident and do the work you have been assigned.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɩŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ saa ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ a tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la.”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, he gave Solomon the plans for building the main rooms of the temple, including the porch, the storerooms, the rooms upstairs and downstairs, as well as the most holy place.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit joŋ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la, ʋ teniŋ a pɩ Solomoŋ, ʋ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ dɩɩsɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ hɛ Wɩa dɩa-la lɛ, a pɛ dɩa-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ, lee-la ba sɩ pɩɩsɛ disiniŋ tɩta.

english_verse: He gave Solomon his plans for the courtyards and the open areas around the temple, and for the rooms to store the temple treasures and gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra joŋ teniŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kaalɩsɩŋ arɩ dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ gollu, a pɛ dɩɩsɩ-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ Wɩa dɩa dʋa arɩ chɔgɩta kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo pɩ La TƖƖNA a bil, a pɩ Solomoŋ.

english_verse: David also gave Solomon his plans for dividing the priests and the Levites into groups, as well as for the work that needed to be done at the temple and for taking care of the objects used for worship.
translation_verse: Devit bɩra dagʋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa kpaa bugoo dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, aŋ pɛ bibeŋ Wɩa dɩa-la tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa.

english_verse: He told Solomon how much gold and silver was to be used in making the sacred objects,
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra dagɛ Solomoŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa:

english_verse: including the lampstands and lamps,
translation_verse: Chaanaa arɩ chaaŋ daasɩŋ,

english_verse: the gold table which held the sacred loaves of bread, the tables made of silver,
translation_verse: hɔpʋla teebʋlba, arɩ sɛlɩmɛ teebʋlba-la nyuŋ ba sɩ yie joŋ boroboro-la ba sɩ joŋo pɩ Wɩa a daŋ.

english_verse: the gold incense altar, and the gold statue of a chariot for the winged creatures which were on the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra dagɛ Solomoŋ sɛlɩmɛ magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa koru-la lɛ ba sɩɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ arɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa janɩŋ toruko a pɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a jɛrɛ tɔ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: David then said to Solomon: The Lord showed me how his temple is to be built.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bɩra bʋl, “La TƖƖNA dagɛmɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ ba saa ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la nɛ mɩ ŋmʋnsa bil.”

english_verse: But you must see that everything is done according to these plans. Be confident, and never be afraid of anything or get discouraged. The Lord my God will help you do everything needed to finish the temple, so it can be used for worshiping him.
translation_verse: Devit bʋla pɩ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ, “Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ a tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ koo dɩ ŋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ. Mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa mɩ sɩ tɩmaa pa jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ vɩaŋ ta, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ dɩ ŋ tɩŋ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩŋŋaa kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: The priests and Levites have been assigned their duties, and all the skilled workers are prepared to do their work. The people and their leaders will do anything you tell them.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa kpaa bugoo kala a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ba tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩŋŋaa. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-doho kala ma kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ba pɛ ŋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ arɩ ba sɩpaalaaraa kala ma kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ba to ŋ niiŋ.”

english_verse: That's why I have done my best to get everything Solomon will need to build it—gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, onyx, turquoise, colored gems, all kinds of precious stones, and marble.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ doluŋ a chɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa saa mɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a bil nɛ: Sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, kɔlɩɩŋ, hɔɔŋ, daa-doloo, tabɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ɔnɩs, tabɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ takʋa arɩ tabɩɩ-tʋl dosunuŋ kala. Ba kala yʋga nɛ woruŋ,

english_verse: and to make the gold and silver objects. Now, who else will show their dedication to the Lord by giving gifts for building his temple?
translation_verse: a pɛ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla kɩalɩŋ kala gɔgɔɔ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa lɛ. Lɛɛlɛ, kʋbɛɛ ma nɛ cho dɩ ʋ suri ʋ tʋɔŋ a joŋ kɩaa ŋaa chɔgɩta pɩ La TƖƖNA dɩ ba kaa saa ʋ dɩa-la?”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, the family leaders, the tribal leaders, the army commanders, and the government officials voluntarily gave gifts
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa, ba doho doho tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ kuoro dʋa joŋ kɩaa pa ba tɩtɩa chonuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who owned precious stones also donated them to the temple treasury, where Jehiel from the Levite clan of Gershon guarded them.
translation_verse: nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa joŋo hɛ Jɛhɩɛl sɩ ŋaa Gɛsɔŋ doho nʋʋ nɛsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba kaa saa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la.

english_verse: David and the people were very happy that so much had been given to the Lord, and they all celebrated. David Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ joŋ kɩaa pa arɩ tʋɔ-bala, ba tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɛ nɛ a tɩŋ kɩaa magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ kaa kʋ pɩ La TƖƖNA, kuoro Devit ma tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ woruŋ. Devit dɛnnɛ Wɩa

english_verse: Then, in front of everyone, David sang praises to the Lord: I praise you forever, Lord! You are the God our ancestor Jacob worshiped.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩpaaŋ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA a bʋl, “Mɩɩ dɛnnɩŋ La TƖƖNA, la naabalɩma Jekɔb Wɩa, a leŋ dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Your power is great, and your glory is seen everywhere in heaven and on earth. You are king of the entire world,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ yʋga kɩɩ kʋŋkala, a kɛŋ doluŋ, arɩ tʋla arɩ yɩrɩŋ. Ŋ nɛ tɩɩ kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ, La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ kuoro. Ŋ nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala.

english_verse: and you rule with strength and power. You make people rich and powerful and famous.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ yie pɩ nɩaa dʋa, ŋ yie leŋ nɩaa kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ. Ŋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ kʋŋkala, ŋ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ nɩa ŋaa nɩbal a kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: We thank you, our God, and praise you.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, la Wɩa, laa lɔllʋŋ a dɩdɛnnɛ ŋ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ.

english_verse: But why should we be happy that we have given you these gifts? They belong to you, and we have only given back what is already yours.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ dɩ mɩ nɩaa nɛ kʋbɛɛba a magɛ dɩ la kɛŋ kɩaa kʋ ŋaa chɔgɩta pɩŋ la tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ. Ŋ nɛ tɩɩ kʋŋkala, kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ pɩla, ba nɛ la bɩra joŋo pɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: We are only foreigners living here on earth for a while, just as our ancestors were. And we will soon be gone, like a shadow that suddenly disappears.
translation_verse: La ŋaa nʋhʋɔra nɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, arɩ la naabalɩmaba fa sɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔra ŋɩɩ. La jaŋ lɛl dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ a nagɛ daaliimiŋ sɩ yie lɛl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Our Lord God, we have brought all these things for building a temple to honor you. They belong to you, and you gave them to us.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa, la kɛŋ dʋa deeŋ kala kɔ dɩ la saa ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ nɛ a zil ŋ yɩrɩ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ama kɩalɩŋ kala lɩɩ ŋ teeŋ nɛ, ŋ nɛ tɩɩ ba kala.

english_verse: But we are happy, because everyone has voluntarily given you these things. You know what is in everyone's heart, and you are pleased when people are honest.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩ jɩma ŋ yie magɩsɛ nʋʋkala tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nyuŋ nɛ. Tʋɔpʋla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ kaa joŋ kɩaa deemba kala pɩŋ. Ŋ nɩaa ma kala sɩ hilimi daha tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa kʋ pɩŋ.

english_verse: Always make us eager to give, and help us be faithful to you, just as our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob faithfully worshiped you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa la naabalɩma Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk, arɩ Jekɔb ba Wɩa, leŋ dɩ ŋ nɩaa kɛŋ tʋɔŋ deeŋ doho, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: And give Solomon the desire to completely obey your laws and teachings, and the desire to build the temple for which I have provided these gifts.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ nanʋala Solomoŋ kɛŋ tʋɔ-la sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ to wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ daga aŋ pɛ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ chɛ bil a saa ŋ dɩa-la.”

english_verse: David then said to the people, “Now it's your turn to praise the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped!” So everyone praised the Lord, and they bowed down to honor him and David their king. Solomon Is Crowned King
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hilime, “Má dɛnnɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa, aŋ tuu kpirimi a zil La TƖƖNA arɩ kuoro Devit. Ba sɛɩ Solomoŋ kuoruŋ

english_verse: The people were very happy, and they ate and drank there at the Lord's altar. That same day, Solomon was again crowned king. The people celebrated and poured olive oil on Solomon's head to show that he would be their next king. They also poured oil on Zadok's head to show that he was their priest.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ chaasa tɔrɛ nɛ ba dii kɩaa aŋ nyʋa kʋnyʋalaa La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Ba bɩra wasa lɩɩsɛ Solomoŋ, Devit nanʋala lɩa ʋ ŋaa kuoro a joŋ nʋʋŋ tɩsʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ Zadɔk ma a joŋ nʋʋŋ tɩsʋ ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: So Solomon became king after David his father. Solomon was successful, and everyone in Israel obeyed him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ laa ʋ nyɩmma Devit nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ a hɔŋ La TƖƖNA kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ, wɩɩkala vɛŋ woruŋ pʋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala tuto ʋ niiŋ.
