english_verse: Every official and every soldier, as well as all of David's other sons, were loyal to him.
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ, a pɛ Devit hambolibiisiŋ kala lɛ fa sɛyɛ nɛ arɩ ba jaŋ to kuoro Solomoŋ.

english_verse: The Lord made Solomon a great king, and the whole nation was amazed at how famous he was. In fact, no other king of Israel was as great as Solomon. David Dies
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ Solomoŋ ŋaa nɩbal, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala zizilu. Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoru kala fa tuo a magɛ Solomoŋ. Devit sʋba

english_verse: David the son of Jesse was king of Israel
translation_verse: Jesi nanʋala Devit nɛ fa ŋaa Iziral tinteeŋ kala kuoro.

english_verse: David was rich and respected and lived to be an old man. Then he died, and his son Solomon became king.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa nɩɩ sɩma nɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, a hɩɛsɛ woruŋ aŋ-na sʋʋ, ka ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ laa ʋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ. Devit fa kɛŋ kɩaa nɛ woruŋ, nɩaa ma zizilu.

english_verse: Everything David did while he was king is included in the history written by the prophets Samuel, Nathan, and Gad.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala Devit sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Netaŋ, Wɩa sɩɩ-naara Samʋɛl arɩ Wɩa sɩɩ-naara Gad tenniŋ tʋɔŋ a bil.

english_verse: They wrote about his powerful rule and about the things that happened not only to him, but also to Israel and the other nations.
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ beŋ ʋ nɩaa, ŋɩɩ ʋ kuoruŋ fa sɩ dolie arɩ wɩalɩŋ fa sɩ ŋaa ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala lɛ arɩ kuorusu-la dɔnsʋŋ tinteeŋ sɩ golliba.

english_verse: While Solomon was king of Israel, there was silver and gold everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as ordinary sycamore trees in the foothills.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Solomoŋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ, hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ fa pʋrɩga nɛ woruŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a nagɛ tabɩaa, kuolu daasɩŋ ma pʋrɩgɛ woruŋ a nagɛ tutogusuŋ sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: and there at the bronze altar, Solomon offered a thousand animals as sacrifices to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Lɛbɩ-la lɛ La Tɩɩna sɩ yie kɔ Iziral teeŋ lɛ nɛ, Solomoŋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ bʋɩ a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɔlɩɩŋ koru-la nyuŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: God appeared to Solomon that night in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ-la nɛ Wɩa kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ Solomoŋ arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Sʋl kʋŋ na-kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ pɩŋ.”

english_verse: Solomon answered: Lord God, you were always loyal to my father David, and now you have made me king of Israel.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ bʋl, “Ŋ chaasa dii zile kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ mɩ nyɩmma Devit lɛ aŋ leŋ mɩ ma dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I am supposed to rule these people, but there are as many of them as there are specks of dust on the ground. So keep the promise you made to my father
translation_verse: Mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa, leŋ dɩ nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ pɩ mɩ nyɩmma Devit sɛnɛ chɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ leŋe mɩ dii kuoruŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ beŋ nɩ-daŋ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛ.

english_verse: God replied: Solomon, you could have asked me to make you rich or famous or to let you live a long time. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom and knowledge to rule my people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ sɩ folo chɩchɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ, aŋ bɩ mɩɩ-duduoŋ koo dʋa nɛ pɩɛsa chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ, a bɩra bɩ sʋla chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ma nɛ sʋʋ, aŋ sʋla chɩchɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa a kaa beŋ mɩ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ leŋe ŋ ŋaa ba kuoro,

english_verse: Solomon then left Gibeon and returned to Jerusalem, the capital city of Israel. Solomon's Wealth (
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ lɩɩ Gibioŋ lɛ dundolo-la nyuŋ ba sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, a mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm a bibeŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Solomon decided to build a temple where the Lord would be worshiped, and also to build a palace for himself.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ saa dɩa-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ chʋchʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kuoru dɩa.

english_verse: This will be a great temple, because our God is greater than all other gods.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ mɩ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩ ʋ chaasa yʋgɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la Wɩa nɛ yʋga kɩɩ vene kala.

english_verse: Praise the Lord God of Israel who made heaven and earth! He has given David a son who isn't only wise and smart, but who has the knowledge to build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bʋl: “Má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ. Ʋ joŋ hambolibie sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa woruŋ a pɩ Devit dɩ ʋ nɛ saa dɩa a pɩ La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kuoru dɩa.

english_verse: I am building a temple where the Lord my God will be worshiped. Sweet-smelling incense will be burned there, and sacred bread will be offered to him. Worshipers will offer sacrifices to the Lord every morning and evening, every Sabbath, and on the first day of each month, as well as during all our religious festivals. These things will be done for all time, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩɩ chɛ mɩ saa dɩa nɛ dɩ ba dɩdɛnnɛ Mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa nɩmɛ, a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pʋpʋ, a joŋ ʋ boroboro-la ba sɩ yie joŋo pɩ Wɩa a bibil nɩmɛ, a ŋɩŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ tapʋlɩɩ-kala chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ dɩdaanɩŋ, arɩ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbielee arɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa gbiele-la dɔnsʋŋ. La TƖƖNA sɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋɩŋaa wɩaa deemba nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: No one can ever build a temple large enough for God—even the heavens are too small a place for him to live in! All I can do is build a place where we can offer sacrifices to him.
translation_verse: Ama kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo saa dɩa a pɩ Wɩa, ʋ paala yʋga kɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kala nɛ. Mɩ nɛ saa kʋbɛɛ dɩ mɩ saa dɩa a pʋ? Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa nɛ dɩ mɩ saa lee dɩ ba nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa a pʋpʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Send me a worker who can not only carve, but who can work with gold, silver, bronze, and iron, as well as make brightly colored cloth. The person you send will work here in Judah and Jerusalem with the skilled workers that my father has already hired.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, chɛ nʋʋ sɩ ŋaa gɔgɔ a jɩŋ kɩaa deemba kaa tɩmɩŋ: sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, kɔlɩɩŋ, hɔɔŋ, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ, ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, a jɩŋ kɩaa higiŋ ma, dɩ ʋ kʋ pɛ gɔgɩa-la mɩ nyɩmma Devit sɩ chɛ pɩmɛ lɛ dɩ ba tɩŋ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: I know that you have workers who are experts at cutting lumber in Lebanon. So would you please send me some cedar, pine, and juniper logs? My workers will be there to help them,
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma ŋ nɩaa jɩŋ daasɩŋ keriŋ nɛ woruŋ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa pɩmɛ kuolu daasɩŋ, bʋtʋma arɩ tɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ jʋnɩpa doloo. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa kʋ pɛ dɩ ba

english_verse: because I'll need a lot of lumber to build such a large and glorious temple.
translation_verse: keri daasɩ-la yʋgɛ woruŋ pɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-ballɩŋ dɩ ʋ yʋgɛ nɛ a chaasa zɔŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Hiram sent his answer back to Solomon: I know that the Lord must love his people, because he has chosen you to be their king.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Taaya kuoro Hiram ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ Solomoŋ a bʋl, “A tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ cho ʋ nɩaa wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ʋ leŋ ŋ ŋaa ba kuoro.”

english_verse: I am sending Huram Abi to you. He is wise and very skillful.
translation_verse: Mɩ leŋe Huram-Abi nɛ kʋkɔ ŋ teeŋ, ʋ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: His mother was from the Israelite tribe of Dan, and his father was from Tyre. Not only is Huram an expert at working with gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, and wood, but he can also make colored cloth and fine linen. And he can carve anything if you give him a pattern to follow. He can help your workers and those hired by your father King David.
translation_verse: Ʋ naaŋ ŋaa Daŋ doho nʋʋ nɛ, ka ʋ nyɩmma lɩɩ Taaya. Huram-Abi jɩŋ sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, kɔlɩɩŋ, hɔɔŋ, tabɩaa, daasɩŋ, gɛrɩpɛ-vachalɩŋ, gɛrɩpɛ-diibelimbine, gɛrɩpɛ-fɩaŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ chaasa jɩŋ kɩaa higiŋ nɛ woruŋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo higiŋ kʋŋkala ŋ sɩ dagʋ. Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa lɛ arɩ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ Devit, ŋ nyɩmma gɔgɔɔ lɛ dɩ ba tɩŋ.

english_verse: Go ahead and send the wheat, barley, olive oil, and wine you promised to pay my workers.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ mɛmpɛ-la, mɩa-la, olif nʋʋŋ arɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩŋ-la ŋ sɩ sɩ ŋ jaŋ pɩla kaa kɔ.

english_verse: I will tell them to start cutting down trees in Lebanon. They will cut as many as you need, then tie them together into rafts, and float them down along the coast to Joppa. Your workers can take them to Jerusalem from there. Solomon's Work Force
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba keri dolo-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ a vɔɔ paa hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ a duoro kaa kɔ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jopa a pɩŋ, dɩ ŋ paa mʋ Jerusalɛm.”

english_verse: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were living in Israel, just as his father David had done when he was king, and the total was
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ dɩɩsɛ nɩwogusu-la kala sɩ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba kala ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ. Ʋ nyɩmma Devit fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ dɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ, ʋ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: He used precious stones to decorate the temple, and he used gold imported from Parvaim
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa nɛ a kpɩɛrɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. Sɛlɩmɛ-la ʋ sɩ kaa tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la, ʋ fa kaa lɩɩ Paavem tinteeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Five hundred and seventy grams of gold was used to cover the heads of the nails. The walls of the small storage rooms were also covered with gold.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa hɛŋŋɛɛ yuŋuŋ fa ka mʋa ka dɩ ʋ yi kilo bala. Dɩɩsɩ-la ma sɩ hɛ nyuŋ, ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ a taarɛ ba kala.

english_verse: Solomon had the inside walls of the temple's main room paneled first with pine and then with a layer of gold, and he had them decorated with carvings of palm trees and designs that looked like chains.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ bʋtʋma daasɩŋ nɛ a kɩɛla tɔ Wɩa dɩa-la dɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ jeeŋ kala a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taarɛ, aŋ higi kɩaa sɩ nagɛ abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ chɔrʋmɔɔ a hɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Solomon had two statues of winged creatures made to put in the most holy place, and he covered them with gold.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ bɩra leŋ ba kɛŋ hɔɔŋ libi kɩaa balɩa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taara tɔ a joŋo bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ lɛ.

english_verse: A curtain was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with designs of winged creatures. The Two Columns (
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ nɛ a ŋaa patɩɩsaŋ, a kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine arɩ ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ arɩ ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ a sʋa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a hɛ.

english_verse: The top of each column was decorated with designs that looked like chains and with
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ ba ŋaa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ chɔrʋmɔɔ ʋ joŋo daŋ jebie-la nyuŋ, aŋ libi kɩaa sɩ nagɛ kampoi nɛnɛɛ zɔlɔ a hɛ chɔrʋmɔ-la lɛ.

english_verse: Solomon had one of the columns placed on the south side of the temple's entrance; it was called Jachin. The other one was placed on the north side of the entrance; it was called Boaz.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ kɔlɩɩŋ jebie-la a pɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiŋ. Dɔŋɔ chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, dɔŋɔ ma chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa. Kʋ-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ ʋ hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Jakɩŋ, a hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa kʋa ma yɩrɩŋ Bʋas.

english_verse: Solomon had a bronze altar made that was nine meters square and four and a half meters high.
translation_verse: Kuoro Solomoŋ leŋe ba kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ, ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ fii, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ fii, ka ʋ leŋiŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋnɔŋ arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Ten gold lampstands were also made according to the plans. Solomon placed these lampstands inside the temple, five on each side of the main room.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa chaaŋ daaŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ dagʋ, kɩaa fii a joŋo bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. Banɔŋ chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, banɔŋ ma chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa.

english_verse: Its outer edge was decorated with two rows of carvings of bulls, ten bulls to about every
translation_verse: Gbaŋa-la niipiniŋ lɛ, ʋ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ a ŋaa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ nɛ-belliŋ naaderee balɩa a golli. Naakieliŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ na-kala pɛgɛ, nɛ-belliŋ fii nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: He also made ten small bowls and put five on each side of the large bowl. The small bowls were used to wash the animals that were burned on the altar as sacrifices, and the priests used the water in the large bowl to wash their hands.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa taasɩ-gbaŋ-biisiŋ fii dɩ ba kaa sʋsɔŋ nɩsaa, a joŋ banɔŋ bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, aŋ joŋ banɔŋ ma bil wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa. Ba tʋɔŋ nɛ ba chɩchɛsɛ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa. Ama taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la tʋɔŋ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ sʋsɔŋ ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: He also made ten tables and placed them in the main room, five on each side. And he made
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa teebʋlba ma fii nɛ a joŋo bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. Banɔŋ chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa, banɔŋ ma chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ. Ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ a ŋaa kʋmɩsɩrɩ-gbansɩŋ ma zɔlɔ.

english_verse: Solomon gave orders to build two courtyards: a smaller one that only priests could use and a larger one. The doors to these courtyards were covered with bronze.
translation_verse: Ʋ saa kaalɩ-bie a pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, aŋ saa kaalɩ-balɩŋ ma a ŋaa ba borusuŋ, a kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ taara tɔ.

english_verse: The large bowl called the Sea was placed near the southeast corner of the temple.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la a bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ pɛgɛ gʋnʋŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Huram made shovels, sprinkling bowls, and pans for hot ashes. Here is a list of the other furnishings he made for God's temple:
translation_verse: Huram bɩra ŋaa puposuŋ, safʋlba arɩ kʋmɩsɩrɩ gbansɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Huram tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩa-la kala kuoro Solomoŋ sɩ sɩ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ a dɛrɛ. Kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: two columns, two bowl-shaped caps for the tops of these columns, two chain designs on the caps,
translation_verse: Jebie-la balɩa, kɩalɩŋ balɩa ʋ sɩ libe ba nagɛ gbaŋa a sagɛ jebie-la balɩa nyuŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa ba nagɛ chɔrʋmɔɔ ba kaa kpɩɛrɛ gbansɩ-la sɩ sagɛ jebie-la nyuŋ,

english_verse: the stands and the small bowls,
translation_verse: taasɩ-gbansɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ nyuŋ ba sɩɩ chɩŋ,

english_verse: the large bowl and the twelve bulls that held it up,
translation_verse: taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la arɩ nɛ-belli-la fii arɩ balɩa nyuŋ ʋ sɩ saga,

english_verse: pans for hot ashes, as well as shovels and meat forks. Huram made all these things out of polished bronze
translation_verse: puposuŋ, safʋlba, lɛsɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ kerikee ba kaa lɩɩsɛ nammɩa, arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ. La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la kɩalɩŋ kala Huram-Abi sɩ ŋaa pɩ kuoro Solomoŋ, kɔlɩɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ ʋ kaa ŋaa.

english_verse: by pouring melted bronze into the clay molds he had set up near the Jordan River, between Succoth and Zeredah.
translation_verse: Kuoro leŋe ba chɔ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ a bɩsa hɛ chʋrʋŋ ba sɩ kaa mɛ kɩaa lɛ a ŋaa kɩalɩŋ Sʋkɔf arɩ Zarɛtaŋ pɛgɛ, Jɔdaŋ tintee-taala-la lɛ.

english_verse: There were so many bronze furnishings that no one ever knew how much bronze it took to make them.
translation_verse: Kɩaa deemba kala Solomoŋ sɩ leŋe ba ŋaa fa yʋga nɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ wuo jɩŋ kɔlɩɩŋ yuŋuŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ ba kaa ŋaaba.

english_verse: Solomon also gave orders to make the following temple furnishings out of gold: the altar, the tables that held the sacred loaves of bread,
translation_verse: Solomoŋ bɩra leŋ ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ a ŋaa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kɩaa deemba: Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ, teebʋlba-la nyuŋ ba sɩ yie joŋ boroboro daŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ,

english_verse: the lampstands and the lamps that burned in front of the most holy place,
translation_verse: chaaŋ daasɩŋ arɩ ba chaanaa, dɩ ba hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a didii arɩ ba sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: whose wings covered both the chest and the poles used for carrying it.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa kɛŋ ba kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ jɛrɛ tɔ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la arɩ ʋ daa-duduosu-la lɛ ba sɩ kaa jujoŋ.

english_verse: Then the priests and the Levites picked up the sacred chest, the sacred tent, and the objects used for worship, and they carried them to the temple.
translation_verse: arɩ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa nɛ chʋŋ kɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: Solomon and a crowd of people stood in front of the chest and sacrificed more sheep and cattle than could be counted.
translation_verse: Ka kuoro Solomoŋ arɩ Iziral tɩmma-la kala sɩ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ laa daga-la sɩpaaŋ, a kpʋ piesee arɩ nɛsɩŋ a yʋgɛ woruŋ, nʋʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: The priests carried the chest into the most holy place and put it under the winged creatures,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kɛŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la kʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ sɩpaaŋ lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ, a joŋo bil kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The poles were so long that they could be seen from just outside the most holy place, but not from anywhere else. And they stayed there from then on.
translation_verse: Daasɩŋ deemba fa duomo nɛ woruŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ tʋɔŋ a chɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo naba, ama dɩ ŋ nɛ hɛ ʋ harɩŋ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo naba. Daasɩ-la ha hɛ nɩmɛ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: The only things kept in the chest were the two flat stones Moses had put there when the Lord made his agreement with the people of Israel at Mount Sinai, after bringing them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Kʋŋkala fa tuo Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la tʋɔŋ a pɛ tabɩɩ-taala-la balɩa Mosis sɩ joŋo hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ Sɩnaɩ peel-la lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ niiŋ ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ, ba sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ harɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord's glory was in that cloud, and the light from it was so bright that the priests could not stay inside to do their work.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩra bɩ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA tʋla fa tɔ dɩa-la kala nɛ.

english_verse: Now I've built a glorious temple where you can live forever.” Solomon Speaks to the People (
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ saa ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ a pɩŋ, lee ŋ sɩ jaŋ hɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: and prayed: Lord God of Israel, no other god in heaven or on earth is like you! You never forget the agreement you made with your people, and you are loyal to anyone who faithfully obeys your teachings.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a bʋl: “Ou, La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, kʋŋkala tuo wɩa-nyuŋ koo tinteeŋ lɛ a magɩŋ. Ŋ sɩ cho ŋ nɩaa a hɛ nii-la ŋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ, ŋ bɩ ʋ wɩaa yʋa. Ŋ yie chɩŋ ŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tʋɔŋ kala a tuto wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I am your servant, and the people of Israel belong to you, and so whenever any of us look toward this temple and pray, answer from your home in heaven and forgive our sins.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa ŋ nɩaa. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, bʋa na-kala dɩ la kʋŋ nɛ joŋ sɩaa a chaasɛ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ a sʋlʋŋ, ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ a laa la sʋla a joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛla.

english_verse: Solomon turned toward the people standing there. Then he blessed them
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa hilime chɩŋ lee-la nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Solomoŋ bɩrɩma chaasɛba, a sʋl Wɩa pɩba.

english_verse: When my father wanted to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: Mɩ nyɩmma Devit fa kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa nɩmɛ.

english_verse: But you're not the one to do it. Your son will build the temple to honor me.”
translation_verse: Ama ŋ dee nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ saa mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ pɩmɛ. Ama ŋ tɩtɩa bii-lʋlʋŋ nɛ jaŋ saa mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlɛmɛ nɩmɛ.’

english_verse: The Lord has done what he promised. I am now the king of Israel, and I've built a temple for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA kɛŋ nii-la ʋ fa sɩ hɛ kaa tɩŋ nɛ. Mɩ laa mɩ nyɩmma Devit nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ nɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, a saa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ ma dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa nɩmɛ.

english_verse: I've also put the sacred chest in the temple. And in that chest are the two flat stones on which is written the solemn agreement the Lord made with our ancestors when he rescued them from Egypt. Solomon Prays at the Temple (
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ nɛ mɩ joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la bil, daga-la tʋɔŋ nɛ tabɩɩ-taalɩ-la balɩa lɛ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ niiri-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bile ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ a hɛ.” Solomoŋ sʋl Wɩa hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ

english_verse: Suppose someone accuses a person of a crime, and the accused has to stand in front of the altar in your temple and say, “I swear I am innocent!”
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ a chei ʋ dɔŋɔ, a magɛ dɩ tɩɩna kʋ jʋʋ chɩŋ ŋ koruŋ sɩpaaŋ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ lɛ a ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ ʋ bɩ wɩɩ jɩŋ,

english_verse: Earlier, Solomon had a bronze platform made that was about two meters square and over a meter high, and he put it in the center of the outer courtyard near the altar. Solomon stood on the platform facing the altar with everyone standing behind him. Then he lifted his arms toward heaven; he knelt down
translation_verse: Ʋ fa kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa kʋ-taala nɛ, ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, ka ʋ leŋiŋ ŋaa naakieli-bala arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, ʋ joŋo bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la harɩŋ kaala-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jɩl kʋ-la nyuŋ a tuu kpirimi Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩpaaŋ, a kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa je wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: My father David was your servant, and today you have kept every promise you made to him.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛŋ nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ pɩ mɩ nyɩmma Devit sɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ a tɩŋ nɛ. Jɩnɩŋ ŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pʋ arɩ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: There's not enough room in all of heaven for you, Lord God. How could you possibly live on earth in this temple I have built?
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa, ŋ sɛnɛ jaŋ hɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ a guoli nuhuobiinee tʋɔŋ? Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ balegi balegi ma paala bɩ jalɩa magɛ ŋ jʋʋnʋŋ. Ɛɛ nɛ saa ŋ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ saa tinteeŋ lɛ?

english_verse: This is the temple where you have chosen to be worshiped. Please watch over it day and night and listen when I turn toward it and pray.
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ nɛ ŋaa lee-la ŋ sɩ sɩ ŋ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlʋŋ nɩmɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, bibeŋ ʋ nyuŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala. Dɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna nɛ joŋ mɩ sɩaa chaasʋ aŋ sʋlʋŋ, jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Listen from heaven and decide who is right. Then punish the guilty person and let the innocent one go free.
translation_verse: ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ a laa wɩɩ-la jɩŋ. Dɔgɩsɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ laa cheeriŋ, aŋ joŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye ta.

english_verse: Suppose your people Israel sin against you, and then an enemy defeats them. If they come to this temple and beg for forgiveness,
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a cheyiŋ dɩ ŋ leŋ dɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diiba, dɩ ba nɛ mɩɩra kɔ ŋ teeŋ a sʋsʋlʋŋ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ lɛ arɩ ba cheye nɛ,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven. Forgive them and bring them back to the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ ba sʋla a joŋo chɛba aŋ mɩɩra kɛmba kɔ tintee-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩ ba dɩ ba naabalɩmaba.

english_verse: Suppose your people sin against you, and you punish them by holding back the rain. If they stop sinning and turn toward this temple to pray in your name,
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩaa nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ cheyiŋ dɩ ŋ dɔgɩsɛba a pɔ dɩ duonuŋ sɩ́ nɩɩ, dɩ ba nɛ joŋ ba sɩaa chaasɛ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ a yɩrɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ a sʋlʋŋ arɩ ba cheye nɛ aŋ leŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven and forgive them. The people of Israel are your servants, so teach them to live right. And send rain on the land you promised them forever.
translation_verse: ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ a joŋo chɛba. Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa dagɛba dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ, aŋ leŋ dɩ duonuŋ bɩra nɩɩ tintee-la lɛ ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩba ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.

english_verse: Sometimes the crops may dry up or rot or be eaten by locusts or grasshoppers, and your people will be starving. Sometimes enemies may surround their towns, or your people will become sick with deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Dɩ losuŋ nɛ jʋʋ tinteeŋ a tɩŋ kʋduuloo sɩ cheye wɩaa koo hɔbɔ sɩ die koo dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ kʋ gollo chu ba tasɩ-la dɔŋɔ koo nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ jʋa, koo wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ koo nyanyalaa nɛ jʋʋ kpʋkpʋ nɩaa,

english_verse: Please listen when anyone in Israel truly feels sorry and sincerely prays with arms lifted toward your temple.
translation_verse: dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋŋ tʋɔŋ chei a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa je a chaasɛ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ a sʋlʋŋ,

english_verse: You know what is in everyone's heart. So from your home in heaven answer their prayers, according to what they do and what is in their hearts.
translation_verse: ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ a joŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛʋ aŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ. Ŋ jɩŋ nʋʋkala tʋɔbɩɩnaa arɩ ʋ mɛlɛ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ŋaa ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa nʋʋkala lɛ.

english_verse: Then your people will worship you and obey you for as long as they live in the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ nɩaa jaŋ fɩfáŋ a tuto ŋ wombiee, bʋa-la kala ba sɩ hɛ tintee-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩ la naabalɩmaba ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Foreigners will hear about you and your mighty power, and some of them will come to live among your people Israel. If any of them pray toward this temple,
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋhʋɔra-la ma sɩ bɩ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋŋ ŋaa nɛ nɩɩ ŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ wɩaa, ŋ doluŋ wɩaa arɩ wʋduoru-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa a lɩɩ tinteye-la sɩ bolie a kɔ dɩ ʋ chʋɔlʋŋ, a joŋ ʋ sɩaa chaasɛ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ a sʋlʋŋ,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven and answer their prayers. Then everyone on earth will worship you, just as your own people Israel do, and they will know that I have built this temple in your honor.
translation_verse: ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ nʋhʋɔrʋ-la sʋla a ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ pʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ jɩmɩŋ a fɩfáŋ arɩ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, aŋ bɩra jɩŋ arɩ mɩ saa ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ a pɩŋ nɛ dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlʋŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes you will order your people to attack their enemies. Then your people will turn toward this temple I have built for you in your chosen city, and they will pray to you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ hɛ ŋ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ laalɩŋ a yuo ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ ba joŋ ba sɩaa chaasɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa arɩ ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la mɩ sɩ saa dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlʋŋ nɩmɛ a sʋlʋŋ,

english_verse: Answer their prayers from heaven and give them victory.
translation_verse: ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ ba sʋla a leŋ dɩ ba yuo dii ba dʋndɔmɔ-la.

english_verse: Everyone sins. But when your people sin against you, suppose you get angry enough to let their enemies drag them away to foreign countries.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala tuo ʋ bɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ ka ŋaa. Ama dɩ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ kʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, dɩ ŋ baanɩŋ sii ba nyuŋ a leŋ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diiba a kɛsɛba kaa mʋ tintee-wogusuŋ, dɩ lee-la kpaga koo ʋ bolie,

english_verse: Come to your new home, where we have already placed the sacred chest, which is the symbol of your strength. I pray that when the priests announce your power to save people, those who are faithful to you will celebrate what you've done for them.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, sii kʋ jʋʋ ŋ dɩa, la joŋ ŋ niiriŋ daga-la bil nɩmɛ nɛ, kʋ-la sɩ ŋaa ŋ doluŋ magɩlɩŋ. Mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa, ŋaa dɩ ŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa leŋ dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ laa nɩaa tɩta. Dɩ ŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Always remember the love you had for your servant David, so that you will not reject your chosen kings.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, sɩ́ mɩ-na nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa vɩa ta. Liisi ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ŋ tɩntɩnna Devit arɩ ŋ jaŋ dagɛ ŋ chonuŋ a pʋ.”

english_verse: When the crowd of people saw the fire and the Lord's glory, they knelt down and worshiped the Lord. They prayed: “The Lord is good, and his love never ends.”
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma-la kala sɩ na nyiŋ-la sɩ kʋʋ tuu arɩ La TƖƖNA tʋla-la sɩ tɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ, ba kala tuu kpirimi a kɛŋ sɩaa chu tinteeŋ a chʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA a lɔllʋ a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA wɩaa zɔmɔ, ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: Then they will answer, “It was because the people of Israel rejected the Lord their God, who rescued their ancestors from Egypt, and they started worshiping other gods.”
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ bʋla pɩba, ‘Ba vɩa dɩ ba to ba TƖƖNA, ba nyɩmmaba Wɩa sɩ kɛmba kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ, aŋ mɩɩra tuto vesiŋ a kpʋkpaarɛba, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ joŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ deemba kala ŋaa ba lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Everybody stood up during the ceremony. The priests were in their assigned places, blowing their trumpets. And the Levites faced them, playing the musical instruments that David had made for them to use when they praised the Lord for his never-ending love.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa chɩŋ lee-la sɩ maga dɩ ba chɩŋ, Levi doho nɩaa ma chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnɩŋ a kori ba kʋduulo-la kuoro Devit fa sɩ ŋaa dɩ ba kaa dɩdɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA. Ba yie du kɩalɩŋ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA a bʋl, “Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.” Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma yie chɩna chaasɛ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ a ŋmʋŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ, ka Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala chɩŋ.

english_verse: If my own people will humbly pray and turn back to me and stop sinning, then I will answer them from heaven. I will forgive them and make their land fertile once again.
translation_verse: dɩ mɩ nɩaa nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri a sʋla chɩchɛmɛ, aŋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, mɩ hɛ mɩ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ nɩɩ ba sʋla a joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba aŋ leŋ dɩ ba tinteeŋ fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: Then on the twenty-third day of the seventh month, Solomon sent everyone home. They left very happy because of all the good things the Lord had done for David and Solomon, and for his people Israel. The Lord Appears to Solomon Again (
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-pɛɩ tapʋlaa mara arɩ batori chɛɛŋ, Solomoŋ ta nɩalɩŋ kala ba mʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ. Ba tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ woruŋ a tɩŋ wʋzɔmɔ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa pɩ Devit arɩ Solomoŋ arɩ ʋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa. La TƖƖNA bɩra kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ Solomoŋ

english_verse: The Lord's temple and Solomon's palace were now finished. In fact, everything Solomon had planned to do was completed.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ sɩ saa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la arɩ ʋ kuoru dɩa dɛrɛ, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ ŋaa ba lɛ a dɛrɛ,

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream and said: I heard your prayer, and I have chosen this temple as the place where sacrifices will be offered to me.
translation_verse: bʋa kʋbala lɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagʋ tɩtaŋɩŋ, aŋ bʋl: “Mɩ nɩɩ ŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ. Mɩ lɩɩsɛ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ ʋ ŋaa mɩ kʋŋ nɛ, lee-la nɩaa sɩ jaŋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a pɩpɩmɛ.

english_verse: Suppose I hold back the rain or send locusts to eat the crops or make my people suffer with deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ pɔ dɩ duonuŋ sɩ nɩɩ, koo a leŋ dɩ hɔbɔ kʋ dii ma tinteeŋ, koo a leŋ dɩ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ kʋ jʋʋ mɩ nɩaa,

english_verse: I will hear the prayers made in this temple,
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ bibeŋ leriŋ deeŋ a jegile nɩɩ nʋʋkala Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɩmɛ,

english_verse: because it belongs to me, and this is where I will be worshiped forever. I will never stop watching over it.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ lɩɩsɛ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ nɛ ʋ ŋaa mɩ kʋŋ dɩ ba zizilmi nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Mɩ tʋɔŋ arɩ mɩ sɩaa jaŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Your father David obeyed me, and now, Solomon, you must do the same. Obey my laws and teachings,
translation_verse: Ŋ-na Solomoŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ tomi arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ nyɩmma Devit fa sɩ tomi, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ daga, a to mɩ niiriŋ arɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile,

english_verse: and I will keep my solemn promise to him that someone from your family will always be king of Israel.
translation_verse: mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ kuoruŋ chɩŋ, arɩ mɩ fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ mɩ dɩ ŋ nyɩmma Devit pɛgɛ ŋɩɩ, bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ sɩ, ‘Ŋ doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ didii kuoruŋ Iziral lɛ.’

english_verse: But if you or any of the people of Israel disobey my laws or start worshiping foreign gods,
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ vɩa mɩ niiriŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma aŋ mɩɩra mʋ tuto vesiŋ a kpʋkpaarɛba,

english_verse: I will pull you out of this land I gave you. I will desert this temple where I said I would be worshiped, so that people everywhere will think it is only a joke and will make fun of it.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na, mɩ jaŋ kiri ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta tintee-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩma lɛ, aŋ vɩa mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ ŋaa mɩ kʋŋ dɩ ba zizilmi nɩmɛ a ta. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋtɔɔ, dɩ nɩaa mʋmɔŋ.

english_verse: This temple is now magnificent. But when these things happen, everyone who walks by it will be shocked and will ask, “Why did the Lord do such a terrible thing to his people and to this temple?”
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ-na mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, ama dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa, nʋʋkala sɩ jaŋ to dɩa deeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ bɩbal jaŋ naʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaaʋ wʋkpuŋkpere dɩ ʋ pɩɛsɛ, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA ŋaa tinteeŋ deeŋ arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ ŋ-la?’

english_verse: Solomon did not force the Israelites to do his work. Instead, they were his soldiers, officers, army commanders, and cavalry troops. But he did make slaves of the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites who were living in Israel. These were the descendants of those foreigners the Israelites did not destroy, and they remained Israel's slaves.
translation_verse: Ama Solomoŋ fa bɩ leŋe Iziral tɩɩna kala ŋaa ʋ yomo a tɩtɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ba nɛ fa ŋaa ʋ laalɩyuoroo, ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ torukoba-la vɩvɛŋ.

english_verse: After that, Solomon had his workers rebuild the towns that Hiram had given him. Then Solomon sent Israelites to live in those towns.
translation_verse: Kuoro Solomoŋ fa bɩra wasa saa tabiisi-la Hiram sɩ joŋo pʋ nɛ a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hɔŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Solomon attacked and captured the town of Hamath-Zobah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ mʋ yuo dii taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hamaf Zoba.

english_verse: He ordered his workers to build the town of Tadmor in the desert and some towns in Hamath where he could keep his supplies.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tadɩmɔ sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ arɩ tabala-la lɛ ba sɩɩ bil kɩaa ʋ sɩ saa Hamaf tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He did the same thing to the town of Baalath and to the cities where he kept supplies, chariots, and horses. Solomon ordered his workers to build whatever he wanted in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and anywhere else in his kingdom.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baalaf, a pɛ tasɩ-la kala lɛ ʋ sɩ saa ʋ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩ-bilee arɩ tabala-la lɛ ʋ janɩŋ arɩ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba sɩɩ chɩŋ. Ʋ saa dɩa na-kala ʋ sɩ cho nɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ arɩ Lɛbanɔŋ tinteeŋ lɛ arɩ lere-la kala ʋ sɩɩ beŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Solomon's wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt, moved from the part of Jerusalem called David's City to her new palace that Solomon had built. The sacred chest had been kept in David's City, which made his palace sacred, and so Solomon's wife could no longer live there.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ kɛŋ ʋ haala sɩ ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro tolo lɩɩ Devit tabal-la lɛ a kɔ kuoru dɩa-la ʋ sɩ saa pʋ, aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ haala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Devit kuoru dɩa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la fa hɛ tabal-la lɛ nɛ, lee na-kala ʋ sɩ hɛ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Solomon offered sacrifices to the Lord on the altar he had built in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ yie vɛnɛ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la ʋ sɩ saa nyuŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA lɛ nɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la zawʋra sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: He followed the requirements that Moses had given for sacrifices offered on the Sabbath, on the first day of each month, the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ ba tuto sɩ daga dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa tapʋlɩɩ kala nɛ: Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele arɩ gbiele-la batori ba sɩ yie vɛnɛɛ gbieli, boroboro sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ gbiele, yɔɔsʋŋ gbiele arɩ lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele.

english_verse: Solomon then assigned the priests and the Levites their duties at the temple, and he followed the instructions that his father, the man of God, had given him. Some of the Levites were to lead music and help the priests in their duties, and others were to guard the temple gates
translation_verse: Solomoŋ fa to wɩalɩŋ ʋ nyɩmma Devit sɩ dagʋ nɛ, a dagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ba sɩ kaa kpaa bugoo ba chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa tapʋlɩɩ kala. Ʋ leŋ Levi doho nɩaa laa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩpaaŋ ba yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa chɛɛ kala, ʋ bɩra dagɛ nɩalɩŋ ma ba sɩ kaa kpaa bugoo ba pʋpɔ boi-balaa arɩ Wɩa tɩntɩnna Devit sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Solomon went to Ezion-Geber and Eloth, two Edomite towns on the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ sii mʋ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛzɩɔŋ Geba arɩ Ɛlaf sɩ hɛ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Hiram sent him ships and some of his experienced sailors. They went with Solomon's own sailors to the country of Ophir and brought back more than
translation_verse: Hiram joŋ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ a tɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ lɩɩŋ woruŋ. Ba pɛ Solomoŋ nɩaa lɛ ba duori lɩɩŋ a mʋ tintee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ofi a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ yi kilo bʋɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ a kaa mɩɩra kʋ pɩ kuoro Solomoŋ.

english_verse: He answered every question, no matter how difficult it was.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ ma chaarɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ pɩɛsa sɩaa. Wɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala fa bɩ wʋhaa ŋaa Solomoŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: She said: Solomon, in my own country I had heard about your wisdom and all you've done.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩ kuoro Solomoŋ, “Mɩ sɩ hɛ mɩ tinteeŋ lɛ aŋ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa arɩ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ, sɛnɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: But I didn't believe it until I saw it with my own eyes! And there's so much I didn't hear about. You are greater than I was told.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ fa bɩ laa dii, see mɩ tɩtɩa sɩɩŋ sɩ na ŋ-la. Mɩ paala bɩ ŋ wɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ma nɩa. Ŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ yʋga kɩɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ nɩa nɛ.

english_verse: Your people and officials are lucky to be here where they can listen to the wise things you say.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɩaa ŋaa nyu-sɩŋ tɩmma nɛ. Ŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ bʋa na-kala ŋaa tʋɔtɔrɛ tɩmma nɛ, ba sɩ jaŋ nɩnɩɩ ŋ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la.

english_verse: I praise the Lord your God. He is pleased with you and has made you king of Israel. God loves the people of this country and will never desert them, so he has given them a king who will rule fairly and honestly.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ dɛnnɛ ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa, ʋ tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɛ ŋ nyuŋ, ʋ leŋ ŋ dii Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoruŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. A tɩŋ ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ cho Iziral tɩŋŋaa aa chɛ dɩ ʋ pɔba a kaa mʋ wuu nɛ tɩɩ ʋ joŋuŋ ŋ ŋaa ba kuoro, dɩ ŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ tʋɔpʋla a bemba.”

english_verse: The Queen of Sheba gave Solomon more than four tons of gold, a large amount of jewels, and the best spices anyone had ever seen.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la sɩ ŋaa Sɩɩba kuoro joŋ sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ kɩɩ kilo bʋɩ banɛsɛ a pɩ Solomoŋ, arɩ tegisiŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma a yʋgɛ woruŋ arɩ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa. Nʋʋkala ha bɩ tegisi-la doho kaa kʋ pɩ kuoro Solomoŋ a magɛ kɩalɩŋ Sɩɩba kuoro sɩ joŋo pʋ.

english_verse: not counting what the merchants and traders brought him. The kings of Arabia and the leaders of Israel also gave him gold and silver.
translation_verse: Lampoo-la bayalaa sɩ yie time pʋ-na bɩ pɛ. Arebia kuoroo kala arɩ Iziral tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ ma yie kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla kʋ pʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Solomon did while he was king is written in the records of Nathan the prophet, Ahijah the prophet from Shiloh, and Iddo the prophet who wrote about Jeroboam son of Nebat.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Solomoŋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa a chɩŋ ʋ dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa deemba tenniŋ lɛ: Netaŋ, Ahija sɩ lɩɩ Sɩlɔ arɩ Ido sɩ ŋaa Wɩa sɩɩ-naara, ʋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: His throne was made of ivory and covered with pure gold.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro leŋ ba kɛŋ batu-nyɩlɩŋ ŋaa kuoru kpasɩ-bal, aŋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ taara tɔ.

english_verse: It had a gold footstool attached to it and armrests on each side. There was a statue of a lion on each side of the throne,
translation_verse: Kuoru kpasa-la kɛŋ lusuŋ-chol sɩaa balɩdʋ nɛ. Ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa naasɩŋ dɩdaŋɩŋ a mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ. Kpasa-la sɛsɩŋ balɩa kala lɛ, nɩsaa dɩdaŋɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, ka kɩaa sɩ nagɛ naachigee balɩa chɩŋ a challɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: and there were two lion statues on each of the six steps leading up to the throne. No other throne in the world was like Solomon's.
translation_verse: Lusuŋ-chol sɩa-la balɩdʋ lɛ, kɩaa sɩ nagɛ naachigee fii arɩ balɩa chɩŋ ba sɛsɩŋ. Lusuŋ-chol sɩɩ kala niipiniŋ lɛ, balɩa hɛ nɩmɛ, dɔŋɔ chɩŋ nadiiŋ, dɔŋɔ ma chɩŋ nagʋa. Ba ha bɩ kuoru kpasa deeŋ doho ŋaa tintee dɔŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: Solomon had a lot of seagoing ships. Every three years he sent them out with Hiram's ships to bring back gold, silver, and ivory, as well as monkeys and peacocks.
translation_verse: Kuoro fa kɛŋ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ ma nɛ. Hiram tɩntɩnnaa kaa duori lɩɩŋ mʋmʋ bayalɩŋ. Jɩsɩŋ batori na-kala ba yie mɩɩra kɔ bala nɛ, a chʋŋ sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, batu-nyɩlaa, ŋmaŋŋaa arɩ fɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: Solomon was the richest and wisest king in the world.
translation_verse: Kuoro Solomoŋ nɛ fa kɛŋ kɩaa arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ a kɩɩ kuoru kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Year after year, other kings came to hear the wisdom God had given him. And they brought gifts of silver and gold, as well as clothes, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.
translation_verse: Jɩna kala, nʋʋ na-kala sɩ kɔ dɩ ʋ na Solomoŋ yie kɛŋ kɩaa nɛ kʋ dii zile pʋ: hɔpʋla kɩaa, sɛlɩmɛ kɩaa, gɛnnɩŋ, laalɩyuori kɩaa arɩ tegisiŋ, janɩŋ arɩ kakusuŋ.

english_verse: He ruled all the nations from the Euphrates River in the north to the land of Philistia in the south, as far as the border of Egypt.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ nɛ faa beŋ kuorusu-la kala a chɩŋ Yufireti fuo-la lɛ a kaa mʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tinteeŋ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ bʋa.

english_verse: While Solomon was king, there was silver everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as the sycamore trees in the western foothills.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Solomoŋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ, hɔpʋla fa pʋrɩga nɛ woruŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a nagɛ tabɩaa, kuolu daasɩŋ ma pʋrɩgɛ woruŋ a nagɛ tutogusuŋ sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Solomon's horses were brought in from other countries, including Musri. Solomon Dies (
translation_verse: Solomoŋ fa yie leŋ ʋ bayalaa mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ arɩ tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ nɛ a yɔɔ ʋ janɩŋ. Solomoŋ sʋba

english_verse: he died and was buried in the city of his father David. His son Rehoboam then became king.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi Jerusalɛm lɛ, Devit tabal-la, ka ʋ nanʋala Rihobuam dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Rehoboam went to Shechem where everyone was waiting to crown him king.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rihobuam sii mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛkɛm. Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala fa mʋ nɩmɛ nɛ dɩ ba bilu kuoruŋ.

english_verse: Three days later, Jeroboam and the others came back.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa batori harɩŋ, Jerobuam arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala mɩɩra kɔ Rihobuam teeŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: Jeroboam son of Nebat heard what was happening, and he returned from Egypt, where he had gone to hide from Solomon.
translation_verse: Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, bʋa-la lɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ fá Solomoŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a mʋ hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mɩɩra lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kɔ.

english_verse: The people from the northern tribes of Israel sent for him. Then together they went to Rehoboam and said,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tɩma yɩrɛ Jerobuam, ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala to dɔŋɔ a mʋ Rihobuam leriŋ a bʋla pʋ:

english_verse: “Your father Solomon forced us to work very hard. But if you make our work easier, we will serve you and do whatever you ask.”
translation_verse: “Ŋ nyɩmma fa fʋgɛla hɛ nɛ la tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ woruŋ, ama dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ duoru-la doho, ŋɩɩ-na la jaŋ sɛɩ a toŋ a tɩma pɩpɩŋ.”

english_verse: Rehoboam replied, “Come back in three days for my answer.” So the people left.
translation_verse: Rihobuam bʋla pɩba, “Má mʋ aŋ mɩɩra kɔ tapʋl tori chɛɛŋ.” Nɩalɩŋ mɩɩra viiri.

english_verse: Rehoboam went to some leaders who had been his father's senior officials, and he asked them, “What should I tell these people?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Rihobuam pɩɛsɛ nɩhɩasɩ-la fa sɩ tɩma pɩ ʋ nyɩmma Solomoŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa lɛ, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ dagɛmɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩ nɩaa deemba?”

english_verse: They answered, “If you want them to serve and obey you, then you should be kind and promise to make their work easier.”
translation_verse: Nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩ, “Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ nɩaa deemba toŋ a tɩma pɩpɩŋ, kɛŋ zile ba teeŋ a ŋaa wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ chɛ pɩba.”

english_verse: But Rehoboam refused their advice and went to the younger men who had grown up with him and were now his officials.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rihobuam vɩa wɩɩ-la nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩ dagʋ, aŋ mɩɩra mʋ pɩɛsɛ bapʋɔsɩa-la sɩ ŋaa ʋ wielee aŋ lɛɛlɛ tɩma pʋpʋ.

english_verse: He asked, “What do you think I should say to these people who asked me to make their work easier?”
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma ma kɛŋ dɩ ma bʋl? Wʋbɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɩ mɩ lɩɩsɛba tɩntɩŋ-duoru-la lɛ mɩ nyɩmma sɩ jomba hɛ?”

english_verse: His younger advisors said: Here's what we think you should say to them: “Compared to me, my father was weak.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bapʋɔsɩa-la bʋl, “Bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋmɛŋ ŋ teeŋ arɩ ŋ nenii-bie nɛ paala barɩma kɩɩ ŋ nyɩmma tɩŋa.

english_verse: He made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba arɩ ŋ nyɩmma leŋe ba tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ nɛ, ama ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba wasa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ. Ŋ nyɩmma vɩɩrɛba arɩ kpaasa nɛ, ama ŋ-na jaŋ joŋ hɔɔnʋŋ a hɛ kpaasɩ-biee niiriŋ lɛ a kaa vɩɩrɛba.”

english_verse: Rehoboam ignored the advice of the older advisors. He spoke bluntly
translation_verse: Rihobuam vɩa wɩɩ-la nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩ dagʋ, aŋ bʋl wɩaa kpɩa nɩalɩŋ lɛ arɩ baanɩŋ,

english_verse: and told them exactly what his own advisors had suggested. He said: “My father made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: aŋ to wɩɩ-la ʋ bapʋɔsɩa-la sɩ dagʋ a bʋl, “Mɩ nyɩmma leŋe ma tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ nɛ, ama mɩ-na jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma wasa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ nyɩmma vɩɩrɛma arɩ kpaasa nɛ, ama mɩ-na jaŋ joŋ hɔɔnʋŋ a hɛ kpaasɩ-bie-la niiriŋ lɛ a kaa vɩɩrɛma.”

english_verse: After Rehoboam returned to Jerusalem, he decided to attack Israel and regain control of the whole country. So he called together
translation_verse: Rihobuam sɩ mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm, ʋ yɩrɛ Juda arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ hɛ dɔŋɔ, dɩ ba mʋ yuo Iziral tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ a bɩra laa kuorii-la pɩ Rihobuam.

english_verse: as well as with shields and spears. He used these fortified cities to keep control of Judah and Benjamin. The Priests and the Levites Support Rehoboam
translation_verse: arɩ hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoro sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori-hɛŋŋɛɛ a pɛ tiŋŋee lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa a wuo beŋ Juda arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the Lord had told Shemaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pɩ Sɛmaaya sɩ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ,

english_verse: “The Lord warns you not to go to war against the people from the northern tribes—they are your relatives. Go home! The Lord is the one who made these things happen.” Rehoboam and his army obeyed the Lord's message and did not attack Jeroboam and his troops. Rehoboam Fortifies Cities in Judah
translation_verse: arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ, ‘Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ ma naambiiriŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa yuo. Má mʋ ma dɩɩsɩŋ, mɩ nɛ leŋe wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa.’ ” Ba sɛɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ a mɩɩrɛ a bɩ Jerobuam yuo. Rihobuam saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli Juda tasɩŋ

english_verse: Rehoboam ruled from Jerusalem, and he had several cities in Judah turned into fortresses so he could use them to defend his country. These cities included
translation_verse: Rihobuam hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ a saa tasɩŋ deemba ba ŋaa ʋ dɩ-duoruŋ dɩ ʋ kaa pɔ Juda tinteeŋ. Tasɩ-la nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
translation_verse: Bɛtɩlɛhɛm, Ɛtam, Tɛkʋa,

english_verse: Beth-Zur, Soco, Adullam,
translation_verse: Bɛf Zuu, Soko, Adulam,

english_verse: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
translation_verse: Gaf, Marɛsa, Zɩf,

english_verse: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
translation_verse: Adorem, Lakɩs, Azɛka

english_verse: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron. After he had fortified these cities in the territories of Judah and Benjamin,
translation_verse: Zora, Aɩjalɔŋ arɩ Hɛbʋrɔŋ. Tasɩŋ deemba nɛ ba fa saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli, Juda tinteeŋ arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: he assigned an army commander to each of them and stocked them with supplies of food, olive oil, and wine,
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe dɩ-duoru-la dol nɛ woruŋ, aŋ leŋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ hɛ ba kʋŋkala lɛ. Ʋ joŋ kʋdiilee, olif nʋʋŋ arɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ a bil tasɩ-la lɛ,

english_verse: The priests and Levites from the northern tribes of Israel gave their support to King Rehoboam.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ hɛ Iziral doho doho-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa tʋɔŋ fa chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: And since Jeroboam and the kings of Israel that followed him would not allow any Levites to serve as priests, most Levites left their towns and pasturelands in Israel and moved to Jerusalem and other towns in Judah.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa fa vɩa ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee arɩ ba dʋa kala ta nɛ aŋ kɔ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm a tɩŋ Jerobuam arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ sɩ vɩaba arɩ ba dee bɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ŋaa.

english_verse: Jeroboam chose his own priests to serve at the local shrines in Israel and at the places of worship where he had set up statues of goat-demons and of calves.
translation_verse: Jerobuam lɩɩsɛ nɩaa sɩ bɩ Levi doho nɩaa ŋaa a hɛ veŋ-kpaarɛ lere-la, aŋ lɩɩsɛ dɔnsʋŋ ma ba kpʋkpaarɛ tɔmɔ-la ba sɩ mɛ ba nagɛ bʋʋnaa arɩ nɛ-biisiŋ.

english_verse: But some of the people from Israel wanted to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done. So they followed the priests and Levites to Jerusalem, where they could offer sacrifices to the Lord.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma-la kala sɩ kɛŋ ba tʋɔŋ a tuto La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa to Levi doho nɩalɩŋ harɩŋ a mʋ Jerusalɛm dɩ ba kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ ba TƖƖNA ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa.

english_verse: For the next three years, they lived in Judah and were loyal to Rehoboam and his kingdom, just as they had been loyal to David and Solomon. Rehoboam's Family
translation_verse: Ba fa pɛ Solomoŋ nanʋala Rihobuam lɛ nɛ jɩsɩŋ batori a leŋ Juda tinteeŋ chaasa kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ. Ba fa to Rihobuam niiŋ nɛ woruŋ arɩ ba fa sɩ to Devit arɩ Solomoŋ niiŋ ŋɩɩ. Rihobuam dɩa nɩaa

english_verse: Rehoboam and Mahalath had three sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
translation_verse: Rihobuam arɩ Mahalaf fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la: Jeyus, Sɛmarɩa arɩ Zaham.

english_verse: Then Rehoboam married Maacah the daughter of Absalom. Their sons were Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rihobuam bɩra jaa Abɩsalɔm tolo Maaka, ba hambolibiisiŋ nɛ fa ŋ-la: Abija, Ataɩ, Ziza arɩ Sɛlɔmɩf.

english_verse: so he chose their oldest son Abijah to be the next king.
translation_verse: Rihobuam lɩɩsɛ Maaka nanʋala Abija nɛ ʋ ŋaa ʋ kuoru-bii-hɩaŋ ʋ naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ nɛ laa ʋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: Rehoboam was wise enough to put one of his sons in charge of each fortified city in his kingdom. He gave them all the supplies they needed and found wives for every one of them.
translation_verse: Rihobuam fa ŋaa wʋjɩnnɩ wɩɩ nɛ, a kɛŋ ʋ hambolibiisi-la dɔnsʋŋ a pɩsa hɛ Juda arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ arɩ tabala-la kala ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli lɛ ba bibeŋ. Ʋ fa pɩba kɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ a jaa haalaa ma yʋgɛ a pɩba.

english_verse: but he still did wrong and refused to obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Rihobuam fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa bɩ La TƖƖNA to arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala.

english_verse: So in the fifth year of Rehoboam's rule, the Lord punished them for their unfaithfulness and allowed King Shishak of Egypt to invade Judah.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ La TƖƖNA to arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro Sɩsak kʋ yuo Jerusalɛm. Rihobuam sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-nɔŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: He captured every one of the fortified cities in Judah and then marched to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa yuo dii Juda tinteeŋ tabala-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli nɛ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah had gone to Jerusalem to escape Shishak's invasion. And while they were there, Shemaiah the prophet told them, “The Lord says that because you have disobeyed him, he has now abandoned you. The Lord will not help you against Shishak!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la ba sɩ yɩrɛ Sɛmaaya kɔ Rihobuam arɩ Juda sɩpaalaara-la sɩ hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ teeŋ a tɩŋ ba sɩɩ fá Sɩsak wɩaa a bʋla pɩba, “Ŋ-la nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, ‘Má vɩamɛ nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ ma vɩama hɛ Sɩsak nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders were sorry for what they had done and admitted, “The Lord is right. We have deserted him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral sɩpaalaaraa arɩ kuoro sɛɩ arɩ ba cheye nɛ aŋ bʋl, “La TƖƖNA kɩaa sɩma nɛ.”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he told Shemaiah: The people of Judah are truly sorry for their sins, and so I won't let Shishak completely destroy them. But because I am still angry,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ na dɩ ba sɛyɛ arɩ ba cheye nɛ, ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ wʋlaabʋlla Sɛmaaya, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ folo sɛɩ arɩ ba cheye nɛ, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ cheiba, ama mɩ jaŋ laaba ta ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ a leŋ dɩ Sɩsak chei Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: he will conquer and rule them. Then my people will know what it's like to serve a foreign king instead of serving me.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ ha jaŋ leŋ dɩ Sɩsak yuo diiba a bibemba, dɩ ba to ŋɩɩ lɛ a jɩŋ arɩ ba sɩ tomi mɩ bibemba nɛ zɔmɔ a kɩɩ ba sɩ to dʋnɩa kuoroo ba bibemba.”

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Rihobuam leŋ ba kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ libi hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ, a hɛ sɛlɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ paa nyuŋ lɛ. Ʋ joŋ kɩalɩŋ hɛ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoru dɩa boiŋ niiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he had finished worshiping.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala dɩ kuoro nɩɩ mʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ lee-la yie paa hɔɔtaalɩ-la ba sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ a to ʋ harɩŋ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa wɩaa dɛrɛ, ba bɩra mɩɩra kaa jʋʋ bil nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Rehoboam turned back to the Lord, and so the Lord did not let Judah be completely destroyed, and Judah was prosperous again. Rehoboam's Rule in Judah (
translation_verse: A tɩŋ Rihobuam sɩ bɩrɩma a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pɩ La TƖƖNA, La TƖƖNA bɩra bɩ baanɩŋ na ʋ nyuŋ a cheyu dɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa Juda lɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king, including a history of his family, is written in the records of the two prophets, Shemaiah and Iddo. During Rehoboam's rule, he and King Jeroboam of Israel were constantly at war.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Rihobuam sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, a chɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Sɛmaaya arɩ Wɩa sɩɩ-naara Ido tenniŋ lɛ. Ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ ba doho nɩaa wɩaa tʋɔŋ. Laalɩŋ fa hɛ Rihobuam arɩ Jerobuam pɛgɛ nɛ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: When Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Abijah became king.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rihobuam sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi Devit tabal-la lɛ ʋ nyɩmmaba tʋɔŋ, ka ʋ nanʋala Abija laa ʋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: Abijah became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam sɩ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ jɩ-fii arɩ chori lɛ nɛ Abija ma dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and the troops let out a battle cry. Then with Abijah leading them into battle, God defeated Jeroboam and Israel's army.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ nɛ Juda tɩŋŋaa ŋaa laalɩyuori goŋ. Ba sɩ ŋaa goŋ-la ŋɩɩ, Wɩa yuo dii Jerobuam arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kala Abija arɩ Juda nɩaa sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Now you and your powerful army think you can stand up to the kingdom that the Lord has given to David's descendants. The only gods you have are those gold statues of calves that Jeroboam made for you.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ ŋ dɩ ŋ laalɩyuori-daŋ-la bɩɩna ma jaŋ wuo sii chɩŋ a yuo laa kuorii-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo hɛ Devit doho nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛɛ? Vesi-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ, sɛlɩmɛ nɛ Jerobuam kaa ŋaaba ba nagɛ nɛ-biisiŋ pɩma.

english_verse: and he ruled from Jerusalem for three years. His mother was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel from Gibeah. Some time later, Abijah and King Jeroboam of Israel went to war against each other.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ batori nɛ. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Maaka, Ʋrɩɛl sɩ ŋaa Gɩbɩa tɩɩna tolo. Laalɩŋ fa hɛ Abija arɩ Jerobuam pɛgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Abijah went to the top of Mount Zemaraim in the hills of Ephraim and shouted: Listen, Jeroboam and all you Israelites!
translation_verse: Abija fa chɩŋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zɛmarem sɩ hɛ Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ nɛ aŋ bʋl, “Jerobuam arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel has made a solemn promise that every king of Israel will be from David's family.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa hɛ niiŋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ birige nɛ a joŋ Iziral kuoruŋ a pɩ Devit arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa a kaa mʋ wuu?

english_verse: But Jeroboam, you were King Solomon's official, and you rebelled.
translation_verse: Ama Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam ma fa sɩ ŋaa Devit nanʋala Solomoŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ dɔŋɔ vɩa ʋ nɩhɩaŋ kuoro Solomoŋ niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Then right after Rehoboam became king, you and your bunch of worthless followers challenged Rehoboam, who was too young to know how to stop you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩtɔɔnʋŋ sii a chɩŋ Solomoŋ nanʋala Rihobuam lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ dɩ ʋ fa ŋaa hambie, ʋ fa bɩ wɩaa ma jɩŋ dɩ ʋ wuo kiriba.

english_verse: You don't even have descendants of Aaron on your side, because you forced out the Lord's priests and Levites. In their place, you appoint ordinary people to be priests, just as the foreign nations do. In fact, anyone who brings a bull and seven rams to the altar can become a priest of your so-called gods.
translation_verse: Ma paala kiri Arɔŋ biiriŋ sɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa ta nɛ, aŋ chaarɛ ma tɩtɩa nɩaa arɩ tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Nʋʋ na-kala nɛ kɛŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ arɩ pie-belliŋ balɩpɛ kaa kʋ pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta, ma yie lɩɩsʋ nɛ ʋ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ vesi-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa ŋaa.

english_verse: But we have not turned our backs on the Lord God! Aaron's own descendants serve as our priests, and the Levites are their assistants.
translation_verse: Ama, La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa la-na Wɩa, la bɩ ʋ vɩa. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ŋaa Arɔŋ biiriŋ, Levi doho nɩaa ma nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛ ba lɛ ba tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: Two times every day they offer sacrifices and burn incense to the Lord. They set out the sacred loaves of bread on a table that has been purified, and they light the lamps in the gold lampstand every day at sunset. We follow the commands of the Lord our God—you have rejected him!
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ dɩdaanɩŋ, ba nɛ yie ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma a pɩ La TƖƖNA. Ba yie joŋ boroboro a daŋ teebʋl-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ, aŋ nyɩgɛ chaana-la ma sɩ sagɛ sɛlɩmɛ kʋ-la nyuŋ dɩdaaŋ kala. Laa to wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ nɛ. Ama ma-na vɩaʋ nɛ.

english_verse: That's why God is on our side and will lead us into battle when the priests sound the signal on the trumpets. It's no use, Israelites. You might as well give up. There's no way you can defeat the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Wɩa hɛ la teeŋ nɛ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa la sɩpaalaara. Ʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ ŋmʋʋ ba banyilliŋ a yɩrɛ laalɩŋ hɛ ma lɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa, má sɩ́ La TƖƖNA, ma nyɩmmaba Wɩa kaa yuo yuosuŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma bɩ jaŋ wuo yuo dii.”

english_verse: But while Abijah was talking, Jeroboam had sent some of his troops to attack Judah's army from behind, while the rest attacked from the front.
translation_verse: Dɩ Jerobuam fa leŋe ʋ laalɩyuoroo dɔnsʋŋ mʋ faa Juda tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo harɩŋ, ka ʋ ma tɩtɩa faa Juda nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Judah's army won because they had trusted the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Juda nɩaa nɛ wuo Iziral nɩaa a yuo diiba chɛɛ-la, bɛɛ wɩaa ba joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ba TƖƖNA, ba nyɩmmaba Wɩa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Abijah kept up his attack on Jeroboam's army and captured the Israelite towns of Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, as well as the villages around them.
translation_verse: Abija arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kire to Jerobuam laalɩyuoroo harɩŋ a mʋ laa Iziral tabalaa deemba: Bɛtɛl, Jesana arɩ Ɛfʋrɔŋ, a pɛ tabiisi-la sɩ golliba lɛ.

english_verse: Jeroboam never regained his power during the rest of Abijah's rule. The Lord punished Jeroboam, and he died, but Abijah became more powerful.
translation_verse: Jerobuam bɩra bɩ wuo laa doluŋ Abija kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ. Ka La TƖƖNA ŋmobu lo, ʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Everything Abijah said and did while he was king is written in the records of Iddo the prophet.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Abija sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Ido tenniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Asa obeyed the Lord his God and did right.
translation_verse: Asa fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ, a tuto ba bʋa lɛ ʋ Tɩɩna Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines and the altars to foreign gods. He smashed the stone images of gods and cut down the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa chei vʋɩyaa korunuŋ arɩ vʋɩyaa dɩ-kpaaraa nɛ, a yɛrɛ vʋɩyaa tabɩaa, a keri vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩ-la ma lo.

english_verse: Then he told everyone in Judah to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done, and to obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Asa fa leŋe Juda nɩaa to La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa nɛ, a tuto ʋ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: The Lord blessed Judah with peace while Asa was king, and so during that time, Asa fortified many of the towns.
translation_verse: Tintee-la fa sɩ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ saa tabalaa Juda tinteeŋ lɛ a saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli. Jɩsɩ-la lɛ nʋʋkala fa bɩ ʋ kaa yuo laalɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA leŋe ʋ na wiese nɛ.

english_verse: He said to the people, “Let's build walls and defense towers for these towns, and put in gates that can be locked with bars. This land still belongs to us, because we have obeyed the Lord our God. He has given us peace from all our enemies.” The people did everything Asa had suggested.
translation_verse: Asa fa bʋla pɩ Juda nɩaa, “Má leŋ dɩ la saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli tabalaa, a saa jebii-duduosuŋ, a hɛ boi-baalaa arɩ daa-doloo a wuo kaa tʋtɔ. Tintee-la ha ŋaa la kʋŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la to La TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ ʋ leŋ la na wiese sɛmɛ kala.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba saa kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ daga, a dʋa woruŋ.

english_verse: Asa met him there, and the two armies prepared for battle in Zephathah Valley.
translation_verse: Asa ma kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ʋ chemu, ba laalɩyuoro-la kala chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ Zɛfata fuonaaŋ lɛ a kpagɛ Marɛsa.

english_verse: Asa prayed: Lord God, only you can help a powerless army defeat a stronger one. So we depend on you to help us. We will fight against this powerful army to honor your name, and we know that you won't be defeated. You are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asa sʋl ʋ Tɩɩna Wɩa a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ jaŋ wuo pɛ nɩpʋgʋŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ yuo dii nɩduoŋ. La TƖƖNA Wɩa, pɛ la lɛ, la yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ la kɔ dɩ la yuo laalɩyuori-daŋ deeŋ. La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ la Wɩa, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nuhuobiine yuo diiŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord helped Asa and his army defeat the Ethiopians. The enemy soldiers ran away,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA pɛ Asa arɩ Juda laalɩyuoroo lɛ ba yuo dii Kus tɩmma-la, ba fá.

english_verse: but Asa and his troops chased them as far as Gerar. It was a total defeat—the Ethiopians could not even fight back! The soldiers from Judah took everything that had belonged to the Ethiopians.
translation_verse: Asa arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kiriba a mʋ yi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɛra. La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo fa chaasa kpʋ Kus tɩmma-la yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ, ba bɩra bɩ wɩɩkala wuo ŋaa. Ka Juda laalɩyuoroo paa ba kɩaa yʋgɛ woruŋ a kaa viiri.

english_verse: The people who lived in the villages around Gerar learned what had happened and were afraid of the Lord. So Judah's army easily defeated them and carried off everything of value that they wanted from these towns.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tabiisi-la ma kala sɩ golli Gɛra sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ leŋ Juda laalɩyuoroo wuo mʋ yuo diiba mɔlɩɩ a paa ba kʋzɔmɔ-la kala ba sɩɩ chɛ tasɩ-la lɛ a kaa viiri.

english_verse: They also attacked the camps where the shepherds lived and took a lot of sheep, goats, and camels. Then they went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra mʋ yuo dii kʋdaaraa ma bugoo lɛ a laa piesee, bʋʋnaa arɩ bʋntaŋŋaba a yʋgɛ woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Some time later, God spoke to Azariah son of Oded.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa dɩma kʋ jʋʋ Ɔdɛd nanʋala Azarɩa.

english_verse: At once, Azariah went to Asa and said: Listen to me, King Asa and you people of Judah and Benjamin. The Lord will be with you and help you, as long as you obey and worship him. But if you disobey him, he will desert you.
translation_verse: Ʋ lɩɩ Asa teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Kuoro Asa, ŋ dɩ Juda doho nɩaa arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa kala, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ chɩna gbɛrɛma dɩ ma nɛ chɩna gbɛrʋ. Dɩ ma nɛ chɛʋ, ma jaŋ naʋ ma, ama dɩ ma nɛ vɩaʋ, ʋ ma jaŋ vɩama ta.

english_verse: For a long time, the people of Israel did not worship the true God or listen to priests who could teach them about God. They refused to obey God's Law.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa diene kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ bɩ Wɩɩ-tɩtɩɩ-la to, a bɩ nʋʋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ ma kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ dagɛba Wɩa wombiee ʋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto.

english_verse: But whenever trouble came, Israel turned back to the Lord their God and worshiped him.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ hɛɛŋ nɛ jʋʋba, ba yie mɩɩra mʋ La TƖƖNA, Iziral Wɩa teeŋ a chɛ naʋ.

english_verse: There was so much confusion in those days that it wasn't safe to go anywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ wombiiŋ vɛnɩŋ fa kɛŋ bɔɩ-joŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa tinteeŋ kala fa vʋgʋma nɛ.

english_verse: Nations were destroying each other, and cities were wiping out other cities, because God was causing trouble and unrest everywhere.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa fa yie sii mʋ yuo tinteeŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa nɛ, tabalɩŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa ma yie mʋ yuo tabalɩŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa, Wɩa nɛ faa walɩmɛba ba nɩna hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: As soon as Asa heard what Azariah the prophet said, he gave orders for all the idols in Judah and Benjamin to be destroyed, including those in the towns he had captured in the territory of Ephraim. He also repaired the Lord's altar that was in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Asa sɩ nɩɩ wɩaa deemba Ɔdɛd nanʋala Azarɩa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la sɩ bʋla, ʋ nyuŋ nyaasɛ. Ʋ chei tɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ Juda arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ arɩ tasɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ yuo laa Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ. Ʋ wasa bɩrɩmɛ La TƖƖNA koru-la sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la zawʋra sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Asa called together the people from Judah and Benjamin, as well as the people from the territories of Ephraim, West Manasseh, and Simeon who were living in Judah. Many of these people were now loyal to Asa, because they had seen that the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ yɩrɛ Juda nɩaa, Bɛnjamɩŋ nɩaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Efirem, Manasɛ nɩaa arɩ Simioŋ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ guoli ba tʋɔŋ. Nɩalɩŋ fa yʋga nɛ woruŋ a lɩɩ Iziral tinteeŋ a kɔ ʋ teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba na dɩ La TƖƖNA chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: In the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa's rule, they all met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ, dɩ Asa sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ banɔŋ chɛŋ-tori tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: They made a solemn promise to faithfully worship the Lord God their ancestors had worshiped,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɛ niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ arɩ ba jaŋ to La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa arɩ ba tʋɔŋ arɩ ba wɩɩwɩɩ kala.

english_verse: The crowd solemnly agreed to keep their promise to the Lord, then they celebrated by shouting and blowing trumpets and horns.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɛ niiŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA arɩ ba jaŋ tou, aŋ faasa ŋaa goŋ, a ŋmʋʋ banyilliŋ arɩ nyilliŋ.

english_verse: Everyone was happy because they had made this solemn promise, and in return, the Lord blessed them with peace from all their enemies.
translation_verse: Juda nɩaa tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩ hɛ nii-la arɩ ba tʋɔŋ kala. Ba chɛ La TƖƖNA arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, ʋ laa ba sʋla a leŋ ba na wiese ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Asa's grandmother Maacah had made a disgusting idol of the goddess Asherah, so he cut it down, crushed it, and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: Kuoro Asa nahɩma Maaka nɛ fa paala ŋaa haalaa kuoro ʋ kaa laa, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ pɛ veŋ-haal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daaŋ a kpʋkpaarɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asa keri daa-la lo a bori ʋ kala a kaa mʋ Kɩdɩrɔŋ fuonaaŋ a nyɩgɛ.

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines in Israel.
translation_verse: Asa fa bɩ vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa kala cheye Iziral lɛ, ama ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ ʋ chaasa to La TƖƖNA nɛ.

english_verse: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ paa hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ nyɩmma fa sɩ joŋo pɩ La TƖƖNA a kaa kʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: There was peace in Judah until the thirty-fifth year of Asa's rule.
translation_verse: Ba fa bɩra bɩ laalɩŋ yuo deeŋ deeŋ a kaa mʋ yi Asa sɩ dii kuoruŋ jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. Then he sent it to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asa sii paa warɩpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ arɩ ʋ kuoru dɩa lɛ, a joŋo tɩŋ ba kaa mʋ pɩ Siiria tinteeŋ kuoro Bɛŋ-Hadad sɩ hɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ aŋ bʋla pʋ,

english_verse: “I think we should sign a peace treaty, just as our fathers did. This silver and gold is a present for you. Would you please break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: “Leŋ dɩ mɩ dɩŋ pɛ niiŋ a ŋaa kʋbala, arɩ la nyɩmmaba fa sɩ pɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ joŋ warɩpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ pa nɛ dɩ ba kaa kʋ pɩŋ chɔgɩta. Leŋ ŋ dɩ Iziral kuoro Baasa pɛgɛ chei dɩ ʋ dɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo lɩɩ mɩ tinteeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel-Maim, and all the towns in Naphtali where supplies were kept.
translation_verse: Bɛŋ-Hadad sɛɩ wɩɩ-la kuoro Asa sɩ bʋla a leŋ ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ba nɩaa mʋ yuo Iziral tasɩŋ. Ba yuo dii Ɩjɔŋ, Daŋ, Abɛl Bɛf Maaka arɩ Nafɩtalɩ tinteeŋ tabala-la kala lɛ ba sɩɩ bil kɩaa.

english_verse: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped his work on the town of Ramah.
translation_verse: Baasa sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ʋ leŋ Rama saanɩŋ ta.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to fortify Ramah. Then he fortified the towns of Geba and Mizpah with these same stones and wood. Hanani the Prophet Condemns Asa
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Asa ŋaa ba bʋla pɩ Juda nɩaa kala ba paa tabɩa-la arɩ daasɩ-la Baasa fa sɩ kaa sɩsaa dɩ ʋ golli Rama. Ba nɛ kuoro Asa kaa saa golli tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Geba arɩ Mɩzɩpa.

english_verse: Soon after that happened, Hanani the prophet went to Asa and said: You depended on the king of Syria instead of depending on the Lord your God. And so, you will never defeat the Syrian army.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩɩ-naara Hanani kɔ Juda kuoro Asa teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa hɛ Siiria kuoro lɛ aŋ vɩa ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa, ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ŋ wuo yuo dii Siiria kuoro laalɩyuoroo.

english_verse: Remember how powerful the Ethiopian and Libyan army was, with all their chariots and cavalry troops! You trusted the Lord to help you then, and you defeated them.
translation_verse: Kus arɩ Libiya laalɩyuoroo fa dolie nɛ woruŋ, a kɛŋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba arɩ ja-jɩllaa ma a yʋgɛ, ama ŋ sɩ joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa hɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ, ʋ leŋe ŋ yuo diiba nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is constantly watching everyone, and he gives strength to those who faithfully obey him. But you have done a foolish thing, and your kingdom will never be at peace again.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩaa hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nɛ a bee chɩchɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tou arɩ ba tʋɔŋ kala dɩ ʋ pɩba doluŋ. Nɩyaarɛ wɩɩ nɛ ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. A chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ kaa mʋ ŋ dɩ laalɩŋ puu dɔŋɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: When Asa heard this, he was so angry that he put Hanani in prison. Asa was also cruel to some of his people. Asa Dies (
translation_verse: Asa sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ baanɩŋ chaasa sii woruŋ, ʋ kɛŋ Hanani Wɩa sɩɩ-naarʋ-la tɔ dɩa. Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ Asa fa chaasa dɔgɩsɛ ʋ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Everything Asa did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala Asa sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, a chɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Juda arɩ Iziral kuoroo wʋŋaalaa tenniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: In the thirty-ninth year of his rule, he got a very bad foot disease, but he relied on doctors and refused to ask the Lord for help.
translation_verse: Asa sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ nibi lɛ, naasɩŋ nyanyalɩɩ kʋbala ŋmobu bil. Ʋ nyanyalɩɩ-la fa jʋʋ ʋ lɛ nɛ woruŋ, ama ʋ vɩa dɩ ʋ sʋl La TƖƖNA nɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ, aŋ joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ daaluŋ-ŋaaraa lɛ.

english_verse: Earlier, Asa had his own tomb cut out of a rock hill in Jerusalem. So he was buried there, and the tomb was filled with spices and sweet-smelling oils. Then the people built a bonfire in his honor.
translation_verse: Ba joŋu hugi bʋa-la ʋ sɩ lu bil ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ Devit tabal-la lɛ. Ba joŋ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ arɩ tʋlaalɩɩba nɛ a mɩsʋ aŋ joŋu hugi, aŋ hɛ nyiŋ-balɩŋ a yel ʋ yoho.

english_verse: He assigned troops to the fortified cities in Judah, as well as to other towns in Judah and to those towns in Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo hɛhɛ Juda tabala-la kala lɛ ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli nɛ, a leŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋmoo bugoo Juda arɩ Efirem tasɩ-la ʋ nyɩmma Asa sɩ yuo laa lɛ.

english_verse: and helped him keep firm control of his kingdom. The people of Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, but even after he became very rich and respected,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ Jehosafat kuoruŋ chaasa chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. Juda nɩaa kala kɛŋ kɩaa kʋ ŋaa zile pʋpʋ. Ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ chaasa kɛŋ dʋa woruŋ, nɩaa ma zizilu.

english_verse: he remained completely faithful to the Lord. He destroyed all the local shrines in Judah, including the places where the goddess Asherah was worshiped.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ a to La TƖƖNA wombiee woruŋ. Ʋ chei vesiŋ dɩ-kpaara-la kala sɩ hɛ dundolluŋ nyuŋ nɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ, a bori vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ ma.

english_verse: Their assistants were the following nine Levites: Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-Adonijah. Two priests, Elishama and Jehoram, also went along.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa nibi arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩaa balɩa nɛ fa to ba harɩŋ. Levi doho nɩalɩŋ nɛ fa: Sɛmaaya, Nɛtanɩa, Zɛbadɩa, Asahɛl, Sɛmɩramɔf, Jehonataŋ, Adonija, Tobija arɩ Tob-Adonija, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma nɛ fa Ɛlɩsama arɩ Jehoram.

english_verse: They carried with them a copy of the Lord's Law wherever they went and taught the people from it.
translation_verse: Ba fa joŋ Wɩa wombiiŋ ʋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto teŋ-la nɛ a kaa gɔllɛ Juda tinteeŋ tasɩŋ kala, a dagɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ wɩaa a pɩ nɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: The nations around Judah were afraid of the Lord's power, so none of them attacked Jehoshaphat.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa leŋe fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteye-la sɩ golli Juda nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba bɩ kuoro Jehosafat kaa yuo laalɩŋ.

english_verse: As Jehoshaphat became more powerful, he built fortresses and cities
translation_verse: Jehosafat doluŋ wasa pʋŋa pɛ woruŋ, ʋ saa dɩɩ-duoruŋ arɩ tabala-la lɛ ʋ sɩɩ bil kɩaa Juda lɛ

english_verse: where he stored supplies. He also kept in Jerusalem some experienced soldiers
translation_verse: a joŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ a bil tasɩ-la lɛ. Ʋ fa bɩra joŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ woruŋ a bil Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: from the Judah and Benjamin tribes. These soldiers were grouped according to their clans. Adnah was the commander of the troops from Judah, and he had
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɛmba hɛ nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa a chɩŋ Juda laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩba nɛ fa ŋ-la: Adɩna faa beŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ zɔɔ-batori nɛ,

english_verse: Amasiah son of Zichri, who had volunteered to serve the Lord, was third in command, with
translation_verse: Zikiri nanʋala Amasɩa ma nɛ tɩga, ʋ-na tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ sɛɩ dɩ ʋ tɩma pɩ La TƖƖNA, ʋ ma faa beŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩa nɛ.

english_verse: These were the troops who protected the king in Jerusalem, not counting those he had assigned to the fortified cities throughout the country.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba nɛ fa tɩma pɩ kuoro Jerusalɛm lɛ, a pɛ laalɩyuoro-la ʋ sɩ leŋe ba hɛ Juda tabala-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli lɛ.

english_verse: Ahab and Jehoshaphat led their armies to Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral kuoro arɩ Juda kuoro Jehosafat sii kɛŋ ba laalɩyuoroo mʋ dɩ ba yuo Ramɔf Gɩlɩad.

english_verse: One day, Jehoshaphat went to visit Ahab in his capital city of Samaria. Ahab slaughtered sheep and cattle and prepared a big feast to honor Jehoshaphat and the officials with him. Ahab talked about attacking the city of Ramoth in Gilead,
translation_verse: Jɩsɩŋ baŋmɛnɛ harɩŋ, Jehosafat sii mʋ Samarɩa dɩ ʋ na Iziral kuoro Ahab. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahab kpʋ piesee arɩ nɛsɩŋ yʋgɛ woruŋ a hʋɔrɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa, aŋ yigu hɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ yuo taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ramɔf Gɩlɩad.

english_verse: But first let's ask the Lord what to do.”
translation_verse: Ama leŋ dɩ la laa sɩpaaŋ pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA na.”

english_verse: But Jehoshaphat said, “Just to make sure, is there another of the Lord's prophets we can ask?”
translation_verse: Jehosafat bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “La TƖƖNA wʋlaabʋllʋ tuo daha dɩ la to ʋ lɛ a pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA naa?”

english_verse: Then Ahab sent someone to bring Micaiah as soon as possible.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahab yɩrɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ dɔŋɔ a bʋl, “Mʋ kɛŋ Imila nanʋala Mɩkaaya kɔ daha lɛɛlɛ.”
