english_verse: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria, listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Ka Iziral kuoro arɩ Juda kuoro Jehosafat kala laalɛ ba kuori gɛnnɩŋ a hɔŋ ba kuoru kpasɩnɩŋ lɛ taha-la sɩ kpagɛ Samarɩa taŋ-la boi-baalɩŋ niiŋ. Wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la chɩŋ ba sɩpaaŋ a bʋbʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, “Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out!”
translation_verse: Wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Zedikaaya, a ŋaa Kɛnaana nanʋala. Ʋ fa kɛŋ hɔɔŋ libi banyilliŋ nɛ, ʋ kaa heele bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Kɩaa deemba nɛ ŋ jaŋ kaa tɩɩgɛ Siiria tɩŋŋaa kala kpʋ.’ ”

english_verse: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth and promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.
translation_verse: Wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la kʋkaanaa ma kala bʋl ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa. Ba sɩ, “Mʋ yuo Ramɔf Gɩlɩad, ŋ jaŋ yuo diiu, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋu hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la ba sɩ tɩma dɩ ʋ yɩrɛ Mɩkaaya bʋla pʋ, “Na, Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la bʋl wʋbala nɛ. Ba sɩ, ‘Kuoro jaŋ yuo dii.’ Dɩ ŋ nɛ mʋa, ŋ ma chɩŋ ba kʋa lɛ a bʋl ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa.”

english_verse: “I'll say whatever the living Lord my God tells me to say,” Micaiah replied.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mɩkaaya bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ weye wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ Wɩa sɩ bʋla, ʋ nɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋl.”

english_verse: Then Micaiah went up to Ahab, who asked, “Micaiah, should we attack Ramoth?” “Yes!” Micaiah answered. “The Lord will help you capture the city.”
translation_verse: Mɩkaaya sɩ kɔ, kuoro Ahab pɩɛsʋ, “La mʋ yuo taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ramɔf Gɩlɩad koo la sɩ́ mʋ?” Ʋ bʋl, “Má mʋ yuou. La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋu hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Ahab shouted, “Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth! What does the Lord really say?”
translation_verse: Kuoro Ahab bɩra pɩɛsʋ, “Naansɩɩŋ bʋŋmɛɛ nɛ maga dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋmɩɛsɛ aŋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ pɩmɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ?”

english_verse: Micaiah answered, “In a vision I saw Israelite soldiers wandering around, lost in the hills like sheep without a shepherd. The Lord said, ‘These troops have no leader. They should go home and not fight.’ ”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mɩkaaya bʋl, “Mɩ na Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala dɩ ba pɩsa su dundolluŋ nyuŋ, a nagɛ piesee sɩ bɩ pie-daara kɛnɛ, ka La TƖƖNA bʋl, ‘Nɩaa deemba bɩ sɩpaalaarʋ kɛnɛ. Leŋ dɩ ba mɩɩra mʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.’ ”

english_verse: Ahab turned to Jehoshaphat and said, “I told you he would bring me bad news!”
translation_verse: Kuoro Ahab bʋla pɩ Jehosafat, “Mɩ bɩ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ ʋ ha bɩ wʋzɔŋ kala sɩ jaŋ ŋaa bʋla pɩmɛ see wʋbɔŋ?”

english_verse: Micaiah replied: I then saw the Lord seated on his throne with every creature in heaven gathered around him.
translation_verse: Mɩkaaya bɩra bʋl, “Má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla: Mɩ na La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ, ka ʋ tɩndaaraa chɩŋ ʋ nadiiŋ arɩ ʋ nagʋa.

english_verse: The Lord asked, “Who can trick Ahab and make him go to Ramoth where he will be killed?” They talked about it for a while,
translation_verse: Ka La TƖƖNA pɩɛsɛ, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ mʋ nyɩsɛ Iziral kuoro Ahab hɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ yuo Ramɔf Gɩlɩad tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɩmɛ?’ Dɔnsʋŋ bʋl ŋ-la, dɔnsʋŋ ma bʋl wɩɩ dɔŋ.

english_verse: then finally a spirit came forward and said to the Lord, “I can trick Ahab.” “How?” the Lord asked.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, dɩma kʋbala kʋ lɩɩ chɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a bʋl, ‘Mɩ jaŋ mʋ nyɩsʋ.’ La TƖƖNA pɩɛsʋ, ‘Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ to?’

english_verse: “I'll make Ahab's prophets lie to him.” “Good!” the Lord replied. “Now go and do it. You will be successful.”
translation_verse: Dɩma-la bʋl, ‘Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ a hɛ ʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bʋl wɩaa pʋpʋ niiŋ lɛ.’ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl, ‘Mʋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo nyɩsʋ.’ ”

english_verse: Zedekiah walked over and slapped Micaiah on the face. Then he asked, “Do you really think the Lord would speak to you and not to me?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zedikaaya sɩ ŋaa Kɛnaana nanʋala mʋ fallɛ Mɩkaaya, aŋ pɩɛsʋ, “Bʋa bɛɛ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA dɩma-la lɩɩ mɩ lɛ, a kɔ ŋ teeŋ a bʋl wɩaa pɩŋ?”

english_verse: Micaiah answered, “You'll find out on the day you have to hide in the back room of some house.”
translation_verse: Mɩkaaya bʋl, “Tapʋlɩɩ-la ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa jʋʋ faa dɩa sɩpaaŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ.”

english_verse: Ahab shouted, “Arrest Micaiah! Take him to Prince Joash and Governor Amon of Samaria.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Ahab bʋl, “Má kɛŋ Mɩkaaya mɩɩra mʋ taŋ nɩhɩaŋ Amɔŋ arɩ mɩ nanʋala Jʋas teeŋ.

english_verse: Tell them to put him in prison and to give him nothing but bread and water until I come back safely.”
translation_verse: Má bʋla pɩba arɩ ba laaʋ tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa a pʋpʋ boroboro mʋa mʋa arɩ lɩɩŋ dʋndʋŋ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.” Ba kpʋ Ahab Ramɔf Gɩlɩad lɛ

english_verse: Micaiah said, “If you do come back, I was wrong about what the Lord wanted me to say.” Then he told the crowd, “Don't forget what I said!” Ahab Dies at Ramoth (
translation_verse: Mɩkaaya bʋl, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ mɩɩra kɔ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa, ŋɩɩ-na, La TƖƖNA dee bɩ mɩ lɛ to a bʋl wɩaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bɩra bʋl, “Ma nɩaa deemba kala, má magɩlɛ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla bil.”

english_verse: Before they went into battle, Ahab said, “Jehoshaphat, I'll disguise myself, but you wear your royal robe.” Ahab disguised himself and went into battle.
translation_verse: Iziral kuoro bʋla pɩ Jehosafat, “Dɩ laalɩŋ nɛ suomo, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa bɩrɩmɛ a jʋʋ laalɩŋ tʋɔŋ, ama ŋ-na laalɛ ŋ kuoru gɛnnɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral kuoro kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa bɩrɩmɛ a jʋʋ laal-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The king of Syria had ordered his chariot commanders to attack only Ahab.
translation_verse: Siiria kuoro fa bʋla pɩ ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba, “Má sɩ́ nʋʋkala yuo, see Iziral kuoro Ahab dʋndʋŋa.”

english_verse: So when they saw Jehoshaphat in his robe, they thought he was Ahab and started to attack him. But Jehoshaphat prayed, and the Lord made the Syrian soldiers stop.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩ na Jehosafat, ba bɩɩnɛ a bʋl, “Iziral kuoro Ahab nɛ ŋ-la.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩrɩmɛ dɩ ba yuou. Ama Jehosafat ŋmoo niiŋ, La TƖƖNA Wɩa pɛ ʋ lɛ a kiriba ba mɩɩrɛ.

english_verse: And when they realized he wasn't Ahab, they left him alone.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩ na dɩ Iziral kuoro dee, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba leŋu.

english_verse: However, during the fighting a soldier shot an arrow without even aiming, and it hit Ahab between two pieces of his armor. He shouted to his chariot driver, “I've been hit! Get me out of here!”
translation_verse: Laal-la tʋɔŋ, laalɩyuoro-la dɔŋɔ yuo to-hɛmɩŋ bine, ʋ to Ahab laalɩyuori gɛrɩŋ pɛgɛ a jʋʋ kɛnʋ. Ʋ bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ toruko vɩvɛŋ, “Mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ a kɛmmɛ lɩɩ laal-la tʋɔŋ, ba bolimimi nɛ.”

english_verse: The fighting lasted all day, with Ahab propped up in his chariot so he could see the Syrian troops. He stayed there until evening, and by sundown he was dead.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la kala laalɩŋ hoso nɛ woruŋ, ka kuoro hɔnɔ tɩɛnɛ a yelli ʋ toruko-la a bibeŋ Siiria tɩmma-la a kaa mʋ yi dɩdaanɩŋ. Wɩɩ-muluŋ tuu jʋjʋʋ dɩ ʋ sʋba.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Juda kuoro Jehosafat mɩɩra mʋ ʋ kuoru dɩa sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: But the prophet Jehu son of Hanani met him and said: By helping that wicked Ahab, you have made friends with someone who hates the Lord. Now the Lord God is angry with you!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa sɩɩ-naara Jehu, Hanani nanʋala mʋ naʋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ bɩɩna ʋ maga dɩ ŋ pɛ nɩbɔmʋŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛrɛ La TƖƖNA bɩrɩmɛ ŋ sɩma nɛ koo? Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa leŋe La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ nɛ ŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: But not everything about you is bad. You destroyed the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah—that shows you have tried to obey the Lord. Jehoshaphat Appoints Judges To Settle Cases
translation_verse: Ama arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, ŋ ha ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ mʋa nɛ. Ŋ sɩ chei vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ŋ tʋɔŋ a to Wɩa.” Jehosafat lɩɩsɛ sarɩya diiree

english_verse: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, but he often traveled through his kingdom, from Beersheba in the south to the edge of the hill country of Ephraim in the north. He talked with the people and convinced them to turn back to the Lord God and worship him, just as their ancestors had done.
translation_verse: Jehosafat fa hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ, ama ʋ yie lɩɩ a gɔllɛ ʋ tinteeŋ kala, a chɩŋ Bɛɛsɩba lɛ a kaa mʋ yi Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩ ʋ nɩaa dɩ ba bɩrɩmɛ a tuto La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa.

english_verse: He assigned judges to each of the fortified cities in Judah
translation_verse: Ʋ fa lɩɩsɛ sarɩya diiree nɛ Juda tinteeŋ tabala-la kala lɛ ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli.

english_verse: and told them: Be careful when you make your decisions in court, because you are judging by the Lord's standards and not by human standards, and he will know what you decide.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a didii nɩaa sarɩya, bɛɛ wɩaa nuhuobiinee doluŋ dee ma kaa dii sarɩya-la, ama La TƖƖNA doluŋ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ bʋa na-kala dɩ ma nɩɩ dii sarɩya.

english_verse: So do your work in honor of him and know that he won't allow you to be unfair to anyone or to take bribes.
translation_verse: Má fá La TƖƖNA, a fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a didii sarɩya. La TƖƖNA Wɩa bɩ chɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ bɩrɩmɛ, ʋ bɩ chɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ nɩaa kaa pɔrɛ koo a lɩlaa kpalaa nɩaa teeŋ.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat also chose some Levites, some priests, and some of the family leaders, and he appointed them to serve as judges in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm ma lɛ, Jehosafat fa lɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ dɩ ba dɩdagɛ La TƖƖNA wombiiŋ dɩ ba tuto, dɩ nɩaa nɛ kɛŋ kaalɛrɛ ma, dɩ ba bʋla wasɛ.

english_verse: The people of Judah will bring you legal cases that involve every type of crime, including murder. You must settle these cases and warn the people to stop sinning against the Lord, so that he won't get angry and punish Judah. Remember, if you follow these instructions, you won't be held responsible for anything that happens.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma taŋ nɩaa kʋŋ nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩkala kɔ ma teeŋ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ba kpʋ, koo wɩɩ-la tɩgɛ Wɩa wombiiŋ ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto lɛ nɛ koo wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga lɛ nɛ koo Wɩa niiriŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ma bʋl wɩaa chagɩlɛba dɩ ba sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ baanɩŋ jaŋ sii ma dɩ ma naambiiriŋ nyuŋ. Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ a sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Amariah the high priest will have the final say in any religious case. And Zebadiah, the leader of the Judah tribe, will have the final say in all other cases. The rest of the Levites will serve as your assistants. Be brave, and I pray that the Lord will help you do right.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ Amarɩa nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ma nɩhɩaŋ wɩɩ na-kala sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ. Ka dɩ Ɩsɩmɛl nanʋala Zebadia sɩ ŋaa Juda doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara ma nɛ ŋaa ma nɩhɩaŋ wɩɩ na-kala sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ kuoro lɛ. Levi doho nɩaa ma nɛ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ chɩŋ. Má kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ a tɩŋ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa, La TƖƖNA jaŋ chɩŋ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa woruŋ harɩŋ.”

english_verse: Messengers told Jehoshaphat, “A large army from Edom east of the Dead Sea has invaded our country. They have already reached En-Gedi.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa kʋ bʋla pɩ kuoro Jehosafat, “Laalɩyuori-daŋ nɛ lɩɩ Ɛdɔm a to mʋgʋ-balɩŋ sɛmɛ kʋkɔ dɩ ba yuoŋ. Ba paala hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hazazɔŋ Tama lɛ.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat was afraid, so he asked the Lord what to do. He then told the people of Judah to go without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ Jehosafat, ʋ pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ na wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa, aŋ heele bʋla pɩ Juda tinteeŋ nɩaa kala ba vɔɔ niiŋ.

english_verse: They immediately left for Jerusalem to ask for the Lord's help.
translation_verse: Juda nɩaa lɩɩ ba tasɩŋ kala a kʋ hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ dɩ ba sʋl La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: After everyone from Judah and Jerusalem had come together at the Lord's temple, Jehoshaphat stood in front of the new courtyard
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehosafat sii chɩŋ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kʋ hilimi La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la kaalɩ-falɩɩ-la sɩpaaŋ,

english_verse: and prayed: You, Lord, are the God our ancestors worshiped, and from heaven you rule every nation in the world. You are so powerful that no one can defeat you.
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl, “La TƖƖNA, la naabalɩmaba Wɩa, ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋ nɩɩ beŋ tinteyee kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Doluŋ kala hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ ŋ sɩpaaŋ wuo chɩŋ.

english_verse: Our God, you forced out the nations who lived in this land before your people Israel came here, and you gave it to the descendants of your friend Abraham forever.
translation_verse: La Wɩa, ŋ nɛ kiri tinteye-la nɩaa fa sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ ta ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaaŋ, aŋ joŋo pɩ ŋ nandɔŋɔ Abɩraham doho nɩaa dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Our ancestors lived in this land and built a temple to honor you.
translation_verse: Ba hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ nɛ a saa ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩ ba ziziliŋ nɩmɛ, aŋ bʋl,

english_verse: They believed that whenever this land is struck by war or disease or famine, your people can pray to you at the temple, and you will hear their prayer and save them.
translation_verse: ‘Dɩ wʋbɔŋ kala nɛ kʋ jʋʋla, dɩ laalɩŋ nɛ koo dɩ nyanyal-bɔŋ nɛ koo dɩ losuŋ nɛ, la jaŋ kɔ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ lɛ ba sɩɩ ziliŋ a chɩŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ a yel la hɛɛŋ pɩŋ dɩ ŋ nɩɩ a laala ta.’

english_verse: You can see that the armies of Ammon, Moab, and Edom are attacking us! Those are the nations you would not let our ancestors invade on their way from Egypt, so these nations were not destroyed.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa, Mʋab tɩŋŋaa arɩ Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa kʋʋ yuola nɛ. Ba tinteeŋ nɛ ŋ fa bʋla pɩ la naabalɩmaba dɩ ba sɩ́ jʋʋ ŋɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kieliba bal, ba bɩ ba cheye.

english_verse: Aren't you going to punish them? We won't stand a chance when this army attacks. We don't know what to do—we are begging for your help.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ la Wɩa, dɔgɩsɛba, bɛɛ wɩaa la bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ la yuo laalɩyuori-daŋ deeŋ sɩ kʋʋ yuola. La-na bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa, ama laa beŋ ŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ ŋ pɛ la lɛ.”

english_verse: While every man, woman, and child of Judah was standing there at the temple,
translation_verse: Juda tɩŋŋaa baalaa arɩ ba haalaa arɩ ba biiriŋ kala fa chɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Then Jahaziel said: Your Majesty and everyone from Judah and Jerusalem, the Lord says that you don't need to be afraid or let this powerful army discourage you. God will fight on your side!
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl, “Kuoro Jehosafat arɩ ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ, má jegili, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩma nɛ ŋ-la, ‘Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma bɔyɛ joŋ koo dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ a tɩŋ laalɩyuori-daŋ-la wɩaa. Ma dee bɩ jaŋ yuo laal-la, ama Wɩa nɛ jaŋ yuo.

english_verse: So here's what you must do. Tomorrow the enemy armies will march through the desert around the town of Jeruel. March down and meet them at the town of Ziz as they come up the valley.
translation_verse: Má chie lɩɩ tuu cheme yuoba. Ba jaŋ to Zɩs wombii-bie-la sɩ hɛ peelee tʋɔŋ a kʋʋ jɩl. Ma jaŋ naba fuonaa-la sɩ hɛ Jɛrʋɛl tintee-hɩlɩŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: You won't even have to fight. Just take your positions and watch the Lord rescue you from your enemy. Don't be afraid. Just do as you're told. And as you march out tomorrow, the Lord will be there with you.
translation_verse: Ma dee bɩ jaŋ yuo laal-la, ma-na chɩŋ ma dɩchɩnaa, a gbɛrɛ na ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ laama ta. Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm tɩmma, má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ. Má chie lɩɩ cheme yuoba, La TƖƖNA jaŋ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ.’ ”

english_verse: Then some Levites from the Kohath and Korah clans stood up and shouted praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ Kohaf arɩ Kora nyɩŋ-nɩaa tʋɔŋ sii chɩŋ a faasa ŋaa goŋ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa.

english_verse: Early the next morning, as everyone got ready to leave for the desert near Tekoa, Jehoshaphat stood up and said, “Listen my friends, if we trust the Lord God and believe what these prophets have told us, the Lord will help us, and we will be successful.”
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla nɩalɩŋ sii mʋ Tɛkʋa tintee-hɩlɩŋ. Ba sɩ lɩa dɩ ba mʋ, Jehosafat sii chɩŋ aŋ bʋl, “Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm tɩmma, má jegili mɩ teeŋ, má laa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa dii, ʋ jaŋ chagɛma kɩɩ. Má laa wɩalɩŋ ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ bʋla dii dɩ ma wɩaa wasɛ.”

english_verse: Then he explained his plan and appointed men to march in front of the army and praise the Lord for his holy power by singing: “Praise the Lord! His love never ends.”
translation_verse: Jehosafat sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ teeŋ dɛrɛ, ʋ lɩɩsɛ nɩaa dɩ ba laa laalɩyuoro-la sɩpaaŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a pɩ La TƖƖNA, a dɛnnʋ a tɩŋ ʋ tʋla arɩ zɔmʋŋ wɩaa a bʋl, “Má lɔllɛ La TƖƖNA, ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: so that the Ammonite and Moabite troops attacked and completely destroyed those from Edom. Then they turned against each other and fought until the entire camp was wiped out!
translation_verse: Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa arɩ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa mɩɩra gʋra yuo Ɛdɔm laalɩyuoroo a kpʋ ba kala. Ba sɩ kpʋ Ɛdɔm nɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ, ba ma tɩtɩa gʋra kpʋ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: When Judah's army reached the tower that overlooked the desert, they saw that every soldier in the enemy's army was lying dead on the ground.
translation_verse: Juda nɩaa sɩ kʋ yi lee-la ba sɩ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ aŋ bibeŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la, ba na dɩ ba dʋndɔmɔ-la kala sʋba a pɩŋ, nɩbala ma bɩ foro fa.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day, everyone came together in Beracah Valley and sang praises to the Lord. That's why that place was called Praise Valley.
translation_verse: Tapʋl nɛsɛ chɛɛŋ ba hilimi fuonaa kʋbala lɛ baa yɩrɛ Bɛraka a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛŋ fuonaa-la yɩyɩrɛ Bɛraka arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: When the other nations heard how the Lord had fought against Judah's enemies, they were too afraid
translation_verse: Tinteye-la kala sɩ golliba a nɩɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa sɩ yuo dii Iziral tɩŋŋaa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba a tɩŋ Wɩa wɩaa.

english_verse: to invade Judah. The Lord let Jehoshaphat's kingdom be at peace. Jehoshaphat Dies (
translation_verse: Jehosafat fa sɩɩ beŋ lee-la kala fɩɛla pɩŋ sɔm, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa pʋ wiese nɛ sɛmɛ kala. Jehosafat kuoruŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ

english_verse: While Jehoshaphat was king, he signed a peace treaty with Ahaziah the wicked king of Israel.
translation_verse: Harɩŋ nɛ, Juda kuoro Jehosafat kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa mʋ mɛrɛ Iziral kuoro Ahazɩa lɛ. Ahazɩa fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: but he did not destroy the local shrines. So the people still worshiped foreign gods, instead of faithfully serving the God their ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ fa bɩ vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa cheye, nɩalɩŋ fa ha bɩ ba tʋɔŋ kala joŋo hɛ ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoshaphat did while he was king is written in the records of Jehu son of Hanani that are included in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Jehosafat sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, a chɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Hanani nanʋala Jehu teniŋ tʋɔŋ a hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoram became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehosafat sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi Devit tabal-la lɛ ʋ naabalɩmaba tʋɔŋ. Ka ʋ nanʋala Jehoram dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: King Jehoshaphat had seven sons: Jehoram, Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah.
translation_verse: Jehoram fa kɛŋ naambiiriŋ nɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ: Azarɩa, Jɛhɩɛl, Zɛkarɩya, Azarɩahu, Maakɩl arɩ Sɛfatɩa. Ba kala fa ŋaa kuoro Jehosafat hambolibiisiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: years from Jerusalem. He died, and no one even felt sad. He was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs.
translation_verse: Jehoram kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ, Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa fa vɩa dɩ ba to Juda tinteeŋ kuoro nɛ, aŋ ma bil ba kuoro.

english_verse: The Lord later caused the Philistines and the Arabs who lived near the Ethiopians to become angry with Jehoram.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA yigi Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa arɩ Arab tɩmma-la sɩ hɔnɔ kpagɛ Kus tɩŋŋaa a hɛ Jehoram lɛ.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat gave each of them silver and gold, as well as other valuable gifts. He also put them in charge of the fortified cities in Judah, but he had chosen his oldest son Jehoram to succeed him as king.
translation_verse: Ba nyɩmma joŋ kʋ-daŋ nɛ pɩba, hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ yuŋuŋ, a pɛ Juda tinteeŋ tasɩ-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli lɛ. Ama ʋ fa lɩɩsɛ ʋ bii-hɩaŋ Jehoram nɛ ʋ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. Jehoram dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ

english_verse: After Jehoram had taken control of Judah, he had his brothers killed, as well as some of the nation's leaders.
translation_verse: Jehoram sɩ dii ʋ nyɩmma kuorii-la ʋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ a kɛŋ doluŋ, ʋ kpʋ ʋ naambiiri-la kala a pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa dɔnsʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Jehoram married Ahab's daughter and followed the sinful example of Ahab's family and the other kings of Israel. He disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong,
translation_verse: Jehoram fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa Iziral kuoroo sɩ ŋaa nɛ a jaa Ahab tolo. Ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa Ahab dɩa nɩaa fa sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: but because the Lord had made a solemn promise to King David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah, he refused to wipe out David's descendants.
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA fa tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩnna Devit wɩaa nɛ a bɩ Juda tinteeŋ cheye, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa hɛ niiŋ nɛ ʋ dɩ Devit pɛgɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ didii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: but Judah was never able to regain control of Edom. Even the town of Libnah rebelled at that time. Those things happened because Jehoram had turned away from the Lord, the God his ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa ha vɩa dɩ ba to Juda nɩaa nɛ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lɩbɩna nɩaa ma vɩa dɩ ba to Juda kuoro Jehoram a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa.

english_verse: Jehoram even built local shrines in the hills of Judah and let the people sin against the Lord by worshiping foreign gods.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa saa vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa nɛ Juda dundolluŋ nyuŋ a leŋ Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda nɩaa kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa a yeŋŋi.

english_verse: One day, Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet that said: I have a message for you from the Lord God your ancestor David worshiped. He knows that you have not followed the example of Jehoshaphat your father or Asa your grandfather.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Ɩlaaja ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ Jehoram. Teŋ-la tʋɔŋ ʋ sɩ, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA, ŋ nyɩmma Devit Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la, ‘Ŋ bɩ ŋ nyɩmma Jehosafat koo ŋ naabalɩma Juda kuoro Asa naabʋɔsʋŋ to.

english_verse: Instead you have acted like those sinful kings of Israel and have encouraged the people of Judah to stop worshiping the Lord, just as Ahab and his descendants did. You even murdered your own brothers, who were better men than you.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ mɩɩra to Iziral kuoroo naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ, a leŋ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa a nagɛ Ahab arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ŋ paala kpʋ ŋ naambiiriŋ nɛ, ŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛ nyɩmma, nɩalɩŋ sɩ paala kpɩaŋ.

english_verse: Because you have done these terrible things, the Lord will severely punish the people in your kingdom, including your own family, and he will destroy everything you own.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa, La TƖƖNA ka chɛ dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛ ŋ nɩaa, ŋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ŋ haalaa nɛ, a chei ŋ dʋa kala.

english_verse: You will be struck with a painful stomach disease and suffer until you die.
translation_verse: Luoruŋ nyanyal-bɔŋ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa a dɔgʋsʋŋ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ dɩ ŋ luobiee lɩɩ.’ ”

english_verse: They invaded Judah and stole the royal property from the palace, and they led Jehoram's wives and sons away as prisoners. The only one left behind was Ahaziah, his youngest son.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ yuo Juda tinteeŋ a paa kʋzɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ kuoru dɩa lɛ, aŋ kɛsɛ Jehoram hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ haalaa kaa viiri. Ʋ nanʋa-bie Ahazɩa dʋndʋŋ nɛ fa ka.

english_verse: After this happened, the Lord struck Jehoram with an incurable stomach disease.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba harɩŋ, La TƖƖNA joŋ luoruŋ nyanyal-bɔŋ ba sɩ bɩ wuo tɩɩbɛ a hɛ Jehoram lɛ.

english_verse: About two years later, Jehoram died in terrible pain. No bonfire was built to honor him, even though the people had done this for his ancestors.
translation_verse: Jɩ-lɩa tʋɔŋ bʋa kʋbala lɛ, ʋ luobiee kʋ lɩɩ. A tɩŋ nyanyalɩɩ-la wɩaa, ʋ na hɛɛŋ woruŋ a sʋʋ. Ʋ nɩaa fa bɩ yoho nyiŋ-balɩŋ hɛ zilu a yel ʋ yoho arɩ ba fa sɩ hɛ ŋɩɩ a pɩ ʋ naabalɩmaba.

english_verse: and while Jehu was doing that, he saw some of Judah's leaders and Ahaziah's nephews who had come with Ahaziah. Jehu killed them on the spot,
translation_verse: Jehu fa sɩɩ kpʋ Ahab dɩa nɩaa arɩ Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ na Juda nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Ahazɩa malɩma biiriŋ sɩ to ʋ harɩŋ kɔ, Jehu kpʋ ba kala.

english_verse: then gave orders to find Ahaziah. Jehu's officers found him hiding in Samaria. They brought Ahaziah to Jehu, who immediately put him to death. They buried Ahaziah only because they respected Jehoshaphat his grandfather, who had done his best to obey the Lord. There was no one from Ahaziah's family left to become king of Judah. Queen Athaliah of Judah (
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ lɛɛlɛ gɔllɔ chɩchɛ Ahazɩa, Jehu nɩaa chɛ mʋ naʋ dɩ ʋ faa Samarɩa lɛ, ba kɛŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛnʋ kʋ pɩ Jehu ʋ kpʋʋ. Ba joŋu hugi aŋ bʋl, “Ʋ ŋaa Jehosafat, nɩɩ-la fa sɩ to La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala nihii nɛ.” Nʋʋkala fa bɩra tuo Ahazɩa dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ a bemba. Atalɩa dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ

english_verse: In fact, after his father's death, Ahaziah sinned against the Lord by appointing some of Ahab's relatives to be his advisors. Their advice led to his downfall.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ arɩ Ahab dɩa nɩaa fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nyɩmma sʋʋŋ harɩŋ, ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ leŋe ʋ tel.

english_verse: He listened to them and went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: Ahazɩa fa to nɩalɩŋ niiŋ nɛ a to Ahab nanʋala Joram harɩŋ a mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ramɔf Gɩlɩad dɩ ba yuo Siiria tɩŋŋaa kuoro Hazɛɛl. Nɩmɛ nɛ Siiria tɩŋŋaa bolimi Joram.

english_verse: and he went to the town of Jezreel to recover. And Ahaziah later went there to visit him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mɩɩra mʋ ʋ jaŋ Jɛzɩrɛl dɩ ʋ vaarɛ ʋ tɩtɩa. Jehoram nanʋala Ahazɩa sɩ ŋaa Juda kuoro mʋ nɩmɛ dɩ ʋ na ʋ nyanyalaa.

english_verse: It was during that visit that God had Ahaziah put to death. When Ahaziah arrived at Jezreel, he and Joram went to meet with Jehu grandson of Nimshi. The Lord had already told Jehu to kill every male in Ahab's family,
translation_verse: Ahazɩa sɩ mʋ na Joram nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa leŋ ʋ tel. Ahazɩa sɩ mʋa, ʋ dɩ Joram lɩɩ dɩ ba na Nimisi nanʋala Jehu, nɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ʋ chei Ahab dɩa.

english_verse: but Jehosheba rescued Joash son of Ahaziah just as the others were about to be murdered. Jehosheba, who was Jehoram's daughter and Ahaziah's half sister, was married to Jehoiada the priest. So she was able to hide her nephew Joash and his personal servant in a bedroom in the Lord's temple where he was safe from Athaliah.
translation_verse: Ama kuoro Jehoram tolo Jehoseba sɩ ŋaa Ahazɩa dɩhaala lʋara kɛŋ kuoro Ahazɩa hambolibiisi-la ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋ tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ a faa. Bile yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Jʋas. Ʋ fa kɛŋ ʋ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ benu nɛ a kaa jʋʋ faa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩɩ-pɩnɩŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Jehoseba fa ŋaa Jehoram tolo nɛ, a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Jehoyada ma haala, aŋ ŋaa Ahazɩa dɩhaala, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kɛŋ bile faa, Atalɩa bɩ wuo kpʋʋ.

english_verse: As soon as Athaliah heard that her son King Ahaziah was dead, she decided to kill any relative who could possibly become king. She would have done just that,
translation_verse: Ahazɩa naaŋ Atalɩa sɩ kʋ jɩŋ arɩ ʋ nanʋala Ahazɩa sɩ ŋaa Juda kuoro sʋba nɛ, ʋ wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋ nʋʋkala sɩ jaŋ wuo dii kuorii-la ba dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with them for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah.
translation_verse: Jʋas fa faa ba teeŋ nɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ ŋɩɩ jɩsɩŋ balɩdʋ, ka Ahazɩa naaŋ Atalɩa dii kuoruŋ a bibeŋ Juda tinteeŋ.

english_verse: These five men went to the towns in Judah and called together the Levites and the clan leaders. They all came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ba gɔllɛ Juda tinteeŋ tasɩŋ kala a yɩrɛ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ba kala kɔ Jerusalɛm,

english_verse: Jehoiada and his sons brought Joash outside, where they placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of the instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, and the crowd cheered and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehoyada arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kɛŋ Ahazɩa nanʋala Jʋas kʋ lɩɩ a joŋ kuoru nyunchuulo chuu, aŋ joŋ teniŋ pʋ. Teŋ-la lɛ nɛ ba ŋmʋnsɛ wombie-la kuoroo sɩ maga dɩ ba to a bibeŋ tintee-la hɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ nʋʋŋ tɩsʋ a dagɛ arɩ ʋ nɛ lɛɛlɛ ŋaa kuoro. Nɩalɩŋ kala ŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “A leŋ dɩ kuoro mɩɩsɩŋ duomi.”

english_verse: Here is what we will do. Three groups of priests and Levites will be on guard duty on the Sabbath—one group will guard the gates of the temple,
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa bugoo batori jaŋ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Buguŋ dɔŋɔ jaŋ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ-niiree,

english_verse: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ jʋjʋɔsɛ. Jerusalɛm kala lɛɛlɛ fɩɛla pɩŋ sɔm, a tɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋ Atalɩa wɩaa.

english_verse: After Ahaziah's son Joash had hidden in the temple for six years, Jehoiada the priest knew that something had to be done. So he made sure he had the support of several army officers. They were Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
translation_verse: Ʋ jɩ-pɛɩ lɛ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Jehoyada bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ maga ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ ʋ dɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ deemba sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba bil niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ: Jeroham nanʋala Azarɩa, Jehohanaŋ nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl, Ɔbɛd nanʋala Azarɩa, Adaaya nanʋala Maasɛya arɩ Zikiri nanʋala Ɛlɩsafat.

english_verse: and gathered at the temple, where they agreed to help Joash. Jehoiada said to them: Joash will be our next king, because long ago the Lord promised that one of David's descendants would always be king.
translation_verse: a hilimi Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ba dɩ kuoro nanʋala Jʋas bil niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ. Jehoyada bʋla pɩba, “Kuoro nanʋala Jʋas nɛ maga dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ arɩ Devit doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ didii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: one will guard the palace, and the other will guard Foundation Gate. The rest of you will stand guard in the temple courtyards.
translation_verse: dɩ dɔŋɔ ma pɔ kuoro dɩa, dɩ dɔŋɔ ma pɔ boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gentine Boi-baalɩŋ, ka dɩ nɩkaanaa ma hɛ La Tɩɩna dɩɩ-bal-la kaalɩsɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Only the priests and Levites who are on duty will be able to enter the temple, because they will be the only ones who have gone through the ceremony to make themselves clean and acceptable. The others must stay outside in the courtyards, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, see Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa sɩ hɛ tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ. Ba-na jaŋ wuo jʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta nɛ. Ama nɩkaana-la maga dɩ ba sɛɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ daga nɛ a hɛ kaala tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You Levites must protect King Joash. Don't let him out of your sight! And keep your swords ready to kill anyone who comes into the temple.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa maga dɩ ba chɩna golli kuoro nɛ a pɔʋ, a kori ba laalɩyuori kɩaa. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɛ. Má kpagɛ kuoro lee na-kala ʋ sɩɩ mʋ.”

english_verse: The Levites and the people of Judah followed Jehoiada's orders. The guards going off duty were not allowed to go home, and so each commander had all his guards available—those going off duty as well as those coming on duty.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ Juda nɩaa ŋaa ŋɩɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Jehoyada sɩ dagɛba. Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la leŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba mʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ maga dɩ ba wiesi, ba kala mʋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Jehoyada bɩ leŋe ba kʋŋkala viiri.

english_verse: Jehoiada went into the temple and brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David, and he gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ paa kuoro Devit tiŋŋee arɩ hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoro sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori-hɛŋŋɛɛ kʋbalaa arɩ kʋbiisiŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ a pɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba.

english_verse: They gave the weapons to the guards, and Jehoiada then made sure that the guards took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect the king on every side.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋ baala-la kala sɩɩ pɔ lee-la kori ba laalɩyuori kɩaa a chɩna golli kuoro a kpagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a pɔ kuoro Jʋas, a chɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: As soon as Queen Athaliah heard the crowd cheering for Joash, she went to the temple.
translation_verse: Atalɩa sɩ nɩa dɩ nɩalɩŋ gɔllɔ fá a ŋaa goŋ a nyɩnyaasɛ kuoro nyuŋ, ʋ sii mʋ ba teeŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns near the entrance, which was the usual place for the king. The commanders and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the musicians were playing instruments and leading the people as they celebrated and blew trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bene, ʋ na kuoro Jʋas dɩ ʋ chɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiŋ a kpagɛ jebiiŋ, ka laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ chɩŋ ʋ sɛmɛ. Tintee-la nɩaa kala jʋjʋɔsɛ aŋ ŋmʋŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ du kɩaa nɛ fa kɛŋ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa ba gbigbieli. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Atalɩa tʋɔŋ chei, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ aŋ ŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “Ma ŋaamɛ zɛmbɛ, ma ŋaamɛ zɛmbɛ.”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Don't kill her near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops, and be sure to kill all of her followers!”
translation_verse: Jehoyada bɩra bʋla pɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba, “Má kɛŋ Atalɩa pɩɛga to nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ tʋɔŋ kʋ lɩɩ, má kpʋ nʋʋkala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ laaʋ ta, ama má sɩ́ Atalɩa kpʋ a kpagɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lee-kala.”

english_verse: She tried to escape, but the commanders caught and killed her near the gate where horses are led into the palace.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛnʋ, dɩ ʋ yi boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Janɩŋ Boi-baalɩŋ a kpagɛ kuoru dɩa, a kpʋʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiada asked King Joash and the people to join with him in being faithful to the Lord. They agreed,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Jehoyada, kuoro Jʋas arɩ nɩalɩŋ hɛ niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ arɩ ba jaŋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA nɩaa.

english_verse: then rushed to the temple of the god Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and the idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala mʋ ŋmoo Baal vene-la dɩa-la lo a yɛrɛ ʋ korunuŋ kala, a ŋmoo tɔmɔ-la kala yɛrɛ muno muno, aŋ kpʋ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ kpaarɛ Baal baa yɩrɛ Mataŋ korunu-la sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Jehoiada assigned the priests and Levites their duties at the temple, just as David had done. They were in charge of offering sacrifices to the Lord according to the Law of Moses, and they were responsible for leading the celebrations with singing.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehoyada joŋ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa hɛ dɩ ba nɛ tɩtɩŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. Ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ kuoro Devit fa sɩ joŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la pa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. Ba nɛ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩpɩ La TƖƖNA arɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ ba tuto sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a jʋjʋɔsɛ arɩ Devit fa sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jehoiada ordered the guards at the temple gates to keep out anyone who was unclean.
translation_verse: Jehoyada fa bɩra leŋe nɩaa pɔ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiree nɛ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ sɩ wuo jʋʋ.

english_verse: Finally, Jehoiada called together the army commanders, the most important citizens of Judah, and the government officials. The crowd of people followed them as they led Joash from the temple, through the Upper Gate, and into the palace, where he took his place as king of Judah.
translation_verse: Ka ʋ kɛŋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba arɩ nɩbalaa, sɩpaalaaraa arɩ tintee-la nɩaa kala, ba kɛŋ kuoro Jʋas a lɩɩ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, a to boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nyuŋ Boi-baalɩŋ a jʋʋ kuoru dɩa, a hollu ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ.

english_verse: While Jehoiada the priest was alive, Joash obeyed the Lord by doing right.
translation_verse: Jʋas fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ nɛ, Jehoyada sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa kala lɛ.

english_verse: Joash and Jehoiada turned the money over to the men who were supervising the repairs to the temple. They used the money to hire stonecutters, carpenters, and experts in working with iron and bronze.
translation_verse: Kuoro arɩ Jehoyada joŋ moribie-la pɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ lɩɩsa ba bibeŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ wasɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la. Ba laa, a chɛ dɩɩ-saaraa, kapɩntaba, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ hɔɔŋ arɩ kɔlɩɩŋ tɩtɩŋ dɩ ba wasɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la.

english_verse: and he was buried in the royal tombs in Jerusalem, because he had done so much good for the people of Israel, for God, and for the temple. Joash Turns Away from the Lord
translation_verse: Ba joŋu hugi kuoroo dɩ-huguŋ Devit tabal-la lɛ, a tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-zɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩ tɩma pɩ Wɩa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. Wʋbɔmɔ-la Jʋas sɩ ŋaa

english_verse: And now we need it to repair the temple because the sons of that evil woman Athaliah came in and wrecked it. They even used some of the sacred objects to worship the god Baal.”
translation_verse: Atalɩa, ha-bɔŋ-la hambolibiisiŋ fa boro jʋʋ paa kʋzɔmɔ-la ba sɩ joŋo hɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɔnsʋŋ nɛ a kaa kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal.

english_verse: Jehoiada even chose two women for Joash to marry so he could have a family.
translation_verse: Jehoyada fa jaa haalaa balɩa nɛ pʋ, ʋ kaa lʋl hambolibiisiŋ arɩ hantolibiisiŋ.

english_verse: Some time later, Joash decided it was time to repair the temple.
translation_verse: Harɩŋ bʋa-kʋbala lɛ Jʋas kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ wasɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la.

english_verse: He called together the priests and Levites and said, “Go everywhere in Judah and collect the annual tax from the people. I want this done at once—we need that money to repair the temple.” But the Levites were in no hurry to follow the king's orders.
translation_verse: Ʋ yɩrɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa a bʋla pɩba, “Má mʋ Juda tasɩŋ kala a laa moribie-la ba sɩ vɛnɛ titiŋ jɩna kala ba kaa wasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ lɩma.” Ama Levi doho nɩalɩŋ bɩ moribie-la lɩma laa.

english_verse: So he sent for Jehoiada the high priest and asked, “Why didn't you send the Levites to collect the taxes? The Lord's servant Moses and the people agreed long ago that this tax would be collected and used to pay for the upkeep of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa Jʋas yɩrɛ Jehoyada, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ ha bɩ leŋe Levi doho nɩaa laa moribie-la Juda nɩaa arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa sɩ yie vɛnɛɛ tiŋ? Moribie-la La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnna Mosis arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ sɛyɛ arɩ ba jaŋ titiŋ dɩ ba kaa wʋwasɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ.”

english_verse: Joash gave orders for a wooden box to be made and had it placed outside, near the gate of the temple.
translation_verse: Kuoro leŋ ba ŋaa dagɩ-bie a joŋo bil La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiŋ jeeŋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: He then sent letters everywhere in Judah and Jerusalem, asking everyone to bring their taxes to the temple, just as Moses had required their ancestors to do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba heele bʋla pɩ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa dɩ nʋʋkala kʋ tiŋ lampoo-la a pɩ La TƖƖNA, kʋ-la Wɩa tɩntɩnna Mosis fa sɩ leŋe Iziral tɩŋŋaa tiŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The people and their leaders agreed, and they brought their money to Jerusalem and placed it in the box.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ arɩ ba sɩpaalaaraa kala tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, ba kɛŋ moribie-la kaa kʋ hɛ dagɩ-bie-la tʋɔŋ ʋ su.

english_verse: Each day, after the Levites took the box into the temple, the king's secretary and the high priest's assistant would dump out the money and count it. Then the empty box would be taken back outside. This happened day after day, and soon a large amount of money was collected.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ Levi doho nɩaa nɛ joŋ daga-la a kaa mʋ kuoro tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ teeŋ, dɩ ba na dɩ moribiee suo, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ kuoro teniŋ arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ yie chaarɛ nɛ, aŋ leŋ ba kaa mɩɩra mʋ bil ʋ dɩ-biliŋ. Ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ bʋa na-kala a laa moribiee yʋgɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: These workers went right to work repairing the temple, and when they were finished, it looked as good as new.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ beŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ tɩŋ woruŋ, ba wasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la ʋ bɩra nagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ fa sɩ naga nɛ, a kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: They did not use all the tax money for the repairs, so the rest of it was handed over to Joash and Jehoiada, who then used it to make dishes and other gold and silver objects for the temple. Sacrifices to please the Lord were offered regularly in the temple for as long as Jehoiada lived.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ wasɛ dɩa-la dɛrɛ, ba kɛŋ moribii kaanaa kʋ pɩ kuoro arɩ Jehoyada. Ba kaa ŋaa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa, tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, hɛntɛrɛɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla ŋaa. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ Jehoyada mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, baa ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ bʋa na-kala La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ.

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the leaders of Judah went to Joash and talked him into doing what they wanted.
translation_verse: Jehoyada sʋʋŋ harɩŋ, Juda nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa sii kɔ kuoro Jʋas teeŋ a zilu, ʋ leŋ ba ŋaa wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: The people of Judah soon stopped worshiping in the temple of the Lord God and started worshiping idols and the symbols of the goddess Asherah. These sinful things made the Lord God angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Ba vɩa La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la ta nɛ, aŋ mɩɩra kpʋkpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ arɩ tɔŋŋɔɔ. Ba wʋbɔmɔ-la leŋ Wɩa na baanɩŋ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa nyuŋ.

english_verse: but he still sent prophets who warned them to turn back to him. The people refused to listen.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tɩŋ ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa dɩ ba kpʋrɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ dɩgɩlaa dɩ ba mɩɩra kɔ ʋ teeŋ, ama ba vɩa dɩ ba nɩɩ.

english_verse: God's Spirit spoke to Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, and Zechariah told everyone that God was saying: “Why are you disobeying me and my laws? This will only bring punishment! You have deserted me, so now I will desert you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩma kʋ jʋʋ Zɛkarɩya sɩ ŋaa Jehoyada, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nanʋala. Ʋ chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma vɩa wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ daga? Wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩma. Ma sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA ŋɩɩ, ʋ ma vɩama nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: King Joash forgot that Zechariah's father had always been a loyal friend. So when the people of Judah plotted to kill Zechariah, Joash joined them and gave orders for them to stone him to death in the courtyard of the temple. As Zechariah was dying, he said, “I pray that the Lord will see this and punish all of you.” Joash Is Killed
translation_verse: Kuoro Jʋas fa bɩ wʋzɔmɔ-la Zɛkarɩya nyɩmma Jehoyada fa sɩ ŋaa ʋ lɛ liise aŋ kpʋ ʋ nanʋala. Zɛkarɩya fa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ sʋʋ, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl, “A leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA na wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa a dɔgʋsʋŋ.”

english_verse: In the spring of the following year, the Syrian army invaded Judah and Jerusalem, killing all of the nation's leaders. They collected everything of value that belonged to the people and took it back to their king in Damascus.
translation_verse: Jɩna dɩ-suomuŋ, Siiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo sii kʋ yuo dii kuoro Jʋas, a tɔ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa hɛ a kpʋ ba sɩpaalaaraa kala, aŋ paa ba dʋa kala kaa mʋ pɩ ba kuoro sɩ hɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ.

english_verse: The Syrian army was very small, but the Lord let them defeat Judah's large army, because he was punishing Joash and the people of Judah for turning away from him.
translation_verse: Siiria tɩmma-la laalɩyuoroo fa bɩ yʋgɛ, ka La TƖƖNA joŋ Juda tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori daŋ-la a hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a tɩŋ Juda nɩaa sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA to a dɔgɩsɛ Jʋas.

english_verse: The History of the Kings also tells more about the sons of Joash, what the prophets said about him, and how he repaired the temple. Amaziah son of Joash became king after his father's death.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ sɩ ŋaa arɩ wʋdaŋ-la kala Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ wasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ lɛ. Ʋ nanʋala Amazɩa nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: One of God's prophets said, “Your Majesty, don't let these Israelite soldiers march into battle with you. The Lord has refused to help anyone from the northern kingdom of Israel,
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ kʋbala kʋ bʋla pʋ, “Kuoro, sɩ́ Iziral laalɩyuoroo deemba kaa to ŋ harɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA bɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa harɩŋ chɩna, ʋ bɩ jaŋ pɛ Efirem tɩmma-la kʋŋkala lɛ.

english_verse: Amaziah replied, “What am I supposed to do about all the silver I paid those troops?” “The Lord will give you back even more than you paid,” the prophet answered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Amazɩa pɩɛsɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la, “Aŋ ka warɩpʋla-la mɩ sɩ joŋo tiŋ Iziral laalɩyuoro-la?” Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la bʋl, “La TƖƖNA jaŋ wuo pɩŋ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: After Amaziah got his courage back, he led his troops to Salt Valley, where he killed
translation_verse: Amazɩa nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo mʋ fuonaa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Yɩsɩŋ Fuonaaŋ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ kpʋ Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa bʋɩ fii.

english_verse: But before the prophet finished speaking, Amaziah interrupted and said, “You're not one of my advisors! Don't say another word, or I'll have you killed.” The prophet stopped. But then he added, “First you sinned and now you've ignored my warning. It's clear that God has decided to punish you!” Israel Defeats Judah (
translation_verse: Ʋ fa ha sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ, kuoro pɩɛsʋ, “La lɩɩsɩŋ nɛɛ dɩ ŋ chagɩlɛ kuoroo? Bɩra sɩ́ wɩɩ bʋl, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kpʋŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la leŋ, aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ jɩma arɩ Wɩa ŋaa siri nɛ dɩ ʋ cheyiŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba kala nɛ aŋ bɩra vɩa dɩ ŋ jegile nɩɩ mɩ sɩɩ chagɩlɩŋ.”

english_verse: King Amaziah of Judah talked with his officials, then sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”
translation_verse: Juda kuoro Amazɩa sɩ mʋ pɩɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chagɩlʋ wɩaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Jehuas sɩ ŋaa Jehuahas nanʋala aŋ ŋaa Jehu ma nihiŋ, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa baal, kʋ lɩɩ chemmi dɩ la yuo laalɩŋ.”

english_verse: Jehoash sent back a reply that said: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon arranged the marriage between his son and the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Jehuas mɩɩra tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋl ŋ-la pɩ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Amazɩa: “Sɔ-pugu-bie nɛ fa hɛ Lɛbanɔŋ tinteeŋ lɛ, a tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ kuolu tɩa ma sɩ hɛ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ, ‘Joŋ ŋ tolo pɩ mɩ nanʋala dɩ ʋ jaa.’ Ŋɩɩ nɛ baga kʋŋ ma fa sɩ hɛ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ kʋ nʋɔsɛ sɔ-pugu-bie-la a bʋrɩgɛ.

english_verse: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. But stay at home and do your celebrating. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Amazɩa, ŋ bɩɩna ŋ dolie nɛ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ yuo dii Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa a bibigisi ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ. Hɔŋ ŋ dɩa lɛ sɔm, sɩ́ wɩaa lɔgɔ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa arɩ Juda tinteeŋ nɩaa kala lɛ.”

english_verse: so Jehoash led his army to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral kuoro Jehuas arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kʋ yuo Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Amazɩa arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf Sɛmɛs sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: During the battle, Judah's army was crushed. Every soldier from Judah ran back home,
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa yuo dii Juda tɩŋŋaa, ba kala fá mʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ,

english_verse: and Jehoash captured Amaziah. Jehoash took Amaziah with him when he went to attack Jerusalem. Jehoash broke down the city wall from Ephraim Gate to Corner Gate, a section nearly
translation_verse: ka Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Jehuas sɩ ŋaa Jʋas nanʋala, a ŋaa Ahazɩa ma nihiŋ yuo kɛŋ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Amazɩa Bɛf Sɛmɛs lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehuas kɛnʋ kɔ Jerusalɛm a ŋmoo jebii-la ba sɩ saa golli Jerusalɛm lo, a chɩŋ Efirem Boi-baalɩŋ a kaa mʋ yi Je-gʋnʋŋ Boi-baalɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa arɩ naakieliŋ zɔɔ-balɩa.

english_verse: He carried away the gold, the silver, and all the valuable furnishings from God's temple where the descendants of Obed-Edom stood guard. He robbed the king's treasury, took hostages, then returned to Samaria. Amaziah Is Killed (
translation_verse: Jehuas paa sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, kɩalɩŋ Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm doho nɩaa fa sɩɩ beŋ, a paa kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ kuoru dɩa ma lɛ, a pɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yuo kɛsɛ lɛ, a kaa mɩɩra mʋ Samarɩa.

english_verse: Everything else Amaziah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Amazɩa sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, a chɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Juda tinteeŋ arɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: As soon as Amaziah started disobeying the Lord, some people in Jerusalem plotted against Amaziah. He was able to escape to the town of Lachish, but another group of people caught him and killed him there.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ Amazɩa sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA tonuŋ, nɩaa vʋʋrɛ a sii chɩŋ ʋ lɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ lɩɩ fá a mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lakɩs. Ama ba hɛ nɩaa ba kiri ʋ libe, a mʋ kpʋʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: His body was taken to Jerusalem on horseback and buried beside his ancestors.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ jaaba joŋ ʋ kʋsʋʋŋ a kaa mɩɩra kɔ, a hugu ʋ nyɩmmaba dɩ-huguŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: Uzziah supplied his army with shields, spears, helmets, armor, bows, and stones used for slinging.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Uzia chɛ laalɩyuori kɩaa deemba a pɩ laalɩyuoro-la kala: Hɔɔtaalɩ-la ba sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori-hɛŋŋɛɛ, tiŋŋee, nyuŋ-chugbaŋkogunuŋ, laalɩyuori-gɛnnɩŋ, tosuŋ arɩ kpalɩŋ tabɩaa.

english_verse: Uzziah had leprosy the rest of his life. He was no longer allowed in the temple or in his own palace. That's why his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.
translation_verse: Dayalɩbɩɩ-la fa hɛ Kuoro Uzia lɛ nɛ ʋ mɩɩ-kaanɩŋ kala lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩsʋ kuoru dɩa lɛ, ʋ jʋjʋʋ ʋ dʋndʋŋ dɩa, ʋ bɩra bɩ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la jʋa aŋ mʋ sʋʋ. Ka ʋ nanʋala Jotam laa ʋ nyuŋ a bibeŋ tintee-la.

english_verse: Everything else Uzziah did while he was king is in the records written by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Uzia sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, a chɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ba kala nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Azaaya sɩ ŋaa Amos nanʋala ŋmʋnsa bil.

english_verse: Some of his skilled workers invented machines that could shoot arrows and sling large stones. Uzziah set these up in Jerusalem at his defense towers and at the corners of the city wall. God helped Uzziah become more and more powerful, and he was famous all over the world. Uzziah Becomes Too Proud
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm lɛ ʋ leŋ gɔgɔɔ ŋaa kɩaa ba sɩ jaŋ kaa yuyuo to-hɛŋŋɛɛ arɩ tabɩɩ-balaa, ba chɩŋ jebii-duduosuŋ arɩ je-gʋnaa lɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ sii leriŋ kala, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA pɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: God helped him defeat the Philistines, the Arabs living in Gur-Baal, and the Meunites.
translation_verse: Wɩa pɛ ʋ lɛ ʋ yuo dii Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa arɩ Arab tɩmma-la fa sɩ hɔŋ Guu Baal lɛ, a kɛŋ Mewuni tɩŋŋaa pɛ.

english_verse: After the death of King Amaziah, the people of Judah crowned his son Uzziah king, even though he was only
translation_verse: Uzia fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ balɩdʋ nɛ aŋ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ balɩa. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Jekolia, a lɩɩ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Uzziah became proud of his power, and this led to his downfall. One day, Uzziah disobeyed the Lord his God by going into the temple and burning incense as an offering to him.
translation_verse: Uzia sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ joŋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa babiibal wɩɩ, ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ tel. Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala ʋ vɩa ʋ TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ aŋ sii jʋʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩ ʋ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ koru-la lɛ ba sɩɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: He obeyed the Lord by doing right, as his father Amaziah had done.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ nɛ, arɩ ʋ nyɩmma Amazɩa fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Zechariah was Uzziah's advisor and taught him to obey God. And so, as long as Zechariah was alive, Uzziah was faithful to God, and God made him successful.
translation_verse: Zɛkarɩya mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, Uzia fa to Wɩa nɛ woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ faa dagʋ. Ʋ sɩ to La TƖƖNA ŋɩɩ, Wɩa leŋ ʋ wɩɩkala vɛŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: While Uzziah was king, he started a war against the Philistines. He smashed the walls of the cities of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod, then rebuilt towns around Ashdod and in other parts of Philistia.
translation_verse: Uzia sii mʋ kɛŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa yuo laalɩŋ a ŋmoo tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gaf, Jabɩnɛ arɩ Asido jebiee kala lo. Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ wasa saa tasɩ-la sɩ kpagɛ Asido arɩ tasɩ-la sɩ hɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tinteeŋ sɛsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: Even the Ammonites paid taxes to Uzziah. He became very powerful, and people who lived as far away as Egypt heard about him.
translation_verse: Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa fa paala tiŋ lampoo a pɩpɩ Uzia nɛ, ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ sii leriŋ kala, a mʋ yi Ijipiti tinteeŋ.

english_verse: In Jerusalem, Uzziah built fortified towers at the Corner Gate, the Valley Gate, and the place where the city wall turned inward.
translation_verse: Uzia fa saa jebii-duduosuŋ hɛ Jerusalɛm boi-baalaa deemba lɛ nɛ: Je-gʋnʋŋ Boi-baalɩŋ, Fuonaaŋ Boi-baalɩŋ arɩ jebii-la loŋgoruŋ lɛ, a leŋ ba dol woruŋ.

english_verse: He also built defense towers out in the desert. He owned such a large herd of livestock in the western foothills and in the flatlands, that he had cisterns dug there to catch the rainwater. He loved farming, so he had crops and vineyards planted in the hill country wherever there was fertile soil, and he hired farmers to take care of them.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bɩra saa jebii-duduosuŋ nɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ a lu pɩlaa yʋgɛ nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ yʋgɛ nɛ dundolluŋ arɩ tintee-taalaa lɛ. Ʋ fa kɛŋ nɩaa ma nɛ ba tɩtɩŋ ʋ bagɩsɩŋ arɩ ʋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ lɛ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ nyuŋ arɩ tintee-taala sɩ zɔmɔ lɛ. Ʋ fa cho pɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: Uzziah's army was always ready for battle. Jeiel and Maaseiah were the officers who kept track of the number of soldiers, and these two men were under the command of Hananiah, one of Uzziah's officials.
translation_verse: Uzia fa kɛŋ laalɩyuoro-la sɩ chaasa gʋnnɛ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ nɛ woruŋ, a kɛŋ ba hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba mʋ laalɩŋ, arɩ Jɛyɛl nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba tenniŋ arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Maasɛya sɩ kɛmba kpaa bugoo. Kuoro dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hananaaya nɛ fa ŋaa Jɛyɛl arɩ Maasɛya kala nɩhɩaŋ, ʋ nɛ dagɛba ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: and said, “Your Majesty, this isn't right! You are not allowed to burn incense to the Lord. That must be done only by priests who are descendants of Aaron. You will have to leave! You have sinned against the Lord, and so he will no longer bless you.”
translation_verse: a mʋ ʋ teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ-na Uzia, ŋ bɩ wombii kɛnɛ dɩ ŋ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ ŋaa Arɔŋ doho nɩaa, ba sɩ joŋo hɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ nɛ. Lɩɩ Wɩa dɩa deeŋ tʋɔŋ. Ŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, La TƖƖNA Wɩa bɩra bɩ jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Uzziah, who was standing next to the incense altar at the time, was holding the incense burner, ready to offer incense to the Lord. He became very angry when he heard Azariah's warning, and leprosy suddenly appeared on his forehead!
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Uzia fa kori kʋ-la lɛ ba sɩ yie hɛ nyiniŋ a nyɩnyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a chɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la sɛmɛ a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA. Ʋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Azarɩa sɩ bʋla, ʋ na baanɩŋ a tʋtʋʋsɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa koru-la sɩpaaŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dayalɩmɩŋ guu yagɛ ʋ tile lɛ.

english_verse: Azariah and the other priests saw it and immediately told him to leave the temple. Uzziah realized that the Lord had punished him, so he hurried to get outside.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ Azarɩa arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ na dɩ dayalɩmɩŋ yagɛ ʋ tile lɛ ŋɩɩ, ba kiru ta ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. Uzia ma tɩtɩa fa cho dɩ ʋ lɩɩ lɩma nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA dɔgʋsʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Since Uzziah had leprosy, he could not be buried in the royal tombs. Instead, he was buried in a nearby cemetery that the kings owned. His son Jotham then became king.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Uzia sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi kuoroo ŋmaŋkaaŋ lɛ a kpagɛ kuoroo dɩ-huguŋ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ dayalɩmɩŋ wɩaa. Ka ʋ nanʋala Jotam dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Jotham obeyed the Lord and did right. He followed the example of his father Uzziah, except he never burned incense in the temple as his father had done. But the people of Judah kept sinning against the Lord.
translation_verse: Jotam fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ nɛ a nagɛ ʋ nyɩmma Uzia fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ʋ-na fa bɩ ʋ nyɩmma wʋbɔŋ-la ŋaa ʋ sɩ jʋʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la dɩ ʋ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ. Ama nɩaa fa haa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Jotham remained faithful to the Lord his God and became a very powerful king.
translation_verse: Jotam fa to ʋ TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ woruŋ, ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ yʋgɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Jotham did while he was king, including the wars he fought, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Jotam sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ: laal-la kala ʋ sɩ yuo arɩ ʋ wɩaa dɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: He was buried in Jerusalem, and his son Ahaz became king.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jotam sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi kuoroo dɩ-huguŋ Devit tabal-la lɛ. Ka ʋ nanʋala Ahas dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Ahaz offered sacrifices at the local shrines, as well as on every hill and in the shade of large trees. Syria and Israel Attack Judah (
translation_verse: Ʋ faa kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa nɛ aŋ nyɩnyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa, dundolluŋ nyuŋ arɩ tɩɩ-lugunuŋ bʋbʋɔsʋŋ kala.

english_verse: So Tiglath Pileser came to Judah, but instead of helping, he made things worse.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asiiria kuoro Tɩgɩlaf Pɩlɩsa kɔ Ahas teeŋ, ama ʋ mɩɩra kʋ hɛʋ wɩaa lɛ nɛ, ʋ bɩ ʋ lɛ pɛ.

english_verse: and he offered sacrifices in Hinnom Valley. Worst of all, Ahaz sacrificed his own sons, which was a disgusting custom of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a nyɩgɛ nɛ Bɛŋ Hɩnɔm fuonaaŋ lɛ, a paala kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hambolibiisiŋ kpʋ a nyɩga pɩ vesiŋ a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kɩsʋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa nɛ tinteye-la nɩaa fa ŋɩŋaa tintee-la lɛ, La TƖƖNA kiriba ta ka Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ hɔŋ.

english_verse: Ahaz and the people of Judah sinned and turned away from the Lord, the God their ancestors had worshiped. So the Lord punished them by letting their enemies defeat them. The king of Syria attacked Judah and took many of its people to Damascus as prisoners. King Pekah of Israel later defeated Judah and killed
translation_verse: Juda nɩaa sɩ vɩa dɩ ba to La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa, ʋ leŋ Remalia nanʋala Pɛka sɩ ŋaa Iziral kuoro joŋ tapʋl bala a kpʋ ba laalɩyuori-duoruŋ bʋɩ zɔlɔ arɩ mara.

english_verse: If you make slaves of the people of Judah and Jerusalem, you will be as guilty as they are of sinning against the Lord.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ maa chɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm baalaa arɩ haalaa bɩrɩmɛ ma yosi nɛ. Ama ma ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: Send these prisoners back home—they are your own relatives. If you don't, the Lord will punish you in his anger.
translation_verse: Má nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, má joŋ ma naambiiri-la ma sɩ kɛsɛ arɩ yosuŋ ta dɩ ba mɩɩra viiri, ŋɩɩ dee La TƖƖNA jaŋ faasa na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ a dɔgɩsɛma.”

english_verse: About the same time, four of Israel's leaders arrived. They were Azariah son of Johanan, Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai. They agreed with Oded that the Israelite troops were wrong,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ hɛ Efirem lɛ: Jehohanaŋ nanʋala Azarɩa, Mɛsɩlɩmɔf nanʋala Bɛrɛkɩa, Salum nanʋala Jɛhɩzɩkɩa arɩ Hadɩlaɩ nanʋala Amasa mʋ cheŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ laal-la kʋkɔ, a bʋla pɩba,

english_verse: and they said: If you bring these prisoners into Samaria, that will be one more thing we've done to sin against the Lord. And he is already angry enough with us.
translation_verse: “Má sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ yuo kɛsɛ kaa kɔ daha. Ŋɩɩ dee la jaŋ laa cheeriŋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Maa chɛ dɩ la laa cheeriŋ dɩ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wasa yʋgɛ nɛɛ? La cheeriŋ paala yʋgɛ nɛ, La TƖƖNA faasa na baanɩŋ la Iziral nɩaa nyuŋ.”

english_verse: So in front of the leaders and the crowd, the troops handed over their prisoners and the property they had taken from Judah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoro-la joŋ Juda nɩalɩŋ ba fa sɩ yuo kɛsɛ arɩ ba kɩaa kala ta, ba sɩpaalaara-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hilime sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The four leaders took some of the stolen clothes and gave them to the prisoners who needed something to wear. They later gave them all a new change of clothes and shoes, then fixed them something to eat and drink, and cleaned their wounds with olive oil. They gave donkeys to those who were too weak to walk, and led all of them back to Jericho, the city known for its palm trees. The leaders then returned to Samaria. Ahaz Asks the King of Assyria for Help (
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaara-la banɛsɛ beŋ nɩalɩŋ ba fa sɩ yuo kɛsɛ kɩaa tʋɔŋ a chaarɛ gɛnnɩŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree ba laalɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩba gɛnnɩŋ, nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ, kʋdiilee arɩ lɩɩŋ, aŋ ŋaa nʋʋŋ ma a hɛ ba naawɩɩlaa. Ba nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ lɔlɔ a bɩra bɩ wuo vɛŋ, ba paaba sagɛ kakusuŋ nyuŋ, a kɛmba kaa mɩɩra mʋ ba nɩaa teeŋ Jeriko lɛ, tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Abɛ Tɩɩsɩŋ taŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ mɩɩra mʋ Samarɩa.

english_verse: Some time later, the Edomites attacked the eastern part of Judah again and carried away prisoners. And at the same time, the Philistines raided towns in the western foothills and in the Southern Desert. They conquered the towns of Beth-Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco, Timnah, and Gimzo, including the villages around them. Then some of the Philistines went to live in these places. Ahaz sent a message to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria and begged for help.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa ma kʋ yuo dii Juda tasɩ-la sɩ hɛ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ nyuŋ arɩ Juda wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Tasɩ-la ba fa sɩ yuo laa a hɔŋ ba lɛ nɛ: Bɛf Sɛmɛs, Aɩjalɔŋ, Gɛdɛrɔf, a pɛ Soko, Tɩmɩna, Gimizo arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ golliba.

english_verse: But God was punishing Judah with these disasters, because Ahaz had disobeyed him and refused to stop Judah from sinning.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa leŋe wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ deemba kala ŋaa Juda nɩaa lɛ a dɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ kuoro Ahas wɩaa nɛ. Ʋ fa chaasa vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ nɛ, a leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ pʋrɩgɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Ahaz gave him gifts from the Lord's temple and the king's palace, as well as from the homes of Israel's other leaders. The Assyrian king still refused to help Ahaz. The Final Sin of Ahaz and His Death
translation_verse: Ahas paa kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, ʋ kuoru dɩa lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩpaalaaraa dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, a ŋaa zile pɩ Asiiria kuoro, ama ŋɩɩ ha bɩ ʋ lɛ pɛ.

english_verse: Even after all these terrible things happened to Ahaz, he sinned against the Lord even worse than before.
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ lɛ wɩaa sɩ jʋʋ Ahas nɛ ʋ wasa vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ, a kɩɩ faafaa-la.

english_verse: He said to himself, “The Syrian gods must have helped their kings defeat me. Maybe if I offer sacrifices to those gods, they will help me.” That was the sin that finally led to the downfall of Ahaz, as well as to the destruction of Judah.
translation_verse: Ʋ faa kpaarɛ Damasɩkʋs tɩmma-la sɩ yuo diiu vesiŋ nɛ, aŋ bɩɩnɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a bʋl, “Asiiria tɩŋŋaa vesi-la nɛ pɛ ba kuoroo lɛ a yuo diimi. Mɩ jaŋ kpaarɛba, ŋ bɩ pɔ ba jaŋ pɛ mɩ ma lɛ.” Ama wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ wasa lɛrɛ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ kʋ hɛ Ahas arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala lɛ.

english_verse: Ahaz collected all the furnishings of the temple and smashed them to pieces. Then he locked the doors to the temple and set up altars to foreign gods on every street corner in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ahas paa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ a ŋmoo yɛrɛ muno muno. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ tɔ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la, aŋ saa vʋɩ-kpaarɛ korunuŋ Jerusalɛm wombiee loŋgoru kala lɛ.

english_verse: In every city and town in Judah he built local shrines to worship foreign gods. All of this made the Lord God of his ancestors very angry.
translation_verse: Juda taŋ kala lɛ ʋ saa vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa ba kpʋkpaarɛ vesiŋ, a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a pɩpɩ vesi-la. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA, ʋ naabalɩmaba Wɩa baanɩŋ chaasa sii ʋ nyuŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Ahas sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, a chɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Juda arɩ Iziral kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Ahaz died and was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs. His son Hezekiah then became king.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahas sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ama ba bɩ ʋ hugo Iziral kuoroo dɩ-huguŋ. Ka ʋ nanʋala Hezikaaya dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord by doing right, just as his ancestor David had done. The Temple Is Purified
translation_verse: Ʋ fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ nɛ a nagɛ ʋ naabalɩma Devit fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: they went back to Hezekiah and said: Your Majesty, we have finished our work. The entire temple is now pure again, and so is the altar and its utensils, as well as the table for the sacred loaves of bread and its utensils.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ kuoro Hezikaaya, “La pɩɩsɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la disiniŋ kala ta nɛ. La pɩɩsɛ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la arɩ ʋ nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa kala disiniŋ ta nɛ, a pɛ teebʋl-la nyuŋ ba sɩ joŋ boroboro daŋ a pɩpɩ Wɩa arɩ ʋ nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa kala.

english_verse: Next, Hezekiah assigned the Levites to their places in the temple. He gave them cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments, according to the instructions that the Lord had given King David and the two prophets, Gad and Nathan.
translation_verse: Hezikaaya leŋ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ gɔllɔ chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ, a kori buguloo, chenniŋ arɩ kɔnɛba, arɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ to ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa Gad arɩ Netaŋ lɛ a dagɛ ŋɩɩ pɩ kuoro Devit.

english_verse: After that, Hezekiah and the crowd of worshipers bowed down and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ sʋl Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la dɛrɛ, kuoro arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala tuu kpirimi a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Then he called the priests and Levites to the east courtyard of the temple
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa kʋ hilimi La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ kaala lɛ,

english_verse: and said: It's time to purify the temple of the Lord God of our ancestors. You Levites must first go through the ceremony to make yourselves clean, then go into the temple and bring out everything that is unclean and unacceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: a bʋla pɩba, “Levi doho nɩaa, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Má pɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa disiniŋ ta, aŋ pɩɩsɛ La TƖƖNA, ma naabalɩmaba Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la ma disiniŋ ta. Má jʋʋ paa kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ a kaa kʋ lɩɩ.

english_verse: Some of our ancestors were unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord our God. Not only did they turn their backs on the Lord, but they also completely ignored his temple.
translation_verse: La nyɩmmaba fa bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ, ba faa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ ka tɔrɛ nɛ. Ba fa vɩa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la ta nɛ aŋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: They locked the doors, then let the lamps go out and stopped burning incense and offering sacrifices to him.
translation_verse: Ba fa kɛŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la zawʋra borusuŋ tɔ nɛ, a leŋ chaana-la ma dɩsɛ. Ba fa bɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ maa nyɩgɛ koo a ŋɩŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩpɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa.

english_verse: The Lord became terribly angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and everyone was shocked and horrified at what he did to punish them. Not only were
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa nyuŋ a leŋ ba kperi, nɩaa mʋmɔmba a sisieriba lɛ. Ma jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: our ancestors killed in battle, but our own children and wives were taken captive.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ tɩɩ ba kpʋ la nyɩmmaba laalɩŋ lɛ, aŋ kɛsɛ la hambolibiisiŋ, la toloo arɩ la haalaa a kaa viiri.

english_verse: So I have decided to renew our agreement with the Lord God of Israel. Maybe then he will stop being so angry with us.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩɩ chɛ mɩ hɛ niiŋ nɛ mɩ dɩ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa pɛgɛ, dɩ ʋ baaŋ-la ʋ sɩ faasa na la nyuŋ fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: Let's not waste any time, my friends. You are the ones who were chosen to be the Lord's priests and to offer him sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mɩ biiriŋ, má sɩ́ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa vɩa ta. Ma nɛ nɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ma hɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ, a tɩma pʋpʋ, aŋ laa nɩaa sɩpaaŋ dɩ ma chʋchʋɔlʋ, aŋ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pʋpʋ.”

english_verse: These leaders gathered together the rest of the Levites, and they all went through the ceremony to make themselves clean. Then they began to purify the temple according to the Law of the Lord, just as Hezekiah had commanded.
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaaraa deemba yɩrɛ ba naambiiriŋ Levi doho nɩaa nɩkaana-la hɛ dɔŋɔ. Ba kala pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta, aŋ lɛɛlɛ suomi dɩ ba pɩɩsɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la ma disiniŋ ta arɩ kuoro Hezikaaya sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ. Ba to wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA wombiiŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: The priests went into the temple and carried out everything that was unclean. They put these things in the courtyard, and from there, the Levites carried them outside the city to Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa jʋʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ dɩ ba pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta, a paa kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ, a kaa kʋ lɩɩ a bil Wɩa dɩa kaala-la tʋɔŋ. Levi doho nɩalɩŋ ma bɩra paa kɩalɩŋ lɩɩ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la kaala-la tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ Kɩdɩrɔŋ fuonaaŋ.

english_verse: The priests and Levites began their work on the first day of the first month. It took them one week to purify the courtyards of the temple and another week to purify the temple. So on the sixteenth day of that same month
translation_verse: Ba suomi ba tɩntɩŋŋaa chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋl bumbuŋ lɛ nɛ. Tapʋl chori lɛ dɩ ba pɩɩsɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la kaala-la disiniŋ ta a mʋ yi ʋ zawʋra, aŋ bɩra kɛŋ tapʋlaa chori ma kaa pɩɩsɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ disiniŋ ta. Chɛnɛ-la tapʋlaa fii arɩ balɩdʋ lɛ nɛ ba dɛrɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala.

english_verse: And we have brought back all the things that King Ahaz took from the temple during the time he was unfaithful to God. We purified them and put them back in front of the altar. Worship in the Temple
translation_verse: Kuoro Ahas fa sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ aŋ paa kɩalɩŋ kala kaa lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, la wasɛ ba kala nɛ a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta. Ba hɛ La TƖƖNA koru-la sɩpaaŋ.”

english_verse: At once, Hezekiah called together the officials of Jerusalem, and they went to the temple.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla kuoro Hezikaaya yɩrɛ taŋ-la tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kala hɛ dɔŋɔ, ba mʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: They brought with them seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven goats as sacrifices to take away the sins of Hezekiah's family and of the people of Judah, as well as to purify the temple. Hezekiah told the priests, who were descendants of Aaron, to sacrifice these animals on the altar.
translation_verse: Ba pɛ kɛŋ nɛ-belliŋ balɩpɛ, pie-belliŋ balɩpɛ, pie-bel-pɔɔrɔɔ ma balɩpɛ arɩ gbuŋgbogusuŋ ma balɩpɛ, dɩ ba kaa mʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a tɩŋ ba tinteeŋ arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la arɩ Juda nɩaa wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro bʋla pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ ŋaa Arɔŋ doho nɩaa, dɩ ba kpʋ pʋsʋ-la a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ La TƖƖNA koru-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: They took the goats to Hezekiah and the worshipers, and they laid their hands on the animals.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ bʋʋna-la kaa kɔ kuoro Hezikaaya arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hilime sɩpaaŋ, ba joŋ ba nɩsaa daŋ ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: The priests then killed the goats and splattered the blood on the altar as a sacrifice to take away the sins of everyone in Israel, because Hezekiah had commanded that these sacrifices be made for all the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kpʋ bʋʋna-la a joŋ ba chalɩŋ mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta, bɛɛ wɩaa Hezikaaya fa sɩ ba sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nɛ.

english_verse: The Levites were ready to play the instruments that had belonged to David; the priests were ready to blow the trumpets.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a kori gɔgʋ kɩalɩŋ Devit sɩ ŋaa, ka Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma kori nyilliŋ a ma kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a chɩŋ.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah gave the signal for the sacrifices to be burned on the altar, the musicians began singing praises to the Lord and playing their instruments,
translation_verse: Hezikaaya pa wombiiŋ dɩ ba joŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ-la kɩaa a daŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la nyuŋ. Ba sɩ suomo dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ-la, nɩaa suomo yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa aa pɩ La TƖƖNA, a ŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ a du Iziral kuoro Devit yɩɩlɩ yɩɩrɩ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ a hɛ.

english_verse: Then Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing the songs of praise that David and Asaph the prophet had written. And so they bowed down and joyfully sang praises to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kuoro Hezikaaya arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ bʋla pɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ dɩ ba yɩɩ yɩɩl-la Devit arɩ Asaf Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a tuu kpirime chʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Hezekiah said to the crowd, “Now that you are once again acceptable to the Lord, bring sacrifices and offerings to give him thanks.” The people did this, and some of them voluntarily brought animals to be offered as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Lɛɛlɛ, ma joŋ ma tɩtɩa a pɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ. Má kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kɔ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la a lɔllʋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ kuoro sɩ bʋla, a kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ kɔ a lɔllʋ. Ba dɔnsʋŋ ma kɛŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kɔ ba tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: There were not enough priests to skin all these animals, because many of the priests had not taken the time to go through the ceremony to make themselves clean. However, since all the Levites had made themselves clean, they helped the priests until the last animal was skinned.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa fa bɩ yʋgɛ dɩ ba puri kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋ-la kala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba naambiiriŋ Levi doho nɩaa pɛ ba lɛ ba tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala dɛrɛ. Ba fa pɛ ba lɛ nɛ a mʋ yi bʋa-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta. Levi doho nɩalɩŋ nɛ fa kɛŋ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta a kɩɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa.

english_verse: Besides all the sacrifices that were burned on the altar, the fat from the other animal sacrifices was burned, and the offerings of wine were poured over the altar. So the temple was once again used for worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ fa yʋga nɛ woruŋ, a pɛ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ nʋʋŋ lɛ arɩ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ yie ŋaa pɛ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra suomo chʋchʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah and the people of Judah celebrated, because God had helped them make this happen so quickly.
translation_verse: Kuoro Hezikaaya arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ a tɩŋ Wɩa sɩ pɛ ba lɛ ba ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala lɩma.

english_verse: Hezekiah's messengers went everywhere in Israel and Judah with the following letter: People of Israel, now that you have survived the invasion of the Assyrian kings, it's time for you to turn back to the Lord God our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob worshiped. If you do this, he will stop being angry.
translation_verse: Kuoro arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ hɛ nɩaa ba kɛŋ tenniŋ gɔllɛ Iziral arɩ Juda tinteeŋ kala. Ŋ-la nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ tenni-la tʋɔŋ: “Iziral tɩmma, má mɩɩra kɔ La TƖƖNA, Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb Wɩa teeŋ, ma nɩkaana-la sɩ fori Asiiria kuoroo nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ laama.

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. Decide now to obey the Lord our God! Come to Jerusalem and worship him in the temple that will belong to him forever. Then he will stop being angry,
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ nyuduoŋ kɛŋ a nagɛba. Má joŋ ma tɩtɩa a hɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Má kɔ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la ʋ sɩ leŋe ʋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Má chʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA ma Wɩa, dɩ baaŋ-la ʋ sɩ faasa na ma nyuŋ fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: and the enemies that have captured your families will show pity and send them back home. The Lord God is kind and merciful, and if you turn back to him, he will no longer turn his back on you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ mɩɩra kɔ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma dʋndɔmɔ-la fa sɩ yuo kɛsɛ ma naambiiriŋ arɩ ma biiriŋ fá ba nenige, a jomba ta dɩ ba mɩɩra kɔ dɩa. Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa kɛŋ zile a fɩfá nɩaa nenige. Dɩ ma nɛ mɩɩra kɔ ʋ teeŋ, ʋ jaŋ laama.”

english_verse: Only a few people from the tribes of Asher, West Manasseh, and Zebulun were humble and went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, baalaa dɔnsʋŋ ha lɩɩ Asa, Manasɛ arɩ Zebuluŋ doho doho tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri nɛ a sii mʋ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: God also made everyone in Judah eager to do what Hezekiah and his officials had commanded. Passover Is Celebrated
translation_verse: Wɩa fa joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ Juda nɩaa ma lɛ nɛ a leŋ ba niiŋ magɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba ŋaa wɩɩ-la kuoro arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ sɩ bʋla. Ba fa to La TƖƖNA niiŋ nɛ a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: In the second month, a large crowd of people gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread.
