translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ kʋ hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ chɛŋ-lɩa-la lɛ dɩ ba gbieli gbiele-la ba sɩ yie dii boroboro sɩ́ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: They took all the foreign altars and incense altars in Jerusalem and threw them into Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba giri vʋɩ-kpaarɛ korunu-la kala sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ a pɛ korunu-la nyuŋ ba sɩɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ, a kaa mʋ yuo hɛ Kɩdɩrɔŋ Fuonaaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Most of the people that came from Ephraim, West Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun had not made themselves clean, but they ignored God's Law and ate the Passover lambs anyway. Hezekiah found out what they had done and prayed, “Lord God, these people are unclean according to the laws of holiness. But they are worshiping you, just as their ancestors did. So, please be kind and forgive them.”
translation_verse: “La TƖƖNA, la naabalɩmaba Wɩa, ŋ zile yʋga nɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, joŋo chɛ nɩaa deemba sɩɩ toŋ arɩ ba tʋɔŋ kala. Ba bɩ ba disiniŋ pɩɩsa ta aŋ dii kɩalɩŋ, fá ba nenige. Ba bɩ ŋ wombiiŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ to.”

english_verse: The Lord answered Hezekiah's prayer and did not punish them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA laa Hezikaaya sʋla a joŋo chɛba a bɩ ba dɔgʋsɔ.

english_verse: The worshipers in Jerusalem were very happy and celebrated the Festival for seven days. The Levites and priests sang praises to the Lord every day and played their instruments.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma-la kala fa sɩ hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ gbieli gbiele-la arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ, ka Levi doho nɩaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa du kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA tapʋlɩɩ kala a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa hɛ a dɩdɛnnʋ.

english_verse: Hezekiah thanked the Levites for doing such a good job, leading the celebration. The worshipers celebrated for seven days by offering sacrifices, by eating the sacred meals, and by praising the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya bʋl wɩaa a nyaasɛ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ nyuŋ arɩ ba sɩ wuo kɛŋ jɩma a laa ba sɩpaaŋ ba dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA. Tapʋlɩa-la balɩpɛ ba sɩ gbieli gbiele-la a sʋl nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, ba dii kʋdiilee nɛ aŋ dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa.

english_verse: Everyone was so excited that they agreed to celebrate seven more days.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hilime sɛɩ arɩ ba bɩra jaŋ gbieli gbiele-la tapʋlaa balɩpɛ a pɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba gbieli arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Everyone was very happy, including those from Judah and Israel, the priests and Levites, and the foreigners living in Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hilime tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Juda arɩ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ nɩwogusu-la sɩ hɔŋ Juda arɩ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: It was the biggest celebration in Jerusalem since the days of King Solomon, the son of David.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm kala fa ŋaa tʋɔtɔrʋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa a chɩŋ Devit nanʋala Solomoŋ kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ a kaa kɔ, gbiele deeŋ nɛ ŋaa gbieli balɩŋ.

english_verse: The priests and Levites asked God to bless the people, and from his home in heaven, he did.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa sii chɩŋ a sʋl Wɩa pɩ nɩalɩŋ. Wɩa hɛ ʋ jaŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ aŋ nɩɩ a laa ba sʋla.

english_verse: Hezekiah divided the priests and Levites into groups, according to their duties. Then he assigned them the responsibilities of offering sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. He also appointed people to serve at the temple and to sing praises at the temple gates.
translation_verse: Kuoro Hezikaaya kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho kaa kpaa bugoo. Nʋʋkala arɩ ʋ tɩntɩmɩɩ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara koo Levi doho nʋʋ, dɩ ba sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Dɔnsʋŋ tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ a pɛ dɩdɛnnʋ, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la boi-baalaa niiŋ a lʋlɔllʋ aŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa dɩdɛnnʋ.

english_verse: The official records also included their wives and children, because they had also been faithful in keeping themselves clean and acceptable to serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba fa ŋmʋnsɛ ba dɩ ba haalaa, ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba toloo arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ kala sɩ hɛ ba dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ yɩraa a hɛ ba tenni-la tʋɔŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ma fa jɩma kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa nɛ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ bʋa kala.

english_verse: He told the people of Jerusalem to bring the offerings that were to be given to the priests and Levites, so that they would have time to serve the Lord with their work.
translation_verse: Ka ʋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, dɩ ba joŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa toruŋ pɩba, dɩ ba wuo joŋ ba nyuŋ kala hɛ La TƖƖNA wombiiŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ ba tuto lɛ.

english_verse: After the Festival, the people went to every town in Judah and smashed the stone images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. They destroyed all the local shrines and foreign altars in Judah, as well as those in the territories of Benjamin, Ephraim, and West Manasseh. Then everyone went home. Offerings for the Priests and Levites
translation_verse: Ba sɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala dɛrɛ, Iziral tɩmma-la kala fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ sii gɔllɛ Juda tinteeŋ tasɩŋ a ŋmoo vesiŋ tabɩaa yɛrɛ, aŋ keri vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩ-la ma lo, a chei vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa arɩ ba korunu-la kala sɩ hɛ Juda, Bɛnjamɩŋ, Efirem arɩ Manasɛ tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba sɩ chei kɩalɩŋ kala dɛrɛ, Iziral tɩmma-la kala mɩɩra mʋ ba tasɩŋ, ba dʋa leriŋ. Ba kɩɛsɛ kɩaa dɩ ba kaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ

english_verse: Hezekiah provided animals from his own herds and flocks to use for the morning and evening sacrifices, as well as for the sacrifices during the Sabbath celebrations, the New Moon Festivals, and the other religious feasts required by the Law of the Lord.
translation_verse: Hezikaaya lɩɩsɛ nɛsɩŋ arɩ piesee ʋ tɩtɩa pʋsʋŋ tʋɔŋ ba kaa ŋɩŋaa chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ dɩdaanɩŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, chɛ wiesii-la kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbielee arɩ gbiele-la dɔnsʋŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, arɩ La TƖƖNA wombiiŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ ba tuto sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: As soon as the people heard what the king wanted, they brought a tenth of everything they owned, including their best grain, wine, olive oil, honey, and other crops.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la kuoro sɩ bʋla, Iziral tɩmma-la sii kɛŋ ba zile kɩaa kɔ. Mɩɩ-bumbumba, tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ, nʋʋŋ, tʋʋŋ arɩ kʋŋ na-kala ba sɩɩ pɛrʋ. Ba kɛŋ kʋ-daŋ nɛ kɔ, a pɛ ba sɩ yie kɛŋ ba kɩaa kpaa leree fii fii a joŋ kʋbala-la pɩ Wɩa lɛ.

english_verse: The people from the other towns of Judah brought a tenth of their herds and flocks, as well as a tenth of anything they had dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Iziral arɩ Juda nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɔŋ Juda tinteeŋ tasɩŋ lɛ ma kɛŋ ba nɛsɩŋ arɩ piesee ba sɩ kaa kpaa leree fii fii a joŋ kʋbala kʋbala pɩ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa a pɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo hɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba joŋo hɛ dɔŋɔ ba chʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: The people started bringing their offerings to Jerusalem in the third month, and the last ones arrived four months later.
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-tori lɛ nɛ ba suomo kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kʋkɔ ŋɩɩ halɩɩ a mʋ dɛrɛ chɛŋ-pɛɩ lɛ.

english_verse: When Hezekiah and his officials saw these offerings, they thanked the Lord and the people.
translation_verse: Hezikaaya arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ sɩ kʋ na kɩalɩŋ sɩ chʋɔra ŋɩɩ, ba dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA aŋ lɔllɛ Iziral nɩalɩŋ ma kala.

english_verse: Hezekiah asked the priests and Levites about the large amount of offerings.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya pɩɛsɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ chʋɔra lɛ.

english_verse: The high priest at the time was Azariah, a descendant of Zadok, and he replied, “Ever since the people have been bringing us their offerings, we have had more than enough food and supplies. The Lord has certainly blessed his people. Look at how much is left over!”
translation_verse: Azarɩa, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ sɩ ŋaa Zadɔk doho nʋʋ bʋl, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ suomo kɩɛsɛ kɩaa kaa kɔ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la, la yie na kʋdiilee yʋgɛ nɛ a dii aŋ ka. La TƖƖNA pɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ nɛ, na kɩaa ha sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ a ka.”

english_verse: So the king gave orders for storerooms to be built in the temple, and when they were completed,
translation_verse: Hezikaaya pa wombiiŋ dɩ ba wasɛ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba wasɛ.

english_verse: all the extra offerings were taken there. Hezekiah and Azariah then appointed Conaniah the Levite to be in charge of these storerooms. His brother Shimei was his assistant, and the following Levites worked with them: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah.
translation_verse: Kuoro Hezikaaya arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ Azarɩa sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ a bibeŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɩɩsɛ nɩaa deemba: Jɛhɩɛl, Azazɩa, Nahaf, Asahɛl, Jɛrɩmɔf, Jozabad, Ɛlɩɛl, Ɩsɩmakaaya, Mahaf arɩ Bɛnaaya ba pɛ Kɔnanɩa arɩ ʋ naambie Sɩmɛɩ lɛ ba bibeŋ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩ-la.

english_verse: Kore son of Imnah was assigned to guard the East Gate, and he was put in charge of receiving the offerings voluntarily given to God and of dividing them among the priests and Levites.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa Ɩmɩna nanʋala Kori nɛ faa pɔ Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ Boi-baalɩŋ. Ʋ nɛ ba fa joŋo hɛ ʋ lɩlaa tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa kʋ pɩ Wɩa. Ʋ nɛ yie bɩra kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ma ba sɩ kɩɛsa kʋ pɩ La TƖƖNA arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ kpɩkpaa.

english_verse: He had six assistants who were responsible for seeing that all the priests in the other towns of Judah also got their share of these offerings. They were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah. Every priest and every Levite over
translation_verse: Ba yie kpaa pɩ baala-la kala yɩraa ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ ba tenniŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii a kaa jɩl, nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie jʋʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tapʋlɩɩ kala a tɩtɩŋ, a magɛ nʋʋkala tɩntɩŋŋaa sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ kɛmba kpaa.

english_verse: Hezekiah also appointed other men to take food and supplies to the priests and Levites whose homes were in the pastureland around the towns of Judah. But the priests had to be descendants of Aaron, and the Levites had to be listed in the official records.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ ŋaa Arɔŋ doho nɩaa a hɔŋ ba ŋmaŋkaanɩ-la sɩ golli Juda tasɩŋ lɛ, ba fa lɩɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ ba kɛŋ kʋdiile-la mʋ kpaa baala-la kala sɩ hɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala yɩraa sɩ hɛ Levi doho nɩaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Everything Hezekiah did while he was king of Judah, including what he did for the temple in Jerusalem, was right and good. He was a successful king, because he obeyed the Lord God with all his heart.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ to La TƖƖNA wombiiŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga, ʋ to ʋ Wɩa nɛ a tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ wɩɩkala wasɛ.

english_verse: The officials said all these things in Hebrew, so that everyone listening from the city wall would understand and be terrified and surrender.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la kɛŋ Hiburu yikoro a kpɩa Jerusalɛm nɩalɩŋ sɩ sagɛ ba taŋ kɛrɛ nyuŋ lɛ, a fugisiba a chɩchɛ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba ka dɩ ba yuo dii tabal-la.

english_verse: You've heard what my ancestors and I have done to other nations. Were the gods of those nations able to defend their land against us?
translation_verse: Ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ dɩ mɩ nyɩmmaba sɩ ŋaa tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ nɩaa lɛ jɩŋ? Tinteye-la vesiŋ fa wuo laaba ta mɩ-na Asiiria kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛɛ?

english_verse: The Lord rescued Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from Sennacherib and also protected them from other enemies.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA laa Hezikaaya arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa ta Asiiria kuoro Sɛnakɛrɩb arɩ ba dʋdɔmɔ-la dɔnsʋŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a pɩba wiese sɛmɛ kala.

english_verse: he and his officials worked out a plan to cut off the supply of water outside the city, so that the Assyrians would have no water when they came to attack. The officials got together a large work force that stopped up the springs and streams near Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ kʋ lɩɩ, ba tɔ lɩɩ-bul-sɩa-la arɩ lɩɩ-libisi-la sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ a pɩpɛllɛ, aŋ bʋl, “Asiiria kuoro nɛ kɔ daha, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ na lɩɩŋ yʋgɛ.”

english_verse: Hezekiah's workers also repaired the broken sections of the city wall. Then they built defense towers and an outer wall to help protect the one already there. The landfill on the east side of David's City was also strengthened. He gave orders to make a large supply of weapons and shields,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya faasa tɩŋ woruŋ a wasa saa jebii-la lere-la kala sɩ tele, a saa jebii-duduosuŋ ʋ nyuŋ. Ʋ bɩra saa kɛrɛ dɔŋɔ ma a golli kʋ-la ba sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ saa, a leŋ Devit tabal-la sɛmɛ-la ba sɩ dɩŋa aŋ saa chaasa kɛŋ doluŋ. Ʋ fa bɩra leŋe ba ŋaa bayuori kɩaa ma yʋgɛ nɛ, a pɛ hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: and he appointed army commanders over the troops. Then he gathered the troops together in the open area in front of the city gate and said to them:
translation_verse: Ʋ chaarɛ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ ba bibeŋ laalɩyuoroo, aŋ yɩrɛ nɩaa kʋ hilimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ ba jaŋ boi-baalɩŋ niiŋ biliiŋ lɛ a bʋl wɩaa deemba a nyaasɛ ba nyuŋ:

english_verse: Be brave and confident! There's no reason to be afraid of King Sennacherib and his powerful army. We are much more powerful,
translation_verse: “Má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ doluŋ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma koo dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ a tɩŋ Asiiria kuoro arɩ ʋ laalɩyuori daŋ-la wɩaa. Dol-la la sɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ nɛ kɩɩ dol-la ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: When Sennacherib and his troops were camped at the town of Lachish, he sent a message to Hezekiah and the people in Jerusalem. It said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ, dɩ Asiiria kuoro Sɛnakɛrɩb arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋmoo buguŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lakɩs lɛ. Ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ ba kɛŋ tɩndaarɩŋ mʋ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Hezikaaya arɩ Juda nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ teeŋ.

english_verse: I am King Sennacherib of Assyria, and I have Jerusalem surrounded. Do you think you can survive my attack?
translation_verse: “Wɩɩ-la Asiiria kuoro Sɛnakɛrɩb sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Bɛɛ kʋŋ lɛ nɛ ma yɩɛlaa paala hɛ, ma hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ ba tɔ ma hɛ?

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah! No god of any nation has ever been able to stand up to Assyria. Believe me, your God cannot keep you safe!
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Hezikaaya nyɩsɛma koo a kɛmma yeŋŋi. Má sɩ́ ʋ laa dii, tintee kala vene ha bɩ wuo laa ʋ nɩaa ta mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ koo Asiiria kuoroo kʋŋkala nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ɛɛ nɛ saa ma-na Wɩa jaŋ wuo laama ta mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Assyrian officials said terrible things about the Lord God and his servant Hezekiah.
translation_verse: Sɛnakɛrɩb laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la ma bʋl wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ yʋgɛ nɛ a tɩgɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna Hezikaaya lɛ.

english_verse: Sennacherib's letter even made fun of the Lord. It said, “The gods of other nations could not save their people from Assyria's army, and neither will the God that Hezekiah worships.”
translation_verse: Asiiria kuoru-la fa paala ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ nɛ a tʋʋsɛ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa joŋŋoo woruŋ, a bʋl, “Tinteye-la dɔnsʋŋ vesiŋ sɩ bɩ wuo laa ba nɩaa ta mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, Hezikaaya vene ma bɩ jaŋ wuo laa ʋ nɩaa ta mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: People brought offerings to Jerusalem for the Lord and expensive gifts for Hezekiah, and from that day on, every nation on earth respected Hezekiah. Hezekiah Gets Sick and Almost Dies (
translation_verse: A chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ a kaa mʋ, tinteye-la kala sɩ golli Juda tinteeŋ chaasa zizil kuoro Hezikaaya woruŋ, nɩ-daŋ kɛŋ kɩaa kɔ Jerusalɛm, a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA. Ba pɛ kɛŋ kɩaa sɩ kɛŋ yuŋuŋ nɛ woruŋ a kaa kʋ dii zile pɩ kuoro Hezikaaya ma. Hezikaaya babii-ballɩŋ, ʋ wʋŋaalaa arɩ ʋ sʋʋŋ

english_verse: About this same time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. He prayed, and the Lord gave him a sign that he would recover.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Hezikaaya faa wɩɩlʋ, a ka mʋa dɩ ʋ sʋba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sʋl La TƖƖNA, ʋ nɩɩ a dagʋ magɩlɩŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ duori.

english_verse: But Hezekiah was so proud that he refused to thank the Lord for everything he had done for him. This made the Lord angry, and he punished Hezekiah and the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ama Hezikaaya ŋaa babii-ballɩŋ a vɩa dɩ ʋ lɔllɛ La TƖƖNA, a tɩŋ zile-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa ʋ lɛ wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ leŋ La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ ʋ dɩ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa nyuŋ.

english_verse: Hezekiah and the people later felt sorry and asked the Lord to forgive them. So the Lord did not punish them as long as Hezekiah was king. Hezekiah's Wealth (
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ babii-ballɩɩ-la lɛ, Jerusalɛm nɩaa ma kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri. La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ, ʋ bɩra bɩ ba dɔgʋsɔ Hezikaaya kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah was very rich, and everyone respected him. He built special rooms to store the silver, the gold, the precious stones and spices, the shields, and the other valuable possessions.
translation_verse: Kuoro Hezikaaya fa kɛŋ dʋa nɛ woruŋ nɩaa zizilu. Ʋ saa chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩŋ a bil ʋ kɩaa deemba: sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, tabɩɩ-tʋlaa, tegisiŋ, hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ, a pɛ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ yuŋuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Storehouses were also built for his supply of grain, wine, and olive oil; barns were built for his cattle, and pens were put up for his sheep.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bɩra saa dɩɩsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ a bil ʋ baga kɩaa: mɩaa, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ, a lɩgɛ nɛ-dɩɩsɩŋ a hɛ ʋ nɛsɩŋ, a saa pie-dɩɩsɩŋ ma a hɛ ʋ piesee.

english_verse: God made Hezekiah extremely rich, so he bought even more sheep, goats, and cattle. And he built towns where he could keep all these animals.
translation_verse: Wɩa fa leŋe Hezikaaya chaasa kɛŋ dʋa nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ yɔɔ piesee arɩ bʋʋnaa pɛ a saa tasɩŋ, lere-la pʋsʋ-la sɩ jaŋ hɛ.

english_verse: It was Hezekiah who built a tunnel that carried the water from Gihon Spring into the city of Jerusalem. In fact, everything he did was successful!
translation_verse: Hezikaaya nɛ fa bɩra gɩbɛ Gɩhɔŋ lɩɩ-bulo sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm harɩŋ, a lɔsɛ bʋa-naaŋ a leŋ lɩɩ-la to ʋ lɛ a kʋʋ tuu Jerusalɛm tʋɔŋ. Wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ fa sɩ ŋaa vɛŋ woruŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Even when the leaders of Babylonia sent messengers to ask Hezekiah about the sign God had given him, God let Hezekiah give his own answer to test him and to see if he would remain faithful. Hezekiah Dies (
translation_verse: Ama Babɩlɔŋ kuoro sɩ tɩŋ nɩaa dɩ ba kʋ pɩɛsɛ Hezikaaya wɩaa a tɩgɛ wʋmagɩl-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo ŋaa tintee-la lɛ, Wɩa fa leŋu nɛ ka dɩ ʋ na wɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Hezekiah did while he was king, including how faithful he was to the Lord, is included in the records kept by Isaiah the prophet. These are written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Hezikaaya sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ to La TƖƖNA a ŋaa wɩaa, ba kala hɛ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo dagɛ Amos nanʋala Azaaya sɩ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ ba ŋmʋnsa bil lɛ. Wɩaa deemba kala hɛ Juda arɩ Iziral kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: When Hezekiah died, he was buried in the section of the royal tombs that was reserved for the most respected kings, and everyone in Judah and Jerusalem honored him. His son Manasseh then became king.
translation_verse: Hezikaaya sʋʋ, ba hugu dundolo-la nyuŋ Devit doho nɩaa vaamaa sɩ hɛ. Ʋ sɩ sʋba, Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala zilu nɛ woruŋ. Ka ʋ nanʋala Manasɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But the people of Judah and Jerusalem listened to Manasseh and did even more sinful things than the nations the Lord had wiped out.
translation_verse: Ama Manasɛ leŋe Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa yeŋŋi nɛ, a wasa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a kɩɩ tinteye-la fa sɩ hɛ lee-la La TƖƖNA cheiba ka Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ hɔŋ.

english_verse: The people obeyed Manasseh, but they worshiped the Lord at their own shrines.
translation_verse: Nɩaa fa haa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ leree dɔnsʋŋ, ama ba TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ ba ŋaa pɩpa.

english_verse: Everything else Manasseh did while he was king, including his prayer to the Lord God and the warnings from his prophets, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Manasɛ sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, a pɛ ʋ sɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa arɩ ŋɩɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla sɩ kpʋrɩsɛ ʋ dɩgɩlaa La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Iziral kuoroo wʋŋaalaa tenniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: While Manasseh was held captive there, he asked the Lord God to forgive him and to help him.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a nɩna hɛɛŋ, ʋ leŋ ʋ sɩaa tuu tinteeŋ ʋ nyɩmmaba Wɩa teeŋ, aŋ sʋl ʋ TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: He rebuilt the local shrines that his father Hezekiah had torn down. He built altars for the god Baal and set up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. And he continued to worship the stars.
translation_verse: Ʋ wasa saa vesiŋ dɩ-kpaarɩa-la kala ʋ nyɩmma Hezikaaya fa sɩ ŋmoo giri nɛ, aŋ saa korunuŋ a pɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal, aŋ pɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ ma. Ʋ fa kpirime aa chʋɔlɛ wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa kala ma nɛ.

english_verse: In the temple, where only the Lord was supposed to be worshiped, Manasseh built altars for the worship of pagan gods
translation_verse: Ʋ saa fa vʋɩyaa korunuŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ tʋɔŋ, lee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla arɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ jaŋ hɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: and the stars. He placed these altars in both courtyards of the temple
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kaalɩsɩ-la balɩa kala lɛ nɛ ʋ saa korunuŋ aa chʋɔlɛ wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa.

english_verse: and even set up a stone image of a foreign god. Manasseh practiced magic and witchcraft; he asked fortunetellers for advice and sacrificed his own sons in Hinnom Valley. He did many other sinful things and made the Lord very angry. Years ago, God had told David and Solomon: Jerusalem is the place I prefer above all others in Israel. It belongs to me, and there in the temple I will be worshiped forever.
translation_verse: Manasɛ fa joŋ vene-la ʋ sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ saa a bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ nɛ. Ama Wɩa fa bʋla pɩ Devit arɩ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ, “Jerusalɛm arɩ mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa Iziral doho doho kala tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ ba jaŋ zizilmi nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: If my people will faithfully obey all the laws and teaching I gave to my servant Moses, I will never again force them to leave the land I gave to their ancestors.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɩɩ tintee-la lɛ mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩ ba naabalɩmaba, dɩ ba nɛ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ ba sɩaa a to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛba a mʋ tɩgɛ wombie-la kala mɩ tɩntɩnna Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ ba tuto.”

english_verse: The Lord tried to warn Manasseh and the people about their sins, but they ignored the warning.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA kpʋrɩsɛ Manasɛ arɩ ʋ nɩaa dɩgɩlaa, ama ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ.

english_verse: So he let Assyrian army commanders invade Judah and capture Manasseh. They put a hook in his nose and tied him up in chains, and they took him to Babylon.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ Asiiria laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ kʋ yuo Juda tinteeŋ, a kɛŋ Manasɛ a joŋ nenii-pɩrɩŋ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ aŋ vɔbʋ arɩ kɔlɩɩŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ a kɛnʋ kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord listened to Manasseh's prayer and saw how sorry he was, and so he let him go back to Jerusalem and rule as king. Manasseh knew from then on that the Lord was God.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA laa ʋ sʋla a leŋ ʋ mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm a bibeŋ ʋ tinteeŋ. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ Manasɛ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Later, Manasseh rebuilt the eastern section of Jerusalem's outer wall and made it taller. This section went from Gihon Valley north to Fish Gate and around the part of the city called Mount Ophel. He also assigned army officers to each of the fortified cities in Judah.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ wasa saa Devit taŋ-la harɩŋ jebiiŋ ʋ leŋie pɛ. Ʋ fa saa jebii-la a chɩŋ Gɩhɔŋ lɩɩ-bulo-la sɩ hɛ fuonaaŋ lɛ nɛ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi boi-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Chenfilee Boi-baalɩŋ a golli dundolo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɔfɛl. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ hɛ Juda tasɩ-la kala ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli lɛ.

english_verse: Manasseh also removed the idols and the stone image of the foreign god from the temple, and he gathered the altars he had built near the temple and in other parts of Jerusalem. He threw all these things outside the city.
translation_verse: Manasɛ paa vesi-la kala ʋ sɩ joŋo bil La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, arɩ tɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ saa, a giri vʋɩyaa korunu-la ma kala ʋ sɩ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la dundolo nyuŋ arɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ, a kɛŋ ba kala lɩɩ ta tabal-la harɩŋ.

english_verse: Then he repaired the Lord's altar and offered sacrifices to thank him and sacrifices to ask his blessing. He gave orders that everyone in Judah must worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra wasa saa La TƖƖNA koru-la a ŋaa nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, aŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ dɔŋɔ ma a lɔllɛ La TƖƖNA, aŋ bʋla pɩ Juda nɩaa dɩ ba tuto La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa.

english_verse: Manasseh died and was buried near the palace, and his son Amon became king. King Amon of Judah (
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Manasɛ sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi ʋ kuoru dɩa lɛ, ka ʋ nanʋala Amɔŋ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. Amɔŋ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ

english_verse: Amon disobeyed the Lord, just as his father Manasseh had done, and he worshiped and offered sacrifices to the idols his father had made.
translation_verse: Amɔŋ ma fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, arɩ ʋ nyɩmma Manasɛ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Amɔŋ faa kpaarɛ tɔmɔ-la kala ʋ nyɩmma Manasɛ sɩ mɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Manasseh had turned back to the Lord, but Amon refused to do that. Instead, he sinned even more than his father.
translation_verse: Manasɛ fa ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la ŋɩɩ, aŋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ nɛ a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pɩ La TƖƖNA, ama Amɔŋ-na fa bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa. Ʋ fa chaasa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ woruŋ a kɩɩ ʋ nyɩmma.

english_verse: Some of Amon's officials plotted against him and killed him in his palace.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Amɔŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ vʋʋrɛ a kpʋʋ ʋ kuoru dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: But the people of Judah killed the murderers of Amon and made his son Josiah king.
translation_verse: Juda nɩaa ma kpʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ vʋʋra kpʋ Amɔŋ, aŋ leŋ ʋ nanʋala Josaaya dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Hilkiah and the four other men left at once and went to talk with Huldah the prophet. Her husband was Shallum, who was in charge of the king's clothes. Huldah lived in the northern part of Jerusalem, and when they met in her home,
translation_verse: Hɩlɩkaaya arɩ nɩalɩŋ kuoro sɩ tɩma mʋ haal kʋbala sɩ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ teeŋ baa yɩrɛ Hulida, dɩ ba chɛ na. Haal-la bala nɛ fa Salum, sɩ ŋaa Tɩkɩva nanʋala. Tɩkɩva ma nyɩmma nɛ fa Hahas. Salum nɛ faa beŋ gɛnnɩ-la ba sɩɩ bil Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ. Hulida ma fa hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ aa jʋʋ je-chigi falɩɩ-la.

english_verse: In the eighteenth year of Josiah's rule in Judah, after he had removed all the sinful things from the land and from the Lord's temple, he sent three of his officials to repair the temple. They were Shaphan son of Azaliah, Governor Maaseiah of Jerusalem, and Joah son of Joahaz, who kept the government records.
translation_verse: Josaaya sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ chori lɛ, ʋ lɩɩsɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ a hɛ ba tinteeŋ arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ ta a leŋ veŋ-kpaarɩŋ dɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ batori dɩ ba mʋ a wasɛ ʋ TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. Nɩalɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Azalɩa nanʋala Safaŋ, arɩ Maasɛya, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm arɩ Jʋahas nanʋala Jʋa, nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba wɩaa bibil.

english_verse: After Josiah had finished reading, he stood in the place reserved for the king. He promised in the Lord's name to faithfully obey the Lord and to follow his laws and teachings that were written in the book.
translation_verse: Kuoro Josaaya sii chɩŋ ʋ dɩchɩnɩŋ, jebii-la sɛmɛ a hɛ niiŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ jaŋ to ʋ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ wɩɩ wɩɩkala, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: He watched as the altars for the worship of the god Baal were torn down, and as the nearby incense altars were smashed. The Asherah poles, the idols, and the stone images were also smashed, and the pieces were scattered over the graves of their worshipers.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋ ba ŋmoo vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal korunuŋ a giri, a pɛ korunu-la ma lɛ ba sɩɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sɩ chɩna kpagɛba lɛ. Ba ŋmoo Asɩra daasɩŋ kala bori muno muno, a bori tɔmɔ-la ba sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ saa aŋ yɛrɛ tɔmɔ-la ba sɩ libe. Ʋ ŋmoo kɩaa deemba kala yɛrɛ muno muno nɛ a paa mɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ kpaarɛba vaamaa.

english_verse: At once he called together Hilkiah, Shaphan, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Abdon son of Micah, and his own servant Asaiah. He said,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ Hɩlɩkaaya arɩ Safaŋ nanʋala Ahɩkam, arɩ Mɩka nanʋala Abɩdɔŋ arɩ Safaŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba tenniŋ arɩ kuoro nanzɔɔ Asaaya,

translation_verse: Josaaya sɩ kɛŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩaa hɛ dɔŋɔ harɩŋ, Ijipiti kuoro Neko sii kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo mʋ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kakɛmɩs a hɛ Yufireti fuo-la leriŋ dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ. Josaaya ma kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo mʋ dɩ ba chemba a yuo laalɩŋ.

english_verse: But Josiah ignored Neco's warning, even though it came from God! Instead, he disguised himself and marched into battle against Neco in the valley near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Ama Josaaya bɩ jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ to Neko lɛ a bʋl, aŋ sii paa kɩaa laalɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ ʋ jɩŋ a mʋ Megido tintee-taala-la leriŋ dɩ ʋ yuo Neko.

english_verse: They carried Josiah out of his chariot, then put him in the other chariot he had there and took him back to Jerusalem, where he soon died. He was buried beside his ancestors, and everyone in Judah and Jerusalem mourned his death.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩsʋ ʋ laalɩŋ jaaba toruko tʋɔŋ a joŋu hɛ toruko dɔŋɔ lɛ a kɛnʋ mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm, ʋ sʋʋ nɩmɛ. Ba joŋu hugi ʋ naabalɩmaba dɩ-huguŋ, ka Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala yel ʋ yoho.

english_verse: Jeremiah the prophet wrote a funeral song in honor of Josiah. And since then, anyone in Judah who mourns the death of Josiah sings that song. It is included in the collection of funeral songs.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya ta jeŋ-biiŋ a pɩ Josaaya. Arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala gɔgʋ-baalaa arɩ haalaa ha yie ta jeŋ-bii-la nɛ a liliisi Josaaya wɩaa. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ jeŋ-biiŋ deeŋ hɛ ba jeŋ-biee tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Josiah did while he was king, including how he faithfully obeyed the Lord,
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Josaaya sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, a pɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ to La TƖƖNA wombiiŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto,

english_verse: The message said: I am King Cyrus of Persia. The Lord God of heaven has made me the ruler of every nation on earth. He has also chosen me to build a temple for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. The Lord God will watch over any of his people who want to go back to Judah.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoro Siirus sɩɩ bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ joŋ dʋnɩa tinteyee kala pɩmɛ nɛ. Ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ saa ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ pʋ Jerusalɛm sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. La TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ pɔ ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa ʋ nɩaa sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ lee-la.”

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar also carried off many of the valuable things in the Lord's temple, and he put them in his palace in Babylon.
translation_verse: Nebukadineza fa pɛ paa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ a joŋo bil ʋ kuoru dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: During Jehoiakim's rule, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia invaded Judah. He arrested Jehoiakim and put him in chains, and he sent him to the capital city of Babylon.
translation_verse: Jehoyakim kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza kʋ yuo dii Juda tinteeŋ a kɛŋ Jehoyakim a vɔbʋ arɩ kɔlɩɩŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ a kɛnʋ mʋ Babɩlɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord sent King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to attack Jerusalem. Nebuchadnezzar killed the young men who were in the temple, and he showed no mercy to anyone, whether man or woman, young or old. God let him kill everyone in the city.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ lɛrɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro kʋ hɛ ba lɛ, ʋ kpʋ ba baalaa arɩ haalaa, hambiisiŋ arɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ kala, a kpʋ ba bapʋɔsaa ma sɩ paala hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. Wɩa fa joŋ ba kala hɛ Nebukadineza nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar carried off everything that was left in the temple; he robbed the treasury and the personal storerooms of the king and his officials. He took everything back to Babylon.
translation_verse: Ʋ paa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa kala, kʋbalaa arɩ kʋbiisiŋ, a paa dʋa-la kala sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, a paa kuoro arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ ma dʋa kala a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: In the spring of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had Jehoiachin arrested and taken to Babylon, along with more of the valuable items in the temple. Then Nebuchadnezzar appointed Zedekiah king of Judah. King Zedekiah of Judah (
translation_verse: Duoŋ puso bʋa lɛ, kuoro Nebukadineza tɩŋ ba kʋ kɛŋ Jehoyachiŋ a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ, a paa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ yuŋuŋ pɛ, aŋ leŋ Jehoyachiŋ nɩɛra Zedikaaya mɩɩra dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ. Zedikaaya dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ

english_verse: The survivors were taken to Babylonia as prisoners, where they were slaves of the king and his sons, until Persia became a powerful nation.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bɩ kpʋa, ʋ kɛsɛba kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, ba ŋaa ʋ dɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ tɩntɩnnaa a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoruŋ sɩ kʋ kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord his God and refused to change his ways, even after a warning from Jeremiah, the Lord's prophet.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ʋ TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ, a bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kaa tuu tinteeŋ a jegile nɩɩ La TƖƖNA wɩalɩŋ ʋ wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had forced Zedekiah to promise in God's name that he would be loyal. Zedekiah was stubborn and refused to turn back to the Lord God of Israel, so he rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Zedikaaya fa vɩa kuoro Nebukadineza ma niiŋ nɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ leŋe ʋ ŋmɩɛsɛ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ tou arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ʋ fa kɛŋ nyuduoŋ nɛ a vɩa dɩ ʋ bɩrɩmɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ a to La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa.

english_verse: The people of Judah and even the priests who were their leaders became more unfaithful. They followed the disgusting example of the nations around them and made the Lord's holy temple unfit for worship.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala wasa bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ Wɩa teeŋ. Ba faa ŋaa wʋkɩsɩa-la tinteye-la sɩ kpagɛba nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ, a ŋaa disiniŋ hɩhɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa Jerusalɛm lɛ dɩ ba zizilu. Jerusalɛm tele

english_verse: But the Lord God felt sorry for his people, and instead of destroying the temple, he sent prophets who warned the people over and over about their sins.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa fá ba nenige a to ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩba bʋlɩa bʋlɩa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa bɩ chɛ ʋ chei nɩalɩŋ arɩ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la.

english_verse: But the people only laughed and insulted these prophets. They ignored what the Lord God was trying to tell them, until he finally became so angry that nothing could stop him from punishing Judah and Jerusalem. Jerusalem Is Destroyed (
translation_verse: Ama ba bɩ ʋ wʋlaabʋlla-la teeŋ jegile nɩɩ, aŋ mɔmba a sieri ba lɛ. Ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ chaasa sii ba nyuŋ, wɩɩkala tuo sɩ jaŋ pɔ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ ba dɔgʋsʋ.

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar's troops burned down the temple and destroyed every important building in the city. Then they broke down the city wall.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba chol nyiniŋ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ aŋ ŋmoo jebii-la sɩ golli Jerusalɛm lo a nyɩgɛ kuoru dɩɩsɩ-la a chei kʋzɔŋ na-kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: In the first year that Cyrus was king of Persia, the Lord had Cyrus send a message to all parts of his kingdom. This happened just as Jeremiah the Lord's prophet had promised.
translation_verse: Siirus sɩ dii Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-bumbuŋ lɛ, La TƖƖNA sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ to Jɛrɩmaaya lɛ bʋl kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ digi Pɛsɩa kuoro Siirus tʋɔŋ nɛ, ʋ ŋaa ba ŋmʋnsɛ heele deeŋ a pɩ ʋ tinteeŋ nɩaa kala:

english_verse: I am King Cyrus of Persia. The Lord God of heaven, who is also the God of Israel, has made me the ruler of all nations on earth. And he has chosen me to build a temple for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. The Lord God will watch over and encourage any of his people who want to go back to Jerusalem and help build the temple.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɩaa kʋŋ nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, a leŋ dɩ ʋ Wɩa hɛ ʋ teeŋ, dɩ ʋ mʋ Jerusalɛm sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ a saa La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, Wɩa-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, dɩɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: The others helped by giving silver articles, gold, personal possessions, cattle, and other valuable gifts, as well as offerings for the temple.
translation_verse: Ba dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔnɔ hɛ dɔŋɔ pɛ ba lɛ arɩ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ, kʋdiilee arɩ pʋsʋŋ, kɩaa sɩ kɛŋ yuŋuŋ a pɛ tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: King Cyrus gave back the things that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the Lord's temple in Jerusalem and had put in the temple of his own gods.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Siirus leŋ ba paa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la kɩalɩŋ kuoro Nebukadineza fa sɩ paa Jerusalɛm lɛ a kaa mʋ bil ʋ vesiŋ dɩa lɛ a kaa kʋ lɩɩ.

english_verse: Cyrus placed Mithredath, his chief treasurer, in charge of these things. Mithredath counted them and gave a list to Sheshbazzar, the governor of Judah.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ kɩaa deemba hɛ Mɩfɩrɛdaf nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bil ʋ moribiee, ʋ dɩɩsɛba a joŋo pɩ Sɛsɩbaza sɩ ŋaa Juda tinteeŋ nɩaa sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: Here is how many people returned whose ancestors had come from the following towns:
translation_verse: Sɛnaa nɩaa ma ŋaa bʋɩ-batori arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ mara arɩ fii nɛ.

english_verse: from Netophah;
translation_verse: Jaala, Daakɔŋ, Gɩdɛl,

english_verse: Here is a list of how many returned from each family of priests:
translation_verse: Harɩm doho nɩaa ŋaa bʋɩ arɩ fii arɩ balɩpɛ nɛ.

english_verse: In fact, the governor told them, “You cannot eat the food offered to God until we find out if you really are priests.”
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ kiriba dɩ ba sɩ́ kʋdiile-la sɩ ŋaa Wɩa kʋzɔmɔ dii, see dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara kɛŋ Urim arɩ Tumim chɛ na.

english_verse: When the people came to where the Lord's temple had been in Jerusalem, some of the family leaders gave gifts so it could be rebuilt in the same place.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mɩɩra kɔ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ joŋ ba tʋɔtɔrɛ kɩaa pa dɩ ba kaa wasa saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la, dɩ ʋ chɩŋ ʋ dɩchɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: Everyone returned to the towns from which their families had come, including the priests, the Levites, the musicians, the temple guards, and the workers.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Levi doho nɩaa, yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boi-baalaa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ a pɛ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ lɛ mɩɩra mʋ hɔŋ tasɩ-la lɛ ba naabalɩmaba sɩ lɩa lɛ, ka Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩkaana-la hɔŋ ba tasɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: During the seventh month of the year, the Israelites who had settled in their towns went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Jɩna tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-pɛɩ sɩ kʋʋ yi dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hɔŋ ba tasɩŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala kʋ hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ arɩ nii-bala.

english_verse: The priest Joshua son of Jozadak, together with the other priests, and Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his relatives rebuilt the altar of Israel's God. Then they were able to offer sacrifices there by following the instructions God had given to Moses, the man of God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jozadak nanʋala Jesua arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara arɩ Zerubabɛl sɩ ŋaa Sɩalɩtɩɛl nanʋala arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ suomo sɩsaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ dɩ ba kaa ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, arɩ wombie-la Wɩa tɩntɩnna Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: And they built the altar where it had stood before, even though they were afraid of the people who were already living around there. Then every morning and evening they burned sacrifices and offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Arɩ ba fa sɩɩ fá nɩalɩŋ sɩ golliba ma kala, ba saa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nɛ ʋ gentine tɩtɩa lɛ, a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ʋ lɛ a pɩ La TƖƖNA, chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ dɩdaanɩŋ kala.

english_verse: The people followed the rules for celebrating the Festival of Shelters and offered the proper sacrifices each day.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba gbieli lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele, a chɛ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ maga dɩ ba chɛ tapʋlɩɩ na-kala arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil.

english_verse: They offered sacrifices to please the Lord, sacrifices at each New Moon Festival, and sacrifices at the rest of the Lord's festivals. Every offering the people had brought voluntarily was also presented to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ, ba joŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ maga dɩ baa nyɩgɛ bʋa na-kala, chɛŋ-falɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ yie ŋaa La TƖƖNA gbielee lɛ, a saa pɛ tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa kʋ pɩ La TƖƖNA lɛ.

english_verse: Although work on the temple itself had not yet begun, the people started offering sacrifices on the Lord's altar on the first day of the seventh month of that year. The Rebuilding of the Temple Begins
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-pɛɩ tʋɔŋ tapʋl-bumbuŋ lɛ nɛ ba suomo ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA, arɩ ba fa ha bɩ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la gentine bile ma kala. Ba suomi Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wasa saanɩŋ

english_verse: King Cyrus of Persia had said the Israelites could have cedar trees brought from Lebanon to Joppa by sea. So they sent grain, wine, and olive oil to the cities of Tyre and Sidon as payment for these trees, and they gave money to the stoneworkers and carpenters.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ moribiee pɩ dɩɩ-saaraa arɩ kapɩntaba, a joŋ kʋdiilee, kʋnyʋalaa arɩ nʋʋŋ pɩ Sɩdɔŋ arɩ Taaya tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba kɛŋ kuolu doloo duori mʋgʋ-balɩŋ a lɩɩ Lɛbanɔŋ a kɔ Jopa, arɩ Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoro Siirus sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: During the second month of the second year after the people had returned from Babylonia, they started rebuilding the Lord's temple. Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned started working. Every Levite over
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋ Wɩa dɩa leriŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ, jɩ-lɩa tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-lɩa lɛ, Sɩalɩtɩɛl nanʋala Zerubabɛl, Jozadak nanʋala Jesua, arɩ ba naambiiriŋ kala suomi tɩntɩmɩɩ-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara a kaa mʋ, dɩ ba beŋ dɩ ba saa La TƖƖNA dɩa-la.

english_verse: The Levites in charge of the whole project were Joshua and his sons and relatives and Kadmiel and his sons from the family of Hodaviah. The family of Henadad worked along with them.
translation_verse: Jesua arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, a pɛ Kadɩmɩɛl arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ lɛ , a bɩra pɛ Hɛnadad hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ nihee arɩ ba ma naambiiriŋ lɛ, ba kala ŋaa Levi doho nɩaa nɛ. Ba kala pɛ a bibeŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ saa Wɩa dɩa-la nɛ.

english_verse: When the builders had finished laying the foundation of the temple, the priests put on their robes and blew trumpets in honor of the Lord, while the Levites from the family of Asaph praised God with cymbals. All of them followed the instructions given years before by King David.
translation_verse: Dɩɩ-saara-la sɩ bil La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la gentine, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa laalɛ ba tɩntɩnnɩ-gɛnnɩŋ, a kori nyilliŋ. Levi doho nɩaa ma kori buguloo, ba chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa dɩ ba dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro Devit sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: They praised the Lord and gave thanks as they took turns singing: “The Lord is good! His faithful love for Israel will last forever.” Everyone started shouting and praising the Lord because work on the foundation of the temple had begun.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA a lɔllʋ a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA wɩaa zɔmɔ, ʋ sɩ cho Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋɩɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala faasa ŋaa goŋ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, a tɩŋ ba sɩ bil La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la gentine.

english_verse: Many of the older priests and Levites and the heads of families wept bitterly because they remembered seeing the first temple years before. But others were so happy that they celebrated with joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Ama, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɩ-bɩnɩa-la jesiŋ, Levi doho nɩaa arɩ dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ fa sɩ na bumbuŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la, ŋmoo niiŋ ba sɩ na lɛɛlɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la gentine ba sɩ bile, ka nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ-na ŋaa goŋ a jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: Their shouting and crying were so noisy that it all sounded alike and could be heard a long way off.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala fa bɩ wuo jɩŋ tʋɔtɔrɛ goŋ-la arɩ yele-la bʋa, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ fa chaasa ŋaa goŋ nɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ hɛ dɩ-bolii ma, ŋ jaŋ nɩɩ goŋ-la.

english_verse: The enemies of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin heard that the people had come back to rebuild the temple of the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Juda arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ nɩa dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ wasaa saa La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la,

english_verse: So they went to Zerubbabel and to the family leaders and said, “Let us help! Ever since King Esarhaddon of Assyria brought us here, we have worshiped your God and offered sacrifices to him.”
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɔ Zerubabɛl arɩ dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ teeŋ a bʋl, “Má leŋ dɩ la pɛ ma lɛ a saa dɩa-la, bɛɛ wɩaa la ma nagɛ ma nɛ a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa-la ma sɩɩ chʋɔlʋ. La ma kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pʋpʋ nɛ a lɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ Asiiria kuoro Ɛsahadɔŋ sɩ kɛnla kɔ daha.”

english_verse: But Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the family leaders answered, “You cannot take part in building a temple for the Lord our God! We will build it ourselves, just as King Cyrus of Persia commanded us.”
translation_verse: Ama Zerubabɛl, Jesua arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩ-la nɩkaanaa bʋl, “Ma bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ la lɛ dɩ la saa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la. La dʋndʋŋa jaŋ saa dɩa-la a pɩ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, arɩ Pɛsɩa kuoro Siirus sɩ dagɛ la ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Then the neighboring people began to do everything possible to frighten the Jews and to make them stop building.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔnɔ golliba ŋɩŋaa wɩaa dɩ Juda nɩaa nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ, dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba dɩ ba sɩ wuo saa dɩa-la.

english_verse: In the first year that Xerxes was king, the neighboring people brought written charges against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Zɛzɛs sɩ buumo dii kuoruŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔnɔ golliba bʋl wɩaa a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩpɩ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa.

english_verse: Later, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their advisors got together and wrote a letter to Artaxerxes when he was king of Persia. It was written in Aramaic and had to be translated.
translation_verse: Pɛsɩa kuoro Atazɛzɛs ma kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ, Bɩsɩlam, Mɛfɩrɛdaf, Tabɛɛl, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ pɩ Atazɛzɛs. Aramek yikoro nɛ ba fa kaa ŋmʋnsɛ teŋ-la, dɩ ba karɩmɛ a dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ pɩ kuoro.

english_verse: This letter said: Your Majesty King Artaxerxes, we are your servants from everywhere in Western Province, and we send you our greetings.
translation_verse: Teŋ-la ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa tʋɔŋ wɩaa nɛ ŋ-la, “Kuoro Atazɛzɛs, la-na ŋ tɩntɩnnaa sɩ lɩɩ Yufireti wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩŋ:

english_verse: You should know that the Jews who left your country have moved back to Jerusalem and are now rebuilding that rebellious city. In fact, they have almost finished rebuilding the walls and repairing the foundations.
translation_verse: Kuoro, laa chɛ ŋ jɩŋ arɩ Juu tɩmma-la sɩ lɩɩ ŋ teeŋ a kɔ Jerusalɛm wasaa saa tabal-la nɩaa sɩ ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ aa vɩa kuoroo niiŋ nɛ. Ba wasaa saa jebie-la nɛ arɩ ba gentisiŋ.

english_verse: You should also know that if the walls are completed and the city is rebuilt, the Jews won't pay any kind of taxes, and there will be less money in your treasury.
translation_verse: Kuoro, ŋ bɩra maga dɩ ŋ jɩŋ dɩ ba nɛ saa tabalɩŋ deeŋ a wasɛ ʋ jebiee kala, ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ titiŋ lampooba. Dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa, ŋ lampoo moribiee jaŋ muuri.

english_verse: We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ la sɩ maga dɩ la tutoŋ, a bɩ jaŋ wuo bibeŋ ka dɩ nɩaa ŋaa wɩaa lileeniŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ laa pɩŋ duoso deeŋ,

english_verse: If you look up the official records of your ancestors, you will find that Jerusalem has constantly rebelled and has led others to rebel against kings and provinces. That's why the city was destroyed in the first place.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋ leŋ dɩ ba beŋ ŋ naabalɩmaba tenniŋ tʋɔŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ bene, ŋ jaŋ na arɩ tabalɩŋ deeŋ nɩaa ŋaa nɩa sɩɩ vɩa kuoroo niiŋ nɛ, a wʋwalɩmɛ kuoroo arɩ tinteyee sɩpaalaaraa faafaa kala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba chei tabal-la ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If Jerusalem is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will no longer have control over Western Province.
translation_verse: Kuoro, laa chɛ ŋ jɩŋ, dɩ ba nɛ wasa saa tabalɩŋ deeŋ arɩ ʋ jebiee, ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ tɩɩ Yufireti wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.”

english_verse: King Artaxerxes answered: Greetings to Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and to your advisors in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
translation_verse: Kuoro ma bʋl ŋ-la a pɩba: Laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ Rehum, Sɩmɩsaɩ sɩ ŋaa teŋ-ŋmʋnsʋra arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ sɩ hɛ Samarɩa arɩ Yufireti wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ leree dɔnsʋŋ, mɩɩ chʋɔlɛma.

english_verse: After your letter was translated and read to me,
translation_verse: “Teŋ-la ma sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩla, ba karɩmʋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ, a kaa bɩrɩmɛ mɩ yikoro lɛ a pɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I had the old records checked. It is true that for years Jerusalem has rebelled and caused trouble for other kings and nations.
translation_verse: Mɩ pa wombiiŋ nɛ ba beŋ a na dɩ tabalɩŋ deeŋ nɩaa kɛŋ kuoroo yuyuo yuosuŋ nɛ faafaa kala, ba ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ kuoroo niiŋ ka sɛɩ nɛ a ŋaa yuo-hɛɛrɛɛ.

english_verse: And powerful kings have ruled Western Province from Jerusalem and have collected all kinds of taxes.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm fa kɛŋ kuori duoruŋ sɩɩ beŋ Yufireti wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ kala, ba tiŋ lampooba pɩpɩba.

english_verse: I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ má bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ dɩ ba leŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la, dɩ ba sɩ wasa saa tabal-la see dɩ mɩ pɩba wombiiŋ.

english_verse: Do this at once, so that no harm will come to the kingdom.
translation_verse: Má pʋpɔ ma sɩ́ wɩɩŋ deeŋ vɩa. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa deemba kanfugo pʋŋa pɩpɛ, a chichei kuoro tʋɔŋ?”

english_verse: As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city. Work on the Temple Starts Again
translation_verse: Ba sɩ karɩmɛ kuoro Atazɛzɛs teŋ-la pɩ Rehum sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ, Sɩmɩsaɩ sɩ ŋaa teŋ-ŋmʋnsʋra, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ, ba guu mʋ Juu tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kiriba ba leŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la.

english_verse: The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ lɛ nɛ ba leŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la saanɩŋ a mʋ yi Daarus sɩ dii Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-lɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord God of Israel told the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to speak in his name to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. And they did.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la dɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa balɩa Hagaɩ arɩ Zɛkarɩya sɩ ŋaa Ido doho nʋʋ bʋl wɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ a pɩ Juu tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: So Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the priest urged the people to start working on the temple again, and God's prophets encouraged them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɩalɩtɩɛl nanʋala Jerubabɛl arɩ Jozadak nanʋala Jesua sii dɩ ba wasa saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ a pɩpɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who told you to rebuild this temple?
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, Tatenai sɩ ŋaa Yufireti wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ arɩ Sɛta-Bozenai arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ mʋ ba teeŋ a pɩɛsɛba, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ pɩma wombiiŋ dɩ ma kʋ wasa saa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ, dɩ ʋ jebiiŋ chɩŋ?”

english_verse: Give us the names of the workers!”
translation_verse: Ba bɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ saa dɩa-la yɩraa nɛ bɛɛ?”

english_verse: But God was looking after the Jewish leaders. So the governor and his group decided not to make the people stop working on the temple until they could report to Darius and get his advice.
translation_verse: Ama ba Wɩa sɩaa fa pɛ ba lɛ nɛ, a bibeŋ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ, ba bɩ wuo giriba dɩa-la saanɩŋ lɛ see bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ Daarus ʋ ma bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ pɩba.

english_verse: Governor Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai, and their advisors sent a report to Darius,
translation_verse: Tatenai sɩ ŋaa Yufireti wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ arɩ Sɛta-Bozenai arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teŋ-la pɩ kuoro Daarus nɛ ŋ-la.

english_verse: which said: King Darius, we wish you the best!
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa nɛ ŋ-la, “Kuoro Daarus, laa chʋɔlʋŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: We went to Judah, where the temple of the great God is being built with huge stones and wooden beams set in the walls. Everyone is working hard, and the building is going up quickly.
translation_verse: Kuoro, laa chɛ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ arɩ la mʋ Juda tinteeŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, lee-la ba sɩɩ saa Wɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩɩ-bal-la. Nɩalɩŋ kɛŋ tabɩaa sɩ jalɩa nɛ a sɩsaa a joŋ doloo hɩhɛ jebiee lɛ. Ba fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ nɛ a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ʋ mʋmʋ sɩpaaŋ arɩ ba sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: We asked those in charge to tell us who gave them permission to rebuild the temple.
translation_verse: La pɩɛsɛ ba nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ pɩma wombiiŋ dɩ ma wasa saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la dɩ ʋ jebiee chɩŋ?’

english_verse: We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.
translation_verse: La bɩra pɩɛsɛba ba yɩraa, dɩ la wuo ŋmʋnsɛ ba nɩhɩasɩŋ yɩraa bil dɩ ŋ jɩmba.

english_verse: They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla pɩla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘La ŋaa Wɩa sɩ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, la wasaa saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la ba sɩ saa faafaa kala nɛ, dɩa-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoru-bal kʋbala fa sɩ saa dɛrɛ.

english_verse: We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple,
translation_verse: Ama a tɩŋ la naabalɩmaba sɩ ŋaa Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ baanɩŋ sii wɩaa, ʋ jomba hɛ Nebukadineza sɩ ŋaa Chalɩdɩ tɩɩna a ŋaa Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ chei Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ aŋ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ

english_verse: Sheshbazzar then went to Jerusalem and laid the foundation for the temple, and the work is still going on.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɛsɩbaza kɔ a bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la gentine Jerusalɛm lɛ. A lɩɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la a kaa kɔ, ba haa saa dɩa-la nɛ, ba ha bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.
translation_verse: Kuoro dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɔ, leŋ dɩ ba gbilli kuoroo tenniŋ tʋɔŋ, Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, a na dɩ kuoro Siirus sɛnɛ pa wombiiŋ nɛ dɩ ba wasa saa Wɩa dɩa-la Jerusalɛm lɛ. Kuoro, ŋɩɩ harɩŋ leŋ dɩ la jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: King Darius ordered someone to go through the old records kept in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Daarus pa wombiiŋ, ba gbilli kuoroo tenniŋ dɩ-biliŋ kala Babɩlɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Finally, a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of Media Province, and it said: This official record will show
translation_verse: Ba na teŋ kʋbala Ɛkɩbatana tabalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Midia tinteeŋ lɛ, dɩ ba ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba hɛ ʋ lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: that in the first year Cyrus was king, he gave orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem, so that sacrifices and offerings could be presented there. It is to be built
translation_verse: Kuoro Siirus sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-bumbuŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ pa wombiiŋ dɩ ba wasa saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la Jerusalɛm lɛ, dɩ ʋ ŋaa lee ba sɩ jaŋ ŋɩŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Má bil ʋ gentine, dɩa-la leŋiŋ jaŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ fii, dɩ ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ fii.

english_verse: with one row of wooden beams for each three rows of large stones. The royal treasury will pay for everything.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ tabɩɩ-jalaa saa jebii-naasɩŋ batori, a joŋ doloo daŋ bala a pɛ. Chɩŋ-la kala ma sɩ ŋmobo maga ma lɩɩsɛ kuori dɩa dʋa tʋɔŋ nɛ a tiŋ.

english_verse: Then the gold and silver things that Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple and brought to Babylonia are to be returned to their proper places. King Darius Orders the Work To Continue
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩa sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ Nebukadineza fa sɩ paa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ, a kaa kɔ Babɩlɔŋ, ʋ maga ma mɩɩra paaba a kaa mʋ bil ba dɩpɩnɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ba maga ba mʋ pɩŋ ba dɩpɩnɩŋ nɛ Wɩa dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: King Darius sent this message: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and Shethar Bozenai, you and your advisors must stay away from the temple.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, ŋ-na Tatenai sɩ ŋaa Yufireti wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ, Sɛta-Bozenai arɩ ma tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ beŋ tintee-la, má lɩɩsɛ ma nɩsɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: Let the Jewish governor and leaders rebuild it where it stood before. And stop slowing them down!
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma niiŋ joŋo hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ. Má leŋ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ wasa saa Wɩa dɩa-la dɩ ʋ chɩŋ ʋ dɩchɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil.
translation_verse: Kʋŋkala ba sɩɩ chɛ: nɛ-bel-pɔrɔɔ, pie-belliŋ, pie-bel-biisiŋ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ, mɩaa, yɩsɩŋ, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ. Kɩaa deemba Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ sɩ jaŋ chɩchɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ma pɩba nɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala, a sɩ́ ba vɔŋ.

english_verse: I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ba wuo ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ tʋɔŋ, aŋ sʋl Wɩa pɩ mɩ-na kuoro arɩ mɩ hambolibiisiŋ dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ pɩla.

english_verse: If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩraa pɩ wombiiŋ, arɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kɛŋ niiŋ deeŋ bɩrɩmɛ, ʋ maga ba lɩɩsɛ ʋ dɩa doluŋ dɔŋɔ, a saa dol-la niiŋ dɔŋɔ, a joŋ nɩɩ-la tɔɔ gɩrɩgɛ ʋ lɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ dɩa-la bɩrɩmɛ pupuluŋ.

english_verse: I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully. The Temple Is Dedicated
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ Wɩa sɩ leŋe ʋ yɩrɩŋ hɛ lee-la, yuo kuoru na-kala koo nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wombiiŋ deeŋ bɩrɩmɛ koo a chei Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Mɩ-na Daarus nɛ pa wombiiŋ deeŋ. Nʋʋkala maga ʋ to wombiiŋ deeŋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ. Ba saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la dɛrɛ a joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ

english_verse: With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩ-la bɩra sɩsaa dɩa-la. Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa Hagaɩ arɩ Zɛkarɩya sɩ ŋaa Ido doho nʋʋ fa bʋl wɩaa nyaasɛ ba nyuŋ nɛ woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la dɛrɛ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, arɩ Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoroo deemba Siirus, Daarus arɩ Atazɛzɛs ma sɩ pa wombiiŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
translation_verse: Ba saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la dɛrɛ chɛnɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ada tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ nɛ, dɩ Daarus ma sɩ dii kuoruŋ, ʋ jɩ-dʋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Levi doho nɩaa arɩ nɩkaana-la kala sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ, kala gbieli arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a joŋ Wɩa dɩa-la hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Ba sɩɩ chɛ ba joŋ Wɩa dɩa-la hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba kpʋ nɛ-belliŋ zɔlɔ nɛ, pie-belliŋ ma zɔɔ-balɩa, pie-bel-pɔrɔɔ ma zɔɔ-banɛsɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ba kpʋ gbuŋgbogusuŋ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ a ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, gbuŋgbogu bala kala chɩŋ Iziral doho doho-la dɔŋɔ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written. The Passover
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa kaa kpaa kpaa ba tɩtɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa Jerusalɛm lɛ, arɩ teŋ-la Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. Dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa fii arɩ banɛsɛ chɛɛŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ gbieli dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la.

english_verse: The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa fa pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta nɛ aŋ ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ Wɩa wombiiŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Levi doho nɩaa kpʋ ba tɩtɩa dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal pie-bie, a kpʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ, arɩ ba naambiiriŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal pie-biisiŋ.

english_verse: The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ chaŋ nammɩa-la, a pɛ nɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ lɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa disiŋ wɩalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ, a ŋaa siri dɩ ba to Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa.

english_verse: For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_verse: Ba gbieli gbiele-la ba sɩ yie gbieli a dii boroboro sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ nɛ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA leŋe tʋɔtɔrʋŋ vɔgɛba nɛ, ʋ sɩ kɛŋ Asiiria kuoro tʋɔŋ bɩrɩmɛ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ ba saa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: Much later, when Artaxerxes was king of Persia, Ezra came to Jerusalem from Babylonia. Ezra was the son of Seraiah and the grandson of Azariah. His other ancestors were Hilkiah, Shallum, Zadok, Ahitub, Amariah, Azariah, Meraioth, Zerahiah, Uzzi, Bukki, Abishua, Phinehas, Eleazar, and Aaron, the high priest. Ezra was an expert in the Law that the Lord God of Israel had given to Moses, and the Lord made sure that the king gave Ezra everything he asked for.
translation_verse: Ɛzɩra deeŋ lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ nɛ a kɔ Jerusalɛm. Ʋ faa dagɛ nɩaa nɛ, a jɩŋ wombie-la La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ joŋo dagɛ Mosis ʋ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto woruŋ. Kuoro fa pʋ kʋŋkala ʋ sɩ pɩɛsaa chɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa, ʋ Tɩɩna Wɩa fa chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Other Jews, including priests, Levites, musicians, the temple guards, and servants, came to Jerusalem with Ezra. This happened during the seventh year that Artaxerxes was king.
translation_verse: Atazɛzɛs sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ tʋɔŋ nɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ, a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Levi doho nɩaa, yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa, boi-pɔɔrɔɔ arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnaa to Ɛzɩra harɩŋ kɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ a suomi ʋ wombiiŋ deeŋ vɛnɩŋ, chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋl-bumbuŋ lɛ nɛ, a kʋ yi Jerusalɛm chɛŋ-nɔŋ tapʋl-bumbuŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ Wɩa naduo-la fa daŋ ʋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
translation_verse: Teŋ-la kuoro Atazɛzɛs sɩ ŋmʋnsa joŋ dɔŋɔ pɩ Ɛzɩra nɛ ŋ-la. Ɛzɩra fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ nɛ, a dɩdagɛ nɩaa, a jɩŋ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa wʋdagaa arɩ ʋ niiriŋ woruŋ:

english_verse: Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Atazɛzɛs sɩ ŋaa kuoroo kala kuoro nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ aa pɩ ŋ-na Ɛzɩra sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, aŋ pɛ bɩra ŋaa nʋʋ sɩɩ dagɛ nɩaa Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ wombiee. Mɩɩ chʋɔlʋŋ.

english_verse: Any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom may go with you to Jerusalem if they want to. My seven advisors and I agree that you may go to Jerusalem and Judah to find out if the laws of your God are being obeyed.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na kuoro arɩ mɩ nɩaa balɩpɛ-la sɩ bʋl wɩaa a chɩchagɩlɛmɛ tɩmɩŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ mʋ a beŋ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm a na ŋɩɩ nɩaa sɩɩ to Wɩa wombie-la ba sɩ joŋo hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra maga dɩ ŋ pɛ paa hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la mɩ-na kuoro arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlɛmɛ sɩ joŋo pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa la tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ, ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋ maga dɩ ŋ paa warɩpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la kala ŋ sɩ laa Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ joŋo pa ba tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ dɩ ba kaa saa ba Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ moribiee deemba a yɔɔ nɛ-belliŋ, pie-belliŋ arɩ pie-bel-biisiŋ, a pɛ ba mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ba kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa lɛ. Kpʋ kɩaa deemba a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la koruŋ nyuŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God.
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩ ŋ naambiiriŋ Juu tɩŋŋaa, jaŋ wuo kɛŋ warɩpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la sɩ ka a ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ma sɩ cho, arɩ wɩɩ-la sɩɩ tɔrɛ ma Wɩa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Give your God the other articles that have been contributed for use in his temple.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ joŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ joŋo pɩŋ a pɩ Wɩa Jerusalɛm lɛ, dɩ ba kaa tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Kʋŋkala ma ŋ ha sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ kaa tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, ŋ jaŋ wuo lɩɩsɛ kuori dɩa dʋa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na kuoro Atazɛzɛs bʋla pɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la kala sɩɩ beŋ Yufireti wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ dʋa arɩ ba pɩ Ɛzɩra sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, aŋ pɛ dɩdagɛ nɩaa Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ wombiee kʋŋkala ʋ sɩ pɩɛsaa chɛ.

english_verse: tons of silver,
translation_verse: Zɛrahɩa, Uzi, Buki,

english_verse: They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me.
translation_verse: Ma maga ma fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a chɛ kɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ sɩ daga dɩ ba kaa saa ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la nɛ, dɩ ʋ baanɩŋ sɩ́ mɩ nyuŋ koo nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ to mɩ harɩŋ dii kuoruŋ nyuŋ sii.

english_verse: We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ wombii kɛnɛ dɩ ma laa lampoo nɩaa deemba teeŋ: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Levi doho nɩaa, yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa, boi-pɔɔrɔɔ, Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnaa koo nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-bal-la lɛ.

english_verse: Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na Ɛzɩra, kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩŋ, a lɩɩsɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ sarɩya diiree dɩ ba bibeŋ Yufireti wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ŋ Wɩa wombiee. Ʋ maga ŋ dagɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ Wɩa wombie-la jɩŋ.

english_verse: Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away. Ezra Praises God
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bɩ ŋ Wɩa wombie-la koo kuoro wombiee to, ʋ maga ŋ guu dɔgɩsɛ tɩɩna nɛ. Ŋ jaŋ kpʋʋ, koo ŋ kiru ta ʋ lɩɩ tintee-la lɛ, koo ŋ kɛŋ ʋ dʋa kala laa koo ŋ kɛnʋ tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa. Ɛzɩra dɛnnɛ Wɩa

english_verse: Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said: Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɛzɩra sɩ, “Má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, la naabalɩmaba Wɩa. Ʋ leŋe kuoro zil ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la nɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, kuoro, ʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlʋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa nɩduoruŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ nɛ. Mɩ Wɩa pɩmɛ tʋɔ-doluŋ nɛ, mɩ wuo bʋl wɩaa pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyɩŋ-nɩaa nɩhɩasɩŋ jesiŋ ba to mɩ harɩŋ a mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm.”

english_verse: Artaxerxes was king of Persia when I led the following chiefs of the family groups from Babylonia to Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩ-la fa sɩ mʋ yoŋ-baga Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ lɛ aŋ mɩɩra to Ɛzɩra harɩŋ a kɔ Jerusalɛm bʋa-la lɛ Atazɛzɛs sɩ ŋaa kuoro nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: Gershom of the Phinehas family; Daniel of the Ithamar family; Hattush son of Shecaniah of the David family; Zechariah and
translation_verse: Bɩgɩvaɩ doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ, Utai arɩ Zakɔ a pɛ baalaa mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii lɛ. Ba mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm

english_verse: I said to the priests: You belong to the Lord, the God of your ancestors, and these things also belong to him. The silver and gold were willingly given as gifts to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ joŋ ma dɩ kɩaa deemba kala hɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Hɔpʋla-la arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la ŋaa tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩaa nɛ a pɩ La TƖƖNA, ma naabalɩmaba Wɩa.

english_verse: I brought everyone together by the river that flows to the town of Ahava where we camped for three days. Not one Levite could be found among the people and priests.
translation_verse: Mɩ yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ kala kʋ hilimi lɩɩ-libe kʋbala ba sɩ kpɛrɛ ʋ lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ mʋmʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ahava dɩɩrɩŋ. La hɔŋ nɩmɛ tapʋlaa batori nɛ. Mɩ sɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tʋɔŋ, mɩ bɩ Levi doho nʋʋkala na.

english_verse: So I sent for the leaders Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam. I also sent for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were very wise counselors.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tɩma yɩrɛ sɩpaalaaraa deemba nibi: Elieza, Arɩɛl, Sɛmaaya, Ɛlɩnataŋ, Jarɩb, Ɛlɩnataŋ, Netaŋ, Zɛkarɩya arɩ Mesulam, Joyarib arɩ Ɛlɩnataŋ. Nɩaa deemba kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Then I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, and I told them to ask him and his temple workers to send people to serve in God's temple.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tɩmba Ido sɩ ŋaa sɩpaalaarʋ Kasɩfɩa lɛ teeŋ. Mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩ Ido arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔsʋŋ, Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ tɩntɩnnaa, dɩ ba pɩla nɩaa sɩ jaŋ kʋ tɩtɩŋ la Wɩa dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: God was kind to us and caused them to send a skillful man named Sherebiah, who was a Levite from the family of Mahli. Eighteen of his relatives came with him.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ Wɩa naduo-la fa sɩ daŋ la lɛ wɩaa, ba pɩla Sɛrɛbɩa sɩ chaasa ŋaa baal, a ŋaa Levi doho nʋʋ, a lɩɩ Mali doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ fii arɩ chori ma to ʋ harɩŋ kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: We were also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the family of Merari along with
translation_verse: Ba fa leŋe Hasabɩa arɩ Jesaaya sɩ ŋaa Mɛrarɩ doho nɩaa ma kɔ nɛ, a pɛ ʋ naambiiriŋ arɩ ba biiriŋ lɛ, ba kala ŋaa baalaa mara.

english_verse: Beside the Ahava River, I asked the people to go without eating and to pray. We humbled ourselves and asked God to bring us and our children safely to Jerusalem with all of our possessions.
translation_verse: La sɩ hɛ Ahava lɩɩ-libe-la ba sɩ kpɛrɛ leriŋ, mɩ leŋ la vɔɔ niiŋ, dɩ la kɛŋ la tɩtɩa muuri la Wɩa sɩpaaŋ dɩ la dɩ la biiriŋ vɛŋ la wombiiŋ woruŋ arɩ la kɩaa kala.

english_verse: So we went without food and asked God himself to protect us, and he answered our prayers. The Gifts for the Temple
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la vɔɔ niiŋ aŋ sʋl la Wɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ la wombii-la vɛnɩŋ lɛ, ʋ laa la sʋla.

english_verse: I chose twelve of the leading priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their relatives.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa fii arɩ balɩa: Sɛrɛbɩa, Hasabɩa arɩ ba naambiiriŋ fii.

english_verse: Be sure to guard them and keep them safe until you reach Jerusalem. Then weigh them inside God's temple in the presence of the chief priests, the Levites, and the heads of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Má pɔ kɩalɩŋ woruŋ a kɛmba mʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, a magɩsɛba chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩ-la lɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ.”

english_verse: The priests and Levites then took charge of the gifts that had been weighed, so they could take them to the temple of our God in Jerusalem. The Return to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa laa hɔpʋla-la, sɛlɩmɛ arɩ Wɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ magɩsa dɩ ba kaa mʋ la Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: On the twelfth day of the first month, we left the Ahava River and started for Jerusalem. Our God watched over us, and as we traveled along, he kept our enemies from ambushing us.
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋl fii arɩ balɩa chɛɛŋ nɛ la sii Ahava lɩɩ-libe-la ba sɩ kpɛrɛ leriŋ dɩ la mʋ Jerusalɛm. La Wɩa nɩsɩŋ fa daŋ la lɛ nɛ, a pɔla a lɩɩsɛla dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ arɩ gaara-la sɩɩ faa wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: After arriving in Jerusalem, we rested for three days.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la mʋ yi Jerusalɛm, a wiesi nɩmɛ tapʋlaa batori.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day we went to God's temple, where the silver, the gold, and the other things were weighed and given to the priest Meremoth son of Uriah. With him were Eleazar son of Phinehas and the two Levites, Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
translation_verse: Tapʋl nɛsɛ chɛɛŋ, la jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a magɩsɛ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la a pɛ Wɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ lɛ a joŋo hɛ Yuria nanʋala Mɛrɛmɔf sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Finihas nanʋala Elieza ma fa hɛ ʋ teeŋ nɛ, a pɛ Levi doho nɩaa Jesua sɩ ŋaa Jozabad nanʋala arɩ Binui nanʋala Nʋadɩa lɛ.

english_verse: goats were sacrificed for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Azigad ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Hakataŋ nanʋala Johanaŋ arɩ baalaa zɔlɔ arɩ fii.

english_verse: Some of those who had returned took the king's orders to the governors and officials in Western Province. Then the officials did what they could for the people and for the temple of God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ teŋ-la ma kuoro sɩ ŋmʋnsa a pɩ Yufireti wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɛ Iziral tɩmma-la lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Later the Jewish leaders came to me and said: Many Israelites, including priests and Levites, are living just like the people around them. They are even guilty of some of the horrible sins of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
translation_verse: La sɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala harɩŋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa kɔ mɩ teeŋ a bʋl, “Iziral tɩŋŋaa, a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa lɛ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɩɩsa wʋkɩsɩa-la nɩwogusu-la sɩ golliba sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ: Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa, Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa, Jebus tɩŋŋaa, Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa, Mʋab tɩŋŋaa, Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Some Israelite men have married foreign women and have let their sons do the same thing. Our own officials and leaders were the first to commit this disgusting sin, and now God's holy people are mixed with foreigners.
translation_verse: Ba jaa nɩaa deemba toloo nɛ, aŋ jaa pɩ ba hambolibiisiŋ ma, a leŋ Wɩa nɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ guoli nɩwogusuŋ tʋɔŋ. Sɩpaalaaraa arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ nɛ paala laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ a chei.”

english_verse: This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Ɛzɩra sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, mɩ kɛŋ mɩ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ, a lɛrɛ mɩ nyu-pʋnaa arɩ tɔŋŋɔɔ churi aŋ hɔŋ a kala vɔgɛ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ.

english_verse: until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners. Ezra's Prayer
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ fá Wɩa kɔ mɩ teeŋ, a tɩŋ wʋbɔŋ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Ka mɩ hɔŋ a kala vɔgɛ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ ŋaa dɩdaanɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms,
translation_verse: Dɩdaanɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ bʋa-la lɛ, mɩ sii lee-la mɩ fa sɩ hɔnɔ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ, aŋ ha laalɛ gɛnnɩ-la mɩ sɩ kaa kɩɛsɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tuu kpirimi mɩ naadʋsʋŋ nyuŋ a kɛŋ nɩsaa je mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa teeŋ,

english_verse: and prayed: I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens.
translation_verse: a sʋlʋ a bʋl, “Ou mɩ Wɩa, hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ arɩ mɩ sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ sɩaa je ŋ sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chʋɔra nɛ a sii kɩɩ la nyusuŋ. La wʋcheelee paala jɩla yiyi wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Since the time of our ancestors, all of us have sinned. That's why we, our kings, and our priests have often been defeated by other kings. They have killed some of us and made slaves of others; they have taken our possessions and made us ashamed, just as we are today.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ la naabalɩmaba bʋa lɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ, la wʋcheelee chaasa yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ. A tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ŋ joŋ la dɩ la kuoroo arɩ ŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ kuoroo nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba kpʋla, a laa la kɩaa, aŋ kɛsɛ la dɔnsʋŋ kaa mʋ tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa. La dii hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, arɩ jɩnɩmba la ha sɩɩ dii hɩɩsɩŋ ŋɩɩ.
