english_verse: But for now, Lord God, you have shown great kindness to us. You made us truly happy by letting some of us settle in this sacred place and by helping us in our time of slavery.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ, La TƖƖNA Wɩa, ŋ fá nisusuŋ a pɩla wiese mʋa nɛ, a leŋ la nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ ka a bɩ sʋba, ŋ pɩla leriŋ nɛ ŋ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ. Ŋ laala ta nɛ la fa sɩ ŋaa yosi lɛ a leŋ la na pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: We are slaves, but you have never turned your back on us. You love us, and because of you, the kings of Persia have helped us. It's as though you have given us new life! You let us rebuild your temple and live safely in Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: La fa ŋaa yosi ma nɛ, ama ŋ-na la Wɩa bɩ la vɩa ta la yoŋ-baga-la lɛ. Ŋ dagɛ ŋ zile pɩla nɛ a leŋ Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoro cho la wɩaa, a leŋ la kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ dɩ la wasa saa ŋ dɩa-la a bɩrɩmɛ lere-la kala sɩ cheye, ŋ leŋe la Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa hɔŋ nɛ wɩɩ bɩ la walɩmɛ.

english_verse: Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands
translation_verse: Ama la Wɩa, wʋbɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩaa deemba kala harɩŋ lɛ? La bɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga to,

english_verse: that were given to us by your servants the prophets. They said the land you are giving us is full of sinful and wicked people, who never stop doing disgusting things.
translation_verse: wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ to ŋ tɩntɩnnaa sɩ ŋaa ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ a dagɛla. Ba bʋla pɩla, ‘Tintee-la ma sɩɩ mʋ, ʋ nɩaa ŋaa disiniŋ a chei ʋ kala nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ ŋaa wʋkɩsaa a leŋ ʋ kala kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.’

english_verse: And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters. Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má sɩ́ ma toloo joŋo pɩ ba biiriŋ dɩ ba jaa, koo a jaa ba toloo a pɩ ma hambolibiisiŋ. Ma pʋpɔ má dɩ ba sɩ niiŋ pɛ a ŋaa nandɔsɛ, ka dɩ ma wuo kɛŋ doluŋ a dii tintee-la kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ ka pɩ ma biiriŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba dʋa a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa la lɛ, la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ la wʋcheelee sɩ faasa yʋgɛ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ. Ama ŋ-na la Wɩa, ŋ bɩ la dɔgɩsɔ a magɛ ŋɩɩ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ maga, aŋ leŋ la dɔnsʋŋ ka a bɩ sʋba.

english_verse: Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all!
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, ʋ sɛnɛ bɩra magɛ dɩ la dɩ nɩaa deemba sɩɩ ŋaa wʋkɩsaa deemba jɩjaa dɔŋɔ ba toloo? Dɩ la nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ chaasa na baanɩŋ la nyuŋ a cheila dɩ la kʋbala ma bɩra sɩ kaa?

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ. Ŋ leŋe la dɔnsʋŋ ka nɛ a bɩ sʋba. La kɔ ŋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ arɩ la cheeriŋ, arɩ la sɩ jɩma arɩ la bɩ wombiiŋ kɛnɛ dɩ la kɔ ŋ sɩpaaŋ ma kala.”

english_verse: While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Ɛzɩra fa sɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa aŋ pɛ dɩdagɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa chei, a yiyel a foro titel Wɩa dɩa sɩpaaŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩ-daŋ, baalaa, haalaa arɩ hambiisiŋ kʋ chɩna gollu, a ma faasa yiyel.

english_verse: Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said: Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛhɩɛl nanʋala Sɛkanɩa, Ɛlam doho nɩaa dɔŋɔ bʋla pɩ Ɛzɩra, “La bɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ to la sɩ jaa nɩwogusuŋ sɩ golli la toloo. Ama la Iziral tɩŋŋaa ha kɛŋ yɩɛlaa nɛ.

english_verse: if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, má leŋ dɩ la bil niiŋ la dɩ la Wɩa pɛgɛ, aŋ kiri haala-la arɩ ba biiriŋ dɩ ba viiri. La jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ŋ-na mɩ kʋhɩaŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ zil la Wɩa sɩ daga. Má leŋ dɩ la ŋaa ŋɩɩ Wɩa wombiiŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
translation_verse: Sii chɩŋ, wɩɩŋ deeŋ hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, la jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ aŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la.”

english_verse: Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛzɩra sii chɩŋ, a leŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa, a pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala lɛ ba ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ ba jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la Sɛkanɩa sɩ bʋla. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋmɩɛsɛ.

english_verse: Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛzɩra sii Wɩa dɩa-la sɩpaaŋ, a mʋ Ɛlɩasɩb nanʋala Jehohanaŋ dɩa, a chʋa nɩmɛ. Ama ʋ bɩ kʋŋkala die, ʋ bɩ lɩɩŋ ma nyʋa nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa haa yel nɛ a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ sɩ bɩ Wɩa niiŋ to.

english_verse: The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bɩ kɔ a kaa mʋ yi tapʋlaa batori pɛgɛ, ba jaŋ laa ʋ dʋa kala, arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, aŋ kiru ta nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Three days later, on the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone from Judah and Benjamin came to Jerusalem and sat in the temple courtyard. It was a serious meeting, and they sat there, trembling in the rain.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa batori-la pɛgɛ, chɛŋ-nibi tapʋl mara chɛɛŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, baala-la kala sɩ hɛ Juda arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ lɛ kɔ Jerusalɛm, a hɔŋ ba dɩ-hilimiŋ, Wɩa dɩa-la sɩpaaŋ. Ba tʋɔŋ kala fa chaasa chei nɛ a tɩŋ hilime-la arɩ duonuŋ fa sɩɩ nɩɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: Ezra the priest stood up and said: You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Ɛzɩra sii chɩŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Ma bɩ Wɩa niiŋ to, aŋ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa cheeriŋ wasɛ yʋgɛ.

english_verse: Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, má dagɛ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa chei a pɩ La TƖƖNA ma naabalɩmaba Wɩa aŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ. Má pɔrɛ ma tɩtɩa a lɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ gollima tʋɔŋ arɩ tintee-wogusuŋ toloo-la ma sɩ jaa lɛ.”

english_verse: Everyone in the crowd shouted: You're right! We will do what you say.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hilime faasa suri ba yikorusuŋ a laa bʋl, “Ŋ bʋl woruŋ nɛ, la maga la ŋaa ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ bʋla nɛ.

english_verse: But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
translation_verse: Ama la faasa yʋgɛ nɛ daha, ka ʋ ŋaa yibiiŋ ma. La bɩ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ jeeŋ harɩŋ. Bɩra ma, wɩɩŋ deeŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɛrɛ chɛ-bala koo tapʋlaa balɩa pɛgɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la chaasa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ woruŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ la tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ laa la kala nyuŋ a ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩla. Leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ la tasɩŋ lɛ a jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo kɔ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ daga, ba dɩ taŋ-la sɩpaalaaraa arɩ sarɩya diiree, a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA baaŋ-la ʋ sɩ faasa na la nyuŋ a tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa sɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ.”

english_verse: Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba-na fa bɩ wɩɩ-la sɛyɛ, Asahɛl nanʋala Jonataŋ arɩ Tɩkɩva nanʋala Jazeya, Mesulam Sabɛtaɩ sɩ ŋaa Levi doho nʋʋ ma chɩŋ ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ba sɩ daga. Ɛzɩra sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara lɩɩsɛ dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ. Ba kʋbala kala chɩŋ ʋ nyɩŋ-nɩaa nyuŋ, ba ŋmʋnsɛ ba kala yɩraa. Chɛŋ-fii tapʋl-bumbuŋ chɛɛŋ, ba suomi dɩ ba beŋ wɩalɩŋ na.

english_verse: and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year. The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
translation_verse: Ʋ mʋʋ yi chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋl-bumbuŋ chɛɛŋ, dɩ ba bʋl wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo wɩaa a dɛrɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo

english_verse: Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer;
translation_verse: Ima ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Hanani arɩ Zɛbadɩa.

english_verse: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim;
translation_verse: Harɩm ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Maasɛya, Ɩlaaja, Sɛmaaya, Jɛhɩɛl arɩ Uzia.

english_verse: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.
translation_verse: Pasɩhɔ doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo nɛ ŋ-la: Elionai, Maasɛya, Ɩsɩmɛl, Nɛtanɛl, Jozabad arɩ Ɛlasa.

english_verse: Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ, nɩaa deemba nɛ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo: Jozabad, Sɩmɛɩ, Kɛlaaya , Pɛtahɩa, Juda arɩ Elieza.

english_verse: Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife. These temple guards had foreign wives: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
translation_verse: Yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa ma tʋɔŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaa tintee wogo tolo nɛ Ɛlɩasɩb. Boi-pɔɔrɔɔ ma tʋɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo nɛ, Salum, Tɛlɛm arɩ Uri.

english_verse: Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma-la tʋɔŋ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toolo nɛ ŋ-la: Parɔs doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Ramɩa, Izia, Malɩkɩja, Mɩjamɩŋ, Eliaza, Malɩkɩja dɔŋɔ arɩ Bɛnaaya.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
translation_verse: Elam ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ: Matanɩa, Zɛkarɩya, Jɛhɩɛl, Abidi, Jɛrɛmɔf arɩ Ɩlaaja.

english_verse: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
translation_verse: Zatu ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ: Elionai, Ɛlɩasɩb, Matanɩa, Jɛrɛmɔf, Zabad arɩ Aziza.

english_verse: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
translation_verse: Bɛbaɩ ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Jehohanaŋ, Hananaaya, Zebai arɩ Afɩlaɩ.

english_verse: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
translation_verse: Banɩ doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ: Mesulam, Maluk, Adaaya, Jasub, Sɩal arɩ Jɛrɛmɔf.

english_verse: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
translation_verse: Pahaf-Mʋab ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ: Adɩna, Kɛlal, Bɛnaaya, Maasɛya, Matanɩa, Bɛzalɛl, Binui arɩ Manasɛ.

english_verse: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
translation_verse: Hasum doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ: Matɛnaɩ, Mataata, Zabad, Ɛlɩfɛlɛt, Jɛrɛmaɩ, Manasɛ arɩ Sɩmɛɩ.

english_verse: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
translation_verse: Nebo doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ: Jɛyɛl, Matɩtɩa, Zabad, Zebina, Jadaɩ, Jowɛl arɩ Bɛnaaya.

english_verse: These men divorced their foreign wives, then sent them and their children away.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba kala fa jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo nɛ, ba dɔnsʋŋ kɛŋ haala-la a lʋl biiriŋ.

english_verse: I am Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and in this book I tell what I have done. During the month of Chislev in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes ruled Persia, I was in his fortress city of Susa,
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Hakalɩa nanʋala Nɛhɩmaaya sɩ bʋla: Atazɛzɛs sɩ dii Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ mara tʋɔŋ, chɛnɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɩsɩlɛ lɛ, dɩ mɩ-na Nɛhɩmaaya hɛ dɩ-duo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sʋsa sɩ ŋaa ba tabalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: when my brother Hanani came with some men from Judah. So I asked them about the Jews who had escaped from being captives in Babylonia. I also asked them about the city of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hanani arɩ baalaa dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Juda tinteeŋ kɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩɛsɛba a mʋ tɩgɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɩkaana-la sɩ bɩ sʋba aŋ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ, a bɩra pɩɛsɛ ba Jerusalɛm ma wɩaa.

english_verse: They told me, “Those captives who have come back are having all kinds of troubles. They are terribly disgraced, Jerusalem's walls are broken down, and its gates have been burned.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ sʋba yoŋ-baga lɛ mɩɩra kɔ tintee-la nɛ a chaasa hɛ wʋwalɩmaa arɩ hɩɩsɩŋ tʋɔŋ. Jebii-la sɩ golli Jerusalɛm kala nɛ ba ŋmoo lo a nyɩgɛ ʋ boi-baalaa kala.”

english_verse: When I heard this, I sat down on the ground and cried. Then for several days, I mourned; I went without eating to show my sorrow, and I prayed:
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ nɩɩ wɩaa deemba, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ hɔŋ a yel. Mɩ yel tapʋl daŋ, a vɔɔ niiŋ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Lord God of heaven, you are great and fearsome. And you faithfully keep your promises to everyone who loves you and obeys your commands.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Ou, La TƖƖNA Wɩa, ŋ sɩ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ, ŋ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ, la chaasa fɩfáŋ. Ŋ kɛŋ nii-la sɩ hɛ ŋ dɩ ŋ nɩaa pɛgɛ kaa tɩtɩŋ nɛ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ choŋ a tuto ŋ wʋdagaa.

english_verse: I am your servant, so please have mercy on me and answer the prayer that I make day and night for these people of Israel who serve you. I, my family, and the rest of your people have sinned
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, suri sɩaa pɩmɛ, aŋ jegile nɩɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna teeŋ, ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩɩ sʋlʋŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ a pɩpɩ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Mɩ dagɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa ŋ lɛ aa pɩŋ nɛ. Mɩ dɩ mɩ naabalɩmaba kala ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: by choosing to disobey you and the laws and teachings you gave to your servant Moses.
translation_verse: La ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ŋ lɛ, a bɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga to. La bɩ ŋ niiriŋ arɩ wombie-la ŋ sɩ to ŋ tɩntɩnna Mosis lɛ a joŋo dagɛla to.

english_verse: Please remember the promise you made to Moses. You told him that if we were unfaithful, you would scatter us among foreign nations.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, liisi wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla pɩ ŋ tɩntɩnna Mosis a bʋl: ‘Dɩ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ kɛmma pɩsa hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But you also said that no matter how far away we were, we could turn to you and start obeying your laws. Then you would bring us back to the place where you have chosen to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ bɩra mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma, dɩ ma nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kɛsɛ mʋ yoŋ-baga nɛ paala hɛ dɩ-bolii ma, mɩ jaŋ kɛmba lɩɩ nɩmɛ a kaa kɔ lee-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ba chʋɔlɛmɛ nɩmɛ.’

english_verse: Our Lord, I am praying for your servants—those you rescued by your great strength and mighty power.
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnaa arɩ ŋ nɩaa nɛ. Ba nɛ ŋ kɛŋ ŋ dol-balɩŋ arɩ ŋ naduo-la laa ta ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Please answer my prayer and the prayer of your other servants who gladly honor your name. When I serve the king his wine today, make him pleased with me and let him do what I ask.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna, jegile nɩɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna sʋla arɩ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa dɔnsʋŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, la nɩalɩŋ sɩ choŋ a ziziliŋ. Leŋ dɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna cheŋ nyu-sɩmɩŋ, a leŋ dɩ kuoro tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ.” Bʋa deeŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ fa ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ kori kuoru-la nyʋnyʋala.

english_verse: During the month of Nisan in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king, I served him his wine, as I had done before. But this was the first time I had ever looked depressed.
translation_verse: Atazɛzɛs sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ mara tʋɔŋ, chɛnɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nisaŋ lɛ nɛ tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala, ba kɛŋ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ kɔ dɩ ba pʋ. Mɩ laa sɩŋ-la kaa mʋ pɩ kuoro. Mɩ tʋɔŋ ha bɩ cheye ʋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ ka.

english_verse: So the king said, “Why do you look so sad? You're not sick. Something must be bothering you.” Even though I was frightened,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ kɛŋ sɩaa chei aŋ bɩ wɩɩlɛ ma? Wɩɩŋ deeŋ naga tʋɔ-chei wɩɩ nɛ jʋʋŋ.” Fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛmmɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: I answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! I feel sad because the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.”
translation_verse: Ama mɩ bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Kuoro, a leŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ duomi. Mɩ tʋɔŋ cheye bɛɛ wɩaa, tabal-la lɛ ba sɩ hugi mɩ naabalɩmaba pɩŋ jikpeeŋ nɛ, ʋ boi-baalaa ma kala nɛ nyiniŋ dii chei.”

english_verse: The king asked, “What do you want me to do?” I prayed to the God who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ saa ŋ chɩchɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sʋl Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ,

english_verse: Then I told the king, “Sir, if it's all right with you, please send me back to Judah, so that I can rebuild the city where my ancestors are buried.”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɛ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna nyuŋ, dɩ ŋ cho dɩ ŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ a pɩmɛ, leŋ dɩ mɩ mʋ Juda tinteeŋ tabal-la lɛ ba sɩ hugi mɩ naabalɩmaba a paa tabal-la wasa saa.”

english_verse: The queen was sitting beside the king when he asked me, “How long will it take, and when will you be back?” The king agreed to let me go, and I told him when I would return.
translation_verse: Dɩ kuoro haala fa hɔŋ ʋ sɛmɛ, ka ʋ pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Ŋ nɛ mʋa, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ diene magɛ aŋ mɩɩra kɔ?” Kuoro tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɔ nɛ ʋ cho dɩ mɩ mʋa, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ dagɛ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ a pʋ.

english_verse: Then I asked, “Your Majesty, would you be willing to give me letters to the governors of the provinces west of the Euphrates River, so that I can travel safely to Judah?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra bʋla pʋ, “Kuoro dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɛ ŋɩɩ lɛ, ŋɩɩ-na ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ pɩ mɩ dɩ mɩ kaa mʋ a pɩ Yufireti fuo-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ dɩ ba pɩmɛ wombiiŋ dɩ mɩ mʋ Juda tinteeŋ.

english_verse: I will need timber to rebuild the gates of the fortress near the temple and more timber to construct the city wall and to build a place for me to live. And so, I would appreciate a letter to Asaph, who is in charge of the royal forest.” God was good to me, and the king did everything I asked.
translation_verse: Bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ dɔŋɔ ma dɩ mɩ joŋo pɩ Asaf, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ ŋ duuŋ dɩ ʋ pɩmɛ doloo dɩ mɩ kaa ŋaa dɩ-duo-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boi-baalaa, a pɛ tabal-la kɛrɛ arɩ lee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ jʋjʋʋ lɛ. A tɩŋ mɩ Wɩa naduo-la sɩ daŋ mɩ lɛ wɩaa, kuoro sɛɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ pɩɛsa chɩchɛ.”

english_verse: The king sent some army officers and cavalry troops along with me, and as I traveled through the Western Provinces, I gave the letters to the governors.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mʋ Yufireti fuo-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ teeŋ, a joŋ kuoro tenni-la a pɩba. Kuoro fa leŋe laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ja-jɩllaa to mɩ harɩŋ mʋ nɛ.

english_verse: But when Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what had happened, they became very angry, because they didn't want anyone to help the people of Israel. Nehemiah Inspects the Wall of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Sanbalat sɩ ŋaa Horo tɩɩna, arɩ Tobia ma sɩ ŋaa Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ba faasa na baanɩŋ a tɩŋ nʋʋ sɩ kɔ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔmʋŋ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wɩaa. Nɛhɩmaaya gɔllɔ beŋ Jerusalɛm kɛrɩsɩŋ

english_verse: Three days after arriving in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mʋ Jerusalɛm a hɛ nɩmɛ tapʋlaa batori,

english_verse: I got up during the night and left my house. I took some men with me, without telling anyone what I thought God wanted me to do for the city. The only animal I took was the donkey I rode on.
translation_verse: tɩtaŋ kʋbala, mɩ dɩ baalaa baŋmɛnɛ lɩɩ gɔllɛ. Mɩ fa bɩ wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo hɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Jerusalɛm lɛ bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala. Mɩ fa bɩ pʋna kala kaa to mɩ harɩŋ lɩɩ, see kakumo-la mɩ sɩ jɩla dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: I went through Valley Gate on the west, then south past Dragon Spring, before coming to Garbage Gate. As I rode along, I took a good look at the crumbled walls of the city and the gates that had been torn down and burned.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ-la mɩ to boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Fuonaaŋ Boi-baalɩŋ nɛ lɩɩ a chaasɛ vil-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jolluŋ Viliŋ a mʋ yi boi-baal-la ma ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nɛ-bɩnɩŋ Boi-baalɩŋ a gɔllɔɔ beŋ Jerusalɛm jebie-la ba sɩ ŋmoo lo, arɩ ʋ boi-baala-la nyiniŋ sɩ dii chei.

english_verse: On the east side of the city, I headed north to Fountain Gate and King's Pool, but then the trail became too narrow for my donkey.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mʋ boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lɩɩ-bulo Boi-baalɩŋ a to ŋɩɩ mʋ fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kuoroo Pɩlɩŋ leriŋ. Ama leriŋ fa bɩ yʋgɛ dɩ mɩ kakumo wuo to bal.

english_verse: So I went down to Kidron Valley and looked at the wall from there. Then before daylight I returned to the city through Valley Gate.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tuu fuonaa-la tɩtaŋ-la a gɔllɔɔ beŋ jebii-la, a bɩra mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ a to Fuonaaŋ Boi-baal-la mɩ sɩ to kʋ lɩɩ a jʋʋ.

english_verse: None of the city officials knew what I had in mind. And I had not even told any of the Jews—not the priests, the leaders, the officials, or any other Jews who would be helping in the work.
translation_verse: Taŋ-la tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ fa bɩ jɩŋ lee-la mɩ sɩ mʋa koo wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa. Mɩ fa ha bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla pɩ mɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, tintee-la nɩbalaa, ba tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ koo nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la.

english_verse: But when I got back, I said to them, “Jerusalem is truly in a mess! The gates have been torn down and burned, and everything is in ruins. We must rebuild the city wall so that we can again take pride in our city.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩba, “Ma tɩtɩa na wʋwalɩmɩa-la tʋɔŋ la sɩ hɛ nɛ. Jerusalɛm kala pɩŋ jikpeeŋ nɛ, ba nyɩgɛ ʋ boi-baalaa ma. Má kɔ dɩ la paa Jerusalɛm jebii-la wasa saa, a tɔ la hɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: Then I told them how kind God had been and what the king had said. Immediately, they replied, “Let's start building now!” So they got everything ready.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩba ŋɩɩ Wɩa naduo-la sɩ daŋ mɩ lɛ arɩ wɩɩ-la kuoro sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ. Nɩalɩŋ bʋl, “Leŋ la suomo paa jebii-la wasa sɩsaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba suomi tɩntɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: When Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard about our plans, they started insulting us and saying, “Just look at you! Do you plan to rebuild the walls of the city and rebel against the king?”
translation_verse: Ama Sambalat arɩ Tobia a pɛ Arab tɩɩna ma ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gesem sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ba mɔŋ-la a sisierila a bʋl, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ maa ŋaa ŋ-la? Maa vɩa kuoro niiŋ nɛ koo?”

english_verse: I answered, “We are servants of the God who rules from heaven, and he will make our work succeed. So we will start rebuilding Jerusalem, but you have no right to any of its property, because you have had no part in its history.”
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋla pɩba, “Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ jaŋ pɛ la lɛ dɩ la tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la dɛrɛ. La ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, la jaŋ suomo sɩsaa jebii-la. Ama ma-na bɩ kpaal kala kɛnɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, a bɩ ʋ naaba wɩaa tʋɔŋ ma lɛ pɛ.”

english_verse: These are the people who helped rebuild the wall and gates of Jerusalem: The high priest Eliashib and the other priests rebuilt Sheep Gate and hung its doors. Then they dedicated Sheep Gate and the section of the wall as far as Hundred Tower and Hananel Tower.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛlɩasɩb sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔnsʋ-la ma sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara suomi ba tɩntɩŋŋaa, a wasa paa boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Piesee boi-baalɩŋ saa. Ba joŋo pɩ Wɩa, aŋ hɛ ʋ borusuŋ a saaʋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi dɩɩ-leŋii-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zɔlɔ arɩ Hananɛl Dɩɩ-duduoŋ-la a joŋ ba ma pɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: The people of Jericho rebuilt the next section of the wall, and Zaccur son of Imri rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Jeriko nɩaa ma nɛ saa tɩgɛ ba lɛ. Imiri nanʋala Zaku ma saa tɩgɛ Jeriko nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: The family of Hassenaah built Fish Gate. They put the beams in place and hung the doors, then they added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Hasɛna hambolibiisiŋ ma nɛ wasa paa Chenfilee Boi-baalɩŋ saa. Ba hɛ ʋ daa-doloo arɩ ʋ borusuŋ a pɛ ʋ hɔɔnʋŋ lɛ arɩ daasɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa gɩgɩrɩgɛ borusu-la lɛ.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, completed the next section of the wall. Meshullam, son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, rebuilt the next section, and Zadok son of Baana rebuilt the section beside that.
translation_verse: Mɛrɛmɔf sɩ ŋaa Yuria nanʋala, a ŋaa Hakɔs ma nihiŋ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ. Mesulam sɩ ŋaa Bɛrɛkɩa nanʋala a ŋaa Mɛsɛzabɛl ma nihiŋ ma nɛ wasa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Baana nanʋala Zadɔk ma nɛ wasa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ Mesulam lɛ.

english_verse: The next section was to be repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their town leaders refused to do the hard work they were assigned.
translation_verse: Tɛkʋa tɩŋŋaa ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Ama ba nɩbalaa vɩa dɩ ba tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ bemba ba tɩtɩŋ sɩ dagɛba nɛ.

english_verse: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah restored Ancient Gate. They put the beams in place, hung the doors, and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Pasɩa nanʋala Joyada arɩ Besodeya nanʋala Mesulam nɛ wasa saa boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jesana Boi-baalɩŋ. Ba hɛ ʋ daa-doloo arɩ ʋ borusuŋ a pɛ ʋ hɔɔnʋŋ lɛ arɩ daasɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa gɩgɩrɩgɛ borusu-la.

english_verse: Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, and the men from Gibeon and Mizpah rebuilt the next section of the wall. This section reached as far as the house of the governor of West Euphrates Province.
translation_verse: Mɛlatɩa sɩ lɩɩ Gibioŋ, Jadɔŋ sɩ lɩɩ Mɛrɔnɔf arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ Gibioŋ arɩ Mizipa ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Ba saa ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi Yufireti fuo-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ dɩa.

english_verse: Uzziel son of Harhaiah the goldsmith rebuilt the next section. Hananiah the perfume maker rebuilt the section next after that, and it went as far as Broad Wall.
translation_verse: Hahaaya nanʋala Ʋzɩɛl sɩ ŋaa sɛlɩmɛ gɔgɔ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Hananaaya ma sɩ ŋaa tʋlaalɩ-ŋaarʋ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Ba wasa saa Jerusalɛm ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi Je-bii Jalɩɩ-la.

english_verse: Rephaiah son of Hur ruled half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Huu nanʋala Refaaya sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm tinteeŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ Hananaaya lɛ.

english_verse: The section after that was close to the home of Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and he rebuilt it. Hattush son of Hashabneiah constructed the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Harumaf nanʋala Jedaaya ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Lee-la fa kpagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa dɩa nɛ. Hasabineya nanʋala Hatus ma nɛ bɩra saa tɩgɛ Jedaaya lɛ.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath Moab rebuilt the section after that, and they also built Oven Tower.
translation_verse: Harɩm nanʋala Malɩkɩja arɩ Pahaf-Mʋab nanʋala Hasub ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga arɩ tabʋʋ-pumoo dɩɩ-leŋii-la.

english_verse: Shallum son of Hallohesh ruled the other half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. Shallum's daughters also worked with him.
translation_verse: Halɔhɛs nanʋala Salum sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm tinteeŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Ʋ toloo ma fa pɛ ʋ lɛ ba tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la nɛ.

english_verse: Hanun and the people who lived in the town of Zanoah rebuilt Valley Gate. They hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. They also rebuilt the wall for
translation_verse: Hanuŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ Zanʋa lɛ ma nɛ wasa saa Fuonaaŋ Boi-baal-la. Ba saaʋ nɛ, a hɛ ʋ borusuŋ a pɛ ʋ hɔɔnʋŋ lɛ arɩ daasɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa gɩgɩrɩgɛ borusu-la. Ba fa bɩra wasa saa jebii-la naakieliŋ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Nɛ-bɩnɩŋ Boi-baal-la.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Rechab ruled the district of Beth-Haccherem, and he rebuilt Garbage Gate. He hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Rekab nanʋala Malɩkɩja sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm sɛmɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf Hakerem ma nɛ wasa saa Nɛ-bɩnɩŋ Boi-baal-la. Ʋ saaʋ nɛ a hɛ ʋ borusuŋ arɩ ʋ hɔɔnʋŋ arɩ daasɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa gɩgɩrɩgɛ borusu-la.

english_verse: Shallum son of Colhozeh ruled the district of Mizpah, and he rebuilt Fountain Gate. He put a cover over the gateway, then hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. He also rebuilt the wall at Shelah Pool. This section was next to the king's garden and went as far as the stairs leading down from David's City.
translation_verse: Koli-Hoze nanʋala Salum sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm sɛmɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mizipa ma nɛ wasa saa Lɩɩ-bul-sɩɩŋ Boi-baal-la. Ʋ saaʋ nɛ a pilimi, a hɛ ʋ borusuŋ arɩ ʋ hɔɔnʋŋ arɩ daasɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa gɩgɩrɩgɛ borusu-la. Ʋ bɩra wasa saa jebii-la sɩ hɛ Sɛla fuo-la leriŋ a tɩgɛ Kuoro Gaarɩŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi lusuŋ-chol-sɩa-la sɩɩ lɩɩ Devit tabal-la lɛ.

english_verse: Nehemiah son of Azbuk ruled half of the district of Beth-Zur, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. It went as far as the royal cemetery, the artificial pool, and the army barracks. Levites Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Azibuk nanʋala Nɛhɩmaaya sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm sɛmɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf-zuu kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi kuoroo dɩ-huguŋ sɩ hɛ Devit tabalɩŋ lɛ arɩ pɩl-la ba sɩ luo a pɛ bawajɩaba dɩa-la lɛ.

english_verse: The Levites who worked on the next sections of the wall were Rehum son of Bani; Hashabiah, who ruled half of the district of Keilah and did this work for his district;
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ ma bɩra sɩ wasa saa jebii-la sɩ tɩgɛ Azibuk lɛ nɛ ŋaa Levi doho nɩaa. Banɩ nanʋala Rehum nɛ bemba ba saa. Hasabɩa sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm sɛmɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɛɛla kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, ma nɛ laa lee-la nɩaa ʋ sɩɩ beŋ nyuŋ a saa tɩgɛ.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad, who ruled the other half of the district of Keilah;
translation_verse: Hɛnadad nanʋala Bavaɩ sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm sɛmɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɛɛla kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la dɔŋɔ ma, ʋ ma nɛ wasa saa tɩgɛ.

english_verse: Ezer son of Jeshua, who ruled Mizpah, rebuilt the section of the wall that was in front of the armory and reached to the corner of the wall;
translation_verse: Jesua nanʋala Ɛza sɩɩ beŋ ba tinteeŋ sɛmɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mizipa ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga, a kpagɛ ba laalɩyuori kɩaa dɩ-biliŋ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi lee-la jee-la sɩ gʋra.

english_verse: Baruch son of Zabbai eagerly rebuilt the section of the wall that went all the way to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest;
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la ma bɩra sɩ wasa saa tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ŋaa Zabaɩ nanʋala Baruk. Ʋ wasa saa lee-la nɛ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ a chɩŋ lee-la jee-la sɩ gʋra a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ Ɛlɩasɩb dɩa boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built up to the far end of Eliashib's house. Priests Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la ma sɩ wasa saa tɩgɛ nɛ ŋaa Mɛrɛmɔf sɩ ŋaa Yuria nanʋala, a ŋaa Hakɔs ma nihiŋ. Ʋ ma chɩŋ Ɛlɩasɩb dɩa boiŋ niiŋ nɛ aŋ wasa saa mʋ yagɛ ʋ dɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who worked on the wall: Priests from the region around Jerusalem rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ hɛ lee-la ma nɛ wasa paa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ saa.

english_verse: Benjamin and Hasshub rebuilt the wall in front of their own houses. Azariah, who was the son of Maaseiah and the grandson of Ananiah, rebuilt the section in front of his house.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamɩŋ arɩ Hasub ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ ba dɩa sɩpaaŋ. Azarɩa sɩ ŋaa Maasɛya nanʋala, aŋ ŋaa Ananɩa ma nihiŋ nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ ʋ ma dɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad rebuilt the section of the wall from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.
translation_verse: Henadad nanʋala Binui ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga, a chɩŋ Azarɩa dɩa sɩpaaŋ a kaa mʋ yagɛ jee-la sɩ gʋra ʋ gʋnʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Palal son of Uzai rebuilt the next section, which began at the corner of the wall and the tower of the upper palace near the court of the guard. Pedaiah son of Parosh rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Uzai nanʋala Palal ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga, a chɩŋ je-gʋŋ-la lɛ a kaa mʋ dɩɩ-leŋii-la sɩ hɛ kuoru dɩa-la ba sɩ saa sugili nyuŋ, a kpagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ kaala. Nɩalɩŋ ma bɩra sɩ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga nɛ ŋaa Parus nanʋala Pedaaya

english_verse: He stopped at a place near the Water Gate on the east and the tower guarding the temple. This was close to a section in the city called Ophel, where the temple workers lived. Other Builders Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnaa sɩ hɛ Ɔfɛl dundolo-la nyuŋ. Ba wasa saa ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ challɛ Lɩɩŋ Boi-baal-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ dɩɩ-leŋii-la sɩ chɔŋɔ lɩɩ.

english_verse: The men from Tekoa rebuilt the next section of the wall, and it was their second section. It started at a place across from the large tower that guarded the Temple, and it went all the way to the wall near Ophel.
translation_verse: Tɛkʋa nɩaa ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ, a chɩŋ dɩɩ-leŋii-la sɩ chɔŋɔ lɩɩ lɛ a kaa mʋ yi Ɔfɛl jeeŋ.

english_verse: Some priests rebuilt the next section of the wall. They began working north of Horse Gate, and each one worked on a section in front of his own house.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ Janɩŋ Boi-baalɩŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Ba kʋŋkala paa lee-la sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩa sɩpaaŋ nɛ a wasa saa.

english_verse: Zadok son of Immer rebuilt the wall in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, who looked after the East Gate, rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Ima nanʋala Zadɔk ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ a challɛ ʋ dɩa. Sɛkanɩa nanʋala Sɛmaaya sɩɩ pɔ Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ Boi-baalɩŋ ma wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ Zadɔk lɛ.

english_verse: Hananiah and Hanun rebuilt the next section, which was the second section for them. Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt the next section, which happened to be in front of his house.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛmaaya nanʋala Hananaaya arɩ Hanuŋ sɩ ŋaa Zalaf hambolibii-dʋ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Bɛrɛkɩa nanʋala Mɛsʋlam ma nɛ wasa saa tɩgɛ ba lɛ a challɛ ʋ dɩa.

english_verse: Malchijah, a goldsmith, rebuilt the next section, as far as the house used by the temple workers and merchants. This area was across from Gathering Gate, near the room on top of the wall at the northeast corner.
translation_verse: Malɩkɩja sɩ ŋaa sɛlɩmɛ tɩntɩnnʋ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la tɩgɛ Mɛsʋlam lɛ. Ʋ fa saa jee-la ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnaa dɩa arɩ bayalaa dɩa, a chaasɛ boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ gbilli nɩaa a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi dɩa-la sɩ hɛ jee-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa gʋnʋŋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The goldsmiths and merchants rebuilt the last section of the wall, which went from the corner room all the way to Sheep Gate.
translation_verse: Sɛlɩmɛ tɩntɩnna-la arɩ bayalɩa-la ma nɛ wasa saa dɩ-kaaŋ-la, a chɩŋ dɩa-la sɩ hɛ je-gʋŋ-la nyuŋ a kaa mʋ yi Piesee boi-baalɩŋ.

english_verse: When Sanballat, the governor of Samaria, heard that we were rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem, he became angry and started insulting our people.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sambalat sɩ nɩa dɩ la wasa paa jebii-la a sɩsaa nɛ, ʋ baanɩŋ chaasa sii woruŋ, ʋ sisieri la-na Juu tɩŋŋaa lɛ

english_verse: In front of his friends and the Samaritan army he said, “What is this feeble bunch of Jews trying to do? Are they going to rebuild the wall and offer sacrifices all in one day? Do they think they can make something out of this pile of scorched stones?”
translation_verse: a bʋl ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ arɩ Samarɩa laalɩyuori hɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ, “Bɛɛ kɩaa wɩaa nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɩpʋgʋnʋŋ deemba ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ? Ba jaŋ wuo wasa saa ba jebii-la a kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩ-sʋlaa? Ba bɩɩna ba jaŋ wuo saaʋ dɛrɛ tapʋl bala koo? Ba bɩɩna ba jaŋ wuo kuusi tabɩa-la arɩ nyiniŋ sɩ diiba ma kala koo?”

english_verse: Tobiah from Ammon was standing beside Sanballat and said, “Look at the wall they are building! Why, even a fox could knock over this pile of stones.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Tobia sɩ ŋaa Amɔŋ tɩɩna ma fa chɩŋ Sambalat sɛmɛ, a bʋl, “Kʋ-la ba sɩɩ saa, dɩ jolo ma nɛ paala jɩlʋ, ʋʋ bori ʋ tel nɛ.”

english_verse: But I prayed, “Our God, these people hate us and have wished horrible things for us. Please answer our prayers and make their insults fall on them! Let them be the ones to be dragged away as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sʋl Wɩa a bʋl, “La Wɩa, nɩɩ, ba bee muurila nɛ, leŋ dɩ jomo-la ba sɩ tʋʋsɛla gʋra dɛrɛ ba nyuŋ lɛ. Leŋ dɩ nɩaa kʋ laa ba kɩaa aŋ kɛsɛba mʋ tintee-wogo dɩ ba ŋaa yosi.

english_verse: Don't forgive the mean and evil way they have insulted the builders.”
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ba wʋcheelee joŋo chɛba koo a yʋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba tʋʋsɛ la nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ saa jebii-la nɛ.”

english_verse: The people worked hard, and we built the walls of Jerusalem halfway up again.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la wasa saa jebii-la ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi ʋ leŋiŋ kpaa-magɛ dɔŋɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ chaasa tɩŋ nɛ arɩ ba tʋɔŋ kala.

english_verse: But Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the people from the city of Ashdod saw the walls going up and the holes being repaired. So they became angry
translation_verse: Ama Sambalat, Tobia, Arab tɩŋŋaa, Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa arɩ Asɩdɔd tɩŋŋaa sɩ nɩa arɩ Jerusalɛm jebii-la saanɩŋ ka mʋ sɩpaaŋ, wuolo-la kala sɩ hɛ jebii-la lɛ tʋtɔ, ba baanɩŋ sii woruŋ.

english_verse: and decided to stir up trouble, and to fight against the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba kala vʋʋrɛ dɩ ba kʋ hɛ yuosuŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kɛŋ wɩaa vʋgʋmɛ.

english_verse: But we kept on praying to our God, and we also stationed guards day and night.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la ma sʋl la Wɩa, aŋ lɩɩsɛ nɩaa ba pʋpɔ leriŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ vʋʋra lɛ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Judah were singing a sorrowful song: “So much rubble for us to haul! Worn out and weary, will we ever finish this wall?”
translation_verse: Ama Juda nɩaa sɩ, “Tɩntɩnnaa doluŋ kala dɛrɛ nɛ, ka tabɩaa arɩ tɩɛrɩŋ ma daŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ yʋgɛ. Ŋɩɩ leŋ la bɩ jaŋ wuo wasa paa jebii-la saa.”

english_verse: Our enemies were saying, “Before those Jews know what has happened, we will sneak up and kill them and put an end to their work.”
translation_verse: La dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ma bʋl, “Juu tɩmma-la jaŋ kʋ jɩjɩŋ koo a nɩnala dɩ la hɛ ba tʋɔŋ a kpʋba, ka dɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la birigi.”

english_verse: On at least ten different occasions, the Jews living near our enemies warned us against attacks from every side,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la Juu tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ jʋʋ kpɩkpagɛba kʋ lɔgɔ pɩla bʋlɩa bʋlɩa wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ vʋʋra tɩgɛ la lɛ.

english_verse: and so I sent people to guard the wall at its lowest places and where there were still holes in it. I placed them according to families, and they stood guard with swords and spears and with bows and arrows.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ leŋ nɩalɩŋ nyɩgɩlɛ a kori tokobiee, tiŋŋee arɩ tosuŋ a chɩŋ dɩa dɩa, jebii-la lere-la ha sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Then I looked things over and told the leaders, the officials, and the rest of the people, “Don't be afraid of your enemies! The Lord is great and fearsome. So think of him and fight for your relatives and children, your wives and homes!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ wɩaa jim, aŋ bʋla pɩ tinteeŋ nɩbalaa, tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩkaana-la, “Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma a tɩŋ la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Má liisi ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ, nɩaa fɩfáʋ, aŋ yuo laa ma naambiiriŋ, ma hambolibiisiŋ, ma toloo, ma haalaa arɩ ma dɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: Our enemies found out that we knew about their plot against us, but God kept them from doing what they had planned. So we went back to work on the wall.
translation_verse: La dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ nɩa arɩ la nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ vʋʋra a tɩgɛ la lɛ nɛ, Wɩa ma kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ vʋʋra vʋgʋmɛ, Ŋɩɩ nɛ la kala bɩra mʋ wasa sɩsaa jebii-la.

english_verse: From then on, I let half of the young men work while the other half stood guard. They wore armor and had spears and shields, as well as bows and arrows. The leaders helped the workers
translation_verse: A chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la a kaa mʋ, mɩ nɩalɩŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ yie tɩtɩŋ, ka kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ma nyɩgɩlɛ a kori tiŋŋee, hɔɔtaalɩ-la ba sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ arɩ tosuŋ. La tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kala fa chɩna pɔ la Juu tɩŋŋaa nɛ,

english_verse: who were rebuilding the wall. Everyone who hauled building materials kept one hand free to carry a weapon.
translation_verse: a chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ saa jebii-la harɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chʋŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa sɩsaa jebii-la fa yie kɛŋ nɩsɩŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ tɩtɩŋ aŋ kori bayuori kʋa ma nɩsɩŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Even the workers who were rebuilding the wall strapped on a sword. The worker who was to blow the signal trumpet stayed with me.
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnna-la kʋŋkala fa yie gɩrɩgɛ ʋ tokobiiŋ nɛ aŋ tɩtɩŋ. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋʋ banyile-na fa hɛ mɩ teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I told the people and their officials and leaders, “Our work is so spread out, that we are a long way from one another.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩ tintee-la nɩbalaa, tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala, “La tɩntɩmɩɩ-la jalla nɛ, ka la pɩsa golli jebii-la a bol arɩ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: If you hear the sound of the trumpet, come quickly and gather around me. Our God will help us fight.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ nɩa ba ŋmʋʋ banyile, má fá kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lee-la ba sɩ ŋmʋa. La Wɩa jaŋ yuo pɩla.”

english_verse: Every day from dawn to dark, half of the workers rebuilt the walls, while the rest stood guard with their spears.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la ha tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la, a chɩŋ chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ pɔsɔ, baala-la kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ yie chɩna pɔ nɛ a kori tiŋŋee.

english_verse: I asked the men in charge and their workers to stay inside Jerusalem and stand guard at night. So they guarded the city at night and worked during the day.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Nʋʋkala arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ ba tɩtɩŋ maga dɩ ma hɛ Jerusalɛm tʋɔŋ nɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ, aa pɔ leriŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ aŋ tɩtɩŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ ma.”

english_verse: I even slept in my work clothes at night; my relatives, the workers, and the guards slept in theirs as well. And we always kept our weapons close by.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na arɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ arɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna-la sɩɩ to mɩ harɩŋ a pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔmɛ lɛ, la kʋŋkala bɩ la gɛnnɩŋ wuro tɩtaŋɩŋ ma. La kori la bayuori kɩaa nɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: Some of the men and their wives complained about the Jews in power
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ baalaa arɩ ba haalaa sii ŋmoo niiŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ ba naambiiriŋ Juu tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and said, “We have large families, and it takes a lot of grain merely to keep us alive.”
translation_verse: Ba dɔnsʋŋ sɩ, “La dɩ la biiriŋ yʋga, laa chɛ mɩaa nɛ dɩ la dii a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: Others said, “During the famine we even had to mortgage our fields, vineyards, and homes to them in order to buy grain.”
translation_verse: Dɔnsʋŋ ma bʋl, “La joŋ la bagɩsɩŋ, girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ arɩ la dɩɩsɩŋ nɛ aa bil bʋbʋɔŋ ka dɩ la wuo na kʋdiilee dɩ losuŋ sɩ́ la kpʋ.”

english_verse: Then others said, “We had to borrow money from those in power to pay the government tax on our fields and vineyards.
translation_verse: Dɔnsʋŋ ma ha bʋl, “La yie chɩŋ moribiee nɛ a tiŋ la bagɩsɩŋ arɩ la girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ lampooba a pɩ kuoro.

english_verse: We are Jews just as they are, and our children are as good as theirs. But we still have to sell our children as slaves, and some of our daughters have already been raped. We are completely helpless; our fields and vineyards have even been taken from us.”
translation_verse: La ma ŋaa Juu tɩmma nɛ arɩ la naambiiri-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. La biiriŋ zɔmɔ nɛ arɩ ba biiriŋ sɩ zɔmɔ ŋɩɩ, ama wɩaa jʋʋla a magɛ dɩ la leŋ dɩ la biiriŋ ŋaa yosi nɛ. La toloo dɔnsʋŋ paala ŋaa yosi nɛ, ama la bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ tɩɩ bagɩsɩŋ arɩ la girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: When I heard their complaints and their charges, I became very angry.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ nɩɩ ba nii-ŋmobo arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ ŋmɛnɛ, mɩ baanɩŋ chaasa sii woruŋ.

english_verse: So I thought it over and said to the leaders and officials, “How can you charge your own people interest?” Then I called a public meeting and accused the leaders
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ bɩɩnɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ, aŋ bʋl tinteeŋ nɩbala-la arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la teeŋ. Mɩ bʋla pɩba, “Maa laa nyʋʋrʋŋ nɛ ma naambiiriŋ tɩtɩa teeŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ yɩrɛ hilim-bal dɩ mɩ chaasa bʋl ba teeŋ.

english_verse: by saying, “We have tried to buy back all of our people who were sold into exile. But here you are, selling more of them for us to buy back!” The officials and leaders did not say a word, because they knew this was true.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ, “Lɛɛlɛ, la hɛ doluŋ nɛ aŋ mɩɩra time lɩlaa la Juu tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ joŋ ba tɩtɩa yalla pɩ tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa. Lɛɛlɛ ma tɩtɩa mɩɩra fʋgɛ ma naambiiriŋ nɛ dɩ ba joŋ ba tɩtɩa yalla pɩma.” Sɩpaa-laara-la kala tɔrɛ ba niiŋ bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ wɩɩ kɛnɛ dɩ ba bʋl.

english_verse: I continued, “What you have done is wrong! We must honor our God by the way we live, so the Gentiles can't find fault with us.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ ŋaa, ʋ bʋa lɛ dee ŋɩɩ. Ma maga má fá Wɩa nɛ aŋ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ, dɩ tinteye-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to aŋ ŋaa la dʋndɔmɔ sɩ́ wuo na wombiiŋ a sieri la lɛ.

english_verse: My relatives, my friends, and I are also lending money and grain, but we must no longer demand payment in return.
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ arɩ mɩ tɩntɩnnaa ma joŋ moribiee arɩ mɩaa chɩchɩŋ nɩalɩŋ nɛ. Lɛɛlɛ, má leŋ dɩ ma nyʋʋrɩɩ-la laanɩŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Now give back the fields, vineyards, olive orchards, and houses you have taken and also the interest you have been paid.”
translation_verse: Má ŋaa lɩma a joŋ ba bagɩsɩŋ, ba girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ, ba olif tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ba dɩɩsɩŋ pɩba, a pɛ nyʋʋrɩ-la kala ma sɩ laa ba teeŋ, moribiee, mɩaa, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ.”

english_verse: The leaders answered, “We will do whatever you say and return their property, without asking to be repaid.” So I made the leaders promise in front of the priests to give back the property.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ ma bʋl, “La jaŋ mɩɩra joŋ kɩalɩŋ pɩba. La bɩra bɩ jaŋ laa kʋŋkala ba teeŋ.” La jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ bʋla. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ yɩrɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, a leŋ nɩbala-la arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ ba jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: Then I emptied my pockets and said, “If you don't keep your promise, that's what God will do to you. He will empty out everything you own, even taking away your houses.” The people answered, “We will keep our promise.” Then they praised the Lord and did as they had promised. Nehemiah Is Generous
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kɛŋ mɩ gɛrɩpɛ jalɩɩ-la sɩ vɔɔ mɩ tɩŋa puri a kaa kpesi aŋ bʋl, “Ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa jaŋ kɛŋ ma kʋŋkala sɩ jaŋ vɩa dɩ ŋ to niiŋ deeŋ a kpese ta. Wɩa jaŋ laa ŋ dɩa arɩ ŋ dʋa kala ka dɩ ŋ kɛŋ na-hɩllɩŋ.” Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hilimi lee-la bʋl, “Amɩɩ,” aŋ dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA. Ŋɩɩ nɛ sɩpaalaara-la kɛŋ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla tɩŋ.

english_verse: I was governor of Judah from the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king until the thirty-second year. And during these entire twelve years, my relatives and I refused to accept the food that I was allowed.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ lɩɩsɛmɛ mɩ ŋaa Juda tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ, dɩ kuoro Atazɛzɛs ma sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ mara lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ sɩ mʋ yi jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩa lɛ, dɩ mɩ ma sɩ ŋaa Juda tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ balɩa lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ dɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ kʋŋkala bɩ leŋe ba kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yie joŋo pɩ tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ kʋ pɩla.

english_verse: Each governor before me had been a burden to the people by making them pay for his food and wine and by demanding forty silver coins a day. Even their officials had been a burden to the people. But I respected God, and I didn't think it was right to be so hard on them.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa tintee-la nɩhɩasɩŋ aŋ ka pɩmɛ joŋ wʋdaŋ nɛ a nyagɛ nɩalɩŋ nyuŋ. Tapʋlɩɩ kala ba yie laa warɩpʋla mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ, a pɛ ba kʋdiilee arɩ ba girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ ma joŋ wɩaa nyagɛ nɩalɩŋ nɛ. Ama a tɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ fá Wɩa, mɩ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: I spent all my time getting the wall rebuilt and did not buy any property. Everyone working for me did the same thing.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa kala hɛ jebii-la saanɩŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ bɩ tintee kala yɔbɔ. Mɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ tɩmaa pɩmɛ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a ma tɩŋ jebii-la tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Each day one ox, six of the best sheep, and lots of chickens were prepared. Then every ten days, a large supply of wine was brought in. I knew what a heavy burden this would have been for the people, and so I did not ask for my food allowance as governor.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kala mɩ yie lɩɩsɛ nɛ-fere, pie-zɔŋŋɔɔ balɩdʋ, a pɛ jiŋŋee lɛ ba ŋaa kʋdiilee pɩla. Tapʋlaa fii na-kala pɛgɛ, mɩ yie chɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ nɛ a yʋgɛ woruŋ. Arɩ mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba ma kala, mɩ ha bɩ pɩɛsa bʋl nɩalɩŋ pɩmɛ kʋdiile-la sɩ maga dɩ tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ laa, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa sɩ nyagɛ nɩalɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless me for everything I have done for my people.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, liisi mɩ wɩaa aŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa pɩ nɩaa deemba.

english_verse: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem, and our other enemies learned that I had completely rebuilt the wall. All I lacked was hanging the doors in the gates.
translation_verse: Sambalat, Tobia, Arab tɩŋŋaa Gesem arɩ la dʋndɔmɔ-la kala nɩa dɩ mɩ wasa saa Jerusalɛm jebii-la kala wuol bɩ ka. Ama mɩ fa ha bɩ borusuŋ hɛ boi-baal-la lɛ.

english_verse: Then Sanballat and Geshem sent a message, asking me to meet with them in one of the villages in Ono Valley. I knew they were planning to harm me in some way.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sambalat arɩ Gesem tɩŋ tɩndaarɩŋ deeŋ pɩmɛ: “Kɔ dɩ la cheŋ dɔŋɔ tabiisi-la dɔŋɔ sɩ hɛ Ono tintee-taala-la lɛ.” Ama ba faa chɛ wombiiŋ nɛ dɩ ba ŋaamɛ wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: So I sent messengers to tell them, “My work is too important to stop now and go there. I can't afford to slow down the work just to visit with you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tɩŋ nɩaa ba mɩɩra kɛŋ duoso deeŋ mʋ pɩba: Mɩɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-fɩaŋ nɛ mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɔ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo vɩa tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ta aŋ kɔ ma teeŋ

english_verse: They invited me four times, but each time I refused to go.
translation_verse: Naansɩɩŋ bʋnɛsɛ nɛ ba tɩŋ tɩndaarɩ-la tɩtɩa a pɩmɛ. Bʋa na-kala mɩ ma yie bʋl ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa a pɩba.

english_verse: which said: A rumor is going around among the nations that you and the other Jews are rebuilding the wall and planning to rebel, because you want to be their king. And Geshem says it's true!
translation_verse: Teŋ-la tʋɔŋ ŋ-la nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ: “Tinteyee tʋɔŋ nɩaa ka bʋl, arɩ ŋ dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ka vʋʋrɛ nɛ dɩ ma hɛ yuosuŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ma wasaa saa jee-la ŋɩɩ. Ba bɩra bʋla arɩ ŋŋ chɛ ŋ ŋaa ba kuoro nɛ, Gesem ma bʋl arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: You even have prophets in Jerusalem, claiming you are now the king of Judah. You know the Persian king will hear about this, so let's get together and talk it over.
translation_verse: Ŋ paala lɩɩsɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ ba heele bʋl Jerusalɛm lɛ, arɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Juda tinteeŋ kuoro. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ saa jaŋ jʋʋ Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoro dɩgɩlɩŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa kɔ dɩ la bʋl wɩɩ-la a hɛ dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: I sent a message back to Sanballat, saying, “None of this is true! You are making it all up.”
translation_verse: Mɩ mɩɩra bʋl ŋ-la a pʋ: “Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ bʋl kala ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ. Ŋ tɩtɩa tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ ŋ bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Our enemies were trying to frighten us and to keep us from our work. But I asked God to give me strength.
translation_verse: Ba kala faa nɛrɩgɛ dɩ ba fugisila nɛ, dɩ la nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la lɛ, dɩ la sɩ́ wuo dɛrɛ. Ama mɩ sʋl Wɩa a bʋl, “Wɩa, pɩmɛ doluŋ.”

english_verse: One day I went to visit Shemaiah. He wasn't supposed to leave his house, but he said, “Let's hurry to the holy place of the temple and hide there. We will lock the temple doors, because your enemies are planning to kill you tonight.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala mɩ mʋ Sɛmaaya dɩa. Sɛmaaya fa ŋaa Delaaya nanʋala nɛ, aŋ ŋaa Mɛhɛtabɛl ma nihiŋ, ʋ fa hɛ dɩa lɛ nɛ ʋ bɩ lɩɩ. Ʋ bʋl, “Leŋ mɩ dɩŋ mʋ faa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ ʋ boyee tɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩaa nɩɩ kɔ dɩ ba kpʋŋ. Tɩtaŋɩŋ baa kɔ dɩ ba kpʋŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: I answered, “Why should someone like me have to run and hide in the temple to save my life? I won't go!”
translation_verse: Ama mɩ bʋla pʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ-na baala sɩ magɛ ŋ-la jaŋ fá fɩfaa? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ jaŋ jʋʋ faa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ laa mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ? Mɩ bɩ mʋ.”

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that God had not given Shemaiah this message. But Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him to trick me
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma arɩ Wɩa dee bɩ ʋ tɩma, ama Sambalat arɩ Tobia nɛ kpalʋ ka dɩ ʋ nyɩsɛmɛ arɩ wɩaa deemba.

english_verse: and to frighten me into doing something wrong, because they wanted to ruin my good name.
translation_verse: Ba kpalʋ nɛ ka dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩaa a yʋɔrɛ mɩ nandaasɩŋ dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, dɩ ba to ŋɩɩ lɛ a chei mɩ yɩrɩŋ a hɩɩsɩ mɩ.

english_verse: Then I asked God to punish Tobiah and Sanballat for what they had done. I prayed that God would punish the prophet Noadiah and the other prophets who, together with her, had tried to frighten me. The Work Is Finished
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a bʋl, “Mɩ Wɩa, liisi wɩalɩŋ Tobia arɩ Sambalat sɩ ŋaa, liisi haal-la sɩ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ baa yɩrɛ Nʋadɩa arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la dɔnsʋŋ kala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba fugusimi wɩaa.” Ba saa kɛrɛ-la dɛrɛ

english_verse: On the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, the wall was completely rebuilt. It had taken
translation_verse: Jee-la saanɩŋ dɛrɛ chɛnɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛlʋl tʋɔŋ nɛ, ʋ tapʋlaa mara arɩ banɔŋ chɛɛŋ. Tapʋlaa mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ ba joŋo saa jee-la.

english_verse: When our enemies in the surrounding nations learned that the work was finished, they felt helpless, because they knew that our God had helped us rebuild the wall.
translation_verse: La dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ hɛ tinteye-la kala sɩ gollila lɛ a nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba ba yɩɛlaa kala lɛl, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jɩma arɩ la Wɩa nɛ pɛ la lɛ la tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: All this time the Jewish leaders and Tobiah had been writing letters back and forth.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la kala lɛ, Juda tinteeŋ nɩbalaa fa ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ yʋgɛ nɛ a pɩpɩ Tobia. Tobia ma laa aŋ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩba.

english_verse: Many people in Judah were loyal to Tobiah for two reasons: Shecaniah son of Arah was his father-in-law, and Tobiah's son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
translation_verse: Nɩaa fa yʋga Juda tinteeŋ lɛ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ʋ teeŋ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa Ara nanʋala Sɛkanɩa hɩɩlɩ-baala wɩaa. Ʋ nanʋala Jehohanaŋ ma fa jaa Bɛrɛkɩa nanʋala Mesulam tolo nɛ.

english_verse: The people would always tell me about the good things Tobiah had done, and then they would tell Tobiah everything I had said. So Tobiah kept sending letters, trying to frighten me.
translation_verse: Ba yie bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la Tobia sɩ ŋaa a pɩpɩmɛ aŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ mɩ ma sɩ bʋla a pʋpʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Tobia ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ aa fugusimi.

english_verse: Although Jerusalem covered a large area, not many people lived there, and no new houses had been built.
translation_verse: Tabal-la fa jalɩa, ama nɩaa fa bɩ yʋgɛ nɩmɛ, ba ha bɩ dɩɩsɩŋ ma paa wasa saa.

english_verse: This is a list of how many returned from each family group:
translation_verse: Gibioŋ ma doho nɩaa ŋaa mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: This is a list of how many returned whose ancestors had come from the following towns:
translation_verse: Sɛnaa tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa bʋɩ batori arɩ zɔlɔ nibi arɩ mara arɩ fii nɛ.

english_verse: from Nebo;
translation_verse: Bɛsaɩ, Mewunim, Nefusim,

english_verse: In fact, the governor told them, “You cannot eat the food offered to God until he lets us know if you really are priests.”
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ kiriba dɩ ba sɩ́ kʋdiile-la sɩ ŋaa Wɩa kʋzɔmɔ dii, see dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara kɛŋ Urim arɩ Tumim chɛ na.

english_verse: Many people gave gifts to help pay for the materials to rebuild the temple. The governor himself gave
translation_verse: Nɩkaanaa ma kala sɩ pa kɩalɩŋ ŋaa sɛlɩmɛ kilo zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ chori nɛ, hɔpʋla ma kilo zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa gɛnnɩŋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ balɩpɛ.

english_verse: And so, by the seventh month, priests, Levites, temple guards, musicians, workers, and many of the ordinary people had settled in the towns of Judah.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Levi doho nɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boi-baalaa, yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ arɩ Iziral tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ kala fa kʋ hɔŋ ba tɩtɩa tasɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ɛzɩra karɩmɛ Wɩa wombiee teniŋ Jɩ-pɛɩ kʋʋ yi dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hɔŋ ba tasɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: From early morning till noon, he read the Law of Moses to them, and they listened carefully.
translation_verse: Ʋ chɩŋ ba jaŋ dɩ-hilimii-la lɛ, Lɩɩŋ Boi-baal-la leriŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ a faasa karɩmɛ teŋ-la ʋ lɩɩ, a chɩŋ chʋchʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩhɛyɛ, ka nɩalɩŋ kala kpil dɩgɩlaa a jijegili.

english_verse: Ezra stood on a high wooden platform that had been built for this occasion. Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah were standing to his right, while Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hash Baddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam were standing to his left.
translation_verse: Ba fa kɛŋ daasɩŋ nɛ a ŋaa kʋŋ ʋ sii je wɩɩ-la wɩaa, Ɛzɩra Wɩa teniŋ kerichi-la jɩla chɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ. Matɩtɩa, Sɛma, Anaaya, Yuria, Hɩlɩkaaya arɩ Maasɛya nɛ fa chɩŋ ʋ nadiiŋ sɛmɛ, ka Pedaaya, Mɩsɩɛl, Malɩkɩja, Hasum, Hasɩbadana, Zɛkarɩya arɩ Mesulam ma chɩŋ ʋ nagʋa sɛmɛ.

english_verse: Ezra was up on the high platform, where he could be seen by everyone, and when he opened the book, all the people stood up.
translation_verse: Ɛzɩra fa sɩ chɩŋ kʋ-la nyuŋ a je kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ kala ŋɩɩ, ba kala sɩaa fa pɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ kɛŋ teŋ-la suri, nɩalɩŋ kala sii chɩŋ.

english_verse: Ezra praised the great Lord God, and they lifted their hands, shouting “Amen! Amen!” Then they bowed with their faces to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛzɩra dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩ-balɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ kala kɛŋ ba nɩsaa je aŋ laa bʋl, “Amɩɩ, Amɩɩ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tuu kpirimi a kɛŋ nyusuŋ chugili tinteeŋ a chʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: After this, the Levites Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah went among the people, explaining the meaning of what Ezra had read.
translation_verse: Ba fa karɩmɛ Wɩa wombiiŋ teŋ-la ʋ tʋʋlɛ nɛ woruŋ aŋ dagɛ wɩalɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ wuo jɩŋ.

english_verse: The people started crying when God's Law was read to them. Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and teacher, and the Levites who had been teaching the people all said, “This is a special day for the Lord your God. So don't be sad and don't cry!”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wombii-la, ba yaraa vɛŋ ba suomo yiyel. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nɛhɩmaaya sɩ ŋaa ba tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ, Ɛzɩra, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, aŋ pɛ ŋaa Wɩa teniŋ kerichi arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ dagɛ wɩalɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ bʋla pɩba, “Jɩnɩŋ ŋaa tapʋl-zɔŋ nɛ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma bɩ maga dɩ ma yel koo dɩ ma tʋɔŋ chei.”

english_verse: Nehemiah told the people, “Enjoy your good food and wine and share some with those who didn't have anything to bring. Don't be sad! This is a special day for the Lord, and he will make you happy and strong.”
translation_verse: Nɛhɩmaaya bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Má mʋ dii kʋdii-sɩŋŋaa, a nyʋa sɩ-zɔmʋŋ aŋ ŋaa dɔnsʋŋ mʋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ kʋŋ kɛnɛ. Jɩnɩŋ ŋaa tapʋl-zɔŋ nɛ a pɩ La TƖƖNA. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tʋɔŋ chei, bɛɛ wɩaa tʋɔtɔrʋ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ma doluŋ.”

english_verse: The Levites encouraged the people by saying, “This is a sacred day, so don't worry or mourn!”
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa nyagɛ nɩalɩŋ bɔyɛ a bʋl, “Má leŋ dɩ ma yaraa pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, jɩnɩŋ ŋaa tapʋl-zɔŋ nɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe ma tʋɔŋ chei.”

english_verse: When the people returned to their homes, they celebrated by eating and drinking and by sharing their food with those in need, because they had understood what had been read to them. Celebrating the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala mʋ dɩ ba dii kɩaa aŋ nyʋa kɩaa a gbieli arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, aŋ pɛ ŋaa kʋdiile-la pɩ ba dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ karɩma pɩba sɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: On the second day of the seventh month, the leaders of all the family groups came together with the priests and the Levites, so Ezra could teach them the Law
translation_verse: Tapʋl-lɩa chɛɛŋ, dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ kala a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa lɛ, kʋ hilimi Ɛzɩra sɩ ŋaa Wɩa teniŋ kerichi teeŋ dɩ ba gʋnnɛ Wɩa wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto.

english_verse: that the Lord had given to Moses. They learned from the Law that the people of Israel were to live in shelters when they celebrated the festival in the seventh month of the year.
translation_verse: Ba na Wɩa wombii-la La TƖƖNA sɩ to Mosis lɛ a joŋo pɩba tʋɔŋ, dɩ Wɩa daga arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa maga dɩ ba jʋʋ lɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ, gbiele-la ba sɩ jaŋ gbieli chɛŋ-pɛɩ-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: They also learned that they were to go into the woods and gather branches of leafy trees such as olives, myrtles, and palms for making these shelters.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra na arɩ ʋ maga ba heele bʋl Jerusalɛm arɩ ba tasɩŋ kala lɛ a bʋl, “Má jɩl dundolluŋ nyuŋ a bori olif pɩpaarɩŋ, chɛɛŋ pɩpaarɩŋ, abɛ pɩpaarɩŋ arɩ tɩɩsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ pɩpaarɩŋ sɩ yʋga a kaa kʋ hɛ lɛŋŋɛɛ, arɩ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa wombiiŋ teniŋ tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: So the people gathered branches and made shelters on the flat roofs of their houses, in their yards, in the courtyard of the temple, and in the open areas around the Water Gate and Ephraim Gate.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ mʋ chɛ pɩpaarɩ-la kaa kɔ hɛ lɛŋŋɛɛ pɩ ba tɩtɩa ba lusunuŋ nyuŋ, ba kaalɩsɩŋ lɛ, Wɩa dɩa kaalɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ dɩ-hilimiŋ Lɩɩŋ Boi-baal-la leriŋ, arɩ dɩ-hilimii-la dɔŋɔ ma sɩ hɛ Efirem Boi-baalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from Babylonia built shelters. They lived in them and joyfully celebrated the Festival of Shelters for the first time since the days of Joshua son of Nun.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ mɩɩra lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ hɛ lɛŋŋɛɛ a jʋjʋʋ. A lɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ Nuŋ nanʋala Josua fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa kɔ tapʋlɩɩ-la, Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa bɩ gbiele-la ŋɩɩ gbiele. Ba tʋɔŋ fa chaasa tɔrɛ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: On each of the first seven days of the festival, Ezra read to the people from God's Law. Then on the eighth day, everyone gathered for worship, just as the Law had said they must.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩa-la kala, a chɩŋ tapʋl bumbuŋ kaa mʋ yi tapʋlɩa-la dɩdɛrɩŋ, Ɛzɩra karɩmɛ Wɩa wombiee teŋ-la nɛ. Ba fa gbieli gbiele-la tapʋlaa balɩpɛ nɛ, tapʋl-chori chɛɛŋ, ba hilimi arɩ Wɩa wombiiŋ teniŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month, the people of Israel went without eating, and they dressed in sackcloth and threw dirt on their heads to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Chɛnɛ-la tɩtɩa tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa mara arɩ banɛsɛ chɛɛŋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa hilimi, a vɔɔ niiŋ aŋ laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ a ŋaa hagɩla bʋgɛ ba nyusuŋ.

english_verse: They refused to let foreigners join them, as they met to confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Ba fa kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa pɔrɛ lɩɩ nɩwogusu-la kala sɩ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ. Ba fa sii chɩŋ nɛ a dagɛ ba wʋcheelee arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la ba naabalɩmaba sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: For three hours they stood and listened to the Law of the Lord their God, and then for the next three hours they confessed their sins and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba fa chɩŋ lee-la ba sɩ chɩna nɛ ka ba karɩmɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa wombiiŋ teŋ-la a mʋ yi hawa batori, aŋ bɩra kɛŋ hawa batori ma a dagɛ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ chʋchʋɔlɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani stood on the special platform for the Levites and prayed aloud to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Ba fa ŋaa kʋŋ nɛ ʋ sii je Levi doho nɩaa deemba jɩla chɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ: Jesua, Banɩ, Kadɩmɩɛl, Sɛbanɩa, Buni, Sɛrɛbɩa, Banɩ dɔŋɔ ma arɩ Kɛnanɩ, a faasa suri ba yikorusuŋ a sʋl ba TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Then the Levites Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said: “Stand and shout praises to your Lord, the eternal God! Praise his wonderful name, though he is greater than words can express.” The People Pray
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Levi doho nɩaa deemba: Jesua, Kadɩmɩɛl, Banɩ, Hasabineya, Sɛrɛbɩa, Hodia, Sɛkanɩa arɩ Pɛtahɩa bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Má sii chɩŋ a dɛnnɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ. Má zil ʋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ arɩ la sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo zilu a magɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga ma kala.” Aŋ bɩra chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a bʋl,

english_verse: You alone are the Lord, Creator of the heavens and all the stars, Creator of the earth and those who live on it, Creator of the ocean and all its creatures. You are the source of life, praised by the stars that fill the heavens.
translation_verse: “Ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa La TƖƖNA. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ba lɛ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa tinteeŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ, a pɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ. Ŋ nɛ pɩ kʋŋkala mɩɩsɩŋ, Wɩa-jaŋ kɩaa kala ziziliŋ.

english_verse: You are the Lord our God, the one who chose Abram— you brought him from Ur in Babylonia and named him Abraham.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ ŋaa La TƖƖNA Wɩa. Ŋ nɛ kɛŋ Abɩram kʋ lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Uu a hɛ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ lɛ a kɛŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ bɩrɩmɛ Abɩraham.

english_verse: Because he was faithful, you made an agreement to give his descendants the land of the Canaanites and Hittites, of the Amorites and Perizzites, and of the Jebusites and Girgashites. Now you have kept your promise, just as you always do.
translation_verse: Ŋ na dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ŋ teeŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ hɛ niiŋ ŋ dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ arɩ ŋ jaŋ joŋ nɩaa deemba tinteeŋ a pɩ ʋ doho nɩaa: Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa, Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa, Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa, Jebus tɩŋŋaa arɩ Gɩgasɩ tɩŋŋaa. Ŋ kɛŋ nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ kaa tɩŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: When our ancestors were in Egypt, you saw their suffering; when they were at the Red Sea, you heard their cry for help.
translation_verse: Ŋ na hɛɛ-la la naabalɩmaba fa sɩ na Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋ jegile nɩɩ ba bunso nɛ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ-la leriŋ.

english_verse: You knew that the King of Egypt and his officials and his nation had mistreated your people. So you worked fearsome miracles against the Egyptians and earned a reputation that still remains.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ nɛ Ijipiti kuoro, ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɩaa kala lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩ wʋrɩgɛ ba nɛ. Ŋ laa yɩrɩŋ a pɩ ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: You divided the deep sea, and your people walked through on dry land. But you tossed their enemies in, and they sank down like a heavy stone.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe mʋgʋ-balɩŋ kpaa balɩa nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaaŋ, ba to ʋ tʋɔŋ a vɛŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ a lɩɩ. Ama ŋ leŋe nɩalɩŋ sɩ kire to ba harɩŋ tuu lɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, a nagɛ ba sɩ joŋ tabɩɩŋ hɛ lɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Each day you led your people with a thick cloud, and at night you showed the way with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Wɩɩhɛyɛ, ŋ leŋe duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ sɩ nagɛ jebiiŋ nɛ laa ba sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba vɩvɛŋ, tɩtaŋɩŋ ma, ŋ leŋ nyiniŋ nagɛ jebiiŋ a laa ba sɩpaaŋ a chaanɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ pɩba.

english_verse: At Sinai you came down from heaven, and you gave your people good laws and teachings that are fair and honest.
translation_verse: Ŋ lɩɩ ŋ jaŋ kʋ tuu Sɩnaɩ peel-la nyuŋ nɛ, a bʋl wɩaa pɩba. Ŋ dagɛba ŋ wombiee sɩ tʋʋla arɩ ŋ wʋdagaa sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You commanded them to respect your holy Sabbath, and you instructed your servant Moses to teach them your laws.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe ba jɩŋ ŋ chɛ-wiesii-la sɩ zɔmɔ wɩaa nɛ, aŋ to ŋ tɩntɩnna Mosis lɛ a dagɛba ŋ niiriŋ, ŋ wombiee arɩ ŋ wʋdagaa.

english_verse: When they were hungry, you sent bread from heaven, and when they were thirsty, you let water flow from a rock. Then you commanded them to capture the land that you had solemnly promised. *
translation_verse: Losuŋ sɩ kɛmba, ŋ pɩba Wɩa-jaŋ kʋdiilee nɛ. Lɩɩ-nyʋasʋŋ ma sɩ kɛmba, ŋ leŋe lɩɩŋ lɩɩ bʋŋ lɛ nɛ ba nyʋa. Ŋ bʋla pɩba arɩ ba yuo laa tintee-la ŋ sɩ chaasa ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ ŋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba nɛ.

english_verse: Our stubborn ancestors refused to obey— they forgot about the miracles you had worked for them, and they were determined to return to Egypt and become slaves again.
translation_verse: Ama la naabalɩmaba ŋaa nyu-duo tɩmma nɛ a kɛŋ babii-ballɩŋ a bɩ dagɩŋ ka nɩɩ, a vɩa dɩ ba to ŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: not even when they made an idol shaped like a calf and insulted you by claiming, “This is the god who rescued us from Egypt.”
translation_verse: ba sɩ paala libi kʋŋ sɩ nagɛ nɛ-bie pɩ ba tɩtɩa aŋ bʋl, ‘Vene-la sɩ kɛnla lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ kʋ lɩɩ nɛ ŋ-la.’ Ba tʋʋsɛ ŋ joŋ-bɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, you never abandoned them in the desert. And you always guided them with a cloud by day and a fire at night.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ faasa fɩfá nɩaa nenige wɩaa, ŋ bɩ ba vɩa ta tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. Wɩɩhɛyɛ, duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la sɩ nagɛ jebiiŋ bɩ ba harɩŋ mɩɩra, nyiŋ-la ma sɩ nagɛ jebiiŋ a chaanɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ pɩpɩba a dɩdagɛba wombii-la ba sɩ jaŋ to bɩ ba harɩŋ mɩɩra.

english_verse: Your gentle Spirit instructed them, and you gave them manna to eat and water to drink.
translation_verse: Ŋ joŋ ŋ Dɩma sɩ zɔmɔ pɩba nɛ ʋ dɩdagɛba. Ŋ bɩ ba kʋdiile-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ‘mana’ vɔmɔ, ŋ pɩba lɩɩŋ ma nɛ ba nyʋa.

english_verse: You took good care of them, and for forty years they never lacked a thing. Their clothes didn't wear out, and their feet were never swollen.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ tʋɔŋ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa-la kala, ŋ pɩba ba kʋchɛɛlɛɛ nɛ. Ba bɩ kʋŋkala chɛ ka, ba gɛnnɩŋ bɩ kɩɛsa, ba naasɩŋ ma bɩ pʋʋsa.

english_verse: You let them conquer kings and take their land, including King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan.
translation_verse: Ŋ joŋ kuoroo tinteyee arɩ tinteyee pɩba nɛ, ba tɩɩ ba kala. Ba yuo laa Hɛsɩbɔŋ kuoro Sɩhɔŋ tinteeŋ nɛ arɩ Basaŋ kuoro Ɔgɩ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: You brought them into the land that you had promised their ancestors, and you blessed their nation with people that outnumbered the stars in the sky.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe ba biiriŋ yʋgɛ nɛ a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ. Ŋ kɛmba kaa kʋ jʋʋ tintee-la ŋ sɩ bʋla pɩ ba naabalɩmaba dɩ ba mʋ laa tɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Then their descendants conquered the land. You helped them defeat the kings and nations and treat their enemies however they wished.
translation_verse: Ba biiriŋ mʋ jʋʋ tintee-la nɛ a laaʋ tɩɩ. Ŋ yuo dii Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa nɛ ba sɩpaaŋ, nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ, a joŋ ba dɩ ba kuoroo kala hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba ŋaaba ŋɩɩ ba sɩ cho.

english_verse: They captured strong cities and rich farmland; they took furnished houses, as well as cisterns, vineyards, olive orchards, and numerous fruit trees. They ate till they were satisfied, and they celebrated your abundant blessings.
translation_verse: Ba yuo laa tabalaa ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli arɩ tinteyee sɩ sɩma nɛ. Ba laa dɩɩsɩŋ sɩ suo arɩ kʋzɔŋ dosunuŋ, vilee ba sɩ luo, girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ, olif tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ tɩɩsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ yʋga a nɩnɛŋ. Ba dii kɩaa vɔgɛ nɛ woruŋ a kala nɛrɛ, ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ wʋzɔmɔ-la kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: In spite of this, they rebelled and disobeyed your laws. They killed your prophets, who warned them to turn back to you, and they cursed your name.
translation_verse: Ama ba vɩa ŋ niiŋ nɛ a lɩɩ ŋ harɩŋ, a joŋ harɩŋ yɩa ŋ wombiiŋ ŋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto. Ba kpʋ ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa dɩ ba mɩɩra kʋ toŋ. Ba chaasa tʋʋsɛ ŋ joŋoo nɛ.

english_verse: So you handed them over to their enemies, who treated them terribly. But in their sufferings, they begged you to help. From heaven you listened to their prayers and because of your great mercy, you sent leaders to rescue them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jomba hɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba dɔgɩsɛba. Ama ba sɩ dɔgɩsɛba, ba yele pɩŋ nɛ. Ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ nɩɩ, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ faasa fɩfá nɩaa nenige wɩaa, ŋ pɩba laataaraa nɛ, ba laaba ta ba dʋndɔmɔ-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But when they were at peace, they would turn against you, and you would hand them over to their enemies. Then they would beg for help, and because you are merciful, you rescued them over and over again.
translation_verse: Ama ba sɩ kʋ na wiese, ba bɩra ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ŋ lɛ. Ŋ bɩra jomba hɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ ba bibemba. Ba bɩra sɩ yele pɩŋ, ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ nɩɩ ba yele, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige wɩaa, ŋ vɛnɛ laaba ta a yʋgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: For years, you were patient, and your Spirit warned them with messages spoken by your prophets. Still they refused to listen, and you handed them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Jɩ-daŋ nɛ ŋ kɛŋ kenyiri arɩ ba. Ŋ Dɩma to ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa chagɩlɛba. Ama ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jomba hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But you are merciful and kind, and so you never forgot them or let them be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ama a tɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige kɩŋkɛŋ wɩaa, ŋ bɩ ba cheye koo a vɩaba ta, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ ŋaa Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ zile nɛ a fɩfá nɩaa nisusuŋ.

english_verse: Our God, you are powerful, fearsome, and faithful, always true to your word. So please keep in mind the terrible sufferings of our people, kings, leaders, priests, and prophets, from the time Assyria ruled until this very day.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ la Wɩa, ŋ nɛ yʋga a kɛŋ doluŋ nɩaa fɩfáŋ, ŋ sɩ cho ŋ nɩaa a hɛ nii-la ŋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ, ŋ kaa tɩtɩŋ nɛ. Sɩ́ bee kieli hɛɛ-la la sɩ na a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ Asiiria kuoroo sɩ dɔgɩsɛla a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ. La kuoroo arɩ la sɩpaalaaraa, la ŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa, la naabalɩmaba arɩ ŋ nɩaa kala nɛ na hɛɛ-la.

english_verse: You have always been fair when you punished us for our sins.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa la lɛ, ŋ to wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ nɛ ka la-na bɩ woruŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Our kings and leaders, our priests and ancestors have never obeyed your commands or heeded your warnings.
translation_verse: La kuoroo, la sɩpaalaaraa, la ŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ la nyɩmmaba bɩ wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile to. Ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ ŋ wʋdagaa koo wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa.

english_verse: You blessed them with a kingdom and with an abundance of rich, fertile land, but they refused to worship you or turn from their evil.
translation_verse: Ba fa sɩ hɛ tintee-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩba lɛ a nɩnɩɩ sɩŋ-bal-la kala, tintee-la sɩ jalɩa aŋ pɛ sɩŋ lɛ, ba bɩŋ to koo a bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Now we are slaves in this fruitful land you gave to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Ama jɩnɩŋ la ŋaa yosi nɛ tintee-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩ la naabalɩmaba lɛ, dɩ ba dii ʋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ arɩ kʋzɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: Its plentiful harvest is taken by kings you placed over us because of our sins. Our suffering is unbearable, because they do as they wish to us and our livestock. The People Make an Agreement
translation_verse: A tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, tintee-la kʋdii daŋ-la kala mɩɩra ŋaa kuoroo-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋ sɩ joŋ-la hɛ kɩaa nɛ. Baa benla arɩ la pʋsʋŋ ŋɩɩ kala ba sɩ cho nɛ. Hɛɛŋ chaasa vɔgɛla nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ŋaa nii-bala

english_verse: And so, a firm agreement was made that had the official approval of the leaders, the Levites, and priests.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala wɩaa, la Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala ŋaa nii-bala nɛ, dɩ la tɔ boŋ a ŋmʋnsa bil, dɩ la sɩpaalaaraa, la Levi doho nɩaa arɩ la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ jaŋ joŋ ba magɩlɩŋ hɛ.”

english_verse: As governor, I signed the agreement together with Zedekiah and the following priests:
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba neniee daŋ teŋ-la lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Hakalɩa nanʋala Nɛhɩmaaya sɩ ŋaa ba tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ, Zedikaaya,

english_verse: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah, Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah, Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch, Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah, Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch, Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin, Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah.
translation_verse: Maazɩa, Bɩlɩgaɩ arɩ Sɛmaaya. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ joŋ ba neniee nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The Levites who signed were: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui from the clan of Henadad, Kadmiel,
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa ma sɩ joŋ ba neniee nɛ ŋ-la: Azanɩa nanʋala Jesua, Bunui sɩ ŋaa Henadad nyɩŋ-nʋʋ arɩ Kadɩmɩɛl.

english_verse: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,
translation_verse: Mɩka, Rehob, Hasabɩa,

english_verse: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
translation_verse: Zaku, Sɛrɛbɩa, Sɛbanɩa,

english_verse: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.
translation_verse: Hodia, Banɩ arɩ Beninu.

english_verse: The leaders who signed were: Parosh, Pahath Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩpaalaaraa ma nɛ ŋ-la: Parɔs, Pahaf-Mʋab, Ɛlam, Zatu, Banɩ,

english_verse: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
translation_verse: Buni, Azigad, Bɛbaɩ,

english_verse: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
translation_verse: Adonija, Bɩgɩvaɩ, Adɩŋ

english_verse: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
translation_verse: Ata, Hezikaaya, Azu,

english_verse: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
translation_verse: Hodia, Hasum, Bɛzaɩ,

english_verse: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
translation_verse: Harɩf, Anatɔf, Nɛbaɩ,

english_verse: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
translation_verse: Magɩpɩas, Mesulam, Hezi,

english_verse: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
translation_verse: Mɛsɛzabɛl, Zadɔk, Jadʋa,

english_verse: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
translation_verse: Pɛlatɩa, Hanaŋ, Anaaya,

english_verse: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
translation_verse: Hosia, Hananaaya, Hasub,

english_verse: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
translation_verse: Halɔhɛs, Pɩlɩha, Sɔbɛk,

english_verse: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
translation_verse: Rehum, Hasabɩna, Maasɛya,

english_verse: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
translation_verse: Ahɩa, Hanaŋ, Anaŋ,

english_verse: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah. The Agreement
translation_verse: Maluk, Harɩm arɩ Baana.

english_verse: All of us, including priests, Levites, temple guards, singers, temple workers and leaders, together with our wives and children, have separated ourselves from the foreigners in this land and now enter into an agreement with a complete understanding of what we are doing. And so, we now place ourselves under the curse of the Lord our God, if we fail to obey his laws and teachings that were given to us by his servant Moses.
