translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Modikaaya ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa a hɛ teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bil, aŋ joŋ tenni-la dɔnsʋŋ a kpaa Juu tɩmma-la kala sɩ hɛ kuoro Zɛzɛs tinteeŋ lere-la sɩ bolie arɩ lere-la sɩ kpaga kala,

english_verse: and told them: Each year you must celebrate on both the fourteenth and the fifteenth of Adar,
translation_verse: a bʋla pɩba: Dɩ ba vɛnɛ gbigbieli chɛnɛ la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Adaa tapʋlaa fii arɩ banɛsɛ arɩ tapʋl fii arɩ banɔŋ chɛɛŋ jɩna-na kala.

english_verse: the days when we Jews defeated our enemies. Remember this month as a time when our sorrow was turned to joy, and celebration took the place of crying. Celebrate by having parties and by giving to the poor and by sharing gifts of food with each other.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩa-la lɛ nɛ la Juu tɩŋŋaa yuo dii la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ. Ʋ maga dɩ ma liisi arɩ chɛnɛ deeŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ ma tʋɔ-cheeŋ bɩrɩmɛ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, ma yele ma bɩrɩmɛ gbiele. Má joŋ tapʋlɩa-la dɩ ba ŋaa tʋɔtɔrɛ tapʋlɩa dɩ ma ŋaa kʋdiilee a dii aŋ gbigbieli aŋ ŋaa kʋdiile-la a pɩpɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa arɩ summo.

english_verse: They followed Mordecai's instructions and set aside these two days every year as a time of celebration. The Reason for the Festival of Purim
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa sɛɩ ŋɩɩ Modikaaya sɩ daga a lɩɩsɛ tapʋlɩa-la balɩa ba ŋaa gbiele tapʋlɩa, ba vɛnɛ gbigbieli jɩna-na kala.

english_verse: Haman was the son of Hammedatha and a descendant of Agag. He hated the Jews so much that he planned to destroy them, but he wanted to find out the best time to do it. So he cast lots.
translation_verse: Hamɛdata nanʋala Hamaŋ Agag tɩɩna-la sɩ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa kala dʋndɔmɔ fa bɩɩna dɩ ʋ kpʋ Juu tɩŋŋaa kala nɛ. Ʋ fa leŋe ba tɔnsɛ nɛ dɩ ʋ jɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa ʋ sɩ jaŋ kpʋba.

english_verse: Esther went to King Xerxes and asked him to save her people. Then the king gave written orders for Haman and his sons to be punished in the same terrible way that Haman had in mind for the Jews. So they were hanged.
translation_verse: Ama Ɛsɩta sɩ sii mʋ kuoro Zɛzɛs teeŋ a sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ laa ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa ta, kuoro ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pa wombiiŋ dɩ ba leŋ dɩ wʋbɔŋ-la Hamaŋ fa sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa lɛ, mɩɩra nyʋa Hemaŋ tɩtɩa nyuŋ lɛ, dɩ ba kɛsɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ fii a lieŋi ba jebii-la ʋ sɩ saa lɛ.

english_verse: Mordecai's letter had said that the Jews must celebrate for two days because of what had happened to them. This time of celebration is called Purim, which is the Hebrew word for the lots that were cast.
translation_verse: Teŋ-la Modikaaya sɩ ŋmʋnsa bʋla arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa maga dɩ ba gbieli nɛ tapʋlaa deemba balɩa a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa ba Juu tɩŋŋaa lɛ wɩaa. Bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ gbieli gbiele-la nɛ baa yɩrɛ Purim.

english_verse: Now every year the Jews set aside these two days for having parties and celebrating, just as they were told to do.
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa sɛɩ ŋɩɩ Modikaaya sɩ daga a lɩɩsɛ tapʋlɩa-la balɩa ba dɩ ba doho nɩaa arɩ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ kʋ pɛ ba lɛ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa kʋdiilee dii aŋ gbigbieli gbiele-la jɩna-na kala.

english_verse: From now on, all Jewish families must remember to celebrate Purim on these two days each year.
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa doho sɩ hɛ lee na-kala arɩ ba dɩa nɩaa maga dɩ ba liliisi gbiele-la wɩaa a gbieli Purim gbiele-la tapʋlɩa-la balɩa jɩna-na kala.

english_verse: Queen Esther, daughter of Abihail, wanted to give full authority to Mordecai's letter about the Festival of Purim, and with his help she wrote a letter about the feast.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩhɛɛl tolo Ɛsɩta sɩ ŋaa kuoro habidiire chɩchɛ dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ teŋ-la Modikaaya sɩ ŋmʋnsa a tɩgɛ Purim gbiele ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ teŋ nɛ. Ʋ ma bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ dɔŋɔ a tɩgɛ gbiele-la lɛ.

english_verse: You and your descendants must always remember to celebrate Purim at the time and in the way that we have said. You must also follow the instructions that we have given you about mourning and going without eating.
translation_verse: Ma dɩ ma doho nɩaa kala maga dɩ ma liliisi Purim gbiele-la wɩaa nɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ arɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ dɩ Modikaaya sɩ bʋla. Ʋ bɩra maga dɩ ma to wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ dagɛma, dɩ ma vɔɔ niiŋ aŋ yiyel nɛ.

english_verse: King Xerxes made everyone in his kingdom pay taxes, even those in lands across the sea.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Zɛzɛs ŋaa nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ ʋ tinteeŋ lɛ titiŋ lampoo, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ mʋga niiŋ.

english_verse: All the great and famous things that King Xerxes did are written in the record books of the kings of Media and Persia. These records also tell about the honors that the king gave to Mordecai.
translation_verse: Wʋduoru-la arɩ wʋbala-la kala kuoro Zɛzɛs sɩ ŋaa, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Midia arɩ Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ zil Modikaaya ma hɛ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Next to the king himself, Mordecai was the highest official in the kingdom. He was a popular leader of the Jews, because he helped them in many ways and would even speak to the king on their behalf.
translation_verse: Modikaaya, Juu tɩɩna-la nɛ faa tɩgɛ kuoro Zɛzɛs lɛ ʋ tinteeŋ kala lɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa nɩbal nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ ba zizilu woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ yie ŋaa wɩaa a pɩpɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ, ʋ yie wuo bʋl wɩaa kuoro teeŋ a chɩchɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa doho kala zɔmʋŋ.

english_verse: Many years ago, a man named Job lived in the land of Uz. He was a truly good person, who respected God and refused to do evil.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ Us tinteeŋ lɛ, baa yɩrɛ Job. Baala deeŋ wɩaa tʋʋla nɛ woruŋ, ʋ bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ. Ʋ faa fá Wɩa nɛ woruŋ a bɛrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: the Lord asked, “Satan, where have you been?” Satan replied, “I have been going all over the earth.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA pɩɛsɛ Sɩtaanɩ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ lɩɩ kɔ daha?” Sɩtaanɩ bʋla pɩ La TƖƖNA, “Mɩ gɔllɔɔ baarɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Job's sons took turns having feasts in their homes, and they always invited their three sisters to join in the eating and drinking.
translation_verse: Ʋ hambolibiisiŋ tʋɔŋ kʋŋkala fa yie ŋaa kʋdiilee ba dii a gbieli a kpɩkpaa nɛ jɩna kala. Ba kʋŋkala nɛ ŋaa kʋdiile-la, ʋ yie yɩrɛ ʋ naambiiri-la arɩ ba dɩhaala-la batori nɛ ba kʋ pɛ ba lɛ ba dii kɩalɩŋ aŋ nyʋa kʋnyʋalaa.

english_verse: After each feast, Job would send for his children and perform a ceremony, as a way of asking God to forgive them of any wrongs they may have done. He would get up early the next morning and offer a sacrifice for each of them, just in case they had sinned or silently cursed God. Angels, the Lord, and Satan
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ gbieli gbieli-la kʋŋkala dɛrɛ, Job yie yɩrɛba nɛ a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta. Ʋ yie sii chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ ba kʋŋkala. Ʋ yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ aŋ bɩɩnɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a bʋl, “Kapo mɩ biiriŋ deemba kʋŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ a tʋʋsɛ Wɩa ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ.” Job fa vɛnɛɛ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ bʋa na-kala. Sɩtaanɩ sɩ magɩsɛ Job bumbuŋ

english_verse: One day, when the angels had gathered around the Lord, and Satan was there with them,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Wɩa tɩndaaraa kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa kɔ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, Sɩtaanɩ ma to ba harɩŋ a kɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord asked, “What do you think of my servant Job? No one on earth is like him—he is a truly good person, who respects me and refuses to do evil.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ na mɩ tɩntɩnna Job nɛɛ? Nʋʋkala tuo dʋnɩa lɛ a nagʋ. Ʋ wɩaa tʋʋla nɛ woruŋ, ʋ bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ. Ʋʋ fá mɩ-na Wɩa nɛ woruŋ a bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ sɩɩŋ na wʋbɔmʋŋ.”

english_verse: “Why shouldn't he respect you?” Satan remarked.
translation_verse: Sɩtaanɩ ma bʋl, “Ŋ bɩɩna Job sɩɩ fáŋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa pɛɩ nɛɛ?

english_verse: “You are like a wall protecting not only him, but his entire family and all his property. You make him successful in whatever he does, and his flocks and herds are everywhere.
translation_verse: Ŋ pɔ ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa arɩ ba dʋa kala nɛ bʋa na-kala. Ŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ʋ wɩɩkala wasɛ woruŋ, ŋ pʋ piesee arɩ pʋŋ-doho-na kala nɛ, ba jɛrɛ su tintee-la kala.

english_verse: Try taking away everything he owns, and he will curse you to your face.”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ laa kɩaa deemba kala ʋ teeŋ, ʋ jaŋ bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ kaa faa.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “All right, Satan, do what you want with anything that belongs to him, but don't harm Job.” Then Satan left. Job Loses Everything
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Sɩtaanɩ, “Ʋ zɔmɔ, mɩ joŋ kʋŋkala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ a hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ama pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ Job tɩtɩa wɩɩkala ŋaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɩtaanɩ sii La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Job's sons and daughters were having a feast in the home of his oldest son,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala, Job hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ toloo dii kɩaa aŋ gbigbieli ba maalɩ-hɩaŋ dɩa lɛ,

english_verse: when someone rushed up to Job and said, “While your servants were plowing with your oxen, and your donkeys were nearby eating grass,
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋ kɛŋ tɩndaarɩŋ deeŋ kʋ pɩ Job, “Nɛ-pɛrɛ-la faa pɛrɛ nɛ, ka kakusu-la ma chɩna kpagɛba a didii kɩaa,

english_verse: a gang of Sabeans attacked and stole the oxen and donkeys! Your other servants were killed, and I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: dɩ Saba tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ, a kʋ yuola a kɛsɛ ba kala kaa viiri. Ba kpʋ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa kala nɛ, mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ wuo foro fá a kɔ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩŋ.”

english_verse: That servant was still speaking, when a second one came running and said, “God sent down a fire that killed your sheep and your servants. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ ha sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa, nʋʋ dɔŋ ma bɩra kʋ jʋʋ a bʋl, “Wɩa nyiniŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a kʋ tuu dii piese-la arɩ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa kala, mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ wuo foro fá a kɔ dɩ mɩ hɛ duoso pɩŋ.”

english_verse: Before that servant finished speaking, a third one raced up and said, “Three gangs of Chaldeans attacked and stole your camels! All of your other servants were killed, and I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ ma ha sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ, nʋʋ dɔŋ ma bɩra kɔ a bʋl, “Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo bugoo batori nɛ kɔ a kiri ŋ bʋntaŋŋaba-la kaa viiri. Ba kpʋ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa kala nɛ, mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ wuo foro fá a kɔ dɩ mɩ hɛ duoso pɩŋ.”

english_verse: That servant was still speaking, when a fourth one dashed up and said, “Your children were having a feast and drinking wine at the home of your oldest son,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ ma ha sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋ dɔŋ ma bɩra kɔ a bʋl, “Ŋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ŋ toloo faa dii kɩaa nɛ aŋ nyʋnyʋa kɩaa a gbigbieli ba maalɩ-hɩaŋ dɩa lɛ,

english_verse: when suddenly a windstorm from the desert blew the house down, crushing all of your children. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: dɩ pel-duo guu lɩɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kʋ yagɛ dɩa-la gʋnaa banɛsɛ kala lɛ, ʋ tuu tele tɔba, ba kala sʋʋ. Mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ wuo lɩɩ a kɔ dɩ mɩ hɛ duoso pɩŋ.”

english_verse: When Job heard this, he tore his clothes and shaved his head because of his great sorrow. He knelt on the ground, then worshiped God
translation_verse: Job sɩ nɩɩ wɩaa deemba kala, ʋ sii kɛŋ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ aŋ fʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ aa dagɛ tʋɔ-cheeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ tuu tele chu tinteeŋ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa

english_verse: and said: “We bring nothing at birth; we take nothing with us at death. The Lord alone gives and takes. Praise the name of the Lord!”
translation_verse: a bʋl, “Yarɩ-biree nɛ mɩ kaa lɩɩ mɩ naaŋ luoruŋ tʋɔŋ a kʋ lɩɩ, yarɩ-biree nɛ mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kaa mʋ dɩ mɩ nɛ sʋba. La TƖƖNA nɛ pɩmɛ nɩaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ mɩ fa sɩ kɛnɛ aŋ bɩra kaa laa. Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: In spite of everything, Job did not sin or accuse God of doing wrong.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala lɛ, Job fa bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: When the angels gathered around the Lord again, Satan was there with them,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ bɩra, Wɩa tɩndaaraa kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, Sɩtaanɩ ma to ba harɩŋ mʋ.

english_verse: and the Lord asked, “Satan, where have you been?” Satan replied, “I have been going all over the earth.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA pɩɛsɛ Sɩtaanɩ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ lɩɩ kɔ daha?” Sɩtaanɩ bʋla pɩ La TƖƖNA, “Mɩ gɔllɔɔ baarɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord asked, “What do you think of my servant Job? No one on earth is like him—he is a truly good person, who respects me and refuses to do evil. And he hasn't changed, even though you persuaded me to destroy him for no reason.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ na mɩ tɩntɩnna Job nɛɛ? Nʋʋkala tuo dʋnɩa lɛ a nagʋ. Ʋ wɩaa tʋʋla nɛ woruŋ, ʋ bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ. Ʋʋ fá mɩ-na Wɩa nɛ woruŋ a bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ sɩɩŋ na wʋbɔŋ. Ŋ sɩ sʋlmɛ dɩ mɩ pɩŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ŋ cheyu arɩ ʋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye ma kala, ʋ ha chɩŋ ʋ wʋtɩtɩɩ naaŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Satan answered, “There's no pain like your own. People will do anything to stay alive.
translation_verse: Sɩtaanɩ bɩra bʋl, “Nuhuobiine jaŋ wuo joŋ ʋ kʋŋkala pa, aŋ ka dɩ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Try striking Job's own body with pain, and he will curse you to your face.”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ chei ʋ yaraa, ʋ jaŋ bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ ʋ bɩ jaŋ kaa faa.”

english_verse: “All right!” the Lord replied. “Make Job suffer as much as you want, but just don't kill him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Sɩtaanɩ, “Ʋ zɔmɔ, mɩ joŋu hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ama sɩ́ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɩɩsʋ.”

english_verse: Satan left and caused painful sores to break out all over Job's body—from head to toe.
translation_verse: Sɩtaanɩ sii La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, a mʋ joŋ naawɩɩlaa sɩɩ wɩɩ woruŋ a hɛ Job lɛ, a chɩŋ ʋ naachɛyɛɛ a kaa jɩl ʋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Then Job sat on the ash-heap to show his sorrow. And while he was scraping his sores with a broken piece of pottery,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Job joŋ kanchele a hɔŋ tʋɔrʋŋ tʋɔŋ aŋ kaa pɩpaasɛ ʋ yaraa.

english_verse: his wife asked, “Why do you still trust God? Why don't you curse him and die?”
translation_verse: Ʋ haala pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ ha chɩŋ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ naaŋ lɛ nɛɛ? Bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a tɩgɛ Wɩa lɛ aŋ sʋʋ.”

english_verse: Job replied, “Don't talk like a fool! If we accept blessings from God, we must accept trouble as well.” In all that happened, Job never once said anything against God. Job's Three Friends
translation_verse: Job bʋl, “Ŋ bʋl wɩaa arɩ ŋ ŋaa hayaarɩ nɛ. Ŋ bɩɩna wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga dɩ la lɩlaa Wɩa teeŋ, aŋ sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ-na laa koo?” Job hɛɛŋ deeŋ ma kala lɛ, ʋ bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala bʋla. Job nandɔnsʋŋ batori

english_verse: When they came near enough to see Job, they could hardly recognize him. And in their great sorrow, they tore their clothes, then sprinkled dust on their heads and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kʋ chɩŋ dɩ-bolii aŋ naʋ, ba bɩ wuo jɩmʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba faasa ŋmuŋmoo niiŋ, a kɛŋ ba gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ aŋ ŋaa hagɩla hɛ ba nyusuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: For seven days and nights, they sat silently on the ground beside him, because they realized what terrible pain he was in.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kʋ hɔŋ tinteeŋ, ba dɩ Job kala, wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ wɩɩ bʋla ʋ teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fa na hɛɛ-la ʋ sɩ chaasaa na nɛ.

english_verse: Finally, Job cursed the day of his birth
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, Job suri ʋ niiŋ a ŋmɩɛsa hɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ lʋlʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Blot out the day of my birth and the night when my parents created a son.
translation_verse: “A leŋ dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ lʋlmɛ lɛl, a leŋ dɩ tɩtaŋ-la ma ba sɩ lʋlmɛ mɩ ŋaa hambolibie lɛl.

english_verse: and send thick, gloomy shadows to fill it with dread.
translation_verse: A leŋ, dɩ birimiŋ lim tɔ tapʋlɩɩ-la kala. A leŋ dɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ tɔʋ, dɩ birimiŋ tɔ ʋ pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: Erase that night from the calendar and conceal it with darkness.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ birimiŋ lim tɔ tɩtaŋ-la kala, dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ ʋ dɩɩsa pɛ chɛnsɩŋ koo jɩna tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa lɛ.

english_verse: Don't let children be created or joyful shouts be heard ever again in that night.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ tɩtaŋ-la birigi, dɩ tʋɔtɔrʋ kala tuo ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Let those with magic powers place a curse on that day.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ tapʋlaa lɛ, ŋmɩɛsa hɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie kosi peribanyeŋŋu ʋ sii ŋɩŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: Darken its morning stars and remove all hope of light,
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ ʋ chʋchʋɔŋ na-nyʋɔlʋŋ biri a leŋ dɩ ʋ gbɛrɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ lɔl, a sɩ́ sɩɩpʋʋraa pʋlʋmʋŋ na,

english_verse: because it let me be born into a world of trouble. Why Didn't I Die at Birth?
translation_verse: a tɩŋ tɩtaŋ-la sɩ bɩ mɩ naaŋ lʋla tɔ ka ʋ lʋlmɛ a hɛ wʋwalɩmaa arɩ hɛɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Why was I accepted and allowed to nurse at my mother's breast?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ naaŋ jommi hɛ ʋ naasɩŋ lɛ, a leŋ mɩ wasɛ ʋ yɩlɩŋ?

english_verse: Now I would be at peace in the silent world below
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa sʋba bʋa-la lɛ, magɛ ŋ-la mɩ fa pɩnaa wiesi,

english_verse: and with rulers once rich with silver and gold.
translation_verse: arɩ kuorusu-la fa sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ, a chʋŋ hɔpʋla su ba dɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I wish I had been born dead and then buried, never to see the light of day.
translation_verse: Koo mɩ fa paala sʋʋ a nagɛ bii-sʋʋŋ ba sɩ lʋla, koo a nagɛ bii-mulo ba sɩ lʋla ʋ sʋʋ chalɩŋ lɛ a bɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ na.

english_verse: In the world of the dead, the wicked and the weary rest without a worry. *
translation_verse: Sʋʋŋ bʋa tʋɔŋ, nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ yie leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ lɔlɔ yie na wiese nɛ.

english_verse: where captives and slaves are free at last. Why Does God Let Me Live?
translation_verse: Nɩbalaa arɩ nɩbiisiŋ kala nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, yosuŋ ma fori ba tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Why does God let me live when life is miserable and so bitter?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ wei, a kɛŋ tʋɔ-cheeŋ kɩŋkɛŋ aŋ hɛ ba mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ?

english_verse: I keep longing for death more than I would seek a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Ba yie chɩchɛ sʋʋŋ, ka ʋ bɩ baa kɛŋ. Ba yie chɩchɛ sʋʋŋ a nagɛ nɩa sɩ faasa fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a chɩchɛ dʋa.

english_verse: Nothing could make me happier than to be in the grave.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ tuu bʋa, ba tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ nɛ ba jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: Why do I go on living when God has me surrounded, and I can't see the road?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa jaŋ joŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a pɩ nɩɩ-la wombiiŋ sɩ faa? Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ maachie kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Moaning and groaning are my food and drink,
translation_verse: Hʋʋna vɔgɛmɛ nɛ a nagɛ kʋdiilee, aŋ pɩpɛllɛ a nagɛ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: and my worst fears have all come true.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ fá jʋʋmɛ nɛ, wɩɩ-la lɛ mɩ bɔyɛ sɩɩ joŋ ŋaa mɩ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I have no peace or rest— only troubles and worries.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ bɩ dɩ-bala pɩna, mɩ dɩgɩlaa ma bɩ fuuri, mɩ bɩ wiese kɛnɛ, see wʋwalɩmaa dʋndʋŋa.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛlɩfas, Tɛmaŋ tɩɩna-la pɩɛsɛ:

english_verse: Please be patient and listen to what I have to say. *
translation_verse: “Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋl wɩɩ ŋ teeŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo nyalɩmɛɛ? Mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo tɔrɛ mɩ niiŋ, see dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ.

english_verse: But now you feel discouraged when struck by trouble.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ wʋwalɩmaa jʋʋŋ nɛ, ŋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ, wɩalɩŋ ŋmobuŋ nɛ, ŋ niiŋ kala maa.

english_verse: In my experience, only those who plant seeds of evil harvest trouble,
translation_verse: Mɩ-na sɩ jɩma, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, a hɩhɛ wɩaa, ba nɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la yie dii.

english_verse: and then they are swept away by the angry breath of God.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ wiese hɛ ba lɛ, ba jaŋ sʋʋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ na baanɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ kpʋba.

english_verse: They may roar and growl like powerful lions. But when God breaks their teeth,
translation_verse: Naachigee jaŋ wuo huosi aŋ chama pɛ, ama Wɩa bori ba nyɩlaa nɛ.

english_verse: they starve, and their children are scattered. A Secret Was Told to Me
translation_verse: Dɩ naachigiŋ nɛ chɛ ʋ kʋdiilee ka dɩ ʋ dii, ʋ yie sʋʋ nɛ, ka ʋ biiriŋ fá pɩsɛ.

english_verse: A secret was told to me in a faint whisper—
translation_verse: Nʋʋ nɛ lʋara bʋl wɩɩ pɩmɛ, mɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ munso bʋl.

english_verse: I was overcome by sleep, but disturbed by dreams;
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la fa nagɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ duosu nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ nɩaa sɩ faasa pɩŋ doŋ.

english_verse: and my hair stood on end, as a wind blew past my face.
translation_verse: Nɩdɩma kʋbala ŋmoo peliŋ hɛ mɩ sɩaa lɛ a bal, mɩ nyu-pʋnaa sii chɩŋ.

english_verse: It stopped and stood still. Then a form appeared— a shapeless form. And from the silence, I heard a voice say,
translation_verse: Nɩdɩma-la mʋ chɩŋ, ama mɩ bɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ naga wuo dagɛ. Kʋŋ chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ, ka mɩ nɩɩ yikori-bie dɩ ʋ pɩɛsa:

english_verse: “No humans are innocent in the eyes of God their Creator.
translation_verse: ‘Nuhuobiine jaŋ wuo kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a kɩɩ Wɩa? Nʋʋ jaŋ wuo pʋllɛ a kɩɩ Wɩa sɩ ŋaaʋ?

english_verse: He finds fault with his servants and even with his angels.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ bɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa laa dii, aŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩpɩ ʋ tɩndaaraa,

english_verse: Humans are formed from clay and are fragile as moths, so what chance do you have?
translation_verse: ɛɛ nɛ saa ʋ jaŋ nagɛ a pɩ nuhuobiine ʋ sɩ kɛŋ chʋrʋŋ mɛ? Nuhuobiinee kala ŋaa hagɩla nɛ, ba jaŋ wuo yɛrɛ mɔlɩɩ arɩ ba sɩ yie chagɛ pʋgʋmʋŋ yɛrɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Your tent pegs are pulled up, and you leave this life, having gained no wisdom.”
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ nɛ ba laa, ka ʋ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, aŋ ha bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ.’

english_verse: Envy and jealousy will kill a stupid fool.
translation_verse: Tʋɔ-gʋŋ yie kpʋ nɩyaara nɛ, yarɩ-bieriŋ ma kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: I have seen fools take root. But God sends a curse, suddenly uprooting them
translation_verse: Mɩ na nɩyaaraa wɩaa sɩ naga ba chɩna woruŋ, ama ŋmɩaŋ guu dii ba dɩɩsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Then hungry and greedy people gobble up their crops and grab their wealth.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ losuŋ sɩ kɛnɛ jaŋ laa nɩyaara-la kʋpɛrɛɛ dii, ba jaŋ paala paa kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ sɔsʋŋ tʋɔŋ ma. Sɩɩŋ tɩŋŋaa jaŋ dii ba dʋa.

english_verse: Our suffering isn't caused by the failure of crops;
translation_verse: Bɔnsʋŋ bɩ kʋŋ sɩɩ nyʋ tinteeŋ ŋaa, wʋwalɩmaa ma bɩ tinteeŋ lɛ ka nyʋ.

english_verse: Job, if I were you, I would ask God for help.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ mɩ-na nɛ fa kaŋ, mɩ fa jaŋ mʋ Wɩa teeŋ a joŋ mɩ wɩɩŋ bil ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: God sends showers on earth and waters the fields.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe duonuŋ nɩnɩɩ tinteeŋ lɛ, a nɩɩ hɩhɛ kɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: He protects the sorrowful and lifts up those who have been disgraced. *
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri, ʋ yie kɛmba je nɛ, a leŋ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ yel kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Darkness is their only companion, hiding their path at noon.
translation_verse: Taŋ yie pʋl ŋɩɩ nɛ ka birimiŋ tɔba, ba lɩlaarɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ a nagɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ.

english_verse: God rescues the needy from the words of the wicked and the fist of the mighty.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa yie laa summoo ta nɛ sʋʋŋ lɛ, a laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ ta dɩ nɩduoruŋ sɩ́ ba dɔgʋsʋ.

english_verse: The poor are filled with hope, and injustice is silenced. Consider Yourself Fortunate
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, summoo kɛŋ yɩɛlaa nɛ, ka Wɩa leŋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ niiŋ tɔ.

english_verse: Consider yourself fortunate if God All-Powerful chooses to correct you.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala Wɩa sɩ kaa tʋraa kɩɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, sɩ́ Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna dagɩŋ vɩa.

english_verse: He may cause injury and pain, but he will bandage and heal your cuts and bruises.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie wuo pɩrɩŋ, aŋ bɩra vɔɔ tɔ naawɩɩl-la. Ʋ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ŋ na hɛɛŋ, aŋ bɩra vaarɩŋ.

english_verse: God will protect you from harm, no matter how often trouble may strike.
translation_verse: Wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ jaŋ wuo vɛnɛɛ jʋʋŋ bʋa na-kala, ama Wɩa jaŋ lɩɩsɩŋ ba kala lɛ.

english_verse: You will be sheltered, without fear of hurtful words or any other weapon.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ laaŋ ta nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa chicheyiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ fá fawʋllʋŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chei nɩaa nɛ kɔ.

english_verse: You will laugh at the threat of destruction and famine. And you won't be afraid of wild animals—
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ mʋmɔŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chei leriŋ arɩ losuŋ nɛ jʋa, ŋ bɩ jaŋ fɩfá baga kɩaa.

english_verse: they will no longer be fierce, and your rocky fields will become friendly.
translation_verse: Ŋ baga bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tabɩaa, baga kɩaa bɩ jaŋ walɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: Your home will be secure, and your sheep will be safe.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ hɔŋ ŋ dɩa lɛ a bɩ wɩɩkala ka fá, ŋ jaŋ dɩɩsɛ ŋ dʋa kala, dɩ kʋŋ bɩ fuolo.

english_verse: You will have more descendants than there are blades of grass on the face of the earth.
translation_verse: Ŋ biiriŋ jaŋ yʋgɛ, dɩ ŋ doho nɩaa paala nagɛ dʋnɩa yaŋ.

english_verse: You will live a very long life, and your body will be strong until the day you die.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ waa a hɩɛsɛ woruŋ aŋ-na sʋʋ, a nagɛ kɩaa sɩ bɩa ba bʋa lɛ ba kʋŋ.

english_verse: Our experience has proven these things to be true, so listen and learn.
translation_verse: La beŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ woruŋ, a na dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, jegile nɩɩʋ woruŋ aŋ kɛnʋ kaa tɩŋ.”

english_verse: They outweigh the sand along the beach, and that's why I have spoken without thinking first.
translation_verse: ʋ fa jaŋ yuŋŋie kɩɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ hagɩlɩ-bumbugulo kala. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ yaraa sɩ hoso mɩ bʋbʋl kperiŋ.

english_verse: The fearsome arrows of God All-Powerful have filled my soul with their poison.
translation_verse: Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna joŋ ʋ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ yagɛmɛ nɛ, ba huoŋ laara kɛŋ mɩ yaraa kala. Wɩa yuomi, fawʋllʋŋ chaasa kɛmmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Do oxen and wild donkeys cry out in distress unless they are hungry?
translation_verse: Kaku-werigiŋ nɛ na yaŋ a didii, ʋ bɩra bɩ yel, dɩ nɛ-fere ma nɛ na ʋ kʋdiilee, ʋ bɩra bɩ yel.

english_verse: What is food without salt? What is more tasteless than the white of an egg?
translation_verse: Ama kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo dii kʋsɛbɩsɩŋ, dɩ ʋ bɩ yɩsɩŋ hɛ? Bɛɛ kʋŋ sɩma nɛ hɛ ji-halɩŋ tʋɔŋ kʋpʋla-la lɛ?

english_verse: That's how my food tastes, and my appetite is gone. *
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ kʋdosunuŋ deemba ka dii, ba leŋe mɩ wʋwɩɩlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Then I would be comforted, knowing that in all of my pain I have never disobeyed God.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala, arɩ mɩ hɛɛŋ sɩ faasa yʋgɛ ma kala. Mɩ jɩma mɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɩ bʋla vɩa.

english_verse: I am not strong as stone or bronze,
translation_verse: Mɩ dolie nagɛ tabɩɩŋ nɛɛ? Mɩ yaraa nammɩa ŋaa kɔlɩɩ nɛɛ?

english_verse: and I have finally reached the end of my rope. My Friends, I Am Desperate
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ pɛ mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ, lɛɛlɛ wʋzɔŋ kala sɩ fá kagɛ mɩ lɛ ŋ-la.

english_verse: My friends, I am desperate, and you should help me, even if I no longer respect God All-Powerful. *
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ cheye, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ nɛ chɩna gbɛrʋ, dɩ tɩɩna nɛ paala bɩra bɩ Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna ka fá ma.

english_verse: like streams that swell with melting snow,
translation_verse: Duoŋ-puso yie leŋ fuonu-la su, yibiiniŋ ba gbu lɩlɩɩ.

english_verse: then suddenly disappear in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ taŋ nɛ lɩa, ba kala kɛrɛ, ka fuo-bʋa-la kala hɩla pɩŋ.

english_verse: I am like a caravan, lost in the desert while searching for water.
translation_verse: Bʋntaŋŋɩ-laalɩŋ yie mʋ nɩmɛ a chɛ lɩɩŋ ka, aŋ gɔllɔ baarɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ a sʋʋ.

english_verse: just as I am with you. Only one look at my suffering, and you run away scared. What Have I Done Wrong?
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, ma wʋŋaalaa daga arɩ ma bɩ mɩ lɛ wuo pɛ. Ma na wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la sɩ jʋʋmɛ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma nɛ.

english_verse: Have I ever asked any of you to give me a gift
translation_verse: Mɩ ha maachie bʋla arɩ ma tiŋ mɩ chɩŋ, koo dɩ ma joŋ ma dʋa a kpal nʋʋ pɩmɛɛ?

english_verse: What have I done wrong? Show me, and I will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Dagɛmɛ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa chei, dagɛmɛ, mɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ mɩ niiŋ.

english_verse: The truth is always painful, but your arguments prove nothing.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ wɩɩ nɛ woruŋ. Ama ma wʋkaalɛrɛ-la bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ bɛɛ?

english_verse: Here I am desperate, and you consider my words as worthless as wind.
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna goŋ pɛɩ nɛ mɩɩ ŋaa? Ŋɩɩ-na ma kɛmmɛ tʋrɛ?

english_verse: Look me straight in the eye; I won't lie to you.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, má beŋ mɩ sɩaa lɛ woruŋ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa a pɩma.

english_verse: I know right from wrong, and I am not telling lies.
translation_verse: Koo wʋbɔŋ nɛ mɩ bʋl? Ma bɩɩna mɩ bɩ wʋzɔmʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ bʋa jɩŋ?

english_verse: We are slaves in search of shade; we are laborers longing for our wages.
translation_verse: Ʋ nagɛ yomo sɩ yie cho dɩ wɩa jʋʋ lɩma nɛ, koo pa-chɩŋ-diire sɩ gbɛrɛ a chichel dɩ ʋ laa ʋ time.

english_verse: God has made my days drag on and my nights miserable.
translation_verse: Chɛnsɩŋ sɩɩ bal ŋɩɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ, tɩtaŋ na-kala mɩ nɩna hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: I pray for night to end, but it stretches out while I toss and turn.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ pɩna tɩtaŋɩŋ, taŋ yie dieni nɛ woruŋ aŋ-na pʋl, mɩ yie pɩna bilimi ŋɩɩ nɛ, a chɩchɛ dɩ taŋ pʋl lɩma.

english_verse: My parched skin is covered with worms, dirt, and sores,
translation_verse: Mɩ yaraa kala nɛ tɔ arɩ nanchʋɔlaa arɩ chalɩŋ sɩ hɩla. Mɩ yaraa kala verigi a lɩlɩɩ nʋɔlʋŋ.

english_verse: and my days are running out quicker than the thread of a fast-moving needle. Don't Forget!
translation_verse: Mɩ tapʋlaa ka dɛrɛ nɛ lɩma lɩma, a nagɛ gɛrɩpɛ-yuoro kpʋlʋŋ-kpoguluŋ sɩɩ fá lɩma lɩma ŋɩɩ, ba dɛrɛ nɛ, ka mɩ bɩ yɩɛla kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I beg you, God, don't forget! My life is just a breath, and trouble lies ahead.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, liise yi arɩ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kala ŋaa pel nɛ, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: I will vanish from sight, and no one, including you, will ever see me again.
translation_verse: Ŋ namɛ nɛ lɛɛlɛ, ama ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ namɛ, ŋ jaŋ bee chɩchɛmɛ, ama mɩ jaŋ tuo.

english_verse: I will disappear in the grave or vanish from sight like a passing cloud.
translation_verse: Dɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ nɛ lɛlɛ, ʋ lɛlɛ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ saa, dɩ nʋʋ ma nɛ mʋ lɛlɩŋ, ʋ bɩra bɩ mɩɩrɛ.

english_verse: Never will I return home; soon I will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ ʋ dɩa. Lee-la ʋ sɩ hɛ, nɩaa yie yʋ ʋ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Am I the sea or a sea monster? Is that why you imprison me?
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nɛ koo mɩ ŋaa peribanyeŋŋu sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, ŋ leŋ ba pʋpɔmɛ?

english_verse: I'd rather choke to death than live in this body.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ paala leŋ mɩ cho dɩ ba chagɛmɛ kpʋ, ʋ nɛ fa kpɩa mɩ sɩ hɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Leave me alone and let me die; my life has no meaning.
translation_verse: Mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ fɩɩ mɩ tɩtɩa nɛ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Lemmi sɔm, mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Why do you test us from sunrise to sunset?
translation_verse: Ŋ yie benu chʋchʋɔŋ, aŋ mɩmagɩsʋ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Won't you look away just long enough for me to swallow?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ ŋ sɩaa mɩ lɛ, a lemmi dɩ mɩ wiesi mʋa?

english_verse: Why do you watch us so closely? What's it to you, if I sin? Why am I your target and such a heavy burden?
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ sɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, wʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa ŋ lɛ, ŋ-na Wɩa sɩɩ beŋ nuhuobiinee? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ joŋ sɩɩŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ a mɩmagɩsɛmɛ? Mɩ mɩɩra nagɛ chʋga nɛ a pɩŋ koo?

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Balɩdad Sʋa tɩɩna-la pɩɛsɛ:

english_verse: Does God All-Powerful stand in the way of justice?
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kaa bɩbɩrɩmɛ. Wɩa, doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ harɩŋ ka lɩɩ.

english_verse: So why don't you turn to him
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ bee chɛ Wɩa, a sʋl Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna,

english_verse: and start living right? Then he will decide to rescue and restore you to your place of honor.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa nɩpʋla dɩ ŋ wɩaa tʋʋlɛ, Wɩa jaŋ kʋ pɛ ŋ lɛ a leŋ dɩ ŋ bɩra kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kala ŋ fa sɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Your future will be brighter by far than your past. Our Ancestors Were Wise
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩ-suomuŋ jaŋ nagɛ ʋ muuro, ama ŋ maachie dʋa jaŋ yʋgɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Our ancestors were wise, so learn from them.
translation_verse: Pɩɛsɛ faafaa nɩaa a na wɩalɩŋ ba naabalɩmaba sɩ gʋnna.

english_verse: Our own time has been short, like a fading shadow, and we know very little.
translation_verse: Dɩa deeŋ tɛgɛɛ nɛ ba lʋlla, la-na bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ. Tapʋlɩa-la la sɩ jaŋ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ bɩ kɩa ŋaa, ba nagɛ daaliimiŋ sɩɩ lɛl nɛ.

english_verse: But they will instruct you with great understanding.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ la naabalɩmaba-la dagɩŋ, ba jaŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jɩma a dagɩŋ.

english_verse: Such is the hopeless future of all who turn from God
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jaŋ nagɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ yʋ Wɩa lɛ, ba yɩɛlaa jaŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: and trust in something as frail as a spider's web—
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ lɛ ba sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ mʋa ma, ba nagɛ badɛrɛ ŋmɛsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Sinful people are like plants with spreading roots and plenty of sun and water.
translation_verse: Ba nagɛ tɩa sɩ vɔgɛ lɩɩŋ nɛ, ka wɩa ma pɔsɔ hɩhɛ ʋ lɛ, ʋ naakelee jɛrɛ laa tinteeŋ kala.

english_verse: They wrap their roots tightly around rocks.
translation_verse: Ʋ naapoloo tuu vɔɔ kɛŋ tabɩaa sɩ gulumo pɩŋ, aa chɛ leriŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: But once they are pulled up, they have no more place;
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba nɛ kɛnʋ churi, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ʋ fa chɩŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: their life slips away, and other plants grow there.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ, ka dɩ tɩɩsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ laa ʋ leriŋ.

english_verse: We know God doesn't reject an innocent person or help a sinner.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, Wɩa bɩ jaŋ vɩa nʋʋ sɩ bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ ta, koo a pɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: And so, he will make you happy and give you something to smile about.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɔmʋŋ bɩra su ŋ niiŋ, dɩ ŋ jʋɔsa ŋɩŋaa goŋ.

english_verse: But your evil enemies will be put to shame and disappear forever.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ dii ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ dɩɩsɩŋ ma lɛl.”

english_verse: What you say is true. No human is innocent in the sight of God.
translation_verse: “Mɩ jɩma wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Ama ɛɛ nɛ nuhuobiine jaŋ wuo kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa teeŋ?

english_verse: Not once in a thousand times could we win our case if we took him to court.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ nʋʋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ wɩɩ kaa lɛrɛ ʋ teeŋ? Dɩ ʋ nɛ pɩɛsɛ wɩaa bʋɩ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo laa wʋbala ma a bʋl.

english_verse: God is wise and powerful— who could possibly oppose him and win?
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋjɩmɩŋ yʋga, ʋ doluŋ ma pʋrɩgɛ leriŋ kala. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ha wuo magɩsɛ Wɩa dɩ wɩɩ bɩ ʋ lɛ ŋaa?

english_verse: When God becomes angry, he can move mountains before they even know it.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie churi peelee a dɩ ba lɛ, dɩ ʋ baanɩŋ nɛ sii ba nyuŋ, ʋ kɛmba wuro chu.

english_verse: God can shake the earth loose from its foundations
translation_verse: Ʋ yie kɛŋ tinteeŋ zigili a tuu kɛŋ ʋ gentine pɛ.

english_verse: or command the sun and stars to hold back their light.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ sɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ sɩ́ pɔsʋ, ʋ bɩ pɔsɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ tɔ chɛnwʋlaa ma, ba bɩ chaanɛ.

english_verse: God alone stretched out the sky, stepped on the sea,
translation_verse: Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ a leŋ ʋ jɛrɛ, aŋ vɩvɛŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩ-peliŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: and set the stars in place— the Big Dipper and Orion, the Pleiades and the stars in the southern sky.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ ŋaa chɛnwʋla-la sɩ chige chɩŋ wɩa-nyuŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ chɛnwʋla-la sɩ chige chɩŋ wɩa-nyuŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Of all the miracles God works, we cannot understand a one.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa nʋʋ sɩ bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ wuo jɩŋ, a ŋɩŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ sɩ bɩ nii kɛnɛ.

english_verse: And if he grabs something, who can stop him or raise a question?
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ kʋŋ laa, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo bʋl ʋ sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo pɩɛsʋ arɩ wʋbɛɛ nɛ ʋ ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ?

english_verse: When God showed his anger, the servants of the sea monster fell at his feet.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa baanɩŋ nɛ sie, wɩɩkala bɩ ʋ wuo kɛrɛ. Ʋ yie chei ʋ dʋndɔmɔ-la kala sɩ pɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ kʋbɔŋ-la lɛ, ba yuyuou nɛ.

english_verse: How, then, could I possibly argue my case with God? Though I Am Innocent
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ saa mɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ wɩaa lɩlɛrɛ Wɩa teeŋ? Wʋbɛɛba nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo kaalɛrɛ ʋ teeŋ?

english_verse: And if God came into court when I called him, he would not hear my case.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ paala yɩrʋ dɩ la mʋ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ, dɩ ʋ sɛɩ ma, mɩ bɩ laa dii arɩ ʋ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: He would strike me with a storm and increase my injuries for no reason at all.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ duoŋ-pel-duoŋ cheimi, a leŋ dɩ mɩ naawɩɩlaa wasa pʋŋa pɛ, ka mɩ bɩ wɩɩ ma cheye.

english_verse: Before I could get my breath, my miseries would multiply.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ na wiese mʋa ma, ama ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ hɛɛŋ faasa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: God is much stronger than I am, and who would call me into court to give me justice?
translation_verse: Dɩ doluŋ nɛ, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ. Dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ma nɛ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo kɛnʋ mʋ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ?

english_verse: I am not guilty, but I no longer care what happens to me.
translation_verse: Arɩ mɩ sɩ bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ ma, mɩ bɩ mɩ tɩtɩa wɩaa chɩla, mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ paala bɩ bʋbʋa kala kɛnɛ a pɩmɛ.

english_verse: What difference does it make? God destroys the innocent along with the guilty.
translation_verse: Dabaŋ kala tuo, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, ‘Wɩa yie chei nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ.’

english_verse: When a good person dies a sudden death, God sits back and laughs.
translation_verse: Dɩ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ guu kpʋ nɩaa, Wɩa yie mʋmɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye nɛ.

english_verse: And who else but God blindfolds the judges, then lets the wicked take over the earth? My Life Is Speeding By
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ joŋ tinteeŋ hɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, Wɩa yie leŋ sarɩya diiree nyʋlɩmɛ nɛ, a bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ka na. Dɩ Wɩa dee bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa?

english_verse: Each day passes swifter than a sailing ship or an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Baa bal nɛ lɩma lɩma, a nagɛ lɩɩŋ daboro sɩɩ fá lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ, a nagɛ kachuuŋ sɩɩ tuu dɩ ʋ joŋ kʋa.

english_verse: Sometimes I try to be cheerful and to stop complaining,
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ sɩ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ wɩaa deemba ŋmɛnɩŋ ma, a sɩ́ mɩ sɩaa kaa nyal aŋ mʋmɔŋ ma,

english_verse: but my sufferings frighten me, because I know that God still considers me guilty.
translation_verse: mɩ bɔyɛ ha yie jujoŋ nɛ mɩ hɛɛ-la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jɩma ŋ-na Wɩa bɩ jaŋ lemmi ta arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye.

english_verse: So what's the use of trying to prove my innocence?
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ folo jɩŋ arɩ mɩ laa cheeriŋ nɛ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ jaŋ bɩra lɔlɔ tɩta pɛɩ?

english_verse: Even if I washed myself with the strongest soap,
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ paala fo chɛnfɛnnɩŋ ma, a kɛŋ sɛhɩyɛ sɔŋ mɩ nɩsaa,

english_verse: God would throw me into a pit of stinking slime, leaving me disgusting to my clothes.
translation_verse: ŋ jaŋ yigimi hɛ buotuoŋ sɩ kɛŋ vʋchɔɔŋ lɛ, dɩ mɩ kala birisi, dɩ mɩ gɛnnɩŋ ma paala bɛrɛmɛ.

english_verse: God isn't a mere human like me. I can't put him on trial.
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩ nuhuobiiŋ ŋaa, mɩ sɩ jaŋ wuo laa wɩaa bʋl ʋ teeŋ, dɩ mɩ dɩ ʋ wuo bʋl wɩaa sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ.

english_verse: Then I could speak up without fear of him, but for now, I cannot speak.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩaa aŋ bɩ ʋ ka fá, ama lɛɛlɛ wɩaa sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ bɩ wɩɩ wuo bʋl.

english_verse: I am sick of life! And from my deep despair, I complain to you, my God.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ hɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ bɩra bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ ŋmɛŋ ŋɩɩ kala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ. Mɩ jaŋ bʋl tʋɔ-chee-la sɩ faasa kɛmmɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: Don't just condemn me! Point out my sin.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩ Wɩa: Sɩ́ cheeriŋ joŋo pɩmɛ, dagɛmɛ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa chei.

english_verse: Why do you take such delight in destroying those you created and in smiling on sinners?
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ pɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛmɛ a vɩa nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa? Ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩɩ ŋaa lɛɛ?

english_verse: Do you look at things the way we humans do?
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛŋ nuhuobiine sɩaa nɛɛ? Ŋŋ na wɩaa arɩ nuhuobiine sɩɩ naba ŋɩɩ nɛɛ?

english_verse: Is that why you are so quick to find fault with me?
translation_verse: Ŋ gbille na mɩ wʋcheelee, a chɛ na mɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ maa?

english_verse: You know I am innocent, but who can defend me against you?
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩma mɩ bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa cheyiŋ, a jɩŋ dɩ nʋʋkala ma bɩ jaŋ wuo laamɛ ta ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Will you now destroy someone you created?
translation_verse: Ŋ nɩsaa nɛ ŋ kaa ŋaamɛ. Ŋ saa jaŋ bɩra cheimi?

english_verse: Remember that you molded me like a piece of clay. So don't turn me back into dust once again.
translation_verse: Liise mʋ yi arɩ chʋrʋŋ nɛ ŋ kaa mɛmɩ. Ŋ chɛ ŋ bɩra nɔmmɛ dɩ mɩ nagɛ hagɩlɩ-munuŋ nɛɛ?

english_verse: As cheese is made from milk, you created my body from a tiny drop.
translation_verse: Ŋ dee bɩ leŋe mɩ nyɩmma fɩɩrɩŋ jʋʋ mɩ naaŋ luoruŋ mɩ suomo waa nɩmɛɛ?

english_verse: Then you tied my bones together with muscles and covered them with flesh and skin.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ mɛmɩ, a ŋaa mɩ haŋgbelee arɩ poloo, a joŋ nampɩlɩŋ arɩ puruŋ tɔ.

english_verse: You, the source of my life, showered me with kindness and watched over me. You Have Not Explained
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ pɩmɛ mɩɩsɩŋ, aŋ dagɛ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ chomi, a bemmi woruŋ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: but you catch and punish me each time I sin.
translation_verse: Ŋ faa beŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ na arɩ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, dɩ ŋ vɩa dɩ ŋ joŋo chɛmɛ.

english_verse: No matter how hard I try, you keep hunting me down like a powerful lion.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa je, ŋ yie nagɛ naachigiŋ nɛ a bagɩlɛmɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ kɛmmɛ, a dagɛ ŋ dol bal-la mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Why did you let me be born? I would rather have died before birth
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ kɛmmɛ kʋ lɩɩ mɩ naaŋ luoruŋ tʋɔŋ? Mɩ fa cho dɩ mɩ sʋba nɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala bɩ mɩ na.

english_verse: I have only a few days left. Why don't you leave me alone? Let me find some relief, *
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ hɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba dɛrɩŋ yie nɛ. Lemmi, dɩ mɩ nɩɩ sɩma mʋa,

english_verse: Your words have silenced others and made them ashamed; now it is only right for you to be put to shame.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩɩna ŋ wʋbʋlʋŋ kɩŋkɛŋ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ nɩaa tɔrɛ ba niiŋ? Dɩ ŋ nɛ mɔŋ Wɩa lɛ, ŋ bɩɩna nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo kɛnɩŋ tʋra kɩɩ?

english_verse: You claim to be innocent and argue that your beliefs are acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Ŋ yie bʋla pɩ Wɩa, ‘Wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ laa dii tʋʋla nɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ pʋla nɛ ŋ sɩpaaŋ.’

english_verse: and let you know that wisdom has many different sides. You would then discover that God has punished you less than you deserve.
translation_verse: a leŋ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ sɩ faa ʋ lɛ, nuhuobiine sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ. Jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa paala bɩŋ dɔgɩsɔ a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ fa sɩ maga dɩ ʋ dɔgʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little,
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋie kɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ, wʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa yi nɩmɛ? Ʋ luŋie kɩɩ sʋʋŋ bʋa ma. Ŋ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ ʋ luŋuŋ maŋŋaa?

english_verse: and these mysteries outreach the earth and the ocean?
translation_verse: Ʋ duomo kɩɩ dʋnɩa, a jalɩa kɩɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ ma.

english_verse: If God puts you in prison or drags you to court, what can you do?
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ kɛnɩŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ dii ŋ sarɩya, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo bʋl dɩ ʋ sɩ́ dii?

english_verse: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful,
translation_verse: Ʋ jɩŋ wʋnyɩɛraa nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ na wʋbɔmʋŋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ leŋu ta pɛɩ.

english_verse: but it's easier to tame a wild donkey than to make a fool wise. Surrender Your Heart to God
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɔ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a nagɛ kaku-werigiŋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo lʋl nuhuobiine.

english_verse: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer,
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ ŋ tʋɔŋ kala pɩ Wɩa, a kɛŋ ŋ nɩsaa je a chʋɔlʋ,

english_verse: and give up your sins— even those you do in secret.
translation_verse: aŋ joŋ ŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala ta, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wʋbɔŋ kala kpagɩŋ,

english_verse: Your troubles will go away like water beneath a bridge,
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ yʋ ŋ wʋwalɩmaa kala, ba jaŋ nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ pɛllɛ viiri, ŋ bɩra bɩ ba wɩaa liisi.

english_verse: and your darkest night will be brighter than noon.
translation_verse: Ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ bɩra chaanɛ a kɩɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ, dɩ ŋ birimiŋ ma nagɛ chʋchʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But those who are evil will go blind and lose their way. Their only escape is death!
translation_verse: Ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ haa niiŋ a bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa ba lɛ. Ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ wombii-kala tuo ba sɩ jaŋ to a fori, ba yɩɛlaa kala nɛ sʋʋŋ.”

english_verse: Job said to his friends:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Job bʋl:

english_verse: You think you are so great, with all the answers.
translation_verse: “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ma bɩɩna arɩ ma dʋndʋŋa nɛ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, dɩ ma nɛ sʋba, wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ lɛl.

english_verse: But I know as much as you do, and so does everyone else.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ dɩ ma kala wʋjɩmɩŋ magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Mɩ bɩ muuro ma teeŋ wɩɩkala lɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ bɩ wɩaa deemba kala ma sɩ bʋla jɩŋ?

english_verse: I have always lived right, and God answered my prayers; now friends make fun of me.
translation_verse: Mɩ mɩɩra ŋaa mɔmɩɩ nɛ mɩ nandɔnsʋŋ teeŋ, mɩ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa ʋ laa mɩ sʋla. Mɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ a bɩ wɩɩkala ma ŋaa chei.

english_verse: It's easy to condemn those who are suffering, when you have no troubles.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ wɩaa sɩ bɩ walɩmɛ ka sieri mɩ lɛ nɛ, a yiyigi nʋʋ sɩ sɩɛra a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ tel.

english_verse: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, “God is in our hands!” If You Want To Learn
translation_verse: Ama gaaraa hɔnɔ nɛ, wɩɩkala bɩ baa walɩmɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa baanɩŋ sii ma kala hɔnɔ ta jɩa nɛ, a bibigisi ba doluŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If you want to learn, then go and ask the wild animals and the birds,
translation_verse: Ŋ-na pɩɛsɛ pʋsʋŋ dɩ ba dagɩŋ koo diibiisiŋ sɩɩ fil, ba jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ.

english_verse: Any of them can tell you what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Kɩaa deemba kʋbɛɛ nɛ bɩ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaaba?

english_verse: Every living creature is in the hands of God.
translation_verse: Kʋŋ na-kala sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, nuhuobiiŋ kala mɩɩsɩŋ lɩɩ ʋ teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ ŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ kʋŋ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ diene dʋnɩa lɛ nɛ yie jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ ŋaa wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, ʋ nɩɩ chagɩlɛ nɩaa a jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ ma.

english_verse: No one can rebuild what he destroys, or release those he has imprisoned.
translation_verse: Kʋ-la ʋ sɩ yige lo, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo saaʋ, nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa ma, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo lɩɩsʋ ta.

english_verse: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a yuo didii ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ bʋa na-kala, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ nɩɩ-la ba sɩ nyɩsa arɩ nɩnyɩsɛra kala doluŋ.

english_verse: God removes priests and others who have great power—
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ yie kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a kaa muuri.

english_verse: puts mighty kings to shame, and takes away their power.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ yie leŋ hɩɩsɩŋ dii kuoroo, aŋ kɛŋ nɩduoruŋ ma laalɩyuori kɩaa kaa laa.

english_verse: God strikes their rulers senseless, then leaves them to roam through barren deserts,
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ yie leŋ ba sɩpaalaaraa yaarɛ a leŋ ba yeŋŋi a lɛl,

english_verse: I know and understand every bit of this.
translation_verse: Mɩ na wɩaa deemba kala nɛ. Mɩ nɩɩ ba nɛ a jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: None of you are smarter than I am; there's nothing you know that I don't.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jɩma, ba tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ ma jɩŋ. Mɩ bɩ nɩ-bee-gʋʋnɩɩ ŋaa ma teeŋ.

english_verse: you are merely useless doctors, who treat me with lies.
translation_verse: Ma joŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ tɔmɛ hɛ. Ma kala nagɛ daaluŋ-ŋaaraa sɩ bɩ nɩaa wuo vaarɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet
translation_verse: Dɩ ma kala nɛ fa jaŋ tɔrɛ ma niiŋ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wʋjɩmɩɩ a pɩma.

english_verse: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?
translation_verse: Maa chɛ ma laa pɛ Wɩa lɛ nɛɛ? Maa chɛ ma laa ʋ wɩɩŋ bʋla pʋʋ nɛɛ?

english_verse: If he took you to court, could you fool him, just as you fool others?
translation_verse: Wɩaa jaŋ zɔmɔ pɩmaa dɩ Wɩa nɛ beŋ wɩaa tʋɔŋ woruŋ? Ma bɩɩna ma jaŋ wuo nyɩsʋ arɩ ma sɩɩ nyɩsɛ nɩaa ŋɩɩ?

english_verse: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you,
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma dɩ ma nɛ lʋara kɛŋ nɩaa pʋpɔrɛ.

english_verse: and his glorious splendor would make you terrified.
translation_verse: Ʋ tʋla jaŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ jʋʋma, dɩ ʋ doluŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma.

english_verse: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.
translation_verse: Má tɔrɛ ma niiŋ, ka dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa, aŋ leŋ wɩɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ lɛ, ʋ ŋaa.

english_verse: I will be responsible for what happens to me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kori, aŋ bʋl mɩ tʋɔŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ jaŋ kpʋmɛ ma, ama mɩ ha jaŋ gbɛrɛ, a bʋl wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ ʋ sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ laamɛ ta nɛ ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩbɔŋ kala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɔ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my words!
translation_verse: Má jegili woruŋ, a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl.

english_verse: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ wɩaa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ lɛɛlɛ, mɩ jɩma ʋ jaŋ bʋl mɩ kɩaa sɩma.

english_verse: If you can prove me guilty, I will give up and die. Job Prays I Ask Only Two Things
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ jaŋ wuo dagɛ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa chei, ŋɩɩ-na mɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ mɩ niiŋ aŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, ŋaa wɩaa deemba balɩa a pɩmɛ, ka dɩ mɩ bɩra sɩ́ mɩ tɩtɩa kaa faa ŋ teeŋ:

english_verse: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
translation_verse: Wɩa, bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ laa bʋl, koo dɩ ŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa dɩ ŋ laa bʋl.

english_verse: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
translation_verse: Wɩaa baŋmɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa chei? Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ baŋmɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa? Dagɛ mɩ wʋcheelee arɩ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩamɛ, a jommi mɩ nagɛ ŋ dʋndɔŋ?

english_verse: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa sɩ chaasa lɔrɛ nɛ a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ, ŋ liisimi mɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa mɩ bapʋɔsʋŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You have tied my feet down and keep me surrounded;
translation_verse: Ŋ vɔɔ mɩ naasɩŋ nɛ arɩ chɔrʋmɔɔ, a bibeŋ mɩ wombii-vɛnɛɛ kala, a magɩlɛ mɩ naavɛnɛɛ.

english_verse: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Mɩ yɔrʋmɔ nɛ a nagɛ daa-pʋa, a nagɛ gɛrɩŋ tiiŋ sɩ die.

english_verse: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ yie lʋl nuhuobiine, ʋ tapʋlaa ŋaa baŋmɛnɛ nɛ aŋ ka ʋ wʋjʋʋlaa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: There's no way a human can be completely pure.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo lɩɩsɛ kʋŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ kɩaa sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ lɛ? Nʋʋ tuo.

english_verse: Our time on earth is brief; the number of our days is already decided by you.
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ nuhuobiine tapʋlaa nɛ, ŋ dagɛ ʋ chɛnsɩŋ niiŋ nɛ, a dagɛ ʋ tapʋlaa bil, ʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo kieli ŋɩɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, lɩɩsɛ ŋ sɩaa ʋ lɛ aŋ leŋu, dɩ ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ a nagɛ pachɩŋ-diire.

english_verse: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ keri tɩa lo, ʋ ha kɛŋ yɩɛlaa nɛ. Ʋ ha jaŋ bɩra tɔsɛ pɩpaa-falaa.

english_verse: but at the touch of water, it sprouts once again.
translation_verse: ama dɩ ʋ nɛ na lɩɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ bɩra tɔsɛ a kɛŋ pɩpaarɩŋ a bɩrɩmɛ tɩa.

english_verse: Humans are different— we die, and that's the end.
translation_verse: Ama nuhuobiine-na yie sʋʋ nɛ ba joŋo hugi. Ʋ yie wiesi ʋ wiesi katɩɩ aŋ tuo.

english_verse: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;
translation_verse: A nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ hʋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, koo fuoŋ tʋɔŋ sɩ hɩla a yɛrɛ,

english_verse: we fall into the sleep of death, never to rise again, until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ nɛ nuhuobiine yie sʋʋ pɩŋ ʋ bɩ sii. Dɩ dʋnɩa nɛ bɩ dɛrɛ, nuhuobiine bɩ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ sii ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ pɩna lɛ.

english_verse: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me. Will We Humans Live Again?
translation_verse: Wɩa, dɩ ŋ nɛ fa jaŋ yaara jommi hɛ bʋa tʋɔŋ, dɩ mɩ faa nɩmɛ ka dɩ ŋ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ. Mɩ fa jaŋ cho dɩ ŋ dagɛ tapʋlaa pɩmɛ nɩmɛ, dɩ ba nɛ yie, dɩ ŋ liisi mɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ yɩrɛmɛ, dɩ mɩ sɛɩ, ŋ jaŋ bee chɛ mɩ-na nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ dɩɩsɛ mɩ naavɛnɛɛ, ama ŋ bɩ jaŋ liliisi mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ joŋ mɩ wʋcheelee hɛ lʋaga lɛ a kaa tɔ, ŋ jaŋ gbaa tɔ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala.

english_verse: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
translation_verse: Ama peelee sɩ tele yɛrɛ muno muno ŋɩɩ, bʋsʋŋ churi ba dɩchɩnaa lɛ,

english_verse: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!
translation_verse: lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ chɩɩrɛ tabɩaa, duoŋ-balɩŋ nɩɩ a pɛllɛ paa hagɩla viiri ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋ yie chei nuhuobiine yɩɛlaa.

english_verse: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
translation_verse: Bala nɛ, ŋ yie yuo kɛnʋ, ʋ lɛl, ŋ yie kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa bɩrɩmɛ nɛ a kɛnʋ viiri.

english_verse: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ laa yɩrɩŋ ma, ʋ-na yie bɩ jɩŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ bɩra dii hɩɩsɩŋ ma, ʋ-na bɩ baa na.

english_verse: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ-la ʋ sɩɩ na ʋ yaraa lɛ dʋndʋŋa wɩaa nɛ ʋ jɩŋ, a yiyel ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said: *
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛlɩfas, Tɛma tɩɩna-la pɩɛsɛ:

english_verse: you would stop spreading all of this hot air.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ wɩaa sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ a lɩlɛrɛ, aa bʋl wʋpɛɩbaa?

english_verse: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.
translation_verse: Ŋ wʋbʋlaa ka kiri nɩaa nɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ Wɩa fá, a pɔ dɩ ba sɩ́ ba tɩtɩa joŋo pʋ.

english_verse: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.
translation_verse: Ŋ wʋbʋlaa sɛnɛ dagɛ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ bɔmɔ nɛ. Ŋ kɛŋ badɛ tɩɩna nandelimiŋ.

english_verse: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.
translation_verse: Ŋ tɩtɩa niiŋ nɛ cheyiŋ, mɩ-na dee. Ŋ niiŋ nɛ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩŋ.

english_verse: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ ba laa sɩpaaŋ lʋl? Ŋ nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ lɩɩ dundolluŋ lɛɛ?

english_verse: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
translation_verse: Ŋ pɛ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ magɩsa bil dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɛɛ? Ŋ bɩɩna wʋjɩmɩŋ ŋaa ŋ dʋndʋŋa kʋŋ nɛɛ?

english_verse: We have the benefit of wisdom older than your father.
translation_verse: La ma kɛŋ nɩaa sɩ hɩɛsa ba nyuŋ pʋllɛ nɛ, ba paala hɩa ŋ nyɩmma.

english_verse: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ nyagɛ ŋ bɔyɛ ŋɩɩ bɩ magaa? La sɩ chɩŋ ʋ naasɩŋ lɛ fɩɛla bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ pɩŋ.

english_verse: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛl, ŋ sɩaa bibeŋ forimo forimo,

english_verse: that's why you attack God with everything you say.
translation_verse: ŋ na baanɩŋ Wɩa teeŋ, a bʋbʋl wʋdosunuŋ deemba?

english_verse: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels,
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ paala bɩ ʋ tɩndaaraa laa dii, dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa joŋo ba ŋaa kɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ʋ teeŋ,

english_verse: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
translation_verse: ɛɛ nɛ saa ʋ jaŋ nagɛ nuhuobiine sɩ kɛŋ nyɛsɩŋ a kala chei, a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a nagɛ nɩa sɩɩ nyʋa lɩɩŋ?

english_verse: wisdom known by others since ancient times.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ wʋjɩnnaa sɩ bʋla, wɩalɩŋ ba naabalɩmaba sɩ dagɛba, ba bɩ kʋŋkala joŋo faa.

english_verse: Those who gained such insights also gained the land, and they were not influenced by foreign teachings.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋ tintee-la pa, nɩwogo-kala fa tuo ba tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa dɩ ba yeŋŋi Wɩa wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But suffering is in store each day for those who sin.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ yie na hɛɛŋ nɛ ʋ tapʋlaa kala lɛ, tʋɔhɛɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ yie pɩna gbɛrʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Even in times of success, they constantly hear the threat of doom.
translation_verse: Fawʋlɩbɩ-goŋ yie su ʋ dɩgɩlaa nɛ. Dɩ wɩaa nɛ paalaa vɛŋ woruŋ ma, gaara jaŋ kʋ ŋmobu aŋ gaa ʋ kɩaa.

english_verse: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa duunuŋ kʋdiilii nɛ aŋ ta gɔllɔɔ baarɛ, ʋ jɩma tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kpʋʋ kpagɛ nɛ.

english_verse: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
translation_verse: Hɛɛŋ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ leŋe fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ nɛ, a chaasa jʋʋ ʋ lɛ, a nagɛ kuoro sɩ nyɩgɩla dɩ ʋ mʋ yuo laalɩŋ,

english_verse: They may be rich and fat,
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛrɛ tɔ sɩaa nɛ, ʋ tɩŋa ma pʋɔrɛ woruŋ,

english_verse: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo foro lɩɩ birimiŋ lɛ, nyiŋgeliŋ jaŋ lieri ʋ pɩpaa-ɔlɩmɔɔ dɩ ba hɩl. Wɩa jaŋ wiesi peliŋ dɩ ʋ joŋu kaa viiri.

english_verse: They have put their trust in something worthless; now they will become worthless
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ́ ʋ tɩtɩa nyɩsʋ a joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa hɛ kʋ-daŋ-la ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ lɛ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ na nyʋʋrɩ kala ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ girep tɩa sɩ nɛnɛ a bɩ bɩa, ka ba pʋrɛ, a bɩra nagɛ olif tɩa sɩ fɩɩla aŋ yuori.

english_verse: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka fá bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doho. Nyiniŋ jaŋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho kpalaa laanɩŋ lɛŋŋɛɛ.

english_verse: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
translation_verse: Ba yie bɩbɩɩnɛ dɩ ba hɛ wɩaa, a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ba yie nyɩnyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ bʋa na-kala.”

english_verse: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋl wɩaa ma, mɩ hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩɩ na bɩ fɩɛlɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ tɔrɛ mɩ niiŋ ma, hɛɛ-la bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
translation_verse: Wɩa, wʋtɩtɩɩ, ŋ kɔsɛ mɩ kala nɛ. Ŋ kpʋ mɩ dɩa nɩaa kala nɛ.

english_verse: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
translation_verse: Wɩa bɛrɛmɛ nɛ, a na baanɩŋ mɩ nyuŋ a kɛmmɛ pʋɔsɛ, aŋ dɩdɩŋ nyɩlaa mɩ nyuŋ, mɩ dʋndɔmɔ chaarɛ sɩaa pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ a gɩgɩɛnɛmɛ.

english_verse: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
translation_verse: Wɩa jommi hɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ jommi yuo hɛ tʋɔhɛɩ tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
translation_verse: Wɩaa fa zɔmɔ pɩmɛ nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ ŋmoomi yɛrɛ nɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ mɩ baŋŋaa lɛ nɛ a chagɛmɛ bʋrɩgɛ. Mɩ lɛ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛ sɩɩŋ pɛ.

english_verse: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
translation_verse: Ʋ to-yuoroo gollimi hɛ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ mɩ nenige fá, aŋ tɔɔ mɩ chʋchɔ-biee bʋrɩgɛ, a yagɛ mɩ lɩɩmɩŋ ma yɛrɛ ta tinteeŋ.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ cheye nɛ mɩ laalɛ gɛrɩ-kɔsʋmɔɔ, mɩ doluŋ dɛrɛ nɛ mɩ hɔŋ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: Mɩ yele nɛ mɩ sɩaa kala fɩɛsɛ, a ŋmɛrɛ tɔ a bɩra bɩ na woruŋ.

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala mɩ bɩ yuosu hɛ, mɩ Wɩɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ kala nɛ pʋlla.

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ, sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ-la ba sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ gbaa tɔ, sɩ́ gbaa tɔ dɩ mɩ nii-ŋmobo-la mɩ sɩ ŋmoboo chɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, mɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ pɛ na mɩ wɩɩŋ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ nɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ bʋla laamɛ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: Mɩ nandɔnsʋŋ ka sieri mɩ lɛ nɛ, mɩ sɩaa sɩɩ pɛllɛ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ, ka mɩɩ sʋl Wɩa.

english_verse: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa jaŋ cho dɩ nʋʋ laa nuhuobiine nyuŋ a sʋl Wɩa, a nagɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ sʋl dɩ ʋ laa ʋ nandɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: Jɩsɩŋ baŋmɛnɛ nɛ ka, ka dɩ mɩ mʋ lɛlɩŋ, lee-la nʋʋ sɩ jaŋ mʋ a bɩra bɩ mɩɩrɛ.

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: Mɩ wiesee puri nɛ, mɩ tapʋlaa dɛrɛ nɛ, sʋʋŋ bʋa gbɛrɛmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Nɩaa gollimi hɛ nɛ a sisieri mɩ lɛ. Mɩɩ na baaŋ-siiri-wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, joŋ kʋŋ bil mɩ wɩaa aŋ laamɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ joŋ kʋa bile laamɛ?

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: Ŋ tɔ ba wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ, ba bɩ wɩaa sɩaa jɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ŋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba yuo dii.

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ tɩŋ time wɩaa a vɩa ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ, ʋ biiriŋ ma paala bɩ jaŋ na kʋŋkala ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: Wɩa leŋe mɩ ŋaa mɔmɩɩ nɛ nɩaa kala teeŋ, a ŋaa nʋʋ ba sɩ tʋ nantʋɔrʋŋ hɩhɛ sɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: Tʋɔ-cheeŋ leŋe mɩ sɩaa bɩra bɩ woruŋ na. Mɩ yaraa kala nɛ dɛrɛ, ka mɩ nagɛ daaliimiŋ.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ kperi tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka fá sɩ sii chɩŋ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye lɛ.

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: Ama tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa ha jaŋ chɩŋ ba tʋɔpʋl wʋŋaalaa naaŋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ka ŋaa doluŋ jaŋ pʋŋa pɩpɛ.

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: Mɩ tapʋlaa bala nɛ, wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bɩɩna dɩ mɩ ŋaa kala ta nɛ. Mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala birige nɛ.

english_verse: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba kɛŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ bɩrɩmɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ nɛ. Birimiŋ yie hɛ nɩmɛ, ka ba bʋl, ‘Pʋlʋmʋŋ kpaga nɛ.’

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: Dɩ dɩa-la mɩ sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ kala nɛ ŋaa sʋʋŋ bʋa, dɩ mɩ bil mɩ bɔsɔ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ,

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pɩ sʋʋŋ, ‘Ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ nyɩmma,’ a bʋla pɩ nanchʋalʋŋ ma, ‘Ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ naaŋ arɩ mɩ dɩhaala,’

english_verse: But what kind of hope is that?
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na, nɩɩ nɛ mɩ yɩɛla-la hɛ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ wuo na mɩ yɩɛlaa?

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Mɩ yɩɛla-la kala jaŋ sɛnɛ tuu sʋʋŋ bʋa koo? Mɩ dɩ ba kala sɛnɛ jaŋ jʋʋ hagɩlaa?”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Balɩdad, Suti tɩɩna-la pɩɛsɛ,

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: “Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɛ ŋ bʋl wɩaa deemba diene magɛ? Tɔrɛ ŋ niiŋ, ka dɩ la ma bʋl wɩaa.

english_verse: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ jonla la nagɛ nɛsɩŋ, a bɩɩnɛ dɩ la ŋaa nɩyaaraa nɛ ŋ teeŋ?

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ chaanɩŋ dɩsa nɛ, ʋ nyiniŋ nyiŋgeliŋ bɩra bɩ dii.

english_verse: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
translation_verse: Ʋ naasɩŋ fa sɩ dolie ŋɩɩ, ba mɩɩra yʋɔrɛ nɛ. Ʋ tɩtɩa wʋŋaalaa nɛ leŋe ʋ tel.

english_verse: they are trapped in a net,
translation_verse: Bɛrɛ kɛŋ ʋ naatilimiŋ lɛ nɛ. Bɛrɛ mɩlʋʋ kpɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Terror strikes and pursues from every side.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ jʋʋ nɛ sɛmɛ na-kala, a daa tuto ʋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
translation_verse: Nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ dii ʋ yaraa nɛ, a leŋ ʋ nɩsaa arɩ ʋ naasɩŋ pʋa.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: Ba tɔ lɩɩsʋ ʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ ʋ fa sɩ ta jɩa nɛ, a yigu mʋ hɛ sʋʋŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
translation_verse: Nyiniŋ hɛ ʋ lɛbɩŋ lɛ nɛ, jiribiiŋ sɩɩ chol nyiniŋ pɩsa nɛ ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: Ʋ naapoloo pʋa nɛ, ʋ naakelee ma kala hɩl.

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: Ba lɩɩsʋ pʋlʋmʋŋ lɛ nɛ a kaa mʋ hɛ birimiŋ lɛ. Ba kiru ta nɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, nɩbɔmʋŋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ.”

english_verse: How long will you torture me with your words?
translation_verse: “Ɛɛ nɛ maa chɛ dɩ ma dɔgɩsɛmɛ a diene magɛ, a bʋl wɩaa jʋjʋʋ mɩ lɛ?

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Naansɩɩŋ fii nɛ ŋ-la ma sɩ dii mɩ baanɩŋ lɛ, a bɩ hɩɩsɩŋ fá aŋ tʋʋsɛmɛ.

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ paala ŋaa wɩɩ a cheima ma, ŋɩɩ ŋaa mɩ dʋndʋŋa wɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ bɩɩna dɩ ma kpɩamɛ a jóŋ hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩɩ na dɩdagɛ arɩ mɩ chei wɩɩ nɛ,

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: ma jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa nɛ jommi hɛ ŋɩɩ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ yuo ʋ jóŋ a kɛmmɛ.

english_verse: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ a bʋl, ‘Baa cheimi nɛ,’ ama nʋʋkala bɩ wɩɩ bʋla. Mɩ yɩrɛ chɩchɛ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, ama wʋtɩtɩɩ tɩɩna kala tuo.

english_verse: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness
translation_verse: Wɩa tɔ mɩ wombiiŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ sɩ́ wuo bal. Ʋ joŋ birimiŋ tɔ mɩ wombiiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: Wɩa baanɩŋ faasa sii mɩ nyuŋ nɛ, ʋ dɩɩsɛmɛ pɛ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. I Am Forgotten *
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɩyuoroo kɔ mɩ lɛ nɛ arɩ doluŋ, ba saa vaŋkumba nɛ dɩ ba yuomi, a ŋmoo buguŋ gollo mɩ dɩa kala.

english_verse: God has turned relatives and friends against me,
translation_verse: Wɩa leŋe mɩ dɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ pɛgɛ bol nɛ. Mɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔrʋ mɩ nɩjɩmaa teeŋ.

english_verse: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ yɩrɛ mɩ tɩntɩnna, ʋ bɩ sɛɩ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ paala sʋlʋ ma, ʋ bɩ nɩɩ.

english_verse: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
translation_verse: Mɩ wiese ka sʋɔrʋ nɛ mɩ haala teeŋ. Mɩ kɛŋ nyɛsɩŋ nɛ mɩ naambiiriŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Hambiisiŋ paala sisieri mɩ lɛ, dɩ ba nɛ namɛ kala, ba mʋmɔmmɛ.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: Mɩ nandɔŋ-fɩɛmaa kala kɩkɩsɛ dɩ ba kpagɛmɛ. Mɩ nɩchooloo joŋ harɩŋ yɩamɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: Mɩ kala nɛ jaga, aŋ ka haŋgbelee. Mɩ fa ka mʋa dɩ mɩ sʋba.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: Má fá mɩ nenige, mɩ nandɔsɛ, má fá mɩ nenige. Wɩa ŋmoomi bil nɛ.

english_verse: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ maa dɔgɩsɛmɛ arɩ Wɩa sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛmɛ ŋɩɩ? Ma bɩ mɩ dɔgɩsɔ magɛɛ?

english_verse: I wish that my words could be written down
translation_verse: Mɩ fa jaŋ cho dɩ nʋʋ liisi wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl, a ŋmʋnsɛba hɛ teniŋ lɛ a bil,

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ jɩma mɩ Laataara hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ. Wɩaa deemba kala dɩdɛrɩŋ ʋ jaŋ kʋ chɩna bʋla laamɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: Dɩ yawɩɩlaa nɛ chei mɩ yaraa kala ma, mɩ ha kɛŋ yɩɛlaa mɩ jaŋ na Wɩa.

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ na Wɩa, ʋ bɩ nʋhʋɔrʋ ŋaa mɩ teeŋ, mɩ malʋ nɛ. Mɩɩ chel nɛ dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la yi.

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ sɩ, ‘La jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Job, a tɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ sɩ hɛ wɩalɩŋ,’

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zɔfa, Naama tɩɩna-la bɩra bʋl:

english_verse: Since the time of creation, everyone has known
translation_verse: Ŋ tɩtɩa jɩma faafaa kala Wɩa sɩ joŋ nuhuobiinee ta dʋnɩa lɛ,

english_verse: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
translation_verse: nɩbɔmʋŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ bɩ dieni, nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to ma tʋɔtɔrʋŋ bɩ dieni.

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka fá babii-ballɩŋ jɩlaa tɩgɛ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ, ʋ nyuŋ didigi duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa.

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ jaŋ lɛl a kaa mʋ wuu a nagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa bɩnɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ naʋ aŋ ka jaŋ pɩɛsɛ, ‘Nɩɩ nɛ ʋ hɛ?’

english_verse: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ naʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ naʋ, ʋ jaŋ tuo lee-la ʋ fa sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Ʋ bapʋɔsɩ dol-la ʋ fa sɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ jaŋ kɛnʋ mɩɩra jʋʋ hagɩla.

english_verse: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nagɛ kʋdii sɩŋŋaa nɛ ʋ niiŋ lɛ, ʋ joŋo faa ʋ nandelimiŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ kʋdiilee jaŋ nyal ʋ fehe lɛ, a bɩrɩmɛ dɩmɩŋ huoŋ ʋ yaraa lɛ.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ lusi dʋa-la kala ʋ sɩ liŋe. Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ tʋɔsɛ ba kala.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: Ba nagɛ dɩmɩŋ huoŋ nɛ ʋ chʋʋsɛ, ba jaŋ kpʋʋ, a nagɛ bɔsʋŋ nyɩlaa sɩ tɔɔ nʋʋ kpʋ.

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩ jaŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ nɩɩ sɩma, a nagɛ fuoŋ sɩ suo a pɩpɛllɛ.

english_verse: because they cheated the poor and took their homes.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nyagɛ summoo bil nɛ, a vɩaba ta, aŋ kɛŋ nɩaa dɩɩsɩŋ laa.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Kʋŋkala bɩra tuo dɩ ʋ dii, ʋ dʋa bɩ jaŋ dieni.

english_verse: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ, hɛɛŋ jaŋ jʋʋ-ʋ. Tʋɔ-cheeŋ kɩŋkɛŋ jaŋ jʋʋ-ʋ.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ fá dɩ ʋ kagɛ hɔɔŋ bayuori kʋa lɛ, ama kɔlɩɩŋ to-hɛmɩŋ jaŋ kɛnʋ.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ dɩ ʋ lɛrɛ churi ʋ harɩŋ lɛ, dɩ to-hɛŋ-la niiŋ lɩlɩɩ ʋ chʋɩŋ lɛ. Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ jʋʋ-ʋ woruŋ.

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: Birimiŋ jaŋ tɔ ʋ dʋa kala. Nyiniŋ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ fuuno hɛ jaŋ diiu a kɔlɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ wʋcheelee kʋ lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ, dɩ tinteeŋ kɩaa ma sii chɩna pɛ.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Lɩɩŋ jaŋ pɛllɛ joŋ ʋ dɩa, tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa nɩbɔmʋŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ toruŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ kpaa pʋʋ.”

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Má nyalɩmɛ ka dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa. Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋla dɛrɛ, ma jaŋ wuo bɩra sisieri mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine teeŋ dee mɩɩ ŋmɛŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɩ kenyiri die ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Ma bemmi aŋ tuo bibeŋ, aŋ ŋaa ma niiŋ chɩm.

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩɩnɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, fawʋllʋŋ yie jʋʋmɛ nɛ, mɩ yaraa chichel.

english_verse: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ nɩmɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, a hɩɛsɛ ma, ka ba doluŋ pʋŋa pɩpɛ?

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Ba yie na ba biiriŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ dɩchɩnɩŋ, ba nihee ma waa puuba.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Ba dɩɩsɩŋ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ, fawʋllʋŋ tuo. Wɩa bɩ baa dɔgɩsɛ.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Ba nɛ-belliŋ bɩ jɩla tɩta pɛɩ, ba nɛ-nɩɩnɩŋ lʋlʋl, a bɩ chei tɩta.

english_verse: their children play and dance safely by themselves.
translation_verse: Ba yie leŋ ba biiriŋ lɩɩ a nagɛ pie-laalɩŋ, ba bii-biisiŋ gʋa bɩbal.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Ba yie du chɩnchɩgɩsɩŋ arɩ chenniŋ, ba ma yɩɩ yɩɩlaa hɛ, ba ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlaa ma, ba jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Ba yie pɩŋ dʋa tʋɔŋ nɛ ba mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, a tuu bʋa fɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: Ba ha yie bʋla pɩ Wɩa, ‘Leŋ la sɔm.’ La bɩ chɛ dɩ la jɩŋ ŋ wombiee,

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Ama ba dʋa bɩ ba tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ lɩa, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ sɩpaa kala tuo nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: Naansɩɩŋ bʋŋmɛɛ nɛ ma na, dɩ Wɩa yie leŋ ba nagɛ mɔ-puruŋ, peliŋ sɩ paa, a nagɛ mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ duoŋ-peliŋ paa viiri?

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yie bʋl, ‘Wɩa yie joŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo dɔgɩsɛ nʋʋ a bile gbɛrɛ ʋ biiriŋ nɛ.’ Ama mɩ Wɩa, leŋ dɩ ba tɩtɩa na hɛɛ-la sɩ maga dɩ ba na.

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba tɩtɩa na ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ cheiba, leŋ dɩ ba na ŋ-na doluŋ kala Tɩɩna baanɩŋ,

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa dɩ tapʋlɩa-la ŋ sɩ kpaa pɩba nɛ dɛrɛ, ba sɩpaa jaŋ tuo ba dɩa nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ leŋe ta harɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋkala tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo dagɛ Wɩa wʋjɩmɩŋ, ʋ nɛ paala didii nɩbalaa ma sarɩya.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Ama hagɩla nɛ jaŋ tɔ ba kala dɩ nanchʋɔlaa diiba.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Ma pɩɛsa, ‘Nɩɩ nɛ nɩbal-la dɩa hɛ, lee-la nɩbɔmɔ-la sɩɩ jʋʋ?’

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Wɛŋ-vɛnnɛɛ sɩ ‘Wɩa yie leŋ nɩbɔmʋŋ nɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ kʋkɔ. Ʋ yie lɩɩsʋ ta nɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ.

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Ba yie joŋu kaa mʋ hugi nɛ, a leŋ nɩaa pɔ ʋ vaamɩŋ.

english_verse: But empty, meaningless words are the comfort you offer me.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ saa ma jaŋ bʋl wʋtɔɔnʋŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ma nyagɛ mɩ bɔyɛ? Ma wʋbʋlaa kala ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛlɩfas, Tɛma tɩɩna-la pɩɛsɛ:

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ nuhuobiine jaŋ wuo ŋaa pɛ Wɩa lɛ? Wʋbɛɛ nɛ wʋjɩnna ma paala jaŋ wuo ŋaa a pɛ ʋ lɛ?

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ dee, ŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ yʋga nɛ tɩɩ. Ŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ paala bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ nɛ tɩɩ.

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe ŋ naambiiriŋ joŋ kɩaa bil chɩmɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ, ka ŋɩɩ bɩ wombii ŋaa. Ŋ laa nɩaa gɛnnɩŋ nɛ, ka ba kɛŋ yarɩ-biree.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ lɩɩŋ ŋaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɔlɔ dɩ ba nyʋa, a vɔŋ nɩalɩŋ ma losuŋ sɩ kɛnɛ kʋdiilee.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: aŋ kiri yo-haalaa ta ba kɛŋ na-hɩllɩŋ viiri, a nyagɛ biisinsiŋ bil ba bɩ wɩɩ wuo ŋaa.

english_verse: That's why you were suddenly trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ wʋjʋʋlaa golluŋ, fawʋllʋŋ faasa jʋʋŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ leriŋ faasa biri ŋɩɩ, ŋ bɩ wuo nɩna, wɩaa tɔŋ a nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ tɔ leriŋ.

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: Wɩa hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ-bolii, aŋ nɩna chɛnwʋlaa ma sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii.
