english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: Ama ŋ pɩɛsa, ‘Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ Wɩa jɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo to biriŋ-la tʋɔŋ a kʋ tuu dii nɩaa sarɩyaa?

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa faasa bire tɔʋ nɛ, ʋ bɩ laa na, dɩ ʋ nɩɩ vɛŋ wɩa-nyuŋ sɩ pilime tɔ leriŋ lɛ.’

english_verse: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
translation_verse: Ŋ ma jaŋ to wombii-bɩnɩɩ-la, nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩɩ too?

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa nɛ fa leŋe ba dɩɩsɩŋ su arɩ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ sɩpaa kala tuo nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: ‘Cheeriŋ puu la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, nyiniŋ dii ba dʋa.’

english_verse: Surrender to God All-Powerful! You will find peace and prosperity.
translation_verse: Joŋ ŋ tɩtɩa pɩ Wɩa, a leŋ ŋ dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ zɔŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ dʋa.

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: Sɛɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ dagɩŋ, a joŋ ʋ wɩaa hɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: a joŋ ŋ sɛlɩmɛ yuo ta hagɩla lɛ, a joŋ ŋ sɛlɩmɛ-la sɩ chaasa zɔŋ a yuo ta fuonaaŋ sɩ hɩla lɛ,

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ sʋlʋ, ʋ jaŋ laa ŋ sʋla, dɩ ŋ ma wuo lɩɩsɛ niiri-la kala ŋ sɩ ta.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ na-kala ŋ sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ŋ ŋaa, ŋ jaŋ wuo ŋaaʋ. Pʋlʋmʋŋ jaŋ chaana hɛ ŋ wombiee kala lɛ.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ kɛŋ nɩaa muuri dɩ ŋ sʋlʋ a bʋl, ‘Kɛmba kaa je,’ ʋ jaŋ laa ŋ sʋla a laaba ta.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ paala kɛŋ cheeriŋ ta, a tɩŋ ŋ tʋɔpʋla wɩaa.”

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: “Jɩnɩŋ mɩɩ ŋmɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ, arɩ mɩ sɩɩ huunu ma kala Wɩa haa dɔgɩsɛmɛ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa jɩŋ lee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ naʋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ fa jaŋ wuo mʋ ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ,

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Wɩa fa jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ dol-bal-la dɔgɩsɛmɛɛ? Aɩ, ʋ fa jaŋ fɩɛlɛ ʋ sɩaa a jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: Ama mɩ chɛʋ a mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, dɩ ʋ tuo nɩmɛ. Mɩ bɩra chɛʋ mʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ma, a bɩ ʋ na.

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a tɩtɩŋ, mɩ bɩ ʋ na, Ʋ sɩ bɩrɩmɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ma, mɩ bɩ ʋ na.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Ama ʋ-na jɩŋ wombii-la mɩ sɩɩ to nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ joŋ wɩaa magɩsɛmɛ dɩ ʋ na, mɩ jaŋ lɩɩ fɩrr a nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Mɩ chaasa to ʋ naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ, mɩ to ʋ wombiiŋ nɛ woruŋ, mɩ bɩ begile.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: Ama dɩ Wɩa nɛ chɩna dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ, nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ wuo kaa bɩrɩmɛ. Ʋ yie ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ.

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ lɛ. Wʋdosunuŋ yʋga ʋ kɛŋ.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ bɩ mɩ niiŋ tɔrɔ biriŋ-la kala sɩ tɔmɛ lɛ, biriŋ-lim-la sɩ tɔ mɩ sɩaa.

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩ bʋa-la lɛ, ʋ sɩ jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya lɩɩsa bil? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩmʋ bee chɩchɛ ŋɩɩ tapʋlʋŋ, a bɩ ʋ ka na?

english_verse: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kɛŋ tabɩa-la ba sɩ joŋo magɩlɛ tinteeŋ bʋa sʋrɩsɛ nɛ, a gaa piesee pɛ ba kɩaa lɛ a dɩdaa.

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ biisime kakusuŋ laa nɛ. Dɩ yo-haala nɩɩ chɛ chɩnnɩŋ, ba laa ʋ nɛ-pɛrɩŋ, a bil ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: Summoo deemba mɩɩra nagɛ bʋrʋmba nɛ, a baaraa chɛ kʋdiilee tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. Tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ nɛ ba kuuni kʋdiilee a pɩpɩ ba biiriŋ.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Ba yie ŋɩŋaa kɩaa bagɩsɩ-la sɩ tuo ba kɩaa lɛ nɛ, a kukuuni kɩaa nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Duonuŋ nɩɩ peelee nyuŋ lɩɩŋ leŋ ba kala chuoli. Ba chɛ dɩjʋʋlaa ka, aŋ pɛllɛ bʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kɛŋ biisiŋ bii-mulluŋ lɛrɛ kɛrɛ ba naamba yɩlɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ba kɛŋ summoo bii-mulluŋ laa nɛ chɩmɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Summoo sɩ bɩ gɛnnɩŋ kɛnɛ, kɛŋ yarɩ-biree vɩvɛŋ, ba yie chʋŋ mɩaa vɩvɛŋ, aŋ kɛŋ losuŋ.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Ba yie tugi olif nɛnɛɛ a lɩɩsɛ nʋʋŋ aŋ bɩ dii, a chagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ ma, aŋ kɛŋ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ sʋʋ ka huuni nɛ tabal-la tʋɔŋ. Nɩalɩŋ ma ba sɩ bolimo ŋmoo niiŋ a chɩchɛ nɩaa dɩ ba pɛ ba lɛ. Ama Wɩa bɩ cheeriŋ joŋo pɩ nʋʋkala.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Dɩ leriŋ ha bire, nɩkpʋʋraa yie sii nɛ, a kpʋ summoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ. Tɩtaŋɩŋ ma, ba gɩgaa nɩaa kɩaa.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ koo bachɔrʋŋ yie gbɩgbɛrɛ nɛ dɩ sɩaa dɩsɛ. Ʋ yie bɩɩnɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a bʋl, ‘Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ namɛ,’ aŋ joŋ kʋa tɔ ʋ sɩaa.

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋɩŋ gaaraa yie bori nɩaa dɩɩsɩŋ a jʋʋ gaa kɩaa, ama dɩ taŋ nɛ pʋla, ba jʋʋ faa dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba bɩ chɛ ba dɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ pɛ wɩɩkala.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Birimiŋ lim nɛ ŋaa ba kala chʋchʋɔŋ. Birimiŋ bɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɛ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: Ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nagɛ fʋnfʋga nɛ aa delli lɩɩŋ nyuŋ. Wɩa ŋmɩɛsɛ hɛ ba tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ, ŋɩɩ leŋ ba bɩ ba girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ wuo mʋ.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: A nagɛ lɩmɩŋ arɩ hɩlɩŋ sɩ yie leŋ bʋrʋŋ sɩ tɔ lɛl ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa ma jaŋ lɛl sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa jaŋ chei nɩduoruŋ deemba arɩ ʋ doluŋ. Ba naga ba chɩna nɛ kpaŋkpaŋ, ama ba bɩ yɩɛlaa kala kɛnɛ ba mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ba hɔŋ, wɩɩkala bɩ baa walɩmɛ. Ama ʋʋ beŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Bɩlɩdad, Sʋa tɩɩna-la bʋl:

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: “Wɩa nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a magɛ dɩ nʋʋkala fɩfáʋ. Ʋ nɛ leŋe fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛ ʋ laalɩyuoroo? Kʋbɛɛ lɛ nɛ ʋ pʋlʋmʋŋ bɩ chaana hɩhɛ?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Dɩ chɛnɛ nɛ paala bɩ pʋlla, dɩ chɛnwʋlaa ma bɩ pʋlla ʋ sɩaa lɛ,

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: ɛɛ nɛ saa nuhuobiine sɩ nagɛ nanchʋɔlʋŋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa nɩpʋla ʋ teeŋ? Nuhuobiine kala paala nagɛ vɛrɩŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: “Ŋ pɛ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ lɛ nɛ. Ŋ laa nʋʋ sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ ta nɛ.

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Ŋ bʋl wɩaa chagɩlɛ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ nɛ. Ŋ dagɛ ŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba ba chichel nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ lɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ kala.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Sʋʋŋ wɩɩkala bɩ faa Wɩa teeŋ, Lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ pɩŋ kpɩlɩɩ nɛ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: Wɩa kɛŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ wɩa-nyuŋ a kaa jɛrɛ tɔ lee-la sɩ wuolo nɛ. Ʋ leŋe tinteeŋ chɩŋ nɛ, ʋ bɩ kʋŋkala nyuŋ saga.

english_verse: God stores water in clouds, but they don't burst,
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe lɩɩŋ hɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ama lɩɩ-la yuŋuŋ bɩ leŋe duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaana-la yɛrɛ.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: Wɩa pilime tɔ chɛnɛ kala nɛ. Ʋ leŋe ʋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa jɛrɛ tɔ ʋ kala nɛ.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: Ʋ tuuri kʋŋ nɛ lɩɩŋ nyuŋ, a magɩlɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ arɩ birimiŋ bʋa.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Jebie-la sɩ chagɛ wɩa-nyuŋ kɩɩ jigise nɛ, Wɩa sɩ kpɩa ba lɛ.

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Ʋ doluŋ lɛ, ʋ bugumi mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ, ʋ kaa keri mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ kʋbɔŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rahab muno muno.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: Ʋ wiese peliŋ nɛ leŋe wɩa-nyuŋ pʋllɛ. Ʋ nɩsɩŋ ma nɛ ʋ kaa kpʋ dɩ-bɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩ bʋla, ŋaa ʋ doluŋ mʋa nɛ ʋ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ wɩaa mʋa kʋrʋ nɛ la nɩɩ ŋɩɩ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ Wɩa doluŋ maŋŋaa?”

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: “Mɩ ŋmɩɛsɛ Wɩa sɩ weye, nɩɩ-la sɩ vɩa dɩ ʋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ a pɛ mɩ lɛ, La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna chaasa leŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ chei nɛ.

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ arɩ ma kɩaa sɩma nɛ, mɩ jaŋ chɩŋ mɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ naaŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nagɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ. A leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ chɩŋ mɩ lɛ na hɛɛŋ a nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down,
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to nɛ sʋba, dɩ Wɩa nɛ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ, bɛɛ kʋŋ yɩɛlaa nɛ ʋ kɛŋ?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna ʋ jaŋ na tʋɔtɔrʋŋ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna teeŋ? Ʋ jaŋ wuo sʋsʋlʋ bʋa na-kala lɛɛ?

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Ma tɩtɩa kala na wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma bʋbʋl wʋpɛɩ deemba kala?

english_verse: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ kpaa bil nɩbɔmʋŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la, wɩalɩŋ yuo-hɛɛrɛ sɩ jaŋ laa La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna teeŋ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Ʋ biiriŋ cho dɩ ba yʋga magɛ ɛɛ ma kala, laalɩŋ nɛ jaŋ dɛrɛ ba kala. Ʋ doho nɩaa jaŋ sʋʋ losuŋ.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ paala fori laalɩŋ lɛ, nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kpʋba. Ba yo-haalaa bɩ jaŋ yel ba lɛ.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ nɛ paala kɛŋ dʋnɩa moribiee kala, dɩ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ ma chʋɔrɛ a nagɛ chʋrʋŋ,

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa nɛ jaŋ laalɛ ʋ gɛnnɩ-la kala. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ moribie-la kala kpaa dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Dɩɩsɩ-la kala nɩbɔmʋŋ sɩ saa nagɛ badɛrɛ ŋmɛsɩŋ nɛ, ba nagɛ palɩŋ nɩa sɩ hɛ a hɔnɔ pʋpɔ kɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩŋ dʋa tʋɔŋ nɛ, ama ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ na ŋɩɩ. Ʋ jaŋ susuri ʋ sɩaa dɩ dʋa-la kala lɛlɛ.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ jʋʋ-ʋ a nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ tɔ leriŋ. Pel-duoŋ jaŋ joŋu a kaa viiri tɩtaŋɩŋ.

english_verse: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ jaŋ fɩfá, ka dɩ pel-la tuu ʋ lɛ, a ŋaa goŋ kiru ta dɩ ʋ lɩɩ ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: the same is done with iron and copper.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ba yie huro lɩɩsɛ hɔɔŋ, ba yie du jigiŋ nɛ a lɩɩsɛ hɔɔ-fɩaŋ.

english_verse: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine yie kɛŋ chaanɩŋ nɛ a tuu biriŋ-lim tʋɔŋ, a chɛ tuu tinteeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ, a huroo chɛ jigiŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ nyuŋ nɛ kʋdiilee wʋwaa, ama ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ ba yie hɛ nyiniŋ dɩ tabɩa-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ sʋʋ dɩ ba yɛrɛ.

english_verse: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
translation_verse: Kachuu kala bɩ wombii-la sɩ faa bʋa-la lɛ jɩŋ. Duu kala sɩɩŋ ha bɩ lee-la na.

english_verse: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
translation_verse: Baga kʋŋkala naaŋ ha bɩ lee-la nʋɔsa. Naachigi kala ha bɩ lee-la gɔllɔ.

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine nɛ giri tabɩɩ-duoru-la kala, a huri peelee a tuu nyɩɩsɛ ba gentisiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: Ba yie lɔsɛ bʋa-naasɩŋ bʋŋ lɛ, a na kʋzɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine yie chɛ tuu yi fuonuŋ lɩɩŋ dɩ-lɩɩlɩŋ kala, a kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ faa kaa kʋ lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Fuoŋ sɩ, ‘Wʋjɩmɩŋ tuo mɩ lɛ.’ Mʋgʋ-balɩŋ ma sɩ, ‘Ʋ tuo mɩ teeŋ.’

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ yɔbʋ, koo a kɛŋ hɔpʋla magɩsɛ ʋ yalɩŋ.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
translation_verse: Sɛlɩmɛ kɛŋ yuŋuŋ a kɩɩ tabɩɩ-tʋlɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ kora koo jasɩpa koo rubi.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Tabɩɩ-tʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ topas sɩ hɛ Kus tinteeŋ lɛ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ wuo magɛ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ yɔbʋ.

english_verse: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.
translation_verse: Ʋ faa nɛ kʋŋkala sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ teeŋ, ʋ paala faa nɛ diibiisiŋ sɩɩ zaarɛ wɩa-nyuŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ arɩ sʋʋŋ sɩ, ‘La ma nɩɩ ba sɩ nɛ a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ.’

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ jɩŋ ʋ wombiiŋ, ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jɩŋ lee-la ʋ sɩɩ jʋʋ.

english_verse: he alone sees everything beneath the heavens.
translation_verse: Ʋʋ beŋ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ kala nɛ, a nɩna kʋŋ na-kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When God divided out the wind and the water,
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe peliŋ kɛŋ doluŋ, aŋ dagɛ ŋɩɩ duonuŋ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ nɩɩ.

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: Wɩa nɩɩ dagɛ duonuŋ wombie-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ to, aa dagɛ taŋ lɩgɩsɩŋ ma ʋ wɛnɩŋ.

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ nuhuobiine, ‘Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ fá mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna, wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ŋ nɛ vɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ, ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa nɛ ŋɩɩ.’ ”

english_verse: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
translation_verse: “Mɩ tʋɔŋ fa jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩra na chɛnsɩ-la sɩ bala, tapʋlɩa-la lɛ Wɩa fa sɩɩ beŋ mɩ nyuŋ.

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: Ʋ chaanɩŋ fa yie chaanɛ mɩ nyuŋ nɛ, ʋ pʋlʋmʋŋ laa mɩ sɩpaaŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ mɩ vɩvɛŋ.

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: Mɩ bapʋɔsʋŋ lɛ, Wɩa fa ŋaa mɩ nandɔŋ-fɩaŋ nɛ, a ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ pɩ mɩ dɩ mɩ dɩa nɩaa.

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ nɛsɩŋ fa kɛŋ nɛ-yɩlɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, ba yie tugu mɩ olif nʋʋŋ bʋŋ nyuŋ ʋ pɩpɛllɛ leriŋ kala.

english_verse: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
translation_verse: Mɩ fa yie mʋ la tabalɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ niiŋ, mɩ dɩ sɩpaalaara-la sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ hɔŋ.

english_verse: while the older ones stood
translation_verse: sɩpaalaaraa leŋ wʋbʋlʋŋ, aŋ tɔrɛ ba niiŋ,

english_verse: and remained silent. Everyone Was Pleased
translation_verse: nɩbalaa ŋaa fʋɩɩ mɩ sɩpaaŋ, ba niiŋ jʋʋ kpʋrʋŋ.

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa dɩ summoo nɛ bunso a chɩchɛ pɛnɩŋ, mɩ yie laaba ta nɛ, aa pɛ biisinsiŋ ma sɩ bɩ nɩaa kɛnɛ dɩ ba pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ naaŋ sɩɩ lieŋi sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ yie bɛsɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ. Mɩ yie leŋ yo-haalaa kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Kindness and justice were my coat and hat;
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋla nagɛ gɛrɩŋ nɛ mɩ joŋo laalɛ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ fa ŋaa mɩ gɛrɩŋ arɩ mɩ nyu-bɛlɛ.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ fa ŋaa nyʋlɩmaa sɩaa, a ŋaa gbɛrɩgɛɛ ma naasɩŋ.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ fa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ nyɩmma, a bʋla laa nʋhʋɔraa ma tɩta sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: Mɩ yie chei nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ doluŋ nɛ, aŋ lorigo laa nɩaa ta ba niiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa bɩɩna mɩ tapʋlaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a nagɛ hagɩlɩ-biee, dɩ mɩ sʋʋ mɩ tɩtɩa dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: Mɩ fa nagɛ tɩa nɛ, mɩ naapoloo tuu tɩgɛ lɩɩŋ lɛ, nyalɩŋ ma nyala hɩhɛ mɩ naakelee lɛ tɩtaŋ na-kala.

english_verse: or like an archer's new bow.
translation_verse: Mɩ yɩrɩŋ sɩ sii woruŋ, mɩ doluŋ ma pʋŋa pɩpɛ.

english_verse: and when I finished speaking, nothing needed to be said.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋl wɩaa dɛrɛ, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ niiŋ ka suri. Mɩ wʋbʋlaa faa jʋʋ ba dɩgɩlaa nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na nɩɩ dagɛba wombii-la sɩ maga dɩ ba to, a nagɛ ba kuoro. Ba tʋɔŋ mɩ fa nagɛ kuoro sɩ kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo vɩvɛŋ nɛ. Mɩ fa nagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ nyagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yel bɔyɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ ŋaa mɔmɩɩ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ mɩ ma sɩ hɩa mʋmɔmmɛ, nɩalɩŋ nyɩmmaba mɩ sɩ paala beŋ dɩ ba bɩ maga dɩ mɩ jomba hɛ vasɩ-la sɩɩ to mɩ piesee harɩŋ.

english_verse: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.
translation_verse: Ba doluŋ fa bɩ bʋbʋa kala kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ, ba doluŋ kala fa dɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: Ba fa bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ, losuŋ yie leŋ ba gɔllɔ bɩbaarɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ a chɩchɛ kɩaa, leree sɩ bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood,
translation_verse: Ba yie pʋʋrɛ pɩpaa-haarɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ a chɩchaŋ, a churi kaala ma a didii.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Ba fa kiriba ta ba dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ nɛ, ba yie kpɩa ba lɛ a nagɛ ba ŋaa gaaraa nɛ.

english_verse: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks,
translation_verse: Ba fʋgɛba tuu hɛ fuonaa hɩlaa tʋɔŋ, a jʋjʋʋ bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ arɩ tinteeŋ bʋɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: where they bray like donkeys gathering around shrubs.
translation_verse: Ba yie pɩŋ tɩɩ-pugunuŋ bʋbʋɔŋ aa yel a nagɛ kakusuŋ, a gu dɔŋɔ lɛ chɛ-tiiŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa nɩtɔɔnɩ nɛ, ba paala bɩ yɩrɩŋ kɛnɛ, ba kiriba ta tintee-la lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ ba biiriŋ nɛ kɛmmɛ hɛ yɩɩlɩŋ a sisieri mɩ lɛ. Mɩ bɩrɩmɛ kʋtɔɔ a guoli ba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Ba kɩkɩsɛ dɩ ba kpagɛmɛ, ba bɩ fá dɩ ba tʋ nantʋɔrʋŋ hɛ mɩ sɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ Wɩa sɩ laa mɩ ba-laala, ka mɩɩ na hɛɛŋ, ba gennee ŋaa sakɔsʋ wɩaa mɩ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ-kala kɛnɛ sii chɩŋ mɩ lɛ nɛ. Ba hɛ bɛrɩsɩŋ nɛ mɩ dɩ-vɛnɩŋ, a bil wombiee ba sɩ jaŋ to cheimi.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ chaasa jʋʋmɛ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, mɩ yɩrɩŋ kala lɛl a nagɛ peliŋ sɩ joŋ kʋa. Mɩ dʋa ma kala lɛl a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ sɩ lɛlɛ.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ ka mʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ, hɛɛŋ tapʋlaa puumi nɛ.

english_verse: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋɩŋ, mɩ haŋgbelee yie wʋwɩɩ nɛ, a bibieri a bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Wɩa kɛŋ ʋ dol-bala-la a kɛŋ mɩ gɛrɩŋ baŋŋaa lɛ nɛ, a lɛrɛ hɛ mɩ baŋŋaa a kaa mɩlɩmɛ.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: Ʋ jommi yuo hɛ vʋchɔɔŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ kala bʋgɛ a nagɛ tʋɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ pɩŋ nɛ, ama ŋ bɩ wɩɩ bʋla, Mɩ kʋ chɩŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ, ama ŋ bɩ mɩ bee na.

english_verse: stirring up a windstorm to toss me about.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛmmɛ chʋʋlɛ nɛ, a leŋ peliŋ jommi, a leŋ duoŋ-peliŋ kɛmmɛ vivilli.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ sʋʋ, a mʋ lee-la nʋʋkala sɩ jaŋ mʋ.

english_verse: No one refuses help to others, when disaster strikes.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ puwuol ka ŋmoo, dɩ ʋ nɛ bunso chɩchɛ dɩ ba pɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: I mourned for the poor and those who suffered.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ yele pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jʋʋ wɩaa? Mɩ tʋɔŋ bɩ summoo wɩaa cheyee?

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ sɩ yɩɛla chɩchɛ wʋzɔmʋŋ, wʋbɔmʋŋ nɛ mɩ mɩɩra na. Mɩ sɩ bee chɩchɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ, birimiŋ nɛ mɩ mɩɩra nɩna.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Mɩ chʋɩŋ kpʋkpɛrɛ a bɩ leŋ, hɛɛŋ puumi tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: Mɩ gɔllɔɔ baarɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, pʋlʋmʋŋ lɛ dee. Mɩ chɩŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ a yele chɩchɛ dɩ ba pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: Jolluŋ nɛ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ mɩ naambiiriŋ, hajaaŋkuŋkumba ma bɩrɩmɛ mɩ pɛ-jʋʋraa.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: Mɩ yaraa kala biri, a fɩfɩsɛ, mɩ yaraa kala lɩŋ a wʋwɩɩ.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: Mɩ bil niiŋ nɛ, arɩ mɩ bɩ jaŋ beŋ hantolibie a hɩɛnʋ.

english_verse: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ chei nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ, aŋ joŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Ʋʋ na wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ, a jɩŋ mɩ naavɛnɛɛ ma kala.

english_verse: I am not dishonest or deceitful,
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa to wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ harɩŋ, koo a nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩaa,

english_verse: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na a leŋ dɩ nɩaa dii mɩ suoluŋ, aŋ kɛŋ mɩ kʋpɛrɛɛ churo ta.

english_verse: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ joŋ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa hɛ mɩ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna haala lɛ, a faa dɩ-jalɩŋ gbɛrʋ boiŋ niiŋ,

english_verse: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na a leŋ dɩ mɩ haala mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ nʋʋ dɔŋ haal, dɩ baalaa kɛnʋ pɩpɩŋ.

english_verse: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ fa jaŋ nagɛ nyiniŋ a dii mɩ kɩaa chei, a dii mɩ kʋpɛrɛɛ kala buru.

english_verse: Otherwise, what answer would I give to God when he judges me?
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa, dɩ Wɩa nɛ pɩɛsɛmɛ? Wʋbɛɛ ba nɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋl dɩ ʋ nɩɩ diimi sarɩya?

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ ŋaamɛ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnna-la ma. Ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa la kala hɛ la naamba luoruŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndʋŋa bɩ mɩ kɩaa ka dii, mɩ yie kpaa pɩ biisinsiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: Mɩ bapʋɔsʋŋ kala lɛ nɛ mɩ dɩɛsɛba, a nagɛ nyɩmma sɩ yie dɩɛsɛ ʋ bie ŋɩɩ, ba sɩ lʋlmɛ kala lɛ nɛ mɩ pɛ yo-haalaa lɛ.

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ ha lɩɩsɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ a ŋaa wɩɩ bii-sime lɛ, a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ jɩma mɩ kɛŋ harɩchɩnnaa sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ wɩaa,

english_verse: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na, leŋ dɩ mɩ vaaŋ chɔlɔ tel, a leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩsaa boro lɩɩ mɩ nasusugusuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ sɛɩ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋdosunuŋ deemba. Mɩɩ fá Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ mɩ chei.

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: Mɩ ha bɩ mɩ niiŋ suro a bʋl wʋbɔŋ a kalɩbɛ hɛ mɩ dʋndɔmɔ lɛ a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kaa fɩfaa a nagɛ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Mɩ ha bɩ mɩ wʋcheeli kaa faa.

english_verse: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
translation_verse: Mɩ yie bɩ wɩalɩŋ nɩaa sɩ jaŋ bʋl a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ ka fá, koo a tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa a tɔrɛ mɩ niiŋ aŋ gʋrɛ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa jaŋ dagɛ wɩɩ na-kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa a pʋ. Mɩ fa jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa mʋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ a nagɛ kuoro.

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ gaa pɩpɛrɛ tintee-la lɛ mɩ sɩɩ pɛrʋ, a gɩrɩma laaʋ ʋ tɩŋŋaa teeŋ,

english_verse: Nor have I cheated my workers and caused them pain.
translation_verse: dɩ mɩ nɩɩ dii tintee-la kɩaa ka ʋ tɩŋŋaa pɩŋ losuŋ,

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na, leŋ dɩ sɔsʋŋ nyʋ lee-la, ka dɩ mɛmpɛ vɩa, leŋ dɩ yaŋ nyʋ, ka dɩ nyonso ma vɩa.” Job wʋbʋlaa dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baala-la batori leŋ wɩalɩŋ ba fa sɩ bʋlaa pɩ Job, bɛɛ wɩaa Job fa laa ʋ tɩtɩa dii arɩ ʋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla nɛ.

english_verse: Elihu from Buz was there, and he had become upset with Job for blaming God instead of himself.
translation_verse: Ama Barakɛl nanʋala Elihu sɩ lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bus, aŋ ŋaa Ram dɩa nɩaa dɔŋɔ, ʋ faasa na baanɩŋ Job nyuŋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ bɩɩna arɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a kɩɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bɩra na baanɩŋ Job nandɔsʋ-la batori ma nyuŋ nɛ bɛɛ wɩaa, ba bɩ wuo dagɛ wɩɩ-la Job sɩ ŋaa chei, aŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pʋ.

english_verse: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
translation_verse: Elihu fa gbɛrɛ nɛ ba kala bʋl wɩaa dɛrɛ, ka ʋ-na bʋl wɩaa pɩ Job, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fa hɩaʋ nɛ.

english_verse: But he became irritated when they could not answer Job,
translation_verse: Ama Elihu sɩ na dɩ Job nandɔsʋ-la batori bɩra bɩ wɩɩ kɛnɛ dɩ ba bʋl, ʋ baanɩŋ sii ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Barakɛl nanʋala Elihu sɩ ŋaa Bus tɩɩna bʋl: “Mɩ ŋaa bii-bie nɛ, ka ma ŋaa nɩhɩasɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ fa fɩfá dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jɩma a pɩma.

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ sɩ, má jegili mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ maa chɛ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jɩma nɛ a pɩma.

english_verse: You shouldn't say, “We know what's right! Let God punish him.”
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ bʋl arɩ ma na wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ, má leŋ dɩ Wɩa nɛ bʋl arɩ Job kɩaa bɩ sɩŋ, nuhuobiine dee.

english_verse: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
translation_verse: Mɩ teeŋ dee Job fa bʋbʋl wɩalɩŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ bɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩaa ʋ teeŋ a nagɛ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ kɛŋ wɩaa lɛrɛ.

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: Ma kala niiŋ maa nɛ, ma bɩra bɩ wɩɩ kɛnɛ dɩ ma bʋl, wɩaa dɛrɛ ma niiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?
translation_verse: Ʋ saa maga dɩ mɩ bɩra hɔnɔ gbɩgbɛrɛ bɛɛ nɛ, lɛɛlɛ ba niiŋ sɩ jʋʋ kpʋrʋŋ ŋ-la?

english_verse: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ suo arɩ wɩaa. Dɩma-la sɩ hɛ mɩ lɛ ka fʋgɛmɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa.

english_verse: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ fá nʋʋkala sɩɩŋ, koo a bʋl nii-sɩŋ wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ nʋʋkala lɛ.

english_verse: Job, listen to me! Pay close attention. *
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ Job, jegili mɩ teeŋ, jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋl.

english_verse: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩma nɛ ʋ kaa ŋaamɛ. La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ wiese hɛ mɩ lɛ, mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Now line up your arguments and prepare to face me.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ jaŋ wuo laa wɩɩ bʋl mɩ teeŋ, kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ la cheŋ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩŋ kala nagɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Chʋrʋŋ nɛ ʋ kaa mɛmɩ ma.

english_verse: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ fɩfámɛ, a leŋ dɩ mɩ wʋbʋlaa yuŋŋie pɩŋ.

english_verse: that you are innocent, guilty of nothing.
translation_verse: ‘Mɩ ŋaa nɩpʋla nɛ, mɩ bɩ wʋbɔŋ kɛnɛ, mɩ bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa chei.

english_verse: You claim that God has made you his enemy,
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, ka Wɩa na dɩ mɩ chei wɩɩ nɛ, ʋ jommi mɩ ŋaa ʋ dʋndɔŋ.

english_verse: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
translation_verse: Ʋ vɔɔ mɩ naasɩŋ nɛ arɩ chɔrʋmɔɔ, a bibeŋ mɩ naavɛnɛɛ kala.’

english_verse: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ bʋlaa pɩŋ, wɩaa deemba kala lɛ ŋ kɩaa bɩ sɩŋ. Wɩa nɛ yʋga a kɩɩ nuhuobiiŋ kala.

english_verse: So why do you challenge God to answer you?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa ʋ teeŋ, arɩ ʋ bɩ nuhuobiine wʋbʋlɩɩ kala jegilee nɩɩ?

english_verse: God speaks in different ways, and we don't always recognize his voice. *
translation_verse: Wɩa yie to wombii dɔŋ a bʋl wɩaa, a bɩra to wombiiŋ dɔŋɔ ma bʋl wɩaa. Nuhuobiine-na bɩ ŋɩɩ wuo jɩjɩŋ.

english_verse: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride
translation_verse: Ʋ yie to ŋɩɩ lɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nuhuobiine bɩrɩma lɩɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ, a lɩɩsʋ babiibal wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ lɩɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ sʋʋŋ bʋa tuu.

english_verse: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ kʋdii-chooloo sʋsʋɔrɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ kʋdii-sɩŋŋaa kɛŋ nyɛsɩŋ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: and we become so skinny that our bones stick out.
translation_verse: Ʋ yaraa kala dɛrɛ aŋ ka, haŋgbelee ba nyɩɩsɛ nyɩɩsɛ.

english_verse: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
translation_verse: Ʋ naaŋ lilieŋi sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ, ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ wɩɩkala nagɛ lɛlɩɩ.

english_verse: The angel shows kindness, commanding death to release us, because the price was paid.
translation_verse: a wuo fá ʋ nenige a bʋl, ‘Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ tuu sʋʋŋ bʋa, mɩ na kʋ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ kaa time laa nɛ,’

english_verse: Our health is restored, we feel young again,
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na ʋ yaraa jaŋ mɩɩra zɔŋ a nagɛ bii-bie, a bɩra nagɛ ʋ bapʋɔsʋŋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
translation_verse: Ʋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa nɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ laa ʋ sʋla, ʋ na Wɩa nɛ, a jʋɔsa ŋaa goŋ, Wɩa leŋ ʋ bɩra chɩŋ ʋ tʋɔpʋla naaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ kʋ bʋla pɩ nɩaa, ‘Mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a kaa bɩrɩmɛ. Ama Wɩa joŋo chɛmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
translation_verse: Ʋ laamɛ ta nɛ, mɩ bɩ sʋʋŋ bʋa jʋa. Mɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a nɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ sɩma.’

english_verse: God gives each of us chance after chance
translation_verse: Wɩa yie ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala nuhuobiine lɛ a mʋ yi naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa koo butori,

english_verse: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ lɩɩsʋ sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ, dɩ ʋ wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a nɩɩ sɩma.

english_verse: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩ dɩ ŋ bʋl, bʋl dɩ mɩ nɩɩ, mɩɩ chɛ mɩ na dɩ ŋ kɩaa sɩma nɛ.

english_verse: Elihu said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elihu bʋl:

english_verse: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!
translation_verse: “Má nɩɩ mɩ ma wʋbʋlaa, ma-na wʋjɩnna, ma jegili mɩ teeŋ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ gʋnnɛ wɩaa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: Think about my words, as you would taste food.
translation_verse: Nandelimiŋ sɩ jɩŋ kʋsɩmɩŋ ŋɩɩ woruŋ, dɩgɩlɩŋ maa nɩɩ wʋsɩŋŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la vʋʋrɛ a joŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, má leŋ dɩ la hɛ dɔŋɔ a gʋnnɛ wɩɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ.

english_verse: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.
translation_verse: Job bʋla, ‘Mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye, ama Wɩa kɛŋ mɩ kʋsɩŋŋaa laa nɛ,

english_verse: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.
translation_verse: arɩ mɩ kɩaa sɩ sɩma ma kala, ʋ ha jommi arɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ. Mɩ ha chaasaa na hɛɛŋ nɛ arɩ mɩ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye ma kala.’

english_verse: He spends his time with sinners,
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nɛ pɛ wɩaa, ʋ dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩɩ vɛŋ.

english_verse: because he has said, “It doesn't pay to please God.” If Any of You Are Smart
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, ‘Nuhuobiine bɩ jaŋ na nyʋʋrɩ kala, dɩ ʋ nɩɩ nɛrɩgɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩaa a tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ.’

english_verse: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Nʋʋkala jɩma Wɩa bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala ka ŋaa, La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩ wʋlɔrʋ kala ka ŋaa.

english_verse: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ lɩɩsʋ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ tinteeŋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ hɛʋ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ dʋnɩa kala?

english_verse: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ fa bɩɩna dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wiese-la, ʋ sɩ joŋo hɛ la lɛ kaa lɩɩsɛ,

english_verse: we humans would die and return to the soil.
translation_verse: nuhuobiinee kala fa jaŋ sʋʋ, a bɩra bɩrɩmɛ hagɩla.

english_verse: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ sɩ bɛrɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ wuo beŋ nɩaa? Ŋ jaŋ wuo chei La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ yɩrɩŋ?

english_verse: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ ŋaa la kala, ʋ bɩ sɩpaalaaraa kaa pɔrɔ bil ba dʋndʋŋ, ʋ bɩ kɩaa tɩŋŋaa ma nɛ cho a kɩɩ summoo.

english_verse: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
translation_verse: Ba kala yie guu sʋʋ nɛ, nɩaa yie vɛsɛ naasɩŋ a sʋʋ tɩta-siesee, babiibalaa yie sʋʋ dɩ nʋʋ bɩ ba kpʋa.

english_verse: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Ʋ teeŋ biriŋ kala tuo, biriŋ-lim kala tuo lee-la wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa sɩ jaŋ wuo faa.

english_verse: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩra bɩ maga dɩ ʋ hɛ tapʋlɩɩ, a kɛŋ nuhuobiine kɔ ʋ sɩpaaŋ a dii ʋ sarɩya.

english_verse: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ nʋʋ pɩɛsa aŋ lɩɩsɛ sɩpaalaarɩ-duoruŋ tɩta, aŋ joŋ nɩaa hɩhɛ ba leree.

english_verse: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Ʋ jɩŋ ba wʋŋaalaa nɛ, ʋ yie kiriba ba dɩchɩnaa, a cheiba tɩtaŋɩŋ.

english_verse: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
translation_verse: Ʋ yie tɩŋ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa a dɔgɩsɛba, lee-la nʋʋkala sɩ bɩ jaŋ naba,

english_verse: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Ba wʋŋaalaa leŋe summoo ŋmoo niiŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ nɛ, ʋ nɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ nii-ŋmobo.

english_verse: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.
translation_verse: a pɔ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka fá sɩ́ kuoruŋ dii, a dʋdɔgɩsɛ ba nɩaa.

english_verse: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
translation_verse: Dɩ nuhuobiiŋ nɛ bʋl ŋ-la a pɩ Wɩa: ‘Mɩ cheye nɛ, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ chei.

english_verse: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
translation_verse: Dagɛmɛ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bɩ na, dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa.’

english_verse: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ vɩa wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ-na saa chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ a pɩŋ? Ŋ nɛ maga ŋŋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la pɩ ŋ tɩtɩa, mɩ-na dee. Bʋl wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ jɩma pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Job, anyone with good sense can easily see
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa bʋla, wʋjɩnna-la sɩ nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ bʋla pɩmɛ:

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: ‘Job bɩ wɩaa sɩaa jɩŋ aŋ bʋbʋl, wʋjɩmɩŋ tuo ʋ wʋbʋlaa lɛ.

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa cho dɩ ba magɩsɛ Job nɛ a mʋ yi dɩdɛrɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ wʋbʋlaa nagɛ nɩbɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩaa dagɛ ŋ dɩ ŋ nandɔsʋ-la kala sɩ hɛ ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Look up to the heavens
translation_verse: Beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ na, beŋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii.

english_verse: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna, wʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋ ŋaa pʋpʋʋ? Bɛɛ nɛ ʋ lɩlaa ŋ teeŋ?

english_verse: The evil or good you do only affects other humans.
translation_verse: Ŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ka chei ŋ nuhuobiiŋ dɔŋɔ dʋndʋŋa nɛ, ŋ tʋɔpʋla ma pɩpɛ ŋ nuhuobiiŋ dɔŋɔ dʋndʋŋa lɛ.

english_verse: In times of trouble, everyone begs the mighty God to have mercy.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yie ŋmuŋmoo niiŋ a tɩŋ nɩaa sɩ nyagɛba a bil wɩaa nɛ, ba yie sʋl dɩ ba laaba ta nɩduoruŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋkala bɩ pɩɛsɛ, ‘Nɩɩ nɛ Wɩa, mɩ ŋɩŋaara hɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ yie pɩla yɩɩlaa la yɩɩ dɩ leriŋ nɛ bire tɔla,

english_verse: though he makes us wiser than animals or birds.
translation_verse: nɩɩ-la sɩ dagɛla wɩaa, la jɩŋ wɩaa kɩɩ baga kɩaa.’

english_verse: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yie yɩrʋ, ka ʋ tɔrɛ ʋ niiŋ, a tɩŋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩɩ-duoŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Job, you were wrong to say God doesn't punish sin.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩra bʋla arɩ ʋ bɩ baanɩŋ na a dʋdɔgɩsɛ nɩaa, ʋ sɩpaaŋ tuo wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Everything you have said adds up to nonsense.
translation_verse: Job wʋbʋlɩa-la kala ŋaa wʋpɛɩba nɛ, ʋ wʋbʋl daŋ-la kala bɩ wʋjɩmɩɩ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Elihu said:
translation_verse: Elihu ha bɩra bʋla:

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: “Dii kenyiri mʋa a pɩmɛ, ka dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ dagɩŋ. Mɩ ha kɛŋ wɩɩ nɛ aa chɛ mɩ chɩŋ Wɩa naasɩŋ lɛ a bʋl.

english_verse: God always does right— and this knowledge comes straight from God.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ wʋdaŋ daŋ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ dagɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ ŋɩŋaara sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: You can rest assured that what I say is true.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ bʋl bɩ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ ŋaa, nʋʋ sɩ chaasa jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa nɛ hɛ ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Although God is mighty, he cares about everyone and makes fair decisions.
translation_verse: Wɩa kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ, ama ʋ bɩ nuhuobiine kaa ŋmuŋmoo gbɛɛŋ, ʋ doluŋ yʋga, wɩɩkala tuo ʋ bɩ ʋ sɩaa jɩŋ.

english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ leŋe nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ hɩhɛ ba mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ama ʋ yie leŋ summoo nɩna wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba na nɛ.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba nɛ vɔɔ nɩaa arɩ chɔrʋmɔɔ, dɩ ba nɩna hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa wɩaa,

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba nɛ bɩ jegile nɩɩ, ba jaŋ kpʋba laalɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba sʋʋ nɩyaarɛ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka fá bɩ leŋe ba baanɩŋ fɩfɩɛlɛ. Wɩa nɛ paala vɔɔba bil ma, ba bɩ yele sʋsʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Hard times and trouble are God's way of getting our attention!
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ, ʋ yie laaba ta ba hɛɛŋ lɛ nɛ, ba wʋjʋʋlaa lɛ nɛ ʋ yie suri ba sɩaa.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: Wɩa ka lɩɩsɛ ŋ ma wʋjʋʋlaa lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ joŋuŋ ta pʋlʋŋ-jaala lɛ, ŋ gʋgɔllɛ ŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ kʋdii sɩŋŋaa gbaarɩŋ.

english_verse: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.
translation_verse: Fɩɛlɛ ŋ sɩaa dɩ nʋʋ sɩ́ kɩaa kaa nyɩsɩŋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ kpalaa kɛnɩŋ mɩɩrɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ harɩŋ.

english_verse: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress,
translation_verse: Ŋ dʋa arɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ hɛ ŋ doluŋ kala a ŋɩŋaa bɩ jaŋ wuo lɩɩsɩŋ hɛɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ chɩchɛ dɩ taŋ biri dɩ ŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, bʋa-la lɛ nɛ ba jaŋ chei nɩaa.

english_verse: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
translation_verse: Fɩɛlɛ ŋ sɩaa a sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ to, ba wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa joŋ hɛɛŋ hɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ kʋŋkala lɛ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo dagɛ wɩaa a nagʋ?

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Ŋ ma liisi wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa a lɔllʋ, wɩalɩŋ wɩaa nɛ nɩaa yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Nuhuobiinee kala nɛ naba, ba chɩŋ dɩ-bolii nɛ aŋ bibemba.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, Wɩa kɛŋ doluŋ, nuhuobiinee bɩ ʋ magɩsɩŋ jɩŋ. Nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ jɩsɩŋ niiŋ wuo dagɛ.

english_verse: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ ŋaa a leŋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa jɛrɛ tɔ leriŋ, koo ŋɩɩ duonuŋ sɩ yie kpɩa a lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ?

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie leŋ taŋ lɩgɩsɛ a pʋllɛ wɩa-nyuŋ kala nɛ, aŋ ka mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ ha biri.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa bibeŋ nuhuobiinee nɛ ŋɩɩ, a chɛ kʋdiilee yʋgɛ a pɩpɩba.

english_verse: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
translation_verse: Ʋ yie kɛŋ taŋ lɩgɩsɩna-la kala hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a leŋ ʋ mʋ yagɛ lee-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: I am frightened and tremble all over,
translation_verse: Ŋ-la yie leŋ mɩ bɔyɛ joŋ, a yɩyagɛ.

english_verse: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
translation_verse: Má jegile nɩɩ, má jegile nɩɩ Wɩa yikoro, arɩ goŋ-la sɩɩ lɩɩ ʋ niiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie leŋ taŋ lɩgɩsɛ a cheŋ wɩa-nyuŋ kala, a mʋ yagɛ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala.

english_verse: and they force animals to seek shelter.
translation_verse: Baga kɩaa ma mʋ ba dɩ-pɩnaa, a pɩŋ ba bugoo lɛ.

english_verse: The windstorms of winter strike,
translation_verse: Duoŋ-pel-duoŋ yie tɔɔ lɩɩ ʋ dɩ-lɩɩlɩŋ, peliŋ lɛrɛ waarɩŋ kɔ.

english_verse: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
translation_verse: Wɩa wiese yie leŋ lɩɩŋ dɛrɩmɛ, lɩɩŋ sɩ pɩna a yʋgɛ gulimi.

english_verse: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
translation_verse: Ʋ yie leŋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa kala su arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ, a leŋ taŋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tɩtɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ yie leŋ taŋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ nɛɛ?

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa sɩ ŋaa vɩvɛŋ wɩa-nyuŋ a bɩ kʋŋkala nyuŋ sagaa? Wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ deemba Wɩa sɩ ŋaa arɩ ʋ jɩma, ŋ jɩmba nɛɛ?

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Leriŋ yie lɩŋ ŋ susuoli nɛ, dɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ peliŋ nɛ kɔ a leŋ leriŋ kala ŋaa siuu.

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo pɛ ʋ lɛ a ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ a leŋ ʋ jɛrɛ, a kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ hɔɔŋ sɩɩ tʋl?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: Dagɛla wɩɩ-la la sɩ jaŋ bʋla pʋ, la tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛlɛ nɛ, la-na bɩ wɩɩ kɛnɛ dɩ la bʋla pʋ.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ chɩchɛ mɩ dɩ Wɩa bʋl wɩaa. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ jaŋ pʋ wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ cheimi?

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ wuo beŋ, ʋ sɩ yie faasa chaanɛ ŋɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ, dɩ peliŋ nɛ paa duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa kala aŋ kaʋ.

english_verse: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
translation_verse: Wɩa lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ a kʋkɔ, a tʋtʋl a nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ. Ʋ sɩɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ ʋ tʋla-la leŋ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnla.

english_verse: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna kɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ kpagʋ nɛ, ʋ doluŋ yʋga. Ʋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ tʋɔpʋla yʋga ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ nʋʋkala nyaga bibil.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ nɩaa zizilu, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩɩna ba jɩŋ wɩaa, ʋ yie yʋ ba wɩaa nɛ.”

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA to duoŋ-peliŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl wɩaa pɩ Job. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ kaŋ dɩ ŋ pɩɛsɛ wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ, aa bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋjɩŋ wɩaa ŋaa?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: Kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a nagɛ baal, mɩ jaŋ pɩɛsɩŋ wɩaa, dɩ ŋ chaarɛ ba sɩaa pɩmɛ.

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩɩ bil dʋnɩa gentine, nɩɩ nɛ ŋ hɛ? Dɩ ŋ nɛ jɩma, bʋla pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Doubtless you know who decided its length and width.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ daga ŋɩɩ ʋ jalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ magɛ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ tuuri ʋ bʋa a golli?

english_verse: What supports the foundation? Who placed the cornerstone,
translation_verse: Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ chagɛ dʋnɩa kɩɩ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ bil ʋ gʋnaa jebiee,

english_verse: When the ocean was born, I set its boundaries
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ kɛrɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ bil, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ gbu lɩɩ?

english_verse: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ leŋe duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tɔ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ, a leŋ birimiŋ lim tɔʋ.

english_verse: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates,
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ tuuri mʋgʋ-balɩŋ bʋa, a kɛrʋ kɩɩ a nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ doloo arɩ borusuŋ kɛrɛ kʋa.

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ bʋla pɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ, ‘Ŋ jaŋ wuo kʋ magɛ ŋ-la nɛ, aŋ sɩ́ ŋɩɩ lɛ kielu, daha nɛ ŋ lɩɩ-peliŋ doluŋ maga dɩ ʋ chɩna magɛ.’

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: Job, ŋ ha wuo dagɛ chʋchʋɔŋ, wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa? Ŋ ha wuo leŋ sɩɩpʋʋraa kɔɔ?

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: Ŋ ha maachie wuo bʋla pɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ dɩ ʋ chaana mʋ yi dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ, a kɛŋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ ta ba kʋ lɩɩ ba dɩ-faalaa?

english_verse: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-muluŋ sɩ nyagaa lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ yie leŋ dundolluŋ arɩ fuonaasɩŋ lɩɩ chaanɛ nɛ, a ŋminsi, a nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ gɛrɩŋ kpeŋ ʋ kɛŋ higisiŋ.

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Ba vɔŋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ pʋlʋmʋŋ nɛ, ba sɩɩ dii dol-la nɩaa lɛ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Nʋʋ ha kɛŋ sʋʋŋ boi-baalaa dagɩŋ? Ŋ ha na lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ dɩ-bine-la boi-baalaa?

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ dʋnɩa sɩ jalɩa magɛɛ? Dɩ ŋ nɛ jɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala, bʋla pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ wombii-la pʋlʋmʋŋ sɩ to kʋkɔ nɛɛ? Nɩɩ nɛ birimiŋ jʋjʋʋ?

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la lɛ dɩ ba lʋlʋŋ, ŋ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ ka mɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa.

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: Ŋ ha jʋʋ dɩɩsɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ joŋ bʋrʋŋ bil, koo a na dɩɩsɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ joŋ duoŋ-tabɩaa bil?

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ kɩaa deemba a bile gbɛrɛ wʋjʋʋlaa tapʋlʋŋ nɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la laalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ sii.

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ bil libisiŋ pɩ duonuŋ ʋ to nɩnɩɩ koo a bil wombiiŋ pɩ duoŋ-peliŋ?

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la vɔgɛ lɩɩŋ, a leŋ yaŋ nyʋ lee-la?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Duonuŋ kɛŋ nyɩmma nɛɛ? Nyalɩŋ nyɩmma nɛ kʋbɛɛ?

english_verse: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ lʋla lɛ nɛ lɩɩ-gulimoo lɩɩ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ lʋl waarɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ,

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: a yie leŋ lɩɩŋ gulimi a dolie nagɛ tabɩɩŋ, mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ nyuŋ ma kala dɛrɩmɛ?

english_verse: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo vɔɔ chɛnwʋla-la sɩ chige chɩŋ wɩa-nyuŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ chɛnwʋla-la sɩ chige chɩŋ wɩa-nyuŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a hɛ dɔŋɔ?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ wombie-la ba sɩ bile pɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa dɩ ba tuto nɛɛ? Ŋ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ wombie-la chɩŋ dʋnɩa ma lɛɛ?

english_verse: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo kpɩa duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa lɛ, a leŋ dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ hɛ ŋ lɛ dɩ ŋ kala chuoli?

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ joŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ hɩhɛ nɩaa nyuŋ lɛ, a leŋ ba jɩjɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa?

english_verse: on the dry, lumpy soil?
translation_verse: dɩ tinteeŋ nɛ faasa hɩl a kala kpal?

english_verse: When lions are hungry, do you help them hunt?
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ chɛ kʋdiilee pɩ naachigi nɩɩŋ, naachigi biiriŋ dii vɔgɛ,

english_verse: Do you send an animal into their den?
translation_verse: dɩ ba hɛ ba dɩ-pɩnaa, koo a faa tɩɩ-lugunuŋ tʋɔŋ ba bugoo lɛɛ?

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ yie chɛ kʋdiilee pɩ gɩlɩŋgaamba, dɩ losuŋ nɛ kɛmba baa baarɛ, koo dɩ ba biiriŋ nɛ yelee chɛ kʋdiilee mɩ-na Wɩa teeŋ?

english_verse: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ bʋŋ-nyuŋ gbuŋgbogoba sɩɩ lʋl nɛɛ? Ŋ ha na aamɩŋ sɩɩ lʋl?

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
translation_verse: Ba biiri-la yie waa gɩrɩ-la tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ doluŋ, a lɩɩ mʋ hɛ lee dɔŋ, ba bɩra bɩ mɩɩraa kɔ.

english_verse: I alone help them survive in salty desert sand.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na nɛ joŋu hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ, a leŋ kpesiŋ ŋaa ba dɩ-diiliŋ.

english_verse: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
translation_verse: Komo yie mʋmɔŋ goŋ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa tabalɩŋ tʋɔŋ, ʋ bɩ nʋʋkala kpɩa-la ka nɩɩ.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: Baga nɛŋ jaŋ sɛɩ a tɩma pɩŋ? Ʋ jaŋ sɛɩ a chʋa ŋ ja-yaŋ dɩ-biliŋ?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ vɔbʋ a leŋ dɩ ʋ pɛrɛɛ? Koo a joŋ doluŋ sɩ yuŋŋie a vɔɔ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ lɛrɛ tinteeŋ dɩ ʋ magɛ dɔŋɔ?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa hɛ ʋ doluŋ lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ ŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa hɛ ʋ lɛɛ, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ŋ baga kɩaa kʋ jʋʋ ŋ taha tʋɔŋ a pɩŋ?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: Nyaŋkɩɩbʋʋna yie ŋmoo ʋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, ama ʋ bɩ ʋ pʋnaa wuo kaa magɩsɛ diibelimbine pʋnaa.

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie lo ʋ halaa a bil tinteeŋ nɛ, a leŋ tinteeŋ lɩmɩŋ kɩkɛmba.

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie bɩ bɩɩnɛ arɩ nʋʋ jaŋ wuo nʋɔsɛba yɛrɛ, koo baga kʋŋ jaŋ nʋɔsɛba.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie bɩ ʋ biiriŋ woruŋ kɛŋ a nagɛ ʋ dee bɩ ba tɩɩ, a bɩ ʋ lɔlʋŋ wɩaa chɩla.

english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Wɩa bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ joŋo pʋ, mɩ bɩ leŋe ʋ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ ʋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ yɛrɛ dɩ ʋ fá, ʋ yie mʋmɔŋ janɩŋ arɩ ja-jɩllaa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ pɩ jaaba doluŋ koo ŋ nɛ pʋ gbɛsɛ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ baŋŋaa lɛ a bibiegi?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ leŋe ʋ fɩfɩl a nagɛ hɔbɔ, a ŋmoo mɩɩsɩŋ a joŋ fawʋllʋŋ hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛɛ?

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie lɔgɛ tinteeŋ yuyuo, aŋ jʋjʋɔsɛ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ, a fá jʋʋ laalɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: To-huoŋ yie dʋdɔŋ nɛ ʋ sɛmɛ, a pɛ timiŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ sɩ leŋe ʋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Ʋ yaraa yie nyaasɛ nɛ ʋ chichel, a faasa fá. Dɩ ba nɛ ŋmʋʋ banyile, ʋ bɩ dɩ-bala wuo chɩŋ.

english_verse: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ ŋmʋʋ banyile, ʋ yie ŋmoo mɩɩsɩŋ. Ʋ yie hɛ dɩ-bolii nɛ aŋ nɩɩ laalɩŋ sʋɔra, a nɩɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ ma sɩɩ ŋaa laalɩyuori goŋ.

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ pɩ kɩla wʋjɩmɩŋ ʋ kaa fifil, a jɛrɛ ʋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a chaasa wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ?

english_verse: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ yie hɛ aŋ bee chɩchɛ ʋ kʋdiilee, ʋ yie naba dɩ-bolii.

english_verse: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
translation_verse: Ʋ biiriŋ ka dii chalɩŋ nɛ. Nammɩa sɩ hɛ lee-la, nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ ma yie hɛ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Job:

english_verse: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
translation_verse: “Mɩ nɛ Wɩa, doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, ama ŋ kɛŋ wɩaa lɛrɛ nɛ mɩ teeŋ arɩ mɩ kɩaa bɩ sɩŋ. Lɛɛlɛ bʋl wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Job said to the Lord:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Job bʋla pɩ La TƖƖNA:

english_verse: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
translation_verse: Mɩ paala bʋl wɩaa a kieli nɛ, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩɩkala.”

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA to duoŋ-peliŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl wɩaa pɩ Job:

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: Ŋŋ chɛ ŋ dagɛ arɩ mɩ-na bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ, ŋ-na nɛ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ koo?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ mɩ-na Wɩa nɛɛ? Ŋ jaŋ wuo kpɩa goŋ arɩ mɩ sɩɩ kpɩa ŋɩɩ?

english_verse: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush
translation_verse: Bee na nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa, na baanɩŋ a kɛmba muuri.

english_verse: all who are proud and evil.
translation_verse: Bemba woruŋ aŋ kɛmba muuri, chei nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lee-la kala ba sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Hugi ba kala tinteeŋ, tɔ ba hɛ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ wuo ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ŋ tɩtɩa doluŋ jaŋ wuo laaŋ ta.

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: Bee na lɩɩ-nɛŋ, mɩ nɛ ŋaaʋ, a nagɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ ŋaaŋ. Ʋ didii yaŋ a nagɛ nɛŋ.

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: Bee na doluŋ sɩ hɛ ʋ kparaa lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ luoruŋ nammɩa sɩ yʋga magɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋbʋɔ-doho sii pɛ a nagɛ kuolo, nampɩl-bʋɔlaa yʋgɛ ʋ huiyee lɛ.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: Ʋ haŋgbelee kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ a nagɛ kɔlɩɩŋ. Ʋ naasɩŋ nagɛ hɔ-doloo.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa tʋɔŋ, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩba. Ama mɩ-na Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaaʋ ha jaŋ wuo yuo diiu.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Peelee nyuŋ nɛ ʋ kʋdiilee yie waa ʋ didii, lee-la baga kɩaa sɩɩ gbielu.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: Ʋ yie pɩŋ sagɩrɩgalɩaba bʋbʋɔŋ, a faa saŋgɛɛŋ sɩ hɛ lɩɩŋ niiŋ vʋchɔɔŋ leriŋ.

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Dɩ fuoŋ nɛ suo a gbu lɩɩ ma, ʋ bɔyɛ bɩ joŋ, ʋ yie ta jɩa a pɩŋ nɛ dɩ Jɔdaŋ fuoŋ lɩɩŋ nɛ paala pɛllɛ jʋjʋʋ ʋ sɩaa.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo tɔ lɩɩ-nɛŋ sɩaa aŋ kɛnʋ, koo a bɛrɛ kɛnʋ a joŋ kʋa luro hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ?

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ gbɩaŋ a kɛŋ peribanyeŋŋu, koo a kɛŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ vɔɔ ʋ nandelimiŋ a bil?

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo joŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ luro hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ, koo ŋ joŋ gbɩaŋ tɔɔ gɩrɩgɛ ʋ tapaŋaa lɛɛ?

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo vɔbʋ a nagɛ diibie, a joŋu pɩ ŋ hantolibiisiŋ dɩ ba kaa gbigbielii?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: Bayalaa jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ba yɔbʋʋ? Ba jaŋ kɛnʋ kpaa pɛ ba bayal kɩaa lɛ a yallɛɛ?

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Nɩtɛrɛ kala tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo kosu dɩ ʋ sii ŋaa wɩaa. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa jaŋ wuo sii chɩŋ mɩ lɛ?

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ kɛŋ kʋŋ mɩ teeŋ, a magɛ dɩ mɩ timuu? Kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ ŋaa mɩ kʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo puri ʋ teniŋ? Koo a joŋ koŋ hɛ ʋ niiŋ lɛ?

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ ʋ niiŋ suri, ʋ nyɩlaa sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ ŋɩɩ?

english_verse: Its back is covered with shield after shield,
translation_verse: Ʋ yaraa puruŋ kpalɩba nɛ, a chaasa jʋʋ dɔŋɔ woruŋ.

english_verse: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
translation_verse: Ba faasa mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ, a nyʋa kɛŋ dɔŋɔ, ŋ bɩ ba wuo kaa lɛrɛ.

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋmoo mɩɩsɩŋ, nyiniŋ yie lɩgɩsɛ nɛ. Ʋ sɩaa yie nagɛ taŋ sɩ pʋlaa kɔ pʋlʋmʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
translation_verse: Nyiŋ-geliŋ yie lɩlɩɩ ʋ niiŋ lɛ nɛ, nyiŋ-kɛntɛrɩsɩŋ ma to dɔŋɔ a lɩlɩɩ.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Nyʋɔsʋŋ yie lɩlɩɩ ʋ mɩɩ-boyee lɛ nɛ, a nagɛ ba sɩ joŋ kɩaa arɩ pupoiŋ a chɔ nyiniŋ lɛ.

english_verse: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
translation_verse: Ʋ wiese peliŋ yie leŋ hɔlɔɔ chol nyiniŋ, nyiŋgeliŋ lɩlɩɩ ʋ niiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
translation_verse: Ʋ baŋŋaa chaasa kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ chemu, fawʋllʋŋ yie kɛnʋ nɛ.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: Ʋ yaraa sɩ kuriso kuriso ŋɩɩ chaasa jʋʋ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ, a ŋaa kpɩm a bɩ jigisi.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ sie, fawʋllʋŋ yie kɛŋ nɩduoruŋ nɛ, ba mɩɩra fá.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: Hɔɔŋ nagɛ sekeliŋ nɛ ʋ teeŋ, kɔlɩɩŋ ma nagɛ daa-pʋɔŋ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
translation_verse: To-hɛŋŋɛɛ bɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ʋ fá, kpalɩŋ tabɩaa bɩ ʋ wʋŋaalɩɩ kala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: Toŋguluŋ paala nagɛ sekeliŋ nɛ ʋ teeŋ. Dɩ nɩaa nɛ yuou arɩ timiŋ, ʋ yie paala mʋmɔmba nɛ.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
translation_verse: Ʋ luoruŋ teniŋ paala kɛŋ niiŋ a nagɛ kenchele nɛ, dɩ ʋ nɩɩ vɛŋ vʋchɔɔŋ tʋɔŋ, ʋ yie kpɛrɛ tinteeŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ.

english_verse: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɩɩ vɛŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, ʋ libe yie pɩŋ nɛ a tʋtʋl, ka lɩɩ-la kala tɔ arɩ fʋnfʋgɩ-pʋla.

english_verse: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
translation_verse: Kʋŋkala tuo dʋnɩa lɛ a magʋ. Ʋ bɩ kʋŋkala ka fá.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie bee gʋʋnɛ baga kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩɩna ba ŋaa wajɩaba nɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa baga kɩaa kala kuoro.”

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: “Mɩ jɩma ŋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩkala, nʋʋkala bɩ wɩɩ ŋ sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ŋ ŋaa wuo birigi.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: Ŋ pɩɛsa, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ kaŋ dɩ ŋ pɩɛsɛ wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ, aŋ bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ? Mɩ sɛnɛ bʋl wɩaa mɩ sɩ paala bɩ ba sɩaa jɩŋ nɛ, wɩalɩŋ kperi a kɩɩ mɩ jɩmɩŋ.’

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩgɩlaa nɛ faa nɩɩ ŋ wɩaa, ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ sɩɩŋ naŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩ Job a dɛrɛ nɛ, ʋ bʋla pɩ Ɛlɩfas, Tɛma tɩɩna-la ma, “Mɩ na baanɩŋ nɛ ŋ dɩ ŋ nandɔsʋ-la balɩa nyuŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ, ma bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ bʋla a nagɛ mɩ tɩntɩnna Job sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má kɛsɛ nɛ-belliŋ balɩpɛ, pie-belliŋ ma balɩpɛ a kaa mʋ mɩ tɩntɩnna Job teeŋ a kpʋ a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ ma tɩtɩa. Mɩ tɩntɩnna Job jaŋ sʋlmɩ pɩma dɩ mɩ laa ʋ sʋla. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma a tɩŋ nɩyaarɛ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bʋla wɩaa. Wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ, ma bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ bʋla a nagɛ mɩ tɩntɩnna Job sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Job sɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩ ʋ nandɔsʋ-la harɩŋ, La Tɩɩna leŋ ʋ bɩra dʋa woruŋ, a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ fa sɩ kɛnɛ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: Ʋ naambiiriŋ kala arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ jɩmʋ kɔ ʋ teeŋ a dii kɩaa ʋ dɩa lɛ. Ba bʋl wɩaa nyagɛ ʋ bɔyɛ ʋ yaraa pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ wʋwalɩmɩa-la kala La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo hɛ ʋ lɛ. Ba kʋŋkala pʋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ nenii-pɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: whose names were Jemimah, Keziah, and Keren Happuch.
translation_verse: Ʋ toli-hɩaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Jemima, lɩa tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ nɛ Kezia, tori tɩɩna ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ Kɛrɩŋ-Hapu.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩpɛ nɛ, hantolibiisiŋ ma batori.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Haal kala fa tuo tintee-la lɛ a zɔmɔ magɛ Job toloo. Ba nyɩmma kpaa ʋ dʋa pɩba a nagɛ ʋ sɩ kpaa ŋɩɩ pɩ ba dɩbaalaa.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa hɩɛsa nɛ woruŋ aŋ-na sʋʋ.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ niiŋ ka to lɛ, a bɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa harɩŋ ka to, a bɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ sieri Wɩa lɛ tʋɔŋ ka guoli.

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: Ba-na tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ dɩ ba to La Tɩɩna wombiiŋ, a kɛŋ wombii-la wɩaa chʋchɔgɩsɛ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Ba nagɛ tɩɩsɩŋ ba sɩ chɔnsɔ fuoŋ niiŋ nɛ, ba nɩnɛŋ ba bʋa lɛ, ba pɩpaarɩŋ bɩ yuori. Wɩɩ na-kala nɛ dɩ nɩaa deemba ŋaa, ʋ yie vɛŋ woruŋ nɛ a pɩba.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ-na bɩ ŋɩɩ naga. Ba nagɛ mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ nɛ peliŋ yie paa viiri.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ chei nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ sarɩya chɛ-diiliŋ, ba bɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ wuo guoli.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Wɩa jɩŋ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wombiiŋ wɩaa nɛ aa pɔba, ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ-na wombiiŋ jaŋ cheiba.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ tinteyee pɛ niiŋ, ba nɩaa vʋvʋʋrɛ wʋpɛɩba?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ kuoroo kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ dɩ ba yuo La Tɩɩna arɩ Nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa.

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ, “Má leŋ dɩ la yuo laa la tɩtɩa ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ la bibeŋ.”

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ mɔŋ, aŋ sieri tinteye-la sɩ vʋʋrɛ wʋpɛɩba-la lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna na baanɩŋ a kpɩa ba lɛ a leŋ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba aŋ bʋl,

english_verse: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
translation_verse: “Mɩ bil mɩ kuoro nɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ, mɩ dundolo-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa pɩ mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: Kuoru-la sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ heele bʋl wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla. Ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Ŋ ŋaa mɩ Bii nɛ, jɩnɩŋ mɩ nɛ lʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Pɩɛsɛmɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ tinteye-la kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ a pɩŋ dɩ ba ŋaa ŋ kɩaa.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ bemba arɩ hɔɔ-daaŋ, a kɛnʋ yɛrɛba a nagɛ ba sɩ yie ŋmoo pupoiŋ ʋ yɛrɛ ŋɩɩ muno muno.’ ”

english_verse: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ma dʋnɩa kuoru-balaa arɩ kuoru-biisiŋ, má kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a jegile nɩɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩɩ chagɩlɛma.

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Má fá La Tɩɩna a tɩma pʋpʋ, dɩ ma nɩɩ jʋɔsʋ ma, ma ha chɩl.

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: Má zil ʋ Nanʋala, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ baanɩŋ jaŋ wuo guu sii dɩ ʋ kpʋma. Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yuoru lɛ.

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, nɩaa yʋga nɛ a ŋaa mɩ dʋndɔmɔ. Nɩ-daŋ nɛ sii chɩŋ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Ba yie bʋl mɩ wɩaa, aŋ bʋl, “Wɩa bɩ jaŋ laaʋ ta.”

english_verse: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na La Tɩɩna nagɛ hɔɔtaala-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ a tɔmɛ, a leŋ mɩ yuo diiba, mɩ nyuŋ nyaasɛ.

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: Mɩ pɩŋ doŋ nɛ aŋ wuo sii a kɛŋ doluŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa La Tɩɩna pɔ mɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ bʋɩ fiiba-la sɩ gollo chumi ka fá.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, kʋ laamɛ ta. Ŋmoo mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tapaŋŋaa yɛrɛ, a churi ba nyɩlaa.

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ yɩrɩŋ, jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Lɩɩsɛmɛ hɛɛŋ lɛ, fá mɩ nisusuŋ aŋ laa mɩ sʋla.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ ma nɩaa deemba chɛ dɩ ma tʋʋsɛ mɩ joŋŋoo a diene magɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ maa chɛ dɩ ma cho vesiŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ a diene magɛ?

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Ma jɩŋ arɩ La Tɩɩna tʋɔsɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa nɛ ba ŋaa ʋ nɩaa. Dɩ mɩ nɛ yɩrʋ, ʋ yie jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ na baanɩŋ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ baaŋ-la leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ bɔsɔ, má pɩŋ sɔm a bɩbɩɩnɛ wɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ nɩɩ pɩɛsʋ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ la lɛ?” La Tɩɩna, leŋ dɩ ŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ chaana hɛ la lɛ.

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Tʋɔtɔrʋ-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ nɛ yʋga kɩɩ ba mɩaa arɩ ba tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩŋ-la kala ba sɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ jʋʋ bɔsɔ, mɩ yie pɩŋ doŋ woruŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ-na mɩ Tɩɩna yie pɔmɛ nɛ dɩ wɩɩ sɩ́ mɩ jʋʋ.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, kpil dɩgɩlɩŋ a nɩɩ mɩ wʋbʋlaa. Jegile nɩɩ mɩ hʋʋna.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Mɩ kuoro arɩ mɩ Wɩa, jegile nɩɩ mɩ nii-ŋmobo a pɛ mɩ lɛ. Ŋ nɛ mɩ sʋsʋl.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, chʋchʋɔ na-kala ŋ yie nɩɩ mɩ yikoro nɛ. Mɩ yie bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ a pɩŋ, aŋ gbɛrɛ dɩ mɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩmɛ.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ Wɩa a bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ cho. Ŋ dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa bɩ ŋ-na mɩ Tɩɩna sɩpaaŋ wuo chɩŋ, ŋ bɛrɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Ŋ yie chei nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ, aŋ bɛrɛ nɩkpʋʋraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ nyɩsɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Ama a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ faasaa fá nɩaa nisusuŋ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ kʋ jʋʋ ŋ dɩa-la sɩ zɔmɔ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ tʋɔŋ a kpirime ziliŋ.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, dagɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ. Leŋ dɩ ŋ wombiiŋ pʋlla pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ to, a tɩŋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Ba niiŋ wʋbʋlaa bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ. Ba yie chɩchɛ dɩ ba chei wɩaa nɛ. Ba wʋbʋlaa nagɛ bʋa-suruŋ sɩɩ sʋɔrɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ, ba bʋl wɩaa a nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
