translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, joŋ cheeriŋ pɩba a dɔgɩsɛba. Leŋ ba tɩtɩa sɩ vʋʋrɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋaa dɩ ba tel. Kiriba ta ŋ sɩpaaŋ a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋ dandaŋ-la wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba vɩaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋ yuoruŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, dɩ ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a jʋjʋɔsɛ bʋa na-kala. Chu tɔ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ choŋ, a leŋ dɩ ba jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla lɛ nɛ. Ŋ chonuŋ chu tɔba a nagɛ laalɩyuoroo sɩ kɛŋ hɔ-taala-la kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, sɩ́ baanɩŋ na a dɔgɩsɛmɛ, koo a dagɛmɛ arɩ baanɩŋ.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: Mɩ bɛsɩmɛ nɛ, mɩ Tɩɩna. Fá mɩ nenige aŋ pɩmɛ doluŋ, mɩ chaasa lɔl nɛ.

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: Mɩ kala chaasa ŋaa hɛɛ nɛ. Mɩ Tɩɩna, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ diene magɛ aŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ?

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩɩra kʋ laamɛ ta, a tɩŋ ŋ chonuŋ sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa laamɛ ta.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sʋba, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo dɛnnɩŋ koo a liisi ŋ wɩaa lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Hʋʋna leŋe mɩ kala bɛsɩmɛ nɛ. Mɩ yie yel bɔsɔ lɛ nɛ tɩtaŋ kala, mɩ bɔsɔ arɩ mɩ nyuŋ-yelle kala su arɩ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ wʋŋaalaa leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ chei nɛ mɩ yel, mɩ sɩaa kala gʋɔlɛ a bɩra bɩ na woruŋ.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, má sʋʋsa lɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. La Tɩɩna nɩɩ mɩ yele nɛ.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɩɩ mɩ sɩ ŋmoo niiŋ pʋ dɩ ʋ fá mɩ nenige nɛ, a laa mɩ sʋla.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ dii mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ dɩ ba suri niiŋ lɔl aŋ guu mɩɩra fá arɩ hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, mɩ kʋ yuoruŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ pɔmɛ a laamɛ ta. Lɩɩsɛmɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ kirimi nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ba jaŋ kɛmmɛ pʋɔsɛ muno muno a nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩ yie kɛŋ kʋa pʋɔsɛ ŋɩɩ, ka nʋʋ jaŋ tuo dɩ ʋ laamɛ ta.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ mɩ nandɔŋ kala joŋo yallɛ koo a yuo mɩ dʋndɔmɔ sɩ bɩ mɩ wɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kʋŋ, leŋ dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kire kɛmmɛ, a nʋɔsɛmɛ bil tinteeŋ dɩ mɩ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna, sii arɩ baanɩŋ a ŋaa wɩɩ. Yuo mɩ dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ faasa na baanɩŋ mɩ nyuŋ. Sii a leŋ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ chɩŋ.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala kʋ chɩna golluŋ, ka dɩ ŋ hɔŋ ŋ kuoru kpasa lɛ wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii aŋ bibemba.

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɩɩ dii nʋʋkala sarɩya, dii mɩ ma sarɩya a dagɛ arɩ mɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ a bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, a jɩŋ nɩaa tʋɔbɩɩnaa arɩ ba wʋchɛɛlɛɛ. Leŋ dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ aŋ pɔ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɩɩ pɔmɛ, ʋ nɩɩ pɔ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Wɩa kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla nɛ a didii sarɩya, ʋ yie chichei nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ tapʋlɩɩ na-kala.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ bɩ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la leŋe, Wɩa jaŋ taa ʋ tokobiiŋ a lɛrɛ ʋ toŋ a ŋaa siri.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala tʋɔŋ sɩ suo arɩ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ yie ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la nɛ a nyɩnyɩɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Nɩdosunu-la yie lu buotuoŋ a bil nɩaa lɛ, a tɩtɩa gʋra tuu.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ hɛ yie gʋra nyʋa ba nyuŋ lɛ. Ba tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ gʋra yɛrɛ ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna a tɩŋ ʋ tʋɔpʋla wɩaa, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnʋ, ʋ nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ benla, ŋ yɩrɩŋ yʋga nɛ woruŋ dʋnɩa lee-kala. Ŋ leŋe ŋ tʋla kieli wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe hambiisiŋ arɩ bii-mulluŋ dɩdɛnnɩŋ a tɩŋ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ, dɩ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ ŋ harɩŋ bɩra sɩ́ wɩɩ wuo bʋl.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa arɩ ŋ nɩsɩŋ, a beŋ chɛnɛ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa ŋ sɩ leŋe ba chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa,

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: mɩ yie bʋl, “Nuhuobiine tuo kʋŋkala, ka ŋ bɩbɩɩnɛ ʋ wɩaa. Nuhuobiine bie tuo kʋŋkala, ka ŋ chɩl ʋ wɩaa.”

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa nuhuobiine a leŋ ŋ tɩndaaraa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ kɩɩʋ mʋa, ka ŋ zilu a leŋ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ arɩ yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: Ŋ joŋ kɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa a hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ bibeŋ, a leŋ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ ba lɛ:

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: diibiisiŋ arɩ chenfilee arɩ kʋŋ na-kala sɩɩ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa, ŋ yɩrɩŋ yʋga nɛ woruŋ dʋnɩa lee-kala.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ La Tɩɩna arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala. Mɩ jaŋ bʋl wʋkpuŋkperisi-la kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a tɩŋ ŋ wɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ chemiŋ, ba mɩɩra fá nɛ a tele sʋʋ.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: Ŋ hɔŋ ŋ kuoru kpasa lɛ nɛ a dii sarɩya arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a dagɛ arɩ mɩ kɩaa sɩma nɛ.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ŋ kpɩa tinteyee lɛ nɛ, a kpʋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ, a leŋ ba yɩrɩŋ dɩsɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Ŋ chei la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ŋ yigi ba tabalaa lo nɛ, nʋʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ liisi ba wɩaa.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ kuoro a kaa mʋ wuu. Ʋ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ nɛ a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ dii sarɩya.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Ʋʋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya arɩ tʋɔpʋla nɛ, aa beŋ tinteyee nɩaa arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ nɩalɩŋ wɩaa sɩ nyaga bil yie fá mʋ yuori, ʋ nɛ dɩ-duo-la nɩaa sɩ yie fá mʋ dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋba.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩmɩŋ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋ bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ kire tɩta.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, ʋ hɔŋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ nɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ a bibeŋ ʋ nɩaa. Má bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa a pɩ tinteyee nɩaa.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa chei, ŋ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba. Ŋ bɩ jaŋ yʋ, koo a vɩa dɩ ŋ jegile nɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ yele.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, na ŋɩɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛmɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, fá mɩ nenige aŋ lɩɩsɛmɛ sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ,

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: dɩ mɩ wuo chɩŋ Jerusalɛm boi-baalaa niiŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa dɛnnɩŋ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ nɩmɛ a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ laamɛ ta wɩaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ foro tuu buotuonu-la ba tɩtɩa sɩ luo nɛ. Bɛrɩsɩ-la ba sɩ bɛrɛ gʋra kɛsɛ ba tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ to a jɩmʋ. Wʋbɔmɔ-la nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ ŋaa nagɛ bɛrɛ nɛ a gʋra kɛsɛba.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ sʋʋ a mʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ, tinteye-la nɩaa kala sɩ yʋ Wɩa wɩaa.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ bɩ jaŋ yʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ wɩaa, koo a leŋ dɩ summoo yɩɛlaa ŋaa pɛɩ.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, sii a ŋaa wɩɩ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ tinteye-la sɩ bɩŋ jɩŋ yuo dii. Leŋ dɩ ba chɩŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ dɩ ŋ dii ba sarɩya.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ faasa kɛmba, leŋ ba jɩŋ arɩ ba ŋaa nuhuobiine nɛ, ba jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ dɩŋ pɛgɛ bol? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa faala, bʋa-la lɛ wɩaa sɩ jʋʋla?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ ka dagɛ ba tɩtɩa nɛ aa dɔgɩsɛ summoo. Leŋ dɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ vʋʋra gʋra dii ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔmɔ-la leŋe ba bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ. Tʋɔ-bɔŋ tɩŋŋaa vɩa La Tɩɩna nɛ a chichei ʋ yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ ka dagɛ ba tɩtɩa kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ a vɩa Wɩa, ba bɩ ʋ wɩaa ka liisi.

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Ba wɩɩkala chɩna nɛ woruŋ, ama ba bɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii ba sarɩya, aŋ bee gʋgʋʋnɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ lɛ ba sɩ, “Wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ ŋaa la lɛ. La tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ bʋa na-kala, wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ jʋʋla.”

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ba yie ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛ aŋ pɛ nyɩnyɩɛ wɩaa, a fufugisi nɩaa ma. Ba wɩɩŋ kala nɛ dɩ ba hɩhɛ wɩaa aŋ bʋbʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ba yie faa tabiisiŋ jeeŋ harɩŋ nɛ a gbɩgbɛrɛ dɩ ba kpʋ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye, a bagɩlaa chɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: Ba yie pɔ lere-la a nagɛ naachigiŋ nɛ, dɩ ba kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ lee kɛnɛ. Ba yie kɛmba ba bɛrɛ lɛ a lɛrɛ viiri.

english_verse: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
translation_verse: Ba yie ŋmoo nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ lee kɛnɛ lo nɛ arɩ doluŋ, ba pɩŋ vɩntɩm,

english_verse: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl, “Wɩa sɩpaa tuo. Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa tɔ nɛ, ʋ bɩ wɩɩ-la ka na.”

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa, sii a ŋaa wɩɩ. Sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ lee kɛnɛ wɩaa yʋ.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ mʋmɔŋ Wɩa lɛ? Ba yie bʋl ba tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Wɩa bɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛla.”

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na Wɩa yie na mɩ hɛɛŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jʋʋmɛ nɛ. Ŋ yie beŋ nɩmɛ nɛ a ŋaa wɩɩ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ lee kɛnɛ joŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɛ biisinsiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ doluŋ dɛrɛ. Dɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa, aŋ ŋaa dɩ ba leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ kuoro a kaa mʋ wuu. Tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ ʋ jɩŋ jaŋ nyɩɩgɛ ʋ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ nii-ŋmobo nɛ, a ŋaa wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ chɛ a leŋ ba nyuŋ nyaasɛ.

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: Ŋ chɩŋ biisinsiŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ wɩaa sɩ nyaga bil harɩŋ nɛ, dɩ nuhuobiiŋ kala bɩra sɩ́ wuo joŋ fawʋllʋŋ hɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ mɩ yie fá mʋ yuori. Ɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩmɛ, “Lʋara fá a nagɛ diibie a sii jɩl peeliŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: Bee na, nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛrɛ ba tosuŋ hɛ nɛ, a hɛ hɛŋŋɛɛ a chɩŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ a mɩmagɩsɛ dɩ ba yuo nɩalɩŋ wʋŋaalaa sɩ tʋʋla.

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩɩ nɛ chei ʋ gentine lɛ, tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna bɩra bɩ wɩɩkala wuo ŋaa.”

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ nɛ, ʋ dɩa-la sɩ zɔmɔ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ Wɩa-jaŋ. Ʋ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋʋ na la kala nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna yie bibeŋ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ wʋŋaalaa nɛ, ama ʋ bɛrɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ hɛ yuosuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nyiŋ-hal muloo arɩ jiribiiŋ chol nyiniŋ a lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a kʋ tuu nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩɩ nɩɩ, aŋ ka dɩ pel-lɩmɩŋ kɛmba.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, ʋ cho wʋtɩtɩɩ. Nɩalɩŋ wʋŋaalaa sɩ tʋʋla jaŋ hɔŋ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ mɩ Tɩɩna, pɛ mɩ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ fáŋ kʋŋ bɩra tuo, wʋtɩtɩɩ tɩŋŋaa bɩra tuo.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala ka nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ ʋ naambie teeŋ, a kɛŋ nii-sɩma nyɩnyɩsɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ nii-sɩma arɩ babiibal wʋbʋllaa niiŋ tɔ.

english_verse: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ, “La nɛ tɩɩ la niiree, la jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩɩkala la sɩ cho. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo pɔ dɩ la sɩ́ wɩaa bʋl.”

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ kɔ lɛɛlɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ arɩ summoo ba yiyel. Mɩ jaŋ laaba ta nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna wʋbʋlaa ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ, a nagɛ hɔpʋla ba sɩ chɔ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ a lɩɩsɛ disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, laala ta nɩdosunuŋ deemba nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a pɔla a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ lee-kala nɛ aa bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ, ka nɩaa bɩbɛsɛ ba wʋbɔŋ wʋŋaalaa lɛ.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɛ ŋ yʋ mɩ wɩaa a diene magɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɛ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa faamɛ a diene magɛ?

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa jaŋ vʋgʋmɛ, dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ chei tapʋlɩɩ kala a diene magɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ yuo diimi a magɛ?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, jegile nɩɩ mɩ sʋla a leŋ dɩ mɩ bɩra kɛŋ doluŋ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ sʋʋ.

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ bʋl, “La yuo diiu nɛ,” Dɩ mɩ nɛ tele, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Mɩ laa ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ dii nɛ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ mɩ jʋjʋɔsɛ a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ laamɛ ta wɩaa.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a pʋ.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Nɩyaaraa nɛ yie bʋl ba tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Wɩa tuo.” Ba ŋaa nɩa sɩ cheye nɛ, ba wʋŋaalaa lɔrɔ, ba kʋŋkala bɩ wʋzɔŋ ka ŋaa.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ beŋ dɩ ʋ na wʋjɩnnʋ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ a ŋaa wɩaa chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ jɩmʋ.

english_verse: But all of them are corrupt; no one does right.
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋkala joŋ harɩŋ yɩa Wɩa nɛ a ŋaa nɩa sɩ cheye. Nɩbala ma paala tuo a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ, ma-na bɩ wɩaa wuo gʋnna pɩpɩ ma tɩtɩa koo? Ma vɩa dɩ ma chʋɔlɛmɛ nɛ, aŋ gɔllɔ kɛsɛ mɩ nɩaa liliŋ.

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ jʋʋma kɩŋkɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ʋ niiŋ teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: Ma wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nɩɩ chei wɩalɩŋ summoo sɩ vʋʋra, ama La Tɩɩna nɛ chu tɔ ba lɛ.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋl Wɩa nɛ dɩ nʋʋ lɩɩ Zaayɔŋ lɛ a kʋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta. La Tɩɩna, dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩra pɛ ŋ nɩaa lɛ, Jekɔb doho nɩaa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ba jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo hɛ ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, koo a hɔŋ ŋ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: See nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ŋ niiŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ baa ŋaa, a bʋbʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ ba tʋɔŋ kala,

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: a bɩ nɩaa harɩŋ ka gaa, a bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa chei ba dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa, a bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma bʋla a tɩtɩgɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl wʋtɔɔnʋŋ wɩaa cho, ama baa zil nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to La Tɩɩna nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ba jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ, ba yie ŋaa nɛ, wɩɩkala tuo sɩ jaŋ giriba.

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: Ba yie joŋ ba moribiee a chɩŋ nɩaa aŋ bɩ nyʋʋrʋŋ kaa pɛ. Ba bɩ kpalaa laa aŋ joŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye hɩhɛ wɩaa lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba bʋa na-kala lɛ, ba jaŋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ, wɩɩkala bɩ ba wuo jigisi.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, pɔmɛ, mɩ yuoruŋ nɛ.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋla pɩ La Tɩɩna, “Ŋ nɛ mɩ Tɩɩna, kʋzɔmɔ-la kala mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ, ŋ nɛ pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: Your people are wonderful, and they make me happy,
translation_verse: Ŋ nɩaa wɩaa chaasa zɔŋ nɛ woruŋ, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ba nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to vesiŋ, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ chei kɩŋkɛŋ. Mɩ-na bɩ jaŋ kpaarɛ vesi-la koo a kɛŋ ba yɩrɩŋ tɩŋ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa kpaal-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ, ŋ nɛ pɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ. Mɩ chie kala hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ kpaal-la ŋ sɩ pɩmɛ nyuŋ nɛ woruŋ, ba ŋaa tʋɔtɔrɛ dʋa nɛ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagɛmɛ. Tɩtaŋɩŋ ma paala, wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ dagɛmɛ ha yie hɛ mɩ nyuŋ lɛ nɛ, a liliisimi.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma La Tɩɩna yie hɛ mɩ teeŋ nɛ bʋa na-kala. Ʋ kpagɛmɛ nɛ, wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ wuo jigisimi.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ mɩ jʋjʋɔsɛ, wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa, ŋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ ka bʋa tʋɔŋ, koo a mʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Ŋ dagɛmɛ wombii-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ to a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ. Ŋ sɩ kpagɛmɛ, ŋɩɩ leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ bʋa na-kala mɩ sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ ŋ nadiiŋ.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ arɩ tʋɔpʋla, jegile nɩɩ mɩ nii-ŋmobo a pɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a sʋsʋlʋŋ, jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩ jɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ŋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ nɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ a bemmi woruŋ a na dɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ. Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ arɩ mɩ bɩ jaŋ bʋbʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩɩ ŋaa ka to, ama wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ mɩ tuto. Mɩ bɩ yuo-hɛɛrʋ ŋaa.

english_verse: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩ to ŋ wombiiŋ, mɩ bɩ begile.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jɩma ŋ jaŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ. Jegile nɩɩ aŋ laa mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Dagɛ ŋ chono-la sɩ yʋga pɩmɛ. Ŋ nɩɩ pɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yuoruŋ a laaba tɩta ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Pɔmɛ arɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ pɔ ŋ tɩtɩa sɩɩ-biiŋ ŋɩɩ. Kɛmmɛ faa ŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ yuomi, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋ-bisiŋ ma tɔmɛ hɛ.

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ nɩaa nenige ka fá, aŋ bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ba to naasɩŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ, a lɛɛlɛ gollimi chu. Ba sɩaa kala pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ ba nyagɛmɛ ŋmʋrɛ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: Ba nagɛ losuŋ sɩ kɛŋ naachigiŋ nɛ ʋ gɔllɔ chɩchɛ kʋdiilee koo naachigi-duoŋ sɩ faa gbɛrɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ kʋa.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, sii chemba, a yuo diiba. Joŋ ŋ tokobiiŋ a yuo laamɛ ta nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: Laamɛ ta nɩalɩŋ time kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Joŋ hɛɛ-la ŋ sɩ joŋo bil a gbɛrɛba a dɔgɩsɛba. Leŋ dɩ ʋ yi ba biiriŋ, aŋ ka dɩ mʋa ha ka a gbɛrɛ ba nihee ma.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ-na jaŋ naŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ sie, mɩ yie na ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ naga nɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
translation_verse: Mɩ choŋ nɛ woruŋ La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ mɩ doluŋ.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ, ŋ nɛ mɩ dɩ-duoŋ, ŋ nɛ laamɛ tɩta. Mɩ Wɩa, ŋ nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ, ŋ nɛ mɩ yuori. Ŋ nɛ chu tɔmɛ, ŋ nɛ laamɛ tɩta, ŋ nɛ mɩ dɩ-duoŋ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ dɛnnɩŋ La Tɩɩna, mɩ sʋla yɩrɩŋ nɛ, ŋ laamɛ ta mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Sʋʋŋ vɔɔmɛ nɛ arɩ ʋ ŋmɛsɩŋ, a nagɛ fuo sɩ suo, ʋ fa ka mʋa dɩ ʋ pɛllɛ jommi a liŋ.

english_verse: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
translation_verse: Sʋʋŋ ŋmɛsɩŋ vɔɔmɛ nɛ a golli, aŋ ka ʋ bɛrɩsɩŋ ma gbɛrɛmɛ.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Wɩaa fa chaasa jʋʋmɛ nɛ, mɩ bunso pɩ ŋ-na mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa dɩ ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ. Ŋ hɛ ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ nɛ aŋ nɩɩ mɩ yikoro, mɩ nii-ŋmobo-la kala jʋʋ ŋ dɩgɩlaa nɛ.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ na baanɩŋ, tinteeŋ zigile nɛ, peelee ma jigisi a tuu kɛŋ ba gentisiŋ pɛ.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Ka nyʋɔsʋŋ lɩlɩɩ ŋ-na La TƖƖNA mɩɩ-boyee lɛ, nyiŋgeliŋ arɩ nyiŋ-hal-muloo maa lɩɩ ŋ niiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛŋ wɩa-nyuŋ bɛgɛ ta nɛ aŋ kʋ tuu, ka duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-bisiŋ hɛ ŋ naasɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Ŋ sagɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa nyuŋ nɛ a file to peliŋ lɛ a kʋ tuu.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe birimiŋ nagɛ lɛbɩŋ nɛ a golluŋ, ka duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-bine ma tɔŋ.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ, duoŋ-tabɩaa arɩ nyiŋ-hal muloo lɩɩ duoŋ sɩ lɩgɩsa tʋɔŋ a ŋmoo duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-bine-la pɩsɛ.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala, ŋ sɩ kpɩa goŋ wɩa-nyuŋ, leriŋ kala chɩɩma nɛ.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ sɩ kpɩa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ, ʋ lɩɩŋ kala hʋa nɛ a nyɩɩsɛ tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋ sɩ wiese ma, tinteeŋ zigile nɛ.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Ŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ a kʋ tuu, a liirimi lɩɩŋ sɩ luŋie tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ laamɛ ta mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ chaasa kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩmɛ.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ sɩ jʋʋmɛ, ba sii kɔ dɩ ba yuomi, ŋ-na La TƖƖNA sii chɩŋ nɛ a pɔmɛ.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ tɔmɛ hɛ, ŋ nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ ta pʋlʋŋ-jaala lɛ. Ŋ chomi nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ laamɛ ta.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ lɛ a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wɩaa nɛ. Mɩ sɩ bɩ disiŋ kala kɛnɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ siilimi.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ to La TƖƖNA wombiee nɛ, mɩ ha bɩ Wɩa harɩŋ lɩa a ŋaa wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ to wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile nɛ, mɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga dɩ la tuto kʋŋkala vɩa.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA siilimi, mɩ sɩ bɩ disiŋ kɛnɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, ŋ yie pʋllɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ pɩba nɛ, ama nɩalɩŋ wɩaa sɩ golibo, ŋ yie hosi ba nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: Ŋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri a ta nɛ, aŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ muuri.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ leŋe mɩ chaanɩŋ chol nɛ a didii, mɩ Wɩa leŋe biriŋ-la tʋɔŋ mɩ sɩ hɛ bɩrɩmɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, ŋ wombiiŋ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ. Ŋ wɩaa ma tʋʋlɛ. Ŋ nagɛ hɔɔtaala-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ, a chu tɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋ yuoruŋ.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Wɩa dɔŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a pɛ La Tɩɩna, Wɩa lɛɛ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ la Wɩa dee?

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ pɩmɛ doluŋ a leŋ mɩ wombiiŋ chaasa zɔŋ.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ leŋe mɩ naachɛɛŋ lɩŋ a nagɛ aamɩŋ. Ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ wuo jɩla chɩŋ peelee nyuŋ.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ gʋnnɛmɛ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ wuo yuo toŋ-la ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: Ŋ chu tɔmɛ nɛ a laamɛ ta. Ŋ nɩsɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ ŋ kaa chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ. Ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ a leŋ mɩ ŋaa nɩbal.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ pori mɩ wombiiŋ ʋ jal, dɩ mɩ sɩ́ mɩ naaŋ joŋo ŋmoo.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Mɩ kire kɛsɛ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, mɩ bɩ harɩŋ mɩɩra aŋ cheiba.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmooba lo mɩ naasɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, ba bɩ wuo sii. Mɩ yuo diiba nɛ.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Ŋ pɩmɛ doluŋ nɛ mɩ kaa yuo laalɩŋ, a yuo dii mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe mɩ dʋndɔmɔ-la mɩɩra fɩfá nɛ, ka mɩ kire kpʋba.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ba ŋmoo niiŋ a chɩchɛ nʋʋ nɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ, ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ laaba ta. Ba yɩrɛ ŋ-na La TƖƖNA ma, ŋ fʋʋla yagɛba.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmooba, ba kala bɩɩ a nagɛ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ peliŋ sɩ paa. Mɩ nʋɔsɛba a nagɛ vʋchɔɔŋ sɩ hɛ womporuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ laamɛ ta nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yuomi nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a leŋ mɩ ŋaa tintee-wogusuŋ sɩpaalaara. Lɛɛlɛ ba ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Ba nandaasɩŋ kala nɛ yʋɔra, ba lɩɩ ba dɩ-duoruŋ lɛ a chele kʋkɔ.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na La Tɩɩna weye nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ, ŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ heele bʋl Wɩa sɩ laamɛ ta yɩrɩ-balɩŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ Wɩa a laa mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo pɩmɛ, a joŋ tinteyee nɩaa pɩmɛ mɩ bibeŋ.

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ laamɛ ta mɩ dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ cho yuosuŋ woruŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a leŋ mɩ ŋaa nɩbal a kɩɩ ba kala.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ tinteyee nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ leŋe mɩ-na ŋ kuoro Devit yuo dii. Ŋ dagɛ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na, nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa arɩ mɩ doho nɩaa a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa kala ka dagɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa tʋla sɩ maga nɛ, baa dagɛ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Tapʋlʋŋ yie bʋl Wɩa tʋla wɩaa a pɩ tapʋlʋŋ dɔŋɔ, tɩtaŋɩŋ ma bʋl ʋ tʋla wɩaa pɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ ba wʋbʋlʋŋ koo ba yikoro ka nɩɩ.

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: Ama ba wʋbʋlaa ka yi dʋnɩa lee-kala nɛ. Dʋnɩa nʋʋkala nɛ nɩɩ ba yikoro. Wɩa hɛ lɛbɩŋ nɛ wɩa-nyuŋ a pɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ ʋ jʋjʋʋ.

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie kʋ lɩɩ chʋchʋɔŋ a nagɛ ha-falɩŋ bala, koo a nagɛ fɩfaarɩ-wajɩa sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ fá pagɩsɛ.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna wombiee ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto chaasa zɔŋ nɛ, a pɩpɩla dol-falɩŋ. Wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna sɩ daga ŋaa wɩa ŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa hɛ nɛ. Ba nɩɩ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ woruŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Niiri-la La Tɩɩna sɩ bile dɩ la tuto chaasa tʋʋlɛ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ toba yie kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ. La Tɩɩna wʋdagaa kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ nɛ a susuri nɩaa sɩaa.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna sɩ sɩ la tuto kala ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ, gɩrɩma tuo ba lɛ.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ yuŋŋie kɩɩ sɛlɩmɛ, ba nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ. Ba nɛ sɩma ma a kɩɩ tʋʋŋ, ba nɛ sɩma kɩɩ tʋʋ-pɛɛŋ.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Ba lɛ nɛ ŋ to a kpʋrɩsɛ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna dɩgɩlaa. Mɩ sɩ sɛɩba, ŋ timmi a yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: La kʋŋkala bɩ la wʋcheelee wuo jɩŋ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ aŋ bɩ jɩŋ, joŋo chɛmɛ.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna sɛŋ aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ kɛŋ doluŋ mɩ lɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ lɩɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ suoo a sɩ́ wʋcheeli kala kɛŋ.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa arɩ mɩ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa tʋtɔrɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ. La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ bʋŋ a laamɛ tɩta.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋl La Tɩɩna bʋa-la lɛ wɩaa sɩ jaŋ jʋʋŋ, dɩ ʋ jegile nɩɩ ŋ teeŋ, a leŋ dɩ Jekɔb Wɩa pɔŋ,

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: a leŋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ a kʋ pɛ ŋ lɛ a lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kʋ chɩŋ ŋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ ʋ liise yi ŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩaa arɩ ŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa lɛ, dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ʋ laaba,

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: a leŋ dɩ ʋ pɩŋ kɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ, dɩ wɩɩkala ŋ sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ vɛŋ woruŋ pɩŋ.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ yuo dii ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ la tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ dɩ la gbiele ŋaa goŋ, a kɛŋ la jɔnjɔmba je la Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ. A leŋ dɩ La Tɩɩna pɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Mɩ lɛɛlɛ jɩma arɩ La Tɩɩna laa kuoru-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa a ta nɛ. Ʋ hɛ ʋ jaŋ sɩ zɔmɔ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ nɛ aŋ laa ʋ sʋla. Ʋ naduo-la nɛ ʋ kaa laaʋ ta.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ba laalɩyuori janɩŋ torukoba arɩ ba janɩŋ doluŋ lɛ nɛ, ama la-na joŋ la yɩɛlaa kala hɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Nɩdosunuŋ deemba jaŋ gɛrɛ tel, ama la-na jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, laa kuoru-la ta! Dɩ la nɛ yɩrɩŋ, nɩɩ a fá la bunso.

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ doluŋ nɛ leŋe kuoro tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, ʋ faasa jʋjʋɔsɛ a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ́ leŋe ʋ yuo dii ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ a pʋ. Wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ pɩɛsɩŋ chɩchɛ, ŋ bɩ ʋ vɔmɔ.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Ŋ chaga laaʋ nɛ, a pɛ ʋ lɛ woruŋ a joŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ ba sɩ kaa ŋaa kuoru nyunchuulo a chuu.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: Ʋ sʋlʋŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ pʋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ŋ joŋ mɩɩ-duduoŋ a pʋ.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ leŋe kuoru-la yuo dii ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, ŋɩɩ leŋe ʋ chaasa laa yɩrɩŋ nɛ ba zizilu.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ a pʋ, a leŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ chaasa tɔrɛ a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ kpagʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ naduo-la nɛ ŋ jaŋ kaa kɛŋ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala, a ŋmooba lo.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ jaŋ kɔ, ŋ jaŋ cheiba a nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩ dii kɩaa. Ŋ-na La Tɩɩna baanɩŋ jaŋ nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ a jomba dii.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ chei ba doho nɩaa kala dɩ ba nyɩɩgɛ tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba yɩrɩŋ jaŋ lɛl nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔmɔ-la kala ba sɩ vʋʋra dɩ ba ŋaa ŋ lɛ, ba bɩ jaŋ na wombiiŋ.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba mɩɩra fá dɩ ŋ nɛ lɛrɛ toŋ a pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, laa dɛnnɩŋ, ŋ doluŋ yʋga. La jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɩŋ a tɩŋ ŋ doluŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩ Wɩa, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ vɩamɛ ta? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ hɛ dɩ-bolii aŋ vɩa dɩ ŋ laamɛ ta? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bɩ mɩ huunoo jegile nɩɩ?

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala nɛ, ama ŋ bɩ jegile nɩɩ, mɩ saa bɩ jaŋ leŋ.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ a hɔŋ ŋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩdɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.
translation_verse: La naabalɩmaba joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ laaba ta.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ ŋmoo niiŋ pɩŋ dɩ ŋ pɛ ba lɛ, ŋ jegile nɩɩ nɛ a laaba ta. Ba sɩ laaŋ dii, ŋ bɩ leŋe hɩɩsɩŋ diiba.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Mɩ paala bɩ nʋʋ ŋaa, mɩ nagɛ vɛrɩŋ nɛ. Nɩaa bɛrɛmɛ a bɩ mɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala yie namɛ a sieri mɩ lɛ a tʋʋsɛmɛ, aŋ vivigisi nyuŋ,

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: a bʋl, “Ŋ laa La Tɩɩna dii nɛ, dɩ ʋ ma nɛ cho ŋ wɩaa, leŋ dɩ ʋ laaŋ ta, dɩ wɩɩkala sɩ́ ŋ lɛ ŋaa yei.”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ leŋe ba lʋlmɛ wɩɩkala bɩ mɩ lɛ ŋaa. Ŋ pɔmɛ nɛ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ ha sɩɩ wasɛ yɩlɩŋ.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ lʋlmɛ, ŋ nɩɩ beŋ mɩ nyuŋ, a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ naaŋ sɩ lʋlmɛ a kaa kɔ, ŋ nɛ mɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ dɩ-bolii hɛ, wʋjʋʋlaa kpagɛmɛ nɛ, ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yʋga a gollimi a nagɛ Basaŋ tinteeŋ nɛ-bel duoruŋ sɩ werige.

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔmɔ-la nagɛ naachigee nɛ a faasa suri ba niiree aa tʋɔrɛ dɩ ba kɛmmɛ pʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Mɩ doluŋ kala nɛ dɛrɛ aŋ ka mʋa a nagɛ lɩɩ-suosoo. Mɩ haŋgbel-susugusuŋ kala lɩɩ, mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala lɛl a nagɛ keliŋ sɩ ŋmɩɛra.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: Mɩ doluŋ kala nɛ dɛrɛ a nagɛ pupoiŋ sɩ yɛrɛ. Mɩ nandelimiŋ ma hɩl a mɛrɛ mɩ tilimiŋ lɛ. Ŋ-na Wɩa nɛ lemmi ta dɩ mɩ sʋʋ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ gollimi a nagɛ vasɩŋ, a tɔɔ mɩ nɩsaa arɩ mɩ naasɩŋ luri.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛ mɩ haŋgbelee, ba kala nyɩɩsa nɛ. Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yie bemmi fii aŋ gɛlɛ dieri.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: Ba tɔnsɛ mɩ gɛnnɩŋ wɩaa nɛ, aŋ paa kpaa dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, sɩ́ dɩ-bolii hɛ. Ŋ nɛ mɩ doluŋ, ŋaa lɩma a kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Laamɛ ta mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba nagɛ vasɩŋ nɛ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba kpʋmɛ.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Laamɛ ta naachigee niiŋ lɛ, a laamɛ ta nɛ-bel-duoru-la ma sɩ werige lɛ.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, má dɛnnʋ. Ma Jekɔb doho nɩaa kala, má zilu. Ma Iziral doho kala, má fáʋ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ wɩaa yʋa. Ʋ bɩ ba kaa gbigbesi ba wʋjʋʋlaa lɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ yɩrʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ, ʋ yie nɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ harɩŋ joŋo yɩyɩaba.

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩaa nɛ yʋga a hilimi ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fáŋ sɩpaaŋ, mɩ jaŋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a lɩɩsɛ nii-la mɩ sɩ ta.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Summoo jaŋ dii kɩaa vɔgɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩ kɔ La Tɩɩna teeŋ jaŋ dɛnnʋ. A leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ mɩɩ-duduoŋ.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ jaŋ liisi La Tɩɩna wɩaa a mɩɩra kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Tinteye-la sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nɩaa kala jaŋ kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlʋ,

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa La Tɩɩna nɛ kuoro, a kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ tinteyee kala.

english_verse: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ jaŋ kʋ kpirimi ŋ sɩpaaŋ. Nɩalɩŋ ma naaŋ sɩɩ lieŋi sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ a bɩ wuo wiesee yi kala jaŋ kʋ kpirimi ŋ sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlʋŋ.

english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, nɩalɩŋ ba ha sɩ jaŋ lʋl, ba ma jaŋ nɩɩ ŋ wɩaa a toŋ.

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ bʋl ŋ tʋɔpʋla wɩaa a pɩ nɩalɩŋ ba ha sɩ bɩ lʋla a bʋl: “La Tɩɩna laa ʋ nɩaa ta nɛ.”

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe mɩ pɩŋ sɩma tʋɔŋ nɛ, a nagɛ pie-daara sɩ kɛŋ ʋ piesee mʋ ba dii ya-fɩɛlɩŋ, ka ʋ kɛmba mʋ ba nyʋa lɩɩzɔmʋŋ.

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie pɩmɛ dol-falɩŋ nɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala. Ʋ yie leŋ mɩ to wombii-la sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ a tɩŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ paalaa vɛŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ ma, mɩ bɩ sʋʋŋ ka fá, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ hɛ mɩ teeŋ nɛ. Ŋ hɔɔ-daaŋ arɩ ŋ kʋdaarɩ daaŋ nɛ ŋ yie kaa pɔmɛ.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe mɩ hɔŋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tʋɔŋ nɛ a dii kɩaa, a leŋ mɩ nyʋnyʋala su a lɩɩ tɩta. Ŋ zilmi nɛ a nagɛ ŋ nʋhʋɔra.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ ŋ jaŋ chomi a ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ pɩpɩmɛ. Mɩ jaŋ hɛ ŋ-na La Tɩɩna dɩa lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa arɩ kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ ŋaa La Tɩɩna kɩaa nɛ. Nuhuobiinee kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ ŋaa ʋ kɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ŋaa tinteeŋ a daŋ mʋgʋ-balaa nyuŋ nɛ, a leŋ ʋ chɩŋ lɩɩŋ nyuŋ kpaŋkpaŋ.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo jɩl La Tɩɩna peel-la? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ tʋɔŋ?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, a bɩ vʋɩyaa ka kpaarɛ koo a nyɩɛ wɩaa aŋ ŋmɩŋmɩɛsɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ pɛ nɩdoho-la lɛ, Wɩa jaŋ laaʋ ta a dagɛ arɩ ʋ bɩ wʋcheeli kɛnɛ.

english_verse: because they worship and serve the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Nɩdosunuŋ deemba dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ wuo mʋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ a dɛnnɛ ʋ-na Jekɔb Wɩa.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ boi-baalaa suri, má suri boi-bɩnɩa-la, dɩ kuoru-balɩŋ kʋ jʋʋ.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa kuoru-balɩŋ deeŋ? Ʋ nɛ ŋaa La Tɩɩna, Nɩɩ-la sɩ dolie a ŋaa laalɩyuori-duo.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ boi-baalɩŋ suri, má suri boi-bɩnɩa-la, dɩ kuoru-balɩŋ kʋ jʋʋ.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa kuoru-balɩŋ deeŋ? Ʋ nɛ ŋaa La Tɩɩna, doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, ʋ nɛ ŋaa kuoru-balɩŋ.

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa kala hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩ laaŋ dii nɛ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diimi, sɩ́ leŋe mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diimi.

english_verse: Don't disappoint any of your worshipers, but disappoint all deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ŋ lɛ, hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ diiba. Ama hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, kɛŋ ŋ wombiee dagɛmɛ, a leŋ dɩ mɩ jɩmba.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Dagɛmɛ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ Wɩa, Nɩɩ-la sɩ laamɛ ta. Bʋa na-kala mɩ yɩɛlaa yie hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, liise yi ŋ chonuŋ sɩ yʋga arɩ ŋ sɩ faasa fá nɩaa nenige ŋɩɩ faafaa kala.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: Joŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa mɩ hambiiriŋ lɛ a chɛmɛ. A tɩŋ ŋ chonuŋ arɩ ŋ zile wɩaa, liisi mɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ŋaa tʋɔpʋla Tɩɩna nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋʋ dagɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa ʋ wombii-la sɩ maga dɩ ba to.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri sɩpaaŋ, a dagɛba dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ aŋ tuto ʋ wombiiŋ.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, wɩɩ na-kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa lɛ, chonuŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ŋ kɛŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to nii-la sɩ hɛ ŋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, tɩŋ ŋ yɩrɩŋ wɩaa a joŋ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛmɛ, ba lɔrɔ kieli.

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, ʋ jaŋ dagɛba wombii-la sɩ maga dɩ ba to.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala ba jaŋ dʋa kɩaa yʋgɛ, ka dɩ ba doho nɩaa ma laa tinteeŋ tɩɩ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ toŋ nandɔŋ nɛ. Ŋ leŋe ba kala jɩŋ nii-la sɩ hɛ ŋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩɩ beŋ ŋ lɛ nɛ bʋa na-kala. Pɛ mɩ lɛ, a lɩɩsɛmɛ bɛrɛ kala lɛ.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Beŋ mɩ sɩaa lɛ aŋ fá mɩ nenige. Wɩaa jʋʋmɛ nɛ, ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Mɩ wʋwalɩmaa pʋŋa pɛ nɛ. Laamɛ ta mɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Beŋ mɩ wʋwalɩmɩa-la arɩ mɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ aŋ joŋ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala chɛmɛ.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Bee na mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ chaasa bɛrɛmɛ.

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Mɩ kʋ yuoruŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ pɔmɛ. Laamɛ ta, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diimi.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ toŋ nɛ arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala, a laa dii arɩ ŋ jaŋ laamɛ ta.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: La Wɩa, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta ba wʋwalɩmaa kala lɛ.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, leŋ dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye. La Tɩɩna, mɩ laaŋ dii nɛ, mɩ bɩ begili.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, magɩsɛmɛ a na, a jɩŋ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa, a jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ naga.

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: Mɩ yie liisi ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa nɛ, a tuto ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la bʋa kala lɛ.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ wʋnyɩɛraa tʋɔŋ ka guoli. Mɩ dɩ kanfugi tɩŋŋaa ma bɩ wɩɩ pɛ.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ sɔmɔ lɩɩsɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ nɛ, a dagɛ arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye, aŋ dɛnnɩŋ gugolli ŋ koruŋ,

english_verse: while gratefully singing about your wonders.
translation_verse: a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa aa lɔllʋŋ, aŋ pɛ bʋbʋl wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩ cho ŋ dɩa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ hɛ nɛ woruŋ, lee-la ŋ tʋla sɩ chaana.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Sɩ́ mɩ dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ chei hɛ dɔŋɔ, sɩ́ mɩ dɩ nɩkpʋʋraa chei hɛ dɔŋɔ,

english_verse: or full of meanness or who bribe others.
translation_verse: nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bʋa-kala lɛ aa laa kpalaa.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ nɛ, fá mɩ nenige aŋ laamɛ ta.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ-na chɩna nɛ kpaŋkpaŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɩaa nɛ hilime a yʋgɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa mɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ arɩ mɩ Laataara, mɩ bɩ kʋŋkala ka fá. La Tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa mɩ dɩ-duoŋ, mɩ bɩ nʋʋkala ka fá.

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ gollimi a wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ, dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩɩ yuomi, ba jaŋ gɛrɛ tel.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoroo jaŋ wuo gollimi, ama fawʋllʋŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛmmɛ. Laalɩŋ ma jaŋ wuo sii mɩ nyuŋ, ama mɩ jaŋ laaŋ dii.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Wʋbala nɛ mɩ chɩchɛ ŋ teeŋ mɩ Tɩɩna. Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ mɩ hɛ ŋ dɩa lɛ tapʋlɩɩ-kala mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ a bɩbagɩsɛ ŋ zɔmʋŋ aŋ chʋchʋɔlʋŋ.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋmɛ tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ, ŋ jaŋ pɔmɛ. Ŋ jaŋ kɛmmɛ faa ŋ lɛbɩŋ tʋɔŋ, a jommi sagɛ bʋŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo yuo dii mɩ dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ gollimi, aŋ jʋʋ ŋ lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ a kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a jʋɔsa ŋaa goŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, dɩ mɩ nɛ sʋlʋŋ, jegile nɩɩ, a fá mɩ nenige a laa mɩ sʋla.

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ mɩ chʋɔlʋŋ. Mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ chʋɔlʋŋ.

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ŋ tɩtɩa kaa faamɛ. Sɩ́ baanɩŋ na a kiri mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna ta. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ Wɩa arɩ mɩ Laataara, sɩ́ mɩ vɩa ta.

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nyɩmma arɩ mɩ naaŋ nɛ paala vɩamɛ ta ma, ŋ-na La Tɩɩna jaŋ beŋ mɩ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, dagɛmɛ ŋ wombiiŋ. Kɛmmɛ to wombii-la sɩ tʋʋla, a tɩŋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ba sɩ cho mɩ lɛ. Nɩaa nyɩɛ wɩaa a pɩpɩmɛ nɛ a chaasa fufugisimi.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ laa dii arɩ mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a na La Tɩɩna wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ la sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ yɩɛlaa a gbɛrɛ La Tɩɩna. Má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ a gbɛrɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ, ŋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ bʋŋ. Sɩ́ chɩm ŋaa mɩ teeŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ tɔrɛ ŋ niiŋ, mɩ ma jaŋ pɛ lɛlɛɛ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ nɩsaa je nɛ a chaasɛ ŋ dɩa-la sɩ zɔmɔ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, a sʋsʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ fá mɩ nenige. Jegile nɩɩ mɩ nii-ŋmobo.

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ mɩ kaa pɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ a kirimi ta, nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl wʋsɩŋŋaa aŋ bɩbɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Ba sɩpaaŋ tuo wɩalɩŋ ŋ-na La Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa lɛ, arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ ta. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, cheiba dɩ ba lɛl a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ dɛnnɩŋ nɛ La Tɩɩna a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa mɩ sʋla a fá mɩ nenige.

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ doluŋ a nagɛ hɔɔtaala-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ a tɔmɛ. Mɩ laaŋ dii nɛ, ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ mɩ jʋjʋɔsɛ. Mɩ jaŋ lɔllʋŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ pɩ ŋ nɩaa doluŋ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa kuoru-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa dɩɩ-duoŋ a laaʋ ta.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Laa ŋ nɩaa ta a pɛ ba lɛ. Ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ ba nyuŋ, dɩ ba hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Ma Wɩa tɩndaaraa kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ, má zil La Tɩɩna, má zilu a tɩŋ ʋ tʋla arɩ ʋ doluŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Má zil La Tɩɩna yɩrɩ-balɩŋ. Má kpɩɛrɛ ma tɩtɩa a dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ tʋla.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna yikoro dɔmɔ nɛ mʋgʋ-balaa nyuŋ. La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ tʋla kpɩa goŋ nɛ mʋgʋ-balaa nyuŋ a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ kpɩa.

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna yikoro kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ, ʋ yikoro ŋaa babiibal yikoro nɛ.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna yikoro-la ka bori kuolu-tɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, a paala bori kuolusuŋ sɩ hɛ Lɛbanɔŋ peele-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: Wɩa leŋe Lɛbanɔŋ peel-la sii fɩl nɛ a nagɛ nɛ-bie, a leŋ peel-la ma ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛmɔŋ fɩl a nagɛ baga nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna yikoro leŋe taŋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: Ʋ yikoro-la yie leŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ zigili nɛ. La Tɩɩna yikoro leŋe tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la sɩ kpagɛ Kadɛs zigili nɛ.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna yikoro leŋe tɩɩ-balaa golibi nɛ, aŋ leŋ duuŋ tɩɩsɩŋ pɩpaarɩŋ kala yuori. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ ŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “Wɩa nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɩɩ beŋ lɩɩraa kala. Ʋ nɛ kuoro a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ joŋ doluŋ a pɩ ʋ nɩaa, a pɛ ba lɛ ba hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ, mɩ fa chɩŋ sʋʋŋ naaŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ laamɛ ta. Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ wuo na wombiiŋ a jʋɔsɛ mɩ sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ nɛ a pɩŋ dɩ ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ vaarɛmɛ,

english_verse: saving me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: a lɩɩsɛmɛ sʋʋŋ lɛ, mɩ bɩ sʋʋŋ bʋa jʋa.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa La Tɩɩna nɩaa, má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnʋ. Má dɛnnɛ ʋ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ baanɩŋ nɛ sie, ʋ bɩ dieni. Ama ʋ chonuŋ-na bɩ dɛrɛ. Ŋ jaŋ wuo yel tɩtaŋɩŋ, ama taŋ jaŋ pʋpʋl dɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ bɩra kɔ.

english_verse: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ fa sɩ bɩ mɩ jʋa, mɩ sɩ, “Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛmmɛ jigisi.”

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ fa sɩ chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ, ŋɩɩ leŋe mɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ peel-duoŋ nɛ. Ama ŋ sɩ joŋ harɩŋ a yɩamɛ, fawʋllʋŋ chaasa kɛmmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ mɩ yɩrɛ, a sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ fá mɩ nenige.

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ sʋba, bɛɛ nyʋʋrɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ na? Dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩrɩmɛ hagɩla, ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo bɩra ŋaa a dɛnnɩŋ a dagɛ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ?

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe mɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ bɩrɩmɛ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ mɩ gʋgʋa. Ŋ wuri mɩ tʋɔ-chei gɛrɩŋ ta nɛ aŋ joŋ tʋɔtɔrɛ gɛrɩŋ laalɛmɛ,

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: dɩ mɩ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɩŋ arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala a sɩ́ leŋ. Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, mɩ jaŋ lɔllʋŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ mɩ yuori, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diimi. Ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, laamɛ ta.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Jegile nɩɩ mɩ sʋla a kʋ laamɛ ta lɩma. Ŋaa mɩ dɩ-duoŋ, a laamɛ ta.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Ŋ nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ, a ŋaa mɩ dɩ-duoŋ. Laa mɩ sɩpaaŋ a dagɛmɛ wombiiŋ a tɩŋ ŋ yɩrɩŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛmɛ bɛrɛ-la ba sɩ bɛrɛ bil mɩ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ nɛ mɩ yuori.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa kala a hɩhɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, ŋ nɛ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, laamɛ ta.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to vʋɩyaa sɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩba nɛ, ama mɩ-na laaŋ dii nɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ mɩ jʋjʋɔsɛ a tɩŋ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ chomi. Ŋ na mɩ hɛɛŋ nɛ a jɩŋ mɩ wʋjʋʋlaa ma lɛ.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ leŋe mɩ jʋʋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ, ama ŋ pɩmɛ wombiiŋ nɛ mɩ gʋgɔllɛ pʋlʋŋ-jaala lɛ.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, fá mɩ nenige, hɛɛŋ jʋʋmɛ nɛ. Mɩ yele nɛ, mɩ sɩaa kala gʋɔlɛ, a bɩra bɩ na woruŋ. Mɩ kala nɛ bɛsɩmɛ.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kala ŋaa tʋɔ-cheeŋ nɛ, mɩ nɩna hɛɛŋ jɩna na-kala. Tʋɔ-chee-la leŋ mɩ pʋgʋmɛ, mɩ haŋgbelee ma bɩra bɩ dol.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɛ kɛmmɛ ŋmuŋmoo gbɛɛŋ, a wasa nyaŋ mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jʋʋ kpɩkpagɛ dɔŋɔ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩmmɛ mɩɩra fɩfámɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ na mɩ wombiiŋ lɛ, ba gɛbɛ.

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: Ba yʋ mɩ wɩaa a nagɛ nɩa sɩ sʋba nɛ. Mɩ nagɛ pupoi-kpaaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yʋga a bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ aa tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ, fawʋllʋŋ kala nɛ kɛmmɛ. Baa vʋʋrɛ mɩ wɩaa nɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ laaŋ dii nɛ mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Laamɛ ta mɩ dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ pɩpɩŋ nɛ mɩ Tɩɩna, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diimi, ama leŋ dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ dii hɩɩsɩŋ a mʋ lɛlɩŋ.

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ wʋnyɩɛra-la niiŋ jʋʋ kpʋrʋŋ. Ba yie bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ a bʋl babiibal wɩaa a tʋtʋʋsɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Ŋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ yʋga, ba nɛ ŋ joŋo bil nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fáŋ lɛ. Ba nɛ ŋ joŋo pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋ yuoruŋ, ka nɩaa bibeŋ.

english_verse: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛmba faa nɛ ŋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ joŋo ŋaa ba lɛ. Ŋ pɔba nɛ, ba wiesi nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tʋʋsɛba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋ chonuŋ mɩ teeŋ, bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ yuomi a nagɛ ba sɩ gollo yuyuo taŋ.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛmmɛ nɛ mɩ bɩɩnɛ arɩ ŋ kirimi ta nɛ ŋ sɩpaaŋ. Ama ŋ nɩɩ mɩ nii-ŋmobo nɛ mɩ sɩ yɩrɩŋ dɩ ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa La Tɩɩna nɩaa, má chou. La Tɩɩna ka pɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, aŋ chaasa dʋdɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ sɩ maga.

english_verse: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa La Tɩɩna lɛ, má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩ joŋ nɩalɩŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba, a kɛŋ ba wʋcheelee faa, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ La Tɩɩna sɩ bee kieli arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ nɩaa ka nyɩsɛ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩ vɩa dɩ mɩ dagɛ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, mɩ yele nɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la kala, a kala bɛsɩmɛ.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Ŋ walɩmɛmɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala nɛ, mɩ doluŋ kala dɛrɛ a nagɛ tafaaŋ wulumuŋ sɩ leŋe leriŋ hɩl.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ dagɛ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ pɩ La Tɩɩna.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ dagɛ ba kala pɩŋ a bɩ kaa faaŋ. Ŋ joŋ ba kala chɛmɛ.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ to La Tɩɩna maga dɩ ba sʋlʋ nɛ dɩ hɛɛŋ nɛ jʋʋba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wʋjʋʋlaa nɛ paala yʋgɛ a kʋkɔ ma, dɩ ba sɩ́ ba yi.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Ŋ lɛ nɛ mɩ faa. Ŋ jaŋ pɔmɛ, dɩ wɩaa sɩ́ mɩ jʋʋ. Mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ laamɛ ta wɩaa.

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: Ŋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mɩ jaŋ chagɩlɩŋ a dagɩŋ wombii-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ to, aŋ bibeniŋ.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Sɩ́ nɩyaarɩ ŋaa a nagɛ jaaba koo kakumo sɩ bɩ wɩaa sɩaa jɩŋ. Ba joŋ koŋ hɛ ʋ niiŋ koo ŋmɛnɩŋ vɔɔ a kɛnʋ dɩdagɛ wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋ doho kala jaŋ jʋʋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ, ama La Tɩɩna chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ jaŋ chu tɔ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laaʋ dii.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa, má yɩɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ yɩɩlaa a pɩ La Tɩɩna. Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ a maga dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Má du cheŋ a dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Má du kɔnɛ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa hɛ a dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩl-falɩŋ pʋ, a du kɩaa woruŋ a ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna cho tʋɔpʋla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ su dʋnɩa sɛmɛ kala nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna wʋbʋlaa lɛ nɛ wɩa-nyuŋ to a hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ wʋbʋlaa nɛ ŋaa kɩalɩŋ kala hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala, má fá La Tɩɩna, dʋnɩa nɩaa kala, má zilu.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl wɩaa nɛ dʋnɩa hɛ nɩmɛ, ʋ wʋbʋlaa nɛ leŋe tinteeŋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Ama wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna-na sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ ŋaa jaŋ chɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa jaŋ chɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Tintee kala nɩaa sɩɩ to La Tɩɩna, jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Nɩalɩŋ ma ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa ba ŋaa ʋ nɩaa jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ bee nɩna nuhuobiinee kala.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: Ʋ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ a bibeŋ tinteeŋ nyuŋ nɩaa kala.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ ŋaa nuhuobiine tʋɔŋ, ʋ jɩŋ wɩɩkala la sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
