translation_verse: Kuoro laalɩyuoroo sɩ yʋga kɩŋkɛŋ dee bɩ jaŋ laaʋ ta. Laalɩyuori babii-balɩŋ ma doluŋ bɩ ʋ wuo laa ta.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa hɛ laalɩyuori janɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba laaŋ ta. Ba doluŋ cho dɩ ba magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ma, ba bɩ jaŋ wuo laaŋ ta.

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Ama La Tɩɩna nɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ fáʋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ʋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ lɛ.

english_verse: He protects them from death and starvation.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ laaba ta sʋʋŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a pɔ dɩ losuŋ sɩ́ ba kpʋ.

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: La joŋ la yɩɛlaa hɛ La Tɩɩna lɛ nɛ, ʋ nɛ chu tɔla a pɩpɛ la lɛ.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: La tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ La Tɩɩna nyuŋ nɛ. La joŋ la yɩɛlaa hɛ ʋ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnʋ a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa, a leŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ nɩɩ, dɩ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Má pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ la dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, má leŋ la gbaara yɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: Mɩ sʋl La Tɩɩna nɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, ʋ nɩɩ a lɩɩsɛmɛ wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ leŋe fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Má joŋ ma wɩɩkala hɛ La Tɩɩna nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma chaanɛ a nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ. Hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ diima.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa bɩ nʋʋ ŋaa, ama mɩ sɩ sʋl La Tɩɩna, ʋ laamɛ ta nɛ mɩ wʋjʋʋlaa kala lɛ.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, Wɩa tɩndaara nɩɩ pɔba aa lɩɩsɛba ba wʋjʋʋlaa kala lɛ.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Má chɛ a na ŋɩɩ La Tɩɩna sɩ kɛŋ zile. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ mʋ yuoru yie kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa La Tɩɩna nɩaa, má fáʋ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna bɩ kʋŋkala chɛɛ ka.

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Losuŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ naachigee dɩ ba pʋgʋmɛ, ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to La Tɩɩna bɩ kʋzɔŋ kala chɛɛ ka.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ biiriŋ, má kɔ mɩ teeŋ a jegile nɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ dagɛma ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ zil La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho dɩ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩ-duduoŋ a nɩɩ sɩma ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: tɩɩna sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bʋl a sɩ́ wɩaa ma nyɩnyɩa.

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, a fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ chɩchɛ dɩ nii-maga hɛ ŋ dɩ nɩaa pɛgɛ.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩaa pɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ, a jegilee nɩɩ ba nii-ŋmobo.

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa joŋ ʋ harɩŋ yɩa wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nɛ, ʋ jaŋ tii paa ba kala tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ ba yɩrɩŋ lɛl.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋmoo niiŋ pɩ La Tɩɩna dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ, ʋ yie nɩɩ nɛ, a lɩɩsɛba ba wʋjʋʋlaa kala lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna kpagɛ nɩalɩŋ nandaasɩŋ sɩ yʋɔra nɛ. Ʋ laa nɩalɩŋ bɩra sɩ bɩ yɩɛlaa kɛnɛ ta nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Wʋwalɩmaa jaŋ wuo yʋgɛ a jʋʋ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa, ama La Tɩɩna nɛ yie laaba ta wɩalɩŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɩɩ beŋ ba haŋgbelee nyuŋ ba kʋbala ma bɩ jaŋ bori.

english_verse: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔmɔ-la nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩɩ ŋaa tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ gʋra kpʋba. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa cho, ba jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩba.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ laa ʋ tɩntɩnnaa tɩta. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ fá mʋ yuoru, ʋ bɩ jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩba.

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ ŋ timiŋ arɩ ŋ laalɩyuori kɩaa je nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kirimi lɛ. Hɛ niiŋ pɩmɛ arɩ ŋ jaŋ laamɛ ta.

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ dii hɩɩsɩŋ. Kiri nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba ŋaamɛ wʋbɔŋ ta, dɩ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa vʋgʋmɛ.

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, leŋ dɩ ŋ tɩndaara kikiri nɩbɔmɔ-la, dɩ ba nagɛ mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ peliŋ sɩ paa vɩvɛŋ.

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba wombiiŋ kɛŋ birimiŋ aŋ pɛ sɩsɩɛrɛ, ka dɩ Wɩa tɩndaara kire tuto ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa ba lɛ, ka ba hɛ bɛrɛ a bil mɩ lɛ. Ba lu buotuo-luŋuŋ ma bil mɩ lɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ tuu dɩ ba kɛmmɛ kpʋ.

english_verse: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ guu ŋaa dɩ ba lɛ. Leŋ dɩ ba tɩtɩa bɛrɛ-la gʋra kɛmba, a leŋ dɩ ba tɩtɩa gʋra tuu buotuo-luŋii-la ba sɩ luo a sʋʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa, mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ La Tɩɩna nyuŋ, dɩ mɩ jʋɔsɛ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ laamɛ ta wɩaa.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋl arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nagɛ La Tɩɩna? Ŋ nɛ yie laa puwuoloo ta nɩduoruŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba sɩ́ summoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ kɩaa kaa laa arɩ doluŋ.”

english_verse: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kʋ lɩɩ nɛ a nyɩɛ wɩaa pɩmɛ, a mʋ tɩgɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩ paala bɩ jɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a tiŋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ chɩmɩŋ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ nagɛ mɩ bɩ nʋʋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: Ama bʋa-la lɛ ba fa sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ, mɩ laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ nɛ a kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa muuri a vɔɔ niiŋ aŋ sʋl Wɩa pɩba,

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: a nagɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ jaŋ sʋl Wɩa pɩ mɩ nandɔŋɔ koo mɩ naambie. Mɩ tʋɔŋ cheye nɛ mɩ yel a nagɛ mɩ sɩɩ yel mɩ naaŋ yoho.

english_verse: Worthless people make fun and never stop laughing.
translation_verse: Ba nagɛ nɩtɔɔnʋŋ nɛ a sieri mɩ lɛ, a mɔmmɛ a bɩ leŋ aŋ gɩgɩɛnɛmɛ.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ beŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ a diene magɛ? Laamɛ ta ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ, laa mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ pɩmɛ naachigee deemba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, dɩ ŋ nɩaa nɛ yʋga a hilimi ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ a lɔllʋŋ ba kala sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jʋɔsɛ mɩ nyuŋ. Mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye, ka ba bɛrɛmɛ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba dierimi.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: Baa bʋl tʋɔ-cheeri wɩaa nɛ, a nyɩɛ wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔnɔ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Ba joŋ cheeriŋ pɩmɛ a bʋl, “Ahaa, la sɩɩŋ na wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa nɛ.”

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ tɩtɩa na wɩalɩŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa sɩ́ ŋ niiŋ tɔrʋ. La Tɩɩna sɩ́ dɩ-bolii hɛ.

english_verse: Fight to defend me, Lord God,
translation_verse: Sii doŋ lɛ a laamɛ. La Tɩɩna Wɩa, yuo laamɛ ta.

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna mɩ Wɩa, ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa laa wɩɩ-la a jɩma pɩmɛ a dagɛ arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba jʋɔsɛ mɩ nyuŋ.

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba bʋl ba tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Ahaa, lɛɛlɛ la na wɩɩ-la la sɩɩ chɛ nɛ,” koo a bʋl, “La kɛnʋ liŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ jʋɔsɛ ŋɩɩ wɩaa sɩ jʋʋ mɩ lɛ dii hɩɩsɩŋ, dɩ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa vʋgʋmɛ. Jolimi nɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩ bene arɩ ba kpɩamɛ nɛ, leŋ dɩ ba dii hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ cho dɩ mɩ laa kʋsɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ba ŋaa goŋ a jʋjʋɔsɛ. Leŋ dɩ ba bʋl bʋa kala lɛ, “La Tɩɩna nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala. Ʋ tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ nɛ dɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna wɩaa nɩɩ vɛŋ woruŋ.”

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ suri mɩ niiŋ a bʋl ŋ tʋɔpʋl wɩaa aŋ dɛnnɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la kala.

english_verse: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ Wɩa ka fá, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ba bɩbɩɩnɛ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: Ba dagɛ ba tɩtɩa kikieli arɩ ba sɩ jaŋ bɛrɛ ba tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ koo a bee naba.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Baa bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ aa nyɩsɛ nɩaa, a bɩra bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ dɩ baa ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ paala pɩŋ ma, ba yie bɩbɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, a joŋ ba nyuŋ kala hɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la ŋaanɩŋ lɛ, a bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ ka leŋ.

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ teeli wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ, ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ ma yi lee-la duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ tʋɔpʋla leŋie a magɛ peel-balaa nɛ, ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ ma luŋ a magɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ. Ŋ nɩɩ beŋ nuhuobiinee arɩ pʋsʋŋ kala.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ. Nɩbalaa arɩ nɩbiisiŋ kala hɛ ŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, ŋ chu tɔba.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: Ŋ pɩba kʋdii-daŋ nɛ ŋ dɩa lɛ, a pɩba kʋnyʋalaa yʋgɛ a nagɛ fuoŋ sɩɩ pɛllʋ.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: Mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɩɩ ŋ teeŋ nɛ. Ŋ nɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ, ŋɩɩ leŋ la ma na pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Ha cho nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩmɩŋ, a ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ kʋ yuomi koo dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kirimi dɩ mɩ fá.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Bee na nɩbɔmɔ-la. Ba tele nɛ, a bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo sii.

english_verse: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ wʋŋaalaa walɩmɩŋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ yaraa bibieri nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Laa La Tɩɩna dii a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ hɔŋ sɔm.

english_verse: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ La Tɩɩna nyuŋ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ wʋchɛɛlɛɛ kala pɩŋ.

english_verse: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
translation_verse: Joŋ ŋ wʋŋaalaa kala a hɛ La Tɩɩna nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Laaʋ dii, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔpʋla chaanɛ a nagɛ taŋ sɩ pʋla, a leŋ dɩ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ ma nagɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
translation_verse: Dii kenyiri a gbɛrɛ La Tɩɩna. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩaa walɩmɩŋ dɩ nɩaa wɩaa nɩɩ vɛŋ woruŋ, koo dɩ nɩaa nɛ wuo ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ.

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ lɛl, ama dɩ ŋ nɛ laa La Tɩɩna dii, tintee-la jaŋ ŋaa ŋ kʋŋ.

english_verse: Sinners will soon disappear, never to be found,
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni, wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa kala jaŋ lɛl. Ŋ jaŋ bee chɛba, a chɛ ka.

english_verse: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ tintee-la a hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ sii chɩŋ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ a gɩgɩɛnɛba.

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: Ama La Tɩɩna ka mɔŋ nɩbɔmɔ-la nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ jɩma arɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ cheiba kpaga nɛ.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ chaarɛ tokobiee nɛ a lɛrɛ ba tosuŋ hɛ, dɩ ba kpʋ summoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: Ama ba tɩtɩa tokobie-la nɛ jaŋ gʋra kpʋba, ka dɩ ba tosuŋ ma bori.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Mʋa-la tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna sɩ kɛnɛ nɛ kpɩa nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kʋ-daŋ-la ba sɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: Dol-la nɩbɔmʋŋ sɩ kɛnɛ jaŋ guu dɛrɛ. Ama La Tɩɩna jaŋ joŋ doluŋ pɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna.

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to La Tɩɩna niiŋ, ʋʋ bemba nɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala. Kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩba jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: Dɩ wʋlɔrʋŋ nɛ jʋa, ba bɩ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ, dɩ kʋdiilee ma nɛ nyaa, ba-na jaŋ kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ sʋʋ. La Tɩɩna dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nagɛ tɩɩfɩɩlaa sɩ hɛ baga lɛ nɛ. Ba jaŋ nyɩɩgɛ, a nyɩɩgɛ a nagɛ nyʋɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ nɛ chɩŋ kʋŋ, ʋ bɩ tiŋ, ama tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-na kɛŋ zile a pɩpɩ nɩaa kɩaa.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ lɛ La Tɩɩna sɩ pɛ nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ tintee-la. Ama nɩalɩŋ lɛ ʋ sɩ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ, ʋ jaŋ keriba ta.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna sɩ cho, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wɩɩ na-kala tɩɩna sɩɩ ŋaa chaasa chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ gɛrɛ ma, ʋ bɩ jaŋ tel, bɛɛ wɩaa La Tɩɩna kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɛsa nɛ lɛɛlɛ, ama a chɩŋ mɩ bapʋɔsʋŋ kala lɛ, mɩ ha bɩ na dɩ La Tɩɩna vɩa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna ta koo a leŋ ʋ biiriŋ sʋsʋl kʋdiilee.

english_verse: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
translation_verse: Ba yie joŋ kɩaa didii zile nɩaa lɛ nɛ aŋ joŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma chɩchɩŋ nɩaa. Ba biiriŋ ma jaŋ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ sɩma.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ hɛ tintee-la lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna cho nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ vɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laaʋ dii ta. Ʋ yie chu tɔ ba lɛ nɛ bʋa na-kala, ama ʋ jaŋ keri nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ doho nɩaa ta.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ tintee-la a hɛ ʋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ hɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wʋbʋlaa lɛ. Ʋʋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ.

english_verse: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
translation_verse: Wombii-la Wɩa sɩ bile dɩ la tuto hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, ʋ bɩ ʋ lɛ ka begili.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ yie bɩbagɩlɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa nɛ, a chɩchɛ wombiiŋ dɩ ba kpʋba.

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: Ama La Tɩɩna bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba jʋʋ nɩbɔmɔ-la nɩsɩŋ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba joŋ cheeriŋ pɩba sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
translation_verse: Gbɛrɛ La Tɩɩna a tuto ʋ wombiiŋ. Ʋ jaŋ ziliŋ a joŋ tinteeŋ pɩŋ, aŋ keri nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ ta ŋ sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ mɩ na nɩbɔmʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔhɛɛŋ a waayi a nagɛ tɩa sɩ chɩŋ dɩ-zɔmʋŋ a waayi.

english_verse: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ bɩ diene aŋ sʋʋ, mɩ beŋ a chɛʋ ka.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Bɩɩna yi nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ lɛ, aŋ bee na nɩalɩŋ ma wʋŋaalaa sɩ tʋʋla. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho dɩ nɩaa kɛŋ nii-maga, ba chie yie zɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kala jaŋ sʋʋ, ba dɩ ba doho nɩaa bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ chie.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa Laataara. Dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋba, ʋ nɛ ba dɩ-duoŋ.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɩɩ pɛ ba lɛ. Ʋ nɛ laaba tɩta nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fá mʋ yuoru nɛ.

english_verse: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, sɩ́ baanɩŋ na a dɔgɩsɛmɛ koo a lɛrɛ mɩ dɩgɩlɩŋ arɩ baanɩŋ.

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: Ŋ pɩrɩmɛ nɛ arɩ ŋ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ aŋ ŋmoomi lo arɩ ŋ nɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: Ŋ baanɩŋ leŋe mɩ bɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa kɛnɛ. Mɩ haŋgbelee ma kala wʋwɩɩ a tɩŋ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: Mɩ yaraa kala ŋaa naawɩɩlaa nɛ a verigi a pʋa sʋsʋɔrɛ, a tɩŋ nɩyaarɩ wʋbɔŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ nyagɛmɛ gʋrɛ nɛ, mɩ bɩra bɩ lee kɛnɛ, mɩ chaasa yel nɛ woruŋ tapʋl-pilimiŋ kala.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: Mɩ yaraa kala nɛ lɩma a wʋwɩɩ, mɩ bɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: Mɩ yaraa kala nɛ yʋɔra a bɩra bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ faasa chei mɩ huhuuni.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ. Mɩ huuno-la bɩ faa ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɔyɛ ka joŋ nɛ, mɩ yaraa kala yʋɔrɛ. Mɩ sɩaa ma bɩra bɩ woruŋ ka na.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: Mɩ nandɔnsʋŋ arɩ mɩ toori-dɔsʋŋ vɩamɛ ta nɛ, a tɩŋ mɩ naawɩɩlaa wɩaa. Mɩ pɛ-jʋʋraa ma bɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpagɛmɛ.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ cho dɩ mɩ sʋba, ba hɛ bɛrɩsɩŋ nɛ dɩ ba kɛmmɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ walɩmɛ dɩ ba ŋaamɛ wʋbɔŋ ka bʋl mɩ cheyiŋ wɩaa nɛ. Ba vʋʋrɛ mɩ wɩaa nɛ tapʋl-pilimiŋ kala.

english_verse: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
translation_verse: Ama mɩ nagɛ taŋɩŋ nɛ, mɩ bɩ wɩaa ka nɩɩ, mɩ bɩ wɩaa maa bʋl.

english_verse: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Mɩ chaasa nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa ka nɩɩ nɛ, a bɩ wɩaa ma wuo laa bʋl.

english_verse: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩɩ gbɛrɩŋ nɛ, mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, mɩ jɩma ŋ jaŋ laa mɩ sʋla.

english_verse: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ, “Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jʋɔsɛ mɩ nyuŋ, koo a bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ sɩara.”

english_verse: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
translation_verse: Mɩ chaasa na hɛɛŋ nɛ a chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ tel.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: Mɩ dagɛ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ pɩŋ nɛ, ba wɩaa ka walɩmɛmɛ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, sɩ́ mɩ vɩa ta, sɩ́ dɩ-bolii hɛ mɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ mɩ Laataara, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, kʋ laamɛ ta lɩma.

english_verse: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa woruŋ a sɩ́ wɩaa bʋla laa cheeriŋ. Mɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ mɩ niiŋ dɩ mɩ nɛ hɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
translation_verse: Mɩ tɔrɛ mɩ niiŋ ŋɩɩ ma nɛ, mɩ bɩ wɩɩ bʋla, ka mɩ tʋɔŋ ha faasa chei.

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩɩ dii nɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛŋ wɩaa chɔgɩsɛ na-kala, ʋ yie nagɛ nyiŋ-la faasaa dii nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ walɩma ka aŋ pɩɛsɛ,

english_verse: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kui nɛ, ʋ bɩ kʋŋkala ŋaa ŋ teeŋ. Nuhuobiiŋ kala mɩɩsɩŋ bɩ wɩɩ maga.

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: Ʋ nagɛ daaliimiŋ nɛ, ʋ bɩ diene aŋ lɩlɛl. Nuhuobiine lɔlʋŋ kala ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ, ʋ yie chɛ kɩaa bil aŋ bɩ jɩŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ dii kɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ yɩɛlaa hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ bɩra bɩ kʋŋ dɔŋ ka chɛ.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛmɛ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala lɛ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩyaaraa sieri mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: Mɩ tɔrɛ mɩ niiŋ nɛ, mɩ bɩ wɩɩ bʋla, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩɩ na hɛɛŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
translation_verse: Bɩra sɩ́ mɩ dɔgɩsʋ, ŋ ŋmoomi nɛ, mɩ chɩchɛ mɩ sʋʋ.

english_verse: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
translation_verse: Ŋ dɔgɩsɛla kɩŋkɛŋ a tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Ŋ nagɛ mʋgʋlʋŋ nɛ a chei kɩalɩŋ la sɩ faasa cho. Nuhuobiine kala nagɛ peliŋ nɛ.

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: “Mɩ Tɩɩna, jegile nɩɩ mɩ sʋla, mɩ yele nɛ a sʋsʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ. Sɩ́ fʋʋla yagɛmɛ. Mɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ a nagɛ nʋhʋɔrʋ nɛ, arɩ mɩ naabalɩmaba fa sɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔra ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Bɩra sɩ́ baanɩŋ na mɩ nyuŋ, leŋ dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ bɩra tɔrɛ, ka dɩ mɩ na sʋʋ a mʋ.”

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: Mɩ nyalɩma nɛ a gbɛrɛ La Tɩɩna dɩ ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jegile nɩɩ mɩ bunso.

english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: Ʋ lɛrɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ buotuo-luŋuŋ sɩɩ sɩɛrʋ lɛ nɛ, a kɛmmɛ lɩɩsɛ vʋchɔɔŋ lɛ a jɩla bil bʋŋ nyuŋ, mɩ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ʋ dagɛmɛ yɩɩl-falɩŋ nɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ yɩɩ a dɛnnʋ. Nɩ-daŋ jaŋ na a fá Wɩa, a laa La Tɩɩna dii.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa La Tɩɩna dii, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ. Ba bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ harɩŋ ka to, a bɩ vesiŋ maa kpaarɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, ŋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ yʋgɛ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ŋ ha sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa pɩla, nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛba. Dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chɛ mɩ dagɛba pɩ nɩaa, ba jaŋ yʋga kɩɩ dɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ pʋsʋ-la ba sɩ yie kpʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ nɛ cho. Ŋ bɩra bɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa ma nɩɩ chɛ. Ama ŋŋ chɛ dɩ mɩ jegile nɩɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa nɛ a toba.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Namɛ, mɩ kɔ nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil ŋ teniŋ tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ ŋ tʋɔpʋla wɩaa kaa fɩfaa. Mɩ yie leŋ nɩaa jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a laa nɩaa tɩta nɛ. Mɩ bɩ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ arɩ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ wɩaa joŋo faa ŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yʋga aa hilimi ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ sɩɩ fá mɩ nenige ŋɩɩ, sɩ́ leŋ. Leŋ dɩ ŋ chonuŋ arɩ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ pɔmɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: Mɩ wʋwalɩmaa yʋga a gollimi, mɩ bɩ ba wuo dɩɩsɛ. Mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ gollimi nɛ, mɩ bɩra bɩ na. Mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yʋga a kɩɩ mɩ nyu-pʋnaa, a leŋ mɩ nandaasɩŋ kala yʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, laamɛ ta, La Tɩɩna, guu kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ, dɩ ba wɩaa vʋgʋmɛ. Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ mɩɩra dii hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, “Just look at you now!”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sieri mɩ lɛ, leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diiba dɩ ʋ kperiba.

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Ama leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ toŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ nyuŋ dɩ ba jʋjʋɔsɛ. Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ cho ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ laaba ta bʋl bʋa na-kala lɛ, “La Tɩɩna nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala.”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ summo a bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ nɛ, ama ŋ bɩ mɩ wɩaa yʋa. Ŋ nɩɩ pɛ mɩ lɛ, ŋ nɛ mɩ Laataara. Mɩ Wɩa, guu kɔ, sɩ́ dienu.

english_verse: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ summoo nyuŋ woruŋ. Dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋba, ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsɛba.

english_verse: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ chu tɔba a leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ tintee-la lɛ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ jomba hɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɩɩ wɩɩlʋ, La Tɩɩna jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ba duori a kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ ŋ lɛ, fá mɩ nenige aŋ vaarɛmɛ.”

english_verse: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ. Baa chɛ dɩ mɩ sʋʋ nɛ, dɩ nɩaa yʋ mɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
translation_verse: Ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋʋ namɛ bɩ nɩfɩɛma ŋaa. Ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ka bʋl, aa bɩɩnɛ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ mɩ lɛ. Ba yie kʋ na mɩ wɩaa a kaa lɩɩ bʋla gaarɛ leriŋ kala.

english_verse: My enemies whisper about me. They think the worst,
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ munsoo bʋl mɩ wɩaa nɛ. Ba bɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ aa tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ, ba sɩ,

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: “Nyanyal-bɔŋ nɛ kɛnʋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ waa.”

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: Mɩ nandɔŋ-fɩɛmɩŋ mɩ sɩ laa dii, mɩ dɩ ʋ didii kɩaa, ma paala vɩamɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, fá mɩ nenige aŋ vaarɛmɛ, dɩ mɩ wuo tiŋ mɩ dʋndɔmɔ-la chɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ nɛ, mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ jaŋ wuo yuo diimi.

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: Ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ a leŋ mɩ hɛ ŋ sɩpaaŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa chei.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ sɩ yie kɛŋ aamɩŋ ʋ gɔllɔ chɩchɛ lɩɩŋ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ ma chɩchɛ ŋ-na Wɩa.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: Mɩ chaasa chɛ ŋ-na Wɩa sɩ weye nɛ woruŋ. Bʋa bɛɛ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ naŋ?

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Mɩ yele nɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala. Sɩlɩɩrɩŋ ŋaa mɩ kʋdiilee, ka nɩaa pɩpɩɛsɛmɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala, “Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ Wɩa hɛ?”

english_verse: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ yie faasa chei nɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ liise yi faafaa-la mɩ sɩ yie laa Wɩa nɩaa sɩpaaŋ a mʋmʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ la ŋaa goŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a lʋlɔllɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ wɩaa wʋwalɩmɛmɛ? Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa hɛ Wɩa lɛ, a bɩra dɛnnʋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ Laataara

english_verse: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
translation_verse: arɩ mɩ Wɩa. Dɩ mɩ nandaasɩŋ nɛ yʋɔra, mɩ yie liise yi wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa a chɩŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la lɛ a kaa mʋ yi peele-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛmɔŋ arɩ Mɩza lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
translation_verse: Ŋ lɩɩ-pel duoruŋ ŋmoo to mɩ nyuŋ bal a dɔmɔ nagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ sɩɩ chuuri buotuo-luŋuŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: Ŋ dagɛ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ mɩ lɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ, tɩtaŋɩŋ ma ŋ pɩmɛ yɩɩlɩŋ mɩ sɩ jaŋ yɩɩ a chʋɔlʋŋ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩɩ pɩmɛ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Mɩ pɩɛsɛ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa mɩ dɩ-duoŋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ yʋ mɩ wɩaa? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ leŋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ mɩ gɔllɔ baarɛ a yiyel?”

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Ba dɔgɩsɛmɛ nɛ mɩ haŋgbelee kala wʋwɩɩ, aŋ pɩpɩɛsɛmɛ bʋa na-kala, “Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ Wɩa hɛ?”

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ wɩaa wʋwalɩmɛmɛ? Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa hɛ Wɩa lɛ, a bɩra dɛnnʋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ Laataara arɩ mɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: La Wɩa, leŋ dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye, a chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩŋ ka to sɩ́ mɩ wuo. Laamɛ ta nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ wʋnyɩɛraa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ nɛ mɩ dɩ-duoŋ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ vɩamɛ ta? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ leŋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ mɩ gɔllɔ baarɛ a yiyel?

english_verse: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ arɩ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ kʋ laa mɩ sɩpaaŋ, a kɛmmɛ mʋ ŋ dɩa sɩ hɛ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ, lee-la ŋ sɩɩ jʋʋ.

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ mʋ ŋ-na Wɩa koru-la leriŋ a dɛnnɩŋ. Ŋ nɛ leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ mɩ jʋjʋɔsɛ. Ŋ nɛ mɩ Wɩa mɩ jaŋ du cheŋ a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ wɩaa wʋwalɩmɛmɛ? Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa hɛ Wɩa lɛ, a bɩra dɛnnʋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ Laataara arɩ mɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛŋ ŋ naduo-la nɛ kiri tinteyee nɩaa ta aŋ leŋ la naabalɩmaba hɔŋ ba tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋ leŋe wɩaa jʋʋ nɩalɩŋ nɛ, ka la naabalɩmaba dʋa woruŋ.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: Ba laalɩyuori kɩaa dee ba kaa yuo laa tintee-la, ba doluŋ ma dee ba kaa yuo dii. Ŋ choba nɛ tɩɩ ŋ kɛŋ ŋ naduoŋ arɩ ŋ tʋla pʋlʋmʋŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩba.

english_verse: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ mɩ kuoro arɩ mɩ Wɩa, ŋ nɛ leŋe ŋ nɩaa yuo laalɩŋ didii.

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Ŋ doluŋ lɛ nɛ la yuo dii la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, a nʋɔsɛba bil ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ mɩ yɩɛlaa joŋo hɛ mɩ toŋ arɩ mɩ tokobiiŋ lɛ nɛ, ba dee bɩ leŋe mɩ yuo dii.

english_verse: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ nɛ leŋe la yuo dii la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, a leŋ ba dii hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ nɛ la kaa ŋmoo bɔyɛ bʋa kala lɛ, la jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ ŋ vɩala ta nɛ a kɛnla muuri, ŋ bɩra bɩ la laalɩyuoroo sɩpaaŋ laa a kɛnla mʋmʋ laalɩŋ.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kirila nɛ, la fá, ka ba paa la kɩaa.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: Ŋ joŋ la ta nɛ ba kpʋla a nagɛ piesee, ŋ kɛnla pɩsa guoli tinteyee lɛ.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: Ŋ joŋ ŋ nɩaa yallɛ nɛ, aŋ bɩ nyʋʋrɩɩ kala na.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe la ŋaa mɔmɩa nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jʋʋ kpɩkpagɛla teeŋ. Tinteye-la sɩ gollila ma sisieri la lɛ.

english_verse: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kala hɩɩsɩŋ yie kɛmmɛ nɛ, mɩ bɩ mɩ sɩaa wuo kaa suri,

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: a tɩŋ mɩ dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩɩ sieri mɩ lɛ aŋ mʋmɔmmɛ, a joŋ ba baanɩŋ aa fɩɩsɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: La bɩ ŋ wɩaa yʋa koo a kɛŋ nii-la sɩ hɛ la dɩŋ pɛgɛ chei, ka wɩaa deemba kala ha ŋaa la lɛ.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: La tʋɔŋ kala hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ, la bɩ begile ŋ wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: Ka ŋ kirila ta la ŋaa nɩpɛɩba a guoli baga kɩaa tʋɔŋ a hɛ birimiŋ lim lɛ.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ fa yʋ ŋ wɩaa, aŋ kpʋkpaarɛ vesiŋ,

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: ŋ-na Wɩa fa jaŋ jɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ jɩŋ nuhuobiine tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala nɛ.

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kala nɛ la sʋsʋʋ ŋ wɩaa. La nagɛ piesee ba sɩ kaa lɩɩ dɩ ba kpʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: Sii doŋ lɛ, La Tɩɩna, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ pɩŋ? Sii, sɩ́ la vɩa ta deeŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa faala, a yʋ la wʋjʋʋlaa arɩ la hɛɛŋ wɩaa?

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Ba nyagɛla bil tinteeŋ nɛ, la yaraa kala ŋaa kʋŋkɔlʋŋ.

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Sii, a pɛ la lɛ, laala ta a tɩŋ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: Tʋɔbɩɩŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ mɩ kaa yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ deeŋ aa pɩ kuoro. Mɩ wʋbʋlaa nagɛ teŋ-jɩnnɩ-wajɩa sɩ yie ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ ŋaa baalaa tʋɔŋ nɩzɔmʋŋ. Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa bʋlʋŋ woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ pɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Mighty king, glorious ruler, strap on your sword
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori babiibal, joŋ ŋ tokobiiŋ gɩrɩgɛ, ŋ ŋaa nɩbal nɛ a kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: To ŋ ballɩŋ lɛ a yuo dii a leŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ tʋɔpʋl wʋŋaalaa chɩŋ, dɩ nɩaa kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri. Leŋ dɩ ŋ naduo-la ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ.

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ŋ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ sɩ kɛŋ niiŋ woruŋ tɔɔ jʋʋ kɛŋ kuoro dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ chʋbagɩlɩŋ-buguloo, leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa ma tel ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Kuori-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ, wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ kuoru dantɩga dɩ ŋ kaa beŋ ŋ nɩaa.

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
translation_verse: Ŋ cho tʋɔpʋl wɩaa nɛ aŋ bɛrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ Nyɩmma Wɩa lɩɩsɩŋ a leŋ ŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a yʋga kɩɩ ŋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: Ŋ kuoru gɛnnɩŋ kala nɩɩ sʋɔrɛ bʋsa bʋsa arɩ tʋlaalɩɩ, ka ba du cheŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a ŋaa ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ kuoru dɩa-la lɛ ba sɩ kpɩɛra arɩ batu-nyɩlaa.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: Kuoroo toloo guoli ŋ haala-la nɩaa sɩɩ zil tʋɔŋ nɛ, ka ŋ haala chɩŋ ŋ nadiiŋ a laalɛ ha-fal gɛrɩŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ kpɩɛrɛ.

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: Kuoro ha-falɩŋ, wuoli dɩgɩlaa a nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Yʋ ŋ nɩaa arɩ ŋ nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa wɩaa.

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: Kuoro tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ zɔmʋŋ lɛ nɛ, to ʋ niiŋ a zizilu, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ ŋ tɩɩna.

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Taaya nɩaa jaŋ kɛŋ kɩaa kɔ dɩ ba dii zile ŋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ma ŋaa sɩma.

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Kuoro tolo nɛ hɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ, ʋ ŋaa hazɔŋ nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ laalɛ gɛrɩŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ kpɩɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: Gɛnnɩŋ ba sɩ kpɩɛra nɛ ʋ laalɛ, ka ʋ hatol dɔsʋŋ to ʋ harɩŋ, ba kɛnʋ kʋ pɩ kuoro.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ ba jʋɔsɛ a jʋjʋʋ kuoro dɩa.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ŋ biiriŋ arɩ ŋ nihee ma jaŋ dii kuoruŋ arɩ ŋ naabalɩmaba fa sɩ die ŋɩɩ. Ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba dii kuoruŋ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ kala.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ doho kala lɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ ŋaa la dɩɩ-duoŋ arɩ la doluŋ. Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ la lɛ bʋa na-kala dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋla.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, fawʋllʋŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛnla dɩ tinteeŋ nɛ paala zigili, dɩ peelee gire mʋʋ tuu mʋgʋ-balɩŋ ma,

english_verse: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
translation_verse: koo dɩ ba lɩɩŋ nɛ pɛllɛ yagɛ dundolluŋ dɩ ba jijigisi ma.

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: Fuo kʋbala nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, ʋ naakelee yie leŋ Wɩa tabalɩŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, lee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala jʋjʋʋ.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Wɩa hɛ tabal-la lɛ nɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ tel. Dɩ taŋ nɛ pʋlaa kɔ, Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ chaasa jʋʋ tinteyee nɩaa nɛ, kuoroo sɩɩ beŋ tinteye-la titel. Ama Wɩa sɩ kpɩa goŋ, tinteeŋ kala yʋɔla nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna hɛ la teeŋ nɛ. Jekɔb Wɩa nɛ la dɩ-duoŋ.

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Má kʋ na La Tɩɩna tɩntɩŋŋaa, ʋ leŋe dʋnɩa kala pɩŋ hoi nɛ.

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: Ʋ bori tosuŋ nɛ a chei tiŋŋee kala, ʋ nyɩgɛ hɔɔtaalɩ-la ma laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ, ʋ leŋe laalɩŋ dɛrɛ dʋnɩa kala lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ, “Má hɔŋ chɩm, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ Wɩa. Mɩ yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ tintee kala lɛ. Mɩ yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ dʋnɩa kala lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna hɛ la teeŋ nɛ, Jekɔb Wɩa nɛ la dɩ-duoŋ.

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Má tinteyee nɩaa kala, má porisi nɩsaa a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ dɛnnɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma fá La Tɩɩna sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala nɛ, ʋ nɛ kuoru-balɩŋ sii beŋ dʋnɩa kala.

english_verse: God has put every nation under our power,
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe la yuo dii nɩaa nɛ a bibeŋ tinteyee.

english_verse: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ joŋ tintee-la la sɩ kaa ŋmoo bɔyɛ pɩ la naabalɩma Jekɔb, nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ cho.

english_verse: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Wɩa jɩla hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ nɛ, La Tɩɩna hɔnɔ nɛ, ka nɩaa ŋmʋŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ aŋ ŋɩŋaa goŋ.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ kuoro dʋnɩa kala lɛ, má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
translation_verse: Wɩa hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ nɛ, ʋ nɩɩ beŋ tinteyee nɩaa.

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Tinteyee sɩpaalaaraa kala kʋ hilimi nɛ a lɛɛlɛ ŋaa Abɩraham Wɩa nɩaa. Wɩa nɛ tɩɩ dʋnɩa kuoroo kala, ʋ yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ, ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga dɩ la dɛnnʋ ʋ tabalɩŋ lɛ, ʋ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ.

english_verse: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
translation_verse: Wɩa peel-la ŋaa dɩ-zɔŋ nɛ a pɩpɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, kuoru-balɩŋ jaŋ.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Wɩa hɛ ʋ tabalɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ daga arɩ ʋ nɛ lee-la dɩ-duoŋ.

english_verse: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
translation_verse: Kuoroo sɩ kɛŋ ba laalɩyuoroo hɛ dɔŋɔ a kɔ dɩ ba yuo tabal-la,

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: ba sɩ naʋ, ʋ kperiba nɛ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba, ba mɩɩra fá.

english_verse: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
translation_verse: La fa nɩɩ wɩɩ-la nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ la sɩɩŋ naʋ nɛ La Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna tabalɩŋ lɛ, la Wɩa tabal-la lɛ. Wɩa leŋe ʋ taŋ-la chaasa chɩŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa nɛ la bɩbɩɩnɛ.

english_verse: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Wɩa, nɩaa ka dɛnnɩŋ nɛ lee-kala. Ŋ yɩrɩŋ teeli dʋnɩa sɛmɛ kala nɛ. Ŋ naduo-la ka tɩŋ tʋɔpʋl tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɩaa, má vɛnɛ golli Zaayɔŋ, a dɩɩsɛ ʋ dɩɩ-leŋee.

english_verse: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
translation_verse: Má beŋ ʋ jeyee woruŋ a jʋʋ ʋ dɩɩ-duoru-la kala tʋɔŋ, dɩ maachie ma wuo bʋl ba wɩaa a pɩ ma doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ to ma harɩŋ kɔ.

english_verse: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
translation_verse: La Wɩa nɛ ŋ-la, ʋ nɛ la Wɩa a kaa mʋ wuu. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ pɔla a kaa mʋ la dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ,

english_verse: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
translation_verse: nɩbiisiŋ arɩ nɩbalaa, kɩaa tɩŋŋaa arɩ summoo kala.

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋl wʋjɩnnɩ wɩaa, mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa jaŋ kɛŋ sɩaa.

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ mɩ sɩaa a jegile nɩɩ namagaba, a du cheŋ aŋ dɩdagɛ ba bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmmɛ dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋmɛ, dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ gollimi?

english_verse: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ba dʋa lɛ nɛ, a kɛŋ ba kɩaa ŋmuŋmoo bɔyɛ.

english_verse: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ dɔŋɔ mɩɩsɩŋ wuo yɔɔ koo a tiŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ chɩmɩŋ a pɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: Mɩɩsɩŋ chɩmɩŋ yʋga kɩŋkɛŋ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo timu,

english_verse: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ a sɩ́ sʋʋ.

english_verse: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
translation_verse: La kala jɩma arɩ wʋjɩnnaa arɩ nɩyaaraa kala yie sʋʋ nɛ, aŋ ka ba dʋa pɩ nɩwogusuŋ.

english_verse: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
translation_verse: Ba fa kɛŋ tinteyee nɛ a joŋ ba yɩraa hɛ, ama ba vaamaa nɛ jaŋ mɩɩra ŋaa ba dɩjʋʋlaa a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine arɩ ʋ kɩaa kala, ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni. Ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ a nagɛ pʋna.

english_verse: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ʋ jaŋ nagɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɛɩba aa to ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ sʋʋ a nagɛ piesee, sʋʋŋ jaŋ nagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ daaba. Ʋ jaŋ daaba kaa mʋ hɛ sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ. Chʋchʋɔŋ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa jaŋ yuo diiba, dɩ ba pʋa bʋa tʋɔŋ dɩ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ ŋaa ba dɩa.

english_verse: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa nɛ jaŋ laa mɩ-na mɩɩsɩŋ, dɩ sʋʋŋ sɩ́ mɩ wuo, aŋ kɛmmɛ kaa mʋ ʋ tɩtɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ kɩaa, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋɩɩ wɩɩŋ. Dɩ ʋ dʋa-la nɛ paala pʋŋaa pɛ ma.

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ sʋba, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ jʋʋ bʋa, dʋa-la bɩ ʋ harɩŋ wuo to.

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ fa sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ bɩɩna ʋʋ nɩɩ sɩma nɛ. Ʋ sɩ dʋa kɩaa ŋɩɩ, nɩaa yie bɩbɛsɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ jaŋ mʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ ʋ naabalɩmaba teeŋ, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ na pʋlʋmʋŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa aŋ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ, ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ a nagɛ pʋna.

english_verse: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna yɩrɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala nɛ, a chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
translation_verse: Wɩa pʋlʋmʋŋ chaana nɛ, a lɩɩ Zaayɔŋ taŋ-la sɩ zɔmɔ woruŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: La Wɩa kɔ nɛ ʋ bɩ lʋara, nyiŋgeliŋ laa ʋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ, ka pel-duoŋ gollu.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: Ʋ kɔ dɩ ʋ dii ʋ nɩaa sarɩya nɛ, ʋ yɩrɛ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kɩaa kala nɛ dɩ ba pɛ na.

english_verse: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Má yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to mɩ harɩŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ pɩmɛ. Ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ pɩmɛ aŋ ka mɩ dɩ ba bil niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa ka dagɛ ʋ tʋɔpʋl wɩaa nɛ, Wɩa tɩtɩa nɛ sarɩya diire.

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: “Mɩ nɩaa, Iziral tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ bʋl ma teeŋ, mɩ-na nɛ Wɩa, ma Wɩa.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ nɛ-bele ka chɛ ma nɛ-dɩa lɛ. Mɩ bɩ bʋʋŋ maa chɛ ma bʋ-dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: Bagɩlaa kala ŋaa mɩ kɩaa nɛ, mɩ nɛ tɩɩ nɛ-daŋ-la kala sɩ hɛ dundolluŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: Diibiisi-la ma kala sɩ hɛ gɩrɩŋ lɛ ŋaa mɩ kɩaa nɛ. Mɩ nɛ tɩɩ gɩrɩŋ kɩaa kala.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: Dɩ losuŋ nɛ fa kɛmmɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ tɩɩ dʋnɩa arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chaŋ nɛ-belliŋ nammɩa nɛ koo bʋʋnaa chalɩŋ nɛ mɩɩ dii?

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ Wɩa, mɩ nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala. Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la doho mɩ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ, dɩ ma lʋlɔllɛmɛ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ niiri-la ma sɩ hɛ pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: Má yɩrɛmɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la wɩaa sɩ jʋʋma, mɩ jaŋ laama ta dɩ ma zilmi.”

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Wɩa bʋla pɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ: “Ma-na bɩ wombii kɛnɛ dɩ ma bʋbʋl wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ baa to wɩaa koo dɩ ma bʋbʋl nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ na gaara, ma yie kaa dii nandɔnsʋŋ nɛ, a joŋ ma tɩtɩa guoli nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: Ma wʋbʋlaa kala ŋaa nɩbɔŋ wɩaa nɛ, aŋ joŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ suu ma nyuŋ.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: Ma yie hɔnɔ gɩgaa ma naambiiriŋ harɩŋ nɛ, a chichei ma dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Ma ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala nɛ, ka mɩ tɔrɛ mɩ niiŋ. Ma bɩɩna arɩ mɩ ma nagɛma nɛ. Ama mɩ jaŋ bʋl ma wɩaa lɛɛlɛ a tɔɔ ma sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ yʋ mɩ-na Wɩa wɩaa, má jegili wɩɩŋ deeŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, mɩ jaŋ kɛmma pʋɔsɛ, ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ laama ta.

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ lɔllɛ mɩ-na Wɩa, Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la sɩɩ tɔrɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Nɩɩ-la wʋŋaalaa sɩ tʋʋla, mɩ-na ma Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ mɩ laaʋ ta.”

english_verse: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ chonuŋ sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, fá mɩ nenige. Ŋŋ fá nɩaa nenige kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, joŋ mɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la chɛmɛ.

english_verse: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Chɛsɛ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala ta, aŋ sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɛ, ba hɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
translation_verse: Mɩ chaasa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ ŋ lɛ. Mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ zɔŋ nɛ ŋ lɛ. Ŋ kɩaa sɩma nɛ a magɛ dɩ ŋ bʋl mɩ teeŋ, a diimi sarɩya a dɔgɩsɛmɛ.

english_verse: But you want complete honesty, so teach me true wisdom.
translation_verse: Ŋŋ chɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dagɛmɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
translation_verse: Pɩɩsɛ mɩ wʋbɔŋ-la ta, dɩ mɩ sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ, aŋ chɛsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ pʋllɛ a kɩɩ kuŋkunuŋ.

english_verse: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ fa sɩ faasa chei ŋɩɩ, leŋ dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ bɩra tɔrɛ dɩ mɩ jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ beŋ. Chɛsɛ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala ta.

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, a wasa chɩŋ mɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ naaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ mɩ kiru ŋ sɩpaaŋ, sɩ́ ŋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kaa laa mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Ŋaa dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ bɩra tɔrɛ a nagɛ bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ laamɛ ta. Leŋ dɩ mɩ cho dɩ mɩ to ŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ dagɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa ŋ wombiee, dɩ ba mɩɩra kɔ ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: Wɩa, lɩɩsɛmɛ nɩaa kpʋnʋŋ lɛ, ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ Laataara. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dagɛ ŋ tʋɔpʋla.

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ mɩ wuo bʋbʋl wɩaa woruŋ, dɩ mɩ suri mɩ niiŋ a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ, dɩ la leŋ la tʋɔŋ faasa chei la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, dɩ la kɛŋ la tɩtɩa muuri. Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ deeŋ doho nɛ ŋ-na Wɩa chɩchɛ.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ Zaayɔŋ nyuŋ, dɩ ŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ, a wasa saa Jerusalɛm jeyee.

english_verse: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ la jaŋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ la kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ. La jaŋ kpʋ nɛ-belliŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ŋ koruŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
translation_verse: Nɩbal, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bibigisi ŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bibigisi ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala aŋ bɩ jɩŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ dii hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ?

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: Ŋ yie chɩchɛ wombiiŋ dɩ ŋ chei ŋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa nɛ, a gɔllɔ nyɩnyɩɛ wɩaa. Ŋ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa didii a nagɛ nyu-fʋna.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: Ŋ cho wʋbɔmʋŋ nɛ a kɩɩ wʋzɔmʋŋ, a cho wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ ma a kɩɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: Ŋ cho dɩ ŋ bʋl wɩaa jʋjʋʋ nɩaa lɛ nɛ, ŋ-na wʋnyɩɛrʋ.

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ cheyiŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ʋ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ lɛrɛ lɩɩ ŋ dɩa lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsɩŋ dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa jaŋ na wɩɩŋ deeŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba, ba jaŋ mɔmʋŋ aŋ bʋl,

english_verse: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
translation_verse: “Má bee na nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa joŋo ʋ ŋaa ʋ dɩ-duoŋ aŋ joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa hɛ ʋ dʋa lɛ, a kɛŋ doluŋ a chichei ʋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa.”

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ-na nagɛ tɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Olif nɛ a hɛ Wɩa dɩa lɛ a tʋtɔsɛ. Mɩ laa Wɩa chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ a dii nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɔllɛ ŋ-na Wɩa bʋa na-kala a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Mɩ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa hɛ ŋ yɩrɩ-la lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ zɔmɔ. Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ dɩ ŋ nɩaa nɛ hilime.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Nɩyaaraa nɛ yie bʋl ba tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Wɩa tuo.” Ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ, ba wʋŋaalaa lɔrɔ. Nɩbala ma paala tuo a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Wɩa hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ beŋ dɩ ʋ naa wʋjɩnnʋ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ a ŋaa wɩaa chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ jɩŋ ʋ-na Wɩa.

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋkala yeŋŋe nɛ ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ. Nɩbala ma paala tuo a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ. Nʋʋ tuo.

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmɔ, ma-na bɩ wɩaa wuo gʋnnaa pɩ ma tɩtɩa koo? Ma vɩa dɩ ma chʋɔlɛmɛ nɛ, aŋ gɔllɔ kɛsɛ mɩ nɩaa liliŋ a nagɛ kʋdiilee.

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Ama fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmma a kɩɩ faafaa-la. Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ haŋgbelee pɩsɛ. Ʋ vɩaba ta nɛ. Ma-na Iziral tɩŋŋaa jaŋ yuo diiba dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmba.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ, dɩ nʋʋ fa lɩɩ Zaayɔŋ a kʋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta. Dɩ Wɩa nɛ bɩra leŋe dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩ ʋ nɩaa, Jekɔb dɩa nɩaa jaŋ jʋɔsɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, laamɛ ta, ŋ doluŋ lɛ, leŋ dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, jegile nɩɩ mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl.

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Nʋhʋɔraa nɛ kʋʋ yuomi, nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala bɩ ŋ-na Wɩa ka fá.

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɛ mɩ lɛ. La Tɩɩna nɛ chagɛmɛ kɩɩ.

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a gʋra dɔgɩsɛba. Cheiba a tɩŋ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kʋ pɩŋ. Mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɛ ŋ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ laamɛ ta mɩ wʋjʋʋlaa kala lɛ. Mɩ sɩɩŋ na ŋ sɩ yuo dii mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
translation_verse: Wɩa, jegile nɩɩ mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, sɩ́ harɩŋ joŋo yɩamɛ.

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ a pɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala vʋgʋma nɛ, mɩ kala ŋaa hɛɩ.

english_verse: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ka kpɩa mɩ lɛ nɛ a gɩgɩɛnɛmɛ. Ba baanɩŋ ka sii mɩ nyuŋ nɛ ba dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ.

english_verse: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɔyɛ joŋo nɛ, fawʋllʋŋ ma kɛmmɛ arɩ mɩ sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ mɩ chichel, a kala ŋaa holumbol.

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Dɩ mɩ fa kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a nagɛ kokomo, mɩ fa jaŋ file mʋ lee a wiesi.

english_verse: I would go and live in some distant desert.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa jaŋ file mʋ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ dɩ-bolii.

english_verse: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, kɛŋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa vʋgʋmɛ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba wʋbʋlaa kɛŋ sɩɩ. Mɩ na dɩ ba lɔgɛ yuosuŋ su tabal-la kala.

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: Wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala mɩ na dɩ baa baarɛ ʋ jeyee harɩŋ. Ka taŋ-la tʋɔŋ kala ŋaa holumoŋ.

english_verse: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
translation_verse: Wʋcheeree hɛ taŋ-la sɛmɛ na-kala nɛ, gɩrɩma arɩ nɩaa dɔgʋsʋŋ su ʋ wombiee kala a bɩ leŋ.

english_verse: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋ nɛ faa tʋʋsɛmɛ, mɩ jaŋ wuo nyalɩmɛ. Dɩ dʋndɔmɔ nɛ kɛŋ wɩaa chɩchaasɛmɛ, mɩ fa jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa faaʋ.

english_verse: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ, mɩ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, mɩ toori dɔŋɔ, mɩ nandɔŋ fɩamɩŋ nɛ joŋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: La fa sɩɩ to dɔŋɔ, ʋ fa sɩma pɩla nɛ woruŋ, la dɩ la dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa nɛ yie to dɔŋɔ a mʋmʋ Wɩa dɩa.

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sʋʋ dɩ ba sʋʋŋ bɩ yie, dɩ ba hugiba dɩŋ-duoŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ ba tʋɔsaa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ-na yɩrɛ Wɩa nɛ, La Tɩɩna jaŋ laamɛ ta.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Dɩdaanɩŋ, chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala nɛ mɩ yie yel arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ, ʋ nɩɩ mɩ yikoro.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yʋga nɛ a yuyuomi sɛmɛ kala, ama ŋ nɛ jaŋ laamɛ ta dɩ wɩɩ sɩ́ mɩ ŋaa laal-la lɛ.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ a kaa mʋ wuu jaŋ nɩɩ ba wɩaa a dɔgɩsɛba. Ba ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa ka bɩrɩmɛ nɛ a bɩ Wɩa ka fá.

english_verse: My friend turned against me and broke his promise.
translation_verse: Mɩ toori dɔŋɔ kɛŋ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ yuyuo nɛ, a chei nii-la sɩ hɛ ba pɛgɛ.

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: Ʋ wʋbʋlaa sɩma a nagɛ tʋʋŋ, ama ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ ʋ bɛrɛ nɩaa nɛ. Ʋ wʋbʋlaa ma pʋnyɛ nɛ a nagɛ nʋʋŋ, aŋ kikeri nɩaa a nagɛ tokobiiŋ sɩ kɛŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Joŋ ŋ wʋwalɩmaa hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ beŋ ŋ nyuŋ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ leŋe dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa tel.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na Wɩa jaŋ joŋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ, nɩkpʋʋraa arɩ wʋnyɩɛraa a hɛ buotuo-luŋuŋ lɛ. Ŋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba yi ba tapʋlaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ma. Ama mɩ-na laaŋ dii nɛ.

english_verse: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.
translation_verse: Wɩa, fá mɩ nenige bɛɛ wɩaa baa yuomi nɛ, mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kirimi ŋɩɩ nɛ deeŋ deeŋ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ fawʋllʋŋ nɛ paala kɛmmɛ ma, mɩ ha jaŋ laaŋ dii.

english_verse: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩɩ dɛnnɩŋ a tɩŋ ŋ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ wɩaa. Mɩ laaŋ dii nɛ, mɩ bɩ fawʋllʋŋ ka fá. Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ nuhuobiine jaŋ wuo ŋaa mɩ lɛ?

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la kala mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ chɛ dɩ ba na mɩ wʋcheeliŋ nɛ, a bɩbɩɩnɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ to a ŋaamɛ wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: Ba yie vʋʋrɛ nɛ a faa bibeŋ mɩ naavɛnɛɛ, a chɩchɛ wombiiŋ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ba sɩ chei wɩaa deemba, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba na wombiiŋ fá, na baanɩŋ a chei tinteye-la nɩaa.

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ tapʋlɩa-la mɩ sɩ gɔllɔ baarɛ nɛ, a na mɩ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ ma sɩ lɩɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ. Ŋ paa su ŋ kpaalɩŋ nɛ a ŋmʋnsɛ ba niiŋ bil.

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ yɩrɩŋ dɩ ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa, mɩ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ŋ-na Wɩa chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Mɩ laaŋ ŋ-na Wɩa dii nɛ, mɩ bɩ fawʋllʋŋ ka fá. Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ nuhuobiine jaŋ wuo ŋaa mɩ lɛ?

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nii-la mɩ sɩ hɛ a pɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kʋ lɔllʋŋ.

english_verse: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
translation_verse: Ŋ laamɛ ta nɛ mɩ bɩ sʋba, a pɔmɛ mɩ sɩ tele. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ vɛŋ ŋ-na Wɩa sɩpaaŋ pʋlʋŋ-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: Fá mɩ nenige, Wɩa, fá mɩ nenige mɩ kʋ yuoruŋ nɛ. Mɩ jʋʋ ŋ kɩŋkɛŋɛ nɛ dɩ ŋ tɔ hɛ mɩ lɛ, dɩ wʋlɔrʋŋ deeŋ bal.

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ tɩŋ dɩ ba lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a kʋ laamɛ ta, aŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yuomi jʋʋ wɩaa lɛ. Wɩa jaŋ dagɛ ʋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ arɩ ʋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: Dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ gollimi nɛ a nagɛ naachigee losuŋ sɩ kɛnɛ, ba chɩchɛ nɩaa dɩ ba chaŋ. Ba nyɩlaa nagɛ tiŋŋee arɩ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ. Ba nandelimee ma nagɛ tokobiee sɩ kɛŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Wɩa, leŋ dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ sii kɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ, dɩ ŋ tʋla su dʋnɩa lee na-kala.

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ bɛrɛ nɛ mɩ wombiiŋ lɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ kala chei. Ba lu buotuoŋ nɛ bil mɩ lɛ. Ama ba tɩtɩa gʋra tuu nɛ.

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa chaasa chɩŋ nɛ, Wɩa, mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa chaasa chɩŋ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ du kɩaa a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ sii doŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ sii sɩɩpʋʋraa a joŋ cheŋ arɩ kɔnɛ a du.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ. Tinteyee tʋɔŋ mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa pɩŋ.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ŋ chonuŋ yʋga nɛ a teeli wɩa-nyuŋ kala, ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ ma jɩla yi wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Wɩa, leŋ dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ sii kɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ, dɩ ŋ tʋla su dʋnɩa lee na-kala.

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: Ma sɩpaalaaraa, maa bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛɛ? Maa dii sarɩya ʋ bʋa lɛ nɛ nɩaa tʋɔŋ?

english_verse: You are always planning evil, and you are brutal.
translation_verse: Aɩ, maa bɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ bʋa-kala lɛ, aa hɛ yuosuŋ dʋnɩa lee na-kala.

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Baa lʋlma dɩ ma paala ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ nɛ a yeŋŋi. Baa lʋlma dɩ ma ŋaa nɩa sɩ cheye nɛ aa nyɩɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Ma wʋbʋlaa kɛŋ huoŋ a nagɛ dɩmɩŋ nɛ. Ma yie kɛŋ dɩgɩlaa tɔ a nagɛ kataha.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: Wɩa, bori ba nyɩlaa, La Tɩɩna, churi naachigee deemba sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ nyɩlaa.

english_verse: Make them disappear like leaking water, and make their arrows miss.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba nyɩɩgɛ a nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ pɛllɛ viiri. Dɩ ba nɛ lɛrɛ toŋ hɛ, leŋ dɩ ba hɛŋŋɛɛ niiŋ gbil.

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba yʋɔlɛ a nagɛ kuŋkoluŋ-bawɩɩba sɩɩ vɛŋ ka soluŋ pɩpɛllɛ. Leŋ dɩ ba nagɛ bii-sʋʋŋ ba sɩ lʋla ʋ bɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ na.

english_verse: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ jɩjɩŋ dɩ Wɩa kpʋba a nagɛ yaŋ. Ʋ jaŋ faasa na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ, a cheiba dɩ ba ha weye.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ, dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ na hɛɛ-la sɩ maga dɩ ba na. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ nɩbɔmɔ-la chalɩŋ sɔŋ ba naasɩŋ.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa jaŋ bʋl, “Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa sɛnɛ haa laa time nɛ. Wɩa sɛnɛ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ a didii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya.”

english_verse: Save me, God! Protect me from enemy attacks!
translation_verse: Wɩa, laamɛ ta mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, pɔmɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sii chɩŋ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛmɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, laamɛ ta nɩkpʋʋra-la sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Bee na, ba faa nɛ a gbɛrɛmɛ. La Tɩɩna, mɩ bɩ wɩɩkala cheye, ka nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ vʋʋrɛ a chɩŋ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa, aŋ ka ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba yuomi. Beŋ mɩ wɩɩŋ, aŋ sii a pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
