translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa. Sii a dɔgɩsɛ tinteye-la nɩaa kala. Sɩ́ nɩbɔmɔ-la sɩ ŋaa zɛmbɛ tɩŋŋaa nenige fá.

english_verse: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Ba yie mɩɩra kɔ dɩdaanɩŋ, a gɔllɔ ŋaa goŋ su tabal-la kala, a nagɛ vasɩŋ sɩɩ huosu.

english_verse: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
translation_verse: Bee na ba wʋbʋlaa sɩ lɔrɔ ŋɩɩ. Ba wʋbʋlaa nagɛ tokobiee nɛ ba niiŋ lɛ. Ba yie bʋl, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nɩɩ la wɩaa?”

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na La Tɩɩna ka mɔŋ tinteye-la nɩaa lɛ nɛ, a sisieri ba kala lɛ.

english_verse: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ nɛ mɩ dɩ-duoŋ arɩ mɩ doluŋ, mɩɩ beŋ ŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, ŋ chomi nɛ. Wɩa, ŋ jaŋ laa mɩ sɩpaaŋ a leŋ dɩ mɩ yuo dii mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, sɩ́ ba kpʋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ mɩ nɩaa jaŋ yʋ. Ama kɛŋ ŋ dol-la a ŋmooba pɩsɛ a kɛmba muuri. Ŋ nɛ hɔɔtaala-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ a tɔla.

english_verse: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
translation_verse: na baanɩŋ a cheiba. Cheiba a leŋ dɩ ba kala dɛrɛ mɩa-mɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ŋ-na Wɩa nɩɩ beŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Ba yie mɩɩra kɔ dɩdaanɩŋ, a gɔllɔ ŋaa goŋ su tabal-la kala, a nagɛ vasɩŋ sɩɩ huosu.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Ba gɔllɔ chɛ kɩaa nɛ dɩ ba dii, dɩ ba nɛ bɩ vɔgɔ ba hihiini.

english_verse: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Wɩa, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ tɩgɛ ŋ doluŋ lɛ. Chʋchʋɔŋ, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ tɩgɛ ŋ chonuŋ lɛ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ dɩ-duoŋ mɩ yie kʋ yuori, dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋmɛ.

english_verse: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ nɛ mɩ doluŋ, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ a dɛnnɩŋ. Wɩa, ŋ nɛ mɩ dɩ-duoŋ, ŋ nɛ Wɩa a chomi.

english_verse: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ fa na baanɩŋ nɛ la nyuŋ a vɩala ta, la bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ. Leŋ dɩ la bɩra kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe tinteeŋ zigili nɛ a faasa yɛrɛ. Leŋ dɩ dɩ-yɛrɩɛ-la bɩra tɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ haa zigili nɛ.

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe ŋ nɩaa na hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ. La kala bugo nɛ a gɩgɛrɛ a nagɛ nɩaa sɩ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bugi.

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fáŋ, ŋ kɛŋ ŋ jɔnjɔŋ je nɛ a dagɛba dɩ ba fá a laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ ŋ naduo-la pɛ la lɛ a laala ta. Laa nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ cho ta.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Wɩa bʋl ŋ-la nɛ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ: “Mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛkɛm a kaa kpaa, a kɛŋ fuonaa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sʋkɔf ma kpaa a pɩ mɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ tɩɩ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ, a tɩɩ Manasɛ tinteeŋ ma. Efirem nɛ ŋaa mɩ laalɩyuori nyunchu-gbaŋkogo, ka Juda ma ŋaa mɩ kuoru dantɩga.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Mʋab nɛ ŋaa gbaŋa-la mɩ sɩ kaa ŋaa lɩɩŋ a sʋsɔŋ mɩ naasɩŋ. Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ mɩ yie chaarɛ mɩ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ bil, aŋ ŋaa laalɩyuori diiri goŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa lɛ.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ kɛmmɛ kɔ taŋ-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ laa mɩ sɩpaaŋ a kɛmmɛ kɔ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ?

english_verse: Have you rejected us and deserted our armies?
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ nɛ vɩala ta, a bɩra bɩ la laalɩyuoroo kaa mʋ laalɩŋ.

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Pɛ la lɛ dɩ la yuo la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, nuhuobiine pɛnɩŋ bɩ bʋbʋa kala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Wɩa chɩŋ la harɩŋ nɛ, la jaŋ yuo dii. Ʋ jaŋ yuo dii la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Wɩa, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, jegile nɩɩ mɩ nii-ŋmobo a laa mɩ sʋla.

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ dɩ-bolii nɛ aŋ yɩrɩŋ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ faasa chei nɛ mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ pɩpɩŋ. Laa mɩ sɩpaaŋ a kɛmmɛ kaa jɩl bʋŋ-la sɩ leŋie kɩɩmɛ.

english_verse: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ dɩɩ-duo-la sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ mɩ sɩ yie yuori, a laa mɩ tɩtɩa mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ hɛ ŋ dɩa lɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, dɩ ŋ kɛŋ ŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ chu tɔmɛ.

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ nɩɩ niiri-la kala mɩ sɩ hɛ pɩŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ pɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ ziliŋ.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ kuoro kɛŋ mɩɩ-duduoŋ, a hɛ nɩmɛ a dieni.

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: Wɩa, a leŋ dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, dɩ ŋ pɔʋ arɩ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɩŋ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ niiri-la kala mɩ sɩ hɛ pɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
translation_verse: Wɩa dʋndʋŋa lɛ nɛ mɩ dɩma jaŋ wuo na wiese, ʋ nɛ laamɛ tɩta.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ mɩ dɩ-duoŋ sɩ nagɛ bʋŋ arɩ mɩ Laataara. Wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ wuo jigisimi.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ ma kala jaŋ yuyuo mɩ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ? Mɩ nagɛ jeeŋ sɩ yɛrɛ aŋ sɔgʋnɔ chɩŋ nɛ, a bɩra nagɛ lɩga sɩ boro.

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: Maa chɛ dɩ ma lɩɩsɛmɛ lee-la sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ma cho wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ woruŋ. Ma yie kɛŋ niiŋ bʋl wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ pɩ nɩaa, aŋ kɛŋ tʋɔŋ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
translation_verse: Wɩa dʋndʋŋa lɛ nɛ mɩ yie na wiese. Mɩ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ mɩ dɩ-duoŋ sɩ nagɛ bʋŋ arɩ mɩ Laataara. Wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ wuo jigisimi.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ laamɛ ta, a leŋ mɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ dɩ-duoŋ sɩ nagɛ bʋŋ, mɩ yie yuori.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: Nandɔmba, má laa Wɩa dii bʋa na-kala, a dagɛ ma wʋwalɩmaa kala pʋ. Ʋ nɛ la yie yuori.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine kala nagɛ peliŋ nɛ, la nɩbalaa arɩ nɩbiisiŋ kala bɩ kɩa kala ŋaa. Dɩ ŋ nɛ jomba a hɛ sanɩa lɛ a magɩsɛ, ba bɩ yuŋ kala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I heard God say two things: “I am powerful,
translation_verse: Wɩa bʋl wʋbala nɛ ka mɩ nɩɩ wɩaa balɩa: Ʋ sɩ doluŋ kala ŋaa ʋ-na Wɩa kʋŋ nɛ,

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: chonuŋ ma ŋaa ʋ-na La Tɩɩna kʋŋ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ tiŋ nʋʋkala a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ tɩma magɛ.

english_verse: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ nɛ mɩ Wɩa. Mɩɩ hɩɛnɩŋ nɛ, mɩɩ chɛŋ nɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ a nagɛ nɩa sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ sɩ lɩma lɛ aa chɛ lɩɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: Mɩ na ŋ doluŋ arɩ ŋ tʋla nɛ, ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ ba sɩɩ dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: Ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ kɩɩ mɩɩsɩŋ mɩ teeŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: Mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ a kɛŋ mɩ nɩsaa je a lɔllʋŋ.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ dɩma vɔgɛ a nagɛ nɩa sɩ dii kʋdii-zɔŋŋɔɔ vɔgɛ, dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ dɩ mɩ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɔsɔ lɛ, mɩ yie liisi ŋ wɩaa nɛ, a kɛmba bɩɩnɛ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala.

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩɩ pɛ mɩ lɛ wɩaa, mɩ hɛ ŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ aŋ yɩyɩɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ yɩɩlaa.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: Mɩ mɛrɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ, ŋ pɔmɛ arɩ ŋ naduo-la.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ, ba jaŋ sʋʋ a tuu bʋa.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kpʋba arɩ tokobiee dɩ ba bɩrɩmɛ jolluŋ kʋdiilee.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Ama kuoro-na jaŋ jʋjʋɔsɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, nɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩ yie hɛ niiŋ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ jaŋ dɛnnʋ. Ama wʋnyɩɛraa kala niiŋ jaŋ jʋʋ kpʋrʋŋ.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
translation_verse: Wɩa, jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ walɩmɛmɛ, laa mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ ta mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛmɛ wɩalɩŋ nɩbɔmɔ-la sɩɩ vʋʋrʋ lɛ. Lɩɩsɛmɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa sɩ hoso nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Ba niiŋ ka dii a nagɛ tokobiee nɛ, ba wʋbʋlaa ma lɔrɛ a tʋtɔɔ nɩaa a nagɛ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ ba sɩ sʋa.

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: Ba yie bʋl wɩaa aa nyaasɛ dɔŋɔba nyuŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ. Ba yie vʋʋrɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ bɛrɛ kɛsɛ nɩaa, aŋ bʋl, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ nala?”

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Ba yie vʋʋrɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la aŋ bʋl, “Wʋzɔŋ nɛ la vʋʋrɛ ŋɩɩ. Nʋʋkala bɩ la tʋɔbɩɩnaa wuo jɩŋ.”

english_verse: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa jaŋ yagɛba arɩ ʋ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ a dɩ ba lɛ, dɩ ba guu tel.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Ba niiŋ wʋbʋlɩa-la tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ jaŋ kaa gʋra cheiba. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ naba, ʋ jaŋ vigisi nyuŋ.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛŋ nʋʋkala. Ba jaŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa, aŋ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa a bɩbɩɩnɛ.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma, má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ La Tɩɩna nyuŋ. Má yuoru. Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa kala, má dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ʋ maga dɩ la dɛnnɩŋ Zaayɔŋ lɛ, aŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ la sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩŋ arɩ la jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
translation_verse: Nɩaa kala jaŋ kɔ ŋ teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ nɩɩ laa ba sʋla nɛ.

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: La wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ fa sɩ nyagɛla bil, ŋ joŋo chɛla nɛ.

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: Ŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa lɛ nɛ, a kɛmba kʋ hɛ ŋ dɩa lɛ. Wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ hɛ ŋ dɩa-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa pɩ ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ, la jaŋ nɩɩ ba sɩma.

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: Wɩa, la Laataara, ŋ laa la sʋla nɛ, a ŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ. Ŋ joŋ yɩɛlaa pɩ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ kala nɩaa nɛ, a pɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ cholo dɩ-bolii.

english_verse: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
translation_verse: Ŋ doluŋ nɛ ŋ kaa ŋaa peelee, ŋɩɩ dagɛ dol-la ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ leŋe mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ dɔmɔ sigili, a leŋ lɩɩ-peliŋ dɔmɔ sigili a leŋ tinteyee nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa goŋ-la ma sigili.

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa leŋe fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ nɩaa nɛ, dʋnɩa nɩaa kala. Ŋ leŋe dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala nɩaa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ ba yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɩɩ beŋ tinteeŋ a leŋ duonuŋ nɩɩ hɩhɛ ʋ lɛ. Ŋ yie leŋ ʋ sɩŋ woruŋ, kʋdosunu kala nyʋ a wasɛ. Wɩa, ŋ fuonuŋ bɩ hʋ, ŋ nɛ leŋe kʋdiilee hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: Ŋ yie leŋ duonuŋ nɩɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ kala pʋɩ, buotuonuŋ kala tɔ, ŋ leŋ kɩaa nyʋ a wasɛ.

english_verse: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
translation_verse: Ŋ zile yʋga, ŋ leŋe la kɩaa wasɛ nɛ woruŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ hɛ lee na-kala, kɩaa yie wasɛ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: Desert pastures blossom, and mountains celebrate.
translation_verse: Tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diiliŋ kala tɔsɛ yaŋ, dundolluŋ nyuŋ kala kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ kala tɔ arɩ piesee, fuonaasɩŋ ma su arɩ mɩaa, tʋɔtɔrʋŋ su lee-kala.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala, má ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a dɛnnɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ a leŋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Má bʋla pɩ Wɩa, “Wɩɩkala ŋ sɩ ŋaa kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ nɛ. Ŋ doluŋ yʋga, ŋɩɩ leŋ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ gbigbieni ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala kpirimi ŋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa dɩdɛnnɩŋ, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa aa yɩrɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ.”

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Má kʋ na wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa, wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa a tɩŋ nuhuobiine wɩaa.

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ hʋ nɛ aŋ ka tintee-hɩlɩŋ pɩŋ, la naabalɩmaba vɛŋ ʋ lɛ, a chol. Ŋɩɩ nɛ la tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ la jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: Ʋ doluŋ nɛ ʋ kaa beŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa a kaa mʋ wuu. Tinteyee nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala, ʋʋ naba nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nʋʋkala sɩ́ ʋ harɩŋ mɩɩrʋ.

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa kala, má dɛnnɛ la Wɩa. Má leŋ dɩ nɩaa nɩɩ ma yikoro ma sɩɩ dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ pɔ la mɩɩsɩŋ a bɩ leŋe la sɩɛrɛ.

english_verse: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ magɩsɛla a nagɛ ba sɩ joŋ hɔpʋla chɔ dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ hɔɔ-biiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe la jʋʋ bɛrɛ nɛ, a joŋ hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ hɛ la lɛ.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe nɩaa nʋɔsɛla nɛ, la na hɛɛŋ, a nagɛ nɩa sɩ jʋʋ nyiniŋ koo lɩɩŋ sɩ pɛllɛ paa nɩaa. Ama ŋ kɛŋ la kaa kʋ lɩɩ bil tinteeŋ sɩ jalɩa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kʋ jʋʋ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ a lɩɩsɛ niiri-la mɩ sɩ hɛ ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: when I was in trouble.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ niiri-la bʋa-la lɛ wɩaa sɩ jʋʋmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ sɩ zɔmɔ ŋ koru-la nyuŋ, pie-belliŋ, nɛ-belliŋ arɩ bʋʋnaa a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩŋ.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ fá Wɩa, má kɔ daha dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa pɩmɛ a pɩma.

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ nɛ a pʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, aŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ laa mɩ sʋla.

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa jegile nɩɩ nɛ a laa mɩ sʋla.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ dɛnnɛ Wɩa nɛ, ʋ bɩ mɩ sʋla vɩa, ʋ dagɛ ʋ chonuŋ pɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
translation_verse: Wɩa, leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ la nyuŋ, leŋ dɩ la na wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, suri ŋ sɩaa pɩla.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jɩŋ ŋ wombiee a toŋ, dɩ tinteyee nɩaa na ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ laa nɩaa tɩta.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Wɩa, a leŋ dɩ nɩaa kala dɛnnɩŋ, a leŋ dɩ ba kala ŋaa goŋ a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, aŋ bibeŋ tinteyee nɩaa kala.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Wɩa, a leŋ dɩ nɩaa kala dɛnnɩŋ, leŋ dɩ ba kala ŋaa goŋ a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Wɩa, la Wɩa, ŋ pɛ la lɛ nɛ woruŋ, a leŋ tinteeŋ kɩaa chaasa wasɛ.

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Wɩa ha jaŋ pɩpɛ la lɛ, dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala zizilu.

english_verse: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
translation_verse: Wɩa, sii ŋaa wɩɩ a kɛŋ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ pɩsɛ. Leŋ dɩ ba mɩɩra fá ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
translation_verse: Ŋmooba pɩsɛ a nagɛ peliŋ sɩ ŋmoo nyʋɔsʋŋ pɩsɛ. Wɩa, leŋ dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛl ŋ sɩpaaŋ a nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩ dii keliŋ ʋ ŋmɩɛrɛ.

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Ama leŋ dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, dɩ ba jʋjʋɔsɛ ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa pɩ Wɩa, má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnʋ. Ʋ sagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa nyuŋ nɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ La Tɩɩna, maa jʋɔsɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: Wɩa hɛ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa biisinsiŋ nyɩmma, ʋ nɩɩ beŋ yo-haalaa ma.

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ nɛ leŋe nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɔŋ ba dʋndʋŋ kɛŋ dɩa nɩaa. Ŋ nɛ laa nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa ta, ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ba yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa. Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ŋ niiŋ ka to jaŋ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ sɩ faasa lɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ sɩ laa ŋ nɩaa sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba vɛŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ tʋɔŋ,

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: tinteeŋ zigile nɛ, duonuŋ nɩɩ ŋ sɩpaaŋ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa Sɩnaɩ peel-la Wɩa, ŋ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa.

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: Ŋ tinteeŋ fa sɩ hɩla, ŋ leŋe duonuŋ nɩɩ nɛ, leriŋ fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɩaa hɔŋ nɩmɛ nɛ, ŋ pɩ summoo kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ chɛ nɛ a tɩŋ ŋ zile sɩ yʋga wɩaa.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ, ha-daŋ nɛ laaba heele bʋl:

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: “Kuoroo arɩ ba laalɩyuoroo mɩɩra fá nɛ, aŋ ka haala-la sɩ hɛ dɩa lɛ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo laa kaa kpaa.

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: Ma sɩ paala faa pie-dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ ma, kokomo kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ taara tɔ nɛ arɩ hɔpʋla, ka ʋ pʋnaa tʋtʋl a nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ.”

english_verse: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
translation_verse: Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ŋ fa ŋmoo kuoroo pɩsɛ ʋ nagɛ bʋrʋŋ sɩ tɔ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zalɩmɔŋ nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: Peele-la sɩ hɛ Basaŋ lɛ leŋie, a pɛ ŋaa peel-balaa ma.

english_verse: Why is it jealous of Zion, the mountain you chose as your home forever?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma yaraa bibieri Zaayɔŋ peel-la lɛ? Peel-la La Tɩɩna sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ ŋaa ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ, lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ hɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Wɩa laalɩyuori janɩŋ torukoba ŋaa bʋɩ bʋɩba nɛ. La Tɩɩna lɩɩ Sɩnaɩ peel-la lɛ nɛ a kʋ jʋʋ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa, ŋ sɩɩ jɩl peel-la nyuŋ, ŋ pɛ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo dii laalɩŋ lɛ nɛ, nɩaa pɩŋ zile kɩaa. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ paala bɩ ŋ niiŋ lɛ ka to ma pɩŋ zile kɩalɩŋ nɛ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ hɔŋ.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ ŋaa la Laataara. Ʋ nɛ laa la wʋwalɩmaa a chʋchʋŋ tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: You always protect us and save us from death.
translation_verse: La Wɩa nɛ ŋaa Laataara, Wɩa nɛ laa nɩaa tɩta sʋʋŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɛnɛ jaŋ yɛrɛ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nyusuŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛsɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bʋla, “Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba kaa lɩɩ Basaŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba lɩɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ a kʋ lɩɩ,

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋ wuo kɛŋ ba chalɩŋ a sɔŋ ŋ naasɩŋ, ka dɩ ŋ vasɩŋ ma lenni ba chalɩŋ.”

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: Wɩa, la na ŋ nɩaa dɩ ba pʋɔla nɛ. La Wɩa arɩ la kuoro, ŋ nɩaa pʋɔla mʋmʋ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ, kʋduuroo tuto, ka hantolibiisiŋ hɛ ba pɛgɛ a chɩchɩgɩsɛ chɩnchɩgɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: Wɩa nɩaa, má dɛnnɛ Wɩa dɩ ma nɛ hilime, Má Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala, má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa nɛ muuro ba doho doho kala tʋɔŋ, ba nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ. Juda doho nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa tɩtɩgɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zebuluŋ arɩ Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa ma tuto.

english_verse: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.
translation_verse: Wɩa, bɩra dagɛla ŋ doluŋ arɩ ŋ fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ a ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋaa dɩ kuoroo kɛŋ zile kɩaa kʋ pɩŋ, ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
translation_verse: Dɔgɩsɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa, ba nagɛ pʋna-la sɩ hɛ fuolo-ŋmʋlba tʋɔŋ nɛ. Dɔgɩsɛ tinteye-la nɩaa arɩ ba biiriŋ sɩ nagɛ nɛ-belliŋ. Leŋ dɩ ba pʋgʋmɛ a gbiene kɛŋ hɔpʋla kʋ ŋaa zile a pɩŋ. Kɛŋ tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ cho laalɩŋ yuonuŋ a pɩsɛ.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ Kus tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ kɔ a dɛnnɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala, má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a pɩ Wɩa, má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: Ʋʋ zaarɛ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ yie kpɩa goŋ arɩ yikori-balɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Má heele bʋl Wɩa doluŋ wɩaa, ʋ nɩɩ beŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Ʋʋ dagɛ ʋ doluŋ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ nɛ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, ʋ nɛ leŋe la kɛŋ doluŋ. Má dɛnnɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
translation_verse: Wɩa, laamɛ ta, mɩ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ magɛ baŋŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Mɩ mʋʋra tuu vʋchɔɔŋ nɛ, mɩ naasɩŋ bɩ dɩ-chɩnɩɩ kɛnɛ. Mɩ tuu lɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ yɩyagɛmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ pɩŋ a kala lɔl nɛ, mɩ yikoro kala hɩl. Mɩ sɩaa ma kala nɛ yʋɔra, mɩ sɩ bee chɩchɛ mɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛrɛmɛ, ka mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye, ba yʋga kɩɩ mɩ nyu-pʋnaa. Doluŋ nɛ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ didii mɩ lɛ dɩ ba cheimi. Baa fʋgɛmɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ tiŋ kɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bɩ gaa.

english_verse: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ jɩŋ mɩ nɩyaarɛ wɩaa lɛ nɛ. Mɩ wʋcheelee bɩ faa ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Ŋ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ baa tʋʋsɛmɛ, mɩ kala ŋaa hɩɩsɛ.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: Mɩ nagɛ nʋhʋɔrʋ nɛ mɩ naambiiriŋ teeŋ, mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛ naaŋ ma teeŋ, mɩ nagɛ nɩwogo.

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩa wɩaa ka dii mɩ nɛ woruŋ a nagɛ nyiniŋ, jomo-la ba sɩ joŋo tʋʋsɛ ŋ-na Wɩa, ba nɛ ba joŋoo tʋʋsɛ mɩ ma.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: Mɩ yel a vɩa kʋdiilee, ka ba ha tʋtʋʋsɛmɛ.

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: Mɩ laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ ma, nɩaa mʋmɔŋ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ boi-baalɩŋ lɛ gɩgaa mɩ harɩŋ, sɩ-nyʋɔraa ma kɛmmɛ hɛ yɩɩlaa a yɩyɩɩ.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Ama La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ mɩ sʋsʋl. Wɩa, ŋ chonuŋ sɩ yʋga wɩaa laa mɩ sʋla bʋa-la ŋ sɩ cho a pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛmɛ vʋchɔɔŋ lɛ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ mʋʋrɛ. Laamɛ ta mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ mɩ sɩ́ lɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ tuu.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ tɔmɛ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ tuu lɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ, dɩ sʋʋŋ kɛmmɛ.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ wɩaa zɔmɔ nɛ, ŋ cho nɩaa, ŋ fá nɩaa nenige kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ. Jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, sɩ́ harɩŋ joŋo yɩamɛ. Wɩaa jʋʋmɛ nɛ, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ lɩma.

english_verse: Come and save me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Kʋ kpagɛ a laamɛ ta, laamɛ ta mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ tʋʋsɛmɛ nɛ, a mʋmɔŋ mɩ lɛ aa hɩɩsɛmɛ. Ŋ jɩŋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɛ.

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ tʋʋsɛmɛ ŋɩɩ leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ faasa chei nɛ, mɩ nagɛ mɩɩ wɩɩlʋ. Mɩ faa yɩɛlɛ arɩ nʋʋ jaŋ fá mɩ nenige a nyagɛ mɩ bɔyɛ, ama mɩ bɩ nʋʋkala na.

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ daalusuŋ hɛ mɩ kʋdiilee lɛ nɛ a pɩmɛ, a ŋaa sɩnɩŋ sɩ nyala a pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ nyʋa.

english_verse: Make their table a trap for them and their friends.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba gbiele kʋdiile-la sɩ chɩŋ ba sɩpaaŋ bɩrɩmɛ bɛrɛ a cheiba. Leŋ dɩ kɩalɩŋ ŋaa ba tel.

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Chaasa na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ a dɔgɩsɛba. Kiriba arɩ baanɩŋ a kɛsɛba.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Chei ba dɩɩsɩŋ dɩ ba pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ nɩmɛ jʋʋ.

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Ŋaa ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ ba sɩ to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ dɔgɩsɔ, a bʋbʋl nɩalɩŋ ma ŋ sɩ bolimo wɩaa.

english_verse: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
translation_verse: Joŋ cheeriŋ yʋgɛ a pɩba, pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ba laa ta.

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Kpʋ ba yɩraa ta mɩɩsɩŋ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba yɩraa guoli tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa yɩraa lɛ.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: Mɩ yaraa kala nɩɩ wɩɩ, mɩ nɩna hɛɛŋ, Wɩa, chu tɔmɛ a laamɛ ta.

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ a dɛnnɛ Wɩa, mɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ a lɔllʋ.

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ tɔrɛ La Tɩɩna tʋɔŋ a kɩɩ ba sɩ kpʋ nɛ-fere koo nɛ-bele a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pʋ.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Summoo jaŋ na dɩ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Wɩa, nyuŋ jaŋ nyaasɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ka jegili nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ nii-ŋmobo nɛ, ʋ bɩ ʋ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ wɩaa ka yʋ.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ, mʋgʋ-balaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ba lɛ, má dɛnnɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ laa Jerusalɛm ta, aŋ paa Juda tinteeŋ tabalaa wasa saa, dɩ ʋ nɩaa hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ, dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: Dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, ba biiriŋ ma jaŋ tɩɩ tintee-la, dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩ cho Wɩa hɔŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, guu kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, a laamɛ ta.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ, dɩ ba wɩaa vʋgʋmɛ. Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ mɩɩra dii hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sieri mɩ lɛ, leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diiba.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Ama leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ toŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ nyuŋ dɩ ba jʋjʋɔsɛ. Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ cho ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ laaba ta bʋl bʋa na-kala lɛ, “Wɩa nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala.”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ summo nɛ a bɩ mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ. Guu kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ nɩɩ pɛ mɩ lɛ, ŋ nɛ mɩ Laataara, kɔ lɩma, sɩ́ dienu.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, guu kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, a laamɛ ta.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ, dɩ ba wɩaa vʋgʋmɛ. Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ mɩɩra dii hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sieri mɩ lɛ, leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diiba.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Ama leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ toŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ nyuŋ dɩ ba jʋjʋɔsɛ. Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ cho ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ laaba ta bʋl bʋa na-kala lɛ, “Wɩa nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala.”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ summo nɛ a bɩ mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ. Guu kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ nɩɩ pɛ mɩ lɛ, ŋ nɛ mɩ Laataara, kɔ lɩma, sɩ́ dienu.

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ mɩ yuori, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diimi.

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, laamɛ ta. Jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ a laamɛ ta.

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Ŋ nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ mɩ yuori, lee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ wuo mʋ bʋa na-kala. Bʋla laamɛ ta, ŋ nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ, ŋ nɛ mɩ dɩɩ-duoŋ.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, laamɛ ta nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, laamɛ ta tʋɔhɛɛ tɩmma-la sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, mɩ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ. Mɩ laaŋ dii nɛ mɩ bapʋɔsʋŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ lʋlmɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ, mɩ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋ nɛ kɛmmɛ kaa kʋ lɩɩ mɩ naaŋ luoruŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: Nɩaa yʋga nɛ aa to mɩ naabʋɔsʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ dɩ-duoŋ mɩ yuori.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala mɩɩ dɛnnɩŋ nɛ, aa yɩrɛ ŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ mɩ kire ta lɛɛlɛ mɩ sɩ hɩɛsa ŋ-la. Sɩ́ mɩ vɩa ta mɩ doluŋ sɩ dɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: My enemies are plotting because they want me dead.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ka vʋʋrɛ mɩ wɩaa nɛ, baa chɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ, “Wɩa vɩaʋ ta nɛ, má leŋ dɩ la kire kɛnʋ. Nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ laaʋ ta.”

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ cheimi dii hɩɩsɩŋ a sʋʋ. Leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ dii nɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba ŋaamɛ wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na jaŋ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa hɛ ŋ lɛ bʋa na-kala. Mɩ jaŋ faasa dɩdɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kala mɩ jaŋ bʋl ŋ tʋɔpʋl wʋŋaalaa wɩaa, arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ laa nɩaa tɩta. Ŋ tɩmba yʋga nɛ, mɩ paala bɩ ba niiŋ wuo jɩŋ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, mɩ jaŋ heele bʋl wʋduoru-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa. Ŋ dʋndʋŋa tʋɔpʋl wʋŋaalaa wɩaa nɛ mɩ jaŋ heele bʋl.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, ŋ dagɛmɛ mɩ hambiriŋ kala lɛ nɛ. Mɩ ha heelee bʋl wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa nɛ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩ hɩɛsa nɛ, mɩ nyuŋ pʋllɛ, sɩ́ mɩ vɩa ta. Leŋ dɩ mɩ ha heele bʋl ŋ dol-bal-la wɩaa a pɩ nɩalɩŋ ba ha sɩ jaŋ lʋl.

english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, ŋ tʋɔpʋl wʋŋaalaa paala jɩla teeli wɩa-nyuŋ ma kala nɛ. Wɩa, ŋ ŋaa wʋbalaa a yʋgɛ nɛ, nʋʋkala tuo a magɩŋ.

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe mɩ na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ, ama ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ yaraa bɩra pɛ dɔŋɔ. Ŋ jaŋ kɛmmɛ lɛrɛ lɩɩsɛ buotuo-luŋuŋ deeŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ ŋaa nɩbal, a leŋ dɩ mɩ bɩra kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩ jaŋ du cheŋ a dɛnnɩŋ a tɩŋ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ wɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ du kɔnɛ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɛ ŋ-na Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a dɛnnɩŋ arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ laamɛ ta.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la kala mɩ jaŋ bʋl tʋɔpʋl wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa a pɩ nɩaa. Ŋ leŋe nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ mɩ lɛ dii hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, ba wɩaa vʋgʋmɛ.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, pɛ kuoro lɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, pɛ kuoru-bie lɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a nagɩŋ,

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ wuo beŋ ŋ nɩaa arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ a wasa nyaŋ summoo.

english_verse: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ tintee-la nɩbalaa arɩ nɩbiisiŋ kala dʋa, dɩ tʋɔpʋla hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ kuoro chɩŋ summoo harɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ, a yuo laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ ta nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyagɛba bil nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, a nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ chɛnɛ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ kuoru-la nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ nɩɩ hɛ yaŋ sɩ bumo tɔsɛ lɛ, a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ faasa nɩɩ a hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ tʋɔpʋla hɛ nɩmɛ kuoro mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa kala lɛ, dɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ a nagɛ chɛnɛ sɩ pɔsɔ chɩŋ.

english_verse: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ tintee-la ʋ sɩɩ beŋ jallɛ a chɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a mʋ yi sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, a chɩŋ fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Yufireti lɛ, a mʋ yi tinteeŋ sɛmɛ na-kala.

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Doho doho-la sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ jaŋ kpirimi kuoru-la sɩpaaŋ, dɩ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ma gbieni ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ Taasɩs tinteeŋ kuoroo arɩ tinteye-la nɩaa lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu to ʋ niiŋ a tiŋ lampoo a pʋpʋ. Leŋ dɩ tasɩ-la ma ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛba arɩ Sɩɩba kɛŋ kɩaa kʋ dii zile kuoro lɛ.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ kuoroo kala kpikpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ, dɩ tinteyee kala nɩaa tɩma pʋpʋ.

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ ta dɩ ba nɛ yele pʋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ nɩaa kɛnɛ dɩ ba pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: Kuoro ka fá puwuoloo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ nenige nɛ, a laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ ta dɩ ba sɩ́ sʋʋ.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ laaba ta nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyagɛba bil arɩ yuo-hɛɛrɛɛ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ chaasa chɩl ba mɩɩsɩŋ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ kuoro mɩɩsɩŋ duomi. Leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ lɩɩ Sɩɩba kʋʋ pʋ. Leŋ dɩ nɩaa sʋl Wɩa pʋpʋ bʋa na-kala, dɩ Wɩa pɩpɛ ʋ lɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ kʋdiilee pʋrɩgɛ tintee-la kala lɛ, dɩ mɩaa su dundolluŋ nyuŋ. Leŋ dɩ kʋdiile-la pʋrɩgɛ a nagɛ Lɛbanɔŋ peel-la kɩaa. Leŋ dɩ mɩa-la chaasa bɩɩ woruŋ a nagɛ yaŋ.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ kuoro yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, a nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ. Leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala to ʋ lɛ a na wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, a kɛnʋ yɩyɩrɛ tʋɔtɔrɛ tɩɩna.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa. Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa.

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ ʋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, a leŋ dɩ ʋ tʋla su dʋnɩa kala. Amɩɩ, Amɩɩ.

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: Jesi nanʋala Devit Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la.

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, Wɩa chaasa kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa woruŋ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Mɩ yaraa faa bieri sɩɩ-duo tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ, a tɩŋ wɩaa sɩ vɛŋ woruŋ aa pɩba.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Ba bɩ hɛɛŋ ka na, ba yaraa fɩɛla nɛ, ba kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: Sɩɩ-duoŋ nagɛ banzɔlɔ nɛ ba joŋo hɛ baŋŋaa lɛ, yuosuŋ ma nagɛ gɛrɩŋ ba joŋo laalɛ.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Ba nɛrɛ chaarɛ sɩaa nɛ kpʋrɩ kpʋrɩ, ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala kʋbɔmɔ.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Baa sieri nɩaa lɛ nɛ a bʋbʋl wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ. Ba sɩɩ-duoŋ leŋ ba fufugisi dɩ ba nyagɛ nɩaa bil.

english_verse: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
translation_verse: Ba bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tɩtɩgɛ Wɩa lɛ nɛ, a bʋbʋl sɩɩ-duo wɩaa nɩaa lɛ dʋnɩa lee na-kala.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ leŋe Wɩa nɩaa ma mɩɩra mʋ ba teeŋ a laa wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ bʋla dii.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmɔ-la bʋla, “Ɛɛ nɛ Wɩa jaŋ wuo ŋaa a jɩŋ? Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩɩ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩbɔmɔ-la nagɛ, wɩɩkala bɩ ba lɛ ŋaa, ka ba dʋa ma pʋŋa pɩpɛ.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ nɛ pʋlla, ŋɩɩ ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ, dɩ mɩ vɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ ma, ʋ ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: Chɛɛ-kala nɛ mɩɩ wɩɩlɛ, ba dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ chʋchʋɔ-na kala.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa bʋl wʋdoho-la nɩbɔmɔ-la sɩ bʋla, mɩ fa jaŋ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ ŋ nɩaa teeŋ.

english_verse: It was hard for me to understand all this!
translation_verse: Mɩ faa walɩmɛ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ wɩaa deemba bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, ama ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋduo nɛ a pɩmɛ,

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: see bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jʋʋ ŋ-na Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ nɛ, mɩ wuo jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe ba chɩŋ lere-la ba sɩ jaŋ sɩɛra tel nɛ, ŋ ŋaa ba tele nyʋgʋsɛ.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Ba guu cheiba nɛ, ba dɩdɛrɩŋ chaasa lɔrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nagɛ duosoo nɩa sɩ duoso a sii chʋchʋɔŋ a yʋ nɛ. La Tɩɩna, dɩ ŋ nɛ sie, ba jaŋ nyɩɩgɛ.

english_verse: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
translation_verse: Wɩaa fa sɩɩ wɩɩmɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ faasa chei nɛ,

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: mɩ fa yaara nɛ a bɩ wɩɩ jɩŋ. Mɩ fa nagɛ pʋna nɛ ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ mɩ hɛ bʋa na-kala ŋ kɛmmɛ arɩ ŋ naduo-la.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ dagɛmɛ nɛ kɛmmɛ bil wombiiŋ lɛ, ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ kala ŋ jaŋ laamɛ arɩ zile.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ mɩ kʋa, tinteeŋ ma lɛ, mɩ bɩ kʋŋkala ka chɛ, see ŋ dʋndʋŋ.

english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa arɩ mɩ yaraa kala jaŋ wuo pʋgʋmɛ, ama ŋ-na Wɩa nɛ mɩ doluŋ, Ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ mɩ chɩchɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩŋ kpaga jaŋ lɛl, ŋ jaŋ chei nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩŋ laa dii.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ-na teeŋ ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ kpagɛ Wɩa. La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ mɩ yuori. Mɩ jaŋ bʋl tɩntɩŋ-duoru-la ŋ sɩ tɩma wɩaa.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: Wɩa, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ vɩala ta ŋ-la? Ŋ jaŋ na baanɩŋ ŋ nɩaa nyuŋ deeŋ deeŋ?

english_verse: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
translation_verse: Liisi nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa ta faafaa kala wɩaa, ba nɛ doho-la nɩaa ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa ba ŋaa ŋ nɩaa, ŋ laaba ta. Bɩɩnɛ Zaayɔŋ peeliŋ wɩaa, lee-la ŋ fa sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: Mʋ jikpeeni-la na, la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ chei kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: Ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ chiese nɛ a jʋʋ ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ ŋ sɩ yie kɔ la teeŋ. Ba joŋ ba jɔnjɔmba pɛ nɩmɛ nɛ aa dagɛ arɩ ba yuo dii lee-la nɛ.

english_verse: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
translation_verse: Ba wʋŋaalaa nagɛ nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ saasɩŋ jʋʋ duuŋ tʋɔŋ a keri tɩɩsɩŋ lulo nɛ.

english_verse: They burned down your temple and badly disgraced it.
translation_verse: Ba nyɩgɛ ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la nɛ, aŋ ŋaa lee-la ba sɩɩ chʋɔlʋŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ lɛ ba sɩ, “La jaŋ yuo diiba gbelem gbelem.” Ba nyɩgɛ lere-la kala la sɩ hilimee dɛnnɛ Wɩa la tinteeŋ kala lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: La bɩra bɩ wʋmagɩl kala na, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa ma tuo. La kʋŋkala bɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ sɩ jaŋ diene magɛ.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: Wɩa, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ mɔmʋŋ a diene magɛ? Ba jaŋ tʋʋsɛ ŋ joŋŋoo deeŋ deeŋ koo?

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Wɩa, dɩ-suomuŋ kala nɛ ŋ ŋaa la kuoro. Ŋ nɛ laa tinteeŋ nɩaa kala ta.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: Ŋ doluŋ nɛ kɛŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ a pɔɩ balɩa, aŋ yɛrɛ peribanyeŋŋu-la sɩ hɛ lɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ nyusuŋ.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ yɛrɛ peribanyeŋŋu-la nyusuŋ, a joŋ ʋ nammɩa pɩ baga kɩaa sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ ba dii.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ leŋe lɩɩ-bul-sɩaa bubul, fuonuŋ pɩpɛllɛ. Ŋ nɛ bɩra leŋe fuo-bala-la ma sɩɩ pɛllʋ bʋa na-kala hʋ.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ tɩɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ, ŋ nɛ tɩɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ ma. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ chɛnɛ, ba chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa kpaŋkpaŋ.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ ŋaa tintee kala kɛŋ ʋ bʋa dʋnɩa lɛ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa yibiiniŋ arɩ tafaaŋ ma.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, liisi ŋɩɩ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ mɔmʋŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ nɩyaara-la sɩ tʋʋsɛ ŋ joŋŋoo.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ leŋe pɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ. Sɩ́ ŋ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛ wɩaa yʋ.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Liise yi nii-la sɩ hɛ la pɛgɛ. Nɩbɔmɔ-la sɩ cho yuosuŋ faa birimiŋ tʋɔŋ dʋnɩa loŋgoru kala lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nyaga bil dii hɩɩsɩŋ a mɩɩrɛ ŋ harɩŋ. Ama pɛ summo-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ lɛ dɩ ba dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: Wɩa, sii chɩŋ a bʋla laa ŋ tɩtɩa. Liisi ŋɩɩ nɩyaara-la sɩɩ mɔŋ ŋ lɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Wɩa, laa lɔllʋŋ, laa lɔllʋŋ a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ kpagɛla wɩaa. Nʋʋkala nɩɩ bʋl wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: You have set a time to judge with fairness.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ, “Mɩ hɛ tapʋlɩɩ nɛ dɩ mɩ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Dɩ tinteeŋ nɛ zigile, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ chel, mɩ jaŋ chagɛ ʋ gentine bil.

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ sɩɩ-duoŋ, ‘Má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa lɛ bigisu,’ aŋ bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ ma, ‘Má sɩ́ ma doluŋ lɛ bigisu.

english_verse: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma doluŋ lɛ bigise bʋl wɩaa, a chaarɛ baŋ-poloo mɩ-na Wɩa teeŋ.’ ”

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Ballɩŋ bɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ koo wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ koo tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ ka lɩɩ.

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ sarɩya diire. Ʋ nɛ yie kɛŋ nɩa dɔŋɔ muuri, aŋ kɛŋ dɔŋɔ ŋaa nɩbal.

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna baanɩŋ sie nɛ a nagɛ sɩ-duoŋ sɩ su nyʋnyʋala ʋ kori. Ʋ wansa pɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, ba nyʋa ʋ kala fɩɩp.

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ-na jaŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa deeŋ deeŋ, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɛ Jekɔb Wɩa.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ doluŋ dɛrɛ, aŋ ka tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa kɛŋ doluŋ a yʋgɛ.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Juda nɩaa jɩŋ Wɩa nɛ woruŋ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ yʋga Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩa hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ, ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ hɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: Ba laalɩyuori babiibalaa sɩ yuo laa kɩalɩŋ, ba kala nɛ ba kaa laa. Ka ba lɛɛlɛ pɩŋ a nagɛ ba sʋba, laalɩyuori babiibala-la kʋbala ma bɩ ʋ nandaa wuo kaa je.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: Jekɔb Wɩa, ŋ sɩ kpɩa ba lɛ, ba janɩŋ arɩ ba ja-jɩllaa kala tele sʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga dɩ nʋʋkala fá. Nʋʋkala bɩ ŋ sɩpaaŋ wuo chɩŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ na baanɩŋ.

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: Ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, aŋ bʋl arɩ ŋ jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya, fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa nɛ ba ŋaa fʋɩɩ,

english_verse: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
translation_verse: bʋa-la lɛ ŋ-na Wɩa, sɩ sii chɩŋ dɩ ŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya, a laa nɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ dɔgɩsʋ dʋnɩa lɛ ta.

english_verse: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa nɛ na baanɩŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ yie leŋ ŋ yɩrɩŋ faasa yɩrɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka a bɩ sʋba nɛ jaŋ gbigbieli ŋ gbiele.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Má hɛ niiriŋ a pɩ La Tɩɩna ma Wɩa, aŋ lɩɩsɛ niiri-la. Má leŋ dɩ tinteye-la nɩaa kala sɩ hɔnɔ gollima kɛŋ kɩaa kʋ ŋaa zile pɩ Nɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ba fá.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ chei sɩpaalaaraa kala bɔɩ-duo wɩaa, a leŋ tinteeŋ kuoroo kala fɩfáʋ.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: Mɩ faasa ŋmoo niiŋ pɩ Wɩa nɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, mɩ yele sʋlʋ nɛ dɩ ʋ nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Wɩaa sɩ jʋʋmɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la, mɩ sʋl La Tɩɩna nɛ. Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ nɩsaa je nɛ a sʋlʋ tɩtaŋɩŋ a bɩ lɔlɔ. Ka mɩ tʋɔŋ ha bɩ wuo pɩŋ dɩ-bala.

english_verse: When I think of you, I feel restless and weak.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩɩnɛ Wɩa wɩaa a hʋʋnɛ nɛ, a kɛŋ ʋ wʋŋaalaa ma chɔgɩsɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ, mɩ nandaasɩŋ kala yʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋɩŋ, ŋ leŋe mɩ sɩaa bɩ tɔ, wɩaa chaasa jʋʋmɛ, mɩ bɩ wɩaa wuo bʋl.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩɩna yi faafaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa tapʋlɩa-la arɩ jɩsɩ-la sɩ bala lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: “La Tɩɩna jaŋ vɩala ta deeŋ deeŋ koo? Ʋ tʋɔŋ bɩra bɩ la nyuŋ tɔrɔɔ?

english_verse: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bɩ la cho koo? Nii-la sɩ hɛ la dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ bɩra tuo koo?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Wɩa yʋa dɩ ʋ fɩfá la nenige nɛ koo? Ʋ baanɩŋ sie ʋ bɩra bɩ la chaachiliŋ ka fá koo?”

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la sɩɩ wɩɩmɛ kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ ŋ-la, Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala bɩra bɩ ʋ naduo-la kaa pɩpɛ la lɛ.”

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ liise yi wʋduoru-la La Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ liise yi wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa faafaa kala lɛ.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ wʋŋaalaa bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Vene kala tuo a nagɛ ŋ-na Wɩa.

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ, ŋ dagɛ ŋ doluŋ nɛ tinteyee nɩaa tʋɔŋ ba na.

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: Ŋ naduo-la nɛ ŋ kaa laa ŋ nɩaa ta, Jekɔb arɩ Josɛf doho nɩaa.

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: Wɩa, mʋgʋsʋŋ sɩ naŋ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba nɛ ba chel, lɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ ma jigisi.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Duonuŋ lɔgɛ jaasɛ, taŋ dʋdɔŋ wɩa-nyuŋ aŋ ka ŋ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ lɩlɩgɩsɛ leriŋ kala.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Ka ba nɩɩ ŋ dɔmɔ pel-vinvilimiŋ tʋɔŋ, leriŋ lɩgɩsɛ a leŋ dʋnɩa kala pʋllɛ. Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ tinteeŋ ʋ zigili.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: Ŋ vɛŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, wombiiŋ to lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ, ka ba bɩ ŋ naabʋɔsʋŋ na.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Ŋ daa ŋ nɩaa a nagɛ pie-laalɩŋ nɛ, a lɩɩsɛ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ ba ŋaa ba sɩpaalaaraa.

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ magɛ namagaba a dagɛ wɩalɩŋ fa sɩ faa, a chɩŋ dʋnɩa dɩ-suomuŋ.

english_verse: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ la sɩ nɩa aŋ jɩŋ ma, wɩalɩŋ la naabalɩmaba sɩ bʋla pɩla.

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: La bɩ jaŋ joŋo faa la biiriŋ, la jaŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ ba ha sɩ jaŋ lʋl, wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa a magɛ dɩ la dɛnnʋ, ʋ doluŋ arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa dagɛ Jekɔb nɛ, a leŋ ʋ wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ Iziral lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩ la naabalɩmaba, ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɩ ba joŋo dagɛ ba biiriŋ,

english_verse: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
translation_verse: dɩ ba biiri-la ma ba sɩ jaŋ lʋl jɩmba a bɩra joŋo dagɛ ba biiriŋ dɩ ba ma jɩmba, dɩ ba ma joŋo dagɛ ba biiri-la ba sɩ jaŋ lʋl,

english_verse: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ba joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ Wɩa lɛ, a sɩ́ ʋ wʋŋaalaa yʋ, aŋ tuto wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori-babiibalaa fa lɩɩ Efirem a vɔɔ tʋɔnʋŋ a kori tosuŋ arɩ hɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ, ama tapʋlɩɩ-la laalɩŋ sɩ sie, ba mɩɩra fá nɛ.

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: Ba fa bɩ nii-la Wɩa sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ ka to a vɩa dɩ ba to wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto.

english_verse: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
translation_verse: Ba fa yʋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa nɛ, wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa dagɛba.

english_verse: he did for their ancestors near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: Wɩa fa ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa ba naabalɩmaba sɩɩŋ lɛ nɛ, Ijipiti tinteeŋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zʋaŋ.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa kɛŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ a kpaa balɩa nɛ, lɩɩ-la sii chɩŋ a nagɛ jebiiŋ, ka ba to ʋ tʋɔŋ lɩɩ.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Wɩɩhɛyɛ ʋ laa ba sɩpaaŋ a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ, tɩtaŋɩŋ ma ʋ nagɛ jebiiŋ sɩ ŋaa nyiniŋ a kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ laa ba sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: Wɩa fa leŋe bʋŋ yɛrɛ nɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ lɩɩ a nagɛ fuoŋ ʋ nɩaa nyʋa.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Ka ba ha vɩa Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala niiŋ, aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɛnɛ nɛ aŋ magɩsɛ Wɩa, a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ pɩba kʋdiile-la ba sɩɩ hɩɛnʋ.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: Ba fa lɩɩ Wɩa harɩŋ nɛ a pɩɛsɛ, “Wɩa jaŋ wuo pɩla kʋdiilee tintee-hɩlɩŋ deeŋ lɛ?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ sɩ ŋmoo bʋŋ, lɩɩŋ gbu lɩɩ nɛ, a pɛllɛ nagɛ fuoŋ. Ama ʋ jaŋ wuo pɩla kʋdiilee maa? Ʋ jaŋ wuo pɩ ʋ nɩaa nammɩaa?”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩ nɩa dɩ ba bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ chaasa na baanɩŋ, a joŋ nyiniŋ wurisi Jekɔb doho nɩaa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ka ʋ baanɩŋ ha sisii ba nyuŋ,

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ Wɩa laa dii, koo a laa dii dɩ ʋ jaŋ wuo laaba ta.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Ka Wɩa ha bʋl wɩaa wɩa-nyuŋ a leŋ Wɩa-jaŋ borusuŋ suri.

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaaraa kʋdiilee nɛ nuhuobiinee dii, ʋ fa pɩba kʋdiilee magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ba sɩɩ chɛ nɛ.

english_verse: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋ diibiisiŋ kʋ su leriŋ a nagɛ hagɩla sɩ pɩŋ mʋga niiŋ, nammɩa pʋrɩgɛ a nagɛ hagɩlɩ-biee.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: Wɩa leŋe ba kʋ tuu su ba buguŋ nɛ, a golli ba lɛŋŋɛɛ kala.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Ba fa chaŋ nammɩa a magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ba sɩɩ chɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa fa pɩba magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ hɩɛnʋ nɛ.

english_verse: But before they had swallowed the last bite,
translation_verse: Ba chaŋ aŋ ha bɩ ba naŋ-hɩɛnɩŋ kpʋa, aŋ chɩchaŋ wuu.

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa na baanɩŋ Iziral tɩmma-la nyuŋ, a kpʋ ba nɩduoruŋ arɩ ba bapʋɔsɛ-zɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.
translation_verse: Wɩa fa ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ deemba kala nɛ, ka nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka ha vɩa aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ba fa bɩ ʋ laa dii.

english_verse: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa keri ba mɩɩsɩŋ tapʋlaa ta, ba jɩsɩŋ kala lɛ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ kpʋ ba dɔnsʋŋ bʋa na-kala, nɩkaana-la yie mɩɩra chɛ ʋ leriŋ nɛ, a bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: Ba yie liise yi arɩ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala nɛ ŋaa ba dɩ-duoŋ arɩ ba Laataara.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Ama niiŋ nɛ ba kala fa kaa nyɩsɛ Wɩa, wʋtɩtɩɩ kala tuo ba lɛ.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa fa ha fá ʋ nɩaa nenige nɛ, a joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba, a bɩ ba cheye. Naansɩɩŋ yʋga nɛ ʋ sɩ nyalɩma a bɩ baanɩŋ ka na ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: Ʋ liise arɩ ba ŋaa kɩa sɩɩ sʋʋ nɛ, ba bɩ dieni, a nagɛ peliŋ sɩ yie lu bal ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, ba yie lɩɩ Wɩa harɩŋ nɛ a ŋaa ʋ tʋɔŋ chei.

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Ba fa magɩsɛ Iziral Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ halɩɩ, ʋ baanɩŋ sii. Ʋ tʋɔŋ chei.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Ba fa bɩ liise yi ʋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ lɛ, arɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ laaba ta ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ arɩ wʋmagɩlaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ, lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zʋaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa leŋe ba fuonuŋ arɩ fuonaasɩŋ lɩɩŋ kala bɩrɩmɛ chalɩŋ nɛ, ba bɩ wuo nyʋa.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋ nanchʋɔsʋŋ kʋ su ba leriŋ, a bɩra leŋ sɔrɔɔ ma kʋ su lee-la kala a chichei ba tinteeŋ.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bɩra leŋe duoŋ-tabɩaa kʋ tuu tel nɛ, a chei ba girep tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ba tutogusuŋ

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: aŋ kpʋ ba nɛsɩŋ kala. Ka duonuŋ ma kpɩa a kpʋ ba pʋŋ-kaanaa kala.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: Wɩa fa chaasa na baanɩŋ nɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ woruŋ. Ʋ yaraa hosi ba nyuŋ, ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ ŋaa ʋ tɩndaaraa kʋ tuu cheiba kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.
translation_verse: Ʋ baaŋ-la fa bɩ fɩɛla, ʋ bɩra bɩ leŋe nɩalɩŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ ma, ama ʋ leŋe nyanyal-bɔŋ nɛ kpʋba.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩaa lɩɩ a nagɛ pie-laalɩŋ, a kɛmba kaa to tintee-hɩlɩŋ a mʋ.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa beŋ ba nyuŋ nɛ woruŋ, fawʋllʋŋ bɩ ba kɛnɛ, ama aŋ leŋ mʋga sii kʋ tɔ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ-na kala lɛ.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa kɛmba kaa mʋ tintee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, a kɛmba kaa mʋ ʋ tɩtɩa sɩ yuo laa tintee-la peelee sɩ gollo chu.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɩaa sɩ kɔ, ʋ kiri tinteye-la nɩaa fa sɩ hɔŋ nɩmɛ ta, aŋ kɛŋ ba tinteeŋ kpaa a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ba doho doho. Ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ, ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ fa ha magɩsɛ Wɩa nɛ, a vɩa Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala, a bɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga ka to.

english_verse: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
translation_verse: Ba lɩɩ ʋ harɩŋ a nagɛ ba naabalɩmaba fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ba fa golibo nɛ a nagɛ toŋ sɩ golibo, ŋ bɩ ŋ yɩɛlaa wuo joŋo hɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ ba vesiŋ dɩ-kpaarɩŋ ŋaa Wɩa na baanɩŋ, ba vʋɩya-la kpaarɩŋ ŋaa ʋ yaraa bibieri.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩa fa sɩ na wɩalɩŋ, ʋ baanɩŋ faasa sii ʋ chaasa vɩa ʋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ vɩa ʋ dɩa-la ma sɩ hɛ Sɩlɔ lɛ ta, lee-la ʋ sɩ yie hɛ a guoli nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋ ba kpʋ ʋ nɩaa laalɩŋ lɛ ʋ fa chaasa na baanɩŋ nɛ ʋ nɩtɩɩlaa nyuŋ.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: Bapʋɔsɩ-biisiŋ kala nɛ ba fa kpʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, aŋ ka hatoloo bɩ baalaa na dɩ ba jaa.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Ba kpʋ ba Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kala, aŋ pɔ dɩ ba yo-haalaa sɩ́ yel.

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: Ʋ kiri ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ pɛgɛ lɛ, a leŋ ba dii hɩɩsɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ ka La Tɩɩna vɩa Josɛf doho nɩaa ta, ʋ bɩ Efirem doho nɩaa ma lɩɩsa.

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: Ʋ mɩɩra lɩɩsɛ Juda doho nɩaa nɛ, peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ, lee-la ʋ sɩ cho.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ saa ʋ dɩa, ʋ leŋie nagɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, ʋ leŋ ʋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ, a nagɛ tinteeŋ sɩ chɩŋ ŋɩɩ kpaŋkpaŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: Ʋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩntɩnna Devit, ʋ fa lɩɩsʋ piesee harɩŋ nɛ,

english_verse: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛnʋ kɔ ʋ ŋaa ʋ tɩtɩa nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro, a beŋ ba nyuŋ, arɩ pie-daara sɩ yie beŋ piesee nyuŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: Devit fa beŋ ba nyuŋ arɩ tʋɔ-bala nɛ, a pɔba woruŋ arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: Wɩa, vʋɩ-kpaaraa kʋ yuo laa ŋ tinteeŋ nɛ, a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ, a leŋ Jerusalɛm kala pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa kʋsʋʋnʋŋ a pɩ duunuŋ nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɛɩ ŋ niiŋ yaraa bɩrɩmɛ gɩrɩŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dii nammɩa kʋdiilee.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: Ba chalɩŋ jaasɛ a pɛllɛ Jerusalɛm kala lɛ a nagɛ lɩɩŋ. Nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ joŋ ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ hugi.

english_verse: Every nation around us sneers and makes fun.
translation_verse: Tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ gollila tʋʋsɛla, a mɔnla, aŋ sisieri la lɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋŋ chɛ dɩ ŋ na baanɩŋ la nyuŋ a kaa mʋ wuu nɛɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ baanɩŋ jaŋ faasa sii la nyuŋ a diene magɛ?

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Mɩɩra na baanɩŋ tinteye-la nɩaa nyuŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩŋ jɩŋ, kuoru-gentisi-la sɩ bɩ ŋ ka chʋɔlɛ nyuŋ.

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ kpʋ ŋ nɩaa, Jekɔb doho nɩaa, aŋ leŋ ba tinteeŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ la naabalɩmaba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa tɩma dɔgɩsɛla. Guu fá la nenige lɛɛlɛ, la bɩra bɩ yɩɛlaa kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: Wɩa, la Laataara, pɛ la lɛ a tɩŋ ŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ wɩaa. Laala ta, a joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛla a tɩŋ ŋ yɩrɩŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ pɩɛsɛla, “Nɩɩ nɛ ma Wɩa hɛ?” Leŋ dɩ la na dɩ ŋ yuo dii tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnaa.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Jegile nɩɩ ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ huunu, a kɛŋ ŋ dol-bal-la laaba ta dɩ ba sɩ́ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, joŋ tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ tʋʋsʋŋ jomo-la chɩmɩŋ a tiŋ ba lɛ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: La-na ŋ nɩaa jaŋ lʋlɔllʋŋ bʋa na-kala lɛ. La nagɛ piesee nɛ, ŋ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ daala. Nɩalɩŋ ma ba ha sɩ jaŋ lʋl jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ laa dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa a nagɛ pie-daara sɩɩ beŋ ʋ piesee, jegile nɩɩ la teeŋ. Ŋ nɛ laa Josɛf doho nɩaa sɩpaaŋ a bibemba. Ŋ hɔŋ kɩalɩŋ balɩa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ pɛgɛ nɛ, leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋla chaanɛ Efirem, Bɛnjamɩŋ

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: arɩ Manasɛ doho doho nɩaa sɩpaaŋ. Sii arɩ ŋ doluŋ a kʋ laala ta.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Wɩa, kɛnla mɩɩra kɔ, a suri ŋ sɩaa pɩla dɩ la na wiese.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ nɩaa Wɩɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ baanɩŋ sii ba nyuŋ a diene magɛ?
