english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe tʋɔ-cheeŋ nɛ ŋaa ba kʋdiilee, sɩlɩɩrɩŋ ma ŋaa ba lɩɩ-nyʋalʋŋ.

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe la ŋaa mɔmɩa nɛ tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ gollila teeŋ, la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sisieri la lɛ.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, kɛnla mɩɩra kɔ, a suri ŋ sɩaa pɩla dɩ la na wiese.

english_verse: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
translation_verse: La nagɛ girep tɩa nɛ, ŋ kɛnla kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋ kiri tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ nɩaa nɛ aŋ jonla chɔnsɛ.

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: Ŋ wasɛ leriŋ gollu nɛ, ʋ naapoloo tuu tinteeŋ woruŋ, ʋ jɛrɛ laa tintee-la kala.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Ʋ fɩɛlɩŋ tɔ peelee, ʋ naakelee ma jɩla kieli kuoli-duduosuŋ.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: Ʋ naakelee jɛrɛ mʋ yi mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediterenia, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Yufireti fuoŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ ŋmoo jebii-la ba sɩ saa gollu a lo? Lɛɛlɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kʋ to lee-la aa bal, ʋ jaŋ wuo tɔrɛ ʋ nɛnɛɛ.

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Baga toonuŋ lɩɩ duuŋ tʋɔŋ a yigi tɩa-la lo nɛ, baga kɩaa didii.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: Wɩa, doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, mɩɩra kɔ la teeŋ. Ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, gʋra bee na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa tɩa-la lɛ.

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: Ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ chɔnsʋ a leŋ ʋ naapoloo tuu tinteeŋ. Ŋ leŋ ʋ waa a ŋaa ŋ kʋŋ.

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: La dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ keri tɩa-la lo nɛ a joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ. Na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ a cheiba.

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Ama chu tɔ nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ dɩɛsa lɛ, ʋ ŋaa ŋ tɩtɩa nʋʋ, a hɔŋ ŋ nadiiŋ.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Kɛnla bɩrɩmɛ a pɩla mɩɩ-falɩŋ, dɩ la bɩra sɩ́ ŋ harɩŋ mɩɩrʋ aŋ dɩdɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, kɛnla mɩɩra kɔ, a suri ŋ sɩaa pɩla dɩ la wuo na wiese.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a pɩ Wɩa sɩ leŋe la kɛŋ doluŋ. Má ŋaa goŋ a dɛnnɛ Jekɔb Wɩa.

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩla-la a chɩgɩsɛ chɩnchɩgɩsɩŋ, a du chenni-la sɩ sɩma arɩ kɔnɛba a hɛ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Má ŋmʋʋ nyile a suomi chɛŋ-falɩŋ arɩ bʋa-la lɛ chɛnɛ sɩ gullo dɛrɛ la gbiele tapʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa wombii nɛ ba bil Iziral lɛ dɩ baa to a ŋaa wɩɩ Jekɔb Wɩa sɩ sɩ dɩ ba tuto,

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ mʋ yuo laaba, a kɛmba lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ bil nii-la a pɩ Josɛf doho nɩaa nɛ dɩ ba tuto. Nɩmɛ nɛ la nɩɩ yikoro-la la sɩ bɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: Yikoro-la bʋla, “Mɩ dʋɔrɛ chʋgʋ-yuŋii-la sɩ daŋ ma vaasɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ma nɩsɩŋ bɩra tuo sime-la lɛ.

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Hɛɛŋ sɩ jʋʋma, ma yɩrɛmɛ, mɩ hɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tʋɔŋ nɛ, aŋ nɩɩ a laama ta. Mɛrɩba lɩɩrɩ-la leriŋ, mɩ magɩsɛma.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩmma, má nɩɩ, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ chagɩlɛma nɛ, mɩ cho dɩ ma jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma kpaarɛ vene kala. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma kpirimi vene sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ nɛ kɛmma kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Má faasa suri niiŋ dɩ mɩ pɩma kʋdiilee.

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: Ama mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩ chɛ dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, ba bɩ chɛ dɩ ba joŋ ba tɩtɩa pɩmɛ.

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ lemba ta ba ŋɩŋaa ba nyu-duo wɩaa, a tuto ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa harɩŋ.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɩaa nɛ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, dɩ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla,

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna jaŋ guu yuo dii ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, mɩ jaŋ chei ma dʋndɔmɔ-la arɩ mɩ doluŋ.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɛrɛ mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna jaŋ kʋ gbieni mɩ sɩpaaŋ, ba hɛɛŋ bɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Ama ma-na Iziral tɩŋŋaa, mɩ jaŋ dɩɛsɛma arɩ kʋdii-zɔŋŋɔɔ, a leŋ dɩ ma dii bʋ-bʋa tʋʋŋ a vɔgɛ.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Wɩa hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ nɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ, aŋ yɩrɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa hilimi a dii ba sarɩya a bʋla pɩba,

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: “Má sɩ́ wɩaa mʋɔla tɔ, a sɩ́ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Má chɩŋ summoo, biisinsiŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ harɩŋ, dɩ ba na wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba na.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Má lorigo laa puwuoloo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ ta nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ, a bɩ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ ma jɩŋ. Ma hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Dʋnɩa gentine kala ka jigisi nɛ.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ, ‘Ma kala nagɛmɛ nɛ, ma ŋaa mɩ-na Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala biiriŋ nɛ,’

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: Ama ma jaŋ sʋʋ a nagɛ nɩaa sɩɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ sʋʋ kuoroo sɩɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Wɩa, sii a dii dʋnɩa nɩaa kala sarɩya, ŋ nɛ tɩɩ tintee kala nɩaa.

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: Wɩa, sɩ́ ŋ niiŋ tɔrʋ, Wɩa, sɩ́ chɩm hɔŋ a bɩ wɩɩ ka ŋaa.

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ hoso nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛrɩŋ kɛŋ sɩɩ-duoŋ a lɩɩ ŋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ, “Má kɔ, má leŋ dɩ la chei ba tintee-la, dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa yɩrɩŋ bɩra sɩ́ yɩrʋ.”

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Ba niiŋ ŋaa kʋbala nɛ ba vʋʋrɛ. Ba pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ dɩ ba ŋaa wɩɩ-la ba sɩ vʋʋra a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
translation_verse: Ba nɩalɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa, Ɩsɩmɛl tɩŋŋaa, Mʋab tɩŋŋaa arɩ Hagi tɩŋŋaa,

english_verse: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
translation_verse: Gɛbal tɩŋŋaa, Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa, Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa arɩ Taaya tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
translation_verse: Asiiria tɩŋŋaa ma pɛ ba lɛ nɛ. Ba nɛ Lɔt doho nɩaa nɩduoruŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Joŋ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa Midiaŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ, a ŋaa ba lɛ, wɩɩ-la ŋ fa sɩ joŋo ŋaa Sɩsɛra arɩ Jabɩŋ sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ lɛ, Kɩsɔŋ fuo-la lɛ.

english_verse: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.
translation_verse: Ŋ fa kpʋba Ɛndɔ lɛ nɛ, ba pɩŋ nɩmɛ pʋa.

english_verse: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
translation_verse: Joŋ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa Ɔrɛb arɩ Zɛɛb lɛ a ŋaa ba nɩbalaa lɛ. Leŋ dɩ ba sɩpaalaaraa kala wɩɩŋ nagɛ Zɛba arɩ Zalɩmʋna.

english_verse: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
translation_verse: Ba kala sɩ, “Má leŋ la yuo laa Wɩa tintee-la, dɩ ʋ ŋaa la kʋŋ.”

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋmooba pɩsɛ dɩ ba nagɛ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ, a nagɛ mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ peliŋ sɩ paa viiri.

english_verse: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ nyiniŋ sɩ yie joŋ duuŋ koo peeliŋ nyuŋ a kɔlɩmɛ ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ wɩaa kiriba arɩ ŋ pel-lɩmɩŋ ŋɩɩ dɩ ba fá, leŋ dɩ ŋ duoŋ-peliŋ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba.

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diiba, dɩ ba mɩɩra kɔ ŋ teeŋ a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diiba deeŋ deeŋ dɩ ba wɩaa kala vʋgʋmɛ. Leŋ dɩ ba sʋʋ arɩ hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba jɩŋ arɩ ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala a hɛ nɩmɛ a bibeŋ dʋnɩa kala.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ cho ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la,

english_verse: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
translation_verse: mɩ fa cho dɩ mɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ. Mɩɩ hɩɛnɛ dɩ mɩ hɛ La Tɩɩna dɩa tʋɔŋ nɛ, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a pɩ ŋ-na Wɩa sɩ weye.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, sɩ ŋaa mɩ Wɩa arɩ mɩ Kuoro, zaarɩ-kokobiisiŋ kɛŋ dɩjʋʋlaa nɛ, ŋ korunuŋ bʋbʋɔŋ. Tɩɩtɩɩba ma saa dɛllɩŋ nɩmɛ a bil ba biiriŋ dɩdɩɛsɛ.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ, bʋa na-kala ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɩdɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ joŋ doluŋ pa, ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ ba cho dɩ ba mʋmʋ Zaayɔŋ.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋ to fuonaa hɩlɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baga, ʋ bɩrɩmɛ lɩɩ-bul sɩaa nɛ, duoŋ-puso nɩɩ, ʋ vil-biisiŋ kala su.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Ba doluŋ fa pʋŋa pɛ nɛ a mʋmʋ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ mʋ chɩŋ ŋ-na Wɩa sɩpaaŋ Zaayɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, nɩɩ mɩ sʋla, Jekɔb Wɩa, jegili mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: Ŋ-na Wɩa nɛ chu tɔla, beŋ nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa nyuŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ tapʋl bala ma, ʋ jaŋ kpɩa tapʋlaa bʋɩ leriŋ dɔŋɔ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ yaara pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ boiŋ niiŋ, ʋ nɛ jaŋ kpɩa mɩ sɩ hɛ nɩbɔmʋŋ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nɛ la teeŋ a chu tɔla. La Tɩɩna kɛŋ chonuŋ arɩ zile, ʋ bɩ kʋzɔŋ kala joŋo faa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, nɩɩ-la sɩ laaŋ dii tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ pɛ ŋ tinteeŋ nɩaa lɛ nɛ woruŋ, a leŋ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩ Jekɔb doho nɩaa.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Ŋ joŋ ŋ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba nɛ a gbaa tɔ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: Ŋ fa sɩ faasa na baaŋ-la ba nyuŋ, ŋ joŋo ta nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: Wɩa, la Laataara, kɛnla mɩɩra kɔ dɩa. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ chei la nyuŋ.

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ jaŋ pɩla mɩɩ-falɩŋ a leŋ dɩ ŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ nyuŋ?

english_verse: Show us your love and save us!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, dagɛla ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, aŋ laala ta.

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ jaŋ bʋl. Ʋ sɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laaʋ dii hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ, dɩ la nɛ bɩra bɩ nɩyaarɩ wɩaa ka ŋaa.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa siri nɛ dɩ ʋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fáʋ a ta, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ tʋla wuo hɛ la tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Chonuŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ jaŋ cheŋ dɔŋɔ, dɩ tʋɔpʋla arɩ yarɩ-fɩɛlɩŋ ma guori dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ jaŋ yʋgɛ tinteeŋ lɛ, ka dɩ tʋɔpʋla hɛ wɩa-jaŋ a chugili.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ pɩla dɩ la tinteeŋ kʋpɛrɛɛ wasɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl wʋŋaalaa nɛ jaŋ laa La Tɩɩna sɩpaaŋ, a wasɛ wombiiŋ pʋ.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ La Tɩɩna, jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ ŋaa summu arɩ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Pɔ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ, a laamɛ ta dɩ mɩ sɩ́ sʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩɩ toŋ nɛ. Ŋ nɛ mɩ Wɩa, laa ŋ tɩntɩnna ta. Mɩ laaŋ dii nɛ.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, fá mɩ nenige, mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ pɩpɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ kala nɛ.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna leŋ dɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa kala hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: Ŋ wɩaa zɔmɔ, ŋ joŋ wɩaa ma a chɩchɛ nɩaa. La Tɩɩna, ŋ chonuŋ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ chʋɔlʋŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋmɛ, mɩ yie yɩrɩŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ jegilee nɩɩ mɩ sʋla nɛ.

english_verse: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.
translation_verse: Vene kala tuo a nagɛ ŋ-na La Tɩɩna. Kʋŋkala tuo a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ ta tinteyee nɩaa kala, La Tɩɩna, ba jaŋ kʋ kpirimi ŋ sɩpaaŋ a dɛnnɩŋ, ba jaŋ yɩrɛ ŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa a kɛŋ doluŋ, a ŋɩŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ.

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, dagɛmɛ ŋ wombiiŋ, dɩ mɩ toŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ tʋɔ-bala a fɩfá ŋ-na Wɩa.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala. Mɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ ŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Ŋ chomi nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ a chu tɔ mɩ lɛ, a laamɛ ta mɩ bɩ sʋba.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: Wɩa, sɩɩ-duo tɩŋŋaa ka yuomi nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɔmɔ kɩŋkɛŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ aa chɛ dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ, ba bɩŋ kaa tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ zile a fɩfá nɩaa nenige. Ŋ baanɩŋ bɩ lɩma lɩma ka sii, ŋ kɛŋ chonuŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, daasɛ mɩ teeŋ a fá mɩ nenige, joŋ ŋ doluŋ pɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna. Laa mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna nanʋala ta.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, dagɛmɛ ŋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ magɩlɩŋ, dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ na, dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmba. Ŋ-na La Tɩɩna nɛ pɛ mɩ lɛ a leŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Wɩa bil ʋ tabal-la gentine peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ baa yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna cho Zaayɔŋ a kɩɩ lere-la kala Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ jʋʋ.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ, ŋ ŋaa Wɩa taŋ nɛ, nʋʋkala bʋl wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a tɩtɩgɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ dɩɩsɛ Ijipiti a pɛ tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ jɩmmɛ lɛ. Ba nɛ: Babɩlɔŋ, Fɩlɩsɩtɩa, Fɔnɩɩsɩa arɩ Itoopia. Nɩaa jaŋ bʋl ba lʋl ba ma Zaayɔŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ jaŋ-la sɩ chɩŋ Zaayɔŋ lɛ kɛŋ doluŋ, dɩ nʋʋkala bʋl, “Ba lʋlla ma nɩmɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ ŋmʋnsɛ nɩaa yɩraa, dɩ ba ma ŋaa Zaayɔŋ nɩaa.

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a gʋgʋa a bʋl, “La kʋzɔŋ-kala lɩɩ Zaayɔŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa mɩ Laataara, tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala nɛ mɩɩ ŋmoo niiŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ dɩ ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, jegile nɩɩ mɩ sʋla, a nɩɩ mɩ nii-ŋmobo a pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Wɩaa jʋʋmɛ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, mɩ dɩ sʋʋŋ kpagɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
translation_verse: Ŋ jommi hɛ buotuo luŋuŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ hɛ lee-la sɩ chaasa luŋ a kɛŋ birimiŋ.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Ŋ baanɩŋ sii mɩ nyuŋ a yʋgɛ nɛ, a nagɛ lɩɩ-pel-duoŋ sɩ jommi.

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe mɩ nandɔŋ fɩɛmaa vɩamɛ ta nɛ, mɩ ŋaa nɩtɔɔ ba teeŋ. Mɩ gʋrɛ dɩa lɛ nɛ, mɩ bɩ wuo lɩɩ.

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, tʋɔ-cheeŋ leŋe mɩ sɩaa bɩra bɩ na woruŋ. Mɩ je mɩ nɩsaa nɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala a sʋsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ a pɩpɩ sʋʋnʋŋ nɛɛ? Sʋʋnʋŋ yie sii dɛnnɩŋ nɛɛ?

english_verse: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ba bɩ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa ka bʋl bʋa tʋɔŋ. Ba bɩ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ ma wɩaa ka bʋl lee-la nɩaa sɩɩ pʋa.

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: Birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nʋʋkala bɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa ka na. Tintee-la ma nɩaa wɩaa ba sɩ yʋa, bɩ tʋɔpʋl wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa ka na.

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ vɩamɛ ta, a joŋ harɩŋ yɩamɛ?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Mɩ hambiriŋ kala lɛ, mɩ na hɛɛŋ nɛ, a ka mʋa dɩ mɩ sʋba. Ŋ leŋe fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ, mɩ na hɛɛŋ a bɩra bɩ wɩɩkala wuo ŋaa.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Ŋ baanɩŋ nagɛ lɩɩ-pel-duoŋ nɛ a tɔmɛ, fawʋlɩbɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ cheimi nɛ.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe mɩ nandɔnsʋŋ arɩ mɩ toori dɔsʋŋ vɩamɛ nɛ, ka birimiŋ lɛɛlɛ ŋaa mɩ nandɔŋ-fɩɛmɩŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a tɩgɛ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ lɛ, a kaa mʋ wuu. Mɩ jaŋ heele bʋl ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la wɩaa, dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma ba ha sɩ jaŋ lʋl sii nɩɩ.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba jɩŋ arɩ ŋ chono-la chaasa chɩŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ ma chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ a nagɛ wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Ŋ bʋla, “Mɩ bil niiŋ nɛ mɩ dɩ nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa pɛgɛ, mɩ ŋmɩɛsa pɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit nɛ a bʋl,

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a mʋ tɩgɛ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa lɛ nɛ. Wɩa tɩndaaraa ma dɛnnɩŋ a tɩgɛ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ.

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Ŋ tɩndaaraa kala tʋɔŋ, ŋ-na Wɩa nɛ ba chaasaa fá woruŋ. Kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ golluŋ ka fáŋ nɛ, ŋ nɛ kɩɩ ba kala.

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, kʋbɛɛ nɛ magɩŋ? La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: You rule the roaring sea and calm its waves.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɩɩ beŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ, dɩ ʋ lɩɩ pel-duoŋ nɛ sie, ŋ yie ŋaa ʋ sigili nɛ.

english_verse: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ kɛŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ baŋgarɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rahab keri muno muno a nagɛ kʋa ba sɩ kpʋa, aŋ kɛŋ ŋ naduo-la ŋmoo ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ pɩsɛ.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ tɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa dʋnɩa arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋla arɩ tɛŋɛ nɛ ŋaa ŋ kuoruŋ gentine, ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ma nɛ laa ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, nɩalɩŋ sɩ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɩdɛnnɩŋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ vɛŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ pʋlʋŋ-la lɛ.

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: Baa jʋɔsɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ aa dɛnnɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ kala, ŋ tʋɔpʋl wʋŋaalaa nɛ laa yɩrɩŋ pɩpɩba.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ ŋaa ba tʋla arɩ ba doluŋ. Ŋ chonuŋ nɛ leŋe la wasa kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ lɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ pɔla, a pɩla. Ŋ-na Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ŋ nɛ lɩɩsɛ la kuoro pɩla.

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Faafaa-la ŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laaŋ dii, ŋ bʋla, “Mɩ joŋ doluŋ pɩ laalɩyuori-duo nɛ. Mɩ lɩɩsɛ bapʋɔsɩ-bie nɛ mɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ ʋ laa yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
translation_verse: Mɩ lɩɩsɛ mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit nɛ, a joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ tɩsʋ, ʋ dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ bʋa na-kala, a pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: Ʋ dʋndɔŋ kala bɩ jaŋ wuo yuo diiu. Nɩbɔŋ ma kala bɩ jaŋ wuo nyagʋ bil.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋrɩgɛ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ʋ sɩpaaŋ, a kpʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɛrʋ.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Mɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ mɩ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ jaŋ hɛ ʋ teeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ tinteye-la ma kala sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balaa arɩ fuonuŋ cholo.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ yɩrɛmɛ a bʋl, ‘Ŋ nɛ mɩ Nyɩmma, mɩ Wɩa, mɩ dɩ-duoŋ arɩ mɩ Laataara.’

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ hambolibii bumbuŋ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ laa yɩrɩŋ a kɩɩ kuorusu-la kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chou a kaa mʋ wuu. Nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ birige.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: Ʋ kuoruŋ jaŋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, a nagɛ wɩa-nyuŋ sɩ chɩŋ ŋɩɩ. Bʋa na-kala lɛ, ʋ doho nʋʋ nɛ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ Devit doho nɩaa nɛ bɩ mɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile ka to, a bɩ mɩ wʋbʋlaa kaa tɩtɩŋ,

english_verse: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
translation_verse: mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, ba jaŋ na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ chono-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ arɩ Devit dɛrɛ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nii-la mɩ sɩ hɛ pʋ birigi.

english_verse: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ chei nii-la mɩ sɩ bile mɩ dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ, koo a lɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla harɩŋ.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: Mɩ chaasa ŋmɩɛsɛ bala nɛ mɩ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ lɛ a pɩ Devit, mɩ bɩ jaŋ nyɩɛ wɩaa pʋ.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: Ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ didii kuoruŋ bʋa na-kala. Mɩ sɩpaaŋ, ʋ kuoruŋ jaŋ chɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu a nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ sɩ chɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ vɩa kuoru-la nɛ a kɛnʋ gbesi, ŋ na baanɩŋ nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Ŋ chei nii-la ŋ sɩ bile ŋ dɩ ŋ tɩntɩnna pɛgɛ nɛ, aŋ suri ʋ kuoru nyunchuulo ta tinteeŋ ʋ birisi.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋmoo jebie-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ ʋ tabalɩŋ a lo nɛ, a leŋ ʋ dɩɩ-duoruŋ kala pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ kʋʋ bal pɩpaa ʋ kɩaa. Ʋ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ mɔmɩɩ nɛ a pɩ ʋ pɛ-jʋʋraa kala.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diiu nɛ, ŋ leŋe ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala jʋɔsɛ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛŋ kuoro tokobiiŋ niiŋ bɩrɩmɛ nɛ, aŋ leŋ ba yuo diiu laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛŋ ʋ kuoru dantɩga laa ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa ma bɩrɩma chu.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe ʋ guu hɩɛsɛ nɛ, ŋ joŋ hɩɩsɩŋ gɛrɩŋ laalʋ.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ faa a diene magɛ? Ŋŋ chɛ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa faa deeŋ deeŋ nɛɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ baanɩŋ jaŋ sii nagɛ nyiniŋ a diene magɛ?

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: Liise yi mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ sɩ bɩ duomi lɛ, ŋ ŋaa nuhuobiinee kala dɩ ba sʋsʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ, koo a laa ʋ tɩtɩa sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ?

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, nɩɩ nɛ ŋ faafaa kala chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ hɛ, kʋ-la ŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a ŋmɩɛsa pɩ Devit?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: Liise yi ŋɩɩ ba sɩ sieri ŋ tɩntɩnna lɛ, ŋɩɩ tinteye-la kala nɩaa sɩ tʋʋsɛmɛ.

english_verse: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa, ama ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kire to mɩ harɩŋ nɛ a mʋmɔmmɛ lee-kala mɩ sɩ yie mʋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ, Amɩɩ.

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ la dɩjʋʋlʋŋ bʋa na-kala a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Ka dɩ ŋ-na ŋaa peelee, koo a ŋaa tinteeŋ arɩ dʋnɩa bʋa-la kala lɛ, ŋ nɛ Wɩa a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ yie ŋaa nuhuobiine sʋʋ, a bɩrɩmɛ tɩɛrɩ-la ŋ sɩ lɔgɔ mɛʋ.

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Jɩsɩŋ bʋɩ nagɛ tapʋl-bala nɛ ŋ teeŋ. Ba yie nagɛ tapʋlʋŋ sɩ bala nɛ, koo tɩtaŋɩŋ hawaba baŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Ŋ yie leŋ nuhuobiine mɩɩsɩŋ guu dɛrɛ nɛ a nagɛ nɩa sɩ pɩŋ doŋ a duosi. La nagɛ chʋchʋɔŋ ya-mulo nɛ.

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: Chʋchʋɔŋ ba yie ŋaa yulo yulo a wʋwaa, ama dɩdaanɩŋ ba ŋmaamɛ a hɩl.

english_verse: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
translation_verse: Ŋ baanɩŋ ka cheila nɛ, a joŋ fawʋllʋŋ hɩhɛ la lɛ.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɛ, wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ lʋara ŋaa.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: Ŋ baanɩŋ keri la tapʋlaa ta nɛ, la jɩsɩŋ dɛrɛ a nagɛ nɩa sɩ wiesi peliŋ ta.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: La jɩsɩŋ ŋaa mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii nɛ, koo mahɩŋ banɛsɛ dɩ la nɛ ha kɛŋ doluŋ. Ama ba tʋɔŋ, la yie kɛŋ wʋjʋʋlaa arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ nɛ. La tapʋlaa yie guu dɛrɛ, la sʋʋ.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ ŋ baanɩŋ doluŋ maŋŋaa? Ŋ baanɩŋ yʋga a magɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ la fɩfáŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Dagɛla dɩ la jɩma kɛŋ la tapʋlaa, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ la kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: Help us, Lord! Don't wait! Pity your servants.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, sɩ́ baanɩŋ na ŋ tɩntɩnnaa nyuŋ a dieni, fá la nenige.

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Chʋchʋɔ na-kala, dagɛla ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ la yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ la mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ la tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ dieni a nagɛ jɩ-daŋ-la ŋ sɩ leŋe wɩaa jʋʋla la na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ pɩ la-na ŋ tɩntɩnnaa, a dagɛ ŋ doluŋ, dɩ la biiriŋ ma na.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa, dagɛ ŋ zile pɩla. Leŋ dɩ wɩɩkala la sɩɩ ŋaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩla.

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala nɛ chu tɔ nʋʋ, tɩɩna jaŋ na wiese Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna teeŋ.

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ wuo bʋl, “La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ mɩ yuori, ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ dɩɩ-duoŋ arɩ mɩ Wɩa, mɩ laaŋ dii nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsɩŋ bɛrɛ lɛ, a lɩɩsɩŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ kala sɩɩ kpʋ nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ chu tɔŋ, dɩ wɩɩ sɩ́ŋ jʋʋ. Ʋ wʋtɩtɩɩ jaŋ nagɛ hɔɔ-taala-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ, koo a nagɛ jebiiŋ ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ taŋ a tɔ hɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ jaŋ fɩfá wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa tɩtaŋɩŋ, koo hɛmɛ-la ba sɩɩ yuo wɩɩhɛyɛ.

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ sɩɩ kpʋ nɩaa, koo wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la sɩɩ chei nɩaa wɩɩhɛɛ siesee ma ka fá.

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ yi bʋɩ fiiba a tele sʋʋ golluŋ, ama wʋbɔŋ kala bɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ-na lɛ.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ŋ ta jaŋ kɛŋ sɩɩŋ nɛ a na ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ leŋe Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala ŋaa ŋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ, a yuori La Tɩɩna,

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na wʋbɔŋ kala bɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ lɛ. Wʋlɔrʋ ma kala bɩ jaŋ kʋ kpagɛ ŋ dɩa.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ bʋl ŋ wɩaa pɩ ʋ tɩndaaraa, dɩ ba pɔŋ woruŋ lee na-kala ŋ sɩɩ mʋ.

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ joŋuŋ kori dɩ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ naaŋ joŋo ŋmoo tabɩɩŋ.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ vɩvɛŋ naachigee arɩ dɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ, a nʋɔsɛ naachigi-duoruŋ arɩ dɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ, “Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ chomi, mɩ jaŋ laaba ta, mɩ jaŋ chu tɔ ba lɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩ jɩmmɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ yɩrɛmɛ, mɩ jaŋ sɛɩ. Dɩ ba nɛ jʋʋ wɩɩ ma, mɩ jaŋ hɛ ba teeŋ, a laaba ta a zilba.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ pɩba mɩɩ-duduoŋ, a dagɛba ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ laa nɩaa tɩta.”

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ la dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a zil Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala,

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: a heele bʋl ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa chʋchʋɔ kala, tɩtaŋɩŋ ma dɩ la bʋl ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ,

english_verse: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
translation_verse: a du kɔnɛ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ cheŋ a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ wʋduoru-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa nyuŋ nɛ, a tɩŋ ŋ wʋŋaalaa wɩaa, mɩ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, tɩntɩmɩa-la ŋ sɩ tɩma ŋaa wʋbala nɛ. Ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa ma luŋ.

english_verse: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
translation_verse: Nɩchʋʋla bɩ ba wuo jɩŋ, nɩyaarɩŋ bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ wuo jɩŋ.

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ jaŋ wuo waa a nagɛ yaŋ, wʋbɔŋ-ŋaaraa jaŋ wuo kuori, ama Wɩa jaŋ cheiba a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: But you will rule over all of us forever,
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na La TƖƖNA nɛ jaŋ beŋ la kala a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, la jɩma ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ sʋʋ, ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ lɛl, wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa kala jaŋ pɩsɛ.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe mɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ baga nɛ-bele nɛ, a pɛ mɩ lɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩŋ na Wɩa sɩ yuo dii mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, mɩ dɩgɩlaa ma nɩɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋ-bisiŋ nii-ŋmobo.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa jaŋ jigi, a nagɛ abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ, ba jaŋ waa a nagɛ kuolo sɩ hɛ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: Ba nagɛ tɩɩsɩŋ ba sɩ chɔnsɔ La Tɩɩna dɩa lɛ nɛ, ba jaŋ jigi la Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ hɩɛsɛ, aŋ ha nɩnɛŋ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa dɩ ba pɩpaarɩŋ zɔŋ.

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ daga arɩ La TƖƖNA kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ. Ʋ nɛ mɩ dɩ-duoŋ, ʋ nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ, ʋ bɩ bɔŋ mʋa ma.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ kuoro, ʋ laalɛ ʋ kuoru-gɛrɩŋ nɛ, a gigenni. Ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ, a leŋ tinteeŋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ, a bɩ jigisi.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: Faafaa kala nɛ ŋ kuoruŋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ, ŋ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mʋgʋ-balaa lɩɩŋ sie nɛ, ba sie nɛ, a ŋɩŋaa goŋ, lɩɩ-pel-duoruŋ dʋdɔŋ.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-pel-duoru-la faasa dʋdɔŋ nɛ woruŋ, ba dɔmɔ kɩkɩɩ lɩɩ-balaa sɩɩ dɔŋ, ama La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ kɩɩba a bibeŋ kʋŋkala.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto chaasa chɩŋ nɛ, ŋ dɩa ma bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ Wɩa sɩ yie dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ wʋŋaalaa sɩ bɩ zɔŋ. Dagɛba ŋɩɩ ŋ baanɩŋ sɩ naga, aŋ dɔgɩsɛba.

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ ŋaa dʋnɩa kala sarɩya diire, sii ŋaa wɩɩ, a joŋ sɩɩ-duo tɩŋŋaa wʋŋaalaa chɩmɩŋ tiŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ɛɛ nɛ nɩbɔmʋŋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ, ɛɛ nɛ nɩbɔmʋŋ jaŋ jʋɔsa diene magɛ?

english_verse: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋ ŋaara-la kala ka bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ, a bʋbʋl babiibal wɩaa.

english_verse: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, baa bʋrɩgɛ ŋ nɩaa nɛ, ba nyagɛba bil nɛ.

english_verse: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
translation_verse: Ba kpʋ yo-haalaa arɩ nʋhʋɔraa nɛ, a kpʋ biisinsiŋ ma,

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl, “La Tɩɩna bɩ wɩɩ-la la sɩ ŋaa na. Jekɔb Wɩa bɩ wɩɩ-la lɛ jɩŋ.”

english_verse: Can't you fools see? Won't you ever learn?
translation_verse: Ma nɩyaara-la sɩ guoli nɩaa tʋɔŋ, má jegili, chɛ bɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ wɩaa?

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ joŋ dɩgɩlaa pɩla, ʋ nɛ pɩla sɩaa ma. Ma saa bɩɩna ʋ bɩ nɩɩ, a bɩ na ma koo?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ kɛŋ tinteyee nɩaa tʋra kɩkɩɩ, ma bɩɩna ʋ bɩ nɩaa wuo dɔgɩsɛ koo? Ʋ nɩɩ dagɛla wʋjɩmɩŋ. Ma bɩɩna ʋ tɩtɩa bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ koo?

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jɩŋ nuhuobiine tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ. Ʋ jɩma la tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, nɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ daga a kɛmba tʋraa kɩɩ ŋ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto lɛ, jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe ba wiesi ba wʋjʋʋlaa lɛ nɛ, a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ jaŋ lu bʋa dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ tuu.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Sarɩya diire jaŋ bɩra kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a dii nɩaa sarɩya, nɩalɩŋ kala wʋŋaalaa sɩ tʋʋla jaŋ to ŋɩɩ harɩŋ.

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, dɩ ŋ nɛ fa bɩ mɩ lɛ pɛ, ŋ-la mɩ fa hɛ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ sɩ, “Mɩ sɩɛra nɛ a chɩchɛ mɩ tel,” La Tɩɩna, ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ chagɛmɛ kɩɩ.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ yʋga dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ chei, ŋ nɛ yie nyagɛ mɩ bɔyɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ bɩra tɔrɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Ama La Tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa mɩ dɩɩ-duoŋ, mɩ Wɩa nɛ mɩ yuori, ʋ nɛ mɩ dɩ-duoŋ a nagɛ bʋŋ.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a gʋra dɔgɩsɛba, a cheiba a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa. La Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ cheiba.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Má kɔ dɩ la dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, má leŋ dɩ la yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a pɩ Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa la dɩ-duoŋ, a laala tɩta.

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Má kɔ ʋ sɩpaaŋ a lɔllʋ, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ Wɩɩ-balɩŋ, Ʋ nɛ kuoru-balɩŋ, ʋ nɛ kɩɩ vene kala.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ arɩ ʋ luŋuŋ kala hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ nɛ tɩɩ peelee nyuŋ ma.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ ŋaa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ, a tɩɩʋ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa tinteeŋ ma.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ la Wɩa, la ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa, ʋ bibenla a nagɛ ʋ piesee. Jɩnɩŋ ma jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ bʋl,

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: má sɩ́ sɩɩ-duoŋ kɛŋ a nagɛ ma naabalɩmaba fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɛrɩba arɩ Masa tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Lee-la, ma naabalɩmaba magɩsɛmɛ nɛ, arɩ ba sɩ na wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaama.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Mɩ na baanɩŋ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ ba nyuŋ a bʋl, “Nɩalɩŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa kɛmba yeŋŋi nɛ, ba bɩ mɩ wombiee jɩŋ.”

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na baanɩŋ a ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ba lɛ a bʋl, “Ma bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ tintee-la mɩ fa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, dɩ ma hɔnɔ wiesi.”

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩl-falɩŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA, dʋnɩa nɩaa arɩ kʋŋkala, má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa pɩ La Tɩɩna, má dɛnnʋ. Tapʋlɩɩ kala, má heele bʋl ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ laala ta.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Má heele bʋl ʋ ballɩŋ wɩaa arɩ tɩntɩŋ-duoru-la ʋ sɩ tɩma a pɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nɛ yʋga kɩɩ kʋŋkala a magɛ dɩ la faasa dɛnnʋ, ʋ nɛ maga dɩ la fá a kɩɩ vene kala.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Tintee-wogusu-la nɩaa kala kpaarɛ vesiŋ nɛ, ama La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Zɔmʋŋ arɩ ballɩŋ kala hɛ ʋ teeŋ, doluŋ arɩ tʋla su ʋ dɩa kala.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, tintee-na kala nɩaa, má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA a tɩŋ ʋ tʋla arɩ ʋ doluŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩ-balɩŋ, má kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kaa kʋ jʋʋ ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
translation_verse: Má kpirime chʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Kʋŋ na-kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, má chichel ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Má bʋla pɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala, “La Tɩɩna nɛ kuoro. Ʋ nɛ leŋe tinteeŋ chɩŋ nɛ kpaŋkpaŋ, kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛnʋ jigisi. Ʋ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, má jʋjʋɔsɛ, dɩ kɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Mʋgʋ-balɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ, má ŋaa goŋ,

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: bagɩsɩŋ arɩ kʋduuloo kala, má jʋjʋɔsɛ. Tɩɩsɩŋ ma kala sɩ hɛ duuŋ lɛ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a pɩ La Tɩɩna. Ʋ jaŋ kʋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa kala sarɩya. Ʋ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya arɩ tʋɔpʋla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ kuoro, tinteeŋ nɩaa, má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, dɩ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu ma nɩaa jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ arɩ birimiŋ lim nɛ gollu. Tʋɔpʋla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ŋaa ʋ kuoruŋ gentine.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: Nyiniŋ nɛ laa ʋ sɩpaaŋ a dii ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɛmɛ na-kala.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: Ʋ nyiniŋ lɩgɩsa su dʋnɩa kala nɛ, tinteeŋ nɩaa na a chichel.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩpaaŋ, peelee yʋɔla nɛ a nagɛ keliŋ sɩ ŋmɩɛra. Ba ŋmɩɛra nɛ La Tɩɩna sɩ tɩɩ dʋnɩa kala sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Wɩa-jaŋ kɩaa kala heele bʋl ʋ tʋɔpʋla wɩaa nɛ, tinteyee nɩaa ma kala na ʋ tʋla.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Hɩɩsɩŋ dii vʋɩ-kpaaraa nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ vʋɩ-pɛɩpɛɩba-la dɩdagɛ ba tɩtɩa, vesiŋ maa kpirimi La Tɩɩna sɩpaaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ nɩaa jaŋ nɩɩ a jʋɔsɛ dɩ Juda tabiisiŋ nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, a tɩŋ La Tɩɩna sɩ dii nɩaa sarɩya wɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala, ŋ nɩɩ beŋ dʋnɩa kɩaa kala, ŋ nɛ yʋga kɩɩ vene kala.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna cho nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ woruŋ, ʋ yie pɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laaʋ dii nɛ, a laaba tɩta nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Wɩa pʋlʋmʋŋ chaana hɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ, a ŋaa nɩalɩŋ wʋŋaalaa sɩ tʋʋla ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, má leŋ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA nyuŋ, má jʋɔsɛ aŋ dɛnnɛ ʋ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩl-falɩŋ pɩ La Tɩɩna, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ nɛ. Ʋ naduo-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ ʋ kaa yuo dii ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna leŋe nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ laa nɩaa ta nɛ. Ʋ leŋe tinteyee nɩaa jɩŋ ʋ tʋɔpʋla lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ʋ liise yi ʋ chono-la arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ. Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala na ŋɩɩ la Wɩa sɩ laa nɩaa tɩta nɛ.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala, má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, a ŋaa goŋ a pɩ La Tɩɩna. Má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a gbieli.

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Má du cheŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa hɛ a pɩ La Tɩɩna, má du cheŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa hɛ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: Má ŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ a ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a pɩ La Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa la kuoro.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mʋgʋ-balaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ba lɛ, dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa goŋ, dɩ dʋnɩa arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ ma ŋɩŋaa goŋ.

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ fuonuŋ porisi nɩsaa, dɩ dundolluŋ ma kala yɩɩ yɩɩlaa hɛ dɔŋɔ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa La Tɩɩna sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ kɔ dɩ ʋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya arɩ tʋɔpʋla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ kuoro, má leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala chel. Ʋ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ nɛ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ pɛgɛ, má leŋ dɩ tinteeŋ ma zigili.

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a hɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ kɩɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala jaŋ dɛnnɛ ʋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ, ʋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Kuoro kɛŋ doluŋ, ʋ cho wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ŋ leŋe wʋtɩtɩɩ chaasa chɩŋ nɛ kpaŋkpaŋ Iziral tinteeŋ kala lɛ, a ŋaa wɩɩ-la sɩ maga arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ La Tɩɩna Wɩa yɩrɩŋ sii, a dɛnnʋ ʋ naakparaa bʋbʋɔŋ. Ʋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ ma fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ. Samʋɛl ma fa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bunso pɩpɩ Wɩa dɔŋɔ nɛ. Ba yie ŋmoo niiŋ pɩ La Tɩɩna, ʋ laa ba sʋla.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ sɩ nagɛ jebiiŋ lɛ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩba. Ba sɛɩ wɩalɩŋ a to wombie-la ʋ sɩ dagɛba.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa, ŋ laa ŋ nɩaa sʋla nɛ a joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba, ama ba sɩ kʋ ŋaa wɩaa chei, ŋ dɔgɩsɛba nɛ.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa, a chʋɔlʋ ʋ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa kɩaa kala, má ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a pɩ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Ma jɩma La Tɩɩna nɛ Wɩa, ʋ nɛ ŋaala a tɩɩla, la ŋaa ʋ nɩaa nɛ, ʋ dɩdaala a nagɛ piesee.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Má kɔ La Tɩɩna boiŋ-baalɩŋ a lɔllʋ. Má jʋʋ ʋ kaala tʋɔŋ a dɛnnʋ. Má lɔllʋ a dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna wɩaa zɔmɔ, ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ wʋtɩtɩɩ bɩ dɩdɛrɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ ŋ chonuŋ arɩ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ a pɩŋ. La Tɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ mɩ sɩaa a ŋaa wɩaa a sɩ́ cheeri kala kɛŋ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Chɛ bɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ? Mɩ jaŋ ŋɩŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa mɩ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked,
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ. Mɩ bɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ mɩɩrɛ Wɩa harɩŋ wʋŋaalaa nɛ, mɩ dɩ ba bɩ jaŋ pɛ wɩɩ.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chei nɩɩ-la kala sɩ lʋara bʋl wʋbɔmʋŋ a tɩgɛ nʋʋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ ŋmobu hɛ pɛgɛ lɛ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ pɩ sɩɩ-duo tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii dɩ ba hɛ mɩ teeŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ chaasa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ jaŋ tɩma pɩpɩmɛ.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩɩ nyɩsɛ nɩaa bɩ jaŋ hɛ mɩ dɩa lɛ. Wʋnyɩɛrʋ kala bɩ jaŋ hɛ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala mɩ jaŋ chei nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ la tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kiri wʋbɔŋ-ŋaaraa ta dɩ ba lɩɩ La Tɩɩna tabalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋmɛ, sɩ́ harɩŋ joŋo yɩamɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ bunso pɩŋ, jegile nɩɩ a guu pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Mɩ tapʋlaa ka dɛrɛ nɛ, a nagɛ nyʋɔsʋŋ sɩɩ lɛl. Mɩ yaraa kala didii a nagɛ nyiniŋ.

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: Mɩ yaraa kala ŋmaama nɛ a nagɛ yaŋ sɩ hɩla. Mɩ niiŋ kpʋa nɛ, mɩ bɩ kʋdiilee cho.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: Mɩ hʋʋna bɩ dɛrɛ, mɩ kala jagɛ aŋ ka haŋgbelee.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: Mɩ nagɛ diibie sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a nagɛ hajaaŋkuŋkuŋ dʋndʋŋa sɩɩ jʋʋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ doŋ ka pɩŋ, mɩ nagɛ zaarɩ-kokobie dʋndʋŋa sɩ sagɛ dɩa nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tʋʋsɛmɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ wɩa tuu jʋʋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ mɔŋ mɩ lɛ mɩɩra kɛŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ ŋmɩɛsaa hɛ nɩaa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Tʋɔrʋŋ nɛ mɩɩra ŋaa mɩ kʋdiilee, mɩ lɩɩ-nyʋalʋŋ kala su arɩ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ŋ baanɩŋ sɩ sii kɩŋkɛŋ wɩaa, ŋ jommi yuo ta nɛ.

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: Mɩ tapʋlaa ka dɛrɛ nɛ, a nagɛ daaliimiŋ sɩ yie lɛl ŋɩɩ dɩdaanɩŋ. Mɩ yaraa kala ŋmaamɛ a nagɛ yaŋ sɩ hɩla.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ kuoro a kaa mʋ wuu. Nɩalɩŋ ma ba ha sɩ bɩ lʋla jaŋ yɩrɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: La-na ŋ tɩntɩnnaa cho taŋ-la, arɩ ba sɩ cheyu ʋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ ma kala. Ʋ wɩaa kɛŋ nenige nɛ a pɩla.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ fá La Tɩɩna, dʋnɩa kuoroo kala jaŋ zilu a tɩŋ ʋ tʋla wɩaa.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ paa Zaayɔŋ wasa saa, a dagɛ ʋ doluŋ.

english_verse: Future generations must also praise the Lord, so write this for them:
translation_verse: Má ŋmʋnsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bil nɩalɩŋ ba maachie sɩ jaŋ lʋl lɛ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ ba ha sɩ bɩ lʋla sii a dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ-bolii, aŋ bibeŋ dʋnɩa,

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: a nɩɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa huuno, a laa nɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋ ta.

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: dɩ tinteyee nɩaa nɛ kʋ hilimi dɩ ba chʋɔlʋ.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: Mɩ ha ŋaa bapʋɔsɩ-bie nɛ, ka La Tɩɩna leŋ mɩ pʋgʋmɛ. Ʋ keri mɩ tapʋlaa ta nɛ.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Wɩa, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ buuro sʋʋ, dɩ mɩ tapʋlaa bɩ yie. Ŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Dɩ-suomuŋ kala, ŋ nɛ bil tinteeŋ gentine, ŋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ ma.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ lɛl, ama ŋ-na jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, ba kala jaŋ kɔsɛ a nagɛ gɛnnɩŋ sɩɩ kɔsɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ a nagɛ gɛrɩ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ lɩa, ba jaŋ jomba yuo ta.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ŋ bɩrɩma. Ŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: La ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, ŋ jaŋ pɔ la biiriŋ arɩ ba doho nɩaa dɩ wɩɩkala sɩ́ ba walɩmʋ.”

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: Mɩɩ dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna nɛ, mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ, a dɩdɛnnɛ ʋ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna nɛ arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ yʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa pɩmɛ.

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ joŋ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala chɛmɛ, aŋ vaarɛ mɩ nyanyalaa kala.

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ pɔmɛ mɩ bɩ sʋba. Ʋ fá mɩ nenige nɛ a dagɛmɛ ʋ chonuŋ.

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ pɩmɛ kʋzɔmɔ-la kala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ leŋe mɩ wasa kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ kachuuŋ.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ ʋ wombiee dagɛ Mosis nɛ, a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa jɩŋ ʋ wʋŋaalaa.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna kɛŋ zile a fɩfá nɩaa nenige, ʋ baanɩŋ bɩ lɩma lɩma ka sii, ʋ nɩaa chonuŋ ma bɩ dɩdɛrɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ laa nyaŋ bʋa na-kala, a bɩ baanɩŋ maa na la nyuŋ deeŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Wɩa cho nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fáʋ a yʋga magɛ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ sɩ bolie magɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna laa la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta dɩ-bolii nɛ, ʋ bolie magɛ a chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: A nagɛ nyɩmma sɩɩ fá ʋ biiriŋ nisusuŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ La Tɩɩna ma fɩfá nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ zilu nenige.

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: Ʋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ mɛla nɛ, ʋ jɩma la ŋaa tɩɛrɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine tapʋlaa nagɛ yaŋ nɛ, ʋ yie waa a kɛŋ tʋla a nagɛ tɩɩfɩɩlaa sɩ hɛ gɩrɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: ka peliŋ yie lu ba kala yuori. Nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ ʋ wɩaa ka liisi.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Ama La Tɩɩna-na cho nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fáʋ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, a ŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa pɩpɩ ba biiriŋ arɩ ba nihee,

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bil ʋ kuoru kpasa ʋ jáŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ, ʋ nɩɩ beŋ kʋŋkala.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, ma-na ʋ tɩndaaraa sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a tuto ʋ niiŋ a sɛɩ ʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, ma Wɩa tɩndaaraa kala sɩ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnaa aa to ʋ niiŋ.

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, ma-na kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa, lee na-kala ʋ sɩɩ beŋ arɩ ʋ doluŋ. Mɩɩ dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩma, dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, ŋ yʋga nɛ woruŋ, ŋ tʋla nagɛ gɛrɩŋ nɛ a tɔŋ ŋ gigenni.

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: Pʋlʋmʋŋ nagɛ gɛrɩŋ nɛ a tɔŋ, ŋ leŋe wɩa-nyuŋ jɛrɛ nɛ a nagɛ palɩŋ,

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: ka ŋ saa ŋ dɩa lɩɩŋ nyuŋ, a kɛŋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa bɩrɩmɛ laalɩŋ janɩŋ toruko, peliŋ joŋuŋ vɩvɛŋ.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe peliŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋ tɩndaaraa, nyiŋgeliŋ ma ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnaa.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe tinteeŋ gentine chɩŋ nɛ, kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛnʋ jigisi.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Ŋ joŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tɔʋ nɛ a nagɛ gɛrɩŋ, lɩɩŋ jɩla tɔ peelee.

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: a pɛllɛ to peelee nyuŋ a tuu fuonaasɩŋ, a mʋ lee-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa bil ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: Ŋ dagɛ ʋ bʋa pʋ nɛ, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ wuo chol, a pɔ dɩ ʋ bɩra sɩ́ dʋnɩa tɔ.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe lɩɩŋ bubul fuonaasɩŋ lɛ nɛ, lɩɩŋ pɩpɛllɛ lɩɩ-libisiŋ sɩ hɛ peelee pɛgɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-la nɛ baga kɩaa nyʋnyʋa, ʋ nɛ bʋrʋmba kaa kpʋ ba lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Diibiisiŋ saa ba dɛllɩŋ a kpagɛ lɩɩ-la, a sagɛ tɩɩsɩŋ naakelee nyuŋ aa yel.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe duonuŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ a nɩɩ hɛ peelee lɛ, kʋdiilee su tinteeŋ kala.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe yaŋ nyʋ nɛ pʋsʋŋ didii, tɩɩsɩŋ ma nyʋ nɩaa kaa tɩtɩŋ, a pɛrɛ tinteeŋ ma a na kʋdiilee,

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: a kaa ŋaa sɩnɩŋ, ʋ pɩpɩla tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, a ŋaa nʋʋŋ la tɩsa tʋtʋl, arɩ kʋdiilee ba pɩpɩla yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ tɩɩsɩŋ kala nɛ vɔgɔ arɩ lɩɩŋ, kuolu-la ŋ sɩ chɔnsɛ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Diibiisiŋ saa ba dɛllɩŋ ba lɛ, tɩɩ-kokoba lɔsɛ ba bʋɔsʋŋ tɩɩsɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Peele-la sɩ leŋie nyuŋ nɛ ŋaa bagɩlaa dɩ-pɩnaa, bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ ma ŋaa bʋŋ-nyuŋ gbuŋgbogusuŋ dɩjʋʋlaa.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa chɛnɛ ʋ dɩdagɛ wɩaa dɩ-suomuŋ arɩ ba dɩ-dɛrɩŋ, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ ma jɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe birimiŋ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ aa dagɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ, gɩrɩŋ kɩaa kala lɩɩ gʋgɔllɛ.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Naachigee huoso bagɩla chɩchɛ kʋdiilee, aa chɛ ba kʋdiile-la Wɩa sɩ pɩba.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Dɩ taŋ nɛ pʋla, ba mɩɩra mʋ pɩŋ ba dɩ-jʋʋlaa.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Ka nuhuobiinee ma bɩra lɩɩ tɩtɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa, a tɩŋ ŋɩɩ halɩɩ a mʋ yi dɩdaanɩŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, kʋ-daŋ nɛ ŋ ŋaa. Wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ ŋ kaa ŋaa ba kala. Kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa su tinteeŋ kala nɛ.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ ŋaa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ ʋ jal woruŋ, ŋ ŋaa kʋbiisiŋ arɩ kʋbalaa hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ, nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛba.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Mʋgʋ-bal-la lɛ nɛ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ vɩvɛŋ. Ka peribanyeŋŋu ŋ sɩ ŋaa dɩ ʋ gbigbieli lɩɩŋ lɛ hɛ mʋga-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Kɩaa deemba kʋŋkala ka beŋ ŋ lɛ nɛ, dɩ ŋ pɩba kʋdiilee bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ pɩba kʋdiile-la, ba yie dii nɛ. Dɩ nɛ ŋ pɩba kʋdiile-la ba yie dii vɔgɛ.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ harɩŋ yɩaba, fawʋllʋŋ yie kɛmba nɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ, ba sʋʋ, a bɩrɩmɛ hagɩla.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaaba nɛ a joŋ mɩɩsɩŋ pɩba. Ŋ nɛ leŋe kɩaa bɩra kɛŋ mɩɩ-falɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, a leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋla hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, a leŋ dɩ La Tɩɩna tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa nyuŋ.

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ yie beŋ tinteeŋ ʋ zigili, aŋ digi peelee ma ba tɔ nyʋɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ a pɩ La Tɩɩna. Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɛ mɩ Wɩa a kaa mʋ yi mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, a leŋ dɩ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa tɔrɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ nɛ leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nyɩɩgɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩra sɩ́ nɩmɛ hɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala. Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Má lɔllɛ La TƖƖNA, má yɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ. Má leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, má bʋl wʋkpuŋkperisi-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa a pɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Má joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ lɛ, aŋ chɩchɛʋ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Má liisi wʋkpuŋkperisi-la arɩ wʋduoru-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ dii sarɩya ʋ bʋa lɛ,

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: ma-na Abɩraham sɩ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnna doho nɩaa, Jekɔb biiriŋ, nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa, ʋ niiŋ wɩaa hɛ dʋnɩa lee-kala nɛ.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ nii-la ʋ sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ma pɛgɛ ka yʋ, nii-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu,

english_verse: God made an eternal promise
translation_verse: nii-la ʋ sɩ bile ʋ dɩ Abɩraham arɩ Aɩzɩk pɛgɛ.

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ pɩŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋ kʋŋ.”

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ba fa bɩ wɩɩ maga, ba chaasa muuri nɛ a ŋaa nʋhʋɔra ma tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: Ba fa gɔllɔɔ baarɛ nɛ, a lɩɩ tinteeŋ a mʋ tinteeŋ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ leŋe nʋʋkala dɔgɩsɛba, a tɩŋ ba wɩaa, ʋ dɔgɩsɛ kuoroo nɛ.

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Má pʋpɔ má sɩ́ mɩ nɩaa mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa digu, a sɩ́ mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa ma wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa.”

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna leŋe ba kʋduuloo bɩ wasa, losuŋ jʋʋ ba tinteeŋ kala.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ a vɔɔ ʋ naasɩŋ a joŋ baŋkoguluŋ ma hɛ ʋ baŋŋaa lɛ,

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ wɩɩ-la Josɛf fa sɩ bʋla arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa, sɛnɛ sɩ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ. Wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ daga sɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋu hɛ ʋ bibeŋ ʋ kuoru dɩa a ŋaa nʋʋ sɩɩ beŋ kʋŋ na-kala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe Josɛf bibeŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ a dɩdagɛ ʋ nɩhɩasɩŋ ma wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jekɔb arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa sii mʋ Ijipiti, a hɔŋ Ham tinteeŋ lɛ, a ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna leŋ ʋ nɩaa chaasa pʋŋ woruŋ, a leŋ ba kɛŋ doluŋ kɩɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa bɛrɛba, a vʋʋra sii chɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa lɛ.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩntɩnna Mosis a pɛ Arɔŋ lɛ, a tɩmba.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Ba mʋ, Wɩa leŋ ba ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ arɩ wʋmagɩlaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩ vɩa dɩ ba to Wɩa niiŋ, ʋ leŋ birimiŋ tɔ ba tinteeŋ.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra leŋ ba fuonuŋ lɩɩŋ kala bɩrɩmɛ chalɩŋ, a leŋ ba chenfilee sʋʋ.

english_verse: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Ba tinteeŋ kala tɔ arɩ yɩŋŋaa, a paala su ba kuoroo dɩɩ-pɩnaa ma.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Wɩa leŋ nanchʋɔsʋŋ arɩ dɩnsɩŋ kʋ su ba tinteeŋ kala.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe ba duonuŋ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ duoŋ-tabɩaa nɛ a tele su ba tinteeŋ, ka taŋ ma lɩgɩsa su leriŋ kala.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: Ʋ chei ba girep tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ tutogusuŋ, a chei ba tinteeŋ tɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩra leŋe hɔbɔ kʋ tɔ ba tinteeŋ kala nɛ, nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛba,
