english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: a dii pɩpaa na-kala sɩ hɛ ba tinteeŋ lɛ, a dii ba kʋduuloo ma.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka Wɩa kpʋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba kala, ba bapʋɔsɛ biiriŋ.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, dɩ ba chʋŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ. Ba doho doho-la kala tʋɔŋ kʋŋ bɩ wɩɩ jʋa.

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: Wɩa fa leŋe duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ nɛ tɔ hɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ, aŋ leŋ nyiniŋ ma laa ba sɩpaaŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ.

english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɩɛsa a chɩchɛ kʋdiilee, ʋ pɩba jɩmpɩrɩwɩɩba. Ʋ leŋe kʋdiilee lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a kʋ tuu nɛ ba dii vɔgɛ.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe bʋŋ yɛrɛ nɛ, lɩɩŋ gbu lɩɩ a pɩpɛllɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ a nagɛ fuoŋ.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa liise yi nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ lɛ nɛ, nii-la sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna Abɩraham pɛgɛ.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩ kɛŋ ʋ nɩaa kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ ba yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ nɩaa tinteeŋ arɩ ba bagɩsɩŋ kɩaa kala a pɩba,

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ba to wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga, a kɛŋ wombie-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto tɩtɩŋ. Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Má lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ wɩaa zɔmɔ, ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo dagɛ tɩntɩŋ-duoru-la La Tɩɩna sɩ tɩma pɩ ʋ nɩaa, koo a chaasa dɛnnʋ a magɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga?

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ chɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ naaŋ lɛ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ bʋa na-kala, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: Remember me, Lord, when you show kindness by saving your people.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, sɩ́ mɩ wɩaa yʋ dɩ ŋ nɩɩ pɛ ŋ nɩaa lɛ. Kɛmmɛ pɛ ba lɛ dɩ ŋ nɛ laaba tɩta.

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ ma pɛ dii ŋ nɩaa dʋa-la, a pɛ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋ-la tintee-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa nɩaa sɩ kɛnɛ, dɩ mɩ pɛ ŋ nɩaa lɛ dɩ la dɩdɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ la naabalɩmaba sɩ hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ba bɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa liise. Ba bɩ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ ma wɩaa liise, aŋ lɩɩ ŋ-na Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala harɩŋ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ leriŋ.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: Ama a tɩŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ wɩaa, ʋ laaba ta nɛ, a leŋ nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ kpɩa Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ lɛ, ʋ hɩla nɛ, ka ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩaa chol a nagɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ lɛ nɛ ba vɩvɛŋ.

english_verse: and drowned every one of their enemies.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe lɩɩŋ tɔ ba dʋndɔmɔ-la kala nɛ, ba kʋbala ma bɩ ka.

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ nɩaa laa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla dii, a yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ bɩ diene, ka ʋ nɩaa guu yʋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa, a bɩ gbɛrɛ dɩ ʋ dagɛba.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, ba suomo hɩɛna chɩchɛ kɩaa. Tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ nɛ ba magɩsɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩba kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ chɛ, aŋ joŋ nyanyal-bɔŋ kʋbala a hɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
translation_verse: Baala-la sɩ hɛ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ yaraa bieri Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ nyuŋ, nɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tinteeŋ suri a joŋ Dataŋ liŋ, a paa Abɩram arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa ma liŋ.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na Wɩa nɛ leŋe nyiniŋ kʋ tuu ba harɩ-tooroo lɛ, a dii ba nɩbɔmɔ-la.

english_verse: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ ŋ-na Wɩa dɛnnɛ nɛ, a pɩ kʋŋ sɩ nagɛ nɛ-bele sɩɩ dii yaŋ.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: Ba yʋ ŋ-na Wɩa sɩ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ, Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a laaba ta wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa Ham tinteeŋ arɩ wʋduoru-la sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ ŋ ŋaa Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ-la leriŋ.

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ na baanɩŋ ŋ nɩaa nyuŋ a chɩchɛ ŋ cheiba, ŋ tɩntɩnna Mosis, nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ ŋaa ba sɩpaa-laarʋ, ʋ nɛ sii chɩŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ a sʋlʋŋ, dɩ ŋ sɩ́ ba chei.

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: Ba fa bɩ cho dɩ ba jʋʋ tintee-sɩŋ-la, a bɩ nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ ma laa dii.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ La Tɩɩna niiŋ sɛyɛ, aŋ gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa ba lɛŋŋɛɛ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ ŋmɩɛsa pɩba arɩ ŋ jaŋ sii chɩŋ ba lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ba sʋʋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: I'll scatter your children everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: aŋ kɛŋ ba doho nɩaa pɩsa hɛ tinteyee lɛ a leŋ ba guoli tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ nɩaa ma pɛ kpʋkpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal sɩ hɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Pio lɛ, a didii vʋɩ-kpaarɛ kɩaa.

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la nɛ, La Tɩɩna na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ, a joŋ nyanyal-bɔmʋŋ hɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
translation_verse: Mɛrɩba lɩɩrɩ-la leriŋ ba ŋaa ŋ na baanɩŋ nɛ, wɩaa jʋʋ Mosis a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: Ba leŋe ʋ na baanɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa aŋ bɩ bɩɩna.

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa vɩa La Tɩɩna niiŋ nɛ, a bɩ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ dɩ ba kpʋ kpʋa,

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: aŋ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa mʋ mɛrɛ tinteye-la nɩaa lɛ, a tuto ba naabarɩŋ.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Ba faa kpaarɛ Kɛnaŋ tɩmma-la vʋɩyaa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ bɩrɩmɛ bɛrɛ a cheiba.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Ba fa yie kɛsɛ ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba hantolibiisiŋ a kpʋ pɩpɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Ba kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye, ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba toloo. Ba kɛsɛba kpʋ nɛ a kpaarɛ Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa tɔŋŋɔɔ, ba chalɩŋ leŋ tintee-la kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa leŋe ba kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, ba fa bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ arɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ La Tɩɩna na baanɩŋ ʋ nɩaa nyuŋ, ʋ tʋɔŋ lɩɩ ʋ nɩtɩɩlaa.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: Ʋ jomba hɛ tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka chʋɔlɛ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba dʋndɔmɔ-la bibemba.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Ba dʋndɔmɔ-la chaasa dɔgɩsɛba nɛ woruŋ, aŋ leŋ ba tuto ba niiŋ.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna vɛnɛ laaba ta a yʋgɛ nɛ, ama ba bɩ ʋ niiŋ sɛyɛ, ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ leŋ ba tel.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ ha laa ba sʋla nɛ, hɛɛŋ sɩ jʋʋba, ba ŋmoo niiŋ ʋ nɩɩ.

english_verse: that their enemies had pity on them.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ yuo kɛsɛba fá ba nisusuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Laala ta, La Tɩɩna Wɩa. Kɛnla lɩɩ tinteyee nɩaa tʋɔŋ a kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ, dɩ la wuo lɔllʋŋ a dɛnnɛ ŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa a kaa mʋ wuu. Nʋʋkala bʋl, “Amɩɩ.” Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Má lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ wɩaa zɔmɔ, ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: ma nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ kaa lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ tintee-wogusuŋ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
translation_verse: Ba dɔnsʋŋ gɔllɔ baarɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wulumuŋ lɛ nɛ, ba bɩ taŋ kala wombiiŋ na dɩ ba mʋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Losuŋ arɩ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ fa kɛmba nɛ, ba bɛsɩmɛ.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Wɩaa chaasa jʋʋba nɛ ba ŋmoo niiŋ pɩ La Tɩɩna, ʋ laaba ta ba hɛɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: At once he brought you to a town.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛmba joŋ wombiiŋ nɛ tegi tegi a mʋ tabal-la ba sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ba lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna a tɩŋ ʋ chonuŋ sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa pɩpɩ nuhuobiine wɩaa.

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ sɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ pɩba lɩɩŋ nɛ ba nyʋa vɔgɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ma losuŋ sɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ yie pɩba kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ba dii vɔgɛ.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Ma dɔnsʋŋ fa ŋaa dansarɩkaba nɛ a hɔŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ lim, ba kɛŋ chɔrʋmɔ vɔɔma, ma nɩna hɛɛŋ,

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ba vɩa Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala niiŋ wɩaa nɛ, a bɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga ka to.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ ba tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ a kala yɛrɛ, a gɩgɛrɛ, ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Wɩaa chaasa jʋʋba nɛ, ba ŋmoo niiŋ pɩ La Tɩɩna, ʋ laaba ta ba hɛɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛmba lɩɩ biriŋ lim-la tʋɔŋ, a kɛŋ ba chɔrʋmɔ-la kɛrɛ ta.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ba lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna a tɩŋ ʋ chonuŋ sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa pɩpɩ nuhuobiine wɩaa.

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋmoo boi-baala-la kala ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa lo nɛ, a bori hɔɔ-daa-doloo.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Ba dɔnsʋŋ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ nɩyaara a vɩa Wɩa niiŋ, ŋɩɩ leŋ nyanyalaa jʋʋba a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Ba niiŋ kpʋa nɛ, ba bɩ kʋdiilii kala cho, aŋ ka ba naaŋ lilieŋi sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Wɩaa chaasa jʋʋba nɛ ba ŋmoo niiŋ pɩ La Tɩɩna, ʋ laaba ta ba hɛɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: Ʋ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa nɛ vaarɛba, a laaba ta ba sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ba lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna a tɩŋ ʋ chonuŋ sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa pɩpɩ nuhuobiine wɩaa.

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a lɔllʋ, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a dagɛ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Ba dɔnsʋŋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ nɛ, a gɔllɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ aa yallɛ bayalɩŋ.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Ba na La Tɩɩna tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ, wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa Mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: Ʋ wʋbʋlaa nɛ leŋe pel-duoŋ lu, lɩɩ-peliŋ sii a kɛŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ vuvuugi.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ sii jɩjɩl wɩa-nyuŋ aŋ tutuu lɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ, wɩaa lɔrɛ ba nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
translation_verse: Baa gɛrɛ a nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bugi, ba wʋjɩmɩŋ kala ŋaa pɛɩ.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Wɩaa chaasa jʋʋba nɛ, ba ŋmoo niiŋ pɩ La Tɩɩna, ʋ laaba ta ba hɛɛŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe pel-duoŋ arɩ lɩɩ-peliŋ kala sigili, ka mʋgʋ-balɩŋ fɩɛla pɩŋ.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɔ nɛ ʋ sɩ leŋe pel-la sigili, aŋ kɛmba mʋ yi lee-la ba sɩɩ mʋ.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ba lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna a tɩŋ ʋ chonuŋ sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa pɩpɩ nuhuobiine wɩaa.

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe fuonuŋ bɩrɩmɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ, a ŋaa lɩɩ-bul-sɩaa tɔ.

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe tintee-la sɩma lɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ nɩmɛ faa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ bɩra leŋe fuonuŋ pɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, a leŋ lɩɩŋ bubul tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe losumoo hɔŋ nɩmɛ, a saa ba jaŋ a jʋjʋʋ.

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: Ba pɛrɛ bagɩsɩŋ arɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ bagɩsɩŋ nɛ, a na kʋdiilee arɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: Ʋ pɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ ba pʋŋa yʋgɛ woruŋ, a leŋ ba pʋsʋŋ ma pʋŋa pɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɩaa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ yuo diiba a nyagɛba bil a dɔgɩsɛba, ba na hɛɛŋ ba tʋɔŋ chei, ŋɩɩ yie leŋ ba muuri nɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna yie joŋ ʋ baanɩŋ a fɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yuo diiba lɛ, a leŋ ba gɔllɔ baarɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ yie laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ ta nɛ ba hɛɛŋ lɛ, a leŋ ba dɩa nɩaa pʋŋa yʋgɛ a nagɛ piesee.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa na wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, ka nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ niiŋ jʋʋ kpʋrʋŋ.

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa, ʋ tɩɩna joŋ wɩaa deemba hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ La Tɩɩna chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa bɩbɩɩnɛ.

english_verse: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
translation_verse: Wɩa, mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa chaasa chɩŋ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ du kɩaa a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɩŋ arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala.

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ sii sɩɩpʋʋraa a joŋ cheŋ arɩ kɔnɛ a du.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ. Tinteyee tʋɔŋ, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a pɩŋ.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ŋ chonuŋ yʋga nɛ a jɩla kieli wɩa-nyuŋ, ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ ma jɩla yi wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Wɩa, leŋ dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ sii kɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ, dɩ ŋ tʋla su dʋnɩa lee-kala.

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Laala ta arɩ ŋ doluŋ, a pɛ la lɛ dɩ wɩɩ sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ cho lɛ ŋaa.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ ŋ bʋla, “Mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛkɛm kaa kpaa, a kɛŋ fuonaa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sʋkɔf ma kpaa muno muno.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ tɩɩ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ, a tɩɩ Manasɛ tinteeŋ ma. Efirem nɛ ŋaa mɩ laalɩyuori nyunchu-gbaŋkogo, ka Juda ma ŋaa mɩ kuoru dantɩga.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Mʋab nɛ ŋaa gbaŋa-la mɩ sɩ kaa ŋaa lɩɩŋ a sʋsɔŋ mɩ naasɩŋ. Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ mɩ yie chaarɛ mɩ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ, aŋ ŋaa laalɩyuori diiri-goŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa lɛ.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ kɛmmɛ mʋ tabal-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ laa mɩ sɩpaaŋ a kɛmmɛ mʋ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ?

english_verse: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
translation_verse: Wɩa, ŋ nɛ vɩala ta, a bɩra bɩ la laalɩyuoroo kaa mʋmʋ laalɩŋ.

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Pɛ la lɛ dɩ la yuo dii la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, nuhuobiine pɛnɩŋ ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ chɩŋ la harɩŋ, la jaŋ yuo dii. Ʋ jaŋ yuo dii la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
translation_verse: Wɩa, mɩɩ dɛnnɩŋ nɛ, sɩ́ ŋ niiŋ tɔrʋ.

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: Ba bɛrɛmɛ nɛ a gollo bʋbʋlmɛ, a yuyuomi, ka mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na choba nɛ, a paala sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩba, aŋ ka ba bɛrɛmɛ.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a tiŋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ chɩmɩŋ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ-na cho ba nɛ, ka ba bɛrɛmɛ.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: Chɛ nɩbɔŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ mɩ dʋndɔmɔ lɛ, a bʋl ʋ teeŋ,

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: dɩ ba nɛ dii ʋ sarɩya dɩ ba na arɩ ʋ cheye nɛ. Leŋ dɩ ʋ Wɩɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ kɛnʋ hɛ wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kui, dɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ laa ʋ leriŋ a ŋaa sɩpaalaarʋ.

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ bɩrɩmɛ biisinsiŋ, dɩ ʋ haala ma bɩrɩmɛ yo-haal.

english_verse: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ gɔllɔ baaraa sʋl, dɩ ba kiriba ta dɩ ba lɩɩ ba jikpeeniŋ lɛ.

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: Leŋ nɩalɩŋ chɩŋŋaa ʋ sɩ die kɛŋ ʋ kɩaa kala laa, leŋ dɩ nʋhʋɔraa laa ʋ dʋa kala.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ zile ŋaa ʋ lɛ, a sɩ́ ʋ biisinsi-la ma nenige fá.

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ʋ doho kala dɛrɛ, dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛl nɩalɩŋ ba ha sɩ jaŋ lʋl tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, liise yi ʋ nyɩmmaba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, a sɩ́ wʋbɔmɔ-la ʋ naaŋ ma sɩ ŋaa yʋ.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, liliisi ba wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa bʋa na-kala, aŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa bɩra sɩ́ ba wɩaa liisu tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: Ʋ cho nɩaa lɛ kalɩba hɛnɩŋ. Leŋ dɩ kalɩbɩna-la gʋra dii ʋ tɩtɩa. Ʋ bɩ Wɩɩ-zɔŋ sʋla pɩpɩ nʋʋ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ ma na wʋzɔŋ.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala lɛ nɛ ʋ kalɩba hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛ. Leŋ dɩ kalɩbɩna-la gʋra wurisu a nagɛ lɩɩŋ a jʋʋ kɛŋ ʋ haŋgbelee a nagɛ nʋʋŋ.

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ʋ nagɛ gɛrɩŋ a tɔʋ, a nagɛ damɛrɛ, a vɔɔ ʋ tɩŋa bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, joŋ wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa a tiŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chei mɩ yɩrɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, tɩŋ ŋ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ wɩaa a kɛmmɛ woruŋ. Ŋ sɩ cho nɩaa a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ba lɛ, laamɛ ta.

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa summu nɛ, mɩ bɩ mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ kala chaasa chei nɛ.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: Mɩ kala yʋɔla dɛrɛ nɛ a nagɛ daaliimiŋ sɩ yie lɛl ŋɩɩ dɩdaanɩŋ, a nagɛ peliŋ sɩ joŋ hɔbɔ kaa viiri.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Mɩ naadʋsʋŋ kala nɛ yʋɔra a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ bɩ kɩaa ka dii, mɩ kala jagɛ, aŋ ka haŋgbelee.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩmɔmɩɩ nɛ, dɩ ba nɛ namɛ, ba chugisi nyuŋ.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, pɛ mɩ lɛ. Laamɛ ta a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ cho nɩaa wɩaa.

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jɩŋ arɩ ŋ-na La Tɩɩna nɛ laamɛ ta.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ kalɩbaa hɛ mɩ lɛ ma, ŋ-na jaŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ golloo yuomi, ba jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ. Ama mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna jaŋ jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ hɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩ-la tɔba a nagɛ gɛrɩŋ ba sɩ laala.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ suri mɩ niiŋ a chaasa lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna. Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa nɛ hilime.

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ chɩna pɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ, a laaba ta nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpʋba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bʋla pɩ mɩ Tɩɩna, “Hɔŋ mɩ nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ, see dɩ mɩ yuo dii ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ kuoruŋ doluŋ kieli Zaayɔŋ, dɩ ŋ yuo dii ŋ dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ golluŋ.

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ yuo ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, ŋ nɩaa jaŋ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa kʋ lɩɩ ŋ harɩŋ a kpɩɛrɛ ba tɩtɩa. Ŋ bapʋɔsɛ biisi-la jaŋ kɔ ŋ teeŋ peel-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa pɩ ŋ tɩtɩa nyuŋ.

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna hɛ ŋ nadiiŋ nɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ bʋrɩgɛ kuoroo.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ dii tinteyee nɩaa sarɩya, a kpʋ nɩaa chʋɔrɛ. Ʋ jaŋ yuo dii dʋnɩa kuoroo kala.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ nyʋnyʋa lɩɩŋ sɩɩ pɛllʋ wombiiŋ sɛmɛ. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ yuo dii nʋʋkala.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Mɩ jaŋ lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala, a dɛnnʋ lee-la ʋ nɩaa sɩ hilime.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ yʋgɛ nɛ. Nʋʋ na-kala tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɛ ba lɛ kɛmba bɩbɩɩnɛ.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: Ʋ wʋŋaalaa kala kɛŋ tʋla arɩ yɩrɩŋ, ʋ tʋɔpʋla bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ a magɛ dɩ la liliisiba nɛ. La Tɩɩna kɛŋ zile a fɩfá nɩaa nenige.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ fáʋ kʋdiilee nɛ. Ʋʋ liisi nii-la sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ wɩaa nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: Ʋ dagɛ ʋ nɩaa dol-la ʋ sɩ kaa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ, a laa tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa tinteyee a pɩba.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ na-kala ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa, ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ŋ jaŋ wuo joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa a hɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga lɛ.

english_verse: They are true and right and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ chaasa chɩŋ nɛ kpaŋkpaŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ tʋɔpʋla nɛ ʋ kaa bilba.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: Ʋ laa ʋ nɩaa ta nɛ, a bil niiŋ ʋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ʋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ma yɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ to wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa nɛ woruŋ. Nɩaa maga dɩ ba dɛnnʋ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ zil La Tɩɩna tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ, nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ to ʋ niiŋ wɩaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: Ʋ biiriŋ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ tinteeŋ lɛ. Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ʋ doho nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩa nɩaa jaŋ kɛŋ dʋa a kuori, ʋ tʋɔpʋl wɩaa jaŋ chɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋcheeli kɛnɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ zile arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, dɩ ba nɛ hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ ma, pʋlʋmʋŋ yie chaana pɩba nɛ.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Wɩaa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ pɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ zile a joŋ kɩaa a chɩchɩŋ nɩaa, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ ʋ wɩɩkala ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ tele, ba jaŋ liliisi ʋ wɩaa bʋa na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ nɩɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ ma, ʋ-na bɩ fawʋllʋŋ ka fá. Ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa chɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ, ʋ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ La Tɩɩna lɛ.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɔyɛ bɩ joŋ, ʋ bɩ fawʋllʋŋ ka fá. Ʋ jɩma, dɩdɛrɩŋ kala ʋ jaŋ yuo dii ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie joŋ kɩaa a didii zile summoo lɛ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ chɩŋ tʋɔpʋl wɩaa naaŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ nɩaa zizilu.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ jaŋ na ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ baanɩŋ sisii, ʋ dɩdɩŋ ʋ nyɩlaa a kala hɩl, ama wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ naʋ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa La Tɩɩna tɩntɩnnaa, má dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ La Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ, a chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna a chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ a kaa mʋ yi wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ. La Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ maga dɩ ʋ yɩrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ kɩɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala, ʋ tʋla kieli wɩa-nyuŋ jɩl.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ magɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa, Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ ʋ jaŋ lɛ dɩ-bolii,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: aŋ yie gʋra beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ?

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋ ba hɔnɔ guoli nɩbalaa tʋɔŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ ʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe hapɩrɩŋ lʋl biiriŋ nɛ. Ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ biiriŋ. Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, Jekɔb doho nɩaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl yikori-wogo tʋɔŋ,

english_verse: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
translation_verse: ʋ leŋe Juda tinteeŋ nɛ ŋaa lee-la ba sɩɩ dɛnnʋ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma a tɩɩba.

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Mʋgʋ-balɩŋ sɩ na Wɩa, ʋ fá nɛ aŋ ka tintee-hɩlɩŋ, Jɔdaŋ fuo-la ma kɛrɛ a bɩra bɩ pɛllɛ.

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: Peelee sii fʋfʋl a nagɛ pie-belliŋ, dundolluŋ ma fʋfʋl a nagɛ pie-biisiŋ.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Mʋgʋ-balɩŋ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ fá aŋ ka tintee-hɩlɩŋ? Jɔdaŋ fuoŋ ma, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ kɛrɛ a bɩra bɩ pɛllɛ?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: Peelee, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma sii fʋfʋl a nagɛ pie-belliŋ? Dundolluŋ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma ma fʋfʋl a nagɛ pie-biisiŋ?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ, zigili La Tɩɩna sɩpaaŋ, Wɩa-la Jekɔb sɩɩ chʋɔlʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe bʋŋ bɩrɩmɛ fuoŋ, a leŋ lɩɩŋ bulo lɩlɩɩ bʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: La-na bɩ maga dɩ nʋʋ dɛnnɛla. Ŋ-na La Tɩɩna, ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga dɩ ba dɛnnɛ, a tɩŋ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ arɩ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ pɩɛsɛla, “Nɩɩ nɛ ma Wɩa hɛ?”

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: La Wɩa hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ yie ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ cho nɛ.

english_verse: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Tinteye-la nɩaa ka to vʋɩyaa nuhuobiine sɩ kɛŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ kaa ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ niiŋ, aŋ bɩ wɩaa wuo bʋl, a kɛŋ sɩaa, aŋ bɩ na.

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ dɩgɩlaa, aŋ bɩ wɩaa ka nɩɩ, a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, aŋ bɩ sʋɔra ka nɩɩ.

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ nɩsaa nɛ, aŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo digi kʋŋ a jɩŋ, a kɛŋ naasɩŋ, aŋ bɩ wuo vɛŋ, a bɩ goŋ ma wuo ŋaa.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa vʋɩya-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ba lɛ, ba kala bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ bʋbʋa a nagɛ vʋɩya-la sɩ bɩ bʋbʋa-kala kɛnɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa, má laa La Tɩɩna dii. Ʋ nɛ pɛ ma lɛ a chu tɔma.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Ma Arɔŋ dɩa nɩaa, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, má laa La Tɩɩna dii. Ʋ nɛ pɛ ma lɛ a chu tɔma.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, má laaʋ dii. Ʋ nɛ pɛ ma lɛ a chu tɔma.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ka liisi la wɩaa nɛ, ʋ jaŋ pɛ la lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fáʋ lɛ, nɩbalaa arɩ nɩbiisiŋ kala.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋl La Tɩɩna dɩ ʋ leŋ ma dɩ ma biiriŋ pʋŋa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ La Tɩɩna pɛ ma lɛ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ ŋaa La Tɩɩna kʋa, ama ʋ joŋ tinteeŋ nɛ a pɩ nuhuobiinee.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba dee bɩ La Tɩɩna ka dɛnnɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ mʋ lɛlɩŋ dee.

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ama la nɩalɩŋ sɩ weye nɛ jaŋ dɛnnʋ, a chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩɩ jegili mɩ teeŋ ŋɩɩ, mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, mɩ jaŋ yɩrʋ.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Sʋʋŋ ŋmɛsɩŋ vɔɔmɛ nɛ a golli, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ, wɩaa jʋʋmɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ chei.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ yɩrɛ La Tɩɩna a bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, laamɛ ta.”

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ka fá nɩaa nisusuŋ nɛ, ʋ tʋɔŋ pʋlla. La Wɩa ka fá nɩaa nenige.

english_verse: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɩɩ pɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ woruŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ wɩaa sɩ jʋʋmɛ, ʋ nɛ laamɛ ta.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bɩra ta jɩa, bɛɛ wɩaa La Tɩɩna kɛmmɛ woruŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ laamɛ ta nɛ mɩ bɩ sʋba, a tɩɩgɛ mɩ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ ta, a pɔmɛ mɩ bɩ tele.

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ vɛŋ La Tɩɩna sɩpaaŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: Mɩ fa ha laaŋ dii nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ sɩ, “Hɛɛŋ jʋʋmɛ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ.”

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ fa sɩ kɛmmɛ, mɩ sɩ, “Nʋʋkala ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa tiŋ La Tɩɩna, a tɩŋ wʋzɔmɔ-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa pɩ mɩ wɩaa?

english_verse: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ laamɛ ta wɩaa.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ niiri-la mɩ sɩ hɛ pɩ La Tɩɩna ʋ nɩaa kala sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna chɩl nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ʋ niiŋ sʋʋŋ wɩaa nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, mɩ chaasa tɩma pɩpɩŋ a nagɛ mɩ naaŋ sɩ tɩma pɩŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ŋ laamɛ ta sʋʋŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna, a yɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ niiri-la mɩ sɩ hɛ pɩ La Tɩɩna, ʋ nɩaa kala sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ tʋɔŋ. Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, ma tinteyee nɩaa kala. Nɩaa kala, má dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna chola nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, ʋ wʋtɩtɩɩ ma bɩ dɛrɛ. Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Má lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ wɩaa zɔmɔ, ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, má bʋl, “Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Arɔŋ doho nɩaa, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, má bʋl, “Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, má bʋl, “Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ sɩ cheye, mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ pɩ La Tɩɩna nɛ, ʋ nɩɩ a laamɛ ta.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ nɛ, mɩ bɩ fawʋllʋŋ ka fá. Bɛɛ nɛ nuhuobiine jaŋ wuo ŋaamɛ?

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ nɛ, ʋ nɩɩ pɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ sɩɩŋ jaŋ na dɩ ʋ yuo dii mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ yuori La Tɩɩna nɛ kpɩa ŋ sɩ joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa hɛ nuhuobiine lɛ.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa yʋga nɛ a gollimi, ama La Tɩɩna doluŋ lɛ, mɩ yuo diiba nɛ.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba gollimi sɛmɛ kala nɛ, ama La Tɩɩna doluŋ lɛ, mɩ yuo diiba nɛ.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Ba tɔmɛ hɛ a nagɛ tʋʋ-biee nɛ, ama ba guu sʋʋ nɛ, a nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩ joŋ sɔsʋŋ dii. La Tɩɩna doluŋ lɛ, mɩ yuo diiba nɛ.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Ba fa pɛsɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ woruŋ, a ka mʋa dɩ ba yuo diimi, ama La Tɩɩna nɛ pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa mɩ doluŋ, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnʋ, ʋ nɛ laamɛ ta.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Tʋɔtɔrɛ goŋ arɩ yuo-diiri goŋ nɛ baa ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa lɛŋŋɛɛ lɛ. Ba sɩ: “La Tɩɩna doluŋ nɛ ŋaa wʋduoru-la.

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna doluŋ nɛ la kaa yuo laalɩŋ dii, La Tɩɩna doluŋ nɛ ŋaa wʋduoru-la.”

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ, ama mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, a heele bʋl wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna leŋe mɩ na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ, ama ʋ bɩ leŋe mɩ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ boi-baala-la tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa sɩ too jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ suro pɩmɛ, dɩ mɩ jʋʋ lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna boi-baalɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la, tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa sɩ to jʋjʋʋ.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɔllʋŋ, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa mɩ sʋla wɩaa, a laamɛ ta.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Tie-bii-la dɩɩ-saaraa sɩ vɩa ta nɛ kʋ ŋaa tie-bii-duoŋ ba sɩ joŋo bil dɩa gentine.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ, wɩɩ-la ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere nɛ a pɩla.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la, ʋ maga dɩ la tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ dɩ la jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: Laa sʋlʋŋ La Tɩɩna, laala ta, La Tɩɩna, leŋ dɩ la yuo dii.

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ kɔ La Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Laa dɛnnɩŋ nɛ La Tɩɩna dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ Wɩa, ʋ leŋe ʋ pʋlʋmʋŋ chaana hɛ la lɛ nɛ. La jaŋ kori abɛ pɩpaarɩŋ a pʋɔla mʋ ʋ koru-la teeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ mɩ Wɩa, mɩ jaŋ lɔllʋŋ, ŋ nɛ mɩ Wɩa, mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Má lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ wɩaa zɔmɔ, ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to La Tɩɩna wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ʋ niiŋ arɩ ba tʋɔŋ kala.

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ wʋbɔŋ ka ŋaa, baa to La Tɩɩna wombiee nɛ.

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ bil wombie-la pɩla, dɩ la chaasa tutoba.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa cho dɩ wɩɩkala mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa, tuto wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ.

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ joŋ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa hɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ sɩ́ mɩ dii.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ arɩ tʋɔpʋla, dɩ mɩ nɛ gʋnnɛ ŋ tʋɔpʋl wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ tuto wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga, sɩ́ mɩ vɩa ta.

english_verse: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ bapʋɔsɩ-bie jaŋ ŋaa a sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ? See dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ aa toŋ, pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ mɩ sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga lɛ yeŋŋu.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa hɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ mɩ sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa chei ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩɩ dɛnnɩŋ nɛ. Dagɛmɛ ŋ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dagɛ ŋ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto a pɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɩɩ to ŋ wʋdagaa, ŋɩɩ yie leŋ mɩ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ, a nagɛ nɩa sɩ dʋa kɩaa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ wʋdagaa chʋchɔgɩsɛ, aŋ joŋ mɩ sɩaa hɛ ŋ wombiee lɛ.

english_verse: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nyuŋ nɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ yʋ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, kɛmmɛ woruŋ, dɩ mɩ wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a to ŋ niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Suri mɩ sɩaa, dɩ mɩ wuo na wʋkpuŋkperisi-la sɩ hɛ wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto lɛ.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔrʋ nɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga joŋo faamɛ.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ cho kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ, dɩ mɩ tuto ŋ wombiee ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto bʋa na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: Ŋ kpɩa sɩɩ-duo tɩmma-la lɛ nɛ, ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩ yeŋŋi wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga lɛ.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba sieri mɩ lɛ a tʋtʋʋsɛmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga tɩtɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaaraa hilime nɛ aa chei mɩ yɩrɩŋ, ama mɩ-na ha jaŋ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga chʋchɔgɩsɛ.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga dɩ la tuto nɛ leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ tʋtɔrɛ, wɩalɩŋ nɩɩ dagɛmɛ.

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: Mɩ chɩŋ sʋʋŋ naaŋ lɛ nɛ, leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa pɩŋ nɛ, ŋ laa mɩ sʋla. Dagɛmɛ ŋ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ ŋ wʋdagaa bʋbʋɔŋ, a kɛŋ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa chʋchɔgɩsɛ.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ cheye mɩ pʋgɩmɛ, leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ doluŋ arɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Leŋ mɩ dɩ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ pɛgɛ bol, fá mɩ nenige aŋ dagɛmɛ ŋ wombiee.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiiŋ nɛ, mɩ joŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala hɛ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diimi.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chaasa to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, dagɛmɛ dɩ mɩ to ŋ wombiee, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ toba bʋa na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ ŋ wombii-la wɩaa woruŋ, mɩ jaŋ tou arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ba lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ cho ŋ wombiee, aŋ sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ hɛ dʋa lɛ.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛmɛ wʋtɔɔnʋŋ lɛ, a leŋ dɩ mɩ to ŋ niiŋ wɩaa a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ sɩ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fáŋ, a pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛmɛ hɩɩsɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ fá lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto zɔmɔ.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: Mɩ cho dɩ mɩ to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ, ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, dagɛ ŋ chonuŋ mɩ lɛ, a laamɛ ta arɩ ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo na wombiiŋ a bʋl wɩɩ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tʋʋsɛmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ laa ŋ niiŋ wɩaa dii nɛ.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ bʋbʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ bʋa na-kala, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ tuto wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ gɔllɔ ta jɩa, a tɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ to ŋ wʋdagaa wɩaa.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga a pɩ kuoroo, ka hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛmmɛ.

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: Mɩ cho wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ba lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Mɩ cho wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ a zizilba, mɩ jaŋ kɛmba chʋchɔgɩsɛ.

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Liise yi nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ pɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna lɛ, ŋɩɩ leŋe mɩ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa nɛ.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ, ŋ leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ nɛ pɩmɛ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ liise yi faafaa kala wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile la tuto lɛ nɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ dagʋ ŋaa yɩɩl nɛ a pɩmɛ, mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ lɛ mɩ sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, tɩtaŋɩŋ mɩ yie liisi ŋ wɩaa nɛ, mɩ jaŋ to wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ vɛnɛɛ ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ Nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ, mɩ hɛ niiŋ nɛ arɩ mɩ jaŋ tuto ŋ niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ nɛ arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala, kɛmmɛ woruŋ arɩ ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: Mɩ beŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ mɛlɛ sɩ naga nɛ, aŋ bɩrɩmɛ aa to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: Mɩ guu sɛɩ nɛ aa to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga, mɩ bɩ kaa dieni.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nyagɛmɛ bil ma nɛ, ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ yʋ wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto wɩaa.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Tɩta-siesee mɩ sii lɔllʋŋ nɛ, a tɩŋ tʋɔpʋl wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto wɩaa.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ fáŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nandɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ hɛ dʋnɩa lee-kala nɛ, dagɛmɛ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ pɩmɛ arɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Pɩmɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ mɩ jɩmaa ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ laa ŋ niiŋ wɩaa dii nɛ.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa yeŋŋi ŋ wombiiŋ lɛ nɛ, ŋ dɔgɩsɛmɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ sɛɩ ŋ niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ŋ wɩaa zɔmɔ, wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋ ŋɩŋaa. Dagɛmɛ ŋ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa gɔllɔ nyɩɛ wɩaa a chichei mɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ, ama mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ a tuto wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Tʋɔ-togi tɩmma nɛ nɩalɩŋ, ama mɩ-na tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ ŋ sɩ dɔgɩsɛmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ leŋ mɩ gʋnnɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto kɛŋ nyʋʋrʋŋ mɩ teeŋ, a kɩɩ moribie-la kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ ŋaamɛ, a leŋ mɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ naga. Pɩmɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ mɩ wuo gʋnnɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fáŋ namɛ, dɩ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa hɛ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ jɩma ŋŋ dii sarɩya ʋ bʋa lɛ nɛ. Ŋ dɔgɩsɛmɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ bʋa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ŋ cholo-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ ŋaa dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala, arɩ ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Fá mɩ nenige a leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa, a tɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ mɩ lɛ, ka mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye. Ama mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga dɩ la tuto chʋchɔgɩsɛ.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fáŋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga dɩ la tuto.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ chaasa tuto wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga woruŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ sɩ́ mɩ dii.

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Mɩ kala nɛ bɛsɩmɛ, mɩ sɩ gbɛrɛ dɩ ŋ laamɛ ta. Ama mɩ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: Mɩ gbɛrɛ dɩ mɩ na wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ sɩ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa a lɔl nɛ, aŋ pɩɛsɛ, “Chɛ bɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala?”

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Mɩ nagɛ puruŋ nyʋɔsʋŋ sɩ chalɩba ʋ kolimi nɛ, ama mɩ ha bɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga yʋa.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɛ dɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna gbɛrɛ a diene magɛ? Bʋa bɛɛ lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa lu buotuoŋ bil mɩ lɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ tuu, nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa dɩ ba to wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto.

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: Ba fa ka mʋa dɩ ba kpʋmɛ, ama mɩ bɩ ŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga vɩa.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa, leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, a wuo to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ niiŋ wɩaa jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, ba chaasa chɩŋ nɛ kpaŋkpaŋ ŋ jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ ma kala ba sɩ jaŋ lʋl teeŋ, ŋ nɛ ŋaa dʋnɩa ʋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto chɩna nɛ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala, bɛɛ wɩaa kʋŋkala tɩmaa pɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Dɩ wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto dee fa bɩ mɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ pa, mɩ fa jaŋ sʋʋ hɛɛ-la sɩ jʋʋmɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ yʋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ sɩɩ toba nɛ tɩɩ ŋ leŋ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ tɩɩmɛ, laamɛ ta, mɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ pɔ nɛ a gbɛrɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ, ama mɩ-na jaŋ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga kaa bɩbɩɩnɛ.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: Mɩ chaasa cho wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto nɛ woruŋ. Mɩ kɛnʋ chʋchɔgɩsɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga hɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ bʋa na-kala, ŋɩɩ leŋ mɩ jɩŋ wɩaa kɩɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa a kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ dagɛmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga chʋchɔgɩsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa a kɩɩ banɩhɩasɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Mɩ lɩɩsɛ mɩ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋ kala wombiiŋ lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩɩ chɛ mɩ to ŋ niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto lɛ lɩa, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ dagɛmɛ.

english_verse: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ leŋe mɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa, ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ bɛrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wombiiŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: Ŋ niiŋ wɩaa nagɛ chaanɩŋ nɛ a laa mɩ sɩpaaŋ, a nagɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ mɩ wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ niiŋ nɛ aŋ chɩna gbɛrɛ arɩ mɩ jaŋ to tʋɔpʋl wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩɩ na hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ. Leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ŋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, laa mɩ dɛnnɛ-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩpɩŋ, aŋ dagɛmɛ ŋ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ bɛrɛ bil mɩ lɛ nɛ, ama mɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga lɛ begile.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga ŋaa dʋa nɛ a pɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, ba nɛ leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ tʋtɔrɛ.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ dɩ mɩ to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ, a kaa mʋ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔsaa balɩa nɛ, ama mɩ cho wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto nɛ.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ mɩ yuori, ŋ nɛ chu tɔmɛ. Mɩ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa hɛ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Ma nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba, má sʋʋsa lɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, ka dɩ mɩ wuo to wɩalɩŋ mɩ Wɩa sɩ daga.

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, pɩmɛ doluŋ arɩ ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ, leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ dii hɩɩsɩŋ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Jommi nɔgɛ, dɩ wɩɩkala sɩ́ mɩ walɩmʋ, bʋa na-kala mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ nyuŋ hɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga lɛ.

english_verse: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
translation_verse: Ŋ vɩa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ yeŋŋe wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga lɛ nɛ, ba nɩnyɩsɩɩ-la kala ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nagɛ nɩsʋrʋŋ nɛ ŋ teeŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ cho wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ mɩ chichel, a tɩŋ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩɩ dii sarɩya lɛ.

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ wɩɩ nɛ mɩ ŋaa, sɩ́ mɩ leŋe pɩ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna woruŋ dɩ wɩɩ sɩ́ mɩ lɛ ŋaa, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ sɩɩ-duo tɩŋŋaa dɔgɩsɛmɛ.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Mɩ gbɛrɛ dɩ ŋ laamɛ ta nɛ a lɔl, a gbɛrɛ tʋɔpʋl nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ a lɔl.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Dagɛ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna, aŋ dagɛmɛ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, pɩmɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ mɩ wuo jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga sɩaa.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: Mɩ cho wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga a kɩɩ sɛlɩmɛ, mɩ choba kɩɩ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ.

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ daga nɛ, aŋ bɛrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wombii kala.

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga chaasa zɔŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ tutoba.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ hɩɛnɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ, a haa niiŋ chɩchɛba.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Beŋ mɩ sɩaa lɛ aŋ fá mɩ nenige, arɩ ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ choŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Dagɛmɛ dɩ mɩ vɩvɛŋ woruŋ arɩ ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ laamɛ tɩɩ.

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Laamɛ ta nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyagɛmɛ bil nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ mɩ wuo to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Suri sɩaa pɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna, aŋ dagɛmɛ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, ŋ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto ma tʋʋlɛ.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Mɩ baanɩŋ chaasa sii nɛ, mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ vɩa dɩ ba to ŋ niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Niiri-la ŋ sɩ hɛ chaasa ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ, mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna choba.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ nɩfɩaŋ ŋaa, nʋʋkala sɩpaa tuo mɩ lɛ, ama mɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga yʋa.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Ŋ tʋɔpʋla bɩ dɩdɛrɩ kɛnɛ, wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto ma ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Wɩaa jʋʋmɛ nɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ chei, ama ŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ leŋe mɩ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga tʋʋla nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ ba sɩaa a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, mɩɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala dɩ ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ sɛɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Mɩ yelee pɩŋ nɛ, laamɛ ta, mɩ jaŋ to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Mɩ sii sɩɩ-pʋʋraa nɛ a ŋmoo niiŋ pɩŋ dɩ ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa hɛ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋɩŋ kala nɛ mɩ bɛrɛ doŋ, a kɛŋ niiri-la ŋ sɩ hɛ chʋchɔgɩsɛ.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, a tɩŋ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa, nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, a fá mɩ nenige a leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmɔ-la sɩ vʋʋrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ kʋʋ kpagɛ nɛ, ba sɩpaa tuo wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto lɛ.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ama La Tɩɩna, ŋ-na kpagɛmɛ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga kala ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Faafaa kala nɛ mɩ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga, arɩ ŋ ŋaaba bil dɩ ba hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Bee na hɛɛ-la tʋɔŋ mɩ sɩ hɛ aŋ laamɛ ta, mɩ bɩ wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto yʋa.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Chɩna gbɛrɩmɛ a laamɛ ta, a leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba na laatanɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto ka chɛ.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋŋ fá nɩaa nenige nɛ woruŋ, leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yʋga nɛ a to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ, ama mɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga vɩa.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Mɩ yie beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩŋ laa dii, mɩ tʋɔŋ chaasa lɩɩba nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa ka to.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, bee na ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ cho wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga, leŋ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ŋ chonuŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: Ŋ niiŋ wɩaa kala ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ, ŋ tʋɔpʋl wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaaraa to naasɩŋ aa dɔgɩsɛmɛ nɛ, ka mɩ bɩ wɩɩkala cheye, ama ŋ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ nɛ mɩ fɩfá.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɛrɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, mɩ tʋɔŋ lɩɩʋ, ama mɩ cho wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Mɩ yie dɛnnɩŋ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ nɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala, a tɩŋ ŋ tʋɔpʋl wombie-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto wɩaa.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto tʋɔŋ yie chaasa pɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ. Wɩɩkala tuo sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ba tel.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩɩ gbɛrɩŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ laamɛ ta, mɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ to ŋ wʋdagaa nɛ, mɩ choba nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩŋ mɩ wɩɩkala nɛ, mɩɩ to ŋ niiŋ wɩaa arɩ ŋ wʋdagaa nɛ.

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩɩ ŋmoo niiŋ ŋ teeŋ nɛ, leŋ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa arɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Jegile nɩɩ mɩ sʋla, aŋ laamɛ ta arɩ ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ bʋa na-kala lɛ, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ dagɛmɛ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa lɛ, ŋ wʋdagaa kala ŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Ŋaa siri a pɛ mɩ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩɩ gbɛrɩŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ laamɛ ta, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a wuo dɛnnɩŋ, leŋ dɩ ŋ wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto chagɛmɛ kɩɩ.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Mɩ yeŋŋe nɛ a nagɛ piese sɩ lɛlɛ. Chɛ kɛŋ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ ŋ wʋdagaa yʋa.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray,
translation_verse: Wɩaa sɩ jʋʋmɛ, mɩ yɩrɛ La Tɩɩna nɛ, ʋ laa mɩ sʋla.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna, laamɛ ta wʋnyɩɛraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ nyɩsɛ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ bayuoro to-hɛŋŋɛɛ sɩ kɛŋ niiŋ woruŋ arɩ nyiŋ-halaa a dɔgɩsɛma.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Wɩaa jaŋ puumi dɩ mɩ nɛ hɛ Mɛsɛk lɛ, koo dɩ mɩ nɛ hɛ Keda nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ nɩaa sɩ bɩ fɩɛlɩŋ cho tʋɔŋ a dieni kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ cho dɩ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ, ama dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋl wɩaa chɩchɛ fɩɛlɩŋ, ba-na yie chɩchɛ yuosuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: Mɩ wʋlaa beŋ peelee nyuŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ na, nɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ na nʋʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ na pɛnɩŋ a lɩɩ La Tɩɩna teeŋ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ tel, ʋ nɩɩ pɔŋ, ʋ bɩ doŋ ka dɩɛgɛ.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩ doŋ ka dɩɛgɛ koo aa pɩŋ doŋ.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ beŋ ŋ nyuŋ, ʋ hɛ ŋ sɛmɛ nɛ a pʋpɔŋ.

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ bɩ jaŋ ŋaaŋ wʋbɔŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ, chɛnɛ ma bɩ jaŋ ŋaaŋ wɩɩkala tɩtaŋɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ pɔŋ a lɩɩsɩŋ wʋbɔŋ kala lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ pɔ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ pɔŋ lee na-kala ŋ sɩɩ mʋ, a chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɔ nɛ ba sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Leŋ dɩ la mʋ La Tɩɩna dɩa.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm, la chɩŋ ŋ boi-baalaa niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm ŋaa tabal nɛ, ba saa ʋ dɩɩsɩŋ kala jʋʋ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ doho doho nɩaa yie mʋ, La Tɩɩna nɩaa doho doho-la a dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, arɩ ʋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ Devit doho nɩaa fa yie dii kuoruŋ a hɔŋ a bibeŋ ba nɩaa.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Má sʋl Wɩa ŋ-la a pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa dɩ ba hɔŋ sɔm, “A leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ choŋ dʋa.

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
