translation_verse: Jerusalɛm, a leŋ dɩ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ ŋ saarɩŋ kala lɛ, dɩ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ ŋ kuori-dɩɩsɩŋ ma lɛ.”

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ mɩ naambiiriŋ arɩ mɩ nandɔnsʋŋ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ sʋl Wɩa a bʋl, “A leŋ dɩ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.”

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ La Tɩɩna Wɩa dɩa wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ sʋl Wɩa dɩ ŋ dʋa.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ beŋ ŋ lɛ nɛ, ŋ hɔŋ ŋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ nɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, fá la nenige, fá la nenige, ba bee gʋʋnɛla kieli nɛ.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa mɔnla a kieli nɛ, sɩɩ-duo tɩŋŋaa bee gʋʋnɛla a kieli nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Dɩ La Tɩɩna nɛ fa bɩ la harɩŋ chɩna, Iziral tɩmma, má bʋl,

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: “Dɩ La Tɩɩna nɛ fa bɩ la harɩŋ chɩna, bʋa-la lɛ la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ kʋʋ yuola,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: ba fa jaŋ paa la kala liŋ, a tɩŋ ba baanɩŋ sɩ faasa sii la nyuŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: Ba baanɩŋ sɩ faasa sii a nagɛ lɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩɩ pɛllʋ ŋɩɩ fa jaŋ paala viiri. Lɩɩ-la fa jaŋ tɔla.

english_verse: of high and roaring waves.”
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-la sɩ faasa pɩpɛllɛ fa jaŋ paala viiri.”

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, ʋ sɩ bɩ leŋe ba kɛnla pʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
translation_verse: La foro lɩɩ nɛ a nagɛ diibie sɩ foro lɩɩ nambagɩla bɛrɛ lɛ. Bɛrɛ-la boro nɛ ka la foro lɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɩɩ pɛ la lɛ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ La Tɩɩna lɛ, ba nagɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ nɛ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛnʋ jigisi, ʋ chɩna nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: A nagɛ peelee sɩ gollo chu Jerusalɛm ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna chɩna golli ʋ nɩaa, a chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kuoruŋ bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ, dɩ ba bibeŋ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa ma mɩɩra ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩ nɩzɔŋŋɔɔ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Ama La Tɩɩna, dɩ ŋ nɩɩ dɔgɩsɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ, dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ to nɩbɔŋ wombiee. A leŋ dɩ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩ kɛnla mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm, wɩɩ-la nagɛ duosoo nɛ a pɩla.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: La mɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa bʋl, “La Tɩɩna ŋaa wʋduoruŋ nɛ a pɩba.”

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna chaasa ŋaa wʋduoruŋ nɛ a pɩla, la tʋɔŋ kala nɛ tɔrɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, pɛ la lɛ dɩ la bɩra dʋa, a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ yie nɩɩ fuo-bʋa bɩra kɛŋ lɩɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ duu kɩaa arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ, ba jaŋ ŋaa kɩalɩŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ chʋŋ kʋdoho a lɩɩ duu arɩ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa kɩalɩŋ a pagɩla kʋ jʋʋ dɩa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ folo sii koo a bɛrɛ doŋ, a lɔlɔ chɩchɛ kʋdiilee, ʋ ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ. La Tɩɩna yie paala chɛ a bil nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ cho lɛ nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ ba ha sɩ pɩŋ doŋ.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Hambolibiisiŋ ŋaa kʋzɔmɔ nɛ La Tɩɩna yie joŋo pɩla, biiriŋ ŋaa zile kɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Dɩ baala nɛ lʋl hambolibiisiŋ ʋ bapʋɔsʋŋ lɛ, ʋ yie nagɛ bayuoro sɩ kɛŋ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala huoŋ sɩ suo arɩ to-hɛmɛ-la, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ diiu dɩ ʋ nɩɩ yuo ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ to ʋ wombiee.

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ nɩɩ ŋ lɔlʋŋ sɩma, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ dʋa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: Ŋ haala jaŋ lʋl biiriŋ yʋgɛ ŋ dɩa lɛ a nagɛ girep sɩ faasa nɛŋ. Ŋ hambolibiisiŋ jaŋ hɔnɔ golluŋ kɩaa dɩ-diiliŋ a nagɛ olif tɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ La Tɩɩna sɩ jaŋ pɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ to ʋ niiŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ dɩ La Tɩɩna lɩɩ Zaayɔŋ lɛ a kʋ pɛ ŋ lɛ, ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ tapʋlaa kala lɛ. A leŋ dɩ ŋ na dɩ Jerusalɛm dʋa.

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ duomi, dɩ ŋ na ŋ nihee. A leŋ dɩ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Ba dɔgɩsɛmɛ nɛ woruŋ mɩ bapʋɔsʋŋ kala lɛ, má leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa bʋl,

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: “Ba dɔgɩsɛmɛ nɛ woruŋ mɩ bapʋɔsʋŋ kala lɛ, ama ba bɩ wuo yuo diimi.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Ba kpɛrɛ mɩ harɩŋ nɛ ʋ kala ŋaa naawɩɩlaa a nagɛ ba sɩ pɛrɛ baga.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: Ama La Tɩɩna ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, ʋ purimi ta nɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋmɛsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɛrɛ Zaayɔŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ a mɩɩra fá.

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba nagɛ yaŋ sɩ nyʋ lusuŋ nyuŋ, a bɩ waa aŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ to nɩmɛ bɩbal bʋl, “Laa sʋl La Tɩɩna dɩ ʋ pɛ ŋ lɛ, laa yɩrɛ La Tɩɩna dɩ ʋ pɛ ŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ jʋʋ wɩaa magɛ baŋŋaa nɛ, a ŋmoo niiŋ pɩpɩŋ.

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, nɩɩ mɩ yele, jegile nɩɩ mɩ nii-ŋmobo-la mɩ sɩ ŋmoo pɩpɩŋ dɩ ŋ fá mɩ nenige.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, dɩ ŋ nɛ sɩ ŋ dɩɩsɛ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ ka.

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ nɛ joŋ wɩaa chɩchɛla, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ maga dɩ la fáŋ.

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: Mɩ gbɛrɛ La Tɩɩna nɛ woruŋ a kɩɩ nʋʋ sɩ pɔ leriŋ a gbɛrɛ dɩ taŋ pʋl. Mɩ gbɛrʋ a kɩɩ nʋʋ sɩ pɔ leriŋ a gbɛrɛ dɩ taŋ pʋl.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, má joŋ ma yɩɛlaa kala hɛ La Tɩɩna lɛ. La Tɩɩna chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ ma ʋ sɩ jaŋ laama ta.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ jaŋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala lɛ.

english_verse: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ bɩ nyuduoŋ kɛnɛ, mɩ sɩaa ma bɩ lɩŋ. Mɩ sɩpaa tuo wʋbalaa ŋaanɩŋ lɛ, wɩalɩŋ sɩ yʋga kɩɩ mɩ ŋaanɩŋ.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Ama, mɩ tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ, a nagɛ bii-bie sɩ pɩna ta jɩa ʋ naaŋ naasɩŋ nyuŋ. Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa a nagɛ bii-bie nɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, má joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ La Tɩɩna lɛ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, liisi Devit wɩaa arɩ hɛɛ-la kala ʋ sɩ na.

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ mʋ mɩ dɩa koo a pɩŋ doŋ,

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: a kaa mʋ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ chɛ leriŋ, a pɩ La Tɩɩna Jekɔb Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala dɩjʋʋlʋŋ.”

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ la fa sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛfɩrata lɛ, la nɩa dɩ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la hɛ lee dɔŋ nɛ a kpagɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jaa.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la bʋl, “Má leŋ dɩ la mʋ La Tɩɩna dɩa a dɛnnʋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ dɩ ŋ niiriŋ daga-la sɩ ŋaa ŋ doluŋ magɩlɩŋ, sii kʋ jʋʋ ŋ dɩa.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, aŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa ŋ wɩaa dii yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a jʋjʋɔsɛ.”

english_verse: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
translation_verse: Devit nɛ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa, ŋɩɩ wɩaa sɩ́ ʋ vɩa ta.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ fa ŋmɩɛsa a pɩ Devit nɛ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ vɩa nii-la ta, ŋ sɩ, “Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ doho nɩaa nɛ didii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ biiriŋ nɛ to nii-la sɩ hɛ la pɛgɛ, a kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛba a tɩtɩŋ, ŋɩɩ-na ba biiriŋ ma jaŋ didii kuoruŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ lɩɩsɛ Zaayɔŋ, ʋ ŋaa ŋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ pɛ Zaayɔŋ nɩaa lɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ, dɩ summo-la sɩ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ ma wuo na kʋdiilee a dii vɔgɛ.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ laa ʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ta, aŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a jʋjʋɔsɛ.”

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Devit doho nʋʋ dii kuoruŋ nɩmɛ, dɩ ʋ kuoruŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a chaanɛ a nagɛ chaanɩŋ sɩ bɩ dɩsɛ,

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: a chu kuoru nyunchuulo sɩɩ tʋl, ka dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ dii hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Dɩ naambiiriŋ nɛ hɛ dɔŋɔ a kɛŋ nii-bala, ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: Nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ nagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ ba sɩ bɩsa hɛ Arɔŋ nyuŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ pɛllɛɛ tuu ʋ tɔŋŋɔɔ, a pɛllɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ ŋɩɩ a tuu jʋʋ ʋ gɛrɩŋ baŋŋaa.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra nagɛ nyalɩŋ sɩ nyala hɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛmɔŋ lɛ nɛ, a pɛllɛ kʋʋ tuu Zaayɔŋ peeliŋ nyuŋ. Lee-la nɛ La Tɩɩna hɛ niiŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ pɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ, dɩ ba kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Má nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa La Tɩɩna tɩntɩnnaa, a tɩtɩŋ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ, má kʋ dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma nɩsaa je a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ aŋ dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩ hɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ma lɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, má leŋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa La Tɩɩna tɩntɩnnaa, má dɛnnʋ,

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ tɩŋ La Tɩɩna Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ arɩ ʋ kaalɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, ʋ wɩaa zɔmɔ. Ma yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a pʋ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna lɩɩsɛ Jekɔb nɛ ʋ ŋaa ʋ nʋʋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala ŋaa ʋ nɩchooloo.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma La Tɩɩna nɛ yʋga, La Tɩɩna nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩ vesiŋ kala.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ka ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ cho nɛ, wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ lɛ, mʋgʋ-balaa arɩ ba dɩ-luŋuŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie leŋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ lee-kala. Ʋ yie leŋ duonuŋ nɩnɩɩ aŋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ, a leŋ peliŋ lɩɩ ʋ dɩ-faalɩŋ a lulu.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ kpʋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa bii-bumbumba arɩ ba pʋsʋŋ bii-bumbumba kala.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kala.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: Ʋ chei tinteyee yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ, a kpʋ kuoroo ma sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ:

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩhɔŋ, Basaŋ tɩŋŋaa kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɔgɩ, arɩ kuorie-la kala sɩ hɛ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ. Kuoroo deemba kala nɛ ʋ kpʋ,

english_verse: and gave their property to his people Israel.
translation_verse: aŋ joŋ ba tinteeŋ kala pɩ ʋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba tɩɩʋ.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, nɩalɩŋ ma kala ba sɩ jaŋ lʋl jaŋ liisi ŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ laa ʋ nɩaa ta, aŋ fá ʋ tɩntɩnnaa ma nenige.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ nɩaa kɛŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ a libi tɔŋŋɔɔ. Ba tɩtɩa nɩsaa nɛ ŋaa kɩaa deemba.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Tɔmɔ-la kɛŋ niiŋ nɛ, aŋ bɩ wɩaa wuo bʋl, a kɛŋ sɩaa aŋ bɩ na.

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ dɩgɩlaa nɛ, aŋ bɩ nɩɩ, a bɩ wiese ma kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ libi tɔmɔ-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ba lɛ jaŋ ŋaa nɩpɛɩba a nagɛ tɔmɔ-la ba sɩ libe.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Má Iziral tɩmma, má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Má Arɔŋ dɩa nɩaa, ma Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa, má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, má dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna Zaayɔŋ lɛ, má dɛnnʋ ʋ jaŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Má lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna, ʋ wɩaa zɔmɔ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Má lɔllɛ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩ vesiŋ kala. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Má lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ kʋŋkala lɛ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɩɩ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ ʋ kaa ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ ŋaa tinteeŋ a daŋ lɩɩŋ nyuŋ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ chɛnɛ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe wɩɩpɔsʋŋ pʋpɔsɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe chɛnɛ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa chɩchaanɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ kpʋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa bii-bumbumba. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ naduo-la nɛ ʋ kaa laaba ta. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ kpaa balɩa. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe Iziral tɩŋŋaa to mʋga-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ a lɩɩ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ-la lɩɩŋ tɔ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala ba sʋʋ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ kɛŋ ʋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa a gɔllɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ kpʋ kuoru-balaa. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ kpʋ kuorie-la sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Sɩhɔŋ nɛ fa ŋaa ba dɔŋɔ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Dɔŋɔ ma nɛ Basaŋ kuoro Ɔgɩ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ kɛŋ ba tinteeŋ laa. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ joŋ ba tintee-la a pɩ ʋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ba tɩɩʋ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna na hɛɛ-la tʋɔŋ la fa sɩ hɛ nɛ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ʋ laala ta la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɩɩ pɩ kʋŋkala sɩ weye kʋdiilee. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Má lɔllɛ Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ. Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ la sɩ hɔŋ Babɩlɔŋ fuonu-la sɛmɛ, nɩmɛ nɛ la liisi Zaayɔŋ wɩaa a yel woruŋ.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Tɩɩsɩ-la sɩ kpagɛ nɩmɛ nyuŋ nɛ la joŋ la chenniŋ a sagɛ.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yuo kɛsɛla kɔ nɩmɛ sɩ dɩ la yɩɩ yɩɩlaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛla chɩchɛ dɩ la yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a gbiele pɩba. Ba yie kpɩa la lɛ a bʋl, “Má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa sɩ mʋʋ tɩgɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ a pɩla.”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ wuo ŋaa yɩɩ La Tɩɩna yɩɩlaa, la sɩ hɛ tintee-wogo lɛ?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm, dɩ mɩ nɛ yʋ ŋ wɩaa, leŋ dɩ mɩ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ nandelimiŋ mɛrɛ mɩ tilimiŋ lɛ, dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ ŋ wɩaa liise, dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ bɩɩna dɩ Jerusalɛm nɛ ŋaa mɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ kɩŋkɛŋ leriŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, liise yi wɩɩ-la Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa tapʋlɩɩ-la la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ yuo dii Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ba sɩ, “Má chei taŋ-la a ŋmoo ʋ gentine kala lo muno muno.”

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa, sʋʋŋ puuma nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ joŋ wɩɩ-la ma sɩ joŋo ŋaa la lɛ chɩmɩŋ a tiŋ ma lɛ, ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ laa ma biiriŋ a joŋo vɩɩrɛ bʋŋ kpʋ, ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ lɔllʋŋ arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala. Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ ŋ tɩndaaraa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kpirime joŋ mɩ sɩaa chaasɛ ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, aŋ dɛnnɩŋ, a tɩŋ ŋ chonuŋ arɩ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ wɩaa. Ŋ yɩrɩŋ arɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa nɛ ŋ leŋ ba kɩɩ kʋŋkala.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, ŋ laa mɩ sʋla nɛ, a leŋ mɩ nyuŋ nyaasɛ, mɩ yaraa polli.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, leŋ dɩ kuorie-la kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ dɛnnɩŋ, dɩ ba nɛ nɩɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, leŋ dɩ ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa La Tɩɩna, ŋ yɩrɩŋ yʋga.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii nɛ, aŋ bibeŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri. Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa bɩ jaŋ wuo faa dɩ ʋ sɩ́ ba na.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Wɩaa sɩ jʋʋmɛ, ŋ nɛ pɔ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ. Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ na baanɩŋ mɩ nyuŋ, ŋ naduo-la nɛ ŋ kaa laamɛ ta ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pɩmɛ. La Tɩɩna, ŋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ. Sɩ́ ŋ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa vɩa ta.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ bemmi nɛ woruŋ, a jɩŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ hɔnɔ nɛɛ, dɩ mɩ chɩna nɛɛ, ŋ jɩŋ mɩ wɩɩ wɩɩkala nɛ. Ŋ hɛ dɩ-bolii nɛ, aŋ jɩŋ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala.

english_verse: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩɩ mʋ lee nɛɛ, dɩ mɩ pɩna nɛɛ, ŋ jɩŋ mɩ wʋŋaalaa kala nɛ.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: Ka dɩ mɩ-na suri mɩ niiŋ a bʋl wɩɩ, ŋ-na La Tɩɩna jɩŋ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl nɛ.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: Ŋ hɛ mɩ sɛmɛ na-kala nɛ aa pɔmɛ arɩ ŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ chaasa jɩmmɛ ŋɩɩ woruŋ, ʋ kɩɩ mɩ jɩmɩŋ nɛ, ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa luŋie arɩ mɩ sɩ jaŋ jɩmba.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: Nɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ mʋ a kagɛ ŋ lɛ? Nɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ mʋ dɩ ŋ tuo?

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ, ŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ mʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ ma, ŋ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ paala kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a wuo file mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, koo a mʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩ-bolii ma,

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: ŋ naduo-la ha jaŋ pɔmɛ a kɛmmɛ woruŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ faa birimiŋ tʋɔŋ, dɩ pʋlʋŋ-la sɩ gollimi bɩrɩmɛ birimiŋ a tɔmɛ,”

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: ŋ-na teeŋ birimiŋ paala bɩ bire, tɩtaŋɩŋ ma yie pʋllɛ nɛ a nagɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ ŋ teeŋ. Birimiŋ arɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ ŋaa kʋbala nɛ ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ sɛmpɛɛ kala a jommi mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a hɛ mɩ naaŋ luoruŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ dɛnnɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ ŋaamɛ mɩ kɩɛgɛ nɛ a kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ. Kɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa zɔmɔ woruŋ. Mɩ jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ kala nɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩ-suomuŋ kala bɩ faa ŋ teeŋ! Ŋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ nandaasɩŋ sɩ kʋ pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa sɩ faa mɩ naaŋ luoruŋ tʋɔŋ aa waa mʋa mʋa.

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: Ŋ namɛ nɛ ka mɩ wʋwaa mʋa mʋa mɩ naaŋ luoruŋ tʋɔŋ. Ŋ jɩŋ mɩ tapʋlaa niiŋ nɛ a ŋmʋnsa hɛ ŋ teniŋ tʋɔŋ, ka tapʋlɩa-la kʋŋkala-na suomi.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa luŋie arɩ mɩ sɩ jaŋ jɩmba, mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo bɩɩna yi ŋɩɩ ba sɩ maga lɛ.

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Mɩ faa walɩmɛ dɩ mɩ dɩɩsɛ ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ, ama ba yʋga a kɩɩ hagɩlɩ-bumbugulo. Dɩ mɩ nɛ sie bʋa na-kala lɛ, mɩ yie na dɩ ŋ ha kpagɛmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩ fa cho dɩ ŋ kpʋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩkpʋʋraa kala nɛ, ka dɩ mɩ wiesi ba lɛ.

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Ba bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ, ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ chichei ŋ yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ bɛrɛ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ bɛrɩŋ nɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ lɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa ŋ niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa mɩ ma dʋndɔmɔ nɛ, mɩ chaasa bɛrɛba nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, beŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ woruŋ, a na wɩɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ. Magɩsɛmɛ a na wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Beŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ a na dɩ mɩɩ to wombii-bɔŋ, dɩ ŋ kɛmmɛ to ŋ wombii-la sɩ zɔmɔ a hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, laamɛ ta nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, aŋ pɔmɛ dɩ yuo-hɛɛrɛɛ sɩ́ mɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa.

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: Baa bɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ bʋa na-kala, a hɩhɛ yuosuŋ tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Ba niiŋ ka dii a nagɛ dɩmɩŋ nɛ, ba wʋbʋlaa ma kɛŋ huoŋ a nagɛ dɩ-kuuro.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, chu tɔmɛ a lɩɩsɛmɛ nɩbɔmɔ-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Laamɛ ta yuo-hɛɛrɛ-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ vʋʋra aa paa mɩ naasɩŋ.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ bɛrɛ bɛrɩsɩŋ nɛ, ba hɛ jomba nɛ dɩ ba kɛmmɛ. Ba bɛrɛ bɛrɩsɩŋ nɛ mɩ dɩ-vɛnɛɛ dɩ ba kɛmmɛ.

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ nɩduoŋ a laamɛ tɩta, ŋ nɩɩ pɔmɛ laalɩŋ tapʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ na wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ chɛ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ vʋʋrʋ chɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ dee ba jaŋ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ.

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ gollimi yuo diimi, leŋ dɩ ba niiŋ wʋbʋlaa gʋra dii ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nyiŋ-hal-muloo tuu ba lɛ a diiba, leŋ dɩ ba tuu buotuo-luŋuŋ, lee ba bɩra sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo lɩɩ.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩ jɩma ŋ chɩŋ summoo harɩŋ nɛ, a chɩna gbɛrɛ dɩ nɩaa joŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a to nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ wʋŋaalaa sɩ tʋʋla jaŋ hɛ ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, mɩɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ guu kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ yɩrɩŋ, jegile nɩɩ.

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nagɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋara sɩ sɩma, leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩsaa mɩ sɩ kaa je ŋ teeŋ aa chʋɔlʋŋ ma nagɛ ba sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩpɩŋ dɩdaanɩŋ.

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ mɩ niiŋ kɛnɩŋ, dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋl wɩɩkala.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛmɛ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, dɩ mɩ sɩ́ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ pɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋ kala. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, a dii ba gbiele kʋdiilee.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ ŋmoomi, aŋ kɛmmɛ tʋra kɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ zɔmɔ pɩmɛ. Ama mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ-na dagɛmɛ wɩɩkala. Mɩ sʋl Wɩa hɩhɛ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la lɛ nɛ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ joŋ nɩbɔmɔ-la sɩpaalaaraa yuo ta dɩ ba lɩɩ bʋŋ nyuŋ lee-la sɩ leŋie a kʋ tuu tel, ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa jaŋ laa dii arɩ mɩɩ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ bʋl, “A nagɛ ba sɩ yie pɛrɛ a kɛŋ tinteeŋ bugili ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba haŋgbelee pɩsa pɩŋ bʋa niiŋ.”

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, mɩɩ beŋ ŋ lɛ nɛ, ŋ nɛ mɩ yuori. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
translation_verse: Pɔmɛ a lɩɩsɛmɛ bɛrɛ ba sɩ hɛ bil mɩ lɛ, bɛrɛ-la nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ bɛrɛ.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba bɛrɩsɩ-la kɛsɛ ba tɩtɩa, ka dɩ mɩ kiele bal suoo.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nandaasɩŋ nɛ yʋɔra, ŋ nɛ yie jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ mɩ ŋaa. Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ bɛrɛ nɛ a bil mɩ wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ beŋ mɩ sɛsɩŋ, nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, mɩ bɩ dɩ-yuori kɛnɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ mɩ wɩaa chɩla.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ pɩpɩŋ nɛ a bʋl, “La Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ mɩ yuori, mɩ sɩ weye tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ, ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ mɩɩ chɛ.”

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Laamɛ ta dansarɩka deeŋ lɛ, dɩ mɩ wuo dɛnnɩŋ. Dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa nɛ na wʋzɔmɔ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa pɩmɛ, ba jaŋ kʋ chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, nɩɩ mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, jegile nɩɩ mɩ nii-ŋmobo a fá mɩ nisusuŋ, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ wɩaa, laa mɩ sʋla.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, sɩ́ mɩ sarɩya dii, bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋkala bɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna ŋaa ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kire ŋmoomi lo nɛ a yuo diimi. Ba jommi hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, mɩ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ sʋʋ faa faa.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Mɩ yɩɛlaa kala dɛrɛ nɛ, mɩ nandaasɩŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: Mɩ liise yi jɩsɩ-la sɩ bala lɛ nɛ, a kɛŋ wʋdaŋ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa chʋchɔgɩsɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ ŋ wʋŋaalaa bɩbɩɩnɛ.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kɛŋ mɩ nɩsaa je wɩa-nyuŋ aa sʋlʋŋ, mɩ dɩma ka hɩɛnɩŋ nɛ a nagɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ lɩɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ La Tɩɩna, laa mɩ sʋla lɩma, mɩ yɩɛlaa kala dɛrɛ nɛ. Sɩ́ harɩŋ joŋo yɩamɛ, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ ma jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ lɛlɩɩ.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Dagɛ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ a pɩmɛ chʋchʋɔ na-kala, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ laaŋ dii nɛ. Dagɛmɛ wombii-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ to, mɩ joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa kala pɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ La Tɩɩna, laamɛ ta mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ pɔmɛ.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ mɩ Wɩa, dagɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ cho, aŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ Dɩma-la sɩ zɔmɔ kɛmmɛ to wombii-la sɩ zɔmɔ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, a tɩŋ ŋ yɩrɩŋ wɩaa pɔ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ. Ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, lɩɩsɛmɛ wʋwalɩmaa lɛ.

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, chei nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛmɛ, ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa, kpʋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ bʋŋ, ʋ nɛ gʋnnɛmɛ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ mɩ Wɩa a chomi, ʋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ dɩ-duoŋ arɩ mɩ Laataara, ʋ nɛ chu tɔmɛ, ʋ nɛ mɩ yuori. Ʋ nɛ leŋe mɩ yuo dii tinteyee a kɛŋ doluŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, nuhuobiine tuo kʋŋkala, ka ŋ chɩl ʋ wɩaa. Nuhuobiine bie tuo kʋŋkala, ka ŋ bɩbɩɩnɛ ʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: La mɩɩsɩŋ nagɛ peliŋ nɛ, la tapʋlaa ma fɩfá a nagɛ daaliimiŋ.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, kɛŋ wɩa-nyuŋ bɛgɛ ta aŋ kʋ tuu, digi peelee dɩ ba kuu nyʋɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ taŋ lɩgɩsɛ a kɛŋ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ pɩsɛ, yuoba arɩ ŋ toŋ dɩ ba fá.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Kɛŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩɛna lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ tuu a lɛrɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ lɩɩ-luŋuŋ tʋɔŋ, laamɛ ta nɩwogusuŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa, a yie hɛ niiŋ aŋ vɩa dɩ ba tou.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩl-falɩŋ a dɛnnɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ du cheŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ hɛ a pɩŋ.

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: Ŋ doluŋ lɛ nɛ kuoroo yuo laalɩŋ dii, ŋ nɛ laa mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna Devit ta ba bɩ mɩ kpʋa.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Laamɛ ta nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, laamɛ ta nɩwogusu-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a yie hɛ niiŋ aŋ vɩa dɩ ba tou.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ la hambolibiisiŋ waa woruŋ, a nagɛ tɩɩsɩŋ sɩ waa, dɩ la toloo ma nagɛ kuoru dɩa jebiee ba sɩ kpɩɛra.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ la virisiŋ su arɩ kʋdii-doho kala. Dɩ la piesee ma pʋŋ a yi bʋɩ fiiba, a su la ŋmaŋkaanɩŋ.

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ la nɛsɩŋ lʋl biiriŋ yʋgɛ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba yuo dii la tasɩŋ kʋŋkala, koo dɩ ba yuo kɛŋ la nʋʋkala a kaa viiri. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la tʋɔ-cheeŋ leŋ dɩ la yelee baarɛ la wombiee lɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ na wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa ba Tɩɩna, ba jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa, ŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ kuoro, mɩ jaŋ ziliŋ. Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ bʋa na-kala a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ, a yɩrɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, ŋ yʋga nɛ a magɛ dɩ la faasa dɛnnɩŋ. Ŋ ballɩŋ kɩɩ nuhuobiine jɩmɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ bʋl ŋ tʋla arɩ ŋ ballɩŋ wɩaa, ka dɩ mɩ ma kɛŋ ŋ wʋduoru-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa chʋchɔgɩsɛ.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ bʋl ŋ doluŋ arɩ ŋ wʋmagɩla-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa, ka dɩ mɩ ma heele bʋl wʋbala-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ gbieli ŋ wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ yʋga gbiele, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a dagɛ ŋ tʋɔpʋla.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ka fá nɩaa nenige nɛ, a kɛŋ zile. Ʋ baanɩŋ bɩ lɩma lɩma ka sii, ʋ cho nɩaa bʋa na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna wɩaa zɔmɔ nɛ nʋʋkala teeŋ, ʋʋ fá kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa nisusuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, kɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ. Ŋ nɩaa kala jaŋ ziliŋ.

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ bʋl ŋ kuoruŋ sɩ yʋga wɩaa a pɩ nɩaa, aŋ bʋl ŋ doluŋ ma wɩaa.

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa jaŋ jɩŋ wʋduoru-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa, arɩ ŋ kuoruŋ tʋla sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: Ŋ kuoruŋ bɩ dɩdɛrɩ kɛnɛ, ŋ nɛ kuoro a kaa mʋ wuu. La Tɩɩna kɛŋ niiri-la kala ʋ sɩ hɛ a tɩtɩŋ nɛ, a cho kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋmoo naaŋ a tel, La Tɩɩna yie pɛ tɩɩna lɛ nɛ a kɛnʋ chʋʋlɛ.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala ka beŋ ŋ sɩaa lɛ nɛ, ŋ yie pɩba kʋdiilee nɛ, dɩ bʋa-la sɩ maga nɛ yie.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ weye nɩna ba kʋchɛɛlɛɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla nɛ a ŋɩŋaa ʋ wɩɩkala, a cho kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna kpagɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ yɩrʋ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ yɩrʋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie leŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ fáʋ na ba kʋchɛɛlɛɛ nɛ, ʋ yie nɩɩ ba nii-ŋmobo a laaba ta.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ka pɔ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ chou nɛ, ama ʋ jaŋ chei nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kala.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna bʋa-kala lɛ, a leŋ dɩ kɩalɩŋ ma kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa dɛnnɛ ʋ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all that I am, I will shout his praises.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Mɩ dɩma, dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ. Mɩ ha sɩ hɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ŋ yɩɛlaa joŋo hɛ kuoroo lɛ, nuhuobiiŋ kala bɩ jaŋ wuo laaŋ ta.

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ sʋba, ba yie bɩrɩmɛ hagɩla nɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ba ŋaa yie dɛrɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ lɛ Jekɔb Wɩa sɩ pɛ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa lɛ.

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ, tinteeŋ, mʋgʋ-balɩŋ arɩ kʋŋ na-kala sɩ hɛ ba lɛ. Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ bʋla lɛ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ yie bʋla laa nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nyaga bil, aŋ pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ ma losuŋ sɩ kɛnɛ kʋdiilee. La Tɩɩna nɛ yie laa dansarɩkaba ta.

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɩɩ suri nyʋlɩmaa sɩaa, aŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ tele aa chʋʋlɛ. La Tɩɩna cho tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ka beŋ nʋhʋɔraa nyuŋ nɛ, a chɩna gbɛrɛ biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa, aŋ chichei nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ kuoro a kaa mʋ wuu. Zaayɔŋ nɩaa, ma Wɩa nɛ kuoro a kaa mʋ wuu. Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ la yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɛ la Wɩa, la tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ la nɛ dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ wasa saa Jerusalɛm, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ mɩɩra kɔ ba jaŋ.

english_verse: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ sɩ cheye bɩra tɔrɛ nɛ, aŋ vɔɔ tɔ ba naawɩɩlaa ma.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe chɛnwʋlaa magɛ ŋɩɩ a hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, ʋ jɩŋ ba kʋŋkala yɩrɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ yʋga, a kɛŋ doluŋ ma, ʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ bɩ dɩdɛrɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ yie kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri ŋaa ba yʋgɛ, aŋ nʋɔsɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bil tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a lʋlɔllɛ La Tɩɩna, má du cheŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a pɩ la Wɩa.

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tɔ wɩa-nyuŋ. Ʋ nɛ leŋe duonuŋ nɩnɩɩ a ŋaa yaŋ nyʋ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ yie pɩ pʋsʋŋ ba kʋdiilee, a pɩ diibiisiŋ ma sɩ yelee chɛ kʋdiilee.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩpaa kala tuo janɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ lɛ, koo laalɩyuoroo sɩ dolie lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna cho nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fáʋ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ʋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna, ma Zaayɔŋ nɩaa, má kʋ dɛnnɛ ma Wɩa.

english_verse: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ ŋaa ma taŋ boi-baalaa kɛŋ doluŋ, aŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ma pɩ ma nɩaa sɩ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ.

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe ma tinteeŋ kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa, aŋ pɩma mɛmpɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ a yʋgɛ.

english_verse: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa a pɩ tinteeŋ, wɩalɩŋ guu ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe bʋrʋŋ tɔ tinteeŋ nɛ a pʋlla nagɛ kuŋkunuŋ, aŋ leŋ leriŋ bʋgɛ a nagɛ tʋɔrʋŋ ba sɩ mɩsa.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe duoŋ-tabɩaa kʋ tuu tʋtɔ tinteeŋ a nagɛ kpagɛ-nyɩlaa. Ʋ yie ŋaa leriŋ fɩɛlɛ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ?

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ bʋl wɩaa, duoŋ-tabɩaa yie yʋɔlɛ nɛ, peliŋ lu, fuonuŋ suomo pɩpɛllɛ.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa dagɛ Jekɔb nɛ, a joŋ ʋ wombiee ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto arɩ ʋ wʋdagaa a pɩ ʋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa pɩ tintee dɔŋ kala, ba bɩ ʋ wombie-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto jɩŋ. Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa kala, má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ balegi balegi, má dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaaraa kala, má dɛnnʋ, kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, má dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ chɛnɛ, má dɛnnʋ, chɛnwʋlaa kala sɩɩ chaanʋ, má dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii arɩ lɩɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, má dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ba kala dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Ʋ wʋbʋlaa nɛ leŋe ba kala hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe ba chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, ba bɩ jaŋ wuo vɩa ʋ niiŋ.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ kɩaa kala arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna,

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: duoŋ-lɩgɩsɩŋ arɩ duoŋ-tabɩaa, bʋrʋŋ arɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ, duoŋ-peliŋ sɩɩ to La Tɩɩna niiŋ,

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: peelee arɩ dundolluŋ kala, tɩɩsɩ-la sɩɩ nɛŋ arɩ kuolusuŋ kala,

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: bagɩlaa arɩ pʋsʋŋ, kɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ tuuri tinteeŋ arɩ zaaraa,

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: dʋnɩa kuoroo arɩ tinteyee kala, tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ sɩpaalaaraa,

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Kɩaa deemba kala, má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Ʋ dʋndʋŋa yɩrɩŋ nɛ maga dɩ ma yɩrɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩ kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ joŋ doluŋ a pɩ ʋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba wuo dɛnnʋ. Ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ sɩ kɛnɛ woruŋ. Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Má yɩɩ yɩɩl-falɩŋ a dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Má dɛnnʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa nɛ kʋ hilimi.

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, má jʋjʋɔsɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa ma lɛ. Zaayɔŋ nɩaa, má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ma Kuoro nyuŋ.

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Má du chenniŋ, a chɩgɩsɛ chɩnchɩgɩsɩŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a gʋa, a dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nɩaa nyuŋ nɛ. Ʋ leŋe nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri yuo didii nɛ.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɩaa, má jʋjʋɔsɛ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ zilma wɩaa, má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnʋ dɩ taŋ pʋl.

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ Wɩa dɛnnɩŋ hɛ ma niiŋ lɛ. Ka ma kori tokobiiŋ niiriŋ balɩa sɩɩ dii,

english_verse: Take revenge and punish the nations.
translation_verse: a joŋ ma baanɩŋ fɩɩsɛ tinteyee lɛ, a dɔgɩsɛ ba nɩaa.

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Má kɛsɛ ba kuoroo hɛ kuroo, aŋ kɛsɛ ba sɩpaalaaraa ma hɛ chɔrʋmɔɔ.

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Má dɔgɩsɛba arɩ Wɩa sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, dol-la Wɩa nɩaa sɩ kɛnɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Má dɛnnɛ Wɩa ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ. Má dɛnnʋ ʋ jaŋ lɛ, ʋ doluŋ leriŋ.

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Má dɛnnʋ, a tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ wɩaa. Má dɛnnʋ, ʋ sɩ yʋga kɩŋkɛŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Má ŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ a dɛnnʋ, a du cheŋ arɩ kɔnɛba ma a dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: Má du gugonnuŋ arɩ chenniŋ, a ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlaa hɛ a gʋa dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: Praise God with cymbals, with clashing cymbals.
translation_verse: Má du kalenlemba a dɛnnʋ, a du sinsensiŋ ma a dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ kʋŋ na-kala sɩɩ wiesu dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna. Má dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
translation_verse: Namagaba-la Iziral kuoro Solomoŋ sɩ maga, ʋ nyɩmma nɛ fa kuoro Devit.

english_verse: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
translation_verse: Namaga deemba jaŋ wuo dagɩŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a jɩŋ ŋ tɩtɩa kɛnɩŋ a pɛ jɩŋ wʋduoruŋ ma bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ wuo dagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ woruŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a pɛ bapʋɔsaa arɩ hatoloo lɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a bɩɩnɛ wɩaa woruŋ aŋ ŋɩŋaa.

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: Namaga deemba ha jaŋ wuo paala dagɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa, dɩ ba wʋjɩmɩŋ pʋŋa pɛ. Ba jaŋ dagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ dɩ ba ma wasa jɩma pɛ.

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ wuo jɩŋ namagaba bʋbʋɔŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ wʋjɩnnaa sɩɩ bʋl.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ to La Tɩɩna niiŋ a zizilu, wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ama nɩyaaraa bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ cho a bɩ sɛɩ dɩ ba dagɛba. Kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ tonuŋ

english_verse: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ nyɩmma sɩɩ dagɩŋ. Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ ŋ naaŋ niiŋ vɩa.

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, dɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nɩɩ nyɩsɩŋ, sɩ́ jegile nɩɩ.

english_verse: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
translation_verse: Ba nɛ sɩ, “Kʋ to la harɩŋ dɩ la mʋ faa a gbɛrɛ a kpʋ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye ta pɛɩ.

english_verse: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
translation_verse: Má leŋ la paaba liŋ kʋweyee, a nagɛ sʋʋŋ bʋa, dɩ ba ŋaa nɩa sɩ hɛ sʋʋnʋŋ bʋa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, la jaŋ paa nɩaa kʋyuŋŋoo yʋgɛ a su la dɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ pɛ la lɛ, ŋ ma jaŋ laa ŋ kpaalɩŋ.”

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, sɩ́ nɩdosunuŋ deemba harɩŋ to, sɩ́ wombie-la ba sɩ joŋo to.

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: Ba cho wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, a paala bɩ diene aŋ kpʋkpʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: Dɩ diibie nɩɩ beniŋ ka dɩ ŋ chɩchɛ ŋ bɛrɛ kɛnʋ, wʋpɛɩ nɛ ŋ ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Nɩdosunuŋ deemba faa a gbɛrɛ dɩ ba kpʋ ba tɩtɩa nɛ, ba tɩtɩa mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ ba jaŋ lɩɩsɛ.

english_verse: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩ dii doluŋ nɩaa lɛ a dʋa, dol-la ʋ sɩ die nɛ jaŋ kpʋʋ. Chagɩlɩna-la sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: Ʋ yie hɛ wombie-la sɩ kɛŋ goŋ lɛ aa kpɩa taŋ-la boi-baalaa lɛ aa bʋl,

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: “Nɩyaaraa, ɛɛ nɛ maa chɛ dɩ ma yaara diene magɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ maa chɛ dɩ ma sieri wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ a diene magɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ maa chɛ dɩ ma bɛrɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ a diene magɛ?

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ vɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma, a bɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ kpʋrɩsɛ ma dɩgɩlaa ma sɛyɛ,

english_verse: “So when you are struck by some terrible disaster,
translation_verse: dɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ nɛ jʋʋma, mɩ jaŋ mɔmma. Dɩ wʋbɔŋ nɛ puuma, mɩ jaŋ sieri ma lɛ.

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: Dɩ wʋbɔŋ nɛ puuma a nagɛ duoŋ-pel-duoŋ koo dɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ nɛ jʋʋma a nagɛ pel-vinvilimiŋ, koo dɩ hɛɛŋ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ nɛ jʋʋma,

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ yɩra chɩchɛmɛ dɩ mɩ pɛ ma lɛ, ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ. Ma jaŋ beŋ lee-kala a chɩchɛmɛ, ama ma bɩ jaŋ namɛ.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ma sɩ bɛrɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ wɩaa, a bɩ La Tɩɩna ka fá,

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: a bɩ mɩ dagɩŋ ka sɛɩ, arɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩɩ kpʋrɩsɛ ma dɩgɩlaa,

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ ma mɛlɛ-la wɩaa, dɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa mɩɩra nyʋa ma nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Sin and self-satisfaction bring destruction and death to stupid fools.
translation_verse: Yaarɩŋ nɛ yie kpʋ nɩyaaraa, chʋʋlʋŋ nɛ yie kpʋ nɩɩ-la sɩ vɩa dɩ ʋ gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋ na-kala sɩ jegilee nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ yie hɔŋ nɛ sɔm. Ʋ bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala sɩ jaŋ kʋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ ka fá.”

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, dɩ ŋ nɛ sɛɩ mɩ wɩaa, a joŋ mɩ wʋdagaa hɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ,

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: a jegilee nɩɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a suri ŋ tʋɔŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ,

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋ nɛ sɛnɛ yele chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa, a faasa yele chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ,

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋ nɛ bee chɩchɛ wɩaa deemba a nagɛ ŋ sɩɩ chɛ hɔpʋla ŋɩɩ, a gbille chɩchɛba a nagɛ dʋa sɩ faa,

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ La Tɩɩna ziliŋ bʋbʋɔŋ, aŋ pɛ gʋnnɛ wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa lɛ.

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɩɩ pa wʋjɩmɩŋ. Ʋ niiŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ yie to a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a pɛ jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wɩaa vɩvɛŋ woruŋ nɛ. Ʋ nɩɩ pɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ aa tou.

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ chu tɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a pɔ ʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiee.

english_verse: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ jegili mɩ teeŋ, ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba, arɩ wombii-la kala sɩ zɔmɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ wɩaa, dɩ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la leŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: Ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa jaŋ pɔŋ woruŋ, wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ pɔŋ.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ lɩɩsɩŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ, a lɩɩsɩŋ wʋnyɩɛraa ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa tʋɔpʋl wombiiŋ aŋ mɩɩra hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ,

english_verse: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
translation_verse: nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ka ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ a jʋjʋɔsɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: nɩalɩŋ wombiee sɩ bɩ tʋʋla, a bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ lɩɩsɩŋ halɩɩla nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a lɩɩsɩŋ hachɔrʋmʋŋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ nyɩsa kɛnɩŋ,

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: haal-la sɩ vɩa ʋ hatol bala, a yʋ nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ mʋ ʋ dɩa, ʋ naga ŋ sɩɩ mʋ lee sʋʋŋ sɩ hɛ nɛ, a bɩra nagɛ ŋ sɩɩ mʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩ mʋ ʋ teeŋ bɩ jaŋ mɩɩrɛ, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, to wombii-la nɩzɔŋŋɔɔ sɩɩ to, to tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wombiiŋ.

english_verse: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ jaŋ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋcheeli kɛnɛ ma jaŋ ka ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: Ama ba jaŋ keri nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ ta tinteeŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ jaŋ lɛl tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɩŋ yʋ, ama joŋ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa hɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ duomi, a leŋ dɩ ŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ chonuŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ bʋa na-kala lɛ, leŋ dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa ŋ banzɔlɔ, leŋ dɩ ba hɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa arɩ nuhuobiine kala jaŋ choŋ.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Laa La Tɩɩna dii arɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ kala, aŋ sɩ́ ŋ tɩtɩa tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛ to.

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ʋ nɛ laa ŋ sɩpaaŋ wɩɩkala ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ wombiiŋ tʋʋlɛ.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ŋ tɩtɩa joŋ arɩ ŋ ŋaa wʋjɩnnʋ, fá La Tɩɩna aŋ lɩɩsɛ ŋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa a kɛŋ doluŋ ma.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ ŋ dʋa a zil La Tɩɩna, joŋ ŋ baga kɩaa kʋbumbumba a pʋ.

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ virisiŋ jaŋ su a lɩɩ tɩta, dɩ ŋ sɩnɩŋ pupoyee ma su a jɩla tɩgɛ niiŋ lɛ a lɩɩ tɩta.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, sɩ́ La Tɩɩna sɩɩ dagɩŋ ŋɩɩ vɩa. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ chei dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛnɩŋ tʋraa kɩɩ,

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa, La Tɩɩna yie kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ cho tʋraa kɩɩ nɛ, arɩ biiriŋ nyɩmmaba sɩ yie choba a kɛmba tʋraa kɩɩ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ, nɩɩ-la ma sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: Ʋ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la kɛŋ nyʋʋrʋŋ a kɩɩ hɔpʋla, ʋ nɛ yuŋŋie a kɩɩ sɛlɩmɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ yuŋŋie kɩɩ jɩnalɩaba, kʋŋkala tuo ŋ sɩ jaŋ kaa magɩsʋ.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ mɩɩ-duduoŋ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ dʋa arɩ yɩrɩŋ ma.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ yie leŋ ŋ wɩɩkala fɩɛla pɩŋ nɛ, ŋ wɩaa vɩvɛŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laaʋ dii, ʋ yie nagɛ tɩa-la sɩɩ pɩ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ ba teeŋ a bɩra ŋaa kʋŋ sɩɩ pɩba tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ La Tɩɩna kaa bil dʋnɩa gentine, ʋ sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ to a ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: Ʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ leŋe fuonuŋ bubul, duonuŋ ma nɩnɩɩ.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, gurigi wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ bɩɩnɛ wɩaa woruŋ a ŋɩŋaa a kpɛrɛ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba fori.

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ mɩɩ-duduoŋ. Ba jaŋ zɔŋ a nagɛ jɩnalɩa.

english_verse: You will walk safely and never stumble;
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ wɩɩkala jaŋ vɩvɛŋ woruŋ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ gɛrɛ.

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ pɩna, fawʋllʋŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ pɩŋ doŋ, ŋ jaŋ pɩŋ fɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɔyɛ bɩ jaŋ joŋ arɩ wʋlɔrʋ jaŋ wuo guu jʋʋŋ, wʋbɔmɔ-la sɩɩ jʋʋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋŋ,

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa La Tɩɩna nɛ jaŋ pɔŋ. Wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ lɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ jʋʋ bɛrɛ́ kala lɛ.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa wʋzɔmʋŋ pa, sɩ́ ba vɔŋ dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩ-la doluŋ.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ bʋla pɩ ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna arɩ ʋ mʋ aŋ kɔ chie dɩ ŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ, ka ŋ jaŋ wuo pɛ ʋ lɛ lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ bɩɩna dɩ ŋ joŋ wʋbɔmʋŋ ŋaa ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna lɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ kpagɩŋ a laaŋ dii.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ cheeriŋ joŋo pɩ nʋʋ dɩ ŋ nɛ jɩma ʋ bɩ wɩɩ cheye, a bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ yaraa bibieri nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dii doluŋ lɛ, koo a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa,

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa La Tɩɩna bɛrɛ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ nɛ, ama nɩalɩŋ-na sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ ŋaa ʋ nandɔsʋ nɛ.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ŋmɩaŋ ka dii nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ dɩɩsɩŋ nɩaa nɛ, ama ʋ yie pɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa dɩɩsɩŋ nɩaa-na lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ mɔŋ La Tɩɩna lɛ, ʋ ma yie mʋmɔŋ ba lɛ nɛ. Ama nɩalɩŋ-na sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri, ʋ yie dagɛ ʋ zile a pɩba nɛ.

english_verse: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ laa yɩrɩŋ, ama nɩyaaraa-na jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ jaŋ dagɩŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ wuo leŋ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɛ ŋaa wʋzɔmɔ nɛ, sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ vɩa.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩ ŋaa bii-bie mɩ nyɩmma dɩa lɛ, a ŋaa mɩ naaŋ bie kala,

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: ʋ fa dagɛmɛ a bʋl, “Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɩŋ, jomba hɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a tutoba, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a jɩjɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔsʋŋ, a pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɩŋ yʋ, a sɩ́ ba vɩa ta.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ wʋjɩmɩŋ vɩa, ʋ jaŋ pɔŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ chou, ʋ jaŋ pɔŋ.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ kʋŋ nɛ a magɛ ŋ kɛnʋ. Joŋ kʋŋkala ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ a yɔɔ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ chou, ʋ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ je. Dɩ ŋ nɛ mɩlʋ kpɛrɛ, ʋ jaŋ ziliŋ.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ tɩɩfɩɩlaa ba sɩ kaa ŋaa kuoru nyunchuulo a kpɩɛrɛ a joŋo chu.”

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, dɩ ŋ nɛ jegile nɩɩ mɩ wʋdagaa a kɛmba tɩŋ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ duomi.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: Mɩ dagɩŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ wombiiŋ nɛ, a dagɩŋ wombii-la sɩ tʋʋla.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ vɛŋ, kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ gɛsɛ ŋ wombiiŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋ nɩɩ fá ma, ŋ bɩ jaŋ gɛrɛ kʋŋ.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɩŋ woruŋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba fori ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Kɛmba woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la, sɩ́ ba ŋaa, sɩ́ ba naabʋɔsʋŋ to.

english_verse: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, sɩ́ sɛnsʋ, lɩɩsɛ ŋ tɩtɩa ba lɛ.

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ-na bɩ doŋ ka pɩŋ, see dɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋ. Ba bɩ doŋ ka pɩŋ see dɩ ba ŋaa wɩɩ jʋʋ nʋʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Bɔnsʋŋ nagɛ kʋdiilee nɛ ba teeŋ, doluŋ diiniŋ ma nagɛ sɩnɩŋ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wombiiŋ nagɛ taŋ sɩ pʋlaa kɔ leriŋ pʋpʋllɛ nɛ, a pʋllɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ leriŋ sɩ chaasa pʋlla dɛrɛ.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ wombiiŋ-na nagɛ leriŋ sɩ chaasa biri nɛ, ba bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ kʋ-la kala sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba gɛrɛ tel.

english_verse: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, suri ŋ dɩgɩlaa a jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩalɩŋ lɛl ŋ teeŋ, jomba hɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ, ba jaŋ pʋ mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa, ba nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ wʋŋaalaa tʋʋlɛ.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ wɩɩkala sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋaa bʋl, a sɩ́ wɩaa nyɩɛ.

english_verse: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
translation_verse: Bibeŋ sɩpaaŋ tegi tegi, leŋ dɩ ŋ sɩaa tʋʋlɛ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ na-kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa, bɩɩnɛ woruŋ aŋ-na ŋaa, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ wɩɩkala jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ begile mʋ nadiiŋ koo nagʋa, lɩɩsɛ ŋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, suri ŋ dɩgɩlaa a jegile nɩɩ mɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ kɛŋ sɩɩ-polluŋ bʋl wɩaa,

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ŋ bɩɩnɛ wɩaa woruŋ a ŋɩŋaa, dɩ ŋ wʋbʋlaa kɛŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Hachɔrʋmʋŋ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa sɩma nagɛ tʋʋŋ nɛ, aŋ mʋllɛ a nagɛ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ nʋʋŋ tɩsɛ kʋa.

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ʋ hɛyɛ bagɛbagɛ a nagɛ batu luobiiŋ, aŋ didii nyamanyama a nagɛ sɩa sɩ kɛŋ niiriŋ balɩa.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ to ʋ harɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ, ʋ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ mʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Ʋ lɛl wombii-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ wombiee golibo nɛ, ama ʋ bɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, mɩ biiri, ma jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, má pʋpɔ ma sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla lɛ begilu.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛ ŋ tɩtɩa hachɔrʋmʋŋ lɛ, pʋpɔ ŋ paala sɩ́ ʋ dɩa boiŋ niiŋ mʋ.

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ muuri ŋ tɩtɩa, ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ŋ ha bɩ hɩɛsa,
