english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: dɩ nʋhʋɔraa kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ suolo a dʋa laa dɩ nɩwogo dɩa nɩaa mɩɩra dii ŋ dʋa.

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ pɩna huhuuni, ŋ yaraa nammɩa kala jaŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: and shout, “I hated advice and correction!
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ bʋl, “Mɩ fa bɛrɛ dagɩŋ, mɩ bɩ chagɩlɩŋ cho.

english_verse: I paid no attention to my teachers,
translation_verse: Mɩ fa bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ dagɛmɛ niiŋ to, mɩ bɩ jegile nɩɩ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ cheye dɛrɛ nɛ, hɩɩsɩŋ diimi nɛ nʋʋkala sɩpaaŋ.”

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: Mɛrɛ ŋ haala lɛ a nagɛ ŋ sɩɩ nyʋa ŋ tɩtɩa viliŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ fuoŋ nagɛ dɩ haal na-kala wuo kɔ ŋ teeŋ a ŋaa ŋ lɩɩŋ nyʋnyʋa.

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa ŋ haala dʋndʋŋa kʋŋ. Pʋpɔ dɩ ma dɩ haal dɔŋ sɩ́ bɔsɔ pɛ.

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ haala nyuŋ, haal-la ŋ sɩ jaa ŋ bapʋɔsʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: Ʋ zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ a nagɛ aamɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ. Leŋ dɩ ŋ haala chonuŋ vɔgʋŋ.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ leŋ haal dɔŋ chonuŋ vɔgʋŋ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ dɩ nʋʋ haal pɛ bɔsɔ?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ka na la naavɛnɛɛ kala nɛ, a bibeŋ la wʋŋaalaa.

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ wʋŋaalaa gʋra kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ. Ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ vɔbʋ.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ bɩ dagɩŋ ka nɩɩ wɩaa, ʋ tɩtɩa yaarɩŋ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ lɛl.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, dɩ ŋ nɛ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ŋ jaŋ laa nʋʋ wɩɩ chʋŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ ta niiŋ arɩ ŋ jaŋ pɛ nʋʋ lɛ,

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la a laa ŋ tɩtɩa, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ joŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ ŋ naambie nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ: Mʋ lɩma a kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa tuu tinteeŋ aŋ sʋl ŋ naambile dɩ ʋ joŋ wɩɩ-la ta.

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ doŋ pɩŋ wɩɩ-la wɩaa, guu ŋaa ŋɩɩ lɩma lɩma.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Laa ŋ tɩtɩa wɩɩ-la lɛ a nagɛ tɛhɩɩ sɩ foro nambagɩla nɩsɩŋ lɛ, koo diibie sɩ foro ʋ kpʋkpʋʋra nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: Yarɩwɩɩ tɩɩna, mʋ cheliwiisiŋ leriŋ a na ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ tɩŋ, aŋ gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: but they store up food during harvest season.
translation_verse: ama ba yie chɛ kʋdiilee bil nɛ tafaaŋ, a gbɛrɛ yibiiniŋ.

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ pɩŋ pɛɩ a diene magɛ? Bʋa bɛɛ lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ sii doŋ lɛ?

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Ŋ yie bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ pɩŋ mʋa, mɩ jaŋ dɩɛgɛ mʋa, mɩ jaŋ hɔnɔ wiesi mʋa.”

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Ba yie bɩbɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a nyɩsɛ nɩaa a hɩhɛ wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ jaŋ jʋʋba, a guu cheiba, ka ba bɩ wɩɩ wuo ŋaa.

english_verse: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
translation_verse: Wɩaa balɩdʋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ La Tɩɩna bɛrɛ, wɩaa balɩpɛ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ ʋ faasa bɛrɛ:

english_verse: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpʋ nɩaa sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye,

english_verse: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
translation_verse: nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bɩɩnɛ dɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ diene aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ,

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: wʋnyɩɛrɩ wʋpɛ-naara, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho dɩa nɩaa nyuŋ kaa yagɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ ba sɩ kpʋrɩsɛ baal-la sɩ kɛŋ haala aŋ chɩchɛ nɩaa haalaa dɩgɩlaa

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ vɛŋ, ba jaŋ laa ŋ sɩpaaŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ pɩŋ doŋ ma, ba jaŋ pɔŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ sii doŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩŋ.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ nagɛ chaanɩŋ nɛ, a nagɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ sɛyɛ baa dagɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ pɔŋ dɩ ŋ sɩ́ halɩɩlɩŋ nɩsɩŋ jʋʋ, ba jaŋ pɔŋ ba nii-sɩŋ wʋbʋlaa lɛ.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ʋ zɔmʋŋ beŋ a hɩɛnʋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa nyɩsa kɛnɩŋ.

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Halɩɩ-la yallɩŋ muuro a magɛ boroboro yallɩŋ nɛ, ama haala sɩ kɛŋ bala aŋ ŋɩŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ wuo kpuŋ.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Nʋʋ jaŋ wuo chaanɛ nyiniŋ daŋ ʋ naapuiŋ lɛ ka ʋ gɛnnɩŋ bɩ nyiniŋ ka dii?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ jaŋ wuo vɛŋ nyiŋ-halaa lɛ, ka ba bɩ ʋ naasɩŋ ka nyɩgɛɛ?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ saa ʋ nagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ haala pɩŋ lɛ. Ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa ŋɩɩ aŋ mʋ pɛɩ, dɩ ba bɩŋ dɔgʋsɔ.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Dɩ losuŋ nɛ kɛŋ gaara dɩ ʋ gaa kɩaa dii, ba bɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ ka chei.

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba nɛ kɛnʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ kʋ-la ʋ sɩ gaa naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ, dɩ ʋ dɩa kɩaa kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ yie kɛŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna haala pɩŋ bɩ wʋjɩmɩɩ kala kɛnɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ chei ŋ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ ŋmobu dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diiu. Hɩɩsɩ-la bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ paala joŋ kʋŋkala kpɩkpalʋ ma, ʋ bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ, kʋ-la cho ʋ magɛ ɛɛ kala ma.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, to mɩ niiŋ wɩaa, aŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ wʋdagaa hɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: Ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Leŋ dɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa nɛ ŋaa ŋ sɩɩfɩaŋ kʋa.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba nagɛ nenii-pɩrɩŋ dɩ ŋ joŋo hɛ ŋ neniiŋ. Ŋmʋnsɛba hɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ ŋaa ŋ dɩhaala, dɩ wɩaa sɩaa jɩmɩŋ ŋaa ŋ nandɔŋ-fɩɛmɩŋ.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ pɔŋ hachɔrʋmʋŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ wuo nyɩsa kɛnɩŋ.

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala, mɩ to mɩ tokoro nyilimi

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ʋ chemu, a laalɛ kɩaa a nagɛ hachɔrʋŋ a kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a ŋɩŋaa goŋ. Ʋ bɩ dɩa lɛ ka hɔŋ.

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie gɔllɔɔ vɛŋ wombiiŋ lɛ nɛ, arɩ yɔɔsʋŋ lɛ, aa chɩŋ loŋgorunuŋ lɛ a gbɩgbɛrɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ baal.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛnʋ a guoru, a bɩ hɩɩsɩŋ ka fá aŋ bʋl,

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: “Jɩnɩŋ mɩ kpʋ pʋna a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ a lɩɩsɛ niiri-la mɩ sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kʋ lɩɩ a bee chɩchɛŋ a kʋ naŋ ŋ-la.

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: Mɩ bil bɔsɔ nɛ a kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ ba sɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ jɛrɛ.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: Mɩ mɩsɛ mɩ bɔsɔ nɛ arɩ tʋlaalɩɩba ba sɩ kaa lɩɩ dɩ-bolii kaa kɔ: mɛɛ, alɔɩ arɩ sɩnamɔŋ.

english_verse: “Let's go there and make love all night.
translation_verse: Kɔ dɩ la mʋ nɩɩ sɩma ŋɩɩ dɩ taŋ pʋl. La guori dɔŋɔ a nɩɩ sɩma.

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Mɩ bala tuo dɩa lɛ, ʋ vɛŋ wombii duduoŋ nɛ.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: Ʋ chʋŋ moribiee su ʋ moribie-lʋaga nɛ a kaa lɩɩ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ lɛɛlɛ see chɛŋ-piliŋ.”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ nii-sɩma a bʋl wɩaa a ŋaa ʋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nii-sɩma ŋɩɩ a nyɩnyɩsʋ.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Ʋ guu to ʋ harɩŋ a nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ nɛ-bele mʋmʋ dɩ ba kpʋ, a nagɛ aamɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ naaŋ mʋ hɩhɛ bɛrɛ lɛ.

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ to-hɛmɩŋ kɛnʋ. Ʋ nagɛ diibie sɩ fá mʋ jʋjʋʋ bɛrɛ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ jɩŋ arɩ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ to nɩmɛ lɩɩ.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ biiriŋ, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, má to wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tʋɔŋ mʋ ha-doho deeŋ lɛ, má sɩ́ yeŋŋe a to ʋ wombiiŋ.

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ nɛ ʋ chei, nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ kpʋa bɩ nii kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩa ŋaa sʋʋŋ bʋa wombiiŋ nɛ a mʋmʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ.

english_verse: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out
translation_verse: Má jegili, wʋjɩmɩŋ nɩɩ ŋaa goŋ. Ʋ suri ʋ yikoro nɛ.

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: Ʋ chɩŋ dundolo nyuŋ nɛ, a chɩŋ wombii chɛŋŋɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: Ʋ chɩŋ taŋ-la boi-baalɩŋ lɛ nɛ, lee-la nʋʋkala sɩ to jʋjʋʋ taŋ-la, nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ hɛ a ŋɩŋaa goŋ a bʋl,

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: “Baalaa, ma nɛ mɩɩ yɩrɛ, nʋʋkala nɛ mɩɩ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋjɩma kɛnɛ, má gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ yaara, má gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.
translation_verse: Má jegile nɩɩ, mɩ kɛŋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl. Mɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ tʋʋla nɛ.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ mɩ bʋbʋl, mɩ bɛrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bʋlʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Mɩ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa kala kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ba kʋŋkala bɩ golibo.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa, ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋlaa pɩŋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Ba tʋʋla nɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Má joŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma aŋ leŋ hɔpʋla. Má cho wʋjɩmɩŋ a kɩɩ sɛlɩmɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ kɩɩ jɩnalɩa. Ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ kʋŋkala ŋ sɩ cho magɩsʋ.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa nɩɩ jʋʋ. Mɩ jɩŋ wɩaa a bɩɩnɛ wɩaa woruŋ a ŋɩŋaa.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, ŋɩɩ-na ŋ jaŋ bɛrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ. Mɩ bɛrɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ dagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ, sɩɩ-duoŋ tɩɩna, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaara arɩ wʋnyɩɛra.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ nɩaa chagɩlɩŋ, a jɩŋ wɩaa jense bʋlʋŋ ma, mɩ jɩŋ wɩaa a kɛŋ doluŋ ma.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Mɩ cho nɩalɩŋ sɩ chomi nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bee chɩchɛmɛ yie namɛ nɛ.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ jaŋ na mɩ teeŋ kɩɩ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ, ʋ nɛ kɩɩ hɔpʋla.

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: a joŋ dʋa pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ chomi, aŋ leŋ ba chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩŋ ma susu.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: Mɩ-na wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ La Tɩɩna laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa, aŋ-na ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa faafaa kala.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Faafaa nɛ ʋ ŋaamɛ. Dɩ-suomuŋ nɛ ʋ ŋaamɛ aŋ-na ŋaa dʋnɩa.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ ŋaamɛ, mʋgʋ-bal kala tuo, lɩɩ-bulo ma kala fa tuo.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ ka ʋ-na ŋaa peelee, a hɛ nɩmɛ ka ʋ ŋaa dundolluŋ ma.

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ ka ʋ-na ŋaa dʋnɩa, mɩ hɛ nɩmɛ ka ʋ ŋaa tinteeŋ arɩ hagɩla.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ ka ʋ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ, a hɛ nɩmɛ ka ʋ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ keese tɔ fuonuŋ.

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ ka ʋ ŋaa duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa ba hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, a ŋaa lɩɩ-bul-sɩaa ma dɩ ba bulo hɩhɛ mʋgʋ-balaa lɛ.

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ ka ʋ keri leriŋ pɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ, dɩ lɩɩ-la sɩ́ wuo kieli lee-la ʋ sɩ kere pʋ. Mɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ ka ʋ bil tinteeŋ gentine.

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ mɩ hɛ La Tɩɩna sɛmɛ a nagɛ gɔgʋ-hɩaŋ. Tapʋlɩɩ kala mɩ tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ nɛ, mɩ jʋjʋɔsɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɛ dʋnɩa kala nyuŋ nɛ, a tɔrɛ nuhuobiinee ma nyuŋ.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, mɩ biiri, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to mɩ niiŋ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Má jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, má sɩ́ ba vɩa ta.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, a kɔ mɩ dɩa boiŋ niiŋ a bee chɩchɛmɛ, a gbɛrɛmɛ nɩmɛ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ namɛ, ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, La Tɩɩna tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩa dɩ ʋ chɛmɛ, ʋ dɔgɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛrɩmɛ cho sʋʋŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ saa ʋ dɩa nɛ a hɛ jebii duduosuŋ balɩpɛ.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: Ʋ kpʋ pʋna a ŋaa kʋdiilee, a ŋaa ʋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ ma siri a bile gbɛrɛ nʋhʋɔraa.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: Ʋ hɔŋ jaŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, lee-la nɩaa sɩ jaŋ naʋ aŋ heele yɩrɛ nɩaa, aŋ tɩŋ ʋ dɩa tɩntɩnnaa ma, a bʋl,

english_verse: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
translation_verse: “Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ woruŋ, má kɔ.” Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ chʋʋla, ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: “Má kʋ dii mɩ kʋdiile-la aŋ nyʋa mɩ sɩŋ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa bil.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Má leŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ wombiiŋ aŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, má to wombii-la sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa.

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ babii-ballɩŋ lɛ kpɩa. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ bɛrɩŋ. Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ chagɩlɛ nʋʋ sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ choŋ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ bʋl wɩɩkala a pɩ nʋʋ sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa, ŋɩɩ yie leŋ ʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ wasa pʋŋa pɛ nɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ dagɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wɩɩ, ʋ yie gʋnnɛ wɩɩ-la nɛ a pɛ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ jɩma lɛ.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ jɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ŋɩɩ-na, ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na wʋjɩmɩŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ tomi, ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ duomi, dɩ ŋ jɩsɩŋ pʋŋa pɛ.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ, ama dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa babiibal, ŋ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ.”

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie hɔŋ ʋ dɩa boiŋ niiŋ, koo ʋ hɔŋ jaŋ tʋɔŋ, lee-la nɩaa sɩ jaŋ naʋ,

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ woruŋ, má kɔ.” Ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ,

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: “Dɩ ŋ nɛ gaa nyʋa lɩɩŋ, ʋ sɩma, dɩ ŋ nɛ lʋara dii kʋdiilee ma, ba sɩma nɛ woruŋ.”

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ mʋ haal-la teeŋ bɩ jɩŋ arɩ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ mʋ ʋ teeŋ ŋaa nɩsʋʋ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ mʋ nɩmɛ kala hɛ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Namagaba-la Solomoŋ sɩ maga: Bii wʋjɩnna yie leŋ ʋ nyɩmma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ, ama bii yaara-na yie leŋ ʋ naaŋ tʋɔŋ chei nɛ.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ to bɔŋ bɔŋ a dʋa, kɩalɩŋ bɩ yuŋ kala kɛnɛ. Ama tʋɔpʋla jaŋ lɩɩsɩŋ sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɩ leŋe tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna chʋchʋa losuŋ, ama ʋ bɩ leŋe nɩbɔmʋŋ nɩna kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ hɩɛnʋ.

english_verse: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
translation_verse: Yarɩwɩɩŋ nɛ kɛŋ nyaaŋ kʋkɔ, ama dɩ ŋ yaraa lɩɩŋ nɛ hɛyɛ, ŋ jaŋ dʋa.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ liliisi tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wɩaa, ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ-na yɩrɩŋ jaŋ lɛl.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna yie sɛɩ dagɩŋ nɛ, ama nɩyaara sɩ cho wɩaa bʋlʋŋ yie tel nɛ.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ walɩmɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ tɩɩna, ama nɩɩ-la wʋŋaalaa sɩ golibo bʋbʋɔŋ jaŋ lɩɩ.

english_verse: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ka bʋl nɩɩ hɛ wɩaa, nɩyaarɩ nii-to tɩɩna nɛ yie chei ʋ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wʋbʋlaa nagɛ lɩɩ-bulo sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ-na yie kɛŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba ŋaa nɩaa lɛ a faa nɛ, ba bɩ baa bʋl.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Dɩ wʋjɩnna nɛ bʋl wɩaa, ŋ yie jɩŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ, ama nɩyaara-na maga dɩ ʋ laa daaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnnaa yie tʋɔlɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ, ama nɩyaara-na niiŋ wʋbʋlaa nɛ yie ŋaa ʋ tel.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Kɩaa tɩɩna teeŋ, dʋa nagɛ taŋ ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli nɛ, ama nyaaŋ nɩɩ kpʋ summoo.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa time yie leŋ ba kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ-na time nɛ dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛba.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ sɛɩ dagɩŋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ama nɩɩ-la na-kala sɩ vɩa dɩ ʋ leŋ ba kɛnʋ tʋra kɩɩ wombiiŋ lɛ, jaŋ yeŋŋi.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩ bɛrɛ nɩaa aŋ kaa fɩfaa ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ. Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ gɔllɔɔ bɛ zɛmbɛ ŋaa nɩyaarɩ nɛ.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Wʋbʋl kɩŋkɛŋ tɩɩna yie bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ bʋl nɛ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ ʋ niiŋ kɛnɩŋ ŋaa wʋjɩnnʋ nɛ.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wʋbʋlaa nagɛ hɔpʋla nɛ, ama nɩbɔmʋŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa-na bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wʋbʋlaa yie pɛ nɩ-daŋ lɛ nɛ, ama nɩyaara yaarɩŋ nɩɩ kpʋʋ.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Dɩ La Tɩɩna nɛ pɛ nʋʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ dʋa, ʋ bɩ hɛɛŋ joŋo daŋ dʋa-la lɛ.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la nɩbɔmʋŋ sɩ chaasa fɩfá nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ, ama tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-na jaŋ na wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Dɩ duoŋ pel-duoŋ nɛ duu bal, ʋ jaŋ joŋ nɩbɔmʋŋ viiri, ama tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-na jaŋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ tɩŋ yarɩwɩɩ tɩɩna, ʋ hɛyɛ a nagɛ batu-luobiiŋ sɩ hɛyɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ, koo nyʋɔsʋŋ sɩ yie jʋʋ ŋ sɩaa ʋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, ʋ yie joŋ jɩsɩŋ pɛ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ duomi, ama nɩbɔmʋŋ-na mɩɩsɩŋ yie keri nɛ kui.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna yɩɛlaa dɩdɛrɩŋ kala yie ŋaa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ, ama nɩbɔmʋŋ-na yɩɛlaa kala yie ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna yie chu tɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ʋ wombiiŋ nɛ, aŋ chichei nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo yigi tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna lo, ama nɩbɔmʋŋ-na bɩ jaŋ dieni tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna yie bʋl wɩaa arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ, ama ba jaŋ tɔ wʋnyɩɛra-na niiŋ.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna niiŋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ bʋl nɛ, ama nɩbɔmʋŋ-na yie bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ maga nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ gɩrɩmɛ nɩaa kɩaa yallɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ama ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yallɛ kɩaa arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa muuri, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɩɩ pɔba. Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ, ba wʋgolibie-la nɛ yie gʋra cheiba.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Dʋa ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ, ama tʋɔpʋla-na jaŋ laaŋ ta sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna sɩ bɩ wʋcheeli kɛnɛ wʋŋaalaa nɛ yie leŋ ʋ wombiiŋ tʋʋlɛ, ama nɩbɔmʋŋ-na wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ yie cheyu.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ yie laaʋ ta, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩ cho jaŋ gʋra kɛnʋ.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Wɩa yie laa tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa ta nɛ dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋba, aŋ leŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩɩra mʋ jʋʋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ wʋbʋlaa nɩɩ chei ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ama tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ yie laaʋ ta.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ a pɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa taŋ lɛ, jaŋ-la yɩrɩŋ yie sii nɛ, ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ wʋbʋlaa nɩɩ chei jaŋ.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wʋjɩmɩɩ kala kɛnɛ nɛ yie bee gʋʋnɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa-na yie kɛŋ ʋ niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Zɛmbɛ tɩɩna joŋ nɩaa yɩyallɛ nɛ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-na bɩ nɩaa joŋo yɩyallɛ.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Dɩ tinteeŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a bɩ sɩpaalaara kɛnɛ, taŋ-la jaŋ tel, ama dɩ taŋ nɛ kɛŋ sɩpaalaaraa yʋgɛ sɩɩ chagɩlɛba, ba taŋ jaŋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Nɩaa ka zil haal-la sɩɩ fá nɩaa nisusuŋ nɛ, ama baala-la sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔhɛɛŋ, dʋa dʋndʋŋa nɛ ba jaŋ kɛŋ.

english_verse: Meanness gets you nowhere, but goodness is rewarded.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ time bɩ kʋtɩtɩɩ ŋaa, ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa nɛ jaŋ laa kʋtɩtɩɩba.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ chɩŋ tʋɔpʋl wɩaa naaŋ lɛ, tɩɩna jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ to wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna chaasa bɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ wʋŋaalaa sɩ golibo nɛ, ama ʋ tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ nɩalɩŋ wɩaa sɩ tʋʋla lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Chaasa jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ: Nɩbɔmʋŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ mʋ pɛɩ dɩ Wɩa bɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɔ. Ama tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-na jaŋ fori dɔgʋsʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Tooŋ ba sɩ joŋ sɛlɩmɛ nenii-pɩrɩŋ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ nagɛ hazɔmʋŋ sɩ yaara nɛ.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ chɛ dɩdɛrɩŋ kala yie ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ, ama nɩbɔmʋŋ-na yɩɛlaa dɩdɛrɩŋ kala Wɩa yie dɔgɩsɛba nɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Nɩa dɔŋɔ yie joŋ kɩaa pɩpa pɛɩ pɛɩ, aŋ ka ʋ nɩsɩŋ ha jʋjʋʋ woruŋ, dɔŋɔ ma hɛ nɩmɛ ʋ kʋŋ bɩ lɩɩ, aŋ ha nyaabɛ.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ bɩ ŋ dʋndʋŋa ka dii, wɩaa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa lɩɩŋ pɩ nɩaa dɩ ba nyʋa, nɩaa ma jaŋ ŋaa lɩɩŋ pɩŋ dɩ ŋ ma nyʋa.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yie ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ yie bɩ ʋ mɩaa ka yallɛ lɛ nɛ, ama ba yie bʋl wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a pɩpɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ yallɛ ʋ kɩaa.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chɛ woruŋ jaŋ na woruŋ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chɛ bɔŋ bɔŋ yie na bɔŋ bɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa hɛ ʋ dʋa lɛ, ʋ jaŋ tel, ama tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wɩaa jaŋ vɩvɛŋ woruŋ a nagɛ tɩa sɩɩ waa ʋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ lɛrɛ wɩaa kʋʋ hɛ ʋ dɩa nɩaa lɛ, ʋ chie bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ kpaal kala ba dʋa lɛ. Nɩyaara jaŋ ŋaa wʋjɩnna tɩntɩnna.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nagɛ tɩa-la sɩɩ pɩ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ tɩta ŋaa wʋjɩnnʋ nɛ.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ laa ba time dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ-na wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ ma jaŋ laa ba time.

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna yie cho nɩɩ-la kala wɩaa sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ, ama ʋ yie chei nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ kala bɩ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ, ama ŋ bɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-na wuo yigee lo.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Dɩ haala mɛlɛ nɛ zɔmɔ, ʋ yie nagɛ kuoru nyunchuulo nɛ ʋ bala chu. Ama haal-la sɩ hɛ ʋ bala hɩɩsɩŋ yie nagɛ nyanyalɩɩ-bɔŋ nɛ ʋ bala lɛ.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa sɩ bɩɩnɛ dɩ ba ŋaa, ŋaa wʋzɔmɔ nɛ. Ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ wʋdagaa kala ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ wʋbʋlaa nagɛ bɛrɛ nɛ, ama tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wʋbʋlaa-na yie laaba ta nɛ.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ yuo dii nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ, ba yie lɛl nɛ, ama tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa-na dɩa yie chɩŋ nɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, nɩaa jaŋ bɛsɛ ʋ lɛ. Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ yaara, nɩaa sɩaa bɩ ʋ ka su.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ nʋʋ ŋaa aŋ kɛŋ tɩntɩnna nɛ kpɩa ŋ sɩ fugo ŋaa nʋʋ aŋ kɛŋ losuŋ.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa yie bibeŋ ba pʋsʋŋ nyuŋ woruŋ nɛ, ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ-na woruŋ ŋaanɩŋ ŋaa tʋɔhɛɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ faasa tɩŋ ʋ baga lɛ yie na kʋdiilee yʋgɛ nɛ, ama nɩyaara nɛ yie kɛŋ ʋ doluŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋpɛɩba.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ wɩɩŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ laa kɩaa ʋ nɩbɔŋ dɔŋɔ teeŋ, ama tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wɩaa yie wasɛ nɛ.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ wʋbɔŋ wʋbʋlʋŋ nɛ kɛnʋ, ama tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-na yie fá lɩɩ wʋjʋʋlaa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: Ŋ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ to na wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ dɩ ŋ nɛ tɩma, ŋ jaŋ laa time.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ bɩɩna wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa, ba ŋaa ba bʋa lɛ nɛ, ama wʋjɩnna na yie jegile nɩɩ chagɩlɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ wʋpɛ-naara yie bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ, ama wʋnyɩɛrɛ wʋpɛ-naara-na yie nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ bɩ dɩdɛrɩ kɛnɛ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa-na bɩ jaŋ dieni aŋ lɛl.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔmʋŋ bɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna ka jʋʋ, ama ba yie jʋʋ nɩbɔmʋŋ-na nɛ a mʋ kieli.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɛrɛ wʋnyɩɛraa nɛ woruŋ, ama ʋ cho nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna bɩ ʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ ŋɩɩ ka dagɛ, ama nɩyaarɩŋ-na yie bʋl wɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ a leŋ nʋʋkala jɩŋ arɩ ʋ yaara nɛ.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la yaraa lɩɩŋ sɩ hɛyɛ nɛ jaŋ laa nɩaa sɩpaaŋ, ama yarɩ-wɩɩ tɩɩna jaŋ tɩŋ yoŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Tʋɔbɩɩnaa kɩŋkɛŋ yie nyagɛ ʋ tɩɩna bil nɛ. Ama wʋbʋl sɩŋŋaa nɩɩ nyagɛ nɩa bɔyɛ.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna yie fɩɛlɛ ʋ sɩaa nɛ a dii nandɔŋɔ koo tanlɔŋɔ. Ama nɩbɔmʋŋ-na yie yeŋŋi nɛ.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Yarɩ-wɩɩ tɩɩna bɩ ʋ wʋchɛɛlɩŋ ka na, ama dɩ ŋ yaraa lɩɩŋ nɛ hɛyɛ, ŋ jaŋ dʋa.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Mɩɩsɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ hɛ tʋɔpʋla wombiiŋ lɛ, sʋʋŋ tuo nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Bii wʋjɩnna yie jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ nyɩmma sɩɩ dagʋ nɛ, ama babii-balɩŋ-na bɩ sɛɩ dɩ ba kɛnʋ kɩɩ wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Nɩzɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ laa wʋzɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ bʋl time. Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ-na ka chɛ yuosuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ ʋ niiŋ kɛnɩŋ nɛ jɩŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kɛnɩŋ. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa foi foi yie chei ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Yarɩwɩɩ tɩɩna yie chɩchɛ kɩaa aŋ bɩ na, ama nɩɩ-la yaraa lɩɩŋ sɩ hɛyɛ yie na kʋ-la kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna bɛrɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, ama nɩbɔmʋŋ-na yie hɩɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wʋtɩtɩɩ nɩɩ pɔʋ, ama bɔnsʋŋ yie yigi wʋbɔŋ ŋaara lo nɛ.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Nɩa dɔŋɔ yie ŋɩŋaa wɩaa arɩ ʋ kɛŋ kɩaa nɛ aŋ bɩ kʋŋ kɛnɛ, dɔŋɔ ma nagɛ arɩ ʋ bɩ kʋŋ kɛnɛ aŋ kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Kɩaa tɩɩna yie kɛŋ ʋ dʋa nɛ a time laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ama nʋʋkala bɩ summo-na wuo fugisi.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nagɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ nɛ a chɩchaanɛ woruŋ, ama nɩbɔmʋŋ-na nagɛ chaanɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ dɩsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa kɛŋ yuosuŋ nɛ kʋkɔ, ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɛyɛ dɩ ba dagɛba yie kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ to aŋ na moribiee, ba bɩ dieni. Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ fɩɛlɛ ŋ sɩaa a chɩchɛ mʋa mʋa, ba jaŋ pʋŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa wɩɩ lɛ aŋ bɩ wɩɩ-la na, ʋ yie nagɛ ŋŋ wɩɩlɛ nɛ. Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ na wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ, ŋ tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ sɛɩ dɩ ba dagʋ, jaŋ chei ʋ tɩtɩa. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ sɛyɛ ba chagɩlʋ jaŋ laa ʋ time.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ wʋjɩnna sɩɩ dagʋ nagɛ lɩɩ-bulo sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, a pɔ dɩ nɩaa sɩ́ sʋʋŋ bɛrɛ jʋʋ.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa, ŋɩɩ yie leŋ ŋ yɩrɩŋ sii nɛ. Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ ka chei ba tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna-na yie kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa, ama nɩyaara-na yie joŋ ʋ yaarɩŋ jɛrɛ nɛ nɩaa na.

english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ nɩɩ jʋʋ wɩaa, ama tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ yie kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa nɛ kʋ pɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ sɛyɛ dɩ ba kɛnʋ tʋrɛ yie nyaabɛ nɛ a dii hɩɩsɩŋ, ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ sɛyɛ ba kɛnʋ bil wombiiŋ lɛ, nɩaa yie zizilu nɛ.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ na wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ, ʋ dɩma yie pɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ. Ka nɩyaarɩŋ-na kɩkɩsɛ dɩ ʋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ dɩ wʋjɩnna nɩɩ to dɔŋɔ, ŋ ma jaŋ jɩŋ wɩaa, ama dɩ ŋ dɩ nɩyaara nɩɩ to dɔŋɔ, ŋ jaŋ jʋʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Nyu-bɔmʋŋ kiree to wʋbɔŋ ŋaara harɩŋ nɛ, ama wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-na time.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Nɩzɔmʋŋ yie dii kɩaa aŋ ka bil ʋ nihee lɛ nɛ, ama dʋa-la nɩbɔmʋŋ sɩ sʋba aŋ ka bil jaŋ mɩɩra ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna kɩaa.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Nyaaba baga kɩaa jaŋ wuo wasɛ woruŋ, ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ yie ŋaa ba lɛl nɛ.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ ʋ bie ka tʋrɛ, ʋ bɩ ʋ cho, ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho ʋ bie, jaŋ fɩɛlɛ ʋ sɩaa a kɛnʋ tʋra kɩɩ.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa yie dii kɩaa vɔgɛ nɛ, ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ-na yie chʋa losuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Ha-wʋjɩnna yie saa ʋ dɩa nɛ woruŋ, ama haal-la sɩ yaara nɛ yigi ʋ dɩa lo.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ wʋŋaalaa sɩ tʋʋla nɩɩ fá Wɩa, ama nɩalɩŋ wʋŋaalaa sɩ golibo sɩɩŋ bɩ Wɩa ka su.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ wʋbʋlaa nɛ yie leŋ ʋ laa daaŋ, ama wʋjɩnna-na wʋbʋlaa nɛ yie pʋpɔʋ.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɛ-pɛrɛɛ nɛ tuo, virisiŋ jaŋ wuoli, ama dɩ ba nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, virisiŋ yie su nɛ arɩ kʋdiilee.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Babii-balɩŋ yie chɩchɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ, aŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo na, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa, jaŋ naʋ mɔlɩɩ.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ŋ tɩtɩa kaa mʋ mɛrɛ nɩyaara lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ bɩ jaŋ nɩɩ wʋjɩŋ wɩɩ ʋ niiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ yie bɩɩnɛ wɩaa nɛ aŋ ŋɩŋaa, ama nɩyaarɩŋ-na yie nyɩnyɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩyaarɩŋ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ, ʋ sɩpaa tuo dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩkala, ama nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ dɩ Wɩa arɩ nɩaa pɛgɛ yie zɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ cheye, ʋ yie ŋaa ŋ dʋndʋŋa wɩɩ nɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ tɔrɔ ma, ŋ dɩ nʋʋ bɩ kaa kpaa.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ chei nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ dɩɩsɩŋ, ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ dɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ wasa chɩŋ.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo bɩɩnɛ arɩ ŋ ŋaa wɩɩ ʋ bʋa lɛ nɛ, ama ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ lɛ ŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Ŋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ wuo chei ka dɩ ŋ ha mʋmɔŋ, ama dɩ ŋ nɛ mɔmɔ dɛrɛ tʋɔ-chei-la ha jaŋ bɩra kɔ.

english_verse: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ jaŋ laa ʋ wʋŋaalaa time kala, dɩ nɩzɔmʋŋ ma laa ʋ wʋŋaalaa time.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ woruŋ-na yie laa wɩɩkala ba sɩ nɩa dii nɛ, ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ-na yie bɩɩnɛ woruŋ nɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ yeŋŋu.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnnaa yie fɩɛlɛ ba sɩaa nɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ wʋbɔmʋŋ ŋaa, ama nɩyaaraa-na bɩ chɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa, ba yie ta jɩa nɛ.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ baanɩŋ sɩɩ sii lɩma lɩma yie ŋɩŋaa nɩyaarɩ wɩaa nɛ. Ama nɩaa bɛrɛ wʋjɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kpirimi tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa sɩpaaŋ, ba jaŋ kpirimi ba boi-baalaa niiŋ.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jʋʋ kpɩkpagɛ summo ma paala bɩ ʋ cho, ama kɩaa tɩɩna nandɔnsʋŋ yʋga.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bee gʋʋnɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, ama Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa zile nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ lɛ.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bɩɩnɛ dɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yie yeŋŋi nɛ. Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bɩɩnɛ dɩ ba ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, nɩaa yie choba nɛ a laaba dii.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ tɩma a suoli, ŋ jaŋ na ʋ nyʋʋrʋŋ, ama dɩ ŋ kɛŋ niiŋ dʋndʋŋa bʋbʋl, ŋ jaŋ summi.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnnaa dʋa nagɛ kuoru nyunchuulo nɛ ba teeŋ, ama nɩyaaraa-na yaarɩsɩŋ nɛ ŋaa ba kʋa.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, ʋ nagɛ jebii-duo nɛ a gollu, ʋ biiriŋ ma jaŋ na leriŋ a yuori.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, ʋ nagɛ lɩɩ-bulo sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, a pɔ dɩ nɩaa sɩ́ sʋʋŋ bɛrɛ jʋʋ.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Dɩ kuoro nɛ kɛŋ nɩaa yʋgɛ, ʋ kuoruŋ jaŋ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ, ama dɩ nɩaa nɛ tuo, ʋ kuoruŋ jaŋ tel.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ pɩŋ dɩ-bala, ŋ yaraa kala jaŋ fɩɛlɛ, ama dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa nyanyalɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛ summoo, Wɩa sɩ ŋaaba nɛ ŋ tʋtʋʋsɛ ŋɩɩ, ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa zile pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ, ʋʋ zil Wɩa nɛ.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la nɛ yie yigu lo, ama tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-na yie na leriŋ nɛ a yuori, a tɩŋ tʋɔpʋl wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ hɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ tɩa wɩaa sɩaa tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛ nɛ, ama nɩyaarɩŋ-na bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋla yie leŋ tinteeŋ nɩaa yɩrɩŋ sii nɛ, ama wʋbɔmʋŋ-na ka hɛ nɩaa hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Kuoro tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa nyuŋ nɛ, ama ʋ baanɩŋ yie sii tɩntɩnnʋ-la sɩɩ hɛʋ hɩɩsɩŋ nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩaa hɛ lee-kala nɛ, a bibeŋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩzɔŋŋɔɔ kala.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ nɛ yie bɩ sɛɩ dɩ ʋ nyɩmma kɛnʋ tʋra kɩɩ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ sɛyɛ ba kɛnʋ bil wombiiŋ lɛ ŋaa wʋjɩnnʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna yie kɛŋ dʋa yʋgɛ nɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ, ama wɩaa yie jʋʋ nɩbɔmʋŋ arɩ ʋ dʋa kala nɛ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna wʋbʋlʋŋ nɛ yie leŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ pʋrɩgɛ leriŋ, ama nɩyaarɩŋ-na tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩ ŋɩɩ naga.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɛrɛ nɩbɔmʋŋ sɩ kpʋ pʋna a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ, ama ʋ tʋɔŋ ka tɔrɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-na Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɛrɛ nɩbɔmʋŋ wʋŋaalaa nɛ woruŋ. Ama ʋ cho nɩɩ-la sɩɩ to tʋɔpʋla wombiiŋ.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ vɩa dɩ ʋ to wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiiŋ, ba jaŋ lɛrɛ ʋ dɩgɩlɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ. Nɩɩ-la ma sɩ bɩ sɛyɛ ba kɛnʋ bil wombiiŋ lɛ jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna na wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ lɛ nɛ, ama ʋ paala na nuhuobiine tʋɔŋ a kɩkɩɩ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ.

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: Babii-balɩŋ bɩ sɛɩ dɩ ba kɛnʋ tʋrɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ pɩɛsɛ wʋjɩnna dɩ ʋ dagʋ.

english_verse: Happiness makes you smile; sorrow can crush you.
translation_verse: Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ yie leŋ nʋʋ mɔŋ, ama tʋɔ-cheeŋ-na yie leŋ ʋ nyal sɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ nɩɩ wɩaa sɩaa chɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ, ama nɩyaarɩ wɩaa nɩɩ vɔgɛ nɩyaarɩŋ-na.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ wɩaa sɩ nyaga bil, tapʋlɩɩ kala lɔrɔ nɛ ba teeŋ, ama ʋ yie ŋaa gbiele nɛ tʋɔtɔrɛ tɩŋŋaa-na teeŋ.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa mʋa aŋ fɩfá La Tɩɩna nɛ kpɩa ŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ, ka wɩaa wʋwalɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: Lee-la nɩaa sɩ cho dɔŋɔ, a hɔnɔ didii jɔgɔɔ nɛ kpɩa, nɩaa sɩ bɛrɛ dɔŋɔ aŋ kpʋ nɛ-fere a hɔnɔ chɩchaŋ.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la baanɩŋ sɩɩ sii lɩma lɩma nɩɩ hɛ yuosuŋ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ kenyiri nɩɩ kɛrɛ yuosuŋ.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Sɔsʋŋ yie nyʋ tɔ yarɩwɩɩ tɩɩna wombiiŋ nɛ, ama nɩɩ-la wɩaa sɩ tʋʋla, ʋ wombiiŋ yie nagɛ womporuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Bii wʋjɩnna yie leŋ ʋ nyɩmma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ, ama nɩyaarɩŋ sɩɩŋ bɩ ʋ naaŋ ka su.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wʋjɩmɩɩ kala kɛnɛ tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ nɩyaarɩ wɩaa lɛ nɛ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa yie joŋ wombii-la sɩ tʋʋla nɛ.

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna yie joŋ wombii-la sɩɩ mʋ mɩɩsɩŋ leriŋ nɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ mʋ.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna yie yigi nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa dɩa a lo nɛ, ama ʋ yie pɔ yo-haala-na dɩa arɩ ʋ kɩaa kala nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɛrɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ, ama ʋ tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Yarɩ-bieri tɩɩna sɩ gɩrɩma lɩlaa nɩaa kɩaa yie lɛrɛ wɩaa nɛ kʋ hɛ ʋ dɩa nɩaa lɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ bɛrɛ kpalaa diiniŋ mɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ duomi.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna yie bɩɩnɛ wɩaa yi nɛ woruŋ aŋ-na bʋl, ama nɩbɔmʋŋ-na niiŋ sɩ puu wʋbɔŋ-la kala nɛ, ʋ yie bʋl.

english_verse: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ka nɩɩ, ama ʋʋ nɩɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-na Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ suri sɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa nɛ yie leŋ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, dɩ ba nɛ bʋl wʋzɔmʋŋ pɩŋ, ŋ yaraa yie fɩɛlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jegile nɩɩ ba kɛnʋ bil wombii-la sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ guoli wʋjɩnnaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ ba kɛnʋ tʋra kɩɩ sɩɩŋ bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa ka su, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ sɛyɛ ba kɛnʋ bil wombiiŋ lɛ jaŋ gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ pɛ.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa muuri, nɩaa jaŋ ziziliŋ.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine yie bɩɩnɛ wɩaa dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɛ, ama La Tɩɩna sɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la nɛ jaŋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine yie bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ wʋŋaalaa kala ŋaa ba bʋa lɛ nɛ, ama La Tɩɩna yie kɛŋ nʋʋkala tʋɔbɩɩnaa jeŋise na nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna ŋaa wɩɩkala kɛŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ paala leŋ nɩbɔmʋŋ kɛŋ tapʋl-bɔŋ nɛ wɩaa sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ-ʋ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ. Má jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ: Ʋ bɩ jaŋ lemba, ʋ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ cho La Tɩɩna a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ joŋ ŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala chɛŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, ŋ yie vɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ wʋŋaalaa nɩɩ tɔrɛ La Tɩɩna tʋɔŋ, ʋ yie leŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala ŋaa sɩma nɛ.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ to wʋtɩtɩɩ a kɛŋ kɩaa mʋa, ʋ nɛ kpɩa ŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ to aŋ dʋa kɩaa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine yie kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ, ama La Tɩɩna nɛ jɩŋ wombii-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ to.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɩ cho dɩ ba gʋrɛ nʋʋkala kɩaa yallɩŋ lɛ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ bɔtɔ lɛ a yuŋ.

english_verse: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
translation_verse: Kuoro bɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ ŋaanɩŋ ka sɛɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ yie leŋ ʋ kuoruŋ chɩŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Kuoro baanɩŋ nɛ sie, ʋ jaŋ wuo kpʋ nɩa, ama wʋjɩnna nɛ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ʋ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Kuoro nɛ suri sɩaa ŋ nyuŋ, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ choŋ nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ nɩɩ tafaaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ kpɩa ŋ sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ, ŋ sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa ma nɛ kpɩa ŋ sɩ kɛŋ hɔpʋla.

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna yie joŋ wombii-la sɩ tʋʋla nɛ dɩ wʋbɔŋ sɩ́ ʋ jʋʋ. Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ ʋ dɩ-vɛnɩŋ nyuŋ woruŋ ka pɔ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Too much pride will destroy you.
translation_verse: Babii-ballɩŋ ka chei ʋ tɩɩna nɛ, sɩɩ-duoŋ maa tel ʋ tɩɩna.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa muuri a guoli summoo tʋɔŋ nɛ kpɩa, ŋ sɩ pɛ sɩɩ-duo tɩŋŋaa sɩ yuo laa kɩaa a kaa kpɩkpaa lɛ.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jegile nɩɩ dagɩŋ jaŋ dʋa. La Tɩɩna jaŋ pɛ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩŋ tɩɩna nɛ baa yɩrɛ nʋʋ sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa. Wʋbʋl sɩŋŋaa nɛ yie leŋ nɩa sɛɩ wɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa, ʋ nagɛ lɩɩ-bul-sɩɩŋ sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ ba teeŋ. Ama yaarɩŋ nɩɩ dɔgɩsɛ nɩyaaraa.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩŋ tɩɩna yie fɩɛlɛ ʋ sɩaa nɛ dɩ ʋ nɩɩ bʋl wɩɩ. Ʋ wʋbʋl sɩŋŋaa nɛ yie leŋ nɩa sɛɩ wɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Wʋbʋl sɩŋŋaa nagɛ tʋʋŋ nɛ, ba sɩma a yie leŋ nɩa tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala, ʋ yaraa fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo bɩɩnɛ arɩ ŋ ŋaa wɩɩ ʋ bʋa lɛ nɛ, ama ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ lɛ ŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Nɩtɔɔŋ yie chɩchɛ wombiiŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ hɛ nɩaa wɩaa lɛ, ʋ wʋbʋlaa ka wɩɩ a nagɛ nyiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Wʋnyɩɛ tɩɩna ka hɛ yuosuŋ nɛ, zɛmbɛ tɩɩna nɛ kɛŋ nandɔŋ-fɩɛmaa pʋpɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Yuo-hɛɛrɛ nɛ yie nyɩsɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, a lɛrʋ hɛ wombii-la sɩ bɩ zɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa woruŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ kɛmɩsɛ sɩaa ŋ nyuŋ ka bɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋ nɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ meri ʋ niiŋ ka chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Nyu-pʋmpʋllʋŋ kɛŋ tʋla nagɛ kuoru nyunchuulo nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ba mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ jaŋ naba.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Kenyiri tɩɩna nɛ kpɩa laalɩyuori wajɩa. Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ ʋ baanɩŋ kɛnɩŋ nɛ kpɩa nʋʋ sɩ yuo dii ta-pilimiŋ.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yie tɔnsɛ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba na wɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɛ, ama La Tɩɩna nɛ jaŋ dagɛ wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ sɩ chaŋ boroboro-hɩlɩŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa, ʋ nɛ kpɩa dɩa-la lɛ ba sɩ ŋaa kʋdii-sɩŋŋaa yʋgɛ ba didii arɩ yuosuŋ.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Dɩa tɩntɩnna sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ doluŋ, a kɩɩ ʋ nɩhɩaŋ bie sɩɩ hɛ hɩɩsɩŋ dɩa lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ kpaalɩŋ ʋ nɩhɩaŋ dʋa tʋɔŋ a nagɛ dɩ ʋ ma ŋaa bile naambii dɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋ ŋaara yie jegilee nɩɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ wʋbʋlʋŋ nɛ. Wʋnyɩɛ tɩɩna ma yie jegilee nɩɩ wʋcheere teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ mɔŋ summo lɛ, tʋʋsɛ Wɩa sɩ ŋaaʋ joŋŋoo nɛ. Ba jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩɩ-la kala tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɛ wʋlɔrʋŋ sɩ ŋaa nɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Nihee ŋaa babiibal kɩaa nɛ ba naabalɩmaba teeŋ. Biiriŋ ma ŋaa babiibal kɩaa nɛ ba lʋllaa teeŋ.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie kperi nɩaa nɛ dɩ nɩyaarɩŋ nɛ bʋl wʋjɩnnɩ wɩɩ. Ʋ jaŋ wasa kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, dɩ kuoro nɛ nyɩɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ wɩalɩŋ nɩaa sɩ ŋaa chei chɩchɛba ka chɛ chonuŋ nɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩɩ kuusi wɩalɩŋ kɛŋ nandɔŋ-fɩɛmaa pʋpɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ kpɩa nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa lɛ, ʋ yie nɩɩ woruŋ nɛ a kɩɩ ba sɩ vɩɩrɛ nɩyaarɩŋ chɩba zɔlɔ.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ wɩɩŋ nɛ, sɩ́ sɛɩ, ba jaŋ tɩŋ tɩndaarɩ-bɔmʋŋ dɩ ʋ kɔ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ sɩ cheŋ lʋgʋmʋŋ sɩ chɛ ʋ bie lɔl ka ʋ yaraa hosi, nɛ kpɩa ŋ sɩ cheŋ nɩyaarɩŋ dɩ ʋʋ ŋaa nɩyaarɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ joŋ wʋbɔmʋŋ a tiŋ wʋzɔmʋŋ chɩmɩŋ, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ suomi yuosuŋ, ʋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ kɛŋ fuoŋ gɩba bubori nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa joŋ wɩɩ-la bil sɔm, dɩ yuosuŋ sɩ́ sii.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɛrɛ nʋʋ sɩ bʋla laa nɩbɔmʋŋ ta, arɩ nʋʋ sɩ bʋla joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ teeŋ ʋ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kala kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ chei moribiee wʋjɩmɩŋ wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ ŋɩɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa kɛnɛ.

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Nandɔnsʋŋ yie cho dɔŋɔ nɛ bʋa na-kala. Ba lʋl naambiiriŋ dɩ ba chɩna gbɛrɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, wʋjʋʋlaa lɛ.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ cho yuosuŋ cho wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ ka chɛ wʋjʋʋlaa nɛ.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Tʋɔgɔrɔɔ tɩɩna bɩ kʋŋ jaŋ dʋa. Wʋnyɩɛra jaŋ jʋʋ wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ lʋl bii-yaara, ŋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ chei. Bii-yaara nyɩmma tʋɔŋ bɩ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ ŋaa daaluŋ-zɔŋ nɛ, ama tʋɔ-cheeŋ-na yie leŋ ŋ jagɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ yie lʋara laa kpalaa nɛ, dɩ ʋ pɔ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ sɩ́ chɩŋ.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa yie joŋ sɩaa hɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ama nɩyaarɩŋ-na tʋɔbɩɩnaa yie bɩbaarɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Bii-yaara yie leŋ ʋ nyɩmma tʋɔŋ chei nɛ, a leŋ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ baanɩŋ sisii.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ wʋzɔŋ ŋaa dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye, koo a ŋmoo nʋʋ dɩchɩnɩŋ sɩ yʋga, ka ʋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ ʋ niiŋ kɛnɩŋ ŋaa wʋjɩnnʋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa bɩ baanɩŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ chɛ ʋ dɩ nʋʋkala pɛ wɩɩ ŋaa tʋɔ-bɔŋ tɩɩna nɛ. Ʋ bɩ chɛ ʋ sɛɩ wɩɩ-la nɩaa sɩ bene dɩ ʋ zɔmɔ.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ sɩpaaŋ tuo wɩaa sɩaa jɩmɩŋ lɛ, ama ʋ-na yie cho dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jɩma nɛ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna wʋbʋlʋŋ luŋie a nagɛ fuoŋ sɩ luŋie nɛ, ʋ lɩɩŋ fɩfɩɛlɛ yaraa a nagɛ lɩɩ-bulo.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ zɔŋ dɩ ba bʋla laa pɛ nɩbɔmʋŋ lɛ koo a pɔ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ́ bɩ wɩɩ cheye sɩ́ kʋsɩŋŋaa laa.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ wʋbʋlʋŋ ka hɛ wɩaa nɛ. Ʋ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa nɛ yie leŋ ʋ laa daaŋ.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ wʋbʋlʋŋ nɛ yie chei ʋ tɩtɩa, ʋ niiŋ nagɛ bɛrɛ nɛ a yie gʋra kɛnʋ.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Zɛmbɛ tɩɩna wʋbʋlʋŋ sɩma a nagɛ kʋdii-sɩŋŋaa nɛ, baa tuu tʋɔŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ yarɩ-wɩɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ arɩ wʋcheere kala nagɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ dɩɩ-leŋiŋ nɛ, tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa yie fá jʋʋ faa nɩmɛ, wɩɩkala bɩ ba lɛ ŋaa.

english_verse: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wɩɩŋ nɩa aŋ dɩdagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ ŋaa nɩyaarɩ nɛ, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ diiu.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ wɩɩlʋ aŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo nyanyalɩɩ-la, ama dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ cheye, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo pɛ ʋ lɛ?

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Zile ŋaanɩŋ suri wombiiŋ pɩpɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa zile nɛ, a wuo leŋ ʋ mʋmʋ nɩbalaa teeŋ.

english_verse: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ to niiŋ, ŋ yie bɩɩnɛ ʋ kɩaa sɩma nɛ, see ʋ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ kaalɛrɛ kʋ lɩɩ pɩɛsʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩduoruŋ balɩa nɛ kɛŋ kaalɛrɛ, tɔnsʋŋ nɛ jaŋ wuo pɔrɛ wɩɩ-la pɩba.

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Nɩa niiŋ wʋbʋlaa nɛ yie leŋ ʋ fehe su, ʋ wʋbʋlaa nɛ yie leŋ ʋ na ʋ wʋchɛɛlɛɛ.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Ŋ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ koo dɩ ŋ sʋʋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho wʋbʋlʋŋ jaŋ na ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ na haala jaa, kʋzɔŋ nɛ ʋ na ŋɩɩ. La Tɩɩna dagɛ ʋ zile pʋ nɛ.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Nyaaba yie sʋsʋl kɩaa tɩɩna dɩ ʋ fá ʋ nenige, ama kɩaa tɩɩna-na yie bʋbʋl chaŋkpaŋ duoŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Nandɔŋ-kɛnɛɛ tɩɩna jaŋ wuo cheyu, ama nandɔŋɔ dɔŋɔ hɛ nɩmɛ a jaŋ wuo kɛnɩŋ woruŋ a kɩɩ ŋ naambie.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ sɩ ŋaa nyaabʋ aŋ bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ, ʋ nɛ kpɩa nʋʋ sɩ ŋaa nɩyaarɩ aŋ nyɩnyɩɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ sɩɩ chel dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ, aŋ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ, ŋɩɩ bɩ zɔŋ. Nʋʋ sɩ pese ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ka perigi nɛ.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine yaarɩŋ nɛ yie cheyu, aŋ ka ʋ mɩɩra joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ La Tɩɩna.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Kɩaa tɩɩna nandɔnsʋŋ yie yʋgɛ nɛ, ama summo-na nandɔŋɔ yie vɩaʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala yie chɩchɛ dɩ nɩbalɩŋ cho ʋ wɩaa nɛ. Zile tɩɩna ŋaa nʋʋkala nandɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Summo naambiiriŋ ma tɩtɩa paala bɩ ʋ cho, a saa bibeŋ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ, ba yie vɩaʋ nɛ. Ʋ yie kire to ba harɩŋ a sʋsʋl, ama ʋ bɩ baa na.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, ʋ cho ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa jaŋ dʋa.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ jaŋ leŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩ wʋpɛ-naara pɛɩ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa jaŋ lɛl.

english_verse: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ hɔŋ sɩma leriŋ, a saa bibeŋ yomo sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ sɩpaalaaraa nyuŋ.

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ yie leŋ ʋ kɛŋ kenyiri. Ʋ wɩɩŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ ŋmoo tɔ nɩaa wʋcheelee a laa yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Kuoro baanɩŋ nɛ sie, ʋ yie nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩɩ huosu nɛ. Ama dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɔ nɩa nyuŋ, ʋ yie nagɛ nyalɩŋ sɩ nyala hɛ yaŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Bii-yaarɩŋ yie leŋ ʋ nyɩmma tel nɛ. Ha-yuo hɛɛrɛ nagɛ duonuŋ sɩɩ pʋʋsʋ a bɩ huo nɛ.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Bie yie dii ʋ nyɩmma dɩa arɩ ʋ dʋa nɛ, ama La Tɩɩna nɛ yie joŋ ha-tɛŋɛ pɩ nɩa.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Yarɩwɩɩ tɩɩna yie pɩŋ doŋ nɛ a yuo naaŋ bʋa na-kala. Losuŋ jaŋ kpʋ nʋʋ yaraa sɩ bɩ digi.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ to Wɩa wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ ba tuto pɔ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩaba jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ joŋ kɩaa dii zile summo lɛ, ʋ joŋo chɩŋ La Tɩɩna nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ timu.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: Tʋrɛ ŋ bie ʋ hambiriŋ bʋa-la lɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga, dɩ ŋɩɩ deeŋ ŋ jaŋ dɔgʋsʋ.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Baaŋ kɩŋkɛŋ tɩɩna yie jʋʋ wɩaa aa ŋmoo chɩmɩŋ bʋa na-kala lɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ lɩɩsʋ wɩɩ lɛ jɩnɩŋ, chie ŋ jaŋ bɩra lɩɩsʋ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Jegilee nɩɩ chagɩlɩŋ, a sɛɩ dɩ ba dagɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ kʋ jɩŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine yie bɩɩnɛ wʋdaŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa, ama wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩɩ chɛ nɛ jaŋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ kala ka chɛ dɩ nɩaa kɛŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ ʋ teeŋ. Summo nɛ kpɩa wʋnyɩɛra.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ fáʋ jaŋ hɔnɔ ta jɩa, wʋbɔŋ kala bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ-ʋ.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Yarɩwɩɩ tɩɩna yie joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ nʋrɛ kʋdiilee lɛ nɛ, ʋ paala bɩ wuo kaa jɩl ʋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Ŋmoo babii-balɩŋ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ woruŋ gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Chagɩlɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa, ʋ jaŋ bɩra gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ pɛ.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, dɩ ŋ nɛ vɩa dɩ ŋ jegilee nɩɩ dagɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ yeŋŋi wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Wʋnyɩɛrɩ wʋpɛ naara, yie nyɩɛ wɩaa aa sieri wʋtɩtɩɩ tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ. Nɩbɔmʋŋ cho wʋbɔmʋŋ a nagɛ kʋdii-sɩŋŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Ba gbɛrɛ nɛ dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ sieri nɩaa lɛ, nɩyaaraa jaŋ laa daaŋ.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Sɩnɩŋ nyɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ a leŋ ba chʋchʋʋlɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ leŋe ʋ kɛnɩŋ yeŋŋi, bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Kuoro baanɩŋ nɛ sie, ʋ yie nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩɩ huosu nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa ʋ baanɩŋ sii jaŋ ŋaa chalɩŋ ta ʋ bɔyɛ.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ vɩa yuosuŋ, ʋ zil ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ. Ama nɩyaara-na bɩ diene aŋ yuyuo yuosuŋ.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine tʋɔbɩɩnaa luŋie a nagɛ fuoŋ sɩ luŋie nɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa yie wuo tuu liiriba a jɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ nɛ yie bʋl arɩ ba kɛŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ, ama kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo chaasa na nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ?

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ, ʋ biiriŋ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo bʋl, “Mɩ-na tʋɔŋ pʋlla nɛ, mɩ bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala kɛnɛ?”

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɛrɛ nʋʋ sɩ magɩsɛ kɩaa gɩgɩrɩmɛ arɩ nʋʋ sɩ yɔɔ kɩaa gɩgɩrɩmɛ kala nɛ.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Hambie wʋŋaalaa lɛ nɛ ba yie to a jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ naga, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ mɛl-zɔmʋŋ koo ɛɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ doŋ pɩnɩŋ cho bʋa na-kala, ŋɩɩ dee ŋ jaŋ summi. Bɛrɛ doŋ a tɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ na kɩaa dii aŋ ka.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Laa nɩɩ-la sɩ chɩna pɩ nʋhʋɔra ʋ dii chɩmɩŋ gɛrɩŋ a bil chɩŋ-la bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ba laa gɛrɩ-la nʋhʋɔrʋ-la chɩmɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ gɩrɩma dii kɩaa, ba sɩma nɛ woruŋ. Ama ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ ba jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ baŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wɩɩ, leŋ dɩ ba dagɩŋ. Leŋ dɩ ba dagɩŋ ka dɩ ŋ-na yuo laalɩŋ.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bʋl wʋlɔrʋŋ ʋ nyɩmma koo ŋ naaŋ lɛ, ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ dɛrɛ a nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩ dɩsɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ guu dʋa kɩaa, ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ bɩ jaŋ zɔŋ.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋbɔŋ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ chɩmɩŋ timiŋ.” Gbɛrɛ La Tɩɩna, ʋ jaŋ laaŋ ta.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɛrɛ nʋʋ sɩ magɩsɛ kɩaa gɩgɩrɩmɛ nɛ, ʋ tʋɔŋ bɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ gʋrɛ nɩaa kɩaa yallɩŋ lɛ nyuŋ ka tɔrɔ.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɩɩ dagɛ nuhuobiiŋ kala naavɛnɛɛ. Ɛɛ nɛ saa nʋʋ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ wombii-la ʋ sɩɩ to?

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ bɩɩna yi woruŋ aŋ guu joŋ kʋŋ a pɩ Wɩa, ʋ jaŋ kʋ bʋl fa jɩma.

english_verse: A wise ruler severely punishes every criminal.
translation_verse: Kuoru wʋjɩnna yie beŋ nɛ a chagɩsa chaarɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ, a dɔgɩsɛba.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ pɩla tʋɔbɩɩnaa, la bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ wɩɩkala faaʋ.
