english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Dɩ kuoro nɛ cho nɩaa a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ walɩmʋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ cho nɩaa, ʋ kuoruŋ jaŋ chɩŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Bapʋɔsaa doluŋ nɛ ba kaa laa yɩrɩŋ. Ba-nɩhɩasɩŋ ma nyu-pʋmpʋllʋŋ nɛ ŋaa ba yɩrɩŋ kɩaa.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, dɩ ba ŋmobu a pɩrʋ, ʋ jaŋ joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ ta. Ŋmobuŋ ka giri tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine yie bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩkala ʋ bʋa lɛ nɛ, ama La Tɩɩna yie kɛŋ nʋʋkala tʋɔbɩɩnaa jeŋise na nɛ.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ wɩɩŋ kala nɛ ŋaa sɩɩ-duoŋ arɩ babii-ballɩŋ, ŋɩɩ saa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ bɩɩnɛ woruŋ aŋ tɩŋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ na ʋ nyʋʋrʋŋ yʋgɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la-na sɩ pesee ŋaa wɩaa, ʋ dɩ sunnuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ gɩrɩma a dʋa kɩaa, ba nagɛ nyʋɔsʋŋ nɛ, aŋ bɩra ŋaa bɛrɛ́ ma sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ tɛrɩsɩŋ nɛ jaŋ gʋra cheiba, bɛɛ wɩaa ba vɩa dɩ ba ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chei wɩaa wʋŋaalaa kala golibo nɛ, ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa ka chei wʋŋaalaa kala tʋʋla nɛ.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ yaara chʋchʋa lusuŋ nyuŋ, ʋ nɛ kpɩa ŋ dɩ haala sɩ cho yuosuŋ sɩ pɛ dɩa.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ hɩɛnɛ wʋbɔmʋŋ ŋaanɩŋ nɛ, ʋ paala bɩ nɩɩ-la ma sɩ jʋʋ kpɩkpagʋ nenige ka fá.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ dɔgɩsɛ babii-balɩŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ woruŋ yie gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ dagɛ wʋjɩnna, ʋ yie gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ pɛ nɛ.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Wɩa ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, ʋʋ beŋ wɩɩkala sɩ hɛ nɩbɔmʋŋ dɩa lɛ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ cheyu dɩ ʋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ vɩa dɩ ʋ nɩɩ summo yele, ʋ ma jaŋ yel, ka nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ jegili ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ chɩna, tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ nɛ, ama fawʋllʋŋ yie faasa jʋʋ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa-na nɛ.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ yeŋŋi wombii-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ to jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa lɛ, ʋ pɛ nɩsʋʋnʋŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho sɩma kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ jaŋ nyaabɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho sɩnɩŋ arɩ nii-sɩŋ kɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ kʋŋ.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ nɛ jaŋ laa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nyuŋ a na hɛɛŋ, dɩ nɩɩ-la ma sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ laa nɩɩ-la wɩaa sɩ tʋʋla nyuŋ a na hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, ʋ nɛ kpɩa ŋ dɩ haala sɩ cho yuosuŋ a kɛŋ baanɩŋ sɩ pɛ dɩa.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna yie tʋɔlɛ tʋɔtɔrɛ kʋdiilee arɩ nʋʋŋ nɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ. Ama nɩyaara-na yie joŋ kʋŋkala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ dii nɛ.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kire to tʋɔpʋla arɩ chonuŋ harɩŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, a kɛŋ dʋa, nɩaa ma zizilu.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna nɛ yie yuo nɩduoruŋ taŋ, a yigi ba dɩ-duoru-la ba sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ a lo.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ ʋ niiŋ kɛnɩŋ, kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ wɩaa jʋʋ.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Babii-balɩŋ arɩ dagɛ-ŋ-tɩtɩɩ tɩɩna, ba kɛnʋ yɩyɩrɛ ‘Sɩɩ-duo tɩɩna nɛ’. Ʋ bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ kikieli lɛ.

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ yaarɩ-wɩɩ tɩɩna sɩɩ hɩɛnʋ nɛ jaŋ kpʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɛrɛ nɩbɔmʋŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa nɛ, a saa bibeŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kɔ arɩ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔmʋŋ.

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Wʋnyɩɛrɩ wʋpɛ naara jaŋ lɛl. Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ jegile nɩɩ ʋ teeŋ, ba jaŋ cheyu a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ yie fugisi arɩ ʋ jɩŋ wɩɩkala nɛ, ama tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-na yie bɩɩnɛ wɩaa nɛ aŋ-na ŋaa.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋ cho ŋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ koo ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa koo a bɩbɩɩnɛ wɩaa woruŋ ɛɛ kala, ŋɩɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ŋ chɩŋ La Tɩɩna sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ jaaba a ŋaa siri gbɛrɛ dɩ ŋ yuo laalɩŋ, ama La Tɩɩna dʋndʋŋ nɛ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ŋ yuo laal-la a dii.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Dagɛ ŋ bie wombii-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ to. Dɩ ʋ nɛ waa ma, ʋ bɩ jaŋ joŋo ta.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Summoo ŋaa kɩaa tɩŋŋaa yosi nɛ, chɩŋ-diiree ma ŋaa nɩalɩŋ teeŋ ba sɩ dii chɩŋŋaa yosi.

english_verse: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ hɛ wɩaa yie jʋʋ wɩaa nɛ. Ʋ baaŋ-la ʋ sɩ na nɩaa nyuŋ jaŋ ŋaa pɛɩ.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ zile lɛ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa kɩaa pɩpɩ summoo.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Kiri babii-balɩŋ ta, dɩ nii-doluŋ, yuosuŋ, arɩ nɩaa joŋŋoo tʋʋsʋŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ cho tʋɔpʋla, a jɩŋ wɩaa bʋlʋŋ nɛ jaŋ dii kuoro nandɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩaa pɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa lɛ nɛ, ama ʋ yie leŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ wɩaa vʋgʋmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Yarɩwɩɩ tɩɩna yie bʋl, “Naachigiŋ nɛ hɛ jeeŋ harɩŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ lɩa, ʋ jaŋ kɛmmɛ chaŋ wombiiŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Hachɔrʋmʋŋ niiŋ nagɛ buotuo-luŋuŋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala nyuŋ La Tɩɩna sɩ na baanɩŋ jaŋ foro tuu bʋa-la.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ nyagɛ summoo bil ka dɩ ʋ dʋa pʋŋ, arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ kɩaa ŋaa zile pɩpɩ kɩaa tɩɩna, ba nɩalɩŋ balɩa kala jaŋ summi. Wʋjɩnnaa wʋbʋlaa

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Suri dɩgɩlaa a jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ wʋjɩnnaa sɩɩ bʋl. Joŋ ŋ tʋɔŋ kala hɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ dagɛ lɛ.

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ wɩalɩŋ hɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, a ŋaa siri dɩ ŋ bʋlba.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ dagɩŋ wɩaa deemba jɩnɩŋ, a paalaa dagɩŋ dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ŋ laa La Tɩɩna wɩaa dii nɛ.

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wʋbiee mara arɩ fii nɛ a paala pɩŋ a mʋʋ tɩgɛ nɩaa chagɩlɩŋ arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: dɩ ŋ wuo jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ŋ wuo bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ a pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ summoo gʋrʋ a tɩŋ ba sɩ summo wɩaa. Sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ gʋrʋ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ,

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa, La Tɩɩna jaŋ laa bʋla pɩba a chei nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ cheiba.

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ baaŋ tɩɩna kaa dii nandɔnsʋŋ. Sɩ́ ŋ tɩtɩa kaa mɛrɛ nɩɩ-la baanɩŋ sɩ bɩ diene aŋ sisii lɛ.

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ŋ jaŋ gʋnnɛ ʋ wʋŋaalaa a joŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ daabɛrɩ-ŋmɛnɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ wuo tiŋ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ kʋpɩnɩŋ laa.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ kʋ-la ŋ naabalɩmaba sɩ joŋo magɩlɛ tinteeŋ bʋa kaa joŋ.

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa woruŋ, ʋ jaŋ tɩŋ kuoro sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ nɩfɩɛma ŋaa teeŋ.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ nɩɩ-la nɩsɩŋ sɩ dolie kʋdiilee dii. Sɩ́ ʋ kʋdii-sɩŋŋaa hɩɛnʋ.

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ hɔŋ sɩpaalaara teeŋ dɩ ŋ dii kɩaa, jɩŋ nɩɩ-la sɩpaaŋ ŋ sɩ hɔnɔ.

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa luobii-tɩɩna ma, keri ŋ luobiiŋ ta.

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ʋ kʋdiile-la sɩma lɛ to, ʋʋ chɛ dɩ ʋ kɛmba nyɩsa kɛnɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie bʋl, “Kʋ dii aŋ nyʋa,” ama ʋ tʋɔŋ bɩ ŋɩɩ cho. Ʋ yie bɩbɩɩnɛ chɩŋ-la ʋ sɩ ŋmobo wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ faasa dɔgɩsɛ ŋ tɩtɩa a chɩchɛ dʋa. Kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a jɩma kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo na dʋa fine, ka dɩ ba lɛl. Ba jaŋ guu nyʋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a file jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ a nagɛ kachuuŋ.

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ tʋɔsɛ mʋa-la kala ŋ sɩ die, wʋsɩma-la kala ŋ sɩ bʋla pʋ jaŋ ŋaa pɛɩ.

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Sɩ́ wɩaa bʋl nɩyaara teeŋ. Ʋ jaŋ sieri wʋjɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ bʋl lɛ.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ma tinteeŋ bʋa magɩlɩ-bɩnɩŋ tabɩɩŋ kaa joŋ, koo a kɛŋ biisinsiŋ tinteeŋ laa,

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ woruŋ, kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa tʋʋlɛ.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ faasaa nyʋa sɩnɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ tʋɔŋ guolu koo nɩalɩŋ sɩ faasaa chaŋ nammɩa.

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: Sɩ-nyʋaraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ faasa cho kʋdiilee jaŋ nyaabɛ. Doŋ pɩnɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba laalɛ gɛrɩ-kɔsʋmɔɔ.

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: Jegile nɩɩ ŋ nyɩmma niiŋ, ʋ nɛ lʋlʋŋ. Dɩ ŋ naaŋ hɩɛsa, sɩ́ ʋ kaa gbesi.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Chɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a sɩ́ joŋo yallɛ. Chɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ a sɛɩ dɩ ba kɛnɩŋ tʋrɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ to jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa.

english_verse: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nyɩmma yie jʋjʋɔsɛ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ bii wʋjɩnna, ʋ tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Make your parents proud, especially your mother. –
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ŋ nyɩmma arɩ ŋ naaŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Leŋ dɩ ŋ naaŋ sɩ lʋlʋŋ jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, suri ŋ tʋɔŋ pɩmɛ, aŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ sɩaa hɛ mɩ wʋŋaalaa lɛ.

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: Halɩɩla nagɛ buotuo-luŋuŋ nɛ. Hachɔrʋmʋŋ ma nagɛ viliŋ sɩ bɩ jal.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: Ʋ yie pɩna gbɛrɛ nɛ a nagɛ gaara, a leŋ baala-la sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ pʋŋa pɩpɛ.

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɩɩ na hɛɛŋ? Kʋbɛɛ tʋɔŋ nɛ cheye? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ba kaa yuo yuosuŋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɩɩ gʋrɩmɛ wɩaa? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ firise aŋ bɩ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ? Kʋbɛɛ sɩaa nɛ keri chalɩŋ?

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hɔnɔɔ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ a bɩ sii, nɩalɩŋ sɩ gɔllɔ laa sɩnɩŋ nyʋa guguoli dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Sɩ́ sɩnɩŋ sɩ fɩɛsɛ ŋɩɩ lɛ beŋ. Ʋ hɛ gbaŋa lɛ nɛ aŋ sisii fʋnfʋga, ʋ jaŋ tuu yikoro fɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: but later it bites like a poisonous snake.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ a nagɛ dɩmɩŋ sɩ ta nɩa, ʋ huoŋ nagɛ kataha nɛ.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ nɩna wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ, a bɩbɩɩnɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bɩ ba sɩaa jɩŋ.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ pɩŋ lɩɩŋ daboro tʋɔŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ, peliŋ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la viviisi.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ bʋl, “Ba ŋmoomi nɛ, ama mɩ bɩ pɩra. Ba ŋmoomi nɛ ka ʋ bɩ mɩ lɛ jʋa. Bʋa bɛɛ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ sii a bɩra wuo chɛ sɩnɩŋ nyʋa?”

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ wʋŋaalaa walɩmɩŋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ yaraa bibieri nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ yaraa bibieri wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nyuŋ. Sɩ́ chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ kɛmba dii nandɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ dɩ ba chɩchɛ nɩaa niiŋ lɛ, a bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩaa wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ bɩ chie kɛnɛ. Ʋ jaŋ lɛl a nagɛ ba sɩ fuuni chaanɩŋ dɩsɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ ba yie kaa chɛ kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bɩ na tɛtɛ arɩ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a su dɩɩsɩ-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, fɩfá La Tɩɩna arɩ kuoro, aŋ pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ tɩtɩa kaa mʋ mɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba niiŋ ka to lɛ.

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ ŋ yuo laalɩŋ, leŋ dɩ ba dagɩŋ, dɩ nɩ-daŋ nɛ chagɩlɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ yuo dii.

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ wuo guu joŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ hɛ nɩalɩŋ lɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa jɩŋ wʋlɔrʋ-la doho ba sɩ jaŋ joŋo hɛ ba lɛ. Wʋjɩnnaa wʋbʋlaa dɔnsʋŋ

english_verse: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ yʋga kɩɩ nɩyaara nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ hilimi wɩaa dɩ-vʋʋrʋŋ, ʋ bɩ wɩɩ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ bʋl.

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnnaa wʋbʋlaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ ma nɛ dii sarɩya a kɛŋ nɩaa pʋpɔrɛ, ŋɩɩ bɩ zɔŋ.

english_verse: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bɩɩnɛ wʋbɔmʋŋ a ŋɩŋaa, nɩaa yɩrʋ wʋhɛɛrʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ nɩyaara sɩ bɩɩna a ŋɩŋaa, ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, nɩaa bɛrɛ babii-balɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Sarɩya diiru-la kala sɩ laa wʋcheere ta, nɩaa jaŋ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ʋ lɛ, ka dɩ tinteyee nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma bɛrʋ.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ŋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ, ŋɩɩ-na ŋ bɩ bɔɩ-duo tɩɩna ŋaa.

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Ama sarɩya diire-la sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛ wʋcheeree, nɩaa jaŋ sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ na wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a yʋgɛ.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ sɩ, “Aɩ, mɩ bɩ wɩɩ jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ,” Wɩa sɩɩ bagɩsɛ nʋʋkala tʋɔbɩɩnaa na nɛ. Ʋ nɛ sɩɩ beŋ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ jɩma nɛ, ʋ jaŋ tiŋ nʋʋkala a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ tɩma magɛ.

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ pɩɛsɩŋ wɩɩ, dɩ ŋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ pʋ, ŋɩɩ daga arɩ ŋ chou nɛ.

english_verse: Honey is good for you, my children, and it tastes sweet.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, dii tʋʋŋ, ʋ sɩma. Tʋʋ-nʋʋŋ arɩ jaga sɩma.

english_verse: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
translation_verse: Tʋʋŋ sɩ sɩma ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ ma nagɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, chɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, ʋ kɛŋ chie nɛ, ŋ yɩɛlaa bɩ jaŋ ŋaa pɛɩ.

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
translation_verse: Laa sɩpaaŋ tɩŋ ŋ ŋmaŋkaaŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa, a ŋaa ŋ baga kɩaa hɛ dɔŋɔ, aŋ-na saa dɩa.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ nɩbɔmʋŋ nagʋ, a faa gbɛrɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna dɩa lɛ, sɩ́ ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ kaa chei.

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: Wɩaa yie wuo jʋʋ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna a yi naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ nɛ, ka ʋ lɩlɩɩ ba lɛ bʋa na-kala. Ama wʋjʋʋlaa jaŋ yigi nɩbɔmʋŋ-na lo.

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Sɩ́ nʋʋ yɩrɩŋ chei pɩ ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna dɩ ŋ nɛ jɩma ʋ bɩ wɩɩ cheye. Sɩ́ wɩaa nyɩa pʋ.

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋ ŋ dʋndɔmɔ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ gɛrɛ ma, sɩ́ jʋɔsʋ.

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ wuo na ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ chei, dɩ ʋ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ dʋndɔŋ-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: Mɩ to yarɩwɩɩ tɩɩna ŋmaŋkaaŋ tʋɔŋ bal, a to nɩyaarɩŋ ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ baga tʋɔŋ a bal,

english_verse: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.
translation_verse: a na dɩ sɔsʋŋ nyʋ tɔ lee-la kala. Tinteeŋ kala tɔ arɩ yaŋ. Ba sɩ kɛŋ tabɩaa saa jebii-la ma tel.

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ dɩɛgɛ doŋ mʋa, dɩ ŋ nɛ pɩŋ doŋ mʋa, dɩ ŋ nɛ paa ŋ vaasɩŋ gɩrɛ dɩ ŋ wiesi mʋa,

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ namagaba dɔnsʋŋ nɛ ŋ-la, Juda kuoro Hezikaaya tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ sɩ naba lee aŋ ma ŋmʋnsɛ:

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ sɩ bolie ŋɩɩ, tinteeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ ma luŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro tʋɔbɩɩnaa nagɛ. Nʋʋ bɩ ba wuo jɩŋ.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ lɩɩsɛ hɔbɩnɩŋ ta hɔpʋla lɛ, ba jaŋ wuo kɛŋ hɔpʋla-la libi kʋŋ.

english_verse: Evil people must be removed before anyone can rule with justice.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ lɩɩsɛ nɩbɔmʋŋ kuoro sɩpaaŋ, wʋtɩtɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ kuoruŋ chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ŋ tɩtɩa kaa ŋaa nɩbal kuoro sɩpaaŋ, a chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ hɔŋ nɩbalaa dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kpɩa dɩ ʋ nɛ sɩ, “Kʋ jɩl daha,” a kɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ hɩɩsɩŋ a bʋl dɩ ŋ sii nɩbalaa dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: Others will find out, and your reputation will then be ruined.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la jaŋ wuo hɩɩsɛma, dɩ ma yɩrɩŋ chei a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bʋl wɩɩŋ woruŋ ʋ bʋa lɛ, ʋ naga ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa kʋŋ a joŋo daŋ hɔpʋla kʋa nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna sɩ kɛŋ nɩaa tʋra kɩɩ ba jegile nɩɩ, ʋ nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ libi dɩgɩlɩŋ-kpɛnsɩŋ arɩ kpɩɛraa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Patience and gentle talk can convince a ruler and overcome any problem.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ kenyiri, ŋ jaŋ wuo sʋl sɩpaalaara dɩ ʋ sɛɩ ŋaa wɩɩŋ. Wʋbʋl sɩŋŋaa nɛ yie kɛŋ nɩbalɩŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩrɩmɛ.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna dɩa mʋmʋ bʋa kala. Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ fɩɩŋ dɩ ʋ bɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: Dɩ losuŋ nɛ kɛŋ ŋ dʋndɔmɔ, ŋaa kʋdiilee pʋ, dɩ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ nɛ kɛnʋ, ŋaa lɩɩŋ pʋ dɩ ʋ nyʋa.

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ wuo ŋaa ŋɩɩ, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ kɛnʋ kɩŋkɛŋ. La Tɩɩna jaŋ timiŋ.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Pel-duoŋ sɩ yie kɛŋ duonuŋ kɔ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ harɩ-gaaŋ ma yie kɛŋ baanɩŋ kʋkɔ.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ yaara chʋchʋa lusuŋ nyuŋ, ʋ nɛ kpɩa ŋ dɩ haala sɩ cho yuosuŋ sɩ pɛ dɩa.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-nyʋasʋŋ sɩ yie kɛnɩŋ ŋ nyʋa lɩɩ-fɩɛla ʋ sɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ yaraa ma yie fɩɛlɛ dɩ ŋ nɛ nɩɩ wʋzɔmʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ dɩ-bolii kʋkɔ.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ sɛyɛ pɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ a to ʋ niiŋ, ʋ nagɛ vʋchɔɔŋ sɩ tɔ lɩɩ-bʋl-sɩɩŋ nɛ koo ba sɩ chʋŋ nʋsʋrʋŋ hɩhɛ viliŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Losing self-control leaves you as helpless as a city without a wall.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ sɩ bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa wuo kɛŋ, ʋ nagɛ taŋ ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli, ʋ tel aŋ ka taŋ-la nɛ.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bɩ wombiiŋ ŋaa dɩ waarɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ wulumuŋ bʋa lɛ ŋɩɩ koo a bɩ maga dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ kɩaa kʋmʋŋ bʋa lɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ zil nɩyaarɩŋ.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa ka dɩ nʋʋ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ŋ lɛ, ŋmɩaŋ-la bɩ jaŋ diiŋ. Ʋ nagɛ zaarɩ-kokobie koo kampiliŋ diibie sɩɩ fil a bɩ togili nɛ.

english_verse: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.
translation_verse: A nagɛ ŋ sɩ yie vɩɩrɛ kakumo ŋɩɩ, koo ŋ sɩ yie joŋ koŋ hɛ jaaba niiŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ maga ŋ ŋmoo nɩyaara.

english_verse: Don't make a fool of yourself by answering a fool.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩyaarɩŋ nɛ pɩɛsɩŋ nɩyaarɩ wɩɩ, sɩ́ wɩɩ-la bʋbʋɔŋ lɩɩsʋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ ma nagʋ nɛ.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: To ʋ yaarɩŋ lɛ a dagɛ ʋ wɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ pʋ. Ŋɩɩ dee ʋ jaŋ bɩɩnɛ ʋ jɩŋ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ tɩŋ nɩyaarɩŋ a bʋl dɩ ʋ mʋ bʋl wɩɩ pɩ nʋʋ, ʋ yie nagɛ ŋ sɩ keri ŋ tɩtɩa naaŋ nɛ, a joŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: A nagɛ gbɛrɩgɛ naasɩŋ bɩra sɩ́ bɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ kɛnɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩyaarɩŋ sɩ magɛ namaga ma nagɛ.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ zil nɩyaarɩŋ, ʋ nagɛ ŋ sɩ joŋ tabɩɩŋ vɔɔ mɛrɛ kpalɩŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ chɩchɛ ŋ yuo.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ sɩ magɛ namaga, ʋ nagɛ sɩ-nyʋara sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛ sɔɔŋ sɩ tɔɔ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ joŋ nɩyaarɩŋ koo nʋʋ na-kala sɩ kʋʋ bal dɩ ʋ tɩŋ ka ʋ timu, ʋ nagɛ to-yuoro sɩ gɔllɔ pɩrɛ nɩaa tɩta nɛ.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ na nʋʋ sɩ bɩɩna ʋ jɩŋ wɩɩkala nɛ aŋ bɩ wɩɩ jɩŋ, nɩyaarɩŋ nɛ kpɩaʋ.

english_verse: Don't be lazy and keep saying, “There's a lion outside!”
translation_verse: Yarɩwɩɩ tɩɩna yie bʋl, “Naachigiŋ nɛ hɛ wombiiŋ lɛ, kpeye yaraa sɩ hoso nɩɩ gɔllɛ jeeŋ harɩŋ.”

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ yie suri boro ʋ chɩna viviisi ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ yarɩwɩɩ tɩɩna ma yie pɩna bibilimi ʋ kʋpɩnaa nyuŋ.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Yarɩwɩɩ tɩɩna yie joŋ nɩsɩŋ a nʋrɛ kʋdiilee lɛ nɛ, ama yarɩwɩɩŋ bɩ sɛɩ dɩ ʋ kaa jɩl niiŋ.

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Yarɩwɩɩ tɩɩna bɩɩna ʋ nɛ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a kɩɩ nɩaa balɩpɛ sɩ jaŋ wuo lɩɩsɛ wɩaa sɩaa woruŋ.

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ yuosuŋ ŋ wɩɩ tuo nɩmɛ, ka ŋ joŋ ŋ niiŋ hɛ, ʋ nagɛ vaha sɩ kʋʋ bal, ŋ kɛŋ ʋ dɩgɩlaa lɛ lɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: It's no crazier to shoot sharp and flaming arrows
translation_verse: A nagɛ nyɩnyɛ tɩɩna sɩɩ yuo to-hɛŋŋɛɛ sɩɩ chol nyiniŋ koo hɛ-sʋʋlaa,

english_verse: than to cheat someone and say, “I was only fooling!”
translation_verse: ʋ nagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ yie nyɩsɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ ta kaa gbieli nɛ.”

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Dɩ daasɩŋ nɛ tuo, nyiniŋ dɩsɛ nɛ, dɩ zɛmbɛ ma nɛ tuo, yuosuŋ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: Troublemakers start trouble, just as sparks and fuel start a fire.
translation_verse: Hɔlɔɔ sɩ yie ŋaa nyiŋ-muluŋ ŋɩɩ ka daasɩŋ ma nɛ ŋaa nyiniŋ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ yuo-hɛɛrɛ ma yie leŋ yuosuŋ pupusi.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Zɛmbɛ tɩɩna wʋbʋlʋŋ sɩma a nagɛ kʋdii-sɩŋŋaa nɛ, baa tuu tʋɔŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Niiŋ sɩɩ bʋl wʋsɩŋŋaa aŋ kɛŋ tʋɔbɔmʋŋ, ʋ nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ chʋrʋŋ mɛ pupoiŋ aŋ joŋ hɔpʋla bɩnɩŋ taara nɛ.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Nɩa yie bɛrɩŋ aŋ fugoo bʋl wʋsɩŋŋaa ŋ teeŋ, aŋ ka ʋ tʋɔŋ biri.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ lu buotuoŋ bil ʋ dɔŋɔ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ gʋra tuu bʋa-la. Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ bilimi tabɩɩŋ dɩ ʋ nyagɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ, tabɩɩ-la jaŋ mɩɩra kʋ nyagʋ.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa bɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa pɩpa nɛ, nii-sɩma ka chei nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ chiemiŋ kaa ŋmoo bɔyɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ bɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ chie sɩ jaŋ nagɛ.

english_verse: Don't brag about yourself— let others praise you.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ bɛsʋ, leŋ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɛsɛ ŋ lɛ, nɩwogo, ŋ tɩtɩa-na dee.

english_verse: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.
translation_verse: Tabɩɩŋ yuŋŋie nɛ, ka hagɩla ŋaa chʋga, ama nɩyaarɩŋ wʋŋaalaa sɩ yie hɛ wɩalɩŋ nɛ yuŋŋie kɩɩ ba kala.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Baanɩŋ ŋaa kʋbɔŋ nɛ a chichei wɩaa, ama yarɩ-bieri ma nɛ bɩra bɔmɔ kɩɩʋ.

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nandɔŋɔ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ a jʋʋŋ lɛ ŋ ha jaŋ wuo laa ʋ wɩaa dii, ama dɩ ŋ dʋndɔmɔ-na nɛ guoruŋ ma, ʋ haa nyɩsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ vɔgɔ, tʋʋŋ ma yie paalaa sʋɔrɛ nɛ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ama dɩ losuŋ nɛ kɛnɩŋ, kʋ-la sɩ hɛyɛ bagɛ bagɛ ma paala ŋaa kʋsɩŋ nɛ ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ fá kagɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ, ʋ nagɛ diibie sɩ yeŋŋi ʋ dɛlɛ leriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ tɩsɛ tʋlaalɩɩ arɩ nʋʋ-sʋara, ŋ tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ nɛ. Ama dɩ ŋ nandɔŋ fɩamɩŋ nɛ chaasa bʋl wɩaa chagɩlɩŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩba.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ nandɔŋɔ arɩ ŋ nyɩmma nandɔŋɔ vɩa ta. Dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋŋ, pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ naambie teeŋ sii mʋ a chɩchɛ ʋ pɛ ŋ lɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ jʋʋ kpagɩŋ jaŋ wuo pɛ ŋ lɛ a kɩɩ ŋ naambie sɩ hɛ dɩ-bolii.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo na wombiiŋ a bʋl wɩaa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba hɩɩsɛmɛ teeŋ.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna yie na wʋbɔmʋŋ dɩ ʋʋ kɔ, ʋ gɛbɛ faa, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ woruŋ-na yie vɛnɛ vɛnɛ mʋ jʋʋ-ʋ nɛ, a na hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Laa nɩɩ-la sɩ chɩna pɩ nʋhʋɔra ʋ dii chɩmɩŋ gɛrɩŋ, a bil chɩŋ-la bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ba laa gɛrɛ-la nʋhʋɔrʋ-la chɩmɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sii chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla a kpɩa chʋɔlɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, nɩaa jaŋ joŋu arɩ ʋ kalɩba hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Haala sɩ cho yuosuŋ nagɛ duonuŋ sɩɩ pʋʋsʋ deeŋ deeŋ a bɩ leŋ nɛ.

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ walɩmɛ dɩ ʋ leŋ, ʋ nagɛ ŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ kɛrɛ peliŋ nɛ, koo nʋʋ-lɩɩŋ nɛ ŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ gulimi.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: A nagɛ ba sɩ yie kɛŋ hɔɔŋ a kaa taa hɔɔŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ nuhuobiinee ma yie dɩdagɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ chɔnsɛ tɩa-la nɛnɛɛ ba sɩɩ dii a beŋ ʋ nyuŋ, ʋ jaŋ dii ʋ nɛnɛɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ beŋ ʋ nɩhɩaŋ nyuŋ woruŋ, nɩaa jaŋ zilu.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ yie beŋ lɩɩŋ lɛ a na ŋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa ma yie leŋ ŋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ŋ mɛlɛ sɩ naga.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: Sʋʋŋ bʋa arɩ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ sɩ bɩ vɔgɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nuhuobiine ma chɩchɛ kɩaa a bɩ vɔgɛ.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Jɩŋ ŋ piesee arɩ ŋ bʋʋnaa yarɩfɩɛlaa wɩaa a beŋ ba nyuŋ woruŋ,

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ ku pʋsʋŋ ya-diiliŋ a ku dundolo nyuŋ kɩaa ma pɛ a hiese hɛ dɔŋɔ, ka dɩ ya-falɩŋ bɩra tɔsɛ,

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: piese-la lɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo na gɛnnɩŋ, aŋ yallɛ bʋʋna-la ma a yɔɔ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ na bʋ-yɩlɩŋ yʋgɛ, a kaa beŋ ŋ dɩa nɩaa, dɩ haala-la sɩɩ tɩŋ ŋ dɩa lɛ ma na dii.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ yie fá nɛ dɩ nʋʋ bɩ ʋ kire, ama tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-na kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a nagɛ naachigiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Dɩ tinteeŋ nɩaa nɛ bɩ dɔŋɔ ba niiriŋ ka sɛɩ, ba sɩpaalaaraa yie yʋgɛ nɛ, ama dɩ sɩpaalaarʋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa, wɩɩkala yie magɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ nɩɩ dɔgɩsɛ summoo, ʋ nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ faasa lɔgɔ jaasɛ a chei kʋdiilee nɛ.

english_verse: Lawbreakers praise criminals, but law-abiding citizens always oppose them.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa Wɩa wombiiŋ nɩɩ bɛsɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, ama ba dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wombii-la-na bɩ sugili.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ paala bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ jɩŋ, ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ La Tɩɩna, ba-na jɩmʋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ sɩ ŋaa nyaabʋ aŋ bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ, ʋ nɛ kpɩa nʋʋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa ka ʋ wʋŋaalaa golibi.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Bile sɩɩ to Wɩa wombiiŋ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa nɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩɩ to luobii-tɩŋŋaa harɩŋ hɩɩsɛ ʋ nyɩmma nɛ.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ joŋ kɩaa chɩŋ nɩaa a faasa kɛŋ lɩɩŋ dɩdaŋ a dʋa kɩaa, ʋ dʋa-la jaŋ ŋaa nʋʋ dɔŋ kɩaa, dɩ ʋ joŋo dii zile summoo lɛ.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ chɛ ʋ jegili Wɩa wombiiŋ wɩaa, ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ paala sʋɔrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ nyɩsɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna hɛ wʋbɔmʋŋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ gʋra jʋʋ ʋ tɩtɩa bɛrɛ́, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wʋcheeli kɛnɛ jaŋ na wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Kɩaa tɩɩna yie bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ jɩŋ wɩaa nɛ, ama summo sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa yie bibenu dɩ ʋ bɩ wɩɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ dii kuoruŋ, nɩaa yie jʋjʋɔsɛ nɛ, ama dɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ nɛ die, nɩaa fá fɩfaa.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ joŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ faa, ʋ wɩaa bɩ sɩpaaŋ ka mʋ, ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ suri ʋ niiŋ a dagɛ ʋ kɩaa aŋ vɩaba, Wɩa jaŋ fá ʋ nisusuŋ.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna bʋa-kala, ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ, ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ jaŋ jʋʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: A nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩɩ huosu koo lʋgʋmʋŋ yaraa sɩ hoso ʋ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ nagɛ summoo lɛ dɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ nɩɩ bemba.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaarʋ-la sɩ tɛrɛ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ cho dɩ ʋ gɩrɩma dʋa jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩ-duduoŋ.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kpʋ nʋʋ, ʋ jaŋ gɔllɔ baarɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ sʋʋ. Nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ wʋcheeli kɛnɛ, wɩaa bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ-ʋ, ama nɩɩ-la wɩaa sɩ golibo jaŋ guu tel.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ faasa tɩŋ ʋ baga lɛ jaŋ na kʋdiilee yʋgɛ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ kire to wʋpɛɩba harɩŋ jaŋ nyaabɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ chaasa pɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ woruŋ, ama ʋ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chel dɩ ʋ dʋa.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ nɩaa pʋpɔrɛ, ŋɩɩ bɩ zɔŋ, aŋ ka nɩa yie ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ a chɩchɛ kʋdiilee mʋa.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Tʋɔ-bɔŋ tɩɩna yie chichel nɛ dɩ ʋ dʋa, aŋ bɩ jɩŋ dɩ nyaaŋ ka gbɛrʋ nɛ.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ gʋrɛ ʋ nyɩmma koo ʋ naaŋ aŋ bʋl, “Ʋ bɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa,” tɩɩna dii gaara nandɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Tʋɔ-bɔŋ tɩɩna ka hɛ yuosuŋ nɛ, ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa hɛ La Tɩɩna lɛ, ʋ wɩaa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ ŋaa nɩyaarɩ nɛ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa, wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ-ʋ.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa kɩaa pɩpɩ summoo bɩ jaŋ chɛ kʋŋ ka, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa tɔ summoo nyuŋ, ba jaŋ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ nɛ dii kuoruŋ, nɩaa yie fɩfaa nɛ, ama nɩbɔmʋŋ kuoruŋ nɛ dɛrɛ, tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa yie pʋŋa pɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nyuŋ nɛ dolie, dɩ ba tʋrʋŋ tʋrʋŋ lɔl, ŋ jaŋ kʋʋ jɩŋ dɩ ba guu chei ŋ kala. Wɩɩkala tuo sɩ jaŋ laaŋ ta.

english_verse: When justice rules a nation, everyone is glad; when injustice rules, everyone groans.
translation_verse: Dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ laa nɩaa sɩpaaŋ, ba yie jʋjʋɔsɛ nɛ, ama dɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ nɛ laa ba sɩpaaŋ, ba gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ cho wʋjɩmɩŋ, ŋɩɩ yie leŋ ʋ nyɩmma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩɩ to ha-lɩɩ-la harɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ ŋmoo chɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Dɩ kuoro nɛ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ yie chɩŋ nɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ cho kpalaa diiniŋ yie yigi taŋ lo nɛ.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ yie gʋra bɛrɛ kɛnʋ, ama tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-na jaŋ wuo yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a jʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa chɩl wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa summoo lɛ wɩaa nɛ, ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ-na sɩpaa tuo.

english_verse: Sneering at others is a spark that sets a city on fire; using good sense can put out the flames of anger.
translation_verse: Babiibalaa yie kɛŋ taŋ hosi nɛ, ama wʋjɩnnaa-na yie leŋ nɩaa baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Dɩ wʋjɩnna arɩ nɩyaara nɛ mʋ wɩaa dɩ-bʋlʋŋ, nɩyaarɩ-la yie na baanɩŋ a yigi wɩaa lo nɛ a ŋɩŋaa goŋ. Leriŋ bɩ fɩɛlaa pɩŋ.

english_verse: A murderer hates everyone who is honest and lives right.
translation_verse: Nɩkpʋʋra bɛrɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wʋcheeli kɛnɛ nɛ. Ʋ yie chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩyaarɩŋ baanɩŋ nɛ sie, ʋ yie ŋaa wɩaa nɛ nʋʋkala jɩŋ, ama wʋjɩnna-na yie jɩma kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Dɩ kuoro nɛ jegilee nɩɩ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ, ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kala yie bɩrɩmɛ nɩbɔmɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Wʋbala nɛ summo arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dɔgɩsʋ kala kaa magɛ dɔŋɔ: La Tɩɩna nɛ pɩ ba kala mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Dɩ kuoro nɛ dii sarɩya dɩ summoo ma wuo nɩna ba wʋchɛɛlɛɛ, ʋ kuoruŋ jaŋ dieni.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ chɩba dagɛ bie, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, ama dɩ ŋ nɛ leŋ bie ta ʋ dʋndʋŋa, ʋ jaŋ hɩɩsɛ ʋ naaŋ.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ laa nɩaa sɩpaaŋ, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yie pʋrɩgɛ nɛ. Ama tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa-na jaŋ na ba dɩ-teliŋ.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: Tʋrɛ ŋ bie, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala, dɩ ŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ niiŋ dʋndʋŋa kɛŋ tɩntɩnna bil wombiiŋ lɛ. Ʋ yie jɩŋ ba sɩaa ma nɛ aŋ bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ na nʋʋ sɩ pese bʋbʋl wɩaa, nɩyaarɩŋ nɛ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa a kɩɩʋ.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ ŋ tɩntɩnna pɩɛnɛ ʋ hambiriŋ kala lɛ, ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ chei.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Baaŋ-tɩɩna ka hɛ yuosuŋ nɛ, nɩɩ-la baanɩŋ sɩɩ sii lɩma lɩma yie ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yʋgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ pɛ gaara lɛ, bɛrɛ ʋ tɩtɩa mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ paala ŋmɩɛsɛ ma, ʋ ha bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ka bʋl.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ fá nuhuobiinee, ŋɩɩ ŋaa bɛrɛ́ nɛ ʋ lɛ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ laa La Tɩɩna dii, wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala yie chɩchɛ dɩ nɩbalɩŋ cho ʋ wɩaa nɛ, ama La Tɩɩna teeŋ nɛ nʋʋkala yie na wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ baa yɩrɛ Agʋ. Ʋ nyɩmma nɛ Jakɛ, a ŋaa Masa tɩɩna. Wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ fa bʋla pɩ Ɩtɩɛl arɩ Uka, “Mɩ Wɩa leŋe mɩ kala bɛsɩmɛ nɛ, mɩ bɛsɩmɛ nɛ, a kala pʋgʋmɛ.

english_verse: I am far too stupid to be considered human.
translation_verse: Nɩaa kala tʋɔŋ mɩ nɛ chʋʋla, nuhuobiinee tʋɔŋ mɩ nɛ bɩ wɩɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ gʋnna. Mɩ bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ aŋ kʋ tuu? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ wuo kɛŋ peliŋ gulimi ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ wuo kɛŋ ʋ gɛrɩŋ a vɔɔ lɩɩŋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ bil dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ lee-la kala ʋ chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ? Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ bɛɛ, ʋ bie yɩrɩŋ nɛ bɛɛ? Dɩ ma nɛ jɩma, má dagɛmɛ.

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: Wɩa niiŋ wʋbʋlaa bɩ cheeri kala kɛnɛ. Ʋ nagɛ hɔɔ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ aa tɔ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ yuoru.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ wɩɩ kaa pɛ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa lɛ. Dɩ ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ tʋra kɩɩ a leŋ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ arɩ ŋ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: “La Tɩɩna, wɩaa balɩa nɛ mɩ sʋlaa chɛ ŋ teeŋ. Sɩ́ mɩ wɩaa deemba vɔŋ ka dɩ mɩ-na sʋʋ:

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ mɩ nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩaa koo aa nyɩɛ wɩaa. Sɩ́ leŋe mɩ nyaabɛ koo a kɛŋ kɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ. Ama pɩmɛ mɩ tapʋlɩɩ kala niiŋ kʋdiiliŋ.

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ka dɩ mɩ kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ, mɩ jaŋ wuo vɩaŋ aŋ pɩɛsɛ, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa La Tɩɩna?’ Koo mɩ jaŋ ŋaa summu a gaa, a chei ŋ-na mɩ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ.”

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ tɩntɩnna yɩrɩŋ chei a pɩ ʋ nɩhɩaŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ʋ jaŋ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋ na hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a bʋl wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ pɩpɩ ba nyɩmmaba a bɩ wʋzɔŋ bʋla pɩpɩ ba naamba ma.

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: Dɔnsʋŋ ma hɛ nɩmɛ a bɩɩnɛ dɩ ba tʋɔŋ pʋlla nɛ, aŋ ka ba bɩ ba disiniŋ fo ta.

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: Dɔnsʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kɛŋ sɩɩ-duoŋ, a bee gʋʋnɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ ŋ-la: lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ, hapɩrɩŋ, tinteeŋ sɩ bɩ lɩɩŋ ka vɔgɛ arɩ nyiniŋ. Ba-na bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba sɩ, “Ʋ maga.”

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ aa mɔŋ ʋ nyɩmma, a kɛŋ ʋ naaŋ ŋmuŋmoo gbɛɛŋ a bɩ ba niiŋ ka to, gɩlɩŋgaamba jaŋ chaarɛ ʋ sɩaa, dɩ duunuŋ ma dii ʋ kala.

english_verse: There are three or four things I cannot understand:
translation_verse: Kɩaa batori koo banɛsɛ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ ba wɩaa kperimi, mɩ bɩ ba wɩaa sɩaa jɩŋ:

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ ŋ-la: ŋɩɩ duunuŋ sɩɩ fil wɩa-nyuŋ, ŋɩɩ dɩmɩŋ sɩɩ vɛŋ bʋŋ nyuŋ, ŋɩɩ lɩɩŋ daboro sɩɩ vɛŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nyuŋ, a pɛ baala arɩ hatolo pɛgɛ wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: An unfaithful wife says, “Sleeping with another man is as natural as eating.”
translation_verse: Haal-la sɩ gɔllɔɔ chɛ nɩaa balaba wɩɩŋ kala nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ yie dii nɛ aŋ tɩɩgɛ niiŋ ta, aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa.”

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: Wɩaa batori koo banɛsɛ nɛ kɛŋ tinteeŋ viviisi, ba ŋaa wʋfakagɩa nɛ:

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: Ba nɛ ŋ-la: Yomo sɩ kʋ dii kuoruŋ, nɩyaarɩŋ sɩ tagɩlɛ kʋdiilee tʋɔŋ,

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: haala sɩ ŋaa nɩaa bɛrʋ, ka ʋ na bala jaa, arɩ ketiiŋ sɩ yigi ʋ dɩa naaŋ ta aŋ laa leriŋ.

english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: Kɩaa banɛsɛ nɛ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ a muuri, aŋ chaasa kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: Chunchusumuŋ doluŋ bɩ wɩɩ maga, aŋ ka tafaaŋ ba yie tʋɔlɛ kʋdiilee.

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: Bʋŋ-nyuŋ gbuŋgbogusuŋ ma doluŋ bɩ wɩɩ maga, aŋ yie kɔrɩgɛ bʋbʋɔŋ jʋjʋʋ.

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: Hɔbɔ ma bɩ kuoro kɛnɛ, aŋ yie hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a vɩvɛŋ.

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ habalɩŋ arɩ ŋ nɩsɩŋ, aŋ ka ʋ yie wuo hɛ kuoro dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: ji-bele sɩ gise jiŋŋee tʋɔŋ, gbuŋgbogo sɩɩ vɛŋ arɩ kuoro sɩɩ vɛŋ, ka ʋ laalɩyuoroo gugollu.

english_verse: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa nɩyaarɩ aŋ bigisi ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ, koo dɩ ŋ nɩɩ bɩɩnɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ŋ leŋ.

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba ŋmoo nɛ-yɩlɩŋ, lɩɩŋ jaŋ lɩɩ aŋ ka nʋʋŋ, dɩ ba ŋmoo nʋʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ chalɩŋ jaŋ lɩɩ, dɩ ba nɛ dii nʋʋ baanɩŋ lɛ, yuosuŋ jaŋ sii.

english_verse: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.
translation_verse: Lɛmʋɛl nɛ fa ŋaa Masa kuoro. Wɩalɩŋ ʋ naaŋ sɩ dagʋ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii-kpɩana, mɩ nɛ lʋlʋŋ. Mɩ sʋl Wɩa nɛ ʋ joŋuŋ pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ŋ doluŋ joŋo hɛ haalaa chɛnɩŋ lɛ. Ba chei kuoroo yʋgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii Lɛmʋɛl, jegile nɩɩ. Kuoroo bɩ maga dɩ ba nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bubugi. Ba paala bɩ maga dɩ ba hɩhɩɛnɛ sɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: Drinking makes you forget your responsibilities, and you mistreat the poor.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bugi, ba jaŋ yʋ wombiee-la ba sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto, aŋ nyagɛ summoo bil.

english_verse: Beer and wine are only for the dying or for those who have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ lɛl nɛ nyʋnyʋa sɩnɩŋ, leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ sɩ faasa chei nɛ nyʋnyʋa.

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ wuo leŋ dɩ ba yʋ ba sunnuŋ lɛ, a bɩra sɩ́ hɛɛ-la ba sɩɩ na wɩaa liisu.

english_verse: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless. In Praise of a Good Wife
translation_verse: Dii sarɩya arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a bʋla laa summoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ ta. Haala sɩ kɛŋ mɛlɛ

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ na haal-la mɛlɛ sɩ zɔmɔ, ʋ hɛyɛ, ʋ nɛ yuŋŋie a kɩɩ yaraa kpɩɛrɩ kala yalɩŋ sɩ hɛyɛ.

english_verse: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.
translation_verse: Ʋ bala yɩɛlaa kala daŋ ʋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ bɩ kʋ-yuŋii kala chɛɛ ka.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: Ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ ʋ yie ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ʋ bala lɛ, ʋ bɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie kɛŋ pie-pʋnaa arɩ tɩɩ-pugubie-la nɛnɛɛ ba sɩ kaa ŋaa gɛnnɩŋ a ŋɩŋaa gɛnnɩŋ nɛ, bʋa kala.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: Ʋ nagɛ bayalaa sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ-daborusuŋ tɩtɩŋ nɛ, a yie mʋ dɩ-bolii a chɛ kʋdiilee kʋkɔ.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie sii dɩ leriŋ ha bire nɛ, a ŋaa kʋdiilee pɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa, aŋ dagɛ haala-la sɩɩ tɩŋ ʋ dɩa lɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard,
translation_verse: Ʋ yie na tinteeŋ a yɔɔ, a kɛŋ moribie-la ʋ sɩ tɩma na a chɔnsɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga.

english_verse: and she always works hard.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ, a chaasa tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie na dɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ tɩŋ kɛŋ nyʋʋrʋŋ. Ʋ tɩŋ ŋɩɩ halɩɩ taŋ siesi.

english_verse: and she helps the poor and the needy.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie pɩpɛ summoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: Dɩ waarɩŋ nɛ kʋ hɛ nɩmɛ, fawʋllʋŋ bɩ ʋ kɛŋ a tɩŋ ʋ dɩa nɩaa wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba kala kɛŋ waarɩŋ gɛnnɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.
translation_verse: Ʋ bala yie ŋaa nɩ-jɩmɩɩ nɛ a guoli ba jaŋ nɩ-hɩasɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: She makes clothes to sell to the shop owners.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ yɛrɛ gɛnnɩŋ aa yallɛ, aŋ yallɛ dɔnsʋŋ ma pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yallɛ kɩaa.

english_verse: She is strong and graceful, as well as cheerful about the future.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ nɩaa zizilu. Ʋ bɔyɛ bɩ joŋ a mʋʋ tɩgɛ maachie lɛ.

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie bʋbʋl wɩaa arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ, a kɛŋ zile a dɩdagɛ nɩaa woruŋ.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie bibeŋ ʋ dɩa wɩɩkala nyuŋ woruŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ yarɩ-wɩɩ tɩɩna ŋaa.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: Ʋ biiriŋ yie sii a kɛnʋ yɩyɩrɛ tʋɔtɔrɛ tɩɩna nɛ. Ʋ bala ma yie bɛsɛ ʋ lɛ a bʋl,

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: “Haalaa yʋga nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, ama ŋ nɛ kɩɩ ba kala.”

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Zɔmʋŋ nyɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ, aŋ lɩlɩɩ ma, ama haal-la sɩɩ fá La Tɩɩna maga dɩ nʋʋkala bɛsɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.
translation_verse: Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ tɩma, ʋ maga dɩ ma zilu nɛ, a bɛsɛ ʋ lɛ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a dɩdagɛ nɩaa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la. Ʋ fa ŋaa Devit nanʋal nɛ a ŋaa kuoro Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a dɩdagɛ nɩaa sɩ, “Kʋŋkala bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, kʋŋkala chaasa bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, kʋŋkala bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ nuhuobiine yie na, ʋ sɩ yie faasa tɩma suoli ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ?

english_verse: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yie sʋsʋʋ nɛ, aŋ ka ba bɩra lʋlʋl dɔnsʋŋ, ama dʋnɩa ha nagɛ ʋ nagɩsɩŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-muluŋ yie pɔsɛ, a tuu jʋʋ, aŋ bɩra guu mʋ lee-la ʋ sɩ chɩna pɔsɛ.

english_verse: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.
translation_verse: Peliŋ yie lu a mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, aŋ ville mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ, ʋ yie golli golli, aŋ bɩra mɩɩra mʋ ʋ dɩ-suomuŋ.

english_verse: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.
translation_verse: Fuonuŋ kala pɛllɛ hɩhɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ nɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ bɩ su. Lee-la kala fuonu-la sɩ lɩɩ kɔ, ba yie bɩra mɩɩra mʋ nɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
translation_verse: Kʋŋkala chaasa lʋlɔl nɛ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ nʋʋ sɩ jaŋ wuo dagɛ. Sɩɩŋ nɩna wɩaa ʋ bɩ vɔgɛ, dɩgɩlɩŋ ma nɩnɩɩ wɩaa ʋ bɩ vɔgɛ.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before; nothing is new, nothing under the sun.
translation_verse: Kʋŋkala fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ ha jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Wɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ a ŋaa nɛ jaŋ bɩra ŋaa. Wɩɩkala bɩ wʋfalɩɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Someone might say, “Here is something new!” But it happened before, long before we were born.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ jaŋ wuo bʋl, “Má bee na, kʋa deeŋ-na ŋaa kʋfalɩɩ nɛ.” Ama ʋ fa hɛ nɩmɛ faafaa kala nɛ, ka ba-na lʋlla.

english_verse: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too. It Is Senseless To Be Wise
translation_verse: Ba bɩ faafaa nɩaa wɩaa ka liisi. Nɩalɩŋ ma ba ha sɩ jaŋ lʋl, nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ, ma paala bɩ jaŋ liisi ba wɩaa. Wʋjɩmɩŋ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ

english_verse: I said these things when I lived in Jerusalem as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ dagɛ nɩaa nɛ fa dii Iziral tinteeŋ kuoruŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I tried to understand everything that happens here on earth. And God has made this so hard for us humans to do.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa joŋ mɩ nyuŋ kala nɛ hɛ dɩ mɩ gʋnnɛ a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a chɛ na wɩɩkala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Chʋgʋ yuŋii nɛ Wɩa joŋo daŋ nuhuobiine nyuŋ.

english_verse: I have seen it all, and everything is just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Mɩ na dɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa lɛ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, ba nagɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ kiri peliŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo tʋrɛ kʋŋ sɩ golibo, dɩ kʋŋ nɛ tuo, ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsʋ.

english_verse: I said to myself, “You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.”
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩɩna mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Bee na, mɩ waa nɛ mɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ a kɩɩ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ mɩ lɛ a dii kuoruŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Mɩ gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa.”

english_verse: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ mɩ nyuŋ kala hɛ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ yaarɩŋ pɛgɛ, a jɩŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ chʋʋlʋŋ pɛgɛ. Ama mɩ na dɩ ŋɩɩ ma nagɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ kiri peliŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ, wɩaa yie faasa walɩmɩŋ nɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa ma kɩŋkɛŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ wɩaa ma yie wʋwɩɩŋ.

english_verse: I said to myself, “Have fun and enjoy yourself!” But this didn't make sense.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩɩna mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ ŋaa wɩaa a na sɩma-la sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ.” Ama mɩ na dɩ ŋɩɩ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ, “Mɔmʋŋ ŋaa nɩyaarɛ wɩɩ nɛ.” Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ kaa kʋkɔ?

english_verse: I wanted to find out what was best for us during the short time we have on this earth. So I decided to make myself happy with wine and find out what it means to be foolish, without really being foolish myself.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩɩna mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ arɩ mɩ nɛ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ mɩ yaraa jaŋ nyaasɛ dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, ka dɩ mɩ ha kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Mɩ faa chɛ dɩ mɩ na wɩɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ a magɛ dɩ nuhuobiine ŋaa tapʋlɩa-la baŋmɛnɛ, ʋ sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ daŋ nɛ: Mɩ saa dɩɩsɩŋ a bil girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I had flower gardens and orchards full of fruit trees.
translation_verse: Mɩ pɛrɛ ŋmaŋkaanɩŋ nɛ a chɔnsɛ tɩɩsɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ arɩ tɩɩ-dosunu-la nɛnɛɛ ba sɩɩ dii.

english_verse: And I had pools where I could get water for the trees.
translation_verse: Mɩ lu vilee a ŋaa ba lɩɩŋ hɩhɛ tɩɩ-daŋ-la.

english_verse: I owned slaves, and their sons and daughters became my slaves. I had more sheep and goats than anyone who had ever lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mɩ yɔɔ yosuŋ, baalaa arɩ haalaa a pɛ yosu-la ma ba sɩ lʋla mɩ dɩa lɛ. Mɩ bɩra kɛŋ nɛsɩŋ arɩ piesee a kɩɩ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Foreign rulers brought me silver, gold, and precious treasures. Men and women sang for me, and I had many wives who gave me great pleasure.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋa sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla chʋɔrɛ nɛ, aŋ laa dɔnsʋŋ ma kuoroo arɩ leree dɔnsʋŋ nɩaa teeŋ. Mɩ kɛŋ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa baalaa arɩ haalaa, mɩ kɛŋ haala-la kala baala sɩ yie cho dɩ ʋ kɛnɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I was the most famous person who had ever lived in Jerusalem, and I was very wise.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa nɩbal nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, a kɩɩ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ mɩ lɛ. Wɩaa deemba kala wʋjɩmɩŋ harɩŋ nɛ mɩ to.

english_verse: I got whatever I wanted and did whatever made me happy. But most of all, I enjoyed my work.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ kʋŋkala mɩ sɩɩŋ sɩ na a cho vɩa, mɩ bɩ mɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa vɩa. Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩ tɩma lɛ nɛ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ tɩŋŋaa kala time.

english_verse: Then I thought about everything I had done, including the hard work, and it was simply chasing the wind. Nothing on earth is worth the trouble. Wisdom Comes from God
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa bɩɩnɛ arɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ faasa tɩŋ a na kɩaa, mɩ na dɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa bɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kɛnɛ. Ʋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ kiri peliŋ nɛ, kʋŋkala bɩ nyʋʋrɩ kɛnɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ yaarɩŋ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ

english_verse: I asked myself, “What can the next king do that I haven't done?” Then I decided to compare wisdom with foolishness and stupidity.
translation_verse: Dɩ kuoro nɛ tuo ka dɩ nʋʋ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ, bɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa aŋ ka dee? Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ suomo kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, chʋʋlʋŋ arɩ yaarɩŋ wɩaa a bɩbɩɩnɛ.

english_verse: And I discovered that wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.
translation_verse: Mɩ na dɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ kpɩa yaarɩŋ, a nagɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ sɩ kpɩa birimiŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ na lee-la ʋ sɩɩ mʋ nɛ, ka nɩyaara-na vɩvɛŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ. Ama mɩ kʋ jɩŋ dɩ wʋbala nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ba kala lɛ ba dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: Finally, I said to myself, “Being wise got me nowhere! The same thing will happen to me that happens to fools. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɩyaarɩŋ lɛ nɛ, jaŋ ŋaa mɩ ma lɛ. Bɛɛ kʋŋ nyʋʋrʋŋ nɛ mɩ saa jaŋ na dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ?” Mɩ bɩra bʋl mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: This made me hate life. Everything we do is painful; it's just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ fɩɩ dʋnɩa wɩaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala la sɩɩ tɩŋ ŋaa hɛɛ nɛ mɩ teeŋ. Ʋ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, ʋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ kiri peliŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ tɩma lɔl a na dʋnɩa lɛ, mɩ bɩra bɩ ba cho, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ lemba pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ, dɩ mɩ nɛ tuo.

english_verse: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ ŋaa wʋjɩnnʋ koo nɩyaarɩ. Ka ʋ nɛ jaŋ dii kɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ kɛŋ mɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ faasa tɩma na dʋnɩa lɛ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I thought about all my hard work, and I felt depressed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ wɩɩmɛ, mɩ sɩ faasa tɩma lɔl ŋɩɩ dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine yie kɛŋ ʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, ʋ wɩaa sɩaa jɩmɩŋ arɩ ʋ jɩma kala a tɩma na kɩaa, aŋ leŋ kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ na pɩ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ tɩma chɛ kɩalɩŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, ʋ ŋaa naabɔŋ bal nɛ.

english_verse: What do we really gain from all of our hard work?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ nuhuobiine na, ʋ sɩ yie walɩmɛ ʋ tɩtɩa a faasa tɩma lɔl dʋnɩa lɛ?

english_verse: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ yie tɩŋ a na hɛɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ chei, tɩtaŋɩŋ ma ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩ leŋe ʋ wiwiesi. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us,
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine bɩ jaŋ wuo nɩɩ sɩma kala ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ, a pɛ ʋ sɩ na kɩaa dii aŋ nyʋa lɛ. Mɩ na dɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ tuo, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo na kɩaa dii koo a nɩɩ sɩma?

english_verse: If we please God, he will make us wise, understanding, and happy. But if we sin, God will make us struggle for a living, then he will give all we own to someone who pleases him. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Wɩa yie joŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, wɩaa sɩaa jɩmɩŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wɩaa a tʋtɔrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ama wʋbɔŋ ŋaara-na Wɩa yie leŋ ʋ tɩŋ nɛ a chɛ kɩaa tʋɔla bil, ʋ joŋo pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wɩaa a tʋtɔrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, ʋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ kiri peliŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Everything on earth has its own time and its own season.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ na-kala kɛŋ ʋ bʋa nɛ, wɩɩ na-kala sɩɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa lɛ kɛŋ bʋa-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɛ:

english_verse: There is also a time for love and hate, for war and peace. What God Has Given Us To Do
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɩaa sɩ jaŋ cho dɔŋɔ arɩ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ bɛrɛ dɔŋɔ. Bʋa-la lɛ nɩaa sɩ jaŋ yuo laalɩŋ arɩ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ.

english_verse: What do we gain by all our hard work?
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnna sɩ yie tɩma lɔl, bɛɛ nyʋʋrɩ nɛ ʋ yie na?

english_verse: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.
translation_verse: Mɩ na dɩ chʋgʋ yuŋŋii nɛ Wɩa joŋo daŋ nuhuobiine nyuŋ.

english_verse: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa kʋŋkala ʋ bʋa-la lɛ nɛ, a leŋ ʋ zɔŋ. Wɩa nɛ joŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ wuu tʋɔbɩɩnaa a pɩ nuhuobiine, aŋ bɩ leŋe ba chaasa jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa a chɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ dɩ-dɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: I know the best thing we can do is to always enjoy life,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jɩŋ dɩ nuhuobiine mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ kʋŋkala tuo a kpɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ arɩ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ.

english_verse: because God's gift to us is the happiness we get from our food and drink and from the work we do.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala maga dɩ ʋ dii aŋ nyʋa a nɩɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ tɩma na sɩma, Wɩa nɛ pʋ.

english_verse: Everything God has done will last forever; nothing he does can ever be changed. God has done all this, so that we will worship him.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma kʋŋkala Wɩa sɩ ŋaa jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Nʋʋ bɩ kʋŋ wuo kaa pɛ nʋʋ bɩ kʋŋ wuo kaa lɩɩsa ta ma. Wɩa ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ nɩaa fɩfáʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before, and all that will be has already been— God does everything over and over again. The Future Is Known Only to God
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, laa sɩpaaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ, wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa maachie, laa sɩpaaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ. Wɩa yie leŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa faafaa kala, bɩra ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩɩnɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Wɩa jaŋ dii tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kala sarɩya, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩɩkala kɛŋ bʋa nɛ, wʋŋaalɩɩ ma kala kɛŋ ba bʋa.”

english_verse: I know God is testing us to show us that we are merely animals.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra bɩɩnɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Wɩa ka magɩsɛ nuhuobiinee dɩ ʋ dagɛ arɩ ba ma nagɛ pʋsʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Like animals we breathe and die, and we are no better off than they are. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiinee arɩ pʋsʋŋ kala wɩɩŋ ŋaa kʋbala nɛ, wʋbala nɛ gbɛrɛ ba kala: Dɔŋɔ sɩɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ dɔŋɔ ma sʋsʋʋ. Ba kala ka wiesi nɛ. Nuhuobiine ma bɩ pʋna lɛ kpɩa, kʋŋkala bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.
translation_verse: Ba kalaa mʋ dɩ-bala nɛ, ba kala lɩɩ hagɩla lɛ nɛ, ba kala jaŋ bɩra bɩrɩmɛ hagɩla.

english_verse: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jɩma dɩ nuhuobiine dɩma ka jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ, aŋ ka pʋna kʋa tutuu tinteeŋ?”

english_verse: I looked again and saw people being mistreated everywhere on earth. They were crying, but no one was there to offer comfort, and those who mistreated them were powerful.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra beŋ, a na nɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ nyaga bil dʋnɩa lɛ: Mɩ na ŋɩɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nyaga bil sɩɩ yel sɩlɩɩrɩŋ, ka nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ nyagɛ ba bɔyɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyagɛba bil kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ, ka nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nyaga bil bɩ nʋʋ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ nyagɛ ba bɔyɛ.

english_verse: I said to myself, “The dead are better off than the living.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba nɛ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ ha sɩ weye.

english_verse: But those who have never been born are better off than anyone else, because they have never seen the terrible things that happen on this earth.”
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ kpɩa ba kala nɛ, nɩɩ-la ba ha sɩ bɩ lʋla, nɩɩ-la ha sɩ bɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa lɛ na.

english_verse: Then I realized that we work and do wonderful things just because we are jealous of others. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra na dɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala nɩaa sɩɩ tɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ yie na lɩɩ ba yaraa sɩɩ bieri ba dɔŋɔ nyuŋ nɛ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, ʋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ kiri peliŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ nɛ yie paa ʋ vaasɩŋ vɔɔ hɔŋ aŋ sʋʋ losuŋ.

english_verse: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ sɩ bɩ faasa lɔl, aŋ na kɩaa nɩsɩŋ sɩɩŋ nɛ kpɩa nʋʋ sɩ lɔlɔ kɩŋkɛŋ aŋ na kɩaa nɩsɩŋ sɩɩŋ bʋlɩa, tɩɩna nagɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ kiri peliŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ dɔŋ ma nɛ mɩ bɩra na dʋnɩa lɛ sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ:

english_verse: For example, some people don't have friends or family. But they are never satisfied with what they own, and they never stop working to get more. They should ask themselves, “Why am I always working to have more? Who will get what I leave behind?” What a senseless and miserable life! It Is Better To Have a Friend
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ ʋ dʋndʋŋ, ʋ bɩ bii kɛnɛ, ʋ bɩ naambii ma kɛnɛ, aŋ ka ʋ lɔlʋŋ fa bɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ sɩɩŋ fa bɩ ʋ dʋa ka su. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ lɔlɔ pɩpa, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ nɩɩ kɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ sɩma?” Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, tʋɔ-chei tɩntɩmɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.
translation_verse: Nɩaa balɩa nɛ kpɩa nɩbala, bɛɛ wɩaa dɩ ba nɛ gbaara tɩŋ, ba yie na kɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.
translation_verse: Dɩ dɔŋɔ nɛ tele, dɔŋɔ jaŋ wuo kɛnʋ dɩ ʋ sii. Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ tele aŋ bɩ nʋʋ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ sii, ŋɩɩ kɛŋ nenige nɛ.

english_verse: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa balɩa nɛ pɩna ma, baa tɔ dɔŋɔ waarɩŋ nɛ. Ama dɩ nɩbala nɛ pɩna, waarɩŋ jaŋ kɛnʋ.

english_verse: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, “A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.”
translation_verse: Nʋʋ jaŋ wuo ŋmoo nɩbala, ama dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa balɩa, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuoba. Ŋmɛŋ-biee batori bɩ ŋɩɩ lɩmaa kɛrɛ. Nyaaŋ arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ wɩaa

english_verse: You may be poor and young, but if you are wise, you are better off than a foolish old king who won't listen to advice.
translation_verse: Bapʋɔsɛ-bie sɩ nyaaba aŋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, ʋ nɛ kpɩa kuoro sɩ hɩɛsa aŋ yaarɛ a bɩra bɩ sɛɩ dɩ ba chagɩlʋ.

english_verse: Even if you were not born into the royal family and have been a prisoner and poor, you can still be king.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba lʋl bapʋɔsɛ-bie-la hɛ sunnuŋ lɛ nɛ koo dɩ ʋ lɩɩ bɩnɩŋ dɩa lɛ nɛ, ʋ jaŋ wuo dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.
translation_verse: Mɩ na dɩ nɩaa kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ ka to bapʋɔsɛ-bie kʋbala sɩ dii kuoruŋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: His followers could not even be counted. But years from now, no one will praise him—this makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Nɩaa fa yʋga a bɩ nii kɛnɛ a tuto ʋ harɩŋ. Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ to harɩŋ kɔ tʋɔŋ bɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ laa kuoru-la nyuŋ tɔrɔ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, ʋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ kiri peliŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Be careful what you do when you enter the house of God. Fools go there to offer sacrifices, because all they do is sin. But it's best just to listen when you go to worship.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ mʋ Wɩa dɩa, kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa woruŋ. Mʋ kpagɛ a jegile nɩɩ wɩaa woruŋ. Ʋ nɛ kpɩa ŋ sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nagɛ nɩyaaraa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, aŋ bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa ʋ bʋa lɛ dee ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Don't talk before you think or make promises to God without thinking them through. God is in heaven, and you are on earth, so don't talk too much.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ niiŋ lɩŋ, sɩ́ pese hɛ niiŋ Wɩa teeŋ. Wɩa hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, ka ŋ ma hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa sɩ́ wʋdaŋ bʋl.

english_verse: If you keep thinking about something, you will dream about it. If you talk too much, you will say the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Dɩ wʋwalɩmaa nɛ yʋga ŋ lɛ, ŋ jaŋ duduosi duosi bɔŋŋɔɔ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ bʋl wɩaa yʋgɛ, ŋ jaŋ bʋl nɩyaarɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: It's better not to make a promise at all than to make one and not keep it.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ niiŋ ta, ʋ nɛ kpɩa ŋ sɩ ta niiŋ aŋ bɩ lɩɩsa.

english_verse: Don't let your mouth get you in trouble! And don't say to the worship leader, “I didn't mean what I said.” God can destroy everything you have worked for, so don't say something that makes God angry.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa kɛnɩŋ hɛ wʋbɔmʋŋ lɛ. Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ bʋla pɩ Wɩa tɩntɩnna, “Nii-la mɩ sɩ ta, mɩ perige nɛ.” Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ wʋbʋlaa ŋaa dɩ Wɩa na baanɩŋ ŋ nyuŋ a chei ŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Respect and obey God! Daydreaming leads to a lot of senseless talk.
translation_verse: Tʋɔbɩɩnaa kɩŋkɛŋ arɩ wʋbʋl daŋ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ. Fɩfá Wɩa. Kɩaa kɛnɩŋ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ

english_verse: Don't be surprised if the poor of your country are abused, and injustice takes the place of justice. After all, the lower officials must do what the higher ones order them to do.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere ŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋ nɛ na dɩ ba nyagɛ summoo bil ma tinteeŋ lɛ, aŋ vɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba joŋo ŋaa ba lɛ ta, bɛɛ wɩaa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ kala kɛŋ nɩhɩaŋ nɛ ʋ bibenu. Ka ba kala ha kɛŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ ba bibemba.

english_verse: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ŋaa nʋʋkala kɩaa nɛ, kuoro ma tɩtɩa yie na kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ pɛrɛ nyʋʋrʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho moribiee bɩ moribiee ka vɔgɛ. Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ cho dʋa bɩ kɩaa ka vɔgɛ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.
translation_verse: Dɩ kɩaa nɛ pʋŋa pɛ, diiree ma yie pʋŋa pɛ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩba bɩ nyʋʋrɩ kala kɛnɛ, ʋ wɩɩŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ tuo bibeŋ.

english_verse: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnna doŋ pɩnɩŋ nɛ sɩma, dɩ ʋ dii kɩaa vɔgɛ koo dɩ ʋ bɩ vɔgɔ. Ama kɩaa tɩɩna dʋa bɩ leŋe ʋ pɩpɩŋ doŋ.

english_verse: I have seen something terribly unfair. People get rich, but it does them no good.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋ sɩ chaasa lɔrɛ nɛ mɩ na dʋnɩa lɛ: Kɩaa tɩɩna joŋ dʋa bil nɛ, ʋ bɩrɩmɛ ʋ nyu-bɔŋ.

english_verse: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.
translation_verse: Naabɔmʋŋ jʋʋ dʋa-la nɛ ʋ lɛl, ʋ bɩ kʋŋkala leŋe bil ʋ biiriŋ lɛ.
