english_verse: They came into this world naked, and when they die, they will be just as naked. They can't take anything with them, and they won't have anything to show for all their work.
translation_verse: Ba lʋl nuhuobiine arɩ yarɩ-biree nɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ jaŋ bɩra kaa mʋ. Ʋ bɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ tɩma na kʋŋkala wuo kaa pɛ mʋmʋ.

english_verse: That's terribly unfair. They leave the world just as they came. They gained nothing from running after the wind.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋ sɩ chaasa lɔrɛ nɛ: Nuhuobiine sɩ kɛŋ ŋɩɩ kɔ dʋnɩa, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra kaa mʋ. Ʋ bɩ nyʋʋrɩ kala na, ʋ lɔlɔ ta nɛ.

english_verse: Besides all this, they are always gloomy at mealtime, and they are troubled, sick, and bitter.
translation_verse: Ʋ na hɛɛŋ nɛ ʋ tapʋlaa kala lɛ, a kɛŋ tʋɔ-cheeŋ kɩŋkɛŋ, wʋwalɩmaa, ʋ baanɩŋ sisii arɩ nyanyalaa.

english_verse: What is the best thing to do in the short life God has given us? I think we should enjoy eating, drinking, and working hard. This is what God intends for us to do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jɩŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ a magɛ dɩ nuhuobiine dii aŋ nyʋa, a nɩɩ sɩma ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ tapʋlɩa-la baŋmɛnɛ Wɩa sɩ joŋo pʋ ʋ kaa tɩma lɔl dʋnɩa lɛ a na kɩalɩŋ. Ʋ kpaalɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Suppose you are very rich and able to enjoy everything you own. Then go ahead and enjoy working hard—this is God's gift to you.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ joŋ dʋa pɩ nuhuobiine dɩ ʋ kɛŋ kɩaa, a wuo leŋ ʋ nɩɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩma, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ ʋ sɩ nɩɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ tɩma na sɩma. Wɩa nɛ joŋo pʋ.

english_verse: God will keep you so happy that you won't have time to worry about each day.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ folo leŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ liliisi ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ tapʋlaa wɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: There is something else terribly unfair, and it troubles everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋ dɔŋɔ ma nɛ mɩ na dʋnɩa lɛ, ʋ yuŋŋie nɛ woruŋ a daŋ nuhuobiinee nyuŋ:

english_verse: God may give you everything you want—money, property, and wealth. Then God doesn't let you enjoy it, and someone you don't even know gets it all. That's senseless and terribly unfair!
translation_verse: Wɩa yie joŋ dʋa a pɩ nʋʋ ʋ kɛŋ kɩaa ba zizilu, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ kʋŋkala ʋ sɩ cho chɛ ka. Ama Wɩa yie bɩ leŋe ʋ nɩnɩɩ ba sɩma, ka nɩwogo mɩɩra nɩnɩɩ ba sɩma. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ sɩ chaasa lɔrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You may live a long time and have a hundred children. But a child born dead is better off than you, unless you enjoy life and have a decent burial.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ biiriŋ zɔlɔ a hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ jɩ-daŋ, ama ʋ sɩ diene ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ a magɛ ŋɩɩ ma kala, dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ wuo dii ʋ dʋa sɩma, ka ba bɩra bɩ ʋ woruŋ ma hugo, mɩ jaŋ bʋl arɩ bii-sʋʋŋ ba sɩ lʋla nɛ kpɩaʋ.

english_verse: That child will never live to see the sun or to have a name, and it will go straight to the world of darkness. But it will still find more rest than you,
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ na ma kala, a bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ, ʋ nɛ ha na wiese a kɩɩ nɩɩ-la,

english_verse: even if you live two thousand years and don't enjoy life. As you know, we all end up in the same place.
translation_verse: dɩ nɩɩ-la nɛ paala hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ jɩsɩŋ bʋɩ balɩa ma, aŋ bɩ wuo nɩɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ sɩma, dɩ-bala nɛ ba kala mʋmʋ.

english_verse: We struggle just to have enough to eat, but we are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine yie tɩtɩŋ dɩ ʋ na kɩaa nɛ a dii, ama ʋ ha bɩ vɔgɛ.

english_verse: We may be sensible, yet we are no better off than a fool. And if we are poor, it still doesn't do us any good to try to live right.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ wʋjɩnna kaa kpɩa nɩyaarɩŋ lɛ? Bɛɛ kʋŋ nyʋʋrɩ nɛ summo sɩ jɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kɛnɩŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ yie na?

english_verse: It's better to enjoy what we have than to always want something else, because that makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ sɩɩŋ nɛ su kʋ-la ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ nɛ kpɩa ŋ sɩɩ hɩɛnɛ kʋŋ ŋ sɩ bɩ kɛnɛ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, ʋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩɩ kiri peliŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Everything that happens was decided long ago. We humans know what we are like, and we can't argue with God, because he is too strong for us.
translation_verse: Kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ laa sɩpaaŋ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ, la kala jɩŋ ŋɩɩ nuhuobiine sɩ naga nɛ. Ŋ dɩ nʋʋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩŋ bɩ kaalɛrɛ wuo kɛŋ.

english_verse: The more we talk, the less sense we make, so what good does it do to talk?
translation_verse: Wʋbʋl kɩŋkɛŋ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, ŋɩɩ saa bɩ nyʋʋrɩ kɛnɛ nʋʋkala teeŋ.

english_verse: Life is short and meaningless, and it fades away like a shadow. Who knows what is best for us? Who knows what will happen after we are gone?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ a pɩ nuhuobiine, ʋ sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ tapʋlɩa-la baŋmɛnɛ sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, a bɩbal a nagɛ daaliimiŋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ nɛ lɩɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ?

english_verse: A good reputation at the time of death is better than loving care at the time of birth.
translation_verse: Yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ nɛ kpɩa tʋlaalɩ-zɔmʋŋ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la nʋʋ sɩ sʋba nɛ kpɩa tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ lʋlʋ.

english_verse: It's better to go to a funeral than to attend a feast; funerals remind us that we all must die.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ sɩ mʋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yel nɛ kpɩa nʋʋ sɩ mʋ lee-la ba sɩ dii kɩaa a gbigbieli, bɛɛ wɩaa sʋʋŋ ŋaa nuhuobiiŋ kala kʋŋ nɛ. Nʋʋkala sɩ weye maga dɩ ʋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Choose sorrow over laughter because a sad face may hide a happy heart.
translation_verse: Tʋɔ-cheeŋ nɛ kpɩa mɔmʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa tʋɔ-cheeŋ jaŋ wuo leŋ nɩaa gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: Correction from someone wise is better by far than praise from fools.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna sɩ kpɩa ŋ lɛ, ʋ nɛ kpɩa ŋ nɩyaarɩŋ sɩ bɛsɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Foolish laughter is stupid. It sounds like thorns crackling in a fire.
translation_verse: A nagɛ ba sɩ joŋ sɔsʋŋ hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ ba pʋpɔsɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩyaarɩŋ mɔmʋŋ nagɛ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Corruption makes fools of sensible people, and bribes can ruin you.
translation_verse: Gɩrɩma dii nɛ yie leŋ wʋjɩnna bɩrɩmɛ nɩyaarɩŋ. Kpalaa laanɩŋ ka chei nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Something completed is better than something just begun; patience is better than too much pride.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ kpɩa ʋ dɩ-suomuŋ, kenyiri ma nɛ kpɩa babii-ballɩŋ.

english_verse: Only fools get angry quickly and hold a grudge.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ guu nɩna baanɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩyaarɩŋ nɛ yie guu na baanɩŋ.

english_verse: It isn't wise to ask, “Why is everything worse than it used to be?”
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ wʋjɩŋ wɩɩ ŋaa dɩ ŋ pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ faafaa kpɩa lɛɛlɛ?”

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you just like money; knowledge with good sense will lead you to life.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ wuo pɔŋ a nagɛ moribiee sɩ jaŋ wuo pɔŋ ŋɩɩ. Ama wʋjɩmɩŋ wɩɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ yie pɔ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛnʋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Think of what God has done! If God makes something crooked, can you make it straight?
translation_verse: Kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa a bɩɩna na. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ kʋŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa ʋ golibi a tʋrɛ?

english_verse: When times are good, you should be cheerful; when times are bad, think about what it means. God makes them both to keep us from knowing what will happen next. Some of Life's Questions
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩaa nɛ vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩŋ, leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, ama dɩ wɩaa nɛ bɩra lɔrɔ ma, kaa bɩɩna na. Wɩa nɛ ŋaa ba kala. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nuhuobiine bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩkala a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ chiemiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I have seen everything during this senseless life of mine. I have seen good citizens die for doing the right thing, while criminals live and prosper.
translation_verse: Mɩ na wɩaa deemba kala nɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ lɛ mɩ sɩ hɛ: Mɩ na dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna sɩɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa aŋ buuro sʋʋ, a bɩra na nɩbɔmʋŋ ma sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ ha hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ a dieni.

english_verse: Don't die before your time by being too evil or acting like a fool.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ faasa ŋaa nɩbɔŋ a bɩra sɩ́ nɩyaarɩ ma ŋaa. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ chɛ dɩ ŋ sʋʋ, dɩ ŋ sʋʋŋ bɩ yie?

english_verse: Keep to the middle of the road. You can do this if you truly respect God.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ hɛ wɩaa deemba balɩa pɛgɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ fá Wɩa nɛ jaŋ wuo lɩɩ ba kala lɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom will make you stronger than the ten most powerful leaders in your city.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ yie leŋ wʋjɩnna kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩ nɩduoruŋ fii sɩɩ beŋ tabalɩŋ.

english_verse: Don't listen to everything that everyone says, or you might hear your servant cursing you.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ wɩɩkala nɩaa sɩɩ bʋl jegilu, ŋɩɩ dee ŋ jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ ŋ tɩntɩnna bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I told myself that I would be smart and try to understand all this, but it was too much for me.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ a kaa magɩsɛ wɩaa deemba kala na a bʋl: Mɩ faa chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋjɩnnʋ nɛ, ama wɩɩŋ deeŋ kɩɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The truth is beyond us. It's far too deep.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ bolie, a luŋ ma. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ?

english_verse: So I decided to learn everything I could and become wise enough to discover what life is all about. At the same time, I wanted to understand why it's stupid and senseless to be an evil fool.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ mɩ nyuŋ hɛ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa, a gbille chɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ mɩ na ŋɩɩ wɩaa sɩɩ vɛŋ, a bɩra chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ bɔnsʋŋ sɩ naga arɩ ŋɩɩ chʋʋlʋŋ sɩ naga.

english_verse: Here is what I discovered: A bad woman is worse than death. She is a trap, reaching out with body and soul to catch you. But if you obey God, you can escape. If you don't obey, you are done for.
translation_verse: Mɩ na dɩ ha-bɔmʋŋ nɛ bɔmɔ kɩɩ sʋʋŋ, Ʋ nagɛ bɛrɛ nɛ. Ʋ nɩsɩŋ nagɛ chɔrʋmɔɔ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la wʋŋaalaa sɩ tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ fori ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ama wʋbɔŋ ŋaara-na ʋ jaŋ bɛrɛ kɛnʋ.

english_verse: but so far I have not been able to. I do know there is one good man in a thousand, but never have I found a good woman.
translation_verse: mɩ haa gbillu nɛ, ama mɩ ha bɩ ba sɩaa na. Mɩ na dɩ nɩaa bʋɩ tʋɔŋ ba-bala dʋndʋŋ nɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ. Ama ha-bala ma tuo ba kala tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: I did learn one thing: We were completely honest when God created us, but now we have twisted minds.
translation_verse: Wʋbala-la mɩ sɩ na nɛ ŋ la: Wɩa ŋaa nuhuobiine ʋ tʋʋlɛ nɛ. Ama ʋ mɩɩra kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a kperi nɛ.”

english_verse: Who is smart enough to explain everything? Wisdom makes you cheerful and gives you a smile. Obey the King
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nagɛ wʋjɩnnʋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo chaarɛ wɩaa sɩaa woruŋ? Wʋjɩmɩŋ yie leŋ nɩa sɩaa chaanɛ nɛ, a kɛŋ tɩɩna sɩɩ-nyalaa bɩrɩmɛ. To kuoro niiŋ

english_verse: If you promised God that you would be loyal to the king, I advise you to keep that promise.
translation_verse: To kuoro wʋdagaa, a tɩŋ nii-la ŋ sɩ ta Wɩa sɩpaaŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Don't quickly oppose the king or argue when he has already made up his mind.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ pipesu dɩ ŋ sii kuoro sɩpaaŋ. Sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ harɩŋ chɩna lɛ pɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ cho.

english_verse: The king's word is law. No one can ask him, “Why are you doing this?”
translation_verse: Kuoro nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ?”

english_verse: If you obey the king, you will stay out of trouble. So be wise and learn what to do and when to do it.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ to ʋ wʋdagaa bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ wɩɩ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ jɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaaʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Life is hard, but there is a time and a place for everything,
translation_verse: Wɩɩkala kɛŋ bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga dɩ ba ŋaaʋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaaʋ nɛ. Ama wʋjʋʋlaa nyagɛ nuhuobiine kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: though no one can tell the future.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ maachie jɩŋ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ?

english_verse: We cannot control the wind or determine the day of our death. There is no escape in time of war, and no one can hide behind evil.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ wuo kɛŋ peliŋ bil. Nʋʋkala bɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ doluŋ kɛnɛ. Laalɩŋ tapʋlʋŋ nʋʋkala bɩ fori, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma bɩ jaŋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaaba ta.

english_verse: I noticed all this and thought seriously about what goes on in the world. Why does one person have the power to hurt another? Who Can Understand the Ways of God?
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ na wɩaa deemba kala, mɩ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa lɛ kaa chɔ na. Bʋa dɔŋɔ nʋʋ yie kɛŋ doluŋ nɩaa nyuŋ a bibemba, a leŋ ba nɩna hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: I saw the wicked buried with honor, but God's people had to leave the holy city and were forgotten. None of this makes sense.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra na dɩ ba paa nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɩɩ lee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ a kaa mʋ sʋʋnʋŋ dɩ-huguŋ a hugi. Nɩaa bɩbɛsɛ ba lɛ tabal-la lɛ tɩtɩa ba sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: When we see criminals commit crime after crime without being punished, it makes us want to start a life of crime.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ bɩ nʋʋ sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ dɔgʋsɔ lɩma, nɩaa yie bɩbɩɩnɛ ba ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They commit hundreds of crimes and live a long time, in spite of the saying: Everyone who lives right and respects God will prosper,
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ zɔlɔ aŋ ha hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ a dieni, mɩ jɩma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fá Wɩa a zizilu, ba-na wɩaa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ pɩba.

english_verse: There is something else that doesn't make sense to me. Good citizens are treated as criminals, while criminals are honored as though they were good citizens.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ dɔŋ ma nɛ bɩra ŋaa dʋnɩa lɛ a bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ: Ba yie joŋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ time a tiŋ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa lɛ, aŋ joŋ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa time a tiŋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Mɩ sɩ, wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: So I think we should get as much out of life as we possibly can. There is nothing better than to enjoy our food and drink and have a good time. Then we can make it through this troublesome life that God has given us here on earth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩɩnɛ arɩ nuhuobiine mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ ʋ maga ʋ dii aŋ nyʋa nɛ a nɩɩ sɩma dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa kʋŋkala bɩra tuo dʋnɩa lɛ a kpɩa ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ jaŋ hɛ ʋ teeŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala ʋ sɩɩ tɩŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ tapʋlɩa-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pʋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Day and night I went without sleep, trying to understand what goes on in this world.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ joŋ mɩ nyuŋ hɛ dɩ mɩ gbilli wʋjɩmɩŋ, aŋ-na tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala nɩaa sɩɩ tɩŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, mɩ bɩ doŋ wuo pɩŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala.

english_verse: I saw everything God does, and I realized no one can really understand what happens. We may be very wise, but no matter how much we try or how much we claim to know, we cannot understand it all.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na dɩ wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ ŋaa, nʋʋkala tuo sɩ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ sɩaa. Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ walɩmɛ dɩ ʋ jɩŋ ma, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ. Dɩ wʋjɩnnʋ kala nɛ paala bʋl dɩ ʋ jɩma ma, ʋ bɩ wuo chaasaa jɩŋ.

english_verse: I thought about these things. Then I understood that God has power over everyone, even those who are wise and live right. Anything can happen to any one of us, and so we never know if life will be good or bad.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ kɛŋ wɩaa deemba kala a bɩɩnɛ, ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ mɩ na dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa arɩ wʋjɩnnaa arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ ŋaa hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ama nʋʋkala bɩ jɩŋ dɩ chonuŋ nɛ koo dɩ bɛrɩŋ nɛ ba kaa gbɛrʋ.

english_verse: But exactly the same thing will finally happen to all of us, whether we live right and respect God or sin and don't respect God. Yes, the same thing will happen if we offer sacrifices to God or if we don't, if we keep our promises or are afraid to make them.
translation_verse: Sʋʋŋ nɛ la kala dɩdɛrɩŋ, tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ, wʋzɔŋ ŋaaraa arɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a sʋsʋl Wɩa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa. Ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ naga wʋzɔŋ ŋaara lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ nagɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaara ma lɛ. Ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ naga nɩalɩŋ sɩ ta niiŋ Wɩa teeŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ nagɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ fá fawʋllʋŋ a bɩ ta lɛ.

english_verse: It's terribly unfair for the same thing to happen to each of us. We are mean and foolish while we live, and then we die.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa lɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-cheeŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Wʋbala nɛ sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ la kala mʋ. Nuhuobiinee tʋɔŋ lɔrɔ kɩŋkɛŋ ba bɩbɩɩnɛ nyɩnyɛ wɩaa ba mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ba sʋʋ.

english_verse: As long as we are alive, we still have hope, just as a live dog is better off than a dead lion.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ weye kɛŋ yɩɛlaa, a nagɛ va-weiŋ sɩ kpɩa naachigi-sʋʋŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: We know we will die, but the dead don't know a thing. Nothing good will happen to them—they are gone and forgotten.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ weye jɩma dɩ ba jaŋ sʋʋ, ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba-na bɩ wɩɩ jɩŋ. Ba bɩra bɩ time kɛnɛ baa yɩɛlɛ, nɩaa paala yʋ ba wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Their loves, their hates, and their jealous feelings have all disappeared with them. They will never again take part in anything that happens on this earth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ ba sɩ cho nɩaa, ŋɩɩ ba sɩ bɛrɛ nɩaa arɩ ba yarɩ-bieriŋ kala lɛlɛ nɛ. Ba-na bɩra bɩ jaŋ pɛ wɩɩ na-kala sɩɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: So be happy and enjoy eating and drinking! God decided long ago that this is what you should do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dii kɩaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, a nyʋa kɩaa a nɩɩ sɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa sɩ cho dɩ ŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la nɛ ŋɩɩ lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: Dress up, comb your hair, and look your best.
translation_verse: Ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ tɔrɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ bʋa-kala lɛ.

english_verse: Life is short, and you love your wife, so enjoy being with her. This is what you are supposed to do as you struggle through life on this earth.
translation_verse: Leŋ ŋ dɩ ŋ haala sɩ cho nɩɩ sɩma ma mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ lɛ, tapʋlɩa-la kala Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩ ma dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Má nɩɩ sɩma tapʋlɩa-la kala sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ toruŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ tɩma lɔl a na dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Work hard at whatever you do. You will soon go to the world of the dead, where no one works or thinks or reasons or even knows anything.
translation_verse: Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala ŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ, fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a faasa tɩmʋ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni ka ŋ mʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ, lee-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ tɩŋ, a bɩ wɩaa ka bɩɩnɛ, a bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ, a bɩ wɩaa sɩaa ma jɩŋ.

english_verse: Here is something else I have learned: The fastest runners and the greatest heroes don't always win races and battles. Wisdom, intelligence, and skill don't always make you healthy, rich, or popular. We each have our own share of misfortune.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ dɔŋ ma nɛ mɩ bɩra na dʋnɩa lɛ: Naachɛ-lɩmɩŋ tɩɩna dee bɩ fá didii, nɩduoŋ ma dee bɩ laalɩŋ yuo didii. Wʋjɩnna dee bɩ kʋdiilee na didii bʋa-kala, nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa ma dee bɩ dʋa ka kɛŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ jɩma yie bɩ lere-la sɩ maga dɩ ba jomba hɛ ka na, ama nyu-sɩmɩŋ ka puu nʋʋkala nɛ.

english_verse: None of us know when we might fall victim to a sudden disaster and find ourselves like fish in a net or birds in a trap. Better To Be Wise than Foolish
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ sʋʋŋ tapʋlʋŋ jɩŋ. Ʋ nagɛ jóŋ sɩ yie kɛŋ chenfiliŋ nɛ, koo ba sɩ bɛrɛ kɛŋ diibie. Ŋɩɩ nɛ wʋbɔmʋŋ bʋa ma nagɛ nuhuobiine lɛ, ʋ yie guu jʋʋba dɩ ba bɩ yɩɛla. Wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ kpɩa yaarɩŋ

english_verse: Once I saw what people really think of wisdom, and it made an impression on me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ dɔŋ ma nɛ mɩ bɩra na dʋnɩa lɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ ʋ sɩma pɩmɛ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: It happened when a powerful ruler surrounded and attacked a small city where only a few people lived. The enemy army was getting ready to break through the city walls.
translation_verse: Tabie kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, ʋ nɩaa bɩ yʋgɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoru-duo kʋbala sii kɔ dɩ ʋ yuou, a leŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo gollu chu a saa laalɩyuori vaŋkumba dɩ ba jʋʋ.

english_verse: But the city was saved by the wisdom of a poor person who was soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal kʋbala ma hɛ taŋ-la lɛ a nyaabɛ aŋ jɩŋ wɩaa. Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la laa taŋ-la ta. Ama nʋʋkala bɩ nyaabʋ-la wɩaa liise.

english_verse: So I decided that wisdom is better than strength. Yet if you are poor, no one pays any attention to you, no matter how smart you are.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ kpɩa doluŋ.” Ama nʋʋkala bɩ nyaabɩ-la wʋjɩmɩɩ-la joŋo dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋŋ, ba bɩ wɩalɩŋ ma ʋ sɩ bʋla jegile nɩɩ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom spoken softly make much more sense than the shouts of a ruler to a crowd of fools.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ jegile nɩɩ wʋjɩnna sɩ fɩɛla bʋl wɩɩŋ, ʋ nɛ kpɩa nɩyaaraa kuoro sɩɩ kpɩa goŋ.

english_verse: Wisdom is more powerful than weapons, yet one mistake can destroy all the good you have done.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ kpɩa laalɩyuori kɩaa, ama wʋbɔŋ ŋaarɩ bala yie chei wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ yʋgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: A few dead flies in perfume make all of it stink, and a little foolishness outweighs a lot of wisdom.
translation_verse: Nanchʋɔsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ hɛ tʋlaalɩ lɛ dɩ ʋ sʋɔra lɔrɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ yaarɩŋ mʋa jaŋ wuo chei wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ zile.

english_verse: Sensible thoughts lead you to do right; foolish thoughts lead you to do wrong.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna tʋɔbɩɩnaa yie kɛnʋ tʋʋlɛ nɛ ʋ ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ. Ama nɩyaarɩŋ-na tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala nɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋlɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Fools show their stupidity by the way they live; it's easy to see they have no sense.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ paala vɛŋ wombiiŋ lɛ, ʋ yie ŋaa nɩyaarɩ wɩaa nɛ a dagɛ nʋʋkala arɩ ʋ yaara nɛ.

english_verse: Don't give up your job when your boss gets angry. If you stay calm, you'll be forgiven.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma kuoro nɛ na baanɩŋ ŋ nyuŋ, sɩ́ ŋ dɩchɩnɩŋ vɩa. Dɩ ŋ nɛ tɔrɛ ŋ niiŋ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ wɩɩ-la fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: Rulers do some things that are terribly unfair:
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋ nɛ mɩ na dʋnɩa lɛ, kuoro sɩ ŋaa wɩaa piperigi:

english_verse: They honor fools, but dishonor the rich;
translation_verse: Ba sɩ joŋ nɩyaaraa hɛ dɩ-balaa aŋ joŋ kɩaa tɩŋŋaa hɛ dɩ-biisiŋ.

english_verse: they let slaves ride on horses, but force slave owners to walk.
translation_verse: Mɩ na yosuŋ dɩ ba jɩl janɩŋ, ka kuori biiriŋ vɩvɛŋ naasɩŋ lɛ a nagɛ yosi.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you might fall in; if you break down a wall, a snake might bite you.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ lu buotuoŋ jaŋ foro tuu, nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ yigi jeeŋ lo, dɩmɩŋ jaŋ dɩmʋ.

english_verse: You could even get hurt by chiseling a stone or chopping a log.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ yɛrɛ tabɩaa, ba jaŋ wuo pɩrʋ. Nɩɩ-kala sɩɩ yɛrɛ daasɩŋ, ba nɛ jaŋ wuo pɩrʋ.

english_verse: If you don't sharpen your ax, it will be harder to use; if you are wise, you'll know what to do.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ saaŋ nɛ gbule ka ŋ bɩ taa, see dɩ ŋ faasa hɛ doluŋ ka dɩ ʋ-na wuo keri kʋa. Ama wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ jaŋ wori wɩɩŋ.

english_verse: The power to charm a snake does you no good if it bites you anyway.
translation_verse: Dɩ dɩmɩŋ nɛ dɩmɩŋ, ka dɩ ŋ-na ŋaa dɩ ʋ bugumi, nɩɩ-la sɩ bugumu bɩ nyʋʋrɩ kala na.

english_verse: If you talk sensibly, you will have friends; if you talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna wʋbʋlaa yie leŋ ba zilu nɛ, ama nɩyaarɩŋ-na wʋbʋlaa yie chei ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: Fools begin with nonsense, and their stupid chatter ends with disaster.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ yie suomo bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ nɛ, ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ ʋ bʋl wʋyaayasɩŋ.

english_verse: They never tire of talking, but none of us really know what the future will bring.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ nɛ yie bʋbʋl wɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ. Nʋʋkala bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa chie, nʋʋkala bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ sʋʋŋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: Fools wear themselves out— they don't know enough to find their way home.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ yie tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a bɛsɩmɛ nɛ, ʋ paala bɩ dɩa wombiiŋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: A country is in for trouble when its ruler is childish, and its leaders party all day long.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu tintee-la nɩaa kuoro sɩ nagɛ ŋaa bii-bie, ba sɩpaalaaraa ma ŋaa nɩaa sɩ yie sii chʋchʋɔ fɩɛla kala dɩ ba niiŋ chɔgɩlɛ kʋdiile lɛ.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to fix a leaky roof— then the house collapses.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ yarɩwɩɩŋ a bɩ ʋ dɩa nyuŋ ka beŋ, ʋ jaŋ chuori a tel.

english_verse: Eating and drinking make you feel happy, and money can buy everything you need.
translation_verse: Kʋdiilee nɛ yie leŋ nɩa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, kʋnyʋalaa ma leŋ nɩaa mʋmɔŋ, ama moribiee nɛ kɛmba kala kʋkɔ.

english_verse: Don't let yourself think about cursing the king; don't curse the rich, not even in secret. A little bird might hear and tell everything.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ bʋl a tɩgɛ kuoro lɛ, koo a bʋl wʋbɔŋ a tɩgɛ kɩaa tɩɩna lɛ ŋ dɩpɩnɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa diibie jaŋ wuo kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ mʋ bʋl. Fillu dɔŋ ma jaŋ wuo mʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: Be generous, and someday you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Ŋaa ŋ kɩaa a kpaa, tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ pɛgɛ ŋ jaŋ bɩra naba.

english_verse: Share what you have with seven or eight others, because you never know when disaster may strike.
translation_verse: Ŋaa kpaa nɩaa balɩpɛ, koo chori, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ bɩ jɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la wʋlɔrʋŋ sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: If you worry about the weather and don't plant seeds, you won't harvest a crop.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ beŋ ŋɩɩ leriŋ sɩ naga bɩ jaŋ wuo duu kʋŋ koo a kʋŋ kɩaa.

english_verse: No one can explain how a baby breathes before it is born. So how can anyone explain what God does? After all, God created everything.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ bɩ peliŋ wombiiŋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ koo ŋɩɩ ba sɩ mɛ nuhuobiine ʋ naaŋ luoruŋ tʋɔŋ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ Wɩa wʋŋaalaa. Wɩa nɛ ŋaa kʋŋkala.

english_verse: Plant your seeds early in the morning and keep working in the field until dark. Who knows? Your work might pay off, and your seeds might produce. Youth and Old Age
translation_verse: Duu ŋ kɩaa chʋchʋɔŋ, dɩdaanɩŋ ma sɩ́ pɛɩ hɔŋ. Ŋ bɩ jɩŋ ba kʋ-la sɩ jaŋ wasɛ, dɩ dɔŋɔ nɛ jaŋ wasɛ a kɩɩ dɔŋɔ koo, dɩ ba kala nɛ jaŋ wasɛ magɛ dɔŋɔ. Liisi La Tɩɩna wɩaa ŋ hambiriŋ lɛ

english_verse: Nothing on earth is more beautiful than the morning sun.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ la na pʋlʋmʋŋ, ʋ ŋaa tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩɩ nɛ dɩ la hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Even if you have a very long life, you should try to enjoy each day, because darkness will come and will last a long time. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Jɩsɩŋ magɛ ŋɩɩ na-kala nuhuobiine sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ nɩɩ ba kala sɩma nɛ. Ama ʋ maga dɩ ʋ liise yi ʋ sʋʋŋ tapʋlaa lɛ nɛ, ba nɛ jaŋ dieni a kɩɩ ʋ sɩ weye. Wɩɩkala bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Be cheerful and enjoy life while you are young! Do what you want and find pleasure in what you see. But don't forget that God will judge you for everything you do.
translation_verse: Bapʋɔsɛ bie, leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ bapʋɔsʋŋ lɛ, nɩɩ sɩma ŋ hambiriŋ lɛ. Ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ arɩ wɩɩ na-kala ŋ sɩ na, ama jɩŋ dɩ wɩaa deemba kala ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ Wɩa jaŋ diiŋ sarɩya.

english_verse: Rid yourself of all worry and pain, because the wonderful moments of youth quickly disappear.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩɩkala walɩmɩŋ, wɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ wɩɩŋ, joŋo ta, bɛɛ wɩaa hambiriŋ arɩ bapʋɔsɛ doluŋ bɩ dieni.

english_verse: Keep your Creator in mind while you are young! In years to come, you will be burdened down with troubles and say, “I don't enjoy life anymore.”
translation_verse: Ŋ bapʋɔsʋŋ lɛ, liise yi Wɩa sɩ ŋaaŋ lɛ, ka dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la wɩaa sɩ jaŋ jʋʋŋ-na yi, ka dɩ jɩsɩ-la sɩ jaŋ yi dɩ ŋ bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ sɩma kala nɩa.”

english_verse: Someday the light of the sun and the moon and the stars will all seem dim to you. Rain clouds will remain over your head.
translation_verse: Liisi ʋ wɩaa ka dɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ, chɛnɛ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa-na biri ŋ sɩaa lɛ, dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ aŋ ha nagɛ ʋ tɩna ŋ sɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: The noisy grinding of grain and the voices of singers will be shut out by your deaf ears, but even the song of a bird will keep you awake.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋ dɩgɩlaa tɔ a bɩra bɩ goŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa wombiiŋ lɛ ka nɩɩ, a bɩ ba sɩɩ nɔŋ kɩaa dɔmʋŋ ma ka nɩɩ, kɩaa chɩɩrɩŋ jaŋ chɩsɩŋ doŋ lɛ ama ŋ bɩ diibiisiŋ yele ka nɩɩ.

english_verse: You will be afraid to climb up a hill or walk down a road. Your hair will turn as white as almond blossoms. You will feel lifeless and drag along like an old grasshopper. We each go to our eternal home, and the streets here are filled with those who mourn.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ fɩfá dundolluŋ jɩlɩŋ, dɩ ŋ vɛnɩŋ ŋaa wʋduo, ŋ nyuŋ jaŋ pʋllɛ, dɩ ŋ bɩra bɩ ŋ tɩtɩa wuo lɛrɛɛ vɛŋ, dɩ ŋ kʋchooloo kala lɛl. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ nuhuobiine jaŋ mʋ ʋ dɩ-wiesiŋ, dɩ nɩaa yiyel wombiee lɛ.

english_verse: The silver cord snaps, the golden bowl breaks; the water pitcher is smashed, and the pulley at the well is shattered.
translation_verse: Liisi Wɩa wɩaa ka dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ sɩ nagɛ hɔpʋla banzɔlɔ-na kɛrɛ, dɩ ŋ sɛlɩmɛ chaanɩŋ tele yɛrɛ, dɩ ŋ gʋʋga ŋmɛnɩŋ kɛrɛ, dɩ ŋ lɩɩŋ pupoiŋ ma tele yɛrɛ muno muno.

english_verse: So our bodies return to the earth, and the life-giving breath returns to God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nuhuobiine jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ hagɩla a gʋra jʋʋ tintee-la ba sɩ lɔgɔ mɛʋ, ka ʋ wiese mɩɩra mʋ Wɩa teeŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋu hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense. Respect and Obey God
translation_verse: Wɩɩkala bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, wɩɩkala bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa a dɩdagɛ nɩaa nɛ bʋla: Wɩɩkala bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I was a wise teacher with much understanding, and I collected a number of proverbs that I had carefully studied.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagɛ nɩaa fa kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, a joŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ jɩma a dagɛ nɩaa. Ʋ chaasa hɔnɔ bɩɩnɛ wɩaa nɛ aŋ magɛ namagaba ba lɩɩ aŋ ka pɩ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are like the stick a farmer uses to make animals move. These sayings come from a shepherd, and they are like nails that fasten things together.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ wʋjɩnna sɩ bʋla nagɛ daaŋ niiŋ sɩ ŋaa chʋla chʋla nɛ, kʋdaaraa kori a kaa daa pʋsʋŋ. Namagaba-la ba sɩ kaa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ ka dienu a nagɛ ba sɩ joŋ hɛŋŋɛɛ ŋmoo hɛ kʋa lɛ ʋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ nɛ. Wɩa nɛ joŋo pɩla, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ daa la kala.

english_verse: My child, I warn you to stay away from any teachings except these. There is no end to books, and too much study will wear you out.
translation_verse: Mɩ nanʋala, wɩɩ dɔŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa arɩ wɩɩ-la: Teniŋ ŋmʋnsʋŋ bɩ dɩdɛrɩ kɛnɛ, dɩ ŋ nɛ gʋnnɛ wɩaa ma kɩŋkɛŋ ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ kɔsɛ.

english_verse: Everything you were taught can be put into a few words: Respect and obey God! This is what life is all about.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala dɩdɛrɩŋ, wʋbala nɛ mɩ kɛŋ dɩ mɩ bʋl: Fɩfá Wɩa a tuto wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ Wɩa ta nuhuobiine.

english_verse: God will judge everything we do, even what is done in secret, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ dii la sarɩya wɩɩ na-kala la sɩ ŋaa lɛ, dɩ ba ŋaa wʋzɔmɔ koo wʋbɔmɔ, a pɛ wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ lʋara ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: This is Solomon's most beautiful song. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Solomoŋ yɩɩlaa tʋɔŋ yɩɩl-sɩmɩŋ. Haala

english_verse: and you smell so sweet. All the young women adore you; the very mention of your name is like spreading perfume. *
translation_verse: Ŋ tʋlaalɩ sʋɔra sɩma nɛ woruŋ. Ŋ yɩrɩŋ sɩma a nagɛ ba sɩ bɩsɛ tʋlaalɩ ta ʋ sʋsʋɔrɛ nɛ, daŋkʋnɛ, hatoloo kala choŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Hurry, my king! Let's hurry. Take me to your home. The Young Women Speak: We are happy for you! And we praise your love even more than wine. She Speaks: Young women of Jerusalem, it is only right that you should adore him.
translation_verse: Pɛ kɛmmɛ mʋ, leŋ la ŋaa lɩma. Leŋ dɩ kuoro kɛmmɛ jʋʋ ʋ dɩpɩnɩŋ. Tanlɔsʋŋ Laa jʋɔsɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ, la tʋɔŋ ma tɔrɛ ŋ nyuŋ. La jaŋ bɛsɛ ŋ chonuŋ lɛ a kɩɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ. Haala Ba kɩaa sɩma nɛ a magɛ dɩ ba bɛsɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: My skin is dark and beautiful, like a tent in the desert or like Solomon's curtains.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm toloo, mɩ yaraa bire nɛ, ama mɩ zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ. Mɩ bire a nagɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Keda lɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ, a bɩra bire nagɛ Solomoŋ kuoru dɩa patɩɩsamba.

english_verse: Don't stare at me just because the sun has darkened my skin. My brothers were angry with me; they made me work in the vineyard, and so I neglected my complexion.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ sɩaa chaara pɛ mɩ lɛ ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ mɩ yaraa sɩ bire wɩaa, a tɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ biri wɩaa. Mɩ naambiiriŋ na baanɩŋ nɛ mɩ nyuŋ a leŋ mɩ bibeŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ, aŋ vɩa mɩ tɩtɩa girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga ta.

english_verse: My darling, I love you! Where do you feed your sheep and let them rest at noon? Don't let the other shepherds think badly of me. I'm not one of those women who shamelessly follow after shepherds. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩ-chooluŋ, dagɛmɛ lee-la ŋ sɩ kɛŋ ŋ piesee mʋ ba didii yaŋ, arɩ lee-la ŋ sɩ yie leŋ ŋ piesee pɩnaa wiesi wɩɩhɛyɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ jaŋ nagɛ ha-gɔllɔ baarɩ a chɩŋ ŋ nandɔsʋŋ piesee sɛmɛ? Tanlɔsʋŋ

english_verse: My dearest, if you don't know, just follow the path of the sheep. Then feed your young goats near the shepherds' tents.
translation_verse: Haala tʋɔŋ ha-zɔmʋŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ jɩŋ, to piese-la naabʋɔsʋŋ a leŋ dɩ ŋ bʋʋ-biisiŋ dii yaŋ pie-daaraa lɛŋŋɛɛ sɛmɛ. Baala

english_verse: You move as gracefully as the pony that leads the chariot of the king.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla, mɩ kɛnɩŋ mɩmagɩsɛ Faaro laalɩŋ janɩŋ toruko ja-nɩɩ-hɩasɩ-la dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Earrings add to your beauty, and you wear a necklace of precious stones.
translation_verse: Ŋ chaŋkpaŋŋaa arɩ dɩgɩlɩŋ-kpɛnsɩŋ zɔmɔ, ŋ baŋŋaa arɩ banzɔlɔba ma zɔŋ.

english_verse: Let's make you some jewelry of gold, woven with silver. She Speaks:
translation_verse: La jaŋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa dɩgɩlɩŋ-kpɛnsɩŋ pɩŋ a kɛŋ hɔpʋla libi kʋbiisiŋ chagɩsɛ. Haala

english_verse: My king, while you were on your couch, my aroma was a magic charm.
translation_verse: Kuoro fa hɔŋ ʋ kumpuŋŋuba nyuŋ nɛ, ka mɩ tʋlaalɩ sʋɔra laa leriŋ.

english_verse: you are flower blossoms from the gardens of En-Gedi. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla nagɛ leele fɩɩlaa ba sɩ kaa lɩɩ Ɛŋ-Gedi girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga nɛ. Baala

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— your eyes are those of a dove. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla, ŋ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ woruŋ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ŋ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ woruŋ. Ŋ sɩaa nagɛ kokomo nɛ. Haala

english_verse: My love, you are handsome, truly handsome— the fresh green grass will be our wedding bed
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla, ŋ ma chaasa zɔŋ nɛ woruŋ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ŋ chaasa kɛŋ buno nɛ. Ya-laaŋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa la bɔsɔ,

english_verse: in the shade of cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: kuolu tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ chɛrɩ tɩɩsɩŋ fɩɛlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I am merely a rose from the land of Sharon, a lily from the valley. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Mɩ nagɛ Sarɔŋ tinteeŋ tɩɩfɩɩlaa sʋɔra sɩ sɩma nɛ, a nagɛ fuo-chalba sɩ hɛ fuonaaŋ lɛ. Baala

english_verse: My darling, when compared with other young women, you are a lily among thorns. She Speaks:
translation_verse: A nagɛ fuo-chalba sɩ hɛ sɔsʋŋ tʋɔŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ hɩɩla nagɛ a hɛ hatoloo tʋɔŋ. Haala

english_verse: And you, my love, are an apple tree among trees of the forest. Your shade brought me pleasure; your fruit was sweet.
translation_verse: A nagɛ tɩa nɛnɩŋ sɩ sɩma duuŋ tɩɩsɩŋ kala tʋɔŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ hɩɩla nagɛ a hɛ bapʋɔsaa tʋɔŋ. Mɩ cho dɩ mɩ hɔŋ ʋ fɩɛlɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ nɛnɛɛ sɩma a pɩmɛ.

english_verse: You led me to your banquet room and showered me with love.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛmmɛ kaa mʋ sɩ-dɩa nɛ. Ʋ chonuŋ nagɛ jɔnjɔŋ nɛ a keese tɔ mɩ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: Mɩ nyuŋ yelli ʋ nagʋa nɩsɩŋ nɛ, ka ʋ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ guorimi.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles never to awaken love before it is ready. Winter Is Past She Speaks:
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm toloo, ma ŋmɩɛsɛ wieme arɩ aamɩŋ arɩ ma bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ la chono-la pugi.

english_verse: I hear the voice of the one I love, as he comes leaping over mountains and hills
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩɩ mɩ hɩɩla yikoro. Bee na, ʋ nɩɩ kɔ a fɩla kikieli peelee arɩ dundolluŋ.

english_verse: like a deer or a gazelle. Now he stands outside our wall, looking through the window
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla nagɛ tɛhɩɩ nɛ koo tɛhɩɩ-bel-pɔrʋŋ. Bee na, ʋ nɛ chɩŋ la jeeŋ harɩŋ ŋɩɩ, a to tokoro a bibeŋ a to daasɩŋ pɛgɛ a nyinyilimi.

english_verse: and speaking to me. He Speaks: My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ, ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ hɩɩla, sii, mɩ hɩɩlɩ-zɔmʋŋ, sii to mɩ harɩŋ dɩ la mʋ.

english_verse: Winter is past, the rain has stopped;
translation_verse: Bee na, taŋ lɩa nɛ, duonuŋ bʋa kiele nɛ a mʋ.

english_verse: flowers cover the earth, it's time to sing. The cooing of doves is heard in our land.
translation_verse: Tɩɩ-fɩɩlaa pɔsɔ nɛ tinteeŋ lɛ. Yɩɩlaa yɩɩnɩŋ bʋa kɔ nɛ, laa nɩɩ kokosuŋ yele nɛ la tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Fig trees are bearing fruit, while blossoms on grapevines fill the air with perfume. My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Tutogusuŋ ka nɛŋ ba nɛŋ-falaa nɛ. Girep fɩɩlaa suomoo pɔsɛ nɛ a sʋɔra lɩlaa leriŋ. Mɩ hɩɩla, sii kɔ, mɩ hɩɩlɩ-zɔŋ, sii to mɩ harɩŋ dɩ la mʋ.” Baala

english_verse: You are my dove hiding among the rocks on the side of a cliff. Let me see how lovely you are! Let me hear the sound of your melodious voice.
translation_verse: Mɩ kokomo sɩ hɛ bʋbʋa tʋɔŋ, a hɛ peelee lere-la kɩaa sɩɩ faa, leŋ dɩ mɩ na ŋ sɩaa, leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩɩ ŋ yikoro, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ yikoro sɩma, ŋ sɩaa ma zɔŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Our vineyards are in blossom; we must catch the little foxes that destroy the vineyards. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Kɛsɛ jolluŋ pɩla, jol-biisi-la sɩɩ chei girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa la girep tɩɩsɩŋ ka fɩɩlɛ nɛ. Haala

english_verse: My darling, I am yours, and you are mine, as you feed your sheep among the lilies.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla nɛ tɩɩmɛ, mɩ ma tɩɩ mɩ hɩɩla. Ʋ cho fuo-chalba tʋɔŋ jʋʋnʋŋ.

english_verse: Pretend to be a young deer dancing on mountain slopes until daylight comes and shadows fade away.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie hɛ ba tʋɔŋ halɩɩ taŋ pʋl daaliimee lɛl. Mɩ hɩɩla, mɩɩra kɔ, fá a nagɛ tɛhɩɩ koo aaŋ-bel-pɔrʋŋ peele-la sɩ bɩ dɔŋɔ maga nyuŋ.

english_verse: While in bed at night, I reached for the one I love with heart and soul. I looked for him, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ pɩŋ mɩ bɔsɔ lɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala, mɩ bee chɩchɛ nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ cho nɛ. Mɩ bee chɛʋ nɛ, ama mɩ bɩ ʋ na.

english_verse: So I searched through the town for the one I love. I looked on every street, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ mɩ jaŋ sii lɛɛlɛ a jʋʋ tabal-la tʋɔŋ, a to ʋ womporunuŋ arɩ ʋ taŋ nɩaa dɩ-hɔnɔɔ. Mɩ sɩ mɩ jaŋ chɛ kɛŋ nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ cho. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sii bee chɛʋ, ama mɩ bɩ ʋ na.

english_verse: I even asked the guards patrolling the town, “Have you seen the one I love so much?”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ namɛ, ba sɩ golli tabal-la a bɩbal. Mɩ pɩɛsɛba, “Ma na nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ cho nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Right after that, I found him. I held him and would not let go until I had taken him to the home of my mother.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ leŋ nɩalɩŋ, ʋ bɩ diene ka mɩ na nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ cho. Mɩ kɛnʋ a bɩ leŋe ʋ mʋ aŋ kɛnʋ kaa kɔ mɩ naaŋ dɩa, a kɛnʋ jʋʋ nɩɩ-la sɩ lʋlmɛ dɩa.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles, never to awaken love before it is ready. The Groom and the Wedding Party Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm toloo, má ŋmɩɛsɛ wieme arɩ aamɩŋ arɩ ma bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ la chono-la pugi.

english_verse: What do we see approaching from the desert like a cloud of smoke? With it comes the sweet smell of spices, including myrrh and frankincense.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ lɩɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ kʋkɔ ŋɩɩ a nagɛ nyʋɔsʋŋ sɩ nagɛ jebiiŋ aa jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ, a sʋsʋɔrɛ tɩɩ-kel-la sʋɔra sɩ sɩma baa yɩrɛ mɛɛ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ bayalaa tegisiŋ kala ŋaa?

english_verse: It is King Solomon carried on a throne, surrounded by sixty of Israel's best soldiers.
translation_verse: Bee na, Solomoŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ a pɩŋ ʋ geleŋgeleŋ lɛ ka ba chʋŋʋ, ka bayuori-duoruŋ mahɩŋ batori kɛnʋ vɩvɛŋ. Ba ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori babiibalaa nɛ.

english_verse: Each of them wears a sword. They are experts at fighting, even in the dark.
translation_verse: Ba kala gɩrɩgɛ tokobiee nɛ, a jɩŋ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ woruŋ. Ba kʋŋkala tokobiiŋ hɛ ʋ sɛmɛ lɛ nɛ, a pɔ dɩ wɩɩkala sɩ́ kuoro ŋaa tɩtaŋɩŋ.

english_verse: Its posts are silver, the back is gold, and the seat is covered with purple cloth. You women of Jerusalem have taken great care to furnish the inside.
translation_verse: Geleŋgeleŋ-la daaterigeba, hɔpʋla nɛ ʋ kaa ŋaa, a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa ʋ bʋbʋa-chala. Geleŋgeleŋ-la dɩhɔnʋŋ, gɛrɩpɛ vachalɩŋ nɛ ʋ kaa ŋaa a hɛ kumpuŋŋuba. Jerusalɛm toloo nɛ jɩma kpɩɛrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Now come and see the crown given to Solomon by his mother on his happy wedding day.
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ toloo, má kʋ lɩɩ a bagɩsɛ kuoro Solomoŋ sɩ chu kuoru nyunchuulo, kuoru nyunchuul-la ʋ naaŋ sɩ joŋo chuu tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaa haala, tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɔ.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— as you look through your veil, your eyes are those of a dove. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla, ŋ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ woruŋ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ŋ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ. Ŋ sɩaa zɔmɔ a nagɛ kokomo nɛ nyu-kpal duduoŋ ŋ sɩ tɔ tʋɔŋ. Ŋ nyu-pʋnaa nagɛ bʋ-laalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Gɩlɩad peeliŋ nyuŋ a kʋʋ tuu nɛ, mɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: Your teeth are whiter than sheep freshly washed; they match perfectly, not one is missing.
translation_verse: Ŋ nyɩlaa pʋlla nɛ a nagɛ piesee ba sɩ kɛ ba pʋnaa ʋ bɩ diene aŋ foba lɩɩŋ. Ba kala magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, ba kʋŋkala bɩ fuolo.

english_verse: Your lips are crimson cords, your mouth is shapely; behind your veil are hidden beautiful rosy cheeks.
translation_verse: Ŋ niipinee nagɛ ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ nɛ, Ŋ niiŋ zɔmɔ. Ŋ chaŋkpaŋŋaa nagɛ kampoi nɛnɩŋ ba sɩ kaa kpaa balɩa nɛ a hɛ ŋ nyu-kpal duduoŋ-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Your breasts are perfect; they are twin deer feeding among lilies.
translation_verse: Ŋ yɩlaa nagɛ tɛhɩɩ biiriŋ balɩa nɛ a nagɛ tɛhɩɩ-bii-daalɩarɩŋ a didii lee-la fuo-chalba sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: I will hasten to those hills sprinkled with sweet perfume and stay there till sunrise.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ mʋ tɩɩ-kel-la sʋɔra sɩ sɩma ba yɩrɛ mɛɛ peel-la arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ dɔnsʋŋ dundolo-la, a gbɛrɛ dɩ taŋ pʋl, dɩ daaliimee lɛl.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely in every way.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla, ŋ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ, ŋ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: My bride, together we will leave Lebanon! We will say goodbye to the peaks of Mount Amana, Senir, and Hermon, where lions and leopards live in the caves.
translation_verse: Mɩ ha-falɩŋ, to mɩ harɩŋ dɩ la lɩɩ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ, kɔ dɩ la lɩɩ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ. Lɩɩ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Amana nyuŋ kʋ tuu, lɩɩ peele-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛnɩ arɩ Hɛmɔŋ nyuŋ kʋ tuu, lere-la naachigee arɩ kpeyee sɩɩ jʋʋ.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you have stolen my heart! With one glance from your eyes and the glow of your necklace, you have stolen my heart.
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩhaala, mɩ ha-falɩŋ, bene-la ŋ sɩ bemmi arɩ ŋ baŋŋaa kpɩɛra-la lɩɩsɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Your love is sweeter than wine; the smell of your perfume is more fragrant than spices.
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩhaala, mɩ ha-falɩŋ, ŋ sɩ chomi ŋɩɩ chaasa kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ. Ŋ sɩ chomi ŋɩɩ paala kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a kɩɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ. Ŋ tʋlaalɩ sʋɔra paala sɩma kɩɩ tegisi na-kala.

english_verse: Your lips are a honeycomb; milk and honey flow from your tongue. Your dress has the aroma of cedar trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Mɩ ha-falɩŋ, ŋ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa sɩma a nagɛ tʋʋŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ mʋsɛ mɩ niiŋ, ʋ sɩma a nagɛ nayɩlɩŋ arɩ tʋʋŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ. Ŋ gɛnnɩŋ sʋɔra sɩma a nagɛ Lɛbanɔŋ tɩɩfɩɩlaa sʋɔra nɛ.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you are a garden, a fountain closed off to all others.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla, mɩ ha-falɩŋ, ŋ nagɛ lɩga ba sɩ lɩga nɛ mɩ teeŋ. Ŋ nagɛ lɩɩ-bulo ba sɩ gɩba nɛ.

english_verse: Your arms are vines, covered with delicious fruits and all sorts of spices— henna, nard,
translation_verse: Ŋ nagɛ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ lɩga nɛ, a nagɛ kampoyee tɩɩsɩŋ baga, a kɛŋ nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ sɩma, a pɛ kɛŋ leele arɩ biriŋ tɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: You are a spring in the garden, a fountain of pure water, and a refreshing stream from Mount Lebanon. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Ŋ nagɛ lɩga lɩɩ-bulo nɛ, a nagɛ fuoŋ lɩɩŋ sɩɩ pɛllʋ a pɛllɛ lɩɩ Lɛbanɔŋ peelee a kʋkɔ. Haala

english_verse: Let the north wind blow, the south wind too! Let them spread the aroma of my garden, so the one I love may enter and taste its delicious fruits.
translation_verse: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa peliŋ, sii, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ peliŋ, kɔ. Ma du hɛ mɩ lɩga lɛ, dɩ ʋ sʋɔra laa leriŋ kala. Leŋ dɩ mɩ hɩɩla kʋ jʋʋ ʋ lɩga a dii ʋ tɩɩ-nɛŋ zɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ sɩma.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, I come to my garden and enjoy its spices. I eat my honeycomb and honey; I drink my wine and milk. Their Friends Speak: Eat and drink until you are drunk with love. Another Dream She Speaks:
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩhaala, mɩ ha-falɩŋ, mɩ kʋ jʋʋ mɩ lɩga nɛ. Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩɩ-kel-la sʋɔra sɩ sɩma baa yɩrɛ mɛɛ arɩ mɩ tegisiŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Mɩ dii mɩ tʋʋ-nʋʋŋ arɩ ʋ tʋʋ-jaga kala nɛ. Mɩ nyʋa mɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ arɩ mɩ nayɩlɩŋ ma kala nɛ. Tanlɔsʋŋ La nɩchooloo, má dagɛ ma chonuŋ, a magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ma sɩɩ chɛ, a nagɛ nɩa sɩ dii kɩaa a nyʋa kɩaa vɔgɛ.

english_verse: I was asleep, but dreaming: The one I love was at the door, knocking and saying, “My darling, my very own, my flawless dove, open the door for me! My head is drenched with evening dew.”
translation_verse: Mɩ pɩŋ doŋ nɛ, ama mɩ tʋɔŋ-na bɩ pɩna. Mɩ dɩgɩlɩŋ nɩa arɩ mɩ hɩɩla ka du boro. Baala Mɩ dɩhaala, mɩ hɩɩla, mɩ kokomo, mɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ: Suri boiŋ pɩmɛ. Mɩ nyuŋ kala nɛ fɩɛla arɩ nyalɩŋ, bʋrʋŋ ma tele daŋ mɩ nyuŋ lɛ. Haala

english_verse: But I had already undressed and bathed my feet. Should I dress again and get my feet dirty?
translation_verse: Mɩ wuri mɩ gɛrɩŋ nɛ, ʋ maga mɩ bɩra joŋo laalɛ nɛɛ? Mɩ sɔŋ mɩ naasɩŋ ma nɛ, ʋ maga mɩ bɩra leŋ dɩ ba birisi nɛɛ?

english_verse: Then my darling's hand reached to open the latch, and my heart stood still.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla sɩ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ hɛ boro bʋa lɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ faasa fɩɛlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: When I rose to open the door, my hands and my fingers dripped with perfume.
translation_verse: Mɩ sii dɩ mɩ kɛŋ boro suro pɩ mɩ hɩɩla, mɩ nɩsaa kala tɔ arɩ tɩɩ-kel-la sʋɔra sɩ sɩma ba yɩrɛ mɛɛ boro-la gʋlʋŋmʋlʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ suro pɩ mɩ hɩɩla, ama dɩ ʋ mɩɩra viiri. Ʋ sɩ viire ŋɩɩ, mɩ daagaa viisi. Mɩ bee chɛʋ, ama mɩ bɩ ʋ na. Mɩ yɩrʋ, ama ʋ bɩ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ, a faa golli tabal-la namɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sagɛ jebie-la nyuŋ a bibeŋ tabal-la, ŋmoomi, a pɩrɛmɛ, aŋ laa mɩ gɛrɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm toloo, mɩɩ sʋlma dɩ ma nɛ na mɩ hɩɩla-la. Má bʋla pʋ arɩ mɩɩ sʋʋ ʋ wɩaa nɛ. Tanlɔsʋŋ

english_verse: Most beautiful of women, why is the one you love more special than others? Why do you ask us to tell him how you feel? She Speaks:
translation_verse: Haalaa tʋɔŋ ha-zɔmʋŋ, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ bɩɩnɛ dɩ ŋ hɩɩla nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ baalaa kala? Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ bɩɩnɛ ŋ hɩɩla nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ baalaa kala ŋ sɩ dɩ la bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pʋ? Haala

english_verse: He is handsome and healthy, the most outstanding among ten thousand.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla ŋaa bapʋɔsɩ fɩaŋ zɔŋ-bie nɛ. Dɩ baalaa bʋɩ fii nɛ paala chɩŋ ma, ʋ nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ ba kala.

english_verse: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.
translation_verse: Ʋ nyuŋ nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ, ʋ nyu-pʋnaa mɩɛla pɩŋ a biri a nagɛ gɩlɩŋgaaŋ.

english_verse: His eyes are a pair of doves bathing in a stream flowing with milk.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩaa zɔmɔ nagɛ kokosuŋ sɩ chɩŋ fuoŋ sɛmɛ nɛ, ba kɛŋ nayɩlɩŋ chɛsɛba aŋ laalɛ ʋ kpɩɛraa.

english_verse: His face is a garden of sweet-smelling spices; his lips are lilies dripping with perfume.
translation_verse: Ʋ chaŋkpaŋŋaa nagɛ lɩga-la ba sɩ duu tegisiŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma nɛ ʋ lɛ. Ʋ niipinee nagɛ fuo-chalba nɛ a chuchuori tɩɩ-kel-la sʋara sɩ sɩma baa yɩrɛ mɛɛ.

english_verse: His legs are columns of marble on feet of gold. He stands there majestic like Mount Lebanon and its choice cedar trees.
translation_verse: Ʋ naasɩŋ nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ tabɩɩ-naŋkpachɩllɩŋ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ nɛ a joŋo daŋ kʋŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa bʋbʋa-chala nyuŋ. Ʋ chɩnɩŋ nagɛ Lɛbanɔŋ peeliŋ nɛ, a zɔmɔ nagɛ Lɛbanɔŋ kuolu tɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: His kisses are sweet. I desire him so much! Young women of Jerusalem, he is my lover and friend.
translation_verse: Ʋ niiŋ mʋsʋŋ sɩma, ʋ wɩɩkala zɔmɔ nɛ. Jerusalɛm toloo, mɩ hɩɩla nɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ tanlɔŋɔ ma nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: When I rose to open the door, my hands and my fingers dripped with perfume.
translation_verse: Mɩ sii dɩ mɩ kɛŋ boro suro pɩ mɩ hɩɩla, mɩ nɩsaa kala tɔ arɩ tɩɩ-kel-la sʋɔra sɩ sɩma ba yɩrɛ mɛɛ boro-la gʋlʋŋmʋlʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ suro pɩ mɩ hɩɩla, ama dɩ ʋ mɩɩra viiri. Ʋ sɩ viire ŋɩɩ, mɩ daagaa viisi. Mɩ bee chɛʋ, ama mɩ bɩ ʋ na. Mɩ yɩrʋ, ama ʋ bɩ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ, a faa golli tabal-la namɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sagɛ jebie-la nyuŋ a bibeŋ tabal-la, ŋmoomi, a pɩrɛmɛ, aŋ laa mɩ gɛrɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm toloo, mɩɩ sʋlma dɩ ma nɛ na mɩ hɩɩla-la. Má bʋla pʋ arɩ mɩɩ sʋʋ ʋ wɩaa nɛ. Tanlɔsʋŋ

english_verse: Most beautiful of women, why is the one you love more special than others? Why do you ask us to tell him how you feel? She Speaks:

english_verse: He is handsome and healthy, the most outstanding among ten thousand.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla ŋaa bapʋɔsɩ fɩaŋ zɔŋ-bie nɛ. Dɩ baalaa bʋɩ fii nɛ paala chɩŋ ma, ʋ nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ ba kala.

english_verse: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.

english_verse: His eyes are a pair of doves bathing in a stream flowing with milk.

english_verse: His face is a garden of sweet-smelling spices; his lips are lilies dripping with perfume.
translation_verse: Ʋ chaŋkpaŋŋaa nagɛ lɩga-la ba sɩ duu tegisiŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma nɛ ʋ lɛ. Ʋ niipinee nagɛ fuo-chalba nɛ a chuchuori tɩɩ-kel-la sʋara sɩ sɩma baa yɩrɛ mɛɛ.

english_verse: His legs are columns of marble on feet of gold. He stands there majestic like Mount Lebanon and its choice cedar trees.

english_verse: His kisses are sweet. I desire him so much! Young women of Jerusalem, he is my lover and friend.
translation_verse: Ʋ niiŋ mʋsʋŋ sɩma, ʋ wɩɩkala zɔmɔ nɛ. Jerusalɛm toloo, mɩ hɩɩla nɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ tanlɔŋɔ ma nɛ ŋɩɩ.

translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla ŋaa bapʋɔsɩ fɩaŋ zɔŋ-bie nɛ. Dɩ baalaa bʋɩ fii nɛ paala chɩŋ ma, ʋ nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ ba kala.

english_verse: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.
translation_verse: Ʋ nyuŋ nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ, ʋ nyu-pʋnaa mɩɛla pɩŋ a biri a nagɛ gɩlɩŋgaaŋ.

english_verse: His eyes are a pair of doves bathing in a stream flowing with milk.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩaa zɔmɔ nagɛ kokosuŋ sɩ chɩŋ fuoŋ sɛmɛ nɛ, ba kɛŋ nayɩlɩŋ chɛsɛba aŋ laalɛ ʋ kpɩɛraa.

english_verse: His face is a garden of sweet-smelling spices; his lips are lilies dripping with perfume.
translation_verse: Ʋ chaŋkpaŋŋaa nagɛ lɩga-la ba sɩ duu tegisiŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma nɛ ʋ lɛ. Ʋ niipinee nagɛ fuo-chalba nɛ a chuchuori tɩɩ-kel-la sʋara sɩ sɩma baa yɩrɛ mɛɛ.

english_verse: His legs are columns of marble on feet of gold. He stands there majestic like Mount Lebanon and its choice cedar trees.
translation_verse: Ʋ naasɩŋ nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ tabɩɩ-naŋkpachɩllɩŋ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ nɛ a joŋo daŋ kʋŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa bʋbʋa-chala nyuŋ. Ʋ chɩnɩŋ nagɛ Lɛbanɔŋ peeliŋ nɛ, a zɔmɔ nagɛ Lɛbanɔŋ kuolu tɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: His kisses are sweet. I desire him so much! Young women of Jerusalem, he is my lover and friend.
translation_verse: Ʋ niiŋ mʋsʋŋ sɩma, ʋ wɩɩkala zɔmɔ nɛ. Jerusalɛm toloo, mɩ hɩɩla nɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ tanlɔŋɔ ma nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, I come to my garden and enjoy its spices. I eat my honeycomb and honey; I drink my wine and milk. Their Friends Speak: Eat and drink until you are drunk with love. Another Dream She Speaks:
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩhaala, mɩ ha-falɩŋ, mɩ kʋ jʋʋ mɩ lɩga nɛ. Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩɩ-kel-la sʋɔra sɩ sɩma baa yɩrɛ mɛɛ arɩ mɩ tegisiŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Mɩ dii mɩ tʋʋ-nʋʋŋ arɩ ʋ tʋʋ-jaga kala nɛ. Mɩ nyʋa mɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ arɩ mɩ nayɩlɩŋ ma kala nɛ. Tanlɔsʋŋ La nɩchooloo, má dagɛ ma chonuŋ, a magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ma sɩɩ chɛ, a nagɛ nɩa sɩ dii kɩaa a nyʋa kɩaa vɔgɛ.

english_verse: I was asleep, but dreaming: The one I love was at the door, knocking and saying, “My darling, my very own, my flawless dove, open the door for me! My head is drenched with evening dew.”
translation_verse: Mɩ pɩŋ doŋ nɛ, ama mɩ tʋɔŋ-na bɩ pɩna. Mɩ dɩgɩlɩŋ nɩa arɩ mɩ hɩɩla ka du boro. Baala Mɩ dɩhaala, mɩ hɩɩla, mɩ kokomo, mɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ: Suri boiŋ pɩmɛ. Mɩ nyuŋ kala nɛ fɩɛla arɩ nyalɩŋ, bʋrʋŋ ma tele daŋ mɩ nyuŋ lɛ. Haala

english_verse: But I had already undressed and bathed my feet. Should I dress again and get my feet dirty?
translation_verse: Mɩ wuri mɩ gɛrɩŋ nɛ, ʋ maga mɩ bɩra joŋo laalɛ nɛɛ? Mɩ sɔŋ mɩ naasɩŋ ma nɛ, ʋ maga mɩ bɩra leŋ dɩ ba birisi nɛɛ?

english_verse: Then my darling's hand reached to open the latch, and my heart stood still.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla sɩ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ hɛ boro bʋa lɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ faasa fɩɛlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: When I rose to open the door, my hands and my fingers dripped with perfume.
translation_verse: Mɩ sii dɩ mɩ kɛŋ boro suro pɩ mɩ hɩɩla, mɩ nɩsaa kala tɔ arɩ tɩɩ-kel-la sʋɔra sɩ sɩma ba yɩrɛ mɛɛ boro-la gʋlʋŋmʋlʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ suro pɩ mɩ hɩɩla, ama dɩ ʋ mɩɩra viiri. Ʋ sɩ viire ŋɩɩ, mɩ daagaa viisi. Mɩ bee chɛʋ, ama mɩ bɩ ʋ na. Mɩ yɩrʋ, ama ʋ bɩ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ, a faa golli tabal-la namɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sagɛ jebie-la nyuŋ a bibeŋ tabal-la, ŋmoomi, a pɩrɛmɛ, aŋ laa mɩ gɛrɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:

english_verse: His kisses are sweet. I desire him so much! Young women of Jerusalem, he is my lover and friend.
translation_verse: Ʋ niiŋ mʋsʋŋ sɩma, ʋ wɩɩkala zɔmɔ nɛ. Jerusalɛm toloo, mɩ hɩɩla nɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ tanlɔŋɔ ma nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, I come to my garden and enjoy its spices. I eat my honeycomb and honey; I drink my wine and milk. Their Friends Speak: Eat and drink until you are drunk with love. Another Dream She Speaks:

english_verse: I was asleep, but dreaming: The one I love was at the door, knocking and saying, “My darling, my very own, my flawless dove, open the door for me! My head is drenched with evening dew.”

english_verse: But I had already undressed and bathed my feet. Should I dress again and get my feet dirty?
translation_verse: Mɩ wuri mɩ gɛrɩŋ nɛ, ʋ maga mɩ bɩra joŋo laalɛ nɛɛ? Mɩ sɔŋ mɩ naasɩŋ ma nɛ, ʋ maga mɩ bɩra leŋ dɩ ba birisi nɛɛ?

english_verse: Then my darling's hand reached to open the latch, and my heart stood still.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla sɩ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ hɛ boro bʋa lɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ faasa fɩɛlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: When I rose to open the door, my hands and my fingers dripped with perfume.
translation_verse: Mɩ sii dɩ mɩ kɛŋ boro suro pɩ mɩ hɩɩla, mɩ nɩsaa kala tɔ arɩ tɩɩ-kel-la sʋɔra sɩ sɩma ba yɩrɛ mɛɛ boro-la gʋlʋŋmʋlʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ suro pɩ mɩ hɩɩla, ama dɩ ʋ mɩɩra viiri. Ʋ sɩ viire ŋɩɩ, mɩ daagaa viisi. Mɩ bee chɛʋ, ama mɩ bɩ ʋ na. Mɩ yɩrʋ, ama ʋ bɩ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ, a faa golli tabal-la namɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sagɛ jebie-la nyuŋ a bibeŋ tabal-la, ŋmoomi, a pɩrɛmɛ, aŋ laa mɩ gɛrɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:

english_verse: He is handsome and healthy, the most outstanding among ten thousand.

english_verse: He is handsome and healthy, the most outstanding among ten thousand.

translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ suro pɩ mɩ hɩɩla, ama dɩ ʋ mɩɩra viiri. Ʋ sɩ viire ŋɩɩ, mɩ daagaa viisi. Mɩ bee chɛʋ, ama mɩ bɩ ʋ na. Mɩ yɩrʋ, ama ʋ bɩ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ, a faa golli tabal-la namɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sagɛ jebie-la nyuŋ a bibeŋ tabal-la, ŋmoomi, a pɩrɛmɛ, aŋ laa mɩ gɛrɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm toloo, mɩɩ sʋlma dɩ ma nɛ na mɩ hɩɩla-la. Má bʋla pʋ arɩ mɩɩ sʋʋ ʋ wɩaa nɛ. Tanlɔsʋŋ

english_verse: Most beautiful of women, why is the one you love more special than others? Why do you ask us to tell him how you feel? She Speaks:
translation_verse: Haalaa tʋɔŋ ha-zɔmʋŋ, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ bɩɩnɛ dɩ ŋ hɩɩla nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ baalaa kala? Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ bɩɩnɛ ŋ hɩɩla nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ baalaa kala ŋ sɩ dɩ la bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pʋ? Haala

english_verse: He is handsome and healthy, the most outstanding among ten thousand.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla ŋaa bapʋɔsɩ fɩaŋ zɔŋ-bie nɛ. Dɩ baalaa bʋɩ fii nɛ paala chɩŋ ma, ʋ nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ ba kala.

english_verse: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.
translation_verse: Ʋ nyuŋ nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ, ʋ nyu-pʋnaa mɩɛla pɩŋ a biri a nagɛ gɩlɩŋgaaŋ.

english_verse: His eyes are a pair of doves bathing in a stream flowing with milk.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩaa zɔmɔ nagɛ kokosuŋ sɩ chɩŋ fuoŋ sɛmɛ nɛ, ba kɛŋ nayɩlɩŋ chɛsɛba aŋ laalɛ ʋ kpɩɛraa.

english_verse: His face is a garden of sweet-smelling spices; his lips are lilies dripping with perfume.
translation_verse: Ʋ chaŋkpaŋŋaa nagɛ lɩga-la ba sɩ duu tegisiŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma nɛ ʋ lɛ. Ʋ niipinee nagɛ fuo-chalba nɛ a chuchuori tɩɩ-kel-la sʋara sɩ sɩma baa yɩrɛ mɛɛ.

english_verse: His legs are columns of marble on feet of gold. He stands there majestic like Mount Lebanon and its choice cedar trees.
translation_verse: Ʋ naasɩŋ nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ tabɩɩ-naŋkpachɩllɩŋ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ nɛ a joŋo daŋ kʋŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa bʋbʋa-chala nyuŋ. Ʋ chɩnɩŋ nagɛ Lɛbanɔŋ peeliŋ nɛ, a zɔmɔ nagɛ Lɛbanɔŋ kuolu tɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: His kisses are sweet. I desire him so much! Young women of Jerusalem, he is my lover and friend.
translation_verse: Ʋ niiŋ mʋsʋŋ sɩma, ʋ wɩɩkala zɔmɔ nɛ. Jerusalɛm toloo, mɩ hɩɩla nɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ tanlɔŋɔ ma nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, I come to my garden and enjoy its spices. I eat my honeycomb and honey; I drink my wine and milk. Their Friends Speak: Eat and drink until you are drunk with love. Another Dream She Speaks:

english_verse: But I had already undressed and bathed my feet. Should I dress again and get my feet dirty?
translation_verse: Mɩ wuri mɩ gɛrɩŋ nɛ, ʋ maga mɩ bɩra joŋo laalɛ nɛɛ? Mɩ sɔŋ mɩ naasɩŋ ma nɛ, ʋ maga mɩ bɩra leŋ dɩ ba birisi nɛɛ?

translation_verse: Ʋ nyuŋ nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ, ʋ nyu-pʋnaa mɩɛla pɩŋ a biri a nagɛ gɩlɩŋgaaŋ.

english_verse: His eyes are a pair of doves bathing in a stream flowing with milk.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩaa zɔmɔ nagɛ kokosuŋ sɩ chɩŋ fuoŋ sɛmɛ nɛ, ba kɛŋ nayɩlɩŋ chɛsɛba aŋ laalɛ ʋ kpɩɛraa.

english_verse: His face is a garden of sweet-smelling spices; his lips are lilies dripping with perfume.
translation_verse: Ʋ chaŋkpaŋŋaa nagɛ lɩga-la ba sɩ duu tegisiŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma nɛ ʋ lɛ. Ʋ niipinee nagɛ fuo-chalba nɛ a chuchuori tɩɩ-kel-la sʋara sɩ sɩma baa yɩrɛ mɛɛ.

english_verse: His legs are columns of marble on feet of gold. He stands there majestic like Mount Lebanon and its choice cedar trees.
translation_verse: Ʋ naasɩŋ nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ tabɩɩ-naŋkpachɩllɩŋ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ nɛ a joŋo daŋ kʋŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa bʋbʋa-chala nyuŋ. Ʋ chɩnɩŋ nagɛ Lɛbanɔŋ peeliŋ nɛ, a zɔmɔ nagɛ Lɛbanɔŋ kuolu tɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: His kisses are sweet. I desire him so much! Young women of Jerusalem, he is my lover and friend.
translation_verse: Ʋ niiŋ mʋsʋŋ sɩma, ʋ wɩɩkala zɔmɔ nɛ. Jerusalɛm toloo, mɩ hɩɩla nɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ tanlɔŋɔ ma nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Most beautiful of women, tell us where he has gone. Let us help you find him. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Haalaa tʋɔŋ ha-zɔmʋŋ, nɩɩ nɛ ŋ hɩɩla mʋ? Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ hɩɩla to mʋ? Dagɛla dɩ la pɛ ŋ lɛ a chɛʋ. Haala

english_verse: My darling has gone down to his garden of spices, where he will feed his sheep and gather lilies.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla mʋ ʋ lɩga nɛ, lee-la ba sɩ duu tegisiŋ, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ piesee mʋ dɩ ba dii yaŋ aŋ pɛ chɛ fuo-chalba.

english_verse: I am his, and he is mine, as he feeds his sheep among the lilies. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla nɛ tɩɩmɛ, mɩ ma tɩɩʋ. Ʋ leŋe ʋ piesee didii fuo-chalba tʋɔŋ nɛ. Baala

english_verse: My dearest, the cities of Tirzah and Jerusalem are not as lovely as you. Your charms are more powerful than all of the stars in the heavens.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla, ŋ zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ a nagɛ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɩza, a zɔmɔ nagɛ Jerusalɛm, a gigenni a nagɛ laalɩyuoroo sɩ kori jɔnjɔmba.

english_verse: Turn away your eyes— they make me melt. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ ŋ sɩaa viire chaasɛ lee dɔŋ a sɩ́ mɩ beŋ, ba leŋe mɩɩ hɩɛnɩŋ nɛ. Ŋ nyu-pʋnaa nagɛ bʋ-laalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Gɩlɩad peeliŋ nyuŋ a kʋʋ tuu nɛ, mɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: Your teeth are whiter than sheep freshly washed; they match perfectly, not one is missing.
translation_verse: Ŋ nyɩlaa pʋlla a nagɛ piesee sɩ lɩɩ lɩɩŋ dɩ-fooluŋ a kʋkɔ nɛ. Ba kala magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, ba kʋŋkala bɩ fuolo.

english_verse: You would be my only choice, my flawless dove, the favorite child of your mother. The young women, the queens, and all the others tell how excited you are as they sing your praises:
translation_verse: ama mɩ kokomo nɛ ha, mɩ ha-zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kɛnɛ, ʋ dɔŋ tuo. Ʋ naaŋ tolo kala nɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa ʋ naaŋ bii-chooluŋ. Hatoloo naʋ, a kɛnʋ yɩrɛ nʋʋ lɛ Wɩa sɩ pɛ. Kuoro habidiiree arɩ haala-la ʋ sɩ bile aŋ bɩ jaa ma bɩbɛsɛ ʋ lɛ. Tanlɔsʋŋ

english_verse: “You are as majestic as the morning sky— glorious as the moon— blinding as the sun! Your charms are more powerful than all the stars above.” She Speaks:
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɩɩ tʋl ŋ-la, a nagɛ taŋ sɩ pʋlaa kɔ, a pʋllɛ a nagɛ chɛnɛ, a chaanɛ a nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, a gigenni a nagɛ laalɩyuoroo sɩ kori jɔnjɔmba kɩɛla vɩvɛŋ? Baala

english_verse: I went down to see if blossoms were on the walnut trees, grapevines, and fruit trees.
translation_verse: Mɩ tuu kube tɩɩsɩŋ leriŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ na tɩɩ-falɩa-la sɩ waa fuonaaŋ lɛ, dɩ mɩ na girep tɩɩsɩŋ tɔsɔ nɛɛ koo kampoyee ma ka fɩɩlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But in my imagination I was suddenly riding on a glorious chariot. Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Mɩɩ jɩŋ dɩ mɩ wʋchɛɛlɛɛ lɛrɛmɛ mʋ hɛ mɩ nɩaa kuoro laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba tʋɔŋ. Tanlɔsʋŋ

english_verse: Dance! Dance! Beautiful woman from Shulam, let us see you dance! She Speaks: Why do you want to see this woman from Shulam dancing with the others?
translation_verse: Sulam tɩŋŋaa tolo, mɩɩra kɔ, mɩɩra kɔ. Mɩɩra kɔ, mɩɩra kɔ dɩ la bagɩsɩŋ. Baala Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma jaŋ chaarɛ sɩaa pɛ Sulam tɩŋŋaa tolo-la sɩɩ gʋa lɛ ka nɩaa chɩnaa beŋ?

english_verse: You are a princess, and your feet are graceful in their sandals. Your thighs are works of art, each one a jewel;
translation_verse: Kuori-bie tolo, ŋ naasɩŋ arɩ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ. Ŋ naakʋɔlaa nagɛ yaraa kpɩɛraa gɔgɔ sɩ libe nɛ.

english_verse: your navel is a wine glass filled to overflowing. Your body is full and slender like a bundle of wheat bound together by lilies.
translation_verse: Ŋ kawule nagɛ gbaŋ-guguluŋ nɛ a bɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ ba sɩ hɛ tegisiŋ lɛ ka nyaa. Ŋ tɩŋa nagɛ mɩɩchaha nɛ, fuo-chalba gollu.

english_verse: Your breasts are like twins of a deer.
translation_verse: Ŋ yɩlaa nagɛ tɛhɩɩ biiriŋ balɩa nɛ a nagɛ tɛhɩɩ-bii-daalɩarɩŋ

english_verse: Your neck is like ivory, and your eyes sparkle like the pools of Heshbon by the gate of Bath-Rabbim. Your nose is beautiful like Mount Lebanon above the city of Damascus.
translation_verse: Ŋ baŋŋaa nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ batu-nyɩlɩŋ saa dɩɩ-leŋiŋ nɛ. Ŋ sɩaa nagɛ fuonu-la sɩ hɛ Hɛsɩbɔŋ tabalɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a kpagɛ boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baf Rabim. Ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nagɛ Lɛbanɔŋ dɩɩ-leŋii-la sɩ chaasɛ Damasɩkʋs nɛ.

english_verse: You are tall and slender like a palm tree, and your breasts are full.
translation_verse: Ŋ chɩnɩŋ nagɛ abɛ tɩa nɛ, ŋ yɩlaa nagɛ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ jaga.

english_verse: I will climb that tree and cling to its branches. I will discover that your breasts are clusters of grapes, and that your breath is the aroma of apples.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ jɩl abɛ tɩa-la, a kɛŋ ʋ nɛnɛɛ lɛ.” Ŋ yɩlaa nagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ jaga nɛ mɩ teeŋ, ŋ wiese ma sʋɔra sɩŋ a nagɛ tɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ apʋl-fɩlaa,

english_verse: Kissing you is more delicious than drinking the finest wine. How wonderful and tasty! She Speaks:
translation_verse: ŋ niiŋ ma nagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ. Haala A leŋ dɩ sɩŋ-la pɛllɛ tegi tegi a tuu mɩ hɩɩla niiŋ, a to ʋ niipinee arɩ ʋ nyɩlaa pɛgɛ.

english_verse: My darling, I am yours, and you desire me.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa mɩ hɩɩla kʋŋ nɛ, ʋ hɩhɩɛnɛ mɩ.

english_verse: Let's stroll through the fields and sleep in the villages.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla, kɔ dɩ la dʋʋra mʋ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ, a chʋa tabiisiŋ lɛ [a chʋa leele tɩɩsɩŋ sɩ fɩɩla tʋɔŋ].

english_verse: At dawn let's slip out and see if grapevines and fruit trees are covered with blossoms. When we are there, I will give you my love.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ la mʋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla a bee na tɩɩsɩ-la tɔsɔ nɛɛ? Ba fɩɩlaa suro nɛɛ, koo kampoyee tɩɩsɩŋ ma fɩɩla nɛɛ? Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa kala pɩŋ.

english_verse: Perfume from the magic flower fills the air, my darling. Right at our doorstep I have stored up for you all kinds of tasty fruits.
translation_verse: Halʋllɩ tɩɩsɩŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma, sʋɔra laa leriŋ nɛ, tɩɩ-nɛŋ zɔmɔ-la kala hɛ la boiŋ niiŋ nɛ, kʋbɩnaa arɩ kʋfalaa kala, mɩ chɛ bil ŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ hɩɩla.

english_verse: If you were my brother, I could kiss you whenever we happen to meet, and no one would say I did wrong.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa cho dɩ ŋ ŋaa mɩ dɩ-baal nɛ, nʋʋ sɩ wasɛ mɩ naaŋ yɩlɩŋ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ fa, dɩ mɩ nɛ naŋ dɩ-jalɩŋ, mɩ fa guoruŋ a mʋsɛ ŋ niiŋ, ka nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ leenimi.

english_verse: I could take you to the home of my mother, who taught me all I know. I would give you delicious wine and fruit juice as well.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa jaŋ laa ŋ sɩpaaŋ a kɛnɩŋ jʋʋ mɩ naaŋ dɩa, nɩɩ-la sɩ dagɛmɛ. Mɩ fa jaŋ pɩŋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ ba sɩ hɛ tegisiŋ, mɩ kampoi nɛnɛɛ lɩɩŋ dɩ ŋ nyʋa.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: Mɩ nyuŋ yelli ʋ nagʋa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ka ʋ nadiiŋ guorimi.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me never to awaken love before it is ready. Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm toloo, má ŋmɩɛsɛ pɩmɛ arɩ ma bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ la chono-la pugi. Tanlɔsʋŋ

english_verse: Who is this young woman coming in from the desert and leaning on the shoulder of the one she loves? She Speaks: I stirred up your passions under the apple tree where you were born.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ lɩɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ kʋkɔ ŋ-la a yelli ʋ hɩɩla? Haala Mɩ chɩsɩŋ tɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ apʋl bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ŋ naaŋ kɛŋ ŋ luoruŋ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ luoruŋ wɩɩ ʋ lʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Always keep me in your heart and wear this bracelet to remember me by. The passion of love bursting into flame is more powerful than death, stronger than the grave.
translation_verse: Kɛmmɛ mɛrɛ ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ a nagɛ magɩlɩŋ dɩ mɩ nagɛ nenii-pɩrɩŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Chonuŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ sʋʋŋ nɛ, ʋ yarɩ-bieriŋ ma pɛsɛ a nagɛ lɛlɛɛ sɩ bɩ sʋʋnʋŋ joŋo tɩta ŋɩɩ. Ʋʋ dii a nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ nɛ, a nagɛ nyiŋ-gel balɩŋ.

english_verse: Love cannot be drowned by oceans or floods. It cannot be bought— any offer would be scorned no matter how great. Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Lɩɩŋ cho dɩ ʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ma, ʋ bɩ chonuŋ wuo dɩsɛ, fuonuŋ bɩ ʋ wuo pɛllɛ paa viviiri. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ paala joŋ ʋ dɩa dʋa kala dɩ ʋ yɔɔ chonuŋ ma, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo naʋ, ka dɩ nɩaa chaasa mɔŋ ʋ lɛ. Haal-la naambiiriŋ

english_verse: We have a little sister whose breasts are not yet formed. If someone asks to marry her, what should we do?
translation_verse: La kɛŋ dɩha-bie nɛ, ʋ ha bɩ yɩlaa kpʋra. Wʋbɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaa pɩ la dɩhaala tapʋlɩɩ-la nʋʋ sɩ jaŋ kɔ a chɩchɛ ʋ jaaʋ?

english_verse: She isn't a wall that we can defend behind a silver shield. Neither is she a room that we can protect behind a wooden door. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ fa nagɛ jebiiŋ, la fa jaŋ kɛŋ hɔpʋla saa dɩɩ-leŋee ʋ nyuŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ fa nagɛ boiŋ niiŋ, la fa jaŋ kɛŋ kuolu daasɩŋ ŋaa boro hɛ. Haala

english_verse: I am a wall around a city, my breasts are towers, and just looking at me brings him great pleasure.
translation_verse: Mɩ nagɛ jebiiŋ nɛ, mɩ yɩlaa ma nagɛ dɩɩ-leŋee. Mɩ hɩɩla teeŋ, mɩ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ yie ŋaa ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ yaraa fɩɛlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Solomon has a vineyard at Baal-Hamon, which he rents to others for a thousand pieces of silver each.
translation_verse: Solomoŋ fa kɛŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga nɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal Hamɔŋ lɛ, a joŋo chɩŋ paaraa. Paara-la kʋŋkala fa maga ʋ kɛŋ warɩpʋla bʋɩ nɛ a kʋ tiŋ tɩɩnɛnɛ-la chɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: My vineyard is mine alone! Solomon can keep his silver and the others can keep their share of the profits. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Ama mɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ tɩtɩa girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga, Solomoŋ, mɩ joŋ warɩpʋla bʋɩ nɛ aa pɩŋ, aŋ joŋ warɩpʋla zɔɔ-balɩa aa pɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ tɔrɛ tɩɩnɛnɛ-la. Baala

english_verse: You are in the garden with friends all around. Let me hear your voice! She Speaks:
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla, ŋ hɛ lɩga tʋɔŋ nɛ, ŋ tanlɔsʋŋ golluŋ, leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩɩ ŋ yikoro. Haala

english_verse: Hurry to me, my darling! Run faster than a deer to mountains of spices.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɩɩla, fá kɔ mɩ teeŋ a nagɛ tɛhɩɩ koo aaŋ-bel-pɔrʋŋ sɩ hɛ tegisiŋ peeliŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: I am Isaiah, the son of Amoz. And this is the message that I was given about Judah and Jerusalem when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah: A Guilty Nation
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Amos nanʋala Azaaya sɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ, a mʋ tɩgɛ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ ŋ-la, bʋa-la lɛ kuoroo deemba sɩɩ beŋ Juda tinteeŋ: Uzia, Jotaŋ, Ahas arɩ Hezikaaya. Tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ sɛyɛ

english_verse: The Lord has said, “Listen, heaven and earth! The children I raised have turned against me.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala, má jegile nɩɩ, mɩ dɩɛsɛ mɩ biiriŋ nɛ ba waa, ama ba vɩa mɩ niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Oxen and donkeys know who owns and feeds them, but my people won't ever learn.”
translation_verse: Nɛ-fere jɩŋ ʋ tɩɩna nɛ, kakumo ma jɩŋ lee-la ʋ tɩɩna sɩɩ pʋ kʋdiilee, ama Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩ mɩ jɩŋ, mɩ nɩaa paala bɩ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ.”

english_verse: Israel, you are a sinful nation loaded down with guilt. You are wicked and corrupt and have turned from the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Aa, ma tinteeŋ deeŋ nɩaa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaara nɛ, ma cheeriŋ yʋga ma nyuŋ lɛ, ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaara nɛ, a didii gɩrɩma. Ma vɩa ma TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ a joŋ harɩŋ yɩaʋ.

english_verse: Why be punished more? Why not give up your sin? Your head is badly bruised, and you are weak all over.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma vɩvɩa ʋ niiŋ deeŋ deeŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ faasa dɔgɩsɛma? Iziral tɩmma, ma nyuŋ kala nɛ cheye, ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa ma kala vʋgʋmɛ.

english_verse: From your head to your toes there isn't a healthy spot. Bruises, cuts, and open sores go without care or oil to ease the pain. A Country in Ruins
translation_verse: A chɩŋ ma naachɛyɛɛ a kaa jɩl ma nyuŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa tuo. Ma yaraa kala nɛ firise a ŋaa naawɩɩlaa. Ma bɩ chɛsɛ, ma bɩ vɔɔ tɔ, ma bɩ daalusuŋ ma ŋaa hɛ.

english_verse: Your country lies in ruins; your towns are in ashes. Foreigners and strangers take and destroy your land while you watch.
translation_verse: Maa beŋ nɛ ka nɩwogusuŋ kʋ yuo dii ma tabalaa a nyɩgɛ ma dɩɩsɩŋ, nʋhʋɔraa dii ma bagɩsɩŋ nɛ, ka ma tinteeŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: Enemies surround Jerusalem, alone like a hut in a vineyard or in a cucumber field.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm dʋndʋŋa nɛ ka a nagɛ lɛbɩŋ sɩ chɩŋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ baga lɛ, a nagɛ lɛbɩŋ sɩ chɩŋ kaŋkɩɛsɩŋ baga lɛ, a nagɛ taŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ gollo chu.

english_verse: Zion would have disappeared like Sodom and Gomorrah, if the Lord All-Powerful had not let a few of its people survive. Justice, Not Sacrifices
translation_verse: Dɩ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna dee fa bɩ la dɔnsʋŋ yuo laa ta, la kʋbala ma fa bɩ jaŋ ka, Jerusalɛm fa jaŋ nagɛ Sodom dɩ la nagɛ Gomora nɩaa fa sɩ sʋʋ dɛrɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You are no better than the leaders and people of Sodom and Gomorrah! So listen to the Lord God:
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm sɩpaalaaraa, má jegile nɩɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ wʋbʋlaa, ma nagɛ Sodom nɩaa nɛ. Má jegile nɩɩ wombii-la la Wɩa sɩ bile dɩ la tuto wɩaa, ma nagɛ Gomora nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: “Your sacrifices mean nothing to me. I am sick of your offerings of rams and choice cattle; I don't like the blood of bulls or lambs or goats.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Ma pʋŋ daŋ-la ma sɩ yie kpʋ pɩpɩmɛ bɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ fɩɩ ma kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa nɛ, ma pie-belliŋ, arɩ ma pʋŋ-zɔmɔ-la ma sɩ yie kpʋ a nyɩgɛ ba nʋʋraa pɩmɛ. Mɩ bɩ ma nɛ-belliŋ, pie-pɔrɔɔ arɩ bʋʋnaa chalɩŋ ka chɛ.

english_verse: “Who asked you to bring all this when you come to worship me? Stay out of my temple!
translation_verse: Ma sɩ yie kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ yie pɩɛsɛ ma kɩaa deemba wɩaa, wʋgɩrɩga gɩrɩga deemba ma sɩ yie ŋɩŋaa mɩ kaalɩsɩŋ lɛ?

english_verse: Your sacrifices are worthless, and your incense disgusting. I can't stand the evil you do on your New Moon Festivals or on your Sabbaths and other times of worship.
translation_verse: Má bɩra sɩ́ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kɛnɛ kaa kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ. Mɩ bɩra bɩ ma kʋsʋɔrʋsʋ-la ma sɩ yie nyɩgaa pɩmɛ maa chɛ. Ba nagɛ bɩnɩŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ. Ma chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele arɩ ma chɛ-wiesiŋ gbielee arɩ ma sɩ yie hilimi aa zilmi, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo chɩna gbɛrɛma ba kʋŋkala lɛ.

english_verse: I hate your New Moon Festivals and all others as well. They are a heavy burden I am tired of carrying.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ ma chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbielee arɩ ma gbiele-la dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ vɛnɛɛ gbieli cho. Ba nagɛ chʋga nɛ mɩ chʋŋ, mɩ bɛsɩmɛ nɛ ba chʋŋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Wash yourselves clean! I hate your filthy deeds. Stop doing wrong
translation_verse: Má chɛsɛ ma tɩtɩa, a sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ. Má kɛŋ ma wʋbɔmɔ-la ŋaanɩŋ sʋʋsa lɩɩ mɩ sɩpaaŋ. Má leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ.

english_verse: and learn to live right. See that justice is done. Defend widows and orphans and help the oppressed.” An Invitation from the Lord
translation_verse: Má gʋnnɛ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ, a tuto wʋtɩtɩɩ, a pɩpɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nyaga bil lɛ. Má chɩna gbɛrɛ biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, invite you to come and talk it over. Your sins are scarlet red, but they will be whiter than snow or wool.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA saa yɩrɛma nɛ a bʋl, “Lɛɛlɛ má kɔ dɩ la bʋla nɩɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ paala fɩɛsɛ a nagɛ chalɩŋ ma, mɩ jaŋ chɛsɛba ta ka ma pʋllɛ a nagɛ kuŋkunuŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ paala fɩɛsɛ a nagɛ vachalɩŋ ma, ma jaŋ pʋllɛ a nagɛ pie-pʋnaa.

english_verse: If you willingly obey me, the best crops in the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ jaŋ sɛɩ a to mɩ niiŋ, ma tinteeŋ kɩaa jaŋ wasɛ dɩ ma dii kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: But if you turn against me, your enemies will kill you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Condemns Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ vɩa mɩ niiŋ aŋ to ma nyuduoŋ lɛ, ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kpʋma.” La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are like an unfaithful wife. Once your judges were honest and your people lived right; now you are a city full of murderers.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm fa nagɛ haala sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ arɩ ʋ bala, ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ. Taŋ-la nɩaa fa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa nɛ fa hɛ taŋ-la lɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ nɩkpʋʋraa nɛ suo.

english_verse: Your leaders have rejected me to become friends of crooks; your rulers are looking for gifts and bribes. Widows and orphans never get a fair trial.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bemma bɩ mɩ niiŋ ka to, gaaraa nɛ ŋaa ba nandɔsʋŋ, ba cho kpalaa laanɩŋ nɛ woruŋ a kiree to kʋmɔlɩɩba harɩŋ. Ba bɩ chɩna gbɛrɛ biisinsiŋ, dɩ yo-haalaa nɛ kɛŋ wɩaa kɔ ba teeŋ, ba bɩ jegile nɩnɩɩ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the mighty ruler of Israel, and I make you a promise: You are now my enemy, and I will show my anger by taking revenge on you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ tiŋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ mɩ walɩmʋ.

english_verse: I will punish you terribly and burn away everything that makes you unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa a jʋʋ ma lɛ, a lɩɩsɛ disiŋ-la kala sɩ hɛ ma lɛ a nagɛ hɔɔ-bɩnɩŋ, a nagɛ ba sɩ yie lɩɩsɛ hɔɔŋ disiniŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will choose judges and advisors like those you had before. Your new name will be “Justice and Faithfulness.” The Lord Will Save Jerusalem
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ bibemma nagɛ faafaa-la nɩaa, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlɛma jaŋ bɩra nagɛ bumbuŋ nɩalɩŋ. Nɩaa jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ Jerusalɛm tabal-la nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, taŋ-la nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, you will be saved by showing justice; Zion's people who turn to me will be saved by doing right.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, ʋ jaŋ laa Jerusalɛm nɩaa ta, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla.

english_verse: But those rebellious sinners who turn against me, the Lord, will all disappear.
translation_verse: Ama ba jaŋ chei nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kala sʋʋ.

english_verse: You will be like a grove of trees dying in a drought.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ nagɛ piiŋ-chigee hɩlɩŋ sɩ chɩna ba pɩpaarɩŋ yuori, koo a nagɛ lɩga tʋɔŋ kɩaa ba sɩ bɩ lɩɩŋ mɩsa ba hɩl.

english_verse: Your strongest leaders will be like dry wood set on fire by their idols. No one will be able to help, as they all go up in flames.
translation_verse: A nagɛ nyiŋ-pʋgʋmʋŋ sɩ yie tel ya-hɩlɩŋ lɛ ʋ chol ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩaa deemba sɩ ŋaa nɩduoru, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ gʋra cheiba, ka nʋʋkala tuo sɩ jaŋ laaba ta.

english_verse: This is the message I was given about Judah and Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba nɛ Wɩa joŋo dagɛ Amos nanʋala Azaaya a mʋ tɩgɛ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm tinteeŋ lɛ.
