english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills; every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa dɩdɛrɩŋ, La TƖƖNA peel-la nyuŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ chɩna jaŋ kɩɩ peelee kala. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ sii je kɩɩ dundolo kala, dɩ dʋnɩa tinteyee kala gire mʋ lee-la.

english_verse: Many people will come and say, “Let's go to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ jaŋ kɔ a bʋl, “Má kɔ dɩ la jɩl La TƖƖNA peel-la nyuŋ, a mʋ Jekɔb Wɩa dɩa. La TƖƖNA jaŋ dagɛla ʋ wombiee, dɩ la tuto. Wɩa jaŋ dagɛla ʋ wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto a lɩɩ Zaayɔŋ lɛ. La TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa jaŋ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm nɛ.”

english_verse: He will settle arguments between nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ laa tinteyee nɩaa wɩaa a jɩma pɩba, aŋ kɛŋ ba nɩ-daŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa sɩma. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ ba tokobiee a libi pirisiŋ, aŋ kɛŋ ba tiŋŋee ma a libi sɩɩkɔrʋsʋŋ. Tintee kala bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋ tokobiiŋ a je ʋ dɔŋɔ lɛ, koo a bɩra gʋnnɛ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ.

english_verse: People of Israel, let's live by the light of the Lord. Following Sinful Customs
translation_verse: Ou, Jekɔb doho nɩaa, má kɔ dɩ la vɛŋ La TƖƖNA pʋlʋmʋŋ lɛ. La TƖƖNA tapʋlʋŋ

english_verse: Our Lord, you have deserted your people, Israel, because they follow customs of nations from the east. They worship Philistine gods and are close friends of foreigners.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ vɩa ŋ nɩaa nɛ, Jekɔb doho nɩalɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa baa ŋaa vʋgʋrʋ wɩaa nɛ, wɩalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ ŋaa. Baa to nɩwogusuŋ naabarɩŋ wombiee nɛ.

english_verse: They have endless treasures of silver and gold; they have countless horses and war chariots.
translation_verse: Ba tinteeŋ kala nɛ suo arɩ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ, ba dʋa bɩ dɩdɛrɩŋ kɛnɛ. Janɩŋ su ba tinteeŋ nɛ woruŋ, ba janɩŋ torukoba ma bɩ nii kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Everywhere in the country they worship the idols they have made.
translation_verse: Ba tinteeŋ suo nɛ arɩ vʋɩyaa, baa kpirimi kɩalɩŋ ba tɩtɩa sɩ ŋaa teeŋ, a dɛnnɛ kɩalɩŋ ba tɩtɩa sɩ mɛ.

english_verse: And so, all of them will be ashamed and disgraced. Don't forgive them! A Day of Judgment
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine sɩaa jaŋ tuu tinteeŋ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ nʋʋkala muuri. La TƖƖNA bɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛba.

english_verse: Every one of you, go hide among the rocks and in the ground, because the Lord is fearsome, marvelous, and glorious.
translation_verse: Má jʋʋ bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ, má jʋʋ faa tinteeŋ bʋɔsʋŋ lɛ a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA doluŋ arɩ ʋ tʋla wɩaa.

english_verse: When the Lord comes, everyone who is proud will be made humble, and the Lord alone will be honored.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ jaŋ kɔ, nuhuobiine dagɛ ŋ-tɩtɩɩ arɩ ʋ babii-ballɩŋ kala jaŋ dɛrɛ. La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has chosen a day when those who are proud and conceited will be put down.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa je sɩaa tuu tinteeŋ.

english_verse: all high mountains and hills,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, peel-leŋie-la arɩ dundolluŋ kala jaŋ tuu tinteeŋ.

english_verse: all the seagoing ships, and every beautiful boat.
translation_verse: Ma lɩɩŋ daabori-bala-la kala ma sɩ kaa dii bayalɩŋ jaŋ chei.

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone who is proud will be put down. Only the Lord will be honored.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine dagɛ ŋ-tɩtɩɩ arɩ ʋ babii-ballɩŋ kala jaŋ dɛrɛ. La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ.

english_verse: Idols will be gone for good.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tɔmɔ-la kala nyɩɩgɛ.

english_verse: You had better hide in caves and holes— the Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ sii dɩ ʋ kɛŋ tinteeŋ a jigisi, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛŋ nɩaa dɩ ba fá jʋʋ bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ arɩ tintee-bʋɔsʋŋ a faa a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA tʋla arɩ ʋ doluŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: On that day everyone will throw to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold they made to worship.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, nuhuobiinee jaŋ joŋ tɔmɔ-la kala ba sɩ kɛŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ libi a kpʋkpaarɛ, a yuo pɩ taatɩaa arɩ jɩnnɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth— they will hide in caves and in the hills.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tinteeŋ jigisi, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛŋ nɩaa dɩ ba fá jʋʋ bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ arɩ bʋ-pɛgɩsɩŋ a faa, a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA tʋla arɩ ʋ doluŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Stop trusting the power of humans. They are all going to die, so how can they help?
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma yɩɛlaa joŋo hɛ nuhuobiine lɛ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni aŋ sʋʋ. Ʋ bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful is going to take away from Jerusalem and Judah everything you need— your bread and water, *
translation_verse: Má bee na, La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩɩ pɩ Juda doho nɩaa arɩ Jerusalɛm tɩŋŋaa kʋdiilee arɩ lɩɩŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma bɩra sɩ́ kɩaa deemba na.

english_verse: soldiers and heroes, judges and prophets, leaders and army officers,
translation_verse: Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ laalɩyuori-wajɩaba arɩ laalɩyuoroo arɩ sarɩya diiree, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa, vʋgʋraa arɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ.

english_verse: He will let children and babies become your rulers.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋaa dɩ hambiisiŋ nɛ bibemba.

english_verse: You will each be cruel to friends and neighbors. Young people will insult their elders; no one will show respect to those who deserve it.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ nyagɛ dɔŋɔ bibil. Nɩaa jaŋ sii chɩŋ dɔŋɔba lɛ, nandɔsʋŋ jaŋ yʋ dɔŋɔba wɩaa. Hambiisiŋ bɩ jaŋ zizil nɩhɩasɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ lee kɛnɛ ma paala bɩ jaŋ zizil nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ lee.

english_verse: Some of you will grab hold of a relative and say, “You still have a coat. Be our leader and rule this pile of ruins.”
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kʋ yi bʋa kʋbala lɛ dɩ dɩa nɩaa lɩɩsɛ ba naambiiriŋ dɔŋɔ a bʋla pʋ, “Ŋaa la kuoro, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ-na ha paala kɛŋ gɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋ sɩ jaŋ laalɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ŋaa la sɩpaalaara bʋa deeŋ lɛ la sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ.”

english_verse: But the answer will be, “I can't do you any good. Don't make me your leader. There's no food or clothing left in my house.”
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la ba sɩ lɩɩsa jaŋ bʋl, “Aɩ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ ma lɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo laa ma sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ kʋdiilee koo gɛnnɩŋ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem and Judah, you rebelled against your glorious Lord— your words and your actions, made you stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm tinteeŋ bɩ chɩna, Juda ma titel, bɛɛ wɩaa ba wʋbʋlaa arɩ ba wʋŋaalaa kala bɩ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ ka tɔrɛ, ba vɩaʋ nɛ, ba bɩ kaa faʋ arɩ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋla ma kala.

english_verse: The look on your faces shows that you are sinful as Sodom, and you don't try to hide it. You are in for trouble, and you have brought it all on yourselves. The Wrong Kind of Leaders
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ beŋ ba sɩaa lɛ, ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaara nɛ. Ba yie ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ a nagɛ Sodom tɩŋŋaa fa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ, ba bɩ kaa fɩfaa. Ba jaŋ na hɛɛŋ, ba tɩtɩa nɛ lɛrɛ wʋlɔrʋŋ deeŋ kʋʋ hɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Tell those who obey God, “You're very fortunate— you will be rewarded for what you have done.”
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla dɩ ba jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, wɩaa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ pɩba. Ba jaŋ dii ba wʋzɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa nyʋʋrʋŋ.

english_verse: Tell those who disobey, “You're in big trouble— what you did to others will come back to you.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ, wʋlɔrʋŋ jʋʋba nɛ. Wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa nɩaa lɛ chɩmɩŋ jaŋ tiŋ ba tɩtɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Though you are God's people, you are ruled and abused by women and children. You are confused by leaders who guide you down the wrong path.
translation_verse: Má bee na mɩ nɩaa, hambiisiŋ nɩɩ dɔgɩsɛba, haalaa ma bibemba. Ou mɩ nɩaa, ma sɩpaalaaraa leŋe ma yeŋŋi nɛ a joŋ wombiiŋ ta.

english_verse: The Lord is ready to accuse and judge all nations.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ʋ dii ʋ nɩaa sarɩya.

english_verse: He will even judge you rulers and leaders of his own nation. You destroyed his vineyard and filled your houses by robbing the poor.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ dii ʋ nɩaa nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ ba sɩpaalaaraa sarɩya. Ʋ sɩ, “Ma dii mɩ tinteeŋ kala kpʋ nɛ, a gɩrɩma laa summoo kɩaa a kaa mʋ su ma dɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says, “You have crushed my people and rubbed in the dirt the faces of the poor.” The Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ, “Ma bɩ wombiiŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ma nʋɔsɛ mɩ nɩaa bil tinteeŋ a kɛŋ summoo jɩla tutuu.”

english_verse: The Lord says: The women of Jerusalem are proud and strut around, winking shamelessly. They wear anklets that jingle and call attention to the way they walk.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Ma bee na Jerusalɛm haalaa sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ, ba yie kpɩɛrɛ ba tɩtɩa nɛ a fɩɛla vɩvɛŋ, ka ba naahɔɔnʋŋ dʋdɔŋ aŋ kɛŋ nyuŋ je a gɔllɔ kɛŋ ba sɩaa kukosi baalaa.”

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will cover their heads with sores, and I will uncover their private parts.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ naawɩɩlaa ŋaa Jerusalɛm haalaa nyusoo lɛ dɩ ba puori.

english_verse: In place of perfume, there will be a stink; in place of belts, there will be ropes; in place of fancy hairdos, they will have bald heads. Instead of expensive clothes, they will wear sackcloth; instead of beauty, they will have ugly scars.
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi, ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba yaraa sʋɔra sɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ mɩɩra sʋsʋɔrɛ kʋpʋɔŋ. Ba sɩ cho dɩ baa vɔɔ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bii-zɔŋŋɔɔ ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ mɩɩra vʋvɔɔ ŋmɛsɩŋ. Ba sɩ cho dɩ ba nyu-pʋnaa mɩɛla ŋɩɩ, ba nyusoo jaŋ mɩɩra puori. Ba sɩ cho baa vɔɔ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ ŋɩɩ, gɛrɛ-kɔsʋmɔɔ nɛ ba jaŋ mɩɩra vʋvɔɔ. Ba zɔmʋŋ kala jaŋ lɛl ka dɩ ba yaraa kala ŋaa fʋfʋʋnʋŋ.

english_verse: The fighting men of Jerusalem will be killed in battle.
translation_verse: Ma baalaa arɩ ma laalɩyuori-wajɩaba kala jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The city will mourn and sit in the dirt, emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm kala jaŋ ŋaa yele dɩ ba tɩta jembiee. Ʋ jaŋ wuoli a nagɛ summo sɩ hɔnɔ a bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: When this happens, seven women will grab the same man, and each of them will say, “I'll buy my own food and clothes! Just marry me and take away my disgrace.” The Lord Will Bless His People Who Survive
translation_verse: Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ kʋ yi, haalaa balɩpɛ jaŋ kɛŋ ba-bala aŋ bʋl, “La jaŋ chɛ a didii aŋ chɛ gɛnnɩŋ ma a vʋvɔɔ la tɩtɩa lɛ. Ŋ-na yaa leŋ dɩ ba yɩyɩrɛla ŋ haalaa a tɔ la hɩɩsɩŋ.” La TƖƖNA jaŋ bɩra laa Jerusalɛm nɩaa

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will make his land fruitful and glorious again, and the people of Israel who survive will take great pride in what the land produces.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala harɩŋ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tinteeŋ zɔŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ sʋba. Ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ba bibigisi a tɩŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ pɛrɛ sɩ jaŋ wasɛ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who is left alive in Jerusalem will be called special,
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ka Jerusalɛm lɛ a bɩ sʋba, nɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, ba jaŋ yɩrɛba tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: after the Lord sends a fiery judgment to clean the city and its people of their violent deeds.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɩɩsɛ Jerusalɛm haalaa disiniŋ ta arɩ chal-la kala sɩ jaasɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ aŋ dii nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la sarɩya arɩ nyiniŋ.

english_verse: Then the Lord will cover the whole city and its meeting places with a thick cloud each day and with a flaming fire each night. God's own glory will be like a huge tent that covers everything.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ tʋla kʋ chu tɔ ʋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ hilimi nɩmɛ. Wɩɩhɛyɛ ʋ jaŋ nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ, tɩtaŋɩŋ ma ʋ nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ. La TƖƖNA tʋla jaŋ chu tɔ ʋ nɩaa kala.

english_verse: It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.
translation_verse: Ʋ tʋla-la jaŋ nagɛ fɩɛlɩŋ sɩ tɔ hɛ ba lɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ, aa kɛrɛ wʋbɔŋ kala, aŋ pɛ kɛrɛ duoŋ-peliŋ ma sɩ jaŋ lu nɩmɛ.

english_verse: I will sing a song about my friend's vineyard that was on the side of a fertile hill.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ a pɩ nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ cho, yɩɩl-la mʋʋ tɩgɛ ʋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga lɛ nɛ. Mɩ nandɔŋɔ kɛŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga nɛ tintee-sɩŋ kʋbala lɛ peeliŋ sɛmɛ.

english_verse: My friend dug the ground, removed the stones, and planted the best vines. He built a watchtower and dug a pit in rocky ground for pressing the grapes. He hoped they would be sweet, but bitter grapes were all it produced.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bugili baga-la tinteeŋ kala a tʋɔsɛ tabɩaa ta, aŋ chɔnsɛ tɩɩsɩ-la ʋ sɩ cho baga-la lɛ, a saa dɩɩ-leŋiŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ chɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ aŋ bibeŋ baga-la, aŋ lu buotuoŋ ba sɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ tɩɩnɛnɛ-la hɛ a chɩchagɛ ba lɩɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ gbɛrɛ dɩ tɩɩsɩ-la nɛŋ nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ, ba mɩɩra nɛŋ nɛŋ-lɔrʋnʋŋ dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: Listen, people of Jerusalem and of Judah! You be the judge of me and my vineyard.
translation_verse: “Lɛɛlɛ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ, má laa mɩ dɩ mɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga-la wɩaa a jɩma pɩmɛ.

english_verse: What more could I have done for my vineyard? I hoped for sweet grapes, but bitter grapes were all that grew.
translation_verse: Wʋbɛɛ nɛ fa maga dɩ mɩ ŋaa mɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga-la lɛ ka mɩ bɩ ŋaa? Mɩ faa chɛ dɩ ʋ nɛŋ nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, ka ʋ mɩɩra nɛŋ nɛŋ-lɔrʋnʋŋ dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: Now I will let you know what I am going to do. I will cut down the hedge and tear down the wall. My vineyard will be trampled and left in ruins.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa mɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga-la lɛ a pɩma. Mɩ jaŋ kɩɛsɛ lɩga-la aŋ ka dɩ ʋ kala chei, mɩ jaŋ ŋmoo ʋ jebii-la lo ka dɩ baga kɩaa jʋʋ didii tɩɩnɛnɛ-la.

english_verse: It will turn into a desert, neither pruned nor hoed; it will be covered with thorns and briars. I will command the clouds not to send rain.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ vɩa tintee-la ta dɩ ʋ bɩrɩmɛ kʋŋkʋlʋŋ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ buori tɩɩsɩ-la koo a pɛrɛ nɩmɛ. Yaŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ jaŋ tɔ ʋ kala. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! Israel is the vineyard, and Judah is the garden I tended with care. I had hoped for honesty and for justice, but dishonesty and cries for mercy were all I found. Isaiah Condemns Social Injustice
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna tɩɩnɛnɛɛ baga-la nɛ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa, Juda doho ma nɛ ŋaa tɩɩsɩ-la ʋ sɩ chɔnsɔ, ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ba nyuŋ. Ʋ yie cho dɩ baa to wʋtɩtɩɩ ka ba kpʋkpʋ nɩaa. Ʋ yie cho dɩ baa ŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa, ka nɩaa yiyel kɩŋkɛŋ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ tinteyee a pɛ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛnɛ lɛ a bɩ lee-kala ka, ka dɩ ma dʋndʋŋa hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful has made this promise to me: Those large and beautiful homes will be left empty, with no one to take care of them.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ma dɩɩ-balaa deemba jaŋ pɩŋ hoi, ma dɩɩ-zɔmɔ-la jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break.
translation_verse: Ba laalɩyuoroo kʋbala ma bɩ jaŋ lɔl, koo a joŋ ʋ naaŋ a ŋmoo. Ba kʋbala ma bɩ jaŋ dɩɛgɛ koo a pɩŋ doŋ. Ba kʋŋkala tɩŋ-gɛnnɛ ma bɩ jaŋ jɔl ʋ tɩŋa, ba nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ ma ŋmɛnɩŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛrɛ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ ʋ nagɛ ŋmɛnɩŋ ba kaa lɛrɛ wʋcheelee arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tuto ba harɩŋ, a nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ lɩlɛrɛ torukoba ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You get up early to start drinking, and you keep it up late into the night.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie sii chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla a kire to sɩnɩŋ harɩŋ, a nyʋa ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ taŋ mʋ siesi a kala bugi.

english_verse: At your drinking parties you have the music of stringed instruments, tambourines, and flutes. But you never even think about all the Lord has done,
translation_verse: Dɩ ba gbielee ma lɛ nɛ, ba yie du chenniŋ arɩ ba kɔnɛba a chɩgɩsɛ chɩnchɩgɩsɩŋ a ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlaa hɛ, aŋ nyʋnyʋa sɩnɩŋ. Ama ba paala bɩ wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa kaa tɩtɩŋ, ba sɩpaaŋ tuo ba lɛ.

english_verse: and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba jaŋ kɛsɛ mɩ nɩaa a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga, a tɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ. Losuŋ jaŋ kpʋ ba sɩpaalaaraa dɩ ba sʋʋ, ka dɩ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ ma chaasa kɛŋ ba nɩ-daŋ.

english_verse: The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a gbɛrɛ, sʋʋŋ bʋa faasa suri niiŋ nɛ, dɩ Jerusalɛm nɩbalaa arɩ ba nɩ-daŋ-la kala sɩɩ ŋaa goŋ jʋʋ-ʋ.

english_verse: Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine sɩaa jaŋ tuu tinteeŋ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ nʋʋkala muuri, dɩ nuhuobiinee babii-ballɩŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: But the holy Lord God All-Powerful is praised, because he has shown who he is by bringing justice.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ a tɩŋ ʋ tɛŋɛ wɩaa. Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ jaŋ dii ʋ nɩaa sarɩya arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ dɩ ŋɩɩ dagɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋla Tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: His people will be like sheep grazing in their own pasture, and they will take off what was left by others.
translation_verse: Ba tinteeŋ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ dɩ piesee arɩ bʋ-pɔrɔɔ didii yaŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: And you say, “Let the holy God of Israel hurry up and do what he has promised, so we can see it for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ yie bʋl, “Má leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA ŋaa lɩma a ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ la na. Má leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bɩɩnɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa, dɩ la kala jɩŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: And you are great at drinking and mixing drinks. But you are in for trouble.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa sɩ-nyʋarʋ-babiibalaa a yie wuo joŋ sɩ-duoruŋ a guoli dɔŋɔ lɛ aa nyʋa,

english_verse: You accept bribes to let the guilty go free, and you cheat the innocent out of a fair trial.
translation_verse: nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie laa kpalaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ chei wɩaa teeŋ aŋ jomba ta, aŋ vɩa dɩ ba bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ a laa pɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye lɛ.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again. Foreign Nations Will Attack
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ nɛ ʋ nɩaa nyuŋ, a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ kpʋ ʋ nɩaa. Peelee jaŋ jigisi dɩ nɩaa sʋʋ a yieni a nagɛ nʋsʋrʋŋ sɩ pɩŋ womporoo lɛ. Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa ka ʋ baanɩŋ ha bɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ, ʋ ha kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛ ʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord has signaled for the foreign nations to come and attack you. He has already whistled, and they are coming as fast as they can.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA hɛ duoso nɛ pɩpɩ tinteye-la sɩ hɛ dɩ-bolii, aŋ ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlʋŋ ma a yɩyɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ. Na ba nɛ fá kʋkɔ ŋɩɩ lɩma lɩma.

english_verse: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Ba to-hɛŋŋɛɛ kɛŋ niiŋ nɛ woruŋ, ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ba yuo ba tosuŋ, ba janɩŋ naachɛŋŋɛɛ ma dolie a nagɛ naŋkpachɩllɩŋ nɛ, ba janɩŋ torukoba ma fɩfá a nagɛ pel-vinvilimiŋ.

english_verse: They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them.
translation_verse: Ba laalɩyuoro-la tʋɔrʋ a nagɛ naachigiŋ nɛ ba huoso nagɛ naachigi-biisiŋ sɩ kpʋ kʋa aŋ hʋhʋʋnɛ, ka nʋʋkala tuo sɩ jaŋ laaʋ ta.

english_verse: On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la huuro jaŋ huuri nɩaa nyuŋ a nagɛ mʋga sɩɩ huuru, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ beŋ tintee-la, ʋ jaŋ na leriŋ kala bire dɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa jaŋ leŋ dɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ bɩrɩmɛ birimiŋ.

english_verse: In the year that King Uzziah died, I had a vision of the Lord. He was on his throne high above, and his robe filled the temple.
translation_verse: Jɩna-la lɛ kuoro Uzia fa sɩ sʋba nɛ mɩ na La TƖƖNA a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ a yʋga kɩɩ kʋŋkala, ʋ gɛrɩŋ jɛrɛ su Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: Flaming creatures with six wings each were flying over him. They covered their faces with two of their wings and their bodies with two more. They used the other two wings for flying,
translation_verse: Kɩa kʋbalaba sɩ chaana a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa, chugili ʋ nyuŋ. Ba kʋŋkala kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ balɩdʋ nɛ. Ba kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩ-la balɩa balɩa a tɔ ba sɩaa, a kɛŋ balɩa balɩa ma a tɔ ba naasɩŋ, aŋ kɛŋ balɩa balɩa ma fifil.

english_verse: As they shouted, the doorposts of the temple shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.
translation_verse: Ba sɩɩ ŋaa goŋ-la ŋɩɩ, Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ jigisi, nyʋɔsʋŋ tɔ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ kala.

english_verse: Then I cried out, “I'm doomed! Everything I say is sinful, and so are the words of everyone around me. Yet I have seen the King, the Lord All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ a bʋl, “Wɩɩŋ jʋʋmɛ, mɩ sʋʋ dɛrɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ to mɩ niiŋ lɩlɩɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ ma mɩ sɩ hɛ wʋbʋlaa kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, ka mɩ na La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa kuoro.”

english_verse: One of the flaming creatures flew over to me with a burning coal that it had taken from the altar with a pair of metal tongs.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kɩalɩŋ dɔŋɔ file kɔ mɩ teeŋ a kɛŋ chɛŋŋɛɛ chɛbɛ joŋ nyiŋ-halɩŋ, ʋ fa lɩɩsɛ nyiŋ-hal-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: It touched my lips with the hot coal and said, “This has touched your lips. Your sins are forgiven, and you are no longer guilty.”
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ nyiŋ-hal-la kʋ digi mɩ niiŋ lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Bee na, nyiniŋ deeŋ sɩ digi ŋ niipinee ŋ-la, ŋ wʋcheelee arɩ ŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɛ mɩ pɩɩsa ta ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the Lord ask, “Is there anyone I can send? Will someone speak for us?” “I'll go,” I answered. “Send me!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ La TƖƖNA yikoro dɩ ʋ pɩɛsa, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ laa la nyuŋ a mʋ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Namɛ, tɩmmɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to go and speak this message to the people: “You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.” The Lord also said,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Mʋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, ba jaŋ nɩnɩɩ wɩaa aŋ bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ, a nɩna wɩaa aŋ bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: “Make these people stubborn! Make them stop up their ears, cover their eyes, and fail to understand. Don't let them turn to me and be healed.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl, “Leŋ dɩ nɩaa deemba tʋɔŋ dol, ŋaa dɩ ba dɩgɩlaa kparɩmɛ, aŋ ŋaa dɩ ba sɩaa ma tɔ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ba jaŋ na wɩaa koo a nɩɩ wɩaa a bɩrɩmɛ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa a kɔ mɩ teeŋ dɩ mɩ laaba ta.”

english_verse: Then I asked the Lord, “How long will this last?” The Lord answered: Until their towns are destroyed and their houses are deserted, until their fields are empty,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩɛsɛ, “La TƖƖNA ɛɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ jaŋ diene magɛ?” Ʋ bʋl, “See dɩ ba tabalaa cheye a pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, dɩ nɩaa tuo ba lɛ dɩ ba dɩɩsɩŋ kala wuoli, dɩ ba bagɩsɩŋ ma kala pɩŋ kʋŋkʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: and I have sent them far away, leaving their land in ruins.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛŋ ba kala kaa mʋ dɩ-bolii ka ba tinteeŋ pɩŋ pɛɩ.

english_verse: If only a tenth of the people are left, even they will be destroyed. But just as stumps remain after trees have been cut down, some of my chosen ones will be left.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa fii tʋɔŋ, nɩbala ma nɛ paala ka tintee-la lɛ, ʋ ha jaŋ bɩra pɩŋ hoi. Nɩɩ-la jaŋ nagɛ piiŋ tɩa ba sɩ kere ta aŋ ka ʋ gentine bɩra tɔsɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩaa ma jaŋ nagɛ tɩa-gentine tintee-la lɛ.”

english_verse: When news reached the royal palace that Syria had joined forces with Israel, King Ahaz and everyone in Judah were so terrified that they shook like trees in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Devit doho nɩaa sɩ kʋ nɩɩ arɩ Siiria tɩŋŋaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛ niiŋ nɛ dɩ ba yuoba, ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahas arɩ ʋ nɩaa bɔyɛ joŋ ba chichel, a nagɛ peliŋ sɩ yie lu a kɛŋ tɩɩsɩŋ jijigisi ŋɩɩ duuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to me: Take your son Shearjashub and go see King Ahaz. You will find him on the road near the cloth makers' shops at the end of the canal that brings water from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Azaaya, “Kɛŋ ŋ nanʋala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩa Jasub dɩ ma mʋ Ahas teeŋ. Ʋ nɛ hɛ lee-la lɩɩ-la sɩ pɛllɛ lɩɩ nyuŋ arɩ lɩɩ-libe-la ba sɩ kpɛrɛ lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ jʋjʋʋ taŋ-la sɩ kʋ cheŋ dɔŋɔ, wombii-la lɛ gɛrɩpɛ yuoroo sɩɩ chɛsɛ gɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Tell Ahaz to stop worrying. There's no need for him to be afraid of King Rezin and King Pekah. They are very angry, but they are nothing more than a dying fire. Ahaz doesn't need to fear
translation_verse: Bʋla pʋ, dɩ ʋ fɩɛlɛ ʋ sɩaa a leŋ dɩ ʋ yaraa pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ dɩ ʋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ. Bɛɛ wɩaa, baaŋ-la Reziŋ arɩ Siiria tɩŋŋaa arɩ Remalia nanʋala Pɛka sɩ faasa na bɩ kʋŋkala ŋaa, ʋ nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩ hɛ daa-kuuŋ lɛ a chɩchɛ ʋ dɩsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: to invade and defeat Judah and Jerusalem and to let the son of Tabeel be king in his place.
translation_verse: ‘Má leŋ dɩ la jʋʋ yuo Juda, a kɛnʋ pʋɔsa kpaa dɔŋɔ, aŋ leŋ dɩ Tabɛɛl nanʋala nɛ dii kuoruŋ nɩmɛ.’

english_verse: Damascus is just the capital of Syria, and King Rezin rules only in Damascus. Samaria is just the capital of Israel, and King Pekah rules only in Samaria. But in less than
translation_verse: Iziral tabalɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Samarɩa, Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa kuoro nɛ Pɛka sɩ ŋaa Remalia nanʋala. Dɩ ma nɛ saa bɩ ma Wɩa laa diiniŋ lɛ chɩna kpaŋkpaŋ, ma bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ dɩ-chɩnɩɩ kala.”

english_verse: “Ask me for proof that my promise will come true. Ask for something to happen deep in the world of the dead or high in the heavens above.”
translation_verse: “Sʋl mɩ-na, ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩ mɩ pɩŋ magɩlɩŋ, a lɩɩ tinteeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ koo wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii.”

english_verse: “No, Lord,” Ahaz answered. “I won't test you!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahas bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩkala a magɩsɛ mɩ TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: Then I said: Listen, every one of you in the royal family of David. You have already tried my patience. Now you are trying God's patience by refusing to ask for proof.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Azaaya ma bʋl, “Má jegili daha, kuoro Devit doho nɩaa, ma magɩsɛ nuhuobiine nɛ dɩ ma na ʋ kenyiri sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ, ma saa chɛ dɩ ma magɩsɛ Wɩa ma a na ʋ kenyiri sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ nɛɛ?

english_verse: But the Lord will still give you proof. A virgin is pregnant; she will have a son and will name him Immanuel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma na magɩlɩŋ. Hatolo ha sɩ bɩ baal jɩŋ jaŋ kɛŋ luoruŋ a lʋl hambolibie, a hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Ɩmanʋɛl.

english_verse: Even before the boy is old enough to know how to choose between right and wrong, he will eat yogurt and honey, and the countries of the two kings you fear will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ka dɩ bile-na kʋ jɩŋ wɩaa a magɛ dɩ ʋ vɩa wʋbɔmʋŋ aŋ lɩɩsɛ wʋzɔmʋŋ, kuorusu-la balɩa sɩ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ kɩŋkɛŋ hɛ ma lɛ, ba tinteeŋ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: But the Lord will make more trouble for your people and your kingdom than any of you have known since Israel broke away from Judah. He will even bring the king of Assyria to attack you. The Threat of an Invasion
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ lɔgɛ wɩaa hɛ ŋ dɩ ŋ nɩaa arɩ ŋ nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa kala lɛ, wɩalɩŋ doho ma ha sɩ bɩ na aŋ ka a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ Iziral arɩ Juda tinteeŋ sɩ pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ Asiiria kuoro kʋ hɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: When that time comes, the Lord will whistle, and armies will come from Egypt like flies and from Assyria like bees.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlʋŋ a yɩrɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba lɩɩ dɩ-bolii kɔ a nagɛ nanchʋɔsʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ fuonuŋ lɛ, dɩ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa ma lɩɩ ba tinteeŋ kɔ a nagɛ tʋʋ-biee.

english_verse: They will settle everywhere—in the deep valleys and between the rocks, on every thornbush and all over the pastureland.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kʋ jʋʋ su ma fuonaasɩ-la kala sɩ luŋie arɩ bʋ-pɛgɩsɩŋ arɩ lere-la kala sɩ kɛŋ sɔsʋŋ arɩ lere-la sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will pay the king of Assyria to bring a razor from across the Euphrates River and shave your head and every hair on your body, including your beard.
translation_verse: Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛŋ Asiiria kuoro a lɩɩ Yufireti fuo-la harɩŋ kɔ. Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ nyu-fʋna a fʋŋ ma nyu-pʋnaa arɩ ma naapʋnaa arɩ ma tɔŋŋɔɔ kala.

english_verse: Anyone who is able to save only one young cow and two sheep,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, baala jaŋ kɛŋ nɛ-pa-bie arɩ bʋʋnaa balɩa dʋndʋŋ,

english_verse: will have enough milk to make yogurt. In fact, everyone left in the land will eat yogurt and honey.
translation_verse: ama a tɩŋ pʋsʋŋ deemba sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ yɩlɩŋ yʋgɛ ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ na nɛyɩl-dɩndɛrɩŋ a didii. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ sʋba aŋ ka tintee-la lɛ jaŋ dii nɛyɩl-dɩndɛrɩŋ arɩ tʋʋŋ.

english_verse: You will go there to hunt with your bow and arrows, because the whole country will be covered with thornbushes.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ mʋ nɩmɛ arɩ tosuŋ a bɩbagɩlɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa yaŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ tɔ ʋ kala.

english_verse: The hills where you once planted crops will be overgrown with thorns and thistles. You will be afraid to go there, and your cattle, sheep, and goats will be turned loose on those hills.
translation_verse: Dundollu-la nyuŋ ma fa sɩɩ pɛrʋ jaŋ tɔ arɩ yaŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ a kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ. Lee-la jaŋ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ nɛsɩŋ arɩ piesee dɩ-diiliŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Isaiah, get something to write on. Then write in big clear letters the name, MAHER-SHALAL-HASH-BAZ.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, “Joŋ teŋ-jalɩɩ a ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba hɛ: Maha-Salal-Hasɩ-Bas.

english_verse: I will tell Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah to serve as witnesses to this.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ Yuria sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara arɩ Jɛbɛrɩkaaya nanʋala Zɛkarɩya nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii dɩ ba kʋ ŋaa mɩ pɛ-naaraa.”

english_verse: Sometime later, my wife and I had a son, and the Lord said, “Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ dɩ haal-la sɩ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ pɛ bɔsɔ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ luoruŋ a lʋl hambolibie. La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Hɛ bile yɩrɩŋ Maha-Salal-Hasɩ-Bas.

english_verse: Because before he can say ‘Mommy’ or ‘Daddy,’ the king of Assyria will attack and take everything of value from Damascus and Samaria.”
translation_verse: Ka dɩ bile-na kʋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ bʋl: ‘Mɩ nyɩmma,’ koo ‘Mɩ naaŋ,’ Asiiria kuoro jaŋ paa Damasɩkʋs dʋa arɩ dʋa-la kala ba sɩ yuo laa Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa teeŋ a kaa viiri.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ,

english_verse: These people have refused the gentle waters of Shiloah and have gladly gone over to the side of King Rezin and King Pekah.
translation_verse: “A tɩŋ nɩaa deemba sɩ vɩa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ nagɛ lɩɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩɩ pɛllɛ mʋa mʋa a lɩlɩɩ Sɩlʋa fuo-la lɛ, aŋ jʋjʋɔsɛ Reziŋ arɩ Remalia nanʋala Pɛka wɩaa,

english_verse: Now I will send the king of Assyria against them with his powerful army, which will attack like the mighty Euphrates River overflowing its banks.
translation_verse: mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ Asiiria kuoro arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala kʋ yuo Juda tɩŋŋaa. Ba jaŋ kɔ a nagɛ Yufireti fuo-la lɩɩŋ sɩ suo a gbu lɩlɩɩ.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers will cover Judah like a flood reaching up to your neck. But God is with us. He will spread his wings and protect our land.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ tii paa Juda tɩŋŋaa kala a nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ pɛllɛ paa kɩaa. Ba jaŋ jɛrɛ tɔ tintee-la kala pɩlɩm pɩlɩm. Wɩa hɛ la teeŋ nɛ, a jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa jɛrɛ tɔla.”

english_verse: All of you foreign nations, go ahead and prepare for war, but you will be crushed.
translation_verse: Ma tintee wogusu-la kala, má leŋ dɩ ma bɔɩsɩŋ jujoŋ. Má jegile nɩɩ, ma nyɩgɩla nɛ a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa kɔ dɩ ma yuola, ama fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmma.

english_verse: The Lord took hold of me with his powerful hand and said: I'm warning you! Don't act like these people.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA chaasa kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa kpʋrɩsɛ mɩ dɩgɩlaa, dɩ mɩ sɩ́ wombii-la nɩaa deemba sɩɩ to joŋ. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: Don't call something a rebellious plot, just because they do, and don't be afraid of something, just because they are.
translation_verse: “Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ nɩaa deemba lɛ pɛ dɩ ma vʋʋrɛ wʋbɔŋ kala. Sɩ́ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ fá ma fá, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ bɔyɛ joŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: I am the one you should fear and respect. I am the holy God, the Lord All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga dɩ ma fɩfá.

english_verse: My message and my teachings are to be sealed and given to my followers.
translation_verse: Mɩ harɩ-tooroo, má pɔ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ a kɛmba woruŋ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, I patiently trust the Lord, even though he is no longer pleased with Israel.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ gbɛrɛ La TƖƖNA, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa faa Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: My children and I are warning signs to Israel from the Lord All-Powerful, who lives on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Na mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la. La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ hɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ, ʋ jonla la ŋaa magɩl nɛ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Someone may say to you, “Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods
translation_verse: Ama, nɩaa jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ ma mʋ vʋgʋraa arɩ chichiribee teeŋ a chɛ na wɩaa. Ba nɛ yie lʋaraa bʋl wɩaa arɩ yikori-bie ŋɩɩ. Wɩa dee nɩaa maga dɩ ba pɩɛsɛ a na wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ba ŋaa? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma pɩpɩɛsɛ nɩsʋʋnʋŋ dɩ ma na nɩweyee wɩaa?

english_verse: what it should do.” None of those who talk like that will live to see the light of day!
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla nɛ bɩ wombii-la La TƖƖNA sɩ daga lɛ to, ŋɩɩ-na ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: They will go around in great pain and will become so hungry that they will angrily curse their king and their gods. And when they try to find help in heaven
translation_verse: Tʋɔ-cheeŋ arɩ losuŋ jaŋ jʋʋba, dɩ ba gɔllɔ baarɛ tintee-la lɛ. Dɩ losu-la nɛ jʋʋba, ba baanɩŋ jaŋ sii woruŋ dɩ ba wʋla beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ a chɛ kʋŋ ka, aŋ bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tɩgɛ ba kuoro arɩ ba Wɩa lɛ.

english_verse: and on earth, they will find only trouble and darkness, terrible trouble and deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ beŋ tinteeŋ ma a chɛ kʋŋ ka, see tʋɔ-cheeŋ arɩ birimiŋ arɩ fawʋllʋŋ dʋndʋŋa, biriŋ-la tʋɔŋ nɛ ba jaŋ hɛ.

english_verse: But those who have suffered will no longer be in pain. The territories of Zebulun and Naphtali in Galilee were once hated. But this land of the Gentiles across the Jordan River and along the Mediterranean Sea will be greatly respected. War Is Over
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Faafaa-la Zebuluŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa dii hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, ama maachie lere-la yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ, a chɩŋ Mediterenia mʋga-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ tintee-la sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ arɩ Galilii tinteeŋ, lee-la nʋhʋɔraa sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: Those who walked in the dark have seen a bright light. And it shines upon everyone who lives in the land of darkest shadows.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ vɛŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ na pʋlʋŋ-bal nɛ. Tintee-la nɩaa fa sɩ hɛ birimiŋ lim tʋɔŋ, pʋlʋmʋŋ lɛɛlɛ chaanaa hɛ ba lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have made your nation stronger. Because of you, its people are glad and celebrate like workers at harvest time or like soldiers dividing up what they have taken.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛŋ tintee-la chʋʋla kɩɩ nɛ a leŋ ʋ nɩaa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ yʋgɛ, ba jʋjʋɔsɛ ŋ sɩpaaŋ, a nagɛ nɩaa sɩ yie jʋjʋɔsɛ ŋɩɩ dɩ ba nɩɩ ŋaa ba baga kɩaa, koo a nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɩaa sɩ yie jʋjʋɔsɛ dɩ ba nɛ kɛŋ dʋa-la ba sɩ yuo laa ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ teeŋ kpɩkpaa.

english_verse: You have broken the power of those who abused and enslaved your people. You have rescued them just as you saved your people from Midian.
translation_verse: Ŋ dʋɔrɛ hɛɛ-la fa sɩ nagɛ daaŋ a daŋ ba baŋŋaa lɛ nɛ, a lɩɩsɛba hɛɛ-la lɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ fa sɩ jomba hɛ. Ŋ yuo dii nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛba nɛ arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ fa sɩ yuo dii Midiaŋ tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: The boots of marching warriors and the blood-stained uniforms have been fed to flames and eaten by fire. A Child Has Been Born
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori-wajɩaba nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ arɩ ba gɛnnɩ-la sɩ fo arɩ chalɩŋ jaŋ dii nyiniŋ, ba jaŋ joŋo hɛ nyiniŋ,

english_verse: A child has been born for us. We have been given a son who will be our ruler. His names will be Wonderful Advisor and Mighty God, Eternal Father and Prince of Peace.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ba lʋl bii nɛ a pɩla, hambolibie nɛ ba joŋo pɩla, ʋ nɛ jaŋ bibenla. Ba jaŋ yɩyɩrʋ: Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ nɩaa chagɩlɩŋ ʋ dɔŋ tuo, Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ, Nyɩmma-la sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ, Kuori-bile sɩ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ kʋkɔ.

english_verse: His power will never end; peace will last forever. He will rule David's kingdom and make it grow strong. He will always rule with honesty and justice. The Lord All-Powerful will make certain that all of this is done. God Will Punish Israel
translation_verse: Ʋ kuoruŋ doluŋ arɩ ʋ fɩɛlɩŋ jaŋ pʋŋa pɩpɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, ʋ bɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ hɔŋ Devit kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ a beŋ ʋ nɩaa a kɛŋ kuorii-la woruŋ a leŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ tʋɔpʋla a benu a lɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nyuŋ sɩ nyaasɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa. La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ

english_verse: The Lord had warned the people of Israel,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl wʋbɔŋ nɛ a tɩgɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ, wɩɩ-la jaŋ jʋʋ Jekɔb doho nɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: and all of them knew it, including everyone in the capital city of Samaria. But they were proud and stubborn and said,
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ: Efirem tɩmma-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Samarɩa lɛ, sɩɩ-duo tɩmma-la sɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa a bʋl,

english_verse: “Houses of brick and sycamore have fallen to the ground, but we will build houses with stones and cedar.”
translation_verse: “Toŋgolumoo dɩa-la tele nɛ, la-na jaŋ kɛŋ tabɩaa ba sɩ wasa ta, a saa. Ba keri tutogusu-la kala lo nɛ, la-na jaŋ chɔnsɛ kuolu tɩɩsɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ.”

english_verse: He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them.
translation_verse: Siiria tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, arɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, ba jaŋ yuo dii Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa, ama La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ ha bɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ, ʋ ha jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a pɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, Iziral tɩŋŋaa ha vɩa nɛ dɩ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ aŋ kɔ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ dɔgɩsɛba teeŋ.

english_verse: In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, tapʋl-bala nɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ, a keri Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ arɩ ba bʋbʋɔ-doho kala ta, ba naakelee arɩ ba pɩpaarɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Their rulers and leaders were the head, and the lying prophets were the tail.
translation_verse: Ba nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ ba nɩbala-la nɛ ŋaa nyuŋ-la, Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la ma sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ ŋaa bʋbʋɔ-doho-la.

english_verse: They had led the nation down the wrong path, and the people were confused.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba nɛ laa ba sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba yeŋŋi, ba nɛ dagɛ nɩalɩŋ ba lɛl.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with his people and kept punishing them, because they had turned against him. They were evil and spoke foolishly. That's why he did not have pity on their young people or on their widows and orphans.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba-pʋɔsa-la kʋŋkala fori. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ fá biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa ma nenige, bɛɛ wɩaa ba kʋŋkala bɩ Wɩa ka fá, aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, a kala bʋbʋl wʋtɔɔnʋŋ. Wɩaa deemba kala lɛ, La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ ha bɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ, ʋ ha jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a pɛ.

english_verse: Evil had spread like a raging forest fire sending thornbushes up in smoke.
translation_verse: Tɛŋɛ, nɩalɩŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩɩ dii nɛ, ʋ yie dii ya-kʋɔŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ a chol duuŋ nyiŋgeliŋ sisii, nyʋɔsʋŋ sii tɔ dugugu.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna baanɩŋ jaŋ nagɛ nyiniŋ a dii tintee-la arɩ nɩaa kala. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ fá ʋ naambie nenige.

english_verse: like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛŋ ba nadiiŋ kuogi kɩaa dii ka dɩ losuŋ ha kɛmba, a kɛŋ nagʋa ma kuogo dii, ka dɩ losuŋ ha kɛmba. Ba jaŋ gʋra kɛsɛ ba biiriŋ a chɩchaŋ.

english_verse: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.
translation_verse: Manasɛ arɩ Efirem nɩaa jaŋ gʋra yuyuo dɔŋɔ, ba balɩa-la ma jaŋ bɩra gbaara yuyuo Juda. Wɩaa deemba kala lɛ La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ ha bɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ, ʋ ha jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a pɛ.

english_verse: You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bil wombie-la sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ ka to, a dʋdɔgɩsɛ mɩ nɩaa,

english_verse: But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables?
translation_verse: Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ ŋaa tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ lɩɩ dɩ-bolii a kɔ dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛma? Kʋbɛɛ teeŋ nɛ ma jaŋ fá mʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ma lɛ? Nɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ joŋ ma dʋa-la bil?

english_verse: How will you escape being captured or killed? The Lord is still angry, and he isn't through with you yet! The Lord's Purpose and the King of Assyria
translation_verse: Wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ laama, ba jaŋ kpʋma koo a kɛsɛma dɩ ma ŋaa nɩa ba sɩ kaa tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa. Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa ma lɛ, ama La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ ha bɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ. Ʋ ha jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma a pɛ. Wɩa jaŋ dii Asiiria sarɩya

english_verse: The Lord says: I am furious! And I will use the king of Assyria as a club
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Asiiria tɩmma, wɩɩŋ puuma, ma nɛ ŋaa mɩ baanɩŋ daŋkpɩlɩŋ, mɩ sɩ jaŋ kaa dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ nyuŋ mɩ sɩ chaasa na baanɩŋ.

english_verse: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩŋ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa nɛ dɩ ba mʋ yuo tintee-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ mɩ-na Wɩa ka fá, nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ baanɩŋ sii. Mɩ tɩmba dɩ ba mʋ kɛŋ ba dʋa laa nɛ aŋ fɩrɩgɛba a nagɛ vʋchɔɔŋ sɩ pɩŋ wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The king of Assyria says: My army commanders are kings!
translation_verse: Ʋ bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ a bʋl, ‘Mɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ kala ŋaa kuoroo nɛ.

english_verse: They have already captured the cities of Calno, Carchemish, Hamath, Arpad, Samaria, and Damascus.
translation_verse: Mɩ yuo dii tasɩŋ deemba nɛ: Kalino arɩ Kachɛmɩsɩ arɩ Hamaf arɩ Apadɩ, Samarɩa arɩ Damasɩkʋs.

english_verse: The gods of Jerusalem and Samaria are weaker than the gods of those powerful nations. And I will destroy Jerusalem, together with its gods and idols, just as I did Samaria.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chei Jerusalɛm arɩ ʋ vʋɩyaa kala, arɩ mɩ sɩ chei Samarɩa arɩ ʋ vʋɩyaa ŋɩɩ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Dɩ mɩ nɛ dɛrɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ arɩ Jerusalɛm tɩŋŋaa lɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Asiiria kuoro a tɩŋ ʋ dagɩŋ-tɩtɩɩ arɩ ʋ babii-ballɩŋ wɩaa.”

english_verse: who says: I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ doluŋ nɛ mɩ kaa ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ a jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔsʋŋ. Mɩ gbaa tinteyee bʋɔsʋŋ ta nɛ, a paa ba kɩalɩŋ ma kala ba sɩ tʋɔla, aŋ yuo dii ba kuoroo ma kala.

english_verse: I have conquered the whole world! And it was easier than taking eggs from an unguarded nest. No one even flapped a wing or made a peep.
translation_verse: Mɩ yuo dii tinteye-la kala nɛ, a laa ba dʋa a nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ na diibie sɩ sie aŋ ka ʋ paa halaa dɛlɛ lɛ, ka nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ kire.”

english_verse: King of Assyria, can an ax or a saw overpower the one who uses it? Can a wooden pole lift whoever holds it?
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Saaŋ jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ ʋ nɛ kɩɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛnʋ tɩtɩŋ? Koo sɩa jaŋ wuo bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ ʋ nɛ kɩɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛnʋ kikeri kɩaa? Dantɩga bɩ jaŋ wuo tɩgɛ ʋ tɩtɩa koo dɩ toŋguluŋ baasɛ ʋ tɩtɩa.”

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ a hɛ ʋ laalɩyuori babiibala-la kala sɩ nɛrɛ pimee pimee lɛ dɩ ba yʋɔlɛ. Nyiniŋ jaŋ chei ba yara-la kala, dɩ ba nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩ lieri kʋa.

english_verse: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ ŋaa ba pʋlʋmʋŋ jaŋ nagɛ nyiniŋ. Ba Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ jaŋ nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ, ʋ jaŋ joŋ tapʋl-bala a dii Asiiria tɩmma-la sɩ nagɛ yakʋɔŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ sɩ lugo.

english_verse: The Lord will make your beautiful forests and fertile fields slowly rot.
translation_verse: Asiiria duu-la arɩ ʋ ŋmaŋkaa sɩma-la kala jaŋ chei a nagɛ nyanyalaa sɩ yie chei nɩa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them. Only a Few Will Come Back
translation_verse: Ʋ duu-la tɩɩsɩŋ mʋapɩlɩɩ jaŋ ka, dɩ bii-bie ma wuo dɩɩsɛba. Iziral nɩkaanaa

english_verse: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.
translation_verse: Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ kʋ yi Iziral nɩkaana-la, Jekɔb doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ sʋba, bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋ ba tɩtɩa a yelli nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋba a dɛrɛ. Ba jaŋ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa kala hɛ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ.

english_verse: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, ma fa yʋga a nagɛ hagɩla sɩ pɩŋ mʋga niiŋ nɛ, ama nɩalɩŋ baŋmɛnɛ sɩ ka nɛ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ. Cheeriŋ chaasa jʋʋma nɛ a cheima, ŋɩɩ nɛ saa maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised that everyone on this earth will be punished.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna ka chɛ dɩ ʋ chei ma tinteeŋ kala nɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma a tɩŋ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa wɩaa. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ dɔgɩsɛma, a joŋ toŋguluŋ je ma nyuŋ a nagɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩ dɔgɩsɛma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni, ka baaŋ-la mɩ sɩ na ma nyuŋ dɛrɛ, ka dɩ mɩ joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ a chaasɛba a cheiba.”

english_verse: I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ vɩɩrɛba arɩ kpaasa a nagɛ ʋ fa sɩ ŋmoo Midiaŋ tɩŋŋaa bil ŋɩɩ Oreb bʋŋ-la leriŋ. Ʋ jaŋ je ʋ dantɩga ba lɛ a nagɛ ʋ fa sɩ je ʋ dantɩga Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, a nagɛ ʋ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
translation_verse: Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, ʋ jaŋ dʋɔrɛ chʋga-la sɩ sagɛ ma vaasɩŋ lɛ, a dʋɔrɛ hɛɛ-la fa sɩ nagɛ daaŋ a daŋ ma baŋŋaa lɛ, ʋ jaŋ boru, ka dɩ ma wiesi.

english_verse: Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash,
translation_verse: Dʋndɔmɔ-la jʋʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ayaf, ba to taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɩgɩrɔŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, ba joŋ ba kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ a bil taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɩkɩmas lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.
translation_verse: Ba chol fuonaa-bie nɛ aŋ bʋl, “La jaŋ chʋa Geba lɛ. Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rama nɩaa nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ kuoro Sɔɔl taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Geba lɛ fá viiri nɛ.”

english_verse: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.
translation_verse: Galɩm tɩmma, má ŋmoo niiŋ, Layɩsa tɩŋŋaa, ma má nɩɩ. Anatɔf nenigi tɩmma, wɩɩŋ jʋʋma.

english_verse: No one is left in Madmenah or Gebim.
translation_verse: Madɩmɛna tɩŋŋaa ka fá nɛ, Gɛbɩm tɩŋŋaa fá lɛl nɛ dɩ ba laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Jɩnɩŋ, dʋndɔmɔ-la chɩŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nɔb lɛ nɛ, a chuchuu barɩŋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ, Jerusalɛm dundolo.

english_verse: With an ax, the glorious Lord will destroy every tree in the forests of Lebanon.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ ʋ saaŋ a keri tɩɩ-lugunu-la kala lo. Lɛbanɔŋ tinteeŋ kala jaŋ tel doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord will be with him to give him understanding, wisdom, and insight. He will be powerful, and he will know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩma jaŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a wuo jɩjɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ, a jɩŋ nɩaa chagɩlɩŋ, a kɛŋ doluŋ a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa a zizil La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord. This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.
translation_verse: Ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ tuto La TƖƖNA niiŋ. Wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ na koo ʋ sɩ nɩa dee ʋ jaŋ kaa dii nɩaa sarɩya.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will be treated with fairness and with justice. His word will be law everywhere in the land, and criminals will be put to death.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋla nɛ ʋ jaŋ kaa dii nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ sarɩya, wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ʋ jaŋ kaa dii summoo sarɩya a chɩŋ ba harɩŋ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa chei, aŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Honesty and fairness will be his royal robes.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ jaŋ nagɛ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie ʋ tɩŋa lɛ.

english_verse: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.
translation_verse: Guŋgurusuŋ arɩ pie-biisiŋ jaŋ jʋjʋʋ dɩ-bala, dɩ kpeye arɩ bʋʋnaa ma guoli dɔŋɔ lɛ a pɩŋ, nɛ-bie arɩ naachigi-bie jaŋ pɛ kɩaa dɩ-diiliŋ, dɩ bii-bie nɛ bibeŋ ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.
translation_verse: Nɛŋ arɩ lugumuŋ jaŋ didii kɩaa dɩ-bala, dɩ ba biiriŋ ma pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a pɩŋ ka wɩɩkala bɩ ŋaa. Naachigiŋ jaŋ didii yaŋ a nagɛ nɛŋ.

english_verse: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.
translation_verse: Bii-mulo jaŋ gbigbieli kataha bʋa niiŋ ka wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ ŋaaʋ, bii-bie jaŋ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ a hɛ dʋndɔ-kuuro bʋa lɛ ka wɩɩ bɩ ʋ ka ŋaa.

english_verse: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
translation_verse: Wɩa peel-zɔŋ-la kala lɛ wʋbɔŋ koo wʋcheyii bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Wɩa wɩaa jaŋ su dʋnɩa kala a nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ yie su mʋgʋ-balɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, kuoru-la sɩ jaŋ lɩɩ Jesi gentine lɛ jaŋ chɩŋ a nagɛ tuuta nɩaa teeŋ, tinteyee jaŋ kɔ ʋ teeŋ a zilu.

english_verse: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
translation_verse: Dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, La TƖƖNA jaŋ tiire laa ʋ nɩkaanaa a lɩɩ Asiiria arɩ Ijipiti sɛmɛ-la sɩ hɛ bʋbʋɔŋ arɩ Ijipiti sɛmɛ sɩ hɛ nyuŋ arɩ Kus, Ɛlam, Babɩlɔŋ, Hamaf a pɛ tinteye-la kala mʋgʋ-balɩŋ sɩ gollo chu lɛ.

english_verse: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ tuuta-la je a dagɛ tinteyee nɩaa kala, aŋ kɛŋ Iziral tɩmma-la ba sɩ kɛsɛ mʋ yoŋ-baga kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ Juda nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ pɩsa, a lɩɩ dʋnɩa loŋgorunu-la banɛsɛ kala lɛ a mɩɩra kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa yarɩ-bieriŋ jaŋ dɛrɛ, dɩ Juda tɩŋŋaa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ma lɛl. Iziral tɩŋŋaa yaraa bɩra bɩ jaŋ bibieri Juda nyuŋ. Juda tɩŋŋaa ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ bɛrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ sii a to lere-la sɩ chulloo tuu a kʋ yuo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Ba jaŋ gbaara yuo dii nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ aŋ laa ba kɩaa. Ba jaŋ yuo dii Ɛdɔm arɩ Mʋab nɩaa. Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa-na jaŋ sɛɩ wɩɩ-la kala ba sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ Ijipiti mʋgʋ-bal-la lɩɩ-libe kala hʋ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ pel-lɩmɩŋ lu a hɛ Efireti fuo-bal-la ma lɛ dɩ ʋ hʋ. Ʋ jaŋ kɛnʋ kpaa bil fuo-biisiŋ balɩpɛ dɩ nɩaa wuo vɛŋ ba tʋɔŋ a chol.

english_verse: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Womporuŋ jaŋ pɩŋ a pɩ ʋ nɩkaana-la sɩ jaŋ lɩɩ Asiiria lɛ, a nagɛ ʋ fa sɩ pɩŋ ŋɩɩ pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “I thank you, Lord! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.
translation_verse: Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, ma jaŋ bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ La TƖƖNA, ŋ fa paala na baanɩŋ nɛ mɩ nyuŋ, ama ŋ leŋe ŋ baaŋ-la fɩɛlɛ nɛ, aŋ ŋaa mɩ tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala.

english_verse: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.”
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, Wɩa nɛ ŋaa mɩ Laataara, mɩ jaŋ laaʋ dii a bɩ fawʋllʋŋ ka fá. La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa mɩ doluŋ, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ dɛnnʋ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ Laataara.”

english_verse: With great joy, you people will get water from the well of victory.
translation_verse: A nagɛ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ sɩ yie kɛŋ nɩa ʋ nyʋa lɩɩzɔmʋŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ʋ nɛ laama ta.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la ma jaŋ bʋl, “Má lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna, má yɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ, má leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa, a leŋ dɩ ba jɩŋ arɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yʋga.

english_verse: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Má yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, a tɩŋ wʋduoru-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa, má leŋ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, má faasa yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: This is the message that I was given about Babylon:
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo dagɛ Amos nanʋala Azaaya a mʋ tɩgɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: From high on a barren hill give a signal, shout the orders, and point the way to enter the gates of Babylon's proud rulers.
translation_verse: Jɩl dundolo nyuŋ kʋŋkala sɩ tuo, a kɛŋ tuuta je aŋ kpɩa laalɩyuoroo lɛ aŋ kɛŋ nɩsɩŋ dagɛba dɩ ba mʋ taŋ-la nɩaa sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa boi-baalaa a yuoba.

english_verse: The Lord has commanded his very best warriors and his proud heroes to show how angry he is.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ mɩ laalɩyuoro-la sɩ jɩŋ laalɩ-yuonuŋ nɛ, mɩ yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ jʋɔsɛ mɩ doluŋ lɛ nɛ, dɩ ba mʋ yuo nɩalɩŋ nyuŋ mɩ sɩ na baanɩŋ.

english_verse: From a distant land the Lord is coming fierce and furious— he brings his weapons to destroy the whole earth.
translation_verse: Ba lɩɩ tinteyee sɩ bolie nɛ, ba lɩɩ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA baanɩŋ chaasa sii nɛ, mɩ kori mɩ laalɩyuori kɩaa kʋkɔ dɩ mɩ chei tintee-la kala nɛ.

english_verse: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *
translation_verse: Má yel, bɛɛ wɩaa tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ jaŋ kɔ kpaga nɛ, mɩ jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya a chei leriŋ.

english_verse: All people will be terrified. Hands will grow limp; courage will melt away.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa, nɩaa nɩsaa jaŋ sʋʋ, nʋʋkala nandaasɩŋ jaŋ yʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: Everyone will tremble with pain like a woman giving birth; they will stare at each other with horror on their faces. There Will Be No Mercy
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmba, hɛɛŋ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ jaŋ jʋʋba, ba hɛɛŋ jaŋ nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl, ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ ŋɩɩ. Ba jaŋ gɩgɩɛnɛ dɔŋɔ, dɩ ba sɩaa fɩɛsɛ a nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya ka kɔ nɛ, ʋ ŋaa tapʋl-bɔŋ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ dɩ mɩ yaraa hosi. Mɩ jaŋ chei wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa, ka dɩ tinteeŋ pɩŋ hoi.

english_verse: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.
translation_verse: Chɛnwʋlaa sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ ba nagɩsɩŋ kala bɩ jaŋ chaanɛ. Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ ma jaŋ biri, chɛnɛ ma pʋlʋmʋŋ bɩ jaŋ chaanɛ.

english_verse: I will punish this evil world and its people because of their sins. I will crush the horrible pride of those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, a dɔgɩsɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa jije tuu tinteeŋ, dɩ ba babii-ballɩŋ kala dɛrɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ sɩɩ-duo tɩmma-la sɩ chaasa bɔŋ.

english_verse: Survivors will be harder to find than the purest gold.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nuhuobiinee nyaa tinteeŋ lɛ a nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ-la sɩ chaasa zɔŋ sɩ nyaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wɩa-nyuŋ chel, dɩ tinteeŋ ma zigili, a sʋrɩsɛ ʋ dɩchɩnɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ jaŋ dagɛma mɩ baaŋ-la mɩ sɩ faasa na.

english_verse: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala ba sɩ kɛnɛ, ba jaŋ joŋ tokobiiŋ tɔbʋ lɩɩ gɩrɩgɛ, ba jaŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kɛsɛ arɩ tokobiiŋ.

english_verse: They will see their children beaten against rocks, their homes robbed, and their wives abused.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ paa ba bii-mulluŋ vɩɩra yɛrɛ ba sɩɩŋ lɛ, aŋ jʋʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ paa ba kɩaa kala aŋ gurigi ba haalaa.

english_verse: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.
translation_verse: Má bee na, mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛ Midiaŋ tɩŋŋaa kʋ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa lɛ, ba-na bɩ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ wɩaa chɩla.

english_verse: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kpʋ ba bapʋɔsaa arɩ tosuŋ, ba bɩ jaŋ fá bii-mulluŋ nisusuŋ, koo a fá hambiisiŋ nenige.

english_verse: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ kɛŋ kpɩɛra-la sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ a kɩɩ tintee kala, ba nɛ ʋ nɩaa kaa dagɛ ba tɩtɩa, ama mɩ-na Wɩa jaŋ chei ʋ kala arɩ mɩ fa sɩ chei Sodom arɩ Gomora ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Only desert creatures, hoot owls, and ostriches will live in its ruins, and goats will leap about.
translation_verse: Gɩrɩŋ kɩaa dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa jolluŋ dɩa, nɩmɛ nɛ hajaaŋkuŋkumba jaŋ jʋjʋʋ, dɩ tɛhɩɩba ma gbigbieli nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Hyenas and wolves will howl from Babylon's fortresses and beautiful palaces. Its time is almost up!
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ kuori-dɩɩ-zɔmɔ-la jaŋ ŋaa kpeyee dɩjʋʋlaa, dɩ jolluŋ nɩnɩɩ sɩma nɩmɛ. Ba jaŋ huoso su lee-la kala. Babɩlɔŋ cheyiŋ tapʋlaa chese nɛ, ba bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tapʋlaa lɛrɛ mʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ fá Iziral tɩŋŋaa nenige. Ʋ jaŋ bɩra lɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba ŋaa ʋ nɩaa, a leŋ dɩ ba hɔŋ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ. Nɩwogusuŋ jaŋ kʋ pɛ hɔŋ Jekɔb doho nɩalɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ ba niiŋ ŋaa kʋbala.

english_verse: Other nations will lead them home, and Israel will make slaves of them in the land that belongs to the Lord. Israel will rule over those who once governed and mistreated them. Death to the King of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Tintee-daŋ jaŋ pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ a kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ ba tinteeŋ. Jekɔb doho nɩalɩŋ jaŋ tɩɩ tinteye-la nɩaa dɩ baalaa arɩ haalaa tɩma pɩpɩba tintee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩba lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ yuo kɛsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ba ma jaŋ yuo kɛsɛba, a bibeŋ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ dɔgɩsɛba.

english_verse: The Lord will set you free from your sorrow, suffering, and slavery.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA jaŋ lɩɩsɛ Iziral nɩaa hɛɛ-la lɛ ba sɩ hɛ, arɩ tɩntɩŋ-duoru-la ba fa sɩ yie fʋgɛba hɛ ba tɩtɩŋ,

english_verse: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ sieri Babɩlɔŋ kuoru-la lɛ a bʋl: “Ŋ fa sɩ bɔmɔ ŋɩɩ a dʋdɔgɩsɛ nɩaa, lɛɛlɛ ʋ dɛrɛ nɛ, ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo dɔgɩsɛ nʋʋ.

english_verse: The Lord has crushed the power of those evil kings,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bori kuoru bɔmɔ-la kuori-dantɩgɩsɩŋ nɛ, ba nɛ ŋaa ba doluŋ.

english_verse: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala na wiese nɛ a fɩɛla hɔŋ, ba kala ka yɩɩ yɩɩlaa nɛ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, “Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.”
translation_verse: Tɩɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ ma paala jʋjʋɔsɛ nɛ a tɩŋ kuoru-la sɩ tele wɩaa, a bʋl, ‘Lɛɛlɛ ŋ sɩ tele ŋ-la, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ kerila lo.’

english_verse: Each one of them will say, “Now you are just as weak as any of us!
translation_verse: Ba kala jaŋ bʋl, ba jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ, ‘Ŋ ma lɛɛlɛ pʋgɩma nɛ, a nagɛla. Ŋ bɩrɩma nagɛla nɛ.’

english_verse: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.”
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩ ŋ babii-ballɩŋ kala nɛ tuu bʋa ŋɩɩ, ba fa yie du chenniŋ nɛ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɩdɛnnɩŋ. Na ŋ nɛ lɛɛlɛ pɩŋ ŋɩɩ, nanchʋɔlaa jɛrɛ tɔ ŋ kala a didii.

english_verse: You, the bright morning star, have fallen from the sky! You brought down other nations; now you are brought down.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ ma nɛ ŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ tuu tel ŋɩɩ, ŋ fa nagɛ nanyʋɔlʋŋ sɩ pɔsɔ nɛ. Ŋ fa yie yuo dii tinteyee nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ba kiriŋ ta nɛ ŋ tuu tinteeŋ.

english_verse: You said to yourself, “I'll climb to heaven and place my throne above the highest stars. I'll sit there with the gods far away in the north.
translation_verse: Ŋ fa yie bʋl ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, ‘Mɩ jaŋ jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ kuoru kpasa jɩla kieli Wɩa chɛnwʋlaa, mɩ jaŋ hɔŋ mɩ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ peel-la nyuŋ vesiŋ sɩɩ hilimu.

english_verse: I'll be above the clouds, just like God Most High.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kieli duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa jɩla hɔŋ, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa ŋaa nagɛ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala.’

english_verse: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ama, na ŋ nɛ ba joŋo nyaga hɛ bʋa lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋ ŋaa lɛlɩɩ.

english_verse: Those who see you will stare and wonder, “Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ naŋ tuo bibeniŋ nɛ, a kɛŋ ŋ nagɩŋ bɩbɩɩnɛ a bʋl, ‘Baala deeŋ dee fa bɩ tinteeŋ kaa zigili ŋɩɩ, a leŋ kuori-gentisiŋ chel,

english_verse: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home?”
translation_verse: ʋ dee bɩ tasɩŋ cheye ŋɩɩ a leŋ tinteeŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a bɩ chɛ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ kɛsɛ mɩɩra mʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ?’

english_verse: When kings die, they are buried in glorious tombs.
translation_verse: Tinteyee kala kuoroo nɛ ba hugi, ba kʋŋkala pɩŋ ʋ kuoru-bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: But you will be left unburied, just another dead body lying underfoot like a broken branch. You will be one of many killed in battle and gone down to the deep rocky pit.
translation_verse: Ama, ba joŋ ŋ-na kʋsʋʋŋ yuo ta nɛ, a nagɛ tɩa naakeliŋ ba sɩ vɩa ta. Nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa laalɩŋ lɛ a paa yuo hɛ bʋɔsʋŋ lɛ, ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ pilime tɔ ŋ kʋsʋʋŋ nɛ. Ŋ nagɛ kʋa sɩ sʋba nɛ ba joŋo ta a nʋɔsa bɩbal.

english_verse: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ bɩ ŋ-na ka hugi arɩ ba sɩɩ hugi kuoro ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ chei ŋ tinteeŋ kala nɛ a kpʋ ŋ nɩaa ma. Nɩbɔmʋŋ doho yɩrɩŋ bɩra bɩ maga dɩ ba yɩrɛ.

english_verse: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Má wasɛ leriŋ a kɛsɛ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kpʋ a tɩŋ ba naabalɩmaba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Ba bɩ maga dɩ ba hɛ nɩmɛ a sii tɩɩ tinteeŋ a saa tabalaa tɔ leriŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ yuo dii Babɩlɔŋ a kpʋ ʋ nɩkaana-la sɩ bɩ sʋba, ʋ biiriŋ arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa, dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛl dʋnɩa lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna ŋmɩɛsa nɛ a bʋl, “Tɛŋɛ, wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bɩɩna nɛ jaŋ ŋaa, wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ mɩ ŋaa, mɩ jaŋ ŋaaba.

english_verse: I will wipe out every Assyrian in my country, and I will crush those on my mountains. I will free my people from slavery to the Assyrians.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chei Asiiria tɩŋŋaa Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, mɩ tinteeŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ jaŋ nʋɔsɛba bil mɩ peelee nyuŋ. Hɛɛ-la sɩ nagɛ daaŋ ba joŋo daŋ mɩ nɩaa baŋŋaa lɛ, mɩ jaŋ dʋɔrʋ, a dʋɔrɛ chʋga-la ba sɩ joŋo sagɛ mɩ nɩaa vaasɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa kala lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ dɔgɩsɛ tinteyee kala.”

english_verse: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla jɩna-la kuoro Ahas sɩ sʋba nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.
translation_verse: “Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa kala, ma pɔ má sɩ́ jʋɔsʋ a tɩŋ daa-la fa sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛma sɩ boro wɩaa. Dɩ dɩmɩŋ nɛ sʋba, dɩŋ-la sɩ kɛŋ huoŋ a kɩɩʋ yie lɩɩ chɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ halaa jaŋ tiesi dɩ-bɔmɔ-la doho sɩ kɛŋ huoŋ-la tɩtɩa.

english_verse: The poor and needy will find pastures for their sheep and will live in safety. But I will starve some of you, and others will be killed.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ pɛ ʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ chaasa ŋaa summo lɛ dɩ ba na kʋdiilee dii, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ fɩɛla pɩŋ sɔm. Ama mɩ jaŋ joŋ losuŋ hɛ ma Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa lɛ dɩ mɩ kpʋ ma nɩkaana-la kala dɩ ba sʋʋ.

english_verse: Cry and weep in the gates of your towns, you Philistines! Smoke blows in from the north, and every soldier is ready.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma, má ŋmoo niiŋ ma tabalaa lɛ, má leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma, dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ. Laalɩyuoroo nɛ hɛ dɔŋɔ a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ a lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a kʋkɔ ma lɛ, nɩtɛsʋ kala tuo laalɩyuoro-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
translation_verse: Wʋbɛɛ nɛ saa la jaŋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ tɩma ba lɩɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tinteeŋ kɔ? Ma jaŋ bʋla pɩba arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ leŋe Zaayɔŋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ, ʋ nɩaa fa sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ba mʋ nɩmɛ a wuo hɔŋ, wɩɩ bɩ baa walɩmɛ.”

english_verse: This is a message about Moab: The towns of Ar and Kir were destroyed in a night. Moab is left in ruins!
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ Mʋab lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Aa a hɛ Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, ba cheyu tɩtaŋɩŋ nɛ. Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kii a hɛ Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, ba cheyu tɩtaŋɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
translation_verse: Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Dɩbɔŋ, ʋ nɩaa sii jɩl ba vene dɩa nɛ peeliŋ nyuŋ a yiyel. Mʋab tɩŋŋaa ka ŋmoo niiŋ nɛ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediba arɩ Nebo wɩaa. Ba paala fʋŋ ba nyusuŋ a fʋŋ ba tɔŋŋɔɔ ma kala a dɩdagɛ arɩ ba tʋɔŋ cheye nɛ.

english_verse: In the towns and at home, everyone wears sackcloth and cries loud and long.
translation_verse: Ba laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ nɛ a yiyel ba lusunuŋ nyuŋ arɩ wombiee, arɩ ba biliŋ lɛ. Ba kala yele nɛ, a pɔ ba bɩ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: From Heshbon and Elealeh, weeping is heard in Jahaz; Moab's warriors scream while trembling with fear. Pity Moab
translation_verse: Tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛsɩbɔŋ arɩ Eliali nɩaa ma faasaa yel nɛ. Ba nii-ŋmobo mʋ yiyi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jahas. Mʋab laalɩyuoroo ŋmoo niiŋ nɛ aŋ chichel, ba nandaasɩŋ yʋɔra nɛ.

english_verse: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
translation_verse: Fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nimirim lɩɩŋ kala nɛ hʋa, yaŋ-la ma sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ kala hɩl. Kʋ-laarɩŋ sʋba nɛ, kʋ-laa kala bɩra tuo nɩmɛ.

english_verse: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
translation_verse: Dʋa-la ma kala ba fa sɩ dʋa a bil, ba kala nɛ ba paa kaa chol fuonaa-la sɩ kɛŋ tɩɩsɩŋ a viiri.

english_verse: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
translation_verse: Ba nii-ŋmobo-la chɩɩmɛ Mʋab tinteeŋ kala nɛ, ba yele mʋ yi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛgɩlam arɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛɛ Ɛlɩm.

english_verse: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
translation_verse: Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Dimoŋ fuonuŋ kala nɛ suo arɩ chalɩŋ, ama mɩ-na Wɩa ha jaŋ lɛrɛ wɩaa kʋ hɛ ba lɛ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛ naachigiŋ kʋ hɛ Mʋab tɩmma-la sɩɩ fá dɩ ba laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ nɩkaana-la sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Mʋab tɩmma, má kɛsɛ pie-pɔrɔɔ kaa mʋ pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ tinteeŋ, má kaa chol taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛla sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, a kaa mʋ ŋaa zile pɩ kuoru-la sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Moab's messengers say to the people of Judah, “Be kind and help us! Shade us from the heat of the noonday sun. Hide our refugees! Don't turn them away.
translation_verse: Ba bʋla pɩ Juda nɩaa, “Má dagɛla wɩɩ-la la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa. Má tɔ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ la lɛ a nagɛ tɩa fɩɛlɩŋ sɩ yie keese tɔ nɩaa lɛ ŋɩɩ, wɩɩ-hɛɛ-siesee. La ŋaa nɩa sɩ fá kʋ yuorima nɛ, má kɛnla kaa faa dɩ la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ́ la na.

english_verse: Let our people live in your country and find safety here.” Moab, your cruel enemies will disappear; they will no longer attack and destroy your land.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la Mʋab tɩmma-la sɩɩ fá la laa la tɩtɩa hɔŋ ma tʋɔŋ. Má laala ta la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.” Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyagɛba bil jaŋ dɛrɛ, wɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ cheiba jaŋ birigi, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ baanɩŋ aa nʋɔsɛba jaŋ dɛrɛ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice. Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
translation_verse: Devit doho nɩaa dɔŋɔ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ a cho nɩaa woruŋ, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ beŋ ʋ nɩaa. Ʋ jaŋ dii ʋ nɩaa sarɩya arɩ tʋɔpʋla, a chɩchɛ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ chɩŋ.

english_verse: We have heard of Moab's pride. Its people strut and boast, but without reason.
translation_verse: La Juda nɩaa nɩɩ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa babii-ballɩŋ wɩaa nɛ, ama ba bigisine-la arɩ ba sɩɩ bɩ suo-la kala ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Tell everyone in Moab to mourn for their nation. Tell them to cry and weep for those fancy raisins of Kir-Hareseth.
translation_verse: Mʋab tɩŋŋaa jaŋ ŋmoo niiŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a tɩŋ ba tinteeŋ wɩaa, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ chei a tɩŋ kʋdii-zɔmɔ-la ba fa sɩɩ dii Kii Harɛsɛf lɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: Vineyards near Heshbon and Sibmah have turned brown. The rulers of nations used to get drunk on wine from those vineyards that spread to Jazer, then across the desert and beyond the sea.
translation_verse: Bagɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛsɩbɔŋ lɛ arɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩbɩma lɛ kala ŋmaama nɛ. Tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩŋ-la sɩ chaasa sɩŋ tinteyee kuoroo fa yie nyʋa bugi. Tɩɩsɩ-la fa tɛllɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jazɛ a joŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi tintee-hɩlɩŋ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Mʋgʋ-sʋʋŋ.

english_verse: Now I mourn like Jazer for the vineyards of Sibmah. I shed tears for Heshbon and for Elealeh. There will be no more harvest celebrations
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ yel a nagɛ Jaza sɩ yel ŋɩɩ, a tɩŋ Sɩbɩma girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩ-la wɩaa. Mɩ kala nɛ fo arɩ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ a tɩŋ Hɛsɩbɔŋ arɩ Eliali wɩaa. Ba fa sɩ yie tʋtɔrɛ tɩɩnɛnɛ-la a ŋɩŋaa goŋ-la arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, ŋɩɩ bɩra tuo.

english_verse: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
translation_verse: Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ bɩra tuo girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩ-la lɛ, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ yɩɩlaa yɩa a ŋɩŋaa goŋ ba lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ma fa sɩɩ chagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ bɩra bɩ chagɛ. Mɩ giri goŋ-la ta nɛ.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I hurt for Moab and Kir-Heres.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ cheye nɛ woruŋ mɩ yiyel a tɩŋ Mʋab tinteeŋ arɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kii Harɛsɛf wɩaa.

english_verse: It's useless for Moab's people to wear themselves out by going to their altars to worship and pray.
translation_verse: Dɩ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa nɛ mʋ ba vene dɩa peeliŋ nyuŋ a sʋlʋ ma, baa lɔl ba tɩtɩa nɛ, ba bɩ jaŋ na wɩɩkala.

english_verse: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl a tɩgɛ Mʋab lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Jɩsɩŋ batori lɛ, Mʋab tɩŋŋaa dʋa arɩ ʋ nɩ-daŋ-la kala jaŋ dɛrɛ, a nagɛ pachɩŋ diiree tɩntɩŋŋaa sɩ yie dɛrɛ ŋɩɩ jɩsɩŋ batori pɛgɛ. Ba nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ nɛ jaŋ ka, ba ma paala bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ.”

english_verse: This is a message about Damascus: Damascus is doomed! It will end up in ruins.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ a tɩgɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Má bee na, Damasɩkʋs kala jaŋ chei, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa taŋ, ʋ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
translation_verse: Siiria tabalaa kala jaŋ pɩŋ hoi, a bɩrɩmɛ piesee arɩ nɛsɩŋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ arɩ dɩ-diiliŋ, ka nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ kiriba nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this. Sin and Suffering
translation_verse: Iziral tasɩ-la kala ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli jaŋ tel, dɩ Damasɩkʋs ma kuoruŋ dɛrɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka Siiria tinteeŋ lɛ jaŋ na hɛɛ-la tɩtɩa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ na. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
translation_verse: Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋla-la kala ba sɩ kɛnɛ jaŋ lɛl, dɩ ba dʋa ma kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Israel will be like wheat fields in Rephaim Valley picked clean of grain.
translation_verse: Iziral jaŋ nagɛ ba sɩ pɛrɛ mɩaa baga a ta a bori, ʋ jaŋ nagɛ ba sɩ kuuni mɩaa fuonaa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rafem lɛ.

english_verse: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
translation_verse: Ama nɩaa mʋa ha jaŋ ka Iziral lɛ, a nagɛ ba sɩ tɔrɛ olif nɛnɛɛ aŋ ka nɛnɛɛ balɩa koo batori ha ka tɩa-la nyu-gbaŋa lɛ. Banɛsɛ koo banɔŋ ma ka naakelee lɛ. La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Dɩ bʋa deeŋ nɛ yie, nɩaa jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaaba teeŋ, ba jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ teeŋ.

english_verse: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
