translation_verse: Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ vʋɩyaa korunu-la ba tɩtɩa sɩ saa lɛ, koo aa kpaarɛ veŋ-haal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ arɩ vʋɩyaa korunu-la ba sɩ saa aa nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: Israel captured powerful cities and chased out the people who lived there. But these cities will lie in ruins, covered over with weeds and underbrush.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, ta-duoru-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kiri nɩaa ba lɩɩ fá kagɛ, tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ yaŋ jaŋ tɔba. Lee-la kala jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, ma yʋ ma Laataara Wɩa wɩaa nɛ, ʋ nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ dolie a nagɛ bʋŋ a pʋpɔma ŋɩɩ. Ma mɩɩra chɔnsɛ tɩɩsɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ dɩ ma kpʋkpaarɛ vʋɩyaa ba bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony. God Defends His People
translation_verse: Ama dɩ tɩɩsɩ-la nɛ pɔsɔ a fɩɩlɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa chʋchʋɔŋ ma sɩ chɔnsɛba ma, ma bɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ nɛŋ kala ba lɛ. Ma jaŋ wɩɩlɛ a na hɛɛ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ dɔmɔ nagɛ lɩɩ-balaa sɩ gulimo a vɩvɛŋ nɛ, ama dɩ Wɩa nɛ kpɩa ba lɛ, ba yie pɩsɛ nɛ a fá mʋ dɩ-bolii, a nagɛ pel-vinvilimiŋ sɩ paa kʋŋkɔlʋŋ koo nɩsʋrʋŋ.

english_verse: In the evening their attack is fierce, but by morning they are destroyed. This is what happens to those who raid and rob us.
translation_verse: Dɩdaanɩŋ ba jaŋ ŋaa dɩ fawʋllʋŋ faasa kɛnla. Ama taŋ jaŋ pʋpʋl dɩ ba viire. Wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋ dii la tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ, ba time ba sɩ jaŋ laa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Downstream from Ethiopia lies the country of Egypt, swarming with insects.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu Kus tɩŋŋaa, ba nɛ hɛ Naayɩl fuo-la niiŋ ŋɩɩ, lee-la hɔbɔ sɩ suo.

english_verse: Egypt sends messengers up the Nile River on ships made of reeds. Send them fast to Ethiopia, whose people are tall and have smooth skin. Their land is divided by rivers; they are strong and brutal, feared all over the world.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ yie tɩŋ nɩaa a leŋ ba paa lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ saŋgɛɛŋ ŋaa a duori fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Naayɩl a kɔ ŋɩɩ. Má mɩɩra mʋ dɩa tɩndaara, ma lɩma nɛ woruŋ. Má mɩɩra mʋ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ waa yi teeŋ, ba yaraa ma ŋaa mʋla mʋla. Tintee-duo-la nɩaa sɩ laa yɩrɩŋ nɩaa yuo diiniŋ lɛ, dʋnɩa nɩaa kala sɩɩ fá, ba tinteeŋ nɛ fuonuŋ kaa kpaa kpaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.
translation_verse: Ma dʋnɩa nɩaa kala, má jegile nɩɩ, dɩ ba nɛ kɛŋ jɔnjɔŋ je peeliŋ nyuŋ, ma jaŋ naʋ, dɩ ba nɛ ŋmʋʋ banyile ma, ma jaŋ nɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ hɛ mɩ dɩɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ a ŋaa chɩm, aŋ bibeŋ leriŋ a nagɛ wulumuŋ bʋa lɛ ŋ sɩ yie na leriŋ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ tʋl ŋɩɩ wɩɩhɛɛ siesee koo a nagɛ baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ bʋa lɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa sɩ yie chɩŋ dɩ-bala ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Before the blossoms can turn into grapes, God will cut off the sprouts and hack off the branches.
translation_verse: A nagɛ tɩa sɩ yie fɩɩlɛ aŋ-na nɛŋ a bɩɩ, ŋɩɩ ba mʋ tɔrɛ, Wɩa jaŋ kɛŋ sɩa-la ba sɩ kaa bubuori tɩɩsɩŋ a keri tɩa-la naakele-la kala sɩ nɛnɛ ta. Kus tɩŋŋaa nɛ tɩɩ-naakele-la.

english_verse: Ethiopians will be food for mountain vultures during the summer and for wild animals during the winter.
translation_verse: Ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ jaŋ ŋaa zaaraa arɩ baga kɩaa kʋdiilee. Ba jaŋ ŋaa zaaraa kʋdiilee yibiiniŋ, aŋ ŋaa baga kɩaa ma kʋdiilee lɩmbaŋa.

english_verse: Those Ethiopians are tall and their skin is smooth. They are feared all over the world, because they are strong and brutal. But at that time they will come from their land divided by rivers, and they will bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful, who is worshiped on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, nɩalɩŋ sɩ waa yi, ba yaraa ŋaa mʋla mʋla, a laa yɩrɩŋ nɩaa yuo diiniŋ lɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala fɩfába, ba tinteeŋ nɛ fuonuŋ kaa kpaa kpaa ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ kɩaa kʋ ŋaa zile pɩ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kɔ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ, lee-la ba sɩɩ zil La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says,
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Ijipiti lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: La TƖƖNA to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ lɛ nɛ a faasa fá kʋkɔ Ijipiti lɛ. Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa tɔŋŋɔɔ kala ka chel nɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ, ʋ nɩaa ma kala nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: “Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.
translation_verse: Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala jaŋ vʋgʋmɛ, ka dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ ma kala ba sɩ vʋʋra bil, dɩ ba ŋaa wʋpɛɩba. Ba jaŋ pɩɛsɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ lɛlɛɛ, vʋgʋraa arɩ kantɔŋŋɔɔ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.” Trouble along the Nile
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa hɛ kuoru-tʋɔhɛɩ tɩɩna nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ bibemba.” La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: The Nile River will dry up and become parched land.
translation_verse: Naayɩl fuo-la lɩɩŋ jaŋ hʋ, dɩ fuo-bʋa-la tʋɔŋ kala hɩl.

english_verse: Its streams will stink, Egypt will have no water, and the reeds and tall grass will dry up.
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-libisi-la sɩ pɛllɛ jʋjʋʋ fuo-la jaŋ sʋsʋɔrɛ. Lɩɩŋ jaŋ tuo Ijipiti lɛ dɩ yasɩ-la kala sɩ chɩŋ fuo-la niiŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Fields along the Nile will be completely barren; every plant will disappear.
translation_verse: Bagɩsɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ Naayɩl fuo-la niiŋ kɩaa kala jaŋ sʋʋ dɩ peliŋ paa ba viiri.

english_verse: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tɩɩ-pugubie-la nɛnɛɛ ba sɩ kaa ŋaa gɛnnɩŋ a yuo ŋmɛnɩŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa jaŋ vʋgʋmɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yuo gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ nandaasɩŋ jaŋ yʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn. Egypt's Helpless Leaders
translation_verse: Gɛrɩpɛ-sʋaraa tʋɔbɩɩnaa jaŋ vʋgʋmɛ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩma ka ba titimba ma tʋɔŋ chei.

english_verse: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, “We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago?”
translation_verse: Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zʋaŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ ŋaa nɩyaara nɛ. Wʋjɩnna-la ma sɩɩ dagɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro ka dagʋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ba bʋla pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro, “La kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, la nɛ faa to faafaa kuorusu-la harɩŋ.”

english_verse: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.
translation_verse: Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro, nɩɩ nɛ ŋ wʋjɩnna-la hɛ lɛɛlɛ? Leŋ dɩ ba dagɩŋ wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ joŋo ŋaa Ijipiti lɛ.

english_verse: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.
translation_verse: Zʋaŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ bɩrɩmɛ nɩyaara nɛ, nɩaa nyɩsɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Memfis sɩpaalaaraa nɛ. Ijipiti tinteeŋ sɩpaalaaraa kala leŋe Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa yeŋŋi nɛ.

english_verse: No one in Egypt can do a thing, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala tuo Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩkala, sɩpaalaarʋ koo harɩ-tooru, ʋ-na cho ʋ nagɛ ɛɛ kala ma.

english_verse: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa, ba kala jaŋ nagɛ haalaa. Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ jʋʋba dɩ ba chichel, dɩ ba nɛ na La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna dɩ ʋ je ʋ nɩsɩŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt. The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
translation_verse: Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa jaŋ fɩfá Juda tɩŋŋaa. Dɩ ba nɛ yɩrɛ Juda yɩrɩŋ dɩ ba kʋŋkala nɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛŋ tɩɩna a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ joŋo ŋaa ba lɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
translation_verse: Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, tabala-la banɔŋ sɩ hɛ Ijipiti lɛ nɩaa jaŋ bʋbʋl Iziral tɩŋŋaa wʋbʋlʋŋ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ tɩtɩŋ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ tasɩ-la dɔŋɔ aa yɩrɛ Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ taŋ.

english_verse: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ jaŋ chɩŋ Ijipiti tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, ka dɩ jebiiŋ ma chɩŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ bʋa niiŋ dɩ ba liliisi ʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Kɩaa deemba jaŋ ŋaa magɩl a dɩdagɛ arɩ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ yele pɩ La TƖƖNA a tɩŋ hɛɛ-la sɩ jʋʋba wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ pɩba nʋʋ sɩ jaŋ laaba ta dɩ ba na wiese.

english_verse: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa jɩmʋ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩaa jaŋ polli La TƖƖNA nyuŋ. Ba jaŋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ, a ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a dɛnnʋ. Ba jaŋ hɛ niiriŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA aŋ sɛnɛ kɛŋ niiri-la tɩtɩŋ ma.

english_verse: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ jʋʋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa, aŋ bɩra lɩɩsɛba. Ba jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ La TƖƖNA teeŋ a sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ jegile nɩɩ ba sʋla aŋ lɩɩsɛba wɩalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, womporuŋ jaŋ pɩŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a mʋmʋ Asiiria, dɩ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa arɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa mʋmʋ dɔŋɔba tasɩŋ. Ba kala jaŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a zizil La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Israel will join with these two countries. They will be a blessing to everyone on earth,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ jaŋ pɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa tasɩŋ batori sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tinteeŋ nɩaa kala na La TƖƖNA pɛnɩŋ.

english_verse: then the Lord All-Powerful will bless them by saying, “The Egyptians are my people. I created the Assyrians and chose the Israelites.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Pɛnɩŋ jaŋ hɛ mɩ nɩaa Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, arɩ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa mɩ sɩ ŋaa, arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa.”

english_verse: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.
translation_verse: Kuoru kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ a bibeŋ Asiiria tinteeŋ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Saagɔŋ. Jɩna kʋbala ʋ hɛ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ ba mʋ yuo dii taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩdɔd a kɛsɛba.

english_verse: About this same time the Lord had told me, “Isaiah, take off everything, including your sandals!” I did this and went around naked and barefoot
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ Amos nanʋala Azaaya. Ʋ sɩ, “Wuri tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩ-la ŋ sɩ laala, a chaarɛ nɛntɛŋŋɛ-la ma ŋ naasɩŋ lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ daga, aŋ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree arɩ naabirimee a gʋgɔllɛ.

english_verse: for three years. Then the Lord said: What Isaiah has done is a warning to Egypt and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ tɩntɩnna Azaaya sɩ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree arɩ naabirimee a gɔllɛ ŋɩɩ jɩsɩ-la batori, ʋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa magɩl nɛ a dɩdagɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ Kus tɩŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Asiiria kuoro jaŋ kɛsɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ Kus tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba ŋaa nɩa ba sɩ kaa tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa, a kɛŋ yarɩ-biree arɩ naabirimee a vɩvɛŋ. Hambiisiŋ arɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ kala jaŋ kɛŋ bʋbʋɔ-biree a vɩvɛŋ, dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: They will be confused and frustrated, because they depended on Ethiopia and bragged about Egypt.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa Kus lɛ, aŋ bibigisi Ijipiti lɛ, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmba, dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diiba.

english_verse: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
translation_verse: Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɔŋ Mediterenia mʋga-la niiŋ jaŋ bʋl, ‘Má na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ lɛ la sɩ joŋ la yɩɛlaa hɛ dɩ ba laala ta Asiiria kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Nɩɩ nɛ la bɩra jaŋ to a fori?’ ”

english_verse: This is a message about a desert beside the sea: Enemies from a hostile nation attack like a whirlwind from the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ lɩɩ tintee nɩaa sɩ tɛrɛ tʋɔŋ a kʋ yuoba a nagɛ pel-vinvilimiŋ sɩ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ kʋkɔ.

english_verse: What a horrible vision was shown to me— a vision of betrayal and destruction. Tell Elam and Media to surround and attack the Babylonians. The Lord has sworn to end the suffering they caused.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ chaasa ŋaa wʋlɔrʋ nɛ. Mɩ na zɛmbɛ tɩɩna ka bɛ zɛmbɛ, a na wʋcheere ma sɩɩ chei leriŋ. Má bʋla pɩ Ɛlam tinteeŋ laalɩyuoroo arɩ Midiaŋ tinteeŋ laalɩyuoroo dɩ ba sii gollo yuo Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa. Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ hɛɛ-la kala ba sɩ joŋo hɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa lɛ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: I'm in terrible pain like a woman giving birth. I'm shocked and hurt so much that I can't hear or see.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ na arɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ nɩa leŋe fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ, hɛɛŋ jʋʋmɛ nɛ, a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: My head spins; I'm horrified! Early evening, my favorite time, has become a nightmare.
translation_verse: Mɩ nyuŋ kala wʋwɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ ma kɛmmɛ mɩ kala chichel. Dɩdaanɩŋ ma mɩ sɩ bɩɩna ʋ jaŋ kpɩa, ʋ nɛ mɩɩra lɔrɔ pɩmɛ.

english_verse: In Babylon the high officials were having a feast. They were eating and drinking, when someone shouted, “Officers, take your places! Grab your shields.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ fa sɩ na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ: Mɩ na dɩ Babɩlɔŋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a hɔŋ kumpuŋŋuba nyuŋ a didii kɩaa aŋ nyʋnyʋa. Ba guu kpɩa a bʋl, “Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ, má sii paa ma hɔɔtaalɩ-la ma sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Send guards to find out what's going on.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mʋ a hɛ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ mʋ bibeŋ, a na wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a kaa kʋ bʋla pɩŋ.

english_verse: When they see cavalry troops and columns of soldiers on donkeys and camels, tell them to be ready!”
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ na janɩŋ torukoba arɩ ja-laalɩŋ, a na nɩaa dɩ ba jɩl kakusuŋ koo bʋntaŋŋaba, ʋ chaasa bemba woruŋ.”

english_verse: Now I see column after column of cavalry troops.” At once someone shouted, “Babylon has fallen! Every idol in the city lies broken on the ground.”
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, na nʋʋ nɛ hɔŋ toruko lɛ ja-laalɩŋ lɛrɛ kʋkɔ ŋɩɩ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ toruko-la lɛ bʋl, ‘Babɩlɔŋ tele, Babɩlɔŋ tele, ʋ vesiŋ ma kala nɛ ba ŋmoo pɩsɛ tinteeŋ.’ ”

english_verse: Then I said, “My people, you have suffered terribly, but I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.” How Much Longer?
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa, ba pugisi ma kala nɛ arɩ ba sɩ ŋmoo mɩaa taha lɛ, ama mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa teeŋ pɩma nɛ. Wɩa bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Ɛdɔm lɛ

english_verse: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, “Guard, how much longer before daylight?”
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Ɛdɔm lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Nʋʋ nɛ yɩrɛmɛ Ɛdɔm lɛ a pɩɛsɛ, “Nɩɩ-la sɩ pɔ a bibeŋ leriŋ, ɛɛ nɛ taŋ jaŋ diene maga aŋ pʋl ɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ diene magɛ?”

english_verse: From my guard post, I answered, “Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ pɔ a bibeŋ leriŋ sɩ, “Taŋ jaŋ pʋl, dɩ taŋ bɩra biri. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ha cho dɩ ŋ pɩɛsɛmɛ, ŋ jaŋ bɩra wuo kʋ pɩɛsɛ.” Wɩa bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Arebia lɛ

english_verse: This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan: You must order your caravans
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla a mʋ tɩgɛ Arebia tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Ma-na Dedaŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ dɔŋɔ vɩvɛŋ a ŋmoo buguŋ Arebia tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: to bring water for those who are thirsty. You people of Tema must bring food for the hungry refugees.
translation_verse: má ŋaa lɩɩŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ sɩ kɛnɛ. Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛma lɛ, má ŋaa kʋdiilee a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋ yuorima.

english_verse: They are worn out and weary from being chased by enemies with swords and arrows.
translation_verse: Ba fá lɩɩ laalɩŋ sɩ hoso tʋɔŋ nɛ a kɔ dɩ ba laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Jɩ-bala lɛ, Kɛda tɩŋŋaa babii-ballɩŋ kala jaŋ dɛrɛ a nagɛ pachɩŋ diire tɩntɩŋŋaa sɩ yie dɛrɛ ŋɩɩ jɩna pɛgɛ.

english_verse: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
translation_verse: To-yuoroo nɛ ŋaa Kɛda laalɩyuori babiibalaa, ama ba jaŋ dɛrɛ aŋ ka baŋmɛnɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: This is a message about Vision Valley: Why are you celebrating on the flat roofs of your houses?
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ fuonaa-la lɛ ba sɩ yie mʋ nɩna wɩaa Wɩa teeŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Wʋbɛɛba nɩɩ walɩmɛma lɛɛlɛ, ma kala sii fá jɩl lusunuŋ?

english_verse: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.
translation_verse: Jaŋ kala hoso nɛ a zizigili, nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ŋɩŋaa goŋ, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba ma jaŋ lɛ, laalɩŋ dee bɩ ba kpʋa.

english_verse: Your leaders ran away, but they were captured without a fight. No matter how far they ran, they were found and caught.
translation_verse: Ma sɩpaalaaraa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a lɩɩ fá dɩ ma laa ma mɩɩsɩŋ, ama nɩaa bɩ to-hɛŋ kala yuo aŋ kɛsɛma. Ma nɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kɛsɛ, ma paala suomo fɩfá nɛ dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ha hɛ dɩ-bolii.

english_verse: Then I said, “Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Má mʋ aŋ lemmi, dɩ mɩ chaasa yel. Má sɩ́ mɩ bɔyɛ nyagʋ a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa wɩaa.”

english_verse: Your most beautiful valleys were covered with chariots; your cities were surrounded by cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Janɩŋ torukoba nɛ su Juda fuonaa zɔmɔ-la kala, ka ja-jɩllaa ma chɩŋ ma tabalaa boiŋ-baalaa lɛ.

english_verse: Judah was left defenseless. At that time you trusted in the weapons you had stored in Forest Palace.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩɩ pɔ Juda cheye nɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la, ma joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ ma laalɩyuori kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ joŋo faa ma bayuori kɩaa dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: You saw the holes in the outer wall of Jerusalem, and you brought water from the lower pool.
translation_verse: Ma na dɩ Devit tabal-la jebiiŋ kɛŋ wuoloo nɛ a magɛ dɩ ba saa tɔ. Ma lu pɩlɩŋ nɛ lɩɩŋ pɩŋ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore down some of them, so you could get stones to repair the city wall.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma beŋ dɩ dɩɩsɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ maga dɩ ma ŋmoo lo a chaarɛ tabɩaa, a kaa nyɩrɛ wuolo-la sɩ hɛ jebii-la lɛ.

english_verse: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen. A Time To Weep
translation_verse: Ma lu vil-balɩŋ nɛ kɛrɩsɩŋ balɩa pɛgɛ dɩ lɩɩ-la sɩ pɛllɛ lɩɩ fuo bɩnɩɩ-la kʋʋ jʋʋ, ama ma bɩ Wɩa nɛ sɩ bil fuo-la niiŋ to, ma paala bɩ ʋ nɛ sɩ bɩɩnɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ faafaa kala kaa tɩŋ.

english_verse: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna yɩrɛma nɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la dɩ ma ŋmoo niiŋ a yiyel a fʋŋ ma nyusuŋ aŋ laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: But instead, you celebrated by feasting on beef and lamb and by drinking wine, because you said, “Let's eat and drink today! Tomorrow we may die.”
translation_verse: Ama ma tʋɔŋ mɩɩra tɔrɛ nɛ, ma jʋjʋɔsɛ a kpʋ nɛsɩŋ arɩ piesee arɩ bʋʋnaa a chɩchaŋ aŋ nyʋnyʋa sɩnɩŋ aŋ bʋl, “Má leŋ la dii kɩaa aŋ nyʋa kʋnyʋalaa, bɛɛ wɩaa chie la jaŋ sʋʋ.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: “I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.” Selfish Officials Are Doomed
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la mɩ nɩɩ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ chɛma, a kaa mʋʋ yi ma sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ.” La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mʋ pɩɛsɛ nɩhɩaŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛbɩna, ʋ nɩɩ beŋ kuoru dɩa-la wɩɩkala ŋɩɩ:

english_verse: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ ŋɩŋaa daha, kʋbɛɛ nɛ pɩŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ŋ lɔsɛ ŋ dɩ-huguŋ bʋŋ lɛ dundolo nyuŋ?”

english_verse: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.
translation_verse: Bee-na La TƖƖNA kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ʋ chigiŋ a joŋo yuo ta, ŋ-na babiibal.

english_verse: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ gulumi a nagɛ bɔɔl, a joŋo yuo hɛ tintee-bal lɛ. Lee-la nɛ ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ pɩŋ ŋ janɩŋ torukoba-la ŋ sɩ kaa ŋmoo ŋ bɔyɛ bʋbʋɔŋ. Ŋ hɛ ŋ nɩhɩaŋ dɩa nɩaa hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is going to take away your job!
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ kiriŋ ŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ, aŋ kɛnɩŋ muuri.

english_verse: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ ŋ tɩntɩnnɩ gɛrɩ-zɔŋ-la a laalʋ, a joŋ ŋ gɛrɩ-pɛlɩɛɛ-bie-la vɔbʋ aŋ joŋ dol-la ŋ fa sɩ kɛnɛ pʋ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ arɩ Juda nɩaa kala nyɩmma.

english_verse: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ Devit dɩa boribiiŋ hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ dɩa-la suri, nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kaa tɔ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩra kaa tɔ ma, nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kaa suri.

english_verse: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ woruŋ a nagɛ ba sɩ pɛ daapɛhɛ tinteeŋ dɩ-duoŋ, dɩ ʋ nagɛ kuoru kpasa a kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.
translation_verse: Ɛlɩakɩm nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa wɩaa kala jaŋ sagɛ ʋ vaaŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ sagɛ ʋ lɛ a nagɛ zalɩŋ ba sɩ yie joŋ gbaŋ-balaa, gbaŋ-biisiŋ, dasɔsʋŋ arɩ danyinsiŋ a sagɛ ʋ lɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ, “Tapʋlɩɩ-la, daapɛhɛ-la ba sɩ ŋmoo pɛ dɩ-duoŋ jaŋ churi, dɩ chʋgʋsʋ-la kala sɩ sagɛ ʋ lɛ kɛrɛ tel.” La TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.
translation_verse: Ma Sɩdɔŋ bayalaa sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ, má kɛŋ goŋ, lɩɩŋ dabori jʋʋraa leŋe ma dʋa nɛ.

english_verse: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
translation_verse: Ma bayalaa chol fuo-balɩŋ arɩ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ, ba dɩ tintee daŋ didii yɔbɔ. Ba kɛŋ mɩaa lɩɩ Naayɩl fuo-la niiŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a kɔ Taaya nɛ, nɩmɛ bɩrɩmɛ yɔɔ-bal a pɩ tinteyee nɩaa.

english_verse: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.
translation_verse: Ou, Sɩdɔŋ nɩaa, hɩɩsɩŋ diima nɛ, ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ joŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ ʋ ŋaa ma dɩ-duoŋ, mʋga-la vɩama nɛ lɛɛlɛ aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ ha bɩ ha-lʋllɛ luoruŋ wɩɩ na, mɩ bɩ bii lʋla aŋ ka, mɩ ha bɩ hambolibie koo hantolibie ma dɩɛsa.”

english_verse: All of you along the coast had better cry and sail far across the ocean.
translation_verse: Má ŋmoo niiŋ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ mʋga niiŋ. Má sii fá chol taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Taasɩs.

english_verse: Can this be the happy city that has stood for centuries? Its people have spread to distant lands;
translation_verse: Ma tabal-la sɩ ŋaa ta-bɩnɩɩ, ma tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-laa? Taŋ-la lɛ ma fa sɩ yie lɩɩsɛ nɩaa ba mʋ hɔŋ tasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ lɛ a bibemba nɛ ŋ-laa?

english_verse: its merchants were kings honored all over the world. Who planned to destroy Tyre?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛba nɛ vʋʋra joŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa Taaya lɛ, tabal-la kuoroo sɩɩ bil kuori biisiŋ? Ʋ bayalaa kala fa ŋaa kuori-biiriŋ nɛ, dʋnɩa nɩaa kala zizilba.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ leŋe ŋɩɩ ŋaa Taaya tabal-la lɛ, dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ba babii-ballɩŋ dɛrɛ, a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa lɛ, dɩ ba nɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ zil yɩrɩŋ tuu tinteeŋ.

english_verse: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
translation_verse: Taasɩs tɩmma, má bil bagɩsɩŋ a nagɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩ bil bagɩsɩŋ Naayɩl fuo-la niiŋ ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa lee-la ma fa sɩɩ bil ma lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ cheye nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ zaarɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nyuŋ nɛ a kɛŋ kuoru-gentisi-la kala jigisi. Ʋ nɛ leŋe ba chei Taaya arɩ Sɩdɔŋ ta-duoru-la ba sɩ saa jebiee a kaa pʋpɔ ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Má Sɩdɔŋ tɩmma, ma tʋɔtɔrʋ-la kala ma fa sɩ kɛnɛ dɛrɛ nɛ lɛɛlɛ, ka ŋ nɩaa nɩna hɛɛŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ paala sii fá mʋ Saapʋrɔs ma, ma ha bɩ jaŋ na wiese.”

english_verse: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ duori lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ Taasɩs lɛ, má ŋmoo niiŋ, dɩ-duoru-la ma sɩɩ bil ma lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ kala nɛ cheye.

english_verse: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
translation_verse: “Hachɔrʋmʋŋ, nɩaa yʋ ŋ wɩaa nɛ, joŋ cheŋ du woruŋ a gɔllɛ tabalɩŋ tʋɔŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa yʋgɛ dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ ŋ ha hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Ama nyʋʋrɩ-la kala ba sɩ jaŋ na jaŋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA kɩaa, ba bɩ jaŋ joŋo bil. Nyʋʋrɩ-la nɛ ba jaŋ joŋo yɔɔ kʋdiilee yʋgɛ arɩ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩma pɩpɩ La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered,
translation_verse: Ma-na bibeŋ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ chei tinteeŋ kala, a ŋmoo nɩaa kala pɩsɛ a leŋ dɩ tinteeŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a ŋaa hoi.

english_verse: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa kala sɛnɛ jaŋ chei a pɩŋ hoi, ba jaŋ tii paa ʋ kʋŋkala. La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Tɩɩsɩ-la nɛnɛɛ ba sɩ kaa chɔ sɩnɩŋ kala hɩla nɛ ka sɩnɩŋ nyaa. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ yie nyʋa sɩnɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, lɛɛlɛ ba tʋɔŋ kala cheye nɛ.

english_verse: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.
translation_verse: Ba fa sɩ yie du cheŋ a ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlaa, a yɩyɩɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ yɩɩla-la kala dɛrɛ nɛ, lɛɛlɛ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ bɩra tuo.

english_verse: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
translation_verse: Nɩaa bɩra bɩ sɩnɩŋ nyʋa a yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa, sɩnɩŋ bɩra bɩ sɩŋ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: Towns are crushed and in chaos; houses are locked tight.
translation_verse: Wɩaa vʋgʋma nɛ tabal-la kala lɛ, nɩaa jʋʋ dɩɩsɩŋ aŋ tɔ ba boiŋ niiriŋ.

english_verse: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
translation_verse: Nɩaa yele su jaŋ tʋɔŋ wombiiŋ kala nɛ a chɩchɛ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ dɩ ba nyʋa. Ba tʋɔtɔrʋŋ kala dɛrɛ nɛ. Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ bɩra tuo tintee-la kala lɛ.

english_verse: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.
translation_verse: Tabal-la pɩŋ jikpeeŋ nɛ, ba ŋmoo ʋ boi-baalaa kala nɛ bori muno muno.

english_verse: Nations will be stripped bare, like olive trees or vineyards after the harvest season. Praise the God of Justice
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa tinteyee kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ ba sɩ tɔrɛ olif nɛnɛɛ koo ba sɩ tɔrɛ girep nɛnɛɛ, aŋ ka kʋkuunoo.

english_verse: People in the west shout; they joyfully praise the majesty of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ka jaŋ chaasa ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Ka nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ heeli aa dagɛ La TƖƖNA ballɩŋ.

english_verse: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ jaŋ dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ jaŋ leŋ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
translation_verse: La jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, a bʋl, “Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ tʋla arɩ tʋɔpʋla.” Ama mɩ sɩ, “Hɛɛŋ jʋʋmɛ nɛ, mɩ yɛrɛ ta nɛ, mɩ yɛrɛ ta nɛ. Zɛmbɛ tɩŋŋaa ka bɛ nɛ, a bɩ leŋ.”

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;
translation_verse: Dɩ fawʋllʋŋ nɛ jʋʋ nɩɩ-la kala dɩ ʋ fɩfá dɩ ʋ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ foro tuu buotuo-luŋii-la. Dɩ nɩɩ-la ma kala nɛ wuo nɛrɩgɛ lɩɩ buotuo-la lɛ, ʋ jaŋ jʋʋ bɛrɛ lɛ. Wɩa-nyuŋ jaŋ suri dɩ lɩɩŋ chuchuuri, ka dɩ tinteeŋ ma zigili.

english_verse: the earth is shattered, ripped to pieces.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ jaŋ yɛrɛ, a suri pagɩɩ a faasa zizigili.

english_verse: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ jaŋ begili a nagɛ nɩa sɩ bugo a gɩgɛrɛ. Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ lɛbɩŋ sɩ chɩna peliŋ kaa viisi, ʋ bɩ dɩ-bala wuo chɩŋ. Dʋnɩa nɩaa wʋcheelee jaŋ leŋ dɩ dʋnɩa tel, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo sii.

english_verse: On that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens and the kings of the earth.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, La TƖƖNA jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ kuorusu-la kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kiriba hɛ dɔŋɔ a nagɛ nɩaa sɩ hɛ bɩnɩŋ dɩa tʋɔŋ. Ba jaŋ tɔba hɛ nɩmɛ a mʋ yi bʋa-la ba sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba.

english_verse: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ bibeŋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ nɩaa arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala. Ʋ jaŋ ŋmoo chɛnɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ a hɛ pɛgɛ lɛ, ka dɩ ʋ nɩhɩasɩŋ na ʋ tʋla.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! I will praise you for doing the wonderful things you had planned and promised since ancient times.
translation_verse: Ou La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ mɩ Wɩa. Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ a yɩrɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ. Ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ, wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bɩɩna bil faafaa kala.

english_verse: You have destroyed the fortress of our enemies, leaving their city in ruins. Nothing in that foreign city will ever be rebuilt.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ leŋe tabal-la pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, tasɩ-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ a golli pɩŋ hoi nɛ. Taduoru-la nɩwogusuŋ sɩ saa bɩra tuo, nʋʋkala ma bɩ jaŋ wuo wasa paa saa.

english_verse: Now strong and cruel nations will fear and honor you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɩduoruŋ kala jaŋ ziliŋ, dɩ tintee-tʋɔhɛɛ tɩŋŋaa ma kala ziliŋ.

english_verse: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
translation_verse: Summoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ lee kɛnɛ yie fá kʋ yuori ŋ nɛ, ŋ nɛ ba yie kʋ yuori, ba wʋwalɩmaa dɛrɛ. Dɩ pel-duo nɩɩ kɔ, ŋ nɛ yie chu tɔba, dɩ wɩa nɩɩ kpʋba, ŋ nɛ yie tɔ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ ba lɛ. Nɩbɔmɔ-la wʋŋaalaa nagɛ pel-duoŋ sɩ luo aa yagɛ jeeŋ nɛ,

english_verse: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
translation_verse: a bɩra nagɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ sɩ faasa lɩŋ bagɛ-bagɛ. Ama ŋ-na La TƖƖNA leŋe la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ pʋgʋmɛ nɛ a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa sɩ yie keese tɔ wɩa-sɩɩŋ leriŋ fɩɛlɛ ŋɩɩ. Ŋ leŋe tʋɔhɛɛ tɩŋŋaa goŋ bal-la dɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
translation_verse: Peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ nyuŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ yɩrɛ gbiele, a ŋaa kʋdii-zɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nammɩɩ-zɔmʋŋ arɩ sɩŋ-la sɩ chaasa sɩŋ a pɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala.

english_verse: Here the Lord will strip away the burial clothes that cover the nations.
translation_verse: Peel-la nyuŋ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ giri tʋɔ-chee-la sɩ nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ a keese tɔ tinteyee ta.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ jaŋ giri sʋʋŋ ta a kaa mʋ wuu, aŋ fɩɩsɛ nʋʋkala sɩlɩɩrɩŋ ta. Hɩɩsɩ-la kala ʋ nɩaa fa sɩ die dʋnɩa lɛ, ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsʋ ta. La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: At that time, people will say, “The Lord has saved us! Let's celebrate. We waited and hoped— now our God is here.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la nʋʋkala jaŋ bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ nɛ la Wɩa, ʋ nɛ la laa dii, ʋ nɛ laala ta. La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋ-la, la laaʋ dii nɛ. Má leŋ dɩ la tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, dɩ la jʋjʋɔsɛ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ laala ta wɩaa.”

english_verse: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ peeliŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ, ama Mʋab tɩŋŋaa-na ʋ jaŋ nʋɔsɛba a bil a nagɛ ba sɩ nʋɔsɛ sekelee a ŋmʋra hɛ nɛ-bɩnɩŋ sɩ pʋa lɛ.

english_verse: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋmoo ba jebii-leŋie-la kala ba sɩ kaa pʋpɔ ba tɩtɩa lo. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kala tuu tinteeŋ.

english_verse: The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song: “Our city is protected. The Lord is our fortress, and he gives us victory.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tapʋlɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ yi, Juda nɩaa jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ deeŋ ba tinteeŋ lɛ: La kɛŋ tabalɩŋ nɛ, ʋ dolie, Wɩa tɩtɩa nɩɩ pɔ ʋ jebiee.

english_verse: Open the city gates for a law-abiding nation that is faithful to God.
translation_verse: Má suri boi-baalaa dɩ tintee-la nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla wuo jʋʋ. Ba nɛ tintee-la nɩaa sɩ laa Wɩa dii.

english_verse: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.
translation_verse: Má laa La TƖƖNA dii a kaa mʋ wuu, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ a pɔla bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: God has put down our enemies in their mountain city and rubbed it in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa muuri nɛ, aŋ chei ba ta-duoruŋ ma kala a yigi ba jebiee lo a kaa jɛrɛ.

english_verse: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ ba fa sɩ nyaga bil arɩ summoo ka vɛŋ taŋ-la nyuŋ nɛ a nʋɔsa bɩbal.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wombiiŋ magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ, ŋ nɛ wasɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wombii-la ʋ ŋaa mʋla mʋla.

english_verse: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, laa to ŋ wombiee ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto nɛ, la yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ. La cho dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ ka yɩrɛ nɛ bʋa na-kala a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩma arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala hɩɛna aa chɛŋ nɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala. Dɩ ŋ nɛ dii tinteeŋ nɩaa sarɩya, dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ba jɩŋ tʋɔpʋla wombiiŋ.

english_verse: Even when the wicked are treated with mercy in this land of justice, they do wrong and are blind to your glory, our Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋ dagɛ ŋ zile nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ teeŋ nɛ, aŋ ka ba bɩ chɛ dɩ ba to tʋɔpʋla wombiiŋ, aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba vɩa dɩ ba liisi La TƖƖNA ballɩŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ kɛŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ je nɛ dɩ ŋ dɔgɩsɛba, ka ba bɩ ʋ na. Leŋ dɩ ba na ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ cho ŋ nɩaa aŋ leŋ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ dii hɩɩsɩŋ. Leŋ dɩ nyiŋ-la ŋ sɩ joŋo bile gbɛrɛ diiba.

english_verse: You will give us peace, Lord, because everything we have done was by your power.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ leŋe la hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ, wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ wuo ŋaa, ŋ nɛ pɛ la lɛ.

english_verse: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa, nɩhɩasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma fa kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ la nyuŋ a bibenla, ama ŋ dʋndʋŋa yɩrɩŋ nɛ la zizil.

english_verse: Those enemies are now dead and can never live again. You have punished them— they are destroyed, completely forgotten.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ-na sʋba nɛ, ba bɩra tuo, ba dɩnsɩŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ sii. Ŋ dɔgɩsɛba nɛ a cheiba, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ ba wɩaa ka liisi.

english_verse: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord. We have more land than before, and you are honored. The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ kɛŋ ŋ nɩaa tinteeŋ kaa jallɛ nɛ, ŋ kɛŋ la tinteeŋ sɛmɛ na-kala bʋa kaa jalla pɛ nɛ. Ŋ leŋe ŋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ dɔgɩsɛ ŋ nɩaa, ba na hɛɛŋ. Ŋ sɩ lɛrɛ ba dɩgɩlɩŋ ba kɔ ŋ teeŋ nɛ a nɛrɩgɛ munso sʋsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na La TƖƖNA ŋaa la yel nɛ woruŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ, a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl a na hɛɛŋ a ŋmuŋmoo niiŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
translation_verse: La na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ a nagɛ bii nɛ laa chɛ dɩ la lʋl, ka dɩdɛrɩŋ kala ʋ ŋaa pɛɩ. La bɩ wuo kɛŋ laatanɩŋ a kɔ tinteeŋ, la bɩra bɩ wuo ŋaa wɩɩkala ma a pɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa.

english_verse: Your people will rise to life! Tell them to leave their graves and celebrate with shouts. You refresh the earth like morning dew; you give life to the dead.
translation_verse: Ama la laa dii arɩ ŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba jaŋ sii a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ bʋa tʋɔŋ jaŋ sii a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. A nagɛ nyalɩŋ sɩ yie nyal a leŋ leriŋ fɩɛlɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ a na fɩɛlɩŋ.

english_verse: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa, má jʋʋ faa ma dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ a kɛŋ ma borusuŋ tɔ aŋ gbɛrɛ mʋa dɩ Wɩa baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.
translation_verse: Má bee na, La TƖƖNA lɩɩ ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ nɛ a kʋkɔ dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ lʋara kpʋ nɩaa wɩaa jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ, ka tinteeŋ ma lusi nɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kpʋa a hugi.

english_verse: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword. Protection and Forgiveness The Lord said:
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ ʋ tokobii-duo-la sɩ kɛŋ niiŋ woruŋ a dɔgɩsɛ peribanyeŋŋu, aŋ kpʋ kʋkpuŋkpere-la sɩ yʋga a nagɛ dɩmɩŋ a hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, La TƖƖNA jaŋ bʋl ŋ-la a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ baga-la sɩ nɛŋ woruŋ lɛ:

english_verse: I, the Lord, will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.
translation_verse: “Mɩ beŋ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ, a ŋaa lɩɩŋ hɩhɛ ʋ lɛ bʋa na-kala. Mɩ yie pɔʋ nɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala, dɩ nʋʋ sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ joŋo ŋaa ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra bɩ baanɩŋ na mɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ baga-la nyuŋ. Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ fa nagɛ sɔ-lugunuŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba walɩmɛmɛ, mɩ jaŋ kpʋba a nyɩga ta.

english_verse: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ mɩ nɩaa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kʋ yuorimi, ba jaŋ wuo kɔ dɩ la bʋla hɛ dɔŋɔ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, má leŋ dɩ la bʋla hɛ dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: Someday Israel will take root like a vine. It will blossom and bear fruit that covers the earth.
translation_verse: Bʋa dɔŋ lɛ, Iziral naapoloo jaŋ tuu tinteeŋ a nagɛ tɩa, a fɩɩlɛ a nɛŋ nɛnɛɛ a su dʋnɩa kala.

english_verse: I, the Lord, didn't punish and kill the people of Israel as fiercely as I punished and killed their enemies.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ka dɔgɩsɛ a nagɛ ʋ sɩ yie dɔgɩsɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ bɩra bɩ baa kpʋ ma a nagɛ ʋ sɩ yie kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kpʋba ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ La TƖƖNA joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala chɛba nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ ba nɛ ŋmoo ba vʋɩyaa korunu-la tabɩaa kala a yɛrɛ muno muno arɩ ba sɩ bugisi chʋrʋŋ ʋ bii ŋɩɩ, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ veŋ-haal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ kʋŋkala hɛ nɩmɛ arɩ ba kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma korunuŋ.

english_verse: Fortress cities are left like a desert where no one lives. Cattle walk through the ruins, stripping the trees bare.
translation_verse: Taŋ-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ a golli kala pɩŋ hoi nɛ, ba vɩa ta nɛ, ʋ nagɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ, nɛsɩŋ didii kɩaa nɩmɛ aŋ pɛ pɩpɩŋ nɩmɛ a gbegisi ʋ tɩɩsɩŋ pɩpaarɩŋ kala.

english_verse: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.
translation_verse: Dɩ tɩɩsɩ-la naakelee nɛ hɩla a boro tel, haalaa yie paa mʋ hɛ nyiniŋ nɛ. Nɩaa deemba bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa sɩ ŋaaba bɩ ba nenige fá ŋɩɩ a bɩ ba lɛ pɛ.

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
translation_verse: Ama bʋa deeŋ lɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋŋ kʋŋ a kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a chɩŋ Efireti fuo-la lɛ, a kaa mʋ yi Ijipiti tinteeŋ niiŋ. Ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsɛba a nagɛ ba sɩ yie chaarɛ mɩaa a lɩɩsɛ mɩɩ-biiŋ aŋ ka mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la ba jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ ba faasa ŋmʋʋ banyile. Iziral tɩmma-la ba sɩ kɛsɛ a kaa mʋ Asiiria arɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ La TƖƖNA teeŋ a dɛnnʋ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ a hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ nyuŋ.

english_verse: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.
translation_verse: Wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tabalɩŋ Samarɩa, ʋ nɛ chɩŋ fuonaa sɩmɩŋ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ. Ba sɩpaalaaraa kala ŋaa sɩ-nyʋaraa nɛ. Ba babii-ballɩɩ-la kala nagɛ tɩɩfɩɩlaa ba sɩ kaa ŋaa kuori-nyunchuulo nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ hɩl a yuori.

english_verse: Only the Lord is strong and powerful! His mighty hand will strike them down with the force of a hailstorm or a mighty whirlwind or an overwhelming flood.
translation_verse: Má bee na, La TƖƖNA kɛŋ nɩduo nɛ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ kʋkɔ ma lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ kɔ a nagɛ duoŋ-peliŋ koo pel-la sɩɩ chei leriŋ koo a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ faasa nɩnɩɩ koo fuoŋ sɩ suo a gbu lɩlɩɩ, a chei tintee-la kala.

english_verse: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.
translation_verse: Iziral tabal-la ʋ sɩpaalaarɩ sɩ-nyʋaraa sɩ kaa ŋmoo bɔyɛ, ba jaŋ chei ʋ kala a nʋɔsʋ bil tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.
translation_verse: Taŋ-la tʋla kala jaŋ lɛl a nagɛ tɩɩ-fɩɩlɩŋ sɩ hɩla yuori, ʋ jaŋ nagɛ tutogo sɩ chɩŋ fuonaaŋ sɩ sɩma nyuŋ a bugimo nɛŋ a bɩɩ dɩ ba tɔrʋŋ bʋa ha bɩ yie ka ba naʋ a guu tɔrɔ dii.

english_verse: When this time comes, the Lord All-Powerful will be a glorious crown for his people who survive.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ nagɛ kuoru-nyunchuulo sɩ zɔmɔ woruŋ, a chu tɔ ʋ nɩkaana-la ba sɩ bɩ kpʋa lɛ.

english_verse: He will see that justice rules and that his people are able to defend their cities. Corrupt Leaders Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ jaŋ pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ sarɩya diiree kpasa lɛ dɩma-la sɩ kɛŋ tɛŋɛ, aŋ joŋ doluŋ ma a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ pʋpɔ ba taŋ boi-baalɩŋ dɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ́ kʋ jʋʋ.

english_verse: Their tables are covered, completely covered, with their stinking vomit.
translation_verse: Teebʋlba-la nyuŋ ba sɩɩ dii kɩaa kala nɛ ba tʋɔsa chei, lee bɩ ka a bɩ nyɛsɩŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: You drunken leaders are like babies! How can you possibly understand or teach the Lord's message?
translation_verse: Ba pɩɛsɛ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ Azaaya chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩaa a dagɛ? Kʋbɛɛba nɛ ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ dagɛ wɩaa bʋbʋɔsʋŋ a pa? Ʋ bɩɩna lɛɛlɛ nɛ ba kɛrɩla yɩlɩŋ lɛɛ?

english_verse: You don't even listen— all you hear is senseless sound after senseless sound.
translation_verse: Ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ dɩdagɛla wɩaa kʋbala kʋbala, wɩɩ wɩɩ, daha mʋa, daha ma mʋa.”

english_verse: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.
translation_verse: Azaaya bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ-na ʋ zɔmɔ, Wɩa jaŋ kɛŋ nɩwogusuŋ wʋbʋlʋŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩ nɩaa deemba.”

english_verse: Now his message to you will be senseless sound after senseless sound. Then you will fall backwards, injured and trapped. False Security Is Fatal
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA jaŋ dɩdagɛma ʋ wɩaa kʋbala kʋbala. Wɩɩ wɩɩ, daha mʋa daha ma mʋa. Ŋɩɩ saa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma gɛrɛ a tele bolimi a jʋʋ bɛrɛ dɩ ba kɛsɛma a nagɛ nɩaa ba sɩ kaa tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa.

english_verse: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.
translation_verse: Ma nɩhɩa-yaayaa deemba sɩɩ dagɛ ma tɩtɩa a bibeŋ Jerusalɛm, má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?
translation_verse: Ma bigisi ma tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ a bʋl, “La dɩ sʋʋŋ bil niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ nɛ, la dɩ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ ma bʋla nɩɩ dɔŋɔ. Dɩ wʋbɔŋ nɛ kʋ jʋʋ la tinteeŋ ma, ʋ bɩ jaŋ ŋaala wɩɩkala, bɛɛ wɩaa la kɛŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ a pilime tɔ la tɩtɩa nɛ dɩ ʋ laala ta.”

english_verse: And so the Lord says, “I'm laying a firm foundation for the city of Zion. It's a valuable cornerstone proven to be trustworthy; no one who trusts it will ever be disappointed.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la, “Má bee na, mɩ joŋ tabɩɩŋ mɩ sɩ magɩsa a jɩŋ ʋ maŋŋaa nɛ a bil Zaayɔŋ lɛ, ʋ ŋaa je-gʋnʋŋ tabɩɩ-zɔŋ nɛ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Zaayɔŋ gentine chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ laa tabɩɩ-la wɩaa dii, hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ dii tɩɩna.

english_verse: Your agreement with death and the world of the dead will be broken. Then angry, roaring waves will sweep over you.
translation_verse: Ma dɩ sʋʋŋ sɩ bil nii-la pɩ dɔŋɔ bɩra bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ, ma dɩ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ bʋla nɩɩ-la ma jaŋ birigi. Dɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ nɛ kɔ, ʋ jaŋ cheima.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night an overwhelming flood will wash you away. The terrible things that happen will teach you this lesson:
translation_verse: Bʋa-la kala lɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kɔ, ʋ jaŋ cheima, chʋchʋɔŋ, wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala, ʋ jaŋ tii paama. Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmma dɩ ma nɛ jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will fiercely attack as he did at Mount Perazim and in Gibeon Valley. But this time the Lord will do something surprising, not what you expect.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ sii yuoma arɩ ʋ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Parazɩm lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ sii ma lɛ arɩ ʋ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Gibioŋ fuonaaŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ wuo ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ ŋaa, wɩalɩŋ ma ha sɩ bɩ na aŋ ka.

english_verse: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction. All Wisdom Comes from the Lord
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má leŋ nɩaa sieriŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee chɔrʋmɔ-la sɩ hɛ ma lɛ jaŋ faasa yuŋ. La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bʋla pɩmɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ chei tinteeŋ kala nɛ.

english_verse: Pay close attention to what I am saying.
translation_verse: Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ woruŋ, a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl.

english_verse: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ bugili baga-la dɛrɛ, ʋ bɩ kɩaa ka duu? Aɩ, ʋ yie joŋ jisiiŋ arɩ siee nɛ a duu, aŋ joŋ mɛmpɛ arɩ mɩaa a duu naaderee a golli baga-la niiŋ.

english_verse: They learn this from their God.
translation_verse: Ʋ Wɩa yie dagʋ nɛ ʋ jɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa wombiiŋ.

english_verse: After dill and cumin have been harvested, the stalks are pounded, not run over with a wagon.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ daa-balɩŋ nɛ kaa ŋmoo miiriŋ, koo a joŋ hɔ-daaŋ aa ŋmoo mɩaa. Ʋ yie joŋ daa-la sɩ maga nɛ.

english_verse: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.
translation_verse: Ba yie nɔŋ mɩaa nɛ aŋ-na kaa ŋaa boroboro. Nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ mɩaa ka ŋmoo deeŋ deeŋ. Ʋ yie kɛŋ toruko jʋʋ nʋɔsɛ nɛ, ama ʋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ janɩŋ nʋɔsa bugili.

english_verse: This wonderful knowledge comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who has such great wisdom.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala lɩɩ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ jɩŋ nɩaa chagɩlɩŋ woruŋ, a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.
translation_verse: Wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm, tabal-la lɛ Devit fa sɩ hɔnɔ. Ma yie gbigbieli ma gbielee nɛ jɩna na-kala, ma ha ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I will still make you suffer, and your people will cry when I make an altar of you.
translation_verse: Ama arɩ ŋɩɩ kala mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wʋlɔrʋŋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ chei dɩ ʋ ŋmoo niiŋ. Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ chalɩŋ sɩ tɔ.

english_verse: I will surround you and prepare to attack from all sides.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ golli ʋ kala chu, mɩ jaŋ saa kɛrɛ-duoruŋ golli ʋ kala a saa lusuŋ chol sɩaa jʋʋ yuou.

english_verse: From deep in the earth, you will call out for help with only a faint whisper.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ muuri, ŋ jaŋ bʋl wɩaa a pɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋ wʋbʋlʋŋ jaŋ nagɛ nɩdɩma sɩ hugi tinteeŋ a mumunsi wɩaa.

english_verse: Then your cruel enemies will suddenly be swept away like dust in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ dʋndɔŋ kɛnɛ-la sɩ yuoŋ jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ. Tʋɔ-hɛɛ tɩmma-la jaŋ nagɛ mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ peliŋ sɩ paa viiri, lɩma lɩma.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will come to your rescue with a thundering earthquake and a fiery whirlwind.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ guu kɔ, leriŋ jaŋ dʋdɔŋ, dɩ tinteeŋ zizigili, dɩ goŋ faasa ŋɩŋaa. Pel-duoŋ jaŋ lulu dɩ nyiŋgeliŋ sii a didii kɩaa.

english_verse: Every brutal nation that attacks Jerusalem and makes it suffer will disappear like a dream when night is over.
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩ-daŋ-la kala sɩɩ yuo Jerusalɛm, arɩ ʋ dɩɩ-duoruŋ a leŋ baa na hɛɛŋ, ba wɩaa kala jaŋ nagɛ nɩa sɩ duoso tɩtaŋɩŋ,

english_verse: Those nations that attack Mount Zion will suffer from hunger and thirst. They will dream of food and drink but wake up weary and hungry and thirsty as ever. Prophets Who Fool Themselves
translation_verse: a nagɛ losumo sɩ duoso dɩ ʋ dii kɩaa a herige sii dɩ losuŋ nɛ ʋ ha kɛŋ, koo a nagɛ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ nɩa ʋ duosi arɩ ʋʋ nyʋa lɩɩŋ a hirige sii dɩ ŋɩɩ dee. Ŋɩɩ nɛ sɛnɛ jaŋ ŋaa tinteyee nɩ-daŋ-la sɩ yuo peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: Be shocked and stunned, you prophets! Refuse to see. Get drunk and stagger, but not from wine.
translation_verse: Ʋ kperima nɛ, ma niiŋ kala maa, ma tɔ ma sɩaa nɛ a bɩ wɩɩkala ka na, ma bugo nɛ aŋ bɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ nyʋa, a gɩgɛrɛ aŋ bɩ sɩ-duo kala nyʋa.

english_verse: The Lord has made you drowsy; he put you into a deep sleep and covered your head.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA ŋaa ma pɩŋ doŋ nɛ a yuo naaŋ. Ʋ tɔ ma Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩaa nɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ na wɩaa arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord has said: “These people praise me with their words, but they never really think about me. They worship me by repeating rules made up by humans.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Nɩaa deemba yie kɔ mɩ teeŋ a kɛŋ niiŋ nɛ zizilmi, ka ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa bol arɩ mɩ. Ba yie to nuhuobiinee wombiee nɛ a chʋchʋɔlɛmɛ.

english_verse: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ a ŋaa daŋ dɔŋɔ ba lɛ, dɩ ba wʋjɩnnaa wʋjɩmɩŋ kala lɛl, dɩ ba wʋjɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ tɩŋŋaa wʋjɩmɩŋ kala nyɩɩgɛ.”

english_verse: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.
translation_verse: Wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ joŋ ba wɩaa faa La TƖƖNA, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa birimiŋ tʋɔŋ aŋ bʋl, “Kʋbɛɛ nɩɩ nala? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ jɩŋ?”

english_verse: You have it all backwards. A clay dish doesn't say to the potter, “You didn't make me. You don't even know how.” Hope for the Future
translation_verse: Ma yie kɛŋ wɩaa bɩrɩmɛ yala nɛ, a nagɛ pupo-mɛɛrɛ arɩ ʋ pupoiŋ kala magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Kʋ-la ba sɩ mɛ jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ mɛʋ arɩ ʋ dee bɩ ʋ mɛ? Pupoiŋ jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ mɛʋ arɩ ʋ bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ?

english_verse: Soon the forest of Lebanon will become a field with crops, thick as a forest.
translation_verse: Ʋ ka mʋa ka dɩ Lɛbanɔŋ ŋmaŋkaaŋ kɩaa luŋi, dɩ ŋmaŋkaa-la sɩ sɩma woruŋ nagɛ duuŋ.

english_verse: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, nɩalɩŋ sɩ taŋa jaŋ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ, dɩ nyʋlɩmaa sɩ hɛ biriŋ lim tʋɔŋ sɩaa wuo nɩna.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri jaŋ wasa jʋɔsɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ, bɩra jʋɔsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ teeŋ.

english_verse: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear,
translation_verse: Tʋɔ-hɛɛ tɩmma-la kala jaŋ nyɩɩgɛ, dɩ sinsieri tɩmma-la ma kala lɛl. Ba jaŋ kpʋ wʋbɔŋ ŋaara-la ma kala,

english_verse: together with everyone who tells lies in court and keeps innocent people from getting a fair trial.
translation_verse: a pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chei nɩaa yɩrɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɔ dɩ ba sɩ́ wʋcheeree dɔgʋsʋ aŋ yie nyɩɛ wɩaa sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ a pɔ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye sɩ́ kʋsɩŋŋaa laa.

english_verse: The Lord who rescued Abraham has this to say about Jacob's descendants: “They will no longer be ashamed and disgraced.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ laa Abɩraham ta, sɩ bʋla pɩ Jekɔb doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: “Hɩɩsɩŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba gʋrɛ nyuŋ.

english_verse: When they see how great I have made their nation, they will praise and honor me, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ na biiri-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩba, ba jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ woruŋ. Ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ Jekɔb Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ chaasa zizil Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa.

english_verse: Everyone who is confused will understand, and all who have complained will obey my teaching.”
translation_verse: Nɩyaaraa jaŋ gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ cho wɩaa gʋrʋmʋŋ sɛɩ dɩ ba dagɛba.”

english_verse: This is the Lord's message for his rebellious people: “You follow your own plans instead of mine; you make treaties without asking me, and you keep on sinning.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ Juda tinteeŋ. Ba vɩa mɩ niiŋ nɛ. Ba yie vʋʋrɛ wɩaa ŋɩŋaa, ka mɩ bɩ ba ŋɩɩ daga. Ba dɩ nɩaa pɛ niiŋ nɛ a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bɩ cho. Ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a dɩdaŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.
translation_verse: Ba sie nɛ a mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro pɛ ba lɛ a dagɛba, aŋ bɩ mɩ pɩɛsa. Baa chɛ dɩ ʋ nɛ pɔba.

english_verse: The king's power reaches from the city of Zoan as far south as Hanes.
translation_verse: Ba tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ba tɩndaaraa magɩla yi tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zʋaŋ arɩ Hanes nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ,

english_verse: This is a message about the animals of the Southern Desert: “You people carry treasures on donkeys and camels. You travel to a feeble nation through a troublesome desert filled with lions and flying fiery dragons.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nɛgɛf pʋsʋŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Má kɛsɛ kakusuŋ arɩ bʋntaŋŋaba nɛ a kaa chʋŋ ma dʋa a to tintee-la sɩ kɛŋ kʋbɔŋŋɔɔ dɩŋŋaa sɩ kɛŋ huoŋ woruŋ arɩ naachigee a mʋmʋ

english_verse: Egypt can't help you! That's why I call that nation a helpless monster.” Israel Refuses To Listen
translation_verse: Ijipiti tintee-la sɩ bɩ nyʋʋrɩɩ kala kɛnɛ a bɩ ma lɛ wuo pɛ. Mɩ-na kɛnʋ yɩyɩrɛ Rahab lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ kʋbɔŋ-la sɩ bɩ wɩɩ wuo ŋaa nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to write down his message for his people, so that it would be there forever.
translation_verse: Mʋ ŋmʋnsɛ mɩ nɩaa wʋkɛnɛɛ a hɛ tabɩɩ-taala arɩ teniŋ lɛ a bil, ʋ jaŋ pɩŋ a ŋaa magɩl pɩba a kaa mʋ wuu arɩ ba ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ nɛ.

english_verse: They have turned against the Lord and can't be trusted. They have refused his teaching
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa nɩa sɩ vɩa wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ daga nɛ. Ba ŋaa wʋnyɩɛraa nɛ. Ba bɩ chɛ dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ dagɛba.

english_verse: and have said to his messengers and prophets: Don't tell us what God has shown you and don't preach the truth. Just say what we want to hear, even if it's false.
translation_verse: Ba bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie na wɩaa arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ, “Ma bɩra sɩ́ wɩaa na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ.” Ba bɩra bʋla pɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa ma, “Má sɩ́ la wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ la ŋaa dagʋ, má bʋl wɩalɩŋ la sɩ cho nɛ a pɩpɩla, dɩ ba ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩ ma. Má leŋ dɩ la tuto wɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: Stop telling us what God has said! We don't want to hear any more about the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Lɩɩ la wombiiŋ lɛ, sɩ́ la wombiiŋ kɛrʋ. Sɩ́ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ wɩaa kaa kɛnla pugi.”

english_verse: Now this is the answer of the holy One of Israel: “You rejected my message, and you trust in violence and lies.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ma sɩ vɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma aŋ tuto tʋɔbɔmʋŋ arɩ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ harɩŋ ŋ-la,

english_verse: This sin is like a crack that makes a high wall quickly crumble
translation_verse: wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ jaŋ dɛrɛ ma nyuŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ jebiiŋ sɩ leŋie a yɛrɛ a guu tel.

english_verse: and shatter like a crushed bowl. There's not a piece left big enough to carry hot coals or to dip out water.” Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ yɛrɛ muno muno a nagɛ pupoiŋ, nʋʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo na ʋ kanchele a kaa chaanɛ nyiniŋ koo a kaa kuoni lɩɩŋ pɩlɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The holy Lord God of Israel had told all of you, “I will keep you safe if you turn back to me and calm down. I will make you strong if you quietly trust me.” Then you stubbornly
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Má bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ aŋ laamɛ dii, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ laama ta dɩ ma na wiese a kɛŋ doluŋ. Ama, ma vɩa nɛ.

english_verse: said, “No! We will safely escape on speedy horses.” But those who chase you will be even faster.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ ma jaŋ kɛŋ janɩŋ sɩɩ fá woruŋ a fá kagɛ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, fanɩŋ na, ma jaŋ fá, ama ma bɩɩna ma janɩ-la ka fá nɛ ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kirima fá kɩkɩɩ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: As few as five of them, or even one, will be enough to chase a thousand of you. Finally, all that will be left will be a few survivors as lonely as a flag pole on a barren hill. The Lord Will Show Mercy
translation_verse: Ma nɩaa bʋɩ jaŋ na ba nɩbala a fá. Ba nɩaa banɔŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma fá aŋ ka ma nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ, a nagɛ jɔnjɔŋ sɩ chɩŋ peeliŋ nyuŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord God is waiting to show how kind he is and to have pity on you. The Lord always does right; he blesses those who trust him.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA ka gbɛrɛ nɛ dɩ ʋ dagɛma ʋ zile, ʋ jaŋ fá ma nenige. La TƖƖNA Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ woruŋ, ʋ jaŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ gbɛrʋ lɛ.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, you don't need to cry anymore. The Lord is kind, and as soon as he hears your cries for help, he will come.
translation_verse: Ma Zaayɔŋ nɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, ma yele jaŋ dɛrɛ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ fá ma nenige. Dɩ ma nɛ yele pʋ, ʋ jaŋ nɩɩ a guu pɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has given you trouble and sorrow as your food and drink. But now you will again see the Lord, your teacher, and he will guide you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA leŋe ma na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ, ama ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ dagɛma, ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa faama, ma jaŋ naʋ arɩ ma sɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice saying, “This is the road! Now follow it.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ yeŋŋi wombiiŋ a mʋ nadiiŋ koo nagʋa, ma jaŋ nɩɩ ʋ yikoro ma harɩŋ dɩ ʋ sɩ, “Má na wombiiŋ, má kʋ lɩɩ to.”

english_verse: Then you will treat your idols of silver and gold like garbage; you will throw them away like filthy rags.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ paa tɔmɔ-la ma sɩ kɛŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ taara tɔ a yuo ta, a nagɛ haala sɩ lɩɩsɛ amuosii yuo ta aŋ bʋl, “Má mʋ aŋ ka mɩ.”

english_verse: The Lord will send rain to water the seeds you have planted—your fields will produce more crops than you need, and your cattle will graze in open pastures.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ dɩ ma duu kɩaa dɩ ba wasɛ woruŋ, dɩ kʋdiilee pʋrɩgɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ ma nɛsɩŋ jaŋ na yaŋ a dii woruŋ.

english_verse: Even the oxen and donkeys that plow your fields will be fed the finest grain.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, ma nɛ-pɛrɛɛ arɩ ma kakusu-la kala ma sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ jaŋ kuri ya-zɔmʋŋ a dii.

english_verse: On that day people will be slaughtered and towers destroyed, but streams of water will flow from high hills and towering mountains.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kpʋ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ yigi ba dɩɩ-duoru-la kala lo, lɩɩŋ jaŋ pɩpɛllɛ peelee arɩ dundolluŋ nyuŋ kala.

english_verse: Then the Lord will bandage his people's injuries and heal the wounds he has caused. The moon will shine as bright as the sun, and the sun will shine seven times brighter than usual. It will be like the light of seven days all at once. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Chɛnɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ jaŋ chaanɛ a nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, ka wɩɩpɔsʋŋ ma chaanɛ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ vɛnɛ chɩchaanɛ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ, a nagɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ sɩ kʋ pɛ dɔŋɔ a chaanɛ tapʋl-bala. Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ naawɩɩla-la ʋ sɩ hɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is coming from far away with his fiery anger and thick clouds of smoke. His angry words flame up like a destructive fire;
translation_verse: Má bee na, La TƖƖNA doluŋ arɩ ʋ tʋla nɛ lɩɩ dɩ-bolii a kʋkɔ. Ʋ baanɩŋ chaasa sii nɛ a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ sɩ tɔ nyʋɔsʋŋ. Ʋ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa kɛŋ baanɩŋ, ʋ nɛ suri ʋ niiŋ ʋ nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩ joŋ kɩaa didii nɛ.

english_verse: he breathes out a flood that comes up to the neck. He sifts the nations and destroys them. Then he puts a bridle in every foreigner's mouth and leads them to doom.
translation_verse: Ʋ wiese peliŋ nagɛ fuoŋ lɩɩŋ sɩ suo a jɩla sɩɩrɛ nɛ, dɩ ʋ chei tinteyee kala a paa chesi. Ʋ joŋ niiŋ koŋ nɛ a hɛ nɩaa niiree lɛ dɩ ʋ lɛrɛ ba mʋ hɛ sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's people will sing as they do when they celebrate a religious festival at night. The Lord is Israel's mighty rock, and his people will be as happy as they are when they follow the sound of flutes to the mountain where he is worshiped.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ a nagɛ ma sɩ yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ dɩ ma nɩɩ gbieli gbiele-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ a nagɛ nɩaa sɩ ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlaa a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a jɩjɩl La TƖƖNA peeliŋ. Ʋ nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ a pɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: The Lord will get furious. His fearsome voice will be heard, his arm will be seen ready to strike, and his anger will be like a destructive fire, followed by thunderstorms and hailstones.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa nɩɩ ʋ baalɩŋ-yikoro, a na ʋ baaŋ-la sɩ nagɛ nyiniŋ a didii kɩaa. Duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ jaŋ tɔ dɩ duonuŋ nɩnɩɩ aŋ kpɩkpɩa dɩ duoŋ-tabɩaa titel.

english_verse: When the Assyrians hear the Lord's voice and see him striking with his iron rod, they will be terrified.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA niiŋ wʋbʋlaa nɛ jaŋ ŋmoo Asiiria lo dɩ ʋ kuoru dantɩga ŋmooba pɩsɛ.

english_verse: He will attack them in battle, and each time he strikes them, it will be to the music of tambourines and harps.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ yuo Asiiria tɩŋŋaa. Dɩ ʋ nɛ joŋ ʋ daa-la ʋ sɩ kaa dɔgɩsɛ nɩaa ŋmooba na-kala, ʋ nɩaa jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a chɩgɩsɛ chɩnchɩgɩsɩŋ a du cheŋ hɛ.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord got a place ready for burning the body of the dead king. The place for the fire is deep and wide, the wood is piled high, and the Lord will start the fire by breathing out flaming sulfur.
translation_verse: Ba gɩrɛ daasɩŋ nɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɔfɛf lɛ faafaa kala a gbɩgbɛrɛ Asiiria kuoro. Ba leŋe nyiŋ-la bʋa luŋ nɛ aŋ jal ma, nyiniŋ arɩ daasɩŋ yʋga nɛ a hɛ nɩmɛ. La TƖƖNA wiese jaŋ nagɛ juribiiŋ sɩ chol nyiŋgeliŋ a jomba dii.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you go to Egypt for help, or if you depend on an army of chariots or a powerful cavalry. Instead you should depend on and trust the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu nɩalɩŋ sɩ mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba pɛ ba lɛ, a joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ janɩŋ arɩ janɩŋ torukoba-la ba sɩ kaa yuo laalɩŋ sɩ yʋga lɛ arɩ ja-jɩllaa sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ, aŋ vɩa dɩ ba mʋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ teeŋ, koo a chɩchɛ dɩ La TƖƖNA pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord isn't stupid! He does what he promises, and he can bring doom. If you are cruel yourself, or help those who are evil, you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ʋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ, ʋ jaŋ lɛrɛ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ kʋ hɛ ba lɛ. Wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla, ʋ bɩ jaŋ kaa bɩrɩmɛ. Ʋ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛ nɩaa lɛ ba ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: The Egyptians are mere humans. They aren't God. Their horses are made of flesh; they can't live forever. When the Lord shows his power, he will destroy the Egyptians and all who depend on them. Together they will fall.
translation_verse: Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nuhuobiinee nɛ, ba bɩ Wɩa ŋaa. Ba janɩŋ jaŋ sʋʋ, ba bɩ jaŋ wuo hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ. Dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ dagɛ ʋ doluŋ, ʋ jaŋ chei Ijipiti tintee-duo-la Iziral tintee-la nɩaa lɛ Ijipiti sɩ pɛ, ba kala balɩa jaŋ tel.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me, “I will roar and attack like a fearless lion not frightened by the shouts of shepherds trying to protect their sheep. That's how I will come down and fight on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Dɩ naachigiŋ nɛ kpʋ nammɩa a chɩchaŋ aŋ hʋʋnɛ, kʋdaaraa cho ba magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ŋɩŋaa goŋ ʋ nyuŋ, fawʋllʋŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ dɩ ʋ fá kagɛ kʋ-la lɛ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ pɔ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ. Wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ wuo kirimi.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will protect Jerusalem like a mother bird circling over her nest.” Come Back to the Lord
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chu tɔ Jerusalɛm a pɔʋ a nagɛ diibie sɩ zaara pʋpɔ ʋ biiriŋ dɛlɛ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kʋ laa Jerusalɛm ta.”

english_verse: People of Israel, come back! You have completely turned from the Lord.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, ma lɩɩ La TƖƖNA harɩŋ nɛ a ŋaa wɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ a cheyu, má mɩɩra kɔ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: The time is coming when you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, made by your sinful hands.
translation_verse: Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, ma kʋŋkala jaŋ vɩa ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tɔmɔ-la ma sɩ kɛŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ a ŋaa.

english_verse: The Assyrians will be killed, but not by the swords of humans. Their young men will try to escape, but they will be captured and forced into slavery.
translation_verse: Asiiria tɩŋŋaa jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, ama nuhuobiine doluŋ dee bɩ jaŋ kpʋba. Ba jaŋ fá, ka ba kɛsɛ ba bapʋɔsaa dɩ ba ŋaa yosi a fʋgɛba hɛ dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: Their fortress will fall when terror strikes; their army officers will be frightened and run from the battle. This is what the Lord has said, the Lord whose fiery furnace is built on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛŋ ba nɩduoruŋ kala dɩ ba fá. Laalɩŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ kala chichel. La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Ʋ nyiniŋ nɩɩ dii Zaayɔŋ peel-la lɛ a ŋaa hololo Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: They will be a place of safety from stormy winds, a stream in the desert, and a rock that gives shade from the heat of the sun.
translation_verse: Ba kʋŋkala jaŋ nagɛ kʋŋ sɩɩ kɛrɛ peliŋ a bɩra ŋaa lee, dɩ peliŋ nɩɩ lu ŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo fá mʋ a faa. Ba jaŋ nagɛ fuoŋ sɩ pɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, a bɩra nagɛ bʋŋ sɩ keese tɔ nɩaa lɛ tintee-la lɛ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ sɩ faasa hɛ.

english_verse: Then everyone who has eyes will open them and see, and those who have ears will pay attention.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩaa sɩ suro jaŋ nɩna wɩaa, dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ dɩgɩlaa jegilee nɩɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: All who are impatient will take time to think; everyone who stutters will talk clearly.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɩaa sɩ bɩ kenyiri kɛnɛ, ama ba jaŋ bʋl wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ bʋl jaŋ kɛŋ sɩaa.

english_verse: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.
translation_verse: Nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋ nɩyaarɩŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɩ-yuŋi koo a zil nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ ka to.

english_verse: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord, to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.
translation_verse: Nɩyaarɩŋ yie bʋl nɩyaarɛ wɩaa nɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ. Ʋ yie ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ La TƖƖNA wombiiŋ ka to nɛ, a nyɩɛ wɩaa ma a tɩtɩgɛ ʋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩ losuŋ sɩ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ kʋdiilee ka pa, a vɔŋ nɩalɩŋ ma lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ sɩ kɛnɛ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ ka nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ʋ yie bɩbɩɩnɛ dɩ ʋ chei summoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ nɛ. Dɩ ba kɩaa nɛ paala sɩŋ ma, ʋ yie joŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ a chei ba kala.

english_verse: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans. Punishment for the Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ zil ba tɩtɩa yie chɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ naaŋ lɛ nɛ kpaŋkpaŋ. Jerusalɛm haalaa

english_verse: You may not have worries now, but in about a year, the grape harvest will fail, and you will tremble.
translation_verse: Jɩna harɩŋ, ma sɩ bɩɩna arɩ wʋwalɩmɩɩ kala tuo, wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋma, ma girep tɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ birigi, ba nɛnɛɛ tɔrʋŋ jaŋ tuo.

english_verse: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards,
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ chei dɩ ma paa nɩsaa chʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma ŋmaŋkaanɩ-la kala sɩ sɩma arɩ ma girep nɛnɛɛ bagɩsɩŋ kala nɛ cheye.

english_verse: and to the happy homes in Jerusalem. The land of my people is covered with thorns.
translation_verse: Yaŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ nɛ mɩɩra nyʋ tɔ mɩ nɩaa tinteeŋ kala. Má yel a tɩŋ dɩɩsɩ-la nɩaa fa sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ arɩ taŋ deeŋ jʋʋnʋŋ fa sɩ sɩma wɩaa.

english_verse: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city empty. Fortresses and towers will forever become playgrounds for wild donkeys and pastures for sheep. God's Spirit Makes the Difference
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ vɩa kuoru dɩɩsɩ-la kala ta, dɩ tabal-la sɩ suo arɩ nɩaa ma pɩŋ jikpeeŋ. Dɩɩ-duoru-la kala ba sɩ kaa pʋpɔ ba tɩtɩa jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Kakusuŋ jaŋ gbigbieli nɩmɛ, dɩ pʋsʋŋ maa dii yaŋ nɩmɛ,

english_verse: When the Spirit is given to us from heaven, deserts will become orchards thick as fertile forests.
translation_verse: a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋ ʋ Dɩma a hɛ la lɛ, tintee-hɩlɩŋ jaŋ mɩɩra sɩŋ, dɩ bagɩsɩŋ kɩaa wasɛ woruŋ a lugi a nagɛ duuŋ.

english_verse: You, the Lord's people, will live in peace, calm and secure,
translation_verse: Fɩɛlɩŋ jaŋ hɛ mɩ nɩaa dɩjʋʋlaa lɛ dɩ ba hɔŋ sɔm.

english_verse: even if hailstones flatten forests and cities.
translation_verse: Dɩ duoŋ-tabɩaa nɛ paala tele chei duu-la arɩ tabal-la kala ma,

english_verse: You will have God's blessing, as you plant your crops beside streams, while your donkeys and cattle roam freely about.
translation_verse: ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ ma kʋduuloo lɛ a tɩŋ duoŋ zɔmʋŋ sɩ jaŋ nɩɩ pɩma, dɩ ma kakusuŋ arɩ ma nɛsɩŋ ma na yaŋ dii wɩaa.

english_verse: You defeated my people. Now you're in for trouble! You've never been destroyed, but you will be destroyed; you've never been betrayed, but you will be betrayed. When you have finished destroying and betraying, you will be destroyed and betrayed in return.
translation_verse: Wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋcheere arɩ zɛmbɛ tɩŋŋaa ka nʋʋkala bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa cheima koo a ŋaama zɛmbɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ leŋ nɩaa cheyiŋ ma, cheeriŋ ha jaŋ puuma. Dɩ ma nɛ leŋ zɛmbɛ ma, nɩaa ha jaŋ ŋaama ma zɛmbɛ.

english_verse: Please, Lord, be kind to us! We depend on you. Make us strong each morning, and come to save us when we are in trouble.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, fá la nenige. La yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋ nɛ la doluŋ tapʋlɩɩ kala. Ŋ nɛ la Laataara la wʋjʋʋlaa lɛ.

english_verse: Nations scatter when you roar and show your greatness.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ sie a kpɩa tinteyee lɛ, ba yie fá pɩsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: We attack our enemies like swarms of locusts; we take everything that belongs to them.
translation_verse: Ŋ yie yuo laa tinteye-la kɩaa a nagɛ hɔbɩ-laalɩŋ sɩ dii kɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are above all others, and you live in the heavens. You have brought justice and fairness to Jerusalem;
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ nɛ jaŋ yɩrɛ, ʋ nɩɩ beŋ kʋŋkala. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tʋɔpʋla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ hɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: you are the foundation on which we stand today. You always save us and give true wisdom and knowledge. Nothing means more to us than obeying you. The Lord Will Do Something
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ma gentiŋ-duoŋ, ʋ teeŋ nɛ laatanɩŋ arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ wɩaa sɩaa jɩmɩŋ kala hɛ. Dɩ ma nɩɩ fá La TƖƖNA, ŋɩɩ ŋaa dʋa bal nɛ.

english_verse: Listen! Our bravest soldiers are running through the streets, screaming for help. Our messengers hoped for peace, but came home crying.
translation_verse: Bee na, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ ka ŋmoo niiŋ nɛ wombiee lɛ. Sɩpaalaara-la sɩɩ nɛrɩgɛ dɩ ba leŋ dɩ ba jaŋ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ ka ŋmoo niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: No one travels anymore; every road is empty. Treaties are broken, and no respect is shown to any who keep promises.
translation_verse: Womporoo kala pɩŋ hoi nɛ, nʋʋ bɩ ba lɛ ka vɛŋ. Ba chei ba bʋla-nɩɩ wombiee kala nɛ. Ba bɩra bɩ nʋʋkala ka zil.

english_verse: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.
translation_verse: Tintee-la kala hɩla nɛ a pɩŋ hoi, Lɛbanɔŋ tinteeŋ duu-la ma kala nɛ hɩla. Sarɔŋ fuonaa sɩŋ-la kala mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ nɛ, a nagɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Araba. Basaŋ tinteeŋ arɩ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kamɛl, ba tɩɩsɩŋ pɩpaarɩŋ kala nɛ yuoro.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Now I will do something and be greatly praised.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ sii lɛɛlɛ, a ŋaa wɩaa dagɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: Your deeds are straw that will be set on fire by your very own breath.
translation_verse: Ma wʋŋaalaa kala nagɛ mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ nɛ, ma wiese jaŋ nagɛ nyiniŋ a gʋra jomma dii.

english_verse: You will be burned to ashes like thorns in a fire.
translation_verse: Nyiniŋ jaŋ dii nɩaa dɩ ba bɩrɩmɛ tʋɔrʋŋ a nagɛ ba sɩ keri sɔsʋŋ a nyɩgɛ ba dii.

english_verse: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power!” Punishment and Rewards
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dɩ-bolii jaŋ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa. Ma nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kpaga jaŋ na mɩ doluŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Those terrible sinners on Mount Zion tremble as they ask in fear, “How can we possibly live where a raging fire never stops burning?”
