translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋ ŋaara-la sɩ hɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ, fawʋllʋŋ jʋʋba nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to ka chel nɛ aŋ pɩpɩɛsɛ, “La kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo hɛ nyiniŋ sɩɩ dii tʋɔŋ? La kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo hɛ nyiŋ-la sɩɩ dii a bɩ dɩsɛ tʋɔŋ aŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ?”

english_verse: But there will be rewards for those who live right and tell the truth, for those who refuse to take money by force or accept bribes, for all who hate murder and violent crimes.
translation_verse: See nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋɔsʋŋ lɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ nɩaa ka gɩrɩmɛ, a bɩ kpalaa maa laa. Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ jegile nɩɩ nɩkpʋʋraa teeŋ, aŋ yie kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa tɔ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa lɛ.

english_verse: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water. The Lord Is Our King
translation_verse: Nɩdoho deeŋ nɛ jaŋ hɔŋ sɔm a nagɛ nɩa sɩ hɛ dɩɩ-duoŋ tʋɔŋ peeliŋ nyuŋ, wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ walɩmʋ. Ʋ jaŋ na kʋdiilee bʋa na-kala lɛ, lɩɩŋ ma bɩ jaŋ nyaa ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.
translation_verse: Ma sɩɩŋ jaŋ na kuoro sɩ hɔnɔ arɩ ʋ zɔmʋŋ, a na ʋ tinteeŋ sɩ jɛrɛ tɔ leriŋ kala.

english_verse: Then you will ask yourself, “Where are those officials who terrified us and forced us to pay such heavy taxes?”
translation_verse: Ma tʋɔŋ lɛ ma jaŋ bɩɩnɛ hɛɛ-la ma fa sɩɩ na wɩaa, a pɩɛsɛ, “Nɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ-la hɛ? Nɩɩ-la fa sɩɩ laa la lampoo? Nɩɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la fa sɩɩ beŋ dɩɩ-leŋie-la nyuŋ ba sɩ hɔnɔ a dɩdaasɛ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ?”

english_verse: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.
translation_verse: Ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ na sɩɩ-duo tɩmma-la, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl wʋtɔɔnʋŋ, nɩalɩŋ yikoro ma sɩ nɩɩ.

english_verse: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.
translation_verse: Má bee na Zaayɔŋ tabal-la lɛ la fa sɩɩ gbieli la gbielee, ma na Jerusalɛm, ʋ chaasa kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa lɛbɩŋ nɛ, ba bɩ jaŋ wuo kaa churi. Ʋ daasɩŋ kʋŋ bɩ jaŋ churi, ʋ ŋmɛsɩ-la ma kʋŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ kɛrɛ.

english_verse: Our wonderful Lord will be with us! There will be deep rivers and wide streams safe from enemy ships. The Lord Is Our Judge
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nɛ jaŋ ŋaa la doluŋ nɩmɛ, ʋ jaŋ nagɛ fuo-balaa. La dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɩɩŋ daboro kala bɩ jaŋ duori ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is our judge and our ruler; the Lord is our king and will keep us safe.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa la sarɩya diire, ʋ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩ dagɛla wombiee la tuto. La TƖƖNA nɛ la kuoro, ʋ jaŋ laala ta.

english_verse: But your nation is a ship with its rigging loose, its mast shaky, and its sail not spread. Someday even you that are lame will take everything you want from your enemies.
translation_verse: La dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɩɩŋ duoruŋ wɩaa bɩra bɩ sɩɩ kɛnɛ. Ba lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ kala yɔrʋmɔ nɛ. La jaŋ laa ba dʋa a kaa kpaa dɔŋɔ. Gbɛrɩgɛɛ ma jaŋ paala laa kɩaa ba teeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will forgive your sins, and none of you will say, “I feel sick.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ kʋŋ bɩ jaŋ bʋl, “Mɩɩ wɩɩlɛ nɛ.” La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation, the entire earth, and all its creatures, come here and listen!
translation_verse: Má kɔ, ma tinteyee nɩaa kala a jegili, nʋʋkala jegile nɩɩ. Má leŋ dɩ kʋŋ na-kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord is terribly angry with the nations; he has condemned them to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ nɛ tinteyee nɩaa kala nyuŋ, ʋ baanɩŋ sii ba laalɩyuoroo kala nyuŋ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ chei ba kala gbelem gbelem.

english_verse: Their dead bodies will be left to rot and stink; their blood will flow down the mountains.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ jaŋ hugi ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ, ba jaŋ pɩŋ a pʋa a sʋsʋɔrɛ. Peelee kala jaŋ fɩɛsɛ arɩ ba chalɩŋ.

english_verse: Each star will disappear— the sky will roll up like a scroll. Everything in the sky will dry up and wilt like leaves on a vine or fruit on a tree. Trouble for Edom
translation_verse: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ chɛnɛ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa kala jaŋ nyɩɩgɛ wɩa-nyuŋ. Wɩa-nyuŋ kala jaŋ kʋʋra kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ teniŋ a chuoli. Chɛnwʋlaa ma jaŋ tuu titel a nagɛ bɩmbaaga pɩpaarɩŋ sɩ hɩla a yuyuori koo tutogo nɛnɛɛ sɩ yuoro.

english_verse: After the sword of the Lord has done what it wants to the skies above, it will come down on Edom, the nation that the Lord has doomed for destruction.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ kʋ dii Ɛdɔm nɩaa sarɩya, nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ chei.

english_verse: The sword of the Lord is covered with blood from lambs and goats, together with fat from kidneys of rams. This is because the Lord will slaughter many people and make a sacrifice of them in the city of Bozrah and everywhere else in Edom.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tokobiiŋ kala tɔ chalɩŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ nɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ kpʋ pie-pɔrɔɔ arɩ bʋʋnaa a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. La TƖƖNA kpʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ nɛ woruŋ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bozira, Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ sʋʋ a nagɛ nɛ-ferisiŋ arɩ nɛ-bel-pɔrɔɔ. Ba tinteeŋ kala jaŋ fɩɛsɛ arɩ chalɩŋ, dɩ hagɩla tɔ arɩ nʋʋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA kɛŋ tapʋlɩɩ nɛ arɩ jɩna ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋ ʋ baanɩŋ a fɩɩsɛ Zaayɔŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ a laaba ta.

english_verse: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ fuonuŋ lɩɩŋ kala jaŋ biri a nagɛ funfule a kɛŋ keliŋ, dɩ ʋ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ kala bɩrɩmɛ jiribiiŋ a didii nyiniŋ, dɩ tintee-la kala dii a biri a nagɛ funfule a kɛŋ keliŋ.

english_verse: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ didii tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala dɩ nyʋɔsʋŋ sisii wuu. Tintee-la jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ to nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks. The End of Edom
translation_verse: Hajaaŋkuŋkumba arɩ gɩlɩŋgaamba dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ hɛ tintee-la lɛ. Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ tintee-la kala bɩra pɩŋ hoi arɩ ʋ fa sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ ka Wɩa-na ŋaaʋ.

english_verse: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
translation_verse: Kuoru kala bɩra bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kɛŋ lee-la a yɩyɩrɛ ʋ lee. Ʋ kuoru biiri-la ma kala jaŋ nyɩɩgɛ.

english_verse: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.
translation_verse: Sɔsʋŋ arɩ chɛyɛɛ jaŋ nyʋ tɔ ba kuori-dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ba jebie-la sɩ leŋie, dɩ jolluŋ arɩ hajaaŋkuŋkumba jʋjʋʋ.

english_verse: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Ŋmanjamba arɩ kantʋnnʋŋ jaŋ gʋgɔllɛ lee-la, baga kɩaa jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ dɔŋɔ nɩmɛ. Tɩta-diiree jaŋ hɛ lee-la a chɛ ba dɩ-pɩna wiesiŋ.

english_verse: Owls will nest there to raise their young among its shadows, while families of vultures circle around.
translation_verse: Hajaaŋkuŋkumba jaŋ saa ba dɛllɩŋ nɩmɛ a lo halaa a tiesi biiriŋ a dɩɛsɛba. Duuŋ-belliŋ arɩ duu-haalaa ma jaŋ hihilimi nɩmɛ.

english_verse: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
translation_verse: Nyilimi La TƖƖNA teniŋ tʋɔŋ a karɩma na wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ kʋŋ na-kala sɩɩ wiesu lɛ. Kɩaa deemba kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ lɛlɛ. Ba kʋŋkala bele arɩ haal nɛ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ bʋla, ʋ Dɩma jaŋ kɛmba kaa kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has decided where they each should live; they will be there forever, generation after generation.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ tintee-la a kpaa pɩba, dɩ ba kʋŋkala kɛŋ ʋ kpaalɩŋ. Ba nɛ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a tɩɩʋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Thirsty deserts will be glad; barren lands will celebrate and blossom with flowers.
translation_verse: Tintee-hɩlɩŋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ, tintee-la sɩ bɩ lɩɩŋ kɛnɛ jaŋ jʋjʋɔsɛ tɩɩfɩɩlaa jaŋ tɔsɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
translation_verse: Tɩɩfɩɩla-la jaŋ pɔsɛ dɩ ʋ ŋɩŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Ba jaŋ joŋ Lɛbanɔŋ tʋla-la a pʋ. Ʋ zɔmʋŋ jaŋ nagɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kamɛl a bɩra nagɛ Sarɔŋ fuonaaŋ. Ba jaŋ na La TƖƖNA Wɩa tʋla arɩ ʋ zɔmʋŋ kala.

english_verse: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:
translation_verse: Bʋl wɩaa a duori nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ nandaasɩŋ, a leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ naadʋsʋŋ sɩ daaga polli.

english_verse: “Cheer up! Don't be afraid. Your God is coming to punish your enemies. God will take revenge on them and rescue you.”
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ bɔɩ-duoŋ kɛnɛ: Má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma. Ma Wɩa jaŋ joŋ ʋ baanɩŋ a fɩɩsɛ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ kʋ laama ta.

english_verse: The blind will see, and the ears of the deaf will be healed.
translation_verse: Nyʋlɩmaa sɩaa jaŋ suri dɩ taŋŋaa ma dɩgɩlaa suri.

english_verse: Those who were lame will leap around like deer; tongues once silent will shout for joy. Water will rush through the desert.
translation_verse: Gbɛrɩgɛɛ jaŋ sii fɩla jʋjʋɔsɛ a nagɛ aamɩŋ, ka nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ wɩaa wuo bʋl jaŋ ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Lɩɩŋ jaŋ bul a lɩɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, dɩ fuonuŋ paala pɩŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home. God's Sacred Highway
translation_verse: Tintee-la fa sɩɩ dii nyiniŋ jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ fuoŋ, dɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ kala su arɩ lɩɩ-bul-sɩaa. Lee-la jolluŋ fa sɩɩ pɩŋ, kaŋgɩl-yaŋ jaŋ tɔ ʋ kala.

english_verse: A good road will be there, and it will be named “God's Sacred Highway.” It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.
translation_verse: Womporuŋ jaŋ pɩŋ nɩmɛ, dɩ ba kɛnʋ yɩyɩrɛ wombii-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Disiŋ tɩɩna kala bɩ jaŋ vɛŋ ʋ lɛ, see nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ dʋndʋŋa. Nɩyaara-la sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ ʋ lɛ jaŋ vɛŋ.

english_verse: No lions or other wild animals will come near that road; only those the Lord has saved will travel there.
translation_verse: Naachigiŋ bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, gɩrɩŋ kʋbɔŋ kala bɩ jaŋ hɛ wombii-la lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ laa ta dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ vɩvɛŋ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ laa ta jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ, ba jaŋ yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a jʋʋ Jerusalɛm. Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ba kʋa, tʋɔ-cheeŋ jaŋ fá lɛl ba teeŋ.

english_verse: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Hezikaaya kɛmma yeŋŋi, dɩ ʋ nɛ sɩ, ‘La TƖƖNA jaŋ laama ta.’ Ma ha na tintee dɔŋ vene wuo laa ʋ tinteeŋ Asiiria kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛɛ?

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la kɛŋ Hiburu yikoro a faasa bʋl, “Má jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Asiiria kuoru-balɩŋ sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Nɩɩ nɛ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hamaf arɩ Apadɩ vesiŋ hɛ? Nɩɩ nɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sefavem vene hɛ? Ba wuo laa Samarɩa ta nɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛɛ?

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ ŋ-la, ‘Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Hezikaaya nyɩsɛma, ʋ bɩ ma wuo laa ta.

english_verse: Three of the king's highest officials came out of Jerusalem to meet him. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ nɛ Juda tɩŋŋaa baalaa batori kʋ lɩɩ chemba. Dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Ɛlɩakɩm, ʋ nɛ ŋaa kuoru dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ. Ʋ nyɩmma nɛ Hɩlɩkaaya. Dɔŋɔ ma nɛ Sɛbɩna, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba teniŋ. Dɔŋɔ ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ Jʋab, ʋ nɩɩ bil ba tenniŋ. Ʋ nyɩmma nɛ Asaf.

english_verse: The Assyrian commander told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ-la bʋla pɩba, “Má pɩɛsɛ kuoro Hezikaaya dɩ wɩɩ-la Asiiria kuoru-balɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ jɩŋ nɛ, ‘Kʋbɛɛ lɛ nɛ ma yɩɛlaa paala hɛ?’

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Ma sɩ ma kɛŋ laalɩŋ-yuonuŋ jɩma arɩ doluŋ nɛ, ama ma wʋbʋlɩɩ-la kala ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ lɛ nɛ ma joŋ ma yɩɛlaa a daŋ aŋ vɩamɛ?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro lɛ nɛ ma joŋ ma yɩɛlaa daŋ. Ʋ saa nagɛ mɔrʋŋ nɩa sɩ joŋo a kaa ŋaa dantɩga a vɩvɛŋ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ bori a tʋrɛ ma nɩsaa lɛ a pɩrɛma. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ nagɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa daŋ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord, your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ saa bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa lɛ nɛ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ, ʋ leree arɩ ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ korunuŋ dee Hezikaaya ŋmoo giri aŋ bʋla pɩ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa, arɩ ʋ maga dɩ ba zil ba TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ deeŋ sɩ daŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛɛ?

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Ma sɩ paala joŋ ma wɩɩkala a hɛ Ijipiti janɩŋ torukoba arɩ ba ja-jɩllaa lɛ ŋɩɩ, ma bɩɩna ma jaŋ wuo yuo dii mɩ nɩhɩaŋ tɩntɩnnaa tʋɔŋ kʋbie naa?

english_verse: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna mɩ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ mɩɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ yuo tinteeŋ deeŋ a cheyu ŋɩɩ? La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ pɩmɛ wombiiŋ dɩ mɩ kʋ yuo ma tinteeŋ a cheyu.”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛlɩakɩm arɩ Sɛbɩna arɩ Jʋa ma bʋla pɩ Asiiria kuoro laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la, “Laa sʋlʋŋ, kɛŋ Aramek tɩŋŋaa yikoro bʋl wɩalɩŋ a pɩla, laa nɩɩʋ nɛ, aŋ leŋ Hiburu tɩŋŋaa yikoro. La bɩ chɛ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sagɛ kɛrɛ nyuŋ nɩɩ.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asiiria kuoro laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la ma bʋl, “Ma bɩɩna ma nɩhɩaŋ arɩ ma dʋndʋŋa teeŋ nɛ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ bʋl wɩaa deemba? Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ sagɛ kɛrɛ-la nyuŋ pɛ nɛ. Ma kala jaŋ gʋra dii ma tɩtɩa bɩnɩŋ aŋ nyʋa ma tɩtɩa fɩɩrɩŋ ma.”

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Hezikaaya nyɩsɛma dɩ ma joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ ma TƖƖNA lɛ, arɩ ʋ sɩ sɩ ma TƖƖNA bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ a joŋ ma tabal-la a pɩ Asiiria kuoro.

english_verse: Stop listening to Hezekiah. Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ Hezikaaya teeŋ jegilu.’ Asiiria kuoro sɩ, ‘Má kɔ mɩ teeŋ dɩ la ŋaa sɩma, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma kʋŋkala jaŋ wuo dii ma tɩtɩa girep nɛnɛɛ aŋ nyʋa ma vilee ma lɩɩŋ,

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ kɛmma mʋ lee-la sɩ nagɛ ma tɩtɩa tinteeŋ, a kɛŋ mɩaa ma sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa kʋdiilee arɩ girep nɛnɛɛ ma sɩ jaŋ kaa chɔ sɩnɩŋ.’

english_verse: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord, your God, can do any better?
translation_verse: Vesiŋ deemba kala tʋɔŋ, ba kʋbɛɛ nɛ wuo laa ʋ tinteeŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ saa ma TƖƖNA jaŋ wuo ŋaa a laa Jerusalɛm ta mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ?”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hɩlɩkaaya nanʋala Ɛlɩakɩm sɩ ŋaa kuoru dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ arɩ Sɛbɩna ma sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba tenniŋ arɩ Jʋa ma sɩɩ bil ba tenniŋ, kɛŋ ba gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ a dɩdagɛ tʋɔ-cheeŋ, aŋ mɩɩra mʋ Hezikaaya teeŋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala Asiiria kuoro laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la sɩ bʋla a pʋ.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kuoro Hezikaaya sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ aa dagɛ tʋɔ-cheeŋ, aŋ paa tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ laalɛ a mʋ jʋʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (
translation_verse: Nɩɩ nɛ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hamaf, Apad, Sɛfavem, koo Hɛna koo Iva kuoroo hɛ?”

english_verse: Isaiah, these are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: Ba mʋ bʋla pʋ, “Wɩɩ-la Hezikaaya sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Jɩnɩŋ la tʋɔŋ kala nɛ cheye, hɛɛŋ jʋʋla nɛ, hɩɩsɩŋ ma diila. La nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl aŋ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ lʋl nɛ.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ pɔ ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Asiiria kuoro sɩ tɩŋ ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ ʋ kɔ a tʋʋsɛ Wɩa sɩ weye joŋŋoo. Ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa sɛnɛ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ nɛ, ʋ jaŋ lɛrɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ bʋlba dɩgɩlɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, sʋl Wɩa pɩ la nɩkaana-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ.’ ”

english_verse: When these leaders came to me,
translation_verse: Azaaya sɩ nɩɩ kuoro Hezikaaya tɩndaarɩŋ,

english_verse: I told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: ʋ ma bɩra tɩmba, “Má mʋ bʋla pɩ ma nɩhɩaŋ dɩ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ Asiiria kuoro tɩndaara-la sɩ bʋla a tʋʋsɛ mɩ-na Wɩa joŋŋoo lɛ.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna jaŋ joŋ dɩma kʋbala a hɛ ʋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ nɩɩ ba sɩ a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ tɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ, a sii mʋ nɩmɛ dɩ ba kpʋ.’ ”

english_verse: Meanwhile the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Asiiria kuoro laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la sɩ nɩa dɩ Asiiria kuoro lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lakɩs lɛ nɛ a mʋ yuyuo Lɩbɩna tabalɩŋ, ʋ mɩɩra mʋ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ Asiiria kuoro Sanakɛrɩb nɩɩ dɩ Tɩɩhaka, Kus tɩɩna-la sɩ ŋaa Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa kuoro kɛŋ laalɩyuoroo kʋkɔ dɩ ba yuou nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ, a tɩŋ ba kaa mʋ pɩ Hezikaaya.

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Ŋ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Asiiria kuoro sɩ ŋaa tinteyee kala lɛ nɛ a chei ba kala. Ŋ bɩɩna ŋ-na jaŋ wuo laa ŋ tɩtɩa?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: Mɩ naabalɩma fa yuo dii tabalaa deemba nɛ: Gozaŋ, Haraŋ, Rɛzɛf arɩ Ɛdɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛl Asaa a chei ba kala. Ba fa kɛŋ vesiŋ nɛ, ka ba kʋŋ bɩ wuo laaba ta.

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Hezikaaya sɩ laa teniŋ tɩndaara-la teeŋ a karɩmɛ, ʋ sii kaa jɩl La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kaa jɛrɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ,

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: “La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, ŋ sɩ hɔŋ ŋ kuoru kpasa-la sɩ hɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa pɛgɛ, ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa, a bibeŋ tinteye-la kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Just look and see how Sennacherib has insulted you, the living God.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, jegile nɩɩ aŋ bɩra bee na Sanakɛrɩb sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala a tʋʋsɛ ŋ-na Wɩa sɩ weye joŋŋoo.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA, Asiiria kuoroo chei nɩ-daŋ nɛ, ka ba tinteyee pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wombii-la ʋ sɩ to kɔ, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ jaŋ bɩra to a mɩɩrɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ taŋ deeŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, you prayed to me about King Sennacherib of Assyria. Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Zaayɔŋ nɩaa ka mɔŋ Sɛnakɛrɩb nɛ a sisieri ʋ lɛ. Jerusalɛm nɩaa kɛŋ nyuŋ kpukpegisi nɛ, ka ʋ fɩfá dɩ ʋ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe ŋ tɩndaaraa tʋʋsɛ La TƖƖNA joŋŋoo nɛ woruŋ. Ŋ sɩ: Mɩ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba sɩ yʋga ŋɩɩ, ba nɛ mɩ kaa jɩl Lɛbanɔŋ peelee nyu-gbaŋa, a jʋʋ ʋ duuŋ tʋɔŋ a keri ʋ kuolu tɩɩ-duduosuŋ arɩ bʋtʋŋ zɔŋŋɔɔ kala lo.’

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ ŋ lu vilee nɛ tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ a nyʋnyʋa lɩɩŋ nɩmɛ. Ŋ sɩ ŋ naachɛɛŋ nɛ ŋ kaa nʋɔsɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ fuonuŋ kala tɔ ba hɩl.

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: Sanakɛrɩb, ŋ bɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ-na La TƖƖNA sɩ bɩɩna bil faafaa kala dɩ mɩ ŋaa nɩa? Lɛɛlɛ mɩ ŋaaba nɛ. Mɩ nɛ pɩŋ doluŋ ŋ kaa kɛŋ tasɩ-la kala ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli bɩrɩmɛ ba nagɛ tabɩaa sɩ daŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ lee-la bɩra bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ, ba bugumo nɛ, ka hɩɩsɩŋ diiba. Ba fa nagɛ yaŋ sɩ miire ŋmaŋkaaŋ lɛ nɛ, koo yaŋ sɩ nyʋ lusuŋ nyuŋ a bɩ waa, ka hɩlɩŋ leŋ ba hɩl.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ ŋ wɩɩkala nɛ, wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa arɩ lee-la ŋ sɩɩ mʋ arɩ baaŋ-la ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ arɩ mɩ.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ faasa kɛŋ baaŋ-la arɩ mɩ arɩ babiibal wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla mɩ nɩɩ, lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ joŋ hɛmɩŋ tɔɔ gɩrɩgɛ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, a joŋ mɩ koŋ ma a hɛ ŋ niiŋ. Mɩ jaŋ lɛrɩŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩra joŋ wombii-la ŋ sɩ to kɔ a mʋ.

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa magɩl a pɩ ŋ-na Hezikaaya nɛ: Jɩna deeŋ ŋ jaŋ dii mɩɩ-tɩarɩŋ, harɩŋ jɩna ma ŋ ha jaŋ dii mɩɩ-tɩarɩŋ. Ama jɩ-tori lɛ, duu kɩaa a kʋŋ, a chɔnsɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ ma a tɔrɛ ba nɛnɛɛ dii.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Juda doho nɩaa nɩkaana-la wɩaa jaŋ chɩŋ woruŋ, a nagɛ tɩa naapoloo sɩ jʋʋ tinteeŋ woruŋ a nɛŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Nɩaa ha jaŋ ka Jerusalɛm arɩ Zaayɔŋ peel-la lɛ a pɛ. La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna chaasa kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ŋ-la nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl a mʋ tɩgɛ Asiiria kuoro lɛ: ‘Ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kʋ jʋʋ taŋ deeŋ koo a yuo hɛmɩŋ ʋ lɛ. Ʋ laalɩyuoroo bɩ jaŋ wuo golli taŋ deeŋ chu a yuou, ba bɩ jaŋ wuo saa lusuŋ-choluŋ a to nɩmɛ jʋʋ.

english_verse: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Asiiria kuoro Sanakɛrɩb leŋ laal-la ʋ fa sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ yuo aŋ mɩɩra mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nɩnɩvɛ a hɔŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Sanakɛrɩb sii a jʋʋ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nɩsɩrɔk dɩa a kpʋkpaarʋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩa, Adɩramɛlɛk arɩ Sarɛza jʋʋ kpʋʋ arɩ ba tokobiiŋ, aŋ lɩɩ fá mʋ Ararat tinteeŋ. Ka ʋ nanʋala dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asahadɔŋ dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa bɩrɩma chaasɛ jeeŋ aŋ sʋl La TƖƖNA,

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ laamɛ ta. La jaŋ du chenniŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɩŋ la mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.”

english_verse: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Hezikaaya faa wɩɩlʋ, a ka mʋa dɩ ʋ sʋba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Azaaya sɩ ŋaa Amos nanʋala sii mʋ ʋ teeŋ a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ: ‘Kɛŋ ŋ tinteeŋ wɩaa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ duori.’ ”

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa bɩ bɩɩna mɩ jaŋ bɩra na La TƖƖNA dʋnɩa lɛ a bɩra bɩ jaŋ na nɩweyee ma, koo a guoli dʋnɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
translation_verse: “Mɩ Tɩɩna, liisi ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a toŋ arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ.” Ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ aŋ chaasa yel woruŋ.

english_verse: Then the Lord sent me
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Azaaya,

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: “Mʋ bʋla pɩ Hezikaaya arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa ʋ naabalɩma Devit Wɩa sɩ, ‘Mɩ nɩɩ ŋ sʋla nɛ a na ŋ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ ma. Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ banɔŋ a pɛ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Ama wʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl? Ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ arɩ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ mɩ sɩaa mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, a tɩŋ hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩ na wɩaa.

english_verse: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ laa ŋ dɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala ta Asiiria kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ pɔ taŋ deeŋ woruŋ.’ ”

english_verse: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Azaaya ma laa bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ joŋo dagɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ daaliimiŋ mɩɩra mʋ harɩŋ naakieliŋ fii, lee-la kuoro Ahas lusuŋ-choluŋ sɩ chɩna.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ daaliiŋ-la sɛnɛ mɩɩra mʋ harɩŋ naakieliŋ fii.

english_verse: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
translation_verse: Juda kuoro Hezikaaya fa sɩ wɩɩla aŋ duori harɩŋ nɛ ʋ ŋmʋnsɛ yɩɩlɩŋ deeŋ:

english_verse: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ fa bɩɩna mɩ jaŋ sʋʋ mɩ bapʋɔsʋŋ bʋa lɛ, a mʋ hɛ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ mɩ mɩɩ-kaanɩŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: Mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ fa naga ʋ dɛrɛ nɛ a nagɛ kʋ-daara sɩ kɛŋ ʋ lɛbɩŋ churo ta, a bɩra nagɛ gɛrɩpɛ-yuoro sɩ chuoli gɛrɩpɛɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ-yuori sɔŋɔ lɛ. Wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ mɩ fa bɩɩna Wɩa leŋe mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ dɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala nɛ, a nagɛ naachigiŋ nɩɩ bori mɩ haŋgbelee. Mɩ fa bɩɩna Wɩa leŋe mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ dɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa faasa yel nɛ, mɩ yikoro kala tɔ, mɩ mɩɩraa yel a nagɛ kokomo. Mɩ fa beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ, mɩ sɩaa kala yʋɔrɛ, hɛɛŋ jʋʋ mɩ nɛ. La TƖƖNA, jegile nɩɩ mɩ bunso.

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa arɩ ŋ wʋŋaalaa nɩɩ pɩ nʋʋkala mɩɩsɩŋ, mɩ dɩma ma na mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ ba lɛ. Ŋ pɩmɛ yarɩfɩɛlaa nɛ a leŋ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, hɛɛ-la mɩ fa sɩ na kɛŋ nyʋʋrʋŋ nɛ a pɩmɛ. Ŋ chonuŋ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ lɩɩsɛmɛ lɩɩ-lɩma lɛ aŋ joŋ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala chɛmɛ.

english_verse: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɛnnɩŋ, ba bɩ jaŋ wuo joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ŋ lɛ arɩ ŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Nɩweyee nɛ jaŋ wuo dɛnnɩŋ. Ba nɛ jaŋ wuo dɛnnɩŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩɩ dɛnnɩŋ jɩnɩŋ. Nyɩmmaba bʋla pɩ ba biiriŋ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Azaaya fa bʋla pɩ Hezikaaya, “Leŋ dɩ ba tugi tutogo nɛnɛɛ a paa taa mɔpʋla-la, ʋ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ.”

english_verse: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya ma pɩɛsɛ, “Magɩl bɛɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋo dagɛ arɩ mɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la?”

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Hezikaaya cheme laa tɩndaara-la arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, a kɛmba gɔllɔ dagɛ ʋ dʋa-la kala sɩ hɛ ʋ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ: Hɔpʋla, sɛlɩmɛ, tegisiŋ, nʋʋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ʋ bayuori kɩaa a pɛ kʋŋkala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ lɛ. Kʋŋkala fa tuo ʋ kuoru dɩa arɩ lee-la kala ʋ sɩɩ beŋ lɛ ʋ bɩ kaa dagɛba.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Merodak-Baladaŋ nɛ fa ŋaa Babɩlɔŋ kuoro. Ʋ fa ŋaa Baladaŋ nanʋala nɛ. Ʋ sɩ nɩa dɩ Hezikaaya wɩɩla nɛ aŋ duori, ʋ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a joŋ kɩaa pɛ, a tɩŋ nɩaa dɩ ba kaa mʋ dii zile ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Azaaya, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la kɔ kuoro Hezikaaya teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Nɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ lɩɩ? Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ba kʋ bʋl?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya sɩ, “Ba lɩɩ dɩ-bolii nɛ, Babɩlɔŋ nɛ ba lɩɩ.”

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Azaaya bʋla pɩ Hezikaaya, “Jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla:

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: ‘Bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi, kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ŋ kuoru dɩa lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ŋ naabalɩmaba sɩ dʋa a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ, ba jaŋ chʋŋ ba kala a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ. Kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ ka. La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛsɛ ŋ doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ arɩ ŋ tɩtɩa bii-lʋlaa a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ a feriba dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro dɩa lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya bʋla pɩ Azaaya, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ.” Ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ-na fa bɩɩna La TƖƖNA sɩ, ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ fɩɛlɩŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, wʋwalɩmɩɩ kala bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ-ʋ.

english_verse: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
translation_verse: La Wɩa sɩ, “Nyagɛ mɩ nɩaa bɔyɛ woruŋ dɩ ba tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala.”

english_verse: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
translation_verse: Má fɩɛla bʋl wɩaa pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa dɩ ba tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala, arɩ hɛɛ-la ba fa sɩɩ na dɛrɛ nɛ. La TƖƖNA leŋe ba tiŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɩmɩŋ kala nɛ, ʋ dɔgɩsɛba naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa nɛ a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa.

english_verse: Someone is shouting: “Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ nɛ heelee bʋl, “Má wasɛ wombiiŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ a bil La TƖƖNA lɛ, má pori wombii-la dɩ ʋ tʋʋlɛ woruŋ a pɩ la Wɩa.

english_verse: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ dagɛ ʋ tʋla dɩ nuhuobiinee kala naʋ. La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, “What should I shout?” We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ yikoro dɩ ʋ bʋla, “Ŋmoo niiŋ.” Mɩ pɩɛsɛ, “Mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wʋbɛɛ lɛ? Nuhuobiinee kala nagɛ yaŋ nɛ, ba tʋla ma kala nagɛ ya-fɩɩlaa nɛ ba bɩ dieni.

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Yaŋ yie hɩl nɛ, ba fɩɩlaa ma yuori, ama Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa-na jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, má kɔ Jerusalɛm, má jɩl peeliŋ sɩ leŋie nyuŋ a heele bʋl wɩalɩŋ. Má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, má bʋla pɩ Juda tasɩŋ nɩaa: “Ma Wɩa hɛ daha.”

english_verse: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɩɩ kɔ arɩ ʋ doluŋ, dɩ ʋ beŋ ʋ nɩaa. Ʋ pɛ kori ʋ time kaa kɔ nɛ: Nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa ta. Ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa ta nɩɩ kɔ.

english_verse: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ beŋ ʋ nɩaa nyuŋ arɩ pie-daara sɩɩ beŋ ʋ piesee nyuŋ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ jaŋ paa ʋ pie-biisiŋ a nɔgɛ aŋ fɩɛla dɩdaa pie-naamba-la sɩ kɛŋ biiriŋ.

english_verse: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ha wuo joŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ kala hɛ ʋ nachala lɛ a magɩsɛ, koo a kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ a magɩsɛ wɩa-nyuŋ duomuŋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ha wuo joŋ tinteeŋ hagɩla kala hɛ sime lɛ a magɩsɛ, koo a joŋ peelee arɩ dundolluŋ kala a hɛ sanɩa lɛ a magɩsɛ?

english_verse: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ La TƖƖNA tʋɔbɩɩnaa koo a bʋl wɩaa a chagɩlʋ?

english_verse: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA ha pɩɛsɛ dɩ ʋ dagʋ wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ha dagʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ koo wɩaa bʋɔsʋŋ jɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA teeŋ, tinteyee kala nagɛ lɩɩ-suosoo sɩ hɛ bogiti lɛ nɛ koo a nagɛ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ sɩ hɛ sanɩa lɛ. Tinteye-la kala lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu yuŋuŋ nagɛ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ nɛ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.
translation_verse: Lɛbanɔŋ tinteeŋ daasɩŋ kala bɩ yʋga magɛ dɩ ba kaa hɛ nyiniŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ nyuŋ. Ʋ pʋsʋŋ ma bɩ yʋga magɛ dɩ ba kaa kpʋ a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: God thinks of the nations as far less than nothing.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA teeŋ, tinteyee kala bɩ kɩa ŋaa. Ʋ jomba ba ŋaa kʋpɛɩba nɛ, ba bɩ kɩa ŋaa.

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩ tɔmʋŋ libiree sɩ yie libi naga, kʋ-la ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taara tɔ aŋ kɛŋ hɔpʋla libi chɔrʋmɔɔ hɛ.

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa summu a bɩ sɛlɩmɛ lɛ wuo yi, ʋ yie chɛ daa-la sɩ bɩ pʋa nɛ, a chɛ saarɩ-gɔgɔ ʋ saa tɔmʋŋ ʋ joŋo bil kʋa nyuŋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ tel.

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jɩŋ? Ma bɩ nɩaa? Dɩ-suomuŋ kala ba bɩ bʋla pɩmaa? Ma bɩ ŋɩɩ dʋnɩa sɩ suomo jɩŋ?

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ nɛ a bibeŋ tinteeŋ. Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala nagɛ nyaŋgɩrɩgɛba nɛ ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ kɛŋ wɩa-nyuŋ a jɛrɛ nɛ ʋ nagɛ patɩɩsaŋ, koo ʋ kaa jɛrɛ ʋ nagɛ palɩŋ.

english_verse: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ sɩpaalaaraa muuri nɛ a leŋ kuoru-duoruŋ yuŋuŋ tuu tinteeŋ.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: Ba nagɛ kɩaa sɩ bumo nyʋ nɛ, ba naapoloo ha bɩ tinteeŋ jʋa woruŋ, ʋ leŋ peliŋ du hɛ ba lɛ ba sʋʋ, pel-vinvilimiŋ paaba viiri a nagɛ mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɩ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛmmɛ magɩsɛ? Koo kʋbɛɛ nɛ magɛmɛ?”

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
translation_verse: Má beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ a na, kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa kɩaa deemba sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ? Ʋ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa chɛnwʋlaa kʋbala kʋbala a yɩyɩrɛ ba yɩraa kʋŋ kʋŋ. Ʋ doluŋ sɩ yʋga kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ tɩɩ ba hɛ nɩmɛ, ba kʋbala ma bɩ lɛlɛ.

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma gʋrɩmɛ wɩaa a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA bɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa la lɛ jɩŋ. Wɩa sɩpaa tuo hɛɛ-la la sɩɩ na lɛ.”

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jɩŋ? Ma bɩ nɩaa? La TƖƖNA nɛ Wɩa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa dʋnɩa kala. Ʋ bɩ lɔl, nʋʋkala ma bɩ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa wuo jɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord gives strength to those who are weary.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛsɩmɛ doluŋ nɛ, a leŋ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ pʋgʋma doluŋ pʋŋa pɩpɛ.

english_verse: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Nɩwaa-falaa yie lɔl nɛ a kala bɛsɩmɛ, bapʋɔsaa gɛrɛ titel,

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa La TƖƖNA lɛ, jaŋ wasa kɛŋ doluŋ. Ba jaŋ nagɛ kachuuŋ sɩɩ fil. Ba jaŋ fá aŋ bɩ jaŋ lɔl, a vɛŋ woruŋ aŋ bɩ jaŋ yiegi.

english_verse: Be silent and listen, every island in the sea. Have courage and come near, every one of you nations. Let's settle this matter!
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ, “Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu lɛ, má kɛŋ goŋ aŋ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Tinteyee nɩaa, má wasa chɛ doluŋ. Má kʋ lɩɩ bʋl ma wɩɩŋ. Má leŋ la cheŋ dɔŋɔ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ.

english_verse: Who appointed this ruler from the east? Who puts nations and kings in his power? His sword and his arrows turn them to dust blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ lɩɩsɛ kuoru-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a leŋ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ a yuo didii tinteyee arɩ ba kuoroo ŋɩɩ? Ʋ tokobiiŋ yie leŋ ba bɩrɩmɛ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ, ka ʋ toŋ ma ŋmooba pɩsɛ a nagɛ peliŋ sɩ paa mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie kire to ba harɩŋ nɛ parɩ parɩ, a yuo diiba, ka kʋŋ ma bɩ ʋ kɩɩsa.

english_verse: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ leŋe wɩaa deemba kala ŋaa? Dɩ-suomuŋ kala, kʋbɛɛ nɩɩ beŋ nuhuobiinee doho wʋkɛnɛɛ nyuŋ? Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ dɩ-suomuŋ kala, mɩ saa jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ.”

english_verse: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu lɛ na wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋaa nɛ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba, dʋnɩa nɩaa kala chichel. Ba kala sii hɛ dɔŋɔ a kɔ.

english_verse: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba nyagɛ dɔŋɔ ba bɔyɛ a bʋl, “Má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ.”

english_verse: Woodcarvers, goldsmiths, and other workers encourage one another and say, “We've done a great job!” Then they nail the idol down, so it won't fall over. The Lord's Chosen Servant
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ daasɩŋ kaa saa kɩaa nyagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ a ŋaa kɩaa bɔyɛ. Nɩɩ-la ma sɩ yie libi tɔŋŋɔɔ nyagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ yie paa mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ bɔyɛ. Ba yie bʋl, “Ba mɛrɛ woruŋ nɛ.” Ʋ yie kpaasɛ tɔŋ-la bil nɛ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ tel.

english_verse: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
translation_verse: Ama ma-na Iziral tɩŋŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa, ma nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ, mɩ nandɔŋɔ Abɩraham doho nɩaa.

english_verse: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛmma lɩɩ dʋnɩa loŋgoruŋ dɩ-bolii nɛ a bʋla pɩma, “Ma ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ.” Mɩ nɛ lɩɩsɛma, mɩ bɩ ma vɩa ta.

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, mɩ hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tʋɔŋ vʋgʋmɛ, mɩ nɛ ma Wɩa. Mɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a pɩma doluŋ, mɩ jaŋ pɔma a laama ta.

english_verse: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ chaasa na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ diiba. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ yuoma jaŋ nagɛ kʋpɛɩba a sʋʋ.

english_verse: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ beŋ a chɛ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ka. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yuoma jaŋ nagɛ kʋpɛɩba,

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. Mɩ kɛŋ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ bʋl, “Má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, mɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ.”

english_verse: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ma Laataara sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɩ, “Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma muuro nɛ a bɩ doluŋ ma kɛnɛ, ama má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, mɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma nagɛ kʋ-la ba sɩ kaa ŋmoo kɩaa, ʋ nyɩlaa ŋaa kʋfalɩa a yʋgɛ a kɛŋ niiŋ. Ma jaŋ yɛrɛ peelee arɩ dundolluŋ a nɔmba dɩ ba pugisi a nagɛ mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ ŋmooba villi, dɩ pel-duoŋ paaba viiri. Ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ a chʋɔlɛmɛ.

english_verse: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-nyʋasʋŋ kɛŋ summoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ nɛ ba chɩchɛ lɩɩŋ aŋ bɩ na, ba yikorusuŋ hɩl. Ama mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ vɩaba ta.

english_verse: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ fuonuŋ pɩŋ dundol-hɩlaa nyuŋ, aŋ ŋaa dɩ lɩɩ-bul sɩaa pɩpɛllɛ fuonaasɩŋ lɛ. Tintee-hɩlɩŋ jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ fuonuŋ lee, dɩ lɩɩ-bul sɩaa bubul tinteeŋ ma sɩ hɩla lɛ.

english_verse: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chɔnsɛ tɩɩsɩŋ deemba tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ: Kuolo, sɔjaamɩŋ, chɛɛŋ arɩ olif tɩa. Mɩ jaŋ bɩra leŋ dɩ tɩɩsɩŋ deemba ma nyʋ ʋ lɛ: Bʋtʋnsʋŋ, chɛrɩsɩŋ arɩ kanchalaa.

english_verse: Everyone will see this and know that I, the holy Lord God of Israel, created it all. Idols Are Useless
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ na a jɩŋ arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord, the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.
translation_verse: Ma Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro bɩra sɩ, “Má kʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ, wɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma kaa lɛrɛ.

english_verse: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma tɔŋŋɔɔ kɔ dɩ ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a pɩla. Má leŋ dɩ ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa bal a pɩla, dɩ la jɩmba aŋ dagɛla ba bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Prove that you are gods by making your predictions come true. Do something good or evil, so we can be amazed and terrified.
translation_verse: Ma dagɛla wɩalɩŋ maachie sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ la jɩŋ arɩ ma sɛnɛ ŋaa vesi nɛ. Má ŋaa wʋzɔŋ koo wʋbɔŋ a leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnla dɩ la chɩl.

english_verse: You idols are nothing, and you are powerless. To worship you would be disgusting.
translation_verse: Ama ma bɩ kɩa kala ŋaa, ma wʋŋaalaa ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ toma ŋaa disiŋ tɩmma nɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ sɩ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kɛŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ tɩtɩŋ nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ. Ʋ jaŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa a kʋ yuoma. Ʋ yie nʋɔsɛ kuoroo a bil tinteeŋ nɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ nʋɔsɛ tɩɛrɩŋ koo a nagɛ pupo-mɛɛrɛ sɩ yie nʋɔsɛ chʋrʋŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Did any of you idols predict what would happen? Did any of you get it right? None of you told about this or even spoke a word.
translation_verse: Ma tɔmɔ-la kʋbɛɛ nɛ fa wuo bʋl arɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ ŋaa, dɩ la jɩŋ a bʋl, ‘Ʋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ?’ Ma kʋŋkala bɩ wɩɩ bʋla. Nʋʋ bɩ wɩɩ nɩa ma teeŋ.

english_verse: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, “Look, it's happening!” I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩ Zaayɔŋ nɩaa, ‘Ma nɩaa ka kɔ nɛ.’ Mɩ-na nɛ bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa.

english_verse: They are nothing, and they can do nothing— they are merely a passing breeze.
translation_verse: Ba kala ŋaa wʋnyɩɛra nɛ. Ba wɩaa bɩ bʋbʋa kala kɛnɛ. Ba tɔmɔ-la nagɛ peliŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ tɩntɩnna nɛ ŋ-la, mɩ nɛ leŋe ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ. Ʋ nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ. Mɩ joŋ mɩ Dɩma a hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ, dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ chɩŋ tinteyee kala lɛ.

english_verse: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ jaŋ ŋɩŋaa goŋ koo aa ŋmoo niiŋ, koo a chɩŋ wombiee lɛ aa kpɩa wɩaa.

english_verse: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.
translation_verse: Fuolo-ŋmʋl sɩ gʋɔra ma ʋ bɩ jaŋ kaa boro ta. Ʋ bɩ chaaŋ-la ma sɩ gʋala jaŋ dɩsɛ. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a leŋ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ chɩŋ.

english_verse: He won't quit or give up until he brings justice everywhere on earth, and people in foreign nations long for his teaching.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ lɔlɔ koo dɩ ʋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ, see dɩ ʋ leŋe wʋtɩtɩɩ chɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ kpaŋkpaŋ. Ʋ wʋdagaa lɛ nɛ tinteye-la kala lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu nɩaa jaŋ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ a leŋ ʋ jɛrɛ tɔ leriŋ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa tinteeŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ pɩ nuhuobiine mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ yɩrɩŋ arɩ tʋɔpʋla. Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ aŋ beŋ ŋ nyuŋ woruŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa nii mɩ dɩ mɩ nɩaa pɛgɛ, aŋ ŋaa pʋlʋŋ a pɩ tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ ma.

english_verse: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ suri nyʋlɩmaa sɩaa, a lɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ bɩnɩŋ dɩa lɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ a ta.

english_verse: My name is the Lord! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.
translation_verse: Mɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ tʋla a pɩ kʋŋ dɔŋ kala, koo a joŋ mɩ dɛnnɛ a pɩ tɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Everything has happened just as I said it would; now I will announce what will happen next. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Má bee na, wʋbɩnaa-na ŋaa bal nɛ, wʋfalaa nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma ŋ-la, wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa maachie.” La TƖƖNA dɛnnɩŋ yɩɩlaa

english_verse: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ, má yɩɩ yɩɩl-falɩŋ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA. Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ duori lɩɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ, arɩ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu nɩaa, má dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: The Lord is marching out like an angry soldier, shouting with all his might while attacking his enemies. The Lord Will Help His People
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɔ a nagɛ bayuori duoŋ, a nagɛ laalɩyuori babii-balɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ yuo laalɩŋ. Ʋ jaŋ kpɩa laalɩyuori-goŋ aŋ yuo dii ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ, “Mɩ tɔrɛ mɩ niiŋ a dieni nɛ. Mɩ fa kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa nɛ a ŋaa fʋlʋlʋ, ama lɛɛlɛ bʋa-la yie nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa. Mɩɩ ŋmoo niiŋ a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: I will destroy the mountains and what grows on them; I will dry up rivers and ponds.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chei peelee arɩ dundolluŋ, a leŋ dɩ ba yaŋ arɩ tɩɩsɩŋ kala hɩl. Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ fuonuŋ leree kala bɩrɩmɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ, aŋ ŋaa dɩ pɩlaa lɩɩŋ ma hʋ.

english_verse: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyʋlɩma sɩpaaŋ, a kɛmba vɛŋ wombii-la ba ha sɩ bɩ vɛnɛ aŋ ka lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ pɔba a leŋ dɩ birimiŋ bɩrɩmɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ ba sɩpaaŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ lere-la kala sɩ ŋaa nyʋra nyʋra ŋaa mʋla mʋla. Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa pɩba nɛ ŋɩɩ: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ vɩaba ta.

english_verse: Everyone who worships idols as though they were gods will be terribly ashamed. God's People Won't Obey
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa kala a daŋ vesiŋ lɛ, a bʋl ‘Ma nɛ la wɩa,’ ba wɩaa jaŋ mʋ harɩŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diiba.” Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyʋlɩma nɛ aŋ taŋ ma

english_verse: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Iziral tɩmma, ma taŋa nɛ a pɛ nyʋlɩmɛ ma, ama má jegile nɩɩ aŋ suri ma sɩaa.

english_verse: No one is as blind or deaf as his messenger, his chosen servant,
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nyʋlɩma a nagɛ mɩ tɩntɩnna, koo a taŋ a nagɛ nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa a tɩmʋ?

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩɩ nɛ, ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tʋɔpʋla-la wɩaa a leŋ ʋ wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto kɛŋ doluŋ arɩ tʋla.

english_verse: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ nɩaa ŋaa nɩa ba sɩ yuo dii a kɛsɛ hɛ buotuonuŋ lɛ nɛ ba faa a nagɛ nɩaa ba kaa tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa ka nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ laaba ta. Ba kɛmba mʋmʋ nɛ ka nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ bʋl, “Má kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ.”

english_verse: Israel sinned and refused to obey the Lord or follow his instructions. So the Lord let us be robbed of everything we owned.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ leŋe ba yuo dii Iziral tɩŋŋaa a paa ba kɩaa ŋɩɩ? La TƖƖNA nɛ, Nɩɩ-la harɩŋ la sɩ lɩa a ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ. Ba vɩa dɩ ba to ʋ wombiiŋ nɛ, a bɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ dagɛba sɛyɛ.

english_verse: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ na baanɩŋ woruŋ ba nyuŋ, laalɩŋ jʋʋba. Ʋ baaŋ-la nagɛ nyiniŋ nɛ a joŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala dii, ka ba ha bɩ wɩɩ-la bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ. Nyiŋ-la diiba ŋɩɩ ma nɛ, ka ba ha vɩa dɩ ba joŋ wɩɩ-la a hɛ ba nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord, created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la. “Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma, má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, mɩ nɛ laama ta, mɩ jɩmma nɛ a yɩrɛma, ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: When you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you won't drown. When you walk through fire, you won't be burned or scorched by the flames.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ hɛ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ ma, mɩ jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ, lɩɩ-la bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛllɛ paama. Dɩ ma nɛ hɛ nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ ma, ʋ bɩ jaŋ nyɩgɛma, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo diima.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, ma Laataara, ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kus arɩ Sɛba, time laama ta.

english_verse: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa nɩfɩɛma mɩ teeŋ wɩaa, mɩ choma a zizilma, mɩ jaŋ joŋ nɩaa lenni ma mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Don't be afraid! I am with you. From both east and west I will bring you together.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, mɩ hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛsɛ ma biiriŋ a lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kɛmma lɩɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: I will say to the north and to the south, “Free my sons and daughters! Let them return from distant lands.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ nɩaa: ‘Má jomba tɩa,’ a bʋla pɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa nɩaa: ‘Má sɩ́ ba lɛrɛ bil.’ Má jomba ta dɩ ba lɩɩ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala a kɔ.

english_verse: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa mɩ nɩaa nɛ, mɩ nɛ ŋaaba, mɩ nɛ mɛba dɩ ba dagɛ mɩ tʋla.”

english_verse: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.
translation_verse: Laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ sɩaa aŋ bɩ na sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba kʋ lɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ dɩgɩlaa aŋ bɩ nɩɩ.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation to gather around. None of them can honestly say, “We told you so!” If someone heard them say this, then tell us about it now.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala kʋ hilimi. Ba tʋɔŋ kʋbɛɛ nɛ fa wuo heele bʋl faafaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa, arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa lɛɛlɛ a pɩla? Leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ kʋ-la sɩ ŋaa magɩlɩŋ kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ʋ dagɛ arɩ ba bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, dɩ la nɩkaanaa ma nɩɩ a bʋl tɛŋɛ nɛ.

english_verse: My people, you are my witnesses and my chosen servant. I want you to know me, to trust me, and understand that I alone am God. I have always been God; there can be no others.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋaa mɩ pɛ-naaraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa ma ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa, dɩ ma wuo jɩmmɛ a laamɛ dii woruŋ arɩ mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa. A lɩɩ mɩ harɩŋ, wɩa dɔŋ kala tuo. Kʋŋ ma dɔŋ saa bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ dɩ mɩ dee.

english_verse: I alone am the Lord; only I can rescue you.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ma TƖƖNA, laataarʋ kala tuo a pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ fa bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a pɩma, aŋ laama ta, vene kala dee. Ma pɛ na nɛ arɩ mɩ nɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, a chɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ kala mɩ nɛ Wɩa. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo fori mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ wɩɩ-la bɩrɩmɛ?” Wɩa nisusu-fanɩŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ

english_verse: I, the Lord, will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA, ma Laataara Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ laalɩyuoroo mʋ Babɩlɔŋ a chei taŋ-la kala. Ba babiibal goŋ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ yele.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your holy God, Israel's Creator and King.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, ma Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa, mɩ nɛ ma kuoro.”

english_verse: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ʋ nɛ bil wombiiŋ mʋga tʋɔŋ, ʋ nɛ leŋe wɛnɩŋ pɩŋ lɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe laalɩyuoroo arɩ ba janɩŋ torukoba arɩ ja-jɩllaa kala tel a bɩra bɩ wuo sii. Ba nyɩɩga nɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ fuuni chaanɩŋ dɩsɛ.

english_verse: Forget what happened long ago! Don't think about the past.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Má yʋ faafaa wɩaa, má bɩra sɩ́ ba kaa tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
translation_verse: Má bee na, lɛɛlɛ mɩɩ ŋaa wʋfalɩɩ nɛ, ʋ suomo nɛ, ma bɩ wɩɩ-la ka naa? Mɩɩ bil wombiiŋ nɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, a leŋ fuonuŋ ma pɩpɩŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Every wild animal honors me, even jackals and owls. I provide water in deserts— streams in thirsty lands for my chosen people.
translation_verse: Baga kɩaa jaŋ zilmi, jolluŋ arɩ hajaaŋkuŋkumba jaŋ zilmi, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ lɩɩŋ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ dɩ fuonuŋ pɩŋ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa ba ŋaa mɩ nɩaa nyʋa.

english_verse: I made them my own nation, so they would praise me.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋaa a pɩ mɩ tɩtɩa dɩ ba dɩdɛnnɛmɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.
translation_verse: Ama Iziral tɩmma, ma ha bɩ mɩ dɛnnɛ a magɛ dɩ ma lɔl mɩ wɩaa, Jekɔb doho nɩaa.

english_verse: You have not honored me by sacrificing sheep or other animals. And I have not burdened you with demands for sacrifices or sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ piesee kaa kʋ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩmɛ. Ma bɩ pʋsʋŋ kpʋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a zilmi. Mɩ bɩ ma fʋga dɩ ma kɛŋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɔ, koo a walɩmɛ ma a tɩŋ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma wɩaa.

english_verse: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ kaa kʋ pɩmɛ koo ma bɩ leŋe mɩ vɔgɛ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa nʋʋra lɛ. Ama ma joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a nyagɛmɛ, a leŋ mɩ lɔl ma wʋcheelee lɛ.

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ Wɩa, mɩ nɛ joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛma. Mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ mɩ tɩtɩa wɩaa nɛ. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ liisi ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.
translation_verse: Má liisi wɩalɩŋ sɩ bala, dɩ la kala jʋʋ ba tʋɔŋ a na wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ma bʋl ma bɩ wɩɩkala cheye.

english_verse: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Ma bumbuŋ naabalɩma ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, ma sɩpaalaaraa ma lɩɩ mɩ harɩŋ.

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ chei Iziral kala aŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa tʋʋsɛ ʋ joŋŋoo.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ tɩntɩnnaa Iziral tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ, Jekɔb doho nɩaa, ma nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ.

english_verse: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaama a pɛ ma lɛ a lɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ lʋlma, wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ tɩntɩnnaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa, má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, ma nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ.

english_verse: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ vɔgɛ lɩɩŋ, dɩ fuonuŋ pɩŋ nɩmɛ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ Dɩma a hɛ ma biiriŋ lɛ aŋ pɛ ma doho nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ tɔsɛ a nagɛ ya-fɩɛlɩŋ koo a nagɛ sagɩrɩgalɩaba sɩ chɩŋ fuoŋ sɩɩ pɛllʋ niiŋ.

english_verse: They will worship me and become my people. They will write my name on the back of their hands.
translation_verse: Dɔŋɔ jaŋ bʋl, ‘La TƖƖNA nɛ tɩɩmɛ.’ Nʋʋ dɔŋ ma jaŋ bʋl, ‘Mɩ ŋaa Jekɔb nʋʋ nɛ.’ Nʋʋ dɔŋ ma jaŋ ŋmʋnsa hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ‘Mɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA nʋʋ nɛ,’ a yɩyɩrɛ ʋ tɩtɩa Iziral tɩɩna.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro arɩ ba Laataara sɩ, “Mɩ nɛ dɩ-suomuŋ arɩ dɩ-dɛrɩŋ, Wɩa dɔŋ kala tuo a pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ hɛ nɩmɛ a magɛ mɩɩ? Leŋ dɩ tɩɩna kʋ lɩɩ dagɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ ŋaa nuhuobiinee a kaa kʋ yi jɩnɩŋ, arɩ wɩalɩŋ ha sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ chel, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma. Mɩ bɩ bʋla pɩma faafaa kala wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa? Ma nɛ ŋaa mɩ pɛ-naaraa. Wɩa dɔŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a pɛ mɩ lɛɛ? Wɩa dɔŋ bɩra tuo.”

english_verse: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ mɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ, tɔmɔ-la ma sɩ ŋaa ba sɩɩfɩaŋ kɩaa bɩ bʋbʋa kala kɛnɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpaarɛ tɔmɔ-la ma ŋaa nyʋlɩma nɛ, a ŋaa nɩyaara. Hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ diiba.

english_verse: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩa jaŋ mɛ tɔmʋŋ aŋ jɩŋ dɩ tɔŋ-la bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩkala?

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ kpaarɛba jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a mɛ tɔmɔ-la ŋaa nuhuobiinee nɛ a bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ. Leŋ dɩ ba kala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a bʋl wɩɩ-la ba sɩ kɛnɛ. Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmba dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diiba.

english_verse: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
translation_verse: Libire yie joŋ hɔɔŋ hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ fɩɛsɛ, ʋ lɩɩsɛ a joŋ hama a ŋmoo ŋɩɩ ʋ mʋ bɩrɩmɛ tɔmʋŋ. Ʋ nɩsɩŋ doluŋ nɛ ʋ yie kaa libu. Dɩ ʋ nɩɩ libu, ʋ yie lɔl nɛ, losuŋ arɩ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ ma yie kɛnʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Some woodcarver measures a piece of wood, then draws an outline. The idol is carefully carved with each detail exact. At last it looks like a person and is placed in a temple.
translation_verse: Kapɩnta ma yie kɛŋ kʋŋ nɛ a magɩsɛ daaŋ a kɛŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa kere lɩɩsɛ, a kɛŋ wogu a lɔsɔ lɩɩsɛ ʋ zɔŋ a nagɛ nuhuobiine, ʋ joŋo bil ʋ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Either cedar, cypress, oak, or any tree from the forest may be chosen. Or even a pine tree planted by the woodcarver and watered by the rain.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie keri kuolo koo kanchalɩŋ koo piine dɔŋɔ nɛ duuŋ lɛ, koo ʋ yie chɔnsɛ bʋtʋma nɛ duonuŋ nɩɩ hɛ ʋ waa.

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine kɛŋ daasɩ-la hɛ nyiniŋ wiwieni nɛ aŋ pɛ kaa ŋaa kʋdiilee, aŋ ha sii kaa ŋaa tɔŋŋɔɔ ma a kpʋkpaarɛ.

english_verse: Afterwards, he bows down to worship the wooden idol. “Protect me!” he says. “You are my god.”
translation_verse: Daasɩ-la kʋkaanaa, ʋ yie kaa ŋaa tɔmʋŋ a kpʋkpaarɛ. Ʋ yie kpaarʋ aŋ bʋl, “Ŋ nɛ mɩ wɩa, laamɛ ta.”

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kʋŋ bɩ jaŋ hɔŋ a bɩɩnɛ a bʋl, “Daasɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ nɛ mɩ kaa hɛ nyiniŋ a ŋaa kʋdiilee didii a kaa wasɛ nammɩa chɩchaŋ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ daa-la kʋkaanaa a ŋaa tɔmʋŋ a kpʋkpaarɛ?”

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ nɩa yaara magɛ, a sii joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa hɛ kʋŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo dii a bɩrɩmɛ tʋɔrʋŋ lɛ? Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo to ŋ-la a laa ʋ tɩtɩa ta. Ba bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩma pɩ ba tɩtɩa arɩ kʋ-la ba sɩ koro bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
translation_verse: “Iziral tɩmma, ma Jekɔb doho nɩaa, má jɩŋ arɩ ma ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaama, ma ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa, mɩ bɩ jaŋ yʋ ma wɩaa.

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋɔrɛ ma wʋcheelee kala ta nɛ a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ sɩ sie, a lɩɩsɛ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma kala ta arɩ nyalɩŋ sɩ huoso. Má mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ laama ta nɛ.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ kɩaa, ma yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, peelee arɩ tɩa na-kala sɩ hɛ duuŋ lɛ má faasa yɩɩ yɩɩlaa, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA dagɛ ʋ doluŋ nɛ a laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa a ta. Nɩaa jaŋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ

english_verse: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA, ma Laataara, Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaama sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, mɩ nɛ ŋaa kʋŋkala. Mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ pɔ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa a bʋl arɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ vʋgʋraa wʋmagɩlaa sɩ́ wʋtɩtɩɩba kʋ ŋaa. Mɩ nɛ leŋe wʋjɩnnaa wʋjɩmɩŋ kala ŋaa pɛɩ.

english_verse: I will make the message of my prophets come true. They are saying, “Jerusalem will be filled with people, and the Lord will rebuild the towns of Judah.”
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ leŋe wɩalɩŋ mɩ tɩntɩnna arɩ mɩ tɩndaaraa sɩ bʋla kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba. Mɩ bʋla arɩ nɩaa jaŋ bɩra hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ, ka ba wasa saa Juda tasɩ-la ma sɩ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ kpɩa fuonuŋ arɩ mʋgʋ-balaa lɛ, ba kala jaŋ hʋ.

english_verse: I am also the one who says, “Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.”
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ bʋla pɩ Siirus, ‘Ŋ nɛ jaŋ beŋ mɩ nɩaa nyuŋ,’ a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ. Ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba wasa saa Jerusalɛm arɩ mɩ-na Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ Siirus, nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa a pʋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ yuo dii tinteyee aŋ dʋɔrɛ kuoroo ba doluŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ suri tabalaa boi-baalaa pʋ, boi-baala-la bɩ jaŋ tɔ.

english_verse: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ laa ŋ sɩpaaŋ a jɛrɛ peelee, aŋ ŋmoo boiŋ-baala-la kala ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa lo, aŋ bori ba hɔ-daa-dolo-la.

english_verse: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ dʋa-la kala sɩ faa birimiŋ tʋɔŋ a pɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ jɩmɩŋ, a yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: Siirus, arɩ ŋ sɩ bɩ mɩ jɩŋ ma kala, ama a tɩŋ mɩ tɩntɩnnaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa wɩaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ lɩɩsɩŋ a pɩŋ yuŋuŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, mɩ dɔŋ tuo. Mɩ nɛ Wɩa, Wɩa dɔŋ bɩra tuo. Arɩ ŋ sɩ bɩ mɩ jɩŋ ma kala, mɩ ha jaŋ pɩŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord. No other gods are real.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ, nʋʋkala jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA. Wɩa dɔŋ bɩra tuo a pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord, do all this.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ŋaa birimiŋ arɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ. Mɩ nɛ leŋe nɩaa dʋdʋa, mɩ nɛ leŋe wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ ma jʋjʋʋba. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala.

english_verse: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ, suri a leŋ dɩ tʋɔpʋla kʋ tuu su tinteeŋ, a nagɛ duonuŋ, dɩ laatanɩŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala.

english_verse: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
translation_verse: Wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ ŋɩŋaara yuyuo yuosuŋ. Ŋ ŋaa chʋrʋŋ nɛ. Chʋrʋŋ jaŋ wuo pɩɛsɛ pupo-mɛɛrɛ arɩ, bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ʋ kɛnʋ ŋɩŋaa? Ŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩŋ arɩ ŋ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛɛ?

english_verse: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
translation_verse: Wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋ nɩɩ-la sɩ bʋla pɩ ʋ nyɩmma koo ʋ naaŋ, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ lʋlmɛ mɩ nagɛ ŋ-la?’ ”

english_verse: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, a ŋaaba sɩ, “Má kɛŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ma pɩɛsɛmɛ wɩalɩŋ maachie sɩ jaŋ ŋaa, koo a pɩɛsɛmɛ mɩ biiriŋ wɩaa, koo a dagɛmɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ mɩ tɩŋ mɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa?

english_verse: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ŋaa tinteeŋ arɩ nuhuobiine kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ, a ŋaa wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ chɛnɛ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa kala a leŋ ba chɩŋ lere-la ba sɩ chɩna.

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Wɩa sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ lɩɩsɛ Siirus a pʋ doluŋ, dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ wombiee kala tʋʋlɛ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ paa mɩ taŋ Jerusalɛm a wasa saa, aŋ laa mɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ a kaa mʋ tintee-wogusuŋ a ta. Nʋʋkala dee bɩ ʋ joŋo dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩaa deemba ka dɩ ʋ timu koo a siilu. La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: “Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ Kus tɩŋŋaa bayal kɩaa jaŋ ŋaa ma kɩaa. Sɛba tɩŋŋaa bawayiile-la kala jaŋ ŋaa ma yosi. Ma jaŋ hɛba chɔrʋmɔɔ, dɩ baa to ma harɩŋ. Ba jaŋ kpirimi ma sɩpaaŋ a suri ba niiŋ bʋl, ‘Wɩa sɩ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ nɛ sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa, kʋŋ dɔŋ tuo.’ ”

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ ŋaa ba Laataara, kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa faa nɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ mɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ. Ba jaŋ hɩɩsɛba hɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA jaŋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta, a laa ba ta a kaa mʋ wuu. Ba bɩ jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ, a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ, hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ diiba.

english_verse: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ. Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa. Ʋ bɩ ba ŋaa dɩ ba pɩŋ hoi, ʋ ŋaa nuhuobiinee arɩ kɩaa hɛ ba lɛ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, kʋŋ dɔŋ bɩra tuo.

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ wɩaa lʋara bʋl koo a ŋaa wɩaa birimiŋ tʋɔŋ. Mɩ bɩra bɩ bʋla pɩ Jekɔb doho nɩaa dɩ ba nɛ tomi ŋɩɩ jaŋ ŋaa pɛɩ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, mɩ yie bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, a dagɛ wɩɩ-la sɩ maga.

english_verse: to every survivor from every nation: “Gather around me! Learn how senseless it is to worship wooden idols or pray to helpless gods.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ fá a kagɛ ma tinteyee lɛ, má hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a kɔ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ a ŋaa tɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ bɩ ba wuo laa ta a kpʋkpaarɛba a tuto vesiŋ, ba bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ.

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Má kɔ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ a bʋl wɩɩ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ nɩɩ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ bʋla faafaa kala arɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ ŋaa? Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dee? Wɩa dɔŋ tuo a pɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ nɛ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a laa nɩaa tɩta. Wɩa dɔŋ tuo a pɛ mɩ lɛ.
