english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: Má mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ dɩ mɩ laama ta, ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa, mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa, Wɩa dɔŋ bɩra tuo.

english_verse: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.
translation_verse: Mɩ tɛŋɛ kala nɛ mɩ kaa hɛ niiŋ deeŋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ ta. Nʋʋkala jaŋ kpirimi mɩ sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlɛmɛ.

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ bʋl, ‘La TƖƖNA dʋndʋŋa teeŋ nɛ la jaŋ wuo kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla arɩ doluŋ.’ Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ na baanɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ Jekɔb doho nɩaa kala ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma dɩ ba yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ vesi-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛɛl arɩ Nɛbɔ wɩaa dɛrɛ nɛ, ba faa kpaarɛba nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ba nɛ ba paa hɛ pʋsʋŋ toruko lɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba mɩɩra ŋaa chʋga nɛ a pɩ pʋsʋ-la, ba chʋŋ a bɛsɩmɛ.

english_verse: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Tɔmɔ-la arɩ pʋsʋ-la sɩ chʋmba kala tuu kpirimi nɛ, ba bɩ ba tɩtɩa wuo laa ta, ba kɛsɛ ba kala mʋ yo-baga nɛ.

english_verse: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Má nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka Jekɔb doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ beŋ ma nyuŋ nɛ a lɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ lʋlma.

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ paala hɩɛsɛ dɩ ma nyusuŋ pʋllɛ ma, mɩ-na nɛ ma Wɩa, mɩ ha jaŋ beŋ ma nyuŋ woruŋ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaama, a kɛmma vɩvɛŋ, mɩ jaŋ beŋ ma nyuŋ woruŋ a laama ta.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? Is anyone my equal?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ wuo kaa magɩsɛmɛ? Mɩ dɩ kʋbɛɛ nɛ magɛ dɔŋɔ?

english_verse: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ yie chaarɛ sɛlɩmɛ ba lʋagaba lɛ, a joŋ hɔpʋla a magɩsɛ sanɩa lɛ, a joŋo pɩ libire ʋ libi vene pɩba, ka ba timu aŋ kpʋkpaarɛ.

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: Ba yie joŋo baasɛ, a kaa mʋ bil ʋ chɩŋ, ʋ bɩ wuo vɛŋ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bunso pʋ ma, ʋ yie chɩŋ nɛ, ʋ bɩ wɩɩ wuo laa bʋl. Dɩ ŋ nɛ jʋʋ wɩɩ ma, ʋ bɩŋ wuo laata.

english_verse: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ mɩ niiŋ sɛyɛ, má liisi wɩɩŋ deeŋ a joŋo hɛ ma nyuŋ lɛ, a sɩ́ yʋ.

english_verse: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
translation_verse: Má liliisi wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa faafaa kala, a jɩŋ arɩ mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa, Wɩa dɔŋ tuo a nagɛmɛ.

english_verse: From the very beginning, I told what would happen long before it took place. I kept my word
translation_verse: Dɩ-suomuŋ kala nɛ mɩ dagɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ kʋ ŋaa maachie. Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ jaŋ chɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaaʋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ birigi.

english_verse: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ dɩ-bolii a kɔ. Ʋ jaŋ kʋ tuu a nagɛ kɩla, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ sɩ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa. Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ ŋaaba.

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, ma tʋɔ-dol tɩmma-la, ma nɩalɩŋ arɩ tʋɔpʋla pɛgɛ sɩ bolie.

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔpʋla kʋ kpagɛma nɛ. Ʋ bɩra bɩ dɩ-bolii hɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ dieni aŋ laa nɩaa ta. Mɩ jaŋ laa Jerusalɛm nɩaa ta, a leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kɛŋ yuŋuŋ.”

english_verse: Start grinding grain! Take off your veil. Strip off your fancy clothes and wade across rivers.
translation_verse: Má paa nɔnnʋŋ a nɔŋ munuŋ, aŋ kɛŋ ma nyu-kpal duduosu-la puri ma nyusuŋ lɛ. Má kɛŋ ma gondomba kuro ta ba jɩl, aŋ kɛŋ naabirimee chol fuonu-la.

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree a dii hɩɩsɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ fɩɩsɛ ma lɛ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ ma kʋbala ma ta.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
translation_verse: La Laataara yɩrɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, ʋ nɛ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Babɩlɔŋ, “Hɔŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ a tɔrɛ ŋ niiŋ. Nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ yɩrɩŋ tinteyee kuoro.

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa na baanɩŋ nɛ mɩ nɩaa nyuŋ a joŋ wɩaa ŋaa ba lɛ arɩ mɩ dee bɩra bɩ ba tɩɩ. Mɩ sɩ jomba a hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ŋ bɩ ba nenige fá. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ paala hɩɛsɛ, ŋ dɔgɩsɛba nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
translation_verse: Ŋ fa bɩɩna arɩ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa kuoru deeŋ deeŋ nɛ, aŋ vɩa dɩ ŋ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ chɔgɩsɛ a na ŋɩɩ ba dɩ-dɛrɩŋ sɩ jaŋ nagɛ.

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, ŋ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ cho sɩma, ŋ fa bɩɩna ŋ hɔŋ woruŋ nɛ, wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ walɩmɩŋ. Ŋ fa bʋla arɩ ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ, kʋŋ dɔŋ tuo a magɩŋ. Ŋ bɩɩna ŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ŋ nagɛ yo-haal koo dɩ ŋ biiriŋ kʋŋ tuo dɩ ŋ na hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: Your magic powers and charms will suddenly fail, then you will be a widow and lose your children.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ guu ŋaa ŋ lɛ tapʋl bala. Ŋ biiriŋ jaŋ lɛl, ka dɩ ŋ pɛ nagɛ yo-haal ma, arɩ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ jɩma arɩ ŋ chichiribiŋ ma kala.

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: Ŋ joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa hɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ bʋl, ‘Nʋʋkala bɩ mɩɩ na.’ Ŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ ŋ kʋjɩma leŋe ŋ yeŋŋi nɛ. Ŋ sɩ ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ. Kʋŋ dɔŋ bɩra tuo a magɩŋ.

english_verse: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!
translation_verse: Ha fɩɛsɛ sɩɩ a ŋɩŋaa ŋ chichiribi wɩaa, a kɛŋ daalusuŋ nyɩsa kɩkɛsɛ nɩaa arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ fa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋ hambiiriŋ kala lɛ. Kapo ba jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ a fugusi nʋʋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ.

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ bʋla chagɩlɩŋ mɩɩra cheyiŋ nɛ. Leŋ dɩ ŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie beŋ chɛnwʋlaa a dɩdagɛ wɩaa kʋ lɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie bʋl wɩalɩŋ maachie sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a pɩpɩŋ chɛnɛ na-kala, leŋ dɩ ba laaŋ ta wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaaŋ lɛ yei.

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ pɩpɩŋ nagɛ ya-yʋalaa nɛ, nyiniŋ jaŋ diiba. Ba bɩ jaŋ wuo laa ba tɩtɩa ta nyiŋ-la lɛ. Nʋʋ paala bɩ nyiŋ-la wuo kpagɛ ma a saa wiwieni.

english_verse: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ harɩŋ ŋ sɩ to ŋ hambiiriŋ kala lɛ ba dɩdagɩŋ, wɩɩ-la kala ba sɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa pɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba kala jaŋ fá aŋ vɩaŋ ta. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo laaŋ ta.”

english_verse: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
translation_verse: Ma Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ ŋaa Juda doho nɩaa, má jegile nɩɩ: Ma nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ maa chʋɔlɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa nɛ, ama ma bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ tʋɔpʋla kɛnɛ.

english_verse: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ ma ŋaa tabal-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɩaa nɛ, ma yɩɛlaa kala hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa lɛ, ʋ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, “Faafaa kala mɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɛ, a leŋ ma jɩmba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ leŋ wɩalɩŋ guu ŋaa a bal.

english_verse: I knew you were stubborn and hardheaded.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma ma nyuŋ dolie nɛ woruŋ a nagɛ hɔɔŋ.

english_verse: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.
translation_verse: Ma nɩɩ wɩaa deemba kala nɛ, a naba ma dɩ ba ŋaa. Lɛɛlɛ ma bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛɛ? A chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ, mɩ jaŋ bʋl wʋfalaa ma sɩ bɩ jɩŋ a pɩma.

english_verse: Today I am doing something new, something you cannot say you have heard before.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ nɛ mɩ leŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋɩŋaa, faafaa dee ma ha bɩ ba nɩa aŋ ka. Ma bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl: ‘La laa sɩpaaŋ jɩmba nɛ.’

english_verse: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
translation_verse: Ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ nɩa, ma bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ ma jɩŋ. Faafaa kala ma dɩgɩlaa yuŋŋie nɛ. Ma ŋaa nɩaa sɩ bɩ dagɩŋ ka nɩɩ nɛ a lɩɩ ma hambiiriŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
translation_verse: Ama a tɩŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ wɩaa, mɩ bɩ leŋe mɩ baanɩŋ sii ma nyuŋ, mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ nɩaa dɛnnɛmɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, a bɩ ma kala chei ta.

english_verse: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ hɛɛŋ sɩ nagɛ nyiniŋ nɛ a hɛ ma lɛ a magɩsɛ ma, arɩ ba sɩ joŋ hɔpʋla a chɔ dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ hɔɔ-bɩnɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I did this because of who I am. I refuse to be dishonored or share my praise with any other god.
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩtɩa wɩaa nɛ mɩ tɩma ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa sɩɩŋ jʋʋmɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ tʋla pɩ kʋŋ dɔŋ kala. La TƖƖNA laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta

english_verse: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
translation_verse: Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ Iziral tɩmma, ma Jekɔb doho nɩaa, ma nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa. Mɩ-na nɛ Wɩa. Mɩ nɛ dɩ-suomuŋ arɩ dɩ-dɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ŋaa tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋl wɩɩ tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ sɛnɛ yie chɩŋ.

english_verse: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
translation_verse: Má kala kʋ hilimi, a jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Ma tɔmɔ-la kʋbɛɛ nɛ wuo bʋla pɩma arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ nɛ dɩ ʋ yuo Babɩlɔŋ, a joŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ cho a ŋaa ʋ lɛ?

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na nɛ yɩrʋ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ lɩɩ dɩ ʋ yuo dii.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: Má kʋ kpagɛmɛ a nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ: Faafaa kala mɩ bɩ lʋara bʋl wɩaa, mɩ heele nɛ. Bʋa-la ma lɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa, mɩ fa hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ.” Lɛɛlɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ joŋ ʋ Dɩma hɛ mɩ-na Azaaya lɛ nɛ, aŋ tɩmmɛ.

english_verse: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la, ma Laataara Iziral Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ: “Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagɛma wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ pɩma arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ maga dɩ ma ŋɩŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ fa jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma, a kɛmba tɩŋ, wɩaa fa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ pɩma a nagɛ fuoŋ sɩ suo a pɩpɛllɛ.

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ma doho nɩaa fa jaŋ yʋgɛ a nagɛ hagɩlɩ-biee nʋʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛ. Ba yɩrɩŋ fa bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ lɛlɛ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
translation_verse: Má lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, má fá kagɛ Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ. Má heele bʋl arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ: ‘La TƖƖNA laa ʋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta nɛ.’ ” Má leŋ dɩ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala nɩɩ.

english_verse: He led us through the desert and made water flow from a rock to satisfy our thirst.
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-nyʋasʋŋ fa bɩ ba kpʋa, ʋ sɩ kɛmba a vɩvɛŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ fa leŋe lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ lɩɩ bʋŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ fa leŋe bʋŋ yɛrɛ nɛ lɩɩŋ gbu lɩɩ, ba nyʋa.

english_verse: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ jaŋ na wiese mʋapɩlɩɩ ma.”

english_verse: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
translation_verse: Má jegili mɩ teeŋ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu. Tinteye-la sɩ hɛ dɩ-bolii nɩaa, ma ma nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ. Ka dɩ ba-na lʋlmɛ, La TƖƖNA yɩrɛmɛ nɛ. Mɩ lʋlʋŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ.

english_verse: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe mɩ niiŋ wɩaa kɛŋ niiŋ a nagɛ tokobiiŋ nɛ. Ʋ kɛmmɛ faa ʋ vaaluŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ chɛsɛmɛ nɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ chɛsɛ to-hɛmɩŋ a joŋo hɛ ʋ to-huoŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma nɛ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa, ma lɛ nɛ nɩaa jaŋ to a zilmi.”

english_verse: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Mɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa bɩ nyʋʋrɩɩ kala kɛnɛ, mɩ lɔlɔ tɩta pɛɩ nɛ. Ama, mɩ joŋ wɩalɩŋ hɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ jɩma arɩ mɩ Wɩa jaŋ timmi.”

english_verse: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl arɩ ka ba na lʋlmɛ, ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ nɛ, mɩ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ, dɩ mɩ kɛŋ Jekɔb mɩɩra kɔ ʋ teeŋ, dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ kɔ ʋ leriŋ. La TƖƖNA zilmi nɛ, mɩ Wɩa nɛ mɩ doluŋ.

english_verse: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Ŋ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnʋ, a kɛŋ Iziral doho doho-la dʋndʋŋ mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ Jekɔb doho nɩkaana-la sɩ bɩ sʋba, ama mɩ ha jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ma pʋlʋmʋŋ, dɩ mɩ laatanɩŋ wuo yi dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala.”

english_verse: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa, Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, a ŋaa ba laataara bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ bɩ ʋ wʋŋaalaa cho a bɛrɛ, a ŋaa kuoroo tɩntɩnnʋ: “Kuoroo jaŋ naŋ a sii chɩŋ, dɩ kuori-biiriŋ ma naŋ a tuu kpirimi. Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɩ lɩɩsɛ mɩ tɩntɩnna, kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.”

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ ʋ nɩaa, “Dɩ bʋa-la sɩ maga dɩ mɩ laa nɩaa ta nɛ yie, mɩ jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ pɔŋ woruŋ, a leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa nii sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ nɩaa pɛgɛ. Ba jaŋ wasa saa ba jikpeeni-la kala a hɔŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ laa nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ a ta dɩ ba na pʋlʋmʋŋ. Ba jaŋ na kʋdiilee lee-la kʋŋkala sɩ paala tuo.

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: Losuŋ koo lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛmba. Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɩmɩŋ ma bɩ jaŋ lɩma kɛmba, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ fá ba nenige jaŋ laa ba sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba mʋ lɩɩ-bulo leriŋ.

english_verse: I will level the mountains and make roads.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ yɛrɛ peelee a bil wombiee a bil womporuŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa vɛŋ.

english_verse: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa jaŋ lɩɩ dɩ-boloo a kɔ. Dɔnsʋŋ jaŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ, dɩ dɔnsʋŋ ma lɩɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma lɩɩ tintee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩwaŋ.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kɩaa, má ŋaa goŋ a jʋjʋɔsɛ, peelee ma má yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa, bɛɛ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA jaŋ nyagɛ ʋ nɩaa bɔyɛ, aŋ fá ʋ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ nisusuŋ.

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: Ama Jerusalɛm nɩaa sɩ, “La TƖƖNA vɩala ta nɛ, ʋ yʋ la wɩaa nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA pɩɛsɛba, “Bie sɩɩ wasɛ yɩlɩŋ, ʋ naaŋ jaŋ wuo yʋ ʋ wɩaa a bɩ ʋ nisusuŋ ka fá? Dɩ ʋ nɛ jaŋ wuo ŋaa ŋɩɩ ma, mɩ-na bɩ jaŋ yʋ ma wɩaa.

english_verse: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm tɩmma, mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo yʋ ma wɩaa. Mɩ tuuri ma yɩraa hɛ mɩ nachala lɛ nɛ, ma wɩaa hɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
translation_verse: Ŋ hambolibiisiŋ sɩ jaŋ paa ŋ jikpeeniŋ a wasa saa ka kɔ nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yigiŋ lo jaŋ lɩɩ aŋ leŋiŋ.

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: Beŋ leriŋ kala na, ŋ nɩaa ka kɔ ŋ teeŋ nɛ. Mɩ nɛ Wɩa sɩ weye, ŋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ ŋ nɩaa nyuŋ arɩ ba sɩ yie kpɩɛrɛ ha-falɩŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Ŋ tinteeŋ fa wuolo nɛ a pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa kʋbie ŋ teeŋ a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kɔ dɩ ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ wɩaa. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yigiŋ lo jaŋ leŋiŋ aŋ mʋ dɩ-bolii.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: Ba sɩ cheyiŋ aŋ kɛnɩŋ mʋ tintee-wogo ŋ lʋl biiri-la, chɛɛ dɔŋ ba jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ tintee-la muuro nɛ, baa chɛ leriŋ nɛ dɩ ba pɛ a wuo hɔŋ.

english_verse: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ pɩɛsɛ ŋ tɩtɩa: ‘kʋbɛɛ nɛ lʋl biiriŋ deemba a pɩmɛ? Mɩ nɩaa kala fa sʋba nɛ aŋ ka mɩ hɔŋ a bɩra bɩ bii wuo lʋl. Mɩ fa bɩ bii kala kɛnɛ aŋ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ dɩɛsɛ nɩaa deemba? Mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ fa ka, nɩɩ nɛ nɩaa deemba saa lɩɩ?’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa duosoo dɩ ba kɛŋ ŋ biiriŋ mɩɩra kʋ pɩŋ. Ba jaŋ paa ŋ hambolibiisiŋ a nɔgɛ, aŋ chaalɛ ŋ toloo a kaa kʋ pɩŋ.

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Kuoroo jaŋ ŋaa nyɩmmaba ŋ teeŋ, dɩ kuori-haalaa ma nagɛ ŋ naamba a bibeniŋ. Ba jaŋ kpirimi ŋ sɩpaaŋ a ziliŋ. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋ Tɩɩna. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ mɩ lɛ bɩ jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: But the Lord has promised to fight on our side and to rescue our children from those strong and violent enemies.
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ paala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ laalɩyuori-wajɩa yomo laa, koo a laa kɩalɩŋ nɩtɛrɛ sɩ yuo laa, mɩ-na jaŋ wuo ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ yuo nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yuoŋ, a laa ŋ biiriŋ ta.

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩɩ walɩmɩŋ gʋra kpʋ dɔŋɔ, ba jaŋ fo ba tɩtɩa chalɩŋ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa, nuhuobiinee kala jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa Laataara.”

english_verse: The Lord says, “Children, I didn't divorce your mother or sell you to pay debts; I divorced her and sold you because of your sins.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ pɩɛsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: “Teŋ-la mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩ ma naaŋ, aŋ kiru ta hɛ nɩɩ nɛ? Koo kʋbɛɛ chɩŋ nɛ mɩ dii a joŋu yalla tiŋ? Ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ma nagɛ nʋʋ ba sɩ yalla. Ma wʋcheelee nɛ tɩɩ mɩ kirima ta.

english_verse: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ wɩa-nyuŋ biri a nagɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛrɩŋ ba sɩ yie laalɛ a yiyel yoho.”

english_verse: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ joŋ nɩaa dagɩŋ doluŋ pɩmɛ nɛ, dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa a leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ nandaasɩŋ sɩ yʋɔra nyuŋ nyaasɛ. Chʋchʋa na-kala, ʋ yie chɩsɛmɛ nɛ a leŋ mɩ cho dɩ mɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ dagɛmɛ.

english_verse: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ dagɛmɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ nɩa nɛ, mɩ bɩ ba vɩa, mɩ bɩ ʋ harɩŋ ma mɩɩra.

english_verse: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋmoo mɩ nɛ, aŋ fʋʋla yagɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ sieri mɩ lɛ a kɛŋ mɩ tɔŋ-pʋnaa lɩlɛrɛ aŋ pɛ tʋ nantʋɔrʋŋ hɩhɛ mɩ sɩaa lɛ mɩ bɩ mɩ sɩaa kaa faaba.

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ joŋ sɩaa chaasɛba nɛ, mɩ jɩma, hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ diimi.

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ tɩtɩa nɛ chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ mɩ chei wɩɩ nɛ? Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ bʋl mɩ teeŋ jaŋ kɔsɛ a nagɛ gɛrɩŋ tiiŋ sɩ die.

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ zil La TƖƖNA, a sɛɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ tɩntɩnna sɩ bʋla, dɩ ma nɩɩ vɛŋ birimiŋ lim tʋɔŋ a bɩ nyiniŋ kɛnɛ ma, má laa La TƖƖNA dii, a bibeŋ ma Wɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
translation_verse: Ama, ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ lɔgɛ wɩaa a wuwurisi ma dɔnsʋŋ, wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ gʋra jomma dii. La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa ma lɛ. Ma jaŋ faasa na hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey the Lord, follow Abraham's example. He was the rock from which you were chipped.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩ, “Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ chɛ tʋɔpʋla, arɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ ma TƖƖNA, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Má beŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ-na Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaama sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ bʋŋ.

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ nyagɛ Zaayɔŋ nɩaa bɔyɛ a fá Jerusalɛm nɩaa nisusuŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ jikpeeni-la lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ kala mɩɩra nagɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA ŋmaŋkaa-la fa sɩ hɛ Ɛdɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la jaŋ nagɛ mɩ ŋmaŋkaaŋ. Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, dɩ ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɩdɛnnɛmɛ.

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa, mɩ tinteeŋ nɩaa, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ woruŋ. Mɩ jaŋ dagɛ mɩ wombiiŋ a pɩ tinteyee nɩaa. Mɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ba pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔpʋl wɩaa kʋ kpagɛma lɩma nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ laama ta kpaga nɛ. Mɩ doluŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu nɩaa joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ, a gbɩgbɛrɛmɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ laaba ta.

english_verse: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
translation_verse: Má wʋla beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ na, aŋ beŋ tinteeŋ ma na. Wɩa-nyuŋ jaŋ nyɩɩgɛ a nagɛ nyʋɔsʋŋ sɩ lɛlɛ. Tinteeŋ ma sɩma kala jaŋ lɩɩ a nagɛ gɛrɩŋ sɩ lɩa. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ jaŋ sʋʋ a nagɛ nanchʋɔsʋŋ. Ama mɩ ha jaŋ laa mɩ nɩaa tɩta a kaa mʋ wuu. Mɩ tʋɔpʋla ma bɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a joŋ mɩ wombii-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto wɩaa hɛ ma nyuŋ lɛ, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Dɩ nɩaa nɛ ŋaa wɩaa a jʋjʋʋ ma lɛ koo a tʋtʋʋsɛma, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma.

english_verse: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
translation_verse: Ba kala jaŋ kɔsɛ a nagɛ gɛrɩŋ tiiŋ sɩ die. Nanchʋɔlaa jaŋ dii ba kala a nagɛ ba sɩ dii pie-pʋnaa. Ama mɩ tʋɔpʋla arɩ mɩ nɩaa laatanɩŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, sii a pɛ la lɛ arɩ ŋ doluŋ a laala ta. Sii ŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa ŋ fa sɩ ŋaa pɩ la bumbuŋ nɩaa. Ŋ dee fa bɩ mʋga tʋɔŋ peribanyeŋŋu ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rahab kaa keri muno muno ŋɩɩ?

english_verse: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?
translation_verse: Ŋ dee fa bɩ ŋaa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ hʋ, aŋ ka ŋ bil wɛnɩŋ ʋ dɩ-luŋuŋ, nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa ta to chol?

english_verse: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ laa ta jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Ba jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ kʋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm. Ba jaŋ nɩɩ sɩma a kaa mʋ wuu. Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ jaŋ faasa yʋgɛ ba teeŋ, dɩ hɛɛŋ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ fa lɛl.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ-na nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ nyagɛ ma bɔyɛ. Ka ma mɩɩra fɩfá nuhuobiine sɩɩ sʋʋ a nagɛ yaŋ a bɩ dɩ-pɛsɩɩ kala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: Ma yʋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa ma wɩaa nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala. Aŋ ka fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma tapʋlɩɩ kala a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛma wɩaa. Kʋbɛɛ ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛma? Nɩɩ nɛ ba hɛ lɛɛlɛ?

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: Fawʋlʋba-la kala ba sɩ kaa tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa, ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni ka mɩ laaba ta. Ba bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ. Losuŋ ma bɩ jaŋ kpʋba,

english_verse: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ nɛ yie ŋaa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ huhuuri. Mɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ joŋ mɩ wɩaa hɛ ma niiriŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ a chu tɔma. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala, aŋ bʋla pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa, ‘Má nɛ mɩ nɩaa.’ ” La TƖƖNA Baanɩŋ

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm nɩaa, má sii chɩŋ, ma na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ na baanɩŋ a dɔgɩsɛma kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ, ma kala vɔgɛ a gɩgɛrɛ.

english_verse: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
translation_verse: Ma hambolibiisiŋ kala tʋɔŋ, nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ laa ma sɩpaaŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ dɩɛsa tʋɔŋ, nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa chaasa na baanɩŋ nɛ ma nyuŋ. Ma biiriŋ yiege nɛ a pɩŋ wombiiŋ niiŋ loŋgoru kala lɛ, a nagɛ bɛrɛ sɩ kɛŋ bagɩla.

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma Jerusalɛm nɩaa, hɛɛ-la sɩ leŋe ma nagɛ nɩaa sɩ bugo, má nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ma Wɩa sɩ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ kɛŋ hɛɛ-la mɩ fa sɩ na baanɩŋ a joŋo hɛ ma lɛ a leŋ ma gɩgɛrɛ a dʋɔrɛ ma lɛ nɛ. Ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ naʋ.

english_verse: Instead I will give it to your brutal enemies, who treated you like dirt and walked all over you.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra joŋ hɛɛ-la a hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛ ma lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie leŋ ma tuu pɩŋ tinteeŋ ba nʋɔsɛma bɩbal a nagɛ ma ŋaa hagɩla nɛ, a nagɛ wombiiŋ ba sɩɩ vɛŋ ʋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm nɩaa, má sii, má sii chɩŋ, a kɛŋ doluŋ. Zaayɔŋ taŋ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɩaa, má paa ma gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ laalɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kʋ jʋʋ ma taŋ-la.

english_verse: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck. Suffering Will End
translation_verse: Má pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ ta, aŋ hɔŋ ma kuoru kpasa nyuŋ. Ma Jerusalɛm nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ, má lɩɩsɛ chɔrʋmɔ-la sɩ hɛ ma baŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ ʋ nɩaa, “Bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kɛmma mʋ yoŋ-baga, ba bɩ moribii kala time aŋ kɛmma mʋ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma bɩ jaŋ tiŋ moribii kala ka dɩ ba jomma ta.”

english_verse: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Faafaa-la mɩ nɩaa sie nɛ a mʋ hɔŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a ŋaa nʋhʋɔra. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ, Asiiria tɩŋŋaa ma bɩra fʋga kɛsɛba mʋ a dɔgɩsɛ.”

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ mɩ kɛŋ daha lɛɛlɛ? Ba kɛsɛ mɩ nɩaa mʋ yoŋ-baga nɛ pɛɩ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bemba sisieri mɩ lɛ aŋ chichei mɩ yɩrɩŋ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi dɩ mɩ nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ Wɩa, mɩ nɛ fa bʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩba.”

english_verse: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ chɩŋ peeliŋ nyuŋ a bʋla pɩ ʋ nɩaa arɩ ba yuo dii ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, a bʋla pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa dɩ Wɩa laaba ta nɛ, dɩ ba jaŋ na fɩɛlɩŋ, a bʋla pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa, “Ma Wɩa nɛ kuoro.”

english_verse: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɔ Jerusalɛm kala ka ŋaa goŋ nɛ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ mɩɩra kɔ Zaayɔŋ, ba jaŋ naʋ arɩ ba sɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Má gbaara yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka Jerusalɛm jikpeeŋ lɛ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ laa Jerusalɛm nɩaa ta, aŋ nyagɛ ba nɩaa bɔyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ dagɛ ʋ doluŋ dɩ tinteyee kala na. Dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala nɩaa jaŋ na ŋɩɩ, la Wɩa sɩ laa ʋ nɩaa ta.

english_verse: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Má lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, má lɩɩ nɩmɛ! Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ chʋŋ Wɩa dɩa kɩaa. Má sɩ́ kʋŋkala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ digu. Má sɩ́ disiniŋ ŋaa hɛ ma tɩtɩa lɛ aŋ lɩɩ.

english_verse: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ pese lɩɩ, nʋʋ dee bɩ ma ka kiri. La TƖƖNA jaŋ hɛ ma sɩpaaŋ, Iziral Wɩa jaŋ hɛ ma harɩŋ a pɔma.

english_verse: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ tɩntɩnna jaŋ dii nyuŋ ʋ wɩaa kala lɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ jaŋ sii kɩŋkɛŋ, dɩ nɩaa zizilu woruŋ.

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yʋga a naʋ ba yaraa vɛŋ. Ʋ nagɩŋ kala bɩrɩmɛ arɩ nuhuobiiŋ dee.

english_verse: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
translation_verse: Ʋ wɩaa jaŋ teeli tinteyee kala, kuoroo niiriŋ jaŋ maa dɩ ba chɛ wɩɩ ka dɩ ba bʋl a tɩŋ ʋ wɩaa. Wɩalɩŋ ba ha sɩ bɩ na a bɩ nɩa ma, ba jaŋ naba a jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a laa wɩalɩŋ la sɩ bʋla a dii? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA kɛŋ ʋ doluŋ dagɛ?

english_verse: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩɩŋ lɛ nɛ ka ʋ tɩntɩnna wʋwaa, a nagɛ jɩnjaaŋ-bʋgʋŋ sɩ tɔsɔ lɩlɩɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩ tʋla kɛnɛ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nʋʋ bɩbagɩsʋ a kɔ ʋ teeŋ, kʋŋkala tuo ʋ lɛ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ la chou.

english_verse: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
translation_verse: Nuhuobiinee vɩaʋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba sɩɩŋ bɩ ʋ suo. Ʋ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔ-cheeŋ nɛ a mal hɛɛŋ. Nɩaa paala bɩ cho dɩ ba naʋ. Ba bɩ ʋ bene dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋŋkala, la lɩɩsɛ la jɩa ta ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: He suffered and endured great pain for us, but we thought his suffering was punishment from God.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ nɛ laa la nyanyalaa arɩ hɛɛ-la kala la sɩ na a chʋŋ. Ka la ha bɩɩnɛ arɩ hɛɛ-la ʋ sɩ na, Wɩa nɛ dɔgɩsʋ.

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: La kala nagɛ piesee sɩ yeŋŋe nɛ, la kʋŋkala joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa wombiiŋ. Hɛɛ-la la kala fa sɩ jaŋ na a tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA mɩɩra joŋo daŋ ʋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
translation_verse: Ba fa dɔgɩsʋ nɛ, ʋ na hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ, ama ʋ bɩ ʋ niiŋ suro. Ba fa kɛnʋ a nagɛ pie-bie nɛ a kaa mʋ dɩ ba kpʋ koo a nagɛ piese ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kɛ ʋ pʋna, ka ʋ tɔrɛ ʋ niiŋ, ʋ bɩ ʋ niiŋ suro.

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: Ba kɛnʋ nɛ a dɔgɩsʋ, a dii ʋ sarɩya, aŋ kɛnʋ mʋ kpʋ. Ʋ nɩaa tɩtɩa bɩ jɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ arɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ ʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: He wasn't dishonest or violent, but he was buried in a tomb among cruel, rich people.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ yuosu kala hɛ. Ʋ bɩra bɩ wɩaa ma nyɩɛ, ka ba kpʋʋ a hugu a nagɛ nɩbɔmʋŋ kɩaa tɩɩna bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA chonuŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ dɔgɩsʋ, a leŋ ʋ na hɛɛŋ. Ʋ sʋʋŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ sɩ leŋe La TƖƖNA joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛ la. Ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ duomi. Ʋ jaŋ na ʋ doho nɩaa. Ʋ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ to a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ cho.

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ-la ʋ sɩ na harɩŋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Ʋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ hɛɛ-la ʋ sɩ na bɩ pɛɩ ŋaa. Mɩ tɩntɩnna sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ laa nɩ-daŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta.

english_verse: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ pʋʋ dɩhɔnʋŋ nɩbalaa tʋɔŋ, ʋ jaŋ laa yɩrɩŋ aŋ kɛŋ doluŋ ma. Bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta nɛ a sʋʋ, a nagɛ ʋ ma ŋaa nɩbɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ laa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala chʋŋ a na hɛɛŋ, aŋ sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ joŋo chɛba.

english_verse: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Jerusalɛm, yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ. Ŋ fa nagɛ hapɩrɩŋ nɛ, ŋ bɩ bii kɛnɛ, ŋ fa ha paala bɩ ha-lʋllɩ luoruŋ wɩɩ na. Ama lɛɛlɛ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ biiriŋ yʋgɛ a kɩɩ haala sɩ kɛŋ bala.”

english_verse: Make your tents larger! Spread out the tent pegs; fasten them firmly.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ ŋ lɛbɩŋ jalla pɛ, a lɛrɛ ʋ patɩɩsamba arɩ ʋ ŋmɛsɩŋ ta ba lɩɩ harɩŋ, a leŋ dɩ ʋ daapɛ-biisiŋ kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
translation_verse: Ŋ tinteeŋ bʋa jaŋ jalla pɛ, a mʋ sɛmɛ na-kala. Ŋ doho nɩaa jaŋ laa tinteyee, a hɔŋ tasɩŋ sɩ pɩŋ jikpeeniŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ. Sɩ́ hɩɩsɩŋ fá, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ jolumuŋ. Hɩɩsɩ-la sɩ diiŋ ŋ hambiiriŋ lɛ, ŋ jaŋ yʋ ʋ wɩaa. Ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ liisi wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo to ŋ lɛ, ŋ fa sɩ ŋaa yo-haal.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaaŋ nɛ jaŋ nagɛ ŋ bala lɛɛlɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ ŋ TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋ Laataara. Ʋ nɛ dʋnɩa kala Wɩa.

english_verse: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
translation_verse: Ŋ fa nagɛ hatolo ʋ bala sɩ vɩa ta nɛ, ŋ tʋɔŋ chei kɩŋkɛŋ. Ama ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa yɩrɩŋ nɛ a bʋl,

english_verse: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
translation_verse: “Mɩ fa vɩaŋ ta mʋa nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ fá ŋ nenige woruŋ a kɛnɩŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
translation_verse: Mɩ fa na baanɩŋ nɛ woruŋ a joŋ harɩŋ yɩaŋ mʋa, ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ dagɛ mɩ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ a pɩŋ.” Ŋ Laataara sɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
translation_verse: “Nowa fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ bʋa-la lɛ, mɩ fa bʋla arɩ mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ lɩɩŋ bɩra kʋ dii dʋnɩa. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩŋ, arɩ mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ ŋ nyuŋ koo a dɔgʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Dɩ peelee nɛ jaŋ wuo jigisi, dɩ dundolluŋ churi ma, ama chono-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ arɩŋ na bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ jigise. Nii-la ma mɩ sɩ hɛ pɩŋ arɩ ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ bɩ jaŋ birigi. Mɩ-na Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ fá ŋ nisusuŋ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm, ŋ ŋaa taŋ-la sɩ chaasa na hɛɛŋ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ nyagɛ ŋ bɔyɛ. Mɩ jaŋ wasa saaŋ, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tabɩɩ-tʋlɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ takʋa arɩ safɩya a bil ŋ gentine.

english_verse: Your fortresses will be built of rubies, your gates of jewels, and your walls of gems.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tabɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ rubi a saa ŋ dɩɩ-duoruŋ, a kɛŋ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa a ŋaa ŋ boi-baalaa, aŋ kɛŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma saa kɛrɩsɩŋ a golluŋ chu.

english_verse: I will teach your children and make them successful.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ŋ TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ dagɛ ŋ biiriŋ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋla nɛ ŋ jaŋ kaa hɔŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɛrɛ jaŋ hɛ dɩ-bolii ŋ bɩ jaŋ fɩfá wɩɩkala. Fawʋllʋŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ, ŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ bol.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ hɛ nʋʋkala dɩ ʋ kʋ yuoŋ. Dɩ nɩa kala nɛ kɔ dɩ ba yuoŋ, ŋ jaŋ yuo diiba.”

english_verse: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Má bee na, mɩ-na nɛ ta libire ʋ yie libi laalɩyuori kɩaa ba kaa yuo laalɩŋ. Mɩ-na nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ yie kɛŋ laalɩyuori kɩalɩŋ ma a chichei leriŋ.

english_verse: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ joŋ laalɩyuori kʋŋkala a yuoŋ ma, ʋ bɩ ŋ lɛɛ dii. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ bʋl ŋ teeŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuoba. Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩ mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ ŋɩɩ, ba kaa yuo didii laalɩŋ.”

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Ma nɩalɩŋ kala lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ sɩ kɛnɛ, má kʋ nyʋa lɩɩŋ. Ma nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ moribiee kɛnɛ, má kʋ dii kɩaa. Má kʋ nyʋa tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ arɩ nayɩlɩŋ, ma bɩ jaŋ tiŋ kʋŋkala.

english_verse: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma chichei moribiee kɩalɩŋ sɩ tuo kʋdiilee lɛ, a lʋlɔl ma tɩtɩa kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ vɔgɩma lɛ? Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ woruŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ dii kʋdii-zɔŋŋɔɔ tɩtɩa a nɩɩ sɩma.

english_verse: Pay close attention! Come to me and live. I will promise you the eternal love and loyalty that I promised David.
translation_verse: Má jegile nɩɩ woruŋ a kɔ mɩ teeŋ, má nɩɩ woruŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ hɛ nii-la sɩ bɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ a choma arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ a nagɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ fa sɩ cho kuoro Devit.

english_verse: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa leŋe ʋ ŋaa nɩaa sɩpaalaarʋ nɛ a ŋaa laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ. Ʋ lɛ nɛ mɩ to a dagɛ mɩ doluŋ.

english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ tinteye-la nɩaa ma fa sɩ bɩ jɩŋ, ma jaŋ yɩrɛba hilimi. Tinteye-la nɩaa ma sɩ bɩ jɩŋ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ ma teeŋ, ba jaŋ fá a yʋasa kɔ ma teeŋ a tɩŋ yuŋ-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɩ joŋo pɩma wɩaa.”

english_verse: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
translation_verse: Má chɛ La TƖƖNA, ma jaŋ naʋ, lɛɛlɛ ʋ kpagɛma nɛ.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ, má leŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ma sɩɩ ŋaa, aŋ bɩrɩmɛ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa. Má mɩɩra kɔ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ, ʋ jaŋ fá ma nenige aŋ joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛma lɩma.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My thoughts and my ways are not like yours.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa naga, mɩ wombiee ma bɩ ma wombiee naga.”

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ pɛgɛ sɩ bolie ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ wombiee kɩɩ ma wombiee mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa ma kɩɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa.

english_verse: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
translation_verse: A nagɛ duonuŋ arɩ nyalɩŋ sɩ yie lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a kʋ tuu, a bɩ mɩɩraa jɩl ŋɩɩ, aŋ leŋ tinteeŋ fɩɛlɛ ŋɩɩ kɩaa nyʋ a waa a ŋaa kʋdoho ba duduu arɩ kʋdiilee nɩaa didii ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa ma nagɛ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ bʋlba ka dɩ ba ŋaa pɛɩ, see dɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla ŋaa.

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a vɛŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ. Peelee arɩ dundolluŋ kala jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a ŋaa goŋ ma sɩpaaŋ, ka dɩ baga tɩɩsɩŋ ma kala puporisi nɩsaa.

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Lere-la sɔsʋŋ sɩ nyʋ tɔ, bʋtʋnsʋŋ nɛ jaŋ mɩɩra nyʋ nɩmɛ. Lere-la sɩ jaŋ lugo tɔ kɩŋkɛŋ, chɛyɛɛ jaŋ mɩɩra nyʋ nɩmɛ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ ŋaa magɩl sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ, a liliisi wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa, ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ dɩsa.

english_verse: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Má to tɛŋɛ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ laa nɩaa ta kpaga nɛ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni, mɩ jaŋ dagɛ mɩ tʋɔpʋla lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩwogo kala nɛ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ mɛrɛ La TƖƖNA nɩaa lɛ, ʋ sɩ́ bɩɩnʋ arɩ La TƖƖNA jaŋ lɩɩsʋ ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ba-fere ma kala sɩ́ bɩɩnʋ arɩ ʋ sɩ bɩ bie wuo lʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ La TƖƖNA nɩaa tʋɔŋ wuo pɛ. Ʋ sɩ́ wɩaa gʋrʋmʋ a bʋl, “Mɩ ŋaa tɩɩ-hɩlɩɩ nɛ.”

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma yɩrɩŋ hɛ mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ dɩ nɩaa liliisu a kaa mʋ wuu, a kɩɩ ma fa sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ hantolibiisiŋ dɩ ba liliisi ma wɩaa. Ma yɩrɩŋ bɩ jaŋ lɛl.

english_verse: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Nɩwogusu-la sɩ joŋ ba tɩtɩa a mɛrɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA lɛ, a chomi a tɩma pɩpɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA a dɩdɛnnɛmɛ, a kɛŋ chɛ-wiesii-la wɩaa woruŋ, a bɩ ʋ wɩaa kaa sɩsɩɩ, aŋ tuto mɩ nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ mɩ nɩaa pɛgɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba mʋ mɩ peel-zɔŋ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ, a leŋ ba kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ ba sɩɩ chʋɔlɛmɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kɔ mɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ, mɩ jaŋ laa ba sʋla. Mɩ dɩa nɛ jaŋ ŋaa tinteyee kala Wɩa dɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ Iziral tɩmma-la ba sɩ kɛsɛ mʋ tintee-wogusuŋ mɩɩra kɔ ŋɩɩ, ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ ha jaŋ kɛsɛ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kʋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kɛsɛ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.” Wɩa bʋl nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ teeŋ

english_verse: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
translation_verse: Tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa kala má kɔ, má kɔ a nagɛ baga kɩaa a dii mɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ maga dɩ ba bibeŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ba nyʋlɩma nɛ. Ba bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ, ba nagɛ vasɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ aŋ bɩ huosi nɛ. Ba yie pɩŋ nɛ a duduosi. Ba cho doŋ-pɩnɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: Ba nagɛ vasɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ luobiiŋ kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ, ba yie dii kɩaa ba bɩ vɔgɛ. Ba ŋaa sɩpaalaaraa sɩ bɩ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ nɛ. Ba kʋŋkala yie ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ cho nɛ, a tuto ba dʋndʋŋa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_verse: Ba yie bʋl dɔŋɔ lɛ, “Má kɔ dɩ la nyʋa girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ. Má leŋ dɩ la nyʋa a vɔgɛ, aŋ yʋ chie wɩaa, chie ma jaŋ nagɛ jɩnɩŋ, koo a paala zɔmɔ kɩɩ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: God's faithful people are dragged off and killed, and no one even cares. Evil sweeps them away,
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna yie sʋʋ, ka nʋʋkala sɩpaaŋ tuo, ba bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ʋ sʋʋ. Ama tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna yie sʋʋ a fori wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ sʋba, ba yie na fɩɛlɩŋ nɛ, ba yie na wiese nɛ sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: Ama ma nɩaa deemba nagɛ vʋgʋraa, arɩ nɩlɩɩlɩŋ arɩ bachɔrʋmɔɔ arɩ hachɔrʋmɔɔ nɛ!

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ lɛ nɛ ma sisieri? Ma ŋaa nɩaa sɩ bɩ mɩ niiŋ ka sɛɩ nɛ, aŋ pɛ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛra ma.

english_verse: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
translation_verse: Ma yie ŋɩŋaa bachɔrʋŋ arɩ hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ-lugunuŋ tʋɔŋ, aŋ kɛsɛ ma biiriŋ ma a kpʋkpaarɛ vʋɩyaa lɩɩ-libisiŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ bʋ-kuloo nyuŋ.

english_verse: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?
translation_verse: Ma yie paa tabɩa-la sɩ ŋaa mʋla mʋla nɛ lɩɩ-libisi-la lɛ, ba ŋaa ma tɔŋŋɔɔ ma kpʋkpaarɛ. Ba teeŋ nɛ ma yie kɛŋ ma kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ma mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kala a mʋ. Ma bɩɩna wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ tɔrɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ?

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: Ma ŋaa ma dɩ-pɩnaa peelee sɩ leŋie nyusuŋ nɛ, a kpʋkpaarɛ ma tɔŋŋɔɔ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
translation_verse: Ma mɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a bil ma borusuŋ harɩŋ, aŋ vɩamɛ, a joŋ ma tɩtɩa yalla pɩ haala-la ma sɩ cho aŋ kɛmba pɩpɩŋ.

english_verse: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: Ma yie tɩsɛ olif nʋʋŋ arɩ tʋlaalɩɩba, a kaa mʋ kpʋkpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk. Ma yie tɩŋ nɩaa ba mʋ dɩ-boloo arɩ lere-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ a chɛ vesiŋ pɩma dɩ ma kpʋkpaarɛ.

english_verse: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
translation_verse: Maa lɔl ma tɩtɩa nɛ wɩaa deemba kala lɛ, aŋ bɩ chɛ ma leŋ, a tɩŋ ma sɩ cho vesiŋ kɩŋkɛŋ wɩaa a bɩɩnɛ ba jaŋ pɩma doluŋ.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ma fɩfá, a bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ, a bɩ mɩ wɩaa ka liisi? Mɩ sɩ tɔrɛ mɩ niiŋ a dieni kɩŋkɛŋ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ma bɩ mɩ ka fá koo?

english_verse: You think you're so good, but I'll point out the truth.
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna ma ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma nɛ, ama mɩ jaŋ wulli ma bʋbʋɔŋ kala.

english_verse: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ ŋmoo niiŋ a chɩchɛ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ma lɛ, má leŋ dɩ ma tɔmɔ-la laa ma ta yei! Peliŋ nɛ jaŋ paaba viiri. Ama nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laamɛ dii, a nʋʋra jʋʋmɛ, ba nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ tinteeŋ. Ba jaŋ hɛ mɩ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ.” La TƖƖNA jaŋ nyagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa hara dɩ ba chei wɩaa bɔyɛ

english_verse: The Lord says, “Clear the road! Get it ready for my people.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Má wasɛ wombiiŋ a leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ kʋŋkala kɛrɛ ba wombiiŋ.

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala a ŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Mɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Mɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ. Ama mɩ ha yie guoli nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri a bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ tʋɔŋ nɛ, a leŋ ba kɛŋ yɩɛlaa.

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ bʋbʋl ma teeŋ deeŋ deeŋ, koo a na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ wuu. Bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na nɛ ŋaa nuhuobiine, mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ chei dɩ ma yɩɛlaa kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
translation_verse: Ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ma tʋɔ-luŋuŋ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ fa na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ a dɔgɩsɛma, aŋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩama. Ka ma ha kɛŋ nyu-duo a tuto ma tʋɔtɔrɛ wombiee.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: Mɩ na wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ ŋaa nɛ, ama mɩ ha jaŋ vaarɛma. Mɩ jaŋ laa ma sɩpaaŋ a beŋ ma nyuŋ woruŋ, a nyagɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ yel bɔyɛ.

english_verse: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ yel Iziral lɛ yaraa fɩɛlɛ, dɩ ba suri ba niiŋ a dɛnnɛmɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dɩ-boloo arɩ dɩ kpagɩsɩŋ kala jaŋ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ vaarɛba.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩra sɩ, “Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ jaŋ na wiese mʋapɩlɩɩ ma.”

english_verse: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Chaasa suri ŋ yikoro dɩ ʋ sii wɩa-nyuŋ a nagɛ banyile a bʋla pɩ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, a leŋ ba jɩŋ arɩ ba vɩa mɩ niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-kala ba yie chʋɔlɛmɛ nɛ, a nagɛ ba ŋaa nɩaa sɩɩ chel dɩ ba jɩŋ mɩ wombiee nɛ, a bɩra nagɛ ba ŋaa tinteeŋ nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ nɛ, a bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba Wɩa sɩ daga ka vɩa. Ba yie pɩɛsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ dagɛba wombie-la sɩ zɔmɔ dɩ ba tuto, a nagɛ baa chel nɛ dɩ ba kpagɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ la yie vɔɔ niiŋ, a kɛŋ la tɩtɩa muuri ka La TƖƖNA bɩ laa tɔgʋmɛ?’ ” La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, bʋa-la ma sɩ yie vɔɔ niiŋ, ma yie ŋɩŋaa ma tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa nɛ, aŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛ ma tɩntɩnnaa.

english_verse: You even get angry and ready to fight. No wonder God won't listen to your prayers!
translation_verse: Ma yie vʋvɔɔ niiŋ, a yuyuo dɔŋɔ nɛ a ŋmuŋmoo dɔŋɔ. Ma bɩɩna nii-vɔɔ doho deeŋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ mɩ jegile nɩɩ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ?

english_verse: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ vɔɔ niiŋ, ma yie nagɛ maa dɔgɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa nɛ, a gʋrɛ nyusuŋ a nagɛ ŋɩɩ kʋlʋmaŋ arɩ fuolo-ŋmʋlba, a laalɛ ma tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ a ŋaa tʋɔrʋŋ bʋgɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ baa yɩrɛ niiŋ-vɔbʋŋ? Ma bɩɩna ŋɩɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ?

english_verse: I'll tell you what it really means to worship the Lord. Remove the chains of prisoners who are bound unjustly. Free those who are abused!
translation_verse: Nii-vɔbɩɩ-la doho mɩ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Má laa nɩalɩŋ wɩaa sɩ nyaga bil ba nɩna hɛɛŋ ta, a giri wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ, a laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa ka baa dɔgɩsɛba ta.

english_verse: Share your food with everyone who is hungry; share your home with the poor and homeless. Give clothes to those in need; don't turn away your relatives.
translation_verse: Má ŋaa ma kʋdiilee a pɩpɩ losumoo, aŋ pɛ summoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ dɩɩsɩŋ kɛnɛ lɛ dɩ ba na dɩjʋʋlaa. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ bɩ gɛrɩŋ kɛnɛ wɩaa, má pʋ gɛrɩŋ. Má sɩ́ ma naambiiriŋ vɩa ta, má pɩpɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ jaŋ chaana hɛ ma lɛ a nagɛ chʋchʋɔŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ. Wɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ nagɛ nyanyalaa ma lɛ, ba kala jaŋ lɛl, ka ma duori. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ a laama ta, mɩ tʋla jaŋ hɛ ma lɛ a pɔma.

english_verse: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ jegile nɩɩ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ bunso pɩmɛ, mɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ, dɩ ma nɛ bɩ nɩaa ka dɔgɩsɛ, a bɩ mɛl-bɔŋ kala doho kɛnɛ arɩ dɔŋɔ, a bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ka bʋl dɔŋɔba teeŋ,

english_verse: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
translation_verse: a pɩpɩ losumoo kʋdiilee, a leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nyaga bil ma na ba wʋchɛɛlɛɛ. Biriŋ-la sɩ gollima jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ, dɩ ma tɩtaŋɩŋ ma pʋllɛ a nagɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ pɔma bʋa na-kala lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ pɩma kʋzɔmɔ-la kala ma sɩɩ chɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ doluŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Ma jaŋ nagɛ lɩga ba sɩɩ mɩsɛ lɩɩŋ bʋa na-kala, a bɩra nagɛ lɩɩ-bul sɩɩŋ sɩ bɩ kɛrɛ.

english_verse: You will rebuild those houses left in ruins for years; you will be known as a builder and repairer of city walls and streets.
translation_verse: Ma nɩaa jaŋ paa ma jikpeeniŋ wasa saa, dɩ ba chɩŋ ba gentiŋ-bɩnaa lɛ. Nɩaa jaŋ yɩyɩrɛma nɩalɩŋ sɩ paa jikpeeniŋ kɛrɩsɩŋ arɩ dɩɩsɩŋ saa, dɩ nɩaa bɩra hɛ ma dɩ-jʋʋlaa lɛ.”

english_verse: But first, you must start respecting the Sabbath as a joyful day of worship. You must stop doing and saying whatever you please on this special day.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ mɩ chɛ-wiesii-la wɩaa woruŋ, a bɩ ma tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa ka ŋaa mɩ tapʋl-zɔŋ-la, dɩ ma nɛ cho mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA chɛ-wiesii-la a joŋu dɩ ʋ ŋaa tapʋl-zɔŋ dɩ ma zizilu a bɩ ma tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa harɩŋ ka to a bɩra bɩ wʋtɔɔnʋŋ maa bʋl chɛɛ-la,

english_verse: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: ma jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA teeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala zizilma. Ma jaŋ nɩɩ sɩma tintee-la lɛ mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩ ma naabalɩma Jekɔb. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
translation_verse: Má wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ kɛŋ ma pɔrɛ Wɩa lɛ, ma wʋcheelee nɛ leŋe ʋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩama, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ ma wɩɩkala nɩɩ.

english_verse: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.
translation_verse: Ma ŋaa nɩkpʋʋra nɛ, ma nɩsaa kala nɛ fo arɩ chalɩŋ. Ma ŋaa wʋnyɩɛra nɛ, a bʋbʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: You falsely accuse others and tell lies in court; sin and trouble are the names of your children.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ wɩaa dɩ-bʋlʋŋ, nʋʋkala bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ka bʋl. Ma yie nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ a laa kʋsɩŋŋaa, aŋ yigi ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa a hɛ wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: You eat the deadly eggs of poisonous snakes, and more snakes crawl out from the eggs left to hatch. You weave spider webs,
translation_verse: Ma wʋbɔmɔ-la ma sɩɩ ŋaa nagɛ dɩmɩŋ halaa nɛ ma ŋaa badɛrɛ chakʋʋrɩba tɔ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ dii hala-la kʋŋ, ʋ yie sʋʋ nɛ. Dɩ hala-la kʋŋ ma nɛ tiese, ʋ yie bɩrɩmɛ basɩŋkpɩaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: but you can't make clothes with those webs or hide behind them. You're sinful and brutal.
translation_verse: Ma badɛrɛ chakʋʋrɩba-la ma sɩ ŋaa, ba ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ ba bɩ jaŋ wuo pilime tɔ ma wʋbɔmɔ-la. Ma wɩɩkala ŋaa nɩbɔŋ wɩɩ nɛ, ma wʋŋaalaa kala ŋaa yuosuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
translation_verse: Maa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ, a kpʋkpʋ nɩaa sɩ bɩ wɩɩkala cheye. Ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala ŋaa kʋbɔmɔ nɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ lee-kala, ma yie chei nɩmɛ kala nɛ ʋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a hɔŋ fɩɛlɩŋ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ tuo ma wɩɩkala lɛ. Maa to wombie-la sɩ golibo nɛ. Nʋʋkala sɩɩ to wombii dosunu-la bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ na wiese.

english_verse: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
translation_verse: La bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ arɩ dɔŋɔ, la dɩ tʋɔpʋla pɛgɛ bolie. La yie chɩchɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ, aŋ bɩ na, aŋ vɩvɛŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
translation_verse: La nagɛ nyʋlɩma sɩ laarɛ jeeŋ a chɩchɛ wombiiŋ nɛ. La nagɛ nyʋlɩma nɛ, wɩɩhɛyɛ ma la yie gɛrɛ nɛ a titel. Nɩduoruŋ tʋɔŋ, la nagɛ nɩsʋʋnʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: We growl like bears and mourn like doves. We hope for justice and victory, but they escape us.
translation_verse: La yie hʋhʋʋnɛ a nagɛ lʋgʋmaa, a yiyel a nagɛ kokosuŋ. La yie chɩchɛ dɩ ba joŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ to la lɛ, aŋ bɩ na a chɩchɛ laatanɩŋ, ka ʋ bɩ la kpaga.

english_verse: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
translation_verse: La ŋaa wɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ a cheyiŋ, la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩla nɛ. La wʋcheelee daŋ la nyuŋ nɛ, la tɩtɩa jɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɛ.

english_verse: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, la vɩa ŋ niiŋ wɩaa nɛ a joŋ harɩŋ yɩa la Wɩa. La dɔgɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ woruŋ aŋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩaŋ. La tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala ŋaa kʋbɔmɔ nɛ, la nyɩnyɩɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.
translation_verse: La kiri wʋtɩtɩɩ ta nɛ la dɩ tʋɔpʋla ma pɛgɛ bol. La wɩaa dɩ-bʋlʋŋ kala wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛlɛ nɛ, ʋ bɩ mʋa ma ka.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔmɔ-la lɛ ma, ba yie kɛŋ nɩɩ-la bɩrɩmɛ dʋndɔŋ nɛ. La TƖƖNA sɩ na dɩ nɩalɩŋ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ tʋɔŋ kala chei.

english_verse: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ na dɩ nʋʋ tuo, wɩɩ-la kperu, nʋʋ sɩ tuo dɩ ʋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ dɔgɩsʋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa doluŋ a laaba ta, ʋ tʋɔpʋla lɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩba.

english_verse: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ ŋaa wɩaa magɛ ŋɩɩ chɩmɩŋ nɛ ʋ jaŋ joŋo timba, ʋ jaŋ na baanɩŋ a dɔgɩsɛ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, Ʋ jaŋ tiŋ nɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩ hɛ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu lɛ.

english_verse: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ jaŋ fɩfá La TƖƖNA nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ jaŋ zizilu, ʋ jaŋ kʋ tii paaba a nagɛ fuoŋ sɩ suo a pɩpɛllɛ koo pel-duoŋ.

english_verse: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Ma Laataara jaŋ kɔ Jerusalɛm, ʋ jaŋ kɔ Jekɔb doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ teeŋ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Jerusalɛm, sii chɩŋ a chaanɛ a nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ. La TƖƖNA tʋla chaana hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
translation_verse: Bee na, birimiŋ tɔ dʋnɩa nɛ, nɩaa hɛ biriŋ lim tʋɔŋ. Ama mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA tʋla chaana hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ, ŋ kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ gire kɔ ŋ pʋlʋŋ-la tʋɔŋ dɩ kuoroo kɔ tʋla-la ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ teeŋ.

english_verse: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
translation_verse: Beŋ leriŋ na, wɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa, ŋ nɩaa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ a kʋkɔ ŋ teeŋ. Ŋ hambolibiisi-la sɩ hɛ tintee-boloo lɛ ka kɔ nɛ. Ba paa ŋ toloo nɔgɛ nɛ a nagɛ hambiisiŋ a kaa kɔ.

english_verse: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ na ŋɩɩ, ŋ yaraa jaŋ fɩɛlɛ ba nyuŋ, ŋ tʋɔŋ kala jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ŋ jʋjʋɔsɛ. Ba jaŋ paa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ cholo dʋa a kaa kɔ ŋ teeŋ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ tinteyee nɩaa dʋa kʋ pɩŋ.

english_verse: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Bʋntaŋɩ-laalɩŋ jaŋ lɩɩ Midia arɩ Ɛfa tinteeŋ a kʋ su ŋ tinteeŋ kala. Ba jaŋ chʋŋ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a lɩɩ Sɛba tinteeŋ a kɔ, a dɩdɛnnɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛsɛ Kɛda piesee arɩ Nabayɔf pie-belli-la kala a hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a kaa kʋ pɩŋ, dɩ ŋ kpʋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ mɩ koru-la nyuŋ, dɩ mɩ laa ŋ sʋla. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la wasa kɛŋ tʋla.

english_verse: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛba ma nɛ file a kʋkɔ ŋ-la a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa koo a nagɛ kokosuŋ sɩ file mʋmʋ ba dɛllɩŋ leriŋ?

english_verse: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
translation_verse: Tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu nɩaa sɛnɛ ka gbɛrɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ. Lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ yʋga nɛ a laa sɩpaaŋ a lɩɩ Taasɩs kʋkɔ. Ŋ nɩaa sɩ hɛ dɩ-boloo nɛ ba paa kʋkɔ dɩa. Ba pɛ chʋŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ dɩ ba kaa kʋ zil mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ leŋe ŋ kɛŋ tʋla.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm, nɩwogusuŋ nɛ jaŋ paa ŋ jeyee wasa saa. Ba kuoroo ma jaŋ tɩma pɩpɩŋ. Mɩ fa na baanɩŋ nɛ a dɔgʋsʋŋ. Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ fá ŋ nenige a dagɩŋ mɩ zile.

english_verse: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
translation_verse: Ŋ boi-baalaa jaŋ suro chɩŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala, ba bɩ jaŋ tɔ, dɩ tinteyee kuoroo arɩ ba nɩaa kɛŋ ba dʋa kʋ jʋʋ pɩŋ.

english_verse: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Dɩ tintee koo kuoru-gentine nɩaa nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a bɩ sɛyɛ dɩ ba tɩma pɩpɩŋ, ba kala jaŋ sʋʋ dɛrɛ, ka dɩ ba tinteeŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛŋ tɩɩ-zɔmɔ-la sɩ hɛ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ, bʋtʋnsʋŋ, chɛrɛ arɩ kanchalaa kaa kʋ pɩŋ, ba daasɩŋ nɛ ba jaŋ kaa kpɩɛrɛ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba kpɩɛrɛ lee-la mɩ sɩɩ jʋʋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ tʋla.

english_verse: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ŋ dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ dɔgʋsʋŋ doho nɩaa jaŋ kʋ kpirimi ŋ sɩpaaŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛnɩŋ ŋmoo gbɛɛŋ jaŋ kʋ gbieni ŋ sɩpaaŋ. Ba jaŋ yɩyɩrɩŋ: ‘La TƖƖNA tabal-la, Zaayɔŋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ jaŋ.’

english_verse: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.
translation_verse: Nɩaa fa bɛrɩŋ nɛ woruŋ a vɩaŋ ta, nʋʋkala bɩŋ to a bɩbal. Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ zɔŋ dɩ nɩaa kɛnɩŋ ŋmuŋmoo bɔyɛ, a kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ ŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
translation_verse: Tinteyee arɩ ba kuoroo nɛ jaŋ dɩɛsɩŋ a nagɛ naaŋ sɩ yie dɩɛsɛ ʋ bie ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ-na ŋ TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa ŋ Laataara, Iziral tɩŋŋaa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ laaŋ ta.

english_verse: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ sɛlɩmɛ pɩŋ aŋ leŋ kɔlɩɩŋ, a joŋ hɔpʋla ma pɩŋ aŋ leŋ hɔ-bine, a joŋ kɔlɩɩŋ pɩŋ aŋ leŋ daasɩŋ, aŋ joŋ hɔ-bine pɩŋ aŋ leŋ tabɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beniŋ kɛnɩŋ hɔŋ sɔm, ŋ sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma.

english_verse: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
translation_verse: Yuosuŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ hɛ ŋ tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ koo a chei. Mɩ jaŋ chu tɔ ŋ lɛ a pɔŋ woruŋ a nagɛ je-kɛrɛ. Ŋ jaŋ dɛnnɛmɛ a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ laaŋ ta wɩaa.

english_verse: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
translation_verse: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dee bɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ koo chɛŋ-pʋla dee bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ, mɩ-na ŋ Tɩɩna nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ a kaa mʋ wuu ŋ Wɩa nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ tʋla.

english_verse: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
translation_verse: Ŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ, ŋ chɛnɛ ma bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ birimiŋ. Ŋ TƖƖNA nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Tʋɔ-chee-la kala ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ jaŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɩaa kala jaŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma, ba jaŋ tɩɩ tintee-la a kaa mʋ wuu. Ba nagɛ tɩɩsɩŋ mɩ sɩ chɔnsɔ nɛ, mɩ tɩntɩmɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ dɩ mɩ dagɛ mɩ doluŋ.

english_verse: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩa-la nɩaa sɩ paala bɩ yʋgɛ jaŋ kʋ ŋaa tintee bal a kɛŋ doluŋ. Mɩ-na nɛ ma TƖƖNA, dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, mɩ jaŋ guu ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala.”

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ Dɩma hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ summoo. Ʋ tɩmmɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ sɩ cheye kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, dɩ mɩ heele bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ, arɩ ba jaŋ jomba ta, aŋ chaarɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn,
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mɩ heeli arɩ jɩna-la ʋ-na La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ pɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ arɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ-na Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋ ʋ baanɩŋ a fɩɩsɛ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ yie nɛ, ʋ jaŋ nyagɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ yel bɔyɛ.

english_verse: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called “Trees of Justice,” planted by the Lord to honor his name.
translation_verse: Tʋɔ-chei-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ sɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba mɩɩra kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, dɩ tʋɔ-chei-la lɛl. Ba tʋɔŋ fa sɩ chei ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ mɩɩra yɩɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ yɩɩlaa. Ba kala jaŋ nagɛ tɩɩsɩŋ La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa sɩ chɔnsɔ. Ba jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ a leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: Then they will rebuild cities that have been in ruins for many generations.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ paa jikpee-bɩnɩa-la arɩ tasɩ-la kala sɩ pɩŋ jikpeeniŋ a dieni a wasa saa.

english_verse: They will hire foreigners to take care of their sheep and their vineyards.
translation_verse: Nʋhʋɔraa jaŋ dɩdaa ma pʋsʋŋ, nɩwogusuŋ jaŋ pɩpɛrɛ ma bagɩsɩŋ arɩ ma girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ a pɩpɩma.

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: Ma-na jaŋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, a ŋaa la Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa. Ma nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ tinteyee kala dʋa, a kɛŋ ba kɩalɩŋ ŋmuŋmoo bɔyɛ.

english_verse: They were terribly insulted and horribly mistreated; now they will be greatly blessed and joyful forever. The Lord Loves Justice
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa sɩ dii hɩɩsɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ nɩɩ sɩma kɩɩ ŋɩɩ bʋlɩa bʋlɩa ba tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba sɩ jolimiba ŋɩɩ, ba kpaalɩŋ jaŋ ŋaa bʋlɩa tintee-la lɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA cho wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ woruŋ, aŋ bɛrɛ gaarɩŋ arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ tiŋ mɩ nɩaa arɩ tʋɔpʋla aŋ bil nii-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ mɩ dɩ ba pɛgɛ.
