english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa doho jaŋ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ tinteyee tʋɔŋ, ba jaŋ zilba nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ naba jaŋ jɩŋ, dɩ ba ŋaa nɩa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ pɛ ba lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ nɛ woruŋ mɩ jʋjʋɔsɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa laatanɩŋ nagɛ gɛrɩŋ nɛ ʋ joŋo laalɛmɛ tʋɔpʋla ma nagɛ gɛrɩŋ ʋ joŋo kpɩɛrɛmɛ, a nagɛ ha-falɩŋ bala sɩ kpɩɛrɛ ʋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ a bɩra nagɛ ba sɩ kpɩɛrɛ ha-falɩŋ,

english_verse: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.
translation_verse: a nagɛ kʋdoho sɩ yie nyʋ lɩɩ tinteeŋ a waa ŋɩɩ baga lɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ jaŋ laa ʋ nɩaa ta dɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala na a dɛnnʋ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ Jerusalɛm wɩaa mɩ bɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ mɩ niiŋ, a tɩŋ Zaayɔŋ wɩaa mɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa chɩm, see mɩ sɩ na dɩ ʋ tʋɔpʋla wɩaa chaana a nagɛ taŋ sɩ pʋla, dɩ ʋ laatanɩŋ wɩaa ma lɩɩ sɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ na ŋ tʋɔpʋla-la, dɩ ba kuoroo ma kala na ŋ tʋla. Ba jaŋ hɛ yɩrɩ-falɩŋ pɩŋ. La TƖƖNA nɛ jaŋ hɛ yɩrɩ-la pɩŋ.

english_verse: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ nagɛ kuoru nyunchuulo-la sɩ kɛŋ tʋla La TƖƖNA teeŋ, a nagɛ kuori nyu-bɛlɛ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: A nagɛ bapʋɔsʋŋ sɩ yie jaa hatolo ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋ biiriŋ jaŋ kʋ laa ŋ tinteeŋ a tɩɩ. Wɩa tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ ŋ nyuŋ a nagɛ baala tʋɔŋ sɩ yie tɔrɛ ʋ ha-falɩŋ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm, mɩ leŋe nɩaa nɛ sagɛ ŋ je-kɛrɩsɩŋ nyuŋ a pʋpɔŋ. Ba bɩ maga dɩ ba tɔrɛ ba niiŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ koo tɩtaŋɩŋ. Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɩrɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ, má sɩ́ wiesu.

english_verse: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ La TƖƖNA ma wiesi, see dɩ ʋ leŋe dɩ Jerusalɛm chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ, dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ dʋnɩa kala lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ lɛ, ʋ chaasa ŋmɩɛsɛ nɛ, ʋ doluŋ lɛ ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ laa ma kʋdiilee didii nɩwogusuŋ bɩ jaŋ laa ma girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ nyʋnyʋa, ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ lɔlɔ pɩba.

english_verse: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ duu kɩaa a ŋaa didii aŋ dɛnnɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ma nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ tɔrɛ girep nɛnɛɛ jaŋ nyʋa ba sɩnɩŋ mɩ-na Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kaalɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
translation_verse: Ma Jerusalɛm tɩmma, má suri ma boi-baalaa, má wasɛ wombiiŋ bil nɩaa lɛ. Má pori dɩ ʋ jal, má kɛŋ tabɩaa kala paa ta, aŋ kɛŋ jɔnjɔŋ je dɩ tinteyee nɩaa na.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA heele bʋla pɩ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala nɛ a bʋl, “Má bʋla pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa arɩ ba Laataara ka kɔ nɛ dɩ ʋ laa ba ta. Ʋ pɛ kori kʋ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ kaa kʋ timba nɛ. Ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ʋ sɩ laa ta nɩɩ kɔ.”

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ yɩrɛma, “Tʋɔpʋl tɩmma, nɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ laa ta. Ba jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ Jerusalɛm Wɩa ta-chooluŋ, Tabal-la Wɩa sɩ bɩ vɩa ta.”

english_verse: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nɩa deeŋ sɩ laalɛ gɛnnɩŋ kʋfɩɛsɩŋ wurisi a lɩɩ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bozira a hɛ Ɛdɔm lɛ kʋkɔ ŋɩɩ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ laalɛ gɛrɩ-duduoŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋla a tʋara kʋkɔ ŋɩɩ arɩ doluŋ? “Mɩ-na Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa arɩ tʋɔpʋla nɛ, a kɛŋ doluŋ a laa nɩaa tɩta.”

english_verse: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ gɛnnɩŋ fɩɛsɛ ŋɩɩ a nagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chɔŋ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ gɛnnɩŋ?

english_verse: “I alone trampled the grapes! None of the nations helped. I trampled nations in my anger and stained my clothes with their blood.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ chɔŋ tinteyee nɩaa nɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ chɔŋ girep nɛnɛɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ mɩ lɛ pɛ. Mɩ fa na baanɩŋ nɛ a chɔŋ tinteyee nɩaa, ba chalɩŋ wurisi mɩ gɛnnɩŋ, ba kala fɩɛsɛ ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ fɩɩsɛ mɩ nɩaa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, aŋ laa mɩ nɩaa ta jɩna-la yie nɛ.

english_verse: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ bene mɩ bɩ nʋʋkala na dɩ ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, ʋ fa kperimi nɛ nʋʋ sɩ tuo dɩ ʋ chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ. Ama mɩ sɩ na baanɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ leŋe mɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a yuo dii.

english_verse: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
translation_verse: Mɩ na baanɩŋ nɛ a leŋ tinteyee nɩaa kala bugumi, mɩ chɔmba, ba chalɩŋ jaasɛ tinteeŋ.” Wɩa dɛnnɩŋ arɩ Wɩa chʋɔlʋŋ

english_verse: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ faasa cho nɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnʋ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa pɩ la Iziral tɩŋŋaa wɩaa. Ʋ chaasa ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ yʋgɛ nɛ pɩla. La TƖƖNA fá la nenige nɛ a dagɛla ʋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
translation_verse: Ʋ fa sɩ, “Ba ŋaa mɩ nɩaa nɛ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ laaba ta.

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba tʋɔŋ nɛ cheye, ʋ ma tʋɔŋ yie chei nɛ. La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ chɩŋ ba harɩŋ a laaba ta. Ʋ choba nɛ, a fá ba nenige a laaba ta. Bumbuŋ kala, ʋ chaasa beŋ ba nyuŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: Ka ba vɩa ʋ niiŋ, aŋ ŋaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ tʋɔŋ chei. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩrɩmɛ ba dʋndɔŋ a tɩtɩa sii chɩŋ ba lɛ a yuoba.

english_verse: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ nɩaa liise mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Mosis arɩ ʋ nɩaa fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, a pɩɛsɛ: Nɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna-la fa sɩ kɛŋ ʋ nɩaa arɩ ba sɩpaalaaraa to mʋga tʋɔŋ a lɩɩ hɛ? Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ leŋe ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ?

english_verse: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ ʋ doluŋ a pɩ Mosis, ʋ leŋ mʋga-la fa sɩ pɩŋ ba sɩpaaŋ kpaa balɩa, dɩ ʋ laa yɩrɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ a pɩ ʋ tɩtɩa,

english_verse: He led his people across like horses running wild without stumbling.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ nɩaa chol mʋgʋ-luŋii-la, a nagɛ jaaba sɩɩ fá pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ a bɩ kʋŋkala gɛrɛ,

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: a nagɛ ba sɩ yie daa nɛsɩŋ kaa mʋ fuonaaŋ ba dii ya-fɩɛlɩŋ aŋ pɩnaa wiesi ŋɩɩ, ŋ Dɩma pɩ ŋ nɩaa wiese nɛ. Ŋ-la nɛ ŋ beŋ ŋ nɩaa nyuŋ a laa yɩrɩ-bal-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ kɛŋ tʋla nɛ woruŋ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ a hɔŋ ŋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. Gʋra bee na wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa la lɛ. Ŋɩɩ ŋ fa sɩ chɩl la wɩaa mʋ nɩɩ nɛ? Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ dol-la hɛ? Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ chono-la ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ a fɩfá nɩaa nenige mʋ? Sɩ́ la vɩa ta.

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ la nyɩmma. La naabalɩma, Abɩraham bɩ la jɩŋ, Jekɔb vɩa la ta nɛ. Ŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA arɩ la nyɩmma. Bumbuŋ kala ŋ nɛ la Laataara.

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ leŋ la yeŋŋi ŋ wombiee lɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ ŋaa la kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a bɩra bɩŋ ka fá? Laala, a tɩŋ la sɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnaa arɩ ŋ nɩaa wɩaa.

english_verse: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
translation_verse: La-na ŋ nɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ŋ dɩɩ-zɔŋ-la, ama la bɩ diene ka la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kʋ ŋmoo ʋ kala lo.

english_verse: Rip the heavens apart! Come down, Lord; make the mountains tremble.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, kɛŋ wɩa-nyuŋ bɛgɛ ta aŋ kʋ tuu, dɩ peelee kala chichel ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kʋ tuu, ba jaŋ chel ŋ sɩpaaŋ a nagɛ ba sɩ chɔ lɩɩŋ ʋ wuwulimi. Kʋ tuu a dagɛ ŋ doluŋ dɩ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jɩmɩŋ, aŋ ŋaa dɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala chichel ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Your fearsome deeds have completely amazed us; even the mountains shake when you come down.
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ, la fa bɩŋ yɩɛla ka ŋ kʋ ŋaa wɩaa sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ, peelee kala chichel ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ, wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ chɛ, ŋ yie pɛ ba lɛ nɛ. Ŋ fa na baanɩŋ nɛ la nyuŋ, a tɩŋ la sɩ vɩa ŋ niiŋ wɩaa, aŋ ha ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ɛɛ nɛ saa la jaŋ wuo ŋaa, dɩ ŋ laala ta?

english_verse: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
translation_verse: La kala ŋaa disiŋ tɩmma nɛ. La tʋɔpʋl wʋŋaalaa kala nagɛ gɛrɩkɔsʋmɔɔ sɩ kɛŋ nyɛsɩŋ nɛ. La wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ leŋe la nagɛ pɩpaarɩŋ sɩ hɩla nɛ, peliŋ lu a paala viiri.

english_verse: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.
translation_verse: La kʋŋkala bɩŋ ka chʋɔlɛ nʋʋkala bɩŋ bee chɛ dɩ ŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ. La wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ leŋe ŋ joŋ harɩŋ a yɩala nɛ a vɩala ta.

english_verse: You, Lord, are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ la nyɩmma, la nagɛ chʋrʋŋ nɛ, ŋ ma nɛ pupo-mɛɛrɛ, ŋ nɛ mɛ la kala.

english_verse: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, sɩ́ faasa na baanɩŋ la nyuŋ a kieli, sɩ́ la wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa liisu a kaa mʋ wuu. Jaaŋ jaaŋ, fá la nenige. La kala ŋaa ŋ nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Every one of your towns has turned into a desert, especially Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋ tasɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nagɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ nɛ. Jerusalɛm paala nagɛ jikpeeŋ nɛ, Zaayɔŋ pɩŋ hoi.

english_verse: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: La Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la fa sɩ kɛŋ tʋla a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, lee-la la naabalɩmaba fa sɩɩ dɛnnɩŋ kala nɛ ba nyɩgɛ, la dɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɛ ba chei.

english_verse: When you see these things, how can you just sit there and make us suffer more?
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, wɩaa deemba kala harɩŋ ŋ jaŋ vɩa dɩ ŋ pɛ la lɛɛ? Ŋ sɛnɛ jaŋ tɔrɛ ŋ niiŋ, ka dɩ la nɩna hɛɛŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ?

english_verse: I, the Lord, was ready to answer even those who were not asking and to be found by those who were not searching. To a nation that refused to worship me, I said, “Here I am!”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ mɩ wɩaa pɩɛsa, mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa a dagɛba nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ mɩ bee chɩchɛ, ba ma namɛ nɛ. Mɩ bʋla pɩ tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ mɩ ka chʋɔlɛ: ‘Má namɛ, mɩ hɛ daha.’

english_verse: They keep making me angry by sneering at me, while offering sacrifices to idols in gardens and burning incense to them on bricks.
translation_verse: Ba yie chaasa ŋaa wɩaa nɛ mɩ sɩɩŋ lɛ a leŋ mɩ baanɩŋ sisii bʋa na-kala. Ba yie kpʋkpaarɛ vʋɩyaa ŋmaŋkaanɩŋ lɛ, a nyɩnyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ vʋɩyaa korunuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋɩŋ ba yie mʋ hɔŋ vaamaa tʋɔŋ a bɛrɛ doŋ a yɩyɩrɛ lɛlɛɛ. Ba yie chɩchaŋ tooŋ nammɩa aŋ nyʋnyʋa vʋɩyaa nammɩa yomuŋ.

english_verse: And then they say to others, “Don't come near us! We're dedicated to God.” Such people are like smoke, irritating my nose all day.
translation_verse: Ba yie bʋl nɩaa lɛ, ‘Má sɩ́ la kʋ kpagɛ, la ŋaa nɩaa sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ arɩ ma sɩ jaŋ digila.’ Mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo sɛɩ pɩ nɩdosunuŋ deemba, ba wʋŋaalaa nagɛ nyʋɔsʋŋ sɩɩ jʋʋ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, a ŋaa nyiŋ sɩɩ dii tapʋl piliŋ.

english_verse: I have written this down; I won't keep silent. I'll pay them back just as their sins deserve.
translation_verse: Mɩ paala kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa ba lɛ hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a bil, mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛba, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a magɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make them pay for their sins and for those of their ancestors— they have disgraced me by burning incense on mountains.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ ma naabalɩmaba arɩ ma tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala wɩaa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Ba nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ nɛ peelee arɩ dundolluŋ kala nyuŋ a jolimimi. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a magɛ ba faafaa wʋbɔmɔ-la ba fa sɩ ŋaa cheimi.”

english_verse: Here is what the Lord says: A cluster of grapes that produces wine is worth keeping! So, because of my servants, I won't destroy everyone.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “A nagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ ha sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ nɩaa pɔ dɩ ba sɩ́ pʋra ta ŋɩɩ, a tɩŋ ba chie sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa sɩnɩŋ wɩaa, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa lɛ mɩ bɩ jaŋ chei ba kala.

english_verse: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral arɩ Juda doho nɩaa pʋŋa pɛ a tɩɩ mɩ tintee-la sɩ kɛŋ peelee. Ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa, ba ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa, ba nɛ jaŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: My people will worship me. Then the coastlands of Sharon and the land as far as Achor Valley will turn into pastureland where cattle and sheep will feed and rest.
translation_verse: Sarɔŋ tinteeŋ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tomi pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diiliŋ, dɩ Akɔ fuonaaŋ ma bɩrɩmɛ lee ba sɩ jaŋ pɩna wiesi.

english_verse: What will I, the Lord, do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call “Good Luck” and “Fate”?
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ vɩa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA a yʋ mɩ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ wɩaa, aŋ kpʋkpaarɛ vesi-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ‘Nyu-sɩŋ’ arɩ ‘Wɩɩ-dagɩŋ’,

english_verse: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.
translation_verse: mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma wɩɩ-dagɩŋ ŋaa laalɩŋ sɩ jʋʋma. Ba jaŋ kpʋ ma kala, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ sɩ yɩrɛma, ma bɩ sɛyɛ. Mɩ sɩ bʋl wɩaa ma teeŋ, ma bɩ jegile nɩɩ, aŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bɩ cho mɩ sɩɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wɩɩ-la mɩ-na Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ tɩntɩnnaa jaŋ na kɩaa didii, ka dɩ ma-na kɛŋ losuŋ. Ba jaŋ na lɩɩŋ nyʋnyʋa, ka dɩ ma-na kɛŋ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ. Mɩ tɩntɩnnaa jaŋ jʋjʋɔsɛ, ka dɩ ma-na dii hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩntɩnnaa tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ba yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa, ka dɩ ma tʋɔŋ faasa chei dɩ ma ŋmuŋmoo niiŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
translation_verse: Ma yɩrɩŋ jaŋ ŋaa ŋmɩaŋ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa teeŋ. Mɩ-na Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ jaŋ kpʋma, ama mɩ jaŋ hɛ yɩrɩ-falɩŋ a pɩ mɩ tɩntɩnnaa-na.

english_verse: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted. The Lord's New Creation
translation_verse: Tintee-la lɛ, dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ Wɩa pɛ ʋ lɛ, mɩ-na Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ ʋ jaŋ yɩrɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ ta niiŋ ma tintee-la lɛ, mɩ-na Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ ʋ jaŋ yɩrɛ. Mɩ jaŋ yʋ faafaa wʋwalɩmɩa-la kala ba jaŋ lɛl mɩ sɩaa lɛ. Wɩa-nyuŋ kʋfalɩŋ arɩ tintee-falɩŋ

english_verse: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ma bee na, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ kʋfalɩŋ arɩ tintee-falɩŋ. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ liisi bumbuŋ wɩalɩŋ fa sɩ ŋaa, ba wɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ mɩ nyuŋ kɔ.

english_verse: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ mɩ nɩaa nyuŋ. Nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ baa ŋmoo niiŋ koo a yiyel nɩmɛ.

english_verse: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
translation_verse: Bii-mulo kala bɩra bɩ jaŋ buuro sʋʋ nɩmɛ dɩ ʋ ha bɩ waa, nɩhɩaŋ kala bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ sʋba dɩ bʋa-la sɩ maga ʋ sʋʋ nɛ bɩ yie. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ yi jɩsɩŋ zɔlɔ aŋ sʋʋ, nɩaa jaŋ joŋu arɩ ʋ ŋaa bapʋɔsɩɩ nɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ wuo yi jɩsɩŋ zɔlɔ, ŋɩɩ-na ŋmɩaŋ nɛ dii tɩɩna.

english_verse: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ saa dɩɩsɩŋ a tɩtɩa jʋjʋʋ, a bil girep bagɩsɩŋ ma a didii ba nɛnɛɛ.

english_verse: No one will take away their homes or vineyards. My chosen people will live to be as old as trees, and they will enjoy what they have earned.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ saa dɩɩsɩŋ, dɩ nɩtanɩa jʋjʋʋ, koo a bil girep bagɩsɩŋ dɩ nɩtanɩa dii ba nɛnɛɛ. A nagɛ tɩa sɩ yie dieni ŋɩɩ aŋ-na sʋʋ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ nɩaa ma jaŋ dieni. Nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa jaŋ dii ba tɩtɩa suoluŋ a dieni.

english_verse: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ jaŋ lɔlɔ tɩta pɛɩ, koo a lʋl ba biiriŋ dɩ ba cheŋ naabɔmʋŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ pɛ ba dɩ ba doho nɩaa lɛ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Guŋguro arɩ pie-bie jaŋ pɛ dɔŋɔ a didii kɩaa. Naachigiŋ jaŋ didii yaŋ a nagɛ nɛŋ. Dɩmɩŋ ma jaŋ didii hagɩla. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ koo a chei dɔŋɔ mɩ peel-zɔŋ-la nyuŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ mɩ kuoru kpasa, ka tinteeŋ ma ŋaa mɩ naasɩŋ dɩ-daŋɩŋ. Nɩɩ nɛ dɩa ma sɩ jaŋ saa pɩmɛ hɛ? Mɩ dɩ-wiesiŋ hɛ nɩɩ?

english_verse: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
translation_verse: Kɩaa deemba kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, mɩ dee bɩ ŋaa?” La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Nɩɩ-la nyuŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɔ nɛ ŋ-la: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa muuri, a leŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ faasa chei ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, a kɛŋ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: You sacrifice oxen to me, and you commit murder; you sacrifice lambs to me and dogs to other gods; you offer grain to me and pigs' blood to idols; you burn incense to me and praise your idols. You have made your own choice to do these disgusting things that you enjoy so much.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa harɩŋ, a cho wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kɩsʋ mɩ teeŋ, dɩ ba kʋŋ nɛ kpʋ nɛ-bele a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, ʋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ kpʋ nuhuobiine nɛ. Koo dɩ ʋ nɛ kpʋ pie-pɔrʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, ʋ nagɛ vaha baŋŋaa ʋ sɩ boro nɛ. Ba kʋŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ma, ʋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ kɛŋ tooŋ chalɩŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ ma, ʋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ kpaarɛ vʋɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most. The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ dolie a ŋaa ba lɛ, a lɛrɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ fá, a kʋ hɛ ba lɛ. Bɛɛ wɩaa, mɩ sɩ yɩrɛba, ba kʋŋ bɩ sɛyɛ. Mɩ sɩ bʋl wɩaa ma ba teeŋ, ba kʋŋ bɩ jegile nɩɩ. Ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bɩ cho nɛ mɩ sɩɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: If you tremble when the Lord speaks, listen to what he says: “Some of your own people hate and reject you because of me. They make fun and say, ‘Let the Lord show his power! Let us see him make you truly happy.’ But those who say these things will be terribly ashamed.”
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to La TƖƖNA niiŋ, má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla. La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Ma naambiiri-la sɩ bɛrɛma, a lɩɩsɛma ta a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ to mɩ wɩaa, a sieri ma lɛ a bʋl, ‘Má leŋ dɩ ma TƖƖNA dagɛ ʋ doluŋ a laama ta yei, dɩ la na dɩ ma hɛ sɩma tʋɔŋ,’ hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ diiba.

english_verse: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.
translation_verse: Má nɩɩ dɔmɔ-la sɩɩ dɔŋ tabalɩŋ lɛ, a nɩɩ goŋ-la sɩɩ ŋaa mɩ-na dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ joŋ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ wʋŋaalaa chɩmɩŋ titiŋ ba lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Have you ever heard of a woman who gave birth to a child before having labor pains?
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm nagɛ hapuugo sɩ bɩ hɛɛŋ na, aŋ lʋl hambolibie nɛ. Ʋ luoruŋ yie ŋaa dɩ ʋ wɩɩ dɩ ʋ lʋla.

english_verse: Who ever heard of such a thing or imagined it could happen? Can a nation be born in a day or come to life in a second? Jerusalem is like a mother who gave birth to her children as soon as she was in labor.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ha nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ doho? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ha na ŋɩɩ aŋ ka? Tinteeŋ nɩaa jaŋ wuo sii chɛ-bala a hɛ nɩmɛɛ? Tinteeŋ jaŋ wuo guu saa? Ama ŋɩɩ nɛ saa Zaayɔŋ nagɛ: Ʋ luoruŋ bɩ jaŋ wɩɩ ka dɩ ʋ lʋl ʋ biiriŋ chɛ-bala.”

english_verse: The Lord is the one who makes birth possible. And he will see that Zion has many more children. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa pɩɛsa nɛ, “Mɩ biiriŋ lʋlʋŋ yie nɛ, ka mɩ vɩa dɩ mɩ lʋl? Mɩ jaŋ wuo tɔ mɩ lʋlla a sɩ́ lʋl, mɩ nɛ sɩ leŋe nɩaa lʋlʋl?

english_verse: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ cho Jerusalɛm, má pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ jʋɔsɛ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Má pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ma jʋɔsɛ woruŋ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yel ʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: She will nurse and comfort you, just like your own mother, until you are satisfied. You will fully enjoy her wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ dii ʋ kɩaa a vɔgɛ woruŋ ʋ jaŋ dɩɛsɛma a nagɛ naaŋ sɩɩ dɩɛsɛ ʋ bie dɩ ma nɩɩ ʋ kʋ-daŋ-la sɩma.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised: “I will flood Jerusalem with the wealth of nations and make the city prosper. Zion will nurse you at her breast, carry you in her arms, and hold you in her lap.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, a nagɛ fuoŋ lɩɩŋ sɩ bɩ hʋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tinteyee dʋa kala ŋaa ʋ kɩaa a su leriŋ a nagɛ fuoŋ lɩɩŋ sɩ suo a pɛllɛ lɩlɩɩ. Ʋ jaŋ dɩɛsɛma a nagɛ naaŋ sɩ yie dɩɛsɛ ʋ bie ŋɩɩ a paama kori a jomma holli ʋ naasɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa, ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ma jʋjʋɔsɛ a jigi a nagɛ yaŋ sɩ tɔsɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA ka pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɛɩ ʋ niiŋ lɛ nɛ, aŋ yie dagɛ ʋ baanɩŋ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will come down like a whirlwind with his flaming chariots. He will be furiously angry and punish his enemies with fire.
translation_verse: Má bee na, La TƖƖNA ka kɔ nɛ arɩ nyiniŋ, ʋ janɩŋ torukoba kala nagɛ pel-vinvilimiŋ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ chaasa na baanɩŋ a joŋ nyiŋgeliŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ nyuŋ ʋ baanɩŋ sɩ sie.

english_verse: The Lord's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people. A Threat and a Promise
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛŋ nyiniŋ arɩ tokobiiŋ a dii nɩaa sarɩya. Nɩ-daŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ kpʋ.

english_verse: Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ joŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ vʋɩyaa kpaarɩŋ lɛ, a to dɔŋɔ jʋʋ lɩgɩsɩ-la tʋɔŋ ba sɩɩ kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa a chɩchaŋ toonuŋ arɩ taatɩaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩɩ kɩsʋ, ba kala dɩdɛrɩŋ ka kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa arɩ ba wɩɩkala nɛ. Bʋa-la yie nɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tinteyee sɩɩ bʋl yikori doho na-kala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba na mɩ tʋla.

english_verse: by proving what I can do. I will send the survivors to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Meshech, Tubal, Javan, and to the distant islands. I will send them to announce my wonderful glory to nations that have never heard about me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bil magɩlɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ba nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ ka a mʋ tintee-wogusuŋ arɩ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollu chu a ha bɩ mɩ wɩaa arɩ mɩ yɩrɩŋ nɩa, a bɩ mɩ doluŋ ma na. Tinteye-la nɛ ŋ-la: Taasɩs, Libiya arɩ Lidiya tɩmma-la sɩ jɩŋ toŋ yuonuŋ, Giriisi arɩ Tubal nɩaa. Ba jaŋ leŋ dɩ tinteye-la jɩŋ mɩ doluŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛŋ ma naambiiri-la kala sɩ hɛ tinteye-la lɛ a kɔ mɩ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ a hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, dɩ ba nagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩaa mɩ teeŋ. Ba jaŋ paaba hɛ janɩŋ, janɩŋ torukoba, kakusuŋ arɩ ba torukoba arɩ bʋntaŋŋaba lɛ nɛ a kaa kɔ. Ba jaŋ kɛmba kɔ a nagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ yie joŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ mɩaa a hɛ gbansɩ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ a kɔ la TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ tʋɔsɛ ba dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, ka dɩ dɔnsʋŋ ma pɛ tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Levi doho nɩaa sɩɩ tɩŋ mɩ dɩɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ.

english_verse: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.
translation_verse: Tintee-falɩɩ-la arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋfalɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ba hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma doho nɩaa arɩ ma yɩrɩŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ.” La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Chɛŋ-falɩɩ na-kala arɩ chɛ-wiesii na-kala, nuhuobiiŋ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ jaŋ kʋ kpirimi mɩ sɩpaaŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a zilmi.

english_verse: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ lɩɩ dɩ-jalɩŋ, ba jaŋ na nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ vɩa mɩ niiŋ dɩ ba sʋʋ pɩŋ pɩŋ. Nanchʋɔla-la sɩɩ diiba bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ. Nyiŋ-la ma sɩ diiba bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ dɩsa. Ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ jaŋ lɔrɛ a pɩ nuhuobiinee kala.”

english_verse: My name is Jeremiah. I am a priest, and my father Hilkiah and everyone else in my family are from Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. This book contains the things that the Lord told me to say.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Hɩlɩkaaya nanʋala Jɛrɩmaaya sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la. Ʋ fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɔŋɔ nɛ, a lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Anatɔf sɩ hɛ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah,
translation_verse: Amɔŋ nanʋala Josaaya sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ batori tʋɔŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA fa bʋl wɩaa a pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya.

english_verse: and he continued to speak to me during the rule of Josiah's son Jehoiakim. The last time the Lord spoke to me was in the fifth month of the eleventh year that Josiah's son Zedekiah was king. That was also when the people of Jerusalem were taken away as prisoners. The Lord Chooses Jeremiah
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, ʋ fa bɩra bʋl wɩaa a pʋ bʋa-la lɛ Josaaya nanʋala Jehoyakim sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ. Ʋ ha bʋl wɩaa pʋpʋ nɛ a mʋ yi Josaaya nanʋala Zedikaaya sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ kʋbala chɛŋ-nɔŋ tʋɔŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ ba fa kɛsɛ Jerusalɛm nɩaa mʋ yoŋ-baga. La TƖƖNA yɩrɛ Jɛrɩmaaya

english_verse: “Jeremiah, I am your Creator, and before you were born, I chose you to speak for me to the nations.”
translation_verse: “Ka dɩ mɩ-na ŋaaŋ a hɛ ŋ naaŋ luoruŋ tʋɔŋ, mɩ jɩmɩŋ nɛ. Ka dɩ ba-na lʋlʋŋ, mɩ lɩɩsɩŋ nɛ a leŋ ŋ ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ a pɩ tinteyee nɩaa.”

english_verse: I replied, “I'm not a good speaker, Lord, and I'm too young.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Ou, La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, mɩ bɩ wɩaa bʋlʋŋ jɩŋ. Mɩ ha ŋaa hambie nɛ.”

english_verse: “Don't say you're too young,” the Lord answered. “If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word!
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Sɩ́ bʋl, arɩ ŋ ŋaa hambie nɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ tɩmɩŋ nʋʋkala teeŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ŋ mʋ nɛ a bʋl wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ sɩ ŋ bʋl.

english_verse: I promise to be with you and keep you safe, so don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ba fá, mɩ hɛ ŋ teeŋ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ laaŋ ta ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, “I am giving you the words to say,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ a digi mɩ niiŋ lɛ, aŋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Lɛɛlɛ mɩ joŋ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa a hɛ ŋ niiŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: and I am sending you with authority to speak to the nations for me. You will tell them of doom and destruction, and of rising and rebuilding again.”
translation_verse: Jɩnɩŋ, mɩ lɩɩsɩŋ nɛ a leŋ ŋ kɛŋ doluŋ tinteyee arɩ kuoroo tinteyee lɛ, dɩ ŋ wuo churiba a yigiba lo, dɩ ŋ wuo cheiba a yuo diiba, dɩ ŋ wuo saaba a leŋ dɩ ba chɩŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Jɛrɩmaaya, bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ na?” Mɩ bʋl, “Mɩ na fʋfʋlʋŋ naakeliŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: “That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Ŋ sɛnɛ na woruŋ nɛ. Mɩɩ beŋ nɛ dɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla kʋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ na?” Mɩ bʋl, “Mɩ na pupoiŋ arɩ lɩɩŋ sɩ chɔ nyiniŋ nyuŋ a wuwulimi wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ, a kpile hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will pour out destruction all over the land.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Wʋlɔrʋŋ jaŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa a kʋ jʋʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: Just watch while I send for the kings of the north. They will attack and capture Jerusalem and other towns, then set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ mɩ yɩrɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩaa nɛ. Ba kuoroo jaŋ kɔ a bil ba kuoru kpasɩnɩŋ Jerusalɛm boi-baalaa niiŋ. Ba jaŋ golli ma kɛrɛsɩŋ chu a yuo Juda tasɩŋ kala. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I will punish my people, because they are guilty of turning from me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dii mɩ nɩaa sarɩya a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Ba vɩamɛ nɛ, aŋ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ vesiŋ a kpʋkpaarɛ vʋɩyaa ba tɩtɩa sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a mʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ a pɩba. Sɩ́ ba fá, ŋɩɩ dee mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ ba sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: My power will make you strong like a fortress or a column of iron or a wall of bronze. You will oppose all of Judah, including its kings and leaders, its priests and people.
translation_verse: Jɩnɩŋ, mɩ leŋe ŋ nagɛ tabalɩŋ ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli nɛ. Ŋ nagɛ hɔɔŋ jebiiŋ nɛ, a nagɛ kɔlɩɩŋ kɛrɛ a chɩŋ Juda tinteeŋ kuoru balaa, ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ ʋ nɩaa kala lɛ.

english_verse: They will fight back, but they won't win. I, the Lord, give my word— I won't let them harm you.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ yuoŋ, ama ba bɩ jaŋ wuo yuo diiŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa, mɩ hɛ ŋ teeŋ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ laaŋ ta ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The Lord told me
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: to go to Jerusalem and tell everyone that he had said: When you were my young bride, you loved me and followed me through the barren desert.
translation_verse: “Mʋ heele bʋla pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala, mɩ liise yi ŋɩɩ ma fa sɩɩ to mɩ nɛ ma hambiriŋ lɛ. Ma fa chomi nɛ woruŋ a nagɛ nɩa sɩ cho ʋ ha-falɩŋ ŋɩɩ, a to mɩ harɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, gɩrɩpɩrɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: and I, the Lord, will speak. I was never unfair to your ancestors, but they left me and became worthless by following worthless idols.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa chei ma naabalɩmaba, ba vɩamɛ a leŋ la pɛgɛ bol? Ba to vʋɩyaa sɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩba harɩŋ nɛ a ma kʋ ŋaa nɩpɛɩba.

english_verse: Your ancestors refused to ask for my help, though I had rescued them from Egypt and led them through a treacherous, barren desert, where no one lives or dares to travel.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ pɩɛsa chɛmɛ a bʋl, ‘Nɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA hɛ?’ Nɩɩ-la sɩ laala ta Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ a kɛnla lɩɩ, a vɛŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ tʋɔŋ. Tintee-la fa ŋaa tintee-hɩlɩɩ nɛ, a kɛŋ buotuonuŋ sɩ luŋie. Duonuŋ bɩ nɩmɛ ka nɩɩ, lee-la sɩ bire, nʋʋkala bɩ nɩmɛ ka vɛŋ. Nʋʋkala ma bɩ lee-la hɔnɔ.

english_verse: The priests who teach my laws don't care to know me. Your leaders rebel against me; your prophets give messages from Baal and worship false gods. The Lord Accuses His People
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩ pɩɛsaa chɛmɛ, a bʋl, ‘Nɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA hɛ?’ Nɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba dagɛ nɩaa wombii-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto, bɩ mɩ jɩŋ. Sɩpaalaaraa ma vɩa mɩ niiŋ nɛ. Mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa ma mɩɩra bʋbʋl wɩaa vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal yɩrɩŋ lɛ, aa to vʋɩyaa sɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩba.

english_verse: of a crime that no nation has ever committed before. Just ask anyone, anywhere, from the eastern deserts to the islands in the west.
translation_verse: Má mʋ tintee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Saapʋrɔs sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ lɩɩŋ gollo chu, koo ma tɩŋ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tintee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɛda a bee na dɩ ba ha ŋaa wʋdosunuŋ deemba kʋŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: You will find that no nation has ever abandoned its gods even though they were false. I am the true and glorious God, but you have rejected me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Tintee-kala nɩaa tuo a vɩa ba vesiŋ aŋ mɩɩra tuto veŋ-wogo. Ama mɩ nɩaa-na joŋ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la mɩ sɩ laa pɩba, a mɩɩra pɩ vʋɩyaa sɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩba nɛ.

english_verse: You, my people, have sinned in two ways— you have rejected me, the source of life-giving water, and you've tried to collect water in cracked and leaking pits dug in the ground.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ balɩa nɛ mɩ nɩaa ŋaa. Mɩ nɩɩ pɩba mɩɩsɩŋ a nagɛ lɩɩ-bulo, ka ba vɩamɛ, aŋ lu ba tɩtɩa vilee, vil-kpaarɩŋ lɩɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tʋɔŋ wuo chɩŋ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you weren't born slaves; you were captured in war.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩ nɩa kala tɩntɩnna ŋaa, ba bɩ yoŋ-biiriŋ ma ŋaa. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo kɛsɛba viiri?

english_verse: Soldiers from the Egyptian towns of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skulls.
translation_verse: Memfis arɩ Tapanhɛs baalaa fʋŋ ma nyu-gbansɩŋ nɛ a hɛ ma hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: It's all your own fault! You stopped following me, the Lord your God,
translation_verse: Ma nɛ lɛrɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ kʋ hɛ ma tɩtɩa lɛ, ma sɩ vɩa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ nɛ fa kɛmma vɩvɛŋ.

english_verse: Your own sins will punish you, because it was a bitter mistake for you to reject me without fear of punishment. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ma tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ jaŋ gʋra diima. Ma sɩ mɩɩrɛ mɩ harɩŋ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma laa cheeriŋ. Lɛɛlɛ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, a ŋaa wʋtɔɔ, ma sɩ vɩamɛ a bɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa ka fá. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Long ago you left me and broke all ties between us, refusing to be my servant. Now you worship other gods by having sex on hilltops or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Faafaa kala nɛ ma vɩamɛ a bɩ mɩɩ to. Ma fa sɩ, ‘La bɩ jaŋ tɩma pɩŋ.’ Dundolo kala nyuŋ arɩ tɩɩ-lugu kala bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ ma kpʋkpaarɛ vesiŋ.

english_verse: You were a choice grapevine, but you have become a wild, useless vine. Israel Is Stained with Guilt
translation_verse: Mɩ fa leŋe ma chɩŋ nɛ a nagɛ girep tɩa naakeliŋ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ ba kere chɔnsɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma mɩɩra chɩŋ mɩ lɛ a nagɛ girep tɩa sɩ yalɩba a bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ?

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Israel, you are stained with guilt, and no soap or bleach can wash it away.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ paala kɛŋ sɛhɩyɛ arɩ chɛnfɛnnɛɛ yʋgɛ a fo ma tɩtɩa ma, mɩ haa na ma cheeriŋ sɩ hɛ ma lɛ nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: You deny your sins and say, “We aren't unclean. We haven't worshiped Baal.” But think about what you do in Hinnom Valley. You run back and forth like young camels, as you rush to worship one idol after another.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ saa ma jaŋ wuo bʋl, ‘La bɩ disiniŋ ŋaa chei la tɩtɩa, la bɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal kpaara?’ Má beŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa fuonaaŋ lɛ. Má kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa bɩɩna na. Ma nagɛ bʋntaŋŋɩ-nɩɩŋ sɩ gɔllɔ fá a chɩchɛ belliŋ dɩ ba jɩlʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Your shoes are worn out, and your throat is parched from running here and there to worship foreign gods. “Stop!” I shouted, but you replied, “No! I love those gods too much.”
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ fá dɩ ma naasɩŋ dii dɛrɛ, dɩ ma yikorusuŋ ma hɩl. Ama, ma fa sɩ, ‘La bɩ jaŋ wuo mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ, la cho tintee-wogusuŋ vesiŋ nɛ. La jaŋ to ba harɩŋ.’

english_verse: You and your leaders are more disgraceful than thieves— you and your kings, your priests and prophets
translation_verse: A nagɛ ba sɩ yie kɛŋ gaara hɩɩsɩŋ kɛnʋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ba kuoru-balaa, ba tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, ba Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ ba Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa kala.

english_verse: worship stone idols and sacred poles as if they had created you and had given you life. You have rejected me, but when you're in trouble, you cry to me for help.
translation_verse: Ba yie bʋla pɩ tɩa, ‘Ŋ nɛ ŋaa la nyɩmma,’ a bʋla pɩ tabɩɩŋ ma, ‘Ŋ nɛ ŋaa la naaŋ.’ Ba joŋ ba harɩŋ yɩamɛ nɛ, ba sɩpaaŋ tuo mɩ lɛ. Ama dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋba, ba yie bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Kʋ laala ta.’

english_verse: Go cry to the gods you made! There should be enough of them to save you, because Judah has as many gods as it has towns. Israel Rebels against the Lord
translation_verse: Nɩɩ nɛ vesi-la ma sɩ ŋaa pɩ ma tɩtɩa hɛ? Má leŋ dɩ ba kʋ laama ta dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋma, bɛɛ wɩaa ma kɛŋ vesiŋ yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ a nagɛ Juda tasɩŋ sɩ yʋga ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Israel: You accuse me of not saving you, but I say you have rebelled.
translation_verse: Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma kɛŋ dɩ ma bʋl mɩ teeŋ? Ma kala vɩamɛ nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I tried punishing you, but you refused to come back to me, and like fierce lions you killed my prophets.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa dɔgɩsɛ ma nɩaa nɛ a chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ kɛmba tʋra kɩɩ nɛ, ama ŋɩɩ ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ. Ba fa bɩ mɩ teeŋ jegile nɩɩ, aŋ kpʋ ma Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa a nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩ hoso a kpʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: Now listen to what I say! Did I abandon you in the desert or surround you with darkness? You are my people, yet you have told me, “We'll do what we want, and we refuse to worship you!”
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ pɩɛsɛma: Mɩ wɩaa hɛyɛ ma teeŋ a nagɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ wɩaa sɩ hɛyɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ, koo mɩ wɩaa lɔrɛ ma teeŋ a nagɛ birimiŋ wɩaa sɩ lɔrɔ ŋɩɩ nɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma bʋl: La laa la tɩtɩa nɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ la gɔllɔ ta jɩa, a bɩra bɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ ŋ teeŋ?

english_verse: A bride could not forget to wear her jewelry to her wedding, but you have forgotten me day after day.
translation_verse: Hatolo jaŋ wuo yʋ ʋ yaraa kpɩɛraa lɛɛ, koo ha-falɩŋ jaŋ wuo yʋ ʋ ha-fal-gɛrɩŋ laalɩŋ? Ama mɩ nɩaa paala yʋ mɩ wɩaa nɛ a dieni.

english_verse: You are so clever at finding lovers that you could give lessons to a prostitute.
translation_verse: Ma chaasa jɩŋ baalaa chɛnɩŋ nɛ woruŋ. Hachɔrʋŋ wajɩa ma tɩtɩa jaŋ wuo gʋnnɛ wɩaa ma teeŋ.

english_verse: You killed innocent people for no reason at all. And even though their blood can be seen on your clothes,
translation_verse: Ma gɛnnɩŋ kala nɛ suo arɩ summo-la sɩ bɩ wɩɩkala cheye chalɩŋ, ka ma bɩ ba na dɩ ba bori ma dɩɩsɩŋ jʋjʋʋ.

english_verse: you claim to be innocent, and you want me to stop being angry with you. So I'll take you to court, and we'll see who is right.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala lɛ ma ha yie bʋl, ‘La bɩ wɩɩkala cheye, La TƖƖNA bɩ baanɩŋ na la nyuŋ.’ Mɩ ha jaŋ dii ma sarɩya a dɔgɩsɛma, a tɩŋ ma sɩ sɩ, ‘La bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa.’

english_verse: and you will leave in great sadness. I won't let you find help from those you trust.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ paa ma nɩsaa chʋŋ ma nyuŋ lɛ a lɩɩ tinteeŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA vɩa nɩalɩŋ lɛ ma sɩ joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ nɛ. Ba bɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to the people of Israel: If a divorced woman marries, can her first husband ever marry her again? No, because this would pollute the land. But you have more gods than a prostitute has lovers. Why should I take you back?
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA pɩɛsa, “Dɩ baal nɛ vɩa ʋ haala, dɩ haal-la lɩɩ mʋ jaa baal dɔŋ, baal-la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ vɩaʋ maga dɩ ʋ bɩra mʋ chɩchɛ haal-la nɛɛ? Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba tinteeŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ? Ama ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ hachɔrʋŋ nɛ, a kɛŋ hɩɩlaba yʋgɛ, aŋ lɛɛlɛ chɩchɛ dɩ ma mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Just try to find one hilltop where you haven't gone to worship other gods by having sex. You sat beside the road like a robber in ambush, except you offered yourself to every passerby. Your sins of unfaithfulness have polluted the land.
translation_verse: Má beŋ dundol kpʋlaa nyuŋ na, lee hɛ nɩmɛ ma sɩ bɩ wʋchɔrʋmɔɔ ŋaa? Ma yie hɔŋ wombiiŋ sɛmɛ nɛ a gbɩgbɛrɛ ma hɩɩlaba. Ma nagɛ nɩaa sɩ gɔllɔɔ baarɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ma ŋaa wʋchɔrʋmɔɔ arɩ tʋɔhɛɩ wɩaa a leŋ tintee-la kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, refused to let the spring rains fall. But just like a prostitute, you still have no shame for what you have done.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ kɛrɛ duonuŋ ŋɩɩ, a pɔ dɩ duoŋ-puso sɩ́ nɩɩ. Ama ma paala nagɛ hachɔrʋŋ nɛ, a bɩ hɩɩsɩŋ ka fá.

english_verse: you beg me to stop being angry, but you won't stop sinning. The Lord Asks Israel To Come Back to Him
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ na baanɩŋ la nyuŋ bʋa na-kalaa? Ŋ baanɩŋ jaŋ sii la nyuŋ a kaa mʋ wuu?’ Ŋ-la nɛ ma yie bʋl wɩaa, ama ma yie ŋaa wʋbɔŋ na-kala ma sɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa nɛ.” Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ

english_verse: When Josiah was king, the Lord said: Jeremiah, the kingdom of Israel was like an unfaithful wife who became a prostitute on the hilltops and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Josaaya sɩ dii kuoruŋ nɛ La Tɩɩna pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Ŋ na wɩɩ-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ sɩ ŋaa nɛɛ? Ba mʋ dundolo kala sɩ leŋie nyuŋ nɛ, arɩ tɩɩ-lugu na-kala bʋbʋɔŋ a ŋaa wʋchɔrʋmɔɔ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: I knew that the kingdom of Israel had been unfaithful and committed many sins, yet I still hoped she might come back to me. But she didn't, so I divorced her and sent her away. Her sister, the kingdom of Judah, saw what happened, but she wasn't worried in the least, and I watched her become unfaithful like her sister.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ teŋ-la mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsa a vɩvɩa Iziral mɩ sɩ jaa, ka ʋ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ a pʋ nɛ aŋ kiru ta, a tɩŋ wʋchɔrʋmɔ-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Ama ʋ naambie Juda ma fa sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ bɩ fawʋllʋŋ fá, aŋ ma mʋ ŋaa wʋchɔrʋmɔ-la tɩtɩa.

english_verse: The kingdom of Judah wasn't sorry for being a prostitute, and she didn't care that she had made both herself and the land unclean by worshiping idols of stone and wood.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ bɩ wʋchɔrʋmɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ joŋo dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋɩɩ, ba kpʋkpaarɛ tabɩaa arɩ tɩɩsɩŋ a ŋaa disiniŋ a hɛ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, shout toward the north: Israel, I am your Lord— come back to me! You were unfaithful and made me furious, but I am merciful, and so I will forgive you.
translation_verse: Mʋ heele bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ, ‘Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ, La TƖƖNA sɩ má mɩɩra kɔ. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ sɩaa chei ma nyuŋ, mɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: You are unfaithful children, but you belong to me. Come home! I'll take one or two of you from each town and clan and bring you to Zion.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ, “Ma ŋaa nɩaa sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ nɛ, má mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma bala. Mɩ jaŋ bagɩsa lɩɩsɛ nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nɩbala taŋ kala lɛ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ nɩaa balɩa ma nyɩŋ-nɩaa tʋɔŋ a kɛmba kaa kɔ Zaayɔŋ.

english_verse: Then I'll appoint wise rulers who will obey me, and they will care for you like shepherds.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ pɩma sɩpaalaara-la mɩ tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɛ ba nyuŋ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔsʋŋ a bibemma.

english_verse: The whole city of Jerusalem will be my throne. All nations will come here to worship me, and they will no longer follow their stubborn, evil hearts.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ba jaŋ yɩrɛ Jerusalɛm La Tɩɩna kuoru kpasa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tinteyee nɩaa kala jaŋ kɔ Jerusalɛm a zil mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ tuto ba nyuduoŋ arɩ ba tʋɔbɔmʋŋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: Then, in countries to the north, you people of Judah and Israel will be reunited, and you will return to the land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Juda nɩaa jaŋ mʋ pɛ Iziral nɩaa lɛ. Ba kala jaŋ to dɔŋɔ a lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa tintee-la a kɔ tintee-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩ ma naabalɩmaba ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.”

english_verse: I have always wanted to treat you as my children and give you the best land, the most beautiful on earth. I wanted you to call me “Father” and not turn from me.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na tɩtɩa nɛ fa sɩ, “Mɩ tʋɔŋ fa jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ mɩ kɛmma a nagɛ mɩ biiriŋ, a joŋ tinteeŋ sɩ zɔmɔ woruŋ a pɩma. Tintee-la nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ tintee kala dʋnɩa lɛ. Mɩ fa bɩɩna ma jaŋ kɛmmɛ yɩrɛ ‘Ma Nyɩmma’, aŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ mɩɩrɛ mɩ harɩŋ.

english_verse: But instead, you are like a wife who broke her wedding vows. You have been unfaithful to me. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People Confess Their Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ama a nagɛ haala sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ ʋ bala teeŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma-na Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Listen to the noise on the hilltops! It's the people of Israel, weeping and begging me to answer their prayers. They forgot about me and chose the wrong path.
translation_verse: Nɩaa nɩɩ yel dundol kpʋlaa nyuŋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩɩ yel ŋɩɩ aŋ sʋsʋl dɩ mɩ joŋo chɛba, bɛɛ wɩaa ba yʋ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩaa nɛ a vɩa mɩ wombiiŋ.

english_verse: I will tell them, “Come back, and I will cure you of your unfaithfulness.” They will answer, “We will come back, because you are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ma ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ nɛ, má mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ vaarɛma a leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.” Nɩalɩŋ jaŋ bʋl, “La jaŋ kɔ ŋ teeŋ, ŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: On hilltops, we worshiped idols and made loud noises, but it was all for nothing— only you can save us.
translation_verse: Goŋ-la kala la sɩɩ ŋaa dundolluŋ nyuŋ arɩ peelee nyuŋ a kpʋkpaarɛ vʋɩyaa, laa nyɩsɛ la tɩtɩa nɛ. La TƖƖNA Wɩa dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ wuo laa Iziral ta.

english_verse: Since the days of our ancestors when our nation was young, that shameful god Baal has taken our crops and livestock, our sons and daughters.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ la hambiriŋ kala lɛ a kaa kɔ, vʋɩyaa sɩ ŋaa hɩɩsɩ kɩaa dii la naabalɩmaba lɔlʋŋ kala a ta nɛ: ba piesee, nɛsɩŋ, ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ hantolibiisiŋ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, if you really want to come back to me, get rid of those disgusting idols.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Iziral tɩmma, dɩ ma nɛ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ, má mɩɩra kɔ. Dɩ ma nɛ joŋ ma vʋɩya-la mɩ sɩɩ kɩsʋ ta a bɩra bɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ leŋe ma yeŋŋi ka to,

english_verse: Make promises only in my name, and do what you promise! Then all nations will praise me, and I will bless them.
translation_verse: aŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ arɩ tʋɔpʋla a ŋmɩɛsɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ weye, ŋɩɩ na, tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ pɛ ba ma lɛ, dɩ nɩaa kala jʋjʋɔsɛ mɩ teeŋ.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem and Judah, don't be so stubborn! Your hearts have become hard, like unplowed ground where thornbushes grow.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ bʋla a pɩ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: “Má pɛrɛ ma tinteye-la ma ha sɩ bɩ pɛrɛ, aŋ pʋpɔ má sɩ́ ma kʋdoho joŋo duu hɛ sɔsʋŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: With all your hearts, keep the agreement I made with you. But if you are stubborn and keep on sinning, my anger will burn like a fire that cannot be put out. Disaster Is Coming The Lord said: *
translation_verse: Má joŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Má Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa, má pʋllɛ ma tʋɔŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, mɩ baanɩŋ jaŋ sii ma nyuŋ a nagɛ nyiniŋ a diima a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ma sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Dɩ nyiŋ-la nɩɩ diima, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩsʋ. Wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ jaŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ kɔ

english_verse: An army will come out, like a lion from its den. It will destroy nations and leave your towns empty and in ruins.”
translation_verse: Naachigiŋ sii ʋ dɩpɩnɩŋ nɛ a kʋ lɩɩ. Kʋ-la sɩɩ chei tinteyee sie nɛ. Ʋ lɩɩ ʋ leriŋ nɛ a kɔ dɩ ʋ chei ma tinteeŋ. Ma tasɩŋ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeniŋ, nɩaa jaŋ tuo ba lɛ.

english_verse: Then I told the people of Israel, “Put on sackcloth! Mourn and cry out, ‘The Lord is still angry with us.’ ”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ a ta jembiee yel woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA baaŋ-la sɩ faasa sii la nyuŋ ha bɩ fɩɛla.

english_verse: The Lord said, “When all this happens, the king and his officials, the prophets and the priests will be shocked and terrified.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Tapʋlɩɩ-la, kuoru-balɩŋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ nandaasɩŋ jaŋ yʋɔrɛ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tʋɔŋ jaŋ vɩɩŋɛ. Mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa ma niiree jaŋ maa.”

english_verse: I said, “You are the Lord God. So why have you fooled everyone, especially the people of Jerusalem? Why did you promise peace, when a knife is at our throats?” The Coming Disaster
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Aa, La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ŋ chaasa nyɩsɛ nɩaa deemba arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala nɛ ŋ fa sɩ sɩ, ‘Má jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ,’ ka tokobiiŋ pɛsɛ ba yikorusuŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Look! The enemy army swoops down like an eagle; their cavalry and chariots race faster than storm clouds blown by the wind.” Then you will answer, “We are doomed!”
translation_verse: Má bee na, dʋndɔmɔ ka kɔ nɛ a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa, ʋ janɩŋ torukoba ka kɔ nɛ a nagɛ pel-vinvilimiŋ, ka ʋ janɩŋ naasɩŋ lɩma kɩɩ kachuunuŋ sɩɩ fil. Wɩɩŋ puula, la dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But Jerusalem, there is still time for you to be saved. Wash the evil from your hearts and stop making sinful plans,
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm nɩaa, má chɛsɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ ta, ka dɩ La TƖƖNA laama ta. Ɛɛ nɛ maa chɛ dɩ ma laa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ a diene magɛ?

english_verse: before a message of disaster arrives from the hills of Ephraim and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ nɛ heelee bʋl wɩaa Daŋ tinteeŋ lɛ, wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ sɩ jaŋ kɔ wɩaa nɛ ʋ heele bʋbʋl Efirem tinteeŋ dundolluŋ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Tell the nations that my people have rebelled against me. And so an army will come from far away to surround Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ golli Jerusalɛm ma chu a nagɛ nɩaa sɩ chɩna pɔ baga nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɩaa vɩa La TƖƖNA nɛ. La Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: “People of Judah, your hearts will be in pain, but it's your own fault that you will be punished.” Jeremiah's Vision of the Coming Punishment
translation_verse: Ma tɩtɩa mɛlɛ arɩ ma wʋŋaalaa nɛ lɛrɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ kʋ hɛ ma lɛ. Ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ faasa hɛɩ nɛ. Ʋ wɩɩ jʋʋ kɛŋ ma chʋbagɩlɩŋ-buguluŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: I can't stand the pain! My heart pounds, as I twist and turn in agony. I hear the signal trumpet and the battle cry of the enemy, and I cannot be silent.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ na hɛɛŋ nɛ, hɛɛŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ mɩ mɩmɩlɩmɛ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ cheye. Mɩ bɔyɛ ka joŋ nɛ, mɩ bɩ mɩ niiŋ wuo tɔrɛ. Mɩ nɩɩ banyile ba sɩ ŋmʋa nɛ. Mɩ nɩɩ laalɩyuori goŋ-la ma ba sɩ ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: I see the enemy defeating us time after time, leaving everything in ruins. Even my own home is destroyed in a moment.
translation_verse: Wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la lɩa aŋ ka pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Tintee-la kala pɩŋ jikpeeniŋ nɛ. Ba guu chei mɩ lɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ, a kɩɛsɛ ba patɩɩsamba kala muno muno.

english_verse: How long will I see enemy flags and hear their trumpets?
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ na laalɩŋ sɩ hoso, aŋ pɛ nɩɩ ba sɩɩ ŋmʋʋ banyile ma a diene magɛ?

english_verse: I heard the Lord say, “My people ignore me. They are foolish children who do not understand that they will be punished. All they know is how to sin.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ nɩaa yaara nɛ, ba bɩ mɩ jɩŋ. Ba ŋaa hambii chʋʋlʋ nɛ, ba bɩ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ. Ba kaasɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ nɛ woruŋ, ama ba bɩ wʋzɔmʋŋ ŋaanɩŋ jɩŋ.”

english_verse: After this, I looked around. The earth was barren, with no form of life. The sun, moon, and stars had disappeared.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ dʋnɩa, ʋ fa bɩ kʋŋkala naga, ʋ fa pɩŋ hoi nɛ. Mɩ sɩ beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ ma, ʋ pʋlʋmʋŋ kala nɛ lɛlɛ.

english_verse: no people could be seen, and all the birds had flown away.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ bene, mɩ bɩ nʋʋkala na. Diibiisiŋ ma kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ fa file viiri nɛ.

english_verse: Farmland had become a desert, and towns were in ruins. The Lord's fierce anger had done all of this. The Death of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ bene, tintee-la fa sɩ sɩma mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ tasɩŋ kala pɩŋ jikpeeniŋ nɛ, a tɩŋ la TƖƖNA sɩ na baanɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord said: I have made my decision, and I won't change my mind. This land will be destroyed, although not completely. The sky will turn dark, and the earth will mourn.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa jaŋ yel, dɩ wɩa-nyuŋ ma biri lim, bɛɛ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla, mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩrɩmɛ. Mɩ kɛŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ mɩ ŋaa nɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ.”

english_verse: Enemy cavalry and archers shout their battle cry. People run for their lives and try to find safety among trees and rocks. Every town is empty.
translation_verse: Dɩ ja-jɩllaa arɩ to-yuoroo nɛ kpɩa, taŋ kala nɩaa yie giŋ nɛ a fá lɩlɛl. Dɔnsʋŋ jʋʋ tɩɩ-lugunuŋ tʋɔŋ, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma fá jɩla jʋʋ bʋ-gɩraa tʋɔŋ. Ba yie fá vɩa tasɩ-la kala nɛ, nʋʋkala tuo ba lɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your land has been wiped out. But you act like a prostitute and try to win back your lovers, who now hate you. You can put on a red dress, gold jewelry, and eye shadow, but it's no use— your lovers are out to kill you!
translation_verse: Ŋ-na Jerusalɛm, ŋ nagɛ nʋʋ ba sɩ chei ʋ kala nɛ, bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ ŋɩŋaa? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ laalɛ gɛrɩ-fɩɛsɩŋ, a hɛ sɛlɩmɛ kpɩɛraa? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ tuuri ŋ sɩaa ŋŋgbensi? Ŋ magɩla kpɩɛrɛ ŋ tɩtɩa pɛɩ nɛ. Ŋ hɩɩlaba mɩɩsɩŋ fɩɩŋ nɛ. Baa chɛ ba lɩɩsɛ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I heard groaning and crying. Was it a woman giving birth to her first child? No, it was Jerusalem, gasping for breath and begging for help. “I'm dying!” she said. “They have murdered me.”
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩa dɩ baa ŋmoo niiŋ a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ lʋl ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ nɛ, a huunoo nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ lʋl ʋ ha-toli bie. Zaayɔŋ nɩaa nɛ ŋmoo niiŋ ŋɩɩ a wiesee puri, a tɩɛnɛ nɩsaa a bʋl, “Ou, mɩ sʋba. Ba jommi hɛ nɩkpʋʋraa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: “Search Jerusalem for honest people who try to be faithful. If you can find even one, I'll forgive the whole city.
translation_verse: La Tɩna sɩ, “Joŋ Jerusalɛm womporunuŋ kala gɔllɛ, beŋ ba kala lɛ fii a gollo bala na, nyilimi ba dɩ-hɔnɔɔ kala. Dɩ ŋ nɛ na nɩbala ma sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ a chɩchɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛ tabal-la nɩaa.

english_verse: I answered, “I know that you look for truth. You punished your people for their lies, but in spite of the pain, they became more stubborn and refused to turn back to you.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, wʋtɩtɩɩ dee ŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ naa? Ŋ ŋmooba nɛ, ama ʋ bɩ ba lɛ wɩa. Ŋ wʋrɩgɛba nɛ, ama ba bɩ ŋ dagɩŋ sɛyɛ. Ba leŋe ba nyuŋ dol nɛ a kɩɩ tabɩɩŋ, aŋ vɩa dɩ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then I thought to myself, “These common people act like fools, and they have never learned what the Lord their God demands of them.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa bʋl mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ: Nɩaa deemba ŋaa summo nɛ, ba ŋaa nɩyaara nɛ. Ba bɩ La Tɩɩna wombiiŋ jɩŋ. Ba bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ jɩŋ.

english_verse: So I'll go and talk to the leaders. They know what God demands.” But even they had decided not to obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ mʋ ba sɩpaalaaraa teeŋ, a bʋl wɩaa pɩba. Ba-na chaasa jɩŋ La TƖƖNA wombiiŋ nɛ. Ba jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ nɛ. Ama ba ma kala pɛ niiŋ nɛ a vɩamɛ a bɩ mɩɩ to.

english_verse: The people have rebelled and rejected the Lord too many times. So enemies will attack like lions from the forest or wolves from the desert. Those enemies will watch the towns of Judah, and like leopards they will tear to pieces whoever goes outside. Enemies Will Punish Judah The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, naachigiŋ jaŋ lɩɩ duuŋ tʋɔŋ a kʋ kpʋba. Guŋguro jaŋ lɩɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ a kʋ kɛmba pʋɔsɛ. Kpeye jaŋ faa kpagɛ ba tasɩŋ a gbɛrɛba, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kʋ lɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ kɛnʋ pʋɔsɛ. Ba chaasa vɩa La TƖƖNA nɛ, wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa chei yʋga nɛ.

english_verse: People of Judah, how can I forgive you? I gave you everything, but you abandoned me and worshiped idols. You men go to prostitutes and are unfaithful to your wives.
translation_verse: LA TƖƖNA sɩ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛma? Ma biiriŋ vɩamɛ nɛ aŋ ŋmɩŋmɩɛsɛ vesiŋ sɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩba. Mɩ pɩba kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ chɛ nɛ, ka ba ha ŋɩŋaa bachɔrʋŋ wɩaa, a yie pʋɔla mʋmʋ hachɔrʋmɔɔ dɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: You are no better than animals, and you always want sex with someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Ba nagɛ ja-bele ba sɩ dɩɛsa ʋ nɛrɛ nɛ, a cho haalaa, ba kʋŋkala yie hɩhɩɛnɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ haala pɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I will tell their enemies, “Go through my vineyard. Don't destroy the vines, but cut off the branches, because they are the people who don't belong to me.”
translation_verse: Má gɔllɛ ʋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ a cheiba, ama má sɩ́ ba kala chei gbelem gbelem. Má keri ba naakelee ta, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩaa deemba bɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩaa ŋaa.

english_verse: In every way, Judah and Israel have been unfaithful to me. *
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Juda nɩaa chaasa bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ mʋa ma kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Their prophets lie and say, “The Lord won't punish us. We will have peace and plenty of food.”
translation_verse: Ba nyɩɛ wɩaa a tɩgɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ nɛ. Ba sɩ, “Ʋ bɩ jaŋ ŋaala wɩɩkala. Wʋbɔŋ kala bɩ jaŋ ŋaa la lɛ. Laalɩŋ koo losuŋ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋla.

english_verse: They tell these lies in my name, so now they will be killed in war or starve to death.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la wʋbʋlaa kala ŋaa peliŋ nɛ, ba bɩ wɩɩkala kɛnɛ. Ba wʋbʋlɩa-la jaŋ gʋra diiba.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful. Jeremiah, I will tell you exactly what to say. Your words will be a fire; Israel and Judah will be the fuel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “A tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ bʋl nagɛ nyiniŋ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma nagɛ daasɩŋ, dɩ wɩalɩŋ jomba dii.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I have made my decision. An army from a distant country will attack you. I've chosen an ancient nation, and you won't understand their language.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Ou, Iziral tɩmma, Mɩ kɛŋ tintee dɔŋ nɩaa nɛ a lɩɩ dɩ-bolii a kʋkɔ dɩ mɩ hɛ ma lɛ. Tintee-la nɩaa hɛ nɩmɛ faafaa kala nɛ a kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ. Ma bɩ ba yikoro jɩŋ. Ma bɩ ba wʋbʋlʋŋ ma ka nɩɩ.

english_verse: All of them are warriors, and their arrows bring death.
translation_verse: Ba bayuori kɩaa kɛŋ huoŋ nɛ woruŋ, ba kala ŋaa laalɩyuori wajɩaba nɛ a kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: This nation will eat your crops and livestock; they will leave no fruit on your vines or fig trees. And although you feel safe behind thick walls, your towns will be destroyed and your children killed. Israel Refused To Worship the Lord
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ chei ma kʋpɛrɛɛ arɩ ma kʋdiilee. Ba jaŋ kpʋ ma hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ma hantolibiisiŋ. Ba jaŋ kpʋ ma piesee arɩ ma nɛsɩŋ kala. Ba jaŋ keri ma girep tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ma tutogusuŋ ta. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ ba tokobiee a chei ma tabala-la ma sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli a joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, the enemy army won't kill everyone in Judah.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Tapʋlɩa-la lɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ kpʋ ma kala.

english_verse: And the people who survive will ask, “Why did the Lord our God do such terrible things to us?” Then tell them: I am the Lord, but you abandoned me and worshiped other gods in your own land. Now you will be slaves in a foreign country.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩaa nɛ pɩɛsa, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa ŋaa wɩaa deemba la lɛ?’ Ŋ jaŋ bʋla pɩba, ‘Ma sɩ vɩamɛ aŋ to vʋɩyaa ma tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ tɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ma jaŋ tɩma pɩ nɩwogusuŋ tintee-la sɩ bɩ ma kʋŋ ŋaa lɛ.’

english_verse: Tell these things to each other, you people of Judah, you descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Heele bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, a bʋla pɩ Juda nɩaa ma kala:

english_verse: You fools! Why don't you listen when I speak? Why can't you understand
translation_verse: Ma ŋaa nɩyaara nɛ a chʋʋlɛ, má nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ma kɛŋ sɩaa nɛ aŋ bɩ na, a kɛŋ dɩgɩlaa ma aŋ bɩ nɩɩ.”

english_verse: that you should worship me with fear and trembling? I'm the one who made the shore to hold back the ocean. Waves may crash on the beach, but they can come no farther.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA pɩɛsa, “Ma bɩ mɩ ka fáa? Ma bɩ maga dɩ ma chichel mɩ sɩpaaŋ? Mɩ-na nɛ bil hagɩlɩ-bumbugulo ʋ ŋaa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ bʋa, bʋa-la hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ a kaa mʋmʋ wuu, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo cholu. Lɩɩ-peliŋ jaŋ wuo sii, ama ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo cholu. Ba jaŋ wuo huuri woruŋ, ama ba bɩ jaŋ wuo cholu.

english_verse: You stubborn people have rebelled and turned your backs on me.
translation_verse: Ama nɩaa deemba kɛŋ nyuduoŋ nɛ, a bɩ dagɩŋ ka nɩɩ. Ba fa vɩamɛ nɛ a joŋ harɩŋ yɩamɛ.

english_verse: You refuse to say, “Let's worship the Lord! He's the one who sends rain in spring and autumn and gives us a good harvest.”
translation_verse: Ba vɩa dɩ ba bʋl, ‘Má leŋ dɩ la zil La TƖƖNA Wɩa, ʋ nɛ leŋe duonuŋ nɩɩ pɩpɩla ʋ bʋa lɛ. Ʋ nɛ yie leŋ la kɩaa wasɛ woruŋ la ŋaa.’

english_verse: A hunter traps birds and puts them in a cage, but some of you trap humans and make them your slaves.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ mɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ, a faa gbɛrɛ dɩ ba kɛsɛ nɩaa a nagɛ nɩaa sɩ yie bɛrɛ kɛsɛ diibiisiŋ ŋɩɩ. Ba nagɛ nɩaa sɩ bɛrɛ bɛrɩsɩŋ dɩ ba kɛsɛ nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: You are evil, and you lie and cheat to make yourselves rich. You are powerful
translation_verse: Ba nyɩsa laa nɩaa kɩaa a su dɩɩsɩŋ a nagɛ jibiisiŋ sɩ su ji-kɔrʋŋ nɛ, ba bɩrɩmɛ kɩa tɩmma nɛ a kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ,

english_verse: Look at the terrible things going on in this country. I am shocked!
translation_verse: Wʋlɔrʋ arɩ wʋberige nɛ ŋaa tintee-la lɛ:

english_verse: Prophets give their messages in the name of a false god, my priests don't want to serve me, and you—my own people— like it this way! But on the day of disaster, where will you turn for help?
translation_verse: Mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ baa bʋl wɩaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ. Ka Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma mɩɩra ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba tɩtɩaba doluŋ lɛ. Mɩ nɩaa ma cho ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ ŋaa. Ama wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa deemba dɩdɛrɩŋ?”

english_verse: Run for your lives, people of Benjamin. Get out of Jerusalem. Sound a trumpet in Tekoa and light a signal fire in Beth-Haccherem. Soon you will be struck by disaster from the north.
translation_verse: “Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa, má fá a laa ma tɩtɩa. Má fá lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Má ŋmʋʋ banyile taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛkʋa lɛ! Má hɛ nyiniŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa magɩl lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf Hakerem lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa wʋlɔrʋŋ nɛ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a kʋkɔ. Ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ sɩ chaasa lɔrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a lovely pasture,
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ, ama mɩ jaŋ cheyu.

english_verse: but shepherds will surround it and divided up, then let their flocks eat all the grass.
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaaraa arɩ ba nɩaa jaŋ kɔ ʋ lɛ, a hɛ ba lɛŋŋɛɛ a gollu, dɩ ba kʋŋkala hɔŋ lee-la ba sɩ kere pʋ.”

english_verse: Kings will tell their troops, “If we reach Jerusalem in the morning, we'll attack at noon. But if we arrive later,
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ bʋl, “Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩaba dɩ la yuo Jerusalɛm. Má sii dɩ la yuou wɩɩhɛyɛ. Ama leriŋ ka biri nɛ, dɩdaanɩŋ yie nɛ, daaliimee duomo pɩpɛ nɛ.

english_verse: we'll attack after dark and destroy its fortresses.”
translation_verse: Má sii dɩ la yuou tɩtaŋɩŋ, a chei ʋ dɩɩ-duoruŋ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I will command these armies to chop down trees and build a ramp up to the walls of Jerusalem. People of Jerusalem, I must punish you for your injustice.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Má keri Jerusalɛm tɩɩsɩŋ lo, a saa lusuŋ-choluŋ yelli ʋ kɛrɩsɩŋ. Ʋ maga mɩ dɔgɩsɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ nɩaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba wʋrɩgɛ nɩaa nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Evil pours from your city like water from a spring. Sounds of injustice and violence echo within your walls; victims are everywhere, wounded and dying.
translation_verse: A nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ yie bul a lɩlɩɩ viliŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Jerusalɛm wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ nagɛ. Yuosuŋ arɩ leriŋ cheyiŋ yʋga ʋ lɛ. Mɩɩ na ʋ nɩaa nyanyalaa arɩ ʋ naawɩɩlaa kala nɛ.

english_verse: Listen to me, you people of Jerusalem and Judah. I will abandon you, and your land will become an empty desert.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩɩ chagɩlɛma, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, mɩ jaŋ lɩɩ ma harɩŋ, a leŋ dɩ ma tinteeŋ pɩŋ hoi dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wuo hɔŋ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: I will tell your enemies to leave your nation bare like a vine stripped of grapes. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah's Anger
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ba jaŋ tiire kpʋ Iziral nɩkaana-la, dɩ ba kala lɛl gbelem gbelem a nagɛ ba sɩ tɔrɛ girep nɛnɛɛ aŋ bɩra mʋ kuuni.”

english_verse: Your anger against Judah flames up inside me, and I can't hold it in much longer. The Lord's Anger Will Sweep Everyone Away The Lord answered: Don't hold back my anger! Let it sweep away everyone— the children at play and all adults, young and old alike.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, baaŋ-la ŋ sɩ na ba nyuŋ chaasa tʋgʋmɛ nɛ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo nyagʋ bil. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Joŋ ŋ baaŋ-la fɩɩsɛ ba biiriŋ sɩ hɛ womporuŋ lɛ, arɩ bapʋɔsɩa-la sɩ hilime. Sɩ́ baalaa arɩ ba haalaa ma lɩɩsa ta. Sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ faasa hɩɛsɛ ma lɩɩsa ta.

english_verse: I'll punish the people of Judah and give to others their houses and fields, as well as their wives. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ba dɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ mɩɩra ŋaa ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kɩaa, a pɛ ba bagɩsɩŋ arɩ ba haalaa lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ.” La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: “Ba nɩbiisiŋ arɩ ba nɩbalaa kala kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ nɛ a chɩchɛ kɩaa. Mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma nagɛ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ, a kala nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Ba yie kɛŋ sɛntɛrɩŋ nɛ a chɛsɛ mɩ nɩaa naawɩɩlaa a nagɛ ba firise nɛ. Ba yie bʋl, ‘Fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ,’ ka fɩɛlɩŋ paala tuo.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of their disgusting sins, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Rejected God's Way of Life
translation_verse: Wʋkɩsɩa-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa, hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmba nɛɛ? Aɩ, ba paala bɩ hɩɩsɩŋ ka fá. Ba paala bɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ sɩaa chei. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba jaŋ sʋʋ, a pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a kɛmba muuri. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, when you stood at the crossroads, I told you, “Follow the road your ancestors took, and you will find peace.” But you refused.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Má chɩŋ wɛŋ-chɛŋŋɛɛ lɛ aŋ beŋ, má pɩɛsa chɛ a jɩŋ wombii-bɩnɩa-la, má pɩɛsa na lee-la wombii-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ, a tou, dɩ ma dɩnsɩŋ na wiese. Ama ma sɩ, ‘La bɩ jaŋ tou.’

english_verse: I also sent prophets to warn you of danger, but when they sounded the alarm, you paid no attention.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa lɩɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ dɩ ba pɔma aŋ bʋl, ‘Má jegile nɩɩ banyile-la ba sɩ ŋmʋa aa kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa.’ Ama ma sɩ, ‘La bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ.’

english_verse: So I tell all nations on earth, “Watch what I will do!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa tinteyee nɩaa, má jegile nɩɩ, máa beŋ, a na wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: My people ignored me and rejected my laws. They planned to do evil, and now the evil they planned will happen to them.”
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ nɩaa, má jegile nɩɩ. Mɩ kɛŋ wʋlɔrʋ nɛ a kʋkɔ dɩ mɩ hɛ nɩaa deemba lɛ, a tɩŋ ba wʋŋaalaa wɩaa. Ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa, aŋ vɩa mɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto.

english_verse: People of Judah, you bring me incense from Sheba and spices from distant lands. You offer sacrifices of all kinds. But why bother? I hate these gifts of yours!
translation_verse: Kʋsʋɔrʋsʋ-la ba sɩ kaa lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩɩba arɩ tegisi-la dɔnsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma ba kaa lɩɩ tintee-la sɩ bolie kʋʋ pɩmɛ, ba bɩ bʋbʋɔ kala kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ bɩ ma kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa ka laa. Mɩ tʋɔŋ bɩ pʋsʋ-la ma sɩ yie kpʋ pɩmɛ nyuŋ ka tɔrɛ.”

english_verse: So I will put stumbling blocks in your path, and everyone will die, including parents and children, neighbors and friends. An Army from the North
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ baŋkɛŋ wɩaa kɛrɛ nɩaa deemba. Bii-lʋllaa arɩ ba biiriŋ jaŋ gɛrɛba tel. Pɛ-jʋʋraa arɩ ba nandɔnsʋŋ ma jaŋ sʋʋ.”

english_verse: Its well-armed troops are cruel and never show mercy. Their galloping horses sound like ocean waves pounding on the shore. This army will attack you, lovely Jerusalem.”
translation_verse: Ba nyɩgɩla nɛ a kori tosuŋ arɩ ba tiŋŋee, ba ŋaa laalɩyuori tʋɔhɛɩ tɩmma nɛ, a bɩ nɩaa nenige ka fá. Ba sɩ jɩl ba janɩŋ, ba dɔmɔ nagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ sɩɩ huuru nɛ. Ba ŋaa nɩaa sɩ nyɩgɩla dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ nɛ a kɔ dɩ ba yuo ŋ-na Jerusalɛm.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Just hearing about them makes us tremble with fear, and we twist and turn in pain like a woman giving birth.”
translation_verse: La nɩɩ la dʋndɔmɔ-la wɩaa nɛ, ŋɩɩ leŋ la nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ. Hɛɛŋ chaasa jʋʋla nɛ, a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ lʋl ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Don't work in your fields or walk along the roads. It's too dangerous. The enemy is well armed
translation_verse: Má pɔ ma sɩ́ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ jɩl a sɩ́ wombiee ma lɛ vɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa la dʋndɔmɔ-la kori tokobiee nɛ, fawʋllʋŋ hɛ lee-kala.

english_verse: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.” The Lord's People Must Be Tested The Lord said:
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩ, “Mɩ nɩaa, má paa tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ laalɛ a bilimi tʋɔrʋŋ lɛ. Má chaasa yel, yel-haaŋ a nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ kɛŋ ʋ bii-bala ʋ sʋʋ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni ka dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chei leriŋ guu kɔ ma lɛ, a yuola.

english_verse: And you'll find they are hard like bronze and iron. They are stubborn rebels, always spreading lies. *
translation_verse: Ba kala ŋaa nyu-duo tɩmma nɛ a vɩa mɩ niiŋ, a gɔllɔ chichei nɩaa yɩrɩŋ. Ba wɩaa dolie nagɛ kɔlɩɩŋ arɩ hɔɔŋ nɛ, ba kala wʋŋaalaa lɔrɔ.

english_verse: Silver can be purified in a fiery furnace, but my people are too wicked to be made pure, and so I have rejected them.
translation_verse: Ba kɛmba yɩyɩrɛ hɔpʋla ba sɩ vɩa ta nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna vɩaba ta nɛ.”

english_verse: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were! Slaughter Valley The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ama ba fa bɩ mɩ teeŋ jegile nɩɩ, a vɩa dɩ ba tomi. Ba fa kɛŋ nyuduoŋ nɛ a wasa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a kɩɩ ba naabalɩmaba.

english_verse: Stop taking advantage of foreigners, orphans, and widows. Don't kill innocent people. And stop worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: dɩ ma nɛ bɩ nʋhʋɔraa, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa ka wʋrʋgɛ, a bɩ nɩaa sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye maa kpʋ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ, a bɩ vesiŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaama wʋbɔŋ harɩŋ ka to,

english_verse: The Lord told me to stand by the gate of the temple and tell the people who were going in that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: Pay attention, people of Judah! Change your ways and start living right, then I will let you keep on living in your own country.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má bɩrɩma lɩɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ naga lɛ a joŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ ŋaa ta, ka dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ daha.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! My temple is here in Jerusalem, but that doesn't mean I will protect you.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ba laa dii ŋɩɩ ba sɩ yie nyɩsɛma a bʋl, ‘La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la nɛ ŋ-la, La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la nɛ ŋ-la, La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la nɛ ŋ-la.’

english_verse: I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ chaasa bɩrɩma lɩɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ naga lɛ, a joŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ ŋaa ta, aŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋɔsʋŋ lɛ dɔŋɔba teeŋ,

english_verse: Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ a kaa mʋmʋ wuu, lee-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩ ma naabalɩmaba.

english_verse: But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies.
translation_verse: Ama, ma bee na, ma mɩɩra joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ nyɩsɛma lɛ nɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you.
translation_verse: Ma yie gɩgaa nɩaa kɩaa nɛ, a kpʋkpʋ nɩaa, a chɩchɛ dɔŋɔba haalaa, a nyɩɛ wɩaa aŋ ŋmɩŋmɩɛsɛ, a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal a tuto vesiŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ bɩ jɩŋ,

english_verse: And then you come into my temple and worship me! Do you think I will protect you so that you can go on sinning?
translation_verse: aŋ kʋ chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ joŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ hɛ lɛ a bʋl, ‘La-na hɔnɔ nɛ, wɩɩ bɩ la ka walɩmɛ.’ Ma jaŋ wuo ŋaa wʋkɩsaa deemba kala, ka dɩ wɩɩ sɩ́ ma walɩmʋʋ?

english_verse: You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ joŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ hɛ pa jaŋ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ gaarɩ dɩa a pɩmaa? Mɩɩ na wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!
translation_verse: Má mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩlɔ, lee-la mɩ fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ nɩaa dɩdɛnnɛmɛ, a na wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa ʋ lɛ a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.”

english_verse: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Ma fa sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala, mɩ fa chagɩlɛma nɛ bʋlɩa bʋlɩa, ka ma bɩ nɩa. Mɩ fa yɩrɛma nɛ, ka ma vɩa dɩ ma sɛɩ.

english_verse: Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ joŋo ŋaa Sɩlɔ lɛ, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ sɩ hɛ lɛ, mɩ-na Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la ma sɩ joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ, lee-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩ ma dɩ ma naabalɩmaba.

english_verse: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa Juda tasɩŋ arɩ Jerusalɛm womporunuŋ lɛ naa?

english_verse: Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me.
translation_verse: Biiriŋ jaa daasɩŋ hɩhɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, nyɩmmaba ma hɩhɛ nyiniŋ, haalaa ma bubuu munuŋ dɩ ba wasɛ boroboro pɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ wɩa-nyuŋ ha-kuoro. Ba wansɛ kʋnyʋalaa ma aa pɩ vesiŋ nɛ. Ba ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala a chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ sii nɛ.

english_verse: But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na baanɩŋ lɛ dee ba didii. Ba tɩtɩa nɛ ba dʋdɔgɩsɛ, a hɩhɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa ma. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.
