english_verse: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ baaŋ-la sɩ faasa sii fɩɩsɛ Juda nɩaa lɛ, ba pʋsʋŋ arɩ ba tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ba kʋpɛrɛɛ lɛ. Mɩ baaŋ-la jaŋ nagɛ nyiŋ-la sɩ bɩ dɩsɛ a diiba.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, but I won't accept sacrifices from you. So don't even bother bringing them to me. You might as well just cook the meat for yourselves.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má joŋ ma kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋ-la dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ kpʋa nammɩa pɛ dɔŋɔ a tɩtɩa chɩchaŋ.

english_verse: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩ kɛŋ ma naabalɩmaba kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩba, mɩ bɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ pʋsʋŋ kpʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ dʋndʋŋa wɩaa nɛ joŋo dagɛba.

english_verse: Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.”
translation_verse: Ama mɩ fa joŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma a dagɛba nɛ: Má sɛɩ mɩ niiŋ, dɩ mɩ ŋaa ma Wɩa, dɩ ma ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa. Má to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma, dɩ wɩaa wuo vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩma.

english_verse: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.
translation_verse: Ama ba fa bɩ jegile nɩɩ koo a kaa tɩŋ. Ba fa mɩɩra to ba nyuduoŋ arɩ ba tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ nɛ. Ba fa mɩɩra mʋ harɩŋ nɛ, ba bɩ sɩpaaŋ mʋa.

english_verse: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ ma naabalɩmaba fa sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ, mɩ yie tɩŋ mɩ tɩntɩnnaa sɩ ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa ba kʋkɔ ma teeŋ nɛ bʋlɩa bʋlɩa.

english_verse: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa bʋla pɩba, ‘Tintee-la nɩaa sɩ vɩa dɩ ba to mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ, a bɩ sɛyɛ dɩ mɩ kɛmba tʋra kɩɩ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛlɛ nɛ, ʋ lɛl ba niiree lɛ nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm tɩmma, má kɛ ma nyu-pʋnaa a yuo ta, aŋ jɩl dundol kpʋlaa nyuŋ a ta jembiee a yiyel, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA baanɩŋ sii doho deeŋ nɩaa nyuŋ nɛ, mɩ vɩaba ta. Fuonaa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ kpʋ nɩaa

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla, “Juda nɩaa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ mɩ sɩɩŋ lɛ. Ba joŋ ba vʋɩyaa mɩ sɩɩ kɩsʋ nɛ a bil mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la mɩ yɩrɩŋ sɩ hɛ lɛ, a ŋaa ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
translation_verse: Ba bil vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɔfɛf dɩ-kpaarɩŋ nɛ Bɛŋ Hɩnɔm fuonaaŋ lɛ, dɩ ba kɛsɛ ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba hantolibiisiŋ a nyɩnyɩgɛ. Wɩɩ mɩ sɩ bɩ ba daga, ŋɩɩ paala bɩ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa kɔ.”

english_verse: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Ma jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ: Tapʋlaa ka kɔ nɛ, nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ lee-la Tɔfɛf koo Bɛŋ Hɩnɔm fuonaaŋ. Ama ba jaŋ kɛnʋ yɩrɛ fuonaa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ kpʋ nɩaa. Ba jaŋ huhugi nɩaa Tɔfɛf lɛ ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ tinteeŋ kala mʋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
translation_verse: Juda nɩaa kʋsʋʋnʋŋ jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ zaaraa arɩ baga kɩaa kʋdiilee. Nʋʋkala jaŋ tuo dɩ ʋ kiriba ta.

english_verse: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ goŋ-la ha-falaa arɩ ba balaba sɩɩ ŋaa dɛrɛ Juda tasɩŋ arɩ Jerusalɛm womporunuŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba tinteeŋ jaŋ pɩŋ hoi.”

english_verse: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Bʋa-la lɛ, ba jaŋ kuuso chaarɛ Juda tinteeŋ kuoru-balaa arɩ ba tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ haŋgbelee ba vaamaa lɛ.

english_verse: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛmba yieni dɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, chɛnɛ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ chaana hɛ ba lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ fa cho kɩaa deemba nɛ a tɩma pɩpɩba. Ba faa toba nɛ a pɩɛsɛba chɩchɛ dɩ ba na wɩaa a kpʋkpaarɛba. Nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ kuri haŋgbele-la hɛ dɔŋɔ a hugi, ama ba jaŋ lemba ta dɩ ba pɩŋ tinteeŋ a nagɛ nʋsʋrʋŋ.

english_verse: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
translation_verse: Lee na-kala mɩ sɩ vɩa tintee-bɔmʋŋ deeŋ nɩaa ta, nɩkaana-la sɩ bɩ sʋba jaŋ cho sʋʋŋ a kɩɩ mɩɩsɩŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.” Ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩaa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.
translation_verse: Pɩɛsɛba na, “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ pɩɛsa nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ nɩaa nɛ tele, ba bɩ sii? Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ yeŋŋe, ʋ bɩ harɩŋ ka mɩɩrɛ?

english_verse: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ nɩaa deemba vɩa dɩ ba mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa yie mɩɩrɛ mɩ harɩŋ? Ba nyʋa mɛrɛ vʋɩyaa sɩɩ nyɩsɛba lɛ nɛ, aŋ vɩa dɩ ba mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: I listen carefully, but none of you admit that you've done wrong. Without a second thought, you run down the wrong road like horses running blindly into battle.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na chaasa jegili ba teeŋ nɛ woruŋ, ama ba bɩ wɩaa ka bʋl ba bʋɔsʋŋ lɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ, a pɩɛsɛ, ‘Wʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa?’ Nʋʋkala ka ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ cho nɛ, a nagɛ jaaba sɩ tʋɔra mʋmʋ laalɩŋ.

english_verse: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
translation_verse: Naliiribommie sɩɩ fil wɩa-nyuŋ ma paala jɩŋ yibiiniŋ arɩ tafaaŋ bʋa nɛ. Kokosuŋ, zaarɩ-kokobiisiŋ arɩ chakpoliba ma paala jɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ yie gɔllɔ mʋ leree nɛ. Ama mɩ nɩaa-na bɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA sɩɩ chɛ jɩŋ.

english_verse: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ wuo bʋl, ‘La ŋaa wʋjɩnna nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la kɛŋ La TƖƖNA wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto nɛ.’ Ka nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ kaa bɩrɩmɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ?

english_verse: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
translation_verse: Hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋjɩnnaa, ba niiŋ jaŋ maa dɩ ba bɛrɛ kɛmba, ba sɩ vɩa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa, wʋjɩŋ bɛɛ nɛ ba kɛŋ?

english_verse: I'll give their wives and fields to strangers. Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ laa ba haalaa pɩ ba-wogusuŋ, ka dɩ nɩtanɩa ma laa ba bagɩsɩŋ tɩɩ. Ba nɩbiisiŋ arɩ ba nɩbalaa kala kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ nɛ a chɩchɛ kɩaa. Mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma nagɛ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ a kala nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Ba yie kɛŋ sɛntɛrɩŋ nɛ a chɛsɛ mɩ nɩaa naawɩɩlaa a nagɛ ba firise nɛ. Ba yie bʋl, ‘Fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, Fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, aŋ ka fɩɛlɩŋ tuo.’

english_verse: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
translation_verse: Wʋkɩsɩa-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa, hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmba nɛɛ? Aɩ, ba paala bɩ hɩɩsɩŋ ka fá. Ba paala bɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ sɩaa chei. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba jaŋ sʋʋ, a pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a kɛmba muuri. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kʋpɛrɛɛ birigi. Girep tɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ nɛŋ kala. Tutogo ma bɩ jaŋ nɛŋ tutogi-nambɩlaa, ba pɩpaarɩŋ jaŋ yuori. Kɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩba, mɩ jaŋ laaba ba teeŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The people of Judah say to each other, “What are we waiting for? Let's run to a town with walls and die there. We rebelled against the Lord, and we were sentenced to die by drinking poison.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juda nɩaa pɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ la ha hɔŋ daha? Má kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ! Má leŋ dɩ la fá mʋ tabala-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli a sʋʋ nɩmɛ. La TƖƖNA Wɩa ka chɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋla nɛ a joŋ bɩɛlɩŋ hɛ lɩɩŋ lɛ dɩ la nyʋa, a tɩŋ la sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ʋ lɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: La faa yɩɛlʋ arɩ la jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ nɛ, ama la bɩ ŋɩɩ na. Bʋa-la sɩ maga dɩ la duoro lɩɩ wɩaa lɛ, fawʋllʋŋ mɩɩra jʋʋla yʋgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Our enemies have reached the town of Dan in the north, and the snorting of their horses makes us tremble with fear. The enemy will destroy Jerusalem and our entire nation. No one will survive.”
translation_verse: La nɩɩ la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ janɩŋ sɩ ŋmʋʋ mɩɩsɩŋ a lɩɩ Daŋ tinteeŋ nɛ. Ba janɩ-la yele leŋe tintee-la kala zigili nɛ. Ba kɔ dɩ ba yuo dii la tinteeŋ nɛ a chei kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ, la tabal-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: “Watch out!” the Lord says. “I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.” Jeremiah Mourns for His People
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Má bee na, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ dɩŋŋaa sɩ kɛŋ huoŋ kʋ jʋʋ ma tʋɔŋ, dɩ-kuuroo nʋʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo bugumi. Ba jaŋ dɩmma.”

english_verse: I'm burdened with sorrow and feel like giving up.
translation_verse: Jɛrɩmaaya bʋl, “Mɩ tʋɔŋ cheye yʋgɛ nɛ, nʋʋ bɩ mɩ bɔyɛ wuo nyagɛ, mɩ daagaa chaasa viisi nɛ.

english_verse: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, “Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king?” I hear the Lord reply, “Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols?”
translation_verse: Jegile nɩɩ mɩ nɩaa nii-ŋmobo tintee-bolii-la lɛ. La TƖƖNA tuo Zaayɔŋ lɛɛ? Ʋ kuoru-balɩŋ bɩra tuoo?” La TƖƖNA pɩɛsɛ “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ mɛ ŋaa mɩ baanɩŋ sii, ba vʋɩ-pɛɩba-la ba sɩ kaa lɩɩ tawogusuŋ?”

english_verse: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
translation_verse: Jɛrɩmaaya bɩra bʋl, “Baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ bala nɛ, lɩmbaŋa dɛrɛ nɛ, ka nʋʋkala bɩ la laata.

english_verse: My people are crushed, and so is my heart. I am horrified and mourn.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ faasa chei nɛ a tɩŋ mɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ sɩ cheye wɩaa. Mɩ yel, aŋ tuo bibeŋ.

english_verse: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?
translation_verse: Naawɩɩlaa nʋʋŋ tuo Gɩlɩad lɛɛ? Daalusuŋ tɩɩna kala tuoo? Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ mɩ nɩaa naawɩɩlaa bɩ fɩɛlɛ?

english_verse: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa cho dɩ mɩ nyuŋ nagɛ lɩɩ-bul-sɩɩŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ sɩaa ma fa bubul sɩlɩɩrɩŋ. Mɩ fa jaŋ yel tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala a tɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋ mɩ nɩaa wɩaa.

english_verse: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God. The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Mɩ fa cho dɩ mɩ kɛŋ lee nɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ nʋhʋɔraa sɩ jaŋ kʋ jʋjʋʋ, dɩ mɩ lɩɩ mɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ a fá mʋ hɛ nɩmɛ, a kagɛ ba lɛ. Ba kala ka ŋaa wʋchɔrʋmɔɔ nɛ. Ba ŋaa nɩ-daŋ nɛ, ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ Wɩa teeŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa nɛ a nagɛ toŋ ba sɩ lɛrɛ hɛ, baa chɛ dɩ ba nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ. Ba wʋtɩtɩɩ dee bɩ leŋe ba kɛŋ doluŋ tintee-la lɛ. Ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɩa aŋ ka pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Ba bɩ mɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, all your friends and relatives tell lies about you, so don't trust them.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa arɩ ma nandɔnsʋŋ. Má sɩ́ ma naambiiriŋ laa dii. Naambii kala ka nyɩsɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna nɛ. Nandɔŋ ma kala ŋaa yɩrɩ-cheeru.

english_verse: They wear themselves out, always looking for a new way to cheat their friends.
translation_verse: Nandɔŋɔ yie nyɩsɛ ʋ nandɔŋɔ. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ka bʋl. Ba niiree mal wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ. Baa lɔl ba tɩtɩa nɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone takes advantage of everyone else, and no one will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Jɛrɩmaaya, ŋ tagɩlɛ nɩ-nyɩsɛraa tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ba sɩɩ nyɩsɛ nɩaa ŋɩɩ, ba bɩ mɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: They say they want peace, but this lie is deadly, like an arrow that strikes when you least expect it.
translation_verse: Ba niiree nagɛ to-hɛmɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ huoŋ nɛ, a nyɩnyɩɛ wɩaa. Ba yie kɛŋ ba niiree bʋl wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ, ama wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ ba kaa gbɛrɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa?” Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. “Bɛɛ nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ tiŋ tintee doho deeŋ lɛ?”

english_verse: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ yele pɩ peelee aŋ ta jembiiŋ tɩgɛ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee lɛ. Ba pɩna nɛ hoi, nʋʋkala bɩ nɩmɛ ka vɛŋ, ŋ bɩra bɩ nɛsɩŋ yele ka nɩɩ nɩmɛ. Diibiisiŋ kala file lɛl nɛ, bagɩlaa ma fá viiri.”

english_verse: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Jerusalɛm pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, a ŋaa jolluŋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Juda tasɩŋ pɩŋ hoi, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wuo hɔŋ lee-la.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I destroyed the land because the people disobeyed me and rejected my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Ba sɩ vɩa wombii-la mɩ sɩ bile pɩba dɩ ba tuto wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ. Ba bɩ mɩ niiŋ sɛyɛ a bɩ mɩ wombii-la mɩ sɩ bile to.

english_verse: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba pɩsa hɛ tinteyee lɛ ba dɩ ba nyɩmmaba kʋŋkala ha sɩ bɩ jɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ kire to ba harɩŋ arɩ tokobiiŋ see dɩ mɩ kpʋba.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said, “Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Bɩɩnɛ wɩaa woruŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ! Yɩrɛ hagɔgɔɔ dɩ ba kɔ, tɩma yɩrɛ ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ chaasa jɩŋ yele.

english_verse: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba ŋaa lɩma kɔ a kʋ yel hagɔgʋŋ pɩla, a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ la sɩaa sɩ jaŋ pɩpɛllɛ arɩ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ, dɩ la sɩaa kala ŋaa lɩɩ.

english_verse: Now those of us on Zion cry, ‘We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.’
translation_verse: La nɩa dɩ baa ŋmoo niiŋ nɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ a bʋbʋl, ‘La cheye dɛrɛ nɛ. La hɩɩsɩŋ chaasa yʋgɛ nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ la lɩɩ la tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la dɩɩsɩŋ kala nɛ ba ŋmoo lo.’ ”

english_verse: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
translation_verse: Ou, haalaa, lɛɛlɛ má jegile nɩɩ La TƖƖNA wɩaa. Má suri ma dɩgɩlaa a nɩɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa. Má dagɛ ma toloo ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ yel, má dagɛ dɔŋɔ hagɔgʋŋ.

english_verse: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
translation_verse: Sʋʋŋ to tokoroba nɛ a jʋʋ la dɩɩsɩŋ a jʋʋ la dɩɩ-duoruŋ. Ʋ kpʋ hambiisiŋ nɛ womporunuŋ lɛ, aŋ kpʋ bapʋɔsaa ma biliiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Nuhuobiinee kʋsʋʋnʋŋ jaŋ pɩna yieni, a nagɛ nʋsʋrʋŋ sɩ pɩŋ dɩ-jalɩŋ, a nagɛ ba sɩ ta mɩaa kɩɛlɛ, ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ paa hɛ dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: If you feel you must brag, then have enough sense to brag about worshiping me, the Lord. What I like best is showing kindness, justice, and mercy to everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Ama, leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ ŋmoo ʋ bɔyɛ, ʋ ŋmoo ʋ bɔyɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ: Arɩ ʋ jɩŋ mɩ wɩaa sɩaa nɛ, a jɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa ʋ TƖƖNA. Nɩɩ-la sɩ cho nɩaa a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ tʋɔpʋla a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa tinteeŋ lɛ, wɩaa deemba nɩɩ tɔrɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Someday I will punish the nations of Egypt, Edom, Ammon, and Moab, and the tribes of the desert. The men of these nations are circumcised, but they don't worship me. And it's the same with you people of Judah. Your bodies are circumcised, but your hearts are unchanged.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ nɛ ŋaa: Ijipiti nɩaa, Ɛdɔm nɩaa, Amɔŋ nɩaa, Mʋab nɩaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ dɩ-boloo. Tinteyee deemba kala nɩaa bɩ ba tʋɔŋ pʋlla. Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala ma paala bɩ ba tʋɔŋ pʋlla.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Má sɩ́ tinteye-la dɔnsʋŋ nɩaa naabʋɔsʋŋ to, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wʋmagɩla-la arɩ kʋmagɩla-la ma sɩɩ na wɩa-nyuŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma, a nagɛ ŋɩɩ tinteye-la dɔnsʋŋ nɩaa sɩɩ fá ba.

english_verse: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol,
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ naabarɩŋ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ. Ba yie keri tɩa nɛ duuŋ lɛ, saara kɛŋ ʋ saaŋ saa daa-la a kaa bɩrɩmɛ vʋɩŋ.

english_verse: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
translation_verse: Ba yie kɛŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ a kpɩɛrʋ nɛ, aŋ kɛŋ hama ŋmoo hɛŋŋɛɛ hɛ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ a sɩ́ jigisu.

english_verse: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you? Jeremiah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Ba vʋɩya-la nagɛ ba sɩ ŋaa kʋa bil baga lɛ nɛ dɩ ʋ nyɩnyɩsɛ diiree. Ba bɩ wɩaa wuo bʋl, ba yie jomba chʋŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ wuo vɛŋ. Má sɩ́ ba fá, ba bɩ wʋbɔŋ wuo ŋaa ma lɛ, a bɩ wʋzɔŋ ma wuo ma lɛ.”

english_verse: Our Lord, great and powerful, you alone are God.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, nʋʋkala tuo a nagɩŋ, ŋ nɛ yʋga, ŋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ, ŋ yɩrɩŋ ma yʋgɛ.

english_verse: You are King of the nations. Everyone should worship you. No human anywhere on earth is wiser than you.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ tinteyee kala kuoru-balɩŋ kʋbɛɛ nɛ bɩ jaŋ fáŋ? Nʋʋkala maga dɩ ʋ ziliŋ nɛ. Ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga dɩ nɩaa fá. Tinteyee nɩaa wʋjɩnnaa arɩ ba kuori-gentisiŋ kala tʋɔŋ, nʋʋkala tuo a magɩŋ.

english_verse: Idols are worthless, and anyone who worships them is a fool!
translation_verse: Ba kala ŋaa nɩaa sɩ chʋʋla arɩ nɩyaaraa nɛ. Daasɩŋ ba sɩ kaa ŋaa vʋɩyaa sɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩba nɩɩ dagɛba wɩaa.

english_verse: Idols are made by humans. A carver shapes the wood. A metalworker hammers out a covering of gold from Uphaz or of silver from Tarshish. Then the idol is dressed in blue and purple clothes.
translation_verse: Ba yie kɛŋ hɔpʋla ba sɩ kaa lɩɩ Taasɩs nɛ a libiba, a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ma ba sɩ kaa lɩɩ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ufas a libi. Kɩaa deemba saara arɩ libire sɩ ŋaa nɛ ba yie joŋ gɛrɩŋ sɩ nagɛ diibelimbine arɩ gɛrɩ-vachalɩŋ a laalɛ. Gɛrɩpɛ-yuori gɔgɔɔ nɛ yuo gɛnnɩŋ deemba kala.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩ-tɩtɩɩ. Ʋ nɛ Wɩa sɩ weye. Ʋ nɛ kuoru-bal-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ na baanɩŋ, tinteeŋ yie zigili nɛ. Dɩ ʋ baanɩŋ nɛ sie, tinteyee bɩ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ.

english_verse: You told me to say that idols did not create the heavens and the earth, and that you, the Lord, will destroy every idol.
translation_verse: Má bʋl ŋ-la pɩ nɩalɩŋ: “Vʋɩyaa deemba ba sɩ to dee bɩ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ ŋaa, ba jaŋ nyɩɩgɛ tinteeŋ lɛ a lɛl dʋnɩa kala lɛ.”

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ kpɩa wɩaa, lɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ yie huuri nɛ. Ʋ yie leŋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa lɩɩ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ a kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ leŋ duonuŋ nɩnɩɩ, aŋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ, a leŋ peliŋ ma lɩɩ ʋ lee-la lɛ ʋ sɩ bilu a lulu.

english_verse: People who make idols are so stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods are not alive.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala chʋʋla nɛ a bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ. Hɩɩsɩŋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ libi vʋɩyaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba vʋɩya-la bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ, ba bɩ wiese ma kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ bʋbʋɔ kala kɛnɛ. Ba ŋaa kɩaa sɩ kɛŋ mɔmʋŋ nɛ. Dɩ ba sarɩya diiniŋ tapʋlʋŋ nɛ yie, ba jaŋ cheiba.

english_verse: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful. Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
translation_verse: Jekɔb Wɩa-na bɩ ba naga. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa kʋŋkala, aŋ lɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ba ŋaa ʋ nɩaa. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna. Cheeri-la sɩɩ kɔ

english_verse: I said to the people of Judah, “Gather your things; you are surrounded.
translation_verse: Má paa ma kɩaa hɛ dɔŋɔ, a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa dɩ ma lɩɩ tintee-la lɛ. Ba golli ma chu nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Bʋa deeŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ a yuo ta. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ hɛɛŋ yʋgɛ a hɛ ba lɛ, dɩ ba yuo kɛsɛba.”

english_verse: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
translation_verse: Wɩaa puumi, mɩ sɩ bolimo wɩaa. Mɩ naawɩɩlɩŋ bɩ kʋfɩɛlɩɩ ŋaa, ka mɩ ha bʋl mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ, “Mɩ nyanyalɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la, ʋ maga dɩ mɩ nyalɩmɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaara-la kala yaara nɛ, a bɩ La Tɩɩna pɩɛsa dɩ ʋ dagɛba wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba wɩɩkala bɩ wasa, ba nɩaa kala pɩsɛ.

english_verse: “Sounds of destruction rumble from the north like distant thunder. Soon our towns will be ruins where only jackals live.” Jeremiah Prays
translation_verse: Má jegile nɩɩ goŋ-la ba sɩ ŋaa kʋkɔ. Yuo-bal nɛ sii wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa tinteeŋ a kʋkɔ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Juda tinteeŋ tasɩŋ pɩŋ hoi, a bɩrɩmɛ jolluŋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ. Jɛrɩmaaya Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ

english_verse: I know, Lord, that we humans are not in control of our own lives.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, mɩ jɩma nuhuobiine tɩtɩa dee bɩ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ koro. Nuhuobiine tɩtɩa dee bɩ ʋ naavɛnɛɛ ka dagɛ.

english_verse: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, kɛmmɛ tʋra kɩɩ. Ama ŋaa ŋɩɩ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛlaa. Sɩ́ baanɩŋ lɛ to, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩ.

english_verse: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
translation_verse: Na baanɩŋ tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ bɩŋ jɩŋ nyuŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ ka yɩrɛ. Ba kpʋ Iziral nɩaa nɛ. Ba kpʋ ba kala nɛ gbelem gbelem, aŋ chei ba tinteeŋ kala.

english_verse: The Lord God told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord, am warning you that I will put a curse on anyone who doesn't keep the agreement I made with Israel. So pay attention to what it says.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la, ‘Ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩa dɩ ʋ to wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ deeŋ sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ lɛ,

english_verse: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
translation_verse: wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ joŋo dagɛ ma naabalɩmaba bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa sɩ laaba ta Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ a kɛmba kʋ lɩɩ, lee-la ba fa sɩ chaasa nɩna hɛɛŋ.’ Mɩ fa bʋla pɩba, ‘Má to mɩ niiŋ a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa, dɩ mɩ ma ŋaa ma Wɩa.’

english_verse: Then I did what I had promised and gave them this wonderful land, where you now live. “Yes, Lord,” I replied, “that's true.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nii-la mɩ sɩ hɛ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba, a joŋ tinteeŋ sɩ zɔmɔ a kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ a pɩba kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ, tintee-la nɛ ŋaa ma kʋŋ ŋɩɩ jɩnɩmba.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “La TƖƖNA, Amɩɩ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, “Heele bʋl wɩaa deemba Juda tasɩŋ arɩ Jerusalɛm womporunuŋ lɛ, ‘Má jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ deeŋ sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ lɛ a toba.

english_verse: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors
translation_verse: A chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa sɩ kɛŋ ma naabalɩmaba a lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a kaa kʋ yi jɩnɩŋ, mɩ kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa bʋlɩa bʋlɩa nɛ a bʋl: Má to mɩ niiŋ.

english_verse: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
translation_verse: Ama ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ, aŋ vɩa dɩ ba tomi, ba mɩɩra to ba nyuduoŋ arɩ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ ŋmɩaŋ-la kala sɩ hɛ nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ba pɛgɛ a hɛ ba lɛ. Nii-la mɩ fa sɩ sɩ ba to ka ba bɩ to.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA fa bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, “Juda tɩŋŋaa arɩ ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ vʋʋrɛ wʋbɔŋ nɛ a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
translation_verse: Ba mɩɩra ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la ba naabalɩmaba-la fa sɩ vɩa dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa aŋ ŋaa nɛ. Ba to vʋɩyaa nɛ a kpaarɛba. Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala chei nii-la mɩ fa sɩ bile mɩ dɩ ba naabalɩmaba pɛgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋlɔrʋŋ ba sɩ́ bɩ jaŋ wuo fá kagɛ a kʋ hɛ ba lɛ. Ba jaŋ ŋmoo niiŋ mɩ teeŋ, ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
translation_verse: Ma Juda nɩaa kɛŋ vʋɩyaa yʋga magɛ tasɩ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ nɛ. Korunu-la ma sɩ saa dɩ ma nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ ma hɩɩsɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal ma yʋga nɛ a magɛ Jerusalɛm womporunuŋ.’

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
translation_verse: Jɛrɩmaaya, sɩ́ mɩ sʋla pɩ nɩaa deemba, sɩ́ ba naasɩŋ lɛ chɩna sʋlmɛ chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩkala a pɩba, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ ba teeŋ bʋa-la lɛ hɛɛŋ sɩ jaŋ jʋʋba dɩ ba yɩrɛmɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
translation_verse: Wombii bɛɛ nɛ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ cho kɛŋ dɩ ba hɛ mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa, ba sɩ gɔllɔ to ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a yʋga magɛ ŋ-la? Ba bɩɩna ba jaŋ giri wʋlɔrʋ-la ta dɩ ba nɛ hɛ niiriŋ aŋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋɩŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Wɩaa deemba jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛɛ?

english_verse: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA faa yɩrɛma olif tɩa sɩ kɛŋ pɩpaarɩŋ nɛ, a kɛŋ nɛnɛɛ sɩ faasa zɔŋ. Ama mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ pel-duoŋ dɔmɔ sɩ nagɛ taŋ sɩ dɔmɔ lu ʋ nyuŋ, a bori ʋ naakelee, dɩ nyiniŋ diiu.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ leŋe ma hɛ nɩmɛ, bʋla arɩ wʋlɔrʋŋ jaŋ jʋʋma, bɛɛ wɩaa ma Iziral arɩ ma Juda nɩaa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal a ŋaa mɩ baanɩŋ sii.” Ba pagɛ Jɛrɩmaaya lɛ

english_verse: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nɛ joŋo dagɛmɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ pagɛ mɩ lɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ, ʋ dagɛmɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: But then the Lord told me that they had planned to chop me down like a tree— fruit and all— so that no one would ever remember me again.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa nagɛ pie-bie sɩ ŋaa chɩm ka ba kaa mʋmʋ dɩ ba kpʋ nɛ. Mɩ fa bɩ jɩŋ dɩ ba pagɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ a bʋbʋl, “Má leŋ dɩ la nyʋgʋsɛ tɩa-la arɩ ʋ nɛnɛɛ kala. Má leŋ dɩ la keru ta nɩweyee tʋɔŋ, dɩ nɩaa bɩra sɩ́ ʋ wɩaa liisu.”

english_verse: I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.”
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA, doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ yie dii sarɩya arɩ tʋɔpʋla, a magɩsɛ nɩaa tʋɔbɩɩnaa arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ba nyuŋ lɛ a jɩmba. Leŋ dɩ mɩ na ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ joŋ ŋ baanɩŋ a tiŋ ba lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ joŋ mɩ wɩɩkala hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla a mʋ tɩgɛ Anatɔf baala-la sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Sɩ́ wɩaa bʋl La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee la jaŋ kpʋŋ.

english_verse: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba. Ba bapʋɔsaa jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, dɩ losuŋ kpʋ ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba toloo ma dɩ ba sʋʋ.

english_verse: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
translation_verse: Ba nɩbala ma bɩ jaŋ ka, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛ wʋlɔrʋŋ kʋ hɛ Anatɔf nɩalɩŋ lɛ, jɩna-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba.”

english_verse: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla nɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ, dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ. Ama mɩ ha jaŋ pɩɛsɩŋ wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa vɩvɛŋ woruŋ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ ŋ teeŋ hɔŋ, wɩɩ bɩ baa walɩmɛ?

english_verse: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Ŋ chɔnsɛba a nagɛ tɩa ba sɩ chɔnsɔ nɛ, ba naapoloo tuu woruŋ, ba waa a nɛŋ nɛnɛɛ. Ŋ wɩaa hɛ ba niiree lɛ aŋ bol arɩ ba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But you know, Lord, how faithful I've always been, even in my thoughts. So drag my enemies away and butcher them like sheep!
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ jɩmmɛ nɛ, ŋ namɛ nɛ a magɩsɛ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa na a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ. Lɛrɛ nɩbɔmɔ-la a nagɛ ba sɩ lɛrɛ piesee mʋmʋ dɩ ba kpʋ. Pɔrɛba bil a gbɛrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kpʋba.

english_verse: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ la tinteeŋ chɛ dɩ ʋ hɩla diene magɛ, dɩ yaŋ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ lee-kala hɩl? Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ sɩ bɔmɔ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ pʋsʋŋ, baga kɩaa arɩ zaaraa kala sʋʋ. Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ, “Ʋ bɩ wɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ ŋaa ka na.” Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya

english_verse: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya, “Dɩ ŋ dɩ nɩaa nɛ kɛŋ naasɩŋ fá pɩpagɩsɛ, dɩ ba kɛnɩŋ fá ŋ kala bɛsɩmɛ, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ dɩ janɩŋ jaŋ wuo fá pagɩsɛ? Dɩ ŋ nɛ gɛrɛ tintee-jaala lɛ, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa, dɩ ŋ nɛ hɛ Jɔdaŋ tɩɩ-lugunuŋ tʋɔŋ?

english_verse: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
translation_verse: Ŋ naambiiriŋ, ŋ dɩa nɩaa tɩtɩa nɛ paala joŋuŋ yallɛ. Ba chaasa chɩŋ ŋ lɛ nɛ. Sɩ́ ba laa dii, arɩ ba sɩ bʋl wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ ma kala.

english_verse: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ vɩa mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta, Mɩ jaŋ vɩa mɩ nɩtɩɩlaa ta. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ nɩchooloo hɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: My people have turned against me and roar at me like lions. That's why I hate them.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa mɩɩra nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩ hɛ duuŋ lɛ nɛ a chɩŋ mɩ lɛ. Baa tʋɔrɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ bɛrɛba nɛ.

english_verse: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩtɩɩlaa mɩɩra nagɛ kɩla nɛ mɩ lɛ, kɩllɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ gollu a chu a yuyuo. Mʋ yɩrɛ baga kɩaa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ, a kɛsɛba kɔ dɩ ba dii vɔgɛ.

english_verse: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaaraa yʋga a jaŋ chei mɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga a nʋɔsɛ mɩ tinteeŋ kpal. Ba jaŋ ŋaa dɩ mɩ tintee-la sɩ sɩma mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ kʋŋkʋlʋŋ a pɩŋ hoi.

english_verse: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ chei leriŋ jaŋ kʋ waala tɔ dundollu-la kala sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA tokobiiŋ jaŋ chɩŋ tintee-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, a kpʋ nɩaa deeŋ deeŋ a mʋ yi sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wiesi.

english_verse: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ duu mɛmpɛ aŋ kʋŋ sɔsʋŋ. Ba jaŋ lɔl woruŋ, ama ba bɩ jaŋ na kʋŋkala. Ba jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ ba kʋpɛrɛɛ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA faasa na baanɩŋ nɛ ba nyuŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Nɩbɔmɔ-la sɩ jʋʋ kpɩkpagɛ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa, a kɛŋ dʋa-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩba kaa laa, mɩ jaŋ churi nɩbɔmɔ-la ba tinteeŋ lɛ a nagɛ mɩ sɩ churi Juda nɩaa ba tinteeŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ mɩ nɛ churiba dɛrɛ, mɩ jaŋ bɩra fá ba nenige aŋ kɛŋ ba kʋŋkala mɩɩra kɔ ba tinteeŋ arɩ ba dʋa leriŋ.

english_verse: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
translation_verse: Dɩ tintee-la nɩalɩŋ nɛ gʋnnɛ mɩ nɩaa wombiee woruŋ, a kɛŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ tɩtɩŋ, a bʋbʋl, ‘La ŋmɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ weye,’ arɩ ba fa sɩ leŋe mɩ nɩaa ŋmɩŋmɩɛsɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal yɩrɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ-na ba jaŋ hɔŋ mɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ tintee kala nɩaa nɛ bɩ jegile nɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ churiba ta a cheiba gbelem gbelem. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna fa sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Mʋ yɔɔ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ tɩŋgɛnnɛ a joŋo vɔɔ ŋ tɩŋa, ama sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ digi lɩɩŋ.”

english_verse: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ yɔɔ tɩŋgɛnnɛ-la, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, a joŋo vɔɔ mɩ tɩŋa.

english_verse: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
translation_verse: “Joŋ tɩŋgɛnnɛ-la ŋ sɩ yɔbɔ a vʋvɔɔ a kaa mʋ Pɛraf sɩ kpagɛ Yufireti fuo-la a joŋo faa bʋ-bʋa lɛ.”

english_verse: Some time later the Lord said, “Go back and get the shorts.”
translation_verse: Ʋ dieni, ka La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mʋ Pɛraf a joŋ tɩŋgɛnnɛ-la mɩ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋ kaa mʋ faa nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mʋ Pɛraf lee-la mɩ fa sɩ joŋ tɩŋgɛnnɛ-la faa, a lɩɩsɛ dɩ ʋ kala cheye ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo kaa ŋaa wɩɩkala.

english_verse: Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Kʋ-la sɩ chei ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ, mɩ jaŋ chei Juda nɩaa babii-ballɩŋ arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa ma babii-ballɩɩ-la sɩ faasa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
translation_verse: Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba sɩ vɩa dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ mɩ wɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ba nyuduoŋ harɩŋ, a kire tuto vʋɩyaa harɩŋ a tɩma pɩpɩba a kpʋkpaarɛba jaŋ nagɛ tɩŋgɛnnɛ deeŋ. Ba jaŋ chei a chaasa ŋaa nɩpɛɩba.

english_verse: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
translation_verse: A nagɛ ba sɩ yie joŋ tɩŋgɛnnɛ vɔɔ tɩŋa ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ fa vɔɔ Iziral doho arɩ Juda doho nɩaa kala a mɛrɛ mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ. Mɩ fa ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ba ŋaa mɩ nɩaa nɛ, a dɩdɛnnɛmɛ a yɩyɩrɛ mɩ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ a zizilmi, ama ba fa bɩ jegile nɩɩ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ puroo

english_verse: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba, ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ puru na-kala maga dɩ ʋ su nɛ arɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ.’ Dɩ ba nɛ pɩɛsɩŋ, ‘Ŋ bɩɩna la bɩ jɩŋ arɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ puru na-kala maga dɩ ʋ su arɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ nɛ koo?’

english_verse: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ-na bʋla pɩba, ‘Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ ŋaa sɩ-nyʋara a pɛ Devit doho nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dii kuoruŋ: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ paaba yagɛ a daŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ, nyɩmmaba arɩ biiriŋ kala. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ lemba, mɩ bɩ jaŋ fá ba nenige koo ba nisusuŋ, mɩ jaŋ kpʋba.’ ” Ba fugisi Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ ba jaŋ kɛsɛba mʋ yoŋ-baga

english_verse: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Má kpil dɩgɩlaa a jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla aŋ sɩ́ nyuduoŋ kɛŋ.

english_verse: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.
translation_verse: Má zil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, ka dɩ ʋ-na leŋ dɩ leriŋ biri, dɩ ma gɛrɛ dundollu-la sɩ kɛŋ birimiŋ lɛ. Maa chɛ dɩ ma na pʋlʋmʋŋ nɛ, ama ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ pʋlʋŋ-la bɩrɩmɛ birimiŋ lim, a ŋaa dɩ leriŋ faasa biri woruŋ.

english_verse: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ bɩ jegile nɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ lʋara yel a tɩŋ ma babii-ballɩŋ wɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ chaasa yel woruŋ, dɩ mɩ sɩaa pɩpɛllɛ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jaŋ yuo kɛsɛ La TƖƖNA nɩaa kaa viiri.

english_verse: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Bʋla pɩ kuoru-balɩŋ arɩ ha-kuoro, má tuu ma kuoru kpasɩnɩŋ nyuŋ, ma kuori-nyunchu zɔmɔ-la jaŋ suri ma nyusuŋ lɛ a tuu tel.”

english_verse: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ tɔ tabala-la sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a hɛ, nʋʋkala tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo laaba ta. Ba jaŋ kɛsɛ Juda nɩaa kala a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga, ba jaŋ kɛsɛ ba kala a kaa viiri.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma sɩaa je a na nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ kʋkɔ. Nɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ hɛ, nɩalɩŋ ma fa sɩ kaa ŋmoo bɔyɛ?

english_verse: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ bʋl dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ leŋe nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ joŋo arɩ ba dɩ ma niiŋ chaasa ŋaa kʋbala nɛ mɩɩra kɛŋ doluŋ ma nyuŋ? Hɛɛŋ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋma a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ ŋɩɩ?

english_verse: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ pɩɛsɛ ma tɩtɩa, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa la lɛ?” Ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ yʋga wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ba kɩɛsɛ ma gɛnnɩŋ aŋ dɔgɩsɛma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
translation_verse: Kus tɩɩna jaŋ wuo kɛŋ ʋ yaraa bɩrɩmɛ koo kpeye jaŋ wuo kɛŋ ʋ yaraa sɩ ŋaa ŋmʋna ŋmʋna ŋɩɩ a bɩrɩmɛ? Ma ma saa bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ma ŋaa mal.

english_verse: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ kɛmma pɩsɛ a nagɛ mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ peliŋ sɩ paa vɩvɛŋ.

english_verse: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
translation_verse: Ma toruŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, kpaal-la mɩ sɩ daga pɩma nɛ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla, bɛɛ wɩaa ma yʋ mɩ wɩaa nɛ aŋ joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩ vʋɩyaa lɛ.

english_verse: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ polli ma gɛnnɩŋ ta, ka dɩ nɩaa na ma hɩɩsɩŋ,

english_verse: So I'll rip off your clothes and leave you naked and ashamed for everyone to see. You are doomed! Will you ever be worthy to worship me again?
translation_verse: a tɩŋ ma wʋchɔrʋmɔɔ arɩ ma sɩaa wʋchoolie-la ma sɩ hiine chɛ, arɩ hɩɩsɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa lɛ. Mɩ na wʋkɩsɩa-la ma sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ dundolluŋ arɩ bagɩsɩŋ lɛ. Jerusalɛm tɩmma, wɩɩŋ puuma. Ɛɛ nɛ maa chɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ disiniŋ a diene magɛ?”

english_verse: When there had been no rain for a long time, the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya a mʋ tɩgɛ hɩlɩŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.
translation_verse: Nɩyuŋoo tɩŋ ba tɩntɩnnaa nɛ dɩ ba mʋ ŋaa lɩɩŋ. Ba mʋ vilee, aŋ bɩ lɩɩŋ na. Ba mɩɩra kɛŋ nyuvii-hɩlaa nɛ kɔ. Ba tʋɔŋ chei, ba nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ, hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmba, ba kɛŋ kɩaa tɔ ba nyusuŋ.

english_verse: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ yɛrɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa duonuŋ bɩ tintee-la lɛ nɩa. Paaraa nandaasɩŋ yʋɔra nɛ, ba kɛŋ kɩaa tɔ ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
translation_verse: Aamaa ma sɩ hɛ gɩrɩŋ tʋɔŋ paala vɩa ba biiriŋ ta nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa yaŋ tuo.

english_verse: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
translation_verse: Bʋrʋmba chɩŋ dundol kpʋlaa nyuŋ nɛ a huhuosi a nagɛ jolluŋ. Ba sɩaa bɩra bɩ na, bɛɛ wɩaa yaŋ tuo.”

english_verse: We rejected you and did evil, so we deserve to be punished. But if you rescue us, Lord, everyone will see how great you are.
translation_verse: La wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ daga arɩ la ŋaa chei nɛ. La TƖƖNA, tɩŋ ŋ yɩrɩŋ wɩaa a ŋaa wɩɩ pɩla. La vɩa ŋ harɩŋ tonuŋ a yʋgɛ nɛ, la ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You're our only hope; you alone can save us now. You help us one day, but you're gone the next.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ la Iziral tɩŋŋaa yɩyɩɛlɛ, ŋ nɛ la Laataara, a lɩlɩɩsɛla la wʋjʋʋlaa lɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ nagɛ nʋhʋɔrʋ tintee-la lɛ a nagɛ wombii-vɛnnʋ sɩ mʋ chʋa leriŋ tapʋl bala?

english_verse: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ nagɛ nʋʋ ba sɩ ŋaa wɩaa a dɩ ʋ lɛ a nagɛ laalɩyuori wajɩa sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ laa nɩaa ta? La TƖƖNA, ŋ hɛ la tʋɔŋ nɛ, la ŋaa ŋ nɩaa nɛ, sɩ́ la vɩa ta.

english_verse: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ nɩaa deemba lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Ba chaasa cho dɩ ba gɔllɔɔ baarɛ nɛ. Ba naasɩŋ bɩ lee-kala buo. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA bɩ ba laa. Lɛɛlɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ liisi ba tʋɔhɛɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa, a dɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, “Sɩ́ mɩ sʋla chɩchɛ dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩ nɩaa deemba.

english_verse: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Arɩ ba sɩɩ vɔɔ niiŋ ma kala, mɩ bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ ba yele. Ba ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩpɩmɛ ma nɛ, ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ laaba. Mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra joŋ laalɩŋ, losuŋ arɩ nyanyalɩŋ a hɛ ba lɛ dɩ ba sʋʋ.”

english_verse: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
translation_verse: Ama mɩ sɩ, “Ah, La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa vɛnɛ bʋla pɩpɩba nɛ arɩ ŋ sɩ, ‘Laalɩŋ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋma koo dɩ losuŋ jʋʋma dɩ ma na hɛɛŋ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ a kaa mʋmʋ wuu.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nɩaa deemba bɩ mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa ŋaa, baa nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ bɩ ba tɩma koo a lɩɩsɛba koo a bʋl wɩɩ pɩba. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ a bʋla pɩma ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ, wʋyaayaasɩ-la ba sɩ vʋga nɩna, arɩ ba tɩtɩa tʋɔbɩɩnaa wɩalɩŋ ka nyɩsɛba nɛ.

english_verse: Those lying prophets say there will be peace and plenty of food. But I say that those same prophets will die from war and hunger.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ dee bɩ ba hɛ, ka ba bʋbʋl, ‘Laalɩŋ koo losuŋ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ tinteeŋ deeŋ.’ Laalɩŋ jaŋ kpʋ wʋlaabʋllaa deemba tɩtɩa, dɩ losuŋ ma kɛŋ dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba sʋʋ.

english_verse: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ ma ba sɩ nyɩɛ wɩalɩŋ pɩpa, jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, dɩ losuŋ ma kɛŋ ba dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba sʋʋ, dɩ ba paaba yuo ta Jerusalɛm womporunuŋ lɛ. Nʋʋkala jaŋ tuo dɩ ʋ hugi ba dɩ ba haalaa, ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba hantolibiisiŋ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ hɛɛ-la sɩ maga dɩ ba na a hɛ ba lɛ.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩba: “Mɩ sɩaa ka pɛllɛ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala nɛ a bɩ kɛrɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɩaa chaasa bolimi nɛ a nɩna hɛɛŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ jɩl pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ, mɩ yie na nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa laalɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ jʋʋ tabal-la tʋɔŋ ma, mɩ yie na nɩaa losuŋ sɩ kɛnɛ ba sʋʋ nɛ. Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kala mʋ tintee-la ba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Have you rejected Judah, Lord? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Ŋ vɩa Juda nɩaa ta biri biri nɛɛ? Ŋ bɛrɛ Jerusalɛm nɩaa nɛɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bolimi la ŋɩɩ kɩŋkɛŋ, dɩ ba sɩ́ wuo vaarɛla? La faa yɩɛlɛ dɩ la hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ nɛ, ama la bɩ ŋɩɩ na. Bʋa-la sɩ maga dɩ la duoro lɩɩ wɩaa lɛ, fawʋllʋŋ nɛ mɩɩra faasa kɛnla.

english_verse: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ŋ yɩrɩŋ wɩaa, sɩ́ la vɩa ta. Sɩ́ hɩɩsɩŋ joŋo hɛ ŋ kuoru kpasa sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Liise yi nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ la dɩ ŋ pɛgɛ lɛ a sɩ́ ʋ chei.

english_verse: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa vʋɩ pɛɩba-la kʋŋ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ? Wɩa-nyuŋ ma tɩtɩa bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ. Ŋ-na La TƖƖNA Wɩa nɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, la joŋ la yɩɛlaa hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ nɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Dɩ Mosis arɩ Samʋɛl nɛ fa paala kʋ chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ a sʋlmɛ ma, mɩ bɩ jaŋ fá nɩaa deemba nenige. Kiriba ta dɩ ba sʋrɩsɛ mɩ sɩpaaŋ! Leŋ dɩ ba mʋ!

english_verse: And when they ask where they are going, tell them that I, the Lord, have said: Some of you are going to die of horrible diseases. Others are going to die in war or from starvation. The rest will be led away to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ pɩɛsɩŋ, ‘Nɩɩ nɛ la jaŋ mʋ?’ bʋla pɩba, Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Nɩalɩŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ jaŋ kpʋ, ba jaŋ kpʋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ sʋʋ. Nɩalɩŋ losuŋ sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ dɩ ba sʋʋ, ba jaŋ sʋʋ. Nɩalɩŋ ma ba sɩ jaŋ kɛsɛ mʋ yoŋ-baga, ba jaŋ kɛsɛ mʋ.’

english_verse: I will punish you in four different ways: You will be killed in war and your bodies dragged off by dogs, your flesh will be eaten by birds, and your bones will be chewed on by wild animals.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wɩaa banɛsɛ sɩ jaŋ cheiba a hɛ ba lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Ba jaŋ kpʋba laalɩŋ lɛ, dɩ vasɩŋ lɛrɛba kaa viiri, dɩ zaaraa arɩ baga kɩaa diiba, a kɛmba chei.

english_verse: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ba nagɛ kʋŋ sɩɩ sʋɔrʋ dʋnɩa kuoroo kala teeŋ, a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ Hezikaaya nanʋala Manasɛ sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ a ŋaa Jerusalɛm lɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm nɩaa, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ fá ma nenige? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ bunsi ma wɩaa? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ chɩna pɩɛsa na ma yarɩfɩɛlaa wɩaa?

english_verse: My people, you abandoned me and walked away. I am tired of showing mercy; that's why I'll destroy you
translation_verse: Ma vɩamɛ nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Ma joŋ harɩŋ yɩyɩamɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ joŋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ ma lɛ a cheima. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo fá ma nisusuŋ.

english_verse: by scattering you like straw blown by the wind. I will punish you with sorrow and death, because you refuse to change your ways.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩ-chaarɛ gbaŋa chaarɛma a balɩma lɩɩsɛma tintee-la tabalɩŋ boi-baalaa niiŋ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ tʋɔ-cheeŋ hɛ mɩ nɩaa lɛ, mɩ jaŋ cheiba, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ leŋe.

english_verse: There will be more widows in Judah than grains of sand on a beach. A surprise attack at noon! And the mothers in Jerusalem mourn for their children.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba yo-haalaa faasa pʋrɩgɛ, a kɩɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ hagɩlɩ-bumbugulo. Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chei leriŋ kʋ hɛ ba lɛ wɩɩhɛɩ-siesee, dɩ ba kpʋ ba bapʋɔsɛ-biisiŋ, ka dɩ ba naamba bibeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ guu lɛrɛ tʋɔ-cheeŋ arɩ wɩaa sɩ faasa kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a kʋ hɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: A mother is in deep despair and struggles for breath. Her daylight has turned to darkness— she has suffered the loss of her seven sons. I will kill anyone who survives. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jeremiah Complains
translation_verse: Naaŋ-la sɩ kɛŋ biiriŋ balɩpɛ jaŋ yiegi, a wiese lʋlɔl. Ʋ wɩɩ-muluŋ jaŋ jʋʋ, ka ʋ ha ŋaa wɩɩhɛyɛ. Ba jaŋ hɩɩsʋ a jolimu. Mɩ jaŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka a bɩ sʋba ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩpaaŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: I wish I had never been born! I'm always in trouble with everyone in Judah. I never lend or borrow money, but everyone curses me just the same.
translation_verse: Mɩ naaŋ, ŋ lʋlmɛ hɛ wɩaa lɛ nɛ, mɩ ŋaa nʋʋ tintee-la nɩaa kala kaa yuyuo yuosuŋ. Mɩ ha bɩ kʋŋ joŋo chɩŋ nʋʋ, mɩ bɩ nʋʋ ma chɩŋ die, ka nʋʋkala ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.” The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ laaŋ ta wʋzɔŋ wɩaa. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kʋ sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ pɛ ba lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ wʋlɔrʋŋ arɩ hɛɛŋ sɩ jaŋ jʋʋba.

english_verse: People of Judah, just as you can't break iron mixed with bronze, you can't defeat the enemies that will attack from the north.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine bɩ jaŋ wuo bori hɔɔŋ arɩ kɔlɩɩŋ hɔɔ-la ba sɩ kaa lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: I will give them everything you own, because you have sinned everywhere in your country.
translation_verse: Ma dʋa arɩ ma kɩaa kala, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa kʋ paaba viiri, ba bɩ jaŋ tiŋ kʋŋkala a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ma sɩ ŋaa ma tinteeŋ kala lɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land. Jeremiah Complains Again
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yosi, tintee-la ma sɩ bɩ jɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ baanɩŋ jaŋ sii a nagɛ nyiniŋ ma nyuŋ a diima.”

english_verse: You can see how I suffer insult after insult, all because of you, Lord. Don't be so patient with my enemies; take revenge on them before they kill me.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ jɩŋ wɩɩkala sɩaa nɛ, liisi mɩ wɩaa aŋ beŋ mɩ nyuŋ. Laa mɩ yuosuŋ yuo pɩmɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ to naasɩŋ dɔgɩsɛmɛ lɛ. Sɩ́ nyalɩma bibeŋ ka dɩ ba kpʋmɛ. Liise yi ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ dii hɩɩsɩŋ ŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: When you spoke to me, I was glad to obey, because I belong to you, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ bʋl ŋ wɩaa pɩmɛ, mɩ jegile nɩɩ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ nɩɩ pɩmɛ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, mɩ choba woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ ŋaa ŋ nʋʋ nɛ, La TƖƖNA Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: I don't go to parties and have a good time. Instead, I keep to myself, because you have filled me with your anger.
translation_verse: Mɩ ha bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ nɩɩ sɩma a yie hɔnɔ ŋɩŋaa goŋ harɩŋ to, mɩ dɩ ba ha bɩ hɔnɔ dii kɩaa a gbieli. Mɩ yie hɔŋ mɩ dʋndʋŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ nɛ kɛmmɛ tɩtɩŋ, ŋ joŋ ŋ baanɩŋ hɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: I am badly injured and in constant pain. Are you going to disappoint me, like a stream that goes dry in the heat of summer? The Lord Replies
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ hɛɛŋ bɩ dɛrɛ, mɩ naawɩɩlaa ma faasa verigi a bɩ fɩɛlɛ? Ŋ chɛ ŋ nyɩsɛmɛ a nagɛ fuoŋ sɩ yie hɩl wulumuŋ lɛ nɛ koo a nagɛ lɩɩ-bul-sɩɩŋ sɩ tɔ nɛɛ?

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya nɛ ŋ-la: “Dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ bɩra kʋ tɩma pɩpɩmɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ jaŋ leŋ wʋtɔɔnʋŋ bʋlʋŋ, aŋ bʋbʋl wɩaa sɩ kɛŋ bʋbʋɔŋ, ŋ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ. Leŋ dɩ nɩaa deemba nɛ mɩɩra kʋ toŋ, ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ nɛ toba.

english_verse: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ laaŋ ta nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a laaŋ ta tʋɔhɛɛ tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.
translation_verse: “Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ jaa haala a lʋl biiriŋ leriŋ deeŋ.”

english_verse: I'll tell you what's going to happen to children and their parents here.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla a mʋ tɩgɛ hambolibiisi-la arɩ hantolibiisi-la ba sɩ lʋla tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ, ba naamba arɩ ba nyɩmmaba lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
translation_verse: “Nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kpʋba. Ba bɩ jaŋ hugiba koo a yel ba yoho. Ba jaŋ nagɛ nʋsʋrʋŋ a pɩŋ tinteeŋ. Ba jaŋ kpʋ dɔnsʋŋ laalɩŋ lɛ, dɩ losuŋ ma kɛŋ dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba sʋʋ. Ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ zaaraa arɩ baga kɩaa kʋdiilee.”

english_verse: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.
translation_verse: Nɩbalaa arɩ nɩbiisiŋ kala jaŋ sʋʋ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ. Ba bɩ jaŋ hugiba koo a yel ba yosuŋ. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ tɩŋ ba wɩaa a kpɛrɛ ʋ tɩtɩa koo a fʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: No one will bring food and wine to help comfort those who are mourning the death of their father or mother.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ joŋ kʋdiilii a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yel yoho, dɩ ʋ nyɩmma koo ʋ naaŋ nɛ paala sʋʋ ma, nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ joŋ kʋnyʋalɩɩ ma paala pɩba a nyagɛ ba bɔyɛ.

english_verse: Don't even set foot in a house where there is eating and drinking and celebrating.
translation_verse: Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ dɩa kala lɛ ba sɩ ŋaa kʋdiilee dii aŋ gbigbieli jʋʋ, a hɔŋ nɩmɛ dii kɩaa aŋ nyʋa kɩaa.

english_verse: Warn the people of Judah that I, the Lord All-Powerful, will put an end to all their parties and wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ŋ sɩɩŋ jaŋ na dɩ mɩ leŋe dɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ goŋ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa kala dɛrɛ, dɩ ha-falaa arɩ ba balaba goŋ ma dɛrɛ leriŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: They will ask, “Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him?”
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ bʋl wɩaa deemba kala pɩ nɩaa deemba dɩ ba pɩɛsɩŋ, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA bʋl wʋlɔrʋŋ deeŋ a tɩgɛ la lɛ? Wʋbɛɛ nɛ la chei? Wʋbɔŋ bɛɛ nɛ la ŋaa La TƖƖNA Wɩa lɛ?’

english_verse: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ-na bʋla pɩba, ‘A tɩŋ ma naabalɩmaba sɩ vɩamɛ, aŋ to vesiŋ, a kpaarɛba wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ.’ Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Ba vɩamɛ nɛ a bɩ mɩ wombii-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto ka to.

english_verse: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.
translation_verse: Ama ma nɛ paala ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a kɩɩ ma naabalɩmaba-la. Ma kʋŋkala kɛŋ nyuduoŋ nɛ a to ʋ tʋɔbɔmʋŋ harɩŋ, aŋ vɩa dɩ ʋ sɛɩ mɩ niiŋ.

english_verse: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛma tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ tintee dɔŋ, ma-na koo ma naabalɩmaba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ. Nɩmɛ nɛ, ma jaŋ tuto vesiŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ fá ma nenige.”

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Tapʋlaa ka kɔ nɛ, nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ bʋl, ‘La ŋmɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ weye, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.’

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go. Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ama ba jaŋ bʋl, ‘La ŋmɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ weye, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kaa lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa tinteeŋ arɩ tinteye-la kala lɛ ʋ sɩ kɛmba pɩsa hɛ.’ Mɩ jaŋ bɩra leŋ dɩ ba kʋ tɩɩ tintee-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩ ba naabalɩmaba.

english_verse: But for now, I am sending enemies who will catch you like fish and hunt you down like wild animals in the hills and the caves.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ tɩma yɩrɛ nɩ-daŋ dɩ ba kʋ kɛsɛ nɩaa deemba a nagɛ chenfil-kpʋʋra sɩɩ kɛsɛ chenfilee. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ tɩma yɩrɛ nambagɩlaa ma a yʋgɛ, dɩ ba kʋ bagɩla kɛsɛba peelee arɩ dundolluŋ nyuŋ arɩ bʋ-pɛgɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩaa ka na ba wʋŋaalaa kala nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala bɩ faa mɩ teeŋ. Ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma bɩ faa mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies. The Lord Gives Strength I prayed to the Lord:
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ timba naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ba wʋcheelee wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ mɩ tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ arɩ ba tɔmɔ-la sɩ bɩ wei, a leŋ mɩ tinteeŋ su arɩ ba tɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩɩ kɩsʋ.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, “Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, mɩ doluŋ arɩ mɩ dɩ-duoŋ, ŋ nɛ mɩ yie yuori dɩ hɛɛŋ nɛ jʋʋmɛ. Tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ kɔ ŋ teeŋ, a lɩɩ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala a bʋl, La naabalɩmaba bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ see vesiŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ, tɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩba a bɩ wʋzɔŋ kala ŋaa pɩba.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ-na mɩ jaŋ dagɛba bʋa deeŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ dagɛba mɩ doluŋ kala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: People of Judah, your sins cannot be erased. They are written on your hearts like words chiseled in stone or carved on the corners of your altars. *
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩ, “Hɔɔŋ nɛ ba kaa ŋmʋnsɛ Juda wʋbɔmʋŋ. Hɔɔ-chʋlachʋla-bie nɛ ba kaa tuuri. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ arɩ ba vʋɩ-kpaarɛ korunuŋ nyilliŋ lɛ.

english_verse: One generation after another has set up pagan altars and worshiped the goddess Asherah everywhere in your country— on hills and mountains, and under large trees.
translation_verse: Ba biiriŋ ma paala ka liisi ba vʋɩyaa korunu-la wɩaa nɛ arɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ ba sɩ pɛ tɩɩ-lugu na-kala bʋbʋɔŋ arɩ dundolluŋ sɩ leŋie nyuŋ.

english_verse: You will lose the land that I gave you, and I will make you slaves in a foreign country, because you have made my anger blaze up like a fire that won't stop burning. Trust the Lord
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ma tɩtɩa cheeriŋ wɩaa, dʋa-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩma jaŋ lɛl ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yosi, tintee-la ma sɩ bɩ jɩŋ lɛ. Ma leŋe mɩ baanɩŋ faasa sii ma nyuŋ nɛ, ʋ saa bɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ.”

english_verse: But I will bless those who trust me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ laamɛ dii lɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa hɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: They will be like trees growing beside a stream— trees with roots that reach down to the water, and with leaves that are always green. They bear fruit every year and are never worried by a lack of rain.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ tɩa ba sɩ chɔnsɔ a kpagɛ lɩɩŋ, ʋ naapoloo tɛllɛ mʋ jʋʋ fuoŋ. Ʋ bɩ lɩmɩŋ ka fá. Ʋ pɩpaarɩŋ yie biri nɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ. Ʋ-na sɩpaa tuo, dɩ hɩlɩŋ nɛ chɩna ma, ʋ yie nɩnɛŋ bʋa na-kala lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine tʋɔŋ nɛ jaŋ wuo nyɩsɛ nɩa a kɩɩ kʋŋkala. Ʋ ŋaa kʋŋ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ wuo tɩɩbɛ nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ nuhuobiine tʋɔŋ wɩaa sɩaa?

english_verse: But I know your deeds and your thoughts, and I will make sure you get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ yie beŋ nɩa tʋɔŋ a magɩsʋ na wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ aŋ timu a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ mɛlɛ, arɩ ʋ wʋŋaalaa sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ lɛ.”

english_verse: You cheated others, but everything you gained will fly away, like birds hatched from stolen eggs. Then you will discover what fools you are. Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: A nagɛ yoho sɩ bɩ halaa lo, aŋ pɛŋ hala-la nyuŋ a tiesi, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋmʋrɛ nɩaa a dʋa kɩaa nagɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ yi ʋ jɩsɩŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, ʋ dʋa-la jaŋ lɛl. Dɩdɛrɩŋ kala, ʋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ʋ ŋaa nɩyaarɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.
translation_verse: Dɩ-suomuŋ kala nɛ la Wɩa kuoru kpasa kɛŋ tʋla a leŋie kɩɩ kʋŋkala. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa la Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: You are a spring of water giving Israel life and hope. But if the people reject what you have told me, they will be swept away like words written in dust.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ lɛ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa yɩɛlaa kala hɛ. Hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ dii nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ joŋ harɩŋ yɩaŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ mɩɩrɛ ŋ harɩŋ yɩrɩŋ jaŋ lɛl a nagɛ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ nɩa yɩrɩŋ bil hagɩla lɛ, a tɩŋ ba sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA sɩɩ pɩba mɩɩsɩŋ a nagɛ lɩɩ-bulo.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, vaarɛmɛ, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ duori. Dɩ ŋ nɛ laamɛ ta, mɩ jaŋ na wiese, ŋ nɛ mɩɩ dɛnnɛ.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to me, “Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true?”
translation_verse: Nɩaa vɛnɛɛ pɩɛsɛmɛ bʋa kala, “La TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩalɩŋ hɛ nɩɩ? Leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ lɛɛlɛ sɛnɛ ŋaa.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ ŋ harɩŋ mɩɩra a vɩa dɩ mɩ ŋaa ŋ pie-daarʋ. Mɩ ha bɩ bɩɩna arɩ maachie wʋlɔrʋŋ jaŋ jʋʋ ŋ nɩaa. Ŋ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ bʋl nɛ.

english_verse: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ kɩŋkɛŋ. Ŋ nɛ mɩɩ yuori bʋa na-kala dɩ wʋlɔrʋŋ nɛ jʋʋmɛ.

english_verse: Keep me from failure and disgrace, but make my enemies fail and be disgraced. Send destruction to make their worst fears come true. Resting on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ to naasɩŋ dɔgɩsɛmɛ dii hɩɩsɩŋ, ama lɩɩsɛ mɩ-na hɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba, ama lɩɩsɛ mɩ-na wɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ lɛ. Leŋ dɩ wʋlɔrʋŋ kʋ jʋʋba. Cheiba naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa. Ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ tuto chɛ-wiesii-la woruŋ

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord, so pay attention.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba: Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA wɩaa, Juda kuoroo arɩ Juda nɩaa kala, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ a to boi-baalaa deemba jʋjʋʋ.

english_verse: If you value your lives, don't do any work on the Sabbath. Don't carry anything through the city gates or through the door of your house, or anywhere else. Keep the Sabbath day sacred! I gave this command to your ancestors, but they were stubborn and refused to obey or to be corrected. But if you obey,
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ, dɩ ma-na nɛ fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a to mɩ niiŋ a bɩ kɩaa chʋŋa to boi-baala-la kʋʋ jʋʋ aŋ lɩlɩɩ tabal-la lɛ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, a bɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala ka tɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la, aŋ joŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la dɩ ʋ ŋaa tapʋl-zɔŋ,

english_verse: then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na kuorusu-la sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ Devit kuoru kpasa nyuŋ arɩ ba tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ jaŋ to boi-baalaa deemba kʋ jʋʋ tabal-la. Ba dɩ ba tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ jaŋ jɩl janɩŋ arɩ janɩŋ torukoba a kʋ jʋʋ. Juda nɩaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ jaŋ hɔŋ tabalɩŋ deeŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ lɩɩ Juda tasɩŋ arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ golli Jerusalɛm a kɔ. Dɔnsʋŋ ma jaŋ lɩɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ arɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ, arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, pʋsʋŋ ma ba sɩ jaŋ kpʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa ma ba sɩ jaŋ kaa lɔllɛmɛ a kaa kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩa.

english_verse: But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ bɩ mɩ niiŋ to a joŋ chɛ-wiesii-la dɩ ʋ ŋaa tapʋl-zɔŋ, aŋ chʋŋ kɩaa to boi-baala-la kʋʋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, ŋɩɩ-na mɩ jaŋ chol nyiniŋ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩsɛ a hɛ Jerusalɛm boi-baala-la lɛ dɩ ʋ dii Jerusalɛm dɩɩ-duoruŋ kala.”

english_verse: I went there and saw the potter making clay pots on his pottery wheel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mʋ pupo-mɛɛrɛ dɩa, a na dɩ ʋʋ mɛ pupoiŋ bʋbʋa-chala soro lɛ.

english_verse: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
translation_verse: Pupo-mɛɛrʋ-la sɩ cho dɩ ʋ mɛ pupoi-la dɩ ʋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ, ka ʋ bɩ ŋɩɩ naga, ʋ bɩra kɛŋ chʋrʋ-la kala ŋmʋra hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a mɛ pupoiŋ dɔŋ, ʋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ:

english_verse: People of Israel, I, the Lord, have power over you, just as a potter has power over clay.
translation_verse: “Iziral tɩmma, mɩ bɩ wombiiŋ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaama ŋɩɩ arɩ pupo-mɛɛrʋ-la sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ chʋrʋ-la lɛɛ? A nagɛ chʋrʋ-la sɩ hɛ pupo-mɛɛrʋ-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If I threaten to uproot and shatter an evil nation,
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋla bʋa na-kala lɛ arɩ mɩ jaŋ churi tintee nɩaa koo kuoru-gentine a yige lo a cheiba,

english_verse: but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.
translation_verse: ka dɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ mɩ sɩɩŋ lɛ a bɩ mɩ niiŋ sɛyɛ, ŋɩɩ-na mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋzɔŋ-la mɩ fa sɩ bɩɩna dɩ mɩ ŋaa pɩba a bɩrɩmɛ.

english_verse: So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ bʋla pɩ Juda nɩaa arɩ ba nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má bee na, mɩɩ bɩɩnɛ wɩɩ nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa ma lɛ. Wʋlɔrʋ nɛ mɩɩ bɩɩnɛ dɩ mɩ joŋo dɔgɩsɛma. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má kʋŋkala bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Ma bɩrɩmɛ ma mɛlɛ arɩ ma wʋŋaalaa.’

english_verse: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
translation_verse: Ama ba jaŋ bʋl, ‘Ŋɩɩ bɩ bʋbʋa kala kɛnɛ. La jaŋ tuto la wombie-la la tɩtɩa sɩ vʋʋra bil. La kʋŋkala jaŋ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a to ʋ tʋɔbɔmʋŋ harɩŋ.’ ”

english_verse: So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ma pɩɛsɛ tinteyee lɛ a na, kʋbɛɛ nɛ ha nɩɩ wʋdoho deeŋ? Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wɩɩ sɩ chaasa lɔrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The snow on Lebanon's mountains never melts away, and the streams there never run dry.
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-la sɩ faasa fɩɛlɛ a gulimi Lɛbanɔŋ peel-leŋie-la lɛ lere-la sɩ chullo tutuu ka lɛl nɛɛ? Ʋ lɩɩ-fɩɛla-la sɩ pɩna a pɛllɛ lɩɩ dɩ-bolii kʋkɔ ka kɛrɛ nɛɛ?

english_verse: But you, my people, have turned from me to burn incense to worthless idols. You have left the ancient road to follow an unknown path where you stumble over idols.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ nɩaa yʋ mɩ wɩaa nɛ. Ba nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a pɩpɩ tɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩba nɛ. Tɔmɔ-la nɛ leŋe ba titel ba wʋŋaalaa lɛ, a bɩ wombii-bɩnɩa-la ka to. Tɔmɔ-la leŋe ba vɩvɛŋ wombiee ba sɩ vɩa ta lɛ nɛ, wombiee ba sɩ bɩ wasa.

english_verse: Your land will be ruined, and every passerby will look at it with horror and make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Ba tinteeŋ jaŋ pɩŋ pɛɩ, dɩ nɩaa mʋmɔŋ ʋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ʋ wɩaa jaŋ kperi nʋʋkala sɩ to nɩmɛ a bɩbal, dɩ ba vivigisi nyuŋ.

english_verse: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ nɩaa pɩsɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩpaaŋ, a nagɛ peliŋ sɩ du lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ a paa kʋŋkɔlʋŋ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ harɩŋ yɩaba, mɩ sɩpaaŋ dee, tapʋlɩɩ-la wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ sɩ jaŋ jʋʋba.”

english_verse: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
translation_verse: Ba sɩ, “Má kɔ dɩ la vʋʋrɛ wɩɩ-la la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Jɛrɩmaaya lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa dɩ la nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ma, wɩalɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ daga a tɩgɛ wombii-la ba sɩ bile dɩ la tuto bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba lɛlɛ. Wʋjɩnnaa ma sɩɩ dagɛ wɩalɩŋ arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba lɛlɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má leŋ dɩ la nyɩɛ wɩaa pʋ aŋ sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl jegilu.”

english_verse: Please, Lord, answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ chɩŋ mɩ lɛ sɩɩ bʋl.

english_verse: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ba joŋ wʋbɔmʋŋ a tiŋ wʋzɔmʋŋ chɩmɩŋ nɛɛ? Ama ba lu bʋa nɛ a bil mɩ lɛ. La Tɩɩna, liise yi arɩ mɩ chɩŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ a laa ba wɩaa bʋl, dɩ ŋ leŋ baaŋ-la ŋ fa sɩ na ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La Tɩɩna, leŋ dɩ losuŋ kpʋ ba biiriŋ dɩ ba sʋʋ. Leŋ dɩ ba sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba haalaa sɩ́ biiriŋ kɛŋ aŋ ŋaa yo-haalaa. Leŋ dɩ ba kpʋ ba baalaa arɩ bapʋɔsaa kala laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ nɩaa nɩɩ ba nii-ŋmobo ba dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋ nɛ guu kɛŋ nɩaa sɩ jaŋ yuoba aŋ paa ba kɩaa kʋ hɛ ba lɛ. Ba lu bʋa nɛ dɩ mɩ foro tuu aŋ hɛ bɛrɩsɩŋ ma dɩ ba kɛmmɛ.

english_verse: You know they plan to kill me. So get angry and punish them! Don't ever forgive their terrible crimes.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ kala ba sɩ vʋʋra dɩ ba kpʋmɛ nɛ. Sɩ́ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛba, sɩ́ ŋ sɩaa lɩɩsɛ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Leŋ dɩ ba tele bilimi ŋ sɩpaaŋ. Na baanɩŋ a dɔgɩsɛba.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la, “Mʋ yɔɔ taga pupo-mɛɛrɛ teeŋ. Pɛ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɔnsʋŋ,
