english_verse: and go to Hinnom Valley, just outside Potsherd Gate. Tell the people that I have said:
translation_verse: dɩ ma mʋ Bɛŋ-Hɩnɔm fuonaaŋ sɩ kpagɛ kanchelliŋ boi-baalɩŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ nɩmɛ, bʋl wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
translation_verse: Bʋl, ‘Juda kuoroo arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA wɩaa.’ Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má jegile nɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋlɔrʋŋ kʋ hɛ leriŋ deeŋ nɩaa lɛ. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ nɩɩʋ ʋ dɩgɩlaa jaŋ chɩɩmɛ.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla tapʋlaa ka kɔ nɛ nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ leriŋ deeŋ Tɔfɛf koo Bɛŋ Hɩnɔm fuonaaŋ, ama ba jaŋ yɩrʋ fuonaa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ kpʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Leriŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ chei Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ vʋʋra. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diiba a kpʋba laalɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ ba lɩɩsɛ ba mɩɩsɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ a pɩ zaaraa arɩ baga kɩaa.

english_verse: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chei tabalɩŋ deeŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋŋ nɩaa sɩ jaŋ mʋmɔŋ. Ʋ wɩaa jaŋ kperi nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ to nɩmɛ bɩbal, dɩ ba sisieri ʋ lɛ a tɩŋ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ cheyu.

english_verse: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba gʋra chaŋ ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ hantolibiisiŋ nammɩa. Bʋa-la lɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ jaŋ faasa tɔba hɛ, ba jaŋ gʋra chɩchaŋ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
translation_verse: Jɛrɩmaaya, dɩ ŋ nɛ bʋl wɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ, joŋ taga-la yaga yɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ to ŋ harɩŋ mʋ sɩpaaŋ,

english_verse: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pɩba, ‘Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ yɛrɛ tinteeŋ deeŋ arɩ tabalɩŋ deeŋ a nagɛ ŋɩɩ taga deeŋ sɩ yɛrɛ, ŋ bɩra bɩ ʋ wuo kaa mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ. Ba jaŋ hugi sʋʋnʋŋ Tɔfɛf lɛ ŋɩɩ halɩɩ dɩ ʋ tinteeŋ kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ Juda kuoroo dɩɩsɩŋ kala jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ a nagɛ Tɔfɛf. Ba dɩɩsɩ-la kala lɛ ba sɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ lusuŋ-nyuŋ a pɩpɩ chɛnɛ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa aŋ ŋaa kʋnyʋalaa ma pɩpɩ ba vesiŋ kala jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.’ ”

english_verse: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya mɩɩra lɩɩ Tɔfɛf kɔ lee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ kɛnʋ mʋ dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩaa ʋ doluŋ lɛ, a kʋ chɩŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ kaala tʋɔŋ a bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala,

english_verse: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
translation_verse: “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Má jegile nɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la mɩ sɩ daga a kʋ hɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ arɩ tabiisi-la kala sɩ gollu lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba kɛŋ nyuduoŋ nɛ a bɩ chɛ ba jegile nɩɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa.’ ”

english_verse: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said,
translation_verse: Ɩma nanʋala Pasɩhɔ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, aŋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnaa nɩhɩaŋ ma, sɩ nɩa dɩ Jɛrɩmaaya ka bʋl wɩalɩŋ Wɩa doluŋ lɛ,

english_verse: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: ʋ leŋ ba ŋmoo Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya, aŋ kɛnʋ jɩla hɛ kuruŋ Bɛnjamɩŋ boi-baal-la sɩ kpagɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ.

english_verse: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, Pasɩhɔ lɩɩsʋ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ Jɛrɩmaaya bʋla pʋ, “Yɩrɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩɩ yɩrɩŋ bɩra dee Pasɩhɔ, ŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Magɔ-Misabib .

english_verse: You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ dɩ ŋ ma leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ ŋ nandɔnsʋŋ. Ŋ sɩɩŋ lɛ, ŋ nandɔnsʋ-la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kpʋba. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ Juda nɩaa kala hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ kpʋ dɔnsʋŋ a kɛŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma mʋ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Ŋ-na Pasɩhɔ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ŋ dɩa lɛ jaŋ mʋ yoŋ-baga Babɩlɔŋ lɛ. Ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ nɩmɛ dɩ ba huguŋ, ŋ dɩ ŋ nandɔnsʋ-la kala ŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa pa.’ ” Jɛrɩmaaya sɩ ŋmɛnɛ

english_verse: You tricked me, Lord, and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ nyɩsɛmɛ nɛ, mɩ sɛɩ. Ŋ dolie kɩɩmɛ nɛ, a yuo diimi. Nɩaa ka sieri mɩ lɛ nɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala, nʋʋkala mʋmɔŋ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: You have let me announce only injustice and death. Your message has brought me nothing but insults and trouble.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋl wɩaa bʋa na-kala, mɩ yie yel nɛ a heele bʋbʋl doluŋ sɩ diila arɩ cheeriŋ sɩ puula. La TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa joŋ joŋŋoo arɩ hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ a hɩhɛ mɩ lɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord, or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ mɩ nɛ sɩ, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ koo a bʋl wɩaa ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ,” ʋ niiŋ wɩaa sɩ hɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ yie nagɛ nyiniŋ a nyɩnyɩgɛmɛ. Mɩ lɔlɔ nɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo.

english_verse: I heard the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah!” All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, “Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.”
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩa dɩ nɩaa yʋga a munso bʋbʋl, “Fawʋllʋŋ hɛ lee-kala nɛ. Má wuoli ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ. Má leŋ la wuoli ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ.” Mɩ nandɔnsʋŋ kala nɩɩ gbɛrɛ dɩ mɩ tel a bʋbʋl, “Kapo la jaŋ wuo nyɩsʋ a yuo diiu a joŋ la baanɩŋ fɩɩsɛ ʋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ yie magɩsɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa, a jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ arɩ ba nyuŋ lɛ. Leŋ dɩ mɩ na ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ joŋ ŋ baanɩŋ timba, bɛɛ wɩaa, mɩ joŋ mɩ wɩɩkala hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ŋmɩaŋ dii tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ lʋlmɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ naaŋ sɩ lʋlmɛ bɩ tapʋl-zɔŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Put a curse on the man who told my father, “Good news! You have a son.”
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ŋmɩaŋ dii baal-la sɩ kʋ hɛ duoso pɩ mɩ nyɩmma, a leŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ a bʋl, “Ba lʋl hambolibie nɛ a pɩŋ.”

english_verse: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ baal-la nagɛ tasɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ cheye a bɩ ba nenige fá. A leŋ dɩ ʋ nɩɩ nii-ŋmobo chʋchʋɔŋ, aŋ nɩɩ laalɩŋ goŋ ma wɩɩhɛyɛ.

english_verse: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ mɩ kpʋa mɩ naaŋ luoruŋ tʋɔŋ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa sʋʋ mɩ naaŋ luoruŋ tʋɔŋ, ʋ luoruŋ nɛ fa jaŋ ŋaa mɩ bʋa a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Why did I have to be born? Was it just to suffer and die in shame?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ paala tɩɩ mɩ kʋ lɩɩ mɩ naaŋ luoruŋ tʋɔŋ, a nɩna wʋwalɩmaa arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ ka dɩ mɩ tapʋlaa kala ma dɛrɛ arɩ hɩɩsɩŋ?

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa a pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya, bʋa-la lɛ kuoro Zedikaaya sɩ leŋe Malɩkɩja nanʋala Pasɩhɔ arɩ Maasɛya nanʋala Zefanaaya sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Ba sɩ,

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Chɛ na wɩaa La TƖƖNA teeŋ a pɩla, bɛɛ wɩaa Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza ka yuola nɛ. Kapo La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere pɩla arɩ ʋ fa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ mʋ aŋ ka la.”

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: Ha bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má bee na, mɩ joŋ mɩɩsɩŋ wombiiŋ arɩ sʋʋŋ wombiiŋ nɛ a bibil ma sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ tabalɩŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ, laalɩŋ koo losuŋ koo nyanyal-bɔmʋŋ jaŋ kpʋʋ. Ama nʋʋ na-kala sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa lɩɩ pɩ Babɩlɔŋ tɩmma-la sɩ kʋ tɔma hɛ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ fori a laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ.’ ”

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Mɩ chaasa kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, wʋzɔŋ dee. Mɩ jaŋ joŋu hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ cheyu arɩ nyiniŋ.”

english_verse: Pay attention, you that belong to the royal family.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ Juda kuoro dɩa nɩaa ma, “Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Each new day, make sure that justice is done, and rescue those who are being robbed. Or else my anger will flame up like a fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: Devit doho nɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má to wʋtɩtɩɩ tapʋlɩɩ na-kala. Má lorigo laa nɩɩ-la ba sɩ nyaga bil ta, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ gʋrʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, mɩ baanɩŋ jaŋ pusi a nagɛ nyiniŋ, a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ma sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Nʋʋkala tuo sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ baaŋ-la fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: and I will punish you as you deserve. I'll set your palace on fire, and everything around you will go up in smoke.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma arɩ ma wʋŋaalaa sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ ma duuŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ dii kʋŋkala sɩ gollima. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ tabalɩŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ, laalɩŋ koo losuŋ koo nyanyal-bɔmʋŋ jaŋ kpʋʋ. Ama nʋʋ na-kala sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa lɩɩ pɩ Babɩlɔŋ tɩmma-la sɩ kʋ tɔma hɛ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ fori a laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ.’ ”

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Mɩ chaasa kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, wʋzɔŋ dee. Mɩ jaŋ joŋu hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ cheyu arɩ nyiniŋ.”

english_verse: Pay attention, you that belong to the royal family.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ Juda kuoro dɩa nɩaa ma, “Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Each new day, make sure that justice is done, and rescue those who are being robbed. Or else my anger will flame up like a fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: Devit doho nɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má to wʋtɩtɩɩ tapʋlɩɩ na-kala. Má lorigo laa nɩɩ-la ba sɩ nyaga bil ta, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ gʋrʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, mɩ baanɩŋ jaŋ pusi a nagɛ nyiniŋ, a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ma sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Nʋʋkala tuo sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ baaŋ-la fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: and I will punish you as you deserve. I'll set your palace on fire, and everything around you will go up in smoke.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma arɩ ma wʋŋaalaa sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ ma duuŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ dii kʋŋkala sɩ gollima. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa a pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya, bʋa-la lɛ kuoro Zedikaaya sɩ leŋe Malɩkɩja nanʋala Pasɩhɔ arɩ Maasɛya nanʋala Zefanaaya sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Ba sɩ,

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Chɛ na wɩaa La TƖƖNA teeŋ a pɩla, bɛɛ wɩaa Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza ka yuola nɛ. Kapo La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere pɩla arɩ ʋ fa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ mʋ aŋ ka la.”

translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Mɩ chaasa kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, wʋzɔŋ dee. Mɩ jaŋ joŋu hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ cheyu arɩ nyiniŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord sent me to the palace of the king of Judah to speak to the king, his officials, and everyone else who was there. The Lord told me to say: I am the Lord, so pay attention! You have been allowing people to cheat, rob, and take advantage of widows, orphans, and foreigners who live here. Innocent people have become victims of injustice, and some of them have even been killed. But now I command you to do what is right and see that justice is done. Rescue everyone who has suffered from injustice.
translation_verse: wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ. Má lorigo laa nɩɩ-la ba sɩ nyaga bil ta nɩɩ-la sɩɩ gʋrʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Má sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ koo yuosu wɩɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔrʋ koo biisime koo yo-haala lɛ. Má sɩ́ nʋʋ ma sɩ bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa chei kpʋ leriŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: If you obey me, the kings from David's family will continue to rule Judah from this palace. They and their officials will ride in and out on their horses or in their chariots.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ wuo fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ dagɛma, ŋɩɩ-na kuoru-la sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ Devit kuoru kpasa nyuŋ jaŋ to kuoru dɩa deeŋ boi-balaa jʋjʋʋ kuoro jaŋ. Ba jaŋ jɩl janɩŋ torukoba arɩ janɩŋ, dɩ ba nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ ba nɩaa tuto ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: But if you ignore me, I promise in my own name that this palace will lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ bɩ wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ dagɛma ka to, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla, mɩ ŋmɩɛsa, kuoru dɩa deeŋ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.’ ”

english_verse: Listen to what I think about it: The palace of Judah's king is as glorious as Gilead or Lebanon's highest peaks. But it will be as empty as a ghost-town when I'm through with it.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Juda kuoro dɩa lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Arɩ ŋ sɩ zɔmɔ nagɛ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ ma kala mɩ teeŋ, a nagɛ Lɛbanɔŋ peelee, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ nagɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ, a nagɛ tasɩ-la nɩaa sɩ́ bɩ jʋʋ.

english_verse: I'll send troops to tear it apart, and its beautiful cedar beams will be used for firewood.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chei leriŋ a hɛ ma lɛ, nʋʋkala arɩ ʋ bayuori kɩaa. Ba jaŋ keri ma kuolo tɩɩ zɔŋŋɔɔ kala a joŋo hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ.

english_verse: People from different nations will pass by and ask, “Why did the Lord do this to such a great city as Jerusalem?”
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ lɩɩ tintee daŋ a kʋ to tabalɩŋ deeŋ bɩbal a pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA ŋaa wʋdoho deeŋ tabalɩŋ deeŋ sɩ faasa yʋgɛ lɛ?’

english_verse: Others will answer, “It's because the people worshiped foreign gods and broke the agreement that the Lord their God had made with them.” King Jehoahaz The Lord said:
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩba nɛ: ‘A tɩŋ ba sɩ vɩa nii-la sɩ hɛ ba dɩ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa pɛgɛ aŋ tuto vesiŋ a kpʋkpaarɛba nɛ tɩɩ.’ ”

english_verse: King Josiah is dead, so don't mourn for him. Instead, mourn for his son King Jehoahaz, dragged off to another country, never to return.
translation_verse: Juda nɩaa, má sɩ́ yele pɩ kuoru-la sɩ sʋba koo sɩ tuo. Ama má yel woruŋ a pɩ nɩɩ-la ba sɩ kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ a na tintee-la lɛ ba sɩ lʋlʋ.

english_verse: You put in big windows and used cedar paneling and red paint. But you were unfair and forced the builders to work without pay. *
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, ‘Mɩ jaŋ saa kuori dɩɩ-bal a pɩ mɩ tɩtɩa, dɩ ʋ nyuŋ dɩɩsɩŋ jal woruŋ.’ Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ hɛ ʋ tokoroba ba jal a kɛŋ kuolo daasɩŋ kɩɛla tɔ a kɛŋ penti fɩaŋ mɩɛrɛ ʋ kala.

english_verse: More cedar in your palace doesn't make you a better king than your father Josiah. He always did right— he gave justice to the poor and was honest.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ kuolo daasɩŋ saa dɩɩsɩŋ, ŋɩɩ daga arɩ ŋ ŋaa kuoru nɛɛ? Ŋ nyɩmma fa kɛŋ kʋdiilee arɩ kʋnyʋalaa yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ, ama ʋ fa ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ nɛ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pʋ.

english_verse: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa chɩna gbɛrɛ summoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ nɛ, wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɩa sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a dagɛ arɩ ʋ jɩmmɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: But all you think about is how to cheat or abuse or murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ sɩaa arɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ kala hɛ gɩrɩma dii lɛ nɛ, a kpʋkpʋ nɩaa sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye a dʋdɔgɩsɛ nɩaa, aŋ pɛ kɛŋ nɩaa kɩaa lɩlaa.”

english_verse: Jehoiakim, no one will mourn at your funeral. They won't turn to each other and ask, “Why did our great king have to die?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Juda kuoro Jehoyakim sɩ ŋaa Josaaya nanʋala lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Nɩaa bɩ jaŋ yel ʋ lɛ a bʋl, ‘La naambii baa!’ Ba bɩ jaŋ yel ʋ lɛ a bʋl, ‘La kʋhɩaŋ baa!’

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm nɩaa, má mʋ Lɛbanɔŋ a ŋmoo niiŋ, ma leŋ dɩ Basaŋ nɩaa ma nɩɩ ma yikoro. Má chɩŋ Abarɩm peele-la nyuŋ a ŋmoo niiŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba yuo dii nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ kʋ pɛ ma lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: When times were good, I warned you. But you ignored me, just as you have done since Israel was young.
translation_verse: Mɩ chagɩlɛma nɛ bʋa-la lɛ wɩaa fa sɩ vɛŋ woruŋ aa pɩma, ama ma sɩ, ‘La bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ.’ Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma nagɛ ma hambiriŋ kala lɛ, ma bɩ mɩ niiŋ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Peliŋ jaŋ paa ma sɩpaalaaraa a kaa viiri, ka nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋ pɛ ma lɛ ma mʋ yoŋ-baga. Nɩaa jaŋ jolimima dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmma, a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: Those who live in the palace paneled with cedar will groan with pain like women giving birth.
translation_verse: Ma Jerusalɛm nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔnɔ ta jɩa, aa jʋʋ Lɛbanɔŋ kuolo daasɩŋ dɩɩsɩŋ, dɩ hɛɛŋ nɛ jʋʋma, ma jaŋ huuni. Hɛɛ-la jaŋ nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl, ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ.”

english_verse: King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ nɛ sɩ weye wɩaa, dɩ ŋ-na Juda kuoro Jehoyachiŋ sɩ ŋaa Jehoyakim nanʋala nɛ fa paala nagɛ kuori nenii-pɩrɩŋ a hɛ mɩ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ ma, mɩ fa ha jaŋ lɩɩsɩŋ ta.

english_verse: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋuŋ hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ ba lɩɩsɛ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ fá. Mɩ jaŋ joŋuŋ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza arɩ ʋ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ ŋ dɩ ŋ naaŋ kala a yuo hɛ tintee dɔŋ lɛ, lee-la ba sɩ bɩ ma kʋŋkala lʋla dɩ ma sʋʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, you are unwanted like a broken clay pot. So you and your children will be thrown into a country you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl: Jehoyakim mɩɩra nagɛ pupoiŋ sɩ yɛrɛ ba joŋo yuo ta nɛ. Ʋ mɩɩra nagɛ kʋŋ nʋʋkala sɩ bɩ chɛ nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ba kiri ʋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ kala ta, ba mʋ hɛ tintee ba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ lɛ?

english_verse: Land of Judah, I am the Lord. Now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Tintee, tintee, tintee, jegile nɩɩ La TƖƖNA wɩaa.

english_verse: Erase the names of Jehoiachin's children from the royal records. He is a complete failure, and so none of them will ever be king. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ŋmʋnsɛ baala deeŋ wɩaa bil arɩ ʋ bɩ bii lʋla, wɩaa bɩ jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ pʋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ. Wɩaa bɩ jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩ ʋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa kala. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ hɔŋ Devit kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ, a bɩra dii kuoruŋ Juda lɛ.”

english_verse: You leaders of my people are like shepherds that kill and scatter the sheep.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Wɩɩŋ puu sɩpaalaara-la sɩɩ chei mɩ nɩaa, a ŋaa ba pɩpɩsɛ.

english_verse: You were supposed to take care of my people, but instead you chased them away. So now I'll punish you severely and make you pay for your crimes!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla a pɩpɩ ma sɩpaalaara-la sɩɩ beŋ mɩ nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: A tɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ mɩ nɩaa nyuŋ bene, aŋ ŋaa ba pɩsɛ, a kiriba ta wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma a tɩŋ wʋbɔŋ-la ma sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: I will bring the rest of my people home from the lands where I have scattered them, and they will grow into a mighty nation.
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩtɩa jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ nɩaa nɩkaana-la kaa kʋ lɩɩ tinteye-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kiriba mʋ hɛ, a kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ kɔ nɩmɛ, ba jaŋ lʋl biiriŋ, a pʋŋa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: I promise to choose leaders who will care for them like real shepherds. All of my people will be there, and they will never again be frightened.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ sɩpaalaaraa pɩba dɩ ba bemba. Fawʋllʋŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛmba, ba bɔyɛ ma bɩ jaŋ joŋ. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ lɛl. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Someday I will appoint an honest king from the family of David, a king who will be wise and rule with justice.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Tapʋlaa ka kɔ nɛ, dɩ mɩ lɩɩsɛ tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna Devit doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa kuoru sɩ jaŋ beŋ ʋ nɩaa arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: As long as he is king, Israel will have peace, and Judah will be safe. The name of this king will be “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: Ʋ kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ, ʋ jaŋ laa Juda nɩaa ta, dɩ Iziral nɩaa ma hɔŋ sɔm. Yɩrɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ yɩyɩrʋ nɛ: La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa la kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla koo La TƖƖNA nɛ laala ta arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ.”

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living God who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Tapʋlaa ka kɔ nɛ, nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ bʋl, ‘La ŋmɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ weye a kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.’

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land. Jeremiah Thinks about Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Ama ba jaŋ bʋl, ‘La ŋmɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ weye a kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kaa lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa tinteeŋ lɛ arɩ tinteye-la kala lɛ ʋ sɩ kɛmba pɩsa hɛ.’ Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ bɩra hɔŋ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ.” Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa

english_verse: When I think of the prophets, I am shocked, and I tremble like someone drunk, because of the Lord and his sacred words.
translation_verse: A mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la lɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ kala chaasa vʋgʋmɛ nɛ, mɩ yaraa kala chichel. Mɩ nagɛ nɩa sɩ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ nɛ, nɩa sɩ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ a chaasa bugi, a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: Those unfaithful prophets misuse their power all over the country. So God turned the pasturelands into scorching deserts. The Lord Will Punish Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Tintee-la kala nɛ suo arɩ hachɔrʋmɔɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋmɩaŋ dii nɩalɩŋ nɛ, tintee-la kala hɩl. Yaŋ-la sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ kala nɛ hɩla. Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la ka to nɩbɔŋ wombiee nɛ, a dɩdagɛ ba doluŋ ŋɩɩ sɩ bɩ maga.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: You prophets and priests think so little of me, the Lord, that you even sin in my own temple!
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩ mɩ ka fá. Mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la ma tɩtɩa lɛ, baa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Now I will punish you with disaster, and you will slip and fall in the darkness. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ba wombiiŋ jaŋ sɩsɩɛrɛ, mɩ jaŋ kiriba hɛ birimiŋ lɛ, dɩ ba tel nɩmɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋlɔrʋŋ kʋ hɛ ba lɛ jɩna-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: The prophets in Samaria were repulsive to me, because they preached in the name of Baal and led my people astray.
translation_verse: Samarɩa tɩmma-la sɩ ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa tʋɔŋ, mɩ na dɩ wʋlɔrʋŋ deeŋ nɛ baa ŋaa: Baa bʋl wɩaa vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a leŋ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa yeŋŋi.

english_verse: And you prophets in Jerusalem are even worse. You're unfaithful in marriage and never tell the truth. You even lead others to sin instead of helping them turn back to me. You and the people of Jerusalem are evil like Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm tɩmma-la sɩ ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa ma tʋɔŋ, mɩ na wɩɩ sɩ bɩ ba na kɛnɛ nɛ: Baa ŋaa wʋchɔrʋmɔɔ nɛ aŋ pɛ nyɩnyɩɛ wɩaa ma. Ba pɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa lɛ nɛ ba ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, ŋɩɩ leŋ nʋʋkala bɩ chɛ ʋ leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ. Ba kala nagɛ Sodom nɩaa nɛ mɩ teeŋ, Jerusalɛm nɩaa ma nagɛ Gomora nɩaa.”

english_verse: You prophets in Jerusalem have spread evil everywhere. That's why I, the Lord, promise to give you bitter poison to eat and drink. The Lord Gives a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ ʋ wʋlaabʋlla-la lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba dii kʋdii haarɩŋ, aŋ nyʋa lɩɩŋ ba sɩ hɛ bɩɛlɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa, mɩ wʋlaabʋlla-la nɛ leŋe wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ pʋrɩgɛ tintee-la kala lɛ.

english_verse: Don't listen to the lies of these false prophets, you people of Judah! The message they preach is something they imagined; it did not come from me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ba ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa a bʋl wɩalɩŋ pɩpɩma teeŋ jegilu. Ba leŋe ma kɛŋ yɩɛlaa sɩ bɩ jaŋ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ba yie bʋl wɩalɩŋ ba tɩtɩa sɩ bɩɩna nɛ a pɩpɩma, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dee bɩ wɩalɩŋ bʋla.

english_verse: These prophets go to people who refuse to respect me and who are stubborn and do whatever they please. The prophets tell them, “The Lord has promised everything will be fine.”
translation_verse: Ba yie bʋla pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ mɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ, ‘La TƖƖNA sɩ: Má jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ.’ Ba yie bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩɩ to ba nyuduoŋ harɩŋ, ‘Wʋbɔŋ kala bɩ jaŋ ŋaa ma lɛ.’

english_verse: But I, the Lord, tell you that these prophets have never attended a meeting of my council in heaven or heard me speak.
translation_verse: Ama ba tʋɔŋ kʋbɛɛ nɛ ha chɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, a nɩɩ mɩ wɩaa? Ba tʋɔŋ kʋbɛɛ nɛ ha jegile a nɩɩ mɩ wɩaa?

english_verse: They are evil! So in my anger I will strike them like a violent storm.
translation_verse: Bee na, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA baanɩŋ nagɛ pel-duoŋ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ lu a nagɛ pel-vinvilimiŋ a kʋ tuu nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nyuŋ.

english_verse: I won't calm down, until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday you will understand exactly what I mean.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA baanɩŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ fɩɛla, see dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ a dɛrɛ. Tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ harɩŋ, ba jaŋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩaa kala woruŋ.

english_verse: I did not send these prophets or speak to them, but they ran to find you and to preach their message.
translation_verse: Mɩ dee bɩ wʋlaabʋllaa deemba tɩma, ama ba tɩtɩa tɩndaarɩŋ nɛ ba kaa mʋ. Mɩ bɩ wɩɩ bʋla pɩba, ka ba mʋ bʋl wɩaa mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If they had been in a meeting of my council in heaven, they would have told you people of Judah to give up your sins and come back to me.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba nɛ fa jɩŋ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa, ba fa jaŋ heele bʋl mɩ wɩaa a pɩ mɩ nɩaa, dɩ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wombii bɔmɔ-la arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: in heaven and on earth. There are no secret places where you can hide from me.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo faa lee dɩ mɩ sɩ́ ʋ na. Mɩ hɛ tinteeŋ arɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kala lɛ nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩa dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ bʋbʋl wɩaa mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ sɩ, ‘Mɩ duoso nɛ! Mɩ duoso nɛ.’

english_verse: But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on?
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ hɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩ wʋlaabʋllaa deemba tʋɔŋ a diene magɛ? Ba yie nyɩɛ bʋbʋl wɩalɩŋ ba tɩtɩa sɩ bɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: They tell each other their dreams and try to get my people to reject me, just as their ancestors left me and worshiped Baal.
translation_verse: Ba bɩɩna ba sɩ bʋl duosoo wɩaa pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa yʋ mɩ wɩaa, arɩ ba naabalɩmaba sɩ kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal a yʋ mɩ wɩaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ wʋnyɩɛrɩ wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩ kɛŋ duosoo wɩaa ba bʋbʋl, ama nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ mɩ wɩaa, ba bʋlba arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Sekeliŋ arɩ mɩɩ-biiŋ bɩ dɔŋɔ maga, La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: My words are a powerful fire; they are a hammer that shatters rocks.
translation_verse: Mɩ niiŋ wɩaa nagɛ nyiniŋ nɛ, a bɩra nagɛ hama a ŋmoo bʋŋ yɩyɛrɛ muno muno.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim I give them their dreams, but it isn't true. I didn't choose them to be my prophets, and yet they babble on and on, speaking in my name, while stealing words from each other. And when my people hear these liars, they are led astray instead of being helped. So I warn you that I am now the enemy of these prophets. I, the Lord, have spoken. News and Nuisance The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Mɩ chaasa chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ baa na wɩaa duosoo tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ. Ba yie nyɩɛ wɩalɩŋ a leŋ mɩ nɩaa yeŋŋi nɛ, ka mɩ dee bɩ ba lɩɩsa koo a tɩmba. Wɩalɩŋ bɩ mɩ nɩaa lɛ ka pɛ mʋa ma. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.” Wʋnyɩɛrɩ duoso arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla nɛ

english_verse: Jeremiah, when a prophet or a priest or anyone else comes to you and asks, “Does the Lord have news for us?” tell them, “You people are a nuisance to the Lord, and he will get rid of you.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya, “Dɩ nɩaa deemba, koo mɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ koo nʋʋ sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩpɩmɛ nɛ pɩɛsɩŋ, ‘Wʋbɛɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl?’ Bʋla pɩba, ‘Ma ŋaa chʋga nɛ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA, ʋ jaŋ vɩama ta.’

english_verse: If any of you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” I will punish you and your families, even if you are a prophet or a priest.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ koo nʋʋ sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩpɩmɛ koo nʋʋ dɔŋ nɛ sɩ, ‘Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩɩ-la arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala.

english_verse: Instead, you must ask your friends and relatives, “What answer did the Lord give?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ma kʋŋkala yie pɩpɩɛsɛ ma nandɔnsʋŋ koo ma naambiiriŋ: Wʋbɛɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl? La TƖƖNA sɩ bɛɛ nɛ?’

english_verse: It seems that you each have your own news! So if you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” you are twisting my words into a lie. Remember that I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma bɩra bʋl, ‘Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la,’ bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋkala niiŋ wʋbʋlaa nɛ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ mɩ-na Wɩa wʋbʋlaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma ŋaa a kɛŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ weye niiŋ wɩaa a bɩrɩmɛ.

english_verse: If you go to a prophet, it's all right to ask, “What answer did the Lord give to my question?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ma vɛnɛ pɩpɩɛsɛ wʋlaabʋlla-la, ‘Wʋbɛɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩma, koo wʋbɛɛ nɛ ʋ bʋl?’

english_verse: But if you disobey me and say, “Here is news from the Lord,”
translation_verse: Ma yie bʋl, ‘Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩma nɛ ŋ-la.’ Ka mɩ bʋla pɩma arɩ ma sɩ́ ŋɩɩ bʋl.

english_verse: I will pick you up and throw you far away. And I will abandon this city of Jerusalem that I gave to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ sɛnɛ yʋ ma wɩaa aŋ kirima ta mɩ sɩpaaŋ, aŋ vɩa tabal-la ma mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩ ma dɩ ma naabalɩmaba a ta.

english_verse: You will never be free from your shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diima a kaa mʋ wuu. Ma bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ma yʋ hɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in a vision after King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had come to Judah and taken King Jehoiachin, his officials, and all the skilled workers back to Babylonia. In this vision I saw two baskets of figs in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza sɩ kɛŋ Juda kuoro Jehoyachiŋ sɩ ŋaa Jehoyakim nanʋala arɩ Juda tinteeŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa arɩ libire lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA dagɛmɛ tutogi-nambɩlaa sinsiŋ balɩa sɩ chɩŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: One basket was full of very good figs that ripened early, and the other was full of rotten figs that were not fit to eat.
translation_verse: Sime-la dɔŋɔ kɛŋ tutogi-nambɩlaa sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ a bɩɩ. Ka sime-la dɔŋɔ ma kɛŋ tutogi-nambɩlaa sɩ cheye, a lɔrɛ a bɩ ba dii kɛnɛ.

english_verse: “Jeremiah,” the Lord asked, “what do you see?” “Figs,” I said. “Some are very good, but the others are too rotten to eat.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Jɛrɩmaaya, bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ na?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Tutogi-nambɩlaa. Kɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ, ama kɩalɩŋ sɩ cheye, chaasa lɔrɛ nɛ a bɩ ba dii kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: where I am watching over them. Then someday I will bring them back to this land. I will plant them, instead of uprooting them, and I will build them up, rather than tearing them down.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ beŋ ba nyuŋ dɩ wɩaa zɔmɔ pɩba, a kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ tinteeŋ deeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba chɩŋ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba tel. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba naapoloo jʋʋ tinteeŋ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ churiba.

english_verse: I will give them a desire to know me and to be my people. They will want me to be their God, and they will turn back to me with all their heart.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ pɩba tʋɔ-la sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA. Ba jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa, dɩ mɩ ma ŋaa ba Wɩa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ arɩ ba tʋɔŋ kala.

english_verse: The rotten figs stand for King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and all the others who were not taken away to Babylonia, whether they stayed here in Judah or went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ama a nagɛ tutogi-nambɩlɩa-la sɩ cheye, a lɔrɛ ŋɩɩ a bɩ ba dii kɛnɛ, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa Juda kuoro Zedikaaya lɛ, ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ sʋba a lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ, dɩ ba hɛ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ koo dɩ ba mʋ hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I will punish them with a terrible disaster, and everyone on earth will tremble when they hear about it. I will force the people of Judah to go to foreign countries, where they will be cursed and insulted.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛ wʋlɔrʋŋ kʋ hɛ ba lɛ, dɩ ba nagɛ kʋŋ sɩɩ sʋɔrʋ dʋnɩa tinteyee nɩaa kala teeŋ. Hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ diiba dɩ nɩaa sisieri ba lɛ. Nɩaa jaŋ kɛŋ ba yɩrɩŋ ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛ lee na-kala mɩ sɩ kɛmba pɩsa hɛ.

english_verse: War and hunger and disease will strike them, until they finally disappear from the land that I gave them and their ancestors.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ laalɩŋ, losuŋ arɩ nyanyalɩɩ a hɛ ba lɛ, a cheiba ŋɩɩ halɩɩ dɩ ba dɛrɛ tintee-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩ ba dɩ ba naabalɩmaba lɛ.”

english_verse: In the fourth year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, which was the first year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia, the Lord told me to speak to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. So I told them:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya bʋl wɩalɩŋ pɩ Juda nɩaa kala arɩ ba nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ʋ sɩ:

english_verse: They told you that the Lord had said: Change your ways! If you stop doing evil, I will let you stay forever in this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ, “Má kʋŋkala bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wombii-bɔmɔ-la ma sɩɩ to arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la ma sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ wuo hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩ ma dɩ ma naabalɩmaba a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I don't want to harm you. So don't make me angry by worshiping idols and other gods.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ vesiŋ to a kpʋkpaarɛba. Má sɩ́ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa, kaa ŋaa dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ sii. Dɩ ma nɛ vɩa wɩaa deemba, mɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaama wʋbɔŋ kala.”

english_verse: But you refused to listen to my prophets. So I, the Lord, say that you have made me angry by worshiping idols, and you are the ones who were hurt by what you did.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Ama ma bɩ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, aŋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ ma nɩsɩŋ ŋaa, a ŋaa a leŋ mɩ baanɩŋ sii a lɛrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kʋ hɛ ma tɩtɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: and now I will let you be attacked by nations from the north, and especially by my servant, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. You and other nearby nations will be destroyed and left in ruins forever. Everyone who sees what has happened will be shocked, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: mɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ nɩaa kala sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa arɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza a hɛ dɔŋɔ, a kɛmba kʋ hɛ tinteeŋ deeŋ arɩ ʋ nɩaa arɩ tinteye-la kala sɩ gollu lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Mɩ jaŋ chei ba kala gbelem gbelem dɩ ba ŋaa mɔmɩa dɩ nɩaa sisieri ba lɛ, nɩaa jaŋ naba dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba dɩ ba hihirigi. Ba jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I will put an end to your parties and wedding celebrations; no one will grind grain or be here to light the lamps at night.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ goŋ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa dɛrɛ, dɩ goŋ-la ha-falaa arɩ ba balaba ma sɩɩ ŋaa dɛrɛ. Nɔmʋŋ ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ dɔŋ, ba bɩ jaŋ nyɩgɛ chaanaa ma nɩmɛ.

english_verse: This country will be as empty as a desert, because I will make all of you the slaves of the king of Babylonia for
translation_verse: Tintee-la kala jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a ŋaa hoi. Ma dɩ tinteye-la nɩaa jaŋ tɩma pɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii.

english_verse: When that time is up, I will punish the king of Babylonia and his people for everything they have done wrong, and I will turn that country into a wasteland forever.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii-la nɛ suo, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ nɩaa arɩ ba tinteeŋ kala a tɩŋ ba cheeriŋ wɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba tinteeŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: My servant Jeremiah has told you what I said I will do to Babylonia and to the other nations, and he wrote it all down in this book. I will do everything I threatened.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ tintee-la lɛ a ŋaa ʋ lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ teniŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ Jɛrɩmaaya sɩ bʋla mɩ doluŋ lɛ a tɩgɛ tinteye-la kala lɛ.

english_verse: I will pay back the Babylonians for every wrong they have done. Great kings from many other nations will conquer the Babylonians and force them to be slaves. The Cup Full of God's Anger
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ tɩmma-la jaŋ ŋaa tintee daŋ nɩaa arɩ kuori duoruŋ yosi. Mɩ jaŋ timba a tɩŋ ba mɛlɛ arɩ ba wʋŋaalaa wɩaa.” Wɩa baanɩŋ

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel showed me a vision in which he said, “Jeremiah, here is a cup filled with the wine of my anger. Take it and make every nation drink some.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Laa mɩ baanɩŋ sɩ nagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ sɩ dolie a su nyʋnyʋala mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a kaa mʋ a leŋ dɩ tinteye-la kala nɩaa teeŋ mɩ sɩ tɩmɩŋ nyʋa.

english_verse: They will vomit and act crazy, because of the war this cup of anger will bring to them.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ nyʋaʋ, ba jaŋ gɩgɛrɛ a mʋ nyaasɛ a tɩŋ laal-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ lɔgɔ hɛ ba lɛ wɩaa.”

english_verse: I took the cup from the Lord's hand, and I went to the kings of the nations and made each of them drink some.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ laa nyʋnyʋala-la La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a leŋ tinteye-la kala nɩaa teeŋ ʋ sɩ tɩmmɛ nyʋa ʋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: I started with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and the king and his officials were removed from power in disgrace. Everyone still makes insulting jokes about them and uses their names as curse words.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ: Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda tasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ kala, ba kuoroo arɩ ba tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, dɩ ʋ jaŋ cheiba dɩ ba ŋaa mɔmɩa dɩ nɩaa sisieri ba lɛ, dɩ nɩaa naba dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba dɩ ba hihirigi, aŋ kɛŋ ba yɩrɩŋ ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛ, arɩ ba sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ jɩnɩmba,

english_verse: Then I went to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon,
translation_verse: a pɛ Ɛdɔm nɩaa lɛ, Mʋab nɩaa arɩ Amɔŋ nɩaa,

english_verse: and to the kings of Tyre, Sidon, and their colonies across the sea.
translation_verse: Taaya arɩ Sɩdɔŋ kuoroo, kuorusu-la sɩ hɛ fuoŋ niiŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ cholo,

english_verse: After this, I went to the kings of Dedan, Tema, Buz, the tribes of the Arabian Desert,
translation_verse: Arebia tɩŋŋaa kuoroo kala sɩ ŋaa nɩwogusuŋ a hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: Zimri, Elam, Media,
translation_verse: Zimiri, Ɛlam arɩ Midia kuoroo kala,

english_verse: and the countries in the north, both near and far. I went to all the countries on earth, one after another, and finally to Babylonia.
translation_verse: a pɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ kuoroo kala lɛ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ kpaga arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bolie kala, dʋnɩa kuori-gentisiŋ kala. A lɩɩ nɩaa deemba kala harɩŋ, Sɛsak kuoro ma jaŋ nyʋa nyʋnyʋala-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord had said to tell each king, “The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, commands you to drink from this cup that is full of the wine of his anger. It will make you so drunk that you will vomit. And when the Lord sends war against the nations, you will be completely defeated.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Bʋla pɩba, ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má nyʋa, má nyʋa bugi a tʋɔsɛ, a tel a bɩra sɩ́ sii, a tɩŋ laal-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ lɔgɔ hɛ ma lɛ wɩaa.’

english_verse: The Lord told me that if any of them refused to drink from the cup, I must tell them that he had said, “I, the Lord All-Powerful, command you to drink.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba nɛ vɩa dɩ ba laa nyʋnyʋala-la ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a nyʋa, bʋla pɩba, Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má maga dɩ má nyʋaʋ nɛ.

english_verse: My voice will be heard everywhere on earth, accusing nations of their crimes and sentencing the guilty to death. Disaster Is Coming
translation_verse: Goŋ-bal-la jaŋ chɩɩmɛ dʋnɩa kala, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kɛŋ wɩɩ nɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ tinteyee lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa kala sarɩya, a kpʋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: You can see disaster spreading from far across the earth, from nation to nation like a horrible storm.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Má bee na, wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ ka pusi nɛ, a lɩɩ tinteeŋ a mʋ jʋʋ dɔŋɔ. Pel-duoŋ ka sii nɛ a lɩɩ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ.”

english_verse: When it strikes, I will kill so many people that their bodies will cover the ground like manure. No one will be left to bury them or to mourn. The Leaders of Judah Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, nɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ kpʋ jaŋ pɩŋ lee-kala, a lɩɩ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a kaa mʋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ. Ba bɩ jaŋ hugiba koo a yel ba yoho. Ama ba jaŋ pɩŋ tinteeŋ a nagɛ nʋsʋrʋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord's people are his flock, and you leaders were the shepherds. But now it's your turn to be butchered like sheep. You'll shatter like fine pottery dropped on the floor. So roll on the ground, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Ma sɩpaalaaraa, má ŋmoo niiŋ a yel. Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ nɩaa, má bibilimi tinteeŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ kpʋma yie nɛ. Ma jaŋ tel a pɩsɛ a nagɛ pupoiŋ sɩ munso.

english_verse: You have nowhere to run, nowhere to hide. *
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaaraa bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ dɩ-fá-mʋʋlɩɩ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩpaalaara-la bɩ dɩ-fori kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Listen to the cries of the shepherds, as the Lord's burning anger turns peaceful meadows into barren deserts.
translation_verse: Tintee-la sɩ fɩɛla pɩŋ sɔm kala jaŋ chei, a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ faasa na baanɩŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Like a lion leaving its den, the Lord has abandoned his people to the destruction of war.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna jaŋ sii a nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩ sii ʋ dɩpɩnɩŋ, a leŋ dɩ ba tinteeŋ pɩŋ hoi a tɩŋ laal-la sɩ jʋʋba arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ faasa na baanɩŋ a dɔgɩsɛba wɩaa.

english_verse: The priests, the prophets, and everyone else in the temple heard what I said,
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Jɛrɩmaaya sɩ bʋla La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But if you put me to death, you and everyone else in Jerusalem will be guilty of murdering an innocent man, because everything I preached came from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ma ta jɩŋ, dɩ ma nɛ kpʋmɛ, nʋʋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye chalɩŋ nɛ jaasɛ ŋɩɩ, a lɔgɛ wɩaa hɛ ma tɩtɩa arɩ tabalɩŋ deeŋ arɩ nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, La TƖƖNA nɛ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ bʋl wɩaa deemba kala dɩ ma nɩɩ.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, I have a message for everyone who comes from the towns of Judah to worship in my temple. Go to the temple courtyard and speak every word that I tell you.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mʋ chɩŋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la kaala lɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Juda tasɩŋ lɛ a yie kɔ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la a dɩdɛnnɛmɛ. Bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ a pɩba, sɩ́ wɩɩkala gɛllɛ ta.

english_verse: Tell them that I have said: You have refused to listen to me and to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba, ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ a to wombii-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ma tuto, wombii-la mɩ sɩ joŋo bil ma sɩpaaŋ,

english_verse: Again and again I have sent my servants the prophets to preach to you, but you ignored them as well. Now I am warning you that if you don't start obeying me at once,
translation_verse: dɩ ma nɛ bɩ mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa wɩaa jegile nɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ tɩma ba kɔ ma teeŋ bʋlɩa bʋlɩa ,

english_verse: I will destroy this temple, just as I destroyed the town of Shiloh. Then everyone on earth will use the name “Jerusalem” as a curse word. Jeremiah on Trial
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ ma nagɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩlɔ, dɩ dʋnɩa tinteyee nɩaa kala kɛŋ tabalɩŋ deeŋ yɩrɩŋ ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: and as soon as I finished, they all crowded around me and started shouting, “Why did you preach that the Lord will destroy this temple, just as he destroyed Shiloh? Why did you say that Jerusalem will be empty and lie in ruins? You ought to be put to death for saying such things in the Lord's name!” Then they had me arrested.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bʋl wɩaa La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ, arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ nagɛ Sɩlɔ, dɩ ba vɩa tabalɩŋ deeŋ ma ta dɩ ʋ pɩŋ hoi?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala kʋ golli Jɛrɩmaaya La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ.

english_verse: The royal officers heard what had happened, and they came from the palace to the new gate of the temple to be the judges at my trial.
translation_verse: Juda tinteeŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩaa deemba, ba lɩɩ kuoru dɩa lɛ a mʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ, a hɔŋ ba dɩ-hɔnɔɔ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la boi-baal falɩɩ-la niiŋ.

english_verse: While they listened, the priests and the prophets said to the crowd, “All of you have heard Jeremiah prophesy that Jerusalem will be destroyed. He deserves the death penalty.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la bʋla pɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala, “Baala deeŋ maga dɩ la kpʋʋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ zɔŋ nɛ a tɩgɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ lɛ. Ma tɩtɩa dɩgɩlaa nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Then I told the judges and everyone else: The Lord himself sent me to tell you about the terrible things he will do to you, to Jerusalem, and to the temple. But if you change your ways and start obeying the Lord, he will change his mind.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, má bɩrɩmɛ ma mɛlɛ arɩ ma wʋŋaalaa aŋ to ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩrɩmɛ, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋlɔrʋ-la wɩaa ʋ sɩ bʋla kʋ hɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: You must decide what to do with me. Just do whatever you think is right.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ-na hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ma ŋaamɛ wɩɩ-la kala ma sɩ bene dɩ ʋ zɔmɔ aŋ ŋaa ʋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: The judges and the other people told the priests and prophets, “Since Jeremiah only told us what the Lord our God had said, we don't think he deserves to die.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala bʋla pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la, “Ma bɩ maga dɩ ma kpʋ baala deeŋ. Ʋ bʋl wɩaa La TƖƖNA Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ a pɩla.”

english_verse: Then some of the leaders from other towns stepped forward. They told the crowd that
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tintee-la nɩhɩasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ kʋ lɩɩ chɩŋ sɩpaaŋ a bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hilime,

english_verse: years ago when Hezekiah was king of Judah, a prophet named Micah from the town of Moresheth had said: “I, the Lord All-Powerful, say Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.”
translation_verse: “Mɩka sɩ lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔrɛsɛf fa bʋl wɩaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ bʋa-la lɛ Hezikaaya sɩ ŋaa Juda tinteeŋ kuoro. Ʋ fa bʋla pɩ Juda nɩaa kala: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la, ‘Ba jaŋ pɛrɛ Zaayɔŋ a nagɛ baga. Jerusalɛm jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a nagɛ pupuluŋ. Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ chɩŋ dundolo-la nyuŋ jaŋ lugi a nagɛ duuŋ.’

english_verse: Then the leaders continued: No one put Micah to death for saying that. Instead, King Hezekiah prayed to the Lord with fear and trembling and asked him to have mercy. Then the Lord decided not to destroy Jerusalem, even though he had already said he would. People of Judah, if Jeremiah is killed, we will bring a terrible disaster on ourselves.
translation_verse: Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Hezikaaya koo Juda nʋʋ dɔŋ fa kpʋʋ nɛɛ? Hezikaaya fá La TƖƖNA nɛ, a sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA leŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la ʋ fa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ba lɛ nɛ. Laa chɛ dɩ la lɛrɛ wɩɩ sɩ chaasa lɔrɛ nɛ a kʋ hɛ la tɩtɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me: Jeremiah, make a wooden yoke with leather straps, and place it on your neck.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Pɩɩnɛ gɛnɛ a kaa vɔɔ daasɩŋ gɛsɛ dɔŋɔ a laalɛ ŋ baŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: Then send a message to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon. Some officials from these countries are in Jerusalem, meeting with Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Tɩŋ tinteye-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ chɩŋ ba kuoroo naasɩŋ lɛ a kɔ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Zedikaaya teeŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ dɩ ba bʋla pɩ ba kuoroo: Ɛdɔm kuoro, Mʋab kuoro, Amɔŋ kuoro, Taaya kuoro arɩ Sɩdɔŋ kuoro.

english_verse: So have them tell their kings that I have said: I am the All-Powerful Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: Joŋ tɩndaarɩ-la pɩba dɩ ba kaa mʋ bʋla pɩ ba nɩhɩasɩ-la, ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má bʋla pɩ ma kuoroo arɩ

english_verse: and with my power I created the earth, its people, and all animals. I decide who will rule the earth,
translation_verse: mɩ kɛŋ mɩ dol-balɩŋ arɩ mɩ naduoŋ nɛ a ŋaa dʋnɩa arɩ nuhuobiine arɩ pʋsʋ-la kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ. Mɩ yie jomba pɩ nʋʋ na-kala mɩ tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: and I have chosen my servant King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to rule all nations, including yours. I will even let him rule the wild animals. All nations will be slaves of Nebuchadnezzar, his son, and his grandson. Then many nations will join together, and their kings will make slaves of the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Tinteyee kala jaŋ tɩma pɩ ʋ dɩ ʋ nanʋala arɩ ʋ nihiŋ see dɩ bʋa-la ʋ tɩtɩa tinteeŋ sɩ jaŋ tel yie, ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ tintee daŋ arɩ kuori-balaa jaŋ yuo diiu dɩ ʋ tɩmaa pɩba.

english_verse: This yoke stands for the power of King Nebuchadnezzar, and I will destroy any nation that refuses to obey him. Nebuchadnezzar will attack, and many will die in battle or from hunger and disease.
translation_verse: Dɩ tinteeŋ koo kuoru-gentine kala nɛ vɩa dɩ ʋ tɩma pɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza koo a bɩ ba tɩtɩa joŋo hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ laalɩŋ, losuŋ arɩ nyanyal-bɔmʋŋ dɔgɩsɛ tintee-la nɩaa, aŋ to ʋ lɛ a kpʋ ba kala. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: You might have people in your kingdom who claim they can tell the future by magic or by talking with the dead or by dreams or messages from a god. But don't pay attention if any of them tell you not to obey Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má sɩ́ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɩ ba ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa, ma vʋgʋraa, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ duosoo bʋbʋɔŋ, ma chichiribee arɩ kantɔŋ yɩrɩraa teeŋ jegilu, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋla pɩma arɩ ma bɩ jaŋ tɩma pɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro.

english_verse: If you listen to such lies, I will have you dragged far from your country and killed.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ pɩma sɩ jaŋ leŋ ba lɩɩsɛma ma tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ ma mʋ hɛ dɩ-bolii. Mɩ jaŋ kirima ta dɩ ma sʋʋ.

english_verse: But if you and your nation are willing to obey Nebuchadnezzar, I will let you stay in your country, and your people will continue to live and work on their farms.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ tintee kala nɩaa nɛ jaŋ joŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ a tɩma pʋpʋ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tintee-la nɩaa hɔŋ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ a pɩpɛrɛ nɩmɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.’ ”

english_verse: After I had spoken to the officials from the nearby kingdoms, I went to King Zedekiah and told him the same thing. Then I said: Zedekiah, if you and the people of Judah want to stay alive, you must obey Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ-na Jɛrɩmaaya fa bʋla pɩ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Zedikaaya. Mɩ sɩ, “Joŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ a tɩma pɩ ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: But if you refuse, then you and your people will die from war, hunger, and disease, just as the Lord has warned.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ dɩ ŋ nɩaa chɩchɛ dɩ laalɩŋ, losuŋ arɩ nyanyal-bɔmʋŋ kpʋma? Wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ tintee-la na-kala sɩ vɩa dɩ ʋ tɩma pɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Your prophets have told you that you don't need to obey Nebuchadnezzar, but don't listen to their lies.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɩ ba ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa teeŋ jegilu. Ba sɩ, ‘Ŋ bɩ jaŋ tɩma pɩpɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro,’ ba nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ pɩpɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Those prophets claim to be speaking for the Lord, but he didn't send them. They are lying! If you do what they say, he will have both you and them dragged off to another country and killed. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, ‘Mɩ dee bɩ ba tɩma. Baa nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ kirima ta dɩ ma sʋʋ, ma dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɩ ba ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa kala a bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩma.’ ”

english_verse: When I finished talking to the king, I told the priests and everyone else that the Lord had said: Don't listen to the prophets when they say that very soon the Babylonians will return the things they took from my temple. Those prophets are lying!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Má sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la teeŋ jegilu. Ba sɩ: Ʋ bɩ dieni, ka dɩ ba mɩɩra kɛŋ La TƖƖNA dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ kaa lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ kɔ. Ba nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ a pɩpɩma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If you choose to obey the king of Babylonia, you will live. But if you listen to those prophets, this whole city will be nothing but a pile of rubble.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ba teeŋ jegilu. Má tɩma pɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ tabalɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ pɩŋ ji-kpee?

english_verse: If I really had spoken to those prophets, they would know what I am going to do. Then they would be begging me not to let everything else be taken from the temple and the king's palace and the rest of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ sɩ ba ŋaa La TƖƖNA wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ a jɩŋ La TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩalɩŋ, leŋ dɩ ba sʋl La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna yei, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba paa ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la kʋkaana-la arɩ Juda tinteeŋ kuoru dɩa kɩaa a pɛ Jerusalɛm kɩaa lɛ a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ.’

english_verse: will be taken to Babylonia, where they will remain until I decide to bring them back to Jerusalem. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: ‘Ba jaŋ paaba kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ, dɩ ba hɛ nɩmɛ a mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ kʋ paaba. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Mɩ jaŋ paaba, a mɩɩra kɛmba kʋ bil leriŋ deeŋ.’ ”

english_verse: Later that same year, in the fifth month of the fourth year that Zedekiah was king, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur from Gibeon came up to me in the temple. And while the priests and others in the temple were listening,
translation_verse: Zedikaaya sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, ʋ jɩ-nɛsɛ tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-nɔŋ lɛ nɛ, Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Hananaaya, sɩ ŋaa Azu nanʋala a lɩɩ Gibioŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: he told me that the Lord had said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I will smash the yoke that Nebuchadnezzar put on the necks of the nations to make them his slaves.
translation_verse: “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ daa-la Babɩlɔŋ kuoro sɩ joŋo laalɛ ma baŋŋaa lɛ a bori.

english_verse: And within two years, I will bring back to Jerusalem everything that he took from my temple and carried off to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Jɩsɩŋ balɩa pɛgɛ, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza fa sɩ kʋ paa daha a kaa mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin and the other people who were taken from Judah to Babylonia will be allowed to come back here as well. All this will happen because I will smash the power of the king of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Jekonaaya , sɩ ŋaa Jehoyakim nanʋala arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ mʋ yoŋ-baga Babɩlɔŋ lɛ a kaa mɩɩra kɔ leriŋ deeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ daa-la Babɩlɔŋ kuoro sɩ joŋo laalɛ ma baŋŋaa lɛ a bori, La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.’ ”

english_verse: The priests and the others were still standing there, so I said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya ma bʋla pɩ wʋnyɩɛrʋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Hananaaya, Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ chɩŋ nɩmɛ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Hananiah, I hope the Lord will do exactly what you said. I hope he does bring back everything the Babylonians took from the temple, and that our people who were taken to Babylonia will be allowed to return home.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Amɩɩ, a leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA ŋaa ŋɩɩ. A leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA ŋaa dɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ dɩa kɩaa mɩɩra kaa kɔɔnʋŋ lɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ, a pɛ nɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: that long before we were born, prophets were saying powerful kingdoms would be struck by war, disaster, and disease.
translation_verse: Faafaa kala, Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kɔ mɩ dɩ ŋ lɛ, ba fa bʋla arɩ laalɩŋ, wʋlɔrʋŋ arɩ nyanyalɩɩ jaŋ jʋʋ tinteyee a yʋgɛ, a jʋʋ kuori-gentiŋ balaa ma a yʋgɛ.

english_verse: Now you are saying we will have peace. We will just have to wait and see if that is really what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ bʋla arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ sɛnɛ ŋaa, ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ nɩaa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ sɛnɛ tɩmʋ.”

english_verse: Hananiah grabbed the wooden yoke from my neck and smashed it.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Hananaaya kɛŋ gɛnɛ-la arɩ daa-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya baŋŋaa lɛ lɩɩsɛ a bori,

english_verse: Then he said, “The Lord says this is the way he will smash the power Nebuchadnezzar has over the nations, and it will happen in less than two years.” I left the temple,
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl ŋ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ jaŋ bori daa-la Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza sɩ joŋo laalɛ tinteyee nɩaa kala baŋŋaa lɛ jɩsɩŋ balɩa pɛgɛ.’ ” Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya viiri.

english_verse: to go back and say to Hananiah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You smashed a wooden yoke, but I will replace it with one made of iron. I will put iron yokes on all the nations, and they will have to do what King Nebuchadnezzar commands. I will even let him rule the wild animals.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ fʋgɛ tinteyee deemba kala nɩaa hɛ dɩ ba tɩma pɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza, ba jaŋ tɩma pʋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ bagɩlaa ma paala tuto ʋ niiŋ.’ ”

english_verse: Hananiah, I have never sent you to speak for me. And yet you have talked my people into believing your lies and rebelling against me. So now I will send you—I'll send you right off the face of the earth! You will die before this year is over.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Mɩ ŋaa siri nɛ dɩ mɩ lɩɩsɩŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Jɩna deeŋ tʋɔŋ ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ dagɛ nɩaa a leŋ ba lɩɩ mɩ-na ŋ TƖƖNA harɩŋ nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: I had been left in Jerusalem when King Nebuchadnezzar took many of the people of Jerusalem and Judah to Babylonia as prisoners, including King Jehoiachin, his mother, his officials, and the metal workers and others in Jerusalem who were skilled in making things. So I wrote a letter to the priests, the prophets, the leaders, and the rest of our people in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ ŋɩɩ, Jɛrɩmaaya ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩ kuoro Jehoyachiŋ arɩ ʋ naaŋ, kuoro dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ a pɛ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm sɩpaalaaraa lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa arɩ libiree.

english_verse: I gave the letter to Elasah and Gemariah, two men that King Zedekiah of Judah was sending to Babylon to talk with Nebuchadnezzar. In the letter, I wrote
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ teŋ-la hɛ nɩaa deemba nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ: Safaŋ nanʋala Ɛlasa arɩ Hɩlɩkaaya nanʋala Gɛmarɩa. Ba nɛ Juda kuoro Zedikaaya tɩŋ ba mʋ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza teeŋ. Teŋ-la tʋɔŋ wɩaa nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. Now I tell you
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ kaa lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ a mʋ yoŋ-baga Babɩlɔŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: to settle there and build houses. Plant gardens and eat what you grow in them.
translation_verse: “Má saa dɩɩsɩŋ a hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Má bil bagɩsɩŋ a duu kɩaa a didii.

english_verse: Get married and have children, then help your sons find wives and help your daughters find husbands, so they can have children as well. I want your numbers to grow, not to get smaller.
translation_verse: Má jaa haalaa a lʋl biiriŋ. Má jaa haalaa pɩ ma hambolibiisiŋ, aŋ joŋ ma toloo ma pɩ balaba, dɩ ba ma lʋl biiriŋ. Má pʋŋa yʋgɛ lee-la, má sɩ́ muuru.

english_verse: Pray for peace in Babylonia and work hard to make it prosperous. The more successful that nation is, the better off you will be.
translation_verse: Má chɩchɛ dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ tabal-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛmma mʋ yoŋ-baga ma hɛ. Má sʋl mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA pʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa, dɩ wɩaa nɛ vɛŋ woruŋ taŋ-la lɛ, wɩaa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩ ma ma.”

english_verse: You will turn back to me and ask for help, and I will answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ kʋ sʋlmɛ, a chʋɔlɛmɛ dɩ mɩ jegile nɩɩ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: You will worship me with all your heart, and I will be with you
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ chɛmɛ, a namɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ chɛmɛ arɩ ma tʋɔŋ kala,

english_verse: You feel secure, because you think I have sent prophets to speak for me in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ wuo bʋl, “La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa pɩla nɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. But you had better listen to me now.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ma nɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ kaa lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, má jegile nɩɩ.

english_verse: You think Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah are prophets because they claim to speak for me. But they are lying! I haven't told them anything. They are also committing other horrible sins in your community, such as sleeping with the wives of their friends. So I will hand them over to King Nebuchadnezzar, who will put them to death while the rest of you watch. And in the future, when you want to put a curse on someone, you will say, “I pray that the Lord will kill you in the same way the king of Babylonia burned Zedekiah and Ahab to death!” A Message for Shemaiah
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ bana kɛnɛ nɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba kɛŋ ba dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa haalaa pɩŋ nɛ, aŋ nyɩɛ wɩaa ma mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, ka mɩ bɩ wɩɩ bʋla pɩba. Mɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ ŋaa nɛ, aŋ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ pɛ na wɩɩ-la. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.” Tɩndaarɩɩ-la Jɛrɩmaaya sɩ tɩma pɩ Sɛmaaya

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, told me what would happen to Shemaiah, who was one of our people in Babylonia. After my letter reached Babylonia, Shemaiah wrote letters to the people of Jerusalem, including the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and the other priests. The letter to Zephaniah said:
translation_verse: wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ŋ ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ ŋ tɩtɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ a kaa mʋ pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala arɩ Maasɛya nanʋala Zefanaaya, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarɩ-hɩaŋ, arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɔnsʋŋ. Ŋ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ ŋ bʋla pɩ Zefanaaya,

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the Lord chose you to be the priest in charge of the temple security force. You know that anyone who acts crazy and pretends to be a prophet should be arrested and put in chains and iron collars.
translation_verse: ‘La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɩŋ nɛ a hɛ Jehoyada nyuŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ a bibeŋ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la. Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ kɛŋ nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ nyaasʋ aŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ a hɛ kuruŋ arɩ chɔrʋmɔɔ.

english_verse: Jeremiah from the town of Anathoth is pretending to be a prophet there in Jerusalem, so why haven't you punished him?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ŋ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa Jɛrɩmaaya lɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Anatɔf a ŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ a hɛ ma tʋɔŋ?

english_verse: He even wrote a letter to the people here in Babylonia, saying we would be here a long time. He told us to build homes and to plant gardens and grow our own food.
translation_verse: Ʋ tɩŋ tɩndaarɩŋ deeŋ nɛ pɩla Babɩlɔŋ lɛ: Ma jaŋ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ a dieni, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma saa dɩɩsɩŋ a hɔŋ a bil bagɩsɩŋ a duu kɩaa a didii.’ ”

english_verse: When Zephaniah received Shemaiah's letter, he read it to me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zefanaaya sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara karɩmɛ teŋ-la a pɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me what to write in a second letter
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya:

english_verse: to the people of Judah who had been taken to Babylonia. In this letter, I wrote that the Lord had said: I, the Lord, have not chosen Shemaiah to be one of my prophets, and he has misled you by telling lies in my name.
translation_verse: “Tɩŋ tɩndaarɩŋ deeŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ: ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Sɛmaaya sɩ lɩɩ Nehelam lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: A tɩŋ Sɛmaaya sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩma ka mɩ dee bɩ ʋ tɩma, a leŋ ma laa ʋ wʋnyɩɛrɩ-la dii,

english_verse: He has even talked you into disobeying me. So I will punish Shemaiah. He and his descendants won't live to see the good things I will do for my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Sɛmaaya sɩ lɩɩ Nehelam arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa kala. Ʋ nɩaa kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ ka nɩaa deemba tʋɔŋ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ na wʋzɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa pɩ mɩ nɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ dagɛ nɩaa a leŋ ba vɩa mɩ niiŋ nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel said, “Jeremiah, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you.
translation_verse: “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ: Ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ a hɛ teniŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to Israel and Judah: Screams of terror are heard, with no word of peace.
translation_verse: “Mɩ nɩɩ nɩaa sɩɩ yel fawʋllʋ yele nɛ, yele-la chaasa kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ nɛ, ba fɩɛla dee.

english_verse: Can men give birth? Then why do I see them looking so pale and clutching their stomachs like women in labor?
translation_verse: Pɩɛsa na: Baala jaŋ wuo lʋl biiriŋ? Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ mɩ na baduo na-kala dɩ ʋ paa nɩsaa vɔɔ ʋ kawule bʋbʋɔŋ a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl, ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ ŋɩɩ, nʋʋkala nyal sɩaa?

english_verse: My people, soon you will suffer worse than ever before, but I will save you.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la chaasa lɔrɛ nɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ jaŋ tuo a nagʋ. Bʋa-la lɛ wʋwalɩmaa jaŋ jʋʋ Jekɔb, ama ʋ jaŋ lɩɩ ba lɛ suoo.”

english_verse: Now you are slaves of other nations, but I will break the chains and smash the yokes that keep you in slavery.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ, “Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, mɩ jaŋ bori daa-la sɩ laalɛ ba baŋŋaa, aŋ kɛrɛ chɔrʋmɔ-la ma sɩ vɔɔba. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɩwogusuŋ yosi.

english_verse: Then you will be my servants, and I will choose a king for you from the family of David. *
translation_verse: Ama, ba jaŋ tɩma pɩ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA Wɩa a tɩma pɩ Devit doho nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba kuoro.

english_verse: Israel, you belong to me, so don't be afraid. You deserved to be punished; that's why I scattered you in distant nations. But I am with you, and someday I will destroy those nations.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, mɩ tɩntɩnna Jekɔb doho nɩaa. Iziral tɩmma, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma niiree maa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Mɩ jaŋ sɛnɛ laama ta tintee-bolii-la ma sɩ hɛ lɛ a kɛmma kɔ dɩa. Mɩ jaŋ laa ma doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ ta. Iziral tinteeŋ jaŋ bɩra kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ dɩ ba hɔŋ sɔm, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba.

english_verse: Then I will bring you and your descendants back to your land, where I will protect you and give you peace. Then your fears will be gone. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Heal Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ laama ta. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Mɩ jaŋ chei tinteye-la kala lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛmma pɩsa hɛ, ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ chei ma-na gbelem gbelem. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmma tʋra kɩɩ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma mʋ pɛɩ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma mʋa.”

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, you are wounded and near death.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Nʋʋ bɩ ma naawɩɩlɩŋ wuo tɩɩbɛ. Ma pɩrɩna-la bɩ vaarɩna kɛnɛ.

english_verse: You are accused of a crime with no one to defend you, and you are covered with sores that no medicine can cure. *
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ sʋla laama, ma naawɩɩlɩŋ bɩ daaluno kɛnɛ. Ma bɩ vaarɩna kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Your friends have forgotten you; they don't care anymore. Even I have acted like an enemy. And because your sins are horrible and countless, I will be cruel as I punish you.
translation_verse: Ma sɩŋŋaa kala yʋ ma wɩaa nɛ, ba bɩ ma wɩaa chɩla. Mɩ ŋmooma a nagɛ ma dʋndɔmɔ sɩ jaŋ ŋmooma ŋɩɩ nɛ, a dɔgɩsɛma a nagɛ tʋɔhɛɛ tɩɩna sɩ jaŋ ŋaama ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma cheeriŋ chaasa yʋgɛ nɛ, ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma faasa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: But if your enemies try to rob or destroy you, I will rob and destroy them, and they will be led as captives to foreign lands.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ cheima, mɩ ma jaŋ cheiba. Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala mʋ yoŋ-baga. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ma kɩaa, ba jaŋ laa ba ma kɩaa. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa ma bɔmbɔŋ, mɩ ma jaŋ ŋaaba bɔmbɔŋ.

english_verse: No one wants you as a friend or cares what happens to you. But I will heal your injuries, and you will get well. The Lord Will Rescue Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ama mɩ jaŋ bɩra pɩma yarɩfɩɛlaa, a ŋaa dɩ ma naawɩɩlaa ma fɩɛlɛ, a tɩŋ nɩaa sɩ sɩ Zaayɔŋ nɩaa ŋaa nɩ-kire taalɩa nɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ ba wɩaa chɩla. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I will be kind to you and let you come home. Jerusalem now lies in ruins, but you will rebuild it, complete with a new palace.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩra tɩɩ ba tinteeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ fá ba nenige. Ba jaŋ bɩra paa Jerusalɛm kɛrɩsɩ-la sɩ tele a wasa saa, dɩ kuoru dɩa-la wasa chɩŋ ʋ dɩchɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: Other nations will respect and honor you. Your homes will be filled with children, and you will celebrate, singing praises to me.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a lʋlɔllɛmɛ, aŋ ŋaa goŋ a jʋjʋɔsɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba pʋŋa pɛ, ba bɩ jaŋ muuri. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa zizilba, ba bɩ jaŋ bee gʋʋnɛba.

english_verse: It will be just like old times. Your nation will worship me, and I will punish anyone who abuses you.
translation_verse: Ba biiriŋ jaŋ nagɛ faafaa-la, dɩ ba tasɩŋ ma chɩŋ woruŋ mɩ sɩɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ nyagɛba bil.

english_verse: One of your own people will become your ruler. And when I invite him to come near me at the place of worship, he will do so. No one would dare to come near without being invited.
translation_verse: Ba tɩtɩa dɔŋɔ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ba sɩpaalaara. Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ bibemba jaŋ lɩɩ ba tɩtɩa tʋɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ kʋ kpagɛmɛ, dɩ ʋ kʋ yimi. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ sɛɩ a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a kʋ kpagɛmɛ? Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ pɩɛsa.

english_verse: You will be my people, and I will be your God. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa, dɩ mɩ ma ŋaa ma Wɩa.”

english_verse: I am furious! And like a violent storm I will strike those who do wrong.
translation_verse: Ma bee na, La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ jaŋ sii a nagɛ duoŋ-peliŋ, ʋ jaŋ nagɛ pel-vinvilimiŋ a tuu nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nyuŋ.

english_verse: I won't calm down until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday, you will understand what I mean.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA baaŋ-la sɩ jaŋ chaasa sii bɩ fɩɛlɛ, see dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ. Tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ harɩŋ, ma jaŋ jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I promise that someday all your tribes will again be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Bʋa-la lɛ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa Iziral doho nɩaa kala Wɩa, dɩ ba ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.”

english_verse: In the desert I was kind to those who escaped death. I gave them peace, and when the time is right, I'll do the same for you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Rebuild Israel
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ foro laalɩŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ cheŋ nyu-sɩmɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kɔ a leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa na wiese.”

english_verse: Some time ago, the Lord appeared to me and told me to say: Israel, I will always love you; that's why I've been so patient and kind.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa dagɛla nɛ a bʋl, “Mɩ choma nɛ, chono-la bɩ dɩdɛrɩŋ kɛnɛ. Mɩ kɛmma kʋ kpagɛ mɩ tɩtɩa nɛ, a kɛŋ zile arɩ kenyiri ma teeŋ.

english_verse: You are precious to me, and so I will rebuild your nation. Once again you will dance for joy and play your tambourines.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, mɩ jaŋ bɩra kɛmma kɩɩ dɩ ma chɩŋ woruŋ. Ma jaŋ bɩra paa ma chɩnchɩgɩsɩŋ, a lɩɩ dɩ ma dɩ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɔ gʋa.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria and enjoy the grapes.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ bɩra pɛrɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ Samarɩa dundolluŋ nyuŋ. Paaraa jaŋ chɔnsɛ tɩɩsɩ-la, a nɩɩ ba nɛnɛɛ sɩma.

english_verse: Someday those who guard the hill country of Ephraim will shout, “Let's go to Zion and worship the Lord our God.” Israel Will Return to Its Own Land
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ jaŋ kɔ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɔ leriŋ a bibeŋ jaŋ faasa yɩrɛ Efirem dundolluŋ nyuŋ a bʋl, ‘Má kɔ dɩ la mʋ Zaayɔŋ, La TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord says: Celebrate and sing for Israel, the greatest of nations. Offer praises and shout, “Come and rescue your people, Lord! Save what's left of Israel.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a pɩ Iziral. Má ŋaa goŋ a pɩ tinteyee kala tʋɔŋ kʋbalɩŋ. Má leŋ dɩ nɩaa nɩɩ ma sɩ dɛnnʋ a bʋl, ‘La TƖƖNA, laa ŋ nɩaa ta, Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩkaana-la.’

english_verse: I, the Lord, will bring my people back from Babylonia and everywhere else on earth. The blind and the lame will be there. Expectant mothers and women about to give birth will come and be part of that great crowd.
translation_verse: Má bee na, mɩ jaŋ kɛmba lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa tinteeŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kɔ, mɩ jaŋ kɛmba lɩɩ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala a kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ. Nyʋlɩmaa arɩ gbɛrɩgɛɛ jaŋ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ, hapuugoo arɩ haalaa sɩɩ chɛ ba lʋl ba luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ ma jaŋ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ. Ba jaŋ yʋgɛ woruŋ a mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: They will weep and pray as I bring them home. I will lead them to streams of water. They will walk on a level road and not stumble. I am a father to Israel, my favorite children.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɔ aŋ yiyel, mɩ nɛ kɛmba mɩɩraa kɔ, ba jaŋ chʋchʋɔlɛmɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba to lere-la sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ yʋgɛ, dɩ ba vɛŋ tinteeŋ sɩ magɛ dɔŋɔ nyuŋ a sɩ́ gɛrʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyɩmma. Efirem nɛ ŋaa mɩ hambolibii bumbuŋ.

english_verse: Listen to me, you nations nearby or across the sea. I scattered the people of Israel, but I will gather them again. I will protect them like a shepherd guarding a flock;
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA wɩaa. Má heele bʋlba a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ dɩ-bolii. Mɩ-na nɛ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɩsɛ, mɩ saa jaŋ bɩra kɛmba kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ. Mɩ jaŋ beŋ mɩ nɩaa nyuŋ a nagɛ pie-daara sɩɩ beŋ ʋ piesee ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: I will rescue them from enemies who could overpower them.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta, mɩ jaŋ laaba ta nɩalɩŋ sɩ dolie kɩɩba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.
