english_verse: My people will come to Mount Zion and celebrate; their faces will glow because of my blessings. I'll give them grain, grapes, and olive oil, as well as sheep and cattle. Israel will be prosperous and grow like a garden with plenty of water.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɔ a ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ Zaayɔŋ dundolluŋ nyuŋ. Ba jaŋ jʋɔsɛ a tɩŋ kʋ-daŋ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩba wɩaa. Mɩ pɩba mɩaa, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ, a pɛ biiri-la ba nɛsɩŋ arɩ ba piesee sɩ lʋla lɛ. Ba jaŋ nagɛ lɩga sɩ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ woruŋ, ba tʋɔŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ chei.

english_verse: Young women and young men, together with the elderly, will celebrate and dance, because I will comfort them and turn their sorrow into happiness.
translation_verse: Hatoloo jaŋ gʋa dɩ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, a pɛ bapʋɔsaa arɩ banɩhɩasɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba yele bɩrɩmɛ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Mɩ jaŋ nyagɛ ba bɔyɛ, a leŋ dɩ ba tʋɔ-chei-la bɩrɩmɛ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: I will bless my people with more food than they need, and the priests will enjoy the choice cuts of meat. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Offers Hope
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa vɔgɛ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋ-daŋ, a leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa vɔgɛ arɩ kʋ-daŋ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ pɩba. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: In Ramah a voice is heard, crying and weeping loudly. Rachel mourns for her children and refuses to be comforted, because they are dead. *
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Nʋʋ nɩɩ yel Rama lɛ. Nɩɩ-la faasa yiyel nɛ. Rakɛl ka yel ʋ biiriŋ wɩaa nɛ. Ʋʋ yel nɛ a bɩ sɛɩ dɩ ba nyagɛ ʋ bɔyɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ biiriŋ kala sʋba nɛ.”

english_verse: But I, the Lord, say to dry your tears. Someday your children will come home from the enemy's land. Then all you have done for them will be greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Má leŋ yele, aŋ fɩɩsɛ ma sɩlɩɩrɩŋ ta, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ tiŋ ma lɔlʋŋ chɩmɩŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Ba jaŋ lɩɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tinteeŋ a mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel moan and say to me, “We were like wild bulls, but you, Lord, broke us, and we learned to obey. You are our God— please let us come home.
translation_verse: Mɩ chaasa nɩɩ Efirem sɩ yele a bʋl, ‘Ŋ kɛmmɛ tʋraa kɩɩ a nagɛ nɛ-bie ba ha sɩ bɩ daga nɛ, mɩ sɛɩ ŋ kɛmmɛ tʋra kɩɩ. Kɛmmɛ mɩɩra kɔ ŋ teeŋ, dɩ mɩ hɛ ŋ leriŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ nɛ mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: When we were young, we strayed and sinned, but then we realized what we had done. We are ashamed and disgraced and want to return to you.”
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa a yeŋŋi, mɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ nɛ. Mɩ sɩ kʋ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩaa, mɩ gʋrɛ nyuŋ nɛ. Hɩɩsɩŋ fa kɛmmɛ mɩ muuri, bɛɛ wɩaa hɩɩsɩ-la diimi a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa mɩ hambiriŋ kala lɛ nɛ.’

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my own dear children. Don't I love you best of all? Though I often make threats, I want you to be near me, so I will have mercy on you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Efirem nɛ mɩ hambolibii-chooluŋ, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ. Mɩ yie bʋl wɩaa a jʋʋ ʋ lɛ ma nɛ, ama mɩ haa liisi ʋ wɩaa nɛ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ kɛnʋ woruŋ, mɩ chaasaa fá ʋ nenige. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: With rock piles and signposts, mark the road well, my dear people. The road by which you left by will now lead you home.
translation_verse: Má bil magɩlaa wombiee lɛ, má bil magɩla-la sɩ jaŋ dagɛma wombiiŋ. Má jɩŋ wombii-jalɩɩ-la wɩaa, wɛŋ-la ma fa sɩ to mʋ. Iziral tɩmma, má mɩɩra kɔ, má mɩɩra kɔ ma tasɩŋ.

english_verse: Will you ever decide to be faithful? I will make sure that someday things will be different, as different as a woman protecting a man. The Lord Will Bring Judah Home
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ maa chɛ ma gɔllɔ baara diene magɛ, ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ? La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋaa wʋfalɩɩ dʋnɩa lɛ, haala jaŋ pʋpɔ baala.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I promise to set the people of Judah free and to lead them back to their hometowns. And when I do, they will once again say, “We pray that the Lord will bless his home, the sacred hill in Jerusalem where his temple stands.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛmba mɩɩra lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ arɩ ʋ tasɩŋ lɛ jaŋ bɩra kɔ a bʋl wɩaa deemba: ‘La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ tʋɔpʋl dɩa deeŋ sɩ chɩŋ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ nyuŋ.’

english_verse: The people will live in Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah. Some will be farmers, and others will be shepherds.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ hɔnɔ hɛ dɔŋɔ Juda tinteeŋ arɩ ʋ tasɩŋ kala lɛ, paaraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba pʋsʋŋ gɔllɔɔ baarɛ.

english_verse: Those who feel tired and worn out will find new life and energy,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɔlɔ yaraa polli, a leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ yiege bɩra kɛŋ doluŋ.”

english_verse: Someday, Israel and Judah will be my field where my people and their livestock will grow.
translation_verse: “Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla, tapʋlaa ka kɔ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa arɩ pʋsʋŋ bɩra pʋŋa su Iziral arɩ Juda tinteeŋ.

english_verse: In the past, I took care to uproot them, to tear them down, and to destroy them. But when that day comes, I will take care to plant them and help them grow.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩ beŋ ba nyuŋ a kɛmba churi ŋɩɩ, a yigiba lo, a cheiba, a lɛrɛ wʋlɔrʋŋ kʋ hɛ ba lɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ jaŋ bɩra beŋ ba nyuŋ dɩ ba wasa hɔŋ a leŋ dɩ ba chɩŋ woruŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: No longer will anyone go around saying, “Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ bʋl, ‘Nyɩmmaba nɛ chaŋ girep nɛŋ huoruŋ ka ba biiriŋ nyɩlaa mɩɩra nyal.’

english_verse: When that day comes, only those who eat sour grapes will get the sour taste, and only those who sin will be put to death. The New Agreement with Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋkala jaŋ sʋʋ a tɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ chaŋ girep nɛŋ-huoruŋ, ʋ tɩtɩa nyɩlaa nɛ jaŋ nyal.”

english_verse: The Lord said: The time will surely come when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla, “Bʋa dɔŋ jaŋ kɔ, dɩ mɩ bil nii-falɩŋ mɩ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Juda doho nɩaa pɛgɛ.

english_verse: It will be different from the agreement I made with their ancestors when I led them out of Egypt. Although I was their God, they broke that agreement.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ jaŋ nagɛ nii-la mɩ fa sɩ bile mɩ dɩ ba naabalɩmaba pɛgɛ, bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛmba kaa kʋʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ fa ŋaa ba bala nɛ, aŋ ka ba ha pɛ vɩa aŋ chei nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ba pɛgɛ. La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Here is the new agreement that I, the Lord, will make with the people of Israel: “I will write my laws on their hearts and minds. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Bʋa-la lɛ nii-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ bil mɩ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wombii-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto wɩaa hɛ ba nyuŋ lɛ, aŋ ŋmʋnsʋ a hɛ ba tʋɔŋ ma lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ba Wɩa, dɩ ba ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: “No longer will they have to teach one another to obey me. I, the Lord, promise that all of them will obey me, ordinary people and rulers alike. I will forgive their sins and forget the evil things they have done.”
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ dagɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna koo ʋ naambii ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a jɩmmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba kala jaŋ jɩmmɛ, a chɩŋ nɩbiisiŋ lɛ a kaa jɩl nɩbalaa. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ liliisi ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. I command the sun to give light each day, the moon and stars to shine at night, and ocean waves to roar.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, nɩɩ-la sɩ leŋe wɩɩpɔsʋŋ pʋpɔsɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ, a leŋ chɛnɛ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa pʋpɔsɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ, ʋ nɛ yie kɛŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ vuugi ʋ lɩɩ-peliŋ dɔŋ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: I will never forget to give those commands, and I will never let Israel stop being a nation. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Dɩ kɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ daga nɛ wuo lɛl mɩ sɩaa lɛ, ŋɩɩ-na Iziral doho ma jaŋ lɛl, a bɩra sɩ́ tintee ŋaa mɩ teeŋ.”

english_verse: Can you measure the heavens? Can you explore the depths of the earth? That's how hard it would be for me to reject Israel forever, even though they have sinned. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ jaŋ wuo magɩsɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, a wuo chɛ na dʋnɩa gentine ma, mɩ jaŋ vɩa Iziral doho nɩaa kala, a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋaa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Someday, Jerusalem will truly belong to me. It will be rebuilt with a boundary line running from Hananel Tower to Corner Gate.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Tapʋlaa ka kɔ nɛ, ba sɩ jaŋ wasa saa tabalɩŋ deeŋ a pɩmɛ, a chɩŋ Hananɛl dɩɩ-leŋii-la lɛ a kaa mʋ yi boi-baal-la sɩ hɛ je-gʋnʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: From there, the boundary will go in a straight line to Gareb Hill, then turn toward Goah.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ magɩsɛ tintee-la bʋa a chɩŋ ŋɩɩ tegi tegi a mʋ yi Garɛb dundolo aŋ gʋra mʋ Gʋa,

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in the tenth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia.
translation_verse: Zedikaaya sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, ʋ jɩ-fii lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa a pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya, dɩ Nebukadineza ma sɩ dii Babɩlɔŋ kuoruŋ, ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ chori lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: At that time, the Babylonian army had surrounded Jerusalem, and I was in the prison at the courtyard of the palace guards.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, dɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro laalɩyuoroo kʋʋ yuo Jerusalɛm a gollu chu, ka ba kɛŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya ma tɔ hɛ laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro kaala lɛ, Juda tinteeŋ kuoru dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Zedekiah had ordered me to be held there because I told everyone that the Lord had said: I am the Lord, and I am about to let the king of Babylonia conquer Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Zedikaaya nɛ fa kɛnʋ tɔ hɛ lee-la, aŋ bʋl, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bʋl ŋɩɩ? Ŋ sɩ sɩ, ‘Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩɩ chɛ mɩ joŋ tabalɩŋ deeŋ a hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ yuo diiu.

english_verse: King Zedekiah will be captured and taken to King Nebuchadnezzar, who will speak with him face to face.
translation_verse: Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Zedikaaya bɩ jaŋ fori Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ sɛnɛ jʋʋ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ, ʋ dɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ sɩaa chaasa dɔŋɔ aŋ bʋbʋl wɩaa. Ʋ jaŋ naʋ arɩ ʋ tɩtɩa sɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Then Zedekiah will be led away to Babylonia, where he will stay until I am finished with him. So, if you people of Judah fight against the Babylonians, you will lose. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ Zedikaaya mʋ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ, dɩ ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ dɔgʋsʋ woruŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ yuo Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo yuo diiba.’ ” Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Later, when I was in prison, the Lord said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ mɩ-na Jɛrɩmaaya,

english_verse: Jeremiah, your cousin Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, will visit you. He must sell his field near the town of Anathoth, and because you are his nearest relative, you have the right and the responsibility to buy it and keep it in the family.
translation_verse: “Ŋ nyɩmbie Salum nanʋala Hanamɛl jaŋ kɔ ŋ teeŋ a bʋl, ‘Laa mɩ ŋmaŋkaa-la sɩ hɛ Anatɔf lɛ a yɔɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ naambile sɩ tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ a jaŋ dii mɩ dʋa dɩ mɩ nɛ tuo. Ŋ nɛ kɛŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ŋ yɔbʋ.’ ”

english_verse: Hanamel came, just as the Lord had promised. And he said, “Please buy my field near Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. You have the right to buy it, and if you do, it will stay in our family.” The Lord had told me to buy it
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, mɩ naambie Hanamɛl kɔ mɩ teeŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ kaala-la tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Laa mɩ ŋmaŋkaa-la sɩ hɛ Anatɔf lɛ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ a yɔɔ. Ŋ nɛ kɛŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ŋ wuo bilu, yɔɔ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋ kʋŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: from Hanamel, and so I did. The price was
translation_verse: Mɩ laa tintee-la yɔɔ mɩ naambie Hanamɛl teeŋ aŋ dɩɩsɛ warɩpʋla fii arɩ balɩpɛ a pʋ.

english_verse: Lord God, you stretched out your mighty arm and made the sky and the earth. You can do anything.
translation_verse: “La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ŋ dol-balɩŋ arɩ ŋ naduo-la nɛ ŋ kaa ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ. Wɩɩkala tuo a dolie pɩŋ.

english_verse: I had two copies of the bill of sale written out: an official copy containing the details of our agreement and another copy, without the details. Some witnesses and I signed the official copy, which was folded and tied, before being sealed shut with hot wax. Then I gave Hanamel the silver.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ teŋ-la sɩ daga arɩ mɩ yɔɔ tintee-la nɛ, kʋ-la mɩ sɩ pilime tɔ sɩ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ tintee-la lɛ, a pɛ kʋ-la mɩ sɩ bɩ pilime tɔ lɛ,

english_verse: And while he, the witnesses, and all the other Jews sitting in the courtyard were still watching, I gave both copies to Baruch son of Neriah.
translation_verse: a joŋo pɩ Baruk sɩ ŋaa Neria nanʋala, aŋ ŋaa Maasɛya ma nihiŋ. Mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ naambie Hanamɛl sɩɩŋ lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ paa ba neniee a ŋaa pɛ-naaraa, arɩ Juu tɩmma-la kala sɩ hɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ kaala-la lɛ.

english_verse: I told Baruch that the Lord had said: Take both copies of this bill of sale, one sealed shut and the other open, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.
translation_verse: “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Laa tenniŋ deemba sɩ daga arɩ mɩ yɔɔ tintee-la nɛ, kʋ-la ba sɩ pilime tɔ arɩ kʋ-la ba sɩ bɩ pilime tɔ kala a joŋo hɛ pupoiŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ba hɛ nɩmɛ a dieni a sɩ́ chei,

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I promise you that people will once again buy and sell houses, farms, and vineyards in this country. Jeremiah Questions the Lord
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Nɩaa jaŋ bɩra yɔɔ dɩɩsɩŋ, tinteyee arɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: You show kindness for a thousand generations, but you also punish people for the sins of their parents. You are the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ŋ yie dagɛ ŋ chonuŋ a pɩ nɩaa bʋɩba nɛ, ama ŋ yie dɔgɩsɛ nɩaa biiriŋ arɩ ba nihee a tɩŋ ba nyɩmmaba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Ŋ nɛ Wɩa sɩ faasa kɛŋ doluŋ, ŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA, doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: With great wisdom you make plans, and with your great power you do all the mighty things you planned. Nothing we do is hidden from your eyes, and you reward or punish us as we deserve.
translation_verse: Ŋ wɩaa kala ŋaa wʋbala nɛ, ŋ wʋŋaalaa ma kala ŋaa wʋduoru. Ŋ sɩaa ka na nuhuobiinee wʋŋaalaa kala nɛ. Ŋ yie tiŋ nʋʋkala a lɩɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ mɛlɛ arɩ ʋ wʋŋaalaa sɩ naga nɛ.

english_verse: You are famous because you worked miracles in Egypt, and you are still working them in Israel and in the rest of the world as well.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, aŋ ha ŋɩŋaaba a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala tʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ leŋ ŋ laa yɩrɩ-balɩŋ lee-kala.

english_verse: You terrified the Egyptians with your miracles, and you reached out your mighty arm and rescued your people Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ nɛ, a dagɛ ŋ doluŋ, a ŋaa wɩaa sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ a kɛŋ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then you gave Israel this land rich with milk and honey, just as you had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Ŋ joŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ, kʋ-la ŋ fa sɩ ŋmɩɛsa arɩ ŋ jaŋ joŋo pɩ ba naabalɩmaba, tintee-la sɩ sɩma woruŋ.

english_verse: Jerusalem is under attack, and we suffer from hunger and disease. The Babylonians have already built dirt ramps up to the walls of our city, and you can see that Jerusalem will be captured just as you said.
translation_verse: Bee na ŋɩɩ ba sɩ saa vaŋkumba dɩ ba yuo dii tabal-la. A tɩŋ laalɩŋ, losuŋ arɩ nyanyalɩŋ wɩaa, tabal-la jaŋ jʋʋ Babɩlɔŋ tɩmma-la sɩɩ yuou nɩsɩŋ. Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ bʋla sɛnɛ ŋaa nɛ, ʋ nɛ ŋ nɩna ŋɩɩ lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: So why did you tell me to get some witnesses and buy a field with my silver, when Jerusalem is about to be captured by the Babylonians? The Lord Explains about the Field
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ jaŋ joŋ tabal-la a hɛ Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ ma, ŋ-na La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ ha bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Joŋ warɩpʋla a yɔɔ tintee-la, aŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa ŋaa pɛ-naaraa.’ ”

english_verse: Jeremiah, I am the Lord God. I rule the world, and I can do anything!
translation_verse: “Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, nuhuobiinee kala Wɩa. Wɩɩ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a dolie pɩmɛɛ?

english_verse: It is true that I am going to let King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩɩ chɛ mɩ joŋ tabalɩŋ deeŋ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza arɩ ʋ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ ba yuo diiu.

english_verse: The Babylonian army is already attacking, and they will capture the city and set it on fire. The people of Jerusalem have made me angry by going up to the flat roofs of their houses and burning incense to Baal and offering wine sacrifices to other gods. Now these houses will be burned to the ground!
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ tɩmma-la sɩɩ yuo tabalɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ kʋ jʋʋ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛʋ. Ba jaŋ nyɩgʋ dɩ ʋ dii tel, a pɛ dɩɩsɩ-la nɩaa sɩ kaa ŋaa wɩaa mɩ baanɩŋ sii lɛ. Dɩɩsɩ-la nyuŋ nɛ ba nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal, aŋ pɛ ŋaa kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ma aa pɩ vesiŋ.

english_verse: They have set up repulsive idols in my temple, and now it isn't a fit place to worship me.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ ba tɔŋŋɔɔ mɩ sɩɩ kɩsʋ nɛ a bil mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la mɩ yɩrɩŋ sɩ hɛ lɛ, a ŋaa ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: And they led Judah into sin by building places to worship Baal in Hinnom Valley, where they also sacrificed their sons and daughters to the god Molech. I have never even imagined they would commit such disgusting sins.
translation_verse: Ba saa vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa nɛ Bɛŋ Hɩnɔm fuonaaŋ lɛ a pɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal dɩ ba kɛsɛ ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba hantolibiisiŋ a kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk. Wɩɩ mɩ sɩ bɩ ba daga, ŋɩɩ paala bɩ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa ma kɔ arɩ ba jaŋ ŋaa wʋkɩsɩŋ deeŋ a leŋ dɩ Juda ŋaa wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, what you said is true. The people of Jerusalem are suffering from hunger and disease, and so the king of Babylonia will be able to capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ma bʋlaa tɩgɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, ‘Laalɩŋ, losuŋ arɩ nyanyalɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ taŋ deeŋ jʋʋ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ,’ ama wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: I am angry with the people of Jerusalem, and I will scatter them in foreign countries. But someday I will bring them back here and let them live in safety.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ sɛnɛ kɛsɛba hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a kaa lɩɩ tinteye-la kala lɛ mɩ sɩ chaasa na baanɩŋ mɩ yaraa hosi mɩ kiriba hɛ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ leriŋ deeŋ dɩ ba hɔŋ sɔm.

english_verse: They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa, dɩ mɩ ma ŋaa ba Wɩa.

english_verse: Even though I have brought disaster on the people, I will someday do all these good things for them.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ sɩ lɛrɛ wʋbɔŋ-balaa deemba kala kʋ hɛ nɩaa deemba lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ jaŋ pɩba dʋa-la kala mɩ sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩba.

english_verse: Jeremiah, when you bought the field, you showed that fields will someday be bought and sold again. You say that this land has been conquered by the Babylonians and has become a desert, emptied of people and animals.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ bɩra yɔɔ ŋmaŋkaanɩŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ, tintee-la ma sɩ sɩ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa yuo laa nɛ ʋ pɩŋ hoi, nɩaa arɩ pʋsʋŋ tuo ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: But someday, people will again spend their silver to buy fields everywhere—in the territory of Benjamin, the region around Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and in the hill country, the foothills to the west, and the Southern Desert. Buyers and sellers and witnesses will sign and seal the bills of sale for the fields. It will happen, because I will give this land back to my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ joŋ warɩpʋla a yɔɔ ŋmaŋkaanɩŋ, dɩ ba ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ a joŋ neniee, a kɛŋ tenni-la pilime tɔ ka dɩ nɩaa dii ŋaa pɛ-naaraa. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ ŋaa Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ golli Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa Juda tasɩŋ arɩ tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ, a pɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba bɩra mɩɩra kɔ ba tinteeŋ. Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: I was still being held prisoner in the courtyard of the palace guards when the Lord told me: I am the Lord, and I created the whole world.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA nɛ sɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa, ʋ nɛ sɩ mɛʋ a leŋ ʋ chɩŋ woruŋ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: Ask me, and I will tell you things that you don't know and can't find out.
translation_verse: “Yɩrɛmɛ, mɩ jaŋ sɛɩ, a dagɩŋ wʋduoruŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ faa ŋ bɩ ba jɩŋ.

english_verse: Then someday, I will heal this place and my people as well, and let them enjoy unending peace.
translation_verse: Ama arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, mɩ ha jaŋ pɩ mɩ nɩaa yarɩfɩɛlaa dɩ ba duori. Mɩ jaŋ vaarɛba a leŋ dɩ ba tinteeŋ chaasa kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ dɩ ba hɔŋ sɔm.

english_verse: I will give this land to Israel and Judah once again, and I will make them as strong as they were before.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Juda arɩ Iziral nɩaa mɩɩra lɩɩ yoŋ-baga-la ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛba mʋ a kɔ, a leŋ dɩ ba chɩŋ a nagɛ ŋɩɩ ba fa sɩ naga.

english_verse: They sinned and rebelled against me, but I will forgive them and take away their guilt.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ pɩɩsɛ wʋbɔŋ-la kala ba sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ a ta, a joŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ma kala ba sɩ vɩamɛ aŋ ŋaa chɛba.

english_verse: When that happens, all nations on earth will see the good things I have done for Jerusalem, and how I have given it complete peace. The nations will celebrate and praise and honor me, but they will also tremble with fear because of the powerful things I have done.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ laa yɩrɩŋ pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, dɩ nɩaa dɩdɛnnɛmɛ a zizilmi dʋnɩa tinteye-la kala nɩaa sɩ nɩɩ wʋzɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa pʋ sɩpaaŋ. Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmba dɩ ba chichel a tɩŋ dʋa bal-la arɩ fɩɛl-la mɩ sɩ pʋ wɩaa.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, you say that this land is a desert without people or animals, and for now, you are right. The towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem are deserted, and people and animals are nowhere to be seen. But someday you will hear
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ma bʋla a mʋ tɩgɛ leriŋ deeŋ lɛ, ‘Ʋ pɩŋ hoi nɛ, nɩaa arɩ pʋsʋŋ tuo.’ Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, Juda tasɩŋ arɩ Jerusalɛm womporunu-la sɩ pɩŋ pɛɩ ŋɩɩ, nɩaa koo pʋsʋŋ tuo ba lɛ, nɩaa jaŋ bɩra nɩɩ

english_verse: happy voices and the sounds of parties and wedding celebrations. And when people come to my temple to offer sacrifices to thank me, you will hear them say: “We praise you, Lord All-Powerful! You are good to us, and your love never fails.” The land will once again be productive.
translation_verse: tʋɔtɔrɛ goŋ nɩmɛ. Ha-falaa arɩ ba balaba jaŋ bɩra ŋaa goŋ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩa dɩ ba lɔllɛmɛ bʋl, ‘Má lɔllɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ wɩaa zɔmɔ ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.’ Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tinteeŋ deeŋ bɩra kɛŋ dʋa arɩ ʋ fa sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Now it is empty, without people or animals. But when that time comes, shepherds will take care of their flocks in pastures near every town in the hill country, in the foothills to the west, in the Southern Desert, in the land of the Benjamin tribe, and around Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord's Wonderful Promise
translation_verse: Tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga tasɩŋ lɛ, wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ, tabiisi-la sɩ golli Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda tasɩŋ lɛ, pie-daaraa jaŋ bɩra daa ba piesee. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I made a wonderful promise to Israel and Judah, and the days are coming when I will keep it.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Tapʋlaa ka kɔ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ nii-la mɩ sɩ hɛ pɩ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Juda nɩaa sɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: I promise that the time will come when I will appoint a king from the family of David, a king who will be honest and rule with justice.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩa-la lɛ, mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna Devit doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: In those days, Judah will be safe; Jerusalem will have peace and will be named, “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩa-la lɛ, ba jaŋ laa Juda nɩaa ta, dɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa hɔŋ sɔm. Ba jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ tabal-la: La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa la kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla.”

english_verse: The king of Israel will be one of David's descendants,
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Devit doho nʋʋ nɛ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ bʋa na-kala Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and there will always be priests from the Levi tribe serving at my altar and offering sacrifices to please me and to give thanks.
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa ma sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ bʋa na-kala a ŋɩŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a kpʋ pʋsʋŋ ma a ŋɩŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl wɩaa pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya:

english_verse: I, the Lord, have an agreement with day and night, so they always come at the right time. You can't break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Dɩ ŋ nɛ jaŋ wuo chei nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ pɛgɛ, a pɔ dɩ wɩa sɩ́ pɔsʋ bʋa-la sɩ maga lɛ, dɩ taŋ ma sɩ́ biru bʋa-la sɩ maga lɛ,

english_verse: and you can't break the agreements I have made with David's family and with the priests from the Levi tribe who serve at my altar. A descendant of David will always rule as king of Israel,
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na, ŋ jaŋ wuo chei nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit pɛgɛ, arɩ nii-la mɩ sɩ bile mɩ dɩ Levi doho nɩaa pɛgɛ arɩ ba nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa a tɩtɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ, dɩ Devit bɩra sɩ́ doho nʋʋ kɛŋ sɩ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: and there will be more descendants of David and of the priests from the Levi tribe than stars in the sky or grains of sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit doho nɩaa arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ doho nɩaa pʋŋ woruŋ a bɩ nii kɛnɛ a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ koo hagɩlɩ-bumbugulo sɩ pɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord also said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya:

english_verse: You've heard foreigners insult my people by saying, “The Lord chose Israel and Judah, but now he has rejected them, and they are no longer a nation.”
translation_verse: “Ŋ bɩ nɩa arɩ nɩaa ka bʋl arɩ mɩ vɩa kuori gentisiŋ deemba balɩa mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa ta nɛɛ? Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba sɩɩŋ bɩ mɩ nɩaa ka su, a bɩra bɩ bene arɩ ba ŋaa tintee ma.

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will never break my agreement with the day and the night or let the sky and the earth stop obeying my commands.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa bɩ niiŋ bile mɩ dɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ pɛgɛ a bil wombiee pɩ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ dɩ ba tuto,

english_verse: In the same way, I will never reject the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob or break my promise that they will always have a descendant of David as their king. I will be kind to my people Israel, and they will be successful again.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ-na mɩ fa jaŋ vɩa Jekɔb doho nɩaa arɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit, a bɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ beŋ Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb doho nɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba bɩra mɩɩra kɔ ba tinteeŋ a fá ba nenige.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar had a large army made up of people from every kingdom in his empire. He and his army were attacking Jerusalem and all the nearby towns, when the Lord told me
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo arɩ ʋ kuori gentisiŋ arɩ ʋ nɩaa sɩ hɛ tintee-la kala ʋ sɩɩ beŋ lɛ sɩ mʋa a yuyuo Jerusalɛm arɩ tasɩ-la kala sɩ gollu lɛ nɛ, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa a pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya.

english_verse: to say to King Zedekiah: I am the Lord, and I am going to let Nebuchadnezzar capture this city and burn it down.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mʋ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Zedikaaya teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩɩ chɛ mɩ joŋ tabalɩŋ deeŋ a hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ ʋ nyɩgʋ.

english_verse: You will be taken prisoner and brought to Nebuchadnezzar, and he will speak with you face to face. Then you will be led away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ jaŋ fori ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ yuo kɛnɩŋ a kaa mʋ hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ŋ jaŋ na Babɩlɔŋ kuoro arɩ ŋ sɩɩŋ, ŋ dɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ sɩaa chaasɛ dɔŋɔ a bʋl wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ ba jaŋ kɛnɩŋ mʋ Babɩlɔŋ.

english_verse: You will die a peaceful death. People will mourn when you die, and they will light bonfires in your honor, just as they did for your ancestors, the kings who ruled before you.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ fɛlɛlɛ. Ba sɩ hɛ yoho nyiniŋ a zil ŋ nyɩmmaba ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ a dii kuoruŋ aŋ ka pɩŋ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba jaŋ hɛ ŋ ma yoho nyiniŋ a ziliŋ a yel ŋ lɛ a bʋl, ‘Ou la nɩhɩaŋ.’ Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ hɛ niiŋ deeŋ, mɩ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: I went to Zedekiah and told him what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya bʋl wɩaa deemba kala a pɩ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Zedikaaya Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the king of Babylonia was trying to break through the walls of Lachish, Azekah, and Jerusalem, the only three towns of Judah that had not been captured. The People Break a Promise
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro ka yuo Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda tabala-la dɔnsʋŋ ba ha sɩ bɩ yuo laa: Lakɩs arɩ Azɛka. Tabalaa deemba ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli dʋndʋŋa nɛ fa ha ka Juda lɛ. Ba joŋ yosuŋ ta

english_verse: King Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone else in Jerusalem made an agreement to free all Hebrew men and women who were slaves. No Jew would keep another as a slave. And so, all the Jewish slaves were given their freedom.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɛɩ a bil niiŋ arɩ ba jaŋ joŋ ba yoŋ-baalaa arɩ ba yoŋ-haalaa ta a bɩra sɩ́ ba kaa bɩrɩmɛ yosi. Ba sɛɩ a jomba ta.

english_verse: But those slave owners changed their minds and forced their former slaves back into slavery.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, ba bɩra kɛŋ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩrɩmɛ, a kɛsɛ ba yosu-la ba fa sɩ joŋo ta ba bɩra ŋaa yosi.

english_verse: That's when the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa a pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: I am the Lord God of Israel, and I made an agreement with your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, where they had been slaves.
translation_verse: “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ fa bil niiŋ nɛ mɩ dɩ ma naabalɩmaba pɛgɛ, bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛmba kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, lee-la ba fa sɩ ŋaa yosi. Mɩ fa bʋla pɩba:

english_verse: but you decided to obey me and do the right thing by setting your Hebrew slaves completely free. You even went to my temple, and in my name you made an agreement to set them free. But you have abused my name, because you broke that agreement and forced your former slaves back into slavery.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ ma bɩra mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ nɛ a chei mɩ yɩrɩŋ. Ma kʋŋkala bɩra mɩɩra kɛsɛ ma yoŋ-baala-la arɩ yoŋ-haala-la ma fa sɩ joŋo ta dɩ ba mʋ lee-kala ba sɩɩ chɛ nɛ. Ma fʋgɛba nɛ ba bɩra ŋaa ma yosi.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by not giving your slaves their freedom. So I will give you freedom—the freedom to die in battle or from disease or hunger. I will make you disgusting to all other nations on earth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ma bɩ mɩ niiŋ to, ma bɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa ma yosuŋ joŋo ta. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ-na jaŋ jomma ta: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ laalɩŋ, losuŋ arɩ nyanyal-bɔmʋŋ kpʋma. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma nagɛ kʋŋ sɩɩ sʋɔrʋ kuori-gentisiŋ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ teeŋ.

english_verse: You asked me to be a witness when you made the agreement to set your slaves free. And as part of the ceremony you cut a calf into two parts, then walked between the parts. But you people of Jerusalem have broken that agreement as well as my agreement with Israel. So I will do to you what you did to that calf.
translation_verse: Baala-la sɩ chei mɩ nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ba pɛgɛ, a bɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ nii-la lɛ ba sɩ bile mɩ sɩpaaŋ to, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa ba lɛ a nagɛ nɛ-bie ba sɩ kaa keri balɩa a bil, aŋ vɩvɛŋ nammɩa-la ba sɩ kaa kere bil balɩa pɛgɛ.

english_verse: These enemies are King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia and his army. They have stopped attacking Jerusalem, but they want to kill King Zedekiah and his high officials. So I will command them to return and attack again. This time they will conquer the city and burn it down, and they will capture Zedekiah and his officials. I will also let them destroy the towns of Judah, so that no one can live there any longer.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla, mɩ jaŋ pa wombiiŋ, a kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ tabalɩŋ deeŋ. Ba jaŋ yuo laaʋ a nyɩgʋ dɩ ʋ dii tel. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Juda tasɩŋ chei a pɩŋ, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wuo hɔŋ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: When Jehoiakim was king of Judah, the Lord told me,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Josaaya nanʋala Jehoyakim sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ nɛ, La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya:

english_verse: “Go to the Rechabite clan and invite them to meet you in one of the side rooms of the temple. When they arrive, offer them a drink of wine.”
translation_verse: “Mʋ Rekab dɩa nɩaa leriŋ, a yɩrɛba dɩ ba kɔ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la sɛmɛ dɩɩsɩ-la dɔŋɔ dɩ ŋ pɩba girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ dɩ ba nyʋa.”

english_verse: So I went to Jaazaniah, the leader of the clan, and I invited him and all the men of his clan.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mʋ yɩrɛ Jazanɩa sɩ ŋaa Jɛrɩmaaya dɔŋ ma nanʋala, aŋ ŋaa Habazɩnaya ma nihiŋ, arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ a pɛ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kala lɛ, Rekab dɩa nɩaa kala.

english_verse: I brought them into the temple courtyard and took them upstairs to a room belonging to the prophets who were followers of Hanan son of Igdaliah. It was next to a room belonging to some of the officials, and that room was over the one belonging to Maaseiah, a priest who was one of the high officials in the temple.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛmba kaa kɔ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la, a kɛmba jʋʋ Ɩgɩdalɩa nanʋala Hanaŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɩa. Dɩa-la fa tɩgɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la dɩa lɛ nɛ, kʋ-la sɩ sugili Salum nanʋala Maasɛya sɩ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɔ boi-niiŋ dɩa nyuŋ.

english_verse: I set out some large bowls full of wine together with some cups, and then I said to the Rechabites, “Have some wine!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ gbansɩŋ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ sɩ suo arɩ nyʋnyʋalʋsʋŋ a bil Rekab dɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma nyʋa girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ.”

english_verse: But they answered: No! The ancestor of our clan, Jonadab son of Rechab, made a rule that we must obey. He said, “Don't ever drink wine
translation_verse: Ama ba mɩɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, “La bɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ ka nyʋa, bɛɛ wɩaa la naabalɩma Rekab nanʋala Jonadab bʋl ŋ-la nɛ a pɩla: ‘Ma-na koo ma doho nɩaa kʋŋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ nyʋa girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: or build houses or plant crops and vineyards. Instead, you must always live in tents and move from place to place. If you obey this command, you will live a long time.”
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ dɩɩsɩŋ ma saa, a sɩ́ kɩaa ma duu koo a bil tɩɩnɛnɛɛ bagɩsɩŋ. Ma bɩ maga ma kɛŋ kɩaa deemba kʋŋkala. Ma maga ma jʋjʋʋ lɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ bʋa na-kala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ ma sɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa a dieni.’

english_verse: except now we have to live inside Jerusalem because Nebuchadnezzar has taken over the countryside with his army from Babylonia and Syria.
translation_verse: Ama Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza sɩ kʋʋ yuo tinteeŋ deeŋ nɛ, la sɩ, ‘Má kɔ, la maga la mʋ Jerusalɛm, a wuo fori Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa arɩ Siiria laalɩyuoroo nɩsɩŋ lɛ.’ Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, want you to learn a lesson
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mʋ pɩɛsɛ Juda baalaa arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa na: ‘Ma bɩ jaŋ gʋnnɛ wɩaa a to mɩ niiŋ wɩaa koo?’ Ma TƖƖNA nɛ pɩɛsa.

english_verse: from the Rechabite clan. Their ancestor Jonadab told his descendants never to drink wine, and to this very day they have obeyed him. But I have spoken to you over and over, and you haven't obeyed me!
translation_verse: Rekab nanʋala Jonadab bʋla pɩ ʋ hambolibiisi-la dɩ ba sɩ́ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩŋ-la nyʋa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ wɩɩ-la kaa tɩŋ, arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala ba bɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ ka nyʋa, bɛɛ wɩaa baa to ba naabalɩmaba niiŋ nɛ. Ama mɩ-na bʋl wɩaa pɩma bʋlɩa bʋlɩa nɛ ka ma bɩ mɩ niiŋ to.

english_verse: You refused to listen to my prophets, who kept telling you, “Stop doing evil and worshiping other gods! Start obeying the Lord, and he will let you live in this land he gave your ancestors.”
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩŋ mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa kala ma teeŋ nɛ bʋlɩa bʋlɩa. Ba bʋla pɩma, ‘Ma kʋŋkala maga ma bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ, a bɩrɩmɛ ma wʋŋaalaa. Má sɩ́ vesiŋ to, dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩ ma dɩ ma naabalɩmaba lɛ.’ Ama ma bɩ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ koo a kaa tɩŋ.

english_verse: The Rechabites have obeyed the command of their ancestor Jonadab, but you have not obeyed me,
translation_verse: Rekab nanʋala Jonadab doho nɩaa kɛŋ wɩɩ-la ba naabalɩma sɩ bʋla pɩba kaa tɩŋ nɛ, ama nɩaa deemba bɩ mɩ niiŋ to.

english_verse: your God. I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warned you about the terrible things that would happen to you if you did not listen to me. But you have ignored me, so now disaster will strike you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Makes a Promise to the Rechabites
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má jegile nɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la kala wɩaa mɩ sɩ bʋla a kaa kʋ hɛ Juda arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Mɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩba nɛ, ama ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ. Mɩ yɩrɛba nɛ, ama ba bɩ sɛyɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the Rechabite clan: “I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You have obeyed your ancestor Jonadab,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya bʋla pɩ Rekab doho nɩalɩŋ, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Ma sɛɩ wɩalɩŋ ma naabalɩma Jonadab sɩ dagɛma nɛ, a to wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ dagɛma, a ŋaa ba kala.’

english_verse: so I promise that your clan will be my servants and will never die out.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Rekab nanʋala Jonadab jaŋ kɛŋ hambolibie bʋa na-kala dɩ ʋ tɩma pɩpɩmɛ.’ ”

english_verse: During the fourth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah, the Lord said to me, “Jeremiah,
translation_verse: Josaaya nanʋala Jehoyakim sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-nɛsɛ lɛ nɛ, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ a pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya:

english_verse: since the time Josiah was king, I have been speaking to you about Israel, Judah, and the other nations. Now, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you,
translation_verse: “Joŋ teniŋ a ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Iziral arɩ Juda lɛ arɩ tinteye-la dɔnsʋŋ, a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ suomo a bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩŋ, bʋa-la lɛ Josaaya sɩ dii kuoruŋ a kaa kɔ lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: then read it to the people of Judah. Maybe they will stop sinning when they hear what terrible things I plan for them. And if they turn back to me, I will forgive them.”
translation_verse: Kapo Juda nɩaa nɛ nɩɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la mɩ sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ dɩ mɩ joŋo hɛ ba lɛ, ba jaŋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ba wʋcheelee a chɛba.”

english_verse: I sent for Baruch son of Neriah and asked him to help me. I repeated everything the Lord had told me, and Baruch wrote it all down on a scroll.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya yɩrɛ Neria nanʋala Baruk, a bʋbʋl wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pʋ, ka Baruk ŋmʋnsa hɩhɛ teniŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then I said, Baruch, the officials refuse to let me go into the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya bʋla pɩ Baruk, “Ba pɔ mɩ bɩra sɩ́ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la jʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: so you must go instead. Wait for the next holy day when the people of Judah come to the temple to pray and to go without eating. Then take this scroll to the temple and read it aloud.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ vɔɔ niiŋ, a karɩmɛ La TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla ŋ ŋmʋnsɛ. Karɩmɛba a pɩ Juda nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ lɩɩ ba tasɩŋ kɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is furious, and if the people hear how he is going to punish them, maybe they will ask to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Kapo ba jaŋ kɔ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a sʋlʋ aŋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA sɩ na baanɩŋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ tɩgɛ nɩaa deemba lɛ bɩ bana kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: In the ninth month of the fifth year that Jehoiakim was king, the leaders set a day when everyone who lived in Jerusalem or who was visiting there had to pray and go without eating. So Baruch took the scroll to the upper courtyard of the temple. He went over to the side of the courtyard and stood in a covered area near New Gate, where he read the scroll aloud. This covered area belonged to Gemariah, one of the king's highest officials.
translation_verse: Baruk fa chɩŋ Safaŋ nanʋala Gɛmarɩa sɩ ŋaa teŋ ŋmʋnsʋra dɩa lɛ nɛ, dɩa-la fa hɛ nyuŋ kaala-la lɛ nɛ, a kpagɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boi-baal falɩɩ-la, aŋ karɩmɛ wɩalɩŋ kala Jɛrɩmaaya sɩ bʋla sɩ hɛ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Gemariah's son Micaiah was there and heard Baruch read what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Gɛmarɩa nanʋala Mɩkaaya sɩ ŋaa Safaŋ nihiŋ sɩ nɩɩ La TƖƖNA wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ,

english_verse: When Baruch finished reading, Micaiah went down to the palace. His father Gemariah was in the officials' room, meeting with the rest of the king's officials, including Elishama, Delaiah, Elnathan, and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: ʋ sii mʋ teŋ ŋmʋnsʋrʋ-la dɩa sɩ hɛ kuoru dɩa lɛ, lee-la tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la kala sɩ hɔnɔ: Ɛlɩsama sɩ ŋaa teŋ ŋmʋnsʋra, Sɛmaaya nanʋala Delaaya, Akɩbɔ nanʋala Ɛlɩnataŋ, Safaŋ nanʋala Gɛmarɩa, Hananaaya nanʋala Zedikaaya arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ kala.

english_verse: Micaiah told them what he had heard Baruch read to the people.
translation_verse: Mɩkaaya sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ nɩa dɩ Baruk karɩma teŋ-la a pɩ nɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ,

english_verse: the officials said, “Please sit down and read it to us,” which he did.
translation_verse: Ba bʋla pʋ, “Yaa tuu hɔŋ a karɩmɛ teŋ-la pɩla.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Baruk karɩma pɩba.

english_verse: After they heard what was written on the scroll, they were worried and said to each other, “The king needs to hear this!” Turning to Baruch, they asked,
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ karɩmɛ wɩalɩŋ ba nɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba ba bibeŋ dɔŋɔ aŋ bʋla pɩ Baruk, “La maga la mʋ bʋl wɩaa deemba kala a pɩ kuoro nɛ.”

english_verse: “Yes, Jeremiah did,” Baruch replied. “I wrote down just what he told me.”
translation_verse: Baruk bʋl, “Oo, ʋ nɛ bʋl wɩaa deemba kala mɩ kɛŋ pensi daaŋ ŋmʋnsɛba a hɛ teniŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The officials said, “You and Jeremiah must go into hiding, and don't tell anyone where you are going.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la bʋla pɩ Baruk, “Ŋ dɩ Jɛrɩmaaya, má mʋ faa. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala jɩŋ lee-la ma sɩ hɛ.”

english_verse: The king told his son Jerahmeel to take Seraiah and Shelemiah and to go arrest Baruch and me. But the Lord kept them from finding us. Jeremiah's Second Scroll
translation_verse: aŋ mɩɩra bʋla pɩ kuoro nanʋala Jɛramɛɛl, Azɩrɩɛl nanʋala Sɛraaya arɩ Abɩdɛɛl nanʋala Sɛlɛmaaya dɩ ba kɛŋ Baruk sɩ ŋaa Wɩa teniŋ kerichi arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya. Ama La TƖƖNA kɛmba faa nɛ.

english_verse: I had told Baruch what to write on that first scroll, but King Jehoiakim had burned it. So the Lord told me
translation_verse: Kuoro sɩ nyɩgɛ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ wɩalɩŋ Jɛrɩmaaya sɩ bʋla, Baruk ŋmʋnsɛ harɩŋ, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: to get another scroll and write down everything that had been on the first one.
translation_verse: “Joŋ teniŋ dɔŋɔ a ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ bumbuŋ teŋ-la lɛ a hɛ ʋ lɛ, ʋ nɛ Juda kuoro Jehoyakim nyɩgɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Then he told me to say to King Jehoiakim: Not only did you burn Jeremiah's scroll, you had the nerve to ask why he had written that the king of Babylonia would attack and ruin the land, killing all the people and even the animals.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Jehoyakim, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ŋ nyɩgɛ teŋ-la nɛ aŋ bʋl, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ ŋmʋnsɛ arɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro jaŋ sɛnɛ kʋ chei tinteeŋ deeŋ a kpʋ ʋ nɩaa arɩ ʋ pʋsʋŋ kala?’

english_verse: So I, the Lord, promise that you will be killed and your body thrown out on the ground. The sun will beat down on it during the day, and the frost will settle on it at night. And none of your descendants will ever be king of Judah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Juda kuoro Jehoyakim lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ nʋʋ sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ Devit kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ. Ba jaŋ joŋ ʋ kʋsʋʋŋ yuo ta dɩ wɩa kpʋʋ wɩɩhɛyɛ, dɩ nyalɩŋ ma nyala kɛnʋ tɩtaŋɩŋ.

english_verse: You, your children, and your servants are evil, and I will punish everyone of you. I warned you and the people of Judah and Jerusalem that I would bring disaster, but none of you have listened. So now you are doomed!
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la wɩaa mɩ sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ ba lɛ kaa kʋ hɛ ba dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.”

english_verse: After the Lord finished speaking to me, I got another scroll and gave it to Baruch. Then I told him what to write, so this second scroll would contain even more than was on the scroll Jehoiakim had burned.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya bɩra joŋ teniŋ dɔŋɔ a pɩ Neria nanʋala Baruk sɩ ŋaa Wɩa teniŋ kerichi. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya bʋl wɩalɩŋ, Baruk ŋmʋnsɛba hɩhɛ teŋ-la lɛ, wɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ hɛ teŋ-la Juda kuoro Jehoyakim sɩ nyɩga tʋɔŋ. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ wʋdaŋ sɩ nagɛ bumbuŋ wɩalɩŋ nɛ a pɛ.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had removed Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim from being the king of Judah and had made Josiah's son Zedekiah king instead.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza nɛ leŋe Josaaya nanʋala Zedikaaya dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ. Jehoyakim nanʋala Jehoyachiŋ nyuŋ nɛ ʋ laa dii kuorii-la.

english_verse: But Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone else in Judah ignored everything the Lord had told me.
translation_verse: Ʋ-na koo ʋ tɩntɩnnaa koo nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ bɩ wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ to Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya lɛ a bʋl kaa tɩŋ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to send them back to Zedekiah with this message: Zedekiah, you wanted Jeremiah to ask me, the Lord God of Israel, what is going to happen. So I will tell you. The king of Egypt and his army came to your rescue, but soon they will go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Bʋla pɩ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro, nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmɩŋ dɩ ŋ kʋ chɛ na wɩaa mɩ teeŋ, Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro laalɩyuoro-la sɩ kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ba pɛ ŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ Ijipiti.

english_verse: Then the Babylonians will return and attack Jerusalem, and this time they will capture the city and set it on fire.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa jaŋ mɩɩra kʋ yuo tabalɩŋ deeŋ. Ba jaŋ yuo diiu a nyɩgʋ dɩ ʋ dii tel.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves into thinking that the Babylonians will leave as they did before.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa nyɩsʋ a bʋl, ‘Babɩlɔŋ tɩmma-la jaŋ lenla.’ Ba bɩ jaŋ lemma.

english_verse: Even if you could defeat their entire army, their wounded survivors would still be able to leave their tents and set Jerusalem on fire. Jeremiah Is Put in Prison
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ fa paala yuo dii Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kala sɩɩ yuoma ma, aŋ ka ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ bolimo dʋndʋŋa ma ba lɛŋŋɛɛ lɛ, ba jaŋ wuo kʋ lɩɩ a nyɩgɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ dɩ ʋ dii tel.”

english_verse: The Babylonian army had left because the Egyptian army was on its way to help us.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la sɩ leŋ Jerusalɛm yuonuŋ aŋ mɩɩrɛ a tɩŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ laalɩyuoroo wɩaa, ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ

english_verse: So I decided to leave Jerusalem and go to the territory of the Benjamin tribe to claim my share of my family's land.
translation_verse: Jɛrɩmaaya suomo lɩɩ tabal-la lɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ a laa ʋ tinteeŋ kpaalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: I was leaving Jerusalem through Benjamin Gate, when I was stopped by Irijah, the officer in charge of the soldiers at the gate. He said, “Jeremiah, you're under arrest for trying to join the Babylonians.”
translation_verse: Ama ʋ sɩ mʋ yi Bɛnjamɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ nɩhɩaŋ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Ɩrɩja, a ŋaa Sɛlɛmaaya nanʋala aŋ ŋaa Hananaaya ma nihiŋ, ʋ kɛnʋ aŋ bʋl, “Ŋ lenla aŋ mʋ pɛ Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: “I'm not trying to join them!” I answered. But Irijah wouldn't listen, and he took me to the king's officials.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya bʋl, “Wɩɩŋ deeŋ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋaa. Mɩ-na bɩ ma leŋe aŋ mʋ pɛ Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ.” Ama Ɩrɩja bɩ Jɛrɩmaaya teeŋ jegile, aŋ kɛnʋ mʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: King Zedekiah secretly had me brought to his palace, where he asked, “Is there any message for us from the Lord?” “Yes, there is, Your Majesty,” I replied. “The Lord is going to let the king of Babylonia capture you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Zedikaaya tɩŋ ba mʋ kɛnʋ kaa kɔ kuoro dɩa. Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ lʋara pɩɛsʋ, “La TƖƖNA bɩ wɩɩ bʋlaa?” Jɛrɩmaaya sɩ, “Oo ʋ bʋla nɛ, ʋ jaŋ joŋuŋ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Then I continued, “Your Majesty, why have you put me in prison? Have I committed a crime against you or your officials or the nation?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya pɩɛsɛ kuoro Zedikaaya, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa a chei ŋ-na koo ŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ koo nɩaa deemba, ma kɛmmɛ tɔ dɩa?

english_verse: Have you locked up the prophets who lied to you and said that the king of Babylonia would never attack Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩŋ hɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɩ, ‘Babɩlɔŋ kuoro bɩ jaŋ kʋ yuoŋ koo a yuo tinteeŋ deeŋ?’

english_verse: Please, don't send me back to that prison at Jonathan's house. If you do, I will die there.”
translation_verse: Kuoro, mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ jegile nɩɩ. Leŋ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ: Bɩra sɩ́ mɩ kaa mɩɩra mʋ Jonataŋ sɩ ŋaa teŋ ŋmʋnsʋra dɩa, dɩ ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ sʋʋ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: King Zedekiah had me taken to the prison cells in the courtyard of the palace guards. He told the soldiers to give me a loaf of bread from one of the bakeries every day until the city ran out of grain.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Zedikaaya pa wombiiŋ dɩ ba joŋ Jɛrɩmaaya hɛ laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro kaala lɛ, aŋ pʋpʋ boroboro-la ba sɩɩ yallɛ womporuŋ lɛ see dɩ ba kala dɛrɛ tabal-la lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya ka laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro kaala-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: One day, Shephatiah, Gedaliah, Jehucal, and Pashhur heard me tell the people of Judah
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Mataŋ nanʋala Sɛfatɩa, Pasɩhɔ nanʋala Gedalia, Sɛlɛmaaya nanʋala Jehukal arɩ Malɩkɩja nanʋala Pasɩhɔ nɩɩ dɩ Jɛrɩmaaya bʋl wɩaa a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ kala. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: that the Lord had said, “If you stay here in Jerusalem, you will die in battle or from disease or hunger, and the Babylonian army will capture the city anyway. But if you surrender to the Babylonians, they will let you live.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Mɩ jaŋ sɛnɛ joŋ tabalɩŋ deeŋ a hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro laalɩyuoroo nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba yuo diiu.’ ”

english_verse: So the four of them went to the king and said, “You should put Jeremiah to death, because he is making the soldiers and everyone else lose hope. He isn't trying to help our people; he's trying to harm them.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Baala deeŋ maga la kpʋʋ nɛ. Ʋ leŋe laalɩyuoro-la sɩ ka tabalɩŋ deeŋ lɛ nandaasɩŋ yʋyʋɔrɛ nɛ a pɛ nɩalɩŋ kala lɛ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩpɩba. Baala deeŋ bɩ nɩaa deemba woruŋ ka chɛ, ʋʋ chɛ ʋ cheiba nɛ.”

english_verse: Zedekiah replied, “Do what you want with him. I can't stop you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Zedikaaya bʋl, “Ʋ hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl ma sɩ́ ʋ wɩɩkala ŋaa.”

english_verse: Then they took me back to the courtyard of the palace guards and let me down with ropes into the well that belonged to Malchiah, the king's son. There was no water in the well, but I sank down in the mud.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ Jɛrɩmaaya, a joŋu hɛ kuoro nanʋala Malɩkɩja viliŋ lɛ. Vil-la fa hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ kaala lɛ nɛ. Ba kɛŋ ŋmɛsɩŋ nɛ vɔɔ Jɛrɩmaaya a joŋu hɛ vil-la tʋɔŋ. Lɩɩŋ fa tuo vil-la lɛ, vʋchɔɔŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya tuu mʋʋrɛ vʋchɔɔ-la lɛ.

english_verse: Ebedmelech said, “Your Majesty, Jeremiah is a prophet, and those men were wrong to throw him into a well. And when Jerusalem runs out of food, Jeremiah will starve to death down there.”
translation_verse: “Kuoro, mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, baalaa deemba ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ ba sɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya lɛ. Ba joŋu yuo hɛ viliŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ arɩ losuŋ nɩmɛ dɩ boroboro nɛ kʋ tuo tabal-la lɛ.”

english_verse: Ebedmelech and the soldiers went to the palace and got some rags from the room under the treasury. He used ropes to lower them into the well.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛbɛd-Mɛlɛk kɛŋ baala-la ba mʋ jʋʋ dɩa kʋbala sɩ hɛ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩa bʋbʋɔŋ kuoru dɩa lɛ. Ʋ paa gɛrɩ-kɔsʋ bɩnaa arɩ gɛrɩ-bɩnaa lee-la a joŋo vɔɔ ŋmɛnɩŋ lɛ a joŋo lo hɛ vil-la tʋɔŋ a pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya.

english_verse: Then he said, “Put these rags under your arms so the ropes won't hurt you.” After I did,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛbɛd-Mɛlɛk bʋla pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya, “Joŋ gɛrɩ-kɔsʋmɔ-la arɩ gɛrɩ-bɩnɩa-la a bɛ ŋ nɩsaa dɩ ŋmɛŋ-la sɩ́ŋ keru.” Jɛrɩmaaya ŋaa ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: the men pulled me out. And from then on, I was kept in the courtyard of the palace guards. King Zedekiah Questions Jeremiah
translation_verse: ba kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-la lɛ a lɛrɛ lɩɩsʋ vil-la tʋɔŋ. Ʋ kʋ lɩɩ a hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ kaala-la tʋɔŋ. Zedikaaya bɩra pɩɛsɛ Jɛrɩmaaya wɩaa

english_verse: King Zedekiah had me brought to his private entrance to the temple, and he said, “I'm going to ask you something, and I want to know the truth.”
translation_verse: Kuoro Zedikaaya tɩŋ ba mʋ yɩrɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya kɔ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la boi-nii-tori-la leriŋ. Kuoro bʋla pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya, “Mɩɩ chɛ mɩ pɩɛsɩŋ wɩɩ nɛ, pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ wɩɩkala joŋo faamɛ.”

english_verse: “Why?” I replied. “You won't listen, and you might even have me killed!”
translation_verse: Jɛrɩmaaya bʋla pɩ Zedikaaya, “Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ pɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ kpʋmɛ, dɩ mɩ nɛ chagɩlɩŋ ma, ŋ bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ.”

english_verse: He said, “I swear in the name of the living Lord our Creator that I won't have you killed. No one else can hear what we say, and I won't let anyone kill you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Zedikaaya lʋara ŋmɩɛsa pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya: “Mɩ ŋmɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ weye, Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɩla wiese, mɩ bɩ jaŋ kpʋŋ koo a joŋuŋ hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ ba lɩɩsɛ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Then I told him that the Lord had said: “Zedekiah, I am the Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Israel. I promise that if you surrender to King Nebuchadnezzar's officers, you and your family won't be killed, and Jerusalem won't be burned down.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya bʋla pɩ Zedikaaya, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro tɩntɩnna-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ŋ jaŋ laa ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ba bɩ jaŋ nyɩgɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ ma, ŋ dɩ ŋ dɩa nɩaa jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: But if you don't surrender, I will let the Babylonian army capture Jerusalem and burn it down, and you will be taken prisoner.”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ ŋ tɩtɩa joŋo hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ, La Tɩɩna jaŋ joŋ tabalɩŋ deeŋ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba nyɩgʋ dɩ ʋ dii tel. Ŋ ma tɩtɩa bɩ jaŋ fori ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Zedekiah answered, “I can't surrender to the Babylonians. I'm too afraid of the people of Judah who have already joined them. The Babylonians might hand me over to them, and they would torture me.”
translation_verse: Kuoro Zedikaaya bʋla pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya, “Fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ a tɩŋ Juu tɩmma-la sɩ mʋ Babɩlɔŋ tɩmma-la teeŋ wɩaa. Babɩlɔŋ tɩmma-la jaŋ wuo jommi hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba chaasa dɔgɩsɛmɛ.”

english_verse: I said, “If you will just obey the Lord, the Babylonians won't hand you over to those Jews. You will be allowed to live, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya bʋl, “Ba bɩ jaŋ joŋuŋ hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ, sɛɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ a ŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, wɩaa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩŋ, dɩ ŋ laa ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: But the Lord has shown me that if you refuse to obey,
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ vɩa dɩ ŋ joŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ kaa dagɛmɛ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: then the women of your palace will be taken prisoner by Nebuchadnezzar's officials. And those women will say to you: Friends you trusted led you astray. Now you're trapped in mud, and those friends you trusted have all turned away.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛsɛ haala-la kala sɩ hɛ Juda kuoro dɩa lɛ a kaa kʋ lɩɩ pa Babɩlɔŋ kuoro tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ. Haala-la jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ: ‘Ba nyɩsɩŋ nɛ a yuo diiŋ, ŋ nandɔsʋ-la lɛ ŋ sɩ joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa hɛ. Ŋ naasɩŋ mʋʋra tuu vʋchɔɔŋ nɛ. Ŋ nandɔsʋ-la vɩaŋ ta nɛ.’

english_verse: The Babylonian army will take your wives and children captive, you will be taken as a prisoner to the King of Babylonia, and Jerusalem will be burned down.”
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛsɛ ŋ haalaa arɩ ŋ biiriŋ kala a kaa kʋ lɩɩ pɩ Babɩlɔŋ tɩmma-la. Ŋ ma tɩtɩa bɩ jaŋ fori ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ama Babɩlɔŋ kuoro jaŋ yuo kɛnɩŋ, ka dɩ ba nyɩgɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ dɩ ʋ dii tel.”

english_verse: Zedekiah said, “Jeremiah, if you tell anyone what we have talked about, you might lose your life.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zedikaaya bʋla pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya, “Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ wɩaa deemba la sɩ bʋla, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ wuo sʋʋ.

english_verse: And I'm sure that if my officials hear about our meeting, they will ask you what we said to each other. They might even threaten to kill you if you don't tell them.
translation_verse: Dɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la nɛ nɩa arɩ mɩ dɩ ŋ bʋl wɩaa nɛ, a kɔ ŋ teeŋ a bʋl, ‘Bʋl wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla pɩ kuoro a pɩla arɩ wɩalɩŋ kuoro ma sɩ bʋla pɩŋ. Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ kaa faala, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee la jaŋ kpʋŋ,’

english_verse: So if they question you, tell them you were begging me not to send you back to the prison at Jonathan's house, because going back there would kill you.”
translation_verse: bʋla pɩba, ‘Mɩ faa sʋl kuoro nɛ dɩ ʋ bɩra sɩ́ mɩ kaa mɩɩra mʋ Jonataŋ dɩa-la dɩ mɩ sʋʋ nɩmɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The officials did come and question me about my meeting with the king, and I told them exactly what he had ordered me to say. They never spoke to me about the meeting again, since no one had heard us talking.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la kala kɔ Jɛrɩmaaya teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ wɩaa, ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa kuoro sɩ dagʋ a pɩba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra bɩ wɩɩ dɔŋ bʋla pʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ dɩ kuoro sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ nɩa.

english_verse: I was held in the courtyard of the palace guards until the day Jerusalem was captured.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya ha hɛ laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro kaala-la tʋɔŋ, a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ yuo dii Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: When King Zedekiah and his troops saw that Jerusalem had been captured, they tried to escape from the city that same night. They went to the king's garden, where they slipped through the gate between the two city walls and headed toward the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Zedikaaya arɩ laalɩyuoro-la kala sɩ naba, ba fá lɩɩ tabal-la lɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ. Ba to wombii-la sɩ hɛ kuoro gaarɩŋ lɛ nɛ a mʋ to boi-baal-la sɩ hɛ jebie-la balɩa pɛgɛ a to Araba dɩɩrɩŋ a mʋ.

english_verse: to Ebedmelech from Ethiopia: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. I warned everyone that I would bring disaster, not prosperity, to this city. Now very soon I will do what I said, and you will see it happen.
translation_verse: “Mʋ bʋla pɩ Ɛbɛd-Mɛlɛk sɩ ŋaa Kus tɩɩna, ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩɩ chɛ mɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ: Wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ nɛ, wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ dee. Bʋa-la lɛ wɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ ŋaa ŋ sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: “Find Jeremiah and keep him safe. Take good care of him and do whatever he asks.”
translation_verse: “Má kɛnʋ a beŋ ʋ nyuŋ. Má sɩ́ ʋ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa, ama má ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ pɩɛsaa chɛ a pʋ.”

english_verse: But the Babylonian troops caught up with them near Jericho. They arrested Zedekiah and took him to the town of Riblah in the land of Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial, then found him guilty,
translation_verse: Ama Babɩlɔŋ laalɩyuoro-la kire to ba harɩŋ a mʋ kɛŋ Zedikaaya Jeriko tintee-taalɩŋ lɛ. Ba kɛnʋ a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza teeŋ Rɩbɩla sɩ hɛ Hamaf tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ diiu sarɩya a joŋ cheeriŋ pʋ.

english_verse: and gave orders for him to be punished. Zedekiah's sons were killed there in front of him, and so were the leaders of Judah's ruling families.
translation_verse: Rɩbɩla lɛ, Babɩlɔŋ kuoro leŋ ba kpʋ Zedikaaya hambolibiisiŋ ʋ sɩɩŋ lɛ, a kpʋ Juda nɩbalaa ma kala.

english_verse: Then his eyes were poked out, and he was put in chains, so he could be dragged off to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ ba kɔrɩgɔ chaarɛ Zedikaaya ma sɩaa, aŋ hɛʋ kɔlɩɩŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ a kɛnʋ mʋ Babɩlɔŋ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the Babylonian army had burned the houses in Jerusalem, including the royal palace, and they had broken down the city walls.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ tɩmma-la chol nyiniŋ hɛ kuoro dɩa lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɩɩsɩŋ aŋ ŋmoo Jerusalɛm jebiee lo.

english_verse: Nebuzaradan, the Babylonian officer in charge of the guards, led away everyone from the city as prisoners, even those who had deserted to Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nebuzaradaŋ sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩhɩaŋ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka tabal-la lɛ a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, a pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa mʋ pʋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ ka.

english_verse: Only the poorest people who owned no land were left behind in Judah, and Nebuzaradan gave them fields and vineyards.
translation_verse: Ama Nebuzaradaŋ sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro nɩhɩaŋ fa leŋ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ ŋaa summo a bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ Juda lɛ nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ pɩba bagɩsɩŋ arɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: sent some of their troops to bring me from the courtyard of the royal palace guards. They put me in the care of Gedaliah son of Ahikam and told him to take me to my home. And so I was allowed to stay with the people who remained in Judah. The Lord Promises To Protect Ebedmelech
translation_verse: tɩŋ ba mʋ lɩɩsɛ Jɛrɩmaaya laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro kaala-la tʋɔŋ. Ba joŋu pɩ Ahɩkam nanʋala Gedalia sɩ ŋaa Safaŋ nihiŋ dɩ ʋ kɛnʋ mɩɩra mʋ ʋ dɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya ka Juda lɛ ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: While I was a prisoner in the courtyard of the palace guard, the Lord told me to say
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Jɛrɩmaaya fa sɩ hɛ laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro kaala-la lɛ, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pʋ. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: But because you trusted me, I will protect you from the officials of Judah, and when Judah is struck by disaster, I will rescue you and keep you alive. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ laaŋ ta. Ŋ bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, ŋ jaŋ fori a laa ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ laamɛ dii nɛ. Mɩ-na ŋ TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.’ ”

english_verse: I was led away in chains along with the people of Judah and Jerusalem who were being taken to Babylonia. Nebuzaradan was the officer in charge of the guard, and while we were stopped at Ramah, the Lord caused him to set me free.
translation_verse: Nebuzaradaŋ sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro kʋhɩaŋ sɩ lɩɩsɛ Jɛrɩmaaya ta Rama lɛ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa a pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya. Ʋ na Jɛrɩmaaya dɩ ba kɛŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ nɛ a vɔbʋ a pɛ Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga Babɩlɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Nebuzaradan said: Jeremiah, the Lord your God warned your people that he would bring disaster on this land.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro kʋhɩaŋ-la sɩ na Jɛrɩmaaya, ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ wʋlɔrʋŋ deeŋ hɛ leriŋ deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But they continued to rebel against him, and now he has punished them just as he threatened.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ La TƖƖNA leŋe wɩɩ-la ŋaa nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa ʋ sɩ bʋla nɛ. Wɩaa deemba kala ŋaa a tɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ La TƖƖNA teeŋ a bɩ ʋ niiŋ to nɛ.

english_verse: Today I am taking the chains off your wrists and setting you free! If you want to, you can come with me to Babylonia, and I will see that you are taken care of. Or if you decide to stay here, you can go wherever you wish.
translation_verse: Ama jɩnɩŋ mɩɩ lɩɩsɛ chɔrʋmɔ-la sɩ vɔɔ ŋ nɩsaa nɛ. Kɔ dɩ la mʋ Babɩlɔŋ dɩ ŋ nɛ cho, mɩ jaŋ beŋ ŋ nyuŋ. Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ chɛ ŋ mʋ, ŋɩɩ-na leŋ. Bee na, tintee-la kala ŋaa ŋ kʋŋ nɛ, mʋ lee-la kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar has chosen Gedaliah to rule Judah. You can live near Gedaliah, and he will provide for you, or you can live anywhere else you choose. Nebuzaradan gave me a supply of food, then let me leave.
translation_verse: Ama Jɛrɩmaaya sɩ bɩrɩma dɩ ʋ mʋ, Nebuzaradaŋ bɩra bʋl, “Mʋ Ahɩkam nanʋala Gedalia sɩ ŋaa Safaŋ nihiŋ teeŋ, ʋ nɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro lɩɩsɛ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ Juda tasɩŋ a hɛ ʋ teeŋ ŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ, koo ŋ mʋ lee-kala ŋ sɩ cho.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro nɩhɩaŋ-la pʋ kʋdiilee arɩ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ aŋ leŋ ʋ mʋ.

english_verse: I decided to stay with the people of Judah, and I went to live near Gedaliah in Mizpah. The Harvest Is Brought In
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛrɩmaaya mʋ Ahɩkam nanʋala Gedalia teeŋ Mɩzɩpa lɛ a hɛ ʋ teeŋ a guoli ʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Gedaliah told them, “There's no need to be afraid of the Babylonians. Everything will be fine, if we live peacefully and obey King Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahɩkam nanʋala Gedalia sɩ ŋaa Safaŋ nihiŋ, ŋmɩɛsa pɩ ba dɩ ba nɩaa a bʋl, “Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma ma sɩ jaŋ tɩma pɩ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa. Má hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ a to Babɩlɔŋ kuoro niiŋ, wɩaa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ pɩma.

english_verse: I will stay here at Mizpah and meet with the Babylonian officials on each of their visits. But you must go back to your towns and bring in the harvest, then store the wine, olive oil, and dried fruit.”
translation_verse: Mɩ-na tɩtɩa jaŋ hɔŋ Mɩzɩpa lɛ a chɩŋ ma naasɩŋ lɛ Babɩlɔŋ tɩmma-la sɩɩ kɔ la teeŋ. Ama ma maga ma ŋaa girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ, yibiiniŋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ arɩ olif nʋʋŋ, a joŋo hɛ puposu-la ma sɩ kaa tʋtʋɔlɛ kɩaa lɛ, a hɔŋ tasɩ-la ma sɩ laa lɛ.”

english_verse: Earlier, when the Babylonians had invaded Judah, many of the Jews escaped to Moab, Ammon, Edom, and several other countries. But these Jews heard that the king of Babylonia had appointed Gedaliah as ruler of Judah, and that only a few people were left there. So the Jews in these other countries came back to Judah and helped with the grape and fruit harvest, which was especially large that year. Gedaliah Is Murdered
translation_verse: ba kala mɩɩra kɔ Juda tinteeŋ, Gedalia teeŋ Mɩzɩpa lɛ. Ba lɩɩ tinteye-la kala lɛ ba sɩ pɩsa hɛ nɛ a kɔ. Ba chaasa chagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ a yʋgɛ woruŋ, a tɔrɛ yibiiniŋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ ma yʋgɛ.

english_verse: One day, Johanan got together with some of the other men who had been army officers, and they came to Mizpah and met with Gedaliah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Karɩa nanʋala Johanaŋ arɩ Juda laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ gɩrɩŋ lɛ kɔ Gedalia teeŋ Mɩzɩpa lɛ,

english_verse: They said, “Gedaliah, we came to warn you that King Baalis of Ammon hired Ishmael to murder you!” Gedaliah refused to believe them,
translation_verse: a bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ bɩ jɩŋ dɩ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa kuoro Baalɩs tɩŋ Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl nɛ dɩ ʋ kʋ kpʋŋ?” Ama Ahɩkam nanʋala Gedalia bɩ laa dii.

english_verse: so Johanan went to Gedaliah privately and said, “Let me kill Ishmael. No one will find out who did it. There are only a few people left in Judah, but they are depending on you. And if you are murdered, they will be scattered or killed.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Karɩa nanʋala Johanaŋ lʋara bʋla pɩ Gedalia Mɩzɩpa lɛ, “Leŋ dɩ mɩ mʋ kpʋ Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ jaŋ kpʋŋ a leŋ dɩ Juu tɩmma-la kala sɩ hɛ ŋ teeŋ pɩsɛ, dɩ Juda tɩŋŋaa nɩkaanaa sʋʋ?”

english_verse: Gedaliah answered, “Don't kill Ishmael! What you've said about him can't be true.”
translation_verse: Ama Ahɩkam nanʋala Gedalia bʋla pɩ Karɩa nanʋala Johanaŋ, “Sɩ́ wʋdoho-la ŋaa. Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Ɩsɩmɛl lɛ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: But in the seventh month, Ishmael came to Mizpah with ten of his soldiers. He had been one of the king's officials and was a member of the royal family. Ishmael and his men were invited to eat with Gedaliah.
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-pɛɩ lɛ nɛ Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl sɩ ŋaa Ɛlɩsama ma nihiŋ a ŋaa kuoro doho nʋʋ, aŋ ŋaa kuoro tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ dɔŋɔ ma sii kɛsɛ baalaa fii ba kɔ Ahɩkam nanʋala Gedalia teeŋ Mɩzɩpa lɛ. Ba kala hɔŋ a didii kɩaa.

english_verse: During the meal, Ishmael and his soldiers killed Gedaliah, the man chosen as ruler of Judah by the king of Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl arɩ baala-la fii sii a kpʋ Gedalia arɩ tokobiiŋ, nɩɩ-la Babɩlɔŋ kuoro sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ chɩŋ ʋ naasɩŋ lɛ a bibeŋ tintee-la.

english_verse: Then they killed the Jews who were with Gedaliah, and they also killed the Babylonian soldiers who were there.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɩsɩmɛl kpʋ Juu tɩmma-la ma kala fa sɩ hɛ Gedalia teeŋ Mɩzɩpa lɛ, a pɛ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa laalɩyuoro-la ma sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The next day, the murders had still not been discovered,
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kpʋ Gedalia taŋ sii pʋl, ka dɩ nʋʋkala-na nɩɩ wɩɩ-la,

english_verse: Ishmael went out the town gate to meet them. He pretended to be weeping, and he asked them to come into Mizpah to meet with Gedaliah, the ruler of Judah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl lɩɩ Mɩzɩpa lɛ dɩ ʋ chemba aŋ yiyel. Ʋ sɩ chemba, ʋ bʋl, “Má kʋ jʋʋ na Ahɩkam nanʋala Gedalia.”

english_verse: But after they were inside the town, Ishmael ordered his soldiers to kill them and throw their bodies into a well.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kʋ jʋʋ tabal-la tʋɔŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl arɩ ʋ baala-la sii a kpʋba a paaba lo hɛ viliŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He let ten of the men live, because they offered to give him supplies of wheat, barley, olive oil, and honey they had hidden in a field.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ nɩaa fii bʋla pɩ Ɩsɩmɛl, “Sɩ́ la kpʋ! La kɛŋ mɩaa, nyonso, nʋʋŋ arɩ tʋʋŋ nɛ, la joŋo faa baga lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ lemba, ʋ bɩ ba-na kpʋa.

english_verse: The well that he filled with bodies had been dug by King Asa of Judah to store rainwater, because he was afraid that King Baasha of Israel might surround Mizpah and keep the people from getting to their water supply.
translation_verse: Vil-la lɛ ʋ sɩ joŋ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ kpʋa a pɛ Gedalia lɛ a yuo hɛ fa ŋaa kuoro Asa kʋa nɛ. Ʋ nɛ luo bʋa-la lɛ Iziral kuoro Baasa sɩɩ yuou dɩ ʋ kaa pɔ laa ʋ tɩtɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl paa nɩsʋʋnʋŋ a su ʋ kala.

english_verse: Nebuzaradan, King Nebuchadnezzar's officer in charge of the guard, had left King Zedekiah's daughters and many other people at Mizpah, and he had put Gedaliah in charge of them. But now Ishmael took them all prisoner and led them toward Ammon, on the other side of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɩsɩmɛl kɛsɛ nɩkaana-la kala sɩ hɛ Mɩzɩpa lɛ ba ŋaa yosi, kuoro toloo arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ka lee-la, nɩalɩŋ Nebuzaradaŋ sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro nɩhɩaŋ sɩ lɩɩsɛ Ahɩkam nanʋala Gedalia ʋ bibeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl kɛsɛba ba ŋaa yosi dɩ ba cholo mʋ Amɔŋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Johanan and the other army officers heard what Ishmael had done.
translation_verse: Karɩa nanʋala Johanaŋ arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la kala sɩ nɩɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl sɩ ŋaa,

english_verse: So they and their troops chased Ishmael and caught up with him at the large pit at Gibeon.
translation_verse: ba kɛsɛ ba nɩaa kala dɩ ba mʋ yuo Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kire mʋ kɛnʋ dɩ ʋ kpagɛ buotuo bal-la sɩ hɛ Gibioŋ lɛ a kɛŋ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: When Ishmael's prisoners saw Johanan and the officers, they were happy
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ to Ɩsɩmɛl harɩŋ sɩ na Karɩa nanʋala Johanaŋ arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la, ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: But Ishmael and eight of his men escaped and went to Ammon. Johanan Decides To Take the People to Egypt
translation_verse: Ama Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl arɩ ʋ baala-la chori fori Johanaŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a fá mʋ Amɔŋ tinteeŋ. Ba fá mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ

english_verse: Johanan and the officers had rescued the women, children, and royal officials that Ishmael had taken prisoner after killing Gedaliah. Johanan led the people from Gibeon
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Karɩa nanʋala Johanaŋ arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ teeŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka Mɩzɩpa lɛ, nɩalɩŋ Ɩsɩmɛl sɩ kpʋ Gedalia aŋ laa: Laalɩyuoroo, haalaa, hambiisiŋ arɩ kuori dɩa tɩntɩnnaa ʋ sɩ kaa lɩɩ Gibioŋ kɔ.

english_verse: toward Egypt. They wanted to go there, because they were afraid of what the Babylonians would do when they found out that Ishmael had killed Gedaliah, the ruler appointed by King Nebuchadnezzar. The People Ask Jeremiah To Pray for Them On the way to Egypt, we stopped at the town of Geruth Chimham near Bethlehem.
translation_verse: dɩ ba fori Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛmba nɛ a tɩŋ ba wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl fa kpʋ Ahɩkam nanʋala Gedalia nɛ, nɩɩ-la Babɩlɔŋ kuoro sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ chɩŋ ʋ naasɩŋ lɛ a bibeŋ tintee-la.

english_verse: Johanan, Jezaniah, the other army officers, and everyone else in the group, came to me
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la kala a pɛ Karɩa nanʋala Johanaŋ lɛ arɩ Hosaaya nanʋala Jezania arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala a chɩŋ ba nɩbiisiŋ lɛ a kaa jɩl ba nɩbalaa

english_verse: and said, “Please, Jeremiah, pray to the Lord your God for us. Judah used to have many people, but as you can see, only a few of us are left.
translation_verse: kala mʋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Laa sʋlʋŋ, jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la la sɩ kɛnɛ, a sʋl ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa a pɩ la nɩkaanaa deemba. Ŋ tɩtɩa sɩɩŋ na la nɛ lɛɛlɛ, la fa yʋga nɛ woruŋ, ama lɛɛlɛ la baŋmɛnɛ nɛ ka.

english_verse: Ask the Lord to tell us where he wants us to go and what he wants us to do.”
translation_verse: Sʋl ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩ ʋ dagɛla lee-la la sɩ jaŋ mʋ arɩ wɩɩ-la la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: “All right,” I answered, “I will pray to the Lord your God, and I will tell you everything he says.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya bʋl, “Mɩ nɩa nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ sʋl ma TƖƖNA Wɩa arɩ ma sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ. Mɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩɩ-la kala La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla a pɩma, mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋ wɩɩkala faama.”

english_verse: even if it isn't what we want to do. We will obey the Lord so that all will go well for us.”
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩɩ-la zɔmɔ koo ʋ bɩ zɔŋ, la jaŋ to La TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ, Nɩɩ-la teeŋ la sɩɩ tɩmɩŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩla a tɩŋ la sɩ jaŋ to La TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa.”

english_verse: Ten days later, the Lord gave me an answer for
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa fii harɩŋ, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa a pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya.

english_verse: and told them that the Lord God of Israel had said: You asked Jeremiah to pray and find out what you should do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, Nɩɩ-la teeŋ ma sɩ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ ma wɩɩŋ mʋ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: I am sorry that I had to punish you, and so I now tell you to stay here in Judah, where I will plant you and build you up, instead of tearing you down and uprooting you.
translation_verse: ‘Dɩ ma nɛ hɔŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma waa, mɩ bɩ jaŋ yigima lo. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma chɩŋ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ churima. Mɩ tʋɔŋ chaasa chei nɛ wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la mɩ sɩ joŋo hɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: and I will even force him to have mercy on you and give back your farms.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ fá ma nenige a leŋ dɩ ʋ ma fá ma nenige a leŋ dɩ ma bɩra tɩɩ ma tinteeŋ.’

english_verse: But you might keep on saying, “We won't stay here in Judah, and we won't obey the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ sɩ, ‘La bɩ jaŋ hɔŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ,’ a bɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ to,

english_verse: We are going to Egypt, where there is plenty of food and no danger of war.”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl, ‘Aɩ, la jaŋ mʋ hɔŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, lee-la la sɩ bɩ jaŋ na laalɩŋ koo a nɩɩ laalɩyuori goŋ koo dɩ losuŋ kɛnla.’

english_verse: People of Judah, you survived when the Babylonian army attacked. Now you are planning to move to Egypt, and if you do go, this is what will happen.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ-na ma Juda nɩkaanaa, má jegile nɩɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa. Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa siri arɩ ma jaŋ mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, a sɛnɛ mʋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ,

english_verse: You are afraid of war, starvation, and disease here in Judah, but they will follow you to Egypt and kill you there. None of you will survive the disasters I will send.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa siri dɩ ba mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a hɔŋ nɩmɛ, laalɩŋ, losuŋ arɩ nyanyalɩɩ jaŋ kpʋba. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ koo a fori wʋlɔrʋ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ kaa kʋ hɛ ba lɛ.’

english_verse: I, the Lord, was angry with the people of Jerusalem and punished them. And if you go to Egypt, I will be angry and punish you the same way. You will never again see your homeland. People will be horrified at what I do to you, and they will use the name of your city as a curse word. Jeremiah Gives a Warning
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘A nagɛ mɩ sɩ na baanɩŋ a dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ a ŋaa ma lɛ, dɩ ma nɛ mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ nyɛsɩŋ nɩaa sɩaa lɛ. Nɩaa jaŋ sisieri ma lɛ, a kɛŋ ma yɩrɩŋ ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛ, a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩpɩma. Ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ma na leriŋ deeŋ.’

english_verse: I told the people: You escaped the disaster that struck Judah, but now the Lord warns you to stay away from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ma-na Juda nɩkaanaa, La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩma, ‘Má sɩ́ Ijipiti mʋ.’ Ma jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ: Mɩ kpʋrɩsɛ ma dɩgɩlaa nɛ jɩnɩŋ

english_verse: You asked me to pray and find out what the Lord our God wants you to do, and you promised to obey him. But that was a terrible mistake,
translation_verse: arɩ ma chaasa chei wɩɩ nɛ ma sɩ tɩmmɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ a bʋl, ‘Sʋl La TƖƖNA Wɩa a pɩla, aŋ bʋl wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ bʋla a pɩla, la jaŋ ŋaa.’

english_verse: because now that I have given you the Lord's answer, you refuse to obey him.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ pɩma nɛ jɩnɩŋ, ama ma ha bɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ to wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ tɩmmɛ mɩ bʋla pɩma lɛ.

english_verse: But Azariah, Johanan and some other arrogant men said to me, “You're lying! The Lord didn't tell you to say that we shouldn't go to Egypt.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ nɛ Hosaaya nanʋala Azarɩa arɩ Karɩa nanʋala Johanaŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ sɩɩ-duoŋ bʋla pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya, “Ŋŋ nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ. La TƖƖNA Wɩa bɩŋ tɩma dɩ ŋ kʋ bʋla pɩla arɩ la sɩ́ mʋ hɔŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Baruch son of Neriah must have told you to say that. He wants the Babylonians to capture us, so they can take us away to Babylonia or even kill us.”
