translation_verse: Neria nanʋala Baruk nɛ yigiŋ hɛ la lɛ dɩ ŋ jonla hɛ Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba kpʋla koo a kɛnla mʋ yoŋ-baga Babɩlɔŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Johanan, the other army officers, and everyone else refused to stay in Judah in spite of the Lord's command.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Karɩa nanʋala Johanaŋ arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la kala a pɛ nɩalɩŋ kala lɛ bɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ to ba sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: So Johanan and the officers led us away toward Egypt. The group that left Judah included those who had been scattered in other countries and who had then come back to live in Judah.
translation_verse: Ama Karɩa nanʋala Johanaŋ arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sii kɛsɛ Juda nɩkaana-la kala sɩ mɩɩra lɩɩ tinteye-la, lere-la kala lɛ ba fa sɩ pɩsa hɛ a kɔ dɩ ba hɔŋ Juda tinteeŋ a kaa mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Baruch and I and others in the group had been staying with Gedaliah, because Nebuzaradan, the Babylonian officer in charge of the guard, had ordered him to take care of the king's daughters and quite a few men, women, and children.
translation_verse: Ba fa pɛ kɛsɛ baalaa, haalaa arɩ hambiisiŋ ma mʋ nɛ, a pɛ kuoro tolie-la Nebuzaradaŋ sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro nɩhɩaŋ sɩ joŋo hɛ Ahɩkam nanʋala Gedalia sɩ ŋaa Safaŋ nihiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a pɛ Jɛrɩmaaya Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la arɩ Neria nanʋala Baruk lɛ.

english_verse: The people disobeyed the Lord and went to Egypt. The group had settled in Tahpanhes,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ to aŋ mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a mʋ yi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tapanhɛs.

english_verse: Jeremiah, carry some large stones to the entrance of the government building in Tahpanhes. Bury the stones underneath the brick pavement and be sure the Jews are watching.
translation_verse: “Leŋ dɩ Juu tɩmma-la bibeniŋ ka dɩ ŋ paa tabɩaa sɩ jalɩa a kaa mʋ hugi ba sɩ kɛŋ chʋrʋŋ ŋaa tiebie-la a saa wombii-la sɩ hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro, kuoru dɩa boi-niiŋ Tapanhɛs lɛ.

english_verse: Then tell them that I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, have sent for my servant, Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. I will bring him here and have him set up his throne and his royal tent over these stones that I told you to bury.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba, ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ tɩma yɩrɛ mɩ tɩntɩnna Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza a leŋ dɩ ʋ kuoru kpasa chɩŋ tabɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ hugo lee-la. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ kuori-palɩŋ jɛrɛ tɔba.

english_verse: The Lord told me to speak with the Jews who were living in the towns of Migdol, Tahpanhes, and Memphis in northern Egypt, and also to those living in southern Egypt. He told me to tell them:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa a pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya a mʋ tɩgɛ Juu tɩmma-la kala sɩ hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ leree deemba lɛ, Ijipiti sɛmɛ-la sɩ hɛ bʋbʋɔŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, Mɩgɩdɔl, Tapanhɛs arɩ Memfis a pɛ Ijipiti sɛmɛ-la ma sɩ hɛ nyuŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You saw how I destroyed Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. They lie empty and in ruins today,
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ma na wʋlɔrʋ-la sɩ bɩ bana kɛnɛ mɩ sɩ kaa kʋ hɛ Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda tasɩŋ kala lɛ nɛ. Jɩnɩŋ tasɩ-la kala cheye nɛ a pɩŋ hoi

english_verse: because the people of Judah made me angry by worshiping gods that had never helped them or their ancestors.
translation_verse: a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Ba leŋe mɩ baanɩŋ sii ba nyuŋ nɛ ba sɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a kpʋkpaarɛ vesiŋ, ba-na koo ma-na koo ma naabalɩmaba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: Time after time I sent my servants the prophets to tell the people of Judah how much I hated their disgusting sins. The prophets warned them to stop sinning,
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩŋ mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ ba teeŋ bʋlɩa bʋlɩa, ba bʋla pɩba, ‘Má sɩ́ wʋkɩsɩa-la mɩ sɩ bɛrɛ ŋaa.’

english_verse: but they refused to listen and would not stop worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Ama ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ, aŋ vɩa dɩ ba tomi. Ba bɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ koo a leŋ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ nyɩga pɩ vesiŋ.

english_verse: Finally, my anger struck like a raging flood, and today Jerusalem and the towns of Judah are nothing but empty ruins.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ chaasa na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ, a chei Juda tasɩŋ arɩ Jerusalɛm womporunuŋ, a leŋ ba cheye pɩŋ hoi arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ naga jɩnɩmba.

english_verse: You have made me angry by worshiping idols and burning incense to other gods after you came here to Egypt. You will die such a disgusting death, that other nations will use the name of Judah as a curse word.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ma tɩtɩa sɩ ŋaa a leŋ mɩ baanɩŋ sii, ma sɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a pɩpɩ Ijipiti vesiŋ lee-la ma sɩ kʋ hɔŋ? Ma jaŋ chei ma tɩtɩa, dɩ dʋnɩa tinteyee kala nɩaa sisieri ma lɛ, a kɛŋ ma yɩrɩŋ ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: When you were living in Jerusalem and Judah, you followed the example of your ancestors in doing evil things, just like your kings and queens.
translation_verse: Ma yʋ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala ma naabalɩmaba sɩ ŋaa nɛɛ? Wʋbɔmɔ-la ma Juda kuoroo arɩ ba haalaa, ma tɩtɩa arɩ ma haalaa sɩ ŋaa Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm womporunuŋ lɛ nɛɛ?

english_verse: Even now, your pride keeps you from respecting me and obeying the laws and teachings I gave you and your ancestors.
translation_verse: Arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala ba ha bɩ ba tɩtɩa kaa muuri koo a zilmi, koo a to wombii-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto, arɩ mɩ wʋdagaa mɩ sɩ bile pɩ ma dɩ ma naabalɩmaba.

english_verse: There were only a few of you left in Judah, and you decided to go to Egypt. But you will die such horrible deaths in war or from starvation, that people of other countries will use the name of Judah as a curse word.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kpʋ Juda nɩkaana-la kala sɩ ŋaa siri a kɔ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Ba kala jaŋ sʋʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ koo losuŋ kpʋba. A chɩŋ ba nɩbiisiŋ lɛ a kaa jɩl ba nɩbalaa, ba jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ koo losuŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ nyɛsɩŋ nɩaa sɩaa lɛ. Nɩaa jaŋ sisieri ba lɛ, a kɛŋ ba yɩrɩŋ ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛ, a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩpɩba.

english_verse: I punished Jerusalem with war, hunger, and disease, and that's how I will punish you.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ laalɩŋ, losuŋ arɩ nyanyal-bɔmʋŋ a dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Ijipiti lɛ, a nagɛ mɩ sɩ dɔgɩsɛ Jerusalɛm nɩaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: None of you will survive. You may hope to return to Judah someday, but only a very few of you will escape death and be able to go back. The People Refuse To Worship the Lord
translation_verse: Juda nɩkaana-la sɩ kɔ dɩ ba hɔŋ Ijipiti lɛ, ba kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ fori koo a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a mɩɩra mʋ Juda tinteeŋ, lee-la ba sɩɩ hɩɛnʋ dɩ ba mʋ. Ba kala bɩ jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ, see nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ.”

english_verse: A large number of Jews from both northern and southern Egypt listened to me as I told them what the Lord had said. Most of the men in the crowd knew that their wives often burned incense to other gods. So they and their wives shouted:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baala-la kala sɩ jɩma dɩ ba haalaa ka nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ vesiŋ arɩ haala-la kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, ba fa yʋga nɛ woruŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Ijipiti sɛmɛ-la sɩ hɛ bʋbʋɔŋ arɩ sɛmɛ-la sɩ hɛ nyuŋ bʋla pɩ Jɛrɩmaaya,

english_verse: Jeremiah, what do we care if you speak in the Lord's name? We refuse to listen!
translation_verse: “La bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ tɩndaarɩ-la ŋ sɩ bʋla pɩla La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: We have promised to worship the goddess Astarte, the Queen of Heaven, and that is exactly what we are going to do. We will burn incense and offer sacrifices of wine to her, just as we, our ancestors, our kings, and our leaders did when we lived in Jerusalem and the other towns of Judah. We had plenty of food back then. We were well off, and nothing bad ever happened to us.
translation_verse: La jaŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ sɩ la jaŋ ŋaa. La jaŋ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a pɩ wɩa-nyuŋ veŋ ha-kuoru-la aŋ wansɛ kʋnyʋalaa ma a pʋ, a nagɛ la dɩ la naabalɩmaba, la kuoroo arɩ la tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Juda tasɩŋ arɩ Jerusalɛm womporunuŋ lɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ, la fa kɛŋ kʋdiilee nɛ woruŋ a kɛŋ kɩaa, wɩɩkala bɩ laa walɩmɛ.

english_verse: But since the time we stopped burning incense and offering wine sacrifices to her, we have been dying from war and hunger.
translation_verse: Ama la sɩ kʋ leŋ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ nyɩga pɩ wɩa-nyuŋ veŋ ha-kuoru-la, a bɩ kʋnyʋalaa wansa pʋpʋ, la bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ, ka laalɩŋ arɩ losuŋ kpʋkpʋla.”

english_verse: Then the women said, “When we lived in Judah, we worshiped the Queen of Heaven and offered sacrifices of wine and special loaves of bread shaped like her. Our husbands knew what we were doing, and they approved of it.”
translation_verse: Haala-la bɩra bʋl, “La sɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a pɩ wɩa-nyuŋ veŋ ha-kuoru-la, a ŋaa kʋnyʋalaa ma aa pʋ, ŋ bɩɩna la balaba bɩ jɩŋ arɩ la yie ŋaa kɩŋkɛsɩmɛɛ sɩ nagʋ a wansɛ kʋnyʋalaa ma pʋpʋ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Don't you think the Lord knew that you and your ancestors, your leaders and kings, and the rest of the people were burning incense to other gods in Jerusalem and everywhere else in Judah?
translation_verse: “Kʋsʋɔrʋsʋ-la ma sɩ nyɩga Juda tasɩŋ arɩ Jerusalɛm womporunuŋ lɛ, ma dɩ ma naabalɩmaba, ma kuoroo, ma tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ, ma bɩɩna La TƖƖNA yʋ ba wɩaa nɛ koo?

english_verse: And when he could no longer put up with your disgusting sins, he placed a curse on your land and turned it into a desert, as it is today.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ kʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ a bɩra bɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ma wʋkɩsɩa-la lɛ wuo nyalɩmɛ, ʋ leŋe ma tinteeŋ pɩŋ hoi nɛ, nʋʋkala tuo nɩmɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ jɩnɩmba, nɩaa kɛŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: This disaster happened because you worshiped other gods and rebelled against the Lord by refusing to obey him or follow his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ma sɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, a bɩ ʋ niiŋ to koo wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto arɩ ʋ wʋdagaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ wʋlɔrʋŋ deeŋ ŋaa ma lɛ, ʋ nɛ ma nɩna ŋɩɩ lɛɛlɛ.”

english_verse: Then I told the men and their wives, that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: Here in Egypt you still keep your promises to burn incense and offer sacrifices of wine to the so-called Queen of Heaven.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ma dɩ ma haalaa wʋŋaalaa sɛnɛ dagɛ nii-la ma sɩ hɛ nɛ a bʋl, ‘La jaŋ sɛnɛ to niiri-la la sɩ hɛ arɩ la jaŋ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ, a wansɛ kʋnyʋalaa ma a pɩ wɩa-nyuŋ veŋ ha-kuoru-la. Má ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ma jaŋ ŋaa. Má lɩɩsɛ niiri-la kala ma sɩ ta.’ ”

english_verse: Keep these promises! But let me tell you what will happen. As surely as I am the Lord God, I swear that I will never again accept any promises you make in my name.
translation_verse: Ama ma Juu tɩmma-la kala sɩ hɛ Ijipiti lɛ, má jegile nɩɩ La TƖƖNA wɩaa. La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ ŋmɩɛsɛ mɩ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ, nʋʋkala sɩ lɩɩ Juda a hɛ Ijipiti lee na-kala bɩra bɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ koo a ŋmɩɛsɛ a bʋl, ‘Mɩ ŋmɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ weye.’

english_verse: Instead of watching over you, I will watch for chances to harm you. Some of you will die in war, and others will starve to death.
translation_verse: Mɩ bene a chɩchɛ wombiiŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaaba wʋbɔŋ, wʋzɔŋ dee. Juu tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Ijipiti lɛ jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, koo losuŋ kpʋba, dɩ ba kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Only a few will escape and return to Judah. Then everyone who went to live in Egypt will know that when I say something will happen, it will—no matter what you say.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ foro laalɩŋ lɛ a mɩɩra lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a mʋ Juda bɩ jaŋ yʋgɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩkaana-la sɩ kʋ hɔŋ Ijipiti lɛ jaŋ jɩŋ nɩɩ-la wɩɩŋ sɩ jaŋ chɩŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ koo ba nɛ.

english_verse: And here is how you will know that I will keep my threats to punish you in Egypt.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa magɩlɩŋ a pɩma arɩ mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma leriŋ deeŋ, dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ mɩ sɩ sɩ mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma ŋɩɩ jaŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: I will hand over King Hophra of Egypt to those who want to kill him, just as I handed Zedekiah over to Nebuchadnezzar, who wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ Ijipiti kuoro Hɔfɩra a hɛ ʋ dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩɩ chɛ ba lɩɩsɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a nagɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ joŋ Juda kuoro Zedikaaya hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ dʋndɔŋ-la fa sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: Then later, the Lord God of Israel told me to say to Baruch:
translation_verse: “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩ ŋ-na Baruk nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: You are moaning and blaming me, the Lord, for your troubles and sorrow, and for being so tired that you can't even rest.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ, ‘Wɩɩŋ puumi. La TƖƖNA joŋ tʋɔ-cheeŋ a pɛ mɩ hɛɛŋ lɛ nɛ. Huuno leŋe mɩ kala bɛsɩmɛ nɛ, mɩ bɩ wiese ka na.’ ”

english_verse: But all over the earth I am tearing down what I built and pulling up what I planted.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Bʋl ŋ-la a pʋ: ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ yigi kʋ-la mɩ sɩ saa a lo, a churi kʋ-la ma mɩ sɩ chɔnsɔ tintee-la kala lɛ.

english_verse: I am bringing disaster everywhere, so don't even think about making any big plans for yourself. However, I promise that wherever you go, I will at least protect you from death. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ʋ saa maga dɩ ŋ chɛ wʋbalaa a pɩ ŋ tɩtɩa nɛɛ? Sɩ́ ba chɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋlɔrʋŋ a kʋ hɛ nɩaa kala lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Ama lee na-kala ŋ sɩ jaŋ mʋ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ fori a laa ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord often told me what to say about the different nations of the world. What the Lord Says about Egypt
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa a pɩ ʋ wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya a mʋ tɩgɛ tinteyee lɛ.

english_verse: In the fourth year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia defeated King Neco of Egypt in a battle at the city of Carchemish near the Euphrates River. And here is what the Lord told me to say about the Egyptian army:
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro Neko laalɩyuoro-la lɛ nɛ, ba nɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza yuo dii Kakɛmɩs sɩ kpagɛ Yufireti fuo-la lɛ ŋɩɩ. Bʋa-la lɛ Josaaya nanʋala Jehoyakim sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-nɛsɛ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. La TƖƖNA sɩ,

english_verse: It's time to go into battle! So grab your shields,
translation_verse: “Má ŋaa ma hɔɔtaalɩ-la ma sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ siri, kʋjalaa arɩ kʋbiisiŋ kala a mʋ yuo laalɩŋ.

english_verse: saddle your horses, and polish your spears. Put on your helmets and armor, then take your positions.
translation_verse: Má nyɩgɩlɛ ma janɩŋ a jɩl. Ma paa nyunchu gbaŋ-kogunuŋ chu a chɩŋ ma dɩchɩnaa. Ma chɛsɛ ma tiŋŋee a paa ma bayuori kɩaa laalɛ.

english_verse: I can see the battle now— you are defeated and running away, never once looking back. Terror is all around.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ mɩ nɩna? Fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba nɛ, ba mɩɩra fɩfá nɛ, ba yuo dii ba laalɩyuoroo nɛ. Baa fa nɛ lɩma lɩma, ba bɩ harɩŋ ka daasɛ, fawʋllʋŋ golliba chu nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: You are strong and run fast, but you can't escape. You fall in battle near the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ naaŋ sɩ lɩma bɩ jaŋ fá viiri koo nɩalɩŋ sɩ dolie fori. Ba gɛrɛ nɛ a tel wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a kpagɛ Yufireti fuo-la.

english_verse: What nation is this, that rises like the Nile River overflowing its banks?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ sie ŋ-la a nagɛ Naayɩl fuo-la, a nagɛ fuoŋ sɩ gbu lɩlɩɩ?

english_verse: It is Egypt, rising with a roar like a raging river and saying, “I'll flood the earth, destroying cities, and killing everyone in them.”
translation_verse: Ijipiti sie nɛ a nagɛ Naayɩl fuo-la, a nagɛ fuoŋ sɩ gbu lɩlɩɩ. Ʋ sɩ, ‘Mɩ jaŋ sii a tɔ tinteeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ chei tabalaa arɩ ba nɩaa.’

english_verse: Go ahead, Egypt. Tell your chariots and cavalry to attack and fight hard. Order your troops to march out, with Ethiopians and Libyans carrying shields, and the Lydians armed with bows and arrows.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ janɩ-la yaraa lɩŋ. Ma nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ janɩŋ torukoba vɩvɛŋ, má chaasa tii paa. Laalɩyuoroo, má mʋmʋ ma Kus arɩ Puti tɩmma-la sɩ kori hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ, arɩ Lidiya baalaa sɩ lɛrɛ ba tosuŋ hɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful will win this battle and take revenge on his enemies. His sword will eat them and drink their blood until it is full. They will be killed in the north near the Euphrates River, as a sacrifice to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ama tapʋlɩɩ-la ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna kʋa nɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ tiŋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Mɩ tokobiiŋ jaŋ dii nɩaa ŋɩɩ a vɔgɛ, a nyʋa ba chalɩŋ ma ŋɩɩ a vɔgɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ kpʋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ tintee-la lɛ a kpagɛ Yufireti fuo-la.

english_verse: Egypt, no medicine can heal you, not even the soothing lotion from Gilead.
translation_verse: Ijipiti nɩaa, ma mʋ Gɩlɩad a bee chɛ daalusuŋ. Ma daalusu-la kala ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ, kʋŋkala bɩ ma wuo vaarɛ.

english_verse: All nations have heard you weep; you are disgraced, and they know it. Your troops fall to the ground, stumbling over each other. A Warning for Egypt
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ nɩɩ hɩɩsɩ-la sɩ diima wɩaa. Ma nii-ŋmobo jaŋ su dʋnɩa kala. Ma bayuoroo jaŋ gɛrɛ dɔŋɔba, a kala tele hɛ dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: When King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia was on his way to attack Egypt, the Lord sent me with a warning for every Egyptian town, but especially for Migdol, Memphis, and Tahpanhes. He said to tell them: Prepare to defend yourselves! Everywhere in your nation, people are dying in war.
translation_verse: “Má heele bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ Ijipiti arɩ Mɩgɩdɔl lɛ. Má heele bʋlʋ Memfis arɩ Tapanhɛs ma lɛ: ‘Má chɩŋ ma dɩchɩnaa a ŋaa siri, bɛɛ wɩaa laalɩŋ ka dii nɩalɩŋ sɩ gollima nɛ.’

english_verse: I have struck down your mighty god Apis and chased him away.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma bayuoroo pɩŋ tinteeŋ? Ba bɩ wuo chɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ yigiba lo.

english_verse: Your soldiers stumble over each other and say, “Get up! The enemy will kill us, unless we can escape to our own land.”
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ gɛrɛ dɔŋɔ bʋlɩa bʋlɩa, a tele daŋ dɔŋɔ nyuŋ. Ba jaŋ bʋl, ‘Má sii, má leŋ dɩ la mɩɩra mʋ la tɩtɩa tinteeŋ, la nɩaa teeŋ, a kagɛ laal-la la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ kaa pɛsɛ la lɛ.’

english_verse: Egypt, I am the true king, the Lord All-Powerful, and as surely as I live, those enemies who attack will tower over you like Mount Tabor among the hills or Mount Carmel by the sea.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA. Mɩ sɩ weye wɩaa, a nagɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tabɔ sɩ sii kɩɩ peelee kala ŋɩɩ, peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kamɛl ma sii kɩɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kʋ yuoma doluŋ jaŋ nagɛ.

english_verse: You will be led away captive, so pack a few things to bring with you. Your capital, Memphis, will lie empty and in ruins.
translation_verse: Má paa ma kɩaa a ŋaa siri dɩ ma mʋ yoŋ-baga, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Ijipiti lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa, Memfis jaŋ pɩŋ hoi a cheye pɩŋ, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: An enemy from the north will attack you, beautiful Egypt, like a fly biting a cow.
translation_verse: Ijipiti zɔmɔ a nagɛ nɛ-pa-bie nɛ, ama dɩma ka kɔ ʋ lɛ nɛ a lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: The foreign soldiers you hired will turn and run. But they are doomed, like well-fed calves being led to the butcher. *
translation_verse: Ijipiti nɩaa sɩ joŋ moribiee pa aŋ laa laalɩyuoro-la nagɛ nɛ-biisiŋ sɩ nɛrɛ nɛ, ba ma jaŋ mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ a fá hɛ dɔŋɔ. Ba bɩ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa wʋlɔrʋŋ ka kɔ ba lɛ nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛba.

english_verse: The enemy army will go forward like a swarm of locusts. Your troops will feel helpless, like a snake in a forest
translation_verse: Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa jaŋ fá aŋ fʋfʋʋrɛ a nagɛ dɩmɩŋ, dɩ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ tʋɔra a kʋkɔ ʋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ kɔ ʋ lɛ arɩ saa-balaa, a nagɛ nɩaa sɩɩ keri tɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: when men with axes start chopping down trees. It can only hiss and try to escape.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ keri ʋ duuŋ tɩɩsɩŋ kala lo, arɩ ʋ sɩ faasa jʋʋ dɔŋɔ ma kala. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Ba yʋga a kɩɩ hɔbɔ, nʋʋ bɩ ba wuo dɩɩsɛ.

english_verse: Your people will be disgraced and captured by the enemy from the north.
translation_verse: Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ, dɩ ba jomba hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. Soon I will punish the god Amon of Thebes and the other Egyptian gods, the Egyptian kings, the people of Egypt, and everyone who trusts in the Egyptian power.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ: “Mɩ ŋaa siri nɛ dɩ mɩ dɔgɩsɛ Tɛbɛs tɩŋŋaa vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Amɔŋ, Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro, Ijipiti arɩ ʋ vesiŋ arɩ ʋ kuoroo, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro lɛ.

english_verse: I will hand them over to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army. But I also promise that Egypt will someday have people living here again, just as it had before. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Bring Israel Home The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ jomba hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ ba mɩɩsɩŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ. Ama harɩŋ, nɩaa jaŋ bɩra hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, a nagɛ faafaa-la. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Israel, don't be afraid. Someday I will bring you home from foreign lands. You and your descendants will live in peace and safety, with nothing to fear.
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩntɩnna Jekɔb, sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ yaraa yʋɔrɛ Iziral. Mɩ jaŋ laama ta dɩ-bolii-la lɛ ma sɩ hɛ, mɩ jaŋ laa ma doho nɩalɩŋ ta yoŋ-baga lɛ. Jekɔb jaŋ bɩra kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ a hɔŋ sɔm, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ.

english_verse: So don't be afraid, even though now you deserve to be punished and have been scattered among other nations. But when I destroy them, I will protect you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩntɩnna Jekɔb, sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ hɛ ŋ teeŋ nɛ, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Mɩ jaŋ chei tinteye-la kala mɩ sɩ kɛmma pɩsa hɛ gbelem gbelem, ama, mɩ bɩ jaŋ chei ma kala gbelem gbelem. Mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛ ma dɩgɩlɩŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ lemma ta pɛɩ.”

english_verse: Before the king of Egypt attacked the town of Gaza, the Lord told me to say to the Philistines:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ ʋ wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya a mʋ tɩgɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa lɛ ka Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro-na mʋ yuo Gaza.

english_verse: When you hear the thunder of horses and chariots, your courage will vanish, and parents will even abandon their own children.
translation_verse: dɩ ba nɛ nɩɩ janɩŋ naasɩŋ dɔmɔ, dɩ ba nɛ nɩɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba dɔmɔ, arɩ ba gɩrɩŋgɩrɩmba dɔmɔ. Nyɩmmaba bɩ jaŋ pɛ ba biiriŋ lɛ, ba nɩsaa jaŋ sʋʋ mɛrɛ ba sɛsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You refugees from Crete, your time has now come, and I will destroy you. None of you will be left to help the cities of Tyre and Sidon.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la yie nɛ dɩ ba chei Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa, aŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka, nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ Taaya arɩ Sɩdɔŋ lɛ. La TƖƖNA ŋaa siri nɛ dɩ ʋ chei Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa, Kafɩtɔ fuoŋ-niiŋ nɩkaana-la.

english_verse: The Anakim who survive in Gaza and Ashkelon will mourn for you by shaving their heads and sitting in silence.
translation_verse: Gaza nɩaa jaŋ fʋŋ ba nyusuŋ aa dagɛ tʋɔ-cheeŋ. Asɩkɛlɔŋ nɩaa jaŋ ŋaa ba niiŋ chɩm. Fɩlɩsɩtɩa nɩkaanaa, ɛɛ nɛ maa chɛ ma yele diene magɛ?

english_verse: You ask how long will I continue to attack you with my sword, then you tell me to put it away and leave you alone.
translation_verse: Ma yie yel a bʋl, ‘La TƖƖNA tokobiiŋ, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɛ ŋ kerila a diene magɛ?’ Mɩɩra jʋʋ ŋ pɛɛŋ, a pɩŋ sɔm.

english_verse: But how can my sword rest, when I have commanded it to attack Ashkelon and the seacoast?
translation_verse: Ama ɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wiesi, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ sɩ hɛʋ dɩ ʋ yuo Asɩkɛlɔŋ arɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ nɩaa?”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, told me to say to the nation of Moab: The town of Nebo is doomed; Kiriathaim will be captured and disgraced, and even its fortress will be left in ruins.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ Mʋab lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Wɩɩŋ puu Nebo, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ. Ba jaŋ yuo dii Kɩrɩatam, a yigi ʋ dɩ-duoruŋ lo, dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ dii ʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: No one honors you, Moab. In Heshbon, enemies make plans to end your life. My sword will leave only silence in your town named “Quiet.”
translation_verse: Nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ bɛsɛ Mʋab lɛ. Hɛsɩbɔŋ lɛ, nɩaa jaŋ chɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ʋ tel a bʋl: ‘Má kɔ dɩ la dɛrɛ tinteeŋ deeŋ.’ Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Madɩmɛŋ ma jaŋ ŋaa chɩm. Laalɩŋ jaŋ kire to ʋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: The people of Horonaim will cry for help, as their town is attacked and destroyed.
translation_verse: Jegile nɩɩ nii-ŋmobo-la ba sɩɩ ŋmoo Horonem lɛ, ba chaasa ŋmoo niiŋ nɛ a tɩŋ ba taŋ sɩ faasa chei.

english_verse: Moab will be shattered! Your children will sob
translation_verse: Mʋab jaŋ boro tel, ʋ biiriŋ jaŋ ŋmoo niiŋ.

english_verse: and cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they will tell of disasters.
translation_verse: Baa mʋ Luhif nɛ, a faasa yele mʋmʋ. Horonem wombiiŋ lɛ, nɩaa tʋɔŋ cheye nɛ ba yiyel a tɩŋ ba taŋ cheyiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Run for your lives! Head into the desert like a wild donkey.
translation_verse: Má fá, má fá a laa ma mɩɩsɩŋ. Ma nagɛ tɩɩ-puguŋ sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You thought you could be saved by your power and wealth, but you will be captured along with your god Chemosh, his priests, and officials.
translation_verse: Mʋab, ŋ sɩ joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa hɛ ŋ wʋŋaalaa arɩ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa lɛ ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ yuo kɛŋ ŋ ma, a joŋ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Chɛmɔs mʋ yoŋ-baga, ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpaarʋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ.

english_verse: Not one of your towns will escape destruction. I have told your enemies, “Wipe out the valley and the flatlands of Moab.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chei leriŋ jaŋ kɔ tasɩ-la kala lɛ. Taŋ kala bɩ jaŋ fori. Fuo-naasɩŋ jaŋ chei, dɩ tintee-taalɩŋ ma kala chei, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Spread salt on the ground to kill the crops. Leave its towns in ruins, with no one living there.
translation_verse: Joŋ yɩsɩŋ hɛ Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ jaŋ pɩŋ pɛɩ. Ʋ tasɩŋ jaŋ pɩŋ hoi, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: I want you to kill the Moabites, and if you let them escape, I will put a curse on you.”
translation_verse: Ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ ʋ tʋɔ-kala kaa tɩtɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩa dɩ ʋ kpʋ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Moab, you are like wine left to settle undisturbed, never poured from jar to jar. And so, your nation continues to prosper and improve.
translation_verse: Mʋab tɩŋŋaa hɔnɔ nɛ sɔm ba hambiiriŋ kala lɛ, a nagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ sɩ fɩɛla tele pɩŋ, ba bɩ ʋ bɩsa lɩɩ pupoiŋ dɔŋɔ a hɩhɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ʋ ha bɩ yoŋ-baga mʋa. Ʋ sɩma bɩ lɩa, ʋ sʋɔra ma bɩ bɩrɩma.”

english_verse: Then you will be ashamed, because your god Chemosh cannot save you, just as Bethel could not help the Israelites.
translation_verse: Mʋab tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ jaŋ lɩɩ Chɛmɔs vene-la, a nagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ sɩ lɩɩ Bɛtɛl ŋɩɩ ba fa sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: You claim that your soldiers are strong and brave.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ wuo bʋl: La ŋaa bayuoroo nɛ, a jɩŋ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: But I am the Lord, the all-powerful King, and I promise that enemies will overpower your towns. Even your best warriors will die in the battle.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ chei Mʋab arɩ ʋ tasɩŋ, ba jaŋ kpʋ ʋ bapʋɔsɛ zɔŋŋɔɔ kala. Mɩ-na Kuoro nɛ bʋla, mɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: It won't be long now— disaster will hit Moab!
translation_verse: Mʋab teliŋ kpaga nɛ, wʋlɔrʋŋ jaŋ guu kɔ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: I will order the nearby nations to mourn for you and say, “Isn't it sad? Moab ruled others, but now its glorious power has been shattered.”
translation_verse: Má yele pʋ, ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kpagʋ, ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jɩŋ yɩrɩ-la ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ. Má bʋl, ‘Ɛɛ nɛ kuori dantɩgɛ duo-la bori ŋɩɩ, ɛɛ nɛ kuori dantɩga-la sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ bori ŋɩɩ.’

english_verse: People in the town of Dibon, you will be honored no more, so have a seat in the dust. Your walls will be torn down when the enemies attack.
translation_verse: Má joŋ yɩrɩ-la kala ma sɩ kɛnɛ bil aŋ tuu hɔŋ tinteeŋ sɩ hɩla lɛ. Ou, Dɩbɔŋ nɩaa, nɩɩ-la sɩ chei Mʋab jaŋ kɔ ma ma lɛ, a chei ma tabala-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli.

english_verse: You people of Aroer, go wait beside the road, and when refugees run by, ask them, “What happened?”
translation_verse: Má chɩŋ wombiiŋ sɛmɛ a bibeŋ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Arʋa lɛ. Má pɩɛsɛ baala-la sɩɩ fá arɩ haala-la sɩ foro fɩfá, má pɩɛsɛba, ‘Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa?’

english_verse: They will answer, “Moab has been defeated! Weep with us in shame. Tell everyone at the Arnon River that Moab is destroyed.”
translation_verse: Hɩɩsɩŋ dii Mʋab nɛ, ʋ kala yagɩsɛ. Má ŋmoo niiŋ, a yel. Má chɩŋ Anɔŋ fuo-la leriŋ a heele bʋl arɩ ba chei Mʋab nɛ.

english_verse: I will punish every town that belongs to Moab, but especially Holon, Jahzah, Mephaath,
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Wɩa dii tasɩ-la sɩ hɛ tintee-taala lɛ sarɩya nɛ, Hɔlɔŋ, Jaza arɩ Mɛfaaf,

english_verse: Dibon, Nebo, Beth-Diblathaim,
translation_verse: Dɩbɔŋ, Nebo arɩ Bɛf Dibilatem,

english_verse: Kiriathaim, Beth-Gamul, Beth-Meon,
translation_verse: Kiriatem, Bɛf Gamʋl arɩ Bɛf Mioŋ,

english_verse: My decision is final— your army will be crushed, and your power broken.
translation_verse: Mʋab doluŋ dɛrɛ nɛ. Ʋ vaaŋ boro nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: People of Moab, you claim to be stronger than I am. Now I will tell other nations to make you drunk and to laugh while you collapse in your own vomit.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ʋ bugi, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ dagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA teeŋ. Má leŋ dɩ Mʋab bilimi kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ tʋɔsa tʋɔŋ. Má leŋ dɩ ʋ bɩrɩmɛ kʋŋ dɩ nɩaa sisieri ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: You made fun of my people and treated them like criminals caught in the act.
translation_verse: Mʋab, ŋ fa sieri Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ. Ŋ kɛnʋ gaaraa tʋɔŋ nɛɛ a magɛ dɩ ŋ vigisi nyuŋ a sisieri ʋ lɛ dɩ ŋ nɩɩ bʋl ʋ wɩaa?

english_verse: Now you must leave your towns and live like doves in the shelter of cliffs and canyons.
translation_verse: Má leŋ ma tasɩŋ aŋ mʋ hɛ bʋsʋŋ tʋɔŋ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Mʋab lɛ. Má nagɛ kokomo sɩ mʋ saa ʋ dɛlɛ bʋ-bʋa niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I know about your pride, and how you strut and boast.
translation_verse: La nɩɩ Mʋab babii-ballɩŋ wɩaa nɛ, ʋ babiibal kɩŋkɛŋ-la arɩ ʋ dagɛ ŋ-tɩtɩɩ arɩ ʋ sɩɩ-duoŋ.

english_verse: So I will cry and mourn for Moab and its town of Kir-Heres.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ ŋmoo niiŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ Mʋab lɛ, mɩ jaŋ yel a pɩ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa kala. Mɩ yele pɩpɩ Kɩ Harɛsɛf baalaa nɛ.

english_verse: People of Sibmah, you were like a vineyard heavy with grapes, and with branches reaching north to the town of Jazer and west to the Dead Sea. But you have been destroyed, and so I will weep for you, as the people of Jazer weep for the vineyards.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ yele pɩŋ, a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ yele pɩ Jaza, ou, Sɩbɩma girep tɩɩsɩŋ. Ŋ naakelee tɛllɛ mʋ yi mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nɛ. Ba mʋ yi Jaza mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chei kɩaa tuu ŋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩ bɩa lɛ nɛ arɩ ŋ girep nɛnɛɛ.

english_verse: Weeping from Heshbon can be heard as far as Elealeh and Jahaz; cries from Zoar are heard in Horonaim and Eglath-Shelishiyah. And Nimrim Creek has run dry.
translation_verse: Ba nii-ŋmobo ka sii nɛ a lɩɩ Hɛsɩbɔŋ a mʋ Ɛlɩalɩ arɩ Jahazi, a lɩɩ Zʋaa lɛ a mʋ yi Horonem arɩ Ɛgalaf Sɛlɩsɩya, bɛɛ wɩaa Nimirim fuonuŋ ma hʋa nɛ.

english_verse: I will get rid of anyone who burns incense to the gods of Moab or offers sacrifices at their shrines. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpaarɛ vʋɩya vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ ba vesiŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: In my heart I moan for Moab, like a funeral song played on a flute. I mourn for the people of the town of Kir-Heres, because their wealth is gone. *
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ, mɩ yele a pɩpɩ Mʋab nɛ a nagɛ ba sɩɩ ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlʋŋ. Ʋʋ yel nɛ a nagɛ ŋmʋlʋŋ a pɩ Kɩɩ Harɛsɛf nɩaa. Dʋa-la kala ba sɩ chɛ lɛlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The people of Moab mourn on the rooftops and in the streets. Men cut off their beards, people shave their heads; they make cuts on their hands and wear sackcloth. And it's all because I, the Lord, have shattered Moab like a jar that no one wants.
translation_verse: Mʋab lusunuŋ nyuŋ kala arɩ lere-la taŋ nɩaa sɩɩ hilimu, yele nɛ su ba kala, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ yɛrɛ Mʋab nɛ a nagɛ pupoiŋ nʋʋkala sɩ bɩ chɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Moab lies broken! Listen to its people cry as they turn away in shame. Other nations are horrified at what happened, but still they mock her.
translation_verse: Mʋab yɛrɛ nɛ. Baa ŋmoo niiŋ nɛ. Mʋab mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ nɛ arɩ hɩɩsɩŋ. Mʋab mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ mɔmɩɩ nɛ nɩaa sisieri ʋ lɛ, ʋ mɩɩra kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ gollu teeŋ.”

english_verse: Moab, an enemy swoops down like an eagle spreading its wings over your land.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Má bee na, kachuuŋ nɛ file kʋʋ tuu a jɛrɛ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ Mʋab nyuŋ.

english_verse: Your cities and fortresses will be captured, and your warriors as fearful as women giving birth.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ yuo dii tabala-la a laa ba dɩ-duoruŋ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la, Mʋab bayuoroo tʋɔŋ jaŋ wʋwɩɩ a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You are finished as a nation, because you dared oppose me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ chei Mʋab dɩ ʋ bɩra sɩ́ tintee ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa, ʋ dagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ.

english_verse: Terror, pits, and traps are waiting for you.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ, buotuo luŋuŋ arɩ bɛrɛ ka gbɛrɛma, ma-na Mʋab nɩaa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; and if you crawl out of the pit, you'll get caught in a trap. The time has come for you to be punished. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ wuo fori fawʋllɩɩ-la lɛ, ʋ jaŋ tuu buotuo-luŋii-la. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ wuo lɩɩ buotuo luŋii-la tʋɔŋ, bɛrɛ́ jaŋ kɛnʋ. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Mʋab jɩna-la lɛ sɩ maga mɩ dɔgʋsʋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Near the city of Heshbon, where Sihon once ruled, tired refugees stand in shadows cast by the flames of their burning city. Soon, the towns on other hilltops, where those warlike people live, will also go up in smoke.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ foro fá chɩŋ Hɛsɩbɔŋ daaliimiŋ lɛ nɛ a bɩ wɩɩkala wuo ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa nyiniŋ cholo nɛ Hɛsɩbɔŋ lɛ, nyiŋgeliŋ sisii Sɩhɔŋ lɛ. Ʋ dii Mʋab tile nɛ, a didii babiibal tɩmma-la nyusuŋ.

english_verse: People of Moab, you worshiped Chemosh, your god, but now you are done for, and your children are prisoners in a foreign country.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu Mʋab tɩŋŋaa. Ba chei Chɛmɔs vene-la nɛ. Ba kɛsɛ ŋ hambolibiisiŋ mʋ yoŋ-baga nɛ, aŋ kɛsɛ ŋ hantolibiisiŋ ma mʋ ba ŋaa yosi.

english_verse: The Lord has this to say about the nation of Ammon: The people of Israel have plenty of children to inherit their lands. So why have you worshipers of the god Milcom taken over towns and land belonging to the tribe of Gad?
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Iziral bɩ hambolibiisiŋ kɛnɛɛ? Ʋ bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ dii ʋ dʋa kɛnɛɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk laa Gad tinteeŋ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ nɩaa hɔŋ Gad tasɩŋ lɛ?

english_verse: Someday I will send an army to attack you in Rabbah, your capital city. It will be left in ruins, and the surrounding villages will lie in ashes. You took some of Israel's land, but on that day Israel will take yours!
translation_verse: Ama tapʋlaa ka kɔ nɛ, dɩ mɩ ŋaa laalɩyuori goŋ ma Mʋab tɩŋŋaa tabalɩŋ Raba nyuŋ. Ʋ jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ jikpeeŋ, ka dɩ ba nyɩgɛ tabiisi-la kala sɩ gollu. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma jaŋ kiri nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ kiriba ta, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Cry, people of Heshbon; your town will become a pile of rubble. You will turn here and there, but your path will be blocked. Put on sackcloth and mourn, you citizens of Rabbah, because the idol you worship will be taken to a foreign country, along with its priests and temple officials.
translation_verse: Ou Hɛsɩbɔŋ, ŋmoo niiŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba chei Aɩ nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Raba lɛ, má ŋmoo niiŋ. Má laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ a yel. Má fá bɩbaarɛ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jaŋ joŋ ma vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk a mʋ yoŋ-baga, a pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpaarʋ lɛ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You rebellious Ammonites trust your wealth and ask, “Who could attack us?” But I warn you not to boast when your strength is fading.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma bibigisi ma doluŋ lɛ? Ma doluŋ ka dɛrɛ nɛ. Ma ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ nɛ. Ma joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ ma kɩaa lɛ nɛ aŋ bʋl, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo yuola?’

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send neighboring nations to strike you with terror. You will be scattered, with no one to care for your refugees.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔnɔ gollima fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla. Ba jaŋ kiri ma kala ta. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ fa pɩsɛ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Yet someday, I will bring your people back home. I, the Lord, have spoken. What the Lord Says about Edom
translation_verse: Ama ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa bɩra dʋa, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.” Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ lɛ

english_verse: I will send disaster to punish you descendants of Esau, so anyone from Dedan had better turn around and run back home.
translation_verse: Má mɩɩrɛ a faasa fá, a mʋ faa bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ sɩ luŋie lɛ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Dɛdaŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋlɔrʋŋ kʋ hɛ Ɛsɔ lɛ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsʋ.

english_verse: People who harvest grapes leave some for the poor. Thieves who break in at night take only what they want.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ girep nɛnɛɛ nɛ kɔ ŋ leriŋ, ba bɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ aŋ ka nɛnɛɛ mʋa? Dɩ gaaraa nɛ kɔ tɩtaŋɩŋ, kɩaa magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ chɛ dee ba jaŋ gaa?

english_verse: But I will take everything that belongs to you, people of Edom, and I will uncover every place where you try to hide. Then you will die, and so will your children, relatives, and neighbors.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ-na jaŋ gbegisi Ɛsɔ, ka dɩ ʋ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree. Mɩ jaŋ suri lee-la ʋ sɩɩ faa, dɩ ʋ bɩra sɩ́ ʋ tɩtɩa wuo kaa faa. Ʋ biiriŋ, ʋ naambiiriŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jʋʋ kpɩkpagʋ kala jaŋ sʋʋ, dɩ ʋ doho kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: But I can be trusted to care for your orphans and widows.
translation_verse: Má leŋ ma biisinsiŋ pɩmɛ, mɩ jaŋ pɔba. Ma yo-haalaa ma jaŋ wuo joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ mɩ lɛ.”

english_verse: Even those nations that don't deserve to be punished will have to drink from the cup of my anger. So how can you possibly hope to escape?
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ maga dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛba nɛ ba dɔgɩsɛ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma-na jaŋ mʋ pɛɩ? Ma bɩ jaŋ mʋ pɛɩ, ma jaŋ na hɛɛ-la sɩ maga ma na.

english_verse: I, the Lord, swear in my own name that your city of Bozrah and all your towns will suffer a horrible fate. They will lie in ruins forever, and people will use the name “Bozrah” as a curse word.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ: Mɩ ŋmɩɛsɛ mɩ tɩtɩa, Bozira jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a bɩrɩmɛ mɔmɩɩ dɩ nɩaa sisieri ʋ lɛ, dɩ nɩaa naʋ, dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba dɩ ba hihirigi a kɛŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛ. Ʋ tasɩŋ kala jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: I have sent a messenger to command the nations to prepare for war against you people of Edom.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ nɛ a lɩɩ La TƖƖNA teeŋ: Ʋ tɩŋ nʋʋ nɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ tinteyee nɩaa teeŋ a bʋl, “Má kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a yuo Ɛdɔm. Má sii yuo laalɩŋ.”

english_verse: Your nation will be small, yet hated by other nations.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma muuri tinteyee tʋɔŋ, dɩ nɩaa bee gʋgʋʋnɛ ma.

english_verse: Pride tricks you into thinking that other nations look at you with fear. You live along the cliffs and high in the mountains like the eagles, but I am the Lord, and I will bring you down.
translation_verse: Fawʋllɩɩ-la ma sɩ joŋo hɛ nɩaa lɛ arɩ ma babii-ballɩɩ-la nyɩsɛma nɛ. Ma hɛ bʋsʋŋ nyu-gbaŋa nɛ, a hɔŋ dundolluŋ nyuŋ. Ma hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii ma nɛ a nagɛ kachuuŋ, ama mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛma lɩɩ nɩmɛ a kʋ tʋʋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: as bad as the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah and towns nearby. The towns of Edom will be empty.
translation_verse: A nagɛ Wɩa sɩ chei Sodom arɩ Gomora ŋɩɩ, a pɛ tasɩ-la sɩ kpagɛ ba lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa Ɛdɔm lɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ nɩmɛ hɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will attack you like a lion from the forest, attacking sheep in a meadow along the Jordan. In a moment the flock runs, and the land is empty. Who will I choose to attack you? I will do it myself! No one can force me to fight or chase me away.
translation_verse: A nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩ lɩɩ Jɔdaŋ duuŋ tʋɔŋ a kʋkɔ a mʋmʋ pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diiliŋ sɩ kɛŋ ya-zɔmʋŋ, mɩ jaŋ kɔ a guu kiri Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa ba tinteeŋ lɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nagɛmɛ a jaŋ wuo magɩsɛmɛ? Sɩpaalaarɩ bɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa magɩsɛmɛ?”

english_verse: The sounds of your destruction will reach the Red Sea and cause the earth to shake.
translation_verse: Dɩ Ɛdɔm nɩaa nɛ tele, ba dɔmɔ jaŋ leŋ dɩ dʋnɩa jigisi. Ba yele jaŋ mʋ huuri Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: An enemy will swoop down to attack you, like an eagle spreading its wings and circling over Bozrah. Your warriors will be as fearful as women giving birth. What the Lord Says about Damascus
translation_verse: Dʋndɔmɔ jaŋ kʋ tuu ba lɛ a nagɛ kachuuŋ a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ jɛrɛ tɔ Bozira lɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la Ɛdɔm laalɩyuoroo bɔyɛ jaŋ joŋ a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ lʋl ʋ bɔyɛ jujoŋ ŋɩɩ. Wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla a mʋ tɩgɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ

english_verse: The Lord says about Damascus: The towns of Hamath and Arpad have heard your bad news. They have lost hope, and worries roll over them like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Hamaf arɩ Apadɩ tʋɔŋ cheye nɛ bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɩɩ wʋbɔŋ nɛ. Ba tʋɔŋ kala vʋgʋma nɛ a nagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ sɩɩ vuugu.

english_verse: You people of Damascus have lost your courage, and in panic you turn to run, gripped by fear and pain.
translation_verse: Damasɩkʋs pʋgʋma nɛ, ʋ mɩɩra dɩ ʋ fá nɛ. Fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ nɛ. Tʋɔ-cheeŋ arɩ hɛɛŋ jʋʋ-ʋ nɛ, a wʋwɩɩ ʋ lɛ a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ.

english_verse: Once I was pleased with your famous city. But now I warn you, “Escape while you still can!”
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ba vɩa tabal-la sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ ta, taŋ-la nyuŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɔ?

english_verse: Soon, even your best soldiers will lie dead in your streets. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ bapʋɔsaa jaŋ sʋʋ womporunuŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ kpʋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala tapʋlɩɩ-la. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I will set fire to your city walls and burn down the fortresses King Benhadad built. Nebuchadnezzar and the People of the Desert
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chol nyiniŋ hɛ Damasɩkʋs jeyee lɛ. Nyiŋ-la jaŋ dii Bɛŋ-Hadad dɩɩ-duoruŋ.” Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Kɛda arɩ Hazɔ lɛ

english_verse: Here is what the Lord says about the Kedar tribe and the desert villages that were conquered by King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia: Listen, you people of Kedar and the other tribes of the eastern desert. I have told Nebuchadnezzar to attack and destroy you.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Kɛda arɩ Hazɔ kuori tinteyee lɛ, ba nɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza yuo ŋɩɩ. Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Má sii a yuo Kɛda a chei nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: His fearsome army will surround you, taking your tents and possessions, your sheep and camels.
translation_verse: Má laa ba piesee arɩ ba lɛŋŋɛɛ, ba lɛŋŋɛɛ patɩɩsamba arɩ ba kɩaa. Má laa ba bʋntaŋŋaba. Má ŋaa goŋ a bʋla pɩba, ‘Fawʋllʋŋ hɛ lee-kala nɛ.’

english_verse: You have no city walls and no neighbors to help, yet you think you're safe— so I told him to attack.
translation_verse: “Má sii a mʋ yuo tintee nɩa sɩ hɔnɔ ta jɩa a bɩ wɩɩ ka fá. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Tinteeŋ deeŋ bɩ boi-baalaa koo doloo kɛnɛ ba kaa tɔ. Ʋ nɩaa yie hɔŋ ba dʋndʋŋa nɛ.

english_verse: Then your camels and large herds will be yours no longer. People of the Arabian Desert, disaster will strike you from every side, and you will be scattered everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ yuo laa ba bʋntaŋŋaba, a yuo laa ba nɛ-daŋ-la ma. Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dɩ-boloo pɩsa hɛ lee-kala, ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛ ba nyu-pʋnaa ba kui, aŋ leŋ dɩ wʋlɔrʋŋ lɩɩ sɛmɛ na-kala a kʋ jʋʋba. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Only jackals will live where your villages once stood. I, the Lord, have spoken. What the Lord Says about Elam
translation_verse: Hazɔ jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ jolluŋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ. Ʋ jaŋ pɩŋ hoi a kaa mʋ wuu. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ jʋjʋʋ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me to say: People of Elam, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will kill the archers who make your army strong.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Má bee na, mɩ jaŋ kpʋ Ɛlam to-yuoroo, nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa ba doluŋ.

english_verse: Enemies will attack from all directions, and you will be led captive to every nation on earth.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɩɩ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ kala kʋ hɛ Ɛlam lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba pɩsa hɛ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ kala, ba jaŋ mʋ yoŋ-baga tintee kala lɛ.

english_verse: Your king and his officials will die, and I will rule in their place. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bil mɩ kuoru kpasa Ɛlam lɛ a chei ʋ kuoro arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ.

english_verse: But I promise that someday I will bring your people back to their land.
translation_verse: Ama ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Ɛlam nɩaa bɩra dʋa.” La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: Announce what will happen and don't leave anything out.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ to ʋ wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya lɛ a bʋla tɩgɛ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa arɩ ba tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: The attack on the Babylonians will come from the north; they and their animals will run, leaving the land empty. Israel and Judah Will Return to Their Land
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ nɩaa jaŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a kʋ yuou, a leŋ dɩ ʋ tinteeŋ pɩŋ hoi. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Nuhuobiinee arɩ pʋsʋŋ jaŋ fá viiri.”

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Israel and Judah, when these things happen you will weep, and together you will return to your land and worship me, the Lord your God.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Tapʋlɩa-la lɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Juda nɩaa kala jaŋ yele mʋ a chɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: You will ask the way to Zion and then come and join with me in making an agreement you won't break or forget.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ pɩɛsa chɛ Zaayɔŋ wombiiŋ, a bɩrɩma joŋ ba sɩaa chaasɛ nɩmɛ. Ba jaŋ joŋ ba tɩtɩa mɛrɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ, a hɛ niiŋ sɩ bɩ dɩdɛrɩŋ kɛnɛ ba sɩ bɩ jaŋ yʋ ʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: My people, you are lost sheep abandoned in the mountains by their shepherds. You don't even remember your resting place.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa nagɛ piesee sɩ lɛlɛ nɛ. Ba sɩpaalaaraa leŋe ba yeŋŋi nɛ, a leŋ ba gʋgɔllɛ peelee nyuŋ. Baa baarɛ peelee arɩ dundolluŋ nyuŋ nɛ, a yʋ ba tɩtɩa dɩ-pɩna wiesiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: I am your true pastureland, the one who gave hope to your ancestors. But you abandoned me, so when your enemies found you, they felt no guilt as they gobbled you up.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ naba yie kpʋba nɛ. Ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ, ‘La bɩ cheeriŋ kɛnɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ ba TƖƖNA teeŋ, Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɩba kʋdiilee. La TƖƖNA lɛ nɛ ba nyɩmmaba fa joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ.’

english_verse: Escape from Babylonia, my people. Get out of that country! Don't wait for anyone else.
translation_verse: Má fá lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ. Má lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa tinteeŋ lɛ, a nagɛ bʋʋna sɩ laa piesee sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: In the north I am bringing great nations together. They will attack Babylon and capture it. The arrows they shoot are like the best soldiers, always finding their target.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ yigi tintee duoruŋ sɩ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a hɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, a lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ. Ba jaŋ chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa a yuo dii tintee-la. Ba nagɛ bayuori wajɩaba nɛ, ba to-hɛŋŋɛɛ bɩ tinteeŋ ka tuu.

english_verse: Babylonia will be conquered, and its enemies will carry off everything they want. Babylon Will Be Disgraced The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ yuo dii Babɩlɔŋ a paa ʋ kɩaa. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ yuo diiu jaŋ paa kɩaa a vɔgɛ.” La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: People of Babylonia, you were glad to rob my people. You had a good time, making more noise than horses and jumping around like calves threshing grain.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa, má yuo paa mɩ tinteeŋ kɩaa nɛ. Ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ ma jʋjʋɔsɛ a nagɛ nɛŋ sɩɩ nʋɔsɛ mɩaa koo a nagɛ jaaba sɩɩ yel.

english_verse: The city of Babylon was like a mother to you. But it will be disgraced and become nothing but a barren desert.
translation_verse: Ama, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ chaasa kɛŋ ŋ naaŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩ lʋlʋŋ jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa tinteyee tʋɔŋ kʋbie, a ŋaa gɩrɩ-pɩrɩŋ, a ŋaa tintee-hɩlɩɩ.

english_verse: My anger will destroy Babylon, and no one will live there. Everyone who passes by will be shocked to see what has happened.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ na baanɩŋ wɩaa, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ. Ama ʋ kala jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ to Babɩlɔŋ bɩbal, ʋ wɩaa jaŋ kperiba a tɩŋ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ cheyu.

english_verse: Attack from every side! Babylon surrenders! The enemy tears down its walls and towers. I am taking my revenge by doing to Babylon what it did to other cities.
translation_verse: Má ŋaa goŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ sɛmɛ kala. Ʋ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pa nɛ. Ʋ dɩɩ-leŋee tele nɛ, ba yigi ʋ jebiee ma lo. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ tiŋ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ joŋo timu nɛ. Ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ ŋaa nɩaa lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ ma joŋo ŋaa ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: There is no one in Babylonia to plant or harvest crops. Even foreigners who lived there have left for their homelands, afraid of the enemy armies.
translation_verse: Kpʋ kʋduuroo Babɩlɔŋ lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ sɩɩkɔrɔ kʋkʋŋ kɩaa. A tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yuo Babɩlɔŋ wɩaa leŋ dɩ nɩwogusu-la kala mɩɩra mʋ ba nɩaa teeŋ. Leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala fá mʋ ʋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Israel is a flock of sheep scattered by hungry lions. The king of Assyria first gobbled Israel up. Then Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylonia, crunched on Israel's bones.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩ kiri piesee ba pɩsɛ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ yuo diiba nɛ ŋaa Asiiria kuoro. Nɩɩ-la ma sɩ to harɩŋ yɛrɛ ʋ haŋgbelee nɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza.”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, punished the king of Assyria, and I will also punish the king of Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ tinteeŋ nɩaa a nagɛ mɩ sɩ dɔgɩsɛ Asiiria kuoro ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But I will bring Israel back to its own land. The people will be like sheep eating their fill on Mount Carmel and in Bashan, in the hill country of Ephraim and in Gilead.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kaa kɔ ba tinteeŋ, ba jaŋ dii kɩaa Kamɛl peel-la nyuŋ arɩ Basaŋ fuonaaŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ dii kɩaa a vɔgɛ Efirem arɩ Gɩlɩad dundolluŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: I will rescue a few people from Israel and Judah. I will forgive them so completely that their sin and guilt will disappear, never to be found. The Lord's Commands to the Enemies of Babylonia
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ba jaŋ chɛ dɩ ba na Iziral tɩŋŋaa wʋcheeliŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla, ama ba bɩ jaŋ na wʋcheeli kala. Ba jaŋ chɛ dɩ ba na Juda nɩaa ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, ama ba bɩ jaŋ na wʋbɔŋ kala, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ joŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba.

english_verse: The Lord said: I have told the enemies of Babylonia, “Attack the people of Merathaim and Pekod. Kill them all! Destroy their possessions!”
translation_verse: Má mʋ yuo Meratem tinteeŋ nɩaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Pɛkɔd lɛ. Má kire to ba harɩŋ a kpʋba a chei ba kala, Ma ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Sounds of war and the noise of destruction can be heard.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori goŋ nɛ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ, leriŋ nɛ ba chei a faasa ŋɩŋaa goŋ.

english_verse: Babylonia was a hammer pounding every country, but now it lies broken. What a shock to the nations of the world!
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ fa nagɛ hama nɛ a yɩyɛrɛ dʋnɩa tinteyee. Ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ nɛ tinteyee kala tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Babylonia challenged me, the Lord God All-Powerful, but that nation doesn't know it is caught in a trap that I set.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ, mɩ hɛ bɛrɛ nɛ a bil ŋ lɛ, ŋ jaŋ jɩjɩŋ dɩ ʋ kɛnɩŋ. Ba naŋ nɛ a yuo kɛnɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ lɩɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Come from far away, you enemies of Babylon! Pile up the grain from its storehouses, and destroy it completely, along with everything else.
translation_verse: Má yuo Babɩlɔŋ sɛmɛ kala. Má yɛrɛ ʋ virisiŋ, a paaba chʋɔrɛ a nagɛ mɩaa. Má chei ʋ kala gbelem gbelem a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala ka.

english_verse: Kill the soldiers of Babylonia, because the time has come for them to be punished.
translation_verse: Má kpʋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala, má kpʋ ba kala. Wɩɩŋ puuba, ba tapʋlʋŋ yie nɛ, bʋa-la sɩ maga dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛba.

english_verse: The Babylonian army destroyed my temple, but soon I will take revenge. Then refugees from Babylon will tell about it in Zion.
translation_verse: Má jegile nɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ foro lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ kɔ sɩɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ Zaayɔŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ tiŋ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa lɛ a tɩŋ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la wɩaa.

english_verse: Attack Babylon, enemy archers; set up camp around the city, and don't let anyone escape. It challenged me, the holy God, so do to it what it did to other cities. Proud Babylon Will Fall
translation_verse: Má yɩrɛ to-yuoroo hɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ yuo tosuŋ. Má ŋmoo buguŋ a gollu. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala fori. Má joŋ ʋ wʋŋaalaa chɩmɩŋ tiŋ ʋ lɛ. Má joŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ ŋaa nɩaa lɛ a ŋaa ʋ ma lɛ. Ʋ chei mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ nɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: People of Babylon, I, the Lord, promise that even your best soldiers will lie dead in the streets.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ʋ bapʋɔsaa jaŋ sʋʋ womporunuŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ kpʋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala tapʋlɩɩ-la. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Babylon, you should be named, “The Proud One.” But the time has come when I, the Lord All-Powerful, will punish you.
translation_verse: Bee na, sɩɩ-duo tɩɩna mɩ chɩŋ ŋ lɛ nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla. Ŋ tapʋlʋŋ kɔ nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga ba dɔgʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: You are proud, but you will stumble and fall, and no one will help you up. I will set your villages on fire, and everything around you will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Sɩɩ-duo tɩɩna-la jaŋ gɛrɛ tel, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ sii. Mɩ jaŋ chol nyiniŋ hɛ ʋ tasɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩ gollu.”

english_verse: You Babylonians were cruel to Israel and Judah. You took them captive, and now you refuse to let them go.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ma nyagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa bil nɛ, a pɛ Juda nɩaa ma lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ yuo kɛsɛba mɩlba kpɛrɛ nɛ, a vɩa dɩ ba leŋ dɩ ba mʋ.

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, will rescue and protect them. I will bring peace to their land and trouble to yours.
translation_verse: Ama ba Laataara kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna. Ʋ jaŋ faasa chɩna gbɛrɛba a leŋ dɩ ba na wiese ba tinteeŋ lɛ. Ama Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa-na bɩ jaŋ na wiese.

english_verse: I have declared war on you, your officials, and advisors.
translation_verse: Laalɩŋ jaŋ jʋʋ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa, Laal-la jaŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, ba tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ba wʋjɩnnaa.

english_verse: This war will prove that your prophets are liars and fools. And it will frighten your warriors.
translation_verse: Laalɩŋ jaŋ jʋʋ ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ba ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ. Ba jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ nɩyaaraa. Laalɩŋ jaŋ jʋʋ ba bayuoroo. Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ faasa jʋʋba.

english_verse: Then your chariot horses and the foreigners in your army will refuse to go into battle, and the enemy will carry away everything you treasure.
translation_verse: Laalɩŋ jaŋ kpʋ ba janɩŋ aŋ chei ba laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba, a kpʋ nɩwogusu-la ma sɩ hɛ ba laalɩyuoroo tʋɔŋ. Ba jaŋ mɩɩra nagɛ haalaa. Ba jaŋ yuo paa ba dʋa. Ba jaŋ paa ba kɩaa kala.

english_verse: Your rivers and canals will dry up. All of this will happen, because your land is full of idols, and they have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ hɩlɩŋ kʋ hɛ ba fuonuŋ lɛ. Ba lɩɩŋ jaŋ hʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa, tɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ su ba tinteeŋ kala, nɩalɩŋ chaasa joŋ ba nyuŋ kala hɛ tɔmɔ-la lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Never again will people live in your land— only desert animals, jackals, and unclean birds.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, tintee-hɩlɩŋ bagɩlaa arɩ baga vasɩŋ nɛ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Hajaaŋkuŋkumba ma jaŋ jʋjʋʋ nɩmɛ. Nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns, and I will destroy Babylon just as completely. No one will live there again. Babylonia Is Invaded The Lord said:
translation_verse: A nagɛ Wɩa sɩ chei Sodom arɩ Gomora ŋɩɩ, a pɛ tasɩ-la sɩ kpagɛ ba lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ nɩmɛ hɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Far to the north, a nation and its allies have been awakened. They are powerful and ready for war.
translation_verse: Bee na, laalɩyuoroo nɛ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ kʋkɔ. Tintee-duo nɩaa arɩ kuori daŋ nɛ ba lɔgɔ hɛ ŋ lɛ, ba lɩɩ dɩ-bolii kʋkɔ.

english_verse: Bows and arrows and swords are in their hands. The soldiers are cruel and show no pity. The hoofbeats of their horses echo like ocean waves crashing against the shore. The army has lined up for battle and is coming to attack you, people of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Ba nyɩgɩla nɛ a kori tosuŋ arɩ tiŋŋee. Ba tʋɔŋ hɛyɛ nɛ woruŋ, ba bɩ nɩaa nenige ka fá. Ba jɩl ba janɩŋ nɛ, ba huhuuri a nagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ. Baa kɔ nɛ a nagɛ baalaa sɩɩ mʋ ba yuo laalɩŋ, dɩ ba yuo Babɩlɔŋ tabal-la.

english_verse: Ever since your king heard about this army, he has been weak with fear; he twists and turns in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩɩ ba wɩaa nɛ, ʋ nɩsaa sʋʋ mɛrɛ. Hɛɛŋ jʋʋ-ʋ nɛ ʋ nɩna hɛɛŋ a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ.

english_verse: Babylonia, I will attack you like a lion from the forest, attacking sheep in a meadow along the Jordan. In a moment the flock runs, and the land is empty. Who will I choose to attack you? I will do it myself! No one can force me to fight or chase me away.
translation_verse: A nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩ lɩɩ Jɔdaŋ duuŋ tʋɔŋ a kʋkɔ a mʋmʋ pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diiliŋ sɩ kɛŋ ya-zɔmʋŋ, mɩ jaŋ kɔ a guu kiri Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa ba tinteeŋ lɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nagɛmɛ a jaŋ wuo magɩsɛmɛ? Sɩpaalaarɩ bɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa magɩsɛmɛ?”

english_verse: The sounds of your destruction will be heard among the nations, and the earth will shake.
translation_verse: Dɩ Babɩlɔŋ nɛ tele, dʋnɩa jaŋ jigisi. Tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ nɩɩ ba nii-ŋmobo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am sending a wind to destroy the people of Babylonia and Babylon, its capital.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Bee na, mɩ jaŋ yigi nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chei leriŋ a hɛ Babɩlɔŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Foreign soldiers will come from every direction, and when the disaster is over, Babylonia will be empty and worthless.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ nɩwogusuŋ dɩ ba mʋ Babɩlɔŋ a chei ʋ tinteeŋ kala a paa chaarɛ. Ba jaŋ chɩŋ ʋ lɛ sɛmɛ na-kala tapʋlɩɩ-la wʋlɔrʋŋ sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ-ʋ.

english_verse: I will tell these soldiers, “Attack quickly, before the Babylonians can string their bows or put on their armor. Kill their best soldiers and destroy their army!”
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ to-yuoro wuo lɛrɛ ʋ toŋ hɛ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ wuo laalɛ bayuori kɩaa. Má sɩ́ ʋ bapʋɔsaa kʋŋkala leŋ. Má chei ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala gbelem gbelem.

english_verse: Their troops will fall wounded in the streets of Babylon.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ tele sʋʋ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, a chaasa bolimi woruŋ ʋ womporunuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel and Judah is guilty. But I, the Lord All-Powerful, their holy God, have not abandoned them.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, bɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Juda nɩaa vɩa ta, arɩ ba sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ mɩ-na ba Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɩpaaŋ, ba tinteeŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: Get out of Babylon! Run for your lives! If you stay, you will be killed when I take revenge on the city and punish it for its sins.
translation_verse: Má fá lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ. Má fá a laa ma mɩɩsɩŋ. Má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa chei a tɩŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Bʋa-la yie nɛ dɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ tiŋ ʋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsʋ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga.

english_verse: Babylon was my golden cup, filled with the wine of my anger. The nations of the world got drunk on this wine and went insane.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ fa nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ nyʋnyʋala nɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ leŋe dʋnɩa nɩaa kala nyʋa ʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ a bugi. Tinteyee nɩaa nyʋa ʋ tʋɔŋ sɩnɩŋ nɛ a bugi. Ŋɩɩ leŋ ba nyuŋ viiri.

english_verse: But suddenly, Babylon will fall and be destroyed. I, the Lord, told the foreigners who lived there, “Weep for the city! Get medicine for its wounds; maybe they will heal.”
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ jaŋ guu tel a bori. Má yel ʋ lɛ. Má chɛ daalusuŋ a hɛ ʋ lere-la sɩɩ wɩɩ, kapo ʋ jaŋ wuo duori.

english_verse: The foreigners answered, “We have already tried to treat Babylon's wounds, but they would not heal. Come on, let's all go home to our own countries. Nothing is left in Babylonia; everything is destroyed.”
translation_verse: Nɩwogusu-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ sɩ, ‘La fa jaŋ sɛɩ a vaarɛ Babɩlɔŋ, ama ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo duori. Má leŋ la leŋu aŋ ka dɩ la kʋŋkala mʋ la tinteeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ wɩɩŋ jɩla tɩgɛ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ, a yi duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa.’ ”

english_verse: I, the Lord, want Babylon destroyed, because its army destroyed my temple. So, you kings of Media, sharpen your arrows and pick up your shields.
translation_verse: Má taa ma to-hɛŋŋɛɛ, aŋ paa ma hɔɔtaalɩ-la ma sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ. La TƖƖNA yigi Media tɩŋŋaa kuoroo hɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋʋ chɛ ʋ chei Babɩlɔŋ nɛ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ ʋ baanɩŋ tiŋ ʋ lɛ a tɩŋ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la wɩaa.

english_verse: People of Babylon, you live along the Euphrates River and are surrounded by canals. You are rich, but now the time has come for you to die.
translation_verse: Ma Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa hɔŋ lee-la sɩ kɛŋ fuonuŋ yʋga nɛ, a kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ woruŋ. Ma dɩdɛrɩŋ kɔ nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga dɩ ba kpʋma.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, swear by my own life that enemy soldiers will fill your streets like a swarm of locusts. They will shout and celebrate their victory. A Hymn of Praise (Jeremiah
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna ŋmɩɛsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma tasɩŋ su arɩ nɩaa, a nagɛ hɔbɩ-laalɩŋ. Ba jaŋ ŋaa laalɩyuori diiri goŋ ma nyuŋ.

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at his command. He makes clouds appear; he sends the wind from his storehouse and makes lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ kpɩa goŋ, lɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ yie huuri nɛ. Ʋ yie leŋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa lɩɩ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ a kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ leŋ duonuŋ nɩnɩɩ, aŋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ, a leŋ peliŋ ma lɩɩ ʋ lee-la lɛ ʋ sɩ bilu a lulu.

english_verse: People who make idols are stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods cannot breathe.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala chʋʋla nɛ a bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ. Hɩɩsɩŋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ libi tɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba tɔmɔ-la bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ, ba bɩ wiese kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ bʋbʋa kala kɛnɛ. Ba ŋaa kɩaa sɩ kɛŋ mɔmʋŋ nɛ. Dɩ ba sarɩya diiniŋ tapʋlʋŋ nɛ yie, ba jaŋ cheiba.

english_verse: But the Lord, Israel's God, is all-powerful. He created everything, and he chose Israel to be his very own. God's Hammer The Lord said:
translation_verse: Jekɔb Wɩa-na bɩ ba naga. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa kʋŋkala, aŋ lɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ba ŋaa ʋ nɩaa. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Babylonia, you were my hammer; I used you to pound nations and break kingdoms,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Babɩlɔŋ, ŋ nɛ mɩ laalɩŋ toŋguluŋ, mɩ laalɩyuori kʋa. Ŋ nɛ mɩ jaŋ kaa ŋmoo tinteyee pɩsɛ, ŋ nɛ mɩ kaa chei kuori-gentisiŋ.

english_verse: But now, my people will watch, while I repay you for what you did to Zion.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Ma sɩɩŋ lɛ mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra tiŋ Babɩlɔŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ, a tɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ zɔŋ Zaayɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You destroyed the nations and seem strong as a mountain, but I am your enemy. I might even grab you and roll you off a cliff. When I am finished, you'll only be a pile of scorched bricks.
translation_verse: Mɩ chɩŋ ŋ-na Babɩlɔŋ lɛ nɛ, ŋ nagɛ peeliŋ nɛ a chei nɩaa. Ŋ chei dʋnɩa kala nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nɩsɩŋ a liesiŋ, a bilimiŋ ta peel-la nyuŋ, a leŋ dɩ ŋ dii nyiniŋ.

english_verse: Your stone blocks won't be reused for cornerstones or foundations, and I promise that forever you will be a desert. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Nations Will Attack Babylon The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ba bɩ jaŋ joŋ tabɩɩ kala ŋ lɛ a kaa bil je-gʋnʋŋ tiebiiŋ, koo a kaa bil dɩa gentine, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ jaŋ pɩŋ hoi a kaa mʋ wuu. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Signal the nations to get ready to attack. Raise a flag and blow a trumpet. Send for the armies of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz. Choose a commander; let the cavalry attack like a swarm of locusts.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ tuuta je tintee-la lɛ. Má ŋmʋʋ banyilliŋ tinteyee lɛ. Má leŋ dɩ tinteye-la nɩaa ŋaa siri a yuo Babɩlɔŋ. Má yɩrɛ kuori-gentisiŋ deemba kala hɛ ʋ lɛ: Ararat, Mini arɩ Asɩkɛnas. Má lɩɩsɛ laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ dɩ ʋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ dɩ ba mʋ yuou. Má leŋ dɩ janɩŋ mʋ ʋ lɛ a nagɛ hɔbɩ-laalɩŋ.

english_verse: Tell the kings and governors, the leaders and the people of the kingdoms of the Medes to prepare for war!
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ tinteye-la ŋaa siri a mʋ yuou: Media kuoroo, ba tinteyee nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ ba tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kala, arɩ tinteye-la kala ba sɩɩ beŋ.

english_verse: The earth twists and turns in torment, because I have decided to make Babylonia a desert where no one can live, and I won't change my mind.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa nɛ ba chichel, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa lɛ chɩna nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ pɩŋ hoi, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ nɩmɛ hɛ.

english_verse: The Babylonian soldiers have lost their strength and courage. They stay in their fortresses, unable to fight, while the enemy breaks through the city gates, then sets their homes on fire.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ laalɩyuori babiibalaa leŋ yuosuŋ nɛ. Ba ka ba dɩ-duoruŋ lɛ nɛ. Ba doluŋ dɛrɛ nɛ. Ba mɩɩra nagɛ haalaa nɛ. Ba chol nyiniŋ hɛ ʋ d-jʋʋlaa kala lɛ nɛ. Ba bori ʋ boi-baalaa doloo kala nɛ.

english_verse: One messenger after another announces to the king, “Babylon has been captured!
translation_verse: Tɩndaaraa paa puu dɔŋɔ nɛ, dɩ ba mʋ heele pa Babɩlɔŋ kuoro arɩ ba yuo dii ʋ tabalɩŋ kala nɛ.

english_verse: The enemy now controls the river crossings! The marshes are on fire! Your army has panicked!”
translation_verse: Ba laa lere-la kala ba sɩ to chuchol ba fuonuŋ nɛ, a nyɩgɛ ba ya-lugunuŋ kala, fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ ba laalɩyuoroo.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I make this promise— “Soon Babylon will be leveled and packed down like a threshing place at harvest time.” Babylonia Will Pay!
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ba jaŋ ŋmoo Babɩlɔŋ a nagɛ ba sɩɩ ŋmoo mɩaa ŋɩɩ taha lɛ, bʋa-la yie nɛ dɩ ba ŋaaʋ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem say, “King Nebuchadnezzar made us panic. That monster stuffed himself with us and our treasures, leaving us empty— he gobbled up what he wanted and spit out the rest.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza paala liŋ nɛ. Ʋ leŋe la bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ la sɩ hɛ. Ʋ leŋe la nagɛ pupo-wuoluŋ nɛ. Ʋ paala liŋ nɛ a nagɛ dɩmɩŋ, a vɔgɛ, aŋ nyɛ ta.

english_verse: The people of Babylonia harmed some of us and killed others. Now, Lord, make them pay!” The Lord Will Take Revenge on Babylon
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ nɩaa jaŋ bʋl, “Leŋ dɩ dol-la kala Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa sɩ die la lɛ chɩmɩŋ tiŋ ba lɛ.” Jerusalɛm nɩaa ma jaŋ bʋl, “Leŋ dɩ la chal-la kala sɩ jaasa chɩmɩŋ tiŋ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa lɛ.”

english_verse: My people, I am on your side, and I will take revenge on Babylon. I will cut off its water supply, and its stream will dry up.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ a joŋ ma chɩmɩŋ tiŋ ba lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ hʋ, aŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ-bul-sɩaa ma hɩl.

english_verse: Babylon will be a pile of rubble where only jackals live, and everyone will be afraid to walk among the ruins.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a nagɛ pupuluŋ, a bɩrɩmɛ jolluŋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ, a kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ dɩ nɩaa sisieri ʋ lɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: The Babylonians roar and growl like young lions.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɩaa kala ka huosi nɛ a nagɛ naachigi-pɔrɔɔ. Baa huosi nɛ a nagɛ naachigi-biiriŋ.

english_verse: And since they are hungry, I will give them a banquet. They will celebrate, get drunk, then fall asleep, never to wake up!
translation_verse: Ama ba jaŋ sisii, dɩ mɩ ŋaa kʋdiilee arɩ kʋnyʋalaa a pɩba a leŋ dɩ ba bugi, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ba mɔmɔ ŋɩŋaa goŋ, a pɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu a bɩ sii. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I will lead them away to die, like sheep, lambs, and goats being led to the butcher.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba kaa mʋ dɩ-kpʋʋlʋŋ a nagɛ pie-biisiŋ, a nagɛ pie-belliŋ arɩ bʋʋnaa.

english_verse: All nations now praise Babylon, but when it is captured, those same nations will be horrified.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ yuo dii Babɩlɔŋ, tabal-la dʋnɩa nɩaa kala sɩɩ bɛsɛ ʋ lɛ, ba jaŋ yuo laaʋ. Babɩlɔŋ jaŋ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ kʋlɔrʋ tinteyee tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Babylon's enemies will rise like ocean waves and flood the city.
translation_verse: Mʋgʋ-balɩŋ jaŋ pɛllɛ tɔ Babɩlɔŋ. Ʋ lɩɩ-peliŋ jaŋ tɔʋ.

english_verse: Horrible destruction will strike the nearby towns. The land will become a barren desert, where no one can live or even travel.
translation_verse: Ʋ tasɩŋ jaŋ pɩŋ hoi, a ŋaa tintee-hɩlɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa tintee nʋʋkala sɩ bɩ jaŋ hɔŋ. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ to nɩmɛ bal.

english_verse: I will punish Marduk, the god of Babylon, and make him vomit out everything he gobbled up. Then nations will no longer bring him gifts, and Babylon's walls will crumble. The Lord Offers Hope to His People
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛl sɩ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ʋ lusi kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ liŋe. Tinteyee nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ kpaarʋ, Babɩlɔŋ kɛrɛ jaŋ tel.

english_verse: Get out of Babylon, my people, and run for your lives, before I strike the city in my anger!
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa, má kʋ lɩɩ ʋ lɛ. Má fá laa ma mɩɩsɩŋ. Má fá a laa ma tɩtɩa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ faasa na baaŋ-la lɛ.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or lose hope, though year after year there are rumors of leaders fighting for control in the city of Babylon.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ koo dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma, dɩ ma nɛ nɩɩ ba-sɩ tintee-la lɛ. Ma jaŋ nɩɩ ba-sɩ jɩna deeŋ, jɩna dɔŋɔ ma dɩ ma bɩra nɩɩ ba-sɩ, a mʋ tɩgɛ yuosuŋ sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ, arɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩɩ yuo dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The time will come when I will punish Babylon's false gods. Everyone there will die, and the whole nation will be disgraced,
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala sɛnɛ jaŋ kɔ, dɩ mɩ dɔgɩsɛ Babɩlɔŋ tɔŋŋɔɔ. Mɩ jaŋ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ kala hɩɩsɩŋ. Ʋ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ jaŋ kpʋ jaŋ pɩŋ ʋ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: when an army attacks from the north and brings destruction. Then the earth and the heavens and everything in them will celebrate.
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ba lɛ jaŋ ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ Babɩlɔŋ nyuŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa laalɩyuoroo sɩɩ chei leriŋ jaŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa a kʋ yuou. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Babylon must be overthrown, because it slaughtered the people of Israel and of many other nations.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa kpʋ dʋnɩa nɩaa a yʋgɛ nɛ ama lɛɛlɛ Babɩlɔŋ jaŋ tel a tɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wɩaa.”

english_verse: My people, you escaped death when Jerusalem fell. Now you live far from home, but you should trust me and think about Jerusalem. Leave Babylon! Don't stay!
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ ʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, “Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ foro laalɩŋ lɛ, má lɩɩ, ma sɩ́ dienu. Ma hɛ dɩ-bolii nɛ, ama má liisi mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA wɩaa a bɩɩnɛ Jerusalɛm ma wɩaa.

english_verse: You feel ashamed and disgraced, because foreigners have entered my sacred temple.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ, ‘Ba hɩɩsɛla nɛ, a tʋʋsɛla, a leŋ la dii hɩɩsɩŋ bɛɛ wɩaa nɩwogusuŋ jʋʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ lee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.’

english_verse: Soon I will send a war to punish Babylon's idols and leave its wounded people moaning everywhere.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ sɩ bʋa dɔŋ ka kɔ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ chei tɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ, ʋ tinteeŋ kala lɛ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bolimo huhuuni. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Although Babylon's walls reach to the sky, the army I send will destroy that city. I, the Lord, have spoken. Babylon Will Be Destroyed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Dɩ Babɩlɔŋ nɛ paala waa a jɩlaa tɩgɛ wɩa-nyuŋ ma, a saa kɛrɛ golli ʋ dɩ-duoruŋ ma, mɩ jaŋ yigi laalɩyuoroo sɩɩ chei leriŋ a hɛ ʋ lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Listen to the cries for help coming from Babylon. Everywhere in the country the sounds of destruction can be heard.
translation_verse: Nɩaa nɩɩ ŋmoo niiŋ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, baa yel Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ sɩ chaasa chei wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: The shouts of the enemy, like crashing ocean waves, will drown out Babylon's cries as I level the city.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ chei Babɩlɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ goŋ pɛɩ-la kala lɛl. Ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kɔ ba lɛ a nagɛ lɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ pɛllɛɛ kɔ. Ba jaŋ ŋaa goŋ, dɩ goŋ-la huhuuri.

english_verse: An enemy will attack and destroy Babylon. Its soldiers will be captured and their weapons broken, because I am a God who takes revenge against nations for what they do.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ chei leriŋ jaŋ kɔ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ yuo kɛsɛ Babɩlɔŋ laalɩyuoroo, a bori ba tosuŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɩɩ tiŋ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa chɩmɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ timba ŋɩɩ sɩ maga.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the true King, promise that the officials and advisors, the governors and leaders, and the soldiers of Babylon will get drunk, fall asleep, and never wake up.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ʋ wʋjɩnnaa kala bugi, a pɛ ʋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ lɛ, ʋ tɩntɩnnaa arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo. Ba jaŋ pɩŋ doŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ sii. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa kuoro nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The thick walls of that city will be torn down, and its huge gates burned. Everything that nation worked so hard to gain will go up in smoke. Jeremiah Gives Seraiah a Scroll
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Babɩlɔŋ kɛrɩ-barɩŋ-la kala jaŋ pɩŋ tinteeŋ dɩ nyiniŋ dii ʋ boi-baala-la kala sɩ leŋie. Nɩalɩŋ lɔlɔ ta pɛɩ nɛ, tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala ba sɩ tɩma nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ sɩ belime ta nɛ.”

english_verse: During Zedekiah's fourth year as king of Judah, he went to Babylon. And Baruch's brother Seraiah went along as the officer in charge of arranging for places to stay overnight.
translation_verse: Tɩndaarɩɩ-la Jɛrɩmaaya sɩ joŋo pɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ Sɛraaya, Neria nanʋala sɩ ŋaa Maasɛya nihiŋ nɛ ŋ-la, bʋa-la lɛ ʋ dɩ Juda kuoro Zedikaaya sɩ mʋ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ, dɩ Zedikaaya sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-nɛsɛ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Before they left, I wrote on a scroll all the terrible things that would happen to Babylon.
translation_verse: Jɛrɩmaaya fa ŋmʋnsɛ wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la kala sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Babɩlɔŋ lɛ a hɛ teniŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa tɩgɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I gave the scroll to Seraiah and said: When you get to Babylon, read this scroll aloud,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ Sɛraaya, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ mʋ Babɩlɔŋ, hɛ doluŋ aŋ chaasa karɩmɛ wɩalɩŋ dɩ ba lɩɩ,

english_verse: then pray, “Our Lord, you promised to destroy this place and make it into a desert where no people or animals will ever live.”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl, ‘Ou La TƖƖNA, ŋ sɩ ŋ jaŋ chei leriŋ deeŋ, dɩ nuhuobiiŋ koo pʋna sɩ́ nɩmɛ hɛ. Ŋ sɩ ʋ jaŋ pɩŋ hoi a kaa mʋ wuu.’

english_verse: When you finish praying, tie the scroll to a rock and throw it in the Euphrates River. Then say,
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ karɩmɛ teŋ-la dɛrɛ, joŋ tabɩɩŋ vɔɔ mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ a joŋo yuo hɛ Yufireti fuo-la lɛ,

english_verse: “This is how Babylon will sink when the Lord destroys it. Everyone in the city will die, and it won't have the strength to rise again.” The End of Jeremiah's Writing Jeremiah's writing ends here.
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl, ‘Ŋɩɩ nɛ Babɩlɔŋ jaŋ tuu lɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ sii a tɩŋ wʋlɔrʋ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ kaa kʋ hɛ ʋ lɛ wɩaa. Ʋ nɩaa kala jaŋ tel.’ ” Jɛrɩmaaya wɩaa dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la.

english_verse: Next, Nebuzaradan arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah his assistant, and three temple officials.
translation_verse: Nebuzaradaŋ fa pɛ kɛsɛ Sɛraaya sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ nɛ arɩ Zefanaaya ma sɩɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ batori sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boyee.

english_verse: then his eyes were poked out. He was put in chains, then dragged off to Babylon and kept in prison until he died.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɔrɩgɔ chaarɛ Zedikaaya ma sɩaa, aŋ hɛʋ kɔlɩɩŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ a lɛrʋ kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ. Ba kɛnʋ mʋ tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa nɩmɛ, ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: meters around. They were hollow, but the bronze was about
translation_verse: Ba tɔ tabal-la nɩaa hɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi Zedikaaya kuoruŋ jɩ-fii arɩ kʋbala lɛ.

english_verse: After a year and a half, all the food in Jerusalem was gone. Then on the ninth day of the fourth month,
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-nɛsɛ tʋɔŋ tapʋl nibi chɛɛŋ, losuŋ faasa jʋʋ tabal-la woruŋ, kʋdiilii kala tuo dɩ ba dii.

english_verse: the Babylonian troops broke through the city wall. That same night, Zedekiah and his soldiers tried to escape through the gate near the royal garden, even though they knew the enemy had the city surrounded. They headed toward the Jordan River valley,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Babɩlɔŋ laalɩyuoro-la ŋmoo taŋ-la kɛrɛ lo. Zedikaaya arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo sii tɩtaŋɩŋ a fá to boi-baal-la sɩ hɛ kɛrɩsɩŋ balɩa pɛgɛ a kpagɛ kuoro ŋmaŋkaaŋ a lɩɩ, arɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ fa sɩ golli tabal-la ma kala. Ba fá to Jɔdaŋ fuo-la dɩɩrɩŋ a mʋ.

english_verse: Zedekiah was taken to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial and found him guilty.
translation_verse: Ba kɛnʋ a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro teeŋ, taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rɩbɩla sɩ hɛ Hamaf tinteeŋ lɛ, Nebukadineza diiu sarɩya, a joŋ cheeriŋ pʋ.

english_verse: Zedekiah's sons and the officials of Judah were killed while he watched,
translation_verse: Rɩbɩla lɛ, Babɩlɔŋ kuoro leŋ ba kpʋ Zedikaaya hambolibiisiŋ kala ʋ sɩɩŋ lɛ, a kpʋ Juda tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ ma kala.

english_verse: Jerusalem was captured during Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king of Babylonia. About a month later, Nebuchadnezzar's officer in charge of the guards arrived in Jerusalem. His name was Nebuzaradan,
translation_verse: Nebukadineza sɩ dii kuoruŋ, ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ nibi, chɛŋ nɔŋ, tapʋl-fii lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Nebuzaradaŋ sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro kʋhɩaŋ, aŋ pɛ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ kɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: and he burned down the Lord's temple, the king's palace, and every important building in the city, as well as all the houses.
