translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ kɔ, ʋ nyɩgɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la, kuoru dɩa arɩ Jerusalɛm dɩɩsɩŋ kala. Dɩɩ-nyuŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ nyɩgɛ.

english_verse: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nebuzaradaŋ leŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋmoo kɛrɛ-la ba fa sɩ saa golli Jerusalɛm a lo.

english_verse: He led away the people left in the city, including everyone who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar, the rest of the skilled workers, and even some of the poor people of Judah.
translation_verse: Nebuzaradaŋ sɩ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ kuoro nɩhɩaŋ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ faasa summi arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ka Jerusalɛm lɛ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa, a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga a pɛ nɩalɩŋ Nebukadineza fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kɛsɛ mʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Only the very poorest were left behind to work the vineyards and the fields.
translation_verse: Ama Nebuzaradaŋ leŋ summo-la dɔnsʋŋ nɛ dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ lɛ arɩ bagɩsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Evil Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.
translation_verse: Evil-Merodak fa kɛŋ Jehoyachiŋ nɛ woruŋ, a pʋ dɩchɩnɩŋ a kɩɩ kuorusu-la dɔnsʋŋ kala ba fa sɩ kɛsɛ tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa Babɩlɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiachin was allowed to wear regular clothes instead of a prison uniform, and he even ate at the king's table every day.
translation_verse: Kuoro fa leŋe Jehoyachiŋ wuri ʋ dansarɩka gɛnnɩŋ ta nɛ aŋ lɩlaalɛ ʋ tɩtɩa gɛnnɩŋ, a didii kɩaa kuoro dɩa lɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: As long as Jehoiachin lived, he was paid a daily allowance to buy whatever he needed.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kala Babɩlɔŋ kuoro yie pɩ Jehoyachiŋ moribiee nɛ a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ sʋba.

english_verse: Jerusalem, once so crowded, lies deserted and lonely. This city that was known all over the world is now like a widow. This queen of the nations has been made a slave.
translation_verse: Bee na Jerusalɛm tabal-la sɩ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ ŋɩɩ, taŋ-la nɩaa fa sɩ suo, ʋ mɩɩra nagɛ yo-haal nɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa ta-zɔŋ nɛ tinteyee tʋɔŋ. Tinteyee tʋɔŋ, ʋ nɛ fa yʋga, ʋ nɛ lɛɛlɛ bɩrɩmɛ yoŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Each night, bitter tears flood her cheeks. None of her former lovers are there to offer comfort; her friends have betrayed her and are now her enemies.
translation_verse: Ʋ chaasa yel nɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ, ʋ chaŋkpaŋŋaa kala ŋaa sɩlɩɩrɩŋ. Ʋ hɩɩlaa kala tʋɔŋ nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ nyagɛ ʋ bɔyɛ. Ʋ tanlɔsʋŋ kala joŋu yallɛ nɛ, ba mɩɩra ŋaa ʋ dʋndɔmɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The people of Judah are slaves, suffering in a foreign land, with no rest from sorrow. Their enemies captured them and were terribly cruel.
translation_verse: Ba chaasa dɔgɩsɛ Juda nɩaa nɛ ba tɩma na hɛɛŋ woruŋ, ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ba kɛmba mʋ yoŋ-baga. Ba mʋ guoli tinteyee nɩaa tʋɔŋ, ba bɩ dɩ-wiesii na. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kire to ba harɩŋ kɛsɛba nɛ, ba bɩ lee-kala kɛnɛ dɩ ba to mʋ.

english_verse: The roads to Zion mourn because no one travels there to celebrate the festivals. The city gates are deserted; priests are weeping. Young women are raped; Zion is in sorrow!
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ wombiee ka yel nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋkala bɩ ba to kʋkɔ ʋ gbielee leriŋ. Ʋ boi-baalaa kala pɩŋ hoi nɛ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa huhuuni, hatolie-la sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ tʋɔŋ faasa chei nɛ, Zaayɔŋ kala ŋaa hɛɩ.

english_verse: Enemies now rule the city and live as they please. The Lord has punished Jerusalem because of her awful sins; he has let her people be dragged away.
translation_verse: Ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ mɩɩra kɛŋ doluŋ ʋ nyuŋ, ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ wiese nɛ. La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa ʋ tʋɔŋ faasa chei a tɩŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ yʋga wɩaa. Ba yuo dii Zaayɔŋ nɛ a kɛsɛ ʋ biiriŋ mʋ yoŋ-baga, ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ diiba nɛ.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared. Her leaders are like deer that cannot find pasture; they are hunted down till their strength is gone.
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ nɩaa tʋla kala lɩa nɛ. Ba sɩpaalaaraa nagɛ aamɩŋ sɩ bɩ yaŋ na dɩ ʋ dii nɛ. Ba doluŋ dɛrɛ nɛ ba fá nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kiriba sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Her people recall the good life that once was theirs; now they suffer and are scattered. No one was there to protect them from their enemies who sneered when their city was taken.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩa-la wɩaa sɩ jʋʋba ba gɔllɔ bɩbaarɛ, Jerusalɛm nɩaa liise yi ba dʋa-la kala wɩaa nɛ, kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kɛnɛ faafaa-la. Ʋ nɩaa sɩ jʋʋ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ, nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ. Ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ benu nɛ aŋ mɔŋ ʋ sɩ cheye lɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem's horrible sins have made the city a joke. Those who once admired her now hate her instead— she has been disgraced; she groans and turns away.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm nɩaa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩɩ zilu mɩɩra kɛnʋ gbigbesi nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba na ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ kala nɛ. Ʋ tɩtɩa hʋʋnɛ aŋ gʋrɛ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Her sins had made her filthy, but she wasn't worried about what could happen. And when Jerusalem fell, it was so tragic. No one gave her comfort when she cried out, “Help! I'm in trouble, Lord! The enemy has won.”
translation_verse: Ʋ disiŋ-la mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ kieli nɛ, ʋ fa bɩ ʋ chie wɩaa bɩɩna. Ʋ sɩ tele ŋɩɩ kperi, ka nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ nyagɛ ʋ bɔyɛ. “Mɩ Tɩɩna, bee na mɩ sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ dʋndɔmɔ yuo diimi nɛ.”

english_verse: Zion's treasures were stolen. Jerusalem saw foreigners enter her place of worship, though the Lord had forbidden them to belong to his people.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm dʋndɔmɔ kɛŋ ʋ dʋa kala laa nɛ. Ʋ na dɩ tinteye-la nɩaa sɩɩ kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ tʋɔŋ, nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ kɩsɛ dɩ ba jʋʋ lee-la ŋ nɩaa sɩɩ hilimu.

english_verse: Everyone in the city groans while searching for food; they trade their valuables for barely enough scraps to stay alive. Jerusalem Speaks: Jerusalem shouts to the Lord, “Please look and see how miserable I am!”
translation_verse: Ʋ nɩaa kala ka huunu nɛ a chɩchɛ kɩaa dɩ ba dii. Ba joŋ ba dʋa kala a lenni kʋdiilee nɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. “La TƖƖNA, bee na mɩ wɩɩŋ a kaa bɩɩna na, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bee gʋʋnɛmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: No passerby even cares. Why doesn't someone notice my terrible sufferings? You were fiercely angry, Lord, and you punished me worst of all.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ to lee-la bɩbal teeŋ? Má bee gollo na. Nʋʋ tuo ʋ hɛɛŋ nagɛ hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩɩ na, kʋ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo hɛ mɩ lɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ baanɩŋ sɩ faasa sii.

english_verse: From heaven you sent a fire that burned in my bones; you set a trap for my feet and made me turn back. All day long you leave me in shock from constant pain.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe nyiniŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii nɛ, a kʋ tuu jʋʋ mɩ haŋgbelee. Ʋ hɛ bɛrɛ́ a kɛmmɛ nɛ a kɛmmɛ mʋ harɩŋ. Ʋ vɩamɛ ta nɛ, mɩ nɩna hɛɛŋ tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: You have tied my sins around my neck, and they weigh so heavily that my strength is gone. You have put me in the power of enemies too strong for me.
translation_verse: Ʋ vɔɔ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ mɛrɛ daaŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ pɩɩnɛba hɛ dɔŋɔ a nagɛ ŋmɛnɩŋ nɛ. Ba nɛ ʋ joŋo hɛ mɩ baŋŋaa, mɩ bɩra bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ. La TƖƖNA jommi hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ dolie kɩɩmɛ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, have turned back my warriors and crushed my young heroes. Judah was a woman untouched, but you let her be trampled like grapes in a wine pit.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA vɩa mɩ laalɩyuori duori-la kala nɛ. Ʋ yɩrɛ laalɩyuoroo a hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ, dɩ ba kpʋ mɩ bapʋɔsaa kala. La TƖƖNA nʋɔsɛ Juda nɩaa a nagɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ chagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Because of this, I mourn, and tears flood my eyes. No one is here to comfort or to encourage me; we have lost the war— my people are suffering. The Prophet Speaks:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ yel, mɩ sɩaa kala pɩpɛllɛ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ. Nʋʋkala bɩ kpaga dɩ ʋ nyagɛ mɩ bɔyɛ, nʋʋ ma tuo dɩ ʋ ŋaa dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala. Mɩ biiriŋ bɩra bɩ kʋŋ kɛnɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diiba nɛ.”

english_verse: Zion reaches out her hands, but no one offers comfort. The Lord has turned the neighboring nations against Jacob's descendants. Jerusalem is merely a filthy rag to her neighbors. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa tɩɛnɛ nɛ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba pɛ ʋ lɛ, ama nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ nyagɛ ʋ bɔyɛ. La TƖƖNA bʋla tɩgɛ Iziral lɛ, arɩ tinteye-la sɩ kpagʋ jaŋ kʋ ŋaa ʋ dʋndɔmɔ. Jerusalɛm mɩɩra ŋaa disiŋ kʋŋ nɛ ba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord was right, but I refused to obey him. Now I ask all of you to look at my sufferings— even my young people have been dragged away.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, ka mɩ pɛ vɩa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga. Nʋʋkala jegili mɩ teeŋ, má bee na hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩɩ na. Mɩ bapʋɔsaa arɩ mɩ hatoloo kala nɛ ba kɛsɛ mʋ yoŋ-baga.

english_verse: I called out to my lovers, but they betrayed me. My priests and my leaders died while searching the city for scraps of food.
translation_verse: Mɩ yɩrɛ mɩ sɩŋŋaa, ka ba vɩa dɩ ba pɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ mɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ, sʋba nɛ tabal-la lɛ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ gɔllɔɔ chɛ kʋdiilee dɩ ba dii a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Won't you look and see how upset I am, our Lord? My stomach is in knots, and my heart is broken because I betrayed you. In the streets and at home, my people are slaughtered.
translation_verse: “La TƖƖNA, na ŋɩɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ sɩ faasa chei, hɛɛŋ chaasa jʋʋmɛ nɛ. Mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa wʋwalɩmɛmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ vɩa ŋ niiŋ a mʋ kieli nɛ. Ba kpʋ mɩ nɩaa jeeŋ harɩŋ nɛ, dɩa tʋɔŋ-na paala nagɛ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone heard my groaning, but no one offered comfort. My enemies know of the trouble that you have brought on me, and it makes them glad. Hurry and punish them, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Nɩaa nɩɩ mɩ huuno nɛ, ama nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ nyagɛ mɩ bɔyɛ. Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɩɩ mɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ wɩaa nɛ, a jʋjʋɔsɛ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa lɛ. Leŋ dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la wɩaa ŋ sɩ heele bʋl yi, dɩ ba ma na hɛɛŋ arɩ mɩ sɩ na ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Don't let their evil deeds escape your sight. Punish them as much as you have punished me because of my sins. I never stop groaning— I've lost all hope!
translation_verse: Bee na wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa, a leŋ dɩ ba na hɛɛŋ woruŋ arɩ ŋ sɩ leŋe mɩ na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Mɩ huuno yʋgɛ nɛ mɩ daagaa kala viisi.”

english_verse: The Lord was angry! So he disgraced Zion though it was Israel's pride and his own place of rest. In his anger he threw Zion down from heaven to earth.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ na baanɩŋ, ʋ joŋ birimiŋ nɛ a tɔ Zaayɔŋ kala. Ʋ yigi Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋla lo tinteeŋ nɛ ʋ birisi. Tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ na baanɩŋ, ʋ bɩ liise yi ʋ tɩtɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord had no mercy! He destroyed the homes of Jacob's descendants. In his anger he tore down every walled city in Judah; he toppled the nation together with its leaders, leaving them in shame.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩ ba nenige fá aŋ chei lere-la kala Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ jʋʋ. Ʋ sɩ na baanɩŋ, ʋ yigi ʋ yigi Juda nɩaa dɩ-duoruŋ lo nɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ ba tinteeŋ arɩ ba sɩpaalaaraa muuri nɛ, a leŋ ba dii hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord was so furiously angry that he wiped out the whole army of Israel by not supporting them when the enemy attacked. He was like a raging fire that swallowed up the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ faasa na baanɩŋ, ʋ leŋe Iziral tɩŋŋaa doluŋ kala dɛrɛ nɛ. Ʋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ naduo-la ba lɛ nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ ba dʋndɔmɔ sɩ kpaga. Ʋ sii chɩŋ Jekɔb doho nɩaa lɛ a nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ nɛ a joŋ kʋŋkala sɩ gollu a dii.

english_verse: He attacked like an enemy with a bow and arrows, killing our loved ones. He has burned to the ground the homes on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩrɩmɛ ʋ dʋndɔŋ nɛ a lɛrɛ ʋ toŋ hɛ a kɛŋ ʋ nadiiŋ ŋaa siri. Ʋ nagɛ dʋndɔŋ nɛ a kpʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ su sɩɩŋ. Ʋ baanɩŋ sie a nagɛ nyiniŋ nɛ a joŋ Jerusalɛm dii.

english_verse: The Lord was like an enemy! He left Israel in ruins with its palaces and fortresses destroyed, and with everyone in Judah moaning and weeping.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nagɛ dʋndɔŋ nɛ a chei Iziral. Ʋ chei ba kuoru dɩɩsɩŋ kala nɛ arɩ ba dɩ-duoruŋ. Ʋ leŋe Juda nɩaa yele arɩ nii-ŋmobo yʋgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: He shattered his temple like a hut in a garden; he completely wiped out his meeting place, and did away with festivals and Sabbaths in the city of Zion. In his fierce anger he rejected our king and priests.
translation_verse: Wɩa chei ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ a nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ lɩga churi nɛ, ʋ chei lee-la ba sɩ yie hilimi ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ. La TƖƖNA leŋe Zaayɔŋ nɩaa yʋ ba gbielee tapʋlaa arɩ chɛ-wiesie-la wɩaa nɛ. Ʋ baanɩŋ sɩ faasa sii, ʋ vɩa kuoro arɩ ʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kala nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord abandoned his altar and his temple; he let Zion's enemies capture her fortresses. Noisy shouts were heard from the temple, as if it were a time of celebration.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA vɩa ʋ koruŋ ta nɛ a leŋ ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ ma ta. Ʋ joŋ Jerusalɛm kɛrɩsɩŋ hɛ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ ba yige lo, aŋ jʋʋ ŋɩŋaa laalɩyuori diiri goŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ a nagɛ gbiele tapʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord had decided to tear down the walls of Zion stone by stone. So he started destroying and did not stop until walls and fortresses mourned and trembled.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA chaasa ŋaa siri dɩ ʋ yigi kɛrɛ-la sɩ golli Zaayɔŋ lo nɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩɛnɛ nɛ a nagɛ ŋmɛŋ-la ba sɩ kaa magɩsɛ leriŋ, ʋ bɩ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɩɩsa leriŋ cheyiŋ lɛ. Ʋ leŋe vaŋkumba arɩ kɛrɩsɩŋ kala yel nɛ a yʋɔla dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Zion's gates have fallen facedown on the ground; the bars that locked the gates are smashed to pieces. Her king and royal family are prisoners in foreign lands. Her priests don't teach, and her prophets don't have a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ boi-baalaa tele nɛ hagɩla tɔ, ba daadoloo bori a chei. Ba kɛŋ ʋ kuoro arɩ ʋ sɩpaalaaraa mʋ yoŋ-baga nɛ, ba guoli tinteyee nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ba bɩra bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ ba tuto ka dagɛ. Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ bɩra bɩ wɩaa ka na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ.

english_verse: Zion's leaders are silent. They just sit on the ground, tossing dirt on their heads and wearing sackcloth. Her young women can do nothing but stare at the ground.
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ hɔŋ tinteeŋ nɛ a bɩ ba niiŋ wuo suri, a ŋaa kʋŋkɔlʋŋ bʋgɛ ba nyusuŋ a laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ. Jerusalɛm hatoloo kɛŋ nyusuŋ gʋrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: My eyes are red from crying, my stomach is in knots, and I feel sick all over. My people are being wiped out, and children lie helpless in the streets of the city.
translation_verse: Mɩ yele, mɩ sɩaa bɩra bɩ na, mɩ tʋɔŋ kala chei. Mɩ kala nɛ bɛsɩmɛ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ a tɩŋ ba sɩ chei mɩ nɩaa wɩaa. Hambiisiŋ arɩ bii-mulluŋ yiege nɛ a pɩŋ tabal-la womporunuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: A child begs its mother for food and drink, then blacks out like a wounded soldier lying in the street. The child slowly dies in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Ba yie yele pɩɛsɛ ba naamba, “Nɩɩ nɛ kʋdiilee arɩ lɩɩŋ hɛ?” Ba yiege pɩŋ tabalɩŋ womporunuŋ lɛ nɛ a nagɛ baalaa sɩ bolimo. Baa sʋʋ nɛ ba naamba nɩsaa lɛ.

english_verse: Zion, how can I comfort you? How great is your pain? Lovely city of Jerusalem, how can I heal your wounds, gaping as wide as the sea?
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm nɩaa, wʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩma? Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ mɩ jaŋ kɛmma kaa magɩsɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa nyagɛ ma bɔyɛ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala? Ma naawɩɩlɩŋ luŋie a nagɛ mʋga nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo vaarɛma?

english_verse: Your prophets deceived you with false visions and lying messages— they should have warned you to leave your sins and be saved from disaster.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ma Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ, ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ a bɩ bʋbʋɔ kala kɛnɛ. Ba bɩ leŋe ma jɩŋ dɩ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ ŋɩɩ fa leŋ dɩ ma sɩ́ yoŋ-baga mʋ. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla pɩma ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ a kɛmma yeŋŋi.

english_verse: Those who pass by shake their heads and sneer as they make fun and shout, “What a lovely city you were, the happiest on earth, but look at you now!”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kielima bɩbal mɔŋ a bʋl, vaha. Ba yie sieri ma lɛ aŋ kɛŋ ba nyusuŋ chugisi ma Jerusalɛm nɩaa wɩaa aŋ pɩɛsɛ, “Tabalɩŋ deeŋ dee ba fa kaa yɩrɛ taŋ-la sɩ chaasa zɔŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a ŋaa dʋnɩa nɩaa kala tʋɔtɔrʋ lee ŋɩɩ?”

english_verse: Zion, your enemies curse you and snarl like wild animals, while shouting, “This is the day we've waited for! At last, we've got you!”
translation_verse: Ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala chaasa suri ba niiree nɛ a sii chɩŋ ma lɛ. Ba sieri ma lɛ nɛ a mɔmɔ chuchuri nyɩlaa a bʋl, “La chei Jerusalɛm nɛ. Tapʋlʋŋ deeŋ nɛ la faa gbɛrɛ ŋɩɩ, la saa naʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord has done everything that he had planned and threatened long ago. He destroyed you without mercy and let your enemies boast about their powerful forces.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɛ. Ʋ leŋe wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla kʋ ŋaa nɛ, wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla faafaa kala. Ʋ cheyiŋ nɛ Jerusalɛm a bɩ ŋ nɩaa nenige fá. Ʋ leŋe ŋ nɩaa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jʋɔsɛ ma nyuŋ nɛ. Ʋ leŋe ba laa doluŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Zion, deep in your heart you cried out to the Lord. Now let your tears overflow your walls day and night. Don't ever lose hope or let your tears stop.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm, leŋ dɩ ŋ kɛrɩsɩŋ ŋmoo niiŋ a pɩ la TƖƖNA a nagɛ nɩaa sɩɩ yel. Leŋ dɩ ma sɩlɩɩrɩŋ pɛllɛ a nagɛ fuoŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala. Má sɩ́ wiesu, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma sɩaa ma wiesi.

english_verse: Get up and pray for help all through the night. Pour out your feelings to the Lord, as you would pour water out of a jug. Beg him to save your people, who are starving to death at every street crossing. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: Má sii, a ŋmoo niiŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ. Má joŋ ma tʋɔŋ wɩaa kala bil La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Má kɛŋ nɩsaa je ʋ teeŋ, a sʋlʋ a tɩŋ ma biiriŋ mɩɩsɩŋ wɩaa. Nɩalɩŋ losuŋ sɩ kpʋa ba yiege pɩŋ womporii kala loŋgoruŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Think about it, Lord! Have you ever been this cruel to anyone before? Is it right for mothers to eat their children, or for priests and prophets to be killed in your temple?
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, beŋ mɩ wɩɩŋ a na: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ ha ŋaa ʋ na hɛɛŋ ŋ-la? Haalaa kɛsɛ ba biiriŋ didii, biiri-la ba sɩ dɩɛsa. Ba kpʋkpʋ ŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: My people, both young and old, lie dead in the streets. Because you were angry, my young men and women were brutally slaughtered.
translation_verse: Hambiisiŋ arɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ pɩna hɛ dɔŋɔ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ lɛ womporunuŋ nyuŋ. Dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kpʋ mɩ bapʋɔsaa arɩ mɩ hatoloo bil nɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ na baanɩŋ nɛ ŋ kpʋba a bɩ ba nenige fá.

english_verse: I have suffered much because God was angry.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ na baanɩŋ a kɛŋ ʋ daŋkpɩlɩŋ dɔgɩsɛ.

english_verse: He chased me into a dark place, where no light could enter.
translation_verse: Ʋ kirimi ta nɛ a leŋ mɩ vɛŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ bɩ sɛyɛ mɩ vɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I am the only one he punishes over and over again, without ever stopping.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ chaasa ŋmoomi nɛ a bɩra ŋmoomi, a ŋmoomi halɩɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la kala.

english_verse: God caused my skin and flesh to waste away, and he crushed my bones.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe mɩ hɩɛsɛ nɛ mɩ yaraa kala ŋmɩɩmɛ, mɩ haŋgbelee nyʋgʋsɛ.

english_verse: He attacked and surrounded me with hardships and trouble;
translation_verse: Ʋ tɔ mɩ hɛ nɛ a gollimi chu a leŋ wɩaa jʋʋmɛ woruŋ, mɩ faasa nɩna hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: he forced me to sit in the dark like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe mɩ hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ a nagɛ nɩaa sɩ sʋʋ faafaa kala.

english_verse: God built a fence around me that I cannot climb over, and he chained me down.
translation_verse: Ʋ saa kɛrɛ nɛ a gollimi, a vɔɔmɛ bil arɩ chɔrʋmɔɔ.

english_verse: Even when I shouted and prayed for help, he refused to listen.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ paala yɩrʋ a ŋmoo niiŋ pʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, ʋ yie vɩa mɩ sʋla nɛ.

english_verse: God put big rocks in my way and made me follow a crooked path.
translation_verse: Ʋ paa tabɩaa nɛ a kɛrɛ mɩ wɛnɩŋ, a leŋ mɩ wombiee golibi.

english_verse: God was like a bear or a lion waiting in ambush for me;
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩna gbɛrɛmɛ a nagɛ lʋgʋmʋŋ nɛ, a nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩ faa.

english_verse: he dragged me from the road, then tore me to shreds.
translation_verse: Ʋ lɛrɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ mɩ wombiiŋ lɛ a kɛmmɛ pʋɔsɛ nɛ aŋ lemmi ta.

english_verse: God took careful aim and shot his arrows
translation_verse: Ʋ lɛrɛ ʋ toŋ hɛ nɛ a joŋ hɛmɩŋ hɛ a kaa pɛsɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: I am a joke to everyone— no one ever stops making fun of me.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa mɔmɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩaa kala teeŋ, ba kɛmmɛ hɛ yɩɩlɩŋ a sisieri mɩ lɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: He made me eat gravel and rubbed me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe mɩ chaŋ kpaga nɛ, mɩ nyɩlaa bori, ʋ nʋɔsɛmɛ ŋmʋrɛ hagɩla lɛ.

english_verse: I cannot find peace or remember happiness.
translation_verse: Ʋ pɔ mɩ sɩ́ fɩɛlɩŋ na nɛ, mɩ yʋ sɩma wɩaa.

english_verse: I tell myself, “I am finished! I can't count on the Lord to do anything for me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Mɩ wɩɩkala dɛrɛ nɛ, wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ fa sɩɩ yɩɛlɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ lɛlɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Just thinking of my troubles and my lonely wandering makes me miserable.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ liise yi ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ na hɛɛŋ a gɔllɔ baarɛ lɛ, ʋ nagɛ susuŋ sɩ hɛyɛ nɛ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: That's all I ever think about, and I am depressed.
translation_verse: Mɩ chaasa liisiba nɛ woruŋ, mɩ tʋɔŋ chaasa chei.

english_verse: Then I remember something that fills me with hope.
translation_verse: Ama wɩɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie bɩɩna yi a kɛŋ yɩɛlaa nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: The Lord's kindness never fails! If he had not been merciful, we would have been destroyed.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ la bɩ sʋba, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige ŋɩɩ bɩ birigi.

english_verse: The Lord can always be trusted to show mercy each morning.
translation_verse: Chʋchʋɔ na-kala ba yie bɩrɩmɛ wʋfalɩa nɛ. Ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ chaasa yʋgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I say, “The Lord is all I need; I can depend on him!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ, “La TƖƖNA nɛ mɩ kʋa kala, ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ gbɛrʋ.”

english_verse: The Lord is kind to everyone who trusts and obeys him.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA wɩaa zɔmɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa ʋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: It is good to wait patiently for the Lord to save us.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ nyalɩmɛ a gbɛrɛ La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ laaŋ ta.

english_verse: When we are young, it is good to struggle hard
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ nʋʋkala gʋnnɛ hɛɛŋ, ʋ hambiriŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and to sit silently alone, if this is what the Lord intends.
translation_verse: Dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ joŋ chʋga chʋŋ nʋʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ fɩɛla hɔŋ chɩm.

english_verse: Being rubbed in the dirt can teach us a lesson;
translation_verse: Ʋ maga ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa tuu tinteeŋ, kapo yɩɛlaa ha jaŋ wuo hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: we can also learn from insults and hard knocks.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga ʋ joŋ ʋ chaŋkpaŋɩŋ pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmobu a sɛɩ hɩɩsɩŋ,

english_verse: The Lord won't always reject us!
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA bɩ nɩaa vɩa tɩta deeŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: He causes a lot of suffering, but he also has pity because of his great love.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie wuo leŋ nɩa na hɛɛŋ, ka ʋ bɩra fá ʋ nisusuŋ. Ʋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ yʋga kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't enjoy sending grief or pain.
translation_verse: Ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ dee dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩaa a leŋ dɩ ba na hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: or cheat anyone out of what is rightfully theirs. God Most High sees everything,
translation_verse: a vɩa dɩ ba leŋ dɩ nuhuobiine na wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ na. Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala bɩ ŋɩɩ cho.

english_verse: and he knows when you refuse to give someone a fair trial.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ pɔ dɩ ba sɩ́ kʋsɩŋŋaa joŋo pɩ nʋʋ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ, La TƖƖNA ka na nɛ.

english_verse: No one can do anything without the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩɩ, aŋ leŋ dɩ wɩɩ-la ŋaa dɩ La TƖƖNA bɩ wombiiŋ pa?

english_verse: Good and bad each happen at the command of God Most High.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala nɛ yie leŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ arɩ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ kala kɔ.

english_verse: We're still alive! We shouldn't complain when we are being punished for our sins.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nuhuobiiŋ kala jaŋ gʋrɩmɛ wɩaa dɩ ba nɛ dɔgʋsʋ a tɩŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa?

english_verse: Instead, we should think about the way we are living, and turn back to the Lord.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la beŋ la wʋŋaalaa aŋ kɛmba bɩɩna na, aŋ mɩɩra mʋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ.

english_verse: When we lift our hands in prayer to God in heaven, we should offer him our hearts and say,
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la pʋllɛ la tʋɔŋ a bal nɩsaa Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ teeŋ a bʋl,

english_verse: “We've sinned! We've rebelled against you, and you haven't forgiven us!
translation_verse: “La ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a vɩa ŋ niiŋ ka ŋ bɩ joŋo chɛla.

english_verse: Anger is written all over you, as you pursue and slaughter us without showing pity.
translation_verse: Ŋ joŋ baanɩŋ tɔ ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ a kire to la harɩŋ. Ŋ kpʋla nɛ a bɩ la nenige fá.

english_verse: You are behind a wall of clouds that blocks out our prayers.
translation_verse: Ŋ joŋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ tɔ ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ŋ sɩ́ la sʋla nɩɩ.

english_verse: You allowed nations to treat us like garbage;
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛnla bɩrɩmɛ pupuluŋ arɩ nʋsʋrʋŋ nɛ, la guoli tinteyee nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: We are terrified and trapped, caught and crushed.”
translation_verse: La dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ cheila nɛ, ka la jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ. La tuu buotuonuŋ nɛ, fawʋllʋŋ faasa jʋʋla.”

english_verse: My people are destroyed! Tears flood my eyes,
translation_verse: Ba chei mɩ nɩaa nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ pɩpɛllɛ mɩ sɩaa lɛ a nagɛ fuoŋ.

english_verse: until the Lord looks down from heaven and helps.
translation_verse: a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ aŋ bee na.

english_verse: I am horrified when I see what enemies have done to the young women of our city.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ na dɩ ba joŋo ŋaa haala-la kala sɩ hɛ mɩ tabalɩŋ lɛ leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ chei nɛ.

english_verse: No one had reason to hate me, but I was hunted down like a bird.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ka mɩ bɩ ba wɩɩ cheye, ka bagɩlɛmɛ nɛ a nagɛ mɩ ŋaa diibie.

english_verse: Then they tried to kill me by tossing me into a pit and throwing stones at me.
translation_verse: Ba walɩma dɩ ba kpʋmɛ nɛ a jommi hɛ buotuoŋ lɛ, a joŋ tabɩɩŋ tɔ.

english_verse: Water covered my head— I thought I was gone.
translation_verse: Lɩɩŋ tɔ mɩ nyuŋ, mɩ bɩɩnɛ dɩ mɩ sʋba nɛ.

english_verse: From the bottom of the pit, I prayed to you, Lord.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, mɩ hɛ buotuo-luŋii-la lɛ nɛ aŋ yɩrɩŋ dɩ ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: I begged you to listen. “Help!” I shouted. “Save me!” You answered my prayer
translation_verse: Ŋ nɩɩ mɩ sɩɩ sʋllʋŋ nɛ, sɩ́ ŋ dɩgɩlaa tɔ mɩ sɩɩ ŋmoo niiŋ dɩ ŋ laamɛ ta.

english_verse: and came when I was in need. You told me, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ yɩrɩŋ, ŋ kʋ kpagɛmɛ nɛ, a bʋla pɩmɛ, “Sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá.”

english_verse: You rescued me and saved my life.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ nɛ a laa mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ pɩmɛ.

english_verse: You saw them abuse me, Lord, so make things right.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ na wʋbɔŋ-la ba sɩ joŋo ŋaa mɩ lɛ nɛ. Laa mɩ wɩɩŋ jɩma pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Yes, you know their insults and their evil plans.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɩɩ jomo-la ba sɩ tʋʋsɛmɛ nɛ, wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ vʋʋra a chɩŋ mɩ lɛ,

english_verse: All day long they attack with words and whispers.
translation_verse: wɩalɩŋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ lʋara gʋrɩmɛ a sii chɩŋ mɩ lɛ chɛɛ-la kala.

english_verse: No matter what they are doing, they keep on mocking me.
translation_verse: Bee naba, dɩ ba hɔnɔ nɛ koo dɩ ba chɩna nɛ, ba kɛmmɛ hɛ yɩɩlaa nɛ a sisieri mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Pay them back for everything they have done, Lord!
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, joŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ maga a tiŋ ba lɛ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Put your curse on them and make them suffer.
translation_verse: Ŋaa dɩ ba tʋɔŋ dol, dɩ ŋ ŋmɩaŋ diiba.

english_verse: Get angry and go after them until not a trace is left under the heavens.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, kire to ba harɩŋ arɩ baanɩŋ a cheiba, dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ dʋnɩa lɛ hɛ.

english_verse: The purest gold is ruined and has lost its shine; jewels from the temple lie scattered in the streets.
translation_verse: Sɛlɩmɛ tʋla lɩa, sɛlɩmɛ sɩ zɔmɔ ŋɩɩ bɩrɩmɛ kʋpɛɩ. Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tabɩɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ jaasa pɩŋ womporuŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: These are Zion's people, worth more than purest gold; yet they are counted worthless like dishes of clay.
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ nɩaa fa ŋaa nɩfɩama nɛ, ba fa kɛŋ yuŋuŋ a nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ, aŋ ka nɩaa lɛɛlɛ jomba, ba nagɛ chʋrʋŋ pupoiŋ, pupo-mɛɛrɛ sɩ mɛ.

english_verse: Even jackals nurse their young, but my people are like ostriches that abandon their own.
translation_verse: Jolluŋ ma yie kɛŋ ba yɩlɩŋ nɛ, a dɩɛsɛ ba biiriŋ, ka mɩ nɩaa-na kɛŋ tʋɔbɔmʋŋ ba biiriŋ lɛ a nagɛ nyaŋkɩɩbʋʋnaa sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Babies are so thirsty that their tongues are stuck to the roof of the mouth. Children go begging for food, but no one gives them any.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa leŋe lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ kɛŋ ba bii-mulluŋ nɛ ba nandelimee jɩla mɛrɛ tilimee lɛ. Hambiisiŋ sʋsʋl kʋdiilee ka nʋʋ bɩ baa pa.

english_verse: All who ate expensive foods lie starving in the streets; those who grew up in luxury now sit on trash heaps.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ dii kʋdii sɩŋŋaa sʋsʋʋ losuŋ womporunuŋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa a lɩlaalɛ gɛrɩ-vachalɩŋ lɛɛlɛ pɩŋ pupuloo nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: My nation was punished worse than the people of Sodom, whose city was destroyed in a flash without the help of human hands.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ ba sɩ dɔgɩsɛ mɩ nɩaa nɛ yʋga a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ ba fa sɩ dɔgɩsɛ Sodom nɩaa. Wɩa fa guu cheiba nɛ, ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: The leaders of Jerusalem were purer than snow and whiter than milk; their bodies were healthy and glowed like jewels.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa fa pʋlla a nagɛ kuŋkunuŋ nɛ, a pʋlla kɩɩ nayɩlɩŋ. Ba yaraa fɩɛsa kɩɩ tabɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rubi, ba nagɩŋ zɔmɔ nagɛ tabɩɩ-tʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Safɩya.

english_verse: Now they are blacker than tar, and no one recognizes them; their skin clings to their bones and is drier than firewood.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ ba bire kɩɩ nʋʋ-hala bʋbʋɔŋ, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ ba wuo jɩŋ womporunuŋ lɛ. Ba yaraa ŋmɩɩmɛ a hɩla mɛrɛ ba haŋgbelee lɛ, a nagɛ daa-hɩlɩŋ.

english_verse: Life in the city is so bad that loving mothers have boiled and eaten their own children.
translation_verse: Haala-la sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige kɛsɛ ba tɩtɩa biiriŋ chɔ a chɩchaŋ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ chei mɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord was so fiercely angry that he burned the city of Zion to the ground.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA chaasa na baanɩŋ nɛ, ʋ baanɩŋ chaasa sii nɛ ʋ pɔsɛ. Ʋ fuuni nyiniŋ hɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ joŋ ʋ kala kɔlɩmɛ a tuu yi gentine.

english_verse: Not a king on this earth or the people of any nation believed enemies could break through her gates.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa kuoroo kʋŋkala bɩ laa dii nʋʋkala ma tuo dʋnɩa lɛ a laa dii, arɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ wuo to Jerusalɛm boi-baalaa jʋʋ.

english_verse: Jerusalem was punished because her prophets and her priests had sinned and caused the death of innocent victims.
translation_verse: Ama ŋɩɩ ŋaa nɛ, a tɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, ba kpʋ tʋɔpʋl tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Yes, her prophets and priests were covered with blood; no one would come near them, as they wandered from street to street.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, ba gɔllɔɔ laarɛ womporunuŋ lɛ nɛ, a nagɛ nyʋlɩmaa. Ba kpʋ nɩaa a kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ digiba.

english_verse: Instead, everyone shouted, “Go away! Don't touch us! You're filthy and unfit to belong to God's people!” So they had to leave and become refugees. But foreign nations told them, “You can't stay here!”
translation_verse: Nɩaa yie bʋl ba lɛ, “Má sʋrɩsa lɩɩ, ma kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Má sʋrɩsa mʋ, má sʋrɩsa lɩɩ. Má sɩ́ la digu.” Dɩ ba nɛ fá mʋ guoli tinteyee nɩaa tʋɔŋ a gɔllɔɔ baarɛ, nɩalɩŋ ma yie bʋl, “Ba bɩ daha wuo hɔŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord is the one who sent them scattering, and he has forgotten them. No respect or kindness will be shown to the priests or leaders.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ kɛmba pɩsɛ, ʋ bɩra bɩ ba nyuŋ ka beŋ. Ʋ bɩra bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pʋpʋ ka zil, ʋ sɩpaa tuo nɩhɩasɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Enemies hunted us down on every public street. Our time was up; our doom was near.
translation_verse: Nɩaa ka densi la nɛ, la bɩra bɩ la womporunuŋ lɛ wuo vɛŋ. La dɩdɛrɩŋ kpaga nɛ, la tapʋlaa dɛrɛ nɛ, la dɛrɩŋ yie nɛ.

english_verse: They swooped down faster than eagles from the sky. They hunted for us in the hills and set traps to catch us out in the desert.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kiree to la harɩŋ naachɛɛŋ lɩma a kɩɩ kachuuŋ sɩɩ fil. Ba kirila baarɛ peelee nyuŋ nɛ, a faa gbɛrɛla tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's chosen leader was our hope for survival! We thought he would keep us safe somewhere among the nations, but even he was caught in one of their traps.
translation_verse: Kuoru-la La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsa ŋaa la mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, ka ba bɛrɛ kɛnʋ. La fa bɩɩna ʋ daanyʋɔsʋŋ lɛ, la jaŋ wuo hɔŋ tinteyee nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You people of Edom can celebrate now! But your time will come to suffer and stagger around naked.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Ɛdɔm arɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ Uzi tinteeŋ lɛ maa jʋɔsʋ nɛ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Ama hɛɛ-la jaŋ jʋʋ ma ma, dɩ ma bugi, ba jaŋ wuri ma kɩaa aŋ ka yarɩ-biree.

english_verse: The people of Zion have paid for their sins, and the Lord will soon let them return home. But, people of Edom, you will be punished, and your sins exposed.
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ nɩaa, Wɩa dɔgɩsɛma dɛrɛ nɛ. Wɩa bɩra bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ a dieni. Ama ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Ɛdɔm lɛ, ʋ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, a leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala na ma bɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget how we have suffered and been disgraced.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, liise yi wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa la lɛ, beŋ a na hɩɩsɩŋ sɩ kɛnla ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: We are like children whose mothers are widows.
translation_verse: La bɩrɩmɛ biisinsiŋ nɛ, a bɩ nyɩmmaba kɛnɛ, la naamba ma ŋaa yo-haalaa.

english_verse: The water we drink and the wood we burn cost far too much.
translation_verse: Dɩ la bɩ lɩɩŋ yɔbɔ, la bɩ nyʋa, dɩ la bɩ daasɩŋ yɔbɔ, la bɩ nyiniŋ hɛ.

english_verse: We are terribly mistreated; we are worn out and can find no rest.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kirila paa puula nɛ, la kala bɛsɩmɛ, aŋ bɩ wuo wiesi.

english_verse: We had to surrender to Egypt and Assyria because we were hungry.
translation_verse: La joŋ la tɩtɩa pɩ Ijipiti arɩ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa nɛ, dɩ la wuo na kʋdiilee dii.

english_verse: Our ancestors sinned, but they are dead, and we are left to pay for their sins.
translation_verse: La naabalɩmaba nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ tuo, ka la mɩɩraa na hɛɛŋ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa.

english_verse: Slaves are now our rulers, and there is no one to set us free.
translation_verse: Yosuŋ nɛ mɩɩraa benla, ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ laala ta ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: We are in danger from brutal desert tribes; we must risk our lives just to bring in our crops.
translation_verse: La yie joŋ mɩɩsɩŋ yɔɔ sʋʋŋ nɛ a na kʋdiilee, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩkpʋʋraa nɛ hɛ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Our skin is scorched from fever and hunger.
translation_verse: La yaraa lɩma nɛ a nagɛ tabʋʋŋ losuŋ kɛnla la vɩvagɩlɛ.

english_verse: On Zion and everywhere in Judah our wives and daughters are being raped.
translation_verse: Baa gurigi haalaa nɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ, aa gurigi haala-la ha sɩ bɩ baal jɩŋ Juda tasɩŋ ma lɛ.

english_verse: Our rulers are strung up by their arms, and our nation's advisors are treated shamefully.
translation_verse: Ba kɛsɛ la sɩpaalaaraa a lieŋi nɛ, a bɩ la nɩhɩasɩŋ ma ka zil.

english_verse: Young men are forced to do the work of slaves; boys must carry heavy loads of wood.
translation_verse: Ba fʋgɛ la bapʋɔsaa hɛ nɛ ba nʋnɔŋ munuŋ nɔmʋŋ lɛ, hambolibiisiŋ chʋŋ daasɩŋ a gɩgɛrɛ.

english_verse: Our leaders are not allowed to decide cases in court, and young people no longer play music.
translation_verse: Nɩhɩasɩŋ bɩra bɩ tabalɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ lɛ wuo hɔŋ, bapʋɔsaa leŋ yɩɩlaa yɩɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: Our hearts are sad; instead of dancing, we mourn.
translation_verse: Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ bɩra tuo la lɛ, la gʋala mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ yele nɛ.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared! And we are doomed because of our sins.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ kaa ŋmoo bɔyɛ bɩra tuo. Hɛɛŋ puula nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: We feel sick all over and can't even see straight;
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa la daagaa viisi. Wɩaa deemba nɛ leŋe sɩlɩɩrɩŋ tɔ la sɩaa, la bɩra bɩ wuo na.

english_verse: our city is in ruins, overrun by wild dogs.
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ nɛ a ŋaa hoi jolluŋ jʋʋ aŋ lɩlɩɩ.

english_verse: You will rule forever, Lord! You are King for all time.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɩɩ beŋ nɩaa a kaa mʋ wuu. Ŋ kuoruŋ bɩ dɩdɛrɩŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Bring us back to you! Give us a fresh start.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, laala dɩ la bɩra ŋaa ŋ nɩaa. Leŋ dɩ la bɩra nagɛ ŋɩɩ la fa sɩ naga,

english_verse: Or do you despise us so much that you don't want us?
translation_verse: see dɩ ŋ paala chaasa vɩala, a na baanɩŋ la nyuŋ a kieli.

english_verse: I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ a na pel-duoŋ sɩ du lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ kʋkɔ, taŋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-bal kʋbala tʋɔŋ, ka pʋlʋmʋŋ golli ʋ kala. Nyiŋ-la sɩɩ lɩgɩsɛ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ fɩɛsɛ a nagɛ hɔɔŋ sɩ hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans,
translation_verse: Nyiŋ-la tʋɔŋ, mɩ na kɩaa banɛsɛ sɩ weye a nagɛ nuhuobiine.

english_verse: except that each one had four faces and four wings.
translation_verse: Ama kɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala kɛŋ sɩaa banɛsɛ ba sɛsɩŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ ma banɛsɛ.

english_verse: Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze.
translation_verse: Ba naasɩŋ fa ŋaa tegi tegi nɛ, ba naachɛyɛɛ ma nagɛ nɛ-bie kɩaa, a tʋtʋl a nagɛ kɔlɩɩŋ.

english_verse: The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
translation_verse: Ba kɩŋkɛnsɩ-la fa tɩgɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ. Ba kala faa vɛŋ nɛ tegi tegi, ba bɩ bɩrɩmɛ.

english_verse: Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala fa kɛŋ sɩaa sɩ bɩ dɔŋɔba naga banɛsɛ nɛ: Sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ sɩaa nagɛ nuhuobiine sɩaa a hɛ sɩpaaŋ, sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ma sɩaa nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩaa a hɛ nadiiŋ, sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ma sɩaa nagɛ nɛ-bele sɩaa a hɛ nagʋa, ka sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ma sɩaa nagɛ kachuuŋ sɩaa a hɛ harɩŋ.

english_verse: Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
translation_verse: Ba sɩaa nagɩŋ nɛ fa ŋɩɩ. Ba kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ balɩa balɩa fa je wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ, ba niipinee mʋ tɩgɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, ka ba kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩ-la balɩa balɩa ma kaa tɔ ba yaraa.

english_verse: The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala ka vɛŋ tegi tegi nɛ. Lee na-kala ba dɩma sɩɩ mʋ, ba yie mʋ nɩmɛ nɛ, ba bɩ gɛbɛ.

english_verse: The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ sɩ weye fa fɩɛsa nɛ a nagɛ nyiŋ-halaa koo tʋʋ-diiri kapɩlaa nyiniŋ. Nyiniŋ faa villi kɩalɩŋ pɛgɛ nɛ, a pʋllɛ woruŋ aŋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ a nagɛ taŋ sɩɩ lɩgɩsʋ.

english_verse: The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ yie faasa fá mʋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ kʋkɔ harɩŋ a nagɛ taŋ sɩɩ lɩgɩsʋ.

english_verse: I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel,
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩɩ beŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ weye ŋɩɩ, mɩ na dɩ gɩrɩŋgɩrɩŋ hɛ ba kʋŋkala sɛsɩ-la banɛsɛ sɩ kɛŋ sɩaa lɛ a didigi tinteeŋ.

english_verse: shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ gɩrɩŋgɩrɩmba-la banɛsɛ fa nagɛ: Ba kala fa nagɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, aŋ tʋtʋl a nagɛ tabɩɩ-zɔŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ kirisola, ba fa ŋaaba ba gɩrɩgɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning.
translation_verse: Dɩ gɩrɩŋgɩrɩmba-la nɩɩ vɛŋ, lee na-kala kɩalɩŋ sɩaa sɩ chaasa nɛ ba ma yie chaasɛ, ba bɩ bɩrɩmɛ.

english_verse: The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them.
translation_verse: Gɩrɩŋgɩrɩmba-la niipinee fa sii jeje nɛ a kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ. Ba fa kɛŋ sɩaa nɛ a golli.

english_verse: The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala dɩ kɩalɩŋ nɩɩ vɛŋ koo a chɩŋ, koo dɩ ba sii wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ, gɩrɩŋgɩrɩmba-la ma yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa kɩalɩŋ sɩ weye dɩma-la fa hɛ gɩrɩŋgɩrɩmba-la lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Above the living creatures, I saw something that was sparkling like ice, and it reminded me of a dome. Each creature had two of its wings stretched out toward the creatures on either side, with the other two wings folded against its body.
translation_verse: Kʋ-la sɩ chugili ba nyuŋ a nagɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ ba kɛŋ ba kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ balɩa balɩa je a chaasɛ dɔŋɔ, aŋ kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ balɩa balɩa ma tɔ ba yaraa.

english_verse: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ fa sɩ file, mɩ nɩɩ ba kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ dɔmɔ, baa huuru a nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ faasa pɛllɛ a dʋdɔŋ nɛ, a bɩra nagɛ Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna yikoro, a bɩra nagɛ laalɩyuoroo sɩ yʋga a ŋɩŋaa goŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ chɩna, ba yie kɛŋ ba kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ kaa tuu nɛ.

english_verse: When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ chɩna ŋɩɩ, mɩ nɩɩ kʋŋ dɔmɔ sɩ lɩɩ kʋ-la sɩ nagɛ wɩa-nyuŋ a chugili kɩalɩŋ sɩ weye nyuŋ.

english_verse: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.
translation_verse: Kʋ-la sɩ nagɛ wɩa-nyuŋ a chugili kɩalɩŋ sɩ weye nyuŋ ma nyuŋ, kʋŋ kʋbala chɩŋ a nagɛ kuoru kpasa ba sɩ kɛŋ tabɩɩ kʋbala sɩ nagɛ diibelimbine a tʋtʋl a ŋaa, ka kʋŋ hɔŋ kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ a nagɛ nuhuobiine.

english_verse: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light,
translation_verse: Mɩ na a chɩŋ kʋ-la tɩŋa lɛ a kaa jɩl fɩɛsa nɛ a nagɛ hɔɔŋ sɩ hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ, a chɩŋ ʋ tɩŋa ma kaa tuu nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ. Pʋlʋŋ fɩrɩtɩtɩ kʋbala nɛ fa golli kʋ-la.

english_verse: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_verse: Duoŋ-sɩa sɩ yie nagɛ ŋɩɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tʋɔŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tʋla ma fa nagɛ a golli kʋ-la. Pʋlʋŋ-la sɩ dagɛ La TƖƖNA tʋla nɛ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ fa sɩ naʋ, mɩ kɛŋ sɩaa chu tinteeŋ, aŋ nɩɩ nʋʋ sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, sii chɩŋ ŋ naasɩŋ nyuŋ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩŋ.”

english_verse: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa Dɩma kʋ jʋʋmɛ, a kɛmmɛ chʋʋla kɩɩ mɩ naasɩŋ nyuŋ, ka mɩ nɩɩ dɩ ʋʋ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, mɩɩ tɩmɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ nɛ, ba ŋaa tintee nɩa sɩ vɩa mɩ niiŋ nɛ, ba dɩ ba naabalɩmaba bɩ mɩ niiŋ ka to a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ teeŋ mɩ sɩɩ tɩmɩŋ ŋaa tʋɔ-dol tɩmma nɛ, a kɛŋ nyuduoŋ woruŋ. Bʋla pɩba, ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la.’

english_verse: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ dagɩŋ ka sɛɩ nɛ. Dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ koo dɩ ba vɩa, ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ wʋlaabʋlla fa hɛ ba tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't be afraid of them or of anything they say. You may think you're in the middle of a thorn patch or a bunch of scorpions. But be brave
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na nuhuobiiŋ, sɩ́ ba fá, a sɩ́ ba wʋbʋlaa ma fá. Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ ŋ hɛ chɛyɛɛ arɩ sɔpʋllʋŋ arɩ nʋɔmaa tʋɔŋ nɛ, ama sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ bɔyɛ joŋ ba wʋbʋlaa lɛ, sɩ́ ba fá. Jɩŋ arɩ ba ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ dagɩŋ ka sɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: and preach my message to them, whether they choose to listen or not.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ koo ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ, ʋ maga ŋ bʋl mɩ wɩaa a pɩba nɛ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na nuhuobiiŋ, jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ mɩ niiŋ vɩa a nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa mɩ niiŋ ŋɩɩ. Kɛŋ ŋ niiŋ suri a dii kʋ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩŋ.”

english_verse: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ a na nɩa nɩsɩŋ tɩɛna a chaasɛmɛ. Nɩsɩ-la tʋɔŋ teniŋ hɛ nɩmɛ,

english_verse: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_verse: ʋ kaa suri mɩ sɩpaaŋ. Teŋ-la sɛsɩŋ balɩa kala lɛ, ba ŋmʋnsɛ tʋɔ-chee wɩaa arɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ nɛ a hɛ.

english_verse: He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, chaŋ teniŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩŋ a vɔgɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ chaŋ teŋ-la ʋ sɩŋ woruŋ a nagɛ tʋʋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, I am sending you to your own people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, mʋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ a bʋl mɩ wɩaa a pɩba.

english_verse: They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩŋ tɩma tintee-bal nɩaa yikoro sɩ kpere koo a hɛɩ teeŋ, nɩalɩŋ wʋbʋlʋŋ ŋ sɩ bɩ nɩɩ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa paala tɩmɩŋ ba teeŋ ma, ba jaŋ jegile nɩɩ ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded,
translation_verse: Ama Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ ŋ teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ chɛ dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala ŋaa nyu-duo tɩmma arɩ tʋɔ-dol tɩmma nɛ.

english_verse: so I will make you as stubborn as they are.
translation_verse: Ama, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ ma kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ arɩ nyuduoŋ a nagɛba.

english_verse: Listen carefully to everything I say and then think about it.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, jegili woruŋ, aŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ bʋlaa pɩŋ a hɛ ŋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mʋ ŋ naambiiri-la sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ teeŋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla a pɩba. Bʋla pɩba, dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ koo ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ.”

english_verse: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩma jommi je, ka mɩ nɩɩ dɔmɔ kʋbala sɩ yʋga mɩ harɩŋ yikoro bʋl, má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩ-balɩŋ ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them.
translation_verse: Dɔmɔ-la fa ŋaa kɩalɩŋ sɩ weye kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ sɩɩ tɩɩgɛ dɔŋɔ dɔmɔ nɛ, gɩrɩŋgɩrɩmba-la ma sɩ hɛ ba sɛsɩŋ dʋdɔŋ. Dɔmɔ-la fa yʋga nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩma-la jommi je a kaa viiri, ka Wɩa doluŋ chaasa hɛ mɩ lɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ chei, mɩ baanɩŋ sii.

english_verse: When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me. The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ teeŋ, lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛl Abib, a kpagɛ Keba fuo-la. Mɩ kʋ hɛ ba teeŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ paala kperimi. Ɛzɩkɩɛl nɛ jaŋ pʋpɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa

english_verse: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa balɩpɛ-la chɛ-dɛrɩŋ, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, mɩ leŋe ŋ nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ pɔ leriŋ a bibeŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ŋɩɩ wɩaa jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ bʋl aŋ mʋ kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋla pɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ, ‘Ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ,’ ka dɩ ŋ vɩa dɩ ŋ kpʋrɩsɛ ʋ dɩgɩlaa dɩ ʋ leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ a laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ a tɩŋ ʋ wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa, dɩ ʋ nɛ saa sʋba, mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ ʋ sʋʋŋ wɩaa a kɛŋ ŋ baŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ kpʋrɩsɛ nɩbɔŋ-la dɩgɩlaa ka dɩ ʋ vɩa dɩ ʋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ wʋbɔmɔ-la lɛ, ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ, ama ŋ-na laa ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ suomo ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ mɩ joŋ wɩaa kɛrɛ ʋ wombiiŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ ʋ dɩgɩlaa kpʋrɩsa dɩ ʋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ. Ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ a tɩŋ ʋ wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa, mɩ bɩ jaŋ liisi ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Dɩ ʋ nɛ saa sʋba, mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ ʋ sʋʋŋ wɩaa a kɛŋ ŋ baŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent. Ezekiel Cannot Talk
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ kpʋrɩsɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-la dɩgɩlaa dɩ ʋ sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa, ʋ nɩɩ a bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ŋ ma laa ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ fa hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ lee-la, ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Sii tuu fuonaaŋ, mɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩŋ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sii a tuu fuonaa-la, nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ na La TƖƖNA tʋla arɩ mɩ fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ naʋ ŋɩɩ Keba fuo-la leriŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tuu tele chu.

english_verse: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩma-la kʋ jʋʋmɛ a kɛmmɛ chʋʋla kɩɩ mɩ naasɩŋ nyuŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mʋ a tɔ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ ŋ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: You will be tied up to keep you inside,
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na nuhuobiiŋ, ba jaŋ vɔbʋŋ arɩ ŋmɛsɩŋ a bil dɩ ŋ sɩ́ wuo lɩɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ nandelimiŋ jɩla mɛrɛ ŋ tilimiŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋ sɩ́ wuo kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa nɩa sɩ vɩa mɩ niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ bʋa dɔŋ nɛ kʋ yi, mɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩŋ, a bɩra suri ŋ niiŋ dɩ ŋ wuo bʋbʋl wɩaa, a bʋl wɩalɩŋ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla a pɩba. Nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ, ama dɔnsʋŋ ma bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa nɩa sɩ vɩa mɩ niiŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, joŋ tiebiiŋ a bil ŋ sɩpaaŋ a tuuri Jerusalɛm sɩ ŋaa tabal nagɩsɩŋ a hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then prepare to attack the brick as if it were a real city. Build a dirt mound and a ramp up to the top and surround the brick with enemy camps. On every side put large wooden poles as though you were going to break down the gate to the city.
translation_verse: Saa lusuŋ-chol sɩaa a tɩgɛ tiebii-la lɛ, a ŋaa leree a nagɛ laalɩyuoroo nɛ ŋmoo bugoo a gollu, a ŋaa doloo ma ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋmobu lo a golli ʋ kala.

english_verse: The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings.
translation_verse: Bɩrɩma chaasɛ laalɩyuoro-la sɩ golli Jerusalɛm, kɛŋ ŋ gɛrɩŋ nɩsɩŋ kuro ta dɩ ʋ jɩl aŋ bʋl wɩaa mɩ doluŋ lɛ a hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: I will tie you up, so you can't leave until your attack has ended.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ vɔbʋŋ arɩ ŋmɛsɩŋ a bil dɩ ŋ sɩ́ wuo bɩrɩmɛ, see dɩ ŋ yuo taŋ-la dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, ŋaa mɛmpɛ, mɩaa, suonoo, sinsuoŋ, mɩɩpʋlʋmaa arɩ bɔndaa, joŋ ba kala guoli dɔŋɔ gbaŋa lɛ a kaa ŋaa boroboro pɩ ŋ tɩtɩa. Boroboro-la nɛ ŋ jaŋ didii tapʋlaa zɔɔ-batori arɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ fii-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ pɩŋ ŋ nagʋa sɛmɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ bɩŋ-golimoo hɛ nyiniŋ a wasɛ boroboro-la nɩaa sɩɩŋ lɛ, a diiu arɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ dii mɩaa boroboro ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ dagɛ ŋɩɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ dii kʋdiile-la sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ tintee-wogusu-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ kɛmba pɩsa hɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Aɩ, La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, mɩ ha bɩ kʋdiilii kala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ die. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ ŋaa hambie a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ, mɩ ha bɩ kʋsʋʋ koo kʋŋ baga kʋŋ sɩ kpʋa chaŋa. Nammɩa kala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ ha bɩ mɩ niiŋ jʋa.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.
translation_verse: Wɩa bʋla pʋ, “Ʋ zɔmɔ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩra wasɛ ŋ boroboro-la nɛ-bɩnɩŋ lɛ aŋ leŋ bɩŋ-golimo-la.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Jerusalem will starve. They will have so little food and water that they will be afraid and hopeless.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Nuhuobiiŋ, mɩ jaŋ keri kʋdiilee fa sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ a jʋjʋʋ Jerusalɛm ta. Nɩalɩŋ jaŋ magɩsɛ kʋdiilee didii aŋ chɩl, a magɩsɛ lɩɩŋ ma nyʋnyʋa arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ.

english_verse: Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
translation_verse: Kʋdiilee arɩ lɩɩŋ jaŋ nyaa, dɩ ba kala yʋɔrɛ a tuo beŋ dɔŋɔ. Ba jaŋ na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, joŋ tokobiiŋ sɩ kɛŋ niiŋ a kaa fʋŋ ŋ nyu-pʋnaa arɩ ŋ tɔŋŋɔɔ. Joŋ sanɩa a magɩsɛ pʋna-la ŋ sɩ fʋma a kaa kpaa leree batori.

english_verse: After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
translation_verse: Dɩ tapʋlɩa-la ŋ sɩ golli tabal-la a yuyuo nɛ kʋ dɛrɛ, joŋ pʋna-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ nyɩgɛ tabal-la tʋɔŋ. Joŋ pʋna-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ma a kɛŋ tokobii-la ta kikeri aŋ gugolli tabal-la. Joŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ma yuo dɩ peliŋ kaa jaasɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ laalɩŋ kire to ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛ pʋna-la mʋa a gul ŋ gɛrɩŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
translation_verse: Bɩra lɩɩsɛ pʋna-la mʋa a joŋo yuo hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ dɩ ba dii. Nyiniŋ jaŋ lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ tɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala hɛ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Má bee na Jerusalɛm, mɩ joŋu a kɩɩ dʋnɩa kala tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ nɛ tinteyee chɩna gollu.

english_verse: But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
translation_verse: Ama a tɩŋ ʋ bɔnsʋŋ wɩaa, ʋ vɩa mɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga nɛ, a kɩɩ tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ gollu. Ʋ vɩa mɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile nɛ, a bɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga maa to.

english_verse: So tell the people of Jerusalem: I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ŋ nɛ paala hɛ wɩaa a kɩɩ tinteye-la sɩ golluŋ, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga arɩ mɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto to. Ŋ to tinteye-la sɩ golluŋ wʋŋaalaa nɛ.

english_verse: Now all those nations will watch as I turn against you and punish you
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: mɩ chɩŋ ŋ-na Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgʋsʋŋ tinteye-la kala sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ kɩsɛ tɔmɔ-la kala ŋ sɩ mɛ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ dɔgʋsʋŋ a magɛ ŋɩɩ mɩ ha sɩ bɩŋ dɔgɩsɔ magɛ, aŋ maachie kala bɩra bɩ jaŋ dɔgʋsʋŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm, ŋ lɛ nyɩmmaba jaŋ chaŋ ba biiriŋ, dɩ biiriŋ ma chɩchaŋ ba nyɩmmaba. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgʋsʋŋ, aŋ kɛŋ ŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka kaa pɩsa hɛ lee-kala.

english_verse: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ-na ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ ŋmɩɛsa nɛ, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋkɩsɩa-la a kɛŋ tɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ ŋaa disiŋ kɩa kʋ jʋʋ mɩ dɩa a leŋ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ, mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ ŋ lɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ fá ŋ nenige, mɩ jaŋ dɔgʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
translation_verse: Nyanyalaa arɩ losuŋ jaŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ hɛ ŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ kpʋ dɔnsʋŋ ma laalɩŋ lɛ taŋ-la harɩŋ, ka mɩ kɛŋ ba dɔnsʋŋ ma pɩsɛ lee-kala, aŋ kire to ba harɩŋ arɩ laalɩŋ.

english_verse: You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord, was furious because of your disobedience.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ baanɩŋ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ, baaŋ-la mɩ sɩ faasa na ŋ nyuŋ ka dɩ mɩ yaraa pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala ŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ-na ŋ TƖƖNA yaraa nɛ biere, mɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba.

english_verse: will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ ŋaa mɔmɩɩ, dɩ nɩaa bʋl wɩaa sisii ŋ baanɩŋ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ faasa na baanɩŋ a dɔgʋsʋŋ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ ŋaa chagɩlɩna a pɩ tinteye-la sɩ golluŋ, dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba dɩ ba hirigi. Mɩ-na ŋ TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I will destroy your crops until you starve to death, and disasters will strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ losuŋ bɔmʋŋ yagɛ Jerusalɛm a nagɛ to-hɛmɩŋ, dɩ ʋ cheima. Mɩ jaŋ keri ma kʋdiilee ta dɩ losuŋ jʋjʋʋma bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ losuŋ arɩ baga kɩaa hɛ ma lɛ, dɩ ba kpʋ ma biiriŋ kala. Nyanyalaa arɩ yuosuŋ arɩ laalɩŋ ma jaŋ diima. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ, ʋ sɩ:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, joŋ ŋ sɩaa chaasɛ Iziral peelee a bʋl wɩaa deemba mɩ doluŋ lɛ a hɛ ba lɛ:

english_verse: Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped.
translation_verse: Iziral peelee, má jegile nɩɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ wɩaa. Ŋ-la nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bʋlaa pɩ peelee arɩ dundolluŋ arɩ fuonaa-luŋoo arɩ fuonaasɩŋ, mɩɩ chɛ mɩ kɛŋ laalɩŋ kʋ hɛ ma lɛ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ chei ma vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa kala.

english_verse: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋmoo ma vʋɩyaa korunuŋ kala lo, a yɛrɛ ma kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ korunuŋ a kpʋ ma vʋɩ-kpaaraa ba tɔŋŋɔɔ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Dead bodies and bones will be lying around the idols and the altars.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋsʋʋnʋŋ pɩsa bil ba tɔŋŋɔɔ sɩpaaŋ, a kɛŋ ba haŋgbelee ma pɩsa golli ba korunuŋ.

english_verse: Every town in Israel will be destroyed to make sure that each shrine, idol, and altar is smashed—everything the Israelites made will be a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Ma tasɩŋ kala jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeniŋ, dɩ ma vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa kala tele pɩŋ, dɩ ma tɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ma vʋɩyaa korunuŋ kala yɛrɛ pɩŋ muno muno. Ma kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ korunuŋ jaŋ pɩsɛ, dɩ kʋŋkala ma sɩ ŋaa lɛl.

english_verse: All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kpʋ ma nɩaa dɩ ba sʋʋ pɩŋ lee-kala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations,
translation_verse: Ama, mɩ jaŋ leŋ ma dɔnsʋŋ, laalɩŋ bɩ jaŋ kpʋma, aŋ kɛmma pɩsa hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ dɔnsʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: where they will be prisoners. And when they think of me, they will realize that they disgraced me by rebelling and by worshiping idols. They will hate themselves for the evil things they did,
translation_verse: Tinteye-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ kɛsɛba mʋ dɩ ba hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ, ba jaŋ liisi ŋɩɩ ba sɩ ŋaa mɩ tʋɔŋ chei a tɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ a joŋ harɩŋ yɩamɛ a cho vʋɩyaa. Ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ lɩɩ ba tɩtɩa a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la arɩ wʋkɩsɩa-la kala ba sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA, mɩ sɩ kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa arɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ ba lɛ, ŋɩɩ bɩ pɛɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra sɩ, “Porisi ŋ nɩsaa, a yagɛ ŋ naasɩŋ, aŋ yel ‘Ou’ a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la arɩ wʋkɩsɩa-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Ba dɔnsʋŋ jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, ka dɩ losuŋ arɩ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ ma kpʋ ba dɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dɩ-bolii, nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kpʋba, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kpaga ma jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ka a bɩ sʋba, losuŋ jaŋ kpʋba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ a fɩɩsɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Sʋʋnʋŋ jaŋ jaasa pɩŋ ba tɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ba korunuŋ, ba dundolluŋ arɩ ba peelee nyuŋ, tɩɩ-lugunuŋ arɩ tɩɩ-balaa bʋbʋɔŋ arɩ lere-la kala ba sɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma pɩpɩ ba tɔŋŋɔɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.

english_verse: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nɩsɩŋ liesi ba tinteeŋ lee na-kala ba sɩ hɛ a cheyu dɩ ʋ pɩŋ hoi a chɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ a kaa mʋ yi lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Dibila. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ, ʋ sɩ:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋlaa tɩgɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Ma tinteeŋ kala cheyiŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ fá ma nenige koo a lemma. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma a tiŋ ma wʋŋaalaa arɩ wʋkɩsɩa-la ma sɩ ŋaa chɩmɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: There's never been anything like the coming disaster.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra sɩ, “Wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ jaŋ kɔ ma lɛ a lɩɩ aŋ ka pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: And when it comes, your life will be over.
translation_verse: Ma dɩdɛrɩŋ kɔ nɛ, ʋ kɔ nɛ a chɩna gbɛrɛma, ʋ kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You people of Israel are doomed! Soon there will be panic on the mountaintops instead of celebration.
translation_verse: Cheeriŋ puu ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ nɛ. Bʋa-la yie nɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la kpaga nɛ, nɩaa ka chel nɛ, tʋɔtɔrʋŋ bɩra tuo ba peelee nyuŋ.

english_verse: I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni, mɩ jaŋ faasa na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ dii ma sarɩya a dɔgɩsɛma a mʋ tɩgɛ ma wʋŋaalaa arɩ wʋkɩsɩa-la kala ma sɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ fá ma nenige koo a lemma. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma a tiŋ ma wʋŋaalaa arɩ wʋkɩsɩa-la ma sɩ ŋaa chɩmɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ dɔgɩsɛma.

english_verse: and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered.
translation_verse: Doluŋ diiniŋ paala pʋrɩgɛ nɛ a nagɛ toŋguluŋ sɩ je dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ. Nɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ ka, nɩ-daŋ-la, ba dʋa arɩ ba kʋŋkala ma sɩ kɛŋ yuŋuŋ.

english_verse: A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel. Israel Is Surrounded The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋʋ banyile nɛ a nyɩgɩlɛ, ama nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ mʋ laalɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ na baanɩŋ nɛ nɩ-daŋ-la kala nyuŋ.

english_verse: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Laalɩŋ jaŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ jeeŋ harɩŋ, ka dɩ losuŋ arɩ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ ma kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ka a bɩ sʋba jaŋ fá jɩla hɛ peelee nyuŋ a yiyel a nagɛ kokosuŋ sɩ hɛ fuonaaŋ lɛ, a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.
translation_verse: Ba nɩsaa jaŋ ŋaa gbɛlɛɛ, dɩ ba naadʋsʋŋ kala chichel.

english_verse: You will put on sackcloth to show your sorrow, but terror will overpower you. Shame will be written all over your faces, and you will shave your heads in despair.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ chaasa jʋʋba. Hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ jʋʋba, ba jaŋ fʋŋ ba nyusuŋ.

english_verse: Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ joŋ ba hɔpʋla yuo ta womporunuŋ lɛ, ba sɛlɩmɛ jaŋ ŋaa kʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ a pɩba. Ba sɛlɩmɛ arɩ ba hɔpʋla bɩ jaŋ wuo laaba ta tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ. Kɩalɩŋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba vɔgɛ, ba nɛ fa leŋe ba ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ.

english_verse: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
translation_verse: Ba fa kɛŋ ba yaraa kpɩɛraa ŋmuŋmoo bɔyɛ nɛ, a kɛmba ŋaa tɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ ŋaa disiŋ kɩa arɩ vesiŋ mɩ sɩɩ kɩsʋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ bɩrɩmɛ kɩaa sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩaba, dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ chei lee-la mɩ sɩ cho a leŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ, gaaraa jaŋ kʋ jʋʋ lee-la a ŋaa dɩ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel,
translation_verse: Ba libi chɔrʋmɔɔ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa vɔɔ nɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩaa kpʋnʋŋ su ba tintee-la kala nɛ, ba tasɩŋ ma su arɩ yuosuŋ.

english_verse: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tintee-la nɩaa sɩ chaasa bɔŋ a kʋ hɛ ba lɛ dɩ ba laa ba dɩɩsɩŋ. Ba nɩduoruŋ babii-ballɩŋ kala jaŋ dɛrɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ leŋe dɩ tinteye-la ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ lere-la ba sɩɩ kpaarɛ ba vesiŋ.

english_verse: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.
translation_verse: Dɩ fawʋllʋŋ nɛ chaasa jʋʋba, ba jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ba hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ, ama ba bɩ jaŋ na.

english_verse: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.
translation_verse: Wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ jaŋ jʋʋba a lɩɩ aŋ ka pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ, dɩ ba nɩnɩɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bʋa na-kala lɛ. Ba jaŋ sʋl mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa dɩ ba dagɛba wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩɩ dagɛ nɩaa wombii-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, nɩhɩasɩŋ ma bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ dagɛba.

english_verse: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Kuoro jaŋ yel, dɩ ʋ sɩpaalaaraa ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala vʋgʋmɛ, dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ dɩ ba chichel. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋaa wɩaa, a nagɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ dɔgɩsɛ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me,
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ jɩ-dʋ tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-dʋ tapʋl-nɔŋ chɛɛŋ, mɩ dɩ Juda nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa hɔŋ mɩ dɩa lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ doluŋ kʋ jʋʋmɛ.

english_verse: and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ a na kʋŋ sɩ nagɛ nuhuobiine. A chɩŋ ʋ tɩŋa kaa tuu nagɛ nyiniŋ, nyuŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ma chaasa fɩɛsɛ a nagɛ hɔɔŋ sɩ hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ.

english_verse: It reached out what seemed to be a hand and grabbed my hair. Then in my vision the Lord's Spirit lifted me into the sky and carried me to Jerusalem. The Spirit took me to the north gate of the temple's inner courtyard, where there was an idol that disgusted the Lord and made him furious.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ kʋŋ sɩ nagɛ nɩsɩŋ tɩɛnɛ a kɛŋ mɩ nyu-pʋnaa lɛ a kɛmmɛ joŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ sɩ nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ, Wɩa Dɩma jommi kaa jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ a kɛmmɛ mʋ Jerusalɛm. Ʋ sɩ kɛmmɛ mʋ nɩmɛ, ʋ kɛmmɛ mʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ kaala-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa boi-baalɩŋ lɛ, lee-la tɔŋ kʋbala fa sɩ chɩna, La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ chaasa sisii ʋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ na Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa tʋla, a nagɛ kʋ-la mɩ fa sɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ dɩ mɩ hɛ Keba fuo-la leriŋ.

english_verse: God said to me, “Ezekiel, son of man, look north.” And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa fa bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, beŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ.” Mɩ sɩ bene, mɩ na dɩ tɔŋ-la fa sɩ leŋe La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ sii chɩna kpagɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa boi-baal-la niiŋ.

english_verse: God then said, “Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, ŋ na wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa nɛɛ? Bee na wʋkɩsɩa-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ ŋaa daha, wɩalɩŋ sɩ kiri mɩ tɩta mɩ dɩa lɛ. Ama ŋ ha jaŋ na wʋkɩsaa a kɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ.”

english_verse: Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛmmɛ kaa mʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kaala boiŋ niiŋ, mɩ beŋ a na bʋa jeeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, luri bʋa jeeŋ lɛ.” Mɩ luri jee-la a na boiŋ niiŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: “Go in,” God said, “and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, “To boi-nii-la jʋʋ a na wʋbɔmɔ-la arɩ wʋkɩsɩa-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jʋʋ a na dɩ ba tuuri kɩalɩŋ sɩɩ vaamɛ tinteeŋ arɩ pʋsʋ-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ a hɛ jee kala lɛ, a pɛ tɔmɔ-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ kpaarʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii hɛ nɩmɛ a pɛ Safaŋ nanʋala Jazanɩa lɛ. Sɩpaalaara-la kʋŋkala fa kori kʋ-la ba sɩ kaa nyɩnyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ nɛ, ka nyʋɔsʋŋ sisii kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma lɛ.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩa pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, ŋ na Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa sɩɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛɛ? Nʋʋkala hɛ ʋ vʋɩyaa dɩa lɛ nɛ. Ba yie bʋl, ‘La TƖƖNA bɩ laa na, ʋ vɩa la tinteeŋ ta nɛ.’

english_verse: But I will show you something even worse than this.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra sɩ, ‘Ŋ ha jaŋ na wʋkɩsɩa-la dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ ŋaa sɩ paala kɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ.’ ”

english_verse: He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛmmɛ kɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa boi-baalɩŋ, mɩ na haalaa dɩ ba hɔnɔ a yiyel vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tamus sɩ sʋba wɩaa.

english_verse: God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, ŋ na wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛɛ? Ŋ ha jaŋ na wʋkɩsaa sɩ kɩɩ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, ŋ na wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛɛ? Ʋ bɩ wʋbie ŋaa Juda doho nɩaa sɩ ŋaa wʋkɩsaa deemba daha. Ʋ maga dɩ ba leŋ dɩ yuosuŋ su tintee-la nɛ a leŋ dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ sisii? Bee na ba sɩ paa daa-biisiŋ jɩjɩl ba mɩɩsɩŋ a chichesi vʋɩ-kpaaraa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish them without mercy and refuse to help them when they cry out to me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ dagɛba arɩ baanɩŋ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ fá ba nenige koo a lemba. Ba jaŋ faasa suri ba yikoro a sʋsʋlmɛ, ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ jegili ba teeŋ.”

english_verse: After that, I heard the Lord shout, “Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ La TƖƖNA faasa kpɩa, “Má kɔ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ tabal-la nɩaa, nʋʋkala kori ʋ bayuori kɩaa.”

english_verse: I saw six men come through the north gate of the temple, each one holding a deadly weapon. A seventh man dressed in a linen robe was with them, and he was carrying things to write with. The men went into the temple and stood by the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na baalaa balɩdʋ dɩ ba lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa boi-baala-la sɩ hɛ nyuŋ dɩɩrɩŋ kʋkɔ, ba kʋŋkala kori bayuori kʋŋ nɛ. Ba tʋɔŋ, baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ a laalɛ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ gɛrɩŋ, ka kʋŋ ba sɩ kaa ŋmʋŋmʋnsɛ kɩaa hɛ ʋ sɛmɛ. Ba kɔ a chɩŋ kɔlɩɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɛmɛ.

english_verse: The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa tʋla lɩɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ lɛ a jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ, lee-la ba fa sɩ chɩna, a mʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ nii-jʋʋlʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɛ baal-la sɩ laalɛ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ gɛrɩŋ, ka kʋ-la ba sɩ kaa ŋmʋŋmʋnsɛ kɩaa hɛ ʋ sɛmɛ,

english_verse: “Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.”
translation_verse: a bʋla pʋ, “Gɔllɛ Jerusalɛm tabal-la lɛ a tuuri magɩlɩŋ hɛ nɩaa tilliŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ sɩ cheye ba yiyel a tɩŋ wʋkɩsɩa-la kala nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa taŋ-la lɛ wɩaa.”
