english_verse: So I solemnly swore that I would scatter the people of Israel across the nations,
translation_verse: Mɩ fa chaasa ŋmɩɛsa pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, arɩ mɩ jaŋ kɛmba kaa pɩsa hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ,

english_verse: because they had disobeyed my laws and ignored my teachings; they had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped the idols their ancestors had made.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ mɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile to. Ba fa vɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga nɛ aŋ chei mɩ chɛ-wiesii-la, a kpʋkpaarɛ tɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa ba naabalɩmaba fa sɩɩ kpaarʋ.

english_verse: and I let them offer me unacceptable sacrifices, including their first-born sons. I did this to horrify them and to let them know that I, the Lord, was punishing them.
translation_verse: Mɩ leŋe ba kɛsɛ ba hambolibii bumbumba fa sɩ maga dɩ ba joŋo pɩmɛ nɛ a kpʋ nyɩga pɩ vesiŋ a chei ba tɩtɩa. Mɩ fa ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ mɩ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ hɛ ba lɛ dɩ ba jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.’

english_verse: by offering sacrifices, incense, and wine to gods on every hill and under every large tree. I was very angry, because they did these things in the land I had given them!
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛmba kʋ jʋʋ tintee-la mɩ fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩba, dɩ ba nɛ na dundolo kala koo tɩɩ-lugu kala nɩmɛ, ba yie kpʋkpaarɛ vʋɩyaa nɩmɛ nɛ. Ba yie joŋ kɩaa pɩpɩba, a nyɩnyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma a ŋaa kʋnyʋalaa pɩpɩba a ŋaa mɩ baanɩŋ sii.

english_verse: I asked them where they went to worship those gods, and they answered, “At the local shrines.” And those places of worship are still called shrines.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩɛsɛba: Vesiŋ dɩ-kpaarɩ-la ŋaa bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ma mʋmʋ nɩmɛ?’ La TƖƖNA jaŋ dii Iziral tɩŋŋaa sarɩya aŋ kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ ba tinteeŋ

english_verse: by worshiping idols and by sacrificing their own children as offerings. They commit these sins and still think they can ask me for a message. As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will give them no answer.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kɛsɛ ma hambolibii bumbumba fa sɩ maga dɩ ma joŋo pɩmɛ, a kpʋ a nyɩga pɩpɩ vesiŋ, ʋ ŋɩɩ kala ŋaa disiniŋ nɛ ma ŋaa hɩhɛ ma tɩtɩa lɛ a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ. Iziral tɩmma, ʋ maga dɩ mɩ leŋ ma pɩɛsɛmɛ na wɩɩ nɛɛ? Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ ŋmɩɛsa, mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma pɩɛsɛmɛ na wɩɩkala.’

english_verse: They may think they can be like other nations and get away with worshiping idols made of wood and stone. But that will never happen! The Lord Promises To Restore Israel The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Ma sɩ, ‘La ma cho la nagɛ tinteye-la dɔnsʋŋ nɩaa nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ a kpʋkpaarɛ tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ tabɩaa.’ Ama wɩɩ-la ma sɩ bɩɩna bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ ŋaa.

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will rule over you with my powerful arm. You will feel my fierce anger
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ ŋmɩɛsa: Mɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ a bemma arɩ mɩ dol-balɩŋ.

english_verse: and lead you into a desert surrounded by nations. I will meet you there face to face. Then I will pass judgment on you
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛmma kɔ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la tinteyee sɩ gollo chu, dɩ la joŋ sɩaa chaasɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ mɩ dɔgɩsɛma.

english_verse: and punish you, just as I punished your ancestors in the desert near Egypt.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩ dɔgɩsɛ ma naabalɩmaba Ijipiti tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ ma ma. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I will force each of you to obey the regulations of our solemn agreement.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma kʋŋkala to nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ.

english_verse: I will separate the sinful rebels from the rest of you, and even though I will bring them from the nations where they live in exile, they won't be allowed to return to Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ tʋɔsɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩamɛ aŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba kaa lɩɩ tinteye-la ba sɩ hɔnɔ lɛ, ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba jʋʋ Iziral tinteeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Go ahead and worship your idols for now, you Israelites, because soon I will no longer let you dishonor me by offering gifts to them. You will have no choice but to obey me!
translation_verse: Ma-na Iziral tɩmma, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má-na kʋŋkala mʋ a kpʋkpaarɛ ma tɔŋŋɔɔ. Ama mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ma jaŋ to mɩ niiŋ, ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋ kɩaa kpʋkpaarɛ vʋɩyaa a chei mɩ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la.

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone in Israel will worship me on Mount Zion, my holy mountain in Jerusalem. I will once again call you my own, and I will accept your sacred offerings and sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla, dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ Iziral lɛ jaŋ chʋɔlɛmɛ Zaayɔŋ peel-la nyuŋ, mɩ peel-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Mɩ jaŋ bɩra kɛmma a yɩrɛ mɩ nɩaa. Nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ laa ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa arɩ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋ-la kala sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: When I bring you home from the places where you are now scattered, I will be pleased with you, just as I am pleased with the smell of the smoke from your sacrifices. Every nation on earth will see that I am holy,
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛmma mɩɩra lɩɩ lere-la ma sɩ pɩsa hɛ lɛɛlɛ a kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ, mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ, arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɛ pʋsʋ-la ma sɩ yie kpʋ nyɩga pɩmɛ ba sʋɔra sɩŋ mɩ teeŋ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ mɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ma tʋɔŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala na.

english_verse: and you will know that I, the Lord, am the one who brought you back to Israel, the land I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛmma mɩɩra kɔ Iziral tinteeŋ, lee-la mɩ fa sɩ chaasa ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩ ma naabalɩmaba, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Then you will remember your wicked sins, and you will hate yourselves for doing such horrible things. They have made you unacceptable to me,
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ ma jaŋ liisi wɩalɩŋ kala ma fa sɩ ŋaa a joŋ disiniŋ hɛ ma tɩtɩa lɛ, dɩ ma tʋɔŋ lɩɩ ma tɩtɩa a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala ma sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: so you deserve to be punished. But I will treat you in a way that will bring honor to my name, and you will know that I am the Lord God. Fire from the South
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA: Dɩ mɩ nɛ tɩŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ wɩaa a kɛmma woruŋ, a bɩ ma nɩbɔŋ wʋŋaalaa arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa chɩmɩŋ joŋo tiŋ ma lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.” Wɩalɩŋ Ɛzɩkɩɛl sɩ bʋla Wɩa doluŋ lɛ a hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ lɛ

english_verse: that I, the Lord God, will start a fire that will burn up every tree, whether green or dry. Nothing will be able to put out the blaze of that fire as it spreads to the north and burns everything in its path.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ duu-la, ‘Jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla. Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ nyɩgɩŋ nɛ. Nyiniŋ jaŋ dii ŋ tɩɩsɩŋ kala, tɩɩ-laarɩŋ arɩ tɩɩ-hɩlaa. Kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩsɛ nyiŋgel-la. Ʋ jaŋ lieri kʋŋ na-kala sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa.

english_verse: Everyone will know that I started it, and that it cannot be stopped.”
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala jaŋ na dɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ nyɩga, nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩsʋ.’ ”

english_verse: But I complained, “Lord God, I don't want to do that! People already say I confuse them with my messages.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Ou, La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, baa bʋl mɩ wɩaa nɛ, ba sɩ, ‘Namagaba dee ʋ ta mɩmagɛɛ?’ ”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the places in Jerusalem where people worship. Warn everyone in Israel
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, joŋ ŋ sɩaa chaasɛ Jerusalɛm a bʋl wɩaa mɩ doluŋ lɛ a hɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ dɛnnɛmɛ lɛ. Bʋl wɩaa mɩ doluŋ lɛ a hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: that I am about to punish them. I will pull out my sword and have it ready to kill everyone, whether good or evil.
translation_verse: Bʋla pʋ, ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ ŋaa ŋ dʋndɔŋ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ mɩ tokobiiŋ ʋ pɛɛŋ lɛ a kpʋ ŋ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa arɩ ŋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kala.

english_verse: Ezekiel, groan in sorrow and despair so that everyone can hear you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nuhuobiiŋ, huuni! Huuni ba sɩpaaŋ a nagɛ hɛɛŋ sɩ jʋʋ nʋʋ, ʋ tʋɔŋ faasa chei.

english_verse: When they ask why you are groaning, tell them you have terrifying news that will make them faint and tremble in fear and lose all courage. These things will happen soon. I, the Lord God, make this promise! A Sword Is Ready To Attack Israel
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ pɩɛsɩŋ, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ huhuuni?’ Bʋla pɩba, ‘Wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kɔ nɛ tɩɩ. Nʋʋkala tʋɔŋ jaŋ faasa chei, dɩ nʋʋkala nɩsaa ŋaa gbɛlɛɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ, dɩ fawʋllʋŋ jʋʋ nʋʋkala dɩ ba naadʋsʋŋ chichel.’ Wɩɩ-la ka kɔ nɛ, ʋ sɛnɛ jaŋ ŋaa, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Jerusalem: I have sharpened my sword to slaughter you; it is shiny and will flash like lightning! Don't celebrate— punishment is coming, because everyone has ignored my warnings.
translation_verse: Ba taaʋ nɛ dɩ ba kaa kpʋ nɩaa, ʋ tʋtʋl a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩɩ lɩgɩsʋ.’ La jaŋ wuo jʋɔsɛ mɩ nanʋala Juda kuoru dantɩga wɩaa? Tokobii-la bee gʋʋnɛ daa-doho-la nɛ.

english_verse: Groan in sorrow, Ezekiel; the sword is drawn against my people and their leaders. They will die! So give up all hope.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ, ŋmoo niiŋ a yel, mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ ba sɩpaalaaraa nyuŋ nɛ tokobii-la kʋkɔ. Baa chɛ dɩ ba kpʋba nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa paa ŋ nɩsaa chʋŋ ŋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I am testing my people, and they can do nothing to stop me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ magɩsɛ mɩ nɩaa nɛ, dɩ ba nɛ vɩa ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa ba lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Ezekiel, warn my people, then celebrate my victory by clapping your hands. My vicious sword will attack again and again, killing my people with every stroke.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nuhuobiiŋ, bʋl wɩaa mɩ doluŋ lɛ aŋ porisi nɩsaa. Leŋ dɩ tokobiiŋ viisi bʋlɩa koo butori. Ʋ ŋaa nɩ-kpʋʋrɩ tokobii nɛ, ʋ jaŋ kpʋ nɩaa yʋgɛ, ʋ tɔba hɛ nɛ sɛmɛ na-kala,

english_verse: They will lose all courage and stumble with fear. My slaughtering sword is waiting at every gate, flashing and ready to kill.
translation_verse: dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ba nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ, dɩ nɩaa sʋʋ yʋgɛ. Mɩ leŋe ba kɛŋ tokobiiŋ chɩŋ ba boi-baalaa lɛ nɛ dɩ ba kpʋ nɩaa. Ʋʋ tʋl nɛ a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩɩ lɩgɩsʋ, ba koru nɛ dɩ ba kaa kpʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: It will slash right and left, wherever the blade is pointed.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛŋ tokobii-la viisi nadiiŋ arɩ nagʋa kala, lee na-kala ʋ niiŋ sɩ chaasa.

english_verse: Then I will stop being angry, and I will clap my hands in victory. I, the Lord, have spoken. The King of Babylonia and His Sword
translation_verse: Mɩ ma jaŋ porisi mɩ nɩsaa, ka dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, mark two roads for the king of Babylonia to follow when he comes with his sword. The roads will begin at the same place, but be sure to put up a signpost where the two roads separate and go in different directions.
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, bil wombiee balɩa dɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro kori ʋ tokobiiŋ to nɩmɛ kɔ. Leŋ dɩ wombie-la kala suomi tintee-bala lɛ. Bil kɩaa sɩ ŋaa magɩl wɛŋ-chɛŋŋɛɛ lɛ a dagɛ wɛŋ-la sɩ gɛbɛ jʋjʋʋ tabal-la.

english_verse: Clearly mark where the two roads lead. One goes to Rabbah, the capital of Ammon, and the other goes to Jerusalem, the fortified capital of Judah.
translation_verse: Bɩra magɩlɛ wombii-la dɔŋɔ tokobii-la sɩ jaŋ to mʋ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Raba, aŋ magɩlɛ wombii-la dɔŋɔ ma sɩɩ mʋ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm tabal-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli.

english_verse: When the Babylonian king stands at that signpost, he will decide which way to go by shaking his arrows, by asking his idols, and by carefully looking at the liver of a sacrificed animal.
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ kuoro jaŋ kʋ chɩŋ magɩla-la sɩ hɛ wɛŋ-chɛŋŋɛ-la lɛ, aŋ bee joŋ wombii-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ to. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ vʋgɛ, a pɩɛsɛ ʋ tɔŋŋɔɔ, aŋ beŋ vʋɩŋ pʋna chʋɩŋ lɛ a jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: His right hand will pull out the arrow marked “Jerusalem.” Then he will immediately give the signal to shout the battle cry, to build dirt ramps up to the top of the city walls, to break down its walls and gates with large wooden poles, and to kill the people.
translation_verse: To-hɛŋ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ kaa tɔnsɔ lɩɩsɛ Jerusalɛm. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ ŋaa laalɩyuori goŋ, a pa wombiiŋ dɩ ba kpʋ nɩaa, a ŋaa doloo ma ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋmoo boi-baalaa lo, aŋ saa lusuŋ-chol-sɩaa a tɩgɛ jebii-la lɛ, a paa kɩaa bil dɩ ba sii je dɩ ba chɩŋ ba lɛ aŋ bibeŋ taŋ-la kala.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem had promised to be loyal to Babylonia, and so none of them will believe that this could happen to them. But Babylonia's king will remind them of their sinful ways and warn them of their coming captivity.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ bɩ jaŋ laa wɩɩŋ deeŋ dii, a tɩŋ nii-la ba dɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro sɩ pɛ wɩaa. Ama Babɩlɔŋ kuoro jaŋ liisiba wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa chei, aŋ yuo kɛsɛba.

english_verse: Ezekiel, tell the people of Jerusalem and their ruler that I, the Lord God, am saying: Everything you do is wicked and shows how sinful you are. You are guilty and will be taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɩɩ dɩ-jalɩŋ nɛ. Nʋʋkala jɩŋ ma wʋcheelee nɛ. Ma wʋŋaalaa daga arɩ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaara nɛ. A tɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa ŋ-la, ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ yuo kɛsɛma.

english_verse: And now, you evil and wicked ruler of Israel, your day of final punishment is almost here.
translation_verse: Iziral kuoro, ŋ ŋaa nɩbɔŋ nɛ a kɛŋ disiniŋ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ dɔgʋsʋŋ yie nɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, command you to take off your royal turban and your crown, because everything will be different. Those who had no power will be put in charge, and those who now rule will become nobodies.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩɩ bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: Puri ŋ nyu-bɛlɛ aŋ suri ŋ kuoru nyunchuulo. Wɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ ba fa sɩ naga. Nɩbiisiŋ jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ nɩbalaa aŋ ka dɩ nɩbalaa ma bɩrɩmɛ nɩbiisiŋ.

english_verse: I will leave Jerusalem in complete ruins like no one has ever seen until my chosen one comes to punish this city. Judgment against Ammon
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, ʋ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ deeŋ deeŋ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩʋ sɩ jaŋ kɔ, dɩ mɩ joŋo hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.’

english_verse: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, the Ammonites have insulted Israel, so condemn them and tell them I am saying: A sword is drawn, ready to slaughter; it is polished and prepared to kill as fast as lightning.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ, bʋl wɩaa mɩ doluŋ lɛ, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ Amɔŋ tɩmma-la sɩɩ tʋʋsɛ Iziral joŋoo lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Tokobiiŋ, tokobiiŋ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba kaa kpʋ nɩaa. Ba chɛsʋ nɛ ʋ tʋtʋl a lɩlɩgɩsɛ a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩɩ lɩgɩsʋ.

english_verse: You wicked Ammonites see false visions and believe untrue messages. But your day of punishment is coming soon, and my sword will slaughter you!
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ vʋga na a tɩgɛ ma lɛ kaa tɩŋ. Ba ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ. Ma ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma yie nɛ. Tokobiiŋ nɛ ba jaŋ kaa keri ma baŋŋaa.

english_verse: Your days to punish others are over, so put your swords away. You will be punished in the land of your birth.
translation_verse: Joŋ tokobiiŋ hɛ ʋ pɛɛŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dii ma sarɩya tintee-la lɛ ba sɩ lʋlma, tintee-la ma naabalɩmaba sɩ lɩa lɛ.

english_verse: My furious anger will scorch you like fire, and I will hand you over to cruel men who are experts in killing.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ, mɩ baanɩŋ jaŋ sii ma nyuŋ a nagɛ nyiniŋ. Mɩ jaŋ jomma hɛ ma dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ bɔmɔ kɩŋkɛŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ nɩaa kpʋnʋŋ jɩma.

english_verse: You will be burned and will die in your own land. Then you will be forgotten forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Nyiniŋ jaŋ diima, ma chalɩŋ jaŋ jaasɛ ma tɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ liisi ma wɩaa a kaa mʋ wuu, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.’ ”

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa pɩɛsɛmɛ:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, are you ready to condemn Jerusalem? That city is filled with murderers, so remind the people of their sins
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ, ŋ jaŋ dii Jerusalɛm sarɩyaa? Ŋ jaŋ dii tabalɩŋ deeŋ sɩ suo arɩ nɩkpʋʋraa sarɩyaa? Ŋɩɩ-na leŋ dɩ ʋ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ kɩsʋ ka ʋ ŋaa.

english_verse: and tell them I am saying: Jerusalem, you have murdered many of your own people and have worshiped idols. You will soon be punished!
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ Jerusalɛm tabal-la, “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ŋ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ kpʋ ŋ tɩtɩa nɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ, aŋ mɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Those crimes have made you guilty, and the idols have made you unacceptable to me. So your final punishment is near. Other nations will laugh at you and make insulting remarks,
translation_verse: Ŋ laa cheeriŋ nɛ, a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ kpʋa arɩ tɔmɔ-la ŋ sɩ mɛ a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ wɩaa. Ŋ tapʋlaa kpagɛ dɛrɩŋ nɛ, ŋ jɩsɩŋ ma dɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa sieri ŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋ ŋaa mɔmɩɩ tinteyee kala lɛ.

english_verse: None of you honor your parents, and you cheat foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Ŋ lɛ nɛ ba bɩ nyɩmmaba arɩ naamba ka zil. Ba nyagɛ nʋhʋɔra-la sɩ hɔŋ ŋ lɛ bil nɛ, aŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛ biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa.

english_verse: You show no respect for my sacred places and treat the Sabbath just like any other day.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ka zil, a bɩ mɩ chɛ-wiesii-la ma ka to.

english_verse: Some of your own people tell lies, so that others will be put to death. Some of you eat meat sacrificed to idols at local shrines, and others never stop doing vulgar things.
translation_verse: Ŋ lɛ nɛ wʋnyɩɛraa hɛ, a nyɩɛ wɩaa pɩ nɩaa ba kpʋkpʋba. Ŋ lɛ nɛ nɩaa didii vʋɩyaa kʋdiilee peeliŋ nyuŋ, a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ.

english_verse: Men have sex with their father's wife or with women who are having their monthly period
translation_verse: Ŋ lɛ nɛ baalaa kɛŋ ba nyɩmmaba haalaa pɩpɩŋ. Haala yie hɛ tɩŋa a kɛŋ disiniŋ, ka ma dɔnsʋŋ joŋ doluŋ a kɛnʋ pɩŋ.

english_verse: Others of you accept money to murder someone. Your own people charge high interest when making a loan to other Israelites, and they get rich by cheating. Worst of all, you have forgotten me, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ŋ lɛ yie laa kpalaa aŋ kpʋ nɩaa. Ba yie joŋ kɩaa chɩŋ nɩaa aŋ chɩchɛ nyʋʋrʋŋ yʋgɛ, aŋ gʋrɛ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ a kuori. Ma yʋ mɩ wɩaa nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I will shake my fist in anger at your violent crimes.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ a gulimi nɩsaa tuu ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ gɩrɩma laa nɩaa kɩaa arɩ nɩkpʋʋra-la sɩ hɛ tabal-la lɛ.

english_verse: When I'm finished with you, your courage will disappear, and you will be so weak that you won't be able to lift your hands. I, the Lord, have spoken and will not change my mind.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ wuo kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ a nyalɩmɛ koo a kɛŋ doluŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa ma lɛɛ? Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ pɩɛsa, mɩ saa jaŋ ŋaa ma.

english_verse: I will scatter you throughout every nation on earth and put a stop to your sinful ways.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛmma pɩsa hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma disiŋ wɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: You will be humiliated in the eyes of other nations. Then you will know that I, the Lord God, have done these things. Jerusalem Must Be Purified
translation_verse: Dɩ tinteyee nɩaa nɛ hɩɩsɛma, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I consider the people of Israel as worthless as the leftover metal in a furnace after silver has been purified.
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩrɩmɛ hɔɔ-bɩnɩŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ, a kala nagɛ hɔɔ-fɩaŋ, hɔɔ-la ba sɩ kaa ŋaa kɔŋkɔŋ, hɔɔ-duoŋ arɩ fanɩ. Ba joŋ ba kala hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ nɛ, ba kala ŋaa hɔpʋla bɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: I will be like a metalworker who collects that metal from the furnace and melts it down. I will collect the Israelites and blow on them with my fiery anger. They will melt inside the city of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ a kɛmma kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ Jerusalɛm lɛ, a fuuni nyiniŋ hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma ŋmɩɛrɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: like silver in a furnace. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have punished them in my anger. Everyone in Jerusalem Is Guilty
translation_verse: A nagɛ ba sɩ yie joŋ hɔpʋla hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ ʋ ŋmɩɛrɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma ma jaŋ ŋmɩɛrɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA sɩ na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that their country is full of sin, and that I, the Lord, am furious!
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, bʋla pɩ Iziral tinteeŋ, ‘Ŋ ŋaa tintee sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ na baanɩŋ ŋ nyuŋ duonuŋ bɩ ŋ lɛ nɩa koo a mirisi ma.’

english_verse: Their leaders are like roaring lions, tearing apart their victims. They put people to death, then steal everything of value. Husbands are killed, and many women are left as widows.
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaara-la sɩ hɛ ŋ lɛ nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩ kpʋ kɩaa a didii nɛ. Ba yie kpʋ nɩaa, a lɩlaa ba dʋa aŋ pɩpaa ba kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ yuŋuŋ, a leŋ yo-haalaa yʋgɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: The priests of Israel ignore my Law! Not only do they refuse to respect any of my sacred things, but they don't even teach the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary or between what is clean and what is unclean. They treat my Sabbath like any other day, and so my own people no longer honor me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ hɛ Iziral lɛ chei mɩ wombii-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto nɛ. Ba bɩ mɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ka zil. Ba bɩ nɩaa daga dɩ ba jɩŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ mɩ teeŋ pɛgɛ. Ba dagɛ nɩaa arɩ dabaŋ kala tuo kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ pɛgɛ, aŋ bɩra bɩ mɩ chɛ-wiesii-la ma ka to. Ŋɩɩ leŋ ba chei mɩ yɩrɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Israel's officials are like ferocious wolves, ripping their victims apart. They make a dishonest living by injuring and killing people.
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ nagɛ guŋgurusuŋ sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a kaa pʋɔsa didii nɛ. Ba gɔllɔ kpʋkpʋ nɩaa nɛ, a leŋ chalɩŋ jaasɛ aŋ gɩrɩma lɩlaa nɩaa dʋa.

english_verse: And then the prophets in Israel cover up these sins by giving false visions. I have never spoken to them, but they lie and say they have a message from me.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩ hɛ Iziral lɛ gbaa tʋtɔ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba kala nɛ, a nagɛ ba sɩ ŋaa tʋɔrʋŋ bʋgɛ kʋa. Ba yie nyɩɛ wɩaa bʋl dɩ ba na wɩaa a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ nɛ, a vʋga dɩdagɛ wɩalɩŋ maachie sɩ jaŋ ŋaa. Ba sɩ, ‘Wɩɩ-la la TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋɩɩ,’ ka mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla.

english_verse: I looked for someone to defend the city and to protect it from my anger, as well as to stop me from destroying it. But I found no one.
translation_verse: Mɩ beŋ ba tʋɔŋ a chɩchɛ nʋʋ sɩ jaŋ saa jeeŋ a chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ wuol-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ba pɛgɛ lɛ, a pɔ tintee-la dɩ mɩ sɩ́ ʋ chei, ama mɩ bɩ nʋʋ na.

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish the Israelites for what they have done, and they will know that I am furious. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ baanɩŋ jaŋ sii ba nyuŋ, mɩ baanɩŋ jaŋ nagɛ nyiniŋ a jomba dii. Wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋaa jaŋ gʋra nyʋa ba nyuŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, listen to this story about two sisters.
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, haalaa balɩa nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, ba naaŋ ŋaa kʋbala.

english_verse: The older one was named Oholah, which stands for Samaria; the younger one was Oholibah, which stands for Jerusalem. They became my wives and gave birth to my children.
translation_verse: Nɩhɩaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Ohola, ʋ ŋaana ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ Oholiba. Mɩ fa jaa ba nɛ ba lʋl hambolibiisiŋ arɩ hantolibiisiŋ kala. Ohola nɛ chɩŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Samarɩa nyuŋ, Oholiba ma nɛ chɩŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jerusalɛm nyuŋ.

english_verse: Even though Oholah was my wife, she continued to be a prostitute and chased after Assyrian lovers.
translation_verse: Ohola fa ŋaa mɩ haala nɛ, aŋ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa a hɩɩlɛ Asiiria laalɩyuoroo a kire to ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: She offered herself to soldiers in purple uniforms: handsome, high-ranking officers and cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoro-la sɩ laalɛ gɛrɩ-diibelimbine. Ba nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ, ba kala ŋaa bapʋɔsɛ zɔmɔ nɛ sɩ jɩl janɩŋ.

english_verse: She had sex with all the important Assyrian officials and even worshiped their disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Hachɔrʋŋ wɩalɩŋ nɛ ʋ fa ŋaa a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pɩ Asiiria nɩalɩŋ dɩchɩnɩŋ sɩ yuŋŋie. Ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ kpaarɛ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ kɛnʋ pɩŋ tɔŋŋɔɔ a kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: Once she started doing these things in Egypt, she never stopped. Men slept with her, and she was always ready for sex.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ hachɔrʋŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ suomo Ijipiti lɛ leŋe, ʋ hatulluŋ bʋa lɛ, baalaa kɛnʋ pɩŋ a ŋaa wɩaa ʋ lɛ a nagɛ hachɔrʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: So I gave Oholah to the Assyrian lovers she wanted so badly.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ joŋu hɛ ʋ hɩɩlaba nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, Asiiria tɩmma-la ʋ sɩɩ hɩɛnʋ.

english_verse: They ripped off her clothes, then captured her children and killed her. Women everywhere talked about what had happened to Oholah.
translation_verse: Ba wuri ʋ gɛnnɩŋ nɛ aŋ ka ʋ yarɩ-biree, a kɛsɛ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ toloo, aŋ kpʋʋ. Ba fa sɩ dɔgɩsɛ Ohola ŋɩɩ, ʋ laa yɩrɩ bɔmʋŋ haalaa kala tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Oholibah saw all this, but she was more sinful and wanted sex more than her sister Oholah ever did.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaana Oholiba na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa, aŋ ha hɩhɩɛnɛ baalaa a ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa yʋga kɩɩ ʋ malɩma.

english_verse: Oholibah also chased after good-looking Assyrian officers, uniformed soldiers, and cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Ʋ ma ha chɩchɛ Asiiria nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ ba laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ sɩ laalɛ ba gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ, ba kala ŋaa bapʋɔsɛ zɔmɔ nɛ a jɩl janɩŋ.

english_verse: But Oholibah behaved worse than her sister. Oholibah saw images of Babylonian men carved into walls and painted red.
translation_verse: Ʋ ma fa ha joŋ hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa a chʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ. Ʋ na ba sɩ tuuri Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa baalaa a mɛrɛ jeeŋ lɛ a joŋ kʋfɩaŋ taarɛ taarɛ.

english_verse: They had belts around their waists and large turbans on their heads, and they reminded her of Babylonian cavalry officers.
translation_verse: Ba fa vɔɔ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ biisiŋ nɛ ba tɩnsɩŋ lɛ aŋ bɛ nyu-bɛllɩŋ sɩɩ biegu. Ba kala nagɛ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa laalɩyuoroo janɩŋ torukoba nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ, a lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: As soon as she looked at them, she wanted to have sex with them. And so, she sent messengers to bring them to her.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ naba dɩdɛrɛ, ʋ hɩɛnɛba a tɩŋ tɩndaaraa ba mʋ ba teeŋ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Men from Babylonia came and had sex with her so many times that she got disgusted with them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Babɩlɔŋ baalaa kɔ ʋ teeŋ a kɛnʋ pɩŋ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ. Ba sɩ ŋaa ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ fɩɩba ʋ mɩɩrɛ ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: She let everyone see her naked body and didn't care if they knew she was a prostitute. That's why I turned my back on her, just as I had done with her older sister.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa sɩ joŋ hachɔrʋŋ wɩalɩŋ chʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, nɩaa kala jɩŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ. Mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ fɩɩ mɩ joŋ harɩŋ yɩaʋ a nagɛ mɩ fa sɩ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa ʋ malɩma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Oholibah didn't stop there, but became even more immoral and acted as she had back in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ama ŋɩɩ bɩ ʋ walɩma, ka ʋ ha chaasa ŋɩŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩalɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ, ʋ sɩ liise mʋ yi ʋ hatulluŋ bʋa lɛ, hachɔrʋŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ fa sɩɩ ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: She eagerly wanted to go to bed with Egyptian men, who were famous for their sexual powers.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ ʋ faa hɩɛnɛ baalaa nɛ woruŋ a kire to ʋ hɩɩlaba harɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ penee sɩ barɩma a nagɛ kakusuŋ penee, ba bafɩɩrɩŋ ma nagɛ jaaba fɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: And she longed for the days when she was a young prostitute, when men enjoyed caressing her body. The Lord Will Punish Oholibah
translation_verse: Oholiba, ŋ cho hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa nɛ woruŋ ŋ hatulluŋ kala lɛ, Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ baalaa chagɩsɛ ŋ yɩlaa nɛ aŋ pʋrʋmɛ ŋ yɩl niiriŋ.

english_verse: The Lord God said: Oholibah, though you no longer want to be around your lovers, they will surround you like enemies, when I turn them against you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa Oholiba, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛ ŋ hɩɩlaba kʋ hɛ ŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ sɩ fɩa ŋ mɩɩrɛ ba harɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmma lɩɩ lee-kala kʋ hɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I will gather all the handsome young officials and the high-ranking cavalry officers from Babylonia and Assyria, as well as from the Chaldean tribes of Pekod, Shoa, and Koa.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛ Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa arɩ Chalɩdɩ tɩŋŋaa kala a kʋ hɛ ŋ lɛ, a pɛ Pɛkɔd, Sʋa arɩ Kʋa baalaa arɩ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa kala. Ba kala ŋaa bapʋɔsɛ zɔmɔ nɛ a kala ŋaa sɩpaalaara, a ŋaa laalɩyuori hɩasɩ, a ŋaa laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba nɩhɩasɩŋ, a kala ŋaa nɩ-bála a jɩl janɩŋ.

english_verse: Their large armies will come from the north with chariots and wagons carrying weapons. They will wear shields and helmets and will surround you, and I will let them judge and sentence you according to their own laws.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛŋ laalɩyuori kɩaa, laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba arɩ torukoba arɩ nɩ-daŋ a kɔ ŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ kʋ chɩna golluŋ a kori hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuori sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ kʋjalaa arɩ kʋbiisiŋ a chu nyunchu-gbaŋkogunuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋuŋ a hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba dɔgʋsʋŋ. Ba jaŋ dɔgʋsʋŋ a magɛ ŋɩɩ ba wombiiŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: I am angry with you, so I will let them be very cruel. They will cut off your nose and ears; they will kill your children and burn alive anyone in your family who survives.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ yarɩ-bieri baanɩŋ a fɩɩsɛ ŋ lɛ, dɩ ba chaasa dɔgʋsʋŋ arɩ baanɩŋ woruŋ. Ba jaŋ keri ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ŋ dɩgɩlaa ta, aŋ kpʋ ŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka arɩ tokobiiŋ. Ba jaŋ kɛsɛ ŋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ŋ hantolibiisiŋ kala viiri aŋ nyɩgɛ nɩkaanaa.

english_verse: Your clothes and jewelry will be torn off.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ wuri ŋ gɛnnɩŋ arɩ ŋ yaraa kpɩɛrɩ-zɔmɔ-la kala.

english_verse: I will stop your wickedness and the prostitution you started back in Egypt. You will never want to think about those days again.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ arɩ ŋ hachɔrʋŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ fa sɩ ŋaa Ijipiti lɛ dɛrɛ. Ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ hɩhɩɛnɛ wɩalɩŋ koo a liliisi Ijipiti wɩaa.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, am ready to hand you over to those hateful enemies that you find so disgusting.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ joŋuŋ hɛ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bɛrɛ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ sɩ fɩa ŋ mɩɩrɛ ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: They will cruelly take away everything you have worked for and strip you naked. Then everyone will see you for the prostitute you really are. Your own vulgar sins
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ joŋ nɩ-bɛrɛ wɩaa ŋaa ŋ lɛ a laa kʋŋ na-kala ŋ sɩ tɩma na. Ba jaŋ wuri ŋ gɛnnɩŋ ka dɩ ŋ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛnɩŋ a tɩŋ ŋ hachɔrʋŋ wɩalɩŋ wɩaa, dɩ nʋʋkala na. Ŋ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ arɩ hachɔrʋŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa nɛ

english_verse: have led to this. You were the one determined to have sex with men from other nations and to worship their idols.
translation_verse: kɛŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ kʋ hɛ ŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ hɩɛnɛ baalaa nɛ a kire to tinteyee nɩaa harɩŋ a kpaarɛ ba vʋɩyaa a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ.

english_verse: You have turned out no better than your older sister, and now you must drink from the cup filled with my anger.
translation_verse: Ŋ malɩma naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ ŋ tuto, ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ ŋ ma arɩ mɩ fa sɩ dɔgʋsʋʋ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, gave your sister a large, deep cup filled with my anger. And when you drink from that cup, you will be mocked and insulted.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ŋ ma jaŋ nyʋa nyʋnyʋala-la tʋɔŋ ŋ malɩma sɩ nyʋa, nyʋnyʋala-la jalɩa nɛ aŋ luŋ ma. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa sieri ŋ lɛ a mɔmʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa yʋga nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: You will end up drunk and devastated, because that cup is filled with horror and ruin.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ bugi dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ kala chei. Ʋ ŋaa nyʋnyʋala sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ chei a chɩŋ ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ. Ŋ malɩma Samarɩa nyʋnyʋala nɛ.

english_verse: But you must drink every drop! Then smash the cup and chew on its broken pieces. Use them to cut your breasts in sorrow. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ nyʋaʋ a suosi ʋ kala dɩ ʋ hɩl, aŋ yɛrʋ muno muno a kaa kpɛrɛ kpɛrɛ ŋ yɩlaa. Mɩ-na ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: You have completely rejected me, and so I promise that you will be punished for the disgusting things you did as a prostitute. The Two Sisters Are Condemned
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ŋ sɩ folo yʋ mɩ wɩaa a joŋ harɩŋ yɩamɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ŋ na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ wʋlɩɩlɩ-la arɩ hachɔrʋŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, it's time for you to tell Oholah and Oholibah that they are guilty. Remind them of their evil ways!
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa pɩɛsɛmɛ: “Nuhuobiiŋ, ŋ jaŋ dii Ohola arɩ Oholiba sarɩyaa? Ŋɩɩ-na leŋ dɩ ba jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kɩsʋ ka ba ŋaa.

english_verse: They have been unfaithful by worshiping idols, and they have committed murder by sacrificing my own children as offerings to idols.
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa nɛ a kpʋ nɩaa. Ba to tɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa, a paala kɛsɛ hambolibiisi-la ba sɩ lʋla pɩmɛ a kpʋ nyɩga pɩ ba tɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: They came into my temple that same day, and that made it unfit as a place to worship me. They have even stopped respecting the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa ba sɩ kɛsɛ ba biiriŋ kpʋ nyɩga pɩ ba tɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ba jʋʋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la a ŋaa disiniŋ cheyu. Wɩɩ-la ba sɩ ŋaa mɩ dɩa lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: They sent messengers to attract men from far away. When those men arrived, the two sisters bathed themselves and put on eye shadow and jewelry.
translation_verse: Ba fa paala tɩŋ tɩndaaraa ba mʋ dɩ-bolii nɛ a yɩrɛ baalaa. Ba sɩ kɔ, ma fo lɩɩŋ nɛ a ŋaa kɩaa tuuri ma sɩɩ-kuŋkoŋŋoo a laalɛ ma kpɩɛraa.

english_verse: They sat on a fancy couch, and in front of them was a table for the olive oil and incense that had belonged to me.
translation_verse: Ma hɔŋ ma kumpuŋŋu-zɔmʋŋ nyuŋ nɛ, ka teebʋl chɩŋ ma sɩpaaŋ, kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ arɩ olif nʋʋŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ kɩaa daŋ ʋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Their room was always filled with a noisy crowd of drunkards brought in from the desert. These men gave the women bracelets and beautiful crowns,
translation_verse: Ka nɩ-daŋ sɩ ta jɩa ŋɩŋaa goŋ a golli haal-la. Ba fa kɛŋ sɩ-nyʋaraa sɩ lɩɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ arɩ nɩdoho kala kʋ jaasɛ leriŋ kala. Baala-la joŋ na-hɔɔnʋŋ a hɛ haala-la balɩa nɩsaa a joŋ kuoru nyunchuuluŋ sɩ zɔmɔ a chuba.

english_verse: and I noticed that the men were eager to have sex with these women, though they were exhausted from being prostitutes.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl ŋ-la a mʋ tɩgɛ haal-la sɩ lɔl hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa lɛ: ‘Leŋ dɩ ba kɛnʋ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ paala ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ nɛ.’

english_verse: In fact, the men had sex over and over with Oholah and Oholibah, the two sinful sisters.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛmba pɩŋ a nagɛ ba sɩ tigisi hachɔrʋmʋŋ. Ba fa tigisi Ohola arɩ Oholiba sɩ ŋaa hachɔrʋmɔɔ ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: But honest judges will someday accuse those two of murder and of being unfaithful, because they are certainly guilty.
translation_verse: Baalaa sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ haala-la sɩ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa a kpʋ nɩaa. Ba jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba, bɛɛ wɩaa ba gɔllɔ saarɛ baalaa a kpʋ nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, now say to these sisters: I will call together an angry mob that will abuse and rob you.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Kɛŋ nɩ-daŋ kʋ hɛ ba lɛ dɩ ba dii doluŋ ba lɛ aŋ paa ba kɩaa.

english_verse: They will stone you to death and cut you to pieces; they will kill your children and burn down your houses.
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ-la jaŋ yagɛba arɩ tabɩaa a kpʋba arɩ ba tokobiee, ba jaŋ kpʋ ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba hantolibiisiŋ kala aŋ nyɩgɛ ba dɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I will get rid of sinful prostitution in this country, so that women everywhere will be warned not to act as you have.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ to a leŋ dɩ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ ŋaanɩŋ dɛrɛ tintee-la lɛ, a chagɩlɛ haalaa kala dɩ ba sɩ́ ma nagʋ.

english_verse: You will be punished for becoming prostitutes and for worshiping idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma a tɩŋ ma wʋlɩɩlɩŋ arɩ ma sɩ kpaarɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ a ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ.”

english_verse: Nine years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the tenth day of the tenth month. He said:
translation_verse: La fa sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ jɩ-nibi tʋɔŋ, chɛŋ-fii tapʋl fii lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ, ʋ sɩ:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, write down today's date, because the king of Babylonia has just begun attacking the city of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, ŋmʋnsɛ jɩnɩŋ tapʋlʋŋ bil, bɛɛ wɩaa tapʋlʋŋ deeŋ tɩtɩa nɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro suomo yuyuo Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Then tell my rebellious people: “Pour water in a cooking pot and set it over a fire. *
translation_verse: Magɛ namaga deeŋ pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa deemba sɩ vɩa dagɩŋ: Wɩɩ-la Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Joŋ pupoiŋ chɔ, a ŋaa lɩɩŋ hɛ.

english_verse: Throw in the legs and shoulders of your finest sheep and put in the juicy bones.
translation_verse: Joŋ nammɩa a kaa keri muno muno a hɛ, lere-la kala sɩ zɔmɔ huiyee arɩ vaasɩŋ. Paa haŋgbele-la sɩ zɔmɔ pɛ a su pupoi-la.

english_verse: Pile wood underneath the pot, and let the meat and bones boil until they are done.”
translation_verse: Nammɩa-la maga ʋ ŋaa pie-zɔmʋŋ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa piesee tʋɔŋ nɛ. Hɛ daasɩŋ pupoi-la bʋbʋɔŋ dɩ lɩɩ-la kpɛrɛ dɩ haŋgbele-la arɩ nammɩa-la kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ bɩɩ.

english_verse: These words mean that Jerusalem is doomed! The city is filled with murderers and is like an old, rusty pot. The meat is taken out piece by piece, and no one cares what happens to it.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩɩŋ puu tabal-la nɩaa sɩ ŋaa nɩkpʋʋraa. Ʋ nagɛ pupoiŋ sɩ faasa fisi nɛ, ba bɩ jaŋ wuo paasɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ. Liliiri nammɩa-la kʋŋ kʋŋ a sɩ́ bagɩsʋ ka dɩ ba dɛrɛ.

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem murdered innocent people in the city and didn't even try to cover up the blood that flowed out on the hard ground.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm nɩaa sɩ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ chalɩŋ jaasɛ ba tabalɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Chal-la jaasɛ bʋ-taala nyuŋ nɛ, ʋ bɩ tinteeŋ jaasa, lee-la hagɩla sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo tɔ.

english_verse: But I have seen that blood, and it cries out for me to take revenge.
translation_verse: Mɩ baanɩŋ sɩ jaŋ sii dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩaa tiŋ chɩmɩŋ ba lɛ nɛ tɩɩ, mɩ leŋ chal-la bʋ-taala-la nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ba sɩ́ wuo gbaa tɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will punish that city of violence! I will make a huge pile of firewood,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩɩŋ puu tabal-la nɩaa sɩ ŋaa nɩkpʋʋraa. Mɩ ma jaŋ chɛ daasɩŋ gɩrɛ dɩ ba sii chʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: so bring more wood and light it. Cook the meat and boil away the broth to let the bones scorch.
translation_verse: Gɩrɛ daasɩŋ a chaanɛ nyiniŋ hɛ. Chɔ nammɩa-la woruŋ, a hɛ tegisiŋ, leŋ dɩ haŋgbele-la fisi.

english_verse: Then set the empty pot over the hot coals until it is red-hot. That will clean the pot and burn off the rust.
translation_verse: Joŋ pupoi-la kʋwuoluŋ chɔ nyiŋ-halaa lɛ dɩ ʋ faasa lɩŋ dɩ hɔɔ-fɩaŋ-la ba sɩ kaa ŋaaʋ fɩɛsɛ, dɩ disiŋ-la ma ŋmɩɛrɛ, dɩ ʋ sɩ sʋa ŋɩɩ ma dii.

english_verse: Jerusalem is so full of sin and evil that I can't get it clean, even though I have tried. It will stay filthy until I let loose my fierce anger against it.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm, ŋ disiniŋ nɛ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa. Mɩ hɛ doluŋ dɩ mɩ chɛsɛ disiŋ-la ta nɛ, ama ŋ bɩ sɛyɛ. Ŋ disiniŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ lɩɩ, see dɩ mɩ joŋ baaŋ-la kala mɩ sɩ na ŋ nyuŋ a fɩɩsɛ ŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ dɩ ʋ mʋ fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: That time will certainly come! And when it does, I won't show the people of Jerusalem any pity or change my mind. They must be punished for the evil they have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Ezekiel's Wife Dies
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Bʋa-la yie nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ fá nʋʋ nenige, koo a kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩrɩmɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgʋsʋŋ a tɩŋ ŋɩɩ ŋ mɛlɛ arɩ ŋ wʋŋaalaa sɩ naga. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.” Ɛzɩkɩɛl haala sʋba

english_verse: “Ezekiel, son of man, I will suddenly take the life of the person you love most. But I don't want you to complain or cry.
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ guu lɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ cho woruŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ. Ama sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ chei koo a yel koo dɩ ŋ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ lɩɩ.

english_verse: Mourn in silence and don't show that you are grieving. Don't remove your turban or take off your sandals; don't cover your face to show your sorrow, or eat the food that mourners eat.”
translation_verse: Fɩɛla huuni, sɩ́ sʋʋ-la lɛ yel. Bɛ ŋ nyu-bɛlɛ a hɛ ŋ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ, sɩ́ kʋŋ kaa tɔ ŋ sɩaa koo a dii ma naaba kʋdiile-la nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yel yoho sɩɩ dii.”

english_verse: One morning, I was talking with the people as usual, and by sunset my wife was dead. The next day I did what the Lord had told me,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ chʋchʋɔŋ mɩ dɩ nɩaa bʋl wɩaa, dɩdaanɩŋ mɩ haala sʋʋ. Taŋ sɩ pʋla chʋchʋɔŋ, mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ sɩ dɩ mɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: and when people saw me, they asked, “Why aren't you mourning for your wife?”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bɩ ŋ haala lɛ ka yel, ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ bɛɛ?”

english_verse: I answered: The Lord God says
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩba, “La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ, ʋ sɩ:

english_verse: he is ready to destroy the temple in which you take such pride and which makes you feel so safe. Your children who now live in Jerusalem will be killed.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ chei mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la nɛ, dɩ-duo-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ a kɛŋ babii-ballɩŋ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ ma chou woruŋ. Ma hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ma hantolibiisi-la ma sɩ leŋe ta Jerusalɛm lɛ, ba jaŋ kpʋba laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then you will do the same things I have done. You will leave your face uncovered and refuse to eat the food that mourners usually eat.
translation_verse: Ma ma jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa mɩ sɩ ŋaa. Ma bɩ jaŋ joŋ kʋŋ a tɔ ma sɩaa koo a dii ma naaba kʋdiile-la nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yel yoho sɩɩ dii.

english_verse: You won't take off your turbans and your sandals. You won't cry or mourn, but all day long you will go around groaning because of your sins.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ bɛ nyu-bɛllɩŋ aŋ hɛ ma nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ. Ma bɩ jaŋ yel koo dɩ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ lɩɩ ma sɩaa lɛ, ama ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma jagɛ a huuno hɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: I am a warning sign—everything I have done, you will also do. And then you will know the Lord God has made these things happen.
translation_verse: Ɛzɩkɩɛl-na ŋaa magɩl nɛ a chɩchagɩlɛma, ma ma jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa ʋ sɩ ŋaa. Dɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ ŋaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ.’

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, I will soon destroy the temple that makes everyone feel proud and safe, and I will take away their children as well.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na, nuhuobiiŋ, tapʋlɩɩ jaŋ yi dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ ŋaa ba dɩ-duoŋ laa ba teeŋ. Ʋ ŋaa ba babiibal arɩ ba tʋɔtɔrɛ lee nɛ, ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ woruŋ ba chou. Mɩ jaŋ kɛsɛ ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba hantolibiisiŋ ma tapʋlɩɩ-la.

english_verse: On that same day, someone will escape from the city and come to tell you what has happened.
translation_verse: Chɛɛ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, nʋʋ jaŋ foro fá a kʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa a pɩŋ.

english_verse: Then you will be able to speak again, and the two of you will talk. You will be a warning sign to the people, and they will know that I am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo suri ŋ niiŋ bʋl wɩaa ʋ teeŋ, ŋ niiŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ tɔ. Ŋ jaŋ ŋaa magɩl nɩaa teeŋ a chɩchagɩlɛba, dɩ ba jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ, ʋ sɩ:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the people of Ammon
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, joŋ sɩaa chaasɛ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ba lɛ a pɩba.

english_verse: Now I am going to let you be conquered by tribes from the eastern desert. They will set up their camps in your land and eat your fruit and drink your milk.
translation_verse: mɩ jaŋ jomma hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba tɩɩma. Ba jaŋ ŋmoo bugoo ma tinteeŋ lɛ a hɛ lɛŋŋɛɛ ma tʋɔŋ, ba jaŋ dii ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ aŋ nyʋa ma nayɩlɩŋ.

english_verse: Your capital city of Rabbah will be nothing but pastureland for camels, and the rest of the country will be pastures for sheep. Then you will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ma tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Raba a bɩrɩmɛ bʋntaŋŋaba dɩ-diiliŋ, aŋ leŋ dɩ Amɔŋ tinteeŋ kala ŋaa piesee dɩjʋʋlʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: And so I will hand you over to enemies who will rob you. I will completely destroy you. There won't be enough of your people left to be a nation ever again, and you will know that I, the Lord, have done these things. Judgment on Moab
translation_verse: mɩ jaŋ jomma hɛ tinteyee nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba kɛsɛma a nagɛ ba sɩ yuo laalɩŋ dii nɩaa aŋ paa kɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ cheima ta tinteyee tʋɔŋ, dɩ ma bɩra sɩ́ nɩa ŋaa tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.” Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Mʋab tɩŋŋaa lɛ

english_verse: The Lord God said, “The people of Moab thought Judah was no different from any other nation.
translation_verse: “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: A tɩŋ tinteye-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mʋab arɩ Sɛɛ sɩ sɩ, ‘Má bee na, Juda dɩa nɩaa ma nagɛ tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ nɩaa kala nɛ,’

english_verse: So I will let Moab's fortress towns along its border be attacked, including Beth-Jeshimoth, Baal-Meon, and Kiriathaim.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ lere-la sɩ kɛrɛ Mʋab suri, a suomi tasɩ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ, ba yɩyɩrɛ Bɛf Jɛsɛmɔ, Baal Mioŋ arɩ Kɩrɩatam, taŋ-la sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ woruŋ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: The same eastern desert tribes that invade Ammon will invade Moab, and just as Ammon will be forgotten forever,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ yuo dii Mʋab, a pɛ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ a tɩɩba, dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa wɩaa liisu tinteyee tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Moab will be punished. Then the people there will know that I am the Lord.” Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.” Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa lɛ

english_verse: The Lord God then said, “The people of Edom are guilty of taking revenge on Judah.
translation_verse: “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ɛdɔm nɩaa sɩ ŋaa wɩaa a tiŋ chɩmɩŋ Juda nɩaa lɛ ŋɩɩ, ba laa cheeriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I will send my own people to take revenge on the Edomites by making them feel my fierce anger. And when I punish them, they will know that I am the Lord God.” Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wɩaa tiŋ chɩmɩŋ Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa lɛ a pɩmɛ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ baanɩŋ a ŋaa wɩaa Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa lɛ. Ɛdɔm tɩmma-la jaŋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ baanɩŋ sɩ naga. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.” Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa lɛ

english_verse: The Lord God said, “The cruel Philistines have taken revenge on their enemies over and over and have tried to destroy them.
translation_verse: “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ Juda nɩaa faafaa kala ŋɩɩ, ba ŋaa wɩaa ba lɛ nɛ a tiŋ chɩmɩŋ a cheiba.

english_verse: Now it's my turn to treat the Philistines as my enemies and to kill everyone living in their towns along the seacoast.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa, a kpʋ ba nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɔŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: In my fierce anger, I will take revenge on them. And when I punish them, they will know that I am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ tiŋ ba lɛ kɩŋkɛŋ. Baanɩŋ nɛ mɩ jaŋ kaa dɔgɩsɛba. Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛŋ mɩ baanɩŋ ŋaa wɩaa tiŋ chɩmɩŋ ba lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the month. He said:
translation_verse: Jɩ-fii arɩ kʋbala tʋɔŋ, chɛnɛ tapʋl bumbuŋ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA fa bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ, ʋ sɩ:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people of the city of Tyre have celebrated Jerusalem's defeat by singing, “Jerusalem has fallen! It used to be powerful, a center of trade. Now the city is shattered, and we will take its place.”
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, a tɩŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Taaya tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɛ Jerusalɛm sɩ tele wɩaa ʋ bʋl, ‘Aŋ haa, boi-baal-la ba sɩ to mʋmʋ tinteyee boro nɛ, ʋ borusuŋ suro chɩŋ a pɩmɛ, lɛɛlɛ ʋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ kuori.’

english_verse: Because the people of Tyre have sung that song, I have the following warning for them: I am the Lord God, and I am now your enemy! I will send nations to attack you, like waves crashing against the shore.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Taaya, mɩ lɩɩ ŋ harɩŋ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tintee daŋ kʋ hɛ ŋ lɛ dɩ ba yuoŋ. Ba jaŋ kʋ yagɩŋ a nagɛ mʋga lɩɩ-peliŋ sɩ sii yɩyagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: They will tear down your city walls and defense towers. I will sweep away the ruins until all that's left of you is a bare rock,
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ chei Taaya jeyee aŋ ŋmoo ʋ dɩɩ-leŋee lo. Mɩ jaŋ paa kʋ-telie-la kala a kaa viiri aŋ ka bʋ-taala nyɩɩsɛ.

english_verse: where fishermen can dry their nets along the coast. I promise that you will be robbed
translation_verse: Taaya bʋ-taala-la nyuŋ nɛ chenfil-kpʋʋraa jaŋ yieni ba jomba mʋgʋ-bal-la leriŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla. Tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ paa ʋ kɩaa,

english_verse: and that the people who live in your towns along the coast will be killed. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: aŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ Taaya tinteeŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia is the world's most powerful king, and I will send him to attack you. He will march from the north with a powerful army, including horses and chariots and cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ kɩɩ dʋnɩa kuoroo kala kɔ dɩ ʋ yuo Taaya. Ʋ jaŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a kɛŋ laalɩyuori daŋ, a pɛ janɩŋ, janɩŋ torukoba arɩ ja-jɩllaa sɩ yʋga lɛ.

english_verse: First, he will attack your towns along the coast and kill the people who live there. Then he will build dirt ramps up to the top of your city walls and set up rows of shields around you.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ yuo kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ ŋ tintee-la lɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ. Ʋ jaŋ kʋ chɩna golluŋ, a paa kɩaa a bil dɩ ba sii je dɩ ba chɩŋ ba nyuŋ a bibeŋ taŋ-la kala, aŋ saa vaŋkumba a jɩla tɩgɛ ŋ jeyee lɛ a kɛŋ hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛ laa bayuori-hɛŋŋɛɛ a kaa kɩɛla golluŋ.

english_verse: He will command some of his troops to use large wooden poles to beat down your walls, while others use iron rods to knock down your watchtowers.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ pa wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kɛŋ doloo ŋmoo ŋ jeyee lo, aŋ giri ŋ dɩɩ-leŋee ma arɩ ʋ bayuori kɩaa.

english_verse: He will have so many horses that the dust they stir up will seem like a thick fog. And as his chariots and cavalry approach, even the walls will shake, especially when he proudly enters your ruined city.
translation_verse: Ʋ janɩŋ jaŋ yʋgɛ kɩŋkɛŋ dɩ ba kʋŋkɔlʋŋ sii tɔŋ. Ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ jaŋ lɛrɛ janɩŋ torukoba arɩ torukoba a to ŋ boi-baalaa jʋʋ a nagɛ tabal-la ba sɩ yuo dii. Dɩ ba nɛ jʋa, ba dɔmɔ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ jeyee jigisi.

english_verse: His troops will ride through your streets, killing people left and right, and your strong columns will crumble to the ground.
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɩyuoroo jaŋ jɩl janɩŋ a guu su ŋ womporoo. Ba jaŋ kpʋ ŋ nɩaa. Ŋ jebii duoruŋ jaŋ tel tinteeŋ.

english_verse: The troops will steal your valuable possessions; they will break down your walls, and crush your expensive houses. Then the stones and wood and all the remains will be dumped into the sea.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ paa ŋ dʋa arɩ ŋ bayal kɩaa, ba jaŋ ŋmoo ŋ jeyee lo aŋ giri ŋ dɩɩ zɔŋŋɔɔ, aŋ paa ba tabɩaa, doloo arɩ tɩɛrɩŋ a yuo hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You will have no reason to sing or play music on harps,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ yɩɩlaa yɩɩnɩŋ dɛrɛ, nʋʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ ŋ du cheŋ a yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa.

english_verse: because I will turn you into a bare rock where fishermen can dry their nets. And you will never rebuild your city. I, the Lord God, make this promise.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Taaya tinteeŋ ŋaa bʋ-taala, lee-la chenfil-kpʋʋraa sɩ jaŋ yiyieni ba jomba. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ paa taŋ-la wasa saa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The people of the nations up and down the coast will shudder when they hear your screams and moans of death.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra sɩ bʋla pɩ Taaya nɛ ŋ-la: “Dɩ ba nɛ yuo diiŋ, nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bolimo jaŋ huuni, dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ, ka dɩ ba kpʋkpʋ ŋ nɩaa.

english_verse: The kings will step down from their thrones, then take off their royal robes and fancy clothes, and sit on the ground, trembling. They will be so shocked at the news of your defeat that they will shake in fear
translation_verse: Kuorie-la sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ jaŋ sii ba kuoru kpasɩnɩŋ nyuŋ. Ba jaŋ wuri ba kuori-gɛnnɩŋ arɩ ba gɛrɩ-sʋalaa ta aŋ hɔŋ tinteeŋ a chichel. Wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa ŋ lɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba kɩŋkɛŋ dɩ ba chichel aŋ bibeniŋ.

english_verse: But now Tyre is in ruins, and the people on the coast stare at it in horror and tremble in fear.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ yuo diiŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ chele nɛ, ŋ sɩ tele fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu nɩaa nɛ.’

english_verse: and carry you down to the world of the dead, where you will join people of ancient times and towns ruined long ago. You will stay there and never again be a city filled with people.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ mʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ a pɛ faafaa nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ hɛ bʋa tʋɔŋ. Ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo guoli nɩweyee tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You will die a horrible death! People will come looking for your city, but it will never be found. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ chaasa lɔrɛ, dɩ ŋ lɛl. Nɩaa jaŋ chɛŋ, ama ba bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba naŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, sing a funeral song for Tyre,
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, ta jembiiŋ a tɩgɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Taaya lɛ,

english_verse: the city that is built along the sea and that trades with nations along the coast. Tell the people of Tyre that the following message is from me: Tyre, you brag about your perfect beauty,
translation_verse: tabal-la sɩ chɩŋ wombii-la ba sɩ to a mʋmʋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ, a didii yɔbɔ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ teeŋ. Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Taaya, ŋ bigisi ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ a bʋl, ‘Mɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ woruŋ.’

english_verse: and your control of the sea. You are a ship built to perfection.
translation_verse: Ŋ fa nagɛ lɩɩŋ daboro nɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ saaŋ leŋe ŋ zɔŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Builders used cypress trees from Mount Hermon to make your planks and a cedar tree from Lebanon for your tall mast.
translation_verse: Ba keri bʋtʋŋ daasɩŋ Hamɔŋ peel-la nyuŋ nɛ a ŋaa ŋ doloo, a keri kuolu daasɩŋ ma a kaa lɩɩ Lɛbanɔŋ a kaa ŋaa ŋ tʋɔŋ daaduduosuŋ.

english_verse: Oak trees from Bashan were shaped into oars; pine trees from Cyprus were cut for your deck, which was then decorated with strips of ivory.
translation_verse: Piiŋ daasɩŋ sɩ hɛ Basaŋ lɛ nɛ ba kaa ŋaa ŋ danyinsiŋ, Kanchal daasɩŋ sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ nɛ ba kaa ŋaa ŋ tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ batu-nyɩlɩŋ a taarɛ.

english_verse: The builders used fancy linen from Egypt for your sails, so everyone could see you. Blue and purple cloth from Cyprus was used to shade your deck.
translation_verse: Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ ba sɩ sʋa nɛ ba kaa ŋaa ŋ jɔnjɔŋ ŋ kaa duori lɩɩŋ. Gɛrɩpɛ diibelimbine arɩ gɛrɩpɛ vachalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa lɩɩ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛlɩsa a hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ nɛ ŋ kaa kɛrɛ wɩa.

english_verse: Men from Sidon and Arvad did the rowing, and your own skilled workers were the captains.
translation_verse: Baala-la sɩ lɩɩ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩdɔŋ arɩ Aavad nɛ kori ŋ danyinsiŋ. Taaya, ŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ jɩma nɛ kɛnɩŋ duduori lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Brave soldiers from Persia, Lydia, and Libya served in your navy, protecting you with shields and helmets, and making you famous.
translation_verse: Baalaa sɩ lɩɩ tinteyee deemba: Pɛsɩa, Lidiya arɩ Puti hɛ ŋ laalɩyuoroo tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ba joŋ ba hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ arɩ nyuŋ-chugbaŋkogunuŋ a sagɛ ŋ jeyee nyuŋ nɛ a laa yɩrɩŋ pɩŋ.

english_verse: Your guards came from Arvad and Cilicia, and men from Gamad stood watch in your towers. With their weapons hung on your walls, your beauty was complete.
translation_verse: Baalaa sɩ lɩɩ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Aavad arɩ tintee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛlɛk nɩɩ pɔŋ, ka baalaa sɩ lɩɩ Gamad ma sagɛ dɩɩ-leŋee nyuŋ a bibeŋ leriŋ, aŋ ma joŋ ba hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ sagɛ ŋ jeyee lɛ. Ba nɛ leŋe ŋ chaasa zɔŋ.

english_verse: You also did business with people from Rhodes, and people from nations along the coast gave you ivory and ebony in exchange for your goods.
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩ Dɛdaŋ tɩŋŋaa ma dii yɔbɔ nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ jesiŋ kala ka dii yɔbɔ ŋ lɛ nɛ. Ba yie joŋ batu-nyɩlaa arɩ kalɩ-daasɩŋ a kaa lenni ŋ kɩaa.

english_verse: Judah and Israel gave you their finest wheat, fancy figs, honey, olive oil, and spices in exchange for your merchandise.
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩ Juda nɩaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma dii yɔbɔ nɛ. Ba kɛŋ mɛmpɛ a kaa lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɩnɩf a pɛ kʋlɛnlɛmba lɛ: Tʋʋŋ, nʋʋŋ arɩ daalusuŋ ba sɩɩ tɩsʋ a lenni ŋ bayal kɩaa.

english_verse: The people of Dedan supplied you with saddle blankets,
translation_verse: Dɛdaŋ tɩŋŋaa ma kɛŋ janɩŋ kpɩɛraa nɛ kʋ yalla pɩŋ.

english_verse: while people from Arabia and the rulers of Kedar traded lambs, sheep, and goats.
translation_verse: Arebia arɩ Kɛda tinteeŋ kuoroo kala ŋaa ŋ yɔɔ-diire nɛ. Ba yie kɛŋ pie-pɔrɔɔ, pie-belliŋ arɩ bʋʋnaa kʋ lenni ŋ bayal kɩaa.

english_verse: Merchants from Sheba and Raamah gave you excellent spices, precious stones, and gold in exchange for your products.
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩ bayalɩa-la sɩ lɩɩ Sɛɛba arɩ Rama ma dii yɔbɔ nɛ. Ba joŋ tegisi doho kala sɩ zɔmɔ arɩ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa arɩ sɛlɩmɛ a lenni ŋ bayal kɩaa.

english_verse: You also did business with merchants from the cities of Haran, Canneh, Eden, Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad,
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩ tabalaa deemba: Haraŋ, Kannɛ, Ɛdɩŋ arɩ Sɛɛba, Asu arɩ Kɩlɩma bayalaa ma ka dii yɔbɔ nɛ.

english_verse: and they gave you expensive clothing, purple and embroidered cloth, brightly colored rugs, and strong rope.
translation_verse: Ŋ yɔbɔ lɛ nɛ ba faa yallɛ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ, gɛrɩ-diibelimbisiŋ, gɛrɩ-sʋalaa arɩ gɛrɩ-ŋmʋŋmʋnaa sɩ kɛŋ jʋɔsaa, ba sɩ kaa mɩlɩmɛ mɩlɩmɛ a kaa gul woruŋ ba joŋoo tɔ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Large, seagoing ships carried your goods wherever they needed to go. You were like a ship loaded with heavy cargo
translation_verse: Taasɩs lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ nɩɩ chʋŋ ŋ bayal kɩaa. Ŋ kala suo nɛ arɩ chʋgʋsʋ-la sɩ yuŋŋie a chɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: and sailing across the sea, but you were wrecked by strong eastern winds.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kori ŋ danyinsiŋ kɛnɩŋ duoroo gɔllɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ama peliŋ jaŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kʋ ŋmobuŋ yɛrɛ muno muno mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The shouts of your drowning crew were heard on the shore.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ ŋmoo niiŋ dɩ tinteeŋ zigili.

english_verse: Every ship is deserted; rowers and sailors and captains all stand on shore,
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kori ŋ danyinsiŋ jaŋ vɩa ba lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ ta, lɩɩ-duoroo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ tʋɔŋ kala jaŋ lɩɩ chɩŋ lɩɩŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: mourning for you. They show their sorrow by putting dust on their heads and rolling in ashes;
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ suri niiŋ a yel ŋ wɩaa woruŋ, aŋ ŋaa hagɩla hɛ ba nyusuŋ lɛ aŋ bibilimi tʋɔrʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: they shave their heads and dress in sackcloth as they cry in despair.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ fʋŋ ba nyusuŋ a tɩŋ ŋ wɩaa, aŋ laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ. Ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ faasa chei dɩ ba yel ŋ wɩaa woruŋ.

english_verse: In their grief they sing a funeral song for you: “Tyre, you were greater than all other cities. But now you lie in silence at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɩɩ yel ŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ ta jembiiŋ tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ a bʋl, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa fʋlʋlʋ, a nagɛ Taaya mʋgʋ-balɩŋ sɩ gollo chu?’

english_verse: “Nations that received your merchandise were always pleased; kings everywhere got rich from your costly goods.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ kɛŋ ŋ bayal kɩaa chol mʋgʋ-balɩŋ cholo, ŋ leŋe tintee daŋ nɛ na ba kʋchɛɛlɛɛ, ŋ dʋa daŋ-la arɩ ŋ bayal kɩaa leŋe dʋnɩa kuoroo ŋaa kɩa tɩmma nɛ.

english_verse: But now you are wrecked in the deep sea, with your cargo and crew scattered everywhere.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ ŋ yɛrɛ nɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, a tuu lɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ dɩ-luŋuŋ. Ŋ bayal kɩaa arɩ ŋ nɩaa kala nɛ to ŋ harɩŋ tuu lɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: People living along the coast are shocked at the news. Their rulers are horrified, and terror is written across their faces.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa ŋ lɛ kperi nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɔŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ nɛ, fawʋllʋŋ chaasa kɛŋ ba kuoroo. Ba sɩaa ŋaa forumo forumo.

english_verse: The merchants of the world can't believe what happened. Your death was gruesome, and you are gone forever.”
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa bayallaa vigisi nyusuŋ nɛ ŋ wɩaa. Ŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ lɔrɔ nɛ, ŋ tuo a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ, ʋ sɩ:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the king of Tyre that I am saying: You are so arrogant that you think you're a god and that the city of Tyre is your throne. You may claim to be a god, though you're nothing but a mere human.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ, bʋla pɩ Taaya kuoro, “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ŋ bigisi ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ a bʋl, ‘Mɩ ŋaa wɩa nɛ, a hɔŋ wɩa kuoru kpasa nyuŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ.’ Ama ŋ ŋaa nuhuobiiŋ nɛ, ŋ bɩ wɩa ŋaa, ŋ sɩ bɩɩna ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa a nagɛ wɩa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You think you're wiser than Daniel and know everything.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩɩna ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa kɩɩ Danɩɛl nɛ, a jɩŋ wɩɩ-kalaa?

english_verse: Your wisdom has certainly made you rich, because you have storehouses filled with gold and silver.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɛŋ ŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ ŋ sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa nɛ a dʋa kɩaa pɩ ŋ tɩtɩa, a dʋa sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla a su ŋ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: You're a clever businessman and are extremely wealthy, but your wealth has led to arrogance!
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ jɩŋ bayalɩŋ wɩaa woruŋ, ŋɩɩ leŋe ŋ dʋa pʋŋa pɛ nɛ. Ŋ dʋa sɩ pʋŋa pɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋ kɛŋ babii-ballɩŋ.

english_verse: You compared yourself to a god, so now I, the Lord God,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩɩ bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ bɩɩna ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa a nagɛ wɩa ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: will make you the victim of cruel enemies. They will destroy all the possessions you've worked so hard to get.
translation_verse: mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ nɩwogusuŋ kʋ hɛ ŋ lɛ, tinteye-la nɩaa tʋɔŋ sɩ chaasa hɛɩ woruŋ. Ba jaŋ chei kʋzɔmɔ-la kala ŋ sɩ kɛŋ ŋ jɩma arɩ ŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ chɛ, a chei ŋ tʋla kala.

english_verse: Your enemies will brutally kill you, and the sea will be your only grave.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kpʋŋ, dɩ ŋ sʋʋ nɩduo sʋʋŋ a tuu mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: When you face your enemies, will you still claim to be a god? They will attack, and you will suffer like any other human.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ kɔ dɩ ba kpʋŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo bʋl dɩ ŋ ŋaa wɩa nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpʋŋ sɩpaaŋ? Ŋ jaŋ ŋaa nuhuobiiŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpʋŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩa.

english_verse: Foreigners will kill you, and you will die the death of those who don't worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken. A Funeral Song for the King of Tyre
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ a nagɛ disiŋ tɩɩna tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, sing a funeral song for the king of Tyre and tell him I am saying: At one time, you were perfect, intelligent, and good-looking.
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, ta jembiiŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ Taaya kuoro lɛ: Bʋla pʋ wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩɩ bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: Ŋ fa bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ, nʋʋkala bibeŋ ŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a zɔŋ ma woruŋ.

english_verse: You lived in the garden of Eden and wore jewelry made of brightly colored gems and precious stones. They were all set in gold and were ready for you on the day you were born.
translation_verse: Ŋ fa hɛ Ɛdɩŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ-na Wɩa ŋmaŋkaa-la lɛ. Ŋ faa laalɛ tabɩɩ-zɔŋ dosunu-la ba sɩ kaa ŋaa yaraa kpɩɛraa nɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ rubi, topas arɩ ɛmɛral, kirisola, ɔnɩs, jasɩpa, safɩya, takʋa arɩ bɛrɛl. Ŋ fa kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ kpɩɛraa nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ ŋaaŋ, kɩaa deemba kala hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ a gbɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: I appointed a winged creature to guard your home on my holy mountain, where you walked among gems that dazzled like fire.
translation_verse: Mɩ lɩɩsɛ mɩ-na Wɩa tɩndaara sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ nɛ ʋ pɔŋ. Ŋ hɛ mɩ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ nɛ, a vɩvɛŋ tabɩa-la sɩɩ chol nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You were truly good from the time of your birth, but later you started doing wicked things.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ ŋaaŋ, ŋ fa bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ a kʋʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ suomoo ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: You traded with other nations and became more and more cruel and evil. So I forced you to leave my mountain, and the creature that had been your protector now chased you away from the jewels.
translation_verse: Ŋ bayalɩŋ fa yʋga, ŋɩɩ leŋ ŋ ŋaa nii-jɩgɛ tɩɩna a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kiriŋ ta mɩ-na Wɩa peel-la nyuŋ, mɩ tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ pɔŋ nɛ kiriŋ ta ŋ lɩɩ tabɩa-la sɩɩ chol nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: It was your good looks that made you arrogant, and you were so famous that you started acting like a fool. That's why I threw you to the ground and let other kings sneer at you.
translation_verse: Ŋ faa dagɛ ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ zɔmɔ wɩaa. Ŋ yɩrɩŋ sɩɩ sii ŋɩɩ ŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ leŋ ŋ chei ŋ tɩtɩa. Mɩ joŋuŋ yuo ta tinteeŋ, kuoroo kala chaarɛ sɩaa pɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You have cheated so many other merchants that your places of worship are corrupt. So I set your city on fire and burned it down. Now everyone sees only ashes where your city once stood,
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yʋgɛ nɛ ŋ bayalɩŋ lɛ a chei ŋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ leree kala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ ŋ taŋ lɛ, ʋ kala dii buru a pɩŋ tinteeŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ beniŋ na arɩ ŋ die nɛ a bɩrɩmɛ tʋɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: and the people of other nations are shocked. Your punishment was horrible, and you are gone forever. Judgment on Sidon and Peace for Israel
translation_verse: Tinteye-la kala sɩ jɩmɩŋ naŋ a hihirigi nɛ. Ŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ chaasa lɔrɛ nɛ, ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.” Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Sɩdɔŋ lɛ

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the city of Sidon
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, joŋ ŋ sɩaa chaasɛ Sɩdɔŋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ

english_verse: and tell its people: I, the Lord God, am your enemy! People will praise me when I punish you, and they will see that I am holy.
translation_verse: a bʋl, Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Sɩdɔŋ, mɩ chɩŋ ŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ yuoŋ a laa yɩrɩŋ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dagɛ arɩ mɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I will send deadly diseases to wipe you out, and I will send enemies to invade and surround you. Your people will be killed, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ ŋ lɛ dɩ chalɩŋ jaasɛ ŋ womporunuŋ lɛ. Nɩaa jaŋ lɩɩ sɛmɛ na-kala a kʋ yuoŋ, a kpʋ ŋ nɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: When that happens, the people of Israel will no longer have cruel neighbors that abuse them and make them feel as though they are in a field of thorns and briers. And the Israelites will know that I, the Lord God, have done these things. A Blessing for Israel
translation_verse: Tinteye-la kala sɩ golli Iziral tɩŋŋaa a kɛmba ŋmuŋmoo gbɛɛŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ nagɛ sɔsʋŋ a tʋtɔɔba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God said: Someday I will gather the people of Israel from the nations where they are now scattered, and every nation will see that I am holy. The Israelites will once again live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɩɩ lere-la kala ba sɩ pɩsa hɛ a kaa kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ, tinteye-la jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa jaŋ hɔŋ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ, tintee-la mɩ fa sɩ joŋo pɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna Jekɔb.

english_verse: They will be safe and will build houses and plant vineyards. They will no longer be in danger, because I will punish their hateful neighbors. Israel will know that I am the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ, wɩɩkala bɩ baa walɩmɛ, a saa dɩɩsɩŋ a pɛrɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɔnɔ kpagɛba a bene gʋʋnɛba. Iziral tɩŋŋaa jaŋ hɔŋ sɔm, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: Ten years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the twelfth day of the tenth month. He said:
translation_verse: La fa sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ jɩsɩŋ fii tʋɔŋ chɛŋ fii, tapʋl fii arɩ balɩa chɛɛŋ, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ, ʋ sɩ:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the king of Egypt. Tell him and his people
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ, joŋ sɩaa chaasɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro a bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa kala lɛ.

english_verse: that I am saying: King of Egypt, you were like a giant crocodile lying in a river. You acted as though you owned the Nile and made it for yourself. But now I, the Lord God, am your enemy!
translation_verse: Bʋla pʋ, Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ chɩŋ ŋ-na Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro lɛ nɛ. Ŋ nagɛ peribanyeŋŋu nɛ a pɩŋ ŋ fuonaasɩŋ lɛ. Ŋ sɩ, ‘Mɩ nɛ tɩɩ Naayɩl fuo-la, mɩ-na nɛ luu a pɩ mɩ tɩtɩa.’

english_verse: I will put a hook in your jaw and pull you out of the water, and all the fish in your river will stick to your scaly body.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ jaŋ joŋ gbɩamba hɛ ŋ tapaŋaa lɛ, aŋ leŋ dɩ chenfile-la sɩ hɛ ŋ fuonuŋ lɛ kʋ mɛrɛ ŋ horuŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ lɛrɩŋ lɩɩsɛ ŋ fuonu-la lɛ, a pɛ chenfile-la sɩ mɛrɛ ŋ horuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I'll throw you and the fish into the desert, and your body will fall on the hard ground. You will be left unburied, and wild animals and birds will eat your flesh.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ ŋ dɩ chenfile-la kala ta tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. Ma jaŋ pɩŋ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ paama. Mɩ jaŋ jomma pɩ baga kɩaa arɩ zaaraa dɩ ba dii.

english_verse: Then everyone in Egypt will know that I am the Lord. You and your nation refused to help the people of Israel and were nothing more than a broken stick.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA. Ma nagɛ mɔrʋŋ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ.

english_verse: When they reached out to you for support, you broke in half, cutting their arms and making them fall.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ kɛmma, ma yie bori nɛ, dɩ ba nɛ yellima, ma yie bori nɛ ka ba tel ba tɩnsɩŋ tʋgɛ.

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will send troops to attack you, king of Egypt. They will kill your people and livestock,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ laalɩyuoroo kʋ hɛ ŋ lɛ, dɩ ba kpʋ ŋ nɩaa arɩ ba pʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: until your land is a barren desert. Then you will know that I have done these things. You claimed that you made the Nile River and control it.
translation_verse: Ijipiti tinteeŋ jaŋ pɩŋ hoi. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA. A tɩŋ ŋ fa sɩ sɩ, ‘Naayɩl fuo-la ŋaa mɩ kʋa nɛ, mɩ-na nɛ luo.’

english_verse: Now I am turning against you and your river. Your nation will be nothing but an empty wasteland all the way from the town of Migdol in the north to Aswan in the south, and as far as the border of Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ chɩŋ ŋ dɩ ŋ fuonuŋ kala lɛ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ pɩŋ hoi a ŋaa jikpeeŋ, a chɩŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɩgɩdɔl a kaa mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩwaŋ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Kus tinteeŋ bʋa.

english_verse: No human or animal will even dare travel through Egypt, because no sign of life will be found there for
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ koo pʋna kala naaŋ bɩ jaŋ to lee-la bal. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ yi jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa.

english_verse: They will once again live in their homeland in southern Egypt. But they will be a weak kingdom
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɛmba lɩɩ lee-la ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛba kaa mʋ, a kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Patʋrɔs, ba naabalɩmaba tinteeŋ. Nɩmɛ ba jaŋ ŋaa kuori-gentine nɩaa sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: My own people Israel will never again depend on your nation. In fact, when the Israelites remember what happened to you Egyptians, they will realize how wrong they were to turn to you for help. Then the Israelites will know that I, the Lord God, did these things. King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia Will Conquer Egypt
translation_verse: Ijipiti tinteeŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa lee Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ. Ama ba jaŋ liliisi wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa, ba sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa mʋ mɛrɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa lɛ dɩ ba pɛ ba lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ.”

english_verse: Twenty-seven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the first month. He said:
translation_verse: La fa sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ balɩpɛ, chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tʋɔŋ tapʋl-bumbuŋ chɛɛŋ, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ:

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked the city of Tyre. He forced his soldiers to carry so many heavy loads that their heads were rubbed bald, and their shoulders were red and sore. Nebuchadnezzar and his army still could not capture the city.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo ba chaasa mʋ yuo tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Taaya nɛ. Ʋ leŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo chʋŋ kʋyuŋŋoo ba nyusuŋ kala puori, ba vaasɩŋ ma kala fol fol. Ama ʋ dɩ ʋ laalɩyuoro-la sɩ na kɩalɩŋ bɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ lɔlɔ Taaya lɛ maga.

english_verse: So now I will hand over the nation of Egypt to him. He will take Egypt's valuable treasures and give them to his own troops.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩɩ bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa a hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ chʋŋ ba dʋa kala kaa viiri. Ʋ jaŋ yuo paa Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa dʋa kala a joŋo tiŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo.

english_verse: Egypt will be his reward, because he and his army have been following my orders. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa dʋa a titimu, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ dɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo sɩɩ ŋaa, ba ŋaa pɩpɩmɛ nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Ezekiel, when Egypt is defeated, I will make the people of Israel strong, and I will give you the power to speak to them. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla nɛ kʋ ŋaa, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kɛŋ doluŋ, aŋ pɩ ŋ ma Ɛzɩkɩɛl doluŋ dɩ ŋ wuo bʋl wɩaa pɩba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Egypt that I am saying: Cry out in despair,
translation_verse: ʋ sɩ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, bʋl wɩaa mɩ doluŋ lɛ a bʋl, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Heele bʋl, tapʋl-bɔmʋŋ ka kɔ nɛ.’

english_verse: because you will soon be punished! That will be a time of darkness and doom for all nations.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la kpaga nɛ, La TƖƖNA tapʋlʋŋ kpaga nɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa jaŋ tɔ, dɩ wɩaa jʋʋ tinteyee nɩaa.

english_verse: Your own nation of Egypt will be attacked, and Ethiopia will suffer. You will be killed in battle, and your land will be robbed and left in ruins.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ kʋ yuo Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa, dɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ yʋgɛ Kus tinteeŋ lɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ kpʋ nɩaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ paa ʋ dʋa kaa viiri, ka dɩ tintee-la pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: Soldiers hired from Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, Arabia, Kub, as well as from Israel, will die in that battle.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kpʋ laalɩyuoro-la kala ba sɩ joŋ moribiee pa aŋ kaa lɩɩ tinteyee deemba kɔ: Kus, Puti, Lidiya, Arebia, Libiya, arɩ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa, a pɛ Ijipiti laalɩyuoroo lɛ.”

english_verse: All of your allies will be killed, and your proud strength will crumble. People will die from Migdol in the north to Aswan in the south. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kʋ pɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa lɛ jaŋ sʋʋ, dɩ dol-la Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩ kaa kɛŋ babii-ballɩŋ kala ŋaa pɛɩ. A chɩŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɩgɩdɔl lɛ a kaa mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩwaŋ, laalɩŋ jaŋ kpʋ ba nɩaa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Your nation of Egypt will be the most deserted place on earth, and its cities will lie in complete ruin.
translation_verse: Ba tinteeŋ nɛ jaŋ faasa pɩŋ hoi tinteye-la sɩ pɩŋ hoi lɛ tʋɔŋ, dɩ ba tabalaa ma pɩŋ jikpeeniŋ.

english_verse: I will set fire to your land, and anyone who defended your nation will die. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, a kpʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.

english_verse: On the same day I destroy Egypt, I will send messengers to the Ethiopians to announce their coming destruction. They think they are safe, but they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ chei Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa, mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ nɩaa dɩ ba jʋʋ lɩɩŋ-daborusuŋ a mʋ fugisi Kus tɩŋŋaa, ba sɩ ta jɩa ŋɩɩ. Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmba Ijipiti tapʋl cheyiŋ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la sɛnɛ ka kɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Your Egyptian army is very strong, but I will send King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to completely defeat that army.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ to Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza lɛ a leŋ dɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori daŋ-la kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: He and his cruel troops will invade and destroy your land and leave your dead bodies piled everywhere.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩ ʋ laalɩyuoro-la sɩ faasa bɔŋ tinteyee kala tʋɔŋ jaŋ kʋ chei tintee-la. Ba jaŋ kʋ yuo Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ tokobiee, a kpʋ nɩaa su tintee-la kala.
