english_verse: I will dry up the Nile River, then sell the land to evil buyers. I will send foreigners to turn your entire nation into a barren desert. I, the Lord, have spoken. Egypt's Proud Cities Will Lie in Ruins The Lord said to the people of Egypt:
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Naayɩl fuo-la lɩɩŋ hʋ, aŋ joŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa hɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa jaŋ chei tintee-la. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: All the idols and images you Egyptians worship in the city of Memphis will be smashed. No one will be left to rule your nation, and terror will fill the land.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ chei ba tɔŋŋɔɔ a leŋ dɩ vesiŋ sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Memfis lɛ wɩaa dɛrɛ. Nʋʋkala jaŋ tuo sɩ jaŋ beŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: The city of Pathros will be left in ruins, and Zoan will be burned to the ground. Thebes, your capital city, will also be destroyed!
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ kala pɩŋ hoi, aŋ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zʋaŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ, aŋ dɔgɩsɛ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛbɛs tɩŋŋaa ma woruŋ.

english_verse: The fortress city of Pelusium will feel my fierce anger, and all the troops stationed at Thebes will be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ faasa na baanɩŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Pɛlʋsɩyʋm lɛ, Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa dɩ-duoŋ, aŋ chei Tɛbɛs tɩŋŋaa nɩ-daŋ-la kala.

english_verse: I will set fire to your nation of Egypt! The city of Pelusium will be in anguish. Thebes will fall, and the people of Memphis will live in constant fear.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nyiniŋ dii Ijipiti, dɩ Pɛlʋsɩyʋm nɩaa na hɛɛŋ woruŋ. Mɩ jaŋ ŋmoo Tɛbɛs lo. Memfis nɩaa ma jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔ-cheeŋ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: The young soldiers in the cities of Heliopolis and Bubastis will die in battle, and the rest of the people will be taken prisoner.
translation_verse: Bapʋɔsɩa-la kala sɩ hɛ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Heliopolis arɩ Bʋbasɩtɩs jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, ka dɩ ba kɛsɛ nɩkaana-la kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga.

english_verse: You were so proud of your nation's power, but when I crush that power and kill that pride, darkness will fall over the city of Tahpanhes. A dark, gloomy cloud will cover the land as you are being led away into captivity.
translation_verse: Birimiŋ jaŋ hɛ Tapanhɛs lɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ chei Ijipiti doluŋ, a leŋ dɩ ba babii-ballɩŋ dɛrɛ. Duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa jaŋ kʋ tɔ ʋ kala, dɩ ba kɛsɛ ba nɩaa ma kaa mʋ dɩ ba ŋaa yosi.

english_verse: When I'm through punishing Egypt, you will know that I am the Lord. Egypt's King Is Powerless
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ dɔgɩsɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa, ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the seventh day of the first month. He said:
translation_verse: La fa sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ jɩ-fii arɩ kʋbala tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I, the Lord, have defeated the king of Egypt! I broke his arm, and no one has wrapped it or put it in a sling, so that it could heal and get strong enough to hold a sword.
translation_verse: ʋ sɩ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, mɩ bori Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ nɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ nɩsɩ-la vɔbɔ koo a joŋ na-boruŋ kʋa laasɛ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ fɩɛlɛ, a bɩra kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ wuo kaa kori tokobiiŋ.

english_verse: So tell him that I am now his worst enemy. I will break both his arms—the good one and the broken one! His sword will drop from his hand forever,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ chɩŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro lɛ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ bori ʋ nɩsaa, ʋ na-zɔŋ-la arɩ ʋ na-borii-la kala, dɩ tokobii-la lɩɩ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ foro tel.

english_verse: and I will scatter the Egyptians all over the world.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa pɩsa hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I will strengthen the power of Babylonia's king and give him my sword to use against Egypt. I will also make the wounded king of Egypt powerless, and he will moan in pain and die in front of the Babylonian king. Then everyone on earth will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsaa kɛŋ doluŋ, ka dɩ Ijipiti kuoro nɩsaa ŋaa gbɛlɛɛ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ tokobiiŋ a hɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kaa je Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.

english_verse: I will force the Egyptians to live as prisoners in foreign nations, and they will know that I, the Lord, have punished them.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa pɩsa hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the third month. He said:
translation_verse: La fa sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ, jɩ-fii arɩ kʋbala tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-tori tapʋl-bumbuŋ lɛ, La TƖƖNA bʋla wɩaa pɩmɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the king of Egypt and his people that I am saying: You are more powerful than anyone on earth. Now listen to this.
translation_verse: ʋ sɩ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, bʋla pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ nɩaa: Ma kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ! Nʋʋkala tuo a magɛma.

english_verse: There was once a cedar tree in Lebanon with large, strong branches reaching to the sky.
translation_verse: Bee na Asiiria, ʋ fa nagɛ kuolu tɩa sɩ hɛ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ naakelee zɔŋ woruŋ, a lugo tɔ duu-la a jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ woruŋ, ʋ nyu-gbaŋa jɩla kieli tɩɩsɩ-la.

english_verse: This tree had plenty of water to help it grow tall, and nearby streams watered the other trees in the forest.
translation_verse: Lɩɩŋ fa hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ, a leŋ ʋ waa a duomi woruŋ. Lɩɩ-bul-sɩaa pɛllɛ gugolli ʋ gentine kala, a pɛllɛ mʋ jʋjʋʋ tɩɩsɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ duu-la lɛ.

english_verse: But this tree towered over those other trees, and its branches grew long and thick.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩa-la waa a kɩɩ tɩɩsɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ duu-la lɛ. Ʋ naakelee duomi aŋ barɩmɛ woruŋ a jɛrɛ a tɩŋ lɩɩŋ sɩ vɔgʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Birds built nests in its branches, and animals were born beneath it. People from all nations lived in the shade of this strong tree.
translation_verse: Diibiisiŋ kala saa ba dɛllɩŋ tɩa-la naakelee lɛ, bagɩlaa ma lʋl ba biiriŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ. Tintee balaa kala hɛ ʋ fɩɛlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: It had beautiful, long branches, and its roots found water deep in the soil.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa chaasa zɔŋ nɛ woruŋ, a kɛŋ naakel-duduosuŋ, ʋ naapoloo ma tuu yi lɩɩ-jɩna lɛ.

english_verse: None of the cedar trees in my garden of Eden were as beautiful as this tree; no tree of any kind had such long branches.
translation_verse: Kuolu tɩɩsɩ-la kala fa sɩ hɛ Wɩa ŋmaŋkaa-la lɛ kʋŋkala bɩ ʋ maga. Tɩɩsɩ-la kala sɩ waa a kɛŋ naakel-duduosuŋ, ma kʋŋkala fa bɩ ʋ maga. Tɩa kala fa tuo Wɩa ŋmaŋkaa-la tʋɔŋ a zɔmɔ magʋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, gave this tree its beauty, and I helped the branches grow strong. All other trees in Eden wanted to be just like it.
translation_verse: Mɩ leŋe ʋ zɔŋ nɛ a kɛŋ naakelee yʋgɛ. Tɩɩsɩ-la kala fa sɩ hɛ Ɛdɩŋ lɛ, Wɩa ŋmaŋkaa-la, yaraa faa bieri ʋ nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: King of Egypt, now listen to what I, the Lord God, am saying about that tree: The tree grew so tall that it reached the sky and became very proud and arrogant.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: A tɩŋ ʋ sɩ waa a kɩɩ tɩɩsɩ-la kala a jɩla tɩgɛ wɩa-nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ dɩdagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will reject the tree and hand it over to a foreign ruler, who will punish it for its wickedness.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋu hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ dɔgʋsʋ a tɩŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Mɩ vɩaʋ ta nɛ,

english_verse: Cruel foreigners will chop it down and leave it wherever it falls. Branches and broken limbs will be scattered over the mountains and in the valleys. The people living in the shade of those branches will go somewhere else.
translation_verse: tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa sɩ faasa bɔŋ tinteyee kala tʋɔŋ kʋ keru lo ʋ pɩŋ nɩmɛ. Ʋ naakel-balaa arɩ kʋbiisiŋ kala bori a pɩŋ ba tinteeŋ peelee arɩ fuonaasɩŋ lɛ. Ba boro pɩŋ fuonaasɩŋ sɩ luŋie lɛ. Tinteye-la kala fa sɩ hɛ ʋ fɩɛlɩŋ lɛ fá viiri aŋ leŋu.

english_verse: Birds will then nest on the stump of the fallen tree, and wild animals will trample its branches.
translation_verse: Diibiisiŋ togili naakele-la sɩ tele pɩŋ lɛ, bagɩlaa ma nʋɔsɛba bɩbal.

english_verse: Never again will any tree dare to grow as tall as this tree, no matter how much water it has. Every tree must die, just as humans die and go down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, a chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ, tɩa kala bɩra bɩ jaŋ waa a magɛ ŋɩɩ a jɩlaa tɩgɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, ʋ cho ʋ na lɩɩŋ a mɩmagɛ ɛɛ kala. Ba kala jaŋ sʋʋ a nagɛ nuhuobiinee sɩ yie sʋʋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ.”

english_verse: On the day this tree dies and goes to the world below, I, the Lord God, will command rivers and streams to mourn its death. Every underground spring of water and every river will stop flowing. The mountains in Lebanon will be covered with darkness as a sign of their sorrow, and all the trees in the forest will wither.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra sɩ: “Tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩa-la sɩ mʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ, mɩ leŋe lɩɩŋ lɩɩ tinteeŋ nɛ a tɔʋ, a dɩdagɛ ʋ yoho yeliŋ. Mɩ tɔ fuonuŋ arɩ lɩɩ-libisiŋ nɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ pɛllʋ. A tɩŋ tɩa-la sɩ sʋba wɩaa, mɩ leŋe birimiŋ kʋ tɔ Lɛbanɔŋ peelee nɛ, a leŋ tɩɩsɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ duu-la lɛ sʋʋ.

english_verse: This tree will crash to the ground, and I will send it to the world below. Then the nations of the earth will tremble. The trees from Eden and the choice trees from Lebanon are now in the world of the dead, and they will be comforted when this tree falls.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ leŋe ʋ tele sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ dɔmɔ leŋe tinteyee nɩaa chel nɛ. Tɩɩsɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ Ɛdɩŋ lɛ arɩ Lɛbanɔŋ tɩɩ-zɔmɔ-la kala sɩ nyʋa lɩɩŋ vɔgɛ aŋ sʋʋ, ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ tɩa-la teliŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Those people who found protection in its shade will also be sent to the world below, where they will join the dead.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ ma fa sɩ hɔŋ ʋ fɩɛlɩŋ lɛ, tinteye-la kala fa sɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ, sʋba nɛ ʋ dɩ ba kala mʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ a pɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: King of Egypt, all these things will happen to you and your people! You were like this tree at one time—taller and stronger than anyone on earth. But now you will be chopped down, just as every tree in the garden of Eden must die. You will be sent down to the world of the dead, where you will join the godless and the other victims of violent death. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Tɩa-la nɛ ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ nɩaa kala. Tɩɩsɩ-la kala fa sɩ hɛ Ɛdɩŋ lɛ kʋŋ bɩ waa a kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ magʋ. Ama lɛɛlɛ, a nagɛ Ɛdɩŋ tɩɩsɩ-la sɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ ma jaŋ sʋʋ a mʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ a pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to ba sɩ kpʋa laalɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Twelve years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the twelfth month. He said:
translation_verse: La fa sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ jɩ-fii arɩ balɩa tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-fii arɩ balɩa tapʋl bumbuŋ lɛ, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ, ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the king of Egypt and tell him I am saying: You act like a lion roaming the earth; but you are nothing more than a crocodile in a river, churning up muddy water with your feet.
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, ta jembiiŋ pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro a bʋla pʋ, ‘Ŋ nagɛ naachigiŋ nɛ tinteye-la tʋɔŋ, ŋ nagɛ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ peribanyeŋŋu nɛ a puŋŋi lɩɩŋ bɩbal, a kɛŋ ŋ naasɩŋ faasa vuugi lɩɩ-la, ʋ kala ŋaa gbʋna gbʋna.’ ”

english_verse: King of Egypt, listen to me. I, the Lord God, will catch you in my net and let a crowd of foreigners drag you to shore.
translation_verse: “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ tinteyee nɩaa nɛ yʋga a kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ, mɩ jaŋ yuo mɩ jóŋ a kɛnɩŋ kaa kʋ lɩɩ bil fuoŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: I will throw you into an open field, where birds and animals will come to feed on your flesh.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋuŋ yuo ta dɩ ŋ pɩŋ tintee-jaala lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ zaaraa arɩ baga kɩaa kala diiŋ.

english_verse: I will spread your rotting flesh over the mountains and in the valleys,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ nammɩa jɛrɛ peelee nyusuŋ aŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ haŋgbelee su fuonaasɩŋ.

english_verse: and your blood will flow throughout the land and fill up the streams.
translation_verse: Ŋ chalɩŋ jaŋ pɛllɛ su tinteeŋ, a lɩɩ peelee nyusuŋ a kʋ tuu su fuonaa luŋoo.

english_verse: I will cover the whole sky and every star with thick clouds, so that the sun and moon will stop shining.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ cheyiŋ dɛrɛ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kala biri dɩ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ́ wuo chaanɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ tɔ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, aŋ leŋ dɩ chɛnɛ ma sɩ́ wuo chaanɛ.

english_verse: The heavens will become black, leaving your country in total darkness. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɩsɛ wɩa-nyuŋ pʋlʋŋ kala, aŋ leŋ ŋ tinteeŋ kala biri. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Foreign nations you have never heard of will be shocked when I tell them how I destroyed you.
translation_verse: Tintee-daŋ nɩaa ŋ ha sɩ bɩ jɩŋ jaŋ hirigi, dɩ mɩ nɛ leŋe ba nɩɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ cheyiŋ.

english_verse: They will be horrified, and when I flash my sword in victory on the day of your death, their kings will tremble in the fear of what could happen to them.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ wɩaa kperi tintee daŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛŋ mɩ tokobiiŋ viisi ba nyusuŋ, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛŋ ba kuoroo dɩ ba chichel. Tapʋlɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ tel, ba kʋŋkala jaŋ chichel bʋa na-kala lɛ a tɩŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: The king of Babylonia is coming to attack you, king of Egypt!
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Babɩlɔŋ kuoro jaŋ kʋ yuo ŋ-na Ijipiti kuoro.

english_verse: Your soldiers will be killed by the cruelest army in the world, and everything you take pride in will be crushed.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ tintee-wogusuŋ laalɩyuoroo sɩ dolie a faasa bɔŋ kʋ kpʋ ŋ nɩaa kala. Ba jaŋ chei kʋŋ na-kala ŋ sɩ kaa ŋmuŋmoo bɔyɛ arɩ ŋ nɩaa kala.

english_verse: I will slaughter your cattle that graze by the river, and no people or livestock will be left to muddy its water.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kpʋ ŋ pʋsʋŋ kala sɩ hɛ fuoŋ niiŋ, nuhuobiiŋ koo pʋna jaŋ tuo sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ lɩɩ-la vuugi.

english_verse: The water will be clear, and streams will be calm. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ lɩɩrɩ-la fɩɛla pɩŋ, dɩ fuonaasɩŋ lɩɩŋ ma pɩpɛllɛ a nagɛ nʋʋŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Egypt will become a barren wasteland, and no living thing will ever survive there. Then you and your people will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ chei Ijipiti tinteeŋ a leŋ dɩ ʋ pɩŋ hoi, a kpʋ nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ lee-la, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.

english_verse: This is your warning, and it will be used as a funeral song by foreign women to mourn the death of your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken. A Sad Ending for Egypt
translation_verse: Jembii-la ba sɩ jaŋ ta pʋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Tintee-wogusuŋ haalaa jaŋ laa jembiiŋ deeŋ a yele hɛ pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ nɩaa kala sɩ sʋba. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.’ ”

english_verse: On the fifteenth day of that same month, the Lord said:
translation_verse: La fa sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ jɩ-fii arɩ balɩa, chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋl-fii arɩ banɔŋ chɛɛŋ, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ, ʋ sɩ:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, mourn for the Egyptians and condemn them to the world of the dead, where they will be buried alongside the people of other powerful nations.
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, yel a pɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa nɩ-daŋ-la kala sɩ jaŋ tuu bʋa a pɛ tintee-duoruŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tuu bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: Say to them: You may be more beautiful than the people of other nations, but you will also die and join the godless in the world below.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba, ‘Ma bɩɩna ma nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ nʋʋkala? Má mʋ a pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to lɛ.’

english_verse: You cannot escape! The enemy's sword is ready to slaughter every one of you.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ sʋʋ a pɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa laalɩŋ lɛ. Ba lɩɩsɛ tokobiiŋ nɛ, dɩ ba kpʋ ʋ nɩ-daŋ-la kala.

english_verse: The graves of soldiers from Assyria are there. They once terrified people, but they were killed in battle and now lie deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ba vaamaa hɛ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ dɩ-luŋii lɛ nɛ. Asiiria laalɩyuoroo kala nɛ ba kpʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, ba vaamaa golli ʋ vaamɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ hɛ tinteeŋ nɩaa lɛ, ba kala nɛ ba kpʋ laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The graves of soldiers from Elam are there. The very sight of those godless soldiers once terrified their enemies and made them panic. But now they are disgraced and ashamed as they lie in the world of the dead, alongside others who were killed in battle.
translation_verse: Ba bil bɔsɔ nɛ a pɩ Elam nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa tʋɔŋ, ʋ nɩ-daŋ-la kala vaamaa golli ʋ vaamɩŋ. Ba kala ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to nɛ. Ba kpʋ ba kala laalɩŋ lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba joŋ fawʋllʋŋ hɛ tinteeŋ nɩaa lɛ nɛ. Ama lɛɛlɛ ba sʋba nɛ a kɛŋ ba hɩɩsɩŋ mʋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ.

english_verse: The graves of soldiers from Meshech and Tubal are there. These godless soldiers who terrified people were all killed in battle.
translation_verse: Mɛsɛk arɩ Tubal kala hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ, ba laalɩyuoru daŋ-la vaamaa golliba. Nɩaa deemba kala fa ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to nɛ. Ba kpʋ ba kala laalɩŋ lɛ nɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ hɛ tinteeŋ nɩaa lɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: They were not given a proper burial like the heroes of long ago, who were buried with their swords under their heads and with their shields over their bodies. These were the heroes who made their enemies panic.
translation_verse: Ba fa bɩ ba-na hugo arɩ zile a nagɛ laalɩyuori babiibala-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ sʋʋ. Ba nyɩgɩla nɛ a mʋ lɛlɩŋ a pɩna yelli ba tokobiee, ka ba hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuori sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ ma dandaŋ ba nyuŋ. Nɩaa deemba fa ŋaa laalɩyuori babiibala nɛ a joŋ fawʋllʋŋ hɛ tinteeŋ nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: You Egyptians will be cruelly defeated, and you will be buried alongside these other godless soldiers who died in battle.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ba jaŋ chɔŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba pɩna guoli nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to ba sɩ kpʋa laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The graves of kings and leaders from Edom are there. They were powerful at one time. Now they are buried in the world of the dead with other godless soldiers killed in battle.
translation_verse: Ɛdɔm arɩ ʋ kuoro arɩ ʋ sɩpaalaaraa kala nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba fa ŋaa laalɩyuori-duori nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ba hɛ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ, ba dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to ba sɩ kpʋa laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The graves of the rulers of the north are there, as well as those of the Sidonians. Their powerful armies once terrified enemies. Now they lie buried in the world of the dead, where they are disgraced like other soldiers killed in battle.
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaara-la kala sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa arɩ Sɩdɔŋ tɩŋŋaa hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba doluŋ fa leŋe fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ nɩaa nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ba sʋba nɛ arɩ hɩɩsɩŋ, a mʋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa laalɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to. Ba ma pɛ dii hɩɩsɩ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ mʋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ sɩ die nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God says: When your king of Egypt sees all of these graves, he and his soldiers will be glad they are not the only ones suffering.
translation_verse: Dɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala nɛ mʋ na nɩaa deemba ba sɩ kpʋa laalɩŋ lɛ, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I sent him to terrify people all over the earth. But he and his army will be killed and buried alongside other godless soldiers in the world of the dead. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ leŋe Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro joŋ fawʋllʋŋ a hɛ tinteeŋ nɩaa lɛ nɛ, ama ba jaŋ kpʋ ʋ dɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala dɩ ba mʋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to ba sɩ kpʋa laalɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: and to sound a warning signal when the enemy is seen coming.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ na ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ka kɔ, ʋ yie ŋmoo bunso nɛ a leŋ nʋʋkala jɩŋ.

english_verse: Their past sins will be forgiven, and they will live because they have done right.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa kʋŋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ tutou. Ʋ to wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Twelve years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, a refugee who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me on the fifth day of the tenth month. He told me that the city had fallen.
translation_verse: La fa sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ jɩ-fii arɩ balɩa tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-fii tapʋl-nɔŋ chɛɛŋ, baal kʋbala sɩ foro lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ kɔ mɩ teeŋ a bʋla pɩmɛ, “Tabal-la tele nɛ.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, warn your people by saying: Someday, I, the Lord, may send an enemy to invade a country. And suppose its people choose someone to stand watch
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, bʋla pɩ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa, dɩ mɩ nɛ leŋe laalɩŋ kʋ jʋʋ tinteeŋ nɩaa, tintee-la nɩaa yie lɩɩsɛ ba tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ ʋ pɔ leriŋ a bibeŋ.

english_verse: If any of these people hear the signal and ignore it, they will be killed in battle. But it will be their own fault, because they could have escaped if they had paid attention.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ nɩɩ bunso-la aŋ bɩ kaa tɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ʋ sʋʋŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ fa kaa tɩŋ, ʋ fa jaŋ wuo laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: But suppose the person watching fails to sound the warning signal. The enemy will attack and kill some of the sinful people in that country, and I, the Lord, will hold that person responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ pɔ leriŋ a bibeŋ nɛ na dʋndɔmɔ-la dɩ baa kɔ ka dɩ ʋ vɩa dɩ ʋ ŋmoo bunso, ka dɩ ba kʋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala a tɩŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, tɩɩna sʋba nɛ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ pɔ leriŋ a bibeŋ nɛ jaŋ laa cheeriŋ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ, mɩ leŋe ŋ nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ pɔ leriŋ a bibeŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ŋɩɩ wɩaa jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ bʋl aŋ bʋl wɩaa chagɩlɛba a pɩmɛ.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways. But if you refuse to warn them, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋla pɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ, ka dɩ ŋ vɩa dɩ ŋ bʋl wɩaa chagɩlʋ dɩ ʋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ a laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ ʋ wʋbɔmɔ-la lɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ saa sʋba, mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ ʋ sʋʋŋ wɩaa a kɛŋ ŋ baŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: If you do warn them, and they keep sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent. The Lord Is Always Fair (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ bʋl wɩaa chagɩlɛ nɩbɔŋ-la, ka dɩ ʋ vɩa dɩ ʋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ a tɩŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, ama ŋ-na laa ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: If good people start doing evil, they will be put to death, because they have sinned.
translation_verse: Dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ leŋ tʋɔpʋl wɩaa ŋaanɩŋ, aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people with you in Babylonia talk about you when they meet by the city walls or in the doorways of their houses. They say, “Let's ask Ezekiel what the Lord has said today.”
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na nuhuobiiŋ, ŋ nɩaa nɛ chɩŋ ba taŋ jeeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ arɩ ba boiŋ-niiree a bʋbʋl ŋ wɩaa. Ba sɩ, ‘Má leŋ la mʋ Ɛzɩkɩɛl teeŋ a nɩɩ tɩndaarɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ La TƖƖNA teeŋ kɔ.’

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, the people of Israel are complaining that the punishment for their sins is more than they can stand. They have lost all hope for survival, and they blame me.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ, bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, wɩɩ-la ma sɩ yie bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: ‘La wʋcheelee arɩ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nyagɛla bil nɛ, la jagɛ a tɩŋ ba wɩaa. Ɛɛ nɛ saa la jaŋ ŋaa a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ?’

english_verse: Tell them that as surely as I am the living Lord God, I don't like to see wicked people die. I enjoy seeing them turn from their sins and live. So if the Israelites want to live, they must stop sinning and turn back to me.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ ŋmɩɛsa arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ bɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ sʋʋŋ lɛ ka tɔrɛ. Mɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ wʋŋaalaa lɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Iziral tɩmma, má leŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ma sɩɩ ŋaa. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma chɩchɛ dɩ ma sʋʋ?

english_verse: Tell them that when good people start sinning, all the good they did in the past cannot save them from being punished. And remind them that when wicked people stop sinning, their past sins will be completely forgiven, and they won't be punished.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ, lɛɛlɛ bʋla pɩ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ‘Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna aŋ mʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, tʋɔpʋla-la ʋ fa sɩ kɛnɛ bɩ jaŋ wuo laaʋ ta. Dɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ ma nɛ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ wʋŋaalaa lɛ, wʋbɔmɔ-la bɩra bɩ ʋ wuo to. Dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ chei, mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛʋ a tɩŋ tʋɔpʋl wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa wɩaa.’

english_verse: Suppose I promise good people that they will live, then later they start sinning and believe they will be saved by the good they did in the past. These people will certainly be put to death because of their sins. Their good deeds will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋla pɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna arɩ ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa hɛ ʋ tʋɔpʋl wʋŋaalɩa-la lɛ aŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ liisi tʋɔpʋl wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa kʋbala ma, ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ a tɩŋ wʋbɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: Suppose I warn wicked people that they will die because of their sins, and they stop sinning and start doing right.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ, ama dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ,

english_verse: For example, they need to return anything they have taken as security for a loan and anything they have stolen. Then if they stop doing evil and start obeying my Law, they will live.
translation_verse: a joŋ kʋ-la nʋʋ sɩ kaa kʋ bil aŋ laa chɩnnɩŋ a mɩɩra pɩ ʋ tɩɩna, a joŋ nɩaa ma kɩaa ʋ sɩ gaa a pɩba, aŋ tuto wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto sɩɩ pɩ mɩɩsɩŋ, aŋ bɩra bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ka ŋaa, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, your people accuse me of being unfair. But they are the ones who are unfair.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ, ‘La TƖƖNA wombiiŋ bɩ tʋʋla.’ Ama ba wombiiŋ nɛ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: And if wicked people stop sinning and start doing right, they will save themselves from punishment.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩbɔmʋŋ ma nɛ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ bɔnsʋŋ lɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: But the Israelites still think I am unfair. So warn them that they will be punished for what they have done. The News of Jerusalem's Fall
translation_verse: Ama Iziral tɩmma, ma sɩ, ‘La TƖƖNA wombiiŋ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ.’ Ama mɩ jaŋ dii ma kʋŋkala sarɩya a mʋʋ tɩgɛ ʋ wʋŋaalaa lɛ.” Ba dagɛ Jerusalɛm teliŋ bʋbʋɔŋ

english_verse: The evening before this man arrived at my house, the Lord had taken control of me. So when the man came to me the next morning, I could once again speak. What Will Happen to Those Left in Israel?
translation_verse: Dɩdaaŋ-la sɩ bala ka baal-la-na kɔ mɩ teeŋ, La TƖƖNA dol-la fa hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ suri mɩ niiŋ nɛ, ka baal-la-na kɔ mɩ teeŋ ŋɩɩ chʋchʋɔŋ, mɩ bɩra wuo bʋbʋl wɩaa.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in the ruined cities of Israel are saying, “Abraham was just one man, and the Lord gave him this whole land of Israel. There are many of us, and so this land must be ours.”
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Iziral jikpeeniŋ lɛ ka bʋl, ‘Abɩraham fa ŋaa nɩbala nɛ, aŋ tɩɩ tintee-la. Ama la nɛ paala yʋgɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa tintee-la ŋaa la kʋŋ nɛ.’

english_verse: So, Ezekiel, tell them I am saying: How can you think the land is still yours? You eat meat with blood in it and worship idols. You commit murder
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, bʋl wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla a pɩba: Ma yie chɩchaŋ nammɩa arɩ chalɩŋ nɛ, a kpʋkpaarɛ vʋɩyaa, a kpʋkpʋ nɩaa ma. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma bɩɩnɛ tintee-la maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ nɛ?

english_verse: and spread violence throughout the land. Everything you do is wicked; you are even unfaithful in marriage. And you claim the land is yours!
translation_verse: Ma yɩɛlaa hɛ ma tokobiee lɛ nɛ, a ŋɩŋaa wʋkɩsaa. Ma gʋra kɛŋ dɔŋɔ ba haalaa pɩpɩŋ nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma bɩɩnɛ arɩ tintee-la maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ nɛ?

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, you people in the ruined cities will be killed in battle. Those of you living in the countryside will be eaten by wild animals, and those hiding in caves and on rocky cliffs will die from deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ ŋmɩɛsa: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka jikpeeni-la lɛ kala jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ baga kɩaa chaŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ jeeŋ harɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ faa dɩ-duoruŋ arɩ bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ lɛ, nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kpʋba.

english_verse: I will make the whole country an empty wasteland and crush the power in which you take such pride. Even the mountains will be bare, and no one will try to cross them.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma tinteeŋ kala pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a ŋaa hoi. Dol-la ma sɩ kaa bibigisi ma tɩtɩa lɛ jaŋ dɛrɛ. Iziral peelee ma jaŋ pɩŋ hoi, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ to ba nyuŋ bal.

english_verse: I will punish you because of your sins, and I will turn your nation into a barren desert. Then you will know that I am the Lord. The People Listen, but Don't Change The Lord said:
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ dɔgɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa a tɩŋ wʋkɩsɩa-la ba sɩ ŋaa wɩaa, a leŋ dɩ ba tinteeŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a ŋaa hoi, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.

english_verse: So they all come and listen to you, but they refuse to do what you tell them. They claim to be faithful, but they are forever trying to cheat others out of their money.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a kɔ ŋ teeŋ dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa, ama ba bɩ jaŋ kɛmba tɩŋ. Ba niiree yie bʋbʋl wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, ama ba tʋɔŋ bɔmɔ a gɩrɩma lɩlaa nɩaa kɩaa.

english_verse: They treat you as though you were merely singing love songs or playing music. They listen, but don't do anything you say.
translation_verse: Ba yie joŋuŋ ŋ nagɛ nʋʋ yikoro sɩ sɩma ʋ yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa sɩ mʋʋ tɩgɛ chonuŋ lɛ nɛ, a du kɩaa hɩhɛ. Ba yie jegili wɩalɩŋ woruŋ, ama ba bɩ jaŋ to ba kʋbala ma.

english_verse: Soon they will be punished, just as you warned, and they will know that a prophet has been among them.
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩaa deemba kala nɛ kʋ ŋaa, ba saa jaŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ fa hɛ ba tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ, ʋ sɩ:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, Israel's leaders are like shepherds taking care of my sheep, the people of Israel. But I want you to condemn these leaders and tell them: I, the Lord God, say you shepherds of Israel are doomed! You take care of yourselves while ignoring my sheep.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ, mɩ doluŋ lɛ, bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa lɛ. Bʋla pɩba, “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩɩŋ puu Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaara-la sɩ chɩl ba dʋndʋŋa wɩaa. Mɩ bɩɩna pie-daara nɛ yie bibeŋ ʋ piesee nyuŋ?

english_verse: You drink their milk and use their wool to make your clothes. Then you butcher the best ones for food. But you don't take care of the flock!
translation_verse: Ma yie dii nayɩl dɩndɛrɩŋ, a kɛŋ piese-la pʋnaa gɛnnɩŋ tɔ ma tɩtɩa, a kpʋ pʋsʋ-la sɩ zɔmɔ a chaŋ, ama ma bɩ ba nyuŋ ka beŋ.

english_verse: You have never protected the weak ones or healed the sick ones or bandaged those that get hurt. You let them wander off and never look for those that get lost. You are cruel and mean to my sheep.
translation_verse: Pʋsʋ-la sɩ pʋgʋma, ma bɩ ŋaa ba kɛŋ doluŋ, kɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ, ma bɩ ba vaara, kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ pɩra, ma bɩ ba naawɩɩlaa vɔɔ tɔ. Kɩalɩŋ sɩ yeŋŋe koo a lɛl, ma bɩ ba chɛ kɛsɛ. Ma bemba arɩ tʋɔhɛɛŋ nɛ a bɩ ba nenige fá.

english_verse: They strayed in every direction, and because there was no shepherd to watch them, they were attacked and eaten by wild animals.
translation_verse: Ba fá pɩsɛ nɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ pie-daara kɛnɛ. Ba sɩ pɩsa ŋɩɩ, ba mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ baga kɩaa kʋdiilee.

english_verse: So my sheep were scattered across the earth. They roamed on hills and mountains, without anyone even bothering to look for them.
translation_verse: Mɩ piesee gɔllɔɔ baarɛ peelee arɩ dundolluŋ nyuŋ kala nɛ. Ba fá pɩsa su dʋnɩa lee-kala nɛ, ka nʋʋkala bɩ bee chɛba.

english_verse: Now listen to what I, the living Lord God, am saying to you shepherds. My sheep have been attacked and eaten by wild animals, because you refused to watch them. You never went looking for the lost ones, and you fed yourselves without feeding my sheep.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ ŋmɩɛsa: Mɩ piesee sɩ bɩ pie-daara kɛnɛ ka baga kɩaa kire kɛsɛ didii wɩaa, a tɩŋ mɩ pie-daaraa sɩ bɩ mɩ piesee chɛ kɛsɛ aŋ chɩl ba tɩtɩa wɩaa,

english_verse: So I, the Lord, will punish you! I will rescue my sheep from you and never let you be their shepherd again or butcher them for food. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ chɩŋ ma pie-daara-la lɛ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmma a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ leŋe ba ŋaa mɩ piesee lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ laa mɩ piesee ma teeŋ dɩ ma bɩra sɩ́ ba daa a kɛsɛ didii. Mɩ jaŋ lorigo laa mɩ piesee ma niiree lɛ, dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ ma kʋdiilee ŋaa.

english_verse: The Lord God then said: I will look for my sheep and take care of them myself,
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra sɩ: Mɩ tɩtɩa jaŋ chɛ kɛsɛ mɩ piesee a beŋ ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: just as a shepherd looks for lost sheep. My sheep have been lost since that dark and miserable day when they were scattered throughout the nations. But I will rescue them
translation_verse: A nagɛ pie-daara piesee sɩ pɩsa ʋ kire hɛ dɔŋɔ a beŋ ba nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ beŋ mɩ nɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ lorigo laaba a lɩɩ lere-la kala ba sɩ pɩsa mʋ tapʋlɩɩ-la duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa arɩ birimiŋ sɩ tɔ.

english_verse: and bring them back from the foreign nations where they now live. I will be their shepherd and will let them graze on Israel's mountains and in the valleys and fertile fields.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛba tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ, a kɛmba hɛ dɔŋɔ a mɩɩra kɛmba kɔ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ Iziral tinteeŋ dɩ ba dii yaŋ peelee arɩ ba fuo-luŋoo arɩ lere-la kala ba sɩ hɔnɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I promise to take care of them and keep them safe,
translation_verse: Mɩ-na tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ dɩdaa mɩ piesee, a chɛ leriŋ pɩba dɩ ba pɩna wiesi. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: to look for those that are lost and bring back the ones that wander off, to bandage those that are hurt and protect the ones that are weak. I will also slaughter those that are fat and strong, because I always do right. Judgment on the Strong Sheep
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chɛ kɛsɛ mɩ piese-la sɩ lɛlɛ, aŋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ yeŋŋe mɩɩra kɔ, a vɔɔ tɔ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ pɩra naawɩɩlaa, a pɩ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ doluŋ. Ama kɩalɩŋ sɩ nɛrɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ, mɩ jaŋ cheiba, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ ŋaa pie-daarʋ-la sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God said to his sheep, the people of Israel: I will carefully watch each one of you to decide which ones are the strong sheep and which ones are weak.
translation_verse: Ma-na mɩ piesee, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ dii ma kala sarɩya, a kɛŋ pie-zɔŋŋɔɔ pɔrɛ pie-bɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa piesee arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa bʋʋnaa.

english_verse: Some of you eat the greenest grass, then trample down what's left when you finish. Others drink clean water, then step in the water to make the rest of it muddy.
translation_verse: Ma dɔnsʋŋ yie dii ya-zɔŋ-la nɛ, aŋ nʋɔsɛ kʋkaanaa bil tinteeŋ. Ma yie nyʋa lɩɩzɔmʋŋ, aŋ kɛŋ kʋkaanɩŋ vuugi ʋ kala ŋaa gbʋna gbʋna.

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will separate you strong sheep from the weak.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ dii pie-duoruŋ arɩ pie-pʋgʋnʋŋ sarɩya.

english_verse: You strong ones have used your powerful horns to chase off those that are weak,
translation_verse: Piese-la sɩ dolie kɛŋ ba nyilliŋ nɛ a kiri pie-pʋgʋnʋ-la ta.

english_verse: but I will rescue them and no longer let them be mistreated. I will separate the good from the bad.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ laa mɩ piesee ta, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ wʋrɩgɛba. Mɩ jaŋ dii mɩ piesee sarɩya a kɛŋ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ kʋbɔŋŋɔɔ pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: After that, I will give you a shepherd from the family of my servant King David. All of you, both strong and weak, will have the same shepherd, and he will take good care of you.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ kuoro pɩba dɩ ʋ nagɛ mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit a ŋaa ba pie-daara a bibemba. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ba pie-daara a dɩdaaba.

english_verse: He will be your leader, and I will be your God. I, the Lord, have spoken. A Bright Future for the Lord's Sheep The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ba Wɩa, dɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit ma ŋaa ba sɩpaalaara. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: The people of Israel are my sheep, and I solemnly promise that they will live in peace. I will chase away every wild animal from the desert and the forest, so my sheep will not be afraid.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ hɛ niiŋ mɩ dɩ ba pɛgɛ dɩ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ ba tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kiri baga kʋbɔmɔ-la kala ba tinteeŋ lɛ, ka dɩ mɩ piesee wuo pɩŋ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ arɩ duuŋ tʋɔŋ ka wɩɩkala bɩ baa ŋaa.

english_verse: They will live around my holy mountain, and I will bless them by sending more than enough rain
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ mɩ nɩaa lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ba hɔnɔ golli mɩ dundolo-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa pɩ mɩ tɩtɩa. Dɩ ba nɩɩ chɛ duonuŋ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ duoŋ-zɔmʋŋ nɩɩ ʋ bʋa lɛ pɩba.

english_verse: to make their trees produce fruit and their crops to grow. I will set them free from slavery and let them live safely in their own land. Then they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba baga tɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ nɛŋ, dɩ ba kʋpɛrɛɛ ma wasɛ. Nʋʋkala jaŋ hɔŋ ʋ tinteeŋ lɛ sɔm. Dɩ mɩ nɛ laa mɩ nɩaa ta nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛmba bɩrɩmɛ yosuŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Foreign nations will never again rob them, and wild animals will no longer kill and eat them. They will have nothing to fear.
translation_verse: Tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ kʋ laa ba kɩaa. Baga kɩaa ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛsɛba dii. Ba jaŋ hɔŋ sɔm, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ hɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: I will make their fields produce large amounts of crops, so they will never again go hungry or be laughed at by foreigners.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee-la sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa nʋʋkala jɩŋ ʋ lɛ a pɩba, dɩ losuŋ lɛl ba tinteeŋ lɛ. Tintee-wogusuŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ sisieri ba lɛ.

english_verse: Then everyone will know that I protect my people Israel. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋkala jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ chɩŋ ba harɩŋ, ba ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa mɩ nɩaa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: They are my sheep; I am their God, and I take care of them.
translation_verse: Ma nagɛ piesee nɛ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ pɩma kʋdiilee ma didii, ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa nɛ mɩ ma ŋaa ma Wɩa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the people of Edom
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ, joŋ ŋ sɩaa chaasɛ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ, a bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ mɩ doluŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and say to them: I, the Lord God, am now your enemy! And I will turn your nation into an empty wasteland,
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba, “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ-na nɛ ŋaa ma Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa dʋndɔmɔ lɛɛlɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma tinteeŋ pɩŋ hoi.

english_verse: leaving your towns in ruins. Your land will be a desert, and then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma tasɩŋ pɩŋ jikpeeniŋ a ŋaa hoi. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: People of Edom, not only have you been Israel's longtime enemy, you simply watched when disaster wiped out its people as punishment for their sins.
translation_verse: Ma joŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ba ŋaa ma dʋndɔŋ-bɩnɩa nɛ, ma fa leŋe ba kpʋba nɛ bʋa-la lɛ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ sɩ jʋʋba, mɩ dʋdɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: And so, as surely as I am the living Lord God, you are guilty of murder and must be put to death.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ ŋmɩɛsa, mɩ jaŋ jomma hɛ nɩkpʋʋraa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba paa puuma. Ma sɩ bɩ nɩaa kpʋnʋŋ bɛrɛ ŋɩɩ, nɩkpʋʋraa jaŋ paa puuma.

english_verse: and your land will lie in ruins forever. No one will live in your towns ever again. You will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma tinteeŋ pɩŋ hoi a kaa mʋ wuu, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ hɛ ma tasɩŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: You thought the nations of Judah and Israel belonged to you, and that you could take over their territory. But I am their God,
translation_verse: Ma sɩ, ‘Tinteyee deemba balɩa, Juda arɩ Iziral kala jaŋ ŋaa la kɩaa, la jaŋ laaba a tɩɩ,’ arɩ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ lee-la ma kala.

english_verse: and as surely as I live, I will punish you for treating my people with anger and hatred. Then they will know that I, the Lord, am punishing you!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA ŋmɩɛsa, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma a tɩŋ baaŋ-la arɩ yarɩ-bierii-la arɩ tʋɔ-bɔŋ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ mɩ nɩaa lɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaama ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩɩ dɔgɩsɛma a tɩŋ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ joŋo to ba lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: And you will finally realize that I heard you laugh at their destruction and say their land was yours to take.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA nɩɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ mɔŋ Iziral peelee lɛ, a bʋl ba tinteeŋ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, dɩ ma laaʋ tɩɩ.

english_verse: just as you celebrated when Israel was destroyed. Your nation of Edom will be nothing but a wasteland. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa, ma ma faa jʋɔsʋ nɛ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ sɩ pɩŋ hoi. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ joŋo to ma ma lɛ. Ɛdɔm peelee arɩ ʋ tinteeŋ kala jaŋ pɩŋ hoi. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the mountains of Israel
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, bʋl wɩaa mɩ doluŋ lɛ pɩ Iziral peelee dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: that I, the Lord God, am saying: Your enemies sneered and said that you mountains belonged to them.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ma Iziral dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jʋɔsa nɛ a bʋl, ‘Ahaa, peel-bɩnɩa-la bɩrɩmɛ la kɩaa nɛ.’

english_verse: So all you mountains and hills, streams and valleys, listen to what I will do. Your towns may now lie in ruins, and nations may laugh and insult you.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Iziral peelee, má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ-na TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩ ma-na peelee arɩ dundolluŋ, fuonaa-luŋoo arɩ fuonaasɩŋ, lere-la sɩ pɩŋ jikpeeniŋ a ŋaa hoi arɩ tasɩ-la kɩaa ba sɩ yuo paa ka tinteye-la sɩ gollima sisieri ma lɛ:

english_verse: But in my fierce anger, I will turn against those nations, and especially the Edomites, because they laughed at you the loudest and took over your pasturelands.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ na baanɩŋ nɛ tinteye-la sɩ gollima arɩ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ kala nyuŋ. Ba mɔŋ mɩ nɩaa nɛ a sieri ba lɛ, a laa mɩ tinteeŋ ma ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ a kɛŋ ʋ pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee ma kaa laa.

english_verse: so I will now insult and disgrace them. That is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ chaasa ŋmɩɛsɛ nɛ arɩ mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ tinteye-la sɩ gollima a leŋ dɩ ba dii hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Trees will grow on you mountains of Israel and produce fruit for my people, because they will soon come home.
translation_verse: Ama ma-na Iziral peelee, tɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ waa ma nyuŋ a kel naakelee a nɛŋ nɛnɛɛ a pɩ ma-na mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni ka dɩ ma mɩɩra kɔ dɩa.

english_verse: I will take care of you by plowing your soil and planting crops on your fertile slopes.
translation_verse: Mɩ chɩl ma wɩaa nɛ, mɩ jaŋ dagɛ mɩ chonuŋ a pɩma, ma jaŋ bɩra pɛrɛ ma tinteeŋ lɛ a duu kɩaa nɩmɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel will return and rebuild your ruined towns and live in them.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma nɩaa pʋŋa pɛ. Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala jaŋ bɩra hɔŋ ma tabalaa lɛ a wasa saa lere-la kala fa sɩ pɩŋ jikpeeniŋ.

english_verse: Children will be born, and animals will give birth to their young. You will no longer be deserted as you are now, but you will be covered with people and treated better than ever. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma nɩaa arɩ ma pʋsʋŋ pʋŋ. Ma jaŋ yʋgɛ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ ma fa sɩ maga, dɩ ma biiriŋ ma pʋŋa pɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ nɩmɛ arɩ ma fa sɩ hɔŋ ŋɩɩ, a dʋa kɩaa a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ ma fa sɩ kɛnɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: I will bring my people Israel home, and they will live on you mountains, because you belong to them, and your fertile slopes will never again let them starve.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ma-na Iziral tɩŋŋaa, mɩ nɩaa mɩɩra kɔ tintee-la. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma biiriŋ sʋsʋʋ.

english_verse: It's true that you have been accused of not producing enough food and of letting your people starve.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, nɩaa ka bʋl arɩ tintee-la ka dii nɩaa nɛ, a pɔ dɩ ʋ nɩaa sɩ́ bii kɛŋ,

english_verse: But I, the Lord, promise that you won't hear other nations laugh and sneer at you ever again. From now on, you will always produce plenty of food for your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord Will Be Honored
translation_verse: Tintee-la nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ nɩnɩɩ ŋɩɩ tinteye-la nɩaa sɩɩ mɔmba lɛ koo a sisieri ba lɛ. Tintee-la bɩra bɩ jaŋ kpʋkpʋ ʋ nɩaa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own country, they made the land unclean by the way they behaved, just as a woman's monthly period makes her unclean.
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ hɛ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ, ba mɛlɛ arɩ ba wʋŋaalaa leŋe tintee-la kala kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Ba wʋŋaalaa fa nagɛ haala sɩ hɛ tɩŋa a kɛŋ disiniŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: They committed murders and worshiped idols, which made the land even worse. So in my anger, I punished my people
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ a dɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋ nɩaa tintee-la lɛ, aŋ pɛ kpaarɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: Wherever they went, my name was disgraced, because foreigners insulted my people by saying I had forced them out of their own land.
translation_verse: Tinteye-la lee na-kala ba sɩ mʋa, ba yie chei mɩ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la nɛ. Nɩaa yie bʋl ŋ-la nɛ a tɩgɛ ba lɛ: ‘La TƖƖNA nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la, ama ʋ leŋe ba lɩɩ ʋ tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ.’

english_verse: I care what those foreigners think of me,
translation_verse: Mɩ chɩl mɩ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩaa nɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa cheyu nɛ tinteye-la kala lɛ ba sɩ mʋa.

english_verse: so tell the Israelites that I am saying: You have disgraced my holy name among the nations where you now live. So you don't deserve what I'm going to do for you. I will lead you home to bring honor to my name
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ma wɩaa dee mɩɩ chɛ mɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba, ama mɩ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩaa nɛ. Ʋ nɛ ma chei ŋɩɩ tinteye-la kala lɛ ma sɩ mʋa.

english_verse: I will gather you from the foreign nations and bring you home.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛmma lɩɩ tintee-wogusuŋ kala tʋɔŋ, a kɛmma mɩɩra kɔ ma tɩtɩa tinteeŋ.

english_verse: I will sprinkle you with clean water, and you will be clean and acceptable to me. I will wash away everything that makes you unclean, and I will remove your disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ lɩɩzɔmʋŋ a mɩsɛma, dɩ ʋ ŋaa dɩ ma zɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ pɩɩsɛ tɔmɔ-la ma sɩ kpaara a kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ disiŋ dɔŋ kala ma sɩ ŋaa a ta.

english_verse: I will take away your stubborn heart and give you a new heart and a desire to be faithful. You will have only pure thoughts,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ pɩma tʋɔ-falɩŋ, a joŋ dɩŋ-falɩŋ ma hɛ ma lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ tʋɔ-dol-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ sɩ nagɛ tabɩɩŋ ta, aŋ pɩma tʋɔ-la sɩ pʋnyɛ.

english_verse: because I will put my Spirit in you and make you eager to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ Dɩma a hɛ ma lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ma to mɩ wʋdagaa a fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a to wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ma tuto.

english_verse: You will once again live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ hɛ tintee-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩ ma naabalɩmaba lɛ. Ma jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa, dɩ mɩ ma ŋaa ma Wɩa.

english_verse: I will protect you from anything that makes you unclean. Your fields will overflow with grain, and no one will starve.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ laama ta wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ leŋe ma kɛŋ disiniŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩaa chaasa pʋrɩgɛ, dɩ losuŋ bɩra sɩ́ ma jʋʋ.

english_verse: Your trees will be filled with fruit, and crops will grow in your fields, so that you will never again feel ashamed for not having enough food.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma tɩɩsɩŋ faasa nɛnɛ yʋgɛ, dɩ ma kʋpɛrɛɛ ma faasa wasɛ, dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ bɩra sɩ́ ma dii tinteye-la lɛ a tɩŋ losuŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: You will remember your evil ways and hate yourselves for what you've done.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ liisi wʋbɔmɔ-la ma sɩ ŋaa, dɩ ma tʋɔŋ lɩɩ ma tɩtɩa a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ wʋkɩsɩa-la ma sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: People of Israel, I'm not doing these things for your sake. You sinned against me, and you must suffer shame and disgrace for what you have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, mɩɩ chɛ ma jɩŋ arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩaa deemba ka ŋaa a tɩŋ ma wɩaa nɛ. Má leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmma dɩ ma gʋrɛ nyuŋ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: After I have made you clean, I will let you rebuild your ruined towns and let you live in them.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Dɩ mɩ nɛ pɩɩsɛ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma bɩra hɔŋ ma tasɩŋ lɛ, a wasa paa jikpeeni-la saa.

english_verse: Your land will be plowed again, and nobody will be able to see that it was once barren.
translation_verse: Nɩaa fa sɩ yie to ma tinteeŋ bɩbal dɩ ʋ pɩŋ hoi ŋɩɩ, nʋʋkala bɩ nɩmɛ ka pɛrɛ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma pɛrʋ.

english_verse: Instead, they will say that it looks as beautiful as the garden of Eden. They won't see towns lying in ruins, but they will see your strong cities filled with people.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ bʋl, ‘Tinteeŋ deeŋ fa sɩ pɩŋ kʋŋkʋlʋŋ ŋɩɩ, lɛɛlɛ ʋ mɩɩra nagɛ Ɛdɩŋ ŋmaŋkaa-la nɛ, tabalaa deemba fa pɩŋ jikpeeŋ nɛ a ŋaa hoi a kala chei, ba lɛ nɛ nɩaa lɛɛlɛ hɛ ŋɩɩ a saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli.’

english_verse: Then the nearby nations that survive will know that I am the one who rebuilt the ruined places and replanted the barren fields. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tinteye-la ha sɩ ka a gollima jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ wasa paa tasɩ-la ba fa sɩ cheye saa, a pɛrɛ baga-la fa sɩ pɩŋ hoi. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla.”

english_verse: I will once again answer your prayers, and I will let your nation grow until you are like a large flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ bɩra jegile nɩɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sʋla a pɛ ba lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba faasa pʋŋa yʋgɛ a nagɛ pie-laalɩŋ.

english_verse: The towns that now lie in ruins will be filled with people, just as Jerusalem was once filled with sheep to be offered as sacrifices during a festival. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Tabala-la lɛɛlɛ sɩ pɩŋ jikpeeniŋ jaŋ su arɩ nɩaa, a nagɛ Jerusalɛm fa sɩ yie su arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ piesee ŋɩɩ ba gbielee tapʋlʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: Some time later, I felt the Lord's power take control of me, and his Spirit carried me to a valley full of bones.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kʋ jʋʋmɛ, ʋ Dɩma-la jommi kaa tuu fuonaa kʋbala tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, dɩ ʋ suo arɩ haŋgbelee.

english_verse: The Lord showed me all around, and everywhere I looked I saw bones that were dried out.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛmmɛ gɔllɛ haŋgbele-la tʋɔŋ. Ba fa yʋga nɛ woruŋ a pɩŋ fuonaa-la lɛ a kala faasa hɩl kori kori.

english_verse: He said, “Ezekiel, son of man, can these bones come back to life?” I replied, “Lord God, only you can answer that.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, haŋgbelee deemba jaŋ bɩra wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ?” Mɩ bʋl, “La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jɩma.”

english_verse: He then told me to say: Dry bones, listen to what the Lord is saying to you,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Bʋl wɩaa mɩ doluŋ lɛ a pɩ haŋgbele-la arɩ ba jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩɩ bʋl.

english_verse: “I, the Lord God, will put breath in you, and once again you will live.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋlaa pɩ haŋgbele-la nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wiese hɛ ma lɛ a leŋ dɩ ma bɩra kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I will wrap you with muscles and skin and breathe life into you. Then you will know that I am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ poloo arɩ nampɩlɩŋ mɛrɛ ma lɛ, a joŋ puruŋ tɔ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wiese hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma bɩra kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: I did what the Lord said, but before I finished speaking, I heard a rattling noise. The bones were coming together!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛmɛ. Mɩ fa sɩɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ Wɩa doluŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ nɩɩ dɩ ba sii yɩ dɔŋɔ a dʋdɔŋ, haŋgbele-la kʋ mɩmɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I saw muscles and skin cover the bones, but they had no life in them.
translation_verse: Mɩ bibeŋ ka poloo arɩ nampɩlɩŋ kʋʋ mɛrɛ ba lɛ, puruŋ ma kʋ tɔ. Ama wiese fa tuo ba lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, now say to the wind, “The Lord God commands you to blow from every direction and to breathe life into these dead bodies, so they can live again.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Bʋl wɩaa mɩ doluŋ lɛ a pɩ wiese. Bʋla pɩ wiese arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ ʋ lɩɩ dʋnɩa loŋgorunuŋ banɛsɛ a kʋ jʋʋ nɩsʋʋnʋŋ deemba a leŋ dɩ ba bɩra kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: As soon as I said this, the wind blew among the bodies, and they came back to life! They all stood up, and there were enough to make a large army.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl wɩaa ʋ doluŋ lɛ arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ dagɛmɛ, wiese kʋ jʋʋba ba kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a sii chɩŋ. Ba fa ŋaa laalɩyuori dandaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are like dead bones. They complain that they are dried up and that they have no hope for the future.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, haŋgbelee deemba nɛ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala. Ba sɩ, ‘La haŋgbelee kala hɩla nɛ, la bɩra bɩ yɩɛlaa kɛnɛ, la lɛlɛ nɛ.’

english_verse: So tell them, “I, the Lord God, promise to open your graves and set you free. I will bring you back to Israel,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, bʋl wɩaa mɩ doluŋ lɛ a pɩba, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ou mɩ nɩaa, mɩ jaŋ suri ma vaamaa a leŋ dɩ ma kʋ lɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ kɛmma kaa mɩɩra kɔ Iziral tinteeŋ.

english_verse: and when that happens, you will realize that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ suri ma vaamaa a kɛmma kʋ lɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma-na mɩ nɩaa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: My Spirit will give you breath, and you will live again. I will bring you home, and you will know that I have kept my promise. I, the Lord, have spoken.” Judah and Israel Together Again
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ wiese hɛ ma lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ma bɩra kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, aŋ ka dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ ma tɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla, aŋ ŋaa ma.” Juda arɩ Iziral kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a kɛŋ kuoru bala

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Judah.” Then get another stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Israel.”
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, joŋ daaŋ a ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba hɛ ʋ lɛ, ‘Juda arɩ ʋ nɩaa daaŋ.’ Bɩra joŋ dɔŋɔ ma a ŋmʋnsa hɛ, ‘Josɛf nanʋala Efirem arɩ Iziral nɩaa sɩ chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ daaŋ.’

english_verse: Hold these two sticks end to end, so they look like one stick.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ daasɩ-la balɩa kaa chonsi dɔŋɔ lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa daa-bala ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And when your people ask you what this means,
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ pɩɛsɩŋ dɩ ŋ dagɛba wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa bʋbʋɔŋ,

english_verse: tell them that I, the Lord, will join together the stick of Israel and the stick of Judah. I will hold them in my hand, and they will become one.
translation_verse: bʋla pɩba, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: mɩ jaŋ joŋ Josɛf sɩ tɩɩ daa-la ka ʋ hɛ Efirem nɩsɩŋ lɛ arɩ Iziral doho doho-la sɩ chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ, a chonsi Juda daaŋ lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa daa-bala mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Hold these two sticks where they can be seen by everyone
translation_verse: Kori daasɩ-la balɩa ŋ sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ hɛ a leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ naba.

english_verse: and then say: I, the Lord God, will gather the people of Israel and bring them home from the foreign nations where they now live.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ mʋ kɛsɛ mɩ nɩaa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ tinteye-la ba sɩ pɩsa hɛ lɛ, a kɛmba kaa mɩɩra kɔ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ.

english_verse: I will make them into one nation and let them once again live in the land of Israel. Only one king will rule them, and they will never again be divided into two nations.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ba kala hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba ŋaa tintee bala nɩaa tintee-la lɛ, Iziral peelee nyuŋ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ kuoru bala dɩ ʋ bibemba. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a ŋaa tinteyee balɩa koo a ŋaa kuoru gentisiŋ balɩa.

english_verse: They will no longer worship idols and do things that make them unacceptable to me. I will wash away their sin and make them clean, and I will protect them from everything that makes them unclean. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ kpaarɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ kɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ kɩsʋ a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ koo a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ dɔnsʋŋ a chei ba tɩtɩa. Mɩ jaŋ laaba ta ba wʋbɔmɔ-la kala ba fa sɩ ŋaa a lɩɩ mɩ harɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta. Ba jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa, dɩ mɩ ma ŋaa ba Wɩa.

english_verse: Their king will always come from the family of my servant King David and will care for them like a shepherd. The people of Israel will faithfully obey my laws. They and their descendants will live in the land I gave my servant Jacob, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ hɔŋ tintee-la mɩ fa sɩ joŋo pɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna Jekɔb lɛ, lee-la ba naabalɩmaba fa sɩ hɔnɔ. Ba dɩ ba biiriŋ arɩ ba nihee kala jaŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ba sɩpaalaara a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I solemnly promise to bless the people of Israel with unending peace. I will protect them and let them become a powerful nation. My temple will stand in Israel for all time,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bil niiŋ mɩ dɩ ba pɛgɛ dɩ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ ba teeŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba chɩŋ, a leŋ dɩ ba nɩaa pʋŋa pɛ. Mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ jaŋ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: and I will live among my people and be their God.
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ jaŋ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ, dɩ mɩ ŋaa ba Wɩa, dɩ ba ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: Every nation on earth will know that my temple is in Israel and that I have chosen the Israelites to be my people.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ leŋe dɩ mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, ŋɩɩ nɛ tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ lɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ba ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog, that wicked ruler of the kingdoms of Meshech and Tubal in the land of Magog. Tell him:
translation_verse: “Nuhuobiiŋ, joŋ ŋ sɩaa chaasɛ Gɔg sɩ hɛ Magɔg tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Mɛsɛk arɩ Tubal nɩaa sɩpaalaara ŋɩɩ. Bʋl wɩaa mɩ doluŋ lɛ,

english_verse: and I will make you powerless! I will put a hook in your jaw and drag away both you and your large army. You command cavalry troops that wear heavy armor and carry shields and swords.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ kaa viire kɩɩ, a joŋ gbɩaŋ hɛ ŋ tapaŋaa lɛ a lɛrɛ ŋ dɩ ŋ laalɩyuoroo kala kʋ lɩɩ: ŋ janɩŋ, ŋ ja-jɩlla-la kala sɩ nyɩgɩla, laalɩyuori daŋ-la sɩ kori hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ, kʋjalaa arɩ kʋbiisiŋ a pɛ tokobiee lɛ.

english_verse: because in a few years, I will command you to invade Israel, a country that was ruined by war. It was deserted for a long time, but its people have returned from the foreign nations where they once lived. The Israelites now live in peace in the mountains of their own land.
translation_verse: Dɩ jɩ-daŋ nɛ kʋ bal, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ mʋ yuo tintee kʋbala nɩaa sɩ yuo laalɩŋ aŋ lɛɛlɛ fɩɛla hɔŋ. Ba kɛmba kaa lɩɩ tintee daŋ nɛ a mɩɩra kɔ Iziral tinteeŋ. Ŋ jaŋ mʋ yuo Iziral tintee-la, lee-la fa sɩ pɩŋ hoi a dieni. Ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ nɩaa hɔŋ ʋ lɛ nɛ, wɩɩkala bɩ baa walɩmɛ.

english_verse: But you and your army will attack them like a fierce thunderstorm and surround them like a cloud.
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩ ŋ laalɩyuoroo arɩ tintee daŋ-la nɩaa sɩ hɛ ŋ teeŋ kala jaŋ mʋ tintee-la lɛ a nagɛ duoŋ-peliŋ, a tɔ ʋ kala a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ.”

english_verse: When that day comes, I know that you will have an evil plan
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, ŋ jaŋ suomo bɩbɩɩnɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: to take advantage of Israel, that weak and peaceful country where people live safely inside towns that have no walls or gates or locks.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ bʋl, ‘Mɩ jaŋ mʋ yuo tintee-la nɩaa tabiisiŋ ba sɩ bɩ kɛrɛ saa golli, mɩ jaŋ mʋ yuo nɩa sɩ fɩɛla hɔŋ wɩɩ bɩ baa walɩmɛ, a bɩ kɛrɩsɩŋ saa golli ba tasɩŋ, a bɩ boi-baalaa kɛnɛ a kɛŋ doloo tʋtɔ.

english_verse: You will rob the people in towns that were once a pile of rubble. These people lived as prisoners in foreign nations, but they have returned to Israel, the most important place in the world, and they own livestock and property.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ yuo paa nɩalɩŋ tasɩŋ fa sɩ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ kɩaa. Ba mɩɩra lɩɩ tinteyee nɛ a kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ, a lɛɛlɛ kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ arɩ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ a hɔŋ dʋnɩa tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ.’

english_verse: The people of Sheba and Dedan, along with merchants from villages in southern Spain, will be your allies. They will want some of the silver and gold, as well as the livestock and property that your army takes from Israel.
translation_verse: Sɛba tɩŋŋaa arɩ Dɛdaŋ tɩŋŋaa, a pɛ Taasɩs arɩ ʋ tabiisiŋ kala bayalaa jaŋ pɩɛsɩŋ, ‘Ŋ kɛŋ ŋ laalɩyuoroo kɔ dɩ ma yuo aŋ paa kɩaa nɛɛ? Ŋŋ chɛ ŋ paa hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ, a kɛsɛ pʋsʋŋ a laa kɩaa yʋgɛ a kaa viiri nɛ koo?’ ”

english_verse: You will attack my people like a storm-cloud that covers their land. I will let you invade my country Israel, so that every nation on earth will know that I, the Lord, am holy. Judgment on Gog
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ kɔ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ sɩ tɔ leriŋ. Dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ-na Gɔg mʋ dɩ ŋ yuo mɩ nɩaa. Dɩ mɩ nɛ to ŋ lɛ a dagɛ mɩ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ tinteyee nɩaa sɩpaaŋ, ba jaŋ jɩŋ nɩdoho-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Gog: Long ago, I ordered my prophets to warn the people of Israel that someday I would send an enemy to attack them. You, Gog, are that enemy, and that day is coming.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩɩ bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: “Ma wɩaa nɛ mɩ fa to mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa a lɩɩ Iziral tinteeŋ a bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ faafaa kala, arɩ maachie mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma kʋ yuo Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: and in my anger I will send a terrible earthquake to shake Israel.
translation_verse: Mɩ baanɩŋ sɩ jaŋ faasa sii dɩ mɩ sɩɩŋ fɩɛsɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tinteeŋ faasa zigili.

english_verse: Every living thing on earth will tremble in fear of me—every fish and bird, every wild animal and reptile, and every human. Mountains will crumble, cliffs will fall, and cities will collapse.
translation_verse: Chenfilee, diibiisiŋ, bagɩlaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ vaamɛ tinteeŋ, a pɛ nuhuobiinee lɛ, ba kala jaŋ chichel mɩ sɩpaaŋ. Peelee jaŋ wuro chu dɩ bʋsʋŋ yɛrɛ dɩ jeyee ma kala tel.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the mountains of Israel turn against you. Your troops will be so terrified that they will attack each other.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ laalɩŋ chaasa hosi woruŋ Gɔg nyuŋ, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla. Gɔg nɩaa jaŋ mɩɩra gʋra yuyuo dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: I will strike you with diseases and punish you with death. You and your army will be pounded with rainstorms, hailstones, and burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ. Ba jaŋ kpʋkpʋ dɔŋɔ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ duonuŋ faasa nɩɩ, dɩ duoŋ-tabɩaa tel ba nyuŋ, dɩ jiribiiŋ ma chol nyiniŋ a wurisi ʋ dɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo arɩ tintee daŋ-la nɩaa sɩ kʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: I will do these things to show the world that I, the Lord, am holy.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, tintee daŋ nɩaa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog and tell him: You are the ruler of Meshech and Tubal, but I, the Lord, am your enemy!
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ, mɩ doluŋ lɛ bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Gɔg lɛ. Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ chɩŋ ŋ-na Gɔg sɩ ŋaa Mɛsɛk arɩ Tubal nɩaa sɩpaalaarʋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I will turn you around and drag you from the north until you reach the mountains of Israel.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ viire kɩɩ, a lɛrɩŋ mʋ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ dɩ-bolii a kaa kʋ hɛ Iziral peelee lɛ.

english_verse: I will knock the bow out of your left hand and the arrows out of your right hand,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋmoo ŋ nagʋa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ŋ toŋ foro tel, a ŋmoo ŋ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ ma lɛ dɩ ŋ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ foro tel.

english_verse: and you and your army will die on those mountains. Then birds and wild animals will eat the flesh
translation_verse: Gɔg, ŋ dɩ ŋ laalɩyuoroo arɩ tinteye-la nɩaa kala sɩ kʋ pɛ ŋ lɛ jaŋ sʋʋ pɩŋ Iziral peelee nyuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ ma kʋsʋʋnʋŋ pɩ zaaraa arɩ baga kɩaa dɩ ba dii.

english_verse: of your dead bodies left lying in open fields. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ sʋʋ pɩŋ ŋmaŋkaaŋ nyuŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I will set fire to the land of Magog and to those nations along the seacoast that think they are so secure, and they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ Magɔg tinteeŋ lɛ, a pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ a ta jɩa lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA.

english_verse: My people Israel will know me, and they will no longer disgrace my holy name. Everyone on earth will know that I am the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa jɩŋ mɩ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba chei mɩ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: The day is coming when these things will happen, just as I have promised.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la wɩaa mɩ sɩ bʋla jaŋ kɔ, ʋ sɛnɛ jaŋ kɔ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: When that day comes, the people in the towns of Israel will collect the weapons of their dead enemies. They will use these shields, bows and arrows, spears, and clubs as firewood, and there will be enough to last for seven years.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Iziral tasɩŋ lɛ jaŋ lɩɩ paa bayuori kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ vɩa ta a hɛ nyiniŋ. Ba jaŋ paa hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ, ba kʋbiisiŋ arɩ kʋjalaa, tosuŋ, to-hɛŋŋɛɛ, tiŋŋee arɩ toŋguloo a kaa hɛ nyiniŋ a mʋ yi jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ.

english_verse: They will burn these weapons instead of gathering sticks or chopping down trees. That's how the Israelites will take revenge on those who robbed and abused them. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Burial of Gog The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ mʋ gɩrɩŋ a jaa daasɩŋ koo a keri tɩɩsɩŋ duuŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa bayuori kɩalɩŋ nɛ ba jaŋ kaa hɩhɛ nyiniŋ. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ yuo a paa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kɩaa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma jaŋ paa ba kɩaa. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ kɛŋ ba kɩaa laa, ba ma jaŋ kɛŋ ba kɩaa laa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: After Gog has been destroyed, I will bury him and his army in Israel, in Travelers' Valley, east of the Dead Sea. That graveyard will be so large that it will block the way of anyone who tries to walk through the valley, which will then be known as “The Valley of Gog's Army.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, mɩ jaŋ dagɛ Gɔg dɩ-huguŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ hɛ wɛŋ-vɛnnɛɛ fuonaaŋ sɩ hɛ Mʋgʋ-sʋʋŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Ʋ jaŋ tɔ wɛŋ-vɛnnɛɛ wombiiŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jaŋ hugi Gɔg arɩ ʋ laalɩyuori daŋ-la kala nɩmɛ. Ba jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ lee-la Hamɔŋ Gɔg laalɩyuoroo fuonaaŋ.

english_verse: The Israelites will spend seven months burying dead bodies and cleaning up their land.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa jaŋ hugi ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ ŋɩɩ chɛnsɩŋ balɩpɛ, a pɩɩsɛ tintee-la disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: Everyone will help with the burial, and they will be honored for this on the day the brightness of my glory is seen.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ jaŋ pɛ a hugiba. Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ yɩrɩŋ sɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hugiba jaŋ laa yɩrɩŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: After those seven months, the people will appoint a group of men to look for any dead bodies left unburied. This must be done for seven months to make sure that the land is no longer unclean.
translation_verse: Dɩ chɛnsɩŋ balɩpɛ-la nɛ bala, ba jaŋ lɩɩsɛ baalaa dɩ ba gɔllɔ beŋ tintee-la kala a paa nɩsʋʋnʋ-la ba sɩ ka ta a hugi, dɩ tintee-la sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ.

english_verse: Whenever they find a human bone, they will set up a marker next to it. Then the gravediggers will bury it in “The Valley of Gog's Army”
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩalɩŋ nɩɩ gɔllɛ tintee-la lɛ a mʋ na nuhuobiine haŋgbeliŋ, ba jaŋ joŋ kʋa pɛ a magɩlɛ lee-la, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ lu bʋa kɔ, a lu bʋa Hamɔŋ Gɔg fuonaa-la lɛ a joŋo hugi.

english_verse: near the town of “Gog's Army.” After that, the land will be pure again.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ paa haŋgbele-la hugo dɛrɛ, ba pɩɩsɛ tintee-la disiniŋ ta nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I am going to hold a feast on Israel's mountains and offer sacrifices there. So invite all the birds and wild animals to come from every direction and eat the meat of sacrifices and drink the blood. The birds and animals
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Nuhuobiiŋ, yɩrɛ zaaraa arɩ baga kɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ dii nammɩa, a bʋl: Má hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a lɩɩ lee-kala kɔ a dii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋdiile-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa bil ma lɛ. Kʋdiile-la jaŋ yʋgɛ woruŋ Iziral peelee nyuŋ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ma jaŋ chaŋ nammɩa aŋ nyʋa chalɩŋ.

english_verse: will feast on the bodies of warriors and foreign rulers that I will sacrifice like sheep, goats, and bulls.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ dii laalɩyuoroo kʋsʋʋnʋŋ, aŋ nyʋa dʋnɩa kuoroo chalɩŋ. Ma jaŋ chaŋ nɩaa deemba kala a nagɛ pie-belliŋ koo pie-pɔrɔɔ, koo bʋʋnaa koo nɛ-belliŋ. Ma kala nagɛ pʋsʋŋ sɩ nɛrɛ nɛ a lɩɩ Basaŋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: I want the birds and animals to eat until they are full and drink until they are drunk.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ kpʋ nɩaa deemba a nagɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ, zaaraa arɩ baga kɩaa jaŋ dii ba nʋʋŋ a kala vɔgɛ, a nyʋa ba chalɩŋ ma a kala bugi.

english_verse: They will come to my table and stuff themselves with the flesh of horses and warriors of every kind. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Israel Will Be Restored The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mɩ kʋdiilee leriŋ, ma jaŋ dii janɩŋ, ja-jɩllaa, laalɩyuori duoruŋ arɩ laalɩyuori doho na-kala a vɔgɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: When I punish the nations of the earth, they will see the brightness of my glory.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ tinteyee lɛ, dɩ ba kala na ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ dɔgɩsɛba a dagɛ mɩ doluŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel will know from then on that I am the Lord their God.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la a kaa mʋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Foreign nations will realize that the Israelites were forced to leave their own land because they sinned against me. I turned my back on my people and let enemies attack and kill them.
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa mʋ yoŋ-baga a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ, ba sɩ bɩ mɩ to arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Mɩ joŋ harɩŋ yɩaba nɛ, aŋ jomba hɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ ba kpʋba laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Their lives were wicked and corrupt, and they deserved to be punished.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ wɩaa deemba ŋaa ba lɛ a tɩŋ ba disiŋ wʋŋaalaa arɩ ba nɩbɔŋ wʋŋaalaa wɩaa nɛ, a joŋ harɩŋ yɩaba.

english_verse: Now I will show mercy to the people of Israel and bring them back from the nations where they are living. They are Jacob's descendants, so I will bless them and show that I am holy.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Lɛɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ fá Jekɔb doho nɩaa sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa nenige, a leŋ dɩ ba mɩɩra lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ, a tɩɩ ba tinteeŋ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ ka wɩɩ mɩ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: They will live safely in their own land, but will be ashamed when they remember their evil ways and how they disgraced me.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ bɩra hɔŋ sɔm ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ baa walɩmɛ, ba jaŋ yʋ hɩɩsɩ-la ba sɩ die arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ arɩ mɩ.

english_verse: Foreign nations will watch as I take the Israelites from enemy lands and bring them back home, and those nations will see that I am holy.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛmba lɩɩ tinteye-la lɛ ba sɩ hɛ, ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tinteye-la lɛ a mɩɩra kɔ, ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ to a dagɛ mɩ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la a pɩ tinteye-la nɩaa.

english_verse: My people will realize that I, the Lord their God, sent them away as prisoners and now will bring them back to their own land.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ nɩaa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa, a kɛmba mʋ yoŋ-baga tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ, aŋ kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ. Ba kʋbala ma bɩ harɩŋ ka.

english_verse: Never again will I turn my back on the people of Israel, and my Spirit will live in them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ Dɩma hɛ ba lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Twenty-five years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, and
translation_verse: A nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ, Wɩa jommi kaa mʋ Iziral tinteeŋ a kɛmmɛ mʋ sagɛ peel-leŋii kʋbala nyuŋ. Peel-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, dɩɩsɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a nagɛ tabal.

english_verse: He measured the entrance room at the far end of the passageway, and it was ten meters wide.
translation_verse: Boi-baal-la tʋɔŋ jebie-la sɩ chɔŋɔ lɩɩ, ʋ magɩsɛ ba ma. Ʋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mara arɩ fii. Ʋ fa magɩsa a mʋ yi zawʋra-la sɩ chaasɛ kaala-la nɛ.

english_verse: In my vision the Lord took me closer, and I saw a man who was sparkling like polished bronze. He was standing near one of the gates and was holding a tape measure in one hand and a measuring stick in the other.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛmmɛ mʋ kpagɛ lee-la, mɩ na baal kʋbala sɩɩ tʋl a nagɛ kɔlɩɩŋ. Ʋ fa chɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ niiŋ nɛ a kori gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ arɩ daaŋ ba sɩ kaa mɩmagɩsɛ kɩaa duomuŋ.

english_verse: The man said, “Ezekiel, son of man, pay close attention to everything I'm going to show you—that's why you've been brought here. Listen carefully, because you must tell the people of Israel what you see.” The East Gate
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, suri ŋ sɩaa, a wuoli ŋ dɩgɩlaa ma a jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ jaŋ dagɩŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ mɩ kɛnɩŋ kɔ daha. Bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ na daha a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.” Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ kaala boi-baalɩŋ

english_verse: The three guardrooms on each side of the passageway were the same size, and the walls that separated them were the same thickness.
translation_verse: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baal-la tʋɔŋ, dɩɩ-biisiŋ batori nɛ hɛ ʋ sɛmɛ kala, dɩɩsɩ-la kala magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Jebie-la ma sɩ hɛ ba pɛgɛ barɩmɩŋ kala magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Next, the man measured the width of the passageway, and it was six and a half meters, but the two doors of the gate were only five meters wide.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ magɩsɛ boi-baal-la jalɩŋ, ʋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋnɔŋ, ʋ duomuŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩdʋ arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The man measured the distance from the back wall of one of these rooms to the same spot in the room directly across the passageway, and it was twelve and a half meters.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ magɩsɛ dɩɩsɩ-la dɔŋɔ harɩŋ kɛrɛ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi kʋ-la sɩ chaasʋ harɩŋ dɩɩrɩŋ jebiiŋ. Ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Finally, he measured the total length of the passageway, from the outer wall to the entrance room, and it was
translation_verse: A chɩŋ boi-baal-la niiŋ a kaa mʋ yagɛ zawʋra-la dɩdɛrɩŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mara arɩ banɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The three walls in the guardrooms had small windows in them, just like the ones in the entrance room. The walls along the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. The Outer Courtyard
translation_verse: Bʋa-biisiŋ nɛ fa hɛ dɩɩsɩ-la harɩŋ jebiee lɛ arɩ tʋɔŋ jebiee kala, arɩ zawʋra-la sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ. Jebie-la sɩ chɔŋɔ lɩɩ, ba tuuri kɩaa sɩ nagɛ abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ nɛ a kpɩɛrɛ jeyee-la. Kaala-la sɩ hɛ harɩŋ

english_verse: The man then led me through the passageway and into the outer courtyard of the temple, where I saw
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛmmɛ kaa kʋ jʋʋ harɩŋ kaala-la tʋɔŋ. Nɩmɛ mɩ na ba saa dɩɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii a yelli kaala-la jebiiŋ. Dɩɩsɩ-la sɩpaaŋ, ba kɛŋ tabɩaa ŋaa wombiiŋ,

english_verse: This was known as the lower sidewalk, and it was
translation_verse: a golli kaala-la kala. Wombii-la jalɩŋ arɩ boi-baal-la jalɩŋ kala magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Wombiiŋ deeŋ fa tuu tinteeŋ mʋa nɛ.

english_verse: I saw the gates that led to the inner courtyard of the temple and noticed that they were higher than those leading to the outer courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gates, and it was
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la chɩŋ boi-baal-la sɩ tuu tinteeŋ lɛ aŋ magɩsɛ a mʋ yi tʋɔŋ kaala-la harɩŋ. Ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ kala. Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa boi-baalɩŋ

english_verse: Next, the man measured the north gate that led to the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ magɩsɛ boi-baal-la sɩ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa a lɩlɩɩ harɩŋ kaala-la, ʋ duomuŋ arɩ ʋ jalɩŋ kala.

english_verse: This gate also had three guardrooms on each side of a passageway. The measurements of these rooms, the walls between them, and the entrance room at the far end of the passageway were exactly the same as those of the east gate. The north gate was also
translation_verse: Ʋ magɩsɛ dɩɩsɩŋ batori-la sɩ hɛ ʋ sɛmɛ na-kala, jebie-la sɩ hɛ ba pɛgɩsɩŋ arɩ ʋ zawʋra, ba kala magɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ boi-baal-la magɩsɩŋ. Ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mara arɩ banɔŋ nɛ, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: and the windows, the entrance room, and the carvings of palm trees were just like those in the east gate. The entrance room also faced the courtyard of the temple and had seven steps leading up to it.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩɩsɩŋ tokoroba, ʋ zawʋra arɩ abɛ tɩɩsɩ-la ba sɩ tuuro kpɩɛrɛ jebie-la kala magɛ boi-baal-la sɩ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ kɩaa nɛ. Lusuŋ-chol-sɩaa balɩpɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩl aŋ-na yi boi-baal-la, ka ʋ zawʋra chaasɛ tʋɔŋ kaala.

english_verse: Directly across the outer courtyard was a gate that led to the inner courtyard, just as there was for the east gate. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was
