translation_verse: Boi-baal dɔŋ ma nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ a jʋjʋʋ tʋɔŋ kaala-la a chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ, a nagɛ dɔŋɔ-la sɩ chaasʋ a hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Ʋ magɩsɛ boi-baala-la sɩ chaasɛ dɔŋɔ pɛgɛ, ʋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii. Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ boi-baalɩŋ

english_verse: The man then took me to the south gate. He measured the walls and the entrance room of this gate, and the measurements were exactly the same as those of the other two gates.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛmmɛ mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Mɩ na boi-baalɩŋ dɔŋɔ sɩ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ. Ʋ magɩsɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ jebiee arɩ ʋ zawʋra, ba ma magɛ ŋɩɩ dɔnsʋ-la sɩ maga.

english_verse: Seven steps led up to the gate; the entrance room was at the far end of the passageway and faced the courtyard of the temple. Carvings of palm trees decorated the walls along the passageway.
translation_verse: Lusuŋ-chol-sɩaa balɩpɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩl aŋ-na yi boi-baal-la. Ʋ zawʋra-la ma fa chaasɛ tʋɔŋ kaala-la nɛ. Ba tuuri abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ a kpɩɛrɛ jebie-la sɩ chɔŋɔ lɩɩ sɛmɛ kala.

english_verse: And directly across the outer courtyard was a gate on the south side of the inner courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was also
translation_verse: Tʋɔŋ kaala-la ma kɛŋ boi-baalɩŋ nɛ a chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ chɩŋ ʋ lɛ a magɩsa lɩɩ yagɛ harɩŋ boi-baal-la ma sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii. Boi-baala-la sɩɩ jʋʋ tʋɔŋ kaala

english_verse: We then went into the inner courtyard, through the gate on the south side of the temple. The man measured the gate, and it was the same size as the gates in the outer wall.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛmmɛ to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ a kɛmmɛ kaa kʋ jʋʋ tʋɔŋ kaala-la. Ʋ magɩsɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ boi-baal-la, dɩ ʋ ma magɛ boi-baala-la dɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: The entrance room of this gate faced the outer courtyard, and carvings of palm trees decorated the walls of the passageway. Eight steps led up to this gate.
translation_verse: Ʋ zawʋra-la chaasɛ harɩŋ kaala-la nɛ, ba tuuri abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ a kpɩɛrɛ ʋ jebiee. Lusuŋ-chol sɩaa chori nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩl aŋ-na yiu.

english_verse: Next, we went through the east gate to the inner courtyard. The man measured this gate, and it was the same size as the others.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛmmɛ to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ a kʋ jʋʋ tʋɔŋ kaala-la. Ʋ magɩsɛ boi-baal-la, dɩ ʋ ma magɛ ŋɩɩ dɔnsʋ-la sɩ maga.

english_verse: The guardrooms, the walls separating them, and its entrance room had the same measurements as the other gates. The guardrooms and the entrance room had windows, and the gate was
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩɩ-biisiŋ, ʋ jebie-la sɩ chɔŋɔ lɩɩ arɩ ʋ zawʋra, ba kala magɛ boi-baala-la dɔnsʋŋ kɩaa nɛ. Boi-baal-la arɩ ʋ zawʋra-la kɛŋ tokoroba nɛ a golli. Boi-la duomuŋ fa ŋaa naakieliŋ mara arɩ banɔŋ nɛ, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and the walls in the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate.
translation_verse: Ʋ zawʋra-la chaasɛ harɩŋ kaala-la nɛ, ba tuuri abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ kpɩɛrɛ ʋ jebiee sɛmɛ kala. Lusuŋ-chol-sɩaa chori nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩl aŋ-na yiu.

english_verse: Then the man took me to the north gate. He measured it, and it was the same size as the others,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛmmɛ kaa kɔ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ a magɩsɛ ʋ ma, ʋ ma magɛ dɔnsʋ-la,

english_verse: and like the other inner gates, its entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and its walls were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate. The Rooms for Sacrificing Animals
translation_verse: Ʋ zawʋra-la chaasɛ harɩŋ kaala-la nɛ, ba tuuri abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ kpɩɛrɛ ʋ jebiee sɛmɛ kala. Lusuŋ-chol sɩaa chori nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩl aŋ-na yiu. Dɩɩsɩ-la tʋɔŋ ba sɩ jaŋ bɩbɩrɩmɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ

english_verse: Inside the entrance room of the north gate, I saw four tables, two on each side of the room, where the animals to be sacrificed were killed. Just outside this room was a small building used for washing the animals before they were offered as sacrifices to please the Lord or sacrifices for sin or sacrifices to make things right.
translation_verse: Zawʋra-la sɩ hɛ boi-baalɩŋ lɛ, teebʋlba banɛsɛ nɛ fa chɩŋ nɩmɛ, balɩa chɩŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, balɩa ma chɩŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ. Ba nyuŋ nɛ ba yie kpʋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: Four more tables were in the outer courtyard, two on each side of the steps leading into the entrance room.
translation_verse: Boi-baal-la zawʋra-la jeeŋ harɩŋ ma, teebʋlba-la dosunuŋ banɛsɛ nɛ fa chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa boi-baal-la lɛ. Balɩa chɩŋ lusuŋ-chol sɩaa sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, balɩa ma chɩŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: So there was a total of eight tables, four inside and four outside, where the animals were killed,
translation_verse: Teebʋlba-la kala ŋaa chori nɛ boi-baal-la lɛ. Banɛsɛ hɛ tʋɔŋ, banɛsɛ ma hɛ jeeŋ harɩŋ. Ba nyuŋ nɛ ba kpʋkpʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: and where the meat was placed until it was sacrificed on the altar. Next to the tables in the entrance room were four stone tables
translation_verse: Hɔɔnʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ kerikee balɩa balɩa, ba kʋŋkala jalɩŋ magɛ nachala nɛ ba joŋo mɛrɛ jebiiŋ lɛ a golli. Teebʋlba-la nyuŋ nɛ ba yie joŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nammɩa dɩdaŋ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɩɩsɩŋ

english_verse: The man then took me to the inner courtyard, where I saw two buildings, one beside the inner gate on the north and the other beside the inner gate on the south.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la kɛmmɛ kʋ jʋʋ tʋɔŋ kaala-la. Dɩɩsɩŋ balɩa nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Dɔŋɔ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa boi-baalɩŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, aŋ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, dɔŋɔ ma hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ boi-baalɩŋ dɩɩrɩŋ aŋ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa.

english_verse: He said, “The building beside the north gate belongs to the priests who serve in the temple,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Dɩa-la sɩ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋa nɛ. Ba nɩɩ beŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la.

english_verse: and the building beside the south gate belongs to those who serve at the altar. All of them are descendants of Zadok and are the only Levites allowed to serve as the Lord's priests.” The Inner Courtyard and the Temple
translation_verse: Dɩa-la dɔŋɔ ma sɩ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa, ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ kʋa nɛ. Nɩaa deemba ŋaa Zadɔk doho nɩaa nɛ. Ba dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a tɩma pʋ.”

english_verse: We walked to the porch of the temple, and the man measured the doorway of the porch: It was seven meters long, two and a half meters wide, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one and a half meters.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛmmɛ kɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la zawʋra a magɩsɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ jebiee. Ba jalɩŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ sɛmɛ na-kala. Boiŋ nii-la ma jalɩŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩpɛ nɛ, tʋɔŋ jebie-la sɩ chɔŋɔ lɩɩ ma barɩmɩŋ ŋaa naakieli bala arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ sɛmɛ na-kala.

english_verse: The porch itself was ten meters by six meters, with steps leading up to it. There was a column on each side of these steps.
translation_verse: Zawʋra-la tʋɔŋ jalɩŋ fa ŋaa naakieliŋ fii nɛ, ʋ duomuŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩdʋ. Lusuŋ-chol sɩaa fii nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩl aŋ-na yiu. Jebiee balɩa nɛ fa hɛ lusuŋ-chol sɩaa-la sɛsɩŋ. Dɔŋɔ hɛ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, dɔŋɔ ma hɛ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Next we went into the main room of the temple. The man measured the doorway of this room: It was
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la kɛmmɛ kʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ dɩ-balɩŋ tɩtɩa, a magɩsɛ ʋ jebie-la sɩ hɛ boiŋ niiŋ, sɛmɛ na-kala barɩmɩŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ butori.

english_verse: with carvings of winged creatures and had a carving of a palm tree between the creatures. Each winged creature had two faces: A human face looking at the palm tree on one side, and a lion's face looking at the palm tree on the other side. These designs were carved into the paneling all the way around the two rooms.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ tinteeŋ a kaa jɩlaa yi borusuŋ nyuŋ, ba fa tuuri kɩaa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ arɩ abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ nɛ a hɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la harɩŋ jeeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then the man walked to the far end of the temple's main room and said, “Beyond this doorway is the most holy place.” He first measured the doorway: It was one meter wide,
translation_verse: Ʋ magɩsɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩpaaŋ dɩa-la duomuŋ, ʋ ŋaa naakieliŋ fii. Ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ fii, a tɩgɛ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Leriŋ deeŋ nɛ ŋaa lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: The walls of the temple were thicker at the bottom than at the top, which meant that the storage rooms on the top level were wider than those on the bottom level. Steps led from the bottom level, through the middle level, and into the top level.
translation_verse: Dɩɩsɩ-la kala fa sɩ golli Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la jɩla a jalla pɩpɛ nɛ. Ba fa saa dɩɩsɩ-la ba lɩɩ aŋ ka pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ jɩl nyuŋ, dɩɩsɩ-la yie jalla pɩpɛ nɛ. Ba fa hɛ lusuŋ-chol-sɩaa nɛ, a chɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ dɩa lɛ a to tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ dɩa a jɩlaa yagɛ nyuŋ.

english_verse: The temple rested on a stone base three meters high, which also served as the foundation for the storage rooms.
translation_verse: Mɩ na dɩ ba saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la gentine ʋ sii je nɛ a golli. Ʋ gentine-la nyuŋ nɛ sɛsɩŋ dɩɩsɩ-la ma chɩŋ. Ʋ leŋiŋ fa ŋaa naakieliŋ butori nɛ.

english_verse: The outside walls of the storage rooms were two and a half meters thick; there was nothing between these walls
translation_verse: Sɛsɩŋ dɩɩsɩ-la ma harɩŋ jeeŋ barɩmɩŋ fa ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Wuol-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɛsɩŋ dɩɩsɩ-la

english_verse: One door led into the storage rooms on the north side of the temple, and another door led to those on the south side. The stone base extended two and a half meters beyond the outside wall of the storage rooms. The West Building and the Measurements of the Temple
translation_verse: Wuol-la sɩ hɛ dɩɩsɩ-la pɛgɛ lɛ, boiŋ-niiree nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ a jʋjʋʋ sɛsɩŋ dɩɩsɩ-la. Dɔŋɔ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ, dɔŋɔ ma hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Jenaa-la sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ wuol-la lɛ barɩmɩŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a golli.

english_verse: The distance across the front of the temple, including the open space on either side, was also
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ kaala arɩ dɩa-la sɩpaaŋ wuoluŋ, ʋ jalɩŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ.

english_verse: Finally, the man measured the length of the west building, including the side rooms on each end, and it was also
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ magɩsɛ dɩa-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ ʋ keesee balɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ sɛsɩŋ, ba kala duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ. Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ dɩ-balɩŋ, ʋ sɩpaaŋ dɩa arɩ zawʋra-la sɩ chaasɛ kaala-la,

english_verse: were paneled with wood all the way from the floor to the windows, while the doorways, the small windows, and the three side rooms were trimmed in wood.
translation_verse: a pɛ boiŋ-nii-jʋʋlʋŋ, tokoroba-la arɩ keese-la batori sɩ golliba, ba fa kɛŋ daborusuŋ nɛ tɔ ba kala, a chɩŋ tinteeŋ a jɩlaa yagɛ tokoroba lɛ. Tokoroba-la kala fa tɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The paneling stopped just above the doorway. These walls were decorated
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ jeyee lɛ, a chɩŋ tinteeŋ a kaa jɩlaa yi borusuŋ nyuŋ,

english_verse: The doorframe to the temple's main room was in the shape of a rectangle. The Wooden Altar In front of the doorway to the most holy place was something that looked like
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la dɩ-balɩŋ boro-daaŋ kɛŋ sɛsɩŋ banɛsɛ nɛ, kʋ-la fa sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ ma nagɛ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: a wooden altar. It was one and a half meters high and one meter square, and its corners, its base, and its sides were made of wood. The man said, “This is a reminder that the Lord is constantly watching over his temple.” The Doors in the Temple
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koruŋ ma ba sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ ŋaa ma fa hɛ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ, a chɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ leŋiŋ ŋaa naakieli bala arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieli bala. Ʋ gʋnaa, ʋ bʋbʋɔ-chala arɩ ʋ sɛsɩŋ kala fa ŋaa daaŋ nɛ. Baal-la bʋla pɩmɛ, “Teebʋl-la sɩ chɩŋ la TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ nɛ ŋ-la.”

english_verse: Both the doorway to the main room of the temple and the doorway to the most holy place had two doors,
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ dɩ-zɔmʋŋ arɩ lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ kala borusuŋ ŋaa boru-kparaa nɛ.

english_verse: and each door had two sections that could fold open.
translation_verse: Borusu-la ŋaa boru-kparaa nɛ, balɩa suro mʋmʋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, balɩa ma suro mʋmʋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The doors to the main room were decorated with carvings of winged creatures and palm trees just like those on the walls, and there was a wooden covering over the porch just outside these doors.
translation_verse: Borusu-la lɛ, ba saa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa nɛ a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a hɛ a pɛ abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba nagɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ jeye-la lɛ nɛ. Zawʋra-la sɩpaaŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, ba kɛŋ daaŋ ŋaa kʋŋ nɛ ʋ keese tɔ.

english_verse: The walls on each side of this porch had small windows and were also decorated with carvings of palm trees.
translation_verse: Zawʋra-la sɛsɩŋ jeyee lɛ, tokoroba nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, ka ba saa abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ a hɛ jeye-la sɛsɩŋ kala lɛ. Dɩɩ-biisi-la sɩ golli Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɛsɩŋ lɛ, ba kɛŋ daaŋ ŋaa kʋŋ nɛ a keese tɔ ba kala.

english_verse: After the man and I left the temple and walked back to the outer courtyard, he showed me a set of rooms on the north side of the west building. This set of rooms was
translation_verse: Dɩɩsɩŋ deemba boiŋ niiŋ sɩ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa, ba duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ, ba jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ mara arɩ banɔŋ.

english_verse: and at the east end of this wall was the door leading from the courtyard to these rooms. There was also a set of rooms on the south side of the west building.
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, dɩɩsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba hɛ harɩŋ kaala-la arɩ wuol-la pɛgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: with doors that opened toward the north, and in front of them was a walkway five meters wide and
translation_verse: Dɩɩsɩ-la pɛgɛ, wombiiŋ nɛ fa nɩmɛ. Ʋ jalɩŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋnɔŋ, ʋ duomuŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii. Dɩɩsɩ-la borusuŋ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa nɛ.

english_verse: The rooms on the top level were narrower than those on the middle level, and the rooms on the middle level were narrower than those on the bottom level.
translation_verse: Dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ nyuŋ nɛ fa muuro a kɩɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ arɩ bʋbʋɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa dɩa-la bʋbʋɔŋ dɩɩrɩŋ jalla lɩɩ nɛ, ka nyuŋ jɩla muuri.

english_verse: The rooms on the bottom level supported those on the two upper levels, and so these rooms did not have columns like other buildings in the courtyard.
translation_verse: Dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ sugili torimuŋ bɩ jebiee sɩ chagɛba kɩɩ kɛnɛ a nagɛ kaala-la dɩɩsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ jebiee ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba leŋ dɩa-la nyuŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ muuri, ka bʋbʋɔŋ kʋa jal.

english_verse: These rooms were exactly like those on the north side, and they also had a walkway in front of them.
translation_verse: Ka wombiiŋ nɛ fa hɛ ba sɩpaaŋ. Dɩɩsɩŋ deemba ma fa nagɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa nɛ. Ba duomuŋ arɩ ba jalɩŋ kala magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, ba boiŋ niiree ma nagɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The door to these rooms was at the east end of the wall that stood in front of them.
translation_verse: Boiŋ niiŋ nɛ fa hɛ dɩɩsɩ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Boiŋ niiŋ dɔŋɔ ma nɛ fa hɛ wombii-la sɩ suomi lee-la a challɛ jee-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ dɩɩsɩ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ba to jʋjʋʋ dɩɩsɩ-la.

english_verse: The man then said to me: These rooms on the north and south sides of the temple are the sacred rooms where the Lord's priests will eat the most holy offerings. These offerings include the grain sacrifices, the sacrifices for sin, and the sacrifices to make things right.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋla pɩmɛ, “Dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ a chaasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kaala, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ tɩɩba. Nɩmɛ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩɩ tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ jaŋ didii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ. Ba jaŋ joŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a bil nɩmɛ: mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa arɩ cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa, lee-la bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: When the priests are ready to leave the temple, they must go through these rooms before they return to the outer courtyard. They must leave their sacred clothes in these rooms and put on regular clothes before going anywhere near other people. The Size of the Temple Area
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ jʋʋ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, aŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ba kʋ lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la harɩŋ kaala-la, ʋ maga dɩ ba wuri gɛnnɩ-la ba sɩ laala tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a bil dɩɩsɩ-la lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa gɛnnɩ-la bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ba maga ba paa gɛrɩ-wogusuŋ nɛ a laalɛ aŋ-na mʋ lee-la nɩaa sɩ hɔnɔ.”

english_verse: After the man had finished measuring the buildings inside the temple area, he took me back through the east gate and measured the wall around this area.
translation_verse: Baal-la sɩ magɩsɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ dɩɩsɩŋ dɛrɛ, ʋ kɛmmɛ to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ lɩɩ, a magɩsɛ lee-la kala a golli.

english_verse: He used his measuring stick to measure the east side of this wall; it was
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ daa-la ʋ sɩ kaa mɩmagɩsɛ kɩaa duomuŋ nɛ a magɩsɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ jeeŋ. Ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii.

english_verse: Then he measured the north side, the south side, and the west side of the wall, and they were each
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩrɩmɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ma a kɛŋ ʋ daa-la magɩsɛ. Ʋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii.

english_verse: and so the temple area was a perfect square. The wall around this area separated what was sacred from what was ordinary.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ magɩsɛ jee-la sɛsɩŋ banɛsɛ kala a golli. Ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii. Jee-la kɛŋ Wɩa leriŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ pɔrɛ nuhuobiinee leriŋ.

english_verse: The man took me back to the east gate of the temple,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la kɛmmɛ kɔ boi-baal-la sɩ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: meters high, was the place where sacrifices were burned, and the four corners of the top section looked like the horns of a bull. The steps leading up to the altar were on the east side. The Dedication of the Altar
translation_verse: Mɩ na Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa tʋla dɩ ʋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ kʋkɔ. Ʋ dɔmɔ nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ faasa pɛllɛ a dʋdɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ tʋla-la leŋ tinteeŋ kala tʋtʋl.

english_verse: This vision was like the one I had seen when God came to destroy Jerusalem and like the one I had seen near the Chebar River. I immediately bowed with my face to the ground,
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ, ma yie nagɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ na nɛ dɩ La TƖƖNA kɔ dɩ ʋ chei Jerusalɛm a bɩra nagɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ fa sɩ na Keba fuo-la niiŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tuu tele chu.

english_verse: and the Lord's glory came through the east gate and into the temple.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tʋla to boi-baal-la sɩ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kʋ jʋʋ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit lifted me to my feet and carried me to the inner courtyard, where I saw that the Lord's glory had filled the temple.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩma jommi a kaa kʋ jʋʋ tʋɔŋ kaala-la, ka La TƖƖNA tʋla su ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la kala.

english_verse: But if the people and their kings stop worshiping other gods and tear down those memorials, I will live among them forever.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ ba maga ba leŋ vʋɩyaa kpaarɩŋ arɩ ba kuoroo vaamaa ba sɩ saa bil a kpʋkpaarɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: The people of Israel must suffer shame for sinning against me, so tell them about my holy temple. Let them think about it,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl, “Nuhuobiiŋ, dagɛ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la nagɩŋ pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba kaa bɩɩnɛ. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmba a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: then if they are truly sorry, describe for them the design and shape of the temple, the gates, the measurements, and how the buildings are arranged. Explain the regulations about worshiping there, then write down these things, so they can study and obey them.
translation_verse: Dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ kɛmba a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa wɩaa, dagɛ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la nagɩsɩŋ kala pɩba: ŋɩɩ ba sɩ saaʋ, ʋ boye-la ba sɩ too jʋʋ arɩ boye-la ba sɩ to lɩlɩɩ, ŋɩɩ ba sɩ kɩɛlɛ ʋ kʋŋkala, a pɛ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ maga dɩ ba to lɛ. Ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba kala bil a pɩba, dɩ ba jɩŋ ŋɩɩ kʋŋkala sɩ kɩɛla, a wuo to wombie-la kala mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ma tuto mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ.

english_verse: The temple area on my holy mountain must be kept sacred! This is the most important law about the temple. The Altar
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la wombiiŋ mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ma tuto nɛ ŋ-la: Lee-la kala sɩ gollu peel-la nyuŋ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa lee zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ. Wombii-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ma tuto a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koruŋ

english_verse: Each day for the next seven days, you must offer a goat and a bull and a ram as sacrifices for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa balɩpɛ-la tʋɔŋ, tapʋlɩɩ kala, má jaŋ kɛŋ gbuŋgbogo dɩ ba kaa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ma jaŋ pɛ kɛŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ arɩ pie-bele kɔ, ba kʋŋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nyɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, after the altar is built, it must be dedicated by offering sacrifices on it and by splattering it with blood. Here is what you must do:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Nuhuobiiŋ, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ ba nɛ saa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koruŋ deeŋ, wombie-la ma sɩ jaŋ to a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a joŋ chalɩŋ mɩmɩsɛ koru-la nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe from the family of Zadok the priest are the only ones who may serve in my temple—this is my law. So give them a young bull to slaughter as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ joŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ pɩ Zadɔk doho nɩaa sɩ ŋaa Levi tɩmma, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa a tɩtɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ dɩ ba kaa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Take some of the animal's blood and smear it on the four corners of the altar, some on the corners of the middle section, and some more on the rim around its edge. That will purify the altar and make it fit for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ ŋaa nɛŋ-la chalɩŋ a taa nyilli-la sɩ hɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la gʋnaa banɛsɛ lɛ, a ŋaa taa bʋbʋɔ-chal tori-la nyuŋ koru-la sɩ daŋa gʋnaa banɛsɛ-la ma lɛ, a ŋaa taa niipiŋ-la ma ba sɩ biere golli. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ to a pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta a joŋu hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then take the body of the bull outside the temple area and burn it at the special place.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ-bele-la a kaa lɩɩ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la harɩŋ a nyɩgʋ lee sɩ maga.

english_verse: The next day, a goat that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice for sin. Purify the altar with its blood, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Tapʋl lɩa, ma jaŋ kpʋ gbuŋgbogo sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a kɛŋ ʋ chalɩŋ pɩɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la disiniŋ ta arɩ ma sɩ kɛŋ nɛ-bele-la ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Then choose a young bull and a young ram that have nothing wrong with them,
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta dɛrɛ, ma jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ arɩ pie-bele, ba kʋŋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nyɔɔ.

english_verse: and bring them to my temple. The priests will sprinkle salt on them and offer them as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ kɛmba kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa laa a joŋ yɩsɩŋ mɩsɛ aŋ jomba ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: The priests will purify the altar during those days, so that it will be acceptable to me and ready to use.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa balɩpɛ nɛ ma jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la lɛ a pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta ka dɩ ʋ zɔŋ dɩ ma joŋo hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: From then on, the priests will use this altar to offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices to ask my blessing. Then I will be pleased with the people of Israel. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa balɩpɛ-la dɩdɛrɩŋ, a chɩŋ tapʋl chori kaa mʋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ kɛŋ ma kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa arɩ ma nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ laama, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The man took me back to the outer courtyard, near the east gate of the temple area. I saw that the doors to this gate were closed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la mɩɩra kɛmmɛ kɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la harɩŋ boi-baal-la sɩ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, dɩ ʋ tɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said: I, the Lord God of Israel, came through this gate, so it must remain closed forever! No one must ever use it.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Boi-baalɩŋ deeŋ maga dɩ ʋ tɔ chɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga ba suru. Nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ to nɩmɛ jʋʋ. Ʋ maga ʋ tɔ chɩŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa to nɩmɛ nɛ a jʋʋ.

english_verse: The ruler of Israel may come here to eat a sacrificial meal that has been offered to me, but he must use only the entrance room of this gate. People Who Are Not Allowed in the Temple
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaarʋ-la dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ wuo hɔŋ boi-la niiŋ a dii kɩaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ maga ʋ to boiŋ niiŋ zawʋra-la tʋɔŋ a jʋʋ, aŋ bɩra to nɩmɛ a lɩɩ.”

english_verse: Then the man took me through the north gate to the front of the temple. I saw that the brightness of the Lord's glory had filled the temple, and I immediately bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la kɛmmɛ to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ la kʋ chɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩpaaŋ. Mɩ beŋ a na La TƖƖNA tʋla dɩ ʋ su ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la kala. Mɩ tuu tele chu.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, I am going to give you the laws for my temple. So pay attention and listen carefully to what kind of people are allowed to come in the temple, and what kind are not.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, beŋ fii a jegili woruŋ a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la wombiee ma sɩ jaŋ tuto lɛ. Ʋ maga ma jɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba jʋʋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ maga dɩ ba jʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Tell those rebellious people of Israel: I, the Lord God, command you to stop your evil ways!
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ bɩ dagɩŋ ka sɛɩ, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ sɛɩ wʋkɩsɩa-la ma sɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Instead of following the proper ways to worship me, you have put foreigners in charge of worship at my temple.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ maga dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ a tɩŋ mɩ kɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ wɩaa, ma mɩɩra leŋ nɩwogusuŋ nɛ ŋɩŋaa.

english_verse: And so I, the Lord God, say that no godless foreigner who disobeys me will be allowed in my temple. This includes any foreigner living in Israel. The Levites Are Punished The Lord said:
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Nɩwogo kala sɩ bɩ mɩ ka to, a bɩ ʋ peniŋ ma kere bɩ maga ʋ jʋʋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la. Nɩwogusu-la ma sɩ paala guoli Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ bɩ maga dɩ ba jʋʋ.

english_verse: Some of the Levites turned their backs on me and joined the other people of Israel in worshiping idols. So these Levites must be punished!
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ arɩ Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ vɩamɛ aŋ mʋ kpʋkpaarɛ vʋɩyaa.

english_verse: They will still be allowed to serve me as temple workers by guarding the gates and by killing the animals to be sacrificed and by helping the worshipers.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ wuo tɩtɩŋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la boi-baalaa lɛ, a wuo kpʋkpʋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ arɩ pʋsʋŋ dɔnsʋŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kaa kɔ a tɩmaa pɩba.

english_verse: But because these Levites served the people of Israel when they worshiped idols, I, the Lord God, promise that the Levites will be punished. They did not stop the Israelites from sinning,
translation_verse: Ama a tɩŋ ba sɩ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaaŋ a kpaarɛ ba vʋɩyaa pɩpɩba, a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ ŋmɩɛsa nɛ arɩ mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba.

english_verse: and now I will no longer let the Levites serve as my priests or come near anything sacred to me. They must suffer shame and disgrace for their disgusting sins.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ digi mɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, koo Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ. Ba maga ba dii hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ a tɩŋ wʋkɩsɩa-la ba sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: They will be responsible for all the hard work that must be done in the temple. Rules for Priests The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ jomba hɛ dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩa-la dɔnsʋŋ kala sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ.

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe who are descendants of Zadok the priest were faithful to me, even when the rest of the Israelites turned away. And so, these priests will continue to serve as my priests and to offer the fat and the blood of sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ama Levi tɩmma-la sɩ ŋaa Zadɔk doho nɩaa a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ to wʋtɩtɩɩ a tɩŋ mɩ dɩa-la tɩntɩŋŋaa bʋa-la lɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩ vɩamɛ, ba-na jaŋ chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ a joŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ nʋʋŋ arɩ chalɩŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩpɩmɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: They will come into my temple, where they will offer sacrifices at my altar and lead others in worship.
translation_verse: Ba dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ jʋʋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ lee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ba dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ kʋ chɩŋ mɩ koru-la sɩpaaŋ a tɩmaa pɩmɛ.

english_verse: When they come to the inner courtyard, they must wear their linen priestly clothes. My priests must never wear anything made of wool when they are on duty in this courtyard or in the temple.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ jʋʋ tʋɔŋ kaala-la boi-baalaa, ba maga ba laalɛ gɛrɩ-fʋfʋlaa nɛ, ba bɩ maga ba laalɛ gɛrɩ na-kala ba sɩ kɛŋ pie-pʋnaa ŋaa a tɩtɩŋ tʋɔŋ kaala-la boi-baala-la lɛ koo mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Even their turbans and underwear must be made of linen to keep my priests from sweating when they work.
translation_verse: Ba maga ba joŋ gɛrɩ-fʋfʋlaa nyu-bɛllɩŋ a bɛ ba nyusuŋ, aŋ joŋ gɛrɩ-fʋfʋlɩa-la dɔnsʋŋ ma vɔɔ ba tɩnsɩŋ. Ba bɩ maga ba laalɛ kʋŋkala sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba suoli.

english_verse: And before they leave to join the other people in the outer courtyard, they must take off their priestly clothes, then place them in the sacred rooms and put on their regular clothes. That way, no one will touch their sacred clothes and be harmed.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɩɩ lɩɩ harɩŋ kaala-la, lee-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ, ba maga ba wuri gɛnnɩ-la ba sɩ laala tɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ a bil dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ nɛ, aŋ paa gɛrɩ-wogusuŋ laalɛ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ́ gɛnnɩ-la sɩ́ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ digu dɩ wɩɩ ŋaa ba lɛ.

english_verse: Priests must never shave their heads when they are mourning. But they must keep their hair properly trimmed and not let it grow too long.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ maga dɩ ba fʋŋ nyu-kpelliŋ koo a leŋ dɩ ba nyu-pʋnaa faasa waa. Ba maga ba kɩkɛ ba nyusuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: They must not drink wine before going to the inner courtyard.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋŋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ nyʋa girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ dɩ ʋ nɛ kʋ jʋʋ tʋɔŋ kaala-la.

english_verse: A priest must not marry a divorced woman; he can marry only a virgin from Israel or the widow of another priest.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ maga dɩ ba jaa yo-haal koo haal sɩ vɩa ʋ bala. Ba jaŋ wuo jaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa tolo sɩ bɩ baal jɩŋ koo ba Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɔŋɔ yo-haala.

english_verse: Priests must teach my people the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary, and between what is clean and what is unclean.
translation_verse: Ba maga ba dagɛ mɩ nɩaa kɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ-na Wɩa kɩaa a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa nuhuobiine kɩaa, dɩ ba jɩŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ bʋa.

english_verse: Touching a dead body will make a person unclean. So a priest must not go near a dead body, unless it is one of his parents or children, or his brother or unmarried sister.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara bɩ maga ʋ digi sʋʋŋ a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ. Ama dɩ ʋ nyɩmma koo ʋ naaŋ nɛ, koo dɩ ʋ nanʋala koo ʋ tolo nɛ koo ʋ naambie koo ʋ dɩhaala ha sɩ bɩ bala jaa nɛ sʋba, ʋ jaŋ wuo digi.

english_verse: If a priest touches a dead body, he is unclean and must go through a ceremony to make himself clean. Then seven days later,
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ digi sʋʋŋ dɩ ba pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta, ʋ maga ʋ gbɛrɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ nɛ.

english_verse: he must go to the inner courtyard of the temple and offer a sacrifice for sin. After that, he may once again serve as my priest. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ kʋ jʋʋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ kaala-la dɩ ʋ tɩŋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ, ʋ maga ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I myself will provide for my priests, and so they won't receive any land of their own.
translation_verse: Mɩ kpaalɩŋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kpaalɩŋ. Ma bɩ maga ma joŋ kpaal kala pɩba Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ba kpaalɩŋ.

english_verse: Instead, they will receive part of the grain sacrifices, as well as part of the sacrifices for sin and sacrifices to make things right. They will also be given everything in Israel that has been completely dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kaa kʋ pɩ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA. Ba kʋdiilee nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The first part of every harvest will belong to the priests. They will also receive part of all special gifts and offerings the Israelites bring to me. And whenever any of my people bake bread, they will give their first loaf as an offering to the priests, and I will bless the homes of the people when they do this.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ yie ŋaa ma bagɩsɩŋ kʋbumbumba-la a kaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ yie kaa kʋ ŋaa zile mɩ lɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ tɩɩba. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa kʋdiilee, ma maga ma laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa pɩba nɛ, dɩ mɩ to ŋɩɩ lɛ a pɛ ma dɩa nɩaa kala lɛ.

english_verse: Priests must not eat any bird or animal that dies a natural death or that has been killed by a wild animal.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩ maga ba chaŋ nammɩa kala, zaarʋ koo pʋna kala sɩ sʋʋ pimee koo baga kʋa sɩ kpʋa.

english_verse: So from now on, you must use honest weights and measures.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ yallɛ kɩaa koo aa yɔɔ kɩaa, má magɩsɛ ba ʋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: The Festival of Shelters will begin on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and will continue for seven days. On each day of this festival, the ruler will provide the same number of animals that he did each day during Passover, as well as the same amount of grain and olive oil for the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele-la ma sɩ jaŋ gbieli tapʋlaa balɩpɛ, ʋ nɛ jaŋ suomi chɛŋ-pɛɩ tapʋlaa fii arɩ banɔŋ ŋɩɩ. Sɩpaalaarʋ-la maga ʋ chɛ pʋsʋ-la doho tɩtɩa nɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ.

english_verse: kilometers wide. This will belong to the people of Israel and will include the city of Jerusalem. Land for Israel's Ruler The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA tintee-la tʋɔŋ, ma magɩsɛ leriŋ dɩ ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ, dɩ ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ banɔŋ. Tintee-la lɛ nɛ mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ jaŋ hɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God said: You leaders of Israel have cheated and abused my people long enough! I want you to stop sinning and start doing what is right and fair. You must never again force my people off their own land. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Iziral sɩpaalaaraa, ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kieli nɛ. Má leŋ doluŋ diiniŋ arɩ nɩaa dɔgʋsʋŋ, aŋ to wʋtɩtɩɩ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ. Má leŋ mɩ nɩaa tinteeŋ kaa laanɩŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: The ephah will be the standard dry measure, and the bath will be the standard liquid measure. Their size will be based on the homer, which will equal ten ephahs or ten baths.
translation_verse: Gbansɩ-la ma sɩ jaŋ kaa mɩmagɩsɛ kɩaa kala maga ba magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, dɩ kɔlɩbɔba-la ma ma sɩ jaŋ kaa mɩmagɩsɛ lɩɩŋ kɩaa kala magɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The same ceremony must also be done on the seventh day of the month, so that anyone who sins accidentally or without knowing it will be forgiven, and so that my temple will remain holy.
translation_verse: Chɛnɛ-la tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ, ŋ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a pɩ nʋʋkala sɩ bɩ sɛnɛ aŋ ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ ŋaa a pɩɩsɛ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: They will also bring one percent of their olive oil. These things will be measured according to the bath, and ten baths is the same as one homer or one cor.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ kɛŋ olif nʋʋŋ ma ma sɩ na kaa kpaa leree zɔlɔ, a kɛŋ kʋbala kɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel will bring you these offerings.
translation_verse: Tintee-la nʋʋkala nɛ maga ʋ kɛŋ kɩaa deemba mʋ pɩ Iziral tinteeŋ sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: But during New Moon Festivals, Sabbath celebrations, and other religious feasts, you leaders will be responsible for providing animals for the sacrifices, as well as the grain and wine. All these will be used for the sacrifices for sin, the grain sacrifices, the sacrifices to please me, and those to ask my blessing. I will be pleased and will forgive the sins of my people. The Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ sɩpaalaarʋ-la nɛ maga ʋ chɛ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa arɩ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele lɛ, chɛ-wiesiŋ gbiele arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa gbielee dɔnsʋŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ chɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa arɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa a pɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta.”

english_verse: Each day of the festival he is to bring seven bulls and seven rams as sacrifices to please me, and he must bring a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Gbiele-la tapʋlaa balɩpɛ-la kala lɛ, ʋ jaŋ chɛ nɛ-belliŋ balɩpɛ arɩ pie-belliŋ balɩpɛ sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ʋ jaŋ chɛ gbuŋgbogo a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ma.

english_verse: The Lord God said: On the first day of the first month, a young bull that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to purify the temple.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋl-bumbuŋ, ma jaŋ kɛŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kɛnɛ a kaa pɩɩsɛ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: The priest will take some blood from this sacrifice and smear it on the doorposts of the temple, as well as on the four corners of the altar and on the doorposts of the gates that lead into the inner courtyard.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna-la chalɩŋ a taa mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiree nyuŋ, a ŋaa taa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la ma nyuŋ gʋnaa banɛsɛ, a ŋaa taa mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ kaala-la ma boi-baalaa nyuŋ.

english_verse: Beginning on the fourteenth day of the first month, and continuing for seven days, everyone will celebrate Passover and eat bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋl fii arɩ banɛsɛ chɛɛŋ, ma jaŋ gbieli dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Gbiele-la lɛ ma jaŋ dii boroboro sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: On the first day, the ruler will bring a bull to offer as a sacrifice for his sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, tinteeŋ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ chɛ nɛ-bele dɩ ba kaa ŋaa ʋ dɩ tintee-la nɩaa kala wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: He will also provide nine kilograms of grain and three liters of olive oil to be offered with each bull and each ram.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ chɛ mɩaa gbansɩŋ banɔŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ kɔlɩbɔ balɩdʋ a pɛ nɛ-bele arɩ pie-bele-la kʋŋkala lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: The east gate of the inner courtyard must remain closed during the six working days of each week. But on the Sabbath and on the first day of the month, this gate will be opened.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ kaala-la boi-baal-la sɩ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ maga ʋ tɔ nɛ tapʋlɩa-la balɩdʋ ma sɩ yie tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ama tapʋl-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ arɩ chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele chɛɛŋ, ʋ maga ʋ suri nɛ.

english_verse: Israel's ruler will go from the outer courtyard into the entrance room of this gate and stand in the doorway while the priest offers sacrifices to ask my blessing and sacrifices to please me. The ruler will bow with his face to the ground to show that he has worshiped me. Then he will leave, and the gate will remain open until evening.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ sɩpaalaara maga ʋ to harɩŋ kaala-la a kʋ jʋʋ zawʋra-la a chɩŋ boiŋ nii-jʋʋlʋŋ lɛ, ka Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ŋaa sɩpaalaarʋ-la kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ʋ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Boi-nii-jʋʋlɩɩ-la lɛ nɛ sɩpaalaarʋ-la jaŋ chʋɔlɛmɛ aŋ mɩɩra lɩɩ. Ama boi-baal-la bɩ maga ʋ tɔ a kaa mʋ yi dɩdaanɩŋ.

english_verse: Each Sabbath and on the first day of each month, the people of Israel must also come to the east gate and worship me.
translation_verse: Chɛ-wiesii na-kala arɩ chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele na-kala lɛ, tintee-la nɩaa maga dɩ ba kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ boi-baal-la niiŋ nɛ a chʋɔlɛmɛ.

english_verse: On the Sabbath, the ruler will bring six lambs and one ram to be offered as sacrifices to please me. There must be nothing wrong with any of these animals.
translation_verse: Kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩpaalaarʋ-la sɩ jaŋ kaa kʋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ jaŋ ŋaa pie-pɔrɔɔ balɩdʋ arɩ pie-bele. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ maga ʋ kɛŋ nyɔɔ.

english_verse: With the ram, he is to offer nine kilograms of grain, and with each of the lambs, he can offer as much as he wants. He must also offer three liters of olive oil with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: Mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a pɛ pie-bele-la lɛ maga ʋ ŋaa mɩaa gbansɩŋ banɔŋ nɛ. Mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ pɛ pie-pɔrɔ-la lɛ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa mɩa-la magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ sɩ cho. Mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la kʋŋkala lɛ ʋ jaŋ hɛ nʋʋŋ kɔlɩbɔ balɩdʋ.

english_verse: The ruler is to bring six lambs, a bull, and a ram to be offered as sacrifices at the New Moon Festival. There must be nothing wrong with any of these animals.
translation_verse: Chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele tapʋlʋŋ, ʋ maga ʋ kpʋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ, pie-pɔrɔɔ balɩdʋ arɩ pie-bele a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Kɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala bɩ maga ba kɛŋ nyɔɔ.

english_verse: With the bull and the ram, he is to offer nine kilograms of grain, and with each of the lambs, he can offer as much as he wants. He must also offer three liters of olive oil with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga ʋ kɛŋ kɩaa deemba a kaa ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ: mɩaa gbansɩŋ banɔŋ a pɛ nɛ-bele-la lɛ, aŋ chɛ mɩaa magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ sɩ cho a pɛ pie-pɔrɔ-la lɛ, ka Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la kʋŋkala lɛ ʋ hɛ nʋʋŋ kɔlɩbɔ balɩdʋ.

english_verse: The ruler must come through the entrance room of the east gate and leave the same way.
translation_verse: Dɩ sɩpaalaarʋ-la nɛ kʋʋ jʋʋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la, ʋ maga ʋ to zawʋra-la sɩ chɩŋ boiŋ nii-jʋʋlʋŋ lɛ nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩra kʋʋ lɩɩ ma, ʋ maga ʋ to nɩmɛ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: When my people come to worship me during any festival, they must always leave by the opposite gate from which they came: Those who come in the north gate must leave by the south gate, and those who come in the south gate must leave by the north gate.
translation_verse: Dɩ tintee-la nɩaa nɛ kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ ba gbieli-la kʋŋkala lɛ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa boi-baalɩŋ jʋʋ chʋɔlɛmɛ, ʋ maga ʋ to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ boi-baalɩŋ nɛ a lɩɩ. Dɩ nʋʋ ma nɛ to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ boi-baalɩŋ jʋʋ, ʋ maga ʋ to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa boi-baalɩŋ nɛ a lɩɩ. Nʋʋkala bɩ maga ʋ to boi-la ʋ sɩ to kʋ jʋʋ a lɩɩ, ama ʋ maga ʋ to boi-la dɔŋɔ sɩ chaasɛ kʋ-la ʋ sɩ to kʋ jʋʋ nɛ a lɩɩ.

english_verse: Their ruler will come in at the same time they do and leave at the same time they leave.
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaarʋ-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala maga dɩ ba to dɔŋɔ nɛ a kʋ jʋʋ. Dɩ ba nɛ bɩraa lɩɩ ma, ba kala maga dɩ ba bɩra to dɔŋɔ nɛ a lɩɩ.

english_verse: At all other festivals and celebrations, nine kilograms of grain will be offered with a bull, and nine kilograms will be offered with a ram. The worshipers can offer as much grain as they want with each lamb. Three liters of olive oil must be offered with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: Gbieli-la kʋŋkala lɛ, ma jaŋ ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ munuŋ gbansɩŋ banɔŋ a pɛ nɛ-bele lɛ, a ŋaa gbansɩŋ banɔŋ a pɛ pie-bele ma lɛ. Ama pie-pɔrɔ-la-na lɛ, ma jaŋ ŋaa munuŋ magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ma sɩ cho, a hɛ nʋʋŋ kɔlɩbɔ bʋlɩdʋ.

english_verse: If the ruler voluntarily offers a sacrifice to please me or to ask my blessing, the east gate of the inner courtyard will be opened for him. He will offer his sacrifices just as he does on each Sabbath; then he will leave, and the gate will be closed.
translation_verse: Dɩ sɩpaalaarʋ-la nɛ kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kʋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, dɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa nɛ koo dɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa nɛ, ʋ maga ma kɛŋ boi-baal-la sɩ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ suro pʋ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koo ʋ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nagɛ ʋ sɩ yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ dɛrɛ aŋ lɩɩ, ma jaŋ kɛŋ boi-baal-la tɔ.

english_verse: Each morning a year-old lamb that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala chʋchʋɔŋ, ma jaŋ kɛŋ pie-bie sɩ yi jɩna aŋ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a kaa kʋ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Along with it, two kilograms of fine flour mixed with a liter of olive oil must be offered as a grain sacrifice. This law will never change—
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ pɛ kɛŋ ʋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ munuŋ mʋa tuo gbaŋa chʋchʋɔ na-kala, a joŋ nʋʋŋ kɔlɩbɔ balɩa a kaa buu muŋ-la. Wombii-la ma sɩ to a ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The Lord God said: If the ruler of Israel gives some of his land to one of his children, it will belong to the ruler's child as part of the family property.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ sɩpaalaarʋ-la nɛ joŋ ʋ tintee-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a pɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɔŋɔ, tintee-la jaŋ ŋaa ʋ nanʋal-la arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa kʋŋ.

english_verse: But if the ruler gives some of his land to one of his servants, the land will belong to the servant until the Year of Celebration, when it will be returned to the ruler. Only the ruler's children can keep what is given to them.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ joŋ ʋ tinteeŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa dɔŋɔ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa tɩntɩnnʋ-la kʋŋ. Ama dɩ jɩna-la sɩ maga dɩ nɩaa mɩɩra joŋ nɩaa kɩaa sɩ hɛ ba teeŋ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ yie, sɩpaalaarʋ-la jaŋ bɩra laa ʋ tinteeŋ. Ʋ tintee-la ŋaa ʋ dɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dʋndʋŋa kʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The ruler must never abuse my people by taking land from them. Any land he gives his children must already belong to him. The Sacred Kitchens
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaarʋ-la bɩ maga ʋ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ laa, a kiriba ta ba tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ maga ʋ keri tintee-la sɩ ŋaa ʋ kʋa nɛ a pɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ, dɩ mɩ nɩaa kʋŋkala tinteeŋ sɩ́ lɛl ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The man who was showing me the temple then took me back to the inner courtyard. We walked to the south side of the courtyard and stopped at the door to the sacred rooms that belonged to the priests. He showed me more rooms at the western edge of the courtyard
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la kɛmmɛ mʋ dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa boiŋ niiŋ, a kpagɛ boi-baal-la sɩ hɛ tʋɔŋ kaala-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Dɩɩsɩ-la fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, ba bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Baal-la dagɛmɛ lee wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: We went back to the outer courtyard and walked past the four corners.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛmmɛ kʋ lɩɩ harɩŋ kaala-la, la golli ʋ gʋnaa banɛsɛ kala, gʋŋ kala lɛ, kaala hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Around the inside of these smaller courtyards was a low wall of stones, and against the wall were places to build fires.
translation_verse: Kaalɩ-biisi-la tʋɔŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, ba kɛŋ tabɩaa nɛ saa jebii-kuuŋ a golli, aŋ saa leree ba sɩ jaŋ hɩhɛ nyiniŋ a yelli jekuunu-la.

english_verse: The man said, “These are the kitchens where the temple workers will boil the meat that worshipers offer as sacrifices.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋla pɩmɛ, “Leree deemba nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ jaŋ chʋchɔ nɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nammɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: The man took me back to the temple, where I saw a stream flowing from under the entrance. It began in the south part of the temple, where it ran past the altar and continued east through the courtyard.
translation_verse: Baal-la mɩɩra kɛmmɛ kɔ harɩŋ, Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiŋ. Mɩ na dɩ lɩɩŋ ka lɩɩ tinteeŋ boiŋ-nii-jʋʋlʋŋ lɛ a chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. . Lɩɩ-la fa pɛllɛ lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ a to Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: We walked out of the temple area through the north gate and went around to the east gate. I saw the small stream of water flowing east from the south side of the gate.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛmmɛ to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa boi-baalɩŋ a kʋ lɩɩ a kɛmmɛ kaa mʋ boi-baal-la sɩ chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, ka lɩɩ-la pɛllɛ kʋkɔ a lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ.

english_verse: The man walked east, then took out his measuring stick and measured
translation_verse: Baal-la mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kori ŋmɛnɩŋ ʋ sɩ kaa mɩmagɩsɛ kɩaa, a magɩsɛ naakieliŋ zɔɔ-banɔŋ aŋ kɛmmɛ to lɩɩŋ luŋuŋ sɩ magɛ naachɩgɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: The man said, “Ezekiel, son of man, pay attention to what you've seen.” We walked to the riverbank,
translation_verse: Baal-la bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nuhuobiiŋ, beŋ kɩaa deemba kala woruŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mɩɩra kɛmmɛ kɔ fuo-la niiŋ.

english_verse: where I saw dozens of trees on each side.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ kʋ yi nɩmɛ, mɩ na dɩ tɩɩsɩŋ yʋga woruŋ a chɩŋ fuo-la sɛmɛ kala.

english_verse: The man said: This water flows eastward to the Jordan River valley and empties into the Dead Sea, where it turns the salt water into fresh water.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋla pɩmɛ, “Lɩɩŋ deeŋ pɛllɛɛ mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ a tutuu Jɔdaŋ fuo-la fuonaaŋ, a to nɩmɛ mʋ jʋjʋʋ Mʋgʋ-sʋʋŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ pɛllɛ mʋ jʋʋ mʋga-la, ʋ lɩɩŋ yie bɩrɩmɛ nɛ a zɔŋ, ʋ bɩra bɩ yɩsɩŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Wherever this water flows, there will be all kinds of animals and fish, because it will bring life and fresh water to the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Lee na-kala fuo-la sɩ jaŋ pɛllɛ mʋ, pʋna na-kala doho arɩ chenfilee jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a yʋgɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa lɩɩ-la jaŋ leŋ dɩ mʋgʋ-bal-la lɩɩŋ sɩ nagɛ yɩsɩŋ bɩrɩmɛ a zɔŋ. Lee na-kala ʋ sɩ pɛllɛ mʋ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: From En-Gedi to Eneglaim, people will fish in the sea and dry their nets along the coast. There will be as many kinds of fish in the Dead Sea as there are in the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Chenfil-kpʋʋraa jaŋ chɩŋ mʋga-la niiŋ, a lɩɩ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛŋ Gedi a kaa mʋ yi lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛŋ Ɛgɩlam a jɛrɛ ba jomba. Chenfil-doho kala jaŋ yʋgɛ nɩmɛ a nagɛ mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediterenia chenfilee.

english_verse: But the marshes along the shore will remain salty, so that people can use the salt from them.
translation_verse: Ama lɩɩrɩ-la sɩ pɩna kpagɛ fuo-la arɩ pɩla-la-na ha jaŋ kɛŋ yɩsɩŋ dɩ nɩaa nɩna yɩsɩŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Fruit trees will grow all along this river and produce fresh fruit every month. The leaves will never dry out, because they will always have water from the stream that flows from the temple, and they will be used for healing people. The Borders of the Land
translation_verse: Tɩɩ-doho kala sɩɩ nɛŋ jaŋ nyʋ a kɩɛlɛ fuo-la sɛsɩŋ kala a nɛŋ. Tɩɩsɩ-la pɩpaarɩŋ bɩ jaŋ hɩl koo ba vɩa nɛnɩŋ. Ba jaŋ nɩnɛŋ chɛnɛ kala, bɛɛ wɩaa fuo-la lɩɩŋ sɩ pɛllɛɛ lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ ka jʋʋba nɛ. Tɩɩsɩ-la nɛnɛɛ jaŋ ŋaa kʋdiilee, dɩ ba kɛŋ ba pɩpaarɩŋ ma vɩvaarɛ nɩaa.” Tintee-la bʋɔsʋŋ

english_verse: The Lord God said to the people of Israel: When the land is divided among the twelve tribes of Israel, the Joseph tribe will receive two shares. Divide the land equally, because I promised your ancestors that this land would someday belong to their descendants. These are the borders of the land:
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ tintee-la kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a pɩ ma tɩtɩa. Mɩ ŋmɩɛsa pɩ ma naabalɩmaba nɛ arɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ pɩba dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean Sea, then continue eastward to Hethlon, to Lebo-Hamath, then across to Zedad,
translation_verse: Tintee-la bʋa nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa jaŋ chɩŋ Mediterenia mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ a mʋ to taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛfɩlɔŋ a mʋ to Lebo Hamaf a lɩɩ nɩmɛ mʋ to Zedad,

english_verse: Berothah, and Sibraim, which is on the border between the two kingdoms of Damascus and Hamath. The border will end at Hazer-Hatticon, which is on the border of Hauran.
translation_verse: a to taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛrɔta arɩ Sibirem a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Haza Hatɩkɔŋ sɩ hɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hawʋraŋ bʋa.

english_verse: So the northern border will run between the Mediterranean Sea and Hazar-Enon, which is on the border between Damascus and Hamath.
translation_verse: Tintee-la bʋa jaŋ chɩŋ mʋgʋ-bal-la lɛ a mʋ yi Haza Ɛnaŋ, a to Damasɩkʋs wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa bʋa, ka lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hamaf ma nɛ ŋaa ʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa bʋa. Tintee-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa bʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin on the border between the two kingdoms of Hauran and Damascus. It will run south along the Jordan River, which separates the territories of Gilead and Israel, and it will end at the Dead Sea near the town of Tamar.
translation_verse: Tintee-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa jaŋ to peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hawʋraŋ arɩ Damasɩkʋs pɛgɛ. Ʋ jaŋ bɩra to Jɔdaŋ fuo-la sɩ hɛ Gɩlɩad arɩ Iziral tinteeŋ pɛgɛ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi mʋga-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kpagɛ Tama. Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The southern border will begin at Tamar, then run southwest to the springs near Meribath-Kadesh. It will continue along the Egyptian Gorge and will end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Tintee-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ bʋa jaŋ chɩŋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tama a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Mɛrɩba Kadɛs lɩɩrɩ-la leriŋ a to Ijipiti tinteeŋ bʋa ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi Mediterenia mʋgʋ-bal-la. Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The western border will run north along the Mediterranean Sea to a point just west of Lebo-Hamath.
translation_verse: Wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ bʋa ma nɛ jaŋ ŋaa Mediterenia mʋgʋ-bal-la a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ challɛ Lebo Hamaf. Wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: That is the land to be divided among the tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ kɛŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ kpaa ma Iziral doho doho-la.

english_verse: It will belong to the Israelites and to any foreigners living among them whose children were born in Israel. These foreigners must be treated like any other Israelite citizen, and they will receive
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ kɛŋ tintee-la kpaa pɩ ma tɩtɩa arɩ nɩwogusu-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a lʋl biiriŋ. Má jomba dɩ ba nagɛ Iziral tɩmma dɩ ma kpaa leriŋ pɩ ba ma Iziral doho doho-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: a share of the land given to the tribe where they live. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Doho na-kala tʋɔŋ nɩwogusu-la sɩ hɔnɔ, ʋ maga dɩ ba laa ba kpaalɩŋ nɩmɛ nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: South of Judah's territory will be a special section of land. Its length will be twelve and a half kilometers, and its width will run from the eastern border of Israel west to the Mediterranean Sea. My temple will be located in this section of land.
translation_verse: Tintee-la sɩ jaŋ tɩgɛ Juda kʋa lɛ, a lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ, ma jaŋ keru bil dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ kʋŋ. Ʋ jalɩŋ jaŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ. Ʋ duomuŋ a chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ jaŋ magɛ doho doho-la dɔnsʋŋ tinteeŋ. Tintee-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ lɛ nɛ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la jaŋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: An area in the center of this land will belong to me. It will be twelve and a half kilometers long and ten kilometers wide.
translation_verse: Tintee-la ma sɩ jaŋ kere pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA duomuŋ jaŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ, ʋ jalɩŋ ma jaŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ banɔŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give half of my sacred land to the priests. Their share will be twelve and a half kilometers long and five kilometers wide, and my temple will be right in the middle.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ lee-la, ʋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ duomuŋ jaŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ, ʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ jalɩŋ ma jaŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ banɔŋ, ʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ jalɩŋ ma jaŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ banɔŋ, ka wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ duomuŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ. Tinteeŋ deeŋ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ lɛ nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la jaŋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: Only priests who are descendants of Zadok will receive a share of this sacred land, because they remained faithful to me when the Levites and the rest of the Israelites started sinning.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ ŋaa Zadɔk doho nɩaa ba joŋo hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba nɛ tɩɩ tintee-la. Ba to mɩ niiŋ nɛ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ba bɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩkaana-la arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ mɩ harɩŋ niiŋ to.

english_verse: The land belonging to the priests will be the most sacred area and will lie south of the area that belongs to the Levites.
translation_verse: Tintee-la jaŋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ, a ŋaa lee mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa a lɩɩ tintee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa lee zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ. Ʋ jaŋ tɩgɛ Levi doho nɩaa tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I will give the other half of my sacred land to the Levites. Their share will also be twelve and a half kilometers long and five kilometers wide,
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa ma jaŋ laa ba tinteeŋ kpaalɩŋ a tɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa leriŋ. Ʋ duomuŋ jaŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa bʋɩ banɔŋ.

english_verse: South of my sacred land will be a section twelve and a half kilometers long and three kilometers wide. It will not be sacred, but will belong to the people of Israel and will include the city of Jerusalem, together with its houses and pastureland.
translation_verse: Lee-la sɩ jaŋ ka jalɩŋ jaŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ, dɩ ʋ duomuŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ. Lee-la jaŋ ŋaa tabal-la nʋʋkala lee, dɩ ba sɩsaa dɩɩsɩŋ nɩmɛ a ŋaa ba pʋsʋŋ ma dɩ-diiliŋ. Tabal-la jaŋ hɛ tintee-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ.

english_verse: The city will be a square: Each side will be two kilometers long,
translation_verse: Tabal-la sɛsɩŋ banɛsɛ kala duomuŋ jaŋ magɛ dɔŋɔ. Sɛmɛ kala duomuŋ jaŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii.

english_verse: The land on the east and west sides of the city limits will be farmland for the people of Jerusalem; both sections will be five kilometers long and three kilometers wide.
translation_verse: Tintee-kaaŋ-la sɩ tɩgɛ tabal-la lɛ, ʋ dɩ tintee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ pɛ bʋa, ʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ duomuŋ jaŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ banɔŋ, dɩ ʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ banɔŋ. Tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ tabal-la nɩaa jaŋ pɛrɛ kɩaa a didii.

english_verse: People from the city will farm the land, no matter which tribe they belong to.
translation_verse: Iziral doho doho-la nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ tabal-la lɛ jaŋ wuo pɛrɛ lee-la.

english_verse: And so the center of this special section of land will be for my sacred land, as well as for the city and its property. The land will be a square, twelve and a half kilometers on each side.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ deeŋ ma sɩ kere bil ʋ ŋaa mɩ-na Wɩa kʋŋ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ʋ sɛsɩŋ banɛsɛ kala duomuŋ jaŋ magɛ dɔŋɔ, sɛmɛ kala duomuŋ jaŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ. Tabal-la ma jaŋ hɛ tintee-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The regions east and west of this square of land will belong to the ruler of Israel. His property will run east to the Jordan River and west to the Mediterranean Sea. In the very center of his property will be my sacred land, as well as the temple,
translation_verse: Tintee-la sɩ ka a hɛ tabal-la nɩaa tinteeŋ arɩ mɩ-na Wɩa tintee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɛsɩŋ lɛ, Iziral tinteeŋ sɩpaalaara nɛ jaŋ tɩɩʋ. Tintee-la jaŋ chɩŋ mɩ-na Wɩa tintee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ, a mʋ yagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ kala wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa arɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ bʋa lɛ. Tinteeŋ sɩpaalaara nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ leree deemba balɩa kala sɩ tɩgɛ doho doho tinteyee lɛ. Ka dɩ mɩ-na Wɩa tintee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ arɩ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ lee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ hɛ tintee-la kala tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ.

english_verse: together with the share belonging to the Levites and the city of Jerusalem. The northern border of the ruler's property will be the land that belongs to Judah, and the southern border will be the land that belongs to Benjamin. The Division of Land among Tribes in the South The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Levi doho nɩaa tinteeŋ arɩ tabal-la nɩaa tinteeŋ kala jaŋ hɛ sɩpaalaarʋ-la tinteeŋ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ. Sɩpaalaarʋ-la tinteeŋ jaŋ hɛ Juda doho nɩaa arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa tinteeŋ pɛgɛ.

english_verse: Gad's southern border is also the southern border of Israel. It will begin at the town of Tamar, then run southwest to the springs near Meribath-Kadesh. It will continue along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Gad doho nɩaa tinteeŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ bʋa jaŋ to taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tama wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a mʋ to Mɛrɩba Kadɛs lɩɩrɩ-la leriŋ, a to Ijipiti tinteeŋ bʋa ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi Mediterenia mʋgʋ-bal-la.

english_verse: That's how the land of Israel will be divided among the twelve tribes. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Gates of Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Tintee-la ma sɩ jaŋ kaa kpaa pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ, ba kpaalaa ma ba sɩ jaŋ laa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla. Tabal-la boi-baalaa

english_verse: and so the total length of the wall will be ten kilometers. The new name of the city will be “The-Lord-Is-Here!”
translation_verse: Kɛrɛ-la sɩ golli tabal-la chu, ʋ duomuŋ kala jaŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋɩ nibi, a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ a kaa mʋ tabal-la yɩrɩŋ jaŋ ŋaa ‘LA TƖƖNA HƐ DƖMƐ.’ ”

english_verse: In the third year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia attacked Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Jehoyakim sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-tori lɛ nɛ, Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza kʋ golli Jerusalɛm kala chu a yuou.

english_verse: The Lord let Nebuchadnezzar capture Jehoiakim and take away some of the things used in God's temple. And when the king returned to Babylonia, he put these things in the temple of his own god.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna joŋ Juda kuoro Jehoyakim hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ pɛ paa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ paa kɩaa deemba a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ nɛ a bil ʋ vene dɩa lɛ, lee-la ʋ sɩɩ bil ʋ sɩɩfɩaŋ kɩaa.

english_verse: One day the king ordered Ashpenaz, his highest palace official, to choose some young men from the royal family of Judah and from other leading Jewish families.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Nebukadineza pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩpɛnas wombiiŋ, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ Iziral tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ kuoru dɩa arɩ nɩalɩŋ ma dɩchɩnɩŋ sɩ yuŋŋie kaa kɔ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: and give them the same food and wine that I am served. Train them for three years, and then they can become court officials.”
translation_verse: Kuoro bɩra bʋla pɩba dɩ ba ŋaa ʋ dɩa kʋdiilee arɩ sɩŋ-la ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa sɩ yie dii kɩaa aŋ nyʋnyʋa a pɩpɩba tapʋlɩɩ kala. Ba jaŋ dagɛba jɩsɩŋ batori ka dɩ ba-na tɩma pɩpɩ kuoro.

english_verse: Four of the young Jews chosen were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, all from the tribe of Judah.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Juda nɛ ŋaa Danɩɛl, Hananaaya, Mɩsɩɛl arɩ Azarɩa.

english_verse: But the king's chief official gave them Babylonian names: Daniel became Belteshazzar, Hananiah became Shadrach, Mishael became Meshach, and Azariah became Abednego.
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ-la fa hɛ yɩrɩ-falaa nɛ a pɩba. Ʋ hɛ Danɩɛl yɩrɩŋ Bɛlɩtɛsaza, Hananaaya ma yɩrɩŋ Sadɩrak, a hɛ Mɩsal yɩrɩŋ Mɛsak, ka Azarɩa ma yɩrɩŋ ŋaa Abedinego.

english_verse: Daniel made up his mind to eat and drink only what God had approved for his people to eat. And he asked the king's chief official for permission not to eat the food and wine served in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Ama Danɩɛl fa kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ bɩ jaŋ dii kuoro dɩa kʋdiilee koo a nyʋa ʋ sɩnɩŋ dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sʋl tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ-la dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ kɩalɩŋ dii a kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: God had made the official friendly and kind to Daniel.
translation_verse: Wɩa leŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ-la cho Danɩɛl wɩaa a fá ʋ nenige.

english_verse: But the man still told him, “The king has decided what you must eat and drink. And I am afraid he will kill me, if you eat something else and end up looking worse than the other young men.”
translation_verse: Ama tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ-la bʋla pɩ Danɩɛl, “Mɩɩ fá mɩ kʋhɩaŋ kuoro nɛ. Ʋ nɛ dagɛ ma kʋdiilee arɩ ma kʋnyʋalaa. Dɩ mɩ nɛ leŋe dɩ ma dii kʋŋ dɔŋ dɩ ma yaraa bɩ ma bapʋɔsɛ dɔsɛ-la naga, ʋ jaŋ wuo kpʋmɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa.”

english_verse: The king's official had put a guard in charge of Daniel and his three friends. So Daniel said to the guard,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Danɩɛl bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ-la sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ bibeŋ ʋ-na Danɩɛl, Hananaaya, Mɩsal arɩ Azarɩa,

english_verse: “For the next ten days, let us have only vegetables and water at mealtime.
translation_verse: “Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, joŋ tapʋlaa fii a kaa magɩsɛla-na ŋ tɩntɩnnaa a na, sɩ́ la nammɩa pa, aŋ pɩpɩla dɩ-pɩpaarɩŋ arɩ lɩɩŋ dʋndʋŋa dɩ la dii aŋ nyʋnyʋa.

english_verse: When the ten days are up, compare how we look with the other young men, and decide what to do with us.”
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ dɩ ŋ beŋ la yaraa aŋ beŋ bapʋɔsɛ biisi-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ dii kuoro dɩa kʋdiilee yaraa a na, a jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa la-na ŋ tɩntɩnnaa lɛ.”

english_verse: The guard agreed to do what Daniel had asked.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bemba sɛɩ a magɩsɛba tapʋlaa fii.

english_verse: Ten days later, Daniel and his friends looked healthier and better than the young men who had been served food from the royal palace.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩa fii sɩ dɛrɛ, dɩ Danɩɛl arɩ ʋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩmma-la kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa, ba yaraa zɔmɔ kɩɩ bapʋɔsɛ biisi-la fa sɩɩ dii kuoro dɩa kʋdiilee kʋŋkala.

english_verse: After this, the guard let them eat vegetables instead of the rich food and wine.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bemba bɩra bɩ ba kʋdiile-la ba fa sɩ jaŋ dii arɩ sɩŋ-la ba fa sɩ jaŋ nyʋa ka pa, aŋ mɩɩra pɩpɩba dɩ-pɩpaarɩŋ.

english_verse: God made the four young men smart and wise. They read a lot of books and became well educated. Daniel could also tell the meaning of dreams and visions.
translation_verse: Wɩa pɩ bapʋɔsɛ biisiŋ deemba banɛsɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ jɩma dɩ ba wuo jɩŋ teniŋ arɩ wɩɩkala. Danɩɛl-na paala wuo jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yie na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ arɩ duosi dosunuŋ kala bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: At the end of the three-year period set by King Nebuchadnezzar, his chief palace official brought all the young men to him.
translation_verse: Jɩsɩ-la batori Nebukadineza sɩ daga sɩ yie, tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ-la kɛmba kaa mʋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The king interviewed them and discovered that none of the others were as outstanding as Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. So they were given positions in the royal court.
translation_verse: Kuoro bʋl wɩaa ba teeŋ, a na dɩ nʋʋkala tuo a magɛ Danɩɛl, Hananaaya, Mɩsɩɛl arɩ Azarɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro leŋ ba tɩma pʋpʋ.

english_verse: From then on, whenever the king asked for advice, he found their wisdom was ten times better than that of any of his other advisors and magicians.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ na-kala kuoro sɩ pɩɛsa a mʋ tɩgɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ wɩaa sɩaa jɩmɩŋ lɛ, ʋ na dɩ ba nɛ kpɩa ʋ tinteeŋ chichiribee arɩ vʋgʋraa kala naansɩɩŋ fii.

english_verse: During the second year that Nebuchadnezzar was king, he had such horrible nightmares that he could not sleep.
translation_verse: Nebukadineza sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-lɩa lɛ, ʋ duosi duosoo, ba chaasa walɩmʋ woruŋ, ʋ bɩ doŋ wuo pɩŋ.

english_verse: and said, “I am disturbed by a dream that I don't understand, and I want you to explain it.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ duoso nɛ ʋ wʋwalɩmɛmɛ, mɩ saa chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: They answered in Aramaic, “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever! We are your servants. Please tell us your dream, and we will explain what it means.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie beŋ chɛnwʋlaa aŋ dɩdagɛ wɩaa kɛŋ Aramek yikoro a bʋla pɩ kuoro, “A leŋ dɩ kuoro mɩɩsɩŋ duomi. La ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, dagɛ ŋ duoso-la pɩla dɩ la dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: But the king replied, “No! I have made up my mind. If you don't tell me both the dream and its meaning, you will be chopped to pieces and your houses will be torn down.
translation_verse: Kuoro bʋla pɩba, “Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ chaasa bɩɩna joŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ mɩ duoso-la daga aŋ dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ ma, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kɛmma keri muno muno aŋ chei ma dɩɩsɩŋ dɩ ba pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: However, if you do tell me both the dream and its meaning, you will be greatly rewarded and highly honored. Now tell me the dream and explain what it means.”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ dagɛ duoso-la pɩmɛ a dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ ma, mɩ jaŋ joŋ kɩaa siilima a zilma woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má dagɛ duoso-la aŋ dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ ma pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: “Your Majesty,” they said, “if you will only tell us your dream, we will interpret it for you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra bʋl, “Kuoro, la ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, dagɛ ŋ duoso-la pɩla, la jaŋ dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: because you know what's going to happen if you don't come up with the answer. You've decided to make up a bunch of lies, hoping I might change my mind. Now tell me the dream, and that will prove that you can interpret it.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ duoso-la bʋbʋɔŋ daga pɩmɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋbala a dɔgɩsɛ ma kala. Ma kala vʋʋra nɛ dɩ ma nyɩɛ wɩaa a nyɩsɛmɛ a bɩɩnɛ arɩ mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩrɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má dagɛmɛ duoso-la, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ jɩŋ dɩ ma jaŋ wuo dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ ma pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: His advisors explained, “Your Majesty, you are demanding the impossible! No king, not even the most famous and powerful, has ever ordered his advisors, magicians, or wise men to do such a thing.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Nʋʋkala tuo dʋnɩa lɛ sɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩ-la ŋ-na kuoro sɩɩ chɛ. Kuoru kala tuo, ʋ doluŋ cho dɩ ʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ kala, ʋ ha bɩ wʋdoho deeŋ joŋo pɩɛsɛ chichiribu koo nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie beŋ chɛnwʋlaa aŋ dɩdagɛ wɩaa koo wʋjɩnnʋ.

english_verse: It can't be done, except by the gods, and they don't live here on earth.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la kuoro sɩ pɩɛsa chaasa ŋaa wʋhaa nɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo dagɛ wɩɩ-la ŋ-na kuoro sɩɩ chɛ, see vesiŋ, ba ma saa bɩ nuhuobiinee tʋɔŋ guolo.”

english_verse: This made the king so angry that he gave orders for every wise man in Babylonia to be put to death, including Daniel and his three friends. God Tells Nebuchadnezzar's Dream to Daniel
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro pa wombiiŋ dɩ ba kpʋ wʋjɩnnaa kala, aŋ hɛ nɩaa ba gɔllɔ chɩchɛ Danɩɛl arɩ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ ma dɩ ba kpʋ.

english_verse: Arioch was the king's official in charge of putting the wise men to death. He was on his way to have it done, when Daniel very wisely went to him
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro kʋhɩaŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Arɔk, lɩɩ dɩ ʋ kpʋ wʋjɩnna-la sɩ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, Danɩɛl kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a fɩɛla bʋl wɩaa pʋ.

english_verse: and asked, “Why did the king give such cruel orders?” After Arioch explained what had happened,
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩɛsɛ kuoro laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ kuoro pa wombii duoŋ deeŋ?” Arɔk joŋ wɩɩkala a to pɩ Danɩɛl.

english_verse: Daniel rushed off and said to the king, “If you will just give me some time, I'll explain your dream.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ, Danɩɛl sii a mʋ kuoro teeŋ a sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pʋ wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ dieni mʋa ka ʋ wuo dagɛ duoso-la bʋbʋɔŋ pʋ.

english_verse: Daniel returned home and told his three friends.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Danɩɛl mɩɩra mʋ dɩa a bʋl wɩɩ-la pɩ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ Hananaaya, Mɩsɩɛl arɩ Azarɩa.

english_verse: Then he said, “Pray that the God who rules from heaven will be merciful and explain this mystery, so that we and the others won't be put to death.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩba dɩ ba sʋl Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ a bibeŋ kʋŋkala dɩ ʋ fá ba nenige a dagɛba wʋkpuŋkpere-la bʋbʋɔŋ, dɩ ba sɩ́ ʋ dɩ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ kpʋ a pɛ wʋjɩnna-la sɩ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: In a vision one night, Daniel was shown the dream and its meaning. Then he praised the God who rules from heaven:
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋɩŋ, Wɩa joŋ wʋkpuŋkpere-la sɩ faa bʋbʋɔŋ a dagɛ Danɩɛl duosoo tʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Danɩɛl dɛnnɛ Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ

english_verse: “Our God, your name will be praised forever and forever. You are all-powerful, and you know everything.
translation_verse: a bʋl, “Mɩɩ dɛnnɛ Wɩa a kaa mʋ wuu, wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ doluŋ ŋaa ʋ kɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: You control human events— you give rulers their power and take it away, and you are the source of wisdom and knowledge.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ bʋa bʋa kala kaa bɩrɩmɛ, ʋ nɩɩ bil kuoroo, ʋ nɩɩ kiri kuoroo. Ʋ nɩɩ pɩ wʋjɩnnaa wʋjɩmɩŋ a leŋ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ dɩgɩlɩŋ jegilee jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa.

english_verse: You are the God who was worshiped by my ancestors. Now I thank you and praise you for making me wise and telling me the king's dream, together with its meaning.” Daniel Interprets the Dream
translation_verse: Mɩ nyɩmmaba Wɩa, mɩɩ lɔllʋŋ aa dɛnnɩŋ. Ŋ nɛ pɩmɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ doluŋ, ŋ nɛ leŋe mɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la la sɩ pɩɛsɩŋ chɩchɛ, ŋ nɛ leŋe la jɩŋ kuoro duoso.” Danɩɛl dagɛ duoso-la bʋbʋɔŋ

english_verse: Daniel went back to Arioch, the official in charge of executing the wise men. Daniel said, “Don't kill those men! Take me to the king, and I will explain the meaning of his dream.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Danɩɛl sii mʋ Arɔk teeŋ, nɩɩ-la kuoro sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ʋ kpʋ wʋjɩnna-la sɩ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ a bʋla pʋ, “Sɩ́ Babɩlɔŋ wʋjɩnnaa kpʋ, kɛmmɛ kaa mʋ kuoro teeŋ dɩ mɩ dagɛ ʋ duoso-la bʋbʋɔŋ pʋ.”

english_verse: Arioch rushed Daniel to the king and announced, “Your Majesty, I have found out that one of the men brought here from Judah can explain your dream.”
translation_verse: Arɔk kɛŋ Danɩɛl a mʋ kuoro teeŋ lɩma a bʋla pʋ, “Kuoro, mɩ na nʋʋ sɩ lɩɩ Juda nɩalɩŋ la sɩ yuo kɛsɛ tʋɔŋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo dagɛ ŋ duoso-la bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: The king asked Daniel, “Can you tell me my dream and what it means?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro pɩɛsɛ Danɩɛl , “Ŋ jaŋ wuo dagɛ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ na duosoo tʋɔŋ aŋ dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ maa?”

english_verse: Daniel answered: Your Majesty, not even the smartest person in all the world can do what you are demanding.
translation_verse: Danɩɛl bʋl, “Wʋjɩnnʋ, vʋgʋrʋ koo chichiribu koo nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie beŋ chɛnwʋlaa a dɩdagɛ wɩaa kʋŋ tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo dagɛ ŋ-na kuoro wʋkpuŋkpere-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ,

english_verse: But the God who rules from heaven can explain mysteries. And while you were sleeping, he showed you what will happen in the future.
translation_verse: Kuoro, ŋ sɩ pɩŋ bɔsɔ lɛ, ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa mʋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa maachie lɛ nɛ. Wɩa sɩ joŋ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ dɩdagɛ nɩaa, dagɩŋ wɩalɩŋ maachie sɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: However, you must realize that these mysteries weren't explained to me because I am smarter than everyone else. Instead, it was done so that you would understand what you have seen.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, wʋkpuŋkpere deeŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo dagɛ mɩ-na, ʋ bɩ naga mɩ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ yʋgɛ a kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ, ama dɩ ŋ-na kuoro wuo jɩŋ ŋ duosoo arɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ pɩna na bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Your Majesty, what you saw standing in front of you was a huge and terrifying statue, shining brightly.
translation_verse: Kuoro, wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ na ŋ duosoo tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ŋ na kʋŋ ba sɩ mɛ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ a yʋgɛ zuu a tʋtʋl aŋ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ.

english_verse: Its head was made of gold, its chest and arms were silver, and from its waist down to its knees, it was bronze.
translation_verse: Sɛlɩmɛ nɛ ba kaa mɛ kʋ-la nyuŋ, a kɛŋ hɔpʋla mɛ ʋ bɔyɛ arɩ ʋ vaasɩŋ, aŋ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ma mɛ ʋ luoruŋ arɩ ʋ naapuyee.

english_verse: From there to its ankles it was iron, and its feet were a mixture of iron and clay.
translation_verse: Ʋ naasɩŋ ŋaa hɔɔŋ nɛ, ʋ naachɛyɛɛ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ŋaa hɔɔŋ, sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ma ŋaa chʋrʋŋ ba sɩ nyɩgɛ.

english_verse: As you watched, a stone was cut from a mountain—but not by human hands. The stone struck the feet, completely shattering the iron and clay.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩɩ beŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋ na dɩ bʋŋ yɛrɛ lɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ peeliŋ nyuŋ, ka nuhuobiine dee bɩ yɛrɛ, ʋ kʋ tuu ŋmoo kʋ-la ba sɩ mɛ naachɛyɛ-la ba sɩ kɛŋ hɔɔŋ arɩ chʋrʋŋ mɛ a yɛrɛ muno muno.

english_verse: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were crushed and blown away without a trace, like husks of wheat at threshing time. But the stone became a tremendous mountain that covered the entire earth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ hɔɔ-la, chʋrʋ-la, kɔlɩɩ-la, hɔpʋla-la arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la kala yɛrɛ muno muno bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ a nagɛ mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ sɩ hɛ taha lɛ. Peliŋ tii paa viiri ba bɩ jɩŋ lee-la kala ba sɩ to. Ama bʋŋ-la sɩ ŋmoo kʋ-la ba sɩ mɛ yɛrɛ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ peel-bal a su dʋnɩa kala.

english_verse: That was the dream, and now I'll tell you what it means.
translation_verse: Duoso-la nɛ ŋɩɩ, lɛɛlɛ la jaŋ dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ a pɩ ŋ-na kuoro.

english_verse: Your Majesty, you are the greatest of kings, and God has highly honored you with power
translation_verse: Kuoro, ŋ nɛ ŋaa kuoroo kala kuoro. Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ a bibeŋ kʋŋkala joŋ kuoruŋ, doluŋ arɩ yɩrɩŋ pɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: After you are gone, another kingdom will rule, but it won't be as strong. Then it will be followed by a kingdom of bronze that will rule the whole world.
translation_verse: Ŋ harɩŋ lɛ, kuoru dɔŋ jaŋ bɩra kɔ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɩŋ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ kuori-tori jaŋ kɔ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa kɔlɩɩ-la, ʋ jaŋ beŋ dʋnɩa kala.

english_verse: This fourth kingdom will be divided—it will be both strong and brittle, just as you saw that the feet and toes were a mixture of iron and clay.
translation_verse: Naanie-la ŋ sɩ na dɩ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ŋaa hɔɔŋ, ka sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ma ŋaa chʋrʋŋ, ŋɩɩ daga arɩ ʋ kuorii-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ, ka sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ma bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: This kingdom will be the result of a marriage between kingdoms, but it will crumble, just as iron and clay don't stick together.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ na hɔɔŋ dɩ ʋ guoli chʋrʋŋ ba sɩ nyɩga lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ ma jaŋ guoli dɔŋɔ lɛ, aŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ nii-bala a nagɛ hɔɔŋ arɩ chʋrʋŋ sɩ bɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ mɛrɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: During the time of those kings, the God who rules from heaven will set up an eternal kingdom that will never fall. It will be like the stone that was cut from the mountain, but not by human hands—the stone that crushed the iron, bronze, clay, silver, and gold. Your Majesty, in your dream the great God has told you what is going to happen, and you can trust this interpretation. Daniel Is Promoted
translation_verse: Duoso-la ŋ sɩ na dɩ bʋŋ yɛrɛ lɩɩ peeliŋ nyuŋ, ka nuhuobiine dee bɩ yɛrɛ, ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Bʋŋ-la sɩ yɛrɛ hɔɔ-la, kɔlɩɩ-la, chʋrʋ-la, hɔpʋla-la arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la muno muno ŋɩɩ, Wɩa sɩ yʋga joŋ wɩɩ-la maachie sɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɛ a dagɛ ŋ-na kuoro ŋɩɩ. Ŋ duoso-la ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ ma ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ.”
