english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar bowed low to the ground and worshiped Daniel. Then he gave orders for incense to be burned and a sacrifice of grain to be offered in honor of Daniel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Nebukadineza tuu kpirimi Danɩɛl sɩpaaŋ a zilu, aŋ ŋaa ba kɛŋ mɩaa ba sɩ kaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma a kʋ pɩ Danɩɛl.

english_verse: The king said, “Now I know that your God is above all other gods and kings, because he gave you the power to explain this mystery.”
translation_verse: Kuoro bʋla pɩ Danɩɛl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ŋ Wɩa nɛ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ vesiŋ kala, a ŋaa kuoroo kala kuoro a kɛŋ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ dɩdagɛ nɩaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ wuo dagɛ wʋkpuŋkpere deeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The king then presented Daniel with a lot of gifts; he promoted him to governor of Babylon Province and put him in charge of the other wise men.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro leŋ Danɩɛl dɩchɩnɩŋ yuŋ woruŋ a joŋ kɩaa ma yʋgɛ a dii zile ʋ lɛ. Ʋ leŋ ʋ bibeŋ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ kala aŋ ŋaa ʋ wʋjɩnnaa ma kala nɩhɩaŋ.

english_verse: At Daniel's request, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to high positions in Babylon Province, and he let Daniel stay on as a palace official.
translation_verse: Danɩɛl sʋl kuoro ʋ leŋ Sadɩrak, Mɛsak arɩ Abedinego ma ŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ sɛsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ, ka Danɩɛl tɩtɩa ha hɛ kuoro dɩa lɛ a tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: and the king's high officials, governors, and advisors all crowded around them. The men were not burned, their hair wasn't scorched, and their clothes didn't even smell like smoke.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ ʋ tinteeŋ ba sɩ kaa kpaa leree, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ ba jaŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa wɩaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chagɩlɛ kuoro kʋ chigiba. Ba na dɩ nyiŋ-bal-la bɩ ba yaraa liere, wɩɩkala bɩ ba nyu-pʋnaa ŋaa, ba gɛrɩ-duduosu-la bɩ die, nyiniŋ ma bɩ ba kʋŋkala lɛ ka sʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: Then an official stood up and announced: People of every nation and race, now listen to the king's command!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ heelu faasa heeli a bʋl, “Nʋʋkala, tinteyee nɩaa arɩ yikoro na-kala nɩaa, wɩɩ-la ba sɩ sɩ dɩ ma ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: Trumpets, flutes, harps, and all other kinds of musical instruments will soon start playing. When you hear the music, you must bow down and worship the statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kɔ dɩ ma nɩa dɩ ba ŋmʋʋ nyile, ŋmʋlʋŋ, a du cheŋ, kɔnɛ arɩ gɔgʋ kʋŋ na-kala, ʋ maga dɩ ma tuu kpirimi a chʋɔlɛ kʋ-la kuoro Nebukadineza sɩ leŋe ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa bil nɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who refuses will at once be thrown into a flaming furnace.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ́ bɩ tuu kpirime chʋɔlɛ kʋ-la, ba jaŋ guu joŋ tɩɩna yuo hɛ nyiŋgeliŋ dɩa tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: As soon as the people heard the music, they bowed down and worshiped the gold statue that the king had set up.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ba sɩ guu nɩɩ dɩ ba ŋmʋʋ nyile, ŋmʋlʋŋ, a du cheŋ, kɔnɛ arɩ gɔgʋ kɩaa, nʋʋkala, tinteyee nɩaa arɩ yikoro na-kala nɩaa tuu kpirimi a chʋɔlɛ kʋ-la kuoro Nebukadineza sɩ leŋe ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa bil.

english_verse: Some Babylonians used this as a chance to accuse the Jews to King Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ lɛ nɛ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kʋ lɩɩ a bʋl wɩaa lɩɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa harɩŋ.

english_verse: They said, “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Ba bʋla pɩ kuoro Nebukadineza, “Kuoro, a leŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ duomi.

english_verse: And you said that anyone who did not bow down and worship it would be thrown into a flaming furnace.
translation_verse: nɩɩ-la kala sɩ́ bɩ tuu kpirime chʋɔlɛ kʋ-la, ba jaŋ joŋ tɩɩna yuo hɛ nyiŋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Sir, you appointed three men to high positions in Babylon Province, but they have disobeyed you. Those Jews, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, refuse to worship your gods and the statue you have set up.”
translation_verse: Ama Juu tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa ba ŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ a bibeŋ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ sɛsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ, Sadɩrak, Mɛsak arɩ Abedinego bɩ ŋ-na kuoro niiŋ ka to. Ba bɩ ŋ vesiŋ ka kpaarɛ a bɩra bɩ kʋ-la ma ŋ sɩ leŋe ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa bil ka chʋɔlɛ.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar was furious. So he sent for the three young men and said,
translation_verse: Kuoro Nebukadineza faasa na baanɩŋ a leŋ ba yɩrɛ Sadɩrak, Mɛsak arɩ Abedinego ba kɔ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: “I hear that you refuse to worship my gods and the gold statue I have set up.
translation_verse: Nebukadineza pɩɛsɛba, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛɛ, Sadɩrak, Mɛsak arɩ Abedinego, ma bɩ mɩ vesiŋ ka kpaarɛ koo aa chʋɔlɛ kʋ-la mɩ sɩ leŋe ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa bil?

english_verse: Now I am going to give you one more chance. If you bow down and worship the statue when you hear the music, everything will be all right. But if you don't, you will at once be thrown into a flaming furnace. No god can save you from me.”
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ dɩ ma nɛ nɩa dɩ ba ŋmʋʋ nyile, ŋmʋlʋŋ, a du cheŋ, kɔnɛ arɩ gɔgʋ kɩaa, dɩ ma nɛ jaŋ tuu kpirimi a chʋɔlɛ kʋ-la mɩ sɩ leŋe ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa bil, ʋ chaasa ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ. Ama dɩ ma nɛ vɩa dɩ ma chʋɔlʋ, ba jaŋ guu jomma yuo hɛ nyiŋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ. Ka dɩ mɩ na vene-la sɩ jaŋ wuo laama ta mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The God we worship can save us from you and your flaming furnace.
translation_verse: Kuoro, dɩ ba nɛ jonla yuo hɛ nyiŋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, Wɩa-la la sɩɩ to jaŋ laala ta ʋ lɛ, a laala ta ŋ nɩsɩŋ ma lɛ.

english_verse: But even if he doesn't, we still won't worship your gods and the gold statue you have set up.”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ paala bɩ jaŋ laala ta ma, kuoro, laa chɛ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ arɩ la bɩ jaŋ to ŋ vesiŋ koo a chʋɔlɛ kʋ-la ŋ sɩ leŋe ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa bil.”

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar's face twisted with anger at the three men. And he ordered the furnace to be heated seven times hotter than usual.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nebukadineza faasa na baanɩŋ Sadɩrak, Mɛsak arɩ Abedinego nyuŋ, a kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa chei. Ʋ leŋ ba wasa gɩrɛ nyiniŋ, ʋ faasa lɩŋ woruŋ, ʋ lɩmɩŋ kɩɩ bumbuŋ-la naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ.

english_verse: Next, he commanded some of his strongest soldiers to tie up the men and throw them into the flaming furnace.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋ ʋ laalɩyuori duoruŋ dɔnsʋŋ vɔɔ Sadɩrak, Mɛsak arɩ Abedinego a jomba yuo hɛ nyiŋ-bal-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Suddenly the king jumped up and shouted, “Weren't only three men tied up and thrown into the fire?” “Yes, Your Majesty,” his officers answered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ wʋkpuŋkpere ŋaa kuoro Nebukadineza hirigi a sii fɩl aŋ pɩɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlʋ, “Nɩaa batori dee la fa vɔɔ daha a joŋo yuo hɛ nyiŋ-bal-la lɛɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Kuoro, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ.”

english_verse: “But I see four men walking around in the fire,” the king replied. “None of them is tied up or harmed, and the fourth one looks like a god.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl, “Bee na, mɩ na baalaa banɛsɛ nɛ dɩ baa gɔllɛ nyiŋ-la tʋɔŋ, ba bɩ ba vɔbɔ, ba bɩra bɩ folo ma, aŋ ka nɩ-nɛsɩmɩŋ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaara.”

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar went closer to the flaming furnace and said to the three young men, “You servants of the Most High God, come out at once!” They came out,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nebukadineza mʋ kpagɛ nyiŋ-bal-la niiŋ aŋ kpɩa yɩrɛ, “Sadɩrak, Mɛsak arɩ Abedinego, Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala tɩntɩnnaa, má kʋ lɩɩ a kɔ daha.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sadɩrak, Mɛsak arɩ Abedinego kʋ lɩɩ nyiŋ-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar said: Praise their God for sending an angel to rescue his servants! They trusted their God and refused to obey my commands. Yes, they chose to die rather than to worship or serve any god except their own.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nebukadineza bʋl, “Má dɛnnɛ Sadɩrak, Mɛsak arɩ Abedinego Wɩa, ʋ nɛ tɩŋ ʋ tɩndaara ʋ kʋ laa ʋ tɩntɩnnaa ta. Ba laaʋ dii nɛ a vɩa mɩ-na kuoro niiŋ aŋ sɛɩ a joŋ ba mɩɩsɩŋ ta a kɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ to vene dɔŋ koo a kpaarɛ vene dɔŋ, dɩ ba Wɩa dee.

english_verse: And I won't allow people of any nation or race to say anything against their God. Anyone who does will be chopped up and their houses will be torn down, because no other god has such great power to save.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ hɛ niiŋ nɛ, nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ tintee kala lɛ koo yikoro kala nɩaa sɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩɩkala a tɩgɛ Sadɩrak, Mɛsak arɩ Abedinego lɛ, ba kɛmba kaa keri muno muno aŋ ŋmoo ba dɩɩsɩŋ lo dɩ ba pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa vene dɔŋ kala tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo laa ʋ nɩaa ta ŋ-la.”

english_verse: After this happened, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to even higher positions in Babylon Province.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro leŋ Sadɩrak, Mɛsak arɩ Abedinego ŋaa nɩbala Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar sent the following letter to the people of all nations and races on the earth: Greetings to all of you!
translation_verse: Kuoro Nebukadineza tɩŋ tɩndaarɩŋ a pɩ nɩaa kala, tinteyee nɩaa arɩ yikori doho na-kala nɩaa sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ a bʋl, “Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma na ma wʋchɛɛlɛɛ kala.

english_verse: I am glad to tell about the wonderful miracles God Most High has done for me.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa mɩ nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wʋkpuŋkperisi-la arɩ wʋmagɩla-la Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala sɩ ŋaa pɩmɛ a pɩma.

english_verse: His miracles are mighty and marvelous. He will rule forever, and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: Ʋ wʋmagɩlaa ŋaa wʋbala nɛ, ʋ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ ma ŋaa wʋduoru. Ʋ kuoruŋ bɩ dɩdɛrɩŋ kɛnɛ, ʋ nɛ kuoro sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I was enjoying a time of peace and prosperity,
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Nebukadineza fa hɛ mɩ kuoru dɩa lɛ nɛ a kɛŋ kɩaa aa nɩɩ sɩma.

english_verse: Then I commanded every wise man in Babylonia to appear in my court, so they could explain the meaning of my dream.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ ŋaa ba kɛŋ Babɩlɔŋ wʋjɩnnaa kala kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ dɩ ba dagɛ duoso-la bʋbʋɔŋ a pɩmɛ.

english_verse: After they arrived, I told them my dream, but they were not able to say what it meant.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɛŋ chichiribee, nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie beŋ chɛnwʋlaa aŋ dɩdagɛ wɩaa, vʋgʋraa arɩ wʋjɩnna-la kɔ, mɩ bʋl duoso-la pɩba, ama ba bɩ wuo dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ pɩmɛ.

english_verse: I said, “Belteshazzar, not only are you the wisest of all advisors and counselors, but the holy gods have given you special powers to solve the most difficult mysteries. So listen to what I dreamed and tell me what it means:
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋla pɩ Bɛlɩtɛsaza, chichiribee kuoro, mɩ jɩma vesiŋ doluŋ hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ, wʋkpuŋkpere kala tuo a hɛɩ pɩŋ. Mɩ duoso nɛ ŋ-la, dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ pɩmɛ.

english_verse: In my sleep I saw a very tall tree in the center of the world.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ pɩna na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ na tɩa mɩ sɩpaaŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ tinteeŋ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ. Ʋ fa duomo nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: It grew stronger and higher, until it reached to heaven and could be seen from anywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Tɩa-la fa waa barɩmɛ nɛ woruŋ aŋ kɛŋ doluŋ ma. Ʋ nyu-gbaŋa jɩla yagɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, dɩ ŋ hɛ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ kala, ŋ jaŋ naʋ.

english_verse: It was covered with leaves and heavy with fruit— enough for all nations. Wild animals enjoyed its shade, birds nested in its branches, and all creatures on earth lived on its fruit.
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩpaarɩŋ fa zɔmɔ, ʋ nɛnɛɛ yʋga magɛ kʋŋkala diiniŋ. Baga kɩaa pɩpɩŋ ʋ fɩɛlɩŋ lɛ, diibiisiŋ sɩsagɛ ʋ naakelee lɛ a saa ba dɛllɩŋ, kʋŋkala na kɩaa didii ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: “While I was in bed, having this vision, a holy angel came down from heaven
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ pɩna a duduosi duoso deeŋ ŋɩɩ, mɩ bɩra beŋ a na Wɩa tɩndaara dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a kʋʋ tuu.

english_verse: and shouted: ‘Chop down the tree and cut off its branches; strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Make the animals leave its shade and send the birds flying from its branches.
translation_verse: Ʋ faasa kpɩa goŋ a bʋl, ‘Má keri tɩa-la a kuosi ʋ naakelee, a chɩrɛ ʋ pɩpaarɩŋ a kɛŋ ʋ nɛnɛ-la kala pɩsɛ, dɩ baga kɩalɩŋ sɩ pɩŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ arɩ diibiisi-la sɩ sagɛ ʋ naakelee lɛ viiri.

english_verse: But leave its stump and roots in the ground, surrounded by grass and held by chains of iron and bronze. ‘Make sure that this ruler lives like the animals out in the open fields, unprotected from the dew.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ʋ gentine arɩ ʋ naapoloo ha chɩŋ yaŋ tʋɔŋ, dɩ ma kɛŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ ba sɩ kɛŋ hɔɔŋ ŋaa arɩ chɔrʋmɔ-la ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa a vɔɔ. Má leŋ dɩ kuoro deeŋ guoli baga kɩaa tʋɔŋ dʋnɩa lɛ dɩ nyalɩŋ nyala hɛ ʋ lɛ,

english_verse: Give him the mind of a wild animal for seven long years.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩrɩmɛ a nagɛ pʋna kɩaa jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ a sɩ́ nuhuobiine kɩaa nagʋ.

english_verse: This punishment is given at the command of the holy angels. It will show to all who live that God Most High controls all kingdoms and chooses for their rulers persons of humble birth.’
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la Wɩa tɩndaaraa sɩ heele bʋl nɛ ŋɩɩ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ nuhuobiinee kuoruŋ, a jaŋ wuo jomba pɩ nɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ cho dɩ ʋ bibeŋ. Ʋ jaŋ wuo paala jomba pɩ nɩbiisiŋ dɩ ba bibeŋ.’

english_verse: “Daniel, that was the dream that none of the wise men in my kingdom were able to understand. But I am sure that you will understand what it means, because the holy gods have given you some special powers.”
translation_verse: Duoso-la mɩ-na kuoro Nebukadineza sɩ duoso nɛ ŋɩɩ. Lɛɛlɛ Bɛlɩtɛsaza, dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ pɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa wʋjɩnna-la kala sɩ hɛ mɩ tinteeŋ lɛ kʋŋ bɩ wuo dagɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ pɩmɛ. Ama ŋ-na jaŋ wuo, bɛɛ wɩaa vesiŋ doluŋ hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ.” Danɩɛl dagɛ duoso-la bʋbʋɔŋ

english_verse: For a while, Daniel was terribly confused and worried by what he was thinking. But I said, “Don't be bothered either by the dream or by what it means.” Daniel replied: Your Majesty, I wish the dream had been against your enemies.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Danɩɛl tʋɔŋ faasa chei a dieni mʋa. Ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa leŋ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ. Kuoro bʋl, “Bɛlɩtɛsaza, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ duoso-la koo ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ.” Bɛlɩtɛsaza ma bʋl, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, mɩ fa cho dɩ duoso-la ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛrɩŋ wɩɩ nɛ, dɩ wɩɩ-la duoso-la sɩɩ dagʋ ma ŋaa ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You saw a tree that grew so big and strong that it reached up to heaven and could be seen from anywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Tɩa-la ŋ sɩ na dɩ ʋ chaasa waa a barɩmɛ aŋ dol woruŋ, ʋ nyu-gbaŋa jɩla yagɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ chɩŋ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ-kala dɩ ʋ naʋ,

english_verse: Its leaves were beautiful, and it produced enough fruit for all living creatures; animals lived in its shade, and birds nested in its branches.
translation_verse: a kɛŋ pɩpaa-zɔŋŋɔɔ, a nɛnɛ yʋga magɛ kʋŋkala diiniŋ. Baga kɩaa pɩpɩŋ ʋ fɩɛlɩŋ lɛ, diibiisiŋ sagɛ ʋ naakelee lɛ a sɩsaa ba dɛllɩŋ.

english_verse: Your Majesty, that tree is you. Your glorious reputation has reached heaven, and your kingdom covers the earth.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na kuoro nɛ tɩa-la. Ŋ ŋaa nɩbal nɛ aŋ kɛŋ doluŋ ma. Ŋ ballɩŋ jɩla tɩtɩgɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, ŋ doluŋ cheŋ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ kala.

english_verse: Then you saw a holy angel come down from heaven and say, “Chop down the tree and destroy it! But leave its stump and roots in the ground, fastened there by a chain of iron and bronze. Let it stay for seven years out in the field with the wild animals, unprotected from the dew.”
translation_verse: Kuoro, ŋ na Wɩa tɩndaara dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kʋʋ tuu aŋ bʋbʋl, ‘Má keri tɩa-la a cheyu, ama má leŋ ʋ gentine arɩ naapoloo sɩ tuu tinteeŋ chɩŋ yaŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ ba sɩ kɛŋ hɔɔŋ ŋaa arɩ chɔrʋmɔ ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa a vɔɔ. Má leŋ dɩ ʋ guoli baga kɩaa tʋɔŋ dɩ nyalɩŋ nyala hɛ ʋ lɛ. Má leŋ dɩ ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ a nagɛ baga kʋŋ halɩɩ jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ.’

english_verse: Your Majesty, God Most High has sent you this message, and it means
translation_verse: Kuoro, duoso-la bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la, wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa ŋ-na kuoro sɩ ŋaa mɩ nɩhɩaŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: that you will be forced to live with the wild animals, far away from humans. You will eat grass like a wild animal and live outdoors for seven years, until you learn that God Most High controls all earthly kingdoms and chooses their rulers.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kiriŋ dɩ ŋ lɩɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ a mʋ guoli baga kɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ŋ jaŋ dii yaŋ a nagɛ nɛŋ, dɩ nyalɩŋ nyala hɛ ŋ lɛ jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ nuhuobiinee kuoruŋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo joŋo pɩ nɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ cho.

english_verse: But he gave orders not to disturb the stump and roots. This is to show that you will be king once again, after you learn that the God who rules from heaven is in control.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaara sɩ sɩ dɩ ba leŋ tɩa-la gentine arɩ ʋ naapoloo ŋɩɩ, ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, Wɩa jaŋ bɩra joŋ ŋ kuoruŋ pɩŋ dɩ ŋ nɛ kʋ jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ nɩɩ beŋ kʋŋkala.

english_verse: Your Majesty, please be willing to do what I say. Turn from your sins and start living right; have mercy on those who are mistreated. Then all will go well with you for a long time. The Rest of Nebuchadnezzar's Letter about His Second Dream
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, kuoro, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, sɛɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ: Leŋ ŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ŋaanɩŋ aŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ, a leŋ ŋ nɩbɔŋ wɩalɩŋ aŋ kɛŋ zile nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nyaga bil lɛ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ pɩŋ.” Duoso-la kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ

english_verse: About twelve months later, I was walking on the flat roof of my royal palace and admiring the beautiful city of Babylon, when these things started happening to me. I was saying to myself, “Just look at this wonderful capital city that I have built by my own power and for my own glory!”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl, “Bee na taŋ deeŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Babɩlɔŋ sɩ yʋga magɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ nɛ kɛŋ mɩ doluŋ saaʋ, ʋ ŋaa mɩ tinteeŋ tabalɩŋ a laa yɩrɩŋ pɩmɛ mɩ gigenni.”

english_verse: But before I could finish speaking, a voice from heaven interrupted: King Nebuchadnezzar, this kingdom is no longer yours.
translation_verse: Ʋ ha bɩ wɩalɩŋ bʋla dɛrɛ dɩ yikoro lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a bʋl, “Kuoro Nebukadineza, wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ laa ŋ kuoruŋ doluŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You will be forced to live with the wild animals, away from people. For seven years you will eat grass, as though you were an ox, until you learn that God Most High is in control of all earthly kingdoms and that he is the one who chooses their rulers.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kiriŋ dɩ ŋ lɩɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ a mʋ guoli baga kɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ŋ jaŋ dii yaŋ a nagɛ nɛŋ jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ nuhuobiinee kuoruŋ. Ʋ jaŋ wuo joŋo pɩ nɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ cho.”

english_verse: This was no sooner said than done—I was forced to live like a wild animal; I ate grass and was unprotected from the dew. As time went by, my hair grew longer than eagle feathers, and my fingernails looked like the claws of a bird.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Nebukadineza lɛ kʋ ŋaa. Ba kiru ta, ʋ lɩɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a dii yaŋ a nagɛ nɛŋ. Nyalɩŋ nyala hɛ ʋ lɛ halɩɩ, ʋ nyu-pʋnaa waa a nagɛ kachuuŋ pʋnaa, ʋ nenii-fʋlaa ma nagɛ diibie kɩaa.

english_verse: Finally, I prayed to God in heaven, and my mind was healed. Then I said: “I praise and honor God Most High. God lives forever, and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: Jɩsɩ-la balɩpɛ harɩŋ, mɩ-na Nebukadineza kɛŋ mɩ nyuŋ je wɩa-nyuŋ, mɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ mɩɩra kɔ mɩ nyuŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ dɛnnɛ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala. Mɩ zilu a leŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ, ʋ nɛ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ʋ doluŋ bɩ dɩdɛrɩŋ kɛnɛ, ʋ nɛ kuoro sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: To him the nations are far less than nothing; God controls the stars in the sky and everyone on this earth. When God does something, we cannot change it or even ask why.”
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala bɩ kɩa ŋaa ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa arɩ nuhuobiinee kala lɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo pɔ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ wɩɩ ŋaa koo a pɩɛsʋ: Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ ŋaa ŋ-la?

english_verse: At that time my mind was healed, and once again I became the ruler of my glorious kingdom. My advisors and officials returned to me, and I had greater power than ever before.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ mɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ sɩ mɩɩra kɔ mɩ nyuŋ nɛ, nɩaa ma bɩra zilmi a yɩyɩrɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ a tɩŋ mɩ kuoruŋ wɩaa. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chagɩlɛmɛ arɩ mɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ chɛ kɛmmɛ, a hollimi mɩ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ yʋga kɩɩ faafaa-la.

english_verse: That's why I say: “Praise and honor the King who rules from heaven! Everything he does is honest and fair, and he can shatter the power of those who are proud.”
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ-na Nebukadineza ka dɛnnɛ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa kuoro a hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ a yɩyɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ŋaa wɩɩkala ʋ bʋa lɛ nɛ, ʋ wʋŋaalaa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ, ʋ yie kɛmba muuri nɛ.

english_verse: One evening, King Belshazzar gave a great banquet for a thousand of his highest officials, and he drank wine with them.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala ma nɛ fa dii kuoruŋ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ lɛ baa yɩrɛ Bɛlɩsaza. Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala ʋ leŋ ba ŋaa kʋdiilee arɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ yʋgɛ, ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ nɩhɩasɩŋ bʋɩ ba kʋ dii kɩalɩŋ, ka ʋ dɩ ba nyʋnyʋa tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩŋ-la.

english_verse: He got drunk and ordered his servants to bring in the gold and silver cups his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem. Belshazzar wanted the cups, so that he and all his wives and officials could drink from them.
translation_verse: Bɛlɩsaza fa sɩɩ nyʋa sɩŋ-la ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaa ba mʋ paa sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla nyʋnyʋalʋsʋ-la ʋ nyɩmma Nebukadineza fa sɩ paa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kaa kɔ, dɩ ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩhɩasɩŋ, ʋ haalaa arɩ haala-la ʋ sɩ bile aŋ bɩ jaa kaa nyʋa sɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: When the gold cups were brought in, everyone at the banquet drank from them and praised their idols made of gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, and stone.
translation_verse: Ba faa nyʋa sɩŋ-la nɛ, aŋ dɩdɛnnɛ vesi-la ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla, kɔlɩɩŋ, hɔɔŋ, daaŋ arɩ tabɩaa a kaa ŋaa.

english_verse: Suddenly a human hand was seen writing on the plaster wall of the palace. The hand was just behind the lampstand, and the king could see it writing.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nuhuobiine nɩsɩŋ guu kʋ lɩɩ aa ŋmʋnsɛ kɩaa jeeŋ ba sɩ taara lɛ, a kpagɛ chaanaa sɩɩ daŋ kʋ-la nyuŋ kuoro dɩa lɛ. Kuoro bibeŋ nɩsɩ-la, ka ʋ ŋmʋŋmʋnsɛ.

english_verse: He was so frightened that his face turned pale, his knees started shaking, and his legs became weak.
translation_verse: Kuoro sɩaa biri, fawʋllʋŋ faasa kɛnʋ, ʋ naadʋsʋŋ ŋmuŋmoo dɔŋɔ, ʋ naasɩŋ nagɛ ba sʋba.

english_verse: The king called in his advisors, who claimed they could talk with the spirits of the dead and understand the meanings found in the stars. He told them, “The man who can read this writing and tell me what it means will become the third most powerful man in my kingdom. He will wear robes of royal purple and a gold chain around his neck.”
translation_verse: Kuoro ŋaa ba yɩrɛ Babɩlɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie beŋ chɛnwʋlaa aŋ dɩdagɛ wɩaa, wʋjɩnnaa arɩ vʋgʋraa ba kɔ. Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ wuo karɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa a dagɛ ba bʋbʋɔŋ pɩmɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ gɛrɩ-vachalɩŋ a laalʋ, a joŋ sɛlɩmɛ banzɔlɔ a hɛ ʋ baŋŋaa, aŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɩ-tori-la sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ mɩ tinteeŋ.”

english_verse: All of King Belshazzar's highest officials came in, but not one of them could read the writing or tell what it meant,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro wʋjɩnnaa kala kɔ, ama ba bɩ wuo karɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa koo a dagɛ ba bʋbʋɔŋ pɩ kuoro.

english_verse: and they were completely puzzled. Now the king was more afraid than ever before, and his face turned white as a ghost.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ faasa kɛŋ kuoro Bɛlɩsaza, ʋ sɩaa wasa biri. Ʋ nɩhɩasɩ-la ma bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: When the queen heard the king and his officials talking, she came in and said: Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! Don't be afraid or look so pale.
translation_verse: Kuoro naaŋ sɩ nɩɩ kuoro arɩ nɩhɩasɩ-la wʋbʋlʋŋ, ʋ kʋ jʋʋ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ ba sɩ hɔnɔ didii kʋdiile-la a bʋl, “Kuoro, a leŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ duomi. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ walɩmɩŋ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ sɩaa biri.

english_verse: In your kingdom there is a man who has been given special powers by the holy gods. When your father Nebuchadnezzar was king, this man was known to be as smart, intelligent, and wise as the gods themselves. Your father put him in charge of all who claimed they could talk with the spirits or understand the meanings in the stars or tell about the future.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala nɛ hɛ ŋ tinteeŋ lɛ, vesiŋ doluŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ. Ŋ nyɩmma Nebukadineza kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ, ʋ na dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa a nagɛ vesiŋ. Kuoro lɩɩsʋ ʋ ŋaa chichiribee, nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie beŋ chɛnwʋlaa aŋ dɩdagɛ wɩaa, wʋjɩnnaa arɩ vʋgʋraa kuoro.

english_verse: He also changed the man's name from Daniel to Belteshazzar. Not only is he wise and intelligent, but he can explain dreams and riddles and solve difficult problems. Send for Daniel, and he will tell you what the writing means.
translation_verse: Baa yɩrɛ baala deeŋ Danɩɛl nɛ, ka kuoro ma fa kɛnʋ yɩyɩrɛ Bɛlɩtɛsaza. Ʋ fa na dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa a dɩdagɛ duosoo bʋbʋɔŋ, a wuo dɩdagɛ namagaba ma bʋbʋɔŋ aa wasɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛyɛ nɩaa teeŋ. Yɩrɛ Danɩɛl, ʋ jaŋ kʋ dagɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bʋbʋɔŋ pɩŋ.”

english_verse: When Daniel was brought in, the king said: So you are Daniel, one of the captives my father brought back from Judah!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ Danɩɛl kɔ kuoro sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ nɛ Danɩɛl, Juda nɩalɩŋ dɔŋɔ mɩ nyɩmma kuoro sɩ yuo kɛsɛ a kaa kɔɔ?

english_verse: I was told that the gods have given you special powers and that you are intelligent and very wise.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩa dɩ vesiŋ doluŋ hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ, ŋ kɛŋ jɩma, a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Neither my advisors nor the men who talk with the spirits of the dead could read this writing or tell me what it means.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ wʋjɩnnaa arɩ chichiribee kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ nɛ dɩ ba karɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa a dagɛ ba bʋbʋɔŋ pɩmɛ, ama ba bɩ wuo dagɛ ba bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But I have been told that you understand everything and that you can solve difficult problems. Now then, if you can read this writing and tell me what it means, you will become the third most powerful man in my kingdom. You will wear royal purple robes and have a gold chain around your neck.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra nɩa dɩ ŋ jaŋ wuo dagɛ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ a wuo wʋwasɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛyɛ nɩaa teeŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ wuo karɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa a dagɛ ba bʋbʋɔŋ pɩmɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ gɛrɩ-vachalɩŋ a laalɩŋ a joŋ sɛlɩmɛ banzɔlɔ a hɛ ŋ baŋŋaa, aŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa nɩ-tori-la sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ mɩ tinteeŋ.”

english_verse: Daniel answered: Your Majesty, I will read the writing and tell you what it means. But you may keep your gifts or give them to someone else.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Danɩɛl bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩmɛ, koo ŋ joŋo pɩ nʋʋ-dɔŋ. Ama mɩ jaŋ karɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa, aŋ dagɛ ba bʋbʋɔŋ ma pɩŋ.

english_verse: Sir, the Most High God made your father a great and powerful man and brought him much honor and glory.
translation_verse: Kuoro, Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala pɩ ŋ nyɩmma Nebukadineza doluŋ nɛ, a leŋ ʋ ŋaa nɩbal, ba zizilu ʋ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: God did such great things for him that people of all nations and races shook with fear. Your father had the power of life or death over everyone, and he could honor or ruin anyone he chose.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ leŋe ʋ dɩchɩnɩŋ yuŋ ŋɩɩ, nɩaa kala, tinteyee nɩaa arɩ yikoro na-kala nɩaa fɩfáʋ. Nɩalɩŋ kuoro sɩ cho dɩ ʋ kpʋ, ʋ kpʋba nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ma ʋ sɩ bɩ cho dɩ ʋ kpʋa, ʋ lemba nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ cho dɩ ʋ leŋ ba dɩchɩnɩŋ yuŋ, ʋ leŋe ba dɩchɩnɩŋ yʋgɛ nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ma ʋ sɩ cho dɩ ʋ kɛmba muuri, ʋ kaa muuri nɛ.

english_verse: But when he became proud and stubborn, his glorious kingdom was taken from him.
translation_verse: Ama Nebukadineza sɩ kʋ kɛŋ sɩɩ-duoŋ a bɩrɩmɛ babiibal, ʋ tʋɔŋ dol, Wɩa kɛŋ ʋ kuoruŋ laa nɛ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ dɩsɛ.

english_verse: His mind became like that of an animal, and he was forced to stay away from people and live with wild donkeys. Your father ate grass like an ox, and he slept outside where his body was soaked with dew. He was forced to do this until he learned that the Most High God rules all kingdoms on earth and chooses their kings.
translation_verse: Ba kiru ta, ʋ lɩɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ, ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa nagɛ pʋna kɩaa, ʋ guoli kosuŋ tʋɔŋ a dii yaŋ a nagɛ nɛŋ. Nyalɩŋ nyala hɛ ʋ lɛ halɩɩ, a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ kʋ jɩŋ, dɩ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ nuhuobiinee kuoruŋ nyuŋ, a jaŋ wuo jomba pɩ nɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ cho.

english_verse: King Belshazzar, you knew all of this, but you still refused to honor the Lord who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na Bɛlɩsaza sɩ ŋaa ʋ nanʋala, ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala nɛ aŋ bɩ ŋ tɩtɩa kaa muuri.

english_verse: Instead, you turned against him and ordered the cups from his temple to be brought here, so that you and your wives and officials could drink wine from them. You praised idols made of silver, gold, bronze, iron, wood, and stone, even though they cannot see or hear or think. You refused to worship the God who gives you breath and controls everything you do.
translation_verse: Ŋ mɩɩra kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa yʋgɛ arɩ ŋ nɛ kɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ Wɩa jaŋ lɛ. Ŋ ŋaa ba paa ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ nyʋnyʋalʋ-la kaa kʋ pɩŋ nɛ, ŋ dɩ ŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ, ŋ haalaa arɩ haala-la ŋ sɩ bile aŋ bɩ jaa kaa nyʋa sɩnɩŋ. Ŋ dɛnnɛ vesi-la ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla, kɔlɩɩŋ, hɔɔŋ, daaŋ arɩ tabɩaa a ŋaa nɛ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ na, a bɩ wɩaa ka nɩɩ, a bɩ wɩaa ma jɩŋ, aŋ vɩa dɩ ŋ zil Wɩa, nɩɩ-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ŋ wɩɩ wɩɩkala sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: That's why he sent the hand to write this message on the wall.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ʋ nɛ tɩŋ nɩsɩ-la sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ kɩaa.

english_verse: Belshazzar gave a command for Daniel to be made the third most powerful man in his kingdom and to be given a purple robe and a gold chain.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Bɛlɩsaza ŋaa ba joŋ gɛrɛ vachalɩŋ a laalɛ Danɩɛl, a joŋ sɛlɩmɛ banzɔlɔ a hɛ ʋ baŋŋaa, aŋ heele bʋl arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa nɩ-tori-la sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ tintee-la.

english_verse: That same night, the king was killed.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ-la tɩtɩa nɛ ba kpʋ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Bɛlɩsaza.

english_verse: In order to make sure that his government was run properly, Darius put three other officials in charge of the governors. One of these officials was Daniel.
translation_verse: aŋ bɩra lɩɩsɛ nɩhɩasɩŋ batori ba ma bibeŋ sɩpaalaara-la. Danɩɛl nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩasɩ-la dɔŋɔ. Dɩ sɩpaalaara-la nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩkala, ba yie kaa kʋ bʋla pɩba nɛ, dɩ kuoro wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: And he did his work so much better than the other governors and officials that the king decided to let him govern the whole kingdom.
translation_verse: Danɩɛl tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ fa lɩɩ sɩɩŋ a kɩɩ ʋ nɩhɩa-dɔsʋ-la arɩ sɩpaalaara-la kala. Ʋ sɩ wuo wɩaa ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ, kuoro bɩbɩɩnɛ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ʋ nɛ bibeŋ ʋ tinteeŋ kala.

english_verse: The other men tried to find something wrong with the way Daniel did his work for the king. But they could not accuse him of anything wrong, because he was honest and faithful and did everything he was supposed to do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩhɩasɩ-la arɩ sɩpaalaara-la tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa a wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ba na dɩ Danɩɛl chei wɩɩ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ, ama ba bɩ wuo na wɩɩ. Ba bɩ ʋ wʋcheeli kala na, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a bɩ nɩaa ka gɩrɩmɛ a kɛŋ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: Finally, they said to one another, “We will never be able to bring any charge against Daniel, unless it has to do with his religion.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ, “La bɩ jaŋ wuo na wɩɩkala a tɩgɛ Danɩɛl deeŋ lɛ, see ʋ Wɩɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ wombiiŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: They all went to the king and said: “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩhɩasɩ-la arɩ sɩpaalaara-la sii hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a mʋ kuoro Daarus teeŋ a bʋl, “Kuoro, a leŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ duomi.

english_verse: All of your officials, leaders, advisors, and governors agree that you should make a law forbidding anyone to pray to any god or human except you for the next
translation_verse: La-na ŋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ, sɩpaalaaraa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chagɩlɩŋ arɩ ŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ sɛyɛ nɛ, dɩ ŋ tɔ boŋ a leŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ, dɩ nʋʋkala jɩŋ arɩ tapʋlaa mara arɩ fii pɛgɛ, nɩɩ-la kala nɛ chʋɔlɛ vene kala koo nuhuobiiŋ dɩ ŋ-na kuoro dʋndʋŋa dee, dɩ ba joŋ tɩɩna yuo hɛ naachigee dɩjʋʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Order this to be written and then sign it, so it cannot be changed, just as no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed.”
translation_verse: Kuoro, pɩ wombiiŋ dɩ ba tɔ boŋ-la aŋ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nʋʋ sɩ wuo kaa bɩrɩmɛ, a nagɛ Medis arɩ Pɛsɩa tɩŋŋaa wombiee ba sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: So King Darius made the law and had it written down.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Daarus tɔ boŋ a leŋ ba ŋmʋnsa bil.

english_verse: Daniel heard about the law, but when he returned home, he went upstairs and prayed in front of the window that faced Jerusalem. In the same way that he had always done, he knelt down in prayer three times a day, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Danɩɛl sɩ nɩa dɩ ba tɔ boŋ-la nɛ a ŋmʋnsa bil nʋʋkala jɩŋ, ʋ mɩɩra mʋ dɩa a jɩl ʋ lusuŋ nyuŋ dɩa, lee-la tokoroba sɩ suroo chaasɛ Jerusalɛm dɩɩrɩŋ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ yie kpirime chʋɔlɛ Wɩa naansɩɩŋ butori tapʋlɩɩ kala, a lɔllʋ arɩ ʋ fa sɩ vɛnɛɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The men who had spoken to the king watched Daniel and saw him praying to his God for help.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sii hɛ dɔŋɔ a mʋ, a na Danɩɛl dɩ ʋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a sʋsʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: The men then told the king, “That Jew named Daniel, who was brought here as a captive, refuses to obey you or the law that you ordered to be written. And he still prays to his god three times a day.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Danɩɛl, Juda nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ dɔŋɔ vɩa ŋ-na kuoro niiŋ nɛ, a bɩ boŋ-la ŋ sɩ tɔ a leŋ ba ŋmʋnsa bil kaa tɩtɩŋ. Ʋ ha yie chʋɔlɛ Wɩa naansɩɩŋ butori nɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala.”

english_verse: The king was really upset to hear about this, and for the rest of the day he tried to think how he could save Daniel.
translation_verse: Kuoro sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ tʋɔŋ faasa chei, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ laa Danɩɛl ta. Ʋ chɛ wombiiŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ to laa Danɩɛl ta halɩɩ, wɩa tuu jʋʋ.

english_verse: At sunset the men returned and said, “Your Majesty, remember that no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed, not even by the king.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ bɩra sii hɛ dɔŋɔ a mʋ kuoro teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Kuoro, ŋ jɩma Medis arɩ Pɛsɩa tɩŋŋaa wombiiŋ lɛ, dɩ kuoro nɛ tɔ boŋ koo a bʋl wɩɩ bil, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛnʋ bɩrɩmɛ.”

english_verse: So Darius ordered Daniel to be brought out and thrown into a pit of lions. But he said to Daniel, “You have been faithful to your God, and I pray that he will rescue you.”
translation_verse: Kuoro pa wombiiŋ ba kɛŋ Danɩɛl kɔ a joŋu yuo hɛ naachigee dɩjʋʋlʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro bʋla pʋ, “Danɩɛl, a leŋ dɩ ŋ Wɩa-la ŋ sɩ tɩma pɩpa bʋa kala laaŋ ta.”

english_verse: A stone was rolled over the pit, and it was sealed. Then Darius and his officials stamped the seal to show that no one should let Daniel out.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba bilimi tabɩɩŋ kʋ tɔ naachigee dɩ-jʋʋlɩɩ-la niiŋ. Ka kuoro joŋ ʋ nenii-pɩrɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɩhɩasɩŋ nenii-pɩraa a magɩlɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wuo kʋ pɛ Danɩɛl lɛ a lɩɩsʋ.

english_verse: All night long the king could not sleep. He did not eat anything, and he would not let anyone come in to entertain him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro mɩɩra mʋ dɩa. Tɩtaŋ-la kala ʋ bɩ kɩaa die a bɩ leŋe nʋʋ kʋ gbieli ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ bɩ doŋ ma wuo pɩŋ.

english_verse: At daybreak the king got up and ran to the pit.
translation_verse: Sɩɩpʋʋraa kuoro sii fá mʋmʋ naachigee dɩ-jʋʋlɩɩ-la.

english_verse: He was anxious and shouted, “Daniel, you were faithful and served your God. Was he able to save you from the lions?”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ kʋ kpagɛ naachigee dɩ-jʋʋlɩɩ-la, ʋ chele yɩrɛ, “Danɩɛl, Wɩa sɩ weye tɩntɩnnʋ, ŋ Wɩa-la ŋ sɩɩ chʋɔlʋ bʋa na-kala wuo laaŋ ta nɛ naachigee deemba niiŋ lɛɛ?”

english_verse: Daniel answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Danɩɛl bʋl, “Kuoro, a leŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ duomi.

english_verse: My God knew that I was innocent, and he sent an angel to keep the lions from eating me. Your Majesty, I have never done anything to hurt you.”
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa tɩŋ ʋ tɩndaara nɛ, ʋ kʋ tɔ naachige-la niiŋ. Ba bɩ mɩ chaŋa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ na dɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye, a bɩ wɩɩ cheye ŋ-ma Kuoro lɛ.”

english_verse: The king was relieved to hear Daniel's voice, and he gave orders for him to be taken out of the pit. Daniel's faith in his God had kept him from being harmed.
translation_verse: Kuoro tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ, ʋ ŋaa ba lɩɩsɛ Danɩɛl naachigee dɩ-jʋʋlɩɩ-la. Ba sɩ lɩɩsʋ, ba bɩ naawɩɩl kala na ʋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa laa ʋ Wɩa dii nɛ.

english_verse: And the king ordered the men who had brought charges against Daniel to be thrown into the pit, together with their wives and children. But before they even reached the bottom, the lions ripped them to pieces.
translation_verse: Kuoro ŋaa ba kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa pɩ Danɩɛl, a kɛsɛ ba haalaa arɩ ba biiriŋ kala kɔ a jomba yuo hɛ naachigee dɩ-jʋʋlɩɩ-la lɛ. Ba paala bɩ tinteeŋ tele, ka naachige-la fɩla jɩlba a kɛmba pʋɔsɛ a chamba, a yɛrɛ ba haŋgbelee kala.

english_verse: King Darius then sent this message to all people of every nation and race in the world: “Greetings to all of you!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Daarus ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ nɩaa kala, tinteyee nɩaa arɩ yikoro na-kala nɩaa sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ a bʋl ŋ-la: Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma na ma wʋchɛɛlɛɛ kala.

english_verse: I command everyone in my kingdom to worship and honor the God of Daniel. He is the living God, the one who lives forever. His power and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ niiŋ nɛ aa pɩ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ hɛ mɩ tinteeŋ sɛmɛ kala lɛ, arɩ ʋ maga dɩ ma fá Danɩɛl Wɩa nɛ a zizilu. Ʋ nɛ Wɩa sɩ weye. Ʋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ. Ʋ kuoruŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ tele, ʋ doluŋ bɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: He rescues people and sets them free by working great miracles. Daniel's God has rescued him from the power of the lions.”
translation_verse: Ʋ yie lɩɩsɛ nɩaa wɩaa lɛ nɛ, a laaba ta. Ʋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ nɛ Wɩa-jaŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala lɛ. Ʋ nɛ laa Danɩɛl ta naachigee niiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: All went well for Daniel while Darius was king, and even when Cyrus the Persian ruled.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Danɩɛl wɩɩkala vɛŋ woruŋ Daarus arɩ Siirus, Pɛsɩa tɩmma-la kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the first year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had some dreams and visions while I was asleep one night, and I wrote them down. The four winds were stirring up the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Danɩɛl sɩ, “Mɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ tɩtaŋ-la, mɩ na pel-duoŋ sɩ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ tuu dʋnɩa loŋgorunuŋ banɛsɛ kala a kɛŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ vuugi.

english_verse: when suddenly four powerful beasts came out of the sea. Each beast was different.
translation_verse: Baga kɩaa kʋbalaa banɛsɛ sɩ bɩ dɔŋɔ naga, lɩɩ mʋgʋ-bal-la tʋɔŋ kʋ lɩɩ.

english_verse: The first was like a lion with the wings of an eagle. As I watched, its wings were pulled off. Then it was lifted to an upright position and made to stand on two feet, just like a human, and it was given a human mind.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ kʋa nagɛ naachigiŋ aŋ kɛŋ kachuuŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ. Mɩɩ benu ka ʋ kɩŋkɛnsɩ-la kala churi, ka ba kɛnʋ chʋʋla kɩɩ ʋ hui-naasɩŋ balɩa nyuŋ a nagɛ nuhuobiine. Ba joŋ nuhuobiine tʋɔbɩɩnaa hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: The second beast looked like a bear standing on its hind legs. It held three ribs in its teeth, and it was told, “Attack! Eat all the flesh you want.”
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra na baga kʋlɩamɩŋ, ʋ nagɛ lʋgʋmʋŋ. Ʋ sii chɩŋ ʋ hui-naasɩŋ nyuŋ, aŋ ka ʋ chɛbɛ sɛnpɛrɩ-biee haŋgbelee batori ʋ niiŋ lɛ. Ba bʋla pʋ, ‘Sii chaŋ nammɩa a magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ.’

english_verse: The third beast was like a leopard—except that it had four wings and four heads. It was given authority to rule.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ mɩ bɩra na baga kʋa dɔŋɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ, ʋ ma nagɛ kpeye. Kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ banɛsɛ hɛ ʋ duguno lɛ a nagɛ diibie kɩaa. Baga kʋa deeŋ fa kɛŋ nyusuŋ banɛsɛ nɛ, ba joŋ doluŋ pʋ dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: The fourth beast was stronger and more terrifying than the others. Its huge teeth were made of iron, and what it didn't grind with its teeth, it smashed with its feet. It was different from the others, and it had horns on its head—ten of them.
translation_verse: Mɩ duoso-la tʋɔŋ tɩtaŋ-la mɩ bɩra na baga kʋnɛsɩmɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ, sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ a fufugisi nɩaa a kɛŋ doluŋ ma woruŋ. Ʋ nyɩlaa fa ŋaa hɔɔnʋŋ nɛ aŋ barɩmɛ, ʋ kaa dɩŋ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yɛrɛ liliŋ aŋ nʋɔsɛ kʋkaanaa bʋrɩgɛ. Ʋ dɩ bumbuŋ baga kɩalɩŋ kala fa bɩ dɔŋɔ naga. Ʋ fa kɛŋ nyilliŋ fii nɛ.

english_verse: Just as I was thinking about these horns, a smaller horn appeared, and three of the other horns were pulled up by the roots to make room for it. This horn had the eyes of a human and a mouth that spoke with great arrogance. Judgment Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩɩ beŋ nyilli-la, nyil-bie kʋbala kʋ lɩɩ ba tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, a churi nyilli-la batori sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Nyile deeŋ fa kɛŋ sɩaa nɛ ba nagɛ nuhuobiine sɩaa a kɛŋ niiŋ a bʋbʋl babiibal wɩaa.

english_verse: Thrones were set up while I was watching, and the Eternal God took his place. His clothing and his hair were white as snow. His throne was a blazing fire with fiery wheels,
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ bene, mɩ na dɩ ba bil kuoru kpasɩnɩŋ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ faafaa kala hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ. Ʋ gɛnnɩŋ fa pʋlla nɛ a nagɛ kuŋkunuŋ. Ʋ nyu-pʋnaa ma pʋllɛ a nagɛ pie-pʋnaa. Ʋ kuoru kpasa-la faa chol nyiniŋ nɛ, ʋ gɩrɩŋgɩrɩmba kala ŋaa nyiŋgeliŋ.

english_verse: and flames were dashing out from all around him. Countless thousands were standing there to serve him. The time of judgment began, and the books were opened.
translation_verse: Ka nyiniŋ nagɛ fuoŋ a pɩpɛllɛ, a lɩlɩɩ ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Nɩaa bʋɩ-bʋɩba tɩma pʋpʋ, ka nɩaa bʋɩ-bʋɩba fii bʋbʋɔ-bugoo bʋɩ fii chɩŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Ba suomi dɩ ba dii nɩaa sarɩya a suri tenniŋ.

english_verse: I watched closely to see what would happen to this smaller horn because of the arrogant things it was saying. Then before my very eyes, the fourth beast was killed and its body destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ ha bibeŋ a tɩŋ babiibal wɩalɩŋ nyil-bie-la fa sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa. Mɩ faa beŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ halɩɩ, ka ba kpʋ baga kʋnɛsɛ-la a chei ʋ kala a paa yuo hɛ nyiŋgeliŋ lɛ.

english_verse: As I continued to watch the vision that night, I saw what looked like a son of man coming with the clouds of heaven, and he was presented to the Eternal God.
translation_verse: Mɩ duoso-la tʋɔŋ tɩtaŋ-la, mɩ bɩra beŋ a na kʋŋ sɩ nagɛ nuhuobiine dɩ ʋ to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tʋɔŋ kʋʋ tuu. Ʋ sɩ kʋ kpagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ faafaa kala, ba kɛnʋ kaa mʋ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: He was crowned king and given power and glory, so that all people of every nation and race would serve him. He will rule forever, and his kingdom is eternal, never to be destroyed. The Meaning of Daniel's Vision
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ doluŋ, yɩrɩŋ arɩ kuoruŋ doluŋ pʋ. Nɩaa kala, tinteyee nɩaa arɩ yikoro na-kala nɩaa dɩdɛnnʋ. Ʋ doluŋ ŋaa dol-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ, ʋ bɩ lɛl. Ʋ kuoruŋ ma ŋaa kʋŋ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo chei. Duoso-la bʋbʋɔŋ

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was terrified by these visions, and I didn't know what to think.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Danɩɛl sɩ duoso na wɩalɩŋ, ba chaasa walɩmɛmɛ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: But God Most High will give his kingdom to his chosen ones, and it will be theirs forever and ever.”
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala nɩaa jaŋ laa kuorii-la a diiu a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: I wanted to know more about the fourth beast, because it was so different and much more terrifying than the others. What was the meaning of its iron teeth and bronze claws and of its feet that smashed what the teeth and claws had not ground and crushed?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ baga kʋnɛsɛ-la bʋbʋɔŋ. Ʋ nɛ fa bɩ dɔnsʋ-la naga ŋɩɩ aŋ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ kɩŋkɛŋ. Ʋ nyɩlaa ŋaa hɔɔnʋŋ, ʋ naanii-fʋlaa nagɛ kɔlɩɩŋ. Ʋ nɛ dɩŋ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yɛrɛ liŋ aŋ nʋɔsɛ kʋkaanaa bʋrɩgɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I also wanted to know more about all ten of those horns on its head. I especially wanted to know more about the one that took the place of three of the others—the horn that had eyes and spoke with arrogance and seemed greater than the others.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa bɩra chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ nyilli-la fii sɩ hɛ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ arɩ nyile-la ma dɔŋɔ sɩ kʋ lɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ, ka nyilli-la batori-na churo tel. Nyile-la nɛ kɛŋ sɩaa arɩ niiŋ a bʋbʋl babiibal wɩaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: While I was looking, this horn attacked God's chosen ones and was winning the battle.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩɩ beŋ, mɩ na dɩ nyile-la kɛŋ Wɩa nɩaa yuo laalɩŋ a yuo didiiba,

english_verse: Then God Most High, the Eternal God, came and judged in favor of his chosen ones, because the time had arrived for them to be given the kingdom.
translation_verse: a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ faafaa kala sɩ kʋ lɩɩ dii sarɩya a laa pɛ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala nɩaa lɛ. Bʋa-la yie nɛ dɩ ba laa kuorii-la dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ.

english_verse: Then I was told by the one standing there: “The fourth beast will be a fourth kingdom to appear on earth. It will be different from all the others— it will trample the earth and crush it to pieces.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la, “Baga kʋnɛsɛ-la ŋaa kuori-gentiŋ-nɛsɛ nɛ sɩ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ dʋnɩa lɛ. Ʋ dɩ kuori-gentisi-la dɔnsʋŋ wɩaa bɩ jaŋ nagɛ dɔŋɔ, ʋ jaŋ kpʋ dʋnɩa nɩaa a nʋɔsɛba bʋrɩgɛ.

english_verse: All ten of those horns are kings who will come from this kingdom, and one more will follow. This horn will be different from the others, and it will conquer three other kings.
translation_verse: Nyilli-la fii ŋaa kuoroo fii nɛ sɩ jaŋ lɩɩ kuori-gentine deeŋ lɛ a dii kuoruŋ deeŋ aŋ ka pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ. Ba harɩŋ lɛ kuoro dɔŋɔ ma jaŋ bɩra dii kuoruŋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ nagɛ faafaa kuorie-la, ʋ jaŋ yuo dii kuoroo batori.

english_verse: “This king will speak evil of God Most High, and he will be cruel to God's chosen ones. He will try to change God's Law and the sacred seasons. And he will be able to do this for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ bʋl wɩaa lɩɩ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala harɩŋ, aŋ nyagɛ Wɩa nɩaa bil, aŋ wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wombii-la Wɩa sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto wɩaa bɩrɩmɛ. Ba jaŋ joŋ Wɩa nɩaa hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ jɩsɩŋ batori arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: But he will finally be judged, and his kingdom completely destroyed.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa jaŋ dii ʋ sarɩya, a laa ʋ doluŋ kala a cheyu a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: “Then the greatest kingdom of all will be given to the chosen ones of God Most High. His kingdom will be eternal, and all others will serve and obey him.”
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ joŋ doluŋ arɩ kuoruŋ yuŋuŋ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ a pɩ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala nɩaa. Ba kuoruŋ doluŋ bɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ. Kuoroo kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ jaŋ to ba niiŋ a tɩma pɩpɩba.”

english_verse: That was what I saw and heard. I turned pale with fear and kept it all to myself.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la. Mɩ-na Danɩɛl tʋɔbɩɩnaa walɩmɛmɛ nɛ woruŋ, mɩ sɩaa biri, ka mɩ joŋ wɩɩ-la hɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the third year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had a second vision
translation_verse: Bɛlɩsaza sɩ dii kuoruŋ, ʋ jɩ-tori lɛ nɛ, mɩ-na Danɩɛl bɩra na wɩaa a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ, bumbuŋ duoso-la harɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: when I looked up and saw a ram standing there with two horns on its head—both of them were long, but the second one was longer than the first.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ a na pie-bele mɩ sɩpaaŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ fuo-la sɛmɛ a kɛŋ nyil-duduosuŋ balɩa, nyile-la sɩ to harɩŋ nyʋ waa kɩɩ bumbuŋ kʋa.

english_verse: The ram went charging toward the west, the north, and the south. No other animals were strong enough to oppose him, and nothing could save them from his power. So he did as he pleased and became even more powerful.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ beŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ ka pie-bele-la tʋɔra mʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Pʋna kala tuo a wuo chemu, kʋŋ ma bɩ ba wuo laa ta ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ, a bɩrɩmɛ geriwoŋŋu.

english_verse: I kept on watching and saw a goat come from the west and charge across the entire earth, without even touching the ground. Between his eyes was a powerful horn,
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ kɛŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ a bɩbɩɩnɛ, dɩ gbuŋgbogo guu lɩɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Nyil-duo kʋbala hɛ ʋ sɩaa pɛgɛ, a tʋɔra golli dʋnɩa kala, ka ʋ naasɩŋ bɩ tinteeŋ dige.

english_verse: and with tremendous anger the goat started toward the ram that I had seen beside the river.
translation_verse: Ʋ na baanɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a tʋɔrɛ chaasɛ pie-bele-la mɩ fa sɩ na dɩ ʋ chɩŋ fuo-la sɛmɛ a kɛŋ nyilliŋ balɩa.

english_verse: The goat was so fierce that its attack broke both horns of the ram, leaving him powerless. Then the goat trampled on the ram, and no one could do anything to help.
translation_verse: Mɩ na dɩ ʋ chaga kɛŋ pie-bele-la arɩ baanɩŋ a yɩ ʋ nyilli-la balɩa bori. Pie-bele-la bɩra bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ chɩna chagʋ. Gbuŋgbogo-la yɩʋ a lo tinteeŋ, a nʋɔsʋ woruŋ, ka kʋŋkala tuo dɩ ʋ laa pie-bele-la ta bʋʋŋ-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: After this, the goat became even more powerful. But at the peak of his power, his mighty horn was broken, and four other mighty horns took its place—one pointing to the north and one to the east, one to the south and one to the west.
translation_verse: Gbuŋgbogo-la bɩrɩmɛ geriwoŋŋu, arɩ ʋ doluŋ sɩ yʋga ma kala, ama ba ha yɩ ʋ ma nyil-duo-la bori nɛ. Ka nyil-duoruŋ banɛsɛ mɩɩra nyʋ nyile-la leriŋ. Ba kʋŋkala chaasɛ dʋnɩa loŋgorunu-la banɛsɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: A little horn came from one of these, and its power reached to the south, the east, and even to the holy land.
translation_verse: Nyilli-la banɛsɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nyil-bie nyʋ a waa a kɛŋ doluŋ a chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tintee-zɔŋ-la.

english_verse: It became so strong that it attacked the stars in the sky, which were heaven's army. Then it threw some of them down to the earth and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Nyil-bie-la waa ŋɩɩ nɛ halɩɩ a jɩla yi wɩa-nyuŋ a yigi wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa arɩ chɛnwʋlaa dɔnsʋŋ lo tinteeŋ a nʋɔsɛba.

english_verse: It humiliated heaven's army and dishonored its leader by keeping him from offering the daily sacrifices. In fact, it was so terrible that it even disgraced the temple and wiped out true worship. It also did everything else it wanted to do.
translation_verse: Nyil-bie-la sɩ bɩ sɛyɛ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa nɩaa bɩra bɩ tapʋlɩɩ kala Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ wuo kpʋ a ŋɩŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Wɩɩkala nyil-bie-la sɩɩ ŋaa wasɛ woruŋ, ʋ leŋ ba joŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ yuo ta tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then one of the holy angels asked another, “When will the daily sacrifices be offered again? What about this horrible rebellion? When will the temple and heaven's army no longer be trampled in the dust?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ dɩ Wɩa tɩndaaraa ka bʋl wɩaa, dɔŋɔ pɩɛsɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ, “Ɛɛ nɛ wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ jaŋ diene magɛ aŋ na ŋaa? Ɛɛ nɛ wʋbɔŋ-la sɩ leŋe ba bɩra bɩ pʋsʋŋ kpʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ tapʋlɩɩ kala jaŋ ŋaa a diene magɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ ba jaŋ ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ aŋ nʋɔsɛ Wɩa nɩaa a diene magɛ?”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was trying to figure out the meaning of the vision, when someone suddenly appeared there beside me.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Danɩɛl fa sɩ na wɩalɩŋ a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ a wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ, kʋŋ guu kʋ chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ a nagɛ nuhuobiine.

english_verse: And from beside the Ulai River, a voice like that of a human said, “Gabriel, help him understand the vision.”
translation_verse: Ka mɩ nɩɩ yikoro dɩ ʋ nagɛ nuhuobiine yikoro a lɩɩ Ʋlaɩ fuo-la lɛ aa yɩrɛ, “Gebiral, dagɛ baala deeŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: Gabriel came over, and I fell to the ground in fear. Then he said, “You are merely a human, but you need to understand that this vision is about the end of time.”
translation_verse: Gebiral sɩ kʋ kpagɛ lee-la mɩ fa sɩ chɩna, fawʋllʋŋ faasa kɛmmɛ mɩ tele chu. Ʋ bʋl, “Nuhuobiiŋ, jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ ka dagɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ wɩaa nɛ.”

english_verse: While he was speaking, I fell facedown in a deep sleep. But he lifted me to my feet
translation_verse: Ʋ fa sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ ŋɩɩ, mɩ kpaŋa pɩŋ nɛ mɩ sɩaa chu tinteeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛmmɛ chʋʋlɛ mɩ sii chɩŋ.

english_verse: and said: Listen, and I will tell you what will happen at the end of time, when God has chosen to show his anger.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl, “Mɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɛ pɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ. Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ ka dagɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: The two horns of the ram are the kings of Media and Persia,
translation_verse: Pie-bele-la ŋ fa sɩ na dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nyilliŋ balɩa nɛ ŋaa Midia arɩ Pɛsɩa kuoroo.

english_verse: the goat is the kingdom of Greece, and the powerful horn between his eyes is the first of its kings.
translation_verse: Gbuŋgbogo-la ma nɛ ŋaa Giriisi tinteeŋ kuoro. Nyil-duo-la ma sɩ chɩŋ ʋ sɩaa pɛgɛ nɛ ŋaa ba kuoru-bumbuŋ.

english_verse: After this horn is broken, four other kingdoms will appear, but they won't be as strong.
translation_verse: Nyilli-la banɛsɛ sɩ nyʋ nyile-la sɩ boro leriŋ ŋaa kuori-gentisiŋ banɛsɛ nɛ sɩ jaŋ sii dii kuoruŋ a kɛŋ tintee-la kpaa, ama ba bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a magɛ bumbuŋ kuoru-la.

english_verse: When these rulers have become as evil as possible, their power will end, and then a king who is dangerous and cannot be trusted will appear.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba kuoruŋ nɛ kʋ kpagɛ dɩdɛrɩŋ, dɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma yʋgɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, kuoru sɩɩ-duo tɩɩna kʋbala wɩaa sɩ hɛyɛ a ŋaa wʋhɛɛrʋ woruŋ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ.

english_verse: He will gain strength, but not on his own, and he will cause terrible destruction. He will wipe out powerful leaders and God's people as well.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ, ama ʋ tɩtɩa kʋlʋŋ doluŋ dee. Ʋ jaŋ chaasa chei leriŋ, dɩ wɩɩ na-kala ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa vɛŋ woruŋ. Ʋ jaŋ chei nɩduoruŋ arɩ Wɩa nɩaa.

english_verse: His deceitful lies will make him so successful, that he will think he is really great. Suddenly he will kill many people, and he will even attack God, the Supreme Ruler. But God will crush him!
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ nyɩsɛ nɩaa a dʋa. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ ʋ nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala. Dɩ nɩaa nɛ hɔnɔ ta jɩa a bɩɩnɛ wɩɩ bɩbaa jʋʋ, kuoru-la jaŋ cheiba yʋgɛ. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ kuoroo kala kuoro yuo yuosuŋ, ama Wɩa jaŋ cheyu dɩ nuhuobiiŋ bɩ pɛ.

english_verse: This vision about the evenings and mornings is true, but these things won't happen for a long time, so don't tell it to others.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ tɩgɛ dɩdaanɩŋ arɩ chʋchʋɔŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ lɛ sɛnɛ jaŋ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ, ama pɔ ŋ sɩ́ bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa maachie wɩaa nɛ.”

english_verse: After this, I was so worn out and weak that it was several days before I could get out of bed and go about my duties for the king. I was disturbed by this vision that made no sense to me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ harɩŋ, mɩ-na Danɩɛl bɛsɩmɛ nɛ a pɩŋ nyanyalaa a yi tapʋlɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra sii a tɩtɩŋ kuoro tɩntɩŋŋaa. Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ fa kperimi nɛ. Mɩ fa bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: Some years later, Darius the Mede, who was the son of Xerxes, had become king of Babylonia. And during his first year as king, I found out from studying the writings of the prophets that the Lord had said to Jeremiah, “Jerusalem will lie in ruins for
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-bumbuŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ-na Danɩɛl karɩmɛ Wɩa teniŋ a jɩŋ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ to ʋ wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya lɛ a bʋl, arɩ Jerusalɛm jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii.

english_verse: Then, to show my sorrow, I went without eating and dressed in sackcloth and sat in ashes. I confessed my sins and earnestly prayed to the Lord my God: Our Lord, you are a great and fearsome God, and you faithfully keep your agreement with those who love and obey you.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩ sʋl mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa ŋɩɩ, mɩ dagɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la mɩ nɩaa sɩ ŋaa a bʋl: “La TƖƖNA ŋ nɛ Wɩa sɩ yʋga a kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ. Ŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ nii-la sɩ hɛ la dɩ ŋ pɛgɛ. Ŋ dagɛ ŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ choŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga nɛ.

english_verse: We have ignored the message your servants the prophets spoke to our kings, our leaders, our ancestors, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Ŋ tɩntɩnnaa sɩ ŋaa ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa a bʋl wɩalɩŋ, la bɩ jegile nɩɩ. Ba bʋl wɩaa ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ a pɩ la kuoroo, la sɩpaalaaraa, la nyɩmmaba arɩ la tinteeŋ nɩaa kala nɛ.

english_verse: Lord God, you are merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against you
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa, ŋŋ fá nɩaa nenige nɛ a joŋ wɩaa chɩchɛba, arɩ la sɩ lɩɩ ŋ harɩŋ ma kala,

english_verse: You warned us and our leaders that Jerusalem would suffer the worst disaster in human history, and you did exactly as you had threatened.
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ la dɩ la sɩpaalaaraa lɛ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ŋ sɩ joŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ ŋaa la lɛ, dʋnɩa kala lɛ wʋdoho-la sɩ ŋaa Jerusalɛm lɛ ha bɩ ŋaa aŋ ka.

english_verse: We have not escaped any of the terrible curses written by Moses, and yet we have refused to beg you for mercy and to remind ourselves of how faithful you have always been.
translation_verse: Wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la kala sɩ hɛ ŋ wombiiŋ teŋ-la Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto lɛ, ŋaa la lɛ nɛ ka la ha vɩa dɩ la bɩrɩma lɩɩ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ŋ-na La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ cho a to ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la.

english_verse: And when you finally punished us with this horrible disaster, that was also the right thing to do, because we deserved it so much.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ bɩ kaa dieni aŋ joŋ wʋlɔrʋŋ ŋaa la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ-na La TƖƖNA Wɩa, ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ wɩɩ na-kala ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala la bɩŋ niiŋ to.

english_verse: Our Lord God, with your own mighty arm you rescued us from Egypt and made yourself famous to this very day, but we have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa, ŋ nɛ kɛŋ ŋ naduo-la a kɛŋ ŋ nɩaa kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a laa yɩrɩŋ pɩ ŋ tɩtɩa a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ. La ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, la cheye nɛ.

english_verse: In the past, you treated us with such kindness, that we now beg you to stop being so terribly angry with Jerusalem. After all, it is your chosen city built on your holy mountain, even though it has suffered public disgrace because of our sins and those of our ancestors.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, a tɩŋ tʋɔpʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa, sɩ́ baanɩŋ na. Leŋ dɩ ŋ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ Jerusalɛm nyuŋ sɩ ŋaa ŋ tabalɩŋ, a ŋaa ŋ dundolo sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. La wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ la nyɩmmaba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ leŋe Jerusalɛm arɩ ŋ nɩaa ŋaa nɩmɔmɩa nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ gollila teeŋ.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord God, and I beg you to answer my prayers and bring honor to yourself by having pity on your temple that lies in ruins.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, jegile nɩɩ mɩ sʋla. Leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ŋ beŋ ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ nyuŋ, a zil ŋ tɩtɩa a laa yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Forgive us! Hurry and do something, not only for your city and your chosen people, but to bring honor to yourself. The Seventy Weeks Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, jegile nɩɩ. La TƖƖNA joŋo chɛla. La TƖƖNA, jegile nɩɩ a kaa tɩŋ. Mɩ Wɩa, tɩŋ ŋ tɩtɩa wɩaa a ŋaa wɩɩ. Sɩ́ kaa dieni a tɩŋ tabal-la arɩ ʋ nɩaa sɩ ŋaa ŋ kɩaa wɩaa.” Gebiral dagɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla Wɩa doluŋ lɛ bʋbʋɔŋ

english_verse: I was still confessing my sins and those of all Israel to the Lord my God, and I was praying for the good of his holy mountain,
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a dɩdagɛ mɩ dɩ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, a sʋsʋl mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ dundolo-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: when Gabriel suddenly came flying in at the time of the evening sacrifice. This was the same Gabriel I had seen in my vision,
translation_verse: mɩ fa haa chʋɔlɛ Wɩa ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ na Gebiral, baal-la mɩ fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ duoso na dɩ ʋ file kɔ mɩ teeŋ dɩdaanɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: and he explained: Daniel, I am here to help you understand the vision.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Danɩɛl, mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: God thinks highly of you, and at the very moment you started praying, I was sent to give you the answer.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩɩ sʋl Wɩa ŋɩɩ, ʋ laa ŋ sʋla nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩŋ. Ʋ choŋ nɛ woruŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa jegile nɩɩ tɩndaarɩ-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ a jɩŋ duoso-la bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: For one week this foreigner will make a firm agreement with many people, and halfway through this week, he will end all sacrifices and offerings. Then the “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction will be put there. And it will stay there until the time God has decided to destroy this one who destroys.
translation_verse: Sɩpaalaara deeŋ arɩ nɩ-daŋ jaŋ bil niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ, ama jɩsɩ-la kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ giri pʋsʋŋ kpʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ kɩaa joŋo ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ta. Ʋ jaŋ joŋ disiŋ kʋŋ sɩɩ chei leriŋ bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, koruŋ leriŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ nɩmɛ halɩɩ, a kaa mʋ bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ daga dɩ ʋ cheyu yie.”

english_verse: In the third year of Cyrus the king of Persia, a message came to Daniel from God, and it was explained in a vision. The message was about a dreadful war, and it was true.
translation_verse: Siirus sɩ dii Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, ʋ jɩ-tori lɛ nɛ Wɩa joŋ wɩaa dagɛ Danɩɛl . Wɩalɩŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ, a ŋaa wɩaa sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ laal-bal kʋbala lɛ. Ba dagɛ wɩalɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ pʋ a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: For three weeks I was in sorrow.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, mɩ-na Danɩɛl yele yɔɔsʋŋ batori nɛ.

english_verse: I ate no fancy food or meat, I drank no wine, and I put no olive oil on my face or hair.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ kʋdii-fɩaŋ kala die a bɩ nammɩa ma chaŋa koo a kɛŋ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ jɩl mɩ niiŋ. Yɔɔsʋ-la batori kala lɛ, mɩ bɩ nʋʋŋ ma tɩsa.

english_verse: Then, on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was standing on the banks of the great Tigris River,
translation_verse: Jɩna tʋɔŋ chɛŋ bumbuŋ tapʋlaa mara arɩ banɛsɛ chɛɛŋ mɩ chɩŋ fuo-bal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɩgɩrɩs niiŋ,

english_verse: when I looked up and saw someone dressed in linen and wearing a solid gold belt.
translation_verse: aŋ beŋ a na nʋʋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ dɩ ʋ laalɛ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ gɛrɩŋ a vɔɔ sɛlɩmɛ tembiiŋ ʋ tɩŋa lɛ.

english_verse: His body was like a precious stone, his face like lightning, his eyes like flaming fires, his arms and legs like polished bronze, and his voice like the roar of a crowd.
translation_verse: Ka ʋ yaraa tʋtʋl a nagɛ tabɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ kirisola, ʋ sɩaa nagɛ taŋ sɩɩ lɩgɩsʋ, sɩɩ-biee ma nagɛ kapɩlɩŋ nyiniŋ, ʋ nɩsaa arɩ ʋ naasɩŋ tʋtʋl a nagɛ kɔlɩɩŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ nʋʋŋ laarɛ, ka ʋ yikoro ma nagɛ nɩ-daŋ sɩɩ ŋaa goŋ.

english_verse: Although the people who were with me did not see the vision, they became so frightened that they scattered and hid.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Danɩɛl dʋndʋŋa nɛ fa na wɩɩŋ deeŋ, mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ lee-la bɩ wɩɩkala na, ama fawʋllʋŋ fa faasa kɛmba nɛ, ba fá mʋ faa.

english_verse: and at the sound of his voice, I fell facedown in a deep sleep.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩaa. Mɩ sɩ nɩɩ ʋ yikoro ŋɩɩ, mɩ tele chu tinteeŋ a kpaŋa pɩŋ.

english_verse: He raised me to my hands and knees
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛmmɛ chʋʋla kɩɩ, mɩ kpirimi mɩ nɩsaa arɩ mɩ naadʋsʋŋ nyuŋ a chichel.

english_verse: and then said, “Daniel, your God thinks highly of you, and he has sent me. So stand up and pay close attention.” I stood trembling, while the angel said:
translation_verse: Ʋ yɩrɛmɛ, “Danɩɛl, Wɩa choŋ nɛ woruŋ a tɩmmɛ ŋ teeŋ. Sii chɩŋ a fɩɛlɛ ŋ sɩaa a jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩŋ.” Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pɩmɛ, mɩ sii chɩŋ a chichel.

english_verse: Daniel, don't be afraid! God has listened to your prayers since the first day you humbly asked for understanding, and he has sent me here.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Danɩɛl, sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá. Tapʋl-bumbuŋ-la ŋ sɩ joŋ ŋ nyuŋ hɛ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩaa a kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa muuri Wɩa sɩpaaŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ laa ŋ sʋla nɛ a tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ chɛ a pɩŋ.

english_verse: I will tell you what is written in The Book of Truth. But first, you must realize that no one except Michael, the guardian angel of Israel, is on my side.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wɩɩ-la ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wʋtɩtɩɩ Teŋ-la lɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ mɩ lɛ pɛ yuoba, see Wɩa tɩndaara Maakɩl. Ʋ nɩɩ pɔ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Now I have come here to give you another vision about what will happen to your people in the future.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la maachie sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ nɩaa lɛ nɛ a pɩŋ. Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ tɩgɛ maachie wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: While this angel was speaking to me, I stared at the ground, speechless.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa ha sɩɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ mɩ teeŋ ŋɩɩ, mɩ kɛŋ mɩ sɩaa chu tinteeŋ a bɩ wɩaa wuo bʋl.

english_verse: Then he appeared in human form and touched my lips. I said, “Sir, this vision has brought me great pain and has drained my strength.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kʋ-la sɩ nagɛ nuhuobiine bɩra digi mɩ niipinee lɛ, mɩ bɩra wuo bʋl wɩaa. Mɩ bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ leŋe mɩ na hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ a bɩ mɩ nandaa kala wuo.

english_verse: I am merely your servant. How can I possibly speak with someone so powerful, when I am almost too weak to get my breath?”
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, ɛɛ nɛ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna jaŋ ŋaa a wuo bʋl wɩaa ŋ teeŋ? Mɩ doluŋ dɛrɛ nɛ, mɩ bɩra bɩ wuo wiesi.”

english_verse: The angel touched me a second time and said, “Don't be frightened! God thinks highly of you, and he intends this for your good, so be brave and strong.” At this, I regained my strength and replied, “Please speak! You have already made me feel much better.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Wɩa choŋ nɛ woruŋ, sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa a faasa dol.” Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, mɩ bɩra kɛŋ doluŋ a bʋl, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ, ŋ sɩ folo pɩmɛ doluŋ.”

english_verse: Then the angel said: Now do you understand why I have come? Soon I must leave to fight against the guardian angel of Persia. Then after I have defeated him, the guardian angel of Greece will attack me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Ŋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ mɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ nɛɛ? Ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni ka dɩ mɩ mɩɩra mʋ yuo Sɩtaanɩ tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ beŋ Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ mʋa, Sɩtaanɩ tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ beŋ Giriisi tinteeŋ ma jaŋ kʋ pɛ dɩ ba yuomi.

english_verse: You also need to know that I protected and helped Darius the Mede in his first year as king. The Angel's Message to Daniel Part One: The Four Kings and Their Successors
translation_verse: Medi tɩŋŋaa Daarus sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-bumbuŋ lɛ, mɩ nɛ chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ a pɔʋ.” Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ Siiria kuoro

english_verse: What I am going to tell you is certain to happen. Four kings will rule Persia, one after the other, but the fourth one will become much richer than the others. In fact, his wealth will make him so powerful that he will turn everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
translation_verse: “Lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa pɩŋ. Kuoroo batori jaŋ dii kuoruŋ Pɛɛsɩa tinteeŋ lɛ aŋ ka pɩ dɔŋɔ. Ka dɩ kuoru-nɛsɛ kʋ dii a kɛŋ kɩaa kɩɩ ba kala. Ʋ dʋa-la nɛ ʋ jaŋ kaa laa doluŋ. Ʋ jaŋ yigi nʋʋkala hɛ dɩ ba sii chɩŋ Giriisi tinteeŋ nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: Then a mighty king will come to power and will be able to do whatever he pleases.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ kuoru-duo kʋbala jaŋ dii kuoruŋ nɩmɛ a kɛŋ ʋ doluŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ cho.

english_verse: But suddenly his kingdom will be crushed and scattered to the four corners of the earth, where four more kingdoms will rise. But these won't be ruled by his descendants or be as powerful as his kingdom.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ʋ kuoruŋ jaŋ tel dɩ ba kaa kpaa dʋnɩa sɛsɩŋ banɛsɛ-la. Ʋ doho nʋʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ koo a kɛŋ ʋ dol-la ŋaa wɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jaŋ laa ʋ kuoruŋ a pɩ nɩwogusuŋ.

english_verse: The king of the south will grow powerful. Then one of his generals will rebel and will rule an even larger kingdom.
translation_verse: Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ, ama ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ dɔŋɔ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ kuoruŋ laa, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ yʋgɛ woruŋ a beŋ ʋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Years later the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom will make a treaty, and the daughter of the king of the south will marry the king of the north. But she will lose her power. Then she, her husband, their child, and the servants who came with her will all be killed. After this,
translation_verse: Jɩsɩŋ baŋmɛnɛ harɩŋ, Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ Siiria kuoro jaŋ pɛ niiŋ, dɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro joŋ ʋ tolo pɩ Siiria kuoro dɩ ʋ jaa, a chɩchɛ dɩ ba nii-la chɩŋ woruŋ, ama ba nii-la bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ. Ba jaŋ joŋ haal-la arɩ ʋ bala, ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna-la sɩ to ʋ harɩŋ mʋ pa dɩ ba kpʋ.

english_verse: one of her relatives will become the ruler of the southern kingdom. He will attack the army of the northern kingdom and capture its fortresses.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ tolo-la nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa dɔŋɔ jaŋ sii laa ʋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ. Ʋ jaŋ yuo Siiria kuoru-la laalɩyuoroo aŋ jʋʋ ba dɩɩ-duoruŋ, a yuo diiba.

english_verse: Then he will carry their idols to Egypt, together with their precious treasures of silver and gold, but it will be a long time before he attacks the northern kingdom again. Some years later
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ paa ba vesiŋ arɩ ba tɔmɔ-la ba sɩ kɛŋ hɔɔŋ libi, arɩ ba kʋ-yuŋŋie-la kala ba sɩ kɛŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa a kaa mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ Siiria kuoru-la yuonuŋ jɩsɩŋ baŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom, but he will be forced back to his own country.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ Siiria kuoru-la ma jaŋ sii mʋ dɩ ʋ yuo Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro, ama ba jaŋ kiru dɩ ʋ mɩɩra mʋ ʋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: The sons of the king of the north will gather a huge army that will sweep down like a roaring flood, reaching all the way to the fortress of the southern kingdom.
translation_verse: Siiria kuoro biiriŋ ma jaŋ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ a kɛŋ laalɩyuori-daŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ. Ba jaŋ tii paa leriŋ, a nagɛ lɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩɩ pɛllʋ, dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ ŋɩɩ halɩɩ, a mʋ jʋʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro dɩɩ-duoruŋ.

english_verse: But this will make the king of the south angry, and he will defeat this large army from the north.
translation_verse: Ijipiti kuoro jaŋ na baanɩŋ a kɛŋ laalɩyuoroo mʋ yuo Siiria tinteeŋ kuoru-la sɩ kɛŋ laalɩyuori-daŋ, a yuo diiu.

english_verse: The king of the south will feel proud because of the many thousands he has killed. But his victories won't last long,
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ yuo dii laalɩyuoru-daŋ-la, Ijipiti kuoru-la nyuŋ jaŋ nyaasɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ-bʋɩba, ama ʋ ha bɩ jaŋ yuo didii deeŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: because the king of the north will gather a larger and more powerful army than ever before. Then in a few years, he will start invading other countries.
translation_verse: Siiria kuoru-la ha jaŋ bɩra chɛ laalɩyuoru-daŋ sɩ nyɩgɩla woruŋ aŋ yʋga kɩɩ bumbuŋ nɩalɩŋ. Dɩ jɩsɩŋ baŋmɛnɛ nɛ bala, dɩ ʋ bɩra mʋ yuo Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro.

english_verse: At this time many of your own people will try to make this vision come true by rebelling against the king of the south, but their rebellion will fail.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɩ-daŋ jaŋ sii chɩŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoru-la lɛ. Yuo-hɛɛrɛ-la sɩ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ jaŋ lɩɩ ŋ harɩŋ dɩ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ na a nagɛ duoso tʋɔŋ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ama ba jaŋ walɩma ka.

english_verse: Then the army from the north will surround and capture a fortress in the south, and not even the most experienced troops of the southern kingdom will be able to make them retreat.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Siiria kuoro jaŋ kɔ a saa vaŋkumba dɩ ba to ba lɛ a jʋʋ yuo dii tabal-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli. Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro laalɩyuoroo bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a wuo chemba. Ba nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ paala jɩŋ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ woruŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo yuoba.

english_verse: The king who invaded from the north will do as he pleases, and he will even capture and destroy the holy land.
translation_verse: Siiria kuoru-la sɩ kɔ dɩ ʋ yuoba jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ cho. Nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ sɩpaaŋ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ. Ʋ dɩ laalɩyuoroo jaŋ chɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tintee-zɔŋ-la lɛ a yuo laa ʋ kala a cheyu.

english_verse: In fact, he will decide to invade the south with his entire army. Then he will attempt to make peace by giving the king of the south a bride from the northern kingdom, but this won't be successful.
translation_verse: Siiria kuoru-la jaŋ chɩchɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro leriŋ dɩ ba pɛ niiŋ. Ʋ jaŋ joŋ ʋ tolo pʋ dɩ ʋ jaa, dɩ ʋ wuo to ŋɩɩ lɛ a yuo dii ʋ tinteeŋ kala, ama ʋ tʋɔbɩɩna-la bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: Afterwards, this proud king of the north will invade and conquer many of the nations along the coast, but a military leader will defeat him and make him lose his pride.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jaŋ mʋ yuo dii tinteyee yʋgɛ sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ, ama laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ kʋbala jaŋ kʋ yuo dii Siiria kuoru-la, dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛnʋ dɩ ʋ babii-ballɩŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: He will retreat to his fortresses in his own country, but on the way he will be defeated and never again be seen.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ harɩŋ lɛ ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra joŋ ʋ sɩaa chaasɛ ʋ tinteeŋ dɩɩ-duoruŋ dɩ ʋ yuo paa kɩaa, ama ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ba jaŋ kpʋʋ, dɩ ʋ wɩaa dɛrɛ.

english_verse: The next king of the north will try to collect taxes for the glory of his kingdom. However, he will come to a sudden end in some mysterious way, instead of in battle or because of someone's anger. Part Two: The Evil King from the North
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ jaŋ hɛ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ gɔllɔ laa lampoo ʋ tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ tinteeŋ kuoruŋ ha kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ. Jɩsɩŋ baŋmɛnɛ lɛ ba jaŋ kpʋ kuoru-la, ama nɩaa tʋɔŋ koo laalɩŋ lɛ dee.

english_verse: The successor of this king of the north will be a worthless nobody, who doesn't even come from a royal family. He will suddenly appear and gain control of the kingdom by treachery.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ laa Siiria kuoro deeŋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ, jaŋ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ dii kuorii-la. Ba bɩ jaŋ zil ʋ kuoruŋ. Ʋ jaŋ yuo tintee-la nɩaa bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ hɔnɔ ta jɩa a bɩɩnɛ wɩɩ bɩbaa jʋʋ. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ badɛ wɩaa laaʋ.

english_verse: Then he will destroy armies and remove God's chosen high priest.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ yuo dii laalɩyuori-daŋ, a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ lɛ a cheiba.

english_verse: He will make a treaty, but he will be deceitful and break it, even though he has only a few followers.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩ nɩaa niiŋ nɛ kʋ ŋaa kʋbala, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a nyɩsɛba aŋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ dɩ ba laa doluŋ.

english_verse: Without warning, he will successfully invade a wealthy province, which is something his ancestors never did. Then he will divide among his followers all of its treasures and property. But none of this will last very long.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ yuo tintee-la sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ nɩaa sɩ hɔnɔ ta jɩa a bɩɩnɛ wɩɩ bɩbaa jʋʋ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ nyɩmmaba arɩ ʋ naabalɩmaba ha sɩ bɩ ŋaa aŋ ka. Ʋ jaŋ joŋ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yuo paa arɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yuo laa arɩ ba dʋa kala a kpaa ʋ harɩ-tooroo. Ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa jaŋ vʋʋrɛ dɩ ba mʋ yuo dii dɩɩ-duoruŋ, ama wɩaa deemba bɩ jaŋ dieni.

english_verse: He will gather a large and powerful army, and with great courage he will attack the king of the south. The king of the south will meet him with a much stronger army, but he will lose the battle, because he will be betrayed
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ aŋ nyɩrɛ ʋ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ laalɩyuori-daŋ mʋ yuo Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro. Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoru-la ma jaŋ kɛŋ laalɩyuori-daŋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a lɩɩ chemu dɩ ba yuo dɔŋɔ. Ama ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo yuo diiu, bɛɛ wɩaa ba vʋʋra nɛ a chɩŋ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: by members of the royal court. He will be ruined, and most of his army will be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Kuoro sɩŋŋaa tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ naaŋ je. Ba jaŋ yuo dii ʋ laalɩyuoroo dɩ ba nɩ-daŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The two kings will meet around a table and tell evil lies to each other. But their plans will fail, because God has already decided what will happen.
translation_verse: Kuoro-la balɩa sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ hɔŋ dɩ-bala dɩ ba dii kɩaa a nyɩɛ wɩaa pɩ dɔŋɔ, ama ba bɩ jaŋ na wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ chɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa laa sɩpaaŋ dagɛ bʋa-la lɛ ba wɩaa sɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Then the king of the north will return to his country with great treasures. But on the way, he will attack the religion of God's people and do whatever else he pleases.
translation_verse: Siiria kuoru-la jaŋ mɩɩra kɛŋ dʋa yʋgɛ a mʋ ʋ tinteeŋ, ama ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔ-lɔrʋŋ Wɩa nɩaa wombiee lɛ a ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ba lɛ, aŋ-na mɩɩra mʋ ʋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: At the time God has decided, the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom again, but this time, things will be different.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ dagɛ bʋa-la nɛ yie, Siiria kuoro jaŋ bɩra mʋ yuo Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro, ama bʋa deeŋ lɛ ʋ bɩ jaŋ yuo diiu a nagɛ bumbuŋ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Ships from the west will come to attack him, and he will be discouraged. Then he will start back to his own country and take out his anger on the religion of God's faithful people, while showing kindness to those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ vɩvɛŋ a hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ jaŋ kʋ yuou dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ Wɩa nɩaa tinteeŋ a joŋ ʋ baanɩŋ sɩ faasa sii ŋɩɩ a fɩɩsɛ ba lɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa mʋ mɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa dɩ ba to Wɩa lɛ.

english_verse: He will send troops to pollute the temple and the fortress, and he will stop the daily sacrifices. Then he will set up that “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction.
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɩyuoroo jaŋ sii chei Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la dɩ-duoŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ a pɔ dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ tapʋlɩɩ kala pʋsʋŋ kpʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ba jaŋ joŋ disiŋ kʋŋ sɩɩ chei leriŋ a bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la dɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: The king will use deceit to win followers from those who are unfaithful to God, but those who remain faithful will do everything possible to oppose him.
translation_verse: Kuoru-la jaŋ kɛŋ nii-sɩma a nyɩsa chei nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa dɩ ba to Wɩa. Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Wɩa jaŋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ a yuou.

english_verse: Wise leaders will instruct many of the people. But for a while, some of these leaders will either be killed with swords or burned alive, or else robbed of their possessions and thrown into prison.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ dagɛ nɩ-daŋ. Ama bʋa dɔŋ jaŋ yi dɩ ba kpʋba laalɩŋ lɛ koo a nyɩgɛba koo a yuo kɛsɛba koo a paa ba kɩaa.

english_verse: They will receive only a little help in their time of trouble, and many of their followers will be treacherous.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɩɩ kpʋ Wɩa nɩaa, nɩaa mʋa nɛ jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ a laaba ta. Nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a dɩdɛ sɩaa arɩ ba ma pɛ ba lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Some of those who are wise will suffer, so that God will make them pure and acceptable until the end, which will still come at the time he has decided.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa wɩɩ sɩ jaŋ chɛsɛba a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta ka dɩ ba zɔŋ a kaa mʋ yi dɩdɛrɩ-la Wɩa sɩ daga.

english_verse: This king will do as he pleases. He will proudly claim to be greater than any god and will insult the only true God. Indeed, he will be successful until God is no longer angry with his people.
translation_verse: Siiria kuoru-la jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ cho, a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa yʋga kɩɩ vene kala a bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ maga a tʋʋsɛ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala joŋŋoo. Wɩaa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ pʋ a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ dɔgʋsʋ arɩ baanɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ ŋaa.

english_verse: This king will reject the gods his ancestors worshiped and the god preferred by women. In fact, he will put himself above all gods
translation_verse: Kuoru-la sɩpaa jaŋ tuo ʋ naabalɩmaba vesiŋ lɛ koo vene-la haalaa sɩ cho koo vene dɔŋ kala lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ bee gʋʋnɛ ba kala aŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa yʋga kɩɩ ba kala.

english_verse: and worship only the so-called god of fortresses, who was unknown to his ancestors. And he will honor it with gold, silver, precious stones, and other costly gifts.
