translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ vɩaba aŋ mɩɩra to vene-la sɩɩ pɔ dɩ-duoruŋ, kʋ-la ʋ naabalɩmaba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ aŋ ka, a joŋ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla arɩ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa arɩ kɩaa yallɩŋ sɩ hɛyɛ a pʋpʋ.

english_verse: With the help of this foreign god, he will capture the strongest fortresses. Everyone who worships this god will be put in a position of power and rewarded with wealth and land. Part Three: The Time of the End
translation_verse: Veŋ wogo-la jaŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ yuo dii dɩɩ-duoruŋ. Ʋ jaŋ faasa zil nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tou. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba bibeŋ nɩ-dandaŋ ka dɩ ʋ kɛŋ tinteeŋ kpaa a siiliba.

english_verse: At the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the kingdom of the north. But its king will rush out like a storm with war chariots, cavalry, and many ships. Indeed, his forces will flood one country after another,
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩ-la Wɩa sɩ daga nɛ yie, Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro jaŋ sii mʋ dɩ ʋ yuo Siiria kuoro. Siiria kuoru-la jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba arɩ ja-jɩllaa a pɛ lɩɩŋ daboru-dandaŋ lɛ a lɩɩ chemu. Ʋ jaŋ mʋ tɔ tinteyee yʋgɛ hɛ a yuoba a nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ tɔ leriŋ.

english_verse: and when they reach the holy land, tens of thousands will be killed. But the countries of Edom and Moab and the ruler of Ammon will escape.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ yuo tintee-zɔŋ-la ma nɩaa. Ʋ jaŋ kpʋ nɩ-daŋ, ama ba jaŋ laa Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ nɩaa arɩ Mʋab tinteeŋ nɩaa a pɛ Amɔŋ tinteeŋ sɩpaalaaraa lɛ a ta ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The king of the north will invade many countries, including Egypt,
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ dii doluŋ tinteyee lɛ woruŋ, Ijipiti tinteeŋ nɩaa ma bɩ jaŋ fori.

english_verse: and he will take its rich treasures of gold and silver. He will also conquer Libya and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ laa Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ yuŋuŋ. Libiya tɩŋŋaa arɩ Nubia tɩŋŋaa ma jaŋ sɛɩ a tɩma pʋ.

english_verse: But he will be alarmed by news from the east and the north, and he will become furious and cause great destruction.
translation_verse: Duoso jaŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a kʋ leŋ dɩ ʋ yaraa hosi, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ baanɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a lɩɩ yuo laalɩŋ a kpʋ nɩ-daŋ.

english_verse: After this, he will set up camp between the Mediterranean Sea and Mount Zion. Then he will be destroyed, and no one will be able to save him.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ hɛ ʋ kuoru-lɛŋŋɛɛ Mediterenia mʋgʋ-balɩŋ arɩ peel-la nyuŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ chɩna pɛgɛ. Ŋɩɩ bʋa lɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ, nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Many of those who lie dead in the ground will rise from death. Some of them will be given eternal life, and others will receive nothing but eternal shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Nɩ-dandaŋ-la sɩ sʋba jaŋ sii, dɩ dɔnsʋŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, ka dɩ dɔnsʋŋ ma dii hɩɩsɩŋ a na hɛɛ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who has been wise will shine as bright as the sky above, and everyone who has led others to please God will shine forever like the stars.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ tʋtʋl a nagɛ wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ dagɛ nɩaa ba joŋ tʋɔpʋla wombiiŋ jaŋ nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Daniel, I now command you to keep the message of this book secret until the end of time, even though many people will go everywhere, searching for the knowledge to be found in it. The End of Time
translation_verse: Ŋ-na Danɩɛl, sɩ́ wɩaa deemba bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala. Kɛŋ teŋ-la tɔ a joŋ kʋa magɩlɛ a kaa mʋ yi dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ. Nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a lɩɩ daha a mʋ daha a chɩchɛ dɩ ba wʋjɩmɩŋ pʋŋa pɛ.”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I looked around and saw two other people—one on this side of the river and one on the other side.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ-na Danɩɛl beŋ a na nɩaa balɩa ma dɩ ba chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ, dɔŋɔ chɩŋ fuo-la niiŋ cholo sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, dɔŋɔ ma chɩŋ niiŋ cholo sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me was dressed in linen and was standing upstream from them. So one of the two beside the river asked him, “How long before these amazing things happen?”
translation_verse: Ba dɔŋɔ pɩɛsɛ baal-la fa sɩ laalɛ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ gɛrɩŋ a chugili fuo-la nyuŋ, “Ɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ diene magɛ ka dɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ deemba na ŋaa?”

english_verse: The angel then raised both hands toward heaven and said, “In the name of the God who lives forever, I solemnly promise that it will be a time, two times, and half a time. Everything will be over, when the suffering of God's holy people comes to an end.”
translation_verse: Baal-la sɩ laalɛ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ gɛrɩŋ a chugili fuo-la nyuŋ, kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa balɩa kala je wɩa-nyuŋ, ka mɩ nɩɩ dɩ ʋ ŋmɩɛsɛ Wɩa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ a bʋl, “Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa jɩsɩŋ batori arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ. Dɩ ba nɛ to naasɩŋ a dɔgɩsɛ Wɩa nɩaa dɛrɛ, wɩaa deemba ma kala jaŋ ŋaa dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: I heard what the angel said, but I didn't understand. So I asked, “Sir, how will it all end?” The angel in my vision then replied:
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla, aŋ bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ wuo jɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩɛsɛ, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, ɛɛ nɛ wɩalɩŋ kala dɩdɛrɩŋ jaŋ nagɛ?”

english_verse: Daniel, go about your business, because the meaning of this message will remain secret until the end of time.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Danɩɛl, ŋ-na mʋ ŋ dɩ-mʋʋlʋŋ, wɩalɩŋ faa nɛ ba tɔ bil see dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ yie.

english_verse: Many people will have their hearts and lives made pure and clean, but those who are evil will keep on being evil and never understand. Only the wise will understand.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ chɛsɛ nɩ-daŋ a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta, dɩ ba zɔŋ. Ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ ha jaŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Nɩbɔmɔ-la kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa, ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ jɩŋ ba sɩaa.

english_verse: So, Daniel, be faithful until the end! You will rest, and at the end of time, you will rise from death to receive your reward.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na Danɩɛl, mʋ ŋ dɩ-mʋʋlʋŋ ka dɩ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ yi. Dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩ-la nɛ yie, ŋ jaŋ na wiese, aŋ sii laa ŋ time.”

english_verse: I am Hosea son of Beeri. When Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah, and when Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel, the Lord spoke this message to me. Hosea's Family
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa bʋl wɩaa pɩ Beri nanʋala Hosia nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Uzia, Jotam, Ahas arɩ Hezikaaya nɛ fa ŋaa Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo, ka Jehuas nanʋala Jerobuam ma ŋaa Iziral kuoro. Hosia haala arɩ ʋ biiriŋ

english_verse: The Lord said, “Hosea, Israel has betrayed me like an unfaithful wife. Marry such a woman and have children by her.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ suomo dɩ ʋ to Hosia lɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Mʋ jaa hachɔrʋmʋŋ dɩ ʋ lʋl mɛŋgaa-biiriŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ nɩaa vɩa mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA aŋ kpʋkpaarɛ vʋɩyaa.”

english_verse: So I married Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and we had a son.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hosia mʋ jaa Dibilem tolo Goma, ʋ kɛŋ luoruŋ a lʋl hambolibie pʋ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Hosea, name your son Jezreel, because I will soon punish the descendants of King Jehu of Israel for the murders he committed in Jezreel Valley. I will destroy his kingdom,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pʋ, “Hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Jɛzɩrɛl, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ jaŋ dieni aŋ dɔgɩsɛ kuoro Jehu doho nɩaa a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ kpʋa Jɛzɩrɛl lɛ wɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral kuoruŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: and in Jezreel Valley I will break the power of Israel.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ jaŋ bori Iziral tɩŋŋaa toŋ Jɛzɩrɛl fuonaaŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Later, Gomer had a daughter, and the Lord said, “Name her Lo-Ruhamah, because I will no longer have mercy and forgive Israel.
translation_verse: Goma bɩra kɛŋ luoruŋ a lʋl hantolibie. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Hosia, “Hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Lo-Ruhama. Ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ ‘chonuŋ tuo’, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ dagɛ mɩ chonuŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ, a joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba.

english_verse: But I am the Lord God of Judah, and I will have mercy and save Judah by my own power—not by wars and arrows or swords and cavalry.”
translation_verse: Ama mɩ jaŋ dagɛ mɩ chonuŋ Juda doho nɩaa lɛ, a laaba ta. Ama laalɩyuori kɩaa deemba dee mɩ jaŋ kaa laaba ta: Toŋ koo tokobiiŋ koo laalɩŋ janɩŋ koo laalɩŋ ja-jɩllaa. Mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ jaŋ laaba ta.”

english_verse: After Gomer had stopped nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she had another son.
translation_verse: Goma sɩ kɛrɛ Lo-Ruhama yɩlɩŋ lɛ, ʋ bɩra lʋl hambolibie.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Name him Lo-Ammi, because these people are not mine, and I am not their God.” Hope for Israel
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Lo-Ammi. Ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ ‘mɩ nɩaa dee’, bɛɛ wɩaa ma bɩ mɩ nɩaa ŋaa, mɩ ma bɩ ma Wɩa ŋaa.

english_verse: Someday it will be impossible to count the people of Israel, because there will be as many of them as there are grains of sand along the seashore. They are now called “Not My People,” but in the future they will be called “Children of the Living God.”
translation_verse: Ama bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pʋŋ a nagɛ hagɩla sɩ pɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo magɩsɛ koo a dɩɩsɛ. Lee-la ba sɩ bʋla pɩba arɩ ba bɩ mɩ nɩaa ŋaa, ba jaŋ bɩra kɛmba yɩrɛ ‘Wɩa sɩ weye biiriŋ’.

english_verse: Israel and Judah will unite and choose one leader. Then they will take back their land, and this will be a great day for Jezreel.
translation_verse: Juda nɩaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa jaŋ bɩra kɛŋ nii-bala. Ba jaŋ lɩɩsɛ sɩpaa-laarɩ bala, ba jaŋ pʋŋa pɛ a dʋa ba tinteeŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa tapʋl-bal a pɩ Jɛzɩrɛl.”

english_verse: So let your brothers be called “My People” and your sisters be called “Shown Mercy.” The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Má yɩyɩrɛ ma naambiiriŋ ‘Mɩ Nɩaa’, a yɩyɩrɛ ma dɩhaalaa ‘Mɩ Nɩchooloo’. Wɩa dɔgɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa aŋ bɩra laaba

english_verse: Accuse! Accuse your mother! She is no longer my wife, and now I, the Lord, am not her husband. Beg her to give up prostitution and stop being unfaithful,
translation_verse: Má kpɩa ma naaŋ lɛ, má kpɩa ʋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ tuo mɩ haal, mɩ ma tuo ʋ bala. Má leŋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ sɩaa hachɔrʋŋ wʋŋaalaa lɛ a leŋ dɩ hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa dɛrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: or I will strip her naked like the day she was born. I will make her barren like a desert, and she will die of thirst.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ dee, mɩ jaŋ wuri ʋ kɩaa ka dɩ ʋ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree a nagɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ lʋlʋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ nagɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ a nagɛ tinteeŋ sɩ hɩla kori-kori dɩ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ kpʋʋ dɩ ʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: You children are the result of her unfaithfulness, and I'll show you no pity.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ dagɛ mɩ chonuŋ ʋ biiriŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa mɛŋgaa biiriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Your mother was unfaithful. She was disgraceful and said, “I'll run after my lovers. Everything comes from them— my food and drink, my linen and wool, my olive oil and wine.”
translation_verse: Ba naaŋ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ nɛ a ŋaa hɩɩsɛ wɩaa a kɛŋ ba luoruŋ. Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ kire to mɩ hɩɩlaba harɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɩmɛ mɩ kʋdiilee arɩ lɩɩŋ, pie-pʋnaa gɛnnɩŋ arɩ gɛrɩ-fʋfʋlʋŋ, nʋʋŋ arɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will build a fence of thorns to block her path.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ ta sɔsʋŋ a tɔ ʋ wombiiŋ, mɩ jaŋ saa jeeŋ a kɛrʋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ wuo na wombiiŋ a lɩɩ.

english_verse: She will run after her lovers, but not catch them; she will search, but not find them. Then she will say, “I'll return to my first husband. Life was better then.”
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kire to ʋ hɩɩlaba harɩŋ, ama ʋ bɩ jaŋ puuba. Ʋ jaŋ bee chɛba, ama ʋ bɩ jaŋ naba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jaŋ bʋl, ‘Mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ mɩ bala teeŋ, mɩ faafaa-la nɛ kpɩa mɩ lɛɛlɛ.’

english_verse: She didn't know that her grain, wine, and olive oil were gifts from me, as were the gold and silver she used in worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ sɛyɛ arɩ mɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ pʋ mɩaa, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ, a pʋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ, kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal.

english_verse: So I'll hold back the harvest of grain and grapes. I'll take back my wool and my linen that cover her body.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ laa mɩ mɩaa dɩ ba nɛ bɩa, a laa mɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ dɩ ba nɛ ŋaaʋ dɛrɛ. Mɩ jaŋ laa mɩ pie-pʋnaa gɛrɩ-la arɩ mɩ gɛrɩ-fʋfʋlɩɩ-la mɩ fa sɩ joŋo tɔ ʋ yarɩ-biree.

english_verse: Then I'll strip her naked in the sight of her lovers. No one can rescue her.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ wuri ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kala ʋ hɩɩlaba-la kala sɩpaaŋ, ka nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ laaʋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I'll stop Israel's celebrations— no more New Moon Festivals, Sabbaths, or other feasts.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ giri gbieli dosunu-la kala ʋ sɩɩ gbielu ta: jɩna jɩna gbiele, chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele, chɛ-wiesii-la arɩ gbiele-la dɔnsʋŋ kala.

english_verse: She said, “My lovers gave me vineyards and fig trees as payment for sex.” Now I, the Lord, will ruin her vineyards and fig trees; they will become clumps of weeds eaten by wild animals.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chei ʋ girep nɛnɛɛ bagɩsɩŋ arɩ ʋ tutogusuŋ, kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ hɩɩlaba joŋo timu. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba lugo kɛŋ dɔŋɔ woruŋ a nagɛ tiiŋ, dɩ baga kɩaa joŋo dii.

english_verse: I'll punish her for the days she worshiped Baal and burned incense to him. I'll punish her for the times she forgot about me and wore jewelry and rings to attract her lovers. I, the Lord, have spoken! The Lord Will Help Israel
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgʋsʋ a tɩŋ tapʋlɩa-la ʋ sɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a pɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal. Ʋ fa kpɩɛrɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ a joŋ nenii-pɩraa arɩ banzɔlɔba hɛ a kire to ʋ hɩɩlaba harɩŋ aŋ yʋ mɩ wɩaa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, will lure you into the desert and speak gently to you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ bʋl nii-sɩŋ wɩaa kɛnʋ, mɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ kaa jʋʋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ a fɩɛla bʋl wɩaa pʋ.

english_verse: I will return your vineyards, and then Trouble Valley will become Hopeful Valley. You will say “Yes” to me as you did in your youth, when leaving Egypt.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ bɩra joŋ ʋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ bagɩsɩŋ pʋ, a leŋ dɩ Akɔ fuonaa-la fa sɩ ŋaa wʋjʋʋlaa lee, dɩ ʋ mɩɩra ŋaa lee sɩ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa. Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a nagɛ ʋ hambiiriŋ bʋa lɛ, a nagɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla, tapʋlɩɩ-la ŋ jaŋ kɛmmɛ yɩrɛ ŋ bala, ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ yɩrɛmɛ, ŋ kʋhɩaŋ.

english_verse: I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called “Master.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ sɩ́ Baal yɩrɩŋ yɩrʋ, a bɩra sɩ́ ŋ yɩrɩŋ kaa ŋmɩɛsɛ.

english_verse: And I will agree to let you live in peace—you will no longer be attacked by wild animals and birds or by weapons of war.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, mɩ jaŋ hɛ niiŋ mɩ dɩ baga kɩaa arɩ diibiisiŋ sɩɩ zaarɛ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tuuri tinteeŋ pɛgɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ ba walɩmʋ. Mɩ jaŋ giri laalɩŋ ta tintee-la lɛ dɩ bayuori kɩaa lɛl, tosuŋ arɩ tokobiee, ka dɩ mɩ nɩaa wuo hɔŋ sɔm.

english_verse: I will accept you as my wife forever, and instead of a bride price I will give you justice, fairness, love, kindness,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa mɩ haala a kaa mʋ wuu, mɩ jaŋ dagɩŋ mɩ tʋɔpʋla arɩ mɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a kɛŋ chono-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ arɩŋ, a fɩfá ŋ nisusuŋ.

english_verse: and faithfulness. Then you will truly know who I am.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ jaaŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ sɛɩ arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋ TƖƖNA.

english_verse: I will command the sky to send rain on the earth,
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla, tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ jaŋ nɩɩ mɩ nɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ba sɩ sʋlaa chɛ duonuŋ, a leŋ dɩ ʋ nɩɩ,

english_verse: and it will produce grain, grapes, and olives in Jezreel Valley.
translation_verse: dɩ mɩaa, girep tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ olif tɩɩsɩŋ wasɛ Jɛzɩrɛl tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I will scatter the seeds and show mercy to Lo-Ruhamah. I will say to Lo-Ammi, “You are my people,” and they will answer, “You are our God.”
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ holluŋ tintee-la lɛ, mɩ jaŋ dagɛ mɩ chonuŋ Lo-Ruhama lɛ, nɩɩ-la mɩ fa sɩ sɩ mɩ bɩ ʋ cho. Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩ Lo-Ammi, nɩalɩŋ ma mɩ fa sɩ sɩ ma bɩ mɩ nɩaa ŋaa: Ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa nɛ lɛɛlɛ. Ba ma jaŋ bʋl, ‘Ŋ nɛ La Wɩa.’ ”

english_verse: Once again the Lord spoke to me. And this time he said, “Hosea, fall in love with an unfaithful woman who has a lover. Do this to show that I love the people of Israel, even though they worship idols and enjoy the offering cakes made with fruit.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Bɩra mʋ dagɛ ŋ chonuŋ ŋ haal-la lɛ, arɩ ʋ sɩ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ ma nʋʋ dɔŋ hɩɩlʋ. Ŋ-na ha chou a nagɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ cho Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋɩɩ, arɩ ba sɩɩ to vesiŋ a joŋ tɩɩ-nɛŋ hɩlaa pɩpɩba ma.”

english_verse: Then I said, “Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ maga dɩ ŋ gbɛrɛmɛ nɛ tapʋl-daŋ ka dɩ la-na pɛ bɔsɔ. Bʋa deeŋ kala lɛ ŋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩɩ koo a joŋ ŋ tɩtɩa pɩ baal dɔŋ. Mɩ ma jaŋ gbɛrɩŋ.”

english_verse: It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ tapʋl-daŋ a bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ kuoro koo sɩpaa-laarʋ, a bɩ pʋsʋŋ ma jaŋ kpʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koo a kpaarɛ tabɩa-la sɩ ŋaa vesiŋ, a bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ gɛrɩ-laala-daŋɩɩ-la ba sɩ kaa chɛ na wɩaa koo tɔŋ.

english_verse: But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa jaŋ mɩɩra chɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa arɩ ba kuoro Devit leriŋ. Ba jaŋ fɩfá La TƖƖNA a kɔ ʋ teeŋ tapʋlaa dɩdɛrɩŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ dɩ ba na wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: And so your land is a desert. Every living creature is dying— people and wild animals, birds and fish. The Lord Warns the Priests
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ tintee-la nɩaa yel, a kala jɩjagɛ. Baga kɩaa arɩ diibiisiŋ sɩɩ zaarɛ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ chenfille-la kala sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ ma sʋsʋʋ.

english_verse: Don't accuse just anyone! Not everyone is at fault. My case is against you, the priests.
translation_verse: Ama má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ ʋ dɔŋɔ, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala nyaŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩ.

english_verse: You and the prophets will stumble day and night; I'll silence your mothers.
translation_verse: Ma-na Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa yie ŋmoo naaŋ nɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala, mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa maa ŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ chei ma naaŋ Iziral.

english_verse: You priests have rejected me, and my people are destroyed by refusing to obey. Now I'll reject you and forget your children, because you have forgotten my Law.
translation_verse: Wɩaa jaŋ chei mɩ nɩaa a tɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ mɩ jɩŋ. Ma sɩ vɩa dɩ ma jɩmmɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ ma vɩama nɛ arɩ ma ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa. Ma sɩ vɩa mɩ wombii-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ma tuto ŋɩɩ, mɩ ma jaŋ vɩa ma biiriŋ.

english_verse: By adding more of you priests, you multiply the number of people who sin. Now I'll change your pride into shame.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ pʋŋa pɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma mɩ lɛ. Ba joŋ ba yɩrɩŋ a lenni kʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You encourage others to sin, so you can stuff yourselves on their sin offerings.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa to didii kɩaa. Ba tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ nɛ dɩ nɩaa nɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: That's why I will punish the people for their deeds, just as I will punish you priests.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma nagɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ ba kala a tɩŋ wombie-la ba sɩɩ to wɩaa, a joŋ ba wʋŋaalaa chɩmɩŋ tiŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: You expect wooden idols and other objects of wood to give you advice. Lusting for sex at pagan shrines has made you unfaithful to me, your God.
translation_verse: bɩ wɩaa sɩaa jɩŋ. Ba yie pɩɛsɛ tɔmʋŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ saa dɩ ʋ dagɛba wɩaa. Ba wʋlɩɩlɩŋ ŋaanɩŋ kɛmba yeŋŋi nɛ. Ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ mɩ-na ba Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: You offer sacrifices on mountaintops and hills, under oak trees, and wherever good shade is found. Your own daughters and daughters-in-law sell themselves for sex.
translation_verse: Ba yie kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa peelee nyuŋ, a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ dundolluŋ nyuŋ, arɩ tɩɩsɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma toloo ŋɩŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa, ma bii-haalaa ma chɩchɛ nɩaa balaba.

english_verse: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ ma toloo dɩ ba nɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, koo ma bii-haalaa dɩ ba nɩɩ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa baala-la ma tɩtɩa mʋ hachɔrʋmɔ-la leriŋ nɛ a kpaarɛ vene a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa sɩaa jɩŋ jaŋ chei ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, ma sɩ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩalɩŋ, Juda nɩaa bɩ maga dɩ ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ, a laa cheeriŋ. Má sɩ́ Gɩlɩgal mʋ, má sɩ́ Bɛf Avɛŋ ma jɩl, a sɩ́ bʋl, ‘La ŋmɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA.’

english_verse: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord, cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ dolie a nagɛ nɛ-pa-werigiŋ nɛ. Ɛɛ nɛ saa La TƖƖNA jaŋ wuo dɩɛsɛba a nagɛ pie-biisiŋ sɩ hɛ pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diiliŋ?

english_verse: You people of Israel are charmed by idols. Leave those people alone!
translation_verse: Efirem joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ vʋɩyaa lɛ nɛ, má leŋu nɩmɛ.

english_verse: You get drunk, then sleep with prostitutes; you would rather be vulgar than lead a decent life.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bugi woruŋ, ba yie bɩra ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ. Ba sɩpaalaaraa chaasa cho hɩɩsɛ wɩaa ŋaanɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: And so you will be swept away in a whirlwind for sacrificing to idols.
translation_verse: Pel-vinvilimiŋ jaŋ paaba kaa viiri dɩ ba vʋɩ-kpaarɩŋ ma leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diiba.”

english_verse: Listen, you priests! Pay attention, Israel! Listen, you members of the royal family. Justice was your duty. But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor you trapped the people.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Ma Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, má nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ. Iziral sɩpaalaaraa, má jegili. Kuoro dɩa nɩaa, má ma jegili. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa ma wɩɩ nɛ. Mɩzɩpa lɛ ma nagɛ bɛrɛ́ nɛ ma nɩaa lɛ, a ŋaa jóŋ, ba sɩ joŋo yuo peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tabɔ lɛ.

english_verse: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩamɛ ka kpʋ nɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba.

english_verse: Israel, I know all about you, and because of your unfaithfulness, I find you unacceptable.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ Efirem wɩɩkala nɛ, Iziral wɩɩ tuo a faamɛ. Efirem, ŋ mɩɩra joŋ ŋ nyuŋ hɛ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ lɛ nɛ, Iziral kala chei.

english_verse: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.
translation_verse: Ba wʋŋaalaa bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ ba mɩɩra mʋ ba Wɩa teeŋ. Wʋlɩɩlɩŋ ŋaanɩŋ sɩ hɛ ba nyuŋ lɛ leŋe ba bɩ ba TƖƖNA jɩŋ.

english_verse: You offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices to me, but I have turned away and refuse to be found.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ kɛŋ ba piesee arɩ nɛsɩŋ mʋ dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a chɛ na La TƖƖNA, ba bɩ jaŋ naʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ mɩɩrɛ ba harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed. The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, ba lʋl mɛŋgaa-biiriŋ nɛ. Lɛɛlɛ ba chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbielee jaŋ chei ba dɩ ba bagɩsɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
translation_verse: Má ŋmʋʋ banyile Gɩbɩa lɛ, a ŋmʋʋ nyile Rama ma lɛ. Má ŋaa laalɩyuori goŋ Bɛf Avɛŋ lɛ. Bɛnjamɩŋ, laa sɩpaaŋ dɩ la mʋ laalɩŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.
translation_verse: Efirem jaŋ pɩŋ hoi tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩaa. Iziral doho doho tʋɔŋ, wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla sɛnɛ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Judah's leaders are like crooks who move boundary markers; that's why I will flood them with my anger.
translation_verse: Juda nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tabɩa-la ba sɩ joŋo magɩlɛ tinteeŋ bʋa gɛbɛ nɛ. Mɩ baanɩŋ jaŋ sii ba nyuŋ, a nagɛ lɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ tɔ leriŋ.

english_verse: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.
translation_verse: Ba nyagɛ Efirem bil nɛ, a nʋɔsʋ bil sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ faa kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa nɛ.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord, will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.
translation_verse: Mɩ nagɛ mʋgʋlʋŋ nɛ a joŋ Efirem didii, a leŋ Juda nɩaa ma chichei.

english_verse: When Israel and Judah saw their sickness and wounds, Israel asked help from Assyria and its mighty king. But the king cannot cure them or heal their wounds.
translation_verse: Efirem sɩ na dɩ ʋʋ wɩɩlʋ, Juda ma na dɩ ʋ kɛŋ naawɩɩlaa, Efirem mɩɩra mʋ Asiiria tinteeŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ kuoru-balɩŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ. Ama ʋ bɩ wuo vaarɛ Efirem, a bɩ wuo ŋaa Juda ma naawɩɩlaa fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ nagɛ naachigiŋ Efirem lɛ, a nagɛ naachigi-balɩŋ Juda lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba pʋɔsɛ muno muno aŋ viiri. Mɩ jaŋ chʋmba viiri, ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ laaba ta.

english_verse: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ mɩ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ ba cheye nɛ, a bee chɩchɛmɛ. Hɛɛŋ nɛ jʋʋba, ba jaŋ chaasa bee chɩchɛmɛ.”

english_verse: Let's return to the Lord. He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ, “Má kɔ dɩ la mɩɩra mʋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Ʋ kɛnla pʋɔsɛ muno muno nɛ, ama ʋ jaŋ vaarɛla. Ʋ pɩrɛla nɛ, ama ʋ jaŋ vɔɔ tɔ la naawɩɩlaa.

english_verse: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa balɩa harɩŋ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la bɩra kɛŋ doluŋ, tapʋl-tori chɛɛŋ ʋ jaŋ bɩra kɛnla kaa kɔ ʋ teeŋ dɩ la hɛ ʋ leriŋ.

english_verse: Let's do our best to know the Lord. His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime. The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la jɩŋ La TƖƖNA. Má leŋ la hɛ doluŋ aŋ jɩmʋ. Ʋ jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ, a nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ sɩ yie pɔsɛ. Ʋ jaŋ kɔ la teeŋ a nagɛ tafaaŋ duonuŋ, a nagɛ yɩ-biiniŋ duonuŋ sɩ yie nɩɩ ŋɩɩ leriŋ fɩɛlɛ.”

english_verse: People of Israel and Judah, what can I do with you? Your love for me disappears more quickly than mist or dew at sunrise.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Efirem, wʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa ŋ lɛ? Juda, wʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa ŋ lɛ? Ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ chomi nagɛ bʋrʋŋ sɩ yie tɔ chʋchʋɔŋ nɛ, a nagɛ nyalɩŋ sɩ yie guu huo.

english_verse: That's why I slaughtered you with the words of my prophets. That's why my judgments blazed like the dawning sun.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ mɩ tɩŋ mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa ba kɛŋ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa kʋ tɔɔ ma sɩɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ nɛ mɩ kaa kpʋma, mɩ wʋbʋlaa nagɛ taŋ sɩ lɩgɩsa nɛ ma nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I'd rather for you to be faithful and to know me than to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mɩ cho dɩ ma fɩfá nɩaa nenige nɛ a kɩɩ ma sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩpɩmɛ, a jɩŋ mɩ-na Wɩa a kɩɩ ma sɩ nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa pɩmɛ.

english_verse: At a place named Adam, you betrayed me by breaking our agreement.
translation_verse: Ama ma nagɛ Adam nɛ a chei nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ba pɛgɛ, ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
translation_verse: Gɩlɩad ŋaa tabal sɩ suo arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, ba kpʋ nɩaa chalɩŋ su lee-kala.

english_verse: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.
translation_verse: A nagɛ wɛŋ-boruroo sɩ yie faa a gbɛrɛ nɩaa ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma yie hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a ŋɩŋaa. Ba yie kpʋ nɩaa Sɛkɛm wombiiŋ lɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ kɛŋ hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Mɩ na wɩɩ nɛ sɩ chaasa lɔrɛ Iziral nɩaa lɛ. Efirem joŋ ʋ nyuŋ hɛ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ nɛ, Iziral ma kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: People of Judah, your time is coming too. The Lord Wants To Help Israel I, the Lord, would like to make my nation prosper again
translation_verse: Ma-na Juda tɩmma, mɩ hɛ tapʋlɩɩ nɛ dɩ mɩ dɔgɩsɛ ma ma, arɩ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩ nɩaa mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ ma kala.

english_verse: and to heal its wounds. But then I see the crimes in Israel and Samaria. Everyone is deceitful; robbers roam the streets.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ vaarɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa na-kala, Efirem wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yie chaasa lɩɩ chɩŋ nɛ kporo, Samarɩa ma nɩbɔŋ wɩaa chɩŋ kporo. Baa nyɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ, gaaraa boro jʋjʋʋ nɩaa dɩɩsɩŋ wɛŋ-boruroo gurigoo laa nɩaa kɩaa womporunuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: No one realizes that I have seen their sins surround them like a flood.
translation_verse: Ama ba bɩ jɩŋ dɩ mɩɩ liisi ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɛ. Ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ golliba nɛ, ba hɛ mɩ sɩpaaŋ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
translation_verse: Ba yie ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a leŋ kuoro tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, a nyɩɛ wɩaa ba sɩpaalaaraa ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: On the day their king was crowned, his officials got him drunk, and he joined in their foolishness.
translation_verse: Kuoro gbiele tapʋlʋŋ, ʋ dɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ yie nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bugi nɛ. Ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ sieru lɛ ŋaa wʋtɔɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: They are flames destroying their leaders. And their kings are powerless; none of them trust me.
translation_verse: Ba kala lɩma nɛ a nagɛ tabʋʋŋ. Ba kpʋ ba sɩpaalaaraa nɛ. Ba kuoroo kala sʋʋ tɩtɩgɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, ka ba kʋŋkala bɩ bunso pɩmɛ, dɩ mɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
translation_verse: Efirem guoli tinteyee tʋɔŋ nɛ, ʋ nagɛ kɩŋkɛsɩmɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ kaa bɩrɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
translation_verse: Nʋhʋɔraa lɩɩsɛ ʋ doluŋ, ama ʋ bɩ jɩŋ. Ʋ nyuŋ pʋlla nɛ, ama ʋ bɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
translation_verse: Iziral sɩɩ-duoŋ daga arɩ ʋ laa cheeriŋ nɛ. Ama wɩaa deemba kala lɛ, ʋ bɩ mɩɩra kɔ ʋ TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ, a bɩ bee chɛʋ ma.

english_verse: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ mʋa, mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ jóŋ a yuo kɛsɛba. Mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛba tuu a nagɛ diibiisiŋ sɩɩ fil wɩa-nyuŋ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ nɩa dɩ ba kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ, mɩ jaŋ kɛsɛba.

english_verse: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puuba, bɛɛ wɩaa ba yeŋŋe nɛ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ cheiba, bɛɛ wɩaa ba vɩa mɩ niiŋ nɛ. Mɩ fa cho dɩ mɩ laaba ta nɛ, ama ba nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ pɩpɩmɛ.

english_verse: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ kala dee ba kaa yele pɩpɩmɛ, ba mɩɩrɛ mɩ harɩŋ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ sʋla chɩchɛ kʋdiilee arɩ sɩnɩŋ ba yie pɩŋ ba bɔsʋnʋŋ lɛ nɛ a ŋmuŋmoo niiŋ a nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ mɩ jɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
translation_verse: Mɩ dagɛba nɛ woruŋ a leŋ ba kɛŋ doluŋ, ka ba vʋʋrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ mɩɩra kɔ mɩ-na Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala teeŋ, ba nagɛ toŋ sɩ golibo nɛ. Ba jaŋ kpʋ ba sɩpaalaaraa laalɩŋ lɛ, a tɩŋ nii-jɩgɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ bʋl. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa, ba jaŋ mɔmba Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Má ŋmʋʋ banyile, dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nagɛ kachuuŋ nɛ aa zaarɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩa nyuŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɩaa chei nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ba pɛgɛ nɛ, a vɩa wombii-la ma mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto.

english_verse: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋmoo niiŋ pɩmɛ a bʋl, ‘La Wɩa, la jɩmɩŋ nɛ.’

english_verse: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.
translation_verse: Ama Iziral tɩŋŋaa vɩa wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ, ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kire to ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: You chose kings and leaders without consulting me; you made silver and gold idols that led to your downfall.
translation_verse: Ba bil kuoroo nɛ, ka mɩ jɩma tuo, a lɩɩsɛ sɩpaalaaraa ma, ka mɩ dee bɩ ŋɩɩ daga. Ba kɛŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ libi tɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩ ba tɩtɩa, sɩ jaŋ cheiba.

english_verse: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
translation_verse: Samarɩa tɩmma, má joŋ tɔŋ-la ma sɩ libe ʋ nagɛ nɛ-bie a yuo ta. Mɩ baanɩŋ ka sii ma nyuŋ nɛ. Ɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ dieni magɛ ka dɩ ma leŋ disiniŋ ŋaanɩŋ?

english_verse: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa gɔgɔ nɛ ŋaa tɔmʋŋ deeŋ sɩ nagɛ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ, ʋ bɩ Wɩa ŋaa. Ma tɔŋ-la sɩ nagɛ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ, ba jaŋ yɛrʋ muno muno.

english_verse: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ duo ba nɛ ŋ jaŋ kʋma yʋgɛ, dɩ mɩɩŋ nɛ bɩ lʋla ʋ bɩ bɩɩ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ fa paala hɛ biee ma, nʋhʋɔraa nɛ jaŋ joŋo dii.

english_verse: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
translation_verse: Iziral kala cheye nɛ, ʋ hɛ tinteyee tʋɔŋ nɛ a nagɛ kʋtɔɔ nʋʋkala sɩ bɩ chɛ.

english_verse: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
translation_verse: Ʋ gɔllɔɔ baarɛ ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ a nagɛ kaku-werigiŋ, a mʋ Asiiria tinteeŋ. Efirem joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa yalla pɩ ʋ hɩɩlaba nɛ.

english_verse: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ ba tɩtɩa yallɛ a hɛ tinteyee nɩaa tʋɔŋ ma nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ kɛmba kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Kuori-duo jaŋ nyagɛba bil dɩ hɛɛŋ jʋʋba, dɩ ba kala jagɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
translation_verse: Efirem saa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ korunuŋ yʋgɛ ma nɛ, ama ba mɩɩra kɛŋ korunuŋ deemba bɩrɩmɛ lee ba sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
translation_verse: Ba yie kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩmɛ, aŋ joŋ nammɩa-la chaŋ, ama mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ bɩ ba Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ-la nyuŋ tɔrɔ. Lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ liise yi ba nɩbɔŋ wɩalɩŋ lɛ a dɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Ba jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa saa kuoru dɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, Juda nɩaa ma saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli tabalaa yʋgɛ. Ama ba yʋ mɩ-na Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaaba wɩaa nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ tabala-la lɛ, dɩ ʋ joŋ ba dɩ-duoruŋ dii.”

english_verse: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, má sɩ́ jʋɔsʋ, a sɩ́ gbielu a nagɛ tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ ma Wɩa teeŋ aŋ mɩɩra gɔllɔɔ kpaarɛ vesiŋ aa chɛ dɩ ma kʋpɛrɛɛ faasa wasɛ.

english_verse: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ jaŋ pɛsɛ hɔŋ La TƖƖNA tintee-la lɛ. Efirem jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, dɩ ba kɛsɛba kaa mʋ Asiiria tinteeŋ dɩ ba dii kʋdiile-la sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ jaŋ na wombiiŋ nɩmɛ a kɛŋ sɩnɩŋ ŋaa kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA. Pʋsʋ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kpʋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ma bɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ. Ba Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa jaŋ nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yel yoho kʋdiilee, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ diiba jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ. Kʋdiilee deemba jaŋ ŋaa ba tɩtɩa kɩaa, ba bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛmba jʋʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
translation_verse: Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ ŋaa ma gbielee tapʋlʋŋ, tapʋlɩa-la ma sɩ yie gbieli a zizil La TƖƖNA?

english_verse: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ paala foro fá ba bɩ ba kpʋa ma, Ijipiti nɩaa-na jaŋ dɛrɛba, dɩ ba hugiba lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Memfis Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Lere-la ba sɩ bil ba warɩpʋla jaŋ lugi a bɩrɩmɛ tiiŋ aŋ ka dɩ sɔsʋŋ ma nyʋ tɔ ba dɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ka kɔ nɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ kpaga nɛ. Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ. Ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yʋga nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, ma chaasa tɛrɛ nɛ woruŋ, a joŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla arɩ ʋ ŋaa nɩyaarɩ nɛ, nɩɩ-la Wɩa dɩma-la sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa nyɩnyɛ tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla nɛ chɩŋ Wɩa naasɩŋ lɛ a bibeŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ka ba ha hɛ bɛrɩsɩŋ ʋ wombiee kala lɛ, tɛrɩsɩŋ ma yʋgɛ ʋ Wɩa dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
translation_verse: Ba wɩɩŋ nɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ, a nagɛ bʋa-la ba sɩ hɛ Gɩbɩa lɛ. Wɩa jaŋ liise yi ba nɩbɔŋ wɩalɩŋ lɛ, a dɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa.

english_verse: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ fa sɩ na Iziral, ʋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ na girep nɛnɩŋ nɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ fa sɩ na ba naabalɩmaba, ʋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ na tutogi-nambɩl folluŋ tutogo lɛ nɛ. Ama ba sɩ kʋ yi peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal Pio, ba joŋ ba tɩtɩa pɩ baal vene-la nɛ a ŋaa hɩɩsɛ wɩaa, a kʋ ŋaa nɩtɔɔnɩ a nagɛ vene-la ba sɩ cho.

english_verse: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa Efirem nɩaa tʋla jaŋ lɛl a nagɛ diibie sɩ file viiri. Ba haalaa bɩ jaŋ lʋlʋl, ba bɩ jaŋ cheŋ chalɩŋ, ba bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ luoruŋ.

english_verse: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ paala dɩɛsɛ ba biiriŋ ma, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba sʋʋ, ba kʋŋ bɩ jaŋ ka. Hɛɛŋ jaŋ jʋʋba dɩ mɩ nɛ mɩɩrɛ ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
translation_verse: Mɩ na dɩ Efirem nagɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Taaya nɛ a chɩŋ lee sɩ zɔmɔ. Ama Efirem nɩaa kɛsɛ ba biiriŋ lɩɩ pa dɩ ba kpʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, wʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋl ŋ joŋo hɛ ba lɛ? Joŋ lʋla-la ba sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ a chei biiriŋ tɩta arɩ yɩla-la sɩ bɩ yɩl lɩɩŋ kɛnɛ a pɩba.

english_verse: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Ba suomi ba nɩbɔŋ wɩaa kala Gɩlɩgal lɛ nɛ, nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ chɩna bɛrɛba. Wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ kiriba ta mɩ tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ choba, ba sɩpaalaaraa kala vɩa mɩ niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
translation_verse: Efirem nɩaa nagɛ tɩa sɩ ŋmaama nɛ ʋ naapoloo hɩl, ʋ bɩ nɛŋ kala kɛnɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ paala lʋl biiriŋ yʋgɛ a choba ma, mɩ jaŋ kpʋ ba kala.”

english_verse: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩa jaŋ vɩaba ta, a tɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ ʋ niiŋ ka to wɩaa. Ba jaŋ ŋaa nɩa sɩ gɔllɔɔ baarɛ tinteyee lɛ.

english_verse: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
translation_verse: Iziral fa nagɛ girep tɩa sɩ jɛrɛ woruŋ nɛ, a nɩnɛŋ woruŋ. Ʋ nɛnɛɛ sɩ kʋ yʋgɛ woruŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ saa veŋ-kpaarɛ korunuŋ yʋgɛ. Ʋ tinteeŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ kpɩɛrɛ tabɩa-la sɩ ŋaa vesiŋ.

english_verse: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa ka nyɩsɛba nɛ, lɛɛlɛ ʋ maga dɩ ba na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ ba cheeriŋ wɩaa. La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋmoo ba korunu-la ta aŋ yɛrɛ ba tabɩa-la sɩ ŋaa vesiŋ.

english_verse: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ bʋl, “La bɩ kuoro kɛnɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la bɩ La TƖƖNA zile. Dɩ la nɛ fa paala kɛŋ kuoro ma, wʋbɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa pɩla?”

english_verse: Israel, you break treaties and don't keep promises; you turn justice into poisonous weeds where healthy plants should grow.
translation_verse: Ba yie hɛ niiriŋ yʋgɛ, a ŋmɩŋmɩɛsɛ pɛɩpɛɩ, a nyɩɛ wɩaa hɛ niiŋ pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wʋtɩtɩɩ bɩrɩmɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ a tɛllɛ naaŋ, a nagɛ saga sɩ hɛ paara baga lɛ.

english_verse: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Samarɩa lɛ ka fá tɔŋ-la ba sɩ bile Bɛf Avɛŋ lɛ ʋ nagɛ nɛ-bie nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to tɔŋ-la jaŋ yel ʋ wɩaa, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pʋpʋ ma jaŋ ŋaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ʋ wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba kɛnʋ laa ba teeŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga.

english_verse: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛnʋ mʋ Asiiria a joŋo pɩ kuoru-balɩŋ a zilu. Efirem jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa a tɩŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ saa tɔmʋŋ aa tou.

english_verse: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛsɛ Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa arɩ ba kuoro viiri a nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ joŋ daa-bie kaa mʋ.

english_verse: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ chei vesiŋ dɩ-kpaarɩa-la sɩ hɛ Bɛf Avɛŋ lɛ ba kaa ŋaa nɩbɔŋ wɩaa. Ʋ nɛ leŋe Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Sɔsʋŋ arɩ chɛɛŋ jaŋ lugo tɔ ba vʋɩ-kpaarɛ korunu-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ bʋl, “Peelee, má tɔla, dundolluŋ, má tele tɔla.”

english_verse: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Iziral tɩmma, bʋa-la ma sɩ hɛ Gɩbɩa lɛ, ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, aŋ ha ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Laalɩŋ fa bɩ kʋ kpʋ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa Gɩbɩa lɛɛ?

english_verse: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ cho, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa sii hɛ dɔŋɔ a kɔ ba lɛ, a kɛsɛba a dɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bʋlɩa bʋlɩa.

english_verse: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
translation_verse: Efirem nagɛ na-paha ba sɩ daga nɛ, ʋ cho mɩaa ŋmobuŋ. Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ chɛ daaŋ vɔɔ mɛrɛ ʋ baŋŋa-la sɩ zɔmɔ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kiri Efirem dɩ ʋ vɩvɛŋ, Juda maga dɩ ʋ pɛrɛ, dɩ Jekɔb ma bugili tinteeŋ.

english_verse: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
translation_verse: Ama ma kɛŋ tʋɔhɛɛŋ nɛ duu kɩaa, a kɛŋ tʋɔbɔmʋŋ kʋŋ kɩalɩŋ. Ma dii wʋnyɩɛrɩ kɩaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ ma tɩtɩa doluŋ arɩ ma laalɩyuori wajɩaba-la sɩ yʋga lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa laalɩŋ jaŋ sii ma nyuŋ a chei ma dɩ-duoruŋ kala, a nagɛ baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Salɩmaŋ fa sɩ chei taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf Abɛl ŋɩɩ laalɩŋ tapʋlʋŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ ba paa naamba arɩ ba biiriŋ vɩɩrɛ tinteeŋ kpʋ.

english_verse: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ma Bɛtɛl nɩaa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma nɩbɔŋ wɩaa yʋga. Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, ba jaŋ chaasa kpʋ Iziral kuoro.”

english_verse: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
translation_verse: LA TƖƖNA sɩ, “Iziral fa sɩ ŋaa bii-bie, mɩ chou nɛ, a yɩrʋ a kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ mɩ yɩrʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ma, ʋ yie fa kagɛ mɩ lɛ a mʋ dɩ-bolii. Ʋ yie kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ tɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ dagɛ Efirem ʋ vɛŋ. Mɩ nɛ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ama ʋ bɩ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ beŋ ʋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ kɛnʋ vɛŋ arɩ nuhuobiine chaachiliŋ a kɛnʋ arɩ chonuŋ. Mɩ nɛ lɩɩsʋ hɛɛŋ lɛ, aŋ tɩtɩa chɔgɩlɛ a dɩɛsʋ.

english_verse: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ vɩa dɩ ʋ mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ, ŋɩɩ-na, ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, Asiiria kuoro jaŋ benu.

english_verse: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa kɛŋ ba tʋɔŋ dɩ ba mɩɩrɛ mɩ harɩŋ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ paala sʋla yɩrɛ mɩ-na Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala ma, mɩ bɩ jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
translation_verse: Efirem, ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa a joŋuŋ ta? Iziral, ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa a joŋuŋ pa? Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa a dɔgʋsʋŋ a nagɛ mɩ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Adɩma lɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa a cheyiŋ a nagɛ mɩ sɩ chei taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zeboyim ŋɩɩ? Mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa kpaa bʋlɩa nɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ ka wɩɩ ŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ faasa na baanɩŋ, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ chei Efirem. Mɩ nɛ Wɩa, mɩ bɩ nuhuobiiŋ ŋaa, mɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, mɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ baanɩŋ a kɔ ma lɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa jaŋ to mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA harɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ huosi a nagɛ naachigiŋ. Dɩ mɩ nɩɩ huosi, mɩ nɩaa jaŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ kɔ a chichel.

english_verse: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ nagɛ diibii-laalɩŋ a lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, a lɩɩ Asiiria tinteeŋ a nagɛ kokosuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ bɩra holliba ba dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.” Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ

english_verse: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.
translation_verse: Wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ Efirem kaa tɔ mɩ hɛ ka Iziral dɩa nɩaa ma nyɩnyɩsɛmɛ. Juda nɩaa ma haa to vʋɩyaa nɛ, a vɩa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
translation_verse: Efirem daa to peliŋ harɩŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ dɩɛsʋ, ʋ yie kire to peliŋ sɩ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ harɩŋ tapʋl-piliŋ kala, a nyɩnyɩɛ wɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a hɩhɛ yuosuŋ. Ʋ dɩ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa nɛ pɛ niiŋ a kɛŋ olif nʋʋŋ mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA kɛŋ wɩɩ nɛ dɩ ʋ bʋla tɩgɛ Juda lɛ, ʋ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Jekɔb a tɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa, a joŋ ʋ wʋŋaalaa chɩmɩŋ tiŋ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
translation_verse: Ʋ naaŋ luoruŋ tʋɔŋ, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ naambie naatilimiŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ sɩ waa baal, ʋ kɛŋ Wɩa loo.

english_verse: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ Wɩa tɩndaara loo, a loo dii, a yel a sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ. Jekɔb na Wɩa lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛtɛl, nɩmɛ nɛ Wɩa bʋl wɩaa ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: God's name is the Lord, the Lord God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA, nʋʋkala jɩŋ.

english_verse: So return to your God. Patiently trust him, and show love and justice.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩɩra mʋ ŋ Wɩa teeŋ, a chou aŋ pɛ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a gbɛrɛ ŋ Wɩa bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Israel, you enjoy cheating and taking advantage of others.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa nagɛ bayalaa sɩ kɛŋ sanɩaba sɩ bɩ zɔŋ nɛ a mɩmagɩsɛ kɩaa, ba cho nɩaa gʋrʋŋ.

english_verse: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
translation_verse: Efirem bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ a bʋl, “Mɩ kɛŋ kɩaa nɛ woruŋ, mɩ nɛ dʋa kɩalɩŋ. Mɩ kɛŋ dʋa-la ŋɩɩ nɛ, ka nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo na dɩ mɩ chei wɩɩ koo dɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ.”

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ, “Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ nɛ kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ bɩra leŋ dɩ ma jʋʋ lɛŋŋɛɛ a nagɛ ma lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele tapʋlaa.

english_verse: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩ mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ a joŋ wɩaa yʋgɛ a dagɛba arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ, a to ba lɛ a magɛ namagaba a pɩma.”

english_verse: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
translation_verse: Gɩlɩad ŋaa ta-bɔŋ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ ŋaa nɩtɔɔnʋ nɛ. Ba kɛŋ nɛ-belliŋ kpʋkpaarɛ vʋɩyaa nɛ Gɩlɩgal lɛ. Ba vʋɩ-kpaarɛ korunu-la jaŋ pɩŋ a nagɛ tabɩaa ba sɩ paa chʋɔrɛ baga lɛ.

english_verse: Jacob escaped to Syria where he tended sheep to earn himself a wife.
translation_verse: Jekɔb lɩɩ fá mʋ Siiria tinteeŋ, nɩmɛ nɛ Iziral tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa ka dɩ ʋ laa haala, piesee nɛ ʋ daa aŋ laa haal-la.

english_verse: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tɩŋ ʋ wʋlaabʋlla nɛ ʋ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la lɛ nɛ ʋ to a beŋ ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.
translation_verse: Faafaa-la dɩ Efirem doho nɩaa nɛ bʋl wɩaa, fawʋllʋŋ yie jʋʋ Iziral doho doho-la dɔnsʋŋ nɩaa nɛ. Ba faa beŋ Efirem lɛ nɛ, ama ʋ nɩaa mɩɩra ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ ba sɩ kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal, ŋɩɩ leŋ ba jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols— yes, even to kiss them.
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ lɛ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ ba kɛŋ ba hɔpʋla nɛ a libi tɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩ ba tɩtɩa. Ba jɩma libiba nɛ woruŋ ba nagɛ nɛ-biisiŋ, gɔgɔɔ nɛ libi kɩalɩŋ kala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bʋl, “Maa kpaarɛ kɩalɩŋ la sɩ libe a guguori kɩalɩŋ la sɩ libe ba nagɛ nɛ-bie.”

english_verse: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba jaŋ nagɛ bʋrʋŋ sɩ tɔ chʋchʋɔŋ, a nagɛ chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla nyalɩŋ sɩ guu huo, a nagɛ peliŋ sɩ paa mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ taha lɛ viiri, a nagɛ nyʋɔsʋŋ sɩ to viise lɩlɩɩ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛmma kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ma maga ma jɩŋ arɩ mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa, Laataarʋ dɔŋ tuo, see mɩ-na.

english_verse: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ beŋ ma nyuŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ lee-la wulumuŋ sɩ yʋga.

english_verse: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ fa pɩba kʋdiilee, ba dii vɔgɛ. Ba sɩ vɔgɔ, ba kɛŋ sɩɩ-duoŋ, a yʋ mɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ fɩla chaalɛba a nagɛ naachigiŋ, mɩ jaŋ faa gbɛrɛba wombiiŋ lɛ a nagɛ kpe-fɩaŋ-mie.

english_verse: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
translation_verse: A nagɛ ba sɩ kɛsɛ lʋgʋmʋŋ biiriŋ ʋ yaraa hosi ŋɩɩ. Mɩ jaŋ luri ba fehe. Mɩ jaŋ chamba a nagɛ naachigiŋ a kɛmba pʋɔsɛ a nagɛ baga kʋa.

english_verse: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, ma chei ma tɩtɩa, bɛɛ wɩaa ma lɩɩ mɩ-na Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɛ ma lɛ harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You wanted a king and rulers. Where is your king now? What cities have rulers?
translation_verse: Nɩɩ nɛ ma kuoro hɛ dɩ ʋ laama ta? Nɩɩ nɛ ma sɩpaalaara-la kala sɩ hɛ ma tasɩŋ lɛ hɛ, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ sɩ mɩ lɩɩsa pɩma?

english_verse: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mɩ na baanɩŋ nɛ a lɩɩsɛ kuoro pɩma, a bɩra na baanɩŋ a joŋu viiri.

english_verse: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
translation_verse: Efirem cheeriŋ pɩna nɛ, ba ŋmʋnsɛ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bil nɛ.

english_verse: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
translation_verse: Mɩ time laaba dɩ sʋʋŋ sɩ́ ba wuoo? Mɩ laaba ta sʋʋŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ? Sʋʋŋ, nɩɩ nɛ ŋ huoŋ hɛ? Lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ, nɩɩ nɛ ŋ huo-la sɩɩ chei nɩaa hɛ? Mɩ bɩ jaŋ fá ba nenige.

english_verse: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
translation_verse: Efirem pʋŋa yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ ʋ naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ, ama La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ peliŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kɔ a lu lɩɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ, dɩ ʋ lɩɩ-bul-sɩɩŋ tɔ, dɩ ʋ viliŋ ma hɩl. Ba jaŋ jʋʋ dii ʋ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩa a paa dʋa-la kala ʋ sɩ bile.

english_verse: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Samarɩa lɛ, ba cheeriŋ jaŋ nyʋa ba nyuŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba lɩɩ ba Wɩa harɩŋ nɛ. Ba jaŋ kpʋba laalɩŋ lɛ, aŋ paa ba biibiisiŋ vɩɩrɛ tinteeŋ kpʋ, a kɛsɛ ba hapuugoo ma kpɛrɛ.”

english_verse: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, má mɩɩra mʋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ. Ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ leŋe ma tel.

english_verse: Return to the Lord and say, “Please forgive our sins. Accept our good sacrifices of praise instead of bulls.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ aŋ mɩɩra mʋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, a bʋla pʋ, “Fá la nenige aŋ joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala chɛla, aŋ chaga laala dɩ la wuo suri la niiŋ a dɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
translation_verse: Asiiria tɩŋŋaa bɩ la wuo laa ta, laalɩyuori janɩŋ bɩ la wuo pɔ. La bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ la bʋla, ‘La wɩa nɛ kɩalɩŋ la tɩtɩa sɩ ŋaa,’ bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɩɩ fá biisinsiŋ nenige.”

english_verse: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ vaarɛ ba dɩgɩlɩŋ-bɩnɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ ba lɛ, aŋ choba woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ ba nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ nagɛ nyalɩŋ a nyala hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ fɩɩlɛ a nagɛ tɩa sɩ fɩɩla. Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ kuolo sɩ hɛ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ, ʋ naapoloo tuu tinteeŋ,

english_verse: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
translation_verse: ʋ naakel-falaa jaŋ waa woruŋ. Ʋ jaŋ zɔŋ a nagɛ Olif tɩa, dɩ ʋ sʋɔra sɩŋ a nagɛ kuolo sɩ hɛ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ bɩra hɔŋ ʋ fɩɛlɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ jigi a nagɛ mɩɩŋ. Ʋ jaŋ fɩɩlɛ a nagɛ girep tɩa aŋ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ a nagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Lɛbanɔŋ.

english_verse: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
translation_verse: Efirem, ŋ dɩ ŋ tɔŋŋɔɔ bɩra bɩ wɩɩ pɛ. Mɩ jaŋ laa ŋ sʋla aŋ beŋ ŋ nyuŋ woruŋ. Mɩ nagɛ bʋtʋma pɩpaarɩŋ sɩ bire woruŋ nɛ, ŋ wʋzɔŋ kala lɩɩ mɩ teeŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ jɩŋ wɩaa deemba. Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa, ʋ jaŋ jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ. La TƖƖNA wombiee ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiee nɛ, tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa vɩvɛŋ ba lɛ, ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩaba gɛrɛ titel nɛ.

english_verse: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me. Locusts Cover the Land
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ Pɛtʋɛl nanʋala Jowɛl. Hɔbɔ kʋ tɔ leriŋ

english_verse: Listen, you leaders and everyone else in the land. Has anything like this ever happened before?
translation_verse: Nɩhɩasɩŋ, má nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ, má jegile nɩɩ. Wʋdoho deeŋ ha ŋaa ma mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa lɛ koo ma naabalɩmaba mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa lɛɛ?

english_verse: Tell our children! Let it be told to our grandchildren and their children too.
translation_verse: Má bʋlʋ pɩ ma biiriŋ, dɩ ma biiriŋ ma bʋlʋ a pɩ ba biiriŋ, dɩ ba ma bʋlʋ pɩ biiri-la ba ha sɩ jaŋ lʋl.

english_verse: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
translation_verse: Tintee nɩaa nɛ kɔ dɩ ba yuo mɩ tinteeŋ, ba kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ, ba bɩ nii kɛnɛ. Ba nyɩlaa nagɛ naachigiŋ nyɩlaa nɛ, a duomo nagɛ naachigi-haala kɩaa.

english_verse: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
translation_verse: Má yel a nagɛ hatolo sɩ laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ a yiyel baala sɩ sʋgʋ dɩ ʋ jaa lɛ.

english_verse: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
translation_verse: Ba giri mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ta nɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ leŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa yiyel, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Barren fields mourn; grain, grapes, and olives are scorched and shriveled.
translation_verse: Bagɩsɩŋ kala cheye nɛ, tinteeŋ kala hɩl. Mɩaa kala nɛ cheye, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ ma dɛrɛ, nʋʋŋ ma lɛl.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
translation_verse: Girep tɩɩsɩŋ kala hɩla nɛ, tutogusuŋ ma kala yuori, a pɛ kampoiŋ, abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ apʋl tɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Baga tɩɩsɩŋ kala hɩla nɛ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, nuhuobiinee tʋɔtɔrʋŋ kala lɛlɛ nɛ. Wɩa sɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ

english_verse: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, má laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ a yel, má ŋmoo niiŋ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la lɛ. Má kɔ, a laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa, mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa bɩra tuo Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ nɩaa vɔɔ nii-la sɩɩ tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ, má hilimi Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Má yɩrɛ nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ dɩ ba kɔ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩa, a yele pɩ La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: We are in for trouble! Soon the Lord All-Powerful will bring disaster.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la kpaga nɛ. La TƖƖNA tapʋlʋŋ kpaga nɛ, doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ chei leriŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la.

english_verse: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Laa beŋ nɛ ka ba chichei la kʋpɛrɛɛ. Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ bɩra tuo, nɩaa bɩra bɩ jʋɔsɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
translation_verse: Kʋduuloo ka sʋʋ nɛ tinteeŋ sɩ hɩla. Mɩaa tuo dɩ ba tʋɔlɛ, ŋɩɩ leŋ virisiŋ wuoli, nɔŋ-virisiŋ wuoli a kala chei.

english_verse: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
translation_verse: Losuŋ kɛŋ nɛsɩŋ nɛ ba yiyel, piesee ma nɩna hɛɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa yaŋ tuo dɩ ba dii.

english_verse: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ mɩɩ yɩrɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa nyiniŋ dii pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee kala nɛ, nyiŋgeliŋ lieri tɩɩsɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
translation_verse: Bagɩlaa ma paala yele pɩpɩŋ nɛ, a chɩchɛ lɩɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa fuonuŋ kala hʋa nɛ, nyiniŋ dii yaŋ kala.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
translation_verse: Má ŋmʋʋ banyile Zaayɔŋ lɛ. Má ŋmoo doworo mɩ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ, má chichel, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA tapʋlɩɩ-la ka kɔ nɛ. Ʋ kpaga nɛ.

english_verse: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa biriŋ lim tapʋlɩɩ, duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa jaŋ tɔ dɩ leriŋ biri. A nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ sɩ yie guu tɔɔ lɩɩ ŋɩɩ peelee nyuŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoroo sɩ yʋga a kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ jaŋ kɔ. Ba doho ha bɩ kɔ aŋ ka, maachie ma ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ.

english_verse: Fiery flames surround them; no one escapes. Before they invaded, the land was like Eden; now only a desert remains.
translation_verse: Nyiniŋ jaŋ didii ba sɩpaaŋ, dɩ nyiŋgeliŋ ma sisii ba harɩŋ. Ba sɩpaaŋ tintee-la jaŋ nagɛ Ɛdɩŋ ŋmaŋkaa-la, ka ba harɩŋ dɩɩrɩŋ nagɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ kʋŋ sɩ tuo. Kʋŋkala bɩ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ ka fori.

english_verse: They look like horses and charge like cavalry.
translation_verse: Ba nagɛ janɩŋ nɛ, baa fa a nagɛ laalɩŋ janɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.
translation_verse: Ba dɔmɔ nagɛ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba dɔmɔ nɛ. Ba fɩla kikieli peelee nyu-gbaŋa, baa pɔsʋ a nagɛ sekelee sɩ hɛ nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ba nagɛ laalɩyuori duoruŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The very sight of them is frightening.
translation_verse: Dɩ tinteyee nɩaa nɛ naba, ba tʋɔŋ kala yie vʋgʋmɛ nɛ, ba sɩaa biri.

english_verse: They climb over walls like warriors; they march in columns and never turn aside.
translation_verse: Ba yie sii tʋɔrɛ a nagɛ bayuoroo nɛ, a fɩlaa kieli jeyee lɛ a nagɛ laalɩyuoroo. Ba kala yie kɩɛlɛ nɛ a vɩvɛŋ, ba bɩ gɛbɛ.

english_verse: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ dɔŋɔba ka gɛrɛ, ba kʋŋkala yie vɩvɛŋ nɛ tegi tegi. Ba yie yuo jʋʋ laalɩyuoroo tʋɔŋ, ka wɩɩkala bɩ ba wuo kɛrɛ.

english_verse: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.
translation_verse: Ba yie fá mʋ tabal-la lɛ, a jɩl ʋ jeeŋ a jʋʋ ʋ tʋɔŋ. Ba yie to tokoroba a jʋʋ dɩɩsɩŋ a nagɛ gaaraa.

english_verse: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɩɩ kɔ, tinteeŋ yie zigili nɛ, wɩa-nyuŋ ma dʋdɔŋ, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ chɛnɛ ma yie biri, chɛnwʋlaa ma bɩra bɩ chaanɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA kpɩa ʋ laalɩyuoroo lɛ nɛ. Ʋ laalɩyuoroo bɩ nii kɛnɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ʋ niiŋ ŋaa nɩduoru nɛ. La TƖƖNA tapʋlɩɩ-la ŋaa tapʋl-bal nɛ a kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ woruŋ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo nyalɩmɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la? Má bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ

english_verse: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Lɛɛlɛ, má mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ arɩ ma tʋɔŋ kala, a vɔɔ niiŋ aŋ pɛ faasa yiyel.”

english_verse: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ chei aŋ sɩ́ ma gɛnnɩŋ nɛ kɩɛsʋ. Má mɩɩra kɔ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ zile, a fɩfá nɩaa nenige. Ʋ baanɩŋ bɩ lɩma lɩma ka sii, aŋ cho nɩaa ma woruŋ. Ʋ yie kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ joŋ wɩaa chɛla nɛ bʋa na-kala a bɩ chɛ ʋ dɔgɩsɛla.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jɩma? Ʋ jaŋ wuo joŋ ʋ baanɩŋ ta aŋ fá ma nisusuŋ a joŋ kʋ-daŋ pɛ ma lɛ, dɩ ma kaa ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
translation_verse: Má ŋmʋʋ banyile Zaayɔŋ lɛ, má leŋ dɩ ba vɔɔ nii-la sɩ zɔmɔ Wɩa teeŋ, má hilimi Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ chɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la zawʋra arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la pɛgɛ a yiyel. Má leŋ dɩ ba bʋl, “La TƖƖNA, laa sʋlʋŋ, joŋo chɛ ŋ nɩaa. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa ŋaa mɔmɩa, dɩ tinteyee nɩaa sisieri ba lɛ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ tinteyee nɩaa pɩɛsɛ arɩ nɩɩ nɛ ba Wɩa hɛ.” Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla

english_verse: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA yaraa jaŋ bieri ʋ tinteeŋ wɩaa, dɩ ʋ fá ʋ nɩaa nisusuŋ.

english_verse: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ mɩɩra bʋla pɩba: “Mɩ jaŋ pɩma mɩaa, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ, dɩ ba yʋgɛ woruŋ dɩ ma dii vɔgɛ. Mɩ maachie bɩra bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa mɔmɩa a pɩ tinteyee nɩaa.

english_verse: An army attacked from the north, but I will chase it into a scorching desert. There it will rot and stink from the Dead Sea to the Mediterranean.” The Lord works wonders
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kiri wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa laalɩyuoroo dɩ ba mʋ dɩ-bolii a sɩ́ ma kpagʋ, a yigiba hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ sɩ bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ lɛ. Ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ sɩpaaŋ jaŋ mʋ jʋʋ mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mʋgʋ-sʋʋŋ, ka nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ harɩŋ mʋ jʋʋ Mediterenia mʋgʋ-bal-la. Ba sʋɔra jaŋ laa leriŋ kala. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, La TƖƖNA ŋaa wʋbalaa nɛ a pɩla.”

english_verse: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
translation_verse: Bagɩlaa, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma, tintee-hɩlɩŋ bɩra suomo nyʋnyʋ yaŋ nɛ. Tɩɩsɩŋ ka nɛŋ nɛ, tutogusuŋ arɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bɩra faasa nɩnɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ nɩaa, má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, má jʋjʋɔsɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ pɩma duoŋ-puso ŋɩɩ sɩ maga nɛ. Ʋ chaasa pɩma duonuŋ nɛ, duoŋ-puso arɩ yibiiŋ duonuŋ kala, arɩ ʋ fa sɩ vɛnɛ pɩpɩma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Tahɩŋ jaŋ bɩra su arɩ mɩaa. Pupo-balaa jaŋ bɩra su arɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bɩra pɩma kɩalɩŋ kala hɔbɔ sɩ die, kɩalɩŋ hɔbɩ-balɩŋ arɩ hɔbɩ-biisiŋ sɩ die, a pɛ hɔbɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ lɛ arɩ hɔbɩ-laal-la, mɩ laalɩyuori duoru-la mɩ fa sɩ joŋo hɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ kɛŋ kʋdiilee yʋgɛ, a dii vɔgɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma dɛnnɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa pɩma. Hɩɩsɩŋ maachie bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, a hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ, nʋʋ dɔŋ kala tuo a pɛ mɩ lɛ. Hɩɩsɩŋ maachie bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ nɩaa. La TƖƖNA tapʋlʋŋ

english_verse: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ Dɩma hɛ nʋʋkala lɛ. Ma hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ma hantolibiisiŋ jaŋ bʋbʋl wɩaa mɩ doluŋ lɛ, ma nɩhɩasɩŋ ma jaŋ duduosi duosoo, ma bapʋɔsaa ma jaŋ nɩna wɩaa a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ Dɩma hɛ mɩ tɩntɩnnaa lɛ, baalaa arɩ haalaa kala, bʋa-la lɛ.

english_verse: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ lɛ. Chalɩŋ jaŋ jaasɛ, dɩ nyiniŋ didii, dɩ nyʋɔsʋŋ tɔ a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.
translation_verse: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ jaŋ biri, dɩ chɛnɛ fɩɛsɛ a nagɛ chalɩŋ, ka dɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA tapʋl-bal-la sɩ faasa kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ-na kɔ.

english_verse: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ laaʋ ta, bɛɛ wɩaa, Zaayɔŋ peel-la arɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ laatanɩŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ. Ba nɛ ŋaa nɩkaana-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsa.

english_verse: At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa mɩɩra lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ.

english_verse: Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tinteyee kala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ, a kɛmba kʋ tuu fuonaa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jehosafat. Nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ diiba sarɩya, a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ, nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa mɩ nɩaa pɩsa hɛ tinteyee lɛ nɛ a kɛŋ mɩ tinteeŋ kpaa.

english_verse: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
translation_verse: Ba tɔnsɔ nɛ a lɩɩsɛ mɩ nɩaa a joŋ ba hambolibiisiŋ yallɛ dɩ ba kaa ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, a yallɛ ba hantolibiisiŋ a laa moribiee dɩ ba kaa nyʋnyʋa sɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
translation_verse: Taaya, Sɩdɔŋ arɩ tasɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ, lɛɛlɛ wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma kaa chɩŋ mɩ lɛ? Mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ nɛ ma lɛ maa chɛ ma ŋaa timmii? Dɩ wɩɩ nɛ mɩ ŋaa ma lɛ, maa chɛ ma ŋaa timmi, mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra leŋ dɩ wɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ chɛ ma ŋaa mɩ lɛ guu ŋaa ma lɛ lɩma lɩma.

english_verse: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
translation_verse: Ma paa mɩ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ, mɩ dʋa-la sɩ zɔmɔ a kaa mʋ ma vesiŋ dɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
translation_verse: Ma yallɛ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa pɩ Giriik tɩŋŋaa nɛ, dɩ ma leŋ dɩ ba mʋ dɩ-bolii a kagɛ ba tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.
translation_verse: Má bee na, mɩ jaŋ kɛmba lɩɩ lere-la ma sɩ yallɛba hɛ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wɩɩ-la ma sɩ ŋaa ba lɛ a timma.

english_verse: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ yallɛ ma hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ma hantolibiisiŋ a pɩ Juda nɩaa, dɩ ba ma laa yalla pɩ Sabɩa nɩaa sɩ hɛ tintee-la sɩ bolie lɛ.” Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: Má heele bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ tinteyee tʋɔŋ: Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a yuo laalɩŋ. Má leŋ dɩ bayuoroo nyɩgɩlɛ. Má leŋ dɩ bayuoro-la kala kʋ kpagɛ a yuo.

english_verse: Make swords out of plows and spears out of garden tools. Strengthen every weakling.”
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma pirisiŋ libi tokobiee a kɛŋ ma sɩɩkɔrʋsʋŋ ma libi tiŋŋee. Má leŋ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ bʋl, “Mɩ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Hurry, all you nations! Come quickly. Ask the Lord to bring his warriors along.
translation_verse: Tinteyee kala, má lɩɩ sɛmɛ na-kala a kɔ lɩma, a hilimi fuonaa-la lɛ. La TƖƖNA, leŋ dɩ ŋ laalɩyuoroo kʋ tuu.

english_verse: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ sɩɩkɔrɔ viisi, kɩaa bɩa nɛ a magɛ kʋmʋŋ. Má kɔ a nʋɔsɛ girep nɛnɛɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa, bʋa-tuo-la lɛ ba sɩɩ chagɛ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ suo nɛ, ba pupoyee ma su a lɩɩ tɩta. Nɩalɩŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chaasa yʋgɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Crowds fill Decision Valley. The judgment day of the Lord will soon be here—
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ, nɩ-daŋ nɛ hɛ fuonaa-la lɛ ʋ sɩɩ dii sarɩya. La TƖƖNA tapʋlʋŋ kpaga nɛ dɩ ʋ dii sarɩya nɩmɛ.

english_verse: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.
translation_verse: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ chɛnɛ jaŋ biri, dɩ chɛnwʋlaa ma sɩ́ chaanʋ.

english_verse: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ chaŋ Zaayɔŋ lɛ, a hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ aŋ kpɩa goŋ. Tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ jaŋ jigisi. Ama La TƖƖNA jaŋ tɔ hɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ-duo a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa hɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ. Jerusalɛm jaŋ ŋaa lee sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Nɩwogusuŋ maachie kala bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba tɔʋ hɛ.

english_verse: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ jaŋ lɩlɩɩ peelee lɛ, dɩ dundolluŋ ma pɩpɛllɛ arɩ nɛ-yɩlɩŋ. Lɩɩŋ jaŋ pɩpɛllɛ Juda fuonaa luŋie-la kala lɛ. Fuoŋ jaŋ pɛllɛ lɩlɩɩ La TƖƖNA dɩa lɛ a mʋ jʋjʋʋ fuonaa-la sɩ kɛŋ sɔjaamaa.

english_verse: Egypt and Edom were cruel and brutal to Judah, without a reason. Now their countries will become a barren desert,
translation_verse: Ama Ijipiti jaŋ pɩŋ hoi, dɩ Ɛdɔm ma nagɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ sɩ bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ, a tɩŋ dol-la ba sɩ die Juda nɩaa lɛ, a kpʋ nɩaa sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Amɔs sɩ na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ a bʋla tɩgɛ Iziral lɛ nɛ ŋ-la. Amɔs fa ŋaa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛkʋa pie-daaraa dɔŋɔ nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Uzia nɛ ŋaa Juda tinteeŋ kuoro, ka Jerobuam nanʋala Jehuas ma ŋaa Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro. Ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ, jɩsɩŋ balɩa nɛ bala ka tinteeŋ-na zigili.

english_verse: and I said: When the Lord roars from Jerusalem, pasturelands and Mount Carmel dry up and turn brown. Judgment on Syria
