translation_verse: Amɔs fa bʋla: “La TƖƖNA jaŋ tʋɔra lɩɩ Zaayɔŋ lɛ, a dɔmɔ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Piesee dɩ-diilee yaŋ kala jaŋ hɩl, dɩ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kamɛl ma nyuŋ yaŋ hɩl.” La Tɩɩna jaŋ dii tinteye-la sɩ kpagɛ Iziral sarɩya

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Damasɩkʋs nɩaa, a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋ dandaŋ-la wɩaa. Ba nɛ ŋmoo Gɩlɩad tɩŋŋaa a nagɛ ba sɩɩ ŋmoo mɩaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ dɩ ʋ dii kuoro Hazɛɛl dɩa a joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ dɩ ʋ dii kuoro Bɛŋ-Hadad ma dɩɩ-duoruŋ.

english_verse: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋmoo Damasɩkʋs boi-baalɩŋ lo, aŋ chei nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Avɛŋ fuonaaŋ lɛ , a chei nɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ beŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf Ɛdɛŋ. Ba jaŋ yuo kɛsɛ Siiria tɩŋŋaa a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga Kɩɩ tinteeŋ.” La Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl: “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Gaza nɩaa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋ dandaŋ-la wɩaa. Ba kɛsɛ ta-pilimee nɩaa nɛ a yalla pɩ Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa ba ŋaa yosi.

english_verse: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ dɩ ʋ dii Gaza jeyee arɩ ʋ dɩɩ-duoruŋ.”

english_verse: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra bʋla, “Mɩ jaŋ chei taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩdɔd nɩaa arɩ nɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ beŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩkɛlɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛkʋrɔŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ halɩɩ, dɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa nɩkaana-la sʋʋ dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Taaya nɩaa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋ dandaŋ-la wɩaa. Ba kɛsɛ ta-pilimee nɩaa nɛ a yalla pɩ Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa ba ŋaa yosi, aŋ bɩ naambii nii-la sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ kaa tɩŋ.

english_verse: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyiniŋ a hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Taaya jeyee lɛ, dɩ ʋ dii ʋ dɩɩ-duoruŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Ɛdɔm nɩaa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋ dandaŋ-la wɩaa. Ba baanɩŋ sɩ sie a faasa hosi, ba bɩ wuo kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa aŋ kire to kpʋ ba naambiiriŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa a bɩ ba nenige fá.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ dɩ ʋ dii tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛmaŋ arɩ Bozira dɩɩ-duoruŋ kala.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Amɔŋ nɩaa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋ dandaŋ-la wɩaa. Ba sɩɩ yuo laalɩŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ ba tinteeŋ bʋa jallɛ pɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛsɛ Gɩlɩad tɩŋŋaa hapuugoo a kpɛrɛ chaarɛ ba biiriŋ ta.”

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ dɩ ʋ dii taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Raba jeyee arɩ ʋ dɩɩ-duoruŋ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ ŋaa laalɩyuoru goŋ, aŋ tɔba hɛ a nagɛ pel-vinvilimiŋ a yuoba.”

english_verse: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna sɩ, “Ba jaŋ kɛŋ ba kuoro arɩ ʋ nɩhɩasɩŋ kala kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Mʋab nɩaa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋ dandaŋ-la wɩaa. Ba nɛ nyɩgɛ Ɛdɔm kuoro haŋgbelee ba bɩrɩmɛ tʋɔrʋŋ.”

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyiniŋ a hɛ Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ dii taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɛrɩɔf dɩɩ-duoruŋ. Laalɩyuoroo jaŋ ŋmʋʋ banyilliŋ aŋ ŋɩŋaa laalɩyuori goŋ, ka dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Mʋab lɛ sʋsʋʋ.”

english_verse: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ chei Mʋab tinteeŋ kuoro aŋ kpʋ ʋ nɩhɩasɩŋ kala.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Juda nɩaa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋ dandaŋ-la wɩaa. Ba vɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛba nɛ, ba bɩ mɩ niiŋ sɛyɛ. Ba leŋe wʋnyɩɛrɩ vesi-la ba naabalɩmaba fa sɩɩ kpaarʋ kɛmba yeŋŋi nɛ.

english_verse: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyiniŋ hɛ Juda lɛ dɩ ʋ dii Jerusalɛm dɩɩ-duoruŋ.” La Tɩɩna jaŋ dii Iziral tɩŋŋaa sarɩya

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Iziral nɩaa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋ dandaŋ-la wɩaa. Ba kɛsɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa yallɛ moribiee nɛ, aŋ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ a yallɛ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ yalɩŋ.

english_verse: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ summoo jɩla tutuu nɛ aŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ gɩɩgaa ta. Ba chei mɩ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa nyɩmmaba arɩ biiriŋ pɛ ha-bala nɛ a kaa pɩpɩŋ.

english_verse: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
translation_verse: Gɛnnɩ-la ma nɩaa sɩ joŋo bil chɩŋŋaa bʋa lɛ nɛ ba kaa jɛrɛ pɩpɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru na-kala bʋbʋɔŋ, aŋ kɛŋ ba sɩ keri chɩŋŋaa pɩ nɩaa ba tiŋ moribie-la, a yɔɔ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ nyʋnyʋa ba vene dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa fa hɛ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ka ma-na jʋʋ nɩmɛ. Ba fa duomo nɛ woruŋ a nagɛ kuolu tɩɩsɩŋ a kɛŋ doluŋ ma a nagɛ piine tɩɩsɩŋ, ka mɩ chei ba nɛnɛɛ arɩ ba naapoloo kala.

english_verse: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, a kɛmma gɔllɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa a joŋ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ pɩma.

english_verse: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ lɩɩsɛ ma dɔnsʋŋ ma ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa, ma dɔnsʋŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ma tɩtɩa pɩmɛ baa yɩrɛ Nazarɩ tɩŋŋaa. Iziral tɩmma, wɩɩŋ deeŋ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋaa? Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
translation_verse: Ama ma pɔ dɩ mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ́ mɩ wɩaa bʋl nɛ, aŋ fʋgɛ Nazarɩ tɩŋŋaa hɛ ba nyʋnyʋa sɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ nyagɛma bil tinteeŋ dɩ ma ŋmʋʋrɛ, a nagɛ mɩaa sɩ su toruko a nyagʋ ŋmʋʋrɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ naaduoruŋ, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo fá lɛl. Dɩ ma kɛŋ doluŋ ma, ʋ jaŋ dɛrɛ, laalɩyuoru ma bɩ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ wuo yuo laa.

english_verse: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma paala cho ma jɩŋ toŋ yuonuŋ a magɛ ŋɩɩ ma kala, ma jaŋ mɩɩra fá. Laalɩyuoro naaŋ sɩ lɩma bɩ jaŋ wuo fá laa ʋ tɩtɩa, ma paala cho ma jɩŋ jaaba jɩlɩŋ a magɛ ŋɩɩ ma kala, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo fá laa ma mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la ma laalɩyuori bɔɩ-duo tɩŋŋaa jaŋ joŋ ba kɩaa ta aŋ fá arɩ yarɩ-biree. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ma lɛ, ma tintee-la kala nɩaa ʋ sɩ kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ,

english_verse: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Tinteye-la kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, ma dʋndʋŋa nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: Can two people walk together without agreeing to meet?
translation_verse: Nɩaa balɩa jaŋ wuo to dɔŋɔ dɩ ba niiŋ nɛ bɩ kʋbala ŋaa?

english_verse: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
translation_verse: Naachigiŋ jaŋ huhuosi duuŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ ʋ kʋdiiliŋ naa? Ʋ jaŋ hʋhʋʋnɛ ʋ dɩpɩnɩŋ dɩ kʋŋ dee ʋ kaa didii?

english_verse: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
translation_verse: Bɛrɛ́ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ diibie tinteeŋ lee-la ba sɩ bɩ bɛrɛ́ hɛɛ? Bɛrɛ́ jaŋ wuo yuo, dɩ kʋŋ dee bɩ nʋɔsa dɩ ʋ kɛnʋ?

english_verse: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ wuo ŋmʋʋ laalɩŋ banyile taŋ lɛ ka fawʋllʋŋ bɩ nɩaa ka kɛŋ? Wʋlɔrʋŋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa taŋ lɛ, dɩ mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna dee bɩ kaa kɔ?

english_verse: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ na-kala mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ma ŋaa, mɩ yie leŋ mɩ tɩntɩnna-la sɩ ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa jɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
translation_verse: Dɩ naachigiŋ nɛ huoso, kʋbɛɛ nɛ fawʋllʋŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ? Dɩ mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋl wɩaa, nʋʋkala bɩ wɩalɩŋ wuo laa tɔrɔ.

english_verse: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
translation_verse: Amɔs, heele bʋla pɩ Asɩdɔd sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Ijipiti sɩpaalaaraa-la, ‘Má kala kʋ hilimi Samarɩa peele-la nyuŋ, a na wɩaa sɩ faasa vʋgʋmɛ ŋɩɩ nɩmɛ arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa.’

english_verse: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
translation_verse: Ba paala bɩ wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ ŋaanɩŋ jɩŋ. Yuosuŋ nɛ ba yuo a gurigo laa nɩaa kɩaa a su ba dɩɩ-duoruŋ.

english_verse: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kʋ golli ba tinteeŋ chu, a chei ba dɩ-duoruŋ kala aŋ jʋʋ paa dʋa-la sɩ hɛ ba dɩɩ-duoruŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ La Tɩɩna bɩra bʋl: “Ŋ jɩŋ pie-daara sɩ lorigo laa piese naasɩŋ haŋgbelee balɩa koo dɩgɩlɩŋ naachigiŋ niiŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba jaŋ lorigo laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Samarɩa lɛ a hɔŋ kɩaa tɩŋŋaa kʋpɩnaa niipinee lɛ arɩ kumpuŋŋuba nyuŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ, “Má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa Jekɔb doho nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ tɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa a dɔgɩsɛba, mɩ jaŋ chei Wɩɩsʋllɩ korunu-la sɩ hɛ Bɛtɛl lɛ. Koru na-kala gʋnaa jaŋ boro tel tinteeŋ.

english_verse: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋmoo dɩɩsɩ-la ba sɩ saa yɩ-biiniŋ arɩ tafaaŋ a lo. Dɩɩsɩ-la kala ba sɩ kɛŋ batu-nyɩlaa kpɩɛrɛ arɩ dɩɩ-bala-la, mɩ jaŋ chei ba kala. Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ ŋmɩɛsa nɛ mɩ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ lɛ: Bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi dɩ ba kɛŋ gbɩamba kɛsɛma a nagɛ ba sɩ yie kɛŋ chenfilee ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛmma lɛrɛ to ma taŋ jeye-la bʋɔsʋŋ a lɩɩ to Hamɔŋ tinteeŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Come to Bethel and Gilgal. Sin all you want! Offer sacrifices the next morning and bring a tenth of your crops on the third day.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ, “Ma-na Iziral tɩŋŋaa, má mʋ Bɛtɛl arɩ Gɩlɩgal a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, a fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a vɩvɩa mɩ niiŋ, ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ka chʋɔrʋ nɛ. Má kpʋ pʋsʋŋ sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ chʋchʋa na-kala, a kɛŋ ma kɩaa kpaa leree fii jɩsɩŋ batori na-kala a joŋ kʋbala pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
translation_verse: Má nyɩgɛ boroboro-la sɩ kɛŋ sɩbʋrʋŋ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a kɛŋ ma tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa ma sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ aŋ ŋmoo ma bɔɩsɩŋ lɛ. Wʋbɔmɔ-la ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ cho dɩ maa ŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ leŋe losuŋ jʋʋ ma tabalaa arɩ ma tabiisiŋ kala, ka ma ha vɩamɛ. Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ ka chɛnsɩŋ batori ka dɩ ma ŋaa ma baga kɩaa, mɩ bɩ leŋe duonuŋ nɩɩ. Bʋa dɔŋɔ lɛ mɩ yie leŋ ʋ nɩɩ taŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ aŋ bɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɩa. Mɩ yie leŋ ʋ nɩɩ baga dɔŋɔ lɛ, aŋ bɩ dɔŋɔ ma lɛ nɩa, ʋ kɩaa kala sʋʋ.

english_verse: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Nɩaa yie lɩɩ tasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ lɛ a baara mʋ taŋ-la sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba nyʋa, aŋ bɩ na nyʋa vʋvɔgɛ. Ka ma ha vɩa dɩ ma mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mɩ leŋe hɩlɩŋ chɩŋ nɛ ma bagɩsɩŋ lɛ, ma ŋmaŋkaanɩŋ arɩ ma girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, ma kʋduuloo kala hɩl. Hɔbɔ dii ma tutogusuŋ arɩ ma olif tɩɩsɩŋ kala, ka ma ha vɩa dɩ ma mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ.”

english_verse: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ, “Mɩ joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ ma lɛ nɛ arɩ mɩ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa lɛ. Mɩ kpʋ ma bapʋɔsaa nɛ laalɩŋ lɛ aŋ leŋ ba kɛsɛ ma janɩŋ, mɩ leŋ sʋʋnʋŋ sʋɔra su ma bugoo kala, ka ma ha vɩa dɩ ma mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mɩ chei ma dɔnsʋŋ arɩ mɩ fa sɩ chei tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sodom arɩ Gomora ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ma fa nagɛ daasɩŋ sɩɩ dii nyiniŋ nɛ, mɩ kɛmma tɩɛrɛ nyiŋ-la lɛ. Ka ma ha vɩa dɩ ma mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Now, Israel, I myself will deal with you. Get ready to face your God!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ dii ma sarɩya nɛ Iziral tɩmma. Má ŋaa siri a cheŋ mɩ-na ma Wɩa.

english_verse: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Má bee na, mɩ nɛ ŋaa peelee arɩ peliŋ, a kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa a dagɛ nuhuobiine. Mɩ nɛ yie ŋaa taŋ biri, aŋ vɩvɛŋ peelee nyuŋ. Mɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ ma Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.”

english_verse: Listen, nation of Israel, to my mournful message:
translation_verse: Ma Iziral tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ jembii-la mɩ-na Amɔs sɩ ta a tɩgɛ ma lɛ:

english_verse: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.
translation_verse: “Iziral tɩmma, ma tele nɛ a bɩra bɩ wuo sii, ba vɩama ta nɛ ma pɩŋ ma tɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ, nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ kɛmma dɩ ma sii.”

english_verse: The Lord keeps saying, “Israel, turn back to me and you will live!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɩra bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, “Má chɛmɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ,

english_verse: Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel or even to Beersheba. Gilgal will be dragged away, and Bethel will end up as nothing.”
translation_verse: má sɩ́ Bɛtɛl mʋ a chɩchɛmɛ, a sɩ́ Gɩlɩgal ma mʋ chɩchɛ dɩ ma namɛ nɩmɛ, a sɩ́ Bɛɛsɩba ma mʋ. Ba jaŋ kɛsɛ Gɩlɩgal nɩaa mʋ dɩ ba ŋaa yosi. Bɛtɛl ma jaŋ kʋ ŋaa kʋpɛɩ.”

english_verse: Turn back to the Lord, you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.
translation_verse: Má chɛ La Tɩɩna, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ jaŋ nagɛ nyiniŋ a kʋ joŋ Josɛf doho nɩaa kala dii, ka nʋʋkala jaŋ tuo Bɛtɛl lɛ sɩ jaŋ dɩsɛ nyiŋ-la.

english_verse: You people are doomed! You twist the truth and trample on justice.
translation_verse: Ma yie kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ bɩrɩmɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ, aŋ gʋrɛ nɩalɩŋ kɩaa sɩ sɩma.

english_verse: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa chɛnwʋlaa a leŋ ba chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ birimiŋ a bɩrɩmɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ, a bɩra kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ ma a bɩrɩmɛ birimiŋ. Ʋ nɛ yie leŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ bɩrɩmɛ duonuŋ a nɩɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses. Choose Good Instead of Evil! The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ chei laalɩyuori babiibalaa arɩ ba dɩ-duoruŋ, a leŋ taŋ-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: you abuse the poor and demand heavy taxes from them. You have built expensive homes, but you won't enjoy them; you have planted vineyards, but you will get no wine.
translation_verse: Ma kɛŋ summoo jɩlaa tuu nɛ a fʋgaa laa ba mɩaa. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma saa dɩɩ-balaa ma nɛ, ama ma bɩ jaŋ jʋʋba a nɩɩ sɩma. Ma pɛrɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ nɛ, ama ma bɩ jaŋ nyʋa ba sɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and I know your terrible sins. You cheat honest people and take bribes; you rob the poor of justice.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ma wʋcheelee arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ yʋga magɛ nɛ. Ma gʋrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a laa kpalaa, a pɔ dɩ summoo sɩ́ kʋsɩŋŋaa laa sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ.

english_verse: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, bʋa deeŋ lɛ wɩaa sɩ lɔrɔ ŋ-la, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ ʋ niiŋ.

english_verse: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, má ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ arɩ ma sɩ sɩ ʋ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people. Judgment Is Coming
translation_verse: Má bɛrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, aŋ cho wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, a leŋ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ chaasa chɩŋ ma sarɩya dɩ-diilee. Kapo La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ fá ma Josɛf doho nɩkaanaa nenige.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has sworn: Noisy crying will be heard in every town and street. Even farmers will be told to mourn for the dead, together with those who are paid to mourn.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ma jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ baa ŋmoo niiŋ womporunuŋ arɩ bilii kala lɛ. Ba jaŋ paala yɩrɛ paaraa dɩ ba kʋ pɛ gɔgɔɔ lɛ dɩ ba yel kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord, have spoken! When the Lord Judges
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ yele su girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ kala. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ ŋaa a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ jaŋ kʋ dɔgɩsɛma wɩaa. Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.” Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya

english_verse: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
translation_verse: Maa gbɛrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ jaŋ kʋ dii nɩaa sarɩya nɛ, ama tapʋlɩɩ-la jaŋ lɔrɔ pɩma. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ maa gbɛrɛ La TƖƖNA tapʋlɩɩ-la? Tapʋlɩɩ-la, leriŋ kala jaŋ biri, pʋlʋmʋŋ jaŋ tuo.

english_verse: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ fá kagɛ naachigiŋ lɛ a mɩɩra mʋ jʋʋ lʋgʋmʋŋ niiŋ, koo a nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ jʋʋ dɩa a joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ tɩgɛ jeeŋ, dɩmɩŋ kaa dɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light. What the Lord Demands
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya, leriŋ jaŋ chaasa biri lim. Pʋlʋmʋŋ mʋa ma bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ bɛrɛ ma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ gbieli-la nɛ, mɩ sɩɩŋ bɩ baa su. Mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ fɩɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ yie hilimi a dɩdɛnnɛmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings or animal sacrifices— not even your very best.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ laa ma kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ma mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Mɩ bɩ pʋŋ-nɛrɛɛ-la ma sɩ yie kpʋ a sʋl nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ma ka chɛ.

english_verse: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.
translation_verse: Má leŋ ma yɩɩlaa goŋ-la, mɩ bɩ jaŋ jegili ma chenni-la ma sɩɩ du.

english_verse: But let justice and fairness flow like a river that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ma wʋtɩtɩɩ nagɛ fuoŋ sɩɩ pɛllʋ, dɩ tʋɔpʋla ma nagɛ fuoŋ lɩɩŋ sɩ bɩ hʋ.

english_verse: Israel, for forty years you wandered in the desert, without bringing offerings or sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma, mɩ sɩ kɛmma gɔllɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa-la, ma bɩ pʋsʋŋ kpʋa a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩmɛ koo a kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kʋ pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Now you will have to carry the two idols you made— Sakkuth, the one you call king, and Kaiwan, the one you built in the shape of a star.
translation_verse: Ma mɛ vesiŋ balɩa nɛ pɩ ma tɩtɩa a kpʋkpaarɛ. Dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Sakuf, kʋ-la ma sɩ kaa yɩrɛ ma kuoro. Dɔŋɔ ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ Kaɩwaŋ, kʋ-la ma sɩ mɛ ʋ nagɛ chɛnwʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: I will force you to march as captives beyond Damascus. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma jaŋ pɛ paa ma vesi-la dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛmma mʋmʋ yoŋ-baga a kieli tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Damasɩkʋs,” La Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ a hɔnɔ ta jɩa arɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Samarɩa peel-la lɛ, wɩɩkala bɩ maa walɩmɛ. Ma Iziral tintee balɩŋ deeŋ sɩpaalaarɩ-duoruŋ nɩaa sɩ yie kɔ ma teeŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ma pɛ ba lɛ, ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: You are cruel, and you forget the coming day of judgment.
translation_verse: Ma yʋ tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya wɩaa nɛ, aŋ leŋ ma wʋŋaalaa lɛrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la kʋʋ kpagɛ.

english_verse: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa aa pɩŋ moribii-balaa kʋpɩnaa nyuŋ, a hɔŋ ma kumpuŋŋuba nyuŋ a kpʋ pie-nɛrɛɛ arɩ nɛ-nɛrɛɛ chɩchaŋ.

english_verse: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.
translation_verse: Ma yie yɩɩ yɩɩl-tɔɔnʋŋ a du chenniŋ hɛ, a yɩɩ yɩɩl-falaa a nagɛ Devit fa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.
translation_verse: Ma yie nyʋnyʋa sɩ-gbaŋ-balaa a tɩtɩsɛ tʋlaalɩɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ, aŋ bɩ Iziral sɩ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ wɩaa ka yel.

english_verse: So you will be the first to be dragged off as captives; your good times will end.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ma nɛ ba jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ kɛsɛ kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga dɩ ma ŋaa yosi. Sɩma-la ma sɩɩ nɩɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ. La TƖƖNA bɛrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa babii-ballɩŋ nɛ

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ ŋmɩɛsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ. La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ: “Ma Jekɔb doho nɩaa, mɩ bɛrɛ ma babii-ballɩɩ-la nɛ, a bɛrɛ ma moribiee dɩɩ-bala-la ma. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ ma tabal-la arɩ ʋ kɩaa kala pɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.”

english_verse: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Amɔs bʋl, “Dɩ ma nɩaa fii nɛ ka a faa dɩa lɛ, ba ma ha jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: As you carry out a corpse to prepare it for burial, your relative in the house will ask, “Are there others?” You will answer, “No!” Then your relative will reply, “Be quiet! Don't dare mention the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ba naambii nɛ paa sʋʋnʋ-la kaa lɩɩ dɩ ʋ nyɩgɛ koo dɩ ʋ hugi, ʋ jaŋ pɩɛsɛ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ ka, ‘Nʋʋ dɔŋ ha hɛ dɩa lɛ a pɛ ŋ lɛɛ?’ Nɩɩ-la jaŋ bʋl, ‘Aɩ,’ Ʋ jaŋ bɩra bʋl, ‘Tɔrɛ ŋ niiŋ, pʋpɔ dɩ ŋ sɩ́ La Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ yɩrʋ.’

english_verse: At the Lord's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Dɩ La Tɩɩna nɛ suri ʋ niiŋ, dɩɩ-balaa arɩ dɩɩ-biisiŋ kala jaŋ tele yɛrɛ muno muno.

english_verse: Horses can't gallop on rocks; oceans can't be plowed. But you have turned justice and fairness into bitter poison.
translation_verse: Janɩŋ ka fá bʋŋ nyuŋ nɛɛ? Ba kɛŋ nɛsɩŋ pɩpɛrɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ nɛɛ? Ama ma-na kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ bɩrɩmɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ, aŋ kɛŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ ma bɩrɩmɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, “We did it on our own.”
translation_verse: Maa jʋɔsʋ nɛ arɩ ma sɩ yuo dii tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lo-Dɛba arɩ Kaanem aŋ ŋmoo ma bɔyɛ lɛ a bʋl, ‘La tɩtɩa doluŋ nɛ la kaa yuo diiba.’ ”

english_verse: But the Lord God All-Powerful will send a nation to attack you people of Israel. They will capture Lebo-Hamath in the north, Arabah Creek in the south, and everything in between.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ yigi tintee kʋbala ma hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ. Ba jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma a chɩŋ Lebo Hamaf sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ Araba fuonaaŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ joŋo dagɛmɛ a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ na dɩ ʋ leŋe hɔbɩ-laalɩŋ kʋ dii baga kɩaa. Ba kɔ bʋa-la lɛ kuoro sɩ ŋaa ʋ baga kɩaa ka kʋharaa bɩra bɩɩ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord, “Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive?”
translation_verse: Duoso-la tʋɔŋ mɩ na dɩ hɔbɔ-la dii kʋŋ na-kala sɩ ŋaa kʋ-laa tintee-la lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ a bʋl, “La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, joŋo chɛ ŋ nɩaa. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ɛɛ nɛ Jekɔb doho nɩaa jaŋ ŋaa a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ? Ba bɩ wɩɩ maga.”

english_verse: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of Fire
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩrɩmɛ a bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ na bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra sɩ joŋo dagɛmɛ a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ na dɩ ʋ joŋ nyiniŋ dɩ ʋ kaa dɔgɩsɛ ʋ nɩaa. Nyiŋ-la dii mʋgʋ-balɩŋ sɩ faasa luŋ arɩ kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of a Measuring Line
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩrɩmɛ a bʋl, “Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɩra leŋ mɩ na wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ: Mɩ na La Tɩɩna chɩŋ jeeŋ sɛmɛ a kori ŋmɛŋ-la dɩɩ-saaraa sɩ kaa magɩsɛ jeeŋ a sɩsaa.

english_verse: Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A measuring line,” I answered. The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Amɔs, bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ na?” Mɩ bʋl, “Ŋmɛnɩŋ ba sɩ kaa magɩsɛ jeeŋ a sɩsaa nɛ.” La Tɩɩna bʋl, “Bee na, mɩ kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-la a mɩmagɩsɛ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛba.

english_verse: Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.” Amos and Amaziah
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chei ba vʋɩ-kpaarɛ lere-la kala, dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ laalɩŋ dii Jerobuam doho nʋʋ na-kala sɩ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ.” Amɔs arɩ Amazɩa

english_verse: Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara sɩ hɛ Bɛtɛl lɛ baa yɩrɛ Amazɩa, tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jerobuam, “Amɔs ka chei ŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Iziral nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ʋ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa jaŋ chei la tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Here is what he is saying: ‘Jeroboam will be put to death, and the people will be taken to a foreign country.’ ”
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Amɔs sɩɩ bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Jerobuam jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, ka dɩ ba kɛsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga a kagɛ ba tinteeŋ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Then Amaziah told me, “Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Amazɩa bʋla pɩ Amɔs ma, “Wɩa sɩɩ-naara, kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ na a kaa lɩɩ daha. Mɩɩra mʋ Juda tinteeŋ a bʋl ŋ Wɩa wɩaa nɩmɛ, aŋ laa ŋ time.

english_verse: Don't do any more preaching at Bethel. The king worships here at our national temple.”
translation_verse: Bɩra sɩ́ Wɩa wɩaa bʋl Bɛtɛl lɛ. Daha nɛ kuoro chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa, daha nɛ la tinteeŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ hɛ.”

english_verse: I answered: I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees.
translation_verse: Amɔs bʋla pɩ Amazɩa, “Mɩ bɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ ŋaa, mɩ bɩra bɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ bii ma ŋaa, ama mɩ ŋaa pie-daarʋ nɛ, aŋ pɛ bibeŋ tutogusuŋ.

english_verse: But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ pie-daalɩŋ lɛ a bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Mʋ bʋl mɩ wɩaa a pɩ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa.’

english_verse: Now, listen to what the Lord says about you: Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, your sons and daughters will be killed in war, and your land will be divided among others. You will die in a country of foreigners, and the people of Israel will be dragged from their homeland.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ: ‘Ŋ haala jaŋ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ ma tabalɩŋ lɛ, ka ba kpʋ ŋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ŋ toloo ma laalɩŋ lɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ŋ tinteeŋ kpaa dɔŋɔ. Ŋ ma tɩtɩa jaŋ sʋʋ tintee-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to lɛ. Ka dɩ ba kɛsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala lɩɩ ba tinteeŋ lɛ a mʋ yoŋ-baga.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God showed me a basket of ripe fruit
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ joŋo dagɛmɛ arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Tɩɩ-nɛŋ bɩɩlaa sɩ hɛ sime tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: and asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A basket of ripe fruit,” I replied. Then he said, “This is the end for my people Israel. I won't forgive them again.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Amɔs, bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ na?” Mɩ bʋl, “Mɩ na tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩ bɩa nɛ a hɛ sime tʋɔŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa bʋa-la yie nɛ, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛba.

english_verse: Instead of singing in the temple, they will cry and weep. Dead bodies will be everywhere. So keep silent! I, the Lord, have spoken!” Israel Is Doomed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yɩɩla-la ba sɩ yie yɩɩ mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la ba jaŋ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ yele, dɩ ba ŋmoo niiŋ a yel. Nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ sʋʋ a su leriŋ kala dɩ leriŋ ŋaa fʋɩɩ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: You say to yourselves, “How much longer before the end of the New Moon Festival? When will the Sabbath be over? Our wheat is ready, and we want to sell it now. We can't wait to cheat and charge high prices for the grain we sell. We will use dishonest scales
translation_verse: Ma yie pɩɛsɛ ma tɩtɩa, ‘Chɛ bɛɛ nɛ chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele jaŋ bal ka dɩ la yallɛ mɩaa? Chɛɛ bɛɛ nɛ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ jaŋ bal ka dɩ la kɛŋ mɩaa gbaŋa muuri, a hɛ kɩaa yalɩŋ, a kɛŋ sanɩaba-la sɩ bɩ zɔŋ a magɩsa gʋrɛ nɩaa?

english_verse: and mix dust in the grain. Those who are needy and poor don't have any money. We will make them our slaves for the price of a pair of sandals.”
translation_verse: La jaŋ wuo joŋ mɩɩ-hagɩla a yallɛ yal-haaŋ, a yɔɔ summo-la sɩ bɩ ba chɩŋŋaa wuo tiŋ dɩ ba ŋaa la yosi, dɩ ba chɩmɩŋ nɛ paala bɩ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ yalɩŋ yie ma.’ ”

english_verse: I, the Lord, won't forget any of this, though you take great pride in your ancestor Jacob.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ma Jekɔb doho nɩaa sɩ kaa ŋmoo bɔyɛ hɛ niiŋ a bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ yʋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa kʋŋkala.

english_verse: Your country will tremble, and you will mourn. It will be like the Nile River that rises and overflows, then sinks back down.
translation_verse: Ma tinteeŋ jaŋ zigili a tɩŋ ma wʋŋaalaa wɩaa, dɩ ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ yel. Tintee-la kala jaŋ sii aŋ bɩra tuu pɩŋ a nagɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Naayɩl fa sɩ sii ŋɩɩ aŋ bɩra tuu pɩŋ.”

english_verse: On that day, I, the Lord God, will make the sun go down at noon, and I will turn daylight into darkness.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ, “Tapʋlɩɩ-la, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ jʋʋ, dɩ leriŋ kala biri lim wɩɩhɛyɛ.

english_verse: Your festivals and joyful singing will turn into sorrow. You will wear sackcloth and shave your heads, as you would at the death of your only son. It will be a horrible day.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ gbielee kala bɩrɩmɛ yoho. Ma yɩɩlaa ma kala jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ yele. Ma jaŋ laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ aŋ fʋŋ ma nyusuŋ a nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ lʋl ʋ hambolibii-bala ʋ sʋʋ ʋ yiyel. Tapʋlɩɩ-la dɩdɛrɩŋ jaŋ lɔrɛ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, also promise you a terrible shortage, but not of food and water. You will hunger and thirst to hear my message.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra bʋla, “Bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ losuŋ jʋʋ ma tinteeŋ. Ʋ bɩ naga kʋdiilee nɛ jaŋ nyaa koo lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ nɛ jaŋ kɛmma, ama ma jaŋ cho dɩ ma nɩɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa, aŋ bɩ jaŋ nɩɩ.

english_verse: You will search everywhere— from north to south, from east to west. You will go all over the earth, seeking a message from me, the Lord. But you won't find one.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ gɔllɛ lee-kala, a chɩchɛ dɩ ma nɩɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa, a chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a mʋmʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a gɔllɛ tinteeŋ kala, ama ma bɩ jaŋ nɩɩ.

english_verse: Your beautiful young women and your young men will faint from thirst.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ jaŋ kɛŋ ma hatol-zɔmɔ-la arɩ ma bapʋɔsɩ duoruŋ dɩ ba yiegi.

english_verse: You made promises to the goddess Ashimah at Samaria; you made vows to other gods at the shrines of Dan and Beersheba. So now you will fall and never get up.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ta niiŋ Samarɩa koo Daŋ koo Bɛɛsɩba tinteeŋ vesiŋ lɛ, jaŋ tel a bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo sii.”

english_verse: I saw a vision of the Lord standing by the temple altar, and he said, “Shake the columns until the tops fall loose, and the doorposts crumble. Then make the pieces fall on the people below. I will take a sword and kill anyone who escapes.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Amɔs na La Tɩɩna arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ sɛmɛ, aŋ bʋl, “Faasa ŋmoo Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la jebiee nyuŋ-gbaŋa lɛ dɩ ba gentisiŋ jigisi a giri tele tɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tʋɔŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka, mɩ jaŋ kpʋba laalɩŋ lɛ. Ba kʋbala ma bɩ jaŋ fá. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ fori.

english_verse: “If they dig deep into the earth or climb to the sky, I'll reach out and get them.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ tɔɔ jʋʋ tinteeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ ma, mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛ lɩɩsɛba. Dɩ ba nɛ jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii ma, mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛba lɩɩ nɩmɛ kʋ tuu.

english_verse: If they escape to the peaks of Mount Carmel, I'll search and find them. And if they hide from me at the bottom of the ocean, I'll command a sea monster to bite them.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ jɩla faa peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kamɛl nyuŋ, mɩ jaŋ chɛ kɛsɛba. Dɩ ba bɩra faa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ dɩ mɩ sɩ́ ba na ma, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ kataha sɩ hɛ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ dɩmba.

english_verse: I'll send a sword to kill them, wherever their enemies drag them off as captives. I'm determined to hurt them, not to help them.” His Name Is the Lord
translation_verse: Dɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ yuo kɛsɛba kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga ma, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kpʋba nɩmɛ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ sɩaa pɛsɛ ba lɛ a ŋaaba wʋbɔŋ, wʋzɔŋ dee.”

english_verse: When the Lord God All-Powerful touches the earth, it melts, and its people mourn. God makes the earth rise and then fall, just like the Nile River.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ digi tinteeŋ, ʋ yie zigili nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ yel. Wɩa ŋaa tinteeŋ kala sii nɛ aŋ bɩra tuu pɩŋ a nagɛ Naayɩl fuo-la fa sɩ sii ŋɩɩ aŋ tuu pɩŋ.

english_verse: He built his palace in the heavens and let its foundations rest on the earth. He scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth. His name is the Lord. The Lord Is God
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna saa ʋ kuoru dɩa Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ aŋ leŋ ʋ gentine hɛ tinteeŋ. Ʋ leŋe mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ sii jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ a bɩrɩmɛ duonuŋ a nɩɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: Israel, I am the Lord God, and the Ethiopians are no less important to me than you are. I brought you out of Egypt, but I also brought the Philistines from Crete and the Arameans from Kir.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bʋla, “Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa nɩfɩɛma ŋɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Kus tɩŋŋaa ma nagɛ. Mɩ nɛ kɛmma lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ nɛ ha kɛŋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa ma kʋ lɩɩ Keriti tinteeŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ Siiria tɩŋŋaa ma a kaa kʋ lɩɩ Kɛɛ tinteeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: My eyes have seen what a sinful nation you are, and I'll wipe you out. But I will leave a few of Jacob's descendants. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bɩra bʋla, “Mɩ sɩɩŋ na ma Iziral tinteeŋ deeŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa ŋɩɩ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kpʋ ma Jekɔb doho nɩaa dɩ ma lɛl dʋnɩa lɛ aŋ ka mʋa. Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: At my command, all of you will be sifted like grain. Israelites who remain faithful will be scattered among the nations. And the others will be trapped like trash in a sifter.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ pa wombiiŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa a chɩgɩsɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ joŋ mɩaa hɛ chese lɛ a chesi. Mɩ jaŋ chesima tinteyee tʋɔŋ a lɩɩsɛ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa nɩyaayasɩŋ a ta.

english_verse: Some of you are evil, and you deny that you will ever get caught. But you will be killed. The Lord's Promise to Israel
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋ ŋaara-la sɩ hɛ mɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ a bʋl, ‘Wʋlɔrʋ kala bɩ jaŋ jʋʋla koo a puula,’ ba jaŋ kpʋba laalɩŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ wasa saa Iziral

english_verse: In the future, I will rebuild David's fallen kingdom. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again, just as it used to be.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ mɩ jaŋ wasa saa kuoro Devit dɩa-la sɩ tele a pɩŋ jikpeeŋ dɩ ʋ nagɛ ʋ fa sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ wasa saa lere-la kala sɩ cheye.

english_verse: Then you will capture Edom and the other nations that are mine. I, the Lord, have spoken, and my words will come true.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩra wuo yuo kɛsɛ Ɛdɔm nɩkaana-la arɩ tinteye-la fa sɩ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.” La Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa deemba.

english_verse: You will have such a harvest that you won't be able to bring in all of your wheat before plowing time. You will have grapes left over from season to season; your fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɩra bʋla, “Bʋa kʋbala ka kɔ nɛ, ma bagɩsɩŋ kɩaa jaŋ wasɛ kɩŋkɛŋ. Ma bɩ jaŋ wuo kʋŋ ma mɩaa kala kɔ dɩa ka dɩ pɛrɩŋ bɩra yi. Ma bɩ jaŋ wuo tɔrɛ ma girep nɛnɛɛ dɛrɛ, ka dɩ ba tɔrʋŋ bɩra yi. Ma peelee arɩ dundolluŋ jaŋ tɔ arɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ dɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ pʋrɩgɛ.

english_verse: I'll make Israel prosper again. You will rebuild your towns and live in them. You will drink wine from your own vineyards and eat the fruit you grow.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa mɩɩra lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ. Ba jaŋ paa ba tasɩ-la sɩ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ saa a jʋjʋʋ. Ba jaŋ pɛrɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ a nyʋnyʋa ba sɩnɩŋ. Ba jaŋ pɛrɛ bagɩsɩŋ, a dii ba kɩaa.

english_verse: I'll plant your roots deep in the land I have given you, and you won't ever be uprooted again. I, the Lord God, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa naapoloo chaasa jʋʋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩba. Nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo churiba a kaa mʋ wuu. Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The Lord God gave Obadiah a message about Edom, and this is what we heard: “I, the Lord, have sent a messenger with orders for the nations to attack Edom.”
translation_verse: Obadaaya sɩ na wɩalɩŋ duosoo tʋɔŋ. La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ bʋl wɩaa tɩgɛ Ɛdɔm nɩaa lɛ. La nɩɩ tɩndaarɩŋ nɛ, ʋ lɩɩ la TƖƖNA teeŋ nɛ. Ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tɩndaara dɩ ʋ bʋla pɩ tinteyee nɩaa, “Má sii dɩ la mʋ yuo Ɛdɔm nɩaa.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Edom: I will make you the weakest and most despised nation.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Ɛdɔm, “Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ŋ muuri tinteyee kala tʋɔŋ. Ba jaŋ bee gʋʋnʋŋ.

english_verse: You live in a mountain fortress, because your pride makes you feel safe from attack, but you are mistaken.
translation_verse: Ŋ babii-ballɩŋ nyɩsɩŋ nɛ, ŋ sɩ hɔŋ bʋŋ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋ dɩa hɛ peelee nyuŋ dɩ-bolii, ŋ bʋl ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo sorimi kʋ tʋʋ tinteeŋ?’

english_verse: I will still bring you down, even if you fly higher than an eagle or nest among the stars. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ file jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ a nagɛ kachuuŋ ma, dɩ ŋ dɩa hɛ chɛnwʋlaa tʋɔŋ, mɩ jaŋ lɛrɩŋ lɩɩ nɩmɛ kʋ tuu. Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: If thieves break in at night, they steal only what they want. And people who harvest grapes always leave some unpicked. But, Edom, you are doomed!
translation_verse: Dɩ gaaraa nɛ kɔ ŋ dɩa tɩtaŋɩŋ, bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ba yie ŋaa? Ba yie gaa kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ cho nɛ. Dɩ girep tɩɩ-nɛŋ tɔrʋrɔɔ nɛ kɔ ŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ tʋɔŋ, ba yie tɔrɛ aŋ ka mʋa nɛ.

english_verse: Everything you treasure most will be taken from you.
translation_verse: Ama, ba jaŋ gbille paa Ɛsɔ dʋa kala, kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ faa.

english_verse: Your allies can't be trusted. They will force you out of your own country. And your best friends will trick and trap you, even before you know it.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩŋŋaa jaŋ kiriŋ ta ŋ tinteeŋ lɛ, ŋ nandɔnsʋŋ jaŋ nyɩsɩŋ a yuo diiŋ, ŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ gbaara didii kɩaa jaŋ dɩdaa dɩ ba kɛnɩŋ, ama ŋ bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ.”

english_verse: Warriors from the city of Teman will be terrified, and you descendants of Esau will be wiped out. The Lord Condemns Edom's Cruelty
translation_verse: Tɛmaŋ nɩaa, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ faasa jʋʋ ma laalɩyuori duoruŋ, ka dɩ ba kpʋ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ nɩaa kala.

english_verse: You were cruel to your relatives, the descendants of Jacob. Now you will be destroyed, disgraced forever.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ ŋ naambie Jekɔb yuo yuosuŋ wɩaa, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ diiŋ. Ba jaŋ cheyiŋ ta a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: You stood there and watched as foreigners entered Jerusalem and took what they wanted. In fact, you were no better than those foreigners.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la fa sɩ maga dɩ ŋ pɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, ŋ chɩna ta jɩa nɛ aŋ ka ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kʋ fʋga jʋʋ ʋ boi-baalaa a chʋŋ ʋ dʋa kala, a kaa kpaa dɔŋɔ. Ŋ ma fa nagɛ ba dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Why did you celebrate when such a dreadful disaster struck your relatives? Why were you so pleased when everyone in Judah was suffering?
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bɩ maga ŋ bee gʋʋnɛ ŋ naambie tapʋlɩɩ-la wɩaa sɩ jʋʋ, koo dɩ ŋ jʋjʋɔsɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ chei Juda nɩaa koo ŋ sisieri ba lɛ a tɩŋ wɩaa sɩ jʋʋba.

english_verse: They are my people, and you were cruel to them. You went through their towns, sneering and stealing whatever was left.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bɩ maga dɩ ŋ to mɩ nɩaa boi-baalaa jʋʋ ba taŋ bʋa-la lɛ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ sɩ jʋʋba koo ŋ bee gʋʋnɛba koo ŋ fʋga laa ba kɩaa a tɩŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ sɩ jʋʋba wɩaa.

english_verse: In their time of torment, you ambushed refugees and handed them over to their attackers. The Lord Will Judge the Nations
translation_verse: Ŋ fa bɩ maga dɩ ŋ kɛrɛ wombiee lɛ a kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ faa lɛl ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, koo a kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka a bɩra kaa mʋ pɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tapʋlɩɩ-la wɩaa sɩ jʋʋba.

english_verse: The day is coming when I, the Lord, will judge the nations. And, Edom, you will pay in full for what you have done.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna tapʋlɩɩ-la kpaga nɛ dɩ mɩ dɔgɩsɛ tinteyee nɩaa kala. Ɛdɔm, wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa ba tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa ŋ lɛ, ŋ wʋŋaalaa kala jaŋ gʋra nyʋa ŋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I forced the people of Judah to drink the wine of my anger on my sacred mountain. Soon the neighboring nations must drink their fill— then vanish without a trace. Victory for Israel
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa sɩ faasa na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ peel-zɔŋ-la nyuŋ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ tinteye-la kala nɩaa ma jaŋ faasa na hɛɛŋ a mʋ lɛl.

english_verse: The Lord's people who escape will go to Mount Zion, and it will be holy. Then Jacob's descendants will capture the land of those who took their land.
translation_verse: Ama Zaayɔŋ peel-la nyuŋ nɛ laatanɩŋ jaŋ hɛ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa lee sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, dɩ Jekɔb doho nɩaa tɩɩ ʋ dʋa kala.

english_verse: Israel will be a fire, and Edom will be straw going up in flames. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Jekɔb doho nɩaa jaŋ nagɛ nyiniŋ, dɩ Josɛf doho nɩaa ma nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ, a joŋ Ɛsɔ doho nɩaa sɩ nagɛ ya-hɩlɩŋ dii. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ ka Ɛsɔ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: The people of Israel who live in the Southern Desert will take the land of Edom. Those who live in the hills will capture Philistia, Ephraim, and Samaria. And the tribe of Benjamin will conquer Gilead.
translation_verse: Nɛgɛf nɩaa jaŋ laa Ɛsɔ tinteeŋ tɩɩ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peeliŋ bʋbʋɔŋ ma laa Fɩlɩsɩtɩa nɩaa tinteeŋ. Ba jaŋ laa Efirem arɩ Samarɩa tinteeŋ, ka dɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ ma tɩɩ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Those who return from captivity will control Phoenicia as far as Zarephath. Captives from Jerusalem who were taken to Sepharad will capture the towns of the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ mʋ yoŋ-baga jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ ba tinteeŋ, a laa tintee-la kala a kaa mʋ yi Zarɛfaf tinteeŋ. Jerusalɛm nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga sɩ kʋ hɛ Sɛfarad tinteeŋ lɛ jaŋ laa Nɛgɛf tasɩŋ kala tɩɩ.

english_verse: Those the Lord has saved will live on Mount Zion and rule over Edom. Then the kingdom will belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɩduoruŋ jaŋ lɩɩ Zaayɔŋ peel-la lɛ a yuo dii Ɛsɔ doho nɩaa a bibemba, dɩ kuorii-la ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋŋ.”

english_verse: One day the Lord told Jonah, the son of Amittai,
translation_verse: Wɩa bʋl wɩaa pɩ Amɩta nanʋala Jona. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, “The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed!”
translation_verse: “Sii mʋ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nɩnɩvɛ a bʋl wɩaa chagɩlɛba a mʋ tɩgɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ. Mɩ na ba wʋbɔmɔ-la nɛ.”

english_verse: Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord. He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.
translation_verse: Jona vɩa Wɩa niiŋ aŋ mɩɩra fá mʋmʋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Taasɩs. Ʋ sɩ mʋ yi Jopa, ʋ na lɩɩŋ daboro sɩɩ mʋ nɩmɛ. Ʋ tiŋ moribiiŋ aŋ jʋʋ, dɩ ʋ duoro mʋ Taasɩs a fá lɛl La TƖƖNA teeŋ.

english_verse: But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ pel-bal lu mʋgʋ-bal-la lɛ. Lɩɩ-pel-bal sii a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ yɛrɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la.

english_verse: The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter. All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ fawʋllʋŋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tɩntɩnnaa kala. Nʋʋkala bunso pɩpɩ ʋ vene. Ba chaarɛ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ a hɛ mʋgʋ-bal-la lɛ, dɩ daboro-la bɩra sɩ́ yuŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Jona-na tuu lɩɩŋ daboro-la bʋbʋɔŋ a pɩŋ doŋ a yuo naaŋ.

english_verse: The ship's captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.”
translation_verse: Daboro-la kʋhɩaŋ tuu pɩɛsʋ, “Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo pɩŋ doŋ ŋ-la? Ŋ ma sii bunso pɩ ŋ vene, kapo ʋ jaŋ nɩɩ a fá la nenige dɩ la sɩ́ sʋʋ.”

english_verse: Finally, the sailors got together and said, “Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble.” It turned out to be Jonah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tɩntɩnnaa bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ, “Má leŋ dɩ la tɔnsɔ na nɩɩ-la sɩ leŋe wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ puula.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tɔnsɛ, ʋ kɛŋ Jona.

english_verse: They started asking him, “Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people?”
translation_verse: Ba pɩɛsʋ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ maga la nyaŋ? Tɩntɩŋ bɛɛ nɛ ŋ tɩtɩŋ? Tabɛɛ nɛ ŋ lɩɩ? Tintee bɛɛ nɛ ŋ lɩɩ? Do bɛɛ nʋʋ nɛ ŋ ŋaa? Dagɛla.”

english_verse: Jonah answered, “I'm a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jona bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ ŋaa Hiburu tɩɩna nɛ, mɩɩ chʋɔlɛ mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ, mʋgʋ-balɩŋ arɩ tinteeŋ.”

english_verse: When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord. Then they said, “Do you know what you have done?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jona bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ fáa lɛl La TƖƖNA teeŋ nɛ.” Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba kɩŋkɛŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ ŋaa ŋ-la?”

english_verse: The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, “What should we do with you to make the sea calm down?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ lɩɩ-pel-la faasa nyɛsɛ. Ba pɩɛsʋ, “Ɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaaŋ dɩ lɩɩ-peliŋ deeŋ sigile pɩla?”

english_verse: Jonah told them, “Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.”
translation_verse: Jona bʋl, “Má jommi yuo hɛ lɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ, dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, pel-la jaŋ sigili. Mɩ jɩma mɩ nɛ tɩɩ lɩɩ-pel-balɩŋ deeŋ kɔ ma lɛ.”

english_verse: The sailors tried their best to row to the shore. But they could not do it, and the storm kept getting worse every minute.
translation_verse: Ba vɩa dɩ ba joŋu yuo hɛ mʋgʋ-bal-la tʋɔŋ aŋ nɩnɛrɩgɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la mɩɩra mʋ yi dundolo. Ba walɩma lɔl, bɛɛ wɩaa lɩɩ-pel-la pʋŋaa pɛ nɛ.

english_verse: So they prayed to the Lord, “Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bunso pɩ La TƖƖNA, “Ou, La TƖƖNA, jaaŋ jaaŋ, joŋo chɛla la sɩɩ chɛ dɩ la kpʋ baala deeŋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye. Sɩ́ la dɔgɩsʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ cho nɛ.”

english_verse: Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka ba joŋ Jona yuo hɛ mʋgʋ-bal-la lɛ, lɩɩ-pel-la guu sigili.

english_verse: The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-pel-la sɩ guu sigili ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ faasa fá La TƖƖNA. Ba kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA aŋ ta niiree ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord sent a big fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ joŋ Jona yuo hɛ mʋgʋ-bal-la tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA leŋ chenfil-bal joŋ Jona liŋ, ʋ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa batori, wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala.

english_verse: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:
translation_verse: Jona hɛ chenfilii-la tʋɔŋ nɛ aŋ dɩdɛnnɛ ʋ TƖƖNA Wɩa.

english_verse: When I was in trouble, Lord, I prayed to you, and you listened to me. From deep in the world of the dead, I begged for your help, and you answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Wɩaa sɩ jʋʋmɛ, mɩ bunso pɩ mɩ Tɩɩna nɛ, ʋ nɩɩ a lɩɩsɛmɛ sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: You threw me down to the bottom of the sea. The water was churning all around; I was completely covered by your mighty waves.
translation_verse: Ŋ jommi yuo hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ mɩ tuu bʋbʋɔŋ, lɩɩŋ tɔ mɩ kala, lɩɩ-pel-balaa ma to mɩ nyuŋ bɩbal.

english_verse: I thought I was swept away from your sight, never again to see your holy temple.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa bɩɩna ŋ kirimi ta nɛ ŋ sɩpaaŋ, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ na ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I was almost drowned by the swirling waters that surrounded me. Seaweed had wrapped around my head.
translation_verse: Lɩɩŋ tɔ mɩ kala nɛ a nagɛ ʋʋ chɛ ʋ kpʋmɛ, mɩ tuu bʋbʋɔŋ, fuo-chalba bɛ mɩ nyuŋ.

english_verse: I had sunk down deep below the mountains beneath the sea. I knew that forever, I would be a prisoner there. But, you, Lord God, rescued me from that pit.
translation_verse: Mɩ tuu yi peele-la sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, ba nyagɛmɛ kpɛrɛ, dɩ mɩ bɩra sɩ́ lɩɩ. Ama mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, ŋ ha laa mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ pɩmɛ nɛ sʋʋŋ-bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: When my life was slipping away, I remembered you— and in your holy temple you heard my prayer.
translation_verse: Mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ fa sɩɩ dɛrʋ, mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩ liise yi ŋ lɛ nɛ a sʋlʋŋ, mɩ sʋla-la mʋ yiŋ, ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ.

english_verse: All who worship worthless idols turn from the God who offers them mercy.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to vʋɩyaa sɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩba harɩŋ, bɩ Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ jaŋ jʋʋ.

english_verse: But with shouts of praise, I will offer a sacrifice to you, my Lord. I will keep my promise, because you are the one with power to save.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɩŋ, aŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩŋ. Mɩ sɩ hɛ niire-la kala, mɩ jaŋ chaarɛba. La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa Laataara.”

english_verse: The Lord commanded the fish to vomit up Jonah on the shore. And it did.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA ŋaa chenfil-bal-la lusi Jona a bil dundolo nyuŋ.

english_verse: Once again the Lord told Jonah
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ Jona lɩamɩŋ lɛ,

english_verse: to go to that great city of Nineveh and preach his message of doom.
translation_verse: “Mʋ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nɩnɩvɛ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ.”

english_verse: Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jona sɛɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ a mʋ Nɩnɩvɛ. Nɩnɩvɛ fa jalɩa nɛ woruŋ. Tapʋlaa batori nɛ ŋ jaŋ joŋo lɩɩ sɛmpɛɛŋ dɔŋɔ a mʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: After walking for a day, Jonah warned the people, “Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jona jʋʋ taŋ-la. Chɛ-bumbuŋ-la ʋ sɩ jʋa, ʋ heele bʋl, “Ʋ ka tapʋlaa mahɩŋ balɩa aŋ ka dɩ Wɩa chei Nɩnɩvɛ kala.”

english_verse: They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, Nɩnɩvɛ nɩaa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sɩ dɩ nʋʋkala vɔɔ niiŋ, nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ hambiisiŋ kala a laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust.
translation_verse: Duoso-la sɩ yi Nɩnɩvɛ kuoro, ʋ sii ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ, a wuri ʋ kuoru gɛnnɩŋ aŋ ma laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ, a hɔŋ bumbugo lɛ.

english_verse: When God saw that the people had stopped doing evil things, he had pity and did not destroy them as he had planned.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ na dɩ ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ, a leŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ, ʋ fá ba nenige, ʋ bɩ ba kpʋa arɩ ʋ fa sɩ bɩɩnɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jonah was really upset and angry.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jona tʋɔŋ faasa chei ʋ na baanɩŋ.

english_verse: So he prayed: Our Lord, I knew from the very beginning that you wouldn't destroy Nineveh. That's why I left my own country and headed for Spain. You are a kind and merciful God, and you are very patient. You always show love, and you don't like to punish anyone.
translation_verse: Ʋ sʋl La TƖƖNA, “Ou, mɩ TƖƖNA, ŋ-la dee mɩ bʋl mɩ fa ha sɩ hɛ mɩ jaŋ lɛɛ? Ŋ-la wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ fa fá lɩma lɩma a mʋmʋ Taasɩs ŋɩɩ. Mɩ jɩma ŋ ŋaa Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ zile a fɩfá nɩaa nenige nɛ. Ŋ baanɩŋ bɩ lɩma lɩma ka sii. Ŋ cho nɩaa ma woruŋ aŋ ŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ cho ʋ joŋ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa nʋʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Now let me die! I'd be better off dead.
translation_verse: Ou, mɩ TƖƖNA, lɛɛlɛ laa mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ yaara sʋʋ, ʋ nɛ kpɩa mɩ sɩ weye.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “What right do you have to be angry?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ kɛŋ wombiiŋ ŋ sɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ?”

english_verse: Jonah then left through the east gate of the city and made a shelter to protect himself from the sun. He sat under the shelter, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jona lɩɩ tabal-la lɛ, a mʋ hɔŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Ʋ mʋ hɛ palɩŋ nɛ nɩmɛ a hɔŋ fɩɛlɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ na wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa tabal-la nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord made a vine grow up to shade Jonah's head and protect him from the sun. Jonah was very happy to have the vine,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa leŋ tɩa nyʋ a pɩ Jona fɩɛlɩŋ, dɩ ʋ hɔŋ a sɩ́ hɛɛŋ na. Jona tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ tɩa-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: During the day the Lord sent a scorching wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah's head, making him feel faint. Jonah was ready to die, and he shouted, “I wish I were dead!”
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ pɔsɔ, Wɩa leŋ pel-lɩmɩŋ arɩ wɩɩ-lɩmɩŋ kpʋ Jona nyuŋ, ʋʋ chɛ ʋ yiegi a cho dɩ ʋ sʋba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ yaara sʋʋ, ʋ nɛ kpɩa mɩ sɩ weye.”

english_verse: But the Lord asked, “Jonah, do you have the right to be angry about the vine?” “Yes, I do,” he answered, “and I'm angry enough to die.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa pɩɛsɛ Jona, “Ŋ kɛŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ŋ na baanɩŋ tɩa-la wɩaa?” Jona bʋl, “Oo, baanɩŋ paala kɛmmɛ a magɛ mɩ sʋʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: But the Lord said: You are concerned about a vine that you did not plant or take care of, a vine that grew up in one night and died the next.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pʋ, “Tɩa-la ŋ sɩ bɩ chɔnsɔ, a bɩ bene ʋ waa, ʋ wɩaa nɛ fɩɛsɛ ŋ sɩɩŋ. Ʋ nyʋ chɛ-bala nɛ a sʋʋ chɛ-bala ma.

english_verse: I am Micah from Moresheth. And this is the message about Samaria and Jerusalem that the Lord gave to me when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah. Judgment on Samaria
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ Mɩka sɩ lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔrɛsɛf, bʋa-la lɛ nɩaa deemba sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ: Jotam, Ahas arɩ Hezikaaya. Mɩka fa na wɩaa arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ nɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Samarɩa arɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: And he will come down to crush underfoot every pagan altar.
translation_verse: Má bee na, La TƖƖNA lɩɩ ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ a kʋkɔ nɛ, ʋ kʋʋ tuu nɛ dɩ ʋ vɛŋ peelee nyuŋ.

english_verse: Mountains will melt beneath his feet like wax beside a fire. Valleys will vanish like water rushing down a ravine.
translation_verse: Peelee jaŋ yʋɔlɛ ʋ naasɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ, a nagɛ keliŋ sɩ kpagɛ nyiniŋ a ŋmɩɛrɛ. Fuo-naasɩŋ ma jaŋ pɩsɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ pɛllɛ lɩɩ dundolo nyuŋ tutuu.

english_verse: This will happen because of the terrible sins of Israel, the descendants of Jacob. Samaria has led Israel to sin, and pagan altars at Jerusalem have made Judah sin.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa a tɩŋ Jekɔb doho nɩaa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ vɩa Wɩa aŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ba jaŋ dɔŋ a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa? Samarɩa sɩ ŋaa ba tabalɩŋ dee? Nɩɩ nɛ Juda nɩaa vʋɩ-kpaarɛ leree hɛ? Jerusalɛm sɩ ŋaa ba tabalɩŋ lɛ dee?

english_verse: So the Lord will leave Samaria in ruins— merely an empty field where vineyards are planted. He will scatter its stones and destroy its foundations.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Samarɩa pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a ŋaa pʋlʋŋ-jaala, lee ba sɩ jaŋ bil girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga. Mɩ jaŋ paa ʋ tabɩa-la sɩ tele daŋ dɔŋɔ tuu fuonaaŋ aŋ ka dɩ ʋ gentine nyɩɩsɛ.

english_verse: Samaria's idols will be smashed, and the wages of temple prostitutes will be destroyed by fire. Silver and gold from those idols will then be used by foreigners as payment for prostitutes. Judah Is Doomed
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋmoo tɔmɔ-la kala ʋ sɩ cho yɛrɛ muno muno, aŋ nyɩgɛ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ joŋo dii zile a bil vene dɩa lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ chei Samarɩa tɔŋŋɔɔ kala. Ba kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa nɛ a ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ a na kɩaa. Ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ma jaŋ paa kɩalɩŋ kaa mʋ tiŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa aa ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ.” Mɩka yele a ŋmoo niiŋ

english_verse: Because of this tragedy, I go barefoot and naked. My crying and weeping sound like howling wolves or ostriches.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Mɩka jaŋ tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa a yel a ŋmoo niiŋ, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ naabirimee arɩ yarɩ-biree a gɔllɛ. Mɩ jaŋ gɔllɔ yel a nagɛ jolo, a huuni a nagɛ hajaaŋkuŋkuŋ,

english_verse: Depart naked and ashamed, you people of Shaphir. The town of Bethezel mourns because no one from Zaanan went out to help.
translation_verse: Má nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Safɩya lɛ, má kɛŋ hɩɩsɩŋ arɩ yarɩ-biree mʋ yoŋ-baga. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaanaŋ lɛ, má sɩ́ dɩ-jalɩŋ lɩɩ. Bɛf Ɛzɛl tɩŋŋaa ka yel nɛ, lee tuo ma sɩ jaŋ yuori.

english_verse: Get the war chariots ready, you people of Lachish. You led Jerusalem into sin, just as Israel did.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lakɩs lɛ, má paa laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba hɛ janɩŋ. Ma nɛ suomo ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Jerusalɛm nɩaa na, bɛɛ wɩaa ma wʋbɔmɔ-la nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa chesi ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Now you will have to give a going-away gift to Moresheth. Israel's kings will discover that they cannot trust the town of Achzib.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa Juda tɩmma, má sal taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔrɛsɛf Gaf a lɩɩ pa. Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Akɩzɩb ka nyɩsɛ Iziral kuoroo nɛ.

english_verse: People of Mareshah, the Lord will send someone to capture your town. Then Israel's glorious king will be forced to hide in Adullam Cave.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ yuo-diiru kʋ hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Marɛsa lɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ mʋ faa Adulam bʋ-bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: Judah, shave your head as bald as a vulture and start mourning. Your precious children will be dragged off to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Juda tɩmma, má fʋŋ nyu-kpelliŋ aŋ yel ma bii-chooloo lɛ. Má kɛŋ nyu-kpelliŋ a nagɛ duuŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jaŋ kɛsɛ ma biiriŋ mʋ yoŋ-baga.

english_verse: Doomed! You're doomed! At night you lie in bed, making evil plans. And when morning comes, you do what you've planned because you have the power.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ vʋʋrɛ nɩbɔŋ wɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie pɩna bɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a sii folo kɛmba tɩŋ, a tɩŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ba ŋaa wɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: You grab any field or house that you want; you cheat families out of homes and land.
translation_verse: Ba nɩɩ chɛ nɩaa bagɩsɩŋ, ba yie kaa laa nɛ. Ba nɩɩ chɛ dɩɩsɩŋ ma, ba kaa laa. Ba yie gɩrɩmɛ dɩa tɩɩna a laa ʋ dɩa, a kɛŋ ba dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa kɩaa lɩlaa.

english_verse: But here is what the Lord says: “I am planning trouble for you. Your necks will be caught in a noose, and you will be disgraced in this time of disaster.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩɩ bɩɩnɛ mɩ ŋaa wʋlɔrʋŋ nɛ ma nɩaa deemba lɛ, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo laa ma tɩtɩa. Ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩaa a dagɛ ma tɩtɩa, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la lɛ wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋma.

english_verse: When that happens, this sorrowful song will be sung about you: “Ruined! Completely ruined! The Lord has taken our land and given it to traitors.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɩaa jaŋ sieri ma lɛ, ba jaŋ yɩɩ nisusu yɩɩlɩŋ deeŋ a sieri ma lɛ, ‘La wɩaa chaasa chei nɛ, ba kɛŋ mɩ nɩaa kɩaa kpaa nɛ. La TƖƖNA kaa laa mɩ teeŋ nɛ, a joŋ la bagɩsɩŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yuo diila.’ ”

english_verse: “Enough of your preaching!” That's what you tell me. “We won't be disgraced, so stop preaching!”
translation_verse: Ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Sɩ́ Wɩa wɩaa bʋla pɩla. Sɩ́ Wɩa wɩaa bʋla tɩgɛ wɩaa deemba lɛ, Wɩa bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la dii hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, is it right for you to claim that the Lord did what he did because he was angry? Doesn't he always bless those who do right?
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ bʋla pɩ Jekɔb doho nɩaa arɩ La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ nɛ ba nyuŋ. Ʋʋ ŋaa wʋyiriba-la nɛɛ? Ʋ niiŋ wɩaa bɩ wʋzɔmɔ nɛ ŋaa a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛɛ?”

english_verse: My people, you have turned against one another! You have even stolen clothes right off the backs of innocent neighbors who pass by in peace.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Tapʋlaa deemba, mɩ nɩaa ma sii chɩŋ mɩ lɛ nɛ a nagɛ ba ŋaa mɩ dʋndɔmɔ. Ba wuri nɩaa gɛnnɩŋ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ ta jɩa a kʋʋ bal, nɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ laalɩyuoroo sɩ mʋ laalɩŋ aŋ mɩɩra kʋkɔ.

english_verse: You take over lovely homes that belong to the women of my nation. Then you cheat their children out of the inheritance that comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba kiri mɩ nɩaa haalaa ba lɩɩ dɩɩsɩ-la ba sɩ cho lɛ nɛ. Ba kɛŋ wʋzɔmɔ-la kala mɩ fa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩ ba biiriŋ laa nɛ, a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Get out of here, you crooks! You'll find no rest here. You're not fit to belong to the Lord's people, and you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Má sii viiri, daha tuo ma dɩ-wiesii. Ma wʋŋaalaa leŋe ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, ʋ cheye nɛ, nʋʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo wasʋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together the people of Israel who have survived. I will gather them, just as a shepherd brings sheep together, and there will be many.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Mɩ sɛnɛ jaŋ kɛŋ ma Jekɔb doho nɩaa kala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ, mɩ sɛnɛ jaŋ kɛŋ Iziral nɩkaanaa kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a nagɛ piesee sɩ hɛ pie-dɩa lɛ. Ba jaŋ nagɛ pie-laalɩŋ sɩ hɛ yaŋ dɩ-diiliŋ. Nɩaa jaŋ bɩra su tintee-la.

english_verse: I will break down the gate and lead them out— then I will be their king.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ jaŋ suri wombiiŋ, a laa ba sɩpaaŋ, a kɛmba lɩɩ yoŋ-baga lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa ba kuoro nɛ jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ.”

english_verse: but you prefer to do evil instead of what is right. You skin my people alive. You strip off their flesh,
translation_verse: ama ma bɛrɛ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ aŋ cho wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ma fɩsɛ mɩ nɩaa puruŋ nɛ aŋ ka ba nampɩlɩŋ arɩ ba haŋgbelee.

english_verse: Someday you will beg the Lord to help you, but he will turn away because of your sins.
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi dɩ ma ŋmoo niiŋ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA, ama ʋ jaŋ fʋʋla yagɛma. Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa faama, bɛɛ wɩaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ ma ŋaa.”

english_verse: You lying prophets promise security for anyone who gives you food, but disaster for anyone who refuses to feed you. Here is what the Lord says to you prophets:
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɩ ma ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ aa nyɩsɛ mɩ nɩaa. Dɩ ba nɛ pɩma kʋdiilee, ma yie bʋl, ‘Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ.’ Dɩ ba nɛ bɩ ma kʋŋ pa, ma bʋl arɩ laalɩŋ jaŋ kʋ jʋʋba.

english_verse: But the Lord has filled me with power and his Spirit. I have been given the courage to speak about justice and to tell you people of Israel that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ-na Mɩka, La TƖƖNA joŋ ʋ Dɩma hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ kɛŋ doluŋ, a jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ nɩaa ŋaa a kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ dɩ mɩ dagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ pɩba.

english_verse: So listen to my message, you rulers of Israel! You hate justice and twist the truth.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa, má nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ma bɛrɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ tʋʋla a golibi.

english_verse: You make cruelty and murder a way of life in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ma kpʋ nɩaa nɛ a saa Zaayɔŋ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma, a saa Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: You leaders accept bribes for dishonest decisions. You priests and prophets teach and preach, but only for money. Then you say, “The Lord is on our side. No harm will come to us.”
translation_verse: Ma sɩpaalaara-la yie laa kpalaa nɛ aŋ dii sarɩya, ma Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa yie dagɛ nɩaa Wɩa wombiiŋ aa chɛ time. Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɩ ma ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa yie bʋl wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ na aa laa moribiee. Ka ma ha yie bʋl dɩ ma yelli La TƖƖNA nɛ. Ma yie bʋl, “La TƖƖNA hɛ la teeŋ nɛ, wʋlɔrʋ kala bɩ jaŋ jʋʋla.”

english_verse: And so, because of you, Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ma wɩaa, ba jaŋ pɛrɛ Zaayɔŋ a nagɛ baga. Jerusalɛm jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a nagɛ pupuluŋ. Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ chɩŋ dundolo-la nyuŋ jaŋ lugi a nagɛ duuŋ.

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills, and every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa dɩdɛrɩŋ, La TƖƖNA peel-la nyuŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ chɩna nɛ jaŋ kɩɩ peelee kala. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ sii je kɩɩ dundolo kala, dɩ tinteyee gire mʋ ʋ leriŋ.

english_verse: People of many nations will come and say, “Let's go up to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: Tintee daŋ nɩaa jaŋ kɔ a bʋl, “Má kɔ dɩ la jɩl La TƖƖNA peel-la nyuŋ a mʋ Jekɔb Wɩa dɩa. La TƖƖNA jaŋ dagɛla ʋ wombiee, dɩ la tuto. Wɩa jaŋ dagɛla ʋ wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto a lɩɩ Zaayɔŋ lɛ. La TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa jaŋ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm nɛ.”

english_verse: He will settle arguments between distant and powerful nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never again make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ laa tintee daŋ nɩaa wɩaa jɩma pɩba, a kɛŋ tintee-duoruŋ sɩ hɛ dɩ-boloo arɩ dɩ-kpagɩsɩŋ nɩaa kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba ŋaa sɩma. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ ba tokobiee a libi pirisiŋ, aŋ kɛŋ ba tiŋŋee ma a libi sɩɩ-kɔrʋsʋŋ. Tintee kala bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋ tokobiiŋ a je ʋ dɔŋɔ lɛ, koo a bɩra gʋnnɛ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ.

english_verse: Everyone will find rest beneath their own fig trees or grape vines, and they will live in peace. This is a solemn promise of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala jaŋ hɔŋ ʋ girep tɩa bʋbʋɔŋ a hɔŋ ʋ tutogo bʋbʋɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Others may follow their gods, but we will always follow the Lord our God. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa kala kɛŋ ba vesiŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ vɩvɛŋ. La-na jaŋ kɛŋ La TƖƖNA Wɩa yɩrɩŋ nɛ vɛŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ ŋaa

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will gather my people— the lame and the outcasts, and all others into whose lives I have brought sorrow.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ gbɛrɩgɛɛ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga arɩ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ leŋe ba nɩna hɛɛŋ kʋ hilimi.

english_verse: Then the lame and the outcasts will belong to my people and become a strong nation. I, the Lord, will rule them from Mount Zion forever.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ gbɛrɩgɛ-la kʋkaanaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kire ta ŋaa tintee-duo, dɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA bemba Zaayɔŋ peel-la nyuŋ a chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Jerusalem, why are you crying? Don't you have a king? Have your advisors gone? Are you suffering like a woman in childbirth?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma faasaa ŋmoo niiŋ, ma bɩ kuoro kɛnɛɛ? Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagɛma lɛlɛ nɛ, ka ma nɩna hɛɛŋ a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ lʋl ʋ luoru wʋwɩɩ?

english_verse: Keep on groaning with pain, you people of Jerusalem! If you escape from your city to the countryside, you will still be taken as prisoners to Babylonia. But later I will rescue you from your enemies.
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ nɩaa, maa na hɛɛŋ a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ lʋl ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ lɛɛlɛ maga dɩ ma lɩɩ tabal-la lɛ nɛ a mʋ ŋmoo buguŋ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ. Ma jaŋ mʋ Babɩlɔŋ, nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ laama ta. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ laama ta ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Zion, because of your sins you are surrounded by many nations who say, “We can hardly wait to see you disgraced.”
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ lɛ tinteyee yʋga nɛ, a kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ dɩ ba yuoma. Ba sɩ, ‘Má leŋ dɩ la cheyu, má leŋ dɩ la na dɩ Zaayɔŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.’

english_verse: Smash them to pieces, Zion! I'll let you be like a bull with iron horns and bronze hoofs. Crush those nations and bring their wealth to me, the Lord of the earth.
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ nɩaa, má sii ŋmoo mɩɩ-jagɩsɩ-la, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ hɔɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma naachɩgɩsɩŋ nagɛ kɔlɩɩŋ dɩ ma kaa nʋɔsɛ tintee daŋ nɩaa bʋrɩgɛ. Ma jaŋ laa kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ gɩrɩma laa a kaa kʋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, a joŋ ba dʋa kala pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ tɩɩ dʋnɩa kala.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, enemy troops have surrounded you; they have struck Israel's ruler in the face with a stick.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm tɩmma, má kɛŋ ma laalɩyuoroo hɛ dɔŋɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba golloo yuola nɛ. Ba jaŋ joŋ daaŋ ŋmoo Iziral kuoro chaŋkpaŋɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Bethlehem Ephrath, you are one of the smallest towns in the nation of Judah. But the Lord will choose one of your people to rule the nation— someone whose family goes back to ancient times.
translation_verse: Bɛtɩlɛhɛm Ɛfɩrata, Juda tinteeŋ tasɩŋ kala tʋɔŋ ŋ nɛ muuro. Ama La TƖƖNA sɩ ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ kuoro ŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ Iziral, nɩɩ-la doho nɩaa sɩɩ dii kuoruŋ faafaa kala.

english_verse: Like a shepherd taking care of his sheep, this ruler will lead and care for his people by the power and glorious name of the Lord his God. His people will live securely, and the whole earth will know his true greatness,
translation_verse: Bile jaŋ chaasa chɩŋ a kɛŋ ʋ TƖƖNA Wɩa doluŋ arɩ ʋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ, a beŋ ʋ nɩaa nyuŋ a nagɛ pie-daara sɩɩ beŋ ʋ piesee nyuŋ ŋɩɩ. Ba jaŋ hɔŋ wɩɩkala bɩ baa walɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ballɩŋ jaŋ yi dʋnɩa sɛmɛ kala.

english_verse: because he will bring peace. Assyria Will Be Defeated Let Assyria attack our country and our palaces. We will counterattack, led by a number of rulers
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ laa ʋ nɩaa ta Dɩ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa nɛ kɔ dɩ ba yuo la tinteeŋ a chichei la dɩ-duoruŋ, la jaŋ leŋ la sɩpaalaarɩ duoruŋ baŋmɛnɛ ku lɩɩ yuoba.

english_verse: whose strong army will defeat the nation of Assyria. Yes, our leaders will rescue us, if those Assyrians dare to invade our land. The Survivors Will Be Safe
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ yuo dii Asiiria tinteeŋ, a jaŋ chei Nɩmɩrɔd tintee-la. Ba jaŋ laala ta Asiiria tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba nɛ kʋ jʋʋ la tinteeŋ a yuyuola.

english_verse: A few of Jacob's descendants survived and are scattered among the nations. But the Lord will let them cover the earth like dew and rain that refreshes the soil.
translation_verse: Jekɔb doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka a bɩ sʋba jaŋ guoli nɩ-daŋ tʋɔŋ. Ba jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ a nagɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie leŋ nyalɩŋ nyala hɛ kɩaa lɛ, koo duonuŋ sɩ yie mirise hɛ kɩaa lɛ ba wasɛ ŋɩɩ. Wɩaa deemba kala ka ŋaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ, nuhuobiine doluŋ lɛ dee.

english_verse: At present they are scattered, but later they will attack, as though they were fierce lions pouncing on sheep. Their enemies will be torn to shreds, with no one to save them;
translation_verse: Jekɔb doho nɩkaana-la jaŋ guoli tinteyee nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a hɛ nɩ-daŋ tʋɔŋ, a nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩ guoli baga kɩaa tʋɔŋ duuŋ lɛ. Ba nagɛ naachigi-bie sɩ guoli pie-laalɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a yie fɩla chɩchaalɛba a kɛmba pʋɔsa ta vɩvɛŋ ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ laaba ta.

english_verse: they will be helpless, completely destroyed. Idols Will Be Destroyed in Israel
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa jaŋ yuo dii ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, ma jaŋ chei ma dʋndɔmɔ-la kala. La TƖƖNA jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ ʋ nɩaa

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will wipe out your cavalry and chariots,
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Bʋa-la lɛ, mɩ jaŋ chei ma janɩŋ a chei ma janɩŋ torukoba ma.

english_verse: as well as your cities and your fortresses.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chei tabalaa sɩ hɛ ma tinteeŋ lɛ, aŋ ŋmoo ma dɩ-duoruŋ ma kala lo.

english_verse: I will stop you from telling fortunes and practicing witchcraft.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chei ma hɩl wɩalɩŋ dɩ ma bɩra sɩ́ vʋgʋ.

english_verse: You will no longer worship the idols or stone images you have made— I will destroy them,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chei ma tɔmɔ-la ma sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ saa aŋ yɛrɛ vʋɩyaa tabɩa-la ma sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, dɩ ma bɩra sɩ́ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa sɩpaaŋ kpirimu.

english_verse: I will become furious and take revenge on the nations that refuse to obey me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ baaŋ-la mɩ sɩ faasa na a fɩɩsɛ tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ mɩ niiŋ sɛyɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to his people: Come and present your case to the hills and mountains.
