translation_verse: Ma jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla: “Má sii chɩŋ a bʋl ma wɩɩŋ peelee sɩpaaŋ. Má leŋ dɩ dundolluŋ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ dɩ ma bʋl.

english_verse: Israel, I am bringing charges against you— I call upon the mountains and the earth's firm foundation to be my witnesses.
translation_verse: Peelee, má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ kɛnɛ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Tinteeŋ gentine sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ, ŋ má jegile nɩɩ. La TƖƖNA kɛŋ wɩɩ nɛ arɩ ʋ nɩaa. Ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kɛŋ wɩɩ nɛ.”

english_verse: My people, have I wronged you in any way at all? Please tell me.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ nɩaa, wʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa ma lɛ? Wʋbɛɛba nɛ mɩ joŋo daŋ ma lɛ? Má bʋla pɩmɛ.

english_verse: I rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to be your leaders.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ kɛmma kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, a laama ta ma fa sɩ ŋaa yosu lɛ. Mɩ-na nɛ tɩŋ Mosis, Arɔŋ arɩ Mɩrɩam ba laa ma sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Don't forget the evil plans of King Balak of Moab or what Balaam son of Beor said to him. Remember how I, the Lord, saved you many times on your way from Acacia to Gilgal. True Obedience
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩaa, má liise yi wɩɩ-la Mʋab kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Balak fa sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma lɛ arɩ ŋɩɩ Balam nanʋala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bioo ma fa sɩ bʋla pʋ. Má liise yi ma sɩ vɛnɛ lɩɩ Sɩtɩm a mʋ Gɩlɩgal a wuo jɩŋ tʋɔpʋl wɩalɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: What offering should I bring when I bow down to worship the Lord God Most High? Should I try to please him by sacrificing calves a year old?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ mɩ jaŋ kaa kɔ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a kpirime joŋo pɩ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala? Mɩ kɛŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ-biisiŋ sɩ yi jɩna kɔ ʋ sɩpaaŋ?

english_verse: Will thousands of sheep or rivers of olive oil make God satisfied with me? Should I sacrifice to the Lord my first-born child as payment for my terrible sins?
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ pie-belliŋ bʋɩba nyuŋ koo nʋʋŋ sɩ su fuonuŋ bʋɩ fiiba a pɩpɛllɛ nyuŋ? Mɩ joŋ mɩ hambolibii bumbuŋ, mɩ tɩtɩa bii-lʋlʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋ a tɩŋ mɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa?

english_verse: The Lord God has told us what is right and what he demands: “See that justice is done, let mercy be your first concern, and humbly obey your God.” Cheating and Violence
translation_verse: Aɩ, Wɩa dagɛla wɩɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ. Wʋbɛɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA chɩchɛ dɩ la ŋaa? Ʋʋ chɛ dɩ la kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa, a cho nɩaa, a muuri la tɩtɩa a tuto ʋ wombiiŋ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa cheeriŋ arɩ ba dɔgʋsʋŋ

english_verse: I am the Lord, and you are wise to respect my power to punish. So listen to my message for the city of Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋjɩmɩɩ nɛ dɩ ŋ nɩɩ fá La TƖƖNA. Má jegile nɩɩ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ hilimi tabal-la lɛ, má jegile nɩɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will punish you for cheating with weights and with measures.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ kɩaa woruŋ ka magɩsɛ, a kɛŋ bɔtɔ-balaa koo kʋbiisiŋ a gʋgʋrɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: You rich people are violent, and everyone tells lies.
translation_verse: Ma kɩaa tɩŋŋaa ŋaa yuo-hɛɛrɛ nɛ, a ŋaa wʋnyɩɛra ma. Ma wɩɩŋ nɛ dɩ ma nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: Because of your sins, I will wound you and leave you ruined and defenseless.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ suomo dɩ mɩ cheima nɛ, mɩɩ cheima a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: You will eat, but still be hungry; you will store up goods, but lose everything— I, the Lord, will let it all be captured in war.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ dii aŋ bɩ vɔgɛ, ma luobiee jaŋ wuoli. Ma jaŋ tʋɔlɛ kɩaa aŋ chɛ ka, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba yuo diima aŋ paa kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ tʋɔla viiri.

english_verse: You won't harvest what you plant or use the oil from your olive trees or drink the wine from grapes you grow.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ duu kɩaa aŋ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa kɩalɩŋ, ma jaŋ tugi nʋʋŋ aŋ bɩ nʋʋ-la jaŋ tɩsɛ. Ma jaŋ chagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ aŋ bɩ jaŋ nyʋa,

english_verse: Jerusalem, this will happen because you followed the sinful example of kings Omri and Ahab. Now I will destroy you and your property. Then the people of every nation will make fun and insult you.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ma to kuoro Omiri naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala kuoro Ahab dɩa nɩaa sɩ ŋaa. Ma to ba naabarɩŋ wʋŋaalaa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ cheima, a leŋ dɩ nɩaa kɛmma ŋmoo gbɛɛŋ. Tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ mɔmma.”

english_verse: I feel so empty inside— like someone starving for grapes or figs, after the vines and trees have all been picked clean.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ cheye. Mɩ nagɛ nʋʋ ba sɩ tɔrɛ girep nɛnɛɛ tafaaŋ, ka mɩ mʋ kukuuni tɩɩnɛnɛɛ baga-la lɛ nɛ. Girep nɛŋ kala tuo dɩ mɩ dii, tutogi-nambɩl-folluŋ ma mɩ sɩɩ hɩɛnʋ kʋŋkala tuo.

english_verse: No one is loyal to God; no one does right. Everyone is brutal and eager to deceive everyone else.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fá Wɩa tintee-la lɛ lɛlɛ nɛ, nʋʋkala tuo a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ. Nʋʋkala hu a gbɩgbɛrɛ nɩaa nɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋ. Nʋʋkala ka bagɩlɛ ʋ naambie nɛ.

english_verse: People cooperate to commit crime. Judges and leaders demand bribes, and rulers cheat in court.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala kaasɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ nɛ, sɩpaalaaraa chɩchɛ kʋmɔlɩɩba. Sarɩya diiree lɩlaa kpalaa, nɩalɩŋ dɩchɩnɩŋ sɩ yuŋŋie ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ cho, ba kala vʋʋra hɩhɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The most honest of them is worse than a thorn patch. Your doom has come! Lookouts sound the warning, and everyone panics.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ kʋ-la sɩ kpɩa nagɛ sɔgɩrɩgalɩa nɛ ba tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wɩɩŋ bɔmɔ kɩɩ sɔ-gbuŋgbeŋe sɔsʋŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔma sɩ bʋl tapʋlɩɩ-la wɩaa yie nɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ nɛ ma wɩaa jaŋ vʋgʋmɛ.

english_verse: Don't trust anyone, not even your best friend, and be careful what you say to the one you love.
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ jʋʋ kpɩkpagɛ dɔŋɔ, sɩ́ ʋ laa dii, a sɩ́ ŋ yɩɛlaa joŋo hɛ ŋ nandɔŋɔ lɛ. Nɩɩ-la ma ŋ sɩ paala guoro pɩŋ, jɩŋ ŋ niiŋ kɛnɩŋ ʋ teeŋ,

english_verse: Sons refuse to respect their own fathers, daughters rebel against their own mothers, and daughters-in-law despise their mothers-in-law. Your family is now your enemy.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa hambolibiisiŋ sɩɩŋ bɩ ba nyɩmmaba ka su. Hantolibiisiŋ ma kɛŋ ba naamba yuyuo yuosuŋ, bii-haalaa kɛŋ ba bala naamba yuyuo yuosuŋ. Nuhuobiine dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ŋaa ʋ tɩtɩa dɩa nɩaa.

english_verse: But I trust the Lord God to save me, and I will wait for him to answer my prayer. The Nation Turns to God
translation_verse: Ama mɩ-na, mɩɩ beŋ La TƖƖNA lɛ nɛ a yɩyɩɛlʋ. Mɩ gbɛrɛ Wɩa nɛ, mɩ Laataara, mɩ Wɩa jaŋ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa jaŋ sii

english_verse: My enemies, don't be glad because of my troubles! I may have fallen, but I will get up; I may be sitting in the dark, but the Lord is my light.
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔmɔ, sɩ́ mɩ nyuŋ jʋɔsʋ, mɩ tele ma nɛ, ama mɩ jaŋ sii. Mɩ hɔŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, ama La TƖƖNA nɛ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: I have sinned against the Lord. And so I must endure his anger, until he comes to my defense. But I know that I will see him making things right for me and leading me to the light.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ nyalɩmɛ baaŋ-la ʋ sɩ na mɩ nyuŋ, a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ laa mɩ wɩɩŋ jɩma pɩmɛ a leŋ dɩ mɩ laa kʋsɩŋŋaa. Ʋ jaŋ kɛmmɛ kʋ lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ, dɩ mɩ na ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ laamɛ ta.

english_verse: You, my enemies, said, “The Lord God is helpless.” Now each of you will be disgraced and put to shame. I will see you trampled like mud in the street. A Bright Future
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔmɔ jaŋ na wɩɩ-la dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛnʋ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa hɛ?” Mɩ sɩɩŋ jaŋ na ʋ teliŋ, dɩ ba nʋɔsʋ a nagɛ vʋchɔɔŋ sɩ hɛ womporuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Towns of Judah, the day is coming when your walls will be rebuilt, and your boundaries enlarged.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm nɩaa, tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ jaŋ bɩra paa ma kɛrɩsɩŋ saa ka kɔ nɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ ma jaŋ kɛŋ ma tinteeŋ bʋa jalla pɛ.

english_verse: Those nations will suffer disaster because of what they did. Micah's Prayer and the Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa sɛmɛ-la sɩ ka jaŋ pɩŋ hoi a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Mɩka chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a dɛnnʋ

english_verse: Lead your people, Lord! Come and be our shepherd. Grasslands surround us, but we live in a forest. So lead us to Bashan and Gilead, and let us find pasture as we did long ago.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, beŋ ŋ nɩaa nyuŋ a nagɛ pie-daara sɩɩ beŋ ʋ piesee nyuŋ ŋɩɩ. Ba ŋaa ŋ nɩaa nɛ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa a hɛ duuŋ tʋɔŋ, ya-fɩɛlɩŋ golliba. Leŋ dɩ ba mʋ dii ya-fɩɛl-la sɩ hɛ Basaŋ arɩ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ lɛ a nagɛ ba sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ faafaa-la.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will work miracles just as I did when I led you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa dagɛma a nagɛ bʋa-la mɩ fa sɩ kɛmma kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Nations will see this and be ashamed because of their helpless armies. They will be in shock, unable to speak or hear,
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ na wɩalɩŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmba, arɩ ba sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ ma kala. Ba niiŋ jaŋ maa, ka dɩ ba dɩgɩlaa ma taŋ.

english_verse: because of their fear of me, your Lord and God. Then they will come trembling, crawling out of their fortresses like insects or snakes, lapping up the dust. No One Is Like God The people said:
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ mʋsɛ hagɩla a nagɛ dɩmɩŋ, a nagɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ bɔyɛ tuuri tinteeŋ. Ba jaŋ lɩɩ ba dɩjʋʋlaa lɛ a chichel. Ba jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ a fɩfá La TƖƖNA Wɩa, aŋ fɩfá ma ma.

english_verse: Our God, no one is like you. We are all that is left of your chosen people, and you freely forgive our sin and guilt. You don't stay angry forever; you're glad to have pity
translation_verse: Wɩa, nʋʋkala tuo a nagɩŋ, ŋ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ ŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka a bɩ sʋba wʋcheelee arɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a chɛba. Ŋ bɩ baanɩŋ na didieni, ŋ cho nɩaa nenige fanɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: and pleased to be merciful. You will trample on our sins and throw them in the sea.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ bɩra fá la nenige, ŋ jaŋ nʋɔsa tɔ la wʋcheelee aŋ joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala yuo hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ dɩ-luŋuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You will keep your word and be faithful to Jacob and to Abraham, as you promised our ancestors many years ago.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ Jekɔb teeŋ, a fá Abɩraham doho nɩaa nenige, a nagɛ ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ la naabalɩmaba ŋɩɩ faafaa kala.

english_verse: I am Nahum from Elkosh. And this is the message that I wrote down about Nineveh. The Fierce Anger of the Lord
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Nahum, Ɛlɩkɔs tɩɩna-la fa sɩ na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nɩnɩvɛ lɛ teniŋ nɛ ŋ-la. Wɩa na baanɩŋ Nɩnɩvɛ nɩaa nyuŋ

english_verse: The Lord is powerful, yet patient; he makes sure that the guilty are always punished. He can be seen in storms and in whirlwinds; clouds are the dust from his feet.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ bɩ lɩma lɩma ka sii, ama ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa chei pɛɩ, ʋ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba. Ʋ wombiiŋ hɛ pel-vinvilimiŋ arɩ duoŋ-peliŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, ʋ naasɩŋ bʋmbʋgʋŋ nɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, oceans and rivers dry up. Bashan, Mount Carmel, and Lebanon wither, and their flowers fade.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ kpɩa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ, ʋ yie hʋ nɛ, ʋ yie leŋ fuonuŋ kala hɩl. Basaŋ tinteeŋ arɩ Kamɛl peeliŋ tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ yaŋ kala hɩl, Lɛbanɔŋ tinteeŋ tɩɩfɩɩlaa kala yuori.

english_verse: At the sight of the Lord, mountains and hills tremble and melt; the earth and its people shudder and shake.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩpaaŋ, peelee yie jigisi nɛ, dundolluŋ ma yʋɔlɛ. Tinteeŋ yie zigili, dʋnɩa nɩaa chichel ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Who can stand the heat of his furious anger? It flashes out like fire and shatters stones. The Power of Assyria Will Be Broken
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ dɩ ʋ baanɩŋ nɛ sie? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo waa, dɩ ʋ baanɩŋ nɛ hoso? Ʋ baanɩŋ yie pusi a nagɛ nyiniŋ nɛ, bʋsʋŋ yɩyɛrɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord is good. He protects those who trust him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA wɩaa zɔmɔ, ʋ nɛ nɩaa yie mʋ yuori dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋba. Ʋʋ beŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laaʋ dii nyuŋ nɛ,

english_verse: But like a roaring flood, the Lord chases his enemies into dark places and destroys them.
translation_verse: ama ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ lɩɩ-balɩŋ pɛllɛ paa Nɩnɩvɛ tabal-la nɩaa kala. Ʋ jaŋ kire kpʋ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: So don't plot against the Lord! He wipes out his enemies, and they never revive.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ a mʋ tɩgɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ? Ʋ jaŋ cheima. Ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ jaŋ wuo sii chɩŋ ʋ lɛ bʋlɩa.

english_verse: They are like drunkards overcome by wine, or like twisted thornbushes burning in a fire.
translation_verse: A nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩ joŋ sɔsʋŋ sɩ vɔɔ kɛŋ dɔŋɔ arɩ ya-hɩlɩŋ dii ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nyiniŋ jaŋ dii Nɩnɩvɛ nɩaa sɩɩ begilu ba wʋŋaalaa lɛ a nagɛ sɩ-nyʋaraa.

english_verse: Assyria, one of your rulers has made evil plans against the Lord.
translation_verse: Ma Nɩnɩvɛ tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ nɛ nʋʋ lɩɩ a bɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a mʋ tɩgɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ, aŋ dɩdagɛ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Assyria, no matter how strong you are, you will be cut down! My people Judah, I have troubled you before, but I won't do it again.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ ʋ nɩaa, Juda doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: “Asiiria tɩŋŋaa kɛŋ harɩchɩnnaa nɛ a yʋgɛ, ama mɩ jaŋ keriba ta dɩ ba lɛl. Mɩ fa ŋaa wɩaa jʋʋ ma Juda doho lɛ nɛ, ama mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I'll snap your chains and set you free from the Assyrians.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa bɩra sɩ́ dol kala kɛŋ ma nyuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛrɛ chɔrʋmɔ-la sɩ vɔɔma.”

english_verse: Assyria, this is what else the Lord says to you: “Your name will be forgotten. I will destroy every idol in your temple, and I will send you to the grave, because you are worthless.”
translation_verse: Nɩnɩvɛ nɩaa, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩɩ nɛ a tɩgɛ ma lɛ, ʋ sɩ, “Ma bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doho nʋʋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ ma yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ chei ma vʋɩya-la ma sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ saa arɩ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ libe ba hɛ ma vesiŋ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ lu ma bʋa bil, bɛɛ wɩaa ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Look toward the mountains, people of Judah! Here comes a messenger with good news of peace. Celebrate your festivals. Keep your promises to God. Your evil enemies are destroyed and will never again invade your country.
translation_verse: Ma beŋ peelee nyusuŋ na, nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ kʋkɔ. Ʋ heelee bʋl arɩ ba yuo dii Asiiria tɩŋŋaa nɛ. Juda tɩmma, má gbieli ma gbielee, aŋ lɩɩsɛ niiri-la ma sɩ ta. Nɩbɔmɔ-la bɩra bɩ jaŋ kʋ tɔ ma tinteeŋ, Wɩa jaŋ chei ba kala.

english_verse: Nineveh, someone is coming to attack and scatter you. Guard your fortresses! Watch the road! Be brave! Prepare for battle!
translation_verse: Nɩnɩvɛ, bayuoru nɩɩ kɔ ŋ lɛ. Kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ, a pɔ ŋ dɩɩ-duoruŋ, aŋ bibeŋ ŋ wombiee ma. Kɛŋ ŋ laalɩyuoroo hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ma yuo laalɩŋ.

english_verse: Judah and Israel are like trees with branches broken by their enemies. But the Lord is going to restore their power and glory. *
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ chei ba tinteeŋ nɛ, ama La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩra kɛŋ tʋla arɩ ʋ fa sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Their horses prance, and their armored chariots dart around like lightning or flaming torches.
translation_verse: Ba laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba faasa fɩfá womporunuŋ lɛ a gɔllɛ vivilli ba jaŋ nɩaa dɩ-hilimiŋ. Ba nagɛ kapɩlaa nyiŋgeliŋ nɛ, ba vɛnɩŋ nagɛ duonuŋ sɩɩ lɩgɩsʋ.

english_verse: An officer gives a command. But his soldiers stumble, as they hasten to build a shelter to protect themselves against rocks thrown down from the city wall.
translation_verse: Ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ bayuoro-la ʋ sɩ tʋɔsa a hɛ dɔŋɔ. Ama baa ŋmoo naasɩŋ nɛ wombiiŋ lɛ, ba yie guu fá mʋ yi tabal-la jeeŋ a kɛŋ hɔɔtaalɩ-la ba sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ mʋ chaga chɩna gbɛrɛ dɩ ba yuo.

english_verse: The river gates fly open, and panic floods the palace.
translation_verse: Fuo-la gɩba kɩɛsa nɛ, lɩɩŋ yigi kuoru dɩa lo.

english_verse: Nineveh is disgraced. The queen is dragged off. Her servant women mourn; they moan like doves, and they beat their breasts in sorrow.
translation_verse: Ba bʋla bil nɛ arɩ ba jaŋ kɛsɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ nɩaa kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga. Ʋ hantolibiisi-la sɩ ŋaa yosi yiyel a nagɛ kokosuŋ aŋ paa nɩsaa vɔɔ ba bɔɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Nineveh is like a pond with leaking water. Shouts of “Stop! Don't go!” can be heard everywhere. But everyone is leaving.
translation_verse: Nɩnɩvɛ nagɛ pɩlɩŋ sɩ yɛrɛ nɛ ʋ lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ lɩɩ. Ba dɔnsʋŋ ŋmoo niiŋ a bʋl, “Ma leŋ, ma leŋ,” ama nʋʋkala bɩ gɛlɛ daasɛ.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers shout, “The city is full of treasure and all kinds of wealth. Steal her silver! Grab her gold!”
translation_verse: Má paa ba hɔpʋla. Má paa ba sɛlɩmɛ. Ba dʋa-la kala ba sɩ bile bɩ kʋ-dɛrɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Nineveh is doomed! Destroyed! Her people tremble with fear; their faces turn pale.
translation_verse: Ba chei tabal-la kala nɛ ʋ pɩŋ hoi, kʋŋkala bɩra tuo ʋ lɛ. Fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba ba chichel, ba nandaasɩŋ kala yʋɔrɛ, ba sɩaa ma bibiri.

english_verse: What happened to this city? They were safer there than powerful lions in a den, with no one to disturb them.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, nɩɩ nɛ naachigee dɩjʋʋlʋŋ hɛ, lee-la ba sɩɩ dɩɛsɛ ba biiriŋ, lee-la naachigi-bele arɩ naachigi-haala arɩ ba biiriŋ sɩ mʋa a bɩ fawʋllʋŋ ka fá?

english_verse: These are the same lions that ferociously attacked their victims, then dragged away the flesh to feed their young.
translation_verse: Nɩnɩvɛ fa nagɛ naachigiŋ nɛ, a kpʋ kɩaa yʋgɛ a pɩ ʋ biiriŋ aŋ chigi bagɩla pɩ ʋ haala ma, ka ʋ dɩ-faalɩŋ arɩ ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ kala su arɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ kpʋa.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is against you, Nineveh. God will burn your chariots and send an army to kill those young lions of yours. You will never again make victims of others or send messengers to threaten everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ, “Mɩ chɩŋ ŋ lɛ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ nyɩgɛ ŋ janɩŋ torukoba aŋ kpʋ ŋ laalɩyuoroo arɩ tokobiiŋ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ kʋŋkala a pɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ. Nʋʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ nɩɩ ŋ tɩndaara-la sɩɩ fugisi nɩaa yikoro.”

english_verse: Doom to the crime capital! Nineveh, city of murder and treachery,
translation_verse: Wɩaa puu tabal-la sɩ suo arɩ nɩkpʋʋraa, a su arɩ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ. Dʋa su tabal-la nɛ nɩaa sɩ jaŋ yuo laa.

english_verse: here is your fate— cracking whips, churning wheels; galloping horses, roaring chariots;
translation_verse: Má jegili, chɩbɩsɩŋ ka dɔŋ nɛ, gɩrɩŋgɩrɩmba ma ŋmoo dɔŋɔ a dʋdɔŋ, janɩŋ naasɩŋ ma dʋdɔŋ, laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba ma dɔmɔ tuto.

english_verse: You were nothing more than a prostitute using your magical charms and witchcraft to attract and trap nations.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala ka ŋaa, a tɩŋ Nɩnɩvɛ sɩ nagɛ hachɔrʋŋ, a kɛŋ daalusuŋ nyɩsa kɩkɛsɛ nɩaa, a nyagɛ tinteyee bil arɩ ʋ wʋchɔrʋŋ wɩaa, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ hɩllɩŋ ma fʋgɛ nɩaa bil.

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, am now your enemy. I will pull up your skirt and let nations and kingdoms stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bʋl, “Mɩ chɩŋ ŋ lɛ nɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ gondoŋ wuro tɔ ŋ sɩaa, aŋ leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa na ŋ yarɩ-biree, dɩ ŋ hɩɩsɩŋ lɩɩ.

english_verse: I will cover you with garbage, treat you like trash, and rub you in the dirt.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ disiŋ-jɩgɩŋ hɛ ŋ lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa ta-tɔɔ, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ naŋ, ʋ chaarɛ sɩaa pɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who sees you will turn away and shout, “Nineveh is done for! Is anyone willing to mourn or to give her comfort?” Nineveh's Fate Is Sealed
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ naŋ, ʋ jaŋ fá aŋ bʋl, ‘Nɩnɩvɛ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ nɛ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ yele pʋʋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ nyagɛ ʋ bɔyɛ?’ ”

english_verse: Nineveh, do you feel safer than the city of Thebes? The Nile River was its wall of defense.
translation_verse: Ŋ kpɩa Tɛbɛs sɩ ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ tabalɩŋ nɛɛ? Tabal-la sɩ hɛ Naayɩl fuo-la sɛmɛ, ka lɩɩŋ gollu chu nɛɛ? Tabal-la fuonuŋ sɩ kɛrɛ lɩɩŋ nagɛ kɛrɛ a golli.

english_verse: Thebes trusted the mighty power of Ethiopia and Egypt; the nations of Put and Libya were her allies.
translation_verse: Kus arɩ Ijipiti tinteyee nɛ fa chaasa pʋ doluŋ, aŋ ka Puti arɩ Libiya tinteeŋ nɩaa ma fa ŋaa ba sɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: But she was captured and taken to a foreign country. Her children were murdered at every street corner. The members of her royal family were auctioned off, and her high officials were bound in chains.
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, ba fa yuo kɛnʋ nɛ a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga. Ba paa ʋ bii-mulluŋ vɩɩra kpʋ nɛ ba womporunuŋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yuo diiu tɔnsɔ lɩɩsɛ ʋ nɩyuŋŋoo nɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩbalaa kala hɛ chɔrʋmɔɔ.

english_verse: Nineveh, now it's your turn! You will get drunk and try to hide from your enemy.
translation_verse: Nɩnɩvɛ, ŋ ma jaŋ gɛrɛ a nagɛ sɩ-nyʋara, ŋ jaŋ faa dɩ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ́ŋ na.

english_verse: Your fortresses are fig trees with ripe figs. Merely shake the trees, and fruit will fall into every open mouth.
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩɩ-duoruŋ ŋ sɩ kaa pʋpɔ ŋ tɩtɩa nagɛ tutogusuŋ nɛŋ-bumbumba sɩ bɩa nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ jagɩsɛba, nɛnɛ-la yie tel ba dɩ-diiree niiree lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Your army is weak. Fire has destroyed the crossbars on your city gates; now they stand wide open to your enemy.
translation_verse: Beŋ ŋ laalɩyuoroo na, ba kala nagɛ haalaa nɛ. Nyiniŋ dii ŋ tinteeŋ boi-baalaa kala nɛ, ba suro chɩŋ a pɩ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Your city is under attack. Haul in extra water! Strengthen your defenses! Start making bricks! Stir the mortar!
translation_verse: Má ŋaa lɩɩŋ, a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩaba gbɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kɔ dɩ ba yuoma. Má pɔ ma dɩ-duoruŋ woruŋ. Má buu tɩɛrɩŋ a nʋɔsɛ, má chɛ tiebii-pɛɛsɩrɩ kʋa bil.

english_verse: You will still go up in flames and be cut down by swords that will wipe you out like a field attacked by grasshoppers. So, go ahead and increase like a swarm of locusts!
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala nyiniŋ jaŋ diima, koo dɩ ba kpʋma laalɩ-baga lɛ a nagɛ nyaŋgɩrɩgɛba sɩ dii kɩaa. Ma pʋŋa nɛ a nagɛ nyaŋgɩrɩgɛba koo hɔbɔ.

english_verse: More merchants are in your city than there are stars in the sky— but they are like locusts that eat everything, then fly away.
translation_verse: Ma leŋe ma bayallaa pʋŋa pɛ nɛ a paala kɩɩ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ. Ama ba nagɛ hɔbɔ sɩ dii tinteeŋ kɩaa kala dɛrɛ nɛ aŋ file viiri.

english_verse: Your guards and your officials are swarms of locusts. On a chilly day they settle on a fence, but when the sun comes out, they take off to who-knows-where.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔma nagɛ hɔbɔ nɛ, ma tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ ma nagɛ hɔbɩ-laalɩŋ nɛ a sagɛ kɛrɛ nyuŋ dɩ leriŋ nɛ fɩɛla, ama dɩ wɩa nɛ pɔsɔ ba file viiri, nʋʋkala bɩ jɩŋ lee-la ba sɩ mʋa.

english_verse: King of Assyria, your officials and leaders are sound asleep, while your people are scattered in the mountains. Yes, your people are sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Asiiria tinteeŋ kuoru-balɩŋ, ŋ sɩpaalaaraa ka dɩɛgɛ doŋ nɛ, ŋ nɩbalaa ma pɩŋ aa wiesi. Ŋ nɩaa pɩsa hɛ peelee nyusuŋ nɛ, ka nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ kɛmba kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: You're fatally wounded. There's no hope for you. But everyone claps when they hear this news, because your constant cruelty has caused them pain.
translation_verse: Kʋŋkala tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo vaarɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ sɩ bolimi ŋɩɩ yʋga kieli nɛ. Nʋʋkala sɩ nɩa dɩ ŋ tele, ʋ yie porisi nɩsaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋkala na hɛɛŋ nɛ a tɩŋ ŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: I am Habakkuk the prophet. And this is the message that the Lord gave me. Habakkuk Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa fa sɩ joŋo dagɛ ʋ wʋlaabʋlla Habaku a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la. Habaku gʋrɩmɛ wɩaa Wɩa teeŋ

english_verse: Our Lord, how long must I beg for your help before you listen? How long before you save us from all this violence?
translation_verse: “La TƖƖNA, ɛɛ nɛ mɩ yɩrɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ diene ŋɩɩ dɩ ŋ pɛ la lɛ, ka ŋ bɩ jegile nɩɩ? Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ pɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ka ŋ bɩ la laa ta ba sɩɩ dii doluŋ la lɛ?

english_verse: Why do you make me watch such terrible injustice? Why do you allow violence, lawlessness, crime, and cruelty to spread everywhere?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ leŋ mɩ na wɩaa sɩ bɩ ba bʋa lɛ ŋaa? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ sɛɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ su leriŋ kala? Ŋ leŋ mɩ bibeŋ ka leriŋ chichei doluŋ didiila mɩ sɛmɛ na-kala ka yuosuŋ arɩ kaalɛrɛ ma pʋrɩgɛ.

english_verse: Look and be amazed at what's happening among the nations! Even if you were told, you would never believe what's taking place now.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA fa bʋl, “Beŋ tinteyee tʋɔŋ, ŋ jaŋ na wɩaa dɩ ba kpere. Ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ lɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ, dɩ ba nɛ bʋl wɩɩ-la pɩŋ ma, ŋ bɩ jaŋ laa dii.

english_verse: I am sending the Babylonians. They are fierce and cruel— marching across the land, conquering cities and towns.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa bɩra kɛŋ doluŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔhɛɛŋ a chaasa bɔŋ woruŋ, a wuo vɛnɛ mʋmʋ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala dɩ ba yuo laa tinteye-la sɩ bɩ ba kɩaa ŋaa.

english_verse: How fearsome and frightening. Their only laws and rules are the ones they make up.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ nɛ woruŋ, nɩaa fɩfába. Baa to ba tɩtɩa wombiiŋ nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ ba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: They make fun of rulers and laugh at fortresses, while building dirt mounds so they can capture cities.
translation_verse: Baa sieri kuoru balaa lɛ nɛ, a mʋmɔŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ ma lɛ. Baa mɔŋ tabala-la kala ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli nɛ. Ba saa vaŋkumba nɛ a yelli kɛrɩsɩ-la a to nɩmɛ jʋʋ yuo kɛsɛba.

english_verse: Then suddenly they disappear like a gust of wind— those sinful people who worship their own strength. Habakkuk Complains Again
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kʋ bal a nagɛ peliŋ. Nɩaa deemba ŋaa wʋcheeree nɛ, ba doluŋ nɛ ŋaa ba wɩa.” Habaku bɩra gʋrɩmɛ wɩaa Wɩa teeŋ

english_verse: But you can't stand sin or wrong. So don't sit by in silence while they gobble up people who are better than they are.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩaa zɔmɔ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, ŋ sɩ jaŋ kaa beŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ŋ bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa woruŋ ka ŋaa. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ŋ sɛɩ pɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ tɔrɛ ŋ niiŋ, ka nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ chichei nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a kɩɩba?

english_verse: The people you put on this earth are like fish or reptiles without a leader.
translation_verse: Ŋ fa leŋe nuhuobiinee nagɛ chenfilee sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, a nagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa sɩ bɩ bibennu kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Then an enemy comes along and takes them captive with hooks and nets. It makes him so happy
translation_verse: Nɩbɔmʋŋ kɛŋ gbɩamba kɩkɛsɛba, a kɛŋ joŋ ma a kɩkɛsɛba. Ʋ yie kɛsɛba arɩ ʋ joŋ-la a lɛrɛ lɩɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, ʋ jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: that he offers sacrifices to his fishing nets, because they make him rich and provide choice foods.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yie kpaarɛ ʋ jomba-la, a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pɩpɩba. Ʋ jomba-la lɛ nɛ ʋ to nɩna kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ, a didii kʋdii sɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Will he keep hauling in his nets and destroying nations without showing mercy?
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ ha kpʋkpʋ tinteyee nɩaa ŋɩɩ nɛ, aŋ bɩ ba nenige ka fáa?

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: “I will give you my message in the form of a vision. Write it clearly enough to be read at a glance.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ kaa dagɩŋ hɛ tabɩɩ-taalaa lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ba chaasa lɩɩ chɩŋ dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ fá ma, dɩ ʋ wuo karɩmɛ a bʋla pɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: At the time I have decided, my words will come true. You can trust what I say about the future. It may take a long time, but keep on waiting— it will happen!
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ kaa dagɩŋ kɛŋ ba tapʋlɩɩ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ mʋʋ tɩgɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ba bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩ. Dɩ ba nɛ naga baa dienu ma, ha gbɛrɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jaŋ sɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa, ba bɩ jaŋ dieni.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, refuse to accept anyone who is proud. Only those who live by faith are acceptable to me.” Trouble for Evil People
translation_verse: Bee na, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa, ba wʋchɛɛlɛɛ bɩ tʋʋla. Ama tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa-na jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩ laa mɩ-na Wɩa wɩaa dii. Tʋɔ-bɔŋ tɩŋŋaa hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ

english_verse: Wine is treacherous, and arrogant people are never satisfied. They are no less greedy than death itself— they open their mouths as wide as the world of the dead and swallow everyone.
translation_verse: Dʋa ka nyɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ. Tʋɔ-luŋ tɩŋŋaa ka dagɛ ba tɩtɩa nɛ, a bɩ wiese ka na. Ba nagɛ sʋʋŋ sɩɩ kpʋ nɩaa a bɩ vɔgɛ nɛ. Kʋŋkala bɩ baa vɔgɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba yuo dii tinteyee nɩaa kala a kɛsɛba.

english_verse: You robbed cities and nations everywhere on earth and murdered their people. Now those who survived will be as cruel to you.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa, ma fa yuo laa ta-gentiŋ-daŋ nɩaa kɩaa nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka, ma jaŋ yuo laa ma kɩaa. Ma fa kpʋ nɩaa nɛ. Ma fa chei tinteyee arɩ tabalaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ba lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You're doomed! You made your family rich at the expense of others. You even said to yourself, “I'm above the law.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ to a dʋa kɩaa, a saa dɩa-la doho dʋndɔmɔ sɩ bɩ wuo jʋjʋʋ dɩ wʋbɔŋ kala sɩ́ ʋ jʋʋ.

english_verse: But you will bring shame on your family and ruin to yourself for what you did to others.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩɩna dɩ ŋ chei nɩ-daŋ nɛ, aŋ mɩɩra hɩhɩɩsɛ ŋ dɩa nɩaa a joŋ ŋ tɩtɩa mɩɩsɩŋ tɩta.

english_verse: The very stones and wood in your home will testify against you.
translation_verse: Ma dɩɩsɩŋ jeyee tabɩaa jaŋ chɩɩrɛ ma nyusuŋ, dɩ doloo laa chɩɩmɛ.

english_verse: You're doomed! You built a city on crime and violence.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ yuosuŋ a kpʋ nɩaa laa kɩaa saa tabalɩŋ, a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ saa jaŋ.”

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful sends up in flames what nations and people work so hard to gain.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ fa leŋe nyiniŋ joŋ kɩalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɔlɔ na dii tinteyee nɩaa lɔlɔ tɩta.

english_verse: Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Ama La Tɩɩna wɩaa arɩ ʋ tʋla jaŋ su tinteeŋ, a nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ su mʋgʋ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced instead of praised. The Lord will make you drunk, and when others see you naked, you will lose their respect.
translation_verse: Yɩrɩ-la ŋ fa sɩ jaŋ laa, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ mɩɩra kɛnɩŋ. Lɛɛlɛ ŋ tɩtɩa jaŋ nyʋa sɩŋ-la a wuri kɩaa ta. Nyʋnyʋa-la sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ ka kɔ ŋ lɛ nɛ, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ tɔ yɩrɩ-la kala ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: You destroyed trees and animals on Mount Lebanon; you were ruthless to towns and people everywhere. Now you will be terrorized. Idolatry Is Foolish
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ keri Lɛbanɔŋ duuŋ ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ chei ŋ ma, pʋsʋ-la ŋ sɩ kpʋa jaŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ jʋʋŋ kɩŋkɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ kpʋ nɩaa nɛ, a chei tinteyee arɩ tabalaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ba lɛ.”

english_verse: What is an idol worth? It's merely a false god. Why trust a speechless image made from wood or metal by human hands?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ kʋŋ bʋbʋa nɛ vʋɩŋ kɛŋ, nuhuobiine nɛ sɩ ŋaaʋ? Ʋ ŋaaʋ ʋ nyɩnyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ saaʋ joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa hɛ ʋ lɛ, kʋŋ ʋ tɩtɩa sɩ mɛ. Tɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa bɩ wɩaa wuo bʋl.

english_verse: What can you learn from idols covered with silver or gold? They can't even breathe. Pity anyone who says to an idol of wood or stone, “Get up and do something!”
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu nɩɩ-la sɩ bʋla pɩ daaŋ, “Sii a bɩrɩmɛ kʋwei,” koo a bʋla pɩ tabɩɩŋ sɩ bɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kɛnɛ, “Sii.” Tɔmʋŋ jaŋ wuo dagɛ nɩaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga baa ŋaa? Sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla nɛ ba kaa tɔʋ, ʋ bɩ wiese kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Let all the world be silent— the Lord is present in his holy temple.
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA hɛ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ tʋɔŋ nɛ, dʋnɩa nɩaa kala, má ŋaa fʋɩɩ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: I know your reputation, Lord, and I am amazed at what you have done. Please turn from your anger and be merciful; do for us what you did for our ancestors.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, mɩ nɩɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ wɩaa nɛ. La TƖƖNA, ŋ wʋŋaalaa kperimi nɛ. Bɩra wasa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ la ma mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa lɛ, dɩ la jɩmba. Dɩ ŋ nɛ na baanɩŋ ma, fá la nenige.

english_verse: You are the same Holy God who came from Teman and Paran to help us. The brightness of your glory covered the heavens, and your praises were heard everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Wɩa lɩɩ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ nɛ a kʋkɔ, Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɩɩ Paraŋ peeliŋ nyuŋ nɛ a kʋkɔ. Ʋ tʋla tɔ wɩa-nyuŋ kala nɛ ka nɩaa dɛnnʋ su tinteeŋ kala.

english_verse: Your glory shone like the sun, and light flashed from your hands, hiding your mighty power.
translation_verse: Ʋ tʋla nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nɛ, pʋlʋmʋŋ chaanɛ lɩɩ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, lee-la ʋ doluŋ sɩ faa.

english_verse: Dreadful diseases and plagues marched in front and followed behind.
translation_verse: Nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ laa ʋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ, ka sʋʋŋ tuto ʋ naabʋɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: When you stopped, the earth shook; when you stared, nations trembled; when you walked along your ancient paths, eternal mountains and hills crumbled and collapsed.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ chɩna, tinteeŋ yie zigili nɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ beŋ tinteyee nɩaa, ba yie chichel nɛ. Peel-bɩnaa arɩ dundol-bɩnaa yie tel a yɛrɛ nɛ. Ʋ wombiee chɩna nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The tents of desert tribes in Cushan and Midian were ripped apart.
translation_verse: Mɩ na dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ Kusa nɩaa ba lɛŋŋɛɛ lɛ, Midiaŋ nɩaa ma chichel ba dɩjʋʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, were you angry with the monsters of the deep? You attacked in your chariot and wiped them out.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA, ŋ baanɩŋ fa sii fuonu-la nyuŋ nɛɛ? Ŋ baanɩŋ fa sii mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nyuŋ nɛɛ, bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ jɩl ŋ janɩŋ arɩ ŋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba-la ŋ sɩ kaa yuo didii?

english_verse: Your arrows were ready and obeyed your commands. You split the earth apart with rivers and streams;
translation_verse: Ŋ lɩɩsɛ ŋ toŋ nɛ ʋ lʋaga lɛ, a leŋ ba kɛŋ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ yʋgɛ a kʋ pɩŋ. Ŋ leŋe tinteeŋ yɛrɛ nɛ fuonuŋ pɩpɛllɛ.

english_verse: mountains trembled at the sight of you; rain poured from the clouds; ocean waves roared and rose.
translation_verse: Peelee naŋ nɛ, a chichel. Duonuŋ faasa nɩɩ, mʋgʋ-balaa huhuuri, lɩɩ-peliŋ sisii.

english_verse: The sun and moon stood still, while your arrows and spears flashed like lightning.
translation_verse: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ chɛnɛ chɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ wɩa-nyuŋ ba sɩ na ŋ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ arɩ ŋ tiŋŋee sɩɩ lɩgɩsʋ wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: In your furious anger, you trampled on nations
translation_verse: Baanɩŋ nɛ ŋ kaa vɛnɛ golli tinteeŋ a nʋɔsɛ tinteyee arɩ baaŋ-la.

english_verse: to rescue your people and save your chosen one. You crushed a nation's ruler and stripped his evil kingdom of its power.
translation_verse: Ŋ lɩa dɩ ŋ laa ŋ nɩaa ta nɛ, dɩ ŋ laa nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa ta. Ŋ kpʋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ tinteeŋ sɩpaalaara nɛ. Ŋ gbegisu nɛ a lɩɩ ʋ nyuŋ a kaa tuu ʋ naasɩŋ.

english_verse: His troops had come like a storm, hoping to scatter us and glad to gobble us up. To them we were refugees in hiding— but you smashed their heads with their own weapons.
translation_verse: Ʋ tɩtɩa timiŋ nɛ ŋ laa a tɔɔ gɩrɩgɛ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ, ʋ bayuoroo sɩ gbu lɩɩ dɩ ba ŋmoola pɩsɛ. Ba faa jʋɔsʋ nɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ sɩ faa a liŋ.

english_verse: Then your chariots churned the waters of the sea. Habakkuk's Response to God's Message
translation_verse: Ŋ vɛŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ arɩ ŋ janɩŋ, a kɛŋ ʋ lɩɩ-balɩŋ vuugi.

english_verse: When I heard this message, I felt weak from fear, and my lips quivered. My bones seemed to melt, and I stumbled around. But I will patiently wait. Someday those vicious enemies will be struck by disaster. Trust in a Time of Trouble
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩɩ wɩaa deemba kala nɛ a chichel, mɩ niipinee ŋmuŋmoo dɔŋɔ, mɩ yaraa kala sʋʋ, mɩ naasɩŋ chichel. Ama mɩ jaŋ dii kenyiri aŋ gbɛrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ tinteye-la sɩ kʋ tɔla hɩhɛ.

english_verse: Fig trees may no longer bloom, or vineyards produce grapes; olive trees may be fruitless, and harvest time a failure; sheep pens may be empty, and cattle stalls vacant—
translation_verse: Arɩ tutogusuŋ sɩ bɩ fɩɩla ma kala, girep tɩɩsɩŋ ma bɩ nɛnɛ, olif tɩɩsɩŋ ma bɩ nɛnɛ, bagɩsɩŋ bɩ kʋdiilii kala kɛnɛ, piesee ma tuo pie-dɩa lɛ, nɛsɩŋ ma tuo nɛ-dɩa lɛ,

english_verse: but I will still celebrate because the Lord God is my Savior.
translation_verse: ama mɩ ha jaŋ jʋɔsɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ mɩ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa mɩ Laataara nyuŋ.

english_verse: The Lord gives me strength. He makes my feet as sure as those of a deer, and he helps me stand on the mountains. To the music director: Use stringed instruments.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɛ ŋaa mɩ doluŋ, ʋ nɛ leŋe mɩ naachɛɛŋ lɩŋ a nagɛ aamɩŋ kʋa. Ʋ nɛ pɛ mɩ lɛ mɩ wuo jɩjɩl peelee. Yɩɩl-la ba sɩ yɩɩ pɩ gɔgʋ-hɩaŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I am Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the grandson of Gedaliah, the great-grandson of Amariah, and the great-great-grandson of Hezekiah. When Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, the Lord gave me this message. Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA fa bʋl wɩaa pɩ Zefanaaya sɩ ŋaa Kusi nanʋala, a ŋaa Gedalia ma nihiŋ, aŋ ŋaa Amarɩa nihi-lɩɛrɛ. Amarɩa nyɩmma nɛ fa ŋaa Hezikaaya. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Josaaya sɩ ŋaa Amɔŋ nanʋala nɛ fa dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. Wɩa jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya

english_verse: I, the Lord, now promise to destroy everything on this earth—
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ tii paa kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ tii paa nuhuobiinee arɩ pʋsʋŋ, diibiisiŋ arɩ chenfilee sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ. Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ daŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ a sii chʋɔrɛ, dɩ mɩ nɛ kpʋ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala.” La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I will reach out to punish Judah and Jerusalem— nothing will remain of the god Baal; nothing will be remembered of his pagan priests.
translation_verse: “Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Juda nɩaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka daha a tuto Baal vene-la, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpaarʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛl.

english_verse: Not a trace will be found of those who worship stars from their rooftops, or bow down to the god Milcom, while claiming loyalty to me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chei nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie jɩl lusuŋ a kpirime chʋɔlɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, chɛnɛ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie kpirime chʋɔlɛ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA a ŋmɩɛsɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, aŋ ha bɩra ŋmɩŋmɩɛsɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk ma yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Nothing will remain of anyone who has turned away and rejected me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ chei nɩalɩŋ sɩ mɩɩrɛ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA harɩŋ tonuŋ, a bɩ mɩ bee chɩchɛ, a bɩ mɩ pɩɛsa nɩna wɩaa.”

english_verse: Be silent! I am the Lord God, and the time is near. I am preparing to sacrifice my people and to invite my guests.
translation_verse: Má ŋaa fʋɩɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA tapʋlʋŋ kpaga nɛ. La TƖƖNA fa leŋe ʋ nɩaa nagɛ pʋsʋŋ nɛ dɩ ba kpʋ a lɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ kpʋba.

english_verse: On that day I will punish national leaders and sons of the king, along with all who follow foreign customs.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ dii mɩ nɩaa sarɩya, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ ba sɩpaalaaraa arɩ kuoru-biiriŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ to nɩwogusuŋ naabarɩŋ.

english_verse: I will punish worshipers of pagan gods and cruel palace officials who abuse their power.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ vʋɩ-kpaaraa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ gɩrɩma laa kɩaa a kpʋ nɩaa ma laa kɩaa su ba vene dɩɩ-balɩŋ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that on that day noisy crying will be heard from Fish Gate, New Town, and Upper Hills.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Tapʋlɩɩ-la ma jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ nɩaa ŋmoo niiŋ Jerusalɛm boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Chenfilee Boi-baalɩŋ lɛ, a nɩɩ yele ma ja-falɩɩ-la ba sɩ saa lɛ, a nɩɩ goŋ ma ba sɩ faasa ŋaa dundolluŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Everyone in Lower Hollow will mourn loudly, because merchants and money changers will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ yɔbɔ leriŋ, má yel. Ba jaŋ kpʋ ma bayalaa kala. Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɔɔ kɩaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yallɛ kɩaa nɩmɛ kala jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: I'll search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those people who sit there unworried while thinking, “The Lord won't do anything, good or bad.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ jaŋ nyɩgɛ chaanɩŋ a gbilli Jerusalɛm a dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ kɛnɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ sɩnɩŋ ba sɩ nyʋa aŋ ka bʋbʋɔŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩɩna mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA bɩ jaŋ ŋaa ba wɩɩkala, wʋzɔŋ koo wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards. A Terrible Day
translation_verse: Ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kɛŋ ba dʋa laa, aŋ ŋmoo ba dɩɩsɩŋ lo. Ba jaŋ saa dɩɩsɩŋ aŋ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋba. Ba jaŋ chɔnsɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ, aŋ bɩ jaŋ nyʋa tɩɩsɩ-la sɩnɩŋ.” La TƖƖNA tapʋl-balɩŋ

english_verse: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tapʋl-bal-la kpaga nɛ, ʋ kpaga nɛ a kʋkɔ lɩma lɩma. Má jegile nɩɩ, La TƖƖNA tapʋlɩɩ-la nɩaa jaŋ ŋmoo niiŋ bagɛ-bagɛ, laalɩyuori wajɩa ma jaŋ paala ŋmoo niiŋ.

english_verse: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa jaŋ dagɛ ʋ baanɩŋ, nɩaa jaŋ na hɛɛŋ dɩ ba tʋɔŋ faasa chei, tapʋlɩɩ-la ba jaŋ chei nɩaa ka dɩ jikpeeŋ pɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa birimiŋ tapʋlɩɩ dɩ leriŋ faasa biri, a ŋaa tapʋlɩɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa sɩ jaŋ tɔ dɩ leriŋ faasa biri.

english_verse: of trumpet calls and battle cries against fortified cities and mighty fortresses.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ ŋmʋʋ banyile tapʋlɩɩ-la aŋ ŋaa laalɩyuori goŋ aŋ yuyuo tabala-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli arɩ dɩɩ-leŋie-la sɩ chɩŋ ba gʋnaa lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord warns everyone who has sinned against him, “I'll strike you blind! Then your blood and your insides will gush out like vomit.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa na hɛɛŋ, ba jaŋ gɔllɔ baarɛ leriŋ a nagɛ nyʋlɩmaa, a tɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA lɛ wɩaa. Ba chalɩŋ jaŋ jaasɛ a pɛllɛ nagɛ lɩɩŋ, dɩ ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ ma pɩna pʋa.

english_verse: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord, am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ, ba warɩpʋla koo ba sɛlɩmɛ bɩ jaŋ wuo laaba ta. Mɩ yarɩ-bieri baanɩŋ jaŋ nagɛ nyiniŋ a joŋ dʋnɩa kala dii, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ guu sʋʋ.”

english_verse: before it's too late. The Lord has set a time when his fierce anger will strike like a storm and sweep you away.
translation_verse: ka dɩ bʋa-la ba sɩ daga-na yi, chɛɛ-la peliŋ sɩ jaŋ paama a nagɛ mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ, ka dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ-na yi. Chɛɛ-la La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ jaŋ faasa sii ma nyuŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: If you humbly obey the Lord, then come and worship him. If you do right and are humble, perhaps you will be safe on that day when the Lord turns loose his anger. Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Má chɛ La TƖƖNA, ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri a hɛ tintee-la lɛ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga, má kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri, ŋ bɩ pɔ ma jaŋ na leriŋ a kɛŋ ma nyusuŋ pɛllɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ. Wɩalɩŋ Zefanaaya sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa lɛ

english_verse: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: “I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out!”
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ, tintee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kiriti tɩŋŋaa. La TƖƖNA bʋla lɩɩ ma harɩŋ nɛ. Ma Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la sɩ hɔŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ, La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ cheima, ma kʋbala ma bɩ jaŋ ka.”

english_verse: Your seacoast will be changed into pastureland and sheep pens.
translation_verse: Tintee-la sɩ kpagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ, lee-la Kiriti tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ jʋʋ jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ pie-daaraa arɩ piesee dɩjʋʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. Judgment on Moab and Ammon *
translation_verse: Juda nɩkaanaa nɛ jaŋ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ, nɩmɛ nɛ ba pʋsʋŋ jaŋ didii yaŋ. Dɩdaanɩŋ ba jaŋ pɩŋ Asɩkɛlɔŋ tɩmma-la dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ beŋ ba nyuŋ, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba bɩra dʋa. Wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa arɩ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I've heard Moab and Ammon insult my people and threaten their nation.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ nɩɩ jomo-la Mʋab tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ tʋʋsɛ mɩ nɩaa arɩ ŋɩɩ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ sieri mɩ nɩaa lɛ nɛ. Ba tʋʋsɛ mɩ nɩaa a fugisiba nɛ arɩ ba jaŋ kɛŋ ba tinteeŋ laa.

english_verse: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ba lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ ba sɩɩ-duoŋ wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba tʋʋsɛ ba TƖƖNA Doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɩaa nɛ a sieri ba lɛ.

english_verse: I will fiercely attack. Then every god on this earth will shrink to nothing, and everyone of every nation will bow down to me, right where they are. Judgment on Ethiopia
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ chei vʋɩya-la kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ, dɩ fawʋllʋŋ faasa jʋʋba. Tinteyee kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ jaŋ kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ, nʋʋ na-kala jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Kus tɩŋŋaa lɛ

english_verse: People of Ethiopia, the sword of the Lord will slaughter you! Judgment on Assyria
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Ma Kus tɩŋŋaa ma, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kpʋma laalɩŋ lɛ.” Wɩalɩŋ Zefanaaya sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa lɛ

english_verse: Herds of wild animals will live in its rubble; all kinds of desert owls will perch on its stones and hoot in the windows. Noisy ravens will be heard inside its buildings, stripped bare of cedar.
translation_verse: Piesee arɩ nɛsɩŋ jaŋ pɩpɩŋ nɩmɛ, pʋŋ-doho na-kala jaŋ pɩŋ nɩmɛ. Hajaaŋkuŋkumba-la sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ arɩ gʋra-nyilimiba jaŋ chʋchʋa ʋ kɛrɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba huuno jaŋ to tokoro wuoloo a lɩɩ chɩchɩɩmɛ leriŋ. Chosuŋ arɩ tɩɛrɩŋ jaŋ tele gɩbɛ boi-niiree lɛ, ka dɩ kuolu doloo nyɩɩsɛ.

english_verse: This is the glorious city that felt secure and said, “I am the only one!” Now it's merely ruins, a home for wild animals. Every passerby simply sneers and makes vulgar signs.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa tabal-la nɩaa fa sɩ hɔnɔ ta jɩa, wɩɩ bɩ baa walɩmɛ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Tabal-la fa bʋl ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ, “Mɩ-na nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, kʋŋkala tuo a magɛmɛ.” Ʋ nɛ mɩɩra pɩŋ jikpeeŋ ŋɩɩ a ŋaa baga kɩaa dɩjʋʋlʋŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ tou bɩbal yie sieri ʋ lɛ aŋ kɛŋ nɩsɩŋ liese dɩdagɛ.

english_verse: Too bad for that disgusting, corrupt, and lawless city!
translation_verse: Wɩaa puu Jerusalɛm, ʋ nyagɛ nɩaa bil nɛ, a vɩa dagɩŋ aŋ ŋaa wɩaa a kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: Forever rebellious and rejecting correction, Jerusalem refuses to trust or obey the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ nʋʋkala niiŋ ka nɩɩ. Ʋ bɩ sɛyɛ ba dɩdagʋ. Ʋ bɩ La TƖƖNA laa dii. Ʋ bɩ sɛyɛ a mʋ kpɩkpagɛ ʋ Wɩa.

english_verse: Its officials are roaring lions, its judges are wolves; in the evening they attack, by morning nothing is left.
translation_verse: Ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ ka ŋaa goŋ nɛ a nagɛ naachigee sɩɩ yel, ʋ sɩpaalaaraa ma nagɛ losuŋ sɩ kɛŋ guŋgurusuŋ dɩdaanɩŋ, ba bɩ kʋŋ die aŋ kɩka taŋ pʋpʋl.

english_verse: Jerusalem's prophets are proud and not to be trusted. The priests have disgraced the place of worship and abused God's Law.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ kɛŋ babii-ballɩŋ, ba ŋaa zɛmbɛ tɩmma nɛ. Ʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ nɛ aŋ kɛŋ wombii-la ma ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto kaa bɩrɩmɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ cho.

english_verse: All who do evil are shameless, but the Lord does right and is always fair. With the dawn of each day, God brings about justice.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ a hɛ tabal-la lɛ, ʋ bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala ka ŋaa. Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala ʋ yie dagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ʋ bɩ giri, ka nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔbɔmʋŋ ha bɩ hɩɩsɩŋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: The Lord wiped out nations and left fortresses crumbling in the dirt. Their streets and towns were reduced to ruins and emptied of people.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ kpʋ tinteyee nɩaa nɛ a ŋmoo ba dɩɩ-duoruŋ lo. Mɩ leŋe ba womporunuŋ pɩŋ hoi nɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ ba ka to. Mɩ chei ba tabalaa nɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ ka nɩmɛ, nɩbala ma bɩ ka.

english_verse: God felt certain that Jerusalem would learn to respect and obey him. Then he would hold back from punishing the city and not wipe it out. But everyone there was eager to start sinning again. Nations Will Turn to the Lord
translation_verse: Mɩ fa bɩɩna mɩ nɩaa jaŋ fámɛ, a sɛɩ mɩ dagɩŋ, dɩ mɩ bɩra sɩ́ ba taŋ chei a dɔgɩsɛba. Ama ba haa ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la ba fa sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Just wait for the day when I accuse you nations. I have decided on a day, when I will bring together every nation and kingdom and punish them all in my fiery anger. I will become furious and destroy the earth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl, “Má gbɛrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ tinteyee nɩaa wʋcheelee pɩba. Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ dɩ mɩ yɩrɛ tinteyee arɩ kuoru tinteyee nɩaa hilimi nɛ, a kɛŋ baanɩŋ dɔgɩsɛba. Mɩ baanɩŋ chaasa sii ba nyuŋ nɛ. Mɩ baanɩŋ sɩ sie mɩ yaraa bibieri ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ nagɛ nyiniŋ a joŋ dʋnɩa kala dii.

english_verse: I will purify each language and make those languages acceptable for praising me. Then, with hearts united, everyone will serve only me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ nɩaa deemba niiree bɩrɩmɛ, dɩ ba kala yɩyɩrɛ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ, a tɩma pɩpɩmɛ arɩ nii-bala.

english_verse: From across the rivers of Ethiopia, my scattered people, my true worshipers, will bring offerings to me.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chʋɔlɛmɛ aŋ pɩsɛ a kieli Kus fuonu-la leriŋ a mʋ, jaŋ kɛŋ kɩaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩmɛ.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't rebel against me and be put to shame. I'll do away with those who are proud and arrogant. Never will any of them strut around on my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ bɩ jaŋ tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ma sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ wɩaa a joŋ hɩɩsɩŋ hɛ ma lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa tabalɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ jʋɔsɛ ba babiibal wɩaa lɛ ta. Ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ma kɛŋ babii-ballɩŋ mɩ dundolo-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, won't destroy any of your people who are truly humble and turn to me for safety.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩaa sɩ fɩɛla tabal-la lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ laamɛ dii.

english_verse: The people of Israel who survive will live right and refuse to tell lies. They will eat and rest with nothing to fear. A Song of Celebration
translation_verse: Iziral nɩkaana-la sɩ bɩ sʋba bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ba bɩ jaŋ nyɩnyɩɛ wɩaa, ba bɩ jaŋ nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩaa ma. Ba jaŋ dii kɩaa aŋ pɩŋ sɔm, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem and Judah, celebrate and shout with all your heart!
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ nɩaa, má yɩɩ yɩɩlaa, Iziral tɩmma, má kpɩa wɩaa. Jerusalɛm nɩaa, má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ, dɩ ma jʋjʋɔsɛ.”

english_verse: Zion, your punishment is over. The Lord has forced your enemies to turn and retreat. Your Lord is King of Israel and stands at your side; you don't have to worry about any more troubles.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA leŋ ma dɔgʋsʋŋ nɛ, ʋ kiri ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ba mɩɩrɛ nɛ. La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Kuoru-balɩŋ hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ, ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ fɩfá wʋwalɩmɩɩ kala.

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time is coming, when it will be said to you: “Don't be discouraged or grow weak from fear!
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la ba jaŋ bʋla pɩ Jerusalɛm tɩŋŋaa, “Má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, Zaayɔŋ nɩaa, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God wins victory after victory and is always with you. He celebrates and sings because of you, and he will refresh your life with his love.” The Lord's Promise to His People
translation_verse: Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ, ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ laama ta. Ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ faasa tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ, ʋ chonuŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ sɔm, dɩ ʋ yɩɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ yɩɩlaa a jʋɔsɛ ma wɩaa.”

english_verse: I will punish those who mistreat you. I will bring together the lame and the outcasts, then they will be praised, instead of despised, in every country on earth.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la nɛ yie, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ wʋrʋgʋma. Mɩ jaŋ laa gbɛrɩgɛɛ ta, aŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɩsa kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ dɩ nɩaa zizilma tinteye-la kala lɛ ba sɩ hɩɩsɛma.

english_verse: I will lead you home, and with your own eyes you will see me bless you with all you once owned. Then you will be famous everywhere on this earth. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, mɩ jaŋ kɛsɛma kʋ hilimi. Bʋa-la nɛ yie, mɩ jaŋ kɛsɛma kɔ dɩa. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala bɩbɛsɛ ma lɛ a zizilma dɩ mɩ nɛ leŋe dɩ ma bɩra dʋa ba sɩɩŋ lɛ.” La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: On the first day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak his message to the governor of Judah and to the high priest. So Haggai told Governor Zerubbabel and High Priest Joshua
translation_verse: Daarus sɩ dii Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoru-balɩŋ, ʋ jɩ-lɩa, chɛŋ-dʋ tapʋl-bumbuŋ lɛ nɛ, La TƖƖNA to ʋ wʋlaabʋlla Hagaɩ lɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩ Zerubabɛl arɩ Josua. Zerubabɛl nɛ fa ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ Juda tinteeŋ, ʋ nyɩmma nɛ Sɩalɩtɩɛl. Josua ma nɛ fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ, ʋ ma nyɩmma nɛ Jehozadak.

english_verse: You harvest less than you plant, you never have enough to eat or drink, your clothes don't keep you warm, and your wages are stored in bags full of holes.
translation_verse: Ma duu kɩaa a yʋgɛ nɛ, ama kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kʋma bɩ wɩɩ maga. Ma yie dii kɩaa, ama ma bɩ vɔgɛ. Ma yie nyʋa kɩaa, ama ma bɩ vɔgɛ. Ma yie laalɛ gɛnnɩŋ, ama ba bɩ ma waarɩŋ ka tɔ. Ma yie laa time, ʋ dɛrɛ a nagɛ ma joŋo hɛ gɛrɩ-fehe sɩ luro lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: But first, go to the hills and get wood for my temple, so I can take pride in it and be worshiped there.
translation_verse: Má jɩl peelee a keri doloo kaa tuu a paa mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la saa, dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ, dɩ nɩaa chʋchʋɔlɛmɛ nɩmɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: You expected much, but received only a little. And when you brought it home, I made that little disappear. Why have I done this? It's because you hurry off to build your own houses, while my temple is still in ruins.
translation_verse: Ma faa yɩɛlɛ dɩ ma na ma baga kɩaa a yʋgɛ nɛ, aŋ mɩɩra na mʋa. Mʋa-la ma ma sɩ kaa kɔ dɩa, mɩ ŋmooba ta nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ? Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ pɩɛsa. Mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, ka nʋʋkala fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa dɩa wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ.

english_verse: That's also why the dew doesn't fall and your harvest fails.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ duonuŋ bɩ nɩɩ, ma kʋduuloo ma bɩ wasɛ.

english_verse: And so, at my command everything will become barren—your farmland and pastures, your vineyards and olive trees, your animals and you yourselves. All your hard work will be for nothing.
translation_verse: Mɩ leŋe hɩlɩŋ chɩŋ ma bagɩsɩŋ arɩ peelee lɛ nɛ, mɩaa, tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ arɩ olif nʋʋŋ nyaa tinteeŋ lɛ. Hɩl-la chei nuhuobiinee arɩ pʋsʋŋ kala nɛ arɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala ma sɩɩ tɩŋ.”

english_verse: Zerubbabel and Joshua, together with the others who had returned from exile in Babylonia, obeyed the Lord's message spoken by his prophet Haggai, and they started showing proper respect for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɩalɩtɩɛl nanʋala Zerubabɛl arɩ Jehozadak nanʋala Josua sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ arɩ nɩkaana-la kala sɛɩ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Hagaɩ sɩ bʋla, bɛɛ wɩaa ba TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ tɩmʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ fa fɩfá La TƖƖNA.

english_verse: And the work began on the twenty-fourth day of that same month.
translation_verse: Dɩ Daarus sɩ dii Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, ʋ jɩ-lɩa chɛŋ-dʋ tapʋlaa mara arɩ banɛsɛ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: On the twenty-first day of the next month, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak this message to Governor Zerubbabel, High Priest Joshua, and everyone else:
translation_verse: “Bʋl wɩaa pɩ Sɩalɩtɩɛl nanʋala Zerubabɛl, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ Juda tinteeŋ arɩ Jehozadak nanʋala Josua ma sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ arɩ nɩkaana-la. Pɩɛsɛba,

english_verse: just as I promised your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt. Don't worry. My Spirit is right here with you.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ hɛ niiŋ mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ a bʋl nɛ ŋɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ ha hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ, má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá.”

english_verse: Soon I will again shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni, ka dɩ mɩ bɩra kɛŋ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ, mʋgʋ-balɩŋ arɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ kala jigisi.

english_verse: and I promise that this new temple will be more glorious than the first one. I will also bless this city with peace. The Past and the Future
translation_verse: Tʋla-la dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ nɛ jaŋ yʋga kɩɩ ʋ faafaa tʋla ʋ fa sɩ kɛnɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ leriŋ deeŋ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.” La TƖƖNA ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ pɩ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ

english_verse: Suppose meat ready to be sacrificed to God is being carried in the folds of someone's clothing, and the clothing rubs against some bread or stew or wine or olive oil or any other food. Would those foods that were touched then become acceptable for sacrifice? “Of course not,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ joŋ nammɩa ba sɩ joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ a hɛ ʋ gɛrɩŋ lɛ a kaa kpeŋ, dɩ gɛrɩ-la nɛ digi boroboro koo dɩsɩŋ, tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ, nʋʋŋ koo kʋdiilii dɔŋ, ba jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ kɩaa ba sɩ joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛɛ?” Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bʋl, “Aɩ.”

english_verse: Then Haggai said, “Suppose someone has touched a dead body and is considered unacceptable to worship God. If that person touches these foods, would they become unclean?” “Of course they would,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hagaɩ bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ digi sʋʋŋ a kɛŋ disiniŋ, aŋ digi kɩaa deemba kʋŋ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ disiniŋ?” Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bʋl, “Oo, ba jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.”

english_verse: So the Lord told Haggai to say: That's how it is with this entire nation. Everything you do and every sacrifice you offer is unacceptable to me.
translation_verse: Hagaɩ bɩra bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ, ‘ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ na dɩ tinteeŋ deeŋ nɩaa naga, wɩɩ na-kala ba sɩɩ ŋaa arɩ kʋŋ na-kala ba sɩ joŋoo sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: That same day the Lord spoke to Haggai again and said:
translation_verse: Chɛnɛ-la tapʋlaa mara arɩ banɛsɛ chɛɛŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl wɩaa pɩ Hagaɩ lɩamɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I made all of your hard work useless by sending mildew, mold, and hail—but you still did not return to me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ saga arɩ dayalɩbɩŋ arɩ duoŋ-tabɩaa a hɛ ma kʋduuloo lɛ a leŋ ba chei, ka ma ha bɩ bɩrɩma kɔ mɩ teeŋ a tomi. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Although you have not yet harvested any grain, grapes, figs, pomegranates, or olives, I will richly bless you in the days ahead. God's Promise to Zerubbabel
translation_verse: Kʋdoho nɛ ka vire tʋɔŋ? A kaa kɔ lɛɛlɛ, girep tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ tutogusuŋ, tɩa-la nɛnɛɛ sɩ nagɛ kampoi nɛnɛɛ arɩ nʋʋŋ tɩɩsɩŋ bɩ nɛŋ kala nɛnɛ. Ama a chɩŋ jɩnɩŋ a kaa mʋ, mɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ.’ ” Zerubabɛl nɛ ŋaa nenii-pɩrɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ kaa magɩlɛ kɩaa

english_verse: Tell Governor Zerubbabel of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Bʋla pɩ Zerubabɛl, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ Juda tinteeŋ, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ jigisi.

english_verse: and wipe out kings and their kingdoms. I will overturn war chariots, and then cavalry troops will start slaughtering each other.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ kuoru kpasɩnɩŋ wuro chu, a chei dol-la ba sɩ kaa bibeŋ tintee-wogusu-la. Mɩ jaŋ kiri laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛmba vɩvɛŋ, janɩŋ jaŋ sʋʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ jɩlba gʋra kpʋ dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: I am the prophet Zechariah, the son of Berechiah and the grandson of Iddo. In the eighth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Daarus sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-lɩa chɛŋ-chori tʋɔŋ, La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ ʋ wʋlaabʋlla Zɛkarɩya sɩ ŋaa Bɛrɛkɩa nanʋala, aŋ ŋaa Ido ma nihiŋ.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord All-Powerful, was very angry with your ancestors. But if you people will return to me, I will turn and help you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ ma jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ ma teeŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. They were warned by the earlier prophets to give up their evil and turn back to me, but they paid no attention.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma naabalɩmaba nagʋ, ba nɛ mɩ wʋlaabʋlla-la laa sɩpaaŋ kʋ bʋla pa ŋɩɩ: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ: ‘Má bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wombii-bɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la ma sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.’ Ama ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ koo a kaa tɩŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Where are your ancestors now? Not even prophets live forever.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ nɛ ma naabalɩmaba-la hɛ lɛɛlɛ? Mɩ wʋlaabʋlla-la ma, ba hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu nɛɛ?

english_verse: But my warnings and my words spoken by the prophets caught up with your ancestors. So they turned back to me and said, “Lord All-Powerful, you have punished us for our sins, just as you had planned.” First Vision: Horses and Riders
translation_verse: Ama mɩ niiŋ wɩaa arɩ mɩ niiri-la mɩ sɩ joŋo dagɛ mɩ tɩntɩnnaa sɩ ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa dii ma naabalɩmaba nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ aŋ bʋl, ‘La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna joŋ la wombiee arɩ la wʋŋaalaa sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ chɩmɩŋ nɛ a tiŋ la lɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ ŋaa.’ ” Baal-la sɩ hɛ chɛyɛɛ tʋɔŋ

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of Shebat, which was the eleventh month of that same year, the Lord spoke to me in a vision during the night: In a valley among myrtle trees, I saw someone on a red horse, with riders on red, brown, and white horses behind him.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋɩŋ mɩ na wɩaa a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ. Mɩ na baala sɩ jɩl ja-fɩaŋ. Ʋ fa chɩŋ chɛyɛɛ tʋɔŋ nɛ fuonaa-luŋii kʋbala lɛ, ka ja-fɩaŋ, ja-bʋgʋŋ arɩ ja-pʋla hɛ ʋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: An angel was there to explain things to me, and I asked, “Sir, who are these riders?” “I'll tell you,” the angel answered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩɛsɛ, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, bɛɛ kɩaa nɛ ŋ-la?” Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la fa sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ dagɩŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: At once, the man standing among the myrtle trees said, “These are the ones the Lord has sent to find out what's happening on earth.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la sɩ chɩŋ chɛyɛ-la tʋɔŋ bʋl, “Ba nɛ ŋaa kɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ tɩma dɩ ba gɔllɔ beŋ dʋnɩa.”

english_verse: Then the riders spoke to the Lord's angel, who was standing among the myrtle trees, and they said, “We have gone everywhere and have discovered that the whole world is at peace.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ La TƖƖNA tɩndaarʋ-la fa sɩ chɩŋ chɛyɛ-la tʋɔŋ, “La gɔllɛ dʋnɩa kala nɛ a na dɩ ʋ fɩɛla pɩŋ, wʋwalɩmɩɩ tuo.”

english_verse: For a while I was angry at the nations, but now I am furious, because they have made things worse for Jerusalem and are not the least bit concerned.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ baanɩŋ chaasa sisii tinteye-la sɩ hɔnɔ wɩɩkala bɩ baa walɩmɛ nyuŋ nɛ. Mɩ fa na baanɩŋ mʋa nɛ mɩ nɩaa nyuŋ, ka nɩalɩŋ mɩɩra leŋ ba hɛɛŋ yʋgɛ.’

english_verse: I also promise that my towns will prosper—Jerusalem will once again be my chosen city, and I will comfort the people of Zion. Second Vision: Animal Horns
translation_verse: Ha heele bʋl: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Dʋa jaŋ bɩra yʋgɛ mɩ tasɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ nyagɛ Zaayɔŋ bɔyɛ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ Jerusalɛm dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ tabalɩŋ.’ ” Nyilliŋ banɛsɛ arɩ libiree ma banɛsɛ

english_verse: Next, I saw four animal horns.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ a na nyilliŋ banɛsɛ mɩ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The angel who was sent to explain was there, and so I asked, “What do these mean?” His answer was, “These horns are the nations that scattered the people of Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem, and took away their freedom.” Then the Lord showed me four blacksmiths, and I asked, “What are they going to do?” He replied, “They are going to terrify and crush those horns.”
translation_verse: Mɩ pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ kɩaa deemba arɩ nɩaa deemba kʋkɔ dɩ ba ŋaa?” Ʋ bʋl, “Nyilliŋ deemba nɛ pɩsɛ Juda dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ wuo kɛŋ nyuŋ je nɩmɛ. Ama libire-la kɔ dɩ ba joŋ fawʋllʋŋ hɛ ba lɛ nɛ a chei tinteyee nɩaa dol-la ba sɩ kaa pɛsɛ Juda lɛ dɩ ba leŋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɩsɛ.”

english_verse: This time I saw someone holding a measuring line,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ a na baal kʋbala dɩ ʋ kori ŋmɛnɩŋ ba sɩ kaa mɩmagɩsɛ kɩaa.

english_verse: and I asked, “Where are you going?” “To measure Jerusalem,” was the answer. “To find out how wide and long it is.”
translation_verse: Mɩ pɩɛsʋ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ mʋmʋ?” Ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mɩɩ mʋ mɩ magɩsɛ Jerusalɛm nɛ, a na ʋ jalɩŋ arɩ ʋ duomuŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me came toward me, when another angel came up to him
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la fa sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ viviiri, Wɩa tɩndaara dɔŋɔ kʋ chemu

english_verse: and said, “Hurry! Tell that man with the measuring line that Jerusalem won't have any boundaries. It will be too full of people and animals even to have a wall.
translation_verse: a bʋla pʋ: “Fá mʋ bʋla pɩ bapʋɔsɩ-bie-la, ‘Jerusalɛm jaŋ ŋaa tabal kɛrɩsɩŋ sɩ bɩ gollo, a tɩŋ nɩaa arɩ pʋsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ faasa yʋgɛ ʋ lɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord himself has promised to be a protective wall of fire surrounding Jerusalem, and he will be its shining glory in the heart of the city.” A Call to Action
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩtɩa jaŋ nagɛ kɛrɛ sɩ kɛŋ nyiniŋ a gollu, mɩ jaŋ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ a ŋaa ʋ tʋla.’ ” La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: The Lord says to his people, “Run! Escape from the land in the north, where I scattered you to the four winds.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Má kɔ, má kɔ. Má fá lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ kɛmma pɩsa hɛ dʋnɩa loŋgorunuŋ banɛsɛ-la lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Leave Babylonia and hurry back to Zion.”
translation_verse: Má kɔ, má foro fá lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ a mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm.”

english_verse: Then the glorious Lord All-Powerful ordered me to say to the nations that had raided and robbed Zion: Zion is as precious to the Lord as are his eyes. Whatever you do to Zion, you do to him.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la, “Ʋ sɩ zilmi harɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ tɩmmɛ tinteye-la sɩ yuo paa ma kɩaa teeŋ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ digima, ʋ tʋʋ mɩ-na Wɩa sɩɩŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: And so, he will put you in the power of your slaves, and they will raid and rob you. Then you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ sɛnɛ lɩɩsɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ liesiba, dɩ ba tɩtɩa yosuŋ yuo diiba a paa ba kɩaa. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ tɩmmɛ.”

english_verse: City of Zion, sing and celebrate! The Lord has promised to come and live with you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Jerusalɛm nɩaa, má ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Mɩɩ kɔ nɛ dɩ mɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: When he does, many nations will turn to him and become his people. At that time you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Tinteyee jaŋ yʋgɛ dɩ ba nɩaa kɔ La TƖƖNA teeŋ bʋa-la lɛ, a ŋaa ʋ nɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ tɩmmɛ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: Then Judah will be his part of the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his chosen city.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ laa Juda tɩɩ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ʋ kpaalɩŋ tintee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ, aŋ bɩra lɩɩsɛ Jerusalɛm dɩ ʋ ŋaa tabal-la ʋ sɩ cho.

english_verse: Everyone, be silent! The Lord is present and moving about in his holy place.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiinee kala, má chɩŋ sɔm La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ sii ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ nɛ a kʋkɔ.

english_verse: I was given another vision. This time Joshua the high priest was standing in front of the Lord's angel. And there was Satan, standing at Joshua's right side, ready to accuse him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la dagɛmɛ Josua sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ La TƖƖNA tɩndaarʋ-la sɩpaaŋ, ka Sɩtaanɩ chɩŋ ʋ nadiiŋ dɩ ʋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ Josua.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Satan, you are wrong. Jerusalem is my chosen city, and this man was rescued like a stick from a flaming fire.”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tɩndaarʋ-la bʋla pɩ Sɩtaanɩ, “La TƖƖNA jaŋ kpɩa ŋ lɛ Sɩtaanɩ. La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsɛ Jerusalɛm jaŋ kpɩa ŋ lɛ. Baala deeŋ nagɛ daaŋ fa sɩ hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ ba kaa lɩɩsɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: So the angel told some of the people to remove Joshua's filthy clothes. Then he said to Joshua, “This means you are forgiven. Now I will dress you in priestly clothes.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa, “Má wuri ʋ gɛnnɩ-la.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bʋla pɩ Josua ma, “Bee na mɩ laa ŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta nɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ gɛnnɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ a laalɩŋ.”

english_verse: I spoke up and said, “Also put a clean priestly turban on his head.” Then they dressed him in priestly clothes and put the turban on him, while the Lord's angel stood there watching.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ ma bʋl, “Leŋ dɩ ba joŋ nyu-bɛlɛ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ a bɛ ʋ nyuŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ nyu-bɛlɛ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ a bɛ ʋ nyuŋ, a laalʋ gɛnnɩŋ, ka La TƖƖNA tɩndaarʋ-la chɩŋ ba sɛmɛ.

english_verse: After this, the angel encouraged Joshua by telling him that the Lord All-Powerful had promised:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tɩndaarʋ-la bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ a pɩ Josua:

english_verse: If you truly obey me, I will put you in charge of my temple, including the courtyard around it, and you will be allowed to speak at any time with the angels standing beside me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Dɩ ŋ nɛ jaŋ to mɩ wombiiŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ, ŋɩɩ-na ŋ jaŋ bibeŋ mɩ dɩa arɩ ʋ kaalɩsɩŋ kala. Mɩ jaŋ pɩŋ dɩchɩnɩŋ nɩaa deemba kala sɩ hɛ daha tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Listen carefully, High Priest Joshua and all of you other priests. You are a sign of things to come, because I am going to bring my servant, the Chosen King.
translation_verse: Josua, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ arɩ ŋ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔsʋ-la sɩ hɔŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ, ma ŋaa magɩl nɛ aa dagɛ wɩalɩŋ maachie sɩ jaŋ kɔ. Má jegile nɩɩ: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ tɩntɩnna ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Naakeliŋ a kaa kɔ.

english_verse: Joshua, I have placed in front of you a stone with seven sides. I will engrave something on that stone, and in a single day I will forgive this guilty country.
translation_verse: Má beŋ tabɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ joŋo bil Josua sɩpaaŋ, tabɩɩ-bala nɛ aŋ kɛŋ sɩaa balɩpɛ. Mɩ jaŋ tuuri kʋŋ a hɛ ʋ lɛ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ tinteeŋ deeŋ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta tapʋl-bala. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Then each of you will live at peace and entertain your friends in your own vineyard and under your own fig trees.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, ma kʋŋkala jaŋ yɩrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna dɩ ʋ kʋ hɔŋ ʋ girep tɩa arɩ ʋ tutogo bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: The angel who explained the visions woke me from what seemed like sleep.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ mɩɩra kɔ a chɩsɛmɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ chɩsɛ nɩa doŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then he asked, “What do you see?” “A solid gold lampstand with an oil container above it,” I answered. “On the stand are seven lamps, each with seven flames.
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ na?” Mɩ bʋl, “Mɩ na ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa chaaŋ daaŋ, chaaŋ gbaŋa daŋ ʋ nyuŋ, chaanaa balɩpɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a kɛŋ chaaŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ leree ma balɩpɛ.

english_verse: One olive tree is on the right side and another on the left of the oil container.
translation_verse: Olif tɩɩsɩŋ balɩa ma nɛ fa chɩna kpagʋ. Dɔŋɔ hɛ gbaŋa-la nadiiŋ, dɔŋɔ ma hɛ nagʋa.”

english_verse: Then he asked, “Don't you know?” “No sir,” I replied.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl, “Ŋ bɩ kɩaa deemba jɩŋ?” Mɩ bʋl, “Aɩ, mɩ nɩhɩaŋ.”

english_verse: So the angel explained that it was the following message of the Lord to Zerubbabel: I am the Lord All-Powerful. So don't depend on your own power or strength, but on my Spirit.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ Zerubabɛl nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Ŋ ballɩŋ lɛ dee koo ŋ doluŋ lɛ dee ŋ jaŋ yuo dii, ama mɩ-na Wɩa Dɩma lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ to yuo dii.’ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Zerubbabel, that mountain in front of you will be leveled to the ground. Then you will bring out the temple's most important stone and shout, “God has been very kind.”
translation_verse: Peel-duo, ŋ nɛ kʋbɛɛ? Ŋ jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ tintee-taala Zerubabɛl sɩpaaŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jaŋ joŋ tiebii-katɩɩ a daŋ, ka dɩ nɩaa ŋaa goŋ a bʋl, ‘Wɩa jaŋ pɛ! Wɩa jaŋ pɛ!’ ”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ:

english_verse: Zerubbabel laid the foundation for the temple, and he will complete it. Then everyone will know that you were sent by me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Zerubabɛl nɛ bil mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ gentine. Ʋ nɛ saa jaŋ saaʋ dɛrɛ ma, dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa, mɩ nɩaa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ba TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ tɩmmɛ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: Those who have made fun of this day of small beginnings will celebrate when they see Zerubbabel holding this important stone. Those seven lamps represent my eyes—the eyes of the Lord—and they see everything on this earth.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ bee gʋʋnɛ wɩaa dɩ-suomuŋ sɩ muuro. Nɩaa tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ba nɛ na Zerubabɛl kori dɩɩsaarɩ-ŋmɛnɩŋ. Chaaŋ ŋmɛsɩ-la balɩpɛ nɛ ŋaa mɩ-na Wɩa sɩaa mɩ kaa bibeŋ dʋnɩa kala.”

english_verse: Then I asked the angel, “What about the olive trees on each side of the lampstand? What do they represent?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩɛsɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la, “Bɛɛ kɩaa nɛ olif tɩɩsɩŋ deemba balɩa sɩ hɛ chaaŋ daaŋ nadiiŋ arɩ nagʋa ŋɩɩ?”

english_verse: And what is the meaning of the two branches from which golden olive oil flows through the two gold pipes?”
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ kɩaa nɛ olif naakelee deemba balɩa sɩ hɛ sɛlɩmɛ fuolo-ŋmʋlba-la balɩa sɛmɛ, olif nʋʋŋ lɩlɩɩ ba lɛ?”

english_verse: “Don't you know?” he asked. “No sir, I don't,” was my answer.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl, “Ŋ bɩ kɩaa deemba jɩŋ?” Mɩ bʋl, “Aɩ, mɩ nɩhɩaŋ.”

english_verse: Then he told me, “These branches are the two chosen leaders who stand beside the Lord of all the earth.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Kɩaa deemba balɩa ŋaa nɩa nɛ Wɩa lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba tɩma pɩpɩ ʋ-na La TƖƖNA sɩ tɩɩ dʋnɩa kala.”

english_verse: When I looked the next time, I saw a flying scroll,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra beŋ a na teniŋ sɩɩ fil mɩ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: and the angel asked, “What do you see?” “A flying scroll,” I answered. “About nine meters long and four and a half meters wide.”
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ na?” Mɩ bʋl, “Mɩ na teniŋ sɩɩ fil nɛ, ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ nibi, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋnɛsɛ arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: Then he told me: This scroll puts a curse on everyone in the land who steals or tells lies. The writing on one side tells about the destruction of those who steal, while the writing on the other side tells about the destruction of those who lie.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Teniŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋmɩaŋ-la sɩ jaŋ tɩtɩŋ tintee-la kala lɛ a hɛ. Teŋ-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ a bʋl arɩ ba jaŋ lɩɩsɛ gaaraa kala ta. Teŋ-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ma ba bʋl arɩ nʋʋkala sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa aŋ ŋmɩɛsɛ, ba jaŋ lɩɩsʋ ta.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has said, “I am sending this scroll into the house of everyone who is a robber or tells lies in my name, and it will remain there until every piece of wood and stone in that house crumbles.” Seventh Vision: A Woman in a Basket
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ, ‘Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ teŋ-la lɩɩ, a mʋ jʋʋ gaarʋ kala dɩa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa aŋ ŋmɩŋmɩɛsɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Teŋ-la jaŋ ka ʋ dɩa lɛ a chei dɩa-la daasɩŋ arɩ ʋ tabɩaa kala.’ ” Haala sɩ hɛ sime tʋɔŋ

english_verse: Now the angel who was there to explain the visions came over and said, “Look up and tell me what you see coming.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la fa sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ kɔ a bʋla pɩmɛ, “Bee na, kʋŋ nɩɩ kɔ.”

english_verse: “I don't know what it is,” was my reply. “It's a big basket,” he said. “And it shows what everyone in the land has in mind.”
translation_verse: Mɩ pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ?” Ʋ bʋl, “Sime ba sɩ kaa mɩmagɩsɛ kɩaa nɛ.” Ʋ ha bɩra bʋl, “Nɩalɩŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ba sɩ ŋaa tintee-la kala lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The lead cover of the basket was opened, and in the basket was a woman.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ fanɩ pɩrata sɩ tɔ sime niiŋ suri, dɩ haala hɔŋ sime-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: “This woman represents evil,” the angel explained. Then he threw her back into the basket and slammed the heavy cover down tight.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bʋl, “Haala deeŋ nɛ chɩŋ dʋnɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala nyuŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ nyagɛ haal-la hɛ sime-la tʋɔŋ aŋ joŋ fanɩ pɩrata-la tɔ.

english_verse: Right after this I saw two women coming through the sky with wings outstretched like a stork in the wind. Suddenly they lifted the basket into the air,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ a na haalaa balɩa dɩ ba file chaasɛmɛ kʋkɔ. Ba kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ fa nagɛ naliiribommie kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ nɛ. Ba kʋ joŋ sime-la a file jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: and I asked the angel, “Where are they taking the basket?”
translation_verse: Mɩ pɩɛsɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la fa sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ sime-la mʋmʋ?”

english_verse: “To Babylonia,” he answered, “where they will build a house for the basket and set it down inside.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl, “Ba kaa mʋmʋ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ nɛ dɩ ba saa dɩa pʋ. Dɩ dɩa-la nɛ dɛrɛ, ba jaŋ joŋ sime-la bil nɩmɛ ʋ dɩchɩnɩŋ.”

english_verse: Finally, I looked up and saw four chariots coming from between two bronze mountains.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra beŋ, a na laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba banɛsɛ dɩ ba lɩɩ kɔlɩɩŋ peelee balɩa pɛgɛ a kʋkɔ.

english_verse: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, and the second by black horses;
translation_verse: Laalɩŋ janɩŋ toruko bumbuŋ janɩŋ ŋaa kʋfɩɛsɩŋ nɛ, lɩa kʋa ma janɩŋ ŋaa kʋbisi,

english_verse: the third chariot was pulled by white horses, and the fourth by spotted gray horses.
translation_verse: tori kʋa ma janɩŋ ŋaa kʋpʋlʋŋ, nɛsɛ kʋa janɩŋ ma ŋaa kʋŋmʋŋmʋnaa. Ba kala ŋaa ja-duoru nɛ.

english_verse: “Sir,” I asked the angel. “What do these stand for?”
translation_verse: Mɩ pɩɛsɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ, “Mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, bɛɛ kɩaa nɛ kɩaa deemba?”

english_verse: Then he explained, “These are the four winds of heaven, and now they are going out, after presenting themselves to the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Dɩnsɩŋ banɛsɛ sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba lɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ tɩɩ dʋnɩa kala sɩpaaŋ nɛ a kʋkɔ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The chariot with black horses goes toward the north, the chariot with white horses goes toward the west, and the one with spotted horses goes toward the south.”
translation_verse: Laalɩŋ janɩŋ toruko-la sɩ kɛŋ ja-bisiŋ ka mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɛ, kʋ-la ma sɩ kɛŋ ja-pʋllʋŋ mʋmʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, kʋ-la ma sɩ kɛŋ ja-ŋmʋŋmʋnaa ka mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: The horses came out eager to patrol the earth, and the angel told them, “Start patrolling the earth.” When they had gone on their way,
translation_verse: Ja-duoru-la sɩ lɩa, ba kpʋkpʋ ba tɩtɩa dɩ ba wuo gɔllɛ dʋnɩa kala. Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bʋl, “Má gɔllɛ dʋnɩa kala.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba gɔllɛ ʋ kala.

english_verse: he shouted to me, “Those that have gone to the country in the north will do what the Lord's Spirit wants them to do there.” The Chosen Leader
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la yɩrɛmɛ a bʋl, “Bee na, janɩ-la sɩɩ mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ leŋe mɩ Dɩma na wiesee nɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa tintee-la lɛ.” Josua kuoru nyunchuulo
