english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ:

english_verse: Tell him that I, the Lord All-Powerful, say, “Someone will reach out from here like a branch and build a temple for me. I will name him ‘Branch,’ and he will rule with royal honors. A priest will stand beside his throne, and the two of them will be good friends.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ jaŋ saa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ woruŋ. Ʋ jaŋ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ a beŋ ʋ nɩaa, a bɩra ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ jaŋ laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ mɩ-na Wɩa. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ balɩa kala hɩhɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: This crown will be kept in my temple as a reminder and will be taken care of by Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.”
translation_verse: Kuori nyunchuul-la jaŋ hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ dɩ ba kaa liliisi Hɛlɩdaɩ, Tobija, Jedaaya arɩ Zefanaaya nanʋala Josaaya wɩaa.”

english_verse: When people from distant lands come and help build the temple of the Lord All-Powerful, you will know that the Lord is the one who sent me. And this will happen, if you truly obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dɩ-bolii jaŋ kʋ pɛ dɩ ma saa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la, dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa, ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ tɩmmɛ ma teeŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ma nɛ chaasa to ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ.

english_verse: On the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month of the fourth year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord again spoke to me.
translation_verse: Daarus sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-nɛsɛ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ Zɛkarɩya chɛŋ-nibi tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa banɛsɛ chɛɛŋ, chɛnɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɩsɩlɛf nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: It happened after the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer with Regem-Melech and his men to ask the priests in the Lord's temple and the prophets to pray for them. So they prayed, “Should we mourn and go without eating during the fifth month, as we have done for many years?”
translation_verse: Dɩ ba pɩɛsɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna dɩa lɛ arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ, “Ʋ maga dɩ la ha yel aŋ vɔɔ niiŋ chɛŋ-nɔŋ lɛ arɩ ŋɩɩ la sɩ vɛnɛɛ ŋaa jɩ-daŋ-la sɩ bala lɛ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: It was then that the Lord All-Powerful told me to say to everyone in the country, including the priests: For
translation_verse: “Pɩɛsɛ tintee-la nɩaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kala: Ma sɩ vɔɔ niiŋ a yel chɛŋ-nɔŋ arɩ chɛŋ-pɛɩ tʋɔŋ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii-la kala sɩ bala lɛ, mɩ wɩaa nɛ ma sɛnɛ vɔɔ nii-la?

english_verse: And when you eat and drink, isn't it for your own enjoyment?
translation_verse: Ma fa sɩ yie gbiele dii kɩaa aŋ nyʋnyʋa kɩaa, ma tɩtɩa dee ma ŋaa wɩaa deemba a pɩpaa?

english_verse: My message today is the same one I commanded the earlier prophets to speak to Jerusalem and its villages when they were prosperous, and when all of Judah, including the Southern Desert and the hill country, was filled with people.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la tɩtɩa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ to mɩ wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kɔ, bʋa-la lɛ Jerusalɛm arɩ ʋ tasɩ-la sɩ gollu fa sɩ kɛŋ nɩaa yʋgɛ ba hɔŋ sɔm a kɛŋ dʋa, a pɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ a bʋl nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: So once again, I, the Lord All-Powerful, tell you, “See that justice is done and be kind and merciful to one another!
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Má leŋ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ chaasa chɩŋ ʋ bʋa lɛ. Má fɩfá nɩaa nenige, a fɩfá dɔŋɔba nisusuŋ.

english_verse: Don't mistreat widows or orphans or foreigners or anyone who is poor, and stop making plans to hurt each other.”
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ yo-haalaa, biisinsiŋ, nʋhʋɔraa arɩ summoo nyaga bil. Má sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩɩnʋ a mʋʋ tɩgɛ dɔŋɔba lɛ.

english_verse: But everyone who heard those prophets, stubbornly refused to obey. Instead, they turned their backs on everything my Spirit had commanded the earlier prophets to preach. So I, the Lord, became angry
translation_verse: Ba leŋe ba tʋɔŋ dol nɛ a nagɛ tabɩɩ-naŋkpachɩla a bɩ chɛ ba jegile nɩɩ wombie-la mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto koo wɩalɩŋ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ to mɩ Dɩma lɛ a bʋla pɩ mɩ wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna faasa na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: and said, “You people paid no attention when I called out to you, and now I'll pay no attention when you call out to me.”
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩba, ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba ma sɩ yɩrɛmɛ, mɩ bɩ jegile nɩɩ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: That's why I came with a whirlwind and scattered them among foreign nations, leaving their lovely country empty of people and in ruins.
translation_verse: Mɩ leŋe pel-duo nɛ kɛmba pɩsa hɛ tinteyee lɛ, ba ŋaa nʋhʋɔra. Tintee-la fa pɩŋ hoi nɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ nɩmɛ ka mʋ koo a lɩɩ nɩmɛ kʋkɔ. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa a leŋ tintee-zɔŋ-la pɩŋ hoi nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩra bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ.

english_verse: I will return to Jerusalem and live there on Mount Zion. Then Jerusalem will be known as my faithful city, and Zion will be known as my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ Zaayɔŋ a hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ Jerusalɛm tabal-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ba jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna peeliŋ ma, Peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: while boys and girls play in the streets.
translation_verse: Hambolibiisiŋ arɩ hantolibiisiŋ jaŋ su tabal-la womporunuŋ a gbigbieli.”

english_verse: This may seem impossible for my people who are left, but it isn't impossible for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere nɩalɩŋ nɩkaana-la teeŋ, ama ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere mɩ-na teeŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: I will save those who were taken to lands in the east and the west,
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ laa mɩ nɩaa ta wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ tinteye-la lɛ.

english_verse: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful to bring about justice.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ dɩ ba hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ba jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa, dɩ mɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ tʋɔpʋla ba teeŋ a ŋaa ba Wɩa.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! So don't give up. Think about the message my prophets spoke when the foundation of my temple was laid.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ma-na nɩalɩŋ lɛɛlɛ sɩɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ wʋlaabʋlla-la fa sɩ bʋla bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ bil mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna dɩɩ-bal-la gentine, má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a wasa saa mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la.

english_verse: Before that time, neither people nor animals were rewarded for their work, and no one was safe anywhere, because I had turned them against each other.
translation_verse: Faafaa la, ba fa bɩ nɩaa koo pʋsʋŋ ka tiŋ dɩ ba nɛ tɩma. Nʋʋkala fa bɩ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa wuo tɩma tɩta jɩa a tɩŋ ʋ dʋndɔmɔ wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ fa yigi nʋʋkala hɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: My people, only a few of you are left, and I promise not to punish you as I did before.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa nɩaa deemba nɩkaana-la lɛ a nagɛ mɩ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ faafaa-la.” La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Instead, I will make sure that your crops are planted in peace and your vineyards are fruitful, that your fields are fertile, and the dew falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ duu ba kɩaa arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Ba girep tɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ nɛŋ, tinteeŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ duo wasɛ, dɩ duonuŋ ma nɩɩ woruŋ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ kɩaa deemba kala a pɩ mɩ nɩaa nɩkaana-la.

english_verse: People of Judah and Israel, you have been a curse to the nations, but I will save you and make you a blessing to them. So don't be afraid or lose courage.
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa fa kɛŋ ma-na Juda arɩ Iziral nɩaa yɩrɩŋ a ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛ nɛ. Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ laama ta a to ma lɛ a pɛ ba lɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma, má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ.

english_verse: Now you no longer need to be afraid. I have decided to treat Jerusalem and Judah with kindness.
translation_verse: mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ lɛɛlɛ dɩ mɩ bɩra ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩ Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda nɩaa. Má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá.

english_verse: But you must be truthful with each other, and in court you must give fair decisions that lead to peace.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: Má bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ a pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ. Ma sarɩya dɩ-diilee, má to wʋtɩtɩɩ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ.

english_verse: Don't ever plan evil things against others or tell lies under oath. I, the Lord, hate such things. A Time of Celebration
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ bɩɩnʋ a mʋʋ tɩgɛ ma dɔŋɔ tɩɩna lɛ, a sɩ́ wɩaa nyɩɛ aŋ ŋmɩŋmɩɛsɛ. Mɩ bɛrɛ wɩaa deemba kala nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful told me to say:
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩra bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ:

english_verse: People of Judah, I, the Lord, demand that whenever you go without food as a way of worshiping me, it should become a time of celebration. No matter if it's the fourth month, the fifth month, the seventh month, or the tenth month, you should have a joyful festival. So love truth and live at peace.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ma sɩ yie vɔɔ niiŋ chɛŋ-nɛsɛ, chɛŋ-nɔŋ, chɛŋ-pɛɩ arɩ chɛŋ-fii lɛ ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ ŋaa jʋɔsa tapʋlɩa arɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ gbielee a pɩ ma Juda nɩaa. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má cho wʋtɩtɩɩ, a hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ.”

english_verse: I tell you that people will come here from cities everywhere.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Nɩ-daŋ arɩ tabal daŋ nɩaa ha jaŋ kɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Those of one town will go to another and say, “We're going to ask the Lord All-Powerful to treat us with kindness. Come and join us.”
translation_verse: Tabalɩŋ nɩaa jaŋ mʋ tabalɩŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa teeŋ a bʋl, ‘Má leŋ dɩ la guu mʋ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna teeŋ a sʋlʋ. La-naa mʋ nɛ.’

english_verse: Many people from strong nations will come to Jerusalem to worship me and to ask me to treat them with kindness.
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ arɩ tintee-duoruŋ jaŋ kɔ Jerusalɛm a chɩchɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna dɩ ba sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ.”

english_verse: When this happens, ten people from nations with different languages will grab a Jew by his clothes and say, “Let us go with you. We've heard that God is on your side.” I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Bʋa-la lɛ nɩaa fii jaŋ lɩɩ tintee-wogusuŋ kala sɩɩ bʋl yikorusuŋ sɩ bɩ dɔŋɔ naga, a kʋ kɛŋ Juu tɩɩna gɛrɩŋ lɛ aŋ bʋl, ‘Leŋ dɩ la to ŋ harɩŋ mʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa la nɩa arɩ Wɩa hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord: His eyes are on everyone, especially the tribes of Israel. So he pronounces judgment against the cities of Hadrach and Damascus.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ hɛɛ-la taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hadɩrak arɩ Damasɩkʋs tabalɩŋ nɩaa sɩ jaŋ na lɛ. La TƖƖNA sɩaa pɛ nʋʋkala lɛ nɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa dʋndʋŋa lɛ dee.

english_verse: Judgment will also fall on the nearby city of Hamath, as well as on Tyre and Sidon, whose people are clever.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Hamaf sɩ kpagɛ Damasɩkʋs, a pɛ Taaya arɩ Sɩdɔŋ sɩ ŋaa tabalaa lɛ, arɩ ba nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ jɩma ma kala.

english_verse: Tyre has built a fortress and piled up silver and gold, as though they were dust or mud from the streets.
translation_verse: Taaya saa dɩ-duo nɛ a pɩ ʋ tɩtɩa, a chɛ hɔpʋla chʋɔrɛ a nagɛ hagɩla, a chɛ sɛlɩmɛ ma chʋɔrɛ a nagɛ nʋsʋrʋŋ sɩ pɩŋ womporunuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Now the Lord will punish Tyre with poverty; he will sink its ships and send it up in flames.
translation_verse: Ama La TƖƖNA jaŋ laa kɩalɩŋ Taaya sɩ kɛnɛ, a chei dol-la ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ. Nyiniŋ jaŋ diiu.

english_verse: Both Ashkelon and Gaza will tremble with fear; Ekron will lose all hope. Gaza's king will be killed, and Ashkelon emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩkɛlɔŋ jaŋ naʋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ. Hɛɛŋ jaŋ jʋʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gaza, a pɛ Ɛkʋrɔŋ lɛ, ʋ yɩɛlaa kala jaŋ lɛl. Ba jaŋ kpʋ Gaza kuoro, ka dɩ Asɩkɛlɔŋ ma pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: A mob of half-breeds will settle in Ashdod, and the Lord himself will rob Philistia of pride.
translation_verse: Nʋhʋɔraa jaŋ hɔŋ Asɩdɔd lɛ. La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ giri Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa babii-ballɩɩ-la ta.

english_verse: No longer will the Philistines eat meat with blood in it or any unclean food. They will become part of the people of our God from the tribe of Judah. And God will accept the people of Ekron, as he did the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ chaŋ nammɩa arɩ chalɩŋ, koo a dii kʋdiile-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ kɩsʋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka jaŋ ŋaa mɩ-na Wɩa nɩaa, a ŋaa sɩpaalaaraa Juda lɛ, dɩ Ɛkʋrɔŋ nɩaa ŋaa mɩ nɩaa a nagɛ Jebus tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ kʋ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: God says, “I will stand guard to protect my temple from those who come to attack. I know what's happening, and no one will mistreat my people ever again.” The Lord Tells about the Coming King
translation_verse: Ama mɩ jaŋ chɩna pɔ mɩ dɩa dɩ laalɩyuoroo bɩra sɩ́ nɩmɛ jʋʋ. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala nyagɛ mɩ nɩaa bil. Lɛɛlɛ mɩ pɔ nɛ a bibeŋ. Zaayɔŋ kuoro jaŋ kɔ

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! Your king has won a victory, and he is coming to you. He is humble and rides on a donkey; he comes on the colt of a donkey.
translation_verse: Zaayɔŋ nɩaa, má faasa jʋɔsɛ. Jerusalɛm nɩaa, má ŋaa goŋ. Ma kuoro ka kɔ ma teeŋ nɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla nɛ a laa nɩaa tɩta, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa muuri nɛ a jɩl kakumo, a sagɛ kaku-pɔrʋŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will take away war chariots and horses from Israel and Jerusalem. Bows that were made for battle will be broken. I will bring peace to nations, and your king will rule from sea to sea. His kingdom will reach from the Euphrates River across the earth. The Lord Promises To Rescue Captives
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba-la kala lɛl Efirem lɛ, arɩ laalɩŋ janɩ-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, aŋ bori ba laalɩŋ tosuŋ. Ma kuoro jaŋ heele bʋl fɩɛlɩŋ wɩaa a pɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala. Ʋ jaŋ bibeŋ nɩaa a lɩɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ a mʋ yi dɔŋɔ, a lɩɩ Yufireti fuo-la lɛ a kaa mʋ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: When I made a sacred agreement with you, my people, we sealed it with blood. Now some of you are captives in waterless pits, but I will come to your rescue
translation_verse: Ama ma-na mɩ nɩaa, a tɩŋ nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ la kɛŋ chalɩŋ magɩlɛ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa dansarɩkaba buotuo-la sɩ bɩ lɩɩŋ kɛnɛ lɛ.

english_verse: and offer you hope. Return to your fortress, because today I will reward you with twice what you had.
translation_verse: Má mɩɩra mʋ ma dɩɩ-duoruŋ, ma-na dansarɩkaba sɩ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa. Lɛɛlɛ mɩ heele bʋl arɩ mɩ jaŋ bɩra pɩma kɩaa magɛ ŋɩɩ ma fa sɩ kɛnɛ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa.

english_verse: I will use Judah as my bow and Israel as my arrow. I will take the people of Zion as my sword and attack the Greeks. The Lord Will Protect His People
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Juda gʋɔrɛ a nagɛ mɩ sɩ gʋɔrɛ mɩ toŋ, dɩ Efirem nɛ ŋaa ʋ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Zaayɔŋ nɩaa nagɛ laalɩyuori babii-balɩŋ tokobiiŋ, dɩ mɩ kaa yuo Giriisi nɩaa.” La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɔ

english_verse: Like a cloud, the Lord God will appear over his people, and his arrows will flash like lightning. God will sound his trumpet and attack in a whirlwind from the south.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ kʋ chuguli ʋ nɩaa nyuŋ. Ʋ to-hɛŋŋɛɛ jaŋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ a nagɛ taŋ sɩɩ lɩgɩsʋ. La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ jaŋ ŋmʋʋ banyile, aŋ to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ pel-duoruŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will protect his people, and they will trample down the sharpshooters and their slingshots. They will drink and get rowdy; they will be as full as a bowl at the time of sacrifice.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ chu tɔ ʋ nɩaa lɛ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ kpalaa a yuo dii ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ. Ba jaŋ kpɩa goŋ laalɩŋ lɛ a nagɛ nɩaa sɩ nyʋa girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ a bugi. Ba jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ chalɩŋ jaasɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ joŋ chalɩŋ hɛ gbaŋa lɛ a mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ gʋnaa.

english_verse: The Lord God will save them on that day, because they are his people, and they will shine on his land like jewels in a crown.
translation_verse: Ba TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ laaba ta tapʋlɩɩ-la a tɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa ʋ nɩaa. Ba jaŋ tʋtʋl ʋ tinteeŋ lɛ a nagɛ kpɩɛraa ba sɩ joŋo hɛ kuori-nyunchuulo lɛ.

english_verse: How lovely they will be. Young people will grow there like grain in a field or grapes in a vineyard.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ ŋaa nɩa sɩ zɔmɔ a kɛŋ buno. Bapʋɔsaa jaŋ dii tintee-la kɩaa a waa woruŋ, dɩ hatoloo ma nyʋa girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ a kɛŋ buno.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am the one who sends storm clouds and showers of rain to make fields produce. So when the crops need rain, you should pray to me.
translation_verse: Má sʋl La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ pɩma yibiiniŋ. La TƖƖNA nɛ yie leŋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tɔ. Ʋ nɛ yie leŋ duonuŋ nɩɩ pɩ nɩaa, nʋʋkala kʋduuloo wasɛ.

english_verse: You can't believe idols and fortunetellers, or depend on the hope you receive from witchcraft and interpreters of dreams. But you have tried all of these, and now you are like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Tɔŋŋɔɔ ka nyɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ, vʋgʋraa ma nɩna wʋnyɩɛrɩ wɩaa a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ. Ba yie bʋl duosoo wɩaa sɩ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ. Ba yie nyagɛ nɩaa bɔyɛ pɛɩ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ leŋ nɩalɩŋ bɩbaarɛ a nagɛ piesee, ba nyagɛba bil a tɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ sɩpaalaara kɛnɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am fiercely angry with you leaders, and I will punish you. I care for my people, the nation of Judah, and I will change this flock of sheep into charging war horses.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ baanɩŋ sii sɩpaalaara-la nyuŋ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ sɩpaalaara-la, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ Tɩɩna jaŋ pɔ mɩ nɩaa, Juda nɩaa, a leŋ dɩ ba nagɛ jaaba sɩɩ tʋɔrʋ laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: From this flock will come leaders who will be strong like cornerstones and tent pegs and weapons of war.
translation_verse: Juda lɛ nɛ je-gʋnʋŋ tiebiiŋ jaŋ lɩɩ, ʋ lɛ nɛ lɛbɩŋ daapɛsɩŋ jaŋ lɩɩ, ʋ lɛ nɛ laalɩŋ toŋ jaŋ lɩɩ, ʋ lɛ nɛ sɩpaalaarʋ kala jaŋ lɩɩ.

english_verse: They will join in the fighting, and together they will trample their enemies like mud. They will fight, because I, the Lord, will be on their side. And they will crush the enemy cavalry.
translation_verse: Ba kala jaŋ ŋaa nɩduoru, a nʋɔsɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ŋmʋrɛ womporuŋ vʋchɔɔŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ ba teeŋ wɩaa, ba jaŋ yuo dii ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ja-jɩllaa.

english_verse: I will strengthen the kingdoms of Judah and Israel. And I will show mercy because I am the Lord, their God. I will answer their prayers and bring them home. Then it will seem as though I had never rejected them.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Juda nɩaa kɛŋ doluŋ aŋ laa Josɛf doho nɩaa ta. Mɩ jaŋ fá ba nenige a kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ dɩa. Ba jaŋ nagɛ nɩa mɩ fa sɩ bɩ vɩa ta, bɛɛ wɩaa, mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ jaŋ laa ba sʋla.

english_verse: Israel will be like a tribe of warriors celebrating with wine. When their children see this, they will also be happy because of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Efirem nɩaa jaŋ mɩɩra nagɛ nɩduoruŋ dɩ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ a nagɛ nɩa sɩ nyʋa girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ. Ba biiriŋ jaŋ na ŋɩɩ dɩ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, dɩ ba jʋjʋɔsɛ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA teeŋ.

english_verse: I will give a signal for them to come together because I have rescued them. And there will be as many as ever before.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ fʋʋla yɩrɛba a kɛmba kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ laaba ta, ba jaŋ bɩra yʋgɛ arɩ ba fa sɩ yʋga ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Although I scattered my people in distant countries, they won't forget me. Once their children are raised, they will return—
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛmba pɩsa hɛ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ tʋɔŋ ma nɛ, ama ba ha jaŋ liisi mɩ wɩaa tintee-bolie-la lɛ. Ba dɩ ba biiriŋ kala jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, a mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: I will bring them home from Egypt and Assyria, then let them settle as far as Gilead and Lebanon, until the land overflows with them.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba mɩɩra lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kɔ, a kɛmba lɩɩ Asiiria tinteeŋ ma kɔ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba kɔ Gɩlɩad arɩ Lɛbanɔŋ tinteyee dɩ ba paala su lee-la kala, dɩ leriŋ bɩra tuo.

english_verse: My people will go through an ocean of troubles, but I will overcome the waves and dry up the deepest part of the Nile. Assyria's great pride will be put down, and the power of Egypt will disappear.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ to wʋwalɩmaa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, a ŋmoo mʋgʋ-bal-la lɩɩ-peliŋ kala bil, dɩ Naayɩl fuo-la tʋɔŋ kala hɩl. Asiiria babii-ballɩŋ kala jaŋ tuu tinteeŋ, dɩ Ijipiti ma doluŋ kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: I'll strengthen my people because of who I am, and they will follow me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ doluŋ, a vɩvɛŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: Lebanon, open your gates! Let the fire come in to destroy your cedar trees.
translation_verse: Lɛbanɔŋ, kɛŋ ŋ borusuŋ suri dɩ nyiniŋ wuo dii ŋ kuolu tɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Cry, you cypress trees! The glorious cedars have fallen and are rotting. Cry, you oak trees of Bashan! The dense forest has been chopped down.
translation_verse: Bʋtʋma, ŋmoo niiŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa kuoluŋ tele nɛ. Ba chei tɩɩsɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ. Basaŋ chɛrɩ tɩɩsɩŋ, má ŋmoo niiŋ, ba keri duu-la sɩ faasa lugi tɩɩsɩŋ kala lo nɛ.

english_verse: Listen! Shepherds are crying. Their glorious pastures have been ruined. Listen! Lions are roaring. The forests of the Jordan Valley are no more to be found. Worthless Shepherds
translation_verse: Má jegile nɩɩ pie-daaraa sɩɩ ŋmoo niiŋ, ba chei ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee nɛ. Má jegile nɩɩ naachigee sɩɩ huosu, ba chei Jɔdaŋ duu-la tʋɔŋ ba sɩɩ pɩŋ nɛ. Pie-daaraa balɩa

english_verse: The Lord my God said to me: Tend those sheep doomed for slaughter!
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Daa piese-la ba sɩ magɩla dɩ ba kpʋ.

english_verse: The people who buy and butcher them go unpunished, while everyone who sells them says, “Praise the Lord! I'm rich.” Not even their shepherds have pity on them.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yɔɔba kpʋba nɛ aŋ mʋ, ka ba bɩ ba dɔgʋsɔ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yallɛba sɩ, ‘Má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, la ŋaa kɩa tɩmma nɛ.’ Ba dɩ-daaraa tɩtɩa bɩ ba nenige fá.

english_verse: Tend those sheep because I, the Lord, will no longer have pity on the people of this earth. I'll turn neighbor against neighbor and make them slaves of a king. They will bring disaster on the earth, and I'll do nothing to rescue any of them.
translation_verse: Mɩ ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ fá tintee-la nɩaa nenige, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nʋʋkala hɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna arɩ ʋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Nɩaa deemba jaŋ chei tintee-la, ka mɩ bɩ jaŋ laa nɩalɩŋ ta ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: So I became a shepherd of those sheep doomed to be slaughtered by the sheep dealers. And I gave names to the two sticks I used for tending the sheep: One of them was named “Mercy” and the other “Unity.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ daa piese-la ba sɩ magɩla dɩ ba kpʋ, a wasa nyaŋ piese-la ba sɩ nyaga bil. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ dantɩgɩsɩŋ balɩa a hɛ dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ Chonuŋ, dɔŋɔ ma Nii-maga, aŋ dɩdaa piese-la.

english_verse: In less than a month, I became impatient with three shepherds who didn't like me, and I got rid of them.
translation_verse: Mɩ kiri pie-daaraa batori chɛŋ bala tʋɔŋ. Piese-la bɛrɛmɛ, mɩ lɔl ba wɩaa

english_verse: Then I said, “I refuse to be your shepherd. Let the sheep that are going to die, go on and die, and those that are going to be destroyed, go on and be destroyed. Then let the others eat one another alive.”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa ma dɩdaara. Kɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ, ba sʋʋ, kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ lɛl, ba lɛl. Kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ka gʋra didii dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: On that same day, I broke the stick named “Mercy” to show that the Lord had canceled his agreement with all people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ mɩ dantɩga-la mɩ sɩɩ yɩrɛ Chonuŋ a boru, a chei nii-la mɩ sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala pɛgɛ.

english_verse: The sheep dealers who saw me knew at once that this was a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ chei nii-la nɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ ba tʋɔŋ fa sɩɩ bemmi jɩma arɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: I told them, “Pay me my wages, if you think you should; otherwise, forget it.” So they handed me my wages, a measly
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Joŋ warɩpʋla-la hɛ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la dʋa tʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ warɩpʋla mara arɩ fii-la, yal-zɔŋ-la ba sɩ bene dɩ ʋ magɛmɛ a hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bala-la dʋa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Then I broke the stick named “Unity” and canceled the ties between Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bori mɩ dantɩgɛ lɩa-la ma mɩ sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nii-maga, a chei naambiri-la fa sɩ hɛ Juda arɩ Iziral pɛgɛ.”

english_verse: Next, the Lord said to me, “Act like a shepherd again—this time a worthless shepherd.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Bɩra ŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ pie-daara. Ama bʋa deeŋ-na lɛ, ŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ pie-daarɩ tɔɔ.

english_verse: Once more I am going to let a worthless nobody rule the land—one who won't care for the strays or search for the young or heal the sick or feed the healthy. He will just dine on the fattest sheep, leaving nothing but a few bones.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ pie-daara tintee-la lɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ chɩl piese-la sɩ lɛlɛ wɩaa, koo a bee chɛ pie-biisiŋ koo a vaarɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ pɩra koo a pɩ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ dolie kʋdiilee. Ama ʋ jaŋ chaŋ piese-la sɩ zɔmɔ nammɩa, a fogi ba naachɛŋŋɛɛ.

english_verse: You worthless shepherd, deserting the sheep! I hope a sword will cripple your arm and blind your right eye.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu pie-daarɩ-tɔɔ-la sɩ vɩa piese-la ta. Ba jaŋ joŋ tokobiiŋ ta ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a tɔɔ ʋ nadiiŋ sɩɩŋ. A leŋ dɩ ʋ nɩsɩŋ sʋʋ, dɩ ʋ nadiiŋ sɩɩŋ ma nyʋlɩmɛ.”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord about Israel: I am the Lord! I stretched out the heavens; I put the earth on its foundations and gave breath to humans.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ Iziral lɛ nɛ ŋ-la. La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ a leŋ ʋ jɛrɛ, a ŋaa dʋnɩa gentine, a mɛ nuhuobiine a joŋ dɩma hɛ ʋ lɛ, wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: I have decided that Jerusalem will become a bowl of wine that makes the neighboring nations drunk. And when Jerusalem is attacked, Judah will also be attacked.
translation_verse: “Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Jerusalɛm nagɛ nyʋnyʋala girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ sɩ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ. Tinteye-la sɩ kpagʋ jaŋ nyʋa a bugi a gɩgɛrɛ. Nɩaa jaŋ kʋ golli Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm chu dɩ ba yuo.

english_verse: But I will turn Jerusalem into a heavy stone that crushes anyone who tries to lift it. When all nations on earth surround Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, dʋnɩa tinteyee kala sɩ jaŋ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a chɩŋ ʋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Jerusalɛm nagɛ bʋŋ sɩ bɩ jigisi a pɩ tinteye-la kala. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ nɛrɩgɛ dɩ ba jigisu jaŋ pɩrɛ ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: I will blind every horse and make them panic, and every rider will be confused. But at the same time, I will watch over Judah.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, mɩ jaŋ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a hɛ jɔɔ kala lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ba jɩjɩllaa ma nyɩnyaasɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. Mɩ jaŋ chaasa pɔ Juda nɩaa woruŋ, ama mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa janɩŋ kala nyʋlɩmɛ.

english_verse: Then every clan in Judah will realize that I, the Lord All-Powerful, am their God, and that I am the source of their strength.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juda sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ bʋl ba tʋɔŋ lɛ, ‘Jerusalɛm nɩaa kɛŋ doluŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ ba Wɩa.’

english_verse: At that time I will let the clans of Judah be like a ball of fire in a wood pile or a fiery torch in a hay stack. Then Judah will send the surrounding nations up in smoke. And once again the city of Jerusalem will be filled with people.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Juda sɩpaalaaraa nagɛ pupoiŋ sɩ chɔ dandʋla arɩ nyiniŋ lɛ, a nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ sɩɩ sii sekelee. Ba jaŋ dii nadiiŋ arɩ nagʋa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ golliba. Ama wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ ŋaa Jerusalɛm nɩaa-na lɛ.

english_verse: But I will first give victory to Judah, so the kingdom of David and the city of Jerusalem in all of their glory won't be thought of more highly than Judah itself.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ laa Juda nɩaa ta, dɩ yɩrɩ-la Devit doho nɩaa arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa sɩ jaŋ laa, sɩ́ Juda nɩaa kʋa kɩɩ.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will protect Jerusalem. Even the weakest person there will be as strong as David, and David's kingdom will rule as though my very own angel were its leader.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ chu tɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, dɩ ba tʋɔŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ paala pʋgʋsɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ kuoro Devit, dɩ Devit doho nɩaa ma nagɛ mɩ-na Wɩa, a nagɛ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ laa ba sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: I am determined to wipe out every nation that attacks Jerusalem. Mourning for the One Pierced with a Spear
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, mɩ jaŋ chei tinteye-la kala sɩɩ yuo Jerusalɛm. Ba yel nɩɩ-la ba sɩ tɔbɔ lɛ

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem feel deep sorrow and pray when they see the one they pierced with a spear. They will mourn and weep for him, as parents weep over the death of their only child or their first-born.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ Dɩma hɛ Devit doho nɩaa arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa lɛ, dɩ ba fɩfá nɩaa nenige aŋ chʋchʋɔlɛmɛ. Ba jaŋ bibeŋ mɩ-na nɩɩ-la ba sɩ tɔbɔ, a yel mɩ lɛ a nagɛ nɩa sɩɩ yel ʋ bii-bala lɛ. Ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ faasa chei a nagɛ nɩa tʋɔŋ sɩ cheye ʋ bii-bumbuŋ sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: On that day the people of Jerusalem will mourn as much as everyone did for Hadad Rimmon on the flatlands near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, yele jaŋ chaasa yʋgɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ a nagɛ ba sɩɩ yel Hadad Rimoŋ sɩ hɛ Megido tintee-taala lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone of each family in the land will mourn, and the men will mourn separately from the women. This includes those from the family of David, and the families of Nathan,
translation_verse: Tintee-la nɩaa jaŋ yel, dɩa na-kala nɩaa jaŋ yel, baalaa jaŋ yel ba dʋndʋŋ, dɩ haalaa ma yel ba dʋndʋŋ: Devit doho nɩaa arɩ ba haalaa, Netaŋ doho nɩaa arɩ ba haalaa,

english_verse: and all other families as well.
translation_verse: a pɛ do-kaana-la dɩa dɩa nɩaa arɩ ba haalaa lɛ.”

english_verse: In the future there will be a fountain, where David's descendants and the people of Jerusalem can wash away their sin and guilt.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ jaŋ suri lɩɩ-bul-sɩɩŋ a pɩ Devit doho nɩaa arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa, a chɛsɛ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ba disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: When that time comes, I will get rid of every idol in the country, and they will be forgotten forever. I will also do away with their prophets and those evil spirits that control them.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ yɩraa ta tintee-la lɛ, dɩ nɩaa bɩra sɩ́ ba wɩaa liisu. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla. Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩa wɩaa arɩ ba ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ jɩnsɩ-la sɩ kɛmba tɩtɩŋ ta tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: If any such prophets ever appear again, their own parents must warn them that they will die for telling lies in my name—the name of the Lord. If those prophets don't stop speaking, their parents must then kill them with a sword.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ ha pɛsɛ a nyɩɛ bʋbʋl wɩaa mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ-la sɩ lʋlʋ jaŋ bʋla pʋ, ‘Ʋ maga ba kpʋŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ.’ Dɩ ʋ nɛ nyɩɛ bʋl wɩaa mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ jaŋ tɔbʋ kpʋ.

english_verse: Those prophets will be ashamed of their so-called visions, and they won't deceive anyone by dressing like a true prophet.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ kala a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ laalɛ ʋ wʋnyɩɛrɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ gɛrɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ pʋnaa aa nyɩsɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: Instead, they will say, “I'm no prophet. I've been a farmer all my life.”
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ bʋl, ‘Mɩ bɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ ŋaa. Mɩ ŋaa paarʋ nɛ, mɩ pɛrɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bapʋɔsʋŋ kala lɛ.’

english_verse: And if any of them are asked why they are wounded, they will answer, “It happened at the house of some friends.” A Wounded Shepherd and Scattered Sheep
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ pɩɛsʋ, ‘Bɛɛ kɩaa naawɩɩla nɛ hɛ ŋ yaraa lɛ ŋɩɩ?’ Ʋ jaŋ bʋl, ‘Mɩ nandɔŋɔ dɩa lɛ nɛ ba pɩrɛmɛ.’ ” Ba kpʋ pie-daara ka piesee pɩsɛ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ, “Tokobiiŋ, sii chɩŋ mɩ pie-daara lɛ, sii chɩŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ kpagɛmɛ lɛ. Kpʋ pie-daarʋ-la, piese-la jaŋ pɩsɛ, ka dɩ mɩ joŋ sɩaa chaasɛ pie-biisi-la.”

english_verse: Then I will purify them and put them to the test, just as gold and silver are purified and tested. They will pray in my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “You are my people,” and they will reply, “You, Lord, are our God!”
translation_verse: Kʋbala deeŋ ma, mɩ jaŋ joŋu hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ wasɛba ta a nagɛ ba sɩ yie joŋ hɔpʋla hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ a lɩɩsɛ ʋ hɔɔ-bɩnɩŋ ta ŋɩɩ. Mɩ jaŋ magɩsɛba na a nagɛ ba sɩ yie joŋ sɛlɩmɛ hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ a magɩsa na ʋ zɔmʋŋ ŋɩɩ. Ba jaŋ yɩrɛmɛ dɩ mɩ sɛɩ. Mɩ jaŋ bʋl, ‘Ba ŋaa mɩ nɩaa nɛ,’ dɩ ba ma bʋl, ‘La TƖƖNA nɛ la Wɩa.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord will have his day. And when it comes, everything that was ever taken from Jerusalem will be returned and divided among its people.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA tapʋlʋŋ ka kɔ nɛ, ba jaŋ paa ma dʋa a kaa kpaa ma sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But first, he will bring many nations to attack Jerusalem—homes will be robbed, women raped, and half of the population dragged off, though the others will be allowed to remain.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tinteyee nɩaa kala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba yuo Jerusalɛm. Ba jaŋ yuo laa tabal-la, a paa ba dɩɩsɩŋ kɩaa, aŋ gurigi ba haalaa. Tabal-la nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ jaŋ mʋ yoŋ-baga, ama nɩkaanaa jaŋ ka tabal-la lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will attack those nations like a warrior fighting in battle.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ lɩɩ yuo tinteye-la, a nagɛ ʋ fa sɩ yuo laalɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: He will take his stand on the Mount of Olives east of Jerusalem, and the mountain will split in half, forming a wide valley that runs from east to west.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, ʋ naasɩŋ jaŋ chɩŋ Olif tɩɩsɩŋ Peel-la nyuŋ, Jerusalɛm wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, ka dɩ Olif tɩɩsɩŋ Peel-la kpaa balɩa, a chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ, a leŋ dɩ lɩɩ-libi-bal pɩŋ ba pɛgɛ, dɩ peel-la kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa, dɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ma hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ.

english_verse: Then you people will escape from the Lord's mountain, through this valley, which reaches to Azal. You will run in all directions, just as everyone did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. Afterwards, the Lord my God will appear with his holy angels.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ fá to lɩɩ-libe-la, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Azɛl. Ma jaŋ fá a nagɛ ma sɩ fá lɩɩ tinteeŋ sɩ zigile lɛ ŋɩɩ Juda kuoro Uzia kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ. Mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ kɔ, ʋ dɩ ʋ tɩndaaraa kala.

english_verse: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, pʋlʋmʋŋ jaŋ tuo, waarɩŋ koo bʋrʋŋ ma jaŋ tuo.

english_verse: And the Lord has decided when it will happen—this time of unending day.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la jaŋ ŋaa tapʋl-dabaŋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ koo tɩtaŋɩŋ, dɩ wɩa nɛ jʋa ma, leriŋ ha jaŋ pʋllɛ. La TƖƖNA dʋndʋŋa nɛ jɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la.

english_verse: In both summer and winter, life-giving streams will flow from Jerusalem, half of them to the Dead Sea in the east and half to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la, lɩɩŋ sɩɩ pa mɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ pɛllɛ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ, kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ jaŋ pɛllɛ mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ, dɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ma pɛllɛ mʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ, yibiiniŋ arɩ tafaaŋ kala.

english_verse: Then there will be only one Lord who rules as King and whose name is worshiped everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋaa dʋnɩa kala kuoro. Tapʋlɩɩ-la, La TƖƖNA dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ba jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.
translation_verse: Nyanyal-bɔŋ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ joŋo hɛ tinteyee nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ yuo Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Ba yaraa jaŋ pʋa, ka dɩ ba ha wei. Ba sɩaa jaŋ pʋa hɛ ba sɩɩ-gbanlonnuŋ lɛ. Ba nandelimee ma jaŋ pʋa hɛ ba niiree lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will make them go into a frenzy and start attacking each other,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a hɛ nɩaa lɛ. Nʋʋkala jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ yuyuo.

english_verse: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ kʋ yuo Jerusalɛm aŋ bɩ sʋba, jaŋ mʋ jɩna na-kala a chʋɔlɛ Kuoro sɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA doluŋ Tɩɩna, aŋ pɛ gbieli lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele.

english_verse: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Dɩ dʋnɩa tinteye-la kʋŋkala nɩaa nɛ bɩ Jerusalɛm mʋa a chʋɔlɛ kuoro sɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, duonuŋ bɩ jaŋ nɩɩ pɩba.

english_verse: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.
translation_verse: Dɔgɩsɩnɔ-la sɩ jaŋ puu Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ tinteye-la kala sɩ bɩ mʋ gbieli lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele-la nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: At that time the words “Dedicated to the Lord” will be engraved on the bells worn by horses. In fact, every ordinary cooking pot in Jerusalem will be just as sacred to the Lord All-Powerful as the bowls used at the altar. Any one of them will be acceptable for boiling the meat of sacrificed animals, and there will no longer be a need to sell special pots and bowls.
translation_verse: Pupoi na-kala sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda lɛ, jaŋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna kɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ jaŋ joŋ puposu-la dɔnsʋŋ a kaa chɔ nammɩa. Bʋa-la lɛ, bayala kala bɩ jaŋ hɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: I am Malachi. And this is the message that the Lord gave me for Israel. The Lord's Love for Israel
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ Malakaɩ dɩ ʋ bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋ-la. La TƖƖNA cho Jekɔb aŋ bɛrɛ Ɛsɔ

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, have loved you. And yet you ask in what way have I loved you. Don't forget that Esau was the brother of your ancestor Jacob, but I chose Jacob
translation_verse: “Iziral tɩmma, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, mɩ choma nɛ. Ama ma ha yie pɩɛsɛ, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ daga arɩ ŋ chola nɛ?’ Má liisi arɩ Ɛsɔ fa ŋaa Jekɔb malɩma nɛ, ka mɩ lɩɩsɛ Jekɔb a cho ʋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa kala,

english_verse: instead of Esau. And I turned Esau's hill country into a barren desert where jackals roam.
translation_verse: aŋ bɛrɛ Ɛsɔ wɩaa a leŋ ʋ tinteeŋ sɩ kɛŋ peelee pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a bɩrɩmɛ jolluŋ dɩ-gɔllʋŋ.

english_verse: Esau's descendants may say, “Although our nation Edom is in ruins, we will rebuild it.” But I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise to tear down whatever they build. Then everyone will know that I will never stop being angry with them as long as they are so sinful.
translation_verse: Ɛsɔ doho nɩaa jaŋ wuo bʋl, ‘La tasɩŋ kala cheye nɛ, ama la jaŋ bɩra saaba.’ ” Ama wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Ba jaŋ saa, ama mɩ jaŋ chei lere-la kala ba sɩ saa. Nɩaa jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ lee-la nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ tinteeŋ, nɩalɩŋ nyuŋ La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ sɩɩ sii bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Israel, when you see this, you will shout, “The Lord's great reputation reaches beyond our borders.” Judgment against Priests
translation_verse: Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa tɩtɩa jaŋ na wɩɩŋ deeŋ, a bʋl, ‘La TƖƖNA chaasa kɛŋ doluŋ a kieli Iziral tinteeŋ mʋ dɩ-bolii nɛ.’ ” Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something to say to you priests. Children respect their fathers, and servants respect their masters. I am your father and your master, so why don't you respect me? You priests have insulted me, and now you ask, “How did we insult you?”
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ, “Biiriŋ yie zizil ba nyɩmmaba nɛ, tɩntɩnnaa ma zizil ba nɩhɩasɩŋ. Mɩ-na nɛ ŋaa ma nyɩmma, a ŋaa ma nɩhɩaŋ ma. Wʋbɛɛ nɛ saa ma ŋaa a zizilmi? Ma Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, ma sɩɩŋ jʋʋmɛ nɛ, aŋ lɛɛlɛ pɩɛsɛ, ‘Sɩɩ-jʋʋ wʋbɛɛ nɛ la ŋaa ŋ-na La Tɩɩna lɛ?’

english_verse: You embarrass me by offering worthless food on my altar. Then you ask, “How have we embarrassed you?” You have done it by saying, “What's so great about the Lord's altar?”
translation_verse: Ma joŋ kʋdiile-la sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ mɩ koruŋ nyuŋ, aŋ pɩɛsɛ, ‘Bɛɛ kʋŋ sɩɩ-jʋʋ wɩɩ nɛ la ŋaa?’ Sɩɩ-jʋʋ wɩɩ-la ma sɩ ŋaa nɛ, ma sɩ joŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ a daŋ mɩ koruŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: But isn't it wrong to offer animals that are blind, lame, or sick? Just try giving those animals to your governor. That certainly wouldn't please him or make him want to help you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ sɩ nyʋlɩma a kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩmɛ, wʋbɔŋ dee ŋɩɩ? Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ sɩ gbɛrɩgɛ koo a wʋwɩɩlɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, wʋbɔŋ dee ŋɩɩ? Dɩ ma joŋ pʋŋ dosunu-la a pɩ ma tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ, ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ? Ʋ jaŋ sɛɩ a ŋaa wʋzɔŋ pɩmaa?”

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ, “Ma Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, má sʋl mɩ-na Wɩa dɩ mɩ fá ma nenige a laa ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa. Dɩ mɩ nɛ vɩa, ma nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ.

english_verse: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa cho dɩ ma dɔŋɔ kɛŋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la borusuŋ kaa yagɛ nɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma sɩ́ kɩaa sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ nyɩgʋ mɩ koruŋ nyuŋ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ bɩ ma Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nyuŋ tɔrɔ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ bɩ jaŋ laa ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: From dawn until dusk my name is praised by every nation on this earth, as they burn incense and offer the proper sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa jaŋ zilmi a chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ. Lee na-kala ba jaŋ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ aŋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la sɩ maga a pɩmɛ. Tinteyee nɩaa kala jaŋ yɩrɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: But even you priests insult me by saying, “There's nothing special about the Lord's altar, and these sacrifices are worthless.”
translation_verse: Ama ma sɩɩŋ jʋʋmɛ nɛ ma sɩ yie bʋl arɩ mɩ koru-la bɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kɛnɛ aŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋdiile-la ma tɩtɩa sɩ bɩ chɛ a daŋ ʋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?
translation_verse: Ma yie bʋl, ‘La lɔl wɩaa deemba kala lɛ nɛ,’ aŋ kɛŋ ma sɩaa chei mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nyuŋ. Ma yie gaa pʋsʋŋ nɛ koo a kɛŋ pʋsʋ-la sɩ gbɛrɩgɛ koo a nyʋlɩmɛ a kaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ma bɩɩna mɩ jaŋ sɛɩ a laaba ma teeŋ? Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: Instead of offering the acceptable animals you have promised, you bring me those that are unhealthy. I will punish you for this, because I am the great King, the Lord All-Powerful, and I am worshiped by nations everywhere.
translation_verse: Ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ ta niiŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna teeŋ, arɩ ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ pʋŋ-bel-zɔmʋŋ pɩmɛ aŋ vɩa dɩ ʋ kɛŋ pʋŋ-zɔŋ-la lɩɩsɛ nii-la aŋ mɩɩra sii kɛŋ pʋna sɩ kɛŋ nyɔɔŋ. Mɩ ŋaa kuoru-bal nɛ, tinteyee nɩaa kala fɩfámɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something else to say to you priests.
translation_verse: “Mɩ-na, ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna kɛŋ wɩɩ nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩ ma Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa.

english_verse: You had better take seriously the need to honor my name. Otherwise, when you give a blessing, I will turn it into a curse. In fact, I have already done this, because you haven't taken to heart your duties as priests.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ jegile nɩɩ, a bɩ ma tʋɔŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ma zilmi, mɩ jaŋ joŋ ŋmɩaŋ hɛ ma lɛ a kɛŋ wʋzɔmɔ-la mɩ fa sɩ ŋaa pɩma kaa bɩrɩmɛ ŋmɩaŋ, dɩ ʋ dii ma kala. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ paala daŋa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ma lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma bɩ ma tʋɔŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ma zilmi.

english_verse: I will punish your descendants and rub your faces in the manure from your animal sacrifices, and then be done with you.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ ma doho nɩaa aŋ kɛŋ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ bɩnɩŋ taarɛ ma sɩaa, aŋ yigima ta.

english_verse: I am telling you this, so I can continue to keep my agreement with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩpɩma, dɩ nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ma naabalɩma Levi pɛgɛ ha wuo chɩŋ.

english_verse: I blessed him with a full life, as I had promised, and he kept his part of the agreement by honoring me and respecting my name.
translation_verse: Nii-la mɩ sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ Levi doho nɩaa pɛgɛ, mɩ bʋla pɩba arɩ ba jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ nɛ, a sɛnɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩba. Ba ma sɛɩ a to wɩalɩŋ a zizilmi.

english_verse: He taught the truth and never told lies, and he led a lot of people to turn from sin, because he obeyed me and lived right.
translation_verse: Ba to wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a bɩ wɩaa nyɩɛ, a dagɛ nɩ-daŋ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Ba to mɩ nɛ a ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ma Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ maga dɩ ma dagɛ nɩaa dɩ ba jɩŋ mɩ wɩaa. Nɩaa maga dɩ ba kɔ ma teeŋ nɛ a gʋnnɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba jɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma nɛ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna tɩndaaraa.

english_verse: But you have turned your backs on me. Your teachings have led others to do sinful things, and you have broken the agreement I made with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ, ma vɩa wɩalɩŋ ta nɛ, ma wʋdagaa mɩɩra leŋ nɩ-daŋ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ wɩaa. Ma chei nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ma naabalɩma Levi pɛgɛ nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: So I caused everyone to hate and despise you, because you disobeyed me and failed to treat all people alike. A Broken Agreement
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ leŋ nʋʋkala hɩhɛ ma hɩɩsɩŋ a bɩ ma kaa tɩtɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma vɩa dɩ ma to mɩ wombiee nɛ aŋ dii sarɩya a laa pɩpɛ ma nɩchooloo lɛ.” Juda nɩaa bɩ La TƖƖNA to arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ

english_verse: Don't you know that we all have God as our Father? Didn't the one God create each of us? Then why do you cheat each other by breaking the agreement God made with your ancestors?
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ la kala nyɩmma ŋaa kʋbala nɛɛ? Wɩɩ-bala-la nɛ ta la kala. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ la gʋgʋrɛ dɔŋɔ a chichei nii-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa arɩ la naabalɩmaba pɛgɛ?

english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Juda nɩaa bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ joŋo to La TƖƖNA. Ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Jerusalɛm arɩ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ. Juda tinteeŋ nɩaa ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ Wɩa dɩa-la ʋ sɩ cho lɛ nɛ. Ba baalaa jaa haalaa sɩ lɩɩ tintee-wogusuŋ nɛ a kpʋkpaarɛ vesiŋ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa lɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ ta, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba pɛ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ la tinteeŋ nɩaa sɩ yie kaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la dɔŋɔ ma sɩ ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: Ma yie yel sɩlɩɩrɩŋ su La TƖƖNA koruŋ nɛ, a chaasa yiyel a ŋmuŋmoo niiŋ a tɩŋ ʋ bɩra sɩ bɩ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ka laa wɩaa.

english_verse: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.
translation_verse: Ma yie pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bɩ la Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ka laa?” Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ nɛ ŋ-la: La TƖƖNA na arɩ ma kʋŋkala bɩ tɛŋɛ joŋo tuto ŋ bapʋɔsɛ haala lɛ. Ma fa hɛ niiŋ ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ arɩ ma dɩ ba nɛ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ma chei nii-la nɛ.

english_verse: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA ŋaa haala arɩ ʋ bala ba kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ ba wɩɩwɩɩ kala lɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ? Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ma wuo lʋl hambiisiŋ sɩ jaŋ tuto Wɩa nɛ. Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ a pʋpɔ ma sɩ́ nii-la ma kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ pɩ ŋ bapʋɔsɛ haala chei.

english_verse: You have worn out the Lord with your words. And yet, you ask, “How did we do that?” You did it by saying, “The Lord is pleased with evil and doesn't care about justice.”
translation_verse: Ma wʋbʋlaa leŋe La TƖƖNA lɔl nɛ. Ama ma yie pɩɛsɛ, “Ɛɛ nɛ la ŋaa leŋ La TƖƖNA lɔl?” A tɩŋ ma sɩ yie bʋl, “Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Ʋ tʋɔŋ ka tɔrɛ ba nyuŋ nɛ.” Koo ma pɩɛsɛ, “Nɩɩ nɛ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ hɛ?”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way. A Day of Change
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ mɩ tɩndaara dɩ ʋ kʋ wasɛ wombiiŋ a bil mɩ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ ma Tɩɩna-la ma sɩ bee chɩchɛ jaŋ guu kʋ jʋʋ ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ. Tɩndaarʋ-la ma sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ wɩaa polli.”

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: Ama ma tʋɔŋ kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo nyalɩma gbɛrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ kɔ? Dɩ ʋ nɩɩ kɔ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ? Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ libire sɩ lɩɩsɛ hɔɔŋ sɩ fɩɛsa nyiniŋ lɛ koo chɛnfɛnnɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ niiŋ ba kaa chɩchɛsɛ kɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord will purify the descendants of Levi, as though they were gold or silver. Then they will bring the proper offerings to the Lord,
translation_verse: Tɩndaarʋ-la jaŋ kʋ chɛsɛ Levi doho nɩaa dɩ ba lɩɩ a nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ koo hɔpʋla ba sɩ joŋo hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ a lɩɩsɛ hɔɔ-bɩnɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba kɛŋ kɩaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pʋ,

english_verse: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past. Don't Cheat God
translation_verse: dɩ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ, arɩ ba fa sɩɩ tɔrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ bumbuŋ-la.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: I'm now on my way to judge you. And I will quickly condemn all who practice witchcraft or cheat in marriage or tell lies in court or rob workers of their pay or mistreat widows and orphans or steal the property of foreigners or refuse to respect me.
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ kɔ a guu dii ma sarɩya. Mɩ jaŋ guu dagɛ nɩaa deemba wʋcheelee. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa chichiribi wɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ gʋrɛ ba tɩntɩnnaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛ yo-haalaa arɩ biisinsiŋ koo a gʋgʋrɛ nɩwogusuŋ. Nɩaa deemba kala bɩ mɩ ka fá. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ gaa Wɩa kɩaa

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: Jekɔb doho nɩaa, mɩ-na nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, mɩ bɩ bɩrɩmɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɩ ma cheye ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: Ma naabalɩmaba bʋa lɛ nɛ ma suomo vɩa mɩ niiŋ wɩaa a bɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ dagɛma ka to. Dɩ ma nɛ mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ ma jaŋ kɔ ma teeŋ. Ama ma yie pɩɛsɛ, ‘Ɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaa a mɩɩra kɔ ŋ teeŋ?’

english_verse: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, “How are we robbing you?” You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ nʋʋ gaa Wɩa nɛɛ? Ama maa gaa mɩ nɛ aŋ yie pɩɛsɛ, ‘Ɛɛ nɛ laa gaaŋ?’ Maa gaa mɩ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ yie kaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩmɛ arɩ kpaalɩŋ fii tʋɔŋ kʋbala-la sɩ ŋaa mɩ kʋa nɛ.

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Ŋmɩaŋ ka dii ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa maa gaa mɩ nɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ kpaalɩŋ fii tʋɔŋ kʋbala-la sɩ ŋaa mɩ kʋa kaa kɔ mɩ dɩa, dɩ kʋdiilee pʋrɩgɛ nɩmɛ. Má magɩsɛmɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ a na. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Wɩa-jaŋ suri a pɛ ma lɛ arɩ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ma sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo na dɩ-biliŋ a bilba. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.

english_verse: I will also stop locusts from destroying your crops and keeping your vineyards from producing.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ diiree chei ma baga kɩaa, ma girep tɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ chaasa nɛŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tinteyee kala yɩyɩrɛma nyu-sɩŋ tɩmma, bɛɛ wɩaa ma tinteeŋ jaŋ chaasa ŋaa dɩ-zɔŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.”

english_verse: You have said horrible things about me, and yet you ask, “What have we said?”
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Ma bʋl wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ nɛ a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ, aŋ yie pɩɛsɛ, ‘Wʋbɛɛ nɛ la bʋl a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ?’

english_verse: Here is what you have said: “It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ma sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Ʋ ŋaa wʋpɛɩ nɛ dɩ la nɩɩ to Wɩa. Wʋzɔŋ bɛɛba nɛ la na bʋa-la lɛ la sɩ to wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ dagɛla a kɛŋ la tɩtɩa muuri La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩpaaŋ a dagɛ arɩ la tʋɔŋ chei la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ?

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: La-na sɩ bene, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɔ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ kɛŋ kɩaa, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ paala magɩsɛ Wɩa yie lɩɩ nɛ suo.’ ”

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ fá La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa dɔŋɔba teeŋ, La TƖƖNA jegile nɩɩ, aŋ leŋ ba ŋmʋnsɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ fáʋ a zizilu yɩraa hɛ teniŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ liliisi ba wɩaa.

english_verse: Then the Lord All-Powerful said: You people are precious to me, and when I come to bring justice, I will protect you, just as parents protect an obedient child.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bʋl, “Ma nɛ jaŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ tɩɩ a choma woruŋ dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ dɩ mɩ dii nɩaa sarɩya. Mɩ jaŋ fá ma nenige a nagɛ nyɩmma sɩ yie fá ʋ bie sɩɩ to ʋ niiŋ nenige ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋkala jaŋ na dabaŋ-la sɩ hɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ pɛgɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to mɩ-na Wɩa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ mɩ ka to.”

english_verse: The day of judgment is certain to come. And it will be like a red-hot furnace with flames that burn up proud and sinful people, as though they were straw. Not a branch or a root will be left. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ, “Tapʋlɩɩ jaŋ yi dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa kala dii nyiniŋ a nagɛ sekelee. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ ka.

english_verse: But for you that honor my name, victory will shine like the sun with healing in its rays, and you will jump around like calves at play.
translation_verse: Ama, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ zilmi, mɩ doluŋ jaŋ hɛ ma lɛ a nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩ ma duori. Ma jaŋ lɩɩ fɩla jʋɔsɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ nɛ-biiriŋ suro ta ba lɩɩ jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: When I come to bring justice, you will trample those who are evil, as though they were ashes under your feet. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ ma jaŋ nʋɔsɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bil, dɩ ba nagɛ tʋɔrʋŋ ma naasɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to send the prophet Elijah before that great and terrible day comes.
translation_verse: Ama ka dɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA tapʋl-bal-la sɩ faasa kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ-na yi, mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ mɩ wʋlaabʋlla Ɩlaaja dɩ ʋ kɔ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: He will lead children and parents to love each other more, so that when I come, I won't bring destruction to the land.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ nyɩmmaba arɩ biiriŋ bɩra hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba sɩŋ, dɩ ba nɛ bɩ sɛyɛ mɩ jaŋ kɔ a chei ma tinteeŋ kala gbelem gbelem.”

english_verse: “A virgin will have a baby boy, and he will be called Immanuel,” which means “God is with us.”
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ʋ fa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: “Hatolo kʋbala ha sɩ bɩ baal jɩŋ jaŋ kɛŋ luoruŋ a lʋl hambolibie. Ba jaŋ hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Ɩmanʋɛl.”

english_verse: From the exile to the birth of Jesus, his ancestors were: Jehoiachin, Shealtiel, Zerubbabel, Abiud, Eliakim, Azor, Zadok, Achim; Eliud, Eleazar, Matthan, Jacob, and Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus, who is called the Messiah.
translation_verse: Jekɔb ma sii lʋl Josɛf, Josɛf nɛ saa jaa Mɛɛrɩ. Mɛɛrɩ nɛ lʋl Yesu, Nɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kirisito.

english_verse: more to the birth of the Messiah. The Birth of Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: Azɔ ma sii lʋl Zadɔk, Zadɔk ma sii lʋl Akɩm, Akɩm ma sii lʋl Ɛlɩʋt.

english_verse: This is how Jesus Christ was born. A young woman named Mary was engaged to Joseph from King David's family. But before they were married, she learned that she was going to have a baby by God's Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ba ŋaa a lʋl Yesu Kirisito. Josɛf nɛ fa sʋgɛ ʋ naaŋ Mɛɛrɩ dɩ ʋ jaa. Ka dɩ ba-na jaa dɔŋɔ, Mɛɛrɩ na dɩ ʋ kɛŋ luoruŋ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ nɛ hɛ pʋ.

english_verse: Joseph was a good man and did not want to embarrass Mary in front of everyone. So he decided to quietly call off the wedding.
translation_verse: Josɛf fa ŋaa nɩpʋla nɛ. Ʋ fa bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ hɩɩsɛ Mɛɛrɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ vɩaʋ.

english_verse: While Joseph was thinking about this, an angel from the Lord appeared to him in a dream. The angel said, “Joseph, the baby that Mary will have is from the Holy Spirit. Go ahead and marry her.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa sɩɩ bɩɩnɛ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa tɩndaara kɔ ʋ teeŋ arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Josɛf, Devit doho nʋʋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ jaa Mɛɛrɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa luoru-la ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ nɛ hɛ pʋ.

english_verse: Then after her baby is born, name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ lʋl baal, ŋ jaŋ hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Yesu, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ jaŋ laa ʋ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta.”

english_verse: After Joseph woke up, he and Mary were soon married, just as the Lord's angel had told him to do.
translation_verse: Josɛf sɩ sii doŋ lɛ, ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ bʋla pʋ a jaa Mɛɛrɩ.

english_verse: But they did not sleep together before her baby was born. Then Joseph named him Jesus.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ jaaʋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ dɩ ʋ bɩ dɔŋɔ jɩŋ, ka ʋ lʋl ʋ hatol-bie. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Yesu.

english_verse: When King Herod heard about this, he was worried, and so was everyone else in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kuoro Hɛrɔd fa sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, wɩɩ-la walɩmɛ ʋ dɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: Herod brought together the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses and asked them, “Where will the Messiah be born?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba ba kʋ hilimi. Ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Nɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ lʋl Kirisito, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa?”

english_verse: They told him, “He will be born in Bethlehem, just as the prophet wrote,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pʋ, “Ba jaŋ lʋlʋ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm lɛ, Judiya tinteeŋ. Ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa fa ŋmʋnsɛ:

english_verse: ‘Bethlehem in the land of Judea, you are very important among the towns of Judea. From your town will come a leader, who will be like a shepherd for my people Israel.’ ”
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ, ‘Bɛtɩlɛhɛm ŋaa tabie nɛ Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ. Ama Judiya tinteeŋ kala lɛ, Bɛtɩlɛhɛm nɩaa nɛ ŋaa nɩbalaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba tʋɔŋ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaara jaŋ lɩɩ, nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ beŋ mɩ nɩaa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa.’ ”

english_verse: Herod secretly called in the wise men and asked them when they had first seen the star.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hɛrɔd lʋara yɩrɛ wʋjɩnna-la sɩ lɩɩ taŋ-bʋbʋɔŋ mʋ pɩɛsɛba dɩ ba dagʋ bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ chɛnwʋl-la sɩ lɩa. Ba daga pʋ.

english_verse: He told them, “Go to Bethlehem and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, let me know. I also want to go and worship him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hɛrɔd taba dɩ ba mʋ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm, aŋ bʋla pɩba, “Má mʋ chɛ bile arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ naʋ, má leŋ dɩ mɩ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ niiŋ lɛ, a ma mʋ chʋɔlʋ.”

english_verse: The wise men listened to what the king said and then left. And the star they had seen in the east went on ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ba lɩɩ joŋ wombiiŋ a mʋmʋ. Chɛnwʋl-la ba fa sɩ na taŋ-bʋbʋɔŋ bɩra laa ba sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: They were thrilled and excited to see the star.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra sɩ na chɛnwʋl-la, ba tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ, ba jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: When the men went into the house and saw the child with Mary, his mother, they knelt down and worshiped him. They took out their gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh and gave them to him.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋ yi lee-la bii-mulo-la sɩ hɛ, chɛnwʋl-la chɩŋ dɩa-la nyuŋ. Ba mʋ jʋʋ dɩa-la a na bii-mulo-la arɩ Mɛɛrɩ, ʋ naaŋ. Ba tuu kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba puri ba chʋgʋsʋŋ a lɩɩsɛ kɩaa pʋ: Sɛlɩmɛ, tɩɩ-kel-zɔŋ baa yɩrɛ fɩraŋkɩsɛŋ arɩ tɩɩ-kel-zɔŋ dɔŋɔ baa yɩrɛ mɛɛ.

english_verse: Later they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, and they went back home by another road. The Escape to Egypt
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa duosoo tʋɔŋ arɩ ba sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ Hɛrɔd teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sii a to wombii-wogo a mɩɩra mʋ ba jaŋ. Josɛf arɩ Mɛɛrɩ fá mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ

english_verse: After the wise men had gone, an angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up! Hurry and take the child and his mother to Egypt! Stay there until I tell you to return, because Herod is looking for the child and wants to kill him.”
translation_verse: Wʋjɩnna-la sɩ mʋa, Josɛf pɩŋ doŋ a duosi a na Wɩa tɩndaara dɩ ʋ kɔ ʋ teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Sii a joŋ bii-mulo-la arɩ ʋ naaŋ a fá mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a hɛ nɩmɛ see dɩ mɩ bɩra bʋla pɩŋ dɩ ŋ lɩɩ nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Hɛrɔd ka chɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋ bii-mulo-la nɛ.”

english_verse: That night, Joseph got up and took his wife and the child to Egypt,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sii a joŋ bii-mulo-la arɩ ʋ naaŋ a mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ. Ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ deeŋ deeŋ Hɛrɔd kʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: where they stayed until Herod died. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “I called my son out of Egypt.” The Killing of the Children
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa dɩ wɩɩ-la Wɩa fa sɩ to ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ bʋl kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ fa bʋla arɩ ʋ jaŋ yɩrɛ ʋ nanʋala dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kɔ. Ba kpʋ hambolibiisiŋ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm lɛ

english_verse: When Herod found out that the wise men from the east had tricked him, he was very angry. He gave orders for his men to kill all the boys who lived in or near Bethlehem and were two years old and younger. This was based on what he had learned from the wise men.
translation_verse: Hɛrɔd sɩ na arɩ wʋjɩnna-la nyɩsʋ nɛ, ʋ faasa na baanɩŋ. Wʋjɩnna-la fa sɩ dagʋ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ lʋl Yesu ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ta ʋ laalɩyuoroo dɩ ba mʋ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm tabiisi-la kala sɩ gollu chu a kpʋ hambolibiisi-la kala ha sɩ bɩ jɩsɩŋ balɩa kiele.

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet Jeremiah had said,
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ŋ-la wɩaa wɩɩ-la Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Jɛrɩmaaya fa sɩ bʋla kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: “In Ramah a voice was heard crying and weeping loudly. Rachel was mourning for her children, and she refused to be comforted, because they were dead.” The Return from Egypt
translation_verse: Ʋ fa sɩ: “Nʋʋ nɩɩ yel Rama lɛ. Nɩɩ-la faasa yiyel nɛ. Rakɛl ka yel ʋ biiriŋ wɩaa nɛ. Ʋʋ yel nɛ a bɩ sɛɩ dɩ ba nyagɛ ʋ bɔyɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ biiriŋ kala sʋba nɛ.” Josɛf arɩ Mɛɛrɩ mɩɩra mʋ Nazarɛt

english_verse: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph while he was still in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hɛrɔd kʋ sʋʋ. Ʋ sɩ sʋba ŋɩɩ, Josɛf bɩra duosi Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, a na Wɩa tɩndaara dɩ ʋ kɔ ʋ teeŋ a bʋla pʋ,

english_verse: The angel said, “Get up and take the child and his mother back to Israel. The people who wanted to kill him are now dead.”
translation_verse: “Sii a kɛŋ bii-mulo-la arɩ ʋ naaŋ a mɩɩra mʋ Iziral tinteeŋ. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋ bii-mulo-la, ba sʋba nɛ.”

english_verse: Joseph got up and left with them for Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sii kɛŋ bile arɩ ʋ naaŋ a kaa mʋ Iziral tinteeŋ.

english_verse: But when he heard that Herod's son Archelaus was now ruler of Judea, he was afraid to go there. Then in a dream he was told to go to Galilee,
translation_verse: Ama Josɛf sɩ nɩa arɩ Hɛrɔd sʋba, ka ʋ nanʋala Akɩlɩas laa ʋ nyuŋ dii kuoruŋ Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ, fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛnʋ arɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bɩra bʋla pʋ duosoo tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ mʋ hɔŋ Galilii tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and they went to live there in the town of Nazareth. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “He will be called a Nazarene.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mʋ Galilii tinteeŋ, ʋ mʋ hɔŋ taŋ kʋbala lɛ baa yɩrɛ Nazarɛt. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa fa sɩ bʋla kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ba fa bʋla: “Ba jaŋ kɛnʋ yɩrɛ Nazarɛt tɩɩna.”

english_verse: Do something to show you have really given up your sins.
translation_verse: Máa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ ma bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ,

english_verse: He said, “Turn back to God! The kingdom of heaven will soon be here.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Má bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa kuorii-la kpaga nɛ.”

english_verse: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.
translation_verse: Jɔɔŋ gɛnnɩŋ fa ŋaa bʋntaŋŋa pʋnaa nɛ ba kaa sʋa, ʋ kɛŋ tembiiŋ vɔɔ ʋ tɩŋa. Ʋ kʋdiilee nɛ fa nyaŋgɩrɩgɛba arɩ tʋʋŋ.

english_verse: From Jerusalem and all Judea and from the Jordan River Valley crowds of people went to John.
translation_verse: Nɩaa lɩɩ Jerusalɛm arɩ Judiya tinteeŋ kala arɩ tasɩ-la kala sɩ golli Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a kɔ ʋ teeŋ,

english_verse: They told how sorry they were for their sins, and he baptized them in the river.
translation_verse: a dagɛ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ tuu Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, ʋ foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Many Pharisees and Sadducees also came to be baptized. But John said to them: You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Jɔɔŋ na Farisii tɩŋŋaa arɩ Saduusi tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba yʋga a kʋkɔ ʋ teeŋ dɩ ʋ foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ. Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma nɩaa deemba wʋŋaalaa nagɛ dɩŋŋaa nɛ. Ma bɩɩna ma jaŋ wuo fá lɛl chɛɛ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii nʋʋkala sarɩyaa?

english_verse: An ax is ready to cut the trees down at their roots. Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into a fire.
translation_verse: Na, ba kɛŋ saaŋ jee nɛ a ŋaa siri dɩ ba keri tɩɩsɩŋ lo. Tɩa-la kala sɩ bɩ nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ ka nɛŋ, ba jaŋ keru lo a joŋo hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ.

english_verse: His threshing fork is in his hand, and he is ready to separate the wheat from the husks. He will store the wheat in a barn and burn the husks in a fire that never goes out. The Baptism of Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kori ʋ mɩɩ-chaarɩ gbaŋa, dɩ ʋ ŋmoo ʋ mɩaa kala dɛrɛ, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ gbaŋa-la a kaa chaarɛ a lɩɩsɛ mɩɩ-biiŋ a hɛ ʋ vire lɛ aŋ joŋ jɔrʋŋ a hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ. Nyiŋ-la bɩ jaŋ dɩsɛ.” Jɔɔŋ fo Yesu Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ Maak

english_verse: Jesus left Galilee and went to the Jordan River to be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Jɔɔŋ fa sɩɩ fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ ŋɩɩ, Yesu sii lɩɩ Galilii tinteeŋ a kɔ Jɔɔŋ teeŋ dɩ ʋ fou Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la lɛ.

english_verse: But John kept objecting and said, “I ought to be baptized by you. Why have you come to me?”
translation_verse: Ama Jɔɔŋ wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ Yesu kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩrɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ nɛ maga dɩ ŋ fomi Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, aŋ ka ŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ nɛ foŋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “For now this is how it should be, because we must do all God wants us to do.” Then John agreed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Ŋaa ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ. Ŋ-la nɛ la jaŋ wuo to a ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala Wɩa sɩ cho.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ sɛɩ a fou Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: So Jesus was baptized. And as soon as he came out of the water, the sky opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him like a dove.
translation_verse: Jɔɔŋ sɩ fo Yesu Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ dɛrɛ, ʋ guu lɩɩ lɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ kʋ lɩɩ, wɩa-nyuŋ kpaa balɩa. Ʋ na Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ dɩ ʋ kʋ tuu a nagɛ kokomo a togili ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then a voice from heaven said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Ka ʋ nɩɩ nʋʋ yikoro wɩa-nyuŋ sɩ bʋla, “Mɩ Bii-chooluŋ nɛ ŋ-la, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ lɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ Jɔɔŋ Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la tɔ dɩa. Yesu sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ sii Judiya lɛ a mʋ Galilii tinteeŋ.

english_verse: But instead of staying in Nazareth, Jesus moved to Capernaum. This town was beside Lake Galilee in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bɩ Nazarɛt lɛ hɔnɔ aŋ sii mʋ hɔŋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Kapɛnam lɛ. Taŋ-la kpagɛ Galilii mʋgʋ-bal-la nɛ a hɛ Zebuluŋ arɩ Nafɩtalɩ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then the devil came to him and said, “If you are God's Son, tell these stones to turn into bread.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɩtaanɩ kɔ ʋ teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie, leŋ dɩ tabɩaa deemba bɩrɩmɛ kʋdiilee.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The Scriptures also say, ‘Don't try to test the Lord your God!’ ”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Ba bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a bʋl, ‘Má sɩ́ ma Tɩɩna Wɩa magɩsʋ.’ ”

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus up on a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms on earth and their power.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɩtaanɩ bɩra kɛŋ Yesu a kaa jɩl peel-bal kʋbala nyuŋ a dagʋ dʋnɩa kuoruŋ fine arɩ ʋ zɔmʋŋ

english_verse: The devil said to him, “I will give all this to you, if you will bow down and worship me.”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ kɩaa deemba kala pɩŋ dɩ ŋ nɛ jaŋ tuu kpirimi a chʋɔlɛmɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Go away Satan! The Scriptures say: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve only him.’ ”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Sɩtaanɩ, mʋ nɩmɛ, Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba ŋmʋnsa, ‘Má chʋchʋɔlɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa dʋndʋŋa a tutou.’ ”

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said,
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa dɩ wɩalɩŋ Azaaya fa sɩ bʋla kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ.

english_verse: “Listen, lands of Zebulun and Naphtali, lands along the road to the sea and across the Jordan. Listen Galilee, land of the Gentiles!
translation_verse: Azaaya fa ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ. Ʋ fa bʋl wɩaa a pɩ Zebuluŋ arɩ Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa nɛ a chaasɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, Jɔdaŋ sɛmɛ, a hɛ Galilii tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: Right then the two brothers dropped their nets and went with him.
translation_verse: Ba guu leŋ ba jomba ta aŋ to ʋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: While Jesus was walking along the shore of Lake Galilee, he saw two brothers. One was Simon, also known as Peter, and the other was Andrew. They were fishermen, and they were casting their net into the lake.
translation_verse: Yesu fa sɩ joŋ Galilii mʋgʋ-bal-la niiŋ a vɩvɛŋ, ʋ na naambiiriŋ balɩa. Dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Saamɔŋ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ dɔŋɔ ma nɛ Pɩɩta. Ʋ naambie ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ Anduru. Ʋ naba dɩ baa kɛsɛ chenfilee nɛ fuo-la lɛ arɩ ba jomba, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fa ŋaa chenfil kpʋʋra nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus walked on until he saw James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat with their father, mending their nets. Jesus asked them to come with him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra vɛŋ a mʋ na naambiiriŋ balɩa, ba yɩraa nɛ Jeems arɩ Jɔɔŋ. Ba fa ŋaa Zebidi biiriŋ nɛ. Ʋ naba dɩ ba dɩ ba nyɩmma fa hɛ ba lɩɩŋ daboro tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ba kɛŋ ba jomba ŋaa siri dɩ ba yuo.

english_verse: At once they left the boat and their father and went with Jesus. Jesus Teaches, Preaches, and Heals (Luke
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu yɩrɛba. Ba guu leŋ ba lɩɩŋ daboro arɩ ba nyɩmma aŋ to ʋ harɩŋ. Yesu bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pɩ nɩaa aŋ pɛ vaarɛ nyanyal tɩŋŋaa Luuk

english_verse: Jesus went all over Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the good news about God's kingdom. He also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu gɔllɛ Galilii tinteeŋ kala a dɩdagɛ nɩaa ba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ a bʋbʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa arɩ Wɩa kuorii-la wɩaa a pɩ nɩaa aŋ pɛ vɩvaarɛ nɩaa nyanyal dosunuŋ kala.

english_verse: News about him spread all over Syria, and people with every kind of sickness or disease were brought to him. Some of them had a lot of demons in them, others were thought to be crazy, and still others could not walk. But Jesus healed them all.
translation_verse: Yesu wɩaa teeli Siiria tinteeŋ kala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa kɛŋ ba nyanyal tɩŋŋaa kɔ ʋ teeŋ arɩ nyanyal dosunuŋ, jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ fa kɛŋ dɔnsʋŋ, dɔnsʋŋ ma titel kuŋkunsuŋ, dɔnsʋŋ ma fa ŋaa gbɛrɩgɛɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu vaarɛ ba kala.

english_verse: Large crowds followed Jesus from Galilee and the region around the ten cities known as Decapolis. They also came from Jerusalem, Judea, and from across the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ nɛ fa to Yesu harɩŋ. Dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Galilii tinteeŋ arɩ tasɩŋ fii. Dɔnsʋŋ ma lɩɩ Jerusalɛm sɩ hɛ Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ, dɔnsʋŋ ma lɩɩ Jɔdaŋ fuoŋ cholo sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: You must obey God's commands better than the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law obey them. If you don't, I promise you will never get into the kingdom of heaven. Anger
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, see dɩ ma kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a kɩɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba arɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.” Yesu bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ baanɩŋ nanɩŋ lɛ

english_verse: So if you are about to place your gift on the altar and remember that someone is angry with you,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ pʋna mʋ Wɩa koruŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ aŋ liise yi arɩ ŋ naambie tʋɔŋ cheye ŋ nyuŋ,

english_verse: God blesses those people who depend only on him. They belong to the kingdom of heaven!
translation_verse: “Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bene arɩ ba ha bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ woruŋ lɛ. Ba nɛ jaŋ hɛ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: God blesses those people who grieve. They will find comfort!
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yel lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are humble. The earth will belong to them!
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa ka dagɛ lɛ. Ba jaŋ dii Wɩa kuorii-la tintee-falɩɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are merciful. They will be treated with mercy!
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige lɛ. Ʋ ma jaŋ fá ba nenige.

english_verse: God blesses those people whose hearts are pure. They will see him!
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla lɛ, ba jaŋ na Wɩa.

english_verse: You are the light for the whole world. A city built on top of a hill cannot be hidden,
translation_verse: Ma nagɛ chaanɩŋ nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala teeŋ. Taŋ kala sɩ chɩŋ peeliŋ nyuŋ, ʋ bɩ wuo faa.

english_verse: But I tell you not to swear by anything when you make a promise! Heaven is God's throne, so don't swear by heaven.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma ŋaa wɩɩ, má sɩ́ ŋmɩɛsʋ. Má sɩ́ Wɩa ŋmɩɛsʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɩɩ beŋ dʋnɩa kʋŋkala.

english_verse: The earth is God's footstool, so don't swear by the earth. Jerusalem is the city of the great king, so don't swear by it.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ tinteeŋ ma ŋmɩɛsʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa naasɩŋ dɩ-wiesiŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Má sɩ́ Jerusalɛm ma ŋmɩɛsʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa kuoru-balɩŋ jaŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You are the salt for everyone on earth. But if salt no longer tastes like salt, how can it make food salty? All it is good for is to be thrown out and walked on.
translation_verse: Ma nagɛ yɩsɩŋ nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa teeŋ. Yɩsɩŋ sɩma, ama dɩ ʋ nɛ sɛbɩsɛ, ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ ʋ sɩŋ. Ʋ ŋaa kʋtɔɔ nɛ, ba yie joŋo ta nɩaa nʋnʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: and no one lights a lamp and puts it under a clay pot. Instead, it is placed on a lampstand, where it can give light to everyone in the house.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ nyɩgɛ chaanɩŋ ʋ dɩa lɛ a kɛŋ gbaŋa chu tɔ, koo a joŋo hɛ godo bʋbʋɔŋ. Ʋ yie joŋo daŋ chaaŋ daaŋ nyuŋ nɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ dɩa-la lɛ wuo nɩna pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: Don't suppose I came to do away with the Law and the Prophets. I did not come to do away with them, but to give them their full meaning.
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ joŋ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto ta nɛɛ? Koo ma bɩɩna mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ giri wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ bʋla ta nɛ? Aɩ, mɩ bɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ giriba ta, ama mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ dagɛ ba bʋbʋɔŋ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: But I promise you if you are angry with someone, you will have to stand trial. If you call someone a fool, you will be taken to court. And if you say that someone is worthless, you will be in danger of the fires of hell.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ na baanɩŋ ʋ naambie nyuŋ, ba jaŋ kɛnʋ kaa kʋ dii ʋ sarɩya. Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ yɩrɛ ʋ naambie nɩpɛɩpɛɩ, ba jaŋ kɛnʋ kaa mʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa teeŋ. Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ yɩrɛ ʋ naambie a bʋl dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɩtɔɔ nɛ, ʋ tɩɩna jaŋ mʋ jʋʋ Wɩa nyiniŋ.

english_verse: leave your gift there in front of the altar. Make peace with that person, then come back and offer your gift to God.
translation_verse: leŋ pʋna-la koru-la nyuŋ aŋ mɩɩra mʋ ma dɩ ŋ naambie sɩŋ, ka dɩ ŋ-na mɩɩra mʋ dɩ ba kpʋ pʋna-la a pɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ samɩŋ a kɛnɩŋ mʋmʋ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ, bʋl wɩɩ-la wasɛ lɩma lɩma wombiiŋ lɛ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ʋ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ mʋ hɛ sarɩya diire nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Sarɩya diire ma jaŋ kɛnɩŋ hɛ porisiba nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba nɛ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ mʋ tɔ dɩa.

english_verse: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe. Marriage
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ kɛnɩŋ mʋ tɔ dɩa, ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo lɩɩ, see dɩ ŋ tiŋ chɩŋ-la kala ba sɩ kere pɩŋ. Yesu bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ haalaa chɛnɩŋ lɛ
