english_verse: You have been taught that a man who divorces his wife must write out divorce papers for her.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra dagɛma a bʋl, ‘Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ vɩa ʋ haala, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ pɩ haal-la arɩ ʋ jaŋ vɩaʋ.’

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.”
translation_verse: Ma bɩra nɩa dɩ ba bʋla pɩ la naabalɩmaba, ‘Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋmɩɛsa arɩ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ pɩ Wɩa, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩɩ-la ta, ama ŋaa wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ sɩ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa a pɩ Wɩa.’

english_verse: When you make a promise, say only “Yes” or “No.” Anything else comes from the devil. Revenge (Luke
translation_verse: Ama ma-na yaa bʋl, ‘Oo’ koo ‘Aɩ’ dʋndʋŋa, a lɩɩ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, dɩ ma bɩra bʋl wʋbɔŋ ʋ lɩɩ Sɩtaanɩ nɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋ lɛ, sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ-la joŋo timu Luuk

english_verse: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋ lɛ, sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ-la joŋo timu. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ fallɛ ŋ nadiiŋ chaŋkpaŋɩŋ lɛ, kɛŋ ŋ nagʋa chaŋkpaŋɩŋ ma kaa bɩrɩma pʋ.

english_verse: If someone sues you for your shirt, give up your coat as well.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ samɩŋ kaa mʋ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ dɩ ʋ laa ŋ gɛrɩ-balɩŋ, wuri ŋ gɛrɩ-bie ma pɛ pʋ.

english_verse: If a soldier forces you to carry his pack one kilometer, carry it two kilometers.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ fʋgʋŋ dɩ ma dɩ ʋ vɛŋ meel-daa, leŋ dɩ ma vɛŋ meel-daasɩŋ balɩa.

english_verse: When people ask you for something, give it to them. When they want to borrow money, lend it to them. Love (Luke
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ kʋŋ, dɩ nʋʋ pɩɛsa chɩchɛ, joŋo pʋ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɔ ŋ teeŋ a chɩchɛ kʋŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛnɛ, joŋo chɩmʋ. Yesu bʋla arɩ la cho la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ Luuk

english_verse: You have heard people say, “Love your neighbors and hate your enemies.”
translation_verse: Ma nɩa arɩ Mosis fa sɩ dɩ ma cho ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa aŋ bɛrɛ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: But I tell you to love your enemies and pray for anyone who mistreats you.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, má cho ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ to naasɩŋ dɔgɩsɛma.

english_verse: Then you will be acting like your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both good and bad people. And he sends rain for the ones who do right and for the ones who do wrong.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ wuo ŋaa ma Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ biiriŋ. Ʋ leŋe Wɩa pɔsɛ hɩhɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩzɔŋŋɔɔ kala lɛ nɛ a leŋ duonuŋ nɩɩ pɩpɩ nɩzɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kala.

english_verse: If you love only those people who love you, will God reward you for this? Even tax collectors love their friends.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ cho nɩalɩŋ sɩ choŋ dʋndʋŋa, ŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ time Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. Lampoo lɩlaaraa ma paala ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ tʋɔsɛ ŋ naambiiriŋ dʋndʋŋa chʋchʋɔlɛ, ŋ bɩ woruŋ ka ŋaa. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ ma paala ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: When you do good deeds, don't try to show off. If you do, you won't get a reward from your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra dagɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo a bʋl, “Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ a pɩ ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, sɩ́ wʋzɔŋ-la joŋo ŋaa ʋ lɛ nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ bɩ time kɛnɛ ŋ Nyɩmma sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ teeŋ.

english_verse: When you give to the poor, don't let anyone know about it.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ kʋŋ a pɛ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ kʋŋ kɛnɛ lɛ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala jɩŋ.

english_verse: When you pray, don't be like those show-offs who love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners. They do this just to look good. I can assure you that they already have their reward.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Dɩ ma nɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, ma sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa nagʋ. Ba yie cho dɩ ba chɩŋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ arɩ wombiee sɛmɛ a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa dɩ nʋʋkala naba. Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, ba paala laa ba time nɛ.

english_verse: When you pray, go into a room alone and close the door. Pray to your Father in private. He knows what is done in private and will reward you.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, má jʋʋ ma dɩɩsɩŋ a kɛŋ borusuŋ tɔ aŋ sʋl ma Nyɩmma-la ma sɩ bɩ na. Ʋ-na ka na wɩɩ-la ma sɩ faa ŋɩŋaa nɛ, ʋ jaŋ timma.

english_verse: When you pray, don't talk on and on as people do who don't know God. They think God likes to hear long prayers.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, ma sɩ́ faasa bʋl wɩaa yʋgɛ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ba bɩɩna arɩ ba sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa deeŋ deeŋ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa jaŋ nɩɩ.

english_verse: Don't be like them. Your Father knows what you need even before you ask.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ba nagʋ. Ma Nyɩmma paala jɩŋ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ chɛ nɛ, ka ma-na pɩpɩɛsʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, help us to honor your name.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ maga dɩ ma chʋɔlɛ Wɩa: ‘La Nyɩmma sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ, leŋ dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: Come and set up your kingdom, so that everyone on earth will obey you, as you are obeyed in heaven.
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ŋ kuorii-la kɔ. Leŋ dɩ nɩaa sɛɩ ŋ niiŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ arɩ ba sɩ sɛɩ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, your Father in heaven will forgive you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋaa wɩaa cheima aŋ ka ma joŋo chɛba, ma Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ ma jaŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa chei a chɛma.

english_verse: But if you don't forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins. Worshiping God by Going without Eating
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ bɩ wɩalɩŋ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa cheima joŋo chɛba, ma Nyɩmma Wɩa ma bɩ jaŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa chei a chɛma.” Yesu dagɛ nɩaa niiŋ vɔbʋŋ wɩaa

english_verse: Instead, comb your hair and wash your face.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ vɔɔ niiŋ, má sɔŋ ma sɩaa a chaasɛ ma nyuŋ,

english_verse: Then others won't know you are going without eating. But your Father sees what is done in private, and he will reward you. Treasures in Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: dɩ nɩaa sɩ́ wuo jɩŋ arɩ maa vɔɔ niiŋ nɛ see ma Nyɩmma Wɩa dʋndʋŋa, Nɩɩ-la ma sɩ bɩ na. Ʋ-na ka na wɩɩ-la ma sɩ faa ŋaa nɛ, ʋ jaŋ timma.” Yesu dagɛ ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a kɛŋ dʋa Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ Luuk

english_verse: But more than anything else, put God's work first and do what he wants. Then the other things will be yours as well.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má laa sɩpaaŋ chɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ a chɛ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ jaŋ joŋ kɩaa deemba kʋŋkala pɛ pɩma.

english_verse: Don't worry about tomorrow. It will take care of itself. You have enough to worry about today.
translation_verse: Má saa sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa walɩmʋ a tɩŋ chiemiŋ wɩaa. Chɛɛ kala kɛŋ ʋ wʋwalɩmɩa nɛ. Má sɩ́ wɩɩ dɔŋ kala kaa pɛ chɛɛ kala wʋwalɩmaa lɛ.

english_verse: Don't store up treasures on earth! Moths and rust can destroy them, and thieves can break in and steal them.
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra bʋla, “Má sɩ́ kɩaa chɛ bil ma tɩtɩa lɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Dʋnɩa lɛ pʋgʋmaa jaŋ dii dɔnsʋŋ aŋ ka dɔnsʋŋ ma sʋ, gaaraa ma jaŋ jʋʋ gaa dɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: Instead, store up your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and thieves cannot break in and steal them.
translation_verse: Ama má chɛ kɩaa bil ma tɩtɩa lɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ, lee-la pʋgʋmaa sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo dii. Ba bɩ jaŋ sʋ ma, gaaraa ma bɩ jaŋ wuo gaaba.

english_verse: Your heart will always be where your treasure is. Light (Luke
translation_verse: Lee-la ma kɩaa sɩ hɛ, nɩmɛ nɛ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa jaŋ hɛ. Yesu dagɛ nɩaa a tɩgɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ lɛ Luuk

english_verse: But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark. If the light inside you is dark, you surely are in the dark. Money (Luke
translation_verse: ama dɩ ŋ sɩaa nɛ bɩ zɔŋ, ŋ yaraa kala hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Dɩ pʋlʋŋ-la nɛ kɔ dɩ ʋ bɩrɩmɛ birimiŋ, birimiŋ lim lɛ nɛ ŋ hɛ ŋɩɩ. Yesu dagɛ nɩaa dɩ ba sɩ́ ba tɩtɩa walɩmʋ a tɩgɛ kʋdiilee arɩ gɛnnɩŋ wɩaa lɛ Luuk

english_verse: You cannot be the slave of two masters! You will like one more than the other or be more loyal to one than the other. You cannot serve both God and money. Worry (Luke
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a pɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ balɩa. Ʋ jaŋ cho dɔŋɔ aŋ bɛrɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ jaŋ tuto dɔŋɔ niiŋ wɩaa woruŋ aŋ vɩa dɔŋɔ niiŋ wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa Wɩa yoŋ aŋ bɩra ŋaa moribiee ma yoŋ.

english_verse: Don't worry and ask yourselves, “Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear?”
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa walɩmʋ a mʋ tɩgɛ kʋdiile-la ma sɩ jaŋ dii arɩ kʋ-la ma sɩ jaŋ nyʋa arɩ kʋ-la ma sɩ jaŋ laalɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: I tell you not to worry about your life. Don't worry about having something to eat, drink, or wear. Isn't life more than food or clothing?
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa walɩmʋ a tɩgɛ kʋdiile-la ma sɩ jaŋ dii koo kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ nyʋnyʋa. Má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa ma walɩmʋ a tɩgɛ gɛnnɩ-la ma sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma laalɛ. Ma mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ kɩɩ kʋdiilee, ma yaraa ma kɩɩ gɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Look at the birds in the sky! They don't plant or harvest. They don't even store grain in barns. Yet your Father in heaven takes care of them. Aren't you worth much more than birds?
translation_verse: Má bee na diibiisiŋ, ba bɩ pɛrɛ, ba bɩ kɩaa kʋŋ, ba bɩ kɩaa ma ka tʋɔlɛ virisiŋ lɛ, ka ma Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ pɩpɩba kʋdiilee. Ma nɛ paala kɛŋ bʋbʋɔŋ a kɩɩ diibiisiŋ.

english_verse: Why worry about clothes? Look how the wild flowers grow. They don't work hard to make their clothes.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ saa bɩ ŋɩɩ wuo ŋaa, bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma wʋwalɩmɛ ma tɩtɩa gɛnnɩŋ wɩaa? Má bee na tɩɩfɩɩlaa sɩ hɛ gɩrɩŋ lɛ, ba bɩ tɩŋ, ba bɩ gɛnnɩŋ ma yɛrɛ a lɩlaalɛ,

english_verse: But I tell you that Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of them.
translation_verse: ama ba zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ. Kuoro Solomoŋ fa kɛŋ kɩaa nɛ woruŋ. Ama ʋ gɛnnɩŋ fa bɩ zɔmɔ magɛ tɩɩfɩɩlaa deemba.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ yie ŋaa yaŋ nyʋ a waa a zɔŋ, ka ʋ bɩ dieni aŋ hɩhɩl. Dɩ ʋ nɛ hɩla, ba yie chol nyiniŋ hɛ ʋ dii. Dɩ Wɩa nɛ wuo ŋaa yaŋ zɔŋ ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo pɩma kʋdiilee arɩ gɛnnɩŋ? Ma Wɩa laa diiniŋ bɩ yʋgɛ.

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father in heaven knows you need all of these.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, ba nɛ yie walɩma chɩchɛ kɩaa deemba. Ma Nyɩmma sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ jɩma arɩ maa chɛ kɩaa deemba kala nɛ.

english_verse: God will be as hard on you as you are on others! He will treat you exactly as you treat them.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ dii ma sarɩya arɩ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa ma sɩɩ ŋaa ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ. Ŋɩɩ ma sɩ joŋo to ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa ma jaŋ joŋo to ma lɛ.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo na daa-bie sɩ tel ŋ naambie sɩɩŋ lɛ aŋ bɩ daa-bal-la sɩ tel ŋ tɩtɩa sɩɩŋ lɛ ka na?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye?
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩ ŋ naambie arɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ŋ lɩɩsɛ daa-bie-la sɩ hɛ ʋ sɩɩŋ lɛ, aŋ bɩ daa-bal-la sɩ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa sɩɩŋ lɛ ka na?

english_verse: You're nothing but show-offs! First, take the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na kanfugi tɩɩna, laa sɩpaaŋ lɩɩsɛ daa-bal-la sɩ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa sɩɩŋ lɛ, ka ŋ sɩaa wuo na, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo pɛ ŋ naambie lɛ a lɩɩsɛ daa-bie-la sɩ hɛ ʋ sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give good things to people who ask.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bɔmɔ aŋ jɩŋ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo pɩ ma biiriŋ, ɛɛ nɛ ma Nyɩmma sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ, a kɛŋ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋla chɩchɛ?

english_verse: Would any of you give your hungry child a stone, if the child asked for some bread?
translation_verse: Ma kʋbɛɛ bie nɛ jaŋ pɩɛsa chɩchɛ boroboro, dɩ ŋ joŋ tabɩɩŋ pʋ?

english_verse: Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: Má sʋl kɩaa, ma jaŋ laa, má chɛ kɩaa, ma jaŋ na. Má du boro, ba jaŋ kaa suro pɩma.

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive. Everyone who searches will find. And the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ sʋl kɩaa Wɩa teeŋ, ʋ yie laa nɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chɛ kɩaa, ʋ yie na nɛ. Nɩɩ-la ma sɩ du boro, ba yie kaa suro pʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Would you give your child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Koo dɩ ʋ nɛ pɩɛsa chɩchɛ chenfiliŋ, ŋ jaŋ joŋ dɩmɩŋ a pʋʋ?

english_verse: Treat others as you want them to treat you. This is what the Law and the Prophets are all about. The Narrow Gate (Luke
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ cho dɩ nɩaa joŋo ŋɩŋaa ma lɛ, má ma joŋ ŋɩɩ ŋɩŋaa ba lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa wʋdagaa wʋnyuŋ nɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ.” Má to boi-bie a mʋ Wɩa-jaŋ Luuk

english_verse: Anyone who hears and obeys these teachings of mine is like a wise person who built a house on solid rock.
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra sɩ, “Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɔ mɩ teeŋ a jegile nɩɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma a tutoba, mɩ jaŋ dagɛma ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ naga. Ʋ nagɛ wʋjɩnna sɩ saa ʋ dɩa nɛ. Ʋ saaʋ kpagɩnyɩlɩŋ nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But the gate to life is very narrow. The road that leads there is so hard to follow that only a few people find it. A Tree and Its Fruit (Luke
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa-jaŋ boiŋ niiŋ muuro nɛ, wombii-la ma sɩɩ mʋ nɩmɛ, ʋ vɛnɩŋ hɛyɛ. Nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ dʋndʋŋ nɛ yie wuo na wombii-la a to. Yesu bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ Luuk

english_verse: Watch out for false prophets! They dress up like sheep, but inside they are wolves who have come to attack you.
translation_verse: Má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa. Ba jaŋ kɔ ma teeŋ a nagɛ nɩzɔmɔ ba sɩaa lɛ, ama ba tʋɔŋ lɛ, ba ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ nɛ a nagɛ guŋgurusuŋ sɩ yie kɛsɛ kɩaa chɩchaŋ.

english_verse: You can tell what they are by what they do. No one picks grapes or figs from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ to ba wʋŋaalaa lɛ nɛ a jɩmba. Sɔjaamɩŋ bɩ chɩchʋɛŋ ka nɛŋ, sɔ-gbuŋgbeŋe ma bɩ tutogi nambɩlaa ka nɛŋ.

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit.
translation_verse: Tɩa-la kala sɩ kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa, ʋʋ nɛŋ nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, ama tɩa-la sɩ bɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa kɛnɛ nɩɩ nɛŋ nɛŋ-lɔrʋnʋŋ.

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: Tɩa-la sɩ kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa bɩ nɛŋ-lɔrʋnʋŋ wuo nɛŋ, tɩa-la sɩ bɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa kɛnɛ ma bɩ nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ wuo nɛŋ.

english_verse: Every tree producing bad fruit will be chopped down and burned.
translation_verse: Tɩa kala sɩ bɩ nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ ka nɛŋ, ba jaŋ kere ta a joŋo yuo hɛ nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You can tell who the false prophets are by their deeds. A Warning (Luke
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ to a jɩŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa. Nʋʋkala dee bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ Luuk

english_verse: Anyone who hears my teachings and doesn't obey them is like a foolish person who built a house on sand.
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jegile nɩɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma aŋ bɩ ba to, ʋ nagɛ nɩyaarɩ-la sɩ saa ʋ dɩa hagɩlɩ-bumbugulo tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and the winds blew and beat against that house. Finally, it fell with a crash.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ duonuŋ nɩɩ, lɩɩŋ su leriŋ kala, peliŋ ma lu a ŋmoo lɩɩ-la yagɛ dɩa-la, dɩa-la kala tel wuru.”

english_verse: Not everyone who calls me their Lord will get into the kingdom of heaven. Only the ones who obey my Father in heaven will get in.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩ yɩrɛmɛ, ‘mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩ Tɩɩna,’ dee bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ, see nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ sɩ daga.

english_verse: On the day of judgment many will call me their Lord. They will say, “We preached in your name, and in your name we forced out demons and worked many miracles.”
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa sarɩya chɛ-diiliŋ nɛ yie, nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a bʋl, ‘La Tɩɩna, La Tɩɩna, la bʋl Wɩa wɩaa a pɩ nɩaa ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ aŋ kiri jɩnsɩŋ ma nɩaa lɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, a ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa ma yʋgɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ.’

english_verse: But I will tell them, “I will have nothing to do with you! Get out of my sight, you evil people!” Two Builders (Luke
translation_verse: Ama mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩba: Mɩ paala bɩ ma jɩŋ. Ma wʋbɔŋ ŋɩŋaaraa, má sʋrɩsa lɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.” Yesu magɛ namaga a tɩgɛ dɩɩ-saaraa balɩa lɛ Luuk

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and winds beat against that house. But it was built on solid rock, and so it did not fall.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ duonuŋ nɩɩ. Lɩɩŋ su leriŋ kala, peliŋ ma lu a ŋmoo lɩɩ-la a yagɛ dɩa-la, ka dɩa-la bɩ tele, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bil ʋ gentine woruŋ nɛ a saaʋ kpagɩnyɩlɩŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, the crowds were surprised at his teaching.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɛrɛ, ba ŋaa nɩ-daŋ-la kala wʋkpuŋkpere.

english_verse: He taught them like someone with authority, and not like their teachers of the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ ba daga a nagɛ ba Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba sɩɩ dagɛba ŋɩɩ. Ʋ-na kɛŋ wɩɩ-la doluŋ nɛ a dagɛba.

english_verse: But the ones who should have been in the kingdom will be thrown out into the dark. They will cry and grit their teeth in pain.”
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ maga dɩ ba hɛ Wɩa kuorii-la lɛ aŋ bɩ jʋa, ba jaŋ jomba yuo ta jeeŋ harɩŋ dɩ ba hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ a pɩna yiyel aŋ dɩdɩŋ ba nyɩlaa.”

english_verse: That evening many people with demons in them were brought to Jesus. And with only a word he forced out the evil spirits and healed everyone who was sick.
translation_verse: Dɩdaanɩŋ sɩ yie, ba kɛŋ nɩaa yʋgɛ jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ kɛnɛ a kɔ Yesu teeŋ. Yesu bʋl wɩaa a kiri jɩŋ-bɔmɔ-la ta aŋ vaarɛ nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ.

english_verse: Suddenly a man with leprosy came and knelt in front of Jesus. He said, “Lord, you have the power to make me well, if only you wanted to.”
translation_verse: Gbege kʋbala ma kɔ ʋ teeŋ a tuu kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ sʋlʋ, “Kʋhɩaŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ cho, ŋaa dɩ mɩ duori.”

english_verse: Jesus put his hand on the man and said, “I want to! Now you are well.” At once the man's leprosy disappeared.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu lɩɩsɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ a digu aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ cho nɛ, duori.” Yawɩɩl-la guu leŋ baal-la.

english_verse: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ jaŋ kʋ ŋaa dɩ ʋ duori.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, “I tell you in all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ nɩɩ wɩaa deemba, ʋ ŋaaʋ wʋkpuŋkpere. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ nɩ-daŋ-la fa sɩɩ to ʋ harɩŋ, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, mɩ ha bɩ Wɩa laa diiniŋ deeŋ doho na Iziral nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: “Lord, my servant is at home in such terrible pain that he can't even move.”
translation_verse: “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, mɩ dɩa tɩntɩnnʋ nɩɩ wɩɩlʋ a pɩŋ dɩa lɛ. Ʋ bɩ wuo vɛŋ a nɩna hɛɛŋ woruŋ.”

english_verse: Many people will come from everywhere to enjoy the feast in the kingdom of heaven with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ a kʋ hɔŋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ dɩ ba dɩ Abɩraham arɩ Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb dii kʋdiilee.

english_verse: Then Jesus said to the officer, “You may go home now. Your faith has made it happen.” Right then his servant was healed. Jesus Heals Many People (Mark
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la, “Mʋ dɩa, ŋ sɩ laa dii arɩ wɩɩ-la jaŋ ŋaa, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa.” Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la tɩntɩnnʋ-la duori. Yesu vaarɛ nɩaa yʋgɛ Maak

english_verse: Suddenly they shouted, “Jesus, Son of God, what do you want with us? Have you come to punish us before our time?”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ na Yesu, ba guu ŋmoo niiŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa la lɛ Wɩa Bii? Ŋ kɔ dɩ ŋ dɔgɩsɛla nɛɛ, ka bʋa-la ha bɩ yiee?”

english_verse: Everyone in town came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged him to leave their part of the country.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ lɩɩ a mʋ dɩ ʋ na Yesu. Ba sɩ mʋ naʋ, ba sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ ba tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus went to the home of Peter, where he found that Peter's mother-in-law was sick in bed with fever.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mʋ Pɩɩta dɩa. Ʋ sɩ jʋa, ʋ na dɩ ʋ hɩɩlɩ-haala pɩna a wʋwɩɩlɛ, ʋ yaraa kala lɩŋ.

english_verse: He took her by the hand, and the fever left her. Then she got up and served Jesus a meal.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu digi ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ yaraa fa sɩ lɩma ŋɩɩ, ʋ fɩɛlɛ. Ʋ sii ŋaa kʋdiilee pɩba ba dii.

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said, “He healed our diseases and made us well.” Some Who Wanted To Go with Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ Azaaya fa sɩ bʋla kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Azaaya fa ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ. Ʋ fa bʋla, “Ʋ nɛ laa la nyanyalaa kala a chʋŋ.” Nɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba to Yesu harɩŋ Luuk

english_verse: When Jesus saw the crowd, he went across Lake Galilee.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ na dɩ nɩ-daŋ-la kʋ gollu, ʋ ŋaa ʋ dɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo chol fuoŋ cholo dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses came up to him and said, “Teacher, I'll go anywhere with you!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ kerichi kʋbala kɔ ʋ teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, mɩ ŋaa siri dɩ mɩ to ŋ harɩŋ a mʋ lee-na kala ŋ sɩɩ mʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Another disciple said to Jesus, “Lord, let me wait till I bury my father.”
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma fa sɩɩ to Yesu harɩŋ, ba tʋɔŋ kʋbala ma bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, leŋ dɩ mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ mʋ hugi mɩ nyɩmma.”

english_verse: so the disciples went over to him and woke him up. They said, “Lord, wake up! Save us before we drown!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo mʋ chɩsʋ a bʋla pʋ, “La Tɩɩna, laala ta, laa chɛ la sʋʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: After Jesus left in a boat with his disciples,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro. Ʋ harɩ-tooroo to ʋ harɩŋ jʋʋ.

english_verse: a terrible storm suddenly struck the lake, and waves started splashing into their boat. Jesus was sound asleep,
translation_verse: Pel-duo kʋbala guu lulu mʋga-la lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ lɩɩ-peliŋ tɔ lɩɩŋ daboro-la. Ama Yesu fa pɩŋ doŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The men in the boat were amazed and said, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him.” Two Men with Demons in Them (Mark
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa nʋʋkala wʋkpuŋkpere. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Nɩbɛɛ nɛ ŋ-la? Peliŋ arɩ lɩɩ-peliŋ kala tuto ʋ niiŋ.” Yesu kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ baalaa balɩa lɛ Maak

english_verse: After Jesus had crossed the lake, he came to shore near the town of Gadara and started down the road. Two men with demons in them came to him from the tombs. They were so fierce that no one could travel that way.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii mʋ tintee kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Gadara. Lee-la fa hɛ fuoŋ cholo nɛ. Dɩ baalaa balɩa lɩɩ vaamaa tʋɔŋ a kʋ chemu. Jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ fa kɛmba, ba nyɩnyaasɛ. Ŋɩɩ leŋ nʋʋkala fa bɩ wombii-la wuo to.

english_verse: Not far from there a large herd of pigs was feeding.
translation_verse: Dɩ toonuŋ ma hɛ lee-la a yʋgɛ a gɔllɔ didii kɩaa.

english_verse: So the demons begged Jesus, “If you force us out, please send us into those pigs!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ jɩnsɩ-la sʋl Yesu, “Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ kirila dɩ la lɩɩ, leŋ dɩ la mʋ jʋʋ toonuŋ deemba.”

english_verse: Jesus told them to go, and they went out of the men and into the pigs. All at once the pigs rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má lɩɩ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩ baala-la lɛ a mʋ jʋʋ toonu-la. Toonu-la kala sii fá a lɩɩ peel-la nyuŋ a tuu tel mʋga tʋɔŋ a sʋʋ.

english_verse: The people taking care of the pigs ran to the town and told everything, especially what had happened to the two men.
translation_verse: To-daara-la kɛŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ fá mʋ bʋla pɩ ba taŋ-la nɩaa, arɩ wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa baala-la fa sɩ kɛŋ jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus got into a boat and crossed back over to the town where he lived.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro a mɩɩra chol a mʋ ʋ jaŋ,

english_verse: Jesus heard them and answered, “Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do.
translation_verse: Yesu nɩɩ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla a mɩɩra bʋla pɩba, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa, ba bɩ daaluŋ-ŋaara ka chɛ, see nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined. New wine must be put into new wineskins. Both the skins and the wine will then be safe. A Dying Girl and a Sick Woman (Mark
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nʋʋ ma bɩ jaŋ joŋ sɩ-huoŋ a hɛ pupo-kpaaŋ lɛ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, pupoi-la jaŋ yɛrɛ, dɩ sɩŋ-la kala bɩsa ta. Sɩ-huoŋ maga dɩ ŋ joŋo hɛ pupoi-zɔmʋŋ lɛ nɛ, dɩ sɩŋ-la arɩ pupoi-la kala zɔŋ.” Yesu chɩsɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩaŋ tolo sʋʋŋ lɛ aŋ pɛ vaarɛ haal kʋbala Maak

english_verse: News about this spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Two Blind Men
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ Yesu sɩ ŋaa teeli tintee-la kala. Yesu vaarɛ nyʋlɩmaa balɩa

english_verse: Some teachers of the Law of Moses said to themselves, “Jesus must think he is God!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba-la dɔnsʋŋ pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Baala deeŋ tʋʋsɛ Wɩa joŋŋoo nɛ.”

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their minds, and he said, “Why are you thinking such evil things?
translation_verse: Ama Yesu jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ba fa sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ a pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ maa bɩɩnɛ wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ?

english_verse: But I will show you that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” So Jesus said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and go on home.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dagɛma arɩ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie kɛŋ doluŋ dʋnɩa lɛ dɩ mɩ joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛ nɩaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ gbɛrɩgʋ-la, “Sii a joŋ ŋ bɔsɔ a mʋ dɩa.”

english_verse: The man got up and went home.
translation_verse: Baal-la guu duori a sii a mʋ dɩa.

english_verse: Go and learn what the Scriptures mean when they say, ‘Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others.’ I didn't come to invite good people to be my followers. I came to invite sinners.” People Ask about Going without Eating (Mark
translation_verse: Má mʋ a beŋ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a na wɩɩ-la ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bʋbʋɔŋ. Ba ŋmʋnsa arɩ Wɩa sɩ, ‘Mɩ cho dɩ ma fɩfá nɩaa nenige nɛ a kɩɩ ma sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩpɩmɛ.’ Mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ yɩrɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nɛ dɩ ba leŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla mɩ sɩpaaŋ dee.” Yesu dagɛ niiŋ vɔbʋŋ wɩaa Maak

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving that place, two blind men began following him and shouting, “Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ lɩɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩaŋ-la dɩa-la lɛ a mʋmʋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ nyʋlɩmaa balɩa sii a tuto ʋ harɩŋ aŋ faasa yɩrɛ a bʋla pʋ, “Yesu, Devit nihiŋ, fá la nenige.”

english_verse: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, some people brought to him a man who could not talk because a demon was in him.
translation_verse: Nyʋlɩma-la balɩa sɩ lɩɩ dɩa-la lɛ Yesu fa sɩ hɛ, nɩaa kɛŋ baal kʋbala jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ bɩ wɩaa wuo bʋl kɔ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving, he saw a tax collector named Matthew sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.” Matthew got up and went with him.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ lɩɩ lee-la aa vɛŋ, ʋ na lampoo laarʋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Matiu. Ʋ fa hɔŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɩa lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu yɩrʋ a bʋla pʋ, “Sii to mɩ harɩŋ.” Ʋ sii a to ʋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples were having dinner at Matthew's house. Many tax collectors and other sinners were also there.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu jʋʋ Matiu dɩa, ʋ dɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo kala, a hɔnɔ didii kɩaa. Lampoo laaraa sɩ yʋga arɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa ma kɔ, ba kala didii kɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: Some Pharisees asked Jesus' disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and other sinners?”
translation_verse: Farisii tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ naba a pɩɛsɛ Yesu harɩ-tooroo, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma kʋhɩaŋ arɩ lampoo laaraa arɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa kala hɔnɔ didii kɩaa?”

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, an official came and knelt in front of him. The man said, “My daughter has just now died! Please come and place your hand on her. Then she will live again.”
translation_verse: Yesu fa sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ, Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩaŋ kʋbala kɔ ʋ teeŋ a tuu kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ tolo nɛ yie sʋʋ lɛɛlɛ, ama kʋ joŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ ʋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ sii.”

english_verse: Jesus turned. He saw the woman and said, “Don't worry! You are now healed because of your faith.” At that moment she was healed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mɩɩra daasɛ a naʋ a bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ tolo, sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, ŋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ tɩɩ ŋ duori.” Haal-la guu duori bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ.

english_verse: After Jesus had forced the demon out, the man started talking. The crowds were so amazed they began saying, “Nothing like this has ever happened in Israel!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu kiri jɩma-la baal-la lɛ, baal-la suomo bʋbʋl wɩaa. Ʋ ŋaa nʋʋkala wʋkpuŋkpere. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl dɩ ba ha bɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ doho na Iziral lɛ.

english_verse: Some followers of John the Baptist came and asked Jesus, “Why do we and the Pharisees often go without eating, while your disciples never do?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la harɩ-tooroo kɔ Yesu teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ la dɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa vʋvɔɔ niiŋ aŋ ka ŋ harɩ-tooroo-na bɩ niiŋ vɔɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: The friends of a bridegroom aren't sad while he is still with them. But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛba, “Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ mʋ jaa haal kaa kɔ, dɩ ʋ dɩ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ hɔŋ, ʋ nandɔsʋ-la tʋɔŋ jaŋ chei? Aɩ. Ama chɛɛ dɔŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ baal-la kaa mʋ lee, aŋ ka dɩ ʋ nandɔsʋ-la vɔɔ niiŋ.”

english_verse: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and tear a bigger hole.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra magɛ namaga a pɩba a bʋl, “Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-falɩŋ a kaa tɔ gɛrɩ-bɩnɩŋ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ chei gɛrɩ-falɩɩ-la.

english_verse: She had said to herself, “If I can just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ, “Dɩ mɩ nɛ digi ʋ gɛrɩŋ ma, mɩ jaŋ duori.”

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples got up and went with the man.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu to ʋ harɩŋ, ʋ dɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo kala.

english_verse: When Jesus went into the home of the official and saw the musicians and the crowd of mourners,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu jʋʋ Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩaŋ-la dɩa. Ʋ jʋa dɩ yoho-la ŋmʋl ŋmʋʋraa arɩ nɩ-daŋ chɩna aa yel.

english_verse: he said, “Get out of here! The little girl isn't dead. She is just asleep.” Everyone started laughing at Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Nʋʋkala lɩɩ, tolo-la bɩ sʋba, ʋ ta pɩŋ doŋ nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala mʋmɔmʋ.

english_verse: But after the crowd had been sent out of the house, Jesus went to the girl's bedside. He took her by the hand and helped her up.
translation_verse: Ama ba sɩ kiri nɩalɩŋ kala ba lɩɩ, Yesu mʋ jʋʋ tolo-la dɩa a kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ sii.

english_verse: After Jesus had gone indoors, the two blind men came up to him. He asked them, “Do you believe I can make you well?” “Yes, Lord,” they answered.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ mʋ dɩa, nyʋlɩma-la balɩa ma to ʋ harɩŋ jʋʋ dɩa-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Ma laa dii arɩ mɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ ma duorii?” Ba bʋl, “Oo, La Tɩɩna, la laa dii nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus touched their eyes and said, “Because of your faith, you will be healed.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu digi ba sɩaa lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Ma sɩ laa dii arɩ ŋɩɩ jaŋ ŋaa, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: They were able to see, and Jesus strictly warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sɩaa suri, ka Yesu bʋla pɩba arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, “Má sɩ́ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala.”

english_verse: But they left and talked about him to everyone in that part of the country. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Talk
translation_verse: Ama ba lɩɩ a bʋl wɩɩ-la Yesu sɩ ŋaa a teeli leriŋ kala. Yesu vaarɛ taŋɩŋ

english_verse: But the Pharisees said, “The leader of the demons gives him the power to force out demons.” Jesus Has Pity on People
translation_verse: Ama Farisii tɩŋŋaa bʋl arɩ jɩnsɩŋ kuoro nɛ pʋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ kikiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ ŋɩɩ. Yesu fá nɩaa nenige

english_verse: Jesus went to every town and village. He taught in their synagogues and preached the good news about God's kingdom. Jesus also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii gɔllɛ tabalaa arɩ tabiisiŋ kala a dagɛ nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ a bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a tɩgɛ Wɩa kuorii-la lɛ aŋ pɛ vaarɛ nɩaa nyanyal dosunuŋ.

english_verse: When he saw the crowds, he felt sorry for them. They were confused and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa sɩ na nɩ-daŋ-la, nenige kala kɛnʋ. Ʋ na dɩ wɩaa nɛ faa walɩmɛba. Ba bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ, a nagɛ piesee sɩ bɩ pie-daara kɛnɛ.

english_verse: He said to his disciples, “A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “Baga kɩaa yʋga nɛ a magɛ dɩ ba ŋaa, ama tɩntɩnnaa bɩ yʋgɛ.

english_verse: Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.”
translation_verse: Má sʋl baga-la tɩɩna dɩ ʋ chɛ tɩntɩnnaa yʋgɛ.”

english_verse: Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew the tax collector, James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus were also apostles.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra lɩɩsɛ Fɩlɩp, arɩ Batolomi, arɩ Tɔmas, arɩ Matiu lampoo laarʋ-la, arɩ Alɩfɩyas nanʋala Jeems, arɩ Tadɩyas,

english_verse: But when someone arrests you, don't worry about what you will say or how you will say it. At that time you will be given the words to say.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ kɛmma kaa mʋ dɩ ba dii ma sarɩya, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma bɔɩsɩŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ bʋl lɛ a laa ma tɩtɩa. Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa jaŋ joŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a hɛ ma nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Go only to the people of Israel, because they are like a flock of lost sheep.
translation_verse: Ama má mʋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, nɩaa deemba nagɛ piesee sɩ lɛlɛ nɛ a bɩra bɩ dɩa wɛnɩŋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: I am sending you like lambs into a pack of wolves. So be as wise as snakes and as innocent as doves.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Má jegile nɩɩ, ma nagɛ piesee nɛ, mɩɩ tɩmma dɩ ma mʋ guoli guŋgurusuŋ tʋɔŋ. Má saa kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a nagɛ dɩŋŋaa sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ ŋɩɩ, aŋ leŋ dɩ ma sɩaa fɩɛlɛ a nagɛ kokosuŋ sɩaa sɩ fɩɛla ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The others were Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas Iscariot, who later betrayed Jesus. Instructions for the Twelve Apostles (Mark
translation_verse: arɩ Saamɔŋ Zɛlɔt, arɩ Judas Ɩsɩkarɔt, nɩɩ-la sɩ kʋ ŋaa zɛmbɛ tɩɩna a yallɛ Yesu. Yesu tɩŋ ʋ harɩ-tooroo fii arɩ balɩa Maak

english_verse: Jesus sent out the twelve apostles with these instructions: Stay away from the Gentiles and don't go to any Samaritan town.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba fii arɩ balɩa, Yesu nɛ tɩmba ba lɩɩ. Ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba aŋ ka ba lɩɩ: “Má sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa tinteeŋ mʋ. Má sɩ́ Samarɩa tinteeŋ ma mʋ.

english_verse: And don't carry a traveling bag or an extra shirt or sandals or a walking stick. Workers deserve their food.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ sʋllɩ-gbansɩŋ koru a kaa vɛŋ wombii-la, a sɩ́ gɛnnɩŋ tʋŋ-bʋlɩa koo nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ tʋŋ-bʋlɩa koru, ma sɩ́ dantɩga ma koru. Dɩ tɩntɩnna nɛ tɩma, ʋ maga dɩ ba timu nɛ.

english_verse: So when you go to a town or a village, find someone able and willing to have you as their guest and stay with them until you leave.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ yi tabal koo tabie, má jʋʋ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ a bee chɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ wuo laama bil a chʋchʋa dɩɩ-bala-la lɛ halɩɩ dɩ bʋa-la ma sɩ jaŋ lɩɩ taŋ-la lɛ yi.

english_verse: I promise you the day of judgment will be easier for the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah than for that town. Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma arɩ sarɩya chɛ-diiliŋ, Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ taŋ-la nɩaa a kɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ dɔgɩsɛ Sodom arɩ Gomora nɩaa ŋɩɩ.” Hɛɛ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ Maak

english_verse: Brothers and sisters will betray one another and have each other put to death. Parents will betray their own children, and children will turn against their parents and have them killed.
translation_verse: Naambiiriŋ jaŋ kɛŋ dɔŋɔ a kaa mʋ pa dɩ ba kpʋ. Nyɩmmaba ma jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ba biiriŋ lɛ. Biiriŋ ma jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a kɛsɛ ba nyɩmmaba arɩ ba naamba a kaa mʋ pa dɩ ba kpʋ.

english_verse: Watch out for people who will take you to court and have you beaten in their synagogues.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba teeŋ. Ba jaŋ kɛmma kaa mʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa teeŋ dɩ ba dii ma sarɩya. Ba jaŋ vɩɩrɛma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Because of me, you will be dragged before rulers and kings to tell them and the Gentiles about your faith.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa, ba jaŋ kɛmma kaa mʋ kuoroo arɩ taŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ dɩ ma ŋaa mɩ pɛ-naaraa. Ba jaŋ kɛmma kaa mʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ma sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: But you will not really be the one speaking. The Spirit from your Father will tell you what to say.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ bʋl, ma dee bɩ jaŋ bʋl. Ma Nyɩmma Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ to ma lɛ a bʋl wɩaa.

english_verse: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you remain faithful until the end, you will be saved.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala jaŋ bɛrɛma a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa. Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ nyalɩma a mʋ dɛrɛ, Wɩa jaŋ laaʋ ta.

english_verse: When people mistreat you in one town, hurry to another one. I promise you before you have gone to all the towns of Israel, the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɩɩ dɔgɩsɛma taŋ lɛ, má lɩɩ a fá mʋ taŋ dɔŋɔ. Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma arɩ ma bɩ jaŋ wuo tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la dɛrɛ Iziral tasɩŋ kala lɛ, ka dɩ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie-na kɔ.

english_verse: Students are not better than their teacher, and slaves are not better than their master.
translation_verse: Sikuuri bie bɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagʋ ka kɩɩ, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nʋʋ dɔŋ teeŋ ma bɩ yʋga kɩɩ nɩɩ-la teeŋ ʋ sɩɩ tɩŋ. Tɩntɩnna bɩ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ ka kɩɩ.

english_verse: It is enough for students to be like their teacher and for slaves to be like their master. If people call the head of the family Satan, what will they say about the rest of the family? The One To Fear (Luke
translation_verse: Ama dɩ sikuuri bile nɛ gʋnnɛ woruŋ, ʋ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ dagʋ jaŋ magɛ dɔŋɔ. Dɩ tɩntɩnnʋ-la ma nɛ gʋnnɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la dɛrɛ, ʋ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ dagʋ kala magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ saa kɛŋ dɩa tɩɩna kaa yɩrɛ Bɛlizibul , ŋɩɩ-na ba jaŋ hɛ yɩrɩ-bɔŋŋɔɔ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ a pɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala. Nɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ la fá Luuk

english_verse: Don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but they cannot harm your soul. Instead, you should fear God who can destroy both your body and your soul in hell.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Má sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo kpʋ ma yaraa fá, nɩaa deemba bɩ ma dɩma wuo kpʋ. Ama má fá Wɩa. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ wuo joŋ ma yaraa arɩ ma dɩnsɩŋ kala a hɛ Wɩa nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ. Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, má fɩfáʋ.

english_verse: Aren't two sparrows sold for only a penny? But your Father knows when any one of them falls to the ground.
translation_verse: Zaarɩ-kokobiisiŋ balɩa dee ba yie joŋo yallɛ kɔbʋʋ? Ama ba tʋɔŋ kʋbala ma bɩ jaŋ lɛl, see ma Nyɩmma Wɩa sɛyɛ.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted.
translation_verse: Wɩa paala jɩŋ ma nyu-pʋnaa kala ma niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Luke
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma. Ma nɛ paala kɩɩ zaarɩ-kokobii laalɩŋ.

english_verse: If you tell others you belong to me, I will tell my Father in heaven you are my followers.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl nɩaa tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ nʋʋ nɛ, mɩ ma jaŋ bʋl ŋɩɩ a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ mɩ Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: But if you reject me, I will tell my Father in heaven you don't belong to me. Not Peace, but Trouble (Luke
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩamɛ nɩaa tʋɔŋ, mɩ ma jaŋ vɩaʋ mɩ Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ sɩpaaŋ. Yesu sɩ ʋ bɩ dʋnɩa kɔ dɩ nɩaa sɩŋ, ama dɩ ba yuo dɔŋɔ Luuk

english_verse: Don't think I came to bring peace to the earth! I came to bring trouble, not peace.
translation_verse: Ma fa bɩɩna mɩ kɔ dʋnɩa dɩ nɩaa sɩŋ nɛɛ? Aɩ, yuosuŋ nɛ mɩ kaa kɔ.

english_verse: Your worst enemies will be in your own family.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ŋaa ʋ tɩtɩa dɩa nɩaa.

english_verse: If you love your father or mother or even your sons and daughters more than me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ a kɩɩmɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ harɩ-tooru. Nɩɩ-la kala ma sɩ cho ʋ bie koo ʋ tolo a kɩɩmɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ harɩ-tooru.

english_verse: And unless you are willing to take up your cross and follow me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa daagɛsɛ baasa a to mɩ harɩŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ harɩ-tooru.

english_verse: If you try to save your life, you will lose it. But if you give it up for me, you will surely find it. Rewards (Mark
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ tɩtɩa mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta. Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Time-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo tinla Maak

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes a prophet, just because that person is a prophet, will be given the same reward as a prophet. Anyone who welcomes a good person, just because that person is good, will be given the same reward as a good person.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ a kɛnʋ woruŋ ʋ dɩa lɛ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ, ʋ jaŋ laa ʋ time. Time-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo timu, ʋ jaŋ magɛ time-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ tiŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ-la. Nɩɩ-la kala ma sɩ laa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna bil a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna wɩaa, time-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo timu, ʋ jaŋ magɛ time-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo tiŋ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna-la.

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes you welcomes me. And anyone who welcomes me also welcomes the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛmma woruŋ, ʋ tɩɩna kɛŋ mɩ ma woruŋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ kɛmmɛ woruŋ, ʋ kɛŋ Tɩɩna ma sɩ tɩmmɛ woruŋ nɛ.

english_verse: And anyone who gives one of my most humble followers a cup of cool water, just because that person is my follower, will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ ŋaa lɩɩ-fɩɛla pɩ mɩ harɩ-tooroo deemba tʋɔŋ kʋbie a tɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ to mɩ harɩŋ wɩaa, ʋ tɩɩna ma jaŋ laa ʋ time.”

english_verse: As John's followers were going away, Jesus spoke to the crowds about John: What sort of person did you go out into the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ harɩ-tooro-la viviiri. Yesu suomo bʋl Jɔɔŋ wɩaa a pɩpɩ nɩ-daŋ-la. Ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Ma sɩ mʋ Jɔɔŋ teeŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, bɛɛ nɛ ma fa gbɛrɛ dɩ ma na? Ma mʋa dɩ ma na yaŋ peliŋ sɩ kaa viviisi nɛɛ? Aɩ.

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “That man has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Jɔɔŋ sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ, ʋʋ vɔɔ niiŋ nɛ a bɩ sɩnɩŋ ka nyʋa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sɩ dɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋ nɛ kɛnʋ.

english_verse: After Jesus had finished instructing his twelve disciples, he left and began teaching and preaching in the towns.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo fii arɩ balɩa-la dɛrɛ, ʋ lɩɩ lee-la a mʋ dɩ ʋ dagɛ nɩaa aŋ pɛ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa tasɩ-la sɩ kpagɛ lee-la.

english_verse: John was in prison when he heard what Christ was doing. So John sent some of his followers
translation_verse: Jɔɔŋ Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la fa sɩ hɛ sarɩka lɛ a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Kirisito fa sɩɩ ŋaa, ʋ tɩŋ ʋ harɩ-tooroo dɔnsʋŋ Yesu teeŋ

english_verse: to ask Jesus, “Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else?”
translation_verse: dɩ ba mʋ pɩɛsɛ Yesu, “Bʋla pɩla, ŋ nɛ nɩɩ-la Jɔɔŋ fa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ kɔ, koo la ha gbɩgbɛrɛ nʋʋ dɔŋ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ pɩɛsʋ.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Go and tell John what you have heard and seen.
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má mɩɩra mʋ Jɔɔŋ teeŋ a bʋla pʋ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ na a nɩɩ ma:

english_verse: The blind are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People with leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: Nyʋlɩmaa sɩaa ka suri nɛ, gbɛrɩgɛɛ vɩvɛŋ, gbegisiŋ ma duduori. Taŋŋaa nɩnɩɩ wɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba sisii sʋʋŋ lɛ. Summoo ma wuo nɩnɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ kaa lɛrɛ arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ tɩma, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.”

english_verse: What kind of man did you go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who dress like that live in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa ma lɩɩ dɩ ma na? Ma lɩa dɩ ma na nʋʋ sɩ laalɛ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛɛ? Aɩ. Bee na nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie laalɛ gɛnnɩŋ deemba, ba yie jʋʋ kuori dɩɩsɩŋ nɛ aa nɩɩ sɩma.

english_verse: What did you really go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was. I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Má saa dagɛmɛ kʋ-la ma sɩ mʋa dɩ ma na. Ma mʋa dɩ ma na Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla nɛɛ? Oo, mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ ma na nʋʋ sɩ kɩɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla nɛ.

english_verse: I tell you no one ever born on this earth is greater than John the Baptist. But whoever is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than John.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, Jɔɔŋ, Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la nɛ kɩɩ nʋʋkala ba sɩ lʋla. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa nɩ-bie Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ nɛ yʋga kɩɩ Jɔɔŋ.

english_verse: From the time of John the Baptist until now, violent people have been trying to take over the kingdom of heaven by force.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ Jɔɔŋ sɩ suomo bʋbʋl Wɩa wɩaa a kaa kʋkɔ tapʋlʋŋ deeŋ, nɩaa kɛŋ Wɩa kuorii-la wɩaa yuyuo dɔŋɔ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩduoruŋ wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ba kaa lorigo laa.

english_verse: And if you believe them, John is Elijah, the prophet you are waiting for.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ jaŋ sɛɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla, Jɔɔŋ nɛ ŋaa Ɩlaaja, nɩɩ-la wɩaa ba fa sɩ bʋla arɩ ʋ jaŋ kɔ.

english_verse: “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not mourn!”
translation_verse: ‘La yɩɩ yɩɩlaa nɛ pɩma, aŋ ka ma bɩ gʋa, la ta jembiiŋ pɩma, aŋ ka ma bɩ yele.’

english_verse: But the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, and you say, “That man eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.” Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what it does. The Unbelieving Towns (Luke
translation_verse: Aŋ ka mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie kɔ ma teeŋ a didii kɩaa aŋ pɛ nyʋnyʋa sɩnɩŋ ma. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, ‘Baala deeŋ ŋaa luobii tɩɩna nɛ a ŋaa sɩ-nyʋarʋ ma aŋ pɛ kɛŋ lampoo laaraa arɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa kala kaa dii nandɔnsʋŋ.’ Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɛɩ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ, ba wʋŋaalaa nɛ yie dagɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ.” Tasɩ-la sɩ bɩ Yesu wɩaa laa dii Luuk

english_verse: In the towns where Jesus had worked most of his miracles, the people refused to turn to God. So Jesus was upset with them and said:
translation_verse: Tasɩ-la lɛ Yesu sɩ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa yʋgɛ, ba nɩaa bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba bɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kpɩaba lɛ a bʋl,

english_verse: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? You will go down to hell! If the miracles that took place in your town had happened in Sodom, it would still be standing.
translation_verse: Ma-na Kapɛnam tɩŋŋaa, ma nɛ paala chɩchɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa a kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ. Wɩa jaŋ jomma yuo ta dɩ ma tuu jʋʋ ʋ nyiniŋ. Wʋmagɩlaa deemba kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa ma teeŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ fa ŋaaba Sodom lɛ, ba fa ha jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa kʋkɔ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: So I tell you on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than you. Come to Me and Rest (Luke
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, sarɩya chɛ-diiliŋ Wɩa jaŋ fá Sodom nɩaa nenige a kɩɩ Kapɛnam nɩaa.” Yesu bʋla pɩ nɩaa dɩ ba kɔ ʋ teeŋ a na wiese Luuk

english_verse: At that moment Jesus said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ Yesu guu yɩrɛ, “Mɩ Nyɩmma, ŋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala Tɩɩna. Mɩɩ lɔllʋŋ arɩ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ joŋo faa a dagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ, aŋ bɩ joŋo dagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.
translation_verse: Mɩ Nyɩmma, mɩɩ lɔllʋŋ. Ŋ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who truly knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ Nyɩmma joŋ kʋŋkala doluŋ nɛ pɩmɛ. Mɩ Nyɩmma dʋndʋŋa nɛ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ naga. Mɩ ma dʋndʋŋa nɛ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ naga. Nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ ʋ jɩŋ, see nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ cho dɩ mɩ daga pa.”

english_verse: If you are tired from carrying heavy burdens, come to me and I will give you rest.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩaa, “Má kɔ mɩ teeŋ, ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ lɔlɔ, aŋ ka wɩaa nyagɛma bil, mɩ jaŋ pɩma wiese.

english_verse: Take the yoke I give you. Put it on your shoulders and learn from me. I am gentle and humble, and you will find rest.
translation_verse: Má laa mɩ chʋga a chʋŋ aŋ gʋnnɛ mɩ teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa muuri nɛ, mɩ sɩaa ma fɩɛlɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ na wiese.

english_verse: This yoke is easy to bear, and this burden is light.
translation_verse: Chʋga-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo chʋmma jaŋ ŋaa chʋgʋ-mɔlɩɩ, ʋ bɩ yuŋ.”

english_verse: Some Pharisees noticed this and said to Jesus, “Why are your disciples picking grain on the Sabbath? They are not supposed to do this!”
translation_verse: Farisii tɩŋŋaa sɩ na wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ba bʋla pɩ Yesu, “Ŋ bɩ naa? Chɛ-wiesii-la kɩsɩŋ nɛ ŋ harɩ-tooroo chichei ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The crowds were so amazed they asked, “Could Jesus be the Son of David?”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaa nɩ-daŋ-la kala wʋkpuŋkpere. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Devit bie nɛ ŋ-laa?”

english_verse: But when I force out demons by the power of God's Spirit, it proves that God's kingdom has already come to you.
translation_verse: Wɩa doluŋ nɛ mɩ kaa kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɩaa lɛ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ daga arɩ Wɩa kuorii-la paala kɔ ma teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Haven't you read in the Law of Moses that the priests are allowed to work in the temple on the Sabbath? But no one says they are guilty of breaking the law of the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Koo ma ha bɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto karɩmaa? Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ kala Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa fa yie chei kɩsɩŋ nɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. Ama ba fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, ʋ bɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Don't you know what the Scriptures mean when they say, “Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others?” If you knew what this means, you would not condemn these innocent disciples of mine.
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ, ba ŋmʋnsa arɩ Wɩa sɩ: ‘Mɩ cho dɩ ma fɩfá nɩaa nenige nɛ a kɩɩ ma sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩpɩmɛ.’ Dɩ ma nɛ fa sɛnɛ jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ, ma fa bɩ jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye,

english_verse: Jesus left and went into one of their synagogues,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu lɩɩ lee-la a mʋ jʋʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa,

english_verse: Then Jesus told the man, “Hold out your hand.” The man did, and it became as healthy as the other one.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ nasʋʋ-la tɩɩna, “Kɛŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩɛnɛ.” Ʋ kaa tɩɛnɛ, ʋ fɩɛlɛ a nagɛ ʋ nɩsɩ-la dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: When Jesus found out what was happening, he left there and large crowds followed him. He healed all of their sick,
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ nɩa dɩ ba vʋʋra dɩ ba kpʋʋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ lɩɩ lee-la. Nɩ-daŋ to ʋ harɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ vaarɛ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ kala

english_verse: but warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pɩba dɩ ba sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ teeli leriŋ.

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as Isaiah the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Azaaya fa sɩ bʋla kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: “Here is my chosen servant! I love him, and he pleases me. I will give him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa sɩ: “Mɩ Tɩntɩnna nɛ ŋ-la, nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa, nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ cho, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ bʋl mɩ sarɩya diiniŋ wɩaa a pɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala.

english_verse: If you are not on my side, you are against me. If you don't gather in the harvest with me, you scatter it.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩ bɩ mɩ nʋʋ ŋaa, ʋ lɩɩ mɩ harɩŋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ mɩ lɛ pɛ dɩ la kiri kɩaa hɩhɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, ʋ kaa pɩsa tɩta nɛ.

english_verse: Some people brought to Jesus a man who was blind and could not talk because he had a demon in him. Jesus healed the man, and then he was able to talk and see.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kɛŋ baal kʋbala kaa kɔ Yesu teeŋ. Jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ fa kɛŋ baal-la. Ʋ fa nyʋlɩma nɛ aŋ pɛ taŋ. Yesu vaarɛ baal-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ wuo wɩaa bʋbʋl a nɩna ma.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he said to them: Any kingdom where people fight each other will end up ruined. And a town or family that fights will soon destroy itself.
translation_verse: Yesu wuo jɩŋ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa a bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ tinteeŋ nɩaa nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a bɩ nii-bala kɛnɛ, ba tintee-la jaŋ tel. Dɩ taŋ nɩaa koo naambiiriŋ ma nɛ bɩ nii-bala kɛnɛ, ba dɩa jaŋ tel.

english_verse: If I use the power of Beelzebul to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? Your followers are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Dɩ Bɛlizibul nɛ pɩmɛ doluŋ mɩ kaa kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɩaa lɛ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa joŋ doluŋ pɩ nɩaa deemba sɩɩ to ma harɩŋ ba ma kikiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɩaa lɛ? Nɩaa deemba tɩtɩa daga arɩ maa nyɩɛ nɛ.

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when the demon doesn't find a place,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩaa, “Dɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋ nɛ lɩɩ nʋʋ lɛ, ʋ yie gɔllɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ nɛ a chɩchɛ dɩ-wiesiŋ, aŋ bɩ na.

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and the person ends up in worse shape than before. That's how it will be with you evil people of today. Jesus' Mother and Brothers (Mark
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra lɩɩ a kɛŋ jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ balɩpɛ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɔmɔ kɩɩʋ, ba kʋ jʋʋ a pɛ ʋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ baal-la yie kperi a kɩɩ bumbuŋ-la. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ jaŋ nagɛ a pɩ ma jɩnɩŋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba.” Yesu bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ ʋ naaŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ lɛ Maak

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit. You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ tɩa nɛŋ nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ, see dɩ ŋ kɛŋ tɩa-la sɩ kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ tɩa-la sɩ bɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa kɛnɛ, see dɩ ʋ nɩnɛŋ nɛŋ-lɔrʋnʋŋ. Tɩa nɛnɛɛ nɛ yie dagɛ tɩa-la doho ʋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: You are a bunch of evil snakes, so how can you say anything good? Your words show what is in your hearts.
translation_verse: Ma nuhuobiiŋ basɩŋkpɩaŋ deemba, ɛɛ nɛ ma nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba jaŋ wuo ŋaa a bʋbʋl wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ? Ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa sɩ kɛŋ wɩɩ-la, ʋ nɛ ŋ niiŋ bʋbʋl.

english_verse: I promise you on the day of judgment, everyone will have to account for every careless word they have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma arɩ sarɩya chɛ-diiliŋ, nʋʋkala jaŋ dagɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la ʋ niiŋ sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: On that day they will be told they are either innocent or guilty because of the things they have said. A Sign from Heaven (Mark
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa ma sɩ bʋla nɛ jaŋ dii ma sarɩya a dagɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla koo ma bɩ tʋɔpʋla kɛnɛ.” Nɩaa sɩ dɩ Yesu ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa Maak

english_verse: Some Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses said, “Teacher, we want you to show us a sign from heaven.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba dɔnsʋŋ arɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ ma kɔ Yesu teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “La kʋhɩaŋ, laa chɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wʋmagɩl nɛ dɩ la na.”

english_verse: But Jesus replied: You want a sign because you are evil and won't believe! But the only sign you will get is the sign of the prophet Jonah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Jɩnɩŋ nɩaa ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ nɛ, ba bɩ Wɩa ka fá. Ma sɩ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋmagɩlɩŋ. Aɩ, mɩ bɩ ŋaa. Wʋmagɩlɩŋ ma sɩɩ chɛ, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo naʋ, see wʋmagɩl-la Wɩa fa sɩ ŋaa a tɩgɛ Jona lɛ.

english_verse: He was in the stomach of a big fish for three days and nights, just as the Son of Man will be deep in the earth for three days and nights.
translation_verse: Jona fa sɩ hɛ chenfil-bal-la tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa batori wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie ma jaŋ hɛ sʋʋŋ bʋa tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa batori, wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala.

english_verse: On the day of judgment the people of Nineveh will stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah.
translation_verse: Sarɩya chɛ-diiliŋ, Nɩnɩvɛ nɩaa ma jaŋ sii a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ ma jɩnɩŋ nɩaa woruŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ Jona fa sɩ mʋ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pɩ Nɩnɩvɛ nɩaa, ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ a to Wɩa. Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a yʋga kɩɩ Jona, ka ma bɩ sɛɩ dɩ ma jegile nɩɩ ʋ wɩaa.”

english_verse: it says, “I will go back to the home I left.” When it gets there and finds the place empty, clean, and neat,
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bɩ lee na ŋɩɩ, ʋ yie bʋl ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, ‘Mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ lee-la mɩ sɩ lɩa.’ Ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra mʋmʋ, dɩ dɩa-la wuolo, disiniŋ tuo ʋ lɛ, ba wasʋ ʋ kala zɔŋ.

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking to the crowds, his mother and brothers came and stood outside because they wanted to talk with him.
translation_verse: Yesu fa sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ naaŋ arɩ ʋ ŋaanaa kɔ ʋ teeŋ a kʋ chɩŋ jeeŋ harɩŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba naʋ.

english_verse: Someone told Jesus, “Your mother and brothers are standing outside and want to talk with you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋ bʋla pʋ, “Bee na, ŋ naaŋ arɩ ŋ ŋaanaa nɛ chɩŋ jeeŋ harɩŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba naŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Who is my mother and who are my brothers?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mɩɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa mɩ naaŋ arɩ mɩ ŋaanaa?”

english_verse: Then he pointed to his disciples and said, “These are my mother and my brothers!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ a dagɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ naaŋ arɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ nɛ ŋ-la.

english_verse: Anyone who obeys my Father in heaven is my brother or sister or mother.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ sɩ cho, ʋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ ŋaana arɩ mɩ dɩhaala arɩ mɩ naaŋ.”

english_verse: Such large crowds gathered around him that he had to sit in a boat, while the people stood on the shore.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yʋgɛ a kʋ gollu chu. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sii mʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro tʋɔŋ a hɔŋ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ, ka nɩ-daŋ-la chɩŋ mʋga niiŋ.

english_verse: Then he taught them many things by using stories. He said: A farmer went out to scatter seed in a field.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ magɛ namagaba a dagɛba wɩaa yʋgɛ. Ʋ namagaba-la dɔŋɔ nɛ ŋ-la: Yesu sɩ: “Baal kʋbala nɛ sie a kɛŋ ʋ kʋdoho kaa lɩɩ dɩ ʋ mɩsɛ.

english_verse: Other seeds fell on thin, rocky ground and quickly started growing because the soil wasn't very deep.

translation_verse: Sɩɩpʋʋraa, Yesu sii vɛŋ lɩɩŋ nyuŋ a mʋmʋ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la teeŋ.

english_verse: When they saw him, they thought he was a ghost. They were terrified and started screaming.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ naʋ dɩ ʋʋ vɛŋ lɩɩŋ nyuŋ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba. Ba bʋl dɩ nɩdɩma nɛ aŋ ŋmuŋmoo niiŋ.

english_verse: At once, Jesus said to them, “Don't worry! I am Jesus. Don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu guu bʋla pɩba, “Má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ. Mɩ-na nɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma.”

english_verse: Peter replied, “Lord, if it really is you, tell me to come to you on the water.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, dɩ ŋ nɛ, bʋl dɩ mɩ lɩɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ lɩɩ-la nyuŋ.”

english_verse: At once, Jesus reached out his hand. He helped Peter up and said, “You surely don't have much faith. Why do you doubt?”
translation_verse: Yesu guu lɩɩsɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ a yɩa a kɛnʋ aŋ bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ Wɩa laa diiniŋ bɩ yʋgɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bɩ mɩ wɩaa laa dii?”

english_verse: When Jesus and Peter got into the boat, the wind died down.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la dɛrɛ, pel-la kɛrɛ.

english_verse: The men in the boat worshiped Jesus and said, “You really are the Son of God!” Jesus Heals Sick People in Gennesaret (Mark
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ chʋɔlɛ Yesu aŋ bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie.” Yesu vaarɛ nyanyal tɩɩna Gɛnɛzarɛt lɛ Maak

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples crossed the lake and came to shore near the town of Gennesaret.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba chol a kʋ yi taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Gɛnɛzarɛt.

english_verse: The people found out he was there, and they sent word to everyone who lived in this part of the country. So they brought all the sick people to Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ lee-la na Yesu a jɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɛ. Ba tɩŋ tɩndaarɩŋ pɩ tintee-la sɩ golliba nɩaa ba paa ba nyanyal tɩŋŋaa kala a kaa kɔ Yesu teeŋ.

english_verse: They begged him just to let them touch his clothes, and everyone who did was healed.
translation_verse: Ba sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ digi ʋ gɛrɩŋ niipiniŋ lɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ dige, ba yie duori nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Every plant that my Father in heaven did not plant will be pulled up by the roots.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Tɩa-la kala mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ sɩ yie bɩ chɔnsɔ, ba jaŋ kaa churo ta.

english_verse: “Why don't your disciples obey what our ancestors taught us to do? They don't even wash their hands before they eat.”
translation_verse: “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ harɩ-tooroo chichei la naabalɩmaba kɩsɩnɩŋ lɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ba bɩ ba nɩsaa ka sɔŋ ŋɩɩ la naabalɩmaba sɩ dagɛla aŋ didii kʋdiilee?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: Why do you disobey God and follow your own teaching?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu ma pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma yie vɩa Wɩa wombiiŋ aŋ tuto ma naabalɩmaba wombiiŋ?

english_verse: But you let people get by without helping their parents when they should. You let them say that what they have has been offered to God.
translation_verse: Ama ma-na daga arɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ kʋŋ a magɛ dɩ ʋ joŋo pɛ ʋ nyɩmma koo ʋ naaŋ lɛ, tɩɩna mʋ a bʋla pɩba dɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ kʋ-la pɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: Is this any way to show respect to your parents? You ignore God's commands in order to follow your own teaching.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩra bɩ maga dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ lɛ. A tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ma vɩa Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa nɛ aŋ to ma naabalɩmaba wombiiŋ.

english_verse: It is useless for you to worship me, when you teach rules made up by humans.” What Really Makes People Unclean (Mark
translation_verse: Ba yie chʋɔlɛmɛ pɛɩ nɛ aa dagɛ nuhuobiine wɛnɩŋ aŋ bʋl mɩ nɛ bʋla. Nuhuobiine wɛnɩŋ nɛ baa to aŋ vɩa Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa.’ ” Kɩalɩŋ sɩ yie ŋaa nuhuobiine kɛŋ disiniŋ Maak

english_verse: Stay away from those Pharisees! They are like blind people leading other blind people, and all of them will fall into a ditch.”
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba wɩaa walɩmɛma, ba ŋaa nyʋlɩma nɛ a laa nyʋlɩmaa sɩpaaŋ. Dɩ nyʋlɩma nɛ saa kɛŋ ʋ nyʋlʋŋ dɔŋɔ daaŋ lɛ, ba kala balɩa jaŋ tuu buotuoŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus did not say a word. But the woman kept following along and shouting, so his disciples came up and asked him to send her away.
translation_verse: Ama Yesu bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla ʋ teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo kɔ ʋ teeŋ a bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ haal-la viiri, dɩ ʋ to ba harɩŋ a ŋɩŋaa goŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The food you put into your mouth doesn't make you unclean and unfit to worship God. The bad words that come out of your mouth are what make you unclean.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ naga kʋ-la sɩ yie to nuhuobiine niiŋ tuu nɛ yie ŋaa ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ, ama kʋ-la sɩ yie to ʋ niiŋ lɩɩ nɛ kɛŋ disiniŋ.”

english_verse: Then his disciples came over to him and asked, “Do you know you insulted the Pharisees by what you said?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu harɩ-tooroo kɔ ʋ teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ jɩma arɩ ŋ chei Farisii tɩmma-la tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ?”

english_verse: Jesus then said: Don't any of you know by now what I am talking about?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Ma ma ha bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛɛ?

english_verse: Don't you know that the food you put into your mouth goes into your stomach and then out of your body?
translation_verse: Ma bɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ? Kʋŋ na-kala sɩ jʋʋ nuhuobiine niiŋ, ʋ yie tuu ʋ luoruŋ nɛ a bɩra to ʋ yaraa lɩɩ.

english_verse: But the words that come out of your mouth come from your heart. And they are what make you unfit to worship God.
translation_verse: Ama wɩalɩŋ sɩ yie to ŋ niiŋ lɩɩ, ba yie lɩɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ. Wɩaa deemba nɛ yie ŋaa nɩaa kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: Out of your heart come evil thoughts, murder, unfaithfulness in marriage, vulgar deeds, stealing, telling lies, and insulting others.
translation_verse: Ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ yie bɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ a mʋ kpʋ nɩaa, a mʋ chɛ nɩaa haalaa, a ŋaa bachɔrʋŋ arɩ hachɔrʋŋ wʋŋaalaa, aa gaa, a nyɩɛ wɩaa aa tɩgɛ nɩaa lɛ, a chichei nɩaa yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: These are what make you unclean. Eating without washing your hands will not make you unfit to worship God. A Woman's Faith (Mark
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba nɛ yie ŋaa nɩaa kɛŋ disiniŋ. Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ dii kɩaa aŋ bɩ ʋ nɩsɩŋ sɔmɔ arɩ ma naabalɩmaba sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ tɩɩna kɛŋ disiniŋ.” Yesu vaarɛ Kɛnaŋ tɩɩna Maak

english_verse: Jesus said, “I was sent only to the people of Israel! They are like a flock of lost sheep.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ haal-la, “Wɩa tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ chɛ kɛsɛ piese-la sɩ lɛlɛ nɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa dʋndʋŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Large crowds came and brought many people who were paralyzed or blind or lame or unable to talk. They placed them, and many others, in front of Jesus, and he healed them all.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩ-daŋ kɔ ʋ teeŋ a kɛŋ gbɛrɩgɛɛ arɩ nyʋlɩmaa arɩ taŋŋaa arɩ nyanyal tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ a kaa kʋ bil Yesu naasɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ vaarɛba.

english_verse: Jesus left and went to the territory near the towns of Tyre and Sidon.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii lee-la a mʋ Taaya arɩ Sɩdɔŋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Suddenly a Canaanite woman from there came out shouting, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on me! My daughter is full of demons.”
translation_verse: Dɩ haal kʋbala sɩ hɛ lee-la kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ fa ŋaa Kɛnaŋ tɩɩna nɛ. Ʋ sɩ kɔ ʋ teeŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna Devit Bii, fá mɩ nenige. Jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ kɛŋ mɩ tolo. Ʋ nɩna hɛɛŋ woruŋ.”

english_verse: The woman came closer. Then she knelt down and begged, “Please help me, Lord!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la kʋ tel ʋ naasɩŋ lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, pɛ mɩ lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “It isn't right to take food away from children and feed it to dogs.”
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ hambiisiŋ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ joŋ ba kʋdiilee a yuo pɩ vasɩŋ.”

english_verse: “Lord, this is true,” the woman said, “but even puppies get the crumbs that fall from their owner's table.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, ʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ama vasɩ-la tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ dii kɩalɩŋ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ tel tinteeŋ nɛ ba ma yie paa didii.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Dear woman, you really do have a lot of faith, and you will be given what you want.” At that moment her daughter was healed. Jesus Heals Many People
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ ŋaa haal sɩ laa Wɩa dii kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ. Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa pɩŋ.” Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ ʋ tolo-la duori. Yesu vaarɛ nɩaa yʋgɛ

english_verse: From there, Jesus went along Lake Galilee. Then he climbed a hill and sat down.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra sii lee-la a to Galilii mʋga-la dɩɩrɩŋ mʋ. Ʋ jɩl peeliŋ nyuŋ a hɔŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed at what they saw and heard. People who had never spoken could now speak. The lame were healed, the paralyzed could walk, and the blind were able to see. Everyone was praising the God of Israel. Jesus Feeds Four Thousand (Mark
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ-la sɩ na taŋŋaa dɩ baa bʋl wɩaa arɩ gbɛrɩgɛɛ sɩɩ vɛŋ, arɩ nyʋlɩmaa sɩaa sɩ suro, ʋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere. Ba dɩdɛnnɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa. Yesu pɩ nɩaa bʋɩ banɛsɛ kʋdiilee Maak

english_verse: Jesus called his disciples together and told them, “I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry. They might faint on their way home.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu yɩrɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo a bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ sɩ beŋ nɩaa deemba, nenige kɛmmɛ nɛ. Ba hɛ mɩ teeŋ tapʋlaa batori nɛ ŋ-la aŋ bɩ kʋdiilee kɛnɛ dɩ ba dii. Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ ba viiri dɩ ba nɛ bɩ kʋŋkala die. Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ wuo mʋ yiegi wombiiŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: His disciples said, “This place is like a desert. Where can we find enough food to feed such a crowd?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo pɩɛsʋ, “Nɩɩ nɛ la jaŋ na kʋdiilee dɩ nɩ-daŋ deeŋ kala dii gɩrɩŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ?”

english_verse: Jesus asked them how much food they had. They replied, “Seven small loaves of bread and a few little fish.”
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Boroboro baŋmɛɛ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ?” Ba sɩ, “Kɩaa balɩpɛ nɛ arɩ chenfil-biisiŋ ma mʋa.”

english_verse: After Jesus had told the people to sit down,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ tuu hɔŋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: he took the seven loaves of bread and the fish and gave thanks. He then broke them and handed them to his disciples, who passed them around to the crowds.
translation_verse: Ka ʋ joŋ boroboroba-la balɩpɛ arɩ chenfile-la a lɔllɛ Wɩa aŋ kaa chɔgɛ chɔgɛ a pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo dɩ ba laa kpaa nɩ-daŋ-la. Ba laa kpaaba.

english_verse: Everyone ate all they wanted, and the leftovers filled seven large baskets.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala dii a vɔgɛ. Ka ba paa kʋkaaŋ-biisiŋ a su sinsiŋ balɩpɛ.

english_verse: After Jesus had sent the crowds away, he got into a boat and sailed across the lake. He came to shore near the town of Magadan.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ta nɩ-daŋ-la aŋ mʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro a mʋ Magadaŋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Don't you know by now that I am not talking to you about bread? Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees!
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ ma bɩɩnɛ arɩ ma teeŋ nɛ mɩɩ bʋl kʋdiilee wɩaa? Má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa arɩ Saduusi tɩŋŋaa lɛ. Ba nagɛ sɩbʋrʋŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples were near the town of Caesarea Philippi, he asked them, “What do people say about the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii mʋ Sɩzarɩya Fɩlɩpa tinteeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nɩaa sɩ dɩ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie ŋaa?”

english_verse: Finally, the disciples understood that Jesus wasn't talking about the yeast used to make bread, but about the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees. Who Is Jesus? (Mark
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo jɩŋ arɩ ʋ bɩ sɩ dɩ ba pɔ ba tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ sɩ-bʋrʋ-la ba sɩ kaa hɩhɛ boroboro lɛ nɛ, ama ʋ sɩ ba pɔ ba tɩtɩa lɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa arɩ Saduusi tɩŋŋaa wʋbʋlaa lɛ nɛ. Pɩɩta dagɛ nɩɩ-la Yesu sɩ ŋaa Maak

english_verse: He told them: If the sky is red in the evening, you say the weather will be good.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ wɩa nɩɩ jʋʋ, ka ma na wɩɩ-muluŋ sɩɩŋ dɩ ʋ fɩɛsa, ma yie bʋl dɩ leriŋ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: But if the sky is red and gloomy in the morning, you say it is going to rain. You can tell what the weather will be like by looking at the sky. But you don't understand what is happening now.
translation_verse: Chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla ma, dɩ leriŋ nɛ bire, ma yie bʋl arɩ duonuŋ jaŋ nɩɩ. Ma yie wuo beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ a wuo jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa, ama ma bɩ wuo jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: The disciples answered, “Some people say you are John the Baptist or maybe Elijah or Jeremiah or some other prophet.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Dɔnsʋŋ sɩ dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Jɔɔŋ, Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la. Dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Ɩlaaja. Dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Jɛrɩmaaya, koo Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: From then on, Jesus began telling his disciples what would happen to him. He said, “I must go to Jerusalem. There the nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses will make me suffer terribly. I will be killed, but three days later I will rise to life.”
translation_verse: A suomi bʋa-la lɛ Yesu chaasa bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo a bʋl, “Ʋ maga dɩ mɩ mʋ Jerusalɛm a na hɛɛŋ woruŋ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ kpʋmɛ, ama mɩ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus then warned them, “Watch out! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ arɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa arɩ Saduusi tɩŋŋaa, ba nagɛ sɩbʋrʋŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: The disciples talked this over and said to each other, “He must be saying this because we didn't bring along any bread.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba suomo bʋla pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ, “La bɩ kʋdiilee koro kɔ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ.”

english_verse: The Son of Man will soon come in the glory of his Father and with his angels to reward all people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie jaŋ kɔ arɩ mɩ Nyɩmma tʋla, a pɛ mɩ tɩndaaraa lɛ. Dɩ la nɛ kɔ, Wɩa jaŋ tiŋ nʋʋkala a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ tɩma.

english_verse: So I will call you Peter, which means “a rock.” On this rock I will build my church, and death itself will not have any power over it.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa Pɩɩta, mɩ bʋlaa pɩŋ arɩ ŋ nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ. Bʋŋ-la nyuŋ nɛ mɩ jaŋ saa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii dɩa. Sʋʋŋ ma bɩ jaŋ wuo yigi dɩa-la lo.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “But who do you say I am?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra pɩɛsɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la ma, “Ka ma ma, ma sɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa kʋbɛɛ?”

english_verse: Simon Peter spoke up, “You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta bʋl, “Ŋ nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, Wɩa-la sɩ weye Bie.”

english_verse: Jesus told him: Simon, son of Jonah, you are blessed! You didn't discover this on your own. It was shown to you by my Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Saamɔŋ, Jɔɔŋ bie, Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ, wʋjɩmɩŋ deeŋ bɩ naga nuhuobiine nɛ pɩŋ. Ama mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ pɩŋ.

english_verse: I will give you the keys to the kingdom of heaven, and God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth. But he will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ Wɩa kuorii-la boribiee pɩŋ. Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ vɩa dʋnɩa lɛ, ba jaŋ vɩaʋ Wɩa-jaŋ ma. Wɩɩ-la ma ŋ sɩ sɛyɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, ba jaŋ sɛyʋ Wɩa-jaŋ ma lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples not to tell anyone he was the Messiah. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Mark
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ dɩ ba sɩ́ bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa. Yesu bʋl ʋ hɛɛŋ nanɩŋ arɩ ʋ sʋʋnʋŋ wɩaa Maak

english_verse: Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that. He said, “God would never let this happen to you, Lord!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta kɛnʋ kaa sʋʋsa lɩɩ a kpɩaʋ lɛ a bʋl, “Wɩa bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ, mɩ Tɩɩna. Wɩɩ-la bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus turned to Peter and said, “Satan, get away from me! You're in my way because you think like everyone else and not like God.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mɩɩra chaasɛ Pɩɩta a bʋla pʋ, “Sɩtaanɩ, mʋ nɩmɛ! Ŋŋ chɛ ŋ nyɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ vɩa wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ mɩ ŋaa nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ bʋl, nuhuobiine wombiiŋ nɛ, Wɩa wombiiŋ dee.”

english_verse: Then Jesus said to his disciples: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “Dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ tomi, see dɩ ʋ vɩa ʋ tɩtɩa wombiiŋ aŋ joŋ ʋ daagɛsɛ baasɛ a to mɩ harɩŋ.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will find it.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ laa ʋ tɩtɩa mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ vɩa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ sɛnɛ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself? What would you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ dʋnɩa kʋŋkala aŋ bɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kɛnɛ Wɩa teeŋ, bɛɛ kʋŋ nyʋʋrɩɩ nɛ ŋ na? Dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo kaa lenni ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ?

english_verse: I promise you some of those standing here will not die before they see the Son of Man coming with his kingdom.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, mɩ bʋlaa pɩma arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, ba bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ see dɩ ba na mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie dɩ mɩ kɔ arɩ mɩ kuorii-la.”

english_verse: There in front of the disciples, Jesus was completely changed. His face was shining like the sun, and his clothes became white as light.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ Yesu bɩrɩmɛ ba sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ sɩaa kala tʋtʋl a nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ sɩɩ tʋl ŋɩɩ. Ʋ gɛnnɩŋ ma pʋllɛ a tʋtʋl.

english_verse: Then the disciples understood Jesus was talking to them about John the Baptist. Jesus Heals a Boy (Mark
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la jɩŋ arɩ Jɔɔŋ Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la wɩaa nɛ ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ. Yesu kiri jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ bie lɛ Maak

english_verse: Six days later Jesus took Peter and the brothers James and John with him. They went up on a very high mountain where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa balɩdʋ sɩ bala, Yesu kɛŋ Pɩɩta arɩ Jeems arɩ ʋ naambie Jɔɔŋ, ba mʋ peel-bal kʋbala nyuŋ a hɛ nɩmɛ ba dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: All at once Moses and Elijah were there talking with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis arɩ Ɩlaaja kʋ lɩɩ ba sɩpaaŋ, a bʋbʋl wɩaa Yesu teeŋ.

english_verse: So Peter said to him, “Lord, it is good for us to be here! Let us make three shelters, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋla pɩ Yesu, “La Tɩɩna, ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ arɩ la sɩ hɛ daha. Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ la jaŋ hɛ lɛŋŋɛɛ batori daha, dɩ ŋ kɛŋ dɔŋɔ, dɩ Mosis ma kɛŋ dɔŋɔ, dɩ Ɩlaaja ma kɛŋ dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the shadow of a bright cloud passed over them. From the cloud a voice said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Pɩɩta fa ha sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ kʋ tɔba, ka yikoro kʋbala lɩɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la tʋɔŋ a bʋbʋl, “Mɩ Bii-chooluŋ nɛ ŋ-la. Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ. Má jegile nɩɩ ʋ teeŋ.”

english_verse: When the disciples heard the voice, they were so afraid they fell flat on the ground.
translation_verse: Yesu harɩ-tooro-la sɩ nɩɩ nɩɩ-la yikoro, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba, ba tuu tel tinteeŋ.

english_verse: But Jesus came over and touched them. He said, “Get up and don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu kɔ ba teeŋ a digiba aŋ bʋla pɩba dɩ ba sii aŋ sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá.

english_verse: When they opened their eyes, they saw only Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ sie a beŋ, ba bɩ nʋʋkala na see Yesu dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: The disciples asked Jesus, “Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say Elijah must come before the Messiah does?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba bʋl dɩ Ɩlaaja nɛ maga ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ kɔ, aŋ ka dɩ Wɩa Bie-na kɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Elijah certainly will come and get everything ready.
