translation_verse: Yesu bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, Ɩlaaja jaŋ sɛnɛ laa sɩpaaŋ kɔ a kɛŋ kʋŋkala wasa bil.

english_verse: In fact, he has already come. But the people did not recognize him and treated him just as they wanted to. They will soon make the Son of Man suffer in the same way.”
translation_verse: Ama mɩ bʋlaa pɩma arɩ Ɩlaaja paala kɔ nɛ, ama nɩaa bɩ wuo jɩmʋ. Ba ŋaaʋ ŋɩɩ kala ba sɩɩ chɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie.”

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples returned to the crowd. A man knelt in front of him
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo batori-la sii lɩɩ peel-la nyuŋ a kʋ tuu nɩ-daŋ-la teeŋ. Dɩ baal kʋbala kɔ Yesu teeŋ a kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ

english_verse: and said, “Lord, have pity on my son! He has a bad case of epilepsy and often falls into a fire or into water.
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, fá mɩ bie nenige, ʋʋ tel kuŋkunsuŋ nɛ. Nyanyalɩɩ-la jʋʋ-ʋ lɛ nɛ woruŋ ʋ nɩna hɛɛŋ, ʋ yie titel nyiniŋ koo lɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I brought him to your disciples, but none of them could heal him.”
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛnʋ kaa kɔ ŋ harɩ-tooroo teeŋ, ama ba bɩ wuo vaarʋ.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You people are too stubborn to have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy here.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Ma lɛɛlɛ nɩaa deemba, ma bɩ Wɩa laa dii, ma ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ nɛ. Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ nyalɩmɛ a diene magɛ ma teeŋ? Kɛŋ bile kaa kɔ mɩ teeŋ.”

english_verse: Then Jesus spoke sternly to the demon. It went out of the boy, and right then he was healed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la lɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ bile lɛ, ʋ lɩɩ. Bile guu duori.

english_verse: Later the disciples went to Jesus in private and asked him, “Why couldn't we force out the demon?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la kɔ ʋ teeŋ a lʋara pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ la-na bɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la wuo kiri?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: It is because you don't have enough faith! But I can promise you this. If you had faith no larger than a mustard seed, you could tell this mountain to move from here to there. And it would. Everything would be possible for you. Jesus Again Speaks about His Death (Mark
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa bɩ jaŋ pɩma doluŋ dɩ ma wuo kikiri jɩŋ-dosunuŋ deemba, see ma vɔɔ niiŋ aŋ pɛ chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa.]” Yesu bɩra bʋl ʋ sʋʋŋ wɩaa Maak

english_verse: While Jesus and his disciples were going from place to place in Galilee, he told them, “The Son of Man will be handed over to people
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo kala kʋ hilimi Galilii lɛ, ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ba jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie a hɛ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ

english_verse: who will kill him. But three days later he will rise to life.” All of this made the disciples very sad. Paying the Temple Tax
translation_verse: dɩ ba kpʋmɛ, ama ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ mɩ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.” Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ harɩ-tooroo tʋɔŋ chei. Wɩa dɩa lampoo

english_verse: When Jesus and the others arrived in Capernaum, the collectors for the temple tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your teacher pay the temple tax?”
translation_verse: Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo sɩ kɔ Kapɛnam, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ laa Wɩa dɩa lampoo kɔ Pɩɩta teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Ma kʋhɩaŋ ka tiŋ Wɩa dɩa time nɛɛ?”

english_verse: “Yes, he does,” Peter answered. After they had returned home, Jesus went up to Peter and asked him, “Simon, what do you think? Do the kings of this earth collect taxes and fees from their own people or from foreigners?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋl dɩ ʋʋ tiŋ nɛ. Pɩɩta sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ aŋ mɩɩra jʋʋ dɩa, Yesu laa sɩpaaŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ tiŋ lampoo a pɩpɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ kuoroo? Ba taŋ nɩaa koo nʋhʋɔraa? Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ bɩɩnɛ?”

english_verse: Peter answered, “From foreigners.” Jesus replied, “Then their own people don't have to pay.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋl dɩ nʋhʋɔraa nɛ. Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ-na taŋ-la nɩaa bɩ maga ba tiŋ kʋŋkala.

english_verse: But we don't want to cause trouble. So go cast a line into the lake and pull out the first fish you hook. Open its mouth, and you will find a coin. Use it to pay your taxes and mine.”
translation_verse: Ama la-na bɩ chɛ dɩ la ŋaa wɩɩ a chei nɩaa deemba tʋɔŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa kɛŋ gbɩaŋ tuu hɛ fuoŋ lɛ a kɛsɛ chenfilee. Gbɩaŋ-la sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ chenfil-bumbuŋ-la, kɛŋ ʋ niiŋ suri, ŋ jaŋ na moribiiŋ ʋ niiŋ lɛ. Lɩɩsɛ moribii-la a tiŋ mɩ dɩ ŋ nyʋŋ lampoo.”

english_verse: If your eye causes you to sin, poke it out and get rid of it. You would be better off to go into life with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fires of hell. The Lost Sheep (Luke
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ sɩɩŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ kɛnɩŋ hɛ wʋbɔmʋŋ lɛ, lɩɩsa ta. Ŋ sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ arɩ sɩɩ-togo, ʋ nɛ kpɩa ba sɩ joŋuŋ yuo hɛ Wɩa nyiniŋ lɛ arɩ sɩɩ-pilimee.” Yesu magɛ namaga a mʋ tɩgɛ pie-lɛlɩŋ lɛ Luuk

english_verse: Don't you think you should show pity to someone else, as I did to you?”
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ŋ-na bɩ wuo fá ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna-la nenige arɩ mɩ sɩ fá ŋ nenige ŋɩɩ?’

english_verse: But if you are as humble as this child, you are the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa muuri a nagɛ hambie, ʋ nɛ kɩɩ ʋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: And when you welcome one of these children because of me, you welcome me. Temptations To Sin (Mark
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ bii-bie deeŋ yiri woruŋ a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa, mɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ woruŋ ŋɩɩ. Yesu bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ Maak

english_verse: If the follower refuses to listen to them, report the matter to the church. Anyone who refuses to listen to the church must be treated like an unbeliever or a tax collector. Allowing and Not Allowing
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ vɩa dɩ ʋ jegile nɩɩ ma teeŋ, ŋ-na bʋl wɩɩ-la pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi. Dɩ ʋ nɛ vɩa dɩ ʋ jegile nɩɩ ba ma teeŋ, dɔgɩsʋ arɩ ŋ bɩ ʋ jɩŋ a nagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ koo a nagɛ lampoo laara sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ. Ŋ sɩ vɩa wɩɩ-la arɩ ŋ sɩ sɛɩ wɩɩ-la

english_verse: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the deepest part of the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks!
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ na hambiisi-la sɩɩ tomi dɔŋɔ a nyɩsʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ, dɩ ba nɛ joŋ nɔmʋŋ a vɔɔ laalɛ ʋ baŋŋaa lɛ a joŋu yuo hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ nyʋa lɩɩŋ a sʋʋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ kpɩa ʋ sɩ weye.

english_verse: If your hand or foot causes you to sin, chop it off and throw it away! You would be better off to go into life paralyzed or lame than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into the fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩsɩŋ koo ŋ naaŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ kɛnɩŋ hɛ wʋbɔmʋŋ lɛ, kere ta. Ŋ sɩ jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ arɩ naakuuŋ koo nakuuŋ, ʋ nɛ kpɩa ŋ sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ napilimee koo naapilimee aŋ jʋʋ Wɩa nyiniŋ.

english_verse: If one of my followers sins against you, go and point out what was wrong. But do it in private, just between the two of you. If that person listens, you have won back a follower.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sɩ, “Dɩ ŋ naambie nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ cheyiŋ, mʋ a bʋl wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa cheyiŋ pʋ, ama ŋaa ŋɩɩ ŋ dɩ ʋ dʋndʋŋa balɩa pɛgɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ bʋl, ŋ dɩ ŋ naambie bɩra sɩma nɛ.

english_verse: Don't be cruel to any of these little ones! I promise you their angels are always with my Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie kɔ dɩ mɩ chɛ a laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɛlɛ nɛ a ta.]”

english_verse: That's how it is with your Father in heaven. He doesn't want any of these little ones to be lost. When Someone Sins (Luke
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ saa mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ bɩ chɛ dɩ hambiisiŋ deemba kʋŋ lɛl.” Yesu dagɛ ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ la naambie nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ a chei la lɛ

english_verse: But if that one refuses to listen, take along one or two others. The Scriptures teach that every complaint must be proven true by two or more witnesses.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ jegile nɩɩ ŋ teeŋ, kɛŋ nʋʋ dɔŋ koo nɩaa balɩa pɛ ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ dɩ ma bɩra mʋ ʋ teeŋ a bʋl wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa chei a wasɛ. Nɩaa balɩa koo batori nɛ maga ba pɛ na wɩɩ ka dɩ ʋ-na chɩŋ.

english_verse: I promise you God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth, but God will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, mɩ bʋlaa pɩma arɩ wɩɩ-la ma sɩ vɩa dʋnɩa lɛ, ba jaŋ vɩaʋ Wɩa-jaŋ ma. Wɩɩ-la ma ma sɩ sɛyɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, ba jaŋ sɛyʋ Wɩa-jaŋ ma.

english_verse: I promise that when any two of you on earth agree about something you are praying for, my Father in heaven will do it for you.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bɩra bʋla pɩma arɩ ma nɩaa balɩa nɛ kɛŋ nii-bala a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a chɩchɛ kʋŋ mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ teeŋ, ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma.

english_verse: Whenever two or three of you come together in my name, I am there with you. An Official Who Refused To Forgive
translation_verse: Lee-la nɩaa balɩa koo batori sɩ hilime mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ hɛ ba teeŋ.” Tɩntɩnnʋ-la sɩ bɩ chɩmɩŋ joŋo chɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna

english_verse: Peter came up to the Lord and asked, “How many times should I forgive someone who does something wrong to me? Is seven times enough?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta kɔ Yesu teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, dɩ mɩ naambie nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ a chei mɩ lɛ, naansɩɩŋ bʋŋmɛɛ nɛ maga mɩ joŋo chɛʋ? Mɩ joŋo chɛʋ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ koo?”

english_verse: This story will show you what the kingdom of heaven is like: One day a king decided to call in his officials and ask them to give an account of what they owed him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu magɛ namaga a kɛŋ Wɩa kuorii-la a kaa mɩmagɩsɛ kuoro arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa a bʋl, “Kuoru kʋbala nɛ sie a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ pɩɛsɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa ʋ chɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: As he was doing this, one official was brought in who owed him
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ suomo dɩ ʋ pɩɛsɛ, ba kɛŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa dɔŋɔ kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ dii ʋ chɩmɩŋ siidi bʋɩ bʋɩ nɛ.

english_verse: But he didn't have any money to pay what he owed. The king ordered him to be sold, along with his wife and children and all he owned, in order to pay the debt.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ chɩŋ-la wuo tiŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la bʋl dɩ ba kɛŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ haala arɩ ʋ biiriŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ a kaa mʋ yallɛ a tiŋ chɩŋ-la.

english_verse: The official got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you every cent I owe!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnʋ-la tuu kpirimi ʋ naadʋsʋŋ nyuŋ a sʋlʋ, ‘Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, dii kenyiri. Mɩ jaŋ tiŋ chɩŋ-la kala.’

english_verse: The king felt sorry for him and let him go free. He even told the official that he did not have to pay back the money.
translation_verse: Ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la fá ʋ nisusuŋ woruŋ a joŋ chɩŋ-la chɛʋ aŋ leŋ ʋ mʋ.

english_verse: The man got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you back.”
translation_verse: Ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔŋ-la ma tuu kpirimi ʋ naadʋsʋŋ nyuŋ a sʋlʋ a bʋl, ‘Dii kenyiri, mɩ jaŋ timiŋ.’

english_verse: But the first official refused to have pity. Instead, he went and had the other official put in jail until he could pay what he owed.
translation_verse: Ʋ vɩa aŋ kɛnʋ mʋ tɔ dɩa, aŋ bʋl see dɩ ʋ tiŋ chɩŋ-la.

english_verse: When some other officials found out what had happened, they felt sorry for the man who had been put in jail. Then they told the king what had happened.
translation_verse: Ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔsʋŋ sɩ na wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa, ba tʋɔŋ kala faasa chei. Ba mʋ bʋla pɩ ba kʋhɩaŋ wɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: The king called the first official back in and said, “You're an evil man! When you begged for mercy, I said you did not have to pay back a cent.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoru-la yɩrʋ a pɩɛsʋ, ‘Ŋ-na tɩntɩnna deeŋ, ŋ ŋaa nɩbɔŋ nɛ. Ŋ sɩ sʋlmɛ, mɩ joŋ chɩŋ-la kala ŋ sɩ die a chɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The king was so angry that he ordered the official to be tortured until he could pay back everything he owed.
translation_verse: Kuoru-la na baanɩŋ woruŋ ʋ nyuŋ a ŋaa ba kɛnʋ tɔ dɩa see dɩ ʋ tiŋ chɩŋ-la kala.”

english_verse: That is how my Father in heaven will treat you, if you don't forgive each of my followers with all your heart.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sɩ, “Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ sɛɩ dɩ ma joŋ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba arɩ ma tʋɔŋ kala, mɩ Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ ma jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: When Jesus finished teaching, he left Galilee and went to the part of Judea east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɛrɛ, ʋ lɩɩ Galilii tinteeŋ a mʋ Judiya tinteeŋ a chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la.

english_verse: Some people are unable to marry because of birth defects or because of what someone has done to their bodies. Others stay single in order to serve God better. Anyone who can accept this teaching should do so.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Mark
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ baalaa bɩ haalaa ka jaa, ba yʋga nɛ. Ba lʋl dɔnsʋŋ ba paala bɩ haalaa wuo pɩŋ. Dɔnsʋŋ ma, nuhuobiinee nɛ ŋaaba ŋɩɩ, dɔnsʋŋ ma bɩ haalaa jaa a tɩŋ Wɩa kuorii-la wɩaa. Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ wuo laa wɩɩŋ deeŋ dii, ʋ sɛɩ.” Yesu joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ hambiisiŋ lɛ Maak

english_verse: Large crowds followed him, and he healed their sick.
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ bɩra to ʋ harɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ vaarɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. They came up to him and asked, “Is it right for a man to divorce his wife for just any reason?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ ma sii kɔ ʋ teeŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba magɩsʋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Dɩ ŋ kɛŋ wɩɩ a tɩgɛ ŋ haala lɛ a chɩchɛ ŋ vɩaʋ, ʋ ŋaa wombii nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Don't you know in the beginning the Creator made a man and a woman?
translation_verse: Yesu mɩɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Ma bɩ karɩma arɩ bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ bugumo ŋaa dʋnɩa, nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa, ba fa ŋaa baal arɩ haal nɛɛ?

english_verse: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married. He becomes like one person with his wife.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ baala jaŋ leŋ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ aŋ ka ʋ dɩ ʋ haala mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Nɩaa deemba balɩa jaŋ kɛŋ chal-bala.

english_verse: Then they are no longer two people, but one. And no one should separate a couple God has joined together.”
translation_verse: Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɩaa balɩa, see kʋbala. Nɩalɩŋ saa Wɩa sɩ kaa mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ nuhuobiine kɛmba pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Pharisees asked Jesus, “Why did Moses say a man could write out divorce papers and send his wife away?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la bɩra pɩɛsʋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ Mosis fa sɩ dɩ baala nɩɩ chɛ ʋ vɩa ʋ haala, dɩ ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ a ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ haal-la aŋ-na vɩaʋ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You are so heartless! That's why Moses allowed you to divorce your wife. But from the beginning God did not intend it to be that way.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Ma tʋɔŋ dolie. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Mosis fa sɛɩ dɩ ma vɩa ma haalaa. Ama dʋnɩa dɩ-suomuŋ, ba fa bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: I say if your wife has not committed some terrible sexual sin, you must not divorce her to marry someone else. If you do, you are unfaithful.”
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, baal-na kala sɩ vɩa ʋ haala aŋ bɩra jaa dɔŋɔ, baal-la ŋaa bachɔrʋŋ nɛ, see dɩ haal-la ka ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa.”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Only those people who have been given the gift of staying single can accept this teaching.
translation_verse: Yesu mɩɩra bʋla pɩba, “Wɩɩŋ deeŋ bɩ naga arɩ nʋʋkala jaŋ wuo ŋaa. Nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋ doluŋ pa, ba dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ wuo ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Some people brought their children to Jesus, so he could place his hands on them and pray for them. His disciples told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa sii kɔ Yesu teeŋ a kɛŋ ba hambiisiŋ kaa kɔ dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ ba lɛ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo kpɩa nɩalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: A man came to Jesus and asked, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala ma nɛ sie a kɔ Yesu teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛ Yesu, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, wʋzɔŋ bɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ?”

english_verse: “Which ones?” the man asked. Jesus answered, “Do not murder. Be faithful in marriage. Do not steal. Do not tell lies about others.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la pɩɛsʋ, “Wʋbɛɛba nɛ?” Yesu sɩ, “Sɩ́ nɩaa kpʋ, sɩ́ ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna haala chɛ, sɩ́ gaa, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa pɛ-naarʋ wɩɩ lɛ, sɩ́ wɩaa nyɩɛ pɛ.

english_verse: After Jesus had placed his hands on the children, he left. A Rich Young Man (Mark
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ ba lɛ aŋ viiri. Kɩaa tɩɩna kɔ Yesu teeŋ Maak

english_verse: Jesus said to him, “Why do you ask me about what is good? Only God is good. If you want to have eternal life, you must obey his commandments.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ pɩɛsɛmɛ wʋzɔmɔ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩaa? Nɩbala dʋndʋŋa nɛ zɔmɔ. Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, tuto wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ daga.”

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Let the children come to me, and don't try to stop them! People who are like these children belong to God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ na ŋɩɩ, ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Má leŋ dɩ hambiisi-la kɔ mɩ teeŋ, má sɩ́ ba kiru! Nɩaa deemba doho nɛ jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: But many who are now first will be last, and many who are last will be first.
translation_verse: Ama sɩpaalaaraa yʋga sɩ jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ harɩ-tooroo. Harɩ-tooroo ma yʋga sɩ jaŋ kʋ bɩrɩmɛ sɩpaalaaraa.”

english_verse: Respect your father and mother. And love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Zizil ŋ nyɩmma arɩ ŋ naaŋ, a cho ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna arɩ ŋ sɩ cho ŋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The young man said, “I have obeyed all of these. What else must I do?”
translation_verse: Baal-la bʋla pɩ Yesu, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, mɩ to wɩaa deemba kala nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ saa ka?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If you want to be perfect, go sell everything you own! Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come and be my follower.”
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ ŋ ŋaa nɩzɔŋ a sɩ́ wɩɩkala kɛŋ, joŋ ŋ kɩaa kala yallɛ a joŋ moribie-la a pɩ summoo aŋ kʋ tomi. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ kɩaa Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, baal-la tʋɔŋ chei, ʋ sii viiri, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ kɛŋ kɩaa nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “I tell you, it's terribly hard for rich people to get into the kingdom of heaven!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, ʋ ŋaa wʋduo nɛ arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa sɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra bʋlaa pɩma, ʋ bɩ hɛɩ arɩ bʋntaŋŋa sɩ jaŋ wuo to gɛrɩ-hɛmɩŋ bʋa lɩɩ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛyɛ ŋɩɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa sɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly surprised and asked, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Ʋ harɩ-tooro-la sɩ nɩɩ wɩaa deemba, ba faasa hirigi a pɩɛsɛ Yesu, “Dɩ ʋ nɛ nagɛ ŋ-la, kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa Wɩa jaŋ laa ta?”

english_verse: Jesus looked straight at them and said, “There are some things people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Yesu mɩɩra bemba aŋ bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kperi nuhuobiine, ʋ bɩ Wɩa wuo kperi. Wɩa wuo wɩɩkala ŋaa nɛ.”

english_verse: Peter replied, “Remember, we have left everything to be your followers! What will we get?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋla pʋ, “Na, la-na leŋ la kʋŋkala nɛ aŋ tuto ŋ harɩŋ. Bɛɛ nɛ saa la jaŋ na?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: Yes, all of you have become my followers. And so in the future world, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, I promise you will sit on twelve thrones to judge the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, dɩ dʋnɩa falɩɩ-la nɛ yie, mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie jaŋ hɔŋ mɩ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ Wɩa pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ, ma harɩ-tooroo deemba fii arɩ balɩa-la sɩ to mɩ harɩŋ, ma ma jaŋ hɔŋ kuoru kpasɩnɩŋ fii arɩ balɩa nyuŋ a bibeŋ Iziral tinteyee fii arɩ balɩa-la a dii ba sarɩya.

english_verse: All who have given up home or brothers and sisters or father and mother or children or land for me will be given
translation_verse: Bɩra, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ leŋ ʋ dɩɩsɩŋ koo ʋ naambiiriŋ koo ʋ nyɩmma koo ʋ naaŋ koo ʋ biiriŋ koo ʋ bagɩsɩŋ a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa, ʋ tɩɩna jaŋ bɩra na kɩaa deemba naansɩɩŋ zɔlɔ, aŋ pɛ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: As Jesus was telling what the kingdom of heaven would be like, he said: Early one morning a man went out to hire some workers for his vineyard.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra magɛ namaga a pɩba a bʋl dɩ Wɩa kuorii-la nagɛ baal kʋbala sɩ kɛŋ ʋ baga nɛ. Chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla ʋ lɩɩ chɩchɛ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ pɛrɛ ʋ baga-la lɛ ka ʋ timba.

english_verse: After he had agreed to pay them the usual amount for a day's work, he sent them off to his vineyard.
translation_verse: Ba sɛɩ arɩ ba jaŋ mʋ pɛrɛ, ka ʋ timba warɩpʋla kʋbala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ ba mʋ ʋ baga-la a pɩpɛrɛ.

english_verse: About nine that morning, the man saw some other people standing in the market with nothing to do.
translation_verse: Ʋ kʋ magɛ kerifi nibi, ʋ bɩra lɩɩ a na nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba chɩŋ yɔbɔ tʋɔŋ pɛɩ. Ba bɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala ka tɩŋ.

english_verse: So they went. At noon and again about three in the afternoon he returned to the market. And each time he made the same agreement with others who were loafing around with nothing to do.
translation_verse: Kerifi fii arɩ balɩa yi, ʋ bɩra lɩɩ a na nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ a ŋaa ba ma mʋ ʋ baga-la. Ʋ bɩra lɩɩ kerifi batori bʋa lɛ a bɩra na nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ a ŋaa ba ma mʋ ʋ baga-la.

english_verse: Finally, about five in the afternoon the man went back and found some others standing there. He asked them, “Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?”
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra kʋ kpagɛ kerifi banɔŋ, ʋ bɩra lɩɩ yɔbɔ tʋɔŋ a na nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma dɩ ba ha chɩŋ nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma chɩŋ daha pɛɩ chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala, ma bɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala ka tɩŋ?”

english_verse: “Because no one has hired us,” they answered. Then he told them to go work in his vineyard.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pʋ arɩ ba bɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa na dɩ ba tɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba dɩ ba ma mʋ a tɩŋ ʋ baga lɛ. Ba ma mʋ.

english_verse: That evening the owner of the vineyard told the man in charge of the workers to call them in and give them their money. He also told the man to begin with the ones who were hired last.
translation_verse: Dɩdaanɩŋ sɩ yie, ŋɩɩ nɛ baga-la tɩɩna yɩrɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ ʋ baga-la dɩ ʋ yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩŋ ʋ baga-la lɛ a timba, dɩ ʋ suomi nɩalɩŋ sɩ to harɩŋ mʋ baga-la a timba aŋ-na mʋ yi nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ mʋ baga-la.

english_verse: they began complaining to the owner of the vineyard.
translation_verse: Ba laa moribie-la aŋ gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa baga-la tɩɩna teeŋ.

english_verse: They said, “The ones who were hired last worked for only one hour. But you paid them the same that you did us. And we worked in the hot sun all day long!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pʋ, “Nɩaa deemba sɩ to harɩŋ kɔ, ba tɩŋ hawa kʋbala dʋndʋŋ nɛ, aŋ ka la-na tɩŋ chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala, aŋ ka ŋ tiŋ la kala magɛ dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: The owner answered one of them, “Friend, I didn't cheat you. I paid you exactly what we agreed on.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baga-la tɩɩna bʋla pɩ ba dɔŋɔ, “Jegile nɩɩ, mɩ bɩ ma gʋra. Ma sɛyɛ arɩ ma jaŋ tɩŋ dɩ wɩa jʋʋ nɛ aŋ laa warɩpʋla kʋbala.

english_verse: Take your money now and go! What business is it of yours if I want to pay them the same that I paid you?
translation_verse: Má laa ma moribiee a viiri. Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ tiŋ baalaa deemba sɩ to harɩŋ kɔ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa mɩ sɩ timma nɛ.

english_verse: Don't I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Why should you be jealous, if I want to be generous?”
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ wombiiŋ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩ moribiee tɩŋ mɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa? Koo ma yaraa bieru a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ kɛŋ zile wɩaa nɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “So it is. Everyone who is now last will be first, and everyone who is first will be last.” Jesus Again Tells about His Death (Mark
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ harɩ-tooroo, dɩ harɩ-tooroo ma bɩrɩmɛ sɩpaalaaraa.” Yesu bʋl ʋ sʋʋŋ wɩaa Maak

english_verse: When Jesus heard them, he stopped and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu chɩŋ aŋ yɩrɛba a pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ maa chɛ mɩ ŋaa pɩma?”

english_verse: Jesus felt sorry for them and touched their eyes. At once they could see, and they became his followers.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu fá ba nenige a digi ba sɩaa lɛ. Ba sɩaa guu suri, ba tuto ʋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: The crowd told them to be quiet, but they shouted even louder, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩ-daŋ-la kpɩa ba lɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ goŋ. Ama ba faasa yɩrɛ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ a bʋl, “La Tɩɩna, Devit nihii, fá la nenige.”

english_verse: As Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, he took his twelve disciples aside and told them in private:
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɩ ba hɛ wombiiŋ lɛ nɛ a mʋmʋ Jerusalɛm. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ harɩ-tooroo fii arɩ balɩa dʋndʋŋa a sʋʋsa lɩɩ a bʋla pɩba wombiiŋ lɛ,

english_verse: and then they will hand him over to foreigners who will make fun of him. They will beat him and nail him to a cross. But on the third day he will rise from death. A Mother's Request (Mark
translation_verse: aŋ kɛmmɛ kaa mʋ hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ mɔmmɛ, a vɩɩrɛmɛ aŋ kpaasɛmɛ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ, ka dɩ mɩ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ.” Zebidi haala sʋl Yesu a chɩchɛ dɩhɔnʋŋ dɩ ʋ pɩ ʋ biiriŋ balɩa Maak

english_verse: The mother of James and John came to Jesus with her two sons. She knelt down and started begging him to do something for her.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zebidi haala kɛŋ ʋ biiriŋ balɩa kɔ Yesu teeŋ a kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus asked her what she wanted, and she said, “When you come into your kingdom, please let one of my sons sit at your right side and the other at your left.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsʋ, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋŋ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa pɩŋ?” Ʋ bʋl, “Ŋ sɩ jaŋ dii Wɩa kuorii-la a hɔŋ ŋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ, leŋ dɩ mɩ biiriŋ deemba balɩa ŋaa ŋ bʋbʋɔŋ hʋhɔnnɔɔ, dɩ dɔŋɔ hɔŋ ŋ nadiiŋ, dɩ dɔŋɔ ma hɔŋ ŋ nagʋa.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Not one of you knows what you are asking. Are you able to drink from the cup that I must soon drink from?” James and John said, “Yes, we are!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ ʋ biiriŋ, “Ma bɩ jɩŋ kʋ-la ma sɩɩ chɛ. Ma jaŋ wuo nyalɩma na hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ naa? Ba sɩ: Oo, la jaŋ wuo.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You certainly will drink from my cup! But it isn't for me to say who will sit at my right side and at my left. This is for my Father to say.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ma bʋl. Hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ na, ʋ nɛ ma ma jaŋ na. Ama mɩ nadiiŋ arɩ mɩ nagʋa hʋhɔnnɔ-la, mɩ dee bɩ jaŋ tʋɔsɛba. Wɩa nɛ jaŋ lɩɩsɛba dɩ ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: When the ten other disciples heard this, they were angry with the two brothers.
translation_verse: Yesu harɩ-tooroo fii-la sɩ nɩɩ Jeems arɩ Jɔɔŋ sɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la, ba na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: But Jesus called the disciples together and said: You know foreign rulers like to order their people around. And their great leaders have full power over everyone they rule.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu yɩrɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo kala ba kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma jɩma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa kuoroo hɔŋ nɩaa nyuŋ nɛ. Ba nɩhɩasɩŋ ma kɛŋ doluŋ ba nɩaa nyuŋ.

english_verse: And if you want to be first, you must be the slave of the rest.
translation_verse: Ma tʋɔŋ nɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ chɛ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋhɩaŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ma tʋɔŋ yomo.

english_verse: The Son of Man did not come to be a slave master, but a slave who will give his life to rescue many people. Jesus Heals Two Blind Men (Mark
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie, mɩ bɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ chɛ nɩaa dɩ ba tɩma pɩmɛ, mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ tɩma pɩba nɛ a sʋʋ a laa nɩ-daŋ mɩɩsɩŋ pɩba.” Yesu vaarɛ nyʋlɩmaa balɩa Maak

english_verse: Jesus was followed by a large crowd as he and his disciples were leaving Jericho.
translation_verse: Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo sɩ lɩɩ Jeriko lɛ, nɩ-daŋ to ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: Two blind men were sitting beside the road. And when they heard that Jesus was coming their way, they shouted, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Nyʋlɩmaa balɩa fa hɔŋ wombiiŋ niiŋ a nɩɩ dɩ Yesu nɩɩ bal. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba faasa yɩrɛ a bʋla pʋ, “La Tɩɩna, Devit nihii, fá la nenige.”

english_verse: They answered, “Lord, we want to see!”
translation_verse: Ba bʋl, “La Tɩɩna, laa chɛ dɩ ŋ suri la sɩaa nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said: I will tell you a story about a man who had two sons. Then you can tell me what you think. The father went to the older son and said, “Go work in the vineyard today!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu magɛ namaga a pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa, “Baal kʋbala nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩa. Ʋ sii mʋ ʋ bii-hɩaŋ teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, ‘Mɩ bii, mʋ baga jɩnɩŋ a tɩŋ.’

english_verse: But when they saw the man's son, they said, “Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnna-la sɩ na bile, ba bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ, ‘Dɩ baga-la tɩɩna nɛ sʋba, bie deeŋ nɛ jaŋ dii ʋ kɩaa. Má kɔ dɩ la kpʋʋ. Dɩ la nɛ kpʋʋ, la nɛ jaŋ mɩɩra tɩɩ ʋ kɩalɩŋ.’

english_verse: If anyone asks why you are doing this, just say, ‘The Lord needs them.’ He will at once let you have the donkeys.”
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ pɩɛsɛma, má bʋla pʋ arɩ ma Tɩɩna nɩɩ chɛ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma kaa kɔ lɩma.”

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa dɩ wɩɩ-la Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla sɩ bʋla kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: “Announce to the people of Jerusalem: ‘Your king is coming to you! He is humble and rides on a donkey. He comes on the colt of a donkey.’ ”
translation_verse: Ʋ fa sɩ, “Má bʋla pɩ Zaayɔŋ nɩaa dɩ ba bee na, dɩ ba kuoro nɩɩ kɔ ba teeŋ. Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa muuri nɛ a jɩl kakumo a sagɛ kaku-pɔrʋŋ nyuŋ.”

english_verse: The disciples left and did what Jesus had told them to do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la mʋ a ŋaa wɩɩ-la Yesu sɩ bʋla pɩba dɩ ba ŋaa.

english_verse: They brought the donkey and its colt and laid some clothes on their backs. Then Jesus got on.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ kakumo-la arɩ ʋ bie kaa kɔ a joŋ ba gɛnnɩŋ daŋ kakumo-la arɩ ʋ bie nyuŋ, Yesu jɩl.

english_verse: When Jesus came to Jerusalem, everyone in the city was excited and asked, “Who can this be?”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ mʋʋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm, taŋ-la kala zigili. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa pɩɛsɛ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ-la?”

english_verse: But the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses were angry when they saw his miracles and heard the children shouting praises to the Son of David.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba sɩ na wʋmagɩla-la ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa a bɩra na hambiisiŋ sɩɩ ŋaa goŋ ŋɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ, ba na baanɩŋ. Hambiisi-la faa bʋl, “Tabarɩkala Devit nihii.”

english_verse: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard these stories, they knew Jesus was talking about them.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa nɩɩ Yesu sɩ magɛ namaga-la a jɩŋ arɩ ba wɩaa nɛ ʋ bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: He told them, “The Scriptures say, ‘My house should be called a place of worship.’ But you have turned it into a place where robbers hide.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Ba ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩ ʋ dɩa jaŋ ŋaa lee-la nɩaa sɩ jaŋ chʋchʋɔlʋ, aŋ ka ma-na mɩɩra kaa bɩrɩmɛ gaarɩ-dɩa.”

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray, you will be given whatever you ask for.” A Question about Jesus' Authority (Mark
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ laa Wɩa dii, kʋŋ na-kala ma sɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a sʋsʋl, ma jaŋ naʋ.” Nɩaa pɩɛsɛ Yesu ʋ doluŋ wɩaa Maak

english_verse: The men said to Jesus, “Don't you hear what those children are saying?” “Yes, I do!” Jesus answered. “Don't you know that the Scriptures say, ‘Children and infants will sing praises’?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba pɩɛsɛ Yesu, “Ŋ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ bʋl nɛɛ?” Yesu bʋl, “Mɩ nɩa nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu ma pɩɛsɛba, “Ma bɩ Wɩa teniŋ karɩmaa? Ba ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, ‘Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ bii-mulluŋ dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa.’ ”

english_verse: Then Jesus left the city and went out to the village of Bethany, where he spent the night. Jesus Puts a Curse on a Fig Tree (Mark
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu lemba aŋ lɩɩ tabal-la lɛ a mʋ Bɛtanɩ a chʋa nɩmɛ. Yesu kalɩba hɛ tutogo lɛ Maak

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I have just one question to ask you. If you answer it, I will tell you where I got the right to do these things.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ ma jaŋ pɩɛsɛma wʋbala. Dɩ ma nɛ dagɛmɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ, mɩ ma jaŋ dagɛma dol-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: When Jesus got up the next morning, he was hungry. He started out for the city,
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, Yesu mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm. Ʋ sɩɩ mʋ, losuŋ kɛnʋ wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus said to them, “If you have faith and don't doubt, I promise you can do what I did to this tree. And you will be able to do even more. You can tell this mountain to get up and jump into the sea, and it will.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, dɩ ma nɛ laa dii a bɩ tʋɔŋ balɩa kɛnɛ, ma ma jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa tutogo-la lɛ. Ŋ-la ma dʋndʋŋa dee, ama ma jaŋ wuo paala bʋl peeliŋ deeŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ sii a mʋ tel mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ sɛnɛ ŋaa.

english_verse: So they told Jesus, “We don't know.” Jesus said, “Then I won't tell you who gave me the right to do what I do.” A Story about Two Sons
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ Yesu, “La bɩ jɩŋ.” Yesu ma bʋla pɩba, “Tɔɔ, mɩ ma bɩ jaŋ dagɛma dol-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus told the chief priests and leaders to listen to this story: A land owner once planted a vineyard. He built a wall around it and dug a pit to crush the grapes in. He also built a lookout tower. Then he rented out his vineyard and left the country.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra magɛ namaga dɔŋɔ a bʋl, “Baal kʋbala nɛ bil baga a chɔnsɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ. Ʋ saa kɛrɛ golli baga-la, a lu bʋa baga-la lɛ dɩ ba chagɛ girep nɛnɛ-la lɩɩŋ hɩhɛ, aŋ saa dɩɩ-leŋiŋ a hɔnɔ pɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ paa nɩaa a hɛ ʋ baga-la tʋɔŋ dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ, aŋ mʋ taŋ dɔŋ.

english_verse: Jesus had gone into the temple and was teaching when the chief priests and the leaders of the people came up to him. They asked, “What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋ Jerusalɛm, Yesu mʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ. Ʋ sɩ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩa-la ŋɩɩ a dɩdagɛ nɩaa, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩŋ, ba kala sii kɔ ʋ teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Dol bɛɛ nɛ ŋ kɛŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa deemba? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ pɩŋ doluŋ ŋ kaa ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ?”

english_verse: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being?” They thought it over and said to each other, “We can't say God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ pɩ Jɔɔŋ doluŋ ʋ fufo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, Wɩa nɛ pʋ koo nuhuobiine nɛ pʋ? Má dagɛmɛ.” Ba suomo kɛŋ wɩɩ-la lɩlɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ aa bʋl, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ laa chɛ dɩ la bʋl? Dɩ la nɛ bʋla pʋ arɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ ʋ lɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ pɩɛsɛla, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla laa dii?’

english_verse: On the other hand, these people think John was a prophet, and we are afraid of what they might do to us. That's why we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize.”
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ saa sɩ ʋ lɩɩ nuhuobiine teeŋ nɛ, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛnla a tɩŋ nɩ-daŋ-la sɩ chɩŋ nɩmɛ wɩaa. Nɩaa bʋla arɩ Jɔɔŋ fa sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Which one of the sons obeyed his father? “The older one,” the chief priests and leaders answered. Then Jesus told them: You can be sure tax collectors and prostitutes will get into the kingdom of God before you ever will!
translation_verse: Hambiisiŋ deemba balɩa tʋɔŋ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ to ba nyɩmma niiŋ lɛ? Bɛɛ nɛ ma bɩɩnɛ?” Ba bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ bii-hɩaŋ-la nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ bʋlaa pɩma arɩ lampoo laaraa arɩ jagumuloba jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ ma lɛ a jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la.

english_verse: When John the Baptist showed you how to do right, you would not believe him. But these evil people did believe. And even when you saw what they did, you still would not change your minds and believe. Renters of a Vineyard (Mark
translation_verse: Bɛɛ wɩaa Jɔɔŋ Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la kɔ a dagɛma wombii-tɩtɩɩ-la nɛ ma sɩ jaŋ to, aŋ ka ma bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii, ama lampoo laaraa arɩ jagumuloba laa ʋ wɩaa dii nɛ. Ma paala na ba sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ nɛ, aŋ ka ma ha bɩ bɩrɩma dɩ ma laa ʋ wɩaa dii.” Yesu magɛ namaga a tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa baga lɛ Maak

english_verse: When it was harvest time, the owner sent some servants to get his share of the grapes.
translation_verse: Girep nɛnɛ-la bɩɩnɩŋ sɩ yie, ʋ tɩŋ ʋ dɩa tɩntɩnnaa dɩ ba mʋ tɩntɩnna-la teeŋ a laa tɩɩnɛnɛ-la kaa kɔ. Ba mʋ.

english_verse: But the renters grabbed those servants. They beat up one, killed one, and stoned one of them to death.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ dɔŋɔ a ŋmobu, a kpʋ dɔŋɔ, a yagɛ dɔŋɔ arɩ tabɩaa a kpʋʋ.

english_verse: He then sent more servants than he did the first time. But the renters treated them in the same way.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ tɩŋ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ a wasa kɩɩ bumbuŋ-la. Ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɩalɩŋ ma lɛ.

english_verse: Finally, the owner sent his own son to the renters, because he thought they would respect him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ tɩŋ ʋ bie. Ʋ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ bie nɛ mʋa, ba jaŋ zilu. Ʋ ma bɩra mʋ.

english_verse: So they grabbed him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ bile a joŋu yuo ta baga-la harɩŋ a kpʋʋ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked, “When the owner of that vineyard comes, what do you suppose he will do to those renters?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛba, “Dɩ baga-la tɩɩna nɛ kɔ, ɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa baga tɩntɩnna-la lɛ?”

english_verse: The chief priests and leaders answered, “He will kill them in some horrible way. Then he will rent out his vineyard to people who will give him his share of grapes at harvest time.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pʋ, “Ʋ jaŋ kɔ a kpʋ nɩbɔmɔ-la aŋ joŋ baga-la a pɩ nɩtanɩa. Dɩ girep nɛnɛ-la bɩɩnɩŋ nɛ yie, ba jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ nɛnɛ-la kaa mʋ pʋ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You surely know that the Scriptures say, ‘The stone the builders tossed aside is now the most important stone of all. This is something the Lord has done, and it is amazing to us.’
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ namaga-la, “Ma bɩ Wɩa teŋ-la karɩma a mʋ yi lee-la ba sɩ bʋl ŋ-la: ‘Tie-bii-la dɩɩ-saaraa sɩ vɩa, ʋ nɛ mɩɩra kʋ ŋaa tie-bii-duoŋ ba sɩ joŋo bil dɩa gentine. La Tɩɩna Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ ŋaala wʋkpuŋkpere nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: I tell you God's kingdom will be taken from you and given to people who will do what he demands.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ a bʋl, “Wɩa jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ kuorii-la laa ma teeŋ, a joŋo pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ to Wɩa niiŋ woruŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who stumbles over this stone will be crushed, and anyone it falls on will be smashed to pieces.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ tel tie-bii-la nyuŋ, ʋ tɩɩna jaŋ yɛrɛ muno muno. Dɩ tie-bii-la ma nɛ tel nʋʋkala nyuŋ, ʋ jaŋ bʋrɩgɛ tɩɩna.”

english_verse: So they looked for a way to arrest Jesus. But they were afraid to, because the people thought he was a prophet.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ba kɛnʋ kaa mʋ tɔ dɩa. Ama ba faa fá nɩ-daŋ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩ-daŋ-la joŋ Yesu arɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ.

english_verse: The Pharisees got together and planned how they could trick Jesus into saying something wrong.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa sii lɩɩ a vʋʋrɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ magɩsɛ Yesu a bɛrɛ kɛnʋ arɩ wʋpɩɛsaa.

english_verse: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and has no children, his brother should marry the widow. Their first son would then be thought of as the son of the dead brother.
translation_verse: “La kʋhɩaŋ, Mosis fa sɩ dɩ baala nɛ jaa haala, dɩ haal-la arɩ baal-la nɛ bɩ bii lʋla, aŋ ka dɩ baal-la sʋʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaana joŋ yo-haal-la jaa nɛ. Dɩ ʋ lʋl biiriŋ pɩ ʋ maala-la sɩ sʋba, biiri-la jaŋ chɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Once again Jesus used stories to teach the people:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra magɛ namaga dɔŋɔ a dɩdagɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: The kingdom of heaven is like what happened when a king gave a wedding banquet for his son.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Wɩa kuorii-la nagɛ kuoru kʋbala bie sɩ jaa haala nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ba gbigbieli hajaarɩ gbiele a ŋaa ba yɩrɛ nɩaa dɩ ba kɔ gbiele-la.

english_verse: The king sent some servants to tell the invited guests to come to the banquet, but the guests refused.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ ŋaa kʋdiile-la dɛrɛ, ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa dɩ ba mʋ yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yɩra arɩ ba ŋaa siri nɛ dɩ ba gbieli gbiele-la. Ba sɩ mʋ yɩrɛba, ba vɩa.

english_verse: He sent other servants to say to the guests, “The banquet is ready! My cattle and prize calves have all been prepared. Everything is ready. Come to the banquet!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yɩra arɩ ba kpʋ nɛ-belliŋ arɩ nɛ-nɩɩnɩŋ kala nɛ a ŋaa kʋdiile-la dɛrɛ, dɩ ba kɔ hajaarɩ gbiele-la.

english_verse: But the guests did not pay any attention. Some of them left for their farms, and some went to their places of business.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yɩra bɩra vɩa dɩ ba mʋ aŋ tɩtɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa. Dɔŋɔ sii mʋ ʋ baga, dɔŋɔ ma sii mʋ ʋ kɩaa dɩ-yallɩŋ.

english_verse: Others grabbed the servants, then beat them up and killed them.
translation_verse: Ka dɔnsʋŋ ma kɛsɛ kuoro dɩa tɩntɩnna-la a ŋmooba aŋ kpʋba.

english_verse: This made the king so furious that he sent an army to kill those murderers and burn down their city.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoru-la na baanɩŋ a ta ʋ laalɩyuoroo, ba mʋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kpʋ ʋ dɩa tɩntɩnna-la aŋ nyɩgɛ ba tabalɩŋ kala.

english_verse: Then he said to the servants, “It is time for the wedding banquet, and the invited guests don't deserve to come.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa dɔnsʋŋ a bɩra bʋla pɩba, ‘Mɩ gbiele kʋdiile-la ŋaa siri nɛ, ama nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ yɩra bɩ maga dɩ ba kɔ gbiele-la.

english_verse: Go out to the street corners and tell everyone you meet to come to the banquet.”
translation_verse: Má saa lɩɩ mʋ womporunuŋ a yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ na nɩmɛ a bʋla pɩba dɩ ba kɔ a dii kʋdiile-la.’

english_verse: When the king went in to meet the guests, he found that one of them wasn't wearing the right kind of clothes for the wedding.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoru-la jʋʋ dɩ ʋ na nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɔ a na baal kʋbala dɩ ʋ bɩ hajaarɩ gbiele gɛrɩŋ laala.

english_verse: Tell us what you think! Should we pay taxes to the Emperor or not?”
translation_verse: Saa bʋla pɩla, ʋ ŋaa wombii nɛ a magɛ la tiŋ lampoo a pɩ Rom tinteeŋ kuoru-balɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Siiza? Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ ma bɩɩnɛ?”

english_verse: The same thing happened to the second and third brothers and finally to all seven of them.
translation_verse: Lɩamɩŋ ma sʋʋ. Torimuŋ tɩɩna ma joŋ haal-la jaa. Ʋ ma ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ. Naambiiri-la balɩpɛ kala nɛ jaa haal-la. Ʋ bɩ lʋla.

english_verse: They sent some of their followers and some of Herod's followers to say to him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest. You teach the truth about what God wants people to do. And you treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tɩŋ ba harɩ-tooroo dɔnsʋŋ arɩ Hɛrɔd ma harɩ-tooroo dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba mʋ Yesu teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɔ ʋ teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “La kʋhɩaŋ, la jɩma dɩ ŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a dɩdagɛ Wɩa tonuŋ wombii-tɩtɩɩ-la. Ŋ sɩpaaŋ tuo nʋʋ lɛ. Ŋ bɩ nɩbal sɩɩ ka fá.

english_verse: Let me see one of the coins used for paying taxes.” They brought him a silver coin,
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ moribii-la ma sɩ kaa titiŋ lampoo kɔ dɩ mɩ bee na.”

english_verse: “The Emperor's,” they answered. Then Jesus told them, “Give the Emperor what belongs to him and give God what belongs to God.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl dɩ Siiza yɩrɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Tɔɔ, má joŋ Rom tinteeŋ kuori-bal-la kɩaa pʋ aŋ joŋ Wɩa ma kɩaa pʋ.”

english_verse: His answer surprised them so much that they walked away. Life in the Future World (Mark
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere ba sii viiri. Ba pɩɛsɛ Yesu a tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba lɛ Maak

english_verse: At last the woman died.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ haal-la ma tɩtɩa sʋʋ.

english_verse: All the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets are based on these two commandments. About David's Son (Mark
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩɩ bʋl, ba kala lɩɩ wɩaa deemba balɩamɩŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ.” Ba pɩɛsɛ Kirisito wɩaa Maak

english_verse: The Sadducees did not believe people would rise to life after death. So that same day some of the Sadducees came to Jesus and said:
translation_verse: Chɛɛ-la tɩtɩa nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Saduusi tɩŋŋaa, ba kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Saduusi tɩŋŋaa yie bʋl dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sʋba, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ sii. Ba kɔ a pɩɛsʋ wɩaa,

english_verse: Jesus answered: You are completely wrong! You don't know what the Scriptures teach. And you don't know anything about the power of God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Ma bɩ Wɩa teniŋ jɩŋ. Ma bɩ Wɩa doluŋ jɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ma yeŋŋi.

english_verse: When God raises people to life, they won't marry. They will be like the angels in heaven.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɩaa sɩ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, baalaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ jaa haalaa, haalaa ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ jaa balaba. Ba kala jaŋ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: “I am the God worshiped by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” He isn't the God of the dead, but of the living.
translation_verse: ‘Mɩ nɛ ŋaa Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb Wɩa.’ Wɩa ŋaa nɩweyee Wɩa nɛ, ʋ bɩ nɩsʋʋnʋŋ Wɩa ŋaa.”

english_verse: The crowds were surprised to hear what Jesus was teaching. The Most Important Commandment (Mark
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ-la sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ dagɛ wɩaa, ʋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere. Wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ la ŋɩŋaa, ba tʋɔŋ wʋbalɩŋ Maak

english_verse: After Jesus had made the Sadducees look foolish, the Pharisees heard about it and got together.
translation_verse: Farisii tɩŋŋaa sɩ nɩa arɩ Yesu bʋl wɩaa lo Saduusi tɩŋŋaa ba ŋaa fʋɩɩ, ba kala kʋ pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: “Teacher, what is the most important commandment in the Law?”
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩɛsɛ Yesu a bʋl, “Kʋhɩaŋ, wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ dagɛ nɩaa baa to, wʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa ba tʋɔŋ sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩŋ?”

english_verse: The second most important commandment is like this one. And it is, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Wʋlɩamɩŋ ma nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Cho ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna arɩ ŋ sɩ cho ŋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ.’

english_verse: While the Pharisees were still there, Jesus asked them,
translation_verse: Farisii tɩŋŋaa ha sɩ hilimi ŋɩɩ, Yesu ma pɩɛsɛba,

english_verse: ‘The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.’
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl: ‘La Tɩɩna bʋla pɩ mɩ Tɩɩna dɩ ʋ hɔŋ ʋ nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ, see dɩ ʋ yuo dii ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala dɛrɛ.’

english_verse: “What do you think about the Messiah? Whose family will he come from?” They answered, “He will be a son of King David.”
translation_verse: “Bɛɛ nɛ maa bɩɩnɛ a mʋʋ tɩgɛ Kirisito, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa wɩaa? Kʋbɛɛ doho nʋʋ nɛ ʋ ŋaa?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl dɩ ʋ ŋaa Devit doho nʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “How then could the Spirit lead David to call the Messiah his Lord? David said,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ fa dagɛ Devit dɩ ʋ kɛnʋ yɩrɛ ʋ Tɩɩna?

english_verse: If David called the Messiah his Lord, how can the Messiah be a son of King David?”
translation_verse: Devit tɩtɩa sɩ yɩrɛ nɩa deeŋ ʋ Tɩɩna, ɛɛ nɛ saa ʋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa ʋ nihii dʋndʋŋ?”

english_verse: No one was able to give Jesus an answer, and from that day on, no one dared ask him any more questions.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ wɩɩ wuo bʋl. A chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la kala a kaa mʋ, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ nyuduoŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ pɩɛsʋ wɩɩkala.

english_verse: If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ, Wɩa jaŋ kɛnʋ muuri, ka nɩɩ-la ma sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa muuri, Wɩa jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ʋ yʋgɛ.

english_verse: And now your temple will be deserted.
translation_verse: Bee na, ma Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Your people have killed the prophets and have stoned the messengers who were sent to you. I have often wanted to gather your people, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But you wouldn't let me.
translation_verse: Ma Jerusalɛm nɩaa, ma kpʋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ, a joŋ tabɩaa yagɛ tɩndaara-la Wɩa sɩ tɩma dɩ ba kɔ ma teeŋ. Naansɩɩŋ yʋga nɛ mɩ fa cho dɩ mɩ chu tɔ ma nɩaa kala arɩ jimiŋ sɩ yie chu tɔ ʋ biiriŋ ŋɩɩ, ka ma bɩ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ nɩ-daŋ-la arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo,

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law are experts in the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: “Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba arɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto.

english_verse: So obey everything they teach you, but don't do as they do. After all, they say one thing and do something else.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma maga dɩ ma to wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ bʋla pɩma dɩ ma ŋaa, ama ma sɩ́ ba wʋŋaalaa chesu, bɛɛ wɩaa ba tɩtɩa bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ dagʋ ka to.

english_verse: They pile heavy burdens on people's shoulders and won't lift a finger to help.
translation_verse: Ba yie vɔɔ chʋgʋ-yuŋŋoo nɛ a kaa chʋŋ nɩaa, ama ba tɩtɩa bɩ chɛ dɩ ba pɛ ba lɛ a laa chʋga-la.

english_verse: Everything they do is just to show off in front of others. They even make a big show of wearing Scripture verses on their foreheads and arms, and they wear big tassels for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Ba yie ŋaa wɩɩkala dɩ nɩaa naba nɛ. Ba yie ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa a hɛ teŋ-jalaa lɛ a kaa vʋvɔɔ ba gɛnnɩŋ nɩsaa lɛ arɩ ba nyunchuuluŋ lɛ aŋ leŋ ba gɛnnɩŋ jʋɔsaa ma duomi duomi.

english_verse: And when they are in the market, they like to have people greet them as their teachers.
translation_verse: Ba yie chɩchɛ dɩ nɩaa chʋchʋɔlɛba aŋ zizilba nɩaa tʋɔŋ aŋ yɩyɩrɛba kerichiba.

english_verse: But none of you should be called a teacher. You have only one teacher, and all of you are like brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Ama ma-na sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩaa kɛmma kaa yɩrɛ kerichiba. Ma kala ŋaa naambiiri nɛ. Ma kala kerichi ŋaa kʋbala nɛ.

english_verse: Don't call anyone on earth your father. All of you have the same Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Ʋ saa bɩ maga dɩ ma yɩrɛ nʋʋkala ma nyɩmma dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma Nyɩmma ŋaa kʋbala nɛ a hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ.

english_verse: None of you should be called the leader. The Messiah is your only leader.
translation_verse: Ma bɩra sɩ́ nʋʋkala yɩrɛ Ma Kʋhɩaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Ma Kʋhɩaŋ nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You lock people out of the kingdom of heaven. You won't go in yourselves, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: Ma Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba arɩ ma Farisii tɩŋŋaa, ma kanfugi tɩmma-la, ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Ma yie kɛŋ yo-haalaa kɩaa laa didii a yie fugo chʋɔlɛ Wɩa didieni. Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii ma sarɩya, ma nɛ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ a kɩɩ nʋʋkala.]

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You travel over land and sea to win one follower. And when you have done so, you make that person twice as fit for hell as you are.
translation_verse: Ma Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba arɩ ma Farisii tɩŋŋaa, ma kanfugi tɩmma-la, ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Ma yie sii a duori lɩɩŋ koo a vɛŋ a mʋ tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ a bʋl Wɩa wɩaa nɩmɛ. Dɩ nɩbala nɛ laa dii, ma yie leŋ ʋ wasa bɔŋ a magɛ dɩ ʋ jʋʋ Wɩa nyiniŋ arɩ ma sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple.
translation_verse: Ma nyʋlʋŋ sɩpaalaaraa, ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Ma yie bʋl, ‘Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋmɩɛsɛ Wɩa dɩa, ʋ bɩ ŋmɩaŋ ŋaa, ama dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋmɩɛsɛ sɛlɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩa tʋɔŋ, ʋ chaasa ŋmɩɛsɛ ŋmɩaŋ nɛ.’

english_verse: You blind fools! Which is greater, the gold or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
translation_verse: Ma nyʋlʋŋ-tɔɔnɩ! Sɛlɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩa-la tʋɔŋ arɩ dɩa-la sɩ ŋaa sɛlɩmɛ-la bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, kɩaa deemba balɩa tʋɔŋ kʋbɛɛ nɛ yʋga?

english_verse: You also teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the altar. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gift on the altar.
translation_verse: Ma bɩra bʋla dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋmɩɛsɛ koru-la lɛ ba sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ Wɩa, ʋ bɩ chaasa ŋmɩɛsɛ ŋmɩaŋ, ama dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋmɩɛsɛ kʋ-la ba sɩ yie joŋo daŋ koru-la nyuŋ a pɩ Wɩa, ʋ chaasa ŋmɩɛsɛ ŋmɩaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Are you blind? Which is more important, the gift or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
translation_verse: Ma nyʋlɩmaa, kʋ-la ba sɩ yie joŋo daŋ koru-la nyuŋ arɩ koru-la sɩ ŋaa kʋ-la bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, kɩaa deemba balɩa tʋɔŋ kʋbɛɛ nɛ yʋga?

english_verse: And anyone who swears by the temple also swears by God, who lives there.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩra ŋmɩɛsɛ Wɩa dɩa, ʋ ŋmɩɛsɛ Wɩa dɩa-la arɩ Wɩa kala nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa hɛ dɩa-la lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: To swear by heaven is the same as swearing by God's throne and by the one who sits on that throne.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩra ŋmɩɛsɛ Wɩa-jaŋ, ʋ ŋmɩɛsɛ Wɩa kuoru kpasa-la arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ hɔŋ ʋ lɛ ma nɛ.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your garden, such as mint, dill, and cumin. Yet you neglect the more important matters of the Law, such as justice, mercy, and faithfulness. These are the important things you should have done, though you should not have left the others undone either.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puu ma Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba arɩ ma Farisii tɩŋŋaa, ma kanfugi tɩmma-la. Dɩ ma nɛ jaa pɩpaarɩ-la ma sɩ yie joŋo hɛ kʋdiilee lɛ ba sʋɔra sɩŋ, ma yie kɛmba kala kaa kpaa leree fii fii a joŋ ba kʋŋkala leriŋ dɔŋɔ a pɩ Wɩa aŋ vɩa dɩ ma to sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile pɩma dɩ ma tuto. Ba nɛ ŋ-la: Má to wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiiŋ a fá nɩaa nenige a laa Wɩa dii. Ʋ maga dɩ ma kpaa ma kɩalɩŋ leree fii fii nɛ a joŋ kʋbala pɩ Wɩa, ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma vɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiiŋ.

english_verse: You blind leaders! You strain out a small fly but swallow a camel.
translation_verse: Ma nyʋlʋŋ sɩpaalaaraa! Ma yie chuori ma sɩnɩŋ a lɩɩsɛ nanchʋɔsʋŋ kala ta aŋ bɩ kɩaa sɩ yʋga a nagɛ bʋntaŋŋa na aŋ liliŋ.

english_verse: You blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of a cup, and then the outside will also be clean.
translation_verse: Ma nyʋlʋŋ Farisii tɩŋŋaa, má laa sɩpaaŋ tiisi ma nyʋnyʋalʋsʋŋ tʋɔŋ aŋ-na tiisi harɩŋ ma dɩ ʋ zɔŋ.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You're like tombs that have been whitewashed. On the outside they are beautiful, but inside they are full of bones and filth.
translation_verse: Ma Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba arɩ ma Farisii tɩŋŋaa, ma kanfugi tɩmma-la, ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Ma nagɛ vaamaa ba sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔrʋŋ bʋgɛ nɛ. Ba harɩŋ zɔŋ, aŋ ka ba tʋɔŋ kala su arɩ haŋgbelee arɩ nɩsʋʋnʋŋ.

english_verse: That's what you are like. Outside you look good, but inside you are evil and only pretend to be good.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma ma nagɛ nɩaa teeŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ nama, ba yie bɩɩnɛ ma ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma nɛ, ka ma tʋɔŋ su arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ kanfugi wʋŋaalaa. Yesu bʋl nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ dɔgʋsʋŋ wɩaa Luuk

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are nothing but show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You build monuments for the prophets and decorate the tombs of good people.
translation_verse: Ma Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba arɩ ma Farisii tɩŋŋaa, ma kanfugi tɩmma-la, ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Ma saa Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la ma naabalɩmaba sɩ kpʋa vaama nɛ, aŋ wasɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa ma vaamaa.

english_verse: And you claim you would not have taken part with your ancestors in killing the prophets.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ, ‘Dɩ la nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ bʋa-la lɛ la naabalɩmaba fa sɩ hɛ ba mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, la fa bɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ba sɩ ŋaa a kpʋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa.’

english_verse: But you prove you really are the relatives of the ones who killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Ama ma sɩ yɩrɛba ma naabalɩmaba ŋɩɩ, ma sɛnɛ sɛɩ arɩ ma ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ kpʋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la doho nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: So keep on doing everything they did.
translation_verse: Má saa mʋ a dɛrɛ wɩalɩŋ ma naabalɩmaba fa sɩ suomo.

english_verse: You are nothing but snakes and the children of snakes! How can you escape going to hell?
translation_verse: Ma nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ma nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ biiriŋ, ma bɩɩna arɩ ma jaŋ wuo fá kagɛ Wɩa nyiŋ-la lɛɛ? Aɩ.

english_verse: I can promise that you people living today will be punished for all these things! Jesus Loves Jerusalem (Luke
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, dɔgʋsʋnɔ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩkpʋʋraa deemba, ʋ jaŋ joŋo dɔgɩsɛ jɩnɩŋ nɩaa. Yesu bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ Jerusalɛm nɩaa lɛ Luuk

english_verse: You won't see me again until you say, “Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ namɛ see bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ jaŋ chʋɔlɛmɛ a bʋl, ‘Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ kɔ La Tɩɩna Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: After Jesus left the temple, his disciples came over and said, “Look at all these buildings!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ a mʋmʋ. Ʋ harɩ-tooroo kɔ a bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ bee na Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la arɩ ʋ dɩɩsɩŋ kala sɩ zɔmɔ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Do you see these buildings? They will certainly be torn down! Not one stone will be left in place.” Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sɩ, “Ma bee na ʋ sɩ zɔmɔ ŋɩɩ, ama, mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, ba jaŋ ŋmoo dɩa-la kala lo. Ba bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tie-bii-bala ma ka daŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ lɛ.” Ba jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii Maak

english_verse: Many will come and claim to be me. They will say they are the Messiah, and they will fool many people.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a kɔ a joŋ ba yɩrɩŋ hɛ arɩ ba nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, a nyɩsɛ nɩaa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: You will soon hear about wars and threats of wars, but don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but that isn't the end.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ nɩɩ arɩ laalɩŋ hɛ daha a hɛ dɩ-bolii. Dɩ ma nɛ kʋ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma bɔyɛ joŋ. Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa bal, ama dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ ha dee ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Later, as Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, his disciples came to him in private and asked, “When will this happen? What will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the world?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mʋ hɔŋ Olif peel-la nyuŋ. Ʋ harɩ-tooroo lʋara kɔ ʋ teeŋ a bɩra pɩɛsʋ, “Bʋa bɛɛ lɛ nɛ wɩaa deemba jaŋ ŋaa? Wʋbɛɛ ba nɛ la jaŋ na a jɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ jaŋ kɔ, arɩ bʋa-la lɛ dʋnɩa sɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ?”

english_verse: Nations and kingdoms will go to war against each other. People will starve to death, and in some places there will be earthquakes.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ nɩaa jaŋ sii a mʋ a yuo tinteeŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa. Taŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ nɩaa jaŋ sii gire mʋ yuo kuoro dɔŋɔ arɩ ʋ nɩaa. Losuŋ ma jaŋ jʋʋ. Tinteeŋ jaŋ zigili leree yʋgɛ.

english_verse: It will be a terrible time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children.
translation_verse: Hapuugoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɔgɛ biiriŋ, oi, ba jaŋ na hɛɛŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: But this is just the beginning of troubles.
translation_verse: Hɛɛŋ dɩ-suomuŋ nɛ ŋ-la.

english_verse: You will be arrested, punished, and even killed. Because of me, you will be hated by people of all nations.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kɛsɛma a jomma hɛ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛma aŋ kpʋ ma dɔnsʋŋ. Tinteyee nɩaa kala jaŋ bɛrɛma a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: Many will give up and will betray and hate each other.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a joŋ ba Wɩa laa diiniŋ ta, ba jaŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ yɩyallɛ, a bɛrɛ dɔŋɔ ma.

english_verse: Many false prophets will come and fool a lot of people.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a kɔ a nyɩsɛ nɩaa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: Someone may say, “Here is the Messiah!” or “There he is!” But don't believe it.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bʋla pɩŋ dɩ ŋ beŋ daha a na Kirisito-la, koo dɩ ŋ beŋ nɩmɛ a naʋ, sɩ́ ʋ laa dii.

english_verse: And pray that you won't have to escape in winter or on a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Má sʋl Wɩa dɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ sɩ́ waarɩŋ bʋa koo chɛ-wiesi-la chɛɛŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Someday you will see that “Horrible Thing” in the holy place, just as the prophet Daniel said. Everyone who reads this must try to understand!
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ na kʋ-la sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ aa chei leriŋ, kʋ-la wɩaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Danɩɛl fa sɩ bʋla. Ba jaŋ joŋ kʋ-la bil Wɩa dɩa lɛ, lee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ . Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ karɩmɛ wɩaa deemba, ma jaŋ jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: If you are living in Judea at that time, run to the mountains.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ na ŋɩɩ, má leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Judiya lɛ fá jɩl peelee nyuŋ a faa.

english_verse: If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ hɛ ʋ baga lɛ a nɩɩ wɩaa deemba, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ dɩa a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ paa ʋ gɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: If God doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of God's chosen ones, he will make the time shorter.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ bɩ tapʋlɩa-la kere ta, nɩbala ma bɩ jaŋ ka. Ama nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ baa tou, ba wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ʋ jaŋ keri tapʋlɩa-la ta.

english_verse: So when you see all these things happening, you will know the time has almost come.
translation_verse: Namaga deeŋ dagɛma wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ. Dɩ ma na wɩaa deemba kala dɩ baa ŋaa, ma jɩŋ dɩ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie kɔɔnʋŋ kpaga nɛ.

english_verse: When the Son of Man appears, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ, ʋ jaŋ nagɛ bʋa-la lɛ Nowa fa sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: No one knows the day or hour. The angels in heaven don't know, and the Son himself doesn't know. Only the Father knows.
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ chɛɛ-la koo bʋa-la lɛ wɩaa deemba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa. Wɩa tɩndaaraa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ koo mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie ma paala bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ, see mɩ Nyɩmma dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day the flood came and Noah went into the big boat.
translation_verse: Ka dɩ duonuŋ-na nɩɩ a su dʋnɩa, nɩaa faa dii kɩaa nɛ a nyʋnyʋa kɩaa ma, baalaa arɩ haalaa ma jɩjaa dɔŋɔ a mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la Nowa fa sɩ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: They didn't know anything was happening until the flood came and swept them all away. This is how it will be when the Son of Man appears.
translation_verse: Ba fa bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ ŋaa see bʋa-la lɛ lɩɩ-la sɩ kʋ pɛllɛ paa ba kala, ba sʋʋ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ ŋaa bʋa-la lɛ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie sɩ jaŋ kɔ.

english_verse: Two men will be in the same field, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ baalaa balɩa jaŋ pɩpɛrɛ baga lɛ. Wɩa jaŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ aŋ leŋ dɔŋɔ ta.

english_verse: So be on your guard! You don't know when your Lord will come.
translation_verse: Má saa kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma bɩ jɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la ma Tɩɩna sɩ jaŋ kɔ.

english_verse: Always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come. Faithful and Unfaithful Servants (Luke
translation_verse: Má ma saa ŋaa siri bʋa na-kala, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie jaŋ kɔ bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ bɩ yɩɛla.” Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ ŋaa Luuk

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks the master won't return until late.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ tɩntɩnnʋ-la nɛ ŋaa nɩbɔŋ a bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la jaŋ dieni

english_verse: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu mɩɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa? Ʋ nɛ nɩɩ-la ʋ kʋhɩaŋ sɩ yie lɩɩsɛ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ ʋ dɩa, aŋ pɛ pɩpɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔsʋŋ ma kʋdiilee bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga.

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job.
translation_verse: Dɩ tɩntɩnnʋ-la nɛ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ sɩ dagʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa, ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ bʋa-la lɛ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: You may be sure a servant who is always faithful will be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la jaŋ joŋ ʋ kɩaa kala hɛ tɩntɩnna deeŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ.

english_verse: Suppose this evil servant starts beating the other servants and eats and drinks with people who are drunk.
translation_verse: aŋ suomo ŋmuŋmoo ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔsʋ-la, aŋ faasa didii kʋdiilee aŋ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bubugi,

english_verse: If that happens, the master will surely come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ siri ŋaa gbɛrɛ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la. Ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la jaŋ kɔ tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bɩ yɩɛla.

english_verse: This servant will then be punished and thrown out with the ones who only pretended to serve their master. There they will cry and grit their teeth in pain.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ dɔgɩsʋ woruŋ aŋ kɛnʋ kaa mʋ hɛ lee-la kanfugi tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ. Lee-la nɛ nɩaa jaŋ yel aŋ chɩchaŋ ba nyɩlaa.”

english_verse: The foolish ones took their lamps, but no extra oil.
translation_verse: Banɔŋ-la sɩ yaara, ba bɩ nʋʋŋ lɔgɔ kori, dɩ ba chaanaa nɛ dɩsa, dɩ ba joŋo hɛ.

english_verse: The ones who were wise took along extra oil for their lamps.
translation_verse: Ama banɔŋ-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, ba lɔgɛ nʋʋŋ kori.

english_verse: Then in the middle of the night someone shouted, “Here's the groom! Come to meet him!”
translation_verse: Tɩta-siesee nɩaa yɩrɛ, ‘Má bee na baal-la nɩɩ kɔ, má kʋ lɩɩ chemu.’

english_verse: When the women got up and started getting their lamps ready,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haala-la kala sii a kɛŋ ba chaanaa ŋmɛnɩŋ yige ta dɩ ba jɩl.

english_verse: the foolish ones said to the others, “Let us have some of your oil! Our lamps are going out.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩyaara-la bʋla pɩ wʋjɩnna-la, ‘La chaanaa chɛ dɩ ba dɩsɛ nɛ, má pɩla nʋʋŋ mʋa.’

english_verse: Those who were wise answered, “There's not enough oil for all of us! Go and buy some for yourselves.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ wʋjɩnna-la bʋla pɩba, ‘Aɩ, ŋ bɩ pɔ nʋʋ-la bɩ jaŋ yi la kala. Má mʋ yɔɔ ma tɩtɩa nʋʋŋ.’

english_verse: But the groom replied, “I don't even know you!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, ‘Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, mɩ bɩ ma jɩŋ.’

english_verse: So, my disciples, always be ready! You don't know the day or the time when all this will happen. A Story about Three Servants (Luke
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ woruŋ. Ma bɩ jɩŋ chɛɛ-la koo bʋa-la lɛ mɩ-na Yesu sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.” Yesu magɛ namaga a tɩgɛ tɩntɩnnaa batori lɛ Luuk

english_verse: Some time later the master of those servants returned. He called them in and asked what they had done with his money.
translation_verse: Ʋ dieni woruŋ, ka tɩntɩnna-la batori kʋhɩaŋ-la kɔ a yɩrɛba dɩ ʋ na ba kʋŋkala sɩ kɛŋ moribie-la tɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You could have at least put my money in the bank, so I could have earned interest on it.”
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ jɩŋ ŋ-la lɛ, ʋ fa maga dɩ ŋ joŋ mɩ moribiee bil lee-la ba sɩɩ bil moribiee nɛ. Mɩ fa sɩ mɩɩra kɔ ŋ-la, mɩ fa jaŋ laa moribie-la arɩ mɩ nyʋʋrʋŋ kala.

english_verse: As soon as the man had gone, the servant with the
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnnʋ-la sɩ laa warɩpʋla bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩa, ʋ kaa mʋ a yɔɔ kɩaa a yallɛ a na warɩpʋla bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩa nyʋʋrʋŋ.

english_verse: “Wonderful!” his master replied. “You are a good and faithful servant. I left you in charge of only a little, but now I will put you in charge of much more. Come and share in my happiness!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la bʋla pʋ, ‘Ŋ ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ŋ hɛ doluŋ nɛ a wuo beŋ kɩaa sɩ bɩ yʋgɛ nyuŋ woruŋ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ bibeŋ kʋkɛnɛɛ. Kɔ dɩ mɩ dɩŋ kala nɩnɩɩ sɩma.’

english_verse: “Wonderful!” his master replied. “You are a good and faithful servant. I left you in charge of only a little, but now I will put you in charge of much more. Come and share in my happiness!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ ma, ‘Ŋ ma ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ nɛ, ŋ ma hɛ doluŋ nɛ a wuo beŋ kɩaa sɩ bɩ yʋgɛ nyuŋ woruŋ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ bibeŋ kʋkɛnɛɛ. Kɔ dɩ mɩ dɩŋ kala nɩnɩɩ sɩma.’

english_verse: I was frightened and went out and hid your money in the ground. Here is every single coin!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ fɩfáŋ a joŋ moribie-la a hugi tinteeŋ dɩ ŋ kɔ. Laa ŋ moribiee.’

english_verse: The master of the servant told him, “You are lazy and good-for-nothing! You know I harvest what I don't plant and gather crops where I haven't scattered seed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la bʋla pʋ, ‘Ŋ ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-bɔŋ nɛ a kɛŋ yarɩwɩɩŋ. Ŋ jɩma arɩ mɩ yie kʋkʋŋ kɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bɩ duo nɛ a paa kɩaa lee-la mɩ sɩ bɩ tɩma.

english_verse: Then the master said, “Now your money will be taken away and given to the servant with
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ-na má laa moribie-la ʋ teeŋ a joŋo pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ warɩpʋla bʋɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ-la.’ ”

english_verse: Everyone who has something will be given more, and they will have more than enough. But everything will be taken from those who don't have anything.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Nɩɩ-la sɩ paala kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ Wɩa jaŋ wasa chɛ a pɛ pa dɩ ʋ kaa yʋgɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ faasa kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ, mʋapɩlɩɩ-la ma ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ, Wɩa jaŋ kaa laa ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: You are a worthless servant, and you will be thrown out into the dark where people will cry and grit their teeth in pain.” The Final Judgment
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-bɔŋ-la a joŋu yuo ta birimiŋ tʋɔŋ. Lee-la nɛ nɩaa jaŋ yel aŋ chɩchaŋ ba nyɩlaa. Sarɩya chɛ-diiliŋ sɩ jaŋ yi

english_verse: When the Son of Man comes in his glory with all his angels, he will sit on his royal throne.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie nɛ dii mɩ kuoruŋ a kɔ, mɩ dɩ Wɩa tɩndaaraa kala jaŋ kɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ hɔŋ mɩ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ a chaanɛ.

english_verse: The people of all nations will be brought before him, and he will separate them, as shepherds separate their sheep from their goats.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ kʋ hilimi mɩ sɩpaaŋ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛmba kaa kpaa leree balɩa, a nagɛ pie-daara sɩ yie kɛŋ ʋ piesee pɔrɛ bʋʋnaa lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: He will place the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa chɩŋ mɩ nadiiŋ, ka dɩ tʋɔ-bɔŋ tɩŋŋaa ma chɩŋ mɩ nagʋa.

english_verse: Then the king will say to those on his right, “My father has blessed you! Come and receive the kingdom that was prepared for you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ-na Kuoro jaŋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ chɩŋ mɩ nadiiŋ, ‘Má kɔ. Mɩ Nyɩmma Wɩa nɛ pɛ ma lɛ. Má kʋ dii Wɩa kuorii-la ba sɩ wasa bil ma lɛ dʋnɩa dɩ-suomuŋ,

english_verse: When I was hungry, you gave me something to eat, and when I was thirsty, you gave me something to drink. When I was a stranger, you welcomed me,
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa, bʋa-la lɛ losuŋ fa sɩ kɛmmɛ, ma ŋaa kʋdiilee pɩmɛ nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ ma fa sɩ kɛmmɛ, ma ŋaa lɩɩŋ pɩmɛ mɩ nyʋa nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa sɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔrʋ, ma kɛmmɛ woruŋ nɛ.

english_verse: and when I was naked, you gave me clothes to wear. When I was sick, you took care of me, and when I was in jail, you visited me.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa kɛŋ yarɩ-biree nɛ, ma joŋ gɛrɩŋ laalɛmɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ, ma beŋ mɩ nyuŋ nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kɛmmɛ tɔ dɩa, ma kʋ namɛ nɛ.’

english_verse: Then the ones who pleased the Lord will ask, “When did we give you something to eat or drink?
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩmma-la jaŋ pɩɛsɛmɛ, ‘La Tɩɩna, chɛ bɛɛ nɛ la naŋ dɩ losuŋ kɛnɩŋ la joŋ kʋdiilee pɩŋ, chɛ bɛɛ nɛ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ kɛnɩŋ la ŋaa lɩɩŋ pɩŋ?

english_verse: When did we welcome you as a stranger or give you clothes to wear
translation_verse: Chɛ bɛɛ nɛ la naŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa nʋhʋɔrʋ la kɛnɩŋ woruŋ, koo chɛ bɛɛ nɛ la naŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree la joŋ gɛrɩŋ laalɩŋ?

english_verse: or visit you while you were sick or in jail?”
translation_verse: Chɛ bɛɛ nɛ la naŋ dɩ ŋ wɩɩlʋ, koo dɩ ba kɛnɩŋ tɔ dɩa la kʋ naŋ?’

english_verse: The king will answer, “Whenever you did it for any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you did it for me.”
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Kuoro jaŋ bʋla pɩba, ‘Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, bʋa-la kala lɛ ma sɩ ŋaa wʋzɔmʋŋ a pɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ deemba tʋɔŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ lee kɛnɛ, ma ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩmɛ nɛ.’

english_verse: Then the king will say to those on his left, “Get away from me! You are under God's curse. Go into the everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ mɩ nagʋa a bʋl, ‘Má sʋrɩsɛ mɩ sɛmɛ, Wɩa ŋmɩaŋ diima nɛ. Má mʋ a jʋʋ nyiŋ-la sɩ bɩ dɩsɛ. Wɩa hɛ nyiŋ-la bil Sɩtaanɩ arɩ ʋ tɩndaaraa lɛ nɛ dɩ ba kʋ jʋʋ,

english_verse: I was hungry, but you did not give me anything to eat, and I was thirsty, but you did not give me anything to drink.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la lɛ losuŋ fa sɩ kɛmmɛ, ma bɩ kʋdiilee ŋaa pɩmɛ, bʋa-la lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ fa sɩ kɛmmɛ, ma bɩ lɩɩŋ ŋaa pɩmɛ.

english_verse: I was a stranger, but you did not welcome me, and I was naked, but you did not give me any clothes to wear. I was sick and in jail, but you did not take care of me.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa sɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔrʋ, ma bɩ mɩ kɛnɛ woruŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa sɩ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree ma, ma bɩ gɛrɩŋ joŋo laalɛmɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ ma, ma bɩ mɩ nyuŋ bene. Bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kɛmmɛ tɔ dɩa ma, ma bɩ kʋ namɛ.’

english_verse: Then the people will ask, “Lord, when did we fail to help you when you were hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in jail?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ pɩɛsɛ mɩ-na kuoro, ‘La Tɩɩna, chɛ bɛɛ nɛ losuŋ kɛnɩŋ koo lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ kɛnɩŋ koo ŋ fa ŋaa nʋhʋɔrʋ, koo ŋ fa kɛŋ yarɩ-biree koo ŋ fa wʋwɩɩlɛ, koo ba kɛnɩŋ tɔ dɩa aŋ ka la bɩ ŋ lɛ pɛ?’

english_verse: The king will say to them, “Whenever you failed to help any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you failed to do it for me.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋl, ‘Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, bʋa-la kala lɛ ma sɩ vɩa dɩ ma pɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ lee kɛnɛ mɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ, ma vɩa dɩ ma pɛ mɩ ma lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.’

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “Those people will be punished forever. But the ones who pleased God will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ jʋʋ lee-la hɛɛŋ sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, aŋ ka dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa ma jʋʋ lee-la mɩɩsɩŋ sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: “You know two days from now will be Passover. This is when the Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies and nailed to a cross.”
translation_verse: tapʋlaa balɩa nɛ ka, ka dɩ dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la yi. Bʋa-la lɛ ba jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie a jommi hɛ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba kpaasɛmɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ.”

english_verse: Finally, Jesus returned to his disciples and said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? The time has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to sinners.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mɩɩra kɔ ʋ harɩ-tooroo teeŋ a pɩɛsɛba, “Ma ha pɩnaa wiesi nɛɛ? Má bee na, bʋa-la yie nɛ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie a hɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They planned how they could sneak around and have Jesus arrested and put to death.
translation_verse: Ba hilimi a vʋvʋʋrɛ ba sɩ jaŋ to wombii-la a lʋara kɛŋ Yesu a kpʋʋ.

english_verse: But they said, “We must not do it during Passover, because the people will riot.” At Bethany (Mark
translation_verse: Ama ba bʋl dɩ ba sɩ́ ʋ kɛŋ ba gbiele-la lɛ, dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, nɩaa jaŋ wuo sii hɛ yuosuŋ. Ba kɛŋ tʋlaalɩɩ tɩsɛ Yesu Maak

english_verse: We could have sold this perfume for a lot of money and given it to the poor.”
translation_verse: Ba fa jaŋ wuo joŋ tʋlaalɩɩ-la a yallɛ a na moribiee yʋgɛ a joŋo pɩ summoo.”

english_verse: But when his disciples saw this, they became angry and complained, “Why such a waste?
translation_verse: Ʋ harɩ-tooro-la sɩ na ŋɩɩ, ba baanɩŋ sii. Ba gʋrɩmɛ wɩaa pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ haala deeŋ kɛŋ tʋlaalɩɩ-la kaa chei ŋ-la?

english_verse: Then they sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives. Peter's Promise (Mark
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba yɩɩ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ yɩɩlɩŋ aŋ sii lɩɩ mʋ peel kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Olif leriŋ.

english_verse: and from then on he started looking for a good chance to betray Jesus. Jesus Eats the Passover Meal with His Disciples (Mark
translation_verse: A chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ Judas suomo chɩchɛ wombiiŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ to a kɛŋ Yesu yallɛ a pɩba. Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo dii dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la kʋdiilee Maak

english_verse: When Jesus was eating with his twelve disciples that evening, he said, “One of you will surely hand me over to my enemies.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩɩ dii kɩalɩŋ ŋɩɩ, Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, ma dɔŋɔ jaŋ jommi yallɛ.”

english_verse: On the first day of the Festival of Thin Bread, Jesus' disciples came to him and asked, “Where do you want us to prepare the Passover meal?”
translation_verse: Gbiele-la lɛ ba sɩ yie dii boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ, ba chɛ-bumbuŋ, Yesu harɩ-tooroo kɔ ʋ teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ cho dɩ la mʋ ŋaa dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la kʋdiilee dɩ ŋ kʋ dii?”

english_verse: During the meal Jesus took some bread in his hands. He blessed the bread and broke it. Then he gave it to his disciples and said, “Take this and eat it. This is my body.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ hɔnɔ didii kɩaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii a joŋ boroboro a lɔllɛ Wɩa aŋ kaa chɔgɛ chɔgɛ a joŋo pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo a bʋla pɩba, “Má laa dii, mɩ yaraa nammɩa nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: This is my blood, and with it God makes his agreement with you. It will be poured out, so that many people will have their sins forgiven.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ chalɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Chalɩŋ deeŋ nɛ Wɩa joŋo hɛ niiŋ ma dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ. Mɩ chalɩŋ jaŋ jaasɛ nɩ-daŋ wɩaa, dɩ Wɩa joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba.

english_verse: From now on I am not going to drink any wine, until I drink new wine with you in my Father's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ deeŋ, see tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ dɩ ma sɩ jaŋ nyʋa sɩ-falɩŋ mɩ Nyɩmma Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I promise you before a rooster crows tonight, you will say three times that you don't know me.”
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, jɩnɩŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ deeŋ ŋ-na Pɩɩta, ŋ jaŋ bʋl naansɩɩŋ butori arɩ ŋ bɩ mɩ jɩŋ, ka dɩ ji-bele-na yel.”

english_verse: Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane. When they got there, he told them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo mʋ jʋʋ lee kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Gɛtɩsɛmanɩ. Yesu bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo dɩ ba hɔŋ daha, ka ʋ mʋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa aŋ kɔ.

english_verse: and he said to them, “I am so sad that I feel as if I am dying. Stay here and keep awake with me.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “Mɩ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ cheye a magɛ dɩ mɩ sʋʋ. Má hɔŋ dɩ la kala pɔ na.”

english_verse: Peter spoke up, “Even if all the others reject you, I never will!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋla pɩ Yesu, “Dɩ ba kala fá ma aŋ leŋiŋ, mɩ-na bɩ jaŋ mɩɩrɛ ŋ harɩŋ da.”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never say I don't know you.” All the others said the same thing. Jesus Prays (Mark
