translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ mɩ dɩŋ nɛ jaŋ paala sʋʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ ma, mɩ bɩ jaŋ bʋl arɩ mɩ bɩŋ jɩŋ.” Kʋkaana-la ma kala bʋl ŋɩɩ. Yesu chʋɔlɛ Wɩa Gɛtɩsɛmanɩ lɛ Maak

english_verse: Again Jesus went to pray and said, “My Father, if there is no other way, and I must suffer, I will still do what you want.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra mʋ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa lɩamɩŋ lɛ a bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ Nyɩmma, dɩ wombiiŋ nɛ tuo dɩ ŋ laa hɛɛŋ deeŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, leŋ dɩ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ ŋaa.”

english_verse: Jesus walked on a little way. Then he knelt with his face to the ground and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, don't make me suffer by drinking from this cup. But do what you want, and not what I want.”
translation_verse: Ba hɔŋ, ka ʋ sʋrɩsa mʋ sɩpaaŋ mʋa a tuu pɩna chigi tinteeŋ a sʋl Wɩa a bʋl, “Mɩ Nyɩmma, dɩ wombiiŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, lɩɩsɛ hɛɛ-la sɩɩ kɔ mɩ lɛ. Ama mɩ-na tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ dee, ŋ-na tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Get up! Let's go. The one who will betray me is already here.” Jesus Is Arrested (Mark
translation_verse: Má sii la mʋ, nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ jommi yallɛ ka kɔ nɛ.” Ba kɛŋ Yesu Maak

english_verse: Jesus took along Peter and the two brothers, James and John. He was very sad and troubled,
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ Pɩɩta arɩ Zebidi biiriŋ balɩa a kaa mʋ nɩmɛ. Ʋ tʋɔŋ faasa chei woruŋ.

english_verse: He came back and found his disciples sleeping. So he said to Peter, “Can't any of you stay awake with me for just one hour?
translation_verse: Ʋ chʋɔla dɛrɛ aŋ sii kɔ ʋ harɩ-tooroo teeŋ dɩ ba pɩŋ doŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛ Pɩɩta, “Ŋ pɩna nɛɛ? Ŋ bɩ doŋ mʋapɩlɩɩ ma wuo bɛrɛ aa yi hawa kʋbalaa?

english_verse: Stay awake and pray that you won't be tested. You want to do what is right, but you are weak.”
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Wɩa aŋ pʋpɔ dɩ Sɩtaanɩ nɛ kʋ magɩsɛma dɩ ʋ sɩ́ ma wuo. Ma tʋɔŋ lɛ ma cho dɩ ma ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, aŋ ka ma bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: He left them and prayed the same prayer once more.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mʋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa torimuŋ lɛ a bɩra bʋl ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “My friend, do what you came for.” The men grabbed Jesus and arrested him.
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ nandɔŋɔ, ŋaa wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ kɔ dɩ ŋ ŋaa?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala guu kɔ a gurigu.

english_verse: Jesus was still speaking, when Judas the betrayer came up. He was one of the twelve disciples, and a large mob armed with swords and clubs was with him. They had been sent by the chief priests and the nation's leaders.
translation_verse: Yesu ha bɩ wɩaa bʋla dɛrɛ, dɩ Judas nɩɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ fa ŋaa Yesu harɩ-tooro-la fii arɩ balɩa dɔŋɔ nɛ. Nɩaa yʋgɛ a tuto ʋ harɩŋ. Dɔnsʋŋ kori tokobiee arɩ toŋguloo. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ ba taŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ nɛ tɩmba, ba kɔ.

english_verse: Judas had told them ahead of time, “Arrest the man I greet with a kiss.”
translation_verse: Zɛmbɛ tɩɩna-la fa pɩ nɩalɩŋ magɩl nɛ, “Nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ mʋ guori, ʋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Má kɛnʋ.”

english_verse: Judas walked right up to Jesus and said, “Hello, teacher.” Then Judas kissed him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Judas vɛŋ tegi tegi a mʋ Yesu teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, mɩɩ chʋɔlʋŋ,” aŋ guoru.

english_verse: One of Jesus' followers pulled out a sword. He struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.
translation_verse: Yesu harɩ-tooro-la dɔŋɔ lɩɩsɛ ʋ tokobii a ta nʋʋ dɩgɩlɩŋ keri. Nɩɩ-la fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ yomo nɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus told him, “Put your sword away. Anyone who lives by fighting will die by fighting.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Joŋ ŋ tokobiiŋ a hɛ ʋ dɩ-hɛɛlɩŋ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩsɛ tokobiiŋ, tokobiiŋ nɛ ba jaŋ kaa kpʋʋ.

english_verse: The high priest then tore his robe and said, “This man claims to be God! We don't need any more witnesses! You have heard what he said.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ aŋ bʋl, “Ŋ chei Wɩa yɩrɩŋ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ la bɩra chɛ dansɩaba. Ma kala bɩ nɩa ʋ sɩ chei Wɩa yɩrɩŋ ŋɩɩ?

english_verse: But Jesus did not answer. So the high priest said, “With the living God looking on, you must tell the truth. Are you the Messiah, the Son of God?”
translation_verse: Yesu tɔrɛ ʋ niiŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ bʋla pʋ, “Wɩa-la sɩ weye yɩrɩŋ lɛ, bʋla pɩla, ŋ nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsaa? Ŋ nɛ Wɩa Biee?”

english_verse: When Peter had gone out to the gate, another servant girl saw him and said to some people there, “This man was with Jesus from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sii lɩɩ chɩŋ zawʋra tʋɔŋ. Ʋ sɩ chɩŋ nɩmɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-tolo dɔŋɔ ma bɩra naʋ a bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ chɩna kpagʋ, “Baala deeŋ ma ŋaa Yesu sɩ lɩɩ Nazarɛt harɩ-tooro-la dɔŋɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: After Jesus had been arrested, he was led off to the house of Caiaphas the high priest. The nation's leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses were meeting there.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ Yesu, kɛnʋ kaa mʋ Kayafas dɩa. Ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ. Dɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba arɩ ba taŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ kala hilimi nɩmɛ.

english_verse: But Peter followed along at a distance and came to the courtyard of the high priest's palace. He went in and sat down with the guards to see what was going to happen.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta daa tuto ba harɩŋ a to jʋʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ kaala. Ʋ jʋʋ kaala-la a mʋ hɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ kaala-la teeŋ dɩ ʋ na wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Yesu lɛ.

english_verse: The chief priests and the whole council wanted to put Jesus to death. So they tried to find some people who would tell lies about him in court.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa chɩchɛ dɩ ba nyɩɛ wɩaa a tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ.

english_verse: But they could not find any, even though many did come and tell lies. At last, two men came forward
translation_verse: Nɩaa paala yʋgɛ a kʋ nyɩɛ wɩaa pʋ, ama ba fa bɩ wuo na wɩɩkala ʋ sɩ ŋaa chei. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa balɩa kʋ lɩɩ

english_verse: and said, “This man claimed he could tear down God's temple and build it again in three days.”
translation_verse: a bʋl, “Baala deeŋ sɩ ʋ jaŋ wuo ŋmoo Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lo aŋ bɩra saaʋ tapʋlaa batori pɛgɛ.”

english_verse: “That is what you say!” Jesus answered. “But I tell all of you, ‘Soon you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right side of God All-Powerful and coming on the clouds of heaven.’ ”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ-na nɛ, ama mɩ bʋlaa pɩma kala, a lɩɩ bʋa deeŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ, ma jaŋ na mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie dɩ mɩ hɔŋ Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ a to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tʋɔŋ kʋʋ tuu.”

english_verse: Then they spit in his face and hit him with their fists. Others slapped him
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tʋ nantʋɔrʋŋ hɛ ʋ sɩaa lɛ a ŋmobu. Nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ ŋmobu bʋl,

english_verse: and said, “You think you are the Messiah! So tell us who hit you!” Peter Says He Doesn't Know Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: “Ŋ-na Kirisito, ka ŋ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ, dagɛla nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋmobuŋ.” Pɩɩta sɩ ʋ bɩ Yesu jɩŋ Maak

english_verse: Again Peter denied it, and this time he swore, “I don't even know that man!”

english_verse: Jesus walked on and soon saw James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat, mending their nets.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ ŋɩɩ baa mʋ, dɩ baalaa balɩa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Baa yɩrɛ Jeems arɩ Jɔɔŋ. Ba fa ŋaa Zebidi biiriŋ nɛ. Ba hɔŋ ba lɩɩŋ daboro lɛ a tʋtɔ ba jómba bʋɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: News about Jesus quickly spread all over Galilee. Jesus Heals Many People (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ, ʋ wɩaa guu teeli Galilii tinteeŋ kala. Yesu vaarɛ nɩaa yʋgɛ Mat.

english_verse: It began just as God had said in the book written by Isaiah the prophet, “I am sending my messenger to get the way ready for you.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Azaaya fa ŋmʋnsa arɩ Wɩa sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ mɩ tɩndaara dɩ ʋ laa ŋ sɩpaaŋ mʋ a wasɛ wombiiŋ bil ŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.
translation_verse: Bʋntaŋŋa pʋnaa gɛnnɩŋ nɛ Jɔɔŋ fa laalɛ a kɛŋ tembiiŋ vɔɔ ʋ tɩŋa. Ʋ kʋdiilee nɛ fa nyaŋgɩrɩgɛba arɩ tʋʋŋ.

english_verse: John also told the people, “Someone more powerful is going to come. And I am not good enough even to stoop down and untie his sandals.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa a bʋl, “Nʋʋ dɔŋ jaŋ to mɩ harɩŋ kɔ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ faasa kɛŋ doluŋ kɩɩmɛ. Mɩ paala bɩ maga dɩ mɩ kpagʋ a kɛŋ ʋ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ ŋmɛsɩŋ ma kaa puri.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples went to the town of Capernaum. Then on the next Sabbath he went into the synagogue and started teaching.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋmʋ a kʋ yi Kapɛnam. Ŋɩɩ nɛ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, Yesu sii a mʋ jʋʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa a dɩdagɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed at his teaching. He taught with authority, and not like the teachers of the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩɩ dagɛba ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere. Ʋ bɩ baa daga arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba sɩ yie dɩdagɛba ŋɩɩ. Ʋ bʋl wɩaa arɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩ-la doluŋ.

english_verse: About that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee, and John baptized him in the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Yesu sii lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nazarɛt a hɛ Galilii tinteeŋ lɛ a kɔ Jɔɔŋ teeŋ, ʋ fou Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la lɛ.

english_verse: As soon as Jesus came out of the water, he saw the sky open and the Holy Spirit coming down to him like a dove.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mɩɩra kʋʋ lɩɩ fuo-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ wʋla beŋ dɩ wɩa-nyuŋ guu kpaa balɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ tuu a nagɛ kokomo a togili ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: A man with leprosy came to Jesus and knelt down. He begged, “You have the power to make me well, if only you wanted to.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ gbege kʋbala ma kɔ Yesu teeŋ a tuu kpirimi a sʋlʋ, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ cho, ŋaa dɩ mɩ duori.”

english_verse: He said, “The time has come! God's kingdom will soon be here. Turn back to God and believe the good news!” Jesus Chooses Four Fishermen (Matthew
translation_verse: a bʋl, “Bʋa-la yie nɛ. Wɩa kuorii-la kpaga nɛ. Má bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ a laa Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la dii.”

english_verse: At once Jesus asked them to come with him. They left their father in the boat with the hired workers and went with him. A Man with an Evil Spirit (Luke
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ naba, ʋ yɩrɛba. Ba leŋ ba nyɩmma Zebidi arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ tɩma pɩba ka ba titimba lɩɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ aŋ to ʋ harɩŋ. Yesu vaarɛ baal kʋbala fa sɩ kɛŋ jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ Luuk

english_verse: Jesus went to her. He took hold of her hand and helped her up. The fever left her, and she served them a meal.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kʋ jʋʋ a kɛŋ haal-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ a kaa chʋʋlɛ. Ʋ yaraa fa sɩ lɩma ŋɩɩ, ʋ fɩɛlɛ. Ʋ sii ŋaa kʋdiilee pɩba.

english_verse: And when they found him, they said, “Everyone is looking for you!”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ naʋ, ba bʋla pʋ, “Nʋʋkala nɩɩ chɛŋ.”

english_verse: Suddenly a man with an evil spirit in him entered the synagogue and yelled,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩ baal nɛ ŋɩɩ. Jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ kɛnʋ. Ʋ kʋ jʋʋ aa ŋmoo niiŋ,

english_verse: “Jesus from Nazareth, what do you want with us? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are! You are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: “Yesu sɩ lɩɩ Nazarɛt, bɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɩchɛ ŋ ŋaa la lɛ? Ŋ kɔ dɩ ŋ kpʋla nɛɛ? Mɩ jɩmɩŋ nɛ, ŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna.”

english_verse: Jesus told the evil spirit, “Be quiet and come out of the man!”
translation_verse: Yesu kpɩa jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la lɛ, “Kɛŋ goŋ aŋ kʋ lɩɩ baal-la lɛ.”

english_verse: The spirit shook him. Then it gave a loud shout and left.
translation_verse: Jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la kɛŋ baal-la terigi aŋ faasa chɩɩrɛ kɩŋkɛŋ aŋ lɩɩ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone was completely surprised and kept saying to each other, “What is this? It must be some new kind of powerful teaching! Even the evil spirits obey him.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala mɩɩra hirigi a pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ-la? Wʋfalɩɩ nɛ ʋʋ dagɛ. Ʋ paala kɛŋ doluŋ a wuo jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ a bʋl wɩaa pɩba, ba tuto ʋ niiŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “We must go to the nearby towns, so that I can tell the good news to those people. This is why I have come.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má leŋ dɩ la mʋ tasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma dɩ mɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ mɩ kɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus felt sorry for the man. So he put his hand on him and said, “I want to! Now you are well.”
translation_verse: Nisusuŋ kɛŋ Yesu. Ʋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ a digu aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ cho nɛ, duori.”

english_verse: As soon as Jesus left the synagogue with James and John, they went home with Simon and Andrew.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii a lɩɩ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa-la lɛ, ʋ dɩ Jeems arɩ Jɔɔŋ, a mʋ Saamɔŋ arɩ Anduru dɩa.

english_verse: When they got there, Jesus was told that Simon's mother-in-law was sick in bed with fever.
translation_verse: Ba mʋa dɩ Saamɔŋ hɩɩlɩ-haala pɩna a wʋwɩɩlɛ, ʋ yaraa kala lɩŋ. Yesu sɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ, ba bʋla pʋ.

english_verse: That evening after sunset, all who were sick or had demons in them were brought to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩdaanɩŋ sɩ yie, ba kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ arɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ kala a kaa kɔ Yesu teeŋ.

english_verse: In fact, the whole town gathered around the door of the house.
translation_verse: Kapɛnam nɩaa kala gire kɔ a hilimi Saamɔŋ dɩa boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Jesus healed all kinds of terrible diseases and forced out a lot of demons. But the demons knew who he was, and he did not let them speak.
translation_verse: Yesu vaarɛ nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ nyanyal dosunuŋ a yʋgɛ, a kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ ma yʋgɛ nɩaa lɛ. Jɩŋ-bɔmɔ-la jɩŋ Yesu nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bɩ ba wombiiŋ pa dɩ ba bʋl wɩaa. Yesu bʋl Wɩa wɩaa Galilii tinteeŋ lɛ Luuk

english_verse: Very early the next morning before daylight, Jesus got up and went to a place where he could be alone and pray.
translation_verse: Chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla, Yesu sii lɩɩ dɩa-la lɛ a mʋ lee-la nɩaa sɩ tuo a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Simon and the others started looking for him.
translation_verse: Ka Saamɔŋ arɩ ʋ dɔnsʋ-la ma sii lɩɩ chɩchɛʋ.

english_verse: Then Jesus went to their synagogues everywhere in Galilee, where he preached and forced out demons. Jesus Heals a Man (Matthew
translation_verse: Ʋ sii a mʋ gɔllɛ Galilii tinteeŋ kala a jʋʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ aa bʋl Wɩa wɩaa aŋ pɛ kikiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ ma nɩaa lɛ. Yesu vaarɛ gbege Mat.

english_verse: At once the man's leprosy disappeared, and he was well.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ yawɩɩl-la guu lɩɩ baal-la lɛ, ka ʋ duori.

english_verse: After Jesus strictly warned the man, he sent him on his way.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ a bʋl,

english_verse: He said, “Don't tell anyone about this. Just go and show the priest that you are well. Then take a gift to the temple as Moses commanded, and everyone will know that you have been healed.”
translation_verse: “Viiri aŋ sɩ́ wɩɩ bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala. Ama kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa mʋ dagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, aŋ joŋ ŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa pʋ dɩ ʋ kpʋ a pɩɩsɛ ŋ disiniŋ ta arɩ Mosis fa sɩ dagɛma ŋɩɩ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, nɩaa jaŋ na arɩ ŋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: The man talked about it so much and told so many people, that Jesus could no longer go openly into a town. He had to stay away from the towns, but people still came to him from everywhere.
translation_verse: Ama baal-la kɛŋ wɩɩ-la kaa lɩɩ a bʋla gaarɛ leriŋ kala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bɩ wuo chaasa jʋʋ taŋ kala tʋɔŋ, ama ʋ yie mʋ hɔŋ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ, ka nɩaa lɩɩ lee na-kala a kʋkɔ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: It was during the time of Abiathar the high priest. David went into the house of God and ate the sacred loaves of bread that only priests are allowed to eat. He also gave some to his followers.”
translation_verse: Ʋ fa jʋʋ Wɩa dɩa nɛ bʋa-la lɛ Abɩata sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ, a joŋ boroboro-la ba sɩ yie joŋo bil Wɩa sɩpaaŋ a chɔgɔ dii aŋ chɔgɔ pɩ ʋ harɩŋ nɩaa ba dii. Ʋ fa ŋaa kɩsɩŋ nɛ arɩ nɩwogo sɩ jaŋ joŋ boroboro-la dii, see Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara dʋndʋŋa.”

english_verse: Then so many of them came to the house that there wasn't even standing room left in front of the door. Jesus was still teaching
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩ-daŋ gire kɔ a tɔ lee-la kala a tɔ boiŋ niiŋ ma. Ka ʋ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pɩpɩba.

english_verse: when four people came up, carrying a man on a mat because he could not walk.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba banɛsɛ joŋ gbɛrɩgʋ kʋbala kaa kɔ. Ʋ pɩŋ ʋ bɔsɔ lɛ.

english_verse: But because of the crowd, they could not get him to Jesus. So they made a hole in the roof above him and let the man down in front of everyone.
translation_verse: Nɩaa sɩ tɔ leriŋ kala ŋɩɩ, ba bɩ jɩŋ lee-la ba sɩ jaŋ to a jʋʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jɩl lusuŋ nyuŋ a ta luri a joŋ bɔsɔ-la arɩ gbɛrɩgʋ-la kala a to bʋa-la ta ʋ tuu Yesu sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: “Why would he say such a thing? He must think he is God! Only God can forgive sins.”
translation_verse: “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ baala deeŋ bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ? Ʋʋ tʋʋsɛ Wɩa joŋŋoo nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛ nʋʋ, dɩ Wɩa dʋndʋŋa dee?”

english_verse: I will show you that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” So Jesus said to the man,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dagɛma arɩ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie kɛŋ doluŋ dʋnɩa lɛ dɩ mɩ joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛ nɩaa.”

english_verse: “Get up! Pick up your mat and go on home.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ gbɛrɩgʋ-la, “Sii a joŋ ŋ bɔsɔ mʋ dɩa.”

english_verse: Once again, Jesus went to the shore of Lake Galilee. A large crowd gathered around him, and he taught them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii nɩmɛ a mɩɩra tuu mʋga niiŋ. Nɩaa yʋgɛ a kʋ hilimi, ʋ dɩdagɛba.

english_verse: Jesus finished by saying, “People were not made for the good of the Sabbath. The Sabbath was made for the good of people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Wɩa lɩɩsɛ chɛ-wiesii-la pɩ nɩaa nɛ dɩ ba tɩɩʋ. Ʋ bɩ sɩ dɩ chɛ-wiesii-la nɛ tɩɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples were having dinner at Levi's house. Many tax collectors and other sinners had become followers of Jesus, and they were also guests at the dinner.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mʋ jʋʋ Levi dɩa, ʋ dɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo kala, a hɔnɔ didii kɩaa. Lampoo laara-la dɔnsʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa ma kɔ, ba kala didii kɩalɩŋ. Ba fa yʋga woruŋ a tuto Yesu harɩŋ.

english_verse: Some of the teachers of the Law of Moses were Pharisees, and they saw Jesus eating with sinners and tax collectors. So they asked his disciples, “Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba arɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa naba a pɩɛsɛ Yesu harɩ-tooroo, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ Yesu arɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa arɩ lampoo laaraa kala hɔnɔ didii kɩaa?”

english_verse: The followers of John the Baptist and the Pharisees often went without eating. Some people came and asked Jesus, “Why do the followers of John and those of the Pharisees often go without eating, while your disciples never do?”
translation_verse: Chɛɛ dɔŋ Jɔɔŋ, Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la harɩ-tooroo arɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa harɩ-tooroo vʋvɔɔ niiŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa sii kʋ pɩɛsɛ Yesu, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ Jɔɔŋ harɩ-tooroo arɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa harɩ-tooro-naa vɔɔ niiŋ, aŋ ka ŋ harɩ-tooro-na bɩ vɔɔ?”

english_verse: But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.
translation_verse: Ama chɛɛ dɔŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ baal-la kaa mʋ lee, aŋ ka dɩ ʋ nandɔsʋ-la vɔɔ niiŋ.”

english_verse: No one patches old clothes by sewing on a piece of new cloth. The new piece would shrink and tear a bigger hole.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ gɛrɩ-bɩnɩŋ dɩ ʋ luri, ŋ jaŋ joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-falɩŋ a tɔɔ? Aɩ, ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, kʋfalɩɩ-la jaŋ kʋʋrɛ dɩ gɛrɩ-la wasa kɩɛsa kɩɩ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined. New wine must be put into new wineskins. A Question about the Sabbath (Matthew
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ joŋ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ a hɛ pupo-kpaaŋ lɛ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, pupoi-la jaŋ yɛrɛ, dɩ sɩŋ-la kala ta. Ŋ yie joŋ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ a hɛ pupoi-zɔmʋŋ lɛ nɛ.” Ba bʋl chɛ-wiesii-la wɩaa Mat.

english_verse: One Sabbath Jesus and his disciples were walking through some wheat fields. His disciples were picking grains of wheat as they went along.
translation_verse: Chɛ-wiesiŋ chɛɛ kʋbala Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo sii to nyonso baga tʋɔŋ mʋmʋ. Ba sɩɩ mʋmʋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ harɩ-tooro-la bubori nyonso-la nyusuŋ.

english_verse: Some Pharisees asked Jesus, “Why are your disciples picking grain on the Sabbath? They are not supposed to do that!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ bɩ naa? Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ kɩsɩŋ nɛ ba chichei ŋɩɩ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Haven't you read what David did when he and his followers were hungry and in need?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛba, “Ma ha bɩ wɩɩ-la Devit fa sɩ ŋaa bʋa-la lɛ losuŋ fa sɩ kɛŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ harɩŋ nɩaa ba chɩchɛ kʋdiilee dɩ ba dii karɩmaa?

english_verse: So the Son of Man is Lord over the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie nɛ ŋaa chɛ-wiesii-la Tɩɩna ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: He even had to tell his disciples to get a boat ready to keep him from being crushed by the crowds.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la dɩ ba mʋ joŋ lɩɩŋ daboro a kaa kʋ kɩɩ lɩɩŋ niiŋ dɩ ʋ jʋʋ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ́ kʋ jugulu.

english_verse: The Pharisees wanted to accuse Jesus of doing something wrong, and they kept watching to see if Jesus would heal him on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ na Yesu dɩ ʋ jʋa, ba kala chaarɛ sɩaa a bibenu dɩ ba na arɩ ʋ jaŋ vaarɛ baal-la chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ. Baa chɛ dɩ ba na wɩɩ nɛ a to ŋɩɩ lɛ a kɛŋ Yesu a bʋl ʋ teeŋ dɩ ʋ chei ba kɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus told the man to stand up where everyone could see him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl na-sʋʋ-la tɩɩna lɛ, “Sii kʋ chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩpaaŋ.” Ʋ sii mʋ.

english_verse: Jesus was angry as he looked around at the people. Yet he felt sorry for them because they were so stubborn. Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his bad hand was healed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ a gɩɛnɛba. Ʋ tʋɔŋ chei a tɩŋ ba dɩgɩlɩŋ-bɩnɩɩ wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ na-sʋʋ-la tɩɩna, “Kɛŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩɛnɛ.” Ʋ kaa tɩɛnɛ. Ʋ nɩsɩ-la fɩɛlɛ a nagɛ ʋ nagɩŋ.

english_verse: Jesus led his disciples down to the shore of the lake. Large crowds followed him from Galilee, Judea,
translation_verse: Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo sii a mʋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ. Nɩaa yʋgɛ a lɩɩ Galilii tinteeŋ a to ba harɩŋ. Dɔnsʋŋ ma lɩɩ Judiya tinteeŋ,

english_verse: Simon was one of the twelve, and Jesus named him Peter.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fii arɩ balɩa yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la: Saamɔŋ, Yesu nɛ hɛ Pɩɩta pʋ,

english_verse: Jesus decided to ask some of his disciples to go up on a mountain with him, and they went.
translation_verse: Yesu sii a mʋ lee-la sɩ kɛŋ peelee a yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ, ba mʋ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: There were also James and John, the two sons of Zebedee. Jesus called them Boanerges, which means “Thunderbolts.”
translation_verse: Zebidi nanʋala Jeems arɩ ʋ naambie Jɔɔŋ. Yesu kɛmba kaa yɩrɛ Bʋanaajɩs .

english_verse: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus were also apostles. The others were Simon, known as the Eager One,
translation_verse: Ba kʋkaanaa ma nɛ ŋ-la: Anduru, Fɩlɩp, Batolomi, Matiu, Tɔmas arɩ Alɩfɩyas nanʋala Jeems, Tadɩyas, Saamɔŋ Zɛlɔt

english_verse: Some teachers of the Law of Moses came from Jerusalem and said, “This man is under the power of Beelzebul, the ruler of demons! He is even forcing out demons with the help of Beelzebul.”
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba-la sɩ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm kɔ ma bʋl, “Jɩnsɩŋ kala kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛlizibul nɛ kɛnʋ. Ʋ nɛ pʋ doluŋ ʋ kikiri jɩnsɩŋ nɩaa lɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The crowd sitting around Jesus told him, “Your mother and your brothers and sisters are outside and want to see you.”
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩ-daŋ hɔnɔ gollu a chu. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ naaŋ arɩ ŋ naambiiriŋ nɛ chɩŋ jeeŋ harɩŋ aa chɛŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus told the people to gather around him. Then he spoke to them in riddles and said: How can Satan force himself out?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu yɩrɛba a magɛ namagaba a pɩpɩba a bʋl, “Ɛɛ nɛ Sɩtaanɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa a kiri ʋ tɩtɩa?

english_verse: Jesus went back home, and once again such a large crowd gathered that there was no chance even to eat.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mʋ dɩa, nɩaa bɩra kʋ hilimi. Ʋ dɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo paala bɩ chɩnɩŋ na dɩ ba dii kʋdiilee.

english_verse: A nation whose people fight each other won't last very long.
translation_verse: Dɩ tinteeŋ nɩaa nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a bɩ nii-bala kɛnɛ, ba taŋ jaŋ tel.

english_verse: And a family that fights won't last long either.
translation_verse: Dɩ dɩa nɩaa ma nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a bɩ nii-bala kɛnɛ, ba dɩa jaŋ tel.

english_verse: So if Satan fights against himself, that will be the end of him.
translation_verse: Dɩ Sɩtaanɩ arɩ ʋ harɩbaa nɛ gʋra yuyuo dɔŋɔ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ dɩchɩnɩŋ, ʋ wɩɩkala jaŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: How can anyone break into the house of a strong man and steal his things, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can take everything.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ nɩduoŋ dɩa a gaa ʋ kɩaa see dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nɩduo-la vɔɔ bil aŋ-na jʋʋ paa ʋ kɩaa.”

english_verse: I promise you that any of the sinful things you say or do can be forgiven, no matter how terrible those things are.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩaa, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, dɩ nɩaa nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala aŋ pɛ tʋʋsɛ Wɩa joŋŋoo ma, Wɩa jaŋ wuo joŋ ba kala chɛba.

english_verse: But if you speak against the Holy Spirit, you can never be forgiven. That sin will be held against you forever.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ tʋʋsɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ joŋŋoo, Wɩa bɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛʋ da. Ʋ tɩɩna ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: Jesus said this because the people were saying that he had an evil spirit in him. Jesus' Mother and Brothers (Matthew
translation_verse: Yesu bʋl ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ fa sɩ, “Jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ nɛ kɛnʋ.” Yesu naaŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ kɔ ʋ teeŋ Mat.

english_verse: Jesus' mother and brothers came and stood outside. Then they sent someone with a message for him to come out to them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu naaŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ kɔ a chɩŋ dɩ-jalɩŋ aŋ tɩŋ dɩ ba yɩrʋ.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “Who is my mother and who are my brothers?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mɩɩra pɩɛsɛ, “Kʋbɛɛ ba nɛ ŋaa mɩ naaŋ arɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ?”

english_verse: Then he looked at the people sitting around him and said, “Here are my mother and my brothers.
translation_verse: Ʋ mɩɩra beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔnɔ gollu chu aŋ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ naaŋ arɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: Anyone who obeys God is my brother or sister or mother.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ cho, ʋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ naambie arɩ mɩ dɩhaala arɩ mɩ naaŋ.”

english_verse: The next time Jesus taught beside Lake Galilee, a big crowd gathered. It was so large that he had to sit in a boat out on the lake, while the people stood on the shore.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mɩɩra mʋ hɔŋ Galilii mʋga-la niiŋ a dɩdagɛ nɩaa. Nɩaa yʋgɛ a kʋ gollu chu. Ba sɩ yʋga ŋɩɩ nɛ, ʋ sii mʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro a hɔŋ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ. Ka nɩalɩŋ chɩŋ mʋga niiŋ.

english_verse: While the farmer was scattering the seed, some of it fell along the road and was eaten by birds.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa ŋaa mɩmɩsɛ nɛ, kʋdoho-la dɔnsʋŋ tel wombiiŋ tʋɔŋ. Diibiisiŋ kʋ tʋɔsa dii.

english_verse: He used stories to teach them many things, and this is part of what he taught:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ magɛ namagaba a dagɛba wɩaa yʋgɛ. Ʋ namagaba-la dɔŋɔ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: Now listen! A farmer went out to scatter seed in a field.
translation_verse: “Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Baal kʋbala nɛ sie a kɛŋ ʋ kʋdoho kaa lɩɩ dɩ ʋ duu.

english_verse: Other seeds fell on thin, rocky ground and quickly started growing because the soil wasn't very deep.
translation_verse: Dɔnsʋŋ ma tel kpagɩnyɩlɩŋ nyuŋ. Hagɩla bɩ yʋga, ka ba guu nyʋ. Ba naapoloo bɩ tinteeŋ jʋa.

english_verse: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched and dried up, because they did not have deep roots.
translation_verse: Wɩa pɔsɛ wulumuŋ kɛŋ ba sʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba naapoloo bɩ tinteeŋ jʋa.

english_verse: Some other seeds fell where thornbushes grew up and choked out the plants. So they did not produce any grain.
translation_verse: Kʋdoho-la dɔnsʋŋ ma tel sɔsʋŋ tʋɔŋ a nyʋ, sɔsʋ-la waa a nyagɛba kpʋ. Ba bɩ wasa.

english_verse: Finally, Jesus said: What is God's kingdom like? What story can I use to explain it?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ joŋ Wɩa kuorii-la a kaa magɩsɛ? Namaga bɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ kaa dagʋ?

english_verse: When Jesus was alone with the twelve apostles and some others, they asked him about these stories.
translation_verse: Yesu dʋndʋŋa sɩ ka, ʋ harɩ-tooroo fii arɩ balɩa-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ gollu, pɩɛsʋ namagaba-la bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But they don't have roots, and they don't last very long. As soon as life gets hard or the message gets them in trouble, they give up.
translation_verse: Ama ba bɩ bɔyɛ kɛnɛ a nagɛ kɩalɩŋ naapoloo sɩ bɩ tinteeŋ jʋa. Ba jaŋ sɛɩ wɩɩ-la a tou mʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ, dɩ hɛɛŋ nɛ jʋʋba, koo dɩ ba to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la wɩaa, ba guu joŋo ta.

english_verse: The reason is, “These people will look and look, but never see. They will listen and listen, but never understand. If they did, they would turn to God and be forgiven.” Jesus Explains the Story about the Farmer (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba yie nyilimi nyilimi aŋ bɩ kʋŋkala wuo na, a jegili jegili aŋ bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ wuo jɩŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ fa jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ, ba fa jaŋ bɩrɩma to Wɩa, dɩ ʋ joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba.” Yesu dagɛ namaga-la bʋbʋɔŋ Mat.

english_verse: The seeds that fell along the road are the people who hear the message. But Satan soon comes and snatches it away from them.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ sɩ tel wombiiŋ lɛ nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie nɩɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ. Dɩ ba nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ, Sɩtaanɩ yie guu kɔ a kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ liiri ba tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: What the farmer is spreading is really the message about the kingdom.
translation_verse: Baal-la sɩɩ duu kɩaa, ʋ nagɛ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa nɛ ʋ kaa lɩɩ dɩ ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jesus also said: You don't light a lamp and put it under a clay pot or under a bed. Don't you put a lamp on a lampstand?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “Ŋ jaŋ nyɩgɛ chaanɩŋ kaa jʋʋ dɩa, a joŋ gbaŋa chu tɔɔ? Koo a joŋo hɛ godo bʋbʋɔŋ? Aɩ, ŋ jaŋ joŋo daŋ chaaŋ daaŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Listen carefully to what you hear! The way you treat others will be the way you will be treated—and even worse.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa woruŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ nɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ ma sɩ joŋo to ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa ma jaŋ joŋo to ma lɛ, a paala kɩɩ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Again Jesus said: God's kingdom is like what happens when a farmer scatters seed in a field.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Wɩa kuorii-la nagɛ nɩa sɩ mʋ duu kɩaa baga lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: It is the ground that makes the seeds sprout and grow into plants that produce grain.
translation_verse: Ba nyʋ ba tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ a waa, a tʋʋrɛ guloo, a lɩɩsɛ nyusuŋ, a hɛ biee a bii.

english_verse: Then when harvest season comes and the grain is ripe, the farmer cuts it with a sickle. A Mustard Seed (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bɩa, ʋ joŋ sɩa a mʋ kʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ yie nɛ.” Yesu magɛ namaga a tɩgɛ kʋdoho kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Masɩtad lɛ Mat.

english_verse: It is like what happens when a mustard seed is planted in the ground. It is the smallest seed in all the world.
translation_verse: Ʋ nagɛ kʋdoho kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ masɩtad nɛ, ba yie joŋo duu. Ʋ nɛ muuro kɩɩ kʋdoho na-kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: But once it is planted, it grows larger than any garden plant. It even puts out branches that are big enough for birds to nest in its shade. The Reason for Teaching with Stories (Matthew
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba nɛ duo dɩ ʋ nyʋ, ʋ yie sii waa a ŋaa tɩa a kɩɩ baga kʋduuloo kala kala. Ʋ naakelee yʋgɛ. Diibiisiŋ yie kʋ sagɛ ʋ lɛ a saa ba dɛllɩŋ.”

english_verse: He did not tell them anything without using stories. But when he was alone with his disciples, he explained everything to them. A Storm (Matthew
translation_verse: Ʋ yie bɩ sɛɩ dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩɩkala polli see ʋ magɛ namaga. Ama ʋ dɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo dʋndʋŋa nɛ hɔnɔ, ʋ yie dagɛ namagaba-la bʋbʋɔŋ a pɩba nɛ. Yesu ŋaa pel-duoŋ kɛrɛ Mat.

english_verse: That evening, Jesus said to his disciples, “Let's cross to the east side.”
translation_verse: Chɛɛ-la tɩtɩa dɩdaanɩŋ Yesu bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “Má leŋ dɩ la chol mʋga cholo.”

english_verse: Jesus used many other stories when he spoke to the people, and he taught them as much as they could understand.
translation_verse: Yesu magɛ namagaba yʋgɛ a dɩdagɛ nɩaa. Ʋ yie dagɛba a magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: So they left the crowd, and his disciples started across the lake with him in the boat. Some other boats followed along.
translation_verse: Ba ta nɩ-daŋ-la kala, aŋ kʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la lɛ ʋ fa sɩ hɔnɔ a kɛnʋ baa mʋ. Lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ a mʋmʋ.

english_verse: Suddenly a storm struck the lake. Waves started splashing into the boat, and it was about to sink.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩ pel-duo kʋbala suomo ŋɩŋaa a ŋmoo lɩɩŋ hɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ su.

english_verse: Jesus was in the back of the boat with his head on a pillow, and he was asleep. His disciples woke him and said, “Teacher, don't you care that we're about to drown?”
translation_verse: Ama Yesu fa pɩŋ doŋ nɛ daboro-la harɩŋ a yelli nyuŋ-yelle. Ba kʋ chɩsʋ a bʋla pʋ, “La kʋhɩaŋ, ŋ bɩ jɩŋ dɩ laa chɛ la sʋʋ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus got up and ordered the wind and the waves to be quiet. The wind stopped, and everything was calm.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sii doŋ lɛ a kpɩa pel-la lɛ a bʋla pɩ lɩɩ-pel-la ma dɩ ʋ fɩɛla pɩŋ. Pel-la sigili, ka leriŋ kala ŋaa fʋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jesus asked his disciples, “Why were you afraid? Don't you have any faith?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma? Ma ha bɩ Wɩa laa dii?”

english_verse: Now they were more afraid than ever and said to each other, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba woruŋ, ba pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa paala ŋaa nɩa deeŋ? Peliŋ arɩ lɩɩ-peliŋ kala tuto ʋ niiŋ.”

english_verse: She had said to herself, “If I can just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”
translation_verse: “Dɩ mɩ digi ʋ gɛrɩŋ ma, mɩ jaŋ duori.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛgɛ nɩalɩŋ a mʋ chɩŋ Yesu harɩŋ a kɛŋ nɩsɩŋ a digi ʋ gɛrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus said to the woman, “You are now well because of your faith. May God give you peace! You are healed, and you will no longer be in pain.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ tolo, ŋ Wɩa laa diiniŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋ duori. Mʋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Nyanyalɩɩ-la bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ.”

english_verse: She had gone to many doctors, and they had not done anything except cause her a lot of pain. She had paid them all the money she had. But instead of getting better, she only got worse.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa gɔllɔ ŋaa daalusuŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a na hɛɛŋ woruŋ a paala chei ʋ moribiee kala pɛɩ, ka ʋ nyanyalɩɩ-la wasa bɛsɛ.

english_verse: Then Jesus went inside and said to them, “Why are you crying and carrying on like this? The child isn't dead. She is just asleep.”
translation_verse: Ʋ mʋ jʋʋ a pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ leriŋ kala ŋaa vugumo vugumo ka ma faasaa ŋmoo niiŋ? Bile bɩ sʋba, ʋ pɩŋ doŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples crossed Lake Galilee and came to shore near the town of Gerasa.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sii chol mʋga cholo a kʋ yi Gɛrasɩŋ tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ a lɩɩ lɩɩŋ daboro lɛ.

english_verse: from the graveyard where he had been living. No one was able to tie the man up anymore, not even with a chain.
translation_verse: Baala deeŋ fa hɛ vaamaa tʋɔŋ nɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ wuo kaa vɔɔ, ŋ paala bɩ chɔrʋmɔɔ ma wuo kaa vɔbʋ bibil.

english_verse: He had often been put in chains and leg irons, but he broke the chains and smashed the leg irons. No one could control him.
translation_verse: Ba fa yie kɛŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ vɔɔ ʋ nɩsaa arɩ naasɩŋ ʋ kaa kɛrɛ. Ba yie kɛnʋ hɛ kuruŋ ma, ʋ ta kuru-la yɛrɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ wuo kɛnʋ bil.

english_verse: Night and day he was in the graveyard or on the hills, yelling and cutting himself with stones.
translation_verse: Wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala ʋ yie hɛ vaamaa tʋɔŋ arɩ dundolluŋ nyuŋ a dʋdʋʋrɛ. Ʋ yie dʋʋrɛ vaama-la tʋɔŋ a ŋmuŋmoo niiŋ a kɛŋ tabɩaa pɩpaasɛ ʋ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: When the man saw Jesus in the distance, he ran up to him and knelt down.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ na Yesu dɩ ʋ hɛ dɩ-bolii, ʋ fá mʋ kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ,

english_verse: He shouted, “Jesus, Son of God in heaven, what do you want with me? Promise me in God's name that you won't torture me!”
translation_verse: aŋ faasa ŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “Yesu, Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala Bie, bɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa mɩ lɛ? Mɩ joŋ Wɩa chʋŋʋŋ, sɩ́ mɩ dɔgɩsʋ.”

english_verse: He then begged Jesus not to send them away.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la sʋlʋ kɩŋkɛŋ a bʋl dɩ ʋ sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba lɩɩ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: Over on the hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.
translation_verse: Dɩ toonuŋ ma hɛ lee-la a yʋgɛ a didii kɩaa dundolo nyuŋ.

english_verse: So the evil spirits begged Jesus, “Send us into those pigs! Let us go into them.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ jɩnsɩ-la sʋl Yesu, “Leŋ dɩ la mʋ jʋʋ toonu-la.”

english_verse: Jesus let them go, and they went out of the man and into the pigs. The whole herd of about
translation_verse: Ʋ sɛɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩ baal-la lɛ a mʋ jʋʋ toonu-la. Toonu-la kala sii a fá lɩɩ peel-la nyuŋ tuu tel mʋga tʋɔŋ a nyʋa lɩɩŋ a sʋʋ. Toonu-la fa yi bʋɩ balɩa.

english_verse: The men taking care of the pigs ran to the town and the farms to spread the news. Then the people came out to see what had happened.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ to-daara-la kɛŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ fá mʋ bʋla pɩ bagɩ-daaraa arɩ taŋ-la nɩaa kala. Ba sii kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ba na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had once been full of demons. He was sitting there with his clothes on and in his right mind, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɔ Yesu teeŋ, ba na baal-la jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ fa sɩ kɛnɛ, dɩ ʋ hɔnɔ a laalɛ gɛnnɩŋ a kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Ba sɩ na ŋɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba.

english_verse: Everyone who had seen what had happened told about the man and the pigs.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa baal-la arɩ toonu-la lɛ, ba bʋl wɩɩ-la pɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: Then the people started begging Jesus to leave their part of the country.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kʋ sʋl Yesu dɩ ʋ lɩɩ ba tinteeŋ lɛ.

translation_verse: Dɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɛ bɩ ba nɩsaa sɔmɔ, ba bɩ kɩaa ka dii, arɩ ba naabarɩŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: None of them will eat anything they buy in the market until it is washed. They also follow a lot of other teachings, such as washing cups, pitchers, and bowls.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ lɩɩ yɔbɔ kɔ, ba bɩ kɩaa dii, see dɩ ba sɔŋ ba nɩsaa. Ba naaba wɩaa yʋga ba tuto. Ba kɛŋ wombii dɔŋ nɛ ba sɩɩ tiisi ba nyʋnyʋalʋsʋŋ arɩ ba gbansɩŋ arɩ ba hɔɔŋ pupoyee kala ma.

english_verse: The Pharisees and teachers asked Jesus, “Why don't your disciples obey what our ancestors taught us to do? Why do they eat without washing their hands?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba kʋ pɩɛsɛ Yesu, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ harɩ-tooroo bɩ la naabalɩmaba wombiiŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ ka to? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ba bɩ ba nɩsaa sɔmɔ aŋ didii kɩaa?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: You are nothing but show-offs! The prophet Isaiah was right when he wrote that God had said, “All of you praise me with your words, but you never really think about me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma ŋaa kanfugi tɩmma nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ kala Azaaya fa sɩ bʋla Wɩa doluŋ lɛ a tɩgɛ ma lɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ba ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩ, ‘Nɩaa deemba kɛŋ niiŋ nɛ a zizilmi, ka ba tʋɔŋ lɩɩmɛ.

english_verse: It is useless for you to worship me, when you teach rules made up by humans.”
translation_verse: Ba yie chʋɔlɛmɛ pɛɩ nɛ aa dagɛ nuhuobiine wombiiŋ aŋ bʋl dɩ Wɩa nɛ bʋla.’

english_verse: You disobey God's commands in order to obey what humans have taught.
translation_verse: Ma vɩa Wɩa wombiiŋ nɛ aŋ mɩɩra tuto nuhuobiinee wombiiŋ.”

english_verse: But you let people get by without helping their parents when they should. You let them say that what they own has been offered to God.
translation_verse: Mosis fa ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ama ma-na sɩ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ kʋŋ a magɛ dɩ ʋ joŋo pɛ ʋ nyɩmma koo ʋ naaŋ lɛ, tɩɩna mʋ a bʋla pɩba: Kʋ-la mɩ fa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɛ ma lɛ ŋaa kʋŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ‘Kobaŋ’ nɛ Ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ: Wɩa nɛ tɩɩʋ.

english_verse: You won't let those people help their parents.
translation_verse: Ma bɩra bɩ sɛɩ dɩ nʋʋ ŋaa wɩɩkala pɛ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And you ignore God's commands in order to follow your own teaching. You do a lot of other things just as bad. What Really Makes People Unclean (Matthew
translation_verse: Ma yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ a vɩa Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa aŋ tuto ma naabalɩmaba wombiiŋ a bɩra joŋoo dagɛ ma hambiisiŋ ma. Wʋdosunu-la yʋga nɛ ma sɩɩ ŋaa.” Kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ Mat.

english_verse: Then Jesus said: What comes from your heart is what makes you unclean.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩa tʋɔŋ a kʋʋ lɩɩ, ba nɛ yie leŋ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.

english_verse: Jesus called the crowd together again and said, “Pay attention and try to understand what I mean.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra yɩrɛ nɩ-daŋ ba kɔ ʋ teeŋ, ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Má kala jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ woruŋ a jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ sɩaa.

english_verse: After Jesus and his disciples had left the crowd and gone into the house, they asked him what these sayings meant.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ leŋ nɩ-daŋ-la aŋ jʋʋ dɩa, ʋ harɩ-tooroo pɩɛsʋ namaga-la bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: He answered, “Don't you know what I am talking about by now? You surely know that the food you put into your mouth cannot make you unclean.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Ma ha bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛɛ? Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ nʋʋ nɛ dii kʋŋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ?

english_verse: It doesn't go into your heart, but into your stomach, and then out of your body.” By saying this, Jesus meant that all foods were fit to eat.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ dii kʋŋ, ʋ bɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ ka tuu see ŋ luoruŋ, a bɩra to ŋ yaraa lɩɩ.”

english_verse: All of these come from your heart, and they are what make you unfit to worship God. A Woman's Faith (Matthew
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba kala yie lɩɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ a leŋ ŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.” Siiria tɩŋŋaa haala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii Mat.

english_verse: The woman replied, “Lord, even puppies eat the crumbs that children drop from the table.”
translation_verse: Haal-la bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ bɩ jaŋ joŋ hambiisiŋ kʋdiilee a pɩ vasɩŋ. Ama hambiisi-la sɩɩ dii kɩalɩŋ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ tel tinteeŋ nɛ, vasɩ-la ma jaŋ paa dii.”

english_verse: Jesus left and went to the region near the town of Tyre, where he stayed in someone's home. He did not want people to know he was there, but they found out anyway.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii a lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ Taaya arɩ Saadɔŋ tinteeŋ a jʋʋ hɛ dɩa kʋbala lɛ a bɩ chɛ dɩ nʋʋkala jɩŋ ʋ wɩaa, ka ba vɩa aŋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: A woman whose daughter had an evil spirit in her heard where Jesus was. And at once she came and knelt down at his feet.
translation_verse: Haal kʋbala ma nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, jɩŋ-bɔŋ kɛŋ ʋ tolo. Ʋ sɩ nɩɩ Yesu wɩaa ʋ sii kɔ a tel ʋ naasɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The woman was Greek and had been born in the part of Syria known as Phoenicia. She begged Jesus to force the demon out of her daughter.
translation_verse: Haal-la fa ŋaa Giriik tɩɩna nɛ, ka ba lʋlʋ Fɔnɩɩsɩa sɩ hɛ Siiria tinteeŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la sʋl Yesu dɩ ʋ kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la ʋ tolo lɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “The children must first be fed! It isn't right to take away their food and feed it to dogs.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Leŋ dɩ hambiisiŋ laa sɩpaaŋ dii kɩaa vɔgɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ wombii ŋaa dɩ la joŋ hambiisiŋ kʋdiilee yuo pɩ vasɩŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “That's true! You may go now. The demon has left your daughter.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ haal-la, “A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa, jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la lɩɩ ŋ tolo lɛ nɛ. Mʋ dɩa.”

english_verse: When the woman got back home, she found her child lying on the bed. The demon had gone. Jesus Heals a Man Who Was Deaf and Could Hardly Talk
translation_verse: Haal-la viiri. Ʋ mʋa dɩ ʋ tolo-la pɩna, jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la lɩɩ ʋ lɛ. Yesu vaarɛ taŋɩŋ

english_verse: Jesus left the region around Tyre and went by way of Sidon toward Lake Galilee. He went through the land near the ten cities known as Decapolis.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mɩɩra lɩɩ Taaya tinteeŋ lɛ a mʋ to Sɩdɔŋ arɩ tasɩŋ fii tinteeŋ a mʋ yi Galilii mʋga.

english_verse: Some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly talk. They begged Jesus just to touch him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩ taŋɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba kɛnʋ kaa kɔ a sʋl Yesu dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: After Jesus had taken him aside from the crowd, he stuck his fingers in the man's ears. Then he spit and put it on the man's tongue.
translation_verse: Yesu kɛnʋ kaa lɩɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ba dʋndʋŋa balɩa hɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ ʋ neniee a kaa mʋ tʋʋ ʋ dɩgɩlaa lɛ aŋ tʋ nantʋɔrʋŋ hɛ ʋ nandelimiŋ lɛ,

english_verse: Jesus looked up toward heaven, and with a groan he said, “Effatha!” which means “Open up!”
translation_verse: aŋ wʋla beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ aŋ faasa wiesi fir aŋ bʋl baal-la lɛ, “Ɛfata.” Ɛfata bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ: Kaa suri.

english_verse: At once the man could hear, and he had no more trouble talking clearly.
translation_verse: Baal-la dɩgɩlaa suri. Ʋ nandelimiŋ ma bɩrɩmɛ. Ʋ bʋbʋl wɩaa woruŋ.

english_verse: Jesus told the people not to say anything about what he had done. But the more he told them, the more they talked about it.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ dɩ ba sɩ́ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa ʋ sɩ sɩ dɩ ba sɩ́ wɩɩ-la bʋla pɩ nɩaa, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba ma fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a bʋl wɩɩ-la gaara bal.

english_verse: They were completely amazed and said, “Everything he does is good! He even heals people who cannot hear or talk.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ba hirigi a bʋl, “Wɩɩ na-kala nɛ ʋ ŋɩŋaa woruŋ. Ʋ paala ŋaa taŋɩŋ dɩgɩlaa suri nɛ ʋ nɩnɩɩ wɩaa a bʋbʋl wɩaa.”

english_verse: Then Jesus explained clearly what he meant. Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that.
translation_verse: Ʋ chaasa bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ pɩba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta kɛnʋ kaa sʋʋsa lɩɩ, a kpɩa ʋ lɛ, arɩ ʋ sɩ́ ŋɩɩ bʋl.

english_verse: “I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat.
translation_verse: “Mɩ beŋ nɩaa deemba nenige kɛmmɛ nɛ. Ba hɛ mɩ teeŋ tapʋlaa batori nɛ ŋ-la, ba bɩ kʋdiilee na dɩ ba dii.

english_verse: Some of them live a long way from here. If I send them away hungry, they might faint on their way home.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ bɩ kʋŋ die, ka dɩ mɩ bʋl dɩ ba viiri, ba jaŋ mʋ yiegi wombiiŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ dɩ-bolii nɛ.”

english_verse: After Jesus told the crowd to sit down, he took the seven loaves and gave thanks. He then broke the loaves and handed them to his disciples, who passed them out to the crowd.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ tuu hɔŋ tinteeŋ. Ka ʋ joŋ boroboroba-la balɩpɛ a lɔllɛ Wɩa, aŋ kaa chɔgɛ chɔgɛ, a pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo dɩ ba laa kpaa nɩalɩŋ. Ba laa kpaaba.

english_verse: They also had a few little fish, and after Jesus had blessed these, he told the disciples to pass them around.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba kɛŋ chenfil-biisiŋ ma mʋa. Ʋ joŋ ba ma a lɔllɛ Wɩa aŋ ŋaa ʋ harɩ-tooroo laa kpaa nɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: he got into the boat with the disciples and crossed to the territory near Dalmanutha. A Sign from Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ taba aŋ kɛŋ ʋ harɩ-tooroo ba mʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro a mʋ Dalimanuuta tinteeŋ. Farisii tɩŋŋaa ka chɛ dɩ Yesu ŋaa wʋmagɩlɩŋ Mat.

english_verse: The Pharisees came out and started an argument with Jesus. They wanted to test him by asking for a sign from heaven.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ sii kɔ aa chɛ dɩ ba magɩsɛ Yesu a kʋ kɛŋ wɩaa lɩlɛrɛ a bʋl, “Ŋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ, ŋaa wʋmagɩl dɩ la na a jɩŋ arɩ ŋ dol-la lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: The disciples had forgotten to bring any bread, and they had only one loaf with them in the boat.
translation_verse: Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo sɩ duoro chol mʋga cholo ŋɩɩ, ʋ harɩ-tooroo liisi arɩ ba yʋ ba kʋdiilee ta nɛ, aŋ joŋ boroboro kʋbala dʋndʋŋ a hɛ ba lɩɩŋ daboro tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, “Why are you talking about not having any bread? Don't you understand? Are your minds still closed?
translation_verse: Yesu jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ bʋl a pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma bʋbʋl, ‘La bɩ boroboro kɛnɛ?’ Ma sɩaa ha bɩ naa, koo ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ? Ɛɛ nɛ ma tʋɔŋ dol ŋɩɩ?

english_verse: how many baskets of leftovers you picked up when I fed those
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ boroboroba banɔŋ nɛ a chɔgɔ kpaa baalaa bʋɩ banɔŋ. Ma sɩ paa kʋkaanaa, sinsiŋ baŋmɛɛ nɛ?” Ba sɩ, “Sinsiŋ fii arɩ balɩa.”

english_verse: Jesus took him by the hand and led him out of the village, where he spit into the man's eyes. He placed his hands on the blind man and asked him if he could see anything.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ nyʋlʋŋ-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ a kaa lɩɩ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ a tʋ nantʋɔrʋŋ hɛ ʋ sɩaa lɛ a joŋ ʋ nɩsaa daŋ ʋ lɛ aŋ pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ na leriŋ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: The man looked up and said, “I see people, but they look like trees walking around.”
translation_verse: Ʋ beŋ leriŋ aŋ bʋl, “Mɩɩ na nɩaa nɛ, ama ba nagɛ tɩɩsɩŋ nɛ aa gɔllɛ.”

english_verse: Once again Jesus placed his hands on the man's eyes, and this time the man stared. His eyes were healed, and he saw everything clearly.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra joŋ ʋ nɩsaa daŋ ʋ sɩaa lɛ. Baal-la faasa chaarɛ sɩaa woruŋ, ʋ sɩaa bɩra nɩna ʋ na kʋŋkala woruŋ.

english_verse: Jesus said to him, “You may return home now, but don't go into the village.” Who Is Jesus? (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Mʋ dɩa, bɩra sɩ́ taŋ tʋɔŋ jʋʋ.” Pɩɩta sɩ dɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa Kirisito Mat.

english_verse: Jesus warned the disciples not to tell anyone about him. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Pɩɩta sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, Yesu bʋla pɩba arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ dɩ ba pɔ dɩ ba sɩ́ wɩɩ-la bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala. Yesu bʋl ʋ sʋʋŋ wɩaa Mat.

english_verse: Jesus began telling his disciples what would happen to him. He said, “The nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses will make the Son of Man suffer terribly. He will be rejected and killed, but three days later he will rise to life.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu suomo dɩdagɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la, “Mɩ-na, Nuhuobiine Bie jaŋ na hɛɛŋ woruŋ. Nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba, ba kala jaŋ vɩamɛ aŋ ŋaa dɩ ba kpʋmɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ kpʋmɛ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa tapʋlaa batori aŋ bɩra sii sʋʋŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: But when Jesus turned and saw the disciples, he corrected Peter. He said to him, “Satan, get away from me! You are thinking like everyone else and not like God.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩrɩma beŋ ʋ harɩ-tooroo aŋ kpɩa Pɩɩta lɛ a bʋl, “Sɩtaanɩ, mʋ nɩmɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ bʋl, nuhuobiine wombiiŋ nɛ, Wɩa wombiiŋ dee.”

english_verse: Jesus then told the crowd and the disciples to come closer, and he said: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala ba kɔ, ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ tomi, see dɩ ʋ vɩa ʋ tɩtɩa wombiiŋ aŋ joŋ ʋ daagɛsɛ baasɛ a tomi.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me and for the good news, you will save it.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ vɩa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ vɩa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa arɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ sɛnɛ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself?
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ tɩɩ dʋnɩa kala aŋ bɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kɛnɛ, bɛɛ kʋŋ nyʋʋrɩɩ nɛ ŋ na?

english_verse: What could you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ saa ŋ jaŋ wuo joŋo lenni ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ?

english_verse: Don't be ashamed of me and my message among these unfaithful and sinful people! If you are, the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ leŋe dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛnʋ a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa arɩ mɩ wʋbʋlaa wɩaa, ma lɛɛlɛ nɩaa deemba sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka fá a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tʋɔŋ, mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie ma jaŋ leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛnʋ dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ arɩ mɩ nyɩmma tʋla a pɛ ʋ tɩndaaraa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: I can assure you that Elijah has already come. And people treated him just as they wanted to, as the Scriptures say they would. Jesus Heals a Boy (Matthew
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ Ɩlaaja paala kɔ nɛ. Ba ŋaaʋ ŋɩɩ kala ba sɩɩ chɛ. Ba fa ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.” Yesu kiri jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ bie lɛ Mat.

english_verse: After Jesus and the disciples had gone back home and were alone, they asked him, “Why couldn't we force out that demon?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo jʋʋ dɩa. Ba lʋara pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ la-na bɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la wuo kiri?”

english_verse: Then Jesus asked a child to stand near him. He put his arm around the child and said,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ bii-bie a kaa kʋ bil ba tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ a guoru aŋ bʋla pɩba,

english_verse: And his clothes became much whiter than any bleach on earth could make them.
translation_verse: Ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kala pʋllɛ kɩŋkɛŋ a tʋtʋl. Gɛrɩ-chɛsɩrʋ kala bɩ jaŋ wuo chɛsɛ gɛnnɩŋ dɩ ba pʋlla nagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Then Elijah and Moses appeared and were talking with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɩlaaja arɩ Mosis kʋ lɩɩ ba sɩpaaŋ a chɩna bʋbʋl wɩaa Yesu teeŋ.

english_verse: The shadow of a cloud passed over and covered them. From the cloud a voice said, “This is my Son, and I love him. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ kʋ tɔba. Ka yikoro lɩɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la tʋɔŋ a bʋbʋl, “Mɩ Bii-chooluŋ nɛ ŋ-la. Má jegile nɩɩ ʋ teeŋ.”

english_verse: At once the disciples looked around, but they saw only Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba guu beŋ leriŋ, ba bɩ nʋʋkala na see Yesu dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: So they kept it to themselves. But they wondered what he meant by the words “raised from death.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sɛɩ a kɛŋ wɩɩ-la ba tʋɔŋ lɛ aŋ pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Sʋʋŋ lɛ siiniŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ bɛɛ?”

english_verse: The disciples asked Jesus, “Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say that Elijah must come before the Messiah does?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsɛ Yesu, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba bʋl arɩ Ɩlaaja nɛ jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ kɔ, aŋ ka dɩ Wɩa Bie-na kɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: Elijah certainly will come to get everything ready. But don't the Scriptures also say that the Son of Man must suffer terribly and be rejected?
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, Ɩlaaja jaŋ sɛnɛ laa sɩpaaŋ kɔ a kɛŋ kʋŋkala wasa bil. Ba saa ŋmʋnsa bil Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie lɛ dɩ mɩ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ, dɩ ba jaŋ bemmi a nagɛ nɩpɛɩ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ?

english_verse: When Jesus and his three disciples came back down, they saw a large crowd around the other disciples. The teachers of the Law of Moses were arguing with them.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɔ ʋ harɩ-tooroo kʋkaana-la leriŋ, ba na dɩ nɩaa yʋga a hilimi nɩmɛ. Ba dɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba kɛŋ wɩaa lɩlɛrɛ.

english_verse: They brought the boy, and as soon as the demon saw Jesus, it made the boy shake all over. He fell down and began rolling on the ground and foaming at the mouth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ bile kaa kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la sɩ kʋ na Yesu, ʋ kɛŋ bile terigi, ʋ tuu tel tinteeŋ a bibilimi, nantʋɔ-fʋnfʋga kʋ tɔ ʋ niiŋ.

english_verse: “When you welcome even a child because of me, you welcome me. And when you welcome me, you welcome the one who sent me.” For or against Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: “Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ bii-bie deeŋ dɔŋɔ woruŋ a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa, mɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ woruŋ ŋɩɩ. Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ kɛmmɛ woruŋ, mɩ dʋndʋŋa dee ʋ kɛŋ woruŋ ŋɩɩ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ ma nɛ ʋ kɛŋ woruŋ ŋɩɩ.” Baala kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ Luuk

english_verse: The crowd was really surprised to see Jesus, and everyone hurried over to greet him.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ na Yesu dɩ ʋʋ kɔ, ba guu hirigi a sii fá a mʋ chemu a chʋɔlʋ.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “What are you arguing about?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma hilimi ŋɩɩ a kaa lɩlɛrɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You people don't have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy to me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Ma lɛɛlɛ nɩaa, ma bɩ Wɩa laa dii. Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ a diene magɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ nyalɩmɛ a diene magɛ? Má kɛŋ bile kaa kɔ mɩ teeŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked the boy's father, “How long has he been like this?” The man answered, “Ever since he was a child.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛ ʋ nyɩmma, “Wɩɩŋ deeŋ sɩ jʋʋ diene magɛ ɛɛ nɛ?” Ʋ bʋl, “Ʋ hambiiriŋ kala lɛ nɛ ʋ suomi.

english_verse: At once the boy's father shouted, “I do have faith! Please help me to have even more.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ bile nyɩmma sii chɩŋ a faasa bubunsi, “Mɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ, ama ʋ bɩ yʋgɛ. Pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ mɩ laaʋ dii a yʋgɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw that a crowd was gathering fast, he spoke sternly to the evil spirit that had kept the boy from speaking or hearing. He said, “I order you to come out of the boy! Don't ever bother him again.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ na dɩ nɩ-daŋ fa kʋ hihilimiba, ʋ kpɩa jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la lɛ, “Jɩŋ-taŋɩɩ, mɩ nɛ bʋla, kʋ lɩɩ bile lɛ. Pʋpɔ dɩ ŋ maachie bɩra sɩ́ ʋ jʋʋ.”

english_verse: The spirit screamed and made the boy shake all over. Then it went out of him. The boy looked dead, and almost everyone said he was.
translation_verse: Jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la chɩɩrɛ aŋ kɛnʋ faasa terigi aŋ lɩɩ ʋ lɛ, ka bile nagɛ dɩ ʋ sʋba. Nɩalɩŋ jesiŋ kala bʋl, “Bile sʋba nɛ.”

english_verse: But Jesus took hold of his hand and helped him stand up.
translation_verse: Ama Yesu mʋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a chʋʋlɛ ʋ sii chɩŋ.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Only prayer can force out this kind of demon.” Jesus Again Speaks about His Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Nʋʋkala bɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ wuo kire tɩta, see ʋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa woruŋ.” Yesu bɩra bʋl ʋ sʋʋŋ wɩaa Mat.

english_verse: Jesus left with his disciples and started through Galilee. He did not want anyone to know about it,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sii lɩɩ lee-la a mʋ to Galilii tinteeŋ. Yesu bɩ cho dɩ nʋʋkala jɩŋ lee-la ʋ sɩ hɛ,

english_verse: because he was teaching the disciples that the Son of Man would be handed over to people who would kill him. But three days later he would rise to life.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ʋʋ dagɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo nɛ arɩ ba jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ-na, Nuhuobiine Bie a hɛ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ, ka dɩ ʋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: The disciples did not understand what Jesus meant, and they were afraid to ask. Who Is the Greatest? (Matthew
translation_verse: Ama ba fa bɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ aŋ fɩfá fawʋllʋŋ dɩ ba pɩɛsʋ. Yesu harɩ-tooroo chɛ dɩ ba jɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ kʋhɩaŋ Mat.

english_verse: If your foot causes you to sin, chop it off. You would be better off to go into life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.
translation_verse: Lee-la nanchʋɔlaa jaŋ dii ŋ yaraa deeŋ deeŋ ba bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ, ka nyiŋ-la ma bɩ jaŋ dɩsɛ.]

english_verse: The worms there never die, and the fire never stops burning.
translation_verse: Lee-la nanchʋɔlaa jaŋ dii ŋ yaraa deeŋ deeŋ ba bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ, ka nyiŋ-la ma bɩ jaŋ dɩsɛ.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples went to his home in Capernaum. After they were inside the house, Jesus asked them, “What were you arguing about along the way?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sii kɔ Kapɛnam. Ba sɩ jʋʋ dɩa, Yesu pɩɛsɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma fa kaa lɩlɛrɛ ŋɩɩ wombiiŋ lɛ?”

english_verse: They had been arguing about which one of them was the greatest, and so they did not answer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tɔrɛ ba niiŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fa kɛŋ ba tʋɔŋ kʋhɩaŋ wɩaa nɛ lɩlɛrɛ.

english_verse: After Jesus sat down and told the twelve disciples to gather around him, he said, “If you want the place of honor, you must become a slave and serve others!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu hɔŋ aŋ yɩrɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la fii arɩ balɩa a bʋla pɩba, “Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma tʋɔŋ kʋhɩaŋ, see dɩ ʋ kʋ ŋaa ma tʋɔŋ hambie a tɩmaa pɩ ma kala.”

english_verse: Everyone must be salted with fire.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala na hɛɛŋ aŋ-na na wʋzɔmʋŋ.

english_verse: Salt is good. But if it no longer tastes like salt, how can it be made salty again? Have salt among you and live at peace with each other.
translation_verse: Yɩsɩŋ sɩma, ama dɩ ʋ nɛ sɛbɩsɛ, ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ ʋ sɩŋ. Má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ sɩŋ, arɩ yɩsɩŋ sɩ sɩma ŋɩɩ, aŋ kala kɛŋ nii-bala.”

english_verse: John said, “Teacher, we saw a man using your name to force demons out of people. But he wasn't one of us, and we told him to stop.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ bʋla pɩ Yesu, “La Kʋhɩaŋ, la na baal kʋbala dɩ ʋʋ kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɩaa lɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. La kiru dɩ ʋ sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ la dɔŋɔ ŋaa.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: Don't stop him! No one who works miracles in my name will soon turn and say something bad about me.
translation_verse: Ama Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má sɩ́ ʋ kiru. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere kala mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, ʋ chie bɩra bɩ jaŋ chei mɩ yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Anyone who isn't against us is for us.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ la harɩŋ lɩa, ʋ ŋaa la dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: And anyone who gives you a cup of water in my name, just because you belong to me, will surely be rewarded. Temptations To Sin (Matthew
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ joŋ gbaŋa ŋaa lɩɩŋ a pɩ ma kʋŋ a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ tomi wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ laa ʋ time. Wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ hɛ wʋbɔmʋŋ lɛ Mat.

english_verse: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ na hambiisi-la sɩɩ tomi dɔŋɔ a nyɩsʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ, dɩ ba nɛ joŋ nɔmʋŋ a vɔɔ laalɛ ʋ baŋŋaa lɛ a joŋu yuo hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ kpɩa ʋ sɩ weye.

english_verse: If your eye causes you to sin, get rid of it. You would be better off to go into God's kingdom with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ sɩɩŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ kɛnɩŋ hɛ wʋbɔmʋŋ lɛ, lɩɩsa ta. Ŋ sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ arɩ sɩɩ-togo, ʋ nɛ kpɩa ba sɩ joŋuŋ yuo hɛ Wɩa nyiniŋ lɛ arɩ sɩaa balɩa.

english_verse: After Jesus left, he went to Judea and then on to the other side of the Jordan River. Once again large crowds came to him, and as usual, he taught them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii a lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ Judiya tinteeŋ a chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la. Nɩ-daŋ bɩra hilimi ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ bɩra dagɛba arɩ ʋ sɩ yie dagɛba ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: A woman who divorces her husband and marries again is also unfaithful.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Matthew
translation_verse: Dɩ haala ma nɛ vɩa ʋ bala aŋ ma bɩra mʋ jaa baal dɔŋ, haal-la ma ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ nɛ.” Yesu joŋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ hambiisiŋ lɛ Mat.

english_verse: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. So they came up to him and asked if it was right for a man to divorce his wife.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ ma sii kɔ ʋ teeŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba magɩsʋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ sɩ vɩa ŋ haala, ʋ kɛŋ wombiiŋ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus asked them, “What does the Law of Moses say about this?”
translation_verse: Yesu mɩɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Ɛɛ nɛ Mosis dagɛma dɩ ma tuto?”

english_verse: They answered, “Moses allows a man to write out divorce papers and send his wife away.”
translation_verse: Ba bʋl, “Mosis sɩ dɩ baala nɩɩ chɛ ʋ vɩa ʋ haala, dɩ ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ a ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ haal-la aŋ-na vɩaʋ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Moses gave you this law because you are so heartless.
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Ma tʋɔŋ dolie, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Mosis ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ pɩma.

english_verse: But in the beginning God made a man and a woman.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa sɩ bugumo ŋaa dʋnɩa, nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa, ba ŋaa baal arɩ haal nɛ.

english_verse: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ baala jaŋ leŋ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ dɩa [aŋ ka ʋ dɩ ʋ haala mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ].

english_verse: He becomes like one person with his wife. Then they are no longer two people, but one.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba balɩa jaŋ kɛŋ chal-bala. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɩaa balɩa, see kʋbala.

english_verse: And no one should separate a couple that God has joined together.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ saa Wɩa sɩ kaa mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ nuhuobiine kaa pɔrɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples were back in the house, they asked him about what he had said.
translation_verse: Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo mɩɩra sii jʋʋ dɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra pɩɛsʋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: He told them, “A man who divorces his wife and marries someone else is unfaithful to his wife.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Baal-na kala sɩ vɩa ʋ haala aŋ bɩra jaa dɔŋɔ, ʋ ŋaa bachɔrʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Some people brought their children to Jesus so he could bless them by placing his hands on them. But his disciples told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Nɩaa sii kɔ Yesu teeŋ a kɛŋ ba hambiisiŋ kaa kɔ, dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ ba lɛ a sʋl Wɩa pɩba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo kpɩa ba lɛ.

english_verse: I promise you that you cannot get into God's kingdom, unless you accept it the way a child does.”
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, dɩ ŋ bɩ Wɩa to a nagɛ hambie sɩ yie to ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw this, he became angry and said, “Let the children come to me! Don't try to stop them. People who are like these little children belong to the kingdom of God.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ na ŋɩɩ, ʋ na baanɩŋ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la nyuŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Má leŋ dɩ hambiisi-la kɔ mɩ teeŋ, má sɩ́ ba kiru. Nɩaa deemba doho nɛ hɛ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Jesus looked closely at the man. He liked him and said, “There's one thing you still need to do. Go sell everything you own. Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come with me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu beŋ ʋ sɩaa lɛ a chou aŋ bʋla pʋ, “Wʋbala nɛ ka, ŋ ha bɩ ŋaa. Joŋ ŋ kɩaa kala yallɛ a joŋ moribie-la a pɩ summoo aŋ kʋ tomi. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ kɩaa Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: When the man heard Jesus say this, he went away gloomy and sad because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaa baal-la sɩaa biri, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ kɛŋ kɩaa nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ tʋɔŋ chei, ʋ sii viiri.

english_verse: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “It's hard for rich people to get into God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu beŋ nɩaa aŋ mɩɩra bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “Ʋ ŋaa wʋduo nɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa sɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: The disciples were shocked to hear this. So Jesus told them again, “It's terribly hard to get into God's kingdom!
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ harɩ-tooro-la hirigi. Ʋ saa mɩɩra bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ biiri, ʋ ŋaa wʋduo nɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa sɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ hɛɩ arɩ bʋntaŋŋa sɩ jaŋ wuo to gɛrɩ-hɛmɩŋ bʋa lɩɩ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛyɛ ŋɩɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa sɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus' disciples were even more amazed. They asked each other, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ harɩ-tooro-la faasa hirigi a pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Ʋ nɛ nagɛ ŋɩɩ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa Wɩa jaŋ laa ta?”

english_verse: Jesus looked at them and said, “There are some things that people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Yesu mɩɩra bemba aŋ bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kperi nuhuobiine, ʋ bɩ Wɩa wuo kperi. Wɩa wuo wɩɩkala ŋaa nɛ.”

english_verse: The disciples were confused as Jesus led them toward Jerusalem, and his other followers were afraid. Once again, Jesus took the twelve disciples aside and told them what was going to happen to him. He said:
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɩ ba hɛ wombiiŋ lɛ nɛ a mʋmʋ Jerusalɛm. Yesu laa ba sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ harɩ-tooroo hirigi, fawʋllʋŋ ma kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ to ba harɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu kɛŋ ʋ harɩ-tooroo dʋndʋŋa a sʋʋsa lɩɩ, a bʋla pɩba wɩɩ-la kala nɩaa sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ a bʋl,

english_verse: We are now on our way to Jerusalem where the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses. They will sentence him to death and hand him over to foreigners,
translation_verse: “Má jegili mɩ teeŋ. Laa mʋ Jerusalɛm nɛ. Dɩ la nɛ yi nɩmɛ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie kaa mʋ pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba. Ba jaŋ diimi sarɩya a bʋl dɩ ʋ maga dɩ mɩ sʋʋ nɛ, aŋ kɛmmɛ kaa mʋ hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ.

english_verse: Jesus asked them what they wanted,
translation_verse: Yesu pɩɛsɛba, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ maa chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa pɩma?”

english_verse: and they answered, “When you come into your glory, please let one of us sit at your right side and the other at your left.”
translation_verse: Ba bʋl, “Ŋ sɩ jaŋ dii Wɩa kuorii-la a kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ a hɔŋ ŋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ, leŋ la ŋaa ŋ bʋbʋɔŋ hʋhɔnnɔɔ, dɩ dɔŋɔ hɔŋ ŋ nadiiŋ, dɩ dɔŋɔ ma hɔŋ ŋ nagʋa.”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “You don't really know what you're asking! Are you able to drink from the cup that I must soon drink from or be baptized as I must be baptized?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Ma bɩ jɩŋ kʋ-la ma sɩɩ chɛ. Ma jaŋ wuo nyalɩma na hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ naa? Ma jaŋ wuo fo Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ arɩ ba sɩ jaŋ fomi ŋɩɩ koo?”

english_verse: “Yes, we are!” James and John answered. Then Jesus replied, “You certainly will drink from the cup from which I must drink. And you will be baptized just as I must!
translation_verse: Ba sɩ, “Oo, la jaŋ wuo.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ma bʋl. Hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ na, ʋ-nɛ ma ma jaŋ na. Ba sɩ jaŋ fomi Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ foma ma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But it isn't for me to say who will sit at my right side and at my left. This is for God to decide.”
translation_verse: Ama mɩ nadiiŋ arɩ mɩ nagʋa hʋhɔnnɔ-la, mɩ dee bɩ jaŋ tʋɔsɛba. Wɩa nɛ jaŋ lɩɩsɛba dɩ ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: When the ten other disciples heard this, they were angry with James and John.
translation_verse: Yesu harɩ-tooroo fii-la sɩ ka a nɩɩ wɩɩ-la Jeems arɩ Jɔɔŋ sɩ bʋla, ba na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: But Jesus called the disciples together and said: You know that those foreigners who call themselves kings like to order their people around. And their great leaders have full power over the people they rule.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu yɩrɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo kala, ba mʋ ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma jɩma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa kuoroo yie joŋ wɩaa a nyagɛ ba nɩaa bil nɛ. Ba kʋhɩasɩŋ ma didii doluŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: And if you want to be first, you must be everyone's slave.

translation_verse: Mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie, mɩ bɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ chɛ nɩaa dɩ ba tɩma pɩmɛ, mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ-na tɩma pɩba nɛ a joŋ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ yɔɔ sʋʋŋ, a laa nɩ-daŋ mɩɩsɩŋ pɩba.” Yesu vaarɛ nyʋlɩma Mat.

translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kʋ yi taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Jeriko. Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo sɩ sie dɩ ba lɩɩ taŋ-la lɛ, nɩ-daŋ to ba harɩŋ. Ba kala mʋmʋ dɩ nyʋlɩma hɔŋ wombiiŋ niiŋ. Ʋ ŋaa sʋllʋ nɛ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Batimeyas a ŋaa Timeyas nanʋala.

english_verse: When he heard that it was Jesus from Nazareth, he shouted, “Jesus, Son of David, have pity on me!”

translation_verse: Nɩaa yʋga a kpɩa ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ goŋ, ama ʋ faasa yɩrɛ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, “Yesu, Devit nihiŋ, fá mɩ nenige.”

english_verse: Jesus stopped and said, “Call him over!” They called out to the blind man and said, “Don't be afraid! Come on! He is calling for you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu chɩŋ aŋ bʋl, “Má yɩrʋ dɩ ʋ kɔ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba yɩrɛ nyʋlʋŋ-la a bʋla pʋ, “Nyɩrɛ ŋ bɔyɛ aŋ sii kɔ. Ʋʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ.”

translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ chɛ mɩ ŋaa a pɩŋ?” Nyʋlʋŋ-la bʋl, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, leŋ dɩ mɩ sɩaa suri dɩ mɩ nɩna.”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “You may go. Your eyes are healed because of your faith.” At once the man could see, and he went down the road with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ tɩɩ ŋ duori. Mʋmʋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sɩaa guu suri, ʋ tuto Yesu harɩŋ.

translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala Yesu sɩ sɩ ba bʋl. Ba sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ba leŋ ba puro mʋ.

english_verse: The disciples led the donkey to Jesus. They put some of their clothes on its back, and Jesus got on.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ kaku-bie-la kaa mʋ pɩ Yesu a wuri ba gɛnnɩŋ a daŋ kaku-bie-la nyuŋ. Yesu jɩla hɔŋ.

translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ hɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ, dɔnsʋŋ maa to ʋ harɩŋ. Ba kala faasa ŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “Tabarɩkala! Wɩa jaŋ pɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ kɔ La Tɩɩna Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples: Have faith in God!

translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ yi Jerusalɛm, Yesu jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a yɩyallɛ kɩaa, dɔnsʋŋ ma yʋyɔɔ kɩaa. Yesu kiri ba kala ta ba lɩɩ. Baalaa ma hɛ nɩmɛ a yɩyɛrɛ moribiee. Yesu ŋmoo ba teebʋlba lo. Baalaa dɔnsʋŋ ma yɩyallɛ kokosuŋ, ʋ ŋmoo ba ma kpasɩnɩŋ a lo.

translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ bɩ wɩaa joŋo chɛ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa, ma Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ, ʋ ma bɩ jaŋ joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛma.]” Nɩaa pɩɛsɛ Yesu ʋ doluŋ wɩaa Mat.

translation_verse: La saa jaŋ wuo bʋl ʋ lɩɩ nuhuobiinee teeŋ nɛɛ? Aɩ.” Fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ chɩŋ nɩmɛ wɩaa. Nɩaa bʋla arɩ Jɔɔŋ fa sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ.
