translation_verse: Ba mɩɩra mʋ aŋ tɩŋ Farisii tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ arɩ Hɛrɔd harɩ-tooroo dɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba bɩra mʋ Yesu teeŋ a magɩsʋ a bɛrɛ kɛnʋ.

english_verse: They went to him and said, “Teacher, we know that you are honest. You treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are. And you teach the truth about what God wants people to do. Tell us, should we pay taxes to the Emperor or not?”
translation_verse: Ba kɔ ʋ teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “La Kʋhɩaŋ, la jɩma dɩ ŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ŋ sɩpaa tuo nʋʋ lɛ. Ŋ bɩ nɩbal sɩɩŋ ka fá. Ŋŋ dagɛ Wɩa wombii-tɩtɩɩ-la nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa wombiiŋ nɛ dɩ la tiŋ lampoo a pɩ Rom tinteeŋ kuoru-balɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Siiza koo ʋ bɩ wombii ŋaa?

english_verse: They brought him a silver coin, and he asked, “Whose picture and name are on it?” “The Emperor's,” they answered.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ dɔŋɔ kaa kɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Kʋbɛɛ nyuŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ? Kʋbɛɛ yɩrɩŋ ma nɛ ba tuuro hɛ moribii-la lɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Siiza yɩrɩŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Then Jesus told them, “Give the Emperor what belongs to him and give God what belongs to God.” The men were amazed at Jesus. Life in the Future World (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Tɔɔ, má joŋ Rom tinteeŋ kuoru-balɩŋ kɩaa pʋ aŋ joŋ Wɩa ma kɩaa pʋ.” Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ba niiriŋ kala maa. Ba pɩɛsɛ Yesu a tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba lɛ Mat.

english_verse: But they cheat widows out of their homes and pray long prayers just to show off. They will be punished most of all. A Widow's Offering (Luke
translation_verse: Ba yie kɛŋ yo-haalaa kɩaa laa didii, a fugo chʋɔlɛ Wɩa didieni. Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii ba sarɩya, ba nɛ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ a kɩɩ ba dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa kala.” Yo-haala joŋ ʋ moribiiŋ kala a pɩ Wɩa Luuk

english_verse: The Sadducees did not believe that people would rise to life after death. So some of them came to Jesus and said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Saduusi tɩŋŋaa, kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Saduusi tɩŋŋaa yie bʋl dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sʋba, ʋ bɩra bɩ sii. Ba pɩɛsʋ wɩaa a bʋl,

english_verse: Jesus answered: You are completely wrong! You don't know what the Scriptures teach. And you don't know anything about the power of God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Ma bɩ Wɩa teniŋ jɩŋ. Ma bɩ Wɩa doluŋ ma jɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ma yeŋŋi.

english_verse: When Jesus saw that the man had given a sensible answer, he told him, “You are not far from God's kingdom.” After this, no one dared ask Jesus any more questions. About David's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: Yesu na dɩ baal-la kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ dɩ Wɩa kuorii-la bɩ bol.” Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ wuo pɩɛsʋ wɩɩkala. Yesu dagɛ nɩaa a tɩgɛ Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa lɛ Mat.

english_verse: One of the teachers of the Law of Moses came up while Jesus and the Sadducees were arguing. When he heard Jesus give a good answer, he asked him, “What is the most important commandment?”
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba dɔŋɔ nɩɩ ba sɩ kɛŋ wɩɩ-la lɩlɛrɛ. Ʋ kɔ ba teeŋ. Ʋ sɩ na dɩ Yesu chaarɛ wɩaa sɩaa woruŋ, ʋ pɩɛsʋ, “Wɩa niiri-la ba sɩ dagɛ nɩaa ba tuto, kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa ba tʋɔŋ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ wɩɩŋ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The most important one says: ‘People of Israel, you have only one Lord and God.
translation_verse: Yesu bʋl, “Ba tʋɔŋ sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la, Iziral tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ: ‘La Tɩɩna Wɩa ŋaa kʋbala nɛ.

english_verse: You must love him with all your heart, soul, mind, and strength.’
translation_verse: Cho ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa arɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ, ŋ doluŋ arɩ ŋ wɩɩwɩɩ kala.’

english_verse: The second most important commandment says: ‘Love others as much as you love yourself.’ No other commandment is more important than these.”
translation_verse: Wʋlɩamɩŋ ma nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Cho ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna arɩ ŋ sɩ cho ŋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ.’ Wɩa niiri-la tʋɔŋ, wɩɩkala tuo a kɩɩ wɩaa deemba balɩamɩŋ.”

english_verse: The man replied, “Teacher, you are certainly right to say there is only one God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ kerichi-la bʋla pʋ, “La kʋhɩaŋ, wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ŋ bʋl ŋɩɩ. Wɩa ŋaa kʋbala nɛ, kʋŋkala bɩra tuo see ʋ dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: Jesus was sitting in the temple near the offering box and watching people put in their gifts. He noticed that many rich people were giving a lot of money.
translation_verse: Yesu mʋ hɔŋ lee-la nɩaa sɩ joŋ ba moribiee bil a pɩpɩ Wɩa a nɩna ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ hɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa, ba faasa hɩhɛ moribiee.

english_verse: Everyone else gave what they didn't need. But she is very poor and gave everything she had. Now she doesn't have a cent to live on.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ joŋ moribiee a pɩ Wɩa, ba lɩɩsa aŋ ka nɛ. Aŋ ka ʋ-na joŋ ʋ summu moribiiŋ kala a hɛ, kʋ-la kala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he said, “How can the teachers of the Law of Moses say the Messiah will come from the family of King David?
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra dɩdagɛ nɩaa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ a pɩɛsɛba, “Ɛɛ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, jaŋ ŋaa Devit doho nʋʋ?

english_verse: If David called the Messiah his Lord, how can the Messiah be his son?” The large crowd enjoyed listening to Jesus teach. Jesus Condemns the Pharisees and the Teachers of the Law of Moses (Matthew
translation_verse: Devit tɩtɩa yɩrɛ nɩa deeŋ ʋ Tɩɩna nɛ. Ɛɛ nɛ saa ʋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa ʋ nihiŋ dʋndʋŋ?” Yesu sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa, nɩaa yʋga a jegile nɩɩ ʋ teeŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Yesu dagɛ nɩaa dɩ ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa woruŋ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba lɛ Mat.

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching, he said: Guard against the teachers of the Law of Moses! They love to walk around in long robes and be greeted in the market.
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra dagɛba, “Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba lɛ. Ba yie gʋgɔllɛ yɔbɔ lɛ arɩ ba gɛrɩ-duduosuŋ aa chɛ dɩ nɩaa zizilba a chʋchʋɔlɛba.

english_verse: They like the front seats in the synagogues and the best seats at banquets.
translation_verse: Ba yie chɩchɛ nɩbalaa dɩhɔnʋŋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ yɩrɛba dɩ ba kʋ dii kɩaa, ba cho dɩ ba hɔŋ nɩbalaa dɩ-hɔnɔɔ ma.

english_verse: Finally, a poor widow came up and put in two coins worth only a few pennies.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ yo-haal kʋbala ma kɔ. Ʋ ŋaa summu nɛ a ma joŋ amiisimba balɩa a hɛ. Kɔbʋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples to gather around him. Then he said: I tell you that this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
translation_verse: Yesu yɩrɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo a bʋla pɩba, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, yo-haala deeŋ moribii-bie-la ʋ sɩ joŋo hɛ nɛ kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ moribie-la kala.

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, look at these beautiful stones and wonderful buildings!”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ kʋʋ lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo dɔŋɔ bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, na tabɩa-la ba sɩ kaa saa dɩa-la sɩ zɔmɔ ŋɩɩ, dɩɩsɩ-la ma kala zɔŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Do you see these huge buildings? They will certainly be torn down! Not one stone will be left in place.” Warning about Trouble (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ na dɩɩ zɔŋŋɔɔ deemba? Ba jaŋ ŋmoo ba kala lo. Ba bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tabɩɩ-bala ma ka daŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ lɛ.” Hɛɛ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ Mat.

english_verse: Jesus answered: Watch out and don't let anyone fool you!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ ma nyɩsʋ.

english_verse: Many will come and claim to be me. They will use my name and fool many people.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a kɔ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ a bʋl ba nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, a nyɩsɛ nɩ-daŋ.

english_verse: Later, as Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives across from the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew came to him in private.
translation_verse: Ba mʋ jɩl peel kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Olif, a hɔŋ ʋ nyuŋ, a chaasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. Pɩɩta, Jeems, Jɔɔŋ arɩ Anduru lʋara pɩɛsʋ,

english_verse: Someday you will see that “Horrible Thing” where it should not be. Everyone who reads this must try to understand! If you are living in Judea at that time, run to the mountains.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ na dɩ ba joŋ kʋ-la sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ aa chei leriŋ a bil lee-la ʋ sɩ bɩ maga ʋ hɛ. Kʋa deeŋ jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ʋ jaŋ chei Wɩa yɩrɩŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ na ŋɩɩ, má leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ, dɩ ba fá jɩl peelee nyuŋ a faa.

english_verse: When you hear about wars and threats of wars, don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but that isn't the end.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ nɩɩ arɩ laalɩŋ hɛ daha a hɛ dɩ-bolii ma, ama má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma bɔyɛ joŋ. Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa bal, ama dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ ha dee ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: This will be the worst time of suffering since God created the world, and nothing this terrible will ever happen again.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa a kʋʋ lɩɩ jɩnɩŋ, nʋʋkala ha bɩ hɛɛŋ deeŋ na a nagɛ ŋɩɩ, nʋʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: They asked, “When will these things happen? What will be the sign that they are about to take place?”
translation_verse: “Bʋa bɛɛ lɛ nɛ wɩaa deemba jaŋ ŋaa? Wʋbɛɛba nɛ la jaŋ na, ka dɩ wɩaa deemba-na ŋaa?” Dagɛla.

english_verse: Nations and kingdoms will go to war against each other. There will be earthquakes in many places, and people will starve to death. But this is just the beginning of troubles.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa jaŋ sii a mʋ a yuo tinteeŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa. Taŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ nɩaa jaŋ sii gire mʋ yuo kuoro dɔŋɔ arɩ ʋ nɩaa. Tinteeŋ jaŋ zigili leree yʋgɛ, dɩ losuŋ ma jʋʋ. Wɩaa deemba kala ŋaa hɛɛŋ dɩ-suomuŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Be on your guard! You will be taken to courts and beaten with whips in their synagogues. And because of me, you will have to stand before rulers and kings to tell about your faith.
translation_verse: Ama má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ. Ba jaŋ kɛmma kaa mʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa teeŋ dɩ ba dii ma sarɩya. Ba jaŋ ŋmooma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ma jaŋ chɩŋ kuoroo arɩ taŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa a ŋaa mɩ pɛ-naaraa.

english_verse: But before the end comes, the good news must be preached to all nations.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ba laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala, ka dɩ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ na yi.

english_verse: When you are arrested, don't worry about what you will say. You will be given the right words when the time comes. But you will not really be the ones speaking. Your words will come from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ kɛmma kaa mʋ dɩ ba diima sarɩya, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma bɔɩsɩŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ bʋl a laa ma tɩtɩa lɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa jaŋ joŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a hɛ ma nyuŋ lɛ. Wɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɔ ma nyuŋ, má bʋl. Ma dee bɩ jaŋ bʋl, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la nɛ jaŋ bʋl.

english_verse: Brothers and sisters will betray each other and have each other put to death. Parents will betray their own children, and children will turn against their parents and have them killed.
translation_verse: Naambiiriŋ jaŋ kɛŋ dɔŋɔ kaa mʋ pa dɩ ba kpʋ. Nyɩmmaba ma jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ba biiriŋ lɛ. Biiriŋ ma jaŋ kɛsɛ ba nyɩmmaba arɩ ba naamba, a kaa mʋ pa dɩ ba kpʋ.

english_verse: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you keep on being faithful right to the end, you will be saved. The Horrible Thing (Matthew
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala jaŋ bɛrɛma a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa. Ama nʋʋkala sɩ nyalɩma a mʋ dɛrɛ, Wɩa jaŋ laaʋ ta.” Yesu bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ kʋ-la sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ aa chei leriŋ sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ Mat.

english_verse: If you are on the roof of your house, don't go inside to get anything.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala hɛ lusuŋ nyuŋ a nɩɩ wɩaa deemba, dɩ ʋ nɛ kʋ tuu, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ ʋ dɩa jʋʋ a chɩchɛ ʋ paa ʋ kɩaa.

english_verse: If the Lord doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of his chosen and special ones, he will make the time shorter.
translation_verse: Dɩ La Tɩɩna fa bɩ tapʋlɩa-la kere ta, nɩbala ma fa bɩ jaŋ ka. Ama nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ baa tou, ba wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ʋ keri tapʋlɩa-la ta.

english_verse: If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ baga lɛ a nɩɩ wɩaa deemba, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ dɩa a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ gɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: It will be an awful time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ luoruŋ arɩ haala-la sɩ nɔgɛ biiriŋ, oi, ba jaŋ na hɛɛŋ yʋgɛ.

english_verse: Pray that it won't happen in winter.
translation_verse: Má sʋl Wɩa dɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ sɩ́ waarɩŋ bʋa lɛ ŋaa.

english_verse: But be on your guard! That's why I am telling you these things now. When the Son of Man Appears (Matthew
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩma nɛ, ka dɩ bʋa-la-na yi. Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ.” Yesu bʋla pɩ nɩaa dɩ ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ Mat.

english_verse: So when you see all these things happening, you will know that the time has almost come.
translation_verse: Namaga deeŋ lɛ ma jaŋ gʋnnɛ wɩaa. Dɩ ma nɛ na wɩaa deemba kala dɩ baa ŋaa, ma jɩŋ dɩ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie kɔɔnʋŋ kpaga nɛ.

english_verse: The sky and the earth will not last forever, but my words will. No One Knows the Day or Time (Matthew
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala jaŋ lɛl, ama wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla bɩ jaŋ lɛl. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ chɛɛ-la wɩaa deemba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Mat.

english_verse: The stars will fall, and the powers in the sky will be shaken.”
translation_verse: Chɛnwʋlaa jaŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ tuu a titel. Ba jaŋ kiri wɩa-nyuŋ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ba lɩɩ ba leree.

english_verse: Learn a lesson from a fig tree. When its branches sprout and start putting out leaves, you know summer is near.
translation_verse: Má gʋnnɛ wɩɩŋ a lɩɩ sɔjaamɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ma nɛ na ʋ kʋʋ tɔsɛ, ma jɩma arɩ lɩmbaŋa yie nɛ.

english_verse: Then the Son of Man will be seen coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ na mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie, dɩ mɩ to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tʋɔŋ kʋʋ tuu. Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ yʋgɛ a chaanɛ.

english_verse: He will send his angels to gather his chosen ones from all over the earth. A Lesson from a Fig Tree (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ Wɩa tɩndaaraa dɩ ba mʋ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala a kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ baa tou a hilimi. Yesu bʋl sɔjaamɩŋ wɩaa Mat.

english_verse: No one knows the day or the time. The angels in heaven don't know, and the Son himself doesn't know. Only the Father knows.
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ chɛɛ-la lɛ koo bʋa-la lɛ wɩaa deemba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa. Wɩa tɩndaaraa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ ma paala bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ. Mɩ-na Wɩa Bie ma bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ, see mɩ Nyɩmma dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: So be alert! You don't know when the master of the house will come back. It could be in the evening or at midnight or before dawn or in the morning.
translation_verse: Má saa pɔ woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma bɩ jɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ dɩa-la tɩɩna sɩ jaŋ kɔ, dɩ dɩdaanɩŋ nɛɛ, dɩ tɩta-siesee nɛɛ, dɩ sɩɩpʋʋraa nɛɛ, koo chʋchʋɔŋ nɛɛ, ma bɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: So watch out and be ready! You don't know when the time will come.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ a pɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa chɛɛ-la jɩŋ.

english_verse: You can be sure that some of the people of this generation will still be alive when all this happens.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, ma lɛɛlɛ nɩaa deemba sɩ hɛ ma mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ, ka dɩ wɩaa deemba ŋaa.

english_verse: But if he comes suddenly, don't let him find you asleep.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ guu kɔ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɔ dɩ ma pɩŋ doŋ.

english_verse: It is like what happens when a man goes away for a while and places his servants in charge of everything. He tells each of them what to do, and he orders the guard to keep alert.

translation_verse: Paalɩt chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa dɩ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Ʋ lɩɩsɛ Barabas ta pɩba aŋ leŋ ba vɩɩrɛ Yesu aŋ kɛnʋ mʋ kpaasa daagɛsɛ nyuŋ. Laalɩyuoroo mɔŋ Yesu Mat.

english_verse: On it was a sign that told why he was nailed there. It read, “This is the King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ sɩ Yesu ŋaa wɩalɩŋ chei, ba ŋmʋnsa mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ-la lɛ a bʋl, “JUU TƖŊŊAA KUORO NƐ Ŋ-LA.”

english_verse: They yelled, “Nail him to a cross!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala faasa kpɩa, “Leŋ dɩ ba kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ.”

english_verse: It was about nine o'clock in the morning when they nailed him to the cross.
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩa magɛ ji-looluŋ, ka ba kpaasʋ daagɛsɛ-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: A Roman army officer was standing in front of Jesus. When the officer saw how Jesus died, he said, “This man really was the Son of God!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔ kʋhɩaŋ kʋbala fa chɩŋ Yesu sɩpaaŋ a pɔʋ. Ʋ sɩ na Yesu dɩ ʋ wiesi ʋ wiesi katɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, baala deeŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bii nɛ.”

english_verse: The soldiers led Jesus inside the courtyard of the fortress and called together the rest of the troops.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoroo kɛnʋ lɩɩ ba kuoru-balɩŋ dɩa kaala tʋɔŋ a yɩrɛ ba laalɩyuoroo dɔnsʋŋ kala. Ba kala kʋ hilimi.

english_verse: And at that time there was a prisoner named Barabbas. He and some others had been arrested for murder during a riot.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma fa hɛ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa lɛ, ba fa hɛ yuosuŋ nɛ a kpʋ nɩaa. Ba kɛmba kaa mʋ tɔ dɩa, ba dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Barabas.

english_verse: The crowd now came and asked Pilate to set a prisoner free, just as he usually did.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa yʋgɛ a gire mʋ Paalɩt teeŋ a bʋl dɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ vɛnɛɛ ŋaa pɩba.

english_verse: Pilate asked them, “Do you want me to free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Paalɩt pɩɛsɛba, “Ma cho dɩ mɩ lɩɩsɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa kuoru-la nɛ ta pɩmaa?”

english_verse: Pilate knew that the chief priests had brought Jesus to him because they were jealous.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa jɩma arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ yaraa bieri nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛŋ Yesu a kɔ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Then Pilate asked the crowd, “What do you want me to do with this man you say is the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt bɩra pɩɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ, “Aŋ ka baal-la ma, ma sɩɩ yɩrɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa kuoro, bɛɛ nɛ ma sɩ mɩ ŋaa ʋ lɛ?”

english_verse: When the soldiers had finished making fun of Jesus, they took off the purple robe. They put his own clothes back on him and led him off to be nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mɔŋ ʋ lɛ a dɛrɛ, ba wuri gɛrɩ-fɩaŋ-la aŋ paa ʋ tɩtɩa gɛnnɩŋ a laalʋ, a kɛnʋ kaa lɩɩ wombiiŋ dɩ ba kɛnʋ kaa mʋ kpaasa mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ. Ba kpaasɛ Yesu mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ Mat.

english_verse: Simon from Cyrene happened to be coming in from a farm, and they forced him to carry Jesus' cross. Simon was the father of Alexander and Rufus. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kʋ lɩɩ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ba cheŋ baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Saamɔŋ. Ʋ jaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Siriini. Ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa Alɛkɩzanda arɩ Rufas nyɩmma. Ʋ lɩɩ baga a jʋjʋʋ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ, ba kɛnʋ a fʋgʋ ʋ laa daagɛsɛ-la a baasɛ.

english_verse: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses also made fun of Jesus. They said to each other, “He saved others, but he can't save himself.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩ-la arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba, ba ma sisieri Yesu lɛ a bʋlaa pɩ dɔŋɔ, “Ʋ wuo nɩaa laa tɩta nɛ aŋ bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa wuo laa ta.

english_verse: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead, and he called in the army officer to find out if Jesus had been dead very long.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt guu hirigi, ʋ sɩ nɩa arɩ Yesu daŋa sʋba. Ʋ yɩrɛ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔ kʋhɩaŋ-la a pɩɛsʋ dɩ ʋ na Yesu daŋa sʋba nɛɛ.

english_verse: A man named Joseph from Arimathea was brave enough to ask Pilate for the body of Jesus. Joseph was a highly respected member of the Jewish council, and he was also waiting for God's kingdom to come.
translation_verse: baal kʋbala ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Josef, a lɩɩ Arɩmatɩya. Ʋ fa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilimi a vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa dɔŋɔ nɛ. Nɩaa zizilu. Ʋ ma fa gbɛrɛ Wɩa kuorii-la nɛ dɩ ʋ kɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩdaaŋ-la ʋ mʋ Paalɩt teeŋ arɩ bɔɩ-duoŋ a sʋl Yesu kʋsʋʋŋ.

english_verse: The soldiers took Jesus to Golgotha, which means “Place of a Skull.”
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ Yesu kaa mʋ lee kʋbala, baa yɩrɛ Gɔlɩgɔta. Yɩrɩ-la bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ nyu-kuŋkogulo.

english_verse: They nailed Jesus to a cross and gambled to see who would get his clothes.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ Yesu a kpaasɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kpaa. Ba tɔnsɔ nɛ a jɩŋ gɛrɩ-la nʋʋkala jaŋ laa.

english_verse: People who passed by said terrible things about Jesus. They shook their heads and shouted, “Ha! So you're the one who claimed you could tear down the temple and build it again in three days.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ to nɩmɛ bɩbal, ba tʋtʋʋsʋ aŋ kɛŋ ba nyuŋ chuchugisi a bʋl, “Oi, ŋ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ sɩ ŋ jaŋ ŋmoo la Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lo aŋ bɩra wuo saaʋ tapʋlaa batori pɛgɛ.

english_verse: If he is the Messiah, the king of Israel, let him come down from the cross! Then we will see and believe.” The two criminals also said cruel things to Jesus. The Death of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, Juu tɩŋŋaa kuoro, leŋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ daa-la nyuŋ kʋ tuu dɩ la na a laa ʋ wɩaa dii.” Nɩalɩŋ balɩa ma ba sɩ kpaasa a pɛ Kirisito lɛ, ba ma tʋʋsʋ. Yesu sʋba Mat.

english_verse: After the officer told him, Pilate let Joseph have Jesus' body.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔ kʋhɩaŋ-la bʋla pʋ arɩ ʋ sʋba nɛ, ʋ pɩ Josɛf wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ mʋ sori Yesu kʋsʋʋŋ.

english_verse: About noon the sky turned dark and stayed that way until around three o'clock.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ kʋ magɛ nyu-gbaŋa, leriŋ kala biri lim a mʋ yi dɩdaanɩŋ kerifi batori.

english_verse: Then about that time Jesus shouted, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, my God, why have you deserted me?”
translation_verse: Kerifi batori-la lɛ Yesu faasa ŋmoo niiŋ a bʋl, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakɩtanɩ.” Ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ: “Mɩ Wɩa, mɩ Wɩa, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ vɩamɛ ta?”

english_verse: Some of the people standing there heard Jesus and said, “He is calling for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ fa chɩŋ nɩmɛ a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Má jegili, Ɩlaaja nɛ ʋ yɩyɩrɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: One of them ran and grabbed a sponge. After he had soaked it in wine, he put it on a stick and held it up to Jesus. He said, “Let's wait and see if Elijah will come and take him down!”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ dɔŋɔ fá mʋ joŋ suosuo a kaa mʋ yuu sɩnɩŋ sɩ nyala a joŋo tuu daaŋ lɛ, a kaa mʋ hɛ Yesu niiŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ nyʋa. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ bʋl, “Má leŋu nɩmɛ, má leŋ la gbɛrɛ a na arɩ Ɩlaaja jaŋ kʋ soru daa-la nyuŋ koo.”

english_verse: Some women were looking on from a distance. They and many others had come with Jesus to Jerusalem. But even before this they had been his followers and had helped him while he was in Galilee. Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of the younger James and of Joseph were two of these women. Salome was also one of them. Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Haalaa deemba kala faa to Yesu harɩŋ nɛ a pɩpɛ ʋ lɛ Galilii lɛ. Haala-la ma sɩ to Yesu harɩŋ a kɔ Jerusalɛm fa yʋga a hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba hugi Yesu Mat.

english_verse: It was now the evening before the Sabbath, and the Jewish people were getting ready for that sacred day.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la dɩ ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a gbɛrɛ ba chɛ-wiesii-la, ʋ dɩdaanɩŋ nɛ,

english_verse: Joseph bought a linen cloth and took the body down from the cross. He had it wrapped in the cloth, and he put it in a tomb that had been cut into solid rock. Then he rolled a big stone against the entrance to the tomb.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf mʋ yɔɔ gɛrɩpɛ-pʋla a sori Yesu kʋsʋʋŋ a kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛɛ-la bɛʋ a joŋu hugi bʋbʋa ba sɩ lɔsɔ lɛ, a bilimi tabɩɩ-balɩŋ tɔ bʋa-la niiŋ.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph were watching and saw where the body was placed.
translation_verse: Mɛɛrɩ Magɩdalɩŋ arɩ Joozis naaŋ Mɛɛrɩ ma hɛ nɩmɛ a na lee-la ba sɩ joŋu hugi.

english_verse: Later, Jesus appeared in another form to two disciples, as they were on their way out of the city.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ baalaa balɩa sii lɩɩ a joŋ wombiiŋ a mʋmʋ taŋ dɔŋ. Ba sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, Yesu bɩra kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa bɩrɩmɛ nagɩna dɔŋ a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛba.

english_verse: Then the disciples left and preached everywhere. The Lord was with them, and the miracles they worked proved that their message was true. ANOTHER OLD ENDING TO MARK'S GOSPEL
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo sii lɩɩ a mʋ lee na-kala a bʋbʋl Wɩa wɩaa. La Tɩɩna Wɩa pɛ ba lɛ ba ŋɩŋaa wʋmagɩlaa, dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ bʋl ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: She left and told his friends, who were crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mʋ bʋla pɩ Yesu harɩ-tooroo wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa. Ʋ mʋa dɩ ba hɔnɔ yiyel.

english_verse: Very early on Sunday morning, just as the sun was coming up, they went to the tomb.
translation_verse: Lahadi chɛɛŋ chʋchʋɔŋ, wɩa sɩ pɔsɔ, ba sii mʋ Yesu vaamɩŋ leriŋ.

english_verse: On their way, they were asking one another, “Who will roll the stone away from the entrance for us?”
translation_verse: Ba sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, ba pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo bilimi tabɩɩ-la sɩ tɔ bʋa-la niiŋ ta?”

english_verse: But when they looked, they saw that the stone had already been rolled away. And it was a huge stone!
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋ kpagɛ bʋa-la leriŋ, ba na dɩ ba kɛŋ tabɩɩ-la suri bʋa-la niiŋ a bilime ta. Tabɩɩ-la fa yʋga nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: The women went into the tomb, and on the right side they saw a young man in a white robe sitting there. They were alarmed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ jʋʋ bʋa-la a na bapʋɔsɩ-bie dɩ ʋ hɔŋ bʋa-la tʋɔŋ nadiiŋ a laalɛ gɛrɩ-pʋla. Fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba.

english_verse: Now go and tell his disciples, and especially Peter, that he will go ahead of you to Galilee. You will see him there, just as he told you.”
translation_verse: Má mʋ bʋla pɩ Pɩɩta arɩ Yesu harɩ-tooroo, arɩ Yesu jaŋ laa ma sɩpaaŋ a mʋ Galilii. Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ nɩmɛ, ma jaŋ naʋ arɩ ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pɩma.”

english_verse: They will handle snakes and will drink poison and not be hurt. They will also heal sick people by placing their hands on them. Jesus Returns to Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ wuo kukori dɩŋŋaa, a nyʋa daalusuŋ sɩɩ kpʋ nɩaa, ka ʋ bɩ jaŋ ŋaaba wɩɩkala. Ba jaŋ wuo joŋ ba nɩsaa a daŋ nyanyal tɩŋŋaa lɛ dɩ ba duori.”

english_verse: But when these disciples told what had happened, the others would not believe either. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mɩɩra kʋ bʋla pɩ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la kʋkaanaa wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa. Ama ba bɩ ba ma laa dii.

english_verse: Anyone who believes me and is baptized will be saved. But anyone who refuses to believe me will be condemned.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii a leŋ ba fou Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, Wɩa jaŋ laaʋ ta, ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ mɩ wɩaa laa dii, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pʋ.

english_verse: After the Lord Jesus had said these things to the disciples, he was taken back up to heaven where he sat down at the right side of God.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ, Wɩa joŋu a kaa mʋ Wɩa-jaŋ, ʋ hɔŋ Wɩa nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: Afterwards, Jesus appeared to his eleven disciples as they were eating. He scolded them because they were too stubborn to believe the ones who had seen him after he had been raised to life.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la fii arɩ kʋbala hɔnɔ didii kɩaa. Ba sɩɩ dii ŋɩɩ, Yesu kpɩaba lɛ a tɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ sɩ dolie wɩaa arɩ ba sɩ bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɩ ba naʋ dɩ ʋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ laa dii.

english_verse: Then he told them: Go and preach the good news to everyone in the world.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Má mʋ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ-na kala a bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nʋʋ na-kala.

english_verse: Everyone who believes me will be able to do wonderful things. By using my name they will force out demons, and they will speak new languages.
translation_verse: Wʋmagɩlaa deemba nɛ ma jaŋ wuo na a jɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii. Ba nɛ ŋ-la: Ba jaŋ wuo kikiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ wuo bʋbʋl yikori dosunuŋ.

english_verse: Many people have tried to tell the story of what God has done among us.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Luuk nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ ŋ-na mɩ nandɔŋɔ Tɩafɩlos. Nɩaa yʋga a hɛ doluŋ a ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa la sɩɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They wrote what we had been told by the ones who were there in the beginning and saw what happened.
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ kala nɩaa sɩ bʋla pɩla nɛ. Ba nɛ na wɩaa deemba kala a suomi bumbuŋ kala, a ma bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa a pɩpɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: So I made a careful study of everything and then decided to write and tell you exactly what took place. Honorable Theophilus,
translation_verse: Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, mɩ pɩa na wɩaa deemba kala nɛ woruŋ, a lɩɩ ba dɩ-suomuŋ. Mɩ na dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ vɛŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩŋ.

english_verse: I have done this to let you know the truth about what you have heard. An Angel Tells about the Birth of John
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmʋnsaa pɩŋ dɩ ŋ wuo jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ dagɩŋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Ba bʋl Jɔɔŋ Wɩa lɩɩ-fooro lʋlʋŋ wɩaa

english_verse: When Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest by the name of Zechariah from the priestly group of Abijah. His wife Elizabeth was from the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Hɛrɔd fa sɩ ŋaa Judiya tinteeŋ kuoro, dɩ baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Zɛkarɩya fa hɛ nɩmɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɔŋɔ. Ba fa kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kaa kpaa kpaa nɛ, Zɛkarɩya fa pɛ baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Abija nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Zɛkarɩya haala yɩrɩŋ nɛ Ɛlɩzabɛt. Ʋ ma fa ŋaa Arɔŋ doho nʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Both of them were good people and pleased the Lord God by obeying all that he had commanded.
translation_verse: Zɛkarɩya arɩ ʋ haala kala fa ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma nɛ. Ba faa to Wɩa niiriŋ arɩ ʋ wʋdagaa nɛ woruŋ a bɩ wʋcheeli kala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: But they did not have children. Elizabeth could not have any, and both Zechariah and Elizabeth were already old.
translation_verse: Ba fa bɩ bii kala lʋla, bɛɛ wɩaa Ɛlɩzabɛt fa ŋaa hapɩrɩ nɛ, ka ʋ dɩ ʋ bala Zɛkarɩya kala hɩɛsɛ.

english_verse: One day Zechariah's group of priests were on duty, and he was serving God as a priest.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zɛkarɩya arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔsʋŋ tapʋlʋŋ yi dɩ ba tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ vɛnɛɛ tɩŋ.

english_verse: According to the custom of the priests, he had been chosen to go into the Lord's temple that day and to burn incense,
translation_verse: Ba tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ, ba yie tɔnsɛ nɛ a lɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ. Ba tɔnsɛ a lɩɩsɛ Zɛkarɩya, ʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la.

english_verse: All at once an angel from the Lord appeared to Zechariah at the right side of the altar.
translation_verse: Zɛkarɩya sɩ nyɩgɛ nyiniŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ Wɩa tɩndaara kɔ ʋ teeŋ a chɩŋ koru-la sɛmɛ nadiiŋ.

english_verse: Zechariah was confused and afraid when he saw the angel.
translation_verse: Zɛkarɩya naʋ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ ʋ chichel.

english_verse: But the angel told him: Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God has heard your prayers. Your wife Elizabeth will have a son, and you must name him John.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bʋla pʋ, “Zɛkarɩya, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ. Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ sʋl Wɩa chɩchɛ, ʋ joŋo pɩŋ nɛ. Ŋ haala Ɛlɩzabɛt jaŋ lʋl baal. Ŋ jaŋ hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Jɔɔŋ.

english_verse: His birth will make you very happy, and many people will be glad.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ. Nɩ-daŋ ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ ʋ lʋlʋŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Your son will be a great servant of the Lord. He must never drink wine or beer, and the power of the Holy Spirit will be with him from the time he is born.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa nɩbal La Tɩɩna teeŋ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ nyʋnyʋa sɩ-duo kala. Ba jaŋ lʋlʋ, dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: John will lead many people in Israel to turn back to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa yʋgɛ a bɩrɩma to ba Tɩɩna Wɩa.

english_verse: He will go ahead of the Lord with the same power and spirit that Elijah had. And because of John, parents will be more thoughtful of their children. And people who now disobey God will begin to think as they ought to. This is how John will get people ready for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ a kɛŋ doluŋ arɩ Ɩlaaja fa sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ biiriŋ arɩ ba nyɩmmaba kala mɩɩra sɩŋ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa ka to, dɩ ba bɩrɩmɛ a to tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wombiiŋ a leŋ dɩ nɩaa ŋaa siri a gbɛrɛ ba Tɩɩna.”

english_verse: Zechariah said to the angel, “How will I know this is going to happen? My wife and I are both very old.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zɛkarɩya pɩɛsɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la, “Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa a jɩŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ? Mɩ ŋaa banɩhɩaŋ nɛ, mɩ haala ma hɩɛsɛ.”

english_verse: The angel answered, “I am Gabriel, God's servant, and I was sent to tell you this good news.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Gebiral a hɔŋ Wɩa sɛmɛ. Ʋ nɛ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ bʋl wʋzɔmʋŋ deeŋ a pɩŋ.

english_verse: You have not believed what I have said. So you will not be able to say a thing until all this happens. But everything will take place when it is supposed to.”
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ jaŋ ŋaa, aŋ ka ŋ bɩ laa dii. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ŋ bɩra bɩ wɩaa jaŋ wuo bʋl, see tapʋlɩɩ-la sɩ yie dɩ wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: The crowd was waiting for Zechariah and kept wondering why he was staying in the temple so long.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ka gbɛrɛ Zɛkarɩya kaala-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ kperiba wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ʋ didieni ŋɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: When he did come out, he could not speak, and they knew he had seen a vision. He motioned to them with his hands, but did not say a thing.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la viiri, aŋ ka Zɛkarɩya kʋ lɩɩ kaala nɩalɩŋ teeŋ. Ʋ bɩ wɩaa wuo bʋla pɩba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa a bʋl wɩaa ba teeŋ. Ʋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa wuo bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ, ba jɩŋ arɩ ʋ na wɩaa a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ nɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: When Zechariah's time of service in the temple was over, he went home.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zɛkarɩya tɩntɩŋŋaa tapʋlaa dɛrɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. Ʋ mɩɩra mʋ ʋ dɩa.

english_verse: Soon after this, his wife was expecting a baby, and for five months she did not leave the house. She said to herself,
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ diene, ka ʋ haala Ɛlɩzabɛt kɛŋ luoruŋ. Ʋ sɩ kɛŋ luoruŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ dɩa lɛ lɩa chɛnsɩŋ banɔŋ.

english_verse: “What the Lord has done for me will keep people from looking down on me.” An Angel Tells about the Birth of Jesus
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl, “Wɩa diene nɛ aŋ lɛɛlɛ pɛ mɩ lɛ ŋ-la. Ʋ tɔ mɩ hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.” Ba bʋl Yesu lʋlʋŋ wɩaa

english_verse: One month later God sent the angel Gabriel to the town of Nazareth in Galilee
translation_verse: Ɛlɩzabɛt sɩ kɛŋ luoruŋ ʋ chɛnsɩŋ balɩdʋ lɛ, Wɩa bɩra tɩŋ ʋ tɩndaara Gebiral dɩ ʋ mʋ Galilii tinteeŋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Nazarɛt.

english_verse: with a message for a virgin named Mary. She was engaged to Joseph from the family of King David.
translation_verse: Ʋ tɩmʋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ tɩndaarɩŋ mʋ pɩ hatolo kʋbala ha sɩ bɩ baal jɩŋ baa yɩrɛ Mɛɛrɩ. Ʋ faa chɛ dɩ ʋ jaa baal kʋbala nɛ baa yɩrɛ Josɛf. Josɛf fa ŋaa kuoro Devit doho nʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: The angel greeted Mary and said, “You are truly blessed! The Lord is with you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la kɔ ʋ teeŋ a chʋɔlʋ aŋ bʋla pʋ, “Wɩa cho ŋ wɩaa nɛ a pɛ ŋ lɛ woruŋ.”

english_verse: Mary was confused by the angel's words and wondered what they meant.
translation_verse: Mɛɛrɩ sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ bʋla pʋ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ. Ʋ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla bʋbʋɔŋ bɩbɩɩnɛ.

english_verse: Then the angel told Mary, “Don't be afraid! God is pleased with you,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bʋla pʋ, “Mɛɛrɩ, Wɩa cho ŋ wɩaa, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ.

english_verse: and you will have a son. His name will be Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ luoruŋ a lʋl hambolibie, a hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Yesu.

english_verse: He will be great and will be called the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make him king, as his ancestor David was.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa nɩbal. Ba jaŋ kɛnʋ yɩrɛ Wɩɩ-balɩŋ Bie. Wɩa jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ arɩ ʋ naabalɩma Devit fa sɩ dii kuoruŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: He will rule the people of Israel forever, and his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ Jekɔb doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ʋ kuoruŋ bɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ da.”

english_verse: Mary asked the angel, “How can this happen? I am not even married!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mɛɛrɩ bʋla pɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la, “Mɩ ha bɩ baal jɩŋ. Ɛɛ nɛ saa wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa?”

english_verse: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come down to you, and God's power will come over you. So your child will be called the holy Son of God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bʋla pʋ, “Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ jaŋ kʋ hɛ ŋ lɛ. Ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ luoruŋ Wɩa doluŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa bile jaŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna. Ba kɛnʋ yɩyɩrɛ Wɩa Bie.

english_verse: Your relative Elizabeth is also going to have a son, even though she is old. No one thought she could ever have a baby, but in three months she will have a son.
translation_verse: Na ŋ naambie Ɛlɩzabɛt sɩ hɩɛsa ŋɩɩ. Ba sɩ ʋ bɩ bii wuo lʋl, aŋ ka ʋ kɛŋ luoruŋ ʋ chɛnsɩŋ balɩdʋ nɛ ŋ-la.

english_verse: Nothing is impossible for God!”
translation_verse: Wɩɩkala bɩ Wɩa wuo kperi.”

english_verse: Mary said, “I am the Lord's servant! Let it happen as you have said.” And the angel left her. Mary Visits Elizabeth
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mɛɛrɩ bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ. Leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ ŋaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la taʋ aŋ viiri. Mɛɛrɩ mʋ chʋɔlɛ Ɛlɩzabɛt

english_verse: A short time later Mary hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mɛɛrɩ sii lɩma lɩma a mʋ dɩ ʋ chʋɔlɛ Ɛlɩzabɛt ʋ jaŋ lɛ. Ʋ fa hɛ Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ, lee-la peelee sɩ yʋga.

english_verse: She went into Zechariah's home, where she greeted Elizabeth.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ yi nɩmɛ, ʋ mʋ jʋʋ Zɛkarɩya dɩa a mʋ chʋɔlɛ ʋ haala Ɛlɩzabɛt.

english_verse: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, her baby moved within her. The Holy Spirit came upon Elizabeth.
translation_verse: Ʋ laa Mɛɛrɩ chʋɔlaa. Ʋ sɩ laa ŋɩɩ, bile sɩ hɛ ʋ luoruŋ lɛ sii bɩrɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ hɛ Ɛlɩzabɛt lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Then in a loud voice she said to Mary: God has blessed you more than any other woman! He has also blessed the child you will have.
translation_verse: Ʋ faasa bʋla pɩ Mɛɛrɩ, “Wɩa pɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ a kɩɩ haalaa kala. Wɩa jaŋ pɛ bile ŋ sɩ jaŋ lʋl lɛ.

english_verse: Why should the mother of my Lord come to me?
translation_verse: Mɩ ma nɛ kʋbɛɛ, Wɩa Bie naaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ chʋɔlɛmɛ?

english_verse: As soon as I heard your greeting, my baby became happy and moved within me.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ laa ŋ chʋɔlaa ŋɩɩ, bile sɩ hɛ mɩ luoruŋ lɛ tʋɔŋ ma tɔrɛ, ʋ sii fɩfɩl.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed you because you believed that he will keep his promise. Mary's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Ŋ ma laa dii arɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩŋ jaŋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ŋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.” Mɛɛrɩ dɛnnɛ Wɩa

english_verse: Mary said: With all my heart I praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mɛɛrɩ bʋl, “Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ, mɩ dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: and I am glad because of God my Savior.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ ŋaa mɩ Laataara, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: God cares for me, his humble servant. From now on, all people will say God has blessed me.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-bii nɛ, ʋ liisi mɩ wɩaa. A lɩɩ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ, nʋʋkala jaŋ kɛmmɛ yɩyɩrɛ tʋɔtɔrɛ tɩɩna.

english_verse: God All-Powerful has done great things for me, and his name is holy.
translation_verse: Wɩa ŋaa Wɩɩ-bal nɛ a ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ mɩ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna.

english_verse: He always shows mercy to everyone who worships him.
translation_verse: Ʋʋ fá nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ fáʋ nenige nɛ, doho-na kala lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has used his powerful arm to scatter those who are proud.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ naduo-la kaa tɩɛnɛ a ŋmoo babiibalaa a ŋaa ba wɩaa kala pugi.

english_verse: God drags strong rulers from their thrones and puts humble people in places of power.
translation_verse: Ʋ kiri nɩbalaa ba kuoru kpasɩnɩŋ nyuŋ nɛ aŋ leŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri hɔŋ.

english_verse: God gives the hungry good things to eat, and sends the rich away with nothing.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩ summoo nɛ aŋ kiri nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa ba kɛŋ nahɩllɩŋ mɩɩrɛ.

english_verse: The Lord made this promise to our ancestors, to Abraham and his family forever!
translation_verse: Ʋ fa fá Abɩraham nenige nɛ. Ʋ saa jaŋ fá ʋ doho nɩaa kala ma nenige a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home. The Birth of John the Baptist
translation_verse: Mɛɛrɩ sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ, ʋ hɔŋ Ɛlɩzabɛt teeŋ a yi chɛnsɩŋ batori nɛ, aŋ-na mɩɩra mʋ dɩa. Ba lʋl Jɔɔŋ, Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la

english_verse: When Elizabeth's son was born,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛlɩzabɛt lʋlʋŋ yi. Ʋ lʋl hambolibie.

english_verse: her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ lʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ pɛ-jʋʋraa arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ fá ʋ nenige. Ba tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ, ba jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.
translation_verse: Bile sɩ yi tapʋlaa chori a magɛ dɩ ba keri ʋ peniŋ aŋ hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ, ba faa chɛ dɩ ba joŋ ʋ nyɩmma Zɛkarɩya yɩrɩŋ nɛ hɛ pʋ.

english_verse: But Elizabeth said, “No! His name is John.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ naaŋ vɩa aŋ bʋl dɩ ba hɛ Jɔɔŋ pʋ.

english_verse: The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.”
translation_verse: Nɩhɩasɩ-la bʋla pʋ arɩ ba bɩ naambii kala kɛnɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ dii Jɔɔŋ.

english_verse: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ nɩsaa bʋl wɩaa ʋ nyɩmma teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ dɩ yɩrɩ bɛɛ nɛ ʋʋ chɛ dɩ ʋ hɛ pʋ.

english_verse: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba. Ba kɛŋ wɩɩ-la lɩɩ a bʋla gaarɛ Judiya tinteeŋ sɛmɛ-na kala, lee-la peelee sɩ yʋga.

english_verse: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him. Zechariah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ba kɛŋ wɩɩ-la bɩbɩɩnɛ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ aa bʋl, “Bie deeŋ saa jaŋ ŋaa kʋbɛɛ nɛ?” Ba na arɩ Wɩa doluŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ. Zɛkarɩya bʋl wɩaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ

english_verse: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ hɛ Zɛkarɩya lɛ ʋ bʋl wɩaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ, ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to save his people.
translation_verse: “Má leŋ dɩ la dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa. Ʋ kɔ dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ nɛ a laaba ta.

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: Ʋ lɩɩsɛ nɩduo nɛ pɩla dɩ ʋ kʋ laala ta. Ʋ lɩɩ Devit doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: Faafaa kala nɛ Wɩa to ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ, a bʋla pɩla

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: arɩ ʋ jaŋ laala ta la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɛrɛla nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla arɩ ʋ jaŋ fá la doho nɩaa nenige, a liise yi nii-zɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ bile ʋ dɩ la naabalɩmaba pɛgɛ.

english_verse: that he would rescue us from our enemies. Then we could serve him without fear,
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bʋla pɩ la naabalɩma Abɩraham a ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ laala ta la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a pɩla wombiiŋ dɩ la kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a tɩma pʋ.

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: Zɛkarɩya sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɛrɛ, ʋ bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ ʋ bie ma lɛ, “Ŋ-na mɩ bii, ŋ jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩ-balɩŋ wʋlaabʋllʋ. Ŋ jaŋ laa La Tɩɩna-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ sɩpaaŋ a wasɛ wombiiŋ bil ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa siri dɩ ba tou, dɩ Wɩa jaŋ joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba aŋ laaba ta.

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: Wɩa kɛŋ zile aŋ fɩfá nɩaa nenige. Ʋ jaŋ laala ta a leŋ dɩ la hɔŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: Pʋlʋŋ-la jaŋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a pɔsɛ hɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɔŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ a faa chɛ dɩ ba sʋʋ. Ʋ jaŋ dagɛla wombii-la sɩ kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa dɩ la to.”

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ bile sii waa a hɛ yaraa a kɛŋ doluŋ arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Ʋ mʋ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ tʋɔŋ a mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kaa kʋ lɩɩ dagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, baa yɩrɛ Ɔgasɩtʋs. Ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa Rom tɩŋŋaa kuoru-balɩŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ bʋl dɩ ba dɩɩsɛ ʋ tinteeŋ nɩaa.

english_verse: Everyone listened and was surprised.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ, ʋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, baa yɩrɛ Simioŋ. Ʋ fa ŋaa nɩzɔŋ nɛ a fɩfá Wɩa a fa gbɩgbɛrɛ dɩ Wɩa laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma hɛ ʋ lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bugumo dɩɩsɛ nɩaa ŋɩɩ, baal kʋbala nɛ fa chɩŋ kuoru-balɩŋ nyuŋ Siiria tinteeŋ lɛ, baa yɩrɛ Kiriinias.

english_verse: Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋkala mʋ ʋ jaŋ dɩ ba dɩɩsʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.
translation_verse: Josɛf ma sii Nazarɛt Galilii tinteeŋ lɛ a mʋ Judiya tinteeŋ, a mʋ jʋʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm. Lee-la nɛ ba fa lʋl kuoro Devit. Josɛf fa ŋaa kuoro Devit doho nʋʋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ mʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby,
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩ Mɛɛrɩ kala nɛ mʋ nɩmɛ. Mɛɛrɩ fa sɛyɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ jaaʋ, aŋ kɛŋ luoruŋ.

english_verse: she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds
translation_verse: aŋ ka ba bɩ leriŋ na nʋhʋɔraa dɩa lɛ dɩ ba jʋʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba mʋ jʋʋ ja-dɩa. Nɩmɛ nɛ Mɛɛrɩ lʋl ʋ bii-bumbuŋ, hambolibie, a kɛŋ gɛrɩŋ bɛʋ a joŋu bil yaŋ nyuŋ. Pie-daaraa nɩɩ bile lʋlʋŋ wɩaa

english_verse: That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ pie-daaraa nɛ fa hɛ tintee-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a hɛ yaŋ tʋɔŋ a chʋa nɩmɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ aa beŋ ba piesee.

english_verse: All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ kʋbala kɔ ba teeŋ. Ʋ sɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa pʋlʋmʋŋ chaana hɛ ba lɛ. Fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba.

english_verse: But the angel said, “Don't be afraid! I have good news for you, which will make everyone happy.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bʋla pɩba, “Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma. Mɩ kɛŋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ kɔ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ nɩɩ wʋzɔmɔ-la, ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋɩŋ deeŋ ba lʋl ma Laataara nɛ Devit jaŋ lɛ. Baa yɩrʋ La Tɩɩna Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa.

english_verse: You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.”
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ma jaŋ wuo to jɩmʋ. Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ nɩmɛ, ma jaŋ na bile dɩ ba kɛŋ gɛnnɩŋ bɛʋ a joŋu bil yaŋ nyuŋ.”

english_verse: Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa yʋgɛ a guu lɩɩ a pɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la lɛ, ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɛ Wɩa a bʋl,

english_verse: “Praise God in heaven! Peace on earth to everyone who pleases God.”
translation_verse: “Má leŋ dɩ la dɛnnɛ Wɩa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ nyuŋ Wɩa tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɔ tinteeŋ lɛ jaŋ na fɩɛlɩŋ.”

english_verse: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaara-la mɩɩra mʋ Wɩa-jaŋ. Ka pie-daara-la bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ, “Má leŋ dɩ la mʋ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm a na wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ to ʋ tɩndaaraa lɛ a bʋla pɩla.”

english_verse: They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.
translation_verse: Ba sii fá lɩma lɩma a mʋ na Mɛɛrɩ arɩ Josɛf. Ba naba aŋ na bile ma dɩ ʋ pɩŋ yaŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ piedaara-la bʋl wɩɩ-la Wɩa tɩndaara-la sɩ bʋla pɩba a tɩgɛ bile lɛ a pɩ bile naaŋ arɩ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.
translation_verse: Mɛɛrɩ laa wɩaa deemba kala hɛ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ a kaa bɩbɩɩnɛ.

english_verse: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ pie-daara-la mɩɩra mʋmʋ, aŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɩdɛnne Wɩa a tɩŋ ba sɩ na wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ bʋla pɩba. Ba hɛ Yesu yɩrɩŋ

english_verse: Eight days later Jesus' parents did for him what the Law of Moses commands. And they named him Jesus, just as the angel had told Mary when he promised she would have a baby. Simeon Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Bile sɩ yi tapʋlaa chori, ba keri ʋ peniŋ aŋ hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ. Ba hɛ Yesu pʋ, yɩrɩ-la Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la fa sɩ daga bʋa-la lɛ Mɛɛrɩ fa ha sɩ bɩ luoruŋ kɛnɛ. Ba kɛŋ Yesu jʋʋ Wɩa dɩa

english_verse: The Law of the Lord also says parents have to offer a sacrifice, giving at least a pair of doves or two young pigeons. So that is what Mary and Joseph did.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra ŋmʋnsa dɩ ba kpʋ kokosuŋ balɩa maa a pɩ Wɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf arɩ Mɛɛrɩ sii mʋ Wɩa dɩa dɩ ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: and told him that he would not die until he had seen Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ fa bʋla pʋ arɩ ʋ bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ see dɩ ʋ na Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ʋ kɔ.

english_verse: When Mary and Joseph brought Jesus to the temple to do what the Law of Moses says should be done for a new baby, the Spirit told Simeon to go into the temple.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ a joŋu pɩ Wɩa aŋ pɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa sɩ daga. Dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kɛŋ Simioŋ ma kʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩa.

english_verse: Simeon took the baby Jesus in his arms and praised God,
translation_verse: Simioŋ na bile a laaʋ hɛ ʋ nɩsaa lɛ aŋ dɛnnɛ Wɩa a bʋl,

english_verse: “Lord, I am your servant, and now I can die in peace, because you have kept your promise to me.
translation_verse: “Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ sɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa. Leŋ dɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna na wombiiŋ a sʋʋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen what you have done to save your people,
translation_verse: Mɩ sɛnɛ na nɩɩ-la sɩ kɔ dɩ ʋ laa dʋnɩa nɩaa ta nɛ.

english_verse: and foreign nations will also see this.
translation_verse: Ŋ tɩmʋ dɩ ʋ kɔ nʋʋkala teeŋ nɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala naʋ.

english_verse: Your mighty power is a light for all nations, and it will bring honor to your people Israel.”
translation_verse: Bie deeŋ jaŋ nagɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ a dagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wombiiŋ, ka dɩ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma na.”

english_verse: Then he blessed them and told Mary, “This child of yours will cause many people in Israel to fall and others to stand. The child will be like a warning sign. Many people will reject him,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Simioŋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩba dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ aŋ bʋla pɩ ʋ naaŋ Mɛɛrɩ, “Wɩa lɩɩsɛ ŋ bie deeŋ dɩ ʋ kʋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii nɛ, aŋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii ta Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ. Wɩa ta bie deeŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa magɩl nɛ. Nɩaa yʋga sɩ jaŋ joŋ ba harɩŋ yɩaʋ,

english_verse: and you, Mary, will suffer as though you had been stabbed by a dagger. But all this will show what people are really thinking.” Anna Speaks about the Child Jesus
translation_verse: ama ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa jaŋ lɩɩ dɩ-jalɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩ Mɛɛrɩ, “Ŋ tɩtɩa tʋɔŋ jaŋ chei woruŋ ŋ bile wɩaa a nagɛ ba sɩ joŋ sɩa tɔbʋŋ.”

english_verse: The prophet Anna was also there in the temple. She was the daughter of Phanuel from the tribe of Asher, and she was very old. In her youth she had been married for seven years, but her husband died.
translation_verse: Haal kʋbala ma nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Ana. Ʋ fa ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ. Ʋ nyɩmma ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Fanʋɛl a lɩɩ Asa doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ʋ fa ŋaa hanɩhɩaŋ nɛ. Ʋ fa jaa bala jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ nɛ ka ʋ sʋʋ,

english_verse: At this time Anna came in and praised God. She spoke about the child Jesus to everyone who hoped for Jerusalem to be set free. The Return to Nazareth
translation_verse: Simioŋ fa sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩ Mɛɛrɩ ŋɩɩ, dɩ Ana ma kʋ jʋʋ. Ʋ na bile a dɛnnɛ Wɩa aŋ bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ bile lɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ gbɛrɛ dɩ Wɩa laa Jerusalɛm nɩaa ta. Ba mɩɩra mʋ Nazarɛt

english_verse: After Joseph and Mary had done everything that the Law of the Lord commands, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee.
translation_verse: Mɛɛrɩ arɩ Josɛf sɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ sɩ dɩ ba ŋaa Jerusalɛm lɛ a dɛrɛ, ba mɩɩra mʋ Galilii tinteeŋ a mʋ ba jaŋ Nazarɛt.

english_verse: The child Jesus grew. He became strong and wise, and God blessed him. The Boy Jesus in the Temple
translation_verse: Bile waa a kɛŋ doluŋ a kala ŋaa wʋjɩmɩɩ. Wɩa pɛ ʋ lɛ. Yesu hɔŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ

english_verse: Every year Jesus' parents went to Jerusalem for Passover.
translation_verse: Jɩna-kala Yesu nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ yie mʋ Jerusalɛm dɩ ba gbieli dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele.

english_verse: And when Jesus was twelve years old, they all went there as usual for the celebration.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ ŋaa jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ balɩa, ʋ dɩ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ mʋ dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la Jerusalɛm lɛ, arɩ ba sɩ vɛnɛɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: After Passover his parents left, but they did not know that Jesus had stayed on in the city.
translation_verse: Gbiele-la sɩ dɛrɛ, ba mɩɩraa mʋ dɩa, ka Yesu ha hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ama ʋ naaŋ arɩ ʋ nyɩmma bɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: They thought he was traveling with some other people, and they went a whole day before they started looking for him.
translation_verse: Ba fa bɩɩna arɩ ʋ hɛ ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ mɩɩra mʋ ba jaŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ba suomo chɩchɛʋ ba naambiiriŋ arɩ ba nandɔnsʋŋ tʋɔŋ. Ba vɛŋ deeŋ deeŋ wɩa tuu jʋʋ a chɛʋ ka.

english_verse: When they could not find him with their relatives and friends, they went back to Jerusalem and started looking for him there.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ chɛʋ ka, ba mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm a bee chɩchɛʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Three days later they found Jesus sitting in the temple, listening to the teachers and asking them questions.
translation_verse: Ʋ tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ nɛ ba naʋ Wɩa-dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ dɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba hɔnɔ. Ʋʋ jegili wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ bʋl aŋ pɛ pɩpɩɛsɛba wɩaa ma.

english_verse: Everyone who heard him was surprised at how much he knew and at the answers he gave.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a nɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ chaarɛ wɩaa sɩaa arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere.

english_verse: When his parents found him, they were amazed. His mother said, “Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been very worried, and we have been searching for you!”
translation_verse: Ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ sɩ naʋ, ʋ ŋaaba ma wʋkpuŋkpere. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ naaŋ pɩɛsʋ, “Mɩ bii, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ ŋaala ŋ-la? Mɩ dɩ ŋ nyɩmma gɔllɔ chɛŋ ka nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I would be in my Father's house?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma gɔllɔɔ chɛmɛ? Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ jaŋ hɛ mɩ Nyɩmma dɩa lɛɛ?”

english_verse: But they did not understand what he meant.
translation_verse: Ama ba fa bɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩba bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth with his parents and obeyed them. His mother kept on thinking about all that had happened.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu arɩ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ mɩɩra mʋ Nazarɛt a hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Ba sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, ʋ to ba niiŋ woruŋ. Ʋ naaŋ laa wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa a hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ aa bɩɩnɛ.

english_verse: Jesus became wise, and he grew strong. God was pleased with him and so were the people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu waa, ʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ ma pʋŋa pɛ. Wɩa chou, nɩaa ma zizilu woruŋ.

english_verse: When tax collectors came to be baptized, they asked John, “Teacher, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ lampoo lɩlaaraa dɔnsʋŋ ma kɔ dɩ ʋ foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “La kʋhɩaŋ, bɛɛ nɛ la ma jaŋ ŋaa?”

english_verse: Do something to show that you really have given up your sins. Don't start saying you belong to Abraham's family. God can turn these stones into children for Abraham.
translation_verse: Máa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ ma bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ, aŋ sɩ́ bɩɩna bʋl Abɩraham sɩ ŋaa ma naabalɩma ŋɩɩ, Wɩa bɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma. Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ Wɩa paala jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ tabɩaa deemba ma sɩ na bɩrɩmɛ Abɩraham doho nɩaa.

english_verse: But to Herod the ruler, he said, “It was wrong for you to take Herodias, your brother's wife.” John also said Herod had done many other bad things.
translation_verse: Ama Jɔɔŋ bʋl wɩaa jʋʋ kuoru-balɩŋ Hɛrɔd lɛ. Ʋ fa jaa ʋ naambie Fɩlɩp haala nɛ baa yɩrɛ Hɛrɔdɩas. Jɔɔŋ bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ jaa ʋ naambie haala. Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ dɔnsʋŋ yʋga Hɛrɔd fa ŋaa.

english_verse: Everyone became excited and wondered, “Could John be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ gbɛrɛ Kirisito dɩ ʋ kɔ, ba bɩɩna arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Isaiah the prophet wrote about John when he said, “In the desert someone is shouting, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord! Make a straight path for him.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Azaaya fa ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ. Wɩalɩŋ ʋ fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa nɛ ŋ-la: “Nʋʋ nɛ chɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ a heelee bʋl, ‘Má wasɛ wombiiŋ bil La Tɩɩna lɛ. Má pori wombii-la dɩ ʋ tʋʋlɛ.

english_verse: Fill up every valley and level every mountain and hill. Straighten the crooked paths and smooth out the rough roads.
translation_verse: Má dɩŋ fuonaa na-kala. Má keri peelee arɩ dundolluŋ a kaa jɛrɛ dɩ ba magɛ dɔŋɔ, wombii-la sɩ golibo, má kaa tʋʋlɛ. Wombii-la sɩ ŋaa nyʋra nyʋra, má leŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa mʋla mʋla.

english_verse: Then everyone will see the saving power of God.’ ”
translation_verse: Dɩ ma ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ na ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ laa nɩaa tɩta.’ ”

english_verse: Crowds of people came out to be baptized, but John said to them, “You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa yʋgɛ a kɔ Jɔɔŋ teeŋ dɩ ʋ foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ. Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma nɩaa deemba wʋŋaalaa nagɛ dɩŋŋaa nɛ. Ma bɩɩna ma jaŋ wuo fá lɛl chɛɛ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii nʋʋkala sarɩyaa?

english_verse: The crowds asked John, “What should we do?”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ la saa jaŋ ŋaa?”

english_verse: Some soldiers asked him, “And what about us? What do we have to do?” John told them, “Don't force people to pay money to make you leave them alone. Be satisfied with your pay.”
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoroo dɔnsʋŋ ma pɩɛsʋ, “Ka la ma, bɛɛ nɛ la ma jaŋ ŋaa?” Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Má sɩ́ nʋʋkala moribiee kaa laa arɩ doluŋ, má sɩ́ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nyɩɛ a laa moribiee. Má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ arɩ time-la ma sɩɩ laa.”

english_verse: John said, “I am just baptizing with water. But someone more powerful is going to come, and I am not good enough even to untie his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ dee. Lɩɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ mɩ-na kaa foma. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ, ʋ nɛ jaŋ faasa kɛŋ doluŋ kɩɩmɛ. Mɩ paala bɩ maga dɩ mɩ kpagʋ a kɛŋ ʋ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ ŋmɛsɩŋ ma kaa puri. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ joŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ma dɔnsʋŋ lɛ aŋ joŋ nyiniŋ ma hɛ dɔnsʋŋ ma lɛ.

english_verse: In many different ways John preached the good news to the people.
translation_verse: Jɔɔŋ to wombiee yʋgɛ nɛ a bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩaa a chagɩlɛba.

english_verse: Finally, Herod put John in jail, and this was the worst thing he had done. The Baptism of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ paala wasa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a pɛ bumbuŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la lɛ a kɛŋ Jɔɔŋ tɔ dɩa. Jɔɔŋ fo Yesu Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ Mat.

english_verse: While everyone else was being baptized, Jesus himself was baptized. Then as he prayed, the sky opened up,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Jɔɔŋ sɩɩ fo nɩaa kala Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, ʋ fo Yesu ma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ fou dɛrɛ, ʋ chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa, ŋɩɩ nɛ wɩa-nyuŋ kpaa balɩa,

english_verse: and the Holy Spirit came down upon him in the form of a dove. A voice from heaven said, “You are my own dear Son, and I am pleased with you.” The Ancestors of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ tuu a nagɛ kokomo a togili ʋ lɛ. Ʋ nɩɩ yikoro dɩ ʋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ nɛ mɩ Bii-chooluŋ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ nyuŋ.” Yesu doho nɩaa Mat.

english_verse: Enosh, and Seth. The family of Jesus went all the way back to Adam and then to God.
translation_verse: Kɛnaŋ nyɩmma ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Ɛnɔs. Ɛnɔs nyɩmma ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Sɛf. Sɛf nyɩmma ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Adam. Wɩa nɛ ta Adam.

english_verse: After the sun had set, people with all kinds of diseases were brought to Jesus. He put his hands on each one of them and healed them.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ ŋɩɩ, ba nandɔnsʋŋ wʋwɩɩlɛ. Nyanyal doho kala nɛ kɛmba. Wɩa sɩ jʋa, ba kɛmba kaa kɔ Yesu teeŋ. Ʋ joŋ ʋ nɩsaa a daŋ ba kʋŋkala lɛ, ba duori.

english_verse: The devil said to Jesus, “If you are God's Son, tell this stone to turn into bread.”
translation_verse: Sɩtaanɩ kʋ bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie, leŋ dɩ tabɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋ sɩ na bɩrɩmɛ kʋdiilee.”

english_verse: Then the devil led Jesus up to a high place and quickly showed him all the nations on earth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ Sɩtaanɩ bɩra kɛnʋ kaa jɩla dagɛ dʋnɩa kuoruŋ fine

english_verse: Just worship me, and you can have it all.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ tuu kpirimi mɩ sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlɛmɛ, kɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa ŋ kɩaa.”

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus to Jerusalem and had him stand on top of the temple. The devil said, “If you are God's Son, jump off.
translation_verse: Sɩtaanɩ kɛnʋ kaa mʋ Jerusalɛm a kɛnʋ jɩl Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ nyu-gbaŋa aŋ bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie, joŋ ŋ tɩtɩa yuo daha a tuu chigisi tinteeŋ.

english_verse: He taught in the Jewish synagogues, and everyone praised him. The People of Nazareth Turn against Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ dagɛ nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba kala bɩbɛsɛ ʋ lɛ. Ba vɩa Yesu Nazarɛt lɛ Mat.

english_verse: “The Lord's Spirit has come to me, because he has chosen me to tell the good news to the poor. The Lord has sent me to announce freedom for prisoners, to give sight to the blind, to free everyone who suffers,
translation_verse: “Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ summoo. Ʋ tɩmmɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ heele bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ arɩ ba jaŋ jomba ta, a bɩra bʋla pɩ nyʋlɩmaa dɩ ba sɩaa jaŋ suri. Ʋ bɩra tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ laa nɩaa ba sɩ nyaga bil a ta,

english_verse: and to say, ‘This is the year the Lord has chosen.’ ”
translation_verse: ʋ sɩ mɩ heele arɩ jɩna jaŋ yi dɩ La Tɩɩna Wɩa laa ʋ nɩaa ta.”

english_verse: Jesus closed the book, then handed it back to the man in charge and sat down. Everyone in the synagogue looked straight at Jesus.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ karɩmɛ teŋ-la dɛrɛ, ʋ kaa tɔ aŋ joŋo pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bil teŋ-la aŋ tuu hɔŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa-la lɛ chaarɛ sɩaa a pɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: All the people started talking about Jesus and were amazed at the wonderful things he said. They kept on asking, “Isn't he Joseph's son?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa kala tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ. Wʋzɔmɔ-la kala ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩba ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere. Ba pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Josɛf bile dee ŋ-laa?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: You will certainly want to tell me this saying, “Doctor, first make yourself well.” You will tell me to do the same things here in my own hometown that you heard I did in Capernaum.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ laa dii arɩ ma jaŋ magɛ namaga a pɩmɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Daalusuŋ tɩɩna, mʋ vaarɛ ŋ tɩtɩa.’ Ma jaŋ bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ a bʋl dɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa Kapɛnam lɛ, dɩ mɩ ŋaaba mɩ tɩtɩa jaŋ ma lɛ.”

english_verse: But you can be sure that no prophets are liked by the people of their own hometown.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ bʋlaa pɩma arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla nɛ kɔ ʋ tɩtɩa jaŋ, ʋ nɩaa bɩ ʋ cho.”

english_verse: Once during the time of Elijah there was no rain for three and a half years, and people everywhere were starving. There were many widows in Israel,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Má jegili, wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma. Ɩlaaja fa sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, duonuŋ bɩ nɩa jɩsɩŋ batori arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ. Ɩlaaja fa ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ. Losuŋ jʋʋ Iziral tinteeŋ woruŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ yo-haalaa yʋga a fa hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: but Elijah was sent only to a widow in the town of Zarephath near the city of Sidon.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa bɩ leŋe Ɩlaaja mʋ pɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa yo-haalaa kʋŋkala lɛ. Ʋ tɩmʋ ʋ mʋ pɛ yo-haal kʋbala dʋndʋŋ lɛ nɛ a lɩɩ Sɩdɔŋ tinteeŋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Zarɛfaf.

english_verse: During the time of the prophet Elisha, many men in Israel had leprosy. But no one was healed, except Naaman who lived in Syria.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Ɩlaasa ma fa sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, gbegisiŋ ma yʋga nɛ a hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, ama Wɩa bɩ leŋe Ɩlaasa vaarɛ ba kʋŋkala see baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Neemaŋ. Ʋ lɩɩ Siiria tinteeŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: But Jesus slipped through the crowd and got away. A Man with an Evil Spirit (Mark
translation_verse: Ka ʋ to nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ a lɩɩ viiri. Jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ kɛŋ baala Maak

english_verse: Jesus went to the town of Capernaum in Galilee and taught the people on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu lɩɩ Nazarɛt lɛ a mʋ Kapɛnam sɩ hɛ Galilii tinteeŋ. Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ ʋ mʋ jʋʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa a dɩdagɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: His teaching amazed them because he spoke with power.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩɩ dagɛba ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋʋ bʋl wɩaa arɩ doluŋ nɛ.

english_verse: There in the synagogue was a man with an evil spirit. He yelled out,
translation_verse: Dɩ baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa-la lɛ. Jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ nɛ fa kɛnʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ faasa chɩɩrɛ

english_verse: They all were amazed and kept saying to each other, “What kind of teaching is this? He has power to order evil spirits out of people!”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ na ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaa nʋʋkala wʋkpuŋkpere. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Ɛɛ nɛ ʋ wuo bʋl ŋ-la? Baala deeŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a wuo jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ, a bʋl wɩaa pɩba ba lɩɩ nɩaa lɛ.”

english_verse: News about Jesus spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Many People (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu wɩaa teeli lee-la kala. Yesu vaarɛ nɩaa yʋgɛ Mat.

english_verse: Jesus left the synagogue and went to Simon's home. When Jesus got there, he was told that Simon's mother-in-law was sick with a high fever.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu lɩɩ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa-la lɛ a mʋ baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Saamɔŋ dɩa. Ʋ mʋa dɩ Saamɔŋ hɩɩlɩ-haala pɩna aa wɩɩlɛ. Ʋ yaraa kala lɩŋ. Ba sɩ bʋl ʋ wɩaa pʋ,

english_verse: Demons went out of many people and shouted, “You are the Son of God!” But Jesus ordered the demons not to speak because they knew he was the Messiah.
translation_verse: Jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ ma lɩɩ nɩaa lɛ a yʋgɛ aa chɩɩrɛ, a bʋla pɩ Yesu, “Ŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu kpɩa ba lɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ ʋ wɩaa bʋl, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jɩma arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Kirisito. Yesu bʋl Wɩa wɩaa Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ Maak

english_verse: The next morning Jesus went out to a place where he could be alone, and crowds came looking for him. When they found him, they tried to stop him from leaving.
translation_verse: Sɩɩpʋʋraa Yesu lɩɩ taŋ-la lɛ a mʋ lee-la nɩaa sɩ tuo nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa suomo chɩchɛʋ. Ba sɩ mʋ naʋ, ba wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ba kɛnʋ bil dɩ ʋ sɩ́ viiru.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “People in other towns must hear the good news about God's kingdom. This is why I was sent.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Ʋ maga dɩ mɩ mʋ tasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma a bʋl Wɩa kuorii-la wɩaa nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: So he kept on preaching in the synagogues in Judea.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa Judiya tinteeŋ, Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus would often go to some place where he could be alone and pray. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Walk (Matthew
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yie sii mʋ lee nɩaa sɩ tuo a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa. Yesu vaarɛ gbɛrɩgɛ Mat.

english_verse: When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the man, “My friend, your sins are forgiven.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ na arɩ ba laaʋ dii woruŋ, ʋ bʋla pɩ gbɛrɩgʋ-la, “Mɩ nandɔŋ, mɩ joŋ ŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus got into the boat that belonged to Simon and asked him to row it out a little way from the shore. Then Jesus sat down in the boat to teach the crowd.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu jʋʋ Saamɔŋ lɩɩŋ daboro aŋ bʋl dɩ ʋ yigu dɩ ʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ mʋa. Ʋ mʋ yigu. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu hɔŋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ aŋ dɩdagɛ nɩ-daŋ-la kala.

english_verse: “Master,” Simon answered, “we have worked hard all night long and have not caught a thing. But if you tell me to, I will let the nets down.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Saamɔŋ bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, la yuo jomba nɛ woruŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala aŋ bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ. Ama ŋ-na sɩ bʋl ŋ-la, mɩ jaŋ yuo.”

english_verse: They did this and caught so many fish that their nets began ripping apart.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ a kɛsɛ chenfilee yʋgɛ kɩŋkɛŋ. Ba sɩ kɛsɛ yʋgɛ ŋɩɩ, ba jomba chɩchɛ dɩ ba kɩɛsɛ.

english_verse: Then they signaled for their partners in the other boat to come and help them. The men came, and together they filled the two boats so full that they both began to sink.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nandɔnsʋŋ hɛ lɩɩŋ daboro dɔŋɔ tʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba yɩrɛba dɩ ba kʋ pɛ ba lɛ. Ba kɔ a chaarɛ chenfile-la a su lɩɩŋ daborusu-la balɩamɩŋ kala. Ba paala chɩchɛ dɩ ba tuu lɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: His partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee, were surprised too. Jesus told Simon, “Don't be afraid! From now on you will bring in people instead of fish.”
translation_verse: Saamɔŋ nandɔnsʋŋ Jeems arɩ Jɔɔŋ ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba fa ŋaa Zebidi biiriŋ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ na ma ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ Saamɔŋ, “Sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá. A suomi jɩnɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ chɛ kɩkɛsɛ nɩaa arɩ ŋ sɩɩ kɛsɛ chenfilee ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The men pulled their boats up on the shore. Then they left everything and went with Jesus. Jesus Heals a Man (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ba kɛŋ lɩɩŋ dabori-biisi-la kaa kʋ lɩɩ lɩɩŋ niiŋ, a leŋ kʋŋkala ta nɩmɛ aŋ to ʋ harɩŋ. Yesu vaarɛ gbege Mat.

english_verse: News about Jesus kept spreading. Large crowds came to listen to him teach and to be healed of their diseases.
translation_verse: Aŋ ka wɩɩ-la ha faasa teeli leriŋ kala. Nɩaa yʋga a kɔ ʋ teeŋ dɩ ba nɩɩ ʋ wɩaa, aŋ ka dɩ ʋ pɛ vaarɛ ba nyanyalaa maa.

english_verse: But because of the crowd, they could not get him to Jesus. So they went up on the roof, where they removed some tiles and let the mat down in the middle of the room.
translation_verse: Ama nɩaa fa sɩ yʋga ŋɩɩ, ba bɩ wombiiŋ na dɩ ba kɛnʋ jʋʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛnʋ kaa jɩl lusuŋ nyuŋ a ta luri a joŋu ta. Ʋ to nɩmɛ a tuu nɩalɩŋ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ Yesu sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the experts began arguing, “Jesus must think he is God! Only God can forgive sins.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba-la suomo pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ a bʋl, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nɩa deeŋ sɩɩ tʋʋsɛ Wɩa joŋŋoo ŋ-la? Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo joŋ nʋʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛʋ see Wɩa dʋndʋŋa.”

english_verse: Is it easier for me to tell this man that his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and walk?
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋl mɩ joŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛʋ nɛ ŋaa mɔlɩɩ koo mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋl ʋ sii a chuoli ʋ bɔsɔ a viiri nɛ ŋaa mɔlɩɩ?

english_verse: But now you will see that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” Jesus then said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk home.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ dagɛma arɩ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie kɛŋ doluŋ dʋnɩa lɛ dɩ mɩ joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛ nɩaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ gbɛrɩgʋ-la a bʋl, “Sii a joŋ ŋ bɔsɔ a mʋ dɩa.”

english_verse: At once the man stood up in front of everyone. He picked up his mat and went home, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Ʋ guu duori a sii a joŋ ʋ bɔsɔ-la ʋ fa sɩ pɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ a mʋ dɩa aŋ dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed and praised God. What they saw surprised them, and they said, “We have seen a great miracle today!” Jesus Chooses Levi (Matthew
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ wʋkpuŋkpere. Fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba. Ba dɛnnɛ Wɩa a bʋl, “La na wʋkpuŋkpere jɩnɩŋ.” Yesu yɩrɛ Levi Mat.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ Yesu bɩra sii a lɩɩ na lampoo laarʋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Levi dɩ ʋ hɔŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ dɩa lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu yɩrʋ a bʋla pʋ, “Sii a to mɩ harɩŋ.”

english_verse: Levi left everything and went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Levi sii a leŋ ʋ kʋŋkala ta aŋ to ʋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: In his home Levi gave a big dinner for Jesus. Many tax collectors and other guests were also there.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Levi ŋaa ba gbieli gbieli-bal ʋ dɩa lɛ. Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo arɩ lampoo laaraa dɔnsʋŋ yʋgɛ, arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ a didii kɩaa.

english_verse: The Pharisees and some of their teachers of the Law of Moses grumbled to Jesus' disciples, “Why do you eat and drink with these tax collectors and other sinners?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba arɩ ba nandɔnsʋŋ sii a pɩɛsɛ Yesu harɩ-tooroo, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma dɩ lampoo laaraa arɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa kala hɔnɔ didii kʋdiilee?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do.
translation_verse: Yesu nɩɩ ba sɩɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa bɩ daaluŋ ŋaara ka chɛ, see nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ.

english_verse: I didn't come to invite good people to turn to God. I came to invite sinners.” People Ask about Going without Eating (Matthew
translation_verse: Mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ yɩrɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nɛ dɩ ba leŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla mɩ sɩpaaŋ dee mɩ kɔ mɩ yɩrɛ.” Ba pɩɛsɛ Yesu niiŋ vɔbʋŋ wɩaa Mat.

english_verse: Some people said to Jesus, “John's followers often pray and go without eating, and so do the followers of the Pharisees. But your disciples never go without eating or drinking.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kʋ pɩɛsɛ Yesu a bʋl, “Jɔɔŋ Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la harɩ-tooroo yie vʋvɔɔ niiŋ nɛ aŋ pɛ chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa bʋa na-kala lɛ. Farisii tɩŋŋaa harɩ-tooroo ma ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ-na harɩ-tooroo bɩ niiŋ ka vɔɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “The friends of a bridegroom don't go without eating while he is still with them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu ma pɩɛsɛba, “Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ mʋ jaa haala kaa kɔ, dɩ ʋ dɩ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ gbigbieli hajaarɩ gbiele, ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ jaŋ vɔɔ niiŋ? Aɩ, ba bɩ niiŋ ka vɔɔ.

english_verse: But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.”
translation_verse: Ama chɛɛ dɔŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ baal-la kaa mʋ lee, ka ʋ nandɔsʋ-la vɔɔ niiŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus then told them these sayings: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and make the hole even bigger.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra magɛ namaga a pɩba, “Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ keri gɛrɩpɛ-falɩŋ a kaa tɔ gɛrɩ-bɩnɩŋ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ chei gɛrɩ-falɩɩ-la. Gɛrɩpɛ-falɩɩ-la ma ŋ sɩ kere tɔ gɛrɩ-kɔsʋ-la ma bɩ jaŋ challɛ.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The new wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nʋʋ ma bɩ jaŋ joŋ sɩ-huoŋ a hɛ pupoi-kpaaŋ lɛ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, pupoi-la jaŋ yɛrɛ a chei, dɩ sɩŋ-la kala bɩsa ta.

english_verse: New wine must be put only into new wineskins.
translation_verse: Sɩ-huoŋ maga dɩ ŋ joŋu hɛ pupoi-zɔmʋŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: No one wants new wine after drinking old wine. They say, “The old wine is better.”
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ nyʋa sɩ-yele, ʋ bɩra bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ nyʋa sɩ-huoŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋkala jɩma arɩ sɩ-yele nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ sɩ-huoŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he told the man to stand up where everyone could see him. And the man stood up.
translation_verse: Ama Yesu fa jɩŋ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ nasʋʋ-la tɩɩna dɩ ʋ sii a kʋ chɩŋ ba tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ. Baal-la sii mʋ chɩŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Some Pharisees said, “Why are you picking grain on the Sabbath? You're not supposed to do that!”
translation_verse: Dɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ a naba. Ba sɩ naba ŋɩɩ, ba pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma ŋaa ŋ-la? Maa chei la chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ kɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Long ago your own people did these same things to the prophets. So when this happens to you, be happy and jump for joy! You will have a great reward in heaven.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ kʋ chɩŋ ma lɛ, ma gʋgʋa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma time jaŋ yʋgɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. La naabalɩmaba ma dɔgɩsɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ.

english_verse: Ask God to bless anyone who curses you, and pray for everyone who is cruel to you.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma lɛ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛma.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “On the Sabbath should we do good deeds or evil deeds? Should we save someone's life or destroy it?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Ɛɛ nɛ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto dagɛ arɩ la ŋɩŋaa chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ? Dɩ la pɛ nɩaa lɛ koo dɩ la dɔgɩsɛba? Dɩ la lɩlaa nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ koo dɩ la kpʋkpʋba?”

english_verse: One was Simon, and Jesus named him Peter. Another was Andrew, Peter's brother. There were also James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa nɛ ŋ-la: Saamɔŋ arɩ ʋ naambie Anduru, arɩ Jeems arɩ Jɔɔŋ arɩ Fɩlɩp arɩ Batolomi

english_verse: On another Sabbath Jesus was teaching in a synagogue, and a man with a paralyzed right hand was there.
translation_verse: Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ dɔŋɔ Yesu bɩra jʋʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa a dɩdagɛ nɩaa, dɩ baal kʋbala ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ sʋba nɛ.

english_verse: The teachers and the Pharisees were furious and started saying to one another, “What can we do about Jesus?” Jesus Chooses His Twelve Apostles (Matthew
translation_verse: Yesu fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, baanɩŋ faasa kɛŋ Farisii tɩŋŋaa arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba-la. Ba vʋvʋʋrɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ. Yesu lɩɩsɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo fii arɩ balɩa Mat.

english_verse: The next morning he called his disciples together and chose twelve of them to be his apostles.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo ba kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛ ba tʋɔŋ nɩaa fii arɩ balɩa a kɛŋ ba ma yɩyɩrɛ ʋ nanzɔɔba.

english_verse: Everyone was trying to touch Jesus, because power was going out from him and healing them all. Blessings and Troubles (Matthew
translation_verse: Wɩa doluŋ nɛ hɛ ʋ lɛ ʋ vɩvaarɛ nɩaa. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala nɩnɛrɩgɛ dɩ ba digu. Dɩ ba nɛ digu, dol-la sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ yie ŋaa ba duori. Ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ Mat.
