english_verse: Matthew, Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus. The rest of the apostles were Simon, known as the Eager One,
translation_verse: arɩ Matiu arɩ Tɔmas arɩ Alɩfɩyas bie Jeems, arɩ Saamɔŋ Zɛlɔt,

english_verse: You well-fed people are in for trouble. You will go hungry! You people who are laughing now are in for trouble. You are going to cry and weep!
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɔgɔ lɛɛlɛ, ma ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Losuŋ jaŋ kɛmma. Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ mɔŋ lɛɛlɛ, ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ chei, dɩ ma yel.

english_verse: These people had come to listen to Jesus and to be healed of their diseases. All who were troubled by evil spirits were also healed.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba kala kɔ dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Yesu sɩɩ bʋl nɛ aŋ ka dɩ ʋ vaarɛba. Nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma hɛ nɩmɛ, jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ kɛmba. Yesu ŋaa ba duori.

english_verse: God will bless you hungry people. You will have plenty to eat! God will bless you people who are now crying. You will laugh!
translation_verse: Ma ma nɩalɩŋ losuŋ sɩ kɛnɛ lɛɛlɛ, Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ pɩma kʋdiilee dɩ ma dii a vɔgɛ. Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yel lɛɛlɛ, Wɩa ma jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa jaŋ ŋaa ma mɔŋ.

english_verse: God will bless you when others hate you and won't have anything to do with you. God will bless you when people insult you and say cruel things about you, all because you are a follower of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa nɛ bɛrɛma a lɩɩsɛma ta ba tʋɔŋ a tʋtʋʋsɛma a chichei ma yɩrɩŋ a bʋl dɩ ma ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ nɛ, dɩ ba nɛ bʋl ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ to mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie harɩŋ wɩaa, Wɩa ma jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble when everyone says good things about you. That is what your own people said about those prophets who told lies. Love for Enemies (Matthew
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa kala nɩɩ bɛsɛ ma lɛ, ma ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa la naabalɩmaba Juu tɩŋŋaa ma bɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ nɛ.” Yesu dagɛ nɩaa dɩ ba cho ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ Mat.

english_verse: If you give to others, you will be given a full amount in return. It will be packed down, shaken together, and spilling over into your lap. The way you treat others is the way you will be treated.
translation_verse: Má ŋaa kɩaa pɩpɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa ma jaŋ ŋaa kɩaa a pɩma a kɛŋ zile ma teeŋ. Ʋ jaŋ magɩsɛ kɩaa chʋɔrɛ a pɩma. Kʋ-la ŋ sɩ kaa magɩsa pɩ ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa ma jaŋ kaa magɩsa pɩŋ.”

english_verse: is like someone who dug down deep and built a house on solid rock. When a flood came and the river rushed against the house, it was built so well that it didn't even shake.
translation_verse: Ʋ nagɛ baala sɩ saa dɩa nɛ a lu dɩa-la gentine, ʋ faasa tuu kpagɩnyɩlɩŋ nyuŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ duonuŋ nɩɩ, fuoŋ su a pɛllɛ yagɛ dɩa-la, ka dɩa-la bɩ jigise ma, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ saaʋ woruŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If someone slaps you on one cheek, don't stop that person from slapping you on the other cheek. If someone wants to take your coat, don't try to keep back your shirt.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ fallɛ ŋ nadiiŋ chaŋkpaŋɩŋ lɛ, kɛŋ ŋ nagʋa chaŋkpaŋɩŋ ma bɩrɩma pʋ dɩ ʋ fallɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ ŋ gɛrɩ-balɩŋ laa, wuri ŋ gɛrɩ-bie ma pɛ pʋ.

english_verse: Give to everyone who asks and don't ask people to return what they have taken from you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ kʋŋ, dɩ nʋʋ pɩɛsɛ chɩchɛ, joŋo pʋ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ joŋ ŋ kʋŋ maa, bɩra sɩ́ pɩɛsa laa.

english_verse: Treat others just as you want to be treated.
translation_verse: Ma sɩɩ chɛ dɩ nɩaa ŋaa ŋɩɩ ma lɛ, má ma joŋ ŋɩɩ ŋɩŋaa ba lɛ.

english_verse: If you love only someone who loves you, will God praise you for that? Even sinners love people who love them.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ cho nɩalɩŋ sɩ choma dʋndʋŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma kɛŋ time, bɛɛ wɩaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa ma cho dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Have pity on others, just as your Father has pity on you. Judging Others (Matthew
translation_verse: Má fɩfá nɩaa nenige arɩ ma Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige ŋɩɩ. Má sɩ́ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa wɩaa laa jɩjɩŋ Mat.

english_verse: Jesus said: Don't judge others, and God won't judge you. Don't be hard on others, and God won't be hard on you. Forgive others, and God will forgive you.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa wɩaa laa jɩŋ, a sɩ́ cheeriŋ joŋo pɩba. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa ma bɩ jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩma. Má joŋ wɩaa chɩchɛ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa ma jaŋ joŋ ma wɩaa chɛma.

english_verse: Jesus also used some sayings as he spoke to the people. He said: Can one blind person lead another blind person? Won't they both fall into a ditch?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra magɛ namaga pɩba a bʋl, “Nyʋlɩma bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ ʋ nyʋlʋŋ dɔŋɔ daaŋ lɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba kala balɩa jaŋ tel buotuoŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Are students better than their teacher? But when they are fully trained, they will be like their teacher.
translation_verse: Sikuuri-bie bɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagʋ ka kɩɩ, ama dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagʋ nɛ dagɛ bile dɛrɛ, ʋ jaŋ wuo magɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagʋ.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo na daa-bie sɩ tel ŋ naambie sɩɩŋ lɛ aŋ bɩ daa-bal-la sɩ tel ŋ tɩtɩa sɩɩŋ lɛ ka na?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye? You show-offs! First, get the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye. A Tree and Its Fruit (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩ ŋ naambie arɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ŋ lɩɩsɛ daa-bie-la sɩ hɛ ʋ sɩɩŋ lɛ, aŋ bɩ daa-bal-la sɩ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa sɩɩŋ lɛ ka na? Ŋ-na kanfugi tɩɩna, laa sɩpaaŋ lɩɩsɛ daa-bal-la sɩ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa sɩɩŋ lɛ, ka ŋ sɩaa wuo na, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo pɛ ŋ naambie lɛ a lɩɩsɛ daa-bie-la sɩ hɛ ʋ sɩɩŋ lɛ.” Yesu magɛ namaga a tɩgɛ tɩa arɩ ʋ nɛnɛɛ lɛ Mat.

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu magɛ namaga a pɩ nɩaa, “Tɩa sɩ kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa bɩ jaŋ wuo nɛŋ nɛŋ-lɔrʋnʋŋ, tɩa-la ma sɩ bɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa kɛnɛ bɩ jaŋ wuo nɛŋ nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces. You cannot pick figs or grapes from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Tɩa nɛnɛɛ nɛ yie dagɛ tɩa-la doho ʋ sɩ ŋaa. Sɔjaamɩŋ bɩ tutogo nambɩlaa ka nɛŋ, sɔ-gbuŋgbeŋe ma bɩ chɩchʋɛŋ ka nɛŋ.

english_verse: Good people do good things because of the good in their hearts, but bad people do bad things because of the evil in their hearts. Your words show what is in your heart. Two Builders (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɩzɔmʋŋ kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩŋ zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ. Nɩbɔmʋŋ ma kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a maa ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ. Ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa sɩ kɛŋ wɩɩ-la, ʋ nɛ ŋ niiŋ bʋbʋl.” Yesu magɛ namaga a tɩgɛ dɩ-saaraa balɩa lɛ Mat.

english_verse: Why do you keep on saying that I am your Lord, when you refuse to do what I say?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma kɛmmɛ yɩyɩrɛ ‘La Tɩɩna, La Tɩɩna,’ aŋ bɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl ka ŋaa?

english_verse: But anyone who hears what I say and doesn't obey me is like someone whose house wasn't built on solid rock. As soon as the river rushed against that house, it was smashed to pieces!
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla aŋ bɩ ba to, ʋ nagɛ baal-la sɩ saa ʋ dɩa tinteeŋ aŋ bɩ gentine luo ʋ tuu nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ duonuŋ nɩɩ, fuoŋ su, lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ yagɛ dɩa-la, dɩa-la kala tel wuru.”

english_verse: I have officers who give orders to me, and I have soldiers who take orders from me. I can say to one of them, ‘Go!’ and he goes. I can say to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes. I can say to my servant, ‘Do this!’ and he will do it.”
translation_verse: Mɩ ma paalaa to mɩ laalɩyuori hɩasɩŋ niiŋ nɛ. Laalɩyuoroo dɔnsʋŋ ma tuto mɩ niiŋ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ sɩ dɩ nɩa deeŋ mʋ daha, ʋ yie mʋ nɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ sɩ dɩ nɩa deeŋ kɔ daha, ʋ yie kɔ nɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋla pɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ yie ŋaa nɛ.”

english_verse: He loves our nation and even built us a synagogue.”
translation_verse: Ʋ cho la nɩaa nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ saa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa a pɩla.”

english_verse: When the Lord saw the woman, he felt sorry for her and said, “Don't cry!”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ na haal-la, nenige kala kɛnʋ. Ʋ bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ yel.

english_verse: The leaders went to Jesus and begged him to do something. They said, “This man deserves your help!
translation_verse: Ba sii a mʋ Yesu teeŋ a sʋlʋ kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a bʋl, “Baala deeŋ ŋaa nɩzɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Simon answered, “I suppose it would be the one who had owed more and didn't have to pay it back.” “You are right,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Saamɔŋ bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ bɩɩna arɩ nɩɩ-la chɩmɩŋ sɩ yʋga nɛ. Yesu bʋla pʋ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: And when he heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish leaders to ask him to come and heal the servant.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la nɩɩ Yesu wɩaa. Ʋ sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ lɩɩsɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩŋ dɩ ba mʋ sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ kʋ vaarɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ-la.

english_verse: So Jesus went with them. When Jesus wasn't far from the house, the officer sent some friends to tell him, “Lord, don't go to any trouble for me! I am not good enough for you to come into my house.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu to ba harɩŋ mʋ. Ba sɩ mʋ kpagɛ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ dɩa, baal-la tɩŋ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ dɩ ba kʋ lɩɩ bʋla pɩ Yesu, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, sɩ́ ŋ tɩtɩa walɩmʋ a kɔ mɩ dɩa. Mɩ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ kʋ jʋʋ mɩ dɩa.

english_verse: And I am certainly not worthy to come to you. Just say the word, and my servant will get well.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ paala bɩ ŋ teeŋ kɔ. Ŋ-na yaa suri ŋ niiŋ a bʋl dɩ mɩ tɩntɩnnʋ-la duori, ʋ jaŋ duori.

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, “In all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ nɩɩ wɩaa deemba, ʋ ŋaaʋ wʋkpuŋkpere. Ʋ mɩɩra chaasɛ nɩ-daŋ-la fa sɩɩ to ʋ harɩŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, mɩ ha bɩ Wɩa laa diiniŋ deeŋ doho na Iziral nɩaa tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: The officer's friends returned and found the servant well. A Widow's Son
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la fa sɩ tɩma, ba mɩɩra mʋ ʋ dɩa, dɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ-la duoro. Yesu chɩsɛ yo-haala bie

english_verse: As they came near the gate of the town, they saw people carrying out the body of a widow's only son. Many people from the town were walking along with her.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mʋ kpagɛ taŋ-la boi-baalɩŋ niiŋ dɩ baa yel yoho. Baal kʋbala nɛ sʋba. Ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa ʋ naaŋ bie kala. Ʋ naaŋ ma fa ŋaa yo-haal nɛ. Nɩaa yʋga a lɩɩ taŋ-la a kʋ chigi haal-la.

english_verse: Jesus went over and touched the stretcher on which the people were carrying the dead boy. They stopped, and Jesus said, “Young man, get up!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mʋ a digi daga-la ba fa sɩ joŋ sʋʋ-la hɛ. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ chʋŋ daga-la a kaa mʋ dɩ ba hugi, ba chɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ sʋʋ-la a bʋl, “Bapʋɔsɩ-bie, mɩ bʋla pɩŋ dɩ ŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The boy sat up and began to speak. Jesus then gave him back to his mother.
translation_verse: Baal-la sii sʋʋŋ lɛ a suomo bʋbʋl wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu joŋu pɩ ʋ naaŋ.

english_verse: Everyone was frightened and praised God. They said, “A great prophet is here with us! God has come to his people.”
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ nʋʋkala. Ba dɛnnɛ Wɩa a bʋl, “Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa tʋɔŋ nɩbal nɛ kɔ la teeŋ. Wɩa kɔ dɩ ʋ laa ʋ nɩaa ta nɛ.”

english_verse: News about Jesus spread all over Judea and everywhere else in that part of the country. John the Baptist (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ Yesu sɩ ŋaa teeli Judiya tinteeŋ kala arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ golli Judiya tinteeŋ. Jɔɔŋ, Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la tɩŋ tɩndaaraa Mat.

english_verse: John's followers told John everything that was being said about Jesus. So he sent two of them to ask the Lord, “Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ yɩrɛ ba tʋɔŋ nɩaa balɩa, a tɩmba dɩ ba mʋ Yesu teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ nɛ nɩɩ-la Jɔɔŋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ kɔ koo la gbɩgbɛrɛ nʋʋ dɔŋ nɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ Yesu teeŋ.

english_verse: When these messengers came to Jesus, they said, “John the Baptist sent us to ask, ‘Are you the one we should be looking for? Or are we supposed to wait for someone else?’ ”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋ ʋ teeŋ, ba bʋl, “Jɔɔŋ, Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la nɛ tɩnla dɩ la kʋ pɩɛsɩŋ arɩ ŋ nɛ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ kɔ koo la gbɩgbɛrɛ nʋʋ dɔŋ?”

english_verse: At that time Jesus was healing many people who were sick or in pain or were troubled by evil spirits, and he was giving sight to a lot of blind people.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ Yesu vaarɛ nyanyal tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩaa yawɩɩlaa a yʋgɛ, a kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɩaa lɛ, aŋ suri nyʋlɩmaa ma sɩaa.

english_verse: Jesus said to the messengers sent by John, “Go and tell John what you have seen and heard. Blind people are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People who have leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can now hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ Jɔɔŋ harɩ-tooro-la, “Má mɩɩra mʋ a bʋla pɩ Jɔɔŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ nɩa aŋ na maa. Nyʋlɩmaa sɩaa susuri, gbɛrɩgɛɛ vɩvɛŋ, gbegisiŋ duduori. Taŋŋaa nɩnɩɩ wɩaa. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba sisii sʋʋŋ lɛ. Summoo ma wuo nɩnɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ kaa lɛrɛ arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ tɩma, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.”

english_verse: After John's messengers had gone, Jesus began speaking to the crowds about John: What kind of person did you go out to the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ harɩ-tooro-la viiri. Ka Yesu suomo bʋl Jɔɔŋ wɩaa a pɩpɩ nɩ-daŋ-la. Ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Ma sɩ mʋ Jɔɔŋ teeŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, bɛɛ nɛ ma fa gbɛrɛ dɩ ma na? Ma mʋ dɩ ma na yaŋ peliŋ sɩ kaa viviisi nɛɛ? Aɩ.

english_verse: What kind of man did you really go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who wear expensive clothes and live in luxury are in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa ma lɩɩ dɩ ma na? Ma lɩa dɩ ma na nʋʋ sɩ laalɛ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛɛ? Aɩ. Bee na nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie laalɛ gɛnnɩŋ deemba, ba yie jʋʋ kuori-dɩɩsɩŋ nɛ aa nɩɩ sɩma.

english_verse: What then did you go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was! I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Má saa dagɛmɛ kʋ-la ma sɩ mʋa dɩ ma na. Ma mʋa dɩ ma na Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla nɛɛ? Oo, mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ ma na nʋʋ sɩ kɩɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla nɛ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures, God calls John his messenger and says, “I am sending my messenger ahead of you to get things ready for you.”
translation_verse: Ʋ-na Jɔɔŋ wɩaa nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa bil Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ, a bʋl dɩ Wɩa sɩ, ‘Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ mɩ tɩndaara dɩ ʋ laa ŋ sɩpaaŋ a mʋ a wasɛ wombiiŋ biliŋ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: No one ever born on this earth is greater than John. But whoever is least important in God's kingdom is greater than John.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩaa a bʋl, “Jɔɔŋ nɛ kɩɩ nʋʋkala ba sɩ lʋla. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa nɩ-bie Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ nɛ yʋga kɩɩ Jɔɔŋ.”

english_verse: Everyone had been listening to John. Even the tax collectors had obeyed God and had done what was right by letting John baptize them.
translation_verse: (Nɩalɩŋ arɩ ba tʋɔŋ lampoo laaraa fa sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Jɔɔŋ sɩ bʋla, ba laa dii a to Wɩa. Ba nɛ kʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma. Jɔɔŋ foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ maa.

english_verse: But the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses refused to obey God and be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Ama Farisii tɩŋŋaa arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba vɩa Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ Jɔɔŋ sɩ bʋla. Ba nɛ bɩ sɛyɛ dɩ Jɔɔŋ foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ.)

english_verse: Jesus went on to say: What are you people like? What kind of people are you?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Bɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ jɩnɩŋ nɩaa kaa magɩsɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ ba nagɛ?

english_verse: You are like children sitting in the market and shouting to each other, “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not cry!”
translation_verse: Ba nagɛ hambiisiŋ sɩɩ gbieli yɔbɔ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Dɔnsʋŋ yie kpɩa dɔŋɔ lɛ, a bʋla pɩba, ‘La yɩɩ yɩɩlaa nɛ pɩma, aŋ ka ma bɩ gʋa, la yel yoho pɩma, aŋ ka ma bɩ yel.’

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “John has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Jɔɔŋ Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ, ʋʋ vɔɔ niiŋ nɛ a bɩ sɩnɩŋ ma nyʋa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma sɩ dɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋ nɛ kɛnʋ.

english_verse: But because the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, you say, “Jesus eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.”
translation_verse: Aŋ ka mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie kɔ ma teeŋ a didii kɩaa aŋ pɛ nyʋnyʋa sɩnɩŋ ma. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ: Baala deeŋ ŋaa luobii tɩɩna nɛ a ŋaa sɩ-nyʋarʋ ma, aŋ pɛ kɛŋ lampoo laaraa arɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa kala kaa dii nandɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what its followers do. Simon the Pharisee
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɛɩ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ, ba wʋŋaalaa daga arɩ ba sɛnɛ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ.” Yesu jʋʋ Farisii kʋbala dɩa baa yɩrɛ Saamɔŋ

english_verse: A Pharisee invited Jesus to have dinner with him. So Jesus went to the Pharisee's home and got ready to eat.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Farisii tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ yɩrɛ Yesu dɩ ʋ kɔ ʋ dɩa dɩ ba dii kʋdiilee. Yesu mʋ a hɔŋ dɩ ba dii kɩaa.

english_verse: When a sinful woman in that town found out that Jesus was there, she bought an expensive bottle of perfume.
translation_verse: Dɩ haal kʋbala hɛ taŋ-la lɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ. Haal-la nɩɩ Yesu wɩaa arɩ ʋ hɛ Farisii tɩɩna-la dɩa lɛ a didii kɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sii joŋ tʋlaalɩɩ loŋ a kaa mʋ jʋʋ dɩa-la.

english_verse: Then she came and stood behind Jesus. She cried and started washing his feet with her tears and drying them with her hair. The woman kissed his feet and poured the perfume on them.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ jʋʋ dɩa-la, ʋ chɩŋ Yesu naasɩŋ sɛmɛ aŋ yel sɩlɩɩrɩŋ hɩhɛ Yesu naasɩŋ lɛ. Sɩlɩɩrɩŋ sɩ hɛ Yesu naasɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nyu-pʋnaa kaa tɩɩgɛ aŋ guori Yesu naasɩŋ, a bɩsɛ tʋlaalɩɩ-la hɛ ʋ naasɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw this and said to himself, “If this man really were a prophet, he would know what kind of woman is touching him! He would know that she is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Farisii tɩɩna-la sɩ yɩrɛ Yesu dɩ ʋ kʋ dii kɩaa na wɩɩŋ deeŋ a bɩbɩɩnɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, “Dɩ baala deeŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ, ʋ fa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ haala deeŋ sɩ digu ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to the Pharisee, “Simon, I have something to say to you.” “Teacher, what is it?” Simon replied.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ Saamɔŋ, “Saamɔŋ, mɩ kɛŋ wɩɩ nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Saamɔŋ bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, bʋla pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Two people were in debt to a moneylender. One of them owed him
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Baalaa balɩa nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ a sii mʋ chɩŋ moribiee kɩaa tɩɩna teeŋ. Dɔŋɔ chɩŋ siidi bʋɩ banɛsɛ, dɔŋɔ ma chɩŋ siidi zɔɔ-banɛsɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus told the woman, “Because of your faith, you are now saved. May God give you peace!”
translation_verse: Ama Yesu bʋla pɩ haal-la, “Ŋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ na laatanɩŋ. Mʋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.”

english_verse: Since neither of them could pay him back, the moneylender said that they didn't have to pay him anything. Which one of them will like him more?”
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba balɩa tʋɔŋ, kʋŋkala bɩ ʋ chɩmɩŋ wuo tiŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ kɩaa tɩɩna-la joŋ chɩŋ-la a chɛ ba kala. Nɩaa deemba balɩamɩŋ tʋɔŋ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ cho baal-la woruŋ?”

english_verse: He turned toward the woman and said to Simon, “Have you noticed this woman? When I came into your home, you didn't give me any water so I could wash my feet. But she has washed my feet with her tears and dried them with her hair.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mɩɩra beŋ haal-la aŋ pɩɛsɛ Saamɔŋ, “Ŋ na haal-la deeŋ nɛɛ? Mɩ kɔ ŋ dɩa, aŋ ka ŋ bɩ lɩɩŋ ŋaa pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ sɔŋ mɩ naasɩŋ, aŋ ka ʋ-na kɛŋ ʋ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ kaa sɔŋ mɩ naasɩŋ aŋ kɛŋ ʋ nyu-pʋnaa ma tɩɩgɛ.

english_verse: You didn't greet me with a kiss, but from the time I came in, she has not stopped kissing my feet.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ kɔ ŋ dɩa, ŋ bɩ mɩ guoro, ama haala deeŋ sɩ guori mɩ naasɩŋ, ʋ ha bɩ leŋe.

english_verse: You didn't even pour olive oil on my head, but she has poured expensive perfume on my feet.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ nʋʋŋ ŋaa tɩsɛ mɩ nyuŋ, ka ʋ-na ŋaa tʋlaalɩɩ tɩsɛ mɩ naasɩŋ.

english_verse: So I tell you that all her sins are forgiven, and that is why she has shown great love. But anyone who has been forgiven for only a little will show only a little love.”
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ mɩ joŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yʋgɛ nɛ a chɛʋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ chomi woruŋ ŋɩɩ. Ama nɩɩ-la ma mɩ sɩ joŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ mʋapɩlɩɩ chɛʋ, ʋ tɩɩna ma chomi mʋapɩlɩɩ nɛ.”

english_verse: Then Jesus said to the woman, “Your sins are forgiven.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ haal-la nɩaa tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a chɛʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Some other guests started saying to one another, “Who is this who dares to forgive sins?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kʋkaanaa fa sɩ hɔnɔ didii kʋdiile-la bɩbɩɩnɛ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ a bʋl, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nɩa deeŋ sɩ paala joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛ nɩaa?”

english_verse: and so were some women who had been healed of evil spirits and all sorts of diseases. One of the women was Mary Magdalene, who once had seven demons in her.
translation_verse: arɩ haalaa dɔnsʋŋ ma. Ba tʋɔŋ dɔnsʋŋ faa wɩɩlɛ nɛ, jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ ma fa kɛŋ dɔnsʋŋ. Yesu vaarɛ ba kala. Ba tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Mɛɛrɩ Magɩdalɩŋ. Yesu fa kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ balɩpɛ nɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: The seeds that fell on rocky ground are the people who gladly hear the message and accept it. But they don't have deep roots, and they believe only for a little while. As soon as life gets hard, they give up.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ sɩ tel kpagɩnyɩlɩŋ nyuŋ ma nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie nɩɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ a sɛɩ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Ama ʋ bɩ ba tʋɔŋ tibe. Ba yie sɛɩ wɩɩ-la a mʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ aŋ vɩa. Dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋba, ba joŋo ta.

english_verse: Other seeds fell on rocky ground and started growing. But the plants did not have enough water and soon dried up.
translation_verse: Dɔnsʋŋ ma tel kpagɩnyɩlɩŋ nyuŋ a nyʋ aŋ sʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa lɩɩŋ tuo nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Some other seeds fell where thornbushes grew up and choked the plants.
translation_verse: Dɔnsʋŋ ma tuu tel sɔsʋŋ tʋɔŋ a nyʋ, sɔsʋ-la ma nyʋ nyagɛ ba kpʋ.

english_verse: So he answered: I have explained the secrets about God's kingdom to you. But for others I use stories, so they will look, but not see, and they will hear, but not understand. Jesus Explains the Story about a Farmer (Matthew
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Ma nɩaa deemba nɛ Wɩa dagɛ ʋ kuorii-la bʋbʋɔŋ pa. Ama nɩ-daŋ kala, namagaba nɛ ʋ yie kaa dɩdagɛba. Ba yie nyilimi nyilimi aŋ bɩ kʋŋkala wuo na, a bɩra jegili jegili aŋ bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ wuo jɩŋ.

english_verse: There is nothing hidden that will not be found. There is no secret that will not be well known.
translation_verse: Wʋfaalɩɩ tuo see dɩ ʋ kʋ lɩɩ dɩ-jalɩŋ. Wɩɩkala sɩ hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: and while they were sailing across, he went to sleep. Suddenly a storm struck the lake, and the boat started sinking. They were in danger.
translation_verse: Ba fa sɩ duoro mʋ ŋɩɩ, Yesu pɩŋ doŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ pel-duo kʋbala suomo ŋɩŋaa, a kʋ ŋmoo lɩɩŋ a hɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ ʋ chɩchɛ ʋ su. Ʋ fa ka mʋa dɩ ba tuu lɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: This is what the story means: The seed is God's message,
translation_verse: Namaga-la bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa nɛ ŋaa kʋdoho-la.

english_verse: The seeds that fell among the thornbushes are also people who hear the message. But they are so eager for riches and pleasures that they never produce anything.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ sɩ tel sɔsʋŋ tʋɔŋ ma nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie nɩɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ, ama dʋnɩa kɩaa wɩaa wʋwalɩmɛba, ba cho dɩ ba jige aa chɩchɛ dʋnɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa. A tɩŋ kɩaa deemba wɩaa ba yie to mʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ aŋ bɩra vɩa wɩalɩŋ. Wɩalɩŋ lɛl ba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Those seeds that fell on good ground are the people who listen to the message and keep it in good and honest hearts. They last and produce a harvest. Light (Mark
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ sɩ tel tintee-zɔmʋŋ tʋɔŋ ma nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ a laaba hɛ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ a tutoba, a pɛsɛ wɩalɩŋ lɛ halɩɩ, ba kɛŋ doho.” Yesu magɛ namaga a mʋ tɩgɛ chaanɩŋ lɛ Maak

english_verse: Then Jesus asked the disciples, “Don't you have any faith?” But they were frightened and amazed. They said to each other, “Who is this? He can give orders to the wind and the waves, and they obey him!” A Man with Demons in Him (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo a bʋl, “Ma bɩ Wɩa laa dii?” Ʋ ŋaa nʋʋkala wʋkpuŋkpere. Fawʋllʋŋ ma kɛmba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa paala ŋaa nɩa deeŋ? Ʋ bʋl wɩaa a pɩ peliŋ arɩ lɩɩ-peliŋ, ba kala to ʋ niiŋ.” Yesu vaarɛ baal kʋbala jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ fa sɩ kɛnɛ Mat.

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and puts it under a bowl or under a bed. A lamp is always put on a lampstand, so people who come into a house will see the light.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra dagɛ nɩaa a bʋl, “Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ nyɩgɛ chaanɩŋ ʋ dɩa lɛ a kɛŋ gbaŋa chu tɔ, koo a joŋo hɛ godo bʋbʋɔŋ. Ʋ yie joŋo daŋ chaaŋ daaŋ nyuŋ nɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kʋ jʋʋ ʋ dɩa, dɩ ʋ wuo na pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: But Jesus answered, “Someone touched me, because I felt power going out from me.”
translation_verse: Ama Yesu ha bʋl, “Nʋʋ nɛ digimi. Mɩ jɩma arɩ doluŋ lɩɩ mɩ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he told Jairus, “Don't worry! Have faith, and your daughter will get well.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ bʋla pɩ Jaarɩs, “Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ laa Wɩa dii, ʋ jaŋ sii.”

english_verse: They begged Jesus not to send them to the deep pit, where they would be punished.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ jɩŋ-bɔmɔ-la sʋl Yesu dɩ ba nɛ leŋ baal-la, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba tuu buotuo-luŋuŋ.

english_verse: The people went out to see what had happened, and when they came to Jesus, they also found the man. The demons had gone out of him, and he was sitting there at the feet of Jesus. He had clothes on and was in his right mind. But the people were terrified.
translation_verse: Nɩaa sii lɩɩ mʋ dɩ ba na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa a kɔ Yesu teeŋ. Baa kɔ dɩ baal-la Yesu sɩ kiri jɩnsɩŋ ʋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ hɔŋ Yesu sɛmɛ a laalɛ gɛrɩŋ a kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Ba sɩ na ŋɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba.

english_verse: Jesus' mother and brothers went to see him, but because of the crowd they could not get near him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu naaŋ arɩ ʋ ŋaanaa kɔ lee-la Yesu sɩ hɛ dɩ ba naʋ. Nɩaa sɩ yʋga ŋɩɩ, ba bɩ ʋ wuo na.

english_verse: As Jesus was getting out of the boat, he was met by a man from this town. The man had demons in him. He had gone naked for a long time and no longer lived in a house, but in the graveyard.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋ yi lee-la, Yesu kʋ lɩɩ lɩɩŋ niiŋ, dɩ baal kʋbala ma lɩɩ taŋ-la a kʋ chemu. Jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ kɛnʋ. Ʋ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree nɛ aa gɔllɛ a dieni. Ʋ bɩ dɩa maa jʋʋ. Vaamaa leriŋ nɛ ʋ yie hɛ.

english_verse: One day, Jesus and his disciples got into a boat, and he said, “Let's cross the lake.” They started out,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo sii jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl dɩ ba chol mʋga cholo dɔŋɔ. Ba jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la a duoro mʋ.

english_verse: So they went to Jesus and woke him up, “Master, Master! We are about to drown!” Jesus got up and ordered the wind and waves to stop. They obeyed, and everything was calm.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la mʋ lee-la ʋ fa sɩ pɩna, a chɩsʋ a bʋla pʋ, “La kʋhɩaŋ, laa chɛ dɩ la sʋʋ nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii doŋ lɛ a kpɩa pel-la lɛ aŋ bʋl lɩɩ-pel-la ma lɛ dɩ ʋ fɩɛla pɩŋ. Pel-la kɛrɛ, ka leriŋ kala ŋaa fʋɩɩ.

english_verse: The man saw Jesus and screamed. He knelt down in front of him and shouted, “Jesus, Son of God Most High, what do you want with me? I beg you not to torture me!”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ na Yesu, ʋ ŋmoo niiŋ aŋ tuu tel ʋ sɩpaaŋ, aŋ bʋla pʋ, “Yesu, Wɩɩ-balɩŋ Bie, bɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɛ ŋ ŋaa mɩ lɛ? Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, sɩ́ mɩ dɔgɩsʋ.”

english_verse: When the men taking care of the pigs saw this, they ran to spread the news in the town and on the farms.
translation_verse: Too-daara-la sɩ na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa, ba fá mʋ a hɛ duoso pɩ bagɩ-daaraa arɩ taŋ-la nɩaa kala.

english_verse: He said this because Jesus had already told the evil spirit to go out of him. The man had often been attacked by the demon. And even though he had been bound with chains and leg irons and kept under guard, he smashed whatever bound him. Then the demon would force him out into lonely places.
translation_verse: Yesu fa bʋla pɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la dɩ ʋ lɩɩ baal-la lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ. Jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la fa vɛnɛ kɛnʋ a yʋgɛ nɛ. Nɩaa kɛnʋ kaa tɔ dɩa a hɛʋ kuruŋ a kɛŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ vɔbʋ aŋ hɛ nɩaa ba bibenu. Ʋ yie kɛŋ chɔrʋmɔ-la kaa kɛrɛ, ka jɩnsɩ-la kɛnʋ kaa lɩɩ jʋʋ gɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Jesus asked the man, “What is your name?” He answered, “My name is Lots.” He said this because there were “lots” of demons in him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ bɛɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋl dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ kʋ-kɛnɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa jɩnsɩŋ fa yʋga nɛ a kɛnʋ.

english_verse: A large herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside. So the demons begged Jesus to let them go into the pigs, and Jesus let them go.
translation_verse: Dɩ toonuŋ ma hɛ lee-la a yʋgɛ a didii kɩaa peeliŋ nyuŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ jɩnsɩ-la sʋl Yesu dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ba mʋ jʋʋ toonu-la. Ʋ sɛɩ.

english_verse: Then the demons left the man and went into the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
translation_verse: Ba lɩɩ baal-la lɛ a mʋ jʋʋ toonu-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ toonu-la kala sii a fá lɩɩ peel-la nyuŋ a tuu tel mʋga tʋɔŋ a nyʋa lɩɩŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Everyone from around Gerasa begged Jesus to leave, because they were so frightened. When Jesus got into the boat to start back,
translation_verse: Ba sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ taŋ-la nɩaa kala kʋ bʋla pɩ Yesu dɩ ʋ lɩɩ ba jaŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro. Ba dɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo duoro viiri.

english_verse: the man who had been healed begged to go with him. But Jesus sent him off and said,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la Yesu sɩ kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ ʋ lɛ ma sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ʋ kɔ dɩ ba mʋ. Ʋ bɩ sɛyɛ aŋ bʋla pʋ,

english_verse: “Go back home and tell everyone how much God has done for you.” The man then went all over town, telling everything that Jesus had done for him. A Dying Girl and a Sick Woman (Matthew
translation_verse: “Mʋ dɩa a bʋla pɩ ŋ dɩa nɩaa Wɩa sɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ŋ lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la gɔllɛ jaŋ tʋɔŋ kala a bʋl wɩɩ-la Yesu sɩ ŋaa ʋ lɛ. Yesu vaarɛ Jaarɩs tolo Mat.

english_verse: In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years. She had spent everything she had on doctors, but none of them could make her well.
translation_verse: Haal kʋbala ma fa hɛ ba tʋɔŋ. Ʋ fa kɛŋ tɩŋa nɛ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ balɩa, ʋ pɔ ʋ bɩ dɛrɛ. [Ʋ gɔllɔ ŋaa daalusuŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a chei ʋ moribiee kala, ka daalusu-la bɩ ʋ laa.]

english_verse: Everyone had been waiting for Jesus, and when he came back, a crowd was there to welcome him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mɩɩra mʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro ba duoro chol mʋga. Ba cholo ŋɩɩ dɩ nɩ-daŋ hilime a hɔnɔ gbɛrʋ.

english_verse: As soon as she came up behind Jesus and barely touched his clothes, her bleeding stopped.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ lugisi nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ a kʋ chɩŋ Yesu harɩŋ a digi ʋ gɛrɩŋ niipiniŋ lɛ. Ʋ tɩŋa-la guu dɛrɛ.

english_verse: “Who touched me?” Jesus asked. While everyone was denying it, Peter said, “Master, people are crowding all around and pushing you from every side.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ digimi?” Nʋʋkala bʋl dɩ ʋ-na dee. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋla pɩ Yesu, “Kʋhɩaŋ, ka ŋ na nɩaa sɩ yʋga ŋɩɩ nɛ a golluŋ chu a yiyigi dɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: The woman knew that she could not hide, so she came trembling and knelt down in front of Jesus. She told everyone why she had touched him and that she had been healed at once.
translation_verse: Haal-la sɩ na arɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa bɩ wʋfaalɩɩ ŋaa, ʋ kʋ kpirimi Yesu sɩpaaŋ a chichel, a bʋl nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ʋ digu, a dagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ digu a duori lɩma.

english_verse: Jesus said to the woman, “You are now well because of your faith. May God give you peace!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ tolo, ŋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ tɩɩ ŋ duori, mʋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.”

english_verse: While Jesus was speaking, someone came from Jairus' home and said, “Your daughter has died! Why bother the teacher anymore?”
translation_verse: Yesu fa sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ tɩndaara lɩɩ Jaarɩs dɩa kɔ, a bʋla pɩ Jaarɩs, “Ŋ tolo-la sʋba nɛ, bɩra sɩ́ la kʋhɩaŋ-la walɩmʋ.”

english_verse: Jesus went into the house, but he did not let anyone else go with him, except Peter, John, James, and the girl's father and mother.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ mʋ yi baal-la dɩa, ʋ bɩ leŋe nʋʋkala to ʋ harɩŋ jʋʋ dɩa-la, see Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ arɩ Jeems, a pɛ bile nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone was crying and weeping for the girl. But Jesus said, “The child isn't dead. She is just asleep.”
translation_verse: Ba kʋ jʋʋ dɩa-la dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ sime aa yel bile yoho. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má sɩ́ yel, bile bɩ sʋba, doŋ nɛ ʋ pɩŋ.”

english_verse: The people laughed at him because they knew she was dead.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala mɔmʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jɩma arɩ ʋ sʋba nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus took hold of the girl's hand and said, “Child, get up!”
translation_verse: Yesu mʋ kɛŋ bile nɩsɩŋ lɛ aŋ yɩrʋ, “Mɩ bii, sii.”

english_verse: She came back to life and got right up. Jesus told them to give her something to eat.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ dɩma mɩɩra kʋ jʋʋ. Ʋ sii chɩŋ. Yesu bʋl dɩ ba ŋaa kʋdiilee pʋ dɩ ʋ dii.

english_verse: Her parents were surprised, but Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ŋaa bile nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ wʋkpuŋkpere. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba dɩ ba sɩ́ wɩɩŋ deeŋ sɩ ŋaa bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala.

english_verse: The apostles came back and told Jesus everything they had done. He then took them with him to the village of Bethsaida, where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la mɩɩra kɔ ʋ teeŋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋaa pʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ba dʋndʋŋa mʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Bɛtɩsaada.

english_verse: They did this, and all the people sat down.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la ŋaa nɩalɩŋ kala tuu hɔŋ.

english_verse: Herod the ruler heard about all that was happening, and he was worried. Some people were saying John the Baptist had come back to life.
translation_verse: Galilii tɩŋŋaa kuoro Hɛrɔd sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la fa sɩ gɔllɔ ŋaa, ʋ tʋɔŋ kala vʋgʋma, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ bʋla arɩ Jɔɔŋ Wɩa lɩɩ-fooru-la nɛ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He told them, “Don't take anything with you! Don't take a walking stick or a traveling bag or food or money or even a change of clothes.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩba dɩ ba sɩ́ kʋŋkala kaa pɛ vɛŋ wombii-la, dɩ ba sɩ́ dantɩgɩsɩŋ koru, dɩ ba sɩ́ lʋagaba ma koru, dɩ ba sɩ́ kʋdiilee ma koru, dɩ ba sɩ́ moribiee ma koru, a sɩ́ gɛnnɩŋ balɩa ma paa.

english_verse: When you are welcomed into a home, stay there until you leave that town.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ jʋʋ taŋ kala, má jʋʋ dɩa-la nɩaa sɩ laama, a hɛ dɩɩ-bala lɛ halɩɩ a mʋ lɩɩ taŋ-la lɛ.

english_verse: Late in the afternoon the twelve apostles came to Jesus and said, “Send the crowd to the villages and farms around here. They need to find a place to stay and something to eat. There is nothing in this place. It's like a desert!”
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ suomo dɩ ʋ jʋʋ, ʋ harɩ-tooro-la fii arɩ balɩa-la kɔ ʋ teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Leŋ dɩ nɩaa deemba viiri a mʋ taŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ bagɩsɩŋ sɩ kpaga daha a chɛ kʋdiilee arɩ dɩpɩnɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa kʋŋkala tuo daha.”

english_verse: While he was praying, his face changed, and his clothes became shining white.
translation_verse: Yesu fa sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa ŋɩɩ, ʋ sɩaa bɩrɩmɛ. Ʋ gɛnnɩŋ ma pʋllɛ a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ lɩgɩsa.

english_verse: Jesus strictly warned his disciples not to tell anyone about this. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ dɩ ba pɔ dɩ ba sɩ́ wɩɩ-la bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala.

english_verse: “Pay close attention to what I am telling you! The Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies.”
translation_verse: “Má sɩ́ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma yʋ. Ʋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ba jaŋ joŋ mɩ-na, Nuhuobiine Bie a hɛ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: But a lot of people found out about this and followed him. Jesus welcomed them. He spoke about God's kingdom and healed everyone who was sick.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ Yesu wɩaa dɩ ʋ mʋ Bɛtɩsaada, ba to ʋ harɩŋ mʋ. Ʋ kɛmba woruŋ a bʋl Wɩa kuorii-la wɩaa pɩba, aŋ vaarɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ.

english_verse: “Don't stop him!” Jesus said. “Anyone who isn't against you is for you.” A Samaritan Village Refuses To Receive Jesus
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pɩ Jɔɔŋ arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo kʋkaanaa, “Má sɩ́ ʋ kiru, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ ma harɩŋ lɩa, ʋ ŋaa ma dɔŋɔ nɛ.” Samarɩa tinteeŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ nɩaa vɩa Yesu

english_verse: About eight days later Jesus took Peter, John, and James with him and went up on a mountain to pray.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba kala dɛrɛ, ʋ tapʋlaa chori chɛɛŋ ʋ sii kɛŋ Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ arɩ Jeems ba jɩl peeliŋ nyuŋ dɩ ba chʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will save it.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ vɩa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ sɛnɛ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself or waste your life?
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ tɩɩ dʋnɩa kɩaa kala aŋ bɩ mɩɩsɩŋ kɛnɛ, bɛɛ kʋŋ nyʋʋrɩɩ nɛ ŋ na?

english_verse: If you are ashamed of me and my message, the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in his glory and in the glory of his Father and the holy angels.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ fá hɩɩsɩŋ a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa arɩ mɩ wʋbʋlaa lɛ, mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie ma jaŋ leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛnʋ dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ a chaanɛ arɩ mɩ nyɩmma tʋla, a pɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ.

english_verse: They appeared in heavenly glory and talked about all that Jesus' death in Jerusalem would mean.
translation_verse: Ba chɩŋ aa bʋl wɩaa. Baa bʋl ŋɩɩ Yesu sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ Jerusalɛm lɛ, dɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba.

english_verse: ) While everyone was still amazed at what Jesus was doing, he said to his disciples,
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala haa bɩɩnɛ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la Yesu sɩ ŋaa lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la,

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, a shadow from a cloud passed over, and they were frightened as the cloud covered them.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta ha sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ, duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ kʋ tuu tɔba. Ʋ sɩ tɔba ŋɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la.

english_verse: From the cloud a voice spoke, “This is my chosen Son. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Ka nʋʋ yikoro lɩɩ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la tʋɔŋ aa bʋl, “Mɩ Bie nɛ ŋ-la. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa. Má jegile nɩɩ ʋ teeŋ.”

english_verse: After the voice had spoken, Peter, John, and James saw only Jesus. For some time they kept quiet and did not say anything about what they had seen. Jesus Heals a Boy (Matthew
translation_verse: Yikoro-la sɩ bʋl wɩaa dɛrɛ, ʋ-na Yesu dʋndʋŋa nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la tɔrɛ ba niiŋ. Ba bɩ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ na bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala. Yesu kiri jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ bie lɛ Mat.

english_verse: A demon often attacks him and makes him scream. It shakes him until he foams at the mouth, and it won't leave him until it has completely worn the boy out.
translation_verse: Jɩŋ-bɔŋ nɛ kɛnʋ, ʋ chɩchɩɩrɛ a terigi. Nantʋɔ-fʋnfʋga yie tɔ ʋ niiŋ. Ʋʋ walɩmʋ a pɔ ʋ bɩ ʋ ka leŋ.

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You people are stubborn and don't have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you?” Then Jesus said to the man, “Bring your son to me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Ma lɛɛlɛ nɩaa deemba, ma bɩ Wɩa laa dii. Ma ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ nɛ. Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ nyalɩmɛ a dieni magɛ ma teeŋ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ baal-la a bʋl, “Kɛŋ ŋ bile kaa kɔ mɩ teeŋ.”

english_verse: While the boy was being brought, the demon attacked him and made him shake all over. Jesus ordered the demon to stop. Then he healed the boy and gave him back to his father.
translation_verse: Bile sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la ŋmobu lo tinteeŋ ʋ terigi. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu kpɩa jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la lɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ bile lɛ. Ʋ lɩɩ, ka bile duori, Yesu joŋu pɩ ʋ nyɩmma.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed at God's great power. Jesus Again Speaks about His Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ kala wʋkpuŋkpere. Ba sɩ dɩ Wɩa kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ. Yesu bɩra bʋl ʋ sʋʋŋ wɩaa Mat.

english_verse: But the disciples did not know what he meant. The meaning was hidden from them. They could not understand it, and they were afraid to ask. Who Is the Greatest? (Matthew
translation_verse: Ama ʋ harɩ-tooro-la bɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ. Ʋ ŋaa wʋfaalɩɩ nɛ ba teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba bɩ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ wuo jɩŋ. Ama ba fɩfá fawʋllʋŋ dɩ ba pɩɛsɛ wɩɩ-la bʋbʋɔŋ. Yesu harɩ-tooroo chɛ dɩ ba jɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ kʋhɩaŋ Mat.

english_verse: Jesus' disciples were arguing about which one of them was the greatest.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu harɩ-tooroo kɛŋ ba tʋɔŋ kʋhɩaŋ wɩaa lɩlɛrɛ.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he had a child stand there beside him.
translation_verse: Yesu fa jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ nɛ a kɛŋ bii-bie kaa kɔ kɩɩ ʋ sɛmɛ,

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “When you welcome even a child because of me, you welcome me. And when you welcome me, you welcome the one who sent me. Whichever one of you is the most humble is the greatest.” For or against Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kɛŋ bii-bie deeŋ dɔŋɔ woruŋ a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa, mɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ woruŋ ŋɩɩ. Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ kɛmmɛ woruŋ, mɩ dʋndʋŋa dee ʋ kɛŋ woruŋ ŋɩɩ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ ma nɛ ʋ kɛŋ woruŋ ŋɩɩ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa nɩ-bie ma tʋɔŋ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa ma tʋɔŋ nɩbalɩŋ.” Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩŋ bɛrɛ, ʋ choŋ nɛ Maak

english_verse: John said, “Master, we saw a man using your name to force demons out of people. But we told him to stop, because he isn't one of us.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ bʋla pɩ Yesu, “La Kʋhɩaŋ, la na baal kʋbala dɩ ʋ kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɩaa lɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. La kiru dɩ ʋ sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ la dɔŋɔ ŋaa.”

english_verse: Not long before it was time for Jesus to be taken up to heaven, he made up his mind to go to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la kpagɛ dɩ ba joŋ Yesu a kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ. Ʋ ŋaa siri a sii, a joŋ wombiiŋ a mʋmʋ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: He sent some messengers on ahead to a Samaritan village to get things ready for him.
translation_verse: Ʋ tɩŋ tɩndaaraa dɩ ba laa ʋ sɩpaaŋ a mʋ Samarɩa tinteeŋ tabie kʋbala, a chɛ leriŋ a bil ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: But he was on his way to Jerusalem, so the people there refused to welcome him.
translation_verse: Ka nɩalɩŋ bɩ siri ŋaa dɩ ba laaʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jɩma dɩ ʋ mʋ Jerusalɛm nɛ.

english_verse: When the disciples James and John saw what was happening, they asked, “Lord, do you want us to call down fire from heaven to destroy these people?”
translation_verse: Ʋ harɩ-tooroo Jeems arɩ Jɔɔŋ sɩ na ŋɩɩ, ba pɩɛsɛ Yesu a bʋl, “La Tɩɩna, ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la sʋl nyiniŋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ tuu a diiba koo?”

english_verse: Then they all went on to another village. Three People Who Wanted To Be Followers (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka ba kiele mʋ taŋ dɔŋɔ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba to Yesu harɩŋ Mat.

english_verse: Jesus said, “Foxes have dens, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man doesn't have a place to call his own.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Jolluŋ kɛŋ bʋɔsʋŋ nɛ a jʋjʋʋ, diibiisiŋ ma kɛŋ dɛllɩŋ nɛ a jʋjʋʋ, ama mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie bɩ dɩpɩnɩŋ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ pɩna wiesi.”

english_verse: Jesus told someone else to come with him. But the man said, “Lord, let me wait until I bury my father.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ ma, “To mɩ harɩŋ.” Ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, leŋ dɩ mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ mʋ hugi mɩ nyɩmma.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Let the dead take care of the dead, while you go and tell about God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Leŋ dɩ sʋʋnʋŋ tɩŋŋaa mʋ hugi ba sʋʋnʋŋ, aŋ ka dɩ ŋ ma mʋ bʋl Wɩa kuorii-la wɩaa a pɩ nɩaa.”

english_verse: Then someone said to Jesus, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first let me go back and take care of things at home.”
translation_verse: Nʋʋ ma dɔŋ bɩra bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ to ŋ harɩŋ, ama leŋ dɩ mɩ mʋ ta mɩ dɩa nɩaa aŋ kɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Anyone who starts plowing and keeps looking back isn't worth a thing to God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ suomo dɩ ʋ pɛrɛ aŋ dɩdaasɛ ʋ harɩŋ, ʋ bɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala kɛnɛ Wɩa kuorii-la lɛ.”

english_verse: He said to them: A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers. Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Kɩaa yʋga baga lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa, ama tɩntɩnnaa bɩ yʋgɛ dɩ ba tɩŋ. Má sʋl baga-la tɩɩna dɩ ʋ hɛ nɩaa dɩ ba tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la.

english_verse: Now go, but remember, I am sending you like lambs into a pack of wolves.
translation_verse: Má sii mʋ. Ma nagɛ pie-biisiŋ nɛ, mɩɩ tɩmma dɩ ma guoli guŋgurusuŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Don't take along a moneybag or a traveling bag or sandals. And don't waste time greeting people on the road.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ moribiee koru, má sɩ́ sʋllɩ-gbansɩŋ koru a sɩ́ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ tʋŋ bʋlɩa ma koru a sɩ́ chɩna chʋɔlɛ nɩaa ma dieni wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: As soon as you enter a home, say, “God bless this home with peace.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ jʋʋ dɩa kala, má laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl, ‘Dɩa deeŋ nɩaa jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.’

english_verse: If the people living there are peace-loving, your prayer for peace will bless them. But if they are not peace-loving, your prayer will return to you.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ sɩ cho yarɩfɩɛla-la, má leŋ dɩ ʋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa arɩ ma sɩ sʋl ŋɩɩ. Dɩ nʋʋ tuo dɩa-la lɛ a cho yarɩfɩɛla-la, yarɩfɩɛla-la ma sɩ sʋla jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: Stay with the same family, eating and drinking whatever they give you, because workers are worth what they earn. Don't move around from house to house.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ pɩma dɩpɩnɩŋ, má hɛ dɩɩ-bala lɛ halɩɩ aa dii kʋdiile-la ba sɩ ŋaa pɩma aa nyʋa lɩɩŋ ma nɩmɛ. Dɩ tɩntɩnna nɛ tɩma, ʋ maga dɩ ba timu nɛ. Má sɩ́ gɔllɔ pɩpɩŋ nɩaa dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If the people of a town welcome you, eat whatever they offer.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ taŋ kala, dɩ ba nɛ laama, má dii kʋŋ na-kala ba sɩ ŋaa pɩma lee-la.

english_verse: Heal their sick and say, “God's kingdom will soon be here!”
translation_verse: Má vaarɛ nyanyal tɩŋŋaa ma kala sɩ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ aŋ bʋla pɩba, ‘Wɩa kuorii-la kʋ kpagɛma nɛ.’

english_verse: But if the people of a town refuse to welcome you, go out into the street and say,
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ mʋ taŋ kala, dɩ ba nɛ bɩ ma laa, má lɩɩ chɩŋ wombiiŋ lɛ aŋ bʋla pɩba,

english_verse: I tell you that on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than the people of that town! The Unbelieving Towns (Matthew
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma arɩ sarɩya chɛ-diiliŋ, Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ taŋ-la nɩaa a kɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ dɔgɩsɛ Sodom nɩaa ŋɩɩ.” Tasɩ-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ Yesu wɩaa laa dii Mat.

english_verse: But don't be happy because evil spirits obey you. Be happy that your names are written in heaven! Jesus Thanks His Father (Matthew
translation_verse: Ama má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ arɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ sɩɩ to ma niiŋ lɛ, má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ma yɩraa Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.” Yesu tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ Mat.

english_verse: Many prophets and kings were eager to see what you see and to hear what you hear. But I tell you they did not see or hear.” The Good Samaritan
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ bumbuŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ faafaa kuoroo yʋga a fa cho dɩ ba na wɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ na aŋ bɩ wuo na, a fa cho dɩ ba nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ma ma sɩɩ nɩɩ, aŋ ka ba bɩ wuo nɩɩ.” Yesu dagɛ nɩaa ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a cho ba dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa

english_verse: On the day of judgment the people of Tyre and Sidon will get off easier than you will.
translation_verse: Sarɩya chɛ-diiliŋ, Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Kɔrazɩŋ arɩ Bɛtɩsaada tɩŋŋaa a kɩɩ Taaya arɩ Sɩdɔŋ tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? Well, you will go down to hell!
translation_verse: Ma-na Kapɛnam tɩŋŋaa, ma nɛ paala chɩchɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa a kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ. Ama Wɩa jaŋ jomma yuo ta dɩ ma tuu jʋʋ Wɩa nyiniŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus told them: I saw Satan fall from heaven like a flash of lightning.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ na Sɩtaanɩ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ tuu tel a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩɩ lɩgɩsɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: I have given you the power to trample on snakes and scorpions and to defeat the power of your enemy Satan. Nothing can harm you.
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ pɩma doluŋ nɛ dɩ ma wuo vɩvɛŋ dɩŋŋaa arɩ nʋɔmaa tʋɔŋ, ka ba bɩ ma wuo dɩŋ. Mɩ pɩma doluŋ dɩ ma wuo Sɩtaanɩ maa. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaama wʋbɔŋ kala.

english_verse: An expert in the Law of Moses stood up and asked Jesus a question to see what he would say. “Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ kerichi kʋbala kɔ a wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ʋ magɩsɛ Yesu a pɩɛsʋ, “Kʋhɩaŋ, bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ?”

english_verse: The man replied, “The Scriptures say, ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, strength, and mind.’ They also say, ‘Love your neighbors as much as you love yourself.’ ”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋla pʋ, “Ba sɩ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ ŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ ŋ wɩɩ-wɩɩkala cho ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa, a cho ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna ma arɩ ŋ sɩ cho ŋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: At that same time, Jesus felt the joy that comes from the Holy Spirit, and he said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people. Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ Yesu tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ Nyɩmma, ŋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala Tɩɩna. Mɩɩ lɔllʋŋ arɩ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ joŋo faa a dagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ, aŋ bɩ joŋo dagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Mɩ Nyɩmma, mɩɩ lɔllʋŋ. Ŋ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who really knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ Nyɩmma joŋ kʋŋkala doluŋ nɛ pɩmɛ. Mɩ Nyɩmma dʋndʋŋa nɛ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ naga. Mɩ ma dʋndʋŋa nɛ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ Nyɩmma ma sɩ naga. Nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ ʋ jɩŋ, see nɩalɩŋ dʋndʋŋa mɩ sɩ cho dɩ mɩ daga.”

english_verse: Jesus then turned to his disciples and said to them in private, “You are really blessed to see what you see!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mɩɩra daasɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la aŋ bʋla pɩ ba dʋndʋŋa, “Ma nyuŋ sɩma nɛ ma sɩ na wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ na.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is written in the Scriptures? How do you understand them?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ? Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ yie karɩmɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You have given the right answer. If you do this, you will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: But the man wanted to show that he knew what he was talking about. So he asked Jesus, “Who are my neighbors?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ kerichi-la chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ dagɛ arɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛ Yesu, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa mɩ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: As a man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, robbers attacked him and grabbed everything he had. They beat him up and ran off, leaving him half dead.
translation_verse: Yesu magɛ namaga a bʋl, “Baal kʋbala nɛ sie a lɩɩ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Jerusalɛm a mʋmʋ Jeriko. Ʋ fa ŋaa Juu tɩɩna nɛ. Ʋ sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ mʋ jʋʋ gaaraa tʋɔŋ. Ba kɛnʋ a wuri ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kala aŋ ŋmobu a bolimu aŋ fá lɛl, ka ʋ pɩŋ nɩmɛ a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: A priest happened to be going down the same road. But when he saw the man, he walked by on the other side.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, ba tʋɔŋ kʋbala ma joŋ wombii-la aa vɛŋ. Ʋ sɩ kʋ a naʋ, ʋ to sɛmɛ dɔŋ nɛ a kpɛrɛ bal.

english_verse: A man from Samaria then came traveling along that road. When he saw the man, he felt sorry for him
translation_verse: Ka Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa baal kʋbala ma fa joŋ wombii-la a vɛnɛɛ kɔ. Ʋ sɩ naʋ, nenige kɛnʋ.

english_verse: and went over to him. He treated his wounds with olive oil and wine and bandaged them. Then he put him on his own donkey and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.
translation_verse: Ʋ mʋ ʋ teeŋ a chɛsɛ ʋ naawɩɩlaa a hɛ daalusuŋ aŋ vɔɔ, aŋ joŋu hɛ ʋ tɩtɩa kakumo lɛ a kɛnʋ kaa mʋ nʋhʋɔraa dɩa kʋbala aa benu.

english_verse: The next morning he gave the innkeeper two silver coins and said, “Please take care of the man. If you spend more than this on him, I will pay you when I return.”
translation_verse: Taŋ-pʋl ʋ joŋ siidi zɔlɔ a pɩ dɩa tɩɩna aŋ bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ ʋ nyuŋ woruŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ mɩɩra kɔ, ʋ jaŋ tiŋ ʋ sɩ ŋmoo chɩmɩŋ magɛ ŋɩɩ kala.”

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “Which one of these three people was a real neighbor to the man who was beaten up by robbers?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛ Wɩa teniŋ kerichi-la, “Nɩaa deemba batorumuŋ tʋɔŋ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa baal-la sɩ jʋʋ gaaraa tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna? Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ bɩɩnɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ?”

english_verse: The expert in the Law of Moses answered, “The one who showed pity.” Jesus said, “Go and do the same!” Martha and Mary
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ kerichi-la bʋl, “Baal-la sɩ fá ʋ nisusuŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Tɔɔ, ŋ ma mʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa.” Yesu mʋ Maata arɩ Mɛɛrɩ dɩa

english_verse: The Lord and his disciples were traveling along and came to a village. When they got there, a woman named Martha welcomed him into her home.
translation_verse: Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo sɩ joŋ wombiiŋ mʋmʋ ŋɩɩ, ba kɔ taŋ kʋbala, dɩ haal kʋbala ma hɛ nɩmɛ, baa yɩrɛ Maata. Ʋ kɛŋ Yesu kaa jʋʋ ʋ dɩa.

english_verse: She had a sister named Mary, who sat down in front of the Lord and was listening to what he said.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaana ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ, baa yɩrʋ Mɛɛrɩ. Yesu sɩ hɔŋ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ kʋ hɔŋ Yesu sɛmɛ a jegilee nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl,

english_verse: Martha was worried about all that had to be done. Finally, she went to Jesus and said, “Lord, doesn't it bother you that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her to come and help me!”
translation_verse: ka Maata fɩɛsɛ sii a ŋɩŋaa kʋdiilee dɩ ʋ pɩ Yesu a kala lɔl. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ na baanɩŋ Mɛɛrɩ nyuŋ a kʋ lɩɩ, a bʋla pɩ Yesu, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ bɩɩna ʋ zɔmɔ nɛ mɩ ŋaana sɩ leŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa kala pɩmɛ mɩ tɩtɩŋ? Leŋ dɩ ʋ kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Martha, Martha! You are worried and upset about so many things,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Maata, wɩaa yʋga nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a wʋwalɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: but only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen what is best, and it will not be taken away from her.”
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ chɛ wʋbala dʋndʋŋ nɛ. Wɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ Mɛɛrɩ lɩɩsɛ ŋɩɩ. Wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo kaa laa ʋ teeŋ.”

english_verse: So I tell you to ask and you will receive, search and you will find, knock and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, má sʋl kɩaa, ma jaŋ laa. Má chɛ kɩaa, ma jaŋ na. Má du boro, ba jaŋ kaa suro pɩma.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give the Holy Spirit to anyone who asks. Jesus and the Ruler of Demons (Matthew
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bɔmɔ aŋ joŋ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ pɩpɩ ma biiriŋ, ɛɛ nɛ ma Nyɩmma sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ bɩ jaŋ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋla chɩchɛ?” Yesu arɩ Bɛlizibul Mat.

english_verse: And suppose your friend answers, “Don't bother me! The door is bolted, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you something.”
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩɩna arɩ ŋ nandɔŋ-la nɛ hɛ dɩa tʋɔŋ aŋ bʋla pɩŋ, ‘Sɩ́ mɩ walɩmʋ, boiŋ yaga nɛ. Ka la dɩ mɩ biiriŋ pɩŋ doŋ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo sii a pɩŋ kʋŋkala.’

english_verse: Which one of you fathers would give your hungry child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Nyɩŋ bɛɛ nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ sɩ jaŋ joŋ dɩmɩŋ a pɩ ʋ bie dɩ ʋ nɛ pɩɛsa chɩchɛ chenfiliŋ?

english_verse: So Jesus told them, “Pray in this way: ‘Father, help us to honor your name. Come and set up your kingdom.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Ŋ-la nɛ ma jaŋ chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa: Má bʋl, ‘La Nyɩmma, leŋ dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ, leŋ dɩ ŋ kuorii-la kɔ.

english_verse: Forgive our sins, as we forgive everyone who has done wrong to us. And keep us from being tempted.’ ”
translation_verse: Joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛla arɩ la ma sɩ joŋ la dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba ŋɩɩ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩɩkala kɛnla hɛ wʋbɔmʋŋ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive, everyone who searches will find, and the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ sʋl kɩaa Wɩa teeŋ, ʋ yie laa nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ chɛ kɩaa, ʋ yie na nɛ. Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ du boro, ba yie kaa suro pʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Just as Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, the Son of Man will be a sign to the people of today.
translation_verse: Wɩa joŋ Jona a kɛnʋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlɩŋ Nɩnɩvɛ nɩaa teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ jaŋ joŋ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie ma a kɛmmɛ ŋaa wʋmagɩlɩŋ jɩnɩŋ nɩaa teeŋ.”

english_verse: While Jesus was still talking, a woman in the crowd spoke up, “The woman who gave birth to you and nursed you is blessed!”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, dɩ haal kʋbala fa hɛ nɩ-daŋ-la tʋɔŋ a faasa bʋla pʋ, “Wɩa jaŋ pɛ haal-la sɩ lʋlʋŋ lɛ a dɩɛsɩŋ arɩ yɩlɩŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus forced a demon out of a man who could not talk. And after the demon had gone out, the man started speaking, and the crowds were amazed.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala ma nɛ fa kɔ Yesu teeŋ. Jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ kɛnʋ a ŋaa ʋ taŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu ŋaa jɩŋ-bɔŋ-la lɩɩ baal-la lɛ, ka baal-la wuo bʋbʋl wɩaa. Nɩ-daŋ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a na wɩɩ-la, ʋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere.

english_verse: Others wanted to put Jesus to the test. So they asked him to show them a sign from God.
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma chɩchɛ dɩ ba magɩsʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sɩ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlɩŋ dɩ ba na a jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa doluŋ nɛ ʋ kaa ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said: A kingdom where people fight each other will end up in ruin. And a family that fights will break up.
translation_verse: Yesu wuo jɩŋ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa a bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ taŋ nɩaa nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a bɩ nii-bala kɛnɛ, ba taŋ jaŋ tel. Dɩ naambiiriŋ ma nɛ bɩ nii-bala kɛnɛ, ba dɩa jaŋ tel.

english_verse: If Satan fights against himself, how can his kingdom last? Yet you say that I force out demons by the power of Beelzebul.
translation_verse: Dɩ Sɩtaanɩ nɩaa nɛ bɩ nii-bala kɛnɛ, ba taŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ. Ma bʋla arɩ Bɛlizibul nɛ pɩmɛ doluŋ mɩ kaa kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: If I use his power to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? They are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɩɩ kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ Bɛlizibul doluŋ lɛ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa joŋ doluŋ pɩ nɩaa deemba sɩɩ to ma harɩŋ ba ma kikiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɩaa lɛ? Nɩaa deemba tɩtɩa daga arɩ maa nyɩɛ nɛ.

english_verse: When a strong man arms himself and guards his home, everything he owns is safe.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩduoŋ nɛ vɔɔ ʋ tʋɔnʋŋ a hɔnɔ pɔ ʋ dɩa, nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ dɩa kʋŋkala wuo jʋʋ joŋ.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You love the front seats in the synagogues, and you like to be greeted with honor in the market.
translation_verse: Ma Farisii tɩŋŋaa, ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ, ma yie cho nɩbalaa dɩhɔnʋŋ nɛ. Dɩ ma nɩɩ gɔllɛ yɔbɔ lɛ maa, ma yie cho dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ zilma a chʋchʋɔlɛma.

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses spoke up, “Teacher, you said cruel things about us.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, dɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichi dɔŋɔ bʋla pʋ, “Kʋhɩaŋ, ŋ sɩ bʋl ŋ-la, ŋ tʋʋsɛla ma nɛ.”

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when it doesn't find a place, it says, “I will go back to the home I left.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩaa, “Dɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋ nɛ lɩɩ nʋʋ lɛ, ʋ yie gɔllɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ a chɩchɛ dɩ-wiesiŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ lee na, ʋ yie bʋl ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ, ‘Mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ lee-la mɩ sɩ lɩa.’

english_verse: When it gets there and finds the place clean and fixed up,
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra mʋmʋ, dɩ disiniŋ tuo dɩa-la lɛ, ba wasʋ ʋ kala zɔŋ.

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and that person ends up in worse shape than before. Being Really Blessed
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra lɩɩ, a kɛŋ jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ balɩpɛ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɔmɔ kɩɩʋ, dɩ ba ma kʋ jʋʋ a pɛ ʋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ baal-la yie wasa kperi a kɩɩ bumbuŋ-la.” Ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ kɩŋkɛŋ

english_verse: Jesus replied, “That's true, but the people who are really blessed are the ones who hear and obey God's message!” A Sign from God (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mɩɩra bʋla pʋ, “Nɩɩ-la sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa a tutoba, ʋ-na tɩɩna tʋɔŋ nɛ jaŋ tɔrɛ.” Nɩalɩŋ chɛ dɩ Yesu ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa Mat.

english_verse: The Pharisee was surprised that he did not wash his hands before eating.
translation_verse: Farisii tɩɩna-la sɩ na ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaaʋ wʋkpuŋkpere.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your gardens, such as mint and rue. But you cheat people, and you don't love God. You should be fair and kind to others and still give a tenth to God.
translation_verse: Ma Farisii tɩŋŋaa, ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Kʋbiisiŋ ma yie kaa kpaa leree fii fii, a joŋ leriŋ kʋbala a pɩ Wɩa. Dɩ ma nɛ jaa pɩpaarɩ-la sʋɔra sɩ sɩma arɩ pɩpaarɩ-la sʋɔra sɩ bɩ sɩŋ arɩ pɩpaa-diilee maa, ma yie kɛmba kaa kpaa leree fii fii, a joŋ ba kʋŋkala leriŋ dɔŋɔ a pɩ Wɩa, ama ma vɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiiŋ a bɩ Wɩa cho. Ʋ maga dɩ ma kpaa ma kɩalɩŋ leree fii fii, a joŋ leriŋ kʋbala a pɩ Wɩa, ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma vɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiiŋ.

english_verse: As crowds were gathering around Jesus, he said: You people of today are evil! You keep looking for a sign from God. But what happened to Jonah is the only sign you will be given.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ golli Yesu ŋɩɩ, ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Bee na, jɩnɩŋ nɩaa deemba bɔmɔ nɛ. Ba sɩ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋmagɩlɩŋ dɩ ba na a jɩŋ arɩ mɩ dol-la lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ. Aɩ, mɩ bɩ ŋaa. Wʋmagɩlɩŋ ma sɩɩ chɛ, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo na, see wʋmagɩl-la Wɩa fa sɩ ŋaa a tɩgɛ Jona lɛ.

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a clay pot. A lamp is put on a lampstand, so everyone who comes into the house can see the light.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra dagɛ nɩaa a bʋl, “Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ nyɩgɛ chaanɩŋ ʋ dɩa lɛ a joŋo faa koo a joŋ gbaŋa chu tɔ. Ʋ yie joŋo daŋ chaaŋ daaŋ nyuŋ nɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kʋ jʋʋ dɩ ʋ wuo na pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: Your eyes are the lamp for your body. When your eyes are good, you have all the light you need. But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩaa nɛ ŋaa ŋ yaraa pʋlʋmʋŋ. Dɩ ŋ sɩaa nɛ zɔmɔ, ŋ yaraa kala kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ nɛ, ama dɩ ŋ sɩaa nɛ bɩ zɔŋ, ŋ yaraa kala hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: So be sure your light isn't darkness.
translation_verse: Má pɔ dɩ pʋlʋŋ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ sɩ́ birimiŋ bɩrɩmʋ.

english_verse: You fools! Didn't God make both the outside and the inside?
translation_verse: Ma ŋaa nɩyaara nɛ. Wɩa sɩ ŋaa ma harɩŋ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa ma tʋɔŋ ma.

english_verse: Yes, you are really in for trouble. You build monuments to honor the prophets your own people murdered long ago.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma saa vaamaa pɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la nɛ, ma naabalɩmaba nɛ fa kpʋba.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him home for a meal. Jesus went and sat down to eat.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɛrɛ, Farisii tɩɩna kʋbala yɩrʋ dɩ ʋ kɔ ʋ dɩa a dii kʋdiilee. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mʋ hɔŋ dɩ ʋ dii kʋdiile-la. Ʋ bɩ lɩɩŋ sɔmɔ aŋ didii kʋdiile-la.

english_verse: If you would only give what you have to the poor, everything you do would please God.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ pʋllɛ, má kɛŋ ma tʋɔŋ a cho summoo a fɩfá ba nenige.

english_verse: But you are in for trouble! You are like unmarked graves that people walk on without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ. Ma nagɛ vaamaa ba sɩ kaa jɛrɛ, dɩ ba dɩ tinteeŋ kala magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, ka nɩaa bɩ jɩŋ aŋ vɩvɛŋ ba nyuŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: You teachers are also in for trouble! You load people down with heavy burdens, but you won't lift a finger to help them carry the loads.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Ma-na Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba, ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Ma yie joŋ chʋga a daŋ nɩaa harɩŋ lɛ, ka ba bɩ wuo chʋŋ. Aŋ ka ma tɩtɩa bɩ jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ a laa chʋga-la.

english_verse: You must think that was the right thing for your people to do, or else you would not have built monuments for the prophets they murdered.
translation_verse: Ma sɛɩ wɩalɩŋ ma naabalɩmaba sɩ ŋaa nɛ a bʋl dɩ ba ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Ba kpʋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ, ma ma nɛ saa ba vaamaa.

english_verse: Because of your evil deeds, the Wisdom of God said, “I will send prophets and apostles to you. But you will murder some and mistreat others.”
translation_verse: A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa, ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Wɩa wʋjɩmɩŋ a bʋl, ‘Mɩ jaŋ ta mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ mɩ nanzɔɔba dɩ ba mʋ ba teeŋ. Ba jaŋ kpʋ dɔnsʋŋ aŋ to dɔnsʋŋ naasɩŋ a dɔgɩsɛba.’

english_verse: You people living today will be punished for all the prophets who have been murdered since the beginning of the world.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ jɩnɩŋ nɩaa a tɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋ ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa a lɩɩ dʋnɩa dɩ-suomuŋ,

english_verse: This includes every prophet from the time of Abel to the time of Zechariah, who was murdered between the altar and the temple. You people will certainly be punished for all of this.
translation_verse: a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kpʋ Ebil a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kpʋ Zɛkarɩya. Ba kpʋʋ Wɩa dɩa tʋɔŋ nɛ a kpagɛ koru-la nyuŋ ba sɩ yie ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ jɩnɩŋ nɩaa kala kɩŋkɛŋ a tɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala lɛ.

english_verse: You teachers of the Law of Moses are really in for trouble! You carry the keys to the door of knowledge about God. But you never go in, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: Ma Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba, ma ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ. Ma tɔ wombii-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ na wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ. Ma tɩtɩa bɩ chɛ dɩ ma to wombiiŋ deeŋ, aŋ pɔ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ walɩmɛ dɩ ba to sɩ́ to.”

english_verse: Jesus was about to leave, but the teachers and the Pharisees wanted to get even with him. They tried to make him say what he thought about other things,
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ lɩɩ lee-la, Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba-la arɩ Farisii tɩmma-la suomo chaasa bʋl wɩaa a lɩlɩɩ ʋ harɩŋ a pɩɛsʋ wɩaa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: so they could catch him saying something wrong.
translation_verse: Baa walɩmɛ dɩ ba bɛrɛ kɛnʋ dɩ ʋ nɛ bʋl wɩɩ chei.

english_verse: As thousands of people crowded around Jesus and were stepping on each other, he told his disciples: Be sure to guard against the dishonest teaching of the Pharisees! It is their way of fooling people.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ kɔ Yesu teeŋ, ba yi nɩaa bʋɩ bʋɩ a yiyigi dɔŋɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu laa sɩpaaŋ a bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “Má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa. Ba ŋaa kanfugi tɩmma nɛ. Ba nagɛ sɩbʋrʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. Won't he do even more for you? You have such little faith!
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ yie ŋaa yaŋ nyʋ a waa a zɔŋ, ka ʋ bɩ dieni aŋ hɩhɩl. Dɩ ʋ nɛ hɩla, ba yie chol nyiniŋ hɛ ʋ dii. Dɩ Wɩa nɛ wuo ŋaa yaŋ zɔŋ ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo pɩma kʋdiilee arɩ gɛnnɩŋ? Ma Wɩa laa diiniŋ bɩ yʋgɛ.

english_verse: But put God's work first, and these things will be yours as well. Treasures in Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má laa sɩpaaŋ a chɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ. Ʋ jaŋ joŋ kɩaa deemba kala pɛ pɩma.” Ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a kɛŋ kɩaa Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ Mat.

english_verse: My friends, don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but after that, there is nothing else they can do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ nandɔnsʋŋ, mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, má sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo kpʋ ma yaraa lɛ fá, aŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaama wɩɩ dɔŋ kala.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted. So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Matthew
translation_verse: Wɩa paala jɩŋ ma nyu-pʋnaa kala ma niiŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma. Ma nɛ paala kɩɩ zaarɩ-kokobiisiŋ a yʋgɛ.

english_verse: My little group of disciples, don't be afraid! Your Father wants to give you the kingdom.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tomi, ma bɩ yʋgɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma. Ma Nyɩmma tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ kuorii-la pɩma.

english_verse: Sell what you have and give the money to the poor. Make yourselves moneybags that never wear out. Make sure your treasure is safe in heaven, where thieves cannot steal it and moths cannot destroy it.
translation_verse: Má joŋ ma kɩaa kala yallɛ a joŋ moribie-la a pɩ summoo. Má chɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ chei a bil ma tɩtɩa lɛ, a joŋ ma kɩaa bil Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. Nɩmɛ ba bɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ, gaarʋ kala bɩ jaŋ wuo paaba, pʋgʋmaa ma bɩ jaŋ diiba.

english_verse: At that time the Holy Spirit will tell you what to say. A Rich Fool
translation_verse: Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ jaŋ dagɛma wɩɩ-la ma sɩ jaŋ bʋl.” Yesu magɛ namaga a tɩgɛ bagɩ-daarɩ tʋɔ-luŋ tɩɩna lɛ

english_verse: But God said to him, “You fool! Tonight you will die. Then who will get what you have stored up?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋla pʋ, ‘Nɩyaarɩ! Tɩtaŋɩŋ deeŋ mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ sʋʋ. Kɩalɩŋ saa ŋ sɩ chɛ bil ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ dii?’ ”

english_verse: If you tell others that you belong to me, the Son of Man will tell God's angels that you are my followers.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl nɩaa tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ nʋʋ nɛ, mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie ma jaŋ bʋl ŋɩɩ a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: But if you reject me, you will be rejected in front of them.
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩamɛ nɩaa tʋɔŋ, mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie ma jaŋ vɩaʋ Wɩa tɩndaaraa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: When you are brought to trial in the synagogues or before rulers or officials, don't worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ kɛmma kaa jʋʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ dɩ ba diima sarɩya koo dɩ ba nɛ kɛmma mʋ kuoroo arɩ kʋhɩasɩŋ teeŋ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma bɔɩsɩŋ joŋ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a laa ma tɩtɩa, koo wɩɩ-na kala ma sɩ jaŋ bʋl.

english_verse: A man in a crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, tell my brother to give me my share of what our father left us when he died.”
translation_verse: Yesu fa sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩ-daŋ-la ŋɩɩ, baal kʋbala lɩɩ ba tʋɔŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, la nyɩmma sʋba nɛ aŋ ka kɩaa. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ bʋla pɩ mɩ naambie dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ la kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kaa kpaa.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Who gave me the right to settle arguments between you and your brother?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ nandɔŋ, mɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ dee dɩ mɩ laa ma sarɩya dii pɩma koo dɩ mɩ kɛŋ ma kɩaa kaa kpaama.”

english_verse: Then he said to the crowd, “Don't be greedy! Owning a lot of things won't make your life safe.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a sɩ́ tʋɔ-luŋuŋ kɛŋ. Dɩ nuhuobiine nɛ kɛŋ kɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ, kɩalɩŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: and he said to himself, “What can I do? I don't have a place large enough to store everything.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩɩnɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ, ‘Ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa? Mɩ bɩra bɩ leriŋ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ tʋɔlɛ mɩ kɩaa.’

english_verse: Later, he said, “Now I know what I'll do. I'll tear down my barns and build bigger ones, where I can store all my grain and other goods.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, ‘Mɩ jaŋ ŋmoo mɩ virisiŋ deemba mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ a ta aŋ wasa saa kʋbalaa. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ kuori-mɩaa arɩ mɩ kɩaa kala a tʋɔlɛ nɩmɛ

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I tell you not to worry about your life! Don't worry about having something to eat or wear.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa walɩmʋ a tɩgɛ kʋdiile-la ma sɩ jaŋ dii koo gɛnnɩ-la ma sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma laalɛ.

english_verse: Life is more than food or clothing.
translation_verse: Ma mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ kɩɩ kʋdiilee, ma yaraa ma kɩɩ gɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Look how the wild flowers grow! They don't work hard to make their clothes. But I tell you Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of these flowers.
translation_verse: Má bee na tɩɩfɩɩlaa. Ba bɩ tɩŋ, ba bɩ gɛnnɩŋ ma yɛrɛ a lɩlaalɛ, ama ba zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ. Kuoru Solomoŋ fa kɛŋ kɩaa nɛ woruŋ. Ama ʋ gɛnnɩŋ fa bɩ zɔmɔ magɛ tɩɩfɩɩlaa deemba.

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father knows what you need.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, ba nɛ yie walɩma chɩchɛ kɩaa deemba. Ma Nyɩmma jɩma arɩ maa chɛ kɩaa deemba nɛ.

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks that the master won't return until late. Suppose that servant starts beating all the other servants and eats and drinks and gets drunk.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ tɩntɩnnʋ-la nɛ bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la jaŋ dieni, aŋ suomo ŋmuŋmoo ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔsʋ-la, baalaa arɩ haalaa kala, aŋ faasa didii kʋdiilee a nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bubugi,

english_verse: Do you think that I came to bring peace to earth? No indeed! I came to make people choose sides.
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna mɩ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ nɛ kaa kɔ dɩ mɩ pɩ dʋnɩa? Aɩ. Mɩ paala kɔ dɩ mɩ ŋaa dɩ nɩaa pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Be ready and keep your lamps burning
translation_verse: Má vɔɔ ma damɛrɩsɩŋ woruŋ a nyɩgɛ ma chaanaa, má ŋaa siri a gbɛrɛ,

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master finds them awake and ready when he comes! I promise you he will get ready and let his servants sit down so he can serve them.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba kʋhɩaŋ nɛ mɩɩra kɔ a na dɩ ba weye a ŋaa siri, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, ʋ jaŋ laalɛ gɛnnɩŋ aŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna-la hɔŋ, dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋdiilee pɩba dɩ ba dii.

english_verse: Those servants are really fortunate if their master finds them ready, even though he comes late at night or early in the morning.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ mɩɩra kɔ tɩta-siesee, koo dɩ ʋ nɛ paala kieli ŋɩɩ ma, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: You would surely not let a thief break into your home, if you knew when the thief was coming.
translation_verse: Ma jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ fa jɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ gaara sɩ jaŋ kʋ gaa ʋ kɩaa ʋ dɩa lɛ, ʋ fa jaŋ hɔnɔ pɔ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ gaara jʋʋ gaa ʋ kɩaa.

english_verse: Peter asked Jesus, “Did you say this just for us or for everyone?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta pɩɛsɛ Yesu, “La Tɩɩna, ŋ magɛ namaga deeŋ pɩpɩla nɛ koo ŋ maga pɩpɩ nʋʋkala nɛ?”

english_verse: The Lord answered: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna mɩɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa? Ʋ nɛ nɩɩ-la ʋ kʋhɩaŋ sɩ yie lɩɩsɛ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ ʋ dɩa, aŋ pɛ pɩpɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔsʋŋ ma kʋdiilee bʋa-la sɩ magɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job.
translation_verse: Dɩ tɩntɩnnʋ-la nɛ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ sɩ dagʋ, ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ bʋa-la lɛ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: A servant who is always faithful will surely be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la jaŋ joŋ ʋ kɩaa kala hɛ tɩntɩnna deeŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ.

english_verse: If that happens, the master will come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him. That servant will then be punished and thrown out with the servants who cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ siri ŋaa gbɛrɛ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la. Ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la jaŋ kɔ tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bɩ yɩɛla. Ʋ jaŋ dɔgɩsʋ woruŋ aŋ kɛnʋ kaa mʋ hɛ lee-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa nɩɩ sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: If servants are not ready or willing to do what their master wants them to do, they will be beaten hard.
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnnʋ-la sɩ jɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ʋ kʋhɩaŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ aŋ bɩ siri ŋaa dɩ ʋ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la, ʋ kʋhɩaŋ jaŋ chaasa vɩɩrʋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: But servants who don't know what their master wants them to do will not be beaten so hard for doing wrong. If God has been generous with you, he will expect you to serve him well. But if he has been more than generous, he will expect you to serve him even better. Not Peace, but Trouble (Matthew
translation_verse: Ama tɩntɩnnʋ-la sɩ bɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ʋ kʋhɩaŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ jɩŋ aŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ba vɩɩrʋ, ba jaŋ vɩɩrʋ mʋa. Dɩ ba nɛ joŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ a pɩ nʋʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba pɩɛsa laa kɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ nɩɩ-la teeŋ. Dɩ ba joŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ woruŋ a pɩ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ beŋ, ʋ ma maga dɩ ba pɩɛsa laa kɩaa yʋgɛ woruŋ ʋ teeŋ.” A tɩŋ Yesu wɩaa, nɩaa jaŋ pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ Mat.

english_verse: I came to set fire to the earth, and I wish it were already on fire!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ ŋaa dɩ dʋnɩa dii nyiniŋ nɛ. Mɩ saa fa cho dɩ ʋ suomo a didii nɛ lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: I am going to be put to a hard test. And I will have to suffer a lot of pain until it is over.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ jʋʋ hɛɛŋ dɩ ʋ nagɛ ba sɩ fomi Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ bɩ jaŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala see dɩ mɩ na hɛɛ-la dɛrɛ.

english_verse: A family of five will be divided, with two of them against the other three.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ, dɩ nɩaa banɔŋ nɛ ŋaa dɩa nɩaa, ba jaŋ pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Batori jaŋ yuyuo balɩa, dɩ balɩa-la ma yuyuo batori-la.

english_verse: Fathers and sons will turn against one another, and mothers and daughters will do the same. Mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law will also turn against each other. Knowing What To Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Nyɩmmaba arɩ ba hambolibiisiŋ jaŋ pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a gʋraa yuo dɔŋɔ. Naamba arɩ ba toloo ma jaŋ gʋraa yuo dɔŋɔ. Bala naamba arɩ ba bii-haalaa ma jaŋ gʋraa yuo dɔŋɔ.” Ʋ maga dɩ ma jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa lɛ bʋbʋɔŋ Mat.

english_verse: Jesus said to all the people: As soon as you see a cloud coming up in the west, you say, “It's going to rain,” and it does.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Dɩ ma nɛ na duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa dɩ ba nɛ lɩɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ a kʋʋ jɩl, ma yie bʋl dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ nɩɩ. Ʋ sɛnɛ nɩɩ.

english_verse: When the south wind blows, you say, “It's going to get hot,” and it does.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ bɩra na peliŋ dɩ ʋ lu a lɩɩ taŋ-bʋbʋɔŋ, ma yie bʋl dɩ leriŋ jaŋ lɩŋ. Ʋ sɛnɛ lɩŋ.

english_verse: Are you trying to fool someone? You can predict the weather by looking at the earth and sky, but you don't really know what's going on right now.
translation_verse: Ma kanfugi tɩŋŋaa deemba, ma yie wuo beŋ tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ, a wuo dagɛ wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ lɛɛlɛ?” Wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa Mat.
