english_verse: When someone accuses you of something, try to settle things before you are taken to court. If you don't, you will be dragged before the judge. Then the judge will hand you over to the jailer, and you will be locked up.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ samɩŋ a kɛnɩŋ mʋmʋ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ, hɛ doluŋ ka dɩ ma bʋl wɩɩ-la wasɛ wombiiŋ lɛ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ʋ jaŋ lɛrɩŋ mʋ sarɩya diire teeŋ. Sarɩya diire jaŋ joŋuŋ hɛ porisiba nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba kɛnɩŋ mʋ tɔ dɩa.

english_verse: You won't get out until you have paid the last cent you owe.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ kɛnɩŋ mʋ tɔ dɩa, ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo lɩɩ, see dɩ ŋ tiŋ chɩŋ-la kala ba sɩ kere pɩŋ.”

english_verse: About this same time Jesus was told that Pilate had given orders for some people from Galilee to be killed while they were offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Yesu fa sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa, nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ bʋl wɩaa pʋ a mʋ tɩgɛ Paalɩt lɛ. Ʋ fa kpʋ Galilii tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you think that these people were worse sinners than everyone else in Galilee just because of what happened to them?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛba, “Ma bɩɩna arɩ Galilii tɩŋŋaa deemba Paalɩt sɩ kpʋa nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ a kɩɩ Galilii tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ kalaa?

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also be killed.
translation_verse: Aɩ, ŋɩɩ dee. Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, ma kala jaŋ sʋʋ arɩ nɩaa deemba sɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jesus said, “What is God's kingdom like? What can I compare it with?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ a bʋl, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Wɩa kuorii-la kaa magɩsɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ Wɩa kuorii-la nagɛ?

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also die. A Story about a Fig Tree
translation_verse: Aɩ, ŋɩɩ dee. Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, dɩ ma kala bɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, ma kala jaŋ sʋʋ a nagɛ nɩaa deemba fa sɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ.” Yesu magɛ namaga a tɩgɛ tɩa sɩ bɩ nɛŋ lɛ

english_verse: Jesus then told them this story: A man had a fig tree growing in his vineyard. One day he went out to pick some figs, but he didn't find any.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu magɛ namaga deeŋ, “Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ fa kɛŋ tutogo nɛ ʋ baga lɛ. Tutogo-la nɛnɩŋ yi, ʋ mʋ a chɩchɛ nɛnɛɛ tutogo-la lɛ. Ʋ bɩ nɛŋ kala na.

english_verse: The gardener answered, “Master, leave it for another year. I'll dig around it and put some manure on it to make it grow.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ bagɩ-paarʋ-la bʋla pʋ, ‘Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, leŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ jɩna deeŋ ma lɛ dɩ la na. Mɩ jaŋ huro golli ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ a hɛ na-bɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: Maybe it will have figs on it next year. If it doesn't, you can have it cut down.” Healing a Woman on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ nɛnɛ harɩŋ jɩna-la lɛ, ʋ zɔmɔ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ nɛnɛ, kere ta.’ ” Yesu vaarɛ gʋma tɩɩna

english_verse: One Sabbath, Jesus was teaching in a synagogue,
translation_verse: Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛ kʋbala Yesu jʋʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa a dɩdagɛ nɩaa Wɩa wɩaa.

english_verse: and a woman was there who had been crippled by an evil spirit for
translation_verse: Dɩ haal kʋbala hɛ nɩmɛ, jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ kɛnʋ ʋ wɩɩlɛ ŋɩɩ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ chori. Ʋ fa kɛnʋ bori nɛ, ʋ bɩ wuo tɩɛnaa chɩŋ.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the woman, he called her over and said, “You are now well.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ na haal-la, ʋ yɩrʋ ʋ kɔ ʋ teeŋ, ʋ bʋl, “Haal, ŋ duoro nɛ. Ŋ nyanyalɩɩ-la lɩɩ ŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Are you trying to fool someone? Won't any one of you untie your ox or donkey and lead it out to drink on a Sabbath?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna bʋla pʋ, “Ma kanfugi tɩŋŋaa deemba, ma tʋɔŋ kʋbɛɛ nɛ bɩ ʋ nɛŋ koo ʋ kakumo puro kaa lɩɩ ʋ nyʋnyʋa lɩɩŋ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ?

english_verse: This woman belongs to the family of Abraham, but Satan has kept her bound for
translation_verse: Haala deeŋ ŋaa Abɩraham doho nʋʋ nɛ. Sɩtaanɩ kɛnʋ vɔɔ bil jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ chori. Ʋ saa bɩ maga dɩ la laaʋ ta chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ koo?”

english_verse: Jesus' words made his enemies ashamed. But everyone else in the crowd was happy about the wonderful things he was doing. A Mustard Seed and Yeast (Matthew
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, hɩɩsɩŋ kɛŋ ʋ dʋndɔmɔ-la kala, aŋ ka nɩalɩŋ kʋkaanaa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la Yesu fa sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ. Yesu magɛ namaga a mʋ tɩgɛ kʋdoho kʋbala lɛ baa yɩrɛ masɩtad Mat.

english_verse: At that time some Pharisees came to Jesus and said, “You had better get away from here, because Herod wants to kill you!”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ kɔ Yesu teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Lɩɩ daha a mʋ lee dɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Hɛrɔd ka chɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: But I am going on my way today and tomorrow and the next day. After all, Jerusalem is the place where prophets are killed. Jesus Loves Jerusalem (Matthew
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, ʋ maga dɩ mɩ ha hɛ mɩ wombiiŋ lɛ jɩnɩŋ arɩ chie arɩ chietuo kala. Ʋ bɩ wombii kɛnɛ dɩ ba kpʋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa lee-kala see Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: There the ones who are now least important will be the most important, and those who are now most important will be least important. Jesus and Herod
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ harɩ-tooroo, dɩ harɩ-tooroo ma bɩrɩmɛ sɩpaalaaraa.” Yesu cho Jerusalɛm nɩaa Mat.

english_verse: Jesus said to them: Go tell that fox, “I am going to force out demons and heal people today and tomorrow, and three days later I'll be through.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má mʋ bʋla pɩ nyɩnyɩsɛrʋ-la, mɩ jaŋ kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ vaarɛ nɩaa jɩnɩŋ arɩ chie. Chietuo mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ mɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa dɛrɛ.

english_verse: It is like what happens when someone plants a mustard seed in a garden. The seed grows as big as a tree, and birds nest in its branches.”
translation_verse: Ʋ nagɛ kʋdoho kʋbala ba kaa yɩrɛ masɩtad nɛ. Baal kʋbala joŋo duu ʋ baga lɛ. Ʋ nyʋ a waa a bɩrɩmɛ tɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ diibiisiŋ kʋ sʋa ba dɛllɩŋ ʋ naakelee lɛ.” Yesu magɛ namaga a mʋ tɩgɛ sɩbʋrʋŋ lɛ Mat.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “What can I compare God's kingdom with?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ mɩ bɩra jaŋ kɛŋ Wɩa kuorii-la a kaa magɩsɛ?

english_verse: As Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, he taught the people in the towns and villages.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu mʋmʋ Jerusalɛm dɩɩrɩŋ, a gɔllɛ tabalaa arɩ tabiisiŋ a dɩdagɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: Do all you can to go in by the narrow door! A lot of people will try to get in, but will not be able to.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ maga arɩ ma to boi-la sɩ bɩ jal nɛ. Má hɛ doluŋ a to boi-la a jʋʋ. Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ba to lee-la jʋʋ aŋ walɩma lɔl.

english_verse: Once the owner of the house gets up and locks the door, you will be left standing outside. You will knock on the door and say, “Sir, open the door for us!” But the owner will answer, “I don't know a thing about you!”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala dɩa-la tɩɩna jaŋ sii a kɛŋ ʋ boiŋ tɔ. Ka ŋ-na jaŋ hɛ jeeŋ harɩŋ a du boro a sʋsʋl, ‘La Tɩɩna, kɛŋ boro suro pɩla.’ Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, ‘Mɩ bɩ lee-la ma sɩ lɩa jɩŋ.’

english_verse: Then you will start saying, “We dined with you, and you taught in our streets.”
translation_verse: Ma ma jaŋ bʋla pʋ, ‘La dɩ ma kala nɛ fa hɔŋ dɩ-bala a dii kɩaa. Ŋ dagɛla ŋ wɩaa la jaŋ ma lɛ.’

english_verse: But he will say, “I really don't know who you are! Get away from me, you evil people!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jaŋ bɩra bʋla pɩma, ‘Mɩ bɩ lee-la ma sɩ lɩa jɩŋ. Má sʋʋsa lɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Ma kala ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ nɛ.’

english_verse: Then when you have been thrown outside, you will weep and grit your teeth because you will see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God's kingdom.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala ma jaŋ na Abɩraham arɩ Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb, arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa kala dɩ ba hɔŋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ, ka ma-na jaŋ hɛ jeeŋ harɩŋ a na baanɩŋ a yiyel aŋ dɩdɩŋ ma nyɩlaa, aŋ bɩ wuo jʋʋ.

english_verse: People will come from all directions and sit down to feast in God's kingdom.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ lɩɩ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ-na kala a hɔŋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ aa gbieli.

english_verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Your people have killed the prophets and have stoned the messengers who were sent to you. I have often wanted to gather your people, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But you wouldn't let me.
translation_verse: Ma Jerusalɛm nɩaa, ma yie kpʋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa, a joŋ tabɩaa a yagɛ tɩndaara-la Wɩa sɩ tɩma dɩ ba kɔ ma teeŋ. Naansɩɩŋ yʋga nɛ mɩ fa cho dɩ mɩ chu tɔ ma nɩaa kala, arɩ jimiŋ sɩ yie chu tɔ ʋ biiriŋ ŋɩɩ, ka ma bɩ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: Now your temple will be deserted. You won't see me again until the time when you say, “Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Bee na, Wɩa jaŋ leŋ ma jáŋ pɩma. Ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ namɛ, see bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ jaŋ chʋɔlɛmɛ a bʋl, ‘Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ kɔ La Tɩɩna Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: All of a sudden a man with swollen legs stood up in front of him.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal kʋbala nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a kɔ Yesu teeŋ. Ʋ yaraa kala fa ŋmɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus turned and asked the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses, “Is it right to heal on the Sabbath?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba arɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa a bʋl, “Ʋ kɛŋ wombiiŋ nɛɛ dɩ la vaarɛ nyanyal tɩŋŋaa chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ koo?”

english_verse: But they did not say a word. Jesus took hold of the man. Then he healed him and sent him away.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu kɛŋ baal-la a vaarʋ aŋ taʋ ʋ mʋ dɩa,

english_verse: There was nothing they could say. How To Be a Guest
translation_verse: Ba bɩ wɩɩkala wuo bʋla pʋ. Yesu bʋla pɩ nɩaa dɩ ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri, a kɛŋ zile, a hʋhʋɔrɛ nɩaa

english_verse: Jesus saw how the guests had tried to take the best seats. So he told them:
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yɩra baa jʋʋ dɩa ŋɩɩ, ʋ na dɩ ba jʋʋ chɩchɛ ba hɔŋ nɩbalaa dɩ-hɔnɔɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ magɛ namaga a pɩba a bʋl,

english_verse: When you are invited to a wedding feast, don't sit in the best place. Someone more important may have been invited.
translation_verse: “Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ yɩrɩŋ dɩ ŋ kɔ ʋ hajaarɩ gbiele a dii kʋdiilee, sɩ́ mʋ bagɩsa joŋ nɩbalaa dɩhɔnʋŋ a hɔŋ. Dɩa tɩɩna jaŋ wuo yɩrɛ nʋʋ ma sɩ kɩɩŋ bɩra dɩ ʋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ, Wɩa jaŋ kɛnʋ muuri. Ka nɩɩ-la ma sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa muuri, Wɩa jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ʋ yʋgɛ.”

english_verse: Then Jesus said to the man who had invited him: When you give a dinner or a banquet, don't invite your friends and family and relatives and rich neighbors. If you do, they will invite you in return, and you will be paid back.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ yɩrʋ dɩ ʋ kʋ dii kʋdiilee, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa kʋdiilee, sɩ́ ŋ nandɔnsʋŋ koo ŋ naambiiriŋ yɩrʋ, sɩ́ ŋ dɩa nɩaa koo ŋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa ma yɩrʋ. Ba ma jaŋ wuo yɩrɩŋ maachie dɩ ŋ kʋ dii kʋdiilee ba teeŋ a tiŋ ŋ chɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: They cannot pay you back. But God will bless you and reward you when his people rise from death. The Great Banquet (Matthew
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa ma jaŋ pɛŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba-na bɩ jaŋ wuo tiŋ ŋ chɩmɩŋ. Wɩa jaŋ tiŋ ŋ chɩmɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ.” Yesu magɛ namaga a tɩgɛ baal-la sɩ ŋaa ba gbieli gbiele lɛ Mat.

english_verse: When the servant returned, he said, “Master, I've done what you told me, and there is still plenty of room for more people.”
translation_verse: Lɩma lɩma dɩ baal-la ʋ sɩ tɩma lɩa a yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ ba kʋ jʋʋ, ka ʋ jʋʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ kɔ nɛ, ama ba ha bɩ yʋgɛ.

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking, one of the guests said, “The greatest blessing of all is to be at the banquet in God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔnɔɔ dii kɩalɩŋ dɔŋɔ bʋla pɩ Yesu a bʋl, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ dii kɩaa Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus told him: A man once gave a great banquet and invited a lot of guests.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu magɛ namaga a bʋl, “Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ba gbieli gbieli-bal. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ nɩaa yʋgɛ dɩ ba kɔ dɩ ba gbieli.

english_verse: When the banquet was ready, he sent a servant to tell the guests, “Everything is ready! Please come.”
translation_verse: Gbiele-la sɩ ŋaa siri, ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩnna dɩ ʋ mʋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yɩra arɩ ba ŋaa siri nɛ dɩ ba gbieli gbiele-la.

english_verse: One guest after another started making excuses. The first one said, “I bought some land, and I've got to look it over. Please excuse me.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mʋ yɩrɛba, ba kala vɩa. Nɩ-bumbuŋ sɩ dɩ ʋ yɔɔ baga nɛ a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ na, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɔ.

english_verse: Another guest said, “I bought five teams of oxen, and I need to try them out. Please excuse me.”
translation_verse: Dɔŋɔ ma sɩ dɩ ʋ ma yɔɔ nɛ-belliŋ fii nɛ a ma kaa lɩɩ dɩ ʋ kaa mʋ pɛrɛ na. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ ma bɩ jaŋ wuo kɔ.

english_verse: The servant told his master what happened, and the master became so angry he said, “Go as fast as you can to every street and alley in town! Bring in everyone who is poor or paralyzed or blind or lame.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnʋ-la mɩɩra mʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ-la. Ʋ sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ baanɩŋ sii kɩŋkɛŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋla pʋ, ‘Lɩɩ mʋ wombiiŋ niiŋ lɩma arɩ jaŋ tʋɔŋ wombii-biisiŋ a yɩrɛ summoo arɩ gbɛrɩgɛɛ arɩ nyʋlɩmaa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ naasɩŋ arɩ nɩsaa sɩ sʋba.’

english_verse: His master then told him, “Go out along the back roads and make people come in, so my house will be full.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bɩra bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ-la, ‘Bɩra lɩɩ bagɩsɩŋ wombiee arɩ wombii-biisiŋ kala a yɩrɛ nɩaa dɩ ba kʋ jʋʋ, dɩ mɩ dɩa su.’

english_verse: Not one of the guests I first invited will get even a bite of my food!” Being a Disciple (Matthew
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ yɩra, ba kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ dii kʋdiilee deemba.” Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa aŋ-na kʋ ŋaa Yesu harɩ-tooro Mat.

english_verse: Large crowds were walking along with Jesus, when he turned and said:
translation_verse: Yesu fa sɩɩ mʋ wombiiŋ ŋɩɩ, nɩ-daŋ to ʋ harɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ daasɛ harɩŋ a bʋla pɩba,

english_verse: You cannot be my disciple, unless you love me more than you love your father and mother, your wife and children, and your brothers and sisters. You cannot follow me unless you love me more than you love your own life.
translation_verse: “Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kɔ mɩ teeŋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa mɩ harɩ-tooru, see ʋ bɛrɛ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ arɩ ʋ haala arɩ ʋ biiriŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ arɩ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋŋaalaa kala.

english_verse: You cannot be my disciple unless you carry your own cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa daagɛsɛ baasɛ aŋ to mɩ harɩŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ harɩ-tooru.

english_verse: Suppose one of you wants to build a tower. What is the first thing you will do? Won't you sit down and figure out how much it will cost and if you have enough money to pay for it?
translation_verse: Dɩ ma kʋŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ saa dii-leŋii, ŋ jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ hɔŋ a bɩɩnɛ a na dɩ moribiee maga nɛ dɩ ŋ kaa saa dɩa-la dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Otherwise, you will start building the tower, but not be able to finish. Then everyone who sees what is happening will laugh at you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa aŋ suomo bil dɩa-la gentine aŋ bɩra bɩ moribiee kɛnɛ dɩ ŋ saa dɩa-la dɛrɛ, nɩaa jaŋ na wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa. Ba jaŋ mʋmɔmʋŋ.

english_verse: They will say, “You started building, but could not finish the job.”
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ bʋl, ‘Baala deeŋ suomo dɩ ʋ saa dɩa nɛ aŋ bɩ wuo saa dɛrɛ.’ ”

english_verse: If he thinks he won't be able to defend himself, he will send messengers and ask for peace while the other king is still a long way off.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ jaŋ wuo dii kuoru-la, ʋ jaŋ tɩŋ tɩndaaraa dɩ ba mʋ cheŋ kuoru-la dɔŋɔ dɩ ba hɛ dɩ-bolii, a leŋ dɩ ba sʋlʋ dɩ ba sɩŋ.”

english_verse: So then, you cannot be my disciple unless you give away everything you own. Salt and Light (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa mɩ harɩ-tooro, see ŋ vɩa kʋŋkala ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ ta. Yesu bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ yɩsɩŋ lɛ Mat.

english_verse: Salt is good, but if it no longer tastes like salt, how can it be made to taste salty again?
translation_verse: Yɩsɩŋ sɩma, ama dɩ ʋ nɛ sɛbɩsɛ, ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ ʋ sɩŋ.

english_verse: It is no longer good for the soil or even for the manure pile. People simply throw it out. If you have ears, pay attention!
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo joŋo hɛ baga lɛ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ kɩaa wasɛ. Ʋ bɩra bɩ nyʋʋrʋŋ kala kɛnɛ. Ba yie joŋo yuo ta nɛ. Ma dɩgɩlaa tɩŋŋaa, má wuoli ma dɩgɩlaa a nɩɩ wɩaa deemba.”

english_verse: I will go to my father and say to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against God in heaven and against you.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ sii a mɩɩra mʋ mɩ nyɩmma teeŋ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ mʋa, mɩ jaŋ bʋla pʋ: Mɩ nyɩmma, mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ arɩ Wɩa arɩŋ kala.

english_verse: The younger son said to his father, “Give me my share of the property.” So the father divided his property between his two sons.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tʋɔŋ kʋbie sii mʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ nyɩmma, ‘Mɩ nyɩmma, kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ aŋ ka pɩla, joŋ mɩ toruŋ pɩmɛ.’ Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kaa kpaa.

english_verse: He had spent everything, when a bad famine spread through that whole land. Soon he had nothing to eat.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ dii kɩalɩŋ kala dɛrɛ ŋɩɩ, dɩ losuŋ jʋʋ taŋ-la woruŋ. Ʋ chɛ kʋdiilee ka.

english_verse: Tax collectors and sinners were all crowding around to listen to Jesus.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala lampoo laaraa arɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa yʋgɛ a kɔ Yesu teeŋ dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ ʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: So the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses started grumbling, “This man is friendly with sinners. He even eats with them.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba suomo gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa a bʋl, “Baala deeŋ leŋe wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa kʋkɔ ʋ teeŋ nɛ aŋ pɛ leŋ ʋ dɩ ba kala didii kɩaa.”

english_verse: Then Jesus told them this story:
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ magɛ namaga pɩba,

english_verse: and carry it home. Then you will call in your friends and neighbors and say, “Let's celebrate! I've found my lost sheep.”
translation_verse: a kaa mʋ dɩa, a yɩrɛ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ arɩ ʋ pɛ-jʋʋraa a bʋla pɩba, ‘Má leŋ dɩ la kala tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Mɩ na mɩ piesu-la sɩ lɛlɛ nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus told the people another story: What will a woman do if she has ten silver coins and loses one of them? Won't she light a lamp, sweep the floor, and look carefully until she finds it?
translation_verse: La joŋ arɩ haal nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ moribii-biiŋ fii, dɩ dɔŋɔ lɛl. Ɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa? Ʋ jaŋ nyɩgɛ nyiniŋ a tii ʋ dɩa kala a beŋ woruŋ see dɩ ʋ naʋ.

english_verse: Then she will call in her friends and neighbors and say, “Let's celebrate! I've found the coin I lost.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ naʋ, ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ tanlɔsʋŋ arɩ ʋ pɛ-jʋʋraa kala a hɛ dɔŋɔ a bʋla pɩba, ‘Má leŋ dɩ la kala tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Mɩ moribii-la sɩ lɛlɛ, mɩ naʋ nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus said, “In the same way God's angels are happy when even one person turns to him.” Two Sons
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ, dɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa kʋbala nɛ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, Wɩa tɩndaaraa yie jʋjʋɔsɛ nɛ.” Yesu magɛ namaga a tɩgɛ bile sɩ lɛlɛ lɛ

english_verse: Jesus told them yet another story: Once a man had two sons.
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra magɛ namaga dɔŋɔ a bʋl, “Baal kʋbala nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a kɛŋ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩa.

english_verse: Not long after that, the younger son packed up everything he owned and left for a foreign country, where he wasted all his money in wild living.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ diene, ka ba tʋɔŋ kʋbie-la sii paa ʋ toruŋ kala ʋ sɩ laa a hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a sii mʋ ta-bolii kʋbala. Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kala kaa mʋ ŋaa wʋtɔɔnʋŋ, ba kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: He went to work for a man in that country, and the man sent him out to take care of his pigs.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ chɩchɛ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Taŋ-la nʋʋ joŋu dɩ ʋ bibeŋ ʋ toonuŋ.

english_verse: He would have been glad to eat what the pigs were eating, but no one gave him a thing.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩɩ daa toonu-la, nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ kʋdiilee ka pa. Ʋ fa chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ dii toonu-la kʋdiilee.

english_verse: Finally, he came to his senses and said, “My father's workers have plenty to eat, and here I am, starving to death!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩɩnɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a mʋ yi ʋ nyɩmma lɛ a bʋl, ‘Mɩ nyɩmma ma kɛŋ tɩntɩnnaa yʋgɛ nɛ. Ba kala nɩna kʋdiilee didii aŋ kɩka, aŋ ka mɩ-na hɛ daha a sʋsʋʋ losuŋ.

english_verse: I am no longer good enough to be called your son. Treat me like one of your workers.’ ”
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bɩ maga dɩ mɩ ŋaa ŋ bii. Jommi dɩ mɩ pɛ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa lɛ dɩ la tɩtɩŋ.’ Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sii a kʋkɔ ʋ nyɩmma teeŋ.

english_verse: The younger son got up and started back to his father. But when he was still a long way off, his father saw him and felt sorry for him. He ran to his son and hugged and kissed him.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ kɔ ʋ nyɩmma teeŋ, ʋ fa ha hɛ dɩ-bolii nɛ, ka ʋ nyɩmma naʋ. Nenige kɛnʋ woruŋ. Ʋ fá mʋ a guoru.

english_verse: The son said, “Father, I have sinned against God in heaven and against you. I am no longer good enough to be called your son.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ bile bʋla pɩ ʋ nyɩmma a bʋl, ‘Mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ arɩ Wɩa arɩŋ kala. Ʋ bɩra bɩ maga dɩ mɩ ŋaa ŋ bii.’

english_verse: But his father said to the servants, “Hurry and bring the best clothes and put them on him. Give him a ring for his finger and sandals for his feet.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ nyɩmma ha bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa a bʋl, ‘Má mʋ lɩma a joŋ gɛrɩ-zɔmʋŋ a kaa kʋ laalʋ. Má joŋ nenii-pɩrɩŋ ma a hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ aŋ joŋ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ ma a hɛʋ.

english_verse: Get the best calf and prepare it, so we can eat and celebrate.
translation_verse: Má mʋ kɛŋ nɛŋ-la ma sɩ nɛrɛ a kaa kʋ kpʋ dɩ la kala dii, dɩ la tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: This son of mine was dead, but has now come back to life. He was lost and has now been found.” And they began to celebrate.
translation_verse: Ʋ naga mɩ bie deeŋ fa sʋba nɛ aŋ lɛɛlɛ sii. Ʋ fa lɛlɛ nɛ, ka la lɛɛlɛ naʋ.’ Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba dii kɩaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: The older son had been out in the field. But when he came near the house, he heard the music and dancing.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ bile malɩma hɛ baga lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɔ dɩa. Ʋ sɩ kʋ kpagɛ ʋ dɩa, ʋ nɩa dɩ baa du kɩaa a gʋgʋa.

english_verse: So he called one of the servants over and asked, “What's going on here?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ nyɩmma tɩntɩnna-la dɔŋɔ a pɩɛsʋ, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ baa ŋaa ŋɩɩ?’

english_verse: The servant answered, “Your brother has come home safe and sound, and your father ordered us to kill the best calf.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pʋ, ‘Ŋ ŋaana nɛ mɩɩra kɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ nyɩmma kɛŋ nɛ-fere a kpʋ a pʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ mɩɩra kɔ dɩa arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa nɛ.’

english_verse: The older brother got so angry that he would not even go into the house. His father came out and begged him to go in.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ bile malɩma-la na baanɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ. Ʋ bɩ dɩa jʋa. Ʋ nyɩmma kʋ lɩɩ a sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ kʋ jʋʋ dɩa.

english_verse: But he said to his father, “For years I have worked for you like a slave and have always obeyed you. But you have never even given me a little goat, so that I could give a dinner for my friends.
translation_verse: Bile bʋla pɩ ʋ nyɩmma, ‘Jɩsɩŋ deemba kala lɛ mɩ faasa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa woruŋ a pɩŋ. Mɩ ha bɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa vɩa chɛ-bala maa. Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ saa pɩmɛ? Ŋ ha bɩ bʋ-bie ma kaa pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ kpʋ la dɩ ma nandɔnsʋŋ gbieli gbiele aŋ chaŋ.

english_verse: This other son of yours wasted your money on prostitutes. And now that he has come home, you ordered the best calf to be killed for a feast.”
translation_verse: Ka ŋ bie deeŋ-na kɛŋ ŋ kɩaa kala chei hachɔrʋmʋŋ lɛ. Ka ʋ sɩ mɩɩra kɔ dɩa ŋɩɩ, ŋ kpʋ nɛ-fere a pʋ.’

english_verse: His father replied, “My son, you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ bile nyɩmma bʋla pʋ, ‘Mɩ bii, ŋ yie hɛ dɩa lɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ nɛ. Kʋŋkala mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ, ŋ ma nɛ tɩɩʋ.

english_verse: But we should be glad and celebrate! Your brother was dead, but he is now alive. He was lost and has now been found.”
translation_verse: Ama ʋ maga dɩ la gbieli gbiele a leŋ dɩ la tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nagɛ ŋ ŋaana deeŋ fa sʋba nɛ aŋ sii. Ʋ fa lɛlɛ nɛ, ka la lɛɛlɛ naʋ.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: A rich man once had a manager to take care of his business. But he was told that his manager was wasting money.
translation_verse: Yesu magɛ namaga dɔŋɔ a pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa kɩaa tɩɩna nɛ. Ʋ fa kɛŋ tɩntɩnnʋ. Ʋ nɛ faa beŋ ʋ kɩalɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa kʋ bʋla pɩ kɩaa tɩɩna-la, arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ-la kɛŋ ʋ kɩalɩŋ chichei nɛ.

english_verse: So the rich man called him in and said, “What is this I hear about you? Tell me what you have done! You are no longer going to work for me.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ yɩrʋ a pɩɛsʋ, ‘Bee na wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ nɩɩ a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ. Leŋ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ yallɛ mɩ kɩalɩŋ pa. Ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnʋ.’

english_verse: The manager said to himself, “What shall I do now that my master is going to fire me? I can't dig ditches, and I'm ashamed to beg.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋl ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ, ‘Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ ka chɛ dɩ ʋ kirimi nɛ mɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa? Mɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ pɛrɛ. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo gɔllɔ sʋsʋl kɩaa ma. Mɩ jaŋ fɩfá hɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I know what I'll do, so that people will welcome me into their homes after I've lost my job.”
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ cheye, mɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a wuo kɛŋ nandɔnsʋŋ, a ŋaa dɩ ba kɛmmɛ woruŋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.’

english_verse: “A hundred barrels of olive oil,” the man answered. So the manager said, “Take your bill and sit down and quickly write ‘
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sɩ dɩ nʋʋŋ nɛ ʋ chɩmʋ aŋkʋra zɔlɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnʋ-la joŋ teŋ-la sɩ dagɛ chɩŋ-la a pʋ aŋ bʋl, ‘Teŋ-la sɩ dagɛ ŋ chɩmɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la. Ŋ chɩmɩŋ ŋaa nʋʋŋ aŋkʋraba zɔlɔ nɛ. Kaa bɩrɩmɛ a ŋmʋnsɛ aŋkʋraba mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii.’

english_verse: The manager asked someone else who was in debt to his master, “How much do you owe?” “A thousand sacks of wheat,” the man replied. The manager said, “Take your bill and write ‘
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna ma a pɩɛsʋ, ‘Ka ŋ maa?’ Ʋ ma sɩ dɩ chɩmɩŋ ʋ sɩ die ŋaa mɩaa bɔtɔba bʋɩ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnʋ-la bʋla pʋ, ‘Teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ arɩ ŋ chɩmɩŋ magɛ ŋ-la nɛ, ama kaa bɩrɩmɛ a ŋmʋnsɛ bɔtɔ zɔlɔ chori.’

english_verse: The master praised his dishonest manager for looking out for himself so well. That's how it is! The people of this world look out for themselves better than the people who belong to the light.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kɩaa tɩɩna-la bɛsɛ sɩŋgɩrɩŋ tɩɩna-la lɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa kukeri nɛ arɩ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Bee na nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho dʋnɩa kɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩpɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Wɩa.”

english_verse: My disciples, I tell you to use wicked wealth to make friends for yourselves. Then when it is gone, you will be welcomed into an eternal home.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la, “Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, má joŋ moribiee a kaa dii nandɔnsʋŋ. Dɩ moribie-la nɛ dɛrɛ, Wɩa jaŋ kɛmma kaa mʋ ʋ jaŋ a joŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ a pɩma.

english_verse: So Abraham said, “If they won't pay attention to Moses and the prophets, they won't listen even to someone who comes back from the dead.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩraham bɩra bʋla pʋ, ‘Dɩ ba nɛ bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ ŋmʋnsa, ba bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ wɩalɩŋ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ paala sii sʋʋŋ lɛ a mʋ ba teeŋ a dagɛba ma.’ ”

english_verse: The Pharisees really loved money. So when they heard what Jesus said, they made fun of him.
translation_verse: Farisii tɩŋŋaa nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ Yesu sɩ bʋla. Ba fa cho dʋnɩa kɩaa nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sisieri ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus told them: You are always making yourselves look good, but God sees what is in your heart. The things that most people think are important are worthless as far as God is concerned.
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Ma nɛ ŋaa nɩdosunu-la sɩ yie chɛ dɩ nɩaa bɩɩnɛ ma kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ama Wɩa jɩŋ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ. Kɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa kʋfɩɛma nuhuobiinee teeŋ, ba ŋaa kʋtɔɔnʋ nɛ Wɩa teeŋ.”

english_verse: Until the time of John the Baptist, people had to obey the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets. But since God's kingdom has been preached, everyone is trying hard to get in.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Nɩalɩŋ faa to wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile nɛ. Ba to tenni-la lɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa a kaa mʋ bʋa-la lɛ Jɔɔŋ sɩ kɔ nɛ, nɩɩ-la fa sɩɩ fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ. Jɔɔŋ sɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ, ba suomo bʋbʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a tɩgɛ Wɩa kuorii-la lɛ aa pɩ nɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋkala fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ʋ jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will disappear before the smallest letter of the Law does.
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ lɛlɩŋ jaŋ ŋaa mɔlɩɩ a kɩɩ wombie-la Wɩa sɩ bile dɩ la tuto wʋbii-bala ma sɩ jaŋ lɛl.

english_verse: It is a terrible sin for a man to divorce his wife and marry another woman. It is also a terrible sin for a man to marry a divorced woman. Lazarus and the Rich Man
translation_verse: Baal-na kala sɩ vɩa ʋ haala aŋ bɩra mʋ jaa dɔŋɔ, baal-la ŋaa bachɔrʋŋ nɛ. Baal-la ma sɩ jaa haala sɩ vɩa ʋ bala, ʋ ŋaa bachɔrʋŋ nɛ.” Yesu magɛ namaga a tɩgɛ kɩaa tɩɩna arɩ Lazarɔs lɛ

english_verse: There was once a rich man who wore expensive clothes and every day ate the best food.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra magɛ namaga a bʋl, “Kɩaa tɩɩna kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ yie lɩlaalɛ gɛrɩ-zɔmɔ-la yalɩŋ sɩ hɛyɛ, a pɩŋ sɩma nyuŋ woruŋ tapʋlɩɩ-na kala.

english_verse: But a poor beggar named Lazarus was brought to the gate of the rich man's house.
translation_verse: Ka summu kʋbala ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ a pɩpɩŋ ʋ boi-baalɩŋ niiŋ, baa yɩrʋ Lazarɔs. Ʋ yaraa kala fa ŋaa naawɩɩlaa nɛ.

english_verse: He was happy just to eat the scraps that fell from the rich man's table. His body was covered with sores, and dogs kept coming up to lick them.
translation_verse: Vasɩŋ yie kɔ a lilenni ʋ naawɩɩla-la. Ʋ yie chɩchɛ dɩ kɩaa tɩɩna-la sɩ dii kʋdiile-la aŋ ka, dɩ ʋ ma paa dii.

english_verse: The poor man died, and angels took him to the place of honor next to Abraham. The rich man also died and was buried.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ summu-la sii sʋʋ. Wɩa tɩndaaraa kʋ joŋu a kaa mʋ Abɩraham teeŋ. Ʋ hɔŋ ʋ sɛmɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ aa nɩɩ sɩma. Kɩaa tɩɩna-la ma sʋʋ ba hugu,

english_verse: He went to hell and was suffering terribly. When he looked up and saw Abraham far off and Lazarus at his side,
translation_verse: ʋ mʋ jʋʋ Wɩa-nyiniŋ a nɩna hɛɛŋ woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bee mʋ na Abɩraham dɩ ʋ hɔŋ dɩ-bolii, ka Lazarɔs ma hɔŋ ʋ sɛmɛ.

english_verse: he said to Abraham, “Have pity on me! Send Lazarus to dip his finger in water and touch my tongue. I'm suffering terribly in this fire.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrʋ a bʋl, ‘Mɩ nyɩmma Abɩraham, fá mɩ nenige aŋ tɩŋ Lazarɔs dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ neniiŋ yuu lɩɩŋ a kaa kɔ a fɩɛlɛ mɩ nandelimiŋ. Mɩɩ na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ nyiniŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ.’

english_verse: Abraham answered, “My friend, remember that while you lived, you had everything good, and Lazarus had everything bad. Now he is happy, and you are in pain.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩraham bʋla pʋ, ‘Mɩ bii, liise mʋ yi ŋ fa sɩ hɛ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ŋ faa nɩɩ sɩma nɛ woruŋ, aŋ ka Lazarɔs fa nɩna hɛɛŋ. Ama lɛɛlɛ Lazarɔs maa nɩɩ sɩma daha, aŋ ka ŋ ma hɛ hɛɛŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But the rich man said, “Abraham, then please send Lazarus to my father's home.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kɩaa tɩɩna-la bɩra bʋla pʋ, ‘Mɩ nyɩmma Abɩraham, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ tɩŋ Lazarɔs dɩ ʋ mʋ mɩ nyɩmma dɩa.

english_verse: Let him warn my five brothers, so they won't come to this horrible place.”
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ naambiiriŋ banɔŋ nɛ, dɩ ʋ kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa dɩ ba ma sɩ́ hɛɛŋ deeŋ leriŋ kɔ dɩ ba nɛ sʋba.’

english_verse: Abraham answered, “Your brothers can read what Moses and the prophets wrote. They should pay attention to that.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩraham bʋla pʋ, ‘Wɩalɩŋ Mosis arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ ŋmʋnsa, ba hɛ ŋ naambiiriŋ teeŋ. Leŋ dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ ba wɩalɩŋ.’

english_verse: Then the rich man said, “No, that's not enough! If only someone from the dead would go to them, they would listen and turn to God.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kɩaa tɩɩna-la bɩra bʋl, ‘Ŋɩɩ ha bɩ maga, mɩ nyɩmma. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ fa sii sʋʋŋ lɛ a mʋ ba teeŋ, ba fa jaŋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.’

english_verse: Why was this foreigner the only one who came back to thank God?”
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nʋhʋɔra deeŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ mɩɩra kɔ dɩ ʋ lɔllɛ Wɩa?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If you had faith no bigger than a tiny mustard seed, you could tell this mulberry tree to pull itself up, roots and all, and to plant itself in the ocean. And it would!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ ma laa diiniŋ nɛ fa magɛ kʋŋ biiŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ masɩtad, ma fa jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩ tɩa dɩ ʋ churi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ a mʋ chɔnsɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ fa jaŋ to ma niiŋ lɛ a ŋaa ŋɩɩ.” Yesu bʋl tɩntɩnnaa tɩntɩmɩŋ wɩaa

english_verse: If your servant comes in from plowing or from taking care of the sheep, would you say, “Welcome! Come on in and have something to eat”?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Dɩ ma kʋŋ nɛ kɛŋ tɩntɩnnʋ ʋ pɩpɛrɛ ŋ baga lɛ koo ʋ dɩdaa ŋ piesee, dɩ ʋ nɛ lɩɩ baga koo pie-daalɩŋ kɔ, ŋ jaŋ bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa lɩma a kʋ dii kʋdiilee?

english_verse: There is no use saying, ‘Look! Here it is’ or ‘Look! There it is.’ God's kingdom is here with you.”
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala ma bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl, ‘Bee na, ʋ hɛ daha koo ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ.’ Má bee na, Wɩa kuorii-la hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: The time will come when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la, “Tapʋlɩɩ jaŋ yi dɩ ma cho dɩ ma na mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie tapʋlaa tʋɔŋ chɛ-bala dʋndʋŋa maa. Ama ma bɩ jaŋ wuo namɛ.

english_verse: Servants don't deserve special thanks for doing what they are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ lɔllɛ ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ-la a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ dagʋ wɩaa?

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: There will always be something that causes people to sin. But anyone who causes them to sin is in for trouble. A person who causes even one of my little followers to sin
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “Wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Ama wɩɩŋ puu nɩɩ-la lɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ to kɔ.

english_verse: So be careful what you do. Correct any followers of mine who sin, and forgive the ones who say they are sorry.
translation_verse: Má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ. Dɩ ŋ naambie nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ŋaa goŋ ʋ nyuŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ sɩ ʋ cheye nɛ, joŋo chɛʋ.

english_verse: Even if one of them mistreats you seven times in one day and says, “I am sorry,” you should still forgive that person.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ cheyiŋ aŋ kʋ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ ʋ cheye nɛ, a ŋaa ŋɩɩ a yi naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ chɛ-bala, joŋo chɛʋ.” Yesu bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ Wɩa laa diiniŋ lɛ

english_verse: The apostles said to the Lord, “Make our faith stronger!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la bʋla pʋ, “La Tɩɩna, ŋaa dɩ la Wɩa laa diiniŋ yʋgɛ kɩŋkɛŋ.”

english_verse: No, you wouldn't say that. You would say, “Prepare me something to eat. Get ready to serve me, so I can have my meal. Then later on you can eat and drink.”
translation_verse: Aɩ, ma jaŋ bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa siri a laalɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ a ŋaa kʋdiilee pɩŋ dɩ ŋ dii. Dɩ ŋ nɛ dii dɛrɛ, ʋ ma jaŋ wuo dii ʋ kʋdiilee.

english_verse: And that's how it should be with you. When you've done all you should, then say, “We are merely servants, and we have simply done our duty.” Ten Men with Leprosy
translation_verse: Ma saa nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ sɩ dɩ ma ŋaa, ʋ maga dɩ ma bʋl, ‘La ŋaa tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba lɔllɛla. Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ la tɩŋ nɛ la tɩŋ.’ ” Yesu vaarɛ gbegisiŋ fii

english_verse: On his way to Jerusalem, Jesus went along the border between Samaria and Galilee.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra sii mʋ Jerusalɛm dɩɩrɩŋ. Ʋ to Samarɩa tinteeŋ arɩ Galilii tinteeŋ bʋa nɛ a mʋ.

english_verse: As he was going into a village, ten men with leprosy came toward him. They stood at a distance
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mʋ jʋʋ taŋ kʋbala, dɩ gbegisiŋ fii kʋ chemu. Ba fa chɩŋ dɩ-bolii nɛ

english_verse: and shouted, “Jesus, Master, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: aŋ faasa yɩrɛ a bʋl, “Yesu, la Kʋhɩaŋ, fá la nenige.”

english_verse: Jesus looked at them and said, “Go show yourselves to the priests.” On their way they were healed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu naba a bʋl, “Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa mʋ a dagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ. Ba sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, ba duori.

english_verse: When one of them discovered that he was healed, he came back, shouting praises to God.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ sɩ na dɩ ʋ duoro, ʋ mɩɩrɛ a faasa dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: He bowed down at the feet of Jesus and thanked him. The man was from the country of Samaria.
translation_verse: Ʋ mʋ Yesu teeŋ a tuu tele chu Yesu sɩpaaŋ a lɔllʋ. Baal-la fa ŋaa Samarɩa tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “Weren't ten men healed? Where are the other nine?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsʋ, “Nɩaa fii dee mɩ vaarɛɛ? Nɩɩ nɛ nibi-la hɛ?

english_verse: Then Jesus told the man, “You may get up and go. Your faith has made you well.” God's Kingdom (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ baal-la, “Sii a viiri, ŋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ ŋaa ŋ duori.” Yesu bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa kuorii-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ Mat.

english_verse: The day of the Son of Man will be like lightning flashing across the sky.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ tapʋlɩɩ-la, ʋ jaŋ nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ lɩgɩsa a lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a kʋ tuu sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: When people say to you, “Look there,” or “Look here,” don't go looking for him.
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, ‘Naʋ, ʋ nɛ ŋ-la, koo, na ʋ nɛ hɛ daha.’ Dɩ ba nɛ bʋl ŋɩɩ, má sɩ́ lɩɩ gɔllɔ chɩchɛʋ.

english_verse: Then Jesus' disciples spoke up, “But where will this happen, Lord?” Jesus said, “Where there is a corpse, there will always be vultures.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la pɩɛsʋ, “Nɩɩ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ, La Tɩɩna?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Lee-la kʋpʋɔŋ sɩ pɩna, nɩmɛ nɛ duunuŋ hihilimi.”

english_verse: Some Pharisees asked Jesus when God's kingdom would come. He answered, “God's kingdom isn't something you can see.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa pɩɛsɛ Yesu dɩ bʋa bɛɛ lɛ nɛ Wɩa kuorii-la jaŋ kɔ? Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ Wɩa kuorii-la nɛ jaŋ kɔ, wʋmagɩl dee bɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ.

english_verse: But first he must suffer terribly and be rejected by the people of today.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Ma lɛɛlɛ nɩaa, ma jaŋ vɩamɛ.

english_verse: When the Son of Man comes, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ, ʋ jaŋ nagɛ bʋa-la lɛ Nowa fa sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day when Noah went into the big boat. Then the flood came and drowned everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɩaa faa dii kʋdiilee nɛ a nyʋnyʋa kɩaa, haalaa arɩ baalaa ma jɩjaa dɔŋɔ a mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la Nowa fa sɩ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ. Ka lɩɩŋ kʋ pɛllɛ paa nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ kala, ba sʋʋ.

english_verse: But on the very day Lot left Sodom, fiery flames poured down from the sky and killed everyone.
translation_verse: Ama tapʋlɩɩ-la Lɔt sɩ lɩɩ taŋ kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sodom lɛ, nyiniŋ arɩ jiribiiŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ a kʋ tuu kpʋ nɩalɩŋ kala.

english_verse: The same will happen on the day when the Son of Man appears.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jaŋ nagɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie ma sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: At that time no one on a rooftop should go down into the house to get anything. No one in a field should go back to the house for anything.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ ʋ lusuŋ nyuŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la lɛ aŋ kɛŋ kɩaa ʋ dɩa tʋɔŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kʋ tuu a chɩchɛ ʋ jʋʋ paa ʋ kɩalɩŋ. Dɩ nʋʋ ma nɛ hɛ baga lɛ, ʋ sɩ́ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ mɩɩra mʋ dɩa a joŋ kʋŋ.

english_verse: Remember what happened to Lot's wife.
translation_verse: Má liise yi wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa Lɔt haala lɛ.

english_verse: People who try to save their lives will lose them, and those who lose their lives will save them.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ walɩmɛ dɩ ʋ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ joŋo ta. Nɩɩ-la kala ma sɩ joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta, ʋ jaŋ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: On that night two people will be sleeping in the same bed, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, tapʋlɩɩ-la nɩaa balɩa jaŋ pɩŋ doŋ godo bala nyuŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ aŋ leŋ dɔŋɔ ta.

english_verse: Two women will be together grinding wheat, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Baalaa balɩa ma jaŋ hɛ baga lɛ a pɩpɛrɛ, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ aŋ leŋ dɔŋɔ ta.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples a story about how they should keep on praying and never give up:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra magɛ namaga pɩba a dagɛba dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa bʋa na-kala lɛ a sɩ́ leŋ.

english_verse: In a town there was once a judge who didn't fear God or care about people.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, dɩ sarɩya diiru nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ taŋ kʋbala lɛ. Ʋ fa bɩ Wɩa ka fá. Ʋ bɩ nuhuobiinee ma kaa tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: In that same town there was a widow who kept going to the judge and saying, “Make sure that I get fair treatment in court.”
translation_verse: Yo-haal kʋbala ma nɛ fa hɛ taŋ-la lɛ. Ʋ yie vɛnɛɛ mʋ sarɩya diiru-la teeŋ a sʋsʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ wuo dii sarɩya a lo ʋ dʋndɔmɔ.

english_verse: For a while the judge refused to do anything. Finally, he said to himself, “Even though I don't fear God or care about people,
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ kala baal-la vɩa dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ. Ama ʋ sɩ yie vɛnɛɛ kɔ ʋ teeŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩtɩa, “Mɩ paala bɩ Wɩa ka fá, mɩ bɩ nuhuobiinee ma kaa tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: I will help this widow because she keeps on bothering me. If I don't help her, she will wear me out.”
translation_verse: Ama yo-haala deeŋ sɩ vɛnɛɛ walɩmɛmɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ dii ʋ sarɩya. Ŋɩɩ dee ʋ ha jaŋ vɛnɛ wʋwalɩmɛmɛ dɩ mɩ lɔl.”

english_verse: He will surely hurry and help them. But when the Son of Man comes, will he find on this earth anyone with faith? A Pharisee and a Tax Collector
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ dɩ ba laa kʋsɩŋŋaa. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ lɩma lɩma. Ama bʋa-la lɛ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ, mɩ jaŋ na nɩaa sɩ laamɛ dii dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus told a story to some people who thought they were better than others and who looked down on everyone else:
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra magɛ namaga a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩɩna ba tʋɔŋ lɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla aŋ lileeni ba dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa. Ʋ bʋla pɩba,

english_verse: The Pharisee stood over by himself and prayed, “God, I thank you that I am not greedy, dishonest, and unfaithful in marriage like other people. And I am really glad that I am not like that tax collector over there.
translation_verse: Farisii tɩɩna-la sii chɩŋ a bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a bʋl, ‘La Tɩɩna Wɩa, mɩɩ lɔllʋŋ arɩ mɩ sɩ bɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ naga, nɩalɩŋ sɩ gɔllɔ kɛŋ nɩaa kɩaa lɩlaa, koo nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ, koo nɩalɩŋ sɩ gɔllɔ chɩchɛ nɩaa haalaa. Mɩ bɩ lampoo laara deeŋ ma sɩ hɛ daha naga.

english_verse: I go without eating for two days a week, and I give you one tenth of all I earn.”
translation_verse: Mɩ yie vɔɔ niiŋ bʋlɩa nɛ yɔbɔ-na kala lɛ. Kʋ-la kala mɩ sɩ na, mɩ yie kaa kpaa leree fii nɛ a joŋ dɔŋɔ pɩŋ.’

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “When the two men went home, it was the tax collector and not the Pharisee who was pleasing to God. If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ Wɩa joŋ lampoo laarʋ-la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛʋ nɛ, ʋ mʋ dɩa. Ama ʋ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa Farisii tɩɩna-la lɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ, Wɩa jaŋ kɛnʋ muuri. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa muuri, Wɩa jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ʋ yʋgɛ.” Yesu sʋl Wɩa pɩ hambiisiŋ Mat.

english_verse: Some people brought their little children for Jesus to bless. But when his disciples saw them doing this, they told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kɛŋ ba hambiisiŋ ma kɔ Yesu teeŋ dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ ba lɛ dɩ Wɩa pɛ ba lɛ. Yesu harɩ-tooroo naba a kpɩa ba lɛ.

english_verse: will be given much more in this life. And in the future world they will have eternal life.” Jesus Again Tells about His Death (Matthew
translation_verse: ʋ jaŋ bɩra na kɩaa yʋgɛ a kɩɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ leŋe ta. Dɩ ʋ nɛ kʋ sʋʋ, ʋ jaŋ na mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.” Yesu bɩra bʋl ʋ sʋʋŋ wɩaa pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo Mat.

english_verse: Jesus took the twelve apostles aside and said: We are now on our way to Jerusalem. Everything that the prophets wrote about the Son of Man will happen there.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu kɛŋ ʋ harɩ-tooroo fii arɩ balɩa-la a kaa sʋʋsa lɩɩ a bʋla pɩba, “Má bee na, laa mʋ Jerusalɛm nɛ. Nɩmɛ wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ ŋmʋnsa a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie lɛ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: An important man asked Jesus, “Good Teacher, what must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩaŋ kʋbala kɔ Yesu teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Mɩ kʋhɩa-zɔmʋŋ, ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ?”

english_verse: He told Jesus, “I have obeyed all these commandments since I was a young man.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋl, “Mɩ to wɩaa deemba kala mɩ hambiiriŋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “There is one thing you still need to do. Go and sell everything you own! Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come and be my follower.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla, ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Wʋbala nɛ ka ŋ ha jaŋ ŋaa. Joŋ ŋ kɩaa kala a yallɛ, a joŋ moribie-la a pɩ summoo, aŋ kʋ tomi. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ kɩaa Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: When the man heard this, he was sad, because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Baal-la sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ tʋɔŋ kala chei, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa kɛŋ kɩaa nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Jesus saw how sad the man was. So he said, “It's terribly hard for rich people to get into God's kingdom!
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ na dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ cheye, ʋ bʋl, “Ʋ ŋaa wʋduo nɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa sɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ hɛɩ arɩ bʋntaŋŋa sɩ jaŋ wuo to gɛrɩ-hɛmɩŋ bʋa lɩɩ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛyɛ ŋɩɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa sɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: When the crowd heard this, they asked, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ba pɩɛsʋ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa Wɩa jaŋ laa ta?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “There are some things that people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kperi nuhuobiine, ʋ bɩ Wɩa wuo kperi.”

english_verse: Peter said, “Remember, we left everything to be your followers!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋla pʋ, “Bee na, la leŋ la dɩɩsɩŋ nɛ aŋ tuto ŋ harɩŋ.”

english_verse: He will be handed over to foreigners, who will make fun of him, mistreat him, and spit on him.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ jommi hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ mɔmmɛ, a tʋʋsɛmɛ, aŋ tʋ nantʋɔrʋŋ hɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: They will beat him and kill him, but three days later he will rise to life.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ vɩɩrɛmɛ aŋ kpʋmɛ, ka dɩ mɩ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ.”

english_verse: When Jesus was coming close to Jericho, a blind man sat begging beside the road.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo sii dɩ ba mʋ Jerusalɛm. Ba mʋ kpagɛ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Jeriko, dɩ nyʋlʋŋ kʋbala fa hɔŋ wombiiŋ niiŋ a sʋsʋl kɩaa. [

english_verse: The man heard the crowd walking by and asked what was happening.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ nɩɩ nɩ-daŋ-la sɩɩ bal dɔmɔ, ʋ pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ?”]

english_verse: Some people told him that Jesus from Nazareth was passing by.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pʋ arɩ Yesu sɩ lɩɩ Nazarɛt nɩɩ bal.

english_verse: So the blind man shouted, “Jesus, Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ Yesu a bʋl, “Yesu, Devit nihi-lɩɛrɛ, fá mɩ nenige.”

english_verse: The people who were going along with Jesus told the man to be quiet. But he shouted even louder, “Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ sɩpaaŋ kpɩaʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ goŋ. Ama ʋ faasa yɩrɛ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ a bʋl, “Yesu, Devit nihi-lɩɛrɛ, fá mɩ nenige.”

english_verse: Jesus stopped and told some people to bring the blind man over to him. When the blind man was getting near, Jesus asked,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu chɩŋ aŋ bʋl dɩ ba kɛŋ nyʋlʋŋ-la kaa kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Nyʋlʋŋ-la kɔ.

english_verse: “What do you want me to do for you?” “Lord, I want to see!” he answered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋŋ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa pɩŋ?” Ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ Kʋhɩaŋ, leŋ dɩ mɩ sɩaa suri dɩ mɩ nɩna.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Look and you will see! Your eyes are healed because of your faith.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ sɩaa jaŋ suri, ŋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ ŋaa ŋ duori.”

english_verse: At once the man could see, and he went with Jesus and started thanking God. When the crowds saw what happened, they praised God.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩaa guu suri. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ to Yesu harɩŋ a dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa. Nɩ-daŋ-la ma kala sɩ na ŋɩɩ, ba ma kala dɛnnɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Jesus was heading his way, and Zacchaeus wanted to see what he was like. But Zacchaeus was a short man and could not see over the crowd. So he ran ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kieli nɩ-daŋ-la, a fá mʋ jɩl tɩa, dɩ ʋ wuo na Yesu. Ʋ jɩma dɩ ʋ jaŋ kʋ to tɩa-la bʋbʋɔŋ bal.

english_verse: When Jesus got there, he looked up and said, “Zacchaeus, hurry down! I want to stay with you today.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ kʋ to tɩa-la bʋbʋɔŋ bɩbal, ʋ wʋla beŋ tɩa-la nyuŋ a naʋ a bʋla pɩ Zakɩyas, “Zakɩyas, kʋ tuu lɩma. Ʋ maga dɩ mɩ chʋa ŋ dɩa lɛ nɛ jɩnɩŋ.”

english_verse: Everyone who saw this started grumbling, “This man Zacchaeus is a sinner! And Jesus is going home to eat with him.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a na ŋɩɩ, ba suomo gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa a bʋl, “Baala deeŋ mʋa dɩ ʋ chʋa wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ-la dɩa lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Later that day Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “I will give half of my property to the poor. And I will now pay back four times as much to everyone I have ever cheated.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ hɛ Zakɩyas dɩa lɛ ŋɩɩ, Zakɩyas sii chɩŋ a bʋla pɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu, “Mɩ Kʋhɩaŋ, jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ kɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a pɩ summoo. Dɩ mɩ nɛ gɩrɩmɛ nʋʋ maa, mɩ jaŋ tiŋ ʋ tɩɩna arɩ moribiee naansɩɩŋ bʋnɛsɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to Zacchaeus, “Today you and your family have been saved, because you are a true son of Abraham.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Wɩa laa ŋ dɩ ŋ dɩa nɩaa kala ta nɛ jɩnɩŋ. Baala deeŋ ma ŋaa Abɩraham doho nʋʋ nɛ,

english_verse: The Son of Man came to look for and to save people who are lost.” A Story about Ten Servants (Matthew
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie kɔ dɩ mɩ chɛ a laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɛlɛ nɛ a ta.” Yesu magɛ namaga a tɩgɛ moribiiŋ lɛ Mat.

english_verse: But the people of his country hated him, and they sent messengers to the foreign country to say, “We don't want this man to be our king.”
translation_verse: Ama ʋ taŋ-la nɩaa bɛrʋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tɩŋ tɩndaaraa ba kiri ʋ harɩŋ mʋ a bʋla pɩ taŋ-la dɔŋɔ kuoro arɩ ba bɩ cho dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba taŋ kuoro.

english_verse: He told them, “Go into the next village, where you will find a young donkey that has never been ridden. Untie the donkey and bring it here.
translation_verse: “Má mʋ taŋ-la sɩ hɛ sɩpaaŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ mʋa, ma jaŋ na kaku-bie dɩ ba vɔbɔ a kɩɩ. Nʋʋ ha bɩ ʋ jɩla. Má mʋ puri a kaa kɔ.

english_verse: The first servant came and said, “Sir, with the money you gave me I have earned ten times as much.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-bumbuŋ kɔ ʋ teeŋ a bʋla pɩ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ, ‘Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, ŋ siidi bʋɩ-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ bɩrɩmɛ siidi bʋɩ fii nɛ.’

english_verse: The second one came and said, “Sir, with the money you gave me, I have earned five times as much.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-lɩamɩŋ ma kɔ ʋ teeŋ a bʋl, ‘Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, ŋ siidi bʋɩ-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ, ʋ bɩrɩmɛ siidi bʋɩ banɔŋ nɛ.’

english_verse: Another servant came and said, “Sir, here is your money. I kept it safe in a handkerchief.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔŋ-la ma kɔ a bʋla pʋ, ‘Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, na ŋ siidi bʋɩ-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ, mɩ joŋo gul gɛrɩ-kɔsʋŋ lɛ nɛ a joŋo faa.

english_verse: Why didn't you put my money in the bank? On my return, I could have had the money together with interest.”
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ŋ bɩ mɩ moribiiŋ joŋo bil lee-la ba sɩɩ bil moribiee? Mɩ fa sɩ mɩɩra kɔ ŋ-la, mɩ fa jaŋ laa moribie-la arɩ mɩ nyʋʋrʋŋ kala.’

english_verse: Then he said to some other servants standing there, “Take the money away from him and give it to the servant who earned ten times as much.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔnsʋ-la fa sɩ chɩŋ nɩmɛ, ‘Má laa siidi bʋɩ-la ʋ teeŋ a joŋo pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ siidi bʋɩ fii-la.’

english_verse: The king replied, “Those who have something will be given more. But everything will be taken away from those who don't have anything.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, ‘Nɩɩ-la sɩ paala kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ, Wɩa jaŋ wasa chɛ pɛ a pʋ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ faasa kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ, mʋapɩlɩɩ-la ma ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ, Wɩa jaŋ kaa laa ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Now bring me the enemies who didn't want me to be their king. Kill them while I watch!” Jesus Enters Jerusalem (Matthew
translation_verse: Mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ deemba saa sɩ bɩ cho dɩ mɩ ŋaa ba kuoro, má kɛmba kaa kɔ daha dɩ mɩ ŋaa ba kpʋba mɩ sɩpaaŋ.’ ” Yesu jʋʋ Jerusalɛm Mat.

english_verse: When Jesus had finished saying all this, he went on toward Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɛrɛ, ʋ joŋ ʋ wombiiŋ a laa ʋ harɩ-tooroo sɩpaaŋ ba mʋmʋ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: As he was getting near Bethphage and Bethany on the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples on ahead.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ yi Bɛtɩfagɩ arɩ Bɛtanɩ dɩɩrɩŋ a kʋ yi peel kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Olif. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu lɩɩsɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo balɩa a tɩmba a bʋla pɩba,

english_verse: They went off and found everything just as Jesus had said.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ a na wɩalɩŋ kala Yesu fa sɩ bʋla pɩba.

english_verse: While they were untying the donkey, its owners asked, “Why are you doing that?”
translation_verse: Ba sɩɩ puri kaku-bie-la, ʋ tɩɩna pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ maa puri kaku-bie-la?”

english_verse: They answered, “The Lord needs it.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pʋ, “La Tɩɩna nɩɩ chɛ.”

english_verse: Then they led the donkey to Jesus. They put some of their clothes on its back and helped Jesus get on.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ kaku-bie-la a kaa mʋ pɩ Yesu, a wuri ba gɛnnɩŋ a daŋ kaku-bie-la nyuŋ, aŋ kɛŋ Yesu ʋ jɩla hɔŋ.

english_verse: And as he rode along, the people spread clothes on the road in front of him.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ jɩl kaku-bie-la aa vɛŋ ŋɩɩ, ba joŋ ba gɛnnɩŋ jɛrɛ wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When Jesus started down the Mount of Olives, his large crowd of disciples were happy and praised God because of all the miracles they had seen.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mʋ kpagɛ Jerusalɛm, lee-la wombiiŋ sɩ lɩɩ Olif peel-la nyuŋ tuu, nɩ-daŋ-la fa sɩ to Yesu harɩŋ suomo jʋjʋɔsɛ a faasa dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa a tɩŋ ʋ wʋmagɩla-la kala ba sɩ na.

english_verse: They shouted, “Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven and glory to God.”
translation_verse: Ba bʋla, “Wɩa jaŋ pɛ kuoru-la sɩɩ kɔ La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. Wɩa yɩrɩŋ ma jaŋ yɩrɛ.”

english_verse: Some Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, make your disciples stop shouting!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ fa sɩ hɛ nɩ-daŋ-la tʋɔŋ bʋla pɩ Yesu, “La kʋhɩaŋ, ŋaa dɩ ŋ harɩ-tooro-la kɛŋ goŋ.”

english_verse: When Jesus came closer and could see Jerusalem, he cried
translation_verse: Yesu sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ kʋ kpagɛ Jerusalɛm a na taŋ-la. Ʋ yel a tɩŋ taŋ-la nɩaa wɩaa aŋ bʋl,

english_verse: and said: It is too bad that today your people don't know what will bring them peace! Now it is hidden from them.
translation_verse: “Mɩ fa cho dɩ ma taŋ deeŋ nɩaa jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa nɛ jɩnɩŋ, ama ma bɩ wuo na.

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time will come when your enemies will build walls around you to attack you. Armies will surround you and close in on you from every side.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ jaŋ yi dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ saa kɛrɛ gollima, dɩ ma sɩ́ wuo lɩɩ.

english_verse: They will level you to the ground and kill your people. Not one stone in your buildings will be left on top of another. This will happen because you did not see that God had come to save you. Jesus in the Temple (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kpʋ ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ, ma dɩ ma biiriŋ kala. Tabɩɩ-bie ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ daŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ lɛ lee-la. Ma bɩ sɛyɛ bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ kɔ dɩ ʋ laama ta. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.” Yesu jʋʋ Wɩa dɩa Mat.

english_verse: When Jesus entered the temple, he started chasing out the people who were selling things.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ mʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩa, ʋ suomo kikiri nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yallɛ kɩaa nɩmɛ

english_verse: He told them, “The Scriptures say, ‘My house should be a place of worship.’ But you have made it a place where robbers hide!”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋla pɩba, “Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl arɩ Wɩa sɩ, ʋ dɩa jaŋ ŋaa lee-la nɩaa sɩ jaŋ chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa, aŋ ka ma mɩɩra kaa bɩrɩmɛ gaarɩ-dɩa.”

english_verse: Each day, Jesus kept on teaching in the temple. So the chief priests, the teachers of the Law of Moses, and some other important people tried to have him killed.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-na kala Yesu yie dɩdagɛ nɩaa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa chɩchɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ.

english_verse: But they could not find a way to do it, because everyone else was eager to listen to him.
translation_verse: Ama ba bɩ jɩŋ wombii-la ba sɩ jaŋ to, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ jegile nɩnɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl nɛ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ.

english_verse: The spies said to him, “Teacher, we know you teach the truth about what God wants people to do. And you treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ hɛ mʋ Yesu teeŋ, a pɩɛsʋ, “La kʋhɩaŋ, la jɩma wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩɩ bʋl aŋ dɩdagɛ ma, ba ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ. La jɩma arɩ ŋ joŋ nɩaa kala ba ŋaa kʋbala nɛ, ŋŋ dagɛ Wɩa wombii-tɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: The Sadducees did not believe that people would rise to life after death. So some of them came to Jesus
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Saduusi tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ ma kɔ Yesu teeŋ. Nɩaa deemba laa dii arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba bɩra bɩ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsʋ,

english_verse: When God raises people from death, whose wife will this woman be? All seven brothers had married her.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɩaa sɩ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, baalaa deemba balɩpɛ tʋɔŋ kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ haal-la? Ba kala balɩpɛ nɛ jaaʋ.”

english_verse: asked him, “What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
translation_verse: a pɩɛsʋ, “Dol bɛɛ nɛ ŋ kɛŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa deemba? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ pɩŋ doluŋ ŋ ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I want to ask you a question.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ ma jaŋ pɩɛsɛma wɩɩ, dɩ ma dagɛmɛ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being?”
translation_verse: Jɔɔŋ, nɩɩ-la fa sɩɩ fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, ʋ doluŋ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ koo nuhuobiine teeŋ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: They talked this over and said to each other, “We can't say God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba suomo kɛŋ wɩɩ-la chʋchɔgɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ a bʋl, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ laa chɛ dɩ la bʋl? Dɩ la nɛ bʋla pʋ dɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ ʋ lɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ pɩɛsɛla, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii?’

english_verse: And we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize. The crowd will stone us to death, because they think John was a prophet.”
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ bɩra sɩ nuhuobiine teeŋ nɛ, nɩ-daŋ-la kala sɩ hilimi daha jaŋ yagɛla arɩ tabɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba sɛyɛ arɩ Jɔɔŋ fa ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: So they told Jesus, “We don't know who gave John the right to baptize.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pʋ, “La bɩ jɩŋ ʋ dol-la sɩ lɩɩ lee-la.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Then I won't tell you who gave me the right to do what I do.” Renters of a Vineyard (Matthew
translation_verse: Yesu ma bʋla pɩba, “Tɔɔ, mɩ ma bɩ jaŋ dagɛma dol-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa deemba bʋbʋɔŋ.” Yesu magɛ namaga a tɩgɛ tɩntɩnnaa sɩ hɛ baga lɛ Mat.

english_verse: Guard against the teachers of the Law of Moses! They love to walk around in long robes, and they like to be greeted in the market. They want the front seats in the synagogues and the best seats at banquets.
translation_verse: “Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba lɛ. Ba yie gʋgɔllɛ yɔbɔ lɛ arɩ ba gɛrɩ-duduosuŋ, a cho dɩ nɩaa zizilba a chʋchʋɔlɛba. Ba yie chɩchɛ dɩ-hɔŋ zɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ yɩrɛba dɩ ba kʋ dii kɩaa, ba cho dɩ ba hɔŋ nɩbalaa dɩ-hɔnɔɔ.

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story: A man once planted a vineyard and rented it out. Then he left the country for a long time.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu magɛ namaga deeŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ a bil baga a chɔnsɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ paa nɩaa hɛ baga-la lɛ dɩ ba bibeŋ, aŋ sii mʋ tintee dɔŋ a dieni nɩmɛ.

english_verse: When it was time to harvest the crop, he sent a servant to ask the renters for his share of the grapes. But they beat up the servant and sent him away without anything.
translation_verse: Girep nɛnɛ-la tɔrʋŋ sɩ yie, ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ mʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ baga teeŋ a laa tɩɩnɛnɛ-la dɔnsʋŋ kaa kɔ. Ʋ mʋ ba kɛnʋ a ŋmobu aŋ kiru, ʋ mɩɩra kɛŋ na-hɩllɩŋ a kaa mʋ baga tɩɩna teeŋ.

english_verse: When the renters saw the owner's son, they said to one another, “Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ baga sɩ naʋ dɩ ʋʋ kɔ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ, ‘Baga-la tɩɩna nanʋala nɛ ŋɩɩ. Dɩ baga-la tɩɩna nɛ sʋba, ʋ nanʋala deeŋ nɛ jaŋ dii ʋ dʋa. Má leŋ dɩ la kpʋʋ, ka dɩ baga-la ŋaa la kʋŋ.’

english_verse: I'll tell you what. He will come and kill those renters and let someone else have his vineyard.” When the people heard this, they said, “This must never happen!”
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɔ a kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ baga-la kala aŋ joŋ baga-la a pɩ nɩtanɩa.” Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Yesu sɩ bʋla, ba sɩ, “Wɩɩŋ deeŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses knew that Jesus was talking about them when he was telling this story. They wanted to arrest him right then, but they were afraid of the people. Paying Taxes (Matthew

english_verse: Two criminals were led out to be put to death with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɛŋ Yesu mʋ ŋɩɩ, ba kɛŋ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ balɩa ma kaa mʋ dɩ ba kpʋba a pɛ Yesu lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus said, “Father, forgive these people! They don't know what they're doing.” While the crowd stood there watching Jesus, the soldiers gambled for his clothes. The leaders insulted him by saying, “He saved others. Now he should save himself, if he really is God's chosen Messiah!”
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma chɩŋ nɩmɛ a bibeŋ, aŋ ka Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩŋ sisieri ʋ lɛ a bʋl, “Ʋ laa nɩaa tɩta nɛ, ma leŋ dɩ ʋ laa ʋ tɩtɩa ta yeii, dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa.”

english_verse: The soldiers made fun of Jesus and brought him some wine.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoroo ma sieri ʋ lɛ a ŋaa sɩnɩŋ sɩ nyala a kaa mʋ pʋ dɩ ʋ nyʋa

english_verse: They said, “If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself!”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa kuoro, laa ŋ tɩtɩa ta.”

english_verse: But the other criminal told the first one off, “Don't you fear God? Aren't you getting the same punishment as this man?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩbɔŋ-la dɔŋɔ kpɩa ʋ lɛ a bʋl, “Ŋ bɩ Wɩa ka fáa? La dɩ ʋ kala nɛ jʋʋ wʋbala.

translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩŋ, mɩ dɩŋ kala jaŋ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ jɩnɩŋ.” Yesu sʋba Mat.

english_verse: The sun stopped shining, and the curtain in the temple split down the middle.
translation_verse: Patɩɩsaŋ nɛ fa hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ ba kaa kɛrɛ. Ʋ kɩɛsɛ balɩa.

english_verse: Then they went to prepare some sweet-smelling spices for his burial. But on the Sabbath they rested, as the Law of Moses commands.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mɩɩra mʋ dɩa a chɛ tʋlaalɩɩ dɩ ba kaa mʋ tɩsɛ Yesu. Ba sii chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ a wiesi, arɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: A crowd had gathered to see the terrible sight. Then after they had seen it, they felt brokenhearted and went home.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ hilimi nɩmɛ dɩ ba na wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa, aŋ lɛɛlɛ na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa, ba paa ba nɩsaa chʋŋ nyuŋ lɛ a mɩɩra mʋ dɩa.

english_verse: All of Jesus' close friends and the women who had come with him from Galilee stood at a distance and watched. Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ jɩŋ Yesu, arɩ haala-la kala fa sɩɩ to ʋ harɩŋ a lɩɩ Galilii kɔ, ba chɩŋ dɩ-bolii a na wɩaa deemba kala. Ba hugi Yesu Mat.

english_verse: There was a man named Joseph, who was from Arimathea in Judea. Joseph was a good and honest man, and he was eager for God's kingdom to come. He was also a member of the council, but he did not agree with what they had decided.
translation_verse: Ba fa sɩɩ vʋʋrɛ dɩ ba kpʋ Yesu ŋɩɩ, ʋ fa bɩ sɛyɛ. Ʋ fa lɩɩ Juda taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Arɩmatɩya nɛ a gbɩgbɛrɛ Wɩa kuorii-la dɩ ʋ kɔ.

english_verse: Joseph went to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sii mʋ Paalɩt teeŋ a sʋl Yesu kʋsʋʋŋ, ʋ sɛɩ.

english_verse: He took the body down from the cross and wrapped it in fine cloth. Then he put it in a tomb that had been cut out of solid rock and had never been used.
translation_verse: Ʋ mʋ sori a joŋ gɛrɩ-pʋla a bɛʋ, a kɛnʋ kaa mʋ hugi bʋŋ ba sɩ lɔsɔ lɛ. Ba ha bɩ nʋʋkala hugo nɩmɛ.

english_verse: It was Friday, and the Sabbath was about to begin.
translation_verse: Zʋma chɛɛŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, dɩ baa ŋaa siri dɩ ba suomi ba chɛ-wiesii-la.

english_verse: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and watched how Jesus' body was placed in the tomb.
translation_verse: Haala-la fa sɩ to Yesu harɩŋ a lɩɩ Galilii kɔ, ba to Josɛf harɩŋ a mʋ na bʋbʋa-la, arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ hugi Yesu.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and some other women were the ones who had gone to the tomb. When they returned, they told the eleven apostles and the others what had happened.
translation_verse: Haala-la sɩ mʋ bʋa-la leriŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɛɛrɩ Magɩdalɩŋ, Jʋana arɩ Jeems naaŋ Mɛɛrɩ. Ba dɩ haalaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ bʋl wɩaa deemba sɩ ŋaa a pɩ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la.

english_verse: When they found the stone rolled away from the entrance,
translation_verse: Ba sɩ yi lee-la, ba na dɩ tabɩɩ-la ba fa sɩ kaa tɔ bʋa-la niiŋ suro.

english_verse: they went in. But they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jʋʋ bʋa-la tʋɔŋ, ama ba bɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu kʋsʋʋŋ na.

english_verse: and they did not know what to think. Suddenly two men in shining white clothes stood beside them.
translation_verse: Ba chɩŋ nɩmɛ a bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa. Ba ŋaa dɩ ba beŋ, dɩ baalaa balɩa nɛ chɩŋ ba sɛmɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba gɛnnɩŋ faasa tʋtʋl.

english_verse: The women were afraid and bowed to the ground. But the men said, “Why are you looking in the place of the dead for someone who is alive?
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ faasa kɛŋ haala-la. Ba kɛŋ ba nyusuŋ gʋrɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ baala-la pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma chɩchɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ weye nɩsʋʋnʋŋ tʋɔŋ?

english_verse: ‘The Son of Man will be handed over to sinners who will nail him to a cross. But three days later he will rise to life.’ ”
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bʋla pɩma arɩ ba jaŋ joŋ ʋ-na Nuhuobiine Bie a hɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba kpaasʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ dɩ ʋ sʋʋ, aŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ.”

english_verse: That same day two of Jesus' disciples were going to the village of Emmaus, which was about eleven kilometers from Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ nɩaa balɩa fa sɩɩ to Yesu harɩŋ mʋmʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Emayɔs. Emayɔs arɩ Jerusalɛm yi arɩ meel-daasɩŋ balɩpɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus came near and started walking along beside them.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ vɩvɛŋ ŋɩɩ, Yesu tɩtɩa kɔ ba teeŋ ba kala vɩvɛŋ,

english_verse: Jesus asked them, “What were you talking about as you walked along?” The two of them stood there looking sad and gloomy.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛba, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma bʋlaa vɛŋ ŋɩɩ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba chɩŋ, ba tʋɔŋ kala chei.

english_verse: We had hoped that he would be the one to set Israel free! But it has already been three days since all this happened.
translation_verse: La fa kɛŋ yɩɛlaa arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ kɔ dɩ ʋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta. Ba sɩ kpʋ Yesu, ʋ tapʋlaa batori nɛ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: Some women in our group surprised us. They had gone to the tomb early in the morning,
translation_verse: La dɩ haala-la dɔnsʋŋ fa sɩɩ to Yesu harɩŋ kʋ bʋl wɩɩ pɩla ʋ kperila. Ba sii mʋ bʋa-la leriŋ sɩɩpʋʋraa,

english_verse: Some men from our group went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said. But they didn't see Jesus either.
translation_verse: La tʋɔŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma mʋ bʋa-la leriŋ a na arɩ wɩɩ-la haala-la sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ba bɩ Yesu na.”

english_verse: Then Jesus asked the two disciples, “Why can't you understand? How can you be so slow to believe all that the prophets said?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Nɩyaaraa, ma tʋɔŋ dolie, ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa fa sɩ bʋla laa dii.

english_verse: Didn't you know that the Messiah would have to suffer before he was given his glory?”
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ ʋ maga dɩ Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, na hɛɛŋ nɛ aŋ-na jʋʋ ʋ kuorii-la tʋɔŋ a laa yɩrɩŋ?”

english_verse: Jesus then explained everything written about himself in the Scriptures, beginning with the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu dagɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ bʋbʋɔŋ a pɩba. Ʋ suomi teniŋ-la Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa a kaa mʋ tenni-la kala Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ ŋmʋnsa lɛ.

english_verse: They begged him, “Stay with us! It's already late, and the sun is going down.” So Jesus went into the house to stay with them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛnʋ bil aŋ bʋl, “Chʋa la teeŋ, taŋ bire nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jʋʋ dɩ ʋ chʋa ba teeŋ.

english_verse: After Jesus sat down to eat, he took some bread. He blessed it and broke it. Then he gave it to them.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ hɔnɔ dɩ ba dii kʋdiilee, Yesu joŋ boroboro a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa aŋ kaa chɔgɔ pɩba dɩ ba dii.

english_verse: At once they knew who he was, but he disappeared.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba sɩaa lʋɔmɛ ba jɩŋ arɩ Yesu nɛ. Ka ʋ lɛl ba sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: They said to each other, “When he talked with us along the road and explained the Scriptures to us, didn't it warm our hearts?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ, “La yaraa fa fɩɛla nɛ woruŋ ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩla wombiiŋ lɛ, aŋ pɛ dɩdagɛla Wɩa teniŋ wɩalɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: So they got up and returned to Jerusalem. The two disciples found the eleven apostles and the others gathered together.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sii lɩma lɩma a mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm, a na Yesu harɩ-tooro-la fii arɩ kʋbala, arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma fa sɩɩ to Yesu harɩŋ dɩ ba hilime,

english_verse: And they learned from the group that the Lord was really alive and had appeared to Peter.
translation_verse: a bʋbʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ La Tɩɩna sɛnɛ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ Saamɔŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Then the disciples from Emmaus told what happened on the road and how they knew he was the Lord when he broke the bread. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ balɩamɩŋ ma bʋl wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wombiiŋ lɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ kʋ jɩŋ arɩ Yesu nɛ. Ba sɩ dɩ bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ boroboro chɔgɛ a pɩba lɛ nɛ ba jɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɛ. Yesu kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo Mat.

english_verse: While Jesus' disciples were talking about what had happened, Jesus appeared and greeted them.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ balɩa sɩɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ Yesu tɩtɩa nɛ chɩŋ ba tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ ŋɩɩ a bʋla pɩba, “Ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.”

english_verse: They were frightened and terrified because they thought they were seeing a ghost.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba, ba bɩɩna arɩ nɩdɩma nɛ ba na ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Why are you so frightened? Why do you doubt?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma, ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa bibegili?

english_verse: Look at my hands and my feet and see who I am! Touch me and find out for yourselves. Ghosts don't have flesh and bones as you see I have.”
translation_verse: Má beŋ mɩ nɩsaa arɩ mɩ naasɩŋ na a jɩŋ dɩ mɩ nɛ. Má digimi na. Ma jɩma arɩ nɩdɩma bɩ yaraa kɛnɛ arɩ mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa arɩ ʋ naasɩŋ kala a dagɛba.

english_verse: The disciples were so glad and amazed that they could not believe it. Jesus then asked them, “Do you have something to eat?”
translation_verse: Ba ha bɩ laa dii, ka wɩɩ-la sɩma pɩba aŋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Ma kɛŋ kʋdiilee nɛɛ?”

english_verse: They gave him a piece of broiled fish.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ chenfiliŋ ba sɩ wasa a pʋ.

english_verse: He took it and ate it as they watched.
translation_verse: Ʋ laa chaŋ ba sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “While I was still with you, I told you that everything written about me in the Law of Moses, the Books of the Prophets, and in the Psalms had to happen.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ fa sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ, mɩ bʋla pɩma arɩ wɩɩ-na kala ba fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ jaŋ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto arɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa, arɩ Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Wɩa yɩɩlaa tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: He told them: The Scriptures say that the Messiah must suffer, then three days later he will rise from death.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ŋ-la nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa bil: Ʋ maga dɩ Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa na hɛɛŋ a sʋʋ aŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ.

english_verse: They also say that all people of every nation must be told in my name to turn to God, in order to be forgiven. So beginning in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, tintee kala lɛ, dɩ nɩaa bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ dɩ Wɩa joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba. Ba jaŋ suomo ŋaa ŋɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: you must tell everything that has happened.
translation_verse: Ma ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala sɩada nɛ, dɩ ma wuo bʋla pɩ nɩaa.

translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ kʋ-la mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma kɔ ma teeŋ. Ama má gbɛrɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ doluŋ sɩ jaŋ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ a kʋ tuu hɛ ma lɛ.” Yesu jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ Maak

english_verse: Jesus led his disciples out to Bethany, where he raised his hands and blessed them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la ba lɩɩ tabal-la lɛ a joŋ wombiiŋ a mʋmʋ Bɛtanɩ dɩɩrɩŋ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa je ba nyuŋ aŋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩba.

english_verse: As he was doing this, he left and was taken up to heaven.
translation_verse: Ʋ ha sɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩba ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sii ba teeŋ .

english_verse: After his disciples had worshiped him, they returned to Jerusalem and were very happy.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba chʋɔlʋ aŋ mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm. Ba tʋɔŋ kala faasa tɔrɛ.

english_verse: They spent their time in the temple, praising God.
translation_verse: Ba yie jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la bʋa na-kala lɛ a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: From the very beginning the Word was with God.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ kala nɛ ʋ fa hɛ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: received its life from him, and his life gave light to everyone.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la fa weye nɛ a kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ kaa kʋ pɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: The light keeps shining in the dark, and darkness has never put it out.
translation_verse: Pʋlʋŋ-la chaanɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ, biriŋ-la bɩ pʋlʋŋ-la wuo tɔ.

english_verse: God sent a man named John,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩŋ ʋ tɩndaarʋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Jɔɔŋ.

english_verse: who came to tell about the light and to lead all people to have faith.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ kɔ dɩ ʋ bʋl pʋlʋŋ-la wɩaa pɩ nɩaa. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ nʋʋkala wuo nɩɩ a to ʋ lɛ a laa pʋlʋŋ-la wɩaa dii.

english_verse: The true light that shines on everyone was coming into the world.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ pʋlʋŋ-la tɩtɩa kʋ tuu dʋnɩa dɩ ʋ chaana hɛ nʋʋkala lɛ.

english_verse: The Word was in the world, but no one knew him, though God had made the world with his Word.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa hɛ dʋnɩa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ to ʋ lɛ ta nɛ, ama dʋnɩa nɩaa bɩ ʋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: He came into his own world, but his own nation did not welcome him.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɔ ʋ tɩtɩa jáŋ, ama ʋ jáŋ nɩaa bɩ ʋ laa.

english_verse: They were not God's children by nature or because of any human desires. God himself was the one who made them his children.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba bɩ naga baala sɩ jɩŋ ʋ haala ba lʋl biiriŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Wɩa tɩtɩa nɛ ŋaa ba Nyɩmma.

english_verse: The Word became a human being and lived here with us. We saw his true glory, the glory of the only Son of the Father. From him the complete gifts of undeserved grace and truth have come down to us.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ wɩɩ-la bɩrɩmɛ nuhuobiine a kʋ hɛ la tʋɔŋ. Ʋ fa hɛ la teeŋ a fɩfá la nenige woruŋ, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. La na ʋ tʋla. Tʋla deeŋ ʋ Nyɩmma Wɩa nɛ joŋo pʋ, arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ʋ Bie kala.

english_verse: Because of all that the Son is, we have been given one blessing after another.
translation_verse: Kʋ-la kala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ, la ma na kpaalɩŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ yie fá la nenige aa pɛ la lɛ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: The religious authorities in Jerusalem sent priests and temple helpers to ask John who he was. He told them plainly, “I am not the Messiah.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ bɩ wɩaa nyɩa aŋ chaasa bʋl arɩ ʋ dee Kirisito, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa.

english_verse: Then when they asked him if he were Elijah, he said, “No, I am not!” And when they asked if he were the Prophet, he also said “No!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra pɩɛsʋ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa ŋ ŋaa? Ŋ nɛ ŋaa Ɩlaaja?” Ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ dee.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la la sɩɩ gbɛrʋ?” Ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Aɩ.”

english_verse: Finally, they said, “Who are you then? We have to give an answer to the ones who sent us. Tell us who you are!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra pɩɛsʋ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa ŋ ŋaa? Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ dagɛla, dɩ la mʋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩnla. Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ bʋl a tɩgɛ ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ?”

english_verse: John answered in the words of the prophet Isaiah, “I am only someone shouting in the desert, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord!’ ”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ bʋl, “Mɩ nɛ ŋaa yikoro-la sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ a heelee bʋl, ‘Má wasɛ wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ tʋʋlɛ a pɩ La Tɩɩna.’ Ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Azaaya fa bʋl dɩ ma ŋaa.”

english_verse: Some Pharisees had also been sent to John.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ kʋ pɩɛsɛ Jɔɔŋ wɩaa deemba, Farisii tɩŋŋaa nɛ fa tɩmba.
