english_verse: They asked him, “Why are you baptizing people, if you are not the Messiah or Elijah or the Prophet?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra pɩɛsɛ Jɔɔŋ, “Ŋ dee bɩ Kirisito ŋaa, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, ŋ dee bɩ Ɩlaaja ma ŋaa, ŋ bɩra bɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ ma ŋaa. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ŋ fufo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ?”

english_verse: John told them, “I use water to baptize people. But here with you is someone you don't know.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ bʋl, “Mɩ sɩɩ fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, lɩɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ mɩ kaa fufoba, ama nʋʋ dɔŋ nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, ka ma bɩ ʋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: Even though I came first, I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ to mɩ harɩŋ kɔ. Mɩ paala bɩ maga dɩ mɩ kɛŋ ʋ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ ŋmɛsɩŋ ma kaa puri.”

english_verse: John said this as he was baptizing east of the Jordan River in Bethany. The Lamb of God
translation_verse: Ba pɩɛsɛ Jɔɔŋ wɩaa deemba kala Bɛtanɩ lɛ nɛ, Jɔdaŋ fuo-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, lee-la Jɔɔŋ fa sɩɩ fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ. Jɔɔŋ bʋl Wɩa Pie-bie wɩaa

english_verse: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said: Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
translation_verse: Ʋ taŋ sɩ pʋla, Jɔɔŋ na Yesu dɩ ʋ tʋʋlʋ kʋkɔ. Ʋ bʋl, “Má bee na, Wɩa Pie-bie-la nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ nɛ laa dʋnɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta.

english_verse: He is the one I told you about when I said, “Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.”
translation_verse: Baala deeŋ wɩaa nɛ mɩ faa bʋl ŋɩɩ, arɩ nʋʋ nɛ jaŋ kɔ mɩ harɩŋ. Ʋ nɛ kɩɩmɛ, ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ ka ba-na lʋlmɛ.

english_verse: I didn't know who he was. But I came to baptize you with water, so that everyone in Israel would see him.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa bɩ jɩŋ nɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa. Ama mɩ ta kʋ fufo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ nɛ, dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ jɩmʋ.”

english_verse: I was there and saw the Spirit come down on him like a dove from heaven. And the Spirit stayed on him.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Jɔɔŋ sɩ bʋla pɩ nɩaa a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ na Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a nagɛ kokomo, a kʋ tuu togili ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Before this I didn't know who he was. But the one who sent me to baptize with water had told me, “You will see the Spirit come down and stay on someone. Then you will know that he is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Mɩ ma tɩtɩa fa bɩ ʋ jɩŋ. Ama Wɩa sɩ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, ʋ nɛ bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Ŋ jaŋ na mɩ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ dɩ ʋ kʋ tuu a hɛ nʋʋ lɛ, tɩɩna nɛ jaŋ joŋ mɩ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la a hɛ nɩaa lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: I saw this happen, and I tell you that he is the Son of God. The First Disciples of Jesus
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ sɛnɛ naʋ nɛ, a bʋlaa pɩma arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie.” Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kʋ to Yesu harɩŋ

english_verse: The next day, John was there again, and two of his followers were with him.
translation_verse: Ʋ taŋ sɩ pʋla, Jɔɔŋ arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo balɩa bɩra chɩŋ lee-la,

english_verse: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Here is the Lamb of God!”
translation_verse: a na Yesu dɩ ʋʋ bal. Jɔɔŋ sɩ naʋ dɩ ʋʋ bal, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Má bee na, Wɩa Pie-bie-la nɛ ŋ-la.”

english_verse: John's two followers heard him, and they went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ʋ harɩ-tooro-la balɩa nɩɩ ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ a to Yesu harɩŋ.

english_verse: When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, “What do you want?” They answered, “Rabbi, where do you live?” The Hebrew word “Rabbi” means “Teacher.”
translation_verse: Yesu mɩɩra daasɛ, dɩ baa to ʋ harɩŋ. Ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ maa chɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ma pɩɛsʋ, “La kʋhɩaŋ, nɩɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ jʋjʋʋ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Come and see!” It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má kʋ na lee-la mɩ sɩɩ jʋʋ.” Ba to ʋ harɩŋ a mʋ na lee-la ʋ sɩɩ jʋʋ. Bʋa-la lɛ ŋaa dɩdaanɩŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɛ ʋ teeŋ wɩɩ-kaanɩŋ tiire jʋʋ.

english_verse: One of the two men who had heard John and had gone with Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ balɩa fa sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la Jɔɔŋ sɩ bʋla a to Yesu harɩŋ, dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Anduru. Ʋ fa ŋaa Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta ŋaana nɛ.

english_verse: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother and tell him, “We have found the Messiah!” The Hebrew word “Messiah” means the same as the Greek word “Christ.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Anduru ma chɛ ʋ malɩma Saamɔŋ leriŋ, a bʋla pʋ, “La na Kirisito nɛ, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa.”

english_verse: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, “Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas.” This name can be translated as “Peter.” Jesus Chooses Philip and Nathanael
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ Saamɔŋ kaa kɔ Yesu teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu benu aŋ bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ nɛ Jɔɔŋ bie Saamɔŋ. Ama lɛɛlɛ ba jaŋ yɩyɩrɩŋ Sefas.” Sefas arɩ Pɩɩta fa ŋaa yɩrɩ-bala nɛ, ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ bʋŋ. Yesu yɩrɛ Fɩlɩp arɩ Natanɩal

english_verse: Philip then found Nathanael and said, “We have found the one that Moses and the Prophets wrote about. He is Jesus, the son of Joseph from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɩlɩp na Natanɩal a bʋla pʋ, “Nɩɩ-la wɩaa Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa wombie-la Wɩa sɩ bile dɩ la tuto tʋɔŋ, la naʋ nɛ. Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa ma fa bʋl ʋ wɩaa nɛ. Ʋ nɛ Yesu, Josɛf nanʋala a lɩɩ Nazarɛt.”

english_verse: Nathanael asked, “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Philip answered, “Come and see.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Natanɩal pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ ha na kʋzɔŋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nazarɛt?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɩlɩp bʋla pʋ, “Kʋ na.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, “Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ na Natanɩal dɩ ʋʋ kɔ ʋ teeŋ, ʋ bʋl, “Nɩa deeŋ ŋaa Iziral tɩɩna tɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.”

english_verse: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Natanɩal pɩɛsʋ, “Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ ŋaa jɩmmɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ naŋ nɛ ŋ sɩ hɔŋ tutogo bʋbʋɔŋ, ka Fɩlɩp-na yɩrɩŋ.”

english_verse: Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Natanɩal bʋla pʋ, “Kʋhɩaŋ, ŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro ma.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsʋ, “Mɩ sɩ bʋla arɩ mɩ naŋ dɩ ŋ hɔŋ tutogo bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ tɩɩ, ŋ laa mɩ wɩaa dii koo? Ŋ jaŋ na wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ a kɩɩ ŋ-la.”

english_verse: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩŋ, ma jaŋ na wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ ʋ suro, dɩ Wɩa tɩndaaraa lɩɩ nɩmɛ a kʋʋ tuu mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie teeŋ, aŋ mɩɩra jɩjɩl.”

english_verse: Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa balɩa sɩ bala, baa chɛ dɩ ba gbieli hajaarɩ gbiele taŋ kʋbala lɛ baa yɩrɛ Kena, a hɛ Galilii tinteeŋ lɛ. Yesu naaŋ ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.
translation_verse: Ba fa yɩrɛ Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo ma hajaarɩ gbiele-la leriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: When the wine was all gone, Mary said to Jesus, “They don't have any more wine.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩɩ gbieli gbiele-la ŋɩɩ, ba nyʋnyʋa tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ. Sɩŋ-la sɩ dɛrɛ, Yesu naaŋ bʋla pʋ dɩ sɩŋ-la dɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ dagɛmɛ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa ha bɩ yie.”

english_verse: Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
translation_verse: Yesu naaŋ bʋla pɩ dɩa-la tɩntɩnnaa, “Má ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩma.”

english_verse: At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa fa kɛŋ ba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ wombiiŋ nɛ aa sɔŋ lɩɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa pupoi-balaa balɩdʋ nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ arɩ lɩɩŋ. Kʋŋkala tʋɔŋ lɩɩŋ yi galaŋ mara a kaa mʋ galaŋ mara arɩ fii.

english_verse: Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ dɩa-la tɩntɩnnaa, “Má ŋaa lɩɩŋ a su puposu-la.” Ba ŋaa lɩɩŋ su puposu-la pɩlɩm pɩlɩm.

english_verse: he said, “Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast.” The servants did as Jesus told them,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Ma ŋaa lɩɩ-la pupoi-la tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ gbiele-la.” Ba ŋaa mʋ pʋ.

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: Ʋ laa lɩɩ-la nyʋa dɩ ʋ bɩrɩmɛ sɩnɩŋ. Ʋ bɩ jɩŋ lee-la ba sɩ na sɩŋ-la. Ama dɩa-la tɩntɩnnaa-na jɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ haal-la tɩɩna

english_verse: and said, “The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last!”
translation_verse: a bʋla pʋ, “Gbiele-na kala lɛ ba yie laa sɩpaaŋ kɛŋ sɩ-zɔmʋŋ nɛ kʋ lɩɩ ba nyʋa. Nʋʋkala sɩ nyʋa vɔgɛ, ŋ saa-na kɛŋ sɩŋ-la sɩ bɩ sɩŋ a kaa to harɩŋ kɔ. Ka ŋ-na joŋ sɩ-zɔmʋŋ bil harɩŋ a kʋ yi bʋa deeŋ kala lɛ.”

english_verse: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.
translation_verse: Ama Yesu sɩ bʋl Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ tɩtɩa yaraa wɩaa nɛ ʋ bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa ka mʋa, ka dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la yi. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii mʋ Jerusalɛm a jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu kɛŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ a bɩrɩmɛ chɩba a kiri nɩalɩŋ arɩ ba piesee arɩ ba nɛsɩŋ kala ta ba lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, aŋ kɛŋ moribii-yɛrɩrɛ-la ma teebʋlba-la kaa bɩrɩma chu, aŋ kɛŋ ba moribii-biiŋ ma jaasɛ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
translation_verse: Ʋ harɩ-tooroo liisi wɩɩ-la ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Wɩa dɩa wɩaa ka diimi nɛ woruŋ a nagɛ nyiniŋ.”

english_verse: “Destroy this temple,” Jesus answered, “and in three days I will build it again!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má ŋmoo Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ lo, mɩ jaŋ joŋ tapʋlaa batori a bɩra saaʋ.”

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ jʋʋ nɩmɛ, ʋ na nɩaa dɩ baa yallɛ nɛsɩŋ, piesee arɩ kokosuŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɛrɛ moribiee ma hɔŋ ba teebʋlba sɛsɩŋ.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka ʋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ yallɛ kokosuŋ, “Má kaa lɩɩ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ. Má sɩ́ mɩ Nyɩmma dɩa kaa bɩrɩmɛ yɔbɔ.”

english_verse: The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, “What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa mɩɩra kɔ ʋ teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ wʋmagɩl nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo joŋo dagɛla arɩ ŋ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ?”

english_verse: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus. Jesus Knows What People Are Like
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo liise yi wɩɩ-la ʋ fa sɩ bʋla lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba laa wɩalɩŋ ba fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ dii, a laa wɩalɩŋ ma Yesu sɩ bʋla dii.

english_verse: In Jerusalem during Passover many people put their faith in Jesus, because they saw him work miracles.
translation_verse: Yesu fa sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la lɛ, nɩaa yʋga a laa ʋ wɩaa dii a tɩŋ ba sɩ na wʋmagɩla-la ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.
translation_verse: Ama Yesu bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kaa pʋllɛ ba teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ jɩŋ nuhuobiinee kala nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa bɩ maga dɩ nʋʋkala bɩra bʋl nuhuobiinee wɩaa pʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ jɩŋ nuhuobiinee tʋɔŋ wʋkɛnɩŋ kala nɛ.

english_verse: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, baa yɩrɛ Nikodemɔs. Ʋ fa ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩaŋ nɛ a hɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ kʋbala ʋ sii kɔ Yesu teeŋ a bʋl, “Kʋhɩaŋ, la jɩma arɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ ta dɩ ŋ dagɛ nɩaa. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wʋmagɩla-la ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa, see dɩ Wɩa pɛ tɩɩna lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩŋ, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ, see dɩ ba wasa lʋl tɩɩna.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Yesu bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩŋ, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ, see dɩ Wɩa joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ tɩɩna lɛ, dɩ tɩɩna ma pɛ fo Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine yie lʋl nuhuobiine ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ. Wɩa ma yie joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a hɛ nʋʋ lɛ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere ŋ lɛ mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ ʋ maga dɩ ba wasa lʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: Peliŋ yie lu mʋmʋ lee-na kala ʋ sɩ cho nɛ. Ŋ nɩnɩɩ ʋ dɔmɔ, ama ŋ bɩ jɩŋ lee-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩ kʋkɔ, koo lee-la ʋ sɩɩ mʋ. Ʋ saa nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋkala Wɩa sɩ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ lɛ.”

english_verse: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nikodemɔs pɩɛsɛ, “Ɛɛ nɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ ŋaa kerichi-bal nɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, aŋ bɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩŋ, la yie bʋl wɩɩ-la la sɩ jɩma nɛ, a bʋbʋl wɩɩ-la la sɩ na. Ama ma kʋŋkala bɩ chɛ dɩ ma sɛɩ wɩɩ-la la sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl dʋnɩa wɩaa nɛ pɩpɩŋ, ka ŋ bɩ laa dii. Ɛɛ nɛ saa ŋ jaŋ wuo laa dii dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋl Wɩa-jaŋ wɩaa pɩŋ?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala ha bɩ Wɩa-jaŋ jɩla, see mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie sɩ lɩɩ nɩmɛ kʋ tuu.

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: Mosis fa sɩ hɛ gɩrɩ-bine tʋɔŋ, ʋ fa kɛŋ hɔɔŋ a libi dɩmɩŋ nɛ, a joŋo mɛrɛ daaŋ lɛ a kaa jee. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba jaŋ kpaasɛ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie ma daaŋ lɛ a kaa jee,

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: Wɩa cho dʋnɩa nɩaa a mʋ kieli, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ Bii-bala a pɩla, dɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii, ŋ bɩ jaŋ lɛl, ama ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩ ʋ Bie ta dɩ ʋ kʋ tuu laa dʋnɩa nɩaa wɩaa jɩŋ, ama dɩ ʋ laa dʋnɩa nɩaa ta.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ʋ bɩ jaŋ dii ʋ tɩɩna sarɩya a joŋ cheeriŋ pʋ, ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii, ʋ paala dii ʋ tɩɩna sarɩya a joŋ cheeriŋ pʋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ Wɩa Bii-bala-la wɩaa laa dii.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ Wɩa dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩba nɛ ŋ-la: Pʋlʋmʋŋ kʋ tuu dʋnɩa nɛ, ama nɩaa cho birimiŋ nɛ a kɩɩ pʋlʋŋ-la, bɛɛ wɩaa baa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ cho, ʋ bɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ lɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ wʋbɔmɔ-la lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ cho pʋlʋmʋŋ a yie lɩlɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ, dɩ nɩaa wuo na arɩ ʋʋ ŋaa wʋzɔmɔ-la Wɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ.” Jɔɔŋ cheŋ Yesu

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ aŋ ha hɛ Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ a dieni mʋa nɩmɛ aa fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ harɩ-tooroo dɔnsʋŋ arɩ Juu tɩɩna kʋbala kɛŋ lɩɩŋ sɔmʋŋ wɩaa kaa lɩlɛrɛ.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Ba mʋ Jɔɔŋ teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “La kʋhɩaŋ, ŋ liisi baal-la fa sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ wɩaa nɛ, nɩɩ-la wɩaa ŋ sɩ bʋla? Lɛɛlɛ ʋ maa fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ nɛ, nɩaa kala mʋmʋ ʋ teeŋ.”

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ bʋl, “Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ kʋŋkala, see dɩ Wɩa joŋo pʋ.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Ma tɩtɩa hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ, ka mɩ bʋl arɩ mɩ dee bɩ Kirisito ŋaa, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, ama Wɩa ta tɩmmɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ laa ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Ha-falɩŋ tɩɩna nɛ tɩɩ haala, ama dɩ ha-falɩŋ tɩɩna nandɔŋɔ nɛ chɩŋ nɩmɛ a jijegili wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ bʋl, ʋ tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɛ nɛ dɩ ʋ nɛ nɩɩ ha-falɩŋ tɩɩna-la yikoro. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ ma tɔrɛ woruŋ Yesu nyuŋ.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ nɛ mɩɩra kʋ ŋaa nɩbalɩŋ, ka dɩ mɩ mɩɩra ŋaa nɩ-bie.” Nɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala. Nɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ tinteeŋ ŋaa tinteeŋ kʋŋ nɛ aa bʋl tinteeŋ wɩaa. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala.

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: Ʋʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ na aŋ nɩɩ ma nɛ, ama nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa sɛyɛ.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ sɛɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ jɩma arɩ Wɩa hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ tɩma, mɩɩ bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ kala a pɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Mɩ Nyɩmma Wɩa cho mɩ-na ʋ Bie, a joŋ ʋ doluŋ kala a hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa mɩ-na Wɩa Bie wɩaa dii, ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ mɩ-na Wɩa Bie wɩalɩŋ ka to, ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, ama Wɩa jaŋ na baanɩŋ ʋ tɩɩna nyuŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩɩ mʋ Galilii ŋɩɩ, ʋ to Samarɩa tinteeŋ

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa haal-la pɩɛsɛ Yesu, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ-na Juu tɩɩna chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ-na Samarɩa tɩɩna ŋaa lɩɩŋ pɩŋ dɩ ŋ nyʋa?” Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa bɩ wɩɩ pɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ haal-la bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la pɩɛsʋ, “Kʋhɩaŋ, ŋ bɩ gʋʋga kɛnɛ dɩ ŋ kaa ŋaa lɩɩŋ, ka vil-la ma luŋ. Nɩɩ lɛ nɛ saa ŋ jaŋ na lɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: La naabalɩma Jekɔb nɛ joŋ viliŋ deeŋ pɩla. Ʋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ arɩ ʋ pʋsʋŋ kala nyʋa viliŋ deeŋ lɩɩŋ nɛ. Ŋ jaŋ bʋl ŋ kɩɩ Jekɔb nɛɛ?”

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ nyʋa lɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ pʋ, lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ da. Lɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ pʋ jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ lɩɩ-bulo ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a bubul, a pʋ mɩɩsɩŋ sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, pɩmɛ lɩɩŋ deeŋ, dɩ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ bɩra sɩ́ mɩ kɛŋ, dɩ mɩ bɩra sɩ́ kʋ ŋaa lɩɩŋ daha.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Mʋ yɩrɛ ŋ bala dɩ ma kɔ daha.”

english_verse: The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.” “That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
translation_verse: Ŋ fa jaa baalaa banɔŋ nɛ, ama ŋ dɩ baal-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ lɛɛlɛ sɛnɛ bɩ ŋ bal-tɩtɩɩ ŋaa. Ŋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la bʋla pɩ Yesu, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, ʋ naga ŋ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Haal-la bɩra bʋla pʋ, “La-na Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba ka chʋɔlɛ Wɩa peeliŋ deeŋ nyuŋ nɛ, aŋ ka ma Juu tɩŋŋaa sɩ Jerusalɛm nɛ lee-la sɩ maga dɩ laa chʋɔlɛ Wɩa.”

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Laamɛ dii, bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi, nɩaa bɩ jaŋ chʋɔlɛ la Nyɩmma Wɩa peeliŋ deeŋ nyuŋ koo Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Ma-na Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa sɛnɛ bɩ jɩŋ nɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ chʋɔlʋ. La-na Juu tɩŋŋaa jɩŋ Nɩɩ-la la sɩɩ chʋɔlʋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ to a laa dʋnɩa nɩaa ta, ʋ lɩɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Ama bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi, ʋ paala yi nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ sɛnɛ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, ba jaŋ chʋɔlɛ la Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ. Nɩdosunu-la nɛ Wɩa chɩchɛ.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Wɩa ŋaa dɩma nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba chʋɔlʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba chʋɔlʋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la bʋl, “Mɩ jɩma arɩ Nɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, jaŋ kɔ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ, ʋ jaŋ dagɛla wɩɩ-na kala.”

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Yesu mɩɩra bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ nɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ nɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋ teeŋ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Yesu harɩ-tooroo mɩɩra kɔ. Ʋ kperiba ba sɩ kʋ naʋ dɩ ʋʋ bʋl wɩaa haal-la teeŋ. Ama ba kʋŋkala bɩ niiŋ suro a pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ ŋŋ chɛ ʋ teeŋ?” Koo ba bɩra bɩ pɩɛsa, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ bʋbʋl wɩaa haal-la teeŋ?”

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la leŋ ʋ pupoiŋ nɩmɛ, aŋ mɩɩra mʋ jaŋ tʋɔŋ, a yɩrɛ nɩaa a bʋla pɩba,

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: “Má kʋ na baal kʋbala sɩ wuo dagɛ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa. Nɩa deeŋ nɛ saa ŋaa Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, koo?”

english_verse: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩ mʋ Yesu teeŋ.

english_verse: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Yesu harɩ-tooroo ka sʋlʋ, “La kʋhɩaŋ, laa kɩaa dii.”

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ kɛŋ kʋdiilee nɛ dɩ mɩ dii, ama ma bɩ kɩalɩŋ wɩaa jɩŋ.”

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la mɩɩra chɩnaa pɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Nʋʋ nɛ saa kɛŋ kʋdiilee kʋ pʋ koo?”

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ kʋdiilee nɛ dɩ mɩ to nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ niiŋ, a tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ pɩmɛ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ ʋ ha ka chɛnsɩŋ banɛsɛ nɛ, ka dɩ ma ŋaa baga kɩaa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, má bee na, kɩaa nɛ bɩa a gollima ŋɩɩ dɩ ma ŋaa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa kɩalɩŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, ba jaŋ laa ba time. Kɩalɩŋ ma ma sɩ ŋaa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, ba ma nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii. Ba nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa, ba kala tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɛnɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Nʋʋ dɔŋ nɛ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa, nʋʋ dɔŋ ma kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩmma nɛ dɩ ma mʋ ŋaa baga-la kɩaa ma sɩ dee bɩ duo. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ tɩma woruŋ, ka ma ma ŋaa kɩalɩŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a nɩɩ ba lɔlʋŋ sɩma.”

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa yʋgɛ Samarɩa taŋ-la lɛ a laa Yesu wɩaa dii a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la haal-la sɩ bʋla. Ʋ fa sɩ, “Ʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa nɛ a pɩmɛ.”

english_verse: They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
translation_verse: Samarɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɔ Yesu teeŋ, ba sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ chʋa ba teeŋ. Yesu sɛɩ a chʋa nɩmɛ tapʋlaa balɩa.

english_verse: Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say.
translation_verse: Nɩaa bɩra yʋga a laa ʋ wɩaa dii a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ dagɛba wɩaa.

english_verse: They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!” Jesus Heals an Official's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ bʋla pɩ haal-la, “Lɛɛlɛ la laa ʋ wɩaa dii a tɩŋ la tɩtɩa sɩ nɩɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa nɛ, ʋ bɩ naga wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ bʋla pɩla nɛ tɩɩ. La jɩma arɩ ʋ nɛ sɛnɛ ŋaa dʋnɩa Laataara.” Yesu vaarɛ kerichi-bal kʋbala bie

english_verse: Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left
translation_verse: Yesu tɩtɩa fa bʋla arɩ nɩaa bɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla ka zil ʋ tɩtɩa jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mʋ Galilii tinteeŋ ŋɩɩ, ba kɛnʋ woruŋ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa ba-na Juu tɩŋŋaa gbiele-la lɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ba ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick.
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra mɩɩra mʋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kena a hɛ Galilii tinteeŋ lɛ, lee-la ʋ fa sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ bɩrɩmɛ sɩnɩŋ. Dɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ kʋbala fa hɛ taŋ kʋbala lɛ baa yɩrɛ Kapɛnam, ʋ bie fa wʋwɩɩlɛ.

english_verse: And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ nɩa dɩ Yesu lɩɩ Judiya tinteeŋ a kɔ Galilii tinteeŋ, ʋ mʋ Yesu teeŋ a sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ kʋ vaarɛ ʋ bie pʋ, dɩ ʋ ka mʋa ka dɩ ʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “See dɩ ma na wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ, ma bɩ jaŋ laa dii.”

english_verse: The man replied, “Lord, please come before my son dies!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ-la bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, kɔ lɩma dɩ mɩ bie sɩ́ sʋʋ.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Mʋ dɩa, ŋ bie duoro nɛ.” Baal-la laa wɩɩ-la Yesu sɩ bʋla pʋ dii a joŋ ʋ wombiiŋ a mʋmʋ.

english_verse: Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ tɩntɩnna kʋ chemu a bʋla pʋ arɩ bile duoro nɛ.

english_verse: He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
translation_verse: Ʋ pɩɛsɛ dɩ ʋ na bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ duoro. Ba bʋla pʋ arɩ dɩamɩŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ, kerifi kʋbala lɛ nɛ waarɩ-la leŋu.

english_verse: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Bile nyɩmma jɩŋ arɩ bʋa-la lɛ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ arɩ ʋ bie kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala laa ʋ wɩaa dii.

english_verse: This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Wʋmagɩlɛ lɩamɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ Yesu fa sɩ ŋaa, ʋ sɩ bɩra lɩɩ Judiya kɔ Galilii tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa gbiele kʋbala bɩra yi Jerusalɛm lɛ. Yesu sii mʋ lee-la.

english_verse: Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala ma nɛ fa hɛ nyanyal tɩmma-la tʋɔŋ. Ʋ fa wɩɩla nɛ a yi jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ chori.

english_verse: You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.
translation_verse: Ʋ niiŋ wɩaa bɩ ma lɛ hɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma bɩ mɩ-na nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ tɩma wɩaa laa dii.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be healed?”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ na baal-la dɩ ʋ pɩŋ nɩmɛ, ʋ jɩŋ arɩ baal-la wɩɩla dieni nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋŋ chɛ dɩ ŋ duori nɛɛ?”

english_verse: The man answered, “Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋl, “Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, mɩ bɩ nʋʋ kɛnɛ daha sɩ jaŋ wuo jommi kaa tuu hɛ fuo-la lɛ dɩ ba nɛ kɛŋ lɩɩ-la vuugi. Ba yie kɛŋ lɩɩ-la vuugi, mɩɩ nɛrɩgɛ dɩ mɩ tuu, dɩ nʋʋ laa sɩpaaŋ tuu mɩ lɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Pick up your mat and walk!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ baal-la, “Sii a chuoli ŋ bɔsɔ a viiri.”

english_verse: Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Baal-la guu duori a sii chuoli ʋ bɔsɔ chʋŋ a vɩvɛŋ. Tapʋlʋŋ deeŋ fa ŋaa chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, “This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa bʋla pɩ baal-la Yesu sɩ vaara, “Jɩnɩŋ ŋaa chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ nɛ. Ʋʋ kɩsɛ nɛ dɩ ŋ chʋŋ bɔsɔ jɩnɩŋ chɛɛŋ.”

english_verse: But he replied, “The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la ma bʋl, “Nɩɩ-la sɩ vaarɛmɛ nɛ bʋla pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ chuoli mɩ bɔsɔ a viiri.”

english_verse: They asked him, “Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsʋ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ baal-la sɩ bʋla pɩŋ dɩ ŋ chuoli ŋ bɔsɔ a viiri?”

english_verse: But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.
translation_verse: Ama baal-la bɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ vaarʋ jɩŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ nɩaa yʋga, Yesu lʋara jʋʋ ba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, “You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.”
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ Yesu na baal-la Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ a bʋla pʋ, “Na, lɛɛlɛ ŋ duoro nɛ, bɩra sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, wɩɩ dɔŋ sɩ lɔrɔ kɩɩ ŋɩɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la sii a mʋ bʋla pɩ Juu tɩmma-la arɩ Yesu nɛ fa vaarʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa suomo to Yesu naasɩŋ dɩ ba dɔgɩsʋ.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ Nyɩmma ka tɩŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ maa tɩŋ.”

english_verse: Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God. The Son's Authority
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ ŋaa Juu tɩmma-la wasa chɩchɛ wombii-la ba sɩ jaŋ to a kpʋʋ. Wɩaa balɩa nɛ ba sɩ dɩ ʋ cheye: Ʋ chei ba chɛ-wiesii-la kɩsɩŋ, aŋ pɛ bʋl dɩ Wɩa nɛ ŋaa ʋ Nyɩmma, a bʋl ŋɩɩ arɩ ʋ dɩ Wɩa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Dol-la Wɩa Bie sɩ kɛnɛ

english_verse: Jesus told the people: I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a pɩpɩma, mɩ-na Wɩa Bie bɩ wɩɩkala wuo ŋaa mɩ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ. Mɩ yie ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ na dɩ mɩ Nyɩmma ŋaa nɛ. Wɩɩ na-kala ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ mɩ ma ʋ Bie ŋɩŋaa,

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ Nyɩmma cho mɩ-na ʋ Bie nɛ, a dɩdagɛmɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ tɩtɩa sɩɩ ŋaa. Ʋ jaŋ dagɛmɛ wɩaa a kɩɩ ŋ-la dɩ mɩ ŋaa, dɩ ba ŋaama wʋkpuŋkpere.

english_verse: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ chɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba ba bɩra kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ ma ʋ Bie joŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ cho.

english_verse: The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone.
translation_verse: Mɩ Nyɩmma-na bɩ nʋʋkala sarɩya ka dii, ama ʋ joŋ ba kala hɛ mɩ-na ʋ Bie nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ nʋʋkala zizil mɩ-na ʋ Bie nɛ, arɩ ba sɩɩ zil mɩ Nyɩmma ŋɩɩ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ mɩ-na Wɩa Bie ka zil, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ mɩ Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ tɩmmɛ ka zil.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩpɩma, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jegile nɩɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa a laa nɩɩ-la ma sɩ tɩmmɛ wɩaa dii, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. Sarɩya bɩ jaŋ dii tɩɩna, ʋ lɩɩ sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩpɩma, bʋa-la jaŋ yi, ʋ saa yie ma nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba jaŋ nɩɩ mɩ-na Wɩa Bie yikoro. Nɩalɩŋ saa sɩ nɩɩ mɩ yikoro, ba jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son.
translation_verse: Mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa mɩ ma ʋ Bie kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ mɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Ʋ saa pɩ mɩ-na ʋ Bie doluŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ dii nɩaa sarɩya, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ ŋaa Nuhuobiine Bie.

english_verse: Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man,
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaama wʋkpuŋkpere. Bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ sʋba a hɛ bʋɔsʋŋ lɛ nɩɩ mɩ yikoro,

english_verse: and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.
translation_verse: a sii ba bʋɔsʋŋ lɛ a kʋ lɩɩ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ sii a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ sii, dɩ Wɩa dii ba sarɩya a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩba.”

english_verse: I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself. Witnesses to Jesus
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ-na bɩ wɩɩkala wuo ŋaa mɩ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ. Mɩ yie dii sarɩya arɩ Wɩa sɩ sɩ mɩ dii ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ sɩ yie dii sarɩya-la ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ, ama wɩɩ-la nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: If I speak for myself, there is no way to prove I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ bʋl mɩ wɩaa, ʋ bɩ yuŋuŋ jaŋ kɛŋ.

english_verse: But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true.
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋ ma nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a jɩŋ mɩ wɩaa a bʋbʋlba. Mɩ saa jɩma wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ, ba ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ.

english_verse: You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth.
translation_verse: Ma tɩŋ ma tɩndaaraa nɛ ba mʋ Jɔɔŋ teeŋ a pɩɛsɛ mɩ wɩaa. Jɔɔŋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ pɩba a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved.
translation_verse: Ʋ saa bɩ naga wɩalɩŋ nuhuobiinee sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ wɩaa nɛ mɩ chɩl, ama mɩɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ Wɩa wuo laama ta nɛ.

english_verse: John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
translation_verse: Jɔɔŋ fa nagɛ chaanɩŋ nɛ a chaanɛ, ma fa cho dɩ ma nɩɩ ʋ chaaŋ-la sɩma mʋapɩlɩɩ.

english_verse: But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
translation_verse: Ama wɩɩŋ dɔŋɔ hɛ nɩmɛ a laa mɩ nyuŋ a bʋbʋl wɩaa, ʋ nɛ kɩɩ Jɔɔŋ. Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ tɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ tɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ daga arɩ mɩ Nyɩmma nɛ tɩmmɛ.

english_verse: The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face.
translation_verse: Mɩ Nyɩmma-la sɩ tɩmmɛ, ʋ maa bʋl mɩ wɩaa nɛ. Ma ha bɩ ʋ yikoro nɩa, ma ha bɩ ʋ na arɩ ma sɩaa ma.

english_verse: You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me,
translation_verse: Ma yie fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a kɩkarɩmɛ Wɩa teniŋ. Ma bɩɩna arɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. Wɩa teŋ-la ma sɩɩ karɩmʋ ma paala bʋl mɩ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.
translation_verse: Ka ma vɩa dɩ ma kɔ mɩ teeŋ a wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I don't care about human praise,
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ nuhuobiinee bɛsɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: but I do know that none of you love God.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma arɩ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ ma bɩ Wɩa cho.

english_verse: I have come with my Father's authority, and you have not welcomed me. But you will welcome people who come on their own.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɔ mɩ Nyɩmma doluŋ lɛ nɛ, ka ma bɩ mɩ kɛnɛ woruŋ. Dɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ nɛ fa kɔ ʋ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ, ʋ nɛ ma fa jaŋ kɛŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!
translation_verse: Ma cho dɩ nɩaa bɛsɛ ma lɛ nɛ, ama ma bɩ chɛ dɩ Wɩa nɛ bɛsɛ ma lɛ. Ɛɛ nɛ saa ma jaŋ wuo laa mɩ wɩaa dii?

english_verse: Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ bɩɩna arɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩma mɩ Nyɩmma sɩpaaŋ. Mosis nɛ jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩma. Ma yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ sɛnɛ fa laa Mosis wɩaa dii, ma fa jaŋ laa mɩ ma wɩaa dii, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ wɩaa nɛ Mosis fa ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋmʋnsa laa dii, ɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ wuo laa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl dii?”

english_verse: The disciples gathered them up and filled twelve large baskets with what was left over from the five barley loaves.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba paa kʋkaana-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ die aŋ ka, a su sinsiŋ fii arɩ balɩa.

english_verse: The disciples wanted to take him into the boat, but suddenly the boat reached the shore where they were headed. The Bread That Gives Life
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, ba joŋu hɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ, lɩɩŋ daboro-la guu yi lɩɩŋ niiŋ lee-la ba fa sɩɩ mʋ. Nɩaa yʋga aa chɛ Yesu

english_verse: They replied, “What miracle will you work, so that we can have faith in you? What will you do?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsʋ, “Wʋmagɩl bɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ la na a laa ŋ wɩaa dii? Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa?

english_verse: No one can come to me, unless the Father who sent me makes them want to come. But if they do come, I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɔ mɩ teeŋ, see dɩ mɩ Nyɩmma-la sɩ tɩmmɛ nɛ kɛŋ ʋ tɩɩna kaa kɔ mɩ teeŋ, dɩ mɩ chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: “There is a boy here who has five small loaves of barley bread and two fish. But what good is that with all these people?”
translation_verse: “Bii-bie kʋbala nɛ hɛ la tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ boroboroba banɔŋ arɩ chenfilee balɩa. Ɛɛ nɛ saa kɩaa deemba jaŋ wuo ŋaa nɩ-daŋ deeŋ?”

english_verse: The ground was covered with grass, and Jesus told his disciples to tell everyone to sit down. About
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Má leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ hɔŋ.” Dɩ yaŋ hɛ lee-la, ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ hɔŋ. Ba tʋɔŋ baalaa fa ŋaa bʋɩ banɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: They got into a boat and started across for Capernaum. Later that evening Jesus had still not come to them,
translation_verse: a jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro, a bɩra duoroo chol mʋga a mʋmʋ Kapɛnam. Taŋ bire dɩ Yesu ha bɩ ba teeŋ kɔ.

english_verse: Jesus crossed Lake Galilee, which was also known as Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ Yesu mɩɩra chol mʋgʋ-bal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Galilii mʋgʋ-balɩŋ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ dɔŋɔ ma nɛ Tabiiras.

english_verse: A large crowd had seen him work miracles to heal the sick, and those people went with him.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yʋga a tuto ʋ harɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fa na ʋ sɩ ŋaa wʋmagɩla-la a vaarɛ nyanyal tɩŋŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: Philip answered, “Don't you know that it would take almost a year's wages just to buy only a little bread for each of these people?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɩlɩp bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ la nɛ yɔɔ boroboro a yi warɩpʋla zɔɔ-balɩa ma, ʋ bɩ nɩaa deemba wɩɩkala wuo ŋaa, mʋa mʋa nɛ ba kʋŋkala jaŋ na.”

english_verse: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the disciples. He spoke up and said,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Anduru, ʋ fa ŋaa Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta naambie nɛ, ʋ bʋla pɩ Yesu,

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he passed the bread to the people, and he did the same with the fish, until everyone had plenty to eat.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu laa boroboroba-la a lɔllɛ Wɩa, aŋ kaa chɔgɔ kpaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔnɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ chenfile-la ma kpaaba. Ba kʋŋkala dii a vɔgɛ.

english_verse: The people ate all they wanted, and Jesus told his disciples to gather up the leftovers, so that nothing would be wasted.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ dii a vɔgɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “Má mʋ paa boroboroba-la sɩ ka dɩ kʋŋkala sɩ́ pɩna ta.”

english_verse: Jesus realized that they would try to force him to be their king. So he went up on a mountain, where he could be alone. Jesus Walks on the Water (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu jɩŋ arɩ ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ba kʋ fʋgʋ dɩ ʋ dii ba kuoruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mʋ faa peeliŋ nyuŋ. Yesu vɛŋ lɩɩŋ nyuŋ Mat.

english_verse: The people who had stayed on the east side of the lake knew that only one boat had been there. They also knew that Jesus had not left in it with his disciples. But the next day
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, nɩ-daŋ-la fa sɩ chɩŋ mʋga-la cholo sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ jɩma arɩ lɩɩŋ daboro kʋbala nɛ fa chɩŋ nɩmɛ. Ba jɩma arɩ Yesu harɩ-tooroo dʋndʋŋa nɛ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la. Yesu tuo ba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Don't work for food that spoils. Work for food that gives eternal life. The Son of Man will give you this food, because God the Father has given him the right to do so.”
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma doluŋ kala hɛ a chɛ kʋdiile-la sɩ jaŋ chei, ama má tɩma chɩchɛ kʋdiile-la sɩ jaŋ pɩma mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. Kʋdiilee deemba mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie nɛ jaŋ pɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ Nyɩmma Wɩa joŋ doluŋ hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ dɩ mɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: One of the prophets wrote, “God will teach all of them.” And so everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him will come to me.
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ba sɩ, ‘Wɩa jaŋ dagɛ nɩaa kala.’ Nʋʋkala sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ Nyɩmma sɩɩ dagʋ a gʋnnɛ ʋ teeŋ, ʋ nɛ jaŋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: They started arguing with each other and asked, “How can he give us his flesh to eat?”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, Juu tɩŋŋaa suomo kɛŋ wɩɩ-la lɩlɛrɛ a bʋl, “Ɛɛ nɛ baala deeŋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa a joŋ ʋ yaraa nammɩa pɩla dɩ la chaŋ?”

english_verse: That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake.
translation_verse: Dɩdaanɩŋ, Yesu harɩ-tooroo tuu mʋga

english_verse: and a strong wind was making the water rough.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ pel-duo kʋbala maa lu a kɛŋ lɩɩ-la kala vuvuugi.

english_verse: When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la ma duoro a mʋ yi meel-daasɩŋ batori koo banɛsɛ, aŋ na Yesu dɩ ʋ vɛŋ lɩɩŋ nyuŋ a kʋkɔ daboro-la teeŋ. Ba sɩ naʋ ŋɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba.

english_verse: But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma, mɩ-na nɛ.”

english_verse: some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ chɩŋ nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ, lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Tabiiras kɔ lee-la, a kpagɛ lee-la Yesu fa sɩ lɔllɛ Wɩa aŋ joŋ boroboro pɩba ba dii.

english_verse: They saw that Jesus and his disciples had left. Then they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ na dɩ Yesu tuo, ʋ harɩ-tooroo ma tuo, ba sii jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daborusu-la a mʋ Kapɛnam aa chɛʋ. Yesu sɩ ʋ nɛ boroboro-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ

english_verse: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ na Yesu mʋga-la cholo dɔŋɔ, ba pɩɛsʋ, “La kʋhɩaŋ, bʋa bɛɛ lɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ daha?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, maa chɛmɛ a tɩŋ boroboro-la ma sɩ dii vɔgɛ wɩaa nɛ, ama wʋmagɩla-la ma sɩ na dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩaa dee.

english_verse: “What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsʋ, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ Wɩa chɛ dɩ la ŋaa?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl, “Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ cho dɩ maa tɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Má laa mɩ-na nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ tɩma wɩaa dii.”

english_verse: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
translation_verse: La naabalɩmaba dii kʋdiilee nɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ baa yɩrɛ Mana. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Ʋ joŋ boroboro-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ a pɩba dɩ ba dii.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Mɩ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a pɩpɩma, kɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ pɩma, ʋ dee bɩ ma pa, Wɩa nɛ pɩma. Kʋdiile-la bɩ ma mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ ka pa. Mɩ Nyɩmma nɩɩ pɩ nɩaa boroboro tɩtɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ.

english_verse: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
translation_verse: Boroboro-la Wɩa sɩ ta, ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ a kʋ tuu. Ʋ nɛ pɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “La Tɩɩna, ŋɩɩ-na vɛnɛ joŋ boroboro deeŋ pɩpɩla.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ nɛ ŋaa kʋdiile-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɔ mɩ teeŋ, losuŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ. Nɩɩ-la ma sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii, lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ.

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋla pɩma arɩ ma namɛ nɛ, ama ma ha bɩ mɩ wɩaa laa dii.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ, ʋ jaŋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ. Nɩaa deemba kala sɩ kɔ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ kiriba ta,

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kʋ tuu dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ, mɩ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa dee.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ chɩchɛ dɩ mɩɩ ŋaa: Dɩ mɩ sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ kʋŋkala lɛl, ama dɩ mɩ chɩsɛ ba kala dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ mɩ Nyɩmma sɩɩ chɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ na mɩ-na ʋ Bie a laa mɩ wɩaa dii, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. Dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ ma, mɩ jaŋ chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa suomo gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ, “Mɩ-na nɛ ŋaa kʋdiile-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kʋ tuu.”

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsɛ: “Baala deeŋ dee Josɛf bie Yesu? La jɩŋ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ kala nɛ. Ɛɛ nɛ saa lɛɛlɛ ʋ sɩ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ a kʋ tuu?”

english_verse: Jesus told them: Stop grumbling!
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Má leŋ ma wɩalɩŋ gʋrʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ ma saa bɩ nagɛ arɩ nʋʋkala na mɩ Nyɩmma Wɩa nɛ, see mɩ-na Nɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ. Mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ naʋ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ŋaa kʋdiile-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, and later they died.
translation_verse: Ma naabalɩmaba dii kʋdiile-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ‘Mana’ nɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ba-na ha sʋba nɛ.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Ama kʋdiile-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kʋ tuu, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ diiba, ʋ bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na nɛ ŋaa kʋdiile-la sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kʋ tuu. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ dii kʋdiilee deemba, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. Mɩ yaraa nammɩa nɛ ŋaa kʋdiile-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa dɩ ba kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, dɩ ma nɛ bɩ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie yaraa nammɩa chaŋa, a nyʋa mɩ chalɩŋ ma, ma bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ chaŋ mɩ yaraa nammɩa, a nyʋa mɩ chalɩŋ ma, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. Dɩ dʋnɩa nɛ dɛrɛ, mɩ jaŋ chɩsɛ ʋ tɩɩna sʋʋŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ,

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ yaraa nammɩa sɛnɛ ŋaa kʋdiilee nɛ, mɩ chalɩŋ ma sɛnɛ ŋaa lɩɩ-nyʋalʋŋ.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ chaŋ mɩ yaraa nammɩa-la a nyʋa mɩ chal-la, ʋ jaŋ hɛ mɩ lɛ, dɩ mɩ ma hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: Mɩ Nyɩmma-la sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a tɩmmɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ nɛ leŋe mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩɩ-la ma sɩ chaŋ mɩ yaraa nammɩa ma jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Kʋdiile-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kʋ tuu nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ bɩ naga kʋdiile-la ma naabalɩmaba sɩ die aŋ ha sʋʋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ dii kʋdiilee deemba, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: Yesu bʋl wɩaa deemba dɩ ʋ hɛ Kapɛnam tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ a dɩdagɛ nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ

english_verse: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
translation_verse: Nɩaa yʋga a faa to Yesu harɩŋ, a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla. Ba sɩ, “Wɩaa deemba ʋ sɩɩ dagʋ, ba hɛyɛ kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo sɛɩba?”

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Ka dɩ ma nɛ saa fa na mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie dɩ mɩ mɩɩraa mʋ lee-la mɩ sɩ lɩa?

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ nɩɩ pɩla mɩɩsɩŋ. Nuhuobiine yaraa doluŋ-na ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ, ʋ bɩ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ wuo pa. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ wɩaa nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩma. Ba jaŋ pɩma mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: Ama ma dɔnsʋŋ bɩ mɩ wɩaa laa dii.” Bumbuŋ kala Yesu fa jɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii nɛ arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ joŋu yallɛ.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma arɩ nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɔ mɩ teeŋ, see dɩ mɩ Nyɩmma pɩ ʋ tɩɩna wombiiŋ.”

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɩ-daŋ-la fa sɩɩ to ʋ harɩŋ, ba mɩɩrɛ.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo fii arɩ balɩa-la, “Ma ma cho dɩ ma mɩɩrɛ mɩ harɩŋ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta bʋl, “La Tɩɩna, kʋbɛɛ teeŋ nɛ saa la ma jaŋ mʋ? Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ bʋl nɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ la laa dii a jɩŋ arɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛba, “Ma nɩaa fii arɩ balɩa dee mɩ lɩɩsɛɛ? Ama ma dɔŋɔ ŋaa dʋndɔŋ nɛ a ŋaa Sɩtaanɩ nʋʋ.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: Judas sɩ ŋaa Saamɔŋ Ɩsɩkarɔt nanʋala wɩaa nɛ ʋ faa bʋl ŋɩɩ. Ʋ fa hɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la fii arɩ balɩa tʋɔŋ nɛ, ama ʋ nɛ fa jaŋ joŋ Yesu yallɛ.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ Yesu gʋgɔllɛ Galilii tinteeŋ. Ʋ bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ gɔllɛ Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Juu tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ hɛ Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ ka chɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters,
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele-la sɩ yie,

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: Yesu ŋaanaa bʋla pʋ, “Sii daha a mʋ Judiya tinteeŋ, dɩ ŋ harɩ-tooroo ma wuo na wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chɛ dɩ nɩaa jɩmʋ, ʋ bɩ faa ŋɩŋaa wɩaa. Ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba, leŋ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala na.”

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: Ba tɩtɩa paala bɩ ʋ laa dii, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Bʋa-la sɩ jaŋ yi dɩ mɩ mʋ gbiele-la, ʋ ha bɩ yie. Ma-na teeŋ bʋa na-kala maga nɛ.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa bɩ ma bɛrɛ, ama ba bɛrɛ mɩ-na nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ vɛnɛ bʋla pɩpɩba arɩ baa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Má-na lɩɩ mʋ gbiele-la, mɩ-na ha bɩ mʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la sɩ jaŋ yi dɩ mɩ mʋ ha bɩ yie.”

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ aŋ hɔŋ Galilii tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: After Jesus' brothers had gone to the festival, he went secretly, without telling anyone.
translation_verse: Yesu ŋaana-la sɩ mʋ gbiele-la dɛrɛ, Yesu ma sii mʋ, ama ʋ bɩ leŋe nɩaa jɩŋ.

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ gbiele-la lɛ, ba bee chɩchɛ Yesu gbiele-la lɛ a pɩpɩɛsɛ, “Nɩɩ nɛ baal-la hɛ?”

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ gbiele-la leriŋ jesiŋ suomo munso bʋbʋl Yesu wɩaa. Dɔnsʋŋ sɩ, “Ʋ ŋaa nɩzɔŋ nɛ.” Dɔnsʋŋ ma bɩ sɛyɛ aŋ bʋl, “Ʋʋ nyɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ.”

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Ama ba kala faa fá Juu tɩmma-la nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ nʋʋkala bɩ wuo faasa bʋl ʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Gbiele-la sɩ kʋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, Yesu jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a dɩdagɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ dagɛ nɩaa ŋɩɩ ŋaa Juu tɩmma-la sɩ jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ wʋkpuŋkpere. Ba sɩ, “Ɛɛ nɛ baala deeŋ jɩŋ wɩaa ŋ-la kɩŋkɛŋ aŋ bɩ karɩma?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagʋ, mɩ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ dee mɩɩ dagɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ nɛ dagɛmɛ wɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ cho, ʋ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagʋ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ koo mɩ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ yie bʋbʋl wɩaa ʋ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ yie bʋla chɩchɛ ʋ tɩtɩa yɩrɩŋ nɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chɛ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmʋ laa yɩrɩŋ, ʋ ŋaa nɩtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ʋ bɩ wɩaa ka nyɩɛ.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Mosis bil wombie-la sɩ maga dɩ maa to pɩma nɛ. Ama ma kʋŋkala bɩ wɩalɩŋ ka to. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ maa chɛ dɩ ma kpʋmɛ?”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩ-daŋ-la bʋla pʋ, “Jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ kɛnɩŋ nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋŋ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ ŋaa wʋmagɩl bala nɛ ma chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, ʋ ŋaa ma wʋkpuŋkpere.

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Mosis fa bʋla pɩma dɩ ma kikeri ma biiriŋ penee. Ʋ dee bɩ ŋɩɩ suomo, ʋ naabalɩmaba nɛ fa suomo ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ma naaba wɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ma paala yie keri ma biiriŋ penee chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ nɛ, dɩ ba lʋlʋŋ nɛ tel ŋɩɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm pɩɛsɛ, “Baala deeŋ dee ba chɩchɛ dɩ ba kpʋ ŋɩɩ?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Na, ʋ nɛ chɩŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ a bʋbʋl wɩaa, ka nʋʋkala bɩ wɩɩ wuo bʋl, koo nɩhɩasɩ-la lɛɛlɛ jɩma arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa?

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ tɩŋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ ʋ sɩ lɩɩ lee-la, ama la kala nɛ jɩŋ lee-la baala deeŋ sɩ lɩa.”

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩɩ dagɛ nɩaa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ faasa pɩɛsɛ, “Ma sɛnɛ jɩmmɛ nɛ, a jɩŋ lee-la mɩ sɩ lɩaa? Mɩ bɩ mɩ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ kɔ, nʋʋ nɛ tɩmmɛ. Nɩɩ-la ma saa sɩ tɩmmɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ Tɩɩna nɛ, ma bɩ ʋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: Mɩ-na jɩmʋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ fa hɛ ʋ teeŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ tɩmmɛ.”

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba chɩchɛ dɩ ba kɛnʋ, ama nʋʋkala nɩsɩŋ bɩ ʋ dige, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ ha bɩ yie.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Ama nɩaa yʋga nɩ-daŋ-la tʋɔŋ a laa ʋ wɩaa dii aa pɩɛsɛ, “Ma bɩɩna dɩ Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nɛ kɔ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa kɩɩ baala deeŋ?” Ba tɩŋ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ kɛŋ Yesu

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Farisii tɩŋŋaa sɩ nɩa dɩ nɩ-daŋ-la munso bʋbʋl Yesu wɩaa ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩ ba mʋ kɛŋ Yesu.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pɩ nɩ-daŋ-la, “Mɩ jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ, aŋ mɩɩra mʋ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ teeŋ.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ chɛmɛ ka. Lee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ hɛ, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo mʋ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩmma-la pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ʋʋ chɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ la bɩ jaŋ wuo naʋ? Ʋʋ chɛ ʋ mʋ Giriik tinteeŋ, lee-la Juu tɩŋŋaa sɩ pɩsa hɛ nɛ, a dɩdagɛbaa?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ dɩ la jaŋ chɛʋ ka, a bɩra bʋl dɩ la bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo mʋ lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ hɛ. Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ bɛɛ?” Yesu bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ lɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Gbiele-la chɛ-dɛrɩŋ, tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ fa ŋaa gbiele-la sɩɩfɩaŋ chɛɛŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii chɩŋ a faasa bʋl, “Nɩɩ-la kala lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ sɩ kɛnɛ, má leŋ dɩ ʋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ a nyʋa lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii, ʋ jaŋ nagɛ lɩɩ-bulo ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a bubul, arɩ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Yesu bʋl wɩaa deemba a tɩgɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii lɛ nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ ʋ ha bɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la joŋo hɛ ba lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ha bɩ sʋʋŋ lɛ sie dɩ ʋ laa yɩrɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a tɩŋ Yesu wɩaa

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Yesu sɩ bʋla, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba dɔnsʋŋ bʋl, “Baala deeŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ, “Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa.” Ama dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ, “Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa bɩ jaŋ lɩɩ Galilii tinteeŋ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla arɩ Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, jaŋ ŋaa Devit doho nʋʋ nɛ a lɩɩ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm. Devit jaŋ nɛ fa Bɛtɩlɛhɛm.”

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a tɩŋ Yesu wɩaa.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Ba dɔnsʋŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ Yesu, ama nʋʋkala bɩ nɩsɩŋ joŋo digu.

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la ba sɩ tɩma dɩ ba mʋ kɛŋ Yesu mɩɩra mʋ Farisii tɩŋŋaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ teeŋ arɩ na-hɩllɩŋ. Ba pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma bɩ ʋ kaa kɔ?”

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Nʋʋkala ha bɩ wɩaa bʋla a nagɛ baala deeŋ sɩɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩmma-la pɩɛsɛba, “Ʋ nyɩsɛ ma ma nɛɛ?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Ma ha nɩa arɩ la kʋhɩasɩŋ tʋɔŋ koo la Farisii tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ kʋbala laa ʋ wɩaa dii?

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: Ama nɩ-daŋ deeŋ kala sɩ hilime, ba bɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil jɩŋ, ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ diiba.”

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Nikodemɔs, ʋ ma fa ŋaa Farisii tɩŋŋaa dɔŋɔ nɛ a hɛ ba tʋɔŋ. Ʋ-na fa laa sɩpaaŋ mʋ Yesu teeŋ nɛ aŋ ka.

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “La kɩsɩŋ nɛ dɩ la joŋ cheeriŋ a pɩ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ, see dɩ la laa sɩpaaŋ nɩɩ tɩɩna niiŋ, a jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩmma-la pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ ma ŋaa Galilii tɩɩna nɛɛ? Karɩmɛ Wɩa teniŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ karɩma, ŋ jaŋ na arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ kala ha bɩ Galilii tinteeŋ lɩa.”

english_verse: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka Yesu ma lɩɩ nɩmɛ a jɩl peel kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Olif nyuŋ.

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla, ʋ bɩra mɩɩra mʋ a jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. Nɩaa kʋ gbaarʋ, ʋ hɔŋ a suomo dɩdagɛba.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba arɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa kɛŋ haal kʋbala kʋ jʋʋ. Ba kɛŋ haal-la dɩ ʋ pɩŋ nʋʋ bala nɛ. Ba leŋ ʋ chɩŋ ba sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka ba bʋla pɩ Yesu, “La kʋhɩaŋ, la kɛŋ haala deeŋ dɩ ʋ chɛ nʋʋ bala nɛ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto daga arɩ nʋʋkala nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ la yagʋ kpʋ nɛ arɩ tabɩaa. Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ ma bʋl?”

english_verse: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
translation_verse: Ba bʋl ŋɩɩ dɩ ba ŋmoo Yesu fehe lɛ nɛ, a wuo na wombiiŋ a bʋl ʋ teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu kɛŋ ʋ nyuŋ chugili tinteeŋ aŋ kɛŋ ʋ neniiŋ tutuuri tinteeŋ.

english_verse: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
translation_verse: Ka ba ha chɩŋ a pɩpɩɛsɛ wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu kɛŋ ʋ nyuŋ wʋl wɩa-nyuŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Ma kʋ-la kala ha sɩ bɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa, má leŋ dɩ ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ joŋ tabɩɩŋ a yagɛ haal-la, dɩ kʋkaanaa pɛ.”

english_verse: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra kɛŋ ʋ nyuŋ chugili a bɩra kɛŋ ʋ neniiŋ a tutuuri tinteeŋ.

english_verse: The people left one by one, beginning with the oldest. Finally, Jesus and the woman were there alone.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla, ba kala lɩɩ kʋŋ kʋŋ. Ba tʋɔŋ nɩhɩasɩ-la nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ lɩɩ, ka kʋkaanaa tuto, aŋ ka Yesu arɩ haal-la dʋndʋŋa lee-la.

english_verse: Jesus stood up and asked her, “Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu kɛŋ ʋ nyuŋ jee a pɩɛsɛ haal-la, “Nɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ hɛ? Nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ yagɩŋ kpʋʋ?”

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: Haal-la sɩ dɩ nʋʋkala tuo. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Tɔɔ, mɩ ma bɩ jaŋ ŋaaŋ wɩɩkala. Viiri aŋ bɩra sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa.” Yesu sɩ dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa dʋnɩa nɩaa pʋlʋmʋŋ

english_verse: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra suomi a dɩdagɛ nɩaa, a bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ nɛ ŋaa dʋnɩa nɩaa pʋlʋmʋŋ, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ tomi, ʋ bɩ jaŋ vɛŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ. Ama ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ pʋlʋŋ sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩmma-la bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋaa ŋ pɛ-naara, wɩalɩŋ saa ŋ sɩ bʋla bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ mɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋaa mɩ pɛ-naara ma, wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jɩŋ lee-la mɩ sɩ lɩa nɛ, a jɩŋ lee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ mʋ. Ama ma-na bɩ lee-la mɩ sɩ lɩa jɩŋ, a bɩra bɩ lee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ mʋ ma jɩŋ.

english_verse: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.
translation_verse: Ma yie to nuhuobiine wombiiŋ nɛ a dii nɩa sarɩya a joŋ cheeriŋ pʋ. Mɩ-na bɩ nʋʋkala sarɩya ka dii.

english_verse: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ mɩ nɛ paala dii nʋʋ sarɩya ma, mɩ diiu ʋ bʋa lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ dʋndʋŋa dee, mɩ dɩ mɩ Nyɩmma-la sɩ tɩmmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Your Law requires two witnesses to prove that something is true.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto daga arɩ nɩaa balɩa nɛ ŋaa pɛ-naaraa wɩɩ lɛ, ʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa mɩ tɩtɩa pɛ-naarʋ nɛ, mɩ Nyɩmma-la ma sɩ tɩmmɛ nɛ ŋaa mɩ pɛ-naara.”

english_verse: “Where is your Father?” they asked. “You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsʋ, “Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ nyɩmma hɛ?” Yesu bʋl, “Ma bɩ mɩ jɩŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma bɩ mɩ Nyɩmma ma jɩŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ fa jɩmmɛ, ma fa jaŋ jɩŋ mɩ Nyɩmma ma.”

english_verse: Jesus said this while he was still teaching in the place where the temple treasures were stored. But no one arrested him, because his time had not yet come. You Cannot Go Where I Am Going
translation_verse: Yesu bʋl wɩaa deemba kala bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩɩ dagɛ nɩaa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ nɛ, lee-la ba sɩ yie joŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa bil. Ka nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ kɛnɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ ha bɩ yie. Yesu sɩ dɩ nɩaa bɩ jaŋ wuo mʋ lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ mʋ

english_verse: Jesus also told them, “I am going away, and you will look for me. But you cannot go where I am going, and you will die with your sins unforgiven.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Mɩ jaŋ viiri, ma jaŋ chɛ mɩ ka, ma saa jaŋ sʋʋ arɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Lee-la mɩ sɩɩ mʋ, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo mʋ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: The people asked, “Does he intend to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying we cannot go where he is going?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩmma-la pɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Ʋ sɩ, la bɩ jaŋ wuo mʋ lee-la ʋ sɩɩ mʋ. Ʋ saa bʋlaa magɩsɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ kpʋ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ koo ɛɛ nɛ ʋ bʋl ŋ-la?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't.
