translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Ma lɩɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ nɛ, ka mɩ ma lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ. Ma lɩɩ dʋnɩa nɛ, aŋ ka mɩ ma bɩ dʋnɩa lɩa.

english_verse: This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.”
translation_verse: Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ ma jaŋ sʋʋ arɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ ma nɛ bɩ laa dii arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ sɩ mɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: “Who are you?” they asked Jesus. Jesus answered, “I am exactly who I told you at the beginning.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ nɛ kʋbɛɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ nɛ Nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ sɩ mɩ ŋaa faafaa kala.

english_verse: There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.”
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ wɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl a tɩgɛ ma lɛ, a wuo to wɩalɩŋ lɛ a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩma. Nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ, ʋ sɛnɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ Tɩɩna nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ nɩa ʋ niiŋ lɛ, ba nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa.”

english_verse: No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ fa bɩ jɩŋ arɩ ʋ Nyɩmma wɩaa nɛ ʋ bʋlaa pɩba ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, you will know who I am. You will also know that I don't do anything on my own. I say only what my Father taught me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie kpaasɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ, ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ sɩ mɩ ŋaa. Ŋɩɩ ma lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ to jɩŋ arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa mɩ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ, ama mɩ yie bʋl wɩalɩŋ mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ dagɛmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la ma sɩ tɩmmɛ hɛ mɩ teeŋ nɛ, ʋ bɩ mɩ dʋndʋŋa leŋe, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ yie ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, many of the people put their faith in him. The Truth Will Set You Free
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ, nɩaa yʋga a laa ʋ wɩaa dii. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɛnɛ ŋaa Abɩraham doho nɩaa

english_verse: Jesus told the people who had faith in him, “If you keep on obeying what I have said, you truly are my disciples.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ Juu tɩmma-la sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii, “Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɛ kaa tɩtɩŋ, ma sɛnɛ ŋaa mɩ harɩ-tooroo nɛ.

english_verse: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ-la saa jaŋ laama ta dɩ ma tɩɩ ma tɩtɩa.”

english_verse: They answered, “We are Abraham's children! We have never been anyone's slaves. How can you say we will be set free?”
translation_verse: Juu tɩmma-la sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii ma bʋl, “La paala ŋaa Abɩraham doho nɩaa nɛ. La ha bɩ nʋʋkala yosi ŋaa. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ŋ bʋl dɩ Wɩa jaŋ laala ta dɩ la tɩɩ la tɩtɩa?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I tell you for certain that anyone who sins is a slave of sin!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, nʋʋ na-kala sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ʋ tɩɩna ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ yoŋ nɛ.

english_verse: And slaves don't stay in the family forever, though the Son will always remain in the family.
translation_verse: Dɩ yomo nɛ hɛ nʋʋ dɩa lɛ, ʋ bɩ dɩa-la lɛ jaŋ hɛ deeŋ deeŋ. Ama dɩ dɩa-la tɩɩna nɛ kɛŋ bii, ʋ-na jaŋ hɛ dɩa-la lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: If the Son gives you freedom, you are free!
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ-na Wɩa Bie nɛ saa laama ta, mɩ sɛnɛ laama ta nɛ dɩ ma tɩɩ ma tɩtɩa.

english_verse: I know that you are from Abraham's family. Yet you want to kill me, because my message isn't really in your hearts.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma arɩ ma ŋaa Abɩraham doho nɩaa nɛ, aŋ ka ma chɩchɛ dɩ ma kpʋmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma bɩ ma dɩgɩlaa jʋa.

english_verse: I am telling you what my Father has shown me, just as you are doing what your father has taught you. Your Father Is the Devil
translation_verse: Mɩ-na yie bʋl wɩalɩŋ mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ dagɛmɛ nɛ, ma ma ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ ma nyɩmma sɩ dagɛma dɩ ma ŋɩŋaa.”

english_verse: The people said to Jesus, “Abraham is our father!” Jesus replied, “If you were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pʋ, “Abɩraham nɛ ŋaa la nyɩmma.” Yesu ma bʋl, “Dɩ ma nɛ sɛnɛ fa ŋaa Abɩraham biiriŋ, ma fa jaŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ Abɩraham fa sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Instead, you want to kill me for telling you the truth that God gave me. Abraham never did anything like that.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ pɩma, wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ dagɛmɛ. A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa nɛ maa chɛ dɩ ma kpʋmɛ. Abɩraham fa bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: But you are doing exactly what your father does.” “Don't accuse us of having someone else as our father!” they said. “We just have one father, and he is God.”
translation_verse: Maa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ma nyɩmma sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “La bɩ mɛŋgaa-biiri ŋaa. La kala Nyɩmma ŋaa kʋbala nɛ, ʋ nɛ Wɩa.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and now I am here. He sent me. I did not come on my own.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ Wɩa nɛ sɛnɛ fa ŋaa ma Nyɩmma, ma fa jaŋ chomi, bɛɛ wɩaa, Wɩa teeŋ nɛ mɩ lɩɩ a kɔ daha. Mɩ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ dee mɩ kɔ. Ʋ nɛ tɩmmɛ.

english_verse: Why can't you understand what I am talking about? Can't you stand to hear what I am saying?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ? Ma bɩ chɛ dɩ ma jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ma bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: Your father is the devil, and you do exactly what he wants. He has always been a murderer and a liar. There is nothing truthful about him. He speaks on his own, and everything he says is a lie. Not only is he a liar himself, but he is also the father of all lies.
translation_verse: Ma nyɩmma nɛ ŋaa Sɩtaanɩ. Ma saa cho dɩ maa ŋaa ʋ tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa nɛ. Dʋnɩa dɩ-suomuŋ kala lɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa nɩkpʋʋrʋ. Ʋ tɩtɩa bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ka to. Dɩ ʋ nɛ nyɩɛ wɩaa ma, ʋ nagɩsɩŋ nɛ paala ŋɩɩ. Ʋ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ, a paala ŋaa wʋnyɩɛraa kala nyɩmma ma.

english_verse: Everything I have told you is true, and you still refuse to have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ama a tɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ wɩaa nɛ ma bɩ mɩ wɩaa laa dii.

english_verse: Can any of you accuse me of sin? If you cannot, why won't you have faith in me? After all, I am telling you the truth.
translation_verse: Ma kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo dagɛ arɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ? Dɩ mɩ nɩɩ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ, bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma bɩ mɩ wɩaa laa dii?

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to God will listen to his message. But you refuse to listen, because you don't belong to God. Jesus and Abraham
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ yie jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩɩ bʋl nɛ. Ma bɩ Wɩa teeŋ lɩa, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl jegile nɩɩ.”

english_verse: The people told Jesus, “We were right to say that you are a Samaritan and that you have a demon in you!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩmma-la bʋla pɩ Yesu, “La bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ bʋlaa, la sɩ sɩ ŋ ŋaa Samarɩa tɩɩna nɛɛ, jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ ma kɛnɩŋ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I don't have a demon in me. I honor my Father, and you refuse to honor me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Jɩŋ-bɔŋ bɩ mɩ kɛnɛ, ama mɩɩ zil mɩ Nyɩmma nɛ, aŋ ka ma-na bɩ mɩ ka zil.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you obey my words, you will never die.”
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ to mɩ niiŋ wɩaa, ʋ bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Now we are sure that you have a demon. Abraham is dead, and so are the prophets. How can you say that no one who obeys your words will ever die?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩmma-la bʋla pʋ, “Lɛɛlɛ la jɩma arɩ ŋ kɛŋ jɩŋ-bɔŋ nɛ. Abɩraham sʋba nɛ. Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa ma sʋʋ. Aŋ ka ŋ bʋl dɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ to ŋ niiŋ wɩaa bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ sʋba.

english_verse: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?”
translation_verse: La nyɩmma Abɩraham sʋba nɛ. Ŋ saa bɩɩna ŋ kɩɩʋ nɛɛ? Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa ma sʋʋ. Ŋ saa bɩɩna ŋ nɛ kʋbɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If I honored myself, it would mean nothing. My Father is the one who honors me. You claim that he is your God,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ mɩ nɩɩ pɩ mɩ tɩtɩa yɩrɩŋ, yɩrɩ-la ŋaa yɩrɩ-pɛɩ nɛ. Mɩ Nyɩmma nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɩmɛ yɩrɩŋ, nɩɩ-la ma sɩ sɩ ʋ ŋaa ma Wɩa nɛ.

english_verse: even though you don't really know him. If I said I didn't know him, I would be a liar, just like all of you. But I know him, and I do what he says.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ ʋ jɩŋ, ama mɩ-na jɩmʋ nɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ jaŋ bʋl arɩ mɩ bɩ ʋ jɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ, arɩ ma sɩ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛra ŋɩɩ. Mɩ saa jɩmʋ nɛ a tuto ʋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that even before Abraham was, I was, and I am.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, ka dɩ ba-na lʋl Abɩraham, mɩ fa hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: The people picked up stones to kill Jesus, but he hid and left the temple.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba paa tabɩaa dɩ ba yagʋ. Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa faa a lʋara lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: As Jesus walked along, he saw a man who had been blind since birth.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ joŋ wombiiŋ vɩvɛŋ, ʋ na baal kʋbala, ba lʋlʋ dɩ ʋ nyʋlɩma nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus' disciples asked, “Teacher, why was this man born blind? Was it because he or his parents sinned?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu harɩ-tooroo pɩɛsʋ, “Kʋhɩaŋ, kʋbɛɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ŋaa baala deeŋ nyʋlɩmɛ? Baal-la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ koo ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ?”

english_verse: “No, it wasn't!” Jesus answered. “But because of his blindness, you will see God work a miracle for him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Baal-la nyʋlʋmʋŋ bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ koo ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ lɩa. Ʋ nyʋlɩma dɩ nɩaa wuo na ŋɩɩ Wɩa dol-la sɩ wuo tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa ʋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: As long as it is day, we must do what the one who sent me wants me to do. When night comes, no one can work.
translation_verse: La sɩ na wombiiŋ, má leŋ dɩ la tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ tɩŋ. Bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la.

english_verse: While I am in the world, I am the light for the world.”
translation_verse: Mɩ ha sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ nɛ ŋaa dʋnɩa nɩaa pʋlʋmʋŋ.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he spit on the ground. He made some mud and smeared it on the man's eyes.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ tʋ nantʋɔrʋŋ bil tinteeŋ a kaa buu tɩarɩŋ, a paa taa baal-la sɩaa, aŋ bʋla pʋ,

english_verse: Then he said, “Go wash off the mud in Siloam Pool.” The man went and washed in Siloam, which means “One Who Is Sent.” When he had washed off the mud, he could see.
translation_verse: “Sii tuu fuo kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Sɩlʋam a sɔŋ ŋ sɩaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la sii tuu sɔŋ ʋ sɩaa fuo-la lɛ. Ʋ sɩaa suri, ʋ mɩɩra mʋ dɩa.

english_verse: The man's neighbors and the people who had seen him begging wondered if he really could be the same man.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɛ-jʋʋraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ naʋ dɩ ʋʋ sʋl kɩaa, ba pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Baala deeŋ dee fa bɩ hɔnɔ sʋsʋl kɩaa ŋɩɩ?”

english_verse: Some of them said he was the same beggar, while others said he only looked like him. But he told them, “I am that man.”
translation_verse: Dɔnsʋŋ sɩ ʋ nɛ, dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ dɩ ʋ dee, ama ʋ ta nagʋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la tɩtɩa bʋl, “Mɩ nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: “Then how can you see?” they asked.
translation_verse: Ba pɩɛsʋ, “Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ ŋaa ŋ sɩaa suri?”

english_verse: He answered, “Someone named Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. He told me to go and wash it off in Siloam Pool. When I did, I could see.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋl, “Baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Yesu nɛ buu tɩarɩŋ, a paa taa mɩ sɩaa lɛ, aŋ bʋla pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ tuu Sɩlʋam fuo-la a sɔŋ. Mɩ tuu sɔŋ, mɩ sɩaa suri.”

english_verse: “Where is he now?” they asked. “I don't know,” he answered. The Pharisees Try To Find Out What Happened
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsʋ, “Nɩɩ lɛ nɛ ʋ hɛ?” Baal-la bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ jɩŋ.” Farisii tɩŋŋaa pɩɛsɛ nyʋlʋŋ-la ʋ vaarɩŋ wɩaa

english_verse: The day when Jesus made the mud and healed the man was a Sabbath. So the people took the man to the Pharisees.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la Yesu sɩ buu tɩarɩŋ a taa baal-la sɩaa ba suri, ʋ ŋaa chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: They asked him how he was able to see, and he answered, “Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. Then after I washed it off, I could see.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩmma-la pɩɛsɛ baal-la ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ ŋaa ʋ sɩaa suri. Baal-la bʋla pɩba, “Ʋ ŋaa tɩarɩŋ nɛ taa mɩ sɩaa, mɩ sɔŋ, mɩ sɩaa suri.”

english_verse: Some of the Pharisees said, “This man Jesus doesn't come from God. If he did, he would not break the law of the Sabbath.” Others asked, “How could someone who is a sinner work such a miracle?” Since the Pharisees could not agree among themselves,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ bʋl, “Wɩa dee bɩ baala deeŋ tɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ la chɛ-wiesii-la kɩsɩŋ lɛ ka to.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ, “Ɛɛ nɛ nʋʋ sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa deemba?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kpaa balɩa.

english_verse: they asked the man, “What do you say about this one who healed your eyes?” “He is a prophet!” the man told them.
translation_verse: Farisii tɩmma-la bɩra pɩɛsɛ baal-la, “Ʋ sɩ suri ŋ sɩaa ŋɩɩ, nɩbɛɛ nɛ ŋ bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la sɩ, “Ʋ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders would not believe that the man had once been blind. They sent for his parents
translation_verse: Ama Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩ-la sɩ, ba-na bɩ laa dii arɩ baal-la fa nyʋlɩma nɛ aŋ lɛɛlɛ nɩna ŋɩɩ, see dɩ ba yɩrɛ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ.

english_verse: and asked them, “Is this the son that you said was born blind? How can he now see?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba yɩrɛ baal-la nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ a pɩɛsɛba, “Ma bie nɛ ŋ-laa? Ma sɩ, ma lʋlʋ dɩ ʋ nyʋlɩma nɛɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa a nɩna lɛɛlɛ?”

english_verse: The man's parents answered, “We are certain that he is our son, and we know that he was born blind.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ bʋl, “La jɩma arɩ la bie nɛ ŋ-la. La jɩma la lʋlʋ ma dɩ ʋ nyʋlɩma nɛ.

english_verse: But we don't know how he got his sight or who gave it to him. Ask him! He is old enough to speak for himself.”
translation_verse: Ama la bɩ jɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩaa suri, la bɩra bɩ jɩŋ nɩɩ-la ma sɩ ŋaa ʋ sɩaa suri. Má pɩɛsʋ, ʋ waa nɛ. Ʋ tɩtɩa jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩma.”

english_verse: The leaders called the man back and said, “Swear by God to tell the truth! We know that Jesus is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩmma-la bɩra yɩrɛ baal-la ba sɩ lʋla dɩ ʋ nyʋlɩma a bʋl, “La jɩma arɩ baala deeŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ nɛ. Wɩa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ pɩla.”

english_verse: The man replied, “I don't know if he is a sinner or not. All I know is that I used to be blind, but now I can see!”
translation_verse: Baal-la sɩ, “Mɩ-na bɩ jɩŋ dɩ baal-la ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ koo ʋ bɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ ŋaa. Ama wɩɩ-la mɩ-na sɩ jɩma nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ fa nyʋlɩma nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ sɩaa suro nɛ.”

english_verse: “What did he do to you?” they asked. “How did he heal your eyes?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsʋ, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋ lɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa a suri ŋ sɩaa?”

english_verse: The man answered, “I have already told you once, and you refused to listen. Why do you want me to tell you again? Do you also want to become his disciples?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩma nɛ, ka ma bɩ jegile. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma bɩra chɩchɛ dɩ ma nɩɩ? Maa chɛ dɩ ma ma ŋaa ʋ harɩ-tooroo nɛɛ?”

english_verse: The leaders insulted the man and said, “You are his follower! We are followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tʋʋsʋ woruŋ aŋ bʋl, “Ŋ nɛ ŋaa ʋ harɩ-tooro, ama la-na ŋaa Mosis harɩ-tooroo nɛ.

english_verse: We are sure God spoke to Moses, but we don't even know where Jesus comes from.”
translation_verse: La jɩma arɩ Wɩa fa bʋl wɩaa pɩ Mosis nɛ, ama baala deeŋ-na, la bɩ jɩŋ ʋ sɩ lɩɩ lee-la kala.”

english_verse: “How strange!” the man replied. “He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋl, “Wʋkpuŋkpere nɛ ŋ-la. Ma bɩ jɩŋ lee-la ʋ sɩ lɩa, ama ʋ nɛ suri mɩ sɩaa.

english_verse: We know that God listens only to people who love and obey him. God doesn't listen to sinners.
translation_verse: La jɩma arɩ Wɩa bɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa wʋbʋlʋŋ ka jegili. Ʋʋ jegili nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ zilu nɛ aŋ pɛ ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ cho.

english_verse: And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa sɩ suomo a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ, ma ha nɩa arɩ nʋʋ ba sɩ lʋla dɩ ʋ nyʋlɩma, dɩ nʋʋ suri ʋ sɩaa?

english_verse: Jesus could not do anything unless he came from God.”
translation_verse: Dɩ baala deeŋ nɛ bɩ Wɩa teeŋ lɩa, ʋ bɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wuo ŋaa.”

english_verse: The leaders told the man, “You have been a sinner since the day you were born! Do you think you can teach us anything?” Then they said, “You can never come back into any of our synagogues!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ baal-la, “Ba paala lʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ nɛ, ka ŋ ma saa chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ dagɛla koo?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kiru ta ʋ lɩɩ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa-la lɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kɛnɛ, ʋ nyʋlɩma nɛ

english_verse: When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, “Do you have faith in the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ nɩa dɩ ba kiri baal-la ta ʋ lɩɩ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ mʋ chɛ naʋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ laa Nuhuobiine Bie wɩaa dii nɛɛ?”

english_verse: He replied, “Sir, if you will tell me who he is, I will put my faith in him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la pɩɛsʋ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ? Dagɛmɛ tɩɩna dɩ mɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii.”

english_verse: “You have already seen him,” Jesus answered, “and right now he is talking with you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ paala naʋ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋ teeŋ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The man said, “Lord, I put my faith in you!” Then he worshiped Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la tuu kpirimi Yesu sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlʋ aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩ laa ŋ wɩaa dii nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “I came to judge the people of this world. I am here to give sight to the blind and to make blind everyone who can see.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Mɩ kɔ dʋnɩa dɩ mɩ ŋaa dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyʋlɩma sɩaa suri nɛ, ka dɩ mɩ ŋaa dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ na nyʋlɩmɛ.”

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard Jesus say this, they asked, “Are we blind?”
translation_verse: Farisii tɩmma-la sɩ chɩŋ nɩmɛ a nɩɩ Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ba pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ bɩɩna la ma nyʋlɩma nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty. But now that you claim to see, you will keep on being guilty.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ ma nɛ fa nyʋlɩma a bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ jɩŋ, ma fa bɩ wɩɩkala cheye. Ama lɛɛlɛ ma sɩ folo bʋl dɩ maa na nɛ a jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋ-la, ŋɩɩ-na ma cheeriŋ ha hɛ ma lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain only thieves and robbers climb over the fence instead of going in through the gate to the sheep pen.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu magɛ namaga a bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ boiŋ niiŋ to jʋʋ pie-dɩa, aŋ wule to kɛrɛ jʋʋ, ʋ tɩɩna ŋaa gaarʋ nɛ.

english_verse: But the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, and he goes in through it. The sheep know their shepherd's voice. He calls each of them by name and leads them out.
translation_verse: Pie-dɩa bibenne yie suri pie-dɩa boiŋ niiŋ nɛ a pʋ. Piese-la ma jɩŋ ʋ yikoro. Ʋ yie yɩyɩrɛba kʋbala kʋbala, a laa ba sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba lɩɩ.

english_verse: When he has led out all of his sheep, he walks in front of them, and they follow, because they know his voice.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ ʋ piesee kala lɩɩ, ʋ yie laa ba sɩpaaŋ nɛ, ka piesee tuto ʋ harɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jɩŋ ʋ yikoro nɛ.

english_verse: The sheep will not follow strangers. They don't recognize a stranger's voice, and they run away.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ nʋhʋɔrʋ harɩŋ ka to, ba jaŋ mɩɩra fá ʋ harɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ ʋ yikoro jɩŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story. But they did not understand what he was talking about. Jesus Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: Yesu magɛ namaga deeŋ pɩba, ka ba bɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩba bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain that I am the gate for the sheep.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, mɩ nɛ ŋaa pie-dɩa-la boiŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: Everyone who came before me was a thief or a robber, and the sheep did not listen to any of them.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kɔ mɩ lɛ ŋaa gaara nɛ, piese-la ma bɩ ba wʋbʋlʋŋ lɛ to.

english_verse: I am the gate. All who come in through me will be saved. Through me they will come and go and find pasture.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ŋaa boi-la, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ to mɩ lɛ jʋʋ, mɩ jaŋ laaʋ ta. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ ba lɩɩ dii yaŋ aŋ mɩɩra kʋʋ jʋʋ.

english_verse: A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully.
translation_verse: Gaara-na yie kɔ dɩ ʋ gaa nɛ, a kpʋ, a chei kɩaa, ama mɩ-na kɔ dɩ nɩaa wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, dɩ ba tʋɔŋ tʋtɔrɛ woruŋ bʋa na-kala lɛ.”

english_verse: I am the good shepherd, and the good shepherd gives up his life for his sheep.
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ nɛ ŋaa pie-daarɩ-zɔmʋŋ. Pie-daarɩ-zɔmʋŋ yie joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ yɔɔ sʋʋŋ nɛ ʋ piesee wɩaa.

english_verse: Hired workers are not like the shepherd. They don't own the sheep, and when they see a wolf coming, they run off and leave the sheep. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the flock.
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ piesee tɩɩ aŋ dɩdaa, ka ba titimu, ʋ nɛ yie na guŋguro dɩ ʋʋ kɔ, ʋ leŋ piese-la aŋ fá. Guŋguro-la kʋ kɛsɛ ba dɔnsʋŋ aŋ ŋaa dɔnsʋŋ pɩsɛ.

english_verse: Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.
translation_verse: Ʋ yie fá, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ daa piese-la, ka ba titimu nɛ. Ʋ sɩpaa kala tuo piese-la lɛ.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep, and they know me.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ŋaa pie-daarɩ-zɔmʋŋ. Mɩ jɩŋ mɩ piesee, mɩ piesee ma jɩmmɛ.

english_verse: Just as the Father knows me, I know the Father, and I give up my life for my sheep.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ Nyɩmma jɩmmɛ, mɩ ma jɩmʋ. Mɩ joŋ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ yɔɔ sʋʋŋ mɩ piesee wɩaa.

english_verse: I have other sheep that are not in this sheep pen. I must also bring them together, when they hear my voice. Then there will be one flock of sheep and one shepherd.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ piesee dɔnsʋŋ ma, aŋ ka ba tuo piesee deemba tʋɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ba ma kaa kɔ. Ba ma jaŋ jɩŋ mɩ yikoro a kala ŋaa nɩbala piesee, ba pie-daara ma ŋaa kʋbala.

english_verse: The Father loves me, because I give up my life, so I may receive it back again.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ yɔɔ sʋʋŋ mɩ piesee wɩaa, ka dɩ mɩ bɩra laa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ Nyɩmma cho mɩ wɩaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: No one takes my life from me. I give it up willingly! I have the power to give it up and the power to receive it back again, just as my Father commanded me to do.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala dee bɩ leŋe mɩ joŋ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ yɔɔ sʋʋŋ, mɩ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ. Mɩ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ mɩ joŋ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ a yɔɔ sʋʋŋ, a bɩra kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ mɩ laa mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ ma. Wɩɩ-la mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ sɩ mɩ ŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The people took sides because of what Jesus had told them.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba, Juu tɩmma-la bɩra kpaa balɩa.

english_verse: Many of them said, “He has a demon in him! He is crazy! Why listen to him?”
translation_verse: Ba jesiŋ sɩ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma jijegili ʋ wɩaa? Jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ kɛnʋ ʋ nyɩnyaasɛ.”

english_verse: But others said, “How could anyone with a demon in him say these things? No one like this could give sight to a blind person!” Jesus Is Rejected
translation_verse: Ba dɔnsʋŋ ma bʋl, “Nɩɩ-la jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ kɛnɛ bɩ wɩaa deemba wuo bʋl. Ʋ bɩra bɩ nyʋlɩmaa ma sɩaa wuo suri.” Yesu bʋla arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie

english_verse: One day he was walking in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch,
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ lɛ nɛ Yesu vɩvɛŋ zawʋra-la tʋɔŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Solomoŋ zawʋra a hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ.

english_verse: and the people gathered all around him. They said, “How long are you going to keep us guessing? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa gbaarʋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɛ ŋ kɛnla diene magɛ aŋ-na dagɛ nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa pɩla? Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, chaasa bʋla pɩla.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am.
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩma nɛ, ka ma bɩ laa dii. Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ tɩŋ mɩ Nyɩmma doluŋ lɛ dagɛ nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: But since you are not my sheep, you don't believe me.
translation_verse: Ama ma bɩ mɩ piesee ŋaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ma bɩ mɩ wɩaa laa dii.

english_verse: My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me,
translation_verse: Mɩ piesee nɩɩ mɩ yikoro nɛ, mɩ ma jɩmba, ba tuto mɩ harɩŋ.

english_verse: and I give them eternal life, so that they will never be lost. No one can snatch them out of my hand.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩba mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, ba bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba sʋba. Nʋʋ ma saa bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛmba kaa laa mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ da.

english_verse: My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands,
translation_verse: Mɩ Nyɩmma-la sɩ jomba pɩmɛ, ʋ nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛmba kaa laa mɩ Nyɩmma-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩ mɩ Nyɩmma kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ.”

english_verse: Once again the people picked up stones in order to kill Jesus.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, Juu tɩmma-la bɩra paa tabɩaa dɩ ba yagʋ.

english_verse: But he said, “I have shown you many good things my Father sent me to do. Which one are you going to stone me for?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ yʋgɛ nɛ ma sɩpaaŋ dɩ ma na. Mɩ Nyɩmma nɛ pɩmɛ doluŋ mɩɩ ŋaa. Ba kʋbɛɛ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ maa chɛ dɩ ma yagɛmɛ?”

english_verse: They answered, “We are not stoning you because of any good thing you did. We are stoning you because you did a terrible thing. You are just a man, and here you are claiming to be God!”
translation_verse: Juu tɩmma-la ma mɩɩra bʋl, “La bɩ chɛ dɩ la yagɩŋ a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa, ama ŋ ŋaa nuhuobiiŋ nɛ aŋ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa a kaa bɩrɩmɛ Wɩa, a tʋtʋʋsɛ Wɩa joŋŋoo. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: In your Scriptures doesn't God say, “You are gods”?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ba ŋmʋnsa a bʋl dɩ la nagɛ Wɩa nɛ.

english_verse: You can't argue with the Scriptures, and God spoke to those people and called them gods.
translation_verse: La jɩma wɩalɩŋ Wɩa teniŋ sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ, a kaa mʋ wuu. Wɩa bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ pa nɛ.

english_verse: So why do you accuse me of a terrible sin for saying that I am the Son of God? After all, it is the Father who prepared me for this work. He is also the one who sent me into the world.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ a tɩmmɛ mɩ kʋ tuu dʋnɩa, ɛɛ nɛ saa ma jaŋ bʋl mɩɩ tʋʋsɛ Wɩa joŋŋoo nɛ mɩ sɩ sɩ mɩ ŋaa Wɩa Bii nɛ?

english_verse: If I don't do as my Father does, you should not believe me.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ mɩ Nyɩmma tɩntɩŋŋaa ka tɩŋ, má sɩ́ mɩ wɩaa laa dii.

english_verse: But if I do what my Father does, you should believe because of that, even if you don't have faith in me. Then you will know for certain that the Father is one with me, and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ mɩ nɩɩ tɩŋ mɩ Nyɩmma tɩntɩŋŋaa, má laa mɩ wɩaa dii a tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ tɩŋ wɩaa, arɩ ma sɩ́ bɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma laa dii kala. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ wuo to jɩŋ a laa dii arɩ mɩ Nyɩmma hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ, mɩ ma hɛ ʋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Again they wanted to arrest Jesus. But he escaped
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ba bɩra chɩchɛ dɩ ba kɛnʋ, ʋ fori ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and crossed the Jordan to the place where John had earlier been baptizing. While Jesus was there,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra mɩɩra mʋ kieli Jɔdaŋ fuoŋ, a mʋ lee-la Jɔɔŋ fa sɩɩ fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ a hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: many people came to him. They were saying, “John didn't work any miracles, but everything he said about Jesus is true.”
translation_verse: Nɩaa yʋga a kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Ba sɩ dɩ Jɔɔŋ fa bɩ wʋmagɩl kala ŋaa, ama wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ fa sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ baala deeŋ lɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: A lot of those people also put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɩaa fa yʋga a laa ʋ wɩaa dii lee-la.

english_verse: The sisters sent a message to the Lord and told him that his good friend Lazarus was sick.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩhaalaa tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Yesu, “La Tɩɩna, nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ cho ka wɩɩlʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “His sickness won't end in death. It will bring glory to God and his Son.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ sɩ, “Nyanyalɩŋ deeŋ dee bɩ maga dɩ Lazarɔs wɩɩla sʋʋ, ama dɩ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ to ŋɩɩ lɛ a yɩrɛ, dɩ mɩ ma Wɩa Bie yɩrɩŋ to nɩmɛ yɩrɛ.”

english_verse: But he stayed where he was for two more days.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ sɩ nɩa dɩ Lazarɔs ka wɩɩlʋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra chʋa lee-la ʋ fa sɩ hɛ tapʋlaa balɩa.

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “Now we will go back to Judea.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “Má leŋ dɩ la mɩɩra mʋ Judiya tinteeŋ.”

english_verse: “Teacher,” they said, “the people there want to stone you to death! Why do you want to go back?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu harɩ-tooroo bʋla pʋ, “La kʋhɩaŋ, Juu tɩŋŋaa faa chɛ dɩ ba paa tabɩaa yagɩŋ lee-la nɛ, ʋ bɩ diene, aŋ ka ŋ bɩraa chɛ dɩ ŋ mʋ nɩmɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Aren't there twelve hours in each day? If you walk during the day, you will have light from the sun, and you won't stumble.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Pʋlʋmʋŋ yie hɛ nɩmɛ hawaba fii arɩ balɩa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ vɛŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ gɩgɛrɛ kɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa leriŋ pʋlla nɛ.

english_verse: But if you walk during the night, you will stumble, because you don't have any light.”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ŋ nɩɩ vɛŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ, ŋ yie gɩgɛrɛ kɩaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa pʋlʋmʋŋ tuo.”

english_verse: Then he told them, “Our friend Lazarus is asleep, and I am going there to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, “La nandɔŋɔ Lazarɔs pɩŋ doŋ nɛ, ama mɩ jaŋ mʋ chɩsʋ doŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: They replied, “Lord, if he is asleep, he will get better.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo bʋla pʋ, “La Tɩɩna, dɩ ʋ nɛ pɩŋ doŋ, ŋɩɩ-na ʋ jaŋ duori.”

english_verse: Jesus really meant that Lazarus was dead, but they thought he was talking only about sleep.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ bʋla arɩ Lazarɔs sʋba nɛ, aŋ ka ʋ harɩ-tooroo bɩɩnɛ arɩ doŋ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ pɩŋ.

english_verse: I am glad I wasn't there, because now you will have a chance to put your faith in me. Let's go to him.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ, “A tɩŋ ma wɩaa mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ arɩ bʋa-la lɛ Lazarɔs sɩ sʋba mɩ tuo lee-la. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ to a wuo laa mɩ wɩaa dii. Má leŋ dɩ la mʋ ʋ teeŋ.”

english_verse: Thomas, whose nickname was “Twin,” said to the other disciples, “Come on. Let's go, so we can die with him.” Jesus Brings Lazarus to Life
translation_verse: Yesu harɩ-tooroo tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Tɔmas. Ba kɛnʋ yɩyɩrɛ daalɩarɩŋ ma nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fa ŋaa daalɩarɩŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩmma-la, “Má leŋ dɩ la kala to Yesu harɩŋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa sʋʋ ma, dɩ la kala sʋʋ.”

english_verse: When Jesus got to Bethany, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋ yi lee-la, nɩaa bʋla pɩ Yesu arɩ ba sɩ hugi Lazarɔs, ʋ tapʋlaa banɛsɛ nɛ ŋ-la.

english_verse: Bethany was less than three kilometers from Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Bɛtanɩ arɩ Jerusalɛm fa ŋaa arɩ meel-daasɩŋ balɩa nɛ.

english_verse: and many people had come from the city to comfort Martha and Mary because their brother had died.
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa fa yʋga a lɩɩ Jerusalɛm kɔ Bɛtanɩ dɩ ba lɔllɛ Maata arɩ Mɛɛrɩ a tɩŋ ba dɩbaala sɩ sʋba wɩaa.

english_verse: When Martha heard that Jesus had arrived, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed in the house.
translation_verse: Maata sɩ nɩa arɩ Yesu ka kɔ nɛ, ʋ sii lɩɩ dɩ ʋ chemu wɛnɩŋ lɛ, aŋ ka Mɛɛrɩ-na fa hɛ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Maata bʋla pɩ Yesu, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, dɩ ŋ nɛ fa hɛ daha, mɩ dɩbaala fa bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Your brother will live again!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ dɩbaala jaŋ sii a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: Martha answered, “I know he will be raised to life on the last day, when all the dead are raised.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Maata bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ jɩma arɩ dʋnɩa chɛ-dɛrɩŋ ʋ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ sʋba sɩ jaŋ sii.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “I am the one who raises the dead to life! Everyone who has faith in me will live, even if they die.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, a chɩsɛ nɩaa sʋʋŋ lɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Nʋʋkala sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii, dɩ ŋ sʋba ma, ŋ jaŋ sii a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: “Yes, Lord!” she replied. “I believe you are the Christ, the Son of God. You are the one we hoped would come into the world.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Maata bʋl, “Oo, mɩ Tɩɩna. Mɩ laa dii arɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, Wɩa Bie, Nɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɔ dʋnɩa deeŋ.”

english_verse: After Martha said this, she went and privately said to her sister Mary, “The Teacher is here, and he wants to see you.”
translation_verse: Maata sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɛrɛ, ʋ mɩɩra jʋʋ dɩa a lʋara yɩrɛ ʋ ŋaana Mɛɛrɩ, a munso bʋla pʋ, “Mɛɛrɩ, la kʋhɩaŋ kɔ nɛ aa pɩɛsɛ ŋ wɩaa.”

english_verse: As soon as Mary heard this, she got up and went out to Jesus.
translation_verse: Mɛɛrɩ sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ sii lɩma a lɩɩ dɩ ʋ chemu.

english_verse: He was still outside the village where Martha had gone to meet him.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Yesu ha bɩ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ jʋa, ʋ ha hɛ lee-la Maata sɩ chemu nɛ.

english_verse: Many people had come to comfort Mary, and when they saw her quickly leave the house, they thought she was going out to the tomb to cry. So they followed her.
translation_verse: Juu tɩmma-la arɩ Mɛɛrɩ fa sɩ hɛ dɩa lɛ baa nyagɛ ʋ bɔyɛ, ba na Mɛɛrɩ dɩ ʋ sii lɩma. Ba sɩ na ŋɩɩ, ba sii to ʋ harɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fa bɩɩna ʋʋ chɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ ʋ dɩbaala vaamɩŋ leriŋ nɛ a yel.

english_verse: Mary went to where Jesus was. Then as soon as she saw him, she knelt at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛrɩ sɩ yi lee-la Yesu fa sɩ hɛ a naʋ, ʋ tuu tel ʋ naasɩŋ lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, dɩ ŋ nɛ fa hɛ daha, mɩ dɩbaala fa bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw that Mary and the people with her were crying, he was terribly upset
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ na Mɛɛrɩ arɩ Juu tɩmma-la sɩ to ʋ harɩŋ kɔ dɩ baa yel, ʋ tʋɔŋ faasa chei. Ʋ yaraa ma faasa vɛŋ.

english_verse: and asked, “Where have you put his body?” They replied, “Lord, come and you will see.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Nɩɩ lɛ nɛ ma hugu?” Ba bʋla pʋ, “La Tɩɩna, kʋ na lee-la.”

english_verse: Jesus started crying,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu yel.

english_verse: and the people said, “See how much he loved Lazarus.”
translation_verse: Juu tɩmma-la bʋl, “Má bee na ʋ sɩ chou ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Some of them said, “He gives sight to the blind. Why couldn't he have kept Lazarus from dying?”
translation_verse: Dɔnsʋŋ ma pɩɛsɛ, “Ka ʋ nɛ suri nyʋlɩmaa sɩaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ saa fa bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ Lazarɔs sɩ́ sʋʋ?” Yesu chɩsɛ Lazarɔs sʋʋŋ lɛ

english_verse: Jesus was still terribly upset. So he went to the tomb, which was a cave with a stone rolled against the entrance.
translation_verse: Yesu yaraa bɩra vɛŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ yi bʋa-la leriŋ. Bʋa-la fa hɛ bʋŋ lɛ nɛ. Ba joŋ tabɩɩŋ tɔ niiŋ.

english_verse: Then he told the people to roll the stone away. But Martha said, “Lord, you know that Lazarus has been dead four days, and there will be a bad smell.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Má kɛŋ tabɩɩ-la suri bʋa-la niiŋ.” Maata, baal-la sɩ sʋba dɩhaala dɔŋɔ, bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, ʋ sɩ sʋba, ʋ tapʋlaa banɛsɛ nɛ jɩnɩŋ, ŋ-la ʋʋ sʋɔrʋ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Didn't I tell you that if you had faith, you would see the glory of God?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ bɩ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ ŋ nɛ laa mɩ wɩaa dii, ŋ jaŋ na ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ?”

english_verse: After the stone had been rolled aside, Jesus looked up toward heaven and prayed, “Father, I thank you for answering my prayer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ tabɩɩ-la suri. Yesu wʋla beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ Nyɩmma, mɩɩ lɔllʋŋ arɩ ŋ sɩ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: I know that you always answer my prayers. But I said this, so the people here would believe you sent me.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma arɩ ŋŋ jegili mɩ teeŋ nɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ. Ama mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ daha wɩaa nɛ, dɩ ba wuo laa dii arɩ ŋ nɛ tɩmmɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus had finished praying, he shouted, “Lazarus, come out!”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ faasa yɩrɛ, “Lazarɔs, kʋ lɩɩ!”

english_verse: The man who had been dead came out. His hands and feet were wrapped with strips of burial cloth, and a cloth covered his face. Jesus then told the people, “Untie him and let him go.” The Plot To Kill Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Baal-la sɩ sʋba sii kʋ lɩɩ. Gɛrɩ-kɔsʋmɔɔ nɛ fa vɔɔ ʋ naasɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɩsaa kala. Gɛrɩŋ dɔŋɔ ma tɔ ʋ sɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Má kɛnʋ puro ta dɩ ʋ viiri.” Ba vʋʋra dɩ ba kpʋ Yesu Mat.

english_verse: Many of the people who had come to visit Mary saw the things Jesus did, and they put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Juu tɩmma-la fa sɩ kɔ dɩ ba chʋɔlɛ Mɛɛrɩ, a to ʋ harɩŋ mʋ a na wɩɩ-la Yesu sɩ ŋaa, ba tʋɔŋ nɩaa yʋga a laa ʋ wɩaa dii.

english_verse: Others went to the Pharisees and told what Jesus had done.
translation_verse: Ama dɔnsʋŋ ma mɩɩra mʋ bʋla pɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa wɩɩ-la Yesu sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called the council together and said, “What should we do? This man is working a lot of miracles.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩmma-la arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa bʋl, “Bɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaa? Má na wʋmagɩla-la kala baala deeŋ sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: If we don't stop him now, everyone will put their faith in him. Then the Romans will come and destroy our temple and our nation.”
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ leŋe dɩ ʋ ŋɩŋaa wɩaa deemba, nʋʋkala jaŋ laa ʋ wɩaa dii. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ Rom tinteeŋ nɩaa jaŋ kɔ a kɛŋ la Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ arɩ la tinteeŋ kala laa.”

english_verse: One of the council members was Caiaphas, who was also high priest that year. He spoke up and said, “You people don't have any sense at all!
translation_verse: Juu nɩhɩasɩ-la tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Kayafas. Jɩna-la lɛ ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Ma bɩ wɩɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: Don't you know it is better for one person to die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed?”
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jɩŋ dɩ nɩbala nɛ laa tinteeŋ nɩaa kala nyuŋ sʋʋ, ʋ nɛ kpɩa la tinteeŋ nɩaa kala sɩ sʋbaa?”

english_verse: Caiaphas did not say this on his own. As high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ naga ʋ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ama ʋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ jɩna-la, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ wuo bʋl wɩaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ, arɩ Yesu jaŋ laa tinteeŋ nɩaa kala nyuŋ sʋʋ,

english_verse: Yet Jesus would not die just for the Jewish nation. He would die to bring together all of God's scattered people.
translation_verse: tinteeŋ deeŋ nɩaa ma dʋndʋŋa wɩaa dee, ama dɩ ʋ wuo pɛ kɛsɛ Wɩa biiri-la sɩ pɩsa hɛ leree dɔnsʋŋ ma a hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: From that day on, the council started making plans to put Jesus to death.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la a kaa mʋ Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩ-la vʋʋrɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ to a kpʋ Yesu.

english_verse: Because of this plot against him, Jesus stopped going around in public. He went to the town of Ephraim, which was near the desert, and he stayed there with his disciples.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa Yesu bɩra bɩ chaasaa gɔllɛ kpɩlɩɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ. Ʋ lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Efirem a kpagɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ. Ʋ dɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: It was almost time for Passover. Many of the Jewish people who lived out in the country had come to Jerusalem to get themselves ready for the festival.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la kpaga. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa yʋgɛ a lɩɩ ba jasɩŋ lɛ a mʋ Jerusalɛm, dɩ ba pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta, aŋ ka dɩ gbiele-la-na yi.

english_verse: They looked around for Jesus. Then when they were in the temple, they asked each other, “You don't think he will come here for Passover, do you?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bee chɩchɛ Yesu gbiele-la tʋɔŋ. Ba sɩ hɔŋ Wɩa dɩa tʋɔŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Ma bɩɩna ʋ jaŋ kɔ gbiele-la koo, ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ?”

english_verse: The chief priests and the Pharisees told the people to let them know if any of them saw Jesus. This is how they hoped to arrest him.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ, dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Farisii tɩŋŋaa pa niiŋ, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ jɩŋ Yesu sɩ hɛ lee-la, dɩ ʋ dagɛ, dɩ ba wuo kɛnʋ.

english_verse: If you serve me, you must go with me. My servants will be with me wherever I am. If you serve me, my Father will honor you.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho dɩ ʋ tɩma pɩpɩmɛ, maga ʋ to mɩ harɩŋ. Lee-la kala mɩ sɩ hɛ, ʋ tɩɩna ma jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ tɩma pɩpɩmɛ, mɩ Nyɩmma jaŋ zil ʋ tɩɩna.

english_verse: Judas did not really care about the poor. He asked this because he carried the moneybag and sometimes would steal from it.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ naga dɩ ʋ cho summo-la nɛ tɩɩ, ama ʋ fa ŋaa gaarʋ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ faa kori ba moribiee a yie lɩlɩɩsɛ moribie-la a kaa ŋaa ʋ tɩtɩa wɩaa.

english_verse: they took palm branches and went out to greet him. They shouted, “Hooray! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! God bless the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala kaarɛ abɛ pɩpaarɩŋ a kaa mʋ dɩ ba chemu, a faasa ŋaa goŋ a bʋbʋl, “Tabarɩkala. Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ kɔ La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa la Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro.”

english_verse: Jesus found a donkey and rode on it, just as the Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu na kaku-bie a hɔŋ ʋ nyuŋ. Ba fa ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl,

english_verse: Mary took a very expensive bottle of perfume and poured it on Jesus' feet. She wiped them with her hair, and the sweet smell of the perfume filled the house.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mɛɛrɩ joŋ nʋʋŋ loŋ sɩɩ, ʋ sʋɔra sɩma, ʋ yalɩŋ ma hɛyɛ. Ʋ joŋo bɩsa hɛ Yesu naasɩŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ ʋ nyu-pʋnaa kaa tɩɩgɛ. Nʋʋ-la sʋɔra su dɩa-la kala.

english_verse: A lot of people came when they heard that Jesus was there. They also wanted to see Lazarus, because Jesus had raised him from death.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yʋga Juu tɩmma-la tʋɔŋ a nɩɩ dɩ Yesu hɛ Bɛtanɩ lɛ, a sii mʋ nɩmɛ. Yesu dʋndʋŋa wɩaa dee ba mʋ nɩmɛ. Ba mʋa ka dɩ ba pɛ na Lazarɔs, nɩɩ-la ʋ fa sɩ chɩsa sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: A meal had been prepared for Jesus. Martha was doing the serving, and Lazarus himself was there.
translation_verse: Ʋ jʋʋ Lazarɔs dɩa. Ba ŋaa kʋdiilee dɩ ba hʋɔrʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Lazarɔs arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ pɛ Yesu lɛ dɩ ba dii kʋdiile-la. Maata nɛ fa kɛŋ kʋdiile-la gɔllɔɔ kpaa.

english_verse: A disciple named Judas Iscariot was there. He was the one who was going to betray Jesus, and he asked,
translation_verse: Dɩ Yesu harɩ-tooroo dɔŋɔ baa yɩrɛ Judas Ɩsɩkarɔt, dɩ ʋ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, nɩɩ-la fa sɩ jaŋ joŋ Yesu yallɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl,

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Leave her alone! She has kept this perfume for the day of my burial.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má leŋ haal-la. Má leŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a gbɛrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ hugimi.

english_verse: You will always have the poor with you, but you won't always have me.” A Plot To Kill Lazarus
translation_verse: Ma dɩ summoo jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ. Ama la dɩ ma bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ.”

english_verse: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ vʋʋrɛ dɩ ba kpʋ Lazarɔs ma.

english_verse: Philip from Bethsaida in Galilee was there too. So they went to him and said, “Sir, we would like to meet Jesus.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa deemba mʋ Fɩlɩp teeŋ. Fɩlɩp fa lɩɩ Bɛtɩsaada nɛ, Galilii tinteeŋ. Ba bʋla pɩ Fɩlɩp arɩ baa chɛ dɩ ba na Yesu nɛ.

english_verse: But the Pharisees said to each other, “There is nothing we can do! Everyone in the world is following Jesus.” Some Greeks Want To Meet Jesus
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Farisii tɩmma-la bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ, “La bɩ wɩɩkala wuo ŋɩŋaa. Má bee na, dʋnɩa nɩaa kala nɩɩ to ʋ harɩŋ ŋɩɩ.” Yesu bʋl ʋ sʋʋŋ wɩaa

english_verse: So Father, bring glory to yourself. A voice from heaven then said, “I have already brought glory to myself, and I will do it again!”
translation_verse: Mɩ Nyɩmma, leŋ dɩ nɩaa yɩrɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋ yikoro lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a bʋl, “Mɩ paala laa yɩrɩŋ nɛ. Mɩ saa jaŋ bɩra leŋ dɩ nɩaa yɩrɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ.”

english_verse: “The Lord has blinded the eyes of the people, and he has made the people stubborn. He did this so that they could not see or understand, and so that they would not turn to the Lord and be healed.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, “Wɩa tɔ ba sɩaa nɛ aŋ nyɩrɛ ba tʋɔŋ, dɩ ba sɩaa sɩ́ kʋŋkala wuo na, dɩ ba sɩ́ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ ma wuo jɩŋ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ba fa jaŋ kɔ Wɩa teeŋ dɩ ʋ pʋllɛ ba tʋɔŋ, dɩ mɩ laaba ta.”

english_verse: The next day a large crowd was in Jerusalem for Passover. When they heard that Jesus was coming for the festival,
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, nɩ-daŋ-la sɩ kɔ dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la nɩɩ arɩ Yesu ka kɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ.

english_verse: “People of Jerusalem, don't be afraid! Your King is now coming, and he is riding on a donkey.”
translation_verse: “Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ́ hɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ, má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá. Ma kuoro nɩɩ kɔ ma teeŋ a jɩl kaku-pɔrʋŋ.”

english_verse: At first, Jesus' disciples did not understand. But after he had been given his glory, they remembered all this. Everything had happened exactly as the Scriptures said it would.
translation_verse: Yesu harɩ-tooroo fa bɩ wɩɩ-la bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ, ama Yesu sɩ sʋba aŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ a laa yɩrɩŋ ŋɩɩ, bʋa-la lɛ nɛ ba liisi arɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ, ba sɛnɛ ŋaa ʋ lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: A crowd had come to meet Jesus because they had seen him call Lazarus out of the tomb. They kept talking about him and this miracle.
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ ma sɩ nɩa arɩ Yesu ŋaa wʋmagɩlɩŋ deeŋ, ba kala lɩɩ dɩ ba chemu.

english_verse: Philip told Andrew. Then the two of them went to Jesus and told him. The Son of Man Must Be Lifted Up
translation_verse: Fɩlɩp ma mʋ bʋla pɩ Anduru. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba balɩa-la mʋ bʋla pɩ Yesu.

english_verse: Jesus said: The time has come for the Son of Man to be given his glory.
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Bʋa-la lɛɛlɛ kpaga nɛ dɩ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie laa yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that a grain of wheat that falls on the ground will never be more than one grain unless it dies. But if it dies, it will produce lots of wheat.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ mɩɩ-biiŋ duu, ʋ yie pʋa nɛ tinteeŋ, aŋ nyʋ, a hɛ biee yʋgɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ joŋo duu tinteeŋ dɩ ʋ pʋa, ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ biee.

english_verse: If you love your life, you will lose it. If you give it up in this world, you will be given eternal life.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ vɩa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta, ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, ʋ tɩɩna jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Now I am deeply troubled, and I don't know what to say. But I must not ask my Father to keep me from this time of suffering. In fact, I came into the world to suffer.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ bɩ dɩ-bala pɩna. Bɛɛ nɛ saa mɩ jaŋ bʋl? Mɩ saa bʋl dɩ mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ lɛ ŋaa koo? Aɩ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl ŋɩɩ. Wɩaa deemba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ lɛ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ kɔ dʋnɩa.

english_verse: When the crowd heard the voice, some of them thought it was thunder. Others thought an angel had spoken to Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ-la sɩ chɩŋ nɩmɛ a nɩɩ nɩɩ-la yikoro, dɔnsʋŋ sɩ dɩ taŋ nɛ dɔmɔ. Dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ dɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ nɛ bʋl wɩaa pʋ.

english_verse: Then Jesus told the crowd, “That voice spoke to help you, not me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Ma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ yikoro deeŋ bʋl ŋɩɩ, mɩ wɩaa dee.

english_verse: This world's people are now being judged, and the ruler of this world is already being thrown out!
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya yie nɛ. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ ma jaŋ kiri Sɩtaanɩ ta, dʋnɩa nɩaa kuoro.

english_verse: If I am lifted up above the earth, I will make everyone want to come to me.”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba nɛ kpaasɛmɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ nɩaa kala kɔ mɩ teeŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the way he would be put to death.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ bʋla dagɛ sʋʋ-la doho ʋ sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: The crowd said to Jesus, “The Scriptures teach that the Messiah will live forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ bʋl, “Ba dagɛla arɩ ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl dɩ Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ, dɩ ʋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ. Ɛɛ nɛ saa ŋ bʋl dɩ ba jaŋ kɛŋ Nuhuobiine Bie a kpaasɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa Nuhuobiine Bie deeŋ wɩaa ŋ sɩɩ bʋl?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The light will be with you for only a little longer. Walk in the light while you can. Then you won't be caught walking blindly in the dark.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Pʋlʋŋ-la sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni. Pʋlʋŋ-la ha sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ, má vɛŋ pʋlʋŋ-la lɛ, dɩ birimiŋ sí ma tɔ. Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ vɛŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ bɩ jɩŋ lee-la ʋ sɩɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Have faith in the light while it is with you, and you will be children of the light.” The People Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus After Jesus had said these things, he left and went into hiding.
translation_verse: Pʋlʋŋ-la sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ ŋɩɩ, má laa ʋ wɩaa dii. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma ma jaŋ kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ a ma chaanɛ.” Yesu sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɛrɛ, ʋ lɩɩ a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa faa dɩ ba sɩ́ ʋ na.

english_verse: He had worked a lot of miracles among the people, but they were still not willing to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ ŋaa wʋmagɩla-la kala ba na, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, ba ha bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii.

english_verse: This happened so that what the prophet Isaiah had said would come true, “Lord, who has believed our message? And who has seen your mighty strength?”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ leŋe wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Azaaya fa sɩ bʋla kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ fa bʋla, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a laa wɩalɩŋ la sɩ bʋla a dii? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ La Tɩɩna kɛŋ ʋ doluŋ dagɛ?”

english_verse: The people could not have faith in Jesus, because Isaiah had also said,
translation_verse: Ba sɛnɛ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa wuo laa dii. Ŋ-la nɛ Azaaya fa bɩra bʋl a tɩgɛ ba lɛ:

english_verse: Isaiah said this, because he saw the glory of Jesus and spoke about him.
translation_verse: Azaaya fa na ŋɩɩ Yesu fa sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Even then, many of the leaders put their faith in Jesus, but they did not tell anyone about it. The Pharisees had already given orders for the people not to have anything to do with anyone who had faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ ma kala Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩŋ yʋga a laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ama a tɩŋ Farisii tɩŋŋaa wɩaa fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛmba. Ba bɩ wuo chaasa bʋl arɩ ba laa ʋ wɩaa dii, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ba fa jaŋ kiriba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: And besides, the leaders liked praise from others more than they liked praise from God. Jesus Came To Save the World
translation_verse: Ba fa cho dɩ nɩaa nɛ bɩbɛsɛ ba lɛ a kɩɩ Wɩa sɩ bɛsɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: In a loud voice Jesus said: Everyone who has faith in me also has faith in the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu faasa bʋl, “Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii, ʋ laa nɩɩ-la ma sɩ tɩmmɛ wɩaa dii nɛ. Mɩ dʋndʋŋa wɩaa dee ʋ laa dii.

english_verse: And everyone who has seen me has seen the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ namɛ, ʋ na nɩɩ-la ma sɩ tɩmmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I am the light that has come into the world. No one who has faith in me will stay in the dark.
translation_verse: Mɩ kʋ tuu dʋnɩa dɩ mɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa pʋlʋmʋŋ nɛ a chaanɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii bɩra bɩ jaŋ hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: I am not the one who will judge those who refuse to obey my teachings. I came to save the people of this world, not to be their judge.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ nɩɩ mɩ wʋbʋlaa aŋ bɩ baa to, mɩ bɩ ʋ tɩɩna sarɩya ka dii, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya. Mɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ laa dʋnɩa nɩaa ta nɛ.

english_verse: But everyone who rejects me and my teachings will be judged on the last day by what I have said.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma nɛ jaŋ dii tɩɩna sɩ bɩ mɩ wɩaa laa dii sarɩya chɛɛ-la dʋnɩa sɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: I don't speak on my own. I say only what the Father who sent me has told me to say.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla, mɩ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ dee mɩ bʋl. Mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ tɩmmɛ, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ dagɛmɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋl, arɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋlba.

english_verse: I know that his commands will bring eternal life. This is why I tell you exactly what the Father has told me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ dagʋ jaŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ toba mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ bʋl, mɩ Nyɩmma nɛ dagɛmɛ.”

english_verse: It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa ka tapʋl-bala nɛ, ka dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la yi. Yesu jɩma arɩ bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ a mʋ ʋ Nyɩmma teeŋ yie nɛ. Ʋ cho nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ʋ harɩŋ nɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ chaasa dagɛ chono-la kɩŋkɛŋ ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo.

english_verse: Even before the evening meal started, the devil had made Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, decide to betray Jesus.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la dɩdaanɩŋ Yesu arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo hɔŋ dɩ ba dii kʋdiilee. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ dɩ Sɩtaanɩ kʋ jʋʋ Saamɔŋ bie Judas Ɩsɩkarɔt dɩ ʋ joŋ Yesu yallɛ.

english_verse: Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power.
translation_verse: Yesu fa jɩma arɩ ʋ Nyɩmma joŋ kʋŋkala doluŋ hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ jɩma ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ, a bɩra jɩŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu sii kʋdiile-la nyuŋ, a wuri ʋ gɛrɩ-balɩŋ bil, aŋ joŋ pɔpɔ vɔɔ ʋ tɩŋa,

english_verse: He put some water into a large bowl. Then he began washing his disciples' feet and drying them with the towel he was wearing.
translation_verse: a ŋaa lɩɩŋ hɛ taasɩ-gbaŋa lɛ, a suomo sʋsɔŋ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la naasɩŋ a kɛŋ pɔpɔ-la sɩ vɔɔ ʋ tɩŋa tɩtɩɩgɛ.

english_verse: But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ kʋ yi Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta pɩɛsʋ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋŋ chɛ dɩ ŋ sɔŋ mɩ naasɩŋ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Bʋa deeŋ lɛ ŋ bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa, ama ʋ harɩŋ lɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: “You will never wash my feet!” Peter replied. “If I don't wash you,” Jesus told him, “you don't really belong to me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ bɩ jaŋ sɔŋ mɩ-na naasɩŋ da.” Yesu ma bʋl, “Dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ ŋ naasɩŋ sɔmɔ, ŋ bɩra bɩ mɩ harɩ-tooru ŋaa.”

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, dɩ ŋɩɩ-na nɛ, sɩ́ mɩ naasɩŋ dʋndʋŋa sɔŋ, sɔŋ mɩ nyuŋ arɩ mɩ nɩsaa ma.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ fo lɩɩŋ, ʋ yaraa kala zɔmɔ nɛ, ʋ saa bɩra bɩ maga dɩ ʋ fo lɩɩŋ [see dɩ ʋ sɔŋ ʋ naasɩŋ dʋndʋŋa]. Ma kala saa bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ama nɩbala dʋndʋŋa nɛ kɛŋ disiniŋ ma tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Yesu paala jɩŋ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋu yallɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bʋl dɩ ba kala tʋɔŋ dee bɩ pʋlla ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said: Do you understand what I have done?
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ sɔŋ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la naasɩŋ dɛrɛ, ʋ bɩra joŋ ʋ gɛrɩŋ laalɛ a bɩra mʋ hɔŋ ʋ dɩhɔnʋŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ pɩɛsɛba, “Ma jɩŋ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa ma lɛ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛɛ?

english_verse: You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am.
translation_verse: Ma kɛmmɛ kaa yɩrɛ ma Kʋhɩaŋ arɩ ma Tɩɩna. Ʋ saa kɛŋ wombiiŋ nɛ dɩ ma yɩrɛmɛ ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ sɛnɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you.
translation_verse: Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa ma na nɛ, dɩ ma ma ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, tɩntɩnnʋ kala bɩ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ kɩɩ, nɩɩ-la ma ba sɩ tɩma, ʋ ma bɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmʋ kɩɩ.

english_verse: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!”
translation_verse: Ma kala dee mɩ bʋl arɩ ma jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Mɩ jɩŋ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa nɛ. Wɩɩ-la ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ sɛnɛ jaŋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ba bʋla arɩ la dɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ dii kʋdiilee nɛ jaŋ mɩɩra sii chɩŋ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma nɛ, ka dɩ ʋ-na ŋaa, dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ sɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa, ma jaŋ laa mɩ wɩaa dii arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ sɩ mɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ harɩ-tooru-la fa sɩ kpagɛ Yesu wasa sʋʋsa mʋ yi Yesu a pɩɛsʋ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, kʋbɛɛ nɛ?”

english_verse: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɛrɛ, ʋ tʋɔŋ bɩ dɩ-bala pɩna. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ chaasa bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, ma dɔŋɔ nɛ jaŋ jommi yallɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal,
translation_verse: Yesu harɩ-tooro-la tʋɔŋ nɩɩ-la ʋ fa sɩ cho nɛ fa hɔnɔ kpagʋ.

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta lɔgɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ pɩɛsɛ Yesu-na dɩ kʋbɛɛ nɛ ʋ dɩdagɛ?

english_verse: No one at the meal understood what Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ kala fa sɩɩ dii kʋdiile-la, ba bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala ʋ fa sɩ bʋla bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.
translation_verse: Judas fa sɩɩ kori ba moribiee ŋɩɩ, Yesu harɩ-tooro-la dɔnsʋŋ fa bɩɩna arɩ Yesu faa chɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ yɔɔ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba dii nɛ gbiele-la lɛ, koo dɩ ʋ joŋ kʋŋ nɛ a pɩ summoo.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Judas sɩ laa boroboro-la dɛrɛ, ʋ guu sii a lɩɩ lɩma lɩma. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ tɩtaŋ nɛ. Yesu bil nii-falɩɩ nɛ a pɩ nɩaa

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ Wɩa doluŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa ma jaŋ dagɛ mɩ-na Nuhuobiine Bie doluŋ sɩ maga. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ lɩma.

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Mɩ biiriŋ, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ dieni. Ma jaŋ bee chɛmɛ, ama mɩ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ a pɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa, mɩ jaŋ bʋl ŋɩɩ a pɩ ma ma. Lee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ mʋ, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo mʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta pɩɛsɛ Yesu, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, nɩɩ nɛ ŋ mʋmʋ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu ma bʋla pʋ, “Lee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ mʋ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo to mʋ, ama ʋ harɩŋ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo to.”

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ sɛnɛ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ŋ joŋ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ yɔɔ sʋʋŋ nɛ mɩ wɩaa? Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩŋ, ka dɩ ji-bele-na yel, ŋ jaŋ bʋl naansɩɩŋ butori arɩ ŋ bɩ mɩ jɩŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tʋɔŋ vʋgʋmɛ. Má laa Wɩa dii, a laa mɩ ma dii.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: Mɩ Nyɩmma jaŋ lɛ dɩɩsɩŋ yʋga a hɛ nɩmɛ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ fa dee, mɩ bɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ mɩ jaŋ mʋ wasɛ leriŋ a bil ma lɛ.

english_verse: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ mʋa a wasɛ lee-la bil ma lɛ dɛrɛ, mɩ jaŋ bɩra kɔ a kɛmma kaa mʋ mɩ teeŋ, dɩ la kala hɛ dɩ-bala.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”
translation_verse: Ma jɩŋ lee-la mɩ sɩɩ mʋ wombiiŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Tɔmas bʋla pʋ, “La Tɩɩna, la bɩ jɩŋ lee-la ŋ sɩɩ mʋ, ɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ wuo ŋaa jɩŋ ʋ wombiiŋ?”

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ nɛ ŋaa wombiiŋ a mʋmʋ Wɩa-jaŋ. Mɩ nɛ bɩra wʋtɩtɩɩ Tɩɩna ma, a bɩraa pɩ nɩaa ma mɩɩsɩŋ. Nʋʋkala bɩ mɩ Nyɩmma teeŋ wuo mʋ, see dɩ ʋ to mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ jɩmmɛ, ma jɩŋ mɩ Nyɩmma ma nɛ. A lɩɩ jɩnɩŋ saa ma paala jɩmʋ nɛ a naʋ ma.”

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɩlɩp bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, dagɛla la Nyɩmma, wɩɩ-la kala la sɩɩ chɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsʋ, “Fɩlɩp, mɩ dɩ ma hɛ nɩmɛ a dieni ŋɩɩ, ka ŋ ha bɩ mɩ jɩŋŋ? Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ namɛ, ʋ na mɩ Nyɩmma ma nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ŋ bʋl dɩ mɩ dagɛma mɩ Nyɩmma?

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ laa dii arɩ mɩ hɛ mɩ Nyɩmma lɛ nɛ, mɩ Nyɩmma ma hɛ mɩ lɛɛ? Wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ yie bʋlaa pɩma, mɩ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ dee mɩɩ bʋl. Wɩalɩŋ ma mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa, mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ hɛ mɩ lɛ nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Má laa dii arɩ mɩ hɛ mɩ Nyɩmma lɛ nɛ, mɩ Nyɩmma ma hɛ mɩ lɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ŋɩɩ wuo laa dii, má laa dii a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii, ʋ jaŋ wuo ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa. Ʋ jaŋ paala wuo ŋaa kɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ mɩ Nyɩmma teeŋ.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Kʋŋ na-kala ma sɩ pɩɛsa chɩchɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma. Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ nɩaa wuo to mɩ lɛ a leŋ dɩ mɩ Nyɩmma yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ kʋŋkala mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa pɩma.” Yesu bʋla arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a hɛ nɩaa lɛ

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Dɩ ma nɛ chomi, ma jaŋ tuto mɩ niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ sʋl mɩ Nyɩmma dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ pɩma, dɩ ʋ pɩpɛ ma lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ dɩdagɛma wʋtɩtɩɩ. Dʋnɩa nɩaa bɩ ʋ jɩŋ. Ba bɩ jaŋ wuo naʋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo hɛ ba lɛ. Ama ma-na jɩmʋ nɛ. Ʋ hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ. Ʋ saa jaŋ hɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ ma dʋndʋŋa ta, mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: Ʋ ka mʋa dʋnɩa nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ namɛ, ama ma-na jaŋ namɛ. Mɩ sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ma ma jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ma lɛ nɛ, ma jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ hɛ mɩ Nyɩmma lɛ nɛ, ma ma hɛ mɩ lɛ, mɩ ma hɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ nɩɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa aa toba, ʋ tɩɩna nɛ chomi. Mɩ Nyɩmma ma saa jaŋ cho nɩɩ-la sɩ chomi. Mɩ ma jaŋ cho tɩɩna a kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa kaa dagʋ.”

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Judas bʋl , “Mɩ Tɩɩna, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa a kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa dagɛla, aŋ bɩ ŋ tɩtɩa kaa dagɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ chomi, ʋ jaŋ tuto mɩ niiŋ wɩaa. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ Nyɩmma ma jaŋ chou. Mɩ dɩ mɩ Nyɩmma kala jaŋ kʋ hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ mɩ cho, ʋ bɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa ka to. Wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ nɩa, mɩ tɩtɩa dee bɩ bʋl. Ama mɩ Nyɩmma-la sɩ tɩmmɛ nɛ dagɛmɛ mɩɩ bʋl.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: Mɩ ha hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩpɩma.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ Nyɩmma jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ tuu a hɛ ma lɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a wuo dagɛma wɩɩkala, a leŋ dɩ ma liisi wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ. Mɩ tɩtɩa fɩɛlɩŋ nɛ mɩ joŋoo pɩma, ʋ bɩ naga fɩɛl-la dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ pa nɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa vʋgʋmɛ, a bɩra sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ ma kɛmma.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Ma nɩa arɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma arɩ mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra viiri aŋ bɩra mɩɩra kɔ ma teeŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ chomi, ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ arɩ mɩ sɩɩ mʋ mɩ Nyɩmma teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩmɛ.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩpɩma nɛ, ka dɩ ba-na ŋaa. Dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa, ma jaŋ laamɛ dii.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩaa ma teeŋ a dieni, bɛɛ wɩaa dʋnɩa kuoro ka kɔ nɛ. Ama ʋ bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: Ama mɩɩ chɛ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ mɩ cho mɩ Nyɩmma nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ sɩ dɩ mɩ ŋaa. Má kɔ dɩ la mʋ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Mɩ nɛ ŋaa tɩɩ-tɩtɩɩ-la. Mɩ Nyɩmma ma nagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ tɩa-la nɛ.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Naakel-la kala sɩ mɛrɛ tɩa-la lɛ aŋ bɩ nɛŋ, ʋ yie kere ta nɛ, naakel-la kala sɩɩ nɛŋ, ʋ yie buoro ta nɛ, ka dɩ ʋ wuo faasa nɛŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: Ma paala bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Má mɛrɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ mɩ ma mɛrɛ ma lɛ. Tɩa naakelee dʋndʋŋa bɩ jaŋ wuo nɛŋ, see dɩ ba mɛrɛ tɩa gentine lɛ. Ma ma bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩkala, see dɩ ma mɛrɛ mɩ lɛ.”

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ nagɛ tɩa nɛ, ma ma nagɛ tɩa-la naakelee. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ mɛrɛ mɩ lɛ, mɩ ma mɛrɛ tɩɩna lɛ, ʋ nɛ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ yʋgɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa dɩ ma nɛ bɩ mɩ lɛ mɛrɛ, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩkala.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ mɩ lɛ mɛrɛ, ba jaŋ joŋ tɩɩna yuo ta, a nagɛ ba sɩ yie keri tɩa naakelee ta ŋɩɩ ba hɩl, nɩaa paa a hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ ba dii.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ mɛrɛ mɩ lɛ, dɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, kʋŋkala ma sɩ pɩɛsɛmɛ a chɩchɛ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa pɩma.

english_verse: When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ yʋgɛ, mɩ Nyɩmma yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ wuo dagɛ arɩ ma ŋaa mɩ harɩ-tooroo nɛ.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: Mɩ choma arɩ mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ chomi ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má mɛrɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ mɩ choma a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ to mɩ niiŋ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ choma, arɩ mɩ sɩɩ to mɩ Nyɩmma niiŋ wɩaa a mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ ʋ chomi ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩma dɩ ma kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋ-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩma nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ faasa tɔrɛ woruŋ a mʋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma dɩ maa ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: Má cho dɔŋɔ arɩ mɩ sɩ choma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma dɩ maa ŋaa, ma jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nandɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛmma kaa yɩrɛ mɩ tɩntɩnnaa, bɛɛ wɩaa tɩntɩnna bɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ kʋhɩaŋ sɩɩ ŋaa jɩŋ. Ama mɩ-na bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ pɩma nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ kɛmma yɩyɩrɛ mɩ nandɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Ma dee bɩ mɩ lɩɩsa, mɩ nɛ lɩɩsɛma. Mɩ nɛ lɩɩsɛma dɩ ma mʋ faasa ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ bɩ jaŋ lɛl. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ Nyɩmma jaŋ pɩma kʋŋkala ma sɩ pɩɛsa chɩchɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: Dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa nɛ bɛrɛma, ma jɩŋ arɩ ba laa sɩpaaŋ bɛrɛmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ fa ŋaa dʋnɩa nɩaa, dʋnɩa nɩaa fa jaŋ choma woruŋ, arɩ ba sɩ cho dɔŋɔ ŋɩɩ. Ama ma dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa bɩ kʋbala ŋaa. Mɩ lɩɩsɛma dʋnɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba bɛrɛma.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ tɩntɩnnʋ bɩ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ kɩɩ. Má liisi wɩɩŋ deeŋ. Ba sɩ dɔgɩsɛmɛ ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ ma ma ŋɩɩ. Dɩ ba nɛ fa sɛɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa, ba fa jaŋ sɛɩ ma ma niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ to mɩ harɩŋ wɩaa. Ba sɩ bɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ jɩŋ nɛ tɩɩ baa ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa bɩ kʋ bʋl wɩaa pɩba, ba sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la kala, mɩ fa bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl dɩ ba chei wɩɩkala. Ama mɩ sɩ folo kʋ bʋl wɩaa pɩba, ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ ba bɩ wɩɩkala cheye.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɛrɛmɛ, tɩɩna bɛrɛ mɩ Nyɩmma ma nɛ.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa, nʋʋkala bɩ ba ŋaa. Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa bɩ ba ŋaa dɩ ba na, ba fa bɩ jaŋ chei wɩɩkala. Ama ba na ba kala nɛ aŋ ha bɛrɛ mɩ dɩ mɩ Nyɩmma kala.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Ama wɩaa deemba kala ŋaa dɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ŋ-la nɛ ba ŋmʋnsɛ, ‘Mɩ bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa chei, ka ba bɛrɛmɛ.’

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ lɩɩ mɩ Nyɩmma teeŋ a kʋ tuu hɛ ma lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a dagɛma wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ bʋl mɩ wɩaa pɩma.

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: Ma ma jaŋ bʋl mɩ wɩaa pɩ nɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ sɩ suomo dɩdagɛ nɩaa, mɩ dɩ ma kala nɩɩ to dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba kala pɩpɩma dɩ ma sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii joŋo ta.

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ kirima ta Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Bʋa dɔŋ jaŋ yi dɩ nɩaa kpʋma aŋ bɩɩnɛ baa to Wɩa wombiiŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala a tɩŋ ba sɩ́ bɩ mɩ Nyɩmma jɩŋ, a bɩ mɩ ma jɩŋ.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba kala pɩpɩma dɩ bʋa-la nɛ kʋ yi dɩ wɩaa deemba ŋɩŋaa, ma jaŋ liisi arɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa Mɩ dɩ ma kala fa sɩɩ to dɔŋɔ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɩ wɩaa deemba bʋla pɩma.

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩɩ mʋ Nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ teeŋ nɛ, aŋ ka ma kʋŋkala bɩ mɩ pɩɛsa arɩ nɩɩ nɛ mɩɩ mʋ.

english_verse: You are very sad from hearing all of this.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩma lɛɛlɛ ŋ-la, ma tʋɔŋ chaasa chei nɛ.

english_verse: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
translation_verse: Ama wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma ŋ-la: Mɩ sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ zɔmɔ pɩma. Dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ mʋa, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ jaŋ kɔ a pɛ ma lɛ bɩ jaŋ kɔ. Ama dɩ mɩ nɛ mʋa, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ kɔ.

english_verse: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ saa kɔ, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ bɩra dagɛba ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ to a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, a bɩra dagɛba arɩ Wɩa jaŋ dii ba sarɩya.

english_verse: The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ba sɩ bɩ mɩ wɩaa laa dii, ʋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ mɩɩraa mʋ mɩ Nyɩmma teeŋ ŋɩɩ, ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ namɛ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ ma jaŋ dagɛ arɩ mɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla nɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ folo dii dʋnɩa kuoro Sɩtaanɩ sarɩya ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa jaŋ dii ba ma sarɩya.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: Wɩaa yʋga nɛ mɩ ha kɛŋ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma, ama ma bɩ ba wuo nyalɩmɛ.
