english_verse: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la nɛ kɔ, ʋ jaŋ dagɛma wʋtɩtɩɩ kala. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ bʋbʋl wɩaa ʋ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ, ama wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ nɩa mɩ Nyɩmma niiŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ bʋl. Ʋ jaŋ dagɛma wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa yɩrɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ mɩ bʋl, ʋ jaŋ kaa kʋ bʋla pɩma.

english_verse: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
translation_verse: Kʋŋkala mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ kɛnɛ ŋaa mɩ kʋŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la jaŋ kaa kʋ bʋla pɩma.” Yesu bʋla pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo arɩ ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ namɛ. Tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ harɩŋ ma jaŋ bɩra namɛ.”

english_verse: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo dɔnsʋŋ pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ bɛɛ? Ʋ bʋla pɩla arɩ tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ la bɩ jaŋ naʋ, dɩ tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ harɩŋ la bɩra jaŋ naʋ. Ʋ bɩra bʋla arɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ mʋ ʋ Nyɩmma teeŋ nɛ tɩɩ la bɩra bɩ jaŋ naʋ.

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ sɩ tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ deeŋ, ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ bɛɛ? La bɩ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Yesu jɩma arɩ baa chɛ dɩ ba pɩɛsʋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ sɩ sɩ tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ ma bɩ jaŋ namɛ, tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ harɩŋ ma jaŋ bɩra namɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ ma pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔɔ?

english_verse: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, ma jaŋ ŋmuŋmoo niiŋ ka dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ chei, ama ma tʋɔ-chei-la jaŋ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
translation_verse: Dɩ haala luoruŋ nɩɩ wɩɩ dɩ ʋ chɩchɛ ʋ lʋl, ʋ yie tʋʋnɛ niiŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ hɛɛŋ bʋa yie nɛ. Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ kʋ lʋl bile dɛrɛ, ʋ yʋ ʋ hɛɛ-la kala lɛ, ka ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ lʋl bii-falɩŋ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ saa ʋ jaŋ nagɛ ma ma lɛ. Lɛɛlɛ ma tʋɔŋ cheye nɛ, ama mɩ jaŋ bɩra nama dɩ ma tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ ma tʋɔŋ bɩra chei.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, ma bɩ jaŋ pɩɛsɛmɛ chɩchɛ kʋŋkala. Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, mɩ Nyɩmma jaŋ pɩma kʋŋkala ma sɩ pɩɛsʋ chɩchɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ ŋ-la, ma ha bɩ kʋŋkala pɩɛsa chɩchɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má saa pɩɛsʋ, ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, dɩ ma tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ a mʋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩɩ bʋl, namagaba nɛ mɩɩ magɛ. Ama bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ magɛ namagaba, mɩ jaŋ chaasa bʋl wɩaa pɩma a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ Nyɩmma lɛ, dɩ ma jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
translation_verse: Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, ma nɛ jaŋ pɩɛsʋ chɩchɛ kɩaa mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ bɩ sɩ mɩ nɛ jaŋ sʋla pɩma,

english_verse: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ Nyɩmma tɩtɩa ma choma nɛ. Ma chomi nɛ a laa mɩ wɩaa dii arɩ mɩ lɩɩ ʋ teeŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ ma choma.

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: Mɩ lɩɩ mɩ Nyɩmma teeŋ nɛ a kʋ tuu dʋnɩa. Lɛɛlɛ mɩ saa jaŋ leŋ dʋnɩa aŋ mɩɩra mʋ mɩ Nyɩmma teeŋ.”

english_verse: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ harɩ-tooro-la bʋla pʋ, “Lɛɛlɛ ŋ chaasaa bʋl wɩaa nɛ. Ŋ bɩra bɩ namagaba ka magɛ.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ la jɩma dɩ ŋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-wɩɩkala nɛ, ŋ bɩ chɛ dɩ nʋʋkala pɩɛsɩŋ wɩɩkala. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ leŋe la jɩŋ arɩ ŋ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛba, “Lɛɛlɛ saa ma laa mɩ wɩaa dii nɛɛ?

english_verse: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi, ʋ saa paala yi nɛ, ma kala jaŋ pɩsɛ a mʋ ma dɩɩsɩŋ, aŋ ka mɩ dʋndʋŋa. Ama saa, mɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ dʋndʋŋ. Mɩ Nyɩmma hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩma dɩ ma wuo hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ nɛ. Dʋnɩa deeŋ tʋɔŋ ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Ama má leŋ dɩ ma nyuŋ nyaasɛ. Mɩ yuo dii dʋnɩa nɛ.”

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɛrɛ, ʋ wʋla beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ aŋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a bʋl, “Mɩ Nyɩmma, bʋa-la yie nɛ. Leŋ dɩ mɩ-na ŋ Bie laa yɩrɩŋ, dɩ mɩ ma leŋ dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ joŋ doluŋ pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ bibeŋ nuhuobiinee kala, a joŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩma arɩ ŋ nɛ sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩɩ-tɩtɩɩ, Wɩa dɔŋ bɩra tuo, aŋ pɛ jɩŋ mɩ-na Yesu Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la ma ŋ sɩ tɩma, ba nɛ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
translation_verse: Mɩ leŋe ŋ laa yɩrɩŋ nɛ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ. Mɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la dɛrɛ nɛ, tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ tɩŋ.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Oo, mɩ Nyɩmma, leŋ dɩ mɩ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ ŋ sɩpaaŋ lɛɛlɛ, yɩrɩ-la mɩ dɩŋ kala fa sɩ kɛnɛ, aŋ-na ŋaa dʋnɩa. Yesu sʋl Wɩa pɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo

english_verse: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
translation_verse: Mɩ leŋe nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa pɩmɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ jɩmɩŋ nɛ. Ba fa ŋaa ŋ kɩaa nɛ, ŋ nɛ lɩɩsɛba pɩmɛ. Ba sɛɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ ba jɩma kʋŋ na-kala mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ lɩɩ ŋ teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl ŋ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ pɩba nɛ, ba laa dii. Ba jɩma arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, mɩ sɛnɛ lɩɩ ŋ teeŋ nɛ. Ba laa dii nɛ arɩ ŋ nɛ tɩmmɛ.

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: Mɩ sʋlʋŋ pɩpɩba nɛ. Mɩ bɩŋ sʋla pɩpɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa, see nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa pɩmɛ dʋndʋŋa. Ba nɛ ŋaa ŋ kɩaa.

english_verse: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ ŋaa ŋ nɩaa nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kala ŋ ma sɩ kɛnɛ ŋaa mɩ ma nɩaa nɛ. Ba nɛ leŋe mɩ laa yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ nɛ, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, ama ba-na jaŋ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Mɩ Nyɩmma, ŋ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Beŋ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa pɩmɛ nyuŋ woruŋ ŋ doluŋ lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ba ŋaa kʋbala, arɩ mɩ dɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ hɛ ba teeŋ, mɩ beŋ ba nyuŋ nɛ woruŋ ŋ doluŋ lɛ, dol-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ nɛ mɩ kaa bemba. Mɩ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba kʋbala ma bɩ lɛlɛ, see nɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ lɛl, dɩ wɩalɩŋ ba fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa.

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ saa mɩɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ nɛ. Mɩ ha sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩba dɩ ba tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ, arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɔ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl ŋ niiŋ wɩaa pɩba nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa bɛrɛba, bɛɛ wɩaa ba dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa bɩ kʋbala ŋaa, arɩ mɩ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩ bɩ kʋbala ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩŋ sʋla chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ lɩɩsɛba dʋnɩa lɛ, ama mɩ sɩ dɩ ŋ pɔba nɛ a lɩɩsɛba Sɩtaanɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
translation_verse: Ba dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa bɩ kʋbala ŋaa, a nagɛ mɩ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩ bɩ kʋbala ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.
translation_verse: Ŋ niiŋ wɩaa ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Dagɛba, dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ.

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ tɩmmɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa teeŋ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ ma tɩmba dʋnɩa nɩaa teeŋ.

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: Mɩ joŋ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ a yɔɔ sʋʋŋ ba wɩaa. Mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ba ma kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba joŋ ba mɩɩsɩŋ yɔɔ sʋʋŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩŋ sʋla pɩpɩ ba dʋndʋŋ, mɩ pɛ sʋlaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ nɩɩ ba niiŋ wɩaa a laa dii nɛ.

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: Mɩ Nyɩmma, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ dɩ ba kala wuo ŋaa kʋbala, a nagɛ ŋ sɩ hɛ mɩ lɛ mɩ ma hɛ ŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dʋnɩa nɩaa jaŋ wuo laa dii arɩ ŋ nɛ tɩmmɛ.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ leŋe mɩ laa yɩrɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ ma leŋ ba laa yɩrɩŋ. Mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ba kala wuo ŋaa kʋbala nɛ, arɩ mɩ dɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ ba lɛ nɛ, ŋ ma hɛ mɩ lɛ. Leŋ dɩ ba ma ŋaa kʋbala, ŋɩɩ nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ŋ nɛ tɩmmɛ, a choba arɩ ŋ sɩ chomi ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: Mɩ Nyɩmma, ŋ paala chomi nɛ a leŋ mɩ laa yɩrɩŋ, ka dʋnɩa-na suomi. Mɩ saa chɛ dɩ ŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa pɩmɛ, dɩ ba hɛ mɩ teeŋ lee na-kala mɩ sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɛ, dɩ ba wuo na ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ leŋe mɩ laa yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: Mɩ Nyɩmma, ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ. Dʋnɩa nɩaa bɩŋ jɩŋ, ama mɩ-na jɩmɩŋ nɛ. Nɩaa deemba ma jɩŋ arɩ ŋ nɛ tɩmmɛ.

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: Mɩ saa ŋaa ba jɩmɩŋ nɛ, mɩ ha jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba jɩmɩŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ chomi, dɩ ba ma cho dɔŋɔ, dɩ mɩ hɛ ba lɛ.”

english_verse: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ dɩa tɩntɩnnaa dɔŋɔ pɛ ʋ lɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa nɩɩ-la Pɩɩta sɩ ta dɩgɩlɩŋ keri naambii nɛ. Ʋ pɩɛsʋ, “Mɩ fa bɩ ŋ dɩ baal-la na lee-la ba sɩ chɔnsɛ olif tɩɩsɩŋ?”

english_verse: Jesus again asked, “Who are you looking for?” “We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth,” they answered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ maa chɛ?” Ba sɩ, “Yesu sɩ lɩɩ Nazarɛt.”

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋ-la. Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛmɛ, má leŋ mɩ harɩ-tooroo deemba-na viiri.”

english_verse: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
translation_verse: Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta fa kori tokobiiŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ tʋʋrɛ a ta Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ dɩa tɩntɩnna nadiiŋ dɩgɩlɩŋ a keri. Tɩntɩnnʋ-la yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Malɩkʋs.

english_verse: The Roman officer and his men, together with the temple police, arrested Jesus and tied him up.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoroo arɩ ba kʋhɩaŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ kɛŋ Yesu a vɔbʋ.

english_verse: Peter stayed outside near the gate. But the other disciple came back out and spoke to the girl at the gate. She let Peter go in,
translation_verse: ka Pɩɩta chɩŋ jeeŋ harɩŋ boiŋ niiŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la dɔŋɔ, nɩɩ-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ sɩ jɩma, ʋ mɩɩra lɩɩ, a bʋla pɩ toli-bie kʋbala sɩ pɔ boi-la niiŋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ Pɩɩta kʋ jʋʋ.

english_verse: but asked him, “Aren't you one of that man's followers?” “No, I am not!” Peter answered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tolo-la sɩ chɩŋ boi-la niiŋ pɩɛsɛ Pɩɩta, “Mɩ bɩɩna ŋ ma ŋaa baal-la harɩ-tooroo dɔŋɔ nɛɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta sɩ, “Aɩ, mɩ bɩ ʋ harɩ-tooru ŋaa.”

english_verse: It was cold, and the servants and temple police had made a charcoal fire. They were warming themselves around it, when Peter went over and stood near the fire to warm himself. Jesus Is Questioned by the High Priest (Matthew
translation_verse: Dɩ waarɩŋ fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩa-la tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ tɩntɩnnɩbiisiŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la hɛ nyiniŋ a chɩna golli aa wieni. Pɩɩta ma mʋ chɩŋ ba teeŋ aa wieni nyiŋ-la. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ pɩɛsɛ Yesu wɩaa Mat.

english_verse: The high priest questioned Jesus about his followers and his teaching.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ pɩɛsɛ Yesu wɩaa a tɩgɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo lɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ fa sɩɩ dagʋ.

english_verse: Why are you questioning me? Why don't you ask the people who heard me? They know what I have said.”
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ŋ pɩɛsɛmɛ? Pɩɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla. Ba jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus was still tied up, and Annas sent him to Caiaphas the high priest. Peter Again Denies that He Knows Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Anas leŋ ba kɛnʋ mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ Kayafas teeŋ, dɩ ba ha vɔbʋ. Pɩɩta bɩra bʋla arɩ ʋ bɩ Yesu jɩŋ Mat.

english_verse: ) Pilate went back out and said, “I don't find this man guilty of anything!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt mɩɩra lɩɩ dɩ-jalɩŋ Juu tɩmma-la teeŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ bɩ wɩɩ-la baala deeŋ sɩ cheye na.

english_verse: It was early in the morning when Jesus was taken from Caiaphas to the building where the Roman governor stayed. But the crowd waited outside. Any of them who had gone inside would have become unclean and would not be allowed to eat the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla ba kɛŋ Yesu lɩɩ Kayafas dɩa lɛ, a kɛnʋ kaa mʋ baal kʋbala dɩa baa yɩrɛ Paalɩt. Paalɩt nɛ fa hɔŋ Rom kuoru-balɩŋ nyuŋ lee-la. Juu tɩŋŋaa bɩ to jʋʋ. Ba bɩ chɛ dɩ ba ŋaa disiniŋ a chei ba kɩsɩŋ lɛ, aŋ wuo dii dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la kʋdiilee.

english_verse: Pilate came out and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt kʋ lɩɩ ba teeŋ a pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ ma sɩ baala deeŋ ŋaa chei?”

english_verse: They answered, “He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ ʋ nɛ fa bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa chei, la fa bɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ kaa kɔ ŋ teeŋ.”

english_verse: And so what Jesus said about his death would soon come true.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa, dɩ ŋɩɩ Yesu fa sɩ daga arɩ ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ, sɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Paalɩt mɩɩra jʋʋ dɩa aŋ yɩrɛ Yesu a pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ nɛ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa kuoroo?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ koo nʋʋ nɛ bʋl ŋɩɩ pɩŋ a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ?”

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: Paalɩt bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ Juu tɩɩna ŋaa. Ŋ tɩtɩa nɩaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ nɛ joŋuŋ hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ ŋaa?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Mɩ kuoruŋ tuo dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Dɩ mɩ kuoruŋ nɛ fa hɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, mɩ nɩaa fa jaŋ yuo laamɛ dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa sɩ́ mɩ wuo kɛŋ. Ama mɩ kuoruŋ tuo daha.”

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ saa ŋaa kuoru nɛ koo?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ba paala lʋlmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa kuoru nɛ. Mɩ kʋ tuu dʋnɩa dɩ mɩ dagɛ nɩaa dɩ ba jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho dɩ ʋ jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ yie jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Pilate asked Jesus, “What is truth?” Jesus Is Sentenced to Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt pɩɛsʋ, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ bɛɛ?” Ba bʋla arɩ ba jaŋ kpʋ Yesu Mat.

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Ama jɩna-na kala, dɩ dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la nɛ yie, mɩ yie lɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa dɔŋɔ nɛ pɩma. Ma saa chɛ dɩ mɩ lɩɩsɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa kuoru-la nɛ ta pɩmaa?”

english_verse: They shouted, “No, not him! We want Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a terrorist.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kpɩa goŋ a bʋl, “Aɩ, nɩa deeŋ dee! Lɩɩsɛ Barabas ta. ”

english_verse: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt leŋ ba kɛŋ Yesu a vɩɩrʋ.

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoroo kɛŋ sɔsʋŋ sʋa kuoru nyunchuulo a joŋo chuu, a joŋ gɛrɩ-fɩaŋ laalʋ,

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: aŋ chʋɔlʋ a bʋl, “Juu tɩŋŋaa kuoro, laa chʋɔlʋŋ,” aŋ pɛ fallʋ.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt bɩra mɩɩra lɩɩ nɩalɩŋ teeŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Má bee na, mɩ kɛnʋ kaa kʋʋ lɩɩ ma teeŋ nɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ mɩ-na bɩ wɩɩkala na ʋ sɩ ŋaa chei.”

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu kʋ lɩɩ a ha chu sɔsʋŋ kuoru nyunchuul-la arɩ gɛrɩ-fɩaŋ-la ba sɩ joŋo laalʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt bʋla pɩba, “Má na baal-la.”

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ naʋ, ba kpɩa goŋ a bʋl, “Leŋ dɩ ba kpaasʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ, leŋ dɩ ba kpaasʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt bʋla pɩba, “Má tɩtɩa kɛnʋ kpaasɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ. Mɩ-na bɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ cheye na.”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩmma-la bɩra bʋl, “Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa yɩrɛ Wɩa Bii nɛ. La wombiiŋ daga arɩ nʋʋkala nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra mɩɩra jʋʋ kuoru dɩa-la tʋɔŋ a pɩɛsɛ Yesu, “Nɩɩ nɛ ŋ lɩɩ?” Yesu bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ tɔrɛ ŋ niiŋ nɛɛ? Ŋ bɩ jɩŋ mɩ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ mɩ joŋuŋ ta, a bɩra kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ ba kpaasɩŋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ Wɩa nɛ fa bɩŋ doluŋ pa, ŋ fa bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ dol kala mɩ lɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ jommi hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ kɛŋ cheeriŋ a kɩɩŋ, ʋ wʋbɔmʋŋ nɛ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Paalɩt sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ fa cho dɩ ʋ joŋ Yesu ta. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa faasa kpɩa goŋ a bʋl, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋu ta, ŋ bɩra bɩ la tinteeŋ kuoru-balɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Siiza nandɔŋ ŋaa. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa yɩyɩrɛ kuoru, ʋ tɩɩna ŋaa kuoru-balɩŋ dʋndɔŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
translation_verse: Paalɩt sɩ nɩa dɩ ba bʋl wɩaa deemba, ʋ kɛŋ Yesu kaa kʋ lɩɩ, aŋ mʋ hɔŋ ʋ sarɩya diiri kpasa nyuŋ. Ba kɛŋ lee-la kaa yɩrɛ ‘Gabata’ nɛ Hiburu yikoro lɛ. Ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ: Lee-la tabɩaa ŋaa mʋla mʋla nɛ.

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩa jɩl nyu-gbaŋa. Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ taŋ nɛ pʋla dɩ ba gbieli dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt bʋla pɩba, “Ma na ma kuoro.”

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ Yesu pɩba dɩ ba kaa mʋ kpaasɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ. Ba kpaasɛ Yesu daagɛsɛ nyuŋ Mat.

english_verse: The soldiers first broke the legs of the other two men who were nailed there.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoro-la mʋ kɛŋ baala-la ba sɩ kpaasa pɛ Yesu lɛ naasɩŋ bori.

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ bʋla pɩ Paalɩt arɩ ʋ sɩ́ ŋmʋnsa bʋl, “Juu tɩŋŋaa kuoro nɛ,” ama dɩ ʋ ŋmʋnsɛ, “Baala deeŋ sɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa kuoro.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ na ʋ naaŋ arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooru-la ʋ fa sɩ cho, dɩ ba chɩŋ nɩmɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl ʋ naaŋ lɛ, “Haal, bee na ŋ bie nɛ ŋ-la,”

english_verse: and he carried his cross to a place known as “The Skull.” In Aramaic this place is called “Golgotha.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ Yesu lɩɩ. Ʋ lɩɩ a baasɛ ʋ tɩtɩa daagɛsɛ a mʋ lee-la ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpaasʋ. Lee-la yɩrɩŋ nɛ nyu-kuŋkogulo. Hiburu yikoro lɛ baa yɩrɛ lee-la Gɔlɩgɔta nɛ.

english_verse: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Lee-la nɛ ba kpaasʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ. Ba fa kpaasɛ nɩaa balɩa ma nɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ a pɛ Yesu lɛ. Dɔŋɔ hɛ ʋ nadiiŋ, dɔŋɔ ma hɛ ʋ nagʋa. Ka Yesu hɛ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ.

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt ŋmʋnsa mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ-la lɛ a bʋl, “JUU TƖŊŊAA KUORO YESU A LƖƖ NAZARƐT.”

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Lee-la kpagɛ Jerusalɛm nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa yʋgɛ a karɩmɛ wɩɩ-la Paalɩt sɩ ŋmʋnsa mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ-la lɛ. Ʋ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩɩ-la arɩ yikorusuŋ batori nɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ Hiburu tɩŋŋaa yikoro ŋmʋnsɛ, a kɛŋ Laatɩŋ yikoro ma ŋmʋnsɛ, a kɛŋ Giriisi tɩŋŋaa yikoro ma ŋmʋnsɛ.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Paalɩt bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsa, mɩ ŋmʋnsa nɛ.”

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoro-la bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ a bʋl, “Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la kɛŋ gɛrɩ-la kɩɛsɛ, má leŋ dɩ la tɔnsɛ, a na nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ dii dɩ ʋ laa gɛrɩ-la.” Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa dɩ wɩalɩŋ ba fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ba fa sɩ, “Ba paa mɩ gɛnnɩŋ kpaa dɔŋɔ nɛ aŋ tɩŋ mɩ gɛrɩŋ dɔŋɔ wɩaa a tɔnsɛ.” Ŋ-la nɛ laalɩyuoro-la ŋaa.

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ chɩna kpagɛ Yesu daagɛsɛ-la nɛ ŋ-la: Yesu naaŋ arɩ ʋ naaŋ ŋaana, arɩ Kilopas haala Mɛɛrɩ, arɩ Mɛɛrɩ Magɩdalɩŋ.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Ba kɔ Yesu leriŋ dɩ ʋ sʋba. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba bɩ ʋ naasɩŋ boro.

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Lee kʋbala nɛ kpagɛ lee-la ba fa sɩ kpaasɛ Yesu daagɛsɛ-la nyuŋ, ba chɔnsɛ tɩɩsɩŋ. Tɩɩsɩ-la tʋɔŋ, bʋ-bʋa kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ ba ha bɩ nʋʋkala hugo nɩmɛ aŋ ka.

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: Yesu jɩma arɩ lɛɛlɛ wɩɩwɩɩ kala dɛrɛ nɛ, ka dɩ ʋ wuo leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ, dɩ ba kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Lɩɩ-nyʋasʋŋ nɛ kɛmmɛ.”

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Dɩ sɩnɩŋ sɩ nyala su gbaŋa chɩŋ nɩmɛ. Ba joŋ suosuo a yuu sɩŋ-la lɛ, a kɛŋ sekeliŋ lɩɩsɛ suosuo-la, a kaa jɩla hɛ Yesu niiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu nyʋa sɩŋ-la aŋ bʋl, “Wɩɩkala dɛrɛ nɛ,” aŋ kɛŋ ʋ nyuŋ chugili a sʋʋ.

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɩhɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ taŋ pʋl dɩ ba gbieli dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la. Tapʋlɩɩ-la ma jaŋ ŋaa chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba bɩ chɛ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kʋsʋʋnʋŋ sagɛ daagɛsɛ-la nyuŋ chɛɛ-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ sʋl Paalɩt dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ laalɩyuoroo mʋ bori ba naasɩŋ aŋ soriba daagɛsɛ-la nyuŋ. Ʋ sɛɩ.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: Ama laalɩyuoro-la dɔŋɔ joŋ ʋ timiŋ a tɔɔ Yesu sɛmɛ luri, ŋɩɩ nɛ chalɩŋ arɩ lɩɩŋ guu gbu lɩɩ.

english_verse: We know this is true, because it was told by someone who saw it happen. Now you can have faith too.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Jɔɔŋ nɛ na wɩaa deemba arɩ mɩ sɩɩŋ aa bʋlba arɩ ba ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Mɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩpɩma dɩ ma ma wuo laa dii.

english_verse: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, “No bone of his body will be broken”
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala ŋaa dɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ba ŋmʋnsa a bʋl, “Ba bɩ jaŋ bori ʋ haŋgbel-bala ma.”

english_verse: and “They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.” Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ba bɩra bʋla, “Ba jaŋ beŋ nɩɩ-la ba sɩ tɔbɔ arɩ timiŋ.” Ba hugi Yesu Mat.

english_verse: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ taŋ sɩ jaŋ pʋl dɩ ba gbieli dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele ŋɩɩ, ka bʋa-la ma kpagɛ lee-la, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ Yesu hugi nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ sʋba, baal kʋbala ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ baa yɩrɛ Josɛf. Ʋ fa lɩɩ Arɩmatɩya tinteeŋ nɛ. Ʋ ma fa ŋaa Yesu harɩ-tooru nɛ. Ama ʋ-na faa lʋarʋ nɛ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ fá Juu tɩŋŋaa wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mʋ sʋl Paalɩt dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ʋ sori Yesu kʋsʋʋŋ. Paalɩt pʋ wombiiŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mʋ sori.

english_verse: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.
translation_verse: Ba balɩa nɛ mʋ joŋ Yesu kʋsʋʋŋ, a joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-pʋla, a joŋ kɩalɩŋ mɩsɛ gɛrɩpɛ-pʋla-la, a kaa bɛ Yesu. Juu tɩŋŋaa yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ a hugi ba sʋʋnʋŋ.

english_verse: Thomas replied, “You are my Lord and my God!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Tɔmas yɩrʋ a bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ nɛ mɩ Wɩa.”

english_verse: On Sunday morning while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.
translation_verse: Lahadi chɛɛŋ sɩɩpʋʋraa dɩ leriŋ kala ha bire, Mɛɛrɩ Magɩdalɩŋ mʋ bʋa-la leriŋ a na tabɩɩ-la ba sɩ joŋo tɔ bʋa-la niiŋ, dɩ ʋ suro.

english_verse: The disciple who got there first then went into the tomb, and when he saw it, he believed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ mʋ bʋa-la leriŋ ma jʋʋ bʋa-la tʋɔŋ a na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa, a laa dii.

english_verse: Although Thomas the Twin was one of the twelve disciples, he wasn't with the others when Jesus appeared to them.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Yesu sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo, ʋ harɩ-tooro-la dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɔmas fa tuo. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ fa daalɩarɩŋ.

english_verse: and saw two angels inside. They were dressed in white and were sitting where Jesus' body had been. One was at the head and the other was at the foot.
translation_verse: a na Wɩa tɩndaaraa balɩa bʋa-la tʋɔŋ dɩ ba laalɛ gɛrɩ-pʋllʋŋ. Dɔŋɔ hɔŋ Yesu nyuŋ fa sɩ mʋ lee-la, dɔŋɔ ma hɔŋ ʋ naasɩŋ fa sɩ mʋ lee-la.

english_verse: She ran to Simon Peter and to Jesus' favorite disciple and said, “They have taken the Lord from the tomb! We don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ fá mʋ Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta arɩ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la dɔŋɔ teeŋ, nɩɩ-la Yesu fa sɩ cho woruŋ, a bʋla pɩba, “Ba lɩɩsɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu bʋa-la tʋɔŋ nɛ. La bɩ jɩŋ lee-la kala ba sɩ joŋu bil.”

english_verse: Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta arɩ Yesu harɩ-tooru-la dɔŋɔ sii mʋmʋ bʋa-la leriŋ.

english_verse: They ran side by side, until the other disciple ran faster than Peter and got there first.
translation_verse: Ba kala balɩa faa fá nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɔŋɔ-la tɩɩna fá kieli Pɩɩta, a laa sɩpaaŋ mʋ bʋa-la leriŋ.

english_verse: He bent over and saw the strips of linen cloth lying inside the tomb, but he did not go in.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ yi bʋa-la leriŋ, ʋ bɩ bʋa-la tʋɔŋ jʋa. Ʋ tuu tiŋ nɛ a nyilimi a na gɛnnɩ-la ba fa sɩ joŋo bɛ Yesu, dɩ ba pɩna.

english_verse: When Simon Peter got there, he went into the tomb and saw the strips of cloth.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta to harɩŋ kɔ a kʋ jʋʋ bʋa-la tʋɔŋ, a na gɛnnɩ-la ba fa sɩ joŋo bɛ Yesu, dɩ ba pɩna,

english_verse: He also saw the piece of cloth that had been used to cover Jesus' face. It was rolled up and in a place by itself.
translation_verse: a pɛ gɛrɩ-la ba fa sɩ joŋo bɛ Yesu nyuŋ, dɩ ʋ chuolo pɩŋ ʋ dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene stood crying outside the tomb. She was still weeping, when she stooped down
translation_verse: Mɛɛrɩ-na fa chɩŋ bʋa-la leriŋ nɛ aa yel. Ʋʋ yel ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ pɛ nyinyilimi bʋa-la tʋɔŋ,

english_verse: The angels asked Mary, “Why are you crying?” She answered, “They have taken away my Lord's body! I don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsʋ, “Haal, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ yiyel?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Ba joŋ mɩ Tɩɩna Yesu kaa lɛl nɛ. Mɩ bɩ jɩŋ ba sɩ joŋu kaa mʋ bil lee-la.”

english_verse: Jesus asked her, “Why are you crying? Who are you looking for?” She thought he was the gardener and said, “Sir, if you have taken his body away, please tell me, so I can go and get him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu ma pɩɛsɛ Mɛɛrɩ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ yiyel? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ chɩchɛ?” Mɛɛrɩ fa bɩɩna baal-la sɩɩ beŋ ŋmaŋkaa-la nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsʋ, “Kʋhɩaŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋo, dagɛmɛ lee-la ŋ sɩ kaa mʋ bil, dɩ mɩ mʋ joŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Don't hold on to me! I have not yet gone to the Father. But tell my disciples I am going to the one who is my Father and my God, as well as your Father and your God.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Sɩ́ mɩ kɛŋ. Mɩ ha bɩ mɩ Nyɩmma teeŋ jɩla. Ama mʋ bʋla pɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ arɩ mɩ jaŋ jɩl mɩ Nyɩmma teeŋ. Ʋ ŋaa ma ma Nyɩmma nɛ a ŋaa mɩ Wɩa, a ŋaa ma ma Wɩa.”

english_verse: and showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they became very happy.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa arɩ ʋ sɛmɛ dagɛba. Ʋ harɩ-tooroo kala tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ba sɩ na ba Tɩɩna.

english_verse: The disciples were afraid of the Jewish leaders, and on the evening of that same Sunday they locked themselves in a room. Suddenly, Jesus appeared in the middle of the group. He greeted them
translation_verse: Lahadi chɛɛŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ ʋ harɩ-tooroo hilimi dɩa tʋɔŋ aŋ kɛŋ boiŋ yagɛ. Baa fá Juu tɩmma-la nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛŋ borusuŋ tɔ a yagɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu kʋ chɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ aŋ bʋl, “Ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ.”

english_verse: After Jesus had greeted them again, he said, “I am sending you, just as the Father has sent me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ. Mɩ Nyɩmma sɩ tɩmmɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ maa timma.”

english_verse: Then he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ wiese hɛ ba lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Má laa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ dɩ ʋ hɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: If you forgive anyone's sins, they will be forgiven. But if you don't forgive their sins, they will not be forgiven.” Jesus and Thomas
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ joŋ nʋʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a chɛʋ, ʋ bɩra bɩ wʋbɔŋ kɛnɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ bɩra bɩ nʋʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛʋ, ʋ ha kɛŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.” Yesu kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ Tɔmas

english_verse: So they told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But Thomas said, “First, I must see the nail scars in his hands and touch them with my finger. I must put my hand where the spear went into his side. I won't believe unless I do this!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ harɩ-tooro-la dɔnsʋŋ bʋla pʋ, “La na La Tɩɩna.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Tɔmas bʋla pɩba, “See dɩ mɩ na hɛmɛ-la bʋɔsʋŋ ʋ nɩsaa lɛ, a joŋ mɩ neniiŋ hɛ bʋa-la lɛ, a joŋ mɩ neniiŋ hɛ ʋ sɛmɛ bʋa-la ma lɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ laa dii.”

english_verse: A week later the disciples were together again. This time, Thomas was with them. Jesus came in while the doors were still locked and stood in the middle of the group. He greeted his disciples
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa chori pɛgɛ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la bɩra jʋʋ dɩa a kɛŋ boiŋ yagɛ. Bʋa-la-na lɛ dɩ Tɔmas hɛ ba tʋɔŋ. Yesu kʋ jʋʋ chɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ aŋ bʋl, “Ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ.”

english_verse: and said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at my hands! Put your hand into my side. Stop doubting and have faith!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ Tɔmas, “Joŋ ŋ neniiŋ a hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ aŋ beŋ mɩ nɩsaa, aŋ kɛŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ hɛ mɩ sɛmɛ bʋa-la ma lɛ a na, aŋ laa mɩ wɩaa dii, aŋ sɩ́ kaa lɛrɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Thomas, do you have faith because you have seen me? The people who have faith in me without seeing me are the ones who are really blessed!” Why John Wrote His Book
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ sɩ namɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ laa mɩ wɩaa dii koo? Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ mɩ na aŋ laa mɩ wɩaa dii, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus worked many other miracles for his disciples, and not all of them are written in this book.
translation_verse: Yesu ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa dɔnsʋŋ yʋgɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo na, mɩ sɩ bɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ teniŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But these are written so that you will put your faith in Jesus as the Messiah and the Son of God. If you have faith in him, you will have true life.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba dɩ ma wuo laa dii arɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa aŋ pɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie ma. Dɩ ma nɛ laa wɩaa deemba dii, ma jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus later appeared to his disciples along the shore of Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: Yesu bɩra kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa dagɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo dɔnsʋŋ mʋga kʋbala niiŋ baa yɩrɛ Tabiiras. Ʋ harɩ-tooro-la nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: Simon Peter, Thomas the Twin, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, and the brothers James and John, were there, together with two other disciples.
translation_verse: Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta arɩ Tɔmas, nɩɩ-la ba fa sɩ kaa yɩrɛ daalɩarɩŋ ma, arɩ Natanɩal fa sɩ lɩɩ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Kena a hɛ Galilii tinteeŋ. Zebidi biiriŋ balɩa ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ, arɩ Yesu harɩ-tooroo balɩa ma dɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: Early the next morning Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize who he was.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋlaa kɔ dɩ Yesu chɩŋ lɩɩ-la niiŋ, ama ʋ harɩ-tooro-la bɩ jɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus shouted, “Friends, have you caught anything?” “No!” they answered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛba, “Mɩ nandɔsʋŋ, ma kɛsɛ chenfilee nɛɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Aɩ, la bɩ kʋŋkala na.”

english_verse: So he told them, “Let your net down on the right side of your boat, and you will catch some fish.” They did, and the net was so full of fish that they could not drag it up into the boat.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Má joŋ ma jóŋ, a yuo hɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la nadiiŋ sɛmɛ, ma jaŋ kɛsɛ chenfilee.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba yuo joŋ-la a kɛsɛ chenfilee su. Ʋ sɩ suo ŋɩɩ, ba bɩ wuo lɩlɛrɛ.

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, “It's the Lord!” When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ harɩ-tooru-la Yesu sɩ cho woruŋ bʋla pɩ Pɩɩta, “La Tɩɩna nɛ.” Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Pɩɩta fa wuri ʋ gɛrɩŋ. Ʋ sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ joŋ ʋ gɛrɩŋ a laalɛ, aŋ lɩɩ lɩɩŋ daboro-la lɛ, a fɩla jʋʋ lɩɩŋ dɩ ʋ duoro kʋ lɩɩ Yesu teeŋ.

english_verse: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kʋ lɩɩ lɩɩ-la niiŋ, ba na hɔlɔɔ nyiniŋ dɩ chenfilee chɛbɛ, ka boroboro ma pɩŋ.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má lɩɩsɛ chenfile-la dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ kɛsɛ lɛɛlɛ a kaa kɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Come and eat!” But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Má kʋ lɩɩ bɩllɛ ma niiŋ.” Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ harɩ-tooroo kʋŋkala bɩ wuo pɩɛsɛ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛɛ?” Ba kala jɩma arɩ La Tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave some of it to his disciples. He did the same with the fish.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu joŋ boroboro-la a pɩba, a joŋ chenfile-la ma a pɩba dɩ ba dii.

english_verse: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death. Jesus and Peter
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ ʋ butori nɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kaa kʋ dagɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo. Yesu bʋl wɩaa a pɩ Pɩɩta

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples had finished eating, he asked, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than the others do?” Simon Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I do!” “Then feed my lambs,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ dii boroboro-la arɩ chenfile-la dɛrɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu pɩɛsɛ Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta, “Jɔɔŋ nanʋala Saamɔŋ, ŋ chomi a kɩɩ nɩaa deemba nɛɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta sɩ, “Oo mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ tɩtɩa jɩma arɩ mɩ choŋ nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Beŋ mɩ nɩaa nyuŋ, arɩ pie-daara sɩ yie beŋ ʋ piesee nyuŋ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you!” “Then take care of my sheep,” Jesus told him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra pɩɛsʋ, “Jɔɔŋ nanʋala Saamɔŋ, ŋ chomi nɛɛ?” Ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Oo mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ jɩma arɩ mɩ choŋ nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pʋ, “Beŋ mɩ nɩaa nyuŋ, arɩ pie-daara sɩ yie beŋ ʋ piesee nyuŋ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra pɩɛsʋ torimuŋ, “Jɔɔŋ nanʋala Saamɔŋ, ŋ chomi nɛɛ?” Yesu sɩ pɩɛsʋ torimuŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ tʋɔŋ chei. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ jɩŋ wɩɩkala nɛ, ŋ jɩma arɩ mɩ choŋ nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pʋ, “Beŋ mɩ nɩaa nyuŋ, arɩ pie-daara sɩ yie beŋ ʋ piesee nyuŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that when you were a young man, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will hold out your hands. Then others will wrap your belt around you and lead you where you don't want to go.”
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩŋ, ŋ fa sɩ ŋaa hambie, ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ yie laalɛ ŋ gɛnnɩŋ a mʋmʋ lee-la kala ŋ sɩ cho. Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ kʋ hɩɛsɛ, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ nɩsaa je, aŋ ka dɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ nɛ joŋ ŋ gɛnnɩŋ a laalɩŋ aŋ kɛnɩŋ mʋ lee-la ŋ sɩ bɩ cho dɩ ŋ mʋa.”

english_verse: Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, “Follow me!” Jesus and His Favorite Disciple
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ dagɛ Pɩɩta sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ a laa yɩrɩŋ pɩ Wɩa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “To mɩ harɩŋ.”

english_verse: Peter turned and saw Jesus' favorite disciple following them. He was the same one who had sat next to Jesus at the meal and had asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta daasɛ harɩŋ a na Yesu harɩ-tooru-la Yesu fa sɩ cho woruŋ, nɩɩ-la fa sɩ sʋʋsa mʋ kpagɛ Yesu bʋa-la lɛ ba fa sɩɩ dii dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la kʋdiilee, a fa pɩɛsʋ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, kʋbɛɛ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋuŋ yallɛ?”

english_verse: When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, “Lord, what about him?”
translation_verse: Pɩɩta sɩ naʋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛ Yesu, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, ka baala deeŋ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ ka dɩ mɩ-na mɩɩra kɔ dʋnɩa, ŋ sɩpaa tuo nɩmɛ. To mɩ harɩŋ.”

english_verse: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋmoo doworo pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii arɩ Yesu harɩ-tooro deeŋ-na bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ. Ama Yesu bɩ ŋɩɩ bʋla. Ʋ sɩ dɩ ʋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ harɩ-tooru-la hɛ nɩmɛ ka dɩ ʋ-na mɩɩra kɔ dʋnɩa, Pɩɩta sɩpaa tuo.

english_verse: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Jɔɔŋ nɛ na wɩaa deemba aa ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ. La saa jɩma arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.
translation_verse: Yesu ŋaa wɩaa dɔnsʋŋ yʋgɛ a pɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ teniŋ deeŋ lɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ kala, leriŋ fa jaŋ tuo dʋnɩa lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ bil tenni-la.

english_verse: until he was taken up to heaven. But before he was taken up, he gave orders to the apostles he had chosen with the help of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: a kaa mʋ tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋu a kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ ʋ dagɛ ʋ nanzɔɔba-la ʋ sɩ tʋɔsa tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ tɩtɩŋ nɛ aŋ-na jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ.

english_verse: While he was still with them, he said: Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait here for the Father to give you the Holy Spirit, just as I told you he has promised to do.
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ, ʋ dɩ ba hɔnɔ didii kɩaa ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Má sɩ́ Jerusalɛm lɛ lɩɩ, má gbɛrɛ mɩ Nyɩmma zile kʋ-la ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, kʋ-la wɩaa mɩ fa sɩ bʋla pɩma.

english_verse: John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. Jesus Is Taken to Heaven
translation_verse: Jɔɔŋ fa kɛŋ lɩɩŋ nɛ a fufo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ. Ama ʋ bɩ dieni, ka dɩ Wɩa joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ma lɛ.” Yesu jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ

english_verse: While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again?”
translation_verse: Yesu arɩ ʋ nanzɔɔba sɩ hilimi ŋɩɩ, ba pɩɛsʋ, “La Tɩɩna, tapʋlaa deemba lɛ, ŋ jaŋ bɩra leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dii kuoruŋ?”

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You don't need to know the time of those events that only the Father controls.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ Nyɩmma nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a hɛ bʋa-la koo tapʋlɩa-la wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa. Ʋ tuo ma wɩɩ dɩ ma jɩŋ.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come upon you and give you power. Then you will tell everyone about me in Jerusalem, in all Judea, in Samaria, and everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: Ama dɩ Wɩa nɛ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ma lɛ, ma jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ, a dii mɩ dansɩa a bʋl mɩ wɩaa Jerusalɛm arɩ Judiya tinteeŋ kala arɩ Samarɩa lɛ, a kaa mʋ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ kala lɛ.”

english_verse: After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him,
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, Wɩa joŋu kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ, ka ba chɩna bibeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ kʋ tɔʋ, ba bɩra bɩ ʋ na.

english_verse: but as he went up, they kept looking up into the sky. Suddenly two men dressed in white clothes were standing there beside them.
translation_verse: Ba ha sɩ wʋla bibeŋ wɩa-nyuŋ ŋɩɩ ka ʋ jɩjɩl, dɩ nɩaa balɩa nɛ guu chɩŋ ba sɛmɛ ŋɩɩ, a laalɛ gɛrɩ-pʋllʋŋ

english_verse: They said, “Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.” Someone To Take the Place of Judas
translation_verse: a pɩɛsɛba, “Galilii tɩmma, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma chɩnaa beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ? Yesu deeŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo ma sɩpaaŋ a kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ, ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ arɩ ma sɩ naʋ dɩ ʋ jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ ŋɩɩ.” Ba lɩɩsɛ Matɩyas ʋ laa Judas nyuŋ

english_verse: The Mount of Olives was about a kilometer from Jerusalem. The apostles who had gone there were Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas the son of James. After the apostles returned to the city, they went upstairs to the room where they had been staying.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ yi Jerusalɛm, ba mʋ jʋʋ lusuŋ nyuŋ dɩa-la ba sɩɩ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Pɩɩta, Jɔɔŋ, Jeems, Anduru, Fɩlɩp, Tɔmas, Batolomi, Matiu, arɩ Alɩfɩyas nanʋala Jeems, Saamɔŋ Zɛlɔt, arɩ Jeems nanʋala Judas, ba kala nɩɩ jʋʋ dɩ-bala.

english_verse: The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers.
translation_verse: Ba dɩ haalaa dɔnsʋŋ arɩ Yesu naaŋ Mɛɛrɩ arɩ Yesu ŋaanaa, ba kala fa ŋaa nii-bala nɛ aa hilimi nɩmɛ, a fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out.
translation_verse: Judas sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la, ba joŋ moribiee timu, ʋ joŋo yɔɔ tintee kʋbala. Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ tuu tele yɛrɛ, ʋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa kala jaasɛ.

english_verse: When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ. Ba yikoro lɛ ba kɛŋ lee-la kaa yɩyɩrɛ Akɩlɩdama. Ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ chalɩŋ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: In the book of Psalms it says, “Leave his house empty, and don't let anyone live there.” It also says, “Let someone else have his job.”
translation_verse: Devit ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Wɩa yɩɩlaa a bʋl, ‘a leŋ dɩ ʋ dɩa pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ nɩmɛ jʋʋ.’ Ʋ bɩra ŋmʋnsa dɩ nʋʋ jaŋ laa ʋ nyuŋ a tɩtɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba dagɛ nɩaa balɩa, dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Josɛf Basabas. Dɔŋɔ-la ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Matɩyas.

english_verse: Then they all prayed, “Lord, you know what everyone is like! Show us the one you have chosen
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a bʋl, “La Tɩɩna, ŋ jɩŋ nʋʋkala tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa dagɛla nɩaa deemba balɩamɩŋ tʋɔŋ kʋ-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa,

english_verse: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.”
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋ nanzɔɔ dɔŋɔ a laa Judas nyuŋ, a tɩtɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa, tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Judas sɩ vɩa aŋ mʋ ʋ dɩ-mʋʋlʋŋ.”

english_verse: They drew names, and Matthias was chosen to join the group of the eleven apostles.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tɔnsɛ, Matɩyas dii. Ba kɛnʋ pɛ Yesu nanzɔɔba fii arɩ kʋbala-la lɛ.

english_verse: On the day of Pentecost all the Lord's followers were together in one place.
translation_verse: Ba gbieli-bal kʋbala chɛɛŋ kʋ yi baa yɩrɛ Pɛntɩkɔs. Chɛɛ-la ba kʋ hilimi dɩ-bala.

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Goŋ kʋbala guu lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ tuu a nagɛ pel-duoŋ, a su dɩa-la tʋɔŋ ba fa sɩ hɔnɔ.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ togili nʋʋkala lɛ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛba kala lɛ, a pɩba doluŋ ba suomo bʋbʋl yikori dosunuŋ.

english_verse: Many religious Jews from every country in the world were living in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ ma fa hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ aa fá Wɩa, a lɩɩ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ-na kala.

english_verse: And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages.
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ sɩ nɩɩ goŋ deeŋ, ba kala kʋ hilimi. Ba sɩ hilimi ŋɩɩ, ba nɩa dɩ baa bʋl wɩaa ba tɩtɩa yikorusuŋ lɛ. Ʋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere.

english_verse: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Ba faasa hirigi a bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ, “Nɩaa deemba kala ŋaa Galilii tɩŋŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages?
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ saa laa nɩɩ dɩ baa bʋl wɩaa la yikorusuŋ lɛ?

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: La dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Paatɩa, dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Miidia, dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Ɩlam. La dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Mesopotemia, dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Judiya, dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Kapadoosia, dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Pɔntɔs, dɔnsʋŋ ma lɩɩ Esia.

english_verse: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
translation_verse: La dɔnsʋŋ ŋaa Juu tɩmma nɛ, la dɔnsʋŋ ŋaa nɩaa sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa aŋ tuto Juu tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ wombiiŋ. La dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Kiriiti, dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Arebia. La kalaa bʋl yikori dabaŋ dabamba nɛ, ka la nɩɩ dɩ baa bʋl wɩaa la yikorusuŋ lɛ. Wɩa sɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duori-la wɩaa nɛ ba bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: Ba kala hirigi, a bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ ba sɩ hɛ, ba pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ wɩɩ nɛ ŋ-la?”

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Dɔnsʋŋ ma sisieriba lɛ dɩ ba bugo nɛ. Pɩɩta bʋl Wɩa wɩaa a pɩ nɩaa

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Pɩɩta arɩ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la fii arɩ kʋbala fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ, Pɩɩta sii chɩŋ a faasa bʋl, “Mɩ naambiiriŋ Juu tɩmma arɩ ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, má wuoli ma dɩgɩlaa dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa a pɩma.

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna nɩaa deemba bugo nɛɛ? Ba bɩ bugo chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla deeŋ.

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: Jowɛl ma fa bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa nɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: “When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
translation_verse: ‘Wɩa bʋla, ŋ-la nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa tapʋlaa dɩdɛrɩŋ: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ nʋʋkala lɛ. Ma hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ma toloo jaŋ bʋl wɩaa mɩ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ. Ma bapʋɔsɩ-biisiŋ ma jaŋ nɩna wɩaa a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ. Ma banɩhɩasɩŋ ma jaŋ duduosi duosoo.

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: Chɛɛ-la mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ baala-la arɩ haala-la sɩ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa lɛ dɩ ba kaa bʋbʋl mɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ wɩa-nyuŋ, aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋmagɩlaa ma tinteeŋ lɛ. Chalɩŋ, nyiniŋ arɩ nyʋɔ-bine jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ jaŋ biri. Chɛnɛ ma jaŋ fɩɛsɛ a nagɛ chalɩŋ, ka dɩ La Tɩɩna tapʋl-bal-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ laa yɩrɩŋ-na yi.

english_verse: Then the Lord will save everyone who asks for his help.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ yɩrɛ La Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ laaʋ ta.’ ”

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bɩra bʋl, “Iziral tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋla pɩma. Yesu sɩ lɩɩ Nazarɛt nɛ Wɩa lɩɩsa pɩma. Wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ Wɩa sɩ to ʋ lɛ ŋaa ma sɩɩŋ lɛ nɛ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. Ma ma jɩma nɛ.

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Wɩa jɩma nɛ aŋ leŋ Yesu jʋʋ ma nɩsɩŋ. Ma nɛ leŋe wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ, a lɩɩsɛ hɛɛ-la ʋ sɩ na bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩɩ sʋʋ. Sʋʋŋ fa bɩ ʋ wuo kaa bibil.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: Devit fa bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ: ‘Mɩ yie na mɩ Tɩɩna nɛ mɩ sɩpaaŋ bʋa na-kala, ʋ kpagɛmɛ nɛ, wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ wuo jigisimi.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ, mɩ bʋbʋl tʋɔ tɔrɛ wɩaa. Mɩ ŋaa nuhuobiiŋ nɛ a jaŋ sʋʋ. Mɩɩ yɩɛlɛ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ ŋaa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ sʋba, ŋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ ka bʋa tʋɔŋ, koo a leŋ dɩ mɩ-na ŋ Tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ-la yaraa pʋa.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: Ŋ dagɛmɛ wombie-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ to a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ. Ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ.’ ”

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ jaŋ chaasa bʋl la naabalɩma Devit wɩaa pɩma. Ʋ sʋba nɛ, ba joŋu hugi, ʋ vaamɩŋ ha pɩna nɛ la jaŋ lɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ a wuo jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pʋ. Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa pʋʋ nɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ-na Devit doho nɩaa dɔŋɔ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: Devit sɩ na wɩɩ-la Wɩa fa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa, ʋ wuo bʋl arɩ Kirisito jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, a bɩra bʋl arɩ Wɩa bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ ka bʋa tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ yaraa pʋa.

english_verse: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
translation_verse: Yesu deeŋ nɛ Wɩa chɩsɛ sʋʋŋ lɛ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. La kala na wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ a jɩŋ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: Wɩa chɩsʋ ʋ sii jɩla hɔŋ Wɩa nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ, a bɩra pʋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ arɩ ʋ fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ. Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ deeŋ Yesu sɩ joŋo hɛ la lɛ jɩnɩŋ, ʋ nɛ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ na a nɩnɩɩ ma.

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: Devit tɩtɩa fa bɩ Wɩa-jaŋ jɩla, ama aŋ bʋla tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ, “La Tɩɩna bʋla pɩ mɩ Tɩɩna: Hɔŋ mɩ nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ,

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: see dɩ mɩ yuo dii ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ma jɩŋ ʋ sɛnɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ Yesu deeŋ ma sɩ kaa kpaasɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ, ʋ nɛ Wɩa leŋ ʋ ŋaa La Tɩɩna. Ʋ nɛ bɩra Kirisito ma.”

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ Pɩɩta sɩ bʋla, ʋ faasa wʋwalɩmɛba kɩŋkɛŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩɛsɛ Pɩɩta arɩ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la dɔnsʋŋ, “La naambiiriŋ, bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ saa la jaŋ ŋaa?”

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋla pɩba, “Má bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, aŋ leŋ dɩ ba foma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ Yesu Kirisito yɩrɩŋ lɛ, dɩ Wɩa joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛma, aŋ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ dii zile ma lɛ.

english_verse: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla, ma nɛ ʋ bʋla pa, ma dɩ ma biiriŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ lɩɩ dɩ-boluŋ, nʋʋ na-kala Wɩa sɩ yɩra dɩ ʋ kɔ ʋ teeŋ.”

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: Pɩɩta sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ sʋlba a paala chaasa bʋl wɩaa dɔnsʋŋ yʋgɛ a bʋl, “Má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together. Life among the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Ba joŋ ba nyuŋ kala hɛ wɩalɩŋ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la sɩɩ dagʋ lɛ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ a kɛŋ nii-bala. Ba kala hɔŋ a didii kʋdiile-la Yesu fa sɩ́ sɩ dɩ ba dii a liliisi ʋ wɩaa, aŋ pɛ gbaara chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii dɩhɔnʋŋ

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kʋŋkala fɩfá Wɩa, bɛɛ wɩaa Yesu nanzɔɔba-la ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ arɩ wʋmagɩlaa yʋgɛ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa wɩalɩŋ dii, ba kala kʋ hihilimi bʋa na-kala lɛ, ba kɩaa kala ma ŋaa kʋbala.

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: Ba yie joŋ ba kɩaa ma yallɛ a kɛŋ moribie-la a kpɩkpaa dɔŋɔ, a magɛ ŋɩɩ nʋʋkala sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely,
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kala ba yie mʋ hilimi Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ arɩ ba dɩɩsɩŋ ma lɛ, a kɛŋ tʋɔ-bala a didii kʋdiile-la Kirisito fa sɩ́ sɩ ba dii a liliisi ʋ wɩaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ,

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: a dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa. Nɩaa ma kala bɩbɛsɛ ba lɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ-na kala La Tɩɩna yie laa nɩ-falaa ta nɛ, ba kʋʋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii lɛ.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ sii a mʋmʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. Ba mʋ nɩmɛ kerifi batori wɩɩhɛyɛ, bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ yie chʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: Dɩ baal kʋbala hɛ nɩmɛ, ʋ naaŋ lʋlʋ dɩ ʋ gbɛrɩgɛ nɛ. Ba yie chʋŋʋ tapʋlɩɩ-na kala a kaa mʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Boi-zɔmʋŋ. Ʋʋ sʋl kɩaa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la teeŋ.

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ na Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ dɩ ba kʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la, ʋ sʋl kɩaa ba teeŋ.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Ba beŋ ʋ sɩaa lɛ fii, ka Pɩɩta bʋla pʋ, “Bibenla.”

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bibemba aŋ gbɩgbɛrɛ kʋ-la ba sɩ jaŋ joŋo pʋ.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋla pʋ, “Mɩ bɩ moribii kala kɛnɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩŋ, ama mɩ jaŋ joŋ kʋ-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ a pɩŋ. Yesu Kirisito sɩ lɩɩ Nazarɛt yɩrɩŋ lɛ, sii a vɛŋ.”

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a kɛnʋ chʋʋlɛ, ʋ sii. Ʋ naasɩŋ arɩ ʋ naachɩgɩsɩŋ kala guu polli.

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: Ʋ sii fɩla chɩŋ ʋ naasɩŋ nyuŋ a suomo vɛŋ, ba jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. Ʋ vɛŋ aŋ pɛ fɩfɩl, a dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ naʋ dɩ ʋʋ vɛŋ aŋ dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa,

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: ba wuo jɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɛ nɩɩ-la fa sɩ yie hɔŋ Wɩa dɩa-la boiŋ niiŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Boi-zɔmʋŋ aa sʋl kɩaa. Ba hirigi. Wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa, ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere. Pɩɩta bʋl Wɩa wɩaa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ arɩ gbɛrɩgʋ-la jʋʋ zawʋra kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Solomoŋ zawʋra. Gbɛrɩgʋ-la kɛŋ Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ nɩsaa lɛ, ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ kala wʋkpuŋkpere, ba kire to ba harɩŋ.

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Pɩɩta sɩ na nɩalɩŋ dɩ baa ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ naambiiriŋ Iziral tɩmma, ɛɛ nɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere ma teeŋ, ma paala faasa chaarɛ sɩaa a bibenla ŋ-la? Ma bɩɩna arɩ la tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ koo la sɩɩ to Wɩa woruŋ nɛ wuo ŋaa baala deeŋ sii vɩvɛŋ?

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: Wɩa-la sɩ ŋaa la naabalɩmaba Abɩraham arɩ Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb Wɩa, ʋ nɛ joŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ a pɩ ʋ Bie Yesu. Ʋ nɛ ma kaa pa ba dii ʋ sarɩya, aŋ bʋl ma bɩ ʋ jɩŋ Paalɩt sarɩya diire-la sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ faa bɩɩnɛ dɩ ʋ joŋu ta, ka ma bɩ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Ma vɩa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ, aŋ sʋl dɩ ba joŋ nɩkpʋʋra ta,

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: aŋ leŋ ba kpʋ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ. Ama Wɩa chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ. La ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɛ-naaraa nɛ.

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ baala deeŋ ma sɩ na a jɩmʋ duori. La sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɛ wuo ŋaa baala deeŋ na yarɩfɩɛlaa woruŋ ma kala sɩɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ jɩma ma dɩ ma kʋhɩasɩŋ sɩ kpʋ Yesu ŋɩɩ, ma bɩ jɩŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But God had his prophets tell that his Messiah would suffer, and now he has kept this promise.
translation_verse: Wɩa leŋe ʋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa bʋl faafaa kala arɩ Kirisito-la jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Ʋ sɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋ-la.

english_verse: So turn to God! Give up your sins, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Má bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ aŋ to Wɩa, dɩ ʋ joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛma, dɩ La Tɩɩna leŋ dɩ ma dɩnsɩŋ na wiese.

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ Kirisito bɩra kʋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ, nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa pɩma.

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ, see bʋa-la yie, dɩ Wɩa leŋ dɩ wɩɩkala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ bɩrɩmɛ wʋfalɩɩ. Wɩa leŋe ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ faafaa kala nɛ.

english_verse: Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.
translation_verse: Mosis fa sɩ, ‘La Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ ma tʋɔŋ a pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ʋ wʋlaabʋllʋ a nagɛ mɩ-na Mosis. Ʋ maga dɩ ma jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩma.

english_verse: No one who disobeys this prophet will be one of God's people any longer.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ ʋ niiŋ to, Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba lɩɩsʋ Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ a ta dɩ ʋ sʋʋ.’

english_verse: Samuel and all the other prophets who came later also spoke about what is now happening.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa kala, a chɩŋ Samʋɛl lɛ a mʋmʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ to ʋ harɩŋ, ba kala fa bʋl wɩaa deemba ma sɩɩ na nɛ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa fa sɩ to ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ a bʋla pɩ ma naabalɩmaba, ma ma pɛ ba lɛ nɛ. Ʋ fa bil niiŋ nɛ ʋ dɩ ma naabalɩma Abɩraham pɛgɛ: ‘Ŋ doho nɩaa lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ to a pɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala lɛ.’

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩntɩnna Yesu, dɩ ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ kɔ ma teeŋ a pɛ ma lɛ, dɩ ma kala bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ fa sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kʋhɩaŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Saduusi tɩŋŋaa, ba kɔ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Ba fa na baanɩŋ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la sɩɩ dagʋ. Ba faa dagɛ nɩalɩŋ arɩ Yesu sii sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ, a dagɛba ŋɩɩ arɩ nʋʋ nɛ sʋba, ʋ jaŋ bɩra sii sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ kaa mʋ tɔ dɩa, taŋ pʋl. Ba fa kɛsɛba dɩ wɩa ka chɛ dɩ ʋ jʋʋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba tɔba taŋ pʋl.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Ka nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla, nɩaa yʋga ba tʋɔŋ a laa Yesu wɩaa dii. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa wɩalɩŋ dii, ba tʋɔŋ baalaa pʋŋa yi bʋɩ banɔŋ.

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, nɩalɩŋ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba kala kʋ hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Anas ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ a pɛ Kayafas arɩ Jɔɔŋ arɩ Alɛkɩzanda, arɩ nʋʋkala sɩ lɩɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ kʋ hilimi ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ hilime ŋɩɩ, ba yɩrɛ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la balɩa a kaa lɩɩ bil ba tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ a pɩɛsɛba, “Dol bɛɛ nɛ ma kaa ŋaa baala deeŋ duori? Kʋbɛɛ yɩrɩŋ nɛ ma yɩrɛ a ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ?”

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa dɩ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ Pɩɩta lɛ woruŋ, ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma sɩpaalaaraa deemba arɩ ma Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩŋ,

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: maa pɩɛsɛla jɩnɩŋ a tɩŋ wʋzɔŋ-la la sɩ ŋaa gbɛrɩgʋ-la lɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ la sɩ ŋaa ʋ duori.

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma nɩaa deemba arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala jɩŋ arɩ Yesu Kirisito sɩ lɩɩ Nazarɛt, ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ baala deeŋ duori a chɩŋ ma sɩpaaŋ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ nɛ ma leŋ ba kpaasa mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ʋ sʋʋ, ka Wɩa chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Yesu wɩaa nɛ ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, ‘Tie-bii-la dɩɩ-saaraa sɩ vɩa, ʋ nɛ kʋ ŋaa tie-bii-duoŋ ba sɩ joŋo bil dɩa gentine.’

english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo laala ta, see Yesu dʋndʋŋa. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa sɩ la yɩrɛ dʋnɩa lɛ dɩ ʋ laala ta. Nʋʋ dɔŋ bɩra tuo dɩ ʋ laala ta.”

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hilime a na Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ dɩ baa bʋl wɩaa arɩ nyuduoŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jɩma ba bɩ nɩfɩɛma ŋaa ba taŋ lɛ a bɩ teniŋ ma jɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba wuo jɩŋ arɩ ba faa to Yesu harɩŋ nɛ a gʋnnɛ ʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Ka ba na gbɛrɩgʋ-la Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ sɩ vaara, dɩ ba kala chɩna, ba niiŋ kala maa.

english_verse: The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩba dɩ ba lɩɩ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ ba fa sɩ hɔnɔɔ vʋʋrɛ wɩaa. Ba lɩɩ, aŋ ka ba pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ,

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: “Bɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaa nɩaa deemba balɩa lɛɛ? Nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ jɩma arɩ ba nɛ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere deeŋ, la saa bɩ wuo kaa lɩlɛrɛ.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Ama má leŋ dɩ la kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ Yesu yɩrɩŋ yɩrʋ, a bɩra sɩ́ ʋ wɩaa bʋla pɩ nɩaa, dɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bɩra sɩ́ leriŋ deeŋ kala teelu.”

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra yɩrɛba kaa jʋʋ, a bʋla pɩba arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ wɩɩkala bʋl, koo a dagɛ nɩaa wɩɩkala a tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ, a bɩra sɩ́ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrʋ.

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ pɩɛsɛba, “La sɩ to ma niiŋ arɩ la sɩ to Wɩa niiŋ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ zɔmɔ Wɩa teeŋ? Má bʋl.

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: La bɩ jaŋ wuo tɔrɛ la niiŋ, see dɩ la bʋl wɩalɩŋ la sɩ na aŋ nɩɩ maa.”

english_verse: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than
translation_verse: Baala deeŋ lɛ ba fa sɩ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere-la ʋ duori, ʋ fa kɩɩ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii sʋl Wɩa chɩchɛ nyuduoŋ

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ jomba ta, Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ mɩɩra mʋ ba naambiiri-la ba dɩ ba fa sɩ yie hilimi teeŋ, a bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩŋ fa sɩ bʋla pɩba.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ba suomo chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa arɩ tʋɔ-bala a bʋl, “La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ŋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ arɩ mʋgʋ-balaa arɩ fuo-biisiŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: Ŋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ, ŋ wuo leŋ la naabalɩma Devit sɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnna bʋl, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, ba faasa na baanɩŋ? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩalɩŋ vʋʋrɛ dɩ ba jaŋ chei Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa aŋ lɔl?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ kuoroo kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ, ba taŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ, ma hilimi dɩ ba yuo La Tɩɩna arɩ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa.’

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba sɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, Hɛrɔd arɩ Pɔntɩɔs Paalɩt arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ba kala hilime nɛ taŋ deeŋ lɛ dɩ ba yuo Yesu, ŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa.

english_verse: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
translation_verse: Ba hilime ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ paala jɩŋ ŋ doluŋ arɩ ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛ arɩ ba jaŋ ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna, beŋ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ fugisila, aŋ pɛ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa lɛ dɩ la wuo bʋl ŋ niiŋ wɩaa arɩ nyuduoŋ.

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: Dagɛ ŋ doluŋ aŋ leŋ dɩ puwuoloo duori, dɩ la ma wuo ŋɩŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ arɩ wʋmagɩlaa ŋ tɩntɩnna Yesu sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ yɩrɩŋ lɛ.”
