english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Ba sɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa dɛrɛ, lee-la ba sɩ hilime zigili. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ hɛ ba kala lɛ. Ba suomo bʋbʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa arɩ nyuduoŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii ka pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ba kala kɛŋ tʋɔ-bala arɩ nii-bala. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ kʋŋ ma, ʋ bɩ jaŋ bʋl ʋ nɛ tɩɩ kʋa deeŋ, ba kala nɛ yie tɩɩʋ.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: Wɩa dol-bal-la nɛ tɩɩ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la wuo na wombiiŋ a bʋlaa pɩ nɩaa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu sii sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa chaasa pɛ ba kʋŋkala lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Ba nɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala fa bɩ kʋŋ chɛɛ ka, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ kɛŋ tinteyee arɩ dɩɩsɩŋ, ba yie joŋo yallɛ nɛ, a kɛŋ moribie-la ba sɩ na

english_verse: to the apostles. Then they would give the money to anyone in need.
translation_verse: a kaa mʋ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la teeŋ. Ba kaa kpaa magɛ ŋɩɩ kala nʋʋkala sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: Joseph was one of the followers who had sold a piece of property and brought the money to the apostles. He was a Levite from Cyprus, and the apostles called him Barnabas, which means “one who encourages others.”
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ joŋ ʋ baga ʋ fa sɩ kɛnɛ a yallɛ, a kɛŋ moribie-la kaa mʋ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la teeŋ.

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: a lɩɩsɛ moribie-la dɔnsʋŋ faa, ʋ haala jɩŋ, aŋ kɛŋ kʋkaana-la kaa mʋ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la teeŋ.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Pɩɩta pɩɛsʋ, “Ananɩas, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ leŋ Sɩtaanɩ nyɩsɩŋ, ŋ joŋ tintee-la ŋ sɩ yalla moribie-la dɔnsʋŋ faa, aŋ nyɩɛ wɩaa pɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ?

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Ka ŋ-na joŋ kʋ-la yallɛ, ŋ dee bɩ ʋ tɩɩ? Moribie-la maa ŋ sɩ yalla, ŋ dee bɩba tɩɩ? Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ŋ bɩɩnɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ aŋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ? Nuhuobiinee dʋndʋŋa dee ŋ nyɩɛ wɩaa pa, ŋ nyɩɛ wɩaa pɩ Wɩa ma nɛ.”

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Ananɩas sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ tele sʋʋ. Fawʋllʋŋ chaasa kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ bapʋɔsaa kʋ joŋ gɛrɩŋ bɛʋ a joŋu kaa lɩɩ a kaa mʋ hugi.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: Ʋ yi hawa batori dɩ ʋ haala kʋ jʋʋ. Ʋ fa bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Pɩɩta pɩɛsʋ ma, “Moribie-la ŋ bala sɩ kaa kɔ, magɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ ma joŋ ma tintee-la yallɛɛ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la bʋl, “Ba niiŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bɩra pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ dɩ ŋ bala vʋʋrɛ dɩ ma magɩsɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ? Bee na, nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ŋ bala mʋ hugi, ba nɛ chɩŋ boiŋ niiŋ ŋɩɩ. Ba saa jaŋ joŋuŋ ma lɩɩ.”

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: Ʋ ma guu tel ʋ sɩpaaŋ a sʋʋ. Bapʋɔsɩa-la sɩ joŋ ʋ bala kaa mʋ hugi, ba kʋ jʋʋ dɩ ʋ sʋba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋu kaa lɩɩ, a hugu kpɛrɛ ʋ bala.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba woruŋ. Wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ arɩ wʋmagɩlaa

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Yesu nanzɔɔba-la ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ yʋgɛ nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ba kala yie hihilimi zawʋra-la ba sɩ kaa yɩrɛ Solomoŋ zawʋra lɛ.

english_verse: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩ bɩ Yesu wɩaa laa dii bɩ nyuduoŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ guoli ba tʋɔŋ, arɩ nɩaa sɩɩ bɛsɛ ba lɛ ma kala.

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa, ba paala paa puwuoloo kaa lɩɩ wombiiŋ niiŋ, a bilba godoba lɛ arɩ bɔsʋnʋŋ lɛ. Ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ Pɩɩta nɛ kʋʋ bal, dɩ ʋ daaliimiŋ wuo hɛ ba dɔnsʋŋ lɛ dɩ ba duori.

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Nɩaa ma yʋga a lɩɩ tabiisi-la sɩ kpagɛ Jerusalɛm, a kɛŋ puwuoloo arɩ nɩalɩŋ jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ kɛnɛ a kaa kɔ ʋ teeŋ, ba kala duori. Ba to naasɩŋ dɔgɩsɛ Yesu nanzɔɔba

english_verse: The high priest and all the other Sadducees who were with him became jealous.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ arɩ ʋ harɩŋ nɩaa sii. Ʋ harɩŋ nɩalɩŋ kala hɛ Saduusi tɩŋŋaa paatɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ nɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ba yaraa faasa bibieri.

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: Ba kɛsɛ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la kaa mʋ tɔ dɩa, lee-la ba sɩɩ tɔ ba nɩaa.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Ama tɩtaŋ-la tɩtɩa Wɩa tɩndaara kʋbala kʋ kɛŋ dɩa-la boiŋ-niiree suri, a leŋ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la lɩɩ. Ka ʋ bʋla pɩba,

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: “Má mʋ jʋʋ chɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ a chaasa bʋl wombii-falɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa pɩ nɩaa.”

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Yesu nanzɔɔba-la sɛɩ. Sɩɩpʋʋraa ba jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a suomo dɩdagɛ nɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ arɩ ʋ harɩŋ nɩaa kɔ, a yɩrɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa, ba kala kʋ hilimi aŋ tɩŋ dɩ ba mʋ dɩa-la lɛ ba sɩ tɔ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la a chaarɛba kaa kɔ.

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Tɩntɩnnɩ hɩasɩ-la sɩ mʋa, ba bɩ ba na nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa-la lɛ. Ba mɩɩra kʋ bʋl,

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: “La sɩ mʋ dɩa-la lɛ ba sɩ tɔba, la na dɩ ba yaga, nʋʋkala bɩ suro, ka nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ dɩa-la, ba ma chɩŋ boiŋ niiŋ. Ama la mʋ suri, la bɩ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la na.”

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la nɩhɩaŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ kperiba kɩŋkɛŋ, ba bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal kʋbala kʋ jʋʋ a bʋla pɩba, “Má bee na, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa, ba nɛ chɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ a dɩdagɛ nɩaa.”

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la nɩhɩaŋ arɩ ʋ nɩaa mʋ kɛsɛ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la kaa kɔ. Ba bɩ ba fʋga, bɛɛ wɩaa fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛmba nɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ jaŋ paa tabɩaa yagɛba.

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la kʋ jʋʋ, a leŋ ba chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa sɩpaaŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ bʋla pɩba,

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: “La bʋla pɩma arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ: Má bɩra sɩ́ wɩɩkala dagʋ Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Ama ma bee na, ma kɛŋ wɩɩ-la kaa gaara cheŋ Jerusalɛm kala aa chɛ ma joŋ cheeriŋ pɩla a tɩŋ baala deeŋ sʋʋŋ wɩaa.”

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta arɩ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la dɔnsʋŋ mɩɩra bʋla pɩba, “Ʋ maga dɩ la to Wɩa niiŋ nɛ a kɩɩ nuhuobiine niiŋ.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: La naabalɩmaba faa to Wɩa nɛ, ʋ nɛ chɩsɛ Yesu sʋʋŋ lɛ, nɩɩ-la ma fa sɩ kaa kpaasɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: Wɩa chɩsʋ ʋ sii jɩla hɔŋ Wɩa nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ, dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba Sɩpaalaara arɩ ba Laataara, a leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, ka dɩ ʋ joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: La pɛ na wɩaa deemba nɛ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma, Wɩa sɩ joŋo hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ʋ niiŋ ma ŋaa pɛ-naaraa.”

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ba faasa na baanɩŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba kpʋba.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Farisii tɩɩna kʋbala ma nɛ fa hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa tʋɔŋ baa yɩrɛ Gamalɩɛl. Ʋ nɛ faa dagɛ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto. Nʋʋkala zizilu. Ʋ sii chɩŋ a bʋl dɩ ba leŋ dɩ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la lɩɩ dɩ-jalɩŋ mʋapɩlɩɩ.

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma Iziral tɩmma, má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa arɩ wɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ bɩɩnɛ dɩ ma ŋaa nɩaa deemba lɛ.

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ, baal kʋbala ma lɩɩ, bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ dɩɩsɛ nɩaa, baa yɩrɛ Judas, a lɩɩ Galilii. Ʋ fa kɛsɛ nɩ-daŋ nɛ a kaa to ʋ harɩŋ, ba kpʋʋ ma, nɩ-daŋ-la ma sɩɩ to ʋ harɩŋ, ba ma pɩsɛ.

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: Ka lɛɛlɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ ma sɩ́ wɩɩkala ŋaa nɩaa deemba lɛ. Má lemba. Dɩ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ lɩɩ nuhuobiine doluŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ jaŋ lɛl.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: Ama dɩ Wɩa tɩntɩmɩɩ nɛ, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo cheyu. Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma cheyu, ma jaŋ na dɩ Wɩa nɛ ma paala yuyuo ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jegile nɩɩ ʋ niiŋ. Ba yɩrɛ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la ba kʋ jʋʋ, a ŋaa ba vɩɩrɛba, aŋ bʋla pɩba dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ wɩaa bʋl Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ, aŋ leŋ ba viiri.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hilime teeŋ. Ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ arɩ ba sɩ dɔgɩsɛba a tɩŋ Yesu wɩaa.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-na kala ba yie jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a pɛɛ mʋ nɩaa dɩɩsɩŋ, a ha bʋbʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a mʋ tɩgɛ Yesu Kirisito lɛ.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la kʋ pʋŋa yʋgɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tʋɔŋ Giriik tɩŋŋaa suomo nyɩnyaŋ Hiburu tɩŋŋaa. Ba bʋla arɩ ba sɩ yie joŋ moribie-la a pɩpɩ yo-haalaa tapʋlɩɩ kala, ba yie bee kikieli ba-na yo-haalaa nɛ.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la fii arɩ balɩa yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hilimi, a bʋla pɩba, “Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ la bibeŋ moribiee wɩaa aŋ ka Wɩa wɩaa ta.

english_verse: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, má lɩɩsɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɩaa balɩpɛ ma sɩ jɩma dɩ nɩaa ka zilba, ka Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ba lɛ aŋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ ma, dɩ la joŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: Ka dɩ la-na joŋ la nyuŋ kala hɛ aa chʋɔlɛ Wɩa aŋ pɛ bʋbʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa.”

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la sɩ bʋla. Ba lɩɩsɛ baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ. Ʋ fa ŋaa baal-la sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ woruŋ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma hɛ ʋ lɛ. Ba bɩra lɩɩsɛ Fɩlɩp arɩ Pʋrɔkɔrʋs arɩ Nɩkanɔ arɩ Tɩmɔŋ arɩ Paamɩnas arɩ Nɩkɔlas. Nɩkɔlas lɩɩ Antɩɔk nɛ. Ʋ fa bɩ Juu tɩɩna ŋaa aŋ tuto Juu tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ wombiiŋ.

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ balɩpɛ-la ba sɩ lɩɩsa a kaa mʋ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la sɩpaaŋ. Ba chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩba aŋ joŋ ba nɩsaa daŋ ba lɛ. Ba kɛŋ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa ha gaara su lee-la kala. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii pʋŋ woruŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa yʋga a ma sɛɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people.
translation_verse: Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ, a wuo ŋɩŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ arɩ wʋmagɩlaa nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, a ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa a lɩɩ Siriini, arɩ Alɛkɩzandɩrɩa. Ba fa lɩɩ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa-la ba fa sɩɩ yɩrɛ ‘yosuŋ ba sɩ joŋo ta’. Dɔnsʋŋ ma fa ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa a ma lɩɩ Siliisia arɩ Esia. Ba lɩɩ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ harɩŋ a kɛŋ wɩaa lɩlɛrɛ.

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ fa pɩ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ woruŋ nɩalɩŋ bɩ ʋ wuo pagɩsɛ.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lʋara hɛ nɩaa, ba bʋl, “La nɩa dɩ ʋʋ chei Mosis arɩ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Ba bʋl ŋɩɩ a nyɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ arɩ nɩhɩasɩ-la arɩ Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba hɛ. Ba baanɩŋ sii Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ nyuŋ. Ba kɛnʋ kaa mʋ nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa teeŋ.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ nɩaa kaa kɔ dɩ ba kʋ nyɩɛ wɩaa pʋ a bʋl, “Baala deeŋ yie vɛnɛɛ bʋl wɩaa aa chei Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la ba sɩ joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, arɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto nɛ.

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: La nɩa dɩ ʋ sɩ dɩ Yesu deeŋ sɩ lɩɩ Nazarɛt jaŋ yigi Wɩa dɩa-la lo, aŋ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ dagɛ la naabalɩmaba dɩ ba tuto a kaa bɩrɩmɛ.”

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ hilimi lee-la chaarɛ sɩaa a pɛ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ lɛ. Ba na dɩ ʋ sɩaa nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaara sɩaa.

english_verse: The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ pɩɛsɛ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ, “Wɩaa deemba ba sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.
translation_verse: Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ bʋl, “Mɩ nyɩmmaba arɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ tʋla fa kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ la naabalɩma Abɩraham, bʋa-la lɛ ʋ fa sɩ hɔŋ Mesopotemia tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ, dɩ ʋ ha bɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Haraŋ lɛ mʋ hɔŋ.

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: Wɩa fa bʋla pʋ, ‘Lɩɩ ŋ tinteeŋ lɛ, a leŋ ŋ nɩaa, aŋ mʋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ dagɩŋ.’

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sii lɩɩ Kalidiya tinteeŋ lɛ a mʋ hɔŋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Haraŋ lɛ. Nɩmɛ nɛ Abɩraham nyɩmma sʋʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa leŋ ʋ sii lee-la a kɔ tinteeŋ deeŋ ma nɩaa deemba sɩ hɔnɔ lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa bɩ lee-la kere pɩ Abɩraham a yi naakieliŋ kʋbala ma, dɩ ʋ ŋaa ʋ kʋŋ, ama Wɩa fa bʋla pʋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ tintee-la a pɩ ʋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Abɩraham fa bɩ bii lʋla.

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa fa bʋla pʋ, ‘Ŋ doho nɩaa jaŋ ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa tinteeŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a bɩrɩmɛ yosuŋ. Ba jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba woruŋ jɩsɩŋ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ.

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Ama mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ tinteye-la nɩaa ba sɩ tɩma pa a nagɛ yosi. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ ba jaŋ lɩɩ lee-la, a bɩra kɔ daha a chʋchʋɔlɛmɛ.’

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bil niiŋ ʋ dɩ Abɩraham pɛgɛ. Ʋ magɩlɩŋ nɛ, dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa kikeri ba penee. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩraham lʋl Aɩzɩk. Tapʋl-chorimuŋ chɛɛŋ ʋ keri ʋ peniŋ. Aɩzɩk ma lʋl Jekɔb a keri ʋ peniŋ. Jekɔb ma lʋl biiriŋ fii arɩ balɩa a keri ba penee, ba nɛ kʋ ŋaa la naabalɩmaba.

english_verse: These men were our ancestors. Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Josɛf. Kʋkaana-la yaraa bibieri ʋ nyuŋ, ba kɛnʋ kaa yalla pɩ baala kʋbalaba a nagɛ yomo. Ba kɛnʋ kaa mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ. Ama Wɩa fa pɛ ʋ lɛ woruŋ

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: a lɩɩsʋ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ fa sɩ jʋa lɛ. Ʋ fa sɩ mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro sɩpaaŋ, Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ ʋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, kuoro chou a leŋ ʋ ŋaa ʋ tinteeŋ kʋhɩaŋ a bibeŋ ʋ tinteeŋ arɩ ʋ kuoru-dɩa kala.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ losuŋ kʋ jʋʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ arɩ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ kala. Losuŋ kpʋ nɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ, la naabalɩmaba bɩ kʋdiilee wuo na.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Jekɔb sɩ nɩa arɩ kʋdiilee hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ tɩŋ ʋ biiriŋ, la naabalɩmaba-la, dɩ ba mʋ nɩmɛ yɔɔ kaa kɔ. Ba bumbuŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: Jekɔb biiriŋ mɩɩra mʋ Ijipiti lɩamɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba yɔɔ kʋdiilee. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josɛf kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa dagɛba, aŋ kɛmba ma dagɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jekɔb sii a mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ sɩ ŋaa la naabalɩmaba kala sʋʋ.

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: Ba mɩɩra kɛmba kaa mʋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ a hugiba lee kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Sɛkɛm. Ba hugiba bʋa kʋbala lɛ Abɩraham fa sɩ yɔbɔ Hamɔ nɩaa teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa sɩ ka mʋa, ka dɩ wɩɩ-la Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pɩ Abɩraham kʋ ŋaa, bʋa-la lɛ Jekɔb doho nɩaa fa pʋŋa nɛ woruŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: Kuoru-la fa sɩ jɩŋ Josɛf sʋʋ, aŋ ka nɩ-tanɩɩ dii kuoruŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ fa bɩ Josɛf wɩaa jɩŋ.

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: Ʋ nyɩsɛ nɩaa a wʋrɩgɛ la nɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ, a fʋgɛ la naabalɩmaba dɩ ba joŋ ba bii-mulluŋ kaa lɩɩ ta dɩ ba sʋʋ.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ ba fa lʋl Mosis. Ʋ fa ŋaa bii-zɔŋ-bie nɛ woruŋ. Ba benu ʋ nyɩmma dɩa lɛ chɛnsɩŋ batori, aŋ ka ba joŋu kaa lɩɩ ta.

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: Ba fa sɩ joŋu kaa lɩɩ ta ŋɩɩ, Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro tolo kʋ joŋu, a dɩɛsʋ a nagɛ ʋ bii-lʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: Ba dagʋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa wʋjɩmɩŋ kala. Ʋ wʋŋaalaa arɩ ʋ wʋbʋlaa leŋ ʋ ŋaa nɩbal.

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mʋ nɩmɛ, ʋ na Ijipiti tɩɩna dɩ ʋʋ dɔgɩsɛ Iziral nɩaa dɔŋɔ. Ʋ mʋ lɩɩ paa Iziral tɩɩna-la tʋɔrʋŋ, a kpʋ Ijipiti tɩɩna-la.

english_verse: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
translation_verse: Mosis fa bɩɩna arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa chɛ dɩ ʋ nɛ laaba ta, ama ba fa bɩ wuo jɩŋ.

english_verse: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, ʋ na dɩ Iziral nɩaa balɩa, ka yuo dɔŋɔ. Ʋ mʋ dɩ ʋ kɛmba hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a bʋl, ‘Ma ŋaa naambiiri nɛ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma gʋra dʋdɔgɩsɛ dɔŋɔ?’

english_verse: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge?
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la fa sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna-la kɛŋ Mosis yige ta aŋ bʋl, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ sɩ ŋ bibenla a laa la wɩaa jɩjɩŋ?

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: Ŋ chɛ dɩ ŋ kpʋ mɩ ma, arɩ ŋ dɩa sɩ kpʋ Ijipiti tɩɩna-la ŋɩɩ nɛɛ?’

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ lɩɩ fá Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a mʋ ŋaa nʋhʋɔrʋ Midiaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ nɛ a jaa haala, a lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa.

english_verse: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
translation_verse: Mosis fa sɩ na ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaaʋ wʋkpuŋkpere. Ʋ mʋ yi dɩ ʋ na tɩɩ-pugubie-la, a nɩɩ La Tɩɩna yikoro. Ʋ bʋla pɩ Mosis,

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
translation_verse: ‘Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ŋ naabalɩmaba Abɩraham arɩ Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb Wɩa.’ Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, Mosis chɩna chichel. Ʋ bɩra bɩ wuo bibeŋ.” Ba yagɛ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ arɩ tabɩaa

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ bɩra bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna fa bʋla pɩ Mosis, ‘Chaarɛ ŋ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ ŋ naasɩŋ lɛ. Tintee-la lɛ ŋ sɩ chɩna ŋaa lee sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: Mɩ na ba sɩɩ wʋrɩgɛ mɩ nɩaa ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, a nɩɩ ba sɩɩ yel ma, a kʋ tuu dɩ mɩ laaba ta. Sii lɛɛlɛ, dɩ mɩ tɩmɩŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩra mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ.’ ”

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ bɩra suomo bʋbʋl, “Mosis deeŋ nɛ ba vɩa aŋ pɩɛsʋ, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa ŋ bibenla a laa la wɩaa jɩjɩŋ?’ Ʋ nɛ Wɩa tɩŋ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋhɩaŋ arɩ ba laataara. Wɩa nɛ to ʋ tɩndaarʋ-la fa sɩ kʋ lɩɩ Mosis teeŋ a nagɛ tɩɩ-bie-la sɩ dii nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ, a pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ laa ʋ nɩaa ta.

english_verse: In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for
translation_verse: Mosis ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, aŋ-na kɛsɛ ʋ nɩaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tʋɔŋ. Ʋ fa ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ nɛ mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ arɩ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ ba sɩ baara jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: Mosis deeŋ nɛ fa bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ‘Wɩa jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ ma tʋɔŋ a pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ʋ wʋlaabʋllʋ a nagɛ mɩ-na Mosis.’ ”

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ bɩra suomo bʋbʋl, “Mosis arɩ la naabalɩmaba nɛ fa hilimi tintee-hɩlɩŋ tʋɔŋ. Nɩmɛ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaara fa bʋl wɩaa pʋ peel kʋbala nyuŋ baa yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ lɛ. Ʋ joŋ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ pʋ dɩ ʋ laa bʋla pɩla.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: Ama La naabalɩmaba vɩa Mosis niiŋ nɛ aŋ joŋ ba harɩŋ yɩaʋ, ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala fa cho dɩ ba fa mɩɩra mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ ba mɛ vene ʋ nagɛ nɛ-bie a kpaarʋ. Ba gbieli a zil kʋ-la ba tɩtɩa sɩ mɛ.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Wɩa joŋ harɩŋ yɩaba, a lemba ta ba chʋchʋɔlɛ chɛnwʋlaa arɩ chɛnɛ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ ŋmʋnsa. Ba ŋmʋnsa arɩ Wɩa sɩ, ‘Ma Iziral tɩmma, bʋa-la lɛ ma fa sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa-la, mɩ-na dee ma fa kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pa.

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Ma vesiŋ nɛ ma kpʋkpaarɛ. Ma vene ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk, ʋ lɛbɩŋ nɛ ma kaa chʋŋaa vɛŋ, a chʋŋ ma chɛnwʋlʋŋ vene ma, vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Refaŋ ʋ magɩlɩŋ nɛ. Kɩaa deemba nɛ ma mɛ a chʋchʋɔlɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ leŋ ba kɛmma kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga dɩ-bolii, a kieli Babɩlɔŋ.’ ”

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ bɩra bʋl, “La naabalɩmaba fa sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ tʋɔŋ, ba kɛŋ lɛbɩ-la ba fa sɩ hɛ pɩ Wɩa nɛ. Wɩa nɛ fa dagɛ Mosis lɛbɩ-la nagɩŋ ʋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ, la naabalɩmaba laa lɛbɩŋ deeŋ ba nyɩmmaba teeŋ. Ba dɩ Josua kaa jʋʋ tintee-la nɩaa Wɩa fa sɩ kire ta. Wɩa Lɛbɩ-la fa hɛ ba teeŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ deeŋ deeŋ a kʋ yi la naabalɩma Devit kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɩa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ Devit nyuŋ, ʋ sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ʋ saa dɩjʋʋlʋŋ pɩ ʋ-na Wɩa sɩ ŋaa ʋ naabalɩma Jekɔb Wɩa.

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: Ama Solomoŋ nɛ mɩɩra saa dɩa-la pʋ.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: Ka Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala, bɩ dɩɩsɩ-la nuhuobiinee sɩ saa ka jʋʋ. Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa dɔŋɔ nɛ fa sɩ,

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: ‘Wɩa sɩ, Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ mɩ kuoru kpasa, ka tinteeŋ ma ŋaa mɩ naasɩŋ dɩ-daŋɩŋ. Dɩɩ bɛɛ doho nɛ saa ma jaŋ wuo saa pɩmɛ? Mɩ dɩ-wiesiŋ hɛ nɩɩ?

english_verse: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa kʋŋkala tuo ma naabalɩmaba sɩ bɩ naasɩŋ to dɔgɩsɛ. Ba fa paala kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl dɩ Wɩa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna jaŋ kɔ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ lɛɛlɛ ma joŋo yallɛ ba kpʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it. Stephen Is Stoned to Death
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaaraa joŋ Wɩa wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto pɩma nɛ, ama ma bɩ ʋ to.”

english_verse: When the council members heard Stephen's speech, they were angry and furious.
translation_verse: Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ, nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa nɩɩ, ba baanɩŋ faasa sii ʋ nyuŋ, ba dɩdɩŋ ba nyɩlaa.

english_verse: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ faasa hɛ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ lɛ yʋgɛ. Ʋ wʋla beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ a na Wɩa tʋla, a na Yesu ma dɩ ʋ hɔŋ Wɩa nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ bʋl, “Má bee na, mɩ na Wɩa-jaŋ boiŋ niiŋ dɩ ʋ suro, ka Nuhuobiine Bie hɔŋ Wɩa nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ.”

english_verse: The council members shouted and covered their ears. At once they all attacked Stephen
translation_verse: Ka ba faasa ŋaa goŋ a tɔ ba dɩgɩlaa, a kala guu mʋ ʋ lɛ,

english_verse: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation_verse: a kɛnʋ yige ta ʋ lɩɩ ba jaŋ lɛ, aŋ paa tabɩaa yɩyagʋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yagɛ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ fa joŋ ba gɛnnɩŋ a pɩ bapʋɔsɩ-bie kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Sɔɔl nɛ, ʋ bibeŋ.

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: Baa yagɛ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ arɩ tabɩaa, ka ʋ yɩrɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu a sʋlʋ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna Yesu, laamɛ kaa mʋ ŋ teeŋ.”

english_verse: He knelt down and shouted, “Lord, don't blame them for what they have done.” Then he died.
translation_verse: Ʋ tuu kpirimi a faasa ŋmoo niiŋ a bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna Yesu, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, sɩ́ wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ ba sɩ ŋaa chɩmɩŋ joŋo tiŋ ba lɛ.” Ʋ fa bʋl ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail. The Good News Is Preached in Samaria
translation_verse: Sɔɔl faa chɛ dɩ ʋ pugi nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, a to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛba. Ʋ to dii-niiriŋ a kɛsɛ baalaa arɩ haala-la sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, a lɛrɛba lɩɩ ba dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, aŋ leŋ ba kɛmba kaa mʋ tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa.

english_verse: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ pɩsa, ba mʋ gɔllɛ lee-kala a bʋbʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩp sii mʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Samarɩa, a bʋl Kirisito wɩaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ-la kala sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Fɩlɩp sɩ bʋla a na ʋ wʋmagɩla-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa, ba kala joŋ ba nyuŋ hɛ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl lɛ.

english_verse: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩp sɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ, jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ fa kɛŋ nɩaa a yʋgɛ, ba lemba. Dɩ ba nɛ lemba, ba yie lɩɩ a faasa yiyel. Nɩaa ma yʋga a gbɛrɩgɛ, dɔnsʋŋ kɛŋ naasʋʋnʋŋ arɩ na-sʋʋnʋŋ, ba ma kala duori.

english_verse: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.
translation_verse: Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa kala tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ.

english_verse: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.
translation_verse: Taŋ-la lɛ baal kʋbala ma nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, baa yɩrɛ Saamɔŋ. Ʋ fa kɛŋ daalusuŋ nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ taŋ-la lɛ nɩaa nɩna, a dɩdagɛ arɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, “This man is the power of God called ‘The Great Power.’ ”
translation_verse: Nɩbalaa arɩ nɩbiisiŋ kala joŋ ba nyuŋ hɛ ʋ wʋŋaalaa lɛ a bʋl, “Baala deeŋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa. Ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ, dol-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Wɩa dol-balɩŋ.”

english_verse: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ deemba nɩaa na ʋ diene, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ nɩaa joŋ ba nyuŋ kala hɛ ʋ wʋŋaalaa lɛ.

english_verse: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.
translation_verse: Ama Fɩlɩp sɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a tɩgɛ Wɩa kuorii-la lɛ, a bʋl Yesu Kirisito ma wɩaa, ba laa wɩalɩŋ dii, ba foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, baalaa arɩ haalaa kala.

english_verse: Even Simon believed and was baptized. He stayed close to Philip, because he marveled at all the miracles and wonders.
translation_verse: Saamɔŋ tɩtɩa kʋ laa wɩalɩŋ dii, ba fou ma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, ka ʋ mɛrɛ Fɩlɩp lɛ. Ʋ sɩ na wʋkpuŋkperisi-la arɩ wʋmagɩlaa Fɩlɩp sɩɩ ŋaa, ʋ ŋaaʋ wʋkpuŋkpere.

english_verse: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.
translation_verse: Yesu nanzɔɔba-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ aŋ nɩɩ arɩ Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tɩŋ Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ dɩ ba mʋ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ba mʋ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩba dɩ Wɩa joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ pɩba,

english_verse: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ha bɩ ba kʋŋkala lɛ hɛ. La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ dʋndʋŋa lɛ nɛ ba fa foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ joŋ ba nɩsaa daŋ ba lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ tuu hɛba lɛ.

english_verse: Simon noticed that the Spirit was given only when the apostles placed their hands on the people. So he brought money
translation_verse: Saamɔŋ sɩ na dɩ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la joŋ ba nɩsaa daŋ ba lɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ hɛ ba lɛ, ʋ joŋ moribiee pɩba,

english_verse: and said to Peter and John, “Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: aŋ bʋl, “Má pɩmɛ ma doluŋ deeŋ dɩ mɩ ma nɛ joŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ daŋ nʋʋkala lɛ, dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ hɛ tɩɩna lɛ.”

english_verse: Peter said to him, “You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ bɩɩna ŋ jaŋ wuo joŋ moribiee yɔɔ Wɩa sɩ joŋ kʋa dii zile nɩaa lɛɛ? Ŋ dɩ ŋ moribiee kala jaŋ jʋʋ nyiniŋ.

english_verse: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ toru kala kɛnɛ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ lɛ. Ŋ bɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ pʋlla Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: Get rid of these evil thoughts and ask God to forgive you.
translation_verse: Bɩrɩma lɩɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ lɛ, aŋ sʋl La Tɩɩna Wɩa dɩ ʋ joŋ ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa deemba ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a chɛŋ.

english_verse: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.”
translation_verse: Mɩ na dɩ ŋ kɛŋ yarɩ-bieri kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma mɩlɩŋ kpɛrɛ.”

english_verse: Simon said, “Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Saamɔŋ bʋl, “Má chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩmɛ dɩ wɩaa deemba kala ma sɩ bʋla sɩ́ mɩ lɛ ŋaa.”

english_verse: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria. Philip and an Ethiopian Official
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bʋl La Tɩɩna Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa pɩba dɛrɛ, ba sii dɩ ba mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm. Ba sɩɩ mʋ Jerusalɛm ŋɩɩ, ba bʋl Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la Samarɩa tinteeŋ tabiisiŋ ma lɛ a yʋgɛ. Fɩlɩp cheŋ baal-la sɩ lɩɩ Itoopia tinteeŋ

english_verse: The Lord's angel said to Philip, “Go south along the desert road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa tɩndaarʋ kʋbala kʋ bʋla pɩ Fɩlɩp, “Sii mʋ taŋ-bʋbʋɔŋ a mʋ wombii-bɩnɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm a mʋmʋ Gaza.”

english_verse: So Philip left. An important Ethiopian official happened to be going along that road in his chariot. He was the chief treasurer for Candace, the Queen of Ethiopia. The official had gone to Jerusalem to worship
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ lɩa dɩ ʋ mʋ, ʋ cheŋ baal kʋbala dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Itoopia tinteeŋ. Ʋ ŋaa bafere nɛ a tɩma pɩpɩ Itoopia kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kandaasɩ. Kandaasɩ fa ŋaa haal nɛ. Ba-fere-la nɛ faa beŋ ʋ kɩaa kala. Ʋ fa mʋ Jerusalɛm nɛ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa aŋ hɔŋ ʋ toruko nyuŋ,

english_verse: and was now on his way home. He was sitting in his chariot, reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.
translation_verse: a mɩɩra mʋmʋ dɩa. Ʋ fa sɩɩ vɛŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɩkarɩmɛ Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ, Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Azaaya sɩ ŋmʋnsa.

english_verse: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ bʋla pɩ Fɩlɩp, “Mʋ a chɩna kpagɛ toruko-la.”

english_verse: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation_verse: Fɩlɩp fá mʋ kpagʋ a nɩɩ dɩ ʋʋ karɩmɛ Wɩa teŋ-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Azaaya fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa. Fɩlɩp pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ karɩmʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: The official answered, “How can I understand unless someone helps me?” He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ, see dɩ nʋʋ dagɛmɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ yɩrɛ Fɩlɩp dɩ ʋ jɩla hɔnɔ pɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: The man was reading the passage that said, “He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.
translation_verse: Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ bafere-la fa sɩɩ karɩmʋ nɛ ŋ-la: “Ʋ tɔrɛ ʋ niiŋ a nagɛ piese ba sɩ kaa mʋ dɩ ba kpʋ, a bɩra nagɛ pie-bie ma sɩ tɔrɛ ʋ niiŋ, ka ba kɩkɛ ʋ pʋnaa nɛ. Ʋ bɩ ʋ niiŋ suro.

english_verse: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away?”
translation_verse: Ba hɩɩsʋ nɛ, a kpaa kʋsɩŋŋaa vɔmʋ. Nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ doho naasɩŋ wuo to, bɛɛ wɩaa ba lɩɩsɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: The official said to Philip, “Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ bafere-la pɩɛsɛ Fɩlɩp, “Kʋbɛɛ wɩaa nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ? Ʋ tɩtɩa wɩaa nɛ koo nʋʋ ma dɔŋ wɩaa nɛ?”

english_verse: So Philip began at this place in the Scriptures and explained the good news about Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɩlɩp suomi Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa teniŋ sɛmpɛɛ-la tɩtɩa lɛ, a bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ.

english_verse: As they were going along the road, they came to a place where there was some water. The official said, “Look! Here is some water. Why can't I be baptized?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɩlɩp bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ laa Yesu wɩaa dii arɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ kala, mɩ jaŋ foŋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ baal-la bʋl, “Mɩ laa dii arɩ Yesu Kirisito nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie.”

english_verse: He ordered the chariot to stop. Then they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ bafere-la ŋaa janɩ-la fa sɩɩ lɛrɛ toruko-la chɩŋ. Ʋ dɩ Fɩlɩp kala tuu a jʋʋ lɩɩ-la. Fɩlɩp fou Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kʋ lɩɩ lɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ, La Tɩɩna Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ guu kʋ joŋ Fɩlɩp kaa lɛl. Baal-la bɩra bɩ Fɩlɩp na aŋ joŋ ʋ wombiiŋ vɩvɛŋ, a kala ŋaa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.
translation_verse: Fɩlɩp ŋaa dɩ ʋ chɩŋ dɩ ʋ hɛ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Azotus lɛ. Ʋ gɔllɛ tabiisi-la kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a bʋbʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Sɩzarɩya.

english_verse: Saul preached with such power that he completely confused the Jewish people in Damascus, as he tried to show them that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl fa sɩɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ wasa kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩ bumbuŋ-la. Ʋ wuo dagɛ arɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa. Ʋ paala faasa bʋl ŋɩɩ, Juu tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ, ba nandaasɩŋ kala yʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: Now get up and go into the city, where you will be told what to do.”
translation_verse: Sii jʋʋ tabal-la tʋɔŋ. Nɩmɛ ba jaŋ dagɩŋ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.”
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ jaŋ dagʋ hɛɛŋ magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ na a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa.”

english_verse: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sɩ mʋ Jerusalɛm, ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ jʋʋ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la tʋɔŋ. Ba bɩ laa dii arɩ ʋ ŋaa Yesu harɩ-tooru nɛ. Ba fɩfáʋ.

english_verse: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Yesu bɩra bʋla pɩ Ananɩas, “Sɔɔl sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa ŋɩɩ, ʋ na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ, ŋ-na Ananɩas, dɩ ŋ kʋ jʋʋ a joŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ sɩaa bɩra suri.”

english_verse: Suddenly something like fish scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see. He got up and was baptized.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, dɩ kɩaa nagɛ chenfiliŋ kerikee guu lɩɩ Sɔɔl sɩaa lɛ a tel, ka ʋ bɩra wuo nɩna. Ʋ sii, ba fou Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Saul kept on threatening to kill the Lord's followers. He even went to the high priest
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl ha fufugisi La Tɩɩna Yesu harɩ-tooro-la arɩ ʋ jaŋ kpʋba, a sii mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ teeŋ,

english_verse: and asked for letters to the leaders of the synagogues in Damascus. He did this because he wanted to arrest and take to Jerusalem any man or woman who had accepted the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: a sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ pʋ dɩ ʋ kaa mʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Damasɩkʋs a kpaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ nɛ na nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ to wombii-la nɩmɛ, baal koo haal, dɩ ʋ wuo kɛŋ doluŋ a kɛsɛba kaa kɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: When Saul had almost reached Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl sɩ lɩɩ joŋ wombiiŋ a mʋmʋ Damasɩkʋs a kʋ kpagɛ taŋ-la, pʋlʋmʋŋ guu lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a faasa chaana hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, “Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: Ʋ tuu tel tinteeŋ. Ka ʋ nɩɩ nʋʋ yikoro. Ʋʋ bʋl ʋ teeŋ, “Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ to naasɩŋ a dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ ŋ-la?”

english_verse: “Who are you?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus,” the Lord answered. “I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɔɔl pɩɛsɛ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ tɩɩna?” Yikoro-la bʋl, “Mɩ nɛ ŋaa Yesu, nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ to naasɩŋ a dʋdɔgɩsɛ.

english_verse: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl arɩ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ vɛŋ chɩna tʋa-bibeŋ, ba nɩɩ yikoro-la, ama ba bɩ nʋʋkala na.

english_verse: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus,
translation_verse: Sɔɔl nyaga sii a suri ʋ sɩaa. Ʋ bɩ kʋŋkala wuo na. Ba kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ a lɛrɛ jʋʋ Damasɩkʋs.

english_verse: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.
translation_verse: Ʋ nyʋlɩmɛ a hɛ nɩmɛ ʋ tapʋlaa batori. Ʋ bɩ kʋŋkala die, ʋ bɩ lɩɩŋ ma nyʋa.

english_verse: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, “Lord, here I am.”
translation_verse: Yesu harɩ-tooru kʋbala ma fa hɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ, baa yɩrɛ Ananɩas. La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrʋ a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Ananɩas!” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sɩ, “Namɛ, mɩ Tɩɩna.”

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu bʋla pʋ, “Sii mʋ wombii-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ wombii-tegi tegi a mʋ baal kʋbala dɩa ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Judas, a pɩɛsɛ chɛ baal-la sɩ lɩɩ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Taasɩs. Baal-la yɩrɩŋ nɛ Sɔɔl, ʋʋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa nɛ lɛɛlɛ ŋ-la.”

english_verse: Ananias replied, “Lord, a lot of people have told me about the terrible things this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ananɩas bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, nɩaa yʋga kɩŋkɛŋ a bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ baala deeŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋ nɩaa sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ pʋ doluŋ taŋ deeŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ chʋɔlʋŋ vɔɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Ananias, “Go! I have chosen him to tell foreigners, kings, and the people of Israel about me.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Yesu bʋla pɩ Ananɩas, “Sii mʋ, mɩ nɛ lɩɩsʋ dɩ ʋ tɩma pɩpɩmɛ. Ʋ jaŋ mʋ bʋl mɩ wɩaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, arɩ ba kuoroo, arɩ Iziral nɩaa teeŋ.

english_verse: Ananias left and went into the house where Saul was staying. Ananias placed his hands on him and said, “Saul, the Lord Jesus has sent me. He is the same one who appeared to you along the road. He wants you to be able to see and to be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ananɩas sii mʋ dɩa-la Sɔɔl sɩ jʋa. Ʋ jʋʋ a joŋ ʋ nɩsaa daŋ Sɔɔl lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ naambie Sɔɔl, La Tɩɩna Yesu-la ŋ sɩ na wombiiŋ lɛ ŋ sɩɩ kɔ daha, ʋ nɛ tɩmmɛ. Ʋ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ kɔ dɩ ŋ sɩaa wuo suri, ka dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma hɛŋ lɛ.” Sɔɔl bʋl Wɩa wɩaa a pɩ nɩaa Damasɩkʋs lɛ

english_verse: Then he ate and felt much better. Saul Preaches in Damascus For several days Saul stayed with the Lord's followers in Damascus.
translation_verse: Ʋ dii kɩaa a bɩra dol. Ʋ hɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ a jʋʋ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la sɩ hɛ Damasɩkʋs tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: Soon he went to the synagogues and started telling people that Jesus is the Son of God.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, ʋ guu sii mʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ a suomo bʋbʋl Yesu wɩaa a pɩpɩ nɩaa, a bʋl dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie.

english_verse: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests?”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla, ʋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere. Baa pɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ, “Baala deeŋ dee fa bɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ hɛ aa kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Yesu deeŋ ŋɩɩ? Ŋ-la wɩaa saa dee ʋ bɩra kɔ daha, dɩ ʋ kɛsɛba kaa mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ teeŋ?”

english_verse: Later some of them made plans to kill Saul,
translation_verse: Ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ a dieni, ŋɩɩ nɛ chɛɛ kʋbala Juu tɩŋŋaa vʋʋrɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ.

english_verse: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl kʋ nɩɩ. Ba yie pɔ taŋ-la boi-baalɩŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala nɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ. Sɔɔl hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ

english_verse: Then one night his followers let him down over the city wall in a large basket. Saul in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ kʋbala Sɔɔl harɩ-tooroo joŋu hɛ sime tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ vɔɔ, a lɛrʋ ʋ kieli jee-la a tuu jeeŋ harɩŋ, a lɩɩ mʋ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Yesu nanzɔɔba-la dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Banabas nɛ pɛ ʋ lɛ a kɛnʋ kaa mʋ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la teeŋ. Ʋ nɛ bʋla pɩba ŋɩɩ Sɔɔl sɩ na La Tɩɩna Yesu wombiiŋ lɛ, La Tɩɩna bʋl wɩaa pʋ. Banabas nɛ saa bɩra bʋla pɩba ŋɩɩ Sɔɔl sɩ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a bʋl Yesu wɩaa pɩ nɩaa Damasɩkʋs lɛ.

english_verse: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba sɛɩ Sɔɔl jʋʋ ba tʋɔŋ a gʋgɔllɛ ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ,

english_verse: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.
translation_verse: a bʋbʋl Wɩa wɩaa arɩ nyuduoŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ dɩ Juu tɩmma-la sɩɩ bʋl Giriik tɩŋŋaa wʋbʋlʋŋ, ba kɛŋ wɩaa lɩlɛrɛ. Ba wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ.

english_verse: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.
translation_verse: Ʋ naambiiri-la sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ba kɛnʋ kaa mʋ Sɩzarɩya a ŋaa ʋ mʋ Taasɩs.

english_verse: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow. Peter Heals Aeneas
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Judiya arɩ Galilii arɩ Samarɩa tinteeŋ lɛ kala na wiese, a wasa laa Wɩa dii, a to La Tɩɩna Yesu a fɩfáʋ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma pɛ ba lɛ. Ba pʋŋa pɛ. Pɩɩta mʋ Lida arɩ Jɔpa

english_verse: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta fa gɔllɛ leree kala nɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala ʋ sii mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lida dɩ ʋ na Wɩa nɩaa nɩmɛ.

english_verse: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mʋ nɩmɛ, ʋ na baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Anɩyas dɩ ʋ gbɛrɩgɛ pɩŋ dɩa lɛ jɩsɩŋ chori.

english_verse: Peter said to Aeneas, “Jesus Christ has healed you! Get up and make up your bed.” At once he stood up.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋla pʋ, “Anɩyas, Yesu Kirisito vaarɩŋ nɛ, sii chuoli ŋ bɔsɔ.” Ʋ guu sii a duori.

english_verse: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord. Peter Brings Dorcas Back to Life
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Lida arɩ Sarɔŋ lɛ a na wɩɩ-la, ba ma bɩrɩma to La Tɩɩna Yesu.

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Haal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ Jɔpa lɛ. Ʋ faa to Yesu nɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Tabɩta. Ʋ kɛŋ zile kɩŋkɛŋ a pɩpɛ summoo lɛ.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ wʋwɩɩlɛ a sʋʋ. Ba fou lɩɩŋ a kaa jɩla bil lusuŋ nyuŋ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Jɔpa arɩ Lida fa bɩ bol. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ Jɔpa lɛ nɩɩ arɩ Pɩɩta hɛ Lida lɛ. Ba tɩŋ nɩaa balɩa ʋ teeŋ dɩ ba sʋlʋ a bʋl, “Hɛ doluŋ aŋ kɔ la teeŋ lɩma lɩma.” Ba mʋ a bʋla pʋ.

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta sii to ba harɩŋ mʋ. Ʋ sɩ mʋ nɩmɛ, ba kɛnʋ jɩl lusuŋ nyuŋ dɩa-la. Yo-haalaa kala chɩna gollu a yiyel, a paa gɛrɩ-laalaa arɩ gɛrɩ-vɔbɩa-la Dɔkas sɩ yɛrɛ ʋ fa sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, a dɩdagɛ Pɩɩta.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta ŋaa ba kala lɩɩ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ. Ba sɩ lɩa, ʋ tuu kpirimi a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bɩrɩmɛ sʋʋ-la teeŋ a bʋl, “Tabɩta, sii.” Ʋ suri ʋ sɩaa. Ʋ sɩ na Pɩɩta, ʋ sii hɔŋ.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta mʋ yiu a kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ ʋ sii. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii arɩ yo-haala-la a joŋu pɩba. Ba kala naʋ dɩ ʋ bɩra weye.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ teeli Jɔpa kala nɛ. Nɩaa yʋgɛ a kʋ laa La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa dii.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta hɛ puri-tɩsɩrʋ kʋbala dɩa lɛ nɛ Jɔpa lɛ a dieni. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Saamɔŋ.

english_verse: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called “The Italian Unit.”
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ Sɩzarɩya lɛ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Kɔnɩɩlɩas. Ʋ fa ŋaa laalɩyuoro-la ba sɩ kaa kpaa zɔlɔ zɔlɔ ba dɔŋɔ kʋhɩaŋ nɛ, laalɩyuoro-la ba sɩ kaa yɩrɛ Ɩtalɩ laalɩyuoroo.

english_verse: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.
translation_verse: Ʋʋ fá Wɩa, ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala tuto Wɩa. Ʋ yie pɩpɛ summoo lɛ, a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa ma bʋa na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Wɩɩhɛyɛ kʋbala arɩ kerifi batori bʋa lɛ, Kɔnɩɩlɩas paala chaasa na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ dɩ Wɩa tɩndaara kʋbala kʋ jʋʋ a yɩrʋ, “Kɔnɩɩlɩas!”

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Ʋ chaarɛ sɩaa bibeŋ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la, fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ. Ʋ pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ mɩ Tɩɩna?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bʋla pʋ, “Wɩa nɩɩ ŋ sɩ yie chʋchʋɔlʋ ŋɩɩ nɛ a na ŋ sɩ yie pɩpɛ summo-la ma lɛ ŋɩɩ. A tɩŋ wɩaa deemba wɩaa ʋʋ liisi ŋ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Tɩŋ nɩaa lɛɛlɛ dɩ ba mʋ Jɔpa a chɛ yɩrɛ baal kʋbala dɩ ʋ kɔ ŋ teeŋ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta.

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: Ʋʋ jʋʋ puri-tɩsɩrʋ kʋbala dɩa nɛ, ʋ ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ Saamɔŋ. Ʋ dɩa kpagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ, ʋ mɩɩra viiri. Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ ka Kɔnɩɩlɩas yɩrɛ ʋ dɩa tɩntɩnnaa balɩa a pɛ laalɩyuoro kʋbala lɛ. Laalɩyuoru-la ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hʋhɔŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ a fɩfá Wɩa.

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: Kɔnɩɩlɩas fa bʋl wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ na nɛ a pɩba aŋ leŋ ba mʋ Jɔpa.

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, wɩa magɛ nyu-gbaŋa dɩ ba mʋ kpagɛ Jɔpa. Ba sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, Pɩɩta ma jɩl lusuŋ dɩ ʋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: Losuŋ fa kɛnʋ ʋ chɩchɛ kʋdiilee dɩ ʋ dii. Ba sii ŋɩŋaa kʋdiilee dɩ ba pʋ. Ba sɩɩ ŋaa kʋdiile-la ŋɩɩ, ʋ na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ

english_verse: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.
translation_verse: dɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kpaa. Ka kʋŋ nagɛ gɛrɩ-balɩŋ a lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ tuu tinteeŋ. Ba kɛŋ ʋ niipinee banɛsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Ka pʋŋ-dosunuŋ arɩ zaarɩ-dosunuŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ bɔyɛ tutuuri tinteeŋ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ nɩɩ nʋʋ yikoro dɩ ʋ bʋla pɩ Pɩɩta, “Pɩɩta, sii kpʋ a dii.”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Pɩɩta bʋl, “Aɩ, mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩ ha bɩ kʋ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ die.”

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Yikoro-la bɩra mɩɩra bʋla pʋ, “Kʋ-la kala Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ zɔmɔ, bɩra sɩ́ bʋl arɩ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: Ʋ na kɩaa deemba dɩ ba kʋ tuu naansɩɩŋ butori nɛ, aŋ mɩɩra guu jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la kperi Pɩɩta. Ʋ hɔnɔ kɛŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ na bʋbʋɔŋ bɩbɩɩnɛ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ Kɔnɩɩlɩas fa sɩ tɩma nɛ pɩɛsa kʋ chɩŋ Saamɔŋ boi-baalɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: and were asking if Simon Peter was staying there.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba yɩrɛ a pɩɛsɛ, “Baal kʋbala hɛ dɩa deeŋ tʋɔŋ baa yɩrɛ Saamɔŋ Pɩɩtaa?”

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta fa ha kɛŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ fa sɩ na a bɩbɩɩnɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ bʋla pʋ, “Bee na baalaa batori nɛ hɛ daha a chɩchɛŋ.

english_verse: Hurry down and go with them. Don't worry, I sent them.”
translation_verse: Sii tuu a sɩ́ logo logo ŋaa, aŋ to ba harɩŋ mʋ. Mɩ nɛ tɩmba ŋ teeŋ.”

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta sii tuu ba teeŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ chɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ ma kaa chɩchɛmɛ?”

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ kʋbala, baa yɩrɛ Kɔnɩɩlɩas nɛ tɩnla. Ʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ a fɩfá Wɩa. Juu tɩŋŋaa ma kala zizilu. Wɩa tɩndaarʋ kʋbala nɛ kʋ bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ dɩ ŋ kɔ ʋ dɩa, dɩ ʋ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ bʋla pʋ.”

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta yɩrɛba dɩ ba kʋ jʋʋ chʋa ʋ dɩa lɛ. Taŋ sɩ pʋla ʋ sii dɩ ba mʋ. Ʋ naambiiri-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii Jɔpa lɛ ma pɛ kɛnʋ mʋ.

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: Chɛ-lɩamɩŋ chɛɛŋ ba mʋ yi Sɩzarɩya. Nɩmɛ Kɔnɩɩlɩas arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ arɩ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ ʋ sɩ yɩra, ba kala hɔnɔ gbɛrʋ.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta fa sɩ kʋ jʋʋ, Kɔnɩɩlɩas sii chemu, a tuu kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlʋ.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta kɛnʋ aŋ bʋl, “Sii, mɩ ma ŋaa nuhuobiiŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: Pɩɩta arɩ Kɔnɩɩlɩas fa haa bʋl wɩaa nɛ aŋ to dɔŋɔ jʋjʋʋ dɩa. Pɩɩta jʋʋ na dɩ nɩaa yʋga a hilimi nɩmɛ.

english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma tɩtɩa jɩma arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa kɩsɩŋ nɛ dɩ ba guoli nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa tʋɔŋ. Ba bɩ ba dɩɩsɩŋ maa mʋ. Ama Wɩa dagɛmɛ dɩ mɩ sɩ́ nʋʋkala kaa yɩrɛ disiŋ tɩɩna.

english_verse: I agreed to come here, but I want to know why you sent for me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ, ba sɩ kʋ yɩrɛmɛ, mɩ bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla aŋ kɔ. Mɩ sɩ kɔ ŋ-la, bʋl wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ŋ yɩrɛmɛ.”

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Kɔnɩɩlɩas bʋla pʋ, “Tapʋlaa batori nɛ ŋ-la arɩ bʋa deeŋ tɩtɩa lɛ, mɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa wɩɩhɛyɛ mɩ dɩa lɛ. Dɩ baal kʋbala nɛ ŋɩɩ a chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ gɛnnɩŋ faasa tʋtʋl.

english_verse: He said, “Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Kɔnɩɩlɩas, Wɩa nɩɩ ŋ sɩ yie chʋchʋɔlʋ ŋɩɩ nɛ, a na ŋ sɩ yie pɩpɛ summoo ma lɛ.

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
translation_verse: Saa tɩŋ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ Jɔpa, a chɛ yɩrɛ baal kʋbala dɩ ʋ kɔ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta. Ʋʋ jʋʋ puri-tɩsɩrʋ kʋbala dɩa nɛ, baa yɩrɛ Saamɔŋ. Ʋ dɩa kpagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: Kɔnɩɩlɩas bɩra bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ guu tɩŋ nɩaa, ba kɔ ŋ teeŋ dɩ ba yɩrɩŋ. Ŋ ma hɛ doluŋ ŋ sɩ kɔ ŋ-la. Lɛɛlɛ la kala hilime nɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, a gbɩgbɛrɛ dɩ la nɩɩ wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ dagɩŋ dɩ ŋ bʋla pɩla.” Pɩɩta bʋl Wɩa wɩaa a pɩpɩ nɩaa

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta suomo bʋbʋl, “Mɩ lɛɛlɛ jɩma arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, Wɩa joŋ nɩaa kala ba ŋaa kʋbala nɛ.

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩɩ faʋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ, Wɩa laaʋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩpaaŋ tuo doho-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: Ma ma nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ. Ʋ fa bʋla pɩba dɩ ba to Yesu Kirisito lɛ a na wiese. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa kʋŋkala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Ma jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa Judiya tinteeŋ kala lɛ nɛ a suomi Galilii lɛ, Jɔɔŋ sɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa aŋ fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ harɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Ma nɩɩ Yesu wɩaa nɛ. Wɩa joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ a pʋ doluŋ. Ʋ sii mʋ lee-kala, a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ pɩpɩ nɩaa, aa vaarɛ nɩalɩŋ kala Sɩtaanɩ sɩ nyaga bil. Wɩa fa hɛ ʋ teeŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ wuo ŋɩŋaa wɩaa deemba kala.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa Jerusalɛm arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ kala lɛ, la na a ŋaa ba pɛ-naaraa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ tapʋl-torimuŋ chɛɛŋ a leŋ nɩaa bɩra naʋ.

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala dee bɩ ʋ na, ama la nɩalɩŋ Wɩa fa sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ la ŋaa ʋ dansɩaba, la nɛ naʋ. Ʋ sɩ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, la kala hɔŋ dɩ-bala a dii kɩaa.

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ dɩ la bʋl Wɩa wɩaa a pɩ nɩaa, a dagɛba arɩ Wɩa lɩɩsʋ nɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɩweyee arɩ nɩsʋʋnʋŋ kala sarɩya diire.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Ʋ wɩaa nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa fa bʋl ŋɩɩ. Ba sɩ nʋʋkala sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ tɩɩna wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛʋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ.” Wɩa joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa lɛ

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta ha sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ nɛ, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ tuu hɛ nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩɩ jegili wɩalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa Juu tɩmma-la fa sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a lɩɩ Jɔpa a to Pɩɩta harɩŋ kɔ wʋkpuŋkpere Wɩa sɩ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said,
translation_verse: Ba nɩa arɩ baa bʋl wɩaa yikori wogusuŋ lɛ ba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ a dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta bʋl,

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: “Wɩa sɩ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ pɩla ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋo pɩ nɩaa deemba ma. Bɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo tɔ nɩaa deemba dɩ ba sɩ́ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ fo?”

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa ba foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ Yesu Kirisito yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ hɔŋ ba teeŋ tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Pɩɩta sɩ mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm, nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho dɩ ba keri nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa penee, ka ba-na to Yesu, ba bʋl ʋ teeŋ woruŋ aŋ pɩɛsʋ,

english_verse: they said, “You stayed in the homes of Gentiles, and you even ate with them!”
translation_verse: “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ mʋ penpuru tɩmma-la sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa teeŋ, ŋ dɩ ba paala dii kɩaa?”

english_verse: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta suomo bʋbʋl wɩɩ-la kala sɩ paala chaasa ŋaa.

english_verse: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋla, “Mɩ fa hɛ Jɔpa lɛ nɛ a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa, a na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ dɩ kʋŋ a nagɛ gɛrɩ-balɩŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ tuu mɩ teeŋ. Ba kɛŋ gɛrɩ-la niipine-la banɛsɩmɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When I looked in it, I saw animals, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Mɩ nyilimi ʋ tʋɔŋ a na pʋsʋŋ arɩ bagɩlaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ bɔyɛ tutuuri tinteeŋ arɩ diibiisiŋ.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Ka mɩ nɩɩ nʋʋ yikoro sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Pɩɩta, sii kpʋ a dii.’

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, ‘Aɩ, mɩ Tɩɩna, mɩ ha bɩ kʋ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ die.’

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Yikoro-la sɩ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ fa bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Kʋ-la kala Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ zɔmɔ, bɩra sɩ́ bʋl arɩ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.’

english_verse: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa naansɩɩŋ butori nɛ, ka kɩalɩŋ mɩɩra jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ baalaa batori ba sɩ tɩma mɩ teeŋ a lɩɩ Sɩzarɩya, ba kʋ jʋʋ dɩa-la mɩ fa sɩɩ jʋʋ.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ bʋla pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ sɩ́ logo logo ŋaa aŋ to ba harɩŋ mʋ, dɩ mɩ joŋ nɩaa kala ba ŋaa kʋbala. Mɩ dɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ deemba balɩdʋ sɩ lɩɩ Jɔpa, la kala nɛ mʋ Sɩzarɩya, a jʋʋ Kɔnɩɩlɩas dɩa.

english_verse: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩla arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ na Wɩa tɩndaara dɩ ʋ chɩŋ ʋ dɩa tʋɔŋ a bʋla pʋ, ‘Tɩŋ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ Jɔpa a yɩrɛ baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta, dɩ ʋ kɔ.

english_verse: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩma a dagɛma wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ laa ŋ dɩ ŋ dɩa nɩaa kala ta.’

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ suomo bʋbʋl wɩaa, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ tuu hɛba lɛ, arɩ ʋ fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ hɛ la lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ liisi wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu fa sɩ bʋla. Ʋ fa sɩ, ‘Jɔɔŋ sɩɩ fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, lɩɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ʋ kaa fo. Ama mɩ-na jaŋ joŋ mɩ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a hɛ ma lɛ.’

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ pɩla ŋɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ la sɩ kʋ laa Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋo dii zile ba ma lɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa ka mɩ dɩ mɩ bʋl Wɩa sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa?”

english_verse: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, “God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them!” The Church in Antioch
translation_verse: Ba sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ba bɩra bɩ wɩɩkala wuo bʋl aŋ dɛnnɛ Wɩa a bʋl, “Wɩa paala pɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wombiiŋ nɛ dɩ ba wuo bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ aŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.” Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Antɩɔk lɛ

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ba fa sɩ to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a tɩŋ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ wɩaa, ba pɩsɛ. Ba sɩ pɩsɛ ŋɩɩ, ba mʋ yi Fɔnɩɩsɩa arɩ Saapʋrɔs tinteeŋ arɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Antɩɔk, a bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa pɩpɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa dʋndʋŋa nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a lɩɩ Saapʋrɔs arɩ Siriini sii mʋ Antɩɔk, a suomo bʋl La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ bʋl Giriik wʋbʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna fa pɛ ba lɛ nɛ woruŋ, nɩaa yʋga a laa Yesu wɩaa dii a bɩrɩma tutou.

english_verse: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ. Ba tɩŋ Banabas dɩ ʋ mʋ Antɩɔk.

english_verse: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mʋa, ʋ na ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ pɛ nɩalɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Ʋ bʋl wɩaa nyaasɛ ba nyuŋ woruŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a to La Tɩɩna Yesu arɩ ba tʋɔŋ kala.

english_verse: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
translation_verse: Banabas fa ŋaa nɩpʋla nɛ a laa Wɩa dii woruŋ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma hɛ ʋ lɛ woruŋ. Nɩaa fa yʋga a to ʋ lɛ a laa La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa dii.

english_verse: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Banabas sii mʋ Taasɩs dɩ ʋ chɛ Sɔɔl leriŋ.

english_verse: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ naʋ, ʋ kɛnʋ ba kɔ Antɩɔk. Ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ jɩ-piliŋ a dagɛ nɩ-daŋ Wɩa wɩaa. Ba dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii yie hihilimi. Antɩɔk lɛ nɛ ba suomo kɛŋ Yesu harɩ-tooro-la kaa yɩyɩrɛ Kirisitiamba.

english_verse: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm a kɔ Antɩɔk.

english_verse: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
translation_verse: Ba dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Agabɔs. Ʋ sii chɩŋ a bʋl wɩaa, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ dɩ losuŋ jaŋ jʋʋ dʋnɩa kala. Losu-la kʋ jʋʋ dɩ Kɩlaadɩa nɛ fa ŋaa Rom tinteeŋ kuoru-balɩŋ.

english_verse: So they appointed Barnabas and Saul to take their gifts to the church leaders in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba kɩɛsɛ moribie-la, a joŋo tɩŋ Banabas arɩ Sɔɔl, ba kaa mʋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii kʋhɩasɩŋ Judiya lɛ.

english_verse: He ordered soldiers to cut off the head of James, the brother of John.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa ba joŋ tokobiiŋ a kpʋ Jɔɔŋ naambie Jeems.

english_verse: When Herod saw that this pleased the Jewish people, he had Peter arrested during the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ na dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa lɛ, ʋ ŋaa ba kɛŋ Pɩɩta ma tɔ dɩa.

english_verse: He put Peter in jail and ordered four squads of soldiers to guard him. Herod planned to put him on trial in public after the festival.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɛŋ Pɩɩta, ba kɛnʋ kaa mʋ tɔ dɩa. Nɩmɛ nɛ ba ŋaa laalɩyuoroo fii arɩ balɩdʋ bibenu. Banɛsɛ yie benu mʋa, banɛsɛ ma bɩra kʋ laaba lɛ. Hɛrɔd fa bɩɩna dɩ dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la nɛ bal, ka ʋ kɛnʋ lɩɩ pɩ nɩalɩŋ dɩ ba dii ʋ sarɩya.

english_verse: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
translation_verse: Pɩɩta fa sɩ hɛ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa lɛ ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pʋpʋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ. Ba lɩɩsɛ Pɩɩta nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa lɛ

english_verse: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ kʋbala Pɩɩta fa pɩŋ doŋ laalɩyuoro-la balɩamɩŋ sɩɩ benu pɛgɛ. Ba fa kɛŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ balɩa nɛ a kaa vɔɔ ʋ nɩsaa lɛ, ka laalɩyuoroo balɩa ma chɩŋ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa-la boiŋ niiŋ a pɔ. Ʋ taŋ nɩɩ pʋl dɩ Hɛrɔd fa kɛnʋ kaa lɩɩ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ba dii ʋ sarɩya.

english_verse: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ kʋbala guu kʋ chɩŋ nɩmɛ. Pʋlʋmʋŋ chaanɛ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ. Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la kʋ pɛɛsɛ Pɩɩta vaaŋ lɛ a chɩsʋ, a bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ sii lɩma. Chɔrʋmɔ-la guu lɩɩ Pɩɩta nɩsaa lɛ a tuu tel.

english_verse: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ paa ʋ gɛnnɩŋ laalɛ a hɛ ʋ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ. Pɩɩta ŋaa ŋɩɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ bʋla pʋ. Ʋ bɩra bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ gɛrɩ-balɩŋ laalɛ a to ʋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
