translation_verse: Ba mʋ kieli laalɩyuoro-la sɩ chɩŋ sɩpaaŋ a bibeŋ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa-la, a bɩra mʋ kieli laalɩyuoro-la dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ chɩŋ harɩŋ a ma ha bibeŋ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa-la, a mʋ yi hɔɔŋ boro-la sɩ tɔ boi-baalɩŋ a jʋjʋʋ tabal-la. Boi-la suri ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ, ba lɩɩ a joŋ wombii kʋbala aa vɛŋ. Ba sɩ mʋ mʋa, Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la joŋ Pɩɩta ta.

english_verse: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta lɛɛlɛ jɩŋ arɩ wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa ʋ lɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ lɛɛlɛ jɩma arɩ Wɩa nɛ tɩŋ ʋ tɩndaara ʋ kʋ laamɛ ta Hɛrɔd nɩsɩŋ lɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala Juu tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ bɩɩna ba ŋaa mɩ lɛ.”

english_verse: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta sɩ kʋ jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ ŋaa ʋ lɛ, ʋ mʋ Jɔɔŋ Maak naaŋ Mɛɛrɩ dɩa. Ʋ mʋ nɩmɛ, dɩ nɩaa fa yʋga a hilimee chʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Peter knocked on the gate, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.
translation_verse: Pɩɩta ŋmoo boro. Toli-bie kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Roda, ʋ fa ŋaa ketii nɛ dɩa-la lɛ. Ʋ kɔ dɩ ʋ na.

english_verse: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ kʋ nɩɩ Pɩɩta yikoro, ʋ wuo jɩŋ dɩ Pɩɩta nɛ. Ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ woruŋ. Ʋ bɩ boi-la suro aŋ mɩɩra fá jʋʋ bʋla pɩ nɩaa dɩ Pɩɩta nɛ chɩŋ dɩ-jalɩŋ.

english_verse: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ toli-bie-la nyuŋ tuo. Ka ʋ-na ha bʋl dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra bʋl, ʋ nɩdɩma nɛ ʋ na.

english_verse: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
translation_verse: Ka Pɩɩta ma ha chɩŋ a ŋmuŋmoo boro. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kʋ kɛŋ boro-la suri a naʋ. Ʋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere.

english_verse: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ vigi dɩ ba kɛŋ goŋ, aŋ bʋla pɩba ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ kɛnʋ kaa lɩɩ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ. Ʋ sɩ dɩ ba bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ a pɩ Jeems arɩ ʋ naambiiri-la ma dɔnsʋŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii. Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ lɩɩ to lee dɔŋ mʋ.

english_verse: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, laalɩyuoro-la sɩ pɔ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa-la bɩ Pɩɩta na. Ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala vʋgʋmɛ. Ba pɩpɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa Pɩɩta lɛ.

english_verse: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hɛrɔd bʋl dɩ ba chɛ kɛnʋ kaa kɔ. Ba chɛʋ lɔl. Hɛrɔd pɩɛsɛ laalɩyuoro-la dɩ ba na wɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa, aŋ ŋaa ba kpʋba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hɛrɔd sii lɩɩ Judiya tinteeŋ, a mʋ Sɩzarɩya a hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Kuoro Hɛrɔd sʋba

english_verse: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ lɛ Hɛrɔd fa na baanɩŋ woruŋ Taaya arɩ Sɩdɔŋ nɩaa nyuŋ. Ba sii hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a mʋ dɩ ba sʋlʋ, a laa sɩpaaŋ a na Bilasitas, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ kuoro dɩa nɛ, dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ. Ʋ pɛ ba lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ Hɛrɔd teeŋ a sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ba sɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɩaa kʋdiilee ka lɩɩ kuoro tinteeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
translation_verse: Hɛrɔd hɛ tapʋlʋŋ dɩ ba kɔ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la sɩ yie, Hɛrɔd sii laalɛ ʋ kuori-gɛnnɩŋ a hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ, a bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: The people shouted, “You speak more like a god than a man!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ faasa ŋɩŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “Wɩa nɩɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, nuhuobiine dee.”

english_verse: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, Hɛrɔd bɩ Wɩa zile pa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa tɩndaara kʋ tuu a guu joŋ nyanyalaa hɛ ʋ lɛ nanchʋɔlaa diiu, ʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Banabas arɩ Sɔɔl sɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ba sɩ sɩ dɩ ba mʋ tɩŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a dɛrɛ, ba mɩɩra mʋ Antɩɔk, a pɛ kɛŋ Jɔɔŋ Maak ma pɛ ba lɛ mʋ.

english_verse: The church at Antioch had several prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon, also called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, who was Herod's close friend, and Saul.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Antɩɔk lɛ, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ nɩaa fa hɛ ba tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ: Banabas, arɩ Simioŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ nɩ-bine, arɩ Lusias sɩ lɩɩ Siriini, arɩ Sɔɔl arɩ Maneyaŋ.

english_verse: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.”
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba fa sɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a vʋvɔɔ niiŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ bʋla pɩba, “Má lɩɩsɛ Banabas arɩ Sɔɔl pɩmɛ dɩ ba tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ yɩrɛba dɩ ba tɩŋ.”

english_verse: Everyone prayed and went without eating for a while longer. Next, they placed their hands on Barnabas and Saul to show that they had been appointed to do this work. Then everyone sent them on their way. Barnabas and Saul in Cyprus
translation_verse: Ba sɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a vɔɔ niiŋ ŋɩɩ, ba joŋ ba nɩsaa daŋ ba lɛ, aŋ taba. Banabas arɩ Pɔɔl hɛ Saapʋrɔs lɛ

english_verse: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ tɩmba ŋɩɩ, ba sii mʋ Sɛlʋsɩa, a lɩɩ nɩmɛ a jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro, a mʋ tintee kʋbala lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu baa yɩrɛ Saapʋrɔs.

english_verse: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ yi nɩmɛ, ba mʋ Saapʋrɔs taŋ dɔŋɔ baa yɩrɛ Salamɩs. Ba bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa Juu tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ nɩmɛ. Ba kɛŋ Jɔɔŋ Maak ma pɛ kɔ dɩ ʋ pɛ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la.

english_verse: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
translation_verse: Ba gɔllɛ tintee-la kala lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu, a mʋ yi taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Paafɔs. Nɩmɛ nɛ ba na daalusuŋ tɩɩna kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Baa-Yesu. Ʋ fa ŋaa Juu tɩɩna nɛ aŋ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ.

english_verse: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa hɛ ba taŋ-la kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Saajas Pɔɔlɔs dɩa lɛ nɛ. Kuoru-la fa ŋaa wʋjɩnnʋ nɛ. Ʋ tɩŋ ba yɩrɛ Banabas arɩ Sɔɔl kɔ ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ faa chɛ dɩ ba bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa nɛ a pʋ dɩ ʋ nɩɩ.

english_verse: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Daalusuŋ tɩɩna Ɛlɩmas lɩɩ ba harɩŋ aa walɩmɛ dɩ kuoru-la sɩ́ Yesu wɩalɩŋ laa dii.

english_verse: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ hɛ Sɔɔl lɛ. Ba fa kɛnʋ kaa yɩyɩrɛ Pɔɔl ma nɛ. Ʋ chaarɛ sɩaa pɛ daalusuŋ tɩɩna-la lɛ

english_verse: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
translation_verse: a bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ-na Sɩtaanɩ bie deeŋ, ŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ kala dʋndɔŋ nɛ. Ŋŋ nyɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ, a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kɩŋkɛŋ. Wɩa wombii-tɩtɩɩba-la ŋ kaa golibi nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
translation_verse: Bee na, Wɩa jaŋ kʋ tuu ŋ lɛ, ŋ jaŋ nyʋlɩmɛ, a magɛ magɩna kʋbala ŋ bɩ jaŋ na pʋlʋmʋŋ.” Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, birimiŋ guu kʋ tɔʋ, ʋ sɩaa bɩra bɩ na. Ʋ gɔllɔ chɩchɛ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
translation_verse: Kuoru-la sɩ na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa, ʋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ daga a tɩgɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu lɛ ŋaaʋ wʋkpuŋkpere. Banabas arɩ Pɔɔl hɛ Antɩɔk lɛ, Pisiidia tinteeŋ

english_verse: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl arɩ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ sii jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro a lɩɩ Paafɔs, a kiele mʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Pɛɛga a hɛ Pamfiilia tinteeŋ lɛ. Jɔɔŋ Maak taba nɩmɛ aŋ mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
translation_verse: Ba sii nɩmɛ a mʋ Antɩɔk, Pisiidia tinteeŋ lɛ. Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, ba mʋ jʋʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa a hɔŋ.

english_verse: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ hɔŋ ŋɩɩ, nʋʋ karɩmɛ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, arɩ Wɩa tenni-la Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa. Ba sɩ karɩma dɛrɛ, Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa-la kʋhɩasɩŋ tɩŋ dɩ ba bʋla pɩba, “La naambiiriŋ, dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩ nɩaa deemba dɩ ba nyuŋ nyaasɛ, má bʋl.”

english_verse: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl sii chɩŋ a kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ vigi dɩ ba kɛŋ goŋ, aŋ suomo bʋbʋl, “Mɩ naambiiriŋ Iziral tɩmma arɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa a hɛ daha a fɩfá Wɩa, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out,
translation_verse: Wɩa-la ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa deemba sɩɩ to, ʋ nɛ lɩɩsɛ la naabalɩmaba a ŋaa ba pʋŋ a yʋgɛ, bʋa-la lɛ ba fa sɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ doluŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ kɛmba kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Make sure what the prophets have said doesn't happen to you. They said,
translation_verse: Má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa dɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩɩ bʋl, sɩ́ ma lɛ ŋaa. Ba sɩ,

english_verse: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.
translation_verse: Ʋ leŋe ba yuo dii tinteyee balɩpɛ nɛ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ a laa tintee-la tɩɩ.

english_verse: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa kiri Sɔɔl kuoruŋ lɛ aŋ ŋaa Devit dii kuoruŋ. Ʋ bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ Devit lɛ a bʋl, ‘Jesi nanʋala Devit nɛ ŋaa mɩ tʋɔtɔrʋ nɩa. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩkala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa.’

english_verse: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
translation_verse: Devit doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ Yesu lɩɩ. Wɩa ŋaa ʋ kʋ ŋaa Iziral nɩaa Laataara, arɩ ʋ fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But before Jesus came, John was telling everyone in Israel to turn back to God and be baptized.
translation_verse: Ka dɩ Yesu-na kɔ, Jɔɔŋ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nɛ, a bʋl dɩ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ aŋ ka dɩ ʋ foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Jɔɔŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa sɩ kpagɛ dɛrɩŋ, ʋ pɩɛsɛ nɩaa, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ma bɩɩnɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa? Mɩ dee nɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ gbɛrʋ dɩ ʋ kɔ. Ʋ jaŋ kɔ mɩ harɩŋ. Nɩɩ-la-na mɩ paala bɩ maga dɩ mɩ kɛŋ ʋ nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ ŋmɛnɩŋ a puri!’

english_verse: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ Abɩraham doho nɩaa arɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa a hɛ daha a fɩfá Wɩa, la wɩaa nɛ ba tɩŋ dɩ ba bʋl wɩaa deemba sɩ jaŋ wuo laala ta.

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ kɔ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ arɩ ba kʋhɩasɩŋ fa bɩ jɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa la Laataara. Ba bɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa wʋbʋlɩɩ-la bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ, wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yie karɩmɛ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ kala. Ama ba ha leŋe Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ, a kpʋ Yesu.

english_verse: They did exactly what the Scriptures said they would. Even though they couldn't find any reason to put Jesus to death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed. After Jesus had been put to death, he was taken down from the cross and placed in a tomb.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ dɛrɛ, ba soru daagɛsɛ nyuŋ a joŋu hugi.

english_verse: But God raised him from death!
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ lɩɩ Galilii a mʋ Jerusalɛm. Ba naʋ tapʋl daŋ nɛ. Ba nɛ lɛɛlɛ saa bʋl ʋ wɩaa pɩpɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: God made a promise to our ancestors. And we are here to tell you the good news
translation_verse: La ma saa kɔ dɩ la bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la nɛ pɩma, wɩɩla Wɩa fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ a pɩ la naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: that he has kept this promise to us. It is just as the second Psalm says about Jesus, “You are my son because today I have become your Father.”
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la pɩla nɛ, la nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa ba doho nɩaa. Wɩa chɩsɛ Yesu sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Ba fa ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Wɩa yɩɩlaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ba ŋmʋnsa a tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ a bʋl, ‘Ŋ ŋaa mɩ Bii nɛ. Mɩ nɛ lʋlʋŋ jɩnɩŋ.’

english_verse: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, Wɩa chɩsɛ Yesu sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ pʋa. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩ, ‘Mɩ jaŋ sɛnɛ to ʋ lɛ a pɛ ma lɛ woruŋ arɩ mɩ fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ a pɩ Devit.’

english_verse: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ baa yɩrɛ Wɩa yɩɩlaa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ maa ba bɩra ŋmʋnsa: ‘Ŋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna sʋʋ a pʋa.’

english_verse: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
translation_verse: Devit fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ aŋ sʋʋ. Ba joŋu hugi ʋ naabalɩmaba tʋɔŋ, ʋ pʋa.

english_verse: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ chɩsa sʋʋŋ lɛ, ʋ-na bɩ pʋa.

english_verse: My friends, the message is that Jesus can forgive your sins! The Law of Moses could not set you free from all your sins.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma kala jɩŋ woruŋ arɩ baala deeŋ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ la wuo bʋbʋl arɩ Wɩa jaŋ joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛma.

english_verse: “Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it!”
translation_verse: ‘Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ mɔŋ Wɩa, má bee na tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ tɩŋ ma mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa lɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bʋla pɩma, ma bɩ jaŋ laa dii dɩ ʋ sɛnɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaama wʋkpuŋkpere a leŋ dɩ ma sʋʋ.’ ”

english_verse: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to say more about these same things on the next Sabbath.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba kala dɛrɛ, ba sii lɩɩ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa lɛ. Ba sɩɩ mʋ, nɩalɩŋ sʋlba dɩ ba mɩɩra kɔ harɩŋ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, a bɩra bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩba.

english_verse: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala lɩɩ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa lɛ. Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa aŋ tuto Juu tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ wombiiŋ, ba yʋga a to Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas harɩŋ. Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas bʋl wɩaa pɩba a sʋsʋlba dɩ ba chɩŋ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la lɛ a sɩ́ joŋo ta.

english_verse: The next Sabbath almost everyone in town came to hear the message about the Lord.
translation_verse: Harɩŋ chɛ-wiesii-la sɩ yie, nɩaa jesiŋ kala sɩ hɛ tabal-la lɛ nɛ mʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ La Tɩɩna niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ na nɩ-daŋ-la hilime ŋɩɩ, ba yaraa bibieri. Ba kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ Pɔɔl fa sɩɩ bʋl chichei aŋ tʋtʋʋsʋ.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas bʋl wɩaa arɩ nyuduoŋ a bʋl, “Ʋ fa maga dɩ la laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa pɩ ma Juu tɩŋŋaa nɛ, ka ma vɩaba ta aŋ bɩɩnɛ ma bɩ maga dɩ ma kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. La jaŋ lemma aŋ mʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa teeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ bʋla pɩla dɩ la ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ʋ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ sɩ, ‘Mɩ nɛ lɩɩsɩŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa pʋlʋmʋŋ. Ŋ jaŋ bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa dʋnɩa sɛmɛ-na kala, dɩ Wɩa laa nɩalɩŋ ta.’ ”

english_verse: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ba tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ, ba bʋl dɩ La tɩɩna niiŋ wɩaa sɩma kɩŋkɛŋ. Nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ba kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, ba laa wɩalɩŋ dii.

english_verse: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Yesu niiŋ wɩaa teeli lee-la kala.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
translation_verse: Ama Juu tɩŋŋaa nyɩsɛ tabal-la nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ haala-la sɩ ŋaa nɩbalaa a fɩfá Wɩa a hɛ. Ba dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa suomo to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛ Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas, a ŋaa ba lɩɩ ba tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas kpesi ba nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ hagɩla ta a dagɛ arɩ ba chei wɩɩ nɛ, aŋ lɩɩ mʋ Ikooniam.

english_verse: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ka nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii Antɩɔk lɛ tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma hɛ ba lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue in Iconium, just as they had done at Antioch, and many Jews and Gentiles put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas sɩ hɛ Ikooniam lɛ, ba jʋʋ Juu tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa a bʋl Wɩa wɩaa. Ba sɩ chaasa bʋl Wɩa wɩaa ŋɩɩ, nɩ-daŋ kʋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa kala.

english_verse: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Ama Juu tɩmma-la sɩ bɩ Yesu wɩaa laa dii, ba nyɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa hɛ, a chei ba nyuŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ ba naambiiri-la sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii lɛ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas hɔŋ lee-la a dieni. Ba bʋl La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa arɩ nyuduoŋ. La Tɩɩna ma dagɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ bʋl ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ, ʋ pɩba doluŋ ba ŋɩŋaa wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ.

english_verse: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ tabal-la lɛ kpaa balɩa. Dɔnsʋŋ tuto Juu tɩŋŋaa, dɔnsʋŋ ma tuto Yesu nanzɔɔba-la.

english_verse: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ ba sɩpaalaaraa wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛ Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas aa chɛ dɩ ba paa tabɩaa yagɛba.

english_verse: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
translation_verse: Ba fa sɩ mʋ Lisita ŋɩɩ dɩ baal kʋbala gbɛrɩgɛ hɔŋ. Ba lʋlʋ dɩ ʋ gbɛrɩgɛ nɛ. Ʋ ha bɩ vɛnɛ na.

english_verse: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
translation_verse: Ʋ hɔnɔ jegile nɩɩ Pɔɔl fa sɩɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ. Pɔɔl benu jim, a na dɩ ʋ laa dii arɩ Yesu jaŋ wuo vaarʋ.

english_verse: and shouted, “Stand up!” The man jumped up and started walking around.
translation_verse: Ʋ faasa bʋla pʋ, “Sii chɩŋ ŋ naasɩŋ nyuŋ.” Ʋ guu sii chɩŋ ʋ naasɩŋ nyuŋ aa vɛŋ.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ-la fa sɩ na wɩɩ-la Pɔɔl sɩ ŋaa, ba kala kpɩkpɩa goŋ aa bʋl arɩ Likoonia yikoro lɛ, “Vesiŋ nɛ bɩrɩmɛ nuhuobiine a kʋ tuu la tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ Banabas yɩyɩrɛ Zuus. Zuus nɛ fa ŋaa ba veŋ-hɩaŋ. Pɔɔl ma nɛ fa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛnʋ ma yɩrɛ Hɛɛmɩs, ba veŋ-hɩaŋ tɩndaara yɩrɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
translation_verse: Ba vene Zuus dɩa fa chɩŋ ba tabal-la boi-baalɩŋ niiŋ nɛ. Vene tɩɩna kɛŋ nɛ-belliŋ arɩ tɩɩfɩɩlaa ba sɩ kaa guori kaa kɔ dɩa-la boiŋ niiŋ. Ʋ dɩ nɩ-daŋ-la faa chɛ dɩ ba kpaarɛ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la nɛ.

english_verse: When the two apostles found out about this, they tore their clothes in horror and ran to the crowd, shouting:
translation_verse: Banabas arɩ Pɔɔl sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ chɛ ba ŋaa, ba kɛŋ ba gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ, aa dagɛ arɩ ba bɩ sɛyɛ, aŋ fá jʋʋ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ a faasa bʋl,

english_verse: Why are you doing this? We are humans just like you. Please give up all this foolishness. Turn to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: “Nandɔmba, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ maa ŋaa ŋ-la? La ma ŋaa nuhuobiinee nɛ a nagɛ ma. La kɔ dɩ la bʋl La Tɩɩna Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la nɛ a pɩma, dɩ ma wuo leŋ ma vʋɩyaa sɩ ŋaa kʋpɛɩba aŋ bɩrɩma to Wɩa sɩ weye. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ, arɩ tinteeŋ, mʋgʋ-balaa arɩ fuonuŋ, arɩ kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: In times past, God let each nation go its own way.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ Wɩa leŋe la naabalɩmaba tuto ba tɩtɩa wombiiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ fa ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ pɩpɩ nɩaa nɛ, a dɩdagɛba ŋɩɩ arɩ ʋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ ŋaa duonuŋ nɩnɩɩ a ŋaa baga kɩaa wʋwasɛ, a pɩma kʋdiilee yʋgɛ, a leŋ ma faasa kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.”

english_verse: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.
translation_verse: Banabas arɩ Pɔɔl bʋl wɩaa deemba kala nɛ, ka nɩalɩŋ ha bɩ sɛyɛ aŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ba kpaarɛba.

english_verse: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
translation_verse: Dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Antɩɔk, Pisiidia tinteeŋ lɛ, a ma kɔ. Dɔnsʋŋ ma lɩɩ Ikooniam a kɔ. Ba kʋ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ pɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ a yagɛ Pɔɔl arɩ tabɩaa, a kɛnʋ lɛrɛ lɩɩ ba tabal-la tʋɔŋ, a bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ sʋba nɛ.

english_verse: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Ama Yesu harɩ-tooro-la sɩ mʋ gollu chu, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sii a mɩɩra jʋʋ tabal-la tʋɔŋ. Taŋ sɩ pʋla, ʋ dɩ Banabas sii mʋ Dɛɛbɩ. Ba mɩɩra lɩɩ Siiria a mʋ Antɩɔk

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas bʋl Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa Dɛɛbɩ lɛ, nɩaa yʋgɛ a laa wɩalɩŋ dii. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mɩɩra mʋ Lisita, a sii nɩmɛ a mʋ Ikooniam, a bɩra sii nɩmɛ a mɩɩra mʋ Antɩɔk, Pisiidia tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
translation_verse: Lee-na kala nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩalɩŋ dii aa hilimi, Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas yie lɩɩsɛ nɩaa ba tʋɔŋ dɩ ba ŋaa ba kʋhɩasɩŋ. Ba nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba yie chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩba a vɔɔ niiŋ, aŋ jomba hɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu nɩsɩŋ lɛ, nɩɩ-la wɩaa ba sɩ laa dii.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
translation_verse: Ba sɩ gɔllɛ Pisiidia tinteeŋ kala dɛrɛ, ba lɩɩ mʋ Pamfiilia tinteeŋ.

english_verse: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ ba bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Pɛɛga lɛ, a bɩra lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Atalɩa.

english_verse: and sailed to Antioch in Syria. It was there that they had been placed in God's care for the work they had now completed.
translation_verse: Ba lɩɩ nɩmɛ a jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro, a mɩɩra kɔ Antɩɔk. Nɩmɛ nɛ ba fa jomba hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ ba wuo tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa dɛrɛ.

english_verse: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɔ Antɩɔk, ba yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hilimi, a bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la kala Wɩa sɩ to ba lɛ a ŋaa pɩba, a dagɛba ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ wuo suri wombiiŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, ba ma wuo laa Yesu wɩaa dii.

english_verse: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
translation_verse: Ba hɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa teeŋ a dieni nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
translation_verse: Baalaa dɔnsʋŋ ma lɩɩ Judiya a kɔ Antɩɔk, a suomo dɩdagɛ ba naambiiri-la sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a bʋl, “Wɩa bɩ jaŋ wuo laama ta, see dɩ ma keri ma penee, arɩ Mosis wombie-la ʋ fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto fa sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas bɩ wɩɩ-la sɛyɛ. Ba dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Judiya kɛŋ wɩɩ-la lɩlɛrɛ. Ba vʋʋrɛ dɩ Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ Antɩɔk, dɩ ba mʋ Jerusalɛm a na Yesu nanzɔɔba-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi kʋhɩasɩŋ nɩmɛ, a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi taba ba mʋ. Ba sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, ba to Fɔnɩɩsɩa arɩ Samarɩa tinteeŋ a bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa sɩ bɩrɩma tuto Wɩa. Ba sɩ bʋl wʋzɔmʋŋ deeŋ ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ mʋ yi Jerusalɛm, Yesu nanzɔɔba-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi arɩ ba kʋhɩasɩŋ, ba kɛmba woruŋ. Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ to ba lɛ ŋaa a pɩba.

english_verse: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa to nɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Farisii tɩŋŋaa, ba sii chɩŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Ʋ maga dɩ ba keri nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa penee nɛ, aŋ ŋaa dɩ ba tuto wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa to.”

english_verse: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
translation_verse: Yesu nanzɔɔba-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii kʋhɩasɩŋ bɩra hilimi dɩ ba kɛŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ chɔgɩsa na.

english_verse: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
translation_verse: Ba hɔnɔ kɛŋ wɩɩ-la a lɛrɛ dieni. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɩɩta sii chɩŋ a bʋl, “Mɩ naambiiriŋ, ma jɩma arɩ faafaa kala nɛ Wɩa lɩɩsɛmɛ ma tʋɔŋ dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, dɩ ba ma wuo laa Yesu wɩaa dii.

english_verse: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
translation_verse: Mɩ mʋ bʋla pɩba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa sɩ jɩŋ nʋʋkala tʋɔŋ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ba lɛ arɩ ʋ fa sɩ joŋo hɛ la lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ dagɛ arɩ ʋ maga dɩ ba ma laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɛ.

english_verse: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa kaa pɔrɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ma laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ joŋ ba ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba.

english_verse: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma joŋ chʋgʋ-balɩŋ aa chʋŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa aŋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, aa magɩsɛ Wɩa ŋɩɩ? La dɩ la naabalɩmaba kala, la fa bɩ chʋga deeŋ wuo chʋŋ.

english_verse: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.
translation_verse: La laa dii arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu dʋndʋŋa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ Wɩa jaŋ laa la kala ta arɩ ʋ sɩ laaba ta ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ hilime ŋaa fʋɩɩ, aŋ jijegili Banabas arɩ Pɔɔl teeŋ. Ba bʋl wʋmagɩla-la arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la Wɩa sɩ to ba lɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ, Jeems ma bʋl, “Mɩ naambiiriŋ, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.
translation_verse: Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta bʋla pɩma ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ cho nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, a lɩɩsɛ nɩaa ba tʋɔŋ dɩ ba ŋaa ʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.
translation_verse: ‘Mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ a chʋʋlɛ Devit dɩa-la sɩ tele. Mɩ jaŋ wasa taasɛ je-kɩɛrɩ-la dɩ ʋ chɩŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: I promised it long ago.”
translation_verse: Wɩa bʋl ŋɩɩ faafaa kala nɛ dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ.”

english_verse: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jeems bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na sɩ bɩɩna nɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ la walɩmɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa aŋ bɩrɩma tuto Wɩa.

english_verse: We should simply write and tell them not to eat anything that has been offered to idols. They should be told not to eat the meat of any animal that has been strangled or that still has blood in it. They must also not commit any terrible sexual sins.
translation_verse: Ama má leŋ dɩ la ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ pɩba a bʋla pɩba dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ vʋɩyaa kɩaa dii, a sɩ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ ŋaa, a sɩ́ pʋsʋŋ sɩ sʋʋ pimee dii, a sɩ́ pʋsʋŋ chalɩŋ ma dii.

english_verse: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues. A Letter to Gentiles Who Had Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Ba dagɛ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ la tuto tabiisi-la kala lɛ nɛ. Ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ faafaa kala nɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ. Ba ma yie karɩmɛ wɩalɩŋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛ na kala nɛ.” Ba ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa aŋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii

english_verse: The apostles, the leaders, and all the church members decided to send some men to Antioch along with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Silas and Judas Barsabbas, who were two leaders of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Yesu nanzɔɔba-la arɩ kʋhɩasɩ-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi, ba vʋʋrɛ a lɩɩsɛ ba tʋɔŋ nɩaa, a tɩmba dɩ ba dɩ Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas mʋ Antɩɔk. Ba lɩɩsɛ Judas ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Basabas arɩ Saalas. Nɩaa deemba balɩa fa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii sɩpaalaaraa nɛ.

english_verse: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ teniŋ tɩmba. Teŋ-la lɛ ba fa ŋmʋnsɛ ŋ-la nɛ, “La nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Yesu nanzɔɔba arɩ la kʋhɩasɩŋ, ma naambiiriŋ, laa chʋɔlɛ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aŋ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa a hɛ Antɩɔk arɩ Siiria arɩ Siliisia lɛ.

english_verse: We have heard that some people from here have terribly upset you by what they said. But we did not send them!
translation_verse: La nɩa arɩ la nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kɔ ma teeŋ a walɩmɛma, a kɛŋ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa vʋgʋmɛ. Ka la dee bɩ ba hɛ.

english_verse: So we met together and decided to choose some men and to send them to you along with our good friends Barnabas and Paul.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa la hilime nɛ a vʋʋra sɛɩ a lɩɩsɛ nɩaa a tɩmba ma teeŋ, ba dɩ la nandɔnsʋŋ Banabas arɩ Pɔɔl nɛ jaŋ kɔ.

english_verse: These men have risked their lives for our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba joŋ ba mɩɩsɩŋ a yɔɔ sʋʋŋ nɛ a tɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: We are also sending Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things that we are writing.
translation_verse: La saa tɩŋ Judas arɩ Saalas nɛ, ba jaŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa la sɩ ŋmʋnsa a pɩma.

english_verse: But you should not eat anything offered to idols. You should not eat any meat that still has the blood in it or any meat of any animal that has been strangled. You must also not commit any terrible sexual sins. If you follow these instructions, you will do well. We send our best wishes.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ vʋɩyaa nammɩa chaŋ, má sɩ́ kʋŋkala chalɩŋ dii, má sɩ́ pʋna-kala sɩ sʋʋ pimee chaŋ, a sɩ́ bachɔrʋŋ arɩ hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa ŋaa. Dɩ ma nɛ lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wɩaa deemba lɛ, ma ŋaa woruŋ nɛ. Ma jaŋ hɔŋ woruŋ.”

english_verse: The four men left Jerusalem and went to Antioch. Then they called the church members together and gave them the letter.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ta nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ lɩɩsa. Ba sii mʋ Antɩɔk. Ba sɩ mʋ nɩmɛ, ba yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi, a joŋ teŋ-la pɩba.

english_verse: When the letter was read, everyone was pleased and greatly encouraged.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ karɩmɛ teŋ-la, ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ wɩalɩŋ lɛ ba nyuŋ nyaasɛ.

english_verse: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they spoke a long time, encouraging and helping the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Judas arɩ Saalas fa ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla nɛ. Ba bʋl wɩaa yʋgɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ, ba nyuŋ nyaasɛ, ba wasa kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: The men from Jerusalem stayed on in Antioch for a while. And when they left to return to the ones who had sent them, the followers wished them well.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ dieni mʋa Antɩɔk lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii taba dɩ Wɩa kɛmba mɩɩra mʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩmba teeŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. [

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas stayed on in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached about the Lord. Paul and Barnabas Go Their Separate Ways
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas ma ka Antɩɔk lɛ. Nɩaa yʋgɛ a pɛ ba lɛ ba bʋl La Tɩɩna Yesu niiŋ wɩaa a pɩ nɩaa a dɩdagɛba. Pɔɔl arɩ Banabas pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ

english_verse: Sometime later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let's go back and visit the Lord's followers in the cities where we preached his message. Then we will know how they are doing.”
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ Pɔɔl bʋla pɩ Banabas, “Leŋ la mɩɩra mʋ tasɩ-la kala lɛ la sɩ bʋl Yesu niiŋ wɩaa, a na ŋɩɩ la naambiiri-la hɔnʋŋ sɩ naga.”

english_verse: Barnabas wanted to take along John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Banabas faa chɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ Jɔɔŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Maak kaa pɛ mʋ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas argued, then each of them went his own way. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus,
translation_verse: Ba faasa kɛŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ kaa lɛrɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, a pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Banabas kɛŋ Jɔɔŋ Maak, ba jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro a duoro mʋ Saapʋrɔs.

english_verse: but Paul took Silas and left after the followers had placed them in God's care.
translation_verse: Ka Pɔɔl ma kɛŋ Saalas. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii jomba hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba jʋʋ ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ.

english_verse: Paul and Silas went back to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a follower named Timothy. His mother was also a follower. She was Jewish, and his father was Greek.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas sii mʋ Dɛɛbɩ, a lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ Lisita. Yesu harɩ-tooru kʋbala fa hɛ nɩmɛ, baa yɩrɛ Timoti. Ʋ naaŋ ŋaa Juu tɩɩna nɛ a ma fa laa Yesu wɩaa dii, aŋ ka ʋ nyɩmma fa ŋaa Giriik tɩɩna.

english_verse: The Lord's followers in Lystra and Iconium said good things about Timothy,
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii Lisita arɩ Ikooniam kala lɛ bɩbɛsɛ Timoti lɛ.

english_verse: and Paul wanted him to go with them. But Paul first had him circumcised, because all the Jewish people around there knew that Timothy's father was Greek.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl faa chɛ dɩ Timoti to ʋ harɩŋ. Ama a tɩŋ Juu tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ lere-la wɩaa Pɔɔl leŋ ba keri ʋ peniŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba kala jɩma arɩ ʋ nyɩmma ŋaa Giriik tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: As Paul and the others went from city to city, they told the followers what the apostles and leaders in Jerusalem had decided, and they urged them to follow these instructions.
translation_verse: Ba sɩɩ mʋ tasɩ-la ŋɩɩ, ba bʋl wɩaa a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɩmɛ. Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ Yesu nanzɔɔba-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii kʋhɩasɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto.

english_verse: The churches became stronger in their faith, and each day more people put their faith in the Lord. Paul's Vision in Troas
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi wasa laa Wɩa dii, a pʋŋaa pɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala. Pɔɔl na wɩaa arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ Tʋrɔwas lɛ

english_verse: Paul and his friends went through Phrygia and Galatia, but the Holy Spirit would not let them preach in Asia.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas gɔllɛ ŋɩɩ halɩɩ a to Firijia arɩ Galiisia tinteeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ bɩ ba wombiiŋ pa dɩ ba bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa Esia tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: After they arrived in Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not let them.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ wombiiŋ a mʋ yi Mɩɩsɩa. Nɩmɛ nɛ ba walɩmɛ dɩ ba jʋʋ Bitiinia tinteeŋ, ama Yesu Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ bɩ ba wombiiŋ pa.

english_verse: So they went on through Mysia until they came to Troas.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba to Mɩɩsɩa tinteeŋ a mʋ yi Tʋrɔwas.

english_verse: During the night, Paul had a vision of someone from Macedonia who was standing there and begging him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us!”
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ, tɩtaŋɩŋ Pɔɔl na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ dɩ baal kʋbala sɩ lɩɩ Masidoonia chɩna aa sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ kɔ Masidoonia tinteeŋ a pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: After Paul had seen the vision, we began looking for a way to go to Macedonia. We were sure that God had called us to preach the good news there. Lydia Becomes a Follower of the Lord
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ na ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, la kɛŋ la tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ la mʋ Masidoonia, bɛɛ wɩaa la jɩma arɩ Wɩa nɛ sɛnɛ dagɛla dɩ la mʋ bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩba. Haal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Lidia laa Yesu wɩaa dii Fɩlɩpa lɛ

english_verse: We sailed straight from Troas to Samothrace, and the next day we arrived in Neapolis.
translation_verse: La bɩra sii nɩmɛ a jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro, a duoro tegi tegi a mʋ Saamɔtas. Ʋ taŋ sɩ pʋla la bɩra sii a mʋ Niapolis.

english_verse: From there we went to Philippi, which is a Roman colony in the first district of Macedonia. We spent several days in Philippi.
translation_verse: La bɩra lɩɩ nɩmɛ a vɛnɛ mʋ Fɩlɩpa. Ʋ fa ŋaa tabal nɛ Masidoonia sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a tuto Rom tinteeŋ. La hɔŋ taŋ-la lɛ tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ.

english_verse: Then on the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to a place by the river, where we thought there would be a Jewish meeting place for prayer. We sat down and talked with the women who came.
translation_verse: Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ sɩ yie, la lɩɩ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ a mʋ fuoŋ niiŋ. La fa bɩɩna la jaŋ na Wɩa dɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ la hɔŋ nɩmɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩ haala-la fa sɩ hilime lee-la.

english_verse: One of them was Lydia, who was from the city of Thyatira and sold expensive purple cloth. She was a worshiper of the Lord God, and he made her willing to accept what Paul was saying.
translation_verse: Haala-la sɩ jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Lidia. Ʋ lɩɩ Taataya tinteeŋ nɛ, a biri gɛnnɩŋ yɩyallɛ. Ʋ faa chʋɔlɛ Wɩa nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Pɔɔl fa sɩɩ bʋl, Wɩa suri ʋ tʋɔŋ, ʋ laa wɩalɩŋ dii.

english_verse: Then after she and her family were baptized, she kept on begging us, “If you think I really do have faith in the Lord, come stay in my home.” Finally, we accepted her invitation. Paul and Silas Are Put in Jail
translation_verse: Ba fo ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la sʋlla a bʋl, “Dɩ ma nɛ bɩɩna dɩ mɩ sɛnɛ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɛ, má kʋ jʋʋ chʋa mɩ dɩa lɛ.” Ʋ sɩ sʋlla dieni ŋɩɩ, la mʋ chʋa. Ba kɛŋ Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas tɔ dɩa Fɩlɩpa lɛ

english_verse: One day on our way to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl. She had a spirit in her that gave her the power to tell the future. By doing this she made a lot of money for her owners.
translation_verse: Chɛɛ kʋbala la bɩra mʋ Wɩa dɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ. Yoŋ toli-bie kʋbala kʋ chenla. Jɩma nɛ kɛnʋ, ʋ vʋga pɩpɩ nɩaa. Ʋ vʋga na moribiee yʋgɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩɩʋ.

english_verse: The girl followed Paul and the rest of us, and she kept yelling, “These men are servants of the Most High God! They are telling you how to be saved.”
translation_verse: Ʋ to la dɩ Pɔɔl harɩŋ a yie faasaa bʋl, “Nɩaa deemba Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala tɩntɩnnaa nɛ. Ba bʋlaa pɩma ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa laama ta nɛ.”

english_verse: This went on for several days. Finally, Paul got so upset that he turned and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ, I order you to leave this girl alone!” At once the evil spirit left her.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa vɛnɛɛ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ a dieni nɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Pɔɔl baanɩŋ sii, ʋ mɩɩra bɩrɩma chaasɛ tolo-la, aŋ bʋla pɩ jɩma-la, “Yesu Kirisito yɩrɩŋ lɛ mɩ sɩ, ŋŋ lɩɩ aŋ leŋ tolo-la.” Jɩma-la guu lɩɩ tolo-la lɛ.

english_verse: When the girl's owners realized they had lost all chances for making more money, they grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them into court.
translation_verse: Tolo-la tɩŋŋaa sɩ na arɩ ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ nɩna moribiee, ba kɛŋ Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas a lɛrɛ mʋ ba taŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ teeŋ ba sɩ yie hihilimi lee-la.

english_verse: They are telling us to do things we Romans are not allowed to do.”
translation_verse: Baa dagɛla dɩ laa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ la Rom tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ kɩsʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: The crowd joined in the attack on Paul and Silas. Then the officials tore the clothes off the two men and ordered them to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ-la kala fa sɩ hilime, ba sii pɛ ba nɩhɩasɩ-la lɛ a kɛŋ Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rom tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩŋ ŋaa ba wuri ba gɛnnɩŋ aŋ vɩɩrɛba.

english_verse: After they had been badly beaten, they were put in jail, and the jailer was told to guard them carefully.
translation_verse: Ba faasa vɩɩrɛba aŋ kɛmba tɔ dɩa, aŋ bʋla pɩ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa bibennu-la dɩ ʋ tɔba woruŋ dɩ ba sɩ́ wuo lɩɩ.

english_verse: The jailer did as he was told. He put them deep inside the jail and chained their feet to heavy blocks of wood.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɩɩ ba niiŋ a kɛŋ Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas a kaa kiele jʋʋ sɩpaaŋ dɩa tʋɔŋ, a kɛŋ ba naasɩŋ balɩamɩŋ kala hɛ kuruŋ.

english_verse: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing praises to God, while the other prisoners listened.
translation_verse: Tɩta-siesee Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa. Nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa kʋkaanaa ma jijegili.

english_verse: Suddenly a strong earthquake shook the jail to its foundations. The doors opened, and the chains fell from all the prisoners.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tinteeŋ guu zigili a kɛŋ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa-la ma kala kaa zigili. Borusuŋ kala guu suri. Nʋʋkala kuruŋ ma lɩɩ tel.

english_verse: When the jailer woke up and saw that the doors were open, he thought that the prisoners had escaped. He pulled out his sword and was about to kill himself.
translation_verse: Nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa bibennu-la hirige sii doŋ lɛ a na dɩ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa-la borusuŋ kala suro. Ʋ bɩɩna nɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa lɩɩ fá viiri nɛ. Ʋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ tokobii dɩ ʋ kpʋ ʋ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: But Paul shouted, “Don't harm yourself! No one has escaped.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl faasa kpɩa a bʋla pʋ, “Sɩ́ ŋ tɩtɩa kpʋ. La kala nɛ hɛ daha.”

english_verse: The jailer asked for a torch and went into the jail. He was shaking all over as he knelt down in front of Paul and Silas.
translation_verse: Sarɩka bibennu-la ŋaa ba kɛŋ chaanɩŋ kaa kɔ. Ʋ laa fá jʋʋ, a tuu tel Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas naasɩŋ lɛ a chichel.

english_verse: After he had led them out of the jail, he asked, “What must I do to be saved?”
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛmba kaa lɩɩ a pɩɛsɛba, “Mɩ nandɔnsʋŋ, ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa laamɛ ta?”

english_verse: They replied, “Have faith in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved! This is also true for everyone who lives in your home.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pʋ, “Laa La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa dii, dɩ Wɩa laa ŋ dɩ ŋ dɩa nɩaa kala ta.”

english_verse: Then Paul and Silas told him and everyone else in his house about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl La Tɩɩna Yesu niiŋ wɩaa pɩ ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: While it was still night, the jailer took them to a place where he could wash their cuts and bruises. Then he and everyone in his home were baptized.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ-la tɩtɩa nɛ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa bibennu-la kɛmba a chɛsɛ ba yaraa naawɩɩlaa, ka ba fo ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: They were very glad they had put their faith in God. After this, the jailer took Paul and Silas to his home and gave them something to eat.
translation_verse: Nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa bibennu-la kɛŋ Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas a kaa mʋ ʋ dɩa, a pɩba kʋdiilee ba dii. Ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala ŋaa tʋɔtɔrʋ arɩ ba sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii.

english_verse: The next morning the officials sent some police with orders for the jailer to let Paul and Silas go.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, Rom nɩhɩasɩŋ tɩŋ ba porisi kʋhɩasɩŋ dɩ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa bibennu-la dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas.

english_verse: The jailer told Paul, “The officials have ordered me to set you free. Now you can leave in peace.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa bibennu-la bʋla pɩ Pɔɔl, “Rom nɩhɩasɩ-la tɩma dɩ ba bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ mɩ lɩɩsɛ ŋ dɩ Saalas. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma mʋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.”

english_verse: But Paul told the police, “We are Roman citizens, and the Roman officials had us beaten in public without giving us a trial. They threw us into jail. Now do they think they can secretly send us away? No, they cannot! They will have to come here themselves and let us out.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl bʋla pɩ porisi-hɩasɩ-la, “La ŋaa Rom tɩmma nɛ ka ba vɩɩrɛla nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a kɛnla tɔ dɩa aŋ bɩ la sarɩya die a dagɛ wɩɩ-la la sɩ cheye. Ka lɛɛlɛ baa chɛ dɩ la lʋara viiri. Aɩ, la bɩ sɛɩ. Ʋ maga dɩ Rom nɩhɩasɩ-la tɩtɩa kɔ daha nɛ a kʋ lɩɩsɛla.”

english_verse: When the police told the officials that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, the officials were afraid.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ porisi kʋhɩasɩ-la mʋ bʋla pɩ Rom nɩhɩasɩ-la arɩ Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas ma ŋaa Rom tɩmma nɛ. Ba sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba.

english_verse: So they came and apologized. They led them out of the jail and asked them to please leave town.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sii mʋ sʋlba arɩ ba cheye nɛ aŋ lɩɩsɛba nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa lɛ, aŋ sʋlba dɩ ba lɩɩ ba taŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But Paul and Silas went straight to the home of Lydia, where they saw the Lord's followers and encouraged them. Then they left.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ lɩɩ nɩtɔɔrɩ dɩa lɛ, ba mʋ Lidia dɩa. Nɩmɛ nɛ ba na nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, a bʋl wɩaa nyaasɛ ba nyuŋ, aŋ viiri.

english_verse: After Paul and his friends had traveled through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they went on to Thessalonica. A synagogue was in that city.
translation_verse: Ba sɩɩ viiri ŋɩɩ, ba mʋ to taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Amfiipolis, a bɩra sii nɩmɛ a to taŋ dɔŋɔ maa baa yɩrɛ Apoloonia, a lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Tɛsalonaaka. Juu tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa fa hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: So as usual, Paul went there to worship, and on three Sabbaths he spoke to the people. He used the Scriptures
translation_verse: Pɔɔl mʋ jʋʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa-la arɩ ʋ sɩ vɛnɛɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ lee-na kala. Ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ joŋ chɛ-wiesie-la batori a kɛŋ Wɩa teniŋ a magɩsɛ wɩaa a pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: to show them that the Messiah had to suffer, but that he would rise from death. Paul also told them that Jesus is the Messiah he was preaching about.
translation_verse: Ʋ karɩmɛ Wɩa teniŋ aŋ dagɛba arɩ Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa maga dɩ ʋ na hɛɛŋ a sʋʋ aŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ. Pɔɔl bɩra sɩ, “Yesu deeŋ wɩaa ʋ sɩ bʋlaa pɩma nɛ ŋaa Kirisito.”

english_verse: Some of them believed what Paul had said, and they became followers with Paul and Silas. Some Gentiles and many important women also believed the message.
translation_verse: Juu tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ laa wɩalɩŋ dii a pɛ Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas lɛ. Ba tʋɔŋ Giriik tɩmma-la sɩɩ fá Wɩa arɩ haala-la sɩ ŋaa nɩbalaa ba taŋ lɛ ma yʋga a laa wɩalɩŋ dii a pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders were jealous and got some troublemakers who hung around the marketplace to start a riot in the city. They wanted to drag Paul and Silas out to the mob, and so they went straight to Jason's home.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa yaraa bibieri. Ba chɛ kɛsɛ nyu-duo tɩŋŋaa sɩ yie bɩbaarɛ wombiee arɩ yɔɔsʋŋ tʋɔŋ a pɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ jaŋ-la hosi. Ba mʋ jʋʋ Jaasɩŋ dɩa dɩ ba chɛ kɛŋ Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas a kaa kʋ lɩɩ nɩ-daŋ-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But when they did not find them there, they dragged out Jason and some of the Lord's followers. They took them to the city authorities and shouted, “Paul and Silas have been upsetting things everywhere. Now they have come here,
translation_verse: Ama ba bɩ ba na, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ Jaasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a lɛrɛba lɩɩ ba taŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ teeŋ, aŋ ŋɩŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “Nɩaa deemba chei lee-kala nɛ aŋ lɛɛlɛ kɔ la jaŋ.

english_verse: and Jason has welcomed them into his home. All of them break the laws of the Roman Emperor by claiming that someone named Jesus is king.”
translation_verse: Ka Jaasɩŋ laaba bil ʋ dɩa lɛ. Ba kala chei wɩɩ-la la kuoru-balɩŋ sɩ bile nɛ aŋ bʋl dɩ kuoru dɔŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, baa yɩrɛ Yesu.”

english_verse: The officials and the people were upset when they heard this.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba ba sɩ bʋla leŋ nɩalɩŋ arɩ ba taŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ kala bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: So they made Jason and the other followers pay bail before letting them go. People in Berea Welcome the Message
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ taŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ ŋaa Jaasɩŋ arɩ ʋ dɔnsʋ-la sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii tiŋ moribiee, aŋ ka ba lemba. Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas mʋ Biriya tinteeŋ

english_verse: That same night the Lord's followers sent Paul and Silas on to Berea, and after they arrived, they went to the synagogue.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ bire, nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii ŋaa Pɔɔl arɩ Saalas lɩɩ mʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Biriya. Ba sɩ yi nɩmɛ, ba mʋ jʋʋ Juu tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa.

english_verse: The people in Berea were much nicer than those in Thessalonica, and they gladly accepted the message. Day after day they studied the Scriptures to see if these things were true.
translation_verse: Juu tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Biriya lɛ nɛ kɛŋ mɛlɛ a kɩɩ Juu tɩmma-la fa sɩ hɛ Tɛsalonaaka lɛ. Ba chaga laa Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ arɩ na-kparɩba nɛ, a kɩkarɩmɛ Wɩa teniŋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-na kala, dɩ ba na wɩalɩŋ Pɔɔl sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ.

english_verse: Many of them put their faith in the Lord, including some important Greek women and several men.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ nɩaa yʋga nɛ a laa Yesu wɩaa dii. Giriik tɩŋŋaa haala-la sɩ ŋaa nɩbalaa arɩ ba baalaa kala laa Yesu wɩaa dii.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders in Thessalonica heard that Paul had been preaching God's message in Berea, they went there and caused trouble by turning the crowds against Paul.
translation_verse: Juu tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Tɛsalonaaka lɛ sɩ nɩa dɩ Pɔɔl bɩra bʋl Wɩa wɩaa Biriya ma lɛ. Ba sii mʋ nɩmɛ ma a nyɩsɛ nɩ-daŋ-la hɛ.

english_verse: At once the followers sent Paul down to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed in Berea.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii ŋaa Pɔɔl lɩɩ a mʋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ, ka Saalas arɩ Timoti bɩ mʋa aŋ hɛ Biriya lɛ.

english_verse: Some men went with Paul as far as Athens, and then returned with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible. Paul in Athens
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Biriya a to Pɔɔl harɩŋ, a kɛnʋ kaa mʋ Atɛŋ. Pɔɔl mɩɩra tɩmba dɩ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Saalas arɩ Timoti dɩ ba kʋ chemu lɩma. Pɔɔl mʋ Atɛŋ tinteeŋ

english_verse: While Paul was waiting in Athens, he was upset to see all the idols in the city.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ hɔŋ Atɛŋ lɛ a gbɩgbɛrɛ Saalas arɩ Timoti, ʋ na dɩ tɔŋŋɔɔ su taŋ-la kala. Ʋ tʋɔŋ faasa chei.

english_verse: He went to the synagogue to speak to the Jews and to anyone who worshiped with them. Day after day he also spoke to everyone he met in the market.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl mʋ Juu tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa, ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa aŋ fɩfá Wɩa, magɩsɛ wɩaa pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ yie jʋʋ yɔbɔ ma chɛɛ-na kala a bʋl Wɩa wɩaa a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɔ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Some of them were Epicureans and some were Stoics, and they started arguing with him. People were asking, “What is this know-it-all trying to say?” Some even said, “Paul must be preaching about foreign gods! That's what he means when he talks about Jesus and about people rising from death.”
translation_verse: Kerichiba-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ to Epikuuras wombiiŋ arɩ Sɩtɔɩk kerichiba dɔnsʋŋ ma kʋ naʋ a kɛŋ wɩaa lɩlɛrɛ ʋ teeŋ. Ba dɔnsʋŋ pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ kɩaa wɩaa nɛ nɩyaarɩŋ deeŋ ma chɩnaa bʋl?” Dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ, “Ʋ naga veŋ-falɩɩ wɩaa nɛ ʋ bʋbʋl.” Pɔɔl sɩ yie bʋl Yesu wɩaa arɩ ʋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ tɩɩ ba bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: They brought Paul before a council called the Areopagus, and said, “Tell us what your new teaching is all about.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛnʋ kaa mʋ ba sɩ yie hilimi dɩa-la lɛ baa yɩrɛ Arɩyɔpagɩs a bʋl, “La cho dɩ la nɩɩ wʋfalɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa ŋ sɩɩ dagʋ nɛ.

english_verse: We have heard you say some strange things, and we want to know what you mean.”
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ŋ sɩɩ bʋl ŋaa wʋfalɩa nɛ la teeŋ. La saa cho dɩ la nɩɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ woruŋ.”

english_verse: More than anything else the people of Athens and the foreigners living there loved to hear and to talk about anything new.
translation_verse: Atɛŋ nɩaa arɩ ba nʋhʋɔraa kala fa bɩ wɩɩkala kɛnɛ a pɛ wʋfalaa nɩɩnɩŋ arɩ ba bʋlʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: So Paul stood up in front of the council and said: People of Athens, I see that you are very religious.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl sii chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hilime tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Atɛŋ tɩmma, mɩ sɩ kɔ daha, mɩ na arɩ ma cho vʋɩyaa kpaarɩŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: As I was going through your city and looking at the things you worship, I found an altar with the words, “To an Unknown God.” You worship this God, but you don't really know him. So I want to tell you about him.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩ gɔllɛ ma taŋ lɛ, mɩ na ma vesiŋ. Mɩ bɩra na koruŋ ma ma sɩ saa. Ŋ-la nɛ ma tuuro hɛ ʋ lɛ: ‘WƖA-LA LA SƖ BƖ JƖŊ DƖ-KPAARƖŊ NƐ Ŋ-LA.’ ” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl bɩra bʋl, “Wɩa-la ma sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ aŋ bɩ ʋ jɩŋ, ʋ wɩaa nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: This God made the world and everything in it. He is Lord of heaven and earth, and he doesn't live in temples built by human hands.
translation_verse: Wɩa-la sɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa arɩ kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ, a ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala Tɩɩna, ʋ bɩ lere-la nuhuobiine sɩ saa aa kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa ka jʋʋ.

english_verse: He doesn't need help from anyone. He gives life, breath, and everything else to all people.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ naga ʋ sɩ chɛ kʋŋ ka nɛ tɩɩ ʋʋ chɛ nuhuobiinee tɩma pʋ. Ʋ nɛ pɩ nuhuobiinee mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ wiese arɩ kʋŋkala.

english_verse: From one person God made all nations who live on earth, and he decided when and where every nation would be.
translation_verse: Wɩa ta nɩbala nɛ bumbuŋ-la. Nɩbala-la lɛ nɛ dʋnɩa tinteyee kala to kɔ, a hɔŋ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ kala. Ka dɩ ʋ ŋaaba, ʋ nɛ dagɛ bʋa-la ba sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, arɩ lere-la kala ba sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ.

english_verse: God has done all this, so that we will look for him and reach out and find him. He isn't far from any of us,
translation_verse: Wɩa ŋaaba ŋɩɩ dɩ ba wuo bee chɛʋ a lɩlaarɛ lee-kala dɩ ba naʋ. Ama Wɩa saa bɩ dɩ-bolii hɛ. Ʋ kpagɛla kʋŋkala nɛ.

english_verse: and he gives us the power to live, to move, and to be who we are. “We are his children,” just as some of your poets have said.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ kʋbala nɛ bʋla arɩ ʋ doluŋ lɛ nɛ la kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a vɩvɛŋ a hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ saa ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ma gɔgʋ-dɩndɛnnɛɛ dɔnsʋŋ ma fa bʋla arɩ la ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Since we are God's children, we must not think that he is like an idol made out of gold or silver or stone. He isn't like anything that humans have thought up and made.
translation_verse: La saa sɩ ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ la bɩɩnɛ arɩ Wɩa nagɛ kɩalɩŋ nuhuobiine sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ kaa mɛ nɛ, koo kʋ-la ba sɩ kɛŋ hɔɔŋ koo tabɩɩŋ kaa ŋaa nɛ. Ʋ bɩ naga kɩaa deemba nuhuobiine sɩ kɛŋ ʋ jɩma kaa ŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: In the past, God forgave all this because people did not know what they were doing. But now he says that everyone everywhere must turn to him.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nuhuobiinee sɩ bɩ ʋ jɩŋ, ʋ fa tɔrɩkɔ nɛ ba nyuŋ. Ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ bʋla pɩpɩ nʋʋkala lee-na kala dɩ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ,

english_verse: He has set a day when he will judge the world's people with fairness. And he has chosen the man Jesus to do the judging for him. God has given proof of this to all of us by raising Jesus from death.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ hɛ tapʋlɩɩ nɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa kala sarɩya arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ʋ jaŋ to nuhuobiiŋ-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa lɛ nɛ a dii sarɩya-la. Nɩɩ-la sɩ sʋba, ʋ chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ a leŋ nʋʋkala jɩŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.”

english_verse: As soon as the people heard Paul say a man had been raised from death, some of them started laughing. Others said, “We will hear you talk about this some other time.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩa arɩ Pɔɔl bʋl sʋʋŋ siiniŋ lɛ wɩaa, ba dɔnsʋŋ mʋmɔmʋ, ama dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ, “La jaŋ cho dɩ ŋ maachie bɩra bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩla.”

english_verse: When Paul left the council meeting,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl sii a lɩɩ lee-la ba sɩ hilime.

english_verse: some of the men put their faith in the Lord and went with Paul. One of them was a council member named Dionysius. A woman named Damaris and several others also put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ laa wɩalɩŋ dii a to ʋ harɩŋ. Ba tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Dayɔnaasɩas. Ʋ fa hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ hilimi Arɩyɔpagɩs dɩa-la tʋɔŋ nɛ. Haal kʋbala ma baa yɩrɛ Damarɩs arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma laa wɩalɩŋ dii.

english_verse: Paul left Athens and went to Corinth,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ Pɔɔl sii Atɛŋ lɛ a mʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Kɔrɩntɩ.

english_verse: where he met Aquila, a Jewish man from Pontus. Not long before this, Aquila had come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Emperor Claudius had ordered the Jewish people to leave Rome. Paul went to see Aquila and Priscilla
translation_verse: Dɩmɛ nɛ ʋ na Juu tɩɩna kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Akuila. Ʋ lɩɩ Pɔntɔs sɩ hɛ Rom tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ dɩ ʋ haala Pɩrɩsɩla sɩ lɩɩ Rom kɔ, ʋ bɩ diene. Kuori-balɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɩlaadɩa fa bʋla pɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa kala dɩ ba lɩɩ Rom lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba sii kɔ. Pɔɔl mʋ ba dɩa dɩ ʋ chʋɔlɛba.

english_verse: and found out they were tent makers. Paul was also a tent maker, so he stayed with them, and they worked together.
translation_verse: Ʋ mʋ jʋʋ ba dɩa a chʋchʋa nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba kala tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-bala nɛ. Ba fa kɛŋ teniŋ yɛrɛ lɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ aa yallɛ.

english_verse: Every Sabbath, Paul went to the synagogue. He spoke to Jews and Gentiles and tried to win them over.
translation_verse: Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ kala ʋ yie mʋ ba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa. Ʋ dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ Giriik tɩŋŋaa magɩsɛ wɩaa pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ba sɛɩ ʋ wɩɩŋ.

english_verse: But after Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, he spent all his time preaching to the Jews about Jesus the Messiah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Saalas arɩ Timoti lɩɩ Masidoonia kɔ. Bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kɔ, Pɔɔl joŋ ʋ nyuŋ kala hɛ aa bʋl Wɩa wɩaa, a dagɛ woruŋ a pɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa Kirisito.

english_verse: Finally, they turned against him and insulted him. So he shook the dust from his clothes and told them, “Whatever happens to you will be your own fault! I am not to blame. From now on I am going to preach to the Gentiles.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩmma-la lɩɩ Pɔɔl harɩŋ aŋ tʋʋsʋ. Ba sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ kpesi ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ hɛ ba lɛ aŋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ nyʋa ma nyuŋ lɛ. Mɩ wɩɩ dee. A lɩɩ jɩnɩŋ mɩ jaŋ mʋ a bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa.”

english_verse: Paul then moved into the house of a man named Titius Justus, who worshiped God and lived next door to the synagogue.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ aŋ sii mʋ jʋʋ baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Taatɩs Jasɩtɩs dɩa. Ʋ faa to Wɩa nɛ. Ʋ dɩa kpagɛ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa nɛ.

english_verse: Crispus was the leader of the synagogue. He and everyone in his family put their faith in the Lord. Many others in Corinth also heard the message, and all the people who had faith in the Lord were baptized.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Kɩrɩsɩpas nɛ fa ŋaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa-la kʋhɩaŋ. Ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala laa La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa dii. Nɩaa ma yʋga Kɔrɩntɩ lɛ a nɩɩ Wɩa wɩalɩŋ a laaba dii, ba foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: One night, Paul had a vision, and in it the Lord said, “Don't be afraid to keep on preaching. Don't stop!
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋ kʋbala Pɔɔl na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ dɩ Wɩa bʋla pʋ, “Sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá. Ha bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa a sɩ́ leŋ.

english_verse: I am with you, and you won't be harmed. Many people in this city belong to me.”
translation_verse: Mɩ chɩŋ ŋ harɩŋ nɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛnɩŋ a ŋaaŋ wʋbɔŋ kala, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɩaa yʋga taŋ deeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Paul stayed on in Corinth for a year and a half, teaching God's message to the people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl hɔŋ nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ jɩna arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a dɩdagɛ nɩalɩŋ Wɩa wɩaa.

english_verse: While Gallio was governor of Achaia, some of the Jewish leaders got together and grabbed Paul. They brought him into court
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Galio nɛ fa chɩŋ Rom kuoru balɩŋ naasɩŋ lɛ aa beŋ Giriisi tinteeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa sii hɛ dɔŋɔ a kɛŋ Pɔɔl kaa mʋ ba sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ.

english_verse: and said, “This man is trying to make our people worship God in a way that is against our Law!”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ, “Baala deeŋ walɩmɛ dɩ nɩaa sɛɩ a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa wombii-la sɩ jaŋ chei wombii-la la sɩɩ to nɛ.”

english_verse: Even before Paul could speak, Gallio said, “If you were charging this man with a crime or some other wrong, I would have to listen to you.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ ŋaa dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ Galio bʋla pɩ Juu tɩmma-la, “Juu tɩmma, dɩ baala deeŋ nɛ fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ koo a ŋaa wɩɩ dɔŋ chei, ʋ fa jaŋ kɛŋ wombii dɩ mɩ kɛŋ kenyiri a jegile nɩɩ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: But since this concerns only words, names, and your own law, you will have to take care of it yourselves. I refuse to judge such matters.”
translation_verse: Ama ʋ sɩ ŋaa wʋbʋlɩɩ nɛ ma kaa lɛrɛ arɩ yɩraa wɩaa, arɩ ma tɩtɩa wombiee ma sɩɩ to wɩaa nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ma tɩtɩa kaa mʋ bʋla wasɛ nɛ dɩa lɛ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo laa wɩɩŋ deeŋ jɩŋ.”

english_verse: Then he sent them out of the court.
translation_verse: Ʋ kiriba ta ba lɩɩ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ.

english_verse: The crowd grabbed Sosthenes, the Jewish leader, and beat him up in front of the court. But none of this mattered to Gallio. Paul Returns to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Ba kala lɩɩ gollo kɛŋ Sɔsɩtɛnɛs, nɩɩ-la fa sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa kʋhɩaŋ, a ŋmobu sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ boiŋ niiŋ. Ama Galio sɩpaa kala fa tuo nɩmɛ. Pɔɔl mɩɩra mʋ Antɩɔk tinteeŋ

english_verse: After Paul had stayed for a while with the Lord's followers in Corinth, he told them goodbye and sailed on to Syria with Aquila and Priscilla. But before he left, he had his head shaved at Cenchreae because he had made a promise to God.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl hɛ Kɔrɩntɩ lɛ a dieni. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ta nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii Kɔrɩntɩ lɛ aŋ lɩɩ. Ʋ dɩ Pɩrɩsɩla arɩ Akuila kala sii mʋ a jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro dɩ ba mʋ Siiria tinteeŋ. Ka dɩ ba-na jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la, Pɔɔl fʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Keŋkiriya lɛ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ ta niiŋ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: The three of them arrived in Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He then went into the synagogue to talk with the people there.
translation_verse: Ba mʋ yi taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Ɛfɛsɩs. Nɩmɛ Pɔɔl leŋ Pɩrɩsɩla arɩ Akuila aŋ mʋ jʋʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa. Ʋ dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa magɩsɛ wɩaa pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: They asked him to stay longer, but he refused.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ bʋl dɩ ʋ hɔŋ ba teeŋ dieni, ka ʋ bɩ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: After staying there for a while, he left and visited several places in Galatia and Phrygia. He helped the followers there to become stronger in their faith. Apollos in Ephesus
translation_verse: Ʋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ a dieni mʋa a bɩra sii, a to Galiisia arɩ Firijia tinteeŋ, a bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɩmɛ dɩ ba wasa chɩŋ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ laa Wɩa dii naaŋ lɛ. Apɔlɔs mʋ Ɛfɛsɩs arɩ Kɔrɩntɩ tinteeŋ

english_verse: A Jewish man named Apollos came to Ephesus. Apollos had been born in the city of Alexandria. He was a very good speaker and knew a lot about the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Juu tɩɩna ma nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, baa yɩrɛ Apɔlɔs, ʋ lɩɩ Alɛkɩzandɩrɩa nɛ. Ʋ sii kɔ Ɛfɛsɩs. Ʋ fa jɩŋ wɩaa bʋlʋŋ nɛ woruŋ, a jɩŋ Wɩa teniŋ ma woruŋ.

english_verse: He also knew much about the Lord's Way, and he spoke about it with great excitement. What he taught about Jesus was right, but all he knew was John's message about baptism.
translation_verse: Ba fa dagʋ La Tɩɩna Yesu wombii-la tonuŋ nɛ. Ʋʋ dagɛ Yesu wɩaa woruŋ arɩ sɩɩfɩaŋ. Wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ bʋla aa tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, Jɔɔŋ sɩɩ fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ ŋɩɩ dʋndʋŋa wɩaa nɛ ʋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: Apollos started speaking bravely in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him to their home and helped him understand God's Way even better.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ hɛ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ, ʋ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa arɩ nyuduoŋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa lɛ. Pɩrɩsɩla arɩ Akuila hɛ nɩmɛ a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛnʋ kaa mʋ ba dɩa a wasa dagʋ Wɩa wombii-la woruŋ.

english_verse: Apollos decided to travel through Achaia. So the Lord's followers wrote letters, encouraging the followers there to welcome him. After Apollos arrived in Achaia, he was a great help to everyone who had put their faith in the Lord Jesus because of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Apɔlɔs chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ Giriisi tinteeŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ pɛ ʋ lɛ a ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii Giriisi lɛ, a bʋla pɩba dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ, ba kɛnʋ woruŋ. Ʋ sɩ mʋ yi nɩmɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ʋ chaasa pɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: He got into fierce arguments with the Jewish people, and in public he used the Scriptures to prove that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa faasa kɛŋ wɩaa lɩlɛrɛ nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ʋ bʋla loba, aŋ dagɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa Kirisito.

english_verse: While Apollos was in Corinth, Paul traveled across the hill country to Ephesus, where he met some of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Apɔlɔs fa sɩ hɛ Kɔrɩntɩ lɛ ŋɩɩ, Pɔɔl bɩra gɔllɛ ŋɩɩ a kɔ Ɛfɛsɩs, a na nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii.

english_verse: He asked them, “When you put your faith in Jesus, were you given the Holy Spirit?” “No!” they answered. “We have never even heard of the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl pɩɛsɛba, “Wɩa joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ma lɛ nɛɛ bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sɩ, “Aɩ, la ha bɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ wɩaa nɩa.”

english_verse: “Then why were you baptized?” Paul asked. They answered, “Because of what John taught.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl bɩra pɩɛsɛba, “Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩ bɛɛ doho nɛ ba foma?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋl, “Jɔɔŋ sɩɩ fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩ-la nɛ la fo.”

english_verse: Paul replied, “John baptized people so they would turn to God. But he also told them someone else was coming, and they should put their faith in him. Jesus is the one that John was talking about.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl bɩra bʋl, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ, Jɔɔŋ fufo Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ. Ʋ fa bʋla pɩba arɩ nʋʋ jaŋ kɔ ʋ harɩŋ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Yesu, dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ ba laa ʋ wɩaa dii.”

english_verse: After the people heard Paul say this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ Pɔɔl sɩ bʋla, ba ŋaa ba foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then Paul placed his hands on them. The Holy Spirit was given to them, and they spoke unknown languages and prophesied.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl joŋ ʋ nɩsaa daŋ ba lɛ. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ tuu hɛ ba lɛ. Ba suomo bʋbʋl yikori wogusuŋ ba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ, a bʋl Wɩa wɩaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ ma.

english_verse: There were about twelve men in this group.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba kala fa ŋaa arɩ baalaa fii arɩ balɩa nɛ.

english_verse: For three months Paul went to the synagogue and talked bravely with the people about God's kingdom. He tried to win them over,
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ hɛ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ, ʋ vɛnɛ jʋjʋʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa chɛnsɩŋ batori nɛ, a chaasa bʋbʋl Wɩa kuorii-la wɩaa arɩ nyuduoŋ. Ba dɩ nɩaa kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ lɩlɛrɛ, ʋ wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ba sɛɩ ʋ wɩɩŋ.

english_verse: but some of them were stubborn and refused to believe. In front of everyone they said terrible things about God's Way. Paul left and took the followers with him to the lecture hall of Tyrannus. He spoke there every day
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ nyuŋ fa dolie, ba vɩa dɩ ba laa wɩɩ-la dii, aŋ bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a kɛŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu wombii-la tonuŋ chichei. Pɔɔl lemba aŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii kaa mʋ. Ba jʋʋ baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Tɩranas dɩɩ-bal kʋbala. Pɔɔl arɩ nɩaa yie vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa nɩmɛ tapʋlɩɩ-na kala.

english_verse: for two years, until every Jew and Gentile in Asia had heard the Lord's message. The Sons of Sceva
translation_verse: Ba vɛnɛɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a yi jɩsɩŋ balɩa nɛ. Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ Giriik tɩŋŋaa kala sɩ hɛ Esia tinteeŋ lɛ wuo nɩɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa. Sɩkɩɩva biiriŋ gɔllɔ kiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ

english_verse: God gave Paul the power to work great miracles.
translation_verse: Wɩa fa joŋ dol-bal kʋbala nɛ a pɩ Pɔɔl, ʋ ŋɩŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ.

english_verse: People even took handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched Paul's body, and they carried them to everyone who was sick. All of the sick people were healed, and the evil spirits went out.
translation_verse: Gɛnnɩŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ biisi-la ma sɩ digi Pɔɔl yaraa, nɩaa yie paa nɛ a kaa mʋ pɩ nyanyal tɩŋŋaa ba duduori. Dɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ kɛŋ nʋʋ ma, ba lɩɩ tɩɩna lɛ.

english_verse: Some Jewish men started going around trying to force out evil spirits by using the name of the Lord Jesus. They said to the spirits, “Come out in the name of that same Jesus that Paul preaches about!”
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ a gɔllɛ a kikiri jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ nɩaa lɛ. Ba wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Ba bʋla pɩ jɩŋ-bɔmɔ-la “Mɩ sɩ, má lɩɩ, Yesu, nɩɩ-la wɩaa Pɔɔl sɩɩ bʋl yɩrɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Seven sons of a high priest named Sceva were doing this,
translation_verse: Baalaa balɩpɛ nɛ faa ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ba nyɩmma yɩrɩŋ nɛ Sɩkɩɩva. Ʋ fa ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: when an evil spirit said to them, “I know Jesus! And I have heard about Paul. But who are you?”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ jɩŋ Yesu nɛ, a jɩŋ Pɔɔl ma, aŋ ka ma ma nɛ kʋbɛɛba?”

english_verse: Then the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and beat them up. They ran out of the house, naked and bruised.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ jɩŋ-bɔmʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ baal-la sii fɩla jɩlba a wuoba, a ŋmooba woruŋ a pɩrɛba kala. Ba gɛnnɩŋ kala kɩɛsɛ, ka ba kɛŋ yarɩ-biree fá lɩɩ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: When the Jews and Gentiles in Ephesus heard about this, they were so frightened that they praised the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ. Fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba kala. Ba dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu woruŋ.

english_verse: Many who were followers now started telling everyone about the evil things they had been doing.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ ma dɔnsʋŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii yʋga kɔ, a dagɛ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa a pɩ Pɔɔl, nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: So the Lord's message spread and became even more powerful. The Riot in Ephesus
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ La Tɩɩna niiŋ wɩaa teeli leriŋ kala a dol woruŋ. Nɩaa hɛ yuosuŋ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ

english_verse: After all this had happened, Paul decided to visit Macedonia and Achaia on his way to Jerusalem. Paul had said, “From there I will go on to Rome.”
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala sɩ ŋaa harɩŋ lɛ nɛ, Pɔɔl bɩɩnɛ dɩ ʋ to Masidoonia tinteeŋ arɩ Giriisi tinteeŋ a mʋ Jerusalɛm. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Dɩ mɩ nɛ mʋ nɩmɛ, ʋ maga dɩ mɩ mʋ Rom ma.”

english_verse: So he sent his two helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia. But he stayed on in Asia for a while.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ balɩa fa sɩɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ, Timoti arɩ Ɩrasɩtas dɩ ba mʋ Masidoonia. Aŋ ka ʋ tɩtɩa hɔŋ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ Esia tinteeŋ a dieni mʋa.

english_verse: At that time there was serious trouble because of the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ yuo-bal nɛ fa sii Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ a tɩgɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu wombii-la tonuŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: A silversmith named Demetrius had a business that made silver models of the temple of the goddess Artemis. Those who worked for him earned a lot of money.
translation_verse: Libiru kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Dɛmɩɩtɩas. Ʋ fa kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ a kaa lilibi kɩaa, ba nagɛ ba taŋ veŋ-balɩŋ Atɛmɩs. Tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ lɛ ba dɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa na moribiee kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Demetrius brought together everyone who was in the same business and said: Friends, you know we make a good living at this.
translation_verse: Chɛɛ kʋbala ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la doho a bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ nandɔmba, ma jɩma arɩ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ la na didii.

english_verse: But you have surely seen and heard how this man Paul is upsetting a lot of people, not only in Ephesus, but almost everywhere in Asia. He claims that the gods we humans make are not really gods at all.
translation_verse: Ma tɩtɩa nɩa nɛ a nɩna wɩalɩŋ ma Pɔɔl sɩɩ bʋl. Ʋ sɩ: Vʋɩya-la nuhuobiinee sɩɩ libu, ba bɩ wɩa ŋaa. Ʋ saa wuo kɛŋ nɩ-daŋ nyusuŋ bɩrɩmɛ ba sɛɩ wɩɩ-la. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Ɛfɛsɩs deeŋ arɩ Esia tinteeŋ jesiŋ kala lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone will start saying terrible things about our business. They will stop respecting the temple of the goddess Artemis, who is worshiped in Asia and all over the world. Our great goddess will be forgotten!
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na sɩɩ fá nɛ ŋ-la: Nɩaa jaŋ chei la tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ yɩrɩŋ. La bɩraa fá arɩ la veŋ-balɩŋ Atɛmɩs dɩa jaŋ kʋ ŋaa ku-tɔɔ. Nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋu dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋŋ. Lɛɛlɛ Esia nɩaa arɩ dʋnɩa nʋʋkala nɩɩ kpaarʋ.”

english_verse: When the workers heard this, they got angry and started shouting, “Great is Artemis, the goddess of the Ephesians!”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ba baanɩŋ sii. Ba ŋaa goŋ a bʋbʋl, “La veŋ-balɩŋ Atɛmɩs sɩ hɛ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ.”

english_verse: Soon the whole city was in a riot, and some men grabbed Gaius and Aristarchus, who had come from Macedonia with Paul. Then everyone in the crowd rushed to the place where the town meetings were held.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ taŋ-la kala hosi. Nɩ-daŋ-la kɛŋ Gayas arɩ Arɩsɩtakʋs sɩ lɩɩ Masidoonia a tuto Pɔɔl harɩŋ. Ba lɛrɛba kaa mʋ lee-la taŋ-la nɩaa sɩ yie hihilimi.

english_verse: Paul wanted to go out and speak to the people, but the Lord's followers would not let him.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl fa cho dɩ ʋ mʋ jʋʋ nɩ-daŋ-la tʋɔŋ, ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii bɩ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: A few of the local officials were friendly to Paul, and they sent someone to warn him not to go.
translation_verse: Esia tinteeŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ dii Pɔɔl nandɔnsʋŋ tɩŋ dɩ ba sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ jʋʋ.

english_verse: Some of the people in the meeting were shouting one thing, and others were shouting something else. Everyone was completely confused, and most of them did not even know why they were there.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hilime bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ ba sɩ hɛ. Dɔnsʋŋ ŋaa goŋ a bʋl ŋ-la nɛ, dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ. Ba jesiŋ kala paala fa bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ba kʋ hilimi.

english_verse: Several of the Jewish leaders pushed a man named Alexander to the front of the crowd and started telling him what to say. He motioned with his hand and tried to explain what was going on.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala ma nɛ fa hɛ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ, baa yɩrɛ Alɛkɩzanda. Juu tɩŋŋaa leŋ ʋ lɩɩ chɩŋ ba sɩpaaŋ dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩaa pɩ nɩ-daŋ-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Alɛkɩzanda kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ vigi dɩ ba kɛŋ goŋ, aŋ wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ʋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ arɩ ʋ dɩ ʋ toori dɔnsʋŋ bɩ wɩɩ cheye.
