english_verse: But when the crowd saw that he was Jewish, they all shouted for two hours, “Great is Artemis, the goddess of the Ephesians!”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kʋ jɩŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa Juu tɩɩna nɛ, ba kala bɩra ŋaa goŋ a hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a yi hawaba balɩa aa bʋl, “La veŋ-balɩŋ Atɛmɩs sɩ hɛ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ.”

english_verse: Finally, a town official made the crowd be quiet. Then he said: People of Ephesus, who in the world doesn't know that our city is the center for worshiping the great goddess Artemis? Who doesn't know that her image which fell from heaven is right here?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba taŋ kerichi-hɩaŋ-la kʋ lɩɩ a wuo ŋaa ba kɛŋ goŋ kala, ka ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ɛfɛsɩs tɩmma, nʋʋkala nɛ jɩma arɩ la taŋ Ɛfɛsɩs nɛ tɩɩ la veŋ-balɩŋ Atɛmɩs arɩ ʋ dɩa kala, a pɛ tabɩɩ-la sɩ́ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ tuu tel, la kpʋkpaarɛ lɛ.

english_verse: No one can deny this, and so you should calm down and not do anything foolish.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ kaa lɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má leŋ goŋ aŋ sɩ́ wɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ ŋaa.

english_verse: You have brought men in here who have not robbed temples or spoken against our goddess.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba bɩ kʋŋ gaa joŋ la veŋ-balɩŋ dɩa lɛ, ba bɩra bɩ wɩɩ bʋla tʋʋsɛ veŋ-balɩŋ ma, ka ma kɛmba kaa kɔ daha.

english_verse: If Demetrius and his workers have a case against these men, we have courts and judges. Let them take their complaints there.
translation_verse: Dɩ Dɛmɩɩtɩas arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔnsʋŋ nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩ arɩ nʋʋ, sarɩya kɛŋ ʋ tapʋl-diilii nɛ, ma taŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ ma hɛ nɩmɛ dɩ ba dii sarɩya. Má leŋ dɩ ba mʋ nɩmɛ bʋl wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: But if you want to do more than that, the matter will have to be brought before the city council.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ wɩɩ dɔŋ ma nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ maa chɛ dɩ ma bʋl, má kaa mʋ taŋ kʋhɩasɩ-la sɩ yie kʋ hilimi teeŋ dɩ ba bʋla wasɛ.

english_verse: We could easily be accused of starting a riot today. There is no excuse for it! We cannot even give a reason for this uproar.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ sɩ nagɛ ŋ-la, la tinteeŋ kʋhɩaŋ jaŋ wuo bʋl la teeŋ a tɩŋ jɩnɩŋ yuosuŋ deeŋ wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa la bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩɩkala a mʋ tɩgɛ yuosu-la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ bʋbʋa kala kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: After saying this, he told the people to leave.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hilime sii viiri.

english_verse: When the riot was over, Paul sent for the followers and encouraged them. He then told them goodbye and left for Macedonia.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ yuosu-la dɛrɛ. Ka Pɔɔl yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩba ba nyuŋ nyaasɛ. Ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ, ʋ taba aŋ sii mʋ Masidoonia tinteeŋ.

english_verse: As he traveled from place to place, he encouraged the followers with many messages. Finally, he went to Greece
translation_verse: Ʋ gɔllɛ Masidoonia tinteeŋ kala a bʋl wɩaa yʋgɛ pɩba dɩ ba nyuŋ nyaasɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka ʋ lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ Giriisi tinteeŋ.

english_verse: and stayed there for three months. Paul was about to sail to Syria. But some of the Jewish leaders plotted against him, so he decided to return by way of Macedonia.
translation_verse: Ʋ hɛ Giriisi tinteeŋ lɛ chɛnsɩŋ batori. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro a mʋ Siiria tinteeŋ. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ nɩɩ dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa vʋʋra dɩ ba kpʋʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩrɩmɛ a mɩɩra sii to Masidoonia tinteeŋ.

english_verse: With him were Sopater, son of Pyrrhus from Berea, and Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica. Gaius from Derbe was also with him, and so were Timothy and the two Asians, Tychicus and Trophimus.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba nɛ fa to ʋ harɩŋ: Dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Sopata a lɩɩ Biriya. Ʋ fa ŋaa Pɩras nanʋala nɛ, a pɛ Arɩsɩtakʋs arɩ Sɛkʋndas sɩ lɩɩ Tɛsalonaaka, arɩ Gayas sɩ lɩɩ Dɛɛbɩ, arɩ Timoti, a pɛ Takɩkas arɩ Tʋrɔfɩmɔs sɩ lɩɩ Esia lɛ.

english_verse: They went on ahead to Troas and waited for us there.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ a mʋ gbɛrɛla Tʋrɔwas lɛ.

english_verse: After the Festival of Thin Bread, we sailed from Philippi. Five days later we met them in Troas and stayed there for a week. Paul's Last Visit to Troas
translation_verse: La hɛ Fɩlɩpa lɛ nɛ, ka ba gbieli gbiele-la ba sɩ yie dii boroboro sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ dɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ la lɩɩ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro, a vɛŋ tapʋlaa banɔŋ aŋ-na mʋ puuba Tʋrɔwas lɛ. La hɛ nɩmɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Pɔɔl mʋ Tʋrɔwas tinteeŋ

english_verse: On the first day of the week we met to break bread together. Paul spoke to the people until midnight because he was leaving the next morning.
translation_verse: Asibiri chɛɛŋ dɩdaanɩŋ la kala hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a dii kʋdiile-la Kirisito fa sɩ sɩ dɩ la didii a liliisi ʋ wɩaa. Ʋ taŋ nɩɩ pʋl dɩ Pɔɔl sii viiri. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ taŋ siesi.

english_verse: In the upstairs room where we were meeting, there were a lot of lamps.
translation_verse: La fa hɔŋ lusuŋ nyuŋ dɩa lɛ nɛ a nyɩgɛ chaanaa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: A young man by the name of Eutychus was sitting on a window sill. While Paul was speaking, the young man got very sleepy. Finally, he went to sleep and fell three floors all the way down to the ground. When they picked him up, he was dead.
translation_verse: Bapʋɔsɩ-bie kʋbala ma hɛ nɩmɛ, baa yɩrɛ Yutikas. Ʋ fa hɔŋ tokoro niiŋ nɛ. Pɔɔl sɩ bʋl wɩaa didieni ŋɩɩ, ʋ hɔnɔ dɩdɩɛgɛ doŋ a joŋo pɩŋ doŋ, a foro lɩɩ dɩɩ-suguloo batori nyuŋ a tuu tel. Ba tuu joŋu dɩ ʋ sʋba.

english_verse: Paul went down and bent over Eutychus. He took him in his arms and said, “Don't worry! He's alive.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl sii tuu time chugili ʋ lɛ a guoru, aŋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩɩ-la walɩmɛma, ʋ weye nɛ.”

english_verse: After Paul had gone back upstairs, he broke bread, and ate with us. He then spoke until dawn and left.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka Pɔɔl bɩra jɩl lusuŋ nyuŋ dɩa-la ba dii kʋdiile-la Kirisito fa sɩ sɩ ba dii a liliisi ʋ wɩaa. Ba sɩ dii dɛrɛ, ʋ bɩra kɛŋ wʋbʋlʋŋ halɩɩ taŋ pʋl, ʋ sii viiri.

english_verse: Then the followers took the young man home alive and were very happy. The Voyage from Troas to Miletus
translation_verse: Nɩaa kɛŋ bapʋɔsɩ-bie-la kaa mʋ dɩa dɩ ʋ weye. Ba tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ. Pɔɔl sii Tʋrɔwas lɛ a mʋ Mɩlɩɩtas

english_verse: Paul decided to travel by land to Assos. The rest of us went on ahead by ship, and we were to take him aboard there.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la sii a mʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro a duoro mʋ Asɔs. Pɔɔl fa bʋla pɩla dɩ ʋ jaŋ vɛŋ naasɩŋ lɛ kʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro Asɔs lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ la jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro a mʋ nɩmɛ dɩ la joŋu.

english_verse: When he met us in Assos, he came aboard, and we sailed on to Mitylene.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ kʋ puula Asɔs lɛ, la joŋu arɩ lɩɩŋ daboro-la a mʋ to Mitilini.

english_verse: The next day we came to a place near Chios, and the following day we reached Samos. The day after that we sailed to Miletus.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, la sii nɩmɛ a duoro kɔ Kɩyɔs. Taŋ bɩra pʋl, la mʋ Samɔs. Taŋ bɩra sɩ pʋla, la sii mʋ Mɩlɩɩtas.

english_verse: Paul had decided to sail on past Ephesus, because he did not want to spend too much time in Asia. He was in a hurry and wanted to be in Jerusalem in time for Pentecost. Paul Says Goodbye to the Church Leaders of Ephesus
translation_verse: Pɔɔl fa bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ dieni Esia tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ faa chɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ Jerusalɛm lɩma lɩma nɛ a puu Pɛntɩkɔs chɛ-gbieli-la. Pɔɔl bʋl wɩaa a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi kʋhɩasɩŋ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ

english_verse: From Miletus, Paul sent a message for the church leaders at Ephesus to come and meet with him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la kiele kɔ Miliitas. Pɔɔl tɩma yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi kʋhɩasɩŋ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ dɩ ba kɔ.

english_verse: When they got there, he said: You know everything I did during the time I was with you when I first came to Asia.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ kɔ, ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ naga nɛ, a chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ Esia tinteeŋ lɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: Some of the Jews plotted against me and caused me a lot of sorrow and trouble. But I served the Lord and was humble.
translation_verse: Mɩ chaasa kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa muuri nɛ a tɩma pɩ La Tɩɩna, a yel sɩlɩɩrɩŋ mɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ, a na hɛɛŋ ma Juu tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩ vʋʋra dɩ ba kpʋmɛ.

english_verse: When I preached in public or taught in your homes, I didn't hold back from telling anything that would help you.
translation_verse: Ma jɩma mɩ dagɛma wɩɩ-na kala sɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ nɛ, mɩ bɩ kaa faama. Mɩ dagɛma Wɩa wɩaa, nɩaa tʋɔŋ arɩ ma dɩɩsɩŋ ma lɛ.

english_verse: I don't know what will happen to me in Jerusalem, but I must obey God's Spirit and go there.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ niiŋ lɛ nɛ a mʋmʋ Jerusalɛm. Mɩ bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ lɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: In every city I visit, I am told by the Holy Spirit that I will be put in jail and will be in trouble in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mɩ ta jɩŋ nɛ arɩ taŋ-na kala lɛ mɩ sɩɩ mʋ, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ yie bʋla pɩmɛ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ arɩ wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋmɛ, dɩ ba kɛmmɛ tɔ dɩa ma.

english_verse: But I don't care what happens to me, as long as I finish the work the Lord Jesus gave me to do. And this work is to tell the good news about God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ sɩ yie beŋ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ bɩ kʋŋkala ŋaa mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ taa chɛ dɩ mɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ sɩ mɩ tɩŋ nɛ a dɛrɛ. Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩaa, a dagɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ zile.

english_verse: I have gone from place to place, preaching to you about God's kingdom, but now I know that none of you will ever see me again.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ jɩma arɩ ma nɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ yie gɔllɛ ma tʋɔŋ a bʋl Wɩa kuorii-la wɩaa pɩma, ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ma namɛ.

english_verse: I tell you today I am no longer responsible for any of you!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ bʋla pɩpɩma jɩnɩŋ dɩ ma nʋʋkala nɛ kɔ dɩ ʋ lɛlɛ mɩ dee bɩ jaŋ laa cheeriŋ,

english_verse: I have told you everything God wants you to know.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ nɛ a pɩma.

english_verse: Look after yourselves and everyone the Holy Spirit has placed in your care. Be like shepherds to God's church. It is the flock he bought with the blood of his own Son.
translation_verse: Má beŋ ma tɩtɩa nyuŋ woruŋ, aŋ pɛ beŋ nɩalɩŋ maa ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ joŋo hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Má beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hihilimi nyuŋ, a nagɛ pie-daara sɩ yie beŋ ʋ piesee nyuŋ ŋɩɩ. Wɩa nɛ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa bie chalɩŋ yɔɔba.

english_verse: I know that after I am gone, others will come like fierce wolves to attack you.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma, dɩ mɩ nɛ lemma, nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kʋ jʋʋ ma tʋɔŋ, a nagɛ guŋgurusuŋ sɩ yie jʋʋ pʋsʋŋ tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ. Nɩbɔmɔ-la bɩ jaŋ lemma, ba jaŋ walɩmɛma.

english_verse: Some of your own people will tell lies to win over the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ paala lɩɩ ma tʋɔŋ ma a kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ kaa bɩrɩmɛ, a nyɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii dɩ ba mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ a toba.

english_verse: Be on your guard! Remember how day and night for three years I kept warning you with tears in my eyes.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má beŋ ma tɩtɩa nyuŋ woruŋ. Má liliisi arɩ mɩ dagɛma nʋʋkala jɩsɩŋ batori nɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala, a yel sɩlɩɩrɩŋ ma woruŋ ma wɩaa.

english_verse: I now place you in God's care. Remember the message about his gift of undeserved grace! This message can help you and give you what belongs to you as God's people.
translation_verse: Mɩ lɛɛlɛ jomma hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ wuo pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ doluŋ a chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma wuo dii kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa bil nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: I have never wanted anyone's money or clothes.
translation_verse: Mɩ ha bɩ ma kʋŋkala moribiee koo gɛnnɩŋ bɩɩna dɩ mɩ kaa laa.

english_verse: You know how I have worked with my own hands to make a living for myself and my friends.
translation_verse: Ma tɩtɩa jɩma mɩ tɩma nɛ woruŋ, a na kɩalɩŋ kala mɩ dɩ mɩ toori dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: By everything I did, I showed how you should work to help everyone who is weak. Remember that our Lord Jesus said, “More blessings come from giving than from receiving.”
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ mɩ wuo dagɛma dɩ ma faasa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ, la maga dɩ la pɛ puwuoloo lɛ a liliisi arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ. Ʋ sɩ, ‘Ŋ sɩ joŋ kʋa pɩ nɩa, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a kɩɩ ŋ sɩ laa kʋa nɩa teeŋ.’ ”

english_verse: After Paul had finished speaking, he knelt down with all of them and prayed.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ bʋl wɩaa dɛrɛ, ʋ dɩ ba kala tuu kpirimi ʋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a pɩba kala.

english_verse: Everyone cried and hugged and kissed him.
translation_verse: Ba guoru a yel.

english_verse: They were especially sad because Paul had told them, “You will never see me again.” Then they went with him to the ship.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ chei woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa bʋla pɩba arɩ ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ naʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛnʋ kaa mʋ lɩɩŋ daboro leriŋ.

english_verse: After saying goodbye, we sailed straight to Cos. The next day we reached Rhodes and from there sailed on to Patara.
translation_verse: La ta dɔŋɔ aŋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro. La duoro tegi tegi a mʋ lee kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Kɔs, a bɩra sii nɩmɛ. Taŋ sɩ pʋla la mʋ lee kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Roodis, a bɩra lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ Patara.

english_verse: We found a ship going to Phoenicia, so we got on board and sailed off.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ la na lɩɩŋ daboro dɩ ʋʋ mʋ Fɔnɩɩsɩa. La jʋʋ mʋ.

english_verse: We came within sight of Cyprus and then sailed south of it on to the port of Tyre in Syria, where the ship was going to unload its cargo.
translation_verse: La sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, la na lee kʋbala la nagʋa, baa yɩrɛ Saapʋrɔs. La kieli nɩmɛ a mʋ yi Siiria tinteeŋ. La mʋ chɩŋ taŋ kʋbala lɛ baa yɩrɛ Taaya. Nɩmɛ nɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la chɛ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ dɩ ba chaarɛ chʋgʋsʋŋ.

english_verse: But when the week was over, we started on our way again. All the men, together with their wives and children, walked with us from the town to the seashore. We knelt on the beach and prayed.
translation_verse: La sɩ hɔŋ nɩmɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ ŋɩɩ, la bɩra lɩɩ nɩmɛ a joŋ la wombiiŋ. Baalaa arɩ ba haalaa arɩ ba biiriŋ kɛnla kaa lɩɩ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ. La kala tuu kpirimi lɩɩŋ niiŋ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Then after saying goodbye to each other, we got into the ship, and they went back home.
translation_verse: La ta dɔŋɔ nɩmɛ aŋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro, ka ba ma mɩɩra mʋ dɩa.

english_verse: We sailed from Tyre to Ptolemais, where we greeted the followers and stayed with them for a day.
translation_verse: La lɩɩ Taaya lɛ a joŋ la wombiiŋ a mʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Pitolimiiyas. La mʋ chʋɔlɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɩmɛ aŋ chʋa.

english_verse: The next day we went to Caesarea and stayed with Philip, the preacher. He was one of the seven men who helped the apostles,
translation_verse: Ʋ taŋ sɩ pʋla, la sii a mʋ Sɩzarɩya, a mʋ jʋʋ baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Fɩlɩp dɩa. Ʋ fa gɔllɔ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa nɛ aa pɩ nɩaa. Ʋ fa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ balɩpɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ ba fa sɩ lɩɩsa Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: We had been in Caesarea for several days, when the prophet Agabus came to us from Judea.
translation_verse: La hɛ nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ, dɩ baal kʋbala lɩɩ Judiya tinteeŋ a ma kɔ, baa yɩrɛ Agabɔs. Ʋ fa ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ.

english_verse: He took Paul's belt, and with it he tied up his own hands and feet. Then he told us, “The Holy Spirit says that some of the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem will tie up the man who owns this belt. They will also hand him over to the Gentiles.”
translation_verse: Ʋ kɔ la teeŋ a laa Pɔɔl damɛrɛ a kaa vɔɔ ʋ tɩtɩa naasɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɩsaa aŋ bʋl, “Ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ bʋl: ‘Juu tɩŋŋaa jaŋ kɛŋ damɛrɛ deeŋ tɩɩna a vɔbʋ ŋ-la Jerusalɛm lɛ, a joŋu hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: After Agabus said this, we and the followers living there begged Paul not to go to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: La sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, la dɩ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ sʋl Pɔɔl dɩ ʋ sɩ́ Jerusalɛm mʋ.

english_verse: But Paul answered, “Why are you crying and breaking my heart? I am not only willing to be put in jail for the Lord Jesus, but I am even willing to die for him in Jerusalem!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl bʋla pɩba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma yiyel ŋ-la a ŋaa mɩ tʋɔŋ chichei? Dɩ ba nɛ jaŋ kɛmmɛ vɔɔ, koo dɩ ba nɛ kpʋmɛ ma Jerusalɛm lɛ a tɩŋ mɩ Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa, mɩ sɛyɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Since we could not get Paul to change his mind, we gave up and prayed, “Lord, please make us willing to do what you want.”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, la na arɩ la bɩ ʋ wuo nyagaa bil. Ŋɩɩ nɛ la leŋ aŋ bʋl, “Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ wɩɩkala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ, ʋ ŋaa dɩ ʋ ŋaa.”

english_verse: Then we got ready to go to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ ka la kɛŋ la tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a sii mʋ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Caesarea went with us and took us to stay in the home of Mnason. He was from Cyprus and had been a follower from the beginning. Paul Visits James
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a lɩɩ Sɩzarɩya ma to la harɩŋ a mʋ, a kɛnla kaa mʋ jʋʋ baal kʋbala dɩa baa yɩrɛ Mineesiŋ. Ʋ lɩɩ Saapʋrɔs nɛ. Ʋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii bʋa-la lɛ ba fa sɩ suomo bʋbʋl Yesu wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa nɛ. Pɔɔl mʋa dɩ ʋ na Jeems

english_verse: When we arrived in Jerusalem, the Lord's followers gladly welcomed us.
translation_verse: La sɩ yi Jerusalɛm, nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɩmɛ chaga laala woruŋ.

english_verse: Paul went with us to see James the next day, and all the church leaders were present.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, la dɩ Pɔɔl mʋ dɩ la na Jeems. La mʋa dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii kʋhɩasɩŋ kala hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Paul greeted them and told how God had used him to help the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl chʋɔlɛba aŋ bʋla pɩba ŋɩɩ kala Wɩa sɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ ʋ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Everyone who heard this praised God and said to Paul: My friend, you can see how many tens of thousands of our people have become followers! And all of them are eager to obey the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ba dɛnnɛ Wɩa aŋ bʋla pɩ Pɔɔl, “La naambii, bee na Juu tɩŋŋaa yʋga a laa Yesu wɩaa dii. Ba yi nɩaa bʋɩ bʋɩ bʋɩ a kala tuto wɩalɩŋ woruŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto.

english_verse: But they have been told that you are teaching those who live among the Gentiles to disobey this Law. They claim that you are telling them not to circumcise their sons or to follow our customs.
translation_verse: Ba nɩɩ ŋ wɩaa nɛ. Ba sɩ ŋ dagɛ Juu tɩmma-la kala sɩ hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa tʋɔŋ dɩ ba vɩa wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ, a bɩra bʋl dɩ ŋ sɩ dɩ ba sɩ́ ba biiriŋ penee keru a sɩ́ Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba wɩaa to.

english_verse: What should we do now that our people have heard you are here?
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ nɩɩ arɩ ŋ kɔ. Bɛɛ nɛ saa la jaŋ ŋaa?

english_verse: Please do what we ask, because four of our men have made special promises to God.
translation_verse: To la niiŋ a ŋaa wɩɩ-la la sɩ sɩ ŋŋ ŋaa. Baalaa banɛsɛ nɛ hɛ daha. Ba ta niiŋ nɛ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: Join with them and prepare yourself for the ceremony that goes with the promises. Pay the cost for their heads to be shaved. Then everyone will learn that the reports about you are not true. They will know you do obey the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: To ba harɩŋ a ma pɩɩsɛ ŋ disiniŋ ta, a tiŋ moribiee dɩ ba wuo pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta aŋ fʋŋ ba nyusuŋ ma. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nʋʋkala jaŋ wuo to ŋɩɩ lɛ jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋaa. Ba jaŋ na arɩ ŋ ma tɩtɩa ka to wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ.

english_verse: Some while ago we told the Gentile followers what we think they should do. We instructed them not to eat anything offered to idols. They were told not to eat any meat with blood still in it or the meat of an animal that has been strangled. They were also told not to commit any terrible sexual sins.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aŋ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, la ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ pɩba arɩ la sɛyɛ dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ vʋɩŋ kɩaa dii, dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ pʋsʋŋ chalɩŋ ma dii, a sɩ́ pʋsʋŋ sɩ sʋʋ pimee dii, a lɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa bachɔrʋŋ arɩ hachɔrʋŋ wʋŋaalaa lɛ.”

english_verse: The next day Paul took the four men with him and got himself ready at the same time they did. Then he went into the temple and told when the final ceremony would take place and when an offering would be made for each of them. Paul Is Arrested
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, taŋ pʋl, Pɔɔl kɛŋ baala-la banɛsɩmɩŋ mʋ, ba kala pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta, aŋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩa ʋ dagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tapʋlaa magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta, ka dɩ ba kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩ Wɩa ba kʋŋkala-nyuŋ lɛ. Ba kɛŋ Pɔɔl Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ

english_verse: When the period of seven days for the ceremony was almost over, some of the Jewish people from Asia saw Paul in the temple. They got a large crowd together and started attacking him.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa balɩpɛ-la sɩɩ yi, Juu tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ Esia na Pɔɔl dɩ ʋ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. Ba nyɩsɛ nɩ-daŋ hɛ ba kɛŋ Pɔɔl.

english_verse: They were shouting, “Friends, help us! This man goes around everywhere, saying bad things about our nation and about the Law of Moses and about this temple. He has even brought shame to this holy temple by bringing in Gentiles.”
translation_verse: Ba faasa kpɩa, “Iziral tɩmma, má kʋ pɛ la lɛ. Baal-la sɩ gɔllɛ lee-kala a dɩdagɛ wɩaa lee-na kala a chichei la nɩaa sɩɩ to wombii-la, aa chei Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ bil dɩ nɩaa tuto maa, a bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a tɩgɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ ma lɛ, ʋ nɩɩ kɔ daha ŋɩɩ. Ʋ paala kɛŋ Giriik tɩŋŋaa kaa kʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la, a ŋaa leriŋ deeŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ kɛŋ disiniŋ.”

english_verse: Some of them thought that Paul had brought Trophimus from Ephesus into the temple, because they had seen them together in the city.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ba bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ: Ba fa na baal kʋbala dɩ ʋ to Pɔɔl harɩŋ taŋ-la lɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Tʋrɔfɩmɔs a lɩɩ Ɛfɛsɩs. Ba fa bɩɩna Pɔɔl kɛnʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la nɛ.

english_verse: The whole city was in an uproar, and the people turned into a mob. They grabbed Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Then suddenly the doors were shut.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɛ taŋ-la kala lɛ, nɩalɩŋ kala to dɔŋɔ a kɛŋ Pɔɔl a kɛnʋ kaa lɛrɛ lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, aŋ guu kɛŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ-niiree tɔ.

english_verse: The people were about to kill Paul when the Roman army commander heard that all Jerusalem was starting to riot.
translation_verse: Ba sɩɩ walɩmɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ, Rom laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ nɩɩ arɩ yuosuŋ sii Jerusalɛm kala lɛ.

english_verse: So he quickly took some soldiers and officers and ran to where the crowd had gathered. As soon as the mob saw the commander and soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.
translation_verse: Ʋ guu lɩɩsɛ laalɩyuoroo dɔnsʋŋ arɩ ba kʋhɩasɩŋ, ba fá mʋ yuosu-la leriŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ na laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoro-la, ba leŋ Pɔɔl ŋmobuŋ.

english_verse: The army commander went over and arrested him and had him bound with two chains. Then he tried to find out who Paul was and what he had done.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la mʋ kɛŋ Pɔɔl, a ŋaa ba kɛŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ balɩa kaa vɔbʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nɩa deeŋ? Bɛɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa chei?”

english_verse: Part of the crowd shouted one thing, and part of them shouted something else. But they were making so much noise that the commander could not find out a thing. Then he ordered Paul to be taken into the fortress.
translation_verse: Ba kala ŋaa goŋ. Dɔnsʋŋ bʋbʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, dɔnsʋŋ ma bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ. Nɩaa fa sɩɩ ŋaa goŋ ŋɩɩ, laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la bɩ wɩɩ-la sɩ paala ŋaa wuo jɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ʋ nɩaa kɛŋ Pɔɔl kaa mʋ laalɩyuoroo dɩɩ-duoŋ.

english_verse: As they reached the steps, the crowd became so wild that the soldiers had to lift Paul up and carry him.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ yi dɩa-la lusuŋ choluŋ, nɩalɩŋ kɛŋ Pɔɔl lɩlɛrɛ a wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoro-la joŋu chʋŋ.

english_verse: The crowd followed and kept shouting, “Kill him! Kill him!” Paul Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala to ʋ harɩŋ a ŋaa goŋ a bʋbʋl, “Má kpʋʋ.” Pɔɔl bʋl wɩaa dɩ ʋ laa ʋ tɩtɩa

english_verse: When Paul was about to be taken into the fortress, he asked the commander, “Can I say something to you?” “How do you know Greek?” the commander asked.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ jɩl lusuŋ chol-la a chɩchɛ dɩ ba jʋʋ dɩa-la, ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl sʋl laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la, “Leŋ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ pɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la pɩɛsɛ Pɔɔl, “Ŋɩɩ-na ŋ nɩɩ Giriik wʋbʋlʋŋ nɛɛ?

english_verse: “Aren't you that Egyptian who started a riot not long ago and led
translation_verse: Ŋ dee Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa baal-la fa sɩ hɛ yuosuŋ aŋ kɛŋ yuo-hɛɛrɛɛ bʋɩ banɛsɛ kaa mʋ gɩrɩ-bine tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ?”

english_verse: “No!” Paul replied. “I am a Jew from Tarsus, an important city in Cilicia. Please let me speak to the crowd.”
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ, “Aɩ, mɩ ŋaa Juu tɩɩna nɛ a lɩɩ Taasɩs, Siliisia tinteeŋ tabalɩŋ. Mɩ tabalɩŋ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ tabal nɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ.”

english_verse: The commander told him he could speak, so Paul stood on the steps and motioned to the people. When they were quiet, he spoke to them in Aramaic:
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pʋ wombiiŋ. Pɔɔl chɩŋ lusuŋ chol-la lɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ viisi dɩ nɩalɩŋ kɛŋ goŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala ŋaa fʋɩɩ, ka Pɔɔl bʋl wɩaa pɩba Juu tɩŋŋaa yikoro lɛ.

english_verse: “My friends and leaders of our nation, listen as I explain what happened!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ nyɩmmaba arɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ, má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla laa mɩ tɩtɩa.”

english_verse: When the crowd heard Paul speak to them in Aramaic, they became even quieter. Then Paul said:
translation_verse: Ba sɩ nɩa dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩaa Hiburu yikoro lɛ aa pɩba, ba kala ŋaa fʋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl bʋl,

english_verse: I am a Jew, born in the city of Tarsus in Cilicia. But I grew up here in Jerusalem where I was a student of Gamaliel and was taught to follow every single law of our ancestors. In fact, I was just as eager to obey God as any of you are today.
translation_verse: “Mɩ ŋaa Juu tɩɩna nɛ. Ba lʋlmɛ Taasɩs lɛ nɛ, Siliisia tinteeŋ. Mɩ hambiiriŋ lɛ nɛ ba kɛmmɛ kaa kɔ daha a bemmi. Gamalɩɛl nɛ dagɛmɛ. Ʋ dagɛmɛ la naabalɩmaba wombii-la ba sɩɩ to arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ. Mɩ tou woruŋ a joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa kala pɩ Wɩa, arɩ ma ma sɩ hɛ daha jɩnɩmba a ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I made trouble for everyone who followed the Lord's Way, and I even had some of them killed. I had others arrested and put in jail. I didn't care if they were men or women.
translation_verse: Mɩ to naasɩŋ a dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ to Yesu wombii-la a chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ kpʋba. Mɩ ŋaa ba kɛsɛba a vɔɔba a kɛmba tɔ dɩa, baalaa arɩ haalaa kala.

english_verse: The high priest and all the council members can tell you this is true. They even gave me letters to the Jewish leaders in Damascus, so that I could arrest people there and bring them to Jerusalem to be punished.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ, arɩ kʋhɩasɩ-la kala sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa ma jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩma arɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ kaa mʋ Damasɩkʋs a joŋo pɩ Juu tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ mɩ wuo kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɩmɛ a vɔɔba, a kaa kɔ Jerusalɛm a dɔgɩsɛba.

english_verse: One day about noon I was getting close to Damascus, when a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around me.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ lɩɩ joŋ wombiiŋ a mʋmʋ Damasɩkʋs a mʋ kpagɛ taŋ-la arɩ wɩɩ-hɛɛ-siesee, pʋlʋmʋŋ guu lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a faasa chaana hɛ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: I fell to the ground and heard a voice asking, “Saul, Saul, why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: Mɩ tuu tel tinteeŋ aŋ nɩɩ nʋʋ yikoro dɩ ʋ bʋl mɩ teeŋ a bʋl, ‘Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ to naasɩŋ a dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ ŋ-la?’

english_verse: “Who are you?” I answered. The Lord replied, “I am Jesus from Nazareth! I am the one you are so cruel to.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩɛsɛ, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ, mɩ Tɩɩna?’ Yikoro-la bʋl, ‘Mɩ-na Yesu sɩ lɩɩ Nazarɛt nɛ, nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ to naasɩŋ a dʋdɔgɩsɛ.’

english_verse: Those who were traveling with me saw the light, but did not hear the voice.
translation_verse: Mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ vɛŋ, ba na pʋlʋŋ-la nɛ, aŋ bɩ nɩɩ-la fa sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ yikoro nɩa.

english_verse: I asked, “Lord, what do you want me to do?” Then he told me, “Get up and go to Damascus. When you get there, you will be told what to do.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩɛsɛ, ‘Mɩ ŋaa wʋbɛɛ, mɩ Tɩɩna?’ Mɩ Tɩɩna bʋl, ‘Sii jʋʋ Damasɩkʋs, nɩmɛ ba jaŋ dagɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa.’

english_verse: The light had been so bright that I couldn't see. And the others had to lead me by the hand to Damascus.
translation_verse: Pʋlʋŋ-la chʋʋlɛ mɩ sɩaa, mɩ bɩra bɩ na, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ vɛŋ kɛŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a lɛrɛ jʋʋ Damasɩkʋs.

english_verse: In that city there was a man named Ananias, who faithfully obeyed the Law of Moses and was well liked by all the Jewish people living there.
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala fa hɛ nɩmɛ, baa yɩrɛ Ananɩas. Ʋ faa fá Wɩa nɛ a tuto wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto. Juu tɩmma-la kala fa sɩ hɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ zizilu.

english_verse: He came to me and said, “Saul, my friend, you can now see again!” At once I could see.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ a chɩŋ mɩ sɛmɛ a bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Mɩ naambii Sɔɔl, kɛŋ ŋ sɩaa suri.’ Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ mɩ sɩaa suri, mɩ bee naʋ.

english_verse: Then Ananias told me, “The God that our ancestors worshiped has chosen you to know what he wants done. He has chosen you to see the One Who Obeys God and to hear his voice.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ananɩas bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Wɩa-la la dɩ la naabalɩmaba sɩɩ to nɛ lɩɩsɩŋ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa. Ʋ leŋ ŋ na Wɩa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna a nɩɩ ʋ yikoro ma ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩŋ.

english_verse: You must tell everyone what you have seen and heard.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ pɛ-naara, a bʋla pɩ nɩaa wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ nɩa aŋ pɛ na.

english_verse: After this I returned to Jerusalem and went to the temple to pray. There I had a vision
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm a jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa. Mɩ sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: of the Lord who said to me, “Hurry and leave Jerusalem! The people won't listen to what you say about me.”
translation_verse: mɩ na La Tɩɩna Yesu a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ. Ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Sii lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ lɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ daha bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩba a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ.’

english_verse: I replied, “Lord, they know that in many of our synagogues I arrested and beat people who had faith in you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩ Yesu, ‘Mɩ Tɩɩna, ba jɩma woruŋ arɩ lee-na kala mɩ sɩ mʋa, mɩ yie jʋʋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ a kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ŋ wɩaa dii nɩmɛ, a ŋmooba aŋ kɛmba tɔ dɩa.

english_verse: Stephen was killed because he spoke for you, and I stood there and cheered them on. I even guarded the clothes of the men who murdered him.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ba fa sɩ kpʋ Sɩtɩɩvɩŋ, sɩ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ pɛ na ŋ wɩaa a bʋlba wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa, mɩ-na Pɔɔl ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ a sɛɩ dɩ ba kpʋʋ. Ba sɩɩ kpʋʋ, mɩ nɛ fa pɔ nɩaa deemba gɛnnɩŋ ba sɩ wuro, aŋ ka ba kpʋʋ.’

english_verse: But the Lord told me to go, and he promised to send me far away to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ Tɩɩna bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Sii daha, mɩ jaŋ tɩmɩŋ dɩ ŋ mʋ dɩ-bolii, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa leriŋ.’ ”

english_verse: The crowd listened until Paul said this. Then they started shouting, “Get rid of this man! He doesn't deserve to live.”
translation_verse: Pɔɔl fa sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ kala fa jegile nɩɩ ʋ teeŋ nɛ. Ama ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ba bɩra suomo ŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “Má kpʋ nɩtɔɔŋ deeŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: They kept shouting. They waved their clothes around and threw dust into the air. Paul and the Roman Army Commander
translation_verse: Ba ŋɩŋaa goŋ, aŋ kɛŋ ba gɛnnɩŋ kpikpesi a ŋaa hagɩla yuyuo.

english_verse: The Roman commander ordered Paul to be taken into the fortress and beaten with a whip. He did this to find out why the people were screaming at Paul.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rom laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la bʋl dɩ laalɩyuoro-la kɛŋ Pɔɔl kaa jʋʋ laalɩyuoroo dɩɩ-duo-la. Ʋ sɩ dɩ ba vɩɩrʋ aŋ pɩɛsa na wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ nɩalɩŋ kala lɩɩ ʋ harɩŋ aŋ ŋɩŋaa goŋ ŋ-la.

english_verse: While the soldiers were tying Paul up to be beaten, he asked the officer standing there, “Is it legal to beat a Roman citizen before he has been tried in court?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba vɔbʋ dɩ ba vɩɩrʋ. Ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba vɩɩrʋ, Pɔɔl pɩɛsɛ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la fa sɩ chɩŋ nɩmɛ, “Ʋ maga dɩ ba vɩɩrɛ nʋʋ sɩ ŋaa Rom tɩɩna aŋ bɩ ʋ sarɩya die, a dagʋ ʋ wʋcheeliŋ nɛɛ?”

english_verse: When the officer heard this, he went to the commander and said, “What are you doing? This man is a Roman citizen!”
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la Pɔɔl sɩ bʋla, ʋ ma bɩra mʋ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Bee na ŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la, baal-la ŋaa Rom tɩɩna nɛ.”

english_verse: The commander went to Paul and asked, “Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?” “Yes,” Paul answered.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la tɩtɩa sii kɔ Pɔɔl teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ ŋaa Rom tɩɩna nɛɛ? Bʋla pɩmɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl sɩ, “Oo.”

english_verse: The commander then said, “I paid a lot of money to become a Roman citizen.” But Paul replied, “I was born a Roman citizen.”
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la ma bʋl, “Mɩ ma ŋaa dɔŋɔ nɛ. Mɩ ta tiŋ moribiee yʋgɛ nɛ aŋ-na kʋ ŋaa Rom tɩɩna.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl bʋl, “Ba paala lʋlmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Rom tɩɩna nɛ.”

english_verse: The men who were about to beat and question Paul quickly backed off. And the commander himself was frightened when he realized that he had put a Roman citizen in chains. Paul Is Tried by the Council
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba vɩɩrɛ Pɔɔl aŋ pɩɛsʋ, ba sʋʋsa lɩɩ ʋ teeŋ lɩma lɩma. Laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la sɩ kʋ jɩŋ arɩ Pɔɔl ŋaa Rom tɩɩna nɛ, ka ʋ ŋaa ba kɛŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ kaa vɔbʋ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ ma. Pɔɔl chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa sɩpaaŋ

english_verse: The next day the commander wanted to know the real reason why the Jewish leaders had brought charges against Paul. So he had Paul's chains removed, and he ordered the chief priests and the whole council to meet. Then he had Paul led in and made him stand in front of them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ sɛnɛ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa bʋbʋl Pɔɔl teeŋ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ taŋ sɩ pʋla ʋ ŋaa ba kɛnʋ puri, a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ kʋhɩasɩ-la sɩ yie hilimi a vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa kʋ hilimi. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ Pɔɔl kaa lɩɩ a ŋaa ʋ chɩŋ ba sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Then Ananias the high priest ordered the men standing beside Paul to hit him on the mouth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ, baa yɩrɛ Ananɩas, bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ chɩna kpagɛ Pɔɔl dɩ ba ŋmoo ʋ niiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Paul turned to the high priest and said, “You whitewashed wall! God will hit you. You sit there to judge me by the Law of Moses. But at the same time you order men to break the Law by hitting me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl ma bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ lɔrɔ nagɛ jeeŋ sɩ yɛrɛ, ka ba ŋaa tʋɔrʋŋ bʋgɛ nɛ dɩ nɩaa sɩ́ na. Wɩa ma jaŋ ŋmobuŋ ŋɩɩ. Ŋ hɔnɔ dɩ ŋ to wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto nɛ a didiimi sarɩya, aŋ ka ŋ bʋl dɩ ba ŋmoomi a chei wɩalɩŋ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: The men standing beside Paul asked, “Don't you know you are insulting God's high priest?”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ chɩna kpagɛ Pɔɔl pɩɛsʋ, “Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ nɛ ŋ tʋʋsɛ ŋɩɩ?”

english_verse: Paul replied, “Oh! I didn't know he was the high priest. The Scriptures do tell us not to speak evil about a leader of our people.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ naambiiriŋ, ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ bɩ maga dɩ la bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ nɩaa. Mɩ bɩ jɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ.”

english_verse: When Paul saw that some of the council members were Sadducees and others were Pharisees, he shouted, “My friends, I am a Pharisee and the son of a Pharisee. I am on trial simply because I believe that the dead will be raised to life.”
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ kʋ jɩŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa, arɩ dɔnsʋŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Saduusi tɩŋŋaa nɛ, dɔnsʋŋ ma ŋaa Farisii tɩŋŋaa, ʋ faasa bʋl nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa teeŋ a bʋl, “Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ ma ŋaa Farisii tɩɩna nɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ lʋlmɛ ma ŋaa Farisii tɩɩna nɛ. Mɩ laa dii arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ baa diimi sarɩya.”

english_verse: As soon as Paul said this, the Pharisees and the Sadducees got into a big argument, and the council members started taking sides.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, Farisii tɩmma-la arɩ Saduusi tɩmma-la kɛŋ wɩɩ-la lɩlɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ leŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hilime pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The Sadducees do not believe in angels or spirits or that the dead will rise to life. But the Pharisees believe in all of these,
translation_verse: Saduusi tɩŋŋaa sɩ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sʋba, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, a bɩra bʋl dɩ Wɩa tɩndaaraa ma tuo, dɩ nɩdɩnsɩŋ ma tuo, ka Farisii tɩŋŋaa sɩ dɩ wɩaa deemba kala hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: and so there was a lot of shouting. Some of the teachers of the Law of Moses were Pharisees. Finally, they became angry and said, “We don't find anything wrong with this man. Maybe a spirit or an angel really did speak to him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sii a faasa ŋɩŋaa goŋ. Wɩa teniŋ kerichiba-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ ŋaa Farisii tɩŋŋaa sii a faasa kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ lɩlɛrɛ a bʋl, “La bɩ na baala deeŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la chei. Ʋ naga arɩ nɩdɩma nɛ koo Wɩa tɩndaara nɛ sɛnɛ bʋl wɩaa pʋpʋ.”

english_verse: The argument became fierce, and the commander was afraid that Paul would be pulled apart. So he ordered the soldiers to go in and rescue Paul. Then they took him back into the fortress.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ wɩɩ-la faasa lɛrɛ, leriŋ kala hosi. Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la arɩ ba jaŋ kɛŋ Pɔɔl lɛrɛ pʋɔsɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ʋ laalɩyuoroo jʋʋ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ a lorigo laaʋ nɩalɩŋ teeŋ, a kɛnʋ kaa mʋ laalɩyuoroo dɩɩ-duo-la.

english_verse: That night the Lord stood beside Paul and said, “Don't worry! Just as you have told others about me in Jerusalem, you must also tell about me in Rome.” A Plot To Kill Paul
translation_verse: Ʋ taŋ sɩ bire, tɩtaŋ-la tɩtɩa La Tɩɩna Yesu kɔ Pɔɔl teeŋ, a chɩna kpagʋ, a bʋla pʋ, “Nyɩrɛ ŋ bɔyɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ pɛ na mɩ wɩaa nɛ bʋlba Rom lɛ arɩ ŋ sɩ bʋl mɩ wɩaa ŋɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ.” Juu tɩŋŋaa ka vʋʋrɛ dɩ ba kpʋ Pɔɔl

english_verse: The next morning more than
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ vʋʋrɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ kɩɩ nɩaa mahɩŋ balɩa.

english_verse: Then some of them went to the chief priests and the nation's leaders and said, “We have promised God that we would not eat a thing until we have killed Paul.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ teeŋ a bʋla pɩba, “La ŋmɩɛsa nɛ dɩ la nɛ bɩ Pɔɔl kpʋa, la bɩ jaŋ dii kɩaa.

english_verse: You and everyone in the council must go to the commander and pretend that you want to find out more about the charges against Paul. Ask for him to be brought before your court. Meanwhile, we will be waiting to kill him before he gets there.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa kʋhɩasɩŋ saa tɩŋ dɩ ba bʋla pɩ Rom laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ Pɔɔl kɔ ma teeŋ. Má fugi arɩ maa chɛ dɩ ma wasa dii ʋ sarɩya nɛ. La jaŋ kɛŋ la tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ nɛ leŋe ʋ kʋkɔ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ yi daha, ka dɩ la kpʋʋ.”

english_verse: When Paul's nephew heard about the plot, he went to the fortress and told Paul about it.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl dɩhaala bie ma nɩɩ ba sɩɩ vʋʋrɛ ŋɩɩ, a mʋ jʋʋ laalɩyuoroo dɩɩ-duo-la a bʋl wɩɩ-la pɩ Pɔɔl.

english_verse: So Paul said to one of the army officers, “Take this young man to the commander. He has something to tell him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl yɩrɛ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ dɔŋɔ a bʋla pʋ, “Kɛŋ bapʋɔsɩ-bie deeŋ kaa mʋ ma kʋhɩaŋ teeŋ, ʋ kɛŋ wɩɩ nɛ dɩ ʋ bʋla pʋ.”

english_verse: The officer took him to the commander and said, “The prisoner named Paul asked me to bring this young man to you, because he has something to tell you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɛnʋ kaa mʋ ba kʋhɩaŋ teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Pɔɔl, nɩɩ-la ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa nɛ yɩrɛmɛ a bʋla pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ bapʋɔsɩ-bie deeŋ kaa kɔ ŋ teeŋ, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wɩɩ nɛ dɩ ʋ bʋla pɩŋ.”

english_verse: The commander took the young man aside and asked him in private, “What do you want to tell me?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la kɛŋ bile nɩsɩŋ lɛ a kɛnʋ lɩɩ mʋa, a fɩɛla pɩɛsʋ, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ kɛŋ dɩ ŋ bʋla pɩmɛ?”

english_verse: He answered, “Some men are planning to ask you to bring Paul down to the Jewish council tomorrow. They will claim they want to find out more about him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Juu tɩŋŋaa vʋʋrɛ nɛ dɩ ba bʋla pɩŋ dɩ ŋ chie leŋ dɩ Pɔɔl kɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa kʋhɩasɩŋ teeŋ. Baa fugi arɩ baa chɛ dɩ ba wasa dii ʋ sarɩya nɛ.

english_verse: The commander sent the young man away after saying to him, “Don't let anyone know you told me this.” Paul Is Sent to Felix the Governor
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la bʋla pɩ bapʋɔsɩ-bie-la, “Sɩ́ bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala arɩ ŋ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩmɛ,” aŋ leŋ ʋ viiri. Ba kɛŋ Pɔɔl mʋ Fɛlɩs teeŋ

english_verse: Get a horse ready for Paul and make sure he gets safely through to Felix the governor.”
translation_verse: Má chɛ janɩŋ a lɩɩsa pɩ Pɔɔl dɩ ʋ ma jɩl, a kɛnʋ woruŋ a kaa mʋ Sɩzarɩya, a kɛnʋ kaa mʋ hɛ Fɛlɩs sɩ chɩŋ kuoru-balɩŋ nyuŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Some Jews grabbed this man and were about to kill him. But when I found out that he was a Roman citizen, I took some soldiers and rescued him.
translation_verse: Baala deeŋ mɩ sɩ ŋaa ba kaa kɔ ŋ leriŋ, Juu tɩŋŋaa nɛ fa kɛnʋ dɩ ba kpʋʋ. Ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ nɩɩ arɩ ʋ ŋaa Rom tɩɩna nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kɛŋ mɩ laalɩyuoroo mʋ, la lorigo laaʋ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I wanted to find out what they had against him. So I brought him before their council
translation_verse: Mɩ faa chɛ dɩ mɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ba bʋbʋl ʋ teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kɛnʋ kaa mʋ ba nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩ yie hɔnɔ vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa teeŋ.

english_verse: and learned that the charges concern only their religious laws. This man isn't guilty of anything for which he should die or even be put in jail.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ pɩɛsʋ wɩaa, mɩ na arɩ ʋ bɩ wɩɩkala cheye a magɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ koo dɩ ba kɛnʋ tɔ dɩa. Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ba bʋbʋl ʋ teeŋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: As soon as I learned that there was a plot against him, I sent him to you and told their leaders to bring charges against him in your court.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ vʋʋra nɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sɩ dɩ ba kɛnʋ kaa kʋ pɩŋ lɩma lɩma. Mɩ saa bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl ʋ teeŋ nɛ dɩ ba kɔ ŋ teeŋ, a ma dagɛ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa chei a pɩŋ.”

english_verse: The soldiers obeyed the commander's orders, and that same night they took Paul to the city of Antipatris.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teŋ-la dɛrɛ, laalɩyuoro-la ŋaa ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩba. Tɩtaŋ-la ba kɛŋ Pɔɔl kaa mʋ yi taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Antɩpatɩs.

english_verse: The next day the foot soldiers returned to the fortress and let the soldiers on horseback take him the rest of the way.
translation_verse: Ʋ taŋ sɩ pʋla, laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ vɛŋ naasɩŋ lɛ nɛ mɩɩra kɔ ba dɩɩ-duo-la, aŋ ka ja-jɩllaa kɛnʋ mʋ Sɩzarɩya.

english_verse: When they came to Caesarea, they gave the letter to the governor and handed Paul over to him.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ yi nɩmɛ, ba joŋ Pɔɔl pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ chɩŋ ba kuoru-balɩŋ nyuŋ, a joŋ teŋ-la ma pɛ.

english_verse: The governor read the letter. Then he asked Paul and found out that he was from Cilicia.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ chɩŋ ba kuoru-balɩŋ nyuŋ karɩmɛ teŋ-la aŋ pɩɛsɛ Pɔɔl lee-la ʋ sɩ lɩa. Ʋ bʋl dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Siliisia nɛ. Ʋ sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: The governor said, “I will listen to your case as soon as the people come to bring their charges against you.” After saying this, he gave orders for Paul to be kept as a prisoner in Herod's palace.
translation_verse: ʋ bʋla pʋ, “Dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl ŋ teeŋ nɛ kɔ, mɩ jaŋ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ dɩ ŋ bʋl, aŋ ka dɩ mɩ-na dii ŋ sarɩya.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ba kɛŋ Pɔɔl mʋ hɛ dɩɩ-bal-la Hɛrɔd sɩ saa, a ŋaa laalɩyuoroo pʋpɔʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Five days later Ananias the high priest, together with some of their leaders and a lawyer named Tertullus, went to the governor to present their case against Paul.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa banɔŋ sɩ kiele, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ baa yɩrɛ Ananɩas sii mʋ Sɩzarɩya, Fɛlɩs teeŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩ chɩŋ ba kuoru-balɩŋ nyuŋ. Ʋ dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ arɩ sarɩya-diiru kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Tatulas, ba kala nɛ mʋa. Ba sɩ mʋ ʋ teeŋ, ba suomo bʋbʋl wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ba bʋbʋl Pɔɔl teeŋ.

english_verse: So Paul was called in, and Tertullus stated the case against him: Honorable Felix, you have brought our people a long period of peace, and because of your concern our nation is much better off.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ yɩrɛ Pɔɔl ʋ kʋ jʋʋ, Tatulas nɛ ba laa sɩpaaŋ yɩrɛ dɩ ʋ dagɛ wɩɩ-la Pɔɔl sɩ ŋaa chei. Ŋ-la nɛ ʋ suomi, “La tinteeŋ kʋhɩaŋ, ŋ nɛ wuo benla woruŋ a leŋ la hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ. Ŋ wasɛ wɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ a pɩla la tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: All of us are always grateful for what you have done.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala la tinteeŋ kala lɛ la tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ woruŋ wɩaa deemba lɛ. La saa lɔllʋŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: I don't want to bother you, but please be patient with us and listen to me for just a few minutes.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa dieni. Mɩ saa sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ kenyiri aŋ jegile nɩɩ wʋkuu-la la sɩ kɛnɛ dɩ la bʋla pɩŋ.

english_verse: This man has been found to be a real pest and troublemaker for our people all over the world. He is also a leader of a group called Nazarenes.
translation_verse: La na dɩ baala deeŋ ŋaa wʋhɛɛrʋ nɛ. Juu tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ-na kala lɛ, ʋ yie mʋ lee-la a ŋaa taawɛɩ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Nazarɛt nɩaa Wɩɩ-chʋɔlaa kʋhɩaŋ ma.

english_verse: When he tried to disgrace the temple, we arrested him. If you question him, you will find out for yourself that our charges are true.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ bʋla pɩ la nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ bʋl Pɔɔl teeŋ dɩ la kɔ ŋ teeŋ a bʋla pɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ la bʋbʋl ʋ teeŋ]. Dɩ ŋ nɛ pɩɛsɛ baala deeŋ, ŋ tɩtɩa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ.”

english_verse: The Jewish crowd spoke up and agreed with what Tertullus had said. Paul Defends Himself
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa ma sii pɛ a bʋl dɩ wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Pɔɔl bʋl wɩaa dɩ ʋ laa ʋ tɩtɩa kuoro Fɛlɩs sɩpaaŋ

english_verse: The governor motioned for Paul to speak, and he began: I know that you have judged the people of our nation for many years, and I am glad to defend myself in your court.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ chɩŋ kuoru-balɩŋ nyuŋ pɩ Pɔɔl wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la ʋ ma sɩ kɛnɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Mɩ jɩma arɩ ŋ dii sarɩya tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ ʋ jɩsɩŋ bolie. Mɩ tʋɔŋ saa tɔrɔ mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩaa a laa mɩ tɩtɩa ŋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: It was no more than twelve days ago that I went to worship in Jerusalem. You can find this out easily enough.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ wuo pɩɛsa nɩɩ ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ mɩ sɩ kʋ mʋ Jerusalɛm dɩ mɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, ʋ bɩ tapʋlaa fii arɩ balɩa kɩɩ.

english_verse: Never once did the Jews find me arguing with anyone in the temple. I didn't cause trouble in the synagogues or in the city itself.
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa bɩ mɩ na dɩ mɩ dɩ nʋʋkala kɛŋ wɩɩ lɩlɛrɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, mɩ bɩ yuosu ma hɛ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ koo lee-kala tabal-la lɛ.

english_verse: There is no way that they can prove these charges they are now bringing against me.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo dagɛ pɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ sɩ mɩ ŋaa chei ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ.

english_verse: I admit that their leaders think the Lord's Way which I follow is based on wrong beliefs. But I still worship the same God that my ancestors worshiped. And I believe everything written in the Law of Moses and in the Prophets.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ maa chʋɔlɛ Wɩa-la la naabalɩmaba sɩɩ to nɛ a ŋaa nʋʋ sɩɩ to Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ wombii-la ba sɩɩ chei. Mɩ ma laa wɩalɩŋ kala Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la to dii nɛ, aa to wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ ŋmʋnsa ma kala.

english_verse: I am just as sure as these people are that God will raise from death everyone, good or evil.
translation_verse: Mɩ ma laa dii arɩ Wɩa jaŋ chɩsɛ nɩzɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kala sʋʋŋ lɛ. Nɩaa deemba kala sɩ hɛ daha ma laa wɩaa deemba kala dii nɛ.

english_verse: And because I am sure, I try my best to have a clear conscience in whatever I do for God or for people.
translation_verse: Mɩ yie wʋwalɩmɛ woruŋ dɩ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala chesi Wɩa arɩ nuhuobiinee kala sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: After being away for several years, I returned here to bring gifts for the poor people of my nation and to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ ʋ diene, a yi jɩsɩ arɩ jɩsɩ. Lɛɛlɛ nɛ mɩ kɔ a kɛŋ moribiiŋ kaa kɔ dɩ mɩ pɩ mɩ tinteeŋ nɩaa aŋ pɛ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: This is what I was doing when I was found going through a ceremony in the temple. I wasn't with a crowd, and there was no uproar.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ba namɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ dɩ mɩ pɩɩsɛ mɩ disiniŋ dɛrɛ. Nɩ-daŋ kala fa tuo mɩ teeŋ, mɩ bɩ yuosu ma kala hɛ.

english_verse: Some Jews from Asia were there at that time, and if they have anything to say against me, they should be here now.
translation_verse: Ama Juu tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ Esia tinteeŋ ma nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ fa kɛŋ wɩɩkala a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ, ʋ fa maga dɩ ba tɩtɩa nɛ kɔ daha a kʋ bʋl.

english_verse: Or ask the ones who are here. They can tell you that they didn't find me guilty of anything when I was tried by their own council.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ ma dee, leŋ dɩ nɩaa deemba sɩ hɛ daha bʋl wɩɩ-la ba sɩ na dɩ mɩ ŋaa chei bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie hilime vʋvʋʋrɛ wɩaa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The only charge they can bring against me is what I shouted out in court, when I said, “I am on trial today because I believe that the dead will be raised to life!”
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la dʋndʋŋa mɩ sɩ ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ fa chɩŋ ba sɩpaaŋ a faasa bʋla pɩba, ‘Jɩnɩŋ maa diimi sarɩya a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ laa dii arɩ nɩsʋʋnʋŋ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ wɩaa nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Felix knew a lot about the Lord's Way. But he brought the trial to an end and said, “I will make my decision after Lysias the commander arrives.”
translation_verse: Fɛlɩs sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ jɩŋ wombii-la Pɔɔl sɩɩ to wɩaa woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ wɩɩ-la bʋlʋŋ bil aŋ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Dɩ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ Lisias nɛ kɔ, mɩ jaŋ beŋ wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ a jɩŋ ʋ sɩaa.”

english_verse: He then ordered the army officer to keep Paul under guard, but not to lock him up or to stop his friends from helping him. Paul Is Kept under Guard
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ kʋbala bibeŋ Pɔɔl, aŋ bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ kɛnʋ tɔ aŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ nɩna wiese, dɩ ʋ pɩ ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ba kʋ nɩnaʋ dɩ ba bʋbʋl wɩaa. Dɩ ʋ nɩɩ chɛ kʋŋ ma, dɩ ba pɛ ʋ lɛ. Pɔɔl chɩŋ Fɛlɩs arɩ Dirusila sɩpaaŋ

english_verse: Several days later Felix and his wife Drusilla, who was Jewish, went to the place where Paul was kept under guard. They sent for Paul and listened while he spoke to them about having faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ harɩŋ Fɛlɩs kɛŋ ʋ haala ba kɔ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Dirusila. Ʋ fa ŋaa Juu tɩɩna nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɛlɩs tɩma yɩrɛ Pɔɔl dɩ ʋ kɔ. Ʋ sɩ kɔ, ʋ bʋl Yesu Kirisito laa diiniŋ wɩaa pʋ ʋ jijegili.

english_verse: But Felix was frightened when Paul started talking to them about doing right, about self-control, and about the coming judgment. So he said to Paul, “That's enough for now. You may go. But when I have time I will send for you.”
translation_verse: Ama Pɔɔl sɩ mʋ bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ tʋɔpʋla lɛ arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ, a bɩra bʋl tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya wɩaa ma, fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ Fɛlɩs. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl dɩ ʋ mʋ, ka dɩ ʋ nɛ na chɩnɩŋ ʋ jaŋ bɩra yɩrʋ.

english_verse: After this, Felix often sent for Paul and talked with him, because he hoped that Paul would offer him a bribe.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ kala lɛ ʋ faa bɩɩnɛ arɩ Pɔɔl jaŋ kpalʋ arɩ moribiiŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ʋ yie yɩyɩrʋ tɛtɛ ba yie bʋbʋl wɩaa.

english_verse: Two years later Porcius Festus became governor in place of Felix. But since Felix wanted to do the Jewish leaders a favor, he kept Paul in jail.
translation_verse: Jɩsɩŋ balɩa sɩ kiele, baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Pɔkɔs Fɛsɩtɔs laa Fɛlɩs leriŋ a ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ chɩŋ kuoru-balɩŋ nyuŋ. Fɛlɩs faa chɛ dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa chou, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ leŋ Pɔɔl ha hɛ bɩnɩŋ-dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Three days after Festus had become governor, he went from Caesarea to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Fɛsɩtɔs sɩ kʋ laa tinteeŋ, ʋ hɔŋ Sɩzarɩya lɛ tapʋlaa batori nɛ aŋ sii mʋ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: There the chief priests and some Jewish leaders told him about their charges against Paul. They also asked Festus
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ mʋ Jerusalɛm ŋɩɩ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩŋ kʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ Pɔɔl sɩ ŋaa cheiba pʋ, aŋ sʋlʋ

english_verse: if he would be willing to bring Paul to Jerusalem. They begged him to do this because they were planning to attack and kill Paul on the way.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ a ŋaa dɩ Pɔɔl kɔ Jerusalɛm. Ba fa vʋʋra nɛ dɩ ba lɩɩ faa wombiiŋ lɛ a kpʋʋ.

english_verse: But Festus told them, “Paul will be kept in Caesarea, and I am soon going there myself.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɛsɩtɔs bʋl, “Ba kɛŋ Pɔɔl tɔ dɩa nɛ Sɩzarɩya tinteeŋ lɛ, mɩ ma jaŋ mɩɩra mʋ nɩmɛ lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: If he has done anything wrong, let your leaders go with me and bring charges against him there.”
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ma sɩpaalaaraa dɔnsʋŋ to mɩ harɩŋ mʋ Sɩzarɩya, a bʋl wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛnɛ a tɩgɛ baal-la lɛ, dɩ ma nɛ sɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ nɛ a chei.”

english_verse: Festus stayed in Jerusalem for eight or ten more days before going to Caesarea. Then the next day he took his place as judge and had Paul brought into court.
translation_verse: Fɛsɩtɔs fa chʋa nɩalɩŋ teeŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ arɩ tapʋlaa chori koo fii nɛ aŋ-na mɩɩra mʋ Sɩzarɩya. Ʋ taŋ sɩ pʋla, ʋ mʋ hɔŋ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ aŋ ŋaa ba kɛŋ Pɔɔl kaa kɔ.

english_verse: As soon as Paul came in, the leaders from Jerusalem crowded around him and said he was guilty of many serious crimes. But they could not prove anything.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ kɔ, Juu tɩmma-la sɩ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm kɔ, ba kʋ gollu chu a bʋl dɩ wɩalɩŋ Pɔɔl sɩ cheye yʋga nɛ sɩɩfɩɛsɛ, ama ba bɩ wuo dagɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba.

english_verse: Then Paul spoke in his own defense, “I have not broken the Law of my people. And I have not done anything against either the temple or the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl ma bʋl wɩaa dɩ ʋ laa ʋ tɩtɩa. Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba wombii-la ba sɩɩ to wɩɩkala cheye, mɩ bɩra bɩ wɩɩ ma kala cheye a tɩgɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ ma lɛ koo Rom kuoru-balɩŋ ma lɛ.”

english_verse: Festus wanted to please the leaders. So he asked Paul, “Are you willing to go to Jerusalem and be tried by me on these charges?”
translation_verse: Fɛsɩtɔs ma faa chɛ dɩ Juu tɩmma-la tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ pɩɛsɛ Pɔɔl, “Ŋ jaŋ cho dɩ ŋ mʋ Jerusalɛm dɩ mɩ dii ŋ sarɩya nɩmɛ a tɩŋ wɩaa deemba ba sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ koo?”

english_verse: Paul replied, “I am on trial in the Emperor's court, and that's where I should be tried. You know very well I have not done anything to harm the Jewish nation.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl bʋl, “Aɩ, mɩ jaŋ cho dɩ mɩ mʋ kuoru-balɩŋ teeŋ. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ nɛ diimi sarɩya. Ŋ tɩtɩa jɩma woruŋ arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa chei Juu tɩŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: If I had done something deserving death, I would not ask to escape the death penalty. But I am not guilty of any of these crimes, and no one has the right to hand me over to these people. I now ask to be tried by the Emperor himself.”
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa ŋaa wɩɩ chei a magɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ, mɩ faa sɛɩ nɛ, ama dɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ bʋl ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ, nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ wuo jommi hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ mʋ kuoru-balɩŋ teeŋ dɩ ʋ nɛ diimi sarɩya.”

english_verse: After Festus had talked this over with members of his council, he told Paul, “You have asked to be tried by the Emperor, and to the Emperor you will go!” Paul Speaks to Agrippa and Bernice
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɛsɩtɔs arɩ ʋ nɩhɩasɩŋ kɛŋ nyusuŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ka ʋ bʋla pɩ Pɔɔl, “Na ŋ sɩ ŋ jaŋ mʋ kuoru-balɩŋ teeŋ dɩ ʋ nɛ dii ŋ sarɩya. Ŋ saa jaŋ mʋ.” Pɔɔl chɩŋ Agɩrɩpa arɩ Bɛɛnɩs sɩpaaŋ

english_verse: A few days later King Agrippa and Bernice came to Caesarea to visit Festus.
translation_verse: Tapʋlaa baŋmɛnɛ harɩŋ dɩ kuoru kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Agɩrɩpa arɩ ʋ dɩhaala Bɛɛnɩs kɔ dɩ ba chʋɔlɛ Fɛsɩtɔs Sɩzarɩya lɛ.

english_verse: They had been there for several days, when Festus told the king about the charges against Paul. He said: Felix left a man here in jail,
translation_verse: Ba sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a dieni, Fɛsɩtɔs bʋl Pɔɔl wɩaa kala a pɩba. Ʋ sɩ, “Baal kʋbala nɛ hɛ daha, Fɛlɩs nɛ kɛnʋ kaa tɔ dɩa.

english_verse: and when I went to Jerusalem, the chief priests and the Jewish leaders came and asked me to find him guilty.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ mʋ Jerusalɛm, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ arɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ kʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa cheiba, aŋ bʋl dɩ mɩ diiu sarɩya a joŋ cheeriŋ pʋ.

english_verse: I told them it isn't the Roman custom to hand a man over to people who are bringing charges against him. He must first have the chance to meet them face to face and to defend himself against their charges.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩba arɩ la-na Rom tɩŋŋaa naabarɩŋ lɛ, la bɩ jaŋ bʋl nʋʋ laa cheeriŋ nɛ aŋ joŋu hɛ ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, see dɩ ba kala balɩa hɔnɔ, dɩ dɔŋɔ bil ʋ niiŋ, dɩ dɔŋɔ ma bil ʋ niiŋ.

english_verse: So when they came here with me, I wasted no time. On the very next day I took my place on the judge's bench and ordered him to be brought in.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɔ daha. Ba sɩ kɔ, mɩ bɩ kaa dieni. Ʋ taŋ sɩ pʋla, mɩ mʋ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ aŋ ŋaa ba kɛŋ baal-la kaa kɔ.

english_verse: But when the men stood up to make their charges against him, they did not accuse him of any of the crimes that I thought they would.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ bʋl Pɔɔl teeŋ sɩ sii chɩŋ a bʋl wɩaa, ba bɩ wuo dagɛ wʋbɔŋ kala mɩ fa sɩ bɩɩna dɩ Pɔɔl ŋaa.

english_verse: Instead, they argued with him about some of their beliefs and about a dead man named Jesus, who Paul said was alive.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋkaalɛrɩɩ nɛ ba kaa lɛrɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ ba Wɩɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ lɛ. Baal kʋbala nɛ sʋba, baa yɩrɛ Yesu, Pɔɔl yie bʋbʋl arɩ ʋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ a hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Since I did not know how to find out the truth about all this, I asked Paul if he would be willing to go to Jerusalem and be put on trial there.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa bɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ jaŋ to a jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩɛsɛ Pɔɔl arɩ ʋ jaŋ sɛɩ a mʋ Jerusalɛm dɩ ba diiu sarɩya nɩmɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ sɩ ʋ ŋaa lɛɛ?

english_verse: But Paul asked to be kept in jail until the Emperor could decide his case. So I ordered him to be kept here until I could send him to the Emperor.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl bɩ sɛyɛ, aŋ sʋlmɛ dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ ba benu a kɛnʋ kaa mʋ kuoru-balɩŋ teeŋ dɩ ʋ dii ʋ sarɩya. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ leŋ ʋ ha hɛ bɩnɩŋ dɩa lɛ ba bibenu, a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kɛnʋ mʋ kuoru-balɩŋ teeŋ dɩ ʋ dii ʋ sarɩya.”

english_verse: Then Agrippa said to Festus, “I would also like to hear what this man has to say.” Festus answered, “You can hear him tomorrow.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Agɩrɩpa bʋla pɩ Fɛsɩtɔs, “Mɩ tɩtɩa jaŋ cho dɩ mɩ ma nɩɩ baal-la niiŋ nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɛsɩtɔs bʋla pʋ, “Chie ŋ jaŋ nɩɩ ʋ niiŋ.”

english_verse: The next day Agrippa and Bernice made a big show as they came into the meeting room. High ranking army officers and leading citizens of the town were also there. Festus then ordered Paul to be brought in
translation_verse: Ʋ taŋ sɩ pʋla, Agɩrɩpa arɩ Bɛɛnɩs kpɩɛrɛ ba tɩtɩa woruŋ nɩaa zuuriba a mʋ jʋʋ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ dɩɩ-bal-la. Ba dɩ laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ taŋ-la nɩbalaa, ba kala kʋ jʋʋ a hɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Fɛsɩtɔs ŋaa ba kɛŋ Pɔɔl kʋ jʋʋ.

english_verse: and said: King Agrippa and other guests, look at this man! Every Jew from Jerusalem and Caesarea has come to me, demanding for him to be put to death.
translation_verse: Fɛsɩtɔs bʋl, “Kuoro Agɩrɩpa, ŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ daha, ma na baala deeŋ. Ʋ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ Juu tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Sɩzarɩya deeŋ lɛ arɩ Juu tɩmma-la sɩ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm kala kʋ wʋwalɩmɛmɛ. Baa ŋaa goŋ a bʋl dɩ ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: I have not found him guilty of any crime deserving death. But because he has asked to be judged by the Emperor, I have decided to send him to Rome.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na bɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa chei a maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ na. Ama ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ sʋlmɛ dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ mʋ kuoru-balɩŋ teeŋ Rom lɛ dɩ ʋ diiu sarɩya. Mɩ saa jaŋ kɛnʋ mʋ.

english_verse: I have to write some facts about this man to the Emperor. So I have brought him before all of you, but especially before you, King Agrippa. After we have talked about his case, I will then have something to write.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ paala bɩ chaasa jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩ jaŋ ŋmʋnsa pɩ kuoru-balɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ kɛnʋ kaa kɔ ma teeŋ dɩ ma nɩɩ ʋ niiŋ. Ŋ-na kuoro Agɩrɩpa teeŋ nɛ mɩ saa paala kɛnʋ kaa kɔ. Mɩ bɩɩna arɩ ŋ ma nɛ jʋʋ wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo na wɩɩ dɩ mɩ wuo ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ pɩ kuoru-balɩŋ.

english_verse: It makes no sense to send a prisoner to the Emperor without stating the charges against him.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na teeŋ, ʋ bɩ wombii ŋaa dɩ mɩ nɛ leŋe dɩ ba kɛŋ nʋʋ ba sɩ kaa tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa kaa mʋ kuoru-balɩŋ teeŋ, aŋ bɩ chaasa bʋl wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa chei.”

english_verse: King Agrippa, I am glad for this chance to defend myself before you today on all these charges my own people have brought against me.
translation_verse: “Kuoro, mɩ jaŋ bʋl mɩ nyuŋ sɩma jɩnɩŋ mɩ sɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩaa a laa mɩ tɩtɩa ŋ sɩpaaŋ wɩaa deemba kala lɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ bʋl mɩ teeŋ,

english_verse: You know a lot about our religious customs and the beliefs that divide us. So I ask you to listen patiently to me.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ-na paala chaasa jɩŋ Juu tɩŋŋaa naaba wɩaa kala nɛ arɩ ba wʋkaa-lɛrɩŋ. Mɩ saa sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ kenyiri aŋ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: All the Jews have known me since I was a child. They know what kind of life I have lived in my own country and in Jerusalem. And if they were willing, they could tell you I was a Pharisee, a member of a group that is stricter than any other.
translation_verse: Ba jɩmmɛ faafaa kala nɛ, dɩ ba nɛ jaŋ sɛɩ a bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ, ba jɩma arɩ bumbuŋ kala mɩ faa to Farisii tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ wombii-duo-la nɛ.

english_verse: Now I am on trial because I believe the promise God made to our people long ago.
translation_verse: Ka jɩnɩŋ ba leŋ mɩ chɩŋ daha dɩ ba diimi sarɩya a tɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ yɩɛlɛ wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pɩ la naabalɩmaba.

english_verse: Day and night our twelve tribes have earnestly served God, waiting for his promised blessings. King Agrippa, because of this hope, some of our leaders have brought charges against me.
translation_verse: La Iziral tɩŋŋaa tinteyee fii arɩ balɩa-la, la kala ka yɩɛlɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ la fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala ŋɩɩ. Mɩ sɩɩ yɩɛlɛ wɩaa deemba nɛ tɩɩ, Juu tɩŋŋaa bʋbʋl mɩ teeŋ ŋɩɩ, mɩ nyɩna.

english_verse: Why should any of you doubt that God raises the dead to life?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma Juu tɩŋŋaa bɩ wuo laa dii arɩ Wɩa jaŋ wuo chɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba, dɩ ba bɩra sii sʋʋŋ lɛ?

english_verse: I once thought that I should do everything I could to oppose Jesus from Nazareth.
translation_verse: Mɩ ma tɩtɩa fa laa dii arɩ ʋ maga dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa a chei Yesu sɩ lɩɩ Nazarɛt yɩrɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I did this first in Jerusalem, and with the authority of the chief priests I put many of God's people in jail. I even voted for them to be killed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ ŋaa Jerusalɛm lɛ. Mɩ laa doluŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩasɩŋ teeŋ, aŋ kɛŋ Wɩa nɩaa yʋgɛ a tɔ dɩa. Dɩ ba nɛ sɩ dɩ ba kpʋba ma, mɩ yie sɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: I often had them punished in our synagogues, and I tried to make them give up their faith. In fact, I was so angry with them, that I went looking for them in foreign cities.
translation_verse: Mɩ vɛnɛ dɔgɩsɛba yʋgɛ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, aa fʋgɛba dɩ ba bʋl arɩ ba bɩ Yesu jɩŋ aŋ vɩa ʋ wombii-la. Mɩ baanɩŋ faasa sii nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ ba nyuŋ, mɩ paala mʋ tasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ tuo Juu tinteeŋ lɛ, a to naasɩŋ a dɔgɩsɛba nɩmɛ. Pɔɔl to ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ ŋaa a kʋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii

english_verse: King Agrippa, one day I was on my way to Damascus with the authority and permission of the chief priests.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ sii mʋ Damasɩkʋs. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ tɩmmɛ a pɩmɛ doluŋ.

english_verse: About noon I saw a light brighter than the sun. It flashed from heaven on me and on everyone traveling with me.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩ mʋ wombiiŋ lɛ mɩ nyɩna, arɩ wɩɩ-hɛɛ-siesee mɩ na pʋlʋmʋŋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a chaana hɛ mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ vɛŋ lɛ. Ʋ pʋlla kɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: We all fell to the ground. Then I heard a voice say to me in Aramaic, “Saul, Saul, why are you so cruel to me? It's foolish to fight against me!”
translation_verse: La kala tuu tel tinteeŋ. Ka mɩ nɩɩ nʋʋ yikoro dɩ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ Hiburu yikoro lɛ a bʋl, ‘Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ to naasɩŋ a dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ ŋ-la? Ŋ dɔgɩsɛ ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ, ŋ nagɛ nɛŋ nɩa sɩ kaa vɩvɛŋ nɛ ka ʋ yɩyagɛ daa-la ʋ sɩ koro.’

english_verse: “Who are you?” I asked. Then the Lord answered, “I am Jesus! I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩɛsɛ, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ, tɩɩna?’ Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩna bʋl, ‘Mɩ nɛ ŋaa Yesu, nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ to naasɩŋ a dʋdɔgɩsɛ.

english_verse: Now stand up. I have appeared to you, because I have chosen you to be my servant. You are to tell others what you have learned about me and what I will show you later.”
translation_verse: Ama sii chɩŋ, mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɩŋ dɩ mɩ lɩɩsɩŋ dɩ ŋ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa pɩmɛ nɛ, a ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ pɛ na mɩ wɩaa, a bʋla pɩ nɩaa ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ namɛ jɩnɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ bɩra namɛ maachie.

english_verse: The Lord also said, “I will protect you from the Jews and from the Gentiles that I am sending you to.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ tɩmɩŋ dɩ ŋ mʋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩmma ŋaa kala teeŋ. Dɩ ba nɩɩ walɩmɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ laaŋ ta ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I want you to open their eyes, so they will turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God. Then their sins will be forgiven, and by faith in me they will become part of God's holy people.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ tɩmɩŋ dɩ ŋ mʋ bʋl wɩaa a suri ba sɩaa, dɩ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ birimiŋ lɛ a kʋ jʋʋ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ, a ŋaa dɩ ba lɩɩ Sɩtaanɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a kɔ Wɩa teeŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a laa mɩ wɩaa dii, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba. Ba jaŋ na leriŋ nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa tʋɔŋ.’ Pɔɔl bʋl ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa pɩ Wɩa

english_verse: King Agrippa, I obeyed this vision from heaven.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa kuoro, mɩ bɩ yikoro-la sɩ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ wɩaa vɩa.

english_verse: First I preached to the people in Damascus, and then I went to Jerusalem and all over Judea. Finally, I went to the Gentiles and said, “Stop sinning and turn to God! Then prove what you have done by the way you live.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ suomo bʋl Wɩa wɩaa Damasɩkʋs lɛ arɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kaa mʋ Judiya tinteeŋ kala, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩmma ŋaa tʋɔŋ. Mɩ bʋla pɩba dɩ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ aŋ bɩrɩma to Wɩa, a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: That is why some men grabbed me in the temple and tried to kill me.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa kɛmmɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ aa chɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ.

english_verse: But all this time God has helped me, and I have preached both to the rich and to the poor. I have told them only what the prophets and Moses said would happen.
translation_verse: Ama arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala Wɩa haa pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ chɩŋ daha aa bʋl wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩ pɛ na aŋ nɩɩ ma a pɩpɩma, ma nɩbalaa arɩ ma nɩbiisiŋ kala. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ Mosis kala fa bʋl arɩ wɩɩ-la jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: I told them how the Messiah would suffer and be the first to be raised from death, so he could bring light to his own people and to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ba fa bʋla arɩ Kirisito jaŋ na hɛɛŋ a sʋʋ, a laa sɩpaaŋ a sii sʋʋŋ lɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba kala tʋɔŋ. Ba bɩra bʋla pɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ to a na pʋlʋmʋŋ.”

english_verse: Before Paul finished defending himself, Festus shouted, “Paul, you're crazy! Too much learning has driven you out of your mind.”
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa dɩ ʋ laa ʋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ, Fɛsɩtɔs kpɩaʋ lɛ a bʋl, “Pɔɔl, ŋŋ nyaasɛ nɛ. Ŋ wʋjɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ kɛnɩŋ nyɩnyaasɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: But Paul replied, “Honorable Festus, I am not crazy. What I am saying is true, and it makes sense.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ nyaasɛ mɩ nyɩna. Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩɩ bʋl. Mɩ sɩaa kala nɛ fɩɛla.

english_verse: None of these things happened off in a corner somewhere. I am sure that King Agrippa knows what I am talking about. That's why I can speak so plainly to him.”
translation_verse: Kuoro Agɩrɩpa, ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ wuo bʋbʋlba arɩ nyuduoŋ. Mɩ jɩma arɩ wɩaa deemba kʋŋkala tuo ŋ sɩ bɩ jɩŋ. Wɩaa deemba kala sɩ ŋaa, ba bɩ wʋfaalɩa ŋaa.

english_verse: Then Paul said to Agrippa, “Do you believe what the prophets said? I know you do.”
translation_verse: Kuoro, ŋ laa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa wɩaa dii nɛɛ? Mɩ jɩma ŋ laa dii nɛ.”

english_verse: Agrippa asked Paul, “In such a short time do you think you can talk me into being a Christian?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Agɩrɩpa pɩɛsɛ Pɔɔl, “Ŋ bɩɩna lɛɛlɛ-bie deeŋ ŋ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ mɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a tutou koo?”

english_verse: Paul answered, “Whether it takes a short time or a long time, I wish you and everyone else who hears me today would become just like me! Except, of course, for these chains.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl bʋl, “Ʋ ŋaa lɛɛlɛ koo ʋ dieni mʋa, mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ dɩ nɩkaana-la kala sɩɩ jegile mɩ teeŋ jɩnɩŋ deeŋ, dɩ ma kʋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a nagɛmɛ. Ama mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ ma nagɛmɛ arɩ ba sɩ vɔɔmɛ arɩ chɔrʋmɔɔ ŋ-la.”

english_verse: Then King Agrippa, Governor Festus, Bernice, and everyone who was with them got up.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɛrɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ chɩŋ kuoru-balɩŋ nyuŋ arɩ Bɛɛnɩs arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ hɔnɔ, ba sii.

english_verse: But before they left, they said, “This man isn't guilty of anything. He doesn't deserve to die or to be put in jail.”
translation_verse: Ba sɩ lɩɩ dɩ-jalɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ba bʋla pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ, “Baala deeŋ bɩ wɩɩkala cheye a magɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ koo dɩ ba kɛnʋ tɔ dɩa.”

english_verse: Agrippa told Festus, “Paul could have been set free, if he had not asked to be tried by the Roman Emperor.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Agɩrɩpa bʋla pɩ Fɛsɩtɔs, “Dɩ baala deeŋ fa bɩ wombiiŋ sʋla arɩ ʋ jaŋ mʋ kuoru-balɩŋ teeŋ dɩ ʋ dii ʋ sarɩya, mɩ fa jaŋ bʋl dɩ ŋ joŋu ta.”

english_verse: When it was time for us to sail to Rome, Captain Julius from the Emperor's special troops was put in charge of Paul and the other prisoners.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba vʋʋrɛ dɩ la jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro a mʋ Ɩtalɩ tinteeŋ. Ba joŋ Pɔɔl hɛ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Julias nɩsɩŋ lɛ a pɛ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ kaa tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa lɛ. Julias lɩɩ Rom nɛ, a fa ŋaa Rom kuoru-balɩŋ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ.

english_verse: We went aboard a ship from Adramyttium that was about to sail to some ports along the coast of Asia. Aristarchus from Thessalonica in Macedonia sailed on the ship with us.
translation_verse: La mʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro sɩ lɩɩ taŋ kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Adɩramɩtam a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ tasɩ-la sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ Esia tinteeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ la sii a mʋmʋ. Baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Arɩsɩtakʋs ma fa hɛ la tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa Masidoonia tɩɩna nɛ a lɩɩ Tɛsalonaaka.

english_verse: The next day we came to shore at Sidon. Captain Julius was very kind to Paul. He even let him visit his friends, so they could give him whatever he needed.
translation_verse: Taŋ ka pʋl dɩ la mʋ yi taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Sɩdɔŋ. Julias fa kɛŋ zile Pɔɔl teeŋ a pʋ wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ mʋ na ʋ nandɔnsʋŋ, dɩ ʋ nɩɩ chɛ kʋŋ ma, dɩ ba pɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: When we left Sidon, the winds were blowing against us, and we sailed close to the island of Cyprus to be safe from the wind.
translation_verse: La bɩra sii nɩmɛ a mʋmʋ. La sɩɩ mʋ, dɩ peliŋ lu lɩɩ lee-la la fa sɩ chaasa. La mɩɩra mʋ to tinteeŋ kʋbala lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu, baa yɩrɛ Saapʋrɔs. La to sɛmɛ-la sɩ kɛrɛ peliŋ.

english_verse: Then we sailed south of Cilicia and Pamphylia until we came to the port of Myra in Lycia.
translation_verse: La kpɛrɛ to Siliisia arɩ Pamfiilia tinteeŋ niiŋ, a mʋ yi lee kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Maara. Ʋ fa hɛ Laasa tinteeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: There the army captain found a ship from Alexandria that was going to Italy. So he ordered us to board that ship.
translation_verse: Nɩmɛ nɛ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la na lɩɩŋ daboro dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Alɛkɩzandɩrɩa a mʋmʋ Ɩtalɩ. Ʋ ŋaa la jʋʋ.

english_verse: We sailed along slowly for several days and had a hard time reaching Cnidus. The wind would not let us go any farther in that direction, so we sailed past Cape Salmone, where the island of Crete would protect us from the wind.
translation_verse: La fɩɛla duori ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ tapʋl daŋ a na hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ, aŋ lɛɛlɛ kʋ kpagɛ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Sɩnaadas. Pel-la bɩ sɛyɛ dɩ la to nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ la bɩra duoro kpɛrɛ to tinteeŋ kʋbala lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu, baa yɩrɛ Kiriiti, a kʋ yi lee kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Salimoni. La kpɛrɛ to tintee-la sɛmɛ-la sɩ kɛrɛ peliŋ.

english_verse: We went slowly along the coast and finally reached a place called Fair Havens, not far from the town of Lasea.
translation_verse: La sɩ kpɛrɛ to lɩɩ-la niiŋ ŋɩɩ, la na hɛɛŋ woruŋ aŋ-na kʋ yi lee kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Fɛɛ Heevins. Ʋ fa kpagɛ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Lasɩa.

english_verse: By now we had already lost a lot of time, and sailing was no longer safe. In fact, even the Great Day of Forgiveness was past.
translation_verse: La hɔŋ nɩmɛ a dieni, Juu tɩŋŋaa tapʋl-bal-la ba sɩ yie pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta kʋ kieli. Bʋa-la lɛ lɩɩŋ duoruŋ yie hɛɩ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ chagɩlɛba a bʋl,

english_verse: Then Paul spoke to the crew of the ship, “Men, listen to me! If we sail now, our ship and its cargo will be badly damaged, and many lives will be lost.”
translation_verse: “Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ na arɩ la wombii-la vɛnɩŋ jaŋ kperila. Má leŋ dɩ la hɔŋ daha. Dɩ la nɛ sɩ la mʋ, la lɩɩŋ daboro arɩ la chʋgʋsʋŋ jaŋ chei, la dɔnsʋŋ ma jaŋ sʋʋ.”

english_verse: But Julius listened to the captain of the ship and its owner, rather than to Paul.
translation_verse: Ama laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la fa bɩ Pɔɔl teeŋ jegile nɩɩ, aŋ mɩɩra to lɩɩŋ daboro-la kʋhɩaŋ arɩ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tɩɩna nii.

english_verse: The harbor at Fair Havens wasn't a good place to spend the winter. Because of this, almost everyone agreed that we should at least try to sail along the coast of Crete as far as Phoenix. It had a harbor that opened toward the southwest and northwest, and we could spend the winter there. The Storm at Sea
translation_verse: Ba sɩ lee-la lɩɩŋ daborosuŋ sɩɩ chɩŋ bɩ zɔŋ arɩ ba sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ waarɩŋ bʋa lɛ. Ba jesiŋ kala fa cho dɩ la jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la, a wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ la nɛ wuolo, dɩ la mʋ yi taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Fiinis a hɛ nɩmɛ waarɩŋ bʋa lɛ. Fiinis nɛ fa ŋaa lee-la lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ sɩ yie chɩŋ a hɛ Kiriiti tinteeŋ. Ʋ fa hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ arɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ pɛgɛ nɛ, a bɩra pɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa arɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ pɛgɛ maa a kɛrɛ peliŋ. Lɩɩ-peliŋ lu mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ

english_verse: When a gentle wind from the south started blowing, the men thought it was a good time to do what they had planned. So they pulled up the anchor, and we sailed along the coast of Crete.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ peliŋ fɩɛla lu a lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩraa a kʋkɔ. Nɩalɩŋ bɩɩna arɩ ba jaŋ na wombiiŋ a vɛŋ arɩ ba fa sɩ bɩɩna ŋɩɩ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ hɔɔ-bal-la ba sɩ yie kaa chagɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la a kaa lɩɩsɛ a hɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ, aŋ duoro kpɛrɛ to Kiriiti tinteeŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: The wind struck the ship, and we could not sail against it. So we let the wind carry the ship.
translation_verse: Ʋ kʋ ŋmoo lɩɩŋ daboro-la, la bɩ pel-la wuo chaasɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ la leŋ pel-la kɛŋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la mʋ lee-la ʋ sɩ lu mʋmʋ.

english_verse: We went along the island of Cauda on the side that was protected from the wind. We had a hard time holding the lifeboat in place,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la to lee kʋbala lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu baa yɩrɛ Kaada, a to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Ʋ kɛrɛ pel-la mʋa. Nɩmɛ la na hɛɛŋ woruŋ aŋ-na wuo kɛŋ lɩɩŋ dabori-bie-la la fa sɩ joŋo vɔɔ lɩɩŋ daboro-la harɩŋ.

english_verse: but finally we got it where it belonged. Then the sailors wrapped ropes around the ship to hold it together. They lowered the sail and let the ship drift along, because they were afraid it might hit the sandbanks in the gulf of Syrtis.
translation_verse: Ba lɛrɛ lɩɩŋ dabori-bie-la kʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ ŋmɛsɩŋ vɔbʋ, aŋ vɔɔ lɩɩŋ daboro-la kala kpaŋ kpaŋ. Fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛmba arɩ ba jaŋ vɛnɛ mʋ jʋʋ hagɩlɩ-bumbugulo-la tʋɔŋ sɩ golli Libiya tinteeŋ a pɛ nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ gɛnnɩ-la ba fa sɩ joŋo vɔɔ lɩɩŋ daboro-la nyuŋ dɩ peliŋ kaa vɛŋ a kaa ta ba sʋʋsa tuu, aŋ leŋ pel-la kɛŋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la aa vɛŋ.

english_verse: The storm was so fierce that the next day they threw some of the ship's cargo overboard.
translation_verse: Pel-la faasa lu ŋɩɩ nɛ deeŋ deeŋ. Taŋ sɩ pʋla ba suomo chaarɛ chʋgʋsʋ-la sɩ hɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ a yuo tɩta.

english_verse: Then on the third day, with their bare hands they threw overboard some of the ship's gear.
translation_verse: Chɛ tori chɛɛŋ, la tɩtɩa chaarɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la kɩaa ba sɩ kaa wasɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la dɔnsʋŋ a yuo ta.

english_verse: For several days we could not see either the sun or the stars. A strong wind kept blowing, and we finally gave up all hope of being saved.
translation_verse: La tapʋlaa yʋga wɩa sɩ bɩ pɔsɔ, chɛnwʋlaa ma bɩ lɩa. Ka pel-la ha faasa lulu kɩŋkɛŋ. Pel-la sɩ faasa lulu ŋɩɩ, la bɩra bɩ yɩɛla arɩ la jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Since none of us had eaten anything for a long time, Paul stood up and told the men: You should have listened to me! If you had stayed on in Crete, you would not have had this damage and loss.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ diene ba bɩ kɩaa die. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl sii chɩŋ ba sɩpaaŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Nandɔmba, ʋ fa maga dɩ ma jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ nɛ dɩ la sɩ́ Kiriiti lɛ lɩɩ. Ma nɛ fa ŋaa ŋɩɩ, la kɩaa deemba kala sɩ cheye, ba fa bɩ chei. Kɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩ lɛlɛ fa bɩ jaŋ lɛl.

english_verse: But now I beg you to cheer up, because you will be safe. Only the ship will be lost.
translation_verse: Ama mɩɩ sʋlma, má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ. Lɩɩŋ daboro dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ lɛl, ama ma kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: I belong to God, and I worship him. Last night he sent an angel
translation_verse: Wɩa-la sɩ tɩɩmɛ, mɩ tɩma pʋpʋ, ʋ tɩndaara dɩa kɔ mɩ teeŋ nɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ

english_verse: to tell me, “Paul, don't be afraid! You will stand trial before the Emperor. And because of you, God will save the lives of everyone on the ship.”
translation_verse: a bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Pɔɔl, sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá. Ŋ jaŋ mʋ chɩŋ kuoru-balɩŋ Siiza sɩpaaŋ. Wɩa tɩŋ ŋ wɩaa nɛ a leŋ ŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ lɩɩŋ daboro tʋɔŋ, kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.’

english_verse: Cheer up! I am sure that God will do exactly what he promised.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ naambiiriŋ, má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ. Mɩ laa Wɩa dii arɩ wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ, ʋ jaŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa.

english_verse: But we will first be shipwrecked on some island.
translation_verse: Ama pel-la ta jaŋ yigi lɩɩŋ daboro-la mʋ pɛ chɩŋ dundol-bie kʋbala lɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu.”

english_verse: They cut the anchors loose and let them sink into the sea. At the same time they untied the ropes that were holding the rudders. Next, they raised the sail at the front of the ship and let the wind carry the ship toward the beach.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba keri hɔɔ-bala-la ba fa sɩ yie kaa chɩchagɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la a lo hɛ lɩɩŋ lɛ.
