Ba kɛŋ ŋmɛsɩ-la ma puri ba sɩ kaa vɔɔ danyine-la ba fa sɩ kaa kukuosi lɩɩŋ, a dɩdagɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la wombiiŋ. Ba bɩra wasa kɛŋ gɛnnɩ-la ma ba sɩ kaa vɔɔ lɩɩŋ daboro-la sɩpaaŋ kaa ta ba jɩl, dɩ peliŋ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la mʋ lɩɩ-la niiŋ.

english_verse: The sailors wanted to escape from the ship. So they lowered the lifeboat into the water, pretending that they were letting down some anchors from the front of the ship.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ duori lɩɩŋ daboro-la lɩɩ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba fá, aŋ ka lɩɩŋ daboro-la arɩ nɩkaanaa. Ba lɩɩsɛ lɩɩŋ dabori-bie-la a hɛ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ, a fufugisi arɩ baa chɛ dɩ ba lɩɩ lɩɩsɛ hɔɔ-la ba sɩ kaa chɩchagɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la sɩpaaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The sailors were afraid that we might hit some rocks, and they let down four anchors from the back of the ship. Then they prayed for daylight.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛmba arɩ ba jaŋ mʋ ŋmoo bʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba chaarɛ hɔɔnʋ-la ba sɩ yie kaa chɩchagɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la a kɩkɩɩ. Ba banɛsɛ nɛ ba fa chaarɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la harɩŋ a chagʋ kɩɩ, aŋ sʋsʋl Wɩa dɩ taŋ pʋl dɩ ba na pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: But Paul said to Captain Julius and the soldiers, “If the sailors don't stay on the ship, you won't have any chance to save your lives.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl jɩŋ a bʋla pɩ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la arɩ laalɩyuoro-la, “Ma bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, see nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ duori lɩɩŋ daboro-la hɛ lɩɩŋ daboro tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: The soldiers then cut the ropes that held the lifeboat and let it fall into the sea.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, laalɩyuoro-la keri ŋmɛsɩ-la ba fa sɩ kaa vɔɔ lɩɩŋ dabori-bie-la, a leŋ lɩɩŋ joŋo viiri.

english_verse: I beg you to eat something. Your lives depend on it. Do this and not one of you will be hurt.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩɩ sʋlma dɩ ma dii kɩaa. Dɩ ma nɛ dii kɩaa, ma jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ, a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Ma kʋŋ nyu-pʋŋ ma bɩ jaŋ lɛl.”

english_verse: After Paul had said this, he took a piece of bread and gave thanks to God. Then in front of everyone, he broke the bread and ate some.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ joŋ boroboro, a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa ba kala sɩpaaŋ, aŋ chɔgɛ didii.

english_verse: They all felt encouraged, and each of them ate something.
translation_verse: Ba nyuŋ nyaasɛ, ba kʋŋkala ma dii kʋdiilee.

english_verse: and after everyone had eaten, they threw the cargo of wheat into the sea to make the ship lighter. The Shipwreck
translation_verse: Ba kala sɩ dii kɩaa vɔgɛ, ba chaarɛ mɩa-la fa sɩ hɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la lɛ a hɛ mʋga-la tʋɔŋ, dɩ lɩɩŋ daboro-la sɩ́ faasa yuŋ. Lɩɩŋ daboro ka chei nɛ

english_verse: Morning came, and the ship's crew saw a coast they did not recognize. But they did see a cove with a beach. So they decided to try to run the ship aground on the beach.
translation_verse: Taŋ sɩ pʋla, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ duori lɩɩŋ daboro-la bɩ wuo jɩŋ arɩ ba yi dundolo-la niiŋ nɛ, ka ba yi. Ba na dɩ tinteeŋ nɛ golli lɩɩ-la chu, lɩɩ-la bɩ jal. Lee-la kala taalɛ a kɛŋ hagɩla. Ba bɩɩnɛ ba jaŋ wuo kɛŋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la mʋ chɩŋ hagɩla-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But it ran aground on a sandbank. The front of the ship stuck firmly in the sand, and the rear was being smashed by the force of the waves.
translation_verse: Ama lɩɩŋ daboro-la fá mʋ jʋʋ hagɩlɩ-bumbugulo tʋɔŋ fuo-balaa balɩa sɩ kʋ cheŋ dɔŋɔ a kuro bil. Daboro-la sɩpaaŋ mʋʋrɛ, ʋ bɩ wuo vɛŋ, aŋ ka pel-bal-la ŋaa lɩɩ-peliŋ kʋ ŋmoo lɩɩŋ daboro-la, a leŋ ʋ harɩŋ kala yɛrɛ.

english_verse: The soldiers decided to kill the prisoners to keep them from swimming away and escaping.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuoro-la vʋʋrɛ dɩ ba kpʋ nɩalɩŋ ba kɛsɛ tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa kala, dɩ ba kʋŋkala sɩ́ wuo lɩɩ a duori lɩɩ-la a fá lɛl.

english_verse: But Captain Julius wanted to save Paul's life, and he did not let the soldiers do what they had planned. Instead, he ordered everyone who could swim to jump into the water and head for shore.
translation_verse: Ka laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ-la faa chɛ dɩ ʋ laa Pɔɔl ta, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba dɩ ba sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa. Ʋ ta bʋla pɩba arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ́ jɩŋ lɩɩŋ a hɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ, dɩ ba laa sɩpaaŋ fɩla tuu a duoro mʋ lɩɩ-la niiŋ,

english_verse: Then he told the others to hold on to planks of wood or parts of the ship. At last, everyone safely reached shore.
translation_verse: aŋ ka dɩ nɩkaana-la ma tuu, dɩ dɔnsʋŋ paa daa-borusuŋ, dɩ dɔnsʋŋ ma paa lɩɩŋ daboro-la dabori-yɛrɩɛ-la, a ma kaa duori lɩɩŋ lɩɩ. Ŋ-la nɛ la kala ŋaa a lɩɩ lɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ suoo.

english_verse: The local people were very friendly, and they welcomed us by building a fire, because it was rainy and cold.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kɛnla woruŋ lee-la, a pɛ la lɛ kɩŋkɛŋ. La sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ, duonuŋ suomo nɩnɩɩ, leriŋ fɩɛlɛ woruŋ. Ba hɛ nyiniŋ pɩla la wiwieni.

english_verse: After Paul had gathered some wood and had put it on the fire, the heat caused a snake to crawl out, and it bit him on the hand.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl mʋ jaa daasɩŋ a kaa kʋ hɛ nyiŋ-la lɛ, dɩ dɩmɩŋ hɛ daasɩ-la lɛ. Wulumuŋ kɛŋ dɩŋ-la ʋ kʋ lɩɩ a dɩma pɛ Pɔɔl nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When the local people saw the snake hanging from Paul's hand, they said to each other, “This man must be a murderer! He didn't drown in the sea, but the goddess of justice will kill him anyway.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ lee-la a na dɩ dɩŋ-la dɩma pɛ Pɔɔl nɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ba bʋla pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ, “Ʋ naga baala deeŋ ŋaa nɩkpʋʋrʋ nɛ. Ʋ wuo lɩɩ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ama Wɩa bɩ sɛyɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: Paul shook the snake off into the fire and wasn't harmed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl kɛŋ dɩŋ-la kpesi ʋ tel nyiŋ-la tʋɔŋ, ama dɩŋ-la sɩ dɩmʋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ ʋ wɩɩkala ŋaa.

english_verse: The people kept thinking that Paul would either swell up or suddenly drop dead. They watched him for a long time, and when nothing happened to him, they changed their minds and said, “This man is a god.”
translation_verse: Ba faa gbɛrɛ dɩŋ-la sɩ dɩŋ Pɔɔl ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ ŋmɛrɛ, koo dɩ ʋ guu tele sʋʋ, dɩ ba na. Ba gbɛrɛ a dieni, ka ba bɩ na arɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa ʋ lɛ. Ba bɩrɩmɛ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa a bʋl dɩ ʋ ŋaa vene nɛ.

english_verse: The governor of the island was named Publius, and he owned some of the land around there. Publius was very friendly and welcomed us into his home for three days.
translation_verse: Tintee-la kuoro yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Pubilias. Ʋ bagɩsɩŋ ma fa kpagɛ lee-la nɛ. Ʋ kɛnla kaa mʋ ʋ leriŋ, a kɛnla woruŋ tapʋlaa batori.

english_verse: His father was in bed, sick with fever and stomach trouble, and Paul went to visit him. Paul healed the man by praying and placing his hands on him.
translation_verse: Kuoru-la nyɩmma faa wɩɩlɛ nɛ a pɩŋ dɩa lɛ. Ʋ yaraa fa lɩma nɛ, aŋ ka ʋ nɩnɩgɩlɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pɔɔl jʋʋ naʋ ʋ dɩa lɛ a joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ ʋ lɛ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pʋ, ʋ duori.

english_verse: After this happened, everyone on the island brought their sick people to Paul, and they were all healed.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, puwuolo-la kala fa sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu kɔ Pɔɔl teeŋ. Ʋ ŋaa ba duori.

english_verse: Three months later we sailed in a ship that had been docked at Malta for the winter. The ship was from Alexandria in Egypt and was known as “The Twin Gods.”
translation_verse: La hɛ nɩmɛ chɛnsɩŋ batori nɛ aŋ sii jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro a lɩɩ Alɛkɩzandɩrɩa. Lɩɩŋ daboro-la yɩrɩŋ nɛ veŋ-daalɩarɩŋ. Yibiiniŋ fa sɩ suomo, ba fa vɔɔ lɩɩŋ daboro-la a bil lɩɩŋ niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: We arrived in Syracuse and stayed for three days.
translation_verse: La sɩɩ mʋ ŋɩɩ, la mʋ yi taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Sɩrakas, a chʋa nɩmɛ tapʋlaa batori.

english_verse: From there we sailed to Rhegium. The next day a south wind began to blow, and two days later we arrived in Puteoli.
translation_verse: La bɩra lɩɩ nɩmɛ a jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro, a duoro mʋ taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Rɩɩgɩam. Ʋ taŋ sɩ pʋla, peliŋ bɩra suomo lu a lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ. Tapʋl-lɩa chɛɛŋ nɛ la kʋ yi taŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Putooli.

english_verse: There we found some of the Lord's followers, who begged us to stay with them. A week later we left for the city of Rome.
translation_verse: La na nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɩmɛ. Ba sɩ dɩ la chʋa ba teeŋ yɔbɔ. La chʋa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ la bɩra lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ Rom.

english_verse: Some of the followers in Rome heard about us and came to meet us at the Market of Appius and at the Three Inns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and was encouraged. Paul in Rome
translation_verse: La naambiiri-la sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii Rom lɛ nɩɩ la wɩaa arɩ laa kɔ nɛ. Ba kʋ chenla dɩ-bolii, lere kʋbalaba baa yɩrɛ Apɩas Yɔbɔ arɩ Dɩɩsɩŋ batori Nʋhʋɔraa sɩɩ chʋa. Pɔɔl sɩ naba, ʋ nyuŋ nyaasɛ ʋ lɔllɛ Wɩa. Pɔɔl hɛ Rom lɛ

english_verse: We arrived in Rome, and Paul was allowed to live in a house by himself with a soldier to guard him.
translation_verse: La sɩ yi Rom, ba pɩ Pɔɔl wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ jʋjʋʋ ʋ dʋndʋŋa dɩa, ka ba ŋaa laalɩyuoru kʋbala bibenu.

english_verse: Three days after we got there, Paul called together some of the Jewish leaders and said: My friends, I have never done anything to hurt our people, and I have never gone against the customs of our ancestors. But in Jerusalem I was handed over as a prisoner to the Romans.
translation_verse: Ʋ tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ Pɔɔl yɩrɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa kʋhɩasɩŋ taŋ-la lɛ ba kʋ hilimi. Ba sɩ kʋ hilimi ŋɩɩ, ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa chei la nɩaa lɛ, mɩ bɩ la naabalɩmaba kɩsɩnɩŋ ma cheye. Ama ba kɛmmɛ a tɔ dɩa nɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, aŋ bɩra jommi a hɛ Rom tɩŋŋaa ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋ-la.

english_verse: They looked into the charges against me and wanted to release me. They found that I had not done anything deserving death.
translation_verse: Ba pɩɛsɛmɛ wɩaa a na dɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩkala cheye a magɛ dɩ ba kpʋmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba chɩchɛ dɩ ba jommi ta.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders disagreed, so I asked to be tried by the Emperor. But I don't have anything to say against my own nation.
translation_verse: Ama Juu tɩŋŋaa bɩ sɛyɛ dɩ ba jommi ta, ŋɩɩ nɛ fʋgɛmɛ mɩ sʋl wombiiŋ dɩ ba kɛmmɛ kaa kɔ kuoru-balɩŋ teeŋ dɩ ʋ diimi sarɩya. Ama mɩ-na bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ nɩaa Juu tɩŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: I am bound by these chains because of what we people of Israel hope for. This is why I have called you here to talk about this hope of ours.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ tɩɩ mɩ sɩ mɩ jaŋ nama dɩ la bʋl wɩaa. Ba kɛŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ deemba vɔɔmɛ a tɩŋ nɩɩ-la wɩaa ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ kɔ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: The leaders replied, “No one from Judea has written us a letter about you. And not one of them has come here to report on you or to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ba bʋla pʋ, “La bɩ teŋ kala laa a lɩɩ Judiya tinteeŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ. La naambiiriŋ kʋbala ma bɩ lee-la lɩɩ kʋ bʋl wʋbɔŋ a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But we would like to hear what you have to say. We understand that people everywhere are against this new group.”
translation_verse: Ama la jɩma arɩ lee-na kala nɩaa yie bʋbʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ wombii-la ŋ sɩɩ to lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la chɩchɛ dɩ la nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa dii.”

english_verse: They agreed on a time to meet with Paul, and many of them came to his house. From early morning until late in the afternoon, Paul talked to them about God's kingdom. He used the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets to try to win them over to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɛ tapʋlʋŋ pɩ Pɔɔl. Tapʋlɩɩ-la sɩ yie, nɩaa yʋga a kɔ lee-la Pɔɔl sɩɩ jʋʋ. Pɔɔl bʋl Wɩa kuorii-la wɩaa a pɩpɩba sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ a lɩɩ chʋchʋɔŋ kala a kaa mʋmʋ dɩdaanɩŋ. Ʋ karɩmɛ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, arɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ dagɛba ŋɩɩ a bʋl Yesu wɩaa pɩba, a wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ba laa Yesu wɩaa dii.

english_verse: Some of the leaders agreed with what Paul said, but others did not.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla, ba dɔnsʋŋ laa dii, dɔnsʋŋ ma bɩ laa dii.

english_verse: Since they could not agree among themselves, they started leaving. But Paul said, “The Holy Spirit said the right thing when he sent Isaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba nɛ Pɔɔl bʋl, ka ba kɛŋ wɩaa lɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a sii viiri. Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ fa sɩ to Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Azaaya lɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ ma naabalɩmaba, ba ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ.

english_verse: to tell our ancestors, ‘Go to these people and tell them: You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ, ‘Mʋ nɩaa deemba teeŋ a bʋla pɩba: Ma jaŋ jegile nɩnɩɩ wɩaa aŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ma jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ. Ma jaŋ nɩna wɩaa aŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ma jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa,

english_verse: All of you have stubborn hearts. Your ears are stopped up, and your eyes are covered. You cannot see or hear or understand. If you could, you would turn to me, and I would heal you.’ ”
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa nɩaa deemba tʋɔŋ dolie, ba tɔ ba dɩgɩlaa nɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ wɩɩ nɩɩ. Ba kɛŋ ba sɩaa ma tɔ nɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ kʋŋkala na. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ba sɩaa fa jaŋ nɩna, dɩ ba dɩgɩlaa ma fa nɩnɩɩ wɩaa. Ba nyuŋ ma fa jaŋ jɩjɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ. Ba fa jaŋ bɩrɩma tomi dɩ mɩ ŋaa dɩ ba duori.’ ”

english_verse: Paul said, “You may be sure that God wants to save the Gentiles! And they will listen.”
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɛrɛ, Juu tɩmma-la kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ lɛrɛ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, a sii viiri.

english_verse: For two years Paul stayed in a rented house and welcomed everyone who came to see him.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl hɔŋ Rom lɛ jɩsɩŋ balɩa, a laa dɩa a jʋjʋʋ. Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ kɔ dɩ ʋ naʋ, ʋ yie kɛnʋ woruŋ nɛ.

english_verse: He bravely preached about God's kingdom and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ, and no one tried to stop him.
translation_verse: Ʋ bʋl Wɩa kuorii-la wɩaa a pɩ nɩaa, a dagɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito ma wɩaa arɩ nyuduoŋ a pɩ nɩaa. Nʋʋkala fa bɩ ʋ tɔ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus. God chose me to be an apostle, and he appointed me to preach the good news
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl sɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito tɩntɩnna, mɩ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ ma Rom tɩŋŋaa. Wɩa nɛ yɩrɛmɛ mɩ ŋaa ʋ nanzɔɔ. Ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: This good news is about his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ! As a human, he was from the family of David. But the Holy Spirit proved that Jesus is the powerful Son of God, because he was raised from death.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ, ŋɩɩ dagɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa Bii nɛ, a kɛŋ doluŋ a kɛŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ma.

english_verse: Jesus was kind to me and chose me to be an apostle, so that people of all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: Ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ Wɩa leŋe mɩ ŋaa ʋ nanzɔɔ nɛ a bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa a pɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala, dɩ ba laa dii a to Yesu niiŋ a wuo zil ʋ yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: You are some of those people chosen by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ma ma Rom tɩŋŋaa hɛ nɩaa deemba tʋɔŋ nɛ. Wɩa lɩɩsɛma nɛ dɩ Yesu Kirisito tɩɩma.

english_verse: This letter is to all of you in Rome. God loves you and has chosen you to be his very own people. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩ ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Rom tinteeŋ lɛ, ma nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ cho a lɩɩsɛma dɩ ma ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa. La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ba jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ. Pɔɔl sʋl Wɩa, Rom tɩŋŋaa wɩaa

english_verse: First, I thank God in the name of Jesus Christ for all of you. I do this because people everywhere in the world are talking about your faith.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ to Yesu Kirisito lɛ aa lɔllɛ Wɩa ma kala wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa dʋnɩa nʋʋkala nɩɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ.

english_verse: God has seen how I never stop praying for you, while I serve him with all my heart and tell the good news about his Son.
translation_verse: Wɩa mɩ sɩ tɩmaa pa arɩ mɩ tʋɔ-bala aa bʋl ʋ Bie wʋzɔmɔ-la, ʋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ pɛ-naara bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chʋɔlʋ, mɩ yie liliisi ma wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: In all my prayers, I ask God to make it possible for me to visit you.
translation_verse: Mɩ yie sʋlʋ a chɩchɛ wombiiŋ dɩ mɩ kʋ nama. Dɩ ʋ nɛ sɛyɛ, mɩ jaŋ kʋ nama lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: I want to see you and share with you the same blessings that God's Spirit has given me. Then you will grow stronger in your faith.
translation_verse: Mɩ cho dɩ mɩ kʋ nama nɛ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, a pɛ ma lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ma dol.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that I have often planned to come for a visit. But something has always kept me from doing it. I want to win followers to Christ in Rome, as I have done in many other places.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ cho dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ mɩ walɩma walɩma dɩ mɩ kʋ nama nɛ, ama wɩɩ nɛ yie tɩɩ mɩ bɩ kɔ. Mɩ cho dɩ mɩ ŋaa dɩ nɩaa lɩɩ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ a kʋ to Wɩa, arɩ mɩ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if people are civilized and educated, or if they are uncivilized and uneducated. I must tell the good news to everyone. That's why I am eager to visit all of you in Rome. The Power of the Good News
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ faasa cho dɩ mɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Rom tinteeŋ lɛ. Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la kɛŋ doluŋ

english_verse: I am proud of the good news! It is God's powerful way of saving all people who have faith, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ hɩɩsɩŋ ka fá dɩ mɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa doluŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laaba dii, Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa kala, Wɩa jaŋ laaba ta.

english_verse: The good news tells how God accepts everyone who has faith, but only those who have faith. It is just as the Scriptures say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.” Everyone Is Guilty
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la dagɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa nɩaa wuo kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ daga arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii, ba kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ, dɩ ba wuo chɩŋ ba laa diine-la naaŋ lɛ a mʋ dɛrɛ. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa Wɩa dii, ʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.” Wɩa baanɩŋ sii nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nyuŋ

english_verse: From heaven God shows how angry he is with all the wicked and evil things that sinful people do to crush the truth.
translation_verse: Wɩa baanɩŋ sii nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa ka to nyuŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba wʋŋaalaa nyagɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la bil nɛ.

english_verse: They know everything that can be known about God, because God has shown it all to them.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ nɩaa sɩ maga dɩ ba jɩŋ a tɩgɛ Wɩa lɛ, ba wombiiŋ chaasa pɩŋ nɛ. Wɩa nɛ dagɛba.

english_verse: God's eternal power and character cannot be seen. But from the beginning of creation, God has shown what these are like by all he has made. That's why those people don't have any excuse.
translation_verse: La bɩ Wɩa nagɩsɩŋ wuo jɩŋ. Ama la wuo chaasa na ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. Ʋ bɩ nuhuobiine naga. Ʋ dagɛla wɩaa deemba, a suomi bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa a kaa kʋkɔ jɩnɩŋ. Kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa nɛ dagɛla ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ ba bɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: They know about God, but they don't honor him or even thank him. Their thoughts are useless, and their stupid minds are in the dark.
translation_verse: Ba jɩma Wɩa hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ, ama ba bɩ ʋ ka zil arɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa. Ba bɩ ʋ ka lɔllɛ. Ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala bɩrɩma nɛ ba ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ. Ba tʋɔbɩɩŋ lɔrʋnʋ-la kɛmba kaa mʋ hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: They claim to be wise, but they are fools.
translation_verse: Ba bɩɩna ba kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ, ama ba yaara nɛ.

english_verse: They don't worship the glorious and eternal God. Instead, they worship idols that are made to look like humans who cannot live forever, and like birds, animals, and reptiles.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa maga dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ aŋ bɩ sʋʋ. Ka ba vɩa aŋ mɩɩra mɛ kɩaa sɩ nagɛ nuhuobiinee a sʋsʋʋ, a bɩra mɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ diibiisiŋ arɩ pʋsʋŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tuuri tinteeŋ, a chʋchʋɔlɛ.

english_verse: So God let these people go their own way. They did what they wanted to do, and their filthy thoughts made them do shameful things with their bodies.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa Wɩa jomba ta ba tuto ba tɩtɩa tʋɔbɩɩŋ lɔrʋnʋ-la ba sɩ cho, a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: They gave up the truth about God for a lie, and they worshiped God's creation instead of God, who will be praised forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ-la ba sɩ jɩma a tɩgɛ Wɩa lɛ, ba joŋu lenni wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ, a mɩɩra chʋchʋɔlɛ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa, aŋ vɩa dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaaba. Ʋ maga dɩ la dɛnnʋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: God let them follow their own evil desires. Women no longer wanted to have sex in a natural way, and they did things with each other that were not natural.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Wɩa jomba ta nɛ dɩ baa ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ a hɩhɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa. Haalaa vɩa dɩ ba dɩ ba balaba pɩpɛ bɔsɔ, aŋ ka ba dɩ ba hadɔsʋŋ mɩɩra pɩpɛ bɔsɔ.

english_verse: Men behaved in the same way. They stopped wanting to have sex with women and had strong desires for sex with other men. They did shameful things with each other, and what has happened to them is punishment for their foolish deeds.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ baalaa ma vɩa dɩ ba jaa haalaa arɩ Wɩa sɩ sɩ baa ŋaa ŋɩɩ, aŋ mɩɩra kɛŋ ba badɔsʋŋ pɩpɩŋ a hɩhɩɛnɛ dɔŋɔ, a ŋɩŋaa hɩɩsɛ wɩaa dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ba sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, baa dɔgɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Dɔgɩsɩna-la jaŋ magɛ ba yaraa lɛ.

english_verse: Since these people refused even to think about God, he let their useless minds rule over them. That's why they do all sorts of indecent things.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba bɩ chɛ dɩ ba jɩŋ Wɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa lemba ta ba tuto ba tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔmɔ-la harɩŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ maga dɩ baa ŋaa.

english_verse: They are evil, wicked, and greedy, as well as mean in every possible way. They want what others have, and they murder, argue, cheat, and are hard to get along with. They gossip,
translation_verse: Baa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ dosunuŋ kala nɛ. Ba kɛŋ nɩaa kɩaa lɩlaa, a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ, a kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ, a kpʋkpʋ nɩaa, a yuyuo yuosuŋ, a gɩgɩrɩmɛ nɩaa, a ŋaa wɩaa jʋjʋʋ nɩaa lɛ, a bʋbʋl nɩaa wɩaa.

english_verse: say cruel things about others, and hate God. They are proud, conceited, and boastful, always thinking up new ways to do evil. These people don't respect their parents.
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa yɩrɩ-cheeree ma nɛ, a bɛrɛ Wɩa, a ŋaa nii-jɩgɩ tɩmma. Baa dagɛ ba tɩtɩa a bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ. Ba yie chɩchɛ wombii-la ba sɩ jaŋ to a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ba bɩ ba nyɩmmaba arɩ ba naamba niiŋ ka to.

english_verse: They are stupid, unreliable, and don't have any love or pity for others.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ, a bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ma kɛnɛ. Ba bɩ nɩaa cho, a bɩ dɔŋɔ ma nenige ka fá.

english_verse: They know God has said that anyone who acts this way deserves to die. But they keep on doing evil things, and they even encourage others to do them.
translation_verse: Ba jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ wʋdosunuŋ deemba lɛ nɛ. Ʋ bʋla arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba, ba maga dɩ ba sʋʋ nɛ, aŋ ka ba vɩa aŋ ŋɩŋaaba. Ŋɩɩ ma dʋndʋŋa dee. Ba paala bɩbɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Some of you accuse others of doing wrong. But there is no excuse for what you do. When you judge others, you condemn yourselves, because you are guilty of doing the very same things.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ woruŋ ka ŋaa ma sɩ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩpɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl nɩaa teeŋ a bʋl dɩ ba cheye nɛ, aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa. Nɩɩ-la-na kala ma sɩ ŋaa, dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la, ma bɩra bɩ wɩɩkala kɛnɛ dɩ ma bʋl. Ma sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma tɩtɩa laa cheeriŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ lɛ.

english_verse: We know that God is right to judge everyone who behaves in this way.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba, la jɩma arɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Do you really think God won't punish you, when you behave exactly like the people you accuse?
translation_verse: Ama ma-na sɩ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ nɩaa aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba ma tɩtɩa lɛ, ma bɩɩna arɩ ma jaŋ wuo fá lɛl Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ ma sarɩya dii koo?

english_verse: You surely don't think much of God's wonderful goodness or of his patience and willingness to put up with you. Don't you know that the reason God is good to you is because he wants you to turn to him?
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ zile kɩŋkɛŋ a kɛŋ kenyiri ŋɩɩ, a nyalɩma pɩma maa ŋaa wɩaa, ma bene arɩ ʋ bɩ kʋŋ ŋaa? Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ zile ŋɩɩ, ʋʋ chɛ dɩ ma bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛɛ?

english_verse: But you are stubborn and refuse to turn to God. So you are making things even worse for yourselves on that day when he will show how angry he is and will judge the world with fairness.
translation_verse: Ma tʋɔŋ dolie. Ma vɩa dɩ ma bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ. Ma wasa ŋaa Wɩa baanɩŋ faasa sisii nɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya, ʋ jaŋ dii sarɩya arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ dɩ nɩaa na.

english_verse: God will reward each of us for what we have done.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ tiŋ nʋʋkala a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ tɩma magɛ.

english_verse: He will give eternal life to everyone who has patiently done what is good in the hope of receiving glory, honor, and life that lasts forever.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kenyiri a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, a ŋaa ŋɩɩ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba laa yɩrɩŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, a chɩchɛ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, Wɩa jaŋ joŋo pɩba.

english_verse: But he will show how angry and furious he can be with every selfish person who rejects the truth and wants to do evil.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ba tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ aŋ vɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la, aŋ tuto wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ, Wɩa jaŋ na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ kɩŋkɛŋ dɩ ba na hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: All who are wicked will be punished with trouble and suffering. It doesn't matter if they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, hɛɛŋ jaŋ jʋʋ. Hɛɛ-la jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ kɛŋ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɛ, aŋ-na kʋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ma.

english_verse: But all who do right will be rewarded with glory, honor, and peace, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ jaŋ na pʋlʋmʋŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, a laa yɩrɩŋ, a hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ, Juu tɩŋŋaa nɛ jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ, aŋ ka nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa tuto,

english_verse: God doesn't have any favorites!
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa bɩ nɩaa kaa pɔrɛ.

english_verse: Those people who don't know about God's Law will still be punished for what they do wrong. And the Law will be used to judge everyone who knows what it says.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba jɩŋ aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, ba jaŋ sʋʋ. Dɩ ba nɛ sʋba, wɩalɩŋ dee Wɩa jaŋ kaa dii ba sarɩya. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ ba ma nɛ sʋba, Wɩa jaŋ to wɩalɩŋ lɛ nɛ a dii ba sarɩya.

english_verse: This proves that the conscience is like a law written in the human heart. And it will show whether we are forgiven or condemned,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ daga arɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, hɛ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ cheye, ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa yie dagɛba nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ bɩra bɩ cheye ma, ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩra yie dagɛba nɛ.

english_verse: By reading the Scriptures you learn how God wants you to behave, and you discover what is right.
translation_verse: ŋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ ŋɩŋaa nɛ. Ba dagɩŋ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ ba tuto nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ.

english_verse: You are sure that you are a guide for the blind and a light for all who are in the dark.
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩma arɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa nyʋlɩmaa daa-kɛnnɛ a ŋaa nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: And since there is knowledge and truth in God's Law, you think you can instruct fools and teach young people.
translation_verse: Ŋ nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ, aa dagɛ hambiisiŋ maa. Wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto ŋaa ŋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ a jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: But how can you teach others when you refuse to learn? You preach it is wrong to steal. But do you steal?
translation_verse: Ŋ-na nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagɛ nɩaa, ŋ bɩ ŋ tɩtɩa ka dagɛɛ? Ŋŋ dagɛ nɩaa dɩ ba sɩ́ gaa, aŋ tɩtɩa gɩgaa.

english_verse: You say people should be faithful in marriage. But are you faithful? You hate idols, yet you rob their temples.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ sɩ dɩ nɩaa sɩ́ ba dɔnsʋŋ haalaa chɛ, aŋ tɩtɩa chɩchɛ nɩaa haalaa. Ŋ sɩ ŋ bɛrɛ vʋɩyaa nɛ, aŋ mʋ gɩgaa kɩaa vʋɩyaa dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You take pride in the Law, but you disobey the Law and bring shame to God.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na ka bigisi ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ arɩ ŋ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ, aŋ chichei wɩalɩŋ a hɩhɩɩsɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures tell us, “You have made foreigners say insulting things about God.”
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ a bʋl, “A tɩŋ ma Juu tɩŋŋaa wɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa tʋʋsɛ Wɩa joŋŋoo nɛ.”

english_verse: Being circumcised is worthwhile, if you obey the Law. But if you don't obey the Law, you are no better off than people who are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ keri ma penee aŋ tuto wɩalɩŋ kala Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, ma penee keriŋ kɛŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, ama dɩ ma nɩɩ chei wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile, ʋ naga arɩ ma bɩ ma penee kere.

english_verse: In fact, if they obey the Law, they are as good as anyone who is circumcised.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ ʋ peniŋ kere nɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa jaŋ benu arɩ ʋ keri ʋ peniŋ nɛɛ?

english_verse: So everyone who obeys the Law, but has never been circumcised, will condemn you. Even though you are circumcised and have the Law, you still don't obey its teachings.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba penee keri aŋ tuto wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, ba jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩma. Ma nɩaa deemba jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil nɛ a kikeri ma penee maa, aŋ ka ma chichei wɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: Just because you live like a Jew and are circumcised doesn't make you a real Jew.
translation_verse: Ŋ yaraa wʋŋaalaa dee bɩ ŋaa ŋ ŋaa Juu tɩɩna. Ŋ sɩ keri ŋ nammɩa ma ta dee bɩ tɩɩ.

english_verse: To be a real Jew you must obey the Law. True circumcision is something that happens deep in your heart, not something done to your body. And besides, you should want praise from God and not from humans.
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa Juu-tɩtɩɩ, ʋ tʋɔŋ wʋŋaalaa lɛ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ ŋaa Juu tɩɩna. Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, ʋ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ keri ʋ peniŋ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ nɛ jaŋ wuo ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩŋ, ŋ sɩ keri ŋ yaraa nammɩa ta dee. Wɩa nɛ jaŋ bɛsɛ ʋ tɩɩna lɛ, nuhuobiiŋ dee bɩ jaŋ bɛsɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: What good is it to be a Jew? What good is it to be circumcised?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa Juu tɩŋŋaa kaa kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa? Ba sɩɩ keri ba pene-la ma, ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ bɛɛ?

english_verse: It is good in a lot of ways! First of all, God's messages were spoken to the Jews.
translation_verse: Wɩaa yʋga nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa kaa kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa. Wɩalɩŋ kala tʋɔŋ wʋbalɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Juu tɩŋŋaa nɛ Wɩa joŋ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa pa.

english_verse: It is true that some of them did not believe the message. But does this mean that God cannot be trusted, just because they did not have faith?
translation_verse: Ka dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ bɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ laa dii, ʋ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ Wɩa sɩ́ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛŋ koo?

english_verse: No, indeed! God tells the truth, even if everyone else is a liar. The Scriptures say about God, “Your words will be proven true, and in court you will win your case.”
translation_verse: Aɩ, ŋɩɩ dee. Dɩ nɩaa kala nɛ paala ŋaa wʋnyɩɛra ma, Wɩa-na jaŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ Wɩa lɛ. Ba sɩ, “Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ bʋl wɩaa ba jaŋ na dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ŋ bʋbʋl, dɩ ŋ nɛ dii nɩaa sarɩya ma, ba jaŋ na dɩ ŋ kɩaa sɩma nɛ.”

english_verse: If our evil deeds show how right God is, then what can we say? Is it wrong for God to become angry and punish us? What a foolish thing to ask.
translation_verse: Ka la wʋbɔmɔ-la la sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ chaasa dagɛ arɩ Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, bɛɛ nɛ laa chɛ dɩ la bʋl? Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl nuhuobiine tʋɔbɩɩnaa wɩaa nɛ a pɩɛsɛ: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ dɔgɩsɛla a tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, ʋ kɩaa bɩ sɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, koo?

english_verse: But the answer is, “No.” Otherwise, how could God judge the world?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ dee. Dɩ Wɩa nɛ fa bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ, ɛɛ nɛ ʋ fa jaŋ wuo dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya?

english_verse: Since your lies bring great honor to God by showing how truthful he is, you may ask why God still says you are a sinner.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ mɩ wʋnyɩɛrɩ-la nɛ wuo leŋ dɩ Wɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la chaasa chɩŋ a laa yɩrɩŋ pʋ, bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ʋ jaŋ diimi sarɩya a bʋl dɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ nɛ, a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩmɛ?

english_verse: You might as well say, “Let's do something evil, so that something good will come of it!” Some people even claim that we are saying this. But God is fair and will judge them as well. No One Is Good
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ fa, mɩ fa jaŋ bʋl dɩ má leŋ dɩ la ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a na wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ paala tʋʋsɛla nɛ aŋ bʋl dɩ la daga arɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ jaŋ na wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ. Dɩ Wɩa nɛ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ nɩaa deemba, ʋ kɩaa jaŋ sɩŋ. Nʋʋkala bɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna ŋaa Wɩa sɩpaaŋ

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean that we Jews are better off than the Gentiles? No, it doesn't! Jews, as well as Gentiles, are ruled by sin, just as I have said.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ saa? Ma bɩɩna la Juu tɩŋŋaa kpɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɛɛ? Aɩ, la bɩ ba kpɩa. Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa kala, ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaara nɛ.

english_verse: Not one of them understands or even searches for God.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala tuo a jɩŋ Wɩa wɩalɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ, nʋʋkala ma bɩ Wɩa bee chɩchɛ.

english_verse: They have all turned away and are worthless. There isn't one person who does right.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala joŋ harɩŋ yɩa Wɩa nɛ a kala ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Nʋʋkala bɩ wʋzɔŋ ka ŋaa. Nɩbala ma tuo.

english_verse: Their words are like an open pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies. Each word is as deadly as the fangs of a snake,
translation_verse: Ba niiŋ wʋbʋlaa nagɛ bʋa-suruŋ sɩɩ sʋɔrɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ba bʋl wɩaa nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩaa. Ba wʋbʋlaa ma kɛŋ huoŋ a nagɛ dɩ-kuuro.”

english_verse: and they say nothing but bitter curses.
translation_verse: “Ba niiŋ hɛyɛ, ba ŋmɩɛsa hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛ.”

english_verse: These people quickly become violent.
translation_verse: “Ba bɩ diene aŋ kpʋkpʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: Wherever they go, they leave ruin and destruction.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ mʋ lee-na kala, ba yie chei lee-la nɛ a ŋaa nɩaa tʋɔŋ chei.

english_verse: They don't know how to live in peace.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ jɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ba dɩ nɩaa sɩŋ.”

english_verse: They don't even fear God.”
translation_verse: “Ba bɩ Wɩa ma ka fá.”

english_verse: We know that everything in the Law was written for those who are under its power. The Law says these things to stop anyone from making excuses and to let God show that the whole world is guilty.
translation_verse: La jɩma arɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, dɩ ʋ nɛ dagɛ wɩɩkala, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ nɛ ʋ daga pɩpa. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩɩkala dɩ Wɩa nɛ dii dʋnɩa nʋʋkala sarɩya.

english_verse: God doesn't accept people simply because they obey the Law. No, indeed! All the Law does is to point out our sin. God's Way of Accepting People
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile lɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Ama wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ dagɛla la jɩŋ arɩ nʋʋkala ka ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ. Nʋʋkala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ

english_verse: Now we see how God does make us acceptable to him. The Law and the Prophets tell how we become acceptable, and it isn't by obeying the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ Wɩa suri wombiiŋ nɛ dɩ nɩaa to a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ wombii-la bɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile lɛ lɩa. Ama wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile arɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ bʋla kala fa bʋl wombii-la wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: All of us have sinned and fallen short of God's glory.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋkala kɛŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a bɩ Wɩa wuo chɩna kpɩkpagɛ.

english_verse: But God treats us much better than we deserve, and because of Christ Jesus, he freely accepts us and sets us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ nɛ ʋ to Yesu Kirisito lɛ a laaba ta ba kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ chɔgɩta nɛ.

english_verse: God sent Christ to be our sacrifice. Christ offered his life's blood, so by faith in him we could come to God. And God did this to show that in the past he was right to be patient and forgive sinners. This also shows that God is right when he accepts people who have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ Wɩa dagɛ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩba nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ aa dagɛ arɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: What is left for us to brag about? Not a thing! Is it because we obeyed some law? No! It is because of faith.
translation_verse: Wʋbɛɛ nɛ saa la jaŋ kaa bigisi la tɩtɩa lɛ? Wɩɩkala tuo. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ? La sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto nɛ tɩɩ? Aɩ, ama la sɩ laa Yesu dii nɛ tɩɩ.

english_verse: We see that people are acceptable to God because they have faith, and not because they obey the Law.
translation_verse: La sɛyɛ arɩ nʋʋ jaŋ wuo na tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa Yesu dii. Dɩ la nɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, la bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla deeŋ.

english_verse: Does God belong only to the Jews? Isn't he also the God of the Gentiles? Yes, he is!
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna Wɩa ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa dʋndʋŋa Wɩa nɛɛ? Aɩ. Ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ma Wɩa nɛ.

english_verse: If he became acceptable to God because of what he did, then he would have something to brag about. But he would never be able to brag about it to God.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ fa leŋe ʋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ a tɩŋ ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa lɛ, ʋ fa jaŋ wuo bibigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ, ama Wɩa teeŋ dee.

english_verse: But you cannot make God accept you because of something you do. God accepts sinners only because they have faith in him.
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ ʋ wʋŋaalaa lɛ nɩɩ beŋ, aŋ laa dii arɩ Wɩa jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ na tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ, ʋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii ŋɩɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ʋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures David talks about the blessings that come to people who are acceptable to God, even though they don't do anything to deserve these blessings. David says,
translation_verse: La naabalɩma Devit ma fa bʋl ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ dɩ Wɩa nɛ leŋe dɩ nʋʋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ, ka ʋ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa a tɩŋ tɩɩna wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ, tɩɩna tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: “What a blessing when God forgives our sins and our evil deeds. What a blessing when the Lord erases our sins from his book.”
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la ma Wɩa sɩ bɩ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ka beŋ, ʋ ma tɩɩna tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.”

english_verse: Are these blessings meant for circumcised people or for those who are not circumcised? Well, the Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.
translation_verse: Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ deeŋ wɩaa saa Devit sɩ bʋla, ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ keri ba penee dʋndʋŋa kʋŋ nɛɛ? Aɩ, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ ba penee keri, ba ma tɩɩʋ nɛ. La laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl arɩ Abɩraham sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ tɩɩ ʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Abraham let himself be circumcised to show he had been accepted because of his faith even before he was circumcised. This makes Abraham the father of all who are acceptable to God because of their faith, even though they are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Abɩraham sɩ keri ʋ peniŋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa magɩl nɛ, aa dagɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ, bʋa-la lɛ ʋ ha sɩ bɩ ʋ peniŋ kere dee. Ŋɩɩ leŋ Abɩraham kʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba penee kere aŋ laa Wɩa dii naabalɩma. Wɩa jomba ba ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma ʋ sɩpaaŋ arɩ ba sɩ bɩ ba penee kere ma kala.

english_verse: God promised Abraham and his descendants that he would give them the world. This promise wasn't made because Abraham had obeyed a law, but because his faith in God made him acceptable.
translation_verse: Abɩraham arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ Wɩa fa bʋla pa dɩ ba jaŋ dii dʋnɩa. Ʋ bɩ naga Abɩraham fa sɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa bʋl ŋɩɩ. Ama Abɩraham fa sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa leŋ ʋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: If Abraham and his descendants were given this promise because they had obeyed a law, then faith would mean nothing, and the promise would be worthless.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto, dɩ ba dʋndʋŋa nɛ fa jaŋ dii dʋnɩa, ŋɩɩ-na nɩaa sɩ laa Wɩa dii fa ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla ma fa ŋaa pɛɩ.

english_verse: God becomes angry when his Law is broken. But where there isn't a law, it cannot be broken.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ yie leŋ Wɩa baanɩŋ sisii nɩaa nyuŋ. Dɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile nɛ fa tuo, nɩaa fa bɩ wɩalɩŋ ka chei.

english_verse: Everything depends on having faith in God, so that God's promise is assured by his gift of undeserved grace. This promise isn't only for Abraham's descendants who have the Law. It is for all who are Abraham's descendants because they have faith, just as he did. Abraham is the ancestor of us all.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, nii-la Wɩa sɩ hɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ jaŋ naʋ. Ʋ ŋaa zile kʋŋ nɛ a pɩ Abɩraham doho nɩaa kala. Ʋ bɩ naga arɩ ʋ joŋo pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile dʋndʋŋa nɛ, ama ba dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Wɩa dii a nagɛ Abɩraham fa sɩ laa Wɩa dii ŋɩɩ, ba kala nɛ ʋ joŋo pa nɩalɩŋ sɩ keri ba penee arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba penee kere kala, bɛɛ wɩaa Abɩraham nɛ ŋaa la kala nyɩmma Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say that Abraham would become the ancestor of many nations. This promise was made to Abraham because he had faith in God, who raises the dead to life and creates new things.
translation_verse: Ba fa ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Wɩa bʋla a tɩgɛ Abɩraham lɛ, “Mɩ leŋe ŋ ŋaa tintee daŋ nyɩmma nɛ.” Wɩa sɩpaaŋ Abɩraham nɛ ŋaa la nyɩmma. Wɩa-la sɩ wuo leŋ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ sʋba, dɩ ba sii sʋʋŋ lɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, aŋ bɩra wuo dagɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa aŋ ha bɩ ŋaa, Wɩa deeŋ nɛ Abɩraham laa dii.

english_verse: But Abraham never doubted or questioned God's promise. His faith made him strong, and he gave all the credit to God.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pʋ, ʋ bɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii lɛ begili. Ʋ laa Wɩa dii nɛ a kɛŋ doluŋ, a leŋ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ yɩra.

english_verse: Abraham was certain that God could do what he had promised.
translation_verse: Ʋ paala chaasa laa Wɩa dii nɛ woruŋ arɩ Wɩa kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: just as we read in the Scriptures. But these words were not written only for Abraham.
translation_verse: Ba fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa a bʋl dɩ Wɩa nɛ leŋe Abɩraham kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ, Abɩraham dʋndʋŋa wɩaa dee ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: They were written for us, since we will also be accepted because of our faith in God, who raised our Lord Jesus to life.
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ la ma wɩaa nɛ, la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa dii arɩ Wɩa chɩsɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu sʋʋŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la ma kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ,

english_verse: God gave Jesus to die for our sins, and he raised him to life, so that we would be made acceptable to God.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ leŋe Yesu sʋʋ a tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ, a bɩra leŋ ʋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ dɩ la kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: By faith we have been made acceptable to God. And now, thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, we have peace with God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, la sɩ laa Wɩa dii ŋɩɩ, Wɩa leŋe la ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma nɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Wɩa to La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ nɛ a leŋ la ŋaa sɩma.

english_verse: Christ has also introduced us to God's gift of undeserved grace on which we now take our stand. So we are happy, as we look forward to sharing in the glory of God.
translation_verse: La sɩ laa Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ, ʋ leŋe la jʋʋ Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ nɛ. Nɩmɛ nɛ la hɛ lɛɛlɛ aa jʋɔsɛ, a kɛŋ yɩɛlaa arɩ la jaŋ kpaa Wɩa yɩrɩ-la chɛɛ dɔŋ.

english_verse: But that's not all! We gladly suffer, because we know that suffering helps us to endure.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ ma dʋndʋŋa dee, la haa jʋɔsɛ nɛ arɩ hɛɛ-la kala la ha sɩɩ na a tɩŋ Kirisito wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa hɛɛ-la jaŋ leŋ dɩ la wuo kɛŋ kenyiri.

english_verse: that will never disappoint us. All of this happens because God has given us the Holy Spirit, who fills our hearts with his love.
translation_verse: La sɩ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa ŋɩɩ, la bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ la dii hɩɩsɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa chola nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ. Ʋ joŋ chono-la a hɛ la tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩla doluŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Christ died for us at a time when we were helpless and sinful.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ la fa sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ la wuo pɛ la tɩtɩa lɛ, Kirisito laa la wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nyuŋ sʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: No one is really willing to die for an honest person, though someone might be willing to die for a truly good person.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋhaa nɛ arɩ nʋʋ sɩ jaŋ laa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nyuŋ sʋʋ. Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, ŋ bɩ pɔ nʋʋ jaŋ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a wuo laa nɩpʋla nyuŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: But God showed how much he loved us by having Christ die for us, even though we were sinful.
translation_verse: Ama ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ daga arɩ ʋ chola nɛ ŋ-la: Bʋa-la lɛ la ha sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nɛ Kirisito sʋʋ la wɩaa.

english_verse: But there is more! Now that God has accepted us because Christ sacrificed his life's blood, we will also be kept safe from God's anger.
translation_verse: Kirisito sɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ a leŋ la kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ teeŋ, ŋɩɩ-na ʋ jaŋ bɩra laala ta tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa nyuŋ.

english_verse: Even when we were God's enemies, he made peace with us, because his Son died for us. Yet something even greater than friendship is ours. Now that we are at peace with God, we will be saved by the life of his Son.
translation_verse: La dɩ Wɩa faa yuo dɔŋɔ nɛ. Ama ʋ leŋe la ŋaa sɩma nɛ a tɩŋ ʋ Bie sɩ sʋba wɩaa. La dɩ ʋ sɩ ŋaa sɩma ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ to Kirisito mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ a laala ta.

english_verse: And in addition to everything else, we are happy because God sent our Lord Jesus Christ to make peace with us. Adam and Christ
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ ma dʋndʋŋa dee, laa jʋɔsʋ nɛ a tɩŋ Wɩa sɩ to La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ a leŋ la ŋaa sɩma. Adam kɛŋ sʋʋŋ kɔ, Yesu Kirisito nɛ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ kɔ

english_verse: Adam sinned, and that sin brought death into the world. Now everyone has sinned, and so everyone must die.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ to nɩbala lɛ nɛ a kʋ jʋʋ dʋnɩa. Wʋbɔmɔ-la nɛ tɩɩ sʋʋŋ jʋʋ dʋnɩa. Nɩbala sɩ kʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ sʋʋŋ jʋʋ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala.

english_verse: Sin was in the world before the Law came. But no record of sin was kept, because there was no Law.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ fa hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, ka wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩ Mosis dɩ nɩaa tuto na kɔ, ama bʋa-la lɛ ba fa bɩ cheeriŋ joŋo pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Mosis nii-la jɩŋ.

english_verse: Yet death still had power over all who lived from the time of Adam to the time of Moses. This happened, though not everyone disobeyed a direct command from God, as Adam did. In some ways Adam is like Christ who came later.
translation_verse: A chɩŋ Adam bʋa-la lɛ a kaa kʋkɔ Mosis ma mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, sʋʋŋ nɛ laa dʋnɩa kala. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ Adam wʋbɔmɔ-la naga, ama sʋʋŋ laa ba ma tɩɩ nɛ. Adam nɛ fa ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ mɩmaarɩŋ.

english_verse: But the gift of God's undeserved grace was very different from Adam's sin. That one sin brought death to many others. Yet in an even greater way, Jesus Christ alone brought God's gift of undeserved grace to many people.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa zile kʋ-la kɩɩ Adam wʋbɔŋ-la. Nɩaa yʋga nɛ a sʋʋ a tɩŋ nɩbala wʋbɔmʋŋ wɩaa. Ama Wɩa fá la nenige a joŋ ʋ zile kʋ-la pɩla, ʋ nɛ paala yʋga kɩɩ wʋbɔŋ-la. Yesu Kirisito nɛ ŋaa zile kʋ-la. Ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ ʋ pɛ nɩaa lɛ yʋgɛ kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
translation_verse: Wɩa zile kʋ-la ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩ nɩaa arɩ wɩɩ-la Adam wʋbɔŋ-la sɩ kaa kɔ dʋnɩa bɩ kʋbala ŋaa. A tɩŋ nɩbala wʋbɔŋ-la wɩaa nɛ Wɩa dii la sarɩya a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩla. Ama nɩaa sɩ yʋga a ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la wɩaa nɛ, Wɩa joŋ ʋ zile kʋ-la pɩla a joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛla, a leŋ la kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
translation_verse: Nɩbala wʋbɔmʋŋ wɩaa nɛ leŋe sʋʋŋ laa dʋnɩa tɩɩ. Wɩɩ-la Yesu Kirisito sɩ ŋaa pɩ nɩaa nɛ yʋga kɩɩ nɩbala-la wʋbɔŋ-la. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jʋʋ Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ sɩ yʋga lɛ, ʋ leŋ ba kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla chɔgɩta ʋ sɩpaaŋ, ba jaŋ to Yesu lɛ a dii kuoruŋ ba mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
translation_verse: Nɩbala wʋbɔmʋŋ sɩ wuo leŋ nʋʋkala laa cheeriŋ Wɩa teeŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩbala tʋɔpʋla wʋŋaalaa ma jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Nɩbala sɩ vɩa Wɩa niiŋ nɛ leŋe nɩ-daŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩbala sɩ to Wɩa niiŋ nɛ wuo ŋaa nɩaa yʋgɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ kʋ wasa leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ pʋrɩgɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Ama wʋbɔmɔ-la sɩ kʋ wasa pʋrɩgɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ ma faasa yʋgɛ woruŋ la lɛ.

english_verse: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a laa dʋnɩa nɩaa tɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ kɛŋ sʋʋŋ kaa kɔ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ-la ma to tʋɔpʋla-la Wɩa sɩ leŋe la kɛŋ lɛ a yuo dii dʋnɩa. Ŋɩɩ leŋ la to La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa la jaŋ bʋl? La ha ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ dɩ Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ-la faasa yʋgɛ la lɛ koo?

english_verse: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?
translation_verse: Aɩ, wombii tuo. Dɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ-na lɛ nɛ, la sʋba nɛ. Ɛɛ nɛ saa la ha jaŋ hɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ a ŋɩŋaa?

english_verse: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
translation_verse: Ma kala jɩma arɩ ba sɩ fola Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ Yesu Kirisito doluŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ sɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, la ma sʋba nɛ.

english_verse: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ fola Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ naga la dɩ ʋ kala sʋba nɛ ba joŋo hugi, dɩ ŋɩɩ wuo leŋ dɩ la kɛŋ mɩɩ-falɩɩ a nagɛ Wɩa doluŋ lɛ ʋ sɩ chɩsɛ Kirisito sʋʋŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: If we shared in Jesus' death by being baptized, we will be raised to life with him.
translation_verse: La dɩ ʋ kala sɩ sʋba ŋɩɩ, la kala ma jaŋ bɩra sii sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
translation_verse: La jɩma arɩ ba sɩ kɛŋ Kirisito kpaasɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sʋʋ, ba kpaasʋ arɩ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a wuo yuo dii dol-la la fa sɩ kɛnɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, dɩ la bɩra sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yosu ŋaa.

english_verse: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ sʋba, Wɩa lɩɩsʋ ʋ wʋbɔmʋŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
translation_verse: La laa dii arɩ la dɩ Kirisito kala sɩ sʋba ŋɩɩ, la ma jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ a hɛ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
translation_verse: La jɩma arɩ Wɩa sɩ chɩsɛ Kirisito sʋʋŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa sʋʋŋ bɩra bɩ ʋ wuo.

english_verse: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, bala dʋndʋŋ nɛ ʋ sʋʋ. Ʋ sʋba dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ doluŋ nɛ chei. Ʋ sɩ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ hɛ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ maga dɩ ma joŋ ma tɩtɩa arɩ ma ma sʋʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ. Yesu Kirisito lɛ, ma mɩɩsɩŋ hɛ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
translation_verse: Ma saa sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tɩɩ ma yaraa deemba sɩɩ sʋʋ, dɩ ma to ʋ lɛ a ŋɩŋaa ʋ wʋchɛɛlɛɛ.

english_verse: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma joŋ ma yaraa lee-kala pɩ Sɩtaanɩ a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ama má joŋ ma tɩtɩa pɩ Wɩa. Ma-na nagɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ chɩsa sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ ma kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Má saa joŋ ma yaraa kala pʋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ maa ŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa.

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩra bɩ ma wuo, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ nɛ ma kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto dee. La ŋaa Wɩa yosuŋ nɛ lɛɛlɛ

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: La sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto lɛ dee, ʋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa saa la ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ koo? Aɩ, wombii tuo.

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: Ama laa lɔllɛ Wɩa arɩ ma nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yosuŋ, ma lɛɛlɛ joŋ ma tʋɔŋ kala aa to Wɩa wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ dagɛma dɩ maa to nɛ.

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsɛma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ma mɩɩra kʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋla yosuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ bʋl yosuŋ wɩaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaa wʋkaa-magɩsɩɩ nɛ mɩ magɩsɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ma bɩ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ wuo jɩŋ. Ma fa sɩ joŋ ma tɩtɩa a hɛ disiniŋ arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ a ŋaa ba yosi, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma maga dɩ ma lɛɛlɛ joŋ ma yaraa kala a hɛ tʋɔpʋl wʋŋaalaa lɛ, dɩ ma bɩra sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ aŋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba ma fa sɩɩ ŋaa, nyʋʋrʋ bɛɛ nɛ ma na? Wɩalɩŋ mɩɩra ŋaa hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmma nɛ lɛɛlɛ. Ba dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ saa ŋaa sʋʋŋ.

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ Wɩa laama ta nɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ma ŋaa Wɩa yosuŋ nɛ. Ma nyʋʋrʋŋ nɛ, ma bɩra sɩ bɩ disiŋ kala kɛnɛ, ma saa jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ time nɛ sʋʋŋ. Ama Wɩa zile kʋ-la ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩla nɛ ŋaa mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, a tɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito wɩaa.

english_verse: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, ma ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ. Ma jɩma arɩ nuhuobiine yie magɛ dɩ ʋ tuto wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bile nɛ dɩ ʋ nɛ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
translation_verse: Dɩ haala nɛ kɛŋ bala, ʋ bala nɛ tɩɩʋ. Ʋ yie magɛ dɩ ʋ tuto ʋ bala niiŋ nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ ʋ bala sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Dɩ ʋ bala-la nɛ sʋba, haal-la laa ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ bala nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩra bɩ ʋ bala niiŋ to.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma ma nagɛ. Ma sʋʋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto tʋɔŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Kirisito sɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, ma dɩ ʋ kala nɛ sʋba. Lɛɛlɛ nʋʋ dɔŋ nɛ tɩɩma, nɩɩ-la sɩ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ la wuo tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩ Wɩa nɛ.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la la sɩɩ to la tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa harɩŋ, wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ fa ŋaa sɩma kɛnla la kɛŋ la yaraa ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ kɛnla mʋ hɛ sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ Wɩa lɩɩsɛla wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile lɛ dɩ nɩaa tuto lɛ nɛ. La tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalɩa-la fa kɛnla kaa ŋaa yosu nɛ. Ba lɛ nɛ la sʋʋ. Lɛɛlɛ la wuo tuto wombii dɔŋ nɛ, a tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa aa pɩ Wɩa. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la nɛ dagɛla ŋɩɩ, wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto dee. Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile nɛ dagɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa laa chɛ dɩ la bʋl? Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto ŋaa wʋbɔŋ wɩa nɛɛ? Aɩ, ŋɩɩ dee. Ama wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile nɛ leŋe mɩ jɩŋ wʋbɔmʋŋ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ. Dɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile nɛ fa bɩ daga arɩ la sɩ́ nɩaa kɩaa gɩrɩma laa, mɩ fa bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Ama wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ na wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ nyɩsɛmɛ hɛ dɩ mɩ gɩrɩma lɩlaa nɩaa kɩaa. Dɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile wɩaa dee, wʋbɔmʋŋ-na fa ŋaa kʋsʋʋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ dol kɛnɛ.

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile fa maga dɩ ba leŋ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ama ba mɩɩra ŋaa mɩ nagɛ nɩsʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ na wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ nyɩsɛmɛ a hɛ sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ.

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: La jɩma arɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile ŋaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la niiŋ wɩaa nɛ. Ama mɩ-na ŋaa nuhuobiiŋ nɛ, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kɛmmɛ nɛ mɩ ŋaa ba yoŋ.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛmmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ cho dɩ mɩ ŋaa ka ŋaa, ama wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bɛrɛ nɛ mɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bɩ cho dɩ mɩ ŋaa, ʋ daga arɩ mɩ sɛyɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile zɔmɔ nɛ.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ tɩtɩa dee bɩ wɩɩ-la ka ŋaa. Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ dɩma-la sɩ hɛ mɩ lɛ nɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ kɛŋ nuhuobiine yaraa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jɩma arɩ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ bɩ mɩ lɛ hɛ. Mɩ fa cho dɩ mɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, a ŋaa lʋlɔl.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bɩ cho dɩ mɩɩ ŋaa, ʋ naga arɩ mɩ dee bɩ ŋaa, ama wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ dɩma-la sɩ hɛ mɩ lɛ nɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: Mɩ lɛɛlɛ na arɩ mɩ nagɩsɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chɛ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ, wɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ zɔŋ yie hɛ mɩ nyuŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ saa mɩ yie ŋaa.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: Mɩ cho wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ daga nɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ, a cho dɩ mɩɩ ŋaaba.

english_verse: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ na arɩ wʋtanɩɩ nɛ mɩɩra hɛ mɩ lɛ aa tɩŋ, a kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩŋ zɔmɔ-la baa yuo dɔŋɔ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ leŋe mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ mɩ lɛ yoŋ nɛ a tuto ʋ niiŋ wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: Mɩ lɛlɛ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ mɩ lɛ kɛmmɛ kaa mʋ sʋʋŋ bʋa nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ laamɛ ta ba lɛ?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ lɔllɛ Wɩa ʋ sɩ to La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ a ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩmɛ. Mɩ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ to Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa arɩ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa, ka dɩ mɩ yaraa maa to wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ niiŋ.

english_verse: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Dɩ la dɩ Kirisito kala nɛ ŋaa kʋbala, Wɩa bɩra bɩ jaŋ dii la sarɩya a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩla.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: La dɩ Yesu Kirisito sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ, ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ joŋ mɩɩsɩŋ pɩla nɛ. Ʋ laala ta nɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ sʋʋŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile bɩ la lɛ wuo pɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la yaraa bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ. Ama wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ wuo ŋaa, Wɩa wuo ŋaaba nɛ. Ba nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛ nuhuobiine wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, ʋ ta ʋ tɩtɩa Bie nɛ ʋ kʋ tuu. Ʋ yaraa nagɛ la yaraa, dɩ ʋ laa la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa lɩɩsɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ doluŋ nuhuobiine lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ la wuo kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ a ŋɩŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto, la nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ la yaraa doluŋ lɛ ka to aŋ tuto Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ.

english_verse: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ to ba yaraa doluŋ lɛ, ba joŋ ba nyuŋ kala a hɛ ba yaraa wʋŋaalaa lɛ nɛ, ama nɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩɩ to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la doluŋ lɛ, ba ma joŋ ba nyuŋ kala a hɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ cho wɩalɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ joŋ la nyuŋ a hɛ la yaraa wʋŋaalaa lɛ, la jaŋ sʋʋ, ama dɩ la nɛ joŋ la nyuŋ a hɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la wʋŋaalaa lɛ, la jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa,

english_verse: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ba yaraa wʋŋaalaa lɛ, ba bɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ cho wuo ŋaa.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ ma lɛ ŋɩɩ, ma-na bɩ ma yaraa wʋŋaalaa lɛ ka to, maa to wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ daga nɛ. Dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la nɛ tuo nʋʋkala lɛ, tɩɩna bɩ Kirisito nʋʋ ŋaa.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Dɩ Kirisito nɛ hɛ ma lɛ, ma yaraa nammɩa ha jaŋ sʋʋ a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Ama Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ ma lɛ, ʋ nɛ pɩma mɩɩsɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla nɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: My dear friends, we must not live to satisfy our desires.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambiiriŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ nʋʋkala fʋgɛla dɩ la tuto la yaraa wʋŋaalaa lɛ.

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ to ma yaraa wʋŋaalaa lɛ, ma jaŋ sʋʋ. Ama dɩ ma nɛ vɩa ma yaraa wʋŋaalaa, ma jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la doluŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la niiŋ wɩaa, ba ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make us slaves who are afraid of him. Instead, we become his children and call him our Father.
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩ ma ŋaa dɩ ma nagɛ yosuŋ a bɩra fɩfá fawʋllʋŋ, ama ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la leŋe ma ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ nɛ. Dɩ la nɩɩ yɩrʋ, la wuo kɛnʋ yɩrɛ “La Nyɩmma.”

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la arɩ la tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala yie dagɛ arɩ la ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: La sɩ ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa joŋ kɩaa nɛ a bil la lɛ, kɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ joŋo bil Kirisito lɛ, la ma jaŋ tɩɩba. Dɩ la dɩ Kirisito kala nɛ na hɛɛŋ, la ma jaŋ laa yɩrɩ-la Kirisito sɩ jaŋ laa. Yɩrɩ-la la sɩ jaŋ laa Wɩa teeŋ

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: Mɩ bee na arɩ hɛɛŋ deeŋ la sɩɩ na, la bɩ jaŋ wuo kaa magɩsɛ yɩrɩ-la la sɩ jaŋ laa.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa kʋŋkala nɩɩ gbɛrʋ a chaarɛ sɩaa dɩ ba na bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa biiriŋ sɩ jaŋ laa yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, creation is confused, but not because it wants to be confused. God made it this way in the hope
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la wɩaa Wɩa sɩ ta dʋnɩa kɩaa kala daga arɩ ba bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaaba. Ba tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ saa dee, ama Wɩa nɛ leŋe ba bɩ wuo ŋaa. Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala Wɩa ha leŋe ba kɛŋ yɩɛlaa nɛ,

english_verse: that creation would be set free from decay and would share in the glorious freedom of his children.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa jaŋ laaba ta a lɩɩsɛba sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ. Wɩa biiriŋ sɩ jaŋ kɔ a laa yɩrɩŋ ŋɩɩ a tɩɩ ba tɩtɩa, ba ma jaŋ tɩɩ ba tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ a ma kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: La jɩma arɩ dʋnɩa kɩaa kala haa huuni nɛ, arɩ haala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ lʋl aa huuni ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa kɩaa dʋndʋŋa dee, ama la ma nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ la lɛ, la maa huuni nɛ la tʋɔŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ la yaraa bɩrɩmɛ dɩ la chaasa ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ a laa yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: And this hope is what saves us. But if we already have what we hope for, there is no need to keep on hoping.
translation_verse: La sɩ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa Wɩa lɛ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ laala ta. Dɩ la nɛ na wɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ, ʋ bɩra bɩ maga dɩ la yɩyɩɛlɛ wɩɩ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ yɩɛlɛ kʋŋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ naʋ, ʋ jaŋ bɩra yɩyɩɛlɛ kʋ-la wɩaa? Aɩ.

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ la nɩɩ yɩɛlɛ wɩalɩŋ la ha sɩ bɩ na, la dii kenyiri a gbɩgbɛrɛ. La sɩ yie kɛŋ yɩɛlaa ŋɩɩ a kɛŋ kenyiri,

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma yie kɔ a pɛ la lɛ a tɩŋ la sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ la pɛ la tɩtɩa lɛ. La paala bɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ la chʋɔlɛ Wɩa. Ama Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la tɩtɩa sʋl Wɩa a pɩpɩla nɛ. Ʋ sɩ yie sʋsʋl Wɩa aa huuni ŋɩɩ, la bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ niiŋ a dagɛ, ama

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Wɩa na nuhuobiine tʋɔŋ kala nɛ a jɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩɩ huuni ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ sʋl Wɩa a pɩpɩ Wɩa nɩaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ yie sʋsʋl.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: La jɩma wɩɩkala lɛ, Wɩa yie leŋ wɩaa zɔŋ nɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ chou, nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ lɩɩsɛ, ʋ lɩɩsɛba dɩ ʋ kɛmba bɩrɩmɛ dɩ ba nagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa Bie nɛ, a leŋ ʋ Bie ŋaa ba kala kʋhɩaŋ.

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ jɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala, bɛɛ nɛ bɩra ka dɩ la bʋl? Dɩ Wɩa nɛ chɩŋ la harɩŋ, kʋbɛɛ ma nɛ bɩra kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩla?

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Wɩa paala bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa Bie kaa laa nɩaa teeŋ. Ʋ joŋu hɛ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ ba kpʋʋ a tɩŋ la wɩaa. Ʋ sɩ wuo ŋaa ŋ-la, ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ wuo chaasa joŋ kʋŋkala ma pɛ pɩla koo?

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa jaŋ bɩra joŋ cheeriŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa? Wɩa tɩtɩa nɛ leŋe ba kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ ma nɛ bɩra jaŋ wuo dii ba sarɩya a dɔgɩsɛba? Kirisito sʋba nɛ, aŋ bɩra sii sʋʋŋ lɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a hɔŋ Wɩa nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ, a sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩla.

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl ŋ-la nɛ: “A tɩŋ ŋ wɩaa, laa gbɛrɛ sʋʋŋ nɛ tapʋlɩɩ-na kala. Ba yie benla arɩ la nagɛ piesee nɛ ba sɩ kaa lɩɩ dɩ ba kpʋ.”

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, dɩ wɩaa deemba kʋŋkala nɛ kʋ jʋʋla, la yie wuo yuo dii nɛ a tɩŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ chola wɩaa.

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Mɩ sɩ ŋaa Kirisito nʋʋ ŋɩɩ, mɩ bɩ wɩaa nyɩɛ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩɩ beŋ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ ma leŋe mɩ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩaa ka nyɩɛ.

english_verse: my heart is broken and I am in great sorrow.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ faasa chei nɛ a tɩŋ mɩ tɩtɩa nɩaa wɩaa. Ʋʋ walɩmɛmɛ kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa cho dɩ Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ a kɛmmɛ pɔrɛ Kirisito lɛ, aŋ laa mɩ naambiiriŋ arɩ mɩ doho nɩaa kala ta.

english_verse: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa. Wɩa leŋe ba nɛ ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tʋla dagɛba. Wɩa bil niiŋ ʋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ, a leŋ Mosis ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa pɩba dɩ ba tuto, a dagɛba Wɩa chʋɔlʋŋ wombiiŋ, a bʋl dɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa pɩpɩba.

english_verse: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ ŋaa la naabalɩmaba doho nɩaa Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa. Kirisito sɩ bɩrɩmɛ nuhuobiiŋ, ʋ ma fa ŋaa la naabalɩmaba doho nʋʋ nɛ. Má leŋ dɩ la dɛnnɛ Wɩa, a kaa mʋ wuu, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɩɩ beŋ kʋŋkala. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ bɩ naga arɩ Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ vɩa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Iziral doho nɩaa kala dee Wɩa leŋ ba ŋaa ʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ daga arɩ nʋʋkala doho bɩ Wɩa nɩaa doho ŋaa, see biiri-la Wɩa sɩ hɛ niiŋ ba lʋl, ba nɛ ʋ beŋ ba ŋaa ʋ doho nɩaa tɩtɩa.

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ ma dʋndʋŋa dee. Rɩbɛka ma sɩ lʋl daalɩarɩ-la, ba nyɩmma ŋaa kʋbala nɛ, ʋ nɛ la naabalɩma Aɩzɩk.

english_verse: Even before they were born or had done anything good or bad, the Lord told Rebekah that her older son would serve the younger one. The Lord said this to show he makes his own choices and it wasn't because of anything either of them had done.
translation_verse: Ka dɩ Rɩbɛka-na lʋl daalɩarɩ-la, biiri-la ha bɩ wʋzɔŋ koo wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa, ka Wɩa bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ sɩ jaŋ lʋl biiri-la, kʋhɩaŋ jaŋ tɩma pɩpɩ kʋbie.” Ŋɩɩ daga arɩ Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ nɩaa a tʋɔsɛba, ʋ bɩ naga arɩ ba sɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ tʋɔsɛba. Ʋ sɩ yɩrɛba nɛ tɩɩ ba ŋaa ʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: Ba bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl ŋ-la nɛ: “Mɩ cho Jekɔb nɛ aŋ bɛrɛ Ɛsɔ.” Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ

english_verse: Everything then depends on God's mercy and not on what people want or do.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ saa bɩ naga nuhuobiine sɩ cho wɩalɩŋ a wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaaba nɛ tɩɩ, ama Wɩa sɩ fá la nenige nɛ tɩɩ,

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ Faaro lɛ arɩ Wɩa bʋla pʋ, “Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ mɩ leŋ ŋ dii kuoruŋ nɛ ŋ-la: mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ mɩ wuo to ŋ lɛ nɛ a dagɛ mɩ doluŋ, dɩ ba yɩrɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ dʋnɩa kala lɛ.”

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ saa Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ʋ fá ba nenige, ʋʋ fá ba nenige nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ma ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ba kɛŋ nyuduoŋ, ʋ leŋe ba ma kɛŋ nyuduoŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: Ma dɔŋɔ jaŋ wuo pɩɛsɛ, “Dɩ Wɩa nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ɛɛ nɛ saa ʋ jaŋ wuo joŋ cheeriŋ a pɩ nɩaa? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo giri Wɩa wʋchɛɛlɩŋ ta?”

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ kaŋ, ŋ-na nuhuobiine dɩ ŋ laa wɩaa bʋl Wɩa niiŋ lɛ? Pupoiŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo pɩɛsɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ mɛʋ a bʋl, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ mɛmɩ mɩ nagɛ ŋ-la?”

english_verse: Doesn't a potter have the right to make a fancy bowl and a plain bowl out of the same lump of clay?”
translation_verse: Pupo-mɛɛrɛ kɛŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ lɔgɛ chʋrʋŋ a kaa mɛ pupoi-zɔmʋŋ a bile gbɛrɛ tapʋl-balaa, a bɩra lɔgɛ chʋrʋ-la tɩtɩa a mɛ pupoiŋ dɔŋɔ ma a kaa tɩtɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa ma jaŋ wuo ŋaa nɩaa lɛ. Ʋ faa chɛ ʋ dagɛ ʋ baanɩŋ nɛ a leŋ dɩ ba jɩŋ ʋ doluŋ. Ama ʋ fa dii kenyiri nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ leŋe ʋ baanɩŋ sii nyuŋ, arɩ ʋ fa sɩ maga dɩ ʋ cheiba ma kala.

english_verse: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tʋla-la sɩ yʋga a dagɛ nɩalɩŋ nenige ʋ sɩ fá nɛ, nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba na ʋ tʋla-la.

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: Ba bʋl ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hozaaya, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ mɩ nɩaa ŋaa, mɩ jaŋ yɩrɛba mɩ nɩaa. Nɩalɩŋ ma mɩ fa sɩ bɩ cho, mɩ jaŋ yɩrɛba mɩ nɩchooloo.

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: Lee-la tɩtɩa ba fa sɩ bʋla pɩ nɩaa arɩ ba bɩ Wɩa nɩaa ŋaa, lee-la nɛ ba jaŋ yɩrɛba Wɩa sɩ weye biiriŋ.”

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Azaaya fa ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ. Ʋ ma fa heele bʋl a tɩgɛ Iziral nɩaa lɛ a bʋl, “Dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ paala faasa yʋgɛ a nagɛ hagɩlɩ-bumbugulo sɩ pɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ ma, ba tʋɔŋ nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa jaŋ laa ta,

english_verse: The Lord will be quick and sure to do on earth what he has warned he will do.”
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa chɛɛ dɔŋ La Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ʋ fa sɩ bʋla pɩla, a guu dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya.”

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ Azaaya ma fa bɩra bʋl dɩ Wɩa jaŋ ŋaa maachie. Ʋ fa sɩ, “Dɩ La Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ fa bɩ la naabalɩma doho nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ leŋe, la kala fa jaŋ sʋʋ, a nagɛ Sodom arɩ Gomora nɩaa kala sɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ.” Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ bɩ tʋɔpʋla kɛnɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa laa chɛ dɩ la bʋl: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa fa bɩ chɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Ba nɛ mɩɩra kʋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ a tɩŋ ba sɩ laa Wɩa dii.

english_verse: It also means that the people of Israel were not acceptable to God. And why not? It was because they were trying to be acceptable by obeying the Law instead of by having faith in God. The people of Israel fell over the stone that makes people stumble,
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ba bɩ tʋɔpʋla-la na? Ba bɩ ʋ na bɛɛ wɩaa, ba bɩ Wɩa laa dii aŋ chɩchɛ wɩɩ-la aŋ bɩɩnɛ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla-la Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Ba joŋ ba naasɩŋ a ŋmoo tabɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa nɩaa sɩsɩɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
