translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ tabɩɩ-la lɛ nɛ a bʋl, “Bee na, mɩ joŋ tabɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa gɛrɛ a bil lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ nɛ. Tabɩɩ-la ŋaa bʋŋ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa gɛrɛ titel. Ama nʋʋ na-kala sɩ laa nɩɩ-la la sɩɩ yɩrɛ bʋŋ-la wɩaa dii, ʋ bɩ jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ.”

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ mɩ faasa cho dɩ Wɩa laa Juu tɩŋŋaa ta nɛ. Mɩ yie chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩba arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I know they love God, but they don't understand
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma arɩ ba joŋ ba nyuŋ kala hɛ Wɩa lɛ nɛ, ama ba bɩ Wɩa wombii-tɩtɩɩ-la jɩŋ.

english_verse: what makes people acceptable to him. So they refuse to trust God, and they try to be acceptable by obeying the Law.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ jɩŋ wombii-la Wɩa sɩ yie leŋ ba to a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ, aŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ba to ba tɩtɩa wombiee. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba bɩ ba tɩtɩa joŋo hɛ wombii-la Wɩa sɩ yie to a leŋ nɩaa kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith. Anyone Can Be Saved
translation_verse: Kirisito nɛ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto dɩdɛrɩŋ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ yɩrɛ Wɩa, ʋ jaŋ laaʋ ta

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Mosis fa ŋmʋnsa a tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa to a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, dɩ ba nɛ wuo to wɩalɩŋ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Neither will they ask, “Who will go down into the world of the dead to raise him to life?”
translation_verse: Koo ma bɩra sɩ́ pɩɛsʋ a bʋl dɩ kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ mʋ lɛlɩŋ ?”

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ba bʋl Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a tɩŋ ba sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii lɛ: Ba sɩ, “Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la kpagɛma nɛ. Ba hɛ ma niiŋ lɛ a hɛ ma tʋɔŋ ma lɛ.” Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la laa diiniŋ wɩaa la sɩɩ bʋl.

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ jaŋ wuo suri ŋ niiŋ a bʋl arɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa ŋ Tɩɩna, a laa dii arɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ Wɩa chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ, Wɩa jaŋ laaŋ ta,

english_verse: God will accept you and save you, if you truly believe this and tell it to others.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa la tʋɔŋ nɛ la yie kaa laa Yesu wɩaa dii, a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. La niiŋ ma nɛ la yie kaa bʋl arɩ Yesu nɛ La Tɩɩna, Wɩa laala ta.

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ, ŋ-la nɛ ba bʋl: “Nʋʋ na-kala sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii, Wɩa bɩ jaŋ hɩɩsʋ.”

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, ba kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ Wɩa teeŋ. Ʋ bɩ ba kaa pɔrɛ. Ʋ ŋaa nʋʋkala Tɩɩna nɛ. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ yɩrʋ, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ʋ tɩɩna lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba nɛ bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii, ɛɛ nɛ ba jaŋ ŋaa a yɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ dɩ ʋ laaba ta? Dɩ ba nɛ bɩra bɩ ʋ wɩaa nɩa, ɛɛ nɛ ba jaŋ ŋaa laa ʋ wɩaa dii? Dɩ nʋʋ ma nɛ saa bɩ ʋ wɩaa bʋla pɩba, ɛɛ nɛ ba jaŋ wuo ŋaa nɩɩ?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ bɩ nɩaa tɩma dɩ ba bʋl ʋ wɩaa, ɛɛ nɛ ba jaŋ wuo ŋaa bʋl ʋ wɩaa? Ba fa ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ kɔ.”

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋ nɩɩ wʋzɔmɔ-la ba kala dee bɩ laa dii. Azaaya fa bɩra bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ sɩ, “La Tɩɩna, kʋbɛɛ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ sɩ laa wɩalɩŋ la sɩ bʋla pɩba dii?”

english_verse: No one can have faith without hearing the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ŋ yie nɩɩ wɩɩ nɛ a laa dii. Ba nɛ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩgɛ Kirisito lɛ.

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Ama mɩ jaŋ pɩɛsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ: Ba bɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la nɩaa? Ba nɩa nɛ. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la lɛ a bʋl, “Ba bʋl wɩaa deemba dʋnɩa lee-kala nɛ. Dʋnɩa nʋʋkala nɛ nɩɩ wɩaa deemba.”

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: Mɩ saa jaŋ bɩra pɩɛsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ: “Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ, ba bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ?” Mosis nɛ fa laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ a bʋl dɩ Wɩa sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa yaraa bieri tintee sɩ bɩ mɩ nɩaa ŋaa wɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ bɩra leŋ dɩ tintee nɩaa sɩ bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ ŋaa dɩ ma baanɩŋ sii.”

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Azaaya fa chaasa bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ a bʋl: Wɩa sɩ, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ mɩɩ chɛ, ba namɛ nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ mɩ wɩaa pɩɛsɛ, mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa dagɛba nɛ.”

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Ama ʋ bʋl ŋ-la nɛ a tɩgɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ: “Mɩ chal mɩ nɩsaa faafaa kala nɛ a gbɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩamɛ a bɩ mɩ niiŋ ka to.”

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ-na saa Wɩa vɩa ʋ nɩaa nɛ koo? Aɩ, mɩ ma tɩtɩa ŋaa Iziral tɩɩna nɛ, a ŋaa Abɩraham doho nʋʋ a lɩɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩ ʋ nɩaa vɩa, nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ lɩɩsɛ. Ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ka liisii? Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa a tɩgɛ Ɩlaaja lɛɛ? Ba ŋmʋnsa arɩ Ɩlaaja fa bʋl Iziral tɩŋŋaa wɩaa pɩ Wɩa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: Ʋ fa sɩ, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, ba kpʋ ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ, a ŋmoo korunu-la ba sɩ saa pɩŋ a lo. Mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ka, ba saa walɩmɛ dɩ ba kpʋ mɩ ma nɛ.”

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa? Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩɩ chɛ kɩalɩŋ, ba bɩ ba na. Ama nɩalɩŋ baŋmɛnɛ Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa ba tʋɔŋ nɛ naba. Nɩkaana-la tʋɔŋ dolie. Wɩa sɩ yɩrɛba, ba vɩa nɛ.

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ nagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ bʋa deeŋ lɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa baŋmɛnɛ nɛ Wɩa lɩɩsɛ a fá ba nenige.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ lɩɩsɛba a fá ba nenige ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ naga ba tɩntɩŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ ba sɩ tɩma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ tɩŋ nɩaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa aa fá ba nenige, ŋɩɩ-na nɩaa nenige dee ʋʋ fá ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “God made them so stupid that their eyes are blind, and their ears are still deaf.”
translation_verse: Ba bʋl ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Wɩa leŋe ba sɩaa chʋʋlɛ nɛ. Ba bɩ kʋŋkala ka na, ba bɩ wɩɩkala maa nɩɩ a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ.”

english_verse: Then David said, “Turn their meals into bait for a trap, so that they will stumble and be given what they deserve.
translation_verse: Devit ma fa bʋla, “Leŋ dɩ ba gbiele kʋdiile-la bɩrɩmɛ bɛrɛ́ a kɛsɛba, leŋ dɩ ʋ bɩrɩmɛ kʋŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ba gɛrɛ tel a na hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.” Gentiles Will Be Saved
translation_verse: Leŋ dɩ ba nyʋlɩmɛ a sɩ́ kʋŋkala wuo na, leŋ dɩ wɩaa nyagɛba dɩ ba duduuri wuu.”

english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ pɩɛsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ: Ba sɩ sɩɛra tel ŋɩɩ, ba tele ŋɩɩ dɩ ba wɩɩ-wɩɩkala dɛrɛ nɛ koo? Aɩ. Ama a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ wɩaa, Wɩa laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ta nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa yaraa bieri nɛ, dɩ ba na baanɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nyuŋ.

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɛ mɩ lɛɛlɛ chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa pa. Wɩa nɛ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nanzɔɔ. Mɩ joŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ ʋ ŋaa tɩntɩŋ-fɩaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ, ŋ bɩ pɔ ʋ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ Juu tɩŋŋaa yaraa bibieri, dɩ ba dɔnsʋŋ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii, dɩ ʋ laaba ta.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa sɩ vɩa Wɩa wɩaa ŋɩɩ leŋe dʋnɩa nɩkaanaa arɩ Wɩa sɩŋ nɛ. Dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɛ bɩra kʋ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii, ɛɛ nɛ saa ʋ jaŋ nagɛ? Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ nɩsʋʋnʋŋ sɩ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ buu boroboro munuŋ a laa sɩpaaŋ lɔgɛ mʋa a pɩ Wɩa, dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, kʋkaanɩŋ ma bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Dɩ tɩa naapoloo ma nɛ zɔmɔ, ʋ naakelee ma zɔmɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa saa nagɛ tɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Olif nɛ. Ba kɛŋ ʋ nɛnɛɛ a kaa tutugi nʋʋŋ nɛ. Wɩa ŋaa ʋ zɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa keri ʋ naakelee dɔnsʋŋ, aŋ kɛmma kaa mɛrɛ ba leree, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ gɩrɩŋ tɩɩ-naakelee. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ma ma pɛ nɩɩ Olif tɩɩ-zɔŋ-la naakelee sɩma nɛ.

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa lɛ bigisu arɩ ma kpɩa tɩa-la naakelee ba sɩ kere ta lɛ. Ma dee bɩ tɩa-la naapoloo chaga bil. Tɩa-la naapoloo nɛ chagɛma bil.

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ Wɩa keri tɩa-la naakelee, ka dɩ ʋ kɛmma nɛ mɛrɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, Wɩa keri Juu tɩŋŋaa ta a tɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii wɩaa nɛ. Ama ma-na nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, ma sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii dʋndʋŋa wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ma chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa lɛ bigisu, aŋ kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ.

english_verse: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ bɩ tɩa-la naakelee tɩtɩa nenige fá aŋ keriba ta ŋɩɩ, dɩ ma ma nɛ bɩ ma sɩaa fɩɛla, ʋ jaŋ keri ma ma ta ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: Ma na ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ zile arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ tɛrɛ nɛ. Ʋ tɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ mɩɩrɛ ʋ harɩŋ nyuŋ nɛ. Ama ʋ kɛŋ zile ma-na teeŋ, dɩ ma nɛ sɛyɛ dɩ ma tuto ʋ zile-la lɛ arɩ ma sɩ suomi ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ dee ʋ jaŋ kerima ma ta.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɛ paala bɩrɩma to Wɩa, Wɩa jaŋ bɩra kɛmba kaa mɛrɛ tɩɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ paala bɩ tɩɩ-zɔŋ-la naakelee ŋaa aŋ ŋaa gɩrɩŋ tʋɔŋ tɩɩ-naakelee, ka Wɩa kɛmma a kaa mɛrɛ tɩɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ, ʋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ tɩa-la tɩtɩa naakelee ʋ sɩ kere ta a kaa mɛrɛ. Wɩa ma jaŋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, wɩaa nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ Wɩa fa joŋo faama, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ. Wɩɩ-la jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ma sɩ́ bɩɩna bʋl arɩ ma kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a bibigisi ma tɩtɩa lɛ. Wɩɩ-la nɛ ŋ-la: Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kɛŋ nyu-duo-la, ba bɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ wuu. Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɛ kʋ yʋgɛ a laa Wɩa wɩaa dii, Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyu-duo-la jaŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la lɛ nɛ Wɩa jaŋ to a laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala ta. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ba sɩ, “La Laataara jaŋ lɩɩ Zaayɔŋ. Ʋ jaŋ kiri wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala Jekɔb doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: Ba bɩra ŋmʋnsa a bʋl, “La dɩ ba jaŋ bil niiŋ a pɩ dɔŋɔ dɩ mɩ laa ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta.”

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ Juu tɩŋŋaa sɩ vɩa Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa dʋndɔmɔ, ma nɩalɩŋ saa sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ. Ama a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ lɩɩsɛba wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ba ŋaa ʋ nɩchooloo, a tɩŋ ba naabalɩmaba wɩaa,

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa kɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩba arɩ ʋ sɩ lɩɩsɛba ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo vɔmba.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Ama, ma-na nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, ma fa vɩa Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa, ama lɛɛlɛ Wɩa fá ma nenige nɛ a tɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma sɩ vɩa Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: And because of the mercy shown to you, they will also be shown mercy.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma sɩ bɩ Wɩa niiŋ ka to lɛɛlɛ, Wɩa jaŋ fá ba ma nenige, arɩ ʋ sɩ fá ma ma nenige ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa ka to, ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nyagɛba bil nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wuo fá ba nenige.

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩɩ fá la nenige ŋɩɩ arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ, ʋ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa? Nʋʋkala bɩ Wɩa wʋŋaalaa jɩŋ.

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ Wɩa tʋɔbɩɩnaa? Kʋbɛɛ ma nɛ jaŋ wuo dagɛ Wɩa?

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ha joŋ kʋŋ pɩ Wɩa aŋ gbɛrɛ dɩ Wɩa mɩɩra joŋ kʋ-la pʋ?

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa nɛ ŋaa kʋŋkala. Ʋ doluŋ lɛ nɛ kʋŋkala ma hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ nɛ tɩɩ kʋŋkala. Má leŋ dɩ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ naambiiriŋ, a tɩŋ Wɩa sɩ faasa fá la nenige wɩaa, mɩɩ sʋlma dɩ ma joŋ ma mɩɩsɩŋ kala a pɩ Wɩa, arɩ ba fa sɩ yie kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ Wɩa ŋɩɩ. Ma sɩ joŋ ma tɩtɩa a pɩ Wɩa ŋɩɩ, ma bɩra sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ, dɩ Wɩa wuo laama. Wɩɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ wombiiŋ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma nyuŋ joŋo hɛ dʋnɩa wʋŋaalaa lɛ. Ama má leŋ dɩ Wɩa kɛŋ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩrɩmɛ dɩ ba zɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ. Ma jaŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ aa tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ aŋ pɛ zɔŋ ma woruŋ.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ zile ŋɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, mɩɩ sʋl ma kʋŋkala dɩ ma sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa kaa yʋgɛ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ maga. Má leŋ dɩ ma sɩaa fɩɛlɛ. Wɩa pɩ nʋʋkala laa diiniŋ nɛ. Ama ba kɩɩ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Nʋʋkala maga dɩ ʋ bɩɩnɛ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ a magɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ leŋe ʋ kɛŋ laa diiniŋ.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine yaraa ŋaa kʋbala nɛ, ka ʋ nandaasɩŋ yʋgɛ. Nandaasɩ-la kala kɛŋ ba tɩntɩmɩa nɛ. Ba bɩ tɩntɩŋ-bala ka tɩŋ.

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ la ma nagɛ. La yʋga nɛ, aŋ ka la kala mɛrɛ Kirisito lɛ a ŋaa kʋbala. La ŋaa nɩ-dabaŋ dabamba nɛ a mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a ŋaa yarɩ-bala.

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: Wɩa pɩla kʋŋkala doluŋ nɛ dɩ la kaa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ dabaŋ dabamba. Ʋ saa lɩɩ ŋɩɩ lɛ Wɩa sɩ dii zile la lɛ nɛ. Dɩ Wɩa nɛ pɩ nʋʋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ wuo bʋl ʋ wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ, má leŋ dɩ ʋ magɛ laa diine-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pʋ lɛ.

english_verse: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ joŋ doluŋ pɩŋ dɩ ŋ tɩma pɩpɩ nɩaa, ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ joŋ doluŋ pɩŋ dɩ ŋ dɩdagɛ nɩaa, ŋ ma ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ŋ wuo dɩdagɛ nɩaa a leŋ dɩ ba nyuŋ nyɩnyaasɛ, ŋ ma ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ zile a pɩpɛ nɩaa lɛ, ʋ ma ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ arɩ tʋɔ-bala. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa sɩpaalaarʋ, tɩtɩŋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a fɩfá nɩaa nenige, ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Má cho dɔŋɔ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Má bɛrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, aŋ joŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Má cho ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii woruŋ arɩ naambiiriŋ sɩ cho dɔŋɔ ŋɩɩ, a zizil dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ yarɩwɩɩŋ kɛŋ, ama má faasa joŋ ma nyuŋ kala hɛ La Tɩɩna tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Má jʋjʋɔsɛ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ lɛ. Dɩ ma nɩɩ na hɛɛŋ, má dii kenyiri. Má pɛsɛ a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
translation_verse: Má pɛ ma naambiiriŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ chɛ, aa kɛŋ nʋhʋɔraa woruŋ.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Má sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛma lɛ, aŋ sɩ́ kalɩba hɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɔ, ŋ ma leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, dɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ cheye, ŋ ma chɩl ba tʋɔ-cheeŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Má chɩl dɔŋɔba wɩaa, má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa kaa yʋgɛ. Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa mɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ nɩbala ŋaa lɛ. Má sɩ́ bɩɩna arɩ ma kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ma lɛ, ma-na sɩ́ wʋbɔmʋŋ joŋo timu. Ama má-na ŋaa wɩɩ-la nʋʋkala sɩ jɩma dɩ ʋ zɔmɔ.

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ wuolo, má leŋ dɩ ma dɩ nʋʋkala sɩŋ.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.”
translation_verse: Mɩ nandɔsɛ, dɩ nɩaa nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma lɛ, má sɩ́ ba chɩmɩŋ tiŋ. Má leŋ dɩ Wɩa nɛ na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ, a tiŋ ba chɩmɩŋ. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ laa yuo pɩma, a tiŋ ma chɩmɩŋ.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: “Ama dɩ losuŋ nɛ kɛŋ ŋ dʋndɔmɔ, ŋaa kʋdiilee pʋ, dɩ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ ma nɛ kɛnʋ, ŋaa lɩɩŋ pʋ dɩ ʋ nyʋa. Dɩ ŋ nɛ wuo ŋaa ŋɩɩ, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ kɛnʋ kɩŋkɛŋ.”

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ wuoma. Ama má leŋ ma wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ yuo dii ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala maga dɩ ʋ tuto ʋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ niiŋ nɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ tinteeŋ wuo beŋ, see dɩ Wɩa lɩɩsʋ a pʋ doluŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ ma tinteeŋ ŋaa Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛba.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ fawʋllʋŋ ka fá ba tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ teeŋ, see nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ fɩfá fawʋllʋŋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ teeŋ, ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ, dɩ ʋ bɩbɛsɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ ŋ lɛ. Ama dɩ ŋ nɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, fɩfáʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa dol-la ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ bɩ dol pɛɩ ŋaa. Ʋ ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ. Nʋʋkala sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ, Wɩa na baanɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ tinteeŋ jaŋ wuo dɔgɩsɛ tɩɩna.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa, máa to ma tinteeŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ niiŋ. Má sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa a tɩŋ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ dʋndʋŋa wɩaa. Ama má ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala su Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsɛ tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ maga dɩ ma tiŋ lampoo, bɛɛ wɩaa tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩ-la ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto dɔnsʋŋ nɛ ŋ-la: “Má sɩ́ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa haala chɛ, má sɩ́ nɩaa kpʋ, má sɩ́ gaa, má sɩ́ nʋʋ kʋŋ gɩrɩma laa.” Wɩaa deemba kala arɩ wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, ba kala ŋaa wʋbala nɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋ-la: “Cho ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna arɩ ŋ sɩ cho ŋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ cho ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ŋ bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala jaŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa dɩ ŋ nɛ cho ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ŋŋ to wɩalɩŋ kala Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ.

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Máa ŋaa wɩaa deemba. Ma paala jɩŋ bʋa deeŋ lɛ la sɩ hɛ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ jaŋ sii doŋ lɛ yie nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ laala ta dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ faasa kpagɛ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ kpaga kɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Taŋ kpagɛ pʋlʋŋ nɛ. Mʋa nɛ ka, ka dɩ wɩa pɔsɛ. Má saa leŋ dɩ la leŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ wʋŋaalaa, aŋ paa pʋlʋmʋŋ laalɩyuori kɩaa laalɛ a yuo laalɩŋ.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la kɛŋ la tɩtɩa woruŋ a nagɛ nɩaa sɩ hɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la faasa gbieli gbieli-tɔɔnʋŋ a bubugi, a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ aŋ pɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Má sɩ́ dɔŋɔ yuo, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma yaraa bibieri dɔŋɔ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ Yesu Kirisito nɛ ŋaa ma laalɩyuori kɩaa, aŋ sɩ́ ma yaraa tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ to.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a laa Yesu wɩaa dii aŋ bɩ faasa chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ lɛ, ma kɛnʋ woruŋ. Ama má sɩ́ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa wɩaa kaalɛrɛ.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Ma tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ tʋɔbɩɩnaa yie ŋaa ʋ didii kʋŋkala nɛ, ama dɔŋɔ ma hɛ nɩmɛ, ʋ bɩ Wɩa laa dii woruŋ a ma didii pɩpaarɩŋ dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ kaŋ dɩ ŋ wuo bʋl dɩ nʋʋ tɩntɩnnʋ cheye nɛ? Tɩntɩnnʋ-la kʋhɩaŋ nɛ jaŋ wuo bʋl dɩ ʋ cheye nɛ koo ʋ bɩ cheye. La Kʋhɩaŋ Yesu jaŋ wuo pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ. Ʋ saa jaŋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: Nɩa dɔŋɔ yie bɩɩnɛ arɩ tapʋlʋŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ kɩɩ tapʋlaa kala. Dɔŋɔ ma bɩɩnɛ arɩ tapʋlaa kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Ʋ saa maga dɩ nʋʋkala chɩŋ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩɩna arɩ tapʋlʋŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ kɩɩ tapʋlaa kala, ʋ lɩɩsɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la dɩ ʋ zizil La Tɩɩna Yesu nɛ. Nɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ dii kʋŋkala, ʋ ma ŋaa ŋɩɩ a zizil La Tɩɩna Yesu nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ sɩɩ dii kɩalɩŋ, ʋ yie lɔllɛ Wɩa nɛ. Nɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ kɩsɛ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ, ʋ ma ŋaa ŋɩɩ aa zil La Tɩɩna Yesu nɛ, aa lɔllɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: La kʋŋkala bɩ la tɩtɩa tɩɩ. Dɩ la nɛ hɛ la mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, la bɩ la tɩtɩa tɩɩ, dɩ la nɛ sʋba ma, la bɩ la tɩtɩa tɩɩ.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa Kirisito sʋba aŋ bɩra sii sʋʋŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ tɩɩ nɩweyee arɩ nɩsʋʋnʋŋ kala nɛ, a ŋaa ba kala Kʋhɩaŋ.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ bʋbʋl ʋ naambie sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii teeŋ a bʋl dɩ ʋ bɩ woruŋ ŋaa? Dɔŋɔ ma bee gʋgʋʋnɛ ʋ naambie sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii lɛ. La kala jaŋ chɩŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ dɩ ʋ dii la sarɩya.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl ŋ-la nɛ: Wɩa sɩ, “Mɩ nɛ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa-la sɩ weye wɩaa, nʋʋkala jaŋ kpirimi mɩ sɩpaaŋ a suri ʋ niiŋ a bʋl arɩ mɩ nɛ sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa.”

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ la nʋʋkala jaŋ dagɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa a pʋ. Má sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma naambie ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ ŋaa

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Yesu leŋe mɩ jɩŋ arɩ kʋdiil kala tuo sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ. Ama nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ bɩɩna arɩ kʋdiilee dɔnsʋŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ bɩɩnɛ ŋɩɩ, kɩalɩŋ ŋaa kɩsɩŋ nɛ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Dɩ kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ dii nɛ leŋe ŋ naambie tʋɔŋ chei ŋ nyuŋ, ŋ bɩ chonuŋ ka dagɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Kirisito sʋʋ ʋ wɩaa nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ kʋdiile-la ŋ sɩɩ dii wɩaa cheyu.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ jɩma dɩ ʋ zɔmɔ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩaa kaa bɩrɩmɛ wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Kʋdiile-la la sɩɩ dii arɩ kɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ nyʋa bɩ sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩ ŋaa Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ. Wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ la kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, a kɛŋ nii-bala, aŋ pɛ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ ma Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩ to wombiiŋ deeŋ lɛ a tɩma pɩ Kirisito, Wɩa tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ, dɩ nɩaa ma zizilu.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: Má saa leŋ dɩ la bɩbɩɩnɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la kɛŋ nii-bala, a wuo pɩpɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ dii wɩaa tɩma chei Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa. Kʋdiil kala zɔmɔ nɛ, ʋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ dɩ maa kɩsɛ. Ama dɩ kʋdiile-la dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩɩ dii nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nʋʋ ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma diiba.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ maa chaŋ nammɩa, koo dɩ ma nyʋa sɩnɩŋ, koo dɩ maa ŋaa wɩɩ-na kala sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma naambie yeŋŋi ʋ wombiiŋ.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ dii kɩaa aŋ bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ dii, dɩ ʋ nɛ diiba, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa dii arɩ ba ŋaa wʋzɔmɔ ka to. Wɩɩ-na kala nɛ ŋ ŋɩŋaa aŋ bɩ laa dii arɩ ʋ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa, ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: La nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii woruŋ, ʋ maga dɩ la pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ laa dii woruŋ lɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ lɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ la ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ la dʋndʋŋa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la kʋŋkala ŋaa dɩ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, dɩ la pɛ ʋ lɛ ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ a chɩŋ ʋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa dii lɛ.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Kirisito ma bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa ŋaa. Ba fa ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl ŋ-la nɛ a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ: “Jomo-la kala nɩalɩŋ sɩ tʋʋsɛ ŋ-na Wɩa, ba nɛ ba joŋoo tʋʋsɛ mɩ ma.”

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɩɩ pɩ nɩaa kenyiri a leŋ ba nyuŋ nyɩnyaasɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ nii-bala a wuo tuto Yesu Kirisito naabʋɔsʋŋ,

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: dɩ ma kala wuo kɛŋ nii-bala arɩ tʋɔ-bala a dɛnnɛ Wɩa. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito Nyɩmma. Ʋ maga dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ma nɩɩ Wɩa wɩaa

english_verse: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má sɛɩ a kɛŋ dɔŋɔ woruŋ, arɩ Kirisito ma sɩ kɛmma woruŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ Kirisito kʋ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a pɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɛ, a dagɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ fa sɩ bʋla pɩ la naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa,

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: a wuo leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, dɩ ba dɛnnɛ Wɩa a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ fá ba nenige ŋɩɩ. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa tʋɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɩŋ.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Ba bɩra ŋmʋnsa a bʋl ŋ-la nɛ: “Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, ma dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, má jʋɔsɛ.”

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Ba bɩra bʋl ŋ-la nɛ: “Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, má dɛnnɛ ma Tɩɩna Wɩa, ma kala yɩɩ yɩɩlaa dɛnnʋ.”

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Azaaya bɩra bʋl ŋ-la nɛ: “Jesi doho nɩaa dɔŋɔ jaŋ kɔ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ sii a beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa. Ba jaŋ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ʋ lɛ.”

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ yie leŋ la kɛŋ yɩɛlaa. Mɩɩ sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa a tɩŋ ma sɩ laaʋ dii, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma yɩɛlaa wasa yʋgɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ. Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ Pɔɔl tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa tʋɔŋ

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ chaasa laa dii arɩ maa ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ woruŋ, a jɩŋ wɩaa ma woruŋ, a wuo dɩdagɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
translation_verse: Ama teniŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ mɩ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ wuo liisima wɩaa dɔnsʋŋ lɛ a tɩŋ dol-la Wɩa sɩ pɩmɛ wɩaa,

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: dɩ mɩ tɩŋ Yesu Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa tʋɔŋ. Mɩ tɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ a nagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ, a bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la pɩba. Mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ Wɩa wuo laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, a nagɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ ŋaa ba bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ joŋo pɩ Wɩa dɩ ʋ tʋɔtɔrɛ ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: Yesu Kirisito doluŋ lɛ mɩ kɛŋ wombiiŋ dɩ mɩ dagɛ mɩ tɩtɩa a tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ tɩma pɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ nyuduoŋ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ dɔŋ kala, see tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Kirisito sɩ pɛ mɩ lɛ mɩ tɩŋ, a wuo leŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa kʋ to Wɩa niiŋ. Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋaa,

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: wʋkpuŋkperisi-la arɩ wʋmagɩla-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la doluŋ lɛ. Mɩ chaasa bʋl Kirisito wʋzɔmɔ-la, a suomi Jerusalɛm lɛ a gɔllɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi Iliirikam.

english_verse: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ bʋa na-kala dɩ mɩ mʋ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la lee-na kala nɩaa ha sɩ bɩ Kirisito wɩaa nɩa. Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ mʋ lee-la nɩaa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ mʋ a bʋl Wɩa wɩaa.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Nɩalɩŋ ba ha sɩ bɩ ʋ wɩaa bʋla pa jaŋ naʋ. Nɩalɩŋ ha sɩ bɩ ʋ wɩaa nɩa, ba jaŋ nɩɩ a jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ.” Pɔɔl chɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ na Rom tɩŋŋaa

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa leree dɔnsʋŋ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɩ ma leriŋ wuo kɔ.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ bɩra bɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ kɛnɛ leree deemba lɛ dɩ mɩ tɩŋ, ka mɩ ma paala cho dɩ mɩ kʋ nama faafaa kala.

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ nama bʋa-la lɛ dɩ mɩ nɩɩ mʋ Sipeeŋ tinteeŋ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ hɔŋ ma teeŋ a dieni mʋa, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ mɩ vɛŋ mɩ wombiiŋ.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii Masidoonia arɩ Akaaya tinteeŋ lɛ, ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ ba sɩ kɩɛsɛ moribiee dɩ ba pɛ summo-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ ba sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ama ŋɩɩ fa paala ŋaa wɩɩ nɛ sɩ maga dɩ ba ŋaa. Wʋzɔmɔ-la kala sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ, Juu tɩŋŋaa nɛ leŋe nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ma naba. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ maga dɩ ba ma pɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa lɛ arɩ dʋnɩa kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma, dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ, mɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ ma lɛ woruŋ, arɩ Kirisito sɩ pɛ mɩ lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩɩ sʋlma La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito yɩrɩŋ lɛ, arɩ chono-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ joŋo pɩla, dɩ ma pɛ mɩ lɛ a chaasa chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩmɛ,

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: dɩ Wɩa lɩɩsɛmɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa Wɩa wɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ a hɛ Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ. Má bɩra sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, dɩ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ kɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ jaŋ kaa mʋ pɩba nyuŋ.

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: Ka dɩ Wɩa nɛ sɛyɛ, mɩ jaŋ kɔ ma teeŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, a kʋ wiesi mʋa ma teeŋ.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩɩ pɩ nuhuobiine fɩɛlɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ mɩ kɛŋ la dɩhaala Foobi dagɛma nɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi sɩpaalaara, a hɛ Keŋkiriya lɛ.

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: Má kɛnʋ woruŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ, arɩ ʋ sɩ maga dɩ Wɩa nɩaa kɛŋ dɔŋɔ ŋɩɩ. Má pɛ ʋ lɛ arɩ kʋŋkala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ma teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ pɛ nɩaa lɛ yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ, a pɛ mɩ ma lɛ.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Pɩrɩsɩla arɩ Akuila. Mɩ dɩ ba kala nɩɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa aa pɩ Yesu Kirisito.

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: Ba joŋ ba mɩɩsɩŋ a yɔɔ sʋʋŋ nɛ mɩ wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩɩ lɔllɛba. Mɩ dʋndʋŋa saa dee, mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa aŋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi, la kala nɩɩ lɔllɛba.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hilimee chʋɔlɛ Wɩa ba dɩa lɛ. Má chʋɔlɛ mɩ nandɔŋ-chooluŋ Epinetus ma. Ʋ nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii Esia tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Mɛɛrɩ ma. Ʋ faasa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ woruŋ a pɩma.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Andɩrɔnɩkas arɩ Junias ma. Ba ma ŋaa Juu tɩmma nɛ. Mɩ dɩ ba kala nɛ fa hɛ sarɩka lɛ. Yesu nanzɔɔba-la tʋɔŋ nɩaa fa jɩmba nɛ woruŋ. Ba nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Aŋpɩlaatɩs ma. Ʋ ŋaa mɩ nandɔŋ-choolii nɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Abaanɩs ma, ʋ ŋaa la tɩntɩnnɩ dɔŋ nɛ Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ. Má chʋɔlɛ mɩ nandɔŋ-chooluŋ Sɩtakɩs ma.

english_verse: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Apɛlɛs ma, ʋ faasa chɩŋ Kirisito wɩaa lɛ nɛ woruŋ. Má chʋɔlɛ Arisitobulus dɩa nɩaa ma.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Herodioŋ ma. Ʋ ma ŋaa Juu tɩɩna nɛ. Má chʋɔlɛ Nasɩsas dɩa nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa dii.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Tɩrafɩɩna arɩ Tɩrafosa. Ba ŋaa haala sɩ faasa tɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ. Má chʋɔlɛ mɩ tanlɔŋ-chooluŋ Pɛsɩs. Ʋ ma ŋaa haal sɩ faasa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a pɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu nɛ.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Rufas ma. Ʋ faasa chɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa lɛ nɛ woruŋ. Má chʋɔlɛ ʋ naaŋ ma, ʋ fa jommi a nagɛ ʋ bii-lʋlɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Asɩŋkɩrɩtas, Fɩlɛgɔŋ, Hɛɛmɩs, Patɩrɔbas, arɩ Hɛɛmas arɩ la naambiiri-la kala sɩ hɛ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Fɩlɔɔlɔgɩs, Julia, Niirias arɩ ʋ dɩhaala. Má chʋɔlɛ Ɔlɩmpas ma arɩ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Má guori dɔŋɔ arɩ chonuŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii aa hilimi lee-na kala, ba maa chʋɔlɛma.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlma nɛ mɩ naambiiriŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie kɛŋ nɩaa pʋpɔrɛ lɛ a leŋ ma yiyeŋŋi wombii-la la sɩ dagɛma ma tuto lɛ. Má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa ba lɛ.

english_verse: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba bɩ La Tɩɩna Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa ka tɩŋ, ama ba tɩtɩa wʋchooloo nɛ baa ŋaa. Ba yie kɛŋ nii-sɩma a nyɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala nɛ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩɩ to Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa ŋɩɩ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa mɩ tʋɔtɔrʋ nɛ, mɩɩ jʋɔsɛ ma wɩaa. Ama mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ lɛ, aŋ ŋaa nɩyaara wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa sɩ pɩ nɩaa fɩɛlɩŋ, bɩ jaŋ dieni, aŋ kɛŋ Sɩtaanɩ nyaga bil ma naasɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ dɩ ma nʋɔsɛ. La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito jaŋ fá ma nenige a pɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Timoti mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔŋɔ, ʋʋ chʋɔlɛma. Lusias arɩ Jaasɩŋ arɩ Sɔsɩpata ma chʋɔlɛma. Ba ma ŋaa Juu tɩmma nɛ.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Tɛtɩas Pɔɔl sɩ leŋe mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ, mɩ maa chʋɔlɛma La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Gaius welcomes me and the whole church into his home, and he sends his greetings. Erastus, the city treasurer, and our dear friend Quartus send their greetings too. Paul's Closing Prayer
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito jaŋ fá ma nenige a pɛ ma kala lɛ. Amɩɩ.] Má leŋ dɩ la dɛnnɛ Wɩa

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la dɛnnɛ Wɩa. Ʋ nɛ leŋe ma chɩŋ ma wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ a tɩŋ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma a tɩgɛ Yesu Kirisito lɛ. Wɩa fa joŋ wɩalɩŋ faa nɛ faafaa kala,

english_verse: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ kaa kʋ lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Wɩa leŋe ba bʋla pɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala nɛ dɩ ba laa wɩalɩŋ dii a tutoba. Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa fa ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa a tɩgɛ wɩaa deemba lɛ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Má leŋ la to Yesu Kirisito lɛ a dɛnnɛ Wɩa wuu. Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl, arɩ la naambie Sɔsɩtɛnɩs nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma. Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito nanzɔɔ.

english_verse: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
translation_verse: La ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Kɔrɩntɩ taŋ-la lɛ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ to Kirisito lɛ a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta, dɩ ba ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma ʋ sɩpaaŋ, a saa pɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Yesu Kirisito a hɛ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ-na kala. Yesu Kirisito ŋaa la dɩ ma kala Tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ. Wɩa to Kirisito lɛ nɛ a pɛ la lɛ

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Mɩ yie lɔllɛ Wɩa woruŋ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ to Kirisito Yesu lɛ nɛ a leŋ ma jʋʋ ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ.

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la chaasa chɩŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa wʋzɔmɔ-la la sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ Kirisito lɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent.
translation_verse: Wɩa ma jaŋ chaasa kɛmma woruŋ dɩ ma sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa, a kaa mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ʋ nɛ yɩrɛma dɩ ma dɩ ʋ Bie Yesu Kirisito kʋ ŋaa kʋbala. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa La Tɩɩna. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii sɩɩ yuo dɔŋɔ

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩɩ sʋl ma kala La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito yɩrɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ma kala kɛŋ nii-bala a sɩ́ dɔŋɔ lɛ pɔrʋ. Mɩɩ sʋlma dɩ ma kɛŋ tʋɔ-bala a chɩŋ wʋbala lɛ.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ nɩa dɩ maa yuo dɔŋɔ nɛ. La naambie ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kuluuwi, ʋ dɩa nɩaa nɛ bʋla pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ mɩ pɩɛsɛma wɩɩŋ deeŋ: Kirisito ŋaa bʋlɩa nɛɛ? Ba kpaasɛ Pɔɔl mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ dɩ ʋ laama ta nɛɛ? Ba foma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ Pɔɔl yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛɛ?

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ lɔllɛ Wɩa arɩ mɩ sɩ bɩ ma kʋŋkala Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ fo, see la naambie Kirisipas arɩ Gayas dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nʋʋ ma saa bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ mɩ fou Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ harɩ-tooru.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: Mɩ liise yi arɩ mɩ fo la naambie Sɩtɛfanas arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa ma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ. Ama mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo liise yi dɩ mɩ fo nʋʋ dɔŋ ma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ.

english_verse: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
translation_verse: Kirisito bɩ mɩ tɩma dɩ mɩ kʋ fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ. Ʋ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la nɛ. Nuhuobiine wʋjɩmɩŋ dee ʋ joŋo pɩmɛ mɩ kaa bʋbʋl wɩalɩŋ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ dol-la sɩ lɩɩ Kirisito lɛ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ, sɩ́ pɛɩ ŋaa nɛ. Kirisito nɛ ŋaa Wɩa doluŋ arɩ ʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: La bʋla arɩ Kirisito sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ, ŋɩɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɛlɛ teeŋ. Ama la nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ laa ta, wɩalɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa doluŋ la teeŋ.

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla dɩ Wɩa sɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wʋjɩnnaa wʋjɩmɩɩ-la ŋaa pɛɩ, dɩ wʋjɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ tɩŋŋaa wʋjɩmɩŋ ma ŋaa pɛɩ.

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa, nɩɩ nɛ wʋjɩnna-la jaŋ hɛ? Wʋjɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ tɩmma-la, nɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ hɛ? Teŋ-jɩnnɩ babiibala-la ba ma jaŋ hɛ nɩɩ? Wɩa daga arɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ ŋaa nɩyaarɩ wʋjɩmɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ wuo ŋaa dɩ nuhuobiine sɩ́ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ to a jɩŋ ʋ-na Wɩa. Nɩaa sɩ dɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la la sɩɩ bʋl ŋaa wʋtɔɔnʋ nɛ, ama Wɩa to wɩalɩŋ lɛ nɛ a laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa wɩalɩŋ dii a ta.

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: Ama Kirisito sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ wɩaa nɛ la bʋbʋl. Kirisito sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ leŋe Juu tɩŋŋaa baanɩŋ sisii, aŋ ka nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ma teeŋ ʋ ŋaa wʋpɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ yɩra kala teeŋ, Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ Giriik tɩŋŋaa kala, Kirisito lɛ nɛ Wɩa doluŋ arɩ ʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ kala hɛ.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ wɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ, ka nɩaa bʋl arɩ ʋ ŋaa nɩyaarɩ wɩɩ nɛ, ʋ nɛ paala kpɩa nuhuobiine wʋjɩmɩŋ. Wɩɩ-la ma sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ, ka nuhuobiine sɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋpʋgʋ nɛ, ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩ nuhuobiine.

english_verse: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, má liise yi ŋɩɩ ma fa sɩ naga bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ yɩrɛma. Ma tʋɔŋ nɩaa baŋmɛɛ nɛ fa kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, koo ma tʋɔŋ nɩaa baŋmɛɛ nɛ fa kɛŋ doluŋ? Ma nɩaa baŋmɛɛ ma nɛ fa ŋaa nɩbalaa nuhuobiinee teeŋ?

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: Wɩa paala chaasa lɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩ sɩ ba ŋaa nɩyaara nɛ, dɩ ʋ wuo hɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa wʋjɩnnaa hɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Wɩa bɩra lɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ ma dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩ sɩ ba ŋaa nɩpʋgʋnʋŋ nɛ, dɩ ʋ wuo hɛ nɩduoruŋ hɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: Wɩa lɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩ bee gʋgʋʋnɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ lee kɛnɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, dɩ ʋ wuo chei nɩalɩŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩ bɩɩna arɩ ba ŋaa nɩa.

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: Wɩa ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ ʋ doluŋ lɛ wuo to a bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba sɩ, “Dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ bigisi a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ dɩ mɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩma, mɩ bɩ wʋduduosi bʋla a nagɛ mɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ.

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ, mɩ joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa a nagɛ mɩ bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ nɛ, see Yesu Kirisito sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ dʋndʋŋa wɩaa nɛ mɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ, mɩ fa nagɛ nɩpʋgʋ nɛ. Fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛmmɛ, mɩ chichel.

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine wʋjɩmɩŋ dee mɩ kaa bʋbʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la, aŋ pɛ dɩdagɛ ma ma. Ama ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa daga arɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: Wɩa ŋaa ŋɩɩ mɩ lɛ dɩ ma na ʋ doluŋ a laa ʋ wɩaa dii, aŋ sɩ́ nuhuobiine wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ to. Wɩa wʋjɩmɩŋ kɩɩ nuhuobiine wʋjɩmɩŋ

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ waa Wɩa wɩaa lɛ, la yie dɩdagɛba wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ. Wʋjɩmɩŋ deeŋ la sɩɩ dagʋ tuo dʋnɩa deeŋ nɩaa wʋjɩmɩŋ, dʋnɩa deeŋ nɩduoruŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ ma dee. Nɩduoruŋ deemba wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩɩ-la wɩaa mɩ sɩɩ bʋl, ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ a ŋaa wʋfaalɩɩ nɩaa teeŋ. Wʋjɩmɩɩ-la faa nɛ Wɩa teeŋ, ka dʋnɩa-na suomi. Wɩa lɩɩsɛla dɩ la kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ deeŋ nɛ a wuo kɛŋ tʋla ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ beŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ bɩ wɩaa deemba bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ fa jɩmba, ba fa bɩ jaŋ kpaasɛ La Tɩɩna sɩ kɛŋ tʋla a mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Kʋ-la nuhuobiine ha sɩ bɩ na, kʋ-la wɩaa ʋ ha sɩ bɩ nɩa, arɩ kʋ-la wɩaa ha sɩ bɩ nuhuobiine tʋɔbɩɩnaa jʋa, kɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa wasa bil nɩalɩŋ sɩ chou lɛ.”

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa to ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ lɛ nɛ a kɛŋ wɩaa deemba fa sɩ faa kaa dagɛla. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ yie gbilli wɩɩkala nɛ, a paala jɩŋ Wɩa wɩɩ-wɩɩkala sɩ faa.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ bɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ dɔŋɔ sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ? Nʋʋkala bɩ wuo jɩŋ, see ʋ tɩɩna tɩtɩa sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ wɩɩ-la. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ, see Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: La laa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la nɛ. Ʋ tuo dʋnɩa deeŋ kʋŋ. Wɩa joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la a pɩla nɛ dɩ la wuo jɩŋ kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ joŋo dii zile la lɛ.

english_verse: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
translation_verse: La yie bʋl kɩaa deemba wɩaa a pɩ nɩaa nɛ. Dʋnɩa deeŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ dee la kaa bʋbʋl wɩaa. Ama Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la nɛ dagɛla ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ. Ʋ yie dagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ lɛ ʋ sɩ hɛ, dɩ ba ma jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kɛnɛ bɩ jaŋ laa kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la. Ʋ tɩɩna bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩmba. Ba yie ŋaa kʋpɛɩba nɛ ʋ teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩmba, see dɩ ʋ kɛŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la nɛ jaŋ wuo chagɩlɛ nʋʋkala a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩɩkala lɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la kɛnɛ bɩ jaŋ wuo chagɩlɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ŋ-la nɛ ba ŋmʋnsɛ a pɩɛsɛ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jɩŋ La Tɩɩna Wɩa tʋɔbɩɩnaa? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩaa a chagɩlʋ?” Ama la-na jɩŋ Kirisito tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ bɩ wuo bʋl wɩaa ma teeŋ a nagɛ ma ŋaa nɩa sɩ kɛŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la nɛ. Ama mɩ bʋl wɩaa ma teeŋ a nagɛ ma haa ŋaa dʋnɩa wɩaa nɛ. Ma ha ŋaa hambiisiŋ nɛ Kirisito wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla ma teeŋ, ba nagɛ yɩlɩŋ nɛ mɩ leŋ ma wasɛ. Mɩ bɩ wʋyuŋi kala bʋla pɩma. Bʋa-la lɛ, ma ha bɩ ma tɩtɩa kaa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ma nɩɩ wʋyuŋi. Arɩ lɛɛlɛ kala ma ha bɩ wʋyuŋi kala wuo nɩɩ.

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: Ma haa ŋaa dʋnɩa wʋŋaalaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa, ma kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a yuyuo dɔŋɔ, ma sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba, dʋnɩa wʋŋaalaa dee ŋɩɩ?

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Ma yie pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ. Dɔŋɔ sɩ dɩ ʋ to Pɔɔl harɩŋ nɛ, ka dɔŋɔ ma sɩ dɩ ʋ to Apɔlɔs harɩŋ nɛ. Ma sɩɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, dʋnɩa nɩaa wʋbʋlaa dee ma bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ?

english_verse: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ Apɔlɔs? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ Pɔɔl? La ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa nɛ. La nɛ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pɩma ma laa dii. La kʋŋkala tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩla dɩ la tɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
translation_verse: Wɩa wɩalɩŋ la sɩ bʋla pɩma nagɛ kʋdoho nɛ la duu. Mɩ nɛ duu kʋdoho-la, Apɔlɔs ma nɛ ŋaa lɩɩŋ a mɩsɛ, ama Wɩa nɛ leŋe ʋ waa.

english_verse: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ duu kʋ-la arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa lɩɩŋ mɩsɛ kala bɩ sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩ ŋaa. Wɩa nɛ kɩɩ ba kala, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ leŋe ʋ waa.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ duu kʋdoho-la arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa lɩɩŋ mɩsɛ, ba kala tɩma magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Wɩa jaŋ tiŋ nʋʋkala a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la magɛ.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: La kala ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔsɛ nɛ a pɛ Wɩa lɛ laa tɩŋ. Ma saa nagɛ Wɩa baga nɛ, a bɩra nagɛ Wɩa dɩa.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ tɩŋ, Wɩa nɛ joŋ doluŋ pɩmɛ. Mɩ nagɛ dɩɩ-saara sɩ jɩŋ dɩa saanɩŋ woruŋ nɛ a bil Wɩa dɩa-la gentine. Nʋʋ ma dɔŋ nɛ saa dɩa-la ʋ jɩl. Nʋʋkala saa fɩɛlɛ ʋ sɩaa ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ saa dɩa-la.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: dɩ Kirisito nɛ mɩɩra kɔ tapʋlɩɩ-la, kɩalɩŋ nʋʋkala sɩ kaa saa dɩa-la, ba jaŋ naʋ. Nyiniŋ nɛ jaŋ dagɛ kʋ-la ba sɩ kaa saa nagɩsɩŋ. Ba jaŋ to ŋɩɩ lɛ a jɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la nʋʋkala sɩ tɩma.

english_verse: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
translation_verse: Dɩ nyiŋ-la nɛ kɔ aŋ bɩ wuo dii kɩalɩŋ nʋʋkala sɩ kaa saa dɩa-la, ʋ tɩɩna jaŋ laa ʋ time.

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ nyiŋ-la nɛ wuo dii kɩalɩŋ nʋʋkala sɩ kaa saa dɩa-la, ʋ tɩɩna lɔlɔ ta nɛ. Ama Wɩa jaŋ laa ʋ-na tɩtɩa ta. Ʋ jaŋ naga arɩ nyiŋ-la faa chɛ dɩ ʋ dii ʋ tɩɩna nɛ, aŋ ka Wɩa lɩɩsʋ nyiŋ-la lɛ.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ ma ŋaa Wɩa dɩa nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la jʋjʋʋ?

english_verse: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ chei Wɩa dɩa-la, Wɩa ma jaŋ chei ʋ tɩɩna. Wɩa dɩa bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ma nɛ saa ŋaa dɩa-la.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩ́ ʋ tɩtɩa nyɩsʋ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ bɩrɩmɛ nɩyaarɩ nɛ a wuo kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa wʋjɩmɩŋ ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ Wɩa teeŋ. Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla, “Wɩa to dʋnɩa nɩaa wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ nɛ a bɛrɛ kɛsɛba.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ma ba ŋmʋnsa arɩ wʋjɩnnaa tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: Ma nɛ tɩɩ Pɔɔl, a tɩɩ Apɔlɔs, a tɩɩ Pɩɩta, a tɩɩ dʋnɩa, a tɩɩ mɩɩsɩŋ, a tɩɩ sʋʋŋ ma, a tɩɩ lɛɛlɛ arɩ maachie. Ma nɛ tɩɩ ba kala.

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: Kirisito nɛ tɩɩma, Wɩa ma nɛ tɩɩ Kirisito.

english_verse: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Ma sɩɩ benla ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ nʋʋkala jɩŋ arɩ la ŋaa Kirisito tɩntɩnnaa nɛ. Wɩa joŋ ʋ wɩalɩŋ fa sɩ faa a hɛ la nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Ʋ saa maga dɩ tɩntɩnnʋ kala kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a tɩtɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩpaa tuo dɩ ma nɩɩ bʋl mɩ teeŋ koo dɩ nɩa nɛ dɔsɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɛ lɛ. Mɩ paala bɩ cheeriŋ joŋo pɩ mɩ tɩtɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala chese nɛ. Ama mɩ saa bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye. La Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ mɩ cheye nɛ koo mɩ bɩ cheye.

english_verse: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má sɩ́ cheeriŋ joŋo pɩ nʋʋkala, dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ jaŋ kɔ a dii la sarɩya ha bɩ yie. Dɩ ʋ nɛ mɩɩra kɔ, wʋbɔmɔ-la kala nɩaa sɩ ŋaa birimiŋ tʋɔŋ, ba kala jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ. Nɩaa tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala ba sɩ kɛnɛ jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa jaŋ bɛsɛ nʋʋkala lɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, ma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ joŋ wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ bʋla a kaa magɩsɛ mɩ dɩ Apɔlɔs sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ wuo pɛ ma lɛ, dɩ ma wuo gʋnnɛ wɩɩ-la nɩaa sɩɩ bʋl, “Má sɩ́ bee kieli wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil.” Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma sɩ́ nʋʋkala beŋ arɩ ʋ nɛ kɩɩ ʋ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa ma yʋga kɩɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ? Wɩa dee bɩ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛnɛ joŋo pɩmaa? Dɩ Wɩa nɛ saa joŋo pɩma, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma bibigisi ma tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ ʋ dee bɩ joŋo pɩma?

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna ma kɛŋ kʋŋkala ma sɩɩ chɛ nɛ, a ŋaa kɩa tɩmma, a dii kuoruŋ aŋ ka la-na bɩ kɩaa deemba kʋŋkala kɛnɛ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, la fa cho dɩ ma dii kuoruŋ nɛ, dɩ la dɩ ma kala ŋaa kuoroo.

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: Ʋ naga mɩ-na teeŋ arɩ Wɩa joŋ la nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa ʋ nanzɔɔba la nagɛ dansarɩkaba ba sɩ lɩɩsa nɩaa tʋɔŋ ba pʋɔla tuto harɩŋ dɩ ba kaa mʋ kpʋ nɛ. Ba tʋɔsɛla a kaa kʋ lɩɩ, dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa arɩ Wɩa tɩndaaraa nala a huurila nɛ.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ Kirisito wɩaa, la ŋaa nɩyaara nɛ, ka ma-na kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ Kirisito teeŋ. La-na ŋaa puwuolo nɛ, aŋ ka ma-na ŋaa nɩduori. Nɩaa mʋmɔŋ la lɛ aŋ zizilma.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Naabʋɔsʋŋ deemba lɛ losuŋ arɩ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ kɛnla nɛ, la laalɛ gɛrɩ-kɔsʋmɔɔ, ba ŋmuŋmoola, la gɔllɔ bɩbaarɛ.

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: La faasa tɩtɩŋ nɛ dɩ la pɛ la tɩtɩa lɛ. Dɩ nɩaa nɛ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ la lɛ, la-na yie sʋl Wɩa pɩba nɛ, dɩ ba nɛ to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛla, la yie nyalɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ chei la yɩrɩŋ, la-na yie bʋl wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a tɩgɛ ba lɛ. Naabʋɔsʋŋ deemba lɛ, la ŋaa kʋtɔɔnɩ nɛ, dʋnɩa nɩsʋrʋŋ nɛ paala kpɩala.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: Ma nagɛ mɩ bii-chooloo nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ bɩ wɩaa deemba ŋmʋnsa pɩma dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmma, ama mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ chagɩlɛma nɛ.

english_verse: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ sɩpaalaaraa sɩɩ dagɛma Kirisito wɩaa, dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa bʋɩ fii ma, ma nyɩmmaba dee ŋɩɩ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma nyɩmma Yesu Kirisito lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩma.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩɩ sʋlma dɩ ma to mɩ naabʋɔsʋŋ, a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ tɩŋ Timoti dɩ ʋ kɔ ma teeŋ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ nagɛ mɩ bii-choolii nɛ, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ ma La Tɩɩna Kirisito wɩaa lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ liliisima ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩɩ to Kirisito wɩaa, arɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ yie dagɛba lee-na kala nɩaa sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Ma dɔnsʋŋ bɩrɩmɛ deŋgiŋ tɩmma nɛ a bɩɩnɛ arɩ mɩ bɩ jaŋ kʋ nama.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ sɛyɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ dieni aŋ kʋ nama. Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ, mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ nɩɩ deŋgiŋ tɩŋŋaa deemba wʋbʋlaa dʋndʋŋa, ama mɩ jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ dol-la ba sɩ kɛnɛ,

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa, Wɩa kuorii-la bɩ nuhuobiine wʋbʋlaa lɛ nɛ chɩna, ama Wɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ chɩŋ.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma cho? Mɩ kori chɩba kʋ vɩɩrɛma, koo mɩ kɛŋ chonuŋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛlaa kɔ?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩa arɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a ŋaa disiniŋ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ lɔrɔ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ ma paala bɩ ŋɩɩ ka ŋaa. Ba bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a laa ʋ nyɩmma haala jaa.

english_verse: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ nɛ saa ma jaŋ wuo ŋaa a bigisi ma tɩtɩa lɛ? Ʋ maga dɩ ma tʋɔŋ chei nɛ, ka dɩ ma lɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a ta ma tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: I am with you only in my thoughts. But in the name of our Lord Jesus I have already judged this man, as though I were with you in person. So when you meet together and the power of the Lord Jesus is with you, I will be there too.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kʋ hilimi La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito yɩrɩŋ lɛ, mɩ dɩma jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ, Yesu Kirisito ma doluŋ jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
translation_verse: Má joŋ baala deeŋ hɛ Sɩtaanɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ to ʋ tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ a dɔgɩsɛ ʋ yaraa, ka dɩ Wɩa laa ʋ dɩma ta tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Ma sɩɩ bigisi ma tɩtɩa lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋɩɩ bɩ zɔŋ. Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ mʋa nɛ ba yie joŋo hɛ boroboro munuŋ lɛ, ka ʋ sii pʋɔrɛ a yʋgɛɛ?

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má leŋ dɩ la gbieli la dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la. Má leŋ dɩ la joŋ boroboro bɩnɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ sɩbʋrʋŋ ta. Sɩ-bʋrʋ-la nagɛ wʋbɔmʋŋ arɩ tʋɔbɔmʋŋ nɛ. Má leŋ dɩ la gbieli arɩ boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ. Boroboro deeŋ nagɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ tʋɔ-bala nɛ.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: Teŋ-la mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩma tʋɔŋ, mɩ bʋla pɩma dɩ ma lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Mɩ saa bɩ bʋla arɩ ma sɩ́ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, koo nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔ-luŋuŋ, koo gaaraa, koo vʋɩ-kpaaraa tʋɔŋ guolu. Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma sɩ́ ba tʋɔŋ guolu, ŋɩɩ-na ma bɩ jaŋ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Why should I judge outsiders? Aren't we supposed to judge only church members?
translation_verse: Mɩ tɩntɩmɩŋ dee dɩ mɩ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Yesu laa dii wɩaa jɩŋ. Ama ma-na saa maga dɩ ma laa dɔŋɔba wɩaa jɩjɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: God judges everyone else. The Scriptures say, “Chase away any of your own people who are evil.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Yesu jɩŋ-na, Wɩa nɛ jaŋ dii ba sarɩya. Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla, “Má lɩɩsɛ nɩbɔmʋŋ ta ma tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa, dɩ wɩɩ nɛ kʋ hɛ ma balɩa pɛgɛ, dɔŋɔ yie kɛŋ wɩɩ-la kaa mʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka chʋɔlɛ teeŋ nɛ, dɩ ba bʋl wɩɩ-la a wasɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma yie bɩ leŋe Wɩa nɩaa bʋl wɩɩ-la wʋwasɛ?

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa nɩaa nɛ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya? Dɩ ma nɛ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya, ma bɩ wʋbiisiŋ deemba wuo bʋla wʋwasɛɛ?

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ la Wɩa nɩaa nɛ jaŋ dii Wɩa tɩndaaraa ma sarɩya? A saa kʋ bibeŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ wɩaa?

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: Ma hɩɩsɛ nɛ. Nɩbala paala tuo ma tʋɔŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, dɩ wɩɩ nɛ kʋ hɛ Wɩa nɩaa balɩa pɛgɛ, dɩ ʋ wuo bʋl a wasɛɛ?

english_verse: But instead, you cheat and rob other followers.
translation_verse: Ama ma tɩtɩa yie ŋaa wɩaa chichei dɔŋɔ aŋ gɩrɩma lɩlaa ma naambiiriŋ ma kɩaa.

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ? Má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa nyɩsʋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa, arɩ bachɔrʋmɔɔ arɩ hachɔrʋmɔɔ, arɩ baalaa koo haalaa balɩa sɩ jaa dɔŋɔ, arɩ baala-la koo haala-la sɩ gɔllɛ lee-kala a ŋɩŋaa ba-lɩɩlɩ koo hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa,

english_verse: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
translation_verse: arɩ gaaraa arɩ tʋɔ-luŋ tɩŋŋaa, arɩ sɩ-nyʋaraa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chei nɩaa yɩrɩŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ gɩrɩma lɩlaa dɔŋɔba kɩaa, nɩaa deemba kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
