translation_verse: Ma dɔnsʋŋ faa ŋaa wɩaa deemba nɛ. Ama Wɩa fo ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta nɛ. Wɩa nɛ tɩɩma. A tɩŋ La Tɩɩna Kirisito Yesu wɩaa arɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la doluŋ lɛ, ma ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma nɛ Wɩa teeŋ. Ʋ maga dɩ la leŋ disiŋ wʋŋaalaa

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ dɩ mɩ nɛ cho, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-na kala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ama wɩɩ-na kala bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ a pɩmɛ. Mɩ jaŋ wuo bɩra bʋl arɩ mɩ nɛ cho, mɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩkala, ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ kʋŋkala kɛŋ doluŋ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ hɛ nɩmɛ a ma jaŋ bʋl, Wɩa nɛ ŋaa kʋdiilee ba dii hɩhɛ luoruŋ lɛ, ka luoruŋ ma laa kʋdiile-la bibil. Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ama Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ kʋdiilee arɩ luoru-la kala pʋa. Wɩa bɩ nuhuobiine ŋaa dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ yaraa ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, ama dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ yaraa tɩma pʋpʋ. Wɩa nɛ tɩɩ yara-la ma.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Wɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ chɩsɛ La Tɩɩna Kirisito sʋʋŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ chɩsɛ la ma sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ ma yaraa ŋaa Kirisito yaraa sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ nɛɛ? Ma bɩɩna mɩ jaŋ wuo joŋ Kirisito yaraa sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a mɛrɛ hachɔrʋmʋŋ yaraa lɛ? Aɩ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Koo ma bɩ jɩŋ dɩ baala nɛ kɛŋ hachɔrʋŋ-la pɩŋ, ba kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛɛ? Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba chaasa bʋl, “Baala arɩ ʋ haala jaŋ mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a ŋaa kʋbala.”

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa mʋ mɛrɛ La Tɩɩna Kirisito lɛ, ʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋbala nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la doluŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ lɛ. Wʋbɔŋ-na kala nuhuobiine sɩ ŋaa bɩ ʋ yaraa ka chei, ama baal-la sɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ yie chei ʋ yaraa kala nɛ.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ ma yaraa ŋaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩma dɩa nɛɛ? Ma dee bɩ ma tɩtɩa tɩɩ. Wɩa nɛ tɩɩma.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: Wɩa joŋ ʋ chalɩŋ nɛ yɔɔma. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má kɛŋ ma yaraa tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la sɩɩ tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: Teŋ-la ma sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩmɛ tʋɔŋ ma pɩɛsɛmɛ wɩaa dɔnsʋŋ. Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ baala nɛ bɩ haala jaa.

english_verse: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
translation_verse: Ama a tɩŋ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ wɩaa, baal kala jaa ʋ haala, dɩ haal ma kala jaa ʋ bala.

english_verse: Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ baala arɩ ʋ haala joŋ ba tɩtɩa a pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ, a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Haala bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa tɩɩ, ʋ bala nɛ tɩɩʋ, baala ma bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa tɩɩ, ʋ haala nɛ tɩɩʋ.

english_verse: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩma, ʋ bɩ naga arɩ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bil nii nɛ a pɩma dɩ ma tuto.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl bonjoŋŋoo arɩ ha-bonjoŋŋoo arɩ ma yo-haalaa wɩaa nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ dɩ ma ma nɛ nagɛmɛ a bɩ baala koo haala jaa.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ma tɩtɩa wuo kɩkɛŋ, má mʋ jaa balaba arɩ haalaa. Ʋ nɛ kpɩa ma sɩ jaŋ joŋ baalaa koo haalaa wɩaa a hɛ ma nyuŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
translation_verse: Baala-la sɩ kɛŋ haalaa arɩ haala-la sɩ kɛŋ balaba, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩma nɛ. Mɩ tɩtɩa dee bɩ bʋl, ama La Tɩɩna nɩɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la. Ʋ nɛ ŋ-la: Haala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ vɩa ʋ bala,

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: Ma nɩkaanaa ma, mɩ-na Pɔɔl nɛ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma, La Tɩɩna Wɩa dee. Dɩ baal-la sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ kɛŋ haal-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii, dɩ haal-la nɛ sɛyɛ dɩ ba hɔŋ, baal-la bɩ maga dɩ ʋ vɩaʋ.

english_verse: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
translation_verse: Dɩ haal-la sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ kɛŋ bala sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii, dɩ ʋ nɛ sɛyɛ dɩ ba hɔŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ haal-la vɩaʋ.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Baal koo haal, dɩ ba tʋɔŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka chʋɔlɛ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaa viiri, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ viiri. Dɩ ʋ nɛ viire, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa chei. Wɩa yie chɩchɛ dɩ ma hɔŋ sɔm nɛ.

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Kʋ-la kala Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ fa sɩ naga ka Wɩa yɩrɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ŋ kɛnʋ nɛ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ mɩ dɩdagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi lee-na kala.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ keri ŋ peniŋ koo dɩ ŋ bɩ kere, ʋ bɩ wɩɩ kɛnɛ Wɩa teeŋ. Wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩ nɛ, dɩ ma tuto Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ aŋ ka Wɩa yɩrʋ, ʋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Yoŋ-na kala La Tɩɩna Kirisito sɩ yɩra, ʋ tɩɩna tɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ Kirisito teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa aŋ ka Kirisito yɩrʋ, ŋaa Kirisito yoŋ nɛ.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Kirisito nɛ joŋ ʋ chalɩŋ yɔɔma. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má sɩ́ nuhuobiinee yosuŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ pɩɛsɛmɛ wɩɩ-la a mʋ tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ ha sɩ bɩ bala koo haala jaa lɛ, Wɩa bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla pɩla a mʋ tɩgɛ ba lɛ, ama Wɩa sɩ fá mɩ nenige ŋɩɩ, ʋ leŋe mɩ ŋaa nɩtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ nɛ a tɩgɛ hatoloo lɛ.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ lɛɛlɛ tinteeŋ sɩ dolie wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ zɔŋ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ bala koo haala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaa haala nɛɛ? Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ʋ vɩa. Ŋ bɩ haala jaa? Ŋɩɩ-na bɩra sɩ́ haal chɛ.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ŋ nɛ jaa haala, ŋ bɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa. Dɩ hatolo ma ha sɩ bɩ bala jaa, dɩ ʋ nɛ jaa bala, ʋ bɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa. Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaa haala koo bala, ba yie jʋʋ wʋwalɩmaa tʋɔŋ nɛ. Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ ma jʋʋ wʋwalɩmaa deemba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ sɩ má sɩ́ bala koo haala kɛŋ.

english_verse: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: La bɩ jaŋ dieni dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ haalaa, maga dɩ ba nagɛ arɩ ba bɩ haalaa kɛnɛ nɛ.

english_verse: It will be all the same if you are crying or laughing, or if you are buying or are completely broke.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yel maga dɩ ba nagɛ arɩ ba tʋɔŋ bɩ cheye, ka nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ mɔŋ maga dɩ ba naga arɩ ba tʋɔŋ bɩ tɔrɔ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɔɔ kɩaa maga dɩ ba nagɛ arɩ ba bɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɔɔ tɩɩ.

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: Bayalaa ma maga dɩ ba nagɛ arɩ ba bɩ kɩaa yallɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa dʋnɩa deeŋ nagɩŋ ʋ sɩ nagɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ wɩaa walɩmɛma. Baal-la sɩ bɩ haala kɛnɛ yie joŋ ʋ nyuŋ kala hɛ La Tɩɩna tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ. Ʋ yie chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ tɩma pɩ ʋ Tɩɩna dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: Ama baal-la sɩ kɛŋ haala yie bɩbɩɩnɛ dʋnɩa wʋŋaalaa wɩaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ yie chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩaa dɩ ʋ haala tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ʋ yie kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa balɩa nɛ a tɩtɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Haal-la koo hatolo-la sɩ bɩ bala kɛnɛ yie joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kala a hɛ La Tɩɩna tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ. Ʋ yie chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ yaraa arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala a pɩ Wɩa nɛ. Ama haal-la sɩ kɛŋ bala yie joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kala hɛ dʋnɩa wʋŋaalaa lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ yie chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩaa dɩ ʋ bala tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma pɛ ma tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bʋbʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ. Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kirima ma tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ. Ama mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wombiiŋ lɛ nɛ, a joŋ ma tɩtɩa arɩ ma wɩɩ-wɩɩkala a hɛ La Tɩɩna tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Dɩ baala nɛ sʋgɛ hatolo dɩ ʋ jaa, dɩ haal-la ma sɛɩ, aŋ ka ba ha bɩ dɔŋɔ jaa, dɩ baal-la nɛ bene arɩ ʋ bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa wuo kɛŋ, a chɩchɛ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ dɩ ʋ jɩŋ haal-la, a na dɩ haal-la ma ka hɩasʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ jaaʋ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ bɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ baal-la nɛ jaa haala, ʋ ŋaa woruŋ nɛ, ama nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ haala jaa nɛ paala kpɩaʋ.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Haala sɩ kɛŋ bala, dɩ ʋ bala nɛ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ bala-la nɛ tɩɩʋ. Ama dɩ ʋ bala nɛ sʋba, ʋ kɛŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ bɩra jaa baal dɔŋ ʋ sɩ cho. Ama ʋ maga dɩ ʋ jaa nɩɩ-la sɩ cho La Tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ bala jaa, ʋ jaŋ na tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma jɩma arɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ pɩɛsɛmɛ wɩaa dɔnsʋŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ vʋɩŋ kʋdiilee lɛ, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ ba lɛ nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ arɩ la kala jɩŋ wɩaa nɛ. Wʋjɩmɩŋ saa yie kɛŋ ʋ tɩɩna bibigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ. Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho nɩaa yie pɛ ba lɛ nɛ dɩ ba chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ jɩŋ wɩaa nɛ, ʋ bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ cho Wɩa, Wɩa jɩŋ ʋ tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa aŋ ka vʋɩŋ kʋdiile-la wɩaa. La jɩma arɩ vʋɩŋ bɩ ku-wei ŋaa. La bɩra jɩma arɩ Wɩɩ-bala dʋndʋŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
translation_verse: Dɩ vesiŋ nɛ paala hɛ nɩmɛ, dɩ ba nɛ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ koo tinteeŋ, dɩ la tɩɩnaba nɛ paala yʋgɛ ma,

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: la-na jɩŋ Wɩɩ-bala lɛ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa la Nyɩmma. Ʋ nɛ ta kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ lɛ nɛ la to a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. La Tɩɩna ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Ʋ nɛ Yesu Kirisito. Ʋ lɛ nɛ Wɩa to a ta kʋŋkala. Ʋ lɛ nɛ la to a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ ma.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Ama nɩaa kala dee bɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ jɩŋ. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ fa kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa a mal nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala dɩ ba nɩɩ dii vʋɩyaa kʋdiilee, ba yie bɩɩnɛ arɩ ba pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa lɛ nɛ, ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩ Wɩa wɩaa lɛ woruŋ chɩna. Ba yie bɩbɩɩnɛ kʋdiile-la ŋaa ba kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Kʋdiilee bɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ Wɩa arɩ nuhuobiinee pɛgɛ zɔŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ dii kʋdiilee dɔnsʋŋ aŋ vɩvɩa dɔnsʋŋ, ʋ tuo wɩɩkala Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ waa Wɩa wɩaa lɛ, dɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ nɛ jʋʋ vʋɩŋ dɩa a hɔnɔ didii kɩaa, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ waa Wɩa wɩaa lɛ nɛ nama dɩ maa dii kʋdiilee deemba, ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ ba ma jaŋ to ma lɛ a didii kɩaa deemba?

english_verse: Then what you know has destroyed someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ma wʋjɩmɩŋ deeŋ, ma naambie sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa lɛ chɩna tele nɛ, nɩɩ-la wɩaa Kirisito sɩ sʋba.

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ mɩ nɛ jɩma arɩ mɩ nɛ dii kʋdiil dɔŋ, mɩ naambie jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ŋɩɩ-na mɩ bɩ jaŋ dii a leŋ dɩ mɩ naambie ŋaa wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ namɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ bɩ mɩ tɩtɩa tɩɩ? Mɩ bɩ Wɩa nanzɔɔ ŋaa? Mɩ ha bɩ Yesu La Tɩɩna naa? Ma sɩ laa wɩalɩŋ dii bɩ daga arɩ mɩ tɩma pɩ La Tɩɩna nɛɛ?

english_verse: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ paala bɩ laa dii arɩ mɩ ŋaa Wɩa nanzɔɔ, ma-na teeŋ mɩ ŋaa nɛ. Mɩɩsɩ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ La Tɩɩna Kirisito lɛ daga arɩ mɩ ŋaa ʋ nanzɔɔ nɛ a tɩma pʋpʋ.

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ wombiiŋ kɛnɛ la sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa a pɩpɩma, dɩ ma ma pɩla kʋdiilee arɩ lɩɩŋ, koo?

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ wombiiŋ kɛnɛ dɩ la ma jaa haalaa sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, dɩ ba to la harɩŋ a mʋmʋ lere-la la sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa, koo? Wɩa nanzɔɔba dɔnsʋŋ arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu ŋaanaa arɩ Pɩɩta ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɩɩfas yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna mɩ dɩ Banabas dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga dɩ la bʋl Wɩa wɩaa aŋ pɛ tɩma pɛ la tɩtɩa lɛɛ?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Laalɩyuori bɛɛ nɛ yie chɛ ʋ tɩtɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa a kaa tɩtɩŋ? Paarɩ bɛɛ nɛ bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa baga kɩaa ka dii? Nɛ-daarɩ bɛɛ nɛ bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa nayɩlɩŋ ka nyʋa?

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil tʋɔŋ, ba bʋla, “Dɩ nɛŋ nɩɩ ŋmoo mɩaa, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ vɔɔ ʋ niiŋ tɔ.” Ʋ bɩ naga nɛŋ-la wɩaa nɛ Wɩa chɩl.

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, la wɩaa nɛ ʋ bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ. La nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa nɛ ba ŋmʋnsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ pa. Paaraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kʋŋ baga kɩaa kala yie yɩyɩɛlɛ arɩ ba kɛŋ toruŋ nɛ kɩalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa wɩalɩŋ la sɩ bʋla pɩma, ba nagɛ kʋdoho nɛ la duu ma teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa dɩ ma nɩɩ pɛ la lɛ arɩ dʋnɩa kɩaa, ma sɩ́ bɩɩna arɩ ma ŋaa kikieli nɛ.

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ pɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kɩaa deemba, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma faasa pɩla a kɩɩbaa? Ama la-na bɩ ŋɩɩ joŋo ʋ ŋaa fʋgʋna, dɩ la sɩ́ wɩɩkala ŋaa kɛrɛ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ tɩgɛ Kirisito wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala dii ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa leriŋ nɛ. Ma jɩma nɩɩ-la sɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩa lɛ ka dii Wɩa dɩa lɛ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ lɛ, ba ma yie laa ba toruŋ nɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ La Tɩɩna bʋl dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la, dɩ ba ma to nɩmɛ a ma nɩna ba kʋdiilee.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ ha bɩ wombiiŋ deeŋ to a chɩchɛ mɩ kʋchɛɛlɛɛ. Mɩ saa bɩ teniŋ deeŋ ŋmʋnsa pɩma, dɩ mɩ laa kɩaa ma teeŋ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ nʋʋkala joŋ kʋŋ pɩmɛ, dɩ mɩ sɩ́ wuo bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ wombii-la mɩ sɩɩ to lɛ. Mɩ sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ nɛ kpɩa nʋʋkala sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ mɩ lɛ.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ wombii kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ a tɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa. Ba tɩmmɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋlba. Ʋ jaŋ lɔrɔ pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la ka bʋl.

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ faa bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la mɩ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ fa jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ laa time. Ama mɩ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ dee mɩ tɩtɩŋ, Wɩa nɛ sɩ mɩ tɩŋ.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa saa, bɛɛ kʋŋ time nɛ ba jaŋ joŋo timmi? Mɩ bɩ kʋŋkala ka chɛ. Mɩ tɩntɩmɩŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩma, a sɩ́ kʋŋkala laa nʋʋkala teeŋ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ laa kʋ-la sɩ maga dɩ mɩ na a tɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ tɩtɩa, mɩ tuo nʋʋkala yoŋ. Ama mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa bɩrɩmɛ nʋʋkala yoŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ na nɩaa yʋgɛ dɩ ba kʋ to Wɩa.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ, dɩ mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɛ hɔnɔ, mɩ yie kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa bɩrɩmɛ ba dɔŋɔ nɛ, dɩ mɩ wuo na dɩ dɔnsʋŋ kʋ to Wɩa. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ bɩ naga arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bile dɩ la tuto ka to. Ama mɩ sɛnɛ tuto wɩalɩŋ Kirisito sɩ bʋla nɛ.

english_verse: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ mʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ waa Wɩa wɩaa lɛ teeŋ, mɩ yie kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa a nagɛ ba dɔŋɔ nɛ, dɩ mɩ wuo leŋ dɩ ba kʋ to Wɩa. Mɩ yie kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa bɩrɩmɛ a nagɛ nʋʋkala nɛ dɩ mɩ wuo laa dɔnsʋŋ ta, dɩ mɩ nɛ wuolo.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa, mɩɩ ŋaaba a tɩŋ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa nɛ. Mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ mɩ ma wuo na kʋzɔmɔ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la dii sɩ jaŋ na Wɩa teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Ma kala jɩma arɩ nɩaa nɩɩ fá, fɩfaara-la kala yie fá nɛ. Ama ba tʋɔŋ nɩbala nɛ yie dii. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má faasa fá a wuo dii a laa kɩaa.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩɩ fá tegi tegi a mʋmʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɩra nagɛ chɔrɩa ŋmuŋmooro ŋɩɩ. Mɩ bɩ mɩ nɩsɩŋ viise tɩta pɛɩ.

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: Ba kala dii kʋdiile-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo lo a pɩba nɛ,

english_verse: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
translation_verse: a nyʋa lɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ ma. Lɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ pɩba dɩ ba nyʋa lɩɩ bʋŋ lɛ nɛ a tuto ba harɩŋ. Kirisito tɩtɩa nɛ saa ŋaa bʋŋ-la.

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, Wɩa tʋɔŋ fa bɩ ba jesiŋ nyuŋ tɔrɔ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa kpʋba tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa nɛ. Baa dagɛla dɩ la sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ cho arɩ nɩaa deemba fa sɩ choba ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ vʋɩyaa kpaarʋ arɩ la naabalɩmaba dɔnsʋŋ fa sɩɩ kpaarʋ ŋɩɩ. Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba sɩ, “Nɩalɩŋ hɔnɔ dɩ ba dii kʋdiilee nɛ, aŋ sii gbieli a ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ.”

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩkala, ama ba kala bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ mɩ lɛ. Ba kala bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ mɩ waa Wɩa wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ la magɩsɛ La Tɩɩna. Ba dɔnsʋŋ fa magɩsʋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ dɩŋŋaa dɩmba a kpʋ.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Ba dɔnsʋŋ ma fa gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa nɛ Wɩa teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ ʋ tɩndaara kʋ kpʋba.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Wɩa ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala ba lɛ dɩ ʋ chagɩlɛba nɛ. Ama ba saa ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba bil nɛ a pɩla dɩ ba dɩdagɛla wɩaa nɛ. La hɛ bʋa-la lɛ dʋnɩa sɩ kpagɛ dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nʋʋkala sɩ́ bɩɩna arɩ ʋ chɩŋ woruŋ nɛ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa dii lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ fɩɛlɛ ʋ sɩaa nɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ jaŋ tel.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Dɩ Sɩtaanɩ nɛ kʋ magɩsɛ nʋʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ jɩŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Sɩtaanɩ yie mɩmagɩsɛ nʋʋkala. Ama Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ Sɩtaanɩ magɩsɛma a kieli ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa a chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ. Bʋa-la Sɩtaanɩ sɩɩ magɩsɛma, Wɩa jaŋ pɩma doluŋ dɩ ma wuo nyalɩmɛ. Ʋ jaŋ dagɛma wombii-la ma sɩ jaŋ to a lɩɩ wɩɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ nandɔŋ-choolie, má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa vʋɩyaa kpaarɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma dɩ ma kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma. Má bɩɩnɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɩɩ dii kʋdiile-la Kirisito sɩ sɩ dɩ la dii a liliisi ʋ wɩaa, la yie lɔllɛ Wɩa nɛ, aŋ joŋ nyʋnyʋala-la a nyʋa ʋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa. La sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ yie dagɛ arɩ a tɩŋ Kirisito chalɩŋ wɩaa la ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Dɩ la nɛ dii boroboro-la ma, ʋ ŋɩɩ daga arɩ a tɩŋ Kirisito yaraa wɩaa la kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ.

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: La yʋga ma nɛ, ama boroboro bala nɛ la yie kaa kpaa dɔŋɔ a didii. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, la kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Má bɩɩna mʋ yi Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ, ba nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ yie kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a nyɩgɛ a pɩpɩ Wɩa. Dɩ ba nɛ kpʋ pʋna-na kala, ba ma yie pɛ chaŋ nammɩa-la nɛ. Ŋɩɩ daga arɩ nɩalɩŋ arɩ Wɩa pɛ gbaŋa nɛ.

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla, ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ bɛɛ? Ma bɩɩna mɩ sɩ dɩ vʋɩyaa arɩ vʋɩyaa kʋdiilee ŋaa kɩaa nɛɛ?

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Aɩ, wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ vʋɩ-kpaaraa nɛ kpaarɛ vʋɩŋ, kʋŋ na-kala ba sɩ kpʋa, ba yie kpʋ pɩ jɩnsɩŋ nɛ. Wɩa dee ba kpʋ pa. Mɩ saa bɩ chɛ dɩ ma dɩ jɩnsɩŋ pɛ gbaŋa.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Ma dɩ Wɩa bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ nyʋnyʋala, aŋ ka ma dɩ jɩnsɩŋ ma pɛ nyʋnyʋala. Ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo didii kɩaa Wɩa teeŋ aŋ bɩra mʋ didii jɩnsɩŋ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Koo laa chɛ dɩ la ŋaa dɩ Wɩa baanɩŋ sii nɛ? Koo la bɩɩna la nɛ dolie kɩɩ Wɩa?

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ wuo dii nammɩa-na kala ba sɩɩ yallʋ yɔbɔ lɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa walɩmɛma a mʋ tɩgɛ nammɩa-la lɛ, arɩ ma jaŋ wuo dii koo ma bɩ jaŋ wuo dii.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba sɩ, “Dʋnɩa arɩ kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ, La Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ tɩɩba.”

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka chʋɔlɛ nɛ yɩrɩŋ dɩ ŋ kʋ dii kɩaa, dɩ ŋ nɛ cho dɩ ŋ mʋa, mʋ a dii, ama sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa walɩmɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ kʋdiile-la lɛ, arɩ ʋ maga dɩ ŋ dii koo ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ dii.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: Sɩ́ ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛ to a dii, to nɩɩ-la sɩ bʋla pɩŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛ a sɩ́ dii. Dɩ mɩ nɛ jɩma arɩ mɩ kɛŋ wombiiŋ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ, bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa jaŋ wuo pɔ dɩ mɩ sɩ́ wɩɩ-la ŋaa?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ lɔllɛ Wɩa aŋ-na dii kʋdiil-na kala, ɛɛ nɛ saa nʋʋ dɔŋ jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ mɩ cheye nɛ a tɩŋ kʋdiile-la mɩ sɩ die wɩaa?

english_verse: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa kʋŋ na-kala ma sɩɩ dii arɩ kʋŋ na-kala ma sɩɩ nyʋa, wɩɩ-na kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa, má ŋaa ba kala dɩ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Má chesimi arɩ mɩ sɩɩ chesi Kirisito ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: Ma ŋaa kukeri nɛ ma sɩ liisi mɩ wɩaa wɩɩkala lɛ a tuto wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Ama mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ Kirisito nɛ ŋaa baal-na kala sɩpaalaara, ka baala ma nɛ ŋaa haala sɩpaalaara, ka Wɩa ma nɛ laa Kirisito sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa dɩ baal nɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, koo dɩ ʋ nɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ joŋ kʋŋ tɔ ʋ nyuŋ, ʋʋ hɩɩsɛ Kirisito nɛ.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Dɩ haal ma kala nɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa koo dɩ ʋ nɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa, aŋ bɩ kʋŋ joŋo tɔ ʋ nyuŋ, ʋʋ hɩɩsɛ ʋ bala nɛ. Dɩ haal nɛ bɩ kʋŋ joŋo tɔ ʋ nyuŋ, ʋ naga arɩ ʋ fʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Dɩ haal nɛ bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋ kʋa tɔ ʋ nyuŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ fʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa hɩɩsɛ wɩɩ ŋɩɩ dɩ haala nɛ fʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ koo dɩ ʋ kɛ ʋ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ haala joŋ kʋŋ nɛ a tɔ ʋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: Baala-na bɩ maga dɩ ʋ joŋ kʋŋ a chu tɔ ʋ nyuŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ naga, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ ŋaa baala. Baala tʋla lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ, ka haala ma tʋla lɩɩ baala teeŋ,

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa haala lɛ dee Wɩa to a ŋaa baala, ama ʋ to baala lɛ nɛ a ŋaa haala.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Bɩra, Wɩa bɩ baala ŋaa a tɩŋ haala wɩaa, ama ʋ ŋaa haala nɛ a tɩŋ baala wɩaa.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ Wɩa tɩndaaraa wɩaa haala maga dɩ ʋ joŋ kʋŋ nɛ a vɔɔ tɔ ʋ nyuŋ a dagɛ arɩ ʋʋ to ʋ bala niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii lɛ, baala bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa tɩɩ, haala ma bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa tɩɩ, ba kala tɩɩ dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ to baala lɛ a ŋaa haala ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ haala ma lʋlʋl baala. Wɩa nɛ ŋaa ba kala.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Má tɩtɩa bɩɩnɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ woruŋ, a na dɩ haal nɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa lee-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii sɩɩ hilimu aŋ bɩ kʋŋ joŋo tɔ ʋ nyuŋ, ʋ zɔmɔ nɛɛ?

english_verse: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.
translation_verse: ama haala-na tʋɔŋ jaŋ wuo tɔrɛ a tɩŋ ʋ nyu-pʋŋ-duduosu-la wɩaa. Wɩa joŋ nyu-puŋ-duduosuŋ pɩ haala dɩ ʋ kaa tɔ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ saa chɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ kaalɛrɛ, mɩ jaŋ bʋl arɩ wɩɩ-la nɛ la tuto. Wɩɩ dɔŋ kala tuo. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi ma ka to ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ la dii kɩalɩŋ a liliisi Yesu wɩaa Mat.

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ dagɛma lɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ bɛsɛ ma lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa dɩ ma nɛ hilime dɩ ma chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, ma yie bɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ pɛ. Ma yie chichei dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ nɩa dɩ ma nɛ kʋ hilimi dɩ ma chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, ma bɩ nii-bala ka kɛŋ. Mɩ saa laa dii a nagɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ mʋa hɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ nɩa lɛ.

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: Ʋ paala magɛ dɩ nii-lɩɛbaa hɛ ma pɛgɛ nɛ, dɩ ma to ŋɩɩ lɛ a jɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa nɩtɩtɩɩba.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa, nʋʋkala yie didii ʋ kɩaa, ʋ bɩ ʋ dɔŋɔ ka gbɛrɛ. Dɔnsʋŋ yie kɛŋ losuŋ, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma bugi.

english_verse: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
translation_verse: Ka dɩ La Tɩɩna-na kɔ, má dii boroboro deeŋ aŋ nyʋnyʋa nyʋnyʋala deeŋ tʋɔŋ. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma dagʋ arɩ La Tɩɩna Kirisito sʋʋ ma wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ bene woruŋ arɩ boroboro-la ʋ sɩɩ dii ŋaa Kirisito yaraa nɛ, sɩ-huo-la ma ŋaa ʋ chalɩŋ, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa baŋŋaa hɛ ŋmɛnɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba sɩ dii boroboro-la dɛrɛ, ʋ bɩra joŋ nyʋnyʋala arɩ sɩnɩŋ aŋ bʋl, “Nyʋnyʋala deeŋ nɛ Wɩa joŋo hɩhɛ nii-falɩɩ-la ʋ dɩ ma pɛgɛ. Mɩ jaŋ sʋʋ dɩ mɩ chalɩŋ jaasɛ. Bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ ma nɩɩ nyʋaʋ, má nyʋa a liliisi mɩ wɩaa.”

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Kirisito teeŋ nɛ mɩ laa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma. Tɩtaŋ-la ba sɩ joŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu yallɛ nɛ, ʋ joŋ boroboro

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: a lɔllɛ Wɩa, aŋ kaa chɔgɛ aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ yaraa nɛ ŋ-la mɩ joŋo pɩma, má laa dii. Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ a liliisi mɩ wɩaa.”

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ dii boroboro-la koo a nyʋa nyʋnyʋala-la tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ sɩ bɩ maga, ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ La Tɩɩna yaraa arɩ ʋ chal-la joŋo arɩ ba ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ kɩaa.

english_verse: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala maga dɩ ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ a beŋ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ woruŋ aŋ-na dii boroboro-la, a nyʋa nyʋnyʋala-la tʋɔŋ ma.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: Ma dɔnsʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a bɩ ma tɩtɩa lɛ bene aŋ-na didii boroboro-la, aŋ pɛ nyʋa nyʋnyʋala-la tʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ wʋwɩɩlɛ ŋɩɩ, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma pʋgʋmɛ, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma sʋʋ.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ Wɩa nɛ na dɩ la cheye, ʋ yie dɔgɩsɛla nɛ a kɛnla tʋrɛ. Ʋ yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ la joŋo pɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa lɛ a cheila.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambiiriŋ, dɩ ma nɛ hilime dɩ ma dii kʋdiile-la La Tɩɩna sɩ sɩ la didii a liliisi ʋ wɩaa, má gbɛrɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Dɩ losuŋ nɛ kɛŋ ma dɔŋɔ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ dii kɩaa ʋ dɩa lɛ nɛ aŋ-na kɔ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ aŋ hilimi, Wɩa bɩ jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩma. Wʋkaanala-na, dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ, mɩ jaŋ dagɛma ba wombiiŋ.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Ma jɩma bʋa-la lɛ ma fa sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka chʋɔlɛ, ma faa to Sɩtaanɩ harɩŋ nɛ, a faa kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa ma. Vʋɩyaa deemba fa bɩ wɩaa wuo bʋbʋl. Ba leŋe ma yeŋŋi nɛ.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl wʋbɔŋ a tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl dɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa La Tɩɩna, see dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ joŋ kɩalɩŋ dii zile la lɛ, ba ŋaa dabaŋ dabaŋ nɛ, ama ba kala lɩɩ ʋ teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
translation_verse: La jaŋ wuo to wombii dabaŋ dabamba a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa, ama Wɩɩ-bala nɛ la tɩma pɩpa.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ joŋo dii zile la lɛ yie tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-dosunuŋ nɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ, ama Wɩa nɛ to ba lɛ a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩa-la kala.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala kɛŋ ʋ wɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ joŋo dii zile ʋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ kaa pɩpɛ ʋ naambiiriŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ yie joŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a pɩ nʋʋ ʋ wuo bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa. Ʋ yie joŋ wɩɩ pɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ ʋ wuo jɩŋ Wɩa wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ a wuo dɩdagɛba woruŋ.

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ yie ŋaa nʋʋ dɔŋ ma kɛŋ laa diiniŋ, ka dɔŋɔ ma kɛŋ doluŋ a ma wuo vɩvaarɛ nɩaa,

english_verse: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: ka dɔŋɔ ma kɛŋ doluŋ a kaa ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ, ka dɔŋɔ ma kɛŋ doluŋ a wuo bʋbʋl Wɩa wɩaa, ka dɔŋɔ ma bɩra kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ ʋ yie jɩŋ dɩnsɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ arɩ dɩnsɩ-la sɩ bɩ ʋ teeŋ lɩa pɛgɛ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ yie pɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ ma doluŋ ʋ wuo bʋbʋl wɩaa, yikoro-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ pɛ nɩaa lɛ ba bʋbʋl, ka ʋ pɩ dɔŋɔ ma wʋjɩmɩŋ ʋ wuo dagɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: Tɩntɩŋ-dosunuŋ deemba kala lɩɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la teeŋ nɛ. Ʋ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ to a joŋ kʋ-dosunuŋ deemba a pɩ nʋʋkala arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ cho.

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: La nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, la nagɛ ŋ-la nɛ. La yʋga nɛ, ama la ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la doluŋ lɛ nɛ ba fola Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa yosi arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩɩ ba tɩtɩa. Wɩa leŋe la laa ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a hɛ la tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine bɩ nandaa-bala kɛnɛ, ʋ nandaasɩŋ yʋga nɛ.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Dɩ nuhuobiine naaŋ nɛ bʋla arɩ ʋ sɩ bɩ nɩsɩŋ ŋaa, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ bɩ nuhuobiine nandaaŋ ŋaa, ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ nuhuobiine sɛmɛ dɔŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Dɩ nuhuobiine dɩgɩlɩŋ ma nɛ sɩ ʋ bɩ sɩɩŋ ŋaa, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ bɩ nuhuobiine yaraa sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ŋaa, ʋ ŋɩɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ nuhuobiine sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ŋaa.

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Dɩ nuhuobiine yaraa kala nɛ fa ŋaa sɩaa, ɛɛ nɛ nuhuobiine fa jaŋ ŋaa a nɩnɩɩ wɩaa? Dɩ nuhuobiine yaraa kala ma nɛ fa ŋaa dɩgɩlaa, ɛɛ nɛ ʋ fa jaŋ ŋaa a nɩnɩɩ sʋɔra?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa ŋaa nuhuobiine nandaa kala arɩ ʋ tɩntɩmɩɩ nɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ cho.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Dɩ nuhuobiine fa kɛŋ nandaa-bala, nɩɩ nɛ ʋ yara-la fa jaŋ hɛ?

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ, nuhuobiine nandaasɩŋ yʋga nɛ a mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a ŋaa yarɩ-bala.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa sɩaa bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩ nɩsɩŋ arɩ ʋ bɩ ʋ chɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nyuŋ ma bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩ naasɩŋ arɩ ʋ bɩ ba ka chɛ.

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ bene, la jaŋ na arɩ nuhuobiine bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ nandaasɩ-la sɩ bɩ chaasa ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ kɩaa nɛ tuo ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
translation_verse: La bɩɩna arɩ la nandaasɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ bɩ sɩɩfɩaŋ kɩaa ŋaa, ama ba nyuŋ nɛ la yie bibeŋ woruŋ. La bɩ nandaasɩ-la nɩaa sɩɩ na nyuŋ ka beŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ joŋ nuhuobiine nandaasɩ-la kala a mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a ŋaa ʋ bibeŋ ʋ nandaasɩ-la sɩ bɩ sɩɩfɩaŋ kɩaa ŋaa nyuŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: Wɩa ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ nuhuobiine yaraa ŋaa kʋbala nɛ a kala tɩma pɩpɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Dɩ nuhuobiine sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ nɩɩ wɩɩ, ʋ yaraa kala nɩɩ wɩɩ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ba nɛ bɩra bɛsɛ nuhuobiine sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, ʋ nandaasɩ-la kala lɛ nɛ ba bɛsɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Ma kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ma ŋaa Yesu yaraa nɛ, ma kʋŋkala nɛ pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a ŋaa yarɩ-bala.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɩaa kala bɩ Wɩa nanzɔɔba ŋaa, ba kala tuo Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa, koo nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ Wɩa wɩaa. Ba kala dee bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa wʋmagɩlaa.

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Ba kala dee bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ba vɩvaarɛ nɩaa. Ba kala dee bɩ yie bʋbʋl wɩaa yikori-yiriba-la, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ pɛ nɩaa lɛ ba bʋbʋl lɛ. Ba kala dee bɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ bʋla bʋbʋɔŋ ka dagɛ.

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má joŋ ma nyuŋ kala hɛ sɩɩfɩaŋ kɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ joŋo dii zile ma lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ dagɛma wombii-la sɩ kɩɩ wombiee kala dɩ ma tuto.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ wuo bʋbʋl yikoro-na kala a wuo bʋbʋl Wɩa tɩndaaraa ma yikoro, aŋ bɩ nɩaa cho, ʋ nagɛ bimbelimiŋ nɛ mɩ ŋmuŋmoo ŋɩɩ a ŋɩŋaa goŋ pɛɩ.

english_verse: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ nɛ pɩmɛ doluŋ dɩ mɩ wuo bʋbʋl Wɩa wɩaa, a wuo jɩŋ wʋfaalɩɩ kala bʋbʋɔŋ, a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ kala, aŋ pɛ laa Wɩa dii a jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ peelee churo mʋmʋ leree dɔnsʋŋ, aŋ bɩ nɩaa cho, ʋ ŋaa wʋpɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ joŋ mɩ kɩaa kala a pɩ summoo, a joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa a pɩ nɩaa dɩ ba nyɩgɛ nyiniŋ dɩ ʋ diimi kpʋ, aŋ bɩ nɩaa cho, ʋ bɩ nyʋʋrɩ kala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Chonuŋ-na bɩ dɛrɛ. Dol-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ joŋo pɩla la wuo bʋbʋl Wɩa wɩaa, a wuo bʋbʋl yikori dosunuŋ kala a pɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ ma lɛ, ba kala jaŋ lɛl.

english_verse: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩɩ-la la sɩ kɛnɛ, arɩ dol-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ joŋo pɩla la bʋbʋl Wɩa wɩaa bɩ suo.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ kʋ-la sɩ ŋaa kʋ-piliŋ nɛ kɔ, kʋ-la sɩ gbɔbɔ jaŋ lɛl.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩ ŋaa hambie, mɩ bʋl hambii wɩaa nɛ, a bɩɩnɛ wɩaa ma a nagɛ hambie, a fa ŋɩŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ hambie. Ama mɩ sɩ kʋ waa dɛrɛ, mɩ joŋ hambii wɩalɩŋ ta nɛ.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ la sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, ʋ naga laa beŋ Kirisito liigu liigu nɛ, a nagɛ nɩaa sɩ beŋ beenantɩrɛ lɛ a na kʋa liigu. La bɩ Kirisito chaasa nɩna woruŋ, ama maachie la sɩaa jaŋ na dɔŋɔ. Lɛɛlɛ mɩ jɩmʋ mʋa nɛ, ama maachie mɩ jaŋ chaasa jɩmʋ woruŋ, arɩ Wɩa sɩ jɩmmɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ-na wɩɩ-la dɩdɛrɩŋ, wɩaa batori nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩa laa diiniŋ, yɩɛlaa arɩ chonuŋ. Ama wɩaa deemba batorumuŋ tʋɔŋ ba sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩŋ nɛ, chonuŋ.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ bʋl wɩaa yikoro-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ pɛ nɩaa lɛ ba bʋbʋl, ʋ tɩɩna bʋl wɩalɩŋ a pɩpɩ Wɩa nɛ, nuhuobiine dee. Ʋ sɩɩ bʋl yikoro-la nʋʋkala bɩ nɩɩ, ama Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ wuo bʋbʋl wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ deemba.

english_verse: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ bʋl wɩaa yikoro-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ pɛ nɩaa lɛ ba bʋbʋl, ʋ tɩɩna bʋla pɩpɛ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa ka pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hihilimi lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ ma teeŋ a bʋbʋl wɩaa yikoro-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ pɛ nɩaa lɛ ba bʋbʋl, ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa a pɛ ma lɛ? Mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ ma lɛ, see dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo dagɛmɛ a pɩma, koo dɩ mɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ a kaa kʋ dagɛma Wɩa doluŋ lɛ, koo dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋl wɩaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ, koo dɩ mɩ joŋ Wɩa wɩɩ dɔŋ a dagɛma ʋ doluŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If all musical instruments sounded alike, how would you know the difference between a flute and a harp?
translation_verse: Dɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa gbigbieli, ŋmʋlʋŋ arɩ cheŋ, dɩ ba nɛ bɩ woruŋ du hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, kɩalɩŋ bɩ dɩgɩlɩŋ ka kɛŋ.

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɩɩ du pampam tʋa, dɩ ba nɛ bɩ ʋ dunuŋ duo, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ arɩ wɩɩ nɛ ŋaa ba yɩyɩrɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ nagɛ, dɩ ŋ nɛ bʋl wɩɩ nɩaa sɩ bɩ nɩɩ, ɛɛ nɛ ba jaŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ bʋl bʋbʋɔŋ? Ŋ jaŋ ta ŋɩŋaa goŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ bʋl wɩaa yikoro-la lɛ mɩ sɩ bɩ nɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ nagɛ nʋhʋɔrʋ ʋ teeŋ, ka nɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ ma nagɛ nʋhʋɔrʋ mɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa yikoro-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ pɛ nɩaa lɛ ba bʋbʋl, ʋ tɩɩna maga dɩ ʋ sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ wuo leŋ dɩ ʋ wuo dɩdagɛ wɩalɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ ma nɛ.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa yikoro-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ pɛ nɩaa lɛ ba bʋbʋl lɛ, mɩ dɩma nɛ yie chʋchʋɔlɛ, ama mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛ mɩ bɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ bʋl bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Wʋbɛɛ nɛ saa maga dɩ mɩ ŋaa? Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ dɩma arɩ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala kaa chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa, aŋ kɛŋ ba kala ma kaa yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa.

english_verse: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kʋ hilimi, aŋ ka dɩ nʋʋ kɛŋ yikoro-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ pɛ nɩaa lɛ ba bʋbʋl a dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ nɩmɛ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ bʋl nɩa, dɩ ŋ nɛ chʋɔla dɛrɛ, ɛɛ nɛ ba jaŋ ŋaa jɩŋ wɩɩ-la bʋbʋɔŋ a bʋl Amɩɩ?

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ lɔllɛ Wɩa arɩ mɩ sɩ wuo bʋbʋl wɩaa yikoro-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ pɛ nɩaa lɛ ba bʋbʋl a kɩɩ ma kʋŋkala.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: Ama dɩ la nɛ kʋ hilimi a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa, mɩ jaŋ cho dɩ mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa bʋl wɩaa baŋmɛnɛ dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ, a kɩɩ mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩaa yʋgɛ yikoro-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ nɩɩ lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, má sɩ́ wɩaa bɩɩnʋ a nagɛ hambiisiŋ sɩɩ bɩɩnɛ ŋɩɩ. Ma wʋŋaalaa lɛ, má nagɛ bii-mulluŋ sɩ bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ jɩŋ, ama má bɩbɩɩnɛ wɩaa a nagɛ kʋhɩasɩŋ sɩɩ bɩɩnɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩ ʋ jaŋ to nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl yikori-tanɩa arɩ nʋhʋɔraa lɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩ ʋ nɩaa, arɩ ŋɩɩ ma kala ba bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɛ kʋ hilimi, dɩ ba kʋŋkala bʋbʋl wɩaa yikoro-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ pɛ ba lɛ ba bʋbʋl, dɩ nɩwogusuŋ koo nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii nɛ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ, ba jaŋ bɩɩnɛ arɩ ma nyuŋ tuo.

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma kala nɛ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ, dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii koo dɩ nɩwogo nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, ʋ jaŋ sɛnɛ jɩŋ arɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bʋla jaŋ jʋʋ-ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ na arɩ ʋ cheye nɛ.

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jaŋ tuu kpirimi Wɩa sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlʋ, a bʋl arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, Wɩa hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ. Wombii-la sɩ maga dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii to chʋɔlɛ Wɩa

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ bʋla, ba bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ ma nɛ kʋ hilimi-na kala, dɩ dɔŋɔ nɛ kɛŋ yɩɩlɩŋ dɩ ʋ yɩɩ, dɩ dɔŋɔ ma kɛŋ wɩɩ dɩ ʋ dagɛ nɩaa, koo nʋʋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo dagʋ ʋ doluŋ lɛ, dɔŋɔ maa chɛ dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩaa yikoro-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ pɛ nɩaa lɛ ba bʋbʋl, dɔŋɔ maa chɛ dɩ ʋ dagɛ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla bʋbʋɔŋ, má maga ma ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala a pɩpɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba bʋl wɩaa yikoro-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ pɛ nɩaa lɛ ba bʋbʋl lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba ŋaa balɩa koo batori a bʋl kʋŋ kʋŋ, ka dɩ nʋʋ ma hɛ nɩmɛ aa dagɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ joŋ wɩɩ dagɛ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hilime tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ bʋla pɩma, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa maga ʋ tɔrɛ ʋ niiŋ ka dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Ma kala jaŋ wuo bʋl Wɩa wɩaa, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la doluŋ lɛ, kʋŋ kʋŋ a dagɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ma nyuŋ nyaasɛ.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa, ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ maga dɩ ʋ wuo kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl lɛ,

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa bɩ chɛ dɩ maa ŋaa wɩaa vʋgʋma vʋgʋma, ama ʋʋ chɛ dɩ la wɩaa vɩvɛŋ woruŋ nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi tʋɔŋ lee-na kala,

english_verse: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
translation_verse: ʋ bɩ maga dɩ haalaa bʋbʋl wɩaa. Ʋ maga dɩ ba tɔrɛ ba niiŋ aŋ tuto baalaa niiŋ nɛ, arɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ ba tuto sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩɩ ma nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a maga dɩ ba jɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba pɩɛsɛ ba balaba nɛ dɩa lɛ. Ʋ ŋaa hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ dɩ Wɩa nɩaa nɛ hilime, dɩ haalaa bʋl wɩaa hɩhɛ.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Ma lɛ nɛ Wɩa wɩaa suomi? Koo ma dʋndʋŋa nɛ ba bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pa?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩɩna arɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ koo dɩ ʋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ joŋo dii zile la lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tɩɩna jɩŋ arɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ sɛɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, má yʋ ʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma ŋaa wɩɩkala ʋ bʋa lɛ, dɩ ʋ ŋaa dee dee.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ liisima a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma. Ma laaba dii nɛ a chɩŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la nɛ jaŋ laama ta, dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma woruŋ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ nagɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ nɩa, ba nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩma. Wɩalɩŋ wʋnyuŋ nɛ ŋ-la, arɩ Yesu sʋʋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ, arɩ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, ba joŋu hugi, ka ʋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ, arɩ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ ʋ harɩ-tooroo zɔɔ-banɔŋ arɩ daŋɩa bʋa bala lɛ. Nɩaa deemba dɔnsʋŋ ha hɛ ba mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma sʋʋ.

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ Jeems, a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ ʋ nanzɔɔba-la kala ma.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Ba kala harɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ mɩ ma. Mɩ-na paala nagɛ nɩɩ-la ba sɩ lʋla, aŋ ka ʋ lʋlʋŋ ha bɩ yie nɛ.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Yesu nanzɔɔba-la kala, mɩ nɛ paala ŋaa ba tʋɔŋ kʋbie. Ʋ paala bɩ maga dɩ ba kɛmmɛ kaa yɩrɛ Wɩa nanzɔɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ to naasɩŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi nɛ.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa dii zile mɩ lɛ woruŋ. Ʋ nɛ leŋe mɩ ŋaa nʋʋ lɛɛlɛ, ʋ zile ma bɩ pɛɩ ŋaa, ama mɩ nɛ faasa tɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ, a kɩɩ ba kala. Mɩ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ dee mɩ wuo tɩtɩŋ, ama Wɩa dol-la ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ nɛ tɩɩ.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ nɛ, Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la la sɩɩ bʋl. Wʋzɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ bʋl, ba nɛ mɩ ma bʋbʋl, ba nɛ ma laa dii. Ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ chɩsɛ nɩaa sʋʋŋ lɛ

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ bʋl Kirisito wɩaa arɩ ʋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ sɩ dɩ nuhuobiinee bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ aŋ bɩra sii sʋʋŋ lɛ?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa nɛ bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ aŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ-na Kirisito bɩ sʋʋŋ lɛ sie.

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: Dɩ Kirisito nɛ bɩ sʋʋŋ lɛ sie, wɩɩ-la la sɩ bʋla pɩma ŋaa wʋpɛɩba nɛ, ma sɩ laa wɩalɩŋ dii ma ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ saa jaŋ nagɛ arɩ la nyɩɛ wɩaa pɩpɩ Wɩa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la bʋla arɩ ʋ chɩsɛ Kirisito sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ. Dɩ nɩaa nɛ bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ aŋ wuo sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ-na Wɩa bɩ Kirisito chɩsa.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ bɩ jaŋ chɩsɛ nɩaa sʋʋŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ-na ʋ bɩ Kirisito ma chɩsa sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ bɩ Kirisito chɩsa sʋʋŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ-na wɩɩ-la ma sɩ laa dii ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ, ma ha hɛ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ saa jaŋ dagɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aŋ sʋʋ ma lɛlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Dɩ la yɩɛlaa sɩ hɛ Kirisito lɛ jaŋ dɛrɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ-na la wɩɩŋ kɛŋ nenige kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ a kɩɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala.

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Ama wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, Wɩa chɩsɛ Kirisito sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ daga arɩ nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ chɩsɛ sʋʋŋ lɛ, Kirisito nɛ nɩɩ-la Wɩa laa sɩpaaŋ chɩsɛ sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Nɩbala lɛ nɛ sʋʋŋ to jʋʋ dʋnɩa. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩbala ma lɛ nɛ nɩaa jaŋ to a sii sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
translation_verse: Adam wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ nɩaa sʋsʋʋ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ a tɩŋ Kirisito ma wɩaa, nɩaa jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Ama la kala kɛŋ bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ chɩsɛla sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ. Kirisito nɛ Wɩa laa sɩpaaŋ chɩsɛ sʋʋŋ lɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ mɩɩra kɔ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa ʋ nɩaa, Wɩa jaŋ chɩsɛ ba ma sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ jaŋ yi. Kirisito jaŋ yuo dii kɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ dii doluŋ dʋnɩa lɛ arɩ dol-bɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, aŋ joŋ kuorii-la a hɛ ʋ Nyɩmma Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
translation_verse: Ama ʋ maga dɩ Kirisito dii kuoruŋ, aŋ-na yuo dii ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala, a kɛmba nyaga bil ʋ naasɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Ʋ dʋndɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ to harɩŋ yuo dii nɛ ŋaa sʋʋŋ.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla arɩ Wɩa joŋ kʋŋkala a hɛ Kirisito nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ bʋla Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ Wɩa joŋ kʋŋkala a hɛ Kirisito nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ bɩ naga arɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa ma hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ joŋ kʋŋkala a hɛ Kirisito nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ, Kirisito ma jaŋ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ kʋŋkala hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ Wɩa kɛŋ kʋŋkala doluŋ.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa nɛ sʋba aŋ bɩ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩaa yie chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba nyuŋ lɛ a ŋaa ba foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ? Dɩ sʋʋŋ lɛ siiniŋ nɛ paala tuo, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩaa yie chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba nyuŋ lɛ ba foba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ?

english_verse: And why do we always risk our lives
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ la nɩna hɛɛŋ bʋa na-kala lɛ?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, bʋa na-kala lɛ mɩ dɩ sʋʋŋ ka loo nɛ. La kala sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ wuo bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa.

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Má sii doŋ lɛ aŋ leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ. Ma dɔnsʋŋ wʋŋaalaa naga arɩ ma bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ, mɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmma nɛ. Yarɩ-zɔmɔ-la la sɩ kaa sii sʋʋŋ lɛ

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Nɩa dɔŋɔ jaŋ pɩɛsɛ, dɩ ɛɛ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba jaŋ wuo ŋaa a sii sʋʋŋ lɛ? Dɩ yarɩ bɛɛba nɛ ba jaŋ kɛŋ?

english_verse: Wheat seeds and all other seeds look different from the sprouts that come up.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ kuorimiiŋ koo mɩɩ-biiŋ a duu, nyʋʋlɩɩ-la bɩ bii-la ŋ sɩ joŋo duu wuo nagɛ.

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ yie leŋ kʋdoho-la nyʋ a nagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ. Kʋdoho na-kala yie nyʋ a nagɛ ʋ nagɩsɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ba nammɩa bɩ kʋbala ŋaa. Nuhuobiinee arɩ pʋsʋŋ arɩ diibiisiŋ arɩ chenfilee nammɩa bɩ kʋbala ŋaa.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ nagɩsɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ nagɩsɩŋ, ba zɔmʋŋ bɩ dɔŋɔ naga. Wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa kɛŋ ba tʋla nɛ, tinteeŋ kɩaa ma kɛŋ ba tʋla.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ kɛŋ ʋ pʋlʋmʋŋ nɛ, chɛnɛ ma kɛŋ ʋ pʋlʋmʋŋ, ka chɛnwʋlaa ma kɛŋ ba pʋlʋmʋŋ. Chɛnwʋlaa ma tʋɔŋ, dɔnsʋŋ ma pʋlla nɛ a kɩɩ dɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ nagɛ dɩ nɩaa nɛ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ. Yara-la ba sɩ joŋo hugi jaŋ pʋa, yara-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ kaa sii sʋʋŋ lɛ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ pʋa.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba ŋmʋnsa, “Nuhuobiiŋ-la Wɩa sɩ bumo ŋaa yɩrɩŋ nɛ Adam. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wiese hɛ ʋ lɛ ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.” Adam-la sɩ to harɩŋ kɔ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa wiese-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ naga Wɩa wiese-la ʋ sɩ joŋo hɛ la lɛ nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ kɔ, ama yara-la la sɩ kɛnɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ kɔ, ka Wɩa wiese-la ʋ sɩ joŋo hɛ la lɛ ma to harɩŋ kɔ.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiiŋ bumbuŋ-la, dʋnɩa tɩarɩŋ nɛ Wɩa lɔgɛ mɛʋ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ to harɩŋ kɔ-na lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ lɔgɛ tɩarɩŋ a mɛ Adam ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ lɩɩ Adam lɛ ŋaa tɩarɩŋ. Kirisito sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kʋ tuu ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ lɩɩ ʋ lɛ ma nagɛ ʋ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: La sɩ kɛŋ nɩɩ-la ba sɩ kɛŋ tɩarɩŋ mɛ nagɩsɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ la jaŋ kɛŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ ma nagɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: Yara-la ba sɩ kɛŋ tɩarɩŋ mɛ bɩ jaŋ wuo hɛ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ. Yara-la ma sɩɩ pʋa bɩ jaŋ wuo hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ a nagɛ yara-la sɩ bɩ pʋa.

english_verse: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
translation_verse: Má jegile nɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ bʋl wʋkpuŋkpere pɩma. La kala bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ. Ama bʋa kʋbala jaŋ kɔ dɩ Wɩa kɛŋ la yaraa kala bɩrɩmɛ.

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ guu ŋaa a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ lɩgɩsa. Dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, Wɩa tɩndaara jaŋ ŋmʋʋ ʋ nyile. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋmʋʋ nyile-la, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aŋ sʋʋ jaŋ sii a wei. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ. La nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ la mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ lɛ aŋ bɩ sʋba ma, Wɩa jaŋ kɛŋ la yaraa bɩrɩmɛ dɩ ba sɩ pʋa.

english_verse: Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ kɛŋ yara-la sɩɩ pʋa kaa bɩrɩmɛ dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ pʋa. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ la yara-la ma sɩɩ sʋʋ, ʋ jaŋ kɛmba kaa bɩrɩmɛ, dɩ ba sɩ́ sʋʋ.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Dɩ la yara-la sɩɩ pʋa nɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa dɩ ba bɩra bɩ pʋa, dɩ la yara-la ma sɩɩ sʋʋ bɩra bɩ sʋʋ, ŋɩɩ daga arɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ sɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ba bʋla, “La yuo dii sʋʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Sʋʋŋ huoŋ nɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ. Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma doluŋ lɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo bil la lɛ dɩ la tuto lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Ama má leŋ la lɔllɛ la Nyɩmma Wɩa, ʋ sɩ to La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ a pɩla doluŋ la wuo yuo dii sʋʋŋ.

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambiiriŋ, má chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ kʋŋkala kɛmma begili. Má fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a tɩŋ La Tɩɩna tɩntɩŋŋaa woruŋ. Ma jɩma arɩ Wɩa tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ tɩŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ ŋaa pɛɩ.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Lahadi chɛɛ na-kala, moribie-la ma kʋŋkala sɩ tɩma a na yɔbɔ-la tʋɔŋ, nʋʋkala lɩɩsɛ magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋo bil, a bil. Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ, ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɩkɩɛsɛ moribiee.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ, mɩ jaŋ ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ lɩɩsa, dɩ ba pɛ kɛŋ ba dɩ ma moribie-la ma sɩ kɩɛsa mʋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ maga dɩ mɩ ma mʋ, la kala jaŋ to dɔŋɔ mʋ. Wɩalɩŋ Pɔɔl sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ to Masidoonia tinteeŋ nɛ a mʋ lee. Dɩ mɩ nɛ kʋ to lee-la, mɩ jaŋ kʋ nama.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ kʋ hɛ ma teeŋ a dieni mʋa, kapo, mɩ jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ dɩ waarɩŋ chɛnsɩŋ dɛrɛ, dɩ ma pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ mɩ vɛŋ mɩ wombiiŋ, lee-la kala mɩ sɩɩ mʋ.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ nama aŋ parɩma kieli. Dɩ Wɩa nɛ sɛyɛ, mɩ cho dɩ mɩ dieni nɛ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: Wɩa pɩmɛ wombii-bal nɛ dɩ mɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ zɔŋ daha, ka nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa daha yʋgɛ.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Dɩ Timoti nɛ kɔ ma teeŋ, má kɛnʋ woruŋ, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ wɩɩkala fá. Mɩ dɩ ʋ kala nɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩmɩa-la.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala bee gʋʋnʋ. Má pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ vɛŋ wombiiŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa, aŋ mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ. Mɩɩ gbɛrɛ ʋ dɩ la naambiiri-la nɛ dɩ ba mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: Ma jɩŋ la naambie ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Apɔlɔs nɛ. Mɩ bʋla pʋ woruŋ arɩ ʋ dɩ la naambiiri-la kʋ nama. Ama ʋ bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kaa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ kɔ lɛɛlɛ. Ama dɩ ʋ na wombiiŋ, ʋ jaŋ kɔ. Wʋkaanaa

english_verse: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
translation_verse: Má pɔ, a chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ. Má kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ a kɛŋ doluŋ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
translation_verse: Wɩɩkala ma sɩɩ ŋaa, má ŋaa arɩ chonuŋ.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, ma jɩŋ baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩtɛfanas nɛ. Ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii Akaaya tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba pɛ Wɩa nɩaa lɛ nɛ woruŋ, a joŋ ba tɩtɩa kala a hɛ ŋɩɩ lɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlma, mɩ naambiiri,

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: dɩ ma tuto nɩdosunuŋ deemba niiŋ. Má tuto Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ-na kala niiŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɛ la lɛ la tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ woruŋ arɩ Sɩtɛfanas arɩ Fɔtʋnaatʋs arɩ Akaakɩs sɩ kɔ mɩ teeŋ. Ba nɛ laa ma nyuŋ daha.

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: Ba leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ. Ba jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma ma tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala. Ʋ maga dɩ ma zizil nɩdosunuŋ deemba nɛ.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi a hɛ Esia tinteeŋ lɛ, ba kala ka chʋɔlɛma. Baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Akuila arɩ ʋ haala Pɩrɩsɩla, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi ba dɩa lɛ, baa chʋɔlɛma woruŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii a hɛ daha maa chʋɔlɛma. Má guori dɔŋɔ aŋ chʋɔlɛ dɔŋɔ kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, mɩ-na Pɔɔl, mɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋmʋnsa aa chʋɔlɛma.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bɩ La Tɩɩna Kirisito cho, Wɩa jaŋ kalɩba hɛ ʋ lɛ. Maranaata! Ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, La Tɩɩna Kirisito kɔ!

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Yesu Kirisito yɩrɩŋ lɛ, mɩ cho ma kala nɛ. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl arɩ la naambie Timoti nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩma. Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Kirisito Yesu nanzɔɔ. La ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi a hɛ Kɔrɩntɩ taŋ-la lɛ nɛ, arɩ Wɩa nɩaa sɩ hɛ Akaaya tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ.

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la dɛnnɛ Wɩa. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito Nyɩmma, aa fá nɩaa nenige. Ʋ nɛ yie leŋ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ sɩ cheye tʋɔŋ bɩra tɔrɛ.

english_verse: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
translation_verse: Kirisito na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ. Hɛɛ-la ʋ fa sɩ na, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ la ma nɩna. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la ma kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋ-la ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɩɩ na hɛɛŋ, ma pɛnɩŋ arɩ ma laatanɩŋ wɩaa nɛ. Dɩ la nɛ na pɛnɩŋ, ma ma jaŋ na pɛnɛ-la doho tɩtɩa, dɩ ma nɛ wuo kɛŋ kenyiri a na hɛɛ-la doho la sɩɩ na.
