english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: La kɛŋ yɩɛlaa nɛ ma lɛ. La yɩɛla-la saa bɩ begili. La jɩma arɩ hɛɛ-la la sɩ na, ma ma na ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ tʋɔtɔrʋ-la la sɩ kɛnɛ, ma ma kɛnʋ nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: La naambiiriŋ, laa chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ la sɩ na hɛɛŋ Esia tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ sɩ jʋʋla lɛ fa yuŋŋie nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a pɩla. La paala bɩ bɩɩna arɩ la jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, la fa bɩɩna arɩ la sʋba dɛrɛ nɛ. Ama ŋɩɩ pɛ la lɛ dɩ la sɩ́ la tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ beŋ, ama dɩ la joŋ la yɩɛlaa kala a hɛ Wɩa lɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ chɩsɛ nɩaa sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛla sʋʋŋ deeŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Maachie dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋla lɛ, ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsɛla ba lɛ. Ʋ lɛ nɛ laa yɩɛlɛ arɩ maachie ʋ jaŋ bɩra lɩɩsɛla dɩ hɛɛŋ nɛ jʋʋla.

english_verse: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
translation_verse: Má ma pɛ sʋl Wɩa pɩla. Nɩaa yʋga nɛ a sʋl Wɩa a pɩpɩla dɩ ʋ pɛ la lɛ. Dɩ Wɩa nɛ laa ba Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, ba kala jaŋ wuo dɛnnʋ. Pɔɔl kɛŋ ʋ wɩaa bɩrɩmɛ

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ la jaŋ wuo bigisi la tɩtɩa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la tʋɔbɩɩnaa daga arɩ la wʋŋaalaa kala zɔmɔ nʋʋkala teeŋ nɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Wɩɩkala la sɩ ŋaa ma teeŋ, la ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Wɩa wombiiŋ nɛ aŋ pɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ. Nuhuobiine wʋjɩmɩŋ lɛ dee la to a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ, ama Wɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ la ŋaaba.

english_verse: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
translation_verse: La bɩ wʋtanɩɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩma, ama wɩalɩŋ la sɩ ŋmʋnsa, ma jaŋ wuo karɩmɛ, a jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ maa. La saa laa dii

english_verse: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
translation_verse: arɩ ma sɩ jɩmba mʋa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ kʋ jɩmba a mʋ dɛrɛ, dɩ ma wuo bigisi la lɛ arɩ la sɩ jaŋ bigisi ma lɛ ŋɩɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ chaasa jɩŋ ŋ-la wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ faa chɛ dɩ mɩ kɔ ma teeŋ, dɩ ma wuo nɩɩ sɩma bʋlɩa.

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: Mɩ faa chɛ mɩ kʋ to ma leriŋ a nama, aŋ-na mʋ Masidoonia tinteeŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ fa bɩra lɩɩ Masidoonia kʋkɔ, dɩ mɩ bɩra kʋ to ma teeŋ, dɩ ma pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ mɩ mʋ Judiya tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ bɩɩnɛ aŋ-na ŋaa? Ma bɩra bɩɩna mɩɩ ŋaa mɩ wɩaa arɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛɛ, dɩ mɩ sɛɩ wɩɩŋ aŋ bɩra bʋl mɩ bɩ wɩɩ-la sɛyɛ naabʋɔsʋ-la tɩtɩa lɛɛ?

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Ma jɩma woruŋ arɩ Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ bʋla pɩma ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, la bɩ niiriŋ balɩa ka bʋl.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Ma bɩra jɩma arɩ mɩ-na Pɔɔl, mɩ dɩ la naambiiriŋ Sɩlɩvaanʋs arɩ Timoti nɛ bʋl Wɩa Bie Yesu Kirisito wɩaa pɩma. Yesu wɩɩ-wɩɩkala ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ niiriŋ balɩa ka bʋl.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩtɩa nɛ leŋe la dɩ ma kala chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ Kirisito lɛ. Ʋ nɛ lɩɩsɛla,

english_verse: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
translation_verse: a joŋ ʋ magɩlɩŋ hɛ la lɛ a tɩɩla. Ʋ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a hɛ la lɛ nɛ, dɩ la wuo jɩŋ arɩ maachie ʋ jaŋ joŋ kʋ-daŋ ma pɩla.

english_verse: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
translation_verse: Arɩ Wɩa, wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Mɩ bɩ ma teeŋ kɔ Kɔrɩntɩ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ fa bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ walɩmɛma.

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: La bɩ chɛ dɩ la fʋgɛma dɩ ma laa wɩalɩŋ la sɩ bʋla dii, ama laa chɛ dɩ la dɩ ma tɩŋ nɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɛ a chɩmba lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɩ ma teeŋ kɔ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa kɔ, ma tʋɔŋ fa jaŋ chei.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa dɩ ma tʋɔŋ chei, kʋbɛɛ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ? Nʋʋkala tuo, see nɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa mɩ sɩ ŋaa ba tʋɔŋ chei.

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teŋ-la pɩma. Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kɔ ma teeŋ dɩ ma leŋ dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ chei, ma nɛ sɩ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Mɩ laa dii arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɔ, ma ma kala tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teŋ-la dɩ mɩ pɩma, mɩ tʋɔŋ faasa chei nɛ woruŋ, mɩ nɩna hɛɛŋ, mɩ yel kɩŋkɛŋ ma wɩaa. Mɩ bɩ teŋ-la ŋmʋnsa dɩ mɩ chei ma tʋɔŋ, ama dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ mɩ faasa choma nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ la joŋo chɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wɩɩ chei

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa ma tʋɔŋ chei, mɩ dʋndʋŋa lɛ dee wɩɩ-la jʋʋ, ʋ paala jʋʋ ma lɛ a kɩɩmɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ paala bɩ ma kala lɛ jʋa ma, ʋ jʋʋ ma dɔnsʋŋ lɛ nɛ. Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la a kieli.

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jesiŋ kala dɔgɩsʋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa má leŋ wɩɩ-la ta.

english_verse: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ-na ʋ maga dɩ ma joŋ wɩɩ-la kala chɛʋ, a pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ faasa chei a kieli dɩ ʋ pʋgʋmɛ.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩɩ sʋlma dɩ ma wasa kɛnʋ woruŋ a chou.

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ pɩma, dɩ mɩ na dɩ ma jaŋ wuo to wɩɩkala mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma.

english_verse: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ joŋ wɩɩ chɛ nʋʋ, mɩ ma joŋo chɛʋ nɛ, dɩ mɩ nɛ fa maga dɩ mɩ joŋ wɩɩ chɛ nʋʋ, mɩ joŋo chɛʋ nɛ, a tɩŋ ma wɩaa. Kirisito sɩpaaŋ nɛ mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa

english_verse: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
translation_verse: mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ Sɩtaanɩ wuola. La jɩŋ ʋ wʋkɛnɩŋ nɛ. Pɔɔl tʋɔŋ bɩ dɩ-bala pɩna Tʋrɔwas tinteeŋ

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ kɔ Tʋrɔwas tinteeŋ dɩ mɩ bʋl Kirisito wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩba, La Tɩɩna suri wombiiŋ pɩmɛ nɛ,

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: ama mɩ tʋɔŋ bɩ dɩ-bala pɩna, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ naambie Taatɩs fa tuo nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sii lee-la a mʋ Masidoonia tinteeŋ. Kirisito doluŋ lɛ la yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Ama, mɩ haa lɔllɛ Wɩa nɛ. Bʋa na-kala, ʋ yie to Kirisito lɛ nɛ a pɛ la lɛ la wuo yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ. Ʋ yie pɛ la lɛ la wuo bʋl Kirisito wɩaa lee-na kala. Kirisito wʋzɔmɔ-la nagɛ tʋlaalɩɩ sɩɩ sʋɔrʋ nɛ, a sʋɔra laa leriŋ kala.

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yʋga nɛ a gɔllɔ bʋbʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa a lɩlaa moribiee, ama la-na bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa. La-na ŋaa nɩtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛla dɩ la tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ. Kirisito doluŋ lɛ nɛ laa bʋl Wɩa wɩaa.

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: Ma-na, ma nɛ saa ŋaa teŋ-la la sɩ ŋmʋnsa, dɩ nɩaa karɩmɛ a jɩŋ ŋɩɩ la sɩ naga. La ŋmʋnsa hɛ la tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ saa chaasa dagɛ arɩ ma ŋaa teŋ-la Kirisito sɩ leŋe la ŋmʋnsɛ. Teniŋ deeŋ, ʋ bɩ naga kʋ-la nɩaa sɩ kaa ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ nɛ. Wɩa sɩ weye joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ nɛ a kaa ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ. Ba saa bɩra bɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ tabɩɩ-taala lɛ, ama ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ nuhuobiinee tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: La to Kirisito lɛ nɛ a laa Wɩa dii, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a bʋbʋl ʋ wɩaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ bɩ naga arɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la la sɩɩ tɩŋ, la tɩtɩa kɛŋ ʋ doluŋ nɛ. Wɩa nɛ pɩla doluŋ la tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩtɩa nɛ pɩla doluŋ la ŋaa nii-faalɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ hɛ pɩ nuhuobiinee tɩntɩnnaa. Nii-la bɩ naga ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil a tuto, ama nii-falɩɩ-la doluŋ lɩɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ wɩalɩŋ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto bɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ wuo pa, ama Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ lɩɩ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la teeŋ nɩɩ pa mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ tabɩɩ-taala lɛ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ fa bɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ wuo pa. Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ jomba pɩpɩ Mosis, ʋ tʋla fa chaana hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis sɩaa kala tʋtʋl, Iziral tɩŋŋaa bɩ ʋ sɩaa lɛ wuo beŋ. Ama tʋla-la fa jaŋ lɛl,

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: ka Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ lɛ, ba tʋla kɩkɩɩ ŋɩɩ. Ba-na bɩ jaŋ lɛl.

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩpɩ nɩaa aŋ ha kɛŋ tʋla, ŋɩɩ-na wɩalɩŋ sɩ leŋe nɩaa kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa teeŋ jaŋ paala kɛŋ tʋla a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ-na bumbuŋ kʋ-la fa sɩɩ tʋl bɩra bɩ tʋla kɛnɛ. Ʋ tʋla-la lɛlɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa kʋŋ dɔŋ nɩɩ tʋl lɛɛlɛ a kɩɩʋ.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Dɩ kʋ-la fa sɩ bɩ jaŋ dieni nɛ kɔ a tʋtʋl, ŋɩɩ-na kʋ-la sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ nɛ jaŋ tʋla kɩkɩɩʋ.

english_verse: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
translation_verse: Laa yɩɛlɛ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la chaasa kɛŋ nyuduoŋ aa tɩŋ.

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: Ama la bɩ Mosis naga, nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ kʋa tɔ ʋ sɩaa dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ tʋla-la fa sɩ hɛ ʋ sɩaa lɛ wuo beŋ. Tʋla-la fa ŋaa kʋŋ sɩɩ lɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩrɩma a to La Tɩɩna Yesu, Wɩa jaŋ kɛŋ kʋ-la sɩ kɛrɛ ba wʋjɩmɩŋ kaa dʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Kirisito arɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Lee-la kala saa La Tɩɩna Kirisito Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ hɛ, ʋ yie laa nɩalɩŋ ta nɛ.

english_verse: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
translation_verse: La nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, kʋ-la fa sɩ tɔ la sɩaa, Wɩa kaa suri nɛ. Kirisito tʋla jʋʋ la sɩaa nɛ la tʋtʋl arɩ ʋ sɩɩ tʋl ŋɩɩ. Ʋ kɛnla kaa bɩbɩrɩmɛ nɛ dɩ la wasa tʋtʋl, a kʋ nagʋ. La Tɩɩna Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ la lɛ.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ fá la nenige a joŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ pɩla dɩ la tɩtɩŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa la nandaasɩŋ bɩ yʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: Hɩɩsɩ wɩalɩŋ arɩ wʋkaa-faalɩɩ-la nɩaa sɩ lʋara ŋɩŋaa, la-na vɩaba ta nɛ faafaa kala. La bɩra bɩ nʋʋ nyɩsɛ. La bɩ wɩaa nyɩɛ pɩpɛ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ lɛ. Ama Wɩa sɩpaaŋ la chaasa bʋl wɩaa, dɩ nʋʋkala tʋɔbɩɩnaa jɩŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ la bʋbʋl.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la la sɩɩ bʋl nɛ faa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɛlɛ teeŋ nɛ ba faa.

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba Sɩtaanɩ nɛ tɔ ba wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ ba sɩ́ wuo na Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la pʋlʋmʋŋ. Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la nɩɩ dagɛ Kirisito tʋla, Nɩɩ-la sɩ nagɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ bʋl, ʋ bɩ naga la tɩtɩa wɩaa nɛ la bʋbʋl, ama Yesu Kirisito wɩaa nɛ la bʋbʋl, Nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ nʋʋkala. Ʋ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ la tɩma pɩpɩma.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa, ʋ leŋe pʋlʋmʋŋ chaanɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ lɛɛlɛ ʋ leŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ kʋ jʋʋ la tʋɔŋ. Pʋlʋŋ-la nɛ leŋe la kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a wuo jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩɩ tʋl. Wɩa to Kirisito lɛ nɛ a dagɛ ʋ tʋla.

english_verse: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.
translation_verse: La nagɛ pupoyee nɛ, Wɩa joŋ kʋzɔmʋŋ deeŋ a tʋɔlɛ la tʋɔŋ lɛ. Ŋ-la saa daga arɩ dol-bal-la ŋaa Wɩa kʋŋ nɛ. La dee bɩ ʋ tɩɩ.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: La na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ lee-na kala, ama hɛɛ-la bɩ la wuo. Bʋa dɔŋɔ lɛ la yie bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala lɛ la sɩ hɛ, ama la ha kɛŋ yɩɛlaa.

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: Ba yie to naasɩŋ a dʋdɔgɩsɛla, ama Wɩa bɩ la vɩa ta. Nɩaa yie ŋmoola lo, ama la bɩ sʋʋ.

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ Yesu wɩaa, la sɩ hɛ mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, nɩaa yie kɛnla dɩ ba kpʋla nɛ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa dɩ mɩɩsɩ-la Yesu sɩ kɛnɛ, dɩ la ma kɛnʋ nɛ.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa Wɩa leŋe la sʋʋ nɛ dɩ ma-na kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Mɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩɩ bʋlba.” La ma laa Wɩa dii ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la ma laa ʋ wɩaa dii a ma bʋbʋlba.

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: La jɩma arɩ Wɩa nɛ chɩsɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu sʋʋŋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ chɩsɛla ma, dɩ la dɩ Yesu kala kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Ʋ jaŋ kɛnla arɩ ma kala a kaa mʋ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Ma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ wɩaa deemba kala ŋaa, dɩ nɩaa wuo yʋgɛ a jʋʋ Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ-la lɛ. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa yʋgɛ a dɛnnɛ Wɩa, dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa la nandaasɩŋ bɩ yʋɔrɛ. Yara-la la sɩ kɛnɛ la mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, ʋʋ hɩɛsɛ nɛ, ama la dɩnsɩŋ-na wasa zʋzɔŋ nɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala.

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa kɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ na dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, la bɩbaa beŋ arɩ ba ŋaa kɩaa. La mɩɩraa beŋ kɩalɩŋ la sɩ bɩ na nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ nɩaa nɩna, ba jaŋ lɛl, ama kɩalɩŋ nɩaa sɩ bɩ na a hɛ Wɩa teeŋ, ba-na jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: La jɩma la yaraa deemba la sɩ kɛnɛ la mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, dɩ la nɛ sʋba a mʋ Wɩa teeŋ, ʋ jaŋ pɩla yarɩ-falaa. Yarɩ-falɩa-la bɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɩa. Ba lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ. La jaŋ kɛmba a hɛ Wɩa jaŋ lɛ deeŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
translation_verse: La sɩ hɛ la mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, la faasa yel nɛ. La fa cho dɩ la kɛŋ yara-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩla nɛ.

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ fa joŋ yara-la pɩla, la fa bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Yara-la la sɩ kɛnɛ la mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ lɛ bɩ leŋe la tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Ʋ bɩ naga arɩ la cho dɩ la sʋba nɛ, ama la cho dɩ la kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ yara-la sɩ bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ, a lenni la yaraa deemba sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ yarɩ-falaa deemba a pɩla. Ʋ nɛ saa joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma hɛ la lɛ dɩ la wuo jɩŋ arɩ la jaŋ kɛŋ yarɩ-falaa deemba ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa bʋa na-kala lɛ la nyuŋ yie nyaasɛ nɛ. La sɩ kɛŋ yaraa deemba la mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, la bɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu kpaga.

english_verse: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
translation_verse: La bɩ Kirisito ka na, ama la laa ʋ wɩaa dii nɛ a tutou.

english_verse: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
translation_verse: La nyuŋ nyaasa nɛ, la saa cho dɩ la lɩɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ a mʋ La Tɩɩna Yesu teeŋ.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ la nɛ hɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, la cho dɩ la ŋaa wɩaa dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ tʋtɔrɛ nɛ. Dɩ la nɛ mʋ ʋ teeŋ maa, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ la jaŋ ŋɩŋaa,

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Laa fá Wɩa nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la bʋl ʋ wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa, dɩ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ a kʋ to Wɩa. Wɩa nɛ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ la sɩ naga. Mɩ saa jɩma arɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ la sɩ naga nɛ.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la bɩ chɛ dɩ la dagɛ la tɩtɩa ma teeŋ, ama laa chɛ dɩ ma bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ-la ma sɩ jɩma a mʋ tɩgɛ la lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma wuo bʋl wɩaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi nɩaa yaraa wʋŋaalaa lɛ aŋ bɩ ŋɩɩ ba tʋɔŋ sɩ nagɛ Wɩa teeŋ chɩla.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna arɩ laa nyaasɛ nɛ la sɩɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ? Dɩ la nɩɩ nyaasʋ, Wɩa wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ, ama dɩ la nyuŋ nɩɩ tɩŋ ma, ma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Kirisito chola nɛ, ʋ chono-la nɛ kɛnla kaa tɩtɩŋ. La saa sɛyɛ arɩ nʋʋkala wɩaa nɛ nɩbala sʋʋ, a tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ nagɛ nʋʋkala sʋba nɛ.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ Kirisito sʋʋ. Ʋ sɩ sʋba ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ to ʋ lɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ, aŋ sɩ́ ba tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa ŋaa, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ sʋʋ ba wɩaa aŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, a lɩɩ jɩnɩŋ kaa mʋmʋ la bɩ chɛ la beŋ nɩaa arɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ beŋ nɩaa ŋɩɩ. Bʋa kʋbala lɛ, la faa beŋ Kirisito ŋɩɩ nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ la bɩra bɩ ʋ beŋ arɩ la fa sɩɩ benu ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii, Wɩa kɛnʋ bɩrɩmɛ nɩ-falɩɩ nɛ. Wʋbɩnɩa-la kala bálá nɛ. Wʋfalaa nɛ suomi ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Wʋfalaa deemba kala lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ. Wɩa to Kirisito lɛ nɛ a leŋ ʋ dɩ nɩaa sɩŋ. Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩla nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ la mʋ bʋla pɩ nɩaa dɩ ba kɔ, dɩ ba dɩ Wɩa ŋaa sɩma.

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: Wɩa to Kirisito lɛ nɛ a wuo ŋaa ʋ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala sɩŋ. Wɩa na dʋnɩa nɩaa arɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, ama ʋ fá ba nenige a joŋ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la a chɛba. Wɩa nɛ sɩ la bʋla pɩ nɩaa arɩ la dɩ Wɩa sɩma nɛ lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa Kirisito naasɩŋ lɛ nɛ la chɩŋ a bʋbʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩpɩ nɩaa. Wɩa to la lɛ nɛ a bʋla pɩma dɩ ma kɔ ʋ teeŋ. A tɩŋ Kirisito wɩaa laa sʋlma dɩ ma kɔ, dɩ ma dɩ Wɩa ŋaa sɩma.

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Kirisito fa bɩ wʋbɔŋ kɛnɛ, ama a tɩŋ la wɩaa, Wɩa leŋe ʋ sʋʋ a nagɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ. Wɩa ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ la wuo to Kirisito lɛ nɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la la sɩɩ tɩŋ, la dɩ Wɩa kala nɩɩ tɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa laa sʋlma, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ-la ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ ma teeŋ ŋaa wʋpɛɩba.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩtɩa bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ ʋ teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ sɩ, “Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ cho nɛ mɩ jegile nɩɩ ma teeŋ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la sɩ maga mɩ laama ta, mɩ pɛ ma lɛ nɛ.” Má bee na, lɛɛlɛ nɛ Wɩa chɛ ʋ dagɛ ʋ chonuŋ, jɩnɩŋ nɛ ŋaa tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ laama ta.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: La bɩ chɛ dɩ la joŋ kʋŋkala gɛrɛ nʋʋkala wombiiŋ lɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ kala bɩɩnʋ a mʋ tɩgɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la la sɩɩ tɩŋ lɛ. La ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa nɛ.

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wɩɩ-na kala la sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ, la yie dagɛ arɩ la ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa nɛ. Wʋwalɩmaa yie jʋʋla, la nɩna hɛɛŋ, la tʋɔŋ faasa chei, ama la yie faasa nyalɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: Ba yie ŋmoola, a kɛnla tɔ dɩa, nɩaa hɛ yuosuŋ la nyuŋ, la yie faasa tɩtɩŋ nɛ, la bɩ doŋ pɩŋ, losuŋ ma kɛnla.

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: La yie dagɛ arɩ la ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. La jɩŋ wɩaa nɛ, a kɛŋ kenyiri, a kɛŋ zile, a kɛŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma, a cho nɩaa arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: La yie bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a kɛŋ dol-la Wɩa sɩ pɩla a kaa tɩtɩŋ, a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ma Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Tʋɔpʋla-la nagɛ huonuŋ nɛ la sɩ vɔɔ laalɛ la nadiiŋ arɩ la nagʋa nɩsaa lɛ a kɛŋ la tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ la pɔ la tɩtɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ka zilla, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma tʋtʋʋsɛla. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ bɩbɛsɛ la lɛ, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a tɩtɩgɛ la lɛ. Ba bɩɩna arɩ laa nyɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ, ama wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ la bʋbʋl.

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: Nuhuobiinee bɩ la jɩŋ, ama Wɩa-na jɩŋ-la nɛ. Nɩaa bɩɩna arɩ la sʋba nɛ, ama Wɩa teeŋ la weye nɛ. Baa dɔgɩsɛla nɛ, ama ba bɩ la kpʋa.

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: La tʋɔŋ yie chei nɛ, aŋ ka la jʋjʋɔsɛ. La ŋaa summoo nɛ, ama la yie pɛ nɩaa lɛ dɩ ba kuori Wɩa teeŋ. La bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ, ama la nɛ tɩɩ kʋŋkala.

english_verse: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
translation_verse: Ma Kɔrɩntɩ nɩaa, la chaasa bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a pɩma. La bɩ wɩɩkala kaa faama.

english_verse: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
translation_verse: La choma nɛ, ma nɛ bɩ la cho, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ma bɩ chɛ dɩ ma suri ma tʋɔŋ pɩla.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: Ma nagɛ mɩ biiriŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa ŋ-la a pɩpɩma. Má leŋ ma tʋɔŋ pʋllɛ a chola. Pɔɔl chagɩlɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a mʋ tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii lɛ

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa kaa mɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Yesu wɩaa laa dii lɛ. Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ wuo mɛrɛ. Pʋlʋmʋŋ arɩ birimiŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo guoli dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Kirisito arɩ Sɩtaanɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ nii-bala, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩɩ-la ma sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo tuto dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: La ŋaa Wɩa-la sɩ weye dɩa nɛ, ʋ hɛ la lɛ. Ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa dɩa a kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa nɩmɛ. Ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa tɩtɩa bʋl ʋ teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ hɛ mɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ a gʋgɔllɛ. Mɩ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ba Wɩa, dɩ ba ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Yesu wɩaa laa dii tʋɔŋ, a hɔŋ ma dʋndʋŋ. Má sɩ́ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ digu. Dɩ ma nɛ lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wɩaa deemba lɛ, mɩ jaŋ laa ma.

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ma Nyɩmma dɩ ma ma ŋaa mɩ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ mɩ toloo.” La Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: Mɩ naambii-kpɩanaba, Wɩa sɩ folo bʋl dɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala pɩla, má leŋ dɩ la lɩɩsɛ la tɩtɩa disiŋ-na kala lɛ. Dɩ la nɛ bɩ disiŋ kala ŋaa, ŋɩɩ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, la sɛnɛ ka fá Wɩa nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Pɔɔl tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Má chaasa pʋllɛ ma tʋɔŋ pɩla. La bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa cheima, la bɩ ma nyuŋ ma cheye, la bɩra bɩ ma gʋra maa.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ bɩ naga arɩ mɩ sɩ dɩ ma cheye nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ la choma nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, la kala jaŋ kɛnʋ, dɩ sʋʋŋ ma nɛ, la kala jaŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: Mɩ laama dii nɛ woruŋ. A tɩŋ ma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bibigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ, mɩ nyuŋ kala nyaasɛ. Wɩaa jʋʋla nɛ, ama mɩ tʋɔŋ ha faasa tɔrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: La sɩ paala kʋ jʋʋ Masidoonia tinteeŋ, la bɩ wiesee na. Wɩaa jʋʋla nɛ. Nɩaa kɛnla yuo yuosuŋ, fawʋllʋŋ jʋʋla.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la naambie kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Taatɩs kɔ la teeŋ. Ʋ sɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ, la tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ woruŋ. Wɩa nɛ pɩla tʋɔtɔrʋŋ deeŋ. Ʋ nɛ yie ŋaa nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ sɩ cheye na tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.

english_verse: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ dʋndʋŋa dee bɩ leŋe la tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Ʋ bʋla pɩla arɩ ma kɛnʋ woruŋ nɛ ʋ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩla arɩ ma cho dɩ ma namɛ nɛ, a bɩra bʋla pɩla arɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma ŋaa ma tʋɔŋ faasa chei nɛ, a bɩra bʋla pɩla arɩ ma cho mɩ wɩaa nɛ. Wɩaa deemba leŋe mɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ wasa yʋgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Teŋ-la mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩma leŋe ma tʋɔŋ chei nɛ. Dɩ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ cheye ma, mɩ-na tʋɔŋ bɩ cheye. Mɩ tʋɔŋ fa chei mʋa nɛ teŋ-la wɩaa, ama mɩ jɩma arɩ ma tʋɔŋ bɩ jaŋ chei a dieni.

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ, ʋ saa bɩ naga mɩ sɩ leŋe ma tʋɔŋ chei wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ, ama tʋɔ-chei-la sɩ leŋe ma bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ tɩɩ. Ma tʋɔ-chei-la ŋaa wɩɩ Wɩa sɩ cho nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa la bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa ma kʋŋkala lɛ.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ leŋe nʋʋ tʋɔŋ chei a tɩŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, ʋ tɩɩna yie bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ Wɩa laaʋ ta. Nʋʋkala tʋɔŋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ chei ŋɩɩ lɛ. Ama dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa wʋŋaalaa nɛ leŋe dɩ nʋʋ tʋɔŋ chei, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ tɩɩna sʋʋ.

english_verse: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
translation_verse: Má bee na wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa ma lɛ a tɩŋ Wɩa sɩ leŋe ma tʋɔŋ chei. Lɛɛlɛ ma fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ nɛ a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩdagɛ arɩ ma bɩ wɩɩ cheye. Ma na baanɩŋ nɛ a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ma sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma. Ma chomi nɛ a fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ dɩ ma namɛ. Ma kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ma dɔgɩsɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ nɛ ma tʋɔŋ. Ma daga arɩ ma bɩ wɩɩkala cheye wɩɩ-la lɛ.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa teŋ-la mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsa, ʋ bɩ naga arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wɩaa chei nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ. Mɩ bɩra bɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la cheyu lɛ. Ama mɩ ŋmʋnsa nɛ dɩ ma dagɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ arɩ ma chola nɛ.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala leŋe la tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ. Taatɩs sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ, ma kala nɛ leŋe ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ woruŋ. Ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa ma pɩŋ dɩ-bala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ leŋe la ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: Mɩ bigisi ma lɛ nɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ, ma ma bɩ leŋe hɩɩsɩŋ diimi, wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ bʋla pɩ Taatɩs a tɩgɛ ma lɛ sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ bʋla pɩma sɛnɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: Dɩ Taatɩs nɛ liisi ŋɩɩ ma sɩɩ to Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ a chagɛ laaʋ a zilu woruŋ, ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ choma yie pʋŋaa pɛ nɛ.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ, mɩ sɩ jaŋ wuo laama dii woruŋ.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: La naambiiri, laa chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Masidoonia tinteeŋ kala lɛ sɩ tɩma Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma arɩ nɩaa deemba pɩla kɩaa a magɛ ba doluŋ maŋŋaa nɛ, ba paala pa kɩɩ ba doluŋ nɛ. Ba tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ,

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: ba faasa sʋlla nɛ woruŋ dɩ la pɩba wombiiŋ dɩ ba ma wuo joŋ kɩaa pɩpɛ Wɩa nɩaa sɩ hɛ Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
translation_verse: La fa bɩ yɩɛla dɩ ba jaŋ wuo pa a magɛ ŋ-la. Ba laa sɩpaaŋ joŋ ba tɩtɩa a pɩ La Tɩɩna Kirisito nɛ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ ba sɛɩ la ma niiŋ wɩaa. Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: Taatɩs nɛ suomo laa kɩaa deemba ma teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa laa sʋlʋ, ʋ sɩ suomo ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma dagɛ chonuŋ deeŋ a mʋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Ma kuoro nɛ wɩɩkala lɛ. Ma laa Wɩa dii nɛ, ma wuo Wɩa wɩaa bʋbʋl nɛ, a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa dɩ ma pɛ nɩaa lɛ, aŋ faasa cho la ma. Laa chɛ dɩ ma faasa kɛŋ zile nɛ a pɩpɛ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ maa fʋgɛ dɩ ma joŋ kɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ nɛ a cho dɩ ba ŋaa kɩaa kpɩkpaa nɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma ma dagɛ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ma sɛnɛ cho nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ, wɩɩ-la mɩ-na sɩ na arɩ ʋ maga dɩ ma ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la, dɩɩmɩŋ ma sɩ suomi wɩɩ-la, ma ŋaaʋ a mʋ dɛrɛ. Ma nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ma kɩɛsɛ kɩaa kaa mʋ pɩ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ, aŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa ma.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ma sɩ suomo, má ŋaaʋ mʋ dɛrɛ ma doluŋ maŋŋaa. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ wɩɩ-la ma fa sɩ kɛnɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ ma sɛnɛ ŋaaʋ nɛ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ŋ joŋ kʋŋ pɩ nʋʋ, tɩɩna jaŋ laa kʋ-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pʋ nɛ, ama ʋ bɩ jaŋ laa kʋ-la ŋ sɩ bɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
translation_verse: Ma sɩ joŋ kɩalɩŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ, mɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ dee dɩ ba nɛ mɩɩra kɛŋ kɩaa ka ma nɩna hɛɛŋ, ama dɩ ma kala kɛŋ kɩaa.

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ lɛ ma kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ, aŋ ka ba bɩ kʋŋ kɛnɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má pɛ ba lɛ dɩ ba na kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ chɛ. Ʋ harɩŋ lɛ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ ma nɛ kʋ kɛŋ kʋŋ, ba ma jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ chɛ. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ a magɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ba bʋl Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ paa yʋgɛ bɩ na kieli, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ paa muuri ma bɩ na muuri.” Pɔɔl tɩŋ Taatɩs dɩ ʋ mʋ na Kɔrɩntɩ nɩaa

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ lɔllɛ Wɩa nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, ʋ sɩ leŋe Taatɩs choma arɩ mɩ ma sɩ choma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ naga la sɩ tɩŋ Taatɩs dɩ ʋ kʋ laa kɩalɩŋ ma teeŋ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kʋkɔ. Ʋ ma fa paala cho dɩ ʋ kɔ ma teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: La naambii dɔŋ ma nɛ to Taatɩs harɩŋ kʋkɔ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi ka zilu nɛ woruŋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ ma dʋndʋŋa dee. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hihilimi tasɩ-la kala lɛ nɛ lɩɩsʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ la lɛ dɩ la lɩlaa kɩalɩŋ a pɩpɛ Wɩa nɩaa lɛ. Ŋɩɩ daga arɩ la kɛŋ la tɩtɩa nɛ dɩ la pɛ ba lɛ, dɩ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ wɩaa wɩɩ-na kala la sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ, laa chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ Wɩa arɩ nuhuobiinee kala teeŋ.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: La naambii dɔŋ ma nɛ to ba harɩŋ kʋkɔ. Wɩɩkala lɛ la magɩsʋ nɛ a na arɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Lɛɛlɛ ʋ paala chaasa fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ nɛ woruŋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ma lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ laama dii nɛ.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Taatɩs-na ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔŋ nɛ, la pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a tɩma pɩpɩma. Ka la naambiiri-la-na chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hihilimi tasɩ-la kala lɛ naasɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Baa tɩŋ Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má dagɛ nɩaa deemba arɩ ma sɛnɛ choba nɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ la sɩ bigisi ma lɛ pɩba, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi tasɩ-la lɛ na dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ mɩ bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ pɩma a bʋbʋl kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɩɛsa pɩla dɩ la kaa mʋ pɩpɩ Wɩa nɩaa sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ wɩaa,

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ paala jɩŋ arɩ ma kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa nɛ dɩ ma pɛ ba lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bigisi ma lɛ a pɩ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Masidoonia tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ bʋla pɩba arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Akaaya tinteeŋ lɛ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ harɩŋ jɩna-la lɛ nɛ dɩ ba pɛ Wɩa nɩaa lɛ. Ma sɩ fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ma leŋe ba nɩaa jesiŋ kala nɛ cho dɩ ba pɛ a kɩɛsɛ kɩaa pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ tɩtɩŋ mɩ naambiiriŋ deemba dɩ ba kɔ ma teeŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ bigisi ma lɛ a tɩgɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ sɩ́ wʋnyɩɛrʋ ŋaa. Ka dɩ ma wuo chɛ kɩalɩŋ bil arɩ mɩ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: Dɩ Masidoonia tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ to mɩ harɩŋ kɔ, a na dɩ ma ha bɩ kɩalɩŋ chɛ bil, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ diila, a diima ma a tɩŋ la sɩ bigisi ma lɛ ŋɩɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɩɩnɛ dɩ ʋ maga dɩ mɩ tɩŋ mɩ naambiiriŋ deemba dɩ ba laa sɩpaaŋ kɔ mɩ lɛ, dɩ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bʋla arɩ ma jaŋ kɩɛsa pɛ Wɩa nɩaa lɛ, dɩ ma joŋo hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, ka dɩ mɩ-na kɔ. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ ma tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ma kɩɛsɛ kɩalɩŋ, mɩ bɩ ma fʋga dɩ ma ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ wɩɩŋ deeŋ yʋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ kʋdoho mʋa duu, kɩaa mʋa nɛ ŋ jaŋ kʋŋ, ama dɩ ŋ kʋdoho nɛ yʋga dɩ ŋ joŋo duu, ŋ jaŋ kʋŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala magɛ dɩ ʋ tɩa magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa sɩ daga nɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa saka saka. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ bɩɩnɛ arɩ baa fʋgʋ nɛ dɩ ʋ pɩ kɩalɩŋ. Nʋʋkala maga dɩ ʋ tɩa kɩaa ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa cho nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Wɩa kɛŋ doluŋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo pɩma kʋŋkala ma sɩɩ chɛ. Ʋ jaŋ paala faasa pɩma kʋŋkala ma sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma kaa wasɛ ma tɩtɩa aŋ ka, a kɛŋ kʋkaanaa ma pɛ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ ba bʋl Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ba sɩ, “Ʋ yie joŋ kɩaa didii zile summoo lɛ nɛ. Ʋ zile bɩ dɛrɛ.”

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma nɩsɩŋ jʋjʋʋ wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma faasa kɛŋ zile a pɩpɛ nɩaa lɛ woruŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ laa kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ joŋo pɩba, ba jaŋ lɔllɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ joŋo pɩ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ, ʋ bɩ naga ba kʋchɛɛlɛɛ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ma pɩba ŋɩɩ. Ama ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba faasa lɔllɛ Wɩa kɩŋkɛŋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ joŋo pɩba daga ŋɩɩ ma sɩ naga nɛ. Nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a dɛnnɛ Wɩa, a tɩŋ ma sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ tɩgɛ Kirisito lɛ a laa dii a tutoba. Ŋɩɩ ma dʋndʋŋa dee, ba jaŋ dɛnnɛ Wɩa a tɩŋ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ joŋo dii zile, ba dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩma aŋ chichel dɩ ba nama, bɛɛ wɩaa zil-bal-bal nɛ Wɩa ŋaa ma lɛ.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Laa lɔllɛ Wɩa a tɩŋ wʋbalbal-la ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩla pɛɩ.

english_verse: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl tɩtɩa nɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ pɩma. Mɩɩ sʋlma a tɩŋ Kirisito wɩaa, nɩɩ-la sɩaa sɩ fɩɛla, ka ʋ kɛŋ kenyiri ma. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ, dɩ mɩ nɛ hɛ ma teeŋ, mɩ yie pʋɩ nɛ gbɛlɛ gbɛlɛ, ama dɩ mɩ tuo ma teeŋ, mɩ nyuŋ duori weŋgem.

english_verse: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ ma teeŋ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɩhaa arɩ mɩ fa sɩ bɩɩna dɩ mɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩɩna arɩ la ŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
translation_verse: La hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nɛ a yuyuo laalɩŋ, ama la bɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa doluŋ nɛ kaa yuyuo laal-la.

english_verse: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
translation_verse: La laalɩyuori kɩaa bɩ dʋnɩa kɩaa ŋaa, ama ba lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ a faasa kɛŋ doluŋ, a wuo yigi dii-duoruŋ a lulo.

english_verse: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ sɛnɛ tuto Kirisito niiŋ wɩaa woruŋ, ŋɩɩ-na la jaŋ kɛŋ la tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa ka to.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Maa beŋ kɩaa jambaa nɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩɩna arɩ ʋ ŋaa Kirisito nʋʋ nɛ, ʋ tɩɩna maga dɩ ʋ jɩŋ arɩ la ma ŋaa Kirisito nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ faasa bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ mʋa a mʋ tɩgɛ dol-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩla lɛ, hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛmmɛ ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Wɩa joŋo pɩla dɩ la kaa wasɛma nɛ, ʋ bɩ sɩ dɩ la kaa cheima.

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ ma bɩɩnɛ arɩ mɩ yie ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ pɩpɩma dɩ mɩ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ nɛ a hɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Ma dɔnsʋŋ yie bʋl dɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ yie ŋmʋnsɛ mɩ tenniŋ tʋɔŋ a pɩma, ba dolie nɛ aŋ pɛ hɛɩ, ka mɩ tɩtɩa bɩ sɩɩ ka su. Mɩ wʋbʋlaa ma bɩ sɩŋ.

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ nɩdosunuŋ-la jɩŋ arɩ la sɩ yie bɩ kpaga aŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ tenniŋ tʋɔŋ, dɩ la nɛ kpaga ma, wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa nɛ la jaŋ bʋl.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: La bɩ jaŋ faasa bigisi la tɩtɩa lɛ a kieli, ama la jaŋ bigise magɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩla lɛ nɛ, tɩntɩmɩɩ-la nɛ la tɩma kʋ yi ma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: La bɩ la tɩtɩa lɛ bigise a tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ tɩma kieli ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ kere pɩla lɛ. La kɛŋ yɩɛlaa arɩ ma jaŋ waa wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ, dɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la la sɩɩ tɩŋ ma teeŋ ma pʋŋa pɛ. Ama la jaŋ tɩma magɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ kere pɩla.

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ chɩna, la jaŋ wuo bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la lere-la sɩ paala kielima mʋ sɩpaaŋ. La bɩ chɛ dɩ la bibigisi la tɩtɩa lɛ lee-la nʋʋ dɔŋ sɩ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlma dɩ ma dii kenyiri mɩ teeŋ. Dɩ mɩɩ bʋl nɩyaarɩ wɩɩ ma, má jegile nɩɩ.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Ama fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ, dɩ ba sɩ kʋ nyɩsɛma dɩ ma sɩ́ Kirisito to arɩ tʋɔ-bala arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. A nagɛ dɩmɩŋ fa sɩ kɛŋ ʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a nyɩsɛ Hawa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ bʋl ŋ-la, bɛɛ wɩaa dɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ nɛ bɩra kɔ ma teeŋ a bʋl wʋtanɩɩ a mʋ tɩgɛ Yesu wɩalɩŋ la sɩ bʋla pɩma lɛ, ma yie laa dii nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ bɩra bʋl dɩŋ-wogo ma wɩaa sɩ tuo Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma sɩ laa, ma yie sɛɩ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ bɩra bʋl wʋwogo ma sɩ tuo Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la la sɩ bʋla pɩma, ma yie chagɛ laa nɛ lɩma lɩma.

english_verse: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩɩna nɩaa deemba sɩ joŋ ba tɩtɩa arɩ ba nɛ ŋaa Yesu nanzɔɔba a kɩɩ nʋʋkala, ba bɩ mɩ lɛ kpɩa.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ mɩ nɛ paala bɩ wɩaa bʋlʋŋ jɩŋ ma, mɩ jɩŋ wɩaa nɛ. La chaasa bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pʋlla pɩma nɛ wombii kala lɛ.

english_verse: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la pɩma, mɩ bɩ kʋŋkala laa ma teeŋ. Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa muuri nɛ dɩ ma wuo yuŋ. Mɩ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛɛ?

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ, dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chɛ kʋŋkala, mɩ ha bɩ ma kʋŋkala baŋŋaa lɛ kɛnɛ. La naambiiri-la sɩ hɛ Masidoonia tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ faa pɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ. Mɩ fa bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa chʋga kʋŋkala ma lɛ. Mɩ saa bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa chʋga ma kʋŋkala lɛ.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ Kirisito wʋtɩtɩɩ-la nɛ. Nʋʋkala tuo Akaaya tinteeŋ lɛ sɩ jaŋ bʋl dɩ mɩ sɩ́ mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ bigisu wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɩ mɩ tɩtɩa joŋo ŋaa chʋga ma lɛ? Ma bɩɩna mɩ bɩ ma cho nɛɛ? Aɩ, Wɩa tɩtɩa jɩma arɩ mɩ choma nɛ.

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩ tɩŋ mɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa aŋ bɩ kʋŋkala ka chɛ ma teeŋ ŋɩɩ, mɩ ha jaŋ ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ. Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɩ ba ŋaa Yesu nanzɔɔba nɛ sɩ wuo na wombiiŋ a bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ la dɩ ba kala to wɛŋ-bala a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ arɩ ba ŋaa Kirisito nanzɔɔba nɛ. Ba bɩra nyɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ. Ba yie fugi a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa bɩrɩmɛ arɩ ba ŋaa Kirisito nanzɔɔba nɛ.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ saa bɩ wʋkpuŋkpere wɩɩ ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa Sɩtaanɩ ma kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a nagɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa tɩndaarʋ sɩ kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: Ʋ saa bɩra bɩ wʋkpuŋkpere wɩɩ ŋaa dɩ Sɩtaanɩ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa ŋaa a nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla. Ba jaŋ timba magɛ ŋɩɩ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa sɩ maga. Pɔɔl sɩ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa Yesu nanzɔɔ

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ mɩ bɩra bʋla pɩma arɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ bɩɩna arɩ mɩ ŋaa nɩyaarɩ nɛ. Ama dɩ ma nɛ jommi arɩ mɩ ŋaa nɩyaarɩ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ mʋapɩlɩɩ.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl aa bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ jɩma Kirisito bɩ ŋɩɩ cho. Ama mɩ jaŋ bʋl nɩyaarɩ wɩalɩŋ a bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yʋga a bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ a tɩŋ dʋnɩa kɩaa wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ ma jaŋ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Ma kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ a wuo sɩsɛɩ wɩalɩŋ nɩyaaraa sɩɩ bʋl.

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ ma nɛ kɛmma bɩrɩmɛ ʋ yosuŋ, koo dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ ma kɩaa kala lɩlaa, koo dɩ ʋ nɩɩ gʋrɛma, koo dɩ ʋ nɛ leŋe ma ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ, koo ʋ nɛ fallɛma, ma yie tɔrɛ ma niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: Hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ. La-na fa bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ la ŋaa wɩaa deemba ma lɛ. Ama mɩ haa bʋl wɩaa arɩ nɩyaarɩ nɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ a tɩŋ wɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ ma jaŋ wuo bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la wɩaa.

english_verse: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa Hiburu tɩmma nɛɛ? Mɩ ma ŋaa dɔŋɔ nɛ. Ba ŋaa Iziral tɩmma nɛɛ? Mɩ ma ŋaa dɔŋɔ nɛ. Ba ŋaa Abɩraham doho nɩaa nɛɛ? Mɩ ma ŋaa dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Ba ŋaa Kirisito tɩntɩnna nɛɛ? Mɩɩ bʋl wɩaa arɩ mɩ nyuŋ tuo nɛ. Mɩ ma ŋaa dɔŋɔ nɛ, a paala kɩɩba. Mɩ nɛ paala fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a tɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ. Ba kɛmmɛ tɔ dɩa a yʋgɛ nɛ. Ba sɩ ŋmoomi kɩŋkɛŋ mɩ ka mʋa dɩ mɩ sʋba, mɩ bɩ ʋ ma niiŋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: Naansɩɩŋ butori nɛ Rom tɩŋŋaa vɩɩrɛmɛ arɩ chɩba. Bʋa kʋbala ma lɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa paa tabɩaa yagɛmɛ dɩ ba kpʋ. Mɩ sɩ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ a vɩvɛŋ, butori nɛ lɩɩŋ daborusu-la chei lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ, chɛɛ kʋbala mɩ hɛ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala a nɩnɛrɩgɛ dɩ mɩ lɩɩ.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ vɛnɛɛ vɛŋ wombiiŋ ŋɩɩ, mɩ na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ. Mɩ na hɛɛŋ fuonuŋ choluŋ lɛ. Mɩ na hɛɛŋ wɛmboriroo ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ na hɛɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, mɩ na hɛɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, mɩ na hɛɛŋ tabalaa lɛ, mɩ na hɛɛŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ ma tʋɔŋ, mɩ na hɛɛŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, mɩ na hɛɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ba ŋaa la naambiiriŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: Mɩ faasa tɩŋ nɛ woruŋ a kala lɔl. Tapʋlaa yʋga mɩ sɩ bɩ doŋ pɩna, losuŋ arɩ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ ma kɛmmɛ, mɩ paala bɩ kʋdiilee kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ dii, a bɩ gɛrɩ-yuŋii kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ kaa tɔ waarɩŋ, ka waarɩŋ kpʋmɛ.

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ paala leŋ wɩɩkala ta ma, nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi lee-kala, ba wɩaa yie hɛ mɩ bɔyɛ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ, mɩ ma bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ. Dɩ ba nyɩsɛ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ma, mɩ tʋɔŋ yie faasa chei nɛ.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ ŋaa La Tɩɩna Yesu Nyɩmma, ʋ yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ deeŋ deeŋ. Ʋ jɩma arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩaa nyɩɛ.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩ hɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ dɩ baal kʋbala baa yɩyɩrɛ Ariitas nɛ fa dii kuoruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ chɩŋ tintee-la kuoru-balɩŋ nyuŋ pɩ wombiiŋ dɩ ba pɔ taŋ-la boiŋ niiŋ a kɛmmɛ.

english_verse: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_verse: Ama ba jommi a hɛ siŋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, a jommi to tokoro ta jeeŋ harɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ wuo lɛl ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga mɩ sɩ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ sɩ bɩ jaŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ ma, ama mɩ ha jaŋ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ leŋe mɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ, arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ joŋo dagɛmɛ.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Tori nɛ ŋ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ nama, dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ walɩmɛma dɩ ma pɩmɛ kʋŋkala. Mɩ bɩ ma kʋŋkala ka chɛ. Ma tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ chɩchɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa hambiisiŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo chɛ kɩaa bil ba nyɩmmaba arɩ ba naamba lɛ. Ama hambiisiŋ nyɩmmaba arɩ ba naamba nɛ maga dɩ ba chɛ kɩaa a bil ba biiriŋ lɛ.

english_verse: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma arɩ baala deeŋ Wɩa guu joŋu kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ. Dɩ Wɩa joŋ ʋ dɩma nɛ koo ʋ yaraa kala nɛ, mɩ bɩ jɩŋ. Wɩa nɛ jɩma.

english_verse: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ nɩa, nuhuobiinee paala bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋlba. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba bʋlba ma.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ ma, mɩ bɩ jaŋ bʋl nɩyaarɛ wɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩba. Ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wuo na wombiiŋ a bɩɩnɛ arɩ mɩ kɩɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ maga nɛ, a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ na mɩ teeŋ, koo a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nɩa dɩ mɩɩ bʋl lɛ.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Mɩ yaraa sɩɩ wɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sʋl Wɩa naansɩɩŋ butori dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ mɩ yaraa fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mɩ zile yʋga kɩŋkɛŋ ŋ teeŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ doluŋ yie faasa tɩŋ ŋ lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ wɩaa, dɩ Kirisito dol-la wuo hɛ mɩ lɛ a tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa a tɩŋ Kirisito wɩaa dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ, dɩ ba nɩɩ tʋʋsɛmɛ, dɩ mɩ nɩɩ na hɛɛŋ, dɩ ba nɛ to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ, koo dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋmɛ ma, mɩ tʋɔŋ ha yie tɔrɛ nɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ, Wɩa yie pɩmɛ ʋ doluŋ nɛ. Kɔrɩntɩ nɩaa wɩaa wɩɩ Pɔɔl

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ mɩ ŋaa nɩyaarɩ nɛ. Ma nɛ saa yigimi hɛ ŋɩɩ lɛ. Ma nɛ fa maga dɩ ma bɩbɛsɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ jɩma arɩ mɩ bɩ nʋʋ ŋaa, ama nanzɔɔba-la sɩ joŋ ba tɩtɩa arɩ ba nɛ kɩɩ nʋʋkala, ba bɩ mɩ kpɩa.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: Mɩ nyalɩma nɛ woruŋ a wuo tɩŋ ma teeŋ. Wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa, wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ daga arɩ mɩ sɛnɛ ŋaa Kirisito nanzɔɔ-tɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ma wɩaa mɩ paala faasa cho nɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ kʋŋkala mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ arɩ mɩ doluŋ a tɩma pɩma. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ mɩ nɛ choma kɩŋkɛŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma ma chomi nɛ.

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ arɩ mɩ bɩ ma walɩma dɩ ma pɩmɛ kʋŋkala, ama ma dɔnsʋŋ bʋla arɩ mɩ nyɩsa laa ma kɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ tɩma ba kɔ ma teeŋ, ma bɩɩna mɩ tɩmba dɩ ba kʋ nyɩsa laa ma kɩaa nɛɛ?

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ tɩŋ Taatɩs arɩ la naambie dɔŋɔ ba kɔ ma teeŋ. Taatɩs sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ, ʋ nyɩsa laa ma kʋŋ nɛɛ? Wɩɩkala la sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ, mɩ dɩ Taatɩs ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. La kala ka to wɛŋ-bala nɛ.

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩɩ bʋl, ma jaŋ bɩɩnɛ arɩ laa bʋl ŋɩɩ dɩ la laa la tɩtɩa ma teeŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ dee. La hɛ Kirisito lɛ nɛ aa bʋl wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Mɩ naambii-kpɩanaba, laa ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala dɩ la wuo pɛ ma lɛ nɛ dɩ ma waa wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: Fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ kɔ ma teeŋ. Ŋ bɩ pɔ mɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ma bɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ cho naga, ma ma jaŋ na dɩ mɩ ma bɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ cho naga. Mɩ bɔyɛ ka joŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ, mɩ jaŋ nama dɩ maa yuo yuosuŋ, a kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ, a nɩna baanɩŋ dɔŋɔ nyuŋ, a kɛŋ dɔŋɔ pʋpɔrɛ, a chichei dɔŋɔba yɩrɩŋ, a gɩgaa dɔŋɔ harɩŋ, a kɛŋ sɩɩ-duoŋ, a bɩ nii-bala kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɔyɛ ka joŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩra kɔ ma teeŋ, Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmmɛ ma wɩaa, dɩ mɩ yel a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Nɩaa yʋga a hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, a ŋaa disiniŋ, a ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, a gɔllɔ chɛ nɩaa haalaa, aŋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba lɛ.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Naansɩɩŋ butori nɛ ŋ-la mɩ sɩɩ kɔ ma teeŋ dɩ mɩ nama. Wɩa teniŋ sɩ, “Nɩaa balɩa koo nɩaa batori nɛ jaŋ pɛ na wɩɩ ka dɩ ʋ na chɩŋ.”

english_verse: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ lɩamɩŋ lɛ, mɩ kpʋrɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ kala dɩgɩlaa nɛ. Lɛɛlɛ mɩ tuo ma teeŋ, ama mɩ bɩra kpʋrɩsɛ ma dɩgɩlaa nɛ arɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ ma teeŋ torimuŋ lɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ taba.

english_verse: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
translation_verse: Maa chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ Kirisito hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ a bʋbʋl wɩaa. Kirisito bɩ puwuol ŋaa, ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ ma lɛ, a wuoma ma wɩɩkala lɛ.

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: Ba kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ a nagɛ arɩ ʋ fa bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ. Ama Wɩa doluŋ lɛ ʋ sie nɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. La hɛ Kirisito lɛ nɛ a bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ la tɩtɩa lɛ. Kirisito sɩ weye ŋɩɩ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ Wɩa doluŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ la ma jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ Wɩa doluŋ lɛ a tɩma pɩma.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Má beŋ ma tɩtɩa lɛ a pɛ mɩmagɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa, a na dɩ ma chɩŋ ma wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii naaŋ lɛ nɛ koo ma bɩ chɩna. Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ Yesu Kirisito hɛ ma lɛ nɛɛ? Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ jɩŋ dɩ ʋ hɛ ma lɛ, ŋɩɩ-na ma tele nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: Mɩ laa dii arɩ ma jaŋ na dɩ la-na bɩ tele.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: La sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩma dɩ ma sɩ́ wɩɩkala ŋaa chei. Ʋ bɩ naga laa chɛ dɩ la dagɛ arɩ la-na ŋaa woruŋ nɛ, ama laa chɛ dɩ ma wuo ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wombiiŋ nɛ, dɩ ma nɛ paala bɩɩnɛ la-na tele ma,

english_verse: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa la bɩ jaŋ wuo lɩɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la harɩŋ. Ama la chɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ ma, la yie jʋjʋɔsɛ nɛ a tɩŋ dol-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ wɩaa. Wɩɩ-la la sɩ sʋl Wɩa chɩchɛ nɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ ma laa Kirisito wɩaa dii wasa dol.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ tuo ma teeŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ pɩpɩma. Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ ma teeŋ, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ dagɛ dol-la La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ ma teeŋ. Ʋ joŋ dol-la pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ kaa pɛ ma lɛ nɛ dɩ ma wasa dol. Ʋ bɩ sɩ dɩ mɩ kaa cheima.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ teniŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la. Maa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma chaasa ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ. Má jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋla pɩma, má kɛŋ nii-bala a ŋaa sɩma. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa sɩ cho nɩaa jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ a leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ tʋɔ-bala a guori dɔŋɔ a chʋchʋɔlɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: Yesu Kirisito joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pa nɛ ba kpʋʋ a tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛla wʋbɔmɔ-la sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ lɛɛlɛ. Ʋ to la Nyɩmma Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ a ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩla.

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: Wɩa yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ. Wɩa wombii dɔŋ bɩra tuo

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Ʋ kperimi nɛ ma sɩ bɩ diene aŋ vɩa nɩɩ-la sɩ yɩrɛma Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, aŋ bɩra tuto wombii-wogo.

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, Wɩa wombii dɔŋ kala bɩra tuo a pɛ kʋ-la la sɩ dagɛma lɛ. Mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩaa yʋga a hɛ nɩmɛ aa walɩmɛma a chɩchɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ Kirisito wʋzɔmɔ-la kaa bɩrɩmɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ la-na, koo dɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ nɛ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a kʋ bʋl wʋwogusi, a kɛŋ Kirisito wʋzɔmɔ-la la sɩ bʋla pɩma kaa bɩrɩmɛ, Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ tɩɩna a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: La laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ, aŋ bɩra bʋbʋl ʋ tɩtɩa lɛɛlɛ ŋ-la. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bʋl wombii-wogo wɩaa pɩma, a lɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii harɩŋ lɛ, Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ tɩɩna a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna arɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ laa yɩrɩŋ nɩaa teeŋ nɛɛ? Wɩa teeŋ nɛ mɩ chɩchɛ mɩ laa yɩrɩŋ. Ma bɩɩna mɩɩ chɛ dɩ nɩaa nɛ zizilmii? Dɩ mɩ nɛ faa chɛ dɩ nɩaa zizilmi, mɩ fa bɩ jaŋ ŋaa Kirisito tɩntɩnnʋ. Pɔɔl daga ŋɩɩ Yesu Kirisito sɩ yɩrʋ dɩ ʋ kʋ ŋaa ʋ nanzɔɔ

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, má leŋ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩma: Kirisito wʋzɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma bɩ nuhuobiine teeŋ lɩa.

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiinee dee bɩ joŋo pɩmɛ, nuhuobiinee dee bɩ mɩ daga. Ama Yesu Kirisito nɛ joŋ wɩalɩŋ dagɛmɛ.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: La Juu tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ wombiiŋ lɛ, mɩ nɛ fa jɩŋ wɩaa kɩɩ mɩ dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa jesiŋ kala. Mɩ fa joŋ mɩ nyuŋ kala a hɛ la naabarɩŋ wombiiŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
translation_verse: Ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ dagɛmɛ ʋ Bie Yesu Kirisito, dɩ mɩ wuo bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ bɩ nʋʋkala teeŋ mʋa dɩ ʋ dagɛmɛ.

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ Jerusalɛm ma mʋa dɩ mɩ na nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa Wɩa nanzɔɔba mɩ lɛ. Ama mɩ guu mʋ tintee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Arebia nɛ, a lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mɩɩra mʋ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Damasɩkʋs.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Jɩsɩŋ batori harɩŋ nɛ, mɩ mʋ Jerusalɛm dɩ mɩ na Pɩɩta, nɩɩ-la ba sɩ kaa yɩrɛ Kɩɩfas. Mɩ sɩ mʋ nɩmɛ, mɩ hɔŋ ʋ teeŋ tapʋlaa fii arɩ banɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ hɔŋ nɩmɛ, mɩ bɩ Yesu nanzɔɔ kala na see Jeems, La Tɩɩna Yesu ŋaana.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsaa pɩma, Wɩa jɩma ba ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Mɩ bɩ nyɩɛ.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sii Jerusalɛm lɛ, a mʋ Siiria arɩ Siliisia tinteeŋ.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ kala lɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ, ba fa ha bɩ mɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: Ba ta nɩɩ nɩaa sɩɩ bʋl mɩ wɩaa nɛ, “Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ to naasɩŋ a dʋdɔgɩsɛla nɛ lɛɛlɛ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa ʋ fa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ chei.”

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Ba dɛnnɛ Wɩa woruŋ a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ banɛsɛ sɩ kiele, mɩ dɩ Banabas bɩra mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm. Mɩ pɛ kɛŋ Taatɩs to la harɩŋ mʋ nɛ.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ mʋ lee-la, Wɩa nɛ dagɛmɛ mɩ mʋ. La sɩ mʋa, mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii kʋhɩasɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ hilime. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩba wɩalɩŋ mɩ fa sɩ bʋla pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa a tɩgɛ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la lɛ. Mɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pɩba dɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ fa sɩ tɩma aŋ haa tɩŋ sɩ́ pɛɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Taatɩs sɩɩ to mɩ harɩŋ fa ŋaa Giriik tɩɩna nɛ, ama ba bɩ ʋ fʋga dɩ ʋ keri ʋ peniŋ.

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: Ama la bɩ sɛyɛ pɩba mʋapɩlɩɩ ma, dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ daga sɩ́ lɛl ma teeŋ.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ bʋl arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ bɩ wɩɩ bʋla dɩ mɩ dagɛ a pɛ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jɩma. Ama nɩaa deemba dɩchɩnɩŋ bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa mɩ teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa bɩ nuhuobiine yaraa lɛ nɩɩ beŋ.

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: Nɩhɩasɩŋ deemba na arɩ Wɩa lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɛ, ka dɩ Pɩɩta ma bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛ Pɩɩta a pʋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ yɩrɛmɛ ma dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ wɩaa a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: Jeems arɩ Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɩhɩasɩ-la na arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-fɩɛmɩŋ deeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ mɩ dɩ Banabas hɛ ba tʋɔŋ, la kala kɛŋ nii-bala. Ba bʋla arɩ la dɩ Banabas jaŋ mʋ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa teeŋ, ka ba ma bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la Juu tɩŋŋaa teeŋ.

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla pɩla dʋndʋŋa nɛ, dɩ la sɩ́ summo-la sɩ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ wɩaa yʋ. Wɩɩ-la mɩ ma fa sɩ paala cho dɩ mɩ ŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Pɔɔl bʋl Pɩɩta teeŋ

english_verse: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
