translation_verse: Ama bʋa kʋbala Pɩɩta sii kɔ Antɩɔk. Ʋ sɩ kɔ, mɩ chaasa bʋl ʋ teeŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ cheye nɛ. Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ cheye nɛ ŋ-la:

english_verse: He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩmma-la kʋkaana-la ma paala to ba fawʋllʋ wɩaa, arɩ Pɩɩta sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Banabas ma paala to ba fawʋllʋ wʋŋaalɩa-la lɛ.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ na arɩ ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ daga ka to, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩ Pɩɩta ba kala sɩpaaŋ, “Ŋ ŋaa Juu tɩɩna nɛ, aŋ ka ŋ wʋŋaalaa nagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ Juu tɩɩna ŋaa. Ɛɛ nɛ saa ŋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa a fʋgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa dɩ ba tuto Juu tɩŋŋaa naabarɩŋ?” Wɩa laa diiniŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa teeŋ

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: La sɩɩ chɛ dɩ la to Kirisito lɛ dɩ Wɩa leŋ dɩ la ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma, la na arɩ la nagɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaara nɛ. Ma saa bɩɩna arɩ Kirisito nɛ leŋe la ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ? Aɩ, ʋ dee!

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ la tuto, dɩ mɩ nɛ vɩaba ta aŋ bɩra suomo tutoba, ʋ ŋɩɩ daga arɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ nɛ.

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ la tuto, ba tɩtɩa nɛ leŋe mɩ sʋʋ. Ama ʋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa mɩ sʋʋ Mosis wɩalɩŋ lɛ nɛ a wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ lahɔrɩmɔ-la Wɩa sɩ kɛnɛ la teeŋ vɩa. Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ jaŋ wuo to wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile lɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ teeŋ, sʋʋ-la Kirisito sɩ sʋba ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: Ma-na Galiisia nɩyaara! Kʋbɛɛ nɛ bugumima? La sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ, mɩ dagɛma woruŋ ŋɩɩ Yesu sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ, ma jɩŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ mɩ pɩɛsɛma wɩɩŋ deeŋ: Wɩa sɩ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ dii zile ma lɛ, ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ, koo a tɩŋ ma sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a laaba dii nɛ tɩɩ?

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma yaarɛ kɩŋkɛŋ ŋ-la? Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la lɛ nɛ ma suomi a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ Kirisito lɛ. Ma saa chɛ dɩ ma na ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ma tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛɛ?

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Hɛɛ-la kɩŋkɛŋ ma sɩ na ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ ma teeŋ koo? Aɩ, mɩ bɩɩna ʋ bɩ pɛɩ wuo ŋaa.

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Wɩa joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la a dii zile ma lɛ, aŋ pɛ ŋɩŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ ma teeŋ. Ma bɩɩna ma sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile nɛ tɩɩ ʋ wuo ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ, koo ma sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a laaba dii nɛ tɩɩ?

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ma jɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii ŋaa Abɩraham biiriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ hɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ faafaa kala nɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, dɩ ba nɛ laa Wɩa dii, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba ma kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla. Faafaa kala nɛ Wɩa bʋl wʋzɔmʋŋ deeŋ a pɩ Abɩraham, “Ŋ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ to a pɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala lɛ.”

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Abɩraham nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ a laa dii. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa pɛ ʋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩ laa wɩɩŋ deeŋ dii, Wɩa pɛ ba ma lɛ nɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ pɛ Abɩraham lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile lɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ba lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla arɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ kala Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil ka to, Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ Wɩa chaasa dagɛ arɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla, “Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a tɩŋ ba sɩ laa Wɩa dii.”

english_verse: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa sɩ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil aŋ bɩ ba wuo tuto, Kirisito lɩɩsɛla wɩaa deemba lɛ nɛ. Ba kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ nɛ. Ba sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ʋ lɛ a tɩŋ la wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Nɩɩ-la kala ba sɩ kpaasa mɛrɛ daaŋ nyuŋ, Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: Kirisito ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa dɩ ba wuo to ʋ lɛ a na pɛnɛ-la Wɩa sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ Abɩraham arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba. Dɩ la nɛ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii, ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla, la jaŋ wuo laa. Mosis nii-la bɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pɩ Abɩraham wuo chei

english_verse: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, wʋmagɩsɩɩ nɛ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ magɩsɛ. Dɩ nɩaa balɩa nɛ vʋʋra dɩ ba ŋaa wɩɩ a ŋmɩɛsa pɩ dɔŋɔ, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo chei wɩɩ-la koo a ŋaa wɩɩ pɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ vʋʋra bil lɛ.

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Wɩa ma hɛ niiŋ nɛ a pɩ Abɩraham arɩ ʋ doho nʋʋ. Ʋ bɩ ʋ doho nɩaa kala daga. Nɩbala nɛ ʋ dagɛ. Nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ daga nɛ ŋaa Kirisito.

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Kʋ-la Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩ Abɩraham, ʋ bɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile lɛ lɩa. Dɩ ʋ nɛ lɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile lɛ, ʋ naga arɩ Wɩa bɩ ʋ niiŋ hɛ pɩ Abɩraham. Ama Wɩa sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ Abɩraham nɛ tɩɩ ʋ joŋ kʋ-la pʋ.

english_verse: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ-na saa wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ bɛɛ? Mosis sɩ bil wɩalɩŋ dɩ nɩaa tuto pɛ dagɛ ŋɩɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ sɩ naga nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Abɩraham doho nɩɩ-la sɩ kɔ. Ʋ lɛ nɛ Wɩa sɩ ʋ jaŋ to a pɛ nɩaa lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile, Wɩa tɩndaaraa nɛ kaa kʋ tuu pʋ. Mosis nɛ saa ŋaa Wɩa arɩ nɩaa sɩpaa-tooro ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Nɩaa balɩa nɛ yie ŋɩŋaa wɩɩ a kɛŋ sɩpaa-tooro. Ama Wɩa ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ Mosis bil nii-la pɩla

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile, ba saa kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pɩ Abɩraham chei nɛɛ? Aɩ, dɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile nɛ faa pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ, ŋɩɩ-na ʋ fa maga dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ toba kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla nɛ.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla arɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yosi nɛ. Wɩa bʋl ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ wuo joŋ kʋ-la wɩaa ʋ fa sɩ bʋla a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɛ, a tɩŋ ba sɩ laa Wɩa dii.

english_verse: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
translation_verse: Ka dɩ bʋa-la-na yi dɩ la wuo laa Yesu Kirisito dii, wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile nyagɛla bil nɛ ka Yesu-na kɔ.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile nɛ faa pɔla, a kʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Kirisito sɩ kɔ, dɩ la wuo laaʋ dii a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ Kirisito sɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ, wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile bɩra dee bɩ laa pɔ.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ma sɩ laa Yesu Kirisito dii nɛ tɩɩ ma kala ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ fo Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ Kirisito yɩrɩŋ lɛ, ma kala nagɛ Kirisito nɛ.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, la bɩra bɩ nɩaa kaa pʋpɔrɛ. Dɩ ŋ ŋaa Juu tɩɩna koo dɩ ŋ bɩ ŋaa, dɩ ŋ ŋaa yoŋ koo dɩ ŋ tɩɩ ŋ tɩtɩa, dɩ ŋ ŋaa haal koo baal, ma kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ Kirisito Yesu teeŋ.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma dɩ Kirisito nɛ ŋaa kʋbala, ŋɩɩ-na ma ŋaa Abɩraham doho nɩaa nɛ. Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la a pɩ Abɩraham, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pɩ ma ma.

english_verse: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ bie nɛ muuro aŋ dii ʋ nyɩmma dʋa, ba yie ŋɩŋaa wɩaa bile lɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa yoŋ nɛ, ka ʋ nɛ paala tɩɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ma.

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: Nɩaa nɛ yie bibenu a dɩdagʋ wɩaa deeŋ deeŋ, ʋ kʋ waa a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ʋ nyɩmma sɩ daga.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la ma fa nagɛ. La fa sɩ bɩ Yesu laa dii, dʋnɩa wʋkɛnɛɛ harɩŋ nɛ la fa tuto.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: Ama bʋa-la tɩtɩa sɩ yie, Wɩa tɩŋ ʋ bie nɛ. Haal nɛ lʋlʋ. Ʋ ma faa to Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba wombii-la nɛ,

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ wuo laa nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ to Juu tɩŋŋaa wombii-la a ta, dɩ ba dɩ la kala wuo ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ la sɩ ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ Bie Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ la lɛ. Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ la tʋɔŋ, ʋ yie ŋaa la kɛŋ Wɩa kaa yɩrɛ “La Nyɩmma.”

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma kʋŋkala bɩra bɩ yoŋ ŋaa. Ma ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ. Ma saa sɩ ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma dii ʋ dʋa. Pɔɔl sɩ chɩl Galiisia nɩaa wɩaa ŋɩɩ

english_verse: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
translation_verse: Faafaa-la, ma sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ, ma faa to vʋɩyaa nɛ a ŋaa ba yosi.

english_verse: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
translation_verse: Ma yie gbigbieli tapʋlaa gbiele, chɛnsɩŋ gbiele, kɩaa duunuŋ arɩ kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ bʋa lɛ gbiele arɩ jɩsɩŋ gbiele.

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: Ma leŋe fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ arɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ tɩma ma teeŋ ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩɩ sʋlma, má nagɛmɛ. Mɩ sɩ nagɛma ŋɩɩ, má ma nagɛmɛ. Ma bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa cheimi.

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: Ma jɩma, bumbuŋ-la mɩ sɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la pɩpɩma, mɩ faa wɩɩlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ ŋɩɩ walɩmɛ ma nɛ, ama ma bɩ mɩ kaa gbesi koo a vɩamɛ ta. Ma kɛmmɛ woruŋ nɛ a nagɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Wɩa tɩndaarʋ nɛ. Ma kɛmmɛ woruŋ nɛ a nagɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ sɛɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la, ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ woruŋ. Nɩɩ nɛ ma tʋɔtɔrʋ-la mʋ? Mɩ tɩtɩa jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ fa wuolo, ma fa jaŋ paala wuo chaarɛ ma sɩaa ma a pɩmɛ.

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: Mɩ lɛɛlɛ ŋaa ma dʋndɔŋ nɛ, a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ-la pɩmaa?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa wombii-la fogo dɩdagɛ arɩ ba tʋɔŋ wɩɩ ma lɛ nɛ woruŋ, ama ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩ zɔŋ. Ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala nɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ mɩ dɩ ma pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, dɩ ma tʋɔŋ wɩɩ ba lɛ.

english_verse: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ la tʋɔŋ nɩɩ wɩɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ hɛ ma teeŋ koo lee na-kala, ama ʋ maga dɩ ba ŋaa tʋɔ-wɩɩ-zɔmɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
translation_verse: Mɩ fa cho dɩ mɩ hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ lɛɛlɛ, a wuo jɩŋ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋl nʋʋkala teeŋ. Ma wɩaa walɩmɛmɛ nɛ woruŋ. Pɔɔl bʋl Haga arɩ Saara wɩaa

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho dɩ ma haa to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile, má leŋ dɩ mɩ pɩɛsɛma na, ma bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ?

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla arɩ Abɩraham fa lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ, dɔŋɔ ŋaa ʋ haala tɩtɩa bie, ka dɔŋɔ ma fa ŋaa ʋ haal-la sɩ ŋaa yomo bii.

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: Abɩraham haal-la sɩ ŋaa yomo a lʋl bile, nuhuobiine wombiiŋ lɛ nɛ ba to a lʋlʋ. Ama Bile Abɩraham haala tɩtɩa sɩ lʋla, Wɩa nɛ hɛ niiŋ ba lʋlʋ.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ kaa magɩsɛ arɩ haalaa deemba balɩa ŋaa niiriŋ balɩa nɛ Wɩa sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ. Haga nɛ chɩŋ nii-la Wɩa sɩ hɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ nyuŋ, ʋ biiriŋ ŋaa yosi nɛ.

english_verse: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
translation_verse: Haga nɛ chɩŋ nii-la Wɩa sɩ hɛ Sɩnaɩ peel-la nyuŋ, a hɛ Arebia tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ bɩra chɩŋ jɩnɩŋ tabal-la ba sɩ kaa yɩrɛ Jerusalɛm nyuŋ, ʋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ kala ŋaa yosi nɛ.

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: Ama Jerusalɛm dɔŋɔ nɛ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ a tɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa la naaŋ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba sɩ, “Hapɩrɩŋ, jʋjʋɔsɛ. Ŋ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ bii lʋla. Faasa ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, ŋ-na nɩɩ-la ha sɩ bɩ halʋllɩ luoruŋ wɩɩ na bɛɛ wɩaa ha-vɩa taalɩŋ jaŋ lʋl biiriŋ yʋgɛ a kɩɩ haal-la sɩ kɛŋ bala.”

english_verse: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, Wɩa fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ ba lʋl Aɩzɩk ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa hɛ niiŋ la ma ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ.

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Abɩraham biiri-la balɩa tʋɔŋ, kʋ-la ba sɩ to nuhuobiine wombiiŋ a lʋl dɔgɩsɛ bile ba sɩ lʋla Wɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba dʋdɔgɩsɛ la ma lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ ba bʋl Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ? Ba sɩ, “Kiri yoŋ-la arɩ ʋ bie ta, bɛɛ wɩaa haal-la sɩ ŋaa yomo bie bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ haal-la sɩ tɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa bie lɛ dɩ ba dii ba nyɩmma dʋa.”

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambiiriŋ, la bɩ hayoŋ-la biiriŋ ŋaa. La ŋaa haal-la sɩ tɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa biiriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Kirisito laala ta nɛ dɩ la tɩɩ la tɩtɩa. Má saa chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ, a pɔ dɩ nʋʋkala bɩra sɩ́ ma kaa ŋaa yosi.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile aa walɩmɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, ma keri ma tɩtɩa ta nɛ Kirisito teeŋ. La Tɩɩna Yesu zile-la nɛ ma vɩa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ, la-na laa dii a kɛŋ yɩɛlaa arɩ la jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: Dɩ la dɩ Kirisito nɛ ŋaa kʋbala, dɩ la keri la penee koo dɩ la bɩ kere, ʋ bɩ wɩɩ kɛnɛ. Wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩ nɛ, dɩ la laa Wɩa wɩaa dii a cho dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: Ma faa ŋaa woruŋ nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa nyɩsɛma dɩ ma sɩ́ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la to?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ yɩrɛma, ʋ dee bɩ ma nyɩsa dɩ ma leŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la tonuŋ.

english_verse: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
translation_verse: Sɩ-bʋrʋŋ mʋapɩlɩɩ nɛ ba yie joŋo hɛ boroboro munuŋ sɩ yʋga lɛ, aŋ ka ʋ kala sii pʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: La dɩ ma kala sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ Kirisito teeŋ, mɩ ha laa dii arɩ ma bɩ jaŋ to wombii-tanɩɩ. Mɩ saa laa dii arɩ Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ walɩmɛma.

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ haa bʋl arɩ ʋ maga dɩ ma keri ma penee nɛ, aŋ ka dɩ Wɩa-na laama ta, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ba ha to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ? Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa sɩ dɩ nʋʋkala maga dɩ ʋ keri ʋ peniŋ, ŋɩɩ-na mɩ fa bɩ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl Yesu sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ-la nyuŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ walɩmɛma, mɩ fa jaŋ cho dɩ ba lɩɩ ma tʋɔŋ a mʋ feri ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: Ka ma-na mɩ naambiiriŋ, Wɩa yɩrɛma nɛ dɩ ma tɩɩ ma tɩtɩa. Ma saa sɩ tɩɩ ma tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ, má sɩ́ ŋɩɩ joŋ a to ma tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ. Ama má cho dɔŋɔ a tɩma pɩpa dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto, ba tʋɔŋ wʋnyuŋ nɛ ŋ-la: “Cho ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna arɩ ŋ sɩ cho ŋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa nɛ nagɛ baga kɩaa dɩ ma gʋra kɛŋ dɔŋɔ didii, má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ma jaŋ kpʋ dɔŋɔ dɛrɛ. Má to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ lɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ

english_verse: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Ama wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma nɛ ŋ-la: Má to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ niiŋ lɛ aŋ vɩa ma tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa,

english_verse: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa la tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa arɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la wʋŋaalaa bɩ dɔŋɔɔ to. La tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa arɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la saa ŋaa dʋndɔmɔ nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la la sɩɩ chɛ la ŋaa, la bɩ ʋ wuo ŋaa.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɩɩ to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la niiŋ lɛ, wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto bɩra bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: La tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa bɩ wʋfaalɩa ŋaa. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ toba, ʋ yie ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, a ŋɩŋaa disiniŋ, a ŋɩŋaa hɩɩsɩ wɩaa,

english_verse: They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are
translation_verse: aa kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa, a ŋɩŋaa hɩl wɩaa, a bɛrɛ nɩaa, a hɩhɛ yuosuŋ, a kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ, a kɛŋ baanɩŋ, a chɩl ʋ dʋndʋŋa wɩaa, a kɛŋ dɔŋɔ pʋpɔrɛ, a lɩlɩɩ dɔŋɔ harɩŋ,

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: a kɛŋ tʋɔbɔmʋŋ, a nyʋa sɩnɩŋ a bubugi. Dɩ ba nɛ kʋ hilimi na-kala, ba nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bugi a ŋɩŋaa wʋtɔɔnʋŋ. Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kpʋrɩsɛ ma dɩgɩlaa nɛ. Mɩ saa bɩraa kpʋrɩsɛ ma dɩgɩlaa nɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba bɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: a kɛŋ sɩɩ-fɩɛlaa, a jɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kɛnɩŋ woruŋ. Wʋzɔŋ kala bɩra tuo a lɩɩ wɩaa deemba harɩŋ.

english_verse: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii, ba kpʋ ba tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa ta nɛ. Ba bɩra bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ hɩɛnʋ arɩ ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ ka to.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ la lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ la tuto ʋ niiŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la cho dɩ la bibigisi la tɩtɩa lɛ, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la ŋaa dɩ la dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa baanɩŋ sisii, a sɩ́ yarɩ-bieriŋ kɛŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, dɩ ma dɔŋɔ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ niiŋ lɛ, má dagʋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ to a lɩɩ ʋ wʋbɔmʋŋ lɛ. Má chagɩlʋ, a sɩ́ ʋ lɛ kpɩa. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ, dɩ Sɩtaanɩ sɩ́ wuo nyɩsɛ ma ma, dɩ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma kʋŋ nɛ jʋʋ wɩɩ, má pɛ ʋ lɛ. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, maa to Kirisito niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩɩna arɩ ʋ ŋaa nʋʋ nɛ, aŋ bɩ nʋʋ ŋaa, ʋʋ nyɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋkala maga dɩ ʋ chʋŋ ʋ tɩtɩa chʋga nɛ.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ dagɛ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa, dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ kʋŋkala, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagʋ nɛ.

english_verse: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa nyɩsʋ. Nʋʋkala bɩ Wɩa wuo mɔŋ. Kʋ-la ŋ sɩ duo, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋ jaŋ kʋŋ.

english_verse: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ to ʋ tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa harɩŋ, ʋ wʋŋaalɩa-la lɛ nɛ Wɩa jaŋ to a dɔgɩsʋ. Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la niiŋ, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ a timu.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la lɔl wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ. Dɩ la nɛ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a lɔl aŋ nyalɩmɛ, dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, Wɩa jaŋ tinla.

english_verse: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord. Final Warnings
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ la nɛ wuolo, la ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nʋʋkala lɛ, a wasa nyaŋ la dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii a ŋaa kʋbala. Chagɩlɩŋ arɩ Chʋɔlaa

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Ma na mɩ ŋmʋnsʋŋ sɩ barɩma ŋɩɩ. Mɩ tɩtɩa nɩsɩŋ nɛ mɩ kaa ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩma.

english_verse: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba dagɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ baa to Juu tɩŋŋaa wombiiŋ, ba nɩɩ fʋgɛma dɩ ma keri ma penee. Ba laa dii arɩ Kirisito sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ba wɩaa nɛ. Ama ba bɩ chɛ dɩ nɩaa to ŋɩɩ lɛ a dɔgɩsɛba.

english_verse: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa sɩ keri ba penee, ba bɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile ka to. Baa chɛ dɩ ma keri ma penee dɩ ba wuo bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ ma maa to Juu tɩŋŋaa wombii-la nɛ.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ-na, mɩ jaŋ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ-la nyuŋ dʋndʋŋa wɩaa. A tɩŋ ʋ sɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, dʋnɩa wɩaa nagɛ wʋsʋʋnɩ nɛ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ ma nagɛ nɩsʋʋ dʋnɩa wɩaa teeŋ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ wɩɩ kɛnɛ dɩ la keri la penee koo dɩ la bɩ kere. Wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩ nɛ, dɩ la bɩrɩmɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩ-falɩɩ-la.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ to wɩɩŋ deeŋ, Wɩa jaŋ fá ba nenige a leŋ dɩ ba hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa, ba dɩ Wɩa nɩaa kala. Ba nɛ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa tɩtɩa Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: A lɩɩ jɩnɩŋ a kaa mʋmʋ, nʋʋkala bɩra sɩ́ mɩ walɩmʋ. Fʋfʋʋnʋ-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ mɩ yaraa lɛ, ba nɩɩ dagʋ arɩ mɩ ŋaa Yesu nʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ ma Wɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ a laa Yesu Kirisito dii arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Kirisito Yesu nanzɔɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ. Wɩa sɩ to Kirisito lɛ a pɛ la lɛ

english_verse: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la dɛnnɛ Wɩa. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito Nyɩmma. La dɩ Kirisito sɩ ŋaa kʋbala nɛ tɩɩ ʋ pɛ la lɛ a joŋ wʋzɔŋ na-kala sɩ lɩɩ ʋ teeŋ a pɩla.

english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: Ka dɩ ʋ-na suomo ŋaa dʋnɩa, ʋ to Kirisito lɛ nɛ a lɩɩsɛla, dɩ la kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, a sɩ́ cheeri kala kɛŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ. A tɩŋ Wɩa sɩ chola wɩaa,

english_verse: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
translation_verse: ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ bɩɩna bil nɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ to Yesu Kirisito lɛ nɛ a leŋ dɩ la ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ. Ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ la wuo dɛnnʋ, a leŋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ fá la nenige. Ʋ Bii-choolii-la ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩla lɛ nɛ ʋ to a pɛ la lɛ.

english_verse: Christ sacrificed his life's blood to set us free, which means our sins are now forgiven. Christ did this because of God's gift of undeserved grace to us. God has great wisdom and understanding,
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩla. Ʋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa lɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩla.

english_verse: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ leŋ la jɩŋ ʋ wɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ faa, wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ to Kirisito lɛ a ŋaa pɩla.

english_verse: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ kʋŋkala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ kala, dɩ Kirisito ŋaa ba kala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: God always does what he plans, and this is why he appointed Christ to choose us.
translation_verse: Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ arɩ ʋ chɛnɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ yie ŋaa wɩɩkala. Ʋ to Kirisito lɛ nɛ a lɩɩsɛla a leŋ la ŋaa ʋ nɩaa, arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ bɩɩna bil faafaa kala.

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ joŋ la yɩɛlaa hɛ Kirisito lɛ, dɩ la wuo leŋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: Ma ma kʋ ŋaa Kirisito nɩaa nɛ bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba, Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ laa nɩaa tɩta. Ma sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ, Wɩa joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ma lɛ nɛ a magɩlɛma, kʋ-la ʋ fa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii.

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ʋ sɩ joŋo hɛ la lɛ nɛ sɛnɛ daga arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, maachie la jaŋ dii kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa bil ʋ nɩaa lɛ, aŋ laa ʋ nɩaa ta. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ. Pɔɔl chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a pɩ Ɛfɛsɩs nɩaa

english_verse: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ laa La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa dii arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ cho Wɩa nɩaa ma nɛ.

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ, dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa na-kala, mɩ yie lʋlɔllʋ nɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa. Mɩ yie liisi ma wɩaa nɛ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩma.

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: Mɩ yie sʋl Wɩa, La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito Nyɩmma, Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ, dɩ ʋ pɩma wʋjɩmɩŋ, a bɩra kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa ma kaa dagɛma ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ dɩ ma wuo jɩmʋ.

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ yɩrɛma dɩ ma wuo jʋʋ ʋ kuorii-la tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ, mɩɩ sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ wuo suri ma tʋɔŋ dɩ ma wuo jɩŋ kʋ-la ma sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ nagɩsɩŋ, a bɩra jɩŋ kɩalɩŋ ma dɩ Wɩa nɩaa kala sɩ jaŋ dii zɔmʋŋ.

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩraa sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ wuo leŋ dɩ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ dol-bal-la sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii teeŋ. Ʋ yie to ʋ dol-bal-la lɛ nɛ a tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: Dol-la tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ kaa chɩsɛ Kirisito sʋʋŋ lɛ a leŋ ʋ hɔŋ ʋ nadiiŋ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ kɩɩ kɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ bɩ na ka ba kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ leriŋ. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ a kɩɩ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ arɩ dʋnɩa-la sɩ jaŋ bɩra kɔ lɛ.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Wɩa joŋ kʋŋkala doluŋ a hɛ Kirisito nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a bɩra leŋ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa kala kʋhɩaŋ ma.

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi nɛ ŋaa Yesu yaraa. Nɩalɩŋ nɛ leŋe Kirisito ŋaa nɩ-piliŋ, ʋ ma leŋ kʋŋkala ŋaa kʋpiliŋ wɩɩkala lɛ.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: Ma fa naga arɩ ma sʋba nɛ a tɩŋ ma wʋcheelee arɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: Ma faa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a ŋɩŋaa dʋnɩa deeŋ tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa, a tuto Sɩtaanɩ. Sɩtaanɩ nɛ ŋaa jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ kala kuoro, ʋ nɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa ka to.

english_verse: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
translation_verse: La ma kala fa nagɛ ba nɛ a tuto la tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa harɩŋ a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ, a bɩbɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. La fa sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba, Wɩa fa na baanɩŋ nɛ la nyuŋ, arɩ ʋ fa sɩ na baanɩŋ nɩalɩŋ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: a leŋ la dɩ Kirisito kala kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. La wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ fa leŋe la sʋʋ nɛ. Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ nɛ ʋ laama ta.

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Wɩa ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ wuo dagɛla ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ nɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige a kaa mʋ maachie kala. Ʋ to Kirisito lɛ a dagɛ ʋ zile sɩ yʋga ŋɩɩ la lɛ.

english_verse: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
translation_verse: Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ laama ta, a tɩŋ ma sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii. Ʋ bɩ naga ma tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa laama ta, ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩma chɔgɩta nɛ.

english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ naga ma tɩntɩŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ʋ laama ta. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ bibigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ ŋaala. Ʋ ŋaala dɩ la dɩ Kirisito Yesu ŋaa kʋbala nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ. Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba bil la lɛ faa faa kala nɛ dɩ la ŋɩŋaaba. Nuhuobiinee kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ Kirisito teeŋ

english_verse: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, má sɩ́ yʋ arɩ Juu tɩmma-la fa sɩ keri ba penee kɛŋ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ma penee keri yɩyɩrɛ peŋ-puru tɩmma nɛ. Ama nuhuobiine nɛ keri ba penee.

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: Ma bɩra sɩ́ yʋ arɩ bʋa kʋbala lɛ ma fa bɩ Kirisito jɩŋ. Ma dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa bɩ wɩɩ pɛ, ma fa nagɛ nʋhʋɔra nɛ. Wɩa fa sɩ bil nii-la ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ nɩaa lɛ, ma-na fa bɩ ba lɛ pɛ. Ma fa bɩ kʋŋkala ka yɩɛlɛ, ma fa hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nɛ a bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Ma dɩ Wɩa pɛgɛ fa bolie nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ma dɩ Kirisito sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ, ʋ joŋ ʋ chalɩŋ jaasɛ ma wɩaa nɛ, a kɛŋ ma dɩ Wɩa kʋ kpagɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Kirisito tɩtɩa nɛ leŋe la sɩŋ, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ ba kʋ ŋaa kʋbala. Ʋ sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ nɛ giri dʋndɔnnɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ la pɛgɛ ta.

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ sʋba ŋɩɩ, ʋ leŋe wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga bɩra bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa kala to ʋ lɛ nɛ a bɩrɩmɛ nɩfalɩa a sɩŋ.

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: Kirisito sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ leŋe ba dʋndɔnnʋ-la dɛrɛ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ leŋe ba kala balɩa to ʋ lɛ nɛ a ŋaa kʋbala, ʋ kɛŋ ba dɩ Wɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ ba sɩŋ.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: Kirisito nɛ kɔ a bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ kʋkɔ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ arɩ Wɩa pɛgɛ fa sɩ bolie, arɩ nɩalɩŋ ma fa sɩ kpagɛ Wɩa kala.

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Kirisito lɛ nɛ la nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ la nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa kala to a kɛŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la, a jaŋ wuo mʋ la Nyɩmma Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Ma saa bɩra bɩ nʋhʋɔraa ŋaa, ma bɩ jʋjʋʋlʋ ma ŋaa. Ma dɩ Wɩa nɩaa kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ a ŋaa Wɩa dɩa nɩaa.

english_verse: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
translation_verse: Ma nagɛ tie-biee Wɩa sɩ kaa sɩsaa ʋ dɩa nɛ. Wɩa nanzɔɔba arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ ŋaa dɩa-la gentine. Kirisito Yesu tɩtɩa nɛ ŋaa tie-bii-duo-la ba sɩ kaa bil dɩa-la gentine.

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ chagɛ dɩa-la kala bil ʋ kʋ ŋaa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, La Tɩɩna Yesu dɩa-la.

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: Ma dɩ Kirisito sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ, ma dɩ Wɩa nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kala nɛ ʋ kaa saa Wɩa dɩa deeŋ, ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ jʋjʋʋ.

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma arɩ ma ma nɩɩ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsɛmɛ ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ dɩ mɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ ma teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Teŋ-la mɩ fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩma mɩ bʋl wɩaa mʋa, a dagɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ fa sɩ faa a kaa dagɛmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ karɩmɛ teŋ-la, ma jaŋ na ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ leŋe mɩ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ fa sɩ faa a tɩgɛ Kirisito lɛ.

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: Wɩa fa bɩ leŋe nʋʋkala jɩŋ wɩaa deemba, ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ to ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ lɛ nɛ a joŋ wɩalɩŋ dagɛ ʋ nanzɔɔba-la sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla arɩ ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa.

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩa to Kirisito Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la lɛ nɛ a leŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ma kɛŋ toruŋ kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa lɛ. Lɛɛlɛ ba kala pɛ Kirisito yaraa lɛ nɛ a tɩŋ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa. Ba ma jaŋ pɛ dii kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ to Kirisito Yesu lɛ a bʋl dɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Wɩa leŋe mɩ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, dɩ mɩ bʋl Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩaa. Ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ nɛ ʋ dii zile mɩ lɛ a joŋ ʋ doluŋ pɩmɛ mɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɩaa kala tʋɔŋ, mɩ nɛ ŋaa ba kʋbie, aŋ ka ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, dɩ ba jɩŋ Kirisito dʋa-la sɩ bɩ dɩdɛrɩ kɛnɛ wɩaa,

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: a bɩra leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ to a ŋaa ʋ wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ faa. Wɩa nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ ta kʋŋkala, ʋ fa joŋ wɩalɩŋ faa faafaa kala nɛ.

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: Wɩa ka chɛ dɩ ʋ to nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi lɛ, a leŋ Wɩa bii-zɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ Wɩa bii-bɔŋŋɔɔ kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ jɩŋ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ ŋɩɩ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: Wɩa fa bɩɩnɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ faafaa kala nɛ a lɛɛlɛ to La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ a leŋ wɩalɩŋ sɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
translation_verse: La sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ, la bɩ jaŋ fɩfá fawʋllʋŋ. La jaŋ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a mʋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Mɩ saa sʋlma dɩ má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tʋɔŋ chei a tɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa. Mɩ sɩɩ na hɛɛ-la jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma laa yɩrɩŋ. Pɔɔl bɩra sʋl Wɩa a pɩ Ɛfɛsɩs nɩaa

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ hɛ doho kala yɩrɩŋ, kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ ŋɩɩ, mɩɩ sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ pɩma doluŋ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩra sʋlʋ dɩ ma wuo laa Kirisito wɩaa dii woruŋ, dɩ ʋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ a leŋ dɩ ma chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ a cho nɩaa.

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩraa sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɩma doluŋ, dɩ ma dɩ ʋ nɩaa kala wuo jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Kirisito sɩ faasa choma kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ Kirisito chono-la sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ nɛ kɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ wuo jɩŋ. Mɩɩ sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma nagɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ naga.

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi to Kirisito Yesu lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ a lɩɩ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ mɩ-na Pɔɔl tɔ dɩa a tɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa nɛ. Ma nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ yɩra, mɩɩ sʋlma dɩ ma leŋ dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa joŋ wombiiŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ma sɩaa tuu tinteeŋ, a pɛ kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri, a kɛŋ kenyiri, a joŋ wɩaa chɩchɛ dɔŋɔ, a tɩŋ ma sɩ cho dɔŋɔ wɩaa.

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: Má hɛ doluŋ aŋ kɛŋ nii-maga-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ pɩma. Má kɛŋ dɔŋɔ woruŋ a fɩɛla hɔŋ sɔm.

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: La kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ a tɩŋ Kirisito wɩaa. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ la lɛ, ma ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Wɩa sɩ yɩrɛla ŋɩɩ, la kala ka yɩɛlɛ wʋbala nɛ.

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-bala dʋndʋŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, a ŋaa la kala Nyɩmma. Ʋ nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala. Ʋ kɛŋ la kʋŋkala tɩtɩŋ nɛ, a hɛ la kala tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us.
translation_verse: Kirisito joŋ kɩaa dii zile la kʋŋkala lɛ nɛ a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a bʋl, “Ʋ sɩɩ jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ, ʋ pɛ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yuo dii nɛ, aŋ joŋ kɩaa dii zile nɩaa lɛ.”

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ sɩ ʋ jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ daga arɩ ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ a kʋ tuu tinteeŋ.

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la tɩtɩa sɩ kʋ tuu tinteeŋ, ʋ nɛ bɩra jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ ŋɩɩ a kieli lere-la kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, dɩ ʋ wuo hɛ lee-kala.

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: Ʋ pɛ la lɛ ŋɩɩ a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ la kala sɩ jaŋ wuo kʋ chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii lɛ, a wuo kʋ jɩŋ Wɩa Bie sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ, a kʋ ŋaa nɩduoru Wɩa wɩaa lɛ, a wuo kʋ nagɛ Kirisito sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ wɩɩkala lɛ.

english_verse: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ-na la bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa hambiisi Wɩa wɩaa lɛ, dɩ wʋwogusu-la nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ dagʋ a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa wɩaa lɛ kɛnla begili. La bɩ jaŋ to nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa, a kɛŋ badɛrɩŋ nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩaa, dɩ ba joŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii ta.

english_verse: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ ŋaa la kala nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ nandaasɩ-la kala nɛ mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a tɩtɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa woruŋ, yara-la jaŋ waa a tɩŋ ba sɩ cho dɔŋɔ. Mɩɩ-falɩɩ-la la sɩ kɛnɛ Kirisito teeŋ

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: Birimiŋ tɔ ba wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ. Ba bɩ jaŋ wuo na mɩɩsɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩ nɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ, ba dɩgɩlaa ma bɩ wɩaa ka nɩɩ.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: Ma nɩɩ Yesu wɩaa nɛ, ba dagɛma wʋtɩtɩɩ-la kala sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ.

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má joŋ ma bumbuŋ mɛlɛ-la ta. Mɛlɛ-la fa nyɩsɛma nɛ a cheima.

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ Wɩa kɛŋ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala bɩrɩmɛ dɩ ba ŋaa kʋfalɩa.

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ tʋɔbɩɩŋ falɩa-la nagɛ gɛrɩŋ ma sɩ laala. Wɩa ŋaama dɩ ma nagʋ nɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ a sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ.

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Sɩtaanɩ na wombiiŋ a nyɩsɛma dɩ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala fa sɩɩ gaa, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ leŋ gaarɩŋ, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa faasa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ a wuo na kʋ-la kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ, aŋ wuo pɛ summoo ma lɛ.

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wʋbɔŋ kala lɩɩ ma niiŋ lɛ. Má bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩɩ jʋʋ nɩaa dɩgɩlaa bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga, a leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ bʋl pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ jegili ba lɛ.

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ tʋɔŋ chei. Ʋ nɛ Wɩa joŋo hɛ ma lɛ, ʋ ŋaa magɩlɩŋ ma lɛ a dagɛ arɩ Wɩa jaŋ laama ta tapʋlɩɩ-la Kirisito sɩ́ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ jʋʋ ma lɛ, má sɩ́ joŋo hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ. Má sɩ́ tɛrʋ, má sɩ́ baanɩŋ na. Má sɩ́ goŋ ŋaa nɩaa nyuŋ. Má sɩ́ nɩaa yɩrɩŋ chichei. Má sɩ́ nʋʋkala bɛrʋ.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_verse: Ama má kɛŋ zile dɔŋɔ lɛ, a fɩfá dɔŋɔ nenige. Má joŋ wɩaa chɩchɛ dɔŋɔ, arɩ Wɩa sɩ to Kirisito lɛ a joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala chɛma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: Ma ŋaa Wɩa bii-chooloo nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má chichesi Wɩa wʋŋaalaa.

english_verse: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Má cho dɔŋɔ arɩ Kirisito sɩ chola ŋɩɩ a sʋʋ la wɩaa. Ʋ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɩ Wɩa nɛ, ba kpʋʋ arɩ ba sɩ yie kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ Wɩa ŋɩɩ, ʋ sʋɔra sɩŋ.

english_verse: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ ma lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ lɛ, a bɩra lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa disiŋ kala lɛ, a sɩ́ tʋɔ-luŋuŋ kɛŋ.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma jɩŋ woruŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ koo nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa disiniŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔ-luŋuŋ [tʋɔ-luŋuŋ nagɛ vʋɩ-kpaarɩŋ nɛ], nɩaa deemba kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ dii kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa bil ʋ nɩaa lɛ, ʋ-na Wɩa arɩ Kirisito kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala kɛŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ a nyɩsɛma. Wɩaa deemba nɛ leŋe Wɩa baanɩŋ sisii nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ niiŋ ka to nyuŋ.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa nɩdosunuŋ deemba lɛ.

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala lɛ ma ma fa hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, ama La Tɩɩna Yesu leŋe ma lɛɛlɛ hɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má leŋ dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: Pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ nɩaa ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, tʋɔpʋl wɩaa arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩba.

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: Má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa birimiŋ tʋɔŋ wɩalɩŋ nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ. Má joŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ ta, a leŋ dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa bɩ zɔŋ.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Ʋ paala kɛŋ hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ dɩ la bʋl wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ lʋaraa ŋaa.

english_verse: But the light will show what these things are really like.
translation_verse: Kʋŋ na-kala lɛ nɛ dɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ chaana hɛ, ba yie na kʋ-la nagɩsɩŋ kala nɛ.

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ba bʋl, “Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɩŋ doŋ a nagɛ ma sʋba, má sii doŋ lɛ. Kirisito jaŋ chaana hɛ ma lɛ.”

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ nɩyaara ŋaa, má hɛ doluŋ a jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa tʋɔŋ a ŋɩŋaaba.

english_verse: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ sɩnɩŋ nyʋa bubugi, dɩ ma nɛ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bubugi, ŋɩɩ jaŋ cheima. Ama má leŋ dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ma lɛ a tɩtɩŋ.

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala lɛ arɩ wɩɩ-na kala lɛ, má lɔllɛ la Nyɩmma Wɩa, La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Haalaa arɩ ba balaba mɛlɛ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Haalaa, má tuto ma balaba niiŋ arɩ ma sɩɩ to Kirisito ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa baalaa nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ ba haalaa nyuŋ arɩ Kirisito sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ ŋɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii aa hilimi nyuŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi nɛ ŋaa ʋ yaraa, ka ʋ ŋaa ba Laataara.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Baalaa, má cho ma haalaa, arɩ Kirisito sɩ cho nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii aa hilimi ŋɩɩ, ʋ sʋʋ ba wɩaa,

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta, a fo ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala ma ta arɩ lɩɩŋ, a tɩŋ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nɩa wɩaa.

english_verse: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii aa hilimi, dɩ ba wuo zɔŋ kɩŋkɛŋ, a sɩ́ disiŋ koo wʋcheeli kala kɛŋ, dɩ wʋbɔŋ kala sɩ́ ba lɛ lagɩsʋ, a sɩ́ nyɔɔ kala kɛŋ.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ cho nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii aa hilimi ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ maga dɩ baalaa cho ba haalaa, arɩ ba sɩ cho ba tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ. Baal-la kala sɩ cho ʋ haala, ʋ cho ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa bɛrɛ, ama ʋ cho ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ a bibeŋ ʋ tɩtɩa nyuŋ woruŋ, arɩ Kirisito sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii aa hilimi nyuŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: Kirisito yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa la ŋaa ʋ nandaasɩŋ nɛ a mɛrɛ ʋ yaraa lɛ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ baala yie leŋ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ, ka ʋ dɩ ʋ haala mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a kɛŋ chal-bala.”

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Wʋkpuŋkpere deeŋ ŋaa wʋbal nɛ a faa. Mɩ saa jɩma arɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ mʋʋ tɩgɛ Kirisito arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii aa hilimi lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Ʋ saa nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ ma ma lɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ nʋʋkala cho ʋ haala arɩ ʋ sɩ cho ʋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ haala ma zil ʋ bala.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Hambiisiŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma tuto ma nyɩmmaba arɩ ma naamba niiŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɩɩ to Wɩa wombiiŋ.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
translation_verse: Ma nyɩmmaba, má sɩ́ ma biiriŋ walɩmʋ kɩŋkɛŋ dɩ ba baanɩŋ sisii ma nyuŋ. Má bemba a dagɛba woruŋ Yesu Kirisito wombiiŋ lɛ. Pɔɔl bʋl yosuŋ arɩ ba tɩŋŋaa wɩaa

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Ma yosuŋ, má tuto nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩɩma niiŋ. Má zizilba a fɩfába. Má kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a tutoba arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ to Kirisito.

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tɩŋŋaa bemma aŋ ka ma-na tɩtɩŋ woruŋ, a sɩ́ chɛ dɩ ma tɩŋ dɩ ba bɛsɛ ma lɛ. Ama má tɩŋ arɩ ma tɩmaa pɩ Kirisito nɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-bala, a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ cho.

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ tɩtɩŋ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa, a nagɛ ma tɩma pɩpɩ Kirisito nɛ, nuhuobiine dee ma tɩmaa pa.

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: Ma jɩŋ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ zɔŋ, La Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ joŋ kʋzɔŋ a timu, dɩ tɩɩna ŋaa yomo koo ʋ tɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ.

english_verse: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ yosuŋ, má kɛmba woruŋ, má sɩ́ ba walɩmʋ. Ma jɩŋ arɩ ma kala tɩɩna ŋaa kʋbala nɛ a hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ. La kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ bɩ la kaa pɔrɛ. Kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩla dɩ la kaa yuo Sɩtaanɩ

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Má paa ma bayuori kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma laalɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ wuo pɔ dɩ Sɩtaanɩ sɩ́ wuo kɛŋ ʋ badɛ wɩaa nyɩsɛma.

english_verse: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
translation_verse: Ama la bɩ naga nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yuo nuhuobiinee. Laa yuo Sɩtaanɩ arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo nɛ, arɩ kʋŋkala sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ teeŋ. Dʋnɩa deeŋ arɩ dol-bɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, ba nɛ laa yuo.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má laalɛ laalɩyuori kɩaa Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma, dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba ŋaa ma lɛ, dɩ ma wuo kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ chɩna gbɛrɛ.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: Má chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ, má leŋ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la ma sɩ nɩa nagɛ ma laalɩyuori damɛrɛ a vɔɔ ma tɩŋa lɛ, a leŋ dɩ tʋɔpʋla nagɛ ma hɔɔŋ-bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ-gɛrɩŋ a tɔ ma harɩŋ arɩ ma sɩpaaŋ kala,

english_verse: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
translation_verse: a leŋ dɩ ma sɩ kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ ŋɩɩ dɩ ma bʋl Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩɩ pɩ fɩɛlɩŋ nagɛ ma laalɩyuori nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ ma hɛ.

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ, má leŋ dɩ ma Wɩa laa diiniŋ dol a nagɛ hɔɔ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛ ba bɔyɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ wuo kɛrɛ laa ma dʋndɔmɔ hɛŋŋɛɛ kala sɩɩ chol nyiŋgeliŋ dɩ ba dɩsɛ.

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ laama ta ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ nagɛ hɔɔŋ nyuŋ-chu-gbaŋkogo nɛ ma joŋo chu, aŋ joŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ tokobiiŋ a kori. Tokobii-la nɛ ŋaa Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people.
translation_verse: Má chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa bʋa na-kala lɛ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la doluŋ lɛ, a sʋsʋlʋ wɩɩ-wɩɩkala lɛ. Ma sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, má pɔ woruŋ a sɩ́ doŋ dɩɛgʋ, aŋ pɛsɛ, a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩ Wɩa nɩaa ma.

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: Má sʋl Wɩa pɩ mɩ ma dɩ mɩ nɛ suri mɩ niiŋ dɩ Wɩa dagɛmɛ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋl, a sɩ́ nʋʋkala fá, aŋ bʋl Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la fa sɩ faa a pɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩ bʋl Kirisito wʋzɔmɔ-la aa pɩ nɩaa ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛmmɛ kaa hɛ chɔrʋmɔɔ. Má sʋl Wɩa pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ wuo bʋl Wɩa wɩaa arɩ nyuduoŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ mɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ. Wʋkaanɩŋ

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito jaŋ leŋ dɩ la naambiiri-la kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a cho dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ, Wɩa jaŋ fá nɩaa deemba kala nenige.

english_verse: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl arɩ Timoti sɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito tɩntɩnnaa nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ aa pɩ Wɩa nɩaa kala sɩ hɛ Fɩlɩpa lɛ a laa Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii. La ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛ nɩhɩasɩ-la lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Pɔɔl chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩ Fɩlɩpa nɩaa

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ma pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩaa. Ma pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ a lɩɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: Mɩ laa dii arɩ Wɩa sɩ pɛ ma lɛ ma tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-zɔmɔ-la ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma tɩma mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sɩ jaŋ kɔ.

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ bɩɩnɛ ma wɩaa nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ ŋaa wombii nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma kala pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ la tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ. Ma pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ bumbuŋ-la mɩ fa sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa, arɩ lɛɛlɛ ma kala ba sɩ kɛmmɛ tɔ dɩa a tɩŋ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ la kala dii dansɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la lɛ arɩ ba ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, a leŋ nɩaa laa dii a chɩŋ ba lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ bɩɩnɛ ma wɩaa nɛ woruŋ. Wɩa nɛ ŋaa mɩ pɛ-naara wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ. Mɩ choma nɛ woruŋ arɩ Kirisito Yesu sɩ choma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma cho dɔŋɔ, dɩ chono-la wasa yʋgɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, a bɩraa sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɩma wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ ma wuo jɩŋ wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩɩ-la jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma lɩɩsɛ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a ŋɩŋaa. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ wuo lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa disiniŋ lɛ, a sɩ́ wɩɩkala ŋaa chei a mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la Kirisito sɩ jaŋ kɔ.

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma to Yesu Kirisito lɛ a wasa ŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa dɩ nɩaa na a dɛnnɛ Wɩa dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ. Pɔɔl sɩ dɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa bil a mʋ tɩgɛ Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa wɩaa

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ leŋe Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩɩ bʋl wasa mʋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
translation_verse: Laalɩyuoro-la kala sɩɩ pɔ kuoru dɩa arɩ nʋʋkala jɩma arɩ Kirisito wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛmmɛ kaa tɔ dɩa.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩma arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ arɩ hadɔrʋŋ nɛ aa bʋl Kirisito wɩaa. Ama dɔnsʋŋ ma kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩŋ zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a bʋbʋl Kirisito wɩaa.

english_verse: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ba tʋɔbɩɩŋ zɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ a bʋbʋl Kirisito wɩaa chomi nɛ. Ba jɩma arɩ Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl Kirisito wɩaa arɩ yarɩ-bieriŋ ka to ba tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ, ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ. Mɩ sɩ hɛ bɩnɩŋ dɩa lɛ ŋ-la, baa chɛ dɩ wɩaa wasa jʋʋmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: Ama mɩ-na teeŋ ʋ bɩ wɩɩkala kɛnɛ. Dɩ tʋɔbɩɩŋ zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ koo dɩ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ba kaa bʋl, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ ba sɩɩ bʋl Kirisito wɩaa. Mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ a kaa mʋmʋ,

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jɩma arɩ ma chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩmɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa a tɩŋ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ Yesu Kirisito Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ lɛ, mɩ jɩma ba jaŋ lɩɩsɛmɛ ta.

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ kɩŋkɛŋ arɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ yɩɛlɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ a mʋ tɩgɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ tɩŋ lɛ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diimi, ama a suomi jɩnɩŋ a kaa mʋ, bʋa na-kala lɛ, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a bʋl Wɩa wɩaa. Dɩ sʋʋŋ nɛ koo waaŋ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ Kirisito tɩntɩmɩɩ-la, dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na teeŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ lɩɩ Kirisito teeŋ nɛ, dɩ mɩ nɛ sʋba ma, mɩ jaŋ na nyʋʋrʋŋ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: Mɩ hɛ wɩaa deemba balɩa pɛgɛ nɛ. Mɩ fa cho nɛ woruŋ dɩ mɩ lɩɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ a mʋ Kirisito teeŋ. Ʋ nɛ kpɩa mɩ sɩ jaŋ hɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: Mɩ laa wɩɩŋ deeŋ dii nɛ arɩ mɩ jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, a wuo pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma waa a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ, aŋ pɛ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ ba lɛ.

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ mɩ nɛ mɩɩra kɔ ma teeŋ, ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ Yesu Kirisito lɛ a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ nɛ, má leŋ dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa tuto Kirisito wʋzɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ mɩ nɛ hɛ ma teeŋ koo dɩ mɩ tuo, mɩ jaŋ wuo nɩɩ arɩ ma faasa chɩŋ nɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ a kɛŋ nii-bala, a leŋ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa ŋaa kʋbala, a faasa hɛ doluŋ a pɩpɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la ma sɩ laa dii lɛ.

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma a mʋ tɩgɛ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Ma kɛŋ nyuduoŋ bʋa na-kala ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba chaasa jɩŋ arɩ ba jaŋ lɛl, ama Wɩa jaŋ laa ma-na ta.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Ma-na, Wɩa nɛ pɩma wombiiŋ dɩ ma laa Kirisito wɩaa dii aŋ pɛ na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ ʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ ma pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ la yuo laal-la, laal-la ma fa sɩ na dɩ mɩɩ yuo, a bɩra nɩɩ dɩ mɩ haa yuo.

english_verse: Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others.
translation_verse: Ma sɩɩ to Kirisito, ŋɩɩ leŋe ma nyuŋ nyaasɛ nɛ, ʋ chonuŋ leŋe ma tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma leŋ ma ŋaa kʋbala, a kɛŋ zile dɔŋɔ lɛ a fɩfá dɔŋɔba nenige.

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má kɛŋ tʋɔ-bala, a wasa cho dɔŋɔ, a kɛŋ nii-bala, ŋɩɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Ma mɛlɛ maga dɩ ʋ nagɛ Yesu Kirisito mɛlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa kɛŋ Wɩa nagɩsɩŋ nɛ, ama ʋ fa bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa joŋo arɩ ʋ dɩ Wɩa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ, ʋ joŋ ʋ Wɩa nagɩsɩŋ bil nɛ, aŋ nagɛ tɩntɩnnʋ. Ba lʋlʋ ʋ nagɛ nuhuobiiŋ. Nɩaa naʋ arɩ ʋ ŋaa nuhuobiiŋ.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa Wɩa chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ a kɛnʋ kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ, a pʋ yɩrɩ-la sɩ yʋga kɩɩ yɩrɩ na-kala.

english_verse: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ, kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ arɩ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ, ba kala jaŋ tuu kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlʋ.

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala jaŋ suri ʋ niiŋ a bʋl arɩ Yesu Kirisito nɛ ŋaa ʋ Tɩɩna, dɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ. Má chaanɛ a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa dʋnɩa lɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambii-chooloo, má tuto mɩ niiŋ arɩ ma fa sɩɩ to ŋɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ. Lɛɛlɛ mɩ tuo ma teeŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ma ha to mɩ niiŋ. Wɩa laama ta nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa má fáʋ, aŋ kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri a tɩtɩŋ, a na kʋ-la ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma.

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa, Wɩa hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ a kɛmma tɩtɩŋ, dɩ ma cho dɩ ma ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: Do everything without grumbling or arguing.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa wɩɩkala, má sɩ́ kaalɛrɛ koo a gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma a sɩ́ wʋcheeli kala kɛŋ. Ma jaŋ ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ a hɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ tʋɔŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Ma chaanɛ nɩaa deemba tʋɔŋ a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ chaanɛ ŋɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ.

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ maga dɩ ma tuto Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɩ mɩɩsɩŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ wuo bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩ tɩma, tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sɩ jaŋ kɔ. Ŋ-la nɛ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩ tɩma bɩ pɛɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba paala kpʋmɛ dɩ mɩ chalɩŋ jaasɛ a nagɛ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a tɩŋ ma sɩ laa Wɩa dii a ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ʋ sɩpaaŋ, mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ mɩ dɩ ma kala jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má ma leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ dɩ la kala jʋjʋɔsɛ. Pɔɔl bʋl Timoti arɩ Epafurodaatus wɩaa

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ yɩɛlɛ arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu doluŋ lɛ mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ Timoti dɩ ʋ kɔ ma teeŋ lɛɛlɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ ma teeŋ aŋ mɩɩra kʋ bʋl ma wɩaa pɩmɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: Ʋ dʋndʋŋ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ chɩl ma wɩaa arɩ mɩ ma sɩ chɩl ma wɩaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ chɩl ba tɩtɩa wɩaa nɛ, ba bɩ Yesu Kirisito wɩaa chɩla.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Ma ma tɩtɩa jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Timoti sɩ naga nɛ. Ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ bʋbʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a nagɛ bie sɩ yie pɛ ʋ nyɩmma lɛ ba tɩtɩŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ kʋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ wɩaa sɩɩ vɛŋ, mɩ jaŋ tɩmʋ dɩ ʋ kɔ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: Mɩ laa dii arɩ Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ tɩtɩa kɔ ma teeŋ, ʋ bɩ dieni.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: Mɩ bee na arɩ ʋ maga dɩ mɩ tɩŋ la naambie Epafurodaatus dɩ ʋ kɔ ma teeŋ nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔŋ nɛ aŋ pɛ ŋaa mɩ laalɩyuori dɔŋ ma. Ʋ ŋaa ma tɩndaarʋ nɛ, ma tɩmʋ ʋ kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: Ʋ faa bɩɩnɛ ma wɩaa nɛ dɩ ʋ kʋ nama, ama ʋ tʋɔŋ cheye a tɩŋ ma sɩ nɩa arɩ ʋ bɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa kɛnɛ.
