english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ wɩɩla nɛ, a fa ka mʋa dɩ ʋ sʋba, ama Wɩa fá ʋ nenige a leŋ ʋ duori. Dɩ Epafurodaatus nɛ fa sʋba, mɩ tʋɔŋ fa jaŋ faasa chei. Ama Wɩa fá mɩ nenige a bɩ leŋe ʋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ sɩɩŋ faasa fɩɛsɛ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ dɩ ʋ kɔ ma teeŋ, dɩ ma naʋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ bɩra tɔrɛ, dɩ mɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa pɩŋ dɩbala.

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ, má laaʋ woruŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Má zizil nɩdosunuŋ deemba.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, wɩɩ-la wʋkaanɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋla pɩma nɛ ŋ-la: Má jʋjʋɔsɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩma nɛ, aŋ bɩra chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ tɩtɩa ŋ-la. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ lɔlɔ arɩ wɩɩ-la bʋlʋŋ. Wɩalɩŋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ kala jʋʋ.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ vasɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛsɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma keri ma penee.

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: La nɛ paala chaasa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɛnɛ keri ba penee, bɛɛ wɩaa la-na to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ niiŋ lɛ nɛ aa chʋɔlɛ Wɩa. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, laa jʋɔsɛ Kirisito Yesu teeŋ nɛ. La-na bɩ la yɩɛlaa joŋo hɛ yaraa wʋŋaalaa lɛ.

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ lʋlmɛ, tapʋl-chorimuŋ chɛɛŋ nɛ ba keri mɩ peniŋ. Mɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩɩna tɩtɩɩ nɛ, a lɩɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Mɩ naaŋ arɩ mɩ nyɩmma ŋaa Hiburu tɩmma nɛ. Dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩma wombii-la nɛ maa to, mɩ ŋaa Farisii tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa bɩɩna wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa jaŋ kɛŋ nyʋʋrʋŋ pɩmɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ a tɩŋ Kirisito wɩaa mɩ na arɩ ba ŋaa wʋpɛɩba nɛ.

english_verse: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
translation_verse: dɩ mɩ dɩ Kirisito kala ŋaa kʋbala. Tʋɔpʋla-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ bɩ mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ lɩa, ʋ saa bɩra bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba wombiiŋ ma lɛ lɩa. Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ sɩ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ teeŋ. Tʋɔpʋla deeŋ-na lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ, ʋ joŋu pɩ nʋʋkala sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii nɛ.

english_verse: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ mɩ jɩŋ Yesu Kirisito, a wuo jɩŋ dol-la sɩ chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ, a wuo na hɛɛ-la doho ʋ sɩ na, a sʋʋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ sʋba.

english_verse: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa arɩ mɩ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ la joŋ la nyuŋ kala hɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ la sɩpaaŋ

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ bʋla, mɩ ha bɩ ba na dɛrɛ, mɩ ha bɩ nɩpʋla ma ŋaa. Mɩ haa loo nɛ dɩ mɩ na kʋ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ na Yesu teeŋ. Yesu Kirisito paala laa sɩpaaŋ yuo diimi nɛ a tɩɩmɛ.

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ joŋ mɩ sɩaa chaasɛ sɩpaaŋ nɛ a yige mʋmʋ dɩ mɩ na kʋ-la Wɩa sɩ to Yesu Kirisito lɛ a yɩrɛmɛ dɩ ʋ joŋo pɩmɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ la nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ waa Kirisito wɩaa lɛ bɩbɩɩnɛ wɩaa deemba nɛ. Dɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ nɩɩ bɩɩnɛ wɩɩ dɔŋ ma, Wɩa jaŋ kɛŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ pʋlla pɩma.

english_verse: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ la ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: Má leŋ dɩ la mʋ sɩpaaŋ a tuto wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa la fa sɩɩ to a kʋ yi lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, má kala chichesi mɩ wʋŋaalaa. Má tuto nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ la sɩ dagɛma naabʋɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
translation_verse: Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩma a tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ lɛ, aŋ ka lɛɛlɛ-na sɩlɩɩrɩŋ paala yuyuori mɩ sɩaa lɛ nɛ ka mɩɩ bʋl. Nɩaa yʋga, ba wʋŋaalaa dagɛ arɩ ba dɩ Kirisito ŋaa dʋndɔmɔ nɛ. Ba teeŋ Kirisito sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋpɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Ba dɩdɛrɩŋ, ba jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa nyiniŋ. Ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ nɛ baa to. Ba sɩɩŋ yie fɩɛsɛ hɩɩsɩ wɩaa lɛ nɛ. Ba yie bɩbɩɩnɛ dʋnɩa kɩaa dʋndʋŋa wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Ama la-na ŋaa Wɩa-jaŋ nɩaa nɛ. La hɔnɔ gbɛrɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kɔ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa la Laataara.

english_verse: has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ dol-la ʋ sɩ kaa bibeŋ kʋŋkala a kaa bɩrɩmɛ la yaraa deemba sɩ jaŋ pʋa, dɩ ba nagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa yara-la sɩ bɩ pʋa.

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ choma nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, mɩ yie bɩbɩɩnɛ ma wɩaa nɛ. Ma nɛ leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ, mɩ kɛmma ŋmuŋmoo bɔyɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambii-kpɩanaba, má chɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ.

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: La dɩhaalaa Yuodia arɩ Sɩntɩkɩ, mɩɩ sʋlma jaaŋ jaaŋ dɩ ma sɩŋ a tɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔŋ, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ pɛ haalaa deemba lɛ nɛ dɩ ba sɩŋ. Ba dɩ Kɩlɛmɛnt nɛ pɛ mɩ lɛ la bʋl Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩaa, a saa pɛ mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔnsʋ-la kala lɛ. Ba kala yɩraa nɛ hɛ mɩɩsɩŋ teŋ-la lɛ.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Má jʋjʋɔsɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ bʋa na-kala. Mɩ jaŋ bɩra bʋla pɩma dɩ ma jʋjʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ kʋŋkala wɩaa wʋwalɩmɛma, ama dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ kʋŋkala, má sʋl Wɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ kʋ-la lɛ. Má lʋlɔllɛ Wɩa, aŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ chɛ aa bil ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋ-la, Wɩa jaŋ pɩma ʋ fɩɛl-la sɩ kɩɩ nuhuobiine jɩmɩŋ. Fɩɛl-la jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala pɩŋ dɩ-bala, Yesu Kirisito doluŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, wɩɩ-la dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Má ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba, wɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ, wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wombiiŋ, wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, wɩalɩŋ sɩ daga arɩ ma cho nɩaa, wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ nɩaa sɩpaaŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa bɩbɛsɛ ma lɛ. Má joŋ ma nyuŋ hɛ wɩaa deemba lɛ.

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma, arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma, arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ nɩa dɩ mɩɩ bʋl, arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ gʋnna mɩ teeŋ, arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ na mɩɩ ŋaa, má kɛmba tɩntɩŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa fɩɛlɩŋ jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ. Pɔɔl lɔllɛ Fɩlɩpa nɩaa arɩ ba sɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ ŋɩɩ

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ jʋɔsɛ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ Wɩa teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa lɛɛlɛ ma daga arɩ ma faa bɩɩnɛ mɩ wɩaa nɛ. Faafaa-la kala ma faa bɩɩnɛ mɩ wɩaa nɛ. Ama wombiiŋ nɛ ma bɩ na dɩ ma wuo dagɛ chono-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ a pɩmɛ.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ yie nagɛ nɛ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ kʋŋ kɛnɛ, a bɩra jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ naga dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ. Mɩ gʋnnɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ bʋa na-kala koo lee-na kala lɛ, dɩ mɩ vɔgɔ koo dɩ losuŋ kɛmmɛ, dɩ mɩ kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ koo dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛŋ mʋa, mɩ sɩpaa tuo.

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa woruŋ wɩɩkala lɛ, a tɩŋ dol-la Kirisito sɩ pɩmɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ ma sɩ pɛ mɩ lɛ bʋa-la lɛ wɩaa sɩ jʋʋmɛ.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Ma Fɩlɩpa nɩaa, ma tɩtɩa jɩma woruŋ arɩ mɩ sɩ lɩɩ Masidoonia lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ suomo bʋbʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la ma teeŋ, ma pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi, ba kʋŋkala bɩ mɩ lɛ pɛ, see ma dʋndʋŋa nɛ pɛ mɩ lɛ arɩ moribiee.

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa sɩ hɛ Tɛsalonaaka tinteeŋ lɛ, ma pɛ mɩ lɛ yʋgɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ naga arɩ mɩ yie chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ laa kɩaa nɛ ma teeŋ, ama mɩ cho dɩ mɩ na arɩ ma time wasa yʋgɛ nɛ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ tɩŋ Epafurodaatus ʋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kʋ pɩmɛ, lɛɛlɛ mɩ kɛŋ kʋŋkala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ. Kɩalɩŋ paala yʋgɛ nɛ. Kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ, ba nagɛ kɩaa ba sɩ yie kpʋ pɩ Wɩa, ʋ laaba, ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ba nyuŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Wɩa-la mɩ sɩ tɩmaa pa kɛŋ kʋŋkala nɛ, ʋ jaŋ to Yesu Kirisito lɛ a pɩma kʋŋkala ma sɩɩ chɛ a yʋgɛ.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: La Nyɩmma Wɩa yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ. Chʋɔlaa

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ to Yesu Kirisito. La naambiiri-la kala ma sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ mɩ teeŋ, ba maa chʋɔlɛma.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɩaa kala sɩ hɛ daha ka chʋɔlɛma, a wasa nyaŋ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ kuori-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Siiza dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa mɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito nanzɔɔ arɩ Timoti, la naambie, laa chʋɔlɛ ma Koloosi nɩaa.

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ ma-na Wɩa nɩaa sɩ ŋaa la naambii-tɩtɩɩba Kirisito teeŋ. La Nyɩmma Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Pɔɔl lɔllɛ Wɩa Koloosi nɩaa wɩaa

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala dɩ la nɛ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa aa pɩma, la yie lɔllʋ, ʋ-na, La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito Nyɩmma,

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa la nɩa arɩ ma sɛɩ Kirisito Yesu niiŋ nɛ, a cho Wɩa nɩaa ma kala.

english_verse: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
translation_verse: Ma ŋaa ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ yɩɛlɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ pɩna gbɛrɛma nɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. Ma nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋa-la ma sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ leree yʋgɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Nɩaa yʋga a laaba dii, ba pʋŋ lere-la arɩ ba sɩ pʋŋ ŋɩɩ ma lɛ. Ba pʋŋ ŋɩɩ ma lɛ a suomi bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ jegile nɩɩ wʋzɔmɔ-la a sɛnɛ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ pɛ ma lɛ ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: Ma gʋnnɛ wɩaa deemba Ɛpafɩras teeŋ nɛ, la nɩ-choolii-la sɩ ŋaa la tɩntɩnnɩ dɔŋɔ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ. Ʋ ŋaa Kirisito tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ nɛ la nyuŋ.

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ bʋla pɩla arɩ ma cho dɔŋɔ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa, a lɩɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la la sɩ nɩɩ ma wɩaa, la chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩma nɛ a bɩ leŋ. Laa sʋl Wɩa aa pɩma dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma sɛnɛ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma ŋaa, a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ dɩgɩlɩŋ jegilee Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ pɩma.

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa kala chɩŋ Wɩa wombiiŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ a leŋ dɩ ma tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ, tɩntɩŋ-dosunuŋ kala lɛ, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ doho, dɩ ma kʋ jɩŋ Wɩa woruŋ a waa pɛ.

english_verse: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ pɩma ʋ dol-bal-la, dɩ ma wuo kɛŋ pɩɩna arɩ kenyiri, a kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: a lɔllɛ Wɩa arɩ ʋ sɩ leŋe ma ma maachie jaŋ wuo pɛ dii kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa bil ʋ nɩaa lɛ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: Ʋ laala Sɩtaanɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a kɛnla kaa mʋ hɛ ʋ bii-chooluŋ kuorii-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Kirisito nɛ nagɛ Wɩa nagɩsɩŋ kala kala, Wɩa-la la sɩ bɩ na. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa bii-bumbuŋ a kɩɩ kʋŋkala ʋ sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: Ʋ lɛ nɛ Wɩa to a ŋaa kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ, kɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ na arɩ kɩalɩŋ la sɩ bɩ na kala, a pɛ kɩalɩŋ la sɩ bɩ na ka ba kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ leriŋ. Ʋ lɛ nɛ ʋ to a ŋaa kɩaa kala, ba ŋaa ʋ kɩaa.

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, ka kʋŋkala-na hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ nɩɩ beŋ kɩaa kala ba chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi kʋhɩaŋ. Ʋ nɛ suomo bil Wɩa nɩaa gentine, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ ŋaa bumbuŋ Nɩɩ-la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ sʋba lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ kʋŋkala lɛ.

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Wɩa cho dɩ Yesu nagɛ ʋ-na Wɩa nagɩsɩŋ kala nɛ.

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: Ʋ lɛ nɛ Wɩa to ʋ dɩ kʋŋkala sɩŋ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ kala. Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ, ʋ chalɩŋ jaasɛ, ʋ ŋɩɩ nɛ leŋe Wɩa arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ dɔŋɔ nyuŋ.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Ma dɩ Wɩa sɩaa fa bɩ dɔŋɔ ka na, a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔmɔ-la ŋaanɩŋ arɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩŋ lɔrʋnʋ-la wɩaa.

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ Wɩa ŋaa ma dɩ ʋ sɩŋ nɛ a tɩŋ Kirisito sʋʋŋ wɩaa, dɩ ʋ kɛmma kaa kɔ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ arɩ tʋɔpʋla, dɩ ma sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ a sɩ́ wʋcheeli ma kɛŋ.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Kirisito jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ pɩma, dɩ ma nɛ chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ, aa yɩɛlɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la tʋɔŋ. Ma nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba ba sɩ bʋla pɩ nɩaa dʋnɩa lee-kala nɛ. Mɩ-na Pɔɔl ma kʋ ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa dɔŋɔ aa bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba. Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Pɔɔl sɩ tɩma pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩ na a pɩma lɛ. Hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩ na ma wɩaa nɛ leŋe Kirisito sɩ na hɛɛ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii aa hilimi dɛrɛ. Nɩalɩŋ nɛ ŋaa ʋ yaraa.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: Mɩ kʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ. Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ, dɩ mɩ bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa kala a pɩma.

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa fa fáa nɛ. Wɩa joŋo faa la naabalɩmaba nɛ faafaa kala a kʋ yi bʋa deeŋ lɛ. Ama lɛɛlɛ Wɩa joŋo dagɛ ʋ nɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ Wɩa lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ ŋɩɩ kɩŋkɛŋ, ka ʋ fa joŋo faa. Lɛɛlɛ ʋ dagɛ ba sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa. Wɩalɩŋ nɛ daga arɩ Kirisito hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má yɩyɩɛlɛ dɩ ma kpaa ʋ yɩrɩ-bal-la nɛ.

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: Ʋ wɩaa nɛ la bʋla pɩpɩ nɩaa. Laa kpʋrɩsɛ nʋʋkala dɩgɩlaa, aa dagɛ nʋʋ na-kala arɩ wʋjɩmɩɩ-na kala, dɩ la wuo ŋaa ba waa dɛrɛ Kirisito wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ faasa hɛ mɩ doluŋ kala nɛ a tɩtɩŋ, arɩ Wɩa sɩ joŋ ʋ dol-bal-la pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ hɛ doluŋ a faasa tɩma pɩma a pɛ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Laadisiya lɛ, arɩ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ kala ha sɩ bɩ mɩ na.

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ a kɛŋ nii-bala a cho dɔŋɔ, a wuo jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa woruŋ a mʋ dɛrɛ, a jɩŋ wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo faa bʋbʋɔŋ, wɩɩ-la nɛ ŋaa Kirisito.

english_verse: but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him.
translation_verse: Ʋ dʋndʋŋa lɛ nɛ Wɩa joŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ jɩma kala faa.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pɩpɩma dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wuo nyɩsɛma arɩ nii-sɩma.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: Mɩ tuo ma teeŋ, ama mɩɩ bɩɩnɛ ma wɩaa nɛ, a nagɛ mɩ hɛ ma teeŋ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ ma sɩ laa Yesu dii a fɩɛlɛ ma yaraa a chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ. Mɩɩ-zɔŋ-la la sɩ kɛnɛ Kirisito teeŋ

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ma naapoloo sʋʋsa jʋʋ-ʋ woruŋ, dɩ ma wuo gʋnnɛ ʋ wɩaa a waa ba lɛ a chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ, arɩ ba sɩ dagɛ ma ŋɩɩ. Má faasa lʋlɔllɛ Wɩa woruŋ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala nyɩsa kɛsɛma dɩ ma tou. Baa dagɛma nuhuobiine wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ, aa nyɩsɛma arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ. Ba to nuhuobiinee naabalɩma wɛnɩŋ nɛ a dagɛ dɩ-suomuŋ wɩaa dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ to. Wɩaa deemba bɩ Kirisito teeŋ lɩa.

english_verse: God lives fully in Christ.
translation_verse: Wɩa nagɩsɩŋ kala hɛ Yesu nuhuobiiŋ yara-la lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: Ma dɩ ʋ sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ, ma wɩɩkala chese nɛ. Ʋ nɛ kɩɩ kɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ bɩ na ka ba kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ leriŋ.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ foma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, ʋ naga ma dɩ Kirisito kala nɛ sʋba ba joŋo hugi, Wɩa chɩsɛ ma dɩ Yesu kala sʋʋ-la lɛ, a tɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii arɩ Wɩa kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
translation_verse: Faafaa-la ma fa naga ma sʋba nɛ Wɩa teeŋ a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa a bɩ ma penee ma kere. Ama Wɩa sɩ chɩsɛ Yesu sʋʋŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ leŋe ma ma kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala a chɛla nɛ.

english_verse: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩsɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la la fa sɩ ŋaa chei ba tutola chɩmɩŋ a ta nɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto sɩɩ chɛ dɩ laa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ. Kirisito sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ nɛ kpʋ wɩalɩŋ ta.

english_verse: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
translation_verse: Ʋ laa kɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ bɩ na ka ba kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ leriŋ doluŋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ yuo diiba nɛ a hɩɩsɛba nʋʋkala na.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala bil kɩsɩnɩŋ pɩma a tɩgɛ ma kʋdiilee koo kʋnyʋalaa lɛ, Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ chɛ-balaa koo chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele koo chɛ-wiesiŋ tapʋlʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
translation_verse: Kɩsɩnɩŋ deemba nagɛ kʋ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ daaliimiŋ nɛ. Kʋ-la tɩtɩa nɛ ŋaa Kirisito.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala joŋ cheeriŋ pɩma, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩɩna arɩ ba ŋaa nɩbala nɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩɩ na wɩaa a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ a pɛsɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa a muuri, a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa. Ba bɩ wɩɩkala kɛnɛ sɩ maga dɩ ba bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ. Ba yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ ba sɩ yie bɩɩnɛ ba yaraa wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: Ba bɩ Kirisito lɛ mɛrɛ, Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa la nyuŋ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa waa ʋ lɛ arɩ Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba waa ʋ lɛ arɩ nuhuobiine yaraa haŋgbel-susugusuŋ arɩ poloo sɩ mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a waa ŋɩɩ, aŋ ka nyuŋ nɛ ŋaa ba doluŋ tɩɩna.

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Ma dɩ Kirisito sɩ sʋba ŋɩɩ, wɩalɩŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ to bɩra bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ ma lɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma haa ŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, aa to kɩsɩnɩŋ deemba:

english_verse: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
translation_verse: “Má sɩ́ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ koru, má sɩ́ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ dii, má sɩ́ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ digu.”

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ kʋdiilee kɩsɩnɩ-la to. Kʋdiile-la ma sɩɩ dii, ba jaŋ dɛrɛ ma yaraa lɛ. Nuhuobiinee nɛ dagɛ kɩsɩnɩŋ deemba.

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Ba wʋdagaa deemba yie nagɛ ba kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Ba yie dagɛ dɩ nɩaa to ba-na Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ wombiiŋ, a bʋl dɩ ba muuri ba tɩtɩa, aa dɔgɩsɛ ba yaraa. Ama wʋdagaa deemba bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ nɩaa leŋ ba yaraa wʋchooloo a ta.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: Ma dɩ Kirisito kala sɩ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, máa chɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ, lee-la Kirisito sɩ hɔŋ Wɩa nadiiŋ sɛmɛ.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Má joŋ ma nyuŋ kala hɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ, aŋ sɩ́ ma nyuŋ joŋo hɛ dʋnɩa wɩaa lɛ,

english_verse: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ naga ma sʋba nɛ, ka ma mɩɩsɩŋ faa Kirisito lɛ. Ʋ nɛ hɛ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
translation_verse: Kirisito nɛ ŋaa la mɩɩsɩŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ, nɩaa jaŋ na ma dɩ ʋ kala dɩ maa kpaa ʋ yɩrɩ-bal-la. Má kpʋ dʋnɩa wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ma lɛ a ta

english_verse: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma kpʋ dʋnɩa wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ma lɛ a ta nɛ. Ba nɛ ŋ-la: Wʋlɩɩlɩŋ ŋaanɩŋ, disiniŋ ŋaanɩŋ, yaraa wʋchooloo, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩɩnɩŋ, tʋɔ-luŋuŋ. Tʋɔ-luŋuŋ-na paala nagɛ vʋɩ-kpaarɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ [sɩ bɩ ʋ niiŋ sɛyɛ] aŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩaa deemba.

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: Ma ma fa hɛ wɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ a vɛnɛɛ ŋaa wɩaa deemba.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ maga dɩ ma joŋ wɩaa deemba kala ta. Ba nɛ ŋ-la: Baanɩŋ nanɩŋ, baanɩŋ joŋo fɩɩsɩŋ, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ nɩaa lɛ, harɩ-gaaŋ arɩ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ bʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ wɩaa nyɩɛ a pɩ dɔŋɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma joŋ ma faafaa mɛlɛ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ ta nɛ

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: aŋ lɛɛlɛ tuto mɛl-falɩɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ. Wɩa leŋe ma waa mɛl-falɩŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ ma wuo jɩŋ ʋ wɩaa woruŋ a kʋ nagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nagɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Mɛl-falɩŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ ʋ bɩ wɩɩ kɛnɛ dɩ ma ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa koo ma bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, dɩ ma keri ma penee koo ma bɩ ma penee kere, dɩ ma ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa, koo dɩ ma ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩaa sɩ bɩ suro, dɩ ma ŋaa yosuŋ koo dɩ ma tɩɩ ma tɩtɩa. Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Kirisito nɛ ŋaa ba wʋnyuŋ, ʋ hɛ ba kala lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsɛma a choma a leŋ ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ma fɩfá nɩaa nenige a kɛŋ zile, a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri, a leŋ dɩ ma sɩaa fɩɛlɛ, a kɛŋ kenyiri.

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: Má nyalɩmɛ a joŋ wɩaa chɩchɛ dɔŋɔ, dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩ arɩ dɔŋɔ. La Tɩɩna sɩ joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛma ŋɩɩ, má ma joŋo chɩchɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala wʋnyuŋ nɛ chonuŋ. Chonuŋ nɛ jaŋ pɩma doluŋ dɩ ma wuo ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala woruŋ.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ fɩɛla-la Kirisito sɩ pɩma kɛmma tɩtɩŋ. Wɩa yɩrɛma dɩ ma ŋaa kʋbala nɛ a hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ, a lɔllɛ bʋa na-kala.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ kala Kirisito sɩ bʋla hɛ ma tʋɔŋ woruŋ. Má kpʋrɩsɛ dɔŋɔba dɩgɩlaa aa dagɛ dɔŋɔ arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Má yɩɩ yɩɩla-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ, arɩ Wɩa nɩaa yɩɩlaa dɔnsʋŋ, arɩ yɩɩlaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ dagɛma. Má yɩɩ ŋɩɩ a pɩ Wɩa a lɔllʋ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa koo ma sɩɩ bʋl, má ŋaa ba kala La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ a lɔllɛ la Nyɩmma Wɩa ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Wɩa nɩaa sɩ maga baa ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɔŋɔba lɛ

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Haalaa, má to ma balaba niiŋ a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ to Wɩa.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Baalaa, má cho ma haalaa, má sɩ́ ba nyuŋ tɛrʋ.

english_verse: Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
translation_verse: Hambiisiŋ, má to ma naamba arɩ ma nyɩmmaba wɩɩ na-kala lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɩɩ tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Nyɩmmaba, má sɩ́ ma biiriŋ walɩmʋ kɩŋkɛŋ dɩ ba yaraa yʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Yosuŋ, má to nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa ma tɩŋŋaa dʋnɩa lɛ wɩɩ na-kala lɛ. Má sɩ́ tɩŋ bʋa-la dʋndʋŋ lɛ ba sɩɩ bemma, aa chɛ dɩ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ. Ama má tɩŋ arɩ tʋɔ-bala a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ fá Wɩa wɩaa.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Tɩntɩmɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ tɩŋ, má tɩŋ arɩ tʋɔ-bala a nagɛ ma tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa nɛ, nuhuobiinee dee.

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ yʋ arɩ Wɩa jaŋ pɩma ma time, kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa bil ʋ nɩaa lɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. La Tɩɩna Kirisito nɛ ma tɩma pɩpa.

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa ma jaŋ laa ba time a magɛ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa. Wɩa bɩ nɩaa sɩaa lɛ nɛ bene aŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
translation_verse: Yosuŋ tɩŋŋaa, má to wʋtɩtɩɩ a joŋ magɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga a pɩ ma yosuŋ, aŋ sɩ́ yʋ arɩ ma ma kɛŋ Tɩɩna nɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
translation_verse: Má chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa bʋa na-kala a sɩ́ leŋ, a pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ, aa lɔllɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: Má pɛ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩ la ma, dɩ Wɩa wuo suri wombiiŋ pɩla dɩ la wuo bʋl Kirisito wɩalɩŋ fa sɩ faa. Ba wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛmmɛ tɔ dɩa.

english_verse: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩla dɩ mɩ wuo bʋl wɩalɩŋ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga mɩ bʋl dɩ ba pʋllɛ.

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ma wʋbʋlaa kala sɩŋ a kɛŋ bʋbʋɔŋ, dɩ ma wuo jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ to a chaarɛ nʋʋkala wɩaa sɩaa pʋ. Chʋɔlaa

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: Takɩkʋs jaŋ bʋl mɩ wɩaa kala pɩma. Ʋ ŋaa la naambii-choolii nɛ, a ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ, a ŋaa la tɩntɩnnɩ dɔŋ ma Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ tɩmʋ ma teeŋ, dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa sɩ naga a pɩla, dɩ ʋ wuo ŋaa dɩ ma nyuŋ nyaasɛ.

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: Ʋ dɩ Oniisimɔs nɛ mɩɩ tɩŋ. Ʋ ma ŋaa la naambii-choolii nɛ a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a ŋaa ma dɔŋɔ. Ba jaŋ bʋl wɩɩ na-kala sɩɩ ŋaa daha a pɩma.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Arɩsɩtakʋs ka chʋɔlɛma. Mɩ dɩ ʋ kala nɛ ba kaa tɔ dɩa. Maak-la sɩ ŋaa Banabas naambie maa chʋɔlɛma. Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ dagɛma wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ, má kɛnʋ woruŋ.

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: Yesu ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jasɩtɩs ma ka chʋɔlɛma. Nɩaa deemba batori dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔsʋŋ a lɩɩ Juu tɩmma-la sɩ laa Yesu dii tʋɔŋ, a pɛ mɩ lɛ aa bʋl Wɩa kuorii-la wɩaa. Ba ŋaa mɩ tʋɔŋ fɩɛlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Ɛpafɩras ma sɩ lɩɩ ma jaŋ ka chʋɔlɛma. Ʋ ma ŋaa Yesu Kirisito tɩntɩnna-la dɔŋɔ nɛ aa tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ʋ yie chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩma arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, dɩ ma waa dɛrɛ Wɩa wɩaa lɛ a jɩŋ woruŋ wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma ŋaa.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩma ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ faasa hɛ ʋ doluŋ kala a tɩma pɩma, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Laadisiya arɩ Hiirapolis lɛ.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Luuk, dɔgɩta-la la sɩ cho arɩ Dɩmas ka chʋɔlɛma.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ la naambiiri-la sɩ hɛ Laadisiya lɛ, arɩ Nimifa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi ʋ dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ karɩmɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩ ma nɩaa dɛrɛ, má karɩmɛ teŋ-la a pɩ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Laadisiya ma lɛ. Ka má ma laa mɩ teŋ-la Laadisiya nɩaa teeŋ a ma karɩmɛ ma tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
translation_verse: Má bʋla pɩ Akɩpas dɩ ʋ hɛ doluŋ aŋ tɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ joŋo pʋ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ mɩ-na Pɔɔl tɩtɩa nɛ ŋmʋnsa aa chʋɔlɛma. Má sɩ́ mɩ wɩaa yʋ arɩ ba sɩ tɔmɛ dɩa ma kala. Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl arɩ Sɩlas arɩ Timoti nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi a hɛ Tɛsalonaaka lɛ a ŋaa la Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito nɩaa. Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Pɔɔl lɔllɛ Wɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ Tɛsalonaaka nɩaa lɛ

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: La yie chʋɔlɛ la Nyɩmma Wɩa pɩpɩ ma kala nɛ. Dɩ la nɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, la yie lʋlɔllʋ nɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa.

english_verse: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
translation_verse: La yie liliisu ŋɩɩ ma sɩ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a tɩŋ ma sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii wɩaa, arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ cho nɩaa, arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, la jɩma nɛ arɩ Wɩa choma nɛ woruŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛma dɩ ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ la sɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩma, ʋ bɩ naga arɩ wʋbʋlʋŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ la kʋ bʋla pɩma. La sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ, Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la fa kɛŋ doluŋ, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma fa hɛ la teeŋ, ka wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ nɩa ma jʋʋ ma dɩgɩlaa woruŋ. La sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ, ma na la mɛlɛ fa sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ la kɛŋ la tɩtɩa woruŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Ma to la wʋŋaalaa harɩŋ nɛ a to La Tɩɩna Kirisito ma. Ma sɩ laa wɩalɩŋ dii ŋɩɩ, ba dɔgɩsɛma nɛ woruŋ, ama Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la leŋe ma jʋjʋɔsɛ wɩalɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ Masidoonia arɩ Akaaya tinteeŋ lɛ chɛbɛ ma lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ nɩa to ma lɛ nɛ a teeli Masidoonia arɩ Akaaya tinteeŋ kala. Ʋ ŋɩɩ dʋndʋŋa ma saa dee, lee-kala baa bʋl wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ bɩra bɩ maga dɩ la bʋl ma wɩaa pɩ nʋʋkala.

english_verse: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yie bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ ma sɩ kɛnla woruŋ bʋa-la lɛ la sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ. Ba yie bʋl ŋɩɩ ma sɩ vɩa ma vʋɩyaa ta aŋ bɩrɩma to Wɩa. Ʋ nɛ weye, ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩ-tɩtɩɩ-la.

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: Ba yie bʋl arɩ maa gbɛrɛ ʋ Bie Yesu dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa jaŋ kɔ. Ʋ nɛ Wɩa chɩsɛ sʋʋŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ laala ta tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa baanɩŋ sɩ jaŋ sii nuhuobiinee nyuŋ.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, la fa sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ ŋɩɩ, ma jɩma ʋ fa bɩ pɛɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: Aŋ ka dɩ la-na kɔ ma teeŋ Tɛsalonaaka lɛ, la fa laa sɩpaaŋ na hɛɛŋ nɛ. Ba dɔgɩsɛla woruŋ Fɩlɩpa taŋ-la lɛ. La sɩɩ chɛ la bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ ma ma, nɩaa yʋga a lɩɩ la harɩŋ. Ama Wɩa-la la sɩ tɩma pɩpa pɩla nyuduoŋ la wuo bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩma ma.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: La bɩ ma teeŋ kɔ dɩ la kʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋaa a pɩma. La bɩra bɩ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ ma kaa kɔ. La bɩ maa nyɩsɛ ma.

english_verse: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
translation_verse: Ma saa jɩma arɩ la sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ, la bɩ nii-sɩma nɛ kaa kɔ. La bɩ kɔ dɩ la bʋl kanfugi wɩaa a laa ma kɩaa. Wɩa nɛ ŋaa la sɩada tɩɩna.

english_verse: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.
translation_verse: La bɩ ma teeŋ kɔ dɩ ma nɩaa koo nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ zizilla. La sɩ ŋaa Kirisito nanzɔɔba ŋɩɩ, la fa jaŋ wuo joŋ wɩaa nyagɛma.

english_verse: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
translation_verse: Ama la bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa. La leŋe la sɩaa fɩɛlɛ ma teeŋ nɛ, a nagɛ haala sɩ yie bibeŋ ʋ biiriŋ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: La choma nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la bɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la dʋndʋŋa nɛ bʋla pɩma, ama la joŋ la tɩtɩa kala a pɩma nɛ. La ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa la chaasa choma nɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: La naambiiriŋ, ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ la fa sɩ faasa tɩŋ a na hɛɛŋ bʋa-la lɛ la fa sɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la aa pɩma. La tɩŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala nɛ, dɩ la sɩ́ ma nyuŋ hɔŋ a gbɛrɛma.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ma dɩ Wɩa kala ŋaa la sɩada tɩŋŋaa nɛ arɩ la fa sɩ hɛ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii teeŋ, la wʋŋaalaa kala fa to Wɩa wombiiŋ nɛ a ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba. La bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa chei.

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: La sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ, la kɛmma a nagɛ hambiisiŋ nyɩmma sɩ yie kɛŋ ʋ hambiisiŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: La bʋl wɩaa ma nyuŋ nyaasɛ nɛ, a leŋ ma tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala. La sʋlma nɛ dɩ ma leŋ dɩ ma mɛlɛ zɔŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Wɩa nɛ yɩrɛma dɩ ma kʋ jʋʋ ʋ kuorii-la tʋɔŋ a pɛ na ʋ tʋla.

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa, la yie lʋlɔllɛ Wɩa nɛ bʋa na-kala. La sɩ kɛŋ Wɩa wɩalɩŋ kʋ bʋla pɩma, ma laaba nɛ a sɛɩba. Ma bɩ ba joŋo arɩ ba ŋaa nuhuobiine wɩaa, ama ma sɛɩba arɩ ba sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa wɩaa nɛ, wɩalɩŋ ka tɩŋ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laaba dii lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, ma ma kʋ nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi a hɛ Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ aa to Yesu Kirisito harɩŋ nɛ. Hɛɛ-la ba sɩ na, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ ma ma na. Juu tɩŋŋaa sɩ dɔgɩsɛ ba tʋɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma ma na hɛɛŋ ma taŋ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: Juu tɩŋŋaa deemba nɛ kpʋ La Tɩɩna Yesu arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa, aŋ to naasɩŋ dɔgɩsɛ la ma. Ba ŋaa wɩaa chei Wɩa tʋɔŋ nɛ aŋ hosi nʋʋkala nyuŋ.

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: Ba paala pugila nɛ, dɩ la sɩ́ Wɩa wɩaa bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa dɩ Wɩa laaba ta. Wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa yi ba dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ. Lɛɛlɛ Wɩa baanɩŋ sii ba nyuŋ nɛ. Pɔɔl bʋla dɩ ʋ cho dɩ ʋ mɩɩra mʋ na Tɛsalonaaka tɩmma-la

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, la pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ ʋ bɩ diene, ama la tʋɔbɩɩnaa-na ha hɛ ma lɛ nɛ. La sɩ bɩ maa na ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ la faa chɛ la kʋ nama arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: La faa chɛ la kʋ nama nɛ. Mɩ-na Pɔɔl tɩtɩa paala nɛrɩgɛ nɛrɩgɛ nɛ, ama Sɩtaanɩ tɔ la wombiiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: La yɩɛlaa hɛ ma lɛ nɛ. La tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ. Dɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu nɛ mɩɩra kɔ, a tɩŋ ma wɩaa la jaŋ bigisi la tɩtɩa lɛ.

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Ma nɛ laa yɩrɩŋ pɩla. A tɩŋ ma wɩaa la yie jʋjʋɔsɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
translation_verse: La sɩ walɩma dɩ la kʋ nama a lɔl, ŋɩɩ nɛ la bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ pɛ la lɛ dɩ la nɛ hɔŋ Atɛŋ taŋ-la lɛ.

english_verse: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
translation_verse: La tɩŋ la naambie Timoti dɩ ʋ kʋ nama. Ʋ ŋaa la naambii nɛ, a ŋaa la tɩntɩnnɩ dɔŋ ma, a bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ tɩgɛ Kirisito lɛ a pɩpɩ nɩaa. La tɩmʋ dɩ ʋ kʋ bʋl wɩaa a nyaasɛ ma nyuŋ dɩ ma chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ woruŋ,

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala bɔyɛ sɩ́ joŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wʋwalɩmɩa-la sɩɩ puuma lɛ. Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛla dɩ wɩaa deemba puula.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: La fa sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ, la laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ ba jaŋ to naasɩŋ a dɔgɩsɛla. Wɩalɩŋ la sɩ bʋla pɩma kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Lɛɛlɛ ma naba nɛ.

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ Timoti sɩ lɩɩ ma teeŋ kɔ, ʋ kɛŋ wʋzɔŋ nɛ kʋ bʋla pɩla. Ʋ bʋla pɩla arɩ ma chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ nɛ a cho nɩaa ma. Ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩla arɩ ma yie liliisi la wɩaa nɛ woruŋ bʋa na-kala lɛ, a fa cho dɩ ma nala, arɩ la ma sɩ cho dɩ la nama ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa la naambiiri, laa na hɛɛŋ nɛ ka wɩaa ma wʋwalɩmɛla, ama la sɩ nɩa arɩ ma chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ ŋɩɩ, la tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ ma wɩaa.

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ-na la wiese nɛ a tɩŋ ma sɩ chɩŋ La Tɩɩna wɩalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: La bɩ jaŋ wuo lɔllɛ Wɩa a mʋ dɛrɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa. La yie jʋjʋɔsɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ nɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa.

english_verse: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
translation_verse: Laa sʋl Wɩa nɛ woruŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala dɩ la wuo kʋ nama, a wuo pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma na kɩalɩŋ sɩ ka a tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Laa sʋl la Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu dɩ ba chɛ wombiiŋ pɩla dɩ la kɔ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: La bɩraa sʋl La Tɩɩna Yesu dɩ ʋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma wasa cho dɔŋɔ, dɩ ma cho dɔŋɔ kɩŋkɛŋ a cho nʋʋkala, arɩ la sɩ choma ŋɩɩ,

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: aŋ bɩra sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ doluŋ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla la Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, a sɩ́ wʋcheeli kala kɛŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu arɩ ʋ nɩaa sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: La naambiiri, wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wʋkaanɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: La dagɛma wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma sɛnɛ ŋɩŋaa. Ama la haa sʋlma La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ dɩ ma wasa ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ma jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ joŋo dagɛma La Tɩɩna Yesu doluŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ ma sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ a lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ ma tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ to a gɔllɔ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: Bɩra, nʋʋkala sɩ́ wɩɩ ŋaa chei ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna a tɩgɛ ʋ haala lɛ. La chaasa bʋla pɩma nɛ faafaa kala a kpʋrɩsɛ ma dɩgɩlaa arɩ Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa disiŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩ la lɩɩsa dɩ la ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, ama ʋ lɩɩsɛla dɩ la ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla, nuhuobiine dee tɩɩna vɩa, Wɩa nɛ ʋ vɩa ŋɩɩ, Nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la pɩma.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a bʋla pɩma ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ cho dɔŋɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa tɩtɩa dagɛma ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ cho dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ma paala cho nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ Masidoonia lɛ nɛ. Mɩ naambiiri, la saa sʋlma dɩ ma wasa cho nɩaa kɩɩ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: La laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩma dɩ ma hɛ ma doluŋ kala a fɩɛla hɔŋ, a bibeŋ ma tɩtɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa nyuŋ a wuo nɩna ma kʋchɛɛlɛɛ.

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii jaŋ zizilma. Ma bɩ jaŋ hɔnɔ gbɛrɛ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ pɩma ma kʋchɛɛlɛɛ. Yesu jaŋ chɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii sʋʋŋ lɛ

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, laa chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la a mʋ tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba lɛ, dɩ ma tʋɔŋ sɩ́ faasa chei a nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ kʋŋkala ka yɩɛlɛ tʋɔŋ sɩ chei ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: La sɩ laa dii arɩ Yesu sʋba nɛ aŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ la ma laa dii arɩ Wɩa jaŋ chɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba la sɩ bʋlaa pɩma lɛɛlɛ, La Tɩɩna Yesu tɩtɩa nɛ dagɛla: La nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ la mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ, la bɩ jaŋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba sɩpaaŋ a mʋ Yesu teeŋ.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Bʋa kʋbala La Tɩɩna Yesu jaŋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a kʋ tuu dʋnɩa. Bʋa-la lɛ nɩaa jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ ʋ faasa kpɩa goŋ. Wɩa tɩndaaraa kʋhɩaŋ ma jaŋ kpɩa, ka dɩ ba ŋmʋʋ Wɩa nyile-la ma. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii aŋ sʋʋ, ʋ jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ chɩsɛba dɩ ba sii sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, la nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ la mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ kɛsɛla kaa pɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ chɩsa sʋʋŋ lɛ, dɩ la kala cheŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tʋɔŋ wɩa-nyuŋ. La jaŋ hɛ La Tɩɩna teeŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Encourage each other with these words.
translation_verse: Má bʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩ dɔŋɔ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ aa dagɛma tapʋlɩɩ-la arɩ bʋa-la lɛ wɩaa deemba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa,

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ma tɩtɩa jɩma woruŋ dɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu nɩɩ kɔ tapʋlɩɩ-la, ʋ jaŋ kʋ dɩ ma lɛ, a nagɛ gaara sɩ yie guu kɔ ŋɩɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɩaa sɩ jaŋ bɩɩnɛ arɩ leriŋ fɩɛla nɛ wɩɩkala tuo, cheeriŋ jaŋ guu jʋʋba. Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo fá lɛl. Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ arɩ haala sɩ kɛŋ luoruŋ, ʋ luoruŋ sii a wʋwɩɩ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ lʋl.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ naambiiri, ma-na tuo birimiŋ tʋɔŋ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ bʋa-la guu kʋ dɩ ma lɛ, a nagɛ gaara sɩ yie jʋʋ gaa nɩaa kɩaa a dɩ ba lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: Ma kala ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. La tuo tɩtaŋɩŋ koo birimiŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Tɩtaŋɩŋ nɛ nɩaa pɩpɩŋ doŋ. Tɩtaŋɩŋ ma nɛ nɩaa nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bubugi.

english_verse: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
translation_verse: Ama la-na hɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ maga dɩ la kɛŋ la tɩtɩa wɩɩ-na kala lɛ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii arɩ la sɩ cho nɩaa ŋɩɩ, má leŋ dɩ ba nagɛ hɔɔŋ bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛrɩŋ. La sɩɩ yɩɛlɛ dɩ Wɩa laala ta ŋɩɩ, má leŋ dɩ ʋ nagɛ hɔɔŋ nyuŋ-chu-gbaŋkogo dɩ la chu,

english_verse: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa bɩ la lɩɩsa dɩ ʋ na baanɩŋ la nyuŋ. Ama ʋ lɩɩsɛla dɩ ʋ to La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ nɛ a laala ta.

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: La wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ʋ sʋʋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ la nɛ sʋba koo dɩ la nɛ weye, la kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má bʋl wɩaa a nyɩnyaasɛ dɔŋɔba nyuŋ, a pɩpɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ dɩ ma wasa waa Wɩa wɩaa lɛ, arɩ ma sɩ vɛnɛɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: La naambiiri, ʋ maga dɩ ma zizil nɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna Kirisito sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ ma teeŋ aŋ pɛ ŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ ma teeŋ aa dagɛma Wɩa wɩaa.

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: Má zizilba a choba woruŋ a tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ tɩŋ wɩaa. Má hɔŋ sɔm a ŋaa sɩma dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: La naambiiri, laa sʋlma dɩ ma kpʋrɩsɛ yarɩwɩɩ tɩŋŋaa dɩgɩlaa, a pɛ fawʋlʋbaa lɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ, a pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ faasa chɩŋ Wɩa wɩaa lɛ. Má kɛŋ kenyiri arɩ nʋʋkala.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna wʋbɔŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la a timu. Ama bʋa na-kala lɛ, má ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ dɔŋɔ lɛ arɩ nʋʋkala lɛ.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Má jʋjʋɔsɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa bʋa na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ na-kala lɛ, má lɔllɛ Wɩa. Ma sɩ laa Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ, ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa cho dɩ maa ŋaa. Pɔɔl chagɩlɛ Tɛsalonaaka tɩŋŋaa aŋ chʋɔlɛba

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nagɛ nyiniŋ nɛ, má sɩ́ ʋ dɩsʋ.

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Ama má magɩsɛ wɩɩkala na, a lɩɩsɛ kʋ-la sɩ zɔmɔ a kɛnʋ woruŋ.

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋl Wɩa sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa fɩɛlɩŋ dɩ ʋ pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ kala. Ʋ jaŋ beŋ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa arɩ ma yaraa kala a lɩɩsɛma wʋbɔŋ-na kala lɛ, dɩ ma wuo ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ a sɩ́ wʋcheeli kala kɛŋ, a mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ yɩrɛma ŋaa Wʋtɩtɩɩ Tɩɩna nɛ, ʋ jaŋ bemma.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: La naambiiri, má ma sʋl Wɩa pɩla.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Má guori dɔŋɔ a chʋɔlɛ la naambiiri-la kala woruŋ.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ dɩ ma karɩmɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩ la naambiiri-la kala.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ hɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl arɩ Sɩlɩvaanʋs arɩ Timoti nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Tɛsalonaaka lɛ, a ŋaa la Nyɩmma Wɩa, arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito nɩaa.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Tapʋlɩɩ-la Yesu sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ na hɛɛŋ ʋ wɩaa, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: La naambiiri, ʋ maga dɩ la lɔllɛ Wɩa nɛ bʋa na-kala a pɩma. Ŋɩɩ maga dɩ la ŋaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋɩɩ ma sɩ laa Wɩa dii pʋŋaa pɛ nɛ, chono-la ma ma sɩ kɛnɛ arɩ dɔŋɔ pʋŋaa pɛ.

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa dɩ la nɛ bʋl ma wɩaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi leree dɔnsʋŋ, la yie bigisi ma lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba to naasɩŋ dɔgɩsɛma nɛ, ma na hɛɛŋ, aŋ ka ma ha nyalɩmɛ a chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala daga arɩ Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ʋ sarɩya diiniŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ ʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ dɔgɩsɛma a magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ba sɩ dɔgɩsɛma magɛ.

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ pɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ wiese, a pɩ la ma wiese. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ ŋaa bʋa-la lɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ jaŋ kɔ arɩ ʋ tɩndaara-la sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ.

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ jaŋ kɔ, ʋ jaŋ nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ a dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la ka to.

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ cheiba a kaa mʋ wuu. Ba bɩ jaŋ wuo mʋ La Tɩɩna Yesu teeŋ. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo na ʋ tʋla arɩ ʋ doluŋ.

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ kɔ, Wɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ pʋ yɩrɩŋ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii ma zilu. Ma ma jaŋ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma laa wɩalɩŋ la sɩ bʋla pɩma dii nɛ.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa la yie chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩma nɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ. Laa sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ a nagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ yɩrɛma dɩ ma nagɛ, a leŋ dɩ ʋ doluŋ hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma wuo ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔmɔ-la ma sɩ cho, a wuo chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ a mʋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: La bɩraa sʋl Wɩa dɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ to ma lɛ a yɩrɛ, dɩ ma ma laa yɩrɩŋ ʋ teeŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ ŋaa la Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ wɩaa nɛ a pɩma. Dɩ ʋ nɩɩ kɔ, ʋ jaŋ leŋ la hilimi a chemu.

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa guu vʋgʋmɛ koo dɩ ma bɔyɛ joŋ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bʋla arɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la Yesu sɩ jaŋ kɔ yie nɛ. Ŋ bɩ pɔ nʋʋ jaŋ lɩɩ ma tʋɔŋ a bʋl dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ bʋla pʋ arɩ Yesu kɔ nɛ, koo nʋʋ sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa ma jaŋ wuo bʋl ŋɩɩ pɩma, koo nɩaa jaŋ nyɩɛ wɩaa bʋl arɩ la nɛ ŋmʋnsa pɩma arɩ Yesu kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala nyɩsɛma wombii kala lɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la bɩ jaŋ yi, see dɩ nɩaa sii ŋaa taawɛɩ a vɩa Wɩa. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kuoro, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ, jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kaa dagɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa harɩŋ a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a kaa yʋga kɩɩ Wɩa arɩ kʋŋkala nuhuobiine sɩɩ chʋɔlʋ. Ʋ jaŋ jʋʋ hɔŋ Wɩa dɩa tʋɔŋ a bʋl arɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa.

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Ma bɩ liise yi arɩ mɩ sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ, mɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩmaa?

english_verse: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kuoru-la ha bɩ kɔ. Ma jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ nɛ. Ama dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kuoru-la jaŋ kɔ.

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kuoru-la doluŋ paala suomo lʋara tɩtɩŋ nɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ nyagɛ wɩalɩŋ bil dɩ ba sɩ́ ŋaa, see dɩ ʋ sʋrɩsa aŋ pa wombiiŋ,

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: ka dɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kuoru-la-na kɔ. Bʋa-la lɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ arɩ ʋ tʋla, a pʋʋsɛ ʋ niiŋ peliŋ a kpʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kuoru-la. Ʋ tʋla-la jaŋ chei wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kuoru-la.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kuoro jaŋ kɛŋ Sɩtaanɩ doluŋ a kɔ. Ʋ jaŋ nyɩsɛ nɩaa arɩ wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ.

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋbɔŋ-na kala kaa kɔ a nyɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ lɛl, bɛɛ wɩaa ba vɩa dɩ ba cho wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ dɩ Wɩa laaba ta.

english_verse: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ vɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la ŋɩɩ, Wɩa leŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ ba lɛ, ba tuto wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la cho aŋ cho wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, Wɩa jaŋ dii ʋ sarɩya a joŋ cheeriŋ pʋ.

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: La naambiiri, ʋ maga dɩ la lɔllɛ Wɩa bʋa na-kala lɛ pɩpɩma nɛ, ma nɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ cho. Ma nɛ Wɩa lɩɩsɛ bumbuŋ kala dɩ ʋ laama ta. Wɩa to ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma a tɩŋ ma sɩ laa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la dii wɩaa.

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la la sɩ bʋla pɩma, Wɩa to ba lɛ nɛ a yɩrɛma. Wɩa yɩrɛma dɩ ma kʋ to kɛŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito tʋla-la nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambiiriŋ, má chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la lɛ la sɩ dagɛma arɩ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩma.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito arɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ chola lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ʋ ŋaa la tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, dɩ la wuo yɩyɩɛlɛ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: Laa sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma nyuŋ nyaasɛ, a pɩma doluŋ dɩ ma ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ aa bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la ma.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Má chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩla dɩ La Tɩɩna niiŋ wɩaa wuo teeli leriŋ lɩma lɩma a laa yɩrɩŋ, arɩ ʋ sɩ laa yɩrɩŋ ŋɩɩ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: Má bɩra chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a pɩpɩla, dɩ Wɩa wuo lɩɩsɛla nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa, nɩaa kala dee bɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ laa dii.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Ama La Tɩɩna Yesu kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ʋ jaŋ pɩma doluŋ a lɩɩsɛma Sɩtaanɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: La kɛŋ yɩɛlaa La Tɩɩna lɛ arɩ maa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ la sɩ daga nɛ, aŋ ha jaŋ ŋɩŋaaba a kaa mʋ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋl La Tɩɩna Wɩa dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma wuo jɩŋ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ arɩ ʋ choma nɛ woruŋ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma wuo kɛŋ kenyiri Kirisito doluŋ lɛ. Nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ yarɩwɩɩŋ

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito doluŋ lɛ, la bʋla pɩpɩma dɩ ma lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ yarɩwɩɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ bʋla pɩma ka to.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Ma tɩtɩa jɩma arɩ ʋ maga dɩ ma ŋaa wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa la sɩɩ ŋaa. La sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ, la fa bɩ yarɩwɩɩŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: La fa bɩ nʋʋkala kʋdiilee die dɩ la bɩ tɩɩna time. La tɩma nɛ woruŋ a suoli wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala dɩ la wuo nɩna la kʋchɛɛlɛɛ, dɩ la sɩ́ hɔnɔ gbɛrɛ ma kʋŋkala aa chɛ kɩaa ma teeŋ.

english_verse: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
translation_verse: La sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ naga arɩ la bɩ wombiiŋ kɛnɛ dɩ la laa kɩaa ma teeŋ nɛ. Ama la faasa tɩŋ ŋɩɩ dɩ ma wuo to la naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.
translation_verse: La fa sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ, wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ la bʋl, “Nʋʋkala nɛ bɩ chɛ ʋ tɩŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ dii kʋdiilee.”

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: La nɩa arɩ yarɩwɩɩ tɩŋŋaa hɛ ma tʋɔŋ. Ba bɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ ka tɩŋ, see dɩ ba joŋ ba niiŋ hɛ nɩaa wɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito yɩrɩŋ lɛ la bʋla pɩ nɩaa deemba aa kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa nɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a wuo na ba tɩtɩa kʋdiilee didii.

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Ama la naambiiriŋ, má sɩ́ lɔl wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a bɩ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ bʋla pɩma teniŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ ka to, má jɩŋ ʋ tɩɩna a lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa ʋ lɛ, a leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛnʋ.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ wɩaa ŋɩŋaa ʋ lɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa dʋndɔŋ nɛ. Ama má joŋu arɩ ʋ ŋaa ma naambii nɛ aŋ kpʋrɩsɛ ʋ dɩgɩlaa. Wʋkaanɩŋ

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Laa sʋl La Tɩɩna Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ, dɩ ʋ pɩma fɩɛla-la bʋa na-kala lɛ. La Tɩɩna Kirisito jaŋ hɛ ma kala teeŋ.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ. La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ ŋaa la Laataara doluŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Kirisito Yesu nanzɔɔ. Kirisito Yesu lɛ nɛ la yɩɛlaa hɛ.

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ ŋ-na Timoti nɛ. A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii lɛ, ŋ ŋaa mɩ bii-tɩtɩɩ nɛ. La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Kirisito Yesu lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ba jaŋ fá ŋ nenige a leŋ dɩ ŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ lɛ

english_verse: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ la fa sɩ hɛ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ, mɩ bʋla pɩŋ dɩ ŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ, aŋ ka dɩ mɩ mʋ Masidoonia tinteeŋ. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ aa dagɛba wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ. Bʋla pɩba dɩ ba leŋ wɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba dɩ ba sɩ nɩalɩŋ sʋnsɔgʋlɔ-la joŋo hɛ ba nyuŋ lɛ, a sɩ́ ba naabalɩmaba doho nɩaa wɩaa sɩ duomo ŋɩɩ dɩɩsʋ. Wɩaa deemba yie ŋaa nɩaa kɛŋ nii-doluŋ nɛ. Nii-doluŋ ma bɩ jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ dɩ ba laa Wɩa dii a laa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa pɩ ʋ nɩaa dii.

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ vɩa wɩaa deemba nɛ aŋ mɩɩraa bʋl wʋyaayasɩŋ.

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, nɩaa deemba fa cho dɩ ba dagɛ nɩaa wɩaa deemba nɛ, ama ba tɩtɩa bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ. Ba bɩ wɩalɩŋ ma ba sɩɩ bʋl chaasa jɩŋ.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: La jɩma arɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, ba zɔmɔ nɛ, dɩ nɩaa nɛ kɛmba kaa tɩtɩŋ arɩ ba sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra maga dɩ la jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, ʋ bɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa. Ama ba ŋmʋnsa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chei Wɩa niiŋ wʋbʋlaa nɛ. Ʋ bɩra ŋmʋnsa pɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka fá, arɩ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpʋ ba nyɩmmaba arɩ ba naamba, arɩ nɩkpʋʋraa.

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: Ba bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba a pɩ balɩɩlɩŋ arɩ halɩɩlɩŋ nɛ, arɩ baala-la sɩ gɔllɔ tuu ba dɔŋɔba bʋbʋɔ-niiree, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ gɔllɔ paa nɩaa biiriŋ a kaa faa lɛl. Ba bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba a pɩ wʋnyɩɛraa arɩ dansɩa wʋnyɩɛraa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la ka to.
