english_verse: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma lɩɩ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ tʋla wʋzɔmɔ-la tʋɔŋ nɛ, ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma. Wɩa nɛ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ. Pɔɔl lɔllɛ Wɩa a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ fá ʋ nenige

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna Kirisito Yesu, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ bene dɩ mɩ maga dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ niiŋ wɩaa pɩ nɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ tɩma pʋ. Ʋ nɛ pɩmɛ doluŋ dɩ mɩ wuo tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ kala nɛ mɩ paala bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ʋ lɛ a to naasɩŋ dɔgɩsʋ a tʋʋsʋ ma. Ka Kirisito ha fá mɩ nenige a lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ tɩmaa pʋ. Bʋa-la kala lɛ mɩ fa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ fa bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa. Mɩ fa bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii maa.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Aŋ ka La Tɩɩna Wɩa ha pɛ mɩ lɛ kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a leŋ mɩ laa Kirisito Yesu dii, aŋ cho nɩaa ma.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl chaasa ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a maga dɩ nʋʋkala laa dii. Ʋ nɛ ŋ-la: Kirisito Yesu kʋ tuu dʋnɩa nɛ dɩ ʋ laa wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa ta. Mɩ nɛ saa paala ŋaa ba tʋɔŋ nɩbɔmʋŋ.

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: Ama ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa fá mɩ-na Pɔɔl sɩ chaasa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a kɩɩ nʋʋkala nenige. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ Kirisito Yesu wuo tomi lɛ a dagɛ nɩaa ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ kenyiri, dɩ ba ma wuo laa ʋ wɩaa dii, a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la dɛnnɛ la Nyɩmma Wɩa aŋ pɛ zilu a kaa mʋ wuu. Ʋ nɛ kuoro a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ. Ʋ-na bɩ sʋʋ, nɩaa ma bɩ ʋ ka na. Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa Wɩa. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii, Timoti, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ nɛ a pɩŋ. Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa fa bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋ nagɛ laalɩyuoru nɛ. Leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ ŋ lɛ ŋaa ŋ laalɩyuori kɩaa, dɩ ŋ kaa yuo laalɩŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: Chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa dii lɛ a leŋ dɩ ŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa chesi. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ bɩra bɩ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛɛ to, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba joŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii ta.

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: Haminiiyas arɩ Alɛkɩzanda ma hɛ nɩaa deemba tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jomba hɛ Sɩtaanɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛba, dɩ ba gʋnnɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ, dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ Wɩa joŋŋoo tʋʋsʋ.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩ nɛ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩma. Ʋ nɛ ŋ-la: Má chʋɔlɛ Wɩa aŋ pɛ sʋsʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɩma kɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ chɛ. Má chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a pɩpɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa ma, aŋ pɛ lɔllʋ a pɩpɩ nʋʋkala.

english_verse: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩ kuoroo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ ma lɛ, dɩ la wuo hɔŋ sɔm arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa, a wuo tuto Wɩa a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ to Wɩa wombiiŋ.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ zɔmɔ nɛ a tʋtɔrɛ la Laataara Wɩa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: Ʋ cho dɩ ʋ laa nʋʋkala ta nɛ dɩ ba wuo jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Wɩa ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Nɩbala ma nɛ hɛ Wɩa arɩ nuhuobiine pɛgɛ dɩ ʋ kɛmba kaa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Nɩɩ-la nɛ ŋaa Kirisito Yesu.

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa ʋ nanzɔɔ a wuo heele bʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, aŋ pɛ dagɛba dɩ ba laa wɩalɩŋ dii a jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩɩ bʋl, mɩ bɩ wɩaa nyɩa.

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: Ama má leŋ dɩ nɩaa bɩbagɩsɛ haalaa a tɩŋ ba wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ baa to Wɩa.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩ haalaa wombiiŋ pa dɩ ba dɩdagɛ baalaa, koo dɩ ba kɛŋ doluŋ baalaa lɛ a bibemba. Ʋ maga dɩ ba hɔŋ sɔm nɛ.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Sɩtaanɩ bɩ Adam nɛ nyɩsa. Hawa nɛ ʋ nyɩsɛ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ a chei Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩba.

english_verse: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ haala nɛ laa Wɩa dii, a cho nɩaa, a leŋ dɩ ʋ sɩaa fɩɛlɛ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, Wɩa jaŋ laaʋ ta biiriŋ lʋlʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Mɩ bɩraa chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a pɩŋ: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ fɩɛsɛ sii aa chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa kʋhɩaŋ, tɩntɩŋ-fɩaŋ nɛ ʋ chɩchɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa sɩ-nyʋarʋ, a sɩ́ baaŋ tɩɩna ma ŋaa. Ama ʋ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɩ-chɩm-chɩm nɛ a sɩ́ yuo-hɛɛrʋ ŋaa. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ cho moribiee kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ wuo beŋ ʋ dɩa nɩaa nyuŋ woruŋ nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ wuo leŋ dɩ ʋ hambiisiŋ tuto ʋ niiŋ a zizilu wɩɩkala lɛ,

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa nyuŋ wuo bibeŋ, ʋ bɩ Wɩa nɩaa nyuŋ ma wuo beŋ.

english_verse: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ laa Yesu wɩaa dii ʋ bɩ dieni, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ tɩɩna ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa nɩhɩaŋ. Dɩ tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa nɩhɩaŋ, ʋ jaŋ dagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ tel arɩ Sɩtaanɩ sɩ tele ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
translation_verse: Wɩa nɩaa nɩhɩaŋ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɩzɔŋ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka chʋɔlɛ teeŋ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee nɩaa jaŋ wuo chei ʋ yɩrɩŋ, dɩ Sɩtaanɩ to ŋɩɩ lɛ a bɛrɛ kɛnʋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɛ Wɩa nɩaa nɩhɩasɩŋ lɛ

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩŋ zɔŋŋɔɔ a laa Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa dii. Wɩalɩŋ fa faa nɛ, ka lɛɛlɛ Wɩa joŋo dagɛla.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Haalaa ma sɩɩ pɛ Wɩa nɩaa kʋhɩasɩŋ lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ mɛl-zɔŋ nɛ a sɩ́ nɩaa harɩŋ ma gɩgaa. Ʋ maga dɩ ba fɩɛlɛ ba sɩaa a pɛ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ wɩɩ na-kala ba sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Baalaa sɩɩ pɛ Wɩa nɩaa kʋhɩasɩŋ lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba jaa ha-bala-bala nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ba wuo bibeŋ ba hambiisiŋ arɩ ba dɩa nɩaa kala nyuŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɛ Wɩa nɩaa kʋhɩasɩŋ lɛ nɩɩ tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa woruŋ, nɩaa jaŋ zizilba. Ba jaŋ wuo kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii a tɩgɛ Kirisito Yesu lɛ.

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ nama nɛ lɛɛlɛ. Ama mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma,

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: dɩ mɩ nɛ ka diene ma, dɩ ma ha wuo jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Wɩa nɩaa mɛlɛ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ nagɛ. Ba nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa-la sɩ weye wɩaa dii aa hilimi. Ba nɛ chagɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ daga kɩɩ a nagɛ dɩa gentine arɩ jebiiŋ sɩ yie chagɛ dɩa kɩɩ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ wombii-la la sɩɩ to ŋaa wʋbal nɛ nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo kaa lɛrɛ. Wɩɩ-la fa faa nɛ ka Wɩa joŋo dagɛla lɛɛlɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩa bɩrɩmɛ nuhuobiine nɛ a kʋ tuu dʋnɩa. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma dagɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ. Wɩa tɩndaaraa ma naʋ. Nɩaa bʋl ʋ wɩaa dʋnɩa sɛmɛ-na kala lɛ. Dʋnɩa nɩaa laa ʋ wɩaa dii nɛ, aŋ ka Wɩa joŋu kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ, ʋ laa yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ paala chaasa bʋl arɩ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ deeŋ lɛ la sɩ hɛ, nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ jaŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii ta. Ba jaŋ tuto jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ a nyɩsɛ nɩaa aa dagɛba Sɩtaanɩ wombiiŋ.

english_verse: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
translation_verse: Ba fugo dɩdagɛ Wɩa wɩaa nɛ, ama ba ŋaa wʋnyɩɛra nɛ. Ba ŋaa tʋɔ-togi tɩmma nɛ.

english_verse: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
translation_verse: Nɩdosunu-la yie dagɛ arɩ ʋ bɩ maga dɩ nɩaa jɩjaa haalaa, a bɩra kɩkɩsɛ kʋdiilee dɔnsʋŋ ma arɩ nammɩɩ-dosunuŋ. Ama Wɩa nɛ ta nammɩa arɩ kʋdiilee deemba dɩ nɩaa didii. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la maga dɩ ba laa sɩpaaŋ lɔllʋ aŋ-na dii.

english_verse: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
translation_verse: Kʋŋ na-kala Wɩa sɩ ta zɔmɔ nɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ nɩaa kɩkɩsɛba, ama ʋ maga dɩ la lɔllɛ Wɩa nɛ aŋ-na dii kɩalɩŋ,

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa arɩ la chʋɔla yie leŋ kɩalɩŋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ Wɩa teeŋ. Pɔɔl bʋla pɩ Timoti dɩ ʋ faasa tɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa woruŋ

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ wɩaa deemba a dagɛ ŋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ŋ jaŋ ŋaa Kirisito Yesu tɩntɩnnɩ-zɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ ŋ waa nɛ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la la sɩ laa dii lɛ, arɩ wʋzɔmɔ-la la sɩ dagɩŋ ŋ to lɛ.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Ama pɔ dɩ ŋ sɩ́ sʋnsɔgʋlɔ-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa wombiiŋ ka to gʋnnʋ. Vɩaba ta. Kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa, a gʋnnɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ to Wɩa wombiiŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Laa yɩɛlɛ Wɩa sɩ weye lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ laa loo a faasaa tɩŋ woruŋ. Wɩa nɛ ŋaa nʋʋkala Laataara, a saa wasanyaŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: Chaasa bʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩpɩ nɩaa dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa aŋ pɛ dɩdagɛba wɩalɩŋ ma.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa hambie nɛ, ama sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala bee gʋʋnʋŋ. Leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii na ŋ wʋbʋlaa, ŋ mɛlɛ, ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ cho nɩaa, ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ laa Wɩa dii arɩ ŋ tʋɔpʋla a to ŋ naabʋɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Ŋaa sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ karɩmɛ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ pɩ nɩaa dɩ ma nɛ hilime, a dɩdagɛ nɩaa, aŋ pɛ bʋl wɩalɩŋ pɩpɩ nɩaa, aŋ ka dɩ mɩ-na kɔ.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ kʋ-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ joŋo dii zile ŋ lɛ vɩa, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ bʋl kʋ-la wɩaa, ka Wɩa nɩaa nɩhɩasɩŋ joŋ ba nɩsaa a daŋ ŋ lɛ ŋ laa.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩaa deemba nɛ. Joŋ ŋ nyuŋ kala hɛ ba lɛ dɩ nʋʋkala wuo na ŋɩɩ ŋ wɩaa sɩ mʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ ŋ mɛlɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ dagɛ lɛ. Chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ lɛ woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ laa ŋ tɩtɩa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jegilee nɩɩ ŋ teeŋ ta.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Sɩ́ nɩhɩaŋ lɛ kpɩa, ama chaasa bʋl wɩaa pʋ, a zilu arɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋ nyɩmma dɔŋɔ tɩɩna nɛ. Kɛŋ bapʋɔsaa woruŋ arɩ ba ŋaa ŋ naambiiriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ hanɩhɩasɩŋ ma woruŋ arɩ ba ŋaa ŋ naamba nɛ, a kɛŋ hantolibiisiŋ ma woruŋ arɩ ba ŋaa ŋ dɩhaalaa nɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, pɔ dɩ disiniŋ sɩ́ ma pɛgɛ hɛ.

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Yo-haalaa sɩ bɩ nɩaa kɛnɛ dɩ ba bibemba, zizilba a pɩpɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ yo-haal-la nɛ kɛŋ biiriŋ koo nihee, ʋ maga dɩ ba laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ sɩ dɩ ba ŋaa nɛ a bibeŋ ba dɩa nɩaa, a wuo tiŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lʋlba arɩ ba naabalɩmaba chɩmɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋɩɩ nɩɩ tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Yo-haal-la chaasa bɩ nʋʋkala kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ benu, ʋ yie joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ Wɩa lɛ aa sʋlʋ tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ bʋa na-kala dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Ama yo-haal-la sɩɩ to ʋ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ, ʋ-na paala nagɛ ʋ sʋba nɛ Wɩa teeŋ aŋ ta wei.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Chaasa bʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩ Wɩa nɩaa, dɩ ba sɩ́ wʋcheeli kala kɛŋ nɩaa teeŋ.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ nyuŋ ka beŋ a wasanyaŋ ʋ dɩa nɩaa tɩtɩa, ʋ vɩa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa dii ta nɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ paala bɩ Yesu wɩaa laa dii nɛ kpɩaʋ.

english_verse: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
translation_verse: Sɩ́ yo-haal kala yɩrɩŋ ŋmʋnsa hɛ yo-haalaa teŋ-la tʋɔŋ, see ʋ tɩɩna yi jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ batori, a fa jaa bal-bala dʋndʋŋ.

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ wʋŋaalaa zɔŋ nɛ, dɩ ʋ bibeŋ ʋ biiriŋ woruŋ, a kɩkɛŋ nʋhʋɔraa woruŋ ʋ dɩa lɛ, a hʋhʋɔrɛ Wɩa nɩaa woruŋ ʋ dɩa lɛ, a pɩpɛ nɩalɩŋ wɩaa sɩ jʋa lɛ, a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Ama sɩ́ yo-haala-la sɩ ŋaa hantolibiisiŋ yɩrɩŋ ŋmʋnsa hɛ yo-haala-la tʋɔŋ. Ba jaŋ wuo kʋ cho dɩ ba jaa balaba, a leŋ Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ dʋndʋŋ ma dee, ba bɩ sɛɩ dɩ ba tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa aŋ gɔllɔ tuto dɩɩ-niiriŋ. Dɩ-bɔmʋŋ nɛ, ba yie gɩgaa nɩaa harɩŋ a joŋ ba niiŋ hɩhɛ nɩaa wɩaa lɛ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ maga dɩ ba bʋl.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ bʋl dɩ yo-haala-la sɩ ŋaa hantolibiisiŋ, dɩ ba jaa balaba a lʋlʋl biiriŋ a bibemba, a tɩtɩŋ ba dɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa. Dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, la dʋndɔmɔ Sɩtaanɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo na wombiiŋ a bʋl wʋbɔŋ kala a tɩgɛ la lɛ.

english_verse: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
translation_verse: Hantolibiisi-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ ŋaa yo-haalaa paala vɩa Kirisito nɛ aŋ mɩɩra tuto Sɩtaanɩ.

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Ama haal-na kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, dɩ yo-haalaa nɛ hɛ ʋ dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ beŋ ba nyuŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ jomba pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi dɩ ba bibemba. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi, nɛ maga dɩ ba bibeŋ yo-haala-la sɩ bɩ nɩaa kɛnɛ dɩ ba bibemba.

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɩaa nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩɩ tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa woruŋ, ʋ maga dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi zizilba nɛ, a wasanyaŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ faasa bʋl Wɩa wɩaa aŋ pɛ dɩdagɛ nɩaa,

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ba bʋl ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ba sɩ, “Dɩ nɛŋ nɩɩ ŋmoo mɩaa, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ vɔɔ ʋ niiŋ tɔ.” Ba bɩra ŋmʋnsa arɩ tɩntɩnna maga dɩ ʋ laa ʋ time nɛ.

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ joŋ cheeriŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi kʋhɩaŋ, sɩ́ jegile nɩɩ tɩɩna teeŋ, see dɩ nɩaa balɩa koo batori pɛ na wɩɩ-la.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɩaa nɩhɩaŋ kala nɛ vɛnɛɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ʋ bɩ leŋ, bʋl ʋ teeŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi sɩpaaŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛŋ nɩkaanaa.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pɩŋ Wɩa arɩ Kirisito Yesu arɩ Wɩa tɩndaaraa Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa sɩpaaŋ nɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ dɩ ŋ to wɩaa deemba, a sɩ́ nɩaa kaa pɔrɛ wɩɩ-na kala ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ. Joŋ ba kala dɩ ba ŋaa nɩbala ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Fɩɛlɛ ŋ sɩaa a pɔ dɩ ŋ sɩ́ pese lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ a joŋ ŋ nɩsaa daŋ ʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa. Dɩ tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ka ŋ lɩɩsʋ, ŋ ma jaŋ pɛ jʋʋ ʋ wʋbɔŋ-la lɛ. Sɩ́ disiŋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: Sɩ́ lɩɩŋ dʋndʋŋ nyʋa, ama nyʋnyʋa sɩnɩŋ mʋa mʋa, a tɩŋ ŋ luoruŋ sɩ yie wʋwɩɩ bʋa na-kala wɩaa.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ faa, ka dɩ ba-na dii ba sarɩya nʋʋkala yie jɩŋ arɩ ba cheye nɛ, ama nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yie faa nɛ, tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ nɛ ba jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ dɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, nɩaa yie naba lɩma lɩma. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ma yie faa nɛ. Ama chɛɛ dɔŋ nɛ ba jaŋ chaasa lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa yosuŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba zizil nɩalɩŋ sɩ yɔɔba nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wombiiŋ na a wuo bʋl wʋbɔŋ kala a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ, koo a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ dagɛma lɛ.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Yosu-la nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba mɩmaasɛ ba tɩŋŋaa a tɩŋ ba kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii. Ʋ paala magɛ dɩ ba tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa woruŋ nɛ a pɩba, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ tɩmaa pa ŋaa nɩa sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɛ, a ŋaa nɩa ba cho. Timoti, wɩaa deemba nɛ ŋ jaŋ joŋo dagɛba a chaasa leŋ dɩ ba tutoba.

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩba-la La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sɩ bʋla daga aŋ dagɛ wʋtanɩɩ, wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ la Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ wombiiŋ ka to,

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: ʋ tɩɩna kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa yʋgɛ nɛ, aŋ bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ. Ʋ kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a cho kaalɛrɛ, a ŋɩŋaa goŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩaa ŋaa lɛ. Ŋɩɩ yie leŋ nɩaa yaraa bibieri dɔŋɔ lɛ, ba yuyuo dɔŋɔ a tʋtʋʋsɛ dɔŋɔ, a bɩbɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba nyuŋ bɩra bɩ tɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba yie kɛŋ wɩaa lɩlɛrɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba bɩra bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ma jɩŋ. Ba bɩɩna Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ wombiiŋ ŋaa moribii chɛɛrɩ wombiiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Wʋtɩtɩɩ, dɩ nɩaa nɩɩ to Wɩa wombiiŋ aŋ leŋ dɩ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kɛnɛ nyuŋ, ŋɩɩ nyʋʋrʋŋ yʋga,

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa la sɩ kɔ dʋnɩa, la bɩ kʋŋkala kaa kɔ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ la nɛ sʋba, la bɩra bɩ kʋŋkala kaa lɩɩ dʋnɩa lɛ a mʋmʋ.

english_verse: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ kɛŋ kʋdiilee arɩ gɛnnɩŋ, ʋ maga la leŋ dɩ ba magɛla nɛ.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho dɩ ba kɛŋ kɩaa dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, Sɩtaanɩ yie nyɩsɛba hɛ bɛrɛ lɛ nɛ, baa ŋaa nɩyaarɩ wɩaa arɩ ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ cheiba. Wɩaa deemba nɩɩ chei nɩaa woruŋ.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa nɛ cho moribiee, ba jaŋ wuo ŋaa wʋbɔŋ na-kala. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ joŋ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ laa Wɩa dii ta nɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩ cho moribiee wɩaa, ŋɩɩ leŋ tʋɔ-cheeŋ kɩŋkɛŋ jʋʋ. Pɔɔl chagɩlɛ Timoti

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na sɩ ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ, sɩ́ wɩaa deemba kala ŋaa. Leŋ dɩ ŋ sɩɩŋ fɩɛsɛ dɩ ŋ ŋɩŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa, a tuto Wɩa wombiiŋ, a chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa dii lɛ, a cho nɩaa, a kɛŋ kenyiri, a kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa muuri nɩaa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
translation_verse: Yuo laal-la woruŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa dii lɛ. Hɛ doluŋ a wuo laa mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ wɩaa nɛ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ suri ŋ niiŋ a bʋl nɩ-daŋ sɩpaaŋ arɩ ŋ laa Wɩa dii nɛ.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ Wɩa arɩ Kirisito Yesu sɩpaaŋ dɩ ŋ to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩŋ. Wɩa nɛ joŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a pɩ kʋŋkala. Kirisito Yesu ma nɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la fa sɩ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ Pɔntɩɔs Paalɩt sɩpaaŋ, nɩɩ-la fa sɩ chɩŋ Rom kuoru-balɩŋ nyuŋ Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ, a wuo bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ a pʋ.

english_verse: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Hɛ doluŋ aŋ to wɩaa deemba arɩ tʋɔ-bala, dɩ nɩaa sɩ́ wuo joŋ cheeriŋ pɩŋ. Kɛŋ ŋɩɩ naaŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ kɔ bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ bene dɩ ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɔ. Wɩa dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga la dɛnnɛ, a ŋaa Wɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ kʋŋkala. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa kuoru-balɩŋ a kɛŋ kuoroo kala doluŋ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa kʋŋkala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ bɩ sʋʋ. Ʋ hɛ pʋlʋŋ-bal tʋɔŋ nɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ nɩmɛ wuo mʋ. Nʋʋkala ha bɩ ʋ na, nʋʋ ma kala saa bɩ ʋ wuo na. Ʋ maga dɩ nɩaa kala zizilu nɛ. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ ba tɩtɩa dagʋ koo a joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ba dʋa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋkala bɩ jɩŋ ʋ dʋa-la chie sɩ jaŋ chɩŋ ŋɩɩ. Ama ʋ maga dɩ ba joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ Wɩa lɛ. Ʋ nɩɩ pɩla kʋŋkala la sɩɩ chɛ dɩ la kaa nɩnɩɩ sɩma.

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ ba leŋ dɩ ba wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ yʋgɛ. Bʋla pɩba dɩ ba kɛŋ zile a ŋaa kɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ wuo chɛ kɩaa a bil ba tɩtɩa lɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ dɩ ba wuo na kɩalɩŋ nyʋʋrʋŋ maachie. Ŋ-la nɛ ba jaŋ wuo na mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ ŋaa mɩɩ-tɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
translation_verse: Tɔɔ, Timoti, pɔ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ woruŋ. Lɩɩsɛ ŋ tɩtɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa wombiiŋ ka to lɛ, aŋ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ lɩlɛrɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ yie nyɩɛ wɩaa aŋ bɩɩnɛ wʋjɩmɩɩ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ to wʋjɩmɩŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ a joŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii ta. Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ. La Tɩɩna Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito nanzɔɔ. Wɩa bʋla pɩla dɩ ʋ to Yesu Kirisito lɛ nɛ a joŋ mɩɩsɩŋ pɩla. Mɩɩsɩ-la wɩaa nɛ ʋ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ ŋ-na mɩ bii-chooluŋ Timoti nɛ. La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ba jaŋ fáŋ nenige a leŋ dɩ ŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Pɔɔl bʋla pɩ Timoti dɩ ʋ chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ lɛ ʋ sɩ laa dii

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ lɔllɛ Wɩa kɩŋkɛŋ, nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ tɩma pa arɩ tʋɔ-bala, a nagɛ mɩ naabalɩmaba fa sɩ tɩma pʋ ŋɩɩ. Dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala, mɩ yie liliisi ŋ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
translation_verse: Mɩ liise yi arɩ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ sii ŋ teeŋ, ŋ faa yel nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ cho dɩ mɩ kʋ naŋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: Mɩ liise yi ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ. Ŋ nahɩma Luwis arɩ ŋ naaŋ Yunis nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii. Mɩ jɩma arɩ ŋ ma chɩŋ ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩɩ liisiŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ kʋ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo dii zile ŋ lɛ kaa tɩŋ woruŋ. Kʋ-la ŋ sɩ laa bʋa-la mɩ sɩ joŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ daŋ ŋ lɛ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩŋ.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa dɩ ŋ nɛ bʋl La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛnɩŋ a tɩŋ Yesu wɩaa. Bɩra sɩ́ leŋe dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛnɩŋ mɩ ma wɩaa, a tɩŋ ba sɩ kɛmmɛ tɔ dɩa Kirisito wɩaa. Ama Wɩa doluŋ lɛ, sɛɩ dɩ la kala na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ laala ta a yɩrɛla dɩ la ŋaa ʋ nɩaa. Ʋ bɩ naga Wɩa to la wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ a laala ta. Ama ʋ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ fá la nenige a laala ta. Yesu Kirisito lɛ nɛ ʋ to a ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩla. Ʋ jɩma arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩla faafaa kala nɛ, ka dʋnɩa-na suomi.

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ la Laataara Kirisito Yesu sɛnɛ kɔ dʋnɩa nɛ. Ʋ sɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ, la wuo na Wɩa zile wɩaa sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Kirisito sɩ kɔ, ʋ kpʋ sʋʋŋ doluŋ kala nɛ. Ʋ bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la pɩla a to ŋɩɩ lɛ a dagɛla arɩ ʋ nɛ pɩla mɩɩsɩŋ, a bɩra dagɛla dɩ la nɛ sʋba ma, la jaŋ bɩra sii a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa ʋ nanzɔɔ, a leŋ mɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩpɩ nɩaa a dɩdagɛba.

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ nɩna hɛɛŋ. Ama hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ mɩ kɛnɛ a tɩŋ hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩ na wɩaa. Mɩ jɩŋ nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ to nɛ. Mɩ sɩ joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, mɩ laa dii arɩ ʋ jaŋ wuo bemmi woruŋ halɩɩ a kaa mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la Kirisito Yesu sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ fa sɩ dagɩŋ, ba ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ lɛ a tutoba. La dɩ Kirisito Yesu sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ, hɛ doluŋ aŋ chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa dii lɛ, a cho nɩaa ma.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ, kɛŋ wʋzɔmɔ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Ama baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɔnɩɩsɩfɔrɔs, ʋ nɛ pɛ mɩ lɛ woruŋ a ŋaa mɩ nyuŋ faasa nyaasɛ. Ba sɩ kɛmmɛ kaa tɔ dɩa ŋɩɩ, hɩɩsɩŋ fa bɩ ʋ kɛnɛ a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa. La Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ fá ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa nenige.

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ kɔ Rom, lee-la ba sɩ tɔmɛ dɩa, ʋ chɛmɛ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ aŋ-na namɛ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ La Tɩɩna Kirisito fá ʋ nenige sarɩya chɛ-diiliŋ. Ŋ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ faasa pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa sɩ hɛ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ŋ-na mɩ bii Timoti, kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ nɩa dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩ nɩ-daŋ, ŋ ma bʋl ba tɩtɩa a pɩ nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, di ba ma joŋo dagɛ ba dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Ŋ sɩ ŋaa Kirisito Yesu laalɩyuoru sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ la dɩŋ kala na hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Bapaarʋ-la sɩ faasa tɩtɩŋ nɛ maga dɩ ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ dii baga kʋfalaa.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Kɛŋ wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩɩ bʋl bɩbɩɩnɛ. La Tɩɩna Yesu jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ dɩ ŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala bʋbʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Liisi Yesu Kirisito wɩaa, ʋ fa ŋaa Devit doho nʋʋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ sʋba, ʋ bɩra sii sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ. Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩɩ bʋl nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: A tɩŋ Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa, mɩ na hɛɛŋ nɛ. Ba vɔɔmɛ arɩ chɔrʋmɔɔ nɛ, a nagɛ mɩ ŋaa nɩbɔŋ nɛ. Ama ba bɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa-na vɔbɔ.

english_verse: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Mɩ nyalɩma nɛ wɩɩkala lɛ a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa wɩaa, dɩ Yesu Kirisito wuo laaba ta dɩ ba na ʋ tʋla a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɩɩ na hɛɛŋ aŋ nyalɩmɛ, la dɩ ʋ kala jaŋ dii kuoruŋ. Dɩ la nɛ sɩ la bɩ Yesu jɩŋ, ʋ ma jaŋ bʋl ʋ bɩ la jɩŋ.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ bɩ ʋ ka to arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ-na ha kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo nyɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa. Pɔɔl bʋla pɩ Timoti dɩ ʋ ŋaa Tɩntɩnnɩtɩtɩɩ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii dɩ ba liliisi wɩaa deemba woruŋ, a kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ wɩaa kaa lɩlɛrɛ. Ma sɩ kɛŋ wɩaa lɩlɛrɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋɩɩ bɩ nʋʋkala lɛɛ pɛ, ama ʋ yie chichei nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ jegilu nɛ.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Hɛ ŋ doluŋ kala dɩ Wɩa wuo na arɩ ŋ ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ nɛ, sɩ bɩ hɩɩsɩŋ ka fá, a bɩra leŋ dɩ ʋ wuo na arɩ ŋ dagɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛ ŋ tɩtɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie bʋbʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa wombiiŋ ka to lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ bʋl yie leŋ nɩaa joŋ ba harɩŋ yɩa Wɩa nɛ.

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ dagʋ jaŋ teeli leriŋ a nagɛ naawɩɩlɩŋ sɩ yie keeri ŋɩɩ a dii nampɩlɩŋ kala. Nɩaa balɩa nɛ hɛ nɩaa deemba tʋɔŋ aa dagɛ wɩaa deemba. Ba yɩraa nɛ Haminiiyas arɩ Fɩlɛtɩs.

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: Ba leŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ wombii-la nɛ aŋ bʋl arɩ bʋa-la lɛ nɩaa sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ aŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ paala kieli nɛ. Ba sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii joŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii ta nɛ.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Ama dɩa gentiŋ-duo-la Wɩa sɩ bile pɩ ʋ nɩaa, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo jigisi. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “La Tɩɩna Wɩa jɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa ʋ nɩaa nɛ.” Ba bɩra ŋmʋnsa arɩ ʋ maga dɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ sɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa nʋʋ nɛ, dɩ ʋ leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ.

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Nɩaa nagɛ gbansɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩaa dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Dɔnsʋŋ ŋaa sɛlɩmɛ gbansɩŋ, dɔnsʋŋ ŋaa taasɩ-gbansɩŋ, dɔnsʋŋ ma ŋaa daaŋ gbansɩŋ, dɔnsʋŋ ma ŋaa hɛnsɩŋ. Dɔnsʋŋ ba yie joŋo bil nɛ a kaa didii kɩaa chɛ-zɔŋŋɔɔ, aŋ kɛŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma kaa didii kɩaa tapʋlɩɩ na-kala.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa dɩ nʋʋ nɛ lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ nagɛ gbansɩ-la ba sɩ kaa didii kɩaa chɛ-zɔŋŋɔɔ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ teeŋ. Nɩɩ-la jaŋ wuo pɛ ʋ kʋhɩaŋ lɛ woruŋ. Ʋ kʋhɩaŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩŋ zɔŋ na-kala.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Lɩɩsɛ ŋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔmɔ-la bapʋɔsaa arɩ hatoloo sɩ yie cho dɩ baa ŋaa lɛ. Ama ŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa arɩ tʋɔbala maga dɩ ma kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla nɛ a chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ woruŋ a cho dɔŋɔ a kɛŋ nii-bala.

english_verse: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
translation_verse: Ama lɩɩsɛ ŋ tɩtɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ nɩyaarɛ wɩaa lɩlɛrɛ lɛ. Ŋ jɩma arɩ wɩaa deemba yie leŋ nɩaa yuyuo dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩma pɩpɩ La Tɩɩna Wɩa, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ yuyuo yuosuŋ. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ zile nɛ nʋʋkala lɛ, a wuo dɩdagɛ nɩaa woruŋ, aŋ pɛ kɛŋ kenyiri.

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ sɩaa fɩɛlɛ dɩ ʋ nɩɩ dagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ harɩŋ chɩna. Ŋ bɩ pɔ, Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba na wombiiŋ a wuo bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ a kʋ jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la.

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba jaŋ bɩra wasa kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a lɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa Sɩtaanɩ bɛrɛ́-la lɛ. Ʋ fa bɛrɛ kɛmba nɛ ba tuto ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Timoti, bʋa-la lɛ dʋnɩa sɩ jaŋ kpagɛ dɛrɩŋ, wɩaa jaŋ doŋ.

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ jaŋ cho nɩaa. Ba bɩ jaŋ joŋ wɩaa chɩchɛ nɩaa. Ba jaŋ chichei nɩaa yɩrɩŋ ma. Ba bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ ba tɩtɩa kɛnɩŋ. Ba jaŋ tɛrɛ. Ba jaŋ bɛrɛ wʋzɔŋ kala.

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ ŋaa zɛmbɛ tɩmma, ba bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ sɩɩ-duoŋ. Ba bɩ jaŋ cho Wɩa. Ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa dʋndʋŋa nɛ ba jaŋ cho dɩ baa ŋaa.

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: Ba yie ŋɩŋaa wɩaa arɩ baa to Wɩa nɛ, ama ba bɩ laa dii arɩ Wɩa kɛŋ doluŋ. Lɩɩsɛ ŋ tɩtɩa nɩaa deemba tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Nɩdosunuŋ deemba nɛ yie jʋʋ nɩaa dɩɩsɩŋ a nyɩnyɩsɛ ha-yaaraa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ nyaga bil, ba tuto ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa sɩ bɔmɔ harɩŋ.

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: Haalaa deemba yie cho wʋfalaa gʋnnʋŋ ama ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la wuo jɩŋ.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Baalaa balɩa nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ Janɩs arɩ Jambɩrɛs. Ba fa bɩ Mosis harɩŋ chɩna, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ baalaa deemba ma bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la harɩŋ chɩna. Nɩaa deemba nyuŋ bɩ tɩŋ. Ba bɩ Yesu wɩaa laa dii.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Ama nɩaa deemba bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa ŋɩɩ a mʋ sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋkala jaŋ na dɩ ba ŋaa nɩyaara nɛ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩalɩŋ ma fa na dɩ Janɩs arɩ Jambɩrɛs fa yaara. Pɔɔl chagɩlɛ Timoti

english_verse: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɛ nɛ, a jɩŋ mɩ mɛlɛ, a jɩŋ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, a bɩra jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ laa dii lɛ, a kɛŋ kenyiri, a cho nɩaa aŋ kɛŋ nyalɩma ma.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ to Wɩa wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ dɩ Kirisito Yesu ŋaa kʋbala, nɩaa jaŋ to naasɩŋ dɔgɩsʋ.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ gɔllɔɔ nyɩsɛ nɩaa jaŋ wasa ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ba jaŋ nyɩsɛ nɩaa aŋ pɛ nyɩnyɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa maa.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na hɛ doluŋ aŋ chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ gʋnna naaŋ lɛ, wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa dii arɩ ba ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ŋ jɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ dagɩŋ wɩalɩŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: A suomi ŋ hambiiriŋ kala lɛ a kaa kɔ, ŋ jɩŋ Wɩa teniŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ʋ nɛ pɩŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ ŋ laa Kirisito Yesu wɩaa dii dɩ ʋ laaŋ ta.

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ jaŋ pɛ Wɩa tɩntɩnna lɛ, dɩ ʋ wɩaa kala chesi dɩ ʋ wuo tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ zɔŋ na-kala.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ Wɩa arɩ Kirisito kala sɩpaaŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ dii nɩweyee arɩ nɩsʋʋnʋŋ kala sarɩya. Ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ a dii kuoruŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pɩpɩ nɩaa bʋa na-kala lɛ, dɩ wɩaa zɔmɔ koo dɩ ba lɔrɔ. Kɛmba tʋra kɩɩ, bʋl ba teeŋ, aŋ ŋaa dɩ ba nyuŋ nyaasɛ. Kɛŋ kenyiri a jɩma dɩdagɛba woruŋ.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi, nɩaa bɩ jaŋ jegili Wɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ dagɛba. Ama ba jaŋ to ba tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ a chɛ kɛsɛ kerichiba yʋgɛ sɩ jaŋ dɩdagɛba wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ cho dɩ ba nɩa.

english_verse: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la aŋ cho dɩ baa nɩɩ sʋnsɔgʋlɔɔ.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na hɛ doluŋ a kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa woruŋ wɩɩ na-kala lɛ. Dɩ hɛɛŋ nɛ jʋʋŋ ma, nyalɩmɛ. Ŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ ŋɩɩ, bʋl Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩaa a tɩŋ ŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala woruŋ. Pɔɔl bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ

english_verse: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
translation_verse: Mɩ yuo laalɩ-zɔŋ-la nɛ woruŋ. Mɩ fá mɩ fanɩŋ dɛrɛ nɛ. Mɩ chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ laa dii lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ, La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ ŋaa sarɩya diiru-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl kuoru nyunchuulo nɛ a bil dɩ ʋ joŋo siilimi, tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ. Mɩ dʋndʋŋa dee ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ pa, ama nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ chou a gbɛrʋ dɩ ʋ mɩɩra kɔ, ba ma jaŋ laa ba siilee.

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Hɛ doluŋ aŋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ lɩma,

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa Dɩmas vɩamɛ nɛ. Ʋ cho dʋnɩa kɩaa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ vɩamɛ ta aŋ mʋ Tɛsalonaaka. Kɩrɛsɩsɛŋ ma mʋ Galiisia, Taatɩs ma mʋ Dalɩmatɩa.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Luuk dʋndʋŋa nɛ hɛ mɩ teeŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ kɔ mɩ teeŋ, pɛ kɛŋ Maak kaa kɔ. Ʋ jaŋ wuo pɛ mɩ lɛ a yʋgɛ.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ kɔ, pɛ kɛŋ mɩ gɛrɩ-la arɩ mɩ tenni-la kaa kɔ. Mɩ joŋo pɩ baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kaapɩs nɛ a hɛ Tʋrɔwas lɛ. Tenni-la ba sɩ kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ puruŋ kaa ŋaa nɛ mɩ wasa chɩchɛ.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Libiru kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Alɛkɩzanda dɔgɩsɛmɛ nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ sɩ ŋaamɛ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa jaŋ fɩsɛ ʋ puruŋ.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: Pɔ ŋ tɩtɩa arɩ libiru-la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la sɩ bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ pɩ nɩaa, ʋ lɩɩ la harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wɩaa dɩ mɩ laa mɩ tɩtɩa, ba sɩɩ diimi sarɩya, nʋʋkala bɩ mɩ harɩŋ chɩna. Ba kala vɩamɛ ta nɛ. Mɩɩ sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ sɩ́ ba dɔgɩsʋ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa wɩaa.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ nɛ a pɩmɛ doluŋ mɩ wuo bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ kala. Mɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɛ. Wɩa lɩɩsɛmɛ nɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ lɩɩsɛmɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ bemmi woruŋ a kɛmmɛ joiiŋ kaa mʋ hɛ ʋ kuorii-la tʋɔŋ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. Wɩa yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ, a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ. Chʋɔlaa

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: Chʋɔlɛ Pɩrɩsɩla arɩ Akuila pɩmɛ, a chʋɔlɛ Ɔnɩɩsɩfɔrɔs arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa kala ma.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Ɩrasɩtas tuo mɩ teeŋ. La sɩ joŋ wombiiŋ, ʋ ká Kɔrɩntɩ lɛ nɛ, aŋ ka mɩ leŋ Tʋrɔfɩmɔs ma Miliitas lɛ. Ʋ faa wɩɩlɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Hɛ doluŋ aŋ kɔ, ka dɩ yibiiniŋ na jʋʋ. Nɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Yubulas arɩ Pʋdɛns arɩ Linus arɩ Kɩlaadɩa, ba maa chʋɔlʋŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ hɔnʋŋ zɔŋ. Ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ ʋ jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ aa pɩ ŋ-na Taatɩs. Mɩ ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ a ŋaa Yesu Kirisito nanzɔɔ ma. Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ pɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa lɛ dɩ ba wasa chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii lɛ, a wuo jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la sɩɩ to Wɩa wombiiŋ.

english_verse: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ cho nɛ, ʋ joŋ wɩɩ-la a dagɛla ʋ Wʋzɔmɔ-la tʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ la Laataara Wɩa joŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ a hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ laa bʋla pɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ ŋ-na Taatɩs sɩ ŋaa mɩ bii-tɩtɩɩ Yesu wɩaa lɛ. La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ la Laataara Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ŋ jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba nagɛ ŋɩɩ

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: Mɩ leŋiŋ Kiriiti lɛ dɩ ŋ wuo wasɛ wɩalɩŋ fa sɩ maga ba ŋaa nɛ. Mɩ bʋla pɩŋ dɩ ŋ lɩɩsɛ Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ taŋ na-kala lɛ.

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɩaa nɩhɩaŋ maga dɩ ʋ sɩ́ wʋcheeli kala kɛŋ nɩaa teeŋ. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ha-bala nɛ, ka ʋ biiriŋ ma kala laa Wɩa wɩaa dii, dɩ nɩaa sɩ́ bʋl arɩ ba tɛrɛ, a bɩ kʋhɩasɩŋ ma niiŋ ka to.

english_verse: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ Wɩa nɩaa ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋcheelee nɩaa teeŋ. Ʋ bɩra bɩ maga dɩ ʋ dɩdagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa, a sɩ́ baaŋ tɩɩna koo sɩ-nyʋarʋ koo nii-jɩgɩ tɩɩna koo nɩɩ-la sɩ cho moribiee kɩŋkɛŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ beŋ nʋhʋɔraa woruŋ ʋ dɩa lɛ a cho wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ jɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kɛnɩŋ nɛ a ŋaa nɩtɩtɩɩ. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɩpʋla a wuo kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: They must stick to the true message they were taught, so their good teaching can help others and correct everyone who opposes it.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ dagʋ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛmba woruŋ, dɩ ʋ wuo dagɛ ʋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ gʋnna. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ wuo dagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa chichei Wɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la la sɩɩ to.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii yʋga a bɩ chɛ dɩ ba tuto nɩhɩasɩŋ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa, a saa wasa nyaŋ Juu tɩmma-la sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii. Ba ŋaa wʋbʋl deeŋ deeŋ tɩmma nɛ, aa nyɩsɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Kiriiti nɩaa tʋɔŋ vʋgʋrʋ bʋl wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ. Ʋ bʋla arɩ Kiriiti nɩaa kala ŋaa wʋnyɩɛraa nɛ a ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ, luobii tɩmma, aŋ pɛ kɛŋ yarɩwɩɩŋ ma.

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, bʋl ba teeŋ woruŋ dɩ ba chɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la ba sɩ laa dii lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ.

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: Bɩra bʋla pɩba dɩ ba sɩ́ Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba wɩaa sɩ nagɛ sʋnsɔgʋlɔɔ nɩɩ, a sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa Wɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la harɩŋ to.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna teeŋ kʋŋkala zɔmɔ nɛ. Disiŋ tɩmma-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii teeŋ, kʋŋkala ŋaa disiŋ kʋŋ nɛ. Ba tʋɔŋ lɔrɔ, ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala bɩ zɔŋ.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: Baa bʋl arɩ ba jɩŋ Wɩa nɛ, ama ba wʋŋaalaa daga arɩ ba bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ. Ba wʋŋaalaa lɔrɔ, ba bɩ Wɩa niiŋ ka to, ba bɩ wʋzɔŋ kala wuo ŋaa.

english_verse: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ-na Taatɩs, dɩdagɛ Wɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la.

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ banɩhɩasɩ-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ dɩ ba leŋ dɩ ba sɩaa fɩɛlɛ, a kɛŋ mɛl-zɔmʋŋ, a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa woruŋ, a jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii woruŋ, a cho nɩaa, a kɛŋ kenyiri.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ hanɩhɩasɩ-la ma dɩ ba ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ daga arɩ baa to Wɩa wombiiŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba gɩgaa nɩaa harɩŋ koo dɩ ba ŋaa sɩ-nyʋaraa. Bʋla pɩba dɩ ba dɩdagɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ,

english_verse: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
translation_verse: dɩ ba wuo dagɛ hatoloo ma dɩ ba cho ba balaba arɩ ba biiriŋ,

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: a wuo kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa woruŋ, a sɩ́ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ ŋɩŋaa, a beŋ ba dɩa nɩaa woruŋ, a kɛŋ zile, a tuto ba balaba niiŋ woruŋ, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wuo bʋl wʋbɔŋ kala a tɩgɛ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la lɛ.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Bʋl ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa a nyaasɛ bapʋɔsaa ma nyuŋ dɩ ba jɩma kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa woruŋ.

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wuo kaa lɛrɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ jaŋ wuo na wʋbɔŋ kala a bʋla tɩgɛ la lɛ.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ yosuŋ ma dɩ ba tuto nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩɩba niiŋ wɩɩkala lɛ, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ maga dɩ ba tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ba nyuŋ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba laa wɩaa bʋbʋl ba teeŋ.

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: Ba sɩ́ ba tɩɩnaba kɩaa gɩgaa. Wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ ŋaa, ʋ maga dɩ ba leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩɩba laaba dii arɩ ba kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, nʋʋkala jaŋ zil la Laataara Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Wɩa dagɛ ʋ zile pɩla nɛ, a kɔ dɩ ʋ laa nʋʋkala ta.

english_verse: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la dagɛla dɩ la sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa, a sɩ́ la tɩtɩa joŋo hɛ dʋnɩa wɩaa lɛ, a jɩma kɛŋ la tɩtɩa, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a tuto Wɩa wombiiŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: La sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, laa gbɛrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la la Wɩɩ-balɩŋ arɩ la Laataara Yesu Kirisito sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ arɩ ʋ tʋla nɛ.

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: La wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ʋ sʋʋ, dɩ ʋ laala ta la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ a pɩɩsɛ la disiniŋ ta, dɩ la ŋaa ʋ nɩaa. Ʋʋ chɛ dɩ la ŋaa nɩa sɩ joŋ la nyuŋ hɛ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, joŋ wɩaa deemba a dagɛba, a kɛŋ dol-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩŋ, a bʋl wɩaa nyaasɛ ba nyuŋ, dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ ma chei dɩ ŋ bʋl ba teeŋ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala bee gʋʋnʋŋ.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩ Wɩa nɩaa dɩ ba joŋ ba tɩtɩa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ ba lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bemba a tutoba, a ŋaa siri dɩ ba ŋaa wɩɩ na-kala sɩ zɔmɔ.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: La ma tɩtɩa fa ŋaa nɩyaara nɛ, a fa bɩ Wɩa niiŋ to, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ fa leŋ la yeŋŋi. La fa to la tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa harɩŋ nɛ a bɩrɩmɛ ba yosi. La fa cho dɩ nɩaa jʋʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a fa kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Nɩaa fa bɛrɛla, la ma fa bɛrɛba.

english_verse: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
translation_verse: Ama la Laataara Wɩa dagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ zile arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ cho nɩaa nɛ,

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: a laala ta. Ʋ bɩ naga arɩ la sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma nɛ tɩɩ ʋ laala ta. Ama ʋ sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige nɛ tɩɩ ʋ laala ta. Ʋ laala ta nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fola Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ dagɛ arɩ Wɩa bɩra wasa lʋlla nɛ, la kɛŋ mɩɩ-falɩŋ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: Wɩa to la Laataara Yesu Kirisito lɛ nɛ a joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a hɛ la lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: Ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ la kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ, a wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, wɩɩ-la la sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ lɛ.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ paala chaasa bʋl wɩaa deemba, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii, dɩ ba ŋaa siri a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ bʋa na-kala lɛ. Wɩaa deemba ŋaa wʋzɔmɔ nɛ. Ba jaŋ wuo pɛ nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Má leŋ nɩyaarɩ wʋkaalɛrɛ, a sɩ́ ma naabalɩmaba gentine sɩ duomo dɩɩsʋ. Má sɩ́ yuosuŋ hɛ a sɩ́ dɔŋɔ yuo a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, ŋɩɩ bɩ nʋʋ lɛ ka pɛ.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ vɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la nɛ aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ʋ wʋŋaalaa gʋra diiu sarɩya nɛ. Wʋkaanɩŋ

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ tɩŋ Atɩmas koo Takɩkʋs dɩ ʋ kɔ ŋ teeŋ, hɛ doluŋ aŋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ Nikopolis lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩɩna dɩ mɩ hɔŋ nɩmɛ nɛ waarɩŋ chɛnsɩ-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Dɩ Ziinas sarɩya diiru-la arɩ Apɔlɔs nɩɩ vɛŋ ba wombiiŋ, pɛ ba lɛ woruŋ. Pɩba kʋ-la kala ba sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: La dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɔnɔ, laa chʋɔlʋŋ. Chʋɔlɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a chola. Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma kala lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl, nɩɩ-la ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa a tɩŋ Yesu Kirisito wɩaa arɩ la naambie Timoti nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ aa pɩ ŋ-na Fɩlɩmɔŋ. Ŋ ŋaa la nandɔŋ-choolii nɛ, a bɩra ŋaa la tɩtɩnnɩ dɔŋ ma.

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: La bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi ŋ dɩa lɛ, a bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ la dɩhaala Apɩa arɩ la naambie Akɩpʋs. Akɩpas ŋaa la laalɩyuori dɔŋ nɛ Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Pɔɔl lɔllɛ Wɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ Fɩlɩmɔŋ lɛ

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, mɩ yie lɔllɛ Wɩa nɛ a tɩŋ ŋ wɩaa,

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ cho Wɩa nɩaa, arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ laa La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii.

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: Mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ dɩ Wɩa pɛ ŋ lɛ dɩ ŋ wasa bʋl Kirisito wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa dii a pɩ nɩaa, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ŋ chaasa jɩŋ wʋzɔŋ-na kala la sɩ kɛnɛ Kirisito teeŋ.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: Mɩ naambii-choolii, ŋ sɩ́ cho Wɩa nɩaa ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa mɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, mɩ nyuŋ nyaasɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ leŋe Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ. Pɔɔl sʋl Fɩlɩmɔŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ Oniisimɔs woruŋ

english_verse: Christ gives me the courage to tell you what to do.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Kirisito wɩaa lɛ, mɩ fa jaŋ wuo dagɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: Ama a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ choŋ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la. Mɩ-na Pɔɔl nɛ paala chɩŋ Yesu Kirisito naasɩŋ lɛ aŋ lɛɛlɛ hɛ sarɩka lɛ a tɩŋ ʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ a tɩŋ mɩ bie Oniisimɔs wɩaa. Ʋ naga mɩ bii nɛ Yesu wɩaa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa, mɩ lɛ nɛ ʋ to a laa Yesu wɩaa dii bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ hɛ sarɩka lɛ.

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ fa sɩ hɛ ŋ teeŋ, ʋ fa bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ a pɩŋ, ama lɛɛlɛ, ʋ kɛŋ bʋbʋɔŋ a pɩ mɩ dɩŋ kala nɛ.

english_verse: Sending Onesimus back to you makes me very sad.
translation_verse: Mɩ leŋe ʋ kʋkɔ ŋ teeŋ nɛ, mɩ chou nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: Mɩ fa cho dɩ ʋ hɛ mɩ teeŋ nɛ. Mɩ ha sɩ hɛ sarɩka lɛ ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa, ʋ fa jaŋ wuo pɛ mɩ lɛ arɩ ŋ fa sɩ jaŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ fʋgʋŋ dɩ ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ to ŋ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ a pɛ mɩ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩkala see dɩ ŋ sɛyɛ.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Kapo Oniisimɔs lɩɩ ŋ teeŋ tapʋlɩa-la baŋmɛnɛ ŋɩɩ ka dɩ ʋ mɩɩra kɔ a hɛ ŋ teeŋ deeŋ deeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Oniisimɔs fa ŋaa ŋ yomo nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ kɩɩ yomo. Ʋ ŋaa la naambii-tɩtɩɩ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɛ. Mɩ chou nɛ woruŋ, mɩ jɩma ŋ ma jaŋ chou, ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋ yomo arɩ ŋ naambie kala La Tɩɩna Yesu teeŋ.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ bene dɩ mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔŋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ, kɛnʋ woruŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ fa sɩ jaŋ kɛmmɛ.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa wɩɩ cheyiŋ, koo dɩ ʋ dii ŋ chɩmɩŋ ma, joŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ-la.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɔɔl, mɩ tɩtɩa nɩsɩŋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ timiŋ. Sɩ́ yʋ arɩ ŋ ma kɛŋ mɩ chɩmɩŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ to a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ Yesu teeŋ.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambii, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, a tɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa, ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩmɛ. La sɩ ŋaa naambiiri Kirisito lɛ, leŋ dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.

english_verse: I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more.
translation_verse: Mɩ laa dii arɩ mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ. Mɩ jɩma arɩ ŋ jaŋ paala ŋaa kɩɩ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: Pɛ chɛ dɩa a bil mɩ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩɩ yɩɛlɛ arɩ ma sɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩmɛ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa jaŋ laa ma kala sʋla a leŋ dɩ mɩ mɩɩra kɔ ma teeŋ. Pɔɔl arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ chʋɔlɛ Fɩlɩmɔŋ

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Ɛpafɩras ma ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa a pɛ mɩ lɛ Yesu wɩaa, ʋ ma ka chʋɔlʋŋ.

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: Maak arɩ Arɩsɩtakʋs arɩ Dɩmas arɩ Luuk, ba ma ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔsʋŋ nɛ, ba ma ka chʋɔlʋŋ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Faafaa-la Wɩa bʋl wɩaa pɩ la naabalɩmaba a yʋgɛ nɛ. Wombie-la ʋ sɩ to bʋl wɩaa pɩba ma yʋga nɛ. Ʋ to ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩba.

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: Ama lɛɛlɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, ʋ to ʋ Bie lɛ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩla. Wɩa to ʋ Bie lɛ nɛ a ŋaa dʋnɩa, a joŋ kʋŋkala hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ tʋla-la, ʋ nɛ ʋ Bie ma kɛŋ. Ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ naga, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ Bie ma nagɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl kɛŋ doluŋ, dol-la nɛ ʋ kaa beŋ kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Ʋ sɩ pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ ta dɛrɛ, ʋ jɩla hɔŋ Wɩa nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ kɩɩ Wɩa tɩndaaraa kala. Yɩrɩ-la ʋ sɩ laa Wɩa teeŋ, ʋ ma nɛ kɩɩ yɩrɩ-la Wɩa tɩndaara-la sɩ laa.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Ŋ ŋaa mɩ Bii nɛ, mɩ nɛ lʋlʋŋ jɩnɩŋ.” Ʋ saa bɩra bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ: “Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ Nyɩmma, ŋ ma jaŋ ŋaa mɩ Bii.” Wɩa tɩndaarɩ bɛɛ lɛ nɛ Wɩa ha bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ?

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ leŋe ʋ Bii-hɩaŋ kʋ tuu dʋnɩa, ʋ sɩ, “Wɩa tɩndaaraa kala maga ba chʋɔlʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ tɩndaaraa lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ leŋe mɩ tɩndaaraa sɩ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nagɛ peliŋ arɩ nyiŋgeliŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ ʋ Bie lɛ, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl: Ʋ sɩ, “Ŋ ŋaa Wɩa nɛ, ŋ kuoruŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ. Tʋɔpʋla nɛ ŋ jaŋ kaa beŋ ŋ nɩaa.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: Ŋ cho tʋɔpʋl wɩaa nɛ aŋ bɛrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ-na ŋ Wɩa lɩɩsɩŋ a leŋ ŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a kɩɩ ŋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ba bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ba sɩ, “La Tɩɩna, dɩ-suomuŋ kala ŋ nɛ bil tinteeŋ gentine, ŋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ ma.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
translation_verse: Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala jaŋ lɛl, ama ŋ-na jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba kala jaŋ kɔsɛ, a nagɛ gɛnnɩŋ sɩɩ kɔsɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ nagɛ gɛrɩŋ dɩ ŋ kaa kpeŋ. Ba jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ a nagɛ gɛrɩŋ zɔmʋŋ sɩ lɩa. Ama ŋ-na bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ŋ bɩrɩma. Ŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa bɩra sɩ bʋla pʋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ sɩ, “Kʋ hɔŋ mɩ nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ, see mɩ yuo dii ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala dɛrɛ.” Wɩa tɩndaarɩ bɛɛ lɛ nɛ Wɩa ha bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ?

english_verse: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaara-la kala ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa nɛ. Wɩa yie tɩmba ba mʋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ laa ta lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa, ʋ maga dɩ la kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ nɩa woruŋ, dɩ wɩɩkala sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ.

english_verse: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa tɩndaaraa fa sɩ bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ fa bɩ baa to, koo dɩ nʋʋ nɛ fa chei ba kʋŋ, Wɩa yie dɔgɩsɛba nɛ.

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa dɩ la nɛ vɩa wʋbalɩŋ deeŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa dɩ ʋ laala ta, ɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaa a fori? La Tɩɩna Yesu nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wɩɩ-la, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la bʋla pɩla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: Wɩa ma tɩtɩa daga arɩ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ dagɛ ʋ doluŋ a ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ arɩ wʋmagɩlaa kala. Wɩa to ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ a joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a dii zile nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ naga Wɩa joŋ tintee-falɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ a hɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ ba bibeŋ, tintee-falɩɩ-la wɩaa la sɩɩ bʋl.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ba bʋla, “Nuhuobiine tuo kʋŋkala ka ŋ bɩbɩɩnɛ ʋ wɩaa. Nuhuobiine bie tuo kʋŋkala ka ŋ chɩl ʋ wɩaa

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋaa nuhuobiine, a leŋ ŋ tɩndaaraa nɛ kɩɩʋ mʋa, ka ŋ zilu a leŋ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ arɩ yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: Ŋ joŋ kʋŋkala ŋ sɩ ŋaa hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ bibeŋ.” Ŋ sɩ joŋ kʋŋkala hɛ nuhuobiine nɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋ leŋe ʋ kɛŋ ba kala doluŋ nɛ. Ama lɛɛlɛ la na dɩ nuhuobiine ha bɩ kʋŋkala ka beŋ.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: La na arɩ Wɩa fa leŋe Wɩa tɩndaaraa nɛ kɩɩ Yesu mʋa. Ama lɛɛlɛ Wɩa zilu nɛ a leŋ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ arɩ yɩrɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ na hɛɛŋ nɛ a sʋʋ. Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ nɛ ʋ fa ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ wuo laa nuhuobiinee kala nyuŋ a sʋʋ.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, Wɩa nɛ ŋaaba a tɩɩba ma. Ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ yʋgɛ kʋ jʋʋ ʋ kuorii-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ leŋe Yesu, nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ laaba ta na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Yesu, nɩɩ-la sɩ pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ ta, arɩ nɩalɩŋ disiniŋ ʋ sɩ pɩɩsa ta, ba kala nyɩmma ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a wuo yɩrɛ ba kala ʋ naambiiriŋ, ka hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ ʋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Yesu sɩ bʋla pɩ Wɩa nɛ ŋ-la: “Mɩ jaŋ bʋl ŋ wɩaa pɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ, aŋ dɛnnɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hilime aa chʋɔlʋŋ tʋɔŋ.”

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bʋla, “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ Wɩa lɛ,” a bɩra bʋl, “Na mɩ dɩ ŋ biiri-la kala ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la.”

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Biiri-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩ Kirisito kɛŋ chalɩŋ arɩ yaraa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Kirisito ma bɩrɩmɛ nuhuobiiŋ a kɛŋ chalɩŋ arɩ yaraa dɩ ʋ sʋʋ a wuo yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ, nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ sʋʋŋ doluŋ,

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: a wuo laa nɩaa ta, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fá sʋʋŋ a ŋaa sʋʋŋ yosi ba mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ bɩ naga Wɩa tɩndaaraa lɛ nɛ ʋ kʋ pɛ, ama ʋ kʋ pɛ Abɩraham doho nɩaa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bɩrɩmɛ nuhuobiine a ma nagɛ ʋ naambiiri-la, ba wɩɩ-wɩɩkala lɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ wuo kʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa nɩaa nyuŋ kʋhɩaŋ ʋ naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ a ŋaa nʋʋ sɩɩ fa nɩaa nenige, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ Wɩa joŋ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba.
