english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Ʋ tɩtɩa na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ. Sɩtaanɩ ma fa magɩsʋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ jaŋ wuo pɛ nɩalɩŋ Sɩtaanɩ sɩɩ magɩsʋ lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambiiriŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, Wɩa nɛ yɩrɛla dɩ la kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ saa maga dɩ ma joŋ Yesu wɩaa hɛ ma nyuŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa nanzɔɔ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ ma, wombii-la la sɩɩ to lɛ.

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa to nɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩsʋ nɛ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, arɩ Mosis fa sɩ to Wɩa arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa dɩa lɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: La jɩma arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ saa dɩɩ-zɔmʋŋ nɛ maga dɩ ʋ laa yɩrɩŋ a kɩɩ dɩa-la ʋ sɩ saa. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ yɩrɩ-la Yesu sɩ laa nɛ yʋga kɩɩ Mosis yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Dɩa na-kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, nʋʋ nɛ saa. Ama Wɩa nɛ ta kʋŋkala.

english_verse: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.
translation_verse: Mosis fa ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ nɛ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa. Ʋ nɛ fa bʋl wɩaa pɩba a tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa maachie sɩ jaŋ bʋl lɛ.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Ama Kirisito-na fa ŋaa Wɩa Bii nɛ, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a bibeŋ Wɩa nɩaa. Dɩ la ma nɛ kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ a tɩŋ kɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ wɩaa, la jaŋ wuo ŋaa ʋ nɩaa. Ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a na wiese Wɩa teeŋ

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ bʋla pɩla, “Jɩnɩŋ, dɩ ma nɛ nɩɩ Wɩa yikoro,

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: má sɩ́ sɩɩ-duoŋ kɛŋ, arɩ ma naabalɩmaba fa sɩ kɛŋ sɩɩ-duoŋ a lɩɩ Wɩa harɩŋ ŋɩɩ, bʋa-la lɛ nɛ ba magɩsɛmɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Lee-la ma naabalɩmaba magɩsɛmɛ nɛ woruŋ, arɩ ba sɩ na mɩ wʋŋaalaa jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa ma kala.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ baanɩŋ sii nɩaa deemba kala nyuŋ, mɩ bʋl, ‘Ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa yie ŋaa ba yeŋŋi nɛ, ba bɩ mɩ wombiiŋ jɩŋ.’

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na baanɩŋ a ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ba lɛ a bʋl, ‘Ma bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ tintee-la mɩ fa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ma hɔnɔ wiesi.’ ”

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ nʋʋ sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ bɩɩnʋ koo a kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩna-la sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ Wɩa laa dii, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa Wɩa sɩ weye.

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Ama má pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ tapʋlɩɩ-na kala a lɩɩ jɩnɩŋ a kaa mʋmʋ, dɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ́ wuo nyɩsɛ ma kʋŋkala a leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa sɩɩ-duo wɩaa Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii bumbuŋ, dɩ la nɛ kɛmba ŋɩɩ a kaa mʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, la dɩ Kirisito kala jaŋ ŋaa kʋbala.

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛba nɛ nɩɩ Wɩa yikoro aŋ lɩɩ Wɩa harɩŋ ŋɩɩ? Ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛba lɛ nɛ Wɩa fa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ arɩ ba bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ tintee-la ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩba dɩ ba hɔnɔ wiesii ŋɩɩ? Ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ bɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa ka to.

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: La na arɩ ba sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii nɛ tɩɩ ba bɩ wuo jʋʋ tintee-la Wɩa fa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋo pɩba.

english_verse: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.
translation_verse: Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla arɩ la jaŋ wuo kɔ ʋ teeŋ a na wiese, ŋɩɩ ha chɩna nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ dɩ wiese deeŋ sɩ́ ma kʋŋkala lɛ bal.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la ba sɩ bʋla pɩla, ba fa bʋla pɩ la naabalɩmaba ma nɛ. Ama ba bɩ wɩalɩŋ laa dii. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ fa bɩ ba wiese-la pa.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: La nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa wɩalɩŋ dii jaŋ wuo mʋ Wɩa teeŋ a na wiese-la arɩ Wɩa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ. Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ fa na baanɩŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ ba bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ tintee-la mɩ fa sɩɩ chɛ mɩ joŋo pɩba dɩ ba hɔnɔ wiesi.” Ama la jɩma arɩ bumbuŋ-la Wɩa sɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa, ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa kala dɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ chɛ-pɛmɩŋ chɛɛŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ba sɩ, “Wɩa sɩ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa dɛrɛ, ʋ wiese nɛ chɛ-pɛmɩŋ chɛɛŋ.”

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Lee-la tɩtɩa Wɩa bɩra bʋla, “Ba bɩ jaŋ na wiese mɩ teeŋ.”

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ha jaŋ na wiese-la. Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la bɩ wiese-la na, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nɩa laa dii.

english_verse: Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bɩra lɩɩsɛ tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala. Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ ŋaa jɩnɩŋ. Ʋ to la naabalɩma Devit lɛ nɛ a bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ. Ʋ sɩ, “Jɩnɩŋ, dɩ ma nɛ nɩɩ Wɩa yikoro, má sɩ́ sɩɩ-duoŋ kɛŋ.”

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ ba naabalɩma Josua fa sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaara, ʋ bɩ ba wiese pa. Dɩ ʋ nɛ fa pɩba wiese, Wɩa fa bɩra bɩ jaŋ bʋl tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ wɩaa.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, Wɩa nɩaa sɩ jaŋ wiesi.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ na wiese Wɩa teeŋ, ʋ tɩɩna leŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ aŋ wiesi, arɩ Wɩa ma sɩ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa dɛrɛ aŋ wiesi ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Má saa leŋ dɩ la hɛ doluŋ a na wiese-la Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋo pɩla. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ bɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ to, ba bɩ wiese-la na. Dɩ la ma nɛ bɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ ka to, la ma bɩ jaŋ na wiese-la.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa weye a kɛŋ niiŋ a kɩɩ tokobiiŋ niiriŋ balɩa kala sɩɩ dii nyagaga. Ʋ yie wuo tɔɔ jʋʋ nuhuobiine, a kɛŋ ʋ dɩma arɩ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kaa pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ʋ yie wuo jɩŋ nuhuobiine tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala.

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: Kʋŋkala tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa faa Wɩa teeŋ. Wɩa na kʋŋkala nɛ, ʋ teeŋ ba kala hɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la dagɛ la wʋŋaalaa kala a pʋ. Yesu nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa nɩaa nyuŋ kʋhɩaŋ

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Yesu nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie a bɩra ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa nɩaa nyuŋ kʋhɩaŋ. Ʋ sɩ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa dɛrɛ, ʋ jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ a mʋ Wɩa teeŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má leŋ dɩ la kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii woruŋ.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má leŋ dɩ la kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a wuo yi lee-la Wɩa sɩ hɔnɔ, dɩ ʋ wuo fá la nenige. Dɩ la nɛ jʋʋ wɩɩkala, ʋ jaŋ fá la nenige a pɛ la lɛ.

english_verse: Every high priest is appointed to help others by offering gifts and sacrifices to God because of their sins.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ-na kala, ba yie lɩɩsʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ hɛ nuhuobiine arɩ Wɩa pɛgɛ a laa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa pɩpɩ Wɩa, aŋ pɛ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ tɩta.

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩaa yie wuo fɩɛlɛ nɩaa nyuŋ nɛ woruŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ bɩ jɩŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yeŋŋe Wɩa wombii-la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ma tɩtɩa yie ŋaa wɩaa chichei nɛ.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ. Wɩa nɛ yie lɩɩsɛ tɩɩna, arɩ ʋ fa sɩ lɩɩsɛ Arɔŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Kirisito ma bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kaa yʋgɛ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ. Ama wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla pʋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ sɩ, “Ŋ ŋaa mɩ Bii nɛ, jɩnɩŋ mɩ nɛ lʋlʋŋ.”

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Yesu fa sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, ʋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a faasa yel sɩlɩɩrɩŋ a sʋl Wɩa, ʋ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ wuo laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta dɩ ʋ sɩ́ sʋʋ. Yesu kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa muuri nɛ a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa laa ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: Yesu fa ŋaa Wɩa Bii ma nɛ, ama ʋ gʋnnɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ to Wɩa niiŋ a tɩŋ hɛɛ-la ʋ sɩ na.

english_verse: Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ to Wɩa niiŋ kala dɛrɛ, ʋ kʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩɩ to ʋ niiŋ sɩpaalaara, a laaba ta a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa lɩɩsʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ, a tɩma pɩ Wɩa arɩ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk fa sɩ tɩmaa pɩ Wɩa ŋɩɩ. Má waa Wɩa wɩaa lɛ, aŋ sɩ́ harɩŋ joŋo yɩaba

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: La kɛŋ wɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ dɩ la bʋl a tɩgɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ. Ama la bɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩɩ-la dɩ ma jɩŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma dɩgɩlaa yuŋŋie.

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la, ʋ diene nɛ. Ʋ fa maga dɩ ma nɛ dɩdagɛ nɩaa, ama ma haa chɛ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ dɩdagɛma Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ nɩa bumbuŋ. Ʋ naga maa chɛ yɩlɩŋ nɛ, ma ha bɩ kʋduoruŋ wuo didii.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ wasɛ yɩlɩŋ ŋaa bii-mulo nɛ, ʋ bɩ wʋzɔmʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ bʋa jɩŋ.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa la sɩ wuo jɩŋ bumbuŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla pɩla a tɩgɛ Kirisito lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ la mʋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ a wuo waa dɛrɛ Kirisito wɩaa lɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la bɩra suomo bʋbʋl wɩalɩŋ la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a bɩrɩma lɩɩ la wʋbɔmɔ-la lɛ la fa sɩɩ ŋaa. La bɩra bɩ chɛ dɩ la suomo bʋl ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ to a laa Wɩa wɩaa dii.

english_verse: Let's grow up, if God is willing.
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ sɛyɛ, la jaŋ kieli bumbuŋ wɩalɩŋ aŋ mʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: But what about people who turn away after they have already seen the light and have received the gift from heaven and have shared in the Holy Spirit? What about those who turn away after they have received the good message of God and the powers of the future world? There is no way to bring them back. What they are doing is the same as nailing the Son of God to a cross and insulting him in public!
translation_verse: dɩ ba nɛ jɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala aŋ bɩra joŋ harɩŋ yɩa Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la, ɛɛ nɛ ba jaŋ bɩra ŋaa a bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, aŋ kɔ Wɩa teeŋ? Ʋ saa naga arɩ ba bɩra wasa kpaasɛ Wɩa Bie mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ nɛ. Ba sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba bɩra leŋe hɩɩsɩŋ diiu nɛ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Dɩ duonuŋ nɛ nɩa, dɩ tinteeŋ nyʋa lɩɩŋ vɔgɛ, tintee-la kɩaa yie wasɛ nɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɛrɛ lee-la. Wɩa nɛ pɛ tintee-la lɛ.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ yaŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ dʋndʋŋa nɩɩ nyʋ lee-la, ŋɩɩ-na tintee-la bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ. Wɩa jaŋ wuo ŋmɩɛsa hɛ tintee-la lɛ. Ba jaŋ chaanɛ nyiniŋ hɛ dɩ ʋ dii buru.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: Laa bʋl wɩaa deemba kala, ama ma-na, la nandɔŋ-chooloo, la kɛŋ yɩɛlaa ma lɛ. La jɩma ma jaŋ na kʋzɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ laatanɩŋ wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ yʋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ma sɩ tɩma pʋ arɩ chono-la ma sɩ daga pʋ a pɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ aŋ ha pɩpɛ ba lɛ.

english_verse: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.
translation_verse: La saa cho dɩ ma kʋŋkala fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ aa yɩɛlɛ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ na, a jɩŋ woruŋ arɩ ma sɛnɛ jaŋ naba, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ naaŋ lɛ a mʋ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: La bɩ chɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ yarɩwɩɩŋ. Laa chɛ dɩ ma to nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii faafaa naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ. Nɩaa deemba chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii lɛ nɛ a nyalɩma ŋɩɩ halɩɩ, a wuo na kɩalɩŋ Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pɩba arɩ ba jaŋ na. Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla sɛnɛ ŋaa nɛ

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Faafaa-la Wɩa hɛ niiŋ a pɩ Abɩraham nɛ. Kʋŋkala fa tuo a yʋga kɩɩ ʋ-na Wɩa dɩ ʋ ŋmɩɛsɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋmɩɛsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants!”
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋmɩɛsa a bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ a leŋ dɩ ŋ doho nɩaa pʋŋa yʋgɛ.”

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩraham kɛŋ kenyiri a gbɛrɛ, a sɛnɛ na wɩɩ-la Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pʋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ na.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Dɩ nuhuobiinee nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba dagɛ arɩ wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ bʋl ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ba yie ŋmɩɛsɛ kʋŋ sɩ kɩɩba nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ kaalɛrɛ kala yie dɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pɩ ʋ nɩaa arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ kɩaa pɩba, ʋ fa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba chaasa jɩŋ arɩ ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ niiŋ bɩrɩmɛ, ʋ ŋmɩɛsa daŋ nɛ.

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: Wɩa saa ŋaa wɩaa balɩa nɛ. Ʋ sɩ wuo bʋl wɩɩ-la aŋ pɛ ŋmɩɛsɛ ŋɩɩ, wɩaa deemba balɩamɩŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba bɩrɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa bɩ wɩaa nyɩɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, la nɩalɩŋ sɩ fá mʋ Wɩa teeŋ dɩ ʋ laala ta nyuŋ nyaasɛ nɛ dɩ la kɛŋ yɩɛlaa woruŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pɩla lɛ.

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: La sɩɩ yɩɛlɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋɩɩ, la jaŋ wuo nyɩrɛ la bɔyɛ a chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii lɛ woruŋ, a wuo jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, lee-la patɩɩsaŋ-balɩŋ fa sɩ kɛrɛ.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: Baal-la ba sɩ yɩrʋ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk, ʋ fa ŋaa taŋ kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Salɛm kuoru nɛ aŋ fa pɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ. Bʋa kʋbala Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk cheŋ Abɩraham dɩ ʋ mʋ yuo laalɩŋ dii tinteeŋ dɔnsʋŋ kuoroo aŋ kʋkɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sʋl Wɩa pɩ Abɩraham.

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩraham kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yuo dii laal-la lɛ a kaa kpaa leree fii, a joŋ kʋbala pʋ. Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk yɩrɩ-la bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, ‘kuoru-la sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ’. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Salɛm kuoro ma. Salɛm kuoro bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, ‘kuoru-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ nɩaa hɔŋ sɔm’.

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk fa bɩ nyɩmma kɛnɛ, ʋ bɩ naaŋ ma kɛnɛ. Nʋʋkala fa bɩ ʋ doho jɩŋ, a bɩ bʋa-la ba sɩ lʋlʋ arɩ bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ sʋba ma jɩŋ. Ama ʋ fa nagɛ Wɩa Bie nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Ma jaŋ na dɩ ʋ fa ŋaa nɩbal nɛ. La naabalɩma Abɩraham fa sɩ lɩɩ laalɩŋ kɔ, ʋ paala kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yuo dii laal-la lɛ a kaa kpaa leree fii, a joŋ kʋbala pʋ.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk fa bɩ Levi doho nʋʋ ŋaa aŋ pɛ laa kpaalɩŋ fii tʋɔŋ kʋbala-la Abɩraham teeŋ, aŋ sʋl Wɩa pʋ, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ hɛ niiŋ pa.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ tuo wʋkaalɛrɛ, nɩbalɩŋ nɛ yie sʋl Wɩa pɩ nɩ-bie.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Levi nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa kpaalɩŋ fii tʋɔŋ kʋbala deeŋ, ba-naa sʋʋ nɛ. Ama Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk-na sɩ laa kɩaa Abɩraham teeŋ, ʋ-na bɩ sʋʋ. Arɩ jɩnɩŋ ʋ ha weye nɛ. Ba bʋl ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ joŋ ʋ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ a pɩ Mosis dɩ nɩaa tuto lɛ nɛ Levi doho nɩaa to a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩɩ tɩŋ. Dɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la nɛ fa pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ dɩ ba chaasa ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ, ŋɩɩ-na ʋ bɩra bɩ maga dɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ sɩ nagɛ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk kɔ aa tɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ama Wɩa sɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ jaŋ kɔ, ʋ-na bɩ jaŋ lɩɩ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ Levi doho nʋʋ ŋaa nɛ kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ, ŋɩɩ-na ʋ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto ma kaa bɩrɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Kirisito wɩaa nɛ baa bʋl ŋɩɩ. Ʋ ma lɩɩ doho dɔŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Nʋʋkala ha bɩ doho deeŋ tʋɔŋ lɩa a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara.

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ dɔŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara sɩ folo kɔ ŋ-la a nagɛ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk, wɩaa deemba kala chaasa pʋllɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Wɩa bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ nagɛ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk nɛ. Ŋ jaŋ laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ.”

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto bɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala wuo chaasa ŋaa nɩzɔŋ. Wʋfalaa nɛ lɛɛlɛ Wɩa bil dɩ la tuto, wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la mʋ kpagʋ.

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Ama La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsɛ Yesu, ʋ ŋmɩɛsa nɛ a bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ niiŋ bɩrɩmɛ. Ʋ bɩra bʋla, ‘Ŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara a kaa mʋ wuu.’ ”

english_verse: There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa fa yʋga nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba faa sʋʋ nɛ. Ba sɩɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, ba bɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la wuo tɩŋ deeŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: Ama Kirisito-na jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara a kaa mʋ wuu, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ sʋʋ.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ wuo laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ to ʋ lɛ a kɔ Wɩa teeŋ ta. Ʋ jaŋ wuo laaba ta, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ bʋa na-kala a sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩba.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara kʋhɩaŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ a pɩla. Yesu bɩ disiŋ kɛnɛ, ʋ bɩ wʋcheeli kɛnɛ, ʋ chaasa ŋaa nɩzɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pɔrɛ nɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa lɛ. Wɩa kɛnʋ ŋaa nɩbal. Ʋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ yʋga kɩɩ kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ fa yie kpʋ pʋsʋŋ tapʋlɩɩ-na kala nɛ. Ʋ fa maga dɩ ba kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a tɩŋ ba tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ, aŋ bɩra kpʋ dɔnsʋŋ ma a tɩŋ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Yesu-na bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa. Ʋ bɩ pʋsʋŋ kpʋa a tɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ bala nɛ a pɩ Wɩa a tɩŋ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Ʋ tɩtɩa mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ ʋ kaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la kala la sɩɩ bʋl wʋnyuŋ nɛ ŋ-la. La kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa kʋhɩaŋ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ a hɔŋ Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ kuoru kpasa nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ.

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lee-la sɩ chaasa zɔŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ hɛ a tɩtɩŋ. Wɩa dɩa tɩtɩa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Lee-la nuhuobiine dee bɩ saa. La Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ saa.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ saa fa hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, ʋ fa bɩ jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, ba nɛ yie to wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto lɛ a tɩtɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ Wɩa dɩa tʋɔŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Ba sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, baa chesi Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ wɩaa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tɩtɩa deeŋ. Mosis fa sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ hɛ lɛbɩŋ, Wɩa fa bʋl wɩaa pʋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ, “Hɛ lɛbɩ-la dɩ ʋ nagɛ kʋ-la mɩ sɩ dagɩŋ peel-la nyuŋ.”

english_verse: Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.
translation_verse: Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Kirisito sɩɩ tɩŋ nɛ yʋga kɩɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la bumbuŋ nɩaa sɩ tɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa to ʋ lɛ nɛ a bil nii-falɩŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ. Nii-falɩɩ-la nɛ kpɩa bumbuŋ nii-la Wɩa sɩ hɛ pɩ ʋ nɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ ta da.

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Dɩ bumbuŋ nii-la Wɩa sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ nɛ fa pɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ, Wɩa fa bɩra bɩ jaŋ bil nii dɔŋ ʋ nɩaa teeŋ.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Ʋ na dɩ bumbuŋ wɩalɩŋ bɩ ʋ nɩaa lɛ pɛ dɩ ba wuo ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Bʋa dɔŋ jaŋ kɔ, dɩ mɩ bil nii-falɩŋ mɩ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Juda doho nɩaa pɛgɛ.

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ jaŋ nagɛ nii-la mɩ fa sɩ bile mɩ dɩ ba naabalɩmaba pɛgɛ, bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛmba kaa kʋʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba fa bɩ mɩ nii-la lɛ to, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ joŋ harɩŋ yɩaba.”

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ, “Bʋa-la lɛ nii-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ bil mɩ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto hɛ ba nyuŋ lɛ, aŋ ŋmʋnsɛba hɛ ba tʋɔŋ ma lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ba Wɩa, dɩ ba ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ dagɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna koo ʋ naambii ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a jɩmmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba kala jaŋ jɩmmɛ, a chɩŋ nɩbiisiŋ lɛ a kaa jɩl nɩbalaa.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ liliisi ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.”

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ bʋl nii-falɩɩ-la wɩaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ sɩ dɩ bumbuŋ kʋ-la ŋaa kʋbɩnɩɩ nɛ. Kʋ-la kala saa sɩ diene ŋaa kʋbɩnɩɩ nɛ, ʋ jaŋ lɛl.

english_verse: The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ-la nii-la Wɩa fa sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ, fa kɛŋ wombiee nɛ ba to a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa, a kɛŋ lɛbɩŋ ma ba sɩɩ chʋɔlʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: Lɛbɩ-la fa kɛŋ leree balɩa nɛ, tɛgɛɛ arɩ sɩpaaŋ. Tɛgɛɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ nɛ chaaŋ daaŋ fa chɩŋ. Teebʋl ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ, boroboro-la ba sɩ yie kaa mʋ bil Wɩa sɩpaaŋ ma fa daŋ nyuŋ. Lee-la yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa lee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ,

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Sɛlɩmɛ koruŋ nɛ fa hɛ lee-la. Nɩmɛ nɛ ba yie nyɩgɛ tɩɩ-keliŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma a pɩpɩ Wɩa. Daga kʋbala ma nɛ fa chɩŋ nɩmɛ, sɛlɩmɛ tɔ ʋ kala. Sɛlɩmɛ pupoiŋ nɛ fa hɛ daga-la tʋɔŋ, ba joŋ kʋdiile-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kʋ tuu baa yɩrɛ ‘mana’ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ. Arɔŋ daa-la sɩ tɔsɔ ma fa hɛ daga-la tʋɔŋ nɛ. Tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la lɛ Wɩa fa sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ʋ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ hɛ, ba ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Daga-la nyuŋ, ba mɛ kɩaa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ aa tʋl, a bil ba ma chɩŋ. Ba kɛŋ ba kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ kaa jɛrɛ tɔ daga-la nii-tɔlɔ, lee-la Wɩa sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige, a joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a chɩchɛba. Lɛɛlɛ la bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩaa yʋgɛ a tɩgɛ wɩaa deemba lɛ.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Ba sɩ bil kɩalɩŋ kala dɛrɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, yie jʋʋ tɛgɛɛ lɛbɩ-la a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ baa tɩŋ.

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ yie jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ. Ʋ ma saa yie jʋʋ lee-la bala nɛ jɩna kala. Ʋ yie kɛŋ pʋna chalɩŋ nɛ a kaa jʋʋ pɩ Wɩa, a tɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la a chei Wɩa aŋ bɩ jɩŋ.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ to wɩaa deemba kala lɛ aa dagɛ arɩ wombii-la ba sɩ to jʋjʋʋ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ ha bɩ suro, bɛɛ wɩaa tɛgɛɛ lɛbɩ-la ha hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba ka dagɛ kʋdiilee arɩ kʋnyʋalaa arɩ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ sɔmʋŋ dʋndʋŋa wɩaa nɛ, a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋfalaa kɔ.

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Ama Kirisito kɔ nɛ lɛɛlɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ. Wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kaa kɔ nɛ zɔmɔ a kɩɩ bumbuŋ wɩalɩŋ. Ʋ sɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ, ʋ jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ nɛ, ʋ nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ bumbuŋ kʋ-la. Nuhuobiine dee bɩ saa. Ʋ bɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ kʋŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: Kirisito jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ bala dʋndʋŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ bʋʋna koo nɛ-pasɩŋ chalɩŋ kaa jʋʋ nɩmɛ. Ama ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa chalɩŋ nɛ kaa jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a joŋ chal-la a tiŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɩmɩŋ, a laala ta a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ ba fa yie joŋ bʋʋnaa koo nɛ-belliŋ chalɩŋ nɛ a pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ ta. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa disiniŋ, ba yie kpʋ nɛ-paha a nyɩgɛ a paa ʋ tʋɔrʋŋ mɩsɛ tɩɩna a pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩaa deemba nɛ wuo pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ ta, ŋɩɩ-na Kirisito chalɩŋ ma jaŋ wuo paala pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ ta a kɩɩ bʋʋnaa koo nɛsɩŋ chalɩŋ. Kirisito fa bɩ disiŋ kala kɛnɛ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ, ʋ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pɩ Wɩa, a sʋʋ a tɩŋ la wɩaa. Ʋ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa chesi dɩ má sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ bɩɩnʋ, ka dɩ ma wuo tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa sɩ weye.

english_verse: In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sɩ dɩ ʋ nɛ sʋba, nʋʋ dɔŋ nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ ʋ kɩaa, dɩ tɩɩna nɛ ha bɩ sʋba, nɩɩ-la bɩ jaŋ wuo tɩɩ kɩalɩŋ, see dɩ kɩalɩŋ tɩɩna sʋba.

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: Dɩ kɩaa tɩɩna nɛ weye, nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ tɩɩ ʋ kɩaa bɩ jaŋ wuo tɩɩ kɩalɩŋ, see dɩ ʋ sʋba.

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa kɛŋ chalɩŋ bil bumbuŋ nii-la.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, dɩ ʋ nɛ kʋ dagɛba wɩalɩŋ a kʋ dɛrɛ-na kala, ʋ yie kpʋ nɛ-pasɩŋ arɩ bʋʋnaa nɛ, a laa chalɩŋ a ŋaa lɩɩŋ guoli. Ʋ yie chɛ pie-pʋŋ-fɩɛsɩŋ arɩ kaku-dɩgɩlɩŋ a vɔɔ a hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a kaa yuu chal-la, a mɩsɛ hɛ teŋ-la lɛ ʋ sɩ ŋmʋnsa, aŋ pɛ ŋaa mɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ ma.

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa chal-la mɩmɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ yie bʋl: “Chal-la Wɩa sɩ kaa bil niiŋ ʋ dɩ ma pɛgɛ nɛ ŋ-la.”

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ yie ŋaa chal-la mɩsɛ lɛbɩ-la arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ nagɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ chalɩŋ pɩɩsɛ kɩaa deemba disiniŋ ta. Ama kɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba chɛ kʋ-la sɩ zɔmɔ kɩɩ pʋsʋ-la chalɩŋ nɛ a kaa pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ naga Kirisito jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la nuhuobiinee sɩ ŋaa nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ ŋaa lɛbɩ-la, ka chesi Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la nɛ. Ama Kirisito jʋʋ Wɩa-jaŋ tɩtɩa nɛ, dɩ ʋ chɩŋ la nyuŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ fa yie jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ jɩna jɩna nɛ, a pɛ kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ chalɩŋ kaa jʋʋ a pɩ Wɩa. Ama Kirisito-na sɩ jʋʋ lee-la, ʋ bɩ naga arɩ ʋ jaŋ vɛnɛɛ jʋʋ nɩmɛ jɩna-na kala a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɩpɩ Wɩa.

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ faa ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ fa jaŋ na hɛɛŋ jɩna na-kala a lɩɩ dʋnɩa dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. Ama lɛɛlɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ kpaga nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɔ bala dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɩ Wɩa a sʋʋ, a laa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta.

english_verse: We die only once, and then we are judged.
translation_verse: Bala nɛ nʋʋkala jaŋ sʋʋ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ, Wɩa jaŋ dii ʋ tɩɩna sarɩya.

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba kpʋ Kirisito balá dɩ ʋ laa nɩ-daŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta. Dɩ ʋ nɛ mɩɩra kɔ, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ laa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta, ama ʋ jaŋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a gbɛrʋ ta.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil nagɛ wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ nɛ, ama wʋzɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa dee ŋɩɩ. Ba nagɛ wʋzɔmɔ-la daaliimiŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa pʋsʋ-la ba sɩ yie kaa kʋ kpʋ pɩpɩ Wɩa jɩna-na kala, ba bɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ pʋsʋ-la kaa kɔ chaasa ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: But the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins. It only reminds people of their sins from one year to the next.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa nɛsɩŋ arɩ bʋʋnaa chalɩŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo laa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta.

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Kirisito bʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩ Wɩa bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ kʋ tuu dʋnɩa. Ʋ sɩ, “Ŋ-na bɩ pʋsʋ-la ba sɩ yie kpʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ nɛ cho, ama ŋ lɩɩsɛmɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa kala a pɩŋ.

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: Ŋ bɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa ma nɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, ‘Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, mɩ kɔ nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ. Mɩ kɔ nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil ŋ teniŋ tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them?
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ daga dɩ ba kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋɩŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a joŋ kɩaa ŋɩŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a ŋɩŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ama Kirisito bʋla dɩ Wɩa bɩ ŋɩɩ cho. Ʋ tʋɔŋ ma bɩ ba nyuŋ tɔrɔ.

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ kɔ nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ.” Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ vɩa bumbuŋ wɩalɩŋ ta nɛ, aŋ mɩɩra suomo bil wʋfalɩa.

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: Ama Kirisito sʋba a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɩ Wɩa bala nɛ dɩ ʋ laa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ a hɔŋ Wɩa nadiiŋ.

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ halɩɩ, see dɩ Wɩa yuo dii ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɩ Wɩa balá ŋɩɩ, ʋ leŋe nɩalɩŋ disiniŋ ba sɩ pɩɩsɛ ta ŋaa nɩa sɩ chaasa zɔŋ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma ŋaa wɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ bʋl pɛ-naara. Bumbuŋ ʋ sɩ,

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: “Dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, nii-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ bil mɩ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto wɩaa hɛ ba nyuŋ lɛ, aŋ ŋmʋnsɛba hɛ ba tʋɔŋ ma lɛ.”

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩra bʋla, “Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ liliisi ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ba nɩbɔŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa.”

english_verse: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices. Encouragement and Warning
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala a chɛla, ʋ bɩra bɩ maga dɩ la kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a pʋ a tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Má kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a kpagɛ Wɩa

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: La folo kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarɩ-hɩa-bal nɛ, ʋ bibeŋ Wɩa nɩaa.

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má leŋ la kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a laa wɩaa deemba dii arɩ tʋɔ-bala, a mʋ Wɩa teeŋ. Wɩa chɛsɛ la tʋɔŋ nɛ, a chɛsɛ la tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔmɔ-la kala ta. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ wʋwalɩmɛla. Ʋ kɛŋ lɩɩzɔmʋŋ nɛ fola.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii, má leŋ dɩ laa yɩɛlɛ wɩalɩŋ, a chɩŋ ba lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ, a sɩ́ begilu mʋa ma, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla, la laa dii arɩ la jaŋ naba.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la cho dɔŋɔ, a kɛŋ dɔŋɔ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, aa pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: La sɩ yie hihilimi ŋɩɩ, nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ yie vɩa nɛ. Má sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa. Ama má leŋ dɩ la haa hilimi a pɩpɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ dɩ la to Wɩa arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ kpaga nɛ.

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ kʋ jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la aŋ vɩaʋ ta a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, kʋŋ dɔŋ bɩra tuo ba sɩ jaŋ wuo kpʋ a pɩ Wɩa a laa la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta.

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: Ama fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛnla, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa jaŋ dii la sarɩya. Ʋ jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩla, a jonla hɛ nyiniŋ sɩ faasa didii lɛ. Nyiŋ-la jaŋ dii Wɩa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: La jɩŋ Wɩa nɛ. Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa dɔŋɔ lɛ a timba.” Nʋʋ dɔŋ bɩra sɩ, “La Tɩɩna jaŋ dii ʋ nɩaa sarɩya.”

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ jʋʋ Wɩa-la sɩ weye nɩsɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ lɔrɔ pɩŋ.

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Má liise mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ suri ma sɩaa, ma kʋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii. Bʋa-la lɛ ma na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ aŋ nyalɩmɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Bʋa dɔŋɔ ba yie tʋʋsɛma a dɔgɩsɛma nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Bʋa dɔŋɔ ma ma yie chɩna gbɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ dɔgɩsʋ.

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: Ma fa nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa Yesu wɩaa bunso nɛ. Ba sɩ fʋga laa ma kɩaa, ma sɛɩ wɩɩ-la arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma jɩma arɩ ma kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ kɩɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ kɩaa nɛ. Kɩalɩŋ-na jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma kɛŋ kenyiri a wuo ŋaa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ na kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ sɩ, “Mʋapɩlɩɩ, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa jaŋ kɔ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Ama tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa-na jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩ laamɛ dii wɩaa. Ama dɩ ba nɛ vɩa Wɩa, ʋ tʋɔŋ bɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ ba nyuŋ.”

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Ama la-na tuo nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa Wɩa ʋ cheiba. La ŋaa nɩa sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ ʋ laala ta.

english_verse: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii, ŋ yie jɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ Wɩa teeŋ, ŋ jaŋ naba. Ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩŋ sɩ bɩ na sɛnɛ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ nɩalɩŋ fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ba nyuŋ.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: La laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa suri ʋ niiŋ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa kʋŋkala hɛ nɩmɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Kɩalɩŋ la sɩ bɩ na tʋɔŋ nɛ kɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ na lɩɩ.

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: Ebil fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kpʋ pʋna a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ sɩ zɔmɔ a pɩ Wɩa a kɩɩ ʋ naambie Keeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa joŋu arɩ ʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa wɩaa. Ebil sʋba ma nɛ, ama a tɩŋ ʋ fa sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ, ʋ ha bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩla nɛ.

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Ɛnɔk ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ʋ bɩ sʋba, aŋ ka Wɩa joŋu kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ ʋ na. Wɩa tɩtɩa nɛ joŋu kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ. Wɩa tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ, ka ʋ-na joŋu kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Nowa ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa kpʋrɩsɛ ʋ dɩgɩlaa a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dʋnɩa lɛ a pʋ, ʋ bɩ wɩɩ-la na aŋ sɛɩ Wɩa niiŋ a kpaasɛ lɩɩŋ daboro dɩ ʋ laa ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa ta. Nowa sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna aŋ joŋ cheeriŋ a pɩ nɩkaana-la kala.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Abɩraham ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Wɩa bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ ʋ jaŋ lɛ a mʋ tinteeŋ dɔŋɔ, dɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ lee-la a pɩ ʋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa. Ʋ to Wɩa niiŋ lɛ a lɩɩ ʋ jaŋ lɛ a mʋmʋ lee-la. Ʋ fa bɩ lee-la ʋ sɩɩ mʋ jɩŋ.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ, ʋ mʋ hɔŋ tintee-la Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pʋ lɛ a nagɛ nʋhʋɔrʋ. Ʋ nanʋala Aɩzɩk arɩ ʋ nihiŋ Jekɔb ma fa hɔŋ lee-la tɩtɩa nɛ a ŋaa nʋhʋɔra. Ba fa hɛ lɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ a jʋjʋʋ. Wɩa fa bʋla arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ tintee-la pɩ ba kala nɛ.

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: Abɩraham faa chɛ dɩ ʋ jʋʋ taŋ-la Wɩa tɩtɩa sɩ bil ʋ gentine a saa nɛ. Taŋ deeŋ nɛ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ a mʋmʋ.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Abɩraham fa hɩɛsa nɛ woruŋ a kieli biiriŋ lʋlʋŋ a kpagɛ sʋʋŋ aŋ lʋl bile. Ʋ doho nɩaa pʋŋa yʋgɛ woruŋ a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa, koo hagɩla sɩ pɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba kala laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ aŋ-na sʋʋ. Ba bɩ kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba laa. Ba naba arɩ ba hɛ dɩ-bolii, ama ba laa dii arɩ maachie ba jaŋ laa kɩalɩŋ. Ba bɩra jɩma arɩ ba ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa nɛ, a ŋaa jʋjʋʋlɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba faa chɛ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ nɛ dɩ ba hɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba bʋl wɩaa deemba a mʋ tɩgɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ faa bɩɩnɛ tintee-la lɛ ba sɩ lɩa wɩaa, ba fa jaŋ chɛ wombiiŋ a mɩɩra mʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Ama ba faa chɛ dɩ ba hɔŋ tintee-la sɩ zɔmɔ kɩɩ tintee kala. Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Wɩa tɩtɩa nɛ saa jaŋ-la a pɩba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba yɩrɛ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ, ka hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ Wɩa kɛnɛ.

english_verse: Abraham had been promised that Isaac, his only son, would continue his family. But when Abraham was tested, he had faith and was willing to sacrifice Isaac,
translation_verse: Wɩa fa bʋla pɩ Abɩraham arɩ Aɩzɩk lɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ tou a leŋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa pʋŋ.

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: Abɩraham fa jɩma arɩ Wɩa jaŋ wuo chɩsɛ ʋ bie sʋʋŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa ma sɛnɛ joŋ Aɩzɩk pɩ Abɩraham a nagɛ ʋ sʋba nɛ ka ʋ chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Jekɔb ma laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ʋ sʋʋŋ sɩ kpaga, ʋ ma sʋl Wɩa pɩ ʋ nihee nɛ Josɛf biiriŋ. Ʋ tɩɛbɛ ʋ dantɩga nɛ aŋ sʋl Wɩa pɩba.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Josɛf ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ʋ sʋʋŋ sɩ yie, ʋ bʋla arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa maachie jaŋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩra dagɛba ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ ʋ kʋsʋʋŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Mosis naaŋ arɩ ʋ nyɩmma ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba sɩ lʋl Mosis ba joŋu faa chɛnsɩŋ batori, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fa na dɩ ʋ ŋaa bii-zɔŋ nɛ. Ba fa bɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro fá aŋ vɩa nii-la ʋ sɩ bil a bʋl dɩ ba kpʋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa bii-mulluŋ kala sɩ ŋaa hambolibiisiŋ.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Mosis sɩ kʋ waa dɛrɛ, ʋ ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bɩ sɛyɛ dɩ ba kɛnʋ yɩrɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro tolo bii.

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: Mosis fa bene ba sɩ dɔgɩsʋ pɛ Wɩa nɩaa lɛ nɛ kpɩa ʋ sɩ jaŋ hɛ Faaro dɩa lɛ a nɩnɩɩ sɩma-la sɩ bɩ dieni aŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Mosis fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ dagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ba dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la. Ʋ leŋe ba kpʋ pʋsʋŋ, a kɛŋ chalɩŋ taa ba borusuŋ kala. Ba sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la ʋ sɩ tɩma dɩ ʋ kʋ tuu a kpʋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa bii-bumbumba kala Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ kʋ tuu a kpʋba aŋ kieli Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba vɛŋ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ-la tʋɔŋ a lɩɩ a nagɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ. Ama Ijipiti tɩmma-la fa sɩɩ kiriba sɩ kɔ a walɩmɛ dɩ ba chol, mʋga-la kʋ tɔba nɛ, ba kala sʋʋ.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Bʋa kʋbala lɛ, ba ŋaa wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ dagɛba, a vɛnɛ golli jee-la ba sɩ kɛrɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jeriko tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Ba sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a dɛrɛ, kɛrɛ-la tel wuru.

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
translation_verse: Wɩaa dɔnsʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ mɩ fa ha sɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl. Ama chɩnɩŋ tuo dɩ mɩ bʋl nɩaa deemba wɩaa: Gɩdɩɔŋ, Barak, Samɩsɩŋ, Jɛfɩta, Devit, Samʋɛl arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa wɩaa.

english_verse: Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions
translation_verse: Ba kala fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ, ba yuo dii kuoroo arɩ ba tinteyee. Ba to wʋtɩtɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ nɛ, a na kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba. Ba dɔnsʋŋ ma yuo dii naachigee.

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: Nyiniŋ ma bɩ ba dɔnsʋŋ wuo dii. Wɩa lɩɩsɛba nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ ba kpʋ. Ba fa bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ, ama Wɩa nɛ pɩba doluŋ ba wuo ŋaa wɩaa. Ba kʋ ŋaa bɔɩ-duoŋ tɩŋŋaa a yuo laalɩŋ a dii. Ba yuo a dii tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ, ba laalɩyuoroo fá lɛl.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Haalaa dɔnsʋŋ ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii, ba biiriŋ sɩ sʋba, Wɩa chɩsɛba sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ ba vɩɩrɛba kpʋ. Nɩaa deemba fa bɩ chɛ dɩ ba joŋ harɩŋ yɩa Wɩa aŋ laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ. Ba fa jɩma dɩ ba nɛ sʋba ma, Wɩa jaŋ chɩsɛba sʋʋŋ lɛ a joŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ a kɩɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ kʋa a pɩba.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa mɔŋ dɔnsʋŋ nɛ. Ba vɩɩrɛ dɔnsʋŋ ma ba yaraa bɩɛlɛ. Ba vɔɔ dɔnsʋŋ ma arɩ chɔrʋmɔɔ aŋ kɛmba tɔ dɩa.

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: Ba yagɛ dɔnsʋŋ arɩ tabɩaa, a kɛŋ dɔnsʋŋ keri balɩa balɩa, aŋ kpʋ dɔnsʋŋ ma arɩ tokobiee. Ba dɔnsʋŋ faa laalɛ piesee arɩ bʋʋnaa jɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ, a ŋaa summo. Ba to naasɩŋ dɔgɩsɛba, ba na hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa deeŋ fa bɩ zɔmɔ pɩ nɩalɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩ a gɔllɔɔ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ arɩ peelee nyuŋ, a fáa bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ arɩ bʋɔsʋŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bɛsɛ nɩaa deemba lɛ nɛ woruŋ. Ba kala fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ, ama kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba, ba bɩ ba na.

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: Wɩa faa chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋ kʋzɔŋ nɛ a pɩ la dɩ ba kala. Ʋ faa chɛ dɩ la dɩ ba kala ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ dɩ ʋ wuo joŋ kʋ-la pɩ la kala.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: La sɩ na dɩ nɩ-daŋ deeŋ gollila a ŋaa pɛ-naaraa a mʋ tɩgɛ ba sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa laa dii lɛ, má leŋ dɩ la joŋ wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ nyagɛla bil ta, arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala sɩ mɛrɛ la lɛ. Má leŋ dɩ la nyalɩmɛ a mʋmʋ sɩpaaŋ, a ŋaa wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo bil la sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Má bee na ŋɩɩ Yesu sɩ na hɛɛŋ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, aŋ nyalɩma. Dɩ ma nɛ bɩɩnɛ ʋ wɩaa, ma nandaasɩŋ bɩ jaŋ yʋɔrɛ. Ma bɩ jaŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii ta.

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: Nyu-nyaasɛ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩma, ma yʋa nɛɛ? Wɩa bʋl wɩalɩŋ pɩ ʋ biiriŋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ bii, dɩ Wɩa nɩɩ dagɩŋ, jegile nɩɩ woruŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛnɩŋ tʋraa kɩɩ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ.

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: Wɩa cho ʋ bii-na kala nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ yie kɛnʋ tʋraa kɩɩ. Nʋʋ na-kala Wɩa sɩ bene ʋ ŋaa ʋ bii, ʋ yie dɔgɩsʋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ kɛmma tʋraa kɩɩ, má nyalɩmɛ, ʋ jomma arɩ ma ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ nɛ. Bii bɛɛ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ ʋ nyɩmma bɩ ʋ ka dagɛ?

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Wɩa yie kɛŋ ʋ biiriŋ tʋraa kɩɩ nɛ, dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ ma kaa tʋraa kɩɩ, ʋ naga arɩ ma tuo ʋ biiri, ma ŋaa mɛŋgaa-biiri nɛ.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: La kala kɛŋ nyɩmmaba nɛ, ba yie dɩdagɛla nɛ, la ma zizilba. Ŋɩɩ-na ʋ maga dɩ la to la Nyɩmma Wɩa woruŋ a wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: La nyɩmmaba sɩ lʋlla, ba yie dagɛla jɩsɩŋ baŋmɛnɛ nɛ. Ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa nɛ ba yie dagɛla la tuto. Ama Wɩa-na yie dagɛla a tɩŋ la zɔmʋŋ wɩaa nɛ. Ʋʋ chɛ dɩ la ŋaa nɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ a nagʋ.

english_verse: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má leŋ dɩ ma yaraa polli.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Má hɛ ma doluŋ kala aŋ loo chɩchɛ dɩ ma dɩ nʋʋkala kɛŋ nii-bala, a bɩra loo chɩchɛ dɩ ma sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ma jaŋ wuo na Wɩa.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ fá la kala nenige ŋɩɩ, má pɔ dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ harɩŋ joŋo yɩaʋ. Má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ dɩ nɩbɔŋ kala sɩ́ ma tʋɔŋ hɛ a ŋaa wɩaa chei nɩ-daŋ.

english_verse: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ ma sɩ jɩma, ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ nyɩmma sʋl Wɩa pʋ, ʋ vɩa nɛ. Ʋ faasa yel a sʋl ʋ nyɩmma dɩ ʋ sʋl Wɩa pʋ. Ama ʋ bɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wuo kaa bɩrɩmɛ.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Ma kɔ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ, ama ma bɩ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ leriŋ nɛ kɔ a nagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ kɔ ʋ teeŋ ŋɩɩ, peel-la ma sɩ jaŋ wuo na a pɛ digi, peel-la fa sɩɩ chol nyiŋgeliŋ, birimiŋ tɔ ʋ kala lim ka duoŋ-pel-balɩŋ lulu.

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: Ba nɩɩ banyile ba sɩɩ ŋmʋa, a nɩɩ nʋʋ yikoro ma sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa. Ba sɩ nɩɩ yikoro-la, ŋɩɩ nɛ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba ba sʋl dɩ yikoro-la bɩra sɩ́ wɩaa bʋl ba teeŋ,

english_verse: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla pɩba fa ŋaa wʋduo nɛ. Ʋ fa sɩ dɩ nʋʋ koo dɩ pʋna ma nɛ paala digi peel-la, ʋ maga dɩ ba yagʋ arɩ tabɩaa nɛ a kpʋ.

english_verse: The sight was so frightening that Moses said he shook with fear.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ na leŋe fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ ba kala nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis tɩtɩa bʋl, “Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ mɩ ma nɛ mɩ chichel.”

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Ama ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ma kʋ yi peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ nɛ. Ma kʋ yi tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jerusalɛm a hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ nɛ. Wɩa sɩ weye jaŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ma kɔ Wɩa tɩndaaraa bʋɩ bʋɩba bʋɩ sɩ hilimi lee-la arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ,

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: lee-la nɛ nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ laa ta hɛ, nɩalɩŋ yɩraa ʋ sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil ʋ jaŋ lɛ. Ma kɔ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ dii nʋʋkala sarɩya. Ma kɔ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba teeŋ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ leŋe ba ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa ʋ sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: Ma kɔ Yesu ma teeŋ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ hɛ Wɩa arɩ nuhuobiine pɛgɛ. Wɩa to ʋ lɛ nɛ a bil nii-falɩŋ ʋ dɩ nuhuobiinee pɛgɛ. Ʋ chalɩŋ jaasɛ nʋʋkala wɩaa nɛ. Ʋ chal-la-na faasa tɩŋ nɛ a pɛ la lɛ. Ʋ bɩ Ebil chalɩŋ naga. Ebil chalɩŋ-na fa joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kpʋʋ nɛ.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Má jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Yesu sɩɩ bʋl. Má sɩ́ ba vɩa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ vɩa wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bʋla pɩba, Wɩa dɔgɩsɛba ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ la nɛ vɩa wɩalɩŋ Yesu Kirisito sɩ bʋla, Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛla a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ dɔgɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa nɩɩ Wɩa yikoro nɛ, ʋ yikoro leŋ tinteeŋ kala zigili. Lɛɛlɛ Wɩa bʋla pɩla arɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tinteeŋ bɩra zigili, ama tinteeŋ dʋndʋŋa dee, wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala nɛ jaŋ zigili.

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ bʋla dɩ ʋ jaŋ bɩra leŋ dɩ tinteeŋ zigili kɛŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ dʋnɩa kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa jigisi. Kɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ jigisi jaŋ lɛl, ka kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wuo jigisi-na jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Wɩa joŋ ʋ kuorii-la sɩ bɩ wuo jigisi nɛ a pɩpɩla. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má leŋ dɩ la fáʋ a lɔllʋ, aŋ pɛ chʋchʋɔlʋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ,

english_verse: Our God is like a destructive fire!
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ nɛ a didii kɩaa.

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ma sɩ cho dɔŋɔ ŋɩɩ, má kɛŋ ŋɩɩ naaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Má hɛ doluŋ a bibeŋ nʋhʋɔraa woruŋ ma dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ laa nʋhʋɔraa bil ba dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, aŋ bɩ jɩŋ dɩ nʋhʋɔra-la ŋaa Wɩa tɩndaaraa nɛ.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Ma dɔnsʋ-la ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa, má liliisi ba wɩaa, a nagɛ ma kala nɛ ba kaa tɔ dɩa ŋɩɩ. Ma dɔnsʋ-la ba sɩ to naasɩŋ dɔgɩsɛ ma, má liliisi ba ma wɩaa a nagɛ ma kala nɛ baa dɔgɩsɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaa dɔŋɔ, má kɛŋ dɔŋɔ woruŋ a sɩ́ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa jaŋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa bachɔrʋŋ arɩ hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa sarɩya, a pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ faasa cho moribiee kɩŋkɛŋ. Kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛnɛ, má leŋ dɩ ma sɩɩŋ suba. Ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa bʋl ʋ teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ vɩama ta. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ lɩɩ ma harɩŋ.”

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa, la jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ nyuduoŋ, “La Tɩɩna nɩɩ pɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ fá fawʋllʋŋ. Bɛɛ nɛ nuhuobiine jaŋ wuo ŋaamɛ?”

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Má liisi ma sɩpaalaaraa wɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pɩma. Má bɩɩna mʋ yi ŋɩɩ ba sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii a chɩŋ ŋɩɩ lɛ a mʋ sʋʋ, aŋ to ba naabʋɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kɛŋ wʋtanɩa kʋ dagɛma dɩ ma yeŋŋi. Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ nɛ la jaŋ wuo kɛŋ doluŋ a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ, kʋdiilee kɩsɩnɩŋ lɛ dee. Nɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa sɩɩ to kʋdiilee kɩsɩnɩ-la ŋɩɩ bɩ ba lɛ ka pɛ.

english_verse: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
translation_verse: La kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ nɛ, Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tʋɔŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ koru-la nyuŋ bɩ wombiiŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ba dii kʋdiile-la sɩ daŋ koru-la nyuŋ.

english_verse: Jesus himself suffered outside the city gate, so his blood would make people holy.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Yesu ma na hɛɛŋ Jerusalɛm jeeŋ harɩŋ dɩ ʋ wuo joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa chalɩŋ a pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ ta, dɩ ba ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Yesu dii hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ woruŋ taŋ-la jeeŋ harɩŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa má leŋ dɩ la mʋ lee-la a ma dii hɩɩsɩ-la tɩtɩa.

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: La bɩ jáŋ kɛnɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ la sɩ jaŋ hɛ a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ. Ama laa gbɛrɛ taŋ-la maachie sɩ jaŋ kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala má ŋaa kukeri a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛnɛ, má ŋaa pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Má tuto ma sɩpaalaaraa niiŋ a joŋ ma tɩtɩa a pɩba. Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɩɩ bemma. Maachie ba nɛ jaŋ dagɛ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ tɩŋ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa a pɩ Wɩa. Dɩ ma nɛ to ba niiŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa woruŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Ama dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ba niiŋ to, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ chei ma nyuŋ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ saa bɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlma arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ dɩ ma sʋl Wɩa pɩmɛ, dɩ Wɩa pɩmɛ wombiiŋ dɩ mɩ kɔ ma teeŋ lɩma. Teniŋ wʋbʋlʋŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: A leŋ dɩ Wɩa sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa fɩɛlɩŋ pɛ ma lɛ. Ʋ nɛ chɩsɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sʋʋŋ lɛ. Yesu Kirisito nagɛ pie-daarɩ-duo nɛ aa beŋ ʋ nɩaa nyuŋ woruŋ. Ʋ chalɩŋ nɛ Wɩa kaa bil nii-la sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ.

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ to Yesu Kirisito lɛ a pɩma kʋzɔŋ-na kala dɩ ma wuo kaa ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ tɔrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ. Má leŋ dɩ Kirisito yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩɩ sʋlma dɩ ma jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma. Wʋkuu-bie nɛ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩma ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ la naambie Timoti ba fa sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa, ba lɩɩsʋ nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ mɩ teeŋ lɩma, mɩ dɩ ʋ kala jaŋ kɔ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Má chʋɔlɛ ma sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Wɩa nɩaa kala a pɩla. La tʋɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Ɩtalɩ tinteeŋ maa chʋɔlɛma.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Jeems sɩ ŋaa Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito tɩntɩnna, mɩɩ chʋɔlɛ ma Juu tɩŋŋaa kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a pɩsa hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa tʋɔŋ. Wɩa laa diiniŋ arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ wɩaa

english_verse: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, dɩ wʋdoho-na kala nɛ jʋʋma, má leŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma tʋɔtɔrʋ,

english_verse: You know you learn to endure by having your faith tested.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa dɩ ma nɩɩ na hɛɛŋ wɩɩ lɛ aŋ ha laa Wɩa dii, ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ kɛŋ kanyalɩma.

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ nyalɩma wɩɩkala lɛ a mʋ dɛrɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ waa dɛrɛ Wɩa wɩaa lɛ a sɩ́ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nyaa.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma kʋŋkala nɛ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ, ʋ sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ pʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Wɩa kɛŋ zile, ʋ yie joŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ pɩ nʋʋkala sɩ sʋlʋ nɛ, ʋ bɩ nʋʋkala vɩa ta.

english_verse: If you are that kind of person, you can't make up your mind, and you surely can't be trusted. So don't expect the Lord to give you anything at all. Poor People and Rich People
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa balɩa a bɩ wʋbala lɛ chɩna wɩɩkala ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ, ʋ tɩɩna sɩ́ yɩɛlʋ arɩ La Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ joŋ kʋŋkala pʋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa summoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa wɩaa

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ lee kɛnɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii tʋɔŋ, ʋ leŋ dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ arɩ Wɩa sɩ pʋ dɩchɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa, wɩa yie pɔsɛ, leriŋ faasa lɩŋ, wulumuŋ ŋaa yaŋ-la hɩl ʋ fɩɩlaa yuori. Ʋ zɔmʋŋ lɛl. Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa ma nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ ha jaŋ tɩtɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa aŋ sʋʋ kagɛ.

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩɩ-la wɩɩŋ sɩ jʋa lɛ, aŋ ka ʋ wuo nyalɩmɛ a chɩŋ. Ʋ sɩ wuo nyalɩmɛ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ a timu, mɩɩsɩ-la ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ chou. Ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ wɩɩ nɛ jʋʋla

english_verse: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ jʋʋ wɩɩ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ tɩɩna bʋl arɩ Wɩa nɛ magɩsʋ. Nʋʋkala bɩ Wɩa wuo nyɩsɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ʋ tɩtɩa ma bɩ nʋʋkala ka nyɩsɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ.

english_verse: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
translation_verse: Ama tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔmɔ-la sɩ hɛ nʋʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ yie nyɩsʋ ʋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Tʋɔbɩɩŋ-bɔmɔ-la nɛ yie kɛnʋ yeŋŋi.

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ sɛyɛ dɩ ʋ to tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔmɔ-la lɛ, ba yie leŋ ʋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Dɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la nɛ kʋ yʋgɛ ba yie ŋaa nɩɩ-la sʋʋ.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambii-kpɩanaba, má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa nyɩsʋ.

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Kʋzɔŋ-na kala lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ ta kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ lɛ a chaanɛ. Ama dɩ ba nɛ jʋa, birimiŋ yie hɛ nɩmɛ. Wɩa tɩtɩa bɩ ŋɩɩ naga. Ʋ bɩ bɩrɩmɛ.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: Ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl ʋ niiŋ wɩaa sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ a pɩla dɩ la wuo tutoba, a ŋaa ʋ bii-bumbumba kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa tʋɔŋ. Wɩa wɩaa jegiliŋ arɩ ba kaa tɩmɩŋ

english_verse: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambii-kpɩanaba, ma jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ: Nʋʋkala maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ dɩgɩlɩŋ-jegilee, aŋ sɩ́ chele bʋbʋl wɩaa, a sɩ́ baanɩŋ ma lɩma lɩma nɩna,

english_verse: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ na baanɩŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wʋzɔmɔ-la Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: You must stop doing anything immoral or evil. Instead be humble and accept the message planted in you to save you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋ wʋŋaalaa lɛ a vɩa wʋbɔmɔ-la kala sɩ gollima. Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri Wɩa sɩpaaŋ a sɛɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ dagɛma, wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo laama ta.

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ aŋ bɩbaa ŋaa, ʋ nagɛ nɩa sɩ joŋ beenantɩrɛ a bee na ʋ nagɩsɩŋ nɛ,

english_verse: and forget what they look like as soon as they leave.
translation_verse: ʋ yie beŋ a na ʋ tɩtɩa beenantɩrɛ-la tʋɔŋ, ama dɩ ʋ nɛ sʋrɩsa lɩɩ, ʋ guu yʋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ naga.

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ ʋ sɩaa hɛ Wɩa wombii-la sɩ chaasa zɔŋ a laa nɩaa tɩta lɛ, a fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ tutou, a bɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ nɩa yʋa aŋ kɛmba tɩtɩŋ, Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ ʋʋ to Wɩa nɛ, aŋ bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kɛnɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl lɛ, ʋʋ nyɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ. Ʋ Wɩɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: La Nyɩmma Wɩa wombiiŋ tonuŋ ʋ sɩ daga arɩ ʋ ŋaa wombii-tɩtɩɩ nɛ ŋ-la: Má pɩpɛ biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haala-la sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ lɛ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa dʋnɩa nɩaa wʋŋaalaa sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ disiniŋ lɛ.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, lɛɛlɛ ma laa La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii nɛ, ʋ-na yɩrɩ-balɩŋ Tɩɩna. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma zizil nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ aŋ ka ma sɩɩŋ bɩ dɔnsʋŋ ka su.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la joŋ arɩ nɩaa balɩa nɛ kʋ jʋʋ lee-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii sɩ hilime. Dɔŋɔ kɛŋ kɩaa a laalɛ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ a joŋ sɛlɩmɛ nenii-pɩraa a kpɩɛrɛ ʋ tɩtɩa. Dɔŋɔ ma ŋaa summu a ma laalɛ gɛrɩ-kɔsʋmɔɔ.

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma kɛŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ laalɛ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ woruŋ a pʋ dɩ-hɔŋ-zɔmʋŋ ʋ hɔŋ, aŋ bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ laalɛ gɛrɩ-kɔsʋmɔɔ dɩ ʋ hɔŋ tinteeŋ koo dɩ ʋ chɩŋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma kɛŋ nɩaa pʋpɔrɛ nɛ. Ma daga arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ kpɩa dɔnsʋŋ. Ma tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔmɔ-la nɛ ma kaa ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambii-kpɩanaba, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa summoo dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, Wɩa tʋɔsɛba nɛ dɩ ba laa ʋ wɩaa dii woruŋ a jʋʋ ʋ kuorii-la, lee-la ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ chou.

english_verse: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
translation_verse: Ama ma bɩ woruŋ ka ŋaa, ma sɩ yie ŋaa wɩaa jʋjʋʋ summoo lɛ ŋɩɩ. Kɩaa tɩŋŋaa nɛ yie didii doluŋ ma lɛ, a fʋga kɛmma mʋmʋ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ.
