english_verse: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
translation_verse: Ba yie chichei Kirisito yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo hɛ pɩma.

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl ŋ-la nɛ: “Cho ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna arɩ ŋ sɩ cho ŋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ.” Dɩ ma nɛ sɛnɛɛ to niiŋ deeŋ, ma ŋaa woruŋ nɛ. La Kuoro Wɩa nɛ joŋ niiŋ deeŋ pɩla.

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ nɩaa pʋpɔrɛ, maa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ. Maa chei wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ leŋe ba ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ paala tuto wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto aŋ chei ba tʋɔŋ wʋbala ma, ʋ naga ʋ chei wɩalɩŋ kala nɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Wɩa-la sɩ sɩ dɩ ma sɩ́ nɩaa haalaa chɛ, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ sɩ dɩ ma sɩ́ nɩaa kpʋ. Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ nɩaa haalaa chɛ aŋ kpʋkpʋ nɩaa, ma ha chei Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bile nɛ.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ nɩaa nenige ka fá, Wɩa ma bɩ jaŋ fá tɩɩna nenige bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ didii nɩaa sarɩya. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ fá nɩaa nenige bɩ jaŋ fá wɩɩkala sarɩya-la chɛ-diiliŋ. Wɩa laa diiniŋ arɩ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sɩ ʋ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ aŋ bɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ cho ka ŋaa, ʋ ŋɩɩ zɔmɔɔ? Dɩ ʋ Wɩa laa diiniŋ nɛ nagɛ ŋ-la, ma bɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ laaʋ ta koo?

english_verse: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la joŋ arɩ ma naambie bɩ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ kɛnɛ a bɩ ʋ niiŋ kʋdiilee wuo naa dii,

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: ŋɩɩ nɛ ma bʋla pʋ, “Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ a pɩŋ kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ chɛ.” Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ aŋ bɩ sɛyɛ dɩ ma pɛ ʋ lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ, ʋ ŋɩɩ zɔmɔɔ?

english_verse: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sɩ ʋ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii aŋ bɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ cho ka ŋaa, ʋ laa diine-la ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: Ŋ jɩma arɩ Wɩɩ-bala nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ koo? Dɩ ŋ nɛ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ. Ama sɩ́ yʋ arɩ jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba, ba chichel.

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: Abɩraham laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ a faa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ma Wɩa sɩ cho. Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a pɛ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa dii lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ Wɩa laa diine-la sɛnɛ wasa su.

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ daga arɩ wɩalɩŋ nʋʋ sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ yie tɩɩ Wɩa leŋ ʋ wuo ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii dʋndʋŋa dee bɩ tɩɩ.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: La kala yie ŋaa wɩaa piperigi nɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ wɩaa bʋla piperigi, ʋ bɩ wʋcheeli kɛnɛ. Ʋ wuo kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Bɩra na lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ ma. Ba ŋaa kʋbalaa nɛ, pel-duoŋ yie lu a kaa vɛŋ. Ama danyiŋ-bie nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la vɩvɛŋ yie kaa kuosi lɩɩŋ a dagɛ lɩɩŋ daboro-la lee-la kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ mʋ.

english_verse: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nuhuobiine nandelimiŋ ma nagɛ. Ʋ ŋaa la yaraa sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a bɩ wɩɩkala maga aŋ bʋbʋl wʋbalaa. Má bee na ŋɩɩ nyiŋ-gel-bie sɩ jaŋ wuo chol gɩrɩ-balɩŋ a dii ʋ kala.

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine nandelimiŋ ma nagɛ nyiniŋ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ wuo bʋl wʋbɔŋ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Ʋ ŋaa la yaraa sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Ama ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ʋ sɩ yie ŋaa yie cheŋ la yaraa kala nɛ ʋ chei. Ʋ yie nagɛ nyiniŋ nɛ a dii ŋɩɩ halɩɩ nuhuobiine mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ nyiniŋ yie lɩɩ Sɩtaanɩ teeŋ nɛ a kɔ.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Nuhuobiine kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ kala doluŋ nɛ: Baga kɩaa arɩ diibiisiŋ, arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ tuuri tinteeŋ, arɩ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa. Ʋ kɛŋ ba kala doluŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋkala bɩ nandelimiŋ doluŋ kɛnɛ. Ʋ ŋaa kʋbɔŋ nɛ a kɛŋ huoŋ sɩɩ kpʋ nɩaa.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Nii-la tɩtɩa la sɩ kaa dɛnnɛ Wɩa, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ la kaa bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ hɩhɛ nɩaa lɛ. Mɩ naambiiri, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ la ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-bul-sɩɩ bala bɩ jaŋ wuo bul lɩɩzɔmʋŋ arɩ lɩɩlɔrʋŋ kala.

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: Tutogo ma bɩ jaŋ wuo nɛŋ babɩlaa. Chɩchʋɛŋ ma bɩ jaŋ wuo nɛŋ tutogi-nambɩlaa. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ lɩɩ-bulo sɩ nagɛ yɩsɩŋ ma bɩ jaŋ wuo bɩrɩmɛ lɩɩzɔmʋŋ. Wʋjɩmɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ma tʋɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa, ʋ maga dɩ ma ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri, a dagɛ ŋɩɩ arɩ ma sɛnɛ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ma nɛ faasa kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a chɩl ma dʋndʋŋa wɩaa, aŋ dɩdagɛ ma tɩtɩa arɩ ma kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, maa nyɩɛ nɛ.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Wʋjɩmɩŋ deeŋ doho bɩ Wɩa teeŋ lɩa. Ʋ ŋaa dʋnɩa wɩɩ nɛ a lɩɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛ arɩ Sɩtaanɩ teeŋ.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa nɛ faasa kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ a chɩl ba dʋndʋŋa wɩaa, ba jaŋ yuyuo dɔŋɔ, a ŋɩŋaa wʋdoho na-kala.

english_verse: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.
translation_verse: Dɩ nanjejeeree nɛ pɛ nɩaa lɛ dɩ ba hɔŋ sɔm, wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ba yie na.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma yie gʋraa yuo dɔŋɔ? Ʋ lɩɩ ma wʋchɛɛlɛ-la sɩɩ walɩmɛma nɛ.

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Ma cho dɩ ma kɛŋ kɩaa aŋ bɩ baa na, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ maa chɛ dɩ ma kpʋ dɔŋɔ aŋ laa. Ma yie hɩhɩɛnɛ kɩalɩŋ aŋ bɩ wuo na. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ma gʋraa yuo dɔŋɔ ŋɩɩ. Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ma bɩ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ chɛ kɛnɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Ma bɩ Wɩa sʋl dɩ ʋ joŋo pɩma.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: Bʋa dɔŋɔ ma lɛ ma yie sɛnɛ sʋlʋ a chɩchɛ kɩaa. Ama ma yie kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a sʋl dɩ ma kaa ŋaa ma tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ma bɩ na.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Ma nagɛ haala bɩra sɩ bɩ ʋ bala niiŋ ka to nɛ. Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ joŋ ʋ nyuŋ kala hɛ dʋnɩa kɩaa lɛ ŋaa Wɩa dʋndɔŋ nɛɛ? Wʋtɩtɩɩ, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ joŋ ʋ nyuŋ hɛ dʋnɩa kɩaa lɛ bɩrɩmɛ Wɩa dʋndɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
translation_verse: Ma bɩɩna wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ daga Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ bɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kɛnɛɛ? Ba ŋmʋnsa arɩ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ʋ sɩ joŋo hɛ la lɛ chaasa kɛŋ hadɔrʋŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa fá la nenige nɛ woruŋ a pɩpɛ la lɛ dɩ la joŋ la tɩtɩa kala a pʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ Wɩa vɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ aŋ pɩpɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri lɛ.

english_verse: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má joŋ ma tɩtɩa a hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Má joŋ harɩŋ yɩa Sɩtaanɩ, ʋ jaŋ fá lɛl.

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Má sʋrɩsa mʋ kpagɛ Wɩa, ʋ ma jaŋ kʋ kpagɛma. Má sɔŋ ma nɩsaa lɩɩsɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ, a pʋllɛ ma tʋɔŋ, a bɩra sɩ́ tʋɔbɩɩŋ lɔrʋnʋŋ bɩɩnʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa balɩa balɩa nɛ.

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ chei. Máa yel, aa ŋmoo niiŋ. Má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔtɔrʋŋ bɩrɩmɛ tʋɔ-cheeŋ.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ kɛmma je. Má pɔ ma sɩ́ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa wɩaa laa jɩŋ

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Bee na, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie bʋl arɩ maachie ma jaŋ mʋ taŋ deeŋ a yallɛ bayalɩŋ a yi jɩna a na nyʋʋrʋŋ, ma paala bɩ chiemiŋ wɩaa jɩŋ.

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: Ma paala bɩ jɩŋ ma chie sɩ jaŋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ. Ma mɩɩsɩŋ nagɛ bʋrʋŋ sɩ yie tɔ nɛ chʋchʋɔŋ, ka mʋapɩlɩɩ wɩa pɔsɛ ʋ lɛl.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Ʋ fa maga dɩ ma bʋl arɩ Wɩa nɛ sɛyɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ma jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ koo deeŋ.

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Ama ma haa ŋmoo ma bɔyɛ lɛ nɛ aa dagɛ ma tɩtɩa. Ʋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ jɩŋ wʋzɔmʋŋ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa, ka ʋ vɩa dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la, ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. Máa ŋmoo niiŋ a yiyel a tɩŋ hɛɛ-la sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ ma wɩaa.

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Ma kʋ-daŋ-la suomo chichei nɛ. Tiiŋ ma suomo didii ma gɛnnɩŋ.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: Ma sɛlɩmɛ arɩ ma hɔpʋla kala nɛ sʋa. Kɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋa ŋɩɩ daga arɩ ma bɩ woruŋ ŋaa. Ma kɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋa ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma yaraa ma jaŋ pʋa a nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩ die. Lɛɛlɛ dʋnɩa kpagɛ dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ, aŋ ka ma-na ha nyagɛ kɩaa bil.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Ma vɩa dɩ ma tiŋ nɩalɩŋ ma, ma sɩ ŋaa ba tɩŋ ma bagɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ba nɛ yele hɩhɛ ma lɛ. Ba yele-la jʋʋ La Tɩɩna Wɩa dɩgɩlaa nɛ, Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ dʋnɩa kʋŋkala.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, ma nɩɩ sɩma a ŋaa ma tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa nɛ. Ma dɩɛsɛ ma tɩtɩa a nagɛ nɛsɩŋ ba sɩ dɩɛsa ba nɛrɛ dɩ ba kpʋ nɛ.

english_verse: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
translation_verse: Ma joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye nɛ, a kpʋba. Ka ba bɩ lobo dɩ ba laa ba tɩtɩa. Má kɛŋ kenyiri a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa

english_verse: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, má kɛŋ kenyiri a gbɛrɛ chɛɛ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ. Ma bee na ŋɩɩ paara sɩ kɛŋ kenyiri. Ʋ yie gbɛrɛ nɛ duoŋ-puso nɩɩ, ʋ duu kɩaa, a bɩra kɛŋ kenyiri a gbɛrɛ gbanchaaŋ-duonuŋ lɛ ʋ kɩaa ŋaa, ʋ kʋŋ.

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: Má ma kɛŋ kenyiri ŋɩɩ, a chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ kpaga nɛ.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, má sɩ́ wɩaa gʋrʋmʋ dɔŋɔ lɛ, dɩ Wɩa sɩ́ ma sarɩya dii a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩma. Na nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ dii la sarɩya nɛ chɩŋ boiŋ niiŋ a ŋaa siri dɩ ʋ jʋʋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, má bee na Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la sɩ bʋl wɩaa La Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ lɛ, ba na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ aŋ ha kɛŋ kenyiri. Má ma hɛ doluŋ aŋ to ba naabʋɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Wɩa pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ wuo nyalɩmɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ dɛrɛ lɛ nɛ woruŋ. Ma nɩɩ ŋɩɩ baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Job sɩ na hɛɛŋ aŋ nyalɩmɛ nɛ, a bɩra nɩɩ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ ʋ hɛɛ-la harɩŋ lɛ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, La Tɩɩna ka fá la nenige arɩ la nisusuŋ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ ma nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a wʋwɩɩlɛ, má leŋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi tʋɔŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ dɩ ba kɔ ʋ teeŋ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pʋ. Ba jaŋ lɔgɛ nʋʋŋ a tɩsʋ, aŋ sʋl Wɩa pʋ La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ laa dii arɩ Wɩa jaŋ sɛnɛ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ba sɩ sʋlʋ chɩchɛ, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ duori a kɛŋ doluŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ ba kala chɛʋ.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má dagɛ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩ dɔŋɔ a sʋl Wɩa a pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ, dɩ Wɩa wuo ŋaa dɩ ma duori. Dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ sʋl Wɩa, ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ yie faasa kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ a ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ pʋ.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Má na baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Ɩlaaja. Ʋ ma fa nagɛla nɛ. Ʋ faasa sʋl Wɩa arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ dɩ duonuŋ sɩ́ nɩɩ. Duonuŋ sɛnɛ bɩ nɩa jɩsɩŋ batori arɩ chɛnsɩŋ balɩdʋ.

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ bɩra sʋl Wɩa a chɩchɛ duonuŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa leŋ duonuŋ nɩɩ, ba duu kɩaa, ba kala wasɛ.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, dɩ ma tʋɔŋ nʋʋ nɛ faa to wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ aŋ bɩra leŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la, ka nʋʋ dɔŋ bɩra kɛnʋ mɩɩra kɔ ʋ tuto wʋtɩtɩɩ-la,

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: ʋ tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ-la lɛ nɛ ʋ leŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ aŋ mɩɩra kɔ a tuto wʋtɩtɩɩ-la. Ʋ laa tɩɩna mɩɩsɩŋ pʋ nɛ. Wɩa jaŋ joŋ nɩɩ-la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala chɛʋ. Mɩ teniŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Pɩɩta sɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito nanzɔɔ, mɩ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aŋ tɩŋ hɛɛŋ wɩaa a pɩsɛ a hɛ Pɔntɔs lɛ, Galiisia, Kapadoosia, Esia, arɩ Bitiinia tinteeŋ kala lɛ.

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: Faafaa kala nɛ la Nyɩmma Wɩa bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ maga dɩ ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛma a joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a hɛ ma lɛ, dɩ ma ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma ʋ teeŋ a tuto Yesu Kirisito niiŋ. Ʋ nɛ joŋ ʋ chalɩŋ jaasɛ ma wɩaa dɩ ma sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ Wɩa teeŋ. La Tɩɩna Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, fɩɛlɩŋ jaŋ yʋgɛ ma teeŋ. Wɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la dɛnnɛ Wɩa, ʋ nɛ ŋaa La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito Nyɩmma. Ʋ fá la nenige nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ a leŋ la kɛŋ mɩɩ-falɩŋ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ chɩsɛ Yesu Kirisito sʋʋŋ lɛ. La saa yɩɛlʋ arɩ la jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ,

english_verse: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
translation_verse: a dii kʋzɔmɔ-la Wɩa sɩ ŋaa bil ʋ nɩaa lɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ. Kɩalɩŋ bɩ jaŋ pʋa, ba bɩ jaŋ chei ma, ba zɔmʋŋ ma bɩ jaŋ lɩɩ.

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ma sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ, Wɩa ka pɔma nɛ arɩ ʋ doluŋ. Dɩ dʋnɩa nɛ kʋ dɩdɛrɛ, ʋ jaŋ dagɛ nɩaa ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ laama ta.

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ na Wɩa teeŋ leŋe ma tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ nɛ. Lɛɛlɛ ŋ-la-na ma tʋɔŋ cheye nɛ bɛɛ wɩaa, wɩaa yʋga nɛ a jʋʋma. Ama ma jɩma arɩ hɛɛ-la sɩ jʋʋma, ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni.

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba jʋʋma dɩ ba magɩsɛ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ, a leŋ nɩaa wuo na arɩ ʋ sɛnɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ ba sɩ joŋo chɔ a yʋgɩlɛ dɩ ba na ʋ sɛnɛ ŋaa sɛlɩmɛ nɛɛ? Ba sɩ joŋ sɛlɩmɛ chɔ ŋɩɩ ma kala, ʋ bɩ dieni ka dɩ ʋ chei. Ma Wɩa laa diiniŋ nɛ yuŋŋie a kɩɩ sɛlɩmɛ. Ba sɩ magɩsɛma na ŋɩɩ, tapʋlɩɩ-la Yesu Kirisito sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ, nɩaa jaŋ dɛnnɛ Wɩa a zizilu dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii wɩaa.

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: Arɩ ma ha sɩ bɩ Yesu Kirisito na ma kala, ma ha chou nɛ. Ma ha sɩ bɩ ʋ na lɛɛlɛ ma, ma laa ʋ wɩaa dii nɛ. Ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ woruŋ, ma paala bɩ jaŋ wuo dagɛ ŋɩɩ ma tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɛ magɛ.

english_verse: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa laama ta, wɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ chɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Laatanɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa nɛ, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa fa gbilli Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ dɩ ba na ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ laa ʋ nɩaa ta. Ba fa bʋla arɩ Wɩa jaŋ joŋ kʋŋ a dii zile nɩaa lɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: Yesu Kirisito Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ fa sɩ hɛ ba lɛ, ʋ nɛ bʋla pɩba ŋɩɩ Kirisito sɩ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ, ka dɩ nɩaa-na zizilu. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba nɩnɛrɩgɛ dɩ ba na bʋa-la lɛ wɩaa deemba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Wɩa joŋo dagɛba arɩ ma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ba faa bʋl wɩaa deemba, ba tɩtɩa wɩaa dee. Lɛɛlɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la pɩpɩma, ba dagɛma bumbuŋ wɩaa deemba kala nɛ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kʋ tuu hɛba lɛ nɛ pɩba doluŋ deeŋ. Wɩa tɩndaaraa ma fa cho dɩ ba na wɩaa deemba nɛ. Ŋɩɩ Wɩa nɩaa sɩ maga dɩ ba nagɛ

english_verse: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má kɛŋ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a ŋaa siri dɩ ma tɩŋ. Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ, a joŋ ma yɩɛlaa kala hɛ kʋ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma lɛ bʋa-la Yesu Kirisito sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Má tuto Wɩa niiŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ ma fa sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ, ma faa to ma tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa sɩ bɩ zɔŋ lɛ nɛ. Má bɩra sɩ́ ba to.

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ aŋ yɩrɛma. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má ma sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ wɩɩ-na kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ,

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋmʋnsa nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩ, “Má sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ ma bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.”

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ yie chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa a kɛnʋ yɩyɩrɛ ma Nyɩmma ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ pɛ ma lɛ, ma jɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɩɩ dii nɩaa sarɩya, ʋ bɩ ba kaa pɔrɛ. Ʋ yie dii nʋʋkala sarɩya a magɛ ŋɩɩ ŋ wɩɩŋ sɩ maga nɛ. Má saa fáʋ a leŋ dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa zɔŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: Ma kala jɩma arɩ Yesu Kirisito tiŋ ma chɩmɩŋ nɛ, a lɩɩsɛma wʋpɛɩba-la ma naabalɩmaba fa sɩ joŋo dagɛma, ma ŋɩŋaa lɛ. Ʋ bɩ naga arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chei a nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ koo hɔɔ-pʋla nɛ ʋ joŋo time laama.

english_verse: You were rescued by the precious blood of Christ, that spotless and innocent lamb.
translation_verse: Ama Yesu Kirisito chalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ yuŋuŋ kɩɩ kʋŋkala nɛ ʋ joŋo time laama. Yesu nagɛ pie-bie sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ kala, ka dɩ Wɩa-na ŋaa dʋnɩa, ʋ lɩɩsɛ Yesu Kirisito nɛ dɩ ʋ to ʋ lɛ a laa dʋnɩa nɩaa ta. Ama Wɩa leŋe ʋ kɔ nɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ma wɩaa.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: Ma to ʋ lɛ nɛ a laa Wɩa wɩaa dii. Ʋ nɛ chɩsɛ Yesu sʋʋŋ lɛ a pʋ yɩrɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma laa diiniŋ arɩ ma yɩɛlaa kala hɛ Wɩa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ma sɩɩ to wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiiŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ma pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ kala ta nɛ. Ma sɛnɛ cho ma naambiiri-la sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má kɛŋ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma doluŋ kala a wasa cho dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Nuhuobiine kala nagɛ yaŋ nɛ. Ba tʋla ma kala nagɛ ya-fɩɩlaa. Yaŋ-la yie hɩl, ya-fɩɩla-la ma yuori.

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa-na jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.” Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ nɛ ŋaa wʋzɔmɔ-la ba sɩ bʋla pɩma.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩ-falɩŋ ŋɩɩ, má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋ kala lɛ, a sɩ́ nɩaa nyɩnyɩsʋ, a sɩ́ kanfugi tɩmma ŋaa. Má sɩ́ yarɩ-bieriŋ kɛŋ, a sɩ́ nɩaa harɩŋ gɩgaa.

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ ma chɩchɛ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ nɛ a nagɛ bii-mulluŋ sɩɩ chɛ yɩlɩŋ ŋɩɩ. Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ Wɩa wɩaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ waa woruŋ ba lɛ, a mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ laama ta.

english_verse: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
translation_verse: Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma tɩtɩa jɩma arɩ La Tɩɩna Wɩa kɛŋ zile ma teeŋ.

english_verse: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má kʋ kpagɛ La Tɩɩna Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la sɩ nagɛ tabɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Nɩaa vɩaʋ ta nɛ, ama Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsʋ ʋ ŋaa kʋzɔŋ ʋ teeŋ.

english_verse: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
translation_verse: Ma ma nagɛ tabɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má leŋ dɩ Wɩa kɛmma saa ʋ dɩa, a leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa nɩa sɩ́ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ a laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pʋpʋ, a nagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa. Wɩa chɛ dɩ ma to Yesu Kirisito lɛ nɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la sɩ maga a pʋ.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Ma bee na, mɩ lɩɩsɛ tabɩɩ-zɔŋ nɛ a joŋo bil Zaayɔŋ lɛ, ʋ ŋaa jegunuŋ tiebiiŋ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii, hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ dii ʋ tɩɩna.”

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii, ʋ ŋaa kʋzɔŋ nɛ ma teeŋ. Ama ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii lɛ, “Tiebii-la dɩɩsaaraa sɩ vɩa, ʋ nɛ mɩɩra kʋ ŋaa jegunuŋ tiebii-duoŋ.”

english_verse: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Ama Wɩa lɩɩsɛma nɛ dɩ ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa, a laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ ma Kuoro. Ma ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ. Wɩa tɩtɩa nɛ tɩɩma. Ʋ yɩrɛma dɩ ma wuo bʋl wʋkpuŋkperisi-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa a pɩ nɩaa arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ lɩɩsɛma birimiŋ tʋɔŋ a kaa kʋ jʋʋ ʋ pʋlʋŋ-jalɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ-la ma fa bɩ kʋŋkala ŋaa, ama lɛɛlɛ ma ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa nɛ. Wɩa fa bɩ ma nenige fá, ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ fá ma nenige nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii ŋɩŋaa

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambii-kpɩanaba, ma jɩma ma ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa nɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩɩ sʋlma, má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa ma tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaala-la sɩ bɩ zɔŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ ma ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ guoli nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii tʋɔŋ, má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ, dɩ ba sɩ́ wombiiŋ na a bʋl arɩ ma ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ bʋla arɩ maa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma, má leŋ dɩ ba na wʋzɔmɔ-la ma sɩɩ ŋaa, a dɛnnɛ Wɩa dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito wɩaa, má sɛɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ aa bemma dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ niiŋ. Má zizil ma tinteeŋ kuoru-balɩŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ nʋʋkala,

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: a bɩra zizil nɩalɩŋ kuoru-balɩŋ sɩ lɩɩsa ba chɩŋ ʋ naasɩŋ. Ba yie dʋdɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, aŋ bɩbɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ma tɩɩ ma tɩtɩa nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa má hɔŋ a nagɛ nɩaa sɩ tɩɩ ba tɩtɩa, aŋ sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa dɩ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ama má ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ ma ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa nɛ.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Máa zil nʋʋkala. Má cho nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a ŋaa ma naambiiriŋ. Má fá Wɩa a zizil ma kuoru-balɩŋ. Má to Yesu naabʋɔsʋŋ

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa tɩntɩnnaa a tɩmaa pɩ nɩaa, má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri a tuto ma nɩhɩasɩŋ niiŋ a zizilba bʋa na-kala lɛ. Dɩ ba wɩaa zɔmɔ koo dɩ ba nɛ tɛrɛ ma, má zizilba.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ wɩɩ cheye ka baa dɔgɩsʋ, ka dɩ ʋ tɩŋ Wɩa wɩaa nyalɩmɛ, Wɩa jaŋ pɛ tɩɩna lɛ.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ dɩ ba dɔgʋsʋŋ, ka ŋ wuo dii kenyiri ŋɩɩ lɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ba lɔllʋŋ. Ama dɩ ŋ nɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ, ka dɩ baa dɔgʋsʋŋ a tɩŋ wʋzɔŋ-la wɩaa, dɩ ŋ nɛ nyalɩma, Wɩa tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ ŋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: Wɩa paala yɩrɛma dɩ ma na hɛɛŋ nɛ. Má liisi arɩ Yesu Kirisito tɩtɩa na hɛɛŋ nɛ ma wɩaa a dagɛma ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ to ʋ naabʋɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa. Ʋ bɩ wɩaa ma nyɩɛ.

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: Arɩ nɩaa sɩ tʋʋsʋ ma kala, ʋ bɩ laa tʋʋsɛ. Ba sɩ dɔgɩsʋ kala ma, ʋ bɩ bʋla arɩ ʋ ma jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba. Ʋ ta joŋ wɩɩkala a hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a dii nɩaa sarɩya.

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: Yesu Kirisito tɩtɩa nɛ laa la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a chʋŋ, ba kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ dɩ la joŋ harɩŋ yɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ ŋɩŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa. Ba vɩɩrʋ ʋ yaraa ŋaa naawɩɩlaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ leŋe la nyanyalaa kala dɛrɛ.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Ma fa nagɛ piesee sɩ yeŋŋe nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ma mɩɩra kɔ Pie-daarɩ-la teeŋ nɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ ma mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma haalaa, má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri a tuto ma balaba niiŋ. Dɩ kʋŋ bala nɛ bɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la laa dii, ʋ bala-la jaŋ wuo bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ wʋŋaalaa lɛ a laa Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la dii, dɩ haal-la nɛ paala bɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la bʋla pʋ ma,

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ na ʋ haala mɛlɛ sɩ zɔmɔ ŋɩɩ arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ fá Wɩa.

english_verse: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ yaraa kpɩɛraa nɛ kaa dagɛ ma zɔmʋŋ: Ŋɩɩ ma sɩɩ vɔɔ ma nyusuŋ, a lɩlaalɛ sɛlɩmɛ kpɩɛraa arɩ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
translation_verse: Ama má leŋ dɩ ma zɔmʋŋ lɩɩ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ. Má leŋ dɩ ma sɩaa fɩɛlɛ, a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri. Zɔmʋŋ deeŋ doho-na bɩ lɛl. Ʋ nɛ bɩra kɛŋ nyʋʋrʋŋ ma Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Faafaa haala-la sɩɩ to Wɩa niiŋ a joŋ ba yɩɛlaa kala hɛ Wɩa lɛ faa dagɛ ba zɔmʋŋ ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ. Ba yie kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri nɛ aa to ba balaba niiŋ.

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Saara ma fa to ʋ bala Abɩraham niiŋ a kɛnʋ yɩyɩrɛ ʋ tɩɩna. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ, a bɩ fawʋllʋŋ ka fá, ma ŋaa Saara toloo nɛ.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma baalaa ma maga dɩ ma leŋ dɩ ma mɛlɛ zɔŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ ma haalaa woruŋ a zizilba. Ma jɩma ma dolie kɩɩba nɛ, ka Wɩa joŋ mɩɩsɩŋ pɩ ma kala. Ma ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ wɩɩkala sɩ́ ma Wɩɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ chei. Má sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ joŋo tiŋ wʋbɔmʋŋ chɩmɩŋ

english_verse: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wʋkaanɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Má kala kɛŋ tʋɔ-bala, má fɩfá dɔŋɔ nenige, má cho dɔŋɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma ŋaa naambiiri nɛ, a kɛŋ zile dɔŋɔ lɛ, a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri dɔŋɔ teeŋ.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ joŋo tiŋ wʋbɔmʋŋ chɩmɩŋ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ tʋʋsɛma, má sɩ́ tʋʋsa tiŋ, ama má sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ pɛ tɩɩna lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa ma lɩɩsɛma nɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ ma lɛ.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ nɩɩ sɩma a na wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, tɩɩna sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bʋbʋl, a sɩ́ wɩaa ma nyɩnyɩa.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: Tɩɩna maga ʋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ, a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiiŋ, a fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ chɩchɛ dɩ nii-maga hɛ ʋ dɩ nɩaa pɛgɛ,

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa sɩaa kala hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa lɛ nɛ, a wuoli ʋ dɩgɩlaa ma a nɩnɩɩ ba Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ama Wɩa joŋ ʋ harɩŋ yɩa nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ aa chɛ dɩ ma ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ma lɛ?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ ba nɩɩ dɔgɩsɛma a tɩŋ ma tʋɔpʋl wʋŋaalaa wɩaa, Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩ dɔgɩsɛma fá, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩɩkala wʋwalɩmɛ ma.

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: Ama ma tʋɔŋ lɛ má fɩfá Kirisito a leŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma Tɩɩna. Bʋa na-kala lɛ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ pɩɛsɛma dɩ ʋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ma laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ma kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ a to wɩɩ-la naasɩŋ pʋ. Ama ma fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a bʋl wɩɩ-la.

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala lɛ, má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa chesi, dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa dagɛ arɩ maa to Kirisito nɛ. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chei ma yɩrɩŋ.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ dɩ ma na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, ʋ nɛ kpɩa ma sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a na hɛɛŋ.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Yesu Kirisito sʋʋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa bala nɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ, a sʋʋ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa wɩaa, dɩ ʋ wuo kɛnla kaa mʋ Wɩa teeŋ. Nuhuobiinee nɛ kpʋ ʋ yaraa, ama Wɩa leŋ ʋ dɩma wei.

english_verse: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ʋ nɩdɩma lɛ ʋ mʋ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩdɩnsɩ-la ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa.

english_verse: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba nɛ fa vɩa dɩ ba to Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa bʋa-la lɛ Nowa fa sɩɩ kpaasɛ lɩɩŋ dabori-bal-la. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ Wɩa fa kɛŋ kenyiri a gbɩgbɛrɛba dɩ ba kʋ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daboro-la, ka ba vɩa. Nɩaa chori dʋndʋŋ nɛ fa jʋʋ lɩɩŋ dabori-bal-la, a laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ ba sɩ duoro lɩɩ naga ba sɩ fo nɩaa Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ foŋ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, ʋ bɩ naga arɩ ŋ yaraa disiniŋ nɛ ba fo ta. Ama la yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ a dɩdagɛ arɩ la tʋɔbɩɩnaa chesi nɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ yie laala ta nɛ a tɩŋ Yesu Kirisito sɩ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ wɩaa.

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ lɩɩ dʋnɩa lɛ a jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ a hɔŋ Wɩa nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ Wɩa tɩndaaraa arɩ kʋŋkala sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ Kirisito tɩtɩa sɩ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ, má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ dɩ ma na hɛɛ-la doho ʋ sɩ na, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩɩ-la kala sɩ na hɛɛŋ, ʋ leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Ma sɩ hɛ ma mɩɩ-kaanɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, ma bɩra sɩ́ ma tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ to, ama má tuto Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ-la kala lɛ ma faa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ. Ma faa to ma tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa harɩŋ nɛ aa ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, a chɩl ma yaraa wʋchɛɛlɛɛ wɩaa, a fa nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bubugi, a ŋɩŋaa wʋtɔɔnʋŋ, a yie gɔllɔ nyʋnyʋa sɩnɩŋ, a faa kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa ma, wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩɩ kɩsʋ.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ ʋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere nɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ, ma bɩra sɩ bɩ ba lɛ pɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba tʋtʋʋsɛma.

english_verse: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Ama tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala, ba jaŋ dagɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋaa a pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa dɩ ʋ dii nɩweyee arɩ nɩsʋʋnʋŋ kala sarɩya.

english_verse: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ Kirisito bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba ma, arɩ ba sɩ sʋba ba yaraa lɛ ma kala a nagɛ nʋʋkala sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ba dɩnsɩŋ wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii sɩ maga dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa dɔŋɔ lɛ

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la dʋnɩa sɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ kpaga nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ a leŋ dɩ ma sɩaa fɩɛlɛ, dɩ ma wuo chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Má hɛ ma doluŋ kala a faasa cho dɔŋɔ. Dɩ ma nɛ cho dɔŋɔ, ma jaŋ joŋ wʋdaŋ chɩchɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: Má hʋhʋɔrɛ dɔŋɔ woruŋ ma dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, aŋ sɩ́ wɩaa gʋgʋrɩmʋ.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Wɩa joŋ doluŋ pɩ nɩaa dɩ ba kaa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-dosunuŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nʋʋkala kɛŋ wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pʋ a kaa pɩpɛ ʋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Dɩ Wɩa nɛ pɩ nʋʋkala doluŋ dɩ ʋ wuo bʋbʋl Wɩa wɩaa, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ Wɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ tɩma pɩpɩ nɩaa, ʋ kɛŋ dol-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pʋ a tɩma pɩpɩba. Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ nɩaa wuo to Yesu Kirisito lɛ a dɛnnɛ Wɩa, dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ wɩɩ-na kala lɛ. Ʋ nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ arɩ yɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ. Hɛɛ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii sɩɩ na

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambii-kpɩanaba, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ hɛɛ-la ma sɩ faasa nɩna ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere ma lɛ. Wɩaa deemba kala ka magɩsɛma nɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa wʋfalɩɩ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ-la Kirisito sɩ na, má ma na hɛɛ-la tɩtɩa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má jʋjʋɔsɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la Kirisito nɛ kɔ arɩ ʋ tʋla, ma jaŋ faasa jʋɔsɛ.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɩɩ tʋʋsɛma a tɩŋ Kirisito wɩaa, Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ hɛ ma lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Ma kʋŋkala sɩ́ hɛɛŋ na a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ kpʋ nɩaa wɩaa, koo ʋ sɩ ŋaa gaarʋ wɩaa, koo ʋ sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, koo ʋ sɩ ŋaa wʋhɛɛrʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ Kirisito wɩaa, ʋ sɩ́ leŋe dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛnʋ. Ʋ maga dɩ tɩɩna dɛnnɛ Wɩa, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa Kirisito nʋʋ wɩaa.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Bʋa-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa sarɩya yie nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ a suomi Wɩa nɩaa lɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ saa suomi ba lɛ, ɛɛ nɛ saa ʋ jaŋ nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa Wʋzɔmɔ-la ka to lɛ?

english_verse: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ Wɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa ŋaanɩŋ lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba joŋ ba tɩtɩa kala a hɛ Wʋtɩtɩɩ Tɩɩna-la sɩ ŋaaba nɩsɩŋ lɛ aŋ ha ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ wɩɩ nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa nɩhɩasɩŋ. Mɩ ma ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa nɩhɩaŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Mɩ tɩtɩa sɩɩŋ na hɛɛ-la Kirisito sɩ na nɛ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ ma jaŋ na tʋla-la Kirisito sɩ jaŋ na bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ. Ŋ-la nɛ tɩɩ mɩɩ sʋlma

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: dɩ ma beŋ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ joŋo hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ, arɩ pie-daaraa sɩɩ beŋ ba piesee nyuŋ ŋɩɩ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ nagɛ arɩ baa fʋgɛma nɛ dɩ ma bemba, ama má bemba ma tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ arɩ Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ ŋɩɩ. Má cho tɩntɩmɩɩ-la, aŋ sɩ́ naga arɩ moribiee nɛ maa chɛ.

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ doluŋ kaa beŋ nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ama má leŋ dɩ ba na arɩ ma mɛlɛ zɔmɔ, dɩ ba tuto ma naabʋɔsʋŋ.

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, tapʋlɩɩ-la Yesu Kirisito sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ, Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa Pie-daaraa kala Kʋhɩaŋ, ʋ jaŋ joŋ kʋ-la sɩ zɔmɔ a kɩɩ kʋŋkala pɩma. Ʋ-na bɩ jaŋ chei.

english_verse: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
translation_verse: Ma bapʋɔsɩ-biisiŋ ma, má joŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ ma nɩhɩasɩŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Má kala kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri dɔŋɔba teeŋ. Má liisi arɩ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla, “Wɩa lɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ harɩŋ nɛ, ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri, ʋʋ pɛ ba lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri Wɩa teeŋ. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ aa bemma. Dɩ bʋa-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ yie, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa nɩbalaa.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ walɩmɛma, má joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɩɩ bemma.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ, a pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ. Ma dʋndɔmɔ Sɩtaanɩ, gɔllɔɔ chɛma nɛ, a nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩ gɔllɔ yele chɩchɛ kʋdiilee.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Má vɩa Sɩtaanɩ aŋ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii kpaŋ kpaŋ. Ma jɩma arɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii a ŋaa ma naambiiriŋ a hɛ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ-na kala, ba maa na hɛɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Hɛɛŋ deeŋ ma sɩɩ na bɩ jaŋ dieni. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ, Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ zile kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a yɩrɛma dɩ ma ma na tʋla-la Kirisito sɩ kɛnɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ kɛmma wasa kɩɩ, a leŋ dɩ ma chaasa chɩŋ arɩ doluŋ.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ. Chʋɔlaa

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ leŋe Sɩlɩvaanʋs ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma. Mɩ jɩma arɩ ʋ ma ŋaa la naambii-tɩtɩɩ nɛ. Wʋkuu-bie nɛ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩma dɩ mɩ ŋaa dɩ ma nyuŋ nyaasɛ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, mɩ bʋla pɩma ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ pɛ la lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má chɩŋ wɩaa deemba lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ba ŋaa ʋ nɩaa arɩ ʋ sɩ lɩɩsɛ ma ma ŋɩɩ, ba maa chʋɔlɛma. Mɩ nanʋala Maak maa chʋɔlɛma.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Má guori dɔŋɔ a chʋɔlɛ dɔŋɔ, a dagɛ ma sɩ cho dɔŋɔ ŋɩɩ. Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma. Mɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ a ŋaa ʋ nanzɔɔ ma. Mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩ ma nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii arɩ la ma sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ. La dɩ ma kala ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma nɛ a tɩŋ Wɩa arɩ la Laataara Yesu Kirisito wɩaa.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ fɩɛlɩŋ jaŋ yʋgɛ ma teeŋ, a tɩŋ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu lɛ. Má leŋ dɩ ma mɛlɛ zɔŋ dɩ Wɩa wuo timma

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: Wɩa doluŋ lɛ, ʋ pɩla kʋŋkala la sɩɩ chɛ la mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ la wuo kaa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ to ʋ wombiiŋ, dɩ la wuo jɩŋ ʋ-na Wɩa, Nɩɩ-la sɩ yɩrɛla dɩ la wuo na ʋ tʋla arɩ ʋ zɔmʋŋ kala.

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala lɛ nɛ Wɩa to a ŋaa wʋbal-la ʋ fa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pɩla. Wɩalɩŋ zɔmɔ kɩŋkɛŋ la teeŋ. Ʋ joŋ wɩaa deemba pɩla dɩ la wuo lɩɩsɛ la tɩtɩa wʋbɔmɔ-la dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ to ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ a ŋɩŋaa, ka dɩ la kʋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ naga.

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Dɩ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba nɛ hɛ ma lɛ, ba jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ tɩmma a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jɩma a mʋ tɩgɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ wɩaa deemba ka ŋaa, ʋ tɩɩna ŋaa nyʋlʋŋ nɛ, a nagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ na ʋ naasɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ dʋndʋŋa aŋ bɩ dɩ-bolii ka na, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ tɩɩna paala yʋ arɩ Yesu chɛsɛ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩɩ sʋlma arɩ Wɩa sɩ yɩrɛma a lɩɩsɛma ŋɩɩ, má hɛ doluŋ a chɩŋ wɩaa deemba lɛ woruŋ. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaaba, ma bɩ jaŋ yeŋŋi Wɩa wombiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ lɛ woruŋ, ma jaŋ na wombiiŋ a jʋʋ La Tɩɩna arɩ la Laataara Yesu Kirisito kuorii-la sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ liliisima bʋa na-kala lɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩaa deemba lɛ. Ma paala jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la nɛ a chɩŋ ʋ lɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: Mɩ ha sɩ hɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ liliisima wɩaa deemba dɩ ma sɩ́ ba yʋ,

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jɩma arɩ mɩ bɩ jaŋ dieni dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito tɩtɩa bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ hɛ doluŋ a dagɛma wɩaa deemba, dɩ mɩ nɛ sʋba ma, dɩ ma ha wuo liliisiba bʋa na-kala lɛ. Pɩɩta sɩ dɩ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ na Yesu ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: La bʋla pɩma ŋɩɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sɩ kɔ dʋnɩa arɩ doluŋ. Wɩɩ-la la sɩ bʋla pɩma bɩ nagɛ sʋnsɔgʋlɔɔ wʋjɩnnaa sɩ sɔgʋlɔ. La tɩtɩa sɩɩŋ nɛ na Yesu Kirisito tʋla.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ la Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ joŋ doluŋ arɩ tʋla pʋ, la nɩɩ yikoro dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ, Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ yikoro nɛ. Ʋ fa sɩ, “Mɩ Bii-chooluŋ nɛ ŋ-la, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ.”

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: La ma tɩtɩa fa nɩɩ yikoro-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ dɩ la dɩ Yesu kala nɛ fa hɛ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba leŋe la wasa laa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa ma fa sɩ bʋla dii nɛ. Má jegile nɩɩba, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla nagɛ chaanɩŋ nɛ a chaanɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ jaŋ chaanɛ ŋɩɩ halɩɩ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Yesu Kirisito pʋlʋmʋŋ sɩ jaŋ chaanɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ, a nagɛ nanyʋɔlʋŋ sɩ yie chaanɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala lɛ, sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la. Ʋ maga dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ, Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ dee ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla bɩ ba tɩtɩa tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛ lɩa. Ama Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ nɛ kʋ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ a leŋ ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩba.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ wʋnyɩɛraa fa hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii tʋɔŋ, aa fugi arɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichiba jaŋ kʋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a lʋara dɩdagɛma wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ cheima a paala bʋl arɩ ba bɩ La Tɩɩna Kirisito jɩŋ, Nɩɩ-la sɩ laaba ta. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Wɩa guu cheiba.

english_verse: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
translation_verse: Nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a to ba harɩŋ a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa. Ba wʋŋaalaa jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa bʋl wɩaa a chichei Wɩa wombii-tɩtɩɩ-la la sɩɩ to.

english_verse: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
translation_verse: Wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichi deemba jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔ-luŋuŋ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ nii-sɩma a nyɩnyɩsɛma a lɩlaa ma kɩaa ma. Faafaa kala nɛ Wɩa dagɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ dii nɩaa deemba doho sarɩya. Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ cheiba bɩ doŋ pɩna.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ kala nɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa dɔnsʋŋ fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ba sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa bɩ ba leŋe pɛɩ. Ʋ kɛsɛba a jomba yuo hɛ Wɩa-nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ba kɛŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ vɔɔba a leŋ ba pɩŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ. Ba jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya.

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Nowa fa sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, Wɩa fa bɩ ba leŋe pɛɩ. Ʋ leŋe lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ paa nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba kala nɛ, aŋ leŋ Nowa arɩ ʋ nɩaa balɩpɛ dʋndʋŋ. Nowa fa bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ dɩ baa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Wɩa wombiiŋ.

english_verse: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
translation_verse: Lɔt fa sɩ hɔŋ nɩbɔmɔ-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ yie na aŋ pɛ nɩɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala ba fa sɩɩ ŋaa tasɩ-la tʋɔŋ tapʋlɩɩ na-kala. Wɩaa deemba nɛ leŋe ʋ tʋɔŋ viisi, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ-na fa ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ.

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala dagɛla arɩ Wɩa jɩŋ wombii-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ to a laa tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa ta nɛ, dɩ Sɩtaanɩ sɩ́ wuo magɩsɛba dɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋ. Ba bɩra dagɛla ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a dɔgɩsɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ ma a kaa mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya.

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: Ba tʋɔŋ, Wɩa jaŋ faasa dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ ba joŋ ba tɩtɩa a hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichi deemba bɩ nʋʋkala ka fá, aŋ pɛ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ ma a ŋɩŋaa ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba yie tʋʋsɛ Wɩa tɩndaara-la sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ a hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaara-la nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩ wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichi deemba. Ama Wɩa tɩndaara-la bɩ ba ka tʋʋsɛ, a bɩ cheeriŋ ma joŋo pɩ nɩaa deemba Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichi deemba yie ŋɩŋaa wɩaa arɩ pʋsʋŋ sɩ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ba yie nagɛ pʋsʋŋ nɩaa sɩ yie dɩɛsɛ dɩ ba kɛsɛ kpʋ nɛ. Ba yie bʋbʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ aa tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ lɛ. Ba sɩ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩba dɩ ba sʋʋ.

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: Wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa nɩaa lɛ, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la chɩmɩŋ a tiŋ ba lɛ. Ba tʋɔtɔrʋŋ kala nɛ dɩ ba gɔllɔɔ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ deemba ba bɩ kaa fɩfaa. Ba sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, nɩaa yie chichei ma yɩrɩŋ a joŋ hɩɩsɩŋ aa hɛ ma lɛ. Ba yie guoli ma tʋɔŋ nɛ ma kala didii kɩaa, ama ba yie lɩɩ ma harɩŋ a ŋɩŋaa ba wʋlɩɩlɩŋ.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ ba nɛ na haal, ba yie chɛʋ nɛ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ. Ba-na bɩ lɔl arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ. Ba yie nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa lɛ chɩna kpaŋ kpaŋ dɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋ. Ba ŋaa tʋɔ-luŋ tɩmma nɛ. Wɩa kalɩba hɛ ba lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba vɩa Wɩa wombiiŋ nɛ a yeŋŋi. Baa to bumbuŋ baal kʋbala harɩŋ nɛ baa yɩrɛ Balam. Ʋ nyɩmma yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Bioo. A tɩŋ moribiee wɩaa Balam fa vɩa Wɩa wɩaa aŋ tuto wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ.

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩ vɩa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa dagʋ a leŋ Balam kakumo bʋl wɩaa a nagɛ nuhuobiine, a kɛrʋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ wʋyaayasɩŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichi deemba nagɛ lɩɩ-bulo sɩ hɩla nɛ. Ba bɩra nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ tɩna, aŋ ka peliŋ ŋaa kiri ʋ bɩ nɩa nɛ. Nɩaa deemba, Wɩa jaŋ jomba hɛ biriŋ lim tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Ba yie bʋbʋl babiibal wɩaa sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kɛnɛ. Ba yie kɛŋ nii-sɩma a nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bumo lɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ jɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩaa nɛ kʋ jɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito, a lɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa dʋnɩa wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ zɔŋ lɛ, aŋ bɩra leŋ dɩ wɩaa deemba malba a kɛŋ doluŋ ba lɛ, nɩaa deemba dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ jaŋ bɔmɔ kɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ ba ha sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la jɩŋ.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Ʋ fa jaŋ kpɩa dɩ ba nɛ fa bɩ tʋɔpʋla wombiiŋ jɩŋ, ama ba jɩmʋ nɛ aŋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pɩba dɩ baa ŋaa. Wɩaa deemba bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ deeŋ sɩ ŋaa nɩaa deemba lɛ daga arɩ namaga-la nɩaa sɩɩ magʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ba sɩ, “Vaha yie gbu kɩaa nɛ aŋ gʋra paa dii. Ba yie fo tooŋ ma lɩɩŋ, ka ʋ bɩra mʋ ŋmoo vʋchɔɔŋ.”

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɩ ma liliisi wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la fa sɩ bʋla faafaa, dɩ ma sɩ́ ba yʋ. Má pɛ liliisi wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu fa sɩ to ma nanzɔɔba lɛ a bʋla pɩma. Ʋ nɛ la Laataara.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma laa sɩpaaŋ jɩŋ arɩ bʋa-la lɛ dʋnɩa sɩ jaŋ kʋ kpagɛ dɩdɛrɩŋ, nɩsieree jaŋ to ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ a sisierima lɛ.

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba chaasa jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ ŋaa nɛ, ama ba bɩ chɛ dɩ ba sɛɩ arɩ faafaa kala dʋnɩa fa tuo a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ bʋl wɩaa, ka wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala-na kʋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Tinteeŋ fa hɛ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, ka Wɩa kaa pɔrɛ ʋ pɩŋ ʋ dʋndʋŋa, ka lɩɩŋ ma pɩŋ ʋ dʋndʋŋa.

english_verse: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Lɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa joŋo tɔ bumbuŋ dʋnɩa-la, ʋ kala chei.

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩra bʋla arɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nyiniŋ dii tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ lɛɛlɛ ŋ-la. Ama ba jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ halɩɩ, dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya kʋ yi. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa ka to, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩba a cheiba.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't forget that for the Lord one day is the same as
translation_verse: Ama mɩ nandɔŋ-kpɩanaba, má sɩ́ yʋ, arɩ Wɩa teeŋ tapʋl-bala nagɛ jɩsɩŋ bʋɩ nɛ, ka jɩsɩŋ bʋɩ ma nagɛ tapʋl-bala.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ bɩɩna arɩ Wɩa fɩɛla nɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa lɛ. Ʋ bɩ fɩɛlɛ, ama ʋ kɛŋ kenyiri nɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ chɛ dɩ ma kʋŋkala lɛl. Ʋʋ chɛ dɩ nʋʋkala bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Ama tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu jaŋ sɩ kɔ, ʋ jaŋ nagɛ gaara sɩ kʋ dɩ nɩaa lɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ nʋʋkala jaŋ nɩɩ huuri-bal kʋbala wɩa-nyuŋ. Wɩa-nyuŋ jaŋ lɛl, ka kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ ma jaŋ ŋmɩɛrɛ nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ a nyɩɩgɛ, ka dɩ tinteeŋ kʋŋkala ma dii nyiniŋ.

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: Ma sɩɩ gbɛrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ jaŋ kɔ ŋɩɩ, má pɛ pipesi, dɩ ma ŋaa wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la yima lɩma. Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ wɩa-nyuŋ jaŋ ŋmɩɛrɛ nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ a nyɩɩgɛ. Ka kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ ma jaŋ ŋmɩɛrɛ nyiniŋ lɛ a lɛl.

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Faafaa-la Wɩa bʋla arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩa-nyu-falɩɩ arɩ tintee-falɩɩ. Lee-la ʋ nɩaa jaŋ ŋɩŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa. Wɩaa deemba nɛ laa gbɛrɛ.

english_verse: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ nandɔŋ-kpɩanaba, ma sɩɩ gbɛrɛ dɩ ma na wɩaa deemba ŋɩɩ, má fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a leŋ dɩ ma mɛlɛ zɔŋ, dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, dɩ Wɩa sɩ́ cheeriŋ joŋo pɩma, ka dɩ ma dɩ Wɩa sɩŋ.

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiriŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu kɛŋ kenyiri nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ wuo laama ta nɛ. Wɩaa deemba tɩtɩa nɛ la naambii-chooluŋ Pɔɔl ma ŋmʋnsa pɩma. Wɩa nɛ pʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ deeŋ ʋ kaa bʋl wɩalɩŋ.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba nɛ ʋ bʋl ʋ tenni-la kala lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla ʋ tenni-la lɛ, ba dɔnsʋŋ hɛyɛ. Nɩaa bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii lɛ chɩna kpaŋ kpaŋ yie kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ kaa bɩrɩmɛ wʋwogusu, arɩ ba sɩ yie kɛŋ Wɩa teniŋ wɩaa sɛmɛ dɔnsʋŋ kaa bɩrɩmɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa jaŋ cheiba.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Ma-na mɩ naambii-kpɩanaba, ma paala jɩŋ arɩ wʋnyɩɛraa deemba jaŋ kɔ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa niiŋ ka to sɩ́ wuo nyɩsɛma dɩ ma to ba wʋnyɩɛrɩɩ-la harɩŋ, aŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii a chɩŋ ba lɛ ta.

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ ma wʋjɩmɩŋ pʋŋa pɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito wɩaa, Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa la Laataara. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ nɩaa jaŋ yɩrɛ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Jɔɔŋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma a tɩgɛ wɩɩ kʋbala lɛ. Wɩɩ-la fa hɛ nɩmɛ bumbuŋ kala nɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. La nɩɩ ʋ yikoro a kɛŋ la sɩaa ma naʋ a chaasa benu, a kɛŋ la nɩsaa ma digu.

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la sɩ kʋ ŋaa nuhuobiine, la naʋ nɛ a laaʋ dii, a bʋl ʋ wɩaa pɩpɩma. Wɩɩ-la nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ fa hɛ la Nyɩmma teeŋ nɛ a kʋ lɩɩ la teeŋ la naʋ. Yesu Kirisito nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ la sɩ na aŋ nɩɩ ma, ba nɛ la bʋlaa pɩma, dɩ ma wuo jʋʋ la tʋɔŋ dɩ la kala kɛŋ nii-bala. La dɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ ʋ Bie Yesu Kirisito kɛŋ nii-bala nɛ.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Laa chɛ dɩ la tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ nɛ woruŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la ŋmʋnsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma. Wɩa nɛ kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Bie sɩ dagɛla a tɩgɛ Wɩa lɛ, ba nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩa nɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ, birimiŋ mʋa ma tuo ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ sɩ la dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nii-bala aŋ ka laa ŋaa birimiŋ tʋɔŋ wɩaa, laa nyɩɛ nɛ. La wʋŋaalaa arɩ la wʋbʋlaa kala bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ la nɛ hɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ, arɩ Wɩa sɩ hɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ-na la dɩ la dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa kala kɛŋ nii-bala nɛ. Dɩ la nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa Bie Yesu chalɩŋ ma jaŋ chɛsɛ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala ta.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ sɩ la bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa, laa nyɩsɛ la tɩtɩa nɛ. La bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ la nɛ sɛyɛ arɩ la ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a dagɛ la wʋbɔmɔ-la a pʋ, Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ wuo joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a chɛla a chɛsɛ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala ta.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ama dɩ la nɛ sɩ la bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa, la kɛŋ Wɩa yɩrɛ wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ. La bɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa laa dii.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: Mɩ biiri, mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma dɩ ma bɩra sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa, ama dɩ la kʋŋkala nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, la kɛŋ nʋʋ nɛ sɩ chɩŋ la nyuŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ jaŋ sʋla laala ʋ Nyɩmma teeŋ. Tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito nɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ a yɔɔ sʋʋŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, dɩ Wɩa joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a chɛla. La dʋndʋŋa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa dee, ama dʋnɩa nɩaa kala wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ daga, ŋɩɩ daga arɩ la jɩŋ Wɩa nɛ.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sɩ ʋ jɩmʋ, aŋ bɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga ka to, tɩɩna ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ, ʋ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ to ʋ niiŋ wɩaa, ʋ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ sɛnɛ cho Wɩa kɩŋkɛŋ. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ la jaŋ to jɩŋ arɩ la hɛ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ sɩ ʋ dɩ Wɩa ŋaa kʋbala, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tɩɩna wʋŋaalaa nagɛ Yesu Kirisito wʋŋaalaa nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ vɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii-chooloo, wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsaa pɩma lɛɛlɛ, ʋ bɩ wʋfalɩɩ kala ŋaa, ʋ ŋaa wʋbɩnɩɩ nɛ ma sɩ nɩa bumbuŋ kala. Wʋbɩnɩɩ-la nɛ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ nɩa faafaa kala.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Ama ʋ saa naga arɩ wʋfalɩɩ nɛ mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ Kirisito mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ arɩ ma ma mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ birimiŋ ka lɛl nɛ, aŋ ka pʋlʋmʋŋ suomo chɩchaanɛ.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ sɩ ʋʋ vɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ aŋ bɛrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ʋ ha hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ʋʋ vɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Wɩɩkala bɩra tuo sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ʋ tel.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Ka nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɛrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ʋ tɩɩna ka vɛŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ jɩŋ lee-la kala ʋ sɩɩ mʋ. Birimiŋ ŋaa ʋ sɩaa bɩ na.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: Mɩ biiriŋ, a tɩŋ Yesu wɩaa nɛ Wɩa joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a chɛma. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba pɩpɩma.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Mɩ nyɩmmaba ma, ma jɩŋ Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ bumbuŋ kala nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩ ma ma. Ma bapʋɔsaa ma, ma lɛɛlɛ yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩ ma ma. Mɩ biiriŋ, ma ma jɩŋ la Nyɩmma Wɩa nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩ ma ma.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Mɩ kʋhɩasɩŋ ma, ma jɩŋ Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ bumbuŋ kala nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩma. Ma bapʋɔsaa ma, ma ma kɛŋ doluŋ, Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa ma hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ. Ma lɛɛlɛ yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩma.

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ dʋnɩa kɩaa cho. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho dʋnɩa kɩaa, ʋ bɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa cho.

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, la yaraa wʋchɛɛlɛɛ arɩ la sɩɩŋ wʋchooloo arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa nɩaa bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ, ba kala bɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa teeŋ lɩa, ba ŋaa dʋnɩa kɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nuhuobiinee cho, ba kala jaŋ lɛl. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ cho, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. Kirisito dʋndɔŋ-balɩŋ

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: Mɩ biiriŋ, dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ kpaga nɛ. Ma nɩa arɩ Kirisito dʋndɔŋ-balɩŋ jaŋ kɔ. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ Kirisito dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ paala yʋgɛ nɛ a kɔ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, la jɩma arɩ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ kpaga nɛ.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Ba lɩɩ la tʋɔŋ nɛ, ama la dɩ ba fa bɩ kʋbala ŋaa. Dɩ la dɩ ba nɛ fa ŋaa kʋbala, ba ma fa ha jaŋ hɛ la tʋɔŋ. Ama ba sɩ lɩɩ la tʋɔŋ nɛ daga arɩ la dɩ ba bɩ kʋbala ŋaa.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Ama ma-na jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Kirisito joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ma lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ naga dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩma a tɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la jɩŋ nɛ. Ama mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩma a tɩŋ ma sɩ jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la nɛ. Ma jɩma arɩ wʋnyɩɛrɩ tɩɩna bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
