translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩ tɩɩna? Nɩɩ-la sɩ sɩ Yesu dee bɩ Kirisito ŋaa, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, ʋ nɛ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩ tɩɩna. Nɩɩ-la nɛ ŋaa Kirisito dʋndɔŋ-balɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ vɩa la Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ ʋ Bie Yesu.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩa Wɩa Bie, ʋ bɩ ʋ Nyɩmma ma jɩŋ. Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ sɛɩ Wɩa Bie, ʋ sɛɩ ʋ Nyɩmma ma nɛ.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ nɩa bumbuŋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ. Dɩ wɩaa deemba nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ, ma jaŋ hɛ Wɩa Bie arɩ ʋ Nyɩmma lɛ.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba pɩpɩma a mʋ tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba nyɩsɛma lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Ama Kirisito joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la hɛ ma lɛ nɛ. Ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ ma lɛ ŋɩɩ, ma bɩra bɩ nʋʋ ka chɛ dɩ ʋ dagɛma. Ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ ma lɛ ka dagɛma wɩɩkala nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩɩ dagɛma ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ, wʋnyɩɛrɩ dee. Má to wɩalɩŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ dagɛma, a leŋ ma dɩ Kirisito ŋaa kʋbala.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: Mɩ biiri, dɩ ma nɩɩ to Kirisito ŋɩɩ a kaa mʋ, la jaŋ kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ chɛɛ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ. Hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛnla dɩ la faa.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Ma jɩma arɩ Kirisito ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, ma saa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ nʋʋkala sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna, ʋ tɩɩna ŋaa Kirisito bii nɛ.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Ma na ŋɩɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ chola. Ʋ chola kieli, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kɛnla yɩyɩrɛ ʋ biiriŋ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, la sɛnɛ ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ nɛ. Dʋnɩa nɩaa bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba bɩ la ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: Mɩ nandɔŋ-kpɩanaba, lɛɛlɛ la ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ. Ama Wɩa ha bɩ chaasa daga pʋllɛ ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ nagɛ. Ama wɩɩ-la la sɩ jɩma nɛ ŋ-la: Bʋa-la lɛ Kirisito sɩ jaŋ kɔ, la ma jaŋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ naga, bɛɛ wɩaa la jaŋ na ʋ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ kala.

english_verse: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ yɩɛlɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ aŋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, arɩ Kirisito sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ, ʋ chei wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ leŋe ba ŋmʋnsa bil nɛ dɩ nɩaa tuto. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ʋ chei wɩalɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful,
translation_verse: Ma kala jɩma arɩ Kirisito kɔ dɩ ʋ laa la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta nɛ. Ʋ-na bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ arɩ Kirisito nɛ ŋaa kʋbala, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ka ŋaa. Ama nɩɩ-la kala ha sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ Kirisito jɩŋ. Ʋ sɩaa ma ha bɩ ʋ nyuŋ pollo.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Ama nɩɩ-la kala ha sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ ŋaa Sɩtaanɩ nʋʋ nɛ. Sɩtaanɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bumbuŋ kala nɛ a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ Wɩa Bie kɔ dʋnɩa nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ kɔ dɩ ʋ chei Sɩtaanɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa Wɩa bii, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa nagɩsɩŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo vɩa aŋ ha ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ŋaa Wɩa bii nɛ.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Ŋ-la lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ wuo to jɩŋ Wɩa biiriŋ arɩ Sɩtaanɩ biiriŋ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ wɩaa ŋaa ba bʋa lɛ, koo nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna cho, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ Wɩa bii ŋaa. Má cho dɔŋɔ

english_verse: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ma sɩ nɩa bumbuŋ kala nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ maga dɩ ma cho dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ la nagɛ Keeŋ. Ʋ fa ŋaa Sɩtaanɩ nʋʋ nɛ a kpʋ ʋ ŋaana. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kpʋʋ? Keeŋ faa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, aŋ ka ʋ ŋaana fa ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kpʋʋ.

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: Mɩ naambiiri, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere ma lɛ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa nɛ bɛrɛma.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: La-na cho la dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la jɩŋ arɩ la lɩɩ sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ nɩaa cho ha hɛ sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɛrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ʋ ŋaa nɩkpʋʋrʋ nɛ. Mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɩdɛrɩŋ kɛnɛ, ma jɩma arɩ nɩkpʋʋra bɩ ʋ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: Kirisito joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ yɔɔ sʋʋŋ la wɩaa nɛ, a dagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ faasa chola. La ma saa maga dɩ la cho la dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ a joŋ la mɩɩsɩŋ a yɔɔ sʋʋŋ ba wɩaa.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ aŋ na ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna ʋ jʋʋ wɩɩ a chɩchɛ pɛnɩŋ, ka ʋ kɛŋ tʋɔhɛɛŋ a bɩ ʋ nenige fá, ɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ wuo bʋl dɩ ʋ cho Wɩa nɛ?

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: Mɩ biiriŋ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la kɛŋ niiŋ dʋndʋŋa cho dɔŋɔ. Má leŋ dɩ la to wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiiŋ a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ la wʋŋaalɩa-la dagɛ arɩ la sɛnɛ cho dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, la jaŋ wuo to ŋɩɩ lɛ a jɩŋ arɩ laa to wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiiŋ nɛ a wuo na wiese Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: Dɩ la tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ wuo dagɛ arɩ la cheye nɛ, la jɩma arɩ Wɩa nɛ yʋga kɩɩ la tʋɔbɩɩnaa a jɩŋ wɩɩkala.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: Mɩ nandɔŋ-kpɩanaba, dɩ la tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ bɩ daga arɩ la cheye nɛ, la jaŋ kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ la nɛ sʋl kʋŋ na-kala ʋ teeŋ, ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla, bɛɛ wɩaa laa to wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ daga nɛ: dɩ la laa ʋ Bie Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii a cho dɔŋɔ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ dagɛla.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ dagɛla, ʋ tɩɩna hɛ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ, Wɩa ma hɛ ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ sɩ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ la lɛ nɛ leŋe la jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa hɛ la teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: Mɩ bii-chooloo, dɩ nɩaa nɛ sɩ dɩ ba kɛŋ doluŋ a wuo bʋl wɩaa, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la doluŋ lɛ, má sɩ́ guu laa dii arɩ baa bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Má laa sɩpaaŋ magɩsɛba na arɩ ba sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛɛ. Bɛɛ wɩaa wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa yʋga nɛ a hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ ŋɩɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ, ʋ bɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ kɛnɛ. Dol-la ʋ tɩɩna sɩ kɛnɛ ŋaa Kirisito dʋndɔŋ-balɩŋ doluŋ nɛ. Ma nɩa arɩ Kirisito dʋndɔŋ-balɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ kɔ dʋnɩa. Ʋ doluŋ nɛ saa paala hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: Mɩ biiri, ma nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ tɩɩ. Ma nɛ lɛɛlɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ hɛ ma lɛ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩ dol-la dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩ kɛnɛ.

english_verse: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ, ba hɛ dʋnɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ a bʋbʋl dʋnɩa wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa jegilee nɩɩ ba teeŋ.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Ama la-na ŋaa nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ tɩɩ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jɩŋ Wɩa, ʋ tɩɩna ma jegilee nɩɩ la teeŋ nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ, ba bɩ la teeŋ jegili. Ŋ-la lɛ nɛ la jaŋ wuo to jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ tɩŋŋaa arɩ wʋnyɩɛraa. Wɩa sɩ cho nɩaa ŋɩɩ

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii-chooloo, má leŋ dɩ la cho dɔŋɔ. Dɩ la nɛ cho dɔŋɔ, ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho nɩaa ŋaa Wɩa bii-lʋlɩɩ nɛ a jɩŋ Wɩa.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ bɩ nɩaa cho, ʋ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa chonuŋ ŋaa Wɩa kʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa dagɛla arɩ ʋ chola nɛ: Ʋ joŋ ʋ Bii-bala dɩ ʋ kʋ tuu dʋnɩa, dɩ la to ʋ lɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Ŋ-la nɛ chonuŋ nagɛ: Ʋ bɩ naga la nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ cho Wɩa, ama Wɩa nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ chola. Ʋ tɩŋ ʋ Bie ʋ kʋ tuu sʋʋ la wɩaa, dɩ Wɩa joŋ ʋ baanɩŋ ta ʋ fa sɩ kɛnɛ a tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, a joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛla.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: Mɩ bii-chooloo, Wɩa sɩ chola ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ la ma cho dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala ha bɩ Wɩa na. Dɩ la nɛ cho dɔŋɔ, Wɩa hɛ la teeŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ hɛ la teeŋ ŋɩɩ, la jaŋ cho Wɩa arɩ la dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Ʋ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la hɛ la lɛ dɩ ʋ dɩdagɛla. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ la to jɩŋ arɩ la hɛ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ, Wɩa ma hɛ la teeŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: La tɩtɩa na nɛ a laa dii arɩ Wɩa ta ʋ Bie dɩ ʋ kʋ tuu ŋaa dʋnɩa nɩaa Laataara nɛ.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala sɩ wuo bʋl arɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie, Wɩa hɛ tɩɩna teeŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ. Ʋ tɩɩna ma hɛ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ la tɩtɩa jɩŋ a laa dii arɩ Wɩa chola nɛ. Chonuŋ ŋaa Wɩa kʋŋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho Wɩa arɩ nɩaa a kaa mʋ, ʋ tɩɩna hɛ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ. Wɩa ma hɛ ʋ tɩɩna teeŋ a kaa mʋ.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ cho Wɩa arɩ nɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ, la jaŋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ fa sɩ naga dʋnɩa lɛ. Dɩ la nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, la jaŋ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la Kirisito sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ cho Wɩa arɩ nɩaa, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ fawʋllʋŋ ka fá. Dɩ la nɛ cho Wɩa arɩ nɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ, chono-la kiri fawʋllʋŋ ta nɛ. Dɩ la nɛ haa fá fawʋllʋŋ arɩ Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛla, la ha bɩ Wɩa arɩ nɩaa cho kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sɩ ʋ cho Wɩa nɛ aŋ bɛrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ʋ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ wuo na ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna aŋ bɩ ʋ cho, ŋɩɩ-na ʋ bɩ Wɩa ʋ sɩ bɩ wuo na ma cho.

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Wɩa bʋla pɩla arɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ chou, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ cho ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna ma nɛ.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa dii arɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, ʋ ŋaa Wɩa bii nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho nʋʋ, ʋ cho nɩɩ-la bie ma nɛ.

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ cho Wɩa a tuto wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ dagɛla, ŋɩɩ daga arɩ la cho Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ dagɛla, ŋɩɩ dagɛ arɩ la cho Wɩa nɛ. Ʋ bɩ hɛɩ a pɩla dɩ la to wɩaa deemba,

english_verse: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa bii kala kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ dʋnɩa wɩaa lɛ. La sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ pɩla doluŋ deeŋ la yuo dii dʋnɩa wɩaa.

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ wuo yuo dii dʋnɩa? See nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa dii arɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie. Kɩalɩŋ batori sɩ daga arɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie

english_verse: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
translation_verse: Ʋ-na Yesu Kirisito nɛ kɔ dʋnɩa ba fou Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, a kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ʋ chalɩŋ jaasɛ. Ŋ-la daga arɩ lɩɩŋ dʋndʋŋa dee ba fou, ba kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ma nɛ ʋ chalɩŋ jaasʋ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ ŋɩɩ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
translation_verse: Kɩaa batori nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a dɩdagɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ ŋaa: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ arɩ lɩɩ-la arɩ ʋ chal-la. Ba kala ka bʋl wʋbala nɛ.

english_verse: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
translation_verse: Dɩ wɩɩ nɛ ŋaa nʋʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la, la yie sɛɩ nɛ. Ama dɩ Wɩa nɛ bʋl wɩɩ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ a kɩɩ nuhuobiine wʋbʋlʋŋ. Wɩa tɩtɩa nɛ saa bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ ʋ Bie lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa Wɩa Bie wɩaa dii, ʋ tɩɩna jɩma ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ Wɩa laa dii, ʋ kɛŋ Wɩa yɩyɩrɛ wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ Bie lɛ laa dii.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ ʋ pɩla mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ. Mɩɩsɩ-la hɛ ʋ Bie teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa Bie teeŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala ma sɩ bɩ Wɩa bile teeŋ hɛ, ʋ ma bɩ mɩɩsɩ-la kɛnɛ. La kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: Mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma dɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa Bie wɩaa dii ma wuo jɩŋ arɩ ma kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: La kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ nɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa la laa dii arɩ la nɛ sʋlʋ a chɩchɛ kʋŋkala sɩɩ tɔrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ, ʋ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ la teeŋ.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɛ saa jɩma arɩ la nɛ sʋl kʋŋkala ʋ teeŋ, ʋ yie jegile nɩɩ la teeŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ-na la jɩma arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ kʋ-la la sɩɩ chɛ pɩla.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: La jɩma arɩ Wɩa bii kala bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ka ŋaa deeŋ deeŋ. Wɩa Bie Yesu nɛ yie pʋpɔʋ. Sɩtaanɩ bɩ ʋ wɩɩkala wuo ŋaa.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: La jɩma la ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ. Nɩkaana-la-na kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ hɛ Sɩtaanɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: La bɩra jɩma arɩ Wɩa Bie nɛ kɔ a suri la sɩaa la wuo jɩŋ Wɩɩ-tɩtɩɩ-la. La dɩ Wɩɩ-tɩtɩɩ-la ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. La hɛ ʋ Bie lɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa tɩtɩa. Ʋ nɛ joŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ pɩla.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: Mɩ biiri, má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa vʋɩyaa lɛ.

english_verse: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Wɩa dɩa nɩhɩaŋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ aa pɩ ŋ-na haal-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, arɩ ŋ biiriŋ, nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ cho woruŋ. Mɩ dʋndʋŋa dee bɩ ma cho, mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la nɛ choma.

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: La choma ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ la lɛ nɛ. Ʋ saa jaŋ hɛ la lɛ a kaa mʋ.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ ʋ Bie Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ba jaŋ fá la nenige, a leŋ dɩ la hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa, a pɛ la lɛ dɩ la sɛnɛ to wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ a cho dɔŋɔ. Ʋ maga dɩ la cho dɔŋɔ

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ kɩŋkɛŋ mɩ sɩ na arɩ ŋ biiriŋ dɔnsʋŋ to wʋtɩtɩɩ-la lɛ, arɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ dagɛla ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Haal, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ to wɩɩ-la dɔŋɔ Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pɩla bumbuŋ kala. Ʋ bɩ wʋfalɩɩ ŋaa. Ʋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ maga dɩ la cho dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
translation_verse: Dɩ la nɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ daga, la sɛnɛ cho Wɩa arɩ nɩaa nɛ. Wɩɩ-la Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pɩla bumbuŋ kala nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ la cho dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Nɩaa yʋga a hɛ lee-kala dʋnɩa lɛ dɩ ba nyɩsɛ nɩaa. Nɩaa deemba bɩ sɛyɛ arɩ Yesu Kirisito kʋ ŋaa nuhuobiiŋ nɛ a kʋ tuu dʋnɩa. Nʋʋkala sɩ nagɛ nɩaa deemba ŋaa nɩnyɩsɛrʋ nɛ a ŋaa Kirisito dʋndɔŋ-balɩŋ ma.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ma sɩ tɩma, sɩ́ pɛɩ ŋaa. Ama má tɩŋ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ Wɩa wuo joŋ ma time kala a pɩma.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ Kirisito sɩ daga dʋndʋŋa ka to, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ Wɩa teeŋ hɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Kirisito sɩ daga dʋndʋŋa, ʋ tɩɩna kɛŋ Wɩa arɩ ʋ Bie kala nɛ.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kɔ ma teeŋ a bɩ wɩaa deemba ka dagɛ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ tɩɩna jʋʋ ma dɩa. Má paala sɩ́ ʋ chʋɔlʋ.

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ chʋɔlʋ a kɛnʋ woruŋ, ʋ ma ŋaa ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Wʋkaanaa

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ wɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma. Ama mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba kala teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ tɩtɩa kʋ yi ma nɛ a bʋla pɩma, dɩ la kala tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: Ŋ dɩhaala Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, ʋ biiriŋ ka chʋɔlʋŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Wɩa dɩa nɩhɩaŋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩ ŋ-na Gayas, mɩ nandɔŋ-la mɩ sɩ cho woruŋ.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: Mɩ nandɔŋ-choolii, mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa a nagɛ wɩaa sɩ zɔmɔ pɩŋ ŋ dɩma lɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ woruŋ la naambiiriŋ sɩ lɩɩ wombiiŋ kʋ bʋla pɩmɛ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a tuto wʋtɩtɩɩ-la. Mɩ jɩma ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ vɛnɛɛ ŋaa.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Wɩɩkala bɩ leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ kɩŋkɛŋ a magɛ mɩ sɩ nɩa arɩ mɩ biiriŋ ka to wʋtɩtɩɩ wombii-la. Jɔɔŋ bɛsɛ Gayas lɛ

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: Mɩ nandɔŋ-choolii, ŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa pɩpɩ ŋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩmma-la sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, arɩ ba sɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa ma kala ŋ teeŋ.

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: Ba bʋl ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ cho nɩaa a pɩ la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi. Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ hɛ doluŋ aŋ pɛ ba lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kaa vɛŋ wombiiŋ. Ŋaa ŋɩɩ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Wɩa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ,

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: bɛɛ wɩaa ba lɩɩ ba dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba tɩŋ Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ. Ba vɩa dɩ ba laa kʋŋkala nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii teeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Ʋ maga dɩ la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ pɛ nɩaa deemba lɛ. Dɩ la nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ naga la ma pɛ ba lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ wombii-la tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ. Dayɔtɩfɩs bɩ woruŋ ŋaa

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ, mɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa a tɩgɛ la lɛ a pɩma. Ʋ yie gɩgaa la harɩŋ a chichei la yɩrɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ ma dʋndʋŋa dee, la naambiiri-la sɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa, dɩ ba nɛ kɔ, ʋ bɩ ba woruŋ ka kɛŋ, aŋ bɩra pɔ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kɛmba woruŋ, dɩ ba sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa. Dɩ ba nɛ vɩa aŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ yie kiriba ta nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: Mɩ nandɔŋ choolii, sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chesu. Ama chichesi nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa Wɩa bii nɛ. Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Baal-la ma ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Dɛmɩɩtɩas ŋaa nɩzɔŋ nɛ. Nʋʋkala bʋbʋl ʋ wɩaa woruŋ. Ʋ wʋŋaalaa ma tɩtɩa dagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ to wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ. La maa bʋl ʋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ. Ma jɩma arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ bʋl ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Chʋɔlaa

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: Mɩ kɛŋ wɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ aa chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩŋ. Ama mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba kala teniŋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ nɛ ʋ bɩ dieni, dɩ la hɔnɔ bʋl wɩaa.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Ŋ jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Ŋ nandɔnsʋŋ kala sɩ hɛ daha ka chʋɔlʋŋ. Ŋ ma chʋɔlɛ la nandɔnsʋŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ pɩla.

english_verse: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Juud nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ. Mɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ a ŋaa Jeems naambii ma. Mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ yɩra, nɩalɩŋ la Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ cho, nɩalɩŋ Yesu Kirisito sɩɩ pɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ fá ma nenige a leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa kɩŋkɛŋ, a na ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ choma kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ. Juud bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichiba lɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
translation_verse: Mɩ nandɔŋ-chooloo, mɩ fa cho dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ pɩma nɛ, a bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ laa la dɩ ma kala ta lɛ. Ama mɩ na dɩ ʋ maga dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a sʋlma dɩ ma kala luloo woruŋ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii wɩaa. Wɩa joŋ wɩalɩŋ hɛ ʋ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ bala nɛ.

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka fá lʋara jʋʋ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ba bɩ Wɩa wombiiŋ ka to, ŋɩɩ wɩaa Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a leŋ dɩ ba sʋʋ. Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋl faafaa kala nɛ dɩ Wɩa jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Wɩa sɩ fá la nenige a laala ta, ba to ŋɩɩ a kɛŋ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la kaa bɩrɩmɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ. Ba yie bʋl arɩ ba bɩ Yesu Kirisito jɩŋ, Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa la kala Tɩɩna.

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
translation_verse: Ma jɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩpɩma nɛ, ama mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ liisima nɛ arɩ La Tɩɩna fa kɛŋ ʋ nɩaa kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ, ama ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, ʋ chei nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii nɛ.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ yʋ arɩ Wɩa dɔgɩsɛ ʋ tɩndaaraa ma nɛ. Ba fa kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ a bibeŋ leree, ama ba vɩa lere-la ba sɩ hɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa kɛmba hɛ chɔrʋmɔɔ a bil birimiŋ tʋɔŋ lim. Ba jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, see dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya kʋ yi.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ, Wɩa dɔgɩsɛ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sodom arɩ Gomora arɩ tabala-la kala sɩ golli lee-la. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ tasɩ-la tʋɔŋ faa ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ arɩ disinni-la nuhuobiinee paala sɩ bɩ maga dɩ ba ŋaa nɛ. Wɩa jomba hɛ nyiŋ-la sɩɩ dii deeŋ deeŋ, a bɩ dɩsɛ lɛ nɛ, aa chagɩlɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.

english_verse: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ lʋara kʋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, ba wʋŋaalaa nagɛ bumbuŋ nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ dɔgɩsɔ nɛ. Ba yie bʋl arɩ ba na wɩaa duosoo tʋɔŋ, a to ŋɩɩ lɛ a ŋaa wɩaa chei ba tɩtɩa. Ba vɩa Wɩa doluŋ nɛ, aŋ tʋtʋʋsɛ ʋ tɩndaaraa ma sɩ kɛŋ tʋla.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Ama bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa kʋhɩaŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Maakɩl, arɩ Sɩtaanɩ fa sɩ kɛŋ Mosis kʋsʋʋŋ wɩaa yuyuo dɔŋɔ, Maakɩl bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla chei Sɩtaanɩ tʋɔŋ, ama ʋ ta bʋl nɛ arɩ La Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsʋ.

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Ama wɩɩ na-kala nɩaa deemba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ, ba yie bʋl ʋ ŋaa wʋtɔɔ nɛ. Ba wʋŋaalaa nagɛ pʋsʋŋ sɩ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ gʋra cheiba.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Wɩɩŋ puuba. Ba to Keeŋ naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ. Ba tɩŋ moribiee wɩaa nɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a nagɛ baal kʋbala ba fa sɩɩ yɩrɛ Balam fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ba lɩɩ Wɩa harɩŋ nɛ a nagɛ baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kora ma fa sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa harɩŋ ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa kpʋ ba kala.

english_verse: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
translation_verse: Dɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho dɔŋɔ nɛ hilime dɩ ma dii kɩaa, nɩaa deemba yie guoli ma tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ba nagɛ nanchʋɔsʋŋ nɛ aa chei ma kʋdiile-la. Ba dʋndʋŋa wɩaa nɛ ba yie chɩl. Ba nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ yie tɩŋ nɛ, ka peliŋ ŋaa kiri ʋ bɩ nɩa. Ba bɩra nagɛ tɩɩsɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba nɛŋ nɛ aŋ bɩ nɛŋ. Ba jaŋ huro churiba dɩ ba sʋʋ.

english_verse: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba nagɛ lɩɩ-peliŋ sɩ dolie nɛ. Ba hɩɩsɩ wɩalɩŋ ma nagɛ disiniŋ lɩɩ-peliŋ sɩ kaa kʋ lɩɩ ta lɩɩŋ niiŋ. Ba nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ churo nɛ a mʋ jʋʋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ lim. Ba jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛnɔk fa bʋl wɩaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ faafaa kala nɛ a tɩgɛ nɩaa deemba lɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa Adam nihi-lɩɛrɩ-pɛmɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ, “Má bee na, La Tɩɩna Wɩa ka kɔ nɛ arɩ ʋ tɩndaaraa bʋɩ fii fiiba sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ,

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: dɩ ʋ dii nʋʋkala sarɩya, a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ nɩbɔmɔ-la kala a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa, arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ Wɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba yie gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa, a dʋdɔŋ nɩaa, baa to ba tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ nɛ, a bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ, a kɛŋ nii-sɩma a nyɩsa lɩlaa nɩaa kɩaa. Juud sɩ chagɩlɛ nɩaa ŋɩɩ

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ama mɩ nandɔŋ-chooloo, má liliisi wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito nanzɔɔba sɩ bʋla pɩma arɩ ba jaŋ kʋ ŋaa.

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: Ba bʋla pɩma arɩ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ, nɩaa jaŋ kɔ a sisieri Wɩa lɛ. Ba jaŋ tuto ba tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ.

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Nɩdosunuŋ deemba jaŋ kɛmma pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa arɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ tuo ba lɛ.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: Ama ma-na, mɩ nandɔŋ-chooloo, wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má kɛmba woruŋ a waa ba lɛ, a to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la lɛ a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: Wɩa sɩ choma ŋɩɩ, má chɩŋ ŋɩɩ lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ, a gbɛrɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito dɩ ʋ kɔ, Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ fá ma nenige a pɩma mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ jʋʋ Wɩa nyiniŋ, má lorigo laaba ta. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma hɛ nɩmɛ sɩ maga dɩ ma fá Wɩa aŋ fá ba nenige, ama má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa dɩ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la sɩ́ ma chol.

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa Wɩa, ʋ nɛ to La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ a laala ta. Má dɛnnʋ a leŋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a tɩɩ kʋŋkala aa bemba ma, a lɩɩ dɩ-suomuŋ kʋkɔ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba nɛ Wɩa joŋo pɩ Yesu Kirisito dɩ ʋ joŋo dagɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa, dɩ ba jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa lɛɛlɛ. Wɩa tɩŋ ʋ tɩndaara ʋ kɔ ʋ tɩntɩnna Jɔɔŋ teeŋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ pʋ.

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ na, wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ dagʋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala Yesu Kirisito sɩ bʋla pʋ.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ karɩmɛ wɩaa deemba nɩaa nɩɩ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jegile nɩɩ wɩaa deemba a laa hɛ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ a tutoba, Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la wɩaa deemba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa kpaga nɛ. Jɔɔŋ chʋɔlɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ Esia lɛ

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Jɔɔŋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi tasɩŋ balɩpɛ-la sɩ hɛ Esia tinteeŋ lɛ. Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ faafaa kala arɩ Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ. Wɩaa deemba lɩɩ Wɩa Dɩnsɩŋ balɩpɛ-la sɩ chɩŋ Wɩa kuoru kpasa-la sɩpaaŋ nɛ

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: arɩ Yesu Kirisito teeŋ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩada tɩɩna a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩ sʋba aŋ laa sɩpaaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ dʋnɩa kuoroo kala doluŋ. Má leŋ dɩ la dɛnnʋ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ chola ŋɩɩ a joŋ ʋ chalɩŋ a jaasɛ, a lɩɩsɛla wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ʋ nɛ leŋe la dɩ ʋ kala dii kuoruŋ a tɩmaa pɩ Wɩa, Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa ʋ Nyɩmma. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ arɩ doluŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Má bee na, ʋ nɛ to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tʋɔŋ a kʋkɔ. Nʋʋkala jaŋ naʋ. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ joŋ kɩaa tɔbʋ jaŋ naʋ. Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ yel ʋ wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ sɛnɛ jaŋ ŋaa. Amɩɩ.

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ, “Mɩ nɛ ŋaa Alɩfa arɩ Omega. Mɩ-na Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, mɩ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ arɩ Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ faafaa kala arɩ Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ.” Wɩalɩŋ Jɔɔŋ sɩ na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na ma naambie Jɔɔŋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩma. A tɩŋ Yesu Kirisito wɩaa nɛ laa na hɛɛŋ. Ama la nɩalɩŋ sɩ na hɛɛ-la ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ ʋ wɩaa, la ma jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ. Hɛɛ-la kala lɛ la dii kenyiri nɛ a nyalɩmɛ. Mɩ fa bʋl Wɩa wɩaa nɛ aŋ pɛ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito sɩada tɩɩna. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛmmɛ kaa mʋ tintee kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Patɩmɔs. Lɩɩŋ golli tintee-la kala chu nɛ.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ kʋ hɛ mɩ lɛ woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ nʋʋ yikori-bal mɩ harɩŋ a nagɛ ba sɩɩ ŋmʋʋ banyilliŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ yikoro-la bʋla pɩmɛ, “Ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ na, a joŋo tɩŋ dɩ ba kaa mʋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi tasɩŋ balɩpɛ-la sɩ hɛ Esia tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba nɛ ŋ-la: Ɛfɛsɩs, Sɩmɩɩna, Pɛgamɔm, Taataya, Saadɩs, Fɩladɛlɩfɩa arɩ Laadisiya.”

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mɩɩra daasɛ harɩŋ dɩ mɩ na nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ sɩ daasa, mɩ na chaaŋ daasɩŋ balɩpɛ. Sɛlɩmɛ nɛ ba kaa ŋaa ba kala.

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: Ka nʋʋ chɩŋ ba tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ a nagɛ Nuhuobiine Bie, a laalɛ gɛrɩ-duduoŋ, a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie a vɔɔ ʋ bɔyɛ.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: Ʋ nyuŋ arɩ ʋ nyu-pʋnaa kala pʋllɛ a nagɛ kuŋkunuŋ, a pʋlla nagɛ bʋrʋŋ sɩ tɔ. Ʋ sɩaa kala nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ.

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: Ʋ naasɩŋ ma nagɛ kɔlɩɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ ʋ fɩɛsɛ. Ʋ yikoro ma nagɛ lɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩɩ pɛllʋ gbul gbul.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: Ka ʋ kori chɛnwʋlaa balɩpɛ ʋ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, tokobiiŋ lɩɩ ʋ niiŋ lɛ a kʋ lɩɩ. Ʋ niiriŋ balɩa kala didii nyagaga. Ka ʋ sɩaa kala tʋtʋl a nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ sɩ faasa pɔsɛ.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ naʋ ŋɩɩ, mɩ tuu tel ʋ sɩpaaŋ a pɩŋ nɩmɛ chɩm a nagɛ dɩ mɩ sʋba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ ʋ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ mɩ lɛ aŋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, mɩ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ bumbuŋ arɩ Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ.

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Mɩ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩ weye. Mɩ fa sʋba nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ weye nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Mɩ kɛŋ sʋʋŋ arɩ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ kala doluŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: Lɛɛlɛ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ na, wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa harɩŋ.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Wʋkpuŋkpere-la ŋ sɩ na a mʋ tɩgɛ chɛnwʋla-la balɩpɛ ŋ sɩ na mɩ na-diiŋ lɛ arɩ chaaŋ daasɩ-la balɩpɛ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ: Chɛnwʋlaa balɩpɛ-la nɛ ŋaa Wɩa tɩndaara-la sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hihilimi a hɛ tasɩ-la balɩpɛ-la sɩ hɛ Esia tinteeŋ lɛ. Chaaŋ daasɩ-la balɩpɛ nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hihilimi tasɩŋ balɩpɛ-la sɩ hɛ Esia tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ŋmʋŋsɛ wɩaa deemba a pɩpɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Ɛfɛsʋs lɛ. Mɩ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ kori chɛnwʋla-la balɩpɛ mɩ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a vɩvɛŋ chaaŋ daasɩ-la balɩpɛ tʋɔŋ, mɩ nɛ tɩŋ tɩndaarɩŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ ŋaa nɛ. Mɩ na ŋɩɩ ma sɩ tɩma arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ nɛ, a dii kenyiri wɩɩkala lɛ. Mɩ jɩma ma dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ wuo. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ joŋ ba tɩtɩa arɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa nanzɔɔba nɛ, ama ma magɩsɛ nɩaa deemba nɛ a na dɩ baa nyɩɛ nɛ.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: Ma kɛŋ kenyiri nɛ, a na hɛɛŋ mɩ wɩaa aŋ nyalɩmɛ, a ha bɩ lɔlɔ.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: Ama wɩɩ nɛ mɩ kɛŋ a tɩgɛ ma lɛ. Ma fa sɩ chomi ŋɩɩ bumbuŋ-la, ma bɩra bɩ mɩ ŋɩɩ cho.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: Má bɩɩna yi wɩalɩŋ lɛ a sɩ́ tele. Má bɩrɩma lɩɩ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ ma fa sɩɩ ŋaa bumbuŋ-la. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, mɩ jaŋ kʋ joŋ ma chaaŋ daaŋ.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Ama wɩɩ-la ma sɩ ŋaa mɩ cho nɛ ŋ-la: Ma bɛrɛ Nɩkɔlaata nɩaa wʋŋaalaa nɛ arɩ mɩ ma sɩ bɛrɛ ba wʋŋaalaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: Dɩgɩlaa tɩŋŋaa, má wuoli ma dɩgɩlaa a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ bʋlaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hihilimi lee-kala Esia lɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ wuo yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ dii tɩa-la nɛnɛɛ sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ a hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩ Sɩmɩɩna nɩaa

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba a pɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Sɩmɩɩna lɛ. Wɩaa deemba lɩɩ mɩ-na Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ bumbuŋ kala teeŋ nɛ, aŋ ha jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ. Mɩ sʋba nɛ, aŋ bɩra sii sʋʋŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ walɩmɛma nɛ, a jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ summo, ama Wɩa teeŋ, ma ŋaa kuoroo nɛ. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ aa chei ma yɩrɩŋ. Nɩaa deemba joŋ ba tɩtɩa arɩ ba ŋaa Juu tɩmma nɛ aŋ bɩ Juu tɩmma ŋaa. Baa to Sɩtaanɩ harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma a mʋ tɩgɛ hɛɛ kala ma sɩ jaŋ na lɛ. Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, Sɩtaanɩ jaŋ magɩsɛ ma dɔnsʋŋ a leŋ dɩ ba kɛmma tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa. Ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ a yi tapʋlaa fii. Dɩ ba nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋma ma, ma-na ha chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩɩ-zɔmʋŋ pɩma Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: Dɩgɩlaa tɩŋŋaa, má wuoli ma dɩgɩlaa a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ bʋlaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi lee-na kala Esia lɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ wuo yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ, dɩ ʋ nɛ sʋba, ʋ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa nyiniŋ. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩ Pɛgamɔm nɩaa

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba a pɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Pɛgamɔm lɛ. Mɩ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ kori tokobiiŋ niiriŋ balɩa kala sɩɩ dii nyagaga nɩɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba.

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ lee-la ma sɩ hɛ nɛ, nɩmɛ nɛ Sɩtaanɩ dii kuoruŋ. Ama ma ha kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii joŋo ta bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kpʋ Antɩpas sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ tɩɩna a bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ. Ba kpʋʋ ma tabalɩŋ lɛ nɛ, lee-la Sɩtaanɩ sɩ hɛ.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Ma ŋaa kukeri nɛ, ama wɩaa baŋmɛnɛ nɛ ma ŋaa chei. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a tuto wɩalɩŋ baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Balam fa sɩɩ dagʋ. Ʋ nɛ dagɛ kuoru kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Balak dɩ ʋ nyɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba didii vʋɩyaa kɩaa aŋ pɛ ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a tuto wʋbɔmɔ-la Nɩkɔlaata tɩmma-la sɩɩ dagʋ.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má bɩrɩma lɩɩ wɩalɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee mɩ jaŋ kɔ lɛɛlɛ a kɛŋ mɩ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa sɩ nagɛ tokobiiŋ, a yuoma.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: Dɩgɩlaa tɩŋŋaa, má wuoli ma dɩgɩlaa a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Esia tinteeŋ lɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ kʋdiile-la sɩ faa Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ a pʋ, a joŋ tabɩɩ-pʋla ma a pʋ. Mɩ jaŋ ŋmʋnsɛ yɩrɩ-falɩŋ a hɛ tabɩɩ-la lɛ. Yɩrɩ-la nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ jɩmʋ, see nɩɩ-la sɩ laa tabɩɩ-la dʋndʋŋa.” Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩ Taataya nɩaa

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba nɛ a pɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Taataya lɛ. Mɩ-na Wɩa Bie nɛ bʋl wɩaa deemba. Mɩ sɩaa nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ nɛ, ka mɩ naasɩŋ ma nagɛ kɔlɩɩŋ ba sɩ chɛsɛ ʋ faasa tʋtʋl.

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: Bʋla pɩba dɩ mɩ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ. Mɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ cho nɩaa nɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ laa Wɩa dii, arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩɩ pɛ nɩaa lɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ kɛŋ kenyiri. Lɛɛlɛ ma paala ŋaa wɩaa deemba aa kɩɩ ŋɩɩ ma fa sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ bumbuŋ-la.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Ma ŋaa kukeri, ama wɩaa baŋmɛnɛ nɛ ma ŋaa chei. Haal kʋbala nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ aa dagɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, ka ma bɩ ʋ kire. Haal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jɛzɛbɛl nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ fa joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ ama ʋʋ nyɩɛ nɛ. Ʋʋ dagɛ mɩ nɩaa nɛ dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ aŋ pɛ didii vʋɩyaa kɩaa ma.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: Mɩ pɩ haala deeŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ wʋlɩɩlɩ-la lɛ nɛ, ka ʋ vɩa aŋ ŋɩŋaa.

english_verse: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má bee na, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ wɩɩlɛ woruŋ a pɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩɩ tou a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩ-la, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba ma faasa na hɛɛŋ, see dɩ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋŋaalɩa-la lɛ.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: Mɩ jaŋ ŋmoo ʋ harɩ-tooroo kala kpʋ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ jɩŋ nʋʋkala tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ. Nʋʋkala sɩ tɩma magɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ jaŋ timu magɛ.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: Ama ma nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ hɛ Taataya lɛ a bɩ wɩalɩŋ haala deeŋ sɩɩ dagʋ ka to, a bɩ Sɩtaanɩ wʋbisi-la gʋnna, mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋyuŋŋii kala daŋ ma lɛ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ dʋndʋŋ nɛ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma:

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: Ama wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩma nɛ, má kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la ma sɩ nɩa kpaŋ kpaŋ a mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ kɔ.

english_verse: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ wuo yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ aŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ a mʋ yi ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ pʋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Dɩgɩlaa tɩŋŋaa, má wuoli ma dɩgɩlaa a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dɩ aa hilimi Esia tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: Bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba a pɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Saadɩs lɛ. Bʋla pɩba: Mɩ-na Nɩɩ-la sɩ kori Wɩa Dɩnsɩŋ balɩpɛ-la aŋ pɛ kɛŋ chɛnwʋlaa balɩpɛ-la nɛ bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩba. Mɩ jɩŋ ma Saadɩs nɩaa tɩntɩŋŋaa kala nɛ. Ma laa yɩrɩŋ arɩ ma weye nɛ, ama ma sʋba nɛ.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: Má sii doŋ lɛ a pɔ dɩ wʋkaana-la mʋa ma ha sɩ kɛnɛ sɩ́ chei, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ na dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa ha bɩ sɩɩŋ suo Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: Má liise yi wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ dagɛma arɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ nɩa aŋ laa maa. Má toba, aŋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ doŋ lɛ sie, mɩ jaŋ lʋara kɔ a nagɛ gaara. Ma bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ bʋa-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ kɔ ma teeŋ.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ nɛ ha hɛ Saadɩs lɛ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ba nɛ jaŋ laalɛ gɛrɩ-pʋllʋŋ a to mɩ harɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba magɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ wuo yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ, ʋ tɩɩna jaŋ laalɛ gɛrɩ-pʋllʋŋ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ kpʋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ ta mɩɩsɩŋ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ suri mɩ niiŋ a yɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ mɩ Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ ʋ tɩndaaraa sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
translation_verse: Dɩgɩlaa tɩŋŋaa, má wuoli ma dɩgɩlaa a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Esia tinteeŋ lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩ Fɩladɛlɩfɩa nɩaa

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba pɩ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Fɩladɛlɩfɩa lɛ. Mɩ-na Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna arɩ Nɩtɩtɩɩ nɩɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba. Mɩ nɛ kori Devit taŋ-la boribiiŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ suro, nʋʋkala bɩ wuo kaa tɔ, dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩra kaa tɔ ma, nʋʋkala bɩ wuo suri.

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ ma wʋŋaalaa nɛ. Má bee na, mɩ kɛŋ boro kaa suri nɛ a pɩma. Nʋʋkala bɩ wuo kaa tɔ. Mɩ jɩma arɩ ma doluŋ bɩ yʋgɛ, ama ma haa to mɩ niiŋ wɩaa a bɩ mɩ vɩa.

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Má bee na, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Sɩtaanɩ a nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ba ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa nɛ aŋ bɩ Juu tɩmma ŋaa, kpirimi ma sɩpaaŋ, dɩ ba jɩŋ arɩ mɩ choma nɛ.

english_verse: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ ma sɩ to mɩ niiŋ wɩaa a nyalɩmɛ, mɩ ma jaŋ pɔma a lɩɩsɛma hɛɛ-la sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala, a magɩsɛba.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: Mɩɩ kɔ nɛ lɛɛlɛ. Má faasa kɛŋ kʋ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ kuori-nyunchuul-la sɩ ŋaa ma time kaa laa ma teeŋ.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ wuo yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ nagɛ jebiiŋ a hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. Mɩ jaŋ ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ a hɛ ʋ lɛ, a ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa-jaŋ yɩrɩŋ ma hɛ ʋ lɛ. Jaŋ-la nɛ ŋaa Jerusalɛm falɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kʋ tuu. Mɩ jaŋ ŋmʋnsɛ mɩ tɩtɩa yɩrɩ-falɩŋ a hɛ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: Dɩgɩlaa tɩŋŋaa, má wuoli ma dɩgɩlaa a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Esia tinteeŋ lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩ Laadisiya nɩaa

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba pɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Laadisiya taŋ-la lɛ. Mɩ-na nɛ Nɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ “Amɩɩ,” a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a didii dansɩa arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, Nɩɩ-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ to a ŋaa dʋnɩa, mɩ nɩɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
translation_verse: Mɩ jɩŋ ma wʋŋaalaa nɛ. Ma ŋaa tɔlɔ tɔlɔ nɛ. Ma bɩ fɩɛla, ma bɩra bɩ lɩŋ ma. Mɩ fa cho dɩ ma fɩɛla nɛ koo dɩ ma lɩŋ.

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Ama a tɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa tɔlɔ tɔlɔ, a bɩ lɩŋ a bɩra bɩ fɩɛla ma, mɩ jaŋ lusima ta mɩ niiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: Ma yie bigisi ma tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ ma kɛŋ kɩaa nɛ, ma bɩra bɩ kʋŋkala ka chɛ. Ama ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ ma wɩɩŋ kɛŋ hɛɛŋ nɛ, ma ŋaa nisusu tɩmma, a ŋaa summo, a ŋaa nyʋlɩma aŋ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree.

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ bʋlaa pɩma dɩ ma yɔɔ sɛlɩmɛ-la ba sɩ chɛsɛ mɩ teeŋ, a ma wuo kɛŋ kɩaa, a yɔɔ gɛrɩ-pʋllʋŋ ma a laala tɔ ma yarɩ-biree, dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ sí ma kɛŋ. Má yɔɔ nʋʋŋ ma a hɛ ma sɩaa a wuo nɩna.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Dɩ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ cho nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ chei, mɩ yie dagɛba nɛ a kɛmba bil wombiiŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a bɩrɩma lɩɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Má bee-na, mɩ chɩŋ boiŋ niiŋ nɛ aa ŋmoo boro. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ nɩɩ mɩ yikoro a kɛŋ boro suri, mɩ jaŋ kʋ jʋʋ ʋ teeŋ, dɩ la dɩ ʋ kala dii kɩaa.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ wuo yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ, mɩ jaŋ pʋ wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ pɛ hɔŋ mɩ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ arɩ mɩ ma sɩ yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ aŋ pɛ hɔŋ mɩ Nyɩmma kuoru kpasa nyuŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Dɩgɩlaa tɩŋŋaa, má wuoli ma dɩgɩlaa a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi lee-kala Esia tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala sɩ ŋaa harɩŋ, mɩ beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ a na dɩ Wɩa-jaŋ boro suro. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ yikoro-la fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ a nagɛ ba sɩɩ ŋmʋʋ nyile, dɩ ʋ sɩ, “Kʋ jɩl daha dɩ mɩ dagɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa deemba harɩŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ guu kʋ jʋʋmɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ a na kuoru kpasa dɩ ʋ chɩŋ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ, ka nʋʋ hɔŋ ʋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɔŋ kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ tʋtʋl a nagɛ tabɩɩŋ sɩɩ tʋl a nagɛ jɩnalɩa, arɩ tabɩɩŋ sɩ fɩɛsa a nagɛ chalɩŋ. Ka duoŋ-sɩa golli kuoru kpasa-la chu. Duoŋ-sɩa-la fa nagɛ tabɩɩŋ sɩ nagɛ jɔgɩlɩɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na kuoru kpasɩnɩŋ mara arɩ banɛsɛ ma dɩ ba chɩna golli kuoru kpasa-la. Nɩhɩasɩŋ mara arɩ banɛsɛ hɔŋ ba nyuŋ a laalɛ gɛrɩ-pʋllʋŋ, a chu sɛlɩmɛ kuori-nyunchuuluŋ.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ taŋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ aŋ pɛ kpɩkpɩa kuoru kpasa-la leriŋ. Ka chaanaa balɩpɛ ma chɩŋ kuoru kpasa-la sɩpaaŋ a didii. Chaanɩa-la nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Dɩnsɩŋ balɩpɛ-la.

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: Kuori-kpasa-la sɩpaaŋ, kʋŋ pɩŋ a nagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ a tʋtʋl pal pal, a pʋlla nagɛ duoŋ-tabɩɩŋ. Ka kɩaa banɛsɛ sɩ weye golli kuoru kpasa-la chu a kɛŋ sɩɩ-kɛnɛɛ, sɩpaaŋ arɩ harɩŋ kala.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ banɛsɛ-la dɔŋɔ nagɛ naachigiŋ, dɔŋɔ ma nagɛ nɛ-bele, dɔŋɔ ma sɩaa nagɛ nuhuobiine, dɔŋɔ ma nagɛ kachuuŋ sɩɩ fil.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ balɩdʋ balɩdʋ nɛ, sɩaa ma hɛ ba lee-kala arɩ ba kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ ma kala. Tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala ba yie yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa, ba bɩ tɔrɛ, a bʋbʋl: “Ŋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ŋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, ŋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ŋ nɛ Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ faafaa kala, arɩ Nɩɩ-la ha sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, arɩ Nɩɩ-la ha sɩ jaŋ kɔ.”

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Bʋa na-kala dɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ weye nɛ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɛnnɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɔŋ kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ, Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu,

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: “La Tɩɩna Wɩa, ʋ maga dɩ la chʋɔlʋŋ, ʋ maga dɩ la dɛnnɩŋ a yɩyɩrɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ, ŋ nɛ doluŋ Tɩɩna. Ŋ nɛ ta kʋŋkala, ŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ taba ba hɛ nɩmɛ.”

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka mɩ na dɩ Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɔŋ kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ, dɩ ʋ kori teŋ-chuoluŋ ʋ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ arɩ harɩŋ kala, aŋ kɛŋ kelliŋ balɩpɛ a mɛrɛ tɔ.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-duo kʋbala dɩ ʋ faasa heeli a bʋl, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo lɛrɛ kelli-la ba sɩ kaa mɛrɛ teŋ-la aŋ suri teŋ-la?”

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Ama nʋʋkala tuo Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ koo tinteeŋ lɛ, koo lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ lɛ sɩ jaŋ wuo suri teŋ-la koo a nyilimi ʋ tʋɔŋ.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ bɩ nʋʋkala na sɩ jaŋ wuo teŋ-la beŋ, mɩ faasa yel.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩhɩasɩ-la mara arɩ banɛsɛ-la dɔŋɔ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Sɩ́ yel, bee na nɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Juda nɩaa tʋɔŋ Naachigiŋ, ʋ lɩɩ Devit doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ, ʋ yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ nɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ lɛrɛ kɩalɩŋ balɩpɛ-la ba sɩ kaa mɛrɛ teŋ-la aŋ suru.”

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ a na Pie-bie dɩ ʋ chɩŋ kuoru kpasa-la arɩ kɩalɩŋ banɛsɛ-la sɩ weye arɩ nɩhɩasɩ-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ. Pie-bie-la fa naga ba sɩ kpʋa nɛ. Ʋ fa kɛŋ nyilliŋ balɩpɛ nɛ, sɩaa ma balɩpɛ. Sɩa-la balɩpɛ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Dɩnsɩŋ balɩpɛ-la Wɩa sɩ ta ba kʋ tuu dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pie-bie-la mʋ laa teŋ-la, nɩɩ-la sɩ hɔŋ kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩhɩasɩ-la arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ weye ta yɩɩl-falɩŋ aa yɩɩ, “Ŋ nɛ wuo laa teŋ-la ba sɩ mɛrɛ, a lɛrɛ kel-la ba sɩ kaa mɛrɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba kpʋŋ nɛ. Ba sɩ kpʋŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋ joŋ ŋ chalɩŋ a yɔɔ nuhuobiine mɩɩsɩŋ a pɩ Wɩa. Nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ yɔbɔ lɩɩ nɩdoho kala tʋɔŋ nɛ aa bʋl yikori doho kala a hɛ taŋ kala arɩ tintee kala lɛ.

english_verse: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
translation_verse: Ŋ leŋe nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ yɔbɔ, dii kuoruŋ nɛ a laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa. Ba jaŋ beŋ tinteeŋ kala.”

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ a na dɩ Wɩa tɩndaaraa bʋɩ bʋɩba bʋɩ golli kuoru kpasa-la arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ weye arɩ nɩhɩasɩ-la. Mɩ nɩa dɩ ba faa yɩɩ yɩɩl nɛ.

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: Yɩɩl-la ba fa sɩɩ yɩɩ arɩ yikori-balɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: “Pie-bie-la ba sɩ kpʋa nɛ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ nɩaa. Ʋ nɛ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ kɩaa, arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ, arɩ doluŋ kʋŋkala lɛ. Ʋ nɛ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ, dɩ nɩaa dɛnnʋ a chʋɔlʋ.”

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka mɩ nɩɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ, arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ, arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, arɩ kʋŋ na-kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ dɩ baa yɩɩ yɩɩlaa aa bʋl, “Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɔŋ kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ arɩ Pie-bie-la, ba nɛ maga la dɛnnɛ, a zilba a yɩrɛ ba yɩrɩŋ. Ba nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kɩalɩŋ banɛsɛ-la sɩ weye bʋl, “Amɩɩ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩhɩasɩ-la tuu kpirimi a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na dɩ Pie-bie-la kɛŋ kelli-la ba fa sɩ kaa mɛrɛ teŋ-la dɔŋɔ lɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ weye banɛsɛ-la dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ faasa yɩrɛ. Ʋ yikoro nagɛ duonuŋ sɩɩ kpɩa a bʋl, “Kɔ.”

english_verse: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bee na ja-pʋla dɩ nʋʋ hɔŋ ʋ nyuŋ a kori toŋ. Ba joŋ kuori-nyunchuul-la pʋ. Ʋ jɩl jɔɔ-la lɩɩ a yuo laalɩŋ dii lee-kala.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pie-bie-la bɩra kɛŋ kelli-la ba sɩ kaa mɛrɛ teŋ-la kʋlɩamɩŋ kaa lɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra nɩɩ dɩ kɩalɩŋ banɛsɛ-la sɩ weye lɩamɩŋ tɩɩna bɩra yɩrɛmɛ a bʋl, “Kɔ.”

english_verse: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bee a na jaaba dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ kʋ lɩɩ. Jɔɔ-la ŋaa ja-fɩaŋ nɛ a faasa fɩɛsɛ, ka nʋʋ hɔŋ ʋ nyuŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɩ tɩɩna wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ yuosuŋ kaa kɔ dʋnɩa, dɩ nɩaa yuyuo dɔŋɔ a kpʋkpʋ dɔŋɔ. Ba joŋ tokobii-bal nɛ a hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
translation_verse: Pie-bie-la bɩra kɛŋ kelli-la ba sɩ kaa mɛrɛ teŋ-la ku-torimuŋ kaa lɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ weye, tori tɩɩna yɩrɛmɛ a bʋl, “Kɔ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na ja-bine dɩ nʋʋ hɔŋ ʋ nyuŋ a kori kʋmagɩsɩrɩ kʋa ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ yikoro sɩ nagɛ nʋʋ yikoro. Yikoro-la lɩɩ kɩalɩŋ banɛsɛ-la sɩ weye tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩna bʋl, “Ba jaŋ yallɛ folii-mɩaa gbaŋa kʋbala, a yi chɛ-bala tɩntɩnna sɩ yie laa ʋ time magɛ ŋɩɩ, ka dɩ mɩaa gbansɩŋ batori ma yi chɛ-bala tɩntɩnna time. Ama sɩ́ olif tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ chei.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pie-bie-la bɩra kɛŋ kelli-la ba sɩ kaa mɛrɛ teŋ-la nɛsɩmɩŋ tɩɩna kaa lɛrɛ. Kɩalɩŋ banɛsɛ-la sɩ weye nɛsɩmɩŋ tɩɩna yɩrɛmɛ a bʋl, “Kɔ.”

english_verse: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ a na jaaba dɩ nʋʋ hɔŋ ʋ nyuŋ. Jɔɔ-la fa ŋaa kʋbʋgʋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɔŋ ʋ nyuŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ sʋʋŋ, ka lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ tuto ʋ harɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa pɩba doluŋ dɩ ba kpʋ nuhuobiinee kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa sɛsɩ-la banɛsɛ dɔŋɔ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ tokobii-la a kpʋ dɔnsʋŋ, dɩ losuŋ ma kpʋ dɔnsʋŋ, ka dɩ nyanyalaa arɩ baga kɩaa ma kpʋ dɔnsʋŋ.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Pie-bie-la sɩ kɛŋ kelli-la ba sɩ kaa mɛrɛ teŋ-la nɔŋ tɩɩna kaa lɛrɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bee na nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa dɩnsɩŋ dɩ ba hɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ bʋbʋɔŋ. Nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa faa bʋl Wɩa wɩaa nɛ a fa ŋaa La Tɩɩna Kirisito pɛ-naaraa ma, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba kpʋba.

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋmoo niiŋ vɩl vɩl aa bʋl, “La Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, ŋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ Tɩɩna nɛ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, bʋa bɛɛ lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya, aŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kpʋla?”

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa joŋ gɛrɩ-pʋl-duduoŋ a pɩ ba kʋŋkala aŋ bʋla pɩba dɩ ba gbɛrɛ a wiesi mʋapɩlɩɩ, see dɩ ba kpʋ ba tɩntɩnnɩ dɔnsʋŋ arɩ ba naambiiri-la dɔnsʋŋ a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ.

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: Pie-bie-la sɩ kɛŋ kelli-la ba sɩ kaa mɛrɛ teŋ-la dʋmʋŋ tɩɩna kaa lɛrɛ, mɩ bee na dɩ tinteeŋ faasa zigili. Ŋɩɩ nɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ kala biri lim a nagɛ chɛŋ-birimiŋ, chɛŋ-pʋla ma fɩɛsɛ a nagɛ chalɩŋ.

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: Ka chɛnwʋlaa lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a kʋ tuu tinteeŋ, a nagɛ pel-duoŋ sɩ luo a ŋaa tutogi-nambil-huoruŋ yuori ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ wɩa-nyuŋ kala chuolo kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a nagɛ ba sɩ chuoli bɔsɔ ŋɩɩ. Peel-na kala arɩ lee-na kala lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu, ba kala sii ba leree.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ dʋnɩa kuoroo, arɩ nɩbalaa, arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ, arɩ nʋʋkala, yosuŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ tɩɩ ba tɩtɩa, ba kala fá jʋʋ faa bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ arɩ peel-pɛgɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba yɩyɩrɛ peele-la arɩ bʋsʋ-la a bʋl, “Má tele tɔla dɩ Pie-bie-la arɩ Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɔŋ kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ sɩ́ la na, dɩ baaŋ-la Pie-bie-la sɩ na la nyuŋ sɩ́ la yi.

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: Tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa arɩ Pie-bie-la sɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa nyuŋ yie nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa jaŋ wuo chɩŋ ba sɩpaaŋ?”

english_verse: After this I saw four angels. Each one was standing on one of the earth's four corners. The angels held back the four winds, so that no wind would blow on the earth or on the sea or on any tree. These angels had also been given the power to harm the earth and the sea. Then I saw another angel come up from where the sun rises in the east, and he was ready to put the mark of the living God on people. He shouted to the four angels,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka mɩ na Wɩa tɩndaara dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ to wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ aa jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ, a kori kʋ-la Wɩa sɩ weye sɩ kaa magɩlɛ ʋ nɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ faasa yɩrɛ Wɩa tɩndaara-la banɛsɛ Wɩa fa sɩ pa doluŋ dɩ ba chei tinteeŋ arɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ.

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ Wɩa tɩndaaraa banɛsɛ-la, “Má sɩ́ tinteeŋ koo mʋgʋ-balɩŋ koo tɩɩsɩŋ chei, see dɩ la magɩlɛ la Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa ba tilliŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
translation_verse: a bʋl, “Amɩɩ. La jaŋ dɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa a yɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ, aa lɔllʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ doluŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ.”

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
translation_verse: Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ mɩ beŋ a na nɩ-dandaŋ, nʋʋ bɩ ba wuo dɩɩsɛ, sɩ lɩɩ tintee-dosunuŋ, do-yiriba arɩ nɩdosunuŋ sɩɩ bʋl yikori-wogusuŋ. Mɩ na dɩ ba chɩŋ kuoru kpasa-la arɩ Pie-bie-la sɩpaaŋ a laalɛ gɛrɩ-pʋl-duduosuŋ, a kori abɛ pɩpaarɩŋ ba nɩsaa lɛ.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Nɩ-daŋ-la faasa ŋaa goŋ aa bʋl, “La Wɩa sɩ hɔŋ kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ arɩ Pie-bie-la, ba nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ba laala ta.”

english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Ka Wɩa tɩndaaraa kala chɩna golli kuoru kpasa-la arɩ nɩhɩasɩ-la arɩ kɩalɩŋ banɛsɛ-la sɩ weye. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaara-la tuu kpirimi kuoru kpasa-la sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩhɩasɩ-la dɔŋɔ pɩɛsɛmɛ a bʋl, “Kʋbɛɛba nɛ laalɛ gɛrɩ-pʋl-duduosuŋ ŋɩɩ, nɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩ?”

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
