translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ nɛ jɩma, mɩ kʋhɩaŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nɩaa deemba nɛ Wɩa lɩɩsɛ hɛɛ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. Ba chɛsɛ ba gɛnnɩŋ Pie-bie-la chalɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ba lɩɩ a pʋllɛ.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba chɩŋ Wɩa kuoru kpasa-la sɩpaaŋ a tɩma pʋpʋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala ŋɩɩ ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɔŋ kuoru kpasa-la lɛ nɛ jaŋ chu tɔ ba.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Losuŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛmba, lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ ma bɩ jaŋ kɛmba, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ ma bɩ jaŋ kpʋba, wulumuŋ ma bɩ jaŋ kɛmba.

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: Wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ ŋaaba, bɛɛ wɩaa Pie-bie-la sɩ chɩŋ Wɩa kuoru kpasa-la sɩpaaŋ nɛ jaŋ bibeŋ ba nyuŋ, a nagɛ pie-daara. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ kɛmba kaa mʋ lɩɩ-bulo leriŋ, lɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ. Wɩa ma jaŋ fɩɩsɛ sɩ-lɩɩrɩ kala sɩ hɛ ba sɩaa lɛ ta.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Pie-bie-la lɛrɛ kelli-la ba sɩ kaa mɛrɛ teŋ-la pɛɩ tɩɩna. Ʋ sɩ suro dɛrɛ, Wɩa-jaŋ kala ŋaa fʋɩɩ a yi hawa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ ka mɩ na Wɩa tɩndaaraa balɩpɛ-la sɩ yie chɩŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Ba pɩba nyilliŋ balɩpɛ.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaara dɔŋɔ ma kʋ chɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koruŋ sɛmɛ a kori sɛlɩmɛ kʋ-la lɛ ba sɩ yie joŋ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ hɛ, a nyɩga pɩ Wɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pʋ kʋsʋɔrʋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ yʋgɛ, dɩ ʋ nyɩga pɩ Wɩa a pɛ Wɩa nɩaa Wɩɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ nyɩgɛba sɛlɩmɛ koru-la nyuŋ, kʋ-la sɩ chɩŋ kuoru kpasa-la sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋ-la nyʋɔsʋŋ arɩ Wɩa nɩaa Wɩɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ lɩɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ a mʋ Wɩa teeŋ.

english_verse: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook. The Trumpets
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la joŋ sɛlɩmɛ kʋ-la a chaanɛ nyiniŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ, a hɛ kʋ-la tʋɔŋ, a joŋo yuo ʋ kʋ tuu tinteeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ duonuŋ kpɩkpɩa aŋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ, ka tinteeŋ zizigili. Wɩa tɩndaaraa ŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ

english_verse: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa balɩpɛ-la sɩ kɛŋ banyilliŋ balɩpɛ-la kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa dɩ ba ŋmʋʋ.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-bumbuŋ ŋmʋʋ ʋ nyile. Ŋɩɩ nɛ duoŋ-tabɩaa arɩ nyiniŋ guoli chalɩŋ lɛ kʋ tuu tel tinteeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tinteeŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ kaa kpaa batori, sɛmpɛɛŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ yasɩŋ kala dii nyiniŋ.

english_verse: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-lɩamɩŋ ma ŋmʋʋ ʋ nyile. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba joŋ kʋŋ sɩ nagɛ peel-balɩŋ sɩɩ dii nyiniŋ a yuo hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ. Mʋgʋ-bal-la, dɩ ŋ nɛ kaa kpaa batori, sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ kala bɩrɩmɛ chalɩŋ,

english_verse: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
translation_verse: kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a hɛ mʋgʋ-bal-la sɛmɛ-la kala sʋʋ. Lɩɩŋ daborusu-la ma sɩ hɛ lee-la chei.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-tori-la ma ŋmʋʋ ʋ nyile. Ʋ sɩ ŋmʋʋ ŋɩɩ, chɛnwʋl-bal kʋbala lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ, a chaanɛ a nagɛ kapɩlɩŋ-nyiniŋ, a kʋ tuu tel fuonuŋ arɩ lɩɩ-bulluŋ sɩ kpaa sɛsɩŋ batori sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Chɛnwʋl-la yɩrɩŋ nɛ kʋhaaŋ. Ʋ sɩ hɛyɛ ŋɩɩ, lɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ ʋ sɩ tele ma hɛɩ. Lɩɩ-la sɩ hɛyɛ ŋɩɩ, nɩ-daŋ-la sɩ nyʋa lɩɩ-haa-la, ba sʋʋ.

english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-nɛsɛ-la ma ŋmʋʋ ʋ nyile. Ʋ sɩ ŋmʋʋ ŋɩɩ, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ kaa kpaa butori, sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ biri, chɛnɛ ma dɩ ŋ nɛ kaa kpaa butori, sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ biri, chɛnwʋlaa ma, dɩ ŋ nɛ kaa kpaa butori, sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ biri. Wɩɩhɛyɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ ma kpaa butori sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ biri.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ a na kachuuŋ dɩ ʋʋ fil wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii, mɩ nɩɩ dɩ ʋ faasa yiyel, aa bʋl, “Wɩɩŋ puuma, wɩɩŋ puuma, wɩɩŋ puu ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ, a tɩŋ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-kaana-la batori sɩ jaŋ ŋmʋʋ nyilli-la wɩaa.”

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-nɔŋ-la ma ŋmʋʋ ʋ nyile. Ʋ sɩ ŋmʋʋ ŋɩɩ, mɩ na chɛnwʋlʋŋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a kʋ tuu tel tinteeŋ. Ba joŋ buotuo luŋuŋ boribiiŋ pʋ.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ suri buotuo-luŋii-la boro, nyʋɔsʋŋ lɩɩ buotuo-luŋii-la tʋɔŋ a nagɛ nyiŋ-balɩŋ nyʋɔsʋŋ, a tɔ pʋlʋmʋŋ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ kala ba biri.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ hɔbɔ to nyʋɔsʋ-la tʋɔŋ a kʋ tuu tinteeŋ. Wɩa pɩba doluŋ ba kɛŋ huoŋ a nagɛ nʋɔmaa.

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: Wɩa bʋla pɩba dɩ ba sɩ́ yaŋ dii koo tɩɩsɩŋ koo kɩalɩŋ sɩ nyʋ tinteeŋ lɛ, ama dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ́ bɩ Wɩa magɩlɩŋ kɛnɛ ba tilliŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: Wɩa bɩ hɔbɔ-la wombiiŋ pa dɩ ba kpʋ nɩaa deemba, ama dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛba chɛnsɩŋ banɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba dɔgɩsɛba a nagɛ nʋɔmʋŋ sɩ yie dɩŋ nɩa ʋ wʋwɩɩ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ nɩaa jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ba sʋʋ, ama ba bɩ wuo sʋʋ.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Hɔbɔ-la fa nagɛ janɩŋ nɛ ba sɩ kpɩɛra dɩ ba kaa mʋ laalɩŋ. Ba chu kɩaa sɩ nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ nyunchuuluŋ nɛ. Ba sɩaa ma nagɛ nuhuobiinee sɩaa.

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ nyu-pʋnaa ma nɛ. Ba duomo a nagɛ haala nyu-pʋnaa. Ba nyɩlaa ma nagɛ naachigee nyɩlaa.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: Ba yaraa horuŋ nagɛ hɔɔŋ ba sɩ yie joŋo tɔ bɔyɛ a kaa yuo laalɩŋ nɛ. Ba kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ ma ŋɩŋaa goŋ, a nagɛ janɩŋ sɩ yʋga a lɛrɛ torukoba a fá mʋmʋ laalɩŋ.

english_verse: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.
translation_verse: Ba fa kɛŋ bʋbʋɔ-dosuŋ nɛ arɩ fɩllɩŋ a nagɛ nʋɔmʋŋ kɩaa. Dol-la kala ba fa sɩ kɛnɛ dɩ ba kaa dɔgɩsɛ nɩaa chɛnsɩŋ banɔŋ-la kala fa hɛ ba bʋbʋɔ-dosu-la lɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la fa sɩ kori buotuo-luŋii-la boribiiŋ nɛ fa ŋaa ba kuoro. Juu tɩŋŋaa yikoro lɛ baa yɩrʋ Abadɔŋ nɛ. Giriik tɩŋŋaa ma yikoro lɛ baa yɩrʋ Apɔlɩyɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Bumbuŋ hɛɛ-la ba sɩ jaŋ na nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ama kɩaa balɩa nɛ ha ka.

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-dʋ-la ŋmʋʋ ʋ nyile. Ʋ sɩ ŋmʋʋ ŋɩɩ, mɩ nɩɩ nʋʋ yikoro dɩ ʋ lɩɩ sɛlɩmɛ koru-la sɩ chɩŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ gʋnaa banɛsɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ yikoro-la bʋla pɩ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-dʋ-la sɩ kori nyile-la, “Puri Wɩa tɩndaaraa banɛsɛ-la ba sɩ vɔbɔ Yufireti fuo-la lɛ a ta.”

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba puri Wɩa tɩndaara-la. Wɩa fa vɔbɔ a bil a gbɛrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la arɩ chɛnɛ-la arɩ jɩna-la ʋ fa sɩɩ chɛ ʋ kpʋ dʋnɩa nɩaa, ba sɩ kaa kpaa butori sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: By listening, I could tell there were more than
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba dagɛ laalɩyuoro-la sɩ jɩl janɩŋ niiŋ pɩmɛ. Ba fa ŋaa bʋɩ bʋɩ bʋɩba zɔɔ-balɩa nɛ.

english_verse: In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ na laalɩyuoro-la sɩ jɩl ba janɩŋ mɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ, ŋ-la nɛ ba nagɛ: Ba bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ gɛnnɩŋ ba sɩ yie joŋo tɔ bɔɩsɩŋ a kaa yuo laalɩŋ, ba dɔnsʋŋ faasa fɩɛsɛ nɛ, dɔnsʋŋ nagɛ diibelimbine pʋnaa, dɔnsʋŋ ma nagɛ jiribiiŋ. Janɩ-la nyusuŋ nagɛ naachigee nyusuŋ, ka nyiniŋ arɩ nyʋɔsʋŋ arɩ jiribiiŋ lɩlɩɩ ba niiriŋ lɛ.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Kɩaa deemba batori nɛ Wɩa leŋ ba kʋ kpʋ dʋnɩa nɩaa, dɩ ŋ nɛ kaa kpaa butori sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ: Nyiniŋ, nyʋɔsʋŋ arɩ jiribiiŋ-la sɩɩ lɩɩ janɩ-la niiriŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
translation_verse: Janɩ-la doluŋ kala fa hɛ ba niiriŋ arɩ ba bʋbʋɔ-dosuŋ lɛ nɛ. Ba bʋbʋɔ-dosu-la nagɛ dɩŋŋaa nɛ a kɛŋ nyusuŋ, ba kaa pɩpɩrɛ nɩaa.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩkaana-la nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ deemba sɩ bɩ kpʋa, ba ma ha bɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ. Ba haa to Sɩtaanɩ nɛ a kpʋkpaarɛ vʋɩyaa. Sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔɔŋ arɩ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ ba kaa mɛ vʋɩya-la dɔnsʋŋ, dɔnsʋŋ ma ŋaa tabɩaa, dɔnsʋŋ ma ŋaa tɩɩsɩŋ. Vʋɩya-la bɩ na, ba bɩ wɩaa maa nɩɩ, ba bɩra bɩ wuo vɩvɛŋ ma.

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba fa bɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ nɩaa kpʋnʋŋ lɛ, ba hɩl wɩaa lɛ, ba wʋlɩɩlɩŋ arɩ ba gaarɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka mɩ bɩra na Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-duo kʋbala dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a kʋʋ tuu. Duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tɔʋ kala, ka duoŋ-sɩa chugili ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. Ʋ sɩaa tʋtʋl a nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ. Ʋ naasɩŋ ma nagɛ jebiee sɩɩ dii nyiniŋ.

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: Ka ʋ kori teŋ-chuoli-bie ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba sɩ kaa polli. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ ʋ nadiiŋ naaŋ a daŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nyuŋ, a joŋ ʋ nagʋa naaŋ ma a bil tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ faasa kpɩa goŋ a nagɛ naachigiŋ sɩ huoso. Ʋ sɩ kpɩa goŋ ŋɩɩ, duonuŋ ma laa kpɩa naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Bʋa-la lɛ duonuŋ sɩ kpɩa, mɩ faa chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ bil. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋ yikoro lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a bʋla pɩmɛ, “Leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ duonuŋ sɩ kpɩa bʋl hɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ, sɩ́ ŋmʋnsa bil.”

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka mɩ na Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la, nɩɩ-la naaŋ dɔŋɔ sɩ chɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nyuŋ, ka dɔŋɔ ma chɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ kaa yɩa Wɩa-jaŋ.

english_verse: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋmɩɛsɛ Wɩa, Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, nɩɩ-la sɩ ta wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, arɩ tinteeŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, arɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ, arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ sɩ, “Bʋa-la yie nɛ, la bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ wɩɩkala dieni.”

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: Ama tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-pɛɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kʋ ŋmʋʋ ʋ nyile, Wɩa wʋfaalɩa-la ʋ fa sɩ dagɛ ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnaa, ba kala jaŋ ŋaa.

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra nɩɩ yikoro-la tɩtɩa sɩ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a bʋl wɩaa pɩmɛ. Ʋ sɩ, “Mʋ a laa teŋ-bie-la ba sɩ suro, Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ, nɩɩ-la naaŋ dɔŋɔ sɩ chɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nyuŋ, ka dɔŋɔ ma chɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mʋ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la teeŋ a bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ joŋ teŋ-bie-la pɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Laa teŋ-bie-la a joŋo chaŋ. Ʋ jaŋ sɩŋ ŋ niiŋ lɛ a nagɛ tʋʋŋ, ama ŋ luoruŋ lɛ ʋ jaŋ hɛɩ.”

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ laa teŋ-bie-la Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ a joŋo chaŋ. Ʋ sɩma nagɛ tʋʋŋ nɛ mɩ niiŋ lɛ, ama ʋ sɩ tuu mɩ luoruŋ, mɩ fehe nyala nɛ.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩmɛ, “Ŋ jaŋ bɩra bʋl wɩaa, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ a tɩgɛ nɩ-daŋ, tintee daŋ yikori daŋ arɩ kuori daŋ lɛ.”

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: ama sɩ́ Wɩa dɩa-la kaala-na magɩsʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba joŋ lee-la pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɛ, ba jaŋ fɩrɩgɛ tabal-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ chɛnsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ balɩa.

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Wɩa pɛ-naara-la balɩa nɛ ŋaa Olif tɩɩsɩ-la balɩa arɩ chaaŋ daasɩ-la balɩa sɩ chɩŋ La Tɩɩna sɩpaaŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ tinteeŋ.

english_verse: Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaaba wʋbɔŋ, nyiniŋ yie lɩɩ ba niiŋ lɛ nɛ a dii ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala. Nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ ŋaaba wʋbɔŋ, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ yie sʋʋ.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Wɩa pɩba doluŋ dɩ ba wuo kiri duonuŋ, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ nɩɩ tapʋlɩa-la ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba bʋl Wɩa wɩaa lɛ. Wɩa bɩra pɩba doluŋ dɩ ba wuo ŋaa dɩ lɩɩŋ bɩrɩmɛ chalɩŋ. Ba jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ nyanyalaa jʋʋ dʋnɩa nɩaa, bʋa na-kala lɛ ba sɩ cho.

english_verse: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ bʋl Wɩa wɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ, baga kʋŋ jaŋ lɩɩ buotuo-luŋii-la tʋɔŋ kʋ lɩɩ yuo diiba, a kpʋba.

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ jaŋ pɩŋ tabal-la womporuŋ lɛ, lee-la ba sɩ kpaasɛ ba Tɩɩna daagɛsɛ nyuŋ. Tabal-la fa nagɛ Sodom koo Ijipiti tinteeŋ nɛ.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Nɩaa sɩ lɩɩ doho kala, a bʋbʋl yikori doho kala a lɩɩ tintee kala jaŋ beŋ ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ tapʋlaa batori arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ. Ba bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ dɩ ba paaba hugi.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ arɩ ba sɩ kpʋ ba balɩa-la. Ba jaŋ gbieli a ŋaa kɩaa didii zile dɔŋɔ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la balɩa fa walɩmɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Ama tapʋlaa batori arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la harɩŋ lɛ, Wɩa joŋ wiese hɛ nɩaa deemba balɩamɩŋ lɛ, ba sii chɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ naba, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba woruŋ.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba nɩɩ nʋʋ yikoro dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Má kʋ jɩl daha.” Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, ba to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ lɛ a jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ. Ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ bibemba, ka ba jɩjɩl.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ tinteeŋ faasa zigili. Tabal-la, dɩ ŋ nɛ kaa kpaa leree fii, sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ kala tel a kpʋ nɩaa bʋɩ balɩpɛ. Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ nɩkaanaa, ba dɛnnɛ Wɩa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Hɛɛ-lɩa-la dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, ama torimuŋ jaŋ kɔ lɛɛlɛ. Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-pɛɩ-la ŋmʋʋ ʋ nyile

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-pɛɩ-la ŋmʋʋ ʋ nyile. Mɩ nɩɩ yikori-balaa dɩ baa bʋl wɩaa, Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. Ba sɩ, “Dʋnɩa kuorii-la lɛɛlɛ ŋaa La Tɩɩna Wɩa arɩ Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa kʋa nɛ. Wɩa jaŋ dii kuoruŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: “Laa lɔllʋŋ La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ faafaa arɩ Nɩɩ-la ha sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ. Lɛɛlɛ-na ŋ kɛŋ ŋ dol-bal-la, a suomo bibeŋ dʋnɩa nɛ.

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa fa na baanɩŋ nɛ ŋ nyuŋ. Ama bʋa-la ŋ baanɩŋ sɩ jaŋ sii ba nyuŋ yie nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ jaŋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba sarɩya yie nɛ, arɩ bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ jaŋ siili ŋ tɩntɩnnaa sɩ ŋaa ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa, a pɛ ŋ nɩaa kala lɛ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ziliŋ lɛ, nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ hambiisiŋ kala, Bʋa-la yie nɛ dɩ ŋ chei nɩalɩŋ sɩ chei dʋnɩa.”

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ boro suri, mɩ na Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la ʋ tʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ duonuŋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ leriŋ kala, ba nɩnɩɩ yikorusuŋ, ka duonuŋ kpɩkpɩa ŋmana ŋmana, tinteeŋ zigili, ka duoŋ-tabɩaa faasa titel.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: Haal-la fa kɛŋ luoruŋ nɛ. Ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ, ʋ faasa yiyel a wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ʋ lʋl.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kʋkpuŋkpere dɔŋɔ ma kʋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ. Kʋkpuŋkpere deeŋ fa nagɛ dɩmɩŋ sɩ yʋga kieli nɛ a kala fɩɛsɛ a nagɛ chalɩŋ. Dɩŋ-la fa kɛŋ nyusuŋ balɩpɛ nɛ arɩ nyilliŋ fii, a chu kuori nyunchuuluŋ balɩpɛ.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔ-doho gbaa chɛnwʋlaa, dɩ ŋ nɛ kaa kpaa leree batori sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ kʋ tuu tel tinteeŋ. Aŋ ka dɩŋ-la mʋ chɩŋ haal-la fa sɩɩ walɩmɛ dɩ ʋ lʋl sɩpaaŋ a gbɛrɛ, dɩ haal-la nɛ lʋla, dɩ ʋ guu joŋ bile liŋ.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la lʋl hambolibie, nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ beŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala arɩ hɔɔŋ dantɩga. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa joŋ bile kaa mʋ ʋ teeŋ a leŋ ʋ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ,

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: aŋ ka haal-la fá jʋʋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ, lee-la Wɩa sɩ wasa bil ʋ lɛ. Wɩa pʋ kʋdiilee nɩmɛ tapʋlaa bʋɩ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ batori.

english_verse: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ lɛ laalɩŋ sii Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-hɩaŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Maakɩl arɩ tɩndaaraa dɔnsʋŋ suomi a yuyuo dɩŋ-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩŋ-la arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo maa yuo.

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: Ama Maakɩl nɩaa yuo dii dɩŋ-la arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo. Dɩŋ-la arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo bɩra bɩ dɩ-hɔnɩɩ kala kɛnɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ dɩŋ-la arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo a yuo ta ba lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a kʋ tuu tinteeŋ. Dɩŋ-la fa hɛ nɩmɛ faafaa kala nɛ a lɩɩ dʋnɩa dɩ-suomuŋ. Ʋ nɛ baa yɩrɛ Sɩtaanɩ, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ nyɩsɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa ba yeŋŋi.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka mɩ nɩɩ yikori-bal kʋbala dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a bʋl, “Lɛɛlɛ Wɩa dagɛ dol-la ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ laa ʋ nɩaa ta nɛ. Ʋ dagɛ ʋ doluŋ arɩ ʋ kuoruŋ nɛ, arɩ dol-la Kirisito sɩ kɛnɛ, Nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ la naambiiriŋ, ba joŋu yuo ta nɛ ʋ kʋ tuu tinteeŋ. Ʋ fa joŋ cheeriŋ pɩba Wɩa sɩpaaŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala nɛ.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Ba yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ a tɩŋ Pie-bie-la chalɩŋ wɩaa nɛ, arɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ ba fa sɩ bʋla pɩpɩ nɩaa. Ba fa kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa dɩ ba kpʋba a tɩŋ Wɩa wɩalɩŋ wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ, má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Ama ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ, ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Sɩtaanɩ kʋ tuu ma teeŋ nɛ, ʋ faasa na baanɩŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ jɩma arɩ ʋ bɩra bɩ dieni, ka dɩ ba laa ʋ doluŋ.”

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Dɩŋ-la sɩ na dɩ ba joŋu yuo ta, ʋ kʋ tuu tinteeŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kire to haal-la sɩ lʋl hambolibie-la harɩŋ.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa joŋ kachuu-balɩŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ pɩ haal-la, dɩ ʋ wuo fil a kagɛ dɩŋ-la lɛ a mʋ tinteeŋ, lee-la Wɩa sɩ wasa bil ʋ lɛ. Nɩmɛ nɛ Wɩa benu jɩsɩŋ batori arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ lɩɩŋ lɩɩ dɩŋ-la niiŋ lɛ a nagɛ fuoŋ, a kire to haal-la harɩŋ dɩ ʋ pɛllɛ joŋu.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Ama tintee-hɩlɩŋ kʋ pɛ haal-la lɛ a joŋ lɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ dɩŋ-la niiŋ lɛ kala a nyʋa.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩŋ-la na baanɩŋ haal-la nyuŋ a mʋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ haal-la biiriŋ dɔnsʋŋ a yuo laalɩŋ. Haal-la biiriŋ nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa a tutoba, a didii Yesu dansɩa, a bʋl ʋ wɩaa a pɩpɩ nɩaa.

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩŋ-la mʋ chɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na baga kʋŋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ a kʋʋ lɩɩ. Ʋ fa kɛŋ nyusuŋ balɩpɛ nɛ, ʋ nyilliŋ ma fii. Ʋ fa chu kuori-nyunchuuluŋ fii nɛ ʋ nyilliŋ fii-la lɛ. Yɩrɩ-la ʋ fa sɩ kɛnɛ ʋ nyusu-la lɛ faa tʋʋsɛ Wɩa joŋŋoo nɛ.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Baga kʋ-la mɩ sɩ na fa nagɛ kpeye nɛ, aŋ ka ʋ naasɩŋ nagɛ lugumuŋ kɩaa, ʋ niiŋ ma nagɛ naachigiŋ kʋa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ dɩŋ-la joŋ ʋ doluŋ kala arɩ ʋ kuoru kpasa-la a pɩ baga kʋ-la.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Baga kʋ-la nyusuŋ balɩpɛ-la dɔŋɔ fa kɛŋ naawɩɩl-bal nɛ sɩ faasa lɔrɛ woruŋ, ama ʋ fɩɛla nɛ. Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala sɩ na dɩ naawɩɩl-la fɩɛla, ʋ ŋaa ba wʋkpuŋkpere, ba sii to ʋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa chʋɔlɛ dɩŋ-la a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ joŋ ʋ doluŋ a pɩ baga kʋ-la wɩaa, aŋ chʋɔlɛ baga kʋ-la ma a bʋl, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a magɛ kʋa deeŋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo kɛnʋ yuo yuosuŋ?”

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: Ba pʋ wombiiŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ Wɩa nɩaa a yuo laalɩŋ, a yuo diiba. Ba fa pʋ doluŋ nɛ ʋ wuo doho kala, nɩaa kala, tinteyee kala arɩ nɩaa sɩɩ bʋl yikoro kala.

english_verse: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala yɩrɩŋ sɩ tuo mɩɩsɩŋ teŋ-la lɛ a lɩɩ dʋnɩa dɩ-suomuŋ, jaŋ dɛnnɛ baga kʋ-la. Pie-bie-la ba sɩ kpʋa nɛ tɩɩ teŋ-la.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: Dɩgɩlaa tɩŋŋaa, má wuoli ma dɩgɩlaa a jegile nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ.

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ maga dɩ ŋ mʋ yoŋ-baga, ŋ jaŋ sɛnɛ mʋ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ arɩ tokobiiŋ, ba jaŋ sɛnɛ kpʋʋ arɩ tokobiiŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ daga arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii maga dɩ ba nyalɩmɛ nɛ a chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii lɛ. Baga kʋ-la sɩ lɩɩ tinteeŋ kʋ lɩɩ

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra na baga kʋa dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ tinteeŋ a kuu lɩɩ. Ʋ fa nagɛ pie-bie nɛ a kɛŋ nyilliŋ balɩa. Ʋʋ bʋl wɩaa a nagɛ kʋ-la sɩ nagɛ dɩŋ-la nɛ.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Ʋ ma kɛŋ dol-la bumbuŋ baga kʋ-la fa sɩ kɛnɛ nɛ, a leŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala chʋɔlɛ bumbuŋ baga kʋ-la fa sɩ kɛŋ naawɩɩl-bal-la, ka ʋ fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: Baga kʋa deeŋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa yʋgɛ nɛ. Ʋ paala leŋ nyiniŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ tuu tinteeŋ, nʋʋkala na.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: A tɩŋ wʋmagɩla-la ba sɩ pʋ doluŋ ʋ ŋaa bumbuŋ baga kʋ-la nyuŋ, ʋ nyɩsɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa dɩ ba mɛ kʋŋ sɩ nagɛ bumbuŋ baga kʋ-la, kʋ-la ba sɩ pɩra arɩ tokobiiŋ ka ʋ ha wei.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: Ba pɩ baga kʋ-lɩa-la doluŋ dɩ ʋ wuo joŋ wiese hɛ kʋ-la ba sɩ mɛ lɛ dɩ ʋ wuo wɩaa bʋbʋl, dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ba kpʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ vɩa dɩ ba chʋɔlɛ baga kʋ-la ba sɩ mɛ.

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: Kʋ-la bɩra fʋgɛ nʋʋkala a magɩlɛba, ba tilliŋ lɛ koo ba nɩsaa lɛ, nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ hambiisiŋ, kuoroo arɩ summoo, nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩɩ ba tɩtɩa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa yosi.

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo yɔɔ kʋŋ, koo a yallɛ kʋŋ dɩ ŋ bɩ magɩlɩŋ deeŋ kɛnɛ, kʋ-la yɩrɩŋ koo ʋ yɩrɩ-la sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ, see dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ baga kʋa deeŋ magɩlɩŋ niiŋ kaa dɩɩsa na, magɩl-la ŋaa nʋʋ yɩrɩ nɛ. Magɩl-la nɛ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ balɩdʋ.

english_verse: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ dɔmɔ kʋbala Wɩa-jaŋ a nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩɩ pɛllʋ gbul gbul, a bɩra nagɛ duonuŋ sɩɩ kpɩa. Dɔmɔ-la fa bɩra nagɛ cheŋ-duuroo sɩɩ du chenniŋ nɛ.

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba chɩŋ kuoru kpasa-la arɩ nɩhɩasɩ-la, arɩ kɩalɩŋ banɛsɛ-la sɩ weye sɩpaaŋ nɛ aa yɩɩ yɩɩl-falɩɩ kʋbala. Nʋʋkala bɩ yɩɩl-la wuo gʋnnɛ, see nɩalɩŋ bʋɩ zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ banɛsɛ-la dʋndʋŋa. Nɩaa deemba nɛ Wɩa tʋɔsɛ dʋnɩa lɛ a laaba ta.

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Nɩaa deemba nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ ŋaa, a lɩɩsɛ ba tɩta disiŋ kala lɛ. Ba nɩɩ to Pie-bie-la harɩŋ lee-na kala ʋ sɩɩ mʋ. Ba nɛ Wɩa laa sɩpaaŋ lɩɩsɛ nuhuobiinee tʋɔŋ, dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa arɩ Pie-bie-la tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: Ba ha bɩ wɩaa nyɩɛ aŋ ka, ba bɩ cheeri kala kɛnɛ. Wɩa tɩndaaraa batori bʋl wɩaa

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra na Wɩa tɩndaara dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋʋ fil wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii. Ʋ fa kori Wɩa Wʋzɔmɔ-la nɛ, Wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ʋ kaa mʋ bʋla pɩ tintee kala nɩaa, doho kala nɩaa, yikoro kala nɩaa arɩ nɩaa kala.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bʋl arɩ yikori-balɩŋ, “Má fá Wɩa a dɛnnɛ ʋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya yie nɛ. Má dɛnnʋ, ʋ nɛ ta wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ arɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ arɩ lɩɩ-bulluŋ kala.”

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Ka Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-lɩa-la ma tuto a bʋl, “Babɩlɔŋ tele, Babɩlɔŋ tele, tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Babɩlɔŋ, ʋ tele. Ʋ nɛ joŋ ʋ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ a dagɛ tintee kala nɩaa. Wʋlɩɩlɩ-la nagɛ sɩ-duoŋ.”

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-tori ma tuto ba harɩŋ, a ma bʋl wɩaa arɩ yikori-balɩŋ. Ʋ sɩ, “Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ chʋɔlɛ baga kʋ-la arɩ ʋ nagɩsɩŋ ba sɩ mɛ bil, a laa magɩl-la ʋ tile lɛ koo ʋ nɩsaa lɛ,

english_verse: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
translation_verse: Wɩa jaŋ na baanɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ ʋ tɩɩna nyuŋ. Wɩa jaŋ faasa na baanɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ a dɔgɩsʋ woruŋ dɩ ʋ na hɛɛŋ a nagɛ nɩa sɩ nyʋa sɩ-duoŋ a bugi. Ba jaŋ joŋ jiribiiŋ nyiniŋ a dɔgɩsɛ tɩɩna. Ba jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Wɩa tɩndaara-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ arɩ Pie-bie-la sɩpaaŋ.

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: Nyiŋ-la jaŋ diiba deeŋ deeŋ, ʋ bɩ dɩsa. Nɩaa deemba bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba na wiese wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala. Nɩaa deemba sɩ chʋɔlɛ baga kʋ-la arɩ ʋ nagɩsɩŋ ba sɩ mɛ bil a laa ʋ yɩrɩŋ magɩl-la, ba bɩ jaŋ na wiese.”

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Bʋa deeŋ lɛ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Wɩa niiŋ a laa Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii, ʋ maga dɩ ba nyalɩmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Ka mɩ nɩɩ yikoro kʋbala dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a bʋl, “Ŋmʋnsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa dii aŋ sʋʋ, Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ a chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ kaa mʋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma bʋl, “Wɩa sɛnɛ jaŋ pɛ nɩaa deemba lɛ dɩ ba wuo na wiese woruŋ. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ tɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ba sɩ tɩma ka to ba harɩŋ nɛ.” Ba kɛŋ sɩɩkɔrɔ a kaa kʋŋ kɩaa

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra beŋ a na duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-pʋla, dɩ nʋʋ nagɛ nuhuobiine bie a hɔŋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la nyuŋ a chu sɛlɩmɛ kuoru nyunchuulo aŋ kori sɩɩkɔrɔ sɩ kɛŋ niiŋ woruŋ.

english_verse: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ hɔŋ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la nyuŋ kɛŋ ʋ sɩɩkɔrɔ-la viisi tinteeŋ a kʋŋ tinteeŋ kʋŋkala.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaara dɔŋɔ ma lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ a kʋ lɩɩ, a ma kori sɩɩkɔrɔ sɩ kɛŋ niiŋ nɛ woruŋ.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaara dɔŋɔ ma lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la koru-la sɛmɛ a kʋ lɩɩ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ kɛŋ nyiniŋ doluŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ kori sɩɩkɔrɔ-la arɩ yikori-balɩŋ a bʋl, “Kɛŋ ŋ sɩɩkɔrɔ-la a kaa keri tɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ girep jagɩsɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛnɛɛ bɩa nɛ.”

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la kɛŋ ʋ sɩɩkɔrɔ-la kaa viisi tinteeŋ a keri girep jagɩsɩ-la kala, a paa ba kala hɛ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ luo aa chagɛ tɩɩnɛnɛ-la lɩɩŋ, Wɩa baanɩŋ leriŋ.

english_verse: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
translation_verse: Tabal-la jeeŋ harɩŋ nɛ ba chagɛ tɩɩnɛnɛ-la. Ba sɩ chagɛba, lɩɩ-la kala lɩɩ a bɩrɩmɛ chalɩŋ, a tuu pɩpɛllɛ tinteeŋ a nagɛ fuoŋ, ʋ duomuŋ yi naakieli zɔɔ-balɩa, ʋ luŋuŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa.

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra na ku-kpuŋkperi-bal ma dɔŋ wɩa-nyuŋ. Ʋ kɛmmɛ fawʋllʋŋ. Mɩ na Wɩa tɩndaaraa balɩpɛ dɩ ba kori nyanyal-bɔŋ dosunuŋ balɩpɛ sɩ ŋaa dɩdɛrɩŋ kɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa dɩ ba nɛ kʋ ŋaa dɛrɛ, Wɩa baanɩŋ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ.

english_verse: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na kʋŋ sɩ nagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ a tʋtʋl pal pal aŋ pɛ chuchol nyiniŋ. Ka mɩ na nɩalɩŋ sɩ yuo dii baga kʋ-la arɩ ʋ nagɩsɩŋ ba sɩ mɛ bil, arɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ magɩlɩŋ, dɩ ba chɩŋ mʋgʋ-bal-la sɛmɛ. Ba fa kori chenniŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩba nɛ,

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: a yɩyɩɩ Wɩa tɩntɩnna Mosis yɩɩlɩŋ arɩ Pie-bie-la yɩɩlɩŋ. Yɩɩla-la ba sɩ yɩa nɛ ŋ-la: “La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ arɩ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ nɛ ŋ tɩtɩŋ. Ŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ. Ŋ nɛ kuoro a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Wɩa, kʋbɛɛ nɛ bɩ jaŋ fáŋ, aŋ dɛnnɛ ŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ? Ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ kʋ chʋɔlʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa nʋʋkala na nɛ.”

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Mɩ sɩ nɩɩ yɩɩla-la dɛrɛ, mɩ na Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ, dɩ ʋ suro.

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa balɩpɛ-la sɩ kori nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ balɩpɛ-la lɩɩ nɩmɛ kʋ lɩɩ. Ba laalɛ gɛrɩ-fʋfʋlaa sɩɩ tʋl a zɔŋ woruŋ, a joŋ sɛlɩmɛ damɛrɩsɩŋ a vɔɔ ba bɔɩsɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ kɩalɩŋ banɛsɛ-la sɩ weye dɔŋɔ joŋ sɛlɩmɛ gbansɩŋ balɩpɛ a pɩ Wɩa tɩndaaraa balɩpɛ-la. Wɩa baanɩŋ fa su sɛlɩmɛ gbansɩ-la nɛ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nyʋɔsʋŋ tɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kala. Wɩa tʋla arɩ ʋ doluŋ nɛ ŋaa nyʋɔsʋ-la hɛ nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ. Nʋʋkala bɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wuo jʋʋ, see Wɩa tɩndaaraa balɩpɛ-la sɩ joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ balɩpɛ-la kala hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ a dɛrɛ.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ nʋʋ yikoru-balɩŋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ a bʋla pɩ Wɩa tɩndaara-la balɩpɛ, “Má kɛŋ gbansɩ-la balɩpɛ lɛ Wɩa baanɩŋ sɩ hɛ a kaa mʋ bɩsa hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-bumbuŋ tɩɩna joŋ ʋ gbaŋa-la Wɩa baanɩŋ sɩ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ, a kaa mʋ bɩsa hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ sɩ bɩsa hɛ dɛrɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ naawɩɩl-bɔŋŋɔɔ sɩɩ wɩɩ woruŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ baga kʋ-la magɩlɩŋ lɛ, aŋ pɛ chʋɔlɛ ʋ nagɩsɩŋ ba sɩ mɛ bil.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-lɩamɩŋ joŋ ʋ gbaŋa arɩ Wɩa baanɩŋ a kaa mʋ bɩsa hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mʋgʋ-bal-la lɩɩŋ bɩrɩmɛ a nagɛ nuhuobiine sɩ sʋba chalɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a hɛ mʋgʋ-bal-la tʋɔŋ sʋʋ.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-tori-la ma kɛŋ ʋ gbaŋa kaa mʋ a bɩsa hɛ fuo-biisiŋ arɩ lɩɩ-buloo lɛ. Ba kala bɩrɩmɛ chalɩŋ.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ doluŋ ma bʋl wɩaa. Ʋ sɩ, “La Tɩɩna Wɩa, ŋ kɩaa sɩma nɛ dɩ ŋ dɔgɩsɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa. Ŋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ŋ nɛ Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ faafaa kala arɩ Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ lɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa nɩaa kpʋ ŋ nɩaa arɩ ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ. Ba sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ ŋaa chalɩŋ pɩba dɩ ba nyʋa. Ʋ maga dɩ ba nyʋa nɛ.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ nʋʋ yikoro sɩ lɩɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ. Ʋ sɩ, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ŋ kaa dii nɩaa sarɩya.”

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-nɛsɛ-la joŋ ʋ gbaŋa a bɩsa hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ lɛ, a pʋ doluŋ ʋ faasa pɔsɛ a nyɩnyɩgɛ nɩaa a nagɛ nyiniŋ.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Wɩɩ-pɔsʋ-la faasa nyɩgɛ nɩaa woruŋ, ba tʋtʋʋsɛ Wɩa joŋŋoo, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jɩma ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ nyanyal-dosunuŋ deemba kala lɛ. Ama ba bɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ dɩ ba chʋɔlɛ Wɩa.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-nɔŋ-la joŋ ʋ gbaŋa a bɩsa hɛ baga kʋ-la kuoru kpasa lɛ, birimiŋ tɔ lee-la kala ʋ sɩɩ beŋ, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɩna hɛɛŋ a dɩdɩŋ ba nandelimee.

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tʋtʋʋsɛ Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ joŋŋoo a tɩŋ ba naawɩɩla-la arɩ hɛɛ-la ba sɩɩ na wɩaa. Ama ba bɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-dʋ-la joŋ ʋ gbaŋa arɩ Wɩa baanɩŋ a bɩsa hɛ fuo-bal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Yufireti lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ fuo-la kala hʋ aŋ ka wombiiŋ pɩ kuorusu-la sɩ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ kʋkɔ.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ batori dɩ ba nagɛ yɩŋŋaa. Dɔŋɔ lɩɩ dɩŋ-la niiŋ lɛ, dɔŋɔ ma lɩɩ baga kʋ-la niiŋ lɛ, dɔŋɔ ma lɩɩ baga kʋ-lɩa-la sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ niiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: Jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ deemba batori lɩɩ Sɩtaanɩ lɛ nɛ a yie ŋɩŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ. Ba nɛ gɔllɛ dʋnɩa kuoroo kala teeŋ, a kɛmba hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ baa kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ La Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna tapʋl-bal-la.

english_verse: Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
translation_verse: Má bee na, mɩ jaŋ kɔ arɩ gaara sɩ yie kɔ ŋɩɩ. Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ doŋ pɩna aŋ pɔ lɛ, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laalɛ ʋ gɛrɩŋ, dɩ nɩaa sɩ́ ʋ yarɩ-biree na.

english_verse: Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ jɩŋ-bɔmɔ-la kɛŋ dʋnɩa kuorusu-la a kaa mʋ hilimi lee kʋbala dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ. Hiburu tɩŋŋaa yikoro lɛ baa yɩrɛ lee-la Amagɛdɔŋ.

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-pɛɩ-la joŋ ʋ gbaŋa tʋɔŋ kɩaa bɩsa hɛ peliŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ yikori-bal kʋbala lɩɩ lee-la kuoru kpasa-la sɩ chɩna Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Wɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: There were flashes of lightning, roars of thunder, and the worst earthquake in all history.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ duonuŋ lɩlɩgɩsɛ leriŋ kala, ba nɩnɩɩ yikorusuŋ, ka duonuŋ kpɩkpɩa ŋmana ŋmana, tinteeŋ ma faasa zigili. Dʋnɩa sɩ suomo kala, tinteeŋ ha bɩ ŋɩɩ zigile aŋ ka.

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Tinteeŋ sɩ zigili ŋɩɩ, tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Babɩlɔŋ kpaa leree batori, tinteyee tabalaa ma tel. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa liise mʋ yi Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, a dɔgɩsʋ woruŋ a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ na baanɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ.

english_verse: Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu arɩ peelee kala lɛl.

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa balɩpɛ-la sɩ kori gbansɩŋ balɩpɛ-la, ba dɔŋɔ kɔ mɩ teeŋ a bʋla pɩmɛ, “Kɔ dɩ mɩ dagɩŋ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ hachɔrʋŋ kpantɩɩgʋ deeŋ. Ʋ nɛ hɔŋ lee-la lɩɩŋ sɩ hɛ kɩŋkɛŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa kuoroo arɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala kɛnʋ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ a kala bugi, a nagɛ ba sɩ nyʋa sɩ-duoŋ.”

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ hɛ mɩ lɛ, Wɩa tɩndaara jommi kaa jʋʋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ tʋɔŋ. Nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ na haal kʋbala dɩ ʋ hɔŋ baga kʋfɩaŋ kʋbala nyuŋ. Ba fa ŋmʋnsɛ yɩraa sɩɩ tʋʋsɛ Wɩa joŋoo nɛ a hɛ baga kʋ-la yaraa kala lɛ. Ʋ fa kɛŋ nyusuŋ balɩpɛ nɛ, ʋ nyilliŋ ma ŋaa fii.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Haal-la fa laalɛ gɛrɩ-fɩaŋ arɩ gɛrɩ-vachalɩŋ, a hɛ sɛlɩmɛ kpɩɛraa arɩ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa a pɛ bʋ-sɩaa lɛ. Ʋ fa kori sɛlɩmɛ nyʋnyʋala nɛ. Wʋtɔɔnʋ arɩ wʋlɩɩlɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa su nyʋnyʋala-la,

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: ka ba ŋmʋnsɛ yɩrɩ-kpuŋkpere a hɛ ʋ tile lɛ: “Babɩlɔŋ ŋaa tabal nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋtɔɔnʋŋ, arɩ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ naaŋ.”

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka mɩ na haal-la dɩ ʋ nyʋa Wɩa nɩaa chalɩŋ, a pɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa a tɩŋ Yesu wɩaa lɛ a bugi. Mɩ sɩ naʋ, ʋ wɩaa kperimi kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ tɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere ŋ lɛ? Mɩ jaŋ dagɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ faa a mʋ tɩgɛ haal-la lɛ, arɩ baga kʋ-la ʋ sɩ jɩla sɩ kɛŋ nyusuŋ balɩpɛ arɩ nyilliŋ fii.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Baga kʋ-la ŋ sɩ na nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ bumbuŋ aŋ bɩra tuo. Ʋ jaŋ lɩɩ buotuo-luŋii-la tʋɔŋ kʋ lɩɩ a mʋ sʋʋ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ ka ba bɩ ba yɩraa ŋmʋnsa hɛ mɩɩsɩŋ teŋ-la lɛ a lɩɩ dʋnɩa dɩ-suomuŋ jaŋ na baga kʋ-la dɩ ʋ ŋaaba wʋkpuŋkpere, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa hɛ nɩmɛ bumbuŋ aŋ bɩra tuo, aŋ saa jaŋ bɩra kɔ.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ. Nyusuŋ balɩpɛ-la ŋaa peelee balɩpɛ nɛ. Ba nyuŋ nɛ haal-la hɔŋ. Nyusuŋ balɩpɛ-la ha ŋaa kuoroo ma balɩpɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: Kuoroo balɩpɛ-la tʋɔŋ banɔŋ nɛ sʋba, dɔŋɔ nɛ dii kuoruŋ lɛɛlɛ, aŋ ka dɔŋɔ-na ha bɩ kuoruŋ die. Dɩ ʋ ma nɛ kʋ dii kuoruŋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a dieni.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Baga kʋ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ aŋ bɩra tuo, ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa kuori-chori. Ʋ ma pɛ kuorie-la balɩpɛ-la tʋɔŋ ba sɩ jaŋ chei nɛ.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: Nyilli-la fii ŋ sɩ na ŋaa kuoroo fii nɛ, ama ba-na ha bɩ kuoruŋ die. Ba dɩ baga kʋ-la jaŋ dii kuoruŋ, ama ba kuoruŋ jaŋ ŋaa hawa bala dʋndʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Kuoroo deemba kala tʋɔbɩɩnaa ŋaa kʋbala nɛ, ba jaŋ joŋ dol-la ba sɩ kaa bibeŋ nɩaa a pɩ baga kʋ-la.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Ba dɩ Pie-bie-la jaŋ yuo dɔŋɔ, ama Pie-bie-la jaŋ yuo diiba, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ beŋ nɩaa Kʋhɩaŋ, a kɛŋ kuoroo kala ma doluŋ. Ʋ dɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo nɛ jaŋ yuo diiba. Nɩaa deemba nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ yɩra aŋ lɩɩsɛ, ba ŋaa nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.”

english_verse: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, “Lɩɩrɩ-la ŋ fa sɩ na lee-la hachɔrʋŋ-la fa sɩ hɔnɔ ŋaa nuhuobiinee nɛ, a yʋgɛ woruŋ, a lɩɩ tintee kala aa bʋl yikoro kala.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Nyilli-la fii ma ŋ sɩ na, ba dɩ baga kʋ-la jaŋ bɛrɛ hachɔrʋŋ-la. Ba jaŋ wuri ʋ kɩaa ta ka dɩ ʋ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree. Ba jaŋ chaŋ ʋ nammɩa aŋ nyɩgɛ ʋ haŋgbelee.

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
translation_verse: Wɩa nɛ joŋ ŋɩɩ tʋɔbɩɩnaa hɛ ba lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ cho. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba sɛɩ a joŋ dol-la ba sɩ kɛnɛ a bibeŋ nɩaa a pɩpɩ baga kʋ-la. Ba jaŋ bibeŋ kʋ-la, see dɩ wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ bʋla ŋaa dɛrɛ.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Haal-la ŋ sɩ na ŋaa tabal nɛ. Tabalɩŋ deeŋ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ a bibeŋ kuorusu-la sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala sɩ ŋaa bal, mɩ bɩra na Wɩa tɩndaara dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a kʋ tuu tinteeŋ. Ʋ fa kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ, ka ʋ tʋla leŋ dʋnɩa kala pʋllɛ.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ faasa suri ʋ yikoro a bʋl, “Babɩlɔŋ tele, Babɩlɔŋ tabal-la tele. Ʋ lɛɛlɛ bɩrɩmɛ jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ diibiisiŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ kɩɩsʋ kala dɩjʋʋlʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.”
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa joŋ ba wʋlɩɩlɩŋ a dagɛ tintee kala nɩaa nɛ. Wʋlɩɩlɩ-la nagɛ sɩ-duoŋ nɛ. Dʋnɩa kuoroo ma kɛnʋ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ. Dʋnɩa bayalaa ma to ʋ wʋlɩɩlɩ-la lɛ a dʋa kɩaa.”

english_verse: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, “My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra nɩɩ nʋʋ yikoro dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ aa bʋl, “Mɩ nɩaa, má sii Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ma jaŋ pɛ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ pɛ dɔgɩsɛma arɩ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ dɔgɩsɛ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa ŋɩɩ.

english_verse: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.
translation_verse: Ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chʋara nɛ a jɩlaa tɩgɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa bɩ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa yʋa.

english_verse: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.
translation_verse: Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa ma lɛ, má ma joŋo ŋaa ba lɛ, a tiŋ ma chɩmɩŋ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa. Gbaŋa-la ba sɩ kaa ŋaa sɩnɩŋ pɩma ma nyʋa, má ma kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a ŋaa sɩnɩŋ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa pɩba dɩ ba nyʋa.

english_verse: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. “Deep in her heart Babylon said, ‘I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.’
translation_verse: Má dɔgɩsɛba dɩ ba na hɛɛŋ, a magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ nɩɩ sɩma. Ba yie bɩɩnɛ ba kuoro nɛ, ba tʋɔŋ bɩ jaŋ chei a nagɛ yo-haala. Ba yie bʋl arɩ ba bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba yele.

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ deemba jaŋ jʋʋba chɛ-bala: Ʋ nɩaa jaŋ sʋʋ, dɩ ba tʋɔŋ chei, dɩ losuŋ ma jʋʋba. Nyiniŋ ma jaŋ diiba. Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ jaŋ diiu sarɩya kɛŋ doluŋ.”

english_verse: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.
translation_verse: Dɩ dʋnɩa kuorusu-la sɩ kɛnʋ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ aŋ pɛ nɩɩ ʋ sɩma-la nɛ na nyiŋ-la sɩɩ diiu nyʋɔsʋŋ, ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ chei dɩ ba yel.

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ beŋ hɛɛ-la taŋ-la nɩaa sɩɩ na, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmba. Ba jaŋ chɩŋ dɩ-bolii a ŋmoo niiŋ bʋl, “Ou, ou, tabalɩŋ deeŋ, tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Babɩlɔŋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ, ʋ bɩ diene ka ba dɔgɩsʋ.”

english_verse: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.
translation_verse: Dʋnɩa bayalaa jaŋ yel Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋkala tuo a bɩraa yɔɔ ba kɩaa.

english_verse: There won't be anyone to buy their gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, sweet-smelling wood, fancy carvings of ivory and wood, as well as things made of bronze, iron, or marble.
translation_verse: Kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ yallɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, tabɩɩ-tʋlaa, bʋ-sɩaa gɛrɩpɛ tʋlaa, gɛrɩpɛ-fʋfʋlaa, gɛrɩpɛ-fɩɛsɩŋ, arɩ daasɩ-la kala yallɩŋ sɩ hɛyɛ, arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kɛŋ batu-nyɩlaa ŋaa, arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kɛŋ daa-la yallɩŋ sɩ hɛyɛ saa, arɩ kɔlɩɩŋ, arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ hɔɔŋ ŋaa, arɩ lokuŋ-bʋɩyaa,

english_verse: No one will buy their cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and other humans.
translation_verse: kɩaa ba sɩ yie joŋo hɛ kʋdiilee lɛ ba sʋɔra sɩŋ arɩ tegisiŋ, kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ, tɩɩ-kel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ mɛɛ arɩ fɩraŋkɩsɛŋ, sɩnɩŋ, nʋʋŋ, munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ, mɩaa, nɛsɩŋ, arɩ piesee, arɩ janɩŋ, arɩ janɩŋ torukoba, arɩ yosuŋ arɩ nɩaa ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ laalɩŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.
translation_verse: Bayalɩa-la jaŋ bɩra bʋl, “Kʋzɔmɔ-la kala ma fa sɩɩ hɩɛnʋ, ma tel ba kala lɛ nɛ, ma kʋzɔŋ-zɔŋ-na kala arɩ ma sɩma-la kala ma fa sɩɩ nɩɩ, ba bɩra tuo. Ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ma naba.”

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Bayalɩa-la kala fa sɩ yallɛ kɩaa pɩ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa aa na moribiee, ba jaŋ fá fawʋllʋŋ a tɩŋ hɛɛ-la Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa sɩɩ na. Ba kala jaŋ chɩŋ dɩ-bolii a faasa ŋmoo niiŋ a yele bʋbʋl,

english_verse: Then they shouted, “Pity the great city of Babylon! She dressed in fine linen and wore purple and scarlet cloth. She had jewelry made of gold and precious stones and pearls.
translation_verse: “Ou, ou, tabalɩŋ deeŋ fa zɔmɔ a kɛŋ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ maa. Ʋ nɩaa fa lɩlaalɛ gɛrɩpɛ-tʋlaa, gɛrɩpɛ-vachalɩŋ arɩ gɛrɩ-fɩɛsɩŋ gɛnnɩŋ, a lɩlaalɛ banzɔlɔba ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ, tabɩɩ-tʋlaa arɩ bʋ-sɩaa a ŋaa.

english_verse: Yet in a single hour her riches disappeared.” Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea.
translation_verse: Ʋ bɩ diene ka kɩaa deemba kala lɛl ŋ teeŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ duori lɩɩŋ dabori-bala-la sɩɩ vɛŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ kʋhɩasɩŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ daboro-la tʋɔŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ jʋʋ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ a mʋmʋ leree, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ chɛ kɩaa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ, ba chɩŋ dɩ-bolii.

english_verse: When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”
translation_verse: Dɩ ba nɛ na nyiŋ-la sɩɩ diiu nyʋɔsʋŋ, ba jaŋ ŋmoo niiŋ a bʋl, “Ta bɛɛ nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ a magɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ?”

english_verse: They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said, “Pity the great city of Babylon! Everyone who sailed the seas became rich from her treasures. But in a single hour the city was destroyed.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ ŋaa hagɩla hɩhɛ ba nyusuŋ lɛ aŋ yele bʋbʋl, “Ou, ou, tabalɩŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ to a jigi. Má bee na, ʋ bɩ diene ka kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ fa sɩ kɛnɛ lɛl.

english_verse: The heavens should be happy with God's people and apostles and prophets. God has punished her for them.”
translation_verse: Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ, má jʋjʋɔsɛ Babɩlɔŋ wɩaa. Ma Wɩa nɩaa arɩ Wɩa nanzɔɔba arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa, má jʋjʋɔsɛ. Wɩa joŋ wɩalɩŋ Babɩlɔŋ sɩ ŋaa ma lɛ chɩmɩŋ a tiŋ ʋ lɛ nɛ.”

english_verse: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, “This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarɩ-duo kʋbala joŋ tabɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ magɛ nɔmʋŋ a yuo hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ aŋ bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba jaŋ ŋaa Babɩlɔŋ tabal-la lɛ. Ba jaŋ joŋu yuo ta arɩ doluŋ. Ʋ jaŋ lɛl dʋnɩa lɛ.

english_verse: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.
translation_verse: Nʋʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ nɩɩ cheŋ-dunuŋ nɩmɛ, nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa nɩmɛ, ŋmʋl-ŋmɩɩraa arɩ nyil-ŋmɩɩraa ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋmʋŋmʋʋ. Tɩntɩnnɩ-gɔgɔ kala bɩra bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ nʋnɔŋ munuŋ ʋ lɛ.

english_verse: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.
translation_verse: Chaanaa ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ chaanɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ. Baalaa arɩ haalaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ jaa dɔŋɔ ʋ lɛ. Babɩlɔŋ bayalaa nɛ fa ŋaa nɩbalaa dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ chichiribi wɩaa a nyɩsɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala.

english_verse: On the streets of Babylon is found the blood of God's people and of his prophets, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Babɩlɔŋ lɛ nɛ ba kpʋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa, arɩ Wɩa nɩaa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala bɩ sɩ kpʋa dʋnɩa lɛ.”

english_verse: After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting, “Praise the Lord! To our God belongs the glorious power to save,
translation_verse: Wɩaa deemba kala sɩ ŋaa harɩŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ goŋ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. Goŋ-la nagɛ nɩ-daŋ yikoro nɛ aa bʋl, “Haleluya, La Tɩɩna Wɩa kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ laala ta. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ arɩ doluŋ.

english_verse: because his judgments are honest and fair. That filthy prostitute ruined the earth with shameful deeds. But God has judged her and made her pay the price for murdering his servants.”
translation_verse: Ʋʋ dii nɩaa sarɩya arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ dii hachɔrʋŋ-bal-la sarɩya nɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ a chei dʋnɩa kala. Wɩa dɔgɩsʋ nɛ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ kpʋ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa.”

english_verse: Then the crowd shouted, “Praise the Lord! Smoke will never stop rising from her burning body.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩra ŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “Haleluya, nyiŋ-la sɩɩ dii haal-la nyʋɔsʋŋ ka jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.”

english_verse: From the throne a voice said, “If you worship and fear our God, give praise to him, no matter who you are.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ nʋʋ yikoro lɩɩ Wɩa kuoru kpasa-la teeŋ a bʋl, “Ma Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa kala arɩ ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ fáʋ, nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ hambiisiŋ kala, má leŋ dɩ la dɛnnɛ Wɩa.”

english_verse: Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying, “Praise the Lord! Our Lord God All-Powerful now rules as king.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra nɩɩ nɩ-daŋ goŋ. Goŋ-la fa nagɛ fuo-balaa sɩɩ pɛllʋ nɛ gbul gbul. Ʋ bɩra nagɛ duonuŋ sɩɩ kpɩa ŋmana ŋmana aŋ pɛ lɩlɩgɩsɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ yikoro-la heele bʋl, “Haleluya, La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna dii ʋ kuoruŋ nɛ.

english_verse: So we will be glad and happy and give him praise. The wedding day of the Lamb is here, and his bride is ready.
translation_verse: Má leŋ dɩ la jʋjʋɔsɛ a yɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ a dɛnnʋ woruŋ. Bʋa-la Pie-bie-la sɩ jaŋ jaa haala yie nɛ. Haal-la ma sɩ jaŋ jaaʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: She will be given a wedding dress made of pure and shining linen. This linen stands for the good things God's people have done.”
translation_verse: Ba joŋ gɛrɩpɛ tʋlʋŋ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ a pɩ haal-la dɩ ʋ laalɛ. Gɛrɩpɛ tʋlɩɩ-la nɛ ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔpʋl wʋŋaalaa.”

english_verse: Then the angel told me, “Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” The angel also said, “These things God has said are true.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bʋla pɩmɛ, “Ŋmʋnsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ‘Wɩa jaŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yɩra dɩ ba kʋ gbieli Pie-bie-la hajaarɩ gbiele a dii kʋdiilee nɩmɛ.’ ” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bʋla pɩmɛ, “Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ ŋɩɩ.”

english_verse: I knelt at the feet of the angel and began to worship him. But the angel said, “Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you and everyone else who tells about Jesus. Don't worship anyone but God. Everyone who tells about Jesus does it by the power of the Spirit.” The Rider on the White Horse
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tuu kpirimi dɩ mɩ chʋɔlʋ, ama ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, la kala ŋaa tɩntɩnnaa a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa, la dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Yesu sɩ bʋla. Wɩa nɛ maga ŋ chʋɔlɛ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ-la Yesu sɩ daga nɛ leŋe Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa kɛŋ doluŋ aa bʋl Wɩa wɩaa.” Ja-pʋla jɩjɩllʋ-la

english_verse: I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na Wɩa-jaŋ dɩ ʋ suro. Mɩ beŋ a na ja-pʋla dɩ nʋʋ jɩla. Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩla yɩrɩŋ nɛ Nɩtɛŋɛ arɩ Wʋtɩtɩɩ Tɩɩna. Ʋ dii nɩaa sarɩya arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, aa yuo laalɩŋ ma arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ.

english_verse: He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.
translation_verse: Ʋ sɩaa kala chuchol a nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ, aŋ ka ʋ chu kuori-nyunchuuluŋ a yʋgɛ. Ba ŋmʋnsɛ yɩrɩŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ, ama nʋʋkala bɩ yɩrɩ-la jɩŋ, see ʋ tɩtɩa.

english_verse: The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as “The Word of God.”
translation_verse: Ʋ laalɛ gɛrɩŋ chalɩŋ sɩ mɩsa nɛ. Baa yɩrɛ nɩɩ-la yɩrɩŋ Wɩa Niiŋ Wɩaa nɛ.

english_verse: He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen.
translation_verse: Wɩa-jaŋ laalɩyuoroo laalɛ gɛrɩ-fʋfʋlaa, a ma jɩl ja-pʋllʋŋ a tuto ʋ harɩŋ nɛ.

english_verse: From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ tokobiiŋ sɩ kɛŋ niiŋ woruŋ nyagaga lɩɩ ʋ niiŋ lɛ a kʋ lɩɩ. Tokobii-la nɛ ʋ jaŋ kaa yuo dii tinteyee nɩaa kala. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ hɔɔŋ dantɩga a beŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa. Ʋ jaŋ dagɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa ŋɩɩ Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ na baanɩŋ ba nyuŋ a magɛ. Ʋ jaŋ nʋɔsɛ ba bʋrɩgɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ yie bʋrɩgɛ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ ŋɩɩ a lɩɩsɛ sɩnɩŋ.

english_verse: On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, “KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF LordS.”
translation_verse: Ba ŋmʋnsɛ yɩrɩŋ deeŋ nɛ hɛ gɛrɩ-duduoŋ-la ʋ sɩ laala lɛ arɩ ʋ naapuiŋ lɛ: “KUOROO KALA KUOROO ARƖ LA TƖNNABA KALA TƖƖNA.”

english_verse: I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, “Come and join in God's great feast!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ ka mɩ na Wɩa tɩndaarʋ kʋbala dɩ ʋ chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ lɛ, a yɩrɛ diibiisi-la kala sɩɩ fil wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii arɩ yikoru-balɩŋ a bʋl, “Má kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a dii kʋdii daŋ-la Wɩa sɩ ŋaa.

english_verse: You can eat the flesh of kings, rulers, leaders, horses, riders, free people, slaves, important people, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Má kʋ dii kuoroo nammɩa, laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩduoruŋ nammɩa, janɩŋ arɩ ba jɩjɩllaa nammɩa, nuhuobiinee, nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩɩ ba tɩtɩa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa yosuŋ, nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ hambiisiŋ kala nammɩa.”

english_verse: I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka mɩ na baga kʋ-la arɩ dʋnɩa kuoroo arɩ ba laalɩyuoroo dɩ ba hilime dɩ ba yuo nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩl jɔɔ-la arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo.

english_verse: But the beast was captured and so was the false prophet. This is the same prophet who had worked miracles for the beast, so he could fool everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into a lake of burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩl jɔɔ-la arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo yuo dii baga kʋ-la a kɛŋ ʋ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ kala. Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa baga kʋ-la nyuŋ a wuo nyɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ baga kʋ-la magɩlɩŋ, aa chʋɔlɛ baga kʋ-la nagɩsɩŋ ba sɩ mɛ bil. Nɩaa deemba balɩa kʋweyee nɛ ba joŋo yuo hɛ Wɩa nyiŋ-la sɩɩ dii a nagɛ jiribiiŋ lɛ.

english_verse: But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩl jɔɔ-la kɛŋ tokobii-la sɩ lɩɩ ʋ niiŋ lɛ kaa kpʋ nɩkaanaa. Diibiisiŋ lorigi ba nampɩlɩŋ kala.

english_verse: I saw thrones, and sitting on those thrones were the ones who had been given the right to judge. I also saw the souls of the people who had their heads cut off because they had told about Jesus and preached God's message. They were the same ones who had not worshiped the beast or the idol, and they had refused to let its mark be put on their foreheads or hands. They will come to life and rule with Christ for
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na kuoru kpasɩnɩŋ dɩ nɩaa hɔŋ ba nyuŋ. Nɩaa deemba nɛ Wɩa pa doluŋ dɩ ba dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya. Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ ka mɩ na nɩaa dɩnsɩŋ. Nɩaa deemba nɛ faa bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ-la Yesu fa sɩ daga a pɩ nɩaa, aŋ pɛɛ bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kpʋba a keri ba nyusuŋ. Nɩaa deemba-na fa bɩ baga kʋ-la ka chʋɔlɛ, ba bɩ kʋ-la ba sɩ mɛ ʋ nagʋ ma chʋɔlɛ. Ba bɩ baga kʋ-la magɩlɩŋ kɛnɛ ba tilliŋ lɛ koo ba nɩsaa lɛ. Nɩaa deemba sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, ba dɩ Kirisito dii kuoruŋ a beŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa jɩsɩŋ bʋɩ.

english_verse: These people are the first to be raised to life, and they are especially blessed and holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and Christ and will rule with them for
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, ba bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ. Nɩaa deemba sʋʋ bala nɛ, sʋʋ-lɩa-la ma bɩ jaŋ wuoba. Ba jaŋ laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa arɩ Kirisito. Ba dɩ Kirisito jaŋ dii kuoruŋ jɩsɩŋ bʋɩ. Ba yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ

english_verse: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach,
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ a nyɩsɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ sɛmɛ-na kala lɛ dɩ ba kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a yuo laalɩŋ. Gɔg arɩ Magɔg nɩaa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba yʋga nɛ woruŋ a nagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ hagɩlɩ-bumbugulo.

english_verse: and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba dʋʋrɛ dʋnɩa kala a mʋ golli lee-la Wɩa nɩaa sɩ hɛ, arɩ taŋ-la Wɩa sɩ cho. Ama nyiniŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a kʋ tuu dii ba kala.

english_verse: Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever. The Judgment at the Great White Throne
translation_verse: Sɩtaanɩ nɛ nyɩsɛ Gɔg arɩ Magɔg nɩaa hɛ dɩ ba yuo Wɩa nɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋu a yuo hɛ nyiniŋ sɩɩ dii a nagɛ jiribiiŋ lɛ, lee-la ba sɩ joŋ baga kʋ-la arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ a yuo a hɛ. Ba jaŋ na hɛɛŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala a kaa mʋ wuu. Ba dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya

english_verse: I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na kuori-kpasɩ-bal kʋbala sɩ ŋaa kʋpʋla dɩ ʋ chɩna, nʋʋ hɔŋ ʋ nyuŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na dɩ tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kala lɛlɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩŋ lɛ. Ba bɩra bɩ lee kɛnɛ.

english_verse: I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ka mɩ na nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba, nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ hambiisiŋ kala, dɩ ba chɩŋ kuoru kpasa-la sɩpaaŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba suri tenniŋ, a bɩra suri teniŋ dɔŋɔ ma, mɩɩsɩŋ teniŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Tenni-la lɛ nɛ ba ŋmʋnsɛ nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ wʋŋaalaa hɛ, ba lɛ nɛ ba to a dii nʋʋkala sɩ sʋba sarɩya.

english_verse: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ sʋʋ ʋ tʋɔŋ kʋ lɩɩ. Sʋʋŋ arɩ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ ma joŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ba lɛ ta, ba kala kʋ lɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba beŋ nʋʋkala wʋŋaalaa sɩ maga ŋɩɩ a dii ʋ sarɩya.

english_verse: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ sʋʋŋ arɩ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ a yuo hɛ nyiŋ-bal-la lɛ. Nyiŋ-bal-la nɛ ŋaa sʋʋ bʋlɩa.

english_verse: Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala yɩrɩŋ nɛ tuo mɩɩsɩŋ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ, ba yie joŋu yuo hɛ nyiŋ-bal-la tʋɔŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na Wɩa-jaŋ kʋfalɩɩ arɩ tintee-falɩɩ. Bumbuŋ Wɩa-jaŋ arɩ bumbuŋ tinteeŋ kala lɛlɛ nɛ. Mʋga kala tuo.

english_verse: I heard a loud voice shout from the throne: God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ ka mɩ nɩɩ nʋʋ yikori-balɩŋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ kuoru kpasa-la sɛmɛ a bʋl, “Má bee na, lɛɛlɛ Wɩa kɔ nuhuobiine teeŋ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ hɔŋ ba tʋɔŋ. Ba nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ nɩaa. Wɩa tɩtɩa jaŋ hɔŋ ba teeŋ a ŋaa ba Wɩa.

english_verse: He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.
translation_verse: Ʋ jaŋ fɩɩsɛ ba sɩlɩɩrɩŋ kala ta. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ, ba tʋɔŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ chei. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ yel a bɩra bɩ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ma, bɛɛ wɩaa wʋbɩnɩa-la kala bala nɛ.”

english_verse: Then the one sitting on the throne said: I am making everything new. Write down what I have said. My words are true and can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɔŋ kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ bʋl, “Má bee na, mɩ ŋaa kʋŋkala bɩrɩmɛ kʋfalɩɩ nɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bɩra bʋl, “Ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ bʋla, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, a magɛ dɩ nɩaa laaba dii.”

english_verse: Everything is finished! I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give water from the life-giving fountain to everyone who is thirsty.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Wɩɩkala dɛrɛ nɛ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa Alɩfa arɩ Omega, mɩ nɛ dɩ-suomuŋ arɩ dɩdɛrɩŋ. Nɩɩ-la kala lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ sɩ kɛnɛ, mɩ jaŋ ŋaa lɩɩ-bulo lɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ a pʋ dɩ ʋ nyʋa pɛɩ.

english_verse: All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ wuo yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ jaŋ na kɩaa deemba kala. Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ Wɩa, ʋ ma jaŋ ŋaa mɩ bii.

english_verse: But I will tell you what will happen to cowards and to everyone who is unfaithful or dirty-minded or who murders or is sexually immoral or uses witchcraft or worships idols or tells lies. They will be thrown into that lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa fawʋlʋba, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii, arɩ disiŋ ŋaaraa, arɩ nɩkpʋʋraa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa chichiribi wɩaa, arɩ vʋɩ-kpaaraa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa, ba jaŋ jʋʋ nyiniŋ sɩɩ dii a nagɛ jiribiiŋ tʋɔŋ. Sʋʋ bʋlɩa-la nɛ ŋɩɩ.” Jerusalɛm falɩɩ-la

english_verse: I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa balɩpɛ-la sɩ kori gbansɩŋ balɩpɛ-la sɩ suo arɩ dɩdɛrɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la balɩpɛ kʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Kɔ dɩ mɩ dagɩŋ haal-la Pie-bie-la sɩ jaŋ jaa.”

english_verse: Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ kʋ hɛ mɩ lɛ, Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la jommi kaa jɩl peel-bal kʋbala sɩ leŋie nyuŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ dagɛmɛ taŋ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ baa yɩrɛ Jerusalɛm, dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kuu tuu tinteeŋ.

english_verse: The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone.
translation_verse: Wɩa tʋla chaana hɛ taŋ-la lɛ, ʋ tʋtʋl a nagɛ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa, a bɩra nagɛ tabɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ jasɩpa, a tʋtʋl a nagɛ beenantɩrɛ.

english_verse: The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Taŋ-la kɛŋ kɛrɛ-bal kʋbala nɛ. Ʋ leŋie nɛ woruŋ a kɛŋ boiŋ-niiriŋ fii arɩ balɩa a golli. Wɩa tɩndaaraa fii arɩ balɩa chɩŋ boye-la lɛ, ka ba ŋmʋnsɛ Iziral doho doho fii arɩ balɩa-la yɩraa hɛ boye-la lɛ.

english_verse: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.
