translation_verse: Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ kɛŋ boyee batori nɛ, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa ma kɛŋ batori, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ ma kɛŋ batori, wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ma kɛŋ batori.

english_verse: The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
translation_verse: Kɛrɛ-la gentine lɛ, ba bil tabɩaa fii arɩ balɩa nɛ. Tabɩa-la lɛ nɛ ba ŋmʋnsɛ Pie-bie-la nanzɔɔba fii arɩ balɩa-la yɩraa hɛ.

english_verse: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls.
translation_verse: Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ kori sɛlɩmɛ daaŋ ba sɩ kaa magɩsɛ kɩaa nɛ dɩ ʋ kaa magɩsɛ tabal-la arɩ ʋ boi-baalaa arɩ ʋ kɛrɩsɩŋ.

english_verse: The city was shaped like a cube, because it was just as high as it was wide. When the angel measured the city, it was about
translation_verse: Tabal-la sɛsɩŋ kala magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ magɩsɛ taŋ-la arɩ sɛlɩmɛ daa-la dɩ ʋ ŋaa meel-daasɩŋ bʋɩ arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ. Ʋ duomuŋ arɩ ʋ jalɩŋ arɩ ʋ leŋiŋ kala magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Ba kɛŋ tabɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ jasɩpa nɛ kaa saa kɛrɛ-la, aŋ ka tabal-la kala ŋaa sɛlɩmɛ, a kala chaanɛ pɩrr a nagɛ beenantɩrɛ.

english_verse: Each of the twelve foundations was a precious stone. The first was jasper, the second was sapphire, the third was agate, the fourth was emerald,
translation_verse: Tabal-la kɛrɛ-la gentine tabɩaa kala ŋaa tabɩɩ-zɔmɔ nɛ ba kaa kpɩɛrɛ. Bumbuŋ kʋa yɩrɩŋ nɛ jasɩpa, lɩamɩŋ kʋa ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ safɩya, torimuŋ kʋa ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ agɛtɩ, nɛsɩmɩŋ kʋa ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ ɛmɛral,

english_verse: the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.
translation_verse: nɔŋ kʋa yɩrɩŋ nɛ ɔnɩs, dʋmʋŋ kʋa yɩrɩŋ nɛ kaanɛlɩaŋ, pɛɛmɩŋ kʋa yɩrɩŋ nɛ kirisola, chorimuŋ kʋa ma ŋaa bɛrɛl, nibimiŋ kʋa ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ topas, fiimiŋ kʋa yɩrɩŋ nɛ kirisopiris, fii arɩ kʋŋ kʋa yɩrɩŋ nɛ jasɩŋ, ka fii arɩ balɩamɩŋ kʋa ma yɩrɩŋ ŋaa amɛtɩs.

english_verse: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Boi-baala-la fii arɩ balɩa kala ŋaa bʋ-sɩaa fii arɩ balɩa nɛ. Boi-kala ŋaa bʋ-sɩɩ bala. Tabal-la womporuŋ kala, sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ ba kaa ŋaa, a tʋtʋl a nagɛ beenantɩrɛ.

english_verse: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ tabal-la tʋɔŋ a bɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal kala na nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa La Tɩɩna Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna arɩ Pie-bie-la nɛ ŋaa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lee-la.

english_verse: And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
translation_verse: Tabal-la bɩra bɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ chɛnɛ ka chɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa tʋla nɛ ŋaa ba pʋlʋmʋŋ. Pie-bie-la ma nɛ ŋaa ba chaanɩŋ.

english_verse: Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there.
translation_verse: Ʋ pʋlʋmʋŋ lɛ nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ vɛŋ. Dʋnɩa kuoroo kala jaŋ kɛŋ ba dʋa kaa jʋʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.
translation_verse: Ba bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba kɛŋ tabal-la boi-baala-la kaa tɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa, tɩtaŋɩŋ tuo nɩmɛ.

english_verse: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.
translation_verse: Tinteyee nɩaa kala jaŋ kɛŋ ba dʋa arɩ ba kuori kɩaa kaa jʋʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_verse: Ama kʋŋkala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ, koo nɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa nɩbɔŋ, koo wʋnyɩɛrʋ kala bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ taŋ-la, see nɩalɩŋ Pie-bie-la sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa hɛ mɩɩsɩŋ teŋ-la lɛ nɛ jaŋ jʋʋ nɩmɛ.

english_verse: The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bɩra dagɛmɛ fuo-la lɩɩŋ sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ. Lɩɩ-la kala pʋlla nɛ chɩl chɩl a nagɛ beenantɩrɛ. Lɩɩ-la pɛllɛ lɩɩ Wɩa arɩ Pie-bie-la kuoru kpasa-la teeŋ nɛ,

english_verse: Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
translation_verse: a pɛllɛ to tabal-la womporuŋ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, ka tɩa-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ chɩŋ fuo-la cholluŋ balɩa-la kala lɛ. Tɩa-la yie nɛŋ nɛŋ-dosunuŋ naansɩɩŋ fii arɩ balɩa jɩna kala. Chɛnɛ kala ʋ yie nɛŋ bala. Tɩa-la pɩpaarɩŋ nɛ tinteyee nɩaa kaa vɩvaarɛ ba tɩtɩa.

english_verse: God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God
translation_verse: Kʋŋ na-kala lɛ Wɩa sɩ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ bɩ jaŋ hɛ tabal-la tʋɔŋ. Wɩa kuoru kpasa arɩ Pie-bie-la kpasa jaŋ hɛ lee-la, ka ʋ tɩntɩnnaa chʋɔlʋ.

english_verse: and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people.
translation_verse: Ba jaŋ na ʋ sɩaa, ka ʋ yɩrɩŋ hɛ ba tilliŋ lɛ.

english_verse: Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever. The Coming of Christ
translation_verse: Taŋ bɩ jaŋ biri nɩmɛ. Ba bɩ chaanɩŋ koo wɩɩpɔsʋŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ chɛ nɩmɛ. La Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ba pʋlʋmʋŋ. Ba nɛ jaŋ beŋ dʋnɩa a kaa mʋ wuu. Yesu sɩ dɩ ʋ jaŋ kɔ lɛɛlɛ

english_verse: Then I was told: These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, “Wɩaa deemba ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ a magɛ dɩ nɩaa laaba dii. La Tɩɩna Wɩa, Nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a hɛ ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ tɩŋ ʋ tɩndaara dɩ ʋ kʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa lɛɛlɛ a pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa.”

english_verse: Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ, “Má bee na, mɩ jaŋ kɔ lɛɛlɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ a hɛ teniŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ, Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ.”

english_verse: My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Jɔɔŋ, mɩ nɛ nɩɩ wɩaa deemba aŋ pɛ na ma. Mɩ sɩ nɩɩba aŋ pɛ na ŋɩɩ, mɩ tuu kpirimi Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ dagɛmɛ wɩaa deemba sɩpaaŋ dɩ mɩ chʋɔlʋ.

english_verse: But the angel said, Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, mɩ dɩŋ arɩ ŋ naambiiri-la kala sɩ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ teniŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ. Wɩa nɛ maga ŋ chʋɔlɛ.”

english_verse: Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má leŋ dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ kɛŋ ŋɩɩ naaŋ lɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ ma kɛŋ ŋɩɩ naaŋ lɛ a ŋɩŋaa disiniŋ, dɩ nɩzɔŋŋɔɔ ma kɛŋ ŋɩɩ naaŋ lɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa ma kɛŋ ŋɩɩ naaŋ lɛ a ŋɩŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa.”

english_verse: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
translation_verse: Yesu sɩ, “Má bee na, mɩ jaŋ kɔ lɛɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ kʋ tiŋ nʋʋkala. Nʋʋkala sɩ tɩma magɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ jaŋ laa ʋ time.

english_verse: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
translation_verse: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Wɩa wɩaa, Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ dɩ ba wuo na wombiiŋ a to tabal-la boi-baalaa jʋʋ, a wuo dii tɩa-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ nɛnɛɛ.

english_verse: But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
translation_verse: Ama nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ chɩŋ taŋ-la jeeŋ harɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ wʋŋaalaa sɩ nagɛ vasɩŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa chichiribi wɩaa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpʋ nɩaa, arɩ vʋɩ-kpaaraa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ cho wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ aa nyɩɛ wɩaa, ba kala jaŋ chɩŋ taŋ-la jeeŋ harɩŋ.

english_verse: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Yesu nɛ tɩŋ mɩ tɩndaara dɩ ʋ kɔ ma teeŋ a bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa mɩ wɩaa dii a hihilimi lee na-kala. Mɩ ŋaa Devit dɩa nɩaa gentine nɛ, a ŋaa ʋ doho nʋʋ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa nanyʋɔlʋŋ.”

english_verse: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
translation_verse: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ arɩ haal-la Pie-bie-la sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ jaa bʋla pɩ nɩaa, “Má kɔ. Nʋʋkala sɩ nɩa, má leŋ dɩ ʋ kɔ. Nʋʋ na-kala lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ sɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ kɔ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho dɩ ʋ nyʋa lɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ sɩ ŋaa chɔgɩta kʋŋ, ʋ kɔ a nyʋa.” Wʋkaanaa

english_verse: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.
translation_verse: Mɩ-na Jɔɔŋ chɛ dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ nɩɩ wɩaa deemba ba sɩ bʋla hɛ teniŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ, dɩ ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa woruŋ arɩ wɩaa deemba lɛ. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩ pɛ wɩaa deemba lɛ, Wɩa ma jaŋ joŋ nyanyal-bɔmɔ-la ba sɩ daga teniŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ a dɔgɩsɛ ʋ tɩɩna.

english_verse: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
translation_verse: Dɩ nʋʋkala ma nɛ lɩɩsɛ wɩaa deemba kʋŋ ta, Wɩa ma jaŋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩɩna ta. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ pʋ wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ na wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ teniŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ tɩɩna bɩ jaŋ wuo dii tɩa-la sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ nɛnɛɛ. Ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa tabal-la ma.

english_verse: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
translation_verse: Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagɛ wɩaa deemba sɩ, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩɩ kɔ nɛ lɛɛlɛ.” Amɩɩ, kɔ, La Tɩɩna Yesu.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: La Tɩɩna Yesu lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, Wɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Amɩɩ.
